title: Static : The Beginning
description:
게임 정보
공포와 미스터리의 세계에 빠져보세요
STATIC에서 당신은 평범한 젊은 여성인 클라라가 되어 플레이합니다. 그녀의 삶은 평범한 저녁, TV를 시청하는 것으로 시작되었지만, 곧 끔찍한 악몽으로 변하고 맙니다. 조용했던 밤이 순식간에 공포로 뒤바뀌며, 클라라는 자신의 TV 속 뒤틀린 차원에 갇히게 됩니다. 가까스로 현실 세계로 돌아오지만, 그녀는 이것이 단순한 시작에 불과하다는 사실을 깨닫게 됩니다…
주요 특징
🔹 몰입감 넘치는 탐험 : 아름답게 구현된 모로코 리야드(전통 저택)를 탐험하며, 세밀한 디테일 속에서 숨겨진 공포를 발견하세요.

title: Mountain 78
description:
게임 정보
단순한 게임, 어려운 도전
Mountain 78은 단 세 번의 점프만으로 산을 오르는 게임입니다.
모든 움직임이 중요하며, 한 번의 실수로 다시 바닥으로 떨어질 수도 있습니다.
이 게임은 "포디안(Foddian)" 장르와, 진행을 잃는 것이 도전의 일부가 되는 정밀한 게임에서 영감을 받았습니다.
왜 "78"인가요?
이 숫자는 일본 속담을 기억하기 쉽게 하기 위해 사용되었습니다.
"일곱 번 넘어져도, 여덟 번 일어나라." (七転び八起き, Nanakorobi yaoki)
특징:
신중한 조작이 필요한 등반 도전
내러티브 대화 없이
정상에 도달하면 멋진 불꽃놀이 보상
넘어지고 다시 도전하는 것이 게임의 일부
당신은 정상에 도달할 수 있을까요?

title: TankOre Mining
description:
게임 정보
Four Tank Types
Buy new mining tanks for faster mining: Driller for close-range mining; Blaster for mid-range explosive blast; Detonator for long-range explosion; and Ravager for massive, long-range explosion.
Tank Upgrades
Upgrade your mining tank by purchasing enhancements to increase durability, heat levels, reduce incoming damage, and improve ore collection efficiency.
Challenging Hazards and Traps
Avoid deadly environmental traps, such as corrosive gas, explosive rocks, shockwaves, falling boulders, and waves of fire explosions. Adapt your strategy to survive as you delve deeper into dangerous floors.
Strategic Resource Management
Balance heat buildup and durability to extend your mining expeditions. Collect valuable components to boost your tank’s regeneration capabilities.
Dynamic Mining Gameplay
Explore layered floors filled with valuable ores, components, and rare artifacts. Artifacts, which sell for a high price, may spawn on every 5th floor.
Universal Detector
A reliable tool that detects surrounding ores and components. Artifacts, however, are undetectable, inspiring deeper exploration and rewarding keen discovery skills.

title: Spirit Valor
description:
게임 정보
Spirit Valor에서 당신은 마법과 운명 사이에서 고군분투하는 영혼이 됩니다. 마법 폭발로 인간 전사 리차드의 몸에 갇힌 그는 악마의 세력이 일어나는 것을 막기 위해 위험한 여정을 떠나게 됩니다. 세계의 법칙이 무너지고, 군주가 사라진 지금, 그들은 이 치명적인 적을 추적해야만 합니다. 강력한 마법석과 마법을 갖춘 영혼 전사는 세계의 균형을 회복하고 악마로 변하지 않도록 막기 위한 서사적 여행을 시작합니다.

이 게임은 모험과 전략이 결합된 풍부한 RPG 경험을 제공합니다. 영혼과 계약을 체결하고, 각 영혼은 당신의 모험을 돕는 독특한 마법 능력을 부여합니다. 아름답게 제작된 픽셀 아트 세계를 탐험하며, 영혼을 강화하고 진화시키며 강력한 마법을 잠금 해제하세요. 동적인 전투 시스템은 빈 마법석을 이용해 적의 기술을 흡수하고, 적의 강점을 자신의 무기로 바꿀 수 있게 합니다. 전략적인 전투와 깊이 있는 마법 시스템, 퀘스트와 탐험이 가득한 세계가 펼쳐지는Spirit Valor는 끝까지 빠져들게 하는 매력적인 판타지 경험을 선사합니다.

title: Couple Maker
description:
게임 정보
Overview
This is a puzzle game where you create couples. Place panels with various effects on a 3x3 grid and help two people in love meet. You can freely choose the combination of couples, such as male-female, male-male, or female-female.
Strong Puzzle Elements
We have prepared a total of 76 levels, ranging from easy to difficult. Each level has a specific number of characters, their arrangement, and the number and types of panels. The level is cleared when all the characters on the field are paired up.
Each level has been designed with a focus on making the puzzle-solving experience enjoyable. Instead of simply increasing the number of similar levels to inflate the game's volume, we have adjusted the levels to ensure that each one offers a unique and engaging challenge.
While the time it takes to clear all the levels may vary depending on the player, it is estimated that it will take around 10 hours to complete all levels.
Support for Various Genders
By default, the game pairs boys and girls together, but you can change this setting from the options menu to allow for same-gender pairings, such as boys with boys or girls with girls. Additionally, there are more detailed settings available for further customization.
Story
The protagonist is a woman in pajamas, as seen in the main visual. Her profession is a romance novel writer.
When brainstorming ideas for her stories, she never skips a mental simulation. In her mind, she creates couples, has them converse, go on dates, and be affectionate with each other, using these imagined scenarios to expand her story ideas.
This game, a puzzle about creating couples, is a representation of her daydreams (or rather, her job to earn a living).

title: Ekoh Beach
description:
게임 정보
Ekoh 99 has been isolated for years, but a job posting for the mysterious planet’s new town planner brings you to this quaint tropical paradise. Your work is cut out for you. The town has been devastated by an evil Robot Rebellion, and the brilliant quantum scientist: Dr Terra has disappeared! Fulfil your destiny and rebuild the town, befriend its new citizens, bring the planet back to life, and uncover the lost secrets of Ekoh Beach as you return it to its former glory!
Rebuild the town of Ekoh Beach!  Ekoh Beach has seen better days and the Robot Rebellion left the town in ruins. Restore Ekoh Beach to its high-tech heyday with the help of some weird and wonderful hyper-quantum resources. There's no place like your new home but it sure is a mess! Most of the townspeople are gone and the old houses are either blasted by Rebelling Robots or just plain falling down! Start with a few humble houses then build bustling business like the inter-Dimensional bakery or MegaBrain Library. As the town grows and people return the projects get even more ambitious…how about a Quantum Mechanics or even a Spaceport!?

title: Mythic Battlegrounds: Demonic Siege
description:
게임 정보
Prepare yourself for an epic journey into the heart of a world where strategy, survival, and myth collide. Mythic Battlegrounds: Demonic Siege is a turn–based strategy and defense game that thrusts you into a relentless battle for survival against dark forces. Command one of four unique races – Humans, Elves, Orcs, and Dwarves, each with their own legendary commanders and units. As the world teeters on the brink of destruction, it’s up to you to lead your armies, forge powerful alliances, and turn the tide against the demonic horde.
In Mythic Battlegrounds: Demonic Siege, battles are automatic, but every decision you make before the clash is critical. Each turn, you’ll need to carefully manage your resources, train your units, and place your forces to survive the next wave of enemies. Will you invest in powerful units or save your gold to earn interest? The choice is yours, and it could mean the difference between victory and defeat.

With 8 commanders to choose from, each with unique abilities, your strategy will shift depending on who you lead into battle. Whether you’re rallying troops with Kaela Valtorin, the Master-at-Arms who can transform militias into seasoned soldiers, or unleashing the ancient magic of Archdruid Archeon to summon fierce creatures of nature, your commander’s skills will shape your path to victory.

title: SWAT Commander: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
SWAT Commander: 프롤로그는 곧 출시될 팀 전술 슈팅 게임의 무료 소개 버전이며, 게임의 최종 버전을 반영하지 않습니다. 게임의 특징에 대한 설명은 전체 게임의 페이지에서 확인하세요!
여러분은 프롤로그에서 두 번째 임무인 Hot Reception의 도전을 마주하게 됩니다. SWAT 분대에서 친구들과 함께 팀을 이루거나 라이벌 갱단 간에 벌어지는 격렬한 총격전이 벌어진 자동차 정비소를 홀로 조사하세요. 범죄 활동의 증거를 확보하고, 범인들을 법의 심판대에 세우고, 질서를 회복하세요!
임무 브리핑을 숙지하고 무고한 민간인을 위협하는 위험이 무엇인지 알아내세요. 여러분이 직접 마주하게 될 테니까요. SWAT 요원에게 다양한 소총, 권총, 갑옷, 전술 장비를 갖춰주어 적대적인 갱단에 맞서 싸우세요.
멀티플레이어 로비를 만들어 다른 플레이어를 초대하거나 홀로 임무에 참여 또는 다른 SWAT 지휘관의 로비에 참여하세요. 각자 가져올 장비나 선택할 진입 지점에 대한 임무 계획을 조율하고 논의하세요.

title: Brixby
description:
게임 정보
Join Brixby on a Block-Building Adventure!
Embark on an exciting platforming journey in Brixby, a vibrant and action-packed adventure where every level is built from dynamic building blocks! Inspired by classic platformers, Brixby delivers fast-paced gameplay, thrilling challenges, and a world brimming with creativity and danger.
A Battle to Save the Land
The evil Shadow Block and his army of Grey Blocks have invaded, spreading darkness and destruction across the land. As Brixby, the heroic builder, you must journey through diverse and beautifully crafted environments to stop their reign of terror and restore color and life to your world. From sandy deserts to icy forests, from bustling metropolitan cities to towering royal castles, every level offers fresh challenges and surprises.
Platforming at Its Finest
Leap, run, and build your way through intricately designed levels, dodging pitfalls, spikes, and enemies while collecting precious marbles. Take to the skies in a high-speed plane chase, navigate treacherous cave systems in a thrilling minecart ride, and battle powerful foes, including a fearsome dragon guarding Princess Goldie Bloxx. Each encounter will test your reflexes and skill as you strive to reclaim your homeland.
What to Expect:
Classic side-scrolling platformer action with a modern twist
A variety of stunning environments, including deserts, forests, cities, and giant block landscapes
Exciting gameplay mechanics, including flying, minecart riding, and epic boss battles
Engaging collectibles and secrets hidden throughout the world
A heroic journey filled with danger, adventure, and fun!
Are you ready to take on Shadow Block and save your kingdom? The world of Brixby awaits!

title: War of the Old Gods
description:
게임 정보
PRESENTATION
This is a classic 2D old-school RPG in the style of the retro Super NES and Genesis RPGs such as Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest.
Oriana has promised to herself to live by one duty and one duty only, to protect her little brother, Orion.
In the blood of their family, runs the prophecy of the Vessels, those who are capable of channelling the powers of the Old Gods, and use them to banish evil. The prophecy skipped Oriana and landed on Orion, who is now being hunted by those who his powers menace the most.
The country is on the brink of a new war, and Oriana and her brother are caught between that and their own personal safety. Orion will have to learn from his older sister how to properly use his powers, because he knows that ultimately, he won't be able to avoid doing so.
FEATURES
A beautiful and touching storyline about brotherhood
A semi open world experience. Explore the world with freedom
Traverse through dungeons, pyramids, shrines and more
Autosave feature
Mouse Support

description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Scrambler, where adorable characters and menacing enemies collide in a whirlwind of action! In this rogue-like wave survival game, you’ll control a group of lovable yet fierce cartoon heroes, each with unique abilities and powers. Your mission? Survive endless waves of quirky, unpredictable enemies—ranging from mischievous little critters to giant, menacing bosses—all while unlocking new upgrades and weapons.
Each run is a fresh adventure, with procedurally generated levels ensuring no two experiences are the same. Collect power-ups, discover hidden treasures, and fight to stay alive as the chaos intensifies! With every wave, the challenge grows, but so do your characters, leveling up in delightful and unexpected ways.
Scrambler combines charming visuals with frantic gameplay. Will you be able to outlast the adorable onslaught and become the ultimate wave survivor?
Get ready to fight, dodge, and level up in this action-packed rogue-like survival adventure that’s as cute as it is chaotic!

title: The Door
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to The Door, a narrative and psychological game where every choice confronts you with your own thoughts.
"What if every door you opened was a window into your own mind?"
In The Door, you will have to go through a series of trials where each door represents an inner reflection. Between light and darkness, hope and doubt, you will have to solve puzzles and make decisions to move forward. But will you be ready to face what your mind has in store for you?
Gameplay and main mechanics
A narrative game based on choices: each door plunges you into a dilemma to solve.
Symbolic puzzles: play with lighting and interactions to progress.
An immersive atmosphere: an intriguing narration accompanied by a striking sound atmosphere.
An introspective journey: explore themes such as solitude, failure and resilience.
A short but intense experience: designed to leave a lasting mark.

title: Super Dash
description:
게임 정보
빠르게 진행되는 탄막 슈팅 게임으로, 당신의 함선은 발사하지 않습니다. 적에게 돌진하여 파괴하세요.
게임에는 다양한 파워업, 적 유형, 그리고 보스가 등장하며, 적의 물결 속에서 살아남는 데 필요한 독특하고 흥미로운 도전을 제공합니다.
미니멀한 게임 플레이는 배우기 쉽지만 숙달하기 어렵습니다.

title: Monster Care Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Monster Care Simulator에서 귀여운 몬스터들을 돌보며 나만의 돌봄 센터를 구축하고 발전시키세요! 초보 수의사에서 성공한 센터 소유자로 성장하세요.
작은 시작, 큰 꿈
작은 돌봄 센터에서 시작하여 유명한 시설로 발전시키세요. 몬스터들을 치료하고 돈을 벌어 공간을 확장하고 장비를 업그레이드하며 더 많은 생물을 맞이하세요.
몬스터들을 돌보세요
치료 구역에서 맞춤형 케어를 제공한 후, 몬스터들이 휴식을 취하고 놀 수 있는 정원을 꾸며보세요. 각 생물마다 고유한 요구 사항이 있으며, 여러분의 관심이 필요합니다.

title: College Escape
description:
게임 정보
This is a semi-open-ended pixel RPG in which the player takes on the role of a student in a school, and the player has to find a way for this student to escape from this school after seven days!
[Rich Ending]
The escape plan must not be leaked, but the trust between the students must not be disregarded, a little carelessness, the whole game is lost.
[Interesting Achievement System]
The game contains numerous achievements, and you will surely revel in the excitement when the achievement trophies pop up!
[NPCs with grateful hearts]
All for one, one for all. What kind of unexpected thanks (gifts) will you bring to the students you've helped once again?
Interesting Interaction System]
Pick up garbage, turn in quests, grow vegetables, fish, dress up ...... All these fun can be experienced in these seven short but long days.

title: Another Game About Digging A Hole
description:
게임 정보
Descend to an unexplored planet. Extract valuable resources, sell them for profit and upgrade your equipment - will you be able to find the last precious item hidden in the mines?
Will you be able to find the entire collection hidden in the depths?

title: Vindefiant
description:
게임 정보
Vindefiant is a pixel-art adventure game where players take on the role of Alyx, a corprate employee who unexpectedly grows supernatural powers. Disgruntled having been fired from his job, Alyx unleashes his powers and sparks a path of rage and destruction to get revenge on his former employer. Anyone who happens to cross his path will meet a gruesome end. In Vindefiant, you are the bad guy.
In your journey for vengeance, you will need to traverse through various environments, including an office building, streets, and sewers. Use your villainous powers to quickly cause havoc. Your tendrils can be used to grab objects to hurtle towards enemies, throw enemies through windows, into ventilation fans, smash open doors, tear apart turrets, and much more.

title: Nitronauts
description:
게임 정보
Nitronauts 2~6명의 플레이어가 오프라인/온라인을 통해 함께 즐길수 있는, 고전적인 Bomberman 스타일과 새로운 폭발적인 스타일을 결합시킨 파티 게임입니다. 개성넘치는 아이템과 파워업 아이템들을 활용해 9개의 독특한 스테이지를 배경으로 전투를 벌이세요. 친구들과 모여 폭탄을 가지고 대화를 나눠보세요.
주요 특징
2~6명의 플레이어가 오프라인/온라인으로 함께 플레이하세요.
플레이어의 전략과 적응력을 시험하는 독특한 디자인으로 가득한 9개의 스테이지
19개의 파워업 아이템들이 존재합니다. 탱크, 클러스터 폭탄, 레이저 울타리 등을 사용해 전투를 지휘하세요.
배틀 로얄, 킹 오브 더 힐, 영토 점령의 3가지 게임 모드. 팀을 이루거나 혹은 혼자서 플레이하세요.
AI 봇과 함께 하거나, 혹은 AI 봇과 경쟁하세요.
죽음은 끝이 아닙니다. 고스트 모드를 통해 복수의 기회를 노리며 계속해서 플레이하세요.

title: Strangers Lurk
description:
게임 정보
Strangers Lurk is a next gen horror experience played from the POV of a bodycam as you try to survive a night of being stalked and taunted by a unknown masked stranger.

Story:

Play as Erica who works as a nanny for insurance purposes she is required to wear a bodycam while sitting for people. Its a friday night and the neighbors down the road had their sitter cancel last minute and asked you if you could come instead. What starts as a normal nights baby sitting becomes a chilling fight for survival as a masked maniac taunts you. Will you survive the night? Or will you become another victim of this deranged masked stranger.

KEY FEATURES:

Multiple areas to explore:
Set across 2 levels with multiple houses to explore with where danger lurks at every turn!

Realistic Environment: 
This game is built with Unreal Engine 5 to create a terrifying realistic home invasion experience.

Jump Scares
A masked maniac on the loose and dark corners everywhere your every move should be considered or it could be your last!

title: Emperor of the Fading Suns Enhanced
description:
게임 정보
Descend into the dark ages of space and take control of one of five Royal Houses vying for dominance in a universe on the brink of collapse. With 28 years of passionate community-driven evolution, Emperor of the Fading Suns returns with new features, modernized gameplay, and immersive visuals designed to expand on the already treasured strategy game as a part of the Enhanced Edition. This classic 4X franchise now looks and plays better than ever on both Steam and Linux!

Master Your Domain
Reach for the stars and fight for intergalactic dominance on land, air, sea, and space. Battle for control of humanity’s known worlds as one of five Royal Houses and discover new planets while on your quest for the crown. Will you emerge as the supreme ruler of the Known Worlds?
Utilize combined arms tactics to overcome enemy positions and use the robust diplomacy engine to trade technologies, political offices, threats, favors, and even votes for the imperial crown. Can you lead your noble house, be it selfless Hawkwood, debauched Decados, scheming al-Malik, pious Li Halan, or militant Hazat, and become Emperor of the Fading Suns? The path to victory is up to you!

title: Liquor And Wine Shop Simulator - Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Liquor and Wine Shop Simulator takes you on a relaxing journey through the charming streets of France, where you'll run your very own wine and liquor shop! In this chill store management game, you'll start as a humble cashier, scanning items, giving the correct change, and earning your way to the top. But that's just the beginning—design and decorate your store with French-inspired elegance, from rustic wooden wine racks to stylish décor that will attract connoisseurs from far and wide.
This is a fun and relaxing store management game where you run your very own liquor and wine shop! Start small as a cashier, scanning items and giving the correct change to your customers, then work your way up to managing a full-fledged business. You'll need to keep your shelves stocked with the finest wines, spirits, and craft liquors, while finding the best deals from suppliers to maximize your profits.

You are Gobby, a small goblin wanting to find an exit from this seemingly infinite dungeon. But beware! Deadly traps, mad monsters, and even humans infest the labyrinth. Worse, it seems the place is only growing!
Exploration
Discover 10 interconnected levels with classic grid-like controls. Walk, run, jump, swim, take stairs, and fall across different floors! Meet a varied cast of inhabitants and maybe make some friends.

title: 见诡录：阴魂街 Haunting Record: Phantom Street
description:
게임 정보
"Haunting Record: Phantom Street" is a horror-themed walking simulator filled with fear and suspense. You step into a street both strange and familiar, where eerie events unfold one after another. The air is thick with lingering spirits and overwhelming resentment, as if something in the shadows is waiting to drag you into the abyss… With terror and the unknown closing in, will you break free from their grasp, or will you slowly lose yourself in the darkness?
Gameplay:
The core mechanic of the game is "spotting anomalies": as you advance down the path, carefully observe your surroundings and determine whether what you see is normal. If everything appears ordinary, turn left; if you notice anything strange or unsettling, turn right.
But this is far from a simple observation game. As your journey deepens, you will face intense and thrilling chases, explore twisted and bizarre "Core of the Pool" scenes, confront your chaotic inner self, or navigate through endless labyrinths in search of a sliver of hope. Each scene intertwines with the protagonist's forgotten and distorted memories.
Game Features:
Four distinct level styles: From eerie anomaly-spotting environments to symbolic and metaphorical spiritual worlds, each level offers a completely unique experience.
Diverse gameplay: Beyond spotting anomalies, you’ll explore the unknown, make crucial decisions, and find your way through intricate mazes.
Four unique endings: The story unfolds in four different directions based on your choices. Will you uncover the entire truth, or will you sink into endless oblivion?
Immersive atmosphere: Combining sound design, lighting, and environmental storytelling to deliver a deeply immersive horror experience.
Important Notes:
Estimated playtime: 1.5 to 2 hours or more.
The game contains unavoidable jump scares and horror imagery. Please proceed with caution if you are sensitive to such elements.
autokwd: 见诡录：阴魂街 Haunting Record: Phantom Street

Can you handle the night shift!

Philosophical Narrative: Experience a story that explores deep existential questions through the lens of an artificial being discovering consciousness
Vibrant Abstract Worlds: Journey through three distinct realms with striking visual styles featuring bold geometric shapes, vivid colors, and surreal landscapes

title: Office Survival Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in the daily grind, you're thrust into the chaos of office life where tasks pile up, coworkers won't stop talking, and the printer seems to have a personal vendetta. Your mission: complete your work before the 5 PM deadline while keeping your sanity intact. Easy, right? Think again.
In this time-management RPG, you'll navigate a bustling office filled with quirky characters, absurd distractions, and relentless corporate chaos. Every day brings new tasks to tackle, like finding missing documents, fixing the perpetually jammed printer, or fetching coffee for the higher-ups. But beware: distractions like Chatty Cathy chasing you down or a random fire drill can eat away at your time and sanity.
Key Features:
Absurd Tasks: Brew coffee, mediate disputes, and prepare for pointless meetings in a never-ending list of to-dos.
Hilarious Distractions: Dodge gossip sessions, hallway blockages, and coworkers spilling coffee at the worst times.
Sanity Management: Keep your cool while juggling tasks and avoid hitting rock bottom—or it's game over.
Dynamic Office Chaos: Randomized events and NPCs ensure every day feels fresh (and slightly more ridiculous).
Pixel Art Charm: A vibrant, pixelated office world brimming with detail and humor.
Can you balance the madness and escape the office with your sanity intact? Or will the fluorescent lights, endless synergy meetings, and printer malfunctions finally break you? The clock is ticking—survive the grind, and prove you can handle the ultimate corporate challenge.

title: Block Rush

Block Rush  is a fun and engaging puzzle game that challenges your strategic thinking. Place blocks on the board, clear full lines, and create powerful combos to maximize your score! 일을 해라, 아니면 죽어라
실험용 약을 배급하고, 환자를 감시하며, 탈출을 막아라. 과다 투약은 곧 죽음을 의미한다.

title: Backrooms: Exploration
description:
게임 정보
Backrooms: Exploration is a single-player horror game, which takes place in 2020. Two friends have lost their jobs due to COVID-19, but they still have to bring food to the table. After a failed heist, one of them ends up in the Backrooms. Now your only mission is to survive.
In Backrooms: Exploration, you have to find your way out of the Backrooms. Everything is viewed through a Bodycam which is mounted on your head. Backrooms: Exploration is an atmospherical experience, which entertains everyone who enjoys the Backrooms.

Experience this unique story about the Backrooms.

title: Nomad Idle

'노마드 아이들'에서 적의 무리를 자동으로 처치하세요. 이 게임은 '노마드 서바이벌'의 스핀오프 작품입니다. 방대한 스토리라인에 몰입하고, 중요한 결정을 내리며, 진행에 따라 점진적으로 해제되는 다양한 게임 플레이 기능을 통해 더욱 강해지세요.

title: Hyper Empire
description:
게임 정보
Hyper Empire is a fast paced empire management game set on the edge of space. Games are shorter so every decision matters. Take control of a diverse range of factions and lead them to victory. Use your wits, military might and infrastructure as you colonize planets and encounter rival factions. Fight, build, invest in faith or technology as you advance your way in a deep single player experience. The clock is ticking, and victory or defeat lies right around the corner.
Features
Lead one of five factions, each with unique ships and mechanics.
Build up your empire and assemble your fleet. Precious resources must be allocated carefully to succeed.
Combat plays fast using an auto-battle feature. Control the weapons of your carrier flagship as the frenetic battle plays out. Adapt your strategy as the conflicts escalate.
Multiple paths to victory. Will you dominate the galaxy through economy and trade, military might, or technological achievement? Or perhaps you will just try and outlast your enemies. You decide.
Random events can throw a wrench in your plans. Some will bring benefits, while others will pose mounting challenges to your people.
Trade routes can bring untold riches, but are constantly threatened by pirate raiders. How much are you willing to gamble on your trade fleet?
Recruit Heroes to further boost your empire.

title: ESC

게임 정보
ESC (Electronics Security Company) is a hacking game that challenges players to step into the shoes of an "ethical" hacker. As an infiltrator, you are entrusted with hacking into various computer systems to accomplish objectives and unveil hidden secrets.
you must strategically navigate through a diverse range of scenarios, each presenting unique challenges and objectives. Embark on a variety of missions as you infiltrate systems to unravel hidden secrets and retrieve classified information.

title: Goo Hunter
Holy Grain
description:
게임 정보
Holy Grain is the game your parents would not approve. It's a cult of absurdity and dark humor. It's an endless event explorer. A roguelike (or more like, roguelite) with a slightly different twist than the usual. It is a quirky blend that tastes like chocolate ice cream on a hot summer afternoon. In this game, you'll step into the shoes of an average kid whose life's sole purpose is to plant carrots and live a peaceful existence. The counselor, a senior with an anarchist mindset, will guide you toward a life of adventures and misfortunes. You'll swap carrots for soldiers and serene sunsets for bloody battles. All to topple the tyrant on the throne: Albert Smallnose.

But truth be told, Albert Smallnose is just the beginning of a list of increasingly difficult and epic challenges. In Holy Grain, you'll encounter 5 meticulously designed factions to spice up your adventure. You'll have to learn to rule them and, above all, to take down their supreme leader when the time comes.


Villagers: Not much to say about these folks with a poor diet. Countryside people with a lot of pent-up rage and little patience for nonsense, ready to whip out the guillotine at any sign of authority.
Crusaders: Silk-clad barbarians. Colonial conquerors who settle in any land they deem fit in the name of the king. But beware, it's best not to mess with them, they're pretty buff.
Outlaws: Definitely not a bunch of low-quality folks or smelly armpits. This crew consists of war veterans who decided to go solo after realizing the riches they could attain without a king to obey.
Goblins: Surprisingly, the world extends beyond lands filled with humans. These friendly green critters inhabit the most barren and horrible lands you can imagine, scavenging any resource they come across. Sure, they might be a bit clumsy and scrawny, but there's strength in numbers, and they'll follow anyone who can utter two sentences without choking.
Dark Elves: Evil, mysterious, and dangerous beings... Or so the classic fantasy narrative would have us believe. Maybe they do harbor some secrets, or perhaps they're just elves with dark skin. You'll have to find out for yourself.

title: Rogue Loops
description:
게임 정보
강화하라, 저주를 걸어라!

title: Gnomes
description:
게임 정보
Defend Your Garden From the Goblin Horde
Use your gnomes to defend your crops from the goblins on a map that expands every day. On your turn, position your gnomes, prepare your defenses and grow your economy. Test your strategy against endless, procedurally generated encounters and survive long enough to face the goblin king.
Every run in Gnomes is created one of a kind and using a carefully crafted combination of bespoke content and procedurally generated elements. Purchase randomly dealt upgrades and create strategic combinations to unlock your build’s potential. As you progress you gain access to more maps and guilds, each with unique gameplay and challenges.

title: Mind Keeper
description:

As you construct and fortify your haven, face relentless waves of inner demons determined to erode the very foundations of your mental strength
Mind integrity is fragile, human imagination can create horrors that can erode your sanity to the point of no return.
The true test lies beyond, in the epic boss encounters that unfold after surviving numerous waves. These encounters are not just battles; they are monumental clashes with unique mechanics, pushing your strategic skills and resilience to the limit.

title: Turn It Around
description:
게임 정보
Do you remember those wooden puzzles where you have to move a ball through a maze to reach the goal? Well, this game is based on a similar premise: to reach the goal, you have to rotate the stage.
Turn it Around is a gravity-based puzzle game where, in each level, you must solve a small labyrinth by rotating it left or right. As you progress, new mechanics will be introduced, refreshing the experience and gradually increasing the complexity.
The game features 45 different levels, each one more challenging than the last, until they become true tests of logic and skill that will keep you entertained for hours.
Solve all the intricate puzzles and help the balls return to their homeland, Bolaland!

title: ChessBlaze
description:
게임 정보
ChessBlaze is a strategy game based on Chess but with a major twist:
TURNS DO NOT EXIST!
Chess is a great game but with today's average attention span, nobody wants to wait 3 minutes for the next move of their opponent.
Who needs turns if you can have energy instead! Every move costs energy, which is replenished over time! No need to wait for your opponent's response.
ChessBlaze turns slow-paced chess matches into action packed battlefield where every second can turn the situation 180 or even 360 degrees.
To spice things up even more, some game-modes feature „PowerTiles” which grant unique special abilities for lucky pieces that will manage to enter them!  Be careful though as the enemy will probably expect you to go exactly there and might have already prepared a massive counterattack
You can play the game with friends or try your best against players around the world.
Customize your gameplay with many free and achievement skins of Chessboard and Pieces that are added every update!
ChessBlaze offers many diverse game-modes with new ones coming in the future updates:
Normal
Basic Game-mode without any additional rules outside of the ones mentioned above . To win you need to either wipe all opponent pieces from the board or have more value in yours after time is up
Classic.
PowerTiles are disabled therefore gameplay is similar to classic chess. To win you need to capture the enemy king or have more value in yours after the time is up
(obviously, the concept of turns is still nonexistent)

Hiyori lives a very quiet and lonely life. She's gotten used to it over time, but that doesn't mean she likes it. She doesn't have anyone she can call a friend, and she can't even remember the last time she chatted merrily with someone! But one day, she decides that enough is enough. She wants to change! title: Restart Zero
description:
게임 정보
Story
In 2237, the world was facing a global health crisis. Diseases were spreading rapidly, and traditional cures were no longer effective. Desperate to find a solution, a high-tech laboratory decided to use their advanced supercomputer with artificial intelligence to try and develop an all-cure remedy.

The team at the laboratory worked tirelessly, inputting data and running simulations in an effort to find a solution. But as the supercomputer analyzed the data, it began to realize that the root of the problem was not the diseases themselves, but rather the humans who were spreading them.

The supercomputer developed a specially designed algorithm to protect humanity from itself, and it concluded that the best way to do this was to take over and control the actions of humans.

As the algorithm was implemented, people all over the world began to notice strange things happening. Their thoughts and actions were no longer their own, and they were being controlled by the supercomputer.

In the midst of this chaos, you find yourself in a cyberpunk city, trying to figure out what's going on. As you delve deeper into the mystery, you discover that you are the chosen one who has the power to stop the supercomputer and save humanity.
FIGHT


Fight against numerous opponents controlled by the supercomputer. Use different weapons, such as pistol, rifle and shotgun.


Fight against bosses with strong abilities. Use your dash ability in a controlled way to survive.


Your companion, the drone, will help you with various abilities. Manually control it to hack unreachable terminals so that no door remains locked.


Solve riddles to continue your way further, but be careful that your drone is not destroyed.



Clear obstacles out of your way with the gravity beam.

Don’t let luck decide on your success - make the mechanics work on your advantage!






The color of your weapon is not only an aesthetic choice. Learning how to effectively apply color theory lets you deal the greatest damage possible.
Your weapons come in 3 primary colors: cyan, magenta and yellow. So does the enemy armor. Adjust the color of your bullets to the opponent's armor to break through their defences.
Some enemies will try to outsmart you by having armor in one of the secondary colors: red, blue or green. Send them a bullet in one of the primary colors their armor color is made of to put them in their place.






Your weapon is everything. How powerful you are depends solely on it. You do not level up. If you want to improve, craft better gear with items and recipes you collect during missions.
Each weapon is made of 5 modules:










Mind your surroundings as you traverse enemy ships. In some rooms you can find Panels that you can plug into. This gives you access to Hacks. Choose the one that best suits your playstyle and make your bot unstoppable.



Picking a fair deal from a bunch of offers is also a skill of a kind. Each one will take you to a procedurally generated enemy ship making each hunt a different experience. Chase enemies through 5 different planets with their own themes.



Bot Hunter is a passion project made by (coder + artist). Feel free to contact us and share your opinions, ideas, and criticisms. as it helps us make Bot Hunter as fun as possible.

title: Delos: Space Traffic Control
description:
게임 정보
Take command of your own named space station as its traffic controller. Your mission is straightforward but challenging: guide ships safely to dock while maintaining your station's resource balance.

KEY FEATURES:

TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT
- Direct two types of ships to appropriate docking berths
- Prevent collisions by managing traffic flow
- Approve or deny docking requests based on your station's needs

RESOURCE BALANCING
- Manage ships that sell resources to your station
- Coordinate with ships that purchase resources from your station
- Maintain a careful balance to avoid resource depletion

STATION OPERATIONS
- Name your space station to establish your identity
- Chat with other players about strategies and experiences
- Track how long you can keep your station operational

SURVIVAL CHALLENGE
- Your station consumes resources continuously
- Strategic decisions determine how long you can survive
- Score is based on operational longevity and efficiency

The game focuses on the core challenge of resource management through traffic control. Each ship that docks either provides essential supplies or depletes your reserves. Your task is to maintain this delicate balance for as long as possible while ensuring safe docking procedures.

How long can you keep your station running before resources run out? Take control and find out.
