title: Glimmer Fighters
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Glimmer Fighters! Participate in an all-new fighting game against your foes.
With the planet's surface being stripped of most of its sunlight, Glimmer Power is society's only source of light.
Participate in the Glimmer Fighters Tournament, organized by the mega corporation Glim-Corp, to receive its grand prize of a life-long supply of Glimmer Power to the winner.
Exciting roster of characters
Play interesting never before seen characters fighting with each their own set of ambitions and reasons for participating in the Glimmer Fighters Tournament. Every character comes with at least one other color variation.
Easy to master controls
As a beginner in fighting games or a veteran, you will find something to enjoy in this easy to understand but fun to master gameplay.
Learn to master the natural abundance of Glimmer Power
With each hit traded, your shared Glimmer Gauge will fill. Strategically trade hits to fill out the Glimmer Gauge to trigger an all powerful burst of raw Glimmer Power, affecting all the fighters and environment, but be careful not to trade hits or else with the Glimmer Gauge emptied out the surrounding light will also disappear from yours and your enemies grasps.
Stylized aesthetics
With colorful and eye-catching aesthetics, be it 2D or 3D, this game will certainly be a pleasant experience of the eyes.
Small indie development team
Glimmer Fighters was created as a student project within six months of development by a team of six. Our team consisting of two Programmers, three Game Artists and a Musician. We are happy to announce the early-access release of our team project and hope everyone will be able to enjoy the time and effort spent into this student project.

title: Idle Zombie Wave: Survivors
description:
게임 정보
좀비가 침공하고 세계가 붕괴 직전입니다!
이 종말 생존 전투에서 당신은 현명하고 결단력 있는 리더로서 생존자 팀을 지휘하게 됩니다. 끊임없이 몰려오는 언데드 무리를 막아내고, 타워 디펜스(TD) 전투에서 기지를 방어하세요!
게임 특징:
· 대규모 좀비 웨이브
끝없이 몰려오는 좀비 물결을 견뎌내세요. 적의 숫자는 상상을 초월할 것입니다!
· 다양한 생존자 캐릭터
각기 다른 무기와 전투 스타일을 가진 30명 이상의 생존자 중에서 선택하세요. 최강의 방어팀을 구축하여 좀비 무리를 격퇴하세요!
· 부관 시스템
전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있는 다양한 부관을 활용하여 전략적으로 좀비를 압도하세요!
· 로그라이크 요소
200개 이상의 독특한 로그라이크 아이템을 발견하고 생존을 위한 전략을 세우세요. 매번 달라지는 아이템을 활용하여 전술을 조정하세요!
· 강력한 보스전
강력한 좀비 보스들과 맞서 싸우며 타워 디펜스 전투의 짜릿한 긴장감을 경험하세요. 기지를 방어하고 가장 어려운 생존 도전에 도전하세요!
좀비 아포칼립스에 맞서 싸울 준비가 되었나요? 생존자들을 이끌고, 언데드 무리를 처치하며 최강의 수호자가 되어보세요!

title: Setuna:Legend of Hamburger
description:
게임 정보
Setuna, aspiring to become the ultimate warrior, receives a new mission. Cutting down enemy after enemy, Setuna fights through countless battles to return home safely once again. A legendary tale spun by hamburgers, players take on the role of Setuna to etch their name into history.
[Solo Anime-Style Hardcore Action Game]
~ Fight Your Way, Your Style ~
Techniques Transform Mid-Action: Attacks change into different skills depending on your current action (Martial Arts Techniques).
Unrestricted Action Flow: Cancel any motion at any time ("Setuna Cancel").
Seamless Action Chain: Connect every move freely and fluidly at any timing.
Dodge Without Stopping Attacks: Continue attack motions while nullifying enemy attacks (Attack Motion Dodge).

title: BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH
description:
게임 정보
DON'T WATCH는 복잡한 시리즈BrokenLore의 1인칭 심리 공포 게임입니다.
신지는 작은 도쿄 아파트에 갇힌 젊은 히키코모리입니다. 미납된 임대료와 쌓여가는 청구서, 그리고 자신을 이해하지 못하는 가족 때문에 그는 세상과 자신으로부터 고립감을 느낍니다.
그의 유일한 탈출구는 비디오 게임이지만, 그것조차도 그의 불안감의 무거운 짐을 덜어줄 수 없습니다.

title: WhamPunch 超能打
description:
게임 정보
WHAM! Punch enemies to the building and destroy it !
《WhamPunch》 is a first-person superpowered combat game that focuses on high-speed battles, environmental destruction, and uniquely designed levels.
GAME FEATURE
Fight using your fists—charge up your punches to send enemies flying with shockwaves and air pressure, creating exaggerated knockback effects. Smash them into buildings, causing massive explosions and large-scale environmental destruction.
Almost all enemies and NPCs can be punched into the air, and most buildings in the world can be destroyed—from streetlights and water towers to even skyscrapers and mountains.
SUPERPOWER BATTLE

title: Screaming Savage Blood Death
description:
게임 정보


Salvador Bolero welcomes you to No-Pi-Ba-Ca! Nestled in the heart of New Jersey's Pine Barrens, we are a camp retreat for troubled youth. Our unique approach involves counseling children with the aid of survival training in the forest. However, we need your help!

The camp is teeming with danger. The Barrens are alive, as animals and insects breed aggressively, posing a threat not just to the children but to the staff as well. That's where you come in, alongside four other camp counselors, to patrol our grounds. Keep the kids safe and maintain order, and we might just make it through the week unscathed...



But animals are not our only concern at No-Pi-Ba-Ca. Mysterious lights glide through the woods at night. Sounds of wings too large to belong to any bat echo among the trees. And let's not forget the bodies that have found their final resting place in New Jersey's marshes.

An unseen force is disrupting the natural—and perhaps even the supernatural—balance. Can you uncover the truth?



Brace yourself for seven days and nights of relentless defense against vicious animals and eerie occurrences. Take control of a team of five counselors, patrolling the paths and ensuring everyone's safety. Be ready to respond to calls for help, equipped to face whatever lurks in the shadows. Unearth hidden clues and tools to battle the nightmares emerging from the depths of New Jersey's lore and history. Delve into the malevolence that stalks The Barrens.



Choose from five unique camp counselors, each boasting distinct strengths and weaknesses. Replay the game with an even larger cast of playable characters.

Arm yourself with a plethora of unique weapons, ranging from Molotov cocktails to Philly snowballs.

Stay vigilant as you navigate through dynamic hazards of an active day and night cycle, adding an extra layer of suspense and strategy to your survival.

Experience multiple endings that further unravel the deep-seated mysteries of the Barrens.

title: Unprotected
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에서 우리의 주요 목표는 과학자를 찾아 그에게서 정보를 얻는 것입니다. 그러나 우리는 과학자가 발생한 사건으로 인해 사망했을 것으로 의심하고 그가 단서를 남겼기를 바라며 모험을 계속합니다.
당신의 유일한 희망은 그가 자신이 만든 악을 파괴하는 해독제를 남겼다는 것입니다. 이 모험에서 당신은 인류를 구하려고 노력하면서 다양한 퍼즐, 공포 및 액션 요소를 경험하게 될 것입니다.

title: Menhera & Troll
description:
게임 정보
스토리
인터넷에 각종 악플과 싸움이 넘쳐흐르는 세상.
천재 심리학자 교수는 자신의 애제자인 '조수군'에게 인터넷세상의 키보드 워리어들의 실체를 조사하고, 그들의 마음을 치유할 수 있는 방법을 연구하라고 지시한다.
교수의 갑작스러운 지시에 조수군은 당황하지만, 연구해 볼만한 가치가 있다고 느끼고 곧 키보드 워리어들을 찾아 나서기 시작한다.
에...? 그런데 내 주변의 키보드 워리어들이 모두 여자들이었다고?
게임 플레이
당신은 심리학과 대학원생으로서, 키보드 워리어들의 실체를 조사하고 그들의 마음을 치유하는 것이 당신의 임무입니다.
대화를 통해 그녀들을 치유해 보세요!
하지만 명심하세요. 치유에 실패할 경우, 그녀들이 키보드 워리어였다는 사실을 다시한 번 깨닫게 될 것 입니다.
게임 특징
랜덤하게 주어지는 수많은 상황들
이 게임은 일직선형 스토리 게임이 아닙니다. 다양한 상황들을 마주하며 모든 캐릭터들의 마음을 치유해보세요! 만약 실패한다면? 그녀들이 키보드 워리어라는 사실을 다시 한 번 깨닫게 될 것 입니다.
스피디한 게임 플레이
그녀들은 당신의 반응을 무제한 기다려줄만한 인내심을 가지고 있지 않습니다.
당신이 여러명을 동시에 상대하더라도 말이죠.
스피디하게 그녀들의 마음을 공략해보세요.
매력적인 캐릭터
결코 평범하지 않은 그녀들!
키보드 워리어들과 관계를 쌓아 그녀들의 숨겨진 이야기들을 발견해나가세요.
그녀들의 마음을 치유하려면, 그녀들의 대화를 주의 깊게 들여보아야 할 것입니다.

title: POGOPPL
description:
게임 정보
Take on a unique challenge in this physics-based pogo stick platformer! Play as a vast cast of characters as you bounce through the sunny streets of Pogo City. Although it was built to be a haven for pogo-enthusiasts, there now exist sinister forces in the city that are trying to change it forever. Lasers and obstacles of various kinds are being deployed to eradicate pogo activity in the city. As you bounce across town, alone or with friends, you'll uncover this diabolical plot!
Features:



70-level STORY MODE with varied challenges and unlockable characters!



6-player local MULTIPLAYER! Race with your friends or challenge them to a fight in POGO KOMBAT!



An easy-to-use LEVEL EDITOR! Play some user made levels, or make your own and share them via Steam Workshop.

title: Ammo Garden
description:
게임 정보
가능한 한 많은 작물을 재배하고 수확하여 막대한 수익을 올리십시오. 농작물을 업그레이드하여 탄약을 업그레이드하세요. 하루가 끝날 때 무기와 아이템을 구입하십시오. 개, 고양이, 까마귀, 돼지, 소 친구들과 친구가 되어 농사를 자동화하고 농장을 방어하세요 밤마다 농작물을 먹으려는 공격자로부터 농작물을 보호하세요. 최종 수확에 도달할 때까지 매 시즌 도전적인 보스와 싸우십시오. 새로운 생물군계를 잠금 해제하고 탐험하고 오래 전에 사라진 농장의 유용한 유물을 찾으십시오. 강력한 전리품은 농사와 전투 능력을 증가시킵니다.

title: Dragon-Dodge
description:
게임 정보
Dragon-Dodge
Soar into the skies as a majestic dragon in Dragon-Dodge, a thrilling arcade-style adventure with Old-School gameplay. Battle through relentless waves of enemies, earn coins and gems, and unlock a number of customization options to make your dragon truly yours. Will you rise as the ultimate dragon champion and take down the Wicked King to claim his legendary helmet?
Game Modes:
Campaign Mode: Embark on an epic journey through engaging levels as you face formidable foes and strive to defeat the Wicked King.
Quickplay: Challenge yourself in a variety of battles across multiple difficulty settings, aiming for the highest score and showing off your skills.
Endless Mode: Test your endurance in an unlimited battle against waves of enemies. How long can you survive?
With its homage to classic arcade gameplay, Dragon-Dodge is set to provide both nostalgic thrills and fresh experiences. Gather your strength, prepare for battle, and unleash your inner dragon today! Dive in and prove your worth in the skies!

title: Gray Planet
description:
게임 정보
몇세기 후 테라포밍 기술이 개발되고 인류는 여러 행성을 개척하고 있으며 수많은 행성에서 살아가고 있습니다. 당신은 여러 행성을 돌아다니는 용병이며 여행가이지만 나노머신에 점령당한 행성에 불시착을 하였습니다. 이 행성에 어떤 일이 일어났는지 알기 위해 탐험을 하고 자원을 수집하세요.

여러가지 지역을 탐험하세요
이 행성의 다양한 지역들을 탐험하세요

다양한 몬스터들
이 행성에는 다양한 종류의 위협이 존재합니다

1 감염체
나노머신에 감염된 생명체이며 당신을 감염시킬려고 달려드는 단순한 생명체입니다



2 로봇
사람들의 작업을 도와주는 노동자였지만 나노머신에 침식된후 사람을 공격하게 되었습니다. 일부 군용 로봇들은 더 크고 단단한 장갑을 가지고있습니다.



3 나노모프
나노머신들이 뭉쳐서 만들어진 새로운 생명체이며 분열이나 위장 등 여러 독특한 패턴을 보입니다

적을 죽이거나 광물 및 여러 잔해들을 분해함으로서 자원을 얻으세요


다양한 장비를 제작하고 그것들을 사용하여 적을 물리치거나 탐험을 하세요

기지를 건설하여 자원을 저장하고 장비나 차량을 제작하며 쉴곳을 만드세요

title: The Awakening of the Bleak Dimension
description:
게임 정보
Travel through six distinct areas, each with its own unique biome and enemies, in a journey filled with dangers and rewards. To progress, you’ll need to strengthen your character in two ways:
Leveling up by defeating enemies.
Forging powerful equipment by finding blueprints hidden in chests.
Each new area is more challenging than the last, requiring strategy and preparation to face the terrors of the Bleak Dimension.
The Camp serves as the game's central HUB, where you’ll find NPCs offering essential services for your journey. Here, you can:
Upgrade equipment.
Enhance your healing Elixir.
autokwd: The Awakening of the Bleak Dimension

title: Hanako's Flower Shop
description:
게임 정보
Hanako, a young woman at a crossroads in her life, takes on the challenge of running her grandpa’s beloved flower shop. Hanako’s Flower Shop is a heartwarming coming-of-age visual novel with resource management elements, where every flower tells a story and every bouquet has the power to heal.
Guided by her deep admiration for her grandpa, a renowned florist known for his unparalleled skill and compassion, Hanako is determined to uphold his legacy. But as she navigates the pressures of living up to her grandpa’s reputation and the fear of falling short of his greatness, she begins to wonder: can she ever truly fill his shoes?

title: I commissioned some frogs 5
description:
게임 정보
A hidden object game where you must find all the frogs and flies to complete each level.
Key features:
❓1500+ Hidden objects total
🐸750+ Frogs
🪰750+ Flies
🖼️ 15 unique artworks
💡 ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck
♻️ Restore a small number of hidden objects to a painting so you can find them again!
🎵 Music for each artwork
⌨️ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scroll wheel
💾 3x save slots
🗑️ Reset progress entirely and play again
🕒 Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level
Context:
The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many frogs and flies as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ hidden objects, you will have a lot of searching to do.
Controls:
Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden object, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom.
Difficulty:
All levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck.
Get immersed:

title: Downware
description:
게임 정보
John heads to the heart of the city to visit his girlfriend Lucy. After falling asleep while waiting for her, he finds himself trapped in her apartment due to a malfunctioning security system. With a building filled with all sorts of traps and a cyborg tasked with enforcing the country's tyrannical law, John's grim fate seems sealed. Will he manage to escape the building and outwit the cyborg to avoid his dire fate?
Complex Puzzles
Discover secret hideouts essential for your survival.
- An apartment filled with secrets
- New areas to explore
- A story to uncover
Chase Sequences
Run away to escape the enemy!
- He hears, sees, and detects your movement
- Set traps to ensnare him
- Every decision counts!
Immerse yourself in the heart of an oppressive cyberpunk city.
- Various apartments, corridors, and areas to explore
- A sound and visual atmosphere that complements the plot
- A world filled with dangers

title: The Earth Is Flat
description:
게임 정보
Teddy is a 40-year-old who’s super into conspiracy theories. Life was going pretty smoothly for him until one day he gets a call from his girlfriend, Mel, who breaks up with him. Mel says Teddy does nothing with his life except wake up at 2 PM, play video games all day, and listen to conspiracy theory podcasts.

Heartbroken, Teddy has a moment of inspiration and comes up with a genius idea: he’ll be the first person ever to really prove that the Earth is flat.

Get ready to dive into a bizarre and electrifying adventure with over 15 challenging levels, each one packed with traps and lurking dangers that will keep you on your toes. Explore a decaying world brought to life with detailed graphics and handcrafted animations that showcase an obsessive attention to detail.

Take on multiple side quests brimming with Easter Eggs and a twisted sense of dark humor, all while jamming to a wild 90s-inspired soundtrack that sets the perfect tone. Face unpredictable and surreal boss encounters that will leave you questioning reality.

With varied mechanics ranging from skateboarding and jet skiing to using balloons to reach the highest point in the Earth’s atmosphere, this game is anything but ordinary.

Don’t waste any more time — wish list it right now!

Features:

Over 15 challenging levels, packed with traps and lurking dangers.
Multiple side quests filled with Easter Eggs and a lot of dark humor.
Detailed graphics that bring a decaying world to life.
Handcrafted animations with obsessive attention to detail.
A wild soundtrack that captures the essence of the 90s.
Unpredictable and surreal boss encounters.
Varied mechanics, like a skateboarding level, a jet ski level, and even a stage where Teddy uses balloons to reach the highest point in the Earth's atmosphere.
Don't waste time—jump into this bizarre and electrifying adventure right now!

title: Prince Nikolai and the Vampires
description:
게임 정보
SUMMARY
Prince Nikolai and the Vampires is a SRPG in the classic style of Shining Force, Fire Emblem, Bahamut Lagoon, Feda the Emblem of Justice and from the same developer team:
Play as Prince Nikolai and gather an army of colorful, diverse heroes as he needs to save his kindgom from the threat of his archrival, the arrogant and ambitious vampire Zarius.
Meet friends and foes along the way, manage your units and their inventories, purchase goods and weapons in this enthralling old-school SRPG.
FEATURES
23 exciting battles of increasing complexity and difficulty
11 playable characters with different profiles, strengths and weaknesses
A New Game+ offering the ultimate challenge for tactics experts: all characters from the start (that you were able to find in Normal Game), no item shops, and more damaging enemies. You also get more experience boost for completing a battle fast.
A Book of Records to keep track of your best local and global performances, as well as the overall length of your campaign (global records only apply in Normal Game and as long as you haven't lost a battle)
Skills that evolve to Level 2 and 3 depending on use: choose which skills to favor in battle, resulting in unlimited combinations, strategies and ways of playing
Pure tactics and strategy: the troops, both allies and enemies alike, never do a critical and their damage are estimated before an action is decided, plus only a few selected enemies can evade, resulting in no miss most of the times -> pure strategy!
Adjustable Battle Animations Speed: 4 different levels for maximum enjoyment!
Great Replay Value! While the main quest lasts about 20 hours, you may want to replay this game over and over to refine your strategy and/or discover new ways of playing, not to mention New Game+.
PLAY MORE AWESOME GAMES!

title: MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS
description:
게임 정보
JUST LIKE IN THE PAPERS.
MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS is a short, fast-paced 3rd person horror/comedy hybrid of games like Hotline Miami and Post Void, with hand-drawn visuals inspired loosely by retro detective comics. You'll step into the well-polished shoes of Clive, an undead detective working to take down the criminals that initially killed him.
LIVE. DIE. LIVE AGAIN.
When a parasite reawakens detective Clive from death, he is recruited into a secret taskforce to stop those that killed him from weaponizing this newfound immortality. Slay crooks and goons in semi-linear corridor levels that are built for honing in and optimising your own quickest path through. Prepare to die, and then die again.

title: Emergency Exit
description:
게임 정보
Emergency Exit: Puzzles, Communication, and Escape
Discover Emergency Exit, an intense cooperative game where you must guide your teammate through the darkness and solve puzzles together. Communicate constantly, be resourceful, synchronize your actions, but remain quick and efficient. Avoid traps, solve puzzles and find the emergency exit before time runs out!
Your attention: Emergency Exit does not include a traditional tutorial. This is entirely intentional and part of the game’s vision. There’s what’s on the screen, and then there’s what’s implied, hidden, obscure, or deliberately left unexplained
Key Features:
Two players, two distinct roles:
*The first player, equipped with a limited-battery flashlight, navigates alone through an emergency escape plan. Flames spread, deadly traps are triggered, and disturbing noises are heard in the distance... He must advance carefully, remain vigilant and not get lost.

title: Bubble Battle
description:
게임 정보
BUBBLE BURSTING
Bubble Battle is designed for those craving an online/local party game experience reminiscent of the 80's and 90's. 
Players fly around with one simple objective: burst opponents’ bubbles before they burst yours. Collect powerups and out-maneuver opponents for fast-paced, addictive fun!
BATTLE YOUR FRIENDS ONLINE
Battle it out with up to 4 players online or locally.
TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS

title: Hydra - Poseidon's conspiracy
description:
게임 정보
Gameplay:
- Investigate eerie clues and solve puzzles to uncover the bunker’s dark past.
- Battle otherworldly creatures rising from ocean depths.
- Scavenge resources to endure unrelenting horrors.
Features:
- Dual perspectives: Toggle between FPS and TPP anytime.
- 5 unique endings: Your decisions define the outcome.
- Immersive audio: Haunting soundscapes amplify the terror.
- Retro-modern fusion.
- Mental health system.
You have been sent to the island of Kanaan to find an abandoned research facility of the "Third Reich".
During the briefing, you received information that the facility was engaged in researching parallel dimensions and collecting information about ancient deities.
There are various legends about the island of Kanaan, some say that it was once inhabited by a tribe worshiping ancient sea deities. Others claim that the control over the island belonged to the fish people.
Four months earlier, tectonic tremors occurred throughout the archipelago, as a result of which tsunami waves rolled through the islands, but by some coincidence they missed Kanaan, but many of the buildings were damaged or collapsed.
Hydra is a detective game with survival horror elements. The main character's condition is described by three parameters: health, endurance and sanity. The player's task during the adventure is to keep these parameters at a decent level. Seth's character can die from the damage dealt, but he can also fall into madness. Endurance describes how long our character can run, parry blows or attack with melee weapons.
company: FM Simple Games Studio, Acid Arrow Studio

title: Ketz: Galactic Overlords
description:
게임 정보
Ketz: Galactic Overlords is a sci-fi fantasy-themed roguelite horde survival game with RPG elements. Choose your character, collect various gear, and create game-breaking builds using powerful skills from the Galactic Leaders. Find out why the Galactic Leaders chose to help you.
                                          Rare Gear Made Easy with Master Tinket!
Use Master Tinket to upgrade your gear and reach rare items. Placing the same type of item will increase your chances of obtaining the desired equipment!
                                   Different Skill Combinations = Different Strategies

Choose from 9 Galactic Leaders who have allied with you against Ketzeror, discover the skill combinations that suit you best, and craft your battle strategy!

title: Nuts For You
description:
게임 정보
Do you like Romance? Comedy? Adven- SQUIRRELS!
You’re a squirrel at a vacation park, here to chill out and meet some other squirrels. You start out at the Great Squirrel Log where you can grab a bite to eat, sip on a Squirltale, and maybe meet some locals. There's 5 fuzzy tailed-bachelors just waiting for you to get to know them.
After getting to know a bit about the bachelors you can choose which whimsical and romantic date to go on. Where ever you may end up be careful of what you say. Actions have consequences and all squirrels have feelings. 
                                      Nuts For You is a comedic dating sim where you play as a squirrel in a park and have the choice to date one of five squirrel bachelors. Choices matter and change the outcome of the game.
There are ten possible endings five good endings and five bad endings. Each choice you make has the opportunity to push you towards one of the good or bad endings. All five of the squirrel bachelors have their own routes you can go down and try to get the good ending will, each have their own unique storyline and backstory that is revealed through the game.

title: Micro Manager - 90 Days Probation
description:
게임 정보
Can you survive the first 90 days probation to keep your job? Tailored for those who've ever dreamt of pranking their Manager, or anyone looking to escape into a game that mirrors the chaos of office life humor. Inspired by daydreams of pranks and ways to get through the day.
Choose Your Path:
Work Hard or Slack Off: Will you be the epitome of productivity, or the office's secret slacker? The choice affects not just your standing but your sanity.
Dynamic Schedule Management: Balance your work and leisure time. Overwork for more cash? Maybe. Slack off for a prank? Why not?

title: The Junkyard
description:
게임 정보
The fine line of madness
Awaken outside your Shelter, where you have lived all your life, and discover an ancient network of tunnels that connected several Shelters. Abandoned and empty, the network of tunnels has been filled with bizarre, carnivorous creatures amidst a lot of garbage and rust.
At first, everything seems like a dream. In the middle, it all seems like a nightmare. In the end, everything seems so real... Be careful not to go mad, but the voices in the tunnels echo the inevitability of dementia.
Key Features:
Survive: Beware the creatures of the underground junkyard, they are very dangerous and carnivorous. If your life meter reaches zero, start all over again...
Items: Collect items from around the map. Manage them and create more items through your inventory.
Weapons: Find firearms and melee weapons scattered around the map. There are four different firearms.
Battles: Get ready to defeat frantic and bizarre bosses in crazy battles. Each boss has its own unique look and abilities.
Choices: With each new save, the spawns of items and enemies change. Here, the choices are yours: choose your start, choose your order of battle and choose your end... But don't worry, because nothing will alter your character's reality.
Story: Although you choose how this story is told, the reality of Joseph, the main character, is only one and it's up to you to discover the truth.
Crazy: The more things you see, the “madder” your character becomes. And the higher your Madness Bar measures, the more things you can see.

title: Blade of the Yokai
description:
게임 정보
SUMMARY OF THE GAME:
Journey through Edo Japan as you fight enemies and bosses. Explore dungeons to save Japan from demon lord Oden in Blade of the Yokai. You'll play as Katsuro, a teenage boy who lives a peaceful life in Asahi village. Help katsuro defeat demon lord Oden and help save his world and Edo Japan.
EXPLORATION IS KEY:
Blade of the Yokai is designed around exploration in the world of Edo Japan. You'll travel across a few big regions: The forest, the coast, and the mountain. Each region has a dungeon for you to beat. You'll also have plenty of secrets to find if you look hard enough. Fight all kinds of enemies such as the Slime, Cyclops, Fish, Octopus, and Bamboo through out your journey in Edo Japan. Find chest and weapons to help you defeat enemies and bosses helping you get closer in saving Edo Japan.
USE YOUR WEAPONS WISELY:
As you progress through the game, you'll find new weapons that you can use to fight the enemies. You will also need to use those weapons to unlock new ways to explore. Use the Ninjaku to shoot fire and break wood in your quest through the world of Edo Japan. Use the Shuriken as a long rang weapons to reach objects and defeat enemies. Use an Axe to break rocks in your exploration through Edo Japan.
HELP OUT THE VILLAGE:
Asahi village will have side quests from villagers who require your assistance. Lend them a hand, and you will get rewarded with credits and some exciting rewards as a thank you to help you through your exploration in Edo Japan.

title: Ninjam!
description:
게임 정보
A competitive action game for up to 4 players!
Earn 1 point for surviving on the stage. The player who reaches the designated points first wins!
Rise to the top with a variety of weapons and flashy ninjutsu!

title: Pipeline Crawl
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in a tight, suffocating pipeline, there's no way out but forward... or back.
🌀 A claustrophobic challenge

Navigate a confined tunnel filled with deadly traps.
⚠️ Hard

One mistake, and you're back to the start.

Move forward or backward—every decision matters.

Learn from your failures and try again.

🔦 : Feel the pressure of being trapped in a narrow space.
🎉 : The first game from a new developer, bringing a unique vision to life.

title: The Nightmare of Pandemic - Kyle's Story
description:
게임 정보
Kyle wakes up with a headache, not realizing he has survived a helicopter crash. He finds himself alone on a farm, surrounded by wreckage. His team is dead, and he must recover the pilot's remains to complete their mission.
As Kyle assesses his injuries, a bright flash of light envelops him. Suddenly, he is floating in space, wearing a space suit. Just then, a friend appears and tells him, “I got a message from Lucas. You need to help Kevin with teleportation.”
Kyle realizes he must assist Kevin, who possesses vital information. He hears Lucas's orders echo in his mind: “Help Kevin with teleportation.” Though he can’t remember much about what happened during the mission, he knows this is just the beginning.
autokwd: The Nightmare of Pandemic - Kyle's Story

title: Thrice Cursed
description:
게임 정보
Something is not right in the land. Oswald, the inn keeper of the Dancing Pig needs your help to check on his missing regulars. Take on the role of an outsider who has lost everything and get to the bottom of what is so very wrong here.

Hack and slash your way through quests in a random order
Fight against monsters, men, beasts and bosses in the ruins of this devastated land. Simplified Souls like combat and stats allow you to hack and slash with different weapons. Underneath lies the complexity to make many builds with unique strengths.

Find and buy from a vast selection of weapons, armour and charms to piece together your build as you take on the evil that has beset these lands. Items are randomised and so is your progress route, each character will have different options for equipment.
A bearded, grizzled warrior. A pointy eared, long haired elf maiden. A scarred half-orc sporting a mohawk. The options are endless. It is a roguelike, so death is an opportunity for a new character.

title: Medieval Legacy
description:
게임 정보
Medieval Legacy 소개
Medieval Legacy는 가족 시뮬레이션과 도시 건설 전략을 결합한 독특한 게임으로, 모든 결정이 당신의 유산을 형성합니다. 겸손한 시민으로 시작하여 세대를 거쳐 가족을 이끄세요. 사회적 지위를 상승시켜 왕국에서 가장 영향력 있는 가문이 되십시오. 전략, 기지, 그리고 약간의 운을 사용하여 오래 지속되는 유산을 구축하십시오 – 하지만 경계하십시오, 통제되지 않은 야망은 몰락을 초래할 수 있습니다!
가족을 관리하세요
가족의 건강과 허기를 관리하여 생존을 보장하세요. 다른 가문과 교류하며 강력한 동맹을 맺거나 숙적 관계를 형성할 수 있습니다. 신비한 생물을 만나고 마법 유물을 수집하세요. 가족을 도둑으로부터 보호하거나, 그들과 함께 약탈에 나설 수도 있습니다. 집을 확장하고, 새로운 건물을 건설하며, 자신의 땅을 차지하세요.

title: Kingdom's Deck
description:
게임 정보
이곳의 마지막 통치자로서, 당신은 이 나라의 운명을 손에 쥐고 있습니다. 게임에서는 카드를 수집하고 덱을 구성해야 합니다. 각 카드에는 고유한 기능이 있습니다. 자원 생산, 방어 시설을 위한 카드부터 다양한 군사 유닛을 소환하는 공격형 카드까지 전략적으로 활용하세요. 올바른 순간에 적절한 카드를 사용하는 것이 승리를 위한 열쇠입니다.
적들은 거센 파도처럼 몰려옵니다! 상상력을 발휘하세요. 일반적인 공격뿐만 아니라 강력한 마법도 사용할 수 있습니다. 하늘에서 쏟아지는 마법 화살, 적을 가둬버리는 지옥불 등, 이 땅에는 엄청난 힘이 잠들어 있습니다.

title: WarOS
description:
게임 정보
중국의 Qikuai Studio가 개발한 SF 행성간 전쟁을 주제로 한 실시간 전략 게임(RTS)인 WarOS에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 국내 RTS 고전 "Between Life and Death"의 정신적 후속작으로, 28년간의 노고와 열정을 쏟았으며, 플레이어를 전례 없는 지구 이후의 우주 전장으로 인도하여 전례 없는 전략적 깊이와 풍부한 스토리라인을 경험하게 할 것입니다.
【게임 배경】
"WarOS"의 스토리는 지구 이후의 시대를 배경으로 합니다. 이 시대는 기술이 매우 발달했지만 전쟁으로 황폐해진 세계입니다. 인간과 인공지능의 갈등은 결국 예상치 못한 방식으로 끝났고, 살아남은 인간들은 새로운 집을 찾아야 했습니다. 당신은 행성 변형 계획에 참여하도록 모집된 개척자 역할을 하게 될 것입니다. 광활한 별이 빛나는 하늘 아래에서 당신은 당신의 팀을 이끌고 알려지지 않은 도전과 도덕적 선택에 직면하게 될 것입니다.

title: Crisis in the Kremlin: The Cold War
description:
게임 정보
크렘린의 위기: 냉전은 소련의 마지막 10년을 배경으로 한 실시간 정치 전략 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 경제, 외교, 내정 등 국가 운영의 핵심 요소들을 관리하며 소련의 운명을 좌우하세요. 외교를 통해 전 세계 국가들과 교류하거나 대리전을 통해 영향력을 행사하여 세력을 확장하세요.

사회주의의 불꽃을 다시 피우는 것부터 서구의 민주주의를 수용하는 것까지, 소련을 다양한 길로 이끌 중요한 결정을 내리는 역사적 사건과 대체 역사에 몰입해 보세요. 당신의 선택에 따라 수십 가지의 다양한 결말이 기다리고 있습니다. 소련의 미래에 대한 당신만의 비전을 실현해 보세요.

크렘린의 위기는 초강대국의 운명이 당신의 손에 달린 매우 세밀한 시뮬레이션을 제공합니다.연방을 보존할 것인가, 새로운 미래를 건설할 것인가?

페레스트로이카 - 10월 혁명의 지속
위기... 위기가 혁명의 모국이자 혁명의 심장인 크렘린을 덮쳤습니다
소비에트 연방은 너무 오랫동안 정체되어 있었으며, 이제 다양한 상황, 집단, 사람들이 변화를 요구하고 있습니다. 어떤 이들은 과거로의 회귀에서 미래를 찾고, 어떤 이들은 신중한 개혁을 원하며, 또 다른 이들은 급진적인 변화를 요구합니다. 위기는 크렘린의 탑들에 깊이 뿌리내렸고, 숨어 있는 반역자들은 스포트라이트를 받을 순간을 기다리고 있습니다.

이번에는 체카 요원의 징벌의 칼날이 어디로 향할까요? 붉은 갑옷을 입은 당의 기사는 어디를 가리킬까요? 그리고 모든 소비에트 인민들의 발걸음은 어디로 향할까요? 위대한 제국? 공산주의? 개혁? 붕괴?

새롭게 업데이트된 '크렘린의 위기'에서 소련을 이끌어보세요. 가장 어려운 시기를 극복하도록 국가를 이끄세요. 과학 연구를 수행하고, 재정을 관리하고 소련을 장기화된 정치 위기에서 벗어나게 하세요. 사회 개혁을 실행하고, 자유 선거를 도입하거나, 반대로 모든 자유주의적 개혁 시도를 되돌리세요: 법률을 세밀하게 조정하는 것도 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 서방 세계와 친구가 되거나 미국에 맞서 서방의 붕괴를 가져오세요, 신제국주의라는 독특한 길을 따르거나 당신만의 길을 개척하세요: "크렘린의 위기"는 당신에게 거대한 기회를 열어줍니다.

title: Eternal Hell
description:
게임 정보
Story
You'll die if you enter a site that you're never supposed to enter. You have to run away from the monster. This game is horror game, you go to the hell and you adventure hell
You have to survive in hell
This Game
The Eternal Hell is a short horror anomaly experience (~30 minutes) inspired by liminal spaces and psychological horror walking simulators, like 'The Exit 8', 'Pools', and their virtual predecessor, 'P.T.'.
Game Features
Two endings
Mainly a first person walking simulator.
Realistic graphics.
It's a normal horror game.
SO MANY SECRETS!
One big secret connects all the stories. Each story will have its own secrets for you to uncover.
The building is filled with eerie rooms bearing traces and stories of past inhabitants on each building.

title: Badlands Crew
description:
게임 정보
선량한 생존자들의 마지막 보루, 시타델의 보호관이 되어 무법천지인 배드랜드로 떠날 시간입니다. 제멋대로 날뛰는 약탈자 세력을 정복하고, 사악한 우두머리인 오레터를 물리치십시오. 위협의 손길이 점점 여러분 앞까지 뻗쳐옵니다. 이에 맞서 임무를 성공시키기 위해서는 강력한 전투 차량을 만들어야 합니다.
깊이 있고 역동적인 차량 커스터마이징 시스템을 활용해 보세요. 화염방사기, 저격 포탑, 개틀링 기관총, 망루, 치료소, 바퀴, 서스펜션, 연료 탱크, 엔진, 배기관 등 각종 부품과 무기를 전투 차량에 장착할 수 있습니다. 세상에 단 하나뿐인, 나만의 전투 차량을 만들어 보세요.
오합지졸에, 실력도 없어 우왕좌왕하는 크루를 전투 차량의 장점과 여러분의 플레이 스타일을 보완할 능력을 갖춘 정예 전사로 만드세요. 배드랜드에서 죽음은 일상 그 자체이며 그 죽음은 영원합니다. 오직 단련된 전사만이 살아남을 수 있습니다. 누구를 희생시킬지… 신중히 생각하고 결정하십시오.

title: Battle Bits
description:
게임 정보
용감한 Arroba(@)의 역할을 맡아 치열한 컴퓨터 바이러스 공격으로부터 시스템을 방어하는 흥미진진한 2D 게임인 Battle Bits에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 이 역동적이고 도전적인 게임에서 여러분의 임무는 여러분이 가는 길에 있는 모든 적과 보스를 제거하여 바이러스가 시스템을 장악하는 것을 막는 것입니다.

게임 메커니즘:
- 다양한 적: A부터 Z까지의 문자로 표시되는 적 무리에 맞서세요. 각각은 고유한 공격 및 방어 패턴을 가지고 있습니다.
- 강력한 보스: 0부터 9까지의 숫자는 당신의 능력을 최대한 시험할 강력한 보스 역할을 합니다.
- 고유 무기: 기호를 무기로 사용합니다: !, ?, -, +, :, =, %, #, *. 각 무기에는 점부터 대시까지 고유한 발사 방식이 있어 적과 싸울 수 있는 다양한 전략을 제공합니다.
- 강렬한 생존: 시스템에서 최대한 오래 살아남아 최종 보스인 9번을 물리치고 최종 승리를 쟁취하세요.

주요 기능:
- 중독성 있고 도전적인 게임: 반사 신경을 예리하게 유지할 열광적이고 액션으로 가득 찬 게임 플레이입니다.
- 진행 및 업그레이드: 각 게임에서 얻는 비트를 사용하여 상점에서 업그레이드와 새로운 무기를 구입하고 Arroba를 강화하여 더욱 치열한 대결을 펼치세요.
- 레트로 2D 스타일: 고전 아케이드 게임의 향수를 불러일으키는 2D 그래픽으로 매력적인 시각적 디자인을 즐겨보세요.
- 전략 및 기술: 전략을 계획하고 각 무기를 유리하게 사용하여 가장 어려운 적과 보스를 물리치세요.

시스템을 보호하고 바이러스를 물리치는 데 필요한 능력이 있습니까? 전투에 참여하고 Battle Bits에서 실력을 뽐내세요!

title: Warfare Legacy Collection
description:
게임 정보
Bundling together the classic tug of war games Warfare 1917 and Warfare 1944, Warfare Legacy Collection contains the definitive versions of these original strategy games. This edition also introduces an all-new campaign, Battle of the Bulge. Engage in the strategic battles of WW1 and WW2, commanding troops and shaping battlefields.



Fighting historical battles in and out of the trenches of France, Warfare 1917 sees you play as either the British or German Army in a campaign of attrition.

Deploy troops and control the trenches!
Make use of the first tanks used in war to dominate the battlefield.
Break the enemy morale with fire support and take their ground.
Spend command points to upgrade your troops and fire support.
Set up custom battles with your choice of units, trenches, barbed wire and land mines!



Taking to the fields of battle in you’ll choose between the U.S Forces or the Wehrmacht. Choose to either fight to liberate France or defend it from the Allied assault. Engage in the strategic tug of war across three lanes of battle.







Set during the freezing winter of 1944, adds an entirely new campaign to the collection. Inspired by one of WWII’s final major offensives, these missions take players through snowy forests, shattered towns, and desperate defenses on both sides of the front.

title: Angle Wars
description:
게임 정보
Angle Wars is a light-hearted, top-down war game blending elements of speed and strategy. Control soldiers using a variety of weapons and abilities, across an array of battlefields and game modes. You'll have to direct your men where to move and at what angles to shoot, taking into account perspective, obstacles, physics, wind, and elevation. Victory or defeat, the balance lies in your hands...because in Angle Wars, you call the shots!
Features
Do battle with a variety of weapons, from rifles and pistols to mortars and airstrikes.
Hone your skills while winning the war in campaign mode. Progress through dozens of missions across the European theater, alone or co-op with up to 4 players, doing things only an expert marksman can!
Use your surroundings to your advantage! Hold the high ground, position your troops in buildings, take cover behind objects for a defensive bonus.
Master the angles, and then master them again. Ricochet a bullet off a rock, off a building, and into your enemy's face.
Take wind into account, or you'll throw a grenade at your own feet, knock a tree down on yourself, or roast your own men in a grass fire.
Let destruction be your friend! Take cover in a crater left by an airstrike, or crush an enemy soldier with a falling tree or dislodged boulder.
Play a variety of game types, such as the competitive, tactical Battleground, or the frantic co-op survival mode.
Advance through the ranks, and earn medals for your awesome marksmanship and heroic deeds on the battlefield!
Local multiplayer for 1-4 players.
Gamepads fully supported. No gamepads, no problem! Inputs are configurable, so 4 people can play crowded around 1 mouse and keyboard. Perfect for local play, or for Steam's Remote Play!

title: Wuthering Waves
description:
게임 정보
오픈월드 액션 RPG 『명조:워더링 웨이브』에서는 높은 자유도의 액션과 다양한 오픈월드 어드벤처를 즐길 수 있으며, 플레이어는 오랜 잠에서 깨어난 '방랑자'가 되어, 스스로의 기억과 이야기를 찾는 여정에 올라 다양한 파트너들과 함께 이 세상을 바꾸기 위한 여정을 떠나게 됩니다.

◆게임 소개◆
방랑자님! 이곳에서 깨어나신 것을 환영합니다.
소리 없는 조수가 우리 세계의 많은 것을 휩쓸고 갔습니다.
비명의 강림 앞에 인류는 과거의 법칙만을 남겼으며, 문명은 비명의 발아래 묻혔습니다.
그러나 침묵의 정적이 끝난 지금, 인류는 새로운 시작을 위해 나아가고자 합니다.
파멸과 함께 나타난 이상 현상은 새로운 삶을 가져왔고, 인류는 그들과 함께 새로운 시대를 열어가고 있습니다.
그리고…… 방랑자의 여행도 이제 막 시작되려 합니다.
함께 싸워 줄 친구를 만나 상상을 뛰어넘는 적과 마주할 수도 있고, 자신을 변화시키는 힘을 받아들여 모든 것을 뒤엎는 진실을 파헤칠 수도 있고, 미처 보지 못한 기묘한 광경을 탐험하게 될 수도 있습니다. 물론 모든 길은 방랑자의 선택에 달려 있습니다.
방랑자가 어떤 선택을 하게 될지는 알 수 없으나, 자신만의 답을 찾고 이 재난의 아픔을 이겨 나갈 수 있을 것이라 믿습니다.
어쩌면, 정체된 문명이라는 배를 출항시킬 수 있는 사람은 방랑자 뿐일지도 모릅니다.
조수의 흐름이 순환되듯, 인류의 문명도 끊임없이 순환됩니다.
이제, 자신의 답을 찾기 위한 여행길에 오르세요.
◆게임 특색◆

title: Navigating The Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
The city of Pherae is in decline. It was once rich, but has been overshadowed by the Labyrinth Kingdoms and their Minotaur king.

Every year, brave adventurers venture forth to solve the mysteries of the labyrinths in order to return with treasure to save their dying city, but none ever return. This loss of healthy, skilled people only serves to accelerate the decline.

Can you succeed where others have failed? Test your mettle against the mazes and discover the secrets and riches that lie within!

Navigating the Labyrinth is a classic first-person party-based dungeon crawler RPG with grid-based movement and turn-based combat. Build and level up a party of up to six adventurers of different classes and use their spells and abilities to defeat progressively tougher monsters as they explore farther into the labyrinth.

This is a standalone game in the same style as Into The Inferno and Crossing The Sands by the same developer and you do not need to play the previous games to enjoy this one fully.

title: City of Cats
description:
게임 정보
A cozy sandbox where you live the ultimate feline life in a vast, bustling city! Explore streets, alleyways, and parks as a mischievous cat, meowing, napping, and causing chaos. Hang out with your friends, chase mice, knock over objects, or lounge in the sun. No rules—just a world of purrfect possibilities. How will you spend your nine lives?

title: Propaganda vs. Zombies
description:
게임 정보
WISHLIST NOW COMRADE, THATS AN ORDER!!
Propaganda vs. Zombies is a bullet hell deck builder roguelike where you fight an onslaught of zombies. Resources are scarce and your main goal will be to convert all these zombies into Comrades with the use of Propaganda!
• Fight the Undead: Use carefully curated cards to shoot, zap, and crush the zombie menace before they overrun your borders.
• Summon Comrades: Use Propaganda Bullets (trademark pending) to convert zombies into Comrades that will spread the good word of our nation!
• Strategic Deckbuilding: Build a deck to suit your playstyle. Whether you prefer overwhelming firepower, cunning spell combos, or comrade-based tactics, there’s always a new strategy to explore.
• Shape Your Path: Make critical resource choices that open new opportunities or impose new challenges. These decisions affect your progression and can completely alter how each run unfolds.
• Roguelite Progression :Each run is unique. Randomized cards, unpredictable enemies, and different resource decisions ensure no two playthroughs are the same.
Will you answer the call to defend Hibura, or will the zombie hordes consume your country’s hopes of a bright red future? Join the revolution—Propaganda vs. Zombies awaits!

title: Eydigard
description:
게임 정보
『에이디가르드(Eydigard)』는 16세기 초 혼란에 빠진 북노르웨이의 피오르드를 무대로 펼쳐지는 민담 기반 RPG입니다. 정체 모를 전염병으로 인해 번성했던 농장들은 폐허가 되었고, 주변의 야생지대에는 신화 속의 생명체들이 나타나기 시작했습니다.
변신 능력을 가진 신비로운 용병이 되어 전설 속 괴물과 싸우고, 버려진 농장을 되찾아 나만의 기지로 발전시키며, 씨족 간의 정치적 긴장감을 극복해 나가세요. 다양한 동물로의 변신은 플레이 전략과 게임 진행 방식을 크게 좌우할 것입니다.
당신의 모든 결정은 지역 사회와 씨족 간의 관계에 직접적인 영향을 미치며, 게임 속 세계를 다채롭게 변화시킵니다.
주요 특징:
생생한 오픈월드 탐험: 버려진 농장과 웅장한 산악 궁전, 활기찬 시장을 탐험하세요. 상인, 방랑자, 전설 속 존재들과 소통하며 숨겨진 이야기들을 밝혀내세요.
변신 능력 활용: 다양한 동물 형태로 변신하여 전투, 탐험, 퍼즐 해결에 필요한 특수 능력을 자유롭게 활용하세요. 선택한 동물에 따라 게임 플레이가 달라집니다.

title: SubwaySim 2
description:
게임 정보
Dive into Simuverse Interactive's new public transport simulation!
Explore the three most picturesque underground lines in Germany! The Berlin U1/U3 and the Hamburg U3 are waiting for you. 
Immerse yourself in everyday life in the two German metropolises and discover famous sights such as Hamburg's harbour or Berlin's Oberbaum Bridge. 
Master various scenarios and get your passengers to their destination safely and on time. Watch out, though, as disruptions and red signals can suddenly change your workload!
Are you ready to start your first shift?
Experience public transport on a new level. SubwaySim 2 offers an unparalleled standard of realism and authenticity. The graphics have been improved even more since the predecessor, and particular attention was dedicated to the vehicles, which are more detailled than ever before.
Authentic scenarios, dynamic weather and the brand-new career mode round off the realistic picture of a subway operator's day-to-day work.

title: Red October
description:
게임 정보
"Red October" will transport you to the secret research center Oktyabrsk-21, where work is in full swing on Project "Red October" – a revolutionary energy source based on cold nuclear fusion. You will take on the role of Dmitry Sokolov, a young nuclear physicist who has just arrived in the city and immediately finds himself at the epicenter of events capable of changing the world.
What awaits you in "Red October":
Gripping Plot: Uncover the secrets of Project "Red October", face intrigue, industrial espionage, and ethical dilemmas. Expect unexpected twists, difficult decisions, and a struggle for the future of science.
Living Characters: Meet ambitious scientists, tough party officials, and mysterious intelligence agents. Each character is an individual with their own motives and secrets.
Atmosphere of the Soviet Union: Immerse yourself in the era of the Cold War, explore the meticulously recreated science city, and feel the spirit of competition and secrecy that reigned in Soviet science.
Science Fiction and Thriller: "Red October" is a story about scientific progress, its price, and its consequences. You can expect thrilling investigations, tense dialogues, and unexpected discoveries.
Moral Choice: Who should be entrusted with the revolutionary technology? How can its use for the benefit of humanity be ensured? You will have to make difficult decisions that will affect the future not only of Oktyabrsk-21, but of the entire world.

title: Secrets of Antares
description:
게임 정보
Journey to humanity's most ambitious expedition yet - a mysterious paradise planet orbiting the mighty red supergiant Antares. Experience pure exploration in this peaceful simulation designed for those seeking tranquility among the stars.
As one of the first explorers to set foot on this alien world, you'll experience its wonders in stunning virtual reality that pushes the boundaries of visual fidelity. No combat, no enemies - just you and an untouched alien paradise waiting to be discovered.
Key Features:
True Open-World Serenity: No invisible walls or locked paths—explore every inch of the vast, alien landscape at your leisure. From sprawling forests and jagged mountain ranges to glowing bioluminescent caverns, the only limit is your curiosity and the fuel in your jetpack.
Pure Exploration Experience: This is a peaceful simulation focused entirely on discovery and wonder. No fighting, no survival mechanics - just the freedom to explore at your own pace. Perfect for unwinding after a long day when you need to escape and recharge.

title: K2: Digital Edition
description:
게임 정보
The officially licensed digital adaptation of board game K2 with Spiel des Jahres Kennerspiel Nominee and Golden Geek Best Family Board Game Nominee.

title: GoKaDu
description:
게임 정보
GoKaDu is a retro simulator of a role-playing card game of the 80s and 90s - "Govno".
Seven ghost friends gathered at GoKaDu Castle to play their favorite game. And the name of that game is "Govno". Play as one of them, intrigue, fight for power, distribute the budget of the deck and put it in order, such as you like. For many years it was believed that this game could not be programmed, but the desire to give players the opportunity to play it at any time of the day or night accomplished the impossible, and it appeared on computers. The game has 52 cards, a phase mode, there is rude profanity, heavy folk rock music and a sea of joy and happiness! The rules and the game world are described in the help and pdf manual.

The gameplay is based on imitation of communication with computer characters. During the game, you need to press the buttons on which the recorded phrases, playing the role of the player. These phrases can be checked for sclerosis damage and edited in the slide-out panel that opens when you click on the key. It closes when you click on the flickering handle of the key or by rotating the mouse wheel at the very bottom of the window. Prepared phrases can be called not only with the mouse, but also with hotkeys, which can be peeped in the slide-out panel. During the game, players can summon additional characters who act as bystanders and spectators of the game. During the games of "Govno" on the street, such extraneous characters added a special atmosphere to the game, which is recreated by this game. After the first section of maps, the letter "A" appears in the lower right corner, clicking on which the Autopilot turns on and off. It will help you cope in a situation when you will not know what to say or you will be too lazy to divide the cards.

title: Blight's Grasp
description:
게임 정보
Carve a path through this planet:
Battle your way through a variety of environments, and fix broken down portals using power cores you find in the environment. With your grit, wits, and some elbow grease you’ll overcome and overpower any obstacle in your way.
String together your on unique attacks:
In Blights Grasp you can mix and match your different fighting styles with the alien elements you can harness, creating a variety of effects and combinations. The act of mixing these elements and styles is quick, allowing for on the fly moves and strategies. 
Features:
A 3rd Person Action Game centering on melee combat.
Use your ranged attack to extend combos and hit far away enemies.
Collect power cores to buy power ups and fix portals.
Navigate environments using your jumps and dashes.
Switch between different fighting styles and elements using the radial menu.

title: Strike Zero
description:
게임 정보
Strike Zero에서 당신은 「Pi」부스레기와 결합되어 기억을 잃은 소녀 역을 맡게 됩니다. 근미래 세계에서 제1함대 실습조종사 신분으로 신형 전투기를 운전하고 일련의 독특한 모험을 겪게 됩니다. 스토리가 전개되면서 당신은 초현실 꿈경에 빠져들고 시나리오를 추진하게 됩니다. 각종 세력이 나타나고 서로 경쟁하면서 세상도 빈번하게 나타난 괴물으로 위기에 빠져듭니다. 당신은 점점 잃어진 기억을 찾게 되고 혼란에 빠진 세상을 구하려고 시도하게 되니다.
독특한 전투 놀이법, 게임의 재미를 다시 찾는다
게임에서 당신은 「Pi젼투기」를 운전하고 세계 각지에서 싸우게 됩니다. 전통 탄막 게임과 달리 당신의 전투기는 대다수 시간에 단일 방향인 엔진을 통해 이동합니다. 동시 일부 물리적 엔진 원칙에 맞당하여 적과 마침 스쳐지나가는 공중 전투 체험이 생겨집니다.

온갖 화력을 다해! 적한테 달리자! 비록 다칠 수도 있지만 치명적이지 않습니다. 「Pi전투기」는 부단히 강화하는 방패가 있어 충격을 저소할 수 있습니다. 이로 자유로이 화력을 발사합니다!
전투기의 성장방향, 공격, 방어, 움직임을 스스로 정하고 스타일이 다른 무기를 배치하여 부동한 전투 체험을 얻게 됩니다. 당신은 다종다양한 구역에서 적과 싸우게 되는데 광훨한 하늘이든가, 깜깜한 바닥속 동굴이라든가, 부지런히 적들을 패배하고 결국 운명의 속박에서 벗어나게 됩니다.

완정한 시나리오 체험, 자신의 최종 운명을 선택:
게임에서 당신은 완정한 메인라인 시나리오를 체험하게 되는 동시, 시나리오에 따라 게임속 미래 세상, 각종 세력의 캐릭터 및 입장을 깊이 이해하게 됩니다. 다종다양한 정보가 플레이어가 체한 무대 센터에 모이게 됩니다. 깜깜한 안개를 휘우치며 주인공의 신세를 알게 됩니다. 당신의 선택은 또한 나중 시나리오 방향에도 영향을 줍니다!

게임 시나리오에 따라 당신은 부동한 장면에서 전투하게 됩니다. 환경, 지형이 다르고 심지어 일부 장절에서는 당신이 생각지도 못한 장면에서 전투하게 됩니다. 이런 장면은 플레이어의 비행 전략, 전투 전략에 부동한 영향을 끼치게 됩니다.

왜곡된 광훨한 하늘에서 어떻게 고속도로 이동하고 있는 적들을 명중할가요? 어떻게 좁은 터미널에서 적들의 추격을 벗어날가요? 어떻게 장애물이 많은 공간속에서 빨리 이동할가요? 어떻게 숨이 막히는 곤난 상황에서 보급을 구할가요? 어떻게 거의 통제를 잃은 환경에서 눈 앞에 보이는 보물을 만질가요?...이러한 도전들에 점차 나타날 것인데 우리는 당신만의 해결방식이 있을거라고 믿습니다!

당연하죠, 당신은 이런 극한 특수환경의 전투에서 쾌감을 느끼게 됩니다!

전투 외에 당신은 주인공으로서 다종다양한 장면에서 탐색할 수 있습니다. 함대 맴버와 대화하여 부동한 시나리오를 촉발하는 동시 일부 단서를 얻거나, 혹은 일부 의상밖의 수확이 생깁니다. 비록 모든 것은 필수가 아니지만...하지만 당신한테 혹시 전투를 제외한 부분이 당신이 진짜 필요한 것인지?

격렬한 전투 후에 아름다운 바다섬 커피숍에서 잠깐 쉬고 푸른 하늘과 백사장을 즐기는 것도 일종 괜찮은 휴식 방식이 아닐가 싶습니다~

「Pi」부스레기는 일정한 자아의식이 있는바 게임에서 플레이어는 손목에 찬 시계를 통해 "그"와 대화할 수 있습니다. 부지런히 탐색하는 동시 후속 시나리오도 점점 나타나게 됩니다.

전투를 통해 각종 괴물의 「Pi」부스레기를 흡수하면 당신은 독특한 천부판으로 전투기의 각종 능력을 강화할 수 있습니다. 동시 전투기 장비도 1세트 강화 시스템이 주어집니다.
전투기와 독특한 강화 시스템을 통해 더 좋은 전투 체험을 얻게 됩니다.

당연하죠! 강화하지 않아도 괜찮아요! 더 극한적으로 게임을 즐기세요! 된다면 적을 강화해볼래요?

여러 플레이어들이 게임에서 자신이 좋아하는 놀이법과 유파를 찾고 게임의 재미를 찾으며 일상과 다른 모험을 향수하게 됩니다. 만약 시간을 소모하고 게임 내용을 깊이 탐색하면 더 좋지 말입니다. 우리는 모든 플레이어들이 게임의 모든 내용을 느끼고 즐겼으면 합니다.
Strike Zero에서 운명을 위해 싸웁시다!

title: Mining Company
description:
게임 정보
OBJECTIVES
You've gone to work for yourself and have taken out a loan on a spaceship. To make money, you fly to nearby asteroids and mine through caves to collect and sell gems so you make the payments in time. The cash you earn can be used to travel to new asteroids with higher risks and rewards--or you can buy upgrades to your tools and your spaceship. Explore the asteroids, watching for all sorts of enemies along the way, especially those that come out at night.
DON'T GO BY YOURSELF
The monsters and robots on the asteroids prey on the vulnerable and singled-out, so the help of your friends is invaluable. Coordinate your mining and survival plans easily with in-game proximity voice chat and walkie-talkies.

title: TIME ARENA
description:
게임 정보
In Time Arena, time is the ultimate prize. Players battle it out in a futuristic arena where the goal is simple—collect more Clocks than your opponents before time runs out. Speed and strategy are your keys to victory. Use Speed Dash to zip across the map and Ventilator Fans to launch yourself to Main Arena. But be careful, the arena is full of dangers like time-warping grenades and red plasma that can slow you down. Outrace, outsmart, and outlast your friends to prove you’re the fastest in the arena!
Objective
Collect more Clock items than your friends before time runs out! Clocks only spawn on the first and top floors of the Main Arena.
MULTIPLAYER
In order to play this game, STEAM SHOULD BE RUNNING IN YOUR BACKGROUND!
Create a session with Room name, Required players to start and Total gameplay time. Once session is created(it's public by default), your friends could find the game by clicking the "Find Session" button on the mainmenu.
Each player’s Steam ID is displayed above their character, and collected Clocks appear at the top-right. Keep an eye on players hoarding Clocks!
Controls
W,A,S,D : Basic Movements
Shift : Speed Dash (Requires Stamina)
1 key : SMG
2 key : Pistol
Right Click : Weapon Aim (Should be equipping weapon beforehand)
G key : Plasma Grenade (Reduce the flow of time within a blasted area)
Tips
You could use Giant ventilation fans to quickly fly from rear of the map from Main Arena/ground floor from the top level of Main Arena.
Plasma Grenades don’t deal damage but slow enemies with a large blast radius. Use them wisely!
Red plasma which is coving Ground floor and first floor of Main Arena slowly deals players inside it. Grab a health item to stay alive!

title: Levity Race
description:
게임 정보
LEVITY Race is the first full-body hoverboard VR racing game, developed for Meta Quest 2+3. Challenge other players or your friends in the fastest hoverboard VR game.
Taking place in the year 2150 after humanity discovered the power of Levitite which has brought hoverboard racing to new heights. Several factions are in control of different parts of Earth.
Featuring high-speed racing on multiple tracks in different styles
LEVY, your Smartdrone companion will be your support on the tracks
A variety of weapons that Levy will use for you (send it to the enemy to attack)
Lots of accessibility and comfort options (e.g. standing and seated gaming)
Soundtrack created for the game (No AI or license-free music! Streaming allowed)
Hang out in your private garage, alone, or with your friends. Some of its features include:
Choose different (unlockable) hoverboard deck designs and skins
Customise your Avatar or tune your hoverboard controls
Talk to LEVY to learn more about the History of Levity and Levitite
Some other surprises for you
Get on the right track with LEVITY Race and feel the Adrenaline!
Wishlist the game to stay up to date with the newest developments.
Launching into early access 2025

title: Sylia
description:
게임 정보
Presentation
Three gigantic and mysterious Cubes have landed on Sylia's main islands.
Inside them, unknown creatures (… Aliens) are gathered and plot on how to take control of the lands and ultimately extract the planet's energy – that would be the end of all life.

Is Sylia a realm about to fall? Maybe not!
A group of heroes is not willing to let that happen! They are Sylia's finest knight, wizardress, cleric and warrior. Supported and guided by their nation, they must enter the Cube where the Aliens' Queen (a mysterious woman going by the name of Lady Godiva) is and stop her!

But the task seems overwhelming… too overwhelming... Who is going to win the fight for Sylia? Will the land thrive or will the Aliens gain its energy and destroy every life form in the process? A cute dog, a witty cat and a crazy rooster have a say on it!

title: Survive the Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
Survey the Labyrinth – A living maze where escape is your only goal.
Step into Survey the Labyrinth, a dark and ever-changing maze where the walls shift and the exits vanish before your eyes. Every corridor holds secrets, every turn could lead to salvation—or doom. Navigate a world filled with shifting paths, cryptic puzzles, and unseen horrors that stalk your every move. The labyrinth is alive, and it does not want you to leave. Will you find the way out, or will you become part of its endless corridors?

title: Another World: Pirates And The Great Old Gods
description:
게임 정보
《Another World: Pirates And The Great Old Gods》
An exploration adventure game with chapter-style plots and Cthulhu elements.
This is the beginning of all adventures. You accidentally arrive in a different world and gain the ability to travel through different time and space...
You will try to explore the truth and find a way back to reality in the two scenes of the eternal pirate tavern and the temple of the old gods.
You are not alone. You will meet some friends or enemies in the eternal world. Completing their quests or defeating enemies can speed up your progress.

title: Pungolo - A prickly adventure

The game takes place in a magical world where players must navigate through challenging levels, defeat enemies and discover hidden areas.

title: Days Of Haze
description:
게임 정보
Days Of Haze is a puzzle filled climate simulated action RPG where your actions affect the weather and temperature.
Coated in the exakt NES palette. Every enemy killed, every life tree planted, and every seed sown plus every quest undertaken will dynamically affect how much disease is in the air, how the climate system evolves, and ultimately, the fate of the planet. This will, in turn, influence how fast things grow and have a bearing on the survival of the people living on the planet. You have never played an rpg like this before.


You are a boy shielded from everything by your grandfather. Now he is gone and you have to decide if you dare to enter the big world.
Explore a world in decline. Fight the planet's elements. Get diseases and cure diseases and hopefully make the whole world easier to explore and help the people that are left.
Unravel the mystery of the Red Goo and its effect on the world. Why did the Protectors disappear and is there a conspiracy or not?

Do your best to survive but remember, you have to live too. If some days you feel you don't want to challenge the elements and put your life at risk.
Go play arcade games in the bars in towns and collect capsules or take care of your strong willed animals and DAX.

title: Galactic Warship
description:
게임 정보
I always wanted to play an action game where I could take direct control of a capital ship in 3D space. Not fake 3D where you're on the same plane, actual 6-Axis Freedom of Movement. One day, I decided to make that game. As a solo developer, I poured two years into crafting Galactic Warship, letting you pilot massive capital-class warships in full 3D with complete 6-axis freedom. You'll unlock dozens of ships, each armed with powerful, customizable weapons, as you face waves of enemies and insane bosses from outside our reality.
Full Command of Capital-Class Warships: Finally, a game that puts the full weight of commanding these massive ships in your hands. Navigate, dodge, and engage in epic battles, with the freedom to move on all six axes.
A Growing Arsenal to Match the Threat: As you progress, you’ll gain access to an ever-expanding array of ships and weapons to suit your style. Progression is constant, every sector you complete unlocks a permanent upgrade that will help you on your next run.  
   
Infinite Replayability: No two runs will be the same, and I will be adding new missions, ships, and features with the help of player feedback.

title: Mirrors of Epiphany
description:
게임 정보
Mirrors of Epiphany is a puzzle game where you guide light beams to their designated goals by placing mirrors on a board.
Core gameplay
Light sources and detectors (paired up by colours) are placed around an empty board. The challenge is to place mirrors in positions and orientations so that each source and detector pair is connected.
Rich in content
There are 100 unique puzzles, ranging from the simplest possible to larger boards with multiple pairs of light sources and detectors.
Choose your own challenge level
Most puzzles have a lot of workable solutions, but each puzzle has only one optimal solution (i.e. using as few mirrors as possible). Explore and play around to find solutions that just get the job done, or satisfy your puzzle solving instincts by reaching for perfection.
Unlimited number of moves
You can place mirrors, change their orientations, and remove them again as many times as you like. The number of moves are not counted. The only scoring measure is the number of mirrors placed on the board when all pairs of light sources and detectors are connected.
Relaxing
There are no time limits. You can enjoy solving all the puzzles at your own pace.

title: Axona

title: Gassy Getaway
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Gassy Getaway - the hilarious casual game that will put your laughter and time management skills to the test!
Navigate Through Office Chaos

In this frantic office adventure, you take on the role of an employee in a highly urgent situation - a pressing need that just can't be stopped! But beware: Your character unfortunately has limited control over their gases and must navigate through the office without hitting too many colleagues with their unwanted emissions.
Complete Tasks Before the Countdown

Your mission? Complete all the important tasks assigned to you in the office before you just can't hold it anymore and urgently need to visit the restroom! Whether it's quickly printing out an important document or locking the computer - withstand the time pressure and avoid embarrassing encounters on the way to relief.
Key Features:

Unique Gameplay: Navigate through the office and complete important tasks while trying to keep your flatulence under control.
Exciting Challenges: From simple to tricky tasks waiting to be completed before you just can't hold it anymore.
Hilarious Animations: Dive into a world full of funny animations and characters that will tickle your funny bone.
Office Environment: Explore various office areas with different obstacles and hiding spots as you make your way to the restroom.
Rewards and Leaderboards: Unlock achievements and compete for the top spot on leaderboards as you showcase your skills in flatulence management.
Customization Options: Customize your character with different outfits and accessories, getting ready for the wild adventure in the office!

With these features, Gassy Getaway is sure to provide an unforgettable experience for all players looking for a humorous and entertaining pastime!

title: Scarred Mansion
description:
게임 정보
이 독특한 덱 빌더에서 떠나는 정맥이 끊기는 여정에는 로그라이크 탐험, 이소메트릭 그리드 이동 및 혁신적인 카드 제작이 순조롭게 융합되어 턴 기반 퍼즐 전략 게임으로 결합됩니다. 저주받은 집에 갇힌 어린 소년 역할을 맡아 탈출을 필사적으로 찾으십시오. 참으실 수 있습니까?
👻 몰입형 로그라이크 탐험
각 플레이스루가 새로운 도전, 놀람 및 초자연적인 만남을 제시하는 저주받은 집의 변화무쌍한 복도를 탐험하십시오. 그림자에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견하지만, 조심하십시오 - 당신이 내린 모든 결정은 심각한 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다.
🃏 혁신적인 카드 제작 시스템
전통적인 덱 구축 게임과 달리, Scarred Mansion은 혁신적인 카드 제작 시스템을 소개합니다. 덱에서 카드를 추가하거나 제거하는 대신, 다양한 효과를 가진 인벤토리를 사용하여 사용자 지정할 수 있는 고정된 카드 세트를 보유하게 됩니다. 추가 카드 슬롯을 잠금 해제하고 효과의 힘을 향상시켜 사용자 지정 및 강력한 덱을 생성하세요!
🔮 다이나믹한 만남과 퍼즐
다양한 초자연적인 엔터티를 만나고, 복잡한 퍼즐을 해결하고, 위협적인 적에게 맞서 보십시오. 재생되는 각 카드는 여정의 결과에 영향을 줍니다. 예상치 못한 도전에 대비하여 전략을 신속히 조정하십시오. 이를 통해 각 플레이스루가 흥미 진진하고 예측할 수 없는 경험이 되도록 보장하십시오.
🌟 업그레이드 가능한 효과 및 비밀
숨겨진 코너를 탐험하여 놀라운 비밀을 발견하고 강력한 새로운 효과를 잠금 해제하십시오. 이러한 요소들은 게임플레이에 깊이를 더하며, 도전에 대한 새로운 접근 방식을 제공하고, 유령 같은 모험의 흐름을 변경합니다.
👁️ 시각적으로 멋진 분위기
환경의 매혹적인 아름다움에 몰입하세요. 모든 그림자, 깜박이는 양초, 스펙트럴 엔터티가 느껴지는 분위기 있는 경험에 기여합니다.
🎶 기이한 사운드트랙
기가 적당한 시각적 효과를 보완하는 것은 Scarred Mansion의 기이한 분위기를 더욱 강화하는 오리지널 사운드트랙입니다. 기이한 음악과 분위기 있는 사운드는 불길한 감각을 증폭시키며, 잊지 못할 청각적 경험을 제공합니다.
알려지지 않은 곳으로 모험을 떠나 운명을 만들고 초자연적인 손아귀에서 탈출하세요. 어둠에 맞서 과연 속에 숨겨진 미스테리를 발견할 용기가 있습니까? 당신의 으스스한 모험이 문 뒤에 기다립니다.

title: Monday Morning Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Monday Morning Simulator is the much-anticipated sequel to Call Hating, the 2D point-and-click adventure game released in 2023.

In Monday Morning Simulator, you play the part of a worker-from-home who hasn't exactly kept up with modern technology. Your old, outdated, and half-broken home becomes one giant puzzle as you struggle to get your internet working and make it to an important online work meeting.

But fear not, you are accompanied by the benevolent Voice Inside Your Head, or VInYH, who serves as a helpful (and sometimes not-so-helpful) narrator in your quest for bandwidth.

Monday Morning Simulator is stocked with minigames and home maintenance-themed puzzles, including washing dishes, fixing plumbing, troubleshooting errors, remembering passwords and finding the right tools for the job around your home.

Will you overcome these challenges and make it through the automated phone system from hell to get your internet back from A.N.I.T.A. (AllNet InterCorp Technical Assistance) the evil A.I. who is out to thwart you at every turn?!

Coming 2024.

title: Domino Clicker
description:
게임 정보
About

Domino Clicker is a simple clicker game where you can enjoy the thrill of toppling dominoes. With just a click, you can set up plenty of dominoes and revel in the mesmerizing cascade as they fall. It offers straightforward gameplay that anyone can enjoy, providing a calming experience for the mind.
Description
In Domino Clicker, players are immersed in the addictive world of domino toppling. With just a simple click, you can set up an array of dominoes and watch the mesmerizing chain reaction unfold before your eyes.
The game offers a captivating experience suitable for players of all ages, combining relaxation with engaging gameplay.

I'm a junior indie game developer working independently on this project. Your support by adding the game to your wishlist would be greatly appreciated. Feel free to share any feedback or questions you may have—I'm here to listen and improve the game based on your input.

title: Collateral Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
Collateral Dungeon is a tactical puzzle dungeon crawler. Explore as an archaeologist trapped in your most recent dig: an enemy-infested dungeon. However, you are a lover, not a fighter. Without weapons, you must turn to your wit and clever traps to defeat enemies lest you relive your failings.
EXPLORE
Explore procedurally generated dungeons.

title: Make Your Choice
description:
게임 정보
Pick a theme and craft your own story by making branching choices that shape each unique adventure.
You'll be able to explore distinct themes, each offering a unique scenario:
Embark on a seven-year journey at a magic school, where you'll master your powers and unravel ancient mysteries
Lead a party of heroes on a rescue mission to save a lost prince
Establish and fortify an outpost in newly conquered territory, ensuring the prosperity and security of your ancient empire’s expansion
Features
Including a variety of unique themes and situations to start your journey from
Customize characters looks, abilities and backstories
Guide your story with meaningful choices that mold your characters and their world
Intuitive controls, game-play and interactions
Cute 3D art-style
Discover secret and hidden elements to personalize your creations
Be careful, as you shape your creations, they shape you

title: Kafkaesque: The Nightmare Trial
description:
게임 정보
Kafkaesque: The Nightmare Trial is a psychological survival horror game that thrusts you into a world of bureaucratic nightmares and existential dread.
Solve twisted puzzles, manage scarce resources, and battle monstrous manifestations of authority. Navigate a nightmarish bureaucracy as you piece together the dark truth behind your arrest.
You'll navigate a maze of early 20th century bureaucratic architecture while confronting corrupted officials like the cryptic Inspector and the ominous Magistrate.
Unravel a conspiracy that reaches far beyond your case, challenging your perception of justice and reality itself. Your investigation leads to one of three distinct endings as you face the brutal truth of your fate and the corruption that plagues this world.

title: Space Menace 2
description:
게임 정보
Space Menace 2에서 은하는 혼란의 기로에 서 있으며, 당신의 선택이 그 운명을 결정합니다. 우주 함장으로서 작은 함대와 함께 시작하지만, 당신의 여정은 결코 평범하지 않습니다. 자유롭게 항로를 개척하며, 프리랜서 임무를 수행하고, 무역과 전투를 통해 함대를 확장하고 업그레이드하는 데 필요한 크레딧을 획득하세요.

권력으로의 상승
당신이 계급을 오를수록 위험도 함께 증가합니다. 처음에는 몇 척의 함선만 지휘하지만, 곧 강력한 함대를 지휘하며 은하계에서 가장 영향력 있는 세력들의 신뢰와 존경을 얻을 것입니다. 신중하게 세력을 선택하세요. 당신의 평판은 강력한 동맹과 치명적인 충돌의 문을 열어줄 것입니다. 하지만 권력을 쥐고 있는 동안, 정체불명의 세력에 대한 소문이 점점 커지며 모든 것을 뒤흔들 위협을 가하고 있습니다.
커스터마이징
Space Menace 2에서 커스터마이징은 매우 중요합니다. 다양한 무기, 장비, 전투기를 선택하여 당신의 전략에 맞는 완벽한 조합을 만들어 보세요. 또한, 모드 지원 기능을 통해 게임을 더욱 개인화하고, 새로운 콘텐츠와 가능성을 추가할 수 있습니다.

Space Menace 2는 최소한의 반복 작업으로 최대한의 전략적 재미를 제공하도록 설계되었습니다. 게임이 진행될수록 도전과 복잡성이 증가하여 매 순간 전술적 판단과 짜릿한 전투가 이어집니다. 적 함대를 능숙하게 제압하거나 강력한 동맹과 협상을 통해 은하계에서 당신만의 전설을 만들어 가십시오.

전략, 액션, 스토리텔링이 조화를 이루는 여정을 준비하고, 전쟁이 임박한 은하에서 최강자가 되기 위한 길을 개척하세요!

title: I Come In Peace
description:
게임 정보

Survive as a pacifist alien in a chaotic bullet hell!
Crash-landing on Earth was not part of the plan, and neither was the hostile welcome from its paranoid inhabitants. As a peaceful UFO pilot, you find yourself under attack from relentless mobs, police forces, the army, helicopters, and even a special boss level. But you're not defenseless—your advanced tech bracelet equips you with:
Shield Redirect: Deflect projectiles back at your enemies with an awesome shield.
Transparency Ability: Become intangible, allowing bullets to pass through you harmlessly.
Agile Maneuvers: Sprint and roll to dodge nonstop attacks.
Your mission is critical: find the 10 scattered screws needed to repair your spaceship and escape before it's too late. Every second counts in this adrenaline-pumping, rogue-like, skill-based game where quick reflexes are your best ally.
Can you survive the mayhem and return home? Survive, little alien... survive!

Fungi Fantastico는 버섯으로 가득한 생동감 넘치는 세계를 배경으로 한 재미있는 1인칭 플랫폼 어드벤처 게임입니다. 평화로운 계곡에서 독성 곰팡이 감염을 처리하는 자연 마법 지팡이를 휘두르는 드루이드가 되어 플레이하세요. 부패를 제거하고 새로운 기술을 배우기 위해 모험을 떠나세요. 버섯을 터뜨리고 세상을 이동하는 방식을 개발하세요. 자연 광선으로 땅에 있는 버섯을 터뜨리면 다양한 버프를 얻을 수 있고, 더 높이 움직이고 점프하여 환경을 더 빠르게 횡단할 수 있는 게임입니다. 이와 함께 움직임, 이중 점프, 대시 및 중력 제어를 향상시키는 기술을 습득하세요. 힘든 하루를 보낸 후 편안하게 휴식을 취할 수 있는 이 모험에서 게임 전용으로 제작된 다채로운 환경과 차분한 lofi/주변 음악이 여러분을 기다립니다. 곰팡이와 함께 탈출하세요, in Fungi Fantastico ~

title: Path Of Balls

The stolen balls.

title: Septic
description:
게임 정보
Escape the sewer

Do you have what it takes to reach the top? In Septic, you are thrust into the depths of an underground sewer system. With its responsive controls and demanding jumps, this first-person platformer will test your agility and precision at every turn. Navigate through treacherous environments and aim to escape the murky depths.

Don't fall

A single misstep could lead to a devastating fall, costing you tons of progress. The stakes are high, and the margin for error is slim. Each jump must be perfectly timed and executed. Stay focused and don’t let the pressure get to you, or you might find yourself back at the bottom, starting all over again.


Septic challenges you to master its intricate mechanics. Every movement, from the simplest jump to the most complex maneuver, requires precision and skill. The responsive controls are designed to give you full command over your actions, allowing you to hone your abilities and achieve perfection. Practice makes perfect, and perfection is the key to survival.


Prepare yourself for an intense and unforgiving journey. Septic ramps up the difficulty as you progress, presenting you with relentless obstacles and increasingly complex levels. Your perseverance and determination will be tested like never before. Only the most resilient players will endure the challenge and emerge victorious.

title: Void Collector
description:
게임 정보
Void Collector is a speedrunning FPS with a unique weapon-switching system, focusing on tightly designed stages that can be replayed over and over again to get faster and faster.
USE A LARGE ARSENAL OF WEAPONRY
Utilize a variety of powerful weapons with many different effects. From a powerful, knockback-inducing shotgun, to an uppercut that sends you and your opponents soaring, to a middle finger that fires an immensely powerful laser, there's an ideal weapon for any situation.
MASTER THE SYSTEM
Press 1-5 on the keyboard to toggle each finger of your hand on or off. This adds a layer of difficulty that allows for a ton of deep skill expression and clever tactics.
FIGHT A TON OF ENEMIES
Blast through a wide array of enemies. From the projectile-shooting Gunther to the bomb-placing Steve Strike, these guys are sure to keep you on your toes at all times!
MANAGE YOUR RESOURCES
Attacking drains your JUICE meter, but defeating enemies gets some back! There's also a combo system, which rewards skillful play with more Juice to use so that you can pull off impressive skips! But be careful, playing too recklessly will leave you open to attack!
BECOME A VOID MASTER
Each stage has a target time to beat to test the most skilled players in their weapon-swapping and rapid movement abilities! Void Collector focuses on a high skill-ceiling to ensure it's fun to play and replay over and over again!
COLLECT DOODADS
Each main stage has a hidden piece of 'memorabilia' to collect. Find them all to understand the history of the mysterious Void Collector and those who hunt it!
ANYONE CAN PLAY
This demo includes multiple difficulties to give some breathing room to new players and truly challenge seasoned veterans. Also included is an accessibility control scheme, ensuring that anyone can enjoy!
The game sports a loose, wobbly artstyle with a jazzy soundtrack to match.

title: Moon Carrier
description:
게임 정보
In Moon Carrier, you will be doing cargo missions between bases and cities founded on the future moon. You can drive to anywhere you want, however, you are limited with the capabilities of your vehicle. Your oxygen tanks have limited capacity. Your vehicle has limited electrical capacity. Moreover, when you hit on the rocks which may appear in front of you suddenly, your vehicles condition decreases based on your hit velocity. Drive fast and you take risk of a sudden death, drive slower and you take risk of failing your missions for not delivering on time.

title: Kozomo: The Smoldering Ember
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist and Follow the Game to Get Notified When The Game Comes Out
Accompany Kozomo in this pointless life
Kozomo is a young man in his late teens, who has spent most of his youth either asleep or escaping to the woods. Despite his and his family’s wealth and reputation, Kozomo finds no joy in life, often neglecting even the simplest of duties like eating. To those around him, his behavior is not just baffling but unsettling. Some people see his detachment as a sign of madness or moral weakness. And some believe that there is a smoldering ember inside him, one day that will raise him up again.
Solve a variety of puzzles
Kozomo: The Smoldering Ember is a platformer game where you'll have to think so often to solve the puzzles blocking your way. The game usually introduces new elements or expects from you to discover new interactions between already introduced elements in some clever ways. This game is not a hardcore puzzle experience, but it also will not be a piece of cake.
Explore your firepowers
Witness Kozomo's discovery of his sorcery powers. Will this powers be able to grant him the life purpose he's lacking? Will he use those for the good, or will the power poison him? Make use of Kozomo's new firepowers to solve puzzles in different ways and find out the uncertain fate of Kozomo.

title: Lucy's Journey
description:
게임 정보
Maana Tales: Lucy is a narrative visual novel set in the enchanting and war-torn world of Maana. Follow Lucy, a determined young girl who joins the Order of Demonists to uncover the legacy of her mother—and begins a journey that will change her forever. Along the way, another tale unfolds in parallel: that of Rose, her rival, whose fate is tightly bound to her own.
A World of Secrets and Wonders
Shaped by centuries of ancient pacts and divine influence, Maana is a land of lost ruins, clashing kingdoms, and fragile harmony between humans and demons. The Eight Divinities guide its cultures and beliefs, but truth is often buried deeper than faith.
A Journey to Find Oneself
Leaving her home behind, Lucy sets out into a world she barely understands—seeking not just answers, but the strength to define who she really is. With each challenge, she grows. With each encounter, her understanding of herself and her world deepens.
Choices That Echo
Every decision matters. Dialogue, actions, and alliances will shape relationships and drive the story toward different outcomes. With two intertwined campaigns offering unique perspectives, your choices carry emotional weight—and lasting consequences.
An Emotional Tale Awaits
Maana Tales: Lucy weaves a rich narrative filled with magic, rivalries, love, political intrigue, and personal growth. It’s more than a battle of powers—it’s a story of finding your place, embracing your flaws, and carving your own path.
Where certainty ends, her journey begins.

title: Dungellion
description:
게임 정보

Rogue-lite with elements of Battle Royale and Action-RPG, inspired by roguelikes such as The Binding of Isaac, Enter the Gungeon, Nuclear Throne. Fight against other players in randomly generated dungeons and find a lot of unique abilities! Become the only one who survived and go to the next stage with all your loot, where you will battle with the winners of other arenas. The number of stages is not limited, but the farther away - the more deadly you are and your opponents. How long can you survive?
Features:
Every man for himself until the last survivor. Arenas up to 4 players.
A lot of abilities that significantly affect your game and tactics. Find the rarest and create unsurpassed synergy.
Randomly generated dungeons and loot. Each new game is unique.
Rewards for the victory. Unlock new characters, skins, and weapons. The farther you go, the more valuable the reward will be.
