Leaving her home behind, Lucy sets out into a world she barely understands—seeking not just answers, but the strength to define who she really is. With each challenge, she grows. With each encounter, her understanding of herself and her world deepens.
Choices That Echo
Every decision matters. Dialogue, actions, and alliances will shape relationships and drive the story toward different outcomes. With two intertwined campaigns offering unique perspectives, your choices carry emotional weight—and lasting consequences.
An Emotional Tale Awaits
Maana Tales: Lucy weaves a rich narrative filled with magic, rivalries, love, political intrigue, and personal growth. It’s more than a battle of powers—it’s a story of finding your place, embracing your flaws, and carving your own path.
Where certainty ends, her journey begins.

title: Kozomo: The Smoldering Ember
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist and Follow the Game to Get Notified When The Game Comes Out
Accompany Kozomo in this pointless life
Kozomo is a young man in his late teens, who has spent most of his youth either asleep or escaping to the woods. Despite his and his family’s wealth and reputation, Kozomo finds no joy in life, often neglecting even the simplest of duties like eating. To those around him, his behavior is not just baffling but unsettling. Some people see his detachment as a sign of madness or moral weakness. And some believe that there is a smoldering ember inside him, one day that will raise him up again.
Solve a variety of puzzles
Kozomo: The Smoldering Ember is a platformer game where you'll have to think so often to solve the puzzles blocking your way. The game usually introduces new elements or expects from you to discover new interactions between already introduced elements in some clever ways. This game is not a hardcore puzzle experience, but it also will not be a piece of cake.
Explore your firepowers
Witness Kozomo's discovery of his sorcery powers. Will this powers be able to grant him the life purpose he's lacking? Will he use those for the good, or will the power poison him? Make use of Kozomo's new firepowers to solve puzzles in different ways and find out the uncertain fate of Kozomo.

title: CubeyCollect
description:
게임 정보
Cubey Collect is a minimalistic singleplayer puzzle game, which was originally made in a GameJam in the span of 3 Days.

Collect Coins and progress futher through the level getting harder and harder

title: Leafing Home
description:
게임 정보
출시 시 저희 게임은 한국어로 번역되지 않지만, 위시리스트의 수를 모니터링하고 수요가 충분하다면 번역해 드리겠습니다. 그러니까 관심이 있다는 것을 알 수 있도록 위시리스트를 꼭 작성해 주세요.
리핑 홈 (Leafing Home)은 탐험과 재미로 가득한 마법의 세계로 여러분을 안내해 줄 아늑한 작은 모험입니다. 작은 다람쥐로서 당신은 세계 나무의 열매를 되찾고 집으로 돌아가는 길을 찾기 위해 탐험을 떠날 것입니다. 차가운 탐험, 플랫폼, 플라잉 챌린지, 미니 게임을 섞어가며 날씨가 조금 나빠진 세상을 치유하고 기발한 크루들의 사랑을 전파합니다. 정말 귀엽고 완전히 이상한 캐릭터들을 만나 퍼즐을 풀고 하루를 구하는 방법을 알아 봅니다. 짧지만 열정과 유머로 가득 찬 모험을 할 준비가 되었습니까?
하늘을 날아다니세요! 저희의 독특한 비행 메커니즘은 여러분이 쉽게 공중을 지나거나 활공할 수 있게 해줍니다. 비행 중 모드를 전환하고 네 개의 다른 영역에서 숨겨진 모서리를 발견하세요. 주요 공중 도전 과제: 종이 비행기를 낚아채거나, 의심하지 않는 낚시꾼을 말리거나, 반딧불이를 잡거나, 동료 날다람쥐를 따라 새로운 땅으로 이동합니다.

title: Pawsky
description:
게임 정보
🐾 A Short & Whisker-Twitching Adventure! 🐾
Step into the paws of a curious cat in this choice-driven, storybook-style game! Explore, interact, and make decisions that shape your journey—whether that means making friends, causing mischief, or discovering something unexpected.
What’s in the Box?
✨ Be a Cat – Nap, explore, knock things over, and do what cats do best!
✨ Make Choices – Your decisions shape the story, leading to different outcomes.
✨ Meet Quirky Characters – Befriend (or bother) a cast of charming animal NPCs.
✨ Explore & Collect – Find hidden surprises and collect fun mementos of your adventure.
It’s a short and delightful game—perfect for a cozy playthrough in a single sitting. Where will your paws take you? 🐱

title: Floodlight
description:
게임 정보
Floodlight is a short horror game where you play as a broke college student who just moved into a crappy apartment, which should have been fine if it weren't for the massively bright light that gets turned on every night, directed straight at your apartment's window...
Featuring an immersive, atmospheric experience with photorealistic graphics, discover the truth about this mysterious apartment by exploring the environment around you. Talk to the neighbors to find out what is going on, but you may just end up with more questions than answers.

title: I met an Archaeologist
description:
게임 정보
Someone strange has entered your office. They offer you historical objects which can fulfil your darkest desires. However, you must answer their questions first. Three wrong answers and it can cost you more than you bargained for. Do you accept?
Features
Inspect the objects and make deductions

title: Ferral Quest
description:
게임 정보
2D Pixel MMORPG Game
Playable in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, and French.
Multiplayer (Play solo, with friends, or against everyone). Open world with diverse biomes: forest, jungle, desert, snowy wasteland, and volcanic regions.
Plus, dozens of dungeons to explore and hidden secrets to uncover. Ranking PvP and Top Players. Clan system.
Features:
Open World PVE Quests and Special Dungeons: Embark on missions across the world and challenge unique dungeons.
Raid Bosses and Wanderers to Hunt: Scattered across the world for an epic challenge.
Progression from Tier 0 to Tier 10: Level up and unlock new tiers of power.
Skill Tree Development: Customize your character and make them truly unique.
Buffs and Equipment: Forge your battle strategy with a variety of buffs and gear options.
Defeat Mighty Dungeon Bosses for the Best Gear: Face legendary enemies and earn top-tier rewards.
Storyline:
Embark on a grand narrative adventure to discover who you were before rising as a skeleton and find a way to break your curse. Time is running out, as you risk losing your sanity and becoming part of the enslaved warrior army of the great necromancer, Ferral.
Highlights:
Simple and Intuitive Controls: With an accessible information panel that explains gameplay mechanics in detail.
Achievement Panels: Hunt down all the bosses in the game and complete your achievement panel 100%. You can also complete the mythical items panel. Ferral Quest won’t make it easy for you.
Collaboration with Streamers and Content Creators: Each streamer has chosen a Raid Boss as their champion representative. Hunt them all!
Side Quests Across the Open World: Help a merchant find lost items, mine resources while waves of subterranean creatures attack, or pray to the gods—they might bless you… or punish you by sending their troops to destroy you.

title: Switch Box
description:
게임 정보
'스위치 박스' 는 2D 픽셀풍 플랫폼 점프 퍼즐 게임이다.약한 그것이 미지의 세계로 왔다.여기에는 기회와 위험이 병존한다.마음을 편히 하고 주변의 물건에 의지하여 여행의 종착점에 이르자.
목표는 앞의 길을 개척하는 것이다.
주변의 도구를 이용하여 장애물을 통과하십시오.

title: Moon Carrier
description:
게임 정보
In Moon Carrier, you will be doing cargo missions between bases and cities founded on the future moon. You can drive to anywhere you want, however, you are limited with the capabilities of your vehicle. Your oxygen tanks have limited capacity. Your vehicle has limited electrical capacity. Moreover, when you hit on the rocks which may appear in front of you suddenly, your vehicles condition decreases based on your hit velocity. Drive fast and you take risk of a sudden death, drive slower and you take risk of failing your missions for not delivering on time.

title: BitRick's Venture
description:
게임 정보
BitRick's Venture is an action-roguelite with procedurally generated maps.
Can you make it through all the floors?
Content:
3 floors
3 weapons
3 bosses
Various enemies
39 items
Here's a quick summary of what the game is about:

title: Bearly Alive
description:
게임 정보
Bearly Alive – Defend. Shoot. Avenge.
In the world of Bearly Alive, food is infinite... but at what cost? You play as a gummy bear returning from the grave, determined to avenge your people after being sacrificed to the God of Food. Once a respected community, the gummy bears lost everything—now, it's time to fight back.
This intense mix of Tower Defense and Third-Person Shooter challenges you to build strategic defenses while diving into action-packed combat against relentless waves of enemies who want to invade your castle.
◑ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ▣ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◐
🔸 Tower Defense + TPS – Set up traps and turrets, but also take matters into your own hands!
🔸 Relentless enemy hordes – Face increasingly challenging waves of enemies.
🔸 The revenge of a sweet warrior – Uncover the dark truth behind a world that thrives on gummy bear suffering.
🔸 An eldritch arsenal – Wield unique weapons and special abilities to turn the tide of battle.
◑ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ▣ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◐
The fate of the gummy bears is in your hands. Will you break the cycle and restore your people's honor?
🔥 The feast is over. Now it’s time for revenge! 🔥

title: Shadows of Wyrmwood
description:
게임 정보
Shadows of Wyrmwood is a roguelike adventure RPG where every encounter can be life or death. Use spells, swords, and strategy to defeat every cursed foe blocking you from saving Wyrmwood. Adventure across four procedurally generated maps that grow harder and harder with every encounter. With each victory, you obtain new armor, weapons, and spells from defeated enemies. Adapt, survive, and overcome every challenge across the land to save all who have been corrupted.  Do you have what it takes to be the Hero?

title: Vasrak Kingdom: Battle on the frontier
description:
게임 정보
바스락 왕국: 변방의 전투
햄스터 장군 죌버가 지휘하는 유쾌한 전략 게임! 덱빌딩과 틱택토를 결합한 실시간 전투에서 승리하고 왕국의 귀중한 자원을 지켜내세요.
개요
바스락 왕국과 푸드덕 왕국 간의 끝없는 식량 전쟁. 장군 햄스터 죌버는 변방에서 인간 병사들을 지휘하며 적의 침략을 막아야 합니다. 귀여운 캐릭터와 빠른 전투 속에서 실시간 전략과 덱빌딩의 재미를 느껴보세요.
특징
덱빌딩과 틱택토의 결합: 병사를 배치해 전장을 점령하며 한 줄을 완성하면 적에게 큰 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다.
실시간 전략 전투: 마나를 모아 병사를 소환하고, 전장에서 빠르게 반응하며 적과 교전합니다.
다양한 병사 카드와 능력: 검사의 강력한 교전 능력, 궁수의 돌입 공격, 농부의 마나 회수 능력 등 전략적으로 병사를 배치하세요.
전투를 통한 보상: 승리하면 얻는 돈으로 상점에서 새로운 카드를 구매해 덱을 강화하세요.
스토리
바스락 왕국의 유능한 장군 죌버는 어느 날 갑작스럽게 변방으로 좌천됩니다. 한적하게 털이나 다듬을 줄 알았던 그는, 오랫동안 적대 관계에 있던 푸드덕 왕국과의 전투에 휘말리게 됩니다. 겨울이 다가오며 식량 부족이 심화되는 가운데, 죌버는 부관 회듀와 함께 인간 병사들을 지휘하여 왕국의 귀중한 해바라기씨를 지켜내야 합니다.
게임 플레이

title: no the baby
description:

You've had enough! Peter and the other kids are manipulative little goblins, and for some reason, the teacher is trying to catch YOU! This terror will never stop. There is only one solution. You have to escape. For good. Escape before your parents come to pick you up.
no the baby is a stealth-horror game about a child trying to escape a strange kindergarten filled with puzzles, oddities and annoying children.
Explore kindergarten
Find items
Solve puzzles
Run from teacher
Hate the Peter
Sneak around
Features some tunes
Crisp textures
Evil contraptions

title: Raider of Realms
description:
게임 정보
Raider of Realms is a 2D real-time strategy game played on a hexagonal grid. Begin your adventure with a few tiles under your control and gather valuable resources to grow your kingdom. Build units, develop an army, and strategically conquer new tiles to expand your empire.
Players must manually place humans and units on the right tiles to collect resources, defend their land, and fight enemies. Success depends on your ability to manage your resources and territory efficiently while fending off opposing forces. Are you ready to become the raider of realms?
Key features:

title: Draguna Matata
description:
게임 정보
Draguna Matata는 드래곤 아기가 되어 점점 더 복잡해지는 미로를 빠져나가야 하는 도전적인 퍼즐 게임입니다. 거대한 열대우림에서 작은 용이 되어 삶의 부조리에 맞서면서 논리력과 탐색 능력을 발휘하세요. 더 크게 성장하고, 힘을 얻고, 상자를 밀고, 환경을 제어하고... 그 과정에서 만난 친구들로부터 원치 않는 조언을 받을 수 있습니다!
게임 플레이
이 멋진 Steam 페이지의 제작자가 만든 이 게임에는 70개 이상의 퍼즐 레벨이 있으며, 탐색 과제와 심리적인 함정으로 가득 차 있어 신뢰에 문제가 생길 수 있습니다. Draguna Matata는 드래곤의 성장기를 직접 경험하면서 좁은 공간에서 길을 찾아야 하는 캐주얼한 사고력 퍼즐입니다.
드래곤이 더 커지고 더 현명해지면 주변 세계를 지배할 수 있는 멋진 힘을 얻게 됩니다. 상자를 밀어 넣는 소코반 퍼즐을 현대적으로 재해석한 이 게임에서, 변화하는 물줄기와 급강하하는 구덩이의 역동적인 환경에 몰입해 보세요(때로는 말 그대로!). 티키 횃불을 따라가야 하고 숲 속 동식물을 찾아야 하는 등, 진정한 퍼즐 애호가라면 탐험할 지역과 수집할 파인애플이 가득합니다.

title: Drones vs Tanks
description:
게임 정보
Multiplayer Clash of Tanks and FPV Drones
The clash of tanks and drones symbolizes the evolution of conflict, blending AI, agility, and advanced technology into a high-tech duel for dominance.
Engage in high-stakes multiplayer matches where two players go head-to-head. One controls a tank with a mission to reach its destination. The other pilots an FPV drone, aiming to destroy the tank before it completes its route. The round ends when the tank reaches the target or is eliminated. Players then switch roles. The first to win two rounds claims victory!
Choose Your Side in the Tech War
Join one of two factions:
West  East 
Key Features:
Tactical duels with role-switching mechanics.
Immersive FPV drone controls with a first-person perspective.
Rank progression from Private to Captain, with upgradeable equipment.
Modifications: dynamic armor, electronic countermeasures (ECM), and speed boosters for drones.
Unique strategies for each faction.
Will you lead your tank to victory or destroy it with the cutting-edge tactics of FPV drones? The choice is yours!

title: Threats To Humanity
description:
게임 정보
Threats to Humanity: 
Defend Sacramento from an alien invasion!
In this action-packed arcade-style tower defense demo, you are humanity's last hope against waves of alien invaders, rogue robots, and devastating meteors!
Features:
Intense Levels: Battle through challenging levels set in iconic Sacramento locations.
Powerful Turrets: Deploy a variety of turrets, each with unique strengths and upgrade paths.
Epic Boss Battles: Face off against challenging mini-bosses that will test your skills.
Upgrade System: Upgrade your turrets and unlock new abilities to enhance your defenses.
Arcade Action: Experience fast-paced, addictive gameplay with vibrant visuals and explosive sound effects.

title: Super Silent Sensei
description:
게임 정보
Master the art of stealth in Super Silent Sensei, a fast-paced, casual stealth game where precision and cunning are key. Step into the role of a legendary ninja on a mission to rescue elusive aliens scattered across the military compound Zone 52 without ever being captured.

Stay hidden, stay silent, and use your environment to outsmart patrolling enemies and traps, you only have one 

Get all aliens and make a run for the escape point!

Only the most disciplined Sensei will succeed.

title: My Dear Can't Speak
description:
게임 정보
Main Story
After years of relentless effort, the protagonist finally achieves their lifelong dream. However, upon realizing this dream, they are overcome with a deep sense of emptiness and numbness. One day, while drowning their sorrows in alcohol, they come across a mysterious girl at the train station...
Gameplay
As the president of a software company, the protagonist is responsible for managing and operating the business. From software development plans to various employee affairs, every aspect is personally overseen by the protagonist.
Players are not only responsible for advancing the game's main storyline but can also freely explore various management and interactive gameplay elements to create a unique gaming experience.
Players take on the role of a company founder, responsible for operating and developing a software development company. By researching new software, recruiting and training employees, and optimizing budget management, they can help the company grow and enhance its market competitiveness. Players must allocate resources wisely, formulate development strategies, and ensure the company's steady progress.
The game features a shop where players can purchase various items. Using these items strategically can effectively advance the game.
Additionally, the game incorporates heartwarming interactions between the protagonist and his daughter. Players can arrange time to spend with her and participate in her growth journey. Different choices will influence the depth of their father-daughter relationship and may even alter the course of the story.
Players must find a balance between career and family, managing their company while maintaining a strong bond with their daughter, ultimately leading to different game endings.
Main Characters
autokwd: My Dear Can't Speak,私の娘は話すことができません

title: The Froglings
description:
게임 정보
Grow Your Civilization!
Build Houses for your froglings so that they can grow, Utilize them to help build other structures like tower defenses and simple resource gathering buildings!
Defend with defenses!
Take care though, as in the night a raid of robots will want to come and destroy everything you've built! Use the different tower defenses you unlock along the way and your hero to protect your new home and keep it safe from the evil robots.

Grow and prosper your frogling community!

title: Signal Creek
description:
게임 정보
Held captive by the abandoned Signal Creek Shopping Mall, Nour and her companions must come to terms with their deepest regrets or lose themselves to the Void.
Signal Creek is narrative-driven RPG set in a surreal pixel art world. Playing as Nour, you will guide your companions through a journey of reconciliation as you all search for a way to escape.
Explore an abandoned mall
You, along with your younger brother's best friend and your professional mentor, are trapped in a place that should no longer exist. Search the third floor of the mall to find objects and characters that may hold the keys to your escape.
Reconcile with past mistakes
Help Nick through his growing pains, Ms. Gaw deal with old friends, and you yourself face a friendship gone sour as you reveal elements of your pasts that have somehow manifested.
Find the missing apple prince...?
Discover three old (or new?) stores that house a colorful cast of NPCs, including a glitchy store manager, a troupe of apple royalty, and some guy named Tim who wears shoes on his hands.

title: Bounty Off Road
description:
게임 정보
Bounty Off Road is inspired by early 2000s Offroading games. Put some relaxing music in the background, complete trails to earn money, customize and tune your vehicles for better performance, and ride together with people in massive open worlds. 

Immerse yourself in the world
3 Large Maps full of events are sure to give you plenty of open world to explore
 Enjoy your OffRoading by yourself or together

title: Stopping Santa
description:
게임 정보
A top-down arena shooter where you play a mercenary fighting against the legions of Santa. Santa has gone ROGUE. He is not paying the Elves, contributing to global warming, and using sweatshops to produce extra presents to save on costs. You have been hired by the United Nations to fight his legions, because they are afraid of a PR nightmare.    
This is a very classic Arcade game. Simple controls, instant action, short play sessions, and a leaderboard for the global Top 10. Slay Santa's minions while enjoying some smooth Jazz.
There are three types of soldiers in the legions of Santa. Elves, Reindeer, and Mall Santas.

title: Hegzis
description:
게임 정보
육각형 그리드를 지배하세요!
다채로운 색감의 2D 스타일로 구현된 차분한 육각형 그리드 퍼즐 게임, Hegzis의 독특한 도전 과제를 통해 자기 두뇌 능력을 시험하세요! 평화로운 해변, 속삭이는 숲 등에서 스테이지 하나를 선택하고, 각 세계에 펼쳐진 다수의 레벨을 진행하세요. 육각형이 연결되어 만들어진 피스를 배치하여 방향에 상관없이 한 줄을 만들면 됩니다.
피스를 돌리면서 끝까지 줄을 채우면, 채워진 육각형 줄은 사라지고 점수가 올라갑니다. 하지만 막히지 않게 조심하세요! 특수 도구를 사용해서 틈을 메우거나 원치 않는 육각형을 지워 공간을 확보하세요. 몇 수 앞을 보고 효율적으로 육각형을 배치하면 더 큰 보너스를 받게 될 것입니다. 새로운 스테이지를 잠금 해제하거나, 이미 클리어한 스테이지로 돌아가서 더 높은 점수에 도전하세요!

title: Rapid Impact
description:
게임 정보
Rapid Impact is an online PvP-PvE shooter set in a realistic post-apocalyptic world. Choose your preferred weapons and compete for the top spot in each match. Play against real players, AI, or both together.
The game features several modes: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Zone Control, and Capture the Flag.
From the Developer:
As a solo developer, I created Rapid Impact as a project driven by community feedback and player suggestions. At this stage, I’ve built the core gameplay, and new features will be gradually added based on majority votes from players. During early access, the game will include the essential mechanics and core gameplay - but this is just the beginning. The future of the project will depend on your support and feedback.

title: Little TD
description:
게임 정보
There are several different game modes in this Tower Defense Strategy (TD), which can be completed in one go or with endless enemies - resist countless waves of enemies for as long as possible and complete missions!
Complete the storyline to earn rich rewards, and challenge stronger enemies to earn more rewards.
-Simple, optimized, small in size but fully functional.
-Having dozens of different levels and a large number of tasks - no endless hard work!
-A huge permanent upgrade tree (over 500 different studies).
-Completing hardcore tasks can lead to many achievements
-Detailed statistical data for each run
-Complete the storyline and unlock stronger challenge tasks
-No ads, everything can be unlocked for free!

title: Coin x Union
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Coin pusher x Watermelon-like game.
This is a game where you can enjoy Coin pusher and Watermelon-like union action.
Enjoy this crossover between the coin pusher element of dropping and collecting coins and the exhilarating Watermelon-like sensation of uniting coins.
Throw a coin and let's union coins!
If you hit the same coins together (union), they will turn into higher-ranked coins.
Aim for the golden coin.
Also, if you union coins, bonus coins will fall.
Try to get the coins without dropping them!
Move the boxes to grab the coins that fall.
If you drop them towards you, black coins that cannot be unionized will fall.
Try to grab them without dropping them if possible.
Aim for a high score!
Collect high-scoring coins through union or get and aim for a high score.
The game will finish when the number of coins falls below the value of the coins you threw, or when they fly off to the left, right, or back of the platform and fall.

title: Univocity
description:
게임 정보
Univocity is a short, 4K ready, cyberpunk visual novel wrapped in neon aesthetics with a lush atmospheric soundtrack, featuring a deep and emotional conversation between two people about taking down a global tech monopoly and the responsibility that it entails.
Synopsis:
Max, a former engineer who turned fugitive, is headed to the top of tallest tower of Univocity—an urban sprawl owned by Ōṁ, a global tech monopoly—to set off an electromagnetic pulse bomb that will plunge the city into a technological dark age. But their plans are disrupted when they encounter Nina, an Ōṁ employee, which sparks a conversation that makes them question their motives.

title: The Little Shelter
description:
게임 정보
The Little Shelter
The Little Shelter is a narrative-driven 2D platform adventure that follows Lunaaa, a young Asian woman navigating the chaos of New York City in search of solace and self-discovery. Caught between reality and surreal dreamscapes, players will embark on an emotional journey of escape, resilience, and self-reflection.
Key Features:
🎭 Deeply Personal Story – Experience Lunaaa’s emotional struggles, shaped by the highs and lows of city life, as she seeks a place to call home.
🏙️ Surreal NYC-Inspired Environments – Explore hand-crafted 2D levels blending urban realism with dreamlike fantasy, reflecting Lunaaa’s shifting emotions.
🎮 Platforming & Puzzle Mechanics – Solve environmental puzzles, navigate complex platforming challenges, and make narrative-driven choices that impact the journey.
🔥 Anxiety System – A unique game mechanic that represents Lunaaa’s emotional state, affecting her movement, perception, and interactions with the world.
🎶 Atmospheric Soundtrack – A rich, immersive score that evolves with the narrative, heightening the emotional depth of Lunaaa’s journey.
🎨 Hand-Drawn Art & Animation – Vibrant, expressive visuals that bring the world to life, blending modern indie aesthetics with evocative storytelling.
Whether you’ve ever felt lost in a city’s overwhelming presence or sought shelter in your own emotions, The Little Shelter offers a poignant and visually stunning experience about finding strength in uncertainty.

title: Bear vs. Wolf Jigsaw Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
Step into the wild with "Bear vs. Wolf Jigsaw Puzzle"—a captivating puzzle game that lets you piece together stunning images of nature’s most formidable predators. Whether you prefer the raw power of a grizzly bear or the cunning intensity of a wolf, enjoy a relaxing yet engaging puzzle experience set against breathtaking wilderness landscapes.
From simple 30-piece puzzles to intricate 285-piece challenges, tailor your gameplay to your skill level and immerse yourself in vivid depictions of bears and wolves in their natural habitats.
Features:
🐻 Epic Wildlife Scenes – Assemble striking images of bears and wolves in forests, mountains, and snowy tundras.
🧩 Multiple Difficulty Levels – Choose between 30 to 285-piece puzzles for a casual or challenging experience.
🎨 Stunning Realistic Artwork – High-quality visuals bring these majestic animals to life.
🎵 Relaxing & Immersive Gameplay – No timers, no pressure—just pure puzzle-solving enjoyment.
"Bear vs. Wolf Jigsaw Puzzle" is a simple yet mesmerizing game designed for puzzle lovers and wildlife enthusiasts. Whether you want a quick mental escape or a deep, challenging puzzle session, enjoy the thrill of assembling nature’s fiercest rivals, one piece at a time!

title: Slippy Bear
description:
게임 정보
Newton said
Things don't move on their own.
I thought
The same applies to bears.
Slippy Bear is a game that shows the physical law of inertia through mouse controls. The cute bear in the game sometimes follows inertia, sometimes fights against it, and moves forward.
Finding
Inertia in the laws of physics.
Newton who found it.
And bear.
Challenge
Get past the tricks and traps set up in each level.
With bear.
And sometimes with frogs too.
Growth
While playing the game, you will notice on your own.
Wait... am I getting better at this game?
It's not a joy that someone gives you. It's a joy that you discover yourself.
There are 45 stages in total.
If everything goes smoothly, you can complete the game in about 3 hours.

title: DEATH PIT EXPLORER
description:
게임 정보
ARE YOU SKILLED ENOUGH TO TRAVERSE THE DEATH PIT?
Deep below the surface of The City's endless sprawl, something terrible festers. Six months ago, a gaping hole opened and swallowed an entire city block. Government-contracted drone operators attempted to explore the pit, but the operation was deemed a failure and the program ended. Now, the drone-operating software has leaked online and many are trying to fly into the pit to uncover its secrets. 
Features:
Master a challenging control scheme: Attempt to fly your drone to the bottom of the pit in first person using an unconventional control scheme...
Explore surreal environments: Several distinct, challenging, and hand-crafted environments to see...
Effectively manage your drone's power: Every movement, bump, and action costs energy - don't forget to recharge...
WARNING this game may induce motion sickness

title: Disclosures
description:
게임 정보
The player takes on the role of a video blogger as Luke harper, who loves to explore abandoned places. This time luke sets off to explore an old abandoned hospital in the midst of a deep forest, to capture exclusive footage for his viewers.
Rumor has it the hospital was somehow connected to a case of disappearances in that area.
Game Features:
realistic graphics!
Extremely immersive sound design - almost every sound was recorded specifically for this project!
Screamers and creepy atmosphere - the game has plenty!
Game genre: Horror, Walking simulator.
Made with Unreal Engine 5

title: GnollHack
description:
게임 정보
About
GnollHack is a remastered and enhanced version of the classic roguelike game NetHack, one of the most iconic games developed in 1980s and 1990s. With GnollHack, you get:
Traditional roguelike with turn-based gameplay
Modern user interface
Legendary strategic depth of NetHack
Endless replayability
Several new features, enhancing your gameplay experience
Story
In GnollHack, you are a hero sent by your deity into the perilous Dungeons of Doom, tasked with recovering the stolen Amulet of Yendor from the clutches of the malevolent god Moloch, who has hidden it in the fiery depths of the underworld. Along your journey, you will encounter formidable enemies, discover great magical artifacts, and strive for glory. You must either triumph or perish in the attempt.
Roguelike Gameplay
Explore procedurally generated dungeons filled with monsters, traps, and treasures.
Rich Class and Race System
13 classes: wizard, barbarian, rogue, etc.
5 races: human, elf, gnoll, etc.
Deep Item and Magic System
Hundreds of items, spells, and artifacts with diverse effects.
Challenging Permadeath
(Classic Mode Only)
Death is permanent, requiring players to adapt, plan, and learn from mistakes to progress further.

title: Swifty
description:
게임 정보
⚡ Swifty – Precision. Speed. Survival.
Race through challenging levels where speed is everything. Swifty tests your reflexes, timing, and precision in a fast-paced 2D platformer designed for players who love a challenge. Dodge deadly traps, pull off flawless jumps, and perfect your runs. Show that annoying frog who is the real "Swifty" here.
💥 Key Features:
Fast-paced gameplay that rewards precision and speed
Tight, responsive controls for smooth movement
Challenging levels with deadly obstacles
Minimalist art style focused on gameplay clarity

title: Offspring
description:
게임 정보
In a future ravaged by a deadly virus, humanity is falling on the brink of extinction. But amidst the chaos, Dr. Blavius discovers a shocking truth: a rare gene, found in a small subset of the population, holds the key to saving mankind. This gene, carried by only a few, could allow scientists to extract a cure — if it can be passed down through future generations.
That's where YOU come in, an average young man crippled by fear of rejection and lack of self-confidence. While the fate of humanity rests on your ability to find a partner and spread the rare gene, YOU face the daunting challenge of navigating the world of romance, a place where you've always felt like an outsider.
Can YOU overcome your insecurities, face your fears, and form lasting connections? Will you find love, and in doing so, become the key to saving the human race? The future of humanity depends on your choices — but first, YOU have to learn how to take the first step into the unknown world of dating.
Key Features:
Heartfelt Romance: You'll navigate complex relationships, overcome your fears, and build meaningful connections with a diverse cast of characters.
Sci-Fi Twist: Explore a future on the edge of collapse and unravel the mystery behind the rare gene that holds the fate of the world.
Character Growth: Watch yourself evolve from a friendless introvert to a confident individual ready to face his destiny.
Story-driven Gameplay: A deep narrative blending the challenges of love, self-discovery, and a world on the brink of annihilation.
Will YOU rise to the challenge? Will you find love, spread your gene, and save humanity? It’s all in your hands. The future may be dead, but there’s still hope — if you can help unlock it.

title: Risk the Dark
description:
게임 정보
액션 로그라이트

Risk The Dark는 어둠 속에서 진행되는 실시간 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다.
어려운 난이도와 빛과 어둠, 묵직하고 다양한 생존주의적인 액션을 통해 높은 몰입감을 제공합니다.
어둠 속을 탐험하며 성장하고 눈앞의 위협들을 다양한 방식으로 파훼하며 출구를 찾아내세요.
어둠 속에 고립되다



당신은 '찢김' 후 생겨난 괴물들과 싸우다 던진 수류탄으로 인해 알 수 없는 동굴 속에 고립되었습니다.
일단은 살아남았지만 이곳엔 당신 말고도 많은 것들이 존재하고 있었습니다.
살아남기 위해 어둠을 마주하세요.
빛과 어둠



당연하게도, 어둠 속에선 빛이 없다면 앞이 보이지 않습니다. 안전을 위해 어둠을 걷어내세요.
다양한 종류의 광원들은 당신의 눈이 되어줄 겁니다.



평범한 당신도 무기를 들고 싸울 수 있다는 걸 보여주세요.
근접, 원거리, 투척, 원소 등 조합이 가능한 플레이 방식들이 존재하며, 이를 위한 여러 종류의 장비와 개조, 소모품, 액세서리, 숙련도 등이 준비되어 있습니다.
탐색을 하며 원하는 스타일을 강화하고 보완하세요.



각 구역의 마지막에는 당신을 기다리고 있는 특별한 적이 있습니다.
적의 공격을 피하고 허점을 공격해 당신이 쉬운 상대가 아니라는 걸 알려주세요.

title: Collapsed Horizon
description:
게임 정보
Travel to planets
Travel the galaxy in search of planets rich in ores.
Explore and dig into the ground for valuable ores
Terraforms the planet and collects ores.
Sell ores
Remember that the company takes 30% of your earnings but that's the price you pay to return to Earth.
Buy new equipment
Jetpack, radar, sand vacuum, icebreaker, etc. Everything needed to optimize ore extraction.

title: Frog Bard
description:
게임 정보
Frog Bard is a short, poetic experience about finding inspiration in the world around you. Explore a simple forest and perform reflective ballads as you travel from inn to inn.
Drive through a procedurally generated forest to find sparks of inspiration. Select thoughtful themes for your songs to perform at an inn. Break even and continue your journey.
Please note that Frog Bard is a short (5-10 minutes) but re-playable experience.
This game features an original song.

title: Star Scavenger
description:
게임 정보
Star Scavenger delivers golden-era arcade action in a modern roguelike package.
You're on the hook for $100,000 space dollars owed to Cervo Corporation for repairing your tractor beam without authorization. There's only one way out of this mess: mine low, sell high.
Analyze the mineral market with the help of Aimee, your adorable, super-smart AI companion. Read the price charts of the 9 minerals to uncover the secret patterns within, and win big by mining just before a price surge or selling ahead of a crash. Or, trade those rocks for precious ship upgrades to bring home a bigger bounty in the future.
Whip around asteroids with responsive, momentum-based controls, and blast them apart with 4 distinct weapons. Then, suck up all the dropped loot with your trusty tractor beam. But beware: you're not the only one after these rocks. Pirate drones lurk in every system, ready to attack.
Will your journey be the ultimate rags-to-riches story, or will you be crushed by your financial burdens? Find out in Star Scavenger!

title: Temne
description:
게임 정보
Lets find out how well you can navigate in complete darkness
Explore the landscape of the area, search for unique things in this place that can help you find your way out of here and don't die... because this is an adventure into the unknown and who knows what lies up ahead

title: Eternal Survival
description:
게임 정보
Venture into the forgotten depths of Navel, the massive underground labyrinth built by the dwarves, now overrun by the horrors of the Great War of Menegroth.
Description
Centuries ago, the dwarves abandoned their ancestral home, sealing entire armies of the undead within the vast caverns of Navel. Deadly traps and labyrinthine corridors were constructed to contain the dark plague. But where there’s danger, there’s also glory and unimaginable wealth.
You are a daring adventurer who dares to enter these cursed catacombs, facing endless waves of the undead while seeking fame, treasures, and the secrets of the dreaded necromancer generals of Menegroth.
Key Features
Survive the impossible – Face ever-growing waves of the undead while leveling up and enhancing your abilities with each run.
Addictive progression – Collect relics, unlock new powers, and create devastating builds to survive longer.
Dark and treacherous environments – Explore abandoned dwarven cities, trap-filled mines, and temples defiled by dark magic.
Terrifying enemies and bosses – Battle horrific creatures and the necromancer generals guarding forbidden secrets.
Multiple characters and playstyles – Choose between warriors, mages, and hunters, each with unique abilities.
Eternity awaits those who dare challenge the darkness… Will you survive?

title: Orphans
description:
게임 정보


Dive into this immersive game, taking on the role of Victoria, a young girl orphaned after a tragic sea accident, trapped in the enigmatic confines of a mysterious city. In a place full of traps and dangers, Victoria must rely on her dexterity to advance.



But Victoria will not be alone on this journey. She joins other orphaned children, inexplicably locked away for sinister purposes. Victoria's mission involves locating and liberating these children, each of whom has unique abilities crucial for overcoming the challenges that lie ahead.



But, the perils extend beyond traps and puzzles. Victoria is chased by humanoid creatures with the only goal of devouring her. In order to stop these creatures, Victoria uses the environment to create distractions with her slingshot, facilitating her escape.

Join the orphans on their journey to escape the city of animals. In this world, survival is a collective endeavor and no one can face it alone.

title: Wizabeasts
description:
게임 정보
Wizabeasts is a monster-taming RPG where you uncover a mystery from the past, take down a dangerous gang, and get your student debt forgiven by defeating club champions!
You moved to Chademars to attend the prestigious Oscar's Academy, an academy that helps develop the battle skills of commanders! Graduates of Oscar's Academy can look forward to a very lucrative career! The one big downside of attending Oscar's Academy is that it costs $5,000,000... This debt gets reduced by defeating club champions in battle. Defeating 1 club champion drops student debt to $2,000,000, defeating 2 club champions drops student debt to $1,000,000, and so on. You'll also have to worry about and help stop the increasingly dangerous Plume Gang. Plume Gang steal Wizabeasts, show a suspicious interest in cart research, and seem to be plotting something. You're also having recurring dreams that appear to have connections to events in the past and present... During your adventure, you will meet several characters like the snobby rich rival Edward and the friendly aspiring baker Cara.
You can encounter wild Wizabeasts when you want to, or you can avoid them if you don't want random encounters. There are many cool and/or cute Wizabeasts to meet! All Wizabeast species are viable in battle so you can pick your favourites without worry! To add a wild Wizabeast to your party, it's suggested that you deal some damage first. Once you've dealt damage and are within range, you can attempt a download with a cart. If the download is successful, the wild Wizabeast is now yours!

title: Progress Racer RPG
description:
게임 정보
이동 거리가 곧 재화입니다
앞으로 자동 운전하고 킬로미터를 쌓아 올린 다음 이를 사용하여 차량을 업그레이드하세요. 더 많이 운전할수록 속도는 더 빨라져 더 먼 곳으로 신속하게 이동할 수 있습니다.
선호하는 빌드를 선택하세요
직접 조작을 통해 앞길에 놓인 장애물을 피하거나 장갑을 사용해 억지로 길을 뚫고 나아가세요. 업그레이드를 선택하여 부스트를 결합하거나 완전히 자동화하세요. 활동적인 플레이 스타일을 선호하든 편안하게 앉아서 휴식을 취하든 즐길 수 있는 빌드가 준비되어 있습니다.
기하급수적인 업그레이드 강화
다양한 업그레이드를 스크롤 한 후 강화할 업그레이드를 결정하여 동력, 지속력, 효율성 등을 개선하세요. 비밀을 더 많이 밝혀낼수록 그 이상으로 업그레이드를 촉진할 수 있습니다.

title: Fishing On My Desktop
description:
게임 정보
Feeling a bit bored at work? Come fishing!
Fishing On My Desktop is an idle fishing game that runs as a floating button on your desktop. Whether you’re working, studying, watching movies, or even playing other games, you can enjoy the fun of fishing at the same time!
Interesting Fishing Experience
Just a click to start fishing—no complex controls needed.
Fish in rivers, lakes, and oceans.
Collect over 100 different types of fish.
Unique rods and bait options.
Some unexpected catches: crabs, pearls, jellyfish, message bottles, and even treasure chests…
And
The cutest cat in the world.
3 story-driven NPCs.
Mysterious hidden fishing spots.

title: 31 Room
description:
게임 정보
31 Room is a shooter puzzle game that challenges your brain and also your reflexes. Combining physics-based mechanics and strategic mind, the game gives you a fulfilling combination of problem-solving and skill.

Unravel the mystery between the AI (you) and the developers (Nawaf & Mohammed). As you proceed, you get new tools with more complexity in puzzles along with more rewards for solving them.

Designed for two players only, 31 Room is a co-op game—you can't play by alone. Play with a buddy or drop into a random lobby to get through the challenges as a team. (In-game voice chat isn't supported.)

title: Ducky: The Curious
description:
게임 정보
Ducky: The Curious는 세상에 대한 호기심으로 가득한 집오리 덕희와 함께하는 아이들러 수집 게임입니다. 여유를 즐기고 싶을 때는 천천히 걸으면서, 호기심이 차오를 때는 힘차게 뛰면서 원하는 속도로 물건들을 수집하고 수첩에 기록하세요. 탐험을 통해 재화를 모으고 희귀한 수집품들을 위해 지역, 시간, 날씨에 맞는 장비를 전략적으로 착용하고 탐험하세요.
탐험을 원하는 지역을 선택하고 탐험을 시작하세요
아무런 조작 없이도 게임은 진행되지만, 간단한 조작을 통해 더 빠르게 수집품에게 다가가세요. 원하는 속도로 탐험을 진행하세요.
수집품 진척도에 따라 다음 지역을 개방하고 탐험을 계속하세요.
탐험을 통해 모이는 재화로 원하는 장비를 구매하고 착용하세요.
지역, 시간, 날씨에 유리한 장비를 착용하여 더 효율적으로, 혹은 더 귀엽게 탐험하세요.
특정 수집품의 등장 조건을 확인하고, 적절한 장비을 사용하여 더 쉽게 수집하세요.
원하는 만큼 느리게도, 원하는 만큼 빠르게도 탐험할 수 있습니다.

title: Kutha Stroom Rush
description:
게임 정보
Kutha Stroom Rush is an electric-grid simulator game. Build, maintain, and plan the city's electric grid. As time progresses, the city will grow out and more Consumers will 'settle in'; so your electric grid will need to grow as well. Watch the Consumers' fluctuating (and growing) electric needs, and keep all of them fulfilled!
Use various Producers (power plants/generators) at your disposal
Each power plants have their own characteristics and restrictions. Utilize and integrate multiple types of power plants into the electric grid.
Watch and observe your Consumers' electric usage
Depending on the time of the day, your Consumer's electric usage will go up and down. Observe your Consumer's past electric usage, and anticipate ahead. Oh, and do watch out for the weather, too...
10+ cities/regions are available now!
Based on real places, each cities/regions have different terrain/geographic conditions, different starting money, different electric tariffs, and different Consumers compositions. Your plan/strategy to develop the electric grid might be different from one city to another!

title: Harold Rabbit - Finder of Lost Things
description:
게임 정보
As a little rabbit, while reading the books of rabbit detective Flynn, Harold wanted nothing more than to become a rabbit detective himself!

And now, he is!
Together with his faithful sidekick, the bumblebee Maud, Harold will find anything that has been lost and misplaced.
But now, something has been stolen from Harold himself!  Will he be able to find out who did it, and why, and solve the mystery of ... the missing trumpet?

Find out in Harold Rabbit : Finder of Lost Things!

title: bagelball
description:
게임 정보
only bagels can move the ball properly.
whoever scores the most goals within 5 minutes wins the match.
play 1v1 or 2v2, on a variety of maps (currently 4, i plan for more)
utilise the unique physics properties of the bagels to propel yourself across the map, as well as the ball.
use the practice mode to get to grips with the unique movement system within the game.
lobby browser makes it easy to set up a match with your friends, or find a match with another player.
join a game before it starts to spectate.
peer-to-peer netcode.
bagelball.
controls
left click to pick up bagel/drop bagel
wasd to move
shift to sprint
scroll wheel to make bagel close and far
ctrl to fastfall
right click to quantum switch
space to jump, space while in the air to double jump, space while on a wall to wall jump
jump onto a bagel underneath you while in close mode to start flying

title: Impossible Moto Sim
description:
게임 정보
Impossible Moto Sim – Conquer the Sky on Two Wheels!
Welcome to the ultimate challenge for those who live and breathe motorcycles! This is not just a race—it’s a battle against gravity, speed, and fear itself. Imagine tearing through high-altitude tracks suspended 3,000 meters above sea level, with no barriers to save you. Every turn is a test of precision, every jump is a leap of faith, and every second pushes your adrenaline to the max.
Some say it’s impossible. Others wouldn’t dare. But do you have what it takes to master the impossible? One wrong move and it’s game over. Only those with steel nerves and blazing speed will cross the finish line in one piece.
🔥 Game Features:
🏍 3 High-Performance Sports Motorcycles – Choose your beast and take on the challenge.
🎮 A Huge Variety of Levels – Each more extreme than the last.
⚠️ Obstacles Everywhere – Every track is designed to test your skill and courage.
This is not just a race. It’s survival. Are you ready to face the ultimate two-wheel test?

title: Cut it!
description:
게임 정보
Cut It! – Slice Your Way to Victory!
Get ready to wield a blade like never before in Cut It!—a thrilling physics-based game where your cutting skills determine the fate of others! Obstacles are blocking the paths ahead, and it's up to you to clear the way with your sharp instincts and even sharper weapons.
With a special knife that adapts to any situation—whether as a humble kitchen tool or a mighty katana—you’ll slice, chop, and carve through anything standing in your way. Precision and timing are key as you decide how and when to strike. Are you ready to do a good deed with a deadly edge?
🔪 Game Features:
A morphing knife that changes size and form to match the challenge
Dynamic obstacles blocking the way—slice through them to clear paths
Physics-based cutting mechanics that reward skillful slicing
Simple and intuitive controls—just use your mouse to slash through the chaos
Step up, grab your blade, and cut your way to success in Cut It!

title: Boom Buddy
description:
게임 정보
Boom Buddy is a thrilling and nostalgic twist on the classic catapult game, blending childhood fun with modern gameplay mechanics. Get ready to load your launcher, take aim, and bring down hidden enemies cleverly tucked behind wooden beams and stone barricades!
Precision is key as you analyze each trajectory to cause maximum destruction. With intuitive controls and satisfying physics, every shot feels impactful and rewarding. Whether you're a casual player or a strategic thinker, Boom Buddy delivers a dynamic challenge across more than 30 hand-crafted levels.
The game’s colorful characters and lively animations add charm to every moment, while power-ups and unique enemy types keep the gameplay fresh and engaging. Whether you're launching for fun or aiming for perfection, Boom Buddy promises hours of addictive entertainment.
Game Features:
🎯 Over 30 challenging levels to master
🧠 Smart aiming system with helpful trajectory guides
🤹‍♂️ A variety of quirky characters and clever obstacles
💥 Power-ups that boost your blasting power
Get ready to launch, smash, and conquer in Boom Buddy – the ultimate catapult showdown!

title: the Shadow of Swallow
description:

Experience ancient China in a visually stunning, realistic side-scrolling 3D action-adventure. Play as a master swordswoman, a deadly assassin fighting for justice.
Engaging Gameplay
Engage in thrilling stealth and combat. Infiltrate heavily guarded palaces to eliminate key targets, using stealth or brute force to overcome obstacles.
Engage in dynamic sword fights, showcasing your mastery of combat.

description:

Collect Resources, Build Up Your Base, Upgrade Defenses and Defend Your Precious Elixer Against the Endless Hoards of Lunar Snails. Take Part in Seasonal Events and Earn Limited Time Cosmetics.

title: MEMASIKI
description:
게임 정보
"MEMASIKI" is an exciting game that immerses you in the world of the most popular Internet memes. The essence of the game is to correctly answer questions related to iconic memes that have become an integral part of modern digital culture.
Each round offers you a picture or description of a meme, after which you need to choose the correct answer from the proposed options. For each correct answer, the player gets +1 point, and for an incorrect answer, 1 point is deducted. A special feature of the game is that all images are as close as possible to the original memes, which makes the process even more recognizable and exciting.
Upon completion of the game, the participant is assigned one of six statuses, which are determined based on the points scored. These statuses reflect the player's level of knowledge about memes and his ability to navigate the world of Internet humor.
"MEMASIKI" is an ideal choice for those who want to test their knowledge of memes, have fun and get special recognition among friends or other participants.

title: Mental Harm
description:
게임 정보
경고: 이 비디오 게임은 이 질병에 취약한 사람들에게 광과민성 간질 발작을 유발할 수 있습니다. 게임 관객을 합리적으로 제한하는 것이 좋습니다.

Mental Harm은 걷기 시뮬레이터 장르의 1인칭 심리적 공포 게임입니다.



사샤라는 이름의 주인공은 조부모님의 오래된 정원을 방문할 예정입니다. 이웃들은 그곳에서 이상한 소리가 난다고 오랫동안 불평해 왔다. 단 하나의 손전등으로 무장한 당신은 이 신비한 장소를 조사하러 갑니다. 이 장소의 비밀은 상상을 초월하는 무언가를 만듭니다. 거기에 무슨 일이 일어나고 있습니까?

게임 특징:
- 게임의 주요 장르는 "워킹 시뮬레이터"입니다.
- 현실에 가까운 3D 그래픽;
- 1인칭 시점

description:

Survival in a Distorted Reality
This is a horror game with elements of exploration and survival. You will explore a strange world, find ways to move forward, and control your fear. Reality will begin to distort, familiar things will become alien, and disturbing events will escalate.
Gameplay and Features:
Exploration – discover a world full of strange locations, unexpected transitions, and hidden details.
Distorted Reality – the environment shifts, and you never know what awaits around the next corner.
An Atmosphere of Unsettling Calm – nothing is chasing you here... for now.

You are an ordinary villager, living a peaceful life among familiar faces and a well-known routine. Day after day, everything follows its usual course—until one day, something happens that changes your world forever…

description:

Mazer is a puzzle game where you have to find a way through a maze while following rules of every element you encounter. With 150 handcrafted puzzles of varying difficulty, each level will test your logic to its limits!
How to Play?
🧩 Find a path through the maze while obeying the rules of stars, shapes, geometric figures, and other elements.
🌟 Each element has its own unique behavior – find out how they interact to solve the puzzle!
💡Learn the game through a dedicated in-game "How to play?" tutorial and starter puzzles set.

title: White Day Lost Class Funds

This is a role-playing game. You will become a student male host to help your framed girlfriend and experience a day of puzzle solving, exploration and magic.
Synopsis: You will play the man who bought the gift the day before in white day and gave it to his girlfriend who lived with him, but things didn't go so smoothly. Your girlfriend was not at home that day, and you learned from your brother that your girlfriend was framed. In this game, you need to find clues, know his girlfriend's movements and why someone wants to frame your girlfriend.
Game features
Multiple endings: The game has three endings, and your extra discovery may lead to different endings.
Brain burning puzzle: an incredible circular staircase, looking for keys with strange tricks
Stimulate tension: 123 Woodenhead, chase after battle, crack the secret code and race against time at the same time

title: The Last Visit: 98th
description:
게임 정보
"The Last Visit: 98th"는 소련 이후의 겨울 공간을 배경으로 한 워킹 시뮬레이터 장르의 1인칭 심리적 인디 호러입니다. 주된 초점은 사실적인 3D 그래픽과 몰입감 넘치는 3D 사운드로 강조된 호러 분위기입니다.
1998년, 주인공은 어린 시절을 보낸 고향으로 돌아갑니다. 부모님이 돌아가신 지 1년 후, 그는 마침내 빈 아파트를 방문하기로 결심합니다. 그는 아파트를 판매할 준비를 해야 하지만, 몇 가지 어려움에 직면합니다. 그의 차가 고장 나서 그는 모든 구석이 상실의 고통을 상기시키는 아파트에서 밤을 보내야 합니다. 과거의 어두운 거리와 소름 돋는 복도로 뛰어든 그는 자신이 처리해야 할 어두운 비밀에 사로잡히기 시작합니다.
◇ 90년대 후반 소련 이후 공간의 안뜰 중 하나를 방문하여 겨울 분위기에 푹 빠져 눈 더미 사이에서 구원의 열쇠를 찾아보세요.
◇ 소련 아파트를 돌아다니며 미스터리를 풀고 증거를 수집하세요

title: MERIDIAN
description:
게임 정보
MERIDIAN: 웰니스 VR 여정

MERIDIAN은 1시간 동안 지속되는 VR 체험으로, 여러분의 신체, 그 특성 및 한계를 탐구합니다. 원하는 각도로 가속, 감속 및 비행할 수 있습니다. 이 체험은 여러분의 신체를 뼈, 근육, 근막 사이의 연결망으로 바라보도록 장려하며, 움직임 패턴과 자세 습관을 이해하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 근육과 근막은 근육 체인 또는 근막 경락으로 연결되어 있습니다. 이 경락은 머리부터 발끝까지 뻗어 있어 신체의 다양한 부분을 연결합니다. 이 상호 연결성은 한 영역의 긴장이나 기능 장애가 멀리 떨어진 예기치 못한 영역에 영향을 미칠 수 있음을 의미합니다. 운동할 때, 단순히 고립된 근육만이 작동하는 것이 아니라, 뼈, 근육, 결합 조직이 협력하는 복잡한 시스템이 작동합니다.



VR에서 이 근육 체인을 탐구함으로써, 발광 플래시에 의해 안내를 받아 다양한 근육 그룹이 여러분의 움직임에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지에 대한 감각적이고 시각적인 정보를 얻게 됩니다. 이 체험을 충분히 지속하면, 시각과 감각이 결합되어 뇌에 각인되어 보다 고급스러운 언어로 신체와 소통할 수 있게 됩니다. 꾸준한 연습을 통해 폭풍 속에서도 내면의 평화를 찾게 될 것입니다. 깊게 숨을 들이쉬세요.



호흡은 하루 24시간 지속되는 일상입니다. 코와 횡격막뿐만 아니라, 신체 전체, 척추를 포함합니다. 여러분의 신체가 숨을 들이쉬고 내쉬는 방식을 관찰하고 배우며, 흉곽이 흐르는 방식을 관찰하고 이 과정이 근육 체인에 어떻게 관여하는지 알아보세요. 산소 공급은 폐뿐만 아니라 모든 세포에 영향을 미칩니다. 이 연습을 통해 이점을 얻으세요. 의식적인 산소 공급을 통해 운동 효율성을 높이는 길입니다. 슬라이드하는 방법을 배워보세요!



정적 근력 훈련 또는 등척성 운동은 관절 각도와 거리를 변경하지 않고 저항에 대해 정적 위치를 유지하는 것을 포함합니다. 이러한 운동은 근지구력, 안정성 및 근력을 향상시킵니다. 특히 코어 강화와 안정성, 자세 개선, 그리고 통제감 향상에 유익합니다. 이 연습을 통해 무의미한 노력을 이해하게 될 것입니다. 시간과 반복을 통해 개선과 성장을 보게 될 것입니다. 여러분이 얼마나 연결되어 있는지를 기억하세요.



MERIDIAN은 인간 웰니스에 대한 복잡한 접근 방식에 대한 나의 첫 시도입니다. 근육과 근막이 어떻게 협력하여 작동하는지에 대한 인식을 자극합니다. 상호 연결성. 여러분은 새로운 제어와 감각을 개발하게 될 것입니다. 어쩌면 여러분의 고통이 수수께끼로 변할지도 모릅니다.

출처:
조던 테리 "적응 가능한 극성"
토마스 마이어스 "해부학 트레인"

아름다운 가이드가 포함되어 있습니다.

title: Motorcycle Sales Simulator: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
도난 시스템
이제 오토바이 세계의 어두운 면으로 들어가 보세요. 눈에 띄는 오토바이를 훔쳐서 합법적으로 벌 수 있는 것 이상으로 위험하지만 수익성이 높은 수입을 올릴 수 있는 기회를 얻으세요. 다양한 오토바이 브랜드와 모델
클래식한 디자인부터 최첨단 모델까지 다양한 오토바이 중에서 선택하세요. 각각의 고유한 성능, 주행거리, 가격 특성을 살펴보세요.



경찰 및 세금 추적
물론 처벌받지 않는 범죄는 없습니다! 프롤로그에서는 도난당한 오토바이를 처리하는 과정에서 경찰의 순찰과 세무 조사가 여러분을 괴롭힐 것입니다. 계속 주시하고 적절한 타이밍에 범인을 놓쳐서 가게의 평판을 지켜야 합니다.

현실적인 협상 경험
고객과 열심히 협상하고, 제안을 검토하고, 수익성 있는 거래를 체결하세요. 하지만 설득이 항상 쉬운 것은 아니므로 신중할 필요가 있습니다!

스토어 관리
구매한 오토바이를 스토어에 전시하고 매력적인 가격으로 판매하세요. 쇼룸을 올바르게 구성하면 더 많은 구매자를 유치하고 수익을 높일 수 있습니다.

유지보수 및 개조 기회
때때로 오토바이는 특별한 관리가 필요합니다. 작은 손길이나 광범위한 수정을 통해 오토바이의 가치를 높이고 잠재 고객을 유치하세요.



단순한 구매와 판매가 아닌 진정한 열정
오토바이 거래 시뮬레이터를 사용하면 거래뿐만 아니라 오토바이 세계의 복잡성을 탐구할 수도 있습니다. 다양한 모델을 비교하고, 가치를 분석하고, 비즈니스에 가장 매력적인 제안을 준비하세요.

꿈에 그리던 오토바이 사업을 시작할 준비가 되셨다면, 오토바이 판매 시뮬레이터가 특별한 모험을 선사합니다!

title: Fantasy Gatekeeper
description:
게임 정보
Fantasy Gatekeeper is a fantasy simulation game where you take on the role of a city guard, responsible for inspecting adventurers seeking entry. Analyze their documents, search their belongings, and enforce ever-changing laws. Some will try to bribe you, others will attempt to deceive you, and a few may hold secrets that could alter the fate of the city.
Will you be a loyal enforcer of the law, a corrupt official, or someone who uncovers hidden truths? Every decision shapes your reputation, wealth, and the world around you.
Key Features:
Inspect and Judge: Examine adventurers' papers, belongings, and behavior to determine who enters the city.
Evolving Laws & Restrictions: New decrees and changing policies challenge your judgment each day.
Moral Dilemmas: Take bribes, confiscate items, or follow strict orders—your choices define your fate.
Deep Progression System: Earn gold and spend it to unlock tools, resources, and access to hidden knowledge.
Uncover Secrets: Discover hidden conspiracies, forbidden artifacts, and the true power struggles within the city.
Hold the gates. Make your choice. Shape the city's future.

title: Mystic Explorer
description:
게임 정보
The game is divided into two processes, 10 minutes before the development stage, 10 minutes after the challenge stage, only the hunter who survived the challenge stage can take away the treasure
A wide variety of weapons
Weapons in the game are divided into basic/melee/range/missiles/projectiles and other weapon types, and the difference between physical and magic properties, is also divided into savage/blood/lightning and other genres, you can choose more different types of weapons, with their own attack methods.
Enhance your weapon for special effects
Upgrades can obtain strengthening points to strengthen weapons, and there is a probability of obtaining weapon effects, forming the key to construction. Depending on the special effects, choose more suitable skills and treasures. Some weapons have effects that can interact with other weapons, some can enhance the weapon itself based on attributes, and some can increase character attributes.
Example: Savage Hammer - One of the weapon effects: The maximum health can be added to the damage and scope of the weapon

title: Pushmania
description:
게임 정보
Pushmania is a well-crafted puzzle game that is designed as an experience to be played together. You can play the entire game on your own, unlocking all map collections to solve, exploring the story and conquering each logical challenge by yourself. However, you can also play with a friend in local co-op style.
Pushmania also includes a full-featured editor so you can design complex challenges, share them and play together.
The PUSHMANIA is scheduled for release April 2025, until then try the DEMO!
PUSHMANIA FEATURES
explore logical love letter to well crafted gameplay-first games from the past
a heartfelt story about two brothers made by real two brothers
meet familiar characters from other game worlds
has an inbuild editor capable of creating your own maps with the ability to share them with your friends
enjoy the game solo or with a friend playing together at the same machine
a great atmospheric soundtrack reflective of gameplay depth
inspired by our decades old game written in QBasic

title: Task Code Foolish
description:
게임 정보
This is an immersive first-person shooter where players take on the role of the clone soldier, SI, dropped onto a planet teeming with crime and chaos. Every inch of this world is corrupted by endless violence and monstrous threats. Players will need to undertake a series of dangerous and high-stakes missions to uncover the dark secrets lurking beneath the surface. In this desolate and decaying world, you will face alien monsters, corrupt military forces, and other terrifying challenges that defy expectation.
The game's aesthetic blends sci-fi and monster realism, creating a vast and intricately detailed virtual world. Each environment is meticulously crafted, filled with futuristic technology and the menacing presence of horrific creatures, offering a truly immersive experience. The pulsating electronic music is seamlessly integrated throughout, with rapid beats and heavy bass that amplify the high-energy, adrenaline-fueled combat. The soundtrack motivates players to fight harder and push their limits, keeping the action intense and non-stop.
To fully immerse players in this brutal, blood-soaked world, the game features a range of brutal execution animations. Each kill isn't just about defeating an enemy—it’s about showcasing stunning and visceral animations that highlight the savage beauty of combat. Every execution is a spectacle of violence, enhancing the visual impact of every encounter and giving players a visceral sense of the high-stakes, life-or-death battles unfolding. Each victory is a test of not only your combat skills but also your nerve and resilience.
In this never-ending battle, Zen's mission is more than just survival—he must unravel the dark conspiracy at the heart of this corrupted world while fighting off waves of monstrous enemies and traitorous foes. The planet is a desolate wasteland, and every moment is a fight for survival. With each heartbeat syncing to the relentless electronic beats, players race against time to complete seemingly impossible missions, becoming the last hope for a doomed world.

title: Keep Them Sleeping
description:
게임 정보
A sci-fi simulation game in which you take the role of the Emergency Pod Management Bot (EPMB) on a spaceship. The inhabitants of the medbay pods have been put into cryosleep due to the length of the journey. Somewhere along the way, disaster strikes, ripping apart the hull and disabling most of the automated systems. It is your job to keep the patients alive, healthy, and asleep.
Global Stats
The global number of crew members that have lived and died across all users is displayed on the title screen.
Steam Friends
The default setting for the game will pull users from your Steam friends list to use as crew members. This option can be disabled in the settings.
Customize your character for your friends
In the crew manifest, if you customize your own character, then when your friends are playing they can see your customized character.
Customize your friend's characters
In the crew manifest, you can customize your friends' characters. Note that this will overwrite your friends' custom characters.

title: Kinder Finders
description:
게임 정보
Kinder Finders is a click and find game featuring hand drawn characters, items and locations.
In the game you are the newest member of the Kinder Finders (an after school club all about helping people). And the Kinder Finders are all about BADGES.
Talk to people all around town. Help them find things.
And with your kindness,
And your findness,
Earn some badges. 
Everyone Needs Some Kindness
The game is full of characters who have all lost things. Can you help them?
Features:
5 unique locations
23 quests 
23 badges
15-20+ Items to find in each location
6 Cozy Songs to vibe with
All with original art created by Patrick Sutherland (Art By Sutherland).
Featuring the musical talents of DJ Kenneth A.
