title: K.I.D.N.A.P
description:
게임 정보
Warning: This game doesn't have a save system (which will be added in a future update). If you collect items and do not enter inspection mode, the game may encounter a bug, requiring you to restart the game ( milk bottle, heart, and gun are exempt from this issue).                                               
"K.I.D.N.A.P" is a psychological horror game where you play as a kidnapped victim trying to escape from a mysterious room by solving puzzles.
Short Story
You are an ordinary young man who, one day, wakes up to find yourself kidnapped and trapped in an old, decayed room with an eerie atmosphere.
No matter what, you must find a way out. In this unfamiliar and terrifying environment, you must solve puzzles, survive, and escape. However, this room is not the only place you will encounter. Whatever awaits you beyond, good luck.
Game features:
Puzzle-solving
Escaping from locked rooms
Finding a way out of the labyrinth

title: President Coin
description:
게임 정보
Limited to 10,000,000 coins. 1,000,000 Golden coins, 3,000,000 Silver coins. 6,000,000 bronze coins. President Coin is a clicker game where you get a random coin between 2000 and 10000 clicks. Every coin is a valuable coin. Click through!

title: Rope Raider
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a challenging adventure with Fredrick Twinkly. After a fateful misstep, Fredrick finds himself tumbling down a massive hole, breaking both legs and leaving him stranded in the depths of an ancient, mysterious world. Armed only with his trusty rope and an unyielding spirit, Fredrick must swing his way through the hazardous environment's to uncover the legendary Lost Treasure of the Twinkly Star, a relic tied to the legacy of his great-grandfather.
Gameplay Mechanics:
The game features a unique and precision-based rope-swinging system that will test your timing, patience, and skill. Each stage presents its own set of challenges and environmental hazards, requiring players to master the art of momentum and precision to progress.

title: Hauntrick
description:
게임 정보
초자연적인 현상이 끔찍할 뿐만 아니라 완전히 우스꽝스럽기도 한 협동 공포 게임입니다. 장난스럽고 예측할 수 없는 유령과 맞서고, 혼란스러운 의식을 수행하고, 점점 커지는 광기 속에서 살아남으세요. 당신은 유령을 능가할 수 있습니까? 아니면 속임수가 당신에게 달려 있습니까?
1-4명의 플레이어 온라인 협동
이 혼란스러운 공포 경험에서 최대 3명의 친구와 팀을 이루세요. 함께 협력하여 저주받은 물건을 찾고, 의식을 준비하고, 길을 가로막는 기괴하고 예측할 수 없는 존재를 처리하세요. 무작위 적의 행동, 초자연적인 디버프, 계속 추측할 수 있는 지도 덕분에 각 게임이 신선하게 느껴집니다.
예측할 수 없고 멍청한 영혼들
Hauntrick의 영혼은 결코 평범하지 않습니다. 각각은 다르게 행동합니다. 일부는 멍청하고 일부는 예측할 수 없으며 다른 일부는 의식을 방해하는 이상한 방법을 가지고 있습니다. 그들이 다음에 무엇을 할지 결코 알 수 없으며, 모든 만남을 예상치 못한 혼란으로 만들 것입니다.
모든 달리기는 다릅니다
Hauntrick의 각 세션은 새로운 놀라움을 선사합니다. 절차적으로 생성된 지도, 무작위로 저주받은 개체, 회전하는 독특한 영혼을 통해 두 번의 실행이 동일하게 느껴지지 않습니다. 빨리 적응하지 않으면 속아 조기 무덤에 빠지게 됩니다.

title: Multi Championchip Futsal
description:
게임 정보
Get ready to dive into the exciting world of futsal with Multi-Championchip Futsal! Manage your own team and lead it to glory in an epic championship that brings together 45 of the best futsal teams from countries such as Portugal, Spain, France, Italy, Kazakhstan, Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay, Canada, and Australia. Can you rise to challenges, make strategic decisions, and emerge victorious in this intense competition? Key Features:Realistic Team Management:Create and manage your team, from selecting players to developing winning tactics. Every decision counts! Intense Competitions: Take part in an exciting championship where each game is a strategic battle. Win challenging matches to climb the leaderboard and win the title. Team Diversity: Choose from a vast array of teams from different countries, each with their own unique playstyle and characteristics. Intuitive Gameplay: Easy-to-learn controls, allowing both newcomers and veterans alike have fun. Join the Title Fight! In Multi-Championchip Futsal, only one team can be crowned champion. Do you have what it takes to take your team to the top? Get in the game, make your strategic choices, and show off your management skills. The championship is about to start, don't miss out!
 PS: contains AI-generated store images and also some player names

title: Misty's Super Golf Solitaire
description:
게임 정보
A Classical Journey with Misty!
Join Misty on his relaxing adventures across a nostalgic country side in Misty's Super Golf Solitaire. Blend strategy, luck, and breathtaking scenery in this fresh twist of a classic card game - Golf Solitaire.
What kind of game is it?
Misty's Super Golf Solitaire is a Golf Solitaire with deck-building elements.
Combine classic Golf Solitaire rules with special ability cards that you can buy to build a deck and clear more levels. Earn gold coins with each play. Play smart and do combos that will multiply the amount of gold you gain.  At the end of each round buy various cards with unique attributes such as wild cards, revivers, money bonus cards and scrap cards to help balance your deck. Each card has limited uses that shape your strategy. Every decision counts as you try to maintain your winning streak. Aim for the highest rank!
Classical Music and Landscapes:
Immerse yourself in Classical Music and landscapes inspired by the late 19th century and early 20th century that change with each level .

title: Mama Nyah's House of Tarot
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Mama Nyah’s House of Tarot, where the veil between fate and fortune is as thin as a whisper on a warm New Orleans night. Step inside the parlor, where the air is thick with incense and the hum of the unknown. Here, the cards don’t just tell the future—they weave stories, unlock hidden truths, and speak in riddles only the soul can understand. Every reading is a personal journey, shaped by your intentions, the cards you draw, and the unseen forces that stir within the deck.
Key Features for Mama Nyah’s House of Tarot
A Living Tarot Experience – Each reading is uniquely generated, reflecting your intentions and the cards drawn, ensuring no two sessions are the same.
Mystical New Orleans Setting – Step into Mama Nyah’s parlor, right outside of the French Quarter, where the spirits listen through the humid New Orlean's air.
Classic Pixel Aesthetic – Immerse yourself in the retro glow of old-school computer graphics, where every flickering detail adds to the mystery.
Glimpses Through Time – Each reading unfolds across past, present, and future, revealing echoes of what was, clarity for what is, and whispers of what may come.
Fate is in Your Hands – Whether you seek clarity, closure, or curiosity, the cards speak—gain perspective from Mama Nyah's insights.

title: Lag Simulator
description:
게임 정보
A simple endless runner however the player's jump is delayed due to lag.

title: Fruitgeddon
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for an intergalactic battle like no other! In this fast-paced space shooter with bullet hell action, you’ll face waves of adorable yet deadly mutant fruits threatening to destroy the universe. Only the most skilled players can dodge the chaos, shoot relentlessly, and uncover the dark truth behind the invasion.
Key Features
🚀 Intense Action – Shoot and dodge at high speed in a challenge where every second matters.
🍉 Unique Boss Battles – Each boss offers a different fight that will test your reflexes and strategy.
🌌 A Story with a Twist – Discover who's behind the chaos and prepare for a shocking revelation.
🎮 Hardcore Difficulty – If you love tough games and bullet hell challenges, this is your ultimate test.
🔫 Tight Controls – Master the art of dodging and shooting with smooth and addictive gameplay.
Are you ready to take on the mutant fruit invasion and save the universe? 🌠🔥

In Fruitgeddon, you don’t just survive the chaos – you shape it! Customize your weapons to match your playstyle: modify your shot type, adjust your firing angle, and create unique combinations to unleash maximum power against your enemies. In this world of fruity destruction, you decide how to fight. Do you prefer a barrage of projectiles or a precise, deadly shot? The choice is yours!

title: Destroy the Asteroids
description:
게임 정보
Destroy the Asteroids and Save Earth!
Planet Earth is under attack! Swarms of giant asteroids are on a mission route, and hostile alien ships will do anything to stop your mission. In Destroy the Asteroids, you are the last line of defense! With a devastating arsenal and relentless challenges, your mission is simple: eliminate all threats before it’s too late!
🔥 Key Features 🔥
🚀 Defend humanity – Destroy asteroids before they reach the planet and fight off specific ships determined to destroy you.
💥 Powerful arsenal – Utilize black hole cannons, high-powered lasers, guided shots, and devastating bombs to destroy everything in your path!
🌌 Increasing Challenges – With each wave, the enemies become faster and more unpredictable. Do you have the reflexes and strategy to survive?
🎇 Total Immersion – Fight on the surface of the Moon with Earth in the background, feel the intense brightness of the Sun and immerse yourself in cinematic battles with epic explosions!
🎶 Dynamic Music – An electrifying soundtrack that adapts to the battles, heightening the tension in critical moments and celebrating your victory with epic music.
Grab your Oculus, enter the battle and prove that you are humanity’s last hope! Destroy the asteroids before they destroy Earth!🚀🌍🔥

title: Temporal Gunslinger
description:
게임 정보
Temporal Gunslinger is an action puzzle game where you have the power to redirect bullets mid-flight and rewind time to take down multiple foes in the blink of an eye. You follow the Revenant, an undead hitman tasked with slaying the Reaper's traitorous Heralds, and travel across time to chase them down to their hiding places.
Experience a story-rich 5 hour campaign where you will:
Have mastery over projectiles
Your bullets bend to your will. Set up impossible trickshots to thoroughly overwhelm your enemies. Unlock additional abilities that allow more complex tactics.
Control time as you desire
You possess the ability to rewind time, allowing you to correct your strategy with ease. Escape death by undoing the actions of your enemies.

title: Shoot'n'Shell
description:
게임 정보
NOT EASY, NOT SORRY!
A fully offline, true indie, solo-developed mid-core 2.5D looter-shooter with hand-drawn visuals and fast-paced combat.
It’s hard by design—you WILL get better.
Skill-based gameplay combines decision making and gradual progression.
A challenging yet fair action game where success depends on skill and strategy, not luck alone. Master mechanics, leverage upgrades, and adapt to survive.
Key Features:
A Unique Universe – A beautifully hand-drawn world filled with distinct creatures, enemies, and immersive environments.
3 Distinct Biomes – Each with unique enemies, traps, surroundings, and interactive encounters.
Challenging Boss Fights – Face 9 Mini Bosses, 3 Major Bosses, and a Final Boss, each with unique mechanics.
Wearable Items & Weapons – Customize your loadout with gear that provides unique perks and playstyles.
Upgradeable Village – Unlock 27 permanent upgrades to enhance abilities and refine your strategy.
120+ Perks – A deep perk system with tree-like progression for limitless builds and replayability.
Unique enemies — Every one with it unique style, attacks and skills.
Gameplay Focus:
Skill-Oriented Progression – No artificial difficulty—your own skill and strategy determine success.
Tough Yet Fair – Charming visuals, brutal challenge. You earn every victory.
Final Touches:
Fully offline!

title: After Friday 星期五之后
description:
게임 정보
"After Friday" is a psychological horror game where tension builds through atmosphere and exploration rather than combat or jump-scares. There are no monsters to fight—just the unsettling feeling that something is off. You’ll find yourself walking through eerie environments, slowly uncovering a deeper secret. It’s a journey into the unknown—or perhaps, into a familiar place.
This game evolved from the Taptap Spotlight Game Jam. After receiving positive feedback and seeing how much people connected with the concept, I decided to develop it into a complete game. It’s been a rewarding journey.
Finally, I truly hope you enjoy playing it, and I hope she is ok.

title: Doorz
description:
게임 정보
Step into a world of mystery and riddles!
You’ve been taken from your reality and thrust into a strange, magical world with only one way forward—through doors guarded by mind-bending riddles. A mischievous, clown-like Riddle Master holds the key, testing your wits at every turn. Solve his riddles, unlock the doors, and uncover the truth behind this world as you journey toward the final showdown with the ultimate boss. Can you outsmart the Riddle Master and escape?

title: Absolute Canasta  Windows 11
description:
게임 정보
Canasta is an entertaining and strategic card game that requires both tactics and a bit of luck.
The aim of the game is to score as many points as possible by declaring cards of the same rank.
The many settings allow you to customize your game to your liking.
Whether you are an advanced player or a beginner, "Absolute Canasta for Windows 11" offers you everything you need to consolidate your knowledge of Canasta or to learn it from scratch.
All the rules of the game are explained in detail in the integrated instructions.
You can either play traditionally or use the settings to adapt the game to Viennese Canasta, for example.
Features:
- For advanced players or beginners
- Many setting
- Integrated instructions for all implemented game rules

title: Forest 6174
description:
게임 정보
Forest 6174
1인칭 심리 공포 단편 경험
스토리
당신은 대니(Danny)입니다. 그는 특별한 존재입니다.
대니는 협조적입니다. 대니는 규칙을 따릅니다.
아무리 힘들어도, 대니는 항상 미소를 짓습니다.
그러나 어느 날, 대니는 호출됩니다.
승진도 아니고, 질책도 아닙니다.
그저 휴가를 받기 위해서입니다. 일상에서 벗어날 시간을 갖기 위해서입니다.
이제 대니는 어둠이 깔린 숲 속에 갇혀 있습니다.
그곳에서 그는 현실을 벗어난 듯한 기이한 사건들을 마주하게 됩니다.
탈출하기 위해서는, 이곳 깊숙이 숨겨진 비밀을 밝혀내야 합니다.
게임 플레이
Forest 6174는 1인칭 심리 공포와 분위기 중심의 공포 요소를 결합한 몰입감 넘치는 경험을 제공합니다.
불길한 환경을 탐험하며, 게임을 진행하면서 이야기를 구성하는 단서를 발견하세요.

title: Market Empire Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Market Empire Simulator puts you in the role of a rising market owner, where your business skills and strategy will determine your success. Build, manage, and optimize your very own supermarket from the ground up.
Run Your Own Supermarket
Start with a modest store and turn it into the go-to shopping destination. Control everything from inventory to pricing, ensuring customers leave satisfied and keep coming back.
Hire and Manage Employees
Find the right staff to keep your store running smoothly. Hire employees and maintain morale to maximize productivity.
Stock Your Shelves Wisely
Choose the right products and arrange them strategically to attract customers. From everyday essentials to specialty items.
Expand and Upgrade
Upgrade your store with better equipment, more shelves, and a bigger layout.
Customize and Optimize
Design your store’s layout for peak efficiency or focus on aesthetics to create a welcoming shopping experience. Every detail matters when it comes to running a thriving supermarket.
Do you have what it takes to build the ultimate shopping empire? The challenge awaits in Market Empire Simulator!

title: Ars Vox Arcana
description:
게임 정보
Ars Vox Arcana is a voice-driven fantasy duel-game where you command magic through spoken incantations.
Whether in full VR or with PC and mouse and keyboard, you take the role of a wizard whose words shape reality. This is more than spellcasting. This is language-born sorcery.
Engage in magical duels with your friends, where strategy and spellcasting skill determine the victor.
Say the words, shape the world. Build incantations in real time using modular arcane phrases. Each word changes the result—no menus, just magic.
Ars Vox Arcana is built for VR immersion, but fully supports traditional PC play.
Both modes offer the same depth, spellcraft, and progression.

title: Georgie-Yolkie 64 - The Furry Tale
description:
게임 정보
Let's tell an old tale anew, and go back to the good ol' days of gaming with a new classic, hack and slash adventure. Upgrade Georgie & Yolkie's abilities and travel across 17 lovely lands and save Princess Tabitha from the clutches of the evil King Rattie! Lots of addictive swordplay and fun here!
Embark on a thrilling adventure across 17 immersive 3D levels! Battle scary Lions, Minions, Witches, Dragons, and the wicked King Rattie who has kidnapped Princess Tabitha and using her power for his own! Collect gold and fish, upgrade weapons, and use powerful items to become an unstoppable feline and bird duo!
Key Features
Dynamic Combat: Face clever, strategic enemies with fluid battle mechanics.
10+ Unique Foes: Challenge a variety of fierce opponents.
Character Customization: Personalize Georgie's gear and obtain upgrades
Bonus Challenges: Unlock all new stuff!
Replayability: Replay any level from the World Map and find alternative paths and hidden things!
Retro Style Polygons, effects, charming atmosphere and a return to great music!
Well scripted and dynamic boss fights!
Catch all the sheep that annoy you and force you to find new ways to continue on your way, push objects to make new platforms and avoid their pitfalls!

title: Skogdal
description:
게임 정보
Something strange is afoot in the small rustic Norwegian town of Skogdal...
This is a deckbuilding card game where you have to explore a large hand-crafted world across multiple runs. Immerse yourself in this weird but familiar adventure, and uncover an unsettling Carpenter-esque mystery…

title: Versebound
description:
게임 정보
Slay hordes of enemies and fight mythical bosses in this challenging action roguelike. In a desperate fight for survival you must perform rituals, buildcraft and learn from every misstep to become stronger. Use unique abilities and powerful artifacts to beat every trial in the world of Kalevala!
Slay hordes of enemies and fight mythical bosses!
Fight through thousands of mythological creatures and defeat special mini bosses to acquire their souls.
Experiment with different weapons and poems to craft your favorite build!
Find forgotten powers, unlock new weapons, upgrade and imbue them with souls. Tons of different builds, all with their own play-style.

title: Little Spaceman
description:
게임 정보
LITTLE SPACEMAN
In a universe full of secrets, you take on the role of a brave astronaut in search of space relics. Explore this vast universe, traverse territories, and dodge asteroids while uncovering rare artifacts lost in the cosmos.
GAME MODES
Explore the mysteries of the universe in Story Mode or test your reflexes in Infinite Run. Take on three challenging minigames: All Sides tests your reaction time, Planet Hop requires precision, and Zero-Gravity Pool brings strategic challenges in weightlessness.

title: Null State
description:
게임 정보
Overview
You are a hacker - a rarity in a world nearly destroyed by a cascading global systems failure. Prowl through networks node by node, disabling their security in risky turn-based combat, as you explore branching storylines to uncover what caused Obsidian Wednesday.
Set in a dystopian near-future which - a few years earlier - experienced a cataclysmic, global system crash (called "Obsidian Wednesday" by those who survived), Null State is a game about helping those in need while trying to uncover the truth about what happened on the day that most of the world's computer systems simultaneously imploded.
Explore Branching Storylines
Learn about the lives and struggles of nearly twenty distinct and fascinating characters who need your help (in one way or another).
Discover the lore of the Null State universe through dozens of data files archived throughout the ancient (and active!) networks still in operation. Some files - found in the networks still running from before Obsidian Wednesday - hold clues to questions that have haunted your new-found associates for over a decade.
Prowl Through Networks
Sneak or blast your way through hundreds of procedurally-generated networks while searching for data and ware to use and sell.
Most networks employ security systems: passive IC (Intrusion Countermeasures) guard the contents of nodes while active AV (Anti-Virus) constantly move from node to node, scanning for signs of an intruder. It's best to avoid these fights if you can help it, though, since combat can be brutal.
Risky Turn-based Combat
During combat, your inventory is put front-and-center as the opposing security systems will try to destroy the very equipment you've brought to destroy them!
Successfully clearing a node's security can reveal new data about the world you're in, as well as upgraded ware (for use in future runs!) -- and, depending on the jobs you pick up from your contacts, you can even get paid for cleverly manipulating the networks to the specifications of your clients.
Obsidian Wednesday

title: Pushmania
description:
게임 정보
Pushmania is a well-crafted puzzle game that is designed as an experience to be played together. You can play the entire game on your own, unlocking all map collections to solve, exploring the story and conquering each logical challenge by yourself. However, you can also play with a friend in local co-op style.
Pushmania also includes a full-featured editor so you can design complex challenges, share them and play together.
The PUSHMANIA is scheduled for release April 2025, until then try the DEMO!
PUSHMANIA FEATURES
explore logical love letter to well crafted gameplay-first games from the past
a heartfelt story about two brothers made by real two brothers
meet familiar characters from other game worlds
has an inbuild editor capable of creating your own maps with the ability to share them with your friends
enjoy the game solo or with a friend playing together at the same machine
a great atmospheric soundtrack reflective of gameplay depth
inspired by our decades old game written in QBasic

title: Incelthread
description:
게임 정보

guy is planning a meeting with his girlfriend to use their shared photos to prank board visitors with provocative posts.
They are both hikikomori who enjoy hanging out together, but circumstances prevent them from living together.
Having been traumatized by their past, they must go through a difficult journey of adapting to a new, still unfamiliar life.    

I don’t know their names. In general, I don’t know that much... But I’ll try to tell you something!

title: Fantasy Gatekeeper
description:
게임 정보
Fantasy Gatekeeper is a fantasy simulation game where you take on the role of a city guard, responsible for inspecting adventurers seeking entry. Analyze their documents, search their belongings, and enforce ever-changing laws. Some will try to bribe you, others will attempt to deceive you, and a few may hold secrets that could alter the fate of the city.
Will you be a loyal enforcer of the law, a corrupt official, or someone who uncovers hidden truths? Every decision shapes your reputation, wealth, and the world around you.
Key Features:
Inspect and Judge: Examine adventurers' papers, belongings, and behavior to determine who enters the city.
Evolving Laws & Restrictions: New decrees and changing policies challenge your judgment each day.
Moral Dilemmas: Take bribes, confiscate items, or follow strict orders—your choices define your fate.
Deep Progression System: Earn gold and spend it to unlock tools, resources, and access to hidden knowledge.
Uncover Secrets: Discover hidden conspiracies, forbidden artifacts, and the true power struggles within the city.
Hold the gates. Make your choice. Shape the city's future.

title: Mental Harm
description:
게임 정보
경고: 이 비디오 게임은 이 질병에 취약한 사람들에게 광과민성 간질 발작을 유발할 수 있습니다. 게임 관객을 합리적으로 제한하는 것이 좋습니다.

Mental Harm은 걷기 시뮬레이터 장르의 1인칭 심리적 공포 게임입니다.



사샤라는 이름의 주인공은 조부모님의 오래된 정원을 방문할 예정입니다. 이웃들은 그곳에서 이상한 소리가 난다고 오랫동안 불평해 왔다. 단 하나의 손전등으로 무장한 당신은 이 신비한 장소를 조사하러 갑니다. 이 장소의 비밀은 상상을 초월하는 무언가를 만듭니다. 거기에 무슨 일이 일어나고 있습니까?

게임 특징:

- 1인칭 시점

title: MERIDIAN
description:
게임 정보
MERIDIAN: 웰니스 VR 여정

MERIDIAN은 1시간 동안 지속되는 VR 체험으로, 여러분의 신체, 그 특성 및 한계를 탐구합니다. 원하는 각도로 가속, 감속 및 비행할 수 있습니다. 이 체험은 여러분의 신체를 뼈, 근육, 근막 사이의 연결망으로 바라보도록 장려하며, 움직임 패턴과 자세 습관을 이해하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 근육과 근막은 근육 체인 또는 근막 경락으로 연결되어 있습니다. 이 경락은 머리부터 발끝까지 뻗어 있어 신체의 다양한 부분을 연결합니다. 이 상호 연결성은 한 영역의 긴장이나 기능 장애가 멀리 떨어진 예기치 못한 영역에 영향을 미칠 수 있음을 의미합니다. 운동할 때, 단순히 고립된 근육만이 작동하는 것이 아니라, 뼈, 근육, 결합 조직이 협력하는 복잡한 시스템이 작동합니다.



VR에서 이 근육 체인을 탐구함으로써, 발광 플래시에 의해 안내를 받아 다양한 근육 그룹이 여러분의 움직임에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지에 대한 감각적이고 시각적인 정보를 얻게 됩니다. 이 체험을 충분히 지속하면, 시각과 감각이 결합되어 뇌에 각인되어 보다 고급스러운 언어로 신체와 소통할 수 있게 됩니다. 꾸준한 연습을 통해 폭풍 속에서도 내면의 평화를 찾게 될 것입니다. 깊게 숨을 들이쉬세요.



호흡은 하루 24시간 지속되는 일상입니다. 코와 횡격막뿐만 아니라, 신체 전체, 척추를 포함합니다. 여러분의 신체가 숨을 들이쉬고 내쉬는 방식을 관찰하고 배우며, 흉곽이 흐르는 방식을 관찰하고 이 과정이 근육 체인에 어떻게 관여하는지 알아보세요. 산소 공급은 폐뿐만 아니라 모든 세포에 영향을 미칩니다. 이 연습을 통해 이점을 얻으세요. 의식적인 산소 공급을 통해 운동 효율성을 높이는 길입니다. 슬라이드하는 방법을 배워보세요!



정적 근력 훈련 또는 등척성 운동은 관절 각도와 거리를 변경하지 않고 저항에 대해 정적 위치를 유지하는 것을 포함합니다. 이러한 운동은 근지구력, 안정성 및 근력을 향상시킵니다. 특히 코어 강화와 안정성, 자세 개선, 그리고 통제감 향상에 유익합니다. 이 연습을 통해 무의미한 노력을 이해하게 될 것입니다. 시간과 반복을 통해 개선과 성장을 보게 될 것입니다. 여러분이 얼마나 연결되어 있는지를 기억하세요.



MERIDIAN은 인간 웰니스에 대한 복잡한 접근 방식에 대한 나의 첫 시도입니다. 근육과 근막이 어떻게 협력하여 작동하는지에 대한 인식을 자극합니다. 상호 연결성. 여러분은 새로운 제어와 감각을 개발하게 될 것입니다. 어쩌면 여러분의 고통이 수수께끼로 변할지도 모릅니다.

출처:
조던 테리 "적응 가능한 극성"
토마스 마이어스 "해부학 트레인"

아름다운 가이드가 포함되어 있습니다.

title: Bleeding Deities
description:

Classic side-scrolling adventure with modern solutions. Experience the nostalgia of a classic platformer with a modern twist.
Face formidable foes in epic boss battles that test your skill and strategy, offering a rewarding challenge and progression.
Gather blood of your enemies to upgrade your equipment, enhancing strength and resilience.
Equip powers gained from defeated deities, use them in combat and reach previously unreachable areas
Navigate a nonlinear world at your own pace, unlocking areas and secrets that shape the unfolding narrative.
Solve puzzles throughout the adventure, testing your problem-solving skills and unlocking new pathways.

title: Grocery Store Tycoon - First Store
description:
게임 정보
Grocery Store Tycoon - First Shop은 플레이어가 첫 번째 가게를 관리하고 확장하여 점주로서 첫 발을 내딛게 해줍니다. 작은 가게로 시작하여 레이아웃을 최적화하고, 선반을 효율적으로 채우고, 고객에게 서비스를 제공하여 사업을 성장시키세요. 신중한 계획과 전략적 결정이 소박한 시작을 번창하는 슈퍼마켓으로 바꾸는 열쇠가 될 것입니다!

title: Escape Haunted Mansion
description:
게임 정보
Escape Haunted Mansion is a horrific multiplayer deduction game for 3 to 10 players with voice chat. The Haunteds must complete tasks to escape, while the Cursed seek to eliminate them discreetly.

You and your band of friends find yourselves trapped in the basement of a haunted mansion after an exploration gone wrong. Except one of your friends isn't, and he's the one who brought you all here, knocked you unconscious, and imprisoned and killed you.
Get out of here and try to unmask the culprit who deceived you. Then carry out all the tasks necessary for your release. Cooperate to be more efficient in your quest for freedom. Be careful, unmasking your cursed friend won't set you free - you have to complete all the tasks necessary to win and escape.
If everyone dies except your cursed friend, then it's all over for you and he wins.
Don't trust anyone, be quick and open the portal to get away and save yourself.

title: Orange You Glad i Didn't Say Banana
description:

Orange You Glad I Didn't Say Banana?!
Get ready for the wackiest, most action-packed roguelike platformer you've ever seen! Orange You Glad I Didn’t Say Banana? throws you into the peel of Banana man, a bipedal banana with a thirst for destruction and a minigun that spits absolute chaos!

Why settle for just a minigun when you can slap on some of the wildest mods imaginable? Choose from a selection of ridiculous yet devastating weapon upgrades to turn your gun into something truly overpowered:

Desktop Pals is the ultimate desktop companion game. The game has a wide selection of pets to chose from, and includes advanced features; you will never have to leave your new pal!
The gold game features a toony and pixelised artstyle, with additional DLCs pets from different universes. The pets include dogs, cats, rabbits, and much more!
The pals are interactive! Each pal has a unique reaction to you petting him, and they have natural behaviour patterns, such as falling asleep or going for a walk around your screen.
Desktop Pals also works over most modern games, so you can play with your pal during those pesky down-times, like when you are waiting for your friend to join your lobby.
The game also features advanced customization. You can choose the pals location on your screen, his scale, his capabilities, and more! You can change the game to your liking.

Dual screen players can switch the screen where their girl is located by using the win key, shift key, and left/right keys.
Contents:
The game includes a cute desktop pet character.

title: Amaz'd
description:
게임 정보
Amazd is a 2D fast-paced, pixel-art roguelike dungeon crawler where every second counts! Battle through procedurally generated mazes, slay monsters and powerful bosses, and collect loot to power up and increase your score.
Tutorial
There is a short tutorial that can be accessed from the main menu, which teaches players the ropes of Amazd. You will learn how to fight, move through mazes and beat the game!
Main Game - 8 Levels
There is a series of 8 levels in Amazd, each one contains a procedurally generated maze, with the 8th level being a boss fight! The mazes get increasingly more difficult as you progress. Each maze contains:
-Coins to collect
-Monster to slay
-Powerups and Potions to use
-A portal to the next level
Your score goes down every second! so slay monsters and collect coins to increase your score.
Don't Die!
-You only have 7 hearts, so careful not to die in combat, otherwise game over!
-You have a stamina bar, so careful when sprinting so save stamina!
The aim is to beat all 8 levels as fast as possible, and get a highest score!

title: Desert Angels
description:
게임 정보
Desert Angels is a third-person, story-driven exploration game set in a desert scrapyard. There's a generator buried in the scrapyard that can restore power to your village's water purification system, and save your people. Uncover the scrapyard's memories — or blast those memories to pieces — to find it.
Travel through the striking landscape of the scrapyard at your own pace. There are no enemies or hazards, only layers upon layers of trash and the open sands. Discover the artifacts and relics scattered between the trash to compile your own understanding of the scrapyard's past.
Once upon a time, the desert was ravaged by war, and to this day many of the weapons lying around the scrapyard are still operational.

title: Cardinal Sequence
description:
게임 정보
Cardinal Sequence is a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by space and sci-fi with a unique twist to how to play your cards. It is all about finding perfect synergies, organizing your cards and reaching scores beyond human readability.
A new way to play cards
Input a pattern of directions to match your card's in order to score as high as you can. Every card comes with unique effects and synergies to allow you to beat an ever increasing challenge. Carefully manage your cards to reach for the stars and beyond.
A relaxing space theme
Lean back as you sit in front of your view into space. Watch the stars pass while listening to relaxing, sci-fi inspired tunes. Take your time as you play your cards at your own pace and watch the stars fly by.
More to come...
The game is in active development and will see more content and new ways to play.

The protagonist, Hiro, visits his relative's house in the countryside by himself.

How you spend your time is up to you!
You can fish in the ocean or a river, have your catch cooked, build a secret base...
The village is full of interesting folks, like the fisherman, the candy store owner, and your neighbors.

Haruka

title: TCL - The Cursed Legacy
description:
게임 정보
The Cursed Legacy is an action/exploration game based on “die and retry” and made with love and passion to pay homage to the games of the 90s. It also offers mini games that give this work an infinite lifespan.
FEATURES
6 action stages
13 bosses
Action platformer run'n gun phases
Metroid-like exploration phases
5 mini-games

STORY
Year 3145. The human race has practically disappeared from the universe. The principality of Dallongeville, the last bastion of humanity, no longer exists. It was the scene of the worst abuses.
In these tormented times, the young mercenary Leif survives by committing the worst misdeeds. Always in search of power, he will try to steal the RB209, in one of the oases of the Cube god.
Will you have the courage to accompany him on this odyssey?

title: Neuro Nightmare
description:
게임 정보
꼭 Game Setting Manual을 읽어주세요! 이 게임을 플레이하기 위해선 NeuroSky의 Mindwabe Mobile 2가 필요합니다.
Neuro Nightmare는 뇌-컴퓨터 인터페이스(BCI) 기술을 활용하여 공포 게임의 몰입감을 극대화하는 혁신적인 게임입니다. 플레이어는 폐쇄된 기숙 학원에서 미지의 존재로부터 도망치며, 모든 레버를 작동시켜 탈출구를 찾아야 합니다. 하지만 단순한 생존 게임이 아닙니다—당신의 두뇌 활동이 게임 플레이에 직접 영향을 미칩니다.
이 게임은 BCI 기술을 통해 플레이어의 집중력과 안정도를 실시간으로 분석하여 게임 환경을 조정합니다. 집중력이 높을수록 시야가 넓어지고, 안정도를 유지하면 괴물에게서 숨을 수 있는 특수 능력을 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 독창적인 메커니즘은 기존의 공포 게임과 차별화된 몰입감을 제공합니다.
BCI를 지원하지 않는 일반적인 플레이 모드도 포함되어 있으며, 두 가지 모드를 비교하면서 색다른 게임 경험을 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: Cucu
description:
게임 정보
Unlock various skills and engage in intense battles with other players as you compete for survival. Combine different attributes and abilities to create your own unique combat style, and strategize to face increasingly powerful enemies. As stronger foes continue to appear, you'll need to grow stronger yourself to defeat them. This battle is not just about raw strength, but also about intelligence and strategy, making it a psychological challenge.
As the competition heats up, you'll have access to more skills and items, which will help you refine and perfect your combat style. By overcoming various challenges and battles within the game, you will continuously improve and prepare to face even tougher enemies. Strive to survive until the end and become the strongest player. Seize the opportunity to rise to the top by surviving until the very end, and prove your strength by defeating players from all over the world. In the endless battlefield, unleash your tactics and abilities, fighting with only victory in mind.

title: A Game About Cutting A Tree
description:
게임 정보
게임은 간단합니다. 모든 나무를 베어내세요.....
울창한 숲에서 자연의 균형을 되찾거나, 시간에 갇혀 방치된 도시를 되찾는 것을 주제로 한 미니멀리스트 게임입니다. 도끼와 결심만으로 빽빽한 초목 속을 헤치고, 귀중한 나무를 모으며, 뿌리 아래에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견하세요.
게임 특징
나무 베기 – 울창한 식생을 제거하고 주위 환경을 구성하세요.
나무 모으기 및 판매 – 더 나은 도구 및 업그레이드를 위해 자원을 모아 거래하세요.
도끼 업그레이드 – 기본 도구로 시작하여 강력한 장비로 업그레이드하세요.
스태미너 관리 – 과로와 부상을 피하기 위해 자신의 페이스에 맞게 조절하세요.
숨겨진 비밀 발견 – 야생이나 폐허 속을 깊이 탐험하며 지표 아래 숨겨진 신비를 밝혀내세요.
복구 및 되찾기 – 풍경을 변화시켜 잊혀진 장소에 생명을 되돌리세요.

title: Supreme War God
description:
게임 정보
In this mmo game, the human empire is in chaos, and demons have broken free from their seals to wreak havoc. but fear not! many heroes have risen to fight the demons and save humanity. by defeating demons, players can grow stronger and eventually become the saviors of the world.
###Game System###
In this immersive game, you can personalize your character's appearance using the Fashion System, experimenting with diverse styles and accessories. the Crafting System lets you unleash your creativity, transforming collected resources into practical or valuable items. with the Enchanting System, you can infuse your gear with magical attributes to gain an edge in battles. the Enhancement System provides a way to boost your equipment's performance through meticulous upgrades. mastering the Skill System allows you to develop a unique combat style and strategy. the Retainer System offers the convenience of having helpful assistants for various in-game tasks. through the Castle System, you can showcase your architectural and managerial talents while defending and expanding your territory. the Mercenary System enables you to lead a group of skilled warriors on exciting missions. lastly, the Quest System presents a variety of thrilling challenges that reward your efforts with precious treasures and well-earned fame.
###Gameplay###
In this action-packed game, players can boost their strength by defeating powerful demon armies and obtaining rare items. here's a closer look at the various gameplay elements:
al Enhancement: fortify your magical barriers by battling demon hordes to acquire enhancement stones.
Elven Kingdom: safeguard the elves' realm from demonic forces within a time limit to claim your rewards.
Kingdom Conquest: engage in strategic battles against other players to achieve dominance and boost your kingdom's power.
Demonic Wilderness: explore this vast, untamed land where dark energies surge beneath the cracked earth, inhabited by terrifying creatures and ancient evils.
Troll's Lair: venture into this foul-smelling underground den, where monstrous trolls with an insatiable hunger for battle stand guard.
Demon Cave: delve into this cavernous abyss where the air is thick with infernal power, a breeding ground for demons plotting world chaos.
Goblin Warrens: traverse this labyrinth of tunnels teeming with mischievous goblins, whose traps and laughter pose a constant threat to the unwary.

title: The Escape: Team Battle Arena
description:
게임 정보
Experience an intense 1v1 ~ 5v5 light MOBA battle with stunning virtual anime-style heroines! Strategize, fight, and outmaneuver your opponents to escape first and claim victory.
Use unique abilities, battle maps, and unleash powerful teamwork.
Every match is a thrilling race against time—will your team break free or fall behind?
Join the fight and prove your skills in the ultimate escape battle!

title: Sound of Summer Thunder: Day 1
description:
게임 정보
A BARA game built on a visual novel engine with RPG elements.
Choices matter for the main character, Kody. Not only must Kody decide if he should speak of the future, but also decide which details he will share.
The potential of 4 love interests or enemies await.
Each game installment covers a full day in Kody's adventure. This is Day 1 of 8
~15 hours of gameplay
Voiced characters with separate volume control
A complex flow-chart leads to many multiple endings by the end of Day 8, possibly even a thruple.
Will Kody be smart enough to navigate the past? Will he end up in a Sanatorium? Or, will he be a Himbo?  Player choices matter...

title: Zui's Witch Academy
description:
게임 정보
Zui's Witch Academy is a boss rush roguelike-styled action game. You build a deck of 3 magical cards to take down one of many bosses. Each boss has an arena specifically tailored to them. Can you help Rysa graduate from Zui's Witch Academy with flying colors?
This game was originally made for the Boss Rush 2025 Game Jam!
Features
18 unique cards to collect and build your deck with!
3 difficulties to attempt and conquer, I doubt you can beat impossible mode (no like seriously, give up).
Practice and master against every boss in training mode.
8 bosses each with their own arena specifically designed around them.
An energetic and fun soundtrack! Complemented by a charming modern pixel-art aesthetic.
What are you waiting for?
The game is free! Download it and play it now! Rysa is waitin' for you to wake her up, how else is she going to graduate from Zui's Witch Academy?

title: Hidden Cats Ellara
description:
게임 정보
Hidden Cats in Ellara is a charming hidden object game where you explore a carefully crafted, hand-drawn isometric world in search of 100 hidden cats. With its cozy atmosphere and peaceful soundtrack, immerse yourself in a relaxing experience as you uncover each cat tucked away in the detailed environment.
Gameplay & Controls
Save Progress: Automatically saves, so you can continue anytime.
Camera Movement: Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys
Pan: Click and hold the left mouse button, then drag
Edge Panning: Move the cursor to the screen edges
Zoom: Adjust with the scroll wheel

title: Pupupu
description:
게임 정보
Pupupu is a relaxing casual puzzle game about collecting mushrooms and filling the basket. Nothing more, nothing less. Take a break from the complications of your everyday life and just collect some mushrooms. There is no plot, no challenges, no DLC or paid content, no RPG elements or leaderboards. Just mushrooms.

This game was made for my girlfriend so she could feel less anxious and have a little bit of fun. Play it yourself, or give it to any sad overwhelmed person in your vicinity. And take care.

title: It Takes a Village
description:
게임 정보
It Takes a Village is a city-building RPG with a procedurally generated world inspired by Legend of Zelda and Animal Crossing. Gather resources, build your village, manage diverse villagers, craft weapons and armor, and explore a dynamic world—from lush forests with temples to mountainous tundras with caves and gems. Shape your village's destiny in this immersive adventure.
Explore a unique and changing world
Embark on an epic journey in It Takes a Village across diverse and procedurally generated biomes like deserts, tundras, and forests. Encounter unique enemies and explore intriguing places like caves, graveyards, bandit camps, and elaborate mazes. Gather resources to build and fortify your village and equip yourself to take on bigger and stronger foes.
Build and customize your village
Unleash your creativity in "It Takes a Village" as you personalize every detail of your village. With an extensive array of buildings, furniture, and cosmetics, transform your village into a living tribute to the countless adventures beyond its walls. Dive into the details by customizing pub atmospheres, workshop layouts, and even your own cozy personal house. Your village is a canvas—craft a unique haven that echoes the tales of your extraordinary adventures.

title: WARRIORS
description:
게임 정보
WARRIORS는 멀티플레이어와 AI 봇이 포함된 싱글플레이어 모두를 위해 설계된 슈팅 게임입니다. 얼리 액세스를 구매한 플레이어는 모든 무기 스킨과 캐릭터를 즉시 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다. 이후에는 경험치를 얻어 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다.
현재 게임에서 제공되는 8가지 모드는 다음과 같습니다:
정복
목표를 점령하여 시간 경과에 따라 점수를 얻으세요. 더 많은 목표를 점령할수록 점수를 더 빨리 얻을 수 있습니다.
러시
목표를 파괴하거나 방어하세요. 공격팀의 병력이 소진되면 방어팀이 승리합니다.
킬 컨펌
적을 처치하고 그들의 인식표를 수집하여 점수를 얻으세요. 팀의 인식표를 수집하여 적의 점수 획득을 방지할 수도 있습니다.
팀 데스매치
적을 처치하여 점수를 얻으세요.
깃발 뺏기
적의 깃발을 탈취하여 기지로 가져와 점수를 얻으세요. 깃발이 탈취되면 먼저 그것을 되찾아야 합니다.
모두의 전쟁
모든 플레이어를 처치하여 점수를 얻으세요.
서치 앤 디스트로이
시간 내에 목표를 파괴하세요. 라운드당 한 명의 플레이어만 생존할 수 있습니다.
좀비 모드
무시무시한 좀비와 싸우세요.
.

title: Oxide Room 208
description:
게임 정보
After Matt’s tragic disappearance in room 104 of the Night Soul Motel, his business partner Josh is still trapped there at the mercy of a ruthless and cruel scientist. The lives of Kat, Josh and Matt crossed paths in science —a macabre science orchestrated by Doc’s deadly hands.

FEATURES:

- Digitalized real actors and use of advance motion capture technology, that will instantly immerse you in this terrifying experience. Putting yourself in the shoes of the protagonists has never been so easy!
- Dig into the bowels of the Night Soul Motel and sneak into the huge underground lab.
- Experience new restarting mechanics after dying, either accidentally or at the hands of horrific creatures that lurk around the facilities. Your actions have consequences! But in OXIDE, death is just the beginning.
- Realistic use of the inventory. You will have the chance to pick up a large number of weapons and items that will help you get out of there, but you can’t carry them all with you! You’d better use your head.

Classes
There are four different types of themes, each played in a unique way. However, they all encourage you to play as many cards as possible. The power of animals helps you upgrade your equipment or generate long-term income.

Leaderboard

title: Metrogether Train Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Metrogether is a train simulator where you drive, collect passengers, work together with friends and explore the subway network in a fictional city. Embark on your journey as a train driver or ticket inspector in single and multiplayer.
Drive Trains
Take control of a subway train, try to follow the timetable and collect passengers as you travel from station to station in this immersive subway simulation.
Explore the Subway Network
Immerse yourself in this fictional subway network, filled with tunnels, bustling stations, and hidden secrets.
Play as a Ticket Inspector
Step into the shoes of a vigilant ticket inspector, ensuring that passengers have valid tickets and deal with troublemakers during the journey.

title: Range
description:
게임 정보
Range was built as a tool to help you limit distractions and make work (or play!) sessions more productive. Embark on a drive by selecting a duration for your session and any tasks or goals you want to complete. Select the environment you’d like to drive through, and customize your vehicle to your liking! Set off on your relaxing drive, complete tasks as you go, and decompress with a break before your next session.
As you complete sessions (and breaks!), level up with rewarded experience and build up Credits. Credits can be spent to unlock the full roster of 8 customizable vehicles and 10 different vehicle accessories. As you level up, you automatically unlock 4 different playable environments.
As you play and level up, enjoy drives through new areas - the Snowy Mountains, Coastal Highway, Canyon Straights, and Redwood Forest.

title: Caverna
description:
게임 정보
Caverna is the digital adaptation of the board game of the same name created by Uwe Rosenberg. The game has the following game mechanics: Automatic Resource Growth, Tile Placement, Turn Order Claim Action, Worker Placement. The game has a Solomode and Multiplayer option. You can also play against the AI. It is a turnbased game that you can play live but also asynchronously. It can be played with 1-7 players. You have 2 options for the look of the game. The classic board game appearance and our 3D interpretation. 

Caverna makes you the head of a dwarf tribe, living in a small cavern.
You cultivate the forest in front of your cavern and dig deeper into the mountain throughout the game. By furnishing rooms in your caverns you make space to grow your tribe and and create new goods from your resources. Deeper into the mountain you will find fountains as well as ore and gem mines. It’s on you to decide how much ore and gems you want to mine, giving you the opportunity to forge weapons and go on adventures; a new way to do things in the game instead of using actions with your workers. Outside your cavern you can clear the forest, cultivate fields, fence pastures and grow crops or breed animals. All this in order to increase your wealth and become the strongest and best tribe leader of them all!

title: Mine & Slash
description:
게임 정보
던전으로 들어가 적을 물리치고 금을 캐세요! 많은 금을!
진정한 채굴자로서, 던전 깊숙이 파고 들어가면서 금과 귀중한 자원을 수집할 수 있는 독특한 기회를 가집니다.
주의하세요! 더 깊이 들어갈수록 도전이 더 어려워지고, 더 강력한 적들이 기다리고 있습니다.
강력한 전리품으로 영웅을 맞춤 설정하고 장비를 업그레이드하여 더욱 치명적이고 효과적으로 만드세요.
앞으로의 퀘스트에 도움이 될 강력한 기술을 해제하고 더욱 강력해지세요!

title: The Pub Life Simulator
description:
게임 정보
꿈의 펍을 운영해볼 준비 되셨나요?
The Pub Life는 여러분을 처음부터 자신의 펍을 설립하고 운영하는 경험으로 초대합니다! 오래된 가게를 인수하고 꿈꾸던 공간을 만들기 위해 도전하세요. 고객을 만족시키고 사업을 확장하려면 무엇이든 해야 합니다. 하지만 주의하세요: 훌륭한 펍을 운영하려면 철저한 계획과 결단력 있는 관리가 필요합니다.
가게를 청소하고 시작하세요
펍에 들어서자마자 청소부터 시작하세요. 먼지와 어수선함 속에 갇히지 마세요. 깨끗한 펍은 만족스러운 고객을 의미합니다! 플레이어는 초기 예산을 신중하게 사용하여 첫 번째 재료를 구입하고 간단한 메뉴로 시작할 수 있습니다.
성장하고 레시피를 발견하세요
사업을 확장하려면 레벨을 올리고 더 고급 재료의 잠금을 해제하세요. 새로운 레시피를 배우고, 칵테일 제조 기술을 향상시키며 고객을 놀라게 할 특별한 메뉴를 만드세요. 창의력을 발휘해 고객의 사랑을 받는 펍으로 거듭나세요!
균형 유지
훌륭한 펍 운영은 메뉴에만 국한되지 않습니다. 재고를 균형 있게 유지하고 예산을 계획하며 고객의 요구를 충족시키는 것을 잊지 마세요. 수입을 신중하게 관리하고 비싼 투자에 신중히 접근하세요. 그렇지 않으면 부채의 늪에 빠질 수 있습니다!
사실적인 시뮬레이션
The Pub Life는 실제 펍 운영자가 직면하는 모든 도전과 보상을 시뮬레이션합니다. 세밀한 관리 시스템, 다양한 레시피 옵션 및 재미있는 공간 개발 과정은 몰입감 넘치는 경험을 제공합니다.
준비되셨나요? 꿈의 펍을 창조하고, 운영하고, 가장 사랑받는 공간으로 만들어보세요!

title: PAKO 4
description:
게임 정보


Another action-packed crime romp from the infamous PAKO series!
PAKO 4 is an atmospheric and violent indie action game where the player causes chaos in a big city by committing various crimes with his accomplice and escaping the police. The game is shot from a third-person view and you can move around the city on foot or by car. Fast paced arcade mechanics from Pako 2 meet more in depth missions varying from escorting people to doing all kinds of hi-jinx around the North Paw area! Come and enjoy the old school feel of doing crimes!

title: Wonderland on Desktop
description:
게임 정보
The screen is big enough, why don’t we fully use it! Wonderland on Desktop will meet your idea! Doing multiple works while arranging your farmland!
3D experience!
Although it’s a tiny window, but there is full function illumination and day night cycle! 3D experience, use mouse wheel to change camera form 45’ angle to top down view. That’s incredible!

title: COMBOLITE
description:
게임 정보
COMBOLITE combines roguelike deckbuilders and autobattlers in a unique way.
Your goal is to hit the rock as hard as possible by making the perfect sequence of weapons.

What is a combo?
Combos are defined by a sequence of 3 directions and a reward for pulling them off.
Each weapon attacks in one of 8 directions, and you can execute a combo by placing them in your deck in the correct order.
Combos level up based on the amount of damage the 3 weapons performing the combo do.
The higher their level, the stronger and more useful they become!

❤️ Cats and Seek 시리즈의 4번째 작품이 왔습니다! 도쿄로 가서 도시 곳곳에서 놀고 있는 고양이들을 찾아보세요 🗼. 모든 고양이를 찾을 수 있을까요? 😻

title: Backrooms: Hide Together
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에 대하여

주요 특징:
실제와 같은 그래픽 및 환경: 매우 세밀한 비주얼과 몰입감 있는 환경이 The Backrooms의 불안한 세계를 놀라운 현실감으로 생생하게 구현합니다.
멀티플레이어 생존: Backrooms를 탐험하면서 협력하거나 분리하여 탐험합니다. 의사소통과 팀워크는 생존을 위한 가장 중요한 도구입니다.
몰입감 있는 공포 분위기: 실제와 같은 환경과 다이나믹한 조명이 잊혀진 방과 불가능한 공간의 공포 세계로 여러분을 끌어들입니다.
무서운 적들: 무자비한 존재들이 각 레벨을 순찰하며, 각각 독특한 행동을 보입니다. 숨거나, 달리거나, 조용히 해야 합니다. 생존은 본능에 달려 있습니다.
8개의 도전적인 레벨: 숨 막히는 복도, 기괴한 열린 공간, 복잡한 퍼즐을 탐험하며 여러 레벨을 넘어섭니다. 새로운 콘텐츠와 레벨이 정기적으로 추가되어 계속해서 긴장감을 유지합니다.

준비하세요. 탈출은 가능하지만, 협력해야만 가능합니다.

title: Office Simulator
description:

오피스 시뮬레이터 는 기업 세계에 깊이 몰입할 수 있는 현실적인비즈니스 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 인턴으로 시작하여 회사 계층을 단계별로 올라가고, 궁극적으로 자신의 회사를 설립하여 업계 리더가 되세요.

커리어 여정
인턴으로 커리어를 시작하고 점점 더 어려운 업무를 수행하세요. 파일 정리, 회의 일정조율, 문서 전달, 이메일 응답 등 다양한 사무실 업무를 처리하여 경험을 쌓고, 역량을강화하며 승진을 통해 더 높은 직책으로 올라가세요.



사무실 업그레이드
최신 사무실 장비와 가구에 투자하여 생산성과 업무 효율성을 극대화하세요. 더 나은 근무환경을 조성하여 직원들의 성과를 극대화하고 회사의 성장을 가속화하세요.

title: Viper Squad
description:
게임 정보
Take Your Shot in Viper Squad
Step into the high-stakes, adrenaline-fueled world of Viper Squad. In this sci-fi multiplayer FPS, every decision, every shot, and every teammate counts. Assemble your squad, outthink your opponents, and climb the ranks to claim your spot as a legend in the Exoleague.
---
What Sets Viper Squad Apart?
🔥 Multiplayer Modes That Keep You on Your Toes
Whether you're all about fast action or tactical teamwork, Viper Squad has a mode for you:
TDM: Quick, intense, and all about who’s got the sharper reflexes.
Objective-Based Missions: Work together, outsmart the enemy, and secure the win.
Custom Matches: Create your own rules, choose your favorite maps, and play your way.
---
🎖️ Earn Your Place in the Exoleague
We get it—rising through the ranks isn’t just about playing; it’s about proving you’re the best.
Climb through six distinct ranks, from Recruit to the ultimate Apex.
Earn Ascension Points (AP) for kills, assists, and objectives. Every match matters.
Feel the tension as your rank adjusts in real-time after each game.
This isn’t just about winning—it’s about leaving your mark.
---
⚔️ Play Your Way with Unique Classes
Build your perfect squad with four specialized roles:

title: MazeSlug
description:
게임 정보
This is an immersive first-person single-player horror game. Players will take on the role of an ordinary person returning home late at night, who inexplicably steps into a special space on a familiar path. You must explore and move forward in this space filled with unknown fears.
The game is divided into four chapters. Players will explore four distinctly different styled areas in sequence. Please be advised that some scenes contain bloody elements, and players should mentally prepare themselves accordingly.

title: Snakecremental
description:
게임 정보
Collect fruits colors
Upgrade the Skill Tree
Features:
Skill Tree with a variety of upgrades
Multiple collectables with different effects
Skins
number go up

title: Stack & Sort Pals
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Stack & Sort Pals, a delightful and brain-teasing puzzle game where logic and strategy lead to victory! Your mission is simple yet challenging: sort and stack colorful blocks, each representing a cute animal, into perfectly organized columns. But beware—every move counts!
How to Play:
🐾 Drag & Drop – Move blocks around and stack them by color.
🧠 Plan Your Moves – Think ahead to avoid getting stuck and clear the board efficiently.
🌈 Solve the Puzzle – Organize every column so each one contains a single color.
Key Features:
✔ Hundreds of Puzzles – From easy warm-ups to mind-bending challenges!
✔ Adorable Blocky Friends – Meet charming animals with unique personalities.
✔ Relaxing Yet Addictive – Simple to pick up but hard to master!
✔ No Time Limits – Enjoy stress-free puzzle-solving at your own pace.
✔ Colorful & Engaging Design – A visually appealing world full of fun and charm.
Think you have what it takes to master the art of sorting? Test your skills and become the ultimate stacking champion in Stack & Sort Pals! 🏆🐶🐱

title: Wrap House Simulator🌯 Prologue
description:
게임 정보
🏆 Start Your Wrap House Journey – For Free!
Wrap House Simulator🌯 Prologue is a free standalone introduction to the full game, letting you experience the fast-paced world of running a wrap shop. Start in a small kitchen, take customer orders, and perfect the art of making the best wraps. Whether you play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer, your goal is to serve customers quickly and efficiently while keeping your shop running smoothly. 
🔪Chop, Grill, and Wrap Under Pressure!
Every second counts in the kitchen. Slice fresh ingredients, grill meats to perfection, and wrap orders with precision to satisfy hungry customers. The Prologue features a limited selection of ingredients and recipes, challenging you to manage time and resources effectively. As you gain experience, you’ll improve your speed and efficiency in handling multiple orders at once. 
🎉 Team Up and Work Together!

title: Pantry Raid
description:
게임 정보
Pantry Raid is a rogue lite dungeon-crawler with cooking elements. Players traverse the pantry, defeating food-themed enemies to make meals to improve your character during the course of the game.
Featuring:
High-energy combat where quick reflexes and sharp strategy are key. With dynamic enemies, fluid movement, and ever-changing buff combinations, every battle is a thrilling test of skill. Dodge, strike, and adapt in the heat of the pantry.
Randomized levels and dynamic buff combinations, ensuring no two playthroughs are ever the same. Adapt to shifting strategies as new buffs reshape your play-style.
Each buff ties to a flavorful element—like Spicy for fire attacks or Salty for ice defenses—leading to unexpected synergies. Adapt, experiment, and master these dynamic power-ups to dominate the pantry!
An adorable crew of cooking critters!

title: 101 Cats Hidden in Shenzhen
description:
게임 정보
✍️ 선전에 숨겨진 101마리의 고양이는 손으로 만든 아름다운 풍경 속에서 숨겨진 고양이를 찾는 데 도전합니다.

🎵 검색하는 동안 평화롭고 몰입도 높은 사운드트랙을 즐겨보세요.

😸 수많은 성과를 달성하세요.

🏆 친구들에게 최단 시간 내에 고양이를 모두 찾아보도록 도전해보세요! ⏱️
게임플레이:
🐾 하나의 풍경에 숨겨진 101마리의 고양이.
👉 찾은 고양이를 클릭하세요.
🙌 눈이 피로해지지 않도록 밝기를 조절해보세요.
🔎 놀라운 줌!

😺🐾🐈 😻

title: Lumberjacked
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to LumberJacked, a 3D incremental clicker game that takes place deep in a mysterious forest.
Chop trees, collect the logs, and toss them into the chipper to earn cash. Use your earnings to upgrade your strength and efficiency, or sharpen your axe allowing you to cut down increasingly tougher and more valuable trees.
Tunnel through trees to uncover the story, discover loot, and meet the locals who’ll trade tools for a price.
Destiny calls, do you embrace it, or defy it?
Features:
Be the Lumberjack: Chop down trees, and harvest them in the chipper to earn money.
Pump Some Iron: Upgrade your core stats to increase your efficiency
Hit the Grindstone: Sharpen your axe to improve its effectiveness against harder and more valuable trees
Treasures - Find various treasures and other discoverables to earn extra loot and tools.
Gnomes - Deal with gnomes who are ready to help you, for a fee.
Uncover the Mystery: Seek out the scattered story of the forest to discover your purpose in it.
Determine Your Destiny: Follow the clues and work with gnomes to uncover your story, and accept or deny your destiny through multiple endings.
Replayability: Play the game a second time to unlock purchasable skins & Golden Maple currency, uncover all secrets, and experience the second ending.
company: Inner Realm Studios, Dumb Duck Games

title: Pioneer Racing
description:
게임 정보
In Pioneer Racing, the goal is simple: be the best driver! You start with a slow car, and as you win races against Bots, you unlock new cars! Your best lap times are saved, for you to beat them. After a race, you can relax by driving around the map, or customize your car.

This game is still in development, and it has a lot of niew things planned:
-multiplayer, to race against each other, or drive in the same car
-New circuits, with better visuals
-New garage, with more customization to all cars
-New cars, designed with every little detail
-UI update, to match a futuristic look and game design direction
-More instinctive controls, and UI accessibility
-Fix of bugs, like looking around with the mouse
... and much more! Feel free to tell me, for example on my youtube channel, anything you would like to be in the game!
As I'm alone on this game and I try to do everything by myself, updates may take time to come. You can expect one thing to be added each month or less.

title: Zombie Town Breakout
description:
게임 정보
Thank you everyone for your tremendous support. We're a newly established studio that created this game out of our passion for zombie and shooter games. Zombie Town Breakout embodies the collective effort of our team. While we're aware the game still has many flaws and shortcomings, we hope to continuously improve it through Early Access. We'll sincerely listen to feedback and learn from the guidance of experienced players like you.
Welcome to Zombie Town Breakout, an intense top-down survival action game where you must lead survivors through a town overrun by zombies. For survival, for hope—pick up your weapons and break through the hordes!
Once a thriving town, now a playground for the undead. As one of the few survivors, you must take charge and seek hope in this desolate wasteland. The intuitive top-down perspective lets you command the battlefield effortlessly, whether slashing through enemies with cold steel or switching to blazing firearms for ranged combat—all delivering exhilarating action.
Venture into dangerous ruins to scavenge supplies and powerful weapons to boost your survival chances. Most importantly, you’re not alone! Along your journey, you’ll encounter other survivors with unique skills. Recruit them to strengthen your team and gain unexpected advantages. Expand your squad, upgrade gear, and survive the relentless zombie onslaught.
Zombie Town Breakout features meticulously designed levels, including exploration maps full of unknowns and strategic stronghold defense challenges. In exploration missions, delve into zombie territories to rescue survivors and gather resources. In defense missions, withstand waves of frenzied attacks—strategize formations, utilize terrain, and protect your survivors at all costs.
Core Features:
Seamless Weapon Switching: Flexibly alternate between melee weapons and ranged firearms to tackle diverse zombie threats and forge your combat style. Recruit Unique Survivors: Discover skilled survivors in the ruins and build a formidable team.

title: Jackroid
description:
게임 정보
Jackroid
A Retro-Inspired Sci-Fi Platformer Adventure — Now Free on Steam
Originally developed as a birthday gift for my nephew, Jackroid is a heartfelt indie game that blends classic action-platforming with Metroid-style exploration. After several requests and growing interest, I’ve decided to bring Jackroid to Steam—for free—as a thank you to everyone who’s supported my game dev journey. This is the first game that I built after quitting PCL work (aka automation) seven years ago. 
About the Game
Play as Jackroid—the first machine-human hybrid built for deep space exploration. Journey across mysterious galaxies and uncharted planets in search of your identity and purpose. Along the way, uncover hidden upgrades, solve environmental puzzles, and fight to protect the future of the human race.
🪐 Open Map Exploration
Inspired by the classics—discover secret areas and unlock powerful abilities as you traverse hand-crafted alien worlds.
🤖 Action-Platforming Combat
Fast-paced gameplay and satisfying controls designed to challenge and reward.
🧠 Puzzles & Upgrades
Use your wits and tools to access new paths and evolve your abilities.
🎭 Story, Characters & Cutscenes
Dive into a narrative about identity, humanity, and courage in the face of isolation.
🎮 Built With Love
Originally made for my nephew's 11th birthday—this is more than just a game, it’s a memory brought to life.
Part of the Goliath Corp franchise with upcoming games "Jaws of Hell" and "The Hive Pandemic"
Controls:
Arrow keys,
Z - Jump/Select,
X - Shoot
C - Rocket

title: Zombie Graveyard Simulator - Prologue
description:
게임 정보
In a world where the dead turn into zombies, your job is to manage your very own Graveyard! Perform burials and cremations, and fulfill visitor requests with special flowers and gravestones by day. But when night falls, everything changes. The dead may rest, but the zombies don’t. They are coming for your precious work. Will you be able to protect them?

Visitor Satisfaction is Key
After processing the bodies, visitors will regularly return to check on their loved ones. Your duty is to keep graves clean and intact while providing fresh flowers to ensure their satisfaction. Every visit rewards you with valuable bonuses to help keep your business running smoothly.
Build your Defenses

title: Fart King
description:
게임 정보
Fart King – The Ultimate Precision Platforming Challenge!
A determined pug, a legendary crown, and only one way to reach it—by mastering the power of fart propulsion! Fart King is a hardcore platformer where every jump is a test of skill, and every mistake sends you plummeting back down. Can you control your toots well enough to reach the top?
Gameplay:
💨 High-Stakes Jumping!
The only way forward is up, and gravity is your greatest enemy. One wrong move, and you'll face a long, painful fall.
🐶 Master the Art of the Fart!
Every jump demands precision, patience, and nerves of steel.

title: Remote Reaper: FPV Drone
description:
게임 정보
“Remote Reaper: FPV Drone" is a simulator that immerses the player in the role of an FPV drone operator in modern warfare. The player operates FPV drones using remote control to strike enemy vehicles.
The game offers realistic controls via a controller and a simplified control mode that allows easy drone operation using a keyboard and mouse.
Each enemy vehicle has weak spots. Your task is to identify these critical points and deliver precise strikes for effective enemy destruction.

title: Green Thing From The Planet Jupiter
description:
게임 정보
Green Thing from the Planet Jupiter is a fast-paced two-player competitive chase game where players take on the roles of Cannoli, a crafty housecat, and Green Thing, a stranded alien engineer. Cartoonish chaos meets strategic gameplay as Green Thing scavenges parts from around the house to repair his UFO while avoiding Cannoli and his traps.
Collect all the parts as Green Thing, or stop him as Cannoli before his owner Zia Nina gets back home!
Green Thing must rummage through Zia Nina's house to find parts to repair his UFO. He wields his Jupiterian gun, which can stun, smoke out, and distract Cannoli as he explores the house.
Cannoli must stop Green Thing at all costs, before Zia Nina grounds him. He has access to a "CAT-ALOGUE", where he can select and place ACME traps throughout the level, like a glue trap, anvil, and box of TNT.
autokwd: Green Thing From The Planet Jupiter

title: Synthwave Driver
description:
게임 정보
A nostalgic road trip on an endless highway, driving iconic '80s cars through a neon-filled paradise. Let the synthwave/retrowave soundtrack guide you toward the horizon, leading you into a world of nostalgic vibes.
The road stretches infinitely, taking you back to a simpler time, where palm trees sway gently in the warm breeze. As the rhythm takes over, you enter a state of serene reflection, racing through a universe where time is measured in moments of calm and nostalgia.
As you accelerate, you'll unlock new worlds and over 15 iconic vehicles, each offering customization options and upgrades. For competitive players, each world features an online leaderboard, allowing you to compete globally or with friends for the highest scores.
Over 15 Vehicles : Each with unique characteristics and a first-person view.
Soundtrack : An extensive library of Synthwave/Vaporwave/Retrowave tracks.
Gameplay : 5 different game modes.
Garage : Personalize it your way, by changing the flooring and wallpaper, as well as decorative objects.
Vehicles : Acquire new vehicles and improve your performance, as well as customize them the way you want.
Scenery: Explore over 10 worlds, each offering different atmospheres and feelings.
Leaderboards : Chase high scores on global and friends' leaderboards.
Cool Vibes : Brings back fond memories of simpler times.

TDM: Quick, intense, and all about who’s got the sharper reflexes.
Objective-Based Missions: Work together, outsmart the enemy, and secure the win.
Custom Matches: Create your own rules, choose your favorite maps, and play your way.

Climb through six distinct ranks, from Recruit to the ultimate Apex.
Earn Ascension Points (AP) for kills, assists, and objectives. Every match matters.
Feel the tension as your rank adjusts in real-time after each game.
This isn’t just about winning—it’s about leaving your mark.

title: Help Rococo
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever dreamed of meeting a character from the virtual world?
Now is your chance! Rococo, a girl trapped in the virtual world, is sending out a distress signal to you.
She longs to escape her digital cage and live with you in the real world.
However, saving her is no easy task.

title: Fuel Harvest Together
description:
게임 정보
형제라면 당연히 기름 캐야지! 최대 5인 멀티 지원, 1명은 공장장, 4명은 합작 파트너! 역할을 나누어 최적의 운영을 하세요. 밤새 정제소 돌리는 노동왕, 숨겨진 보물을 캐는 행운러, 주식 시장을 읽는 전략가, 심지어 손 놓고 구경하는 유저도 가게에서 소소한 성취감을 느낄 수 있습니다. 협력해서 석유 산업을 키워나가세요. 적절한 역할 분배만 있다면 석유 제국도 꿈이 아닙니다!
사이버 탐사 장비 메탈 디텍터를 활용해 랜덤으로 생성되는 맵에서 현실판 황금 캐기 게임을 즐겨보세요. 원유를 채굴하는 동안 숨겨진 ‘미스터리 박스’를 발견하고, 희귀 보석, 화석, 광물을 획득해 컬렉션을 완성하고 추가 수익을 올릴 수 있습니다.

title: Sector Unknown - Prologue
description:
게임 정보
Sector Unknown - Prologue is a free introductory version of the full-game Sector Unknown.
Sector Unknown - Prologue is an immersive isometric RPG that draws inspiration from classics like Fallout 2, Knights of the Old Republic, Fallout: New Vegas, as well as more modern titles such as Wasteland 3, Encased, Colony Ship, Trudograd, and Pathfinder: Kingmaker. Every decision, every nuance in character development has tangible consequences. Alongside combat, the game equally emphasizes alternative strategies for progression, inviting players to leverage their character's unique abilities to navigate through the narrative creatively and diplomatically.
Story
In Sector Unknown - Prologue, your saga begins as a prisoner aboard a transport ship from which you escape in a commandeered escape pod, crash-landing on Maku, a forsaken world veiled within a remote and uncharted region of space. This planet becomes the foundation of your odyssey as you convert it into a stronghold and base of operations. From there, you will set forth into space, exploring distinct worlds and locations, each teeming with its own factions and unique stories.
In your quest, you will confront the shadowy dealings of Star Frontier, the powerful trading corporation that once imprisoned you. Operating unchecked in the hidden 'null sector'—now absent from all official star charts—Star Frontier has established a tyrannical reign of terror and destruction. Your mission becomes to unite the sector's backwater and forsaken planets, through either force or diplomacy, and overthrow their oppressive rule once and for all.

title: Night Club Simulator
description:
게임 정보
낡고 버려진 장소를 인수하여 국가에서 가장 인기 있는 나이트클럽으로 탈바꿈하세요. 이 모험에서 플레이어는 공간의 모든 구석을 리모델링하고 업그레이드하며 확장하여 나이트라이프의 정점에 도달합니다. 그러나 그것은 쉽지 않을 것입니다. 문제 많은 고객을 관리하면서 클럽의 명성을 유지해야 합니다. 이 게임은 단순한 나이트클럽 시뮬레이터가 아니라 전략, 창의성, 혼란의 여정을 친구들과 함께 경험하는 것입니다.
장소 디자인부터 고객 관계까지, 우리는 당신을 나이트라이프의 혼돈과 흥분 속으로 빠져들게 하는 역동적인 분위기를 제공합니다. 당신만의 클럽 스타일과 분위기를 만들고, 장소를 맞춤 설정하며 나이트라이프 장면에 당신의 흔적을 남기세요. 모던한 디자인으로 클럽을 장식하거나 향수를 불러일으키는 요소를 추가하고 싶든, 선택은 전적으로 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
당신이 플레이하게 될 협동 시뮬레이션 장르에서 최고의 그래픽. Unreal Engine 5로 개발되었습니다.
더 몰입감 있는 경험을 제공하는 역동적인 고객 AI 행동과 자발적인 이벤트.

title: Love Curse: Find Your Soulmate
description:
게임 정보
Story
You’re entering your junior year of college. Your first two years went by quickly— You were an average college student, living an average college life. However, after almost getting hit by a car, you meet a mysterious woman who says you’ll die if you don’t find your soulmate soon! Now you have to juggle school, work, and your impending doom?!
Fate works in mysterious ways. You bump into your childhood best friend who you haven’t seen in years. Your friend’s sister takes a keen interest in you. The senior you occasionally bump into helps you get an internship. And even the CEO at your new job seems to have her eyes on you…
Who will be your soulmate, and who holds a hidden vendetta against you? In this twisted, passionate game of emotions, what will come to light? Love, possessiveness, manipulation, and obsession swirl together… Will you discover the truth behind it all?
Characters
Selene Yan (*First name can be customized)
A junior at Ocean City University. You’re a soft and sweet person with a big heart who’s always willing to stand up for what they believe in. Kind and empathetic, your caring nature is adored by those around you.

title: MotoGP25
description:
게임 정보
MotoGP™25에 참가하세요!
2025 시즌의 모든 디테일을 느껴보세요
공식 챔피언십에 참가하고 좋아하는 라이더들과 함께 경쟁하면서 유명한 바이크와 시즌 트랙을 마스터하세요. 언리얼 엔진 5, 공정한 전투를 보장하는 MotoGP™ Stewards, 공식 바이크를 현장에서 녹음하여 개선한 사운드 디자인을 통해 가장 사실적인 경주의 스릴을 경험하세요.
레이싱 유산을 만들어가세요
MotoGP™ Legend가 되는 길은 여기에서부터 시작됩니다! 바이크의 진화 속으로 뛰어들고, 시즌 중에 자신만의 커리어 Turning Point를 선택하고, 트랙 밖에서 사회적 관계를 쌓으세요. 그리고 이런 다양한 선택이 주말 동안 어떻게 진화해 나가는지 직접 확인하세요. 라이더 마켓의 분위기를 익히고 항상 개성 넘치는 여정을 만들어가세요.
실력을 키우세요
커리어 및 퀵 모드에서 이용할 수 있는 새로운 Race Off 규칙을 통해 챔피언이 되는 법을 배우세요. 2개의 오리지널 환경에 펼쳐져 있는 4개의 전용 트랙에서 Motard, Flat Track, Minibike 바이크를 타고 질주하세요. 일리미네이션과 릴레이 레이스 같은 챌린지에 도전하고, 라이더의 신체 능력을 끌어올리고, 액세서리를 잠금 해제하고, 스킬을 날카롭게 다듬어서 트랙을 지배하세요!
자신만의 길을 질주하세요
끝없는 플레이, 아니면 풀 시뮬레이션 챌린지? 새로운 Arcade 경험을 통해 즉시 아드레날린이 솟구치는 재미를 느끼세요. 아니면 Pro 경험에서 트랙의 모든 세밀한 정보, 연료 소비량, 전자 장치를 마스터하면서 실감 나는 MotoGP™의 세계를 체험하세요! 적응형 난이도 모드, 신경 지원 시스템, 새로운 튜토리얼을 통해 바이크를 완벽하게 조종하세요.
현장을 장악하세요
랭킹 레이스와 완벽한 크로스 플레이를 통해 자신이 속한 플랫폼*에 상관없이 비슷한 스킬을 가진 친구 및 상대에게 도전할 수 있습니다. 게임 내 에디터를 통해 창의력을 발휘하고 온 세상에 자신만의 개성을 표출하세요.
*Nintendo Switch 제외

title: Domovoy
description:
게임 정보
In the game "Domovoy" you will have to dive into a seemingly ordinary apartment, but the further you go, the more HE reveals his essence. This horror game is a first-person walking simulator with a tense atmosphere, explore the apartment, find answers and move on. Are you ready to meet HIM?
Domovoy is not only a guardian of the hearth, but also a vengeful spirit. If ignored or disrespected, it can turn against the owners.

title: Retreat
description:
게임 정보

This is a cooperative first-person psychological horror game. You are a test subject in a series of inhuman experiments conducted by an unknown organization. How much time have you already spent in this cold cell? Perhaps the moment has come to break out of captivity, overcome your fears and escape from this horror. Open the door to the unknown, join forces with your fellow prisoners and together try to find a way out of this nightmare. Only you are able to regain your freedom and put an end to these crazy experiments.



Explore the mysteries of the abandoned laboratory with your friends.



Your task is to get out of this creepy place, taking advantage of all possible resources, using limited ammunition.

-Collaborative online play for 2-4 players
-Voice chat
-Walking simulator
-High quality sounds
-Realistic graphics

title: Laundry Simulator : PowerWash It!
description:
게임 정보
"세탁소 시뮬레이터"는 분주하고 도전적인 세탁 사업의 세계에서 자신의 사업을 운영할 수 있는 경험을 제공합니다. 부티크 세탁소의 주인으로서 일반 옷부터 고급 의류까지 다양한 세탁 요구를 처리하고 세탁 관련 제품도 판매할 수 있습니다. 시간과 자원을 현명하게 관리하고, 장비를 업그레이드하며, 매장 레이아웃을 최적화하고, 우수한 서비스를 제공하여 더 많은 고객을 유치하세요.

고객이 가져온 더러운 빨래를 하나씩 세탁바구니에 넣고 세탁기에 넣어야 합니다. 세탁된 옷은 건조되어야 하며, 이는 품질과 고객 만족도를 보장합니다.




세탁소에서 세탁 서비스뿐만 아니라 세탁 관련 제품도 판매할 수 있습니다. 제품을 신중하게 선택하고, 합리적인 가격을 설정한 후 진열대에 배치하여 고객의 구매를 유도하세요.

title: House of Lost Souls
description:
게임 정보
스토리: 오래 전 사건 이후 잭은 부모님의 집으로 돌아왔고, 지금은 자신의 집이 되었습니다. 어렸을 때 보았던 기억이 그를 잠 못 이루게 했고, 그는 과거를 다시 돌아보기로 결심했습니다.
눈앞에서 부모님이 살해당한 집이 그를 부르는 것 같았습니다. 그 집은 잭의 고통을 먹어치우고 그를 미치게 만들었습니다. 하지만 시간이 지날수록 고통은 가라앉지 않고 점점 더 심해졌습니다. 잭은 마침내 내면의 고통을 진정시킬 해답을 찾고 싶었습니다.
주요 게임 플레이는 주인공인 잭의 과거를 다루고 있습니다. 잭은 어린 시절에 목격했던 사건들을 재현합니다. 잭이 집에 오래 머무를수록 기억을 더 깊이 파고들어 아버지와 관련된 미스터리를 푸는 데 가까워집니다.

title: Private Military Manager: Tactical Auto Battler
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 1990년대 남미의 코르디비아에 터를 잡은 용병회사의 사장입니다.

title: Icaria
description:
게임 정보
Automate a team of robots to gather resources, reshape terrain, and scale up factories on a procedurally generated alien world.
Explore a procedural world
Every game you are exploring a different planet, with a different set of resources and biomes that present unique challenge. You start able to only see a small area, but as you progress you build out a radio network and unlock more of the world.
Collect resources
Expanding your colony requires ever increasing quantity of resources. Luckily, the planet you're on is ripe with them to find and use.

title: 9 Kings
description:
게임 정보
수도를 건설하라



당신의 도시를 가장 강력한 왕국으로 만들어보세요. 건물, 부대, 마법, 배치의 무한한 조합을 통해 게임의 규칙을 깨고 압도적인 힘을 손에 넣는 방법을 찾아보세요. 전략적으로 왕국을 성장시키고 수많은 독특한 이벤트에 대비하여 당신의 왕국이 다른 어떤 왕국보다 오래 지속될 수 있음을 세계에 보여주세요.
왕국을 지켜라



당신의 부대와 방어 시설, 그리고 성의 힘을 활용하여 어떤 침략자도 당신의 도시에 접근하지 못하도록 막아보세요.



특별한 카드를 모으고 독특한 특전을 얻어 게임 플레이 방식을 완전히 바꿔보세요.

카드를 무한한 방법으로 조합해보세요. 다른 왕들과 외교를 펼치고, 상식을 뛰어넘는 구성을 시도하며, 대군이 당신의 왕관을 위해 싸우는 모습을 지켜보세요. 가능한 한 오래 생존하여 게임의 규칙을 깨뜨릴 수 있음을 증명하세요.

title: Caravanners: Co-op Open World Camping
description:
게임 정보
돈을 벌고 꿈의 캐러밴을 처음부터 만들어보세요!
완벽하게 맞춤화된 캐러밴으로 자유롭게 여행하고 캠핑하세요.
