title: Metrogether Train Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Metrogether is a train simulator where you drive, collect passengers, work together with friends and explore the subway network in a fictional city. Embark on your journey as a train driver or ticket inspector in single and multiplayer.
Drive Trains
Take control of a subway train, try to follow the timetable and collect passengers as you travel from station to station in this immersive subway simulation.
Explore the Subway Network
Immerse yourself in this fictional subway network, filled with tunnels, bustling stations, and hidden secrets.
Play as a Ticket Inspector
Step into the shoes of a vigilant ticket inspector, ensuring that passengers have valid tickets and deal with troublemakers during the journey.

title: Crime Scene Technician
description:
게임 정보


When the world awakens to life, it discovers the terrible deeds of the night. As a criminal department technician, you will find yourself a regular visitor to scenes of crime, gathering evidence for analysis and skillfully combining the facts - necessary steps for apprehending a suspect.




While the task at hand might seem overwhelming, do not fret - you’re not alone, accompanied by plenty of companions in the form of various tools.
Thanks to the ultraviolet lamp, you will see what’s hidden in the light of day. Test the collected samples in a well-equipped laboratory and recover damaged files or identify fingerprints with the help of advanced software.




Keep in mind, however, that the specialized equipment will be worthless without the most important tool - you! Be perceptive and inquisitive, spotting clues overlooked by others, finding patterns and similarities. Then, once gathered, connect the dots with a line that will lead you towards the truth.




Finish the job by putting the right person behind bars, but that’s not the end! Each day streets are filled with a sordid cast of characters, just waiting for an opportunity to strike. Clear the city of criminals and become a legend in your trade thanks to Crime Scene Technician!

title: Necrophosis
description:
게임 정보
Necrophosis invites you to immerse yourself in a mystical puzzle adventure set in a surreal universe, the environment itself becomes a nightmarish masterpiece, filled with unsettling shapes and haunting visuals.


A MA·CA·BRE WORLD
Billions of years after the universe met its demise, you awaken in a realm where death reigns supreme but even death may die.
Necrophosis, the curse that plagues this world, inflicts decay upon everything it touches. Here, amidst a landscape crafted with meticulous care, dread and decay permeate every corner. The characters of this world, infected by the curse, embody the very essence of decay.

With every turn you take and every sigh that escapes your lips, you bear witness to the relentless touch of decay. Necrophosis weaves its grim tapestry, enveloping you in a haunting journey through a macabre world where death is not an end, but a pervasive reality.




In Necrophosis, visuals are just the surface of a deep, immersive experience. Delve into a world where every element is steeped in a rich backstory, where each step forward unveils a new layer of mystery. As you progress, you'll encounter mechanics that challenge your wit, each puzzle a piece of a larger, enigmatic narrative.
Prepare for a journey of discovery and introspection, where every event is a unique encounter, and each solution leads to deeper revelations. Whether through haunting narrations or evocative poetry, Necrophosis weaves a slow burn of intrigue, drawing you into its captivating tale with every twist and turn.

title: Castle Craft
description:
게임 정보
한없는 창의력과 혼돈이 지배하는 QubiQuest: Castle Craft에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 뭐든 파괴할 수 있는 복셀 세계에, 거대한 성채를 세울 수 있는 대규모 공성전 시뮬레이션 게임에 빠져드세요.
경제력을 키우세요. 정신없는 난장판에 재밌는 물리 효과를 끼얹은 대격전을 벌이세요. 독특한 적들의 끝없는 물량 공세에서 성을 지켜내세요.
Castle Craft는 복셀 샌드박스의 재미와 박진감 넘치는 게임플레이와 정신 나간 물량 디펜스를 한데 버무린 궁극의 역작입니다.
Castle Craft에서는 성주가 되어서 꿈의 성을 세울 수 있습니다! 아마도요.
당신은 존경받고 공경받는 데비미우스 전하의 오른팔입니다. 국왕 전하께서 친히 이르시길, “일은 경이 하게. 칭송은 짐이 받을 테니."
계속 진화하는 적 떼거리가 끝없이 몰려와서 꿈의 성에 끊임없이 몸을 던질 겁니다. 없는 것 빼고는 다 있는 온갖 함정과 장치를 조합해서 살상력을 극대화할 수 있어서 망정이죠!

title: MATCHO
description:
게임 정보


Start your new epic journey in MATCHO with Max and his friends as he tackles a mysterious alien invasion that could lead to curing his illness and saving the Earth.

MATCHO is bringing puzzles into the combat. It‘s Match-3 FPS - a unique combination of genres that merges frenetic shooting with quick decision-making. Explore story-driven chapters as you choose destiny for Max, his friends, and the rest of the world. Fight in action-packed arenas like never before and explore intricate areas –⁠ all that with breathtaking visuals and an insane arsenal of abilities including the freedom of parkour movement.

This is a full-featured indie videogame developed with love by a small group of friends and developers from the Czech Republic. And it‘s FPS like you've never experienced before.



Navigate through a series of exciting platforming sections, solve ingenious puzzles and talk with many lovable characters you'll encounter as Max. MATCHO is our own take on a modern superhero story, with breathtaking visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5.
Main features:
Intense and clever tactical fighting built around the match-3 shooter concept.
Dazzling visuals powered by Unreal Engine.
A non-linear, humor-packed plot with multiple endings.
An extensive, built-in parkour system lets you wall-run, double-jump, float and dash in any direction.

title: Brassheart
description:
게임 정보
ADVENTURE SPARKED BY INVENTION!


Brassheart is a Point & Click adventure game set in the alternative 1920s, inspired by the dieselpunk aesthetics and the classics of the genre.

In the world of Brassheart, you play as Pola Zagórska, a smart and chipper aeroplane pilot. She follows the clues that may provide a way to save her father kidnapped by his own invention, a rebellious supermachine, Valkiria. This powerful difference engine gathered loyal army and relentlessly pursues the goal of mechanizing and militarizing the whole world. It is governed by cold calculation, and all those who oppose it will be in danger. One of such people was Prof. Zagórski, the co-creator of the machine. Before the kidnapping, however, he managed to give his daughter a clue about defeating the Valkiria. The key to stopping the machine's domination may be a mysterious invention called ‘Brassheart' that affects her will.

Pola has to set off on a journey and find parts of the mechanical heart scattered all over the world, for they are her only chance to stop the sinister machine, end the era of mechanical terror and save her father.
DISCOVER THE WORLD OF BRASSHEART
Embark on an exciting adventure around the world and visit places like a village in the Himalayas or palaces in Europe, filled with great industrial machines and opulent interiors. Admire many meticulously designed 2D locations and a unique graphic style inspired by dieselpunk and cartoons.

Welcome in the alternative reality of 1920s, the age of global turmoil and brilliant technologies born out of science and creativity. Get to know fantastic inventions of this peculiar world, such as sprawling networks of engines, antigravity generators or automatons, all created under the watchful eye of the immense computing power: Valkiria.

Follow Pola’s steps in her quest against the immeasurable power of Valkiria. Put in such a plight and filled with doubt, her close relationships with friends and family will drive her to embark on a dangerous adventure around the world. With your support and help from her trusty companions: mechanic Manfred, artist Tamara and automaton Pascal, Pola will have to unearth her father’s enigmatic inventions and outsmart the malevolent machine.

On your way you will meet a lot of interesting figures: barons and countesses entangled in high-society intrigues, spies, criminals, adventurers and inventors. Get tangled up in crazy conundrums, permeated with humor and requiring extraordinary solutions.
You’ll have a chance to utilize some crazy inventions in this twisted timeline: lasers, robots, airships, giant levitating statues and more! Fix mechanisms, solve puzzles and come up with creative solutions to head-scratching problems. Your companion on the journey, automaton Pascal is ready to offer you helpful hints at any time!
Take a journey to the world of Brassheart and feel the vibe of genre classics through experiencing cartoonish, colorful art-style, coming up with the crazy MacGyver-esque solutions and finding yourself in extraordinary situations permeated with humor. At the same time enjoy puzzles grounded in commonsensical logic without pixel hunting along the way.

title: Eternal Rising
description:
게임 정보
영원한 루프가 시작되며, 매번 새로운 도전이 기다리고 있습니다. Eternal Rising은 로그라이크와 탄막 슈팅이 결합된 게임으로, 끊임없이 몰려오는 적들과 맞서 싸워야 합니다. 전진하는 것만이 유일한 선택이며, 앞을 가로막는 모든 것을 제거하세요. 죽음은 피할 수 없지만, 새로운 시도마다 더 강해지며 영원한 생명의 도전에 다시 맞설 준비가 됩니다.


코인과 경험치 오브를 모아 강력한 무기, 유물, 그리고 강화된 스킬을 획득하여 적들을 압도하세요!


Eternal Rising에서는 승리 아니면 패배뿐입니다. 다양한 전략을 활용하여 적들을 제압하고, 이 가혹한 로그라이크에서 승리를 쟁취하세요!


가디언 보스를 처치하고 다음 세계로 향하는 길을 여세요. 장대한 전투를 준비하고, Eternal Rising의 미지의 영역을 개척하세요!

title: PLATiNA :: LAB
description:
게임 정보
데이터의 세계는 언제나 예측불허
말랑말랑 DB들과 함께하는 리듬 플레이!
'PLATiNA :: LAB'은 전통적인 노트 낙하형(Top-Down) 플레이 방식으로 즐기는 리듬 게임입니다.
다양한 장르의 악곡을 연주하고 개성 넘치는 DB(캐릭터)들과 교감하며
'PLATiNA :: LAB'만의 특별한 매력을 느껴 보세요.
● 누구나 재미있게 즐길 수 있는 플레이 방식
초보자부터 숙련자까지 각자의 실력에 맞는 방식으로 다양하게 즐길 수 있습니다.
4LINES · 6LINES로 구분되는 두 가지 연주 방식은
비슷해 보이지만 각각 색다른 즐거움을 선보입니다.
또한 각 모드에서는 특수 패턴이 등장하는 PLUS 패턴을 통해
더욱 깊이 있는 플레이를 경험할 수 있습니다.
곡의 리듬에 맞춰 패턴을 연주하여 더 좋은 성과로 플레이를 완성해 보세요.
● 다양한 플레이어의 취향을 만족시키는 악곡
국내외에서 잘 알려진 게임과 애니메이션의 수록곡부터
다양한 리듬 게임에서 활발하게 활동 중인 유명 아티스트의 인기 악곡과 함께,
'PLATiNA :: LAB'에서만 즐기실 수 있는 다채로운 오리지널 악곡도 준비되어 있습니다.
여러 리듬 게임을 두루 즐겨본 매니아는 물론, 리듬 게임을 즐겨본 적이 없는 분들도 즐겁게 플레이할 수 있습니다.

title: Cosmobreeder Yiffai
description:
게임 정보
In an age of faster-than-light travel and advanced cyber-robotics, brave explorers known as Cosmobreeders travel to forgotten worlds and study alien creatures.
Play as a lone Cosmobreeder shot down over Planet Tutone, a world fallen to ruin and haunted by ancient betrayal. Your comrades have been captured, your equipment stolen. Armed with only your wits, traverse ancient service tunnels, eerie alien forests, and deep volcanic caverns. Reclaim your gear, uncover alien artifacts, and awaken mysterious ESPer abilities to survive the planet’s numerous dangers.
Navigate hundreds of intricate rooms, in which fragile walls hide secrets and hidden paths reward the curious. Battle dozens of unique foes and conquer epic bosses, each victory granting new abilities and allowing you to delve deeper into Tutone.

title: Anomaly Bus
description:
게임 정보
ANOMALY BUS
A Soviet-Era Psychological Horror Where the Route Never Ends...
The year is 1991. You board a rickety bus in a forgotten Soviet village, heading home after another bleak day. But something’s wrong. The same station keeps appearing—or does it? The signs are familiar, the streets look identical… yet something lurks in the gaps of your memory.
Will you escape the loop? Or become its next passenger?
Inspired by The Exit 8 and I’m On Observation Duty, Anomaly Bus blends memory-based horror with paranormal dread. Observe. Remember. Survive.
GAMEPLAY
RIDE THE BUS HOME… OR... BECOME FOREVER PASSENGER
Board only the normal buses—the ones matching your memory of Station 1.
If something feels off, skip it. Your life depends on attention, not speed.
HIDDEN IN PLAIN SIGHT
Anomalies aren’t subtle… but they’re easy to miss if you’re careless.
A flickering light. A missing poster. A passenger who wasn’t there before. Scratching on the windows. Ghost driver and more...
NO CHEAP SCARES—JUST PURE DREAD
No cheap jumpscares… you have to spot the anomaly...
The horror builds as the loop tightens. What’s waiting at the final stop?
SMALL BUS, ENDLESS TERROR
The bus is cramped, but anomalies shift with every ride.
Randomization ensures no two playthroughs are the same.
IMMERSE YOURSELF
Memory Over Reflexes – Patience is your greatest weapon.
Headphones Highly Recommended – The creaks, whispers, and distant Soviet radio static will haunt you.
Average Single Playtime: 1 – 3 Hours – A tight, chilling experience with high replayability.

title: A Weekend Trip
description:
게임 정보
Play as River as they have a trip over the weekend with their friends. Choose what River does during the trip. Will they hang out with their friends? Will they explore the cabin? Or will they choose to just let the trip pass by as quickly as possible.
Features:
- point-and-click gameplay
- choose how River talks to their friends
- choose how River reacts to their surroundings
- simple puzzles
- hand drawn sprites and backgrounds
- atmospheric and ambient music

title: gogh: Focus with Your Avatar
description:
게임 정보
gogh: Focus with Your Avatar 는 아바타&방 꾸미기, 육성 게임, 작업 집중 뽀모도로 타이머가 합쳐진 작업용 게임입니다. 좋아하는 것에 둘러싸인 방, 로파이 비트와 아름다운 환경 소리, 작업을 함께하는 귀여운 아바타와 성장하는 신기한 캐릭터가 당신의 공부와 작업을 더욱 즐겁게 해줍니다.
나만의 공간
가구와 소품을 자유자재로 배치하여 색상 변경이 가능한 압도적인 자유도의 방 꾸미기 모니터나 포스터, 레코드 등등, 자신이 좋아하는 이미지나 GIF를 붙여서 자신만의 개성을 살려보세요. 열심히 꾸민 여러 방을 저장해서, 기분에 맞추어 작업 환경을 바꿀수 있습니다.
귀여운 애니메이션 스타일의 아바타
다향한 얼굴, 헤어스타일, 패션으로 당신과 작업을 함께하는 아바타를 자유롭게 꾸며보세요. 아바타를 의자, 침대, 바닥 등 원하는 장소로 이동시키고 아바타 애니메이션을 선택해 봅시다. 그리고 뽀모도로 타이머의 연동이나, 아바타 타이핑 소리 등의 기분 좋은 작업음이 함께 공부하는 감각을 높여줍니다.

title: Veloria: The Knot of Candles
description:
게임 정보
벨로리아의 촛꽃
벨로리아의 촛꽃은 퍼즐과 레벨 디자인, 강렬한 비주얼과 음악을 결합한 혁신적인 호러 퍼즐 게임입니다.
인간의 정신 질환이라는 가혹한 현실과 마주하며, 심리적 깊이와 공포 요소가 뒤엉키는 이야기.
어둠과 절망 속에서 살아남기 위한 몸부림, 겉모습과 내면의 진실을 탐색하는 과정.
스토리 개요
플레이어는 심각한 정신 질환을 앓고 있는 소녀 벨로리아가 되어, 어린 시절의 악몽 같은 기억을 통해 진실을 찾고 구원을 구하게 됩니다.
게임은 여섯 개의 장으로 나뉘며, 여섯 명의 인물의 이야기를 통해 암울하고 비극적인 이야기가 전개됩니다.
플레이어는 손수 충격적인 진실을 밝혀내야 합니다.
벨로리아는 으스스한 고아원의 문 앞에서 깨어납니다.
타버린 재가 공기 중을 떠다니며, 잊힌 비밀을 드러냅니다. 실제 고아원은 수년 전 화재로 소실되었습니다.
지금 남아 있는 것은 기억의 조각들로 만들어진 기묘한 세계.
진실을 찾기 위해, 그녀는 그 불길한 세계의 문을 엽니다.
이 건물 안은 기괴한 어둠에 뒤덮여 있으며, 오직 촛불의 희미한 빛만이 발밑의 길을 밝혀줍니다…
등장인물
autokwd: Veloria: The Knot of Candles,비라리아의 촛불꽃

title: TaskTwist
description:
게임 정보
Your to-do list just got electrifying.
Charge devices, water plants, or tidy up—but this house and garden are packed with peril . Sparks, faulty cords, and sneaky traps lurk in every corner. Will you survive?

Pick Your Playstyle:
Adventure Mode: Roam freely, dodge hazards, and enjoy the journey.
Speedrun Mode: Compete on leaderboards for the fastest cleanup!
Why Play?
For Everyone: Tackle chores casually or race for the high score—your choice!
Electrifying Hazards: Dodge rogue appliances, frayed wires, and wet zones—all while keeping your sanity
Hidden Risks in Every Corner: Explore every room and yard in a charming, danger-filled world.
“This isn’t a chore—it’s an obstacle course!”
Dive in and turn mundane tasks into electrifying adventures!

title: Leap by Franklin Burnett
description:
게임 정보
...you Leap...
You stand at the bottom of a pit, a lone figure... Above you, only ledges, cliffs, and the long, punishing climb to the summit.  With a single Leap, you begin your ascent.
...you Leap...
Every Leap is a decision.  Every Leap is a chance at progress.  Every fall… is a lesson in despair.  No mercy.  Just you, gravity, and the relentless pull of failure.  One misplaced Leap, and you plummet—losing minutes, hours, maybe even your sanity.
...you Leap...
Like Sisyphus condemned to roll his boulder, you will climb again and again, knowing the pit owes you nothing.  Yet something within you refuses to quit. Is it hope?  Stubbornness?  Or just madness creeping in?
...you Leap...
Gameplay:
-High Stakes Platforming!
The higher you climb, the closer to victory.  But also the farther you will fall!

-Simple Controls!
Hold Space to charge and then release it to LEAP.

-Think Before you LEAP!
Every LEAP requires much patience and thought, DON'T RUSH IT! Or you will certainly fall back to the bottom...
Features:
LEAP is a simple to control game where you climb to the top only by LEAPing into the air.
The higher you jump, the harder you fall
You can enable checkpoints, which you can teleport back to.
Extremely difficult but addictive gameplay
50 brutal floors.
Built in speed running timer
Practice mode.

title: StarVaders
description:
게임 정보


죽여 첨탑의 융합,위반에,그리고 공간 침략자,스타 베이더는 그리드 기반의 전술 카드 전투의 불량 라이트 캠페인에 외계인 침략자의 떼를 싸울 메카 갑옷을 조종하는 스릴 턴 기반 전략 게임이다.

당신이 당신의 언어로이 게임을보고 싶다면 위시리스트하시기 바랍니다! 우리는 번역 할 언어를 결정하기 위해 위시리스트 통계를 볼 것이다!



복잡한 그리드 기반 전술을 마스터하십시오!

title: Moroi
description:
게임 정보
Moroi is set within the Cosmic Engine, a personalized hellscape designed to distort any semblance of normalcy. Truth is an illusion, paranoia is constant, and your humanity is an oddity.

You awake to find yourself a prisoner within a living nightmare. Your name, your past: gone, but not the record of your misdeeds. Your crimes: beyond comprehension. Your conviction: incontestable. Your sentence: eternal. The need to escape and set things right: undeniable.


Fight your way out of a living, twisting labyrinth. Hone your skills as you take on dynamic combat encounters and absurd puzzles. Meet the Cosmic Engine’s most disturbing and grotesque inhabitants, all with unique and nonsensical personalities, who are just as likely to aid in your quest as they are to deceive you.

Escape means freedom, and in freedom, the truth.
Descend through the surreal, twisting Spire as you recover from amnesia and slowly discover the morbid truth about your past and your hostile surroundings. Cling to your sanity as the very fabric of reality is unraveled before your eyes.

title: Dark Pact
description:
게임 정보
적의 위치를 조작하고 지형을 활용하여 전투에서 우위를 점하세요. 이 창의성 중심의 전술 턴제 전략 게임에서는 수치 계산보다 기발한 콤보로 압도적인 적을 물리치는 것이 핵심입니다.
전략적 학살이 기다린다
Into the Breach에 정식 캠페인이 있었다면 어땠을까요? 그 질문이 바로 Dark Pact의 탄생을 이끌었습니다. 이 게임은 여러분의 전략적 능력을 한계까지 시험하면서도, 매력적이고 스토리 중심의 경험을 제공합니다. Fire Emblem, Advance Wars, Into the Breach에서 영감을 받아 탄생한 Dark Pact는 이 전설적인 타이틀들과 어깨를 나란히 하려 합니다. 과연 성공했을까요? 데모를 플레이해 직접 확인해 보세요!
강력한 능력을 마스터하세요
승리는 단순히 피해를 주는 것만으로 이루어지지 않습니다—핵심은 제어입니다. Dark Pact의 능력은 강력한 피해뿐 아니라, 밀치고, 끌어당기고, 도발하고, 교란하여 전장을 끊임없이 변화시킵니다. 창의력이 생존의 열쇠입니다.
대지 가르기 – 일직선으로 피해를 주고 인접한 유닛을 밀쳐냅니다.

title: New Life
description:
게임 정보


Immerse yourself in the dark adventure of a guy who suffers from depression and feels guilty. He never takes off his hood and always keeps his hands in his pockets. Michael became disillusioned with life and decided to try to start his life over. To do this, he left the metropolis and a successful career, sold the house he inherited, and moved to the other side of the country to forget the mistakes made in the past. But is it possible to escape from your past?

Unravel the sinister secrets of your neighbors to find the truth hidden by the veil of darkness, and also help Michael get rid of guilt, overcome depression and start a new, happy life.


Enjoy this exciting and intense story through the eyes of Michael, a young man haunted by nightmares
Help Michael get rid of guilt, overcome depression and start a new happy life
Explore, interact with your surroundings... and come face to face with your fears.

In this adventure game, you will interact with Michael's life. In addition to the obvious plot, you can find many hidden details, secrets and tasks that will reveal the plot more, tell neighborly secrets and help Michael cope with his past, which haunts him. But to reveal the whole plot completely, you will have to be attentive and seriously invoke a bit of head-scratching

title: Cataclysm Wars
description:
게임 정보
The Empire is under attack, and only its mighty armies can save it! Shame you aren't in charge of those, then. Lead an outmatched militia through overwhelming odds in this turn-based strategy game, and save your nation from collapse - and perhaps even an apocalypse. Or, lead the dogged Syrinx foe and crush the Empire thoroughly!

An Empire At War
Caught in the surprise attack of the Syrinx Kingdom, your militia will have to fight desperately to hold its own and give army troops time to fight back. Lead your forces through 9 missions as the Commander of the Carcasier Militia, and hold back the tide.

A Kingdom On The Offense
Alternatively, take the role of the dreaded owl menace and execute a daring assault upon the Empire. Execute your battleplan through 5 missions as leading officer of the forces of the Syrinx Kingdom, and bring the humans to their knees!

A Classic Experience
Upgrade your troops through your campaign, read about the situation at hand through narrative events, and take in the details of the world of Cataclysm Wars through its encyclopedia.

Homebrewed to Completion
Cataclysm Wars is based on a "homemade" tabletop role playing game which has been in constant development for half a decade. It is a world of fading magic and gunpowder, dragons and humanoid owls. It is also a world that has grown over half a decade, with well-explored adventures and fleshed-out characters that now inform the setting of Cataclysm Wars.

title: Skin Deep
description:
게임 정보
Skin Deep은 몰입감 넘치는 1인칭 슈팅 게임입니다. 플레이어는 재채기를 하고 뾰족한 물건을 밟으면 발이 다칩니다. 광대한 비선형 우주선을 잠입하여 파괴 공작을 펼치고, 적들을 방해하여 이 우주의 샌드박스에서 생존해 보세요. 플레이어는 수적으로 열세이며, 화력도 적보다 약하고, 신발도 없습니다.

숨쉬고 살아있는 보험증권
보험회사가 귀중품을 안전하게 보관하고 싶을 때는 플레이어를 얼려서 화물 우주선에 실어 둡니다.

그리고 우주 해적들이 우주선에 탑승해 무음 경보를 발동시키면, 플레이어는 마음을 가다듬고 심호흡을 한 다음, 상황을 처리합니다.

행운을 빕니다, 요원님.

title: All Whispering Tome
description:
게임 정보
All Whispering Tome is a captivating reading game where you explore a vast library of untold tales. Within its weathered pages lie stories whispered through time and space, both prophecies of futures yet to unfold and echoes of forgotten pasts.

As the reader, you embark on a captivating odyssey of discovery, where each turn of the page unlocks a new narrative tapestry. As you decipher these stories, the narratives evolve, even the words may or may not shift before your eyes. All the hints are hidden within the ever-evolving nature of these stories.

Lose yourself in these mesmerizing tales and uncover the stories beyond the stories in the All Whispering Tome.
Gameplay
Read the books and look for anything unusual. The definition of unusual may vary from story to story. Also be careful to notice any changes in the stories you've already read. The All Whispering Tome may or may not change shape and content before your eyes in any moment. You must read carefully to uncover the stories beyond the stories.

title: Wool at the Gates
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 점점 더 어려워지는 일련의 라운드에 걸쳐 도시를 건설하여 침략하는 양떼로부터 도시를 방어하는 전략 게임입니다. 인간, 오크, 엘프가 함께 양떼가 도시를 점령하는 것을 막기 위해 싸워야 합니다. 각 라운드에서 살아남기 위해 경제와 방어의 균형을 신중하게 유지하세요. 건물 유형과 위치를 최적화하고 직업 유형을 쌓아 강력한 시너지 효과를 낼 수 있도록 여러 전략을 짜보세요. 진영과 병과 유형의 독특한 조합으로 레벨을 플레이하여 새로운 도전을 완료하고 보상을 획득하세요.
게임 플레이
기지 건물: 타워, 벽, 자원 생산 건물과 같은 구조물을 건설하고 업그레이드하여 경제를 성장시키고 양 무리를 방어하세요.
라운드 기반 레벨: 다음 웨이브가 시작되기 전에 각 라운드를 천천히 건설하여 레벨당 점점 더 어려워지는 일련의 라운드를 진행하세요. 
자동 전투에서 영감을 얻은 시너지 효과: 같은 클래스의 타워, 부대, 영웅 능력을 선택하면 영웅과 해당 클래스의 모든 캐릭터가 고유하게 강화됩니다.
진영이 연합합니다: 도시를 건설할 때 휴먼, 오크, 엘프를 조합하여 각 진영의 고유한 특전을 얻으세요.
영웅 또는 신: 영웅 형태로 병력과 함께 싸우거나 하늘을 나는 눈동자로 변신하여 빠르게 전장을 가로지르세요. 레벨을 진행하면서 새로운 영웅 능력을 선택하세요.

title: Conquest Dark
description:
게임 정보
검은 행성이 도착한 지 237년 후, 인류는 멸망 직전에 서 있습니다. 언데드 군대는 인류의 왕국을 황폐화시켰고, 우주의 신들은 무너졌으며, 태고의 존재들은 오랜 잠에서 깨어났습니다. 이제 용사들과 범죄자들 모두 문명을 무릎 꿇린 바로 그 세력에 맞서기 위해 어둠의 의식을 거행합니다.
어둠의 의식을 마스터하세요
우주적 공포와 태초의 흉포함이 만나는 무시무시한 환경으로 모험을 떠나세요. 길들여지지 않은 사자의 야만 전사, 신성한 맹세 수호자, 신비한 쿠의 수행자 등 저마다 어둠에 맞서는 고유 능력을 지닌 전설 클래스 중에서 나아갈 길을 선택하세요.
즉각적인 액션 RPG의 희열을 만끽하세요
치열한 의식 공략을 통해 강력한 판타지를 해제하세요. 미약한 호흡으로 시작해서 성장해 나가며 파괴적인 빌드를 발견하세요. 모든 의식은 보람찬 진척도를 제공하여, 농축된 형태의 ARPG의 성장 곡선을 확인할 수 있습니다. 의식을 공략할 때마다 전설 상태에 가까워집니다.
신을 처단하는 빌드를 구성하세요
기괴한 능력을 발견하고, 전설적인 갑옷을 장착하고, 타락한 용사의 독특한 무기를 휘두르세요. 무기고를 강화하고 신을 죽일 만한 빌드를 제작하세요. 심도 있는 커스터마이징과 끝없는 가능성으로 신성을 갖추는 이론적인 길을 개척하세요.

title: Gloamvault
description:
게임 정보
"90s Black Metal Monster Collector"
You are a resurrected evil wizard.
Charm any monster you encounter to build up your army.
Over 500 different monsters to fight.
Use your dark magic to merge two monsters together.
Spend points to get upgrades.
Cast spells to influence the battle.
Collect items to further enhance your build.
Try to reach the depths of the dungeon... or die trying.
Each dungeon is procedurally generated, making each run unique!
Inspired by crazy build games like Path of Achra and aesthetics of old school first person dungeon crawlers like wizardry. Gloamvault combines elements from roguelikes, auto battlers, monster collectors and first person dungeon crawler!

title: Ranch Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
매력적인 마을로 들어와 당신의 기업가적 여정을 시작하세요! 작물을 키우고 농장 동물들을 돌보며, 신선한 농산물과 귀중한 상품을 수집하여 활기찬 시장에서 판매하세요. 온실, 작업장, 장식 요소로 농장을 확장하고 독특하게 꾸며보세요.
마을 주민들과 강한 관계를 형성하여 새롭고 더 나은 물품에 접근하세요. 친절한 나무꾼의 도움으로 가판대를 업그레이드하고, 작업을 간소화하기 위해 직원들을 고용하세요. 가축을 키우고 원자재를 인기 있는 상품으로 변환하세요.
농업
씨앗을 사고, 작물을 키우고, 시장에서 판매하세요. 사계절 재배가 가능하도록 농장이나 온실을 확장하세요.
작업장
고기를 손질하거나 신선한 제품을 굽고, 음료 기계를 사용해 음료를 발효시키세요. 각 도구에 대한 레시피가 제공되어 시작을 돕습니다.
가축
소, 염소, 닭을 사서 헛간에서 키우세요. 매일 먹이를 주면 우유나 계란과 같은 제품을 제공합니다.

title: KIBORG
description:
게임 정보
핏덩이 맷돌, 피와 살이 뒤엉킨 미래 전장! 반란군을 이끌고 무작위로 생성된 스테이지에서 수많은 돌연변이와 기계 군단에 맞서 싸우며 탈출을 시도하십시오! 자원을 수집하고, 동료를 모집하며, 금지된 기술을 연구하여 치열한 전투에서 살아남기 위해 모든 것을 걸어야 합니다. 이곳은 피비린내 나는 전투와 무자비한 살육만이 존재하는 곳입니다. 과연 당신은 이 도전을 받아들일 준비가 되었습니까?
당신은 지옥에서 기어 나온 무법자이며 반란군의 잔존 지도자입니다. 잊혀진 감옥 행성에서 전례 없는 재난이 모든 것을 파괴했습니다. 나노 바이러스가 행성을 침식하여 죄수들을 피에 굶주린 괴물로 변이시켰습니다.
당신은 동료들을 이끌고 시체와 피바다를 헤쳐 나가야 합니다. 이곳에는 법이 없으며, 오직 생존을 위한 싸움만이 있을 뿐입니다. 돌연변이 괴물들의 광기 어린 공격과 적대 세력의 무자비한 추격 속에서 끊임없이 싸우고 진화해야 합니다. 주먹과 칼, 총으로 이 황폐한 땅을 붉게 물들이십시오!
이 재난의 배후에 숨겨진 음모를 파헤치고, 죽어가는 이 행성을 구하십시오! 이 종말의 혼돈 속에서 당신은 인류의 가장 어두운 면모와 가장 빛나는 순간을 목격하게 될 것입니다.
이제 무기를 들어 전투에 참여하고, 절망 속에서 희망의 불씨를 밝히십시오!

title: Grey Galactic
description:
게임 정보
Grey Galactic is a real time strategy game, where you colonize planets to collect their resources and have a base to build ships. By collecting resources, improving your buildings and ships, and expanding your empire to new planets, you will use your fleet of ships to try to destroy the enemy before they can destroy you.
Strategic Real Time Battling - Build your fleet of upgradeable ships to explore, expand, and conquer! Ranging from simple ships to attack with, scout ships to explore the galaxy, and settler ships to take new planets, you can strategically position your fleet to defend your planets, and take down your enemies!
Heroic Capital Ships - The powerful Capital Ship is your secret weapon in battle, as a free moving ship that can hold other ships as a mobile base. With unique abilities to help in battle, the Capital Ship can be the ultimate force to turn the battle!
Unique Consumable Artifacts - The universe is full of mystery, and powerful artifacts from both ancient civilizations and modern science will aid you in different ways. Want to quickly spawn in an extra few ships? Maybe instantly settle a new planet? With research into these powerful items, you can use them throughout the game to become an even greater captain!
Varied and Numerous Battlefields - With a powerful map generator, Grey Galactic features both randomly generated and hand crafted systems to explore. Including planets, moons, asteroid fields, ship-destroying-voids, pirates, space stations, wormholes, and more, each battle is a unique experience!
Scenario, Campaign, and Survival Modes - In addition to Scenario maps where you'll have to overcome a unique enemy and challenging Survival games where you try to outlast the onslaught of enemies, there will also be a 3 part, story driven campaign that explores the themes and history of this universe. Learn about the tumultuous past between the human factions of the UFMC and The Skeptics, the desperate fighters of the alien faction of The Proditum, and the mysterious and incredibly dangerous Grey.

title: Racing: Storm Chase
description:
게임 정보
🚗 럭셔리 카스터마이징
독특한 성능을 가진 차량을 언락하세요! 컬러링과 튜닝으로 나만의 최강 머신을 완성해보세요.
🏁 전략적 서킷 공략
각 차량마다 장단점이 존재합니다. 트랙 지형을 분석하고 최적의 차량을 선택해 전략적으로 승리하세요!
🎮 테크닉 & 아이템 활용
드리프트, 니트로 가속... 실력의 극한을 보여주세요! 숨겨진 지름길을 발견하고 아이템 타이밍으로 역전하세요!
👥 로컬 대전 & 글로벌 랭킹
거실이 레이싱 아레나로 변신! 2인 스플릿스크린 대결. 세계 랭킹에 도전해 최고의 기록을 증명하세요!
⭐ 레전드에 도전하라
신규 차량, 트랙, 모드 지속 추가! 지금 엔진을 가동하고 세계 챔피언의 자리를 차지하세요 – 오직 당신만이 가능합니다!

title: Suspense: Madman's Dreams
description:
게임 정보
Step into a world where fears become reality — and you are not just a witness, but a participant in the nightmare.
Suspense: Madman's Dream is a narrative-driven psychological horror inspired by real manifestations of mental disorders. Here, imagination and delusion are not fantasies — they are ways of existing.
Take on the roles of observer, creator, and madman — all at once. Explore a hospital, a magical forest, and a 1950s English house through the eyes of those whose minds are on the brink. Feel their world collapse: walls distort, memories blur, and shadows come to life.
Each environment is a reflection of the character’s inner world. Everything you see is rooted in reality — but filtered through a fractured, distorted mind. Piece together fragments of the story, examine the details, and find meaning in the chaos to understand what truly happened.
And maybe — just maybe — you'll answer the question:
Can anyone truly help a mind that's falling apart?
Game Features:
Voice-Controlled Gameplay:
Use your voice to interact with the world, uncover hidden elements, and solve unconventional puzzles.

title: Time Tales
description:
게임 정보
This game is a farming simulation developed by a two-person team, where players take on the role of a 12-year-old boy inheriting a farm from his missing grandfather. The goal is to repay the massive debt owed to the missing village chief within three years while uncovering the conspiracy behind it.
The game follows a traditional farm setting (in terms of atmosphere), but in terms of gameplay, it will completely subvert the usual conventions of other farming games—no character customization, no fishing mini-games, no animal petting, no blacksmith shop for upgrading items, no sword fighting, no collecting items to unlock certain things, no weather-reporting TV, and not even NPC names… Instead, we will introduce fresh and engaging mechanics to replace these conventional tropes, creating a world full of surprises—because if a game has no surprises, then what’s the point, right?

title: Critter Isle
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to CRITTER ISLE!
A wonderful resort where you can immerse yourself in the role of island manager and caretaker for the Egglins, rare and mysterious critters taking the world by storm. 
BECOME A FARMER
With over 10 different crops, you'll have your work cut out for you learning how to grow all of them and figuring out your Egglin's favorite.
DECORATE YOUR ISLAND
Every good environment deserves some homey touches, and with over 60 different island decorations, you can customize every inch of your island to suit your fancy. The Egglins will appreciate you for making their world your own.
COLLECT EGGLINS
company: Jesse F, Tyler C, Ben P

title: PalWar
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to "PalWar"!
This is a casual game that integrates upgrade, card drawing, fusion, and tower defense elements.
Upgrade
You can use gold coins to upgrade the altar, bank, and battlefield. Different buildings have different upgrade effects.
Upgrading the altar can have a higher probability of drawing high-level pets
Upgrading the bank will give you more gold coins
Upgrading the battlefield allows you to deploy more pets to kill enemies
Card drawing
Randomly summon three pets and choose the one you want. Contains dozens of pets, draw, draw! It's time to test your luck!
Fusion
Two identical pets can be synthesized into a higher-level pet with stronger combat power!
One star, two stars, three stars, evolve towards the five-star ultimate pet!
Tower defense
Completely free layout! Players can design their own tower defense routes, as well as the lineup and position of pets!
Different battlefield layouts will bring completely different effects.
A good layout allows pets to fight against hundreds of enemies and soar into the sky!
Wrong arrangement may lead to failure...
Endless Mode
Not satisfied after clearing the game? Unlock the endless mode and fight till dawn!

title: Rebellion GODSOUL: Awakening
description:
게임 정보
RebellionGODSOUL is a story + card battle + anime girl collection RPG game
The love that stems from the heart, the firm ideal and dedication, will eventually turn into strength,
Link people who resonate, awaken the power of "God Soul", defeat evil, and move towards freedom...
From now on, I will never be dictated by others
In 20X1, in the fictional city of Dream City, giant corporations monopolize the internet, AI takes away jobs, and the Hengpu Model enslaves campuses...
People's thoughts are controlled, their time constantly taken away, and their dreams formatted.
But you are the [cc] who remains unyielding in adversity and stays devoted to your ideals.
Link with those [Rebel Girls] who resonate with you and share your love for otaku culture.
This time, your youth shall never bow to the oppression of reality!
You'll grow with them, experience conflicts and beautiful moments together, and every heroine has her own affection storyline!

title: Gizmo
description:
게임 정보
In Gizmo, you’ll use different tools and components to build contraptions that solve specific problems presented in each level. Maybe it’s a conveyor belt here or a burner – but every solution is up to you! No strict paths, just you, your imagination, and some tools.

title: Neurosis
description:
게임 정보
Neurosis is an intense horror-thriller where your decisions can save—or cost—lives. Step into the shoes of a young psychiatrist running an online support group with deeply troubled patients. Each session reveals unsettling connections, buried secrets, and the shadow of a manipulative psychopath hiding among them.
Dive into a gripping narrative inspired by real psychological challenges and therapeutic practices. Your choices will define relationships, uncover truths, and determine how many lives can be saved. With themes of trust, betrayal, and survival, Neurosis blends a detective’s sharp mind with the haunting uncertainty of the human psyche.
Will you unmask the hidden predator before it's too late, or become their next victim? In Neurosis, the answers lie in your hands.

title: Battle  Rakir
description:
게임 정보
Lead the fight against the tyrannical Federation, by flying a variety of space craft, leveling up and choosing from hundreds of character builds, commanding your fleet, and much more. How will you outwit and destroy the invaders, in this open world isometric space battle adventure?
You are a special agent for the Intelligence Division of the Rakir Military. The only thing standing between the Federation and the annihilation of your home planet. How will you win this conflict?

title: I had a Friend
description:
게임 정보
I Had a Friend is a first-person, single-player psychological horror game set in the unsettling atmosphere of an abandoned family house. You play as Richard, a foreign tech university student living in Germany. One night, as you drift off to sleep at your computer, your phone suddenly rings.
A message from your mother, Hannah, lights up the screen. She informs you that your father, Tom, has been in a serious accident and is now hospitalized. With no one else to care for the family cat, Felix, Hannah asks you to return home immediately.
Upon arriving at the empty house, with only Felix as your companion, you begin to feel a growing unease. Strange, unexplained noises echo through the halls, objects shift as if moved by it self, and Felix’s behavior grows increasingly erratic with each passing night.

title: Little Sim World

Its adorable, tiny version, that is! Little Sim World is not only the new cosy sim next door but a story you’ll write and grow on your own! We surveyed over 10,000 hardcore sim fans to find out what they wanted in a life simulation game, and we've packed Little Sim World with all the must-have features! As you move into your rustic, snug little home, the next step of your journey is completely up to you! So what will it be?


Why not take a walk around your new neighbourhood? Very soon you’ll notice it’s alive and bustling with activity - Cars, NPCs, and busy shops will meet you at every step, and with no loading screens or transitions, the entire world is at your disposal! There are countless spots to explore in the city, each brimming with its own set of attractions, character, and chances to mingle with friendly faces!



Fancy eating out? Simon's Pub has got you covered or maybe the food truck is in town. If a home-cooked meal is more up your alley you can always visit the Let's Go Grocery Store for fresh ingredients and create delicious dishes from home. Your mornings could also get a boost through the freshly brewed coffee of Moon Coffee!

Each locale offers unique activities tailored to your interests! There's a charming Canal for , a large Gym for improving , and a quaint Library for those craving adventures. Countless other places eagerly await your exploration to unveil their true purpose. Plus, these delightful pastimes can pop up in unexpected places, be it in your cosy home or random corners of the world!


Even before you discover the charm of buying new clothes and getting new haircuts at the salon, you’ll get to create a character that’s just to your liking, be it their style or their personality! . Over time, your persona will transform as you unlock traits to assist in caring for your sim and achieving all the goals you've chosen for yourself!



At the beginning, you might not have many stylistic choices, but as you explore and level up, you'll open up a bunch of new looks and styles to try on! Certain accessories may be more readily available than others, so keep on exploring to ensure you don't overlook your preferred styles! The amazing hues of the colour wheel aren’t reserved only for your littlish friend, as we’ve made sure you have the same freedom when envisioning !



to spice up your living quarters. Paint or upcycle objects at the workbench or just sell them at the pawn shop. There are plenty of ways to make use of the things you no longer need! Walls won't confine you either so feel free to bulldoze them and start over. !


Don’t forget that your little human gets sleepy and thirsty too, make sure to as you go about your day and build your perfect life! . Every activity, whether it's crafting, working out, or fishing, affects your needs in unique ways. Plan accordingly to ensure you stay balanced.



There are plenty more existing features that we couldn't fit in here that we're sure you'll love! Not to mention many of the things that have yet to be added like being able to , & plenty of others that we can't wait to show you!

Many stories await you, but the most important one is the one that you create! Are you ready to start living your dream life in London?

title: Adulting
description:
게임 정보
Growing older has nothing to do with feeling grown up.

»Adulting« is an interactive visual novel tackling the topic of being an adult. It is a third person side scroller and a single player. It's unique style combines two-dimensional as well as three-dimensional art to reflect the look and feel of comics and graphic novels. Set in different apartments it should give the player a closer look into the lives of the three main characters.The goal is to embed the feeling of insecurity that accompanies the term »being an adult« in the form of a visual, interactive story and to enable the recipients to deal with this topic individually but also socially. The game takes around 20–30 minutes, depends on how much time you invest in mini games and reading the dialoge carefully.




The game is an experience focusing heavily on storytelling and featuring engaging mini-games as well as point-andclick interactions with dialogue. The story focuses on three characters, each with 3 acts of the story whereas the storylines are linear. The setting is a multi-apartment building. All those light interactions and additional dialogue focus on different problematic aspects of our three characters who should represent different age groups who are struggling with different aspects of being an adult. Furthermore it features point-and-click events which trigger short animations or dialogues giving the characters and environments more context.


Throughout the story the player will encounter light mini-games that they must complete to continue progressing. It features 12 mini-games with various styles of gameplay.




Additionally the players can write messages and send them to other players. Here, own thoughts can be written down and decorated with stickers. Writing and sending these messages can take place at any time during the course of the action. With the help of a scrapbook that can be accessed at any time, the player can send messages and read and store collected paper planes.




By combining 2D and 3D art styles Adulting reflects with a hand drawn look and feel comics and graphic novels. It features hand painted assets as well as 2D character animations. This gives it a unique art style which is easily recognizable.




The topic of the perception of being and becoming an adult in society is personified with three main characters and their individual struggle with the theme. In preparation the development team invested in a 3 month long research by interviewing psychologists and collaborating with the Sigmund Freud Private University Linz as well as making an online survey with over 70 participants.


A coherent soundtrack with individual themes per character ensures that players are immersed in a calm but emotional atmosphere. Full Soundtrack is available on Spotify.






This game was created from five students + helping hands in their master's degree at the University of Applied Sciences Salzburg as their final master's project. Since then the team graduated and they tried to improve it as much as was possible for them after their studies in their free time and with their limited programming knowledge. So please keep that in mind while playing the game and don't be too harsh on the loading times or other bugs. A lot of sweat, tears, money and love went into this project, so thank you for your support! <3










Liv is a 23-year-old single student who is pursuing a university education in the creative industry as well as a part-time job. She has financial difficulties, as her parents also have to support her other siblings financially. The pressure to get her adult life together financially in addition to education and work is growing.





Albert is a man in his mid-40s with two children. He has difficulty taking care of his two children and all his other adult responsibilities, such as his own florist store, because his partner‘s job often prevents him from being at home.





Finja is a 70-year-old pensioner who has particular difficulties with loneliness, as it is difficult for her to stay in contact with her friends, as she no longer has the possibility to travel long distances due to her age. Her family through their busy adult life also do not have much time to visit her.

title: Scarlet Enigma
description:
게임 정보
A birthday turns deadly, and the truth is buried beneath layers of secrets.
In Scarlet Enigma, you take on the role of a rookie detective navigating a tangled web of lies, timelines, and unanswered questions. A young woman is murdered during what should have been a joyful celebration, and it’s up to you to uncover what really happened, before time runs out.
Explore a richly detailed world where your decisions drive the investigation. Question dozens of unique characters, piece together clues, solve puzzles, and dive into interactive environments that reward curiosity and intuition.
Whether you're chasing leads, uncovering betrayals, or decoding the past, every step brings you closer to the killer and deeper into a case that may not be as straightforward as it seems.

title: Solar System Experience
description:
게임 정보
Fly through space in different modes while learning about our solar system in a fun way. Currently you can fly amongst the planets in the gallery mode, in which every planet is close to each other. This is the easiest way to study the planets and participate in quizzes about each planet. Also available is the traveling mode, where you have to collect fuel to jump to different planets. You can land your landing module on rocky planets to experience gravity differences and also test landing on gas giants in simulated conditions.

title: FREERIDE
description:
게임 정보


Hop aboard a Fate Train to the Spirit World, discovering wondrous landscapes and strange characters. But be warned – the future of this world may very well rest on your knobby little shoulders.
FULL STEAM AHEAD!

Use your newfound Physics-Based Telekinetic powers to do… whatever you want! Chuck fish! Play basketball! Solve puzzles! Fight demons! The choice is yours, as are the consequences.

MAKE NEW FRIENDS(?)

BRANCHING STORYLINES!

The story of Freeride is shaped by your decisions, both Conscious and Unconscious. Go looking for a fight and you’ll find one. Want drama? There’s pllllllenty~ of that. <3

title: DIG VR
description:
게임 정보
DIG VR은 초보와 프로 모두가 흥미롭고 스릴 넘치는 굴착기 기사의 진짜 삶을 즐길 수 있는 게임입니다. 현실적이고 몰입감 넘치는 컨트롤로 진짜 굴착기 기사가 되어보세요. DIG VR은 캐주얼한 아케이드성을 갖춘 가벼운 시뮬레이션 게임입니다!
굴착기로 모든 걸 해결할 수 있는 매력적인 Diglington 마을에서 사업을 차리세요. 다양한 작업을 수행하세요. 전통적인 건축 작업에서부터 기이한 작업을 다양하게 즐기세요. 다양한 음악으로 하루를 밝혀줄 DIG FM이 당신과 함께합니다.
다양한 툴이 달린 초소형에서부터 초대형 굴착기로 그 어떤 도전도 다 해결할 수 있습니다. 70개 이상의 커스터마이즈 옵션을 잠금 해제하고 나만의 스타일을 추구하세요!
빠른 속도의 미니 게임을 플레이하거나, 샌드박스 모드에서 느긋한 시간을 보내세요. 그 다음 새 아이템이 주기적으로 추가되는 Lost Treasure라는 스탠드얼론 모드를 즐기세요.
신참과 전문가 모두를 위한 보물이 기다립니다!

title: despelote
description:

despelote는 사람들에 관한 축구 게임입니다. 8살 아이 Julián의 눈과 귀로, 키토의 거리와 공원에 빠져보세요. 도시 주위로 당신의 축구공을 드리블하고, 패스하고, 슈팅해 다른 사람의 앞으로 축구공을 차면 어떤 일이 일어나는지 확인하세요. 에콰도르가 월드컵 본선 진출에 어느 때보다도 가까워지면서 도시가 변하는 모습을 느껴보세요.

달콤씁쓸하고 가끔은 몽환이기도 한 어린 시절의 반자전적 이야기입니다.
활동, 상호작용, 저질러 볼 장난으로 가득 찬 빽빽한 도시 공간을 한가하게 탐험해 보세요.

재미있고 진심 어린 대화를 하는 캐릭터로 가득 찬 활기찬 세계입니다.
에콰도르 지역에서 기록한 사진과 오디오를 이용해 강렬한 느낌을 주는 장소를 만들었습니다.

title: Light The Beacon
description:
게임 정보
About LIGHT THE BEACON
LIGHT THE BEACON is a 2D action-adventure survival game with rogue-like elements, set in the depths of a sci-fi apocalyptic universe. Take on the role of a genetically engineered Ranger, humanity’s last hope, as you navigate the dangers of space, maintain your ship, and battle for survival against hostile AI creations.
Key Features:
Survive in Hostile Space: Pilot your customizable ship through derelict stations and forgotten sectors, scavenging for critical resources to keep your crew alive while defending against relentless AI forces and unknown threats.

title: Empire Builder - Europe
description:
게임 정보
Zombie Possum Games Inc, in collaboration with Darwin's Toys Inc, is excited to bring the Empire Builder series of board games to your PC. As fans of these games, we at Zombie Possum Games Inc sought more time in our busy lives to enjoy them. To our surprise, we couldn't find any playable versions online using the services that we love like Steam and Xbox. That changes now. With the release of Empire Builder - Europe and the license to offer all other installments in the franchise, we are partnering with Darwin's Toys to publish the latest versions on Steam, iOS, Xbox, and other platforms.

If you are an avid train gamer in the physical space, we hope you will enjoy our adaption of the board game to the digital game space.

Features to be included in the initial release include the following:
All of the game's resources, cities, demand cards and event cards, fully implemented in the digital game.
A select number of popular house rules. (TBD)
2-6 player multiplayer between Steam friends and those with a ZPG account.
A user interface that is designed to make the game play of the boardgame faster. Our goal is to get 4 player game play down to under an hour or 45 minutes for experienced players.
Tournament rules.
Current tournament approved map coming soon for the physical board game. (published by Darwin's Toys)

2009 map, cards and rules.

Planned features for after release.
iOS support
Xbox and controller support.
Additional languages.

This is the first in a series of Empire Builder games that we plan to release alongside Darwin's Toys' re-release of the physical board games. As avid players ourselves, this is a passion project; one we hope allows us to be able to play with our friends when getting together in person is less than ideal.

title: Heart Keeper
description:
게임 정보
What is Heart Keeper?
Heart Keeper is a survival tower defense game with action roguelike elements. Protect the Sacred Heart by building and upgrading an arsenal of turrets and various structures. Combine strategy and quick reflexes to survive massive waves of enemies!
Enter the world of HUGE waves of enemies and dynamic battles!
To protect yourself, you will strategically build powerful defenses, including turrets and various structures. These essential tools can be unlocked by leveling up or collecting resources scattered throughout the map. Choose from an arsenal of unique weapons, each designed with special abilities and tailored to different strategies. But be careful: one wrong move can lead to your quick death.
Every death resets your progress, sending you back to the beginning. But don't lose hope! Gold persists between runs, allowing you to purchase permanent upgrades that will significantly ease your future attempts.
Test your strategic skills and quick reflexes by eliminating thousands of enemies to defend the Sacred Heart in Heart Keeper!
Starting Tips
Use the time between the first waves and quickly gather resources.
High damage turrets are worth upgrading their speed.
There is nothing wrong with dying in this game; it allows you to purchase new upgrades in the menu.
Pay attention to the statistics of the turrets.

title: LAN Party
description:
게임 정보
Experience a LAN party like never before! LAN Party is designed to be the perfect compliment to your gaming group. Whether you're playing the latest FPS cooperatively, competing against each other in an RTS, or playing different games entirely, LAN Party makes communicating and sharing gameplay so much easier. Fully customize your unique gaming room and gaming setup, select your avatar, and invite your friends to hang out and play games or have a watch party in your virtual space. Welcome to the next era of online gaming, where the excitement, energy, and camaraderie of a LAN party meets the freedom of the virtual world.
Stream Gameplay
Experience the excitement of the game together through seamless in-room gameplay streaming. Open your friend's gameplay stream to cheer them on and broadcast your stream to a virtual screen so you can all watch together.
Watch Content With Friends
Use a shared video screen and have a watch party with your friends. Our streaming infrastructure ensures that videos are always synced between viewers.

title: Herald: The Interactive Period Drama – Complete Edition
description:
게임 정보
Herald is a choice-driven adventure game set during an alternate 19th century in which the West is united as a colonial superpower: the Protectorate.
Help tell the story of Devan Rensburg, a man of mixed heritage who became steward on board of the HLV Herald, a merchant ship set for his country of birth.
As Devan it is your job to keep the peace among the crew and passengers by resolving their daily squabbles. Set during a time of widespread inequality and injustice, you are challenged to uncover a great mystery that surrounds the Herald's perilous voyage.

The 'Complete Edition' contains all four books that tell the entire story of Herald.
For the episodic version of the game, please go to the store page of Herald: Book I & II.
Key Features

A branching narrative that changes depending on how you decide to play. Do you choose to be bold and stand up for the downtrodden, or would pleasing the elite be the safer and smarter choice?
Uncover all of the secrets aboard the merchant clipper Herald, as you explore its many nooks and crannies.
The Herald is a microcosm of 19th century society. The crew and passengers all have their own dark secrets and often use sly coercion to convince Devan to help them. But who can you trust?
Herald's diverse cast of characters is brought to life by beautifully animated portraits, and the performances of thirteen talented voice actors.
Herald is set during an alternate 1857 in which the West has been united as a single global superpower: the Protectorate. Governed not by kings but by an elected 'Lord Protector’, the Protectorians believe they are morally superior. But are they?
A gripping tale about finding your place in a world divided by race, class and culture.

CONTENT WARNING: Emotional and physical violence, suggestive themes and infrequent use of strong language. Suitable for ages 12 and up.
