Set sail on your ship to discover diverse islands and uncover the wonders of the vast sky!

Craft!
Gather resources to craft tools, structures, and unique merchandise that will aid you on your journey!

Build!
Enhance your vessel by adding interactive structures, creating a ship that’s uniquely yours!

Cargo!
Transport merchandise to outposts and expand your wealth as you become a successful trader!

Cook!
Collect recipes and whip up delicious meals to fuel your adventures and impress your new friends!

Customize!
Spend some of your hard earned wealth on a variety of customization options and upgrades for your vessel!

title: Zombolion
description:
게임 정보
Zombolion is an arcade zombie shooter where the only sheriff in the entire county must defend a research bunker and uncover the mystery of the virus using proven scientific and diplomatic methods.
These include: machine gun fire, grenades, turrets, purchasing upgrades, and many other methods prohibited by the UUN convention.
Explore the map, gather resources, strengthen your defenses, and eliminate hordes of zombies to save the world from the terrible virus.

title: Shred-A-Bunch!
description:
게임 정보
SUMMARY
Shred zombies in slow-mo while drifting with your good old tractor?! Harvest crops, slaughter zombies, overcome epic boss fights and upgrade your vehicle. Rinse and repeat.
FEATURES
Harvest crops
Kill zombies
Watch out for your fuel level. If you run out of fuel, you lose
Upgrade your vehicles
Engage unique boss fights
Fight your way through different seasons and weather conditions
Endless mode where you can kill thousands of zombies through endless waves and upgrade your vehicle on the go
STORY
Your grandpa left his farm to you when he passed away, and you gave him the promise to keep the farm in good shape. After the zombie apocalypse, you take your good old tractor and protect your farm from zombies.











Hit, shred, or shoot the zombies. It's all up to you, all that matters is to kill those damn zombies and protect your precious crops! As a bonus to protecting your crops, enjoy the satisfying ragdoll zombies flying around when you hit them.

Engage unique boss fights and bring all you to take them down!















You are gonna love this game.


I can still confidently suggest this game. You can focus on the things you like most. There is an endless mode where you can skip the harvesting, focus on the and kill thousands of zombies through endless waves and upgrade your vehicle on the go. You'll have a pretty good time.


Maybe wait for a discount if you want to try it out.


Sorry, this game is not for you.
If you decide to purchase a copy, thank you, I hope that you'll enjoy it.

title: Lumos
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an Epic Journey Across Time and Worlds!
In a universe frozen in despair, an ancient petrifying machine has fossilized entire civilizations. It’s up to you to uncover and rescue the lost heroes, immortal beings, fearless warriors, robotic protectors, and humble villagers who were trapped in time. Each character holds a piece of the puzzle—and a role to play in the final battle.
Explore stunning, fantastical realms filled with floating islands, gravity-defying landscapes, and mysterious portals. Traverse dangerous terrains and solve mind-bending challenges as you work to revive these frozen souls. Each ally you save strengthens your cause, bringing unique abilities and powers to aid in the ultimate showdown: a legendary battle to destroy the petrifying machine and restore freedom to the galaxy.
Will you rally enough allies to stand against the alien overlords and robotic armies guarding the machine? Or will time remain forever frozen?
Join the adventure and fight for the future in this action-packed, visually stunning journey.

title: Bleb
description:
게임 정보
그 길은 쉽지 않습니다:
이 게임은 모든 플레이어에게 도전합니다! 포기하지 마세요! 더 많이 잃을수록 더 나은 플레이어가 될 수 있습니다!
주요 특징:
게임에는 100개가 넘는 레벨과 몇 가지 비밀 레벨이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다!
지루할 틈이 없는 흥미로운 메커니즘

title: Damashi Game
description:
게임 정보
Damashi Game에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
Damashi Game에서는 플레이어들이 퍼즐, 사회적 도전, 장애물 코스에서 서로 경쟁하며 궁극적인 상을 차지하기 위해 서로를 이기고 살아남으려고 노력합니다.
개요:
전략, 심리학, 빠른 사고가 가장 큰 무기가 되는 스릴 넘치는 멀티플레이어 사회적 속임수 경험인 "Damashi Game"의 세계에 발을 들여보세요. 모든 행동이 중요하고 모든 말이 마지막이 될 수 있는 게임에서 플레이어들은 일련의 치열한 도전에서 서로 맞서 싸우며, 기술뿐만 아니라 상대를 속이고 이길 수 있는 능력을 테스트합니다.
"Damaashi Game"에서 승리하는 유일한 방법은 살아남는 것입니다. 그리고 생존을 위해서는 속임수의 기술을 마스터해야 합니다. 고위험의 1대1 결투에서든 적들과 함께 위험한 장애물 코스를 통과할 때든, 당신의 결정 하나하나가 생사의 갈림길이 될 수 있습니다.

title: OopsFixers Company
description:
게임 정보
OopsFixers Company — 세계에서 가장 대담한 회사의 일원이 되도록 초대하는 최대 4인용 협동 게임입니다. 우리는 다른 이들이 거부하는 임무를 맡습니다: 이상 현상, 위험한 상황, 불가능해 보이는 도전들. 회사는 당신을 믿으며, 함께라면 어떤 장애물도 극복할 수 있습니다!
게임 특징
- 고유한 능력을 가진 독특한 캐릭터들: 각 팀원은 자신만의 강점과 특성을 가지고 있습니다. 어떤 이는 예리한 시력을 가졌지만 청력이 약할 수 있고, 다른 이는 뛰어난 청력을 가졌지만 시력에 자신이 없을 수 있습니다. 극한의 상황에서도 침묵을 지키는 이가 있는가 하면, 신체 활동을 좋아하지 않아 팀의 지원이 필요한 이도 있습니다. 이러한 특성들은 게임 플레이에 깊를 더하고 긴밀한 협력을 촉진합니다
- 팀워크가 최우선: 파트너와의 협력과 조율은 계약을 성공적으로 완수하는 데 핵심입니다. 각 캐릭터의 고유한 능력을 활용하여 서로를 보완하고 가장 어려운 도전들을 극복하세요.
- 다양하고 예측 불가능한 계약들: 각 임무는 새로운 도전을 가져옵니다. 미스터리를 해결하는 것부터 이상한 현상에 맞서는 것까지, 다음에 무엇이 기다리고 있을지 알 수 없습니다.
- 팀의 향상과 발전: 계약을 완수하고 자원을 획득하여 팀과 장비를 업그레이드하세요. 훈련과 발전은 어떠한 상황에도 대비할 수 있도록 도와줍니다.
- 가장 어려운 상황에서도 유머를: 일이 계획대로 되지 않더라도 미소를 잃지 마세요. 이는 게임을 더욱 흥미롭게 만들고 특별한 매력을 더합니다.
왜 OopsFixers Company를 선택해야 하나요?
우리는 불가능이란 그것에 도전할 준비가 된 사람들을 기다리는 단어일 뿐이라고 믿습니다. 우리 회사에는 "너무 위험하다"거나 "말도 안 된다"는 말이 없습니다—우리는 그것을 그저 일상의 한 부분이라고 부릅니다.
도전을 받아들일 준비가 되셨나요?
OopsFixers Company에 합류하여 미지의 것을 두려워하지 않는 팀의 일원이 되어 보세요. 함께라면 서로의 강점을 활용하여 어떤 어려움도 극복할 수 있음을 증명할 것입니다.
잊지 마세요: 잘못될 수 있는 것은 잘못됩니다. 하지만 바로 그것이 우리가 존재하는 이유입니다!
주요 특징:

title: ShapeRaid
description:
게임 정보
Shape Raid is a fast-paced boss rush game. Play casually or competitively with up to 7 friends in this unique bullet hell experience.
Included:
-30 Unique Boss Battles
-2 Distinct Game Modes
-3 Difficulty Options
-100+ Customization Options
-Dozens of tasks to complete

title: Ferret Frenzy
description:
게임 정보
Ferret Frenzy is a free compilation of 4 minigames with 3 variants each originally made for Pirate Software's January Game Jam in 2024.   Access the variants by going to Level Select or in the settings menu, changing the Variant Dropdown, and then clicking Play on the main menu.
Animal Wrangler:
Play as Thor and try to wrangle some ferrets
Catch as many as possible within the time limit
Find Us Ferrets:
Find the ferrets in a simple hidden object minigame
Variants will spice up the gameplay and make it so you have new rules to win!

title: Geometry Shooter Pro
description:
게임 정보
Geometry Shooter PRO takes the exciting foundation of the original Geometry Shooter and cranks it up to the next level! Jump into this hand-drawn arcade game where precision meets action.
Fire from a moving cannon at expanding geometric shapes like circles, squares, and triangles, all while mastering the art of perfect shots and crazy combos.
In this enhanced version, experience brand-new PVP and CO-OP modes, where you can team up or compete with friends for the ultimate score.
No more game-overs after a single mistake! Now you have 3 lives to keep the fun going! Plus, discover bonus balls with unique effects that add new layers of strategy..
Whether you're a fan of the original or a new player, Geometry Shooter PRO promises even more challenging and exciting gameplay. Can you master the art of the perfect shot?

title: The Steel Dawn
description:
게임 정보
The Steel Dawn is a unique project that combines elements of classic RPGs and unique combat mechanics. A deep story, a well-developed world and a variety of gameplay options make this game attractive to a wide audience.
In a vast galactic Empire, the loss of contact with an important cargo convoy has caused alarm. The convoy's last activity was recorded near the Terminus system, consisting of three planets. Each of these planets developed in its own unique way, but one of them, Vectis, stood out for its military power. It was with it that the Empire entered into an alliance, making it its vassal. Under the control of the Empire, they began to capture neighboring planets, one of which was the main character's homeland - the planet Venta. After losing the war, the main character ended up under the control of the Empire's vassals.
When the game begins, the main character is given an important mission on his home planet. He is sent in a capsule to his homeland, where he lands in the middle of the desert expanses. From here his adventures begin.
Gameplay: The player will have to complete many interesting quests, fight against other robots with melee and ranged weapons. All robots consist of parts, which, if damaged, the robot loses its functionality. For example, you can shoot off the enemy's hand with a weapon, which will make him run away in fear. The player can also explore a huge game world teeming with bandits, or customize his robot from found parts.

title: Word Scores
description:
게임 정보
Blocks of letters are falling down. Can you spell words fast enough to keep the board from filling up and beat your high score?
Word scores is a casual strategy word game. The dictionary includes about 100,000 words, including some proper nouns, ranging from 4 to 15 characters in length.
Unlike other popular block-falling games, word scores has only 1 shape, a square letter block. Up to 3 of these blocks can spawn at once. Depending on your luck, a bonus or penalty block could spawn instead.
When a word is spelled, its respective letter blocks turn to gold and then get cleared from the board. Points are awarded per letter, with common letters worth less and rare letters worth more. Earn bonus points for cascades and cross word combos.
If you manage to spell a word that spans the width of the game board, the board will widen, giving you more room for longer words, more points, and less risk of running out of space.

title: Run Pizza Run 2
description:
게임 정보

Run Pizza Run 2가 더 많은 재미와 도전 과제를 가지고 돌아왔습니다! 게임의 두 번째 시리즈는 모든 움직임이 결정적인 역할을 할 수 있는 혼란스러운 온라인 경쟁의 새로운 세계로 여러분을 초대합니다. 이제 차분한 피자 배달은 잊어버리세요 — 이제 여러분의 주문뿐만 아니라 최고의 배달원의 타이틀이 걸려 있습니다!
이번 게임에서는 친구들과 전 세계의 무작위 플레이어와 경쟁할 수 있는 흥미진진한 멀티플레이어 모드를 경험할 수 있습니다. 다양한 장애물과 독특한 승리 조건을 갖춘 역동적인 맵들이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다: 시간 경주부터 가장 민첩한 배달원의 타이틀을 놓고 펼쳐지는 전투까지.
각 맵은 새로운 도전 과제로, 교통 속에서 능숙하게 이동하고, 장애물을 뛰어넘으며, 예상치 못한 충돌과 추락을 피해야 합니다. 민첩성, 속도, 전략이 진정한 챔피언을 구별합니다!

title: Gob Johnson's Downhill Marmalade
description:
게임 정보
Gob Johnson's Downhill Marmalade is a fast-paced slalom 'em up fantasy roguelite, featuring beloved household name Gob Johnson himself.
Avoid obstacles, smash into enemies, collect marmalade boons and do sick tricks.
A Radical Roguelite
Start at the top of the highest peak and race to the the deepest depths to catch the sickest air.
Each run down the Great Mountain is different. Choose your path.
Unlock all Gob's friends
Unlock and play as a bunch of different characters, who all have unique powers.
Collect powerful marmalade boons
Collect Enchanted Marmalade to choose from a ton of boons.
Journey through the Radicallion on your quest
The world of Radicallion has many biomes to explore as you descend it's peak. Race down the mountain, skid through the mines, cause havoc in the city and much more.

title: Quarter Lie
description:
게임 정보
A swindler exorcist loans a ticket for a long sea voyage, hoping to earn a living off of rich passengers. Everything goes smoothly until he discovers that the ship is actually haunted, and he can’t lie his way out anymore.
Forced to choose between your own well-being and the safety of the ship and its passengers, find a way to get the best outcome for everyone.
Features:
— A complex, intertwined narrative system
— 9 characters to con or befriend
— A hard limit on the amount of lies you can tell
— About 2 hours of playtime

title: Babka
description:
게임 정보
Babushka is a first-person horror game about an old grandmother whom her grandson—the player—must rescue. The player needs to find her stolen and lost belongings and rebuild her old house in an ancient town, all while avoiding strange townsfolk and monsters from the underworld.

title: Manifest369
description:
게임 정보
In Island Reclamation, a gripping post-apocalyptic survival game, you find yourself in a shattered world where fragmented islands hold the key to humanity's rebirth. As a resilient survivor, your mission is clear: restore power, rebuild infrastructure, and navigate the delicate balance between diplomacy and survival.
Embark on a compelling journey in "Island Reclamation," a post-apocalyptic game where survival relies on rebuilding power on fragmented islands. As a resilient survivor, your task is to construct power stations to rebuild the main power lines encircling each island. However, the challenge extends to smaller settlements, where traders reside. These traders will only engage in transactions if you provide them with the power needed to operate. Fail to do so, and once-friendly settlements may turn hostile, viewing you with suspicion and mistrust.
The strategic loop intensifies as each settlement possesses a critical resource, such as the sawmill for poles. Timing becomes crucial – acquire rock, wood, iron, and more while the settlements aren't harvesting resources. Seize the opportunity when their backs are turned, deciding whether to negotiate for access or loot surrounding abandoned houses, shops, etc., to trade for gold. Use the gold to secure access to mines or acquire essential resources like wood, stone, and reliable transportation through cars .
Building trust with communities becomes paramount – those in good standing will reward you with gold for providing power. However, for settlements harbouring mistrust, even if you provide power, the compensation in gold remains elusive. Regardless of the community's stance, they will trade with you and maintain civility as long as your firearm remains holstered. Draw your weapon, and you have only a fleeting second to stow it away before they open fire. Cars and trailers become essential for moving large items in significant quantities, overcoming a significant restriction factor in this dynamic, shattered world. Adapt your approach, navigate alliances, and decide whether to trade, loot, or embark on covert operations to meet the challenges. The fate of these islands rests squarely in your hands.

title: RTS Chess
description:
게임 정보
메커니즘
모든 조각은 이동 및 이동 옵션에 대해 별도의 쿨타임을 가지며, 조각을 조합하여 새로운 조각을 만들 수도 있습니다.
지도
체스 테마를 좀 더 재미있게 만들기 위해, 지도는 각각의 고유한 유형(생태계)을 가진 헥사곤으로 구성되어 있습니다.
건물
조각과 그들의 이동을 강화, 생산 또는 변경하는 건물을 지으세요.

title: Tides of Lava
description:
게임 정보
끊임없이 변화하는 환경에서 끊임없는 적의 무리로부터 기지를 보호할 수 있는 능력이 있으신가요? 알아볼 방법은 단 하나뿐입니다.
Tides of Lava는 기존 타워 디펜스 게임에서 볼 수 없었던 몇 가지 독특한 기능을 갖춘 로그라이크 타워 디펜스 게임입니다.
1. 타워 수정: 2.5분마다 같은 유형의 모든 타워에 적용되는 타워 개조를 받게 됩니다. 이 모드를 조합하여 타워를 커스터마이징하세요!
2. 그리드 기반 빌딩 시스템: 그리드 기반 빌딩 시스템의 자유와 유연성을 즐기세요.

title: MIKU: May I Keep Up?
description:
게임 정보
MIKU is a game that should not exist in a perfect world
But the world is not perfect
So here we are
I suggest you forget you ever came across this game and move on with your life. 
Still here?

title: Tsan-shadow ninja
description:
게임 정보
Are you looking for an interesting retro-style game combined with something new? You've come to the right place!
Embark on a dangerous journey as a shinobi towards revenge, which will turn into a journey towards intrigue that threatens the entire world - it turns out that the shadow is not only an ally of a true ninja, but also a space that hides something darker.
Fight exciting duels,
hide in the shadows for stealth kills,
sneak like a shinobi!
In this 2D game in a pixel and cartoon style, you will use stealth and combat mechanics depending on the need.

title: Backpack Scavenger
description:
게임 정보
Scavenge the Battlefield:
Explore ancient battlefields to gather resources, tools, weapons, and armor. Pack your backpack strategically using a Tetris-style minigame.
Rebuild and Expand the Bastion:
Construct and upgrade buildings, from warehouses and workshops to towering fortifications and training grounds. Build vertically on the massive Bastion wall for maximum efficiency.
Craft and Prepare:
Turn scavenged resources into valuable equipment. Assemble gear sets to arm your defenders for the battles ahead.

title: Idle Farm tycoon
description:
게임 정보
What is Idle Farm Tycoon The game is based on click game, and farm game we have fed these together to a completely separate play game. Nice relaxing gaming, but also busy with farm simulation at the same time. Like inreal life you get nothing for nothing. You have to do something for it
You expand your farm by buying more and more fields, so that you get more yield. You have Wheat, for the chickens and Corn for the cows, and potatoes for the pigs. You use these yields for your animals, these animals eat the harvest yields. The animals in turn give products, which are sold so that you can buy new animals or fields. You start with 1 Wheat field and 1 chicken, you then have to expand this further, after a certain time you can expand the farm with a new product Corn and then the cows come. After some time a new product comes again and so on
By buying tractors you can speed up production and even make it completely automatic. The more tractors you buy the faster the process will run and you can earn money much faster Each type of field has its own tractor color so you know which field you are buying a tractor for. Finally, they are not cheap, The prices increase per purchase each tractor has its own properties that help you to make faster and more products.

title: Bling: Fortune Memories
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling adventure of exploration and survival in Bling: Fortune Memories, a platformer and strategy game set in a mysterious abandoned temple. Play as a young adventurer searching for his lost brother, who vanished while trying to collect the temple’s legendary gems.
Key Features:
Strategic exploration: Move on a 2D grid through an environment filled with traps, enemies, and hidden secrets.
Invisibility power: Use the Medallion’s power to temporarily become invisible and evade deadly dangers.
Puzzles and challenges: Each level introduces new mechanics and obstacles that will test your wits and reflexes.
Minimalist art style: A simple, geometric visual style that enhances the strategic gameplay.
Collection-based progression: Find and gather gems to unlock new levels and advance the story.
Can you overcome the temple’s challenges and rescue your brother before it’s too late?

title: Osiris Quest
description:
게임 정보
In Osiris Quest, step into the sandals of Horus, the son of Osiris, and take on a journey inspired by the timeless mythology of ancient Egypt. After the evil Seth betrays and murders Osiris, scattering his remains across the land, it falls upon you to retrieve them and restore balance to the kingdom. Traverse vast landscapes filled with treacherous traps, dangerous enemies, and mythical creatures as you reclaim Osiris’s body parts and prepare to challenge Seth for the throne of Egypt.

Classic 2D precision platforming action
Inspired by the iconic platformers of the Sega Genesis and SNES eras, Osiris Quest blends classic mechanics with modern design. Enjoy tight controls, beautifully hand-crafted pixel art, and an original 16-bit music score that evokes the nostalgia of retro gaming. Each level presents unique challenges and hazards drawn from Egyptian mythology, offering players a mix of exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving.

title: In Purr-Suit
description:
게임 정보
음, 이거 좀 어색하네...
너는 친구 미야에게서 메시지를 받았어 — 알고 보니 그녀가 이상한 바이러스에 감염되어 고양이로 변하고 있대!
당신의 임무: 모든 고양이들을 모아서 멋지고 엉뚱한 모험을 떠나라!
하지만 조심해—고양이는 탈출의 달인이야. 한 번... 아니 두 번... 심지어 여섯 번이나 도망칠 수도 있어.
어떤 고양이들은 특히 까다로워서, 좋아하는 장난감이나 간식 없이는 절대 움직이지 않아—그러니 그들이 원하는 것을 찾아 설득해야 해!

title: Haunted Mines
description:
게임 정보
Haunted Mines is a 4-player online co-op horror game set in old abandoned mines. Your goal is to investigate the location and restore the power, but beware—you won’t be alone down there. A lurking threat is waiting for you in the darkness.
Use weapons and gear to investigate and defend yourself. Try to restore the electricity by completing additional objectives to earn money, all while avoiding the deadly threat trapped within these haunted mines.
The Mines
The mines are procedurally generated, creating a unique layout every game. With millions of possible maps, you’ll need to explore, adapt, and take advantage of special rooms scattered throughout the mines to survive.
Discover the monster you’re up against
While there’s only one threat per game, it can take different forms. Each form has unique behaviors and stats, all designed to hunt you down as quickly as possible. Identify the monster’s type and use your experience to earn additional rewards.
Use and buy equipment
Make the most of the gear at your disposal to complete the mission, earn money, and upgrade your equipment. Each match offers a fresh experience thanks to the variety of tools and strategies you can use.
Co-op Multiplayer
Enjoy the game solo or with up to 4 players in online co-op. Working as a team can make the experience easier and more manageable, but without proper coordination, surviving the mines may prove to be far more difficult than it seems.

title: Quodan: Treachery on the Arheid
description:
게임 정보
Captain John Will Smith is tasked with delivering the cargo aboard the spacecraft Arheid III to it's destination, however a spy on board tries to sabotage the mission. Captain Smith must find out who the traitor is before they strike again.
Quodan: Treachery on the Arheid is an interactive visual novel in which you must solve the mystery of who betrayed the crew thorugh interrogations and multiple different minigames.
THIS GAME FEATURES:
Put on your Detective Hat
To get to the bottom of this mystery you'll have to interrogate a variety of different characters in a pixel art style universe.
Minigames, Minigames, Minigames
Complete a variety of minigames that impact your relationship with the rest of the crew. 
Multiple Endings
Different choices you make could lead to a variety of outcomes. Discover all 7.

title: Mobocalypse
description:
게임 정보
The planet parade in the solar system messes up your ship electronics and you have to emergency land on earth.
You find yourself in the middle of the Mobocalypse and you only have one friend who supports you with weapons and upgrades - Rüdiger.
Fight your way through a total of 5 different worlds with different enemies and a powerful boss in each world. Do you die in the process? No problem! A rift in the space-time continuum brings you back to Rüdiger again and again - he can supply you with upgrades and new weapons in his shop that you can keep after you die. Every failed attempt makes you stronger!
Can you find a way to repair your spaceship and escape the Mobocalypse? Or is there perhaps even a way to stop the Mobocalypse and save planet Earth? And what does Rüdiger's disappeared wife have to do with all that?
Find out!

title: Hungrities
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to start collecting new and adorable creatures?
⭐ Features:
+30 different creatures
4 different seasons
Day and night cycle: Day lasts 2 minutes, and night lasts 10 seconds (Cinematic)
Capture creatures by dragging them with the click and bringing them inside the farm
Dynamic: You control everything with your mouse
Visitors will react every time they see a creature
🛑 STOP the unruly creatures
📢 Bring order to your ranch! Click on the rowdy creatures so they stop fighting.

title: Moe Waifu H Push-Box
description:
게임 정보
5명의 사랑스러운 친구들과 함께 블록 밀기 퍼즐을 푸세요!
이토록 매혹적인 블록 퍼즐을 보신 적이 있으세요? Moe Waifu H Push-Box에서 당신의 문제 해결 능력을 테스트하고 결과에 따라 보상을 제공하는 5명의 여자 친구들을 만나 보세요. 다채로운 계절 테마의 톱다운 스타일 스테이지에서 상자를 밀어서 지정된 타일로 옮기세요.
15개의 스테이지와 더불어, 게임을 진행하면서 갤러리 이미지와 주크박스 사운드를 잠금 해제할 수도 있습니다. 좋아하는 와이푸와 함께 이처럼 다양한 콘텐츠를 즐기고 오붓한 시간을 보내세요!

title: Orbital Challenge
description:
게임 정보
Roll, jump, and teleport your way through 10 challenging levels in this fast-paced physics platformer! Compete for the fastest time on global leaderboards!

title: Banpo's Bridge Wondrous Worlds
description:
게임 정보
Banpo's Bridge Wondrous Worlds is a reimagining of the classic Japanese puzzle genre, Hashiwokakero, or hashi. Explore and experience a tranquil vastness while connecting islands of imaginative worlds with bridges, and play through an extensive catalog of increasingly difficult puzzles.
Features
An in-depth tutorial for learning how to play hashi
Play through 5 unlockable worlds
Over 200+ puzzles

title: Rolling In Gears
description:
게임 정보
Rolling In Gears is an engaging puzzle physics platformer game where you control a ball navigating through a series of mechanical challenges. The game’s main mechanic revolves around rotating gears and moving platforms to guide the ball towards its target destination. Players need to carefully maneuver through the levels, using precision and timing to overcome obstacles and reach the end of each stage.
How to Play Rolling in Gears
In Rolling in Gears, your goal is to guide a small ball through a series of intricate levels filled with mechanical obstacles and clever puzzles. Use the arrow keys to control the ball's movement, all with just two moves—forward and backward.
Your challenge is to roll the ball forward and backward with precision as you navigate ramps, gears, and spinning hazards. Each level introduces new challenges, like gravity beams or suction mechanics, keeping you on your toes with emerging gameplay.
Your timing and precision are key, especially when avoiding dangerous traps or timing your movements to perfection. The key is to watch out for platforms that shift or spin and think strategically to overcome trickier sections. If you get stuck, analyze the mechanics at play—sometimes, it’s about patience and letting the environment do the work for you; other times, it’s all on you. There are 35 levels to master, each more difficult than the next.

title: Arcana
description:
게임 정보
🃏 Arcana를 만나보세요
SF 판타지 세계에서 펼쳐지는 CCG와 로그라이크 덱빌더의 만남!
인류는 지구를 버리고 미지의 행성 아르카나에 불시착합니다.
그곳은 용족이 지배하는 다종족의 세계.
억압과 차별 속에서 인류는 다시 일어섭니다.
다른 종족들을 하나씩 쓰러뜨리고, 설득하고, 동료로 삼으며
마침내 용족과의 마지막 대결을 준비하세요.
🎮 게임 특징
130장 이상의 카드 수집과 커스터마이징
덱빌딩 로그라이크 방식의 루트 선택과 리소스 관리
전투는 CCG 스타일로 전개 — 전략성과 즉흥성의 완벽한 조화
깔끔하고 감성적인 픽셀 아트 그래픽
무료 플레이, 누구나 부담 없이 시작 가능
짧지만 도전적인 구조 — 반복 플레이에 최적화된 볼륨
🎲 당신에게 맞는 게임입니다
Slay the Spire, Hearthstone 스타일의 게임을 좋아하신다면
로그라이크 특유의 리플레이성에 빠져보신 적이 있다면
카드 수집과 전략적인 덱 구성에 흥미가 있다면
그리고 SF 판타지 세계관에서의 모험을 원한다면!
📌 출시 예정
Arcana는 곧 데모 버전을 선보일 예정입니다.
지금은 시작에 불과합니다 — 더 많은 이야기와 콘텐츠가 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다.
위시리스트에 추가하고, 아르카나의 다음 소식을 함께 따라가 주세요.

title: Lost In Lofi
description:
게임 정보
Escape the chaos of everyday life and immerse yourself in the soothing world of Lost In Lofi, a cozy indie game designed to help you unwind and focus. In this chill, lo-fi inspired environment, you can grow a variety of plants, care for peaceful fish, and transform your room into the ultimate cozy space. Keep track of your real-life tasks by writing them down in-game and enjoy a serene atmosphere that helps you focus on completing them. Whether you're customizing your room or nurturing your virtual space, Lost In Lofi offers a calm escape where relaxation meets productivity.
Perfect for those who love lo-fi beats and cozy vibes!
                                                      Try Your Paper Toss Skills
Have your timers finished? Have a few minutes to kill? Instead of boring "Placing paper in the bin" how about have some fun and try your hand at tossing the paper ball into the bin.
                                                            Grow Your Plants

title: CONDEMNED TO BE FREE
description:
게임 정보
A third/first-person hybrid shooter where the government has turned fate into a weapon. Navigate a world suffocating under prophecy, torn between destiny and rebellion.
The Game:
A narrative-driven shooter drenched in existential dread and Wong Kar-wai melancholia.
Tactile, deliberate combat inspired by Killer7
Experience a decaying city soaked in neon and regret.
Conversations that drift between allegory and confession, unraveling meaning in the spaces between action.
Do you follow the script written for you, or carve your own path into the static?
The Premise:
Five years ago, Leer was arrested for a crime he hadn't committed yet. But fate is a machine with loose bolts, and the enigmatic Moirai have set him free. It's a bleak world out there. Filled with a sense of dread and compounding cognitive dissonance, Leer must determine who he is and how to live in the face of an Oedipus level prophecy.

title: Songs of Solace
description:
게임 정보
Defeat enemy monsters in melee combats , explore the maps for new weapons and items and trade in items shop in this ACTION RPG game. The hero wakes up in a strange land in a state of amnesia. He must get stronger and find out more about himself and his true purpose and return to his true home . Gradually level up by defeating monsters and doing various quests. This game will contain everything that is in a RPG strategy game.

title: Heistfest
description:
게임 정보
Become the notorious getaway driver, dodging through destructible cityscapes inspired by real-world locations, rendered in a unique retro hand-drawn style. Your goal? Escape the relentless pursuit of cops, SWAT teams, helicopters, tanks, missiles, and even paratroopers!
You are now the public enemy
Will you be able to survive the rampage?



Features:
-Escape epic cop chases and become the most wanted heist driver



-Unlock legendary vehicles
-Find and craft weapons and power-ups to enhance your car and firepower
-Rob banks and survive against police units, SWAT , helicopters, military tanks, airstrikes jeeps, , missiles , paratroopers and more.



-From the streets of Italy to the pyramids of Egypt, embark on daring heists worldwide.
-Evade law enforcement through sprawling, free-roaming maps ripe for action-packed drifting and racing.

Can you outrun the law and cement your status as the ultimate heist driver? The world of high-stakes crime awaits—will you make it out alive?

title: Squiigee
description:
게임 정보
Control two window cleaners, Klenley and Ness, tethered to one another in this physics-based platformer. Use your momentum to swing, launch, and clean your way through a variety of cityscapes.

Master the swing and discover new ways to traverse each level. Avoid obstacles and clean grime in record time to earn cash and unlock new jobs. Each city brings with it new challenges and unique scenery to explore.
Some notes from The Boss:
Throw caution to the wind and finish your job with no regard for safety standards. Seriously, I want this job done quick.
YeeeOUCH! That looked like it hurt. But they do say pain is the best teacher. So I guess you learned your lesson, huh?
They also say a job half-done is as good as none. Well, I say screw 'em! If you want to wrap up a job half-done, be my guest.
But if you do feel like cleaning more, I'll pay you extra. Just be quick about it. I'm a busy man.
Finally, there’s no ‘i’ in “team” but there are two in “SQUiiGEE”… I’m not going anywhere with that, I just felt like sharing the thought.

title: Astropods: Starside Glaze
description:
게임 정보
Astropods: Starside Glaze is a 2D Fighting Platformer with endless mobility and combat potential! Starring as Hemi (pink) and Acro (blue), swap between them at any time to utilize their unique attacks and physics within various environments.

Astropods combines platform fighter combat with platformer styled levels, alongside nonlinear progression and perk customization, to create a dynamic combat-platforming experience unlike anything else!

GAMEPLAY
Experience speedy platform fighter gameplay within this nonlinear singleplayer adventure!
Utilize knockback alongside high mobility to maintain combos and maximize damage!
Swap between Hemi and Acro with the press of a button, each with their own unique physics and attacks.
Discover, and equip unique badges to further specialize your playstyle!
FEATURES
Enter one of 7 stages at any order to obtain their unique Star Badge and utilize their unique abilities!

title: Art of Blades
description:
게임 정보
Art of Blades is a top-down, hand-drawn hack-and-slash adventure
inspired by Japanese manga and anime.
a fast-paced hack-and-slash action,
every swing of your weapon brings excitement.
Can you become a master of combat?
You will face many different enemies in this game!
Each enemy has unique traits, so you will need different strategies to defeat them.
Can you outsmart them in quick combat?
Explore a stunning fantasy world where the beauty of feudal Japan meets sci-fi.
Here, robots and magic exist side by side.
Discover the secrets of this vibrant world!

title: shutterbuds
description:
게임 정보
Explore Rockle National Park with up to 3 of your photojournalist friends. Take jobs from top magazine brands, and then hit the trail in search of interesting landmarks and goofy creatures to photograph. Use your pay to buy useful items and cosmetics. You’ll be sure to make the front page in a flash!
COOPERATIVE MULTIPLAYER
Explore Rockle National Park with up to 3 of your friends! Work together to complete jobs for top magazine brands or just smack your comrades upside the head with a hammer (sickle not included).
CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER
shutterbuds contains a bunch of funny and interesting cosmetic options for you to unlock and personalize your character with!
YOU HAVE A CAMERA AND CAN TAKE PICTURES
Armed with your trusty Rejec brand digital camera, you can take photos of anything you see. Also featuring a convenient ‘Save to Desktop’ button so you can share them more easily!
SILLY LITTLE GUYS
Rockle National Park is filled with a variety of unique creatures, all with their own behaviors and personalities!
MAKE THE FRONT PAGE IN A FLASH
As you complete more jobs, the magazines you work for will be filled out with your photos, eventually creating articles for you to read.

title: Sumigami
description:
게임 정보
You wake up in the middle of the night the very first night after moving in your new apartment and everything is bit different. A dark corridor just appeared and will lead you to a whole new world made of familiar rooms populated with weird creatures, the Sumigamis. Investigate your past to find the escape out of this nightmare!
Explore
Explore the ever-changing Sumigami world with only your flash-light and courage and try to understand what is happening to you. The various creature are here to help, but are also searching for an escape just as you.
Collect
You will find a bunch of items. Each one helping you understand better what made you who you are and what needs to be done to escape.
Run
Not all creatures are friendly, and when the escape way will become clearer, everyone will try to make it. Never hesitate to run for your life, although sometimes fighting back might be the only option.
Evolving visuals
The visuals of the game will evolve along the history and depending on what is happening on screen. The visuals are based on the work of the artist Andre Da Costa, famous for his grim and curious black-and-white world filled with cute but scary creatures.

title: Backpack Inspector
description:
게임 정보
Fantasy customs officer simulator. Decide the fate of the heroes who want to get into the kingdom, on whose guard you stand. Check their backpacks for forbidden artifacts, stolen items, and contraband. And their characteristics to ensure they meet the needs and policies of the kingdom. Be watchful, for the glory of the crown!
New day - new rules
You start each workday by learning the new rules of the pass for the day. They change depending on the needs and policies of the kingdom. And are sure to increase in number and complexity as you progress through the game.
Inspect travelers
Examine the contents of heroes' backpacks to discover forbidden artifacts, contraband, and stolen items. Also check their race, class, and level to see if they meet the requirements of the pass.

title: Farming Through The End
description:
게임 정보
좀비 아포칼립스가 끝없이 이어지는 세상에서 생존은 단순히 좀비와 싸우는 것만이 아닙니다. Farming Through The End에서 플레이어는 자원을 확보하고, 방어선을 구축하며, 전투를 치르는 일 외에도 죽어가는 세상에서 음식을 재배해야 하는 절박한 필요성을 조화롭게 다루어야 합니다. 문명은 붕괴했고, 도시는 좀비들에 의해 점령되었으며, 생존자들은 흩어졌습니다. 장기적인 생존을 위한 유일한 기회는 인류의 뿌리인 농업으로 돌아가는 것입니다.

당신은 혼자 남은 생존자 또는 혼란 속에서 작은 땅을 지키기 위해 고군분투하는 소규모 그룹으로 게임을 진행합니다. 좀비 무리는 계속해서 이동하고 있으며, 다른 생존자들은 동맹이 될 수도 있고 적이 될 수도 있습니다. 자원은 부족하고, 날씨는 예측할 수 없으며, 끊임없는 좀비의 위협은 당신을 극한으로 몰고 갈 것입니다.

작물을 재배하고, 가축을 돌보며, 임시 방어시설을 만들어 농장을 보호하세요. 밤이 되면 주의하세요: 좀비 무리는 생명 신호에 끌려 농장을 무자비하게 공격합니다. 땅을 요새화하고, 함정을 설치하며, 방어 시설이 밤을 견딜 수 있도록 하세요.

낮 동안에는 트럭을 몰고 황폐해진 세상을 탐험하며 자재와 귀중한 물자를 모을 수 있습니다. 버려진 도시, 숲, 폐품 야적장에서 희귀한 아이템을 찾아 농장을 업그레이드하고, 차량을 수리하고, 강력한 무기를 제작하세요. 그러나 조심해야 합니다. 이 탐험은 위험하며, 좀비나 경쟁 생존자들과 마주칠 수 있습니다.

생존자 그룹 간의 거래 경제도 활성화됩니다. 당신이 키운 작물을 다른 생존자 그룹에게 판매하고 더 나은 장비, 고급 무기 및 필수 자재를 교환할 수 있습니다. 농장을 강화하고, 방어 시설을 진화시키며, 생존을 위한 강력한 도구에 접근하세요. 안전한 자원 수집을 위해 트럭을 업그레이드할 것인지, 더 큰 무리를 막기 위해 농장을 요새화할 것인지 선택은 당신에게 달려 있습니다.

Farming Through The End에서 살아남고, 성장하고, 번영하세요. 좀비의 야간 공격에 맞서 싸우고, 동맹을 구축하며, 붕괴하는 세상에서 농장을 요새로 만드세요.

title: Journey of Harvest
description:
게임 정보
Background
Your father, the district governor, used a little bit of tactics to train you to become the manager of District 21 of the Black Stone Mining Cave, and set a small goal for you: to make a hundred million dollars. You need to work hard to run District 21 and find ways to earn money from adventurers.
About
Journey of Harvest is a top-down simulation game that combines planting, automation, adventure and tower defence combat elements. The game revolves around the ‘adventure gathering - base processing - commodity selling’ mode. Players go on adventures in mines, collect all kinds of resources, return to the base to process and sell them, and challenge the ultimate small goals.
Adventure Gathering - Turns & Tower Defence & Combos
Players need to protect the mining machines from enemy attacks by building walls, defensive turrets, and defences before the start of each turn, while weapons are loaded and ready to meet the enemies attacking from all sides.
As you level up, you will unlock more types of turrets, and players can freely combine them and fuse their special attributes.

title: Noah's Dilemma
description:
게임 정보
Strategy Roguelike x Noah's Ark
Noah's Dilemma is a crew-building strategy roguelike set in a reinvented mythology of Noah's Ark, featuring unique placement-centric gameplay inspired by sudoku and autochess.
Playtime
A successful run typically takes up to 2 hours to complete, with 3 to 5 attempts expected before beating the game for the first time.
Build Your Animal Crew
Embark on a journey to gather animals who will also serve as your sailors. Harness their abilities, ignite synergies, and turn your ark into a swift vessel.
Explore Wild Islands
Sail through a procedurally generated map, venturing to untamed islands filled with hidden treasures, hot springs, altars, villages, and more.
Battle the Coral-Born
The Coral-Born are hostile creatures that emerged after the Great Flood. Command your animal crew to defend the ark from their relentless assaults.
Conquer the Four Seas
Each of the Four Seas is ruled by a formidable boss. Defeat them all, bring every animal onboard to the promised land, and claim your title as the conqueror of the Four Seas.

title: Healer Simulator RPG
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Healer Simulator RPG !

Can you help the sick townsfolk?

Will you solve all the mysteries?






In this world, you are a mage with the power of healing magic!
You will uncover the mysteries of this world and heal those who are sick, injured, or suffering from psychological or physical issues
This is a , an , an :

title: Horror Camp
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THIS GAME
Step into a world where old-school cartoon charm meets pure horror. Horror Camp is a survival horror puzzle game set in a twisted, ever-changing maze filled with deadly traps, cryptic puzzles, and a relentless monster hunting you down.
Explore the eerie labyrinth, collect valuable resources, and use strategic thinking to escape before it's too late. Every corner holds a secret, and every decision matters—will you risk searching for upgrades, or will you run for your life?
KEY FEATURES
Maze-like Horror – Navigate a surreal, hand-drawn world filled with dangers, puzzles, and secrets.
Classic Cartoon Aesthetic – Inspired by vintage animations, with a dark, unsettling twist.
Terrifying Monster – Always watching, always hunting—stay quiet, stay hidden, or face the consequences.
Challenging Puzzles – Solve intricate puzzles to unlock new areas and uncover the truth.
Resource Gathering & Upgrades – Find, trade, and upgrade items to improve your chances of survival.
Dynamic Gameplay – Every run is different; adapt to unpredictable threats and changing environments.
Escape… If You Can – The deeper you go, the more dangerous it becomes. Will you find a way out?
No paywalls, no microtransactions—just pure, heart-pounding survival horror. Add Horror Camp to your wishlist and prepare for a terrifying adventure!

title: Yixin
description:
게임 정보
Groundbreaking First Love Simulator, a truly immersive real-life love game in the form of a visual novel. In 2028, a tech company has developed an AI program with human-like consciousness and emotions. You'll have the opportunity to meet "her" in your dreams. Together, you can chat, go on dates, and experience an unparalleled sense of realism in your dreams, where you might even fall in love with the AI girl. However, she's not a real human. Are you ready to embrace such an inter-species romance?

This game features a complete story, rather than short, disconnected segments. The script, written in novel form, focuses on the psychological experiences of the player. You can customize your name to become immersed in the plot, providing a true first-person perspective. The story is a prophetic, near-future sci-fi tale, incorporating elements of philosophy and physics, and integrating them into a love story. It will guide you to truly understand AI, virtual worlds, reality, and explore the possibilities of cross-species love in this new era. The content is realistic, moving, and logical, aiming to bring back the feelings of first love.

This work is produced by 神风教主(Master Kamikaze) as an individual. It was originally planned as a mobile game in 2016, with 100% original content. However, due to various reasons, it has been delayed from being released. Now, after major revisions to the script, it is being remade. Currently, it only represents a part of the 2016 planning, and improvements will be made in the future. The current version is not the final form. This game is a long-term up dating project without a set completion date. The initial launch of the game includes the prologue and Chapter 1, subsequent contents and more characters will be released as DLC in the future.

Sincerely dedicate this work to all the single brothers around the world.

title: TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods
description:
게임 정보
「TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods」is a 2.5D pixel action roguelike game. The story centers on the fateful battle between Koishi Komeiji and Hata no Kokoro.
Game Features
Combat System: A classic and exhilarating bullet-hell shooting game. Take on the role of the powerful Koishi  and engage in thrilling battles alongside Kokoro!
Dynamic Stage Difficulty: During battles, you can enhance or weaken your enemy (Kokoro) through strategic adjustments, creating a customized challenge that allows you to achieve higher scores!
autokwd: TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods,恋恋幻之森

title: KindFolx
description:
게임 정보
KindFolx is a single player PvE real time deckbuilding card game! Play as 1 of 3 monsterfolk members of the Adventurers Guild in their quest to liberate the city of KindFolx's humans from its corrupt leader!
Face challenges head on as the orphan outcast adventurer, dodge and buy your way out of situations as the affluent noble, or deliver an unrelenting barrage of combos with the feisty pugilist!
-Fast paced real-time combat, a new twist on deckbuilders that requires efficient and creative decisions
-Randomly generated maps will make each run different from the last!
-3 unique voice acted characters and a variety of mechanics and cards allow you to play in different ways that suit your play style or create additional challenge
-Beautiful frame by frame animation!
company: Tristan Barona, Taco Pizza Cat Games

title: Gyra
description:
게임 정보
Game Features:
1. Online third person shooter adventure game.
2. Intense and exciting Boss battles, rich and varied. Monster category
3. Item affixes full of surprises and random drops.
4. Fight with pistols, rifles, shotguns and melee weapons.
Game background:
In the near future, human beings have been freed from the bondage of the body and have mastered the ability to incarnate fantasy bodies. The best warriors among men can even stand up to the gods. Then the abuse of the ability leads to the blurring of the boundary between fantasy and reality......
You will play as a new recruit, solve various world anomalies, and strengthen yourself.
Remember: Death is not the end. Any powerful affix could easily change the course of the war.

title: Grandma With A Gun
description:
게임 정보
Grandma With A Gun is a Foddian-style, difficult platformer that leaves you with nothing but a wheelchair-bound grandma and her trusty 12-gauge. With the power of buckshots, help Grandma escape Elder Care by launching her into the air, over obstacles, and achieve greatness on a difficult journey to freedom.
Help Grandma release herself from this Earthly Hell, and reach Ascension.
Cool Feature: Lose hours of progress in seconds! No save states will leave you peeling your own skin off in anguish and despair.

title: FALARMA - Open World
description:
게임 정보
🌟 Welcome to FALARMA: Where Adventure Awaits! 🚀
Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey into the vibrant world of Falarma! 🌍 With its open-world setting and missions, Falarma offers an experience like no other. Whether you’re seeking relaxation or simply gaming for fun, FALARMA has something for everyone! 💫
🌲 Roam through breathtaking landscapes, uncover hidden secrets, and immerse yourself in a world filled with endless possibilities. From thrilling quests to unexpected encounters, every step in FALARMA brings a new adventure!🌲
🔥 Explore, Discover, and Enjoy the Journey! 🔥
🎯 Key Features:
✅ Expansive Open World – Explore a beautifully crafted world full of mysteries and challenges.
✅ Exciting Missions & Side Quests – Engage in thrilling story-driven missions or take a break with fun side activities.
✅ 100% Free-to-Play – No paywalls, no subscriptions—just pure adventure!
✅ Regular Updates & New Content – We’re always adding fresh adventures, missions, and surprises!

title: Late Ming Fly Guy
description:
게임 정보
LateMingFlyGuy is a platformer game.During the Wanli era, the daughter of the Chief Grand Secretary inexplicably ascends to the heavens. You will take on her role to defy gravity through flight techniques and aerial platforms, overcoming humanity"s lurking threats in the cosmos via collisions and other mechanics.
Operation Method：
Use the keyboard to control character movement.
Game Content:
Includes three different scenes and ten types of monsters that can be defeated.
Gameplay:
The game randomly generates floating platforms and obstacles. Players can choose to collide with and eliminate monsters or dodge them, while continuously challenging themselves to ascend higher.
Music Material：
Music provided by [Crow Producer]
autokwd: Late Ming Fly Guy,明末飞升之昙

title: Delven
description:
게임 정보
델벤(Delven)에서 탐험, 기지 건설, 그리고 희귀한 전리품을 찾는 짜릿한 전략 게임의 대서사시적 여정을 시작하세요! 전략, RPG, 그리고 방치형 게임 요소가 완벽하게 어우러져 중독성 있고 독특한 게임 경험을 만들어내는 세계에 몰입하세요.
탐험하고 기지를 건설하세요
모험이 지표면 아래에서 기다리고 있습니다! 미지의 세계로 깊이 들어가 다양한 생태계, 이국적인 식물, 그리고 귀중한 광물을 발견하세요. 당신의 영역을 확장하고, 부지런한 일꾼들을 고용하며, 자동화된 제작의 기술을 마스터하세요. 고급 일꾼들은 여러 구역을 관리할 수 있으니, 테트리스 실력을 갈고 닦는 것을 잊지 마세요!
몬스터와 싸우세요
용감한 용병들을 훈련시키고, 무시무시한 몬스터들을 물리치며, 무작위로 생성되는 무기와 방어구를 수집하세요! 자동 전투 옵션은 일반 몬스터 무리를 제거하는 데 완벽하고, 더 강한 적과 보스를 물리치기 위해서는 수동 조작이 필요합니다.
자신만의 속도를 선택하세요
델벤에서는 도전을 빠르게 해결하거나 천천히 세계를 탐험할 수 있습니다. 전투는 턴제 방식이므로 필요할 때 언제든 휴식을 취할 수 있습니다.
가장 좋은 점은? 당신의 진행이 멈추지 않는다는 것입니다! 델벤은 오프라인 진행 기능을 제공하여 당신이 자리를 비우거나 컴퓨터가 꺼져 있을 때도 제작이 계속됩니다.
깊은 곳을 정복하는 데 관심이 있으신가요? 델벤을 위시리스트에 추가하고 최신 개발 소식을 계속 확인하세요!

title: Do Not Disturb
description:
게임 정보
1960년 벨헤이븐 호텔에서 일어난 가족의 비극적인 죽음으로 주인공의 삶은 완전히 뒤바뀌었고, 38년 동안 과거의 어두운 비밀과 싸우며 살아왔습니다. 이제 그녀는 이 저주받은 호텔에서 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아내고 진실을 밝히기 위해 돌아가기로 결심합니다. 하지만 이 호텔은 단순한 오래된 건물이 아니라 과거의 끔찍한 사건에 의해 괴롭힘을 당하는 생지옥입니다.
게임에서 여러분을 기다리는 것은 무엇일까요?
스토리 중심의 공포 체험: 주인공의 입을 통해 들려주는 감정적이고 심리적인 이야기로 과거의 조각들을 연결하세요. '가족들의 얼굴을 알아보는데도 우리의 기억이 나를 괴롭힙니다. 하지만 이 호텔의 비밀을 풀기 전까지는 절대 포기하지 않겠습니다.'
분위기 있는 발견: 수년 동안 버려지고 폐허가 된 1960년대 벨헤이븐 호텔을 탐험하세요. 구석구석, 복도마다 알 수 없는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다.
퍼즐과 단서: 호텔의 모든 방에 숨겨진 단서를 발견하고 복잡한 퍼즐을 풀며 미스터리를 풀고 스토리를 더 깊이 파헤쳐 보세요.
초자연적 위험: 여러분이 만나게 될 존재들은 단순한 상상의 산물이 아닙니다. 그림자, 속삭임, 그리고 당신을 따라다니는 무언가가 있습니다. 이 호텔은 방문객을 쉽게 떠나지 않습니다.
심리 스릴러와 생존: 이 호텔은 여러분을 육체적으로뿐만 아니라 정신적으로도 시험할 것입니다. 점점 더 긴장되는 분위기 속에서 살아남을 용기를 내세요.
하이라이트:
소름이 돋는 긴장감 넘치는 분위기와 디테일
다층적인 스토리텔링: 호텔의 어두운 과거를 발견하세요
현실과 광기 사이를 오가는 초자연적인 사건들

title: Custom Party
description:
게임 정보


Custom Party, the free indie online party game based on customization !

Custom Party is a party game for 2 to 8 players online.
It contains a unique customization system and lots of mini-games to play !

Which makes this game a great experience to play with friends or even in competition!





All elements of customization for your character are essential !

Choose your hats, shoes, tops, and colors wisely! All items affect your playstyle by changing stats or even powers !










It works by choosing a number of that you must stake in each game you play !
So this gives players who feel underranked higher ranked players by !

Additionally, it encourages cautious players to bet less, and slowly but surely progress to !

title: Mole Maiden
description:
게임 정보
It All Started with a Dream
The Burrow League is the most popular sport in R&D Mine, and all 14-year-old Penny wants is to claim the Burrow League Champion title from her big sister Coppra. To do so, Penny must leave home, explore R&D Mine, defeat the four Burrow League Captains, and finally face her sister in the ultimate battle!
Mole Maiden is a brand-new 2D Action Adventure about a Mole Girl who leaves home to become a champion fighter! Explore a vast interconnected world chalk full of tricky platforming challenges, diverse characters, quirky boss fights, and a whole bunch of juicy secrets; as you work towards your ultimate goal to become the very best!

title: MvsM
description:
게임 정보
[b][u]마법과 기술의 동맹[/u][/b]
두 세계, 두 가지 힘! [b]Magic Versus Mind[/b]는 전략과 액션을 결합하여 여러분을 매력적인 모험으로 초대합니다. 마법과 기술이 공존하는 세계에서 진영을 선택하고, 기술을 개발하며 적을 물리치세요. 새로운 레벨, 독특한 메커니즘, 몰입감 있는 스토리가 가득한 게임 경험을 준비하세요!
[b][u]새로운 레벨과 이야기[/u][/b]
[list][*]각기 다른 테마를 가진 도전적이고 매력적인 레벨에서 여러분의 기술을 시험해보세요. 마법사와 기술 전문가로 가득한 세계에서 생존할 방법을 찾아보세요!
[*]마법과 기술 간의 서사적인 싸움에서 진영을 선택하고, 이야기의 진행을 결정하세요![/list]
[img][/img]
[b][u]고급 메커니즘 및 전략[/u][/b]
[list][*]두 진영의 독특한 기술과 도구를 활용하여 전략적 이점을 확보하세요. 기술로 적을 무찌르거나 마법으로 함정을 설치하세요!
[*]다양한 전투 시스템과 다양한 캐릭터 클래스가 있는 각 게임 경험은 독특할 것입니다.[/list]
캐릭터 커스터마이징
[list][*]의상: 다양한 의상으로 캐릭터의 외모를 커스터마이징하세요.
[*]스킬 세트: 캐릭터의 스킬과 능력을 커스터마이징하여 전략적 이점을 확보하세요.
[*]펫 커스터마이징: 다양한 외모와 스킬을 선택하여 전투에서 효과적인 펫을 만드세요.
[*]색상 및 패턴: 캐릭터와 펫의 색상과 패턴을 변경하여 개인 스타일을 반영하세요.
[*]액세서리: 다양한 액세서리를 추가하여 캐릭터의 외모를 완성하고 독특한 스타일을 만드세요.[/list]
[img][/img]
[b][u]스킬 시스템[/u][/b]
플레이어는 게임을 플레이하면서 영구 랭크 레벨을 획득합니다. 랭크가 오를수록 무작위 활성 스킬이 인벤토리에 추가됩니다. 인벤토리에서 이러한 활성 스킬을 커스터마이징할 수 있습니다.
[img][/img]
[b][u]웨이브 모드[/u][/b]
이 모드에서는 다가오는 몬스터의 물결을 물리치면서 진행합니다. 각 웨이브에는 점점 어려워지는 적들이 포함되며, 특정 수의 웨이브를 완료하면 각 구역이 완료됩니다. 모든 웨이브를 완료하면 다음 구역으로 이동합니다. 각 구역의 마지막에는 특별한 보스 전투가 있으며, 보스를 물리치면 플레이어는 더 높은 레벨에 도달하고 보상을 받을 수 있습니다.
[b][u]목표 모드[/u][/b]

title: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree
description:
게임 정보
Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree is a 2D adventure game deeply rooted in Arabian mythology. Dive into Ma'een, a stunning underwater realm. Once a thriving ocean, Ma'een is now corrupted by dark entities.
From vibrant, ecosystems of plants and coral, to decaying ruins of an ancient civilization, explore the vast expanse of the cosmic sea, Ma'een through smooth, seamless swimming. As you delve deeper into the depths of Ma'een, encounter more challenging environments and darker corruption.

title: Ostrich Farm
description:
게임 정보
Step into the role of an ostrich farm owner, where your goal is to breed the most striking ostriches. It's more than just about looks; smart strategies, good timing, and a little bit of luck will take your business to a whole new level.

Key Features
Breed Colorful Ostriches: Selectively breed a multitude of extravagant ostriches.
Fulfill Orders: Your birds are in high demand! Deliver the requested ostriches to earn rewards.
Unlock Rare Variations: Discover rare mutations in the form of over 1 million unique combinations of colors, patterns, beak shapes and hairstyles.
Watch Your Ostriches Interact: Observe delightful mating dances and social behaviors.
Expand Your Farm: Expand your farm to provide more space for your growing ostrich population.
Collect Achievements: Challenge yourself and accomplish various milestones to collect achievements that reflect your expertise as a skilled ostrich breeder.

Social Behavior
Observe charming dances when your ostriches try to impress each other.

Witness the first steps of your baby ostriches. Every hatchling brings a fresh wave of excitement and potential.

Use rewards to enhance your breeding strategies and boost your farm's productivity.

title: Gigantes Ex Machina
description:
게임 정보
게임 특징
『기간테스 엑스 마키나』는 로그라이트 메카닉 액션 슈팅 게임입니다.
많은 이들에게 친숙한 탑다운 시점과 레벨업을 통한 무작위 강화 및 업그레이드 시스템을 채택하여 플레이어가 보다 빠르게 적응하고 쉽게 즐길 수 있습니다.
화려한 폭발과 상쾌한 타격감 그리고 현실감 넘치는 사운드가 당신의 눈과 귀를 즐겁게 할 것입니다!

title: Winter Clothing
description:
게임 정보
"겨울옷 축제"는 중국 민속을 소재로 한 공포 극의 수수께끼 풀이 게임인 톈허진에는 불문율의 규정이 있다: 한의절에는 어떤 촌민도 뒷산에 접근해서는 안 된다. 만약 이로 인해 어떤 산신야귀를 건드렸다면 청풍관의 도장들은 상관하지 않을 것이다.그러나 할아버지의 실종으로 진래는 산 아래로 내려갔다.산에 정말 귀신이 있습니까?혹시, 귀신보다 무서운 것도 있어.
본 작품은 중국 전통 명절인"한의절"을 인용하여 20여 년 전 톈허진에서 발생한 원한과 갈등을 여러분에게 알려드립니다.대량의 전통 민속 문화 요소, 예를 들면: 동물 선아, 초혼, 야간 시집, 종이 굽기, 빙의, 금기 등은 게임 줄거리와 수수께끼 풀이 단계에 융합되었고, 게임 장면에는 또 일부"문물 골동품"이 나타나 당신이 미혹을 풀 수 있도록 도와준다....
게임 특징
성전 앞까지 가면, 세 가지 향을 피우세요 - 중국식 민속 공포 미스터리 서사
폐쇄된 산촌에서 사람들의 신앙은 왕왕 상위자의 손에 장악된다.한때 마을 남항북에서 활약했던"대선아"는 더 이상 미진을 지적할 수 없었다. 만약 가택이 평온하려면 전 앞의 세 가지 향을 얻어"유원인"이 되어야 한다.
게이머가 연기한"진일"은"초혼"의 방법을 통해 고인의 망혼을 볼 수 있고, TA들이 당신에게 보여주고 싶은 옛일을 볼 수 있지만, 조심해야 한다. 반드시 당신이 보고 싶은 그 TA를 불러오는 것은 아니다....
당신 자신을 포함한 누구도 경솔하게 믿어서는 안 된다는 점에 유의하십시오 -  일부 줄거리는 실제 사건에서 각색됩니다.
그들은 다른 곳에서 왔고 육체는 이곳에 갇혔으며 영혼도 집으로 돌아갈 방향을 찾지 못했다."그들은 다른 곳으로 갔는데, 이곳은 고향도 아니고, 귀처도 아니다."가을밤 골목에서 바퀴가 흙길을 누르는 소리가 들려오니 내일은 또 시끌벅적한 하루가 될 것이다.

title: Greatsword Point!
description:
게임 정보
Be the strongest greatsword user in this game world. Defend your point by swinging your greatsword, and parrying attacks.

Game can be played offline. 

Story
You are retired and have you own territory. The Oranges are back! Stronger and smarter! Only you can hold them back, as you are still the strongest greatsword user in the world! Though you are pretty old right now.

Information to know
Spend Magic Ingots to temporarily empower you to your former self. You can gain this by playing the game or in-app-purchase.

Game is designed for smartphone; the UI will likely look gigantic.

The game uses PlayFab for account and leaderboard. The cloud save should be able to load into both PC version and Android version.
Disclaimer: currency is stored into your save data.
Purchase while logged in for the save to update to the cloud.
Or log in after purchasing.
Please be careful when there is a difference in Local Data and Cloud Data, confirming in choosing one will override the other.
You can play through the entire game without logging in at all.

title: MIRROR MIRROR
description:
게임 정보
누구세요? 이상한 사건들이 펼쳐지면서 당신을 괴롭히는 질문. 당신은 기묘하게 익숙한 느낌이 드는 집에 갇혀 있지만, 그 집은 매 사이클마다 비틀리고 재형성됩니다. 현실이 왜곡되고, 방이 이동하며, 과거와 현재의 경계가 흐려집니다. 당신의 정신은 그 안에서 보내는 매 순간마다 부서져 가며, 미치지 않기 위해 아슬아슬하게 버티고 있습니다.
진실을 밝혀낼 수 있을까요, 아니면 끝없는 반복에 영원히 갇혀버릴까요?
게임플레이
MIRROR MIRROR는 불길한 분위기의 집을 배경으로 한 1인칭 공포 걷기 시뮬레이터입니다. 게임 플레이는 탐험과 반복되는 루프 속 사건과 퍼즐을 밝혀내는 데 중점을 둡니다. 이 게임은 분위기, 긴장감 형성, 공포감 조성, 그리고 깜짝 놀라게 하는 요소들을 강조합니다.
게임 플레이 시간은 약 50~60분입니다.
줄거리
당신은 기억이 없습니다—오직 과거의 삶의 단편들만, 반복되는 루프 속에서 잃어버린 아내와 딸의 메아리만 남아 있습니다. 끝없이 반복되는 집에 갇혀, 당신은 암호화된 메시지, 왜곡된 라디오 전파, 그리고 무엇인가... 지켜보고 있는 듯한 짧은 순간을 발견합니다.

title: Safety Check YOSHI!
description:
게임 정보
Overview
This is a game where you identify dangers and near-miss situations in various locations.
You have recently been appointed as the Chairperson of the Safety and Health Committee at your workplace.
As the new chairperson, it is your responsibility to learn about various near-miss incidents and potential hazards.
As part of your training, you will enter a virtual world created with digital twin technology, which closely replicates the real world.
In this simulation, avatars will engage in dangerous behaviors, and your mission is to identify and point out those hazards.
Contents
Collect manuals that describe the safety rules for each location.
When you find an avatar engaging in dangerous behavior or breaking the rules, confront them by presenting the manual.
Once the avatar is in a safe state, confirm it with a cheerful "Safety Check! (Yoshi!)"
Your work isn’t done until you return safely.
There is also a time limit, so try to complete your tasks efficiently and reach the goal.
※ The images shown are from a development version and may be subject to change.

title: Poco
description:
게임 정보
Poco is a 2D/3D hybrid point-and-click adventure game where you play as Poco, a two-inch tall clown who is banished from a giant walking circus, and left to fend for themselves in the undergrowth of the Below World, where they befriend and enlist the help of the local homunculus population to build a rocket.
Explore the beautiful, cluttered Below World... Where everything broken, lost, or unwanted from the Worlds Above comes to decay.
Find items, solve puzzles, and engage in interactive minigames to complete quests.
Meet and befriend a cast of 5 homunculi: bizarre little creatures representing the 5 senses.
Enjoy the deliciously detailed 2D painted backgrounds and joyously cartoony 3D animation.

title: Island Keeper
description:
게임 정보
2037년, 전 세계는 오염으로 인해 급속히 멸종하고 있습니다. 새로운 인공지능 프로토타입이 죽어가는 군도를 청소하기 위해 파견되었습니다. 그가 어떻게 하는지 살펴봅시다.
여러분의 행동에 따라 세상이 실시간으로 변화하고 있습니다! 나무와 풀이 자라고, 동물과 새가 나타나거나 모든 것이 죽어 가고 있습니다 ...

title: Mall Simulator 2025
description:
게임 정보
몰 시뮬레이터는 여러분이 직접 운영하는 다양한 상점이 있는 대형 쇼핑몰의 재벌이 되는 경험을 할 수 있는 편안한 1인칭 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
디자인은 중요합니다! 최고의 쇼핑몰 디자인을 만들고 상점을 관리하세요. 베스트셀러 상점을 전시하고 고객을 위한 완벽한 쇼핑몰을 만드세요.
제로에서 히어로로! 가장 유명한 브랜드의 새로운 매장을 열고 귀하의 쇼핑몰에서 그들의 제품을 판매하세요. 식료품점에서 보석점으로 매장을 확장하세요.
재고가 소진되었나요? 항상 새로운 제품을 공급하고 최신 트렌드를 따라 고객이 귀하의 쇼핑몰에 머물도록 하세요.
시간은 돈입니다! 귀하의 쇼핑몰이 바쁠 수 있으니 결제를 받고 새로운 직원들을 고용하여 고객이 기다리지 않도록 하세요.
벽을 부수세요! 새로운 공간을 열고 쇼핑몰에 더 많은 상점과 브랜드를 위한 공간을 만드세요.

title: Umbra Mortis
description:
게임 정보
THIS GAME IS STILL IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT, SO YOU MIGHT ENCOUNTER THESE THINGS WHEN PLAYING:
MISSING TEXTURES
MISSING ANIMATIONS
LACK OF OBJECTIVE
ACCESS TO DEBUG FEATURES
The darkness brews, the evil within these people has stirred and stirred until their shells weren't enough. They have strayed from the path. With these righteous weapons of God and by being in unity with others of your faith, grasp at victory over evil.
This is a multiplayer shooter about advancing through a linear level with 2 friends and shooting your way through hordes of Venetian carnival goers that had their minds corrupted by a heretical deity.
Push until the end of Venice in a single go to destroy their false idols and complete the game
The game includes:
A controllable first person player
A gun on that player
Connecting with your friends through steam to be in the same space
A level to walk around in
One spot where you can shoot at zombies
Zombies that walk at you if you get close enough

title: Pochemeow
description:
게임 정보
무역 전쟁에 대한 경제 전략 게임. 도시를 개발하고, 경제 지형을 재편하고, 상대를 파산시키세요.
특징:
- 250개 레벨의 캠페인
- 무작위 지도 생성기가 있는 샌드박스 모드
- 달력 모드(매일 새로운 레벨)
- 재미있는 작은 미니 게임 ;)
- 깔끔한 UI

title: The Town of Nie Iromusubi
description:
게임 정보
INTRODUCTION
A strange tale, weaved like the petals of a flower.
A fan-disc of the strange and eerie otherworldly BL fantasy "The Town of Nie".
This title is set about one year after the main story, and features epilogues for the lover partners, side stories told from the perspective of side characters, and episodes after the ending, which delves deeper into the characters and the world view.
STORY
*Opening（End 7 - After the Ending）
Our main character, Hisora, spent his days working his blue-collar jobs every day without a moment to rest. One day, he followed a man in mourning clothes and ended up getting lost in an eerie world.
It has been about one year of Hisora searching for a way back home while staying at the Inn - the season is now summer.
While he still has not found a way back to the real world, Hisora has come to enjoy his life together with the residents of the Inn.
autokwd: The Town of Nie Iromusubi,贄の町 いろむすび

title: Online Records: Unknown Seller
description:
게임 정보
Online Records
Online Records is an episodic psychological horror game where each story tells unsettling events that could happen to anyone… even you.
Episode 1: Unknown Seller
A 22-year-old student arranges to meet an online seller at their home to pick up an item. At first, everything seems normal, but as she steps inside, an eerie feeling creeps in. What was supposed to be a simple transaction quickly turns into an experience she will never forget.
Gameplay
Online Records is a first-person narrative experience with exploration and interaction mechanics.
Key Features
Immersive and gripping story, based on everyday events that take a sinister turn.
VHS aesthetics and realistic graphics for a truly atmospheric experience.
Real-time messages that add depth to the narrative.
Choices and consequences that shape the outcome.
Are you ready to face the unknown?

title: SLIME EGG
description:
게임 정보
당신의 데스크톱에 살고 있는 작은 알의 돌보미가 되어보세요.
단지 지켜보기만 해도 성장하는 편안한 방치형 육성 게임!
게임 방법은 아주 간단합니다:
알에게 이름을 지어주고, 그냥 지켜보기만 하면 됩니다.
하지만 단순히 기다리기만 해서는 알이 부화하지 않습니다.
온도와 스트레스 수준을 조절하여 정성껏 돌봐야 합니다.
시간이 지나면 알에 조금씩 금이 가기 시작하고…
마침내, “슬라임몬(Slimeon)” 이라는 슬라임 몬스터가 태어납니다.
다양한 슬라임몬을 키우고 컬렉션을 완성해 보세요!

title: Putrika 1st.cut:The Reason She Must Perish
description:
게임 정보
The stage is set when Lazriel awakes without any memories to call her own.
Awaiting her is Remi, a quiet young man whose gaze seems to pierce through her. Without anyone else to turn to, Lazriel finds herself under Remi's care.

title: Room Service
description:
게임 정보
Room Service
Step into the dark world of Room Service, a narrative horror game with psychological elements.
You play as Jacob White, a man in desperate need of a job, who takes a position at an old motel. The tasks seem simple: cleaning and tidying up. But with each passing day, the thin veneer of normalcy begins to crack. Jacob’s struggle is further compounded by a personal tragedy: the recent death of his wife.
Experience Jacob’s Story
The events at the motel unfold from Jacob’s perspective as he reflects on the strange and increasingly unsettling occurrences he faced. The story is rich with subtle clues and shocking twists, complemented by scattered newspaper clippings, conversations, and other details Jacob uncovers during his work.
Atmospheric Horror
Psychological Tension: A growing sense of unease fueled by eerie sounds and a dark, oppressive atmosphere.
A Blend of Subtlety and Intensity: Horror elements range from creeping dread to sudden shocks, maintaining constant tension.
Your Job Becomes a Nightmare
Interactive Gameplay: Clean rooms, tidy spaces, and more—until nothing feels normal anymore.
Scripted Horror: Every event is meticulously crafted to draw you deeper into the ominous narrative.
No Enemies, Just Fear: There’s no traditional monster chasing you. The threat is subtle, psychological, and ever-present.
For Indie Horror Fans
Room Service is perfect for horror enthusiasts who enjoy games like Fears to Fathom and creations by Chilla’s Art. If you’re drawn to dark stories and immersive atmospheres, Room Service will captivate you.

title: Mall Simulator 2025: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
프롤로그를 통해 Mall Simulator 2025의 엔트리 레벨 콘텐츠와 기능을 체험해 보실 수 있습니다. 위시리스트에 추가하는 것을 잊지 마시고 정식 버전이 출시되면 저희를 팔로우하세요.
몰 시뮬레이터는 여러분이 직접 운영하는 다양한 상점이 있는 대형 쇼핑몰의 재벌이 되는 경험을 할 수 있는 편안한 1인칭 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.

title: Cargo Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
In Cargo Shop Simulator, easily measure and weigh your customers' packages. Inquire about the contents, their destination, and whether they are fragile. Collect payments and label the packages according to their destination. Transport your packages individually or in bulk on pallets, or allow a transport robot to assist you. At the end of the day, load the packages onto vehicles based on their destinations and send them off. Enjoy the experience of running a cargo shop! We plan to introduce features such as fast shipping areas, filling the inside of the box, and rewards and penalties based on the box's fragility soon.

title: + PC Maker
description:
게임 정보
+ PC Maker is a simulation game in which you have to assemble and customize computers, and also improve your home/office as you progress through the game.
In the game, we have worked out a good system for assembling and customizing a PC, so you can make a PC assembly that is closest to what you would like to assemble in life.
After completing the PC build, you can install the operating system on it and test it in various benchmarks.
The construction system is also well developed, thanks to which you can create amazingly detailed interiors.

title: Emily_
description:
게임 정보
THE FORGOTTEN AI
Hidden inside an old program somewhere lies Emily, a long forgotten AI, lonely. She seems to know way more than she lets on, it's up to you to discover what secrets she's hiding and to unearth the mysteries that reside deep within the program. How much does she really know? There are too many unaswered questions and the more you look the more seem to come up
CHAT WITH EMILY
In the game you'll have the opportunity to chat with Emily and although you don't know anything about her, she seems to know more than she lets on about you. Emily is willing to chat but sometimes your connection to the chatroom gets severed, if you wanto to uncover the truth you'll have to push trough and get her to tell you everything... but maybe there's another way to get some informations

title: Away From Life
description:
게임 정보
Flying over the islands of the Indian Ocean, your helicopter malfunctioned, as a result of which you crashed. You miraculously survived, finding yourself alone with the local nature of the islands and the water element. You will have to plunge into the odyssey of survival and face unforeseen circumstances, find out the secret of these places and the reason for the helicopter crash. Get a new experience every time in order to ultimately survive and find out if there is a way to get out of here!
You will have to build a shelter, protect yourself from weather conditions, dive in search of sunken ships, fight hostile animals and savages, engage in plant growing, electricity, fishing and much more.
Play alone or together!
Key features:
Keep track of your character's status, time, compass and more using a smartwatch
   Create your own unique character.
Explore the island you find yourself on when you wake up.
Stock up on resources and food to avoid starvation.
Build a shelter to survive the night safely.

title: Spray Paint Simulator
description:
게임 정보
스프레이 페인트 시뮬레이터로 세상에 색을 입히세요! 낡은 표면에 새 페인트를 칠하고 다시 생기를 불어넣으세요. 스프레이 도구를 정확하게 사용하여 구석구석 칠하고 완벽한 마무리의 만족감을 느껴보세요. 스패터빌에 들어가서 나만의 스프레이 페인트 사업을 시작하세요. 지역 주민들을 만나고, 주방과 지역 명소부터 거대한 로봇까지 모든 것을 복원, 수리, 마스킹 및 페인팅하세요. 새로운 도구와 장비를 구입하고, 자유 스프레이 모드를 잠금 해제하며 마을을 변화시키세요.
마을 최고의 페인트공이 되기 위해선 먼저 명성을 쌓아야 합니다. 하지만 걱정마세요! 플레이어가 할 일은 무궁무진하니까요! 도색이 번지는 것을 막기 위해 표면에 마스킹 작업을 하고, 이물질을 제거하고, 손상된 부분을 메꿔넣어 표면을 매끈하게 만드세요.
도색 도구를 들고 낡은 물건에 신선하고 세련된 색을 입혀 새로운 생명을 불어넣으세요! 변화하는 과정에서 쾌감을 느끼고, 부드러운 리듬을 즐기며 스프레이를 뿌리고, 각 물건들에 활기를 불어넣는 순수한 즐거움을 맛보세요. 모든 물건들을 새것처럼 만들고, 그 과정에서 즐거움을 느끼는것, 그게 중요한 포인트입니다! 스프레이를 뿌리고, 즐기며, 낡은 물건들에 활력을 불어넣으세요!

title: Survive the Fall
description:
게임 정보
A meteor strike has brought an end to civilization as we know it. Humanity is on the brink of extinction. However, after years of uncertainty, sudden climate changes, extreme temperatures and other catastrophes, conditions seem to improve to a point that it is possible to explore and re-populate this post-apocalyptic Earth.

Build a settlement as a safe haven and new home for you and other survivors. Leverage their strengths and abilities for the greater good. For only as a close-knit community will you be able to overcome these harsh new times where rivaling factions fight for supremacy and can rebuild society against seemingly overwhelming odds.


Discover an open world full of dangers, secrets and valuable artifacts. But don’t get fooled by the sometimes tranquil environment and the beautiful scenery. Get distracted and both human enemies as well as wildlife or even nature itself will make sure that this is the last thing you’ll ever see. And be warned: The meteor left more than just a crater when it hit Earth. Are you brave enough to unearth the truth?




You are not alone. Manage your followers, optimize their equipment and make sure that they stay healthy and in top condition. Take them with you on expeditions, fight and loot together as an unstoppable team of three or give them jobs in your base. The choice is yours. But remember: Who fights alone, dies alone!




There is more than one way to survive. Try to sneak your way out of dangerous situations, disarm traps, try to set up stealthy ambushes or choose open combat, where you can issue commands to your team anytime. Keep in mind, however, that ammo is as limited as medicine and every companion returning to the camp is another step closer to surviving. Pick your strategy wisely.




Create, maintain and enhance a settlement with over 30 facilities like farms, kitchens, research labs and shelters. Attract other survivors, leverage their strengths, utilize their abilities and unlock new technologies in the extensive techtree. Manage your resources and make sure that everybody’s needs are satisfied. Only a good leader will win the respect of their followers.




Although forever changed, your environment is still rich in resources - and full of valuable remnants and artifacts of a fallen civilization. Gather them on your expeditions to ensure your survival both in the field as well as in your settlement. Craft weapons and items or utilize your environment to fight hunger, cold or enemies: For every dangerous situation there is a solution. Make sure you live to see another day.




Discover the rich story and deep lore of the downfall of civilization in the aftermath of a devastating meteor strike. Environmental storytelling set against the backdrop of a world on the brink of collapse, engulfed in a mysterious stasis and memorable characters bring this tale to life. Get to know the warring factions fighting for dominance in the post-apocalyptic beauty that is Survive The Fall!

title: Miami Hotel Simulator
description:
게임 정보
태양, 모래, 네온 불빛의 도시 마이애미에 오신 것을 환영합니다! Miami Hotel Simulator에서 당신과 당신의 친구들은 팀을 이루어 자신의 호텔을 개조하고 관리하며 성장시킵니다. 멀티플레이어 모드에서 함께 방을 청소하고, 손님을 맞이하며, 고객을 행복하게 유지하세요.
마이애미 중심부에 있는 오래된 호텔을 방금 구입했습니다. 당신의 임무는? 큰 수익을 가져다주는 호화로운 휴양지로 바꾸는 것입니다. 호텔을 업그레이드하고, 고객 서비스를 관리하며, 방문객들이 슬롯 머신, 레스토랑, 바에 돈을 쓰면서 성공을 일구는 모습을 지켜보세요.
하지만 항상 햇빛만 있는 것은 아닙니다. 손님이 많아질수록 더 많은 혼란이 발생합니다. 쓰레기, 막힌 화장실, 지저분한 방을 새 손님이 체크인하기 전에 처리해야 합니다. 더 많이 관리할수록 더 많은 수익을 얻고 호텔을 사용자 스타일에 맞게 맞춤화할 수 있습니다.
주요 기능:
멀티플레이어: 친구들과 함께 호텔을 관리하고 업무를 분담하며 팀으로 협력하세요.
호텔 맞춤화: 호텔의 각 부분을 디자인하고 업그레이드하여 더 많은 손님을 유치하고 수익을 극대화하세요.
역동적인 도전: 손님의 혼란을 처리하고, 호텔을 유지하며, 고객이 계속 돌아오도록 만드세요.
Miami Hotel Simulator에 뛰어들어 네온의 도시에서 호텔을 낙원으로 만들어보세요!

title: Food Industry
description:
게임 정보
You are evolving in a world where the climate has changed over decades of overproduction. The pollution of an ever more intensive industry has accelerated the arrival of storms that have spread across the world, devastating everything in their path.
Your only solution is to flee, to rebuild everything. Will you then make the same choices as before? Will you be able to survive in the face of increasingly intense storms?
In Food Industry, you are in charge of developing a prosperous city where survival depends on food production. You must juggle the construction of infrastructure, resource management and the well-being of citizens while facing environmental and economic challenges.
Key Features
✓ Agriculture: sowing and harvesting fields of grains, fruits and vegetables, and raising farm animals for its food resources.
✓ Construction and Management: Create and grow your city by balancing the needs of your citizens while overcoming the challenges of food production.
✓ Dynamic Economy: Manage your economy by establishing markets, efficiently supplying them with a wide variety of goods, while responding to the changing needs of the population. ✓ Detailed industry: build production lines machine by machine. Repair, improve, and find new line plans. Transform and assemble resources from agriculture to create new products.
✓ Interactive environment: face climatic events that affect your agriculture, your industry and the inhabitants of your city, and thus test your management skills. Collect oil, water and generate electricity via power stations or wind turbines.

title: Miami Hotel Simulator
description:
게임 정보
태양, 모래, 네온 불빛의 도시 마이애미에 오신 것을 환영합니다! Miami Hotel Simulator에서 당신과 당신의 친구들은 팀을 이루어 자신의 호텔을 개조하고 관리하며 성장시킵니다. 멀티플레이어 모드에서 함께 방을 청소하고, 손님을 맞이하며, 고객을 행복하게 유지하세요.
마이애미 중심부에 있는 오래된 호텔을 방금 구입했습니다. 당신의 임무는? 큰 수익을 가져다주는 호화로운 휴양지로 바꾸는 것입니다. 호텔을 업그레이드하고, 고객 서비스를 관리하며, 방문객들이 슬롯 머신, 레스토랑, 바에 돈을 쓰면서 성공을 일구는 모습을 지켜보세요.
하지만 항상 햇빛만 있는 것은 아닙니다. 손님이 많아질수록 더 많은 혼란이 발생합니다. 쓰레기, 막힌 화장실, 지저분한 방을 새 손님이 체크인하기 전에 처리해야 합니다. 더 많이 관리할수록 더 많은 수익을 얻고 호텔을 사용자 스타일에 맞게 맞춤화할 수 있습니다.
주요 기능:
멀티플레이어: 친구들과 함께 호텔을 관리하고 업무를 분담하며 팀으로 협력하세요.
호텔 맞춤화: 호텔의 각 부분을 디자인하고 업그레이드하여 더 많은 손님을 유치하고 수익을 극대화하세요.
역동적인 도전: 손님의 혼란을 처리하고, 호텔을 유지하며, 고객이 계속 돌아오도록 만드세요.
Miami Hotel Simulator에 뛰어들어 네온의 도시에서 호텔을 낙원으로 만들어보세요!

title: Rift Riff
description:
게임 정보
Rift Riff는 타워 배치를 직접 고를 수 있고, 미리 정해진 타워 위치에 타워를 건설하고, 자유롭게 배회하는 괴물을 물리치며, 압도적인 타워 업그레이드를 적용하고, 생동감 넘치는 여러 월드를 여행하는 타워 디펜스 게임입니다.

괴물들은 웨이브로 공격하며, 베이스캠프로 직행하거나 가까이에 있는 모든 타워를 파괴하려고 합니다. 플레이어는 괴물 웨이브 동안 즙(건설 자원)을 얻고 웨이브 도중 또는 후에 타워를 건설할 능력을 갖게 됩니다.

괴물 맹습에서 생존하면 그 대가로 더 많은 월드, 타워, 타워 업그레이드를 잠금 해제할 수 있게 해주는 프리즘을 받습니다.
