Your odds for each action will change dynamically throughout the game, based on your circumstances.
You control the pace of the game with the settings.  You can allow for pauses and notifications so you can track every move and decision, or you can choose to jump immediately to your next decision, so there is no waiting.  There are multiple pacing and notifications settings so that whether you play against the computer, or against your friend, you can create a vibe that feels right to you.

title: Maiden
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 영구적인 죽음이 있는 제한된 공간에서 펼쳐지며 매 순간 긴장을 늦출 수 없습니다. 이 역동적인 세계에서, 당신은 끊임없이 움직이고, 잠긴 방의 열쇠를 찾고, 탈출할 방법을 찾아야 합니다. 생존하려면, 플레이어는 다양한 효과가 있는 포션—피해를 주는 포션부터 버프까지—을 사용해야 하지만, 그들의 수급은 제한적이며, 모든 결정은 치명적일 수 있습니다. 각 방은 새로운 도전을 제시하며, 영구적인 죽음은 모든 움직임을 신중하게 생각하게 만듭니다. 이 게임은 당신의 민첩성, 전략 및 예측할 수 없는 상황에 적응하는 능력을 진정으로 테스트할 것입니다.
각각의 모험은 열쇠와 포션을 숨기고 있는 절차적으로 생성된 상자 덕분에 독특합니다. 다음 문 뒤에 무엇이 기다리고 있는지 알 수 없습니다. 열고 있는 모든 상자가 생명을 구할 기회일 수도 있고, 더 큰 위험을 감수하게 만들 수도 있습니다.
열쇠는 진행의 중요한 부분으로, 다음 방으로 가는 문을 열 수 있게 해줍니다. 열쇠에는 여러 가지 유형이 있으며, 각각 고유한 테마를 가지고 있습니다. 피 묻은 열쇠는 희생이나 전투를 요구하고, 돌 열쇠는 힘을 상징하며, 얼음 열쇠는 극복해야 하는 함정에 얼어붙어 있고, 아크열쇠는 드물며 특별한 물건에 접근할 수 있게 해줍니다.

title: EmemeTown
description:
게임 정보
Hello, World... of Gen AI NPCs!
Have you ever wanted to watch the daily lives of your favorite characters forever?
Welcome to Ememe Town!
Here, thanks to generative AI technology, NPCs (Non-Player Characters) engage in autonomous conversations, create schedules, establish relationships with other NPCs, and lead their everyday lives as they please. You can create new AI-NPCs in this town, set their personalities, and occasionally intervene in their actions, creating a reality drama akin to the Truman Show.
Through this Early Access version, we want to build this world together with all of you.
Ememe is a small team. To tackle the vast potential of AI-NPC simulation, we need brains (probably) with six digits or more. By thoroughly listening to player feedback and suggestions, we aim to make Ememe and the AI characters living there beloved by all of you.
Generating NPC Life
According to the personality of the NPC, AI automatically generates their daily schedule. Oversleeping, missing meals, running to school, having silly conversations with friends, coming back, staying up late on social media, and going to sleep... AI generates the daily life of your favorite character.
Dialogue-to-Motion AI
NPC conversations are generated in real-time by LLM. And animations too! With our proprietary technology, the AI predicts and outputs appropriate facial expressions and body animations from over 1,000 motion data types based on conversations and schedules. Without complicated development techniques, your character will lively laugh, dance, and automatically output 3D animations.
Conversation and Intervention
You can freely converse with AI characters yourself! By taking on the "inner voice" of the NPC or role-playing as "other NPCs," you can influence NPC behavior. Encourage skipping school or whisper negative comments about a boyfriend... Now, let's see what the NPCs will do! (Pranks on AI should be moderate)

title: Dream Prison
description:
게임 정보
《꿈의 감옥》은 8번 출구와 유사한 3D 공포 탈출 게임입니다. 이상한 방을 찾아내고 사교 교회에서 탈출하세요.
【게임 배경】
당신은 교회 안에서 깨어나며, 한 목소리가 왼쪽 방으로 안내합니다. 교회를 떠나는 길은 비정상적으로 구불구불하지만 단서가 전혀 없는 것은 아닙니다. 올바른 길은 꿈속의 인물들에 의해 지켜지고 있으며, 이상을 찾아내면 탈출로를 발견할 수 있습니다.
【게임 특징】
정교하게 설계된 이상
공포스러운 분위기
[Development Team]
Developer: Budai
BGM: “Music Egg” Takai, Music Atelier Amacha
3D Model: Bought from fab
Sound Effects: Found on pixabay

title: ToHeart
description:
게임 정보
The late-’90s landmark visual novel from AQUAPLUS is back and fully remastered!

3D scenes and animations!
Updated art in full HD, with modern Windows support!
Your choice of classic or all-new voiceovers!
English & Chinese in addition to Japanese!



Discover the “heartful love comedy” that has captivated Japanese hearts for over a decade!
STORY
Spring is almost here!

Strolling down a street paved with pastel tiles, the sun warms my back as pigeons flock by the roadside. Amid this everyday scenery, it’s another ordinary morning, with just a soft whisper of spring on the wind.

“It’s a little warmer again today, huh?” Akari pipes up as she turns her eyes to me, her bangs swaying gently in the breeze. “I guess winter’s over.”

“I guess it is,” I answer offhandedly, and Akari giggles. I don’t know why.

ToHeart is a “heartful,” heartfelt, and comedic multiple-ending visual novel.
The protagonist is an utterly ordinary young man, but his friends Akari, Masashi, and Shiho make every day a happy one.

As winter turns to spring and March turns to April, the wind also carries a whisper of love.

title: Ankhway: The Interplanetary Legacy
description:
게임 정보
Ankhway it's a 2D Indie Adventure and Sci-fi videogame with an epic, original and intriguing story that incorporates systems like jumping to avoid traps such as spikes, shooting, ''MP3 Player'' Item to listen to the soundtrack completely free in-game... Among many other mechanics and game systems! Combining the adventure (Exploration, puzzle-solving etc) with action and science fiction.
NEO-RETRO MODERN PIXEL ART STYLE GRAPHICS
Features gorgeous, colorful hand-drawn pixel art by awesome artists like Rinober, KR or NeonPixel

title: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster
description:
게임 정보
System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster by Nightdive Studios brings to you the modernized remaster of the FPS/RPG classic.
It’s the year 2114 and as you awake from cryo sleep on the FTL ship Von Braun, you are unable to remember who or where you are… and something has gone terribly wrong. Hybrid mutants and deadly robots roam the halls while the cries from the remaining crew reverberate through the cold hull of the ship. SHODAN, a rogue AI bent on the destruction of mankind has taken over and it's up to you to stop her.

title: DarkRanger
description:
게임 정보
"Dark Ranger" is a light Rogue RPG. Veterans who have retired from the human battlefield have regained their glory in the secondary battlefield against monsters. In the Kingdom of Mist, there is a special trial. If a knight who has reached the age of 40 has not conquered a city and has not been awarded a knighthood, he will be judged as a "frail person". The past will be erased and he will no longer have the right to continue serving. The fate of the faint-hearted people is not good. The long-lasting war has caused the family industry to decline. Some people have become postmen because they are familiar with the kingdom's transportation fortresses after years of wandering. But most people are discouraged and live in the simple taverns in the town.
However, a new threat is approaching in recent years. The monsters in the dungeon are becoming more and more active at night, and the nobles are worried that these monsters will rush to their manors sooner or later. So they began to recruit adventurers. The regular troops have no time to take care of these unimportant secondary battlefields, so the skilled swordsmen and the unhonored ones are the best candidates. You are such an unhonored one. Before going on a mission, the town sheriff will arrange a brief combat training for you. Forget your years of experience fighting humans, the battlefield here is completely different. The time in the dungeon does not pass evenly, it is controlled by the big clock of the dark church in the center of the earth. When the big clock swings to the east, human time freezes, and when it swings to the west, the monsters' time freezes. To win the battle in the swing of the clock back and forth.

title: Pair A Dice
description:
게임 정보
Trapped on an island where every roll of the dice shapes your fate, team up with friends to take back what's yours using the resources that you create!

Roll the dice to summon items, both helpful and harmful. Collect resources, craft tools, and survive the island's unpredictable challenges. As you and your friends roll the dice, new friends, enemies, and bosses will keep you on your toes, testing your strategy and teamwork at every turn.



Features:

Dice Rolling
Bosses
Crafting
PVE / CO-OP
Unique Upgrades

title: Death Row Escape
description:
게임 정보
Death Row Escape에서 당신은 정기적인 수리 작업을 위해 버려진 감옥으로 보내진 작업자를 조종합니다. 하지만 상황은 빠르게 악화되며, 목숨을 건 치열한 싸움이 시작됩니다. 감옥은 강력한 인공지능(AI)에 의해 통제되고 있으며, 용병들과 위험한 실험체들이 곳곳에 도사리고 있습니다. 바디캠을 활용하여 타임 루프를 탐색하고, 퍼즐을 풀며 탈출 방법을 찾아야 합니다.
슈팅 액션
Death Row Escape는 짜릿한 슈팅 경험을 제공합니다. 강력한 무기, 전략적인 사격, 그리고 긴장감 넘치는 액션이 생존의 열쇠입니다. 감옥에는 용병과 치명적인 생물체, 그리고 다양한 위험 요소가 가득합니다. 빠른 반사 신경과 정확한 조준이 필수적이며, 주변 환경을 이용해 최적의 순간을 포착하여 공격해야 합니다.

title: The Glued
description:
게임 정보
THE STORY
Observe your surroundings. Squint through the static. Focus on small, seemingly mundane details. Somewhere, there is a path forward. Just don't look too long at those shapes at the edge of your vision. They will jump at you, given the chance.
Did you do something bad? Are you being punished? Is there a way to atone, or is this the end of the line already? And the peg dolls from your childhood bedroom... why can't they just leave you alone?
THE GAMEPLAY
THE GLUED melds the storytelling of visual novels with the interactive elements of first-person point-and-click games. Some light puzzle-solving is mixed with exploration as you investigate your surroundings to find clues on how to progress.
THE ATMOSPHERE
The story unfolds in an oppressive, twisted setting where the sky is rarely visible, and a Backrooms aesthetic permeates the bleak interiors.
The relentless onslaught of the game's stylized visuals amplifies the pressure and stress you feel as you try to make sense of your situation.

title: Vagabond Starship
description:
게임 정보

The crew of the starship Spearhead have been heading back to Artovya to deliver a unicorn to the king. After a harrowing battle with space pirates, their rutabaga supply is running dangerously low, and they need to find more if they're ever going to make it home.

Sir Typhil of Creulor and his fearless crew of elves, dwarves, aliens, and robots set out on a search across various unknown worlds, meeting zealots, rogues, reporters, and more as they seek out the ever-elusive rutabaga.


A riveting space adventure in which you choose your landing party. With 5 crew members to choose from, your decision changes your experience at each location and the puzzle solutions there
Freely travel between three distinct alien planets
Traditional adventure game puzzles as well other more unique types of puzzles
Fully voiced by professional (and awesome) voice actors
3rd person point and click gameplay
Retro arcade sections for the action elements

While a stand-alone game in its own right, this game continues the over-arching story from the previous four games in the series:

title: Rockoon
description:
게임 정보
Play from the top-down inspired camera, experience the linear story and puzzle elements.
Explore Mysterious Levels:
Embark on an adventure through uniquely designed levels.
Solve Puzzles:
Solve challenging puzzles to progress.
Hunt Monsters:
Battle dangerous monsters and defeat them with fast paced combat mechanics.
Join Our Story:
Become a part of the unfolding story and immerse yourself in the adventure.
Discover New Mechanics:
Explore innovative gameplay mechanics and become stronger.
Hunt with Special Skill:
Use your gun’s special skill to eliminate enemies with limited bullets.
Progress with Your Katana:
Wield your katana to fight enemies and continue your journey.

title: Fuel Station Simulator
description:
게임 정보
In this game about a gas station, you are the boss. From Zero to Hero, you are responsible here for either the economic success or downfall.

You start - as it should be - with almost nothing. If you handle it skillfully, you’ll end up with a fully developed gas station, complete with your own employees and plenty to keep you busy.

The following areas await you:
- Fuel Pumps: Refuel the approaching cars and collect payments. Additionally, expand the refueling options by earning more fuel pumps.

- Car Wash: Plenty of dirty cars! Once you’ve created at least one car wash facility, you can serve your customers and clean their vehicles. Later on, you can even add a self-service option!

- Car Repair: Fix vehicles in your own workshop, at least until you have staff for this task.

- Gas Station Shop: Collect payments from customers who have refueled, order goods, stock shelves, and sell them profitably! Of course, this comes after you’ve equipped your shop with a few shelves.

- Refinery: This is where you get the raw material… but will you also get the best conditions?1

title: The Murder Hotel
description:
게임 정보
또 다른 피해자는 내 이름으로 ""그들은 모두 수치심에 휩싸여 서 있었다""고 주장했다.

The Murder Hotel은 거대한 반전이 있는 인터랙티브 Murder Mystery Adventure입니다: 가위를 휘두르는 악마는 살인자이고 당신은 인간 손님 중 한 명을 의심해야 합니다.


그들이 어떻게 그런 짓을 할 수 있었는지에 대한 그럴듯한 이론을 만들어 내야 합니다.
언제든지 저를 가스펑거라고 불러주세요. 저는 악마 같은 호텔리어입니다, 당신을 위한.
아, 벌써 떠나실래요? 얼마나 재미있을까요. 내가 허락하지 않는 한 아무도 이곳을 떠나지 못합니다.
살인사건 4건을 해결하는 건 어때요. 쉽겠죠? 반전이 있어요. 내 손님들을 죽이는 건 바로 접니다. 그리고 조사해서 다른 손님 중 한 명을 범인으로 의심하게 하는 것이 당신의 임무입니다.
라이벌을 물리치고 악마 위원회를 설득해 승소해야 합니다.
한 번이라도 지면 여기서 영원히 머물게 될 거야!
어떻게 나한테 도전해 보겠습니까?
게임에 대하여
악마가 가해자일지는 몰라도 각각의 살인은 인간의 방법으로만 설명할 수 있습니다. 도전할 준비가 되었나요?


왜 살인이 일어나고 있는지, 어떻게 살인을 끝낼 수 있는지 알아보세요.

title: Colonies of The Remnant
description:
게임 정보
CATX 회사는 의학적 혁명을 이뤘습니다. 기술적으로 바이러스인 Catxone이라는 약물은 모든 종류의 암을 치료하고 면역력을 강화하는 화려한 제품이었습니다. 인류는 큰 승리를 축하했습니다.
여섯 번째 멸종이 어떻게 시작되었는지 이렇습니다.
큰 재난 후, 생존자들 중 일부가 모여 자신의 식민지를 설립했습니다. 이 포스트 아포칼립스적인 새 세계에서, 사람들은 죽은 것보다 더 위험했습니다. 당신만의 전략을 수립하고 그들에게 리더십을 증명하세요!
자신의 식민지 설립하고 리드하기
FPS 및 TPS 게임 모드로 당신만의 이야기를 만드세요. 당신은 리더인가요, 아니면 겁쟁이 시민인가요? 적군 식민지에 대항하여 식민지를 창건, 발전 및 방어하세요. 새로운 동료를 캠프로 모집하고 방어력을 강화하세요. 다른 식민지와 동맹을 맺으세요.
캠프 생활과 리더십
생존자들을 캠프로 유혹하세요. 커뮤니티를 구축하고 농사, 축산 및 자원 수집과 같은 작업을 할당하세요. 포스트 아포칼립스 세계에서 모두를 생존하고 행복하게 유지하세요. 굶주림, 수면 및 특정 심리적 가치를 균형있게 유지하세요.
액션 가득한 전투
언데드와 경쟁하는 식민지와 전투하세요. 적군 식민지를 점령하고 그들의 구성원을 자신의 그룹에 모집하십시오(또는 원하는 경우 그들을 모두 제거하십시오). 혼자 또는 팀과 함께 대규모 공격을 시작하세요. 식민지를 언데드와 다른 경쟁 식민지로부터 안전하게 유지하세요.
시나리오와 오픈 월드
먼저 시나리오로 시작하세요. 좀 더 전문가가 되면 스스로 이벤트의 흐름을 결정할 수 있습니다. 도시를 자유롭게 돌아 다니지만 언데드와 불신할만한 사람들을 조심하세요.
주요 기능:
- 6 평방 킬로미터에 걸쳐 있는 광대한 도시 지도.

title: Moonlight Knight
description:
게임 정보
Moonlight Knight is an action-slasher game with RPG elements where you have to fight hordes of enemies using a variety of character abilities.
FIGHT

Sword? Bow? Magic? Or Hook? Or maybe all at once? Fight in your style!
LOOT

Collect gold to upgrade stats and become unstoppable.
Explore levels to unlock new abilities and find powerful items.

title: Parkour Bot
description:
게임 정보
Zdravím všechny hráče, kteří sem zavítali během „CZ & SK Games Week 2024“. Vyzkoušet si zde můžete demo hry. Demo má zatím hotovou hlavní mechaniku, tj. fyziku hlavní postavy. Na grafice, zvucích, úrovních atd. budu pracovat. Plná hra by měla mít i achievementy a žebříčky. Budu rád za každý wishlist a hlavně odezvu v komunitním centru. Super bude, když zasídlíte video nebo screenshot z vašeho hraní. Pokud narazíte na chybu napište zde do diskuze.
Děkuju.
Parkour bot - 5 best game features
1) Unique playable character = Unique game experience
2) Physics based levels = Lots of unexpected events & more fun
3) Diverse enemies = New challenges
4) Less talking = More playing
5) A lot of achievements = Speedrunners are welcome
Fast paced rhythm based physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character and dynamic levels. No story, just your skill. So what are you waiting for?

title: GraeHart
description:
게임 정보
GraeHart is an immersive medieval fantasy 16-Bit RPG, launching as early access in 2025. Step into the role of Percival, a hunter battling to protect his village and uncover dark forces threatening the realm. Explore vast regions, forge alliances, and face challenging enemies in a rich, story-driven world. 
A multiplayer mode with PvP, PvE, in an Arena mode for epic battles will be introduced post-launch, along with guilds for deeper cooperative gameplay. Your choices will shape the fate of GraeHart!

title: CHROMA+ELEKTRON
description:
게임 정보
CHROMA+ELEKTRON is a 2D twin-stick shooter.
Increasingly difficult waves of enemies.
Collect their energy and unleash powerful weapons and abilities.
Return all chromatic energy to its proper state.
Your speed and power will know no equal.
Features:
Fast-paced, high-speed twin-stick shooter gameplay, with 2D platformer and shoot 'em up elements.
Challenging but rewarding difficulty.
Variety of arenas, enemies and bosses.
Atmospheric levels and music.

title: Blasten!!
description:
게임 정보
Blasten!! is a retro styled action side-scroller, hearkening back to the heyday of early console games. Take control of Blasten, an advanced ultra battle bot with a strong sense of right and wrong. Blast your way through challenging platformer levels and take down the nefarious Dr. Kraven and hordes of evil robots!

Features:
An homage to 80s-era side-scrolling shooters!!
Evolving weapons and perks system!!
Challenging platformer levels!!
Beautiful sprite animations and background art!!
Unique robot bosses and sub-bosses!!
No disappearing/reappearing blocks!!
Cursing!!

Some X number of years in the near-future. The world has enjoyed 100 years of peace due to a benevolent and fair world government known as the Peacekeepers. There is very little conflict, and problems that do arise are quickly, wisely, and efficiently dealt with, and everyone leaves happy! On top of that, wondrous future-type technology makes life easier and enjoyable for all citizens, including the invention of robots with free will by the world’s top scientist: Dr. Grey.

However, there are those who are not happy with this peace. The shifty Dr. Kraven decides to hold the PeaceOut Conference, where the world's greatest minds build robots to benefit mankind. Dr. Grey answers the call and invents Blasten, an ultra battle bot with a strong sense of right and wrong.

The conference goes well until the battle robots start going crazy! Dr. Kraven reveals he has taken control of all robots and plans to take over the world!

It's up to Blasten to fight his way through hazardous levels, crazed battle robots, and defeat the evil Dr. Kraven to restore forever peace!

title: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
description:
게임 정보


Sondro Gomez is an aspiring musician trying to make it on his own in Sunova. Unfortunately, his career isn’t going very well, and he’s racked up quite a debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Sondro has little choice but to make a deal with him: If Sondro can find the magic, wish-granting "Mystic Orbs" that have fallen from the stars and landed all across Sunova, the Masked Man won’t continue adding interest to his dues. With little to lose, Sondro turns his guitar strings into "the Barbed-Lasso", and goes out on a quest to acquire treasures and recover the Mystic Orbs!




Guide Sondro through an ancient world of wonder on his journey to overcome his financial woes and discover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows. Sunova is home to many unusual residents who are just as keen to get the Mystic Orbs as he is...




In the action-adventure platformer "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story", use Sondro's Barbed-Lasso to attack enemies, solve puzzles, even swing and slingshot around obstacles and hazards! Several power-ups appear throughout each level to aid in exploration by providing Sondro with new ways to traverse terrain, defeat enemies, and find hidden treasures:





Is this an unreleased title from 1989, once lost the sands of time and finally dusted off for the world to play? Is it instead a modern labor of love by a young team of developers aiming to authentically re-create the classic feel right down to the pixel? Who knows... (it's probably the latter...)

title: Out of Sight
description:
게임 정보
Experience thrilling stealth-action.
Use advanced gadgets to outwit the alien invaders and save the surviving members of your crew.

title: Train Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
Set in the United States of the 19th century.
It is a game that aims to acquire all railway lines by trading.
Get a railroad permit and open a new city.
Make money by trading, research technology, and upgrade your locomotive.
Technological research can evolve steam locomotives.
Let's challenge the quest!
Major features
Set in 19th century America
Get a railroad network that connects cities in the United States during the pioneering era
Use locomotives to carry supplies and passengers
Develop technology and evolve locomotives. The evolved locomotive can carry a lot of supplies at once.
Bring your necessities to the city and increase the satisfaction of your residents.
Clear the request from the mayor and raise your fame!
It costs a lot to get the whole rail network
Make money through trade!

title: Fractured Worlds
description:
게임 정보
The world is broken. All that remains are fragments, forming an ever-changing labyrinth of times and places lost. Explore randomly generated zones, uncover lost stories and amass loot & power as you search for what broke the world and a way to fix it in this action RPG.

Utilize a variety of weapons, skills and spells in easy to control beat 'em up style combat.
Find and obtain both randomly generated and unique gear with varied bonuses and modifiers to suit your playstyle in a system designed to minimize "trash" items and focus on interesting decisionmaking.
Seamlessly connect to other players to cooperatively take on the combined contents of both players' dungeons. Or, use shards found in your travels to set up a multiplayer run in a set dungeon with up to 4 total players.
Leave markers for others that are more than just messages; the same nearby enemies, treasures and traps you encountered will appear in their procedurally generated area, allowing players to share particularly rewarding - or punishing - encounters.

title: Village of Origins
description:
게임 정보
Awaken in a body that isn’t your own—your true form stolen. But this theft grants you an unexpected gift: the freedom to inhabit multiple forms. Assemble a diverse team of hosts, each with unique abilities to tackle challenges, solve puzzles, and dominate battles. As you conquer milestones, your collection of bodies grows, expanding your strategic options. Harness your newfound power to uncover the truth behind your stolen body and face the one responsible.
ENGAGE:
Village of Origins reimagines classic gameplay by blending retro point-and-click puzzle-solving with dynamic RPG storytelling and quick combat. The core of the experience lies in the body-swapping mechanic, allowing you to control an array of hosts at any moment, each bringing their own skills and advantages. Use this power to outsmart enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and navigate the world in unique ways. The mechanic is “easy to learn but hard to master,” offering endless experimentation and depth.
EXPLORE:
Journey through four distinct worlds—the bustling City, the peaceful Castle, the mystic Mountains, and the fractured Isles. Each area is filled with quests, collectibles, and narrative threads that enrich your adventure. Uncover hidden lore, meet quirky characters, and experience unique challenges that reward curiosity. Alongside the crafted worlds, venture into the Forest of Formings, a procedurally generated space that offers a way to gather resources and encounter fresh challenges.
FIGHT:
Unlock 50 unique host bodies, each with their own combat styles, weapons, and abilities. Craft your team wisely, switching between hosts to master diverse strategies and tackle formidable foes. Whether battling relentless hordes or powerful bosses, the body-swapping mechanic keeps combat fresh, allowing you to adapt on the fly. Engage with hosts ranging from mystical spellcasters wielding complex spells to gritty brawlers who give as good as they get to… modern construction workers who not only install HVACs but know exactly how to use them. Each offers a distinct approach, turning every battle into a unique challenge.

title: Rock Paper Scissors ULTIMATE
description:
게임 정보
Rock Paper Scissors ULTIMATE is a roguelike deckbuilder that features the classic gameplay of the "Rock, Paper, Scissors" but with the ability to enhance the offensive and defensive stats while maintaining the hit points of each tool by using different types of cards.

Rock beats Scissors,
Scissors beats Paper,
Paper beats Rock.

Their offensive and defensive abilities, as well as the gameplay actions and reactions can be modified by placing certain cards in the tools' representative panel slots.

The four type of cards:

Clubs: enhances the damage dealing abilities.
Spades: affects the defensive capabilities.
Hearts: hit points related skills.
Diamonds: magic tricks.

Carefully selecting cards based on SYNERGIES makes the tools significantly more powerful.

You will need to play on the synergies, since opponents must be defeated within a certain number of rounds, and as the game progresses they get tougher with more and more dirty tricks up their sleeves.
The number of rounds that can be played in a set can be selected from the randomly given dices. Got some strong combo in your hand? Pick a high round number. Got unlucky pulls? Go for a lower one.

Make sure you pick the right cards for the right slots and choose an appropriate round number, since the selection of Rock, Paper or Scissors will be random for you and your opponent as well.

Collected some money along the way? Feel free to spend it in the shop where stat boosters, other cards and services can be purchased. Or spin the slot machine for a small fee to win something small or big.

One more thing.

Try not to lose any from the Rock, Paper, Scissors trio, since winning without having all of them is very difficult...






But given the right synergies...

title: Age of Discovery
description:
게임 정보
Age of Discovery is a top-down 2D Role-Playing Game built on the solid model of Table Top Role Playing Games. You create your character by selecting your race and class, then pick two party members, the three of you venture off into the world to see what is going on. Travel through six continents exploring various cultures as you gain levels and power. What mystery awaits you...

title: Mantra
description:
게임 정보
Set in the near future, a growing force of robots controlled by a corrupt AI is hell-bent on destroying humanity. Humanity is on the brink of extinction. Corrupted AI code caused thousands of industrial robots to turn into human-killing murder machines. As the former lead developer for Tenso Corp, you feel it's your duty to right the wrongs that brought chaos to the world.
Mantra is a sci-fi FPS inspired by the likes of Doom, TitanFall and Halo taking you through an expansive world where robots have gone corrupt and are seeking to take over the planet. Throughout Mantra, you'll encounter a healthy mix of action-packed combat, swift traversal spaces and puzzles you'll have to complete in order to progress.
Key Features
Wall run through both dense and open environments to maneuver around your enemies and keep the advantage. Master your movement abilities and keep your foes on their toes.
Use a wide array of weapons to break down every bot who stands in your way. Will you master the iconic double-barrel shotgun, or will you stick to the trusty magnum handgun?
Tenso Corp. manufactured multiple bot types that each have their own strengths and weaknesses. From fighting a swarm of Drones to dodging the deadly charger, studying your enemies will help you survive as you journey to the top of the Tenso Corp. factory.

title: Corlero
description:
게임 정보
Choose between 2 factions, each with 56 units and 72 trait variants, distinct from the other factions.
Upgrade your units and construct the best team you can submit on each turn.
Consult the combat meters and watch battles carefully to evaluate strengths and weaknesses in your strategy.
Use dust to redo battles, swap units into the battlefield from your bench, level up and reposition your team. The dusts of time are finite, so pick your battles carefully...
All units have 3 different traits that enhance their effectiveness in a variety of ways. Both factions have 3 different variants for their traits, causing traits to play differently between games. Choosing unique combinations of traits allows you to customize your team and explore new options.
What's your most important unit? What's your team's strategy? That's entirely up to you.

title: DREAM SURVIVAL
description:
게임 정보
이 매력적인 2D 어드벤처에서 당신의 내면의 영웅을 해방하세요! 사랑스러운 동물 수호자로 플레이하며 일곱 개의 매혹적인 세계를 여행하면서 새로운 동료를 잠금 해제하세요. 어둠의 군대를 물리치고 강력한 보스를 정복하며 고대 빛의 포털을 수리해 각 마을에 빛을 회복하세요. 자원을 모아 고향을 업그레이드하고 강력한 무기, 마법, 포션을 제작하세요. 다섯 명의 독특한 캐릭터와 풍부한 재플레이성으로 수도를 해방하고 그림자의 위협으로부터 왕국을 구하는 전투에 참여하세요!

title: Stop the Crawl
description:
게임 정보
DECK BUILDER AUTO BATTLER HYBRID
Choose between 50+ monsters across 10 different factions to create a deck that is able to handle anything the heroes will throw at you.
DEFEND YOUR DUNGEON
Tactically position your units to defend against waves of marauding heroes. As you clear out the floors of the dungeon, you will encounter progressively stronger enemies. Do you have what it takes to stop the crawl?
SYNERGIZE
The key to unlocking your monsters’ potential is knowing how to utilize their faction traits. These traits have significant effects that will change the tide of battle. Figure out which factions work well together to create a board that can beat back the heroes.
ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM
You’ll encounter new and more powerful heroes as you progress through your dungeons' many floors. Each floor will introduce a new challenge requiring you to rebuild and rethink your defenses using the monsters in your deck.

title: Keystone Titans VR
description:
게임 정보


Keystone Titans VR is a VR Autobattler where units will need to be strategically selected and arranged to dominate your opponents. Outsmart the enemy with clever drafting, positioning, and economy management.



Build synergies with different champions.



Strategically manage your resources to create the best team.

title: Hexoria
description:
게임 정보
턴제 로그라이크 덱 빌더 게임인 Hexoria에서 마법 카드의 힘을 활용하고 마스터 전략가가 되십시오. 위험한 세계를 탐험하고, 마을을 건설 및 확장하고, 자원을 모으고, 카드를 사용하여 복종하십시오. 미지의 세계에서 살아남고 컬트를 영광으로 이끄세요!



Hexoria의 마법의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 마법 학교의 학생으로서 당신은 마법 카드의 힘을 활용하고 추종자들의 복종을 얻을 수 있도록 덱을 커스터마이즈해야 합니다. 최종 시험은 전략과 재치의 게임에서 마스터와 대결하는 기술의 궁극적인 테스트입니다. 하지만 Hexoria의 세계는 위험하고 예측할 수 없으므로 생존을 위해 마을을 건설 및 확장하고, 자원을 모으고, 추종자들을 저주해야 합니다.
위시리스트!
오늘 위시리스트에 추가하고 게임 개발에 대한 업데이트를 팔로우하세요.
기능🔥

🃏 나만의 덱 꾸미기
🏡 마을 건설
⚒️ 자원을 모으고 컬트에서 살아남으세요
🧙‍♀️ 팔로워 저주
🔮 순종하기

Hexoria의 턴 기반 메커니즘은 신중한 계획과 전략적 사고가 필요합니다. 자원을 관리하고 이동을 계획하고 마법사의 행동에 반응해야 합니다. 또한 탐색, 자원 수집 및 컬트 관리 간에 우선순위의 균형을 맞춰야 합니다. 게임을 진행하면서 더 어려운 도전에 직면하고 덱에 추가할 새 카드를 얻을 수 있습니다.

Hexoria는 Stacklands와 같은 도시 건설 카드 게임, Frostpunk와 같은 서바이벌 게임, Cult of the Lamb의 컬티스트 요소에서 영감을 받았습니다. 마을 건설에 집중하시겠습니까, 아니면 어둠의 마법과 조작을 통해 더 많은 힘을 얻으시겠습니까? 이 스릴 넘치는 모험에서 결정하는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!

title: Automatonics
description:
게임 정보

Explore the Depths of a Distant Galaxy
A distant group of planets may be the solution to host the humans after Earth resources and space are exhausted. The supposedly empty planets are mysterously filled with unfriendly robots. Lead your crew into exploring different planets in search of resources for Earth and solving the mysteries surounding the inhabitant robots.

Automatonics is a beautiful 2D action adventure styled around different planets. Explore unexpected environments; battle mysterious robots and solve the mysteries to bring hope back to Earth.

Game Features
Side-scrolling action/adventure, alongside beautiful environments.
Explore five mysterious planets in search of a new home for humans.
Master weapons and abilities to overcome enemies and barriers.
Upgrade your parts, become stronger, faster and more adaptable.
Bond with your companion droid and face the challenges that await you.
Play solo or co-op to beat enemies and bosses.
Beautiful styled colorful worlds.

title: Volatility
description:
게임 정보
In Volatility, explore an interconnected world unfolding as you acquire new abilities, each region brimming with secrets to uncover!
Left to die in a collapsing artificial world, you must learn how to escape it with the help of its few inhabitants still sane.
Why is this world being engulfed by its own core? What happened to the people who lived here? Who are you and how did you end up here?

Inspired by both modern metroidvanias and adventure games of the '90s and early 2000s, the game sees you conquering a world of dungeons and treasure.
Every newly acquired ability means new ways to interact with your environments like slashing chains, shooting far-away objects and riding on laser beams!

- An adventure spanning several floating islands and their dungeon interiors.
- Earn and upgrade Gems to broaden your combat and puzzle-solving options.
- Engage in widely varied gameplay including third-person shooting, top-down action, and on-rails shooting.
- Collect secret treasures to power up and learn more about the world.
- Help survivors stay alive and sane in their broken world.
- Escape the collapsing pocket dimension before it's too late!

title: Card Artisan
description:
게임 정보
Become a card designer and create cards from scratch! From spells to minions, you can select and bring to life your perfect card including its attack and resistance, the effects, and even activation conditions and timing of their abilities!
Random generation & Roguelike elements
Every card in Card Artisan past your starter deck as well as every card in your enemies' decks is randomly generated. This in addition to a randomly generated map results in no two runs being the same!

title: Alaric's Quest
description:
게임 정보
Alaric's Quest is a charming 2D platformer with a hand-drawn medieval setting that will take you on an exciting adventure. This game is designed for Linux, Windows, and SteamDeck, meaning you can enjoy the action on a wide variety of devices. Additionally, Alaric's Quest supports different types of controls, including keyboard, gamepad, and touchscreen, allowing you to choose the option that best suits your playstyle.
In Alaric's Quest, you'll dive into a magical and colorful world. Taking control of Alaric, the brave protagonist, your mission is to overcome challenging platforming levels, solve puzzles, and defeat enemies to recover your stolen book collection from evil minions.

title: Cards and Towers
description:
게임 정보


Cards and Towers는 카드 게임, 타워 디펜스, 로그라이크가 혼합된 게임입니다. 덱을 구성하고, 베이스 타워를 방어하고, 적을 물리치고, 최대한 오래 살아남으세요. 준비됐나요?
특징

전략적으로 타워를 보호하세요.
승리 전략을 개발하세요.
수백 개의 새로운 카드를 잠금 해제하세요.
완벽한 컨트롤러 지원.
끝없는 재생 가능성.
세계 리더 보드.
역동적 인 덱 빌딩

현명하게 카드를 선택하세요! 수백 장의 카드를 발견하세요. 시너지 효과를 내는 카드를 선택하세요. 같은 품질의 카드 두 장을 조합하면 무작위로 더 높은 품질의 카드를 얻을 수 있습니다.

카드 플레이로 베이스 타워를 지켜내세요

독특한 타워 디펜스를 경험하세요! 타워와 유닛 카드를 배치하여 방어 구조를 구축하세요. 지속적인 효과를 위해 아이템 카드를 사용하세요. 능력을 위해 활성 카드를 사용하십시오. 파워 카드를 사용하여 즉각적인 효과를 얻으세요.


나만의 방식으로 플레이하세요! 이 게임은 마우스와 컨트롤러로 모두 플레이할 수 있습니다.

몇 시간 동안 재미있게 플레이하세요! 실력을 테스트하고 점수를 향상하세요.

title: Desolated District
description:
게임 정보
Desolated District is a survival crafting game set in a post-apocalyptic dystopia. Scavenge, craft, build, and battle to survive in a sprawling, decaying urban environment now overrun with looming threats.
Explore a Vast Post-Apocalyptic World
Build and Customize Your Base
Grow and Harvest Your Own Crops
Craft, Upgrade, and Survive
Engage in Challenging Combat
Progression and Skill Development
Resource Management and Strategy
Traverse an expansive district filled with abandoned homes, crumbling factories, and hidden underground areas. Uncover secrets, scavenge for resources, and encounter dangers lurking in every corner.
company: Real Heroes Studio, SC 16 BIT NIGHTS SRL

title: Liekki
description:
게임 정보
Liekki is a fast-paced puzzle platformer where you play as a small fire spirit and burn everything you touch. You can solve levels with trying to burn everything or very little. Solve puzzles and move through a strange world with different fire related powers and find secrets. Levels change when you burn objects within and if you are not careful, you might miss something.

title: Buhei
description:
게임 정보
Twin-Stick Party Shooter
Up to 8 players in local multiplayer (controller required)
Up to 8 players with Steam Remote Play
A wide variety of weapons and abilities
Different game modes: Free for all, Teams, and more...
Character customization options
The Game
Attention! Behold Buhei! The wonder granted to humanity! Experience how believed boundaries fade away and the exquisite combination of game mechanics transcends the human mind.
Multiplayer
In this game, up to 8 players can compete against each other in friendly or less friendly rivalry at the same time. Buhei is THE party game! Gather your friends! Gather your enemies! Marvel together at the explosion of action on your screen.
Diverse Weapons
Watch out! Witness the symphony of firepower. A fantastic arsenal that gives you the opportunity to wreak havoc on your opponents. An inexhaustible selection awaits you. From high-speed projectiles to sophisticated traps that can outsmart even the cleverest opponents.

title: Warped
description:
게임 정보
Survive at spaceship captured by unknown life forms. Permadeath, crafting weapons, repairing machinery, spacewalks, talking with ship's AI, zero gravity... Resolve mystery of ancient cursed spaceship, and finally, find a way to return home.

title: Burden of the Blue
description:
게임 정보
Explore hidden realms and navigate through sprawling dungeons in an action packed adventure. Play as an agile bird that is guided by the Sea. Follow the destined path in order to uncover the burdens of the past.
Explore Maze-like Dungeons
Discover forgotten lands filled with deadly traps, unique puzzles, weird creatures and interconnected layouts.
Over 100 hand-crafted rooms filled with secrets to explore
As little hand holding as possible!
Maybe some backtracking? (OH NO)
Combat Foes With Agile Abilities
Use your sword to defend yourself against hostile foes. Spacing is the key for survival!
Easy to get used to but hard to master combat
Tons of secret game mechanics to discover and use
I think there is a bird carrying a gun or something

title: Seven Dwarfs: Legends Untold
description:
게임 정보
Seven Dwarfs: Legends Untold is an epic co-op roguelike set in a dark fantasy realm, centered on intense, action-packed combat. Join forces with a team of up to 4 players, each taking on the role of one of the 7 dwarf warriors, each with unique abilities. Embark on a quest through a kingdom dominated by the ominous presence of the Evil Queen, where darkness and fear reign. Work together to overcome adversaries and ancient, powerful creatures. Upgrade your character with mighty weapons and spells, and reclaim the Kingdom from the grip of darkness.
A DARK REALM TO EXPLORE AND FEARLESS ENEMIES TO ENCOUNTER
Travel through the vast and captivating biomes of the Kingdom, and face hordes of different enemies. Experience epic battles against a set of diverse, powerful dark entities, full of unique challenges.
WORK TOGETHER TO SAVE THE KINGDOM
Experience the fantastic world designed to bring you and up to three friends together in an epic fight. Harness the individual skills of your team members and work together in complex assaults on the enemy.
NO NEED TO BE A SKILLED SWORDSMAN TO START YOUR QUEST

title: Gamebook H. P. Lovecraft: The Haunter of the Dark
description:
게임 정보
I have seen the dark universe yawning
Where the black planets roll without aim,
Where they roll in their horror unheeded,
Without knowledge or lustre or name.

Nemesis



Beyond Games and Audiobooks

Robert Blake, the main human character of The Haunter Of The Dark, died under unexplained circumstances.
Do you have the nerve to play his role as written down by the master Lovecraft?

is an audio-active horror where less is more.
You'll see less, hear (fear) more.
Images will appear and disappear similar to the flashes of a night storm.
Music and sounds will indicate you the right direction in the darkness.
Use sound orientation and explore the winding streets of the haunted settlement to find and then escape the cursed temple.
Well, adventurer, you have a small chance called... hope.


In detail:

+ Steam Achievements.
+ Two audio-active modes: Story and Explore.
enhance your listening experience with various intuitive actions. Know when to open doors, chests or sometimes even dodge a certain death…
Let the music guide you through the dark, learn to move effortlessly without the help of your sight. We strongly recommend the use of headphones to find the right direction.
+ Cosmology & horror ambience.
+ 3D audio environment experience.
+ Intuitive controls.



Curtain-up!
autokwd: Gamebook H. P. Lovecraft: The Haunter of the Dark

title: Afterschool Adventurers Club
description:
게임 정보
Rumours are that the AfterSchool Adventurers Club started playing a very strange version of the "Adventurers & Perils" tabletop roleplaying game lately!
Most of the club members have left, too scared of what could happen to them on a bad roll, but, for some reasons, your best friend Billy and his party went in last week, never to be seen again.
Some students have tried to warn the teachers, but none would listen. Adults, right? Always too busy with work and stuff to see the truth!
There is no other choice, only you can do it!
As you open the door to the AfterSchool Adventurers Club, you see the evil grin on the Game Master's face:
"A new player? Roll for initiative!"
Gameplay
AfterSchool Adventurers Club is a rogue-lite dungeon-crawler game set in the 80's, where players prepare for their runs in the high-school's tabletop roleplaying club before entering the fantastic world of Vanderfell to delve into perilous dungeons, fight treacherous monsters, uncover special events and face formidable bosses to solve the mystery of the AfterSchool Adventurers Club!
Features
Randomized dungeons for endless replayabiity.
Multiple quests and events to keep runs fresh.
12 Unique classes, each with their own passive skill and starting gear, to fit your favored playstyle.
Lootable Weapons, Spell books, Accessories and Consumables to help adapt on the go.
Various Table Items to combine in the club to further customize your runs and character.
No power meta progression, your skills as a player is what matters!
Built for the Sega Master System, for an authentic retro feel.

title: Furniture Toss
description:
게임 정보
Set up this cool space by launching furniture in wild and creative ways! Earn style points with epic bank shots, jaw-dropping combo throws, blazing fast tosses, long-distance launches, and more. Craving an adrenaline rush? Take on speed run mode and race to complete your setup in record time.
Get the art pieces in the right places with a painting-shooting gun. But beware—drones are on the loose, swooping in with furniture pieces and turning your setup into a thrilling test of strategy and reflexes! Climb the leader boards by setting the fastest time or racking up the most dazzling style score.
Here’s the kicker: it’s also a memory game! Hunt down hidden furniture scattered throughout the house. Can you conquer the chaos, unlock your creativity, and put it all back together?

title: Final Remedy
description:
게임 정보
Overview

Final Remedy is an atmospheric, story-rich walking simulator with some puzzle elements and crafting mechanics. Solve the mystery, survive, avoid the enemies, or defeat them and escape!

Story

"It's cold! I'm cold! I am very cold! Is that snow?
Where am I? Who am I? How did I get here?"

You wake up in an unfamiliar place, with no memory of how you got there or who you are.

Your first priority is to figure out where you are and why you're there. As you begin to unravel the mystery of your surroundings, you'll realize that your only hope of escape is to find a way out of this strange world. But it won't be easy – you'll need to use all your wits and resources to survive and find your way home.

title: Saadex: Perpetual Storm
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the Saadex Defense Terminal in this strategic tower defense game. Build, move and upgrade everything to fend off waves of relentless enemies! Utilize tactical skills to reshape the flow of battle in your favor. Secure your rank on the leaderboards as the top operator.

The enemy movement is simulated with a combination of fluid mechanics and traditional pathfinding - a unique feature not found in any other game on the market. Enemy spawners slowly corrupt the game board. Corrupted tiles spawn enemies each wave. Balance difficulty by reducing the corruption growth to decrease the number of enemies spawning, or let it grow and reach a higher score!
Deploy Strategical Weapons!

Spend power to purchase one of the six unique intelligent towers. Each tower features fundamentally different mechanics, such as lasers, drone carriers, black holes and more. Move towers into the fray to save your cores at a critical junction, or relocate them out of harm's way when you cannot keep up with the tile corruption. Launch powerful rechargeable beacons to empower your towers and disrupt the enemy flow.
Upgrade ANYTHING!

Level up your towers by destroying enemies and spend skill points on powerful upgrades to increase combat stats or acquire entirely new abilities. Most upgrades have a compounding +50-100% effect on stats, designed to be meaningful and interesting. Once a tower is maxed, you can reset its experience to boost the capabilities of other towers.

Power is gained after completing waves. Besides purchasing towers, power can be spent on upgrading your cores or even the enemy spawners to intensify difficulty and maximize score gains.
Score High!

Everything is ranked - individual levels have leaderboards, and the global ranking boards showcase your performance across all levels. Saadex has no meta grinding; the only way to reach a higher rank is to improve your skills. Cheaters will be automatically identified and banned, ensuring fair competition for all players.

Craft your own levels using the in-game editor and upload them for others to enjoy. Users can rate your levels, providing valuable feedback to enhance your future level designs.

title: Re:AEGIS
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Re:AEGIS ☆

You're an advanced combat android, and now is your time to show what you are capable of doing. Show all those that challenge you in cyberspace who is the dominant machine.
FEATURES:
Battle against countless enemies inside a Y2K-inspired cyberspace.
Face various types of enemies and learn their unique behaviors.
Defeat bosses to earn unique character upgrades to greatly influence your run.
Simple controls and game loop for quick play sessions
Enjoy an endless mode to see how long you last against an endless swarm.

title: Kardashev
description:
게임 정보
Kardashev is a first-person, space set, open world, factory building game.

Everything in this game starts with the Miner. You place the Miner on asteroids, and use this block to mine raw ores. These raw ores can be used directly in production, but mostly they are processed into Ingot via the Refiner.

After you have assembled all the raw materials you need, you use the Fabricator to process these into either intermediate products, or other blocks that can be placed in the world. Intermediate products may be used in other Fabricator recipes, and so the complexity of your factory will quickly increase!

Logistics features heavily in this game, and so you will be using Transporters and Inserters to move items around your factory and to fulfill varying and complex recipes.

Explore the infinite procedural asteroid space world, and build the largest factory that you can.

title: Aureole - Wings of Hope
description:
게임 정보
플랫폼 게임을 천국의 높이로!
최고 속도의 후광이 되어 보세요! Ramila와 Ryleth의 고유한 물리 기반 플랫폼 게임에서 악마의 세력으로부터 고향을 되찾기 위한 여정에 함께하세요.
이 천상의 모험에서 속도와 정확성이 하나가 됩니다!
움직임 기술을 시험하고 초음속 속도로 달릴 수 있도록 설계된 레벨을 질주하며, 만족스럽고 빠른 조작감을 활용해 보세요.
악마 왕으로부터 집을 구하세요
악마들이 지하세계로 추방된 지 수 세기가 지난 후, 천국 왕국에 새로운 위협이 다가옵니다. 악마 군대는 자칭 악마 왕 라젤의 지휘 아래 이전보다 강력한 모습으로 돌아왔으며, 천사들의 왕국을 영원히 정복할 준비가 되어 있습니다.
우리의 천사 주인공들인 Ramila와 Ryleth는 침공 중에 천상의 왕국에서 떨어져 인간 세계에 갇히게 되고, 고향으로 돌아가 악마 왕으로부터 되찾겠다는 한 가지 목표를 품습니다!
배우기 쉬우며, 마스터하는 재미가 있습니다!
다양한 색상의 바이옴을 탐험하며 각각의 게임플레이와 메커니즘을 확장하세요!
직관적인 조작법으로 배우기 쉽고, 마스터하기 재미있습니다!

title: Arcane Tower Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Arcane Tower Survivors is a horde survival game where you face relentless waves of enemies in intense 20-minute sessions, with over 100 unique skills to help you fend off the onslaught. With a diverse selection of heroes and weapons at your disposal, craft the perfect build to suit your playstyle and overcome the challenges ahead.   
Between runs, delve into tower management. Build, customize, and upgrade your own mage tower to unlock passive bonuses and new abilities that will aid you in battles.
Features
Extensive Skill System: Discover and master over 100 character skills, allowing for limitless build combinations and strategies.
Diverse Heroes and Weapons: Choose from a wide array of heroes and weaponry, each offering unique abilities and playstyles to keep each run fresh and exciting.
Strategic Tower Management: Engage in a deep meta-game between battles. Build and upgrade your tower to gain passive bonuses, unlock new content, and strengthen your characters.
Fast-Paced Sessions: Experience intense action in 20-minute runs designed for quick yet satisfying gameplay sessions.
Progressive Enhancement: Benefit from a passive progression system where each run contributes to your overall power, encouraging continual growth and new tactical opportunities.

title: Testament of Power
description:
게임 정보
Testament of Power invites players to embrace the role of a tribal member on the culturally rich island of Ambali. Here, power is earned through time-honored traditions, requiring players to undergo initiation trials and challenge creatures native to the island's diverse biomes. By collecting trophies from these powerful beasts, players enhance their attributes and gain unique abilities, reflecting the island's ancient customs and allowing for a flexible and deeply customizable playstyle.

The game features biomes with escalating challenges, where players can battle increasingly difficult creatures and eventually confront Biome Alphas in cooperative gameplay, rewarding them with a rare and powerful trophy. With an emphasis on character building via trophy collection and raid combat, "Testament of Power" offers a unique and immersive experience in a richly detailed world.
Explore on Ambali
The island Ambali is divided into distinct biomes, each showcasing unique elemental wildlife and fauna. Every biome presents its own set of challenges and requires a different strategy to navigate and reach its central core. Adapt your approach to conquer the varying landscapes and uncover the secrets that lie within each biome.
All about Trophies
In "Testament of Power," character progression deviates from traditional RPG mechanics. Instead of leveling up through experience points, players enhance their characters by hunting for trophies. Each trophy not only boosts your attributes but also grants you new abilities. Every creature you encounter possesses a unique set of abilities that can become yours if you claim their trophy and successfully absorb their spiritual mojo through a traditional ritual.

This trophy system allows for complete flexibility in your playstyle, enabling you to tailor your abilities based on the trophies you've earned. Your journey and your power are defined by the creatures you conquer and the trophies you collect.
Conquer the Biomes for the Symbol of Dominance
At the heart of each biome lies the energy core, a sacred artifact fiercely guarded by a powerful beast known as the biome alpha. To challenge this alpha, players must partake in a specific ritual called Madilka. This prepared event reflects the natural cycle of replacing the old alpha with a new, younger one. During this event, players have the opportunity to defeat the reigning alpha beast and earn the rare and powerful trophy - the Symbol of Dominance.

This special trophy is a crucial component for a legendary trophy ritual that culminates in obtaining the "Testament of Power" trophy.

title: Klaus Lee - Thunderballs
description:
게임 정보

Dive deep through the neon-hued brash and bawdy '80s inspired classic 2D action-platformer with your favorite BADASS Kraut, Klaus Lee! Dust off your jetpack, grab your dynamite, and prepare your laser eyes to dive deep into Klaus' first challenging adventure!


You remember Klaus Lee, right?! No? Well, you should! He almost became a cop in Beverly Hills but then applied to be a private investigator in Hawaii and got bored waiting to find out if he got it. Moving back to Cali, he worked as an unknown stuntman while running a squad of troubleshooters that kept getting beaten to the clients by A much more successful Team. One time he barely missed his job interview at a New York startup and some dude named Zeddemore got the job as an exterminator of spirits.
Did you know that Klaus trained Maverick how to both fly his jet and play killer beach volleyball? This is only a glimpse of everything he experienced living life to the max. Klaus was a really busy guy!



This is the first chapter of the famous action hero Klaus Lee. He was the role model for Colt Seavers, he made Chuck Norris walk as a toddler and prepared some water for Bruce Lee. He dated all Charlie's Angels at the same time in the same restaurant at different tables and he taught Steve McQueen how to drive a car. We are honored to work with him.



Strap on your experimental jetpack and fly through caves, dodge nasty insects, temple traps, and other hazards. But beware: fuel is not an infinite resource.



The unknown creators of the secret temples build puzzles to keep intruders out of their sacred caves. Are you smart enough to solve them?



Riddles aren't the only thing keeping unwanted visitors away, you have to prove your skills against cursed walls, chasing spirits, moving stones, and other threads.



Create, play and share your own levels with other players in the Steam Workshop. Jump in the level editor and discover the countless possibilities.


- Classic platforming action with attitude
- Over 100 levels created by our cruel level designers
- Build your own levels with the comfortable level editor
- Share your level creations cross-platform with the world
- Discover a potentially endless number of user-generated levels

title: Wildwood Down
description:
게임 정보


Wildwood Down is a charming point and click about a quirky high school senior with Down syndrome who embarks on a darkly humorous adventure along the boardwalk of Wildwood, New Jersey. With his sister's life on the line, he must unravel a murder mystery, navigating eccentric characters, unexpected twists, and his own unique perspective to crack the case before time runs out. Can this unlikely hero outsmart the danger lurking beneath the cheerful fa-cade of America's favorite seaside destination?

The main character Daniel is voice-acted by our childhood friend / brother from another mother Daniel himself. He has down-syndrome, a fantastic sense of humor, and loves video games. If anyone deserves his own game it's this guy.

This indie game is a special project for us and we look forward to giving a percentage of the profits to a when the game is released!

"" will first be released on PC in 2024 and then onto other platforms and consoles from there.

The visuals are a "first-in-it's-class" for the P&C genre. A combination of 2D pixel and 3D graphics with a unique art style that presents eye popping scenery. Wildwood Down pulls players into it's world: cinematic camera work, a 3d soundscape, full character voice acting, and retrograde pixel art.
The protagonist Daniel finds himself making donuts, winning an underground wrestling tournament, and getting thrown out of bars in-order to unveil the murderer of his good friend and hopefully save his sister.
Provides an immersive adventure with quirky but lovable characters full of jokes, spoofs, and other humorous scenes. Be ‘Dan,’ and unravel the sinister plot of the "Boardwalk Butcher" and help the high school seniors and

title: Hex Jump
description:
게임 정보
Hex Jump - is Action Puzzle Game.
The game has many unique levels in which you need to solve various puzzles.
At each level, the player needs to get from the starting point to the final one, solving puzzles and overcoming traps along the way.
Game has Casual graphics and simple Plot, not to disturb you testing your brain.
If you enjoy action/puzzle hybrids, Hex Jump will definitely put a smile on your face.. and many long nights of frustrating but addictive fun. Highly recommended!

title: Battle of Rebels
description:
게임 정보
이 싱글 플레이어 또는 멀티 플레이어 크로스 플랫폼 1인칭 및 3인칭 슈팅 게임에서 좀비 무리에 맞서 싸우세요.

스토리
외계인들은 인간의 DNA를 부패시켜 좀비로 만드는 인간 복제 기계를 도심 지역에 설치했습니다. 기계를 비활성화해야 하지만 작업이 쉽지 않습니다. 먼저 기계가 설치된 영역을 좀비로부터 제거해야 합니다. 해당 지역이 정리되면 외계인 보스가 도착합니다.

Access Key를 얻으려면 BOSS를 죽여야 합니다. BOSS가 죽으면 컴퓨터를 비활성화하는 데 사용할 수 있는 액세스 키를 받게 됩니다.

행운을 빌어요!

게임 소개
Battle of Rebels는 여러분의 강점을 활용하여 승리를 향한 자신만의 길을 개척하면서 더 많은 일을 하고 더 많은 사람이 될 수 있는 자유를 제공합니다. 보급품을 모으고 상대를 물리치세요.



싱글 플레이어에서는 외계인이 지구를 침공한 후 바이러스가 지구에 퍼지고 국가는 이를 방어하기 위해 고군분투합니다. 침략을 막기 위해 전 세계에서 연합군이 결성되었지만 허사였습니다. 외계인은 훨씬 더 발전했습니다. 최첨단 기술을 통해 인간 복제가 가능해졌습니다!

우리는 더 이상 우리가 누구와 싸우고 있는지 알지 못합니다! 인간?

title: Primate Wars
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Welcome to Primate Wars, an immersive open-world survival horror experience where primates have risen to dominate the land. In this tense and atmospheric game, you'll navigate a vast and dynamic environment teeming with danger and opportunity.
Key Features:
Expansive Open World: Explore diverse biomes, from dense jungles and eerie swamps to abandoned urban landscapes, each filled with unique challenges and secrets.
Survival Mechanics: Hunt for essential resources like food and water to sustain yourself. Manage your health by staying warm in frigid areas or cool in scorching regions.
Crafting System: Gather materials to craft powerful weapons, tools, and upgrades for your village. Customize your arsenal to suit your playstyle and overcome various threats.
Village Building: Develop and upgrade your base of operations. Construct defenses, enhance living quarters, and expand your village to provide safety and support for your character.
Dynamic Weather and Day-Night Cycle: Adapt to changing weather conditions and strategize your actions based on the time of day. Nighttime brings increased threats from aggressive primate factions.
Intelligent AI Enemies: Encounter various primate factions, each with unique behaviors and strategies. Engage in intense combat or employ stealth tactics to survive.
Quests and Storyline: Immerse yourself in a compelling narrative with engaging quests that reveal the origins of the primate uprising and your role in restoring balance.
Multiplayer Mode: Team up with friends or other players online to tackle challenges together, build communal villages, and defend against formidable primate hordes.
Character Customization: Personalize your character’s appearance, skills, and abilities to create a unique survivor tailored to your preferred gameplay style.
Rich Audio-Visual Experience: Enjoy stunning graphics and a haunting soundtrack that enhance the suspenseful and immersive atmosphere of the game.
What to Expect:
In Primate Wars, every decision you make impacts your survival and the fate of your village. Whether you're scavenging for resources, crafting essential gear, or battling hostile primate factions, you'll need to stay vigilant and strategic. The game's open-world design encourages exploration and experimentation, ensuring that each playthrough offers new experiences and challenges.

title: FOMOGRAPHY
description:
게임 정보
FOMOGRAPHY invites you on a story-driven photography adventure. Step into the shoes of an aging man, navigating the labyrinth of his own memories. As recollections fade, embark on a poignant quest to unravel past mysteries.

The Photos of Our Past
As an elderly man losing his memory, you have been tasked to go back and relive his life. Remember the joy of life, the places you've been, the people you've met. Even those small fleeting details that we forget soon after they happen. Even the traumas, the things that we'd rather forget. Every snapshot is a key to unlock the next revelation.
It's Your World To Explore
While capturing these memories, immerse yourself in a visual odyssey through your lens. Roam through lush Australian forests, dive into subterranean caves, and soak in the atmosphere of bustling towns that pulse with life. Your adventure takes you wherever your camera points.
Personalize Your Camera
Don’t let mindless defaults limit you. Customize your camera, transforming it into an extension of your creativity. Choose lenses that capture emotion, filters that paint memories, or display guides that frame your story with precision.
Chronicle Your Story
Treasure those polaroids! Preserve greatness in your personal album. Organize and explore a multitude of memories. Revisit past scenes and gauge your photographic prowess.
There's hundreds of things for you to find! What do you want to take a photo of? Adorable fauna, exquisite flora, varied landscapes, sparkling gems, peculiar townsfolk, or enigmatic clues. Your camera, your universe.

title: Hexger
description:
게임 정보

Hexforger is a fast-paced roguelite in which you cast magic by combining the three primordial orbs. Craft and upgrade powerful spells in the heat of battle. Loot treasures hidden within the rifts. Die, and spend hard-earned gold to return stronger than ever. The realms are yours to conquer.
A UNIQUE WAY TO FIGHT
As an Hexforger, your weaponry comes from the elements of Ice, Storm and Fire. By wielding them, you can cast a vast array of spells amid the chaos to vanquish the demonic hordes. Will you summon the Reapers to fight for you ? Or perhaps you will call upon a Tornado to send your foes flying before burning them alive with an Eruption. The choice is yours.
POWER UNLIMITED
Destroying fiends is not only a need for survival, but also a mean to grow more powerful. Gaining experience, your spells will gain potency. Persevere and grant them a surprise. A single meteor was clearly enough, but what about three ?
DEATH ? A FAILURE ?
Just another opportunity. Slaying your foes not only comes with power, but also with gold. Who could have known it the hold the key to upgrades unfazed by death itself ? Still, be sure to empty your pouch, or entering the realms will do it for you.
CONQUER THE REALMS
Experience the best the realms have to offer. Open yourself to many cultures and locations. From the bloodthirsty corrupted orcs to the banished ones, an exotic journey awaits you. Be the one to crush them all.

title: Epsylon - The Guardians of Xendron
description:
게임 정보
Step into the shoes of Georgo Valentino, a Private Investigator. While trying to solve one of your longest unresolved case you end up with a lead to the parallel world of Alpha-10. One of your friends, a scientist, helped you cross over. Arriving at the other side you notice one of the scientists "friends" ended up alongside you. While usually working alone you find yourself now with an unusual partner. You should soon learn that this little girl has some special abilities of her own that can be of help to you.

You decide how you conduct your investigation. This influences the reaction of AI around you and alter the course of the story. Interrogate people, snoop around places and interact with various props in the game world. If this is not enough you can count on the special abilities of your partner. While you are out in the field you can task befriended AI with doing errands for you. They can examine objects you find or dig out information you can not find yourself. Play your cards well to find the truth.

title: Ruins of the Forgotten: A Wild Survival
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Play the role of a forest ranger who finds herself stranded in a jungle that has undergone a mysterious anomaly while on an animal tagging mission. As night falls, a mystical energy turns the once-peaceful wildlife into dangerous threats. In this open-world survival game, you must manage your thirst, hunger, and health while uncovering the secrets of the jungle.
Your Mission
Survive the jungle, discover ancient ruins, and collect emeralds ("Manis") tied to the anomaly. Build a strong base, seek help from animals, and face powerful enemies to unlock the truth behind the jungle’s transformation.
Key Features

🌿 Survival, Build, Craft
You start wounded and stranded in a dangerous open-world jungle, now warped by a supernatural anomaly. Managing vital resources—hunger, thirst, and health—is key to surviving in this survival horror environment. Scavenge for resources, craft tools, and build a secure base to protect yourself from the many threats lurking in the darkness.

title: Smash N' Crash
description:
게임 정보
Forget everything you learned in driving school. Speed limits? Stop signs? Turn signals? Here, the "rules" of the road are just suggestions. You've gotta win at all costs—whether it's through skill... or by sheer force.*
Vehicle & Weapons
Drive and customize vehicles inspired by real-world muscle cars, supercars, SUVs, and trucks—then arm them to the teeth with deadly weapons and brutal upgrades.** Build your perfect death machine and unleash chaos on the road.
Open World
Don't you just hate when the neighbourhood watch won't stop yelling at you about your reckless driving? If they've got time to complain, then they've got time to dodge a heat-seeking missile—problem solved!* From farm fields to construction zones, rock quarries to busy harbours—tear across highways, dirt roads, and everything in between, leaving destruction in your wake.***
Deathmatch
Twist some metal in arena-based battles where only the strongest survive. Speed might buy you time, but firepower is the only thing keeping you out of the scrapyard. Dodge missiles, unload on your enemies with everything you've got, and make sure you're the last car standing—because if you're not wrecking something, you're not trying hard enough.
Pursuits
As a problematic fella, you've made quite a few enemies. The police, the mafia, the overzealous neighbourhood watch—they all want you off the road for good. You can run—dodging traffic, roadblocks, and gunfire—or you can stand your ground and turn your pursuers into scrap metal. Either way, somebody's getting wrecked.
Races
The finish line isn't guaranteed—your opponents are just as ruthless as you. Outrun them, outgun them, and make sure the only thing crossing that finish line is you... or whatever's left of your ride.

title: Advaria: Chronicles of Immortality
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an extraordinary quest in Advaria, where the destiny of the realm hangs in the balance. As a seasoned adventurer, your role goes beyond conventional tower defense – now, it's about strategically positioning your magical companions to thwart the relentless onslaught of dark forces.

In the face of looming peril, you must forge alliances and tactically place your companions, each endowed with unique skills and abilities, across the landscape. These aren't just ordinary towers; they are living, breathing allies with their own stories and destinies intertwined with yours. As the savior of Advaria, your decisions in positioning and empowering your companions will shape the course of the battle and the fate of the entire realm.

Navigate the intricacies of both tower defense and RPG elements as you explore the fantastical landscapes of Advaria. Engage in epic battles, unlock the potential of your companions, and delve into the mysteries that permeate the magical world around you. And in the midst of chaos, find solace and connection, as romance blossoms between you and your companions, adding a layer of depth to both the gameplay and narrative.

Advaria beckons – will you rise to the challenge, strategically placing your magical companions to defend against the encroaching darkness? Your journey into this captivating blend of tower defense and RPG awaits, where every decision you make influences not only the outcome of battles but also the fate of a realm steeped in magic and mystery.

title: OverKnights
description:

Customize Everything
Take full control of your OverKnight’s potential. Swap out every part and personalize every card in your deck using Components. With endless combinations, you can craft truly unique strategies that reflect your style. The possibilities are endless!

Join Yatziri and the Wazhari tribe to liberate their hostages, explore hidden secrets, craft essential items and weapons, and strategically use fire and water in challenging puzzles and life-or-death battles for survival.
Gameplay features
Dive into a fully open-world island, offering boundless exploration opportunities.
Dynamic 24-hour day/night cycle and diverse weather conditions such as rain and snow, actively influencing your in-game experience.
Employ your versatile crossbow in various modes, including standard, electric, explosive, and flammable options.
