title: Chess Mess
description:
게임 정보
The Chess pieces you know, but with an addictive puzzle-game twist! You must get the highest score possible while also leaving yourself the material to capture the king.
Do I Need To Know Chess?
We hear this question a lot. The answer is simple: no! Chess Mess will teach you everything you need to know with move indicators and our tutorial system.
Puzzle Game Madness
You control both white and black pieces. Each piece moves how you would expect: knights make an L shape, rooks move in straight lines, etc. What's different is the quantity and placement of the pieces. Each level features a board featuring a randomly generated piece layout which pose a progressively harder challenge as you advance through the game.
Meet the Par Score
Each board has a Par Score that needs to be cleared in order to enter the King phase. Clear the Par Score in as few moves as possible for the most bragging rights!
Summon The King
The King will appear on the board after the par score is met--and the King is out for blood! Use your remaining pieces to capture him and put an end to his rampage!
Earn Cards
When you beat a level you earn cards which can buff or nerf (or sometimes both) specific pieces. Cards can stack, too! But watch out for curses, as they can add a serious wrinkle to the gameplay!
Infinite Replayability
Use a seed or start a New Game and discover a unique, procedurally generated set of boards that present their own unique challenges.
Share Boards
Boards are generated based on seeds and these seeds are shareable with your friends. Compare scores and see if you can beat the par score!

title: Xenomycology
description:
게임 정보
A single spore floats gently to the alien earth below. It lands, and against all odds, finds the minerals and water it needs to take root. Its mycelium spreads, and a mushroom bursts forth from the inhospitable soil. This mushroom is you, and soon your colony will cover the entirety of this planet.

Xenomycology is a city builder, tower defense, and metroidvania. You control a colony of extra-terrestrial fungus spreading across a planet. Invading aliens will attempt to wipe you out, so you will need to balance your resource gathering with defenses.

Gameplay

Xenomycology is played room-by-room. In each room you will start with a single mushroom, and steadily build up your resources to expand your colony. Some rooms will be contested - enemies will attack after a set amount of time. Enemies will come in waves, and you will need to build defensive mushrooms to take them out. After the waves are complete, you'll be able to move on to a new room.

Xenomycology is not linear, however. Many rooms will have multiple exits, and some of the exits will be blocked until you've unlocked certain technologies. This means you can backtrack to old rooms and improve your existing colonies. This doesn't just allow you to find new exits and explore new areas, though, existing colonies will send a percentage of their resources to new rooms. So, upgrading your old colonies will give your new colonies an advantage.

title: PathoBLASTA VS
description:
게임 정보
Patho BLASTA는 놀라운 AAA급 그래픽과 사운드 디자인을 갖춘 Shoot 'Em Up Arcade 스타일 게임의 사이드 스크롤링 슈터입니다. 다양한 유형과 크기의 포자, 드론 어레이, 바이러스로 가득 찬 여러 층의 복도를 통과하세요. 표준 무기가 장착된 함선은 전원이 켜지고 바이오 미사일과 다양한 유형의 특수 무기로 업그레이드됩니다. 이 무기는 가든 코어에 도달하지 못하게 막는 마이크로, 미니, 빅 보스를 포함해 몰려오는 적들을 물리치는 데 필요합니다. Exuoa가 기다리는 곳.

Exuoa가 지구를 인간 존재에 부적합한 세계로 만들기 전에 Exuoa에 도달하여 이를 저지하시겠습니까?

원산지 불명 A(EXUOA)의 바이러스 독립체 X는 수석 병원체 과학자인 Zed 교수에 의해 미국 중부의 외딴 지역에서 발견되었습니다. 바이러스와 가장 먼저 접촉한 제드는 누구보다 이를 잘 이해하고, 바이러스와 싸우기 위해 BLASTA Corp.를 설립했습니다. BLASTA는 여러 정부 기관, 특히 미군과 연계되어 있는 민간 조직입니다. 군대와의 연계를 통해 Zed는 감염 지역을 다루는 데 잘 훈련된 엘리트 바이오 병사 부대를 구성하여 Exuoa 바이러스와 싸워 전 세계적으로 확산되는 것을 방지할 수 있었습니다. BLASTA 회원으로서 귀하는 봉쇄 및 격리 구역을 보호해야 하며 바이러스가 통과하는 것을 허용하지 않아야 합니다. 그러나 격리 구역을 보호하는 것이 BLATAS의 유일한 과제는 아닙니다. 두 번째로 큰 Bio Corp.인 Industria NUMERA는 치료법을 찾는다는 핑계로 일부 엘리트 요원에게 Exuoa 바이러스 샘플을 확보하도록 지시했지만 BLASTA는 실패했습니다. 그러나 Zed는 NUMERA가 Exuoa 바이러스를 무기화하기를 원한다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 인류를 보존하기 위해 BLASTA는 Industria NUMERA와 Exuoa 바이러스 자체에 맞서 두 전선에서 바이오 전쟁에 맞서 싸워야 합니다.

title: Ember the Werefox
description:
게임 정보
Play the role of young Ember, as she confronts her fears in this dream forest;  curiously resourceful by day and mystically fierce by night.
Key Features:
Explore a dream forest as young Ember by day, collecting, building and preparing for the dangers of darkness.
Battle relentless monsters throughout the night as the mystical Werefox, empowered with fiery abilities, cosmic moon powers, and significant upgrades!
When not making progress in the dream world, awaken to Ember's bedroom, where new techniques can be purchased and dream-altering outfits can be unlocked.
Visit Ember's bad memories periodically in this 4 Chapter narrative, where a cast of magical friends will help Ember deal with her fears and become brave enough to drive the nightmares from her thoughts and dreams forever!
Utilize the Forest


The woods in Ember's dreams are how she imagines them: full of resources she can use to prepare for nightfall. Find materials to build and stock light sources, pick, pull and catch different ingredients for invaluable meals, and empower Ember's nightly werefox form! Ember's menu-free crafting experience enables you to quickly stack components together as you dash around the woods, using the fleeting daylight hours to quickly explore, scavenge and craft.


As darkness envelops the woods, Ember will take on her combat-proficient form, enchanted with fiery abilities and magical powers. As she eats meals, various skills will stack to give her a strategic fighting chance against the ever-increasing bombardment of spooky enemies. Take back the forest from the shroud of fear to slowly (but permanently) populate the forest with new food sources, enabling Ember to become yet even stronger!


As Ember is defeated in her dreams, she awakens to her cozy bedroom. Her talking plush fox waits for her here to absorb the nasty "dreamite" Ember collects while asleep. This is turned "courage", the resource used to purchase new abilities and permanent upgrades!

Ember can also catch up on her dream journal illustrations, which correspond to new discoveries and progress. These illustrations will give her additional courage to grow from, and a sense of understanding her progress across all of the dreams.

By accomplishing specific achievements in her dreams, Ember will also unlock dozens of new outfits, which will enchant her and the dream forest in many different ways!


While the plush upgrades, outfits, and story-based tasks completed in dreams are permanent, there are several ways each dream will give Ember a fresh start:



By improving and adapting to each dream and it's secrets, you can help Ember uncover and defeat the 4 nightmares of this dream world!

title: Frontier Ferris For Adventurers
description:
게임 정보
Overview
This is the frontier of Ferris, an unexplored frontier by mankind.
As an adventurer, you risk your life to explore this uncharted land.
Hunt dangerous wild animals, escort traders, cut down trees by yourself, and break rocks that block human invasion.
Main features
Skill tree: Gain skills to suit your style of play.
Store: Buy weapons, armor, and other tools for your adventures. Sell loot from your adventures.
World Map: Some outlying areas can be very dangerous. Check the map carefully. In the beginning, start from areas near your base and hone your skills little by little.
Information Gathering: There is a lot of information you can get in town that can help you avoid unnecessary dangers and advance your adventure. You can also earn money efficiently by accepting requests.

title: Neon Shift
description:
게임 정보
Neon Shift is a speedrun-focused, side-scrolling platformer with a twist! Run, jump and slide your way through levels as fast as possible, then shift into a phantom that can uncover new routes with a dash and chase yourself down to secure a spot on the leaderboard. Alongside a set of core levels to play through, Neon Shift features a level editor that allows players to design and upload their own levels for others to try out and compete in.
Neon Shift's gameplay is all about momentum - the player gradually builds speed as they run and jump, making mistakes costly when going for the fastest times. In order to achieve the perfect run, players will need to familiarise themselves with the obstacles in their path and link jumps and slides together in precise sequences to avoid collisions, all while running at breakneck speed. Reaching the finish line quickly is only half of the challenge though; the player must then immediately chase themselves down as a phantom if they hope to log the time. This can be a tricky task, particularly if they were fast on the first go round, but thankfully the phantom has a new trick up their sleeve - the phase dash. This can be used to surge forward a short distance and pass straight through certain obstacles, revealing new routes if the player knows where to look. Dashing through obstacles also resets the ability's cooldown, allowing the player to clear large stretches of level very quickly and catch up to their target before they run out of road.

title: The Ogi: Cycles
description:
게임 정보
Enjoy the moments, take it at your own pace, delve into mysteries, listen to the sounds of the wind and spot birds and creatures on your way!
Intro
"Welcome, curious stranger, to the world of Mullar!

Come, sit by the fire - you came just in time for the gathering. I would prepare some tasty berry juice, but the berries are gone.. Because of the storms. And so, I’m afraid, is half of our tribe.

Everything was so peaceful and cozy.. And suddenly, it wasn’t anymore. Suddenly, it was all chaos. We don’t know why or how. We just know.. That we miss our friends. I bet they’re lonely out there.. Lonely and story-less. If the storms keep coming, I think we will run out of stories, too..

But tonight, the Elder will share a tale. A dark, important one. About when The Ogi arrived - and led us into chaos. That one, it scares me. A lot.

Luckily, legends aren’t true. .. They aren’t, are they?"

Key features
A unique and beautiful world, filled with mystery, history, interesting creatures and life!
Draw your way through puzzles, unique places and a rich emotional story!
Play on any device you want!

title: Infinite Void
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Infinite Void!

Embark on an intergalactic journey in this retro-inspired side-scrolling space shoot 'em up roguelike that promises an infinite cosmos of excitement and challenge. Brace yourself for a relentless gameplay loop where you start each level at the heart of the solar system and fight your way to the outer reaches, confronting enemies and cosmic challenges along the way.

Key Features:

Endless Exploration:
Dive into procedural generated universes and solar systems, ensuring a unique experience with each new game. No two cosmic landscapes are alike, offering an ever-evolving challenge for even the most seasoned pilots.

Dynamic Gameplay Loop:
Engage in a captivating loop where every level is a battle from the sun to the system's edge. Face powerful bosses every 5 levels, upgrade your ship or pilot's stats every 10 levels, and make crucial decisions by choosing new special abilities or sticking with the ones you have after every level.

Simple Controls, Diverse Platforms:
Choose your preferred control scheme, whether it's WASD and spacebar, arrow keys and mouse clicks, or the smooth precision of a controller. Adapt the game to your play style and dominate the cosmic battleground with ease.

Ever-Changing Universe:
With each death, you'll have the chance to choose a new pilot and ship combo, diving back into the unpredictable expanse of the "Infinite Void." Experience a fresh start as the universe reshapes itself, offering an endless array of challenges and opportunities.

Immerse Yourself in Retro Aesthetics:
Relive the glory days of classic side-scrolling shooters with pixel-perfect visuals.

Get ready to navigate the "Infinite Void," where every journey is a new cosmic odyssey, your choices shape the destiny of the galaxy. Will you become a legendary pilot, conquering the ever-expanding universe, or will you succumb to the challenges of the celestial expanse? The choice is yours in Infinite Void.

title: Ultra Auto Gotchimon
description:
게임 정보
Digital Pets
Ultra Auto Gotchimon is a game with digital pets that sit on top of your screen, enabling you to care for your creatures effortlessly while multitasking. If you crave a more immersive experience, dive into strategic auto-battles, where you strategically select moves, navigate procedurally generated regions, and evolve your creatures.

Designed for Multitasking
Multitasking seamlessly—whether you're engaging in creature battles while watching YouTube or opting to magnify the game for a focused experience. Enjoy the flexibility to resize, move, and click through the game, maintaining its overlay presence. Immerse yourself in a world of synergies, unique typings, and evolving strategies in this auto-battler/virtual pet simulation hybrid.

Craft the perfect combination of moves and types by fusing moves together to create multi-typed moves, and train your Gotchi to adopt new typings.

Embark on a journey through procedurally generated regions with random events and battles, all while leveling up your Gotchi.

Show your Gotchi some love by taking care of it—feed it, play with it, and keep it happy. They'll be your loyal companions while you work, watch TV, or attend to other tasks. Collect all 19 unique Gotchis and create your ultimate team!

title: Little Oceania
description:
게임 정보



Place your little buildings, earn a bit of cash, expand your island, repeat! Position and rotate your buildings optimally so they make the most amount of cash per day. Make enough, and your little island will start to grow. Your session ends when you run out of space to build. It's like Tetris, but cuter!




Watch your ever-expanding island kingdom grow! As you plop down buildings, roads, rivers, castle walls and more, you'll start to witness your kingdom growing before your eyes. Strategize hard to grow your kingdom as large as possible and top the leaderboards, or just sit back and enjoy a chill experience creating a fun little world.




As you expand, you'll discover new buildings with unique effects. Roads that multiply the income of their surroundings, but must always be connected in long segments? Rivers that triple the income of their surroundings, but can only be built downwards? Lighthouses that raise columns from the sea, allowing you to build in those final crucial positions so you can squeak out one more island expansion?




Keep your session completely stress-free in creative mode. Nothing to manage, just complete freedom to build however you feel.


























If you got this far, thank you for reading <3 Check out these links:

title: Squirrels Gone Nuts
description:
게임 정보

You have three different player modes at your disposal: shoot, sprint, and slide. Shoot mode equips your current weapon for firing. Sprint increases your movement speed. Slide allows you to maintain your momentum.


If you can see it, you can run on it. Every surface in the arena can be traversed allowing for a unique perspective on the 2D arena shooter.


Shoot other players with your weapon, and don't worry you'll never run out of ammo. When you're hurt, grab a health nut to get back up to full health.


The way you move around the arena is only limited by your imagination. Utilize the weapons and mechanics to maneuver around and outsmart your opponents.

title: Aliosso
description:
게임 정보
Aliosso is a turn-based roguelike all about combining dice and cards to win battles and survive a perilous journey across the desert of Samsara.


Customize your dice: change their type, place a rune, increase the value of a face, or replace it altogether! Find the right cards that synergize with your dice, because there is only one goal: Power. You'll need every tiny bit to boost your abilities and stop the Djinn.

Cards represent run-altering effects that can influence just about anything, the rules are malleable, like sand.
Different locations and bosses have their own cards, straining your ability to fight back.
SWAY DESTINY WITH AN OFFERING OF WATER
Prayers can affect the battlefield and your run but require a sacrifice of water, a precious resource that you'll have to manage during your journey.
Unlock new prayers to start with, and find places of power to switch prayers as you play.








The last surviving human clans endure a nomadic existence fraught with hardship. As generations passed, the history of Samsara faded into oblivion. Long forgotten, , driven by an insatiable desire to reclaim its full powers and extend its supreme will on the desert and beyond.

title: Cult of Abaruth
description:
게임 정보
Have you always thought you are meant for greatness? Have you ever wanted to test your skills as a dark cult leader? Or maybe you just like Dark Fantasy with a bit of silly humor? Just now you can test your skills! Became cult leader and lead it to achieve fame and glory. From day to day you wil get more followers and the treasury will be filled with blood and souls. But be careful. World is full of danger. Who you trust depends only on you.

Cult of Abaruth is economic strategy in a turn-based system which is easy to control and play - but full of challenges. This simulator of cult management will allow you to experience the climatic soundtrack and stylish pixel art graphics. Remember to plan your moves - this game is cruel to those who are too reckless.

"It's your story"
Give a name to your character, choose its look and specialization of cult. Every specialization can change your gameplay and make it easier or harder.

"Manage your Cult"
Select an action using the appropriate menu, you don't have to move from your headquarters! Watch new cultists join your ranks, how your army recruit and how priest perform dark rituals! Buy new skills in "the tree" and enjoy the great power that comes with them!

"Create Your Own Headquarters"
Don't you think that one building is not enough for such a huge organization? Thanks to the build system, you can change that. Why not, for example, build tents for training the army? Or build a market? Some buildings can also be upgraded to work even better for the sake of your cult!


"Explore the mysterious world of Primeval"
Immerse yourself in the mysterious world of Primeval with the power of one of the Old Ones! Discover the history of the world and the creatures that live in it. Thanks to the event system you can decide about the fate of your organization as well as the entire region (and even the world)! Remember that it is only up to how you wicked you will be and who you will leave alive.

Feature list:
*Many unique events!
*Atmospheric graphics
*Music to highlight events
*Clear game mechanics

title: Sunflowers and the Goddess of Death
description:
게임 정보
우리 시대, Eithne 28년 겨울 61일, 우리를 인도하는 바람, 우리의 영원한 뿌리, Lucan 숲에 있는 언덕 위 도시의 여사제가 흙으로 돌아왔습니다.

우리 민족은 이제 대지와 바람과 나무의 여신인 버드나무의 여인 Imsha 와 연결될 새로운 지도자를 찾아야 합니다. 농작물이 자랄 수 있도록 땅을 축복하고, 우리 동족이 마실 수 있도록 물을 정화하는 것입니다.

누군가가 나서서 영혼들을 꿈으로 이끌어야 합니다. 누군가는 그녀의 신성한 성소에서 찬송을 불러야 우리가 축복받고 그녀의 진노에서 벗어날 수 있습니다. 자연은 친절한 만큼 잔인한 여주인이기 때문입니다. 그리고 나는 그녀의 불만에 대해 느끼는 두려움에 대해 감히 한마디도 말할 수 없습니다.

-Niamh, 약사이자 Amuniai 의 장로

게임의 특징:

🌻 자신의 백성을 지키겠다는 결심을 한 젊은 여성과 그러한 야망이 불러일으키는 고통에도 불구하고 그들의 의지가 펼쳐지기를 바라는 신과 남자를 중심으로 한 스토리 기반 RPG입니다. 설정은 고전 시대에서 영감을 받았습니다. 헤게모니, 의식, 무자비한 정치의 시대. 붉게 물들이는 것 외에는 아무것도 원하는 것 같지 않은 여신이 지배하는 세계...

🌻 다채로운 2D 배경과 3D 그래픽 효과로 보완된 아름다운 사운드트랙이 포함된 구식 영감을 받은 예술입니다. 이 모든 것이 당신을 깊은 마법의 숲, 덩굴로 뒤덮인 고대 유적, 어두운 비밀이 숨어 있는 조용한 마을의 세계로 안내합니다. 음악, 사운드, 예술 및 그에 수반되는 모든 것은 드라마의 맛과 함께 조용하고 편안한 게임 경험을 제공하기 위해 만들어졌습니다.

🌻 상호 작용 가능한 세계: 덩굴을 키워 접근하기 어려운 지역에 접근하고 물체를 띄워 퍼즐을 풀고 숨겨진 보물을 발견하세요. 정식 출시에서는 세상과 상호 작용할 수 있는 더 많은 방법이 계획되어 있습니다.

🌻무작위 전투는 없습니다. 지도를 돌아다니며 원하는 만큼 많은 적과 싸워보세요. 물론, 핵심 스토리 전투는 제외됩니다. 결국 우리 영웅의 죽음을 노리는 생물과 인간이 있고, 그러한 행동은 여신을 기쁘게 합니다...

🌻 과거의 위대한 RPG에서 영감을 받아 RPG에서 기대할 수 있는 모든 요소를 갖춘 시간이 지남에 따라 진행되는 전투 시스템입니다. 전투에는 다양한 아이템, 장비, 전략이 필요합니다.

🌻 사용자 정의 컨트롤 설정, 몬스터 및 전투 애니메이션/이동 끄기, UI 색상/메뉴 레이아웃 등과 같은 다양한 접근성 기능. 스토리에 집중하는 것을 선호하는 사람들이나 죽음 자체를 극복하기 위해 필사적으로 싸우고 싶은 사람들을 위한 난이도 설정이 있습니다. 키보드와 Xbox 컨트롤러 지원이 모두 포함되어 있어 원하는 방식으로 게임을 플레이할 수 있습니다. 이것은 완전한 목록이 아니며 전체 릴리스에는 더 많은 옵션이 있을 것입니다.


게임의 첫 번째 부분을 다루고, 정식 출시에서 기대할 수 있는 세계, 캐릭터, 핵심 게임플레이를 소개하는 무료 데모가 제공됩니다. 데모에는 이번 정식 릴리스에서 사용할 수 있는 모든 기능이 포함되어 있지 않습니다.

지금까지 우리의 이야기가 흥미를 끌었다면 데모를 한번 시도해 보시기 바랍니다.

🌻 전투원을 전문화하고 전투를 신선하게 유지하는 다양한 캐릭터 클래스. 데모에 포함되지 않은 몇 가지 예는 다음과 같습니다:
마녀 - 체력 포인트를 사용하여 공격 주문에 연료를 공급하고 치명적인 부작용과 함께 아군에게 강력한 혜택을 제공합니다.
안개 위버 - 다양한 원소의 마법을 엮어 연속 시전을 강화합니다. 공격력을 극대화하려면 체인을 계속 유지하세요.
검의 처녀 - 마법을 사용하여 무기에 원소 효과를 주입하고 자연스러운 신체 능력을 강화하여 칼날과 활로 적을 학살합니다.

🌻 마법을 사용하여 세상에 영향을 미치는 방법에는 관목을 태우고, 어두운 동굴을 밝히고, 먼 물체를 조작하고, 맹렬한 불꽃을 끄는 등 여러 가지 방법이 있습니다. 게임의 많은 퍼즐과 숨겨진 영역을 해결하고 접근하려면 마법을 창의적으로 사용해야 합니다.

🌻 부서진 섬의 운명을 결정하는 4막의 이야기. 이 땅은 Diadochi 이와 피에 젖은 Martellus 의 왕관에 의한 또 다른 정복이 될 것인가? 신들의 파괴적인 변덕이 균형을 이룰 수 있을까요?

🌻 전체 경험의 길이는 약 20~30시간으로 계획되어 있지만, 플레이 스타일이 얼마나 철저한지 및/또는 선택한 난이도 설정에 따라 확실히 달라집니다.

title: The DREAMFIN PEAK
description:
게임 정보
On paths untamed by feet before,
The climber ventures to explore,
Through magic cliffs, where creatures roam,
To catch the Dreamfin, and bring it home.
This game is a cozy 3d precision platformer in which you will be tackling small 3d platforming challenges while interacting with cute characters and completing side quests and minigames.
features:
A fishing minigame. Progress across each pond dock by dock.
Customization. Find cute hats.
Find Secrets: Fill the Ice Dragon's treasure wall with treasure throughout the world.
Adaptive soundtrack.

title: Edward's Manor
description:
게임 정보
Summary

Edward's Manor is a historical family house in the central region of Chile. Built in 1779, it has been the home of the most important and wealthiest families in the country. Suddenly, they've decided to relocate to Europe, and it is your job to make sure everything is in order before the movers come.

Features

Piece the pieces together to find out the reason for the Edward's sudden departure.
Tag the pending furniture from the moving company.
Survive the dangers that lurk inside and outside the house.


Stephen Cognetti, The Vicious Brothers, Mike Klubnika & David Pateti
company: Brøwn Marcó Studios, Felipe Carvajal Brown

title: The Shaman's Ark
description:
게임 정보
Game Features
Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world inspired by the aesthetics of nomadic Asian cultures. Explore the vast and enigmatic world of the Ark, once again standing on the edge of the Abyss.
Fight in rhythmic battles using the power of the shamanic drum. Let ancient melodies help you crush your enemies!
Defeat gigantic bosses.
Acquire abilities that will unlock new paths.
Meet various characters along your journey, each with their own story and goals.
Seek out and wear bones for your shamanic necklace to gain the powers hidden within.
Discover places of Power to restore and enhance your abilities.

title: BROTANK
description:
게임 정보
In a post-apocalyptic world, take the wheel of a tank and become a legendary hunter! "Tank Brothers" is a top-down action roguelike game that combines retro RPG elements, offering you an unprecedented adventure in a world after the end. Recruit companions with unique personalities, gather equipment, upgrade your tank, capture criminals, and uncover the secrets of the world.
Features include:
Diverse Companions: Each with unique skills to enrich your tactical options.
Powerful Equipment: Enhance your tank's combat strength to take on stronger enemies.
Versatile Builds: Different schools of thought adapt to various tank configurations and pilot setups.
Epic Boss Battles: Exploit your enemies' weaknesses and outsmart them for victory. Tank Customization: Personalize your tank to boost performance and appearance.
Join "Tank Brothers" and pen your legend on the wasteland!

title: Burden of Truth
description:
게임 정보
Burden of Truth is the next entry in the Burden of Proof saga, marking the return of this grand courtroom adventure! Experience the missing chapter from the original story which has been restored & fleshed out into a full game. Gather evidence by investigating the crime scene, find contradictions in the courtroom, and confront the truth with everything you have!



One year after his mentor's poisoning, renowned prosecutor Conrad Cross accepts a new case tangled in web of conspiracy. In order to determine the true culprit, Cross and his opponent, Kate Flocking, engage in a battle of wits and piece together the incident by analyzing the available evidence. However, this objective proves difficult to accomplish when it's revealed that a mysterious organization is interfering with the flow of information to the courtroom. Even so, the legal counsel is determined to persevere through these limitations and expel the lies by uncovering contradictions within the witness' statements. To deliver justice, someone must be found guilty.



But as the trial winds down, an unsettling situation unfolds when a mysterious figure informs Cross that his childhood friend, Sarah Fletcher, has been arrested on suspicion of murder. At the same time, the dangerous rebellion group mounts an assault to retrieve the , a database of information that could plunge the world into if it falls into the wrong hands. Knowing that Sarah could never be responsible for the heinous crime she's accused of, Cross must turn his entire mindset around to become the that his friend deserves. As the only person capable of saving Fletcher and preventing the catastrophic consequences of the Zero Data's exposure, Cross must enter a that could very well determine the fate of the world.



continues RobProductions' iconic hybrid-genre experience with third person investigations and challenging logic puzzles that test your knowledge of each case. Explore the crime scene as you survey for traces of the culprit. Collect evidence and make surprising deductions via the new , which highlights more information about about the status of each clue. Hold people accountable by tracking the source of each item added to the court record, or utilize on-hand items to get out of dangerous situations.



Then, make your case in the courtroom by cross-examining witnesses and presenting evidence that favors your argument. As legal counsel, you get to and when to hold back, but be warned; the judge and his counselors grow weary with every faulty step, so be sure to back up your claims with . As you make choices that affect the course of the trial, new discoveries can be made that contradict previous testimony. With logic as your weapon, search for the within the witness' assertions and take the fight to them!



The outcome of the case is in your hands. As such, to deduce the truth and deliver justice for those that have been wrongly accused!

title: MonoRace
description:
게임 정보
MonoRace is a cheerful monobike racing where you can explore tracks and get points by performing tricks. Try the game in VR and PC versions with unique controls.

Monobikes is an electric, self-balancing unicycles, and you need to lean your body to control them. We have transferred this control mechanism to the game.
In VR game lean forward to accelerate, lean back to brake and lean left or right to turn.
In PC version move a mouse to control your unicycle.

Experience the game:
There will be a lot of tracks available and there will be several race paths on each of them. You can ride the main path or you can take a short cut.
Get benefits by collecting bonuses.
Perform mortal tricks to get points and survive to the end without fail.
Be the quickest, or all your tricks point will be lost.
Lead in Leagues: complete exercises and get points to upgrade the unicycle and unlock new tracks.

Multiplayer mode: it's much more interesting to compete with other players and you will have this opportunity.

In training mode, you can try our unique control system and practice tricks.

title: Egg Chef
description:
게임 정보
Egg Chef challenges you to cook and deliver eggs for points, but try not to drop any! Play by yourself for a high score or online with friends to determine the superior Egg Chef.

Catch eggs with your frying pan as they fall from above. Try to flip them as many times as you can to multiply your egg score, but be careful not to drop them as you will lose points.

Play against your friends in online multiplayer to see who's best. Catch Items as they drop from above to either enhance your cooking or hinder your opponents' cooking.
Key Features:
Move the frying pan to catch and flip eggs
Deliver cooked eggs to score points
Flip eggs to multiply their point value
Online multiplayer
Catch falling Items to use them to your advantage

title: What remains of my sins
description:
게임 정보
What remains of my sins blends psychological horror and retro aesthetics with procedural generation to create a tense and unpredictable journey. You step into the worn shoes of an aging protagonist whose physical limitations and faltering memory reflect a life steeped in regret. Each time you enter a level, the layout and challenges shift, forcing you to adapt quickly while you search for the key to escape.
Beneath the grim visuals and oppressive atmosphere lies a deeper tale of redemption. As you navigate claustrophobic corridors and grimy, decaying spaces, echoes of the past hint at a lifetime of inflicted harm, abuse, and loss. Uncover the protagonist’s story through subtle environmental clues, confronting both inner demons and horrifying enemies along the way.
Will you break free from the nightmare and atone for your sins, or remain trapped in a cycle of guilt forever?
Procedurally Generated Levels
No two playthroughs are the same, ensuring each run feels fresh and terrifying.
Elderly Protagonist
Movement and actions are intentionally constrained to reflect age and vulnerability, intensifying every tense encounter.
Retro Horror Atmosphere
Dark and morbid pixel-inspired visuals, combined with unsettling sound design, evoke a classic survival horror feel.
Stress-Based Puzzle Solving
Rely on quick thinking and memory retention under duress to uncover crucial keys and pathways to safety.
Themes of Sin and Redemption
Dive into a story marked by past wrongdoing and the quest for absolution, woven seamlessly into the gameplay.

title: Deckadent
description:
게임 정보
Deckadent challenges you to build a deck from the cards you collect in the world through quests or other discoveries
Cards:
There are 38 unique cards to choose from. Get creative!
Quests:
Many NPCs offer quests, some silly and some serious, but all rewarding.
Monsters:
Don't let the cozy art style fool you; the world is full of monsters, each with unique attacks and behaviors.
Locations:
Explore four different worlds, each presenting its own challenges.

title: Park It!
description:
게임 정보
Park It! offers a sneak peek into the full grid-based puzzle game, where you step into the paws of a clever valet cat tasked with parking cars in tight spots. Whether you're a seasoned driver or someone who's never been behind the wheel, this game is designed for everyone!
Features:
-100 Engaging Levels: Experience a variety of parking challenges across 100 levels, each requiring strategic thinking and precision.
-Story Mode: Watch as a talented mechanic cat discovers its unexpected talent for parking cars in tricky spots.
CAR-INSPIRED MECHANICS
Consider the direction of the vehicle before parking. Optimise your moves with side turns. This highlights the engaging puzzle aspect that encourages players to think about the parking challenge.
Can you park perfectly without running out of gas?

description:
게임 정보

You continue the story as John Rand, a search and rescue officer stationed at Richburg National Park. After the events of Part 1, John now faces new threats as he tries to make his way to Richburg Mines to rescue Michelle and Elena before it's too late.

title: Knight Lolita
description:
게임 정보
A sleepy little machine doll explores a world of whispering trees, worn paths, deep seas, towering cities, scraped and flooded ruins, and whatever else lies under heaven. Meet interesting characters and murder them, or try to avert their deaths. An extremely lethal combat system with manual sword control emphasizes the decision to avoid enemies or slaughter even bosses in an instant in wide levels full of roaming monsters. The finished game will feature flight and more vertical exploration.
The game's levels are generated in pseudorandom chunks, themselves populated randomly with enemies, bosses, friendly npcs, objects, and effects. The enemies have absolute pathfinding ability through these chunks and will roam or pursue the player, while the player's objective is to reach the end by any means be it avoidance or slaughter, betrayal or cooperation.
Game in development, store page will be updated as more assets are completed.

title: Lost Tribe
description:
게임 정보
Aim and throw your spear to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies. Use it to create platforms that give you a boost to reach new areas.
Master the winds with the gliding spear, riding air streams to explore even higher heights.
Explore a vast world filled with mysterious encounters and hidden secrets. Use the environment to your advantage by swinging on liana ropes.

title: Kitesurf Runner
description:
게임 정보
Learn to kitesurf in 2 dimensions. Compete in competitions, travel to new lands, race for the finish line, or just land some tricks.
Learn to kite. Tutorial covers controls for basic riding, loading and popping, jumping, rails, back rolls, board offs, and kite loops.
Kiteboarding is a dangerous sport!  Watch out for jellyfish, drones, sharks, rockets, and crash landings.
Play through amateur, minor league, semi pro, pro, and heracles worlds.
Travel in traditional platformer levels.
Make it to the end but watch out for sharks, jellyfish, and drones!
Collect coins on the way.  Use them at the shop to customize your look.
Compete in competitions.  Bring home a bronze, silver or gold medal!
High score - high score wins - coins give bonus score points.
Best trick -  best trick wins.
Drone Madness - Hit as many drone grinds as you can, don't let the drones hit you!
Upside Down Grind Mode - Hit rails upside down to score!
Carrot Grab - Collect as many carrots as you can.
Race - Checkpoint race.
Trick Race - Checkpoint race.  Landing tricks gives you bonus time!
Customize your characters outfit and kite gear at the store, be sure to collect plenty of coins in travel mode to use at the store!
Collect powerups. -Jump Higher, -Ride Faster, -Spin Faster.
Indie developed.  My first major game.

title: Zooika
description:
게임 정보
Drop cute animals into a box, pack as many as you can in, but if two of the same collide they'll merge into a larger animal! 
Zooika is a delightful casual game where you'll encounter a parade of adorable animals! But watch out! These critters aren't happy when they meet their twin, match two animals of the same kind and POP! They'll combine to form a brand new, even larger animal! It's your job to strategically contain them all.
With every critter combined, you'll earn points and unlock new challenges. Zooika is easy to pick up and play, but mastering the art of animal combination will take some strategic thinking. So, are you ready to box in some fun? Get ready for Zooika!
Different sets of animals
Time Challenge Mode
Order Challenge Mode

title: E-Sports Hockey League
description:
게임 정보
E-Sports Hockey League is on a mission to create the ultimate online multiplayer hockey experience.  Get ready for fast-paced arcade hockey renewed with modern gaming tech. Team up with your friends and compete in online matches, tournaments, and leagues.  Customize your franchise and compete for promotion to the big show and win the big prize.  It Doesn't matter how, just win.  Create your own fantasy team and join a league with your friends or random players.  ESHL is a game for hockey players by hockey players.

title: Electro Havoc
description:
게임 정보
Enter a neon-charged battleground where survival meets explosive energy in this retro, space-themed twin-stick shooter! As you dance through waves of geometric adversaries, each defeated enemy leaves behind a deadly debris field—lure other enemies into these hazard zones to trigger devastating chain reactions and score multipliers.
Snag powerful upgrades that temporarily boost your ship's offensive and defensive capabilities while you craft the perfect storm of destruction, turning enemy movements into opportunities for spectacular combos. Set your own pace in this sleek, modern take on classic arcade action, where minimalist design meets pixel particle effects in a sea of vibrant colors.
Simple Controls
Mastering Electro Havoc is easy: Use the two joysticks (or WASD+LMB) to control your ship and spray bullets in the general direction of your foes.
Your Ship
Take control of the Starfighter X-7, a lightning-fast combat ship that comes equipped with devastating weapon systems, perfect for carving through waves of geometric baddies. Just... don't let them touch you.
Ship Upgrades
As you progress through the levels, you'll spot offensive and defensive power-ups that last for a few seconds in-game. Grab them on the map before they disappear!

title: Cupig's Key Collectathon
description:
게임 정보
Cupig's Key Collectathon 의 열쇠 수집 대회는 열쇠를 모아 보물 상자를 여는 간단한 게임입니다.
.
주요 목표는 점점 더 어려워지는 레벨을 최대한 빨리 통과하는 최단 경로를 찾는 것입니다. 넘어지면 죽지만 타이머는 계속 작동하므로 정확하게 맞춰야 합니다!
100개의 레벨!
점점 더 어려워지는 100개의 레벨을 통해 하늘 섬에서 심해까지 다양한 세계를 방문하세요.
빨리!
자신의 기록을 깨고 가장 빠른 돼지가 되어 모든 열쇠와 보물을 수집하세요!

title: Nightmare in the Old Mansion
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a first-person indie horror as you take on the role of John, a real estate agent invited to assess a mysterious old mansion. However, what starts as a simple assessment quickly turns into a desperate fight for survival when John finds himself trapped in a sinister nightmare within the ancient walls of the mansion. Explore the dark secrets, face unknown threats, and uncover the truth behind the mansion's mystery as you struggle for your own life.
"Nightmare in the Old Mansion" is a first-person indie horror game of the walking simulator genre where the average time to complete the game is 50 minutes.
Main Features:
Tense and dynamic atmosphere: Perfect for those seeking an intense and unpredictable horror experience.
Realistic and immersive graphics: Gameplay that makes you feel like you're truly in the mansion.
Intriguing narrative: Explore every corner of the mansion while uncovering its mysteries.
Impactful choices: Each decision can shape the character's fate.
Alternate endings: Your actions can lead to different outcomes.
ADULT CONTENT DESCRIPTION

title: Moon 2999
description:
게임 정보
Moon 2999 is a RPG game about Units & resources management, single-player or co-op action missions game set in a lunar base and its nearby space environment.

Set in the year 2999, advancements in technology facilitate the colonization of the solar system, giving rise to multiple factions due to enduring political tensions. As the commander of a Luna base, your goal is to supervise and enhance base operations, explore space, and undertake a variety of missions, encompassing engagements with aliens, bounty hunting, factional conflicts, and PvP combat.

PVP combat


Aliens war on Mars


Bounty hunting


Moon2999 is a strategy game set in a future where humans have colonized most of the planets in the solar system. You are the commander of a human faction and you must manage your colony by constructing buildings, recruiting units and leading battles against other factions and Kragh aliens. You can construct a wide range of buildings, from command centers and military missions to production plants and research centers. Buildings can be upgraded to increase their power and efficiency. You can also recruit troops to protect your colony and attack enemies. There is a significant variety of units available, each with unique skills and different weapons. Battles take place in real time or turn-based and you have to use tactics and strategies to gain an advantage over your opponents. There are also RPG elements, you can upgrade your units by gaining experience on the battlefield.

title: The Ogi: Cycles
description:
게임 정보
Enjoy the moments, take it at your own pace, delve into mysteries, listen to the sounds of the wind and spot birds and creatures on your way!
Intro
"Welcome, curious stranger, to the world of Mullar!

Come, sit by the fire - you came just in time for the gathering. I would prepare some tasty berry juice, but the berries are gone.. Because of the storms. And so, I’m afraid, is half of our tribe.

Everything was so peaceful and cozy.. And suddenly, it wasn’t anymore. Suddenly, it was all chaos. We don’t know why or how. We just know.. That we miss our friends. I bet they’re lonely out there.. Lonely and story-less. If the storms keep coming, I think we will run out of stories, too..

But tonight, the Elder will share a tale. A dark, important one. About when The Ogi arrived - and led us into chaos. That one, it scares me. A lot.

Luckily, legends aren’t true. .. They aren’t, are they?"

Key features
A unique and beautiful world, filled with mystery, history, interesting creatures and life!
Draw your way through puzzles, unique places and a rich emotional story!
Play on any device you want!

title: Ruins of the Forgotten: A Wild Survival
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Play the role of a forest ranger who finds herself stranded in a jungle that has undergone a mysterious anomaly while on an animal tagging mission. As night falls, a mystical energy turns the once-peaceful wildlife into dangerous threats. In this open-world survival game, you must manage your thirst, hunger, and health while uncovering the secrets of the jungle.
Your Mission
Survive the jungle, discover ancient ruins, and collect emeralds ("Manis") tied to the anomaly. Build a strong base, seek help from animals, and face powerful enemies to unlock the truth behind the jungle’s transformation.
Key Features

🌿 Survival, Build, Craft
You start wounded and stranded in a dangerous open-world jungle, now warped by a supernatural anomaly. Managing vital resources—hunger, thirst, and health—is key to surviving in this survival horror environment. Scavenge for resources, craft tools, and build a secure base to protect yourself from the many threats lurking in the darkness.
autokwd: Ruins of the Forgotten: A Wild Survival

title: Paddlenoid
description:
게임 정보
Your spaceship crash-landed in some kind of alien jungle, and you barely made it out using your escape pod. Now, you'll have to cross the jungle to find a city where you can hopefully launch yourself back into space and find your way home again.
Guided by your escape pod AI, you'll traverse 33 unique levels and face 3 epic bosses.
This game is a block breaker you can play alone or with a friend.
Game Features:
Single-player or 2-player local co-op.
3 different episode with a total of 33 levels and 3 boss fights.
An engaging story that has absolutely nothing more to it.
You're definitely not helping an alien fleet conquer and enslave the galaxy.

title: Shroomtopia
description:

귀엽고 알록달록한 Shroomtopia의 세계에 빠져보세요! 평온한 풍경을 탐험하며 다양한 퍼즐을 풀고 편안한 시간을 보내세요. 육각형의 땅을 조작하고 색을 섞어보세요. 자연을 되살릴 수 있는 건 오직 당신뿐입니다!



창의력을 발휘할 수 있는 레벨 에디터 제공
직관적이면서도 강력한 도구로 나만의 스테이지를 디자인해 보세요!
