title: Infinite Void
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Infinite Void!

Embark on an intergalactic journey in this retro-inspired side-scrolling space shoot 'em up roguelike that promises an infinite cosmos of excitement and challenge. Brace yourself for a relentless gameplay loop where you start each level at the heart of the solar system and fight your way to the outer reaches, confronting enemies and cosmic challenges along the way.

Key Features:

Endless Exploration:
Dive into procedural generated universes and solar systems, ensuring a unique experience with each new game. No two cosmic landscapes are alike, offering an ever-evolving challenge for even the most seasoned pilots.

Dynamic Gameplay Loop:
Engage in a captivating loop where every level is a battle from the sun to the system's edge. Face powerful bosses every 5 levels, upgrade your ship or pilot's stats every 10 levels, and make crucial decisions by choosing new special abilities or sticking with the ones you have after every level.

Simple Controls, Diverse Platforms:
Choose your preferred control scheme, whether it's WASD and spacebar, arrow keys and mouse clicks, or the smooth precision of a controller. Adapt the game to your play style and dominate the cosmic battleground with ease.

Ever-Changing Universe:
With each death, you'll have the chance to choose a new pilot and ship combo, diving back into the unpredictable expanse of the "Infinite Void." Experience a fresh start as the universe reshapes itself, offering an endless array of challenges and opportunities.

Immerse Yourself in Retro Aesthetics:
Relive the glory days of classic side-scrolling shooters with pixel-perfect visuals.

Get ready to navigate the "Infinite Void," where every journey is a new cosmic odyssey, your choices shape the destiny of the galaxy. Will you become a legendary pilot, conquering the ever-expanding universe, or will you succumb to the challenges of the celestial expanse? The choice is yours in Infinite Void.

title: Smash N' Crash
description:
게임 정보
Forget everything you learned in driving school. Speed limits? Stop signs? Turn signals? Here, the "rules" of the road are just suggestions. You've gotta win at all costs—whether it's through skill... or by sheer force.*
Vehicle & Weapons
Drive and customize vehicles inspired by real-world muscle cars, supercars, SUVs, and trucks—then arm them to the teeth with deadly weapons and brutal upgrades.** Build your perfect death machine and unleash chaos on the road.
Open World
Don't you just hate when the neighbourhood watch won't stop yelling at you about your reckless driving? If they've got time to complain, then they've got time to dodge a heat-seeking missile—problem solved!* From farm fields to construction zones, rock quarries to busy harbours—tear across highways, dirt roads, and everything in between, leaving destruction in your wake.***
Deathmatch
Twist some metal in arena-based battles where only the strongest survive. Speed might buy you time, but firepower is the only thing keeping you out of the scrapyard. Dodge missiles, unload on your enemies with everything you've got, and make sure you're the last car standing—because if you're not wrecking something, you're not trying hard enough.
Pursuits
As a problematic fella, you've made quite a few enemies. The police, the mafia, the overzealous neighbourhood watch—they all want you off the road for good. You can run—dodging traffic, roadblocks, and gunfire—or you can stand your ground and turn your pursuers into scrap metal. Either way, somebody's getting wrecked.
Races
The finish line isn't guaranteed—your opponents are just as ruthless as you. Outrun them, outgun them, and make sure the only thing crossing that finish line is you... or whatever's left of your ride.

title: The Shaman's Ark
description:
게임 정보
Game Features
Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world inspired by the aesthetics of nomadic Asian cultures. Explore the vast and enigmatic world of the Ark, once again standing on the edge of the Abyss.
Fight in rhythmic battles using the power of the shamanic drum. Let ancient melodies help you crush your enemies!
Defeat gigantic bosses.
Acquire abilities that will unlock new paths.
Meet various characters along your journey, each with their own story and goals.
Seek out and wear bones for your shamanic necklace to gain the powers hidden within.
Discover places of Power to restore and enhance your abilities.

title: Disc Dimension
description:
게임 정보
Play disc golf in an immersive virtual reality world! Whether you've never played disc golf, you play every day, or you're somewhere in between, you'll find an experience for you in the Disc Dimension. Customize the game to match your system, gameplay style, VR comfort, and skill level. Learn how to control disc flight in a powerful, high-fidelity simulation with dynamic wind! Build your bag by collecting numerous unique discs with amazing designs, after discovering secrets and earning rewards.

Visit our Training Hill, where you learn the basics of disc golf, hone your disc golf shots, and complete challenges! Use Throw Assist to effortlessly launch distance shots from your chair, or turn it all the way down for a true-to-life simulated experience.

Put your real-world disc golf skills to the test in a Natural Round, where it's just you vs. nature! Face challenges and lines familiar on traditional courses. Throw your favorite shot shapes, and master your form. Track arm speed, spin force, disc angle, and more! Hit your gaps, develop your hyzer flips, hone your touch upshots, and use any other throws in your arsenal! Increase your putting percentage and go for distance on your drive. Develop your disc golf game, and take what you've learned to a course near you!

In an Adventure Round, face mind-bending hazards that change each round, altering your course strategy! How low can you score, and how stylish can you be? Confront distance-traversing portals, speed-altering fields, gravity-warping orbs, and more! Each hole presents a unique puzzle, blending traditional obstacles like trees and sand with magical forces that test your skill and strategy.

Technical Features include detailed textures and lighting, spatialized soundscapes using Steam Audio, and SteamVR velocity prediction for precise throws. The game supports 1k, 2k, and 4k textures with a dynamic resolution option, so you can scale the settings to match the performance your system can handle. We support OpenXR, so you can play via SteamVR with your favorite devices that support this interface including Oculus devices, Valve Index, HTC Vive, and many others.

Whether you're a seasoned disc golfer seeking a new challenge or a newcomer enticed by the magic of VR sports, prepare for an immersive journey beyond the fairway!

title: Galactic Tavern
description:
게임 정보
우주 술집을 건설하고 관리하며 우주로 떠나는 여정을 떠나보세요! 이국적인 재료를 발견하고, 독특한 칵테일을 만들고, 라이브 음악 공연으로 활기찬 분위기를 조성하세요. 우주의 심연을 탐험하며 이 경영 시뮬레이션 모험에서 궁극의 기업가가 되어보세요!
위시리스트!
오늘 위시리스트에 추가하고 게임 개발에 대한 업데이트를 팔로우하세요.


Galactic Tavern에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 여기서 당신은 당신만의 성간 바를 건설, 관리 및 확장할 수 있는 궁극의 우주 모험을 경험할 수 있습니다. 우주의 생생한 한 구석에 위치한 Galactic Tavern은 은하계에서 가장 유명한 술집 주인이 되기 위한 여정에 당신을 초대합니다.

주요 특징:

🌌 우주 술집 커스터마이징: 우주 술집을 디자인하고 커스터마이징하여 은하계 전체에서 고객을 유치하세요.

🌟 이국적인 믹솔로지: 우주 모험에서 발견한 희귀 재료를 사용하여 다양한 우주 칵테일을 만들어 제공하세요.

👨‍🌾 우주 농업: 신선한 재료를 재배하여 음료와 요리에 사용할 수 있는 우주 농장을 직접 관리하세요. 고객에게 최상의 품질을 제공합니다.

🚀 은하 탐험: 새로운 레시피, 재료 및 보물을 발견하기 위해 용감한 탐험가들을 무모한 임무에 보내세요.

🎵 엔터테인먼트 스펙터클: 재능 있는 밴드의 라이브 음악 공연으로 고객을 즐겁게 하고 전기 같은 분위기를 만드세요.

💫 제국 확장: 시설을 업그레이드하고 시설을 확장하며 은하계 전체에서 새로운 고객을 유치하여 술집 제국을 확장하세요.

모험을 경험하세요:

Galactic Tavern은 경영 시뮬레이션, 탐험 및 우주 모험의 독특한 조합을 제공합니다. 칵테일을 만들거나 외계의 미식을 발견하거나 새로운 영토를 탐험하는 등, 이 우주적 여정에서 당신의 창업 및 발견을 경험할 수 있습니다.

여정을 시작하세요:

궁극의 우주 술집 모험을 시작할 준비가 되었나요? 재료를 모으고, 음악을 준비하고, Galactic Tavern에서 잊지 못할 여정을 떠나보세요!

title: Shadows Of Despair
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the heart of terror with Shadows Of Despair, a spine-chilling co-op horror experience for up to four players.
GAMEPLAY
Navigate through eerie, intricately designed maps, each hosting multiple Case Files that blend intense main challenges with three additional objectives.
Encounter a variety of foes with unique personalities and humorous voice lines, making every session a blend of fear and dark comedy.
Work together to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and survive the night in an immersive horror adventure where teamwork is your only hope.
KEY FEATURES
Co-op horror game for up to four players
Intricately designed Case Files with major and minor challenges
Enemies with unique personalities and humorous voice lines
Collaborative puzzle-solving and secret uncovering
Survival-focused gameplay requiring teamwork
Demonic AI adds dark comedy to the terror

title: SGS Imjin War
description:
게임 정보
임진왜란은 16세기 말 가장 치열했던 전쟁 중 하나로, 1592년부터 1598년(2차 침략 말기)까지 일본이 조선 왕국을 침략한 이야기를 다루고 있습니다. 일본군은 남쪽의 부산을 거점으로 한반도 전역을 점령해야 합니다. 한국 플레이어는 중국의 도움을 받아 침략을 격퇴해야 합니다...
그랜드 캠페인 시나리오는 최대 105턴까지 진행되며, 각 턴은 1592년 5월부터 1594년 4월까지 1주일을 나타냅니다. 1592-1593년 캠페인의 일부를 다루는 소규모 시나리오와 1598년 2차 침략에 대한 시나리오도 있습니다.
한 플레이어는 일본의 명장 히데요시의 사무라이 군대를 대표하고, 다른 플레이어는 조선인과 명나라 군대가 포함된 조선인을 대표합니다. 이벤트와 카드 플레이에 따라 양쪽 모두 만주 여진족(녹색)의 지상 유닛을 지배할 수 있습니다.

title: Devastablance. Mountain Brotherhood
description:
게임 정보
Devastablance: Mountain Brotherhood is a game set in a post—apocalyptic world where you will find many quests, puzzles and unique mechanics. During the adventure, you will have to face various obstacles, strong opponents and ambiguous choices. Dynamic storytelling and a variety of gameplay will not let you get bored! Travel, defend, fight and strive to achieve your goals! Save humanity and your people! Remember: the fate of this world depends on you!
BACKGROUND
The nuclear war that split time into before and after was the result of a conflict between Humans and Magicians. There were no conquered and conquered, the sky was covered with the ashes of war for centuries. When people came to the surface again and saw the rays of the sun, they were overtaken by new threats. People were divided into factions, and each had its own philosophy. You are the head of a faction of "Scavengers" - people who are trying in vain to bring back balance to this world, which everyone has long forgotten about. You have a high position among the people, a small army and influence, but this is not enough to prevent the death of mankind. The strongest faction, a huge Horde consisting of magicians and their necromancer brothers, wants to conquer new lands. Everyone will have to unite in the face of a common threat. Go a long way, overcoming many obstacles, making new allies and completing the history of this world! Don't let humanity down, it's you who can change everything!
・Many different locations.
・Many different game modes.
・Lots of interactive characters.

title: Wild in the West
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for a rootin' tootin' robot showdown! Wild in the West delivers thrilling third-person action with a unique Wild West twist.
Follow the journey of a mysterious gunslinger who arrives in the frontier town of Red Creek. Skilled but unwelcome, he faces suspicion and rumours about his past. But when ruthless robots invade, the townspeople must turn to the outsider they rejected.
Blast robots across the dusty town, upgrade your firepower and outsmart the relentless invaders. Uncover their secrets and face a mighty boss as you fight to save Red Creek. Can you earn your redemption in a town that never trusted you?
Experience thrilling shootouts, dynamic movement, and a clash of Wild West grit and sci-fi technology. Master your arsenal, outmanoeuvre your enemies, and unravel the mystery behind the invasion!

title: Burden of Truth
description:
게임 정보
Burden of Truth is the next entry in the Burden of Proof saga, marking the return of this grand courtroom adventure! Experience the missing chapter from the original story which has been restored & fleshed out into a full game. Gather evidence by investigating the crime scene, find contradictions in the courtroom, and confront the truth with everything you have!



One year after his mentor's poisoning, renowned prosecutor Conrad Cross accepts a new case tangled in web of conspiracy. In order to determine the true culprit, Cross and his opponent, Kate Flocking, engage in a battle of wits and piece together the incident by analyzing the available evidence. However, this objective proves difficult to accomplish when it's revealed that a mysterious organization is interfering with the flow of information to the courtroom. Even so, the legal counsel is determined to persevere through these limitations and expel the lies by uncovering contradictions within the witness' statements. To deliver justice, someone must be found guilty.



But as the trial winds down, an unsettling situation unfolds when a mysterious figure informs Cross that his childhood friend, Sarah Fletcher, has been arrested on suspicion of murder. At the same time, the dangerous rebellion group mounts an assault to retrieve the , a database of information that could plunge the world into if it falls into the wrong hands. Knowing that Sarah could never be responsible for the heinous crime she's accused of, Cross must turn his entire mindset around to become the that his friend deserves. As the only person capable of saving Fletcher and preventing the catastrophic consequences of the Zero Data's exposure, Cross must enter a that could very well determine the fate of the world.



continues RobProductions' iconic hybrid-genre experience with third person investigations and challenging logic puzzles that test your knowledge of each case. Explore the crime scene as you survey for traces of the culprit. Collect evidence and make surprising deductions via the new , which highlights more information about about the status of each clue. Hold people accountable by tracking the source of each item added to the court record, or utilize on-hand items to get out of dangerous situations.



Then, make your case in the courtroom by cross-examining witnesses and presenting evidence that favors your argument. As legal counsel, you get to and when to hold back, but be warned; the judge and his counselors grow weary with every faulty step, so be sure to back up your claims with . As you make choices that affect the course of the trial, new discoveries can be made that contradict previous testimony. With logic as your weapon, search for the within the witness' assertions and take the fight to them!



The outcome of the case is in your hands. As such, to deduce the truth and deliver justice for those that have been wrongly accused!

title: Park It!
description:
게임 정보
Park It! offers a sneak peek into the full grid-based puzzle game, where you step into the paws of a clever valet cat tasked with parking cars in tight spots. Whether you're a seasoned driver or someone who's never been behind the wheel, this game is designed for everyone!
Features:
-100 Engaging Levels: Experience a variety of parking challenges across 100 levels, each requiring strategic thinking and precision.
-Story Mode: Watch as a talented mechanic cat discovers its unexpected talent for parking cars in tricky spots.
CAR-INSPIRED MECHANICS
Consider the direction of the vehicle before parking. Optimise your moves with side turns. This highlights the engaging puzzle aspect that encourages players to think about the parking challenge.
Can you park perfectly without running out of gas?

title: Deckadent
description:
게임 정보
Deckadent challenges you to build a deck from the cards you collect in the world through quests or other discoveries
Cards:
There are 38 unique cards to choose from. Get creative!
Quests:
Many NPCs offer quests, some silly and some serious, but all rewarding.
Monsters:
Don't let the cozy art style fool you; the world is full of monsters, each with unique attacks and behaviors.
Locations:
Explore four different worlds, each presenting its own challenges.

title: Norah's Song
description:
게임 정보
Ordinary home hides a set of abnormal acts. Adam, trapped within the confines of his own mind.
The weight of Adam's past rests heavily on your shoulders, Guide Adam and help his indomitable will shine as a beacon of hope against the darkness. but the question remains: Can you survive long enough to claim the redemption?

This game offers no motives other than self-torture, designed to excite Adam's sanity and impede his path to freedom.
It also balances mind tricks and logical sequence presenting some sort of an exciting challenge to players.

Gameplay:
You are vulnerable in Norah's Song. Seek clues, interact with hidden objects, and desperately piece together Adam's story,.
Survival hinges on maintaining your composure. Avoid succumbing to the terror lurking within the house... and within Adam's fractured mind.

Disclaimer:
-Norah's song video game explores themes of mental anguish, may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy and may be disturbing for some players. Viewer discretion is advised.

-This game focuses on atmosphere and exploration, building tension for a deeper psychological experience Its story unfolds through unsettling imagery and subtle clues within the environment. Expect unconventional challenges that test your resilience.

title: My ranch
description:
게임 정보
This is a farming simulator game!

Here, you need to manage your resources to expand your ranch, raise farm livestock such as chickens, cows, and sheep, and grow a large selection of crops! You can sell your produce for gold to purchase resources and gadgets that will improve your ranch.

As you oversee your ranch, you will also have to take care of yourself, and stay healthy and alive. The game utilizes a dynamic season/weather system, which can interfere with the behavior of certain animals, and the growth of certain crops. There is also a combat system that allows the player to hunt wild animals, and fend off dangerous beasts that might assault your ranch at midnight and eat your livestock (which is also why NOT leaving them wandering outside your ranch at night is a good idea). Lastly, there will also be cute critters who will not-so-cutely eat your crops.

The game allows for multiplayer gameplay, collaborate with your friends to manage the ranch together, hunt or fish for a homemade delicious meal, snuggle with your family cat(s) and dog(s), and much more!

title: Level Down
description:
게임 정보
Controls
WASD / Arrow Keys – Move
Space – Jump
Z – Interact
Gameplay
Your goal is simple: reach the green arrow to ascend to the next level. But in Level Down, every move matters. One wrong step could send you plummeting—One wrong step could send you plummeting—not just one floor, but multiple levels down, undoing your progress in an instant. As you climb higher, the challenge ramps up with new mechanics, unpredictable tiles, and heart-pounding obstacles.
Each level is a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled obstacle course that pushes your reflexes and decision-making to the limit.. Will you take the risky path for a faster climb, or play it safe and steady? With so many unique levels, the game keeps you on your toes with increasingly complex challenges.
Key Features
100 Hand-selected Procedurally Generated Levels: Each level is uniquely designed to test your skills, with no two floors feeling the same.
Diverse Tile Mechanics: Tiles behave in wild and unpredictable ways—some crumble, some slide, and some even bounce you in unexpected directions.
Checkpoint Levels: Every 5 floors, take a breather at checkpoint levels. Interact with NPCs for hints, lore, or just a quick break.
Original Pixel Art & Music: Immerse yourself in a vibrant, retro-inspired world with original pixel art and a soundtrack composed by Blake Hudson.
Unique Mechanics
The heart of Level Down lies in its variety of tiles and level mechanics. Each floor introduces new challenges that keep you on your toes. Here’s what you’ll encounter as you climb:
Crumbling Tiles: Step on them, and they’ll fall beneath your feet. Timing is everything!
Slippery Tiles: Slide across these icy surfaces—can you recover before you fall?

title: EleBall
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the world of EleBall Circus and its brightest star—Eddie the Elephant!
EleBall is a fun, easy-to-pick-up arcade adventure about Eddie—a circus elephant who tries their best to catch falling objects while simultaneously keeping their balance on a bouncy ball.
Keep your balance while holding falling objects and watching out for hazards. Score big and the crowds will love you! Adjust to the situation in order to survive in the harsh world of the circus.

title: What's a King to a God
description:
게임 정보
Slay God. Stay God. Stop the Chaos.

What's a King to a God is an irreverent rogue-lite management sim where you play as a begrudging hero who has just overthrown God and must assume the role themselves. It is now up to you to maintain order in the world and thwart the forces of Chaos without getting overthrown yourself. You'll laugh, you'll cry, and you'll die in this choice-focused story that combines the gameplay of Plague Inc. and Reigns, using our unique narrative-based combat system. With a god's eye view of the map, you'll manipulate heroes, monsters, and locations to keep the realm at peace while building enough resources to stop the cycle of Chaos - of gods rising and being overthrown - once and for all.

Please note that current screenshots do not represent final look.
autokwd: What's a King to a God

title: Necromancer For A Week
description:
게임 정보


I’ve always loved monster tamer games, but I never have enough free time to capture and level up all the weird & unique monsters I want to try.

So I decided to make a game where there's no grinding for levels, and you don’t need to hunt for or capture monsters. Instead, every round you’ll be presented with a selection of monsters and must build the best team out of what you’ve been given.



With every monster having it’s own unique passive and movepool, you'll need to master them all if you want to be the best.



‘Necromancer For A Week’ features a unique combat system where the player is given a number of action points each turn. Every move has a unique cost, and you can also spend them switching out your active monster for the next in line.





The Yearly Necromancer tournament Has Begun!

As an ordinary groundskeeper, you're thrilled to hear you've been selected to compete. The Necromancer Council has provided you with a mentor to teach you the ways of necromancy — this is your chance to finally make something of yourself!

The tournament lasts for 7 days, and you'll need to win every round if you want to be crowned tournament champion.

title: ThrowDown
description:
게임 정보
ThrowDown 
A familiar yet unique tower defense game with randomly-generated maps, reactive mobs, and designed for replayability. 
Overview
ThrowDown takes the classic tower defense gameplay and pairs it with modern features that ensure every playthrough is a fresh challenge. Deploy your defenses strategically as you face endless new maps, diverse enemy waves, and intelligent mobs that will test your tactics.
Key Features
Endless Variety with Random Generation
Every game of ThrowDown presents a new battlefield to master. Maps are procedurally generated, creating unique defensive scenarios that require adaptation and creative thinking. From the layout of the paths to the strategic positions available for your towers, no two games will ever be the same.
Dynamic Wave Composition
Face the unexpected with randomly-generated enemy waves. Each playthrough brings different combinations of mobs, testing your ability to adapt your defenses on the fly. The wave generation system ensures a balanced yet unpredictable variety that keeps you engaged without feeling unfair.
Reactive Mobs - A New Challenge
ThrowDown revolutionizes tower defense with intelligent, reactive mobs. These enemies don't just follow predetermined paths - they analyze your defenses and adapt accordingly:
Mobs actively seek the most efficient route through your defenses
Enemy strength varies based on tower placement, creating a dynamic difficulty system
Witness enemies evolve their tactics as they encounter your defensive strategies
Strategic Tower Defense
Choose from a diverse arsenal of towers, each with unique capabilities:

title: Wizard Duel
description:
게임 정보
In Wizard Duel you take on the role of a wizard. Your goal is to defeat the opposing wizard.
Each wizard has unique stats and abilities (50+ wizards)
The game has turns of two phases. In phase 1 spells are played and in phase 2 new spells are learned from the library.
So you improve and shape your deck during the match.
You cast spells using mana and use knowledge to learn new spells (150+ spells).

title: Day Trader Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
Day Trader Tycoon: Make Your Mark in Stocks and Crypto
Day Trader Tycoon is a parody of the stock market where you play as a day trader trying to beat the market. You'll need to quickly react to news and events, leverage insider trading, and participate in several schemes to earn money trading stocks and crypto.

The game is story-based where you interact with a variety of characters and make decisions that impact the outcome, with multiple possible endings.
Gameplay Features

Trading Platform: Fast-paced trading where quick thinking in stocks and crypto can make or break you. Markets change in real-time based on news and world events
Interactive Storytelling: A story that changes based on what you decide to do, with different endings depending on how you play.

The Story

Fresh out of college with your finance degree, you land a job at Obsidian Capital, a small and shady firm. Your new coworkers are smart and well-connected, but they're not always playing by the rules. It's up to you to figure out how to succeed in this tricky environment, balancing making money with doing what's right in both the stock and crypto markets.



The game will be available for Windows, Linux and Mac.

If you like the game, please consider joining the for more frequent updates & discussions!

title: BROTANK
description:
게임 정보
In a post-apocalyptic world, take the wheel of a tank and become a legendary hunter! "Tank Brothers" is a top-down action roguelike game that combines retro RPG elements, offering you an unprecedented adventure in a world after the end. Recruit companions with unique personalities, gather equipment, upgrade your tank, capture criminals, and uncover the secrets of the world.
Features include:
Diverse Companions: Each with unique skills to enrich your tactical options.
Powerful Equipment: Enhance your tank's combat strength to take on stronger enemies.
Versatile Builds: Different schools of thought adapt to various tank configurations and pilot setups.
Epic Boss Battles: Exploit your enemies' weaknesses and outsmart them for victory. Tank Customization: Personalize your tank to boost performance and appearance.
Join "Tank Brothers" and pen your legend on the wasteland!

title: Nia: Jewel Hunter
description:
게임 정보
Begin a thrilling journey through time with Nia, a brave young girl who finds herself transported to an ancient world filled with mysteries and dangers.
In this captivating platformer, you’ll venture into a past where myths and legends intertwine, guiding Nia on her quest to return home.
Trapped in this hostile world, Nia must navigate her way back by overcoming numerous trials, solving ancient puzzles, and dodging dangers at every turn. Explore mysterious ruins, uncover hidden artifacts, and tackle intricate mechanisms that can either be your salvation or doom.
Collect ancient artifacts, activate portals, and find the exit on each level to help Nia return to the modern world. Your wit, agility, and keen observation will be the keys to success in this remarkable adventure.
Key Features:
Atmospheric World: Explore a setting inspired by the ancient civilizations of Egypt and Greece.
Engaging Puzzles: Solve challenges rooted in myths and legends.
Exciting Levels: Conquer unique obstacles and trials.
Vibrant Graphics and Enchanting Music: Immerse yourself in the ancient world.

title: Eternal Bonds
description:
게임 정보
Eternal Bonds는 두 캐릭터의 시점을 전환하며 우주선에서 퍼즐을 푸는 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임입니다. 당신과 예상 밖의 듀오는 우주선에서 탈출할 수 있을까요, 아니면 퍼즐을 영원히 풀며 갇혀 있을까요?
특징
작은 싱글 플레이어 게임 (플레이 시간은 당신의 지능에 달려 있습니다)
두 캐릭터의 시점을 전환하며 퍼즐을 해결하세요
각각 버려진 우주선의 다른 부분에 갇힌 우주비행사와 그의 로봇으로 플레이하세요
레버를 작동하고, 버튼을 누르고, 포털을 사용하여 출구로 향하세요
흥미진진한 이야기를 탐험하세요

title: Seedborne Soldiers
description:
게임 정보
Seedborne Soldiers is an auto battler roguelike presented in the sweet, nostalgic style of a low-polygon Playstation 1 game. Draft an army from 75 (!) playable units and fight to escape the surreal Dreamworld. Mix and match from a huge selection of traits, equipment, and trinkets to capitalize on powerful synergies and overcome unique enemies and bosses.

title: Maze Craze
description:
게임 정보
《퍼즐 마스터: 감전 미궁》의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 이곳은 리듬과 도전이 가득한 미궁 어드벤처입니다. 정확한 조작과 빠른 반응을 사용하여 연속해서 나타나는 장애물을 극복해야 합니다. 한 걸음 한 걸음이 중요하며, 완벽한 판단만이 미궁 탈출의 열쇠입니다. 이 "감전" 여행에서 진정한 퍼즐 마스터로 거듭날 수 있을까요?
고속 정밀 게임플레이
당신의 반응력과 조작력을 시험해볼 시간입니다! 《퍼즐 마스터: 감전 미궁》은 초정밀 조작이 요구되는 게임으로, 작은 실수도 즉시 게임 오버로 이어집니다. 고속 이동 중에도 침착함을 유지하며 복잡한 미궁을 완주할 수 있을까요?
동적인 음악과 화려한 그래픽
매번 새로운 경험을! 미궁 속 음악과 시각 효과는 플레이어의 움직임에 따라 변하며 몰입감 있는 게임 플레이를 제공합니다. 밝고 다채로운 색상과 우아한 그래픽으로 퍼즐 해결 과정이 더욱 즐겁습니다.
무한 도전의 복잡한 미궁
무한한 도전이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다! 각 미궁은 이전 것보다 더 어려워져 끊임없는 긴장감을 제공합니다. 미궁을 깊이 탐험할수록 게임의 속도도 점점 빨라집니다. 끝까지 버틸 수 있을까요?
자신을 도전해보고, 이 복잡한 미궁에서 살아남을 수 있는지 확인해보세요!

title: Elemental Seasons
description:
게임 정보
Elemental Seasons is a brutal exploration and survival game set in a seasonal themed world. Explore each biome, defeat every boss to earn the chance to escape this world!
EXPLORE THE SEASONAL BIOMES
Immerse yourself in a breathtaking new world divided into four unique biomes inspired by the beauty of each seasons. Explore the valley of autumn, the thick woods of summer, the rebirth in spring and the death of winter. Each biome offers its own unique challenges, secrets, and stunning visuals.
DEFEAT ELEMENTAL TITANS
Prepare for epic battles against 4 elemental titans, each embodying the power of nature. Face the fury of Fire, the uncontrollable wrath of Water, the raging tempest of Air, and the crushing strength of Earth. Each fight is a test of skill and survival against the elements themselves.
BRUTAL YET FAIR COMBAT
Face challenging combat where enemies wield elemental strengths, but you can counter them by consuming specific foods or rely solely on your skill to parry every strike. Every enemy attack can be parried with precision, negating all damage. Be a parry master or stack the odds in your favor, the choice is yours.
KEY FEATURES:
The world consists of 4 biomes each with its unique enemies and resources.
Parry based combat where the player can afford to not eat anything and still win boss fights.
Rewarding food system that gives an edge to players who need it.
Epic boss fights that will satisfy the player's fantasies of being able to control different elements.

title: Starbug Troopers : The 4 horseflies of the apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
As Bea prepares to become the 7th Starbug Trooper, the ceremony is interrupted by an attack. The 4 Horseflies of the Apocalypse return after years of absence. Bea must unite all the Starbug Troopers to put an end to the schemes of Lies, Famine, Plague, and Conquest.
AN ORIGINAL BLEND OF GENRES
Follow the adventures of Bea and the other Starbug Troopers in a humorous journey that mixes strategy and action. Outsmart your opponent by positioning your troops to your advantage and gain the upper hand. Or perhaps you'd prefer to outpace them, using your reflexes and agility to destroy all their ships.
A STRATEGY BASED ON SUPPORT
Increase your chances of victory in combat : position your troops relative to each other to gain greater support than your opponent and stack the odds in your favor during battle.
autokwd: Starbug Troopers : The 4 horseflies of the apocalypse

title: Soul Essence
description:
게임 정보
Explore a decrepit and cultist-infested estate, uncover your secret ties to the cult within, and collect awakened souls to conquer an ancient god looking to feast on your essence. Only one hour remains until the god is released at midnight!

World Features
Time is your enemy in Soul Essence. As midnight approaches, the cultists become more corrupt and erratic from the divine energy in the air that is rapidly spreading across the estate. The atmosphere will thicken making it harder to see, and the estate will become a hellish and terrifying environment. Each run offers a unique experience:

Random enemy encounters made interesting by the in-game clock. New challenges and foes will appear around the estate as the clock nears midnight.

Randomized weapons and item locations.

Unique and special world events randomly selected each run.

The clock feature adds an extra layer of uniqueness and unpredictability to the randomization in Soul Essence creating a unique, rich, and engaging environments that feels truly alive.

How you spend the hour is entirely up to you. Explore the deepest depths of the estate to collect as many useful items, awakened souls and ancient artifacts as you can before midnight or go directly into the god's territory to challenge it. Hold your ground or prevent the God's release all together.

title: Whispers Of The Shadow
description:
게임 정보
Whispers Of The Shadow is a story-driven first-person survival horror game.
Story
Upon receiving a tip about Detective Grace Lawson's missing stepsister named Amy, two police officers quickly go to the scene. When Grace received the news, she immediately sets off and when she gets there, she encounters a horrifying sight: The dead body of her police colleague. While she tries to understand what is going on, she suddenly finds herself trapped inside the house. Now, Grace has only one goal: to find her missing sister and escape this nightmare.
Features
One of the core game mechanics in Whispers Of The Shadow is finding and using candles. Candles are a critical resource that not only illuminates shadows but also acts as a shield against the enemy. In order to illuminate your surroundings and protect yourself against the enemy, you must move forward without getting lost in the darkness by strategically placing and lighting candles.

title: Meat Fest
description:
게임 정보
Meat Fest is a dynamic shooter with soulslike elements, arenas and corridors, secrets, traps and its own story. Built on the foundation of good old shooters, it raises the social problems of society.

To answer questions you will have to use a wide arsenal of weapons, an ax, and a suit to protect and dodge fatal blows and dangerous fauna. Collect the story piece by piece to get to the truth, which, as always, lurks somewhere nearby.
STORY
Humanity was forced to leave their home planet and settle on Radix, where leaders tell new generations that the Earth was destroyed as a result of natural disasters. Combat geneticist Marcus Berger, studying samples from the homeland of people, begins to realize how false such statements about the death of the world are. He becomes increasingly immersed in the search for truth and reaches out to black market dealers, consisting mainly of the opposition. His native corporation begins to see him as a dangerous unit and Marcus escapes from Radix, deciding to find answers on Earth. The player will have to face the current inhabitants of the cradle of humanity and find evidence of the theory of a man-made disaster, because of which the world has turned into hell.
MORE
Combine your attacks

title: WastedRoad Reapers
description: 게임 정보

title: Road To Wealth
description:
게임 정보
Dive into an immersive text-based RPG that blends rich storytelling with vivid visual elements and a variety of mini-games. Navigate through a harsh fantasy world filled with mythical creatures and menacing monsters as you make crucial choices that shape your unique adventure.

Begin your quest in a quaint village, then traverse through perilous roads, shadowy forests, and vibrant cities. Climb towering mountains, explore orc encampments, and discover hidden secrets, all while being guided by atmospheric artwork and ambient sounds that enhance the narrative.

Forge your own identity with a flexible character system. Whether you choose to harness the arcane powers of magic, wield a colossal battle axe, or master the art of thievery through ancient texts, your character's fate is in your hands.

Meet a diverse array of beings, including humans, elves, dwarves, and orcs. Engage in intense battles, negotiate with mercenary knights, and make strategic decisions that influence the unfolding story. Your mission is to survive, gather gold for better equipment, and conquer the myriad of foes and obstacles that lie ahead.

Enjoy various mini-games such as drinking duels, dice rolling, lockpicking, coin flipping, and card playing. Each mini-game adds a layer of fun and complexity to your adventure, offering additional rewards and challenges.

For those seeking a hardcore experience, iron mode presents a relentless survival challenge where every choice matters. Alternatively, save often to ensure you don't lose your hard-earned progress in this demanding game. With its expansive, non-linear storyline and engaging gameplay, this text-based RPG delivers an epic adventure unlike any other.

title: Korter 1996
description:
게임 정보
Korter 1996 is an exploration of loneliness in a point and click adventure game. You can organise and decorate your new apartment and go on expeditions to other people's homes to find more items. While exploring different apartments on the block, you get to solve puzzles that will lead you to more information on each of the inhabitants. How you interact with the items in their apartments will move forward their story and through item dialogues you get to know about their lives.
Features
Move around items and organise to your heart's content (or make a mess)
Hear the thoughts of people who have interacted with the items you find
Unlock new locations and uncover their mysteries
Progress at your own pace
Collect stickers
Unlock the catalogue
Redesign your apartment

title: Stratogun
description:
게임 정보




In an alternate reality you'd find Stratogun in your nearest arcade, consuming all of your hard-earned pocket change. Stratogun is a modern interpretation of the arcade classics of the 80's. It's easy to pick up, but very difficult to master. Shoot your way through of swarms of enemies, unlock weapons ships & perks to increase your chances of survival. Can you conquer the coveted top spot in the leaderboard, or will you die trying?



At it's core Stratogun is an ultra-fast space shooter with tight controls. The game also includes progression as after each run your score is converted to experience points which in turn unlock new gear. Every unlocked item will increase your chances of survival, but in the end it will all boil down to your skills and reaction time. The Red Orbit is ruthless, and only the toughest space pilots will survive the increasingly difficult waves of blood-thirsty enemies.



The visuals of Stratogun draw influence from the arcade classics. Wireframe aesthetics are combined with a kick-ass soundtrack ensuring that this would indeed be something you'd find in an arcade, if those establishments would still be a thing.

title: Recepta: Incarnation
description:
게임 정보
In a world on the brink of destruction, the Cleithosians and Shriners battle endlessly. A mysterious phenomenon escalates their war, driven by capricious deities Maar and Ishmaar. Follow Raphaëlle, a devout follower who becomes the vessel of Maar. Face divine absurdity and strife as you uncover the truth behind the chaos.

Gameplay Features:

Visual Novel Narrative: Immerse yourself in a rich story-driven experience, uncovering the mysteries of the world through engaging dialogues and events.

Turn-Based RPG Battles: Engage in strategic turn-based combat, utilizing a variety of skills and abilities to defeat your enemies. Plan your moves carefully, as each decision can turn the tide of battle.

Note: The base game includes 4 chapters. Additional DLC chapters will be available in the future.

title: 7821 Akuji
description:
게임 정보
7821 Akugi is a short, liminal horror experience where you pilot a makeshift submarine inside a liquid filled asteroid, searching for a lost science crew.
Story:
> loading decryption key 77CX223UI2F9
> ………… packet checksum validated 
> ………… decryption successful 
> ………… decompressing data blob.
> ………… complete
> data stream follows:
Emergency Log Entry 00
Something is up, power went off hours ago. Backups didn't kick in. Everything is dark and my o2 allocation is running out. What is going on? 
Door controls are dead and I hear nothing outside. I hope someone gets this door open soon. My head is starting to ache…  . Hope this isn't my last log.
Emergency Log Entry 01
I’m pretty sure I blacked out from the lack of oxygen. Barely awake when some Enforcers dragged me to the bridge and gave me two choices: accept a brain wipe for the last few weeks and return to Galene, or pilot some… submersible they made to find a lost science crew?
I know what those brain wipes did to other people, I ain’t gonna risk it. Plus Riley was assigned to the science crew - and if I succeeded in this task I was promised a 3rd class citizenship. Easy choice. 
Back in my room now. They left an o2 canister. At least I can breathe.
Emergency log entry 02
I can hear them coming for me. If I can't find you Riley. Know that… I might be in love with you. 
Press any key to continue.
Gameplay:
Navigate your submersible that is barely water tight through tight corridors with only a single light to guide your way.The hacked-together submersible only has a tiny porthole for you to navigate.Choose two routes: Be a good corporate employee and get the job done. Or choose an alternative path...Pick up items, keycards and solve puzzles in order to progress and reach the lost submarine!

title: Blood Sins
description:
게임 정보
Enter the Shadows of Harda
The kingdom of Harda has thrived for centuries under the benevolent rule of the Houser family. But an insidious corruption now creeps out of Wick Cave, threatening to plunge the land into chaos. Monsters, driven by malevolent forces, have begun to emerge, their dark influence spreading fear and destruction. The kingdom's soldiers hold the line, but mere defense cannot save Harda. A hero is needed—someone fearless enough to confront the source of the evil and uncover the secrets buried in the shadows.

Amrak's invasion is an enigma, shrouded in mystery and cloaked in terror. How did it happen? Why now? And most importantly, how can it be stopped? These are the questions you, as a battle-hardened mercenary, must answer. But you won’t journey alone. As you explore the haunting depths of Wick Cave and the labyrinthine underworld, you’ll uncover secrets that could reshape the future—or doom Harda forever.

Navigate a perilous world where every choice matters. From intense, skill-driven battles to the whispered clues hidden in forgotten relics and cryptic notes, every moment tests your resolve. Your actions will shape the story, influence the land's fate, and determine if Harda will ever find peace again. Are you ready to carve your legacy in blood and fire?

title: Flesh Everest
description:
게임 정보

Heavily inspired by old retro horror games, FLESH EVEREST mixes intense survival horror with slow-paced fps combat. Ammo is rare, enemies are tough, and each bullet counts. Built within a massive living organism, the Flesh Everest Nature Attraction is a one-of-a-kind facility that's open to the public and scientists alike. It seems however, that some cataclysmic event is occurring. Play as a police officer attempting to save those trapped below the flesh's surface.
Intense Gory Combat

Face numerous different flesh entities with varying levels of threat. Some may be docile while others are highly aggressive.
Some entities, while slow, are unkillable and force the player to flee.
Contains minimal save points with a permadeath option.

title: Hostile Lands
description:
게임 정보
Hostile Lands is a 2D top-down roguelite shooter where a crash landing is mistaken for an act of war. The game moves through 11 environments, where players will encounter many types of enemies, find hundreds of unique weapons and discover the reason behind the crash.
With procedurally generated levels, alternate bosses, random gun spawns, up to 3 different endings, as well as playable lore sections, players will have a unique experience every time.
Collect them All!
6 different gun types for all play styles: Pistols, Revolvers, Shotguns, SMGs, Assault Rifles, Sniper Rifles…and perhaps some secrets you’ll just have to discover for yourself…

title: Stellar Dawn: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
용감한 전사여, 인터스텔라 도전에 준비하세요
"스타라이트: 생존자"는 알려지지 않은 인터스텔라 황야로 떠나는 생존 게임입니다. 여기에서는 최첨단 고급 기술 무기로 무수한 적과 맞서 싸우는 용감한 전사로 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 각 전투는 긴장과 흥분으로 가득차며, 각 적은 전진하는 길에 큰 장애물이 될 수 있습니다. 손에 든 무기와 전략을 활용하여 강력한 적을 물리치고 생존의 기회를 얻어야 합니다.
미지의 탐험과 귀중한 보물 발굴하기
신비로운 인터스텔라 황야를 탐험하고 지표면 아래에 숨겨진 귀중한 보물을 발견하세요. 생존뿐만 아니라 이 미지의 땅에서 가장 귀중한 자원을 발굴하는 것이 여러분의 임무입니다. 이 보물들은 즉각적인 이익을 가져다주는데 그치지 않고 전투 능력과 생존 능력을 향상시키는 강력한 업그레이드를 해제하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 각 발굴은 모험이자 각 발견은 놀라움의 순간입니다. 계속 전진하고, 알려지지 않은 지역을 탐험하며 더 많은 보물을 찾아야 합니다.
인내와 지혜로 진정한 생존자가 되기
위기에 가득한 인터스텔라 황야에서는 인내와 지혜만이 여러분의 생존을 가능하게 합니다. 전례 없는 도전에 직면하고 다양한 어려움을 극복해야 진정한 생존자가 될 수 있습니다. 준비되셨나요? 이 모험 여행을 시작하고 알려지지 않은 도전을 맞이하여 스타라이트에서 가장 용감한 전사가 되어봅시다.

"스타라이트: 생존자"가 여러분의 참여를 기다리고 있습니다. 함께 이 신비로운 인터스텔라 황야를 정복하고 여러분만의 전설을 만들어봅시다!

title: Langort
description:
게임 정보


로그라이트 덱빌딩 핵 앤 슬래시 게임인 Langort에서 정의롭고 대담한 검사로서 리치 여왕을 물리치기 위한 모험을 시작하세요. 처치할 때마다 더욱 강해지는 수많은 언데드 군단과 맞서 싸우세요. 죽이고, 죽고, 배우고, 이를 반복하세요.

특별한 능력을 개방하세요

모험하면서 발견한 마법 두루마리를 이용해 능력을 개방하세요! 당신은 단 3개의 슬롯을 갖고 있습니다. 따라서 어떤 능력을 택할지, 어떤 능력을 두고 갈지 선택해야 합니다.


언데드를 처치하세요!

수많은 업그레이드 카드 중 원하는 카드를 골라 영웅을 강화하세요. 당신만의 플레이 스타일에 맞추어, 당신만의 영웅을 만드세요!

title: Gravepact
description:
게임 정보
Gravepact is a survival roguelite where the goal is to destroy as many incoming enemies as possible, while collecting experience to spend on attacks, passive items and skills to build your character into a powerful conduit of destruction that lays waste to everything in your way.

Eight strangers find themselves pulled towards a long forgotten graveyard, under the power of an invisible force they are incapable of resisting. Why were they gathered here? Who commands the coven of witches determined to keep them there? What dark secrets are your companions hiding from you, or even from themselves?
Features
Eight characters with branching class upgrades that provide additional skills and improve your primary attack in their own way.
Start from a Gravekeeper shoveling zombies over the head and end with a Wraith Queen that commands angry ghosts to shred her enemies to pieces.
Or begin as a humble Occultist threshing enemies with zig-zagging Eldritch Bolts as he works his way up to becoming an Archmage of unimaginable power.
From magic and archery to summoning and just good old fashioned hacking and slashing, there is a playstyle for everyone.

Bank upgrades
Levelups in Gravepact do not constantly interrupt your gameplay the way they do in most Survivor type games Open up your character screen at any time to spend your level-ups on new weapons, items and upgrades, as well as improve your skills. A + sign on your portrait will let you know if there is something new to be gained.

Forge new weapons, spells and powers
Hate having to get a specific item to upgrade a specific attack into another specific attack? Gravepact does away with narrow limitations. You don't need any specific passive item to upgrade any specific attack. Attacks are upgraded using gems you find during the game and any base attack type can be turned into an ultimate attack type. IE: A base weapon like the Javelin can be turned into any Ultimate weapon like the Knife of Hearts or the Muramasa.

Dig up the past to increase your power
All of the characters have something to contribute beyond their skill in carnage. As you discover more about them and the place you are stuck in together your collective power will grow. Better stats, new and improved starting bonuses, in-run character updates and events, and more.

title: Dark Symphony
description:
게임 정보
In the dead of night, amidst the ominous whispers of the forest, a nightmare awakens. Welcome to Dark Symphony, a spine-chilling first-person horror experience that plunges you into a haunting tale of obsession, madness, and survival.



Story
You are John, a man who wakes from a restless sleep beside his wife in your secluded cabin deep in the woods. Your peaceful night is shattered by the eerie mumblings of an unnamed man outside, searching desperately for his lost vinyl records. He scattered these six records in his drunken stupor, each containing a movement from Percy Grainger's "Lincolnshire Posy," throughout the forest clearing. The man, driven to the brink of madness by his obsession with this music, will stop at nothing to retrieve them.

The stakes are terrifyingly high. The strange man is temporarily distracted as the records play, giving you precious moments to locate and place the remaining records on one of the six gramophones scattered around the clearing. But beware: if he catches you, he will chase you down and end your life. Should the current gramophone finish playing before you find the next record, the man will storm into your cabin and kill your sleeping wife, ending your desperate quest in horror and failure.











Can you unravel the mystery of the strange man and his cursed records? Will you save your wife and escape the forest alive? The gramophones are waiting, and the night is closing in. Prepare yourself for a journey into darkness, where every decision could be your last.

title: ROPOKO  Steam
description:
게임 정보
ROPOKO is an interactive fiction-style adventure game. Players become the robot Ropoko and must escape from a maze-like laboratory with the help of "Doctor." Learn words through conversations and use the vocabulary you've acquired to solve various puzzles!
The Steam version is an enhanced adaptation of the original MZ-700 version, improving playability with features like word selection, auto-mapping, hint functions, and gamepad support, making it easy to enjoy in any play environment.
Story
Forty years have passed since the MZ-700 conquered the Japanese computer market. Nowadays, every citizen has at least two MZ-700s per person, except for a few oddballs who use obscure computers like Windows or Mac.
One day, the AI managing a laboratory suddenly went out of control, initiating a 700-year long expansion project. To escape the labyrinthine lab, "Doctor" activated a newly created robot equipped with a Z80 processor, named Ropoko.
Gameplay
Though interactive fiction games are generally considered high difficulty, we've designed ROPOKO to be accessible even for those unfamiliar with the genre.
Movement is handled entirely with the cursor keys (D-pad), providing smooth navigation similar to action games or RPGs.
In traditional text adventure games, players input commands as keywords to direct the character's actions. In ROPOKO, only one noun is needed to issue commands. You don't need to input verbs or objects as in conventional games; just type a noun while in contact with the target to ask questions or use items.
Examples: "ropoko," "laboratory," "door," "wire."
Only words encountered in previous conversations can be used, so increasing your vocabulary through repeated dialogue is key to progression. Commands can be entered either by typing directly on the keyboard or selecting words using a cursor.
The game includes various puzzles, mini-games, and complex dungeons to keep players entertained. After completing the game, you can aim for the shortest completion time or the highest vocabulary score. The estimated initial playtime is around 7 hours.

title: MEGARACER QUANTUMRUSH
description:
게임 정보
MegaRacer QuantumRush - 궁극의 VR 오픈 월드 레이싱 경험
MegaRacer QuantumRush는 VR 레이싱 게임의 새로운 기준을 제시하는 몰입형 오픈 월드 카트 레이싱 게임입니다. 거대한 미래 도시 Mega City를 배경으로, 귀여운 애니메이션 스타일의 캐릭터와 독창적인 카트를 운전하며 다양한 모드를 즐길 수 있습니다. 이 게임은 모든 연령대의 플레이어가 몰입하고 즐길 수 있도록 설계되었으며, 초보자부터 숙련자까지 만족시킬 다채로운 콘텐츠를 제공합니다.
다양한 게임 모드
MegaRacer QuantumRush는 단순히 레이싱을 넘어선 게임 경험을 제공합니다. 다음과 같은 다양한 게임 모드를 통해 끊임없이 새로운 재미를 느낄 수 있습니다:
스트리트 레이싱: Mega City의 도심을 질주하며 빠른 속도와 민첩성을 요구하는 레이스를 즐기세요.
장애물 레이싱: 전략적인 플레이가 필요한 이 모드에서는 복잡한 장애물을 극복하며 우승을 노립니다.
왕관 쟁탈전: 정해진 시간 안에 왕관을 쟁취하고, 끝까지 방어해 승리하세요.
축구 모드: 레이싱과 축구가 결합된 독창적인 모드로, 카트를 이용해 공을 몰고 골을 넣으며 팀워크를 발휘하세요.
Mega City를 탐험하며 10여 종 이상의 색다른 모드와 특별한 이벤트를 발견하고 도전해 보세요.
VR에 최적화된 몰입감과 편안함

title: Super reaKtor
description:
게임 정보

Super reaKtor is a fast-paced Bullet Hell with original controls, where you must survive by collecting green energy pellets, and avoid or absorb various types of hostile TRI-SKL bullets.
BUT WHAT MAKES IT SPECIAL?
THE CONTROLS: You can Move, Rotate, but also change the Size of your laser beam.
THE GAMEPLAY: Your 2 weak points are located on each side of your laser beam. Your central beam can absorb hostile bullets !
FEATURES
ARCADE MODES: 3 major game modes, over 300 hand crafted patterns across 5 levels
ONLINE LEADERBOARDS: Compete with the world and your friends
TRAINING MODE: Master the patterns in a safe zone
ACHIEVEMENTS: Collect them all

title: Skyline Savior
description:
게임 정보
Get ready to dive into the high-speed, action-packed world of Skyline Savior!

Take control of Sam’s car and navigate through a series of exciting and challenging environments. With a unique set of abilities at your disposal, you’ll need to overcome difficult obstacles to become the ultimate hero of the skies.

Thrilling Gameplay Mechanics

Arcadey Car Movement: Enjoy smooth, responsive driving with the ability to jump, dash, and perform awesome stunts.


Magnet: Use the car’s magnet to interact with various magnets around the map, overcoming obstacles by attracting or repelling the car.


Slow Motion: Slow down time to navigate through tricky sequences and nail those precise maneuvers. You are falling down? Slow the time down so you can afford waiting for the dash cooldown to end.

title: Blitloop
description:
게임 정보
Blitloop is a fast-paced, retro-styled space arcade shooter. You play as “Blit” on a mission to rescue orb pods and save the galaxy. Take down countless enemy ships and face massive bosses as you zip through a stylish world. And at the same time, rush to rescue the pods scattered across the level before they are captured by the enemy.

Blitloop blends the spirit and intensity of 1980s arcade old-school SHMUPs with the tactical elements of modern hardcore bullet hell shoot 'em ups. Earn power-ups to enhance the ship’s weapons, keep the bombs and missiles fully stocked, and prepare for fluid arcade action, stylish graphics, and an '80s synthwave soundtrack.

Achieve a high score by keeping the score multiplier at its maximum and planning for additional combos.
Story

In the future, the Galactic Federation and the pirates of planet Zirkoid are at war. On planet EX4042, the Galactic Federation is mining a powerful orb that powers all crafts and weapons that are keeping the pirates at bay.

An infiltrator droid from Zirkoid intercepted the information of the whereabouts of EX4042 and sent a fleet of forces to steal pods containing the valuable minerals.

The Federation was taken by surprise and was immediately outnumbered. This can be the end of the prosperous Federation and lead to a new era of darkness where pirates of Zirkoid could destroy countless planetary systems.

But all hope is not lost…

Meet Blit, a space bounty hunter that was tracking down a Kessel smuggler in a nearby solar system. She picked up the distress calls from EX4042 and immediately changed course, making her way to the orb mining planet

With her genetically modified spaceship that can absorb orb minerals to enhance into a range of weaponry, Blit is the Federation’s last hope to stop a galactic destruction.
Game Features

title: Oh
description:
게임 정보

title: Crimson Quest

탐험을 해보세요.
탐험을 통해 다양한 오브젝트를 찾아내고, 필드에 어떤 야생 몬스터들이 서식하고 있는지 위치를 미리 파악해 보세요. 당신은 지도를 펼쳐 원하는 지역을 표시할 수 있으며, 둘러보기 기능을 해금하였다면 이를 이용해 먼 곳을 내다볼 수도 있습니다! 적의 세력보다 더 빠르게 성장하고 싶다면 동선을 낭비하지 않고 계획적으로 움직여야 합니다.
자원을 채취하여 몬스터와 타워를 생성하세요.
일꾼 몬스터를 이용하여 필드 곳곳에 위치한 에너지 광상을 채광하거나, 가까이가면 드러나는 다양한 보물 상자를 열고 자원을 습득할 수 있어요! 몬스터들은 상위 등급으로 올라갈수록 더 많은 광석이 필요하고, 타워는 종류마다 요구하는 자원의 양이 다릅니다. 또한, 넘쳐나는 자원을 여행 중인 자원 수집가에게 다른 자원으로 교환할 수도 있으니, 그가 어디에 있는지 찾아보는 것도 좋습니다.

title: Carnival Heroes - Super party minigames
description:
게임 정보
Carnival Heroes is cross-platform online multiplayer board game for 2 to 4 players similar to super mario party.
Inside the game you will enjoy 23 minigames which you play along the main game.
The game can be played in 2 game modes: online (vs real human players or solo (vs AI).
GAMEPLAY
You take turns in an order determined by the biggest dice roll.
On your turn you roll a dice and you use (or not) an item you previously collected.
The goal in the game is to collect as many crowns as possible.
Crowns are bought with gems.  Gems you collect by walking onto the game board, by landing on chests or by winning in minigames.
At the start of the game you choose animal avatar which you will play as.
Each of the 8 avatars comes with a special dice which you can play if you want (you either play the regular 1 to 6 dice or the character special dice).
The game has two main gameplay modes: FREE and FIXED.
In FIXED mode you walk along a fixed routers. But you still choose which direction to go on the intersections.
In FREE mode you draw your exact path on which you player will go. You have to make sure you make most of your path (i.e. it goes through many gems, mates and it lands on a board item.
BOARD ITEMS
Gems. These are diamonds in 3 colors: red = 1 gem, green = 2 gems and blue = 3 gems.
Gems are used to purchase crows or items from the store.
Crowns. This is what you must be aiming to get. Crowns are bought with gems. In the beginning of the game 1 crown costs 10 gems..but as the game progresses they will become more and more expensive (15 or 20 gems).
Mates. Mates are special animal friends which will follow you onto the game board and will give you gems for each player you jump over (i.e. pass through its place). 
Each mate you have, will give you additional big dice that you can roll instead of the regular 1 to 6 dice. Moreover, mates have their own small dice that they will roll with you and it will be added to your dice value.

title: Questboard
description:
게임 정보
**《Questboard》**는 선택과 주사위 굴림이 당신의 여정을 결정하는 텍스트 기반 "선택형 모험" RPG입니다. 신비로운 퀘스트, 위험한 생물, 그리고 운명의 반전을 따라 펼쳐지는 풍부한 스토리텔링이 가득한 무한한 가능성의 세계로 들어가 보세요.
Questboard에서는 모험이 매번 새롭게 펼쳐집니다. 각 퀘스트는 새로운 도전을 제시하며, 성공은 결코 보장되지 않습니다. 주사위 한 번의 굴림으로 승리를 거머쥘 수도, 재앙을 맞이할 수도 있습니다. 거대한 용을 무찌를 것인가, 잊혀진 유적을 탐험할 것인가, 아니면 마을을 구할 것인가? 모든 선택이 중요하며, 모든 결과는 당신의 결정과 약간의 운에 달려 있습니다.
여정 중에는 마을 사람들을 도와주고, 강력한 적들과 맞서 싸우며, 다양한 텍스트 기반 미니게임에 도전하게 됩니다. 낚시에 도전하거나, 적들의 가혹한 도전을 견뎌내고, 주사위 굴리기로 운을 시험하며, 매 순간 예측 불가능한 만남이 기다리고 있습니다.
주요 특징:
인터랙티브 스토리텔링: 당신의 선택과 주사위 굴림이 퀘스트의 결과에 직접적인 영향을 미치는 매력적인 이야기.
역동적인 모험: 각 플레이가 달라지며, 모든 퀘스트는 여러 방식으로 전개되어 높은 반복 플레이 가치를 제공합니다.
독특한 미니게임: 퀘스트 중 낚시를 즐기거나, 생존 도전에 맞서고, 흥미진진한 미니게임에서 주사위를 굴리는 재미를 만끽하세요.
몰입감 넘치는 세계: 생생한 캐릭터와 숨겨진 비밀, 예상치 못한 도전이 가득한 풍부한 세계를 탐험해 보세요.
운명에 따라 달라지는 결과: 당신의 용기는 보상받을 수도, 벌을 받을 수도 있습니다. 각 퀘스트의 결과는 당신의 선택과 운에 의해 결정됩니다.
전설적인 영웅이 될 것인가, 아니면 운명에 굴복할 것인가? Questboard에서 모험은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 용기를 내어 주사위를 굴리고, 모든 선택이 중요한 여정을 떠나보세요!

title: Identity Test
description:
게임 정보
"Bring back the lost moments"

STORY
In the 1980s, an unknown corporation develops groundbreaking technology, seemingly impossible for the era. This technology enables the restoration of memories in individuals who are in tragic states, completely eliminating symptoms of Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, or other memory disorders. The corporation is fully funded by the government. They advertise with numerous successful studies over the years. Their reputation is mainly owed to misinformation among people. At that time, this is very possible because the internet or television are not well developed. Their advertising relies on displaying many opinions of families or individuals who managed to restore memory and cure memory disorders. The problem is that it is arranged in a very good way. The government knows everything about it, but there is a lot of corruption in the world, which the corporation and the government exploit and reduce their wealth. The therapy itself costs $40,000 monthly. The corporation in its premium packages for $70,000 per month includes and provides faster therapy and better care for the subject.

Nonetheless, the intentions of the corporation and the government are good, but in the initial stages of technology development, they exploit the misfortune of the subjects' families. The machine in later stages of development is supposed to truly restore memory, but because such technology is simply impossible to achieve at that time, the government and the corporation take advantage of this.

The machine is supposed to work in such a way that it adjusts its operation based on the latest living synapses and neurons. In most cases, the subject is able to respond instinctively by clicking buttons on the machine. At the moment, instead of restoring memory, the machine creates new personalities.

The main character, who is the first subject of the experimental technology, answers tailored questions. Eventually, the questions lead to the protagonist starting to live in the forest and trying to survive away from civilization. They live in seclusion, in a tent, and try to survive. Their new personality is not without side effects such as depression, suicidal thoughts, and sometimes lack of awareness.
