- Find a way out of the castle by finding and following clues. Traverse the environment by walking, running, and jumping.
- Uncover the story of the castle by looking at and interacting with objects. Pick up the objects that you need to progress through the castle.
- Be wary of ghostly activity and walk around with care. React fast to avoid ghostly activity, don't get too hurt.
- Find bonus items by exploring the castle; They give a glimpse into the castle's past.

title: MI:ND
description:
게임 정보
State-of-the-art Fully-Voiced AI-Powered Dialogue

Every line of dialogue from every character is completely dynamic, generated with the most sophisticated AI-models and realistic emotion-filled speech. Engage in realistic conversations where you can speak freely and must determine exactly what you need to say to get through immersive scenarios while grappling with the psychological challenges posed by a decaying mind and a lurking subconscious.




Thought Reading: Utilize the power of an artifact to read thoughts, offering a unique insight that aids in navigation and decision-making.

Engaging Scenarios

Complex Interactions: From light-hearted moments in a bar to high-stress situations like evading arrest, use your wit and the power of thought reading to navigate through varied scenarios.
Memory Decay and Anomalies: As time progresses, the increasing decay introduces instabilities in the memory, from fun to horrific. Was that bouncer always three kids in trenchcoat?



As you dive deeper into the subconscious, each interaction, and each decision shapes the path forward. There is no dialogue-tree here, only your intuition guides you through a labyrinth of memories teeming with horrors. Will you uncover the secrets held within before it's too late, or will the fading memories consume you?

We're just a small team of two brothers and a close friend, united by our love for video games and a shared dream to create games that stretch the limits of what's possible. From the sounds and music to the art and everything in between, everything you see and hear in our game is crafted by us. We pour our hearts into every detail, hoping to bring you an experience that resonates and inspires.

title: Cell Sword
description:
게임 정보
Cell Sword is a six-degree-of-freedom (6DoF) sci-fi adventure set inside the human body inspired by classic shooters of the 1990s. The full game is an epic single player campaign and story that takes place over 16 unique levels.
Thank you for your interest in our "Cell Sword" medical affiliate program. Here at Mediweapon we value your contributions and we are certainly not a giant evil corporation. After you sign up, we inject a microscopic ship into a patient and rely on you to pilot it around and destroy any virus or disease. It's a great way to save some lives, earn some credits and help build a better future on the ruins of the world we absolutely did not help destroy.
It is the future. Video games are dead. 
War has left the world polluted with microscopic autonomous robots. These drones enter the bloodstream and consume the organs and life-force of their host.
This deadly disease is known as RUST.
Instead of games, players are hired by the rich to remotely pilot fast nanobot crafts to blast the Rust. These guns-for-hire are called Cell Swords.
"It's Descent but inside the human body!" -- Developer
"It's hilarious and dark but also a solid shooter." -- Also the developer
"Have you seen the film Fantastic Voyage? Or Inner Space? No? Yeah, well, I love those too." -- Still the developer
We do original research into the history of games to make interesting projects. Cell Sword is our love letter to the #6DoF subgenre.
Please note: Screenshots and trailer footage are taken from the development version and the final product will look different.
Trailer music is "Spider Pants (with Grace)" by WangleLine.

title: Fur and Void
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of Fur and Void – a turn-based strategy game where anthropomorphic animals engage in epic battles set in a medieval fantasy setting. In this unique tactical game, players take on the role of commanders of two competing armies, each composed of various characters with unique skills and professions.
Diverse Characters: Meet heroes such as the Fox - a master archer, the Bear - a powerful shaman, the Wolf - a fearless knight, and the Cat - a mysterious wizard. Each character offers unique abilities that can turn the tide of battle in your favor.

Strategic Turn-Based Battles: Face off against your opponent on a hex-based board, where every move counts. Utilize terrain, plan your moves and attacks carefully to outsmart your enemy.

Variety of Professions: Your army consists of many unique units, mage, healer, warrior, archer, ax-wielding warrior, hoplite, scout and more. Each unit brings diverse tactics and strategies to the game.

Medieval World: Immerse yourself in a richly realized world inspired by medieval themes, full of castles, forests, and ancient ruins. Beautiful graphics and detailed character animations make each match a visual delight.

Two-Player Mode: Challenge friends and foes in exciting PvP battles. Each game is different thanks to the variety of strategies and playstyles.
Fur and Void combines deep tactics with the charm of anthropomorphic heroes. Are you ready to lead your units to victory and become a legend in this magical land? Prepare for amazing clashes, strategic decisions, and hours of thrilling gameplay.

Enter the world of Fur and Void today and become a legend!

title: Dreamwalker
description:
게임 정보
Dreamwalker is a top-down story RPG game with deckbuilding combat. 
Embark on a journey through dreams and nightmares in Dreamwalker, a 2D top-down RPG set in a mesmerizing pixel art world. You are a wandering traveler, drawn to a small village shrouded in mystery and cursed by an ancient evil.
🃏 Deckbuilding Combat
Choose your starter deck and forge your own playstyle as you collect, upgrade, and craft a unique deck tailored to your strategy.
Visit merchants to buy, sell, upgrade, and trade up cards to refine your deck.
200+ unique cards across 4 rarities (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary), featuring upgradable and combinable effects.
Turn-based combat with animated enemies. Face different elemental foes with special Moves: Stuns, poison, burn, deck disruption, and more - forcing you to adapt as you progress.
💤 Enter a World of Living Dreams
Each villager’s mind is its own world—a haunted castle, a shifting marketplace, or a forest of glowing memories.

title: Cosy Company Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
You're hiring more and more people for your small company!
But that's not all – you need to fit everyone into their workspace. And as if their various shapes and sizes weren't enough, they also come with special requests!
Take George, for example: he always wants to be next to the coffee machine.

title: Slingshot Pilot
description:
게임 정보
Master gravity (or crash trying) in Slingshot Pilot! Pull off risky maneuvers, dodge asteroids, and complete crazy missions to rank up in the corp, and get riskier and shadier assignments. Compete versus peers in the highscore chase but dont fly too close to the sun..
Navigate, Adapt, Survive
Take control of a nimble spaceship and weave through levels filled with shifting gravitational forces from planets and other celestial bodies. Each environment is dynamic and packed with hazards and obstacles. Planning ahead and split-second reactions are your lifelines, but don’t get too comfortable—crashing is all part of the learning curve - So is nailing that perfect gravity maneuver.
A Universe of Peril and Mystery
Navigate asteroid fields, lava planets, ice worlds, and gas giants. Rescue stranded pilots, evacuate survivors, and dodge ominous outsiders that seem to hunt you. Danger lurks everywhere—can you survive the chaos?
Achievements and Leaderboards
Going an extra mile, lending a helping hand endulging your curiosity is rewarded with achievements. Compete with friends and other players on leaderboards, cut corners and perfect your slingshot skills to leave rivals in your space dust.
Keyboard or Game Controller
Play with what you find more comfortable. This game is optimized for Keyboard + Mouse as well as Common Controllers and works naturally also on Steam Deck.

title: Planet Hoarders
description:
게임 정보
You are a replicant engineered by the Corporation for a single purpose: gather valuable bio-species from abandoned facilities across various planets.

Alone or with up to three teammates, you'll land on planet surfaces to explore and locate facility entrances. Inside, navigate dark, procedurally generated networks of rooms and tunnels to collect small creatures you can carry—but beware of monsters that aim to end you. Stealth, strategy, and teamwork are essential to evade or confront these threats.

With limited time on each planet, you must act swiftly to meet your KPIs.
Use in-game radio communication to share information and coordinate actions to access restricted areas.

Finally, uncover the unsettling truth behind your mission.

title: Endless Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Endless Tactics is a Turn-Based Roguelite game where you play as the commander of a high-risk planetary mining expedition. Defend your base from incessant hordes of alien creatures as you harvest valuable resources, and weather dangerous planetary hazards such as spore filled meteor showers and earthquakes, all while uncovering valuable drop pods and new mysterious Artifacts. Whenever things get too bleak, Extract to your orbiting spaceship to rearm, Upgrade, and unlock more dangerous and profitable worlds the more you further you get. Good luck, Commander. MechTek is counting on you to make a buck!
SECURE YOUR OPERATION
Defend your mining operation from the alien menace! Manage a variety of units from military vehicles to towering mechs to fight back the deadly alien hordes as you extract valuable resources! Sometimes, tough decisions and sacrifices will be necessary to keep it going just until the next Extraction Opportunity!
EXPANSIVE UPGRADES
Outfit your orbiting spaceship with the latest gear in excavation and offensive technology (warning: some upgrades might increase profits at the cost of survivability).

title: Private Mining Company
description:
게임 정보
Far in the future, you work as an independent military contractor for various deep space mining companies.
Raise your army to defend mining outposts against alien bugs!
Train your soldiers and purchase upgrades across various missions.

title: Merchant's Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
In Merchant's Odyssey, you step into the shoes of a young merchant who is thrust into action due to family circumstances. As a fledgling merchant, your role will involve planning journeys, trading goods, making critical decisions in unfolding events, and recruiting powerful mercenaries to assist you in navigating the numerous dangers of the road. The game experience revolves around three key pillars:
Combat:
Engage in turn-based combat with group initiative and an strong tactical factor.
Experiment with synergies in combat where even positioning matters.
Utilize diverse character classes with unique skills, offering a wide range of playstyles.
Decision-Making:
Confront various events along your journey that will challenge your decision-making abilities and the capabilities of both your merchant and mercenaries.
Build trust with your mercenaries and provide them with directions for personal development as they gain experience.
Earn experience points for your merchant character and choose enhancements from a skill tree.
Travel:
Strategically plan and travel to destinations of your choice, considering your capacity to maximize profits.
Organize your inventory and resources, requiring you to balance between a safer journey or the pursuit of maximum profit.
Merchant's Odyssey offers a captivating blend of strategic combat, decision-making, and dynamic travel, all wrapped in a compelling narrative. Will you rise to the challenge and carve your path to prosperity in this merchant's adventure? Embark on your odyssey today!

title: Sovenance
description:
게임 정보
Pendant is a top down pixel art adventure with a focus on fast-paced combat and a narrative driven campaign. Uncover the secrets of a shattered world as you commune with gods, enhance your magical capabilities, and take down dangerous monsters and demons.

*This steam page is WIP. Details about the game will be added as development moves forward.

title: The Farming Frontier
description:
게임 정보

The Farming Frontier is an almost idle farming simulator where you can cut wood, mine, fish, grow crops, bake bread, and breed cattle freely. However, it also loosely follows a storyline where you need to use your farming skills to fight your enemies.



In this world, everything is connected. To fight your enemies, you need to train soldiers. Soldiers require weapons and a strong economy to sustain the fight. As the farmer, you're responsible for maintaining the economy.



Firstly, you need wood. Chop trees and employ a woodcutter to convert logs into wood for constructing buildings. Some buildings may require stones, so you must quarry rocks and process them into building materials. Build a fishery, bakery, and mill to produce food for your population.



Your peasants need comfortable homes to rest and eat when tired and hungry. Provide these houses with food. Learn crafting to produce items faster and more efficiently.

title: Escape The Charon
description:
게임 정보
Escape the Charon은 한 번에 플레이할 수 있는 SF 어드벤처 게임입니다

그 물체는 은하계 가장자리에 있는 죽어가는 행성의 사막에서 발견되었습니다. 고고학 팀이 기둥을 발굴했을 때, 그 알 수 없는 상형문자가 그들에게 오싹함을 안겨주었습니다. 이것이 고대인의 작품일 수 있을까요? 그들은 우주 정거장 Charon에서 Andrea West와 그녀의 팀의 도움을 받아 그 기원의 미스터리를 밝혀냈습니다.

제임스 웨스트는 절실히 필요한 휴가를 위해 지구로 배를 조종하고 있었습니다. "안드레아로부터 메시지를 받았습니다." 컴퓨터가 울렸습니다. 그는 신경 연결 장치를 켜고 미소를 지으며 메시지를 열었습니다.

"지미, 도움이 필요해요. 뭔가 크게 잘못됐어요! 혹시..."

그녀의 나머지 말은 잘렸다. 그는 즉시 카론으로 진로를 설정했습니다.

"나 왔어 누나"
조사하다

title: 7Years
description:
게임 정보
7Years is a non-linear, open-world horror game, that offers both a single-player story and 4-player online co-op. After waking up in the middle of the night, you discover that you're wife is missing. Desperate to find her, you try to find help, only to quickly learn that the only person left in your entire mountainside neighborhood is you. No phone service and the main powerline to the neighborhood has been severed. You are alone, or so you think, until you find a modified HAM radio system that is transmitting a repeating message...with your name in it. The person on the other end may be your only hope to find your wife and survive the horrors surrounding you. Traverse open-world maps as you investigate for clues, solve puzzles, uncover mysteries and elude unique demonic enemies, each created to trigger a specific fear and complete their only mission...to find you.

title: Final Forge
description:
게임 정보
마법 망치로 타워를 방어하고 요새 주변의 자원을 최대한 빨리 찾아내세요. 적의 파도가 절차적으로 생성되는 이 타워 디펜스에서 모든 적을 파괴하거나 죽을 때까지 공격으로부터 자신을 보호하고 무기를 만들고 업그레이드할 수 있는 더 나은 방어를 구축하세요.

타워를 방어하세요:
대포를 제어하고, 힘과 제작 무기를 업그레이드하여 타워를 공격하기 위해 절차적으로 생성되는 적의 파도로부터 자신을 방어하세요. 난쟁이의 보물을 훔치지 마세요!
자원을 수집하세요:
요새 주변에서 귀중한 자원을 수집하여 방어를 업그레이드하거나 공격으로부터 회복하세요.
운반할 수 있는 양과 시간에 주의하세요. 탐사 중에 적들이 공격하거나 무방비 상태에서 타워를 파괴할 수 있습니다.

획득한 자원으로 무기를 만들고 업그레이드하고, 여러 적의 약탈자 명령에 맞서고, 자원 수집을 개선하여 모든 적을 파괴할 때까지 살아남으세요.
자원을 수집하는 동안에는 도망쳐서 요새로 돌아갈 수만 있으며, 적들이 당신을 이기기 위해 쫓아올 수 있으니 조심해서 요새로 도망쳐서 적으로부터 자신을 보호하세요.

모두 파괴하세요!

title: Sabotage City
description:
게임 정보
Sabotage city takes the idea of a city builder and flips it on its head, making a city destroyer game. You are an average citizen hired to work for a gigantic demolition company, little to find out the cities are less than abandoned… sweet!
Fast paced money management gameplay with a high skill ceiling, speedrunning tools, and a freeplay mode for replayability.
Different gimmicks that spice up the gameplay experience. like being able to hire workers for extra money, or controlling the press to rile up the people. All with the end goal of making the citizens leave.
A full story mode campaign with 20+ locations to destroy,  and a full plot with multiple characters, locations, and different routes to take the story.
Web 1.0 web page inspired menus and shops. Instead of a normal shop menu the game uses a computer with charming 90s style websites that give advice on how to get better, helps you buy tickets to the cities you destroy, and give backstory to the world of the game.
Multiple endings. 
Codes and ciphers to discover and solve. The game is packed with loads of hidden puzzles and things to solve all across it.

title: Crabs Dive In Crossway
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
"Crabs Dive In Crossway" is a Sokoban-like puzzle game. You need to command a troop of crabs and manage them to the target places. Each crab can only move in horizontal or vertical line, and all crabs will move simultaneously.
When two crabs from crossed directions meet, the later crab will step on the back of the former to form a Crab-Bind, and be driven to move along with the crab below. A Crab-Bind can push single crab forward. The gameplay is all about "How to reasonably allocate target shelters for each crab and deliver them to place". You may try hard brainstorming to avoid the crowding and trampling of crabs in horizontal and vertical lines.
There are 6 chapters, altogether 60 manually designed levels for playing around. Each chapter corresponds to a unique puzzle solving technique for you to discover.
Control
一 Menu 一
[ WASD/↑←↓→ ] Move Crab
[ SPACE ] Interact
一 In Level 一
[ WASD/↑←↓→ ] Move (by grid)
[ ESC ] Exit Level
[ R ] Retry
[ Z ] Undo
[ X ] Redo
Contact Us
QQ Group: 825324074

title: Undead Rampage
description:
게임 정보
Undead Rampage is a third-person co-op shooter that throws you and your friends into the epicenter of a post-apocalypse, where terrible monsters rule the ruins of civilization. Your goal is to survive at all costs, fighting hordes of enemies and collecting upgrades to strengthen your character.
Key features:
Co-op gameplay: Team up with friends in a team of up to 4 people and fight together, coordinating actions to achieve the goal.
Dynamic battles: Use 2 rifles and a pistol, quickly switch between weapons to be ready for any situation.
Maneuverability and evasion: Roll to avoid deadly attacks of monsters and stay alive in tense battles.
Upgrade system: Defeat monsters, pick up dropped upgrades and instantly strengthen your character, increasing health, speed, ammo supply or finding new weapons.

title: CoRoT
description:
게임 정보
경고: 이 게임은 깜빡이는 빛이 포함되어 있어 광과민성 간질을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 조심해서 플레이하세요.
어둡고 차가운 지하실에서 눈을 뜹니다. 멀리서 묘한 메아리가 들려옵니다. 여기가 어딘지, 어떻게 왔는지 모르지만 이곳이 살아있는 것 같아요. 집뿐만 아니라 주변 전체가 불안한 기운으로 움직이는 느낌입니다. CoRoT는 1인칭 심리 공포 게임으로, 현실의 규칙이 무너지는 공간에 당신을 데려갑니다. 이야기는 바로 나오지 않고, 버려진 카세트 테이프와 장소가 전하는 소리를 통해 드러납니다.
방향이 자꾸 바뀌는 복도를 걷고, 눈을 돌리면 다른 방을 보며, 불안한 과거를 풀어내는 녹음을 듣게 됩니다. 내가 어디에 있는지, 무슨 일이 일어나는지 알아내려 할 때, 이 집에 살던 누군가가 그림자 속에서 쫓아옵니다. 근데 또 다른 게 있어요—뭔지 모를 의도로 날 보는 존재요.
CoRoT는 우리가 만들고 있는 우주적 공포 세계의 시작이에요. 깊은 이야기가 담겨 있고 앞으로 더 키울 겁니다. 이건 더 큰 세계로 가는 첫걸음이고, 비밀은 눈에 보이는 걸 넘어섭니다.
그것을 조심하세요
그것에 주의하세요. 그건 너가 누군지 알아요. 방심하지 마세요.

title: Resurrection Core
description:
게임 정보
Resurrection Core is a fast paced, vertically scrolling shooter game.
Destroy enemies and fearsome bosses, collect power-ups and resurrect enemy cores to increase your fire power. Game honors the classics of the arcade genre, but also adds unique, modern touch to gameplay mechanics.
Resurrect the cores
When enemies die, they sometimes leave behind their energy core. These cores can be resurrected to increase your fire power. Eventually they can be fused to become a powerful bomb that annihilates everything on the screen.
Master the weapon systems
You need to strategically swap between light and heavy weapons. Light weapons shoot faster bullets and cover larger area of destruction. Some enemy types can only be destroyed with heavy weapons.

title: Rogue Battalion
description:
게임 정보
Rogue Battalion의 전략적 혼돈 속으로 뛰어드세요. 2차 세계 대전에서 영감을 받은 독특한 오토 배틀러로, 전술적 의사결정과 폭발적인 전장 액션이 결합된 게임입니다. 증강되는 부대를 지휘하고 끊임없이 몰려오는 적군을 상대로 병력과 강력한 능력을 적절히 활용해 전세를 뒤집어 보세요.
주요 특징
다이내믹 오토 배틀 게임플레이
자동으로 진행되는 치열한 전투를 지켜보며 플레이어는 상위 전략에 집중하세요. 유닛을 현명하게 선택하고 전술을 조정해 승리를 거두세요!
    특수 능력으로 전황 주도
강력한 지원 능력을 사용해 전황을 뒤집으세요! 파괴적인 포격을 요청하거나 생존에 필수적인 공중 보급을 투하하고, 결정적 순간에 증원을 배치해 보세요.
진화하는 부대 커스터마이징
웨이브 사이에 무작위로 주어지는 부대를 선택해 전력을 증강하세요. 전선을 강화할 것인지, 장거리 지원을 위한 저격수를 배치할 것인지, 아니면 적 전차에 맞설 대전차 부대를 운용할 것인지 선택해 보세요.

title: C.U.B.E. - Clever Uber Bot Extensible
description:
게임 정보
Learn how to interact with different blocks (magnet, portal, gate, rotator, etc.)

title: Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Freaky Dreams is a survivor-like game where you open your eyes only to find yourself trapped in a nightmare from which you cannot wake. Surrounded by strange and twisted creatures, you must strike deals with demons to gain strength and devour grotesque monsters. Only by surviving can you discover whether this is a real nightmare or a nightmarish reality.
Game Features
Unique hand-drawn artwork depicting a mad, nightmare world
Face off against bizarre creatures while wearing your ordinary pajamas
Devour different monsters to gain power, absorbing their limbs to evolve into insane attack forms
Choose carefully when cleansing your soul—the higher the price, the greater the reward
Each failure will fracture your soul, and only by discerning the patterns of the dream can you rise again
Even the seemingly endless nightmare has an end. Break through the layers of mist and unveil the true nature of the dream
Dodge bullet-hell attacks and use your skill to defeat powerful bosses

title: Cendovia Uprising
description:
게임 정보
Cendovia Uprising is a turn-based battlefield card game. In each battle, you play cards to advance your army across the battlefield. Destroy the enemy's leader before they destroy yours. Tailor your decks to suit your strategy. Navigate challenging terrain as you fight among ten factions to conquer Cendovia.
There are 3 different play modes to choose from in Cendovia Uprising:
Campaign Mode: plot your course across Cendovia as you compete in a series of battles to conquer the island.
Scrimmage Mode: play stand-alone matches against NPCs of your choosing.
Online Mode: battle against others online in public or private matches.
There are five types of cards in Cendovia Uprising:

title: Carnival Heroes - Super party minigames
description:
게임 정보
Carnival Heroes is cross-platform online multiplayer board game for 2 to 4 players similar to super mario party.
Inside the game you will enjoy 23 minigames which you play along the main game.
The game can be played in 2 game modes: online (vs real human players or solo (vs AI).
GAMEPLAY
You take turns in an order determined by the biggest dice roll.
On your turn you roll a dice and you use (or not) an item you previously collected.
The goal in the game is to collect as many crowns as possible.
Crowns are bought with gems.  Gems you collect by walking onto the game board, by landing on chests or by winning in minigames.
At the start of the game you choose animal avatar which you will play as.
Each of the 8 avatars comes with a special dice which you can play if you want (you either play the regular 1 to 6 dice or the character special dice).
The game has two main gameplay modes: FREE and FIXED.
In FIXED mode you walk along a fixed routers. But you still choose which direction to go on the intersections.
In FREE mode you draw your exact path on which you player will go. You have to make sure you make most of your path (i.e. it goes through many gems, mates and it lands on a board item.
BOARD ITEMS
Gems. These are diamonds in 3 colors: red = 1 gem, green = 2 gems and blue = 3 gems.
Gems are used to purchase crows or items from the store.
Crowns. This is what you must be aiming to get. Crowns are bought with gems. In the beginning of the game 1 crown costs 10 gems..but as the game progresses they will become more and more expensive (15 or 20 gems).
Mates. Mates are special animal friends which will follow you onto the game board and will give you gems for each player you jump over (i.e. pass through its place). 
Each mate you have, will give you additional big dice that you can roll instead of the regular 1 to 6 dice. Moreover, mates have their own small dice that they will roll with you and it will be added to your dice value.

title: Elemental Seasons
description:
게임 정보
Elemental Seasons is a brutal exploration and survival game set in a seasonal themed world. Explore each biome, defeat every boss to earn the chance to escape this world!
EXPLORE THE SEASONAL BIOMES
Immerse yourself in a breathtaking new world divided into four unique biomes inspired by the beauty of each seasons. Explore the valley of autumn, the thick woods of summer, the rebirth in spring and the death of winter. Each biome offers its own unique challenges, secrets, and stunning visuals.
DEFEAT ELEMENTAL TITANS
Prepare for epic battles against 4 elemental titans, each embodying the power of nature. Face the fury of Fire, the uncontrollable wrath of Water, the raging tempest of Air, and the crushing strength of Earth. Each fight is a test of skill and survival against the elements themselves.
BRUTAL YET FAIR COMBAT
Face challenging combat where enemies wield elemental strengths, but you can counter them by consuming specific foods or rely solely on your skill to parry every strike. Every enemy attack can be parried with precision, negating all damage. Be a parry master or stack the odds in your favor, the choice is yours.
KEY FEATURES:
The world consists of 4 biomes each with its unique enemies and resources.
Parry based combat where the player can afford to not eat anything and still win boss fights.
Rewarding food system that gives an edge to players who need it.
Epic boss fights that will satisfy the player's fantasies of being able to control different elements.

title: Blow Out
description:
게임 정보
👾Aliens are attacking!! 👾
🔫But all our weapons are useless! 🔫
🌬 So it's up to Mr. Blow (no relation) to BLOW 🌬 them 🌬 away 🌬

Blow Out is a "Non violent" arcade game where you can't kill your enemies, you can only blow them back
It's very fun. Trust me.

There is a demo coming soon so please Wishlist so you can see it

title: Starbug Troopers : The 4 horseflies of the apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
As Bea prepares to become the 7th Starbug Trooper, the ceremony is interrupted by an attack. The 4 Horseflies of the Apocalypse return after years of absence. Bea must unite all the Starbug Troopers to put an end to the schemes of Lies, Famine, Plague, and Conquest.
AN ORIGINAL BLEND OF GENRES
Follow the adventures of Bea and the other Starbug Troopers in a humorous journey that mixes strategy and action. Outsmart your opponent by positioning your troops to your advantage and gain the upper hand. Or perhaps you'd prefer to outpace them, using your reflexes and agility to destroy all their ships.
A STRATEGY BASED ON SUPPORT
Increase your chances of victory in combat : position your troops relative to each other to gain greater support than your opponent and stack the odds in your favor during battle.
autokwd: Starbug Troopers : The 4 horseflies of the apocalypse

title: Flufftopia: Fluffmazing Edition by Daniel da Silva
description:
게임 정보
Flufftopia is a cute little clicker game with a story. Help your town to grow and eventually become Flufftopia! But wait… could there be even more?
Key Features
- An interesting story
- Two endings
- Cute graphics
- Relaxing soundtrack
This new version of Flufftopia brings the game finally to Steam with all new graphics and even more depth!

title: Water Maid
description:
게임 정보
Fill Up Your Pot and Make it Back. Safely

Watermaids are all about heading out and bringing back fresh water for the villagers. Navigate treacherous terrain and evade enemies to find a springwater well.



Fill up your trusty pot and return to the village before the sun sets. Be careful though, you're not as agile as you were before filling up.

Take Down Vicious Beasts and Explore the Island



Escape, Escort, and Strike Back. Outmaneuver cunning enemies and uncover the secrets of Nada Village Island. Investigate the disappearance of your predecessor and keep the villagers safe from the calamity that is to befall the island.

title: Atomic Raid
description:
게임 정보
아토믹 레이드는 3D 아케이드 슈팅 게임으로, 2~3개 장소마다 놀랍도록 역동적이고 변화하는 게임플레이를 즐길 수 있습니다.
내러티브
인류의 기술적 도약은 외부에서 눈에 띄지 않았습니다. 도시 한가운데서 포털이 열리고 무자비한 생명체 무리가 인류를 파괴하려는 단 한 가지 목적만을 위해 쏟아져 들어왔습니다.
침략을 막기 위해 사람들은 핵무기를 사용하여 자신의 도시에 미사일을 발사해야 했습니다.
모두는 이것으로 충분할 것이라고 생각했지만 포털이 손상되면 외계인의 남은 자들은 인류를 파괴 할 목적으로 바이오 매스와 금속으로 새로운 '병사'를 만드는 이동식 실험실을 건설하여 적응할 수있었습니다.
특징
놀랍도록 높은 역동성
당신이 본 모든 것이 어딘가에 숨어 있습니다...
영웅과 무기에 다양한 버프/디버프가 있습니다.
모든 보너스는 모든 것을 바꾸므로 신중하게 선택해야 합니다.

title: Sera Dion: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
HIT, TAKE, SURVIVE!
핵앤슬래쉬 로그라이크 게임 Sera Dion: Survivor를 플레이하세요.
수 천 마리의 몬스터를 죽여 다양한 스킬 조합을 직접 구성하고 강력한 보스를 물리치기 위한 생존의 사투를 펼칩니다.
혼자 혹은 친구들과 함께 플레이하며 긴장감 넘치는 경험을 위해 도전하세요.

title: Bat to the Beat
description:
게임 정보
Swing your bat to the beat in this cricket-themed rhythm action game.
Think on your feet
Experience a unique twist on rhythm gameplay that challenges your sense of rhythm and spatial awareness. At each beat you have to make a split second decision. Attack and risk getting caught by the fielders. Or defend and let the pressure build up.
Enemy positions and patterns are randomized to make each play-through unique, forcing you to think on your feet.
Travel the world
As you make your way across the cricket-playing world you'll be challenged by the unique grooves of each country - ranging from one-drop reggae beats of Jamaica to syncopated Indian rhythms.

title: Superstore Rush
description:
게임 정보
Superstore Rush, the ultimate store management game that lets you build, expand, and thrive in your very own bustling superstore! Developed by Shantek, this engaging game combines strategy, resource management, and fast-paced problem-solving to deliver a fun and rewarding experience.
Whether you’re restocking shelves, upgrading departments, or managing your growing customer base, Superstore Rush offers endless excitement and opportunities to grow your dream store. Are you ready to rise to the challenge and become the ultimate store manager?
Best of all, Superstore Rush is free to play and new content is added regularly!
Start small with basic shelves and work your way up to unlocking an array of departments, including groceries, fridges, freezers, deli cabinets, electronics, clothing, and even a mini-restaurant! Expand your store and serve waves of eager customers to maximize sales and profits.
But running a superstore isn’t just about stocking shelves. You'll face dynamic challenges such as spills, power outages, machine maintenance, unruly customers, and more. Keep your store running smoothly by solving problems quickly and efficiently. Every decision you make shapes your store's success.
Have feedback or suggestions for the game? Jump on the community Discord to share!

title: Vertigo Rush
description:
게임 정보
Vertigo Rush is a virtual reality racing experience that combines speed and parkour in an intense physical challenge. Players control agile robots, propelling them through vast, detailed environments by moving their own arms in a heart-pumping race.
Inspired by the mechanics of classic arcade racing games, each level is crafted to test player’s skill and endurance as they race through Haven's floating cities.
• Competitive Online Multiplayer up to 12 Players in Each Race with Global Ranking System, Time Trial Mode, Character & Robot Customization and Cross-Platform Play.
• Polished full-body physical control for high-speed parkour racing, with fluid and satisfying movement mechanics (jumps, climbing, running) designed for an exhilarating VR experience.
• Immersive and emotionally engaging narrative: In a world divided between floating opulence and terrestrial struggle, two ingenious siblings defy their destiny in robot races to save themselves from oppression and rewrite their future.

title: Feline Realms - The Ancients' Legacy
description:
게임 정보
Dive into Feline Realms: The Ancients' Legacy, a quirky RPG inspired by the golden era of role-playing games.

The story follows an ancient feline race that once traveled between worlds through portals. While they live peacefully on Felix IV, an invading force from a parallel world awakens the gate leading to Earth. Our heroes are called upon, unwillingly, to defend Earth against this new threat—unaware of their ancient heritage.

Rediscover your heritage as the Seshat Ankh, unlock your Guardian powers... or forge your own path—I'm not judging. The fate of Earth lies in your hands.

Oh, and good luck with the humans... To most of them, you're just a strange cat. To others, you're royalty. The modern world presents dangers that are unique to being a cat, as you'll soon discover.

The combat relies on old-school RPG mechanics, and features three different difficulty levels, making it accessible to both young, impatient heroes and hardcore veterans who like to use their full toolkit to achieve victory.

The game is non-linear, meaning you can accomplish goals in any order you choose. You can try to beat some big bosses right away if you dare, but I recommend finding some gear first, as well as acquiring some levels. The loot system is inspired by MMORPGs, where loot is gained through questing, defeating bosses, clearing dungeons, and of course, opening chests and visiting NPC vendors.

title: THE KING IN THE SHADES
description:
게임 정보


A classic late-90s / early 2000s narrative driven survival-horror game, set in a fictional universe full of century old mysteries to uncover.
You play as Douglas Hayles, the one who bears the mark of the king of shades and tasked with an impossible mission that cannot be achieved within a single lifespan.

FEATURES:

Choose both the combat and puzzle difficulty according to your preferences.
Cinematic fixed camera level design.
Classic tank controls movement system.
Limited supplies and inventory space.
Limited amount of lives per play-through, every decision you make has a cost.
In real-time resource management, preparation before every engagement is key to survival.

title: Star Freight
description:
게임 정보
Can you deliver the goods? Board your old but still trusted spaceship and get ready to haul cargo. But fuel is expensive, so make sure to choose the optimal route!

Star Freight is a space-themed puzzle game, featuring:

- a selection of 100 puzzles of increasing difficulty
- unique packing and route choice challenges

title: Passer

This is a minesweeper game from a third-person perspective.
Marking all mines is the task of each level.
Minefields may be covered by obstacles and can be cleared by blasting.
In the levels, you will encounter guards who prevent your action.
You have a wealth of skills to fight them,
Hand-to-hand combat is your basic skill.

title: Bar Night VR
description:
게임 정보
Bar Night VR puts you in the shoes of a virtual bartender, where the hustle never stops! Manage your underground bar, serving customers, restocking drinks, filling machines, and keeping the night alive. As you progress through each shift, you’ll face new challenges and master the art of being a bartender.
Start by serving simple drinks, then work your way up to crafting complex cocktails—all while ensuring your bar stays in control and the vibes stay fun!
Serve up drinks and learn new bartending skills
Keep the peace and prevent bar brawls
Cater to all kinds of customers, from everyday patrons to the more... mysterious types
And most importantly, keep yourself sober!
Get ready to mix, serve, restock, and repeat—because in Bar Night VR, the party never ends!

title: Questboard
description:
게임 정보
**《Questboard》**는 선택과 주사위 굴림이 당신의 여정을 결정하는 텍스트 기반 "선택형 모험" RPG입니다. 신비로운 퀘스트, 위험한 생물, 그리고 운명의 반전을 따라 펼쳐지는 풍부한 스토리텔링이 가득한 무한한 가능성의 세계로 들어가 보세요.
Questboard에서는 모험이 매번 새롭게 펼쳐집니다. 각 퀘스트는 새로운 도전을 제시하며, 성공은 결코 보장되지 않습니다. 주사위 한 번의 굴림으로 승리를 거머쥘 수도, 재앙을 맞이할 수도 있습니다. 거대한 용을 무찌를 것인가, 잊혀진 유적을 탐험할 것인가, 아니면 마을을 구할 것인가? 모든 선택이 중요하며, 모든 결과는 당신의 결정과 약간의 운에 달려 있습니다.
여정 중에는 마을 사람들을 도와주고, 강력한 적들과 맞서 싸우며, 다양한 텍스트 기반 미니게임에 도전하게 됩니다. 낚시에 도전하거나, 적들의 가혹한 도전을 견뎌내고, 주사위 굴리기로 운을 시험하며, 매 순간 예측 불가능한 만남이 기다리고 있습니다.
주요 특징:
인터랙티브 스토리텔링: 당신의 선택과 주사위 굴림이 퀘스트의 결과에 직접적인 영향을 미치는 매력적인 이야기.
역동적인 모험: 각 플레이가 달라지며, 모든 퀘스트는 여러 방식으로 전개되어 높은 반복 플레이 가치를 제공합니다.
독특한 미니게임: 퀘스트 중 낚시를 즐기거나, 생존 도전에 맞서고, 흥미진진한 미니게임에서 주사위를 굴리는 재미를 만끽하세요.
몰입감 넘치는 세계: 생생한 캐릭터와 숨겨진 비밀, 예상치 못한 도전이 가득한 풍부한 세계를 탐험해 보세요.
운명에 따라 달라지는 결과: 당신의 용기는 보상받을 수도, 벌을 받을 수도 있습니다. 각 퀘스트의 결과는 당신의 선택과 운에 의해 결정됩니다.
전설적인 영웅이 될 것인가, 아니면 운명에 굴복할 것인가? Questboard에서 모험은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 용기를 내어 주사위를 굴리고, 모든 선택이 중요한 여정을 떠나보세요!

title: Luck & Loot
description:
게임 정보
Luck & Loot is a dice-builder roguelike all about crafting unique dice and unleashing their power upon corrupted enemies. Customize your dice, collect game changing loot, and explore procedurally generated realms of Eldralith as you try to end the cycle once and for all!
Nostalgic Roguelike With A Dice Building Twist
Play as different heroes with uniquely personal builds and uniquely personal stakes. Swap out dice faces as you build the perfect quartet, all while growing each hero’s power and awakening to the eldritch enigma of eternity. 
Embark on arcade style adventures with growing character unlocks on your path to finally defeat a once beloved lich in his corrupted kingdom.
Dynamic Dice Building
Craft your perfect build with interchangeable and upgradeable dice faces. Swap and customize your dice while exploring, sacrificing unused sides to unlock powerful traits. Choose wisely, as each dice can only hold so much power, and every decision brings you closer to ultimate mastery—or peril.

title: Freckles
description:
게임 정보
Freckles! These cute little creatures live on the planet Mercury. On a mission to Earth, the freckles collide with Earth's space debris. After the crash, they find themselves in the backyard of a greedy family who wants to exploit them. Help the freckles escape by finding their remaining friends and repairing their spaceship.
A unique Story with Mystery Elements
Puzzle and Exploration RPG
Challenging Riddles
Inventory System
Collectables and Sidequets
We have decided to change the design of the Freckles characters. The change will be made with the next update. The demo will also receive general improvements.
What kind of a game is this?

title: Geyserlands
description:
게임 정보
Geyserlands is a deck-building game of modern otherworldly mystery. You are a detective just assigned a national park nobody knows exists.  Gain new cards and upgrade your deck as you explore the mystery of Geyserlands. Unlock secret powers and gain special advantages. But delve too deep and Geyserlands will consume you. How will your story end in Geyserlands?
Key Features
Collect a deck from hundreds of cards that tell the story of your character's history, abilities, insights and connections.
Use the cards you draw each turn to solve some of Geyserlands' hundreds of mysteries.
Solve mysteries to earn new and better cards and remove weaker cards from your deck.
Escape despair and death with a variety of upgradable healing cards that prevent Geyserlands from consuming you.
Earn strange powers and supernatural edges that allow you to push your luck and accomplish the impossible.
Unravel the secrets of Geyserlands.
However your story ends, you will gain new cards for your next journey.

title: PhantomZone labyrinthos ファントムゾーン ラビュリントス
description:
게임 정보
"I can't wake up... I can't wake up... I can't wake up..."
The nightmare that never allows waking lasts forever.
You wake up from bed and a girl appears before you.
She calls herself “Entourfe,” a management support android.
The setting is a strange facility, and you will explore the inside of the strange facility with her. ......
The nightmare lingers. It will drag you to hell itself.

The protagonist, plagued by nightmares
He is invited to an underground facility.

It is a nightmarish place filled with monsters, androids, and members of a bizarre organization.

Can he overcome the nightmare and escape from it?
Conundrum: Propositions are presented in sections.
autokwd: PhantomZone labyrinthos ファントムゾーン ラビュリントス

title: The Indirect Castle Retreat
description:
게임 정보
You are a travel photographer and have been invited to a castle for a photo gig. But all of a sudden you are knocked out, and you wake up in the middle of the night. You are clearly not alone. What is going on? How can you find your way out?

- Find a way out of the castle by finding and following clues. Traverse the environment by walking, running, and jumping.
- Uncover the story of the castle by looking at and interacting with objects. Pick up the objects that you need to progress through the castle.
- Be wary of ghostly activity and walk around with care. React fast to avoid ghostly activity, don't get too hurt.
- Find bonus items by exploring the castle; They give a glimpse into the castle's past.

title: MI:ND
description:
게임 정보
State-of-the-art Fully-Voiced AI-Powered Dialogue

Every line of dialogue from every character is completely dynamic, generated with the most sophisticated AI-models and realistic emotion-filled speech. Engage in realistic conversations where you can speak freely and must determine exactly what you need to say to get through immersive scenarios while grappling with the psychological challenges posed by a decaying mind and a lurking subconscious.




Thought Reading: Utilize the power of an artifact to read thoughts, offering a unique insight that aids in navigation and decision-making.

Engaging Scenarios

Complex Interactions: From light-hearted moments in a bar to high-stress situations like evading arrest, use your wit and the power of thought reading to navigate through varied scenarios.
Memory Decay and Anomalies: As time progresses, the increasing decay introduces instabilities in the memory, from fun to horrific. Was that bouncer always three kids in trenchcoat?



As you dive deeper into the subconscious, each interaction, and each decision shapes the path forward. There is no dialogue-tree here, only your intuition guides you through a labyrinth of memories teeming with horrors. Will you uncover the secrets held within before it's too late, or will the fading memories consume you?

We're just a small team of two brothers and a close friend, united by our love for video games and a shared dream to create games that stretch the limits of what's possible. From the sounds and music to the art and everything in between, everything you see and hear in our game is crafted by us. We pour our hearts into every detail, hoping to bring you an experience that resonates and inspires.

title: PIREND7
description:
게임 정보
Prepare to dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of Pirend7, where high-speed racing collides with explosive combat in a 40-player battle royale! In this sci-fi racer, survival isn't just about speed; it's about strategy, firepower, and skill. Whether you're gunning for the finish line or fighting to be the last one standing, every race is a test of wits, reflexes, and pure combat prowess.
UNLEASH THE POWER OF THE PIRENDS
The stars of the show are the Pirends—futuristic, heavily armed vehicles built for speed, destruction, and strategic dominance. Each Pirend is part of a distinct class, offering unique passive, primary, and ultimate abilities that can give you the edge in combat. Whether you’re dominating the battlefield with raw firepower or outsmarting opponents with strategic precision, your choice of class and abilities will define your approach to victory.
DIVERSE WEAPON ARSENAL

title: RESIDUAL SOUL
description:
게임 정보
RESIDUAL SOUL is a singleplayer narrative short-story heavily inspired by the creepypasta horror genre.
Gameplay
After being taken to a purgatory-like forest with the promise of speaking to his deceased wife, Matt must survive his time there and bring peace to the souls who still linger. Manage threats like violent souls and fluctuating power levels while unveiling the stories of those who came before you.
Features
• Melancholic atmosphere and stunning visuals
• Thoughtful sound design
• Skilled voice acting
• Dynamic storyline

title: Dungeon Sucker
description:
게임 정보
Dungeon Sucker is Pixel-art, Rogue-Lite, top down shooter game with absorption-defense as its core system.
[Synopsis]
Kim-Demon left the cleaning work to cleaning company for DHC(Dungeon-Hygiene-Check) in the second half of the year and went on a summer vacation in a hurry. but we’re cleaning company that has little bit distorted ideology that ‘Getting rid of the source of dirt is a real clean-up’.
Umm... Maybe… Kim-Demon didn’t even know that.
Anyway, You was become a cleaner of Company, Please finish cleaning the dungeon by ‘Neutralize’ all the obstacles(uncooperative-being, thing etc…) that interfere with cleaning along with the “Big - Strong vacuum Cleaner” which is the high-tech!!!
[A Big-Strong Vacuum Cleaner]
Cleaning is like a war, because you don’t know what threats are waiting for you. But, A ‘BSVC’ can suck attacks from uncooperative-being(thing). These sucked things can be fire using the ‘release’ function. neutralizing uncooperative being(thing)s with this function!
Once Again, It's not 'Killing', just 'Neutralizing'!
[Weapons]
BSVC can be equipped with various attachments. More than you think. A whole range of weapons wait you in Dungeon. May be, these weapons are probably you have never heard of. Use that if you need for cleaning work.
Don’t worry, Company's legal team is an expert in this area.
[Procedural-generated Dungeon & Random Event]
Dungeon is very complex and huge place, a random ‘labyrinth’. Dungeon are filled with various trophies, events. and beings and things. There are many thing waiting for you : Quiet, Huge, Great, Loud, Small, and so on.
Ah!, Sometimes there are ‘cooperative mans’ so don’t use the ‘Release function’ at random.

title: Cell Sword
description:
게임 정보
Cell Sword is a six-degree-of-freedom (6DoF) sci-fi adventure set inside the human body inspired by classic shooters of the 1990s. The full game is an epic single player campaign and story that takes place over 16 unique levels.
Thank you for your interest in our "Cell Sword" medical affiliate program. Here at Mediweapon we value your contributions and we are certainly not a giant evil corporation. After you sign up, we inject a microscopic ship into a patient and rely on you to pilot it around and destroy any virus or disease. It's a great way to save some lives, earn some credits and help build a better future on the ruins of the world we absolutely did not help destroy.
It is the future. Video games are dead. 
War has left the world polluted with microscopic autonomous robots. These drones enter the bloodstream and consume the organs and life-force of their host.
This deadly disease is known as RUST.
Instead of games, players are hired by the rich to remotely pilot fast nanobot crafts to blast the Rust. These guns-for-hire are called Cell Swords.
"It's Descent but inside the human body!" -- Developer
"It's hilarious and dark but also a solid shooter." -- Also the developer
"Have you seen the film Fantastic Voyage? Or Inner Space? No? Yeah, well, I love those too." -- Still the developer
We do original research into the history of games to make interesting projects. Cell Sword is our love letter to the #6DoF subgenre.
Please note: Screenshots and trailer footage are taken from the development version and the final product will look different.
Trailer music is "Spider Pants (with Grace)" by WangleLine.

title: Smashshot
description:
게임 정보
From a random guy in his parents apartment, comes a local multiplayer twin-stick shooter with a twist, rather than dying by taking too much damage, you die upon getting knocked off screen. This is definitely an original mechanic, yup I'm sure there's absolutely no game with this mechanic /s

Utilize two out of over a dozen abilities to find a synergy that fits your play style. One for defense and utility and the second one to finish off high damaged opponents.

Along with the ability to change the type of weapon in use, swapping between different fire rates and damage to complement your way to battle

Play with friends and see who can come out on top or play it alone in high score based challenges

title: Batter Up
description:
게임 정보
Batter Up is a rogue-lite arena shooter where you bounce a baseball around the map to kill the undead. The game features 3 biomes and a variety of enemies to battle through. With over 50+ items to choose from for your builds, you can create chaotic and downright overpowered synergies to mow through enemies.

Features
50 unique upgrade items
3 biomes to collect unique items in
3 unique bosses to fight
Multiple map variations
30 minute runs
1-2 minute waves

title: Lazy Writer
description:
게임 정보
You are a writer who is too lazy to work on his books. Your path will be difficult: endless rejections, small payments, competition with other authors. It's no wonder that your desire to create becomes less and less every day.
But perhaps happiness and success await you at the very end?
Get motivated:
Writing books empties your motivation scale. Do side activities to fill it!
Moreover, each trial requires its own approach to replenish your motivation points. Do you have enough spirit to reach the end?
Write books in your own style:

title: #7-J5Z: The Driftwood Experiment
description:
게임 정보
Set in the 1950's at the Limestone Coast, South Australia. A robot is sent to an unexplored underwater cave to gather and test a phosphorescent fungus that is extracted from pieces of driftwood located throughout the cave system. The player's objective is to collect all of the different fish and plants that can be found in the cave. There are also landmarks that needs to be discovered which can be utilised by the player.
SOLO DEVELOPED
FREE TO PLAY
Key Features
Discover and collect fish and plants
Find landmarks and use them for your benefit
Simple and easy to play
Experience a classified mission that took place in the 1950's
Relax and enjoy the underwater vibe

title: Slimenator
description:
게임 정보
슬리미네이터에서, 당신의 영웅(혹은 최소한 충분히 용감한 누군가)을 선택하고, 당신의 모험을 끈적끈적한 혼란으로 바꾸려는 슬라임 무리와 싸우세요. 도전적인 스테이지를 진행하면서 전략적인 선택을 하고, 새로운 위험과 기회에 적응하세요. 매번의 모험은 독특하며, 놀라움과 괴물들의 먹이가 되는 것 이상의 존재임을 증명할 기회가 기다리고 있습니다. 슬라임을 물리치고 진정한 챔피언으로 등장할 준비가 되셨나요?
특징
선택할 수 있는 여러 유니크한 캐릭터들.
수백 가지 마법 능력, 무기 및 액세서리.
새로운 모험을 시작할 때마다 맵 레이아웃이 변경되어, 매번 새로운 도전이 기다리고 있습니다. 여행 중에 다양한 보스들을 만나세요. 각 플레이는 동일하지 않으며, 매번 새롭고 흥미로운 경험이 됩니다!
당신을 돕거나 해를 끼칠 수 있는 맵 전역의 이벤트들.
다양한 종류의 도전들(공격, 데스매치, 웨이브 등).
각 캐릭터는 고유한 스킬 트리를 가지고 있습니다!
슬라임이 많다!

title: Endless Leveling In Mycelium Dungeons: from zero to infinity
description:
게임 정보
Endless Leveling In Mycelium Dungeons: from zero to infinity — is a dark fantasy game with a telling title. This is a hardcore Action RPG in which everyone can make their own interesting and unique build. An endless leveling tree, 50+ different skills, 2000+ skill combinations and an almost complete absence of restrictions will help you cope with this task. Become the new deity of this world, if, of course, you succeed.
One day, a woman died in a terrible magical ceremony in order to give birth to a being with potential similar to a deity. This strengthened her fetus and filled it with all kinds of magic of this world. The being that the woman gave birth to — is You. You will have to surpass the old deity, who was killed by the Devourer of Worlds. And make the most important choice: to continue the endless war, to subjugate the magic of another dimension and become a Devourer of Worlds himself, or to become a new deity protecting this world.
autokwd: Endless Leveling In Mycelium Dungeons: from zero to infinity

title: Tony's Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0
description:
게임 정보
Step into the captivating world of Tony's Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0, where science and adventure collide! This immersive VR experience lets you explore a vibrant insect science museum filled with live insects and reptiles in stunning macro detail. Shrink to their scale and discover the intricate beauty of their world like never before.
The experience also includes a special room showcasing the legendary Dan Capps Exhibit, one of the world's most extensive insect collections, with over 100 meticulously curated display cases. In this immersive exhibit, experience video recordings of Dan Capps himself, as he pops up throughout the room to guide you through the fascinating world of entomology. Whether you’re marveling at the intricacy of insect anatomy or learning about the rare species Dan has collected, this experience brings the hidden wonders of nature right to your fingertips.
Perfect for science enthusiasts and curious explorers, this immersive experience offers an unforgettable introduction to the rich biodiversity of our planet’s insects and reptiles—all from the comfort of your own space.

title: Defender's Dynasty
description:
게임 정보
A 2D Strategic Base Defender game set in Medieval times. As relentless Waves of enemy forces threaten your Stronghold, you must gather Resources, Fortify your Defenses, and lead your Rebellion. Prepare to strengthen your Base and manage your Resources. But be aware of the Storms!
Step into the shoes of Elian, a brave young hero on a mission to defend his home village of Regera from relentless waves of enemy soldiers. Fight for peace and restore balance to the land. Find and gather resources, fortify your village with diverse defensive buildings, and strategically place them to outsmart your foes. But beware of the storms—they'll test your defenses and force you to adapt on the fly. Upgrade your buildings and unlock new ones. Show the enemies who is the boss and join Elian in an epic battle for Regera's future!

title: SHAPELAND
description:
게임 정보
SHAPELAND는 플레이하기 쉽고 이기기 어려운 싱글 플레이어 1인칭 슈팅 게임입니다.
무기는 하나뿐이고 파워업은 없습니다.
피나 고어, 재장전, 유지 관리, 공개된 지식, 거래/통화, 제작, 인벤토리, 긴 여정, 그라인드가 없습니다!
가장 빠른 시간과 가장 높은 점수를 위한 경쟁만 있습니다!
이 작은 오픈 월드 환경에서는 매초 무언가가 일어납니다. 표적을 향해 사격하고, 픽업을 쫓고, 포털과 벽을 여는 동안 적의 모양을 피하고 피합니다.

최대의 재미! 저중력 지형에서 걷고, 달리고, 질주하고, 점프할 수 있습니다. 특정 모양과 아이템을 활용하여 레벨을 '날아다니는' 법을 배우세요. 물 위를 이동하고 때로는 공중을 이동하는 보트도 있습니다. 이 아름답고 중독성 있는 리플레이 가능한 슈팅 게임에는 7개의 레벨과 보너스 레벨이 있습니다. 재미있습니다!

최대의 재미!
게임 세계 전체가 벽으로 사분면으로 나뉜 '유리' 상자 안에 있습니다. 포털을 열고 벽을 내려 새로운 지역에 접근하고 풍경을 바꿔 새로운 보물과 포털을 드러냅니다. 결국 상자 밖에서 게임의 꼭대기로 가는 방법을 찾아 승리합니다!

title: SteamMaze
description:
게임 정보
1、 First Impressions of Wasteland World
（1） Special protagonist appears
In this wasteland world, our protagonist has a unique identity - a cyborg. Its body structure cleverly blends mechanical and organic matter, giving the protagonist extraordinary strength and some stunning special abilities through this unique combination.
And the protagonist's' home 'is a train of wasteland. It is not just a simple place to stay, but also a mobile base for the protagonist to embark on an exploration journey. Every time the train departs, the secrets hidden under the wasteland will be revealed one by one.
（2） Danger and opportunity coexist
The entire wasteland world seems to be shrouded in a mysterious and dangerous layer of steam, making it difficult for people to see the whole picture, but they can always feel the dangerous aura hidden in the shadows.
Every exploration is undoubtedly a thrilling adventure. While taking risks, there will also be unexpected gains, such as discovering precious resources, mastering advanced technology, or meeting reliable allies.

title: SHOCK
description:
게임 정보
Wake up. Survive. Escape.
In SHOCK, a gripping third-person psychological horror experience, you find yourself trapped in the dark, claustrophobic confines of an abandoned indoor parking lot, with no memory of how you got there. Playing as a disabled war veteran, you’ve lost both legs, and your only means of mobility is a wheelchair. But as you soon discover, you're not alone. A terrifying, man-made cybernetic creature roams the desolate lot, hunting you down. The question is: can you survive long enough to escape?

Key Features:
Psychological Horror: Dive deep into a haunting world where the line between reality and nightmare blurs. Explore dark, atmospheric environments while unraveling a mysterious story of survival, fear, and the human spirit.

title: Gemmy's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
We would appreciate your feedback and suggestions!
  Simple but not easy! Move! Avoid the traps! Reach the goal!
  How to Play:
Use only your mouse to guide Gemmy across the map to the goal.
Do not touch any traps, objects, or even the walls!
As you progress, the game becomes more challenging, testing not only your control skills but also your ability to strategize and find a way through the traps.
  Features:
Over 20 types of traps, each with unique mechanics.
Move through these traps, timing your movements carefully to avoid hazards—some even challenge you to pass within a time limit or as the path rotates.
You may even find yourself in shifting mazes where the walls constantly change position, making every second count!
Traps interact with each other, creating even more diverse and unexpected challenges.
                                                                    📌 Accessible to players of any language, even though the system interface is currently available only in English.
Steady your hands, move with precision, dodge the obstacles, and rush forward at the perfect moment!

title: Bug Bait
description:
게임 정보
In Bug Bait, you’ll dive into an intense single-player survival tower defense experience like no other! Defend your base from relentless swarms of ravenous bugs using a blend of strategic planning, clever resource management, and quick reflexes. The bugs are cunning, their numbers are overwhelming, and it’s up to you to hold the line.
Build, defend, and survive: can you outlast the swarm?
Key Features
Dynamic Survival Gameplay
Prepare for a never-ending challenge as waves of bugs adapt and grow stronger with each encounter. The only way to survive is to stay sharp and think fast.
Tower Defense Meets Resource Management
Balance building powerful defenses with managing limited resources. Every decision matters—will you upgrade your base, bolster your defenses, or stockpile resources for the next big wave?
Customizable Defenses
Unlock and upgrade a variety of defensive tools, from ballistas to battering rams, each with unique strengths to exploit against the swarm.
Evolving Bug Threats
Face an ever-changing army of bugs, each with its own behaviors, strengths, and weaknesses. Adapt your strategy as new, more dangerous enemies emerge.
Immersive Environments
Defend your base in stunning, handcrafted levels, each with unique terrain and environmental challenges that will test your strategic skills.
Replayability and Progression
With every victory, unlock new upgrades and abilities to prepare for even greater challenges. Climb the ranks and prove you’re the ultimate bug-busting strategist.
Updates
We're committed to keeping Bug Bait fresh and exciting with high-quality updates that include new features and general improvements from community feedback!
We’re passionate about making Bug Bait the ultimate survival tower defense game. If you have feedback or ideas for improvement, we want to hear from you!
The swarm is closing in—are you ready to take the bait? Jump into Bug Bait and start your survival adventure today!

title: Space Orcs Brawl
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for chaotic, couch-multiplayer mayhem! Pilot wacky, battle-hardened space ships, each with their own wild abilities, and fight for glory in explosive arena combat. It’s time to brawl—who will rule the arena?
Pick from a lineup of 7 unique brawlers, each with their own look, personality, and special powers. Whether you’re zipping around as Doc Croc or befuddle enemies with the tricky Brain Gang CEO, every ship brings a new way to play!
From asteroid belts to junkyard warzones, no two arenas are the same! Dodge hazards, master the terrain, and use the environment to your advantage as you battle for domination.

title: Staroot
description:
게임 정보
게임 특징
■ 씨앗을 심어 키우고, 뿌리를 지키며 다가오는 적들을 막으세요
■ 카드를 사용해 불리한 상황을 역전 시켜보세요
■ 각각의 다른 특징을 가진 식물들을 만나보세요

title: Isoge
description:
게임 정보
Forge Your Dream City in Isoforge
Explore a vast island, design your perfect city, and defend it against relentless invasions! Isoforge combines strategic city-building with dynamic events, giving you endless possibilities to shape your world. Are you ready to build, defend, and thrive?
Build & Expand
Start with only a rocket and expand into a sprawling city. Choose from a wide variety of buildings, each offering unique effects that influence others positively or negatively. Unlock new structures, upgrades and events influencing your city in new ways.
Recruit & Defend
In Isoforge, threats are never far away. Recruit soldiers, unlock new units, and prepare for invasions. Strategize your defenses to protect your city while balancing resources and expansion.
Dynamic Events
Each in-game day brings new surprises! From invasions and upgrades to building unlocks and unexpected challenges, every moment keeps you on your toes. Can you adapt to the ever-changing world of Isoforge?
Unique Interactions
Buildings don’t exist in isolation. Every structure in Isoforge interacts with others, either enhancing their effectiveness or creating obstacles. Master this system to optimize your city and overcome challenges.
Gamemodes
Choose from different gamemodes, challenging you in new ways or giving you an even more relaxing experience.

title: Hop On It
description:
게임 정보
Your goal is to reach the top.With nothing but a pogo stick, you start climbing. The journey isn’t easy. You’ll bounce across tricky obstacles, fight for control, and maybe lose your cool along the way. Play solo or team up with friends for some chaotic fun. Can you conquer the challenge, or will the forest get the best of you?

title: RADIO STALKER
description:
게임 정보
비극으로 삶이 파괴된 후, 주인공은 완전히 고립됩니다. 라디오 스토킹은 고통을 완화할 수 있는 유일한 방법이 됩니다. 그러나 그가 깊이 빠져들수록 현실에서 멀어져 갑니다.

주파수를 맞추고, 신호를 녹음하고, 발견한 것을 공개하세요. 좋아요, 조회수, 돈이 새로운 통화가 됩니다. 그러나 그 대가로 무엇을 희생하고 있습니까?

이것은 괴물에 관한 이야기가 아닙니다. 이것은 자신의 생각에 갇히고 자신을 잃는 것이 얼마나 쉬운지에 대한 이야기입니다.

당신의 행동은 두 가지 결말 중 하나로 이어집니다. 너무 늦기 전에 멈출 수 있습니까?

title: Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition
description:
게임 정보
Hands on sticks... You're one of them. Things to hand out... There's a lot of them.
Embark on a short journey no hand on a stick has been on until now and never again. Rummage through things, avoid being slapped, and hand stuff out to other hands before they lose their patience.
RUMMAGE THROUGH STUFF
Stick your hand in various piles to find what the greedy hands are wanting. You'll need to be quick or they'll become impatient and just leave without even waving goodbye.
KEEP THE STUFF
Put your hand in danger to keep your stuff from falling on the floor, being slapped, or stolen by aliens in tiny UFOs.

title: Out of the Fog
description:
게임 정보
Driven by curiosity and a refusal to believe in the myth of the mysterious faceless creature, you venture into eerie, abandoned locations to uncover the truth. But what starts as a thrill-seeking adventure soon spirals into a nightmare as the legend proves horrifyingly real.
Team up with a friend or face the horrors alone. Work together to explore dark environments, find the drawings, burn them, and evade the mysterious faceless creature as he hunts you in real time. Will you make it out alive together, or will fear tear you apart?
Explore hauntingly detailed locations, from a overgrown forest to a derelict factory. Each area is filled with eerie sounds, unsettling visuals, and environmental storytelling that will send shivers down your spine.
The mysterious faceless creature isn’t just a passive observer — he adapts to your actions. Stay too long in one place, and he’ll find you. Keep moving, but don’t lose track of your objectives, or you’ll fall prey to his relentless pursuit.
Piece together the dark mystery behind the legend. Collect notes scattered throughout the world to learn why the mysterious faceless creature exists — and why you might be his next victim.

title: Slime Attack: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징:
🐾 유니크한 영웅 및 펫 잠금 해제 🐾
퀘스트를 완료하여 각기 다른 플레이 스타일을 가진 강력한 영웅과 함께 싸우는 충실한 펫을 잠금 해제하세요.
⚔ ◆ 6가지의 독특한 무기 타입을 마스터하고 그 이상 ◆ ⚔
중장비: 충격파로 적을 처치하세요.
활: 멀리서 적을 저격하거나 강력한 화살을 발사하세요.
쌍검: 빠른 칼날로 공격적인 전투를 펼치세요.
검과 방패: 공격과 방어의 균형을 맞추세요.
유틸리티 스태프: AoE 피해, 적 제어 및 버프.
소환 스태프: 전투를 돕는 크리처를 소환하세요.

title: Exo Exploits
description:
게임 정보
은하 무역 연합(GTF)의 운영자로서, 당신은 기업 제국을 확장하기 위해 먼 행성으로 파견됩니다. 당신의 임무는 간단합니다: 공장을 건설하고, 자원을 착취하며, 수익을 창출하는 것. 그러나 탐욕으로 가득 찬 은하에서, 연합의 요구를 충족시키기 위해 어디까지 나아갈 수 있겠습니까?
산업 제국을 구축하고 확장하세요
효율성과 이익을 극대화하기 위해 미래지향적인 공장 단지를 설계하고 관리하세요. 자원 채굴, 생산, 물류를 조화롭게 운영하며 행성 밖 제국을 성장시키세요.
우주 함대를 제작하고 지휘하세요
무역, 연구, 방어를 위한 특화된 우주선을 제작하세요. 함대를 구성하여 수익성 높은 무역로를 확보하고 경쟁자를 물리치며 은하 곳곳에서 새로운 기회를 열어보세요.
계약을 완료하고 연방에 영향을 미치세요
GTF에서 자원 수집부터 함대 구축까지 다양한 계약을 수락하세요. 모든 결정이 냉혹한 연방 관리들과의 평판에 영향을 미칩니다. 성공은 보상을, 실패는 대가를 가져옵니다.
네온과 결합된 레트로-퓨처리스틱 미학을 정복하세요
Exo Exploits의 생생하고 신스웨이브에서 영감을 받은 비주얼에 빠져보세요. 빛나는 공장 바닥부터 박동하는 우주 풍경까지, 레트로-퓨처리스틱한 분위기가 모든 순간을 잊을 수 없게 만듭니다.

title: One & Done
description:
게임 정보
다양한 무기를 활용한 전투: 원앤던에서는 4가지의 독특한 무기를 사용해 던전을 탐험하며 몬스터들과 싸워야 합니다.
상황에 맞는 무기 변경: 던전 안에서 무기가 자주 바뀌기 때문에 각 무기의 고유한 특성과 능력을 활용해 전략적으로 전투를 진행해야 합니다.

title: With Dream
description:
게임 정보
At the last moment of life, if you could go back in time, would there be any regrets you want to make up for?
Dr. Carl and Dr. Menoria have a special job: they listen to people's wishes, travel back in time, and then turn those wishes into reality.
However, this also brings serious consequences. As determined by time, even the slightest change can cause irreversible disasters to reality.
Yet one proven fact is that if something has already happened, it can no longer be changed.
Provided that the wish is reasonable, this service is only offered to one kind of people - those who are dying.
This newly - developed technology can convert a person's spirit into an optical signal. With the help of the person's memory fragments, it can trace back step by step to the earliest time. Under one mystery and clue after another, it gradually uncovers the truth and realizes the wish... if everything goes smoothly...
This time, they came to the home of Nathaniel, an old man full of mysteries. Obviously, this job will be different from previous ones.
His last wish is... a door.
------------------------------------------------------------------
A combination of puzzle - solving, adventure elements and RPG
Appropriate music and plot arrangement
A non - combat game mode
A touching story
A cinematic gaming experience

title: Ruby Journey
description:
게임 정보
Note for the demo
1) It's in development, some details may look unpolished or cheap (pausemenu, settings menu)
2) I forgot to delete the save, it'll be removed in a future demo update.
> Click "new game" in the first launch.
3) The settings menu is not yet functioning.
Also don't forget to feedback, it's genuinely helping.
> I have a Discord server dedicated to the game.
Introducing, Ruby Journey
Ruby Journey is an immersive sim taking place in a village.
You arrive with just one gold, and you want their ruby.
Trade, do quests, manage your resources wisely to get richer...
Talk to PNJs and grow friendships, all while discovering their lore...
Befriend...
You've officially come to help the village to recover from its recent hardships.

title: Swingin'!
description:
게임 정보
Swingin’! is a physics-based action game where you stick a pole to your environment to control your character’s movement. Swingin-kun can't generate speed by himself, so be careful not to waste the speed you gain from falling! You can bounce off the floor, stick to walls, alternate between your two arms to attach yourself to the ceiling and move sideways– with some creativity, you can do all kinds of things! Furthermore, Swingin’! includes a level editor so that you can create and share your own custom stages!

title: Tilebound
description:
게임 정보
Tilebound is a captivating blend of strategy, puzzle-solving, and magical combat, where every tile you place shapes your destiny. You are a novice Tile Wizard, bound to an ancient spellbook, seeking freedom by mastering the art of building powerful tile chains and unleashing elemental spells.
Key Features:
Strategic Tile Placement
Begin your journey with a single enchanted tile and unlock new ones as you progress through the levels. Each tile carries unique elemental properties—allowing you to create intricate chains that trigger devastating spells.
Dynamic Spellcasting System
Align your tiles to match rune shapes hidden within each level. The longer your chain and the more precise your patterns, the more powerful your spells become, rewarding you with rare tiles and magical artifacts.
Evolving Challenges
Face an array of progressively complex levels, each introducing new mechanics and environmental hazards. Every level tests your mastery of the spellbook.
Freedom Through Mastery
Every chain you build brings you closer to unlocking the full potential of your spellbook. Can you master the art of tile magic and break free from the book's bindings?
Are you ready to place your first tile and begin the journey to freedom?

title: There's No Cake
description:
게임 정보
The cake is a lie! We looked very hard but still couldn't find any!
There's No Cake is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random sweet treats to find for each of them.
9 Different Levels
3 Difficulty Settings
customizable background colors
replayable with 20 cake out of 60 selected for each play
special hidden cakes
hint system
zoom
achievements
