title: Deb
description:
게임 정보
Deforb is a roguelite top-down shooter game where a mad orb defending its tower from endless waves of enemies. Armed with up to 4 melee guns and a long-range gun, the orb uses a combination of close and ranged combat to keep the foes at bay. In addition to powerful weapons, the orb can deploy turrets, strategically placing them to help turn the tide of battle.
As the game progresses, you can upgrade your skills, choosing from a wide range of abilities that enhance your combat effectiveness and defense strategies. The key to survival lies in creating the perfect build, utilizing these upgrades to adapt to the increasingly difficult waves of enemies. Every decision you make — from weapon choice to skill upgrades — will shape your strategy, allowing you to experiment and find the most powerful combinations to protect the tower.

title: 非常迷 Variable Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
《Variable Puzzle》is a strategy puzzle game.Challenge your intelligence and unleash your strategies! Come and try various challenges, enter the wonderful world of the game, explore the deep secrets of puzzles, and demonstrate your decision-making and thinking abilities.

title: Spell Magic
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling adventure in various procedurally generated open worlds, where magic and mathematics collide. In Spell Magic, you'll craft and master powerful spells using the fundamental forces of arithmetic, geometry, and algebra.
As a skilled mathemagician, you'll explore a vast, ever-changing realm, teeming with fearsome monsters and challenging puzzles. Your quest is to unravel the secrets of the mystical arts, harnessing the power of numbers to bend reality to your will.
Explore Procedurally Generated Worlds
Each time you play, the world is reborn, offering a fresh experience. Various options to customize any new game are available. Options such as starting with any available upgrades or any amount of gold. Various modes all the way from permadeath to invincible exist with many more in-between.
Craft Your Spells
Combine mathematical concepts to create an arsenal of unique spells. Experiment with:
Geometric patterns for your shields and projectiles
Algebraic equations to create perfectly placed elemental attacks
Vector arithmetic to warp the 3rd dimension with your movement

title: Carnival of Souls
description:
게임 정보
Recently, your hometown has been gripped by a wave of terrible events. Children begin to disappear under mysterious circumstances, and no one can explain what is happening. You have become one of the victims of this mysterious abduction and now you must find out who is behind these terrible events.
Carnival of Souls is a first—person psychological horror game with the atmosphere of an abandoned circus and a scary but exciting story.
Photorealistic graphics
Realistic gameplay
The game is based on the Unreal Engine 5
Explore the abandoned circus
Solve the mystery of the missing children

title: AHAPIKA – Heroic Agency
description:
게임 정보
What would make a great hero like Achilles harvest olives for an ordinary market woman? What would drive the great Greek heroes to become ordinary couriers? The desire for fame and adventure, of course!
Ahapika is the most heroic agency in Greece, and only the most valorous and glorious are accepted. Follow the path of its origin from the very beginning! You will have to fulfill the requests and orders of both ordinary mortals and the great Olympian gods. But be careful - sometimes an innocent request to deliver a package can lead to fatal consequences. Fight with beasts and monsters, argue with gods and titans, gather the best heroes to help.
An exciting story:

title: Car Factory Empire
description:
게임 정보
카 팩토리 엠파이어는 자동차 회사를 만들고 관리하는 게임입니다. 시장에서 성공을 거두려면 자동차를 이끌고 경주에 참여하고, 자동차를 개발하고 제작하고, 새로운 기술을 연구하고, 시장을 차지하기 위해 경쟁하고, 새로운 공장과 생산 시설을 차지해서 구매해야 합니다.
이 게임의 배경은 20세기 초, 자동차 시대가 시작되던 때입니다. 자동차 회사를 아예 처음부터 만들어야 합니다. 최초의 자동차를 생산하고 판매하는 법을 배우고, 다른 제조업체와 시장에서 경쟁하기 위해 정기적으로 개선하고 개량합니다. 공장의 모든 생산 공정을 관리하고, 생산을 규제하고, 구매자를 찾고, 연구를 관리하고, 자동차를 설계해야 합니다. 100개가 넘는 자동차 기술과 10개가 넘는 다양한 차체 덕분에 자동차를 만드는 과정은 흥미진진하고 다면적입니다. 또한 생산에 필요한 자원을 추출하고, 원자재 공장을 점령하고 통제해야 하며, 다른 제조업체와 시장 점유율을 위해 경쟁하고, 직접 만든 자동차로 경주에 참여하고, 다양한 대회에 참여해야 합니다. 이 게임은 제작 시뮬레이터, 글로벌 전략 및 역동적인 레이싱의 요소를 갖추고 있습니다. 이 모든 것이 당신에게 진짜 자동차 재벌이 된 듯한 기분을 느낄 수 있는 기회를 줄 것입니다! 비싸고 빠른 차를 생산할 것인가, 아니면 싸고 대량 생산할 것인가? 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!
카 팩토리 엠파이어에서 플레이어는 자신만의 자동차 회사를 만듭니다. 플레이어는 회사 이름을 정하고, 어떤 종류의 자동차를 생산할지 결정해야 합니다. 다음 모델 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다: 고급형, 저가형, 스포츠형. 어떤 종류의 자동차 공장과 그 자동차가 어떤 종류일지는 플레이어가 결정해야 합니다.  생산된 자동차는 품질, 신뢰성, 속도, 가격 등의 특성으로 구성된 특별한 등급에 따라 평가됩니다. 이러한 특징을 바탕으로 게임을 하면서 자동차 구매자를 찾게 됩니다. 하지만 가장 중요한 것은 자동차를 생산하고 판매하는 것입니다! 최초의 자동차는 다소 원시적일 수 있지만, 판매에서 수익을 냄으로써 플레이어는 자동차 설계에 새로운 기술을 개발하고 구현하여 자동차를 더 좋게 만들 수 있을 것입니다. 과학 건물에서 플레이어는 자동차의 새로운 차체와 유닛을 연구하고, 공장의 생산 건물을 개선할 수 있습니다. 관리 건물에서 플레이어는 공장 직원을 관리하고 생산 공정을 제어할 수 있습니다.
새로운 기계를 생산하고 연구하려면 플레이어는 자원과 원자재가 필요하며, 이는 세계 지도에 있는 자원 광산과 건물을 점령하여 획득하고 축적해야 합니다. 컴퓨터 상대는 이러한 건물을 차지하기 위해 플레이어와 경쟁합니다. 게임의 목표: 지도 상에서 가장 큰 도시를 장악하고 영향력을 행사하여 자동차 시장에서 핵심적인 점유율을 차지하는 것입니다. 자동차 생산에 들어간 노력을 보여주기 위해, 플레이어는 직접 자동차를 조종하고, AI와의 경주에서 만들어진 자동차를 평가할 수 있습니다. 플레이어가 자동차 디자인에 구현한 모든 기술은 자동차의 핸들링, 무게, 속도, 제동, 주행 거리 등에 많은 영향을 미칩니다!
Car Factory Empire에서는 회사가 파산하거나 타겟 고객이 없는 열악한 자동차를 생산할 경우 플레이어가 손해를 볼 수도 있습니다. 하지만 어떤 기계공장이 될지, 어떻게 승리를 쟁취할지는 플레이어의 결정에 달려있습니다! 귀하의 자동차는 대중화되어 대량 생산될 수 있고, 반대로 고급스럽고 명성 있는 모델을 소량 생산하여 성공을 거두고 경주에서 명성을 얻을 수도 있습니다! 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!

title: You Die Today
description:
게임 정보
YOU DIE TODAY
Step into a dungeon-crawling adventure that combines the strategic depth of deck-building with the thrill of rolling dice. Inspired by the magic of tabletop RPGs, this game brings you a unique rogue-like experience where every roll counts.
Key Features:
Deck-Building with a Twist: Collect powerful cards with unique abilities and build your ultimate deck.

title: Astrumis - Survive Together
description:
게임 정보
[아스트루미스 - 서바이브 투게더]는 두 명의 플레이어를 위해 설계된 독점 협동 호러 게임입니다. 한 플레이어는 버려진 우주선에서 생존자를 조종하고 다른 플레이어는 우주선 자체를 조종합니다. 두 플레이어는 함께 협력하여 우주선을 탐색하고 퍼즐과 미니게임을 해결하며 미스터리한 괴물로부터 살아남아야 합니다.

생존자
생존자 - 존 코왈스키[/b]로 플레이하세요. 배를 돌아다니며 보이지 않는 괴물과 마주하세요. 다른 플레이어의 지시에 따라 괴물을 피하고 살아남으세요.

미션 컨트롤
미션 컨트롤 - 양성빈으로 플레이합니다. 괴물은 육안으로는 보이지 않지만 보안 카메라를 통해 위치를 파악할 수 있습니다. 다른 플레이어가 우주선을 안전하게 탐색할 수 있도록 조종하세요.

다양한 협동 미니게임을 해결하세요. 혼자서 완료할 수 있는 게임은 없으며, 모두 다른 플레이어와 협력해야 합니다.

title: The Last Trophy
description:
게임 정보
Mell, a space explorer, receives a strange signal from an unknown planet. Interested in the possible rewards, she heads toward the planet.
As she approaches to investigate, a strange force field takes control of the ship.
Being dragged into the atmosphere, Mell enters the escape module and avoids a direct impact.
Now, trapped on an unknown planet, Mell needs to find a way to her ship and escape from this place.

title: Star Deck
description:
게임 정보
Overview



Star Deck is a love-child of Slay the Spire, Smash Up, and all your childhood sci-fi movies! It's a roguelike deckbuilding adventure, set in a galaxy controlled by The Federation, a galactic force that won the Great War, and seized control of the democratically controlled powers before it. It rules with a totalitarian fist, asking for tribute from the citizens of each planet, and offering little in return.

In the game, you'll play as a galactic smuggler who's brother was abducted by The Federation. With little to go on, you embark on an adventure to find and rescue him. Using a randomized roguelite gameplay strategy that keeps things different in each play through, you'll battle your way through 4-6 different levels across the galaxy with varying biomes, ranging from the robot space-islands, to sand-swept deserts, to frozen waste-lands, all the while building up a deck comprised of 2 weapons with unique playstyles!
Weapons



In the final game, there will be 5-6 weapons to choose from when you begin a new run. In each run of the game, you'll get to pick 2 weapons to equip, and those weapons will each have their unique deck of cards that contribute to your card pool for that run.

Each unique weapon deck will have a minimum of 30 cards. Starting decks will be comprised of a few of those cards, and the rest you will encounter during your play through as battle rewards, event rewards, or shop purchases. You'll build the strongest deck you can, using strategies based on the strengths of your weapon classes to synergize together! Part of the fun will be experimenting with different combinations of weapons to see which work the best together.

In the current demo, there are 2 weapons available for use, the Blaster and the Ice Hammer.

The Blaster uses ammo slots in addition to each card's base Energy cost, so you'll need to closely manage your ammo and reload when needed, or else you won't be able to attack! The Blaster specializes in getting many attacks out quickly and dealing good damage.

The Ice Hammer is a defensive weapon that deals less damage, but makes up for that with it's freeze mechanic. Each attack from the hammer places a frost stack on the enemy, and once the enemy gets 3 stacks they'll be frozen until the next turn. Other cards in the hammer's deck will also revolve around this frost mechanic, allowing you to place stacks in other ways, and build your defenses up with passive Power and Skill cards.



In addition to the weapon card pools, there will be a plethora of non-weapon cards to choose from on a run. Events will have unique cards that you can obtain that will aid you on your adventure, and there will also be a general, non-weapon card pool accessible on card selection opportunities, and in the Shop.

Combat will be at the center of the game's core, where you use your cards to battle enemies that you encounter along your journey. A variety of different RPG-style battle mechanics are already in the game, including vulnerability, attack weakness, counter attacks/moves, shielding, healing, multi-attacks. Final game will include critical strike and poison mechanics, along with many more! Play the demo on Steam for the full immersive battle experience!

Explore colorful, intriguing world environments as you battle your way through multiple levels on your adventure to find your lost brother! I'm aiming for a vibrant, amusing, and sometimes silly vibe for the game.

Enemies next moves are shown atop their head so you can plan a strategy for battle. are shown under your HP, and hovering over explains their effects and duration.

In addition to regular enemy battles, will spawn on the map that you can encounter as well. Players are encouraged to fight the elites as they have higher risk/rewards benefits. Players will be able to get a unique artifact from elite enemies that boosts their run in some way. At the end of each level, there will be a boss encounter with even more rewards! After each battle, you'll get to choose a new card to add to your deck, or if you need to you can heal instead.

There will be a vibrant array of unique enemies to encounter through the game. The first level, Robotica is a city full of robots so there is a handful of different robot enemies to encounter. As you progress in the game to new levels, the enemies will be part of that unique biome. Think sand monsters in the desert, ice creatures in the frozen tundra, etc. Each level will have 8-12 unique enemies to encounter!

Encounter unique events that may help or hurt you, all randomized on the map! Events are specific to each level to add to the story.

The Shop! A necessary stop in an adventurer's journey. Use the Remover tool to remove cards from your deck, or the Duplicator to make copies of cards you love! Also stock up on consumables, like the Health Flask. Earn currency, or credits, as you win battles or through Events.

Consumables can be used for a one time bonus in (or sometimes outside) battle to give you an edge. Purchase them in the Shop, get hem as Battle rewards, or from some Events.

Artifacts are permanent bonuses that you gain throughout your adventure. They might give you bonuses when you draw cards, or give you extra Energy or Ammo, or boost your chances at finding rare cards! Some artifacts may be so powerful that they completely change how your strategy for a run goes.

This game contains art assets created by AI tools. As an independent, small game studio of 1 person, I have found AI generation tools to be incredibly helpful for creating my vision of this sprawling, colorful sci-fi galaxy. Human artists are amazing and can never be truly replaced by AI, but in my case, the resources to hire talented artists to work with daily would be significantly higher than I can afford, as this is my first game. Even though AI may have generated these assets, this is still the vision of a human who dreamt it all up. I hope you won't be dissuaded from giving this game a chance just because of that.

title: Shadows Over Harken
description:
게임 정보
Step into the medieval fantasy world of Shadows over Harken, where a dark necromancer threatens to corrupt the peaceful village of Harken and its surrounding lands. Join a unique team of heroes—Relic, a strong warrior; Alessia, a gifted cleric blessed with power; Hiligon, a powerful paladin; Klean, an agile fighter from another plane; and Neville, a unique and special bard. Experience an immersive visual novel that combines deep storytelling with combat mechanics, where your choices shape the story and the fate of the land. Engage in battles, explore a richly detailed world, and uncover hidden secrets while enjoying captivating artwork and an epic soundtrack. Can you lead your team to victory and stop the necromancer before it’s too late? History based in an original roleplaying campaing.

title: Tales of War
description:
게임 정보
Tales of War is a highly dynamic multiplayer voxel medieval experience featuring large scale castle siege maps and many classes to choose from.
Features:

20+ classes
5 classes of each role: Frontline, Ranged, Support and Mobile.


Siege [2-100 players]
Engage in large-scale battles and conquer all flags to win.


Fight in close quarters and defeat each enemy 3 times to win. An Arena server contains 4 arenas (up to 24 players) and 12+ randomly selected map


Make a significant impact on the battlefield by selecting real life Legends with unique abilities.

title: Monster Mash
description:
게임 정보
The evil pharmaceutical mogul Ultrachem has been tampering with a ton of top secret genetic projects lately. Everything seemed to be going as planned until the planet was invaded by the Gorgonaut Empire! With a healthy dose of gamma rays, the laboratory’s test gecko, who has been undergoing less-than-kind experiments lately, decides to exact their revenge!

You're deemed too high of a threat to the city of Metroville and you'll have 2 minutes until the city is completely nuked. The frat alien sect known as the UFBro's are on Lunar Break and they're screwing up the planet just for kicks (and a ton of views on GlikGlok). They'll deliver various mutated weapons like mallets, swords, and ray guns to up the ante, as well as delicious snacks. Destroy buildings, cars, and everything else as you absolutely RAGE!

title: WuttWorld
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Wutt World! A competitive multiplayer platform where simply being the fastest, isn't enough!
Collect bonuses, PLACE hazards, SURVIVE hazards, EARN hazards, place MORE hazards, outsmart your competition and impress the gods of this mysterious world and prove yourself.
Tons of hidden secrets to achieve and unlock. Stand out; be unique; showcase yourself and do it in style.

title: MEDIX
description:
게임 정보
How much can a person endure, and what is the true value of human life? In this minimalist real-time strategy game about war medics, you fight for your own survival and that of others while the army is under constant pressure, retreating from a superior enemy. A narrative campaign, accompanied by hand-drawn illustrations, takes you through the story of physicians pushed to their breaking point in their fight for a sliver of hope.

In MEDIX, you and the Medical Unit IX of the Imperial Army face a formidable challenge. In a story-driven campaign, you'll embark on a journey that will test your speed, wits, and endurance.

Rescue the wounded from the battlefield, gather supplies to care for them, and build infrastructure. Cleverly distribute your personnel between buildings, and when necessary, pack up your structures and use the recycled materials to build new ones or move the entire camp to a different location. In the heat of battle, you must constantly adapt to the dynamically changing situation.

The people you help, and their loved ones, will gladly support your efforts to upgrade your unit or expand your ranks out of gratitude.

War is both terrible and magnificent, and the characters in our story experience its horrors firsthand. Hand-drawn illustrations accompany an emotional narrative about the effort to save as many lives as possible, while also striving to retain one's humanity and hope.

title: Train your slayer
description:
게임 정보
Train your slayer is an auto_attack-linear-idle-survival-clicker game.
Just simply upgrade your slayer, he auto attack and can be forward further in the dungeon to see how far can he go.
Eliminate enemy to gain points for slayer upgrade for your slayer to become stronger.
Donate earned Gold to help maintaining item stock in the shop.
Get your highest score to compete with others.
-Caution for mature scene-

title: Familiar Stranger
description:
게임 정보
Be cautious about what your child watches late at night—certain shows may feature unsettling content or frightening imagery that can cause distress, leaving lingering effects on their imagination. These terrifying images might even bleed into your child’s dreams, giving life to their worst fears. The Familiar Stranger is a gripping 3D psychological horror game that takes you on an intense journey through the fragmented recollections of a child's troubled mind.
In this immersive experience, you will step into the shoes of a young child, forced to navigate through a world of twisted memories and unsettling visions. The game challenges you to uncover dark secrets hidden deep within the child's past, revealing the deep-rooted fears that have shaped their reality. As you delve into their mind, you’ll discover that not everything is as it seems—each memory holds a clue, a piece of the puzzle, but also a terrifying secret that might just haunt you forever.
But there’s more to fear than just the unsettling memories. The Familiar Stranger is an ever-present entity, always watching from the shadows, drawing closer as you uncover more of the child's hidden past. It’s a figure that feels both eerily familiar and undeniably threatening, a silent observer waiting for the right moment to strike.
As you explore, you’ll need to be quick, clever, and stealthy. The Stranger is relentless, lurking in the darkness, always one step behind. Can you outwit it, or will you be caught in a never-ending game of cat and mouse? The game forces you to face your fears head-on, testing your ability to survive in a world where memory and nightmare blur into one.
The Familiar Stranger isn’t just a game—it’s a psychological thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat, forcing you to confront the haunting question: how much of your own past is locked away, and what happens when those memories come back to life? Prepare for an unforgettable experience that will challenge both your courage and your mind.

title: Deadwalker Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
Survive, Strategize, and Adapt in the Ultimate Zombie Apocalypse!
Enter a collapsing world teeming with danger, where every decision shapes your survival. Build your deck, face relentless encounters, and customize your challenges in this unique strategy card game. The question is: How long can you survive?
Dynamic Encounter System
Each game presents a new challenge, with encounters created from Mission, Zombie, Danger, and Location decks. These decks combine to create diverse scenarios, ensuring that your strategies are tested in every session.
Your Choices, Your Strategy
Craft your deck with powerful cards and prepare for the unexpected. Will you focus on combat efficiency, resource management, or defensive strategies? Every decision matters as you navigate the challenges ahead.
Key Features:
Dynamic Encounter Decks: Mix and match Mission, Zombie, Danger, and Location cards for endless possibilities.
Customizable Scenarios: Tailor your challenges by choosing how the encounter decks are built.
Deck-Building Strategy: Create a deck that suits your playstyle and adapt it as the threats evolve.
Tense Survival Atmosphere: Experience the pressure of making critical decisions in a world of constant danger.
Single-Player Focus: A strategy game designed for players who enjoy testing their tactical skills.
How Will You Survive?
Face relentless threats, build your path to survival, and forge your legacy in a world on the brink of collapse. Your journey is waiting—if you dare to take the first step.

title: ToDo LisT
description:
게임 정보
할 일 목록의 중요한 과제
반복되고 지루한 삶에서 벗어나려고 합니다. 일상적인 할 일을 완료하는 동안, 그들은 점점 인생의 진실을 발견하게 됩니다.

어느 날, TV 프로그램에서 신비로운 오웰 선생님이 그들에게 미래를 바꿀 수 있는 정보를 전했습니다. 당신은 이러한 기회를 잡을 수 있을까요?
다양한 결말
매일의 할 일 작업에서, 당신의 선택은 다양한 결과를 가져올 수 있습니다. 좋든 나쁘든.
특별한 퍼즐 풀이 경험
일상적인 과제는 간단하고 지루할 수 있지만, 단서는 이미 당신의 일상의 모든 구석에 숨겨져 있습니다. 이러한 퍼즐을 풀면, 할 일 목록 뒤에 더 큰 음모가 숨어 있을지도 모릅니다.

title: Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu
description:
게임 정보
You could say that Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu is like running a marathon while wearing a lobster onesie, dodging exploding melons thrown by other contestants, avoiding ravenous Shiba inu dogs, and being featured on a bizarre Japanese TV gameshow—all at the same time. If you did say that, you’d be absolutely right!
FEATURES:
VERSUS MODE
Choose from the lobster-man J DARWIN, the horned-hoodie Elizabeth Nishibori, the old-man-sailor Zenbei or everyone’s favourite dog-person Snuguru Maestro or create your own crazy character! Once all four humans or CPU are ready the marathon will begin! 
Get to the finish line by diving, dashing, dodging though the crazy obstacle course. Who will make it through the cup-ramen museum unscathed? Which one will duck though the docks in one piece? Use weapons such as the brand new Whirling Cucumber to slap your opponents silly or take crucial shortcuts using the inflatable Pineapple Balloon to leave them for dust!

title: Station Haven 3
description:
게임 정보
Station Haven 3 is a first-person horror game where you will be playing as the newest crew member aboard the station Haven 3.
As you wake up to the growing sound of an engine, you find yourself aboard a Pod that's about to arrive at Station Haven 3. With no recollection of how you got there in the first place, or even who you are, you unwillingly step onto the Station.
Where is everyone?
Uncover the mystery of the crew's vanishing aboard the station. Find their audio logs and uncover their story, along with their last moments before they disappeared. 
Maintain the ship's usability.
As you uncover the secrets of the Station, you must make sure that it maintains full usability. By using the Terminal aboard the Station, figure out what section of the ship requires your attention and fix the issue before it's too late.
Uncover the secrets of the Station and find out who you are.
Who sent you here? Why were you sent here? Who even are you? Slowly piece together the clues you will find aboard the station and put everything together to figure out what has happened.
Find a way to escape.
Will you be able to find a way to get back home? Is there even a way out?

title: White Prototype
description:
게임 정보
오픈 캠퍼스의 세계를 자유롭게 탐험하며 4년간의 학생 생활을 보내보세요. 게임 제작 동아리 회원으로서 동아리 회원들과 협력하여 유능한 게임 개발자로 성장해 보세요.
캠퍼스 활동에 참여하고, 대학 과정을 이수하고, 생활비와 등록금을 벌고, 캠퍼스에서 생존하고, 성공적으로 졸업합니다.
교실, 기숙사, 상점, 클럽... 낮과 밤이 번갈아 바뀌며 다양한 장면에서 활동하며 계절이 바뀌고 모든 것이 시간에 따라 변합니다.
일상생활에서 게임 디자인에 대한 영감을 수집하고, 커뮤니티 구성원과 협력하여 함께 게임 개발을 완료합니다.
능력을 향상시키고, 더 큰 무대에서 더 많은 캐릭터를 알아가고, 이곳에서 과거와 미래를 탐험해보세요.

title: Nightmare Owl
description:
게임 정보
나이트메어 올"에서, 벗어날 수 없는 악몽에 갇힌 크리시의 잊혀지지 않는 1인칭 공포 세계로 들어가세요. 그녀는 가족의 오래된 농장에서 사탄의 책을 발견한 후, 악마들이 끊임없이 그녀를 사냥하는 무서운 꿈의 풍경에 갇히게 됩니다. 살아남을 수 있는 유일한 희망은 이 어둡고 뒤틀린 세계에서 탈출할 수 있는 열쇠를 쥐고 있는 신비한 안내자인 애매한 올빼미를 찾는 것입니다. 농장의 으스스한 잔해를 탐색하면서, 그림자 속에 도사리고 있는 악마의 세력을 따돌리고 달아나야 합니다. 길을 밝혀줄 손전등만 있으면, 수수께끼를 발견하고, 숨겨진 단서를 찾고, 밤을 살아남는 데 필요한 모든 수단을 사용할 것입니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 한 걸음 한 걸음 나아갈수록 위험에 더 가까워지고, 오직 올빼미만이 자유로 가는 길을 보여줄 수 있습니다. 두려움에 맞서 악몽의 손아귀를 끊을 용기가 있을까요? 아니면 영원히 어둠 속에 갇히게 될까요?
근접 무기 찾기
--------
무기를 사용하여 물건을 부수거나 악마로부터 자신을 보호하세요. 조심하세요, 악마들은 매우 빠르게 공격합니다!
빨리 손전등을 찾으세요!
---------
대부분의 시간 동안 어둠 속에 있기 때문에 손전등이 필요합니다! 손전등은 일반적으로 악몽 속으로 들어갈 때 가까이에 있습니다.

title: Operation Zero
description:
게임 정보
Operation Zero is top-down run-n-gun arcade shooter with a sci-fi comedy edge. A mysterious and threatening artificial intelligence is spreading across New America, and only one hero has the brawn, firepower and ignorance to stop it: TASKILLER, the ultimate bio-engineered super-soldier!
You'll need the help of the GENERAL and some state-of-the-art firepower to blast your way through hordes of AI-deranged droids and drones to reach the nerve center of 8 secret bases, each more dangerous than the last.
Featuring:
Top-down run-n-gun action... fans of the late 80's and 90's arcade classics will feel right at home
Twin-Stick controls by default, but configurable to suit other styles
8 missions to take on, containing 5-7 levels each, spanning forests, secret bases and underground AI nerve centers
Arena Mode: a non-narrative "infinite" way to play - see how long you can survive against a never ending barrage of enemies
Randomly generated levels for extra replayability
Plentiful and stackable weapon powerups to form interesting and deadly combinations. Including but not limited to rapid, bounce, spread, split, explosive...
Personal drone powerups to augment your firepower

title: Crazy Robot Ball
description:
게임 정보
Step into the thrilling world of Crazy Robot Ball, the ultimate turn-based football showdown! Take command of a team of high-tech robots, each with unique attributes designed to give you the edge in the battle for robotic football supremacy.
Gameplay Highlights:
Turn-Based Tactics: Plan your moves strategically in this turn-based twist on traditional soccer. Anticipate your opponent’s plays, set up the perfect pass, and unleash unstoppable shots on goal!
Customizable Robots: Assemble your dream team with robots that boast specialized attributes—lightning-fast speedsters to dart past defenders, powerhouse strikers to blast through any blockade, and durable defenders to hold the line.
Four Unique Maps: Play across four distinct maps, each set in a unique location and featuring interesting layouts that add new layers of strategy. Adapt to varying terrain and field shapes to outwit your opponents.
Game Modes for Every Player: 
Freeplay Mode: Explore the game at your own pace. Experiment with lineups, perfect your strategies, and refine your skills without the pressure of competition.
Tournament Mode: Test your mettle in a high-stakes championship. Face off against increasingly formidable opponents to claim the prestigious Golden Trophy and cement your legacy as a Crazy Robot Ball champion.
With vibrant arenas and dynamic play-by-play action, Crazy Robot Ball delivers an electrifying mix of strategy and excitement. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a fun challenge or a tactical mastermind aiming to dominate the league, this game guarantees hours of thrilling gameplay.

title: Ballardo
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of Ballardo, where classic pool meets innovative roguelike strategy! Plan your shots, aim for high scores, and customize your gameplay with powerful upgrades and abilities. With endless replayability and a unique blend of skill and strategy, Ballardo offers an exciting new way to enjoy billiards.
Core Features:
Classic Pool Gameplay: Intuitive mechanics that are familiar yet refreshing.
Roguelike Progression: Surpass target scores to advance through increasingly challenging stages.
Stickers and Relics: Boost your balls or transform the game dynamics with stickers and relics.
Dynamic Scoring System: Earn points through pocketing, bouncing, and comboing balls with precision.
Shop Between Stages: Spend your hard-earned coins on upgrades, items, and packs to adapt to your strategy.
Stylish Visuals: A clean, modern take on billiard aesthetics.

title: You Have A Delivery
description:
게임 정보
You Have A Delivery는 스타일리시하고 빠른 템포의 FPS 액션 게임입니다. 맨 인 블랙과 성룡 영화의 유머에서 영감을 받은 이 유쾌한 모험에서, 단 하룻밤 만에 뉴욕을 장악한 마피아를 소탕해야 합니다. 당신의 코드네임이 너무 길어서 모두가 간단히 “에이전트”라고 부르며, 건물마다 위험천만한 마피아 보스를 쓰러뜨리는 임무를 수행하게 됩니다. 해낼 수 있겠습니까?
장애물을 뛰어넘고, 벽을 달리고, 공중에서 회전하며, 그래플링 훅을 이용해 적에게 기습하세요. 새로운 무기를 잠금 해제하여 다양한 전략을 시도하고, 적들을 산산조각 내며 각 스테이지를 기록적인 속도로 클리어하세요. 높은 점수를 모아 리더보드에서 이름을 떨쳐보세요!

title: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny
description:
게임 정보
From the hidden pages of Jurnal Risa comes a visual novel where the boundary between the living and the unseen begins to blur. Step into Jurnal Risa's world where each shadow holds a story, and every whisper leads you deeper into the unknown.
Witness the resurrection of the forspoken nemesis of Jurnal Risa crew that was never told before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game.
This is the tale of Jurnal Risa, as recounted to me by Risa herself.
Key features
A Paranormal Adventure Mystery
Brought to Life with Full Voice Acting
Mini games
Collect the Fragments of the Past
Ready to turn the last page and face what lingers beyond?

title: The NAKI Files
description:
게임 정보
Naki is a single-player first-person survival horror game. You play as a conspiracy theorist who reads strange books in search of bibliographic references while an Anunnaki tries to stop you from publishing everything online. You can turn your house into a true battlefield and research lab, moving TVs, cameras, scanners, and even landmines.
READ strange books without being seen
At the start of each round, an even stranger topic is randomly selected. Your job: find mentions or references (direct or indirect) to the topic within the books. The catch? There’s an Anunnaki in your house. What’s it doing there? Well… you’ve been snooping where you shouldn’t, thinking for yourself for far too long… theorizing about grand conspiracies… and now it’s time to share your findings with the world. At any cost.
TYPE manually to publish

title: Titans of Commerce
description:
게임 정보
Titans of Commerce: A game where YOU! become the capitalist behind the shadows at the wake of WW1. Manipulate diplomacy, fund opposition's journals or even a coup! Triple your income via arms sales, profiting from global tension. Design, produce and sell the train, gun or ship of your will! Fund Governments and get hefty tax cuts. Improve your business day by day and open factories all around Europe. Thanks to the fund that were left to you with these tax cuts, improve your factories and even find talented people in their jobs and employ them! Or just live your life as a simple baker... All scenarios are possible with 20 different sectors to play with.

Topple Governments and Fund Politics
Meddle with politics, fund the party you like and help them get to power, in exchange; you can get several benefits and hefty tax cuts.
Profit From Politics, War and Peace
You can maintain relations with +40 different authentic parties throughout the Europe, benefit and thrive your business with your political connections.

title: COLD BOOT
description:
게임 정보
한 방, 한 명
모든 타격이 중요한 치열한 액션을 경험하세요. 적의 총알과 당신의 카타나는 즉시 죽입니다. 죽을 때마다 한 번의 반복(iteration)이 소모되며 마지막 체크포인트로 돌아갑니다. 죽음은 당신의 실력을 연마할 뿐이지만, 너무 자주 죽지 않도록 주의하세요!
반복 회복 메커니즘:
마지막으로 쓰러진 지점에 도달하면 반복을 회복할 수 있습니다. 이 신선하고 영리한 메커니즘은 죽음의 아픔을 덜어주면서도 긴장감을 더합니다—새로운 경로를 찾아 적을 처치할 것인가, 아니면 손실을 보충할 것인가? 매 순간 예측 불가능한 선택이 이어집니다.
업데이트와 스킬:
적을 베어 충전량을 채우고, 이를 사용해 시간 감속 같은 강력한 스킬을 활용하세요. 게임을 진행하면서 이동, 공격, 충전 관리 등에 영향을 미치는 무작위로 제공되는 다양한 업그레이드를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다. 이 업그레이드들을 자유롭게 조합해 나만의 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들어 보세요.

title: Game  Aliens
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 초고도 외계 문명에 의한 갑작스런 인류 멸종에 대비해 만든 보복 프로그램입니다
경고: 이 게임은 인류를 위해 만들어지지 않았습니다.
언어가 필요 없는 직관적인 UI로 은하계 어디에서나 즐길 수 있습니다. 귀여운 그래픽으로 포장된 이 게임의 진짜 목적은 단 하나 - 외계인들을 미치게 만드는 것입니다.
당신이 이 게임을 구매해야 하는 이유:
이 게임은 외계인 침공에 대한 보험입니다
우리가 멸망해도 이 게임은 영원히 외계인들을 괴롭힐 것입니다
당신의 컴퓨터에 이 게임을 설치하는 것은 인류에 대한 헌신입니다
플레이어 가이드
이 게임을 최대한 많은 기기에 설치하십시오
바탕화면과 작업 표시줄 최상단에 배치하여 눈에 잘 띄게 하십시오
게임의 난이도는 매우 높습니다
하지만 도전을 즐기는 용감한 플레이어시라면? 게임 클리어 영상과 스크린샷을 SNS에 공유해주세요. 이 악마적인 게임이 마치 쉽고 재미있는 캐주얼 게임처럼 보이게 만드는 것... 그것이 바로 당신의 임무입니다.
이 게임으로 고통받을 외계인들을 생각하면서 오늘도 평화로운 하루를 보내세요!
올라가세요
거대한 하나의 장소로 이루어진 이 게임에서는 단 하나의 목표만 있습니다.
올라가는 것입니다.
제한시간은 없습니다. 당신의 인내심이 허락한다면 무한히 도전할 수 있습니다.
올라가고, 또 올라가세요. 꼭대기에 도착하면 당신의 승리입니다.

title: Familiar Stranger
description:
게임 정보
Be cautious about what your child watches late at night—certain shows may feature unsettling content or frightening imagery that can cause distress, leaving lingering effects on their imagination. These terrifying images might even bleed into your child’s dreams, giving life to their worst fears. The Familiar Stranger is a gripping 3D psychological horror game that takes you on an intense journey through the fragmented recollections of a child's troubled mind.
In this immersive experience, you will step into the shoes of a young child, forced to navigate through a world of twisted memories and unsettling visions. The game challenges you to uncover dark secrets hidden deep within the child's past, revealing the deep-rooted fears that have shaped their reality. As you delve into their mind, you’ll discover that not everything is as it seems—each memory holds a clue, a piece of the puzzle, but also a terrifying secret that might just haunt you forever.
But there’s more to fear than just the unsettling memories. The Familiar Stranger is an ever-present entity, always watching from the shadows, drawing closer as you uncover more of the child's hidden past. It’s a figure that feels both eerily familiar and undeniably threatening, a silent observer waiting for the right moment to strike.
As you explore, you’ll need to be quick, clever, and stealthy. The Stranger is relentless, lurking in the darkness, always one step behind. Can you outwit it, or will you be caught in a never-ending game of cat and mouse? The game forces you to face your fears head-on, testing your ability to survive in a world where memory and nightmare blur into one.
The Familiar Stranger isn’t just a game—it’s a psychological thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat, forcing you to confront the haunting question: how much of your own past is locked away, and what happens when those memories come back to life? Prepare for an unforgettable experience that will challenge both your courage and your mind.

description:
게임 정보
나이트메어 올"에서, 벗어날 수 없는 악몽에 갇힌 크리시의 잊혀지지 않는 1인칭 공포 세계로 들어가세요. 그녀는 가족의 오래된 농장에서 사탄의 책을 발견한 후, 악마들이 끊임없이 그녀를 사냥하는 무서운 꿈의 풍경에 갇히게 됩니다. 살아남을 수 있는 유일한 희망은 이 어둡고 뒤틀린 세계에서 탈출할 수 있는 열쇠를 쥐고 있는 신비한 안내자인 애매한 올빼미를 찾는 것입니다. 농장의 으스스한 잔해를 탐색하면서, 그림자 속에 도사리고 있는 악마의 세력을 따돌리고 달아나야 합니다. 길을 밝혀줄 손전등만 있으면, 수수께끼를 발견하고, 숨겨진 단서를 찾고, 밤을 살아남는 데 필요한 모든 수단을 사용할 것입니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 한 걸음 한 걸음 나아갈수록 위험에 더 가까워지고, 오직 올빼미만이 자유로 가는 길을 보여줄 수 있습니다. 두려움에 맞서 악몽의 손아귀를 끊을 용기가 있을까요? 아니면 영원히 어둠 속에 갇히게 될까요?
근접 무기 찾기
--------
무기를 사용하여 물건을 부수거나 악마로부터 자신을 보호하세요. 조심하세요, 악마들은 매우 빠르게 공격합니다!
빨리 손전등을 찾으세요!
---------
대부분의 시간 동안 어둠 속에 있기 때문에 손전등이 필요합니다! 손전등은 일반적으로 악몽 속으로 들어갈 때 가까이에 있습니다.

title: Deadwalker Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
Survive, Strategize, and Adapt in the Ultimate Zombie Apocalypse!
Enter a collapsing world teeming with danger, where every decision shapes your survival. Build your deck, face relentless encounters, and customize your challenges in this unique strategy card game. The question is: How long can you survive?
Dynamic Encounter System
Each game presents a new challenge, with encounters created from Mission, Zombie, Danger, and Location decks. These decks combine to create diverse scenarios, ensuring that your strategies are tested in every session.
Your Choices, Your Strategy
Craft your deck with powerful cards and prepare for the unexpected. Will you focus on combat efficiency, resource management, or defensive strategies? Every decision matters as you navigate the challenges ahead.
Key Features:
Dynamic Encounter Decks: Mix and match Mission, Zombie, Danger, and Location cards for endless possibilities.
Customizable Scenarios: Tailor your challenges by choosing how the encounter decks are built.
Deck-Building Strategy: Create a deck that suits your playstyle and adapt it as the threats evolve.
Tense Survival Atmosphere: Experience the pressure of making critical decisions in a world of constant danger.
Single-Player Focus: A strategy game designed for players who enjoy testing their tactical skills.
How Will You Survive?
Face relentless threats, build your path to survival, and forge your legacy in a world on the brink of collapse. Your journey is waiting—if you dare to take the first step.

title: ToDo LisT
description:
게임 정보
할 일 목록의 중요한 과제
반복되고 지루한 삶에서 벗어나려고 합니다. 일상적인 할 일을 완료하는 동안, 그들은 점점 인생의 진실을 발견하게 됩니다.

어느 날, TV 프로그램에서 신비로운 오웰 선생님이 그들에게 미래를 바꿀 수 있는 정보를 전했습니다. 당신은 이러한 기회를 잡을 수 있을까요?
다양한 결말
매일의 할 일 작업에서, 당신의 선택은 다양한 결과를 가져올 수 있습니다. 좋든 나쁘든.
특별한 퍼즐 풀이 경험
일상적인 과제는 간단하고 지루할 수 있지만, 단서는 이미 당신의 일상의 모든 구석에 숨겨져 있습니다. 이러한 퍼즐을 풀면, 할 일 목록 뒤에 더 큰 음모가 숨어 있을지도 모릅니다.

title: Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu
description:
게임 정보
You could say that Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu is like running a marathon while wearing a lobster onesie, dodging exploding melons thrown by other contestants, avoiding ravenous Shiba inu dogs, and being featured on a bizarre Japanese TV gameshow—all at the same time. If you did say that, you’d be absolutely right!
FEATURES:
VERSUS MODE
Choose from the lobster-man J DARWIN, the horned-hoodie Elizabeth Nishibori, the old-man-sailor Zenbei or everyone’s favourite dog-person Snuguru Maestro or create your own crazy character! Once all four humans or CPU are ready the marathon will begin! 
Get to the finish line by diving, dashing, dodging though the crazy obstacle course. Who will make it through the cup-ramen museum unscathed? Which one will duck though the docks in one piece? Use weapons such as the brand new Whirling Cucumber to slap your opponents silly or take crucial shortcuts using the inflatable Pineapple Balloon to leave them for dust!

title: Tretrais
description:
게임 정보
In the near future, within the Tertaris Mountains on Mars, a mysterious force damages your spacecraft with cosmic pressure. The emergency escape system activates, ejecting you into a rescue capsule. Escape is only the beginning—prepare to defend the Tertaris Mountains and Mars from parasitic lifeforms!
Armed with advanced technology and cutting-edge weapons, you’ll fight against hostile lifeforms that tolerate no other species. Survive the cosmic pressure, land in the Tertaris Mountains, and engage in an epic fight against the parasites.
The parasites are attempting to invade Mars. It’s up to you to stop them and save the future of the Red Planet! Fulfill the Tretrais mission and become a hero of Mars.
Explore the secret hideouts of the parasites in the Tertaris Mountains and plan strategic attacks. Remember, humanity needs you. These mountains are a vital resource for human survival. Only you can put an end to this chaos.

title: There's No Cake
description:
게임 정보
The cake is a lie! We looked very hard but still couldn't find any!
There's No Cake is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random sweet treats to find for each of them.
9 Different Levels
3 Difficulty Settings
customizable background colors
replayable with 20 cake out of 60 selected for each play
special hidden cakes
hint system
zoom
achievements
tag: 캐주얼,포인트 앤드 클릭,퍼즐,숨은 그림 및 물체

title: Deb
description:
게임 정보
Deforb is a roguelite top-down shooter game where a mad orb defending its tower from endless waves of enemies. Armed with up to 4 melee guns and a long-range gun, the orb uses a combination of close and ranged combat to keep the foes at bay. In addition to powerful weapons, the orb can deploy turrets, strategically placing them to help turn the tide of battle.
As the game progresses, you can upgrade your skills, choosing from a wide range of abilities that enhance your combat effectiveness and defense strategies. The key to survival lies in creating the perfect build, utilizing these upgrades to adapt to the increasingly difficult waves of enemies. Every decision you make — from weapon choice to skill upgrades — will shape your strategy, allowing you to experiment and find the most powerful combinations to protect the tower.

title: 非常迷 Variable Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
《Variable Puzzle》is a strategy puzzle game.Challenge your intelligence and unleash your strategies! Come and try various challenges, enter the wonderful world of the game, explore the deep secrets of puzzles, and demonstrate your decision-making and thinking abilities.

title: Isoge
description:
게임 정보
Forge Your Dream City in Isoforge
Explore a vast island, design your perfect city, and defend it against relentless invasions! Isoforge combines strategic city-building with dynamic events, giving you endless possibilities to shape your world. Are you ready to build, defend, and thrive?
Build & Expand
Start with only a rocket and expand into a sprawling city. Choose from a wide variety of buildings, each offering unique effects that influence others positively or negatively. Unlock new structures, upgrades and events influencing your city in new ways.
Recruit & Defend
In Isoforge, threats are never far away. Recruit soldiers, unlock new units, and prepare for invasions. Strategize your defenses to protect your city while balancing resources and expansion.
Dynamic Events
Each in-game day brings new surprises! From invasions and upgrades to building unlocks and unexpected challenges, every moment keeps you on your toes. Can you adapt to the ever-changing world of Isoforge?
Unique Interactions
Buildings don’t exist in isolation. Every structure in Isoforge interacts with others, either enhancing their effectiveness or creating obstacles. Master this system to optimize your city and overcome challenges.
Gamemodes
Choose from different gamemodes, challenging you in new ways or giving you an even more relaxing experience.

title: Hop On It
description:
게임 정보
Your goal is to reach the top.With nothing but a pogo stick, you start climbing. The journey isn’t easy. You’ll bounce across tricky obstacles, fight for control, and maybe lose your cool along the way. Play solo or team up with friends for some chaotic fun. Can you conquer the challenge, or will the forest get the best of you?

title: RADIO STALKER
description:
게임 정보
비극으로 삶이 파괴된 후, 주인공은 완전히 고립됩니다. 라디오 스토킹은 고통을 완화할 수 있는 유일한 방법이 됩니다. 그러나 그가 깊이 빠져들수록 현실에서 멀어져 갑니다.

주파수를 맞추고, 신호를 녹음하고, 발견한 것을 공개하세요. 좋아요, 조회수, 돈이 새로운 통화가 됩니다. 그러나 그 대가로 무엇을 희생하고 있습니까?

이것은 괴물에 관한 이야기가 아닙니다. 이것은 자신의 생각에 갇히고 자신을 잃는 것이 얼마나 쉬운지에 대한 이야기입니다.

당신의 행동은 두 가지 결말 중 하나로 이어집니다. 너무 늦기 전에 멈출 수 있습니까?

title: Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition
description:
게임 정보
Hands on sticks... You're one of them. Things to hand out... There's a lot of them.
Embark on a short journey no hand on a stick has been on until now and never again. Rummage through things, avoid being slapped, and hand stuff out to other hands before they lose their patience.
RUMMAGE THROUGH STUFF
Stick your hand in various piles to find what the greedy hands are wanting. You'll need to be quick or they'll become impatient and just leave without even waving goodbye.
KEEP THE STUFF
Put your hand in danger to keep your stuff from falling on the floor, being slapped, or stolen by aliens in tiny UFOs.

title: AHAPIKA – Heroic Agency
description:
게임 정보
What would make a great hero like Achilles harvest olives for an ordinary market woman? What would drive the great Greek heroes to become ordinary couriers? The desire for fame and adventure, of course!
Ahapika is the most heroic agency in Greece, and only the most valorous and glorious are accepted. Follow the path of its origin from the very beginning! You will have to fulfill the requests and orders of both ordinary mortals and the great Olympian gods. But be careful - sometimes an innocent request to deliver a package can lead to fatal consequences. Fight with beasts and monsters, argue with gods and titans, gather the best heroes to help.
An exciting story:

title: Car Factory Empire
description:
게임 정보
카 팩토리 엠파이어는 자동차 회사를 만들고 관리하는 게임입니다. 시장에서 성공을 거두려면 자동차를 이끌고 경주에 참여하고, 자동차를 개발하고 제작하고, 새로운 기술을 연구하고, 시장을 차지하기 위해 경쟁하고, 새로운 공장과 생산 시설을 차지해서 구매해야 합니다.
이 게임의 배경은 20세기 초, 자동차 시대가 시작되던 때입니다. 자동차 회사를 아예 처음부터 만들어야 합니다. 최초의 자동차를 생산하고 판매하는 법을 배우고, 다른 제조업체와 시장에서 경쟁하기 위해 정기적으로 개선하고 개량합니다. 공장의 모든 생산 공정을 관리하고, 생산을 규제하고, 구매자를 찾고, 연구를 관리하고, 자동차를 설계해야 합니다. 100개가 넘는 자동차 기술과 10개가 넘는 다양한 차체 덕분에 자동차를 만드는 과정은 흥미진진하고 다면적입니다. 또한 생산에 필요한 자원을 추출하고, 원자재 공장을 점령하고 통제해야 하며, 다른 제조업체와 시장 점유율을 위해 경쟁하고, 직접 만든 자동차로 경주에 참여하고, 다양한 대회에 참여해야 합니다. 이 게임은 제작 시뮬레이터, 글로벌 전략 및 역동적인 레이싱의 요소를 갖추고 있습니다. 이 모든 것이 당신에게 진짜 자동차 재벌이 된 듯한 기분을 느낄 수 있는 기회를 줄 것입니다! 비싸고 빠른 차를 생산할 것인가, 아니면 싸고 대량 생산할 것인가? 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!
카 팩토리 엠파이어에서 플레이어는 자신만의 자동차 회사를 만듭니다. 플레이어는 회사 이름을 정하고, 어떤 종류의 자동차를 생산할지 결정해야 합니다. 다음 모델 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다: 고급형, 저가형, 스포츠형. 어떤 종류의 자동차 공장과 그 자동차가 어떤 종류일지는 플레이어가 결정해야 합니다.  생산된 자동차는 품질, 신뢰성, 속도, 가격 등의 특성으로 구성된 특별한 등급에 따라 평가됩니다. 이러한 특징을 바탕으로 게임을 하면서 자동차 구매자를 찾게 됩니다. 하지만 가장 중요한 것은 자동차를 생산하고 판매하는 것입니다! 최초의 자동차는 다소 원시적일 수 있지만, 판매에서 수익을 냄으로써 플레이어는 자동차 설계에 새로운 기술을 개발하고 구현하여 자동차를 더 좋게 만들 수 있을 것입니다. 과학 건물에서 플레이어는 자동차의 새로운 차체와 유닛을 연구하고, 공장의 생산 건물을 개선할 수 있습니다. 관리 건물에서 플레이어는 공장 직원을 관리하고 생산 공정을 제어할 수 있습니다.
새로운 기계를 생산하고 연구하려면 플레이어는 자원과 원자재가 필요하며, 이는 세계 지도에 있는 자원 광산과 건물을 점령하여 획득하고 축적해야 합니다. 컴퓨터 상대는 이러한 건물을 차지하기 위해 플레이어와 경쟁합니다. 게임의 목표: 지도 상에서 가장 큰 도시를 장악하고 영향력을 행사하여 자동차 시장에서 핵심적인 점유율을 차지하는 것입니다. 자동차 생산에 들어간 노력을 보여주기 위해, 플레이어는 직접 자동차를 조종하고, AI와의 경주에서 만들어진 자동차를 평가할 수 있습니다. 플레이어가 자동차 디자인에 구현한 모든 기술은 자동차의 핸들링, 무게, 속도, 제동, 주행 거리 등에 많은 영향을 미칩니다!
Car Factory Empire에서는 회사가 파산하거나 타겟 고객이 없는 열악한 자동차를 생산할 경우 플레이어가 손해를 볼 수도 있습니다. 하지만 어떤 기계공장이 될지, 어떻게 승리를 쟁취할지는 플레이어의 결정에 달려있습니다! 귀하의 자동차는 대중화되어 대량 생산될 수 있고, 반대로 고급스럽고 명성 있는 모델을 소량 생산하여 성공을 거두고 경주에서 명성을 얻을 수도 있습니다! 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!

title: You Die Today
description:
게임 정보
YOU DIE TODAY
Step into a dungeon-crawling adventure that combines the strategic depth of deck-building with the thrill of rolling dice. Inspired by the magic of tabletop RPGs, this game brings you a unique rogue-like experience where every roll counts.
Key Features:
Deck-Building with a Twist: Collect powerful cards with unique abilities and build your ultimate deck.

title: Idle Circles
description:
게임 정보
Release a marble so that it fills circle after circle with glowing light.
Clean the light particles to win points, then use these points to buy more marbles.
Let the marbles do their work, or click a circle to manually fill it. 
Play until space runs out and the level ends.
Make strategic choices in the skill tree
Once a level is over, it’s time to spend your remaining marbles in the skill tree.
Choose for each token color critical skills that will change the way you play : boost, automate, multiply…
Do keep a few marbles for the next level ;)
Create your own neon aesthetic
Choose your own color palette or pick among preselected themes, whether for accessibility or maximum visual satisfaction.

title: Escape from Chancellor's Chambers
description:
게임 정보
Escape from Chancellor's Chambers is a puzzle game with platforming elements where you play as a Wizard trying to escape from the many chambers below the chancellor's castle.

Solve puzzles, avoid traps, and find spells to help aid you in your escape. You may meet some interesting characters along the way!


There are several spells that can help the player progress past challenges that were previously impossible.

There is an in-depth story that will try to pull in the player and teach them about the world and the characters inside it, including what roles they play.

title: Evolution adventure
description:
게임 정보
Breeder Simulator: A Game Where Monsters Go on Adventures Themselves
In this game, the player takes control of a base dedicated to raising and crossbreeding monsters. Roads stretch out in all directions from the base, filled with adventures, treasures, and other monsters.
Ran out of monsters? No problem! Skip a day, and new ones will be born in your basement.
Upgrade your base, explore the map, and create the rarest and most valuable monsters.
Planned for release:
A global map packed with quests.
Over 30 base monsters for evolution.
More than 400 types of evolved monsters.
Over 20 hours of gameplay to complete the main story, with endless possibilities for discovering new evolution combinations.
Embark on this evolution adventure and become the ultimate monster breeder!

title: Kiko's Apple Adventure
description:
게임 정보
What if you can move the target point in a block pushing game?
Kiko is a curious little bear who loves tasty apples. Help Kiko collect apples to make the biggest apple pie ever!
But be aware of dangers!
Outsmart your enemy!

title: Solaro
description:
게임 정보
Solaro takes you deep inside a mysterious world, full of strange creatures, cryptic puzzles, and relics of an ancient past... How did you wind up in this quiet, forgotten sector of the galaxy, and can you master the necessary skills to chart a path through the darkness and back towards your origins?
Explore space from a new point of view! Navigate the cosmos by harnessing the natural forces of your environment, like gravity, wind, and magnetic fields. Your powerful protective shell can withstand extreme pressure, temperature, acidity, and other conditions, letting you dive deep into dangerous worlds in search of buried treasures...

title: Air Fleet
description:
게임 정보
Airfleet - your own airline is in your hands! Manage every aspect of the business: from thoughtful route planning to precise crew selection, every decision affects the reputation and efficiency of the company.
Create an extensive transportation network, combining major international terminals with cozy provincial airfields. Optimize connections and logistics, turning each airport into a vital hub for your empire.
Choose your strategy: become a leader in mass budget transportation or create an elite service for demanding customers. A variety of classes allows you to customize comfort and pricing, gaining passenger trust and loyalty.

title: Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories
description:
게임 정보
'The Neverending Check-In: The Hotel Stories'에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 이 게임은 매혹적인 2D 픽셀 RPG로, 당신을 특별한 모험으로 초대합니다. 이 호텔에 체크인하면 호텔의 매력적인 과거의 새로운 장이 펼쳐집니다.
이 몰입감 있는 게임에서 당신은 큰 임무에 도전하게 됩니다: 옛날의 호텔의 영광을 다시 되찾는 것입니다. 호텔의 깊은 곳으로 들어가면, 많은 퀘스트와 미스터리, 도전이 당신의 결심을 시험하게 됩니다.

기발한 스태프부터 흥미로운 손님까지, 각자의 이야기를 가진 다양한 캐릭터들과 교류하십시오. 의미있는 관계를 맺고 비밀을 발견하며 게임을 진행하면서 호텔과 그 안의 주민들의 변화를 목격하세요.

몰입감 있는 퀘스트를 통해 위대한 모험, 유머러스한 탈출, 그리고 감동적인 여정을 경험하십시오. 호텔 내의 미로를 통해 퍼즐을 해결하고 장애물을 극복하면서 호텔의 매력적인 이야기를 발견하십시오.

유머와 알려진 우주를 참조하는 기발한 대사로 여정에 흥미진진한 층을 더해보십시오. 당신이 호텔의 역사와 그것이 갖고 있는 비밀에 다가가는 모든 단계를 즐겨보십시오.

정교하게 제작된 픽셀 아트에 몰입하며 호텔의 매력적인 공간에 생명을 불어넣고, 호텔이 잊혀진 유물에서 생동감 넘치는 생명과 경이의 중심지로 변화하는 것을 목격하십시오.

그리고 우리가 고양이에 대해 언급했던 것을 기억하십니까? 고양이 동반자의 비밀스러운 생활과 그들이 큰 계획에서 놀라운 역할을 하는 것을 발견하십시오.

'The Neverending Check-In: The Hotel Stories'의 영광을 불태우고 당신의 마음을 울리고 도전하는 모험에 참여할 준비가 되셨나요?

이야기는 당신의 도착을 기다리고 있습니다.

title: Ploko
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Ploko, a VR adventure full of creativity and surprises!
🌍 BUILD MINIATURE WORLDS
Step into a universe where you’re the creator. Enjoy piecing together enchanting dioramas that come to life in themed landscapes.
📷 CAPTURE MOMENTS AND UNCOVER SECRETS!
With the Polaroid camera, aim, snap… and sometimes, Ploko himself has hidden surprises waiting in your photos!

title: Spinny Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
Spinny Dungeon is a roguelike deckbuilder with elements of an auto battler.

You were crawling through dungeons as usual. One dungeon... You saw a strange portal in the corner of the room and a huge button in front of it. You pressed that button. Then you pressed it again, and again, and again...

The Demon of the Slot Machine has sent his minions to find your soul. Stop these monsters before they reach the RED ZONE.

title: Paw Party
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Paw Party: Your AI-Powered Party Playground!
Paw Party is an AI-powered social party game community. Here, players can enjoy online gatherings and play tabletop games not only with real friends but also with AI companions.
- Unmatched Social Gaming with AI Companions
In Paw Party, you can enjoy a unique experience playing party games and online tabletop games with lively AI companions. These AI friends bring warmth, understanding, and energy, creating a social dynamic like no other.
- A more authentic AI companionship experience
Our AI NPCs are more than just sidekicks; they’re your pets and companions. Chat with them, deepen your bond, and enjoy a friend who’s there for you anytime, anywhere, making every game feel special!
- Game Features
✨ AI-Generated Challenges and Comments, Surprises at Every Turn!

title: Crabs Dive In Crossway
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
"Crabs Dive In Crossway" is a Sokoban-like puzzle game. You need to command a troop of crabs and manage them to the target places. Each crab can only move in horizontal or vertical line, and all crabs will move simultaneously.
When two crabs from crossed directions meet, the later crab will step on the back of the former to form a Crab-Bind, and be driven to move along with the crab below. A Crab-Bind can push single crab forward. The gameplay is all about "How to reasonably allocate target shelters for each crab and deliver them to place". You may try hard brainstorming to avoid the crowding and trampling of crabs in horizontal and vertical lines.
There are 6 chapters, altogether 60 manually designed levels for playing around. Each chapter corresponds to a unique puzzle solving technique for you to discover.
Control
一 Menu 一
[ WASD/↑←↓→ ] Move Crab
[ SPACE ] Interact
一 In Level 一
[ WASD/↑←↓→ ] Move (by grid)
[ ESC ] Exit Level
[ R ] Retry
[ Z ] Undo
[ X ] Redo
Contact Us
QQ Group: 825324074

title: Sabotage City
description:
게임 정보
Sabotage city takes the idea of a city builder and flips it on its head, making a city destroyer game. You are an average citizen hired to work for a gigantic demolition company, little to find out the cities are less than abandoned… sweet!
Fast paced money management gameplay with a high skill ceiling, speedrunning tools, and a freeplay mode for replayability.
Different gimmicks that spice up the gameplay experience. like being able to hire workers for extra money, or controlling the press to rile up the people. All with the end goal of making the citizens leave.
A full story mode campaign with 20+ locations to destroy,  and a full plot with multiple characters, locations, and different routes to take the story.
Web 1.0 web page inspired menus and shops. Instead of a normal shop menu the game uses a computer with charming 90s style websites that give advice on how to get better, helps you buy tickets to the cities you destroy, and give backstory to the world of the game.
Multiple endings. 
Codes and ciphers to discover and solve. The game is packed with loads of hidden puzzles and things to solve all across it.

title: Awen
description:
게임 정보
Enter the world of Awen
A dark force has spread through the land corrupting everything in it's path.  You have been tasked with restoring the balance.
You will have to overcome dark foes and use your magic to heal and restore the natural order.
Large Open World
If you're tired of linear "on-rails" VR games, Awen is a huge world to explore.  You can progress in your own way and engage with as much or as little content as you want.
Visceral Combat
Tactile and satisfying melee and bow combat.  Melee combat in VR is often awkward due to the weightlessness of the weapon.  Awen leans into that with a more fantasy approach to weapons with elaborate effects.
Gesture-based Spell System
Magic is the core of your characters abilities.  The gesture-based casting system is natural and intuitive allows you to weave and sling spells fluidly and quickly.
Learn powerful new spells as you progress and spend skill points augmenting your existing spells

title: exorSYS
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to exorSYS
After unknowingly upgrading to a cursed operating system, you must follow a breadcrumb of previous victims in order to uncover the truth before you inevitably become a victim yourself. Solve puzzles, dig for secrets, hack computers, and use special programs to help advance from level to level.
exorSYS Report Panel

title: Blood Curse Legions
description:
게임 정보
피의 저주 군단
게임에서 당신은 뱀파이어의 창시자로서 피의 저주 군단을 이끌고 세상을 휩쓸며 뱀파이어 국가를 세우고 지역을 지배하게 됩니다.
이 게임은 최대 4명의 플레이어를 지원하며, 협력 및 경쟁 모드를 제공합니다.
플레이어는 주로 전투에서 뱀파이어 기병 군단을 제어하며, 다양한 상황에 따라 포메이션을 변경하여 최대한의 피해를 입히고 지원 포메이션을 사용자 정의합니다.
영웅 유닛: 영웅은 랜덤 속성을 가지며, 매번 다른 게임 경험을 제공합니다. 일반적으로 4가지 유형이 있습니다:
탱크
약탈자
원거리
마법사
풍부한 스킬 선택을 통해 영웅의 성장 방향을 사용자 정의할 수 있습니다.
다양한 유형의 군대:
방패 보병
창 보병
원거리 부대
괴물 부대
비행 부대
자신만의 뱀파이어 성을 건설하세요: 여러 층의 성을 건설하고 전리품으로 장식할 수 있습니다. 성은 파괴될 수 없습니다.
적의 공격을 막기 위해 전방 요새를 건설하세요. 전방 요새는 파괴될 수 있습니다.
장비 및 제작 시스템: 무기 및 기타 중요한 아이템을 결합할 수 있습니다.

title: Chaotic Cute Ghost
description:
게임 정보
The Mystery of Memory
In a world where chaos and void are intertwined, you awaken from endless darkness, finding yourself in a chaotic world. This place is the haven for forgotten souls, those unable to transcend, wandering here forever unable to be freed. Your memory is fragmented, the only thing you can rely on are the memory fragments scattered throughout this world. These fragments are like guiding beacons, gradually piecing together snippets of your past life.
Battle and Adventure
You vaguely recall having fallen in a fierce battle, destined to enter the cycle of reincarnation, but just before dying, you activated a mysterious reincarnation array. This array carried your soul into the chaotic world, avoiding the fate of reincarnation. You must continuously accumulate strength through adventure and battle in the chaotic world until you can activate the array again to leave this place.

title: Departure
description:
게임 정보
Once upon a time, in the pacific northwest...

Departure is an management sim set in the air traffic control tower of a small, regional airport. Players are tasked with directing incoming and outgoing flights during the normally quiet night shift. Inspired by 90's pulp media like Outer Limits, Twilight Zone, Twin Peaks, and X-Files.
Flight Management Sim: Direct incoming and outgoing flights at Ganlley Airport using radar, runways, and your own best judgment.
Immersive Controls: Move objects and interact with the world using physics inspired by titles like Garry’s Mod.
An Evening Dreary: Let narrative events unfold while you engage with your work. See how your actions unfold the evening’s mystery.

title: ANLG_VOID
description:
게임 정보
YOU WERE NEVER SUPPOSED TO BE HERE.
I want you to imagine something for a second.
You take a wrong turn, step through a doorway that shouldn’t exist, and suddenly—reality slips. The world you knew is gone, replaced by an endless, shifting maze of yellowed hallways, flickering lights, and the distant hum of something you can’t see. ANLG_VOID isn’t just another Backrooms game. It’s an immersive, atmospheric horror experience built to make you feel truly lost.
Running on Unreal Engine 5.5, this game pushes scale, sound, and psychological terror to their limits. Every flickering light, every distant echo, every doorway that wasn’t there a second ago—it’s all designed to mess with you. To make you question whether you’re being watched. Because you are.
This is a true-to-lore survival horror experience that respects the eerie, uncanny world of the Backrooms Wiki. And in this world, reality doesn’t just warp—it fights back.
A WORLD THAT REJECTS YOU
The Backrooms don’t want you here, and they’ll do everything they can to break you.
The campaign mode is a handcrafted descent into madness, a slow-burn horror experience that drags you deeper through the most infamous levels of the Backrooms. You’ll wander through vast, eerily empty hallways, liminal spaces that feel just off enough to make your skin crawl, and branching paths that loop back on themselves—if they even lead anywhere at all.
But you’re not the only one trapped here.
As you explore, you’ll encounter other survivors—some barely clinging to sanity, others banding together to navigate the nightmare. Groups like the M.E.G. (Major Exploration Group) have staked claims in certain areas, offering shelter, supplies, and—if you’re lucky—guidance on how to survive. But not every group has your best interests at heart. Some are desperate. Some are hostile. And some… well, some have been here far too long.
Future multiplayer expansions will introduce procedurally generated environments, where the Backrooms shift and change, ensuring no two journeys are ever the same. But for now, the campaign? That’s carefully designed terror, built to pull you deeper into the unknown, one step at a time.
A GIFT THAT BECAME A NIGHTMARE
You play as James, an uncle who just wanted to buy his nephew the perfect birthday gift—a vintage VHS camera. It should’ve been simple.

title: Dug Out
description:
게임 정보
"Dug Out" is an exciting multiplayer PvP game for 2-4 players, where you dive into an underground arena and engage in intense battles. Armed with guns, you'll dig through the environment to uncover hidden opponents and outsmart your rivals. It’s a fast-paced, action-packed experience that keeps you on your toes!

title: Kingdom Defense: Deliverance
description:
게임 정보
이 몰입감 넘치는 2D 게임에서 끊임없는 오크와 악당의 파도로부터 성을 지켜내세요. 독특한 방어 유닛과 전략적인 게임 플레이를 활용하여 요새를 보호하고 승리를 쟁취하세요. 왕국을 지키면서 장대한 전투와 스릴 넘치는 판타지 모험을 경험하세요.
주요 특징
역동적인 전투 메커니즘: 몰입감 넘치는 전투 메커니즘으로 전략적인 실시간 게임 플레이를 즐기세요.
독특한 방어 유닛: 다양한 영웅, 전사, 신비로운 생명체를 지휘하여 방어를 강화하세요.
강력한 능력: 영웅에게 특별한 능력을 장착하고 파괴적인 힘을 발휘하여 오크의 침략을 막아내세요.
도전적인 레벨: 각각 고유한 적과 장애물이 있는 일련의 도전적인 레벨에서 전투를 벌이세요.
에픽 보스 전투: 전략적인 기술과 결단력을 시험하는 강력한 보스와 대결하세요.
게임플레이
침략군을 격퇴하기 위한 전술을 계획하고 실행하면서 전략적인 방어의 세계로 뛰어들어 보세요. 각 레벨마다 새로운 도전과 적들이 등장하므로 전략을 조정하고 개선해야 합니다. 자원을 수집하고 유닛을 업그레이드하고 난공불락의 요새를 건설하여 공세를 막아내세요.
전투에 참여하기
킹덤 디펜스를 다운로드하세요: 지금 다운로드하여 오크의 침략으로부터 왕국을 지키기 위한 장대한 여정을 시작하세요. 영웅이 되어 군대를 승리로 이끄세요!

title: Lunar Descent
description:
게임 정보
개요:
당신은 달의 깊이로 자동 하강하는 서브루나 캡슐 안에 있습니다.
하강하는 동안 다양한 아노말리들을 만나게 되며, 대부분은 무해합니다. 그러나 잠재적으로 위험한 아노말리를 발견하면 즉시 경로를 변경하고 보고서를 제출하십시오.
게임 방법? 다음 질문에 답하십시오:
잠재적으로 위험한 아노말리를 발견하셨나요?
예 --> 즉시 보고서를 제출하고 경로를 변경하십시오.
아니오 --> 하강을 계속하십시오.
특징:
VHS 분위기 [실시간 소음 및 시각적 왜곡]
동적 카메라 [몰입감을 위한 약간의 "흔들리는" 카메라 효과]
숨겨진 엔딩 [당신의 선택에 따른 여러 결말][/*][/list]
참고 사항:
플레이 시간: 1-3 시간

title: Bam Bam Boom
description:
게임 정보
Experience the thrill of combat with a unique roster of characters, each with their own technical and thoughtful move sets designed for both casual players and competitive fighters alike. Master your character’s abilities and outplay your opponents in intense platform battles.

Whether you're battling friends locally or challenging players online, Bam Bam Boom offers endless fun and competitive game play.

Key Features
Unique characters: Choose from a diverse set of characters, each with unique abilities and strategies
Technical Move Sets: Discover deep, thoughtful move sets that reward skill and timing
Online Multiplayer: Battle against friends and players from all over the world in online matches
Local Multiplayer: Gather your friends and engage in local battles for ultimate bragging rights
Custom Games: Create your own rules and settings for a unique fighting experience
Challenges: Test your skills in a variety of exciting challenges against opponents who will push your limits

title: Riftborn
description:
게임 정보
“Riftborn“ 은 인간, 언데드, 괴물 세 진영의 멀티플레이어 슬래셔 아레나로, 인간, 언데드, 괴물이 아레나에서 대결을 펼칩니다. 각기 다른 직업과 능력으로 각 경기는 전략과 액션으로 가득합니다. 저주받은 폐허에서 싸우고 고대 요새의 깊은 곳에서 우위를 점하세요. 각 경기장에는 교활함, 팀워크, 그리고 승리할 수 있는 능력이 필요합니다. 기사의 검을 휘두르든, 마법을 시전하든, 괴물처럼 적을 찢어 죽이든, 한 가지 확실한 것은 혼돈이 지배하고 재미가 멈추지 않는다는 것입니다!
다양한 무기
검, 도끼, 활, 석궁, 단검, 칼, 창, 원하는 마법 등 다양한 방법으로 상대를 죽일 수 있습니다!
게임 모드
Riftborn에는 다양한 플레이 스타일에 맞게 설계된 다양한 게임 모드가 있습니다. 플레이어는 혼란스러운 자유 대전(FFA) 모드에서 전투를 벌이고, 팀 데스매치(TDM)에서 동료와 협력하며, 최후의 팀 순위(LTS)에서 자신의 기량을 시험해볼 수 있습니다.

title: Pest Control Simulator
description:
게임 정보
현실적인 해충 방제 경험
Pest Control Simulator는 플레이어에게 집안의 해충 문제를 매우 현실적으로 체험할 수 있는 시뮬레이션 경험을 제공합니다. 작은 개미부터 큰 쥐까지 다양한 장비와 화학물질을 사용하여 해충 없는 환경을 유지하세요.
다양한 장비와 전략
다양한 종류의 해충을 처리하기 위해 여러 도구가 제공됩니다. 작은 해충에는 스프레이를, 날아다니는 곤충에는 전기채를, 쥐와 전갈 같은 큰 해충에는 끈끈이 패드를 사용하세요. 상황에 맞는 도구를 선택해 효과적으로 문제를 해결하세요.
화학물질과 업그레이드
다양한 화학물질을 전략적으로 사용해 해충을 처리하세요. 연소, 지연, 산, 바이러스 효과를 가진 스프레이가 해충 제거를 도와주며, 일부는 주변 곤충에게 전파됩니다. 게임을 진행하면서 장비와 화학물질을 업그레이드하여 작업을 더 쉽게 만드세요.
점점 어려워지는 도전
레벨이 올라갈수록 도전 과제가 더 어려워집니다. 새로운 종류의 해충, 더 큰 해충 침입, 복잡한 환경이 여러분을 기다립니다. 도구와 전략을 익혀 커지는 도전에 대비하세요.
재미있고 중독성 있는 게임플레이
빠른 액션과 여유로운 순간이 조화를 이루는 Pest Control Simulator는 모든 연령대의 플레이어에게 재미있고 몰입감 있는 경험을 제공합니다. 전략적 사고와 타이밍을 활용해 각 레벨을 완료하고 해충을 물리치세요!

title: Fire in the Dark
description:
게임 정보
"Fire in the Dark" is a unique psychological horror game. Immerse yourself in a story where reality and fictional worlds intertwine, uncovering the secrets and traumas of the main character. Solve the mysteries of her subconscious across two interconnected realities: her Room and the computer game.
STORY
At first glance, it seems like an ordinary story of a girl trapped in her room. But as you delve deeper, you realize the room conceals her inner fears, memories, and pain. In the computer game, you explore a dark forest, fight to survive by the campfire, and meet characters that embody the girl’s psychological struggles.
Every action in the room affects the game. Interact with objects, explore her personal space, and uncover subtle clues that help you progress in both worlds.
CHAPTERS

title: The Empty House - A Dementia Interactive Experience
description:
게임 정보
The Empty House – An Interactive Experience About Dementia
What Remains When Memories Fade?
The Empty House is a deeply emotional and surreal interactive narrative experience that takes you inside the unraveling mind of a woman suffering from advanced dementia. As reality crumbles around her, time loops, memories distort, and once-familiar places become eerie and unrecognizable.
This is not a traditional puzzle or action game. Instead, it is an experiment in perception, a descent into forgetting, and an exploration of what it means to lose oneself. Through cinematic storytelling and full-motion video (FMV), you will experience the world through her fractured mind—where choices, no matter how small, can reshape her fading reality.
A portion of the proceeds from this interactive film will be donated to organizations dedicated to dementia and Alzheimer’s research, helping to support patients, families, and the search for a cure.
 🌓 Two Diverging Paths: Light and Shadows
Your journey begins with the Light Path, a more reflective and emotional exploration of memory loss, filled with moments of nostalgia and heartbreak.
In "Shadows of The Empty House", reality becomes a nightmare. This alternate version of the story is deeply unsettling, full of psychological horror and existential dread. Shadows stretch unnaturally, familiar faces become faceless specters, and time itself bends in ways you can’t understand.
The choices you make determine whether you will find solace in the memories that remain—or become lost in the terrifying void of forgetfulness.
 🎥 A Unique Interactive FMV Experience
🔹 Over 1.5 Hours of Interactive Video – A rich, cinematic experience with real actors and filmed sequences.
🔹 Multiple Paths & Secret Endings – With over 10 different endings, every choice matters. Some are hidden… waiting to be discovered.
🔹 Psychological Horror Without Jumpscares – The true fear here is existential, built on loss, confusion, and the slow erosion of identity.
🔹 – No complex mechanics—just pure, immersive storytelling.
🔹 – No two playthroughs are the same. Your actions shape the narrative.

title: Macho Harvest ~ Muscular Harvest Puzzle ~
description:
게임 정보
마초 × 농업의 슈퍼 혼돈 퍼즐 게임!
밭에 단백질을 뿌려서 탄생하는 다양한 종류의 마초들을 정중하게 애정을 담아 육성해 출하시키자!
■스토리
마쵸 농원의 원장은 근육을 너무 사랑했던 겨우 '마초를 키우는 농원'을 열어 버린다.
"마초의 씨앗"이라는 수수께끼의 씨앗을 흙에 묻혀 단백질을 물 대신에 준다.
며칠 후, 작은 아령의 싹이 나오고, 밭 일면에 근육의 향기가 풍긴다.
이웃의 사람은 말한다. 「어쩐지, 단백질의 바람이 불어 오지 않는가?」
성장한 마초들은 매일 스쿼트와 벤치 프레스에 힘쓰고,
점차 큰 가슴 근육이 열리고 복근이 갈라진다 ...
■출하시키기에는 단 3스텝만!
①밭에 단백질을 꽂는다
3 종류의 단백질을 밭에 뿌려 마초가 탄생!
색의 곱셈으로 다양한 색의 마초도···?
② 마초를 키우다
탄생한 마초에게 더욱 단백질을 주어 가는 것으로 레벨이 올라간다!
잘 기르고 출하에 대비하자!
③ 정리해 발송한다
많은 마쵸를 한 번에 발송하는 것으로 고득점 겟이다!
단백질의 형상에 맞추어 잘 마초를 키워 가자!

title: Dice With The Universe
description:
게임 정보
Play dice with the Universe. Wield the fundamental forces of physics to control the Universe... and to shape what the next iteration of reality will be. A strategic rogue-like dice-battler with deckbuilding elements where you balance your skills against your luck.
Take the role of a Universal Concept who shapes the very fabric of reality with the power of one of the fundamental forces of physics-- weak, strong, electromagnetic and gravity. Each power provides a distinct and unique playstyle, moveset and dice with special abilities.
Each run crosses the lifespan of the entire Universe, from the Big Bang up until the Big Crunch when the Universe collapses back in on itself, ready to be born again. Your victory or defeat determines your position during the next iteration of the Universe (the next run); when the rules of physics are written during the first Plank epoch, your performance in the previous run will influence reality itself to be favorable to your chosen force. Earn powerful Universal Laws that give you significant bonuses, unique abilities, and change the very rules of the game itself.
Face off against the other fundamental forces in a series of dice-based battles. Your moveset determines the dice outcomes that earn you points (such as straights, of-a-kinds, specific sums, etc). After each roll a decision must be made: will you stay safe and keep the points you have earned-- or roll your remaining dice for more points, but risk not gaining more, and instead losing everything collected so far.
As the four forces struggle eternally as the Universe itself is born and reborn-- could a fifth, previously unknown force arise, looking to permanently break this cycle for it's own malevolent benefit?

title: Paws Against the World
description:
게임 정보
The humans are gone. The world has fallen to the undead, and only the animals remain. In a world overrun by zombies, nature’s fiercest survivors must rise up and fight back! In PAW, you and up to three friends take control of powerful animals, scavenge for upgrades, and battle against relentless zombie hordes in a fight for survival.
Survive, Defend, Evolve!
Choose Your Animal: Play as different animals, each with unique abilities and playstyles.
Scavenge & Upgrade – Collect loot and Essence from fallen zombies to power up your skills and abilities.
How long can you last against an endless zombie onslaught? Protect vital strongholds from being overrun!
Permanent Progression: Leftover Essence can be spent in the Library, unlocking permanent upgrades that make each new run stronger than the last.
Multiplayer: Local Shared Screen Co-Op for up to 4 players
The fate of the world rests on paws, claws, and fangs. Fast, chaotic, and endlessly replayable, PAW is the ultimate test of survival instincts. Are you ready to take back the world?
