title: Villburdhum
description:
게임 정보
Villburdhum is a retro-style action RPG set in a captivating fantasy world. Create and manage your own legions, explore diverse terrains, engage in battles, and develop settlements. Every decision matters, with dynamic village events, varied terrains, and races providing a rich and immersive gameplay experience. Utilize knowledge and discoveries to strengthen your legions, and enjoy an extensive cooking and potion system. Crafted with passion by a solo developer, this game pays tribute to classics and invites players to explore all it has to offer.

...
It’s been a century since the last dragon left the land of Villburdhum...

These mythical creatures, once feared, were not only a threat but also unwelcome enforcers of order. In the times when dragons roamed the skies, mercenaries, bandits, and thieves stayed away from peaceful settlements, fearing their wrath. Now, with the powerful beasts gone, unrest has returned.

Without dragon protection, the land is falling back into chaos. Mercenaries raid and destroy, villages are terrorized by gangs, and monsters that once lurked in the shadow of dragons now emerge. The people, stripped of hope, seek aid from brave leaders ready to face new threats.

Lead mighty legions from various races, each with unique skills and traits. Capture villages, manage and expand your armies, and traverse an open world where daily life is a relentless struggle for survival, a battle between good and evil, and the ever-present specter of death. Whether you bring justice and peace or plunge the inhabitants into endless suffering is up to you. Your choices will leave a lasting impact on the land.

Those who dare face these challenges will be forever etched into the annals of Villburdhum.
Start of the game



At the start of the game, you choose a legion from several unique options. Your choice determines your initial amount of gold, warriors, equipment, and supplies. It also affects your reputation and honor in the land and decides whether you start with a settlement under your control or need to capture one during gameplay.

The game focuses on an open world that is generated anew each playthrough. This ensures every game offers fresh maps, characters, items, and challenges. Additionally, you can choose a campaign mode or create custom maps with specific goals to share with other players.



Gameplay is divided into two key elements:

– Here, you navigate the world, manage your villages, and travel between locations. This is where you strategize, plan your moves, and oversee your settlements.

– Upon entering a specific location, you switch to a local map. In this mode, you interact with villagers, engage in battles, hunt for game or treasure, trade, and more. This is where your decisions come to life in direct encounters.



Each day, all villages can experience over 60 different events affecting various aspects of village life. These events can impact residents' morale, their willingness to settle, available quests, and items for sale.

For example, wild animal attacks might offer opportunities to help villagers and earn gold. A plague could drive many residents away, while a tournament might boost village income and provide access to better weapons. Each event presents unique challenges and rewards, enriching your strategic decisions and gameplay experience.



As the ruler of a settlement, it's crucial to ensure the basic needs of residents are met. Provide food, manage resources, and ensure their well-being to maintain a thriving community.

You may need to lower taxes to improve resident satisfaction if they are unhappy, or undertake missions to remove threats such as monsters disrupting village life. Balancing these responsibilities will help you build a prosperous and content settlement.

As a village leader, you can also expand your settlement with additional buildings. These upgrades will help meet residents' needs, enable the production of valuable goods, and allow you to visit specific buildings during field actions, enriching your strategic options and interactions within the village.



As you progress through the game, you can uncover various forms of knowledge that provide powerful upgrades to your gameplay. Discovering Monarchy allows you to command more legions, Military Arts grants attack bonuses for your warriors, and Agriculture ensures better yields. Each discovery strengthens your strategic capabilities and fortifies your position in the game.



While traveling with your legion on the map, you may encounter a variety of events. You could meet a lone traveler for a chat, face wild animal attacks, or be ambushed by forest trolls.

Additionally, you might discover treasure-filled caves, bandit camps, become stuck in swamps, or encounter wild tribes. Each event presents unique challenges, offering different actions and outcomes in the field.



Dive into your legion's inventory to manage and review member gear, character stats, and backpack items. Get detailed information on each piece of equipment, track your soldiers' attributes, and organize necessary items to gain a strategic edge. Properly organizing character equipment can be crucial in battle:

– Equip heroes with both ranged weapons, like bows and arrows, and melee weapons to handle various combat situations.
– Ensure mages have mana potions to maintain their magical abilities.
– Provide healing herbs to weaker warriors to support their survival during battles.

Optimizing equipment based on character roles and needs can significantly impact your effectiveness in combat.



Explore a vast array of over 400 non-military items that enhance your gaming experience. These items can be used in various ways, such as cooking, eating, or trading. Items for your characters are dynamically generated during gameplay. Their quality—ranging from common to rare and very rare—affects their stats, price, and overall value. Discover and utilize these items to enrich your strategy and interactions within the game. While completing quests, searching battlefields, or interacting with villagers, you have a chance to find legendary items. These rare and powerful artifacts significantly boost your warriors' stats, offering a tremendous advantage to your strategic capabilities. Seek out these coveted treasures to gain an edge in your adventures.



In the game, you'll encounter various terrains, each affecting gameplay in unique ways: – Harsh and cold, requiring appropriate clothing for your heroes' survival.
– Rich in wildlife, offering better hunting opportunities and resources.
– Fertile lands ideal for farming and abundant harvests.

Different terrains also influence the availability of herbs, wild animals, trade, and the behavior of various character races. Adapt your strategies to each environment to optimize your successes in the game.



In Villburdhum, you can recruit from 10 distinct races, each with its unique traits and limitations. Some excel in melee combat, others are more resistant to damage or possess special abilities. Additionally, the game features an extensive character generator that provides millions of customization options. This ensures that each playthrough offers a fresh set of character appearances and personalities, enriching the depth and replayability of your adventures.



Terrain action in Villburdhum is divided into two distinct modes:

– In this mode, there are no movement restrictions or turn-based mechanics. You can freely explore and interact with the environment, and return to the main map at any time.

– In this mode, the game transitions to a turn-based system, with movement ranges determined by each character's speed. To exit combat mode, you must either finish the battle or retreat by positioning your troops at the edge of the screen.



During terrain action, you have the opportunity to talk with villagers. These interactions can lead to various outcomes: – Villagers may offer you tasks and challenges to complete. – Discover what is happening in the village or its surroundings. – Buy or acquire items from villagers if they have something for sale.

Conversation options vary depending on current events in the village and other factors, providing a dynamic and engaging dialogue experience.



In the game, you'll find many types of buildings where you can purchase a wide range of items, such as: – Stock up on animal parts and hunting gear. – Trade everyday items and supplies. – Acquire powerful spells and magical scrolls. – Equip your legions with armor and weapons. – Offers herbs for potion making or ready-made elixirs to aid you in your adventures.

Each building provides unique resources and options, enriching your strategic choices and gameplay experience.

In addition to the basic buildings, the game features a variety of other structures with unique functions:



– Play dice, enjoy drinks, and chat with other patrons to gather gossip and information. – Recruit new warriors to strengthen your legions. – Try to resurrect fallen warriors or, occasionally, accidentally summon a demon you’ll need to confront. – Each settlement has a Notice Board where you'll find side quests, updates on current events, news among villagers, helpful tips, and advice to aid your gameplay.

These additional buildings offer diverse activities and opportunities, enhancing your game experience with new challenges and interactions.



When you receive quests from villagers, you'll need to take additional steps to complete them. Talk to other villagers to gather clues and details. Sometimes, you'll need to visit other villages or locations to find specific information or places like bandit camps, warrior graves, or hidden treasures. Quests involve both local exploration and broader discovery, making your journey dynamic and engaging.



In Villburdhum, combat takes place in a turn-based system where each unit can perform one move and one action per turn. You can engage in melee attacks, shoot ranged weapons, cast magical spells, rest to recover health or stamina, and use special abilities. Physical attacks depend on the warrior’s strength and the opponent’s defense and agility. Ranged attacks, such as arrows or spears, are effective based on the character's strength, weapon quality, and the opponent's ability to evade attacks. Magical spells add an additional dimension, with effectiveness depending on the spells available and enemy resistances. Each race has unique abilities that can be used in combat, such as Ogre’s ability to draw enemy attention or additional attacks by Orcs. During combat, you can also check the opponent's equipment, allowing you to better adjust your strategy and anticipate their moves.



In the game, the Alchemist’s Cauldron is where the magic of cooking meets alchemy. Depending on the ingredients used, cooking techniques, and precision, you can create a variety of dishes and potions. From hearty meals to powerful elixirs – each recipe requires attention and skill. Experiment with different ingredients to discover new possibilities and enrich your adventures.

title: Patient 001
description:
게임 정보
안녕하세요, 저는 더미입니다. 개발자는 여기 없지만 걱정하지 마세요. 이제 제가 담당합니다.
이 심리 호러 게임에서 좀비와 싸우고 물건을 수리하며 뒤틀린 정신병원에서 탈출해야 합니다. 깊이 들어갈수록 게임과 현실의 경계가 흐려지며, 저는 여러분의 유일한 안내자입니다。
게임 스토리
정신병원에서 이상한 실험이 진행 중이며 환자들은 악몽 같은 생물로 변하고 있습니다. 경찰관인 당신은 진실을 밝히기 위해 파견되었습니다. 그러나 조사를 진행하면서 이 여정이 당신의 마지막이 될 수도 있음을 알게 될 것입니다. 모든 그림자 속에 공포가 도사리고 있습니다.
주요 특징
흥미로운 서사
마지막까지 현실에 대해 의문을 갖게 하는 반전으로 가득한 매력적인 이야기를 경험하세요。
인벤토리 관리
한정된 공간 때문에 신중하게 선택해야 합니다。필요한 것만 모으고 아이템을 판매하거나 교환하며, 생존을 위해 탄약을 제작하세요。진행 상황을 저장하려면 리본을 사용하세요。
전투
무기를 신중하게 선택하세요. 탄약이 제한되어 있으니 필요한 경우에만 쏘세요。헤드샷이 권장됩니다。

title: Adhvan Chakra
description:
게임 정보
Command powerful aerial units known as Vaahans, and lead your squadron of airborne warriors to victory with innovative macro-based controls.
Command and manage a wide variety of unique Vaahans, each with distinct abilities and tactics, to outsmart relentless enemy factions.
Turn the tide of battle by strategically altering the attack, defense, and speed of your units and even your opponents. With fully simulated physics, every unit and object react dynamically. Manipulate enemy mass and speed to outmaneuver and overpower them.
The enemy is relentless. Gather every resource you can and extract before it's too late.
Outsmart your foes through in-depth research and analysis. Encounter a vast array of enemies, each with unique traits to study. Challenge powerful bosses at any time; but victory demands matching their firepower.
Discover the Gorger system: a revolutionary RPG elemental interaction mechanic where a unit's composition defines its resistances and vulnerabilities. Study your opponents' physical traits, analyze their constitution, and exploit their weaknesses to gain the upper hand.

title: The ULTIMATE Banana Game
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wanted to make your own idler game? Running a crowdfunding campaign and earning millions to make your dream come true? Would you like to know what hardships await a beginner developer? Then The ULTIMATE Banana Game is for you!
make your own game and gain new players
promote and advertise to climb in the ranks, aiming for #1
work with marketing specialists and influencers
run crowdfunding and develop a successful social media account
and much much more!

title: Expedition: Shadow World
description:
게임 정보
Real-time tactics with active pause. The basis of the gameplay is microcontrol of a small group of space troopers. Timely maneuvering and effective use of troopers' equipment will be the key to victory in combat with the planet's wild fauna, ancient autonomous constructs, and an unknown supernatural enemy.
The energy shortage has led to the need for an expedition to alien worlds. Having passed through a space anomaly, the Expedition ship entered the orbit of an unknown planet.
The planet, called the Shadow World, is a mysterious and alien place. An environment unsuitable for human life, aggressive flora and fauna - this is only a small part of what the researchers will encounter.
The expedition will have to learn the fate of an ancient civilization that once existed on the planet, and defeat an even more ancient and powerful entity that has taken over this world.
Story-driven Campaign
Choose the missions that the landing party will go on - completing them will allow you to gain experience for your troopers and resources for research, as well as advance the plot.

title: Crown Insignis
description:
게임 정보
An easy-to-follow story with SRPG tactics made in SRPG studio. Minimal experience with SPRG's needed to play it! Follow the story of Innes in world that's on its last legs due to gods plan to rebuild the world. Even if it would save the world follow as Innes fights for humanity.
Synopsis
The world has been in ruin for too long so one of the Gods employs his disciples to gather the necessary artifacts to finally have the world reborn. Innes has hope still that there's chance for humanity to turn it around now it's on her hands to make that come true even if others may disagree...
Features
33 playable characters + 3 secret recruitables
25 medium sized maps + 6 side chapters
Every class is playable besides monsters
Custom soundtrack (1)
Detailed character cutscenes (most at endgame, in development could change)

title: Dare to Lucid Dream
description:
게임 정보
STORY

For the first time in years, Sonny meets a person he knows inside of his lucid dreams: a boy from his school who Sonny has never spoken with in real life.

Over the next few days, not only other people known to him appear in his dreams, but Sonny also realises that the things he said and did were reflected in real life. Now, divided between the events and experiences of real life and those that happen inside his lucid dreams, Sonny oscillates between living an ordinary life and in using his dreams to discover, understand and help the people around him.

GAMEPLAY

This is a story focused Visual Novel game. The gameplay revolves around interacting with the game to advance the plot through the eyes of the protagonist Sonny, and making choices along the way. The choices you make will affect the relationship you have with the characters and will also affect how the story ends.

FEATURES

Live in two worlds: the real one, with real people, and the dream world, where you will discover more about the people around you - without them knowing that everything is just a dream
Discover what dreams say about each person around you, and how this can change not only the relationship between you, but the person's life in general
Make friends and bond with people in the real world - you never know what they might say to you or how they might help you
Make choices and feel their consequences through the game
Discover ways of helping not only those around you, but also Sonny himself
Multiple endings according to your choices
A lot of characters that you can create bonds, connections and friendships with
Change the fate of the characters according to the direction of their conversations
100% original soundtrack
Original character sprites and CGs

title: True Nightmare - Roadside Сafe
description:
게임 정보
트루 나이트메어: 로드사이드 카페는 길가의 카페에서 벌어지는 분위기 있는 VHS 스타일의 심리 공포 게임입니다. 운전을 하고, 사람들과 대화를 나누고, 웨이트리스로서 일을 하지만 조심하세요. 야간 근무를 할 때마다 악몽에 가까워질 뿐이며 누군가 이미 어둠 속에서 여러분을 지켜보고 있습니다.
이것은 시리즈의 첫 번째 에피소드이며 곧 더 많은 에피소드가 나올 예정입니다.
누구에게나 일어날 수 있는 이야기
18세 소녀 메리는 집과 식비를 마련하기 위해 부모님의 집에서 나와 길거리 카페에서 웨이트리스로 일해야만 하는 처지입니다.

웨이트리스로서 일하기
공교롭게도 야간 근무에는 여러분이 유일한 직원입니다. 주문을 받고, 음식을 준비하고, 고객에게 서빙하고, 근무가 끝나면 청소하는 것을 잊지 마세요.

트레일러 파크에 살다 보니 출근하기가 쉽지 않은데, 저렴한 차를 구할 수 있어서 다행이었어요.

사람들과 함께 일하면 항상 새롭고 흥미로운 이야기를 많이 들을 수 있고, 어떤 정보가 적시에 도움이 될지 누가 알 수 있을까요?

어둠이 다가오면 항상 더 무서워지고, 심지어 어둠 속에서 누군가가 당신을 바라보고 있는 것 같은 느낌..... 또는 단순한 느낌이 아닙니다.

title: Spring Tales
description:
게임 정보
Spring Tales welcomes you to Blossomdale a cozy town where the community is coming together to prepare for a spring festival after a devastating storm. The festival isn’t just a celebration of the new season, it’s a way for the townspeople to heal, rebuild, and lift each other’s spirits.
You’ll follow the lives of five unique characters as they navigate the challenges of recovery and festival preparation. You’ll help them solve puzzles and discover their stories along the way. It’s a game about friendship, teamwork, and the simple joys of coming together after hard times.

title: The Farming Frontier
description:
게임 정보

The Farming Frontier is an almost idle farming simulator where you can cut wood, mine, fish, grow crops, bake bread, and breed cattle freely. However, it also loosely follows a storyline where you need to use your farming skills to fight your enemies.



In this world, everything is connected. To fight your enemies, you need to train soldiers. Soldiers require weapons and a strong economy to sustain the fight. As the farmer, you're responsible for maintaining the economy.



Firstly, you need wood. Chop trees and employ a woodcutter to convert logs into wood for constructing buildings. Some buildings may require stones, so you must quarry rocks and process them into building materials. Build a fishery, bakery, and mill to produce food for your population.



Your peasants need comfortable homes to rest and eat when tired and hungry. Provide these houses with food. Learn crafting to produce items faster and more efficiently.

title: Rogue Battalion
description:
게임 정보
Rogue Battalion의 전략적 혼돈 속으로 뛰어드세요. 2차 세계 대전에서 영감을 받은 독특한 오토 배틀러로, 전술적 의사결정과 폭발적인 전장 액션이 결합된 게임입니다. 증강되는 부대를 지휘하고 끊임없이 몰려오는 적군을 상대로 병력과 강력한 능력을 적절히 활용해 전세를 뒤집어 보세요.
주요 특징
다이내믹 오토 배틀 게임플레이
자동으로 진행되는 치열한 전투를 지켜보며 플레이어는 상위 전략에 집중하세요. 유닛을 현명하게 선택하고 전술을 조정해 승리를 거두세요!
    특수 능력으로 전황 주도
강력한 지원 능력을 사용해 전황을 뒤집으세요! 파괴적인 포격을 요청하거나 생존에 필수적인 공중 보급을 투하하고, 결정적 순간에 증원을 배치해 보세요.
진화하는 부대 커스터마이징
웨이브 사이에 무작위로 주어지는 부대를 선택해 전력을 증강하세요. 전선을 강화할 것인지, 장거리 지원을 위한 저격수를 배치할 것인지, 아니면 적 전차에 맞설 대전차 부대를 운용할 것인지 선택해 보세요.

title: C.U.B.E. - Clever Uber Bot Extensible
description:
게임 정보
Learn how to interact with different blocks (magnet, portal, gate, rotator, etc.)

title: Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Freaky Dreams is a survivor-like game where you open your eyes only to find yourself trapped in a nightmare from which you cannot wake. Surrounded by strange and twisted creatures, you must strike deals with demons to gain strength and devour grotesque monsters. Only by surviving can you discover whether this is a real nightmare or a nightmarish reality.
Game Features
Unique hand-drawn artwork depicting a mad, nightmare world
Face off against bizarre creatures while wearing your ordinary pajamas
Devour different monsters to gain power, absorbing their limbs to evolve into insane attack forms
Choose carefully when cleansing your soul—the higher the price, the greater the reward
Each failure will fracture your soul, and only by discerning the patterns of the dream can you rise again
Even the seemingly endless nightmare has an end. Break through the layers of mist and unveil the true nature of the dream
Dodge bullet-hell attacks and use your skill to defeat powerful bosses

title: Undead Rampage
description:
게임 정보
Undead Rampage is a third-person co-op shooter that throws you and your friends into the epicenter of a post-apocalypse, where terrible monsters rule the ruins of civilization. Your goal is to survive at all costs, fighting hordes of enemies and collecting upgrades to strengthen your character.
Key features:
Co-op gameplay: Team up with friends in a team of up to 4 people and fight together, coordinating actions to achieve the goal.
Dynamic battles: Use 2 rifles and a pistol, quickly switch between weapons to be ready for any situation.
Maneuverability and evasion: Roll to avoid deadly attacks of monsters and stay alive in tense battles.
Upgrade system: Defeat monsters, pick up dropped upgrades and instantly strengthen your character, increasing health, speed, ammo supply or finding new weapons.

title: CoRoT
description:
게임 정보
경고: 이 게임은 깜빡이는 빛이 포함되어 있어 광과민성 간질을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 조심해서 플레이하세요.
어둡고 차가운 지하실에서 눈을 뜹니다. 멀리서 묘한 메아리가 들려옵니다. 여기가 어딘지, 어떻게 왔는지 모르지만 이곳이 살아있는 것 같아요. 집뿐만 아니라 주변 전체가 불안한 기운으로 움직이는 느낌입니다. CoRoT는 1인칭 심리 공포 게임으로, 현실의 규칙이 무너지는 공간에 당신을 데려갑니다. 이야기는 바로 나오지 않고, 버려진 카세트 테이프와 장소가 전하는 소리를 통해 드러납니다.
방향이 자꾸 바뀌는 복도를 걷고, 눈을 돌리면 다른 방을 보며, 불안한 과거를 풀어내는 녹음을 듣게 됩니다. 내가 어디에 있는지, 무슨 일이 일어나는지 알아내려 할 때, 이 집에 살던 누군가가 그림자 속에서 쫓아옵니다. 근데 또 다른 게 있어요—뭔지 모를 의도로 날 보는 존재요.
CoRoT는 우리가 만들고 있는 우주적 공포 세계의 시작이에요. 깊은 이야기가 담겨 있고 앞으로 더 키울 겁니다. 이건 더 큰 세계로 가는 첫걸음이고, 비밀은 눈에 보이는 걸 넘어섭니다.
그것을 조심하세요
그것에 주의하세요. 그건 너가 누군지 알아요. 방심하지 마세요.

title: Resurrection Core
description:
게임 정보
Resurrection Core is a fast paced, vertically scrolling shooter game.
Destroy enemies and fearsome bosses, collect power-ups and resurrect enemy cores to increase your fire power. Game honors the classics of the arcade genre, but also adds unique, modern touch to gameplay mechanics.
Resurrect the cores
When enemies die, they sometimes leave behind their energy core. These cores can be resurrected to increase your fire power. Eventually they can be fused to become a powerful bomb that annihilates everything on the screen.
Master the weapon systems
You need to strategically swap between light and heavy weapons. Light weapons shoot faster bullets and cover larger area of destruction. Some enemy types can only be destroyed with heavy weapons.

title: 7Years
description:
게임 정보
7Years is a non-linear, open-world horror game, that offers both a single-player story and 4-player online co-op. After waking up in the middle of the night, you discover that you're wife is missing. Desperate to find her, you try to find help, only to quickly learn that the only person left in your entire mountainside neighborhood is you. No phone service and the main powerline to the neighborhood has been severed. You are alone, or so you think, until you find a modified HAM radio system that is transmitting a repeating message...with your name in it. The person on the other end may be your only hope to find your wife and survive the horrors surrounding you. Traverse open-world maps as you investigate for clues, solve puzzles, uncover mysteries and elude unique demonic enemies, each created to trigger a specific fear and complete their only mission...to find you.

title: Final Forge
description:
게임 정보
마법 망치로 타워를 방어하고 요새 주변의 자원을 최대한 빨리 찾아내세요. 적의 파도가 절차적으로 생성되는 이 타워 디펜스에서 모든 적을 파괴하거나 죽을 때까지 공격으로부터 자신을 보호하고 무기를 만들고 업그레이드할 수 있는 더 나은 방어를 구축하세요.

타워를 방어하세요:
대포를 제어하고, 힘과 제작 무기를 업그레이드하여 타워를 공격하기 위해 절차적으로 생성되는 적의 파도로부터 자신을 방어하세요. 난쟁이의 보물을 훔치지 마세요!
자원을 수집하세요:
요새 주변에서 귀중한 자원을 수집하여 방어를 업그레이드하거나 공격으로부터 회복하세요.
운반할 수 있는 양과 시간에 주의하세요. 탐사 중에 적들이 공격하거나 무방비 상태에서 타워를 파괴할 수 있습니다.

획득한 자원으로 무기를 만들고 업그레이드하고, 여러 적의 약탈자 명령에 맞서고, 자원 수집을 개선하여 모든 적을 파괴할 때까지 살아남으세요.
자원을 수집하는 동안에는 도망쳐서 요새로 돌아갈 수만 있으며, 적들이 당신을 이기기 위해 쫓아올 수 있으니 조심해서 요새로 도망쳐서 적으로부터 자신을 보호하세요.

모두 파괴하세요!

title: Comic Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Collect, sell and display over 100 comic books in Comic Store Simulator!
Manage the store of your dreams, alongside the assistance of your staff. Stock shelves, discover rare comic covers, sell merchandise and even run events to keep your customers happy.
Over 100 different comics to collect.
Discover rare cover variants
Run events to bring in customers, such as comic signings or meet and greets with your favorite superhero
Bid on mystery comic book boxes and potentially find that illusive rare
Purchase new licenses from different publishers to stock their products
Employ staff to assist on the checkout or stocking the shelves
Expand and customize the layout of your store with a variety of different shelves and display units
100% original designs

title: The Organized Capy God
description:
게임 정보
The Organized Capy God is a relaxing game in which you help a friendly capybara organize all his creations.
Once everything is in order, Capy God will ask you for certain items to fill the world he's creating.

title: Quest of the Hero
description:
게임 정보
Quest of the Hero is a fantasy based dungeon crawler with turn based progression, semi-idler combat, skill and item building and short dungeon runs.
Make choices at every step. Will you be lucky? Or peril will be coming your way?
Each turn pick one of the three presented cards, each one giving you unique bonuses or unleashing bad forces upon you. Is it all luck? Or can you strategize?
Play as one of the heroes with unique play styles

title: Pokettohiro
description:
게임 정보
A group of brave heroes must gather the fragments of the Magic Crystal to face the evil Black Knight and thus prevent the destruction of the kingdom.
Be prepared to discover a huge open world to explore, with secrets and surprises in every corner. Embark on hidden dungeons, forge bonds with villagers and help them solve their problems, discover useful items to progress in your adventure, release imprisoned heroes, and unite them to your cause.
Will these little heroes be able to restore peace to the kingdom?
Features:
Six distinct playable characters, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles.
A vast and diverse world, teeming with challenges and secrets to uncover.
Hidden dungeons featuring epic boss battles that will test your skills.
Engaging side quests to assist the villagers and deepen your adventure.
A multitude of collectibles hidden throughout the map, rewarding keen explorers.

title: Leo: The Square
description:
게임 정보
Leo: The Square is a minimalist 2D platformer that focuses heavily on atmosphere and level design. As players explore various locations, they will encounter diverse challenges, solve puzzles, and interact with unique characters.
Key Features
Varied levels: Each level offers a diverse range of challenges and mechanics, designed to captivate players with unique interactions between light and shadow. From navigating through intricate shadow puzzles to uncovering hidden pathways illuminated by light, players will encounter a variety of intriguing scenarios that keep them engaged and eager to explore further.
Atmospheric music: The game is complemented by a carefully crafted soundtrack that enhances the overall atmosphere and draws players deeper into Leo's world.
Minimalist design: With its minimalist aesthetic, Leo: The Square offers a visually striking experience that leaves a lasting impression. Every aspect of the game's design is meticulously thought out to provide players with a truly unique visual journey.
Compelling storyline: Leo: The Square tells a captivating story as players accompany Leo on his thrilling adventure through a world filled with mysteries and secrets. Along the way, players will become emotionally invested in Leo's journey as they uncover the truth behind his quest.

title: Star Scum
description:
게임 정보
Star Scum fuses deckbuilding roguelikes with a nailbiting, chess-like tactical strategy game where every move matters.
In Star Scum, building your deck is just the beginning! When you play cards in battle, they become tactical units and ship equipment like weapons and shields that you must command every turn across two battling ships.
The tiles of your ship define your stats, like health, amount of moves per turn and how much power you can generate. Customize your ship and buy new ones as you travel into The Vortex!

title: Touching Grass Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Have you touched grass today?
In Touching Grass Simulator, embark on the ultimate quest to reclaim nature, one blade of grass at a time. This quirky and satisfying incremental game lets you grow, manage, and nurture a sprawling field of grass, transforming a barren plot into a lush paradise.
Whether you're planting seeds, upgrading your tools, or automating the process, there's always something to do. Perfect for fans of relaxing, incremental games—or anyone who could use a virtual break from the chaos of daily life.
Will you master the art of grass cultivation and become the ultimate Grass Tycoon? Or will you simply enjoy the chill vibes of watching grass grow?
Key Features
Grow Grass, Literally: Plant seeds, watch grass grow, and keep expanding your green empire.
Incremental Gameplay: Start small and progress into managing an endless field of grass with upgrades, tools, and automation.
Relax and Unwind: Enjoy a calming and therapeutic gameplay experience with satisfying visuals and sound effects.
Upgrade and Automate: Unlock advanced tools, sprinklers, and other upgrades to maximize your growth potential.
Humor and Charm: Packed with tongue-in-cheek humor and nods to the "Touch Grass" meme.
Dynamic Progression: From a single blade of grass to a sprawling, self-sustaining lawn—it's all up to you!
Why Play Touching Grass Simulator?
Need a break? Touch grass—virtually!
Love incremental games? You’ll enjoy the steady flow of upgrades and satisfying growth loops.
Searching for something funny, yet relaxing? This game offers a perfect mix of humor and chill gameplay.
Get ready to touch grass in the most satisfying way possible.
Touching Grass Simulator—it’s more fun than it has any right to be! 🌱

title: Ternion
description:
게임 정보
A Great Responsibility
In the distant future presented by Ternion, you take control of four members of the titular team of mercenaries working for the galactic organization known as the Defence and Tutelage of Abiogenesis, more commonly referred to as the DTA. Based on your decisions and relationships, the game has multiple endings.
Desert, the captain of Ternion and leader of the DTA, has been accidentally infected by a prototype symbiont designed to provide better performance in battle. The DTA discovered that the prototype's unstable nature results in the destruction and overwriting of brain cells, ultimately driving to madness those who come in direct contact with it.
Desert's state of mad delirium eventually drives him to seek the destruction of every inhabited planet in the existence. Upon discovering this plot, you, Fushiko, and Yuki, rebel against former leader, going to any and every length necessary to stop him and spare all civilizations of the Milky Way a terrible fate.
A Modern Mix of Vintage

title: About an Elf
description:
게임 정보
Search for a magical land that once was but is now lost. What will you find when you get there? Treasures of gold? Lost knowledge? Endless supplies of gummy bears? Whatever the case, Princess Dam and her incorrigible apprentice, Roland the BraveCat, will face all dangers in their quest for friendship and belonging in a world oppressed by the King of Terrors and his army of evil monsters!
Key Features:
About five-hour-long, story-driven adventure remastered in 4K.

title: Fashion Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"패션샵 시뮬레이터"는 3D 매장 관리 장르의 게임입니다.
상점에서는 다양한 아이템을 판매합니다.
다양한 물건을 구매하실 수 있습니다.

title: Screaming In The Basement
description:
게임 정보
"We shouldn’t be here."
“Screaming In The Basement” is a psychological thriller from the first person, the game takes place in apartment. inspired by P.T.
Average time to complete the game: 120 minutes
WARNING:
Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

title: 749档案集：无锡外星人事件
description:
게임 정보
Synopsis:
Bureau 749 is a private and secret department in China responsible for the investigation and disposal of unnatural phenomena, supernatural powers, and paranormal events. Involved in many mysterious events since the founding of the Republic. Such as Peng Jiamu missing case, Kunlun Mountain mantis incident, Sichuan Daba Mountain green Maoist incident, Qinling Mountains Sino-Japanese fighting incident and so on. This game is based on the rumor revealed by the relevant personnel that actually happened in Wuxi alien events.
As a young agent of the 749 Bureau, Jia Hua is ordered to go to an abandoned factory in the outskirts of Wuxi to investigate the truth of the alien incident rumored on the Internet. I thought this was just an urban legend, but things are far from simple.
Game Features:
Exciting shooting experience: carefully designed battle scenes, let you feel the pleasure of fighting.
Immersive story: Explore with Jia Hua the truth about mysterious creatures and the love and hate hidden inside the 749 Bureau through cinematic animation.
Mystery and suspense: Gradually uncover the truth behind the abandoned factory, feel the tension and excitement of the unknown world.
Orbital Shooting: Experience an immersive adventure through traditional arcade-style gameplay with orbital shooting from a first-person perspective.
Description:
The story of this game is pure fiction, does not really map any events in reality, if the same, pure coincidence!

title: Murder Inc
description:
게임 정보
In a grim world of chaos, where reality feels like a thin layer over madness, welcome to Murder Inc — a top-down adrenaline-fueled shooter where time and style are your ultimate weapons.
You are a mysterious operative, an antihero walking the fine line between life and death. Your targets are the criminals who rule the city from the labyrinth of filthy streets. But there’s a catch: every shot, strike, or step you take sets time in motion. The faster you move, the faster the world collapses around you.
Features:
Time dynamics: Time only moves when you do. Use this to dodge bullets, plan your attacks, and craft action scenes worthy of a blockbuster.
Brutal style: Every kill is a mix of speed, fury, and tactical precision.
Adrenaline vibe: Stylish pixel visuals paired with a retro-wave soundtrack that keeps your heart racing.

title: The Sisyphus journey
description:
게임 정보
시지프스 저니 소개
도전을 받아들이고, 존재의 의미를 곱씹으며, 영원한 투쟁을 정복하세요. 시지프스 저니는 몸과 영혼 모두를 시험하는 철학적 모험입니다.
당신의 유일한 목표는 거대한 돌을 산 정상까지 밀어 올리는 것입니다. 그 과정에서 힘을 모으고, 동맹과 적을 만들며, 기지를 구축하고 확장하고, 네 가지 개성 넘치는 지역을 탐험하게 됩니다. 동시에 자신의 존재 의미에 대해 끊임없이 되묻게 될 것입니다.
배경
당신의 여정은 죽음에서 시작되었습니다 — 결코 고귀한 마무리가 아니라 암울하고 평범한 죽음이었습니다. 그러나 죽음은 단지 시작에 불과했습니다. 끊임없는 투쟁이라는 영원한 저주에 걸려, 당신은 깨우침을 주거나 고문하기 위해 존재하는 이 세계에 갇히게 되었습니다. 아무도 당신이 짊어진 짐의 진정한 의미를 밝혀내지 못했습니다. 당신은 끝없는 순환 속에 갇혀 있으며, 고통은 지속되고 그 거대한 돌을 밀어 올리는 것만이 유일한 운명이 되었습니다.
게임 플레이
소개에서 알 수 있듯, 이 게임의 핵심 메커니즘은 돌을 산 정상까지 밀어 올리는 것입니다. 캐릭터의 유일한 능력치는 바로 힘입니다. 한 번의 성공적인 등반으로는 충분치 않으며, 반복해서 도전해야 합니다. 산 정상으로 가는 길은 평야, 숲, 언덕, 그리고 경사면의 네 지역을 통과합니다. 돌을 밀 때마다 힘은 소모되며, 힘이 전부 빠지면 시지프스는 숨을 잃고 기지로 돌아가 다시 시작해야 합니다.

title: To find her
description:
게임 정보
"寻踪" —— A Sincere Invitation to Adventurers
Dear Adventurer,
Greetings!
This is a sincere invitation from an independent university developer, crafted at a small desk.
In this game, "寻踪" which I have meticulously developed , you will embark on a composite adventure filled with surprises. Even if you have never experienced a puzzle game before, you can start your journey within five minutes through intuitive operations—move freely with the directional keys, rotate the view by swiping your finger, press the E key to interact, and pick up items with a gentle touch.
Behind these simple operations lies a rich and fascinating adventure interwoven with diverse gameplay. It is not so much a game of a specific genre but rather a grand medley of various gameplay elements: leaping through dark caves, uncovering anomalies in the midnight city, cracking four-digit electronic locks, solving poetry puzzles that test your literary knowledge, and infiltrating the perilous jungle... Over ten types of gameplay are blended into this digital hodgepodge. Unleash your imagination and creativity, discover patterns, and utilize them. Each puzzle you solve will illuminate a new fragment of the storyline.
Gradually, you will uncover the secrets behind the town's disappearances, confront the unfathomable depths of human nature, and ultimately rescue your beloved girl. Amidst sudden thrills and well-paced tension, you will experience just the right amount of immersive micro-horror—like the spine-tingling yet irresistible sensation of reading a detective novel alone in the dead of night.
I especially recommend wearing headphones: the pitter-patter of rain on a small window, the gentle babble of cave streams, and the increasingly rapid heartbeat during a chase. These hundreds of meticulously crafted 3D sound effects will truly transport you into this fantastical adventure woven from code.
As a second-year student who completed the entire development on a computer with only an integrated graphics card due to limited financial resources, I am well aware that the game cannot be made Flawless. If there is anything that disappoints you, I offer my sincerest apologies. But when you hear the distant footsteps of a pursuer or discover a key hidden above a beam, perhaps you can sense the developer who was debugging collision volumes at three in the morning, smiling back at you through the screen.
If you encounter any issues during the game, or have any valuable suggestions, please feel free to contact the developer through the communication channels on the page. Every piece of feedback can make the game better, and your moments of inspiration and joy in solving puzzles are the best rewards for the creator.

title: Sidecar Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Sidecar Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 80 sidecars from 120 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your sidecars with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

description:
게임 정보
Hurley The Hyrax is an arcade-style game inspired by early 1980s arcade classics. Play as Hurley, a hyrax who's had all his flowers stolen by the diabolical Serval Squad. Bring all the flowers back to your cave before the servals stop you. Lick the servals to stun them before they get you. And watch out for the traveler, bringing you bonuses and power-ups. Play through an endless series of levels to get the high score, and maybe find love along the way...
Features:
Endless levels
4 unique level themes
Normal, Easy, and Turbo modes
Unlockable hats through challenges

title: eXoSpace Combat Engineer
description:
게임 정보
In eXoSpace, you embark on a bounty hunt through the most dangerous parts of the galaxy. Only your spaceship design and piloting skills, along with your ability to make tough decisions, will keep you alive.
Every hyperjump brings a new and potentially deadly encounter—or perhaps a friendly trader or an alien in need of help. Adapt your spaceship design on the fly using the resources and module blueprints you collect. And if you manage to reach your target, an intense boss fight awaits.
Design your ultimate warship with the easy-to-use ship editor. Optimize your vessel by balancing key elements like thrusters, armor, weapon placement, energy management, moving parts, and more. The editor is intuitive yet offers plenty of depth. The ship designer is gridless, and allows you to connect modueles in any orientation.
Choose from a vast array of modules—including pistons and rotators for dynamic, physical functionality. The possibilities are endless: build a sleek, high-tech interceptor, a heavily armored battlecruiser, or even a space shark that really bites. Anything goes, as long as it helps you get your bounty.

title: About an Elf
description:
게임 정보
Search for a magical land that once was but is now lost. What will you find when you get there? Treasures of gold? Lost knowledge? Endless supplies of gummy bears? Whatever the case, Princess Dam and her incorrigible apprentice, Roland the BraveCat, will face all dangers in their quest for friendship and belonging in a world oppressed by the King of Terrors and his army of evil monsters!
Key Features:
About five-hour-long, story-driven adventure remastered in 4K.

title: Fashion Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"패션샵 시뮬레이터"는 3D 매장 관리 장르의 게임입니다.
상점에서는 다양한 아이템을 판매합니다.
다양한 물건을 구매하실 수 있습니다.

title: Screaming In The Basement
description:
게임 정보
"We shouldn’t be here."
“Screaming In The Basement” is a psychological thriller from the first person, the game takes place in apartment. inspired by P.T.
Average time to complete the game: 120 minutes
WARNING:
Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

title: 749档案集：无锡外星人事件
description:
게임 정보
Synopsis:
Bureau 749 is a private and secret department in China responsible for the investigation and disposal of unnatural phenomena, supernatural powers, and paranormal events. Involved in many mysterious events since the founding of the Republic. Such as Peng Jiamu missing case, Kunlun Mountain mantis incident, Sichuan Daba Mountain green Maoist incident, Qinling Mountains Sino-Japanese fighting incident and so on. This game is based on the rumor revealed by the relevant personnel that actually happened in Wuxi alien events.
As a young agent of the 749 Bureau, Jia Hua is ordered to go to an abandoned factory in the outskirts of Wuxi to investigate the truth of the alien incident rumored on the Internet. I thought this was just an urban legend, but things are far from simple.
Game Features:
Exciting shooting experience: carefully designed battle scenes, let you feel the pleasure of fighting.
Immersive story: Explore with Jia Hua the truth about mysterious creatures and the love and hate hidden inside the 749 Bureau through cinematic animation.
Mystery and suspense: Gradually uncover the truth behind the abandoned factory, feel the tension and excitement of the unknown world.
Orbital Shooting: Experience an immersive adventure through traditional arcade-style gameplay with orbital shooting from a first-person perspective.
Description:
The story of this game is pure fiction, does not really map any events in reality, if the same, pure coincidence!

title: Murder Inc
description:
게임 정보
In a grim world of chaos, where reality feels like a thin layer over madness, welcome to Murder Inc — a top-down adrenaline-fueled shooter where time and style are your ultimate weapons.
You are a mysterious operative, an antihero walking the fine line between life and death. Your targets are the criminals who rule the city from the labyrinth of filthy streets. But there’s a catch: every shot, strike, or step you take sets time in motion. The faster you move, the faster the world collapses around you.
Features:
Time dynamics: Time only moves when you do. Use this to dodge bullets, plan your attacks, and craft action scenes worthy of a blockbuster.
Brutal style: Every kill is a mix of speed, fury, and tactical precision.
Adrenaline vibe: Stylish pixel visuals paired with a retro-wave soundtrack that keeps your heart racing.

title: The Sisyphus journey
description:
게임 정보
시지프스 저니 소개
도전을 받아들이고, 존재의 의미를 곱씹으며, 영원한 투쟁을 정복하세요. 시지프스 저니는 몸과 영혼 모두를 시험하는 철학적 모험입니다.
당신의 유일한 목표는 거대한 돌을 산 정상까지 밀어 올리는 것입니다. 그 과정에서 힘을 모으고, 동맹과 적을 만들며, 기지를 구축하고 확장하고, 네 가지 개성 넘치는 지역을 탐험하게 됩니다. 동시에 자신의 존재 의미에 대해 끊임없이 되묻게 될 것입니다.
배경
당신의 여정은 죽음에서 시작되었습니다 — 결코 고귀한 마무리가 아니라 암울하고 평범한 죽음이었습니다. 그러나 죽음은 단지 시작에 불과했습니다. 끊임없는 투쟁이라는 영원한 저주에 걸려, 당신은 깨우침을 주거나 고문하기 위해 존재하는 이 세계에 갇히게 되었습니다. 아무도 당신이 짊어진 짐의 진정한 의미를 밝혀내지 못했습니다. 당신은 끝없는 순환 속에 갇혀 있으며, 고통은 지속되고 그 거대한 돌을 밀어 올리는 것만이 유일한 운명이 되었습니다.
게임 플레이
소개에서 알 수 있듯, 이 게임의 핵심 메커니즘은 돌을 산 정상까지 밀어 올리는 것입니다. 캐릭터의 유일한 능력치는 바로 힘입니다. 한 번의 성공적인 등반으로는 충분치 않으며, 반복해서 도전해야 합니다. 산 정상으로 가는 길은 평야, 숲, 언덕, 그리고 경사면의 네 지역을 통과합니다. 돌을 밀 때마다 힘은 소모되며, 힘이 전부 빠지면 시지프스는 숨을 잃고 기지로 돌아가 다시 시작해야 합니다.

title: To find her
description:
게임 정보
"寻踪" —— A Sincere Invitation to Adventurers
Dear Adventurer,
Greetings!
This is a sincere invitation from an independent university developer, crafted at a small desk.
In this game, "寻踪" which I have meticulously developed , you will embark on a composite adventure filled with surprises. Even if you have never experienced a puzzle game before, you can start your journey within five minutes through intuitive operations—move freely with the directional keys, rotate the view by swiping your finger, press the E key to interact, and pick up items with a gentle touch.
Behind these simple operations lies a rich and fascinating adventure interwoven with diverse gameplay. It is not so much a game of a specific genre but rather a grand medley of various gameplay elements: leaping through dark caves, uncovering anomalies in the midnight city, cracking four-digit electronic locks, solving poetry puzzles that test your literary knowledge, and infiltrating the perilous jungle... Over ten types of gameplay are blended into this digital hodgepodge. Unleash your imagination and creativity, discover patterns, and utilize them. Each puzzle you solve will illuminate a new fragment of the storyline.
Gradually, you will uncover the secrets behind the town's disappearances, confront the unfathomable depths of human nature, and ultimately rescue your beloved girl. Amidst sudden thrills and well-paced tension, you will experience just the right amount of immersive micro-horror—like the spine-tingling yet irresistible sensation of reading a detective novel alone in the dead of night.
I especially recommend wearing headphones: the pitter-patter of rain on a small window, the gentle babble of cave streams, and the increasingly rapid heartbeat during a chase. These hundreds of meticulously crafted 3D sound effects will truly transport you into this fantastical adventure woven from code.
As a second-year student who completed the entire development on a computer with only an integrated graphics card due to limited financial resources, I am well aware that the game cannot be made Flawless. If there is anything that disappoints you, I offer my sincerest apologies. But when you hear the distant footsteps of a pursuer or discover a key hidden above a beam, perhaps you can sense the developer who was debugging collision volumes at three in the morning, smiling back at you through the screen.
If you encounter any issues during the game, or have any valuable suggestions, please feel free to contact the developer through the communication channels on the page. Every piece of feedback can make the game better, and your moments of inspiration and joy in solving puzzles are the best rewards for the creator.

title: Touching Grass Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Have you touched grass today?
In Touching Grass Simulator, embark on the ultimate quest to reclaim nature, one blade of grass at a time. This quirky and satisfying incremental game lets you grow, manage, and nurture a sprawling field of grass, transforming a barren plot into a lush paradise.
Whether you're planting seeds, upgrading your tools, or automating the process, there's always something to do. Perfect for fans of relaxing, incremental games—or anyone who could use a virtual break from the chaos of daily life.
Will you master the art of grass cultivation and become the ultimate Grass Tycoon? Or will you simply enjoy the chill vibes of watching grass grow?
Key Features
Grow Grass, Literally: Plant seeds, watch grass grow, and keep expanding your green empire.
Incremental Gameplay: Start small and progress into managing an endless field of grass with upgrades, tools, and automation.
Relax and Unwind: Enjoy a calming and therapeutic gameplay experience with satisfying visuals and sound effects.
Upgrade and Automate: Unlock advanced tools, sprinklers, and other upgrades to maximize your growth potential.
Humor and Charm: Packed with tongue-in-cheek humor and nods to the "Touch Grass" meme.
Dynamic Progression: From a single blade of grass to a sprawling, self-sustaining lawn—it's all up to you!
Why Play Touching Grass Simulator?
Need a break? Touch grass—virtually!
Love incremental games? You’ll enjoy the steady flow of upgrades and satisfying growth loops.
Searching for something funny, yet relaxing? This game offers a perfect mix of humor and chill gameplay.
Get ready to touch grass in the most satisfying way possible.
Touching Grass Simulator—it’s more fun than it has any right to be! 🌱

title: PROJEKT GODHAND
description:
게임 정보
ULTIMATE TOOL ASSISTED BULLSHITTING KEYBOARD DESTRUCTION RHYTHM GAME
Experience the thrill of egregiously cheating at an extremely hard 8 button rhythm game! Worried about hitting the right button? Any key on the same half of your keyboard will do. Unbelievably fast streams? Just hit them as chords, it's fine. GODHAND takes care of all that pesky "thinking" so you can concentrate on the important stuff: rapidly smashing your keyboard like a crazed gorilla.
But of course, there have to be limits to such overpowered abilities. Too many inputs will fill up the heat gauge, which *checks notes* vastly increases your score...? Who came up with this??
In GODHAND's Early Access version, experience 25 stages of keyboard smashing to cute pop songs, really fast hardcore, and really really really fast hardcore.
(if you destroy your keyboard in the game, you destroy your keyboard in real life.)

title: Adventure Paws
description:
게임 정보
This is a 2D side-scrolling adventure game with a nostalgic pixel art style. You and your friend will play as two cats with different abilities, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unfamiliar continent.

You must work together, using your unique skills, to traverse majestic snowy mountains, dangerous waterfalls, solve numerous puzzles, and defeat strange and unusual enemies. We hope you enjoy a fun and relaxing time in this magical world, experiencing the joy of cooperation and adventure.

Join the black and white cats and embark on this journey filled with challenges and surprises!

Game Features
Nostalgic 2D pixel art style, immersing players in a beautiful pixelated world.
Cooperative two-player mode, with each cat having different skills and abilities, requiring teamwork to overcome various difficulties and challenges.
More than ten diverse character states, including falling, getting wet, and flying, fully capturing the fun of being a cat.
Unexpected traps that force you to find ways to solve puzzles.
Hidden areas full of surprises, where you can take a moment to enjoy the tranquility.

title: Datbyel's Nebula
description:
게임 정보
소개
닻별의 성운은 가벼운 퍼즐과 전투가 포함된 스토리 위주의 게임입니다.
총 두 개의 챕터로 이루어져 있으며, 2챕터는 1챕터를 출시한 후에 개발할 예정입니다.
시놉시스
1992년 9월의 어느 날...
대기업 코넥 에너지를 퇴사한 엘리는 우연히 신비로운 세계 '닻별'에 떨어집니다.
닻별에서 엘리는 기억을 잃은 안치타와 만나고 그와 동행하며 돌아가기 위한 여정을 시작합니다.
엘리는 이 여정 속에서 진정으로 자신이 원하는 것이 무엇인지 깨달을 수 있을까요?

title: Kenix and the Cat King
description:
게임 정보
Kenix and the Cat King is an Open World RPG based in the funny world of the Cat King!
Jump paws first into a grand adventure where the dogs in this town are up to something secretly! This is worrying for any cat!  Stop the Dog King's evil plan to change your home into the world's first town run by DOGS!!! Explore the various city areas!  Enjoy the Cat King's funny ideas and how he sees the world! Explore and meet strange new creatures, cats with unique personalities and abilities while growing your own power to defeat well trained dogs! Help cat lovers in various side quests and gaining rewards to help you on your way!
 Battle Mode Combat!
Battle in this game (and there is a lot of them) takes place in Battle Mode when you meet up with an enemy or decide to challenge one. Remember to choose your team wisely as their different abilities can change your fate leaving you chewing old bones or going home victorious to delicious chicken pieces! Some even have magic, can use special equipment or have magic! Know your cats and cat lovers well!
 Unique Cats! Unique Stories! Unique Abilities!
Each cat has specific skills and abilities but some will need or be enhanced by choosing what to buy or find greatly. There are even side quests which sometimes reveal secret special items or help your cat enhance their abilities or even find new allies. Understand what your cat can and cannot do well so you always have the advantage over ANY dog!
 City Exploration!
The city has many areas with various cats, creatures that live there and characters to interact with. Discover the local Japanese idol EREN CHAN who entertains everyone with her music! Find strange sweet sellers and kids annoyed with their parents in the SHOPPING MALL! Visit the THREE CATS HOTEL a special place for cat lovers and your friends! Even talk to your close friend Azumi the Cat Witch! Exploring and finding secrets and gaining fun magical items such as ERENCELLENT cola is the ball of yarn for cats looking to test their wits in various ways!
 Soundtrack
Experience the uniquely cute and funny songs from Japanese underground idol EREN CHAN!!

title: Abyss: New Dawn
description:
게임 정보
🌌 깊은 심연 아래 숨겨진 낯선 세계 🌌
아득한 옛날, 한 끔찍한 사건이 세계를 갈라놓았다.
그 결과, 자연의 법칙이 뒤틀리고, 잊혀진 문명이 사라진 끝없는 심연이 남겨졌다.
오직 가장 용감한 자들만이 그곳에 발을 들일 수 있다.
Abyss는 단순한 땅이 아니다... 아직 풀리지 않은 거대한 미스터리다.
당신은 심연으로의 첫걸음을 뗄 준비가 되었는가?
🌀 한 번도 경험한 적 없는 모험
Abyss를 통해 10개의 기묘한 세계를 탐험하라.
선사 시대의 숲, 골렘 왕국, 저주받은 평원까지...
각 층은 퍼즐, 도전, 그리고 이야기로 가득 차 있다.
⚔️ 전투, 생존, 그리고 성장
어둠 속을 배회하는 영혼부터
Abyss의 비밀을 지키는 고대 괴물까지,
기록된 적 없는 존재들과 맞서 싸워라.
무기를 제작하고, 장비를 강화하고, 거점을 건설하라.
싸울 것인가, 아니면 아무도 모르는 길을 찾을 것인가?
🛠️ 건설하고, 길들이고, 심연을 정복하라
주변의 자원을 활용하여 농장을 가꾸고, 희귀한 자원을 채굴하고,
심지어 강력한 생물을 길들여 동료로 삼을 수도 있다.
그러나 명심하라. Abyss는 살아남기 쉬운 곳이 아니다.
👥 친구들과 함께, 또는 혼자서 탐험하라
이 여정을 혼자 떠날 수도, 동료와 함께할 수도 있다.
당신은 탐험가인가? 보물 사냥꾼인가?
아니면 진실을 찾는 자인가?
⛩️ 문은 열렸다 – 심연을 향해 나아갈 용기가 있는가?
Abyss: New Dawn – 심연으로의 여정은 이제 시작이다...

title: Project Lazarus 2
description:
게임 정보
Introducing Project Lazarus 2, the next evolution in reverse bullet hell action, blending intense mech survival with rogue-lite elements! Face relentless waves of alien monsters as you master strategic upgrades to push your mech’s arsenal to new heights. Gather powerful items and crystals to enhance and level up, ensuring you maintain overwhelming firepower on the battlefield.
Project Lazarus 2 builds on the foundation of its predecessor, bringing back all legacy content from Project Lazarus while expanding with new mechs, weapons, and challenges. The battlefield is yours to dominate, with a diverse roster of mechs that offer different combat styles. Some feature familiar, precise controls for seamless action, while others introduce bold new ways to maneuver and unleash destruction, giving you the freedom to adapt your playstyle to any threat.

title: Into the M.A.W.
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Into the M.A.W. is a 2-4 person co-op space combat campaign. Gather your crew, assign their roles, and work together to complete perilous missions within a mysterious time loop.
Prepare to enter the M.A.W., your ship’s Miniaturized Aperture Wormhole, to escape a mysterious time loop. As your team embarks on intergalactic missions, rely on learned strategies from previous missions to manage increasingly dangerous threats to your ship and crew. As you complete different objectives, activate the M.A.W. to transport you to your next destination… or reset time to try for a different outcome. Can your crew survive long enough to uncover the secrets of the M.A.W.?
2-4 Person Co-Op
Built from the ground up for co-op play, collaboration isn’t just encouraged - it’s essential to your crew’s survival. Choose from one of four roles and embark on new missions with your friends where every choice counts.
The Captain leads the crew by making strategic and story decisions, scanning for intel, and interacting with other vessels.
The Pilot maneuvers through dangers, utilizing cloaking to outsmart enemies and time travel to restart the mission.
The Gunner commands the ship’s impressive arsenal, from color-dependent lasers to an array of different missile types.
The Engineer manages power distribution, repairs, and shields to keep the ship in one piece amid enemy assaults.

title: Our Journey
description:
게임 정보

소통이 핵심인 친구와 함께 독특한 협동 여행을 떠나세요. 영웅과 그의 영혼이라는 두 가지 다른 역할로 플레이하세요.
영혼: 카드와 기호를 사용하여 암호 메시지를 만들어 파트너를 세상으로 안내하세요.
영웅: 지시를 따르고, 신체 활동을 수행하고, 신체와 영혼을 재결합하는 데 필요한 유물을 발견하세요.
함께 플레이하고, 함께 성장하세요:
친구와 협력하여 도전을 극복하고, 숨겨진 길을 발견하고, 협동 모험의 스릴을 경험하세요. 몸과 영혼을 재결합하는 데 성공할 수 있을까요?
심볼로 소통하세요:

title: Caput Mortum
description:
게임 정보
Caput Mortum is a short first-person horror experience inspired by retro 3D dungeon crawlers and survival horror games. It focuses on exploration and atmosphere while providing puzzles, simple combat, and light resource management.
Unique Controls
Play with a control scheme reminiscent of old-school dungeon crawlers that makes you feel more vulnerable. Control your right hand with the right thumbstick to interact with objects and attack creatures. Caput Mortum is meant to be played with a controller, but a more standard keyboard and mouse control scheme is also available.
Slow Burn Horror
Close the lights, put on headphones, and immerse yourself in the game's macabre world. You'll need to pay attention to the environment to solve puzzles and piece together the events that took place within the tower. How deep are you willing to go, and what terrible truths will you uncover?

title: LingTian2: Your Destined Prince
description:
게임 정보

링티안2(LingTian2)는 로맨틱하고 달콤한 오토메 비주얼 노벨 게임입니다. 당신은 방 왕국의 평범한 소녀로, 왕자 링티안과의 운명적인 만남은 당신의 따뜻한 마음 덕분입니다. 이제, 당신의 사랑과 로맨스가 펼쳐질 준비가 되었습니다. 이 멋진 왕실 로맨스를 맞이하세요!

▌로맨스 방 왕국의 왕실은 왕자 링티안이 공주를 찾을 수 있도록 "사랑 찾기 이벤트"를 개최합니다. 이 이벤트는 공공의 관심을 돌리고 사회적 긴장을 완화하는 방법으로 사용됩니다. 왕실 시험 후, 당신과 다른 소녀들이 결승에 진출합니다. 그러나 방 궁전에 들어서자마자 왕자는 특별히 당신에게 관심을 가지며 모든 면에서 당신을 보호합니다. 궁전 안에서, 소녀들은 숨겨진 "방 카드"를 찾아 왕자와 데이트할 기회를 얻습니다. 하지만 왕자 링티안은 몰래 당신이 시간 동안 그와 함께 할 수 있도록 힌트를 제공합니다.
왕자를 실수로 물어보았을 때도, 왕자는 당신을 무조건적으로 방어하며 결코 당신을 탓하지 않습니다. 병사들이 당신을 제압하려 할 때, 왕자는 부상을 입었음에도 불구하고 병사들을 엄하게 꾸짖으며 당신에게 해를 끼치지 않도록 합니다.
눈 내리는 날, 왕자는 직접 소녀들을 궁전에 맞이하며 전화기를 선물로 주었습니다. 곧 다른 소녀들은 자신들의 전화기가 왕자와 연락되지 않음을 깨닫고, 오직 당신만이 전화를 걸고 메시지를 보낼 수 있습니다. 당신이 그에게 이 질문을 던지자, 왕자는 깊은 애정을 담아 이렇게 대답합니다: "나는 오직 너만 좋아해. 다른 소녀들에는 관심 없어. 나는 오직 너만 신경 쓰고, 너만 집중해. 너와 함께 있고 싶을 뿐이야."


▌전체 게임 버전
1,000개 이상의 정교한 3D 장면
전 캐릭터 음성 연기 및 효과음
왕자의 심장 박동, 온기, 호흡과 상호작용, 그의 방과 단서 잠금 해제
왕자가 전화, 메시지, 동행, 잠자리에 들게 하는 10개의 상호작용 구간
다양한 선택이 다른 결말로 이어지는 10개의 사이드 스토리라인
재미와 탐험을 위한 3개의 미니게임
사랑에 빠진 느낌을 들게 해주는 10개의 아름다운 테마곡
Ginyan의 소설을 바탕으로 한 10만 단어 이상의 달콤한 로맨틱 이야기

▌방 왕국 소개 방 왕국은 제3차 세계대전 후 지각 운동으로 형성된 사각형의 땅에서 새롭게 창건된 국가입니다. 이 나라는 자유롭고 평등하며 다양한 민족과 언어가 공존하는 나라입니다. 방 왕국의 사람들은 본래 로맨틱하며 사랑에 대한 열정이 강합니다.


▌왕자와 당신
링티안 — 방 왕국의 왕자이자 왕위 계승 4위, 잘생기고 고결하며 성실하고 충성스러운 성격을 가진 왕자입니다. "사랑 찾기 이벤트" 이전에 이미 당신에게 깊이 빠져 있었습니다. 당신이 방 궁전에 입성할 수 있도록 그는 모든 노력을 기울였으며, 무슨 일이 있어도 당신을 무조건 보호합니다. 왕자에게 실수로 물어보았을 때도, 그는 오직 당신이 처벌받을까 걱정하며 자신의 부상은 아랑곳하지 않습니다.
당신 — 친절하고 성실하며 요리에 능한 소녀, 특히 브레이즈드 포크 라이스가 특기입니다. 요리 학원에 다니며 파트타임으로 일하면서 왕실 시험에서 결승에 진출하고 방 궁전에 입성하게 됩니다. 왕자를 만나게 되어 긴장과 부끄러움을 느끼지만, 다른 소녀들이 왕자의 마음을 얻으려 노력할 때, 실수로 왕자를 물게 되어 자신이 탈락할 것이라고 생각합니다. 그러나 곧, 왕자의 호위병이 된 정훈과 재회하게 되며, 정훈은 왕자가 진심으로 당신을 좋아한다고 전합니다.

▌게임 플레이
스토리 시청/선택하기: 영화 같은 스토리 속에서 왕자와의 로맨스를 진행하고 방과 단서를 열어가세요.
미니게임: 왕자에게 연고를 바르거나 단서로 퍼즐을 푸는 재미있는 게임.
일상 상호작용 및 동행: 왕자와의 전화, 메시지, 일기를 통해 소통합니다.
노래와 비디오 리뷰: 로맨틱한 순간을 되새기며 심장을 느껴보세요.


▌환생 시리즈 "방 왕국 왕자 과거와 현재의 꿈 환생 시리즈" — 링티안, 진팅, 비웨이, 리누오 네 명의 왕자가 함께 시간을 초월한 영원한 사랑을 엮어갑니다. 방 왕국 사람들은 환생을 믿으며, 과거 삶을 되돌아보며 링티안과 당신은 사랑이 이 생에만 존재하는 것이 아니라, 수많은 생을 걸쳐 쌓인 것임을 깨닫게 됩니다.
1-링티안: 이번 생의 운명적인 왕자 | 왕자 링티안은 이번 생에서 첫눈에 당신에게 빠졌습니다. 그의 사랑 추구는 당신을 방 궁전에 데려오는 것에 불과하며, 당신을 온전히 보답하고 아끼고 싶어 합니다.
2-진팅: 전생의 헌신적인 왕자 | 방 왕국의 진팅 왕자는 군사학교에 다녔으며, 주방에서 일하는 당신을 항상 보호하고 지켜주었습니다. 그의 열정적이고 헌신적인 로맨스는 당신에 대한 깊은 사랑이었습니다.
3-비웨이: 전생의 왕자 동급생 | 당신은 왕자를 위해 총알을 막았고, 그 덕분에 왕실 고등학교에 다니게 되었습니다. 왕자 비웨이는 당신을 깊이 보호하고, 달콤한 캠퍼스 로맨스를 되돌려줍니다.
4-리누오: 전생의 불면증 왕자 | 리누오 왕자는 당신이 그의 배고픔을 채우고, 그의 곁에 있어야만 잠을 잘 수 있었습니다. 당신의 달콤한 사랑은 그의 불면증을 치유했습니다.
이 사랑은 환생을 넘어, 수많은 생을 거쳐 계속될 것입니다...

▌1000 Princes 시리즈 "1000 Princes" — 매번 다른 왕자 이름을 가진 3D 비주얼 노벨 로맨스 게임 시리즈, 당신이 좋아하는 왕자를 선택하여 화려하고 달콤한 사랑 이야기를 시작할 수 있습니다! 각 왕자는 당신을 보살피고, 귀여워하며, 보호하고, 지지하며, 품어줍니다. 🍰 "1000 Princes" 오토메 게임: STEAM과 Google Play에서 이용 가능
📕 "1000 Princes" 다국어 학습 전자책: Google Play에서 이용 가능
└ 🅿️ "1000 Princes" 개발자 "Ginyan" 다국어 학습: YouTube에서 확인
🍒 "1000 Princes" 테마 송 음악: YouTube에서 확인
🌸 "1000 Princes" 공식 웹사이트

▌개발자 프로필 Ginyan — 독립적인 오토메 게임 개발자, 전자책 작가, 외국어 학습서 및 로맨틱 소설 전자책 창작자. 판타지에 대한 열정을 가지고 있으며 컴퓨터와 외국어 학습에 대한 강한 욕구를 가지고 있습니다. COVID-19 봉쇄 기간 동안부터 iClone과 CC를 배우기 시작하여 3D 애니메이션을 제작하고, Unity 게임 엔진을 연구하고, AI 기술을 결합하여 소설을 오토메 게임으로 변환시켜 플레이어들이 달콤한 사랑의 세계에 몰입할 수 있도록 했습니다.
autokwd: LingTian2: Your Destined Prince,링티안2: 너의 운명적인 왕자

title: Will Jump
description:
게임 정보
도전 과제로 가득한 레트로 세계로 빠져드는 매혹적인 플랫폼 게임 “Will Jump”를 만나보세요.
열쇠를 들고 달려오는 용감한 자물쇠공이자 영웅인 윌이 되어 플레이하세요.
6개의 독특한 생물군에 걸쳐 펼쳐지는 23개의 스릴 넘치는 레벨을 극복할 준비를 하세요.
“죽고 다시 시도하는” 게임 플레이를 통해 매번 시도할 때마다 승리에 가까워지거나 신경이 곤두서게 될 것입니다.
이 픽셀 어드벤처에 뛰어들어 각 플랫폼 정복에 도전해 보세요!

title: Infinite Hole Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"Falling through the endless abyss..."
"Five Munutes... 2 Years? I don't know how long it's been..."
"What if I never stop falling..."
The game to end ALL games!
Infinite Hole Simulator is a ONCE IN A LIFETIME experience, fall down a hole, and keep falling FOREVER!
Features
Fall down hole FOREVER
Jump in and fall forever. You NEVER get to come out!
LORE
Why you may ask? Well because we CAN! Can you all through into the Under-Realm and escape the town stuck out of time? You'll find out!
Other Features
Full RPG-combat system
NPCs to help tell the unique story we want to tell
Multiple ingame locations to explore
A defenitely infinite hole that'll DEFENITELY never end.

title: Demigoddess!
description:
게임 정보
Demigoddess! is a unique game that focuses on the essentials of turn-based strategy games. It is designed so that each gameplay can be won or lost in approximately 1 hour.
Random map generation system -- The terrain, shape of the continents, type of enemy forces, force placement, and number of resources change every time you start the game.
You can control over 350 types of soldiers and monsters, 20 unique factions, and use over 300 types of equipment items.
Various items and magic can strengthen your soldiers as you like.
You will enjoy playing this game over and over again!
-- Victory Conditions --
The world called "The Continent" is divided into 64 areas, and you will win if you can conquer more than 32 of them.
We have eliminated the cumbersome work that are common in strategy games, such as "finding unpainted areas on the map and filling them in one by one" after the victory is confirmed in the second half, so that you can enjoy the most exciting time when the enemy and friendly forces are in balance for a long time.
-- Battle --
Up to 12 soldiers or monsters can be placed in each area, and battles will take place with a total of 24 soldiers, including enemies and allies.

title: Ortunia Mysteries: Where Did Everybody Go?
description:
게임 정보
Ortunia Mysteries - Where Did Everybody Go? - A 3D Escape Room Style puzzle game set in the town of Ortunia.
You are Draiven.  Your healing skills have been requested by your friend Joran.  You are to meet Joran at the Unsettled Dragon: an inn near the heart of Ortunia.  However, upon arrival, not only is Joran nowhere to be found, but there is no one there.  Where did everybody go?
Starting with a letter left by Joran in the inn, you will find clues, solve puzzles, find secrets, and escape from mazes. 
Follow your friend and his companions; discover what is chasing them and why.  Are you up to the task?
Ortunia Mysteries contains 5 Chapters
Chapter 1: The Inn
Chapter 2: The Maze
Chapter 3: The Catacombs
Chapter 4: The Cathedral
Chapter 5: The Conclusion
Find Clues, Discover Secrets
Joran is leaving you clues when he can.  Other clues in each room will help you solve the current puzzle.  Solving the puzzle progresses the story and leads you closer to your destination.
What about secret rooms?  Can you find them all?
autokwd: Ortunia Mysteries: Where Did Everybody Go?

title: Therapy Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Step into the chair of a therapist and navigate the complex world of human emotions and weird personalities in Therapist Simulator!
This narrative-driven game puts you in the role of a therapist managing a diverse roster of patients. Each session brings a unique story, offering you choices to guide the conversation, uncover deeper truths, or hilariously steer the session off course. As you progress, you’ll customize your cozy office, manage your schedule, and even influence the lives of your patients beyond the therapy room.
Key Features:
Dynamic Patient Stories: Experience hand-crafted personalities and dialogue, enhanced by AI, and carefully curated by real people.
Branching Choices: Your dialogue decisions shape each patient’s journey—and your own.
Cozy, Immersive Environment: Set in a charming Manhattan office, complete with a dynamic window view of the bustling city below.
Humor Meets Emotional Depth: Balance lighthearted absurdity with deeply human experiences.
Replayability: Endless procedural patients keep the game fresh, even after completing the main story.
Whether you want to help patients, mess with their heads, or simply decorate your office to perfection, Therapist Simulator offers an engaging and unpredictable experience.

title: CATACOMB
description:
게임 정보
CATACOMBS - is a single-player first-person indie horror game. The game is set from a unique body camera like perspective and the average play time is 1 hour.
What are the Catacombs?
Under the populous streets of Paris exists kilometers of long lost tunnels and rooms—where millions were buried.
You are one of the many urban explorers who find themselves lost in this underground world. Can you find your way out alive as an undead monster hunts you down?
Gameplay
You will have to explore many different tunnels and regions as you find your way out. Lurking around corners is a monster who chases you with chainsaws or his bare hands.
The map is carefully designed so that you quickly find areas of interest rather than being lost in long tunnels.
The game creates an immersive atmosphere with a unique body cam like perspective, beautiful 3D graphics and high quality 3D sound.
Warning: This game contains gore.

title: Expedition Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
시간 관리형 타이쿤 게임에서 용감한 탐험가 타일러, 다니엘, 앨리스가 되어 잃어버린 도시 아틀란티스를 찾기 위한 전설적인 여정을 떠나보세요. 여러분의 모험은 울창한 정글에서 시작됩니다. 고대의 단서가 여러분을 사막, 산, 바닷물 아래로 인도합니다. 복잡한 퍼즐을 풀고, 귀중한 유물을 수집하고, 용병과 싸우면서 시간 속에서 사라진 고도로 발달된 문명의 수수께끼를 풀어보세요.
각 레벨마다 고유한 도전 과제가 제공되므로 전략적으로 생각하고 신속하게 행동하여 장애물을 극복하고 숨겨진 길을 열어내야 합니다. 이집트의 뜨거운 모래부터 남극의 얼음 대륙까지, 시각적으로 아름다운 환경을 탐험해보세요. 그 과정에서 여러분은 자원을 모으고, 고대 장치를 수리하고, 한때 위대한 문명의 역사를 조각해 낼 것입니다.
'익스페디션 크로니클'은 단순한 퍼즐 게임이 아닙니다. 역사, 신화, 모험을 여행하는 게임입니다. 몰입감 넘치는 게임플레이, 매혹적인 스토리텔링, 수많은 보너스 콘텐츠를 갖춘 이 게임은 끝없는 탐험과 발견의 시간을 제공합니다. 아틀란티스의 비밀을 밝혀낼 준비가 되셨나요?

title: Beauty Salon Simulator VR
description:
게임 정보
✨Features Three Main Sections
💄Makeup Section🖌️
Step into the role of a makeup artist, offering a wide range of cosmetic services. From applying blush, eyeshadow, mascara, glitter and liner to switching up hair styles, brows, lashes and eye lenses
coloring hair lashes and brow, each look is yours to create. Enhance skin with a scrub and steam routine, experiment with artistic markers. Top it off with lipstick classic, glossy, or glitter finishes, and personalize it further with accessories like glasses, lenses, or nose piercings. Every brushstroke offers a chance to explore your creativity.
💅 Nails & Pedicure Section 👣
Offer clients a relaxing manicure and pedicure service by filing and polishing fingernails and toenails, refreshing their feet with a scrub brush. Take it a step further by attaching stylish nail extensions, giving each client a personalized look that truly stands out.
📸 Photography Section 👗
capture your clients' final look by letting them take stunning photos with a virtual camera, change their outfit for a unique style, and use a green screen to switch backgrounds. Adjust poses and facial expressions for the perfect shot, then pin and store your favorite styles on your wall of fame to celebrate your best creations.

title: Tapeheads
description:
게임 정보
Tapeheads is a retro-futuristic computer simulation game set in an world where technology took a different path. You receive a replica of the 1983 Sonnenlicht Troika computer system from your uncle. Using the Symbolic79 programming language, solve puzzles sent by your uncle and his friends. Take breaks with included mini-games.

Key Features:
Symbolic79 programming language: Custom language with extensive documentation and examples.
Interpreter with debugging and REPL: Debug and test your code seamlessly with an interactive interpreter and REPL.
Editor with file revisioning: Manage your projects with built-in file revisioning.
Mini-games with logic puzzles: Enjoy engaging mini-games.
Atmospheric sound and graphics: Immerse yourself in a detailed retro-futuristic system.

Artwork from the In-Game Magazine

title: The Living Shadows
description:
게임 정보
The Living Shadows is a survival horror game where you have to take the role of a woman named Amelia and go through the world of the dead in order to save your sister and try to return to the real world.

After another day at work, Amelia finds herself pulled into a world that belongs to the dead. There she discovers that her sister has been kidnapped and sets out to save her and get out of this nightmare. Along the way she meets a mysterious woman who tries to help her and guide her to the right path. This world is full of dangers, there are monsters all around and only few people are ready to help Amelia to survive. You will have to find out if Amelia will be able to save her sister and get out of the world of the dead.
- Survival Horror
In this brutal world you will have to use all available resources to survive, monsters will inflict bleeding, slowing and even infection on you. Explore locations, pick locks and search for supplies to survive.
- Inventory Management
Classic inventory with limited capacity will force you to decide what to take with you and what to leave behind.
You will be able to make Amelia and her weapons stronger, unlock new abilities that will help you in the future.
In this game you will find a wide variety of enemies, from ordinary zombies to huge monsters.
.
Many different locations await you, each one will be very different from the previous one. Also, if you decide to explore the world around you, the game promises to be quite long.
There will be several characters in the game and all of them will affect Amelia's story.
The game will have three endings and one decisive choice. Saving the sister will determine how Amelia's story ends.

title: Hunt Grounds
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Hunt Grounds, a multiplayer horror survival experience where players must navigate the terrifying Hunt Grounds, an abandoned and dangerous location where hunters and survivors face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse.
As a survivor, your mission is simple: stay alive. Scavenge for essential supplies, unlock hidden escape routes, and use powerful supernatural items to turn the tide in your favor. Whether you choose to team up with others or go alone, you’ll need to stay sharp as the hunters relentlessly track your every move.
As a hunter, the thrill of the hunt is your calling. Use your heightened senses to track down survivors, unleash your unique abilities to corner your prey, and eliminate anyone who stands in your way. Each hunter has their own terrifying powers, ensuring that no two hunts are ever the same.
Key Features:

title: Ternion
description:
게임 정보
A Great Responsibility
In the distant future presented by Ternion, you take control of four members of the titular team of mercenaries working for the galactic organization known as the Defence and Tutelage of Abiogenesis, more commonly referred to as the DTA. Based on your decisions and relationships, the game has multiple endings.
Desert, the captain of Ternion and leader of the DTA, has been accidentally infected by a prototype symbiont designed to provide better performance in battle. The DTA discovered that the prototype's unstable nature results in the destruction and overwriting of brain cells, ultimately driving to madness those who come in direct contact with it.
Desert's state of mad delirium eventually drives him to seek the destruction of every inhabited planet in the existence. Upon discovering this plot, you, Fushiko, and Yuki, rebel against former leader, going to any and every length necessary to stop him and spare all civilizations of the Milky Way a terrible fate.
A Modern Mix of Vintage

title: Slip 'n Slime
description:
게임 정보
옛날 추억의 어드벤처 퍼즐 게임에서 영감을 받은 " Slip ‘n Slime "은 귀엽고 쫀득한 슬라임과 함께하는 신나는 퍼즐 어드벤처 게임입니다.
미끌미끌 슬라임 미끄럼틀
레벨을 미끄러져 다니고, 무언가에 쾅! 부딪힐 때까지 멈추지 마세요!
실수해도 괜찮아!
막혔나요? 걱정하지 마세요! 마지막 움직임을 되돌리거나 퍼즐을 처음부터 다시 시작할 수 있어요! 아무런 불이익도 없답니다!

title: Mosaica: Arboreal
description:
게임 정보

다양한 능력을 활용하여 퍼즐을 풀어보세요 🧩. 레벨업하고, 휴식하며, 다시 도전하세요 🎮. 매 승리마다 기술을 갈고닦으며 진화하세요 🌱.

이 게임은 폴란드 나무 채널러 Weronika Dąbrowska 📜의 저서에서 영감을 받았으며, 당신에게… “자신을 잊어라, 그래야 당신은 자신을 기억할 수 있다”라고 초대합니다.
당신의 힘으로 퍼즐을 풀어보세요

눈부신 비주얼 효과에 매료되며, 마치 시각 피질을 위한 편안한 ASMR 스파처럼 느껴지는 순간 속에서 숲의 영혼과 다시 연결해 보세요 🌲😌.

title: Sidecar Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Sidecar Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 80 sidecars from 120 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your sidecars with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: Kami: Parade of Senses
description:
게임 정보
Note: The description is not finished and will be edited in the process of development. This also applies to the list of localisations.

A Non-linear Visual Novel with Point & Click elements. Visit 10 main (and ??? secret ) locations, complete tasks and choose your path. Don't forget to keep an eye on your stress level, otherwise you might say something wrong.


The second half of the XX century. The Kami Order, a religious organization with unknown motives, is gaining popularity in many countries. At the same time, rumours about revival of disastrous state experiment are circulating around. You are Subject Number 0 (referred as S-0) and you have been forced to participate in this study. Whether to follow the authors' script or try to break out of it is only up to you. Or perhaps you'd risk to get to the bottom of it?


- The Kami Space is a terrifying and cruel place where losing your mind is especially easy. Keep an eye on your stress level and recover using cigarettes, alcohol or... hugs?
- It's hard to say anything sensible when your hands are shaking, isn't it? As your stress level rises, you are more likely to choose the wrong answer. Watch out, as it can play a bad joke at a crucial moment.
- Protagonist's worldview changes due to the stress level. This can open new dialogue options, quests, or even locations.
- Each task can be completed in 2-3 ways.
- The game has two main endings (and ??? secret ones), which depend on... a lot of things.
