title: Maze and Fairy tale
description:
게임 정보
여주인공은 몇 가지 이상한 이유로 미궁 속으로 빠졌다.
이 미궁에서 30일 동안 생존해야만 미궁에서 탈출할 수 있다.

낮에는 생존에 필요한 물자를 모으기 위해 미궁 속으로 들어갈 수 있다.
하지만 해가 지기 전에 본기지로 돌아가야 한다!
밤의 미로는 변화가 많고 괴물이 출현한다.

미로에서 당신은 완전히 다른 동화 같은 세계를 여러 개 경험하게 될 것이다.
이 동화나라에는 많은 나라가 존재합니다. 포커 왕국, 비비 나라, 증기 나라 등등.
나라들간에 분쟁이 끊이지 않고 세계는 파멸의 위기에 처해있다.
생존한 날이 많아짐에 따라, 당신은 각 나라를 여행하고, 각 세계의 구석구석에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견할 것이다. (존 웨인, 지혜명언)

생존을 위해서는 괴물로부터 방어할 수 있는 무기나 탑을 쌓을 수 있다.
함정을 만드는 것을 추천합니다.
함정끼리 배합을 이루어 몬스터를 연타견제하여 더욱 높은 대미지를 입힌다.

2차원 (2d) 스타일의 서바이벌 가타디펜스 구축용 arpg 게임이다.
지하 감옥과 타워 디펜스 건설을 결합하여, 함정의 달인이 되어, 의외의 콤보를 그려낸다.
autokwd: Maze and Fairy tale,迷宫童话

title: Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale
description:
게임 정보


APOPIA: SUGAR COATED TALE is a comedic adventure with dark mysteries. Help young girl Mai to find her way home. Progress by solving puzzles and outsmarting enemies in minigames. Make friends and foes with talking animals. Unravel the mystery of Mai’s identity from her dark and blurry memories.

As Mai, you will:

Explore the beautiful fantasy world. Get to know funny characters who are a cat, a mole, a lot of bunnies, and more. Each with unique personality and background story.
Solve creative puzzles along your way home.
Beat enemies... um, lower your fists... You'll beat them by outsmarting them in minigames.
Defeat dark bosses in rhythm games.
Discover the truth about your family and identity.











Catch a glimpse into a world before the events of Apopia Prologue. Learn why Moly was banished from her castle in this animated short. Watch and enhance your demo experience!

title: Lustborn
description:
게임 정보
Made by solo developer ILBB, LUSTBORN is a retro third-person action platformer that delivers an exciting single-player adventure where you shoot, jump, and navigate your way through a twisted realm of lust and depravity.
STORY
In the near future, a tear in reality opens a portal to an alternate dimension known as NEERAH'OR. A powerful demon-queen, driven by insatiable lust, seeks to infiltrate our world and spread death and depravity. In response, a global taskforce called OPUS-Y is formed. But alas, every mission into NEERAH'OR ends in disaster.
Hope remains in the discovery of a rare breed of women resistant to the demon-queen's dark magic. You play as MIA MADDEN, the latest recruit and the last known descendant of this secret lineage. Though little is known of her powers, she is the last... LUSTBORN.

title: Island Market Simulator
description:
게임 정보
◆ 집을 100가지 독특한 장식품으로 꾸며 명성을 높이세요. 그림, 가구, 장식 액세서리를 활용해 개인 스타일을 표현할 수 있습니다. 시장과 집 장식은 게임 내 명성 시스템에 직접적인 영향을 미칩니다!

title: Desktop Fishing
description:
게임 정보
A mysterious algae infestation is spreading across the waters, threatening the fish population. Your goal? Rescue as many fish as possible before it’s too late!
You can style your frog however you like, with a wide range of outfits, accessories, and colors to create your perfect fishing buddy!
You can catch over 50 different types of fish – and with a bit of luck, you might even reel in rare Shiny and dazzling Holo variants!

title: Console Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"Console Shop Simulator" is a relaxing first-person simulation that brings every detail of running a store to life.
Store Management
Design your store, optimizing for efficiency and aesthetics. Decide where CDs and consoles will be displayed, manage your shelves, and ensure a smooth shopping experience for your customers.
Product Supply
Order stock using the in-game computer. Unpack goods, organize them in your storage area, and place them on the appropriate shelves for your products.
Trade
Trade with incoming customers, buy products from them and give other products in return!

title: So Far Up
description:
게임 정보
세상의 정상까지 올라가세요! 이제 VR 및 비 VR 모드에서 즐길 수 있는 물리 기반 클라이밍 게임!
VR에서는 단 하나의 모션 컨트롤러를 사용하여 표면을 밀고 더 높이 올라갈 수 있습니다.
헤드셋 없이 플레이하고 싶나요? 새로운 비 VR 모드에서는 마우스만으로 동일한 물리 기반 모험을 경험할 수 있습니다. VR이든 화면이든 도전은 동일합니다. 얼마나 높이 올라갈 수 있을까요?
플랫폼을 뛰어넘으세요

title: fluXis
description:
게임 정보
fluXis is a community-driven, vertical scrolling rhythm game with customizable visual and gameplay effects. Create your own flashy maps or compete against the world in the online leaderboards.
Features
Feature-packed Editor - Create your own maps and share them with the world.
Visual and Gameplay Effects - Move the playfield around, change the key count mid-song, flash the screen white or make it greyscale, with no limitations!
Online Multiplayer - Play with your friends or compete against strangers online.
Customization - Change textures and move HUD elements around however you want.
Cross-game compatible - Import and play maps from various other rhythm games and add support for more games through plugins.

title: EYES ON THE EXAM
description:
게임 정보
Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.
Improve your score in every game
Uncover dark secrets hidden in the classroom
Enjoy a 100% diegetic horror experience
You wake up at your desk in a dreary classroom run by a monstrous teacher. Your goal is to correctly answer as many questions as possible on the exam in front of you. How can you know the answers? Look around you, look at your classmates' exams, strain your eyes and study your surroundings...
But be careful, don't let the teacher catch you with your eyes off the exam or failing will be the least of your problems....

title: Lone Soul
description:
게임 정보
Lone Soul is a hack-and-slash action game featuring a combo-based fluid combat. By performing unique abilities, your combo meter gets upgraded, rewarding you with increased damage. 

A roguelite progression puts you on a multiple runs that takes you through a series of randomly generated locations, allowing you to craft a unique build with every playthrough. Killed enemies drop gear and health orbs, similar to top-down ARPGs.
Express Yourself in Combat
During your excursions into the mythical tower, you will acquire dozens of spells and attacks to enhance your combo deck. Whether you favor close-quarters combat, tactical positioning, or commanding arcane forces, the choice is yours.

title: Hellfire: Wukong
description:
게임 정보
비범한 웅장함, 무한한 환상
환상적인 풍경, 전례 없는 광경, 현실이자 환상인 이 동양의 마법의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 운명의 사람으로서 당신은 서쪽으로 향하는 이상한 여행을 떠나게 될 것이며, 모든 단계는 새로운 놀라움과 도전을 가져올 것입니다. 아직 밝혀지지 않은 비밀을 탐험하고 장대한 모험 전설을 다시 써보세요.
마족들이 다시 나타나고, 마족들이 격렬하게 춤을 추고 있습니다.
유명한 여행자, 교활하고 변덕스러운 마왕. 서쪽으로 가는 길에는 아름다운 풍경뿐만 아니라, 수많은 강력한 적들이 당신의 도전을 기다리고 있습니다. 운명의 사람은 마지막 순간까지 이 길에서 수많은 몬스터와 몬스터들과 치열한 결투를 벌이게 된다.
땅이 흔들리고 산이 흔들리고 신통한 힘이 나타났습니다.
불멸의 기술을 배우고 무한한 변화를 배웠습니다. 다채로운 주문과 마법의 보물은 중국 신화에서 가장 고전적인 전투 요소를 구성합니다. 데스티니드 원은 다양한 스틱 스킬을 습득할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 다양한 주문, 변화, 재능, 무기, 방어구를 자유롭게 조합하여 자신에게 가장 적합한 전투 스타일을 찾을 수 있습니다.
모든 것은 끊임없이 변화하며 영혼을 감동시킵니다.
6가지 형태, 6가지 무기, 6가지 형태 및 6가지 감정. 적들의 교활함과 사악함은 표면에만 있을 뿐이며, 그들 뒤에 숨겨진 이야기는 종종 더 매력적입니다. 치열한 전투 외에도 데스티니는 다양한 캐릭터의 배경 이야기를 탐색하고 그들의 감정과 동기를 이해하며 그들의 사랑과 증오, 탐욕과 분노, 과거와 현재의 삶을 드러낼 것입니다.

title: Holy Shot
description:
게임 정보
끊임없이 몰려오는 몬스터 물결을 처치하고, 환경을 파괴하며, 방어선을 구축하고 장비를 업그레이드하여 살아남아 지옥의 생물들로부터 세상을 해방시키세요. Holy Shot은 물리 기반의 탑다운 액션 슈터로, 로그라이크 요소와 순수한 혼란을 결합하여 다양한 파괴적인 무기와 능력을 수집하여 다양한 공포스러운 생물들과 보스에 맞설 수 있습니다.
하이라이트
물리 기반 게임플레이: 주변 환경을 파괴하고, 산을 폭파하며, 거미 떼에게 불폭풍을 퍼부으세요!
전략과 성장: 적과 무기고를 잘 파악하고 효과적인 전략을 세워 매번 더 멀리 나아가세요.
보스 전투: 독특하고 도전적인 보스를 연구하고 물리치세요.
다양한 무기고: 터렛과 폭발물을 배치하고, 다양한 무기 유형을 사용하며, 최고의 파워업 조합을 찾아 대규모 적군을 핵폭발과 신성한 비로부터 탈출하세요.
독특한 비주얼 스타일: 비밀을 발견하고 천사와 악마 이미지로 가득 찬 세계를 탐험하며, 기괴하고 이상한 몬스터들을 만나보세요.

title: Milo's Tiny Fish Pond
description:
게임 정보
"Milo's Tiny Fish Pond" is a relaxing and enjoyable healing game that allows you to enjoy the pleasure of raising fish in your spare time while working!
Core gameplay:
Easy to place, free to grow Place the game window in a corner of the desktop, and you can earn "rice grains" currency by hanging up. Use rice grains to buy mysterious fish packs, hatch random fish - from lively clownfish to luxurious dragonfish, each with a unique juvenile and adult form.
Immersive interactive experience
Right-click on the fish tank to put fish food, observe the young fish swimming towards the food; adult fish can be sold for more rice grains, forming a sustainable breeding cycle.
Infinite creative space
Unlock multiple fish tanks with different styles, freely adjust the layout, and match decorations to create an exclusive underwater paradise. With no quantity limit, how many surprises can your desktop hold?
Zero-pressure relaxation philosophy
No complex operations, no penalty for failure. Whether you are focusing on work or taking a short break, the swimming fish and the sound of water will bring you peace.
Suitable for you:
► Casual players who love collecting and raising
► Decorators who pursue desktop beauty
► Office workers/students who need to relieve pressure
Release time: Q2 2025
**Join the wish list now and bring your desktop to life!**
autokwd: Milo's Tiny Fish Pond,米洛的桌面鱼塘

title: Blankspace
description:
게임 정보
⬆️ Maximize Your Score!
Your mission: make as many points as possible by harnessing the power of emojis, each with its own unique effect. But be warned—fall short of the target, and it's game over. Strategize, optimize, and push your limits to stay ahead in this high-stakes challenge!



Jump into Blankspace now and see how far your strategy can take you. Will you unlock the ultimate synergies and rise to the top, or will the challenge push you to your limits? Start playing and find out!

title: Encounter
description:
게임 정보
As fate would have it, you’ve stumbled upon this game. Might as well give it a try. Who knows what you might encounter… ayyy. Get it? Encounter is the name of the game. When I said, “who knows what you might encounter,” it was a play on words.
So, what’s this Tarot thing about? They represent scenarios where you might have to think on your feet, snack on some magical berries, or even get attacked by a [REDACTED]-eating succubus! Fun! But it's not just fate at play—you’ll need to manage your resources wisely, timing your limited actions perfectly as you navigate a labyrinth of twists and turns, and overcome a host of unpredictable events.
Your adventure kicks off with a single crate. What’s inside? Treasure? Trash? A mildly cursed sandwich? Crack it open and find out! From there, anything goes. You’ll encounter oddballs, outlaws, and outright disasters. Duel the friendly neighborhood postman, accidentally infuriate a small child, or face down ambush after ambush—who’s to say? Will you fight, finesse, or just wing it and pray to the RNG gods? Whatever you do, tread carefully—your journey lasts only as long as you do, and the next tavern might be farther than you expect.

title: Bad Trip
description:
게임 정보
It’s Friday night, and you’re feeling numb and bored. Life feels like an endless cycle of frustration and regret, with doubts about your choices weighing heavily on your mind. Searching for either confrontation or escape, you turn to your stash of forbidden substances.
What starts as a search for relief quickly spirals into a psychedelic nightmare. Your fragile mindset transforms the trip into a chaotic maze of fears and self-doubt, forcing you to navigate surreal landscapes while confronting the darkest corners of your mind.
Immersive Experience
Explore ever-changing environments that mirror the chaos of a bad trip.
From shadowy forests to claustrophobic corridors, each setting feels unsettling and unpredictable.
Disturbing soundscapes and atmospheric visuals create a tense, immersive journey.
Gameplay
An intense first-person horror experience where you must run and search for an escape while staying ahead of your relentless inner demons.
Navigate through interconnected environments, each revealing new fears and challenges.

title: project; VIRAI: DOOMER’s LIFE ESCAPE
description:
게임 정보
project; VIRAI: DOOMER’s LIFE ESCAPE is a visual novel with elements of horror and psychological thriller, where you take on the role of Hicha — a reclusive girl who dreams of escaping her depressive routine and improving her life.
Now you can suffer, ruin your health, and burn through your days not only in real life but also in the game!
Perform various combinations of actions in Hicha’s apartment to unlock different outcomes. Perhaps one of them will save her!
Oh, and Hicha also works as a virtual singer named Virai. Maybe it’s Virai who can help her change her life?
What to expect:
Hicha's life simulator where every action you take has consequences.
Depressive yet stunning art by the talented artist RIKANI.
Beautiful pixel graphics that create a unique atmosphere.
A branching story with 10 different endings.
10 music tracks by renowned post-punk artists.
An original soundtrack to enhance the immersive experience.
A utopian virtual world, “VITA,” that offers a respite from grim reality.
Can you help Hicha escape her routine and find happiness? The choice is yours!

title: Diecast Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
멀티플레이어
멀티플레이어 다이캐스트 상점 시뮬레이터를 사용하면 다이캐스트 모델 상점을 관리할 수 있습니다. 세밀하고 사실적인 세계에서 진열대를 구성하고, 고객을 돕고, 상점을 확장하세요. 디스코드에 가입하여 다른 플레이어와 소통하고 다이캐스트 상점 경험을 공유하세요!
나만의 다이캐스트 상점 건설
처음부터 최고의 다이캐스트 제국을 건설하세요. 번화한 도시에서 창의력과 전략으로 꿈의 다이캐스트 상점을 디자인하고, 관리하고, 성장시켜 성공으로 이끄세요.
매니저
진열대에 다이캐스트 모델을 배치하고, 미적 감각과 효율성을 위해 매장 레이아웃을 최적화하고, 매력적인 쇼핑 환경을 조성하세요.
커스터마이징
매장 구석구석을 커스터마이즈하고 장식하여 매력적이고 개인화된 쇼핑 환경을 조성하세요.
새 라이선스 잠금 해제
인기 브랜드의 라이선스를 구매하여 다양한 다이캐스트 모델을 구비하세요. 새로운 브랜드를 도입할 때마다 매장에 다양성을 더하고 더 많은 고객을 유치하세요.
희귀 아이템 찾기
희귀한 자동차를 찾아 컬렉션에 추가하세요. 독점 아이템을 제공하여 다이캐스트 애호가와 수집가를 유치하세요.
고객과 거래
고객과 교류하여 다이캐스트 모델을 거래하세요. 공정하고 흥미로운 거래를 통해 관계를 구축하고 충성도 높은 고객층을 확보하세요.
성장
매장의 물리적 공간을 확장하고 인테리어를 업그레이드하며 고객의 요구에 맞게 지속적으로 적응하세요.
온라인 주문
스쿠터로 온라인 주문을 처리하고 배송하여 적시에 정확한 배송을 보장합니다.
특징
다이캐스트 거래 시스템
청소 기계공
NPC 상호작용
랜덤 이벤트
광고 시스템

title: Brominion
description:
게임 정보
Brominion is an interactive overlay strategy game. Turn your boring, lifeless desktop screen into an exciting warzone!
Build your warband:
Buy minions from the shop, or high-roll them from the slot machine! Train an army of fire-breathing dragons or raise a horde of the undead to destroy your adversaries. Civilly, of course.
Learn spells:
Spells are crucial in turning a battle in your favor. Conjure a fiery Meteor from the heavens, bring down enemy flyers with a deadly Tornado, or melt them down with an Acid Rain!

title: ScaleBox
description:
게임 정보
The core mechanics of this game revolve around size, weight, and portals—along with their many surprising applications. You can push boxes as long as their total size does not exceed your own, meaning that the larger you are, the more and bigger boxes you can push!
However, each time you move, you move a distance equal to your own size, making precise positioning more challenging. So, what’s the solution?
Maybe you can use something to block your movement?

title: Circus of Pain
description:
게임 정보
                      The circus welcomes everyone… but not everyone leaves.
Circus of Pain is a terrifying psychological horror game where you must survive a deadly circus performance. Waking up in an abandoned circus, you quickly realize that you have become part of a monstrous show. Every corner hides secrets, and sinister creatures are watching your every move.
To escape, you’ll need to solve challenging puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and uncover the dark history of this cursed place. Every step could be your last, as the horrors of the circus do not forgive mistakes.

title: NOVEMS
description:
게임 정보
Arrange 9 ideal cards on a page of your grimoire! NOVEMS is an auto-battle deck builder where you collect 9 cards to create your own unique build.
Build your ultimate deck in a world where powerful mages clash. What you discard and what you keep - these choices will determine your victory.
The 'placement' of cards holds the key to victory or defeat. Discern the characteristics of each card and seek the most effective arrangement. Place them strategically to defeat powerful rivals!
Cards not only have individual effects but can also demonstrate greater power by 'linking' with other cards. Discover hidden synergies and find the strongest combinations to overwhelm your enemies!

title: Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan
description:
게임 정보
Story
In “Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan,” you play as Maria Ramirez, an American working in Japan as an English teacher. It’s a rewarding, fun job, and you’re beloved by students and coworkers alike–until suddenly, one day you lose your job. You work for a dispatch English teaching company, and they lost their contract with your school, just one month before the end of the school year.
Out of nowhere, you must change the course of your life. You have a loving girlfriend to support you and other friends facing this alongside you, but ultimately you must make an extremely tough choice about your future.
This game is based on the real-life experiences of English teachers throughout Japan, on issues that tens of thousands of people endure every single year, and is designed to provide an up-close viewpoint of what the dispatch contract system does to the individuals impacted.
Features
Live through real-life shock – You’re an English teacher in Japan, and suddenly, your life is turned upside-down. Experience the chaos of a last-second life meteor.
Make tough choices – End your relationship? Risk it all? There are no easy answers to how to face your future.
Exploration of underdiscussed issues – Tens of thousands of English teachers in Japan face the same problems every single year, and “Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan” sheds light on these solvable issues to a mainstream audience.
A myriad of social issues – Job loss, foreign work visas, cross-country moves, same-sex marriage, adult loneliness–this game covers many different factors in a short time span.
Brisk story – Across all endings, the story runs about 6,000 words long, so a full playthrough should take thirty minutes or less.
About Yuri Kissaten
Yuri Kissaten is a game studio that makes narrative-focused games about girls loving girls, founded in 2024 by Fruz and Beatrice Baker. We create experiences with strong stories and memorable characters. All Yuri Kissaten projects focus primarily on LGBTQ+ characters and their relationships, romantic and otherwise. We hope you enjoy our games!
autokwd: Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan

title: Castle Crumble
description:
게임 정보
모험을 떠나 강력한 왕국을 정복하세요!
*Castle Crumble*에서 당신의 목표는 분명합니다—성은 반드시 무너져야 합니다. 완전히 시뮬레이션된 물리 환경에서 거대한 요새를 먼지로 만드는 꿈을 실현하세요. 파괴가 편안할 수도 있을까요? *Castle Crumble*에서는 가능합니다!
주요 특징:
다양한 무기 아스날
다양한 도구를 활용하여 여러 가지 방식으로 성을 무너뜨리세요. 더 강력한 화력을 원한다면 부스터를 장착하고 진정한 파괴력을 unleashed하세요!
창의적인 전략과 계획

title: Nightmare Shift
description:
게임 정보
사람들은 벽에 귀가 있다고 말하지만, 벽에 눈이 있다면 어떨까요? 당신이 하는 모든 일을 지켜보고, 기다리고, 보는 눈이 있다면요.
외딴 모텔에서 야간 근무를 하고, 불안한 손님을 상대하고, 섬뜩한 사건을 해결해 보세요. 엠마의 불안한 아파트 생활을 경험하고, 감시당하고 있다는 불안감을 느끼고, 현실과 악몽의 경계가 흐려지면서 무엇이 진짜인지 의문을 품어보세요.
엠마의 세계
평범한 밤이 비범한 미스터리로 밝혀지는 엠마의 삶 속으로 들어가 보세요. 엠마의 두려움과 고군분투, 현실과 악몽 사이의 모호한 경계를 경험해 보세요.
불안한 일상

title: The Lost Hunter
description:
게임 정보
총알 - 시간 효과:
조준하고 방아쇠를 당기고 총알의 이동 경로를 순간순간 따라가 보세요!
게임의 총알 추적 효과 덕분에 각 총알의 힘과 충격을 자세히 추적할 수 있습니다. 광활한 숲이든 탁 트인 들판이든 목표물에 도달하는 모든 총알을 추적하여 사냥 경험을 한 단계 업그레이드하세요.
이 기능은 모든 순간을 더욱 전략적이고 흥미진진하게 만들어 줍니다. 이제 목표물을 맞추는 것은 모두 여러분의 저격 실력에 달려 있습니다!
크래프트 시스템:
사냥감을 사냥할 뿐만 아니라 귀중한 자원으로 가공할 수도 있습니다!

title: Rally Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Rally Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1970s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 25 rally cars from 50 years of history
- 25 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your rally car with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: Central Bank
description:
게임 정보
Add to your Wishlist to follow this project!
Welcome to Central Bank! The ultimate Central Bank simulator!
Take control of the most fearsome weapon known to mankind: the key interest rate. As head of the central bank, you wield the power to make (or break) nations. Raise it, and watch markets crumble and riots erupt. Lower it, and brace yourself for an economy so hot it could melt steel.

Step into the all-powerful shoes of a central banker, where you hold the world’s fate at your fingertips – literally. Central Bank is about weaving the fine line between euphoric prosperity and absolute chaos:

Too high, and the people revolt as homes become unaffordable, businesses collapse, and global unrest unfolds. Too low, and inflation runs rampant, society devolves into a free-for-all, and governments beg you to reverse course. Play god with the economy, manipulate prosperity, and watch as your every choice impacts millions. Will you be the savior of stability… or the architect of economic apocalypse?

title: Spin Forward
description:
게임 정보
잠에서 깨어나자, 당신은 Slot 대륙으로 전송되었습니다. 슬롯머신과 당신의 운에 의지해 Slot 대륙의 모험에서 죽거나 더 부유하고 강해질 것입니다.
저희는 Luck Be a Landlord와 Slay the Spire의 게임 메커니즘을 결합했습니다. 적들은 강력하며, 패배하면 게임이 끝납니다.
게임 중에는 강력한 상징과 신비로운 유물을 얻게 되며, 각 상징은 고유한 속성을 지니고, 유물은 다양한 특이한 효과를 가지고 있습니다.
Spin을 클릭하여 모험을 시작하세요!
특징:
다양한 능력을 가진 심볼과 유물을 모으고 조합하여 모험의 길에서 몬스터와 보스를 처치하세요.
Spin을 클릭하여 슬롯 머신을 시작하고 랜덤으로 심볼 조합을 생성하세요. 다양한 유물과 결합하면 공격력과 방어력이 달라집니다.
특정 심볼을 사용하여 적에게 특별한 효과를 발생시킬 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 양치기 지팡이는 적을 양으로 변하게 만들 수 있습니다.
각각의 플레이는 독특한 경험을 제공합니다. 다양한 심볼과 유물을 발견하고, 다양한 적과 사건을 만나며, 새로운 놀라움을 경험하세요.

title: Street Soccer Online
description:
게임 정보
a. General Introduction:
Street Soccer Online is a fast-paced multiplayer street soccer game that captures the energy and fun of the sport. With no rules to hold you back, this game delivers a pure, exhilarating soccer experience. Play as both a player and a goalkeeper, and immerse yourself in the spirit of street soccer!
b. Key Features:
No Rules Soccer: Feel the freedom and dynamism of street soccer.
Play as Both Player and Goalkeeper: Show your skills in every position on the field.
Fast and Fun: Simple controls make it easy to play, but hard to master.
Multiple Maps: Various maps are coming soon as the game continues to evolve!
Multiple Game Modes: Ball growth mode and ball rain mode available (New game modes coming soon!)
Realistic Physics: Create strategies with realistic football movements and collisions

title: Harmony in the Wild
description:
게임 정보
Nature's balance lies in the paws of a transforming fox pup.
During a magical open-world adventure, you learn abilities from animal friends and glide, swim and leap across diverse landscapes uncovering the mystery of dying nature. As you progress, storybook pages turn, revealing your destiny.
Features:
Transforming Fox: Adapt to your surroundings by transforming into either an arctic fox or a red fox.
Open-world Exploration: Explore vibrant forests, navigate icy terrains, swim through vast ocean and unravel the secrets of a fading ecosystem.
Various Main & Side Quests: Embark on a compelling journey with animal companions on various main and side quests, each revealing new abilities for you to use.

title: Swing Swamp
description:
게임 정보
This is a very short game~
In the abandoned wetlands, use silk to swing and hang deftly, navigating through the decayed environment. Facing hostile creatures lurking within the microecosystem, you'll need precise shooting and quick reflexes to survive.
Explore, fight, and swing—this is a survival adventure set in a microcosmic world.
Game feature
Environment
Welcome to this overlooked wetland, where peculiar ecosystems and unique landscapes thrive. But beware – this realm has its own rules!
Movement
jump, grapple, swing, glide... Your movement is full of possibilities. Attack your enemies in unexpected ways. But don't fall into the water – there might be other dangers lurking...

title: Ant Guardians
description:
게임 정보
내 맘대로 골라 소환하는 유닛 디펜스 게임!
오염된 크리스탈을 봉인하는 동안, 끊임없이 몰려오는 적들의 침공을 막아야 합니다!
자원을 모아 동료 유닛을 소환하여 점점 강해지는 적들을 물리치세요.
벽을 소환하여 입구를 막거나, 튼튼한 유닛을 앞세워 적들을 막을 수도 있습니다.
아이템을 강화하여 유닛을 더욱 강력하게 만들어보세요.

title: Toward Dawn
description:
게임 정보
Features:
A world and story inspired by Welsh Mythology.
A demo containing the first 3 chapters - around 3 hours of gameplay!
Break your enemies in a unique Turn-Based battle system.
Customise abilities with the Ability Tree and Loadouts.
3 Difficulty modes - Story, Classic and Hard.
Optional romance.
Pet the wolf!
A New Retro-JRPG Inspired by Welsh Mythology
After her temple is raided, Carys finds herself at the mercy of Bleddyn, a Gwyllgi feared by society. But Carys finds that their differences only bring them closer - inspiring them both to seek answers to the events that led both their lives down a dark path. Toward Dawn features mythical beasts and themes inspired by Celtic legends - exploring the delicate subject of trauma and cycles of abuse that appear in such tales.

title: Build a Bridge!
description:
게임 정보


Test your engineering and improvisation skills in a puzzle game where the stakes are as high as they get. It is you who will construct bridges for cars, trucks, buses... And sometimes even monster trucks. Gather your wits and get on with the construction!



During the planning phase the game presents itself with a simple, 2D interface. It is there that you select the best materials for your bridge and connect the dots to make the most resilient structure you can. You can approach each level as a complex puzzle, trying to be as efficient as possible and get the best solution. But don't be afraid to experiment too. You can just go crazy and construct something that looks outrageous but still somehow works. There's fun in both of these approaches.



When you're done, switch to the 3D mode and watch a car drive through your bridge. Will it hold? Or will you watch a spectacular crash?

In addition to the normal mode the game features the easy mode for more relaxed gameplay, focused on creativity and improvisation. You can also use in-game hint system if things get too hard. With 80 levels plus hidden and bonus bridges to construct you will not run out of things to do quickly.

title: The Great Hunt
description:
게임 정보
Ben Stevenson, a rookie search and rescue service worker, embarks on the most mysterious and dangerous mission of his career. What began as a simple mission to find missing tourists soon evolves into a chilling nightmare filled with paranormal enigmas and secrets.

Immerse yourself in the deep forest thickets where reality merges with the darkness of the unknown. Come face to face with mysterious and frightening phenomena that surround you. The deeper you explore, the stranger the surrounding world becomes. Children's cries echo on the wind from nowhere, and tree branches whisper secrets that would be better left unsolved. Will you dare to venture off the beaten paths to uncover the truth, or will you prefer to stay within familiar boundaries and hope for the best?
Explore, Fight, and Survive


The Great Hunt is a survival horror game with RPG elements and a focus on narrative development. However, this doesn't mean your actions are limited. You'll encounter two expansive locations: the quiet town of Tomsville and the adjacent national park. You're granted the freedom to explore these places, encountering random events and assisting those in need. Your character is a search and rescue service worker, and your decisions will influence the transformation of the town and the fate of its inhabitants.
Key Features:


A large, explorable town that lives its own life
Unique events that allow the player to impact the fate of the townspeople
An atmosphere of doom that affects both the player and characters
Open locations to explore, collectible items, and in-game trading
Various types of enemies, each requiring its own approach

title: Daomei Village: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
Daomei Village: Prologue

[프롤로그는 전체 게임의 일부일 뿐이며 완전히 무료입니다. 모든 플레이어는 프롤로그를 플레이하고 정식 버전에서 어떤 콘텐츠가 기다리고 있는지 확인할 수 있습니다.




Daomei Village는 진기한 환경을 배경으로 한 매력적인 픽셀 아트 게임으로서 창의력을 자극합니다!


황제의 명령에 따라 당신은 Daomei Village로 와서 마을을 훌륭하게 복구하기 위한 임무를 수행합니다. 황제에게 바칠 공물을 요구하는 세리의 관심을 피할 수 없다는 것을 잊지 마세요. 그러므로 농장을 돌보고, 밭을 일구고, 동물을 사육하여 수입을 창출해야 합니다. 처음에는 쉽지 않습니다. 당신에게는 몇 가지 간단한 도구, 100위안, 약간의 볍씨, 차밖에 없기 때문이죠. 하지만 포기하지 마세요! 놀라운 모험이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다. 당신과 같이 죄를 짓고 불운한 마을로 온 친구들을 만나게 될 것입니다.




계절의 변화는 채소와 꽃을 재배하는 가능성에 영향을 미칩니다. 각 동물들은 자기의 전용 공간을 요구합니다. 당신이 꿈꾸는 밭, 건물, 주변 환경을 만드세요. 모든 것을 만들고 개선할 수 있습니다. 작물 자동화 기술을 도입하고 마을을 아름답게 꾸리세요.




마을에서의 활동은 당신에게 행복과 지식을 가져다 줍니다. 안심한 황제는 당신이 제국군이 점령한 적들의 땅으로 갈 수 있도록 해줄 것입니다. 덕분에 새로운 기술에 대한 정보와 새로운 원료, 도구, 종자를 얻을 수 있을 것입니다. 지형이 어려울수록 독특한 성과를 거둘 가능성이 커집니다. 하지만 싸움 위험도 커집니다. 탐험 중에 얻은 모든 것은 당신의 것이며 마을을 건설하는 데 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신은 마을의 리더로서 발전 속도를 결정합니다.




Daomei Village에 사는 사람들은 모두 어떤 죄를 지었습니다. 마을 사람들과 교류할 때 그들의 신뢰를 얻을 수 있는 미션을 수행하게 될 것입니다. 당신은 또한 그들이 죄를 짓게 된 이유를 알게 될 것입니다.


Daomei Village는 완전히 독특하고 신비한 곳입니다. 당신은 이전 왕조의 흔적들과 마주치고, 독특한 중국 민속학과 귀신론에 대해 알게 됩니다. 중국 민속명절뿐 아니라 마을 주민들의 생일이 되면 축제를 진행하게 됩니다. 놓치지 마세요!

title: Rocklings
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to mine?
Welcome to Rocklings – a strategy game for anyone with a penchant for cuteness and strategic thinking! Embark on exciting missions with your hard-working crew as they navigate through a world teeming with rocks, resources, and treasure.

About Rocklings:
Rocklings is a strategy game that takes you on carefully crafted mission scenarios or alternatively procedurally generated levels whereby you reach your goal by digging, building and collecting! Unlock new cosmetics for your workers! Use the built-in level editor to craft your own missions!

Key Features:
Adorable Miners: Meet a lovable cast of characters known as Rocklings, each with unique look and irresistible charm. Watch them come to life as they embark on their mining adventure!
Dynamic Exploration: Experience an ever-changing adventure with randomly generated maps, ensuring a fresh and exciting gameplay experience every time you play. Traverse through the landscape with conventional pick-axe or power up with explosives!
Curated Campaign: Immerse yourself in a handcrafted campaign with carefully designed levels that progressively introduce new gameplay mechanics and present exciting challenges for players to conquer.



In Rocklings, players drill their path to victory. Players will have to collect resources and build up their base in order to reach their goal efficiently!

title: Submersed 2 - The Hive
description:
게임 정보
SUBMERSED 2 - THE HIVE is a first-person science-fiction horror game, set in the harrowing depths of the Atlantic Ocean.
Enter the world of SUBMERSED 2 - THE HIVE and face the horror of being submerged at the bottom of the ocean.
Find resources and weapons, investigate terminals and secret documents, and discover the hidden truth in the underwater facilities where you are trapped.
Face your deepest fears and fight the terrible creatures that hide in the deep water.
Search for the last survivors in the underwater station and live the events that will be part of the destiny of the facility and all humanity.
FEATURES

title: Fearbonding
description:
게임 정보
스토리
Fearbonding (공포의 유대)는 얀데레 x 악마 비엘 호러 비주얼 노벨이다.
공포를 먹어라
얀데레를 길들여라
살아남아라
꿀처럼 달콤하고 끈적한, 그것이 히나타에게 공포의 맛이다. 진정한 공포는 찾기 어렵기 때문에, 코스케를 만난 날, 그의 새로운 목표는 명확해졌다
이 무서운 남자를 길들여야 한다.
히나타가 의심을 받지 않으면서 공포를 수확할 수 있도록 도와라. 미치광이 코스케에게 다가가기 위해 조심스럽게 행동해라. 과연 너는 굶주림을 채울 수 있을까, 아니면 오히려 잠식당하게 될까?
특징
약 14,000단어
다양한 피로 물든 엔딩
비엘 호러 만화에서 영감을 받음
끔찍하고 병적인 BL을 즐기는 이들을 위한 작품
지옥에서 만난 한 쌍
등장인물
히나타 쿠스모토
히나타는 악마지만, 구급대원으로 일한다그래서 인간들의 공포를 먹지만하지만 진정한 공포를 찾기에는 어려웠다그러다가 미치광이 남자 코스케를 만나게 된다.히나타의 목표는 명확하다.이 남자를 길들여야 한다.
코스케 아리마
코스케는 항상 가까운 유대 관계를 갈구했지만 그의 방법은 상대에게 너무 과했다. 하지만 최악의 상태에서 히나타를 만난다. 이 낯선 사람을 믿을 수 있을까? 아니면 또 다시 배신을 당하게 될까?

title: Room 404
description:
게임 정보
존경하는 주민 여러분:
최근에 많은 주민분들께서 요즘 한밤중에 4층에서 이상한 소리가 자주 난다고 말씀하셨습니다.
조사를 하였고 당분간 4층에 엘레베이터를 멈추지 않게 설정하였습니다. 불편을 드리게 된 점 양해 부탁드립니다.
실수로 4층에 가시게 되었다면, 나가지 못해도 절대로 당황하지 마시고 4층 복도를 유!심!히! 살펴보시기를 바랍니다.
이상이 없다면 왔던 길로 되돌아가시면 되고, 이상이 있다면 그대로 직진하십시오.
새로 모신 수호신께서 이미 계단에 도착하셔서 귀신을 물러내고 평화를 지키고 계십니다.
전문적인 도사님도 이번달에 오실예정이오니 모두들 안심하시기를 바랍니다.
모두 무사하기를 바랍니다.
게임 특징:
초현실적인 렌더링
가상엔진 5와 대량으로 스캔된 컨텐츠 라이브러리를 사용하는 이 게임은 몰입도가 높고 초현실적인 중국 레트로 호러 환경을 제공합니다.
단편적인 스토리 텔링
이상한 상황들 사이의 연관성을 발견하고 4층 주민들의 이야기를 둘러싼 미스터리를 알아냅니다.
단순한 "틀린 그림 찾기"가 아님

title: Toni Island Adventure
description:
게임 정보
강아지, 섬, 잊지 못할 모험... 그리고 피자!
예기치 않은 난파 이후, 피자에 푹 빠진 항해견 토니는 신비한 살라미노 섬에 갇히게 됩니다. 이 섬은 개들만 살고 있으며, 수세대 전에 고양이들이 추방된 곳입니다. 집으로 돌아가기 위해, 토니는 섬 곳곳을 탐험하고, 고대의 비밀을 풀고, 폭발 직전인 화산과 맞서야 합니다.
토니는 혼란에 빠진 이 섬을 조화로운 장소로 바꿀 수 있을까요?
탐험할 수 있는 활기찬 섬
살라미노 섬은 독특한 매력을 가진 5개의 마을로 구성되어 있습니다. 평화로운 해변 마을부터 활기찬 대도시에 이르기까지, 각 지역은 고유의 문화, 도전과제, 그리고 발견해야 할 비밀들을 제공합니다.
autokwd: Toni Island Adventure,토니 섬 모험 『Toni Island Adventure』

title: Wandness: WandCraft Survivor

title: DeadWire
description:

네온 빛이 가득한 사이버펑크 도시의 어둠 속으로 뛰어드세요, DeadWire—모든 적은 기회가 되고, 모든 물체는 무기가 됩니다.
빚쟁이지만 능숙한 해커인 당신은 자라온 고아원을 위협하는 강력한 범죄 조직을 무찔러야 합니다. 빠르게 전개되는 탑다운 슈터에서 최첨단 무기와 독특한 리와이어 모드로 전세를 역전시킬 수 있습니다.

title: Neural Edge
description:

title: Case 32

title: SGS Spain at War
description:
게임 정보
Spain at War
SGS Spain at War is a complete standalone game that covers the Spanish Civil war from July 1936 to April 1939.


The game covers the whole war from 18th July ’36, using a system of weekly turns. As the Nationalist you have to bring to the Peninsula your powerful units of the Africa’s army and take control of the key cities to force the Republic to surrender. As the Republican player you must delay the initial progress of the enemy and meanwhile start building the Popular Army in order to be ready to face your opponent’s regular army, and in particulars its veteran units.

Spain at War is a very detailed game where you can find every single unit that took part in the conflict, Falangist and Carlist militias, each unit of the Africa’s Army, dozens of Republican militia units, the Italian aerial squadrons with their historical names and images, all the warships of both side, the International Brigades battalions, Basque, Asturian or Catalan units, Anarchists militia units, the Soviet T-26, I-15 Chatos and I-16 Moscas, the Bf109 of the Kondor Legion and much more!

The players have to use wisely their industrial capacity to spend their resources in new units or in replacements for weakened units to avoid their destruction. But it is not possible to rebuild every lost unit or to replace it, like the case of ships or elite units (e.g. Legion). Cards play also a key role in the game as they bring some variation in the different fields, such as reinforcements, economics, diplomacy, politics, popular support and, above all, combats.
The player will also find in the game nice historical events that bring ‘chrome’ to the game and helps you to feel the historical moment represented.

The knowledge, experience and background of the designer of España: 1936 and Battles for Spain, Miguel Santacruz, has been essential in creating and supporting the development of this game, assisted by the SGS team. A lot of bibliography and data was collected to support the research needed to develop this game so that it feels accurate.

The game will contain a grand campaign scenario covering the whole war, as well as other (shorter) scenarios based on different starting years or limited to specific areas (Ebro, Northern Front) of the war.

We plan to also provide the players with interesting options to explore potential what-if situations.

Estimated Playtime: from 1h to many hours…
Favored Side: none.
Hardest to Play: Republicans.

title: A Doctor's Term
description:
게임 정보

Step into the shoes of Dr Vincent Batten, who takes on his new role at the Ministry of Health of the Fifth Republic. Known as a care center for mentally unstable patients, you will find yourself curious, yet intimidated behind the walls of this facility.




In times when the republic is characterized by unrest and riots, it is all the more honourable to tackle such a task.
Your family must be proud!



A Doctor's Term is a story-heavy walking sim featuring stunning environments, thought-provoking narrative and an original soundtrack composed by Manolis Kalpenidis.



A confidential adventure where freedom of choice may be bigger than anticipated.
Observe your patients, test new samples on them, follow your orders!
Are you ready for the job?

title: Heroes of Mount Dragon
description:
게임 정보
흥미진진한 횡 스크롤 격투 게임에서 내면의 드래곤을 해방하세요!
히어로즈 오브 드래곤 마운틴에서 강력한 드래곤으로 변신 가능한 8명의 영웅 중 하나가 되어보세요! 혼자서 혹은 친구와 팀을 이뤄서 적의 무리와 맞서 싸우는 속도감 넘치는 횡 스크롤 전투에 대비하세요. 직관적이면서도 깊이 있는 조작감을 즐기며 다양한 동작과 압도적인 콤보를 구사하고, 장대한 전투를 헤쳐나가며 강력한 업그레이드를 해금하세요.
드래곤으로 변신하는 영웅들
저마다 고유한 능력과 전투 스타일을 겸비한 8*명의 특별한 영웅 중 하나를 선택하세요. 영웅의 힘을 해금하고 강대한 드래곤으로 변신해 점점 더 강력해지는 적들을 상대하세요!
*출시 시 플레이 가능한 영웅 수는 4명
autokwd: Heroes of Mount Dragon,히어로즈 오브 드래곤 마운틴

title: Library of Meialia
description:
게임 정보
Library of Meialia is a 2D pixel art rogue-like adventure where you play as Amlos, a curious young dragon navigating the sprawling, enigmatic Library of Meialia—a place where you don’t quite belong. As you journey through the endless halls, you’ll face off against the library's sentinels and ancient beasts long sealed away. Along the way, forge friendships with diverse characters, uncover hidden secrets, and grow stronger with every battle. Immerse yourself in this meticulously hand-crafted pixel library, where every corner offers both opportunity and peril, all set to a beautifully composed soundtrack.
Soar Through the Library—Until You Can't…
As Amlos, the young dragon, your wings allow you to fly effortlessly through the library, scale walls and explore unknown corridors . But beware—some rooms will ground you, forcing you to tread carefully with your claws.
Knowledge is Power
The Library of Meialia is the ultimate center of magical knowledge. On your quest to master Aethium magic, you’ll discover magic books and pages scattered throughout, each offering new skills to aid your journey. With over 70 skills to unlock, the possibilities are endless. Take your discoveries to the Aethiumeter and use your newfound powers to conquer any obstacle in your path.
Unleash the Sealed Beasts
Each level of the library contains terrifying monsters, sealed away for students to study. But you’ll face them head-on, battling through their varied attack patterns and relentless bullet hells. You'll need to defeat them to prove your worth and advance deeper into the library. But remember—greater dangers lie in wait at each level's end…
No Two Explorations Are Alike
The Library of Meialia is never the same. Thanks to its random map generation, each playthrough in the library offers a fresh experience. New paths, new challenges, and new treasures await every time you step inside. Grab your magic books and prepare for the unexpected!

title: Spiritual Bond ~Breaking the curse
description:
게임 정보



The core gameplay of this game is a "text-based puzzle visual novel".
You'll need to search the cursed environment for hidden "Reifu" cards.
By combining these cards, you'll gradually uncover key events to break the curse.
Afterward, you'll be able to view memory fragments revealed by the "Yuan Shadow".
Through your choices, you can change their fate and guide them to "Higan"!

title: TypInc.
description:
게임 정보
Typinc. is a roguelike deckbuilding typing game.
Complete typing jobs presented to you to unlock perks which affects the score you make.
                        Features:
Typing stats such as Best Typing Speed, Average of Last 10 and Accuracy. 
Roguelike Deckbuilding
Unlock different perks for different affects

title: Burial of Shortcake
description:
게임 정보
"The Burial of Shortcake" is an unpredictable story.  It is a new visual novel with characters which are created/designed by voice actor Nozomi Sasaki, whose "expressiveness" shines throughout her career as a performer.
You can click on the screen to continue to read the story.
Game Features
Genre: Crime suspense, visual novel
Playing time: 5 to 7 hours
Options: none. One way
Story
"Sweat, dirt, blood. It all goes in my mouth and makes me want to throw up."
One night, the main character, Kisetsu, sneaks into a mountain forest in the middle of the night in order to bury the corpse for a certain reason.
A snow shovel.
A shopping cart from a supermarket.
And then he wrapped something in a blue sheet and hid it - [that].
Surrounded by “them”, he started digging a hole, was covered with all the sweat and swallowing blood and dirt.
And then...
“What is that…?”
He just realized that there is no end beyond the hole and beyond the tragedy.
This is about “the world” beyond the tragedy.
Crime Suspense Visual Novel--"The Burial of Shortcake"

title: Diner Bros 2
description:
게임 정보
HECTIC KITCHEN ACTION
Are you ready to put your culinary skills to the test?  Serve up delicious dishes in the fast-paced, fun, and frantic Diner Bros 2.  Open a bustling restaurant in this chaotic local co-op experience: Juggle orders, cook tasty meals, and race against the clock to satisfy your hungry customers!
KNOW YOUR CUSTOMERS
In Diner Bros 2, it's not just the orders that get crazy — it’s also the Unique Customers who will keep you on your toes! Each character has their own quirks and demands that will test your multitasking skills:
No loitering! The Teenager thinks she can stay all day!
Always on the move, the Jogger wants their food quickly - and we mean fast!
Watch out for the sneaky Punk looking for an opportunity to dine and dash!
... and many more! It's up to you to keep the orders flowing!
UPGRADE YOUR RESTAURANT
Purchase New Equipment: as your diner grows, you'll need better tools to keep up with the increasing demand.
Optimize Your Kitchen Layout: Efficiency is key when it comes to earning cash, so make sure your kitchen is set up for smooth operation.  Or don't!
Expand Your Restaurant: Can you impress the Food Critic and earn the coveted 3-star award?

title: Cyber Climb
description:
게임 정보
CYBER CLIMB blends fast-paced movement shooter with strategic factory building.
Like Satisfactory + Titanfall 2.

Your objectives are simple: kill robots, finish quests, build a rocket to get home from Mars. Along the way, you'll encounter increasingly difficult enemies, challenging environments, and a variety of obstacles designed to test your skills.
With inspiration from games like RoboQuest, Deadlink, and Deus Ex, CYBER CLIMB delivers dynamic combat and fluid movement mechanics. Use a grappling hook, double jumps, and air dashes to outmaneuver enemies and navigate tricky platforms. Choose from 7 different weapons, upgrade your abilities with a roguelike card system, and make every run unique as the challenge intensifies the longer you play.
Key Features:
7 unique weapons to discover and master
Factory building: crafting, conveyor belts, batteries, etc.
Movement mechanics like grappling hooks, double jumps, and air dashes for fast-paced traversal
Skills such as throwing grenades and creating bounce pads for creative combat
Roguelike upgrade system: buy new cards and power-ups with in-game currency
Dynamic difficulty: the longer the run, the harder the game becomes
Box stacking to create exploration opportunities
Immersive sim elements that reward experimentation and strategy
CYBER CLIMB is currently in heavy development by a solo developer, with regular updates and new content planned until the release. Feedback from players is highly appreciated!

title: Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a scenic horse ranch to experience the joy and pride of caring for a world-class stable of horses in Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition.
With the help of a friendly mentor, you’ll raise charming foals, care for and train a stable of unique horses, and compete to become a champion racer and rider.
BUILD A BOND
Being an equestrian is about so much more than winning the next race. Get to know your horses and form close bonds through realistic and fulfilling interactions.
Feed your horses their favorite treats, keep them well-groomed, and give them a scratch in just the right spot to see them stretch out their necks in delight!
No task list — Enjoy time with your horses at your own pace.
MANAGE YOUR STABLES
autokwd: Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition

title: Looping Art Museum
description:
게임 정보
Reveal the memories through "Spot the Difference."
Escape from the endless loop in a single-path maze.

This is a single-player adventure game drawn with flickering lights and pixel art.

Game Description
This game is a side-scrolling adventure game.
You can move right or left, but you will always end up returning to the same place.

There is only one way to move forward. Carefully observe the paintings.
You will notice there’s a painting that differs slightly from the one you saw before.

If you feel something is off, take a stop and look at the painting.
If it has changed, congratulations! You have taken a step forward, and now you are ready to look for the next change.

As you discover changes one by one, the path forward will open up.
Now, you are ready for your journey in the looping art museum.

The game is controlled using only the keyboard.

The Character can only move to the left or right.
A key or Left Arrow key: Move left
D key or Right Arrow key: Move right

There are also parts where you will be required to enter text.
Please use the keyboard to input the word.
On a cold day, the protagonist visits the art gallery for the first time in a while.
She got attracted to one specific painting.
As time passes while they are fascinated, people around her disappear.
But when trying to leave, she noticed something strange.
Whether she goes back or forth, the same painting appears in front of her again and again and again...

This is a looping art museum.

Clever "Mr.Cat" talks to you and tells you to play "Spot the Difference" in the museum.
You have to observe the paintings closely and start naming them.
Find the paintings which are changing stealthily.
Can you escape from the loop by repeating "Spot the Difference"?
And what secrets lie hidden in the looping art museum?
Name: Nekko
A mechanical engineer turned indie game developer.
For some reason, I am burning through my savings day and night, devoting myself to game development.
Obsessed with the charm of pixel art, they endlessly tweak the positions of pixels if left alone.

title: Nuclear Sub: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
Nuclear Sub: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game.

Dive into the unique story of the nuclear submarine crew. The government sends its best armed and best tactically prepared undersea crew to face hostile units in the far depths of the cold North.

It seems that everything is already in place that would be needed for success, an excellent crew, a great ship, the only thing missing is a person who has the tactical sense to handle naval battles. You need to control the morale of the sailors, manage weapons and food supplies, and constantly check the technical condition of the submarine, especially its nuclear reactor. Will you prove yourself in this role?


Manage basic resources such as indoor oxygen levels and the correct functioning of the nuclear reactor. Monitor the availability of electricity and check if navigation and mechanical systems are working properly. The better the condition of the ship you provide, the happier the sailors will be and the more efficiently they will perform their tasks. Remember to keep morale high, but also don't forget the realistically represented hierarchy on the submarine directly contributes to maintaining order among the crew.


When going to deep waters with a nuclear submarine, you must remember to control its propulsion. A nuclear reactor requires constant attention and checking of its technical condition. If a malfunction occurs, close off the relevant parts of the ship to cut off damaged or flooded sections.


Explore the oceans of the open world, looking out for enemy units. Complete missions assigned by your superiors and assign tasks to your subordinates. Destroy enemy ships and raise the morale of your crew. A wide range of Cold War missile selections will allow you to win any battle of the many planned scenarios, and an advanced ship damage system will make the gameplay even more realistic.

Features:
- cold, open world of the North
- model of a 3 decks nuclear ship with realistically replicated separate compartments
- manage 80 sailors in the crew, who, thanks to artificial intelligence, behave accordingly to the level of satisfaction and good condition of the ship
- realistic ship damage system will supplement the gameplay with the necessary realism
- a campaign consisting of 10 diverse main missions and 20 side missions based on real scenarios
- possibility to upgrade your ship and equipment, thanks to the money earned for correctly completed missions
- Control your mission from different levels of view: TPP, FPP, map

title: Sit-Back Attack
description:
게임 정보
특징
음료수와 간식을 들고 편히 앉아 팀이 악의 무리를 처단하는 모습을 지켜보세요! 클래스 커스터마이징과 빌드 다양성에 중점을 둔 반유휴형 RPG입니다.
직면하게 될 과제를 해결하기 위해 수천 가지 빌드 옵션을 마음대로 사용할 수 있습니다!
모두 ZERO MTX로!!!!
60개 이상의 다양한 클래스, 500개 이상의 다양한 스킬, 무제한의 빌드 옵션을 갖추고 있어 4명의 영웅으로 구성된 팀이 300개가 넘는 몬스터, 보스, 울트라 보스를 물리칠 수 있습니다!
독특한 도전과 전략으로 재미있고 빠른 전투를 즐겨보세요.
속도 증가는 최대 20배까지 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다!
캐릭터 및 클래스 커스터마이징
팀을 더욱 강하게 만드는 방법을 결정하는 데 도움이 되는 전투, 통계 등의 모든 측면을 볼 수 있는 매우 심층적인 인터페이스입니다!
모든 클래스에는 고유한 캐릭터 아트와 고유한 기술, 강점 및 약점이 있습니다.
레벨업을 하면 원하는 방식으로 캐릭터를 구축하는 데 사용할 수 있는 능력치 포인트가 제공됩니다!
능력치와 플레이스타일을 크게 바꿀 수 있는 패시브 스킬!
애완동물 및 업적
4마리의 애완동물 중 1마리를 선택하여 팀을 강화하고 특수 공격을 사용할 시기를 제어할 수 있습니다. 기본 스텟도 파티를 강화시켜줍니다!
100개 이상의 성과. 달성할 때마다 애완동물의 레벨이 올라갑니다.
애완동물 레벨은 글로벌입니다. 새 게임을 시작하면 프레스티지 효과를 위해 해당 레벨이 상속됩니다!
펫 스킬은 수동으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 캐릭터의 패시브 스킬을 통해서도 향상될 수 있습니다!
레벨링 및 진행
레벨 상한은 500+입니다!
울트라 보스가 있는 도전적인 맵을 완료하여 모든 새로운 캐릭터 파워 등급(레벨 100, 200, 300 등...)을 잠금 해제해야 합니다!
우리가 찾을 수 있는 최고의 진행 균형을 제공하기 위해 엄격한 테스트를 거쳤습니다!

title: Morphing Bullets
description:
게임 정보
Morphing Bullets
Immerse yourself in a third-person shooter that redefines classic action.
It's not just about precise aiming – your tactical skills determine the outcome as you turn death into an opportunity to shift the tide of battle.
Gameplay That Redefines Death
Death is not the end – it's the beginning of a tactical shift.
When your character falls, a unique transformation takes place: Morph into alternative combat forms, such as a mechanical spider sweeping enemies off the ground or a fiery barrier securing key pathways.
Some morphs last until the end of the match, providing a lasting strategic advantage. Every defeat becomes a stepping stone for a clever comeback.
Multiplayer
Engage in intense battles with up to 31 other players – on your own dedicated server or via Steam’s peer-to-peer mode. Choose your maps, game modes, and battle duration for a customized experience.
Different Characters
Choose from five unique characters, each with their own playstyle and strengths. Whether you prefer high damage, increased speed, or strong defense, every hero offers tailored advantages to enhance gameplay variety.
Aura Skills
Each character possesses an exclusive Aura Skill that can turn the tide of battle.
These special abilities are not always available – they require collecting Aura Points, earned by completing objectives or morphing enemies.
Strategic management of your Aura Points is key – will you activate a protective team shield or become nearly invisible for a short time?
Aura Weapons

title: Digging the Forgotten Cave
description:
게임 정보
Explore the depths of the mountain, carve your own tunnels. Move at your own pace and listen to your instincts. Bring treasures to the surface and enhance your gear.
The mountain’s belly is vast, dig wherever you please. If your intuition guides you well, you’ll discover countless enigmatic chambers, corridors, and halls filled with riches. Once you’ve gained enough experience and gold, you’ll be able to purchase powerful tools. With these tools, you’ll finally be able to solve the mountain’s greatest secrets.
Now grab your pickaxe and head into the forgotten CAVE!

title: Teacher Seduction
description:
게임 정보
Teacher Seduction is a kinetic visual novel with dating sim elements about a guy who studies computer science at university.

He likes math and has a crush on his math teacher Ms.Parker, but he can't spend any time with her because of his part-time job, which makes it impossible to have any activities other than classes.

However, when our hero finds out that Jill has recently started a relationship with a literature teacher from his university who is also a total jerk, he decides to quit his job and try to enter a math competition to win her heart while they spend time preparing for it.

Will he succeed and overcome all the problems, or has he risked everything for nothing and made his relationship with Ms.Parker worse? Let's find out!

This game includes:
• Dramatic story with romance and comedy elements.
• HD fully original artworks.
• ≈ 1 hour of content.
• Relaxing atmosphere.
• Soundtrack by Antti Luode.

title: Adult Game
description: Adult Game

title: Book Smugglers
description:
게임 정보
Join the courageous underground network of Book Smugglers in a grim decision-making, point-and-click, resource-management adventure as they risk everything to preserve their cultural heritage and ignite a flame of resistance.

Manage your resources
Strategically manage your limited supplies, such as food, tools, currency and forged documents. Your choices will determine the success of your missions and the safety of the precious literature you transport.


Make tough decisions
Experience the weight of your decisions as you balance risk and reward. Every choice has multiple outcomes that might influence your gameplay differently every time you play. Your choices will shape the Book Smugglers' destiny and leave a lasting impact on the pages of history.



Explore the intriguing phenomenon of book smuggling in a time of oppression in 19th-century Lithuania. Learn about the brave individuals who risked their lives to keep their cultural heritage alive and fight against the suppression of knowledge.

title: Öooo
description:
게임 정보
폭탄 애벌레의 대모험!
"Öooo"는 사랑스럽고 신비로운 탐험형 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임으로, 폭탄을 창의적으로 활용하는 방법을 발견하게 됩니다!
폭탄을 활용한 다양한 해결책!
폭탄을 사용하는 독창적인 방법을 발견하세요!

title: The Book of Aaru
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey in The Book of Aaru, an action-packed rogue-lite game with RPG elements. Discover a world where ancient Egypt has evolved beyond expectations, merging history, mythology, and advanced sci-fi technology. Play as fictional character Emily Sands, a daring explorer who mysteriously vanished while searching for the temple of Osiris in 1926. Cursed and stripped of humanity, you’ll navigate through intricately hand-crafted trap corridors, each presenting a unique challenge that demands diverse skills, precise timing, and adaptable strategies. Will you choose a dangerous path filled with treasures or a safer route with fewer rewards? The choice is yours!
Key Features:
Isometric Action Rogue-lite: Engage in fast-paced, tactical action gameplay from an isometric perspective.

title: Broken Reality 2000
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Broken Reality 2000 is a single player adventure game set in an ethereal metaverse called NATEM, that is full of quests, puzzles and light platforming. Explore diferent sites, make new friends and collect Likes to raise your popularity and earn access to new areas. Discover a wide set of tools, like a virus-slaying Katana, a net-surfing Hoverboard, a Camera to take beautiful pictures, and more, that will help you explore this colorful world!

title: 99 Fails
description:
게임 정보
99 Fails is a tight 2D precision platformer set in Zeebo's weird nightmare. You’ll test your rhythm, timing, and skill as enemies and the environment fight to break your flow!
A platforming game anyone can play, but very few can master!
Bizarre artful visions & monsters with music by David Wise!
Master three unique mechanics & race friends online to the finish!
Compete with everyone in an endless level online - there can be only one!

title: Dice Gambit
description:
게임 정보
Dice Gambit은 저희가 소규모 제작사이기 때문에, 현재 계획상으로는 영어만 지원됩니다. 하지만 한국어에 대한 관심이 충분히 모인다면, 번역 지원에 대해 최선을 다하겠습니다!

title: Daomei Village
description:
게임 정보
Daomei Village




Daomei Village는 진기한 환경을 배경으로 한 매력적인 픽셀 아트 게임으로서 창의력을 자극합니다!


황제의 명령에 따라 당신은 Daomei Village로 와서 마을을 훌륭하게 복구하기 위한 임무를 수행합니다. 황제에게 바칠 공물을 요구하는 세리의 관심을 피할 수 없다는 것을 잊지 마세요. 그러므로 농장을 돌보고, 밭을 일구고, 동물을 사육하여 수입을 창출해야 합니다. 처음에는 쉽지 않습니다. 당신에게는 몇 가지 간단한 도구, 100위안, 약간의 볍씨, 차밖에 없기 때문이죠. 하지만 포기하지 마세요! 놀라운 모험이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다. 당신과 같이 죄를 짓고 불운한 마을로 온 친구들을 만나게 될 것입니다.




계절의 변화는 채소와 꽃을 재배하는 가능성에 영향을 미칩니다. 각 동물들은 자기의 전용 공간을 요구합니다. 당신이 꿈꾸는 밭, 건물, 주변 환경을 만드세요. 모든 것을 만들고 개선할 수 있습니다. 작물 자동화 기술을 도입하고 마을을 아름답게 꾸리세요.




마을에서의 활동은 당신에게 행복과 지식을 가져다 줍니다. 안심한 황제는 당신이 제국군이 점령한 적들의 땅으로 갈 수 있도록 해줄 것입니다. 덕분에 새로운 기술에 대한 정보와 새로운 원료, 도구, 종자를 얻을 수 있을 것입니다. 지형이 어려울수록 독특한 성과를 거둘 가능성이 커집니다. 하지만 싸움 위험도 커집니다. 탐험 중에 얻은 모든 것은 당신의 것이며 마을을 건설하는 데 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신은 마을의 리더로서 발전 속도를 결정합니다.




Daomei Village에 사는 사람들은 모두 어떤 죄를 지었습니다. 마을 사람들과 교류할 때 그들의 신뢰를 얻을 수 있는 미션을 수행하게 될 것입니다. 당신은 또한 그들이 죄를 짓게 된 이유를 알게 될 것입니다.


Daomei Village는 완전히 독특하고 신비한 곳입니다. 당신은 이전 왕조의 흔적들과 마주치고, 독특한 중국 민속학과 귀신론에 대해 알게 됩니다. 중국 민속명절뿐 아니라 마을 주민들의 생일이 되면 축제를 진행하게 됩니다. 놓치지 마세요!

title: CleanFall
description:
게임 정보
역동적인 생태계– 포식자가 들끓는 환경에서 생물의 습성을 활용해 살아남아라.
전함 제작 시스템: 강력한 전함을 설계하고 커스터마이징하여 험난한 환경을 항해하세요.

title: Eko and the Bewitched Lands
description:
게임 정보
Eko and the Bewitched Lands is a single player action rogue-like. Explore and find the castle where the Dark Queen has imprisoned your friend and princess of the realm.
Customize your abilities and enhance your playstyle! Each run offers unique and powerful upgrades, letting you adapt, experiment, and evolve your strategies. Will you harness fire, water, or something entirely different?

title: Shoni Island
description:
게임 정보
After mysterious invaders thoroughly wreck their village, the villager leaders and a ragtag crew of survivors make a daring escape on a stolen boat. After days of drifting, they finally wash up on Shoni Island—a land full of peculiar characters, baffling puzzles, and unexpected challenges. Your mission? Adapt, build, and upskill to escape this fantastical island.
Immerse Yourself in a Living, Breathing Ecosystem
Shoni Island isn’t just a backdrop; it’s a dynamic world where NPCs have lives of their own—whether you’re watching or not. Get to know these unique, opinionated characters as you manage your settlement.
Build, Farm, and Worship with a Twist
Guide your villagers through essential tasks like construction, farming, and the delightfully bizarre practice of god worship. Balance their needs for food, resources, and social interaction while keeping the island’s moody gods—Gaia (earth), Faeris (fire), Simbi (water), and Zephyr (wind)—on your side. Their mood towards you can make or break your settlement.

title: Lost in Prayer
description:
게임 정보
Lost in Prayer is a turn-based roguelike true to its roots.
Expect all the qualities that make the genre so compelling, such as mind-twisting tactical decisions and expansive build options.
High replay value, rewarding progression and tough challenges awaits.
Procedurally generated levels ensure no two runs are the same.
Explore Hell and Heaven each with their dedicated enemies, encounters, and environment.
Unique skill trees that offer a variety of playstyles.
Loot weapons and armor with dedicated abilities to widen your tactical options.
Permadeath keeps tension high, but if you die…

title: Explory Story
description:
게임 정보

Our highly detailed worlds involve beautiful hand-drawn pixel scenery and thoughtful stories. The text on the floor can be interacted with, leading to a huge variety of effects and experiences. Reading and engaging with the text are crucial for progressing through the puzzles. Additionally, many secret interactions and hidden locations are spread out throughout the game.


Progressing through each level will involve cleverly interacting with objects and text. In some cases, you will be tasked with restoring context to a sentence; in other cases, you will be crafting entirely new and highly variable phrases.


Explory Story contains a boss at the end of each Act. That means 4+ entirely unique boss fights with unique mechanics and challenges. These can be undertaken alone or together with a friend. Additionally, each boss has variants that you can access by engaging with the story.

title: Primal Fray
description:
게임 정보
Primal Fray는 턴제 전략 로그라이트 게임입니다. 전투는 절차적으로 생성된 육각형 기반의 하늘에 떠있는 섬에서 이루어집니다. 당신은 유닛을 사용하여 적군을 기습하고 처치할 수 있습니다.
강력한 보스를 물리치세요
독특한 메커니즘을 가진 여러 보스가 등장합니다. 당신은 그들을 뛰어넘을 수 있을까요? 아니면 완벽한 팀을 구성하여 보스를 물리칠 수 있을까요? 가능성은 무한하지만, 한 가지 확실한 점은… 쉽지 않을 거라는 것입니다.

title: ASMR Food Experience: Prologue
description:
게임 정보





ASMR Food Experience: Prologue는 ASMR Food Experience 정식 버전의 일부이며 완전 무료입니다. 가장 중요한 점은 프롤로그를 통해 게임의 세계에 들어갈 수 있으므로 최종 제품 출시 전에 완전히 준비할 수 있다는 것입니다!

ASMR(자율 감각 쾌락 반응)이란 특정 자극에 노출되어 발생하는 머리와 목, 어깨를 맴도는 기분 좋은 찌릿찌릿한 느낌입니다. 일반적으로 이런 종류의 반응을 유발하는 요인은 시각, 촉각 또는 청각 감각입니다. ASMR Food Experience에서는 두 가지 유형의 자극인 청각과 시각의 결합을 주로 다룹니다!

당신만의 식당을 운영하세요!
ASMR Food Experience에서 당신은 작은 식당의 주인이 됩니다. 이 시뮬레이터에서 해야 할 일 중 하나는 고객 서비스입니다. 알맞게 배달하고 청소하며 표본을 관리하고 식당을 최상의 상태로 유지해야 합니다. 이는 매장의 전반적인 평가를 좌지우지하며 관심과 손님 수 및 팁을 늘릴 수 있습니다.

당신만의 원칙으로 식당을 꾸며 보세요. 아시아풍으로 꾸미고 싶으신가요? 아니면 지중해풍 장식에 더 관심이 가시나요? 우리 시뮬레이터에서는 매장을 취향에 딱 맞게 운영할 수 있습니다. 벽을 장식하고 테이블도 바꿔 보고 식당 안팎에 어울리는 액세서리를 놓아 보세요! 시간이 흐르면서 손님들에게 점점 더 인기가 많아질 테니 식당 확장을 고려해야 합니다.

ASMR Food Experience에는 평온과 흥분, 스트레스 해소 등 아주 매력적인 반응을 경험할 수 있는 수많은 소리가 있습니다. 자연과 요리, 청소, 길거리의 대화 소리 등 게임에서 들을 수 있는 소리를 완전히 제어할 수 있습니다. 이 놀라운 시뮬레이터에서 당신을 위한 소리를 찾아보세요!

title: Ogrüuk
description:
게임 정보
Ogrüuk is a 3D platformer stealth game where ogres have captured all your dogs! You must save them before their cooking pot is at the right temperature!
Sneak between monsters and keep away from their lights or you'll also be their dinner!
Key features:
Stealth: sneak between ogres and cursed lamps
Mystical powers: run faster or be invisible for a short period of time!
Hide from the light by crouching down.
Multiple levels with increasing difficulty
Many dogs to save!
Explore a dangerous and mysterious world

description:
게임 정보
소개
코드 네임: 알테온은 스토리 위주의 RPG 게임입니다.
턴제 전투를 통해 단서를 수집하고, 퍼즐을 풀어 막힌 길을 나아가고, 우주 마피아 터스트를 찾아 당신의 머리를 가져오세요.

title: Chubby Cats
description:
게임 정보
Feed the cats, conquer the islands, and upgrade your delicious creations!
In the world of Chubby Cats, the cats are not only hungry but also incredibly picky! Your mission is to place various islands, collect ingredients, cook dishes, and satisfy their demands within a limited time. As you progress through the levels, you'll face even greater challenges!
🟢 Creative island placement with endless strategy!
Strategically place different-shaped islands on the map, allowing them to interact and generate various ingredients! You need precise positioning to maximize production and keep all the cats happy and full.
🟡 Rotate & combine to craft unique dishes!
Special cats can help you rotate islands, altering resource connections and unlocking new possibilities! Additionally, by skillfully combining ingredients, you can upgrade basic food into gourmet meals—for example, turning an apple into a caramelized apple—making the cats even happier and earning higher scores!

title: Psychic Ward: Kill The Seven King Dragon
description:
게임 정보
Join the world as an agent of the Psychic Ward. Explore the strange surreal world and capture the immense world restructuring power of the Seven King Dragon. Use your mind as the weapon to take down the various threats through the history of this new world.
Find and learn new psychic techniques to fight through numerous enemies and boss fights. Explore the lore of this world through the numerous characters that you can encounter. Made decisions leading to the ultimate ending of this new story.

Psychic Ward: Kill The Seven King Dragon is a First Person Surreal Action Adventure game with multiple endings and require important decision making. The game is single player and involved combat against numerous types of enemies and features dodging and shooting mechanics.
autokwd: Psychic Ward: Kill The Seven King Dragon

title: Movierooms - Cinema Management
description:
게임 정보

Enter the wondrous world of cinema management in this thrilling new Tycoon! Explore the times and places that made the big screen what it is today. From the 1900s until today, choose and program movies, create projection rooms and facilities to make your establishment the finest in town, and create a unique experience for your customers!





1. WHAT’S ON TONIGHT?


Today, the choice is yours! Explore a rich, varied movie selection and curate the best fit for your cinema and spectators. Take into account ratings, reviews, cinematographic categories, and available equipment. Choose the perfect time to screen your movie. Days of the week and time of the day will influence attendance and will require planning in advance.



A fine establishment like yours requires the finest team. Carefully pick your hires and keep them happy to get the best out of them. Manage cashiers, janitors, projectionists, and other jobs exclusive to the level's time and place!



Build, decorate, and place movie posters all over your cinema using the building tool. Make this place your own by creating a unique brand and recreating what you love about cinema.





Build up the reputation of your cinema through multimedia advertisements and exceptional quality of service. Decoration, hygiene, movies, staff members, and more will be your tools to build a solid impression on your clients and attract cinema VIPs. Invest in technological research to make your business a state-of-the-art theater. Create your cinema empire from scratch by learning from the most emblematic characters in the history of this industry.





Do you want even more? Have some fun in the ! There, you can play with every piece of equipment available in the game to create a unique place. Unlock extra skins and movies through the story mode, and manage your cinema without any time restrictions!




The history of cinema has been turned upside down! Directors, actors, film celebrities have disappeared to reappear in totally different eras: you have to convince them to return to their era, otherwise their films will disappear forever. The fate of the film industry is in your hands, but fortunately you are not alone. Gaspard, an animated Oscar-like statuette, will guide you through the history of cinema and teach you the business of running a movie theatre, from its roots to success. Come on, there's no time to lose!

title: OH？ME
description:
게임 정보
"Wipe the Tomb and Wait – OH?ME" – A journey to find yourself in a maze where memory and reality intertwine.
When familiar streets and alleys fragment, and the past merges with the present, you’ll wander through a space that feels both unreal and real.
This is a pixel-art puzzle game about growth, memories, and farewells. You play as a ghost, suspended between reality and recollection, exploring the houses, streets, and unsaid words from your past. The maze-like map is filled with traces of your childhood, and objects and scenes serve as vessels for time. Hidden clues guide you toward different endings.
You may walk steadily into the future, find warmth in memories, or lose yourself in the cracks of time… but no matter the path, the journey’s end depends on your choices.
"The past is never finished, and the future has yet to begin." – Are you ready to set out?

title: Forklift Driving Simulator VR
description:
게임 정보
Forklift is a useful and powerful industrial truck used to lift and move materials over short distances, also called lift truck, fork truck, fork hoist, and forklift truck. Forklifts have become an indispensable piece of equipment in manufacturing and warehousing. Along with forklifts, the game also includes pallet trucks, reach trucks, and VNA, allowing you to experience a wide range of industrial equipment.
Up for a real forklift gaming experience? We worked really hard and thoroughly to bring you great forklift simulator realistic graphics in one of the best forklift games, now including pallet trucks, reach trucks, and VNA for a complete experience.
REAL WAREHOUSE EXPERIENCE Not only do you need to ride the forklift, but you'll also need to manually move boxes like in a real warehouse. Be careful in how you manage the forklift; you can cause different problems in this realistic experience. Plus, there's a free-room where you can choose 'Mission Generate Random,' and a truck will arrive to unload or load pallets, adding an extra layer of excitement.

title: Secret Paws - Cozy Offices
description:
게임 정보
Secret Paws - Cozy Offices는 3D 숨은그림찾기 게임으로, 아늑한 사무실에 숨겨진 고양이를 찾는 것이 당신의 임무입니다.

서랍과 캐비닛을 열고 물건을 움직여 가장 예상치 못한 숨겨진 장소를 발견하세요. 사무실의 모든 구석에는 놀라움과 도전이 가득하며, 세밀하게 설계된 아이소메트릭 3D 환경을 탐험할 수 있습니다.
특징

거의 500마리의 숨겨진 고양이: 모든 색상, 크기 및 성격의 고양이를 찾아보세요. 😺
비밀 고양이: 독특한 숨겨진 장소에서 특별한 고양이를 발견하세요. 💡
세부적인 상호작용: 가구를 열고, 물건을 움직이고, 환경과 상호작용하세요. 😻
