title: Our Freedom: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
윌리엄의 발자취를 따라가 보세요. 그는 전쟁, 상실, 그리고 생존을 위한 싸움으로 형성된 평범한 사람입니다. 비극의 재에서, 당신은 지도자로 떠오르고, 잔인한 습격을 피한 생존자들을 이끌게 됩니다. 당신의 임무는 제로에서 시작해 번영하는 정착지를 만들어내고, 사람들에게 집, 일자리, 음식, 그리고 안전을 제공하며, 다가오는 위협에 대비할 수 있도록 그들을 준비시키는 것입니다.

2010년대와 2020년대의 사랑받는 RPG에서 영감을 얻은 이 게임은 아늑하면서도 동적인 분위기를 제공합니다. 풍부한 이야기와 몰입감 있는 시스템이 결합되어, 향수와 혁신이 완벽하게 어우러집니다.
프롤로그
프롤로그를 통해 주인공 윌리엄에게 일어난 사건과 이야기를 이해해 보세요! 오픈 월드, 흥미로운 퀘스트, 그리고 무한 샌드박스가 당신을 기다리고 있습니다.
정착지 건설
작게 시작해 당신의 정착지를 번영하는 피난처로 성장시키세요. 집, 농장, 밀, 광산, 작업장, 방어 시설을 건설하고, 커지는 공동체의 요구를 충족시킬 새로운 건물을 잠금 해제하세요. 전략적인 계획이 중요합니다. 확장을 준비하고 사람들의 번영을 보장하세요.
전투 시스템
도시 건설과 액션 RPG 게임플레이의 완벽한 조화를 경험해 보세요. 검을 들고 대규모 전투를 이끌며, 성을 점령하고 정착지를 방어하세요. 에픽 토너먼트에 참여해 자신의 용기를 증명하고, 귀중한 보상을 얻으세요.
정착지가 번창하는 데 필요한 모든 것을 건설하고, 단련하며, 창조하세요! 필수 도구부터 강력한 무기까지, 모든 아이템은 도시의 생존과 방어에서 중요한 역할을 합니다.






윌리엄을 당신이 이상적인 영웅으로 만들어 보세요. 캐릭터의 외모를 디자인하고, 그의 능력과 정착지의 상태에 영향을 미치는 갑옷, 무기, 액세서리로 장착하세요. 강력한 부적과 반지를 장착하여 속성을 향상시키세요.
생명과 세부사항이 가득한 세계에 몰입하세요. 마을 사람들이 일상적인 작업을 하는 모습과 동물들이 자연 속을 돌아다니는 모습을 지켜보세요. 도로나 정착지에서든, 매력적이고 개성 있는 세계를 발견할 수 있습니다.


전설을 창조하고, 사람들을 이끌며, 모든 역경을 뚫고 번영하는 세계를 건설하세요. 당신의 여정은 여기서 시작됩니다!

title: Arachnoid
description:
게임 정보
Arachnoid is an intense survival horror game where moving into an abandoned home turns into a nightmare. Clean the house by picking up trash, move boxes inside to unpack, and drive your car to complete various tasks. At first, it's just an old house with a few creaks and shadows. But as the days pass, you realize you're not alone - something is watching, crawling, waiting. The house is infested with giant, intelligent spiders, and they are not in a hurry to reveal themselves. Run from the giant spiders, until you find a way to fight them. Finding a shotgun, you are able to find and carry ammo to fight against these monsters.
Uncover the dark mystery behind the infestation while solving puzzles and completing quests to survive. But as the horror escalates, so does the fight. After finding a shotgun with limited ammo, you'll have to decide when to run, when to hide, and when to face the nightmare head-on. The spiders aren't just lurking in the corners - they scale wall crawl across ceilings, and hunt in groups.
With a slow-burning atmosphere that builds into heart-pounding terror, Arachnoid will test your nerves. Will you make it through, or will the spiders claim their next victim?

title: Off Road Together
description:
게임 정보
도전적인 지형과 장애물

좁은 길, 가파른 경사면, 진흙으로 덮인 깊은 길이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다. 올바른 전략을 결정하고 팀과 협력하여 불가능해 보이는 지점까지 도달하세요.
차량 유지 관리 및 커스터마이징

오프로드의 스타가 되기 위해 4x4 차량의 유지 관리를 소홀히 하지 마세요! 타이어 선택부터 서스펜션 업그레이드까지, 성능을 배가하고 지형을 지배하세요.
캠핑과 레크리에이션

길고 피곤한 운전 후에는 자연의 품에서 캠핑을 즐겨보세요. 모닥불 주위에 모여 에너지를 모으고 다음 도전적인 스테이지를 위한 코스를 설정하세요.
전략적 경로 계획

가속 페달을 밟는 것만으로는 충분하지 않습니다! 까다로운 코스에서 속도, 연료, 지구력 사이의 균형을 유지하도록 계획을 잘 세워야 합니다. 타이밍이 맞으면 어떤 장애물도 여러분을 방해할 수 없습니다.
솔로 또는 팀 플레이

솔로 운전 실력을 시험해 보거나 4인 협동 모드에서 친구들과 힘을 합쳐 보세요. 팀 정신은 가장 위험한 트랙에서도 차이를 만듭니다.

오프로드 투게더와 함께 엔진을 시동하고 자연을 거스르며 오프로드 열정의 한계를 뛰어넘어 보세요!

title: Alliance Peacefighter
description:
게임 정보
Alliance Peacefighter is a linear, story-driven space sim in the style of the 90s classics. As a newly qualified Alliance pilot, you find yourself caught up in a plot to break the fragile peace between two galactic super powers.
Take control of the Alliance's most advanced starfighter in a thrilling story-driven campaign.
Fast-paced first-person combat, with full control over your ship's power and shield distribution.
Clear, diegetic UI provides critical information at a glance.
Fight alongside an elite squad of quirky alien teammates. Then relax in the ship's bar.
Built for both VR and traditional monitors, with full support for motion controllers, HOTAS joysticks, gamepads and mouse/keyboard. The Steam Deck is also fully supported (official verification still pending).
Alliance Peacefighter is a tribute to the golden age of space sims, and a love letter to the people who grew up with them.

title: Galactic Simulator2: Stargate
description:
게임 정보
갤럭틱 시뮬레이터 2: 스타게이트는 페르미의 역설과 대필터 이론에서 영감을 받은 Roguelite 게임입니다. 우주선을 조종하고, 자원을 모으며, 비콘을 탐험하고, 스타게이트를 건설하세요. 다른 문명을 발견하거나 별을 식민지화하세요.
페르미 역설
현재(2025년 기준), 외계 생명체가 지구를 방문했다는 신뢰할 만한 증거는 없습니다.
“그들은 어디에 있는가?”
드레이크 방정식
N = R* × Fp × Ne × Fl × Fi × Fc × L
    N：은하에서 감지 가능한 외계 문명의 수
    R*：은하 내 별 형성 속도
    Fp：행성계를 가진 별의 비율
    Ne：유기 생명체가 살 수 있는 환경을 가진 태양계 내 행성 수
    Fl：생명이 나타날 가능성이 있는 행성의 비율
    Fi：지능적 생명체가 나타날 가능성이 있는 비율
    Fc：탐지 가능한 신호를 방출하는 문명의 확률
    L：문명의 생존 기간
드레이크 방정식은 외계 문명의 존재 가능성을 이해하는 데 도움을 줍니다. 갤럭틱 시뮬레이터 2: 스타게이트는 이 방정식의 모든 요소를 구현합니다.
대여과설
대여과설은 생명이 최초의 생화학적 기원(abiogenesis)에서부터 카다셰프 척도(Kardashev Scale)에서 가장 높은 수준에 도달하는 과정까지의 발전 과정에서, 탐지 가능한 외계 생명체를 극도로 희귀하게 만드는 장벽(여과기)이 존재한다는 아이디어입니다.
이 이론에 따라, 갤럭틱 시뮬레이터 2: 스타게이트는 다음과 같은 대여과기(진화 단계)를 정의합니다:
적합한 항성계와 잠재적으로 거주 가능한 행성
유기 분자 
원핵세포
진핵세포
다세포 생물

title: Many Nights a Whisper
description:
게임 정보
Ten years ago, you were chosen to perform a ritual.
Many Nights a Whisper is a meditative third-person archery game. Under the gentle guidance of your mentor, you will train to land an impossibly distant shot. Practice tirelessly, honing your skill for the sacred ceremony that will shape the future of your people. Succeed, and their wishes will come true, bringing a decade of prosperity. Should you fail, ten years of calamity will follow, and their hopes will be lost to the winds.
Ah, and you only have one shot.
No pressure.
Short and thought-provoking
Playtime: 50-75 minutes. Delve into the routine of the Dreamer, the person chosen to perform this critical ceremony. Engage with your mentor in warm and intimate discussions. Listen to the townsfolk at the Confession Wall, weigh their whispers, and decide whether to grant their wishes.
Test your marksmanship
Master the sacred slingshot, a mystical device strung with human hair. Carefully aim, adjust for distance, and land fireballs into ancient chalices scattered across a ruin-sewn archipelago.

title: Boat Together
description:
게임 정보
Paddle through the water with your friends!
Are you ready for a fun-filled journey on kayaks or boats? In this game, where you can play with up to 8 friends, you'll need to paddle well—because controlling your boat won’t be so easy!
Explore the islands!
Explore and discover islands with new biomes as you navigate through dangerous paths. Remember, each new biome offers a unique experience, and reaching the next island will always be more challenging!

title: The EverFloating Island
description:
게임 정보
부유 에너지 세계에서 살아남아라 – 나만의 하늘 섬을 건설하자!
이 게임은 무역, 애완동물들 번식, 생존, 전투가 결합된 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
신비로운 바다 위의 세계에서 나만의 하늘 섬을 만들어 보세요!
부유 에너지 세계에서 생존하고 하늘 섬을 발전시키자!
이곳은 바다와 하늘 섬만이 존재하는 세계이며, 부유 에너지가 생존의 열쇠입니다!
당신의 목표는 하늘 섬이 추락하지 않도록 유지하는 것이며, 무역, 전투, 임무 수행을 통해
귀중한 부유석을 획득하고 나만의 하늘 제국을 건설하세요!
수백 가지의 상품을 거래하며 무역 거물이 되어라!
의뢰를 받아 다양한 임무를 수행하라!
약탈자들을 물리치거나, 해적이 되어 자원을 강탈할 수도 있다!
최강의 애완동물들을 번식시켜 하늘 섬을 방어하라!
이 세계에서 애완동물들은 단순한 친구가 아닙니다. 전투에서 가장 든든한 동료가 됩니다!
독특한 스킬과 강화 시스템으로 최강의 애완동물 군단을 만들자!
번식을 통해 더욱 강한 혈통을 계승하고 궁극의 신수를 탄생시키자!
하늘 섬을 건설하고 강화하여 완벽한 생존 기지를 구축하라!
새로운 시설을 해금하여 하늘 섬의 기능을 확장하자!
부유 퍼니스는 부유 코어에 연결됩니다. 다양한 부유 크리스탈을 사용하여 부유 에너지를 생성합니다.
미지의 세계를 탐험하고 부유 조류를 견뎌내며 약탈자들의 위협에 맞서라!
게임 특징
쉽고 직관적인 무역 시스템 – 자유롭게 경제를 성장시키세요
귀여운 애완동물들과 함께하는 전투 – 적들을 물리치세요!
다양한 시설 해금 – 하늘 섬을 더욱 발전시키세요
전략적인 부유 퍼니스 시스템 – 자원 관리와 배치 능력을 시험하세요!
확장되는 세계 – 새로운 시설을 해금하고 더 강력한 애완동물들을 발견하세요!
하늘 섬 생존 도전에 준비되었나요? 부유 에너지 세계로 뛰어들어 나만의 하늘 섬을 건설하세요!

title: The Hilltop Funeral
description:
게임 정보
"Help Wanted: Cherry Hill Cemetery seeks an individual for part-time work. Position: Pallbearer… Huh? What’s a pallbearer?
Duties: Carrying caskets… Oh.
Apply in person after dusk… Hmm… seems worth a shot!"
—The Part-Timer
Control Two Characters-Solo or Local Co-op!
Coordinate your left hand and right hand or work with a friend, help the two pallbearers carry the casket to the top!
Goofy Ragdoll Physics
Don’t drop the body on the ground! Tilt the casket, toss him around, and make sure the “client” stays well and happy. Pick up some garbage along the way—if you did drop him, just stitch him back together. Repair the casket along the way if a piece or two falls apart—it’s a fragile one.

title: Eternal Siege
description:
게임 정보
The king has exiled his brother for treason (or so we are told). You are an army General returning from a long trip, tasked with defending the kings city against his brothers attacks. In this strategical resource management tower defense, you will die...Eventually. There is no end to the eternal waves of attacks, but how long can you survive? Can you outlive the human era and reach the leaderboard?
Manage resources and upgrades
Invent the fastest, most efficient resource management path. Maybe even sacrifice some early towers to get upgrades faster...at your own risk.
Never-ending chaos
There are no wave timers, no breaks - the armies keep on coming, and they will never stop until they take over the city.

title: Gamba Gun
description:
게임 정보
Gamba Gun is the idiotic fusion of top-down shooter and deck building rogue-likes.
THIS AIN'T NO BABY GAME FOR BABIES!
In Gamba Gun, your weapons are slot machines, and you must gamble your life. The recipe to success is 100% skill, 100% decision-making, and 1000% dumb luck!
(That's 1100% More per 100%!)
((ᴛʜᴀᴛ's 12x ᴠᴀʟᴜᴇ!))
IT'S TWO GUNS,
Wield dual revolvers that have the special capacity to fire nonsensical ammunition. Oh yeah, every time you reload them, their ammo magically shuffles.
A BUNCH OF BULLETS,

title: Psychic Ward: Kill The Seven King Dragon
description:
게임 정보
Join the world as an agent of the Psychic Ward. Explore the strange surreal world and capture the immense world restructuring power of the Seven King Dragon. Use your mind as the weapon to take down the various threats through the history of this new world.
Find and learn new psychic techniques to fight through numerous enemies and boss fights. Explore the lore of this world through the numerous characters that you can encounter. Made decisions leading to the ultimate ending of this new story.

Psychic Ward: Kill The Seven King Dragon is a First Person Surreal Action Adventure game with multiple endings and require important decision making. The game is single player and involved combat against numerous types of enemies and features dodging and shooting mechanics.
autokwd: Psychic Ward: Kill The Seven King Dragon

title: Library of Meialia
description:
게임 정보
Library of Meialia is a 2D pixel art rogue-like adventure where you play as Amlos, a curious young dragon navigating the sprawling, enigmatic Library of Meialia—a place where you don’t quite belong. As you journey through the endless halls, you’ll face off against the library's sentinels and ancient beasts long sealed away. Along the way, forge friendships with diverse characters, uncover hidden secrets, and grow stronger with every battle. Immerse yourself in this meticulously hand-crafted pixel library, where every corner offers both opportunity and peril, all set to a beautifully composed soundtrack.
Soar Through the Library—Until You Can't…
As Amlos, the young dragon, your wings allow you to fly effortlessly through the library, scale walls and explore unknown corridors . But beware—some rooms will ground you, forcing you to tread carefully with your claws.
Knowledge is Power
The Library of Meialia is the ultimate center of magical knowledge. On your quest to master Aethium magic, you’ll discover magic books and pages scattered throughout, each offering new skills to aid your journey. With over 70 skills to unlock, the possibilities are endless. Take your discoveries to the Aethiumeter and use your newfound powers to conquer any obstacle in your path.
Unleash the Sealed Beasts
Each level of the library contains terrifying monsters, sealed away for students to study. But you’ll face them head-on, battling through their varied attack patterns and relentless bullet hells. You'll need to defeat them to prove your worth and advance deeper into the library. But remember—greater dangers lie in wait at each level's end…
No Two Explorations Are Alike
The Library of Meialia is never the same. Thanks to its random map generation, each playthrough in the library offers a fresh experience. New paths, new challenges, and new treasures await every time you step inside. Grab your magic books and prepare for the unexpected!

title: Spiritual Bond ~Breaking the curse
description:
게임 정보



The core gameplay of this game is a "text-based puzzle visual novel".
You'll need to search the cursed environment for hidden "Reifu" cards.
By combining these cards, you'll gradually uncover key events to break the curse.
Afterward, you'll be able to view memory fragments revealed by the "Yuan Shadow".
Through your choices, you can change their fate and guide them to "Higan"!
autokwd: Spiritual Bond ~Breaking the curse, Intertwining fates~,靈緣 ~化謎解咒，緣影交織~

title: TypInc.
description:
게임 정보
Typinc. is a roguelike deckbuilding typing game.
Complete typing jobs presented to you to unlock perks which affects the score you make.
                        Features:
Typing stats such as Best Typing Speed, Average of Last 10 and Accuracy. 
Roguelike Deckbuilding
Unlock different perks for different affects

title: Burial of Shortcake
description:
게임 정보
"The Burial of Shortcake" is an unpredictable story.  It is a new visual novel with characters which are created/designed by voice actor Nozomi Sasaki, whose "expressiveness" shines throughout her career as a performer.
You can click on the screen to continue to read the story.
Game Features
Genre: Crime suspense, visual novel
Playing time: 5 to 7 hours
Options: none. One way
Story
"Sweat, dirt, blood. It all goes in my mouth and makes me want to throw up."
One night, the main character, Kisetsu, sneaks into a mountain forest in the middle of the night in order to bury the corpse for a certain reason.
A snow shovel.
A shopping cart from a supermarket.
And then he wrapped something in a blue sheet and hid it - [that].
Surrounded by “them”, he started digging a hole, was covered with all the sweat and swallowing blood and dirt.
And then...
“What is that…?”
He just realized that there is no end beyond the hole and beyond the tragedy.
This is about “the world” beyond the tragedy.
Crime Suspense Visual Novel--"The Burial of Shortcake"

title: Diner Bros 2
description:
게임 정보
HECTIC KITCHEN ACTION
Are you ready to put your culinary skills to the test?  Serve up delicious dishes in the fast-paced, fun, and frantic Diner Bros 2.  Open a bustling restaurant in this chaotic local co-op experience: Juggle orders, cook tasty meals, and race against the clock to satisfy your hungry customers!
KNOW YOUR CUSTOMERS
In Diner Bros 2, it's not just the orders that get crazy — it’s also the Unique Customers who will keep you on your toes! Each character has their own quirks and demands that will test your multitasking skills:
No loitering! The Teenager thinks she can stay all day!
Always on the move, the Jogger wants their food quickly - and we mean fast!
Watch out for the sneaky Punk looking for an opportunity to dine and dash!
... and many more! It's up to you to keep the orders flowing!
UPGRADE YOUR RESTAURANT
Purchase New Equipment: as your diner grows, you'll need better tools to keep up with the increasing demand.
Optimize Your Kitchen Layout: Efficiency is key when it comes to earning cash, so make sure your kitchen is set up for smooth operation.  Or don't!
Expand Your Restaurant: Can you impress the Food Critic and earn the coveted 3-star award?

title: Cyber Climb
description:
게임 정보
CYBER CLIMB blends fast-paced movement shooter with strategic factory building.
Like Satisfactory + Titanfall 2.

Your objectives are simple: kill robots, finish quests, build a rocket to get home from Mars. Along the way, you'll encounter increasingly difficult enemies, challenging environments, and a variety of obstacles designed to test your skills.
With inspiration from games like RoboQuest, Deadlink, and Deus Ex, CYBER CLIMB delivers dynamic combat and fluid movement mechanics. Use a grappling hook, double jumps, and air dashes to outmaneuver enemies and navigate tricky platforms. Choose from 7 different weapons, upgrade your abilities with a roguelike card system, and make every run unique as the challenge intensifies the longer you play.
Key Features:
7 unique weapons to discover and master
Factory building: crafting, conveyor belts, batteries, etc.
Movement mechanics like grappling hooks, double jumps, and air dashes for fast-paced traversal
Skills such as throwing grenades and creating bounce pads for creative combat
Roguelike upgrade system: buy new cards and power-ups with in-game currency
Dynamic difficulty: the longer the run, the harder the game becomes
Box stacking to create exploration opportunities
Immersive sim elements that reward experimentation and strategy
CYBER CLIMB is currently in heavy development by a solo developer, with regular updates and new content planned until the release. Feedback from players is highly appreciated!

title: Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a scenic horse ranch to experience the joy and pride of caring for a world-class stable of horses in Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition.
With the help of a friendly mentor, you’ll raise charming foals, care for and train a stable of unique horses, and compete to become a champion racer and rider.
BUILD A BOND
Being an equestrian is about so much more than winning the next race. Get to know your horses and form close bonds through realistic and fulfilling interactions.
Feed your horses their favorite treats, keep them well-groomed, and give them a scratch in just the right spot to see them stretch out their necks in delight!
No task list — Enjoy time with your horses at your own pace.
MANAGE YOUR STABLES
autokwd: Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition

title: Looping Art Museum
description:
게임 정보
Reveal the memories through "Spot the Difference."
Escape from the endless loop in a single-path maze.

This is a single-player adventure game drawn with flickering lights and pixel art.

Game Description
This game is a side-scrolling adventure game.
You can move right or left, but you will always end up returning to the same place.

There is only one way to move forward. Carefully observe the paintings.
You will notice there’s a painting that differs slightly from the one you saw before.

If you feel something is off, take a stop and look at the painting.
If it has changed, congratulations! You have taken a step forward, and now you are ready to look for the next change.

As you discover changes one by one, the path forward will open up.
Now, you are ready for your journey in the looping art museum.

The game is controlled using only the keyboard.

The Character can only move to the left or right.
A key or Left Arrow key: Move left
D key or Right Arrow key: Move right

There are also parts where you will be required to enter text.
Please use the keyboard to input the word.
On a cold day, the protagonist visits the art gallery for the first time in a while.
She got attracted to one specific painting.
As time passes while they are fascinated, people around her disappear.
But when trying to leave, she noticed something strange.
Whether she goes back or forth, the same painting appears in front of her again and again and again...

This is a looping art museum.

Clever "Mr.Cat" talks to you and tells you to play "Spot the Difference" in the museum.
You have to observe the paintings closely and start naming them.
Find the paintings which are changing stealthily.
Can you escape from the loop by repeating "Spot the Difference"?
And what secrets lie hidden in the looping art museum?
Name: Nekko
A mechanical engineer turned indie game developer.
For some reason, I am burning through my savings day and night, devoting myself to game development.
Obsessed with the charm of pixel art, they endlessly tweak the positions of pixels if left alone.

title: Nuclear Sub: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
Nuclear Sub: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game.

Dive into the unique story of the nuclear submarine crew. The government sends its best armed and best tactically prepared undersea crew to face hostile units in the far depths of the cold North.

It seems that everything is already in place that would be needed for success, an excellent crew, a great ship, the only thing missing is a person who has the tactical sense to handle naval battles. You need to control the morale of the sailors, manage weapons and food supplies, and constantly check the technical condition of the submarine, especially its nuclear reactor. Will you prove yourself in this role?


Manage basic resources such as indoor oxygen levels and the correct functioning of the nuclear reactor. Monitor the availability of electricity and check if navigation and mechanical systems are working properly. The better the condition of the ship you provide, the happier the sailors will be and the more efficiently they will perform their tasks. Remember to keep morale high, but also don't forget the realistically represented hierarchy on the submarine directly contributes to maintaining order among the crew.


When going to deep waters with a nuclear submarine, you must remember to control its propulsion. A nuclear reactor requires constant attention and checking of its technical condition. If a malfunction occurs, close off the relevant parts of the ship to cut off damaged or flooded sections.


Explore the oceans of the open world, looking out for enemy units. Complete missions assigned by your superiors and assign tasks to your subordinates. Destroy enemy ships and raise the morale of your crew. A wide range of Cold War missile selections will allow you to win any battle of the many planned scenarios, and an advanced ship damage system will make the gameplay even more realistic.

Features:
- cold, open world of the North
- model of a 3 decks nuclear ship with realistically replicated separate compartments
- manage 80 sailors in the crew, who, thanks to artificial intelligence, behave accordingly to the level of satisfaction and good condition of the ship
- realistic ship damage system will supplement the gameplay with the necessary realism
- a campaign consisting of 10 diverse main missions and 20 side missions based on real scenarios
- possibility to upgrade your ship and equipment, thanks to the money earned for correctly completed missions
- Control your mission from different levels of view: TPP, FPP, map

title: Sit-Back Attack
description:
게임 정보
특징
음료수와 간식을 들고 편히 앉아 팀이 악의 무리를 처단하는 모습을 지켜보세요! 클래스 커스터마이징과 빌드 다양성에 중점을 둔 반유휴형 RPG입니다.
직면하게 될 과제를 해결하기 위해 수천 가지 빌드 옵션을 마음대로 사용할 수 있습니다!
모두 ZERO MTX로!!!!
60개 이상의 다양한 클래스, 500개 이상의 다양한 스킬, 무제한의 빌드 옵션을 갖추고 있어 4명의 영웅으로 구성된 팀이 300개가 넘는 몬스터, 보스, 울트라 보스를 물리칠 수 있습니다!
독특한 도전과 전략으로 재미있고 빠른 전투를 즐겨보세요.
속도 증가는 최대 20배까지 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다!
캐릭터 및 클래스 커스터마이징
팀을 더욱 강하게 만드는 방법을 결정하는 데 도움이 되는 전투, 통계 등의 모든 측면을 볼 수 있는 매우 심층적인 인터페이스입니다!
모든 클래스에는 고유한 캐릭터 아트와 고유한 기술, 강점 및 약점이 있습니다.
레벨업을 하면 원하는 방식으로 캐릭터를 구축하는 데 사용할 수 있는 능력치 포인트가 제공됩니다!
능력치와 플레이스타일을 크게 바꿀 수 있는 패시브 스킬!
애완동물 및 업적
4마리의 애완동물 중 1마리를 선택하여 팀을 강화하고 특수 공격을 사용할 시기를 제어할 수 있습니다. 기본 스텟도 파티를 강화시켜줍니다!
100개 이상의 성과. 달성할 때마다 애완동물의 레벨이 올라갑니다.
애완동물 레벨은 글로벌입니다. 새 게임을 시작하면 프레스티지 효과를 위해 해당 레벨이 상속됩니다!
펫 스킬은 수동으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 캐릭터의 패시브 스킬을 통해서도 향상될 수 있습니다!
레벨링 및 진행
레벨 상한은 500+입니다!
울트라 보스가 있는 도전적인 맵을 완료하여 모든 새로운 캐릭터 파워 등급(레벨 100, 200, 300 등...)을 잠금 해제해야 합니다!
우리가 찾을 수 있는 최고의 진행 균형을 제공하기 위해 엄격한 테스트를 거쳤습니다!

title: Primal Fray
description:
게임 정보
Primal Fray는 턴제 전략 로그라이트 게임입니다. 전투는 절차적으로 생성된 육각형 기반의 하늘에 떠있는 섬에서 이루어집니다. 당신은 유닛을 사용하여 적군을 기습하고 처치할 수 있습니다.
강력한 보스를 물리치세요
독특한 메커니즘을 가진 여러 보스가 등장합니다. 당신은 그들을 뛰어넘을 수 있을까요? 아니면 완벽한 팀을 구성하여 보스를 물리칠 수 있을까요? 가능성은 무한하지만, 한 가지 확실한 점은… 쉽지 않을 거라는 것입니다.

title: ASMR Food Experience: Prologue
description:
게임 정보





ASMR Food Experience: Prologue는 ASMR Food Experience 정식 버전의 일부이며 완전 무료입니다. 가장 중요한 점은 프롤로그를 통해 게임의 세계에 들어갈 수 있으므로 최종 제품 출시 전에 완전히 준비할 수 있다는 것입니다!

ASMR(자율 감각 쾌락 반응)이란 특정 자극에 노출되어 발생하는 머리와 목, 어깨를 맴도는 기분 좋은 찌릿찌릿한 느낌입니다. 일반적으로 이런 종류의 반응을 유발하는 요인은 시각, 촉각 또는 청각 감각입니다. ASMR Food Experience에서는 두 가지 유형의 자극인 청각과 시각의 결합을 주로 다룹니다!

당신만의 식당을 운영하세요!
ASMR Food Experience에서 당신은 작은 식당의 주인이 됩니다. 이 시뮬레이터에서 해야 할 일 중 하나는 고객 서비스입니다. 알맞게 배달하고 청소하며 표본을 관리하고 식당을 최상의 상태로 유지해야 합니다. 이는 매장의 전반적인 평가를 좌지우지하며 관심과 손님 수 및 팁을 늘릴 수 있습니다.

당신만의 원칙으로 식당을 꾸며 보세요. 아시아풍으로 꾸미고 싶으신가요? 아니면 지중해풍 장식에 더 관심이 가시나요? 우리 시뮬레이터에서는 매장을 취향에 딱 맞게 운영할 수 있습니다. 벽을 장식하고 테이블도 바꿔 보고 식당 안팎에 어울리는 액세서리를 놓아 보세요! 시간이 흐르면서 손님들에게 점점 더 인기가 많아질 테니 식당 확장을 고려해야 합니다.

ASMR Food Experience에는 평온과 흥분, 스트레스 해소 등 아주 매력적인 반응을 경험할 수 있는 수많은 소리가 있습니다. 자연과 요리, 청소, 길거리의 대화 소리 등 게임에서 들을 수 있는 소리를 완전히 제어할 수 있습니다. 이 놀라운 시뮬레이터에서 당신을 위한 소리를 찾아보세요!

title: OH？ME
description:
게임 정보
"Wipe the Tomb and Wait – OH?ME" – A journey to find yourself in a maze where memory and reality intertwine.
When familiar streets and alleys fragment, and the past merges with the present, you’ll wander through a space that feels both unreal and real.
This is a pixel-art puzzle game about growth, memories, and farewells. You play as a ghost, suspended between reality and recollection, exploring the houses, streets, and unsaid words from your past. The maze-like map is filled with traces of your childhood, and objects and scenes serve as vessels for time. Hidden clues guide you toward different endings.
You may walk steadily into the future, find warmth in memories, or lose yourself in the cracks of time… but no matter the path, the journey’s end depends on your choices.
"The past is never finished, and the future has yet to begin." – Are you ready to set out?

title: Digging the Forgotten Cave
description:
게임 정보
Explore the depths of the mountain, carve your own tunnels. Move at your own pace and listen to your instincts. Bring treasures to the surface and enhance your gear.
The mountain’s belly is vast, dig wherever you please. If your intuition guides you well, you’ll discover countless enigmatic chambers, corridors, and halls filled with riches. Once you’ve gained enough experience and gold, you’ll be able to purchase powerful tools. With these tools, you’ll finally be able to solve the mountain’s greatest secrets.
Now grab your pickaxe and head into the forgotten CAVE!

title: Ogrüuk
description:
게임 정보
Ogrüuk is a 3D platformer stealth game where ogres have captured all your dogs! You must save them before their cooking pot is at the right temperature!
Sneak between monsters and keep away from their lights or you'll also be their dinner!
Key features:
Stealth: sneak between ogres and cursed lamps
Mystical powers: run faster or be invisible for a short period of time!
Hide from the light by crouching down.
Multiple levels with increasing difficulty
Many dogs to save!
Explore a dangerous and mysterious world

턴제 전투를 통해 단서를 수집하고, 퍼즐을 풀어 막힌 길을 나아가고, 우주 마피아 터스트를 찾아 당신의 머리를 가져오세요.

title: Chubby Cats
description:
게임 정보
Feed the cats, conquer the islands, and upgrade your delicious creations!
In the world of Chubby Cats, the cats are not only hungry but also incredibly picky! Your mission is to place various islands, collect ingredients, cook dishes, and satisfy their demands within a limited time. As you progress through the levels, you'll face even greater challenges!
🟢 Creative island placement with endless strategy!
Strategically place different-shaped islands on the map, allowing them to interact and generate various ingredients! You need precise positioning to maximize production and keep all the cats happy and full.
🟡 Rotate & combine to craft unique dishes!
Special cats can help you rotate islands, altering resource connections and unlocking new possibilities! Additionally, by skillfully combining ingredients, you can upgrade basic food into gourmet meals—for example, turning an apple into a caramelized apple—making the cats even happier and earning higher scores!

title: Teacher Seduction
description:
게임 정보
Teacher Seduction is a kinetic visual novel with dating sim elements about a guy who studies computer science at university.

He likes math and has a crush on his math teacher Ms.Parker, but he can't spend any time with her because of his part-time job, which makes it impossible to have any activities other than classes.

However, when our hero finds out that Jill has recently started a relationship with a literature teacher from his university who is also a total jerk, he decides to quit his job and try to enter a math competition to win her heart while they spend time preparing for it.

Will he succeed and overcome all the problems, or has he risked everything for nothing and made his relationship with Ms.Parker worse? Let's find out!

This game includes:
• Dramatic story with romance and comedy elements.
• HD fully original artworks.
• ≈ 1 hour of content.
• Relaxing atmosphere.
• Soundtrack by Antti Luode.

title: Book Smugglers
description:
게임 정보
Join the courageous underground network of Book Smugglers in a grim decision-making, point-and-click, resource-management adventure as they risk everything to preserve their cultural heritage and ignite a flame of resistance.

Manage your resources
Strategically manage your limited supplies, such as food, tools, currency and forged documents. Your choices will determine the success of your missions and the safety of the precious literature you transport.


Make tough decisions
Experience the weight of your decisions as you balance risk and reward. Every choice has multiple outcomes that might influence your gameplay differently every time you play. Your choices will shape the Book Smugglers' destiny and leave a lasting impact on the pages of history.



Explore the intriguing phenomenon of book smuggling in a time of oppression in 19th-century Lithuania. Learn about the brave individuals who risked their lives to keep their cultural heritage alive and fight against the suppression of knowledge.

title: Öooo
description:
게임 정보
폭탄 애벌레의 대모험!
"Öooo"는 사랑스럽고 신비로운 탐험형 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임으로, 폭탄을 창의적으로 활용하는 방법을 발견하게 됩니다!
폭탄을 활용한 다양한 해결책!
폭탄을 사용하는 독창적인 방법을 발견하세요!

title: The Book of Aaru
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey in The Book of Aaru, an action-packed rogue-lite game with RPG elements. Discover a world where ancient Egypt has evolved beyond expectations, merging history, mythology, and advanced sci-fi technology. Play as fictional character Emily Sands, a daring explorer who mysteriously vanished while searching for the temple of Osiris in 1926. Cursed and stripped of humanity, you’ll navigate through intricately hand-crafted trap corridors, each presenting a unique challenge that demands diverse skills, precise timing, and adaptable strategies. Will you choose a dangerous path filled with treasures or a safer route with fewer rewards? The choice is yours!
Key Features:
Isometric Action Rogue-lite: Engage in fast-paced, tactical action gameplay from an isometric perspective.

title: Broken Reality 2000
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Broken Reality 2000 is a single player adventure game set in an ethereal metaverse called NATEM, that is full of quests, puzzles and light platforming. Explore diferent sites, make new friends and collect Likes to raise your popularity and earn access to new areas. Discover a wide set of tools, like a virus-slaying Katana, a net-surfing Hoverboard, a Camera to take beautiful pictures, and more, that will help you explore this colorful world!

title: 99 Fails
description:
게임 정보
99 Fails is a tight 2D precision platformer set in Zeebo's weird nightmare. You’ll test your rhythm, timing, and skill as enemies and the environment fight to break your flow!
A platforming game anyone can play, but very few can master!
Bizarre artful visions & monsters with music by David Wise!
Master three unique mechanics & race friends online to the finish!
Compete with everyone in an endless level online - there can be only one!

title: CleanFall
description:
게임 정보
역동적인 생태계– 포식자가 들끓는 환경에서 생물의 습성을 활용해 살아남아라.
전함 제작 시스템: 강력한 전함을 설계하고 커스터마이징하여 험난한 환경을 항해하세요.

title: Eko and the Bewitched Lands
description:
게임 정보
Eko and the Bewitched Lands is a single player action rogue-like. Explore and find the castle where the Dark Queen has imprisoned your friend and princess of the realm.
Customize your abilities and enhance your playstyle! Each run offers unique and powerful upgrades, letting you adapt, experiment, and evolve your strategies. Will you harness fire, water, or something entirely different?

title: Shoni Island
description:
게임 정보
After mysterious invaders thoroughly wreck their village, the villager leaders and a ragtag crew of survivors make a daring escape on a stolen boat. After days of drifting, they finally wash up on Shoni Island—a land full of peculiar characters, baffling puzzles, and unexpected challenges. Your mission? Adapt, build, and upskill to escape this fantastical island.
Immerse Yourself in a Living, Breathing Ecosystem
Shoni Island isn’t just a backdrop; it’s a dynamic world where NPCs have lives of their own—whether you’re watching or not. Get to know these unique, opinionated characters as you manage your settlement.
Build, Farm, and Worship with a Twist
Guide your villagers through essential tasks like construction, farming, and the delightfully bizarre practice of god worship. Balance their needs for food, resources, and social interaction while keeping the island’s moody gods—Gaia (earth), Faeris (fire), Simbi (water), and Zephyr (wind)—on your side. Their mood towards you can make or break your settlement.

title: Lost in Prayer
description:
게임 정보
Lost in Prayer is a turn-based roguelike true to its roots.
Expect all the qualities that make the genre so compelling, such as mind-twisting tactical decisions and expansive build options.
High replay value, rewarding progression and tough challenges awaits.
Procedurally generated levels ensure no two runs are the same.
Explore Hell and Heaven each with their dedicated enemies, encounters, and environment.
Unique skill trees that offer a variety of playstyles.
Loot weapons and armor with dedicated abilities to widen your tactical options.
Permadeath keeps tension high, but if you die…

title: Dice Gambit
description:
게임 정보
Dice Gambit은 저희가 소규모 제작사이기 때문에, 현재 계획상으로는 영어만 지원됩니다. 하지만 한국어에 대한 관심이 충분히 모인다면, 번역 지원에 대해 최선을 다하겠습니다!

title: Daomei Village
description:
게임 정보
Daomei Village




Daomei Village는 진기한 환경을 배경으로 한 매력적인 픽셀 아트 게임으로서 창의력을 자극합니다!


황제의 명령에 따라 당신은 Daomei Village로 와서 마을을 훌륭하게 복구하기 위한 임무를 수행합니다. 황제에게 바칠 공물을 요구하는 세리의 관심을 피할 수 없다는 것을 잊지 마세요. 그러므로 농장을 돌보고, 밭을 일구고, 동물을 사육하여 수입을 창출해야 합니다. 처음에는 쉽지 않습니다. 당신에게는 몇 가지 간단한 도구, 100위안, 약간의 볍씨, 차밖에 없기 때문이죠. 하지만 포기하지 마세요! 놀라운 모험이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다. 당신과 같이 죄를 짓고 불운한 마을로 온 친구들을 만나게 될 것입니다.




계절의 변화는 채소와 꽃을 재배하는 가능성에 영향을 미칩니다. 각 동물들은 자기의 전용 공간을 요구합니다. 당신이 꿈꾸는 밭, 건물, 주변 환경을 만드세요. 모든 것을 만들고 개선할 수 있습니다. 작물 자동화 기술을 도입하고 마을을 아름답게 꾸리세요.




마을에서의 활동은 당신에게 행복과 지식을 가져다 줍니다. 안심한 황제는 당신이 제국군이 점령한 적들의 땅으로 갈 수 있도록 해줄 것입니다. 덕분에 새로운 기술에 대한 정보와 새로운 원료, 도구, 종자를 얻을 수 있을 것입니다. 지형이 어려울수록 독특한 성과를 거둘 가능성이 커집니다. 하지만 싸움 위험도 커집니다. 탐험 중에 얻은 모든 것은 당신의 것이며 마을을 건설하는 데 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신은 마을의 리더로서 발전 속도를 결정합니다.




Daomei Village에 사는 사람들은 모두 어떤 죄를 지었습니다. 마을 사람들과 교류할 때 그들의 신뢰를 얻을 수 있는 미션을 수행하게 될 것입니다. 당신은 또한 그들이 죄를 짓게 된 이유를 알게 될 것입니다.


Daomei Village는 완전히 독특하고 신비한 곳입니다. 당신은 이전 왕조의 흔적들과 마주치고, 독특한 중국 민속학과 귀신론에 대해 알게 됩니다. 중국 민속명절뿐 아니라 마을 주민들의 생일이 되면 축제를 진행하게 됩니다. 놓치지 마세요!

title: Explory Story
description:
게임 정보

Our highly detailed worlds involve beautiful hand-drawn pixel scenery and thoughtful stories. The text on the floor can be interacted with, leading to a huge variety of effects and experiences. Reading and engaging with the text are crucial for progressing through the puzzles. Additionally, many secret interactions and hidden locations are spread out throughout the game.


Progressing through each level will involve cleverly interacting with objects and text. In some cases, you will be tasked with restoring context to a sentence; in other cases, you will be crafting entirely new and highly variable phrases.


Explory Story contains a boss at the end of each Act. That means 4+ entirely unique boss fights with unique mechanics and challenges. These can be undertaken alone or together with a friend. Additionally, each boss has variants that you can access by engaging with the story.

You have to go through this difficult path from a beginner to a seasoned stalker and uncover the mystery of your own father's disappearance!
T.D.Z. 4 The Heart of Pripyat is a game that will draw you in with its amazing atmosphere from the first seconds! Gray sky, rain, campfire dialogues with loyal stalker friends, mutants, anomalies are just a small part of what awaits you in this 1st-person action-adventure shooter! Explore the abandoned locations of the mysterious Exclusion Zone, shoot back mutants, search caches of ammunition and food, complete tasks of stalker friends and reach the very Pripyat to see the finale of this amazing story!
►Game Features◄

☢️ Convenient controls will appeal to everyone!
☢️ Stunning graphics!
☢️ Dynamic storyline!

title: Nightwatch at the Hopkins' Cliffside
description:
게임 정보
In Nightwatch at the Hopkins' Cliffside, you are a member of the Committee for Handling Illogical Phenomena (CHIP), tasked with investigating and eliminating reality-defying anomalies at remote cliff. Your assignment: monitor the house surroundings for one night and neutralize any disturbances that arise. However, as the clock ticks, the anomalies become more frequent, more dangerous, and most importantly, some of them will hunt you down. Will you survive until dawn?
Features

Survive the Night: Face a variety of anomalies, from subtle spatial distortions to alternate realities seeping into your world. Each anomaly you encounter will challenge your perception and push your sanity to the brink.

Explore the Hopkins' house: Navigate through a beautifully crafted, historically rich environment filled with hidden lore, clues, and secrets that unravel the history of the estate and its former resident.

Master the Artifact: Wield a powerful Tetrahedron, an artifact capable of detecting and neutralizing reality-bending phenomena. Use it wisely, as it must cooldown after each use.

Immersive Atmosphere: Experience haunting atmosphere with dynamic sound design, chilling ambient music, and detailed visual effects that bring the estate’s unsettling presence to life.

Uncover Hidden Lore: Discover letters, and other artifacts that reveal the truth behind the anomalies and their origins.
The story

Over the past few years, anomalies have started to emerge around the world. Initially, they were noticed by only a few, but soon their intensity began to escalate. As governments could no longer deny their existence, investigations commenced. It quickly became clear that these alternate realities posed at least a global threat.

Scientists from around the world are now working together to create the first tools capable of stopping these aberrations. As a member of CHIP, your mission is not only to survive, but also to uncover crucial information about these anomalies.

Prepare yourself for a night of suspense, mystery, and psychological horror. The Hopkins' Cliffside is waiting, and it’s anything but ordinary.

title: Cats & Dice
description:
게임 정보
Cats & Dice is a dice-building roguelike all about getting the right synergies to pull off crazy combos and attain as high a score as you possibly can.
The Cats (maneki-neko) are the mainstay of the game. Every Cat has its own passive ability that can affect how you approach a run. All Cats generate a dice unique to them at the start of each round (for instance there's a Cat that will create a dice with only four on all sides). There is no additional drawing of dice from your deck or the like. These dice are then played to get a score. Reach the target score and you'll win the round.
With more than 60 Cats (and more to come!) to choose from, the possibilities are endless.
There are various Items that can be equipped onto the Cats you own. These Items can add onto or even alter your Cat's passive abilities. Some grant additional effects onto the Cat's dice and allow you to customize it to your liking. These Items are not permanently attached to your Cats, so feel free to experiment and change your strategy.
The dice play as important a role as your Cats. You can get bonus points out of specific combination of dice. There's a number of rerolls per round you can use to reroll specific dice until you attain the desired outcome. Some dice can also have special effects that help in various ways, from adding scoring multiplier to gaining more rerolls.

title: Asphodelium
description:
게임 정보
Asphodelium is a melancholic slice-of-life boys love visual novel about your past confronting you.
Hazel is an ex-adventurer who's settled down with some of his previous guildmates after the adventure of a lifetime—taking down a doomsday cult that tried to end the world, but at the cost of killing their former guild leader who turned against them. Despite their adventure still haunting him months later, he's tried to move on. —That is until a man with the same face as their guild leader approaches him.
This is a story about cults and killing and killing cults. And being in love.
🔪 1 Obsessive Clingy Love Interest
Asphodelium follows the relationship between Hazel, the main character, and Aster, his sudden new roommate. Will love blossom between them, or will old habits die hard?
🪻 2 Main Paths To Walk Down
Depending on your choices, you may find yourself in branching paths. There's 2 main story lines to follow Hazel & Aster down with several smaller scene variations and different endings on each path.
💜 A Melancholic Romance Over 60,000 Words Long
Asphodelium has 60k+ words over both story lines and multiple endings for each, leading to lots of different ways Hazel & Aster's story can go.

title: Bread & Bravery
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 14세기 유럽에서 왕으로부터 영지 관리를 위임받은 봉건 영주가 되어 플레이합니다. 성채 하나에서 시작하여 영지의 경제와 인구를 성장시키세요. 동시에 침략군이 왕국 전체를 돌아다니며 약탈하고 있습니다. 군대를 모으고 방어를 구축하여 영토를 지켜야 합니다. 왕의 요청을 충족시키면 군사력이 성장하고 결국 왕국 전체를 해방할 수 있습니다.

하나의 캠페인은 절차적으로 생성된 레이아웃으로 하나의 맵에서 진행됩니다. 캠페인을 성공적으로 완료하는 데는 많은 시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다. 모든 플레이를 완료할 때마다 다음 플레이의 메커니즘에 영향을 주는 특별한 게임플레이 조정이 잠금 해제됩니다. 한 캠페인 동안 단기 목표는 왕의 특정 요청과 주기적으로 발생하는 이벤트를 처리하는 것입니다.

사회는 두 가지 사회 계급으로 구성됩니다: 농민과 하급 귀족입니다. 각 직업은 고유한 메커니즘을 가지고 있으며 서로 다른 군사 유닛을 제공합니다.
클래식 아케이드 RTS 전투

빈번하고 중요한 전투에서 당신의 규칙은 도전받게 됩니다. 타협 없이 세련된 RTS 유닛 컨트롤 시스템을 즐겨보세요.
복잡한 군대를 개별 유닛까지 통제하세요. 유닛은 부지런히 진형을 정렬합니다. 대형의 방향을 제어하고 표준, 와이드 라인 또는 스프레드 중 적절한 대형 종류를 선택할 수 있습니다.
컨트롤 그룹, 유닛 유형별 선택, 컨트롤 그룹에 카메라 초점 등 표준 기능으로 RTS 근육 기억을 되살려보세요.
이질적인 군대를 간편하게 제어할 수 있는 혁신적인 기능인 자동 하위 그룹을 즐겨보세요.
표준 및 고급 RTS 명령으로 유닛을 지휘하세요: 공격 이동, 결정된 이동, 집중 공격, 위치 유지, 정지, 순찰, 팔로우. 그룹 및 개별 유닛에 대한 명령을 대기열에 추가합니다.
2가지 혁신적인 명령을 실험해 보세요: 현재 명령 건너뛰기, 선택 항목 분할.
언제든지 인터랙티브하게 게임을 일시 정지하여 전술 옵션을 고려하고 명령을 내릴 수 있습니다.
모든 키를 개인 취향에 맞게 바인딩할 수 있으며, 바인딩에 수정자를 사용할 수 있습니다.

유닛 유형은 고전적인 중세 유닛 원형을 기반으로 하되 독창적으로 변형했습니다. 징집된 유닛은 정착지의 생산적인 구성원이 될 수 있으며, 손실되는 유닛은 모두 중요합니다.
10가지 인간 유닛 유형은 각각 고유한 장단점과 특정 생산 요구 사항을 가지고 있습니다.
4가지 공성 유닛 유형.
각 유닛 유형의 강점과 약점이 잘 표현되어 있습니다.
유닛을 해체하고 다른 유형으로 재입대할 수 있습니다.

성 및 주변 지역의 경제 개발은 이 게임의 영원한 목표입니다.









표준 플롯 크기 또는 유기적 레이아웃? 여러분의 선택입니다! 건물을 자유롭게 배치하고 회전할 수 있으며, 일부 건물은 플롯 크기를 사용자 지정할 수 있습니다. 이러한 건물의 경우 표준 플롯 크기를 대신 선택할 수 있습니다.

이 게임은 한 개인 개발자의 열정과 헌신적인 노력의 산물입니다. 지금은 이 게임을 위시리스트에 추가하고 팔로우해 주세요. 감사합니다!

title: Six Shake Coin
description:
게임 정보
This is a game that combines Six Shake Coin divination with cultivation to decipher and reason. The game includes basic knowledge such as the Five Elements, Eight Diagrams, Sixty Four Diagrams, Twelve Longevity, and the various phenomena of the Eight Diagrams, as well as knowledge related to the Six Shake Coin divination such as copper coin shaking, SHI YING, NA JIA, LIU QIN, Fu Shen, Fei Shen, and Yong Shen. In addition, by combining the Eight Diagrams with spells from cultivation, players can experience some cultivation battles in the game. Come and learn about the charm of traditional Chinese culture~

title: GrimmKitchen
description:
게임 정보
Revive the restaurant passed down from your grandmother and aim for a three-star rating!
Enter a fairy tale world where you’ll battle enemies and gather ingredients in action-packed,
while also hiring and training staff to manage your restaurant.
This game offers a blend of restaurant management and fairy tale action!
Fairy Tale Action
Gather Ingredients
Step into a fairy tale world and collect all kinds of ingredients!
Defeat creatures, and you might just find rare, high-quality ingredients.
The more you gather, the more delicious dishes you can serve at your restaurant!
Fairy Tale Skills
Unleash powerful abilities inspired by fairy tale characters in battle!
Use them strategically to turn the tide of the fight in your favor!

title: Trading Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
From Farming to Merchant Competition
Embark on a journey starting as a small Venetian farmer stepping into the challenging and exciting world of trade. Increase your wealth by selling your products in markets, compete with other merchants, and become a respected trader in Europe.
Exploration In A Boundless Open World
Roam freely in our open world, crafted with detailed and vivid depictions of medieval Europe. Write your own adventure across this vast geography that stretches from cities to rural areas, from seas to mountains.
Thrilling Battles On land and Sea
In addition to trade, engage in strategic land and sea battles. Fight aboard ships and build an army to protect your caravan.
An Enriched Gaming Experience with Extra Activities
Develop your character and enhance your enjoyment of the game with various activities like hunting, fishing, and farming. Use the resources nature provides to grow both your skills and your fortune.

title: Bathhouse Creatures
description:
게임 정보
Bathhouse Creatures is a small, cozy and whimsical management game about building up an old bathhouse, keeping animal guests happy, and watching your bathhouse grow to be the best it can be!
Build & Manage Your Bathhouse
Bring an old and abandoned bathhouse back to it's former days of glory! Place bathtubs, purchase decorations, and upgrade facilities to attract the local folk to come and soak their stresses away. 
Serve Lovable Animal Folk
Prepare warm and soothing baths for the local animal folk. Stay on your toes and decorate the bathhouse according to their preferences to keep them happy and satisfied. Use delectable treats and tasteful décor for extra payments and rave reviews!

title: Treasure 'n Trio
description:
게임 정보
트레저 앤 트리오
트레저 앤 트리오는 유명 퍼즐 게임 소코반을 베이스로 한 싱글 플레이어 퍼즐 게임입니다.
타일 단위로 이동하고 오브젝트와 상호작용하며 퍼즐을 풀어나갑니다.
  세 명의 캐릭터
무력으로 해결하는 전사, 기민하고 약삭빠른 도적, 순간이동 마법을 가진 겁쟁이 마법사가 한 팀이 되어 움직입니다.
서로 다른 능력을 가진 세 캐릭터를 적재적소에 사용하여 퍼즐을 풀어보세요.

title: Motorbike Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Motorbike Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 80 motorbikes from 120 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motorbikes with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: Decide 4 God
description:
게임 정보
Decide 4 God is the final entry of the Abime Series.
One hour.
The woman and her team of investigators had one hour to infiltrate a prison and cause a breakout. Her dearest hope was that, among the prisoners, there would be her brother who disappeared nearly twenty years ago.
She couldn't shake the feeling that something sinister was waiting for her team.
One hour.
The man had been up for one hour, contemplating his past. Everything changed when, one day, around noon, a box with clothing was slid through the opening in the cell door. He was told to put it on if he wanted to escape.
The prisoner obeyed, though something felt wrong. Why was someone breaking him out?
The final chapter in the Abime Series. Decide 4 God contains the entire truth behind the events of both Head AS Code and Birth ME Code. Familiar faces return and new faces emerge to complete the unfortunate cast suffering through over a dozen endings due to the misdeeds of Empathy Systems.
Two sides of the story. You will be able to follow multiple characters as they live out their terrible tale. Side A and Side B have wildly different events making up opposite parts of a whole story.

title: BRUTAL JOHN
description:
게임 정보



Experience BRUTAL JOHN, a mind-blowing fusion of the best old-school FPS shooters, like Duke Nukem, Serious Sam, Doom, and Soldier of Fortune. Immerse yourself in a heart-stopping, ultraviolent gaming experience that's sure to get your adrenaline pumping.

About Game :
Prepare for a mind-blowing adventure in the year 2090, where the entire world is controlled by the ruthless crypto-mining mutant, Luzilian. With humanity's fate in his merciless and greedy grip, he has brought the global economy to its knees and left the earth teetering on the edge of disaster. But all is not lost, for the fearless heroes, BRUTAL JOHN and DOGE, have risen to fight against the crypto-mining technology madness. Can they prevail in this epic battle to change the course of the universe?

title: Dragon Sprouts
description:
게임 정보
🏡 Create and customize your very own Dragon Sanctuary!
🌾🥕Grow crops to feed your dragons 🍅🥬
🐉 Unlock all the dragons and complete your collection! 🐲
🐾 Relax & Unwind 
🏡 Settle in, make some 🍵tea, and get ready to raise the cutest 🐲 dragons you’ve ever seen. Your cozy adventure awaits!

title: Our Freedom: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
윌리엄의 발자취를 따라가 보세요. 그는 전쟁, 상실, 그리고 생존을 위한 싸움으로 형성된 평범한 사람입니다. 비극의 재에서, 당신은 지도자로 떠오르고, 잔인한 습격을 피한 생존자들을 이끌게 됩니다. 당신의 임무는 제로에서 시작해 번영하는 정착지를 만들어내고, 사람들에게 집, 일자리, 음식, 그리고 안전을 제공하며, 다가오는 위협에 대비할 수 있도록 그들을 준비시키는 것입니다.

2010년대와 2020년대의 사랑받는 RPG에서 영감을 얻은 이 게임은 아늑하면서도 동적인 분위기를 제공합니다. 풍부한 이야기와 몰입감 있는 시스템이 결합되어, 향수와 혁신이 완벽하게 어우러집니다.
프롤로그
프롤로그를 통해 주인공 윌리엄에게 일어난 사건과 이야기를 이해해 보세요! 오픈 월드, 흥미로운 퀘스트, 그리고 무한 샌드박스가 당신을 기다리고 있습니다.
정착지 건설
작게 시작해 당신의 정착지를 번영하는 피난처로 성장시키세요. 집, 농장, 밀, 광산, 작업장, 방어 시설을 건설하고, 커지는 공동체의 요구를 충족시킬 새로운 건물을 잠금 해제하세요. 전략적인 계획이 중요합니다. 확장을 준비하고 사람들의 번영을 보장하세요.
전투 시스템
도시 건설과 액션 RPG 게임플레이의 완벽한 조화를 경험해 보세요. 검을 들고 대규모 전투를 이끌며, 성을 점령하고 정착지를 방어하세요. 에픽 토너먼트에 참여해 자신의 용기를 증명하고, 귀중한 보상을 얻으세요.
정착지가 번창하는 데 필요한 모든 것을 건설하고, 단련하며, 창조하세요! 필수 도구부터 강력한 무기까지, 모든 아이템은 도시의 생존과 방어에서 중요한 역할을 합니다.






윌리엄을 당신이 이상적인 영웅으로 만들어 보세요. 캐릭터의 외모를 디자인하고, 그의 능력과 정착지의 상태에 영향을 미치는 갑옷, 무기, 액세서리로 장착하세요. 강력한 부적과 반지를 장착하여 속성을 향상시키세요.
생명과 세부사항이 가득한 세계에 몰입하세요. 마을 사람들이 일상적인 작업을 하는 모습과 동물들이 자연 속을 돌아다니는 모습을 지켜보세요. 도로나 정착지에서든, 매력적이고 개성 있는 세계를 발견할 수 있습니다.


전설을 창조하고, 사람들을 이끌며, 모든 역경을 뚫고 번영하는 세계를 건설하세요. 당신의 여정은 여기서 시작됩니다!

title: Arachnoid
description:
게임 정보
Arachnoid is an intense survival horror game where moving into an abandoned home turns into a nightmare. Clean the house by picking up trash, move boxes inside to unpack, and drive your car to complete various tasks. At first, it's just an old house with a few creaks and shadows. But as the days pass, you realize you're not alone - something is watching, crawling, waiting. The house is infested with giant, intelligent spiders, and they are not in a hurry to reveal themselves. Run from the giant spiders, until you find a way to fight them. Finding a shotgun, you are able to find and carry ammo to fight against these monsters.
Uncover the dark mystery behind the infestation while solving puzzles and completing quests to survive. But as the horror escalates, so does the fight. After finding a shotgun with limited ammo, you'll have to decide when to run, when to hide, and when to face the nightmare head-on. The spiders aren't just lurking in the corners - they scale wall crawl across ceilings, and hunt in groups.
With a slow-burning atmosphere that builds into heart-pounding terror, Arachnoid will test your nerves. Will you make it through, or will the spiders claim their next victim?

title: Off Road Together
description:
게임 정보
도전적인 지형과 장애물

좁은 길, 가파른 경사면, 진흙으로 덮인 깊은 길이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다. 올바른 전략을 결정하고 팀과 협력하여 불가능해 보이는 지점까지 도달하세요.
차량 유지 관리 및 커스터마이징

오프로드의 스타가 되기 위해 4x4 차량의 유지 관리를 소홀히 하지 마세요! 타이어 선택부터 서스펜션 업그레이드까지, 성능을 배가하고 지형을 지배하세요.
캠핑과 레크리에이션

길고 피곤한 운전 후에는 자연의 품에서 캠핑을 즐겨보세요. 모닥불 주위에 모여 에너지를 모으고 다음 도전적인 스테이지를 위한 코스를 설정하세요.
전략적 경로 계획

가속 페달을 밟는 것만으로는 충분하지 않습니다! 까다로운 코스에서 속도, 연료, 지구력 사이의 균형을 유지하도록 계획을 잘 세워야 합니다. 타이밍이 맞으면 어떤 장애물도 여러분을 방해할 수 없습니다.
솔로 또는 팀 플레이

솔로 운전 실력을 시험해 보거나 4인 협동 모드에서 친구들과 힘을 합쳐 보세요. 팀 정신은 가장 위험한 트랙에서도 차이를 만듭니다.

오프로드 투게더와 함께 엔진을 시동하고 자연을 거스르며 오프로드 열정의 한계를 뛰어넘어 보세요!

title: Alliance Peacefighter
description:
게임 정보
Alliance Peacefighter is a linear, story-driven space sim in the style of the 90s classics. As a newly qualified Alliance pilot, you find yourself caught up in a plot to break the fragile peace between two galactic super powers.
Take control of the Alliance's most advanced starfighter in a thrilling story-driven campaign.
Fast-paced first-person combat, with full control over your ship's power and shield distribution.
Clear, diegetic UI provides critical information at a glance.
Fight alongside an elite squad of quirky alien teammates. Then relax in the ship's bar.
Built for both VR and traditional monitors, with full support for motion controllers, HOTAS joysticks, gamepads and mouse/keyboard. The Steam Deck is also fully supported (official verification still pending).
Alliance Peacefighter is a tribute to the golden age of space sims, and a love letter to the people who grew up with them.

title: Galactic Simulator2: Stargate
description:
게임 정보
갤럭틱 시뮬레이터 2: 스타게이트는 페르미의 역설과 대필터 이론에서 영감을 받은 Roguelite 게임입니다. 우주선을 조종하고, 자원을 모으며, 비콘을 탐험하고, 스타게이트를 건설하세요. 다른 문명을 발견하거나 별을 식민지화하세요.
페르미 역설
현재(2025년 기준), 외계 생명체가 지구를 방문했다는 신뢰할 만한 증거는 없습니다.
“그들은 어디에 있는가?”
드레이크 방정식
N = R* × Fp × Ne × Fl × Fi × Fc × L
    N：은하에서 감지 가능한 외계 문명의 수
    R*：은하 내 별 형성 속도
    Fp：행성계를 가진 별의 비율
    Ne：유기 생명체가 살 수 있는 환경을 가진 태양계 내 행성 수
    Fl：생명이 나타날 가능성이 있는 행성의 비율
    Fi：지능적 생명체가 나타날 가능성이 있는 비율
    Fc：탐지 가능한 신호를 방출하는 문명의 확률
    L：문명의 생존 기간
드레이크 방정식은 외계 문명의 존재 가능성을 이해하는 데 도움을 줍니다. 갤럭틱 시뮬레이터 2: 스타게이트는 이 방정식의 모든 요소를 구현합니다.
대여과설
대여과설은 생명이 최초의 생화학적 기원(abiogenesis)에서부터 카다셰프 척도(Kardashev Scale)에서 가장 높은 수준에 도달하는 과정까지의 발전 과정에서, 탐지 가능한 외계 생명체를 극도로 희귀하게 만드는 장벽(여과기)이 존재한다는 아이디어입니다.
이 이론에 따라, 갤럭틱 시뮬레이터 2: 스타게이트는 다음과 같은 대여과기(진화 단계)를 정의합니다:
적합한 항성계와 잠재적으로 거주 가능한 행성
유기 분자 
원핵세포
진핵세포
다세포 생물

title: Many Nights a Whisper
description:
게임 정보
Ten years ago, you were chosen to perform a ritual.
Many Nights a Whisper is a meditative third-person archery game. Under the gentle guidance of your mentor, you will train to land an impossibly distant shot. Practice tirelessly, honing your skill for the sacred ceremony that will shape the future of your people. Succeed, and their wishes will come true, bringing a decade of prosperity. Should you fail, ten years of calamity will follow, and their hopes will be lost to the winds.
Ah, and you only have one shot.
No pressure.
Short and thought-provoking
Playtime: 50-75 minutes. Delve into the routine of the Dreamer, the person chosen to perform this critical ceremony. Engage with your mentor in warm and intimate discussions. Listen to the townsfolk at the Confession Wall, weigh their whispers, and decide whether to grant their wishes.
Test your marksmanship
Master the sacred slingshot, a mystical device strung with human hair. Carefully aim, adjust for distance, and land fireballs into ancient chalices scattered across a ruin-sewn archipelago.

title: Boat Together
description:
게임 정보
Paddle through the water with your friends!
Are you ready for a fun-filled journey on kayaks or boats? In this game, where you can play with up to 8 friends, you'll need to paddle well—because controlling your boat won’t be so easy!
Explore the islands!
Explore and discover islands with new biomes as you navigate through dangerous paths. Remember, each new biome offers a unique experience, and reaching the next island will always be more challenging!

title: The EverFloating Island
description:
게임 정보
부유 에너지 세계에서 살아남아라 – 나만의 하늘 섬을 건설하자!
이 게임은 무역, 애완동물들 번식, 생존, 전투가 결합된 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
신비로운 바다 위의 세계에서 나만의 하늘 섬을 만들어 보세요!
부유 에너지 세계에서 생존하고 하늘 섬을 발전시키자!
이곳은 바다와 하늘 섬만이 존재하는 세계이며, 부유 에너지가 생존의 열쇠입니다!
당신의 목표는 하늘 섬이 추락하지 않도록 유지하는 것이며, 무역, 전투, 임무 수행을 통해
귀중한 부유석을 획득하고 나만의 하늘 제국을 건설하세요!
수백 가지의 상품을 거래하며 무역 거물이 되어라!
의뢰를 받아 다양한 임무를 수행하라!
약탈자들을 물리치거나, 해적이 되어 자원을 강탈할 수도 있다!
최강의 애완동물들을 번식시켜 하늘 섬을 방어하라!
이 세계에서 애완동물들은 단순한 친구가 아닙니다. 전투에서 가장 든든한 동료가 됩니다!
독특한 스킬과 강화 시스템으로 최강의 애완동물 군단을 만들자!
번식을 통해 더욱 강한 혈통을 계승하고 궁극의 신수를 탄생시키자!
하늘 섬을 건설하고 강화하여 완벽한 생존 기지를 구축하라!
새로운 시설을 해금하여 하늘 섬의 기능을 확장하자!
부유 퍼니스는 부유 코어에 연결됩니다. 다양한 부유 크리스탈을 사용하여 부유 에너지를 생성합니다.
미지의 세계를 탐험하고 부유 조류를 견뎌내며 약탈자들의 위협에 맞서라!
게임 특징
쉽고 직관적인 무역 시스템 – 자유롭게 경제를 성장시키세요
귀여운 애완동물들과 함께하는 전투 – 적들을 물리치세요!
다양한 시설 해금 – 하늘 섬을 더욱 발전시키세요
전략적인 부유 퍼니스 시스템 – 자원 관리와 배치 능력을 시험하세요!
확장되는 세계 – 새로운 시설을 해금하고 더 강력한 애완동물들을 발견하세요!
하늘 섬 생존 도전에 준비되었나요? 부유 에너지 세계로 뛰어들어 나만의 하늘 섬을 건설하세요!

title: The Hilltop Funeral
description:
게임 정보
"Help Wanted: Cherry Hill Cemetery seeks an individual for part-time work. Position: Pallbearer… Huh? What’s a pallbearer?
Duties: Carrying caskets… Oh.
Apply in person after dusk… Hmm… seems worth a shot!"
—The Part-Timer
Control Two Characters-Solo or Local Co-op!
Coordinate your left hand and right hand or work with a friend, help the two pallbearers carry the casket to the top!
Goofy Ragdoll Physics
Don’t drop the body on the ground! Tilt the casket, toss him around, and make sure the “client” stays well and happy. Pick up some garbage along the way—if you did drop him, just stitch him back together. Repair the casket along the way if a piece or two falls apart—it’s a fragile one.

title: Prison Miners
description:
게임 정보
광산에서 살아남아라, 더 깊이 파고, 업그레이드하라!
당신은 광활한 사막 한가운데, 빛이 닿지 않는 광산에 갇힌 죄수입니다. 여기서 당신의 운명은 팀과 함께 광산에서 일하고, 매일 할당량을 채우며, 속죄하며 살아남는 것입니다. 하지만 조심하세요… 이 광산에는 단순한 돌과 광석만 있는 것이 아닙니다.
장비를 업그레이드하고 강해지세요!
광산에서 자원을 모아 다양한 광석과 귀중한 아이템을 판매하여 돈을 벌 수 있습니다. 러스티 빌(Rusty Bill)이 상점에서 당신을 기다리고 있습니다! 장비를 강화하고, 더 좋은 곡괭이, 가방, 장비를 획득하세요. 하지만 과도한 사치는 죽음을 초래할 수도 있습니다.
단순한 채굴이 아니다!
매일 더 깊이 파고 들어 귀금속과 희귀 광석을 찾아야 합니다. 하지만 깊이 팔수록 숨겨진 비밀이 밝혀지고 어둠 속의 위험이 모습을 드러냅니다.
당신은 두려움에 맞서 점점 더 어두워지는 광산에서 살아남을 준비가 되었습니까?

title: Rope It Two
description:
게임 정보
Rope It Two
여러분과 친구들을 위한 와일드한 협동 파티 플랫폼 게임!
1-8인 플레이 광란
최대 8명의 플레이어와 팀을 이루거나 경쟁하며 혼란스러운 멀티플레이어 재미를 즐기세요!

title: Heroes Unhinged
description:
게임 정보
Story
In a world where justice is no longer blind, superheroes have abandoned their moral restraints and taken the law into their own hands. Welcome to Heroes Unhinged, an action roguelike game where raw power reigns supreme, and the lines between hero and villain blur into chaos.
As one of the world's most powerful beings, you are judge, jury, and executioner. The city is your battlefield, and criminals are your prey. Tear through buildings with explosive energy blasts, hurl vehicles, and crash through entire city blocks as you hunt down the scum that plague society. No prisons. No second chances. Just brutal, unrelenting justice.
Variety of Characters
Choose from a wide range of heroes, each with their own unique ability.  Raise exploding zombies as the Gravedigger, build auto turrets as the Goblineer, fire arrows that curve and seek enemies as the Onna-Musha, set fires as the Pyro Maniac, go into a teleporting attack frenzy as Poof.  The list of heroes is 20+ with more planned for future updates!
Power Points

title: Diamond Runway
description:
게임 정보
In the dazzling and extravagant New York City, the glow of the runway dream attracts countless dreamers.
You, Lindsay, a 19-year-old girl, carrying the dream of becoming a supermodel, set out alone to New York, USA, seeking opportunities.
As you step into the vast world of the fashion industry, you realize that the reality and cruelty behind the scenes are far from as glamorous as they seem.
Facing this bizarre and dazzling arena of fame and fortune, how will you choose?
Your diamond-like shining life begins at this very moment—unfold your destiny!
Game Features：
1. Immersive Story Experience
Step into the world of high fashion as you compete in elite modeling contests, walk the runway for haute couture, and experience the fierce rivalries and hardships of chasing your dreams in the fashion industry.
2. Multiple Story Branches
Every choice you make shapes the storyline, influences character relationships, and determines the ultimate outcome. Will you rise as a top supermodel, or be trapped by the hidden rules of the industry? The decision is yours.
3. Diverse Romantic Relationships
Embark on romantic journeys with four distinct men, each with their own personality and background: the genius photographer Ciang Jiang, the renowned stylist Elliot Graham, the entertainment CEO Nathaniel Sharp, and the world's leading male model Ethan Tanner. Each romance promises a unique and unforgettable experience.
Gameplay：
1. Interaction and Bonds
You can engage in deep interactions with multiple romanceable characters, building different relationships through dialogue choices and actions.
2. Rumors and Public Opinion
Experience the pressure of public opinion in the modeling industry. Your actions may be exposed by journalists, leading to scandalous rumors. You will need to make strategic choices and complete tasks to resolve negative publicity crises.

title: Vampire Prison
description:
게임 정보
[개요]
그들은 뱀파이어의 먹이로 끌려갔어요. 감옥이에요.
그들은 나를 감옥에 가뒀고 나는 자유롭게 움직일 수 없습니다.
그곳에 계속 있으면 뱀파이어가 계속 피를 빨아먹고 결국 죽게 됩니다!
탈출을 방해하는 함정과 수수께끼를 풀고 출구로 나가세요!
경비가 삼엄한 감옥에서 탈출할 수 있을까요?
뱀파이어의 감옥에서 탈출하여 뱀파이어의 감옥에서 탈출하세요!
감옥을 탐험하는 동안 뱀파이어가 나타나 공격할 것입니다!
뱀파이어를 만나면 도망쳐 몸을 숨기세요.
뱀파이어는 감옥을 순찰하므로 뱀파이어의 행동 패턴을 이해하는 것이 중요합니다.
눈에 띄지 않게 전진하세요.
아이템을 사용해 위험을 피하세요!
수색 중에 아이템과 힌트를 얻을 수 있습니다.
수색을 통해 아이템을 획득하여 위험을 피하세요!

title: ChronoPsykotik
description:
게임 정보
Step into the fractured psyche of Dr. Elias Varn, a brilliant theoretical physicist whose groundbreaking experiments have shattered the boundaries of reality—and his own sanity. In ChronoPsykotik, a retro-inspired FPS, you’ll battle through surreal, ever-shifting dimensions born from Elias’ crumbling mind. Wield experimental weapons powered by quantum anomalies, fight nightmarish manifestations of his fears, and unravel the truth behind his descent into madness. Will you escape the abyss, or be consumed by it?
Explore mind-bending levels filled with retro-style visuals and relentless action.
Face off against grotesque enemies that embody Elias’ fractured thoughts—each one a puzzle of its own.
Master a unique arsenal, from plasma-charged shotguns to gravity-defying rifles, as you bend the laws of physics to survive.
Uncover a haunting narrative through cryptic notes and distorted memories, piecing together the physicist’s tragic story.

title: Shards Reunited: Kintsugi
description:
게임 정보
Endless Puzzles, Timeless Beauty
Dive into the calming world of Shards Reunited: Kintsugi, a 2D jigsaw puzzle game where you piece together beautiful Japanese porcelain objects, one shard at a time. In this first chapter of the Shards Reunited series, immerse yourself in a serene experience as you restore vibrant porcelain treasures, each showcasing intricate Japanese designs like cherry blossoms, temples, and tranquil landscapes.
Gameplay
It’s simple yet satisfying: each level presents a new porcelain object broken into shards. Drag, rotate, and snap the pieces into place to complete the puzzle, then move on to the next. With puzzles ranging from easy to challenging, there’s always another piece to fit, offering endless hours of quiet focus and relaxation.
A Feast for the Eyes
Every porcelain object bursts with color, featuring hand-drawn Japanese designs in vivid hues—pink cherry blossoms, red-roofed temples, and misty blue mountains. Set against a minimalist backdrop with soothing music, the game creates a peaceful atmosphere perfect for unwinding.
Key Features
Puzzle After Puzzle: A continuous stream of jigsaw challenges, from simple to intricate, keeping you engaged.
Vibrant Porcelain Art: Enjoy colorful Japanese designs that bring each object to life.
Serene Atmosphere: Relax with calming music featuring traditional Japanese instruments like the koto.

title: Attack on Inirea
description:
게임 정보
The peaceful village of Inirea is under attack and needs your help to defend it from monsters.
In this arcade-style shooter,  you will take command of powerful weapons to defend the village from hordes of monsters, gaining points and powerups as you progress through the maps.
The game consists of several maps, each with their unique characteristics, weapons and waves of enemies.

title: LOOTPLOT
description:
게임 정보
LOOTPLOT is a Roguelite where you generate points by arranging items in slots.

Buy items, re-arrange your items, discover synergies, and break the game!
In this world, the rules bend to your will.
Creativity = power!
Features:
Over 300 unique items to discover, of varying rarities
Starter-items that provide unique starting-perks
Dozes of unique slot types to work with
Highly emergent gameplay, with many overlapping systems
Easter eggs and secrets
Excellent Modding support
Open ended strategies
Seasonal items (Christmas, Halloween, Easter)

title: Parisian Brasserie Simulator
description:
게임 정보
【출시 시 멀티플레이 모드 지원】
흥미진진한 미식 경영의 여정을 시작할 준비가 되셨나요? 세계에서 가장 많은 관광객이 방문하는 파리의 중심에서 직접 프렌치 레스토랑을 운영해 보세요. 파리 특유의 도시 분위기에 몰입하며, 오스만 양식의 건축물과 에펠탑 전망을 감상하고, 정통 프랑스 요리의 매력을 만끽하세요. 시즌별 메뉴를 설계하고, 직원 배치를 최적화하며, 고객 만족도를 높여 작은 레스토랑을 센 강변의 전설적인 맛집으로 성장시키세요!
파리의 활기찬 가로수길에 위치한 작은 레스토랑의 주인으로서, 곧 성대한 개업식을 맞이하게 됩니다. 매장을 정성스럽게 꾸미고, 테이블과 의자를 배치하며, 신선한 식재료를 주문하고, 손님들의 발길을 사로잡을 매력적인 메뉴를 설계하세요. 모든 준비가 끝나면 본격적으로 영업을 시작하고 첫 손님을 맞이하며 미식 경영의 길을 열어가세요!

title: ZPF
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by classic horizontal shooters like Lords of Thunder, Elemental Master, and the Thunderforce series, ZPF is a passion project from the designer and developer of Super XYX and Tänzer.



Players will dodge and weave through intense bullet patterns, unleashing a barrage of firepower upon hordes of unique and challenging enemies.



Choose your hero - from the teleporting trickster to the laser-wielding warrior! Each character boasts a distinct playstyle with unique shots and melee attacks.



Brace yourself for epic encounters with mid and end-stage bosses, each demanding a different strategy to defeat.



Upgrade your arsenal and gain valuable tips between levels at each of the world’s in-game shops.



Finish every stage and discover a treasure trove of hidden secrets.

title: T.D.Z. 4 Heart of Pripyat
description:
게임 정보
You have to go through this difficult path from a beginner to a seasoned stalker and uncover the mystery of your own father's disappearance!
T.D.Z. 4 The Heart of Pripyat is a game that will draw you in with its amazing atmosphere from the first seconds! Gray sky, rain, campfire dialogues with loyal stalker friends, mutants, anomalies are just a small part of what awaits you in this 1st-person action-adventure shooter! Explore the abandoned locations of the mysterious Exclusion Zone, shoot back mutants, search caches of ammunition and food, complete tasks of stalker friends and reach the very Pripyat to see the finale of this amazing story!
►Game Features◄
☢️ Freedom of action! You can explore the stunning beauty of the location, as well as complete the tasks of other stalkers, earning new equipment!
☢️ A large selection of items! 7 types of weapons, bolts, grenades, first aid kits, anomaly detectors, food and much more in your arsenal for survival in a dangerous zone!
☢️ A mixture of genres in one bottle! Horror, Survival, Action Shooter in one game and at once!
☢️ Convenient controls will appeal to everyone!
☢️ Stunning graphics!
☢️ Dynamic storyline!

title: Nightwatch at the Hopkins' Cliffside
description:
게임 정보
In Nightwatch at the Hopkins' Cliffside, you are a member of the Committee for Handling Illogical Phenomena (CHIP), tasked with investigating and eliminating reality-defying anomalies at remote cliff. Your assignment: monitor the house surroundings for one night and neutralize any disturbances that arise. However, as the clock ticks, the anomalies become more frequent, more dangerous, and most importantly, some of them will hunt you down. Will you survive until dawn?
Features

Survive the Night: Face a variety of anomalies, from subtle spatial distortions to alternate realities seeping into your world. Each anomaly you encounter will challenge your perception and push your sanity to the brink.

Explore the Hopkins' house: Navigate through a beautifully crafted, historically rich environment filled with hidden lore, clues, and secrets that unravel the history of the estate and its former resident.

Master the Artifact: Wield a powerful Tetrahedron, an artifact capable of detecting and neutralizing reality-bending phenomena. Use it wisely, as it must cooldown after each use.

Immersive Atmosphere: Experience haunting atmosphere with dynamic sound design, chilling ambient music, and detailed visual effects that bring the estate’s unsettling presence to life.

Uncover Hidden Lore: Discover letters, and other artifacts that reveal the truth behind the anomalies and their origins.
The story

Over the past few years, anomalies have started to emerge around the world. Initially, they were noticed by only a few, but soon their intensity began to escalate. As governments could no longer deny their existence, investigations commenced. It quickly became clear that these alternate realities posed at least a global threat.

Scientists from around the world are now working together to create the first tools capable of stopping these aberrations. As a member of CHIP, your mission is not only to survive, but also to uncover crucial information about these anomalies.

Prepare yourself for a night of suspense, mystery, and psychological horror. The Hopkins' Cliffside is waiting, and it’s anything but ordinary.

title: Cats & Dice
description:
게임 정보
Cats & Dice is a dice-building roguelike all about getting the right synergies to pull off crazy combos and attain as high a score as you possibly can.
The Cats (maneki-neko) are the mainstay of the game. Every Cat has its own passive ability that can affect how you approach a run. All Cats generate a dice unique to them at the start of each round (for instance there's a Cat that will create a dice with only four on all sides). There is no additional drawing of dice from your deck or the like. These dice are then played to get a score. Reach the target score and you'll win the round.
With more than 60 Cats (and more to come!) to choose from, the possibilities are endless.
There are various Items that can be equipped onto the Cats you own. These Items can add onto or even alter your Cat's passive abilities. Some grant additional effects onto the Cat's dice and allow you to customize it to your liking. These Items are not permanently attached to your Cats, so feel free to experiment and change your strategy.
The dice play as important a role as your Cats. You can get bonus points out of specific combination of dice. There's a number of rerolls per round you can use to reroll specific dice until you attain the desired outcome. Some dice can also have special effects that help in various ways, from adding scoring multiplier to gaining more rerolls.

Asphodelium is a melancholic slice-of-life boys love visual novel about your past confronting you.

title: Bread & Bravery
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 14세기 유럽에서 왕으로부터 영지 관리를 위임받은 봉건 영주가 되어 플레이합니다. 성채 하나에서 시작하여 영지의 경제와 인구를 성장시키세요. 동시에 침략군이 왕국 전체를 돌아다니며 약탈하고 있습니다. 군대를 모으고 방어를 구축하여 영토를 지켜야 합니다. 왕의 요청을 충족시키면 군사력이 성장하고 결국 왕국 전체를 해방할 수 있습니다.

하나의 캠페인은 절차적으로 생성된 레이아웃으로 하나의 맵에서 진행됩니다. 캠페인을 성공적으로 완료하는 데는 많은 시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다. 모든 플레이를 완료할 때마다 다음 플레이의 메커니즘에 영향을 주는 특별한 게임플레이 조정이 잠금 해제됩니다. 한 캠페인 동안 단기 목표는 왕의 특정 요청과 주기적으로 발생하는 이벤트를 처리하는 것입니다.

사회는 두 가지 사회 계급으로 구성됩니다: 농민과 하급 귀족입니다. 각 직업은 고유한 메커니즘을 가지고 있으며 서로 다른 군사 유닛을 제공합니다.
클래식 아케이드 RTS 전투

빈번하고 중요한 전투에서 당신의 규칙은 도전받게 됩니다. 타협 없이 세련된 RTS 유닛 컨트롤 시스템을 즐겨보세요.
복잡한 군대를 개별 유닛까지 통제하세요. 유닛은 부지런히 진형을 정렬합니다. 대형의 방향을 제어하고 표준, 와이드 라인 또는 스프레드 중 적절한 대형 종류를 선택할 수 있습니다.
컨트롤 그룹, 유닛 유형별 선택, 컨트롤 그룹에 카메라 초점 등 표준 기능으로 RTS 근육 기억을 되살려보세요.
이질적인 군대를 간편하게 제어할 수 있는 혁신적인 기능인 자동 하위 그룹을 즐겨보세요.
표준 및 고급 RTS 명령으로 유닛을 지휘하세요: 공격 이동, 결정된 이동, 집중 공격, 위치 유지, 정지, 순찰, 팔로우. 그룹 및 개별 유닛에 대한 명령을 대기열에 추가합니다.
2가지 혁신적인 명령을 실험해 보세요: 현재 명령 건너뛰기, 선택 항목 분할.
언제든지 인터랙티브하게 게임을 일시 정지하여 전술 옵션을 고려하고 명령을 내릴 수 있습니다.
모든 키를 개인 취향에 맞게 바인딩할 수 있으며, 바인딩에 수정자를 사용할 수 있습니다.

유닛 유형은 고전적인 중세 유닛 원형을 기반으로 하되 독창적으로 변형했습니다. 징집된 유닛은 정착지의 생산적인 구성원이 될 수 있으며, 손실되는 유닛은 모두 중요합니다.
10가지 인간 유닛 유형은 각각 고유한 장단점과 특정 생산 요구 사항을 가지고 있습니다.
4가지 공성 유닛 유형.
각 유닛 유형의 강점과 약점이 잘 표현되어 있습니다.
유닛을 해체하고 다른 유형으로 재입대할 수 있습니다.

성 및 주변 지역의 경제 개발은 이 게임의 영원한 목표입니다.









표준 플롯 크기 또는 유기적 레이아웃? 여러분의 선택입니다! 건물을 자유롭게 배치하고 회전할 수 있으며, 일부 건물은 플롯 크기를 사용자 지정할 수 있습니다. 이러한 건물의 경우 표준 플롯 크기를 대신 선택할 수 있습니다.

이 게임은 한 개인 개발자의 열정과 헌신적인 노력의 산물입니다. 지금은 이 게임을 위시리스트에 추가하고 팔로우해 주세요. 감사합니다!

title: Motorbike Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Motorbike Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 80 motorbikes from 120 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motorbikes with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: Weldiver
description:
게임 정보
웰다이버의 각 미션은 심해로 떠나는 여정입니다. 플레이어는 해양 구조물 유지보수, 긴급 수리, 광섬유 케이블, 파이프라인, 전력선 같은 해저 인프라 교체 등 도전적인 작업을 수행하게 됩니다.
평균적인 노동자보다 사망할 확률이 40배 높은 일… 내가 내려갈 때마다 압력이 기다리고 있다. 나를 압사시키고, 익사시키고, 얼어붙게 하려 한다… 아니면 그보다 더 끔찍한 일까지도.
Weldiver의 강렬한 세계로 뛰어들어 지구에서 가장 위험한 직업 중 하나인 수중 용접을 체험해 보세요. 이 역할에서는 매일이 생과 사의 경계를 넘나드는 생존 시험입니다. 극한의 압력, 얼어붙을 듯한 온도, 낮은 시야 속에서 매 임무를 완수하기 위해서는 극도의 집중력이 필요합니다. 산소가 줄어들고 장비가 고장 날 때, 과연 침착함을 유지하며 탈출할 수 있을까요?
현실적인 용접 메커니즘:
인류가 경험하는 가장 극한의 환경 중 하나에서, 극도의 수압 속에서 금속을 용접하고, 연마하고, 절단하는 경험을 해보세요.
400미터 아래에서의 수리 및 유지보수:
해저에서 거대한 해양 플랫폼, 송유관, 그리고 신비로운 난파선을 관리하세요. 매일 새로운 생사의 도전이 기다리고 있으며, 결합부를 강화하고, 중요한 연결부를 용접하며, 해저의 가혹한 압력을 견뎌야 합니다.
다양한 환경 및 작업 조건:
작업 현장은 따뜻한 열대 바다부터 차가운 심해의 어둠까지 걸쳐 있습니다. 강한 압력, 강력한 해류, 거의 제로에 가까운 시야와 같은 혹독한 자연의 힘, 그리고 무한히 이어지는 미지의 위험에 대비하세요.

title: Heat incremental
description:

From the creator of reactor idle, factory idle and city idle!

Your mission is simple: HEAT UP THE PLANET, Yes, really.

You’ll start with clean technologies like solar panels that barely produce any heat, but soon begin to research less clean methods to produce even more heat. Who knows—you might
actually succeed in overheating the planet.

title: Forklift Driving Simulator VR
description:
게임 정보
Forklift is a useful and powerful industrial truck used to lift and move materials over short distances, also called lift truck, fork truck, fork hoist, and forklift truck. title: Kart Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Kart Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1970s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 15 karts from 50 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your karts with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!
