title: Calamities in the Dark
description:
게임 정보
In Calamities in the Dark you will plunge into the profanities of a terrible dungeon inhabited by countless Goblins.
But that's not all... The Goblins have evolved and you will find among them powerful enemies.
A game of turn-based tactical battles where your choices really matter!
Choose one of the 3 Heroes, each specialized in a type of branch of attacks and skills and choose three out of 9 possible companions to fight by your side.
You can improve your relationship with them to become your partner and improve their skills!
Of course, you must protect them, because the Goblins use human women to give birth to their progenitors - don't let them capture them, or it will be the end for them!
Strategic and demanding gameplay, death in the dungeon is permanent!
3 Heroes available to choose from.
9 Companions available to choose from.
The Dungeon consists of 200 Levels, procedurally generated.
More than 50 Skills Available to structure your team to your liking.
More than 40 different enemies.
Drop Equipment of different rarities.
No in-game purchases. ][/list]

title: Iskelonia
description:
게임 정보
This game is a partially text game where you can wander freely in nature and in the village of Iskelonia.
- 30 villagers are present in the game with a schedule (for the moment no interaction is possible with them)
- Some residents are merchants and buy categories of objects linked to their profession or passion
- A randomly generated terrain system with objects and animals to find
- A home sales system
- Already more than 220 objects, tools, animals, insects in the game.

title: REVENGE
description:
게임 정보
GET YOUR REVENGE!
REVENGE is a new multiplayer co-op PvE shooter game that is built around connecting players on many different levels. By integrating cooperative gameplay with interactive spectator participation, we’re expanding the definition of what a multiplayer game can be:
PLAY. GUIDE. SPECTATE … AND GET YOUR REVENGE.
Play in 3 ways:
As a Raider (the core FPS experience):
Raiders are the boots on the ground— a four-player FPS squad navigating the surreal landscapes of The Everreach. Your mission? Survive, collect valuable data, and get out before it’s too late.
As a Guide (The Tactical Overseers)
Guides serve as strategic support for the Raiders whilst also acting as the crucial link to Oracles. Played by four additional players in-game, Guides enhance coordination & support, ensuring that no Raider is left behind.
As an Oracle (The Interactive Spectators)
Oracles are Twitch viewers & spectators, but not in a passive sense. Through an innovative new Twitch-stream integration and in-game commands we call CROWD-PLAY GAMING, Oracles directly can influence the match in real-time. Anyone watching a live match can engage with the game, expanding the player base beyond those in the match itself.

title: Sector Unknown
description:
게임 정보
Sector Unknown is an immersive isometric RPG that draws inspiration from classics like Fallout 2, Knights of the Old Republic, Fallout: New Vegas, as well as more modern titles such as Wasteland 3, Encased, Colony Ship, Trudograd, and Pathfinder: Kingmaker.
Every decision, every nuance in character development has tangible consequences. While combat is a viable approach, the game equally emphasizes alternative strategies for progression, inviting players to leverage their character's unique abilities to navigate through the narrative creatively and diplomatically.
Story
In Sector Unknown, your saga begins as a prisoner aboard a transport ship from which you escape in a commandeered escape pod, crash-landing on Maku, a forsaken world veiled within a remote and uncharted region of space. This planet becomes the foundation of your odyssey as you convert it into a stronghold and base of operations. From there, you will set forth into space, exploring distinct worlds and locations, each teeming with its own factions and unique stories.
In your quest, you will confront the shadowy dealings of Star Frontier, the powerful trading and mining that once imprisoned you. Operating unchecked in the hidden 'null sector'—now erased from all official star charts—Star Frontier has established a tyrannical reign of terror and destruction. Your mission becomes to unite the sector's backwater and forsaken planets, through either force or diplomacy, and overthrow their oppressive rule once and for all.

title: Netherworld Covenant
description:
게임 정보
《Netherworld Covenant》(네더월드 커버넌트)는 다크 판타지 테마의 탑다운 3D 액션 로그라이크 게임으로, "정밀한 명령"과 "계약 시스템"을 핵심으로 하여 하드코어하고 전략적으로 깊이 있는 전투 경험을 제공합니다. 플레이어는 재앙 속에서 살아남은 전사를 조작하고, 현세와 이계를 잇는 영혼의 횃불을 손에 쥐고, 돌아가신 전우들의 영혼과 계약을 맺어 이계의 미로에서 부패한 옛 영웅들과 악마의 군주에게 도전합니다.
영혼을 계약하고, 불꽃이 길잡이
영혼의 횃불은 이계와 현세를 잇는 금기된 성물로, 그 깊은 에너지는 오직 사용자의 영혼의 떨림을 통해서만 깨어나며, 생사의 장막을 태울 수 있는 청색 불꽃을 방출합니다. 용사가 굳은 마음으로 횃불을 점화하면, 그 불꽃은 이계로 가는 길을 밝혀줄 뿐만 아니라, 죽은 자들이 차원의 경계를 넘고 다시 현세로 돌아오는 힘을 부여합니다. 횃불의 불꽃 아래서, 떠도는 영혼들은 잠시 인간의 형체를 되찾고, 철과 살로 엮인 몸을 통해 그들이 끝내지 못한 맹세를 완수합니다.
정밀한 명령의 예술
고속 공격 체계가 아닌 환경에서, 플레이어는 정확한 방어, 회피, 이계 비행을 통해 적의 공격을 피하고, 기회를 노려 치명적인 연계를 펼칩니다. 전투에서 타이밍 예측과 자원 배분을 통해 전투의 전략성과 심리전을 한층 더 강화합니다.

title: Sol Cesto
description:
게임 정보


Sol Cesto에서 플레이어는 무작위 던전의 아래로 끝없이 내려가면서 벌써 몇 년째 떠오르지 않는 태양을 찾아야 합니다. 각 화면에는 4개의 방이 표시되고, 언제든 클릭 한 번으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 방을 선택할 수는 있지만, 어떤 위치로 가게 될지는 알 수 없습니다. 공격해 오는 적을 만나게 될까요? 아니면 금화가 가득한 상자를 찾게 될까요? 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있는 건 아닐까요? 무슨 일이 일어날지 아무도 모릅니다...

각각의 화면을 클리어하면서 위험을 얼마나 감수할 것인지 판단하는 건 모두 플레이어의 몫입니다. 캐릭터가 점점 더 강해지고, 아이템과 기술까지 사용하다 보면 확률이 여러분의 편이 되어 줄 것입니다.



Sol Cesto에서는 언제나 새로운 모험을 경험할 수 있습니다.
각기 독특하게 움직이는 괴물과 함정이 숨어 있는 5개 환경
서로 다른 힘과 능력치, 기술을 보유한 캐릭터 10명
특정 위험을 만난 확률을 변화시키는 저주받은 이빨
적을 없애거나 확률을 유리하게 해줄 다양한 물체
그 외에도 깜짝 놀랄 콘텐츠가 다양하게 기다리고 있습니다...

title: Granvir
description:
게임 정보
Granvir is an action roguelite featuring mech building. Players battle through a route of their choice reaching extraction and completing side objectives at the cost of valuable resources. Between battles, players can swap out parts for upgrades found on the battlefield and manage their campaign by taking on loans to afford ammunition, aiding the locals for support in battle and more.



Equip devastating melee weapons such as swords, rocket spears and pile bunkers. Wield powerful long range guns like cannons, machine guns, flamethrowers and rocket pods. Mix and match armaments to suit your play style.



Mix torsos, legs, armatures and special modules to customize your Granvir. Defeating enemy ace pilots unlocks their unique parts.



No campaign is the same as you manage time, resources and your route to each objective. Each zone impacts what services and resources are available. Use down time between missions to refit and upgrade your Granvir to prevail.

title: Crimson Skyline
description:
게임 정보
Crimson Skyline 은 2D로 펼쳐지는 높은 난이도의 아케이드 스타일 비행 슈팅 게임입니다.
진행 방식
Crimson Skyline에서 플레이어는 항공모함과 기타 전함들로 이루어진 적들의 물결에 맞서 싸우게 됩니다.
항공모함은 모든 공중 적기를 실어나르는 게임의 핵심 요소입니다. 이들을 신속하고 전략적으로 격침하는 것이 승리의 관건이 될 것입니다.
각 스테이지는 10개의 웨이브와 최종 보스로 구성되어 있습니다.
플레이 가능한 전투기
RAFALE (라팔)
고속 연사 가능한 더블 머신건을 장착하여 지속적이고 치명적인 피해를 높은 정확도로 가합니다.
특수 능력 "코브라 샷건"은 순간적인 반전 기동 후 산탄총 형태의 탄막을 퍼부어 전방의 적을 모조리 쓸어버립니다.

title: Legacy of Baal
description:
게임 정보
화면 측면에서 작동하는 이 방치형 게임에서는 업무를 처리하면서 동시에 용병단이 자동 탐험을 진행하며 악마와 전투를 벌이고 전리품을 획득할 수 있습니다! 다양한 스킬을 가진 용병들, 1,000종 이상 독특한 장비, 예측불가의 전투 던전이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다! 또한 탐험할 수 있는 다양한 제작 시스템이 무한한 재미를 선사합니다! 본 게임은 2개월 이내에 온라인 장비 거래 시스템을 추가하여 플레이어들이 진정한 상호작용 경험을 얻을 수 있도록 할 예정입니다.
플레리어만의 용병 부대를 구성해 보세요! 4가지 개성적인 직업, 72종 조합 할 수 있는 다양한 스킬, 400종 이상의 불멸 장비, 1,000가지 독특한 장비가 무한한 영웅 육성 가능성을 제공합니다! 원소 마법으로 적을 공격하거나 인챈트로 신급 무기를 제작하고, 오라 중첩으로 부대를 강화 하여, 자기의 아이디어에 따라 당신만의 창의적인 빌드를 개발하세요!

title: The Tavern Tales: Medieval Simulator
description:
게임 정보

Immerse Yourself in Medieval Life with The Tavern Tales!
In The Tavern Tales, you become the owner of a small, old tavern inherited from your family. Numerous opportunities and challenges await, helping you turn it into a thriving hub of city life:
Tavern Management: Purchase ingredients, take orders, prepare dishes, and serve drinks, personally engaging in every process.
Licenses and Recipes: Acquire licenses to sell alcohol, learn new recipes for food and drinks, and experiment with exotic options that may lead to unexpected results.
Interior Improvement: Add tables, chairs, decorations, and other design elements to attract more guests and create a cozy atmosphere.
Garden: Take care of your garden, grow produce, and earn more by selling it or using it in cooking.
Expeditions: Send sailors to distant lands for exotic resources, seeds, decorations, and recipes. But be cautious — not all discoveries are safe.
Serving the Elite: Don’t forget to please important guests, or the consequences may be unpleasant.
Notice Board: Keep an eye on city news and announcements — they might influence your strategy.
Every action you take matters. Manage your tavern, tend to your garden, send out expeditions, and interact with city residents. Your decisions will shape the reputation and growth of your business.

title: Dreadtome
description:
게임 정보
Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, as well as the battles within your own mind, in this Action-Adventure first person shooter.
This is a student project.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Use your gun, Repulsor gadget and environmental hazards in strategic ways to dispatch the corrupted creatures that roam the library.
Overcome trials of the mind in order to upgrade your tools.
Explore the labyrinthian library to replenish resources, and uncover the story that unfolded before your arrival.
Battle varying enemy types, each with their own unique dangers.

title: Void Sails
description:
게임 정보

이 게임은 언리얼 엔진 5를 사용하여 제작되었으며 많은 차세대 기술을 사용합니다. 예를 들어, Nanite는 모델을 영화 수준의 고정밀로 만들 수 있습니다. Lumen은 자연 환경에 필적하는 빛과 그림자를 제공하여 게임의 낮과 밤의 주기를 사실적이고 섬세하게 만들 수 있습니다. 또한, 이 게임은 1인칭으로 플레이어가 게임을 더욱 몰입감 있게 경험할 수 있습니다.

여러 상을 수상한 World of Goo의 놀라운 후속작에서 다리를 만들고, 탑을 세우고, 지형을 만들고, 비행 기계에 연료를 공급하세요.

World of Goo 2의 아름답고 감명 깊은 사운드트랙에 수십 곡이 새로 수록되었답니다.

title: Anomaly 13
description:
게임 정보
WARNING:
There is a risk of seizures related to photosensitivity. Some people may experience seizures triggered by flashing lights and flickering images, which are common in video games. Even those who have never had such seizures before might be unaware of their condition. We recommend a reasonable restriction on the audience for the game.
Anomaly 13 is a horror game in the walking simulator genre with puzzle elements. As a prospective buyer, Cooper Evans, you will explore a mysterious house and try to uncover its secrets.
Explore the house's surroundings.
Pay attention to changes in the environment.
Solve puzzles and complete assigned tasks.
Overview:
The Anti-Anomaly Organization (AAO) has identified a unique anomaly, designated as "13." To study it in detail, AAO agents have installed hidden cameras in a mysterious house that is soon to be auctioned.
The protagonist, eager to purchase the house at a bargain price, decides to make it their new home. As you move in with your belongings, you remain unaware of the strange events awaiting you.
Anomaly 13 is a horror game that emphasizes shifts in time and space.

title: Banker Simulator
description:
게임 정보

뱅커 시뮬레이터 - 금융 세계의 도전에 맞설 준비가 되셨나요?
파산한 은행을 인수하여 다시 일으켜 세우세요. 고객 만족도를 높이고, 전략적 투자를 하고, 금융 위기를 극복하기 위한 결정을 내리세요. 리스크를 관리하고 은행을 성장시키며 업계에서의 입지를 강화하세요. 이 흥미진진한 시뮬레이션 게임에서 금융 전문가이자 전략의 달인이 되어보세요!

title: Clawed
description:

Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must fight to survive in this Action-Adventure Survival Horror game. Navigate diverse biomes, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within the park. With danger lurking at every turn, shoot, strategize, and escape before the park becomes your grave.

EXPLORE THE PARK'S GROUNDS
Explore Prehistoria, a rundown dinosaur park that has seen better days. Brave deadly dinosaur enclosures, delve into the underground tunnels, and ride the park safari tour. The entire park is yours to uncover as you make your way through this action-adventure, survival-horror.

title: Abyss Ring
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a Culinary Adventure into the Abyss!
Dive into a thrilling survival roguelike where cooking monsters is the key to survival. In this unique dungeon-crawling experience, you must satisfy your hunger by turning defeated monsters into life-saving meals as you journey toward the 100th floor of a perilous, randomly generated dungeon.

title: Debugging Hero
description:

변수 조작 능력을 사용해 공격력과 속도 같은 자신의 능력치를 강화하는 것은 물론,
몬스터의 HP를 0으로 만들어 즉시 처치하거나, 적대감을 바꿔 적을 아군으로 만드는 등 무궁무진한 활용이 가능합니다.

title: Death Ring: Second Impact
description:
게임 정보
자신만의 메카 소대 구성: 9개의 주요 제조업체가 제공하는 장비 라이브러리에서 선택하여 "그리핀" 소대를 완전히 무장시킵니다. 특정 장비 조합은 "연계 스킬"을 발동시킵니다. 예를 들어, "극한" 대검과 "T12" 추진 장치를 동시에 장착하면 "대검 습격" 기술이 활성화됩니다. "H37" 다형태 라이플의 원거리 저격형태와 군집 제압형태 같은 특수한 SP 형태도 갖추고 있습니다.
다양한 기계 부품 조합: 연소, 전자기, 파열, 충격 등 수십 가지 유형의 장착중에서 자기의 전투 스타일을 만들 수 있습니다. 또한, 지휘 센터에 장착을 설치하여 모든 메카에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 혹시도 초기에 성장형장착을 얻고 지휘 센터 패널에 장착하면...

title: Deadly Quiet
description:
게임 정보
경고: 이 비디오 게임은 광과민성 간질을 가진 사람들에게 발작을 유발할 가능성이 있습니다. 플레이어분들은 주의해 주시기 바랍니다.
Deadly Quiet는 악명 높은 호이아 바치우(Hoia Baciu) 숲의 섬뜩한 분위기에 몰입할 수 있는 4인 협동 비대칭 호러 게임입니다. 바디캠(bodycam) 시점을 통해, 팀원들과 함께 숲의 음산한 심연을 헤쳐 나가며 긴장감 넘치고 현실감 있는 체험을 선사합니다. 생존은 팀워크, 전략적 판단, 그리고 숲 속에 도사리는 예측 불가능한 공포에 얼마나 잘 적응하느냐에 달려 있습니다.
당신이 내딛는 발걸음 하나, 작게 내는 소리 하나가 곧바로 그룹의 위치를 노출시킬 수 있으므로, 침묵은 단순한 조언이 아니라 생존의 필수 조건입니다. 과연 당신과 친구들은 협력하여 숲의 사악한 힘을 따돌릴 수 있을까요, 아니면 이 깊은 침묵에 잠식되고 말까요?

title: GOD FORSAKEN
description:
게임 정보
《신이 버린 땅》은 《디아블로》의 요소를 결합한 생존 게임입니다.
신들이 버린 이 절망의 땅에서 어둠이 점차 빛을 삼키고 있습니다. 비틀어진 몬스터들이 사방으로 돌아다니며, 밤은 생명의 금지구역이 되었습니다. 고대의 저주와 표현할 수 없는 악이 땅 아래에서 움직이고 있으며, 운명의 족쇄에 저항할 용기 있는 생존자는 극소수입니다.
이곳이 당신의 전장이며, 당신의 운명입니다. 용사여, 당신은 어떻게 자신의 이야기를 쓸 것인가요?
강력한 전사에서 비밀스러운 마법사, 불멸의 존재를 지배하는 소환사에서 그림자처럼 민첩한 사냥꾼까지, 각 직업마다 고유한 스킬 트리와 성장 경로가 있습니다. 플레이 스타일에 맞게 가장 적합한 직업을 선택하고 고급 전투 잠재력을 해금하여 당신만의 전설을 만들어보세요.
몹의 물결을 맞이하여 숨을 돌릴 기회는 없습니다! 모든 전투는 도전으로 가득 찼습니다. 보통 적부터 강력한 엘리트, 그리고 천지를 무너뜨리는 보스까지, 모든 상대는 당신의 조작 기술, 전략, 그리고 즉석 대응력을 시험합니다. 가장 인내심 강한 용사만이 생존할 수 있습니다.

title: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
description:
게임 정보
Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
Every Scan, Every Choice, Humanity’s Survival Depends on You.
Step into the boots of an army officer in Quarantine Zone: The Last Checkpoint, a gripping survival simulation where every decision is a question of life or death for somebody. In a world ravaged by a zombie outbreak, you oversee a critical checkpoint tasked with separating healthy refugees from the infected—and sometimes, the merely suspicious.
Key Features:
Resource Management: Balance limited supplies of test kits and inspection tools while maintaining order and ensuring your checkpoint remains secure.
Dynamic Threats: Face an evolving queue of refugees—some healthy, some carrying ordinary illnesses, and others harboring deadly zombie pathogens.

title: QIMEN Tower Defense

・상문(傷門): 몬스터의 출병 기지를 파괴하여 한쪽 길의 몬스터가 전진하는 것을 막을 수 있습니다.

title: Y2ROLL
description:
게임 정보
Y2ROLL is an N64-style minimalistic physics-based arcade-style marble rolling game that will take you back to the turn of the millennium.
Features
Minimalistic gameplay that is easy to pick up, with a very high skill ceiling and constant opportunities for skill expression
Return to the 32bit console era
Vibrant N64-style graphics and art direction
Soundtrack inspired by atmospheric/intelligent DnB music
Easy to pick up
Every level simply asks you to reach the goal
Every level can be played with a single analogue stick or WASD keys
Hard to master
Later levels will test the movement mastery of even genre veterans
Replay levels to try and earn elusive gold medal times

title: Eden: Discovery
description:
게임 정보
EDEN: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic first-person extraction shooter where 20 players enter a dangerous wasteland, each armed with a primary and secondary weapon. Your goal is simple: loot and reach an extraction point before time runs out—or risk losing everything you carry. Players can scavenge gear from crates, defeat AI threats guarding valuable supplies, or take down rival players to claim their loot. If you’re killed, all your equipment drops, and your killer can pick it up. Multiple players can extract and win if they survive; in some matches, no one makes it out alive.
Key Features:
• High-Stakes Extraction
Gather gear from crates, fallen foes, or AI-guarded areas, then make it to the exfil point to secure your haul. Dying means you lose everything you’ve collected.
• In-Game Currency & Tournaments
Earn and spend in-game currency on gear or enter buy-in matches. Settle your score with 1v1 showdowns where you compete for loot or currency.
• Social Spaces
Between matches, return to a shared hub where you can relax, plan your next raid, and trade with other players. This space is persistent, keeping your prized gear on display.
• Future Creative Mode
Build your own maps and game modes for others to explore. Host custom matches where you control the rules, bringing new challenges and fun to the community.
• Multiple Paths to Victory
Survive the wasteland, escape on time, or challenge rivals 1v1. Whether you’re outsmarting AI threats or battling other players, every decision can lead to glory—or complete loss.
EDEN: Discovery blends tense firefights with meaningful risk and reward. It’s not just about shooting—it’s about planning your loadout, picking your battles, and deciding when to cut your losses. Welcome to a world where every match carries real consequences, and only the savviest competitors come out on top.
• Marketplace & Player Economy
Every item you find or craft holds real worth. Trade gear with others using the in-game currency, fueling a player-driven economy.
• PvPvE Gameplay
Face tense firefights against human players while dealing with AI adversaries guarding high-tier loot and strategic locations.

title: Aura Kingdom - Impact
description:
게임 정보
The classic Japanese anime fantasy MMORPG world, Aura Kingdom: Impact, officially returns with a global version launching soon!
Featuring a passionate anime style, stunning characters, and elements of fantastical adventure. Players will experience the brand-new class "Floating Cannon," along with innovative gameplay such as Eidolon Inlay and free weapon switching, delivering an unparalleled adventure experience.
"Awaken Resonance! Eidolon Awakening, Fateful Fracas begins now!"
Form contracts with Eidolons, connect destinies, and resonate to forge the strongest Ties That Bind! Protect the origin, conquer fate! Venture into the fantasy world alongside your Eidolon and explore the infinite possibilities brought by Eidolon Awakening.
Global Version Game Features
[New Class "Floating Cannon" — A technological revolution of elemental Rift!]
Harnessing ice and fire elements with the ability to switch attributes, it gains temporary superpower through "Rift Mode." In battle, entering Rift Mode allows the Floating Cannon to attack with a secondary attribute for enhanced strikes, neutralizing potential effects between attributes.
[Free Weapon Switching — Your combat style, your choice!]
No need to retrain characters: Experience different Skills combinations without recreating characters. Freely switch main weapons to adapt to various battle scenarios and craft your unique combat style.
[Eidolon Inlay × Resonance System — Create your exclusive combat archetype!]
Equip Skills with Eidolons: Alter combat effects and create exclusive fighting styles. Reduce the burden of strengthening new Eidolons and easily cultivate ultimate power. Focus on leveling up primary Eidolons while newly acquired ones can level up using the Resonance system.
[Weapon Inlay × Enhancement System — Forge your personalized divine weapon!]
Cultivate exclusive divine weapons: Enhance weapon specialization levels to unlock more gem inlay slots. Customize diverse combinations to create your ultimate personal weapon.
[Convenience System × Global Communication Without Borders]
Origin Helper: Offers features like automatic Item usage and discarding Items for easier character management.
Language switching and real-time translation: Eliminate communication barriers and foster connections among global players.

title: Ventomori
description:
게임 정보
Ventomori is a 3D asynchronous puzzle co-op that places you centre stage as intrepid astronauts on their way to Planet M-113, Xanahspati, hoping to unveil the secrets behind a mysterious distress call. 
Join forces to brave the unknown
Choose to be the eyes from above on the space station as the Control player or conquer your fears as you plunge headfirst towards planet Xanahspati as the Scout. Work in tandem to solve puzzles, manage your oxygen, and ensure each other’s survival as you traverse. But be careful, silence here… is quite deadly.
Discover the past, reveal the future
Towering ruins of intrigue await in this narrative driven world. Take in the melancholic sights and deduce the history of the unseen Padullurians as you navigate around monoliths of ancient, alien technology and the planet’s harsh, bone-rending winds.
If at first you don’t succeed…
Try and try again to hone your experience with each attempt. Draw out every last breath of your oxygen and overcome your struggles together till you reach the end. The digital bodies may fade, but the everpresent minds remember.

title: Go To Sleep
description:
게임 정보
Was that door always open? Or is something peeking out from inside the closet? Is that breathing yours or is that just the demon under the bed waiting for you to close your eyes?
Go To Sleep is a short first-person point-and-click survival horror game where you play as a young teen trapped in a dream-turned-nightmare. Stuck in his bedroom, you must survive until morning keeping a relentless demon at bay with your only source of support being a tiny stuffed companion.
Will you make it until the morning?

title: ReCharge RC: High Voltage
description:
게임 정보
Customize your vehicle, Create your very own race tracks, Share them online and race your friends best times with global online leaderboards. Created by an RC enthusiast, for RC enthusiasts! High speeds, huge jumps, big drifts, ReCharge RC: High Voltage is a racing game unlike anything youve ever played before!
From the creator of the hit indie racer played by millions: ReCharge RC! With a community-driven development approach, get involved and lets make the best RC game ever!
Featuring:
A fun and rewarding sim-cade handling model
that blurs the line between arcade and simulation. Inspired by real life RC but tuned to be an absolute blast to pick up and play. Noobs, racing game fans, RC enthusiasts, and pro racers alike will enjoy the intuitive arcade handling with just enough sim based elements to make those coming from real life RC feel right at home and provide intense competition. title: The Hatchling

The Overseer watches—cold, unwavering, and silent in its judgment. You are but one of many caretakers before you, each evaluated, each replaced. Failure is not an option.

title: Texas HoldEm POKER
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to play the world's most popular poker game? Texas Hold 'em will take you into an exciting world of strategy, mental games and endless possibilities!
Ready to experience the world-famous poker game? Texas Hold'em will take you into an exciting world of strategy, psychological battles, and endless possibilities!
Here’s a quick guide to Texas Hold'em:
1. Game Objective
Use your two hole cards and the five community cards to create the best possible five-card hand and win the pot (the total chips bet by players).
2. Game Flow
Deal Hole Cards:
Each player receives two private cards (visible only to them).
Betting Rounds:
Pre-flop: First round of betting after receiving hole cards.
Flop: Three community cards are revealed, followed by a second betting round.
Turn: A fourth community card is revealed, followed by a third betting round.
River: The fifth and final community card is revealed, followed by the last betting round.
Showdown:
If multiple players remain, they reveal their hands. The strongest five-card hand wins the pot.
3. Hand Rankings
From strongest to weakest:
Royal Flush (A-K-Q-J-10 of the same suit)
Straight Flush (Five consecutive cards of the same suit)
Four of a Kind (Four cards of the same rank)
Full House (Three of a kind + a pair)
Flush (Five cards of the same suit, not in sequence)
Straight (Five consecutive cards, mixed suits)

Establish a Secure Outpost: Create a functional base to escape the harsh realities of space.
Survive the Void
Manage Your Oxygen Supply: In the unforgiving vacuum of space, oxygen is your most critical resource.
autokwd: Survival In Space Is Not Guaranteed

title: Fairy Tale TD 2 童话塔防2
description:
게임 정보
동화탑방어는 3D 만화풍의 탑방어게임으로서 게임에는 많은 관문이 있는데 매 관문마다 게임을 시작할 때 소량의 자원을 주어 몬스터를 처치하면 더욱 많은 자원을 얻을수 있다.
게임에서 각 몬스터의 생명치와 이동 속도가 다릅니다. 몬스터가 에너지 보호막을 가지고 있을 때 생명치가 높아집니다. 호박포탑은 에너지 보호막을 가진 몬스터에게 추가 데미지를 입힙니다.
피쳐:
6 가지 승급 가능한 방어포탑
16종 몬스터(일반 몬스터 8종 + 보호막이 있는 일반 몬스터 8종)
25개 관문
autokwd: Fairy Tale TD 2 童话塔防2

title: Cats Visiting Historical Times
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a Whisker-Twitching Time-Travel Quest!
When a mischievous portal suddenly opens, a curious cat and their bewildered owner are swept away on an extraordinary journey through history! Now, they must explore ancient civilizations, uncover hidden cats, and piece together clues to find their way back home.
Explore Legendary Eras:
Travel through Mesopotamia, Ancient Egypt, Ancient Greece, the Roman Empire, the Viking Age, the Middle Ages, and the Golden Age of Pirates—each beautifully recreated with immersive visuals and playful historical details.
Find Cats of All Kinds:
Friendly Cats – Happy to be found, these kitties offer fun facts about their time period.
Shy Cats – Masters of disguise, they hide cleverly but leave behind paw prints, knocked-over objects, or flickering tails.
Historian Cats – Rare and wise, these special felines share fascinating knowledge about their era, unlocking entries in your Cat Encyclopedia.
Two Exciting Game Modes:
Story Mode – A relaxed adventure where you explore each era, uncover secrets, and meet quirky historical characters.
Arcade Mode – A fast-paced challenge! Race against the clock to find all the hidden cats and climb the leaderboards.
Collect, Learn, and Unlock:
Fill your Cat Collection with adorable felines from across time.
Discover hidden artifacts and unlock bonus mini-games (like deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphs or navigating a Viking ship!).
Upgrade your tools with a cat whistle or time compass to make finding shy cats easier.
A Purr-fect Blend of Fun & Learning:
With its charming art style, humorous dialogue, and lighthearted take on history, Cats Visiting Historical Times is a delightful adventure for cat lovers, history buffs, and gamers of all ages. Will you help these time-traveling companions make it home—or will you stay forever lost in history?
tag: 캐주얼,숨은 그림 및 물체,손으로 그린,싱글 플레이어

title: Pirates - Rogue's Fortune
description:
게임 정보

Take on the role of Henry Barrington, a returning pirate captain, in this immersive roguelite. Your quest for wealth and glory has led you to the far reaches of the Caribbean in search of the legendary Mapoya treasure.

title: Smash It Wild
description:
게임 정보
챔피언들이 무자비한 토너먼트에서 정면으로 승부를 가르는 판타지 세계에 뛰어드세요. 배구와 피구가 결합된 전술적 턴 기반 게임 Smash It Wild에서는 한 경기 한 경기가 모두 중요합니다. 선수들을 업그레이드하고, 강력한 아이템으로 무장하고, 고유한 시너지를 발견하여 로그라이크 경쟁에서 최선을 다해 살아남으세요. 단 한 번만 패배해도 처음부터 다시 시작해야 합니다.
[h2]무적의 팀 만들기[/h2]
다양한 능력을 보유한 동물 팀을 이끄세요. 각 팀에는 독특한 전술이 존재하며, 모든 매치에서 각기 다른 도전을 경험할 수 있습니다. 강력한 공격을 잠금 해제하고 시너지를 선택해서 게임 플레이 방식을 완벽하게 연마하세요.
[h2]패배는 성장의 씨앗[/h2]
이 로그라이크 토너먼트에서는 멈추지 않는 연승을 기록해야만 우승컵을 차지할 수 있습니다. 한 번만 패배해도 처음부터 다시 시작해야 합니다. 그리고 패배할 때마다 새롭게 배우고 성장할 기회를 얻을 수 있습니다. 훈련 세션과 기술, 아이템을 신중하게 선택해서 상대보다 유리한 고지를 점하세요.

title: Broken Arrow
description:
게임 정보
Broken Arrow is a large-scale real-time modern warfare tactics game. The base game features both the American and Russian factions, each containing 5 unique sub-factions like the marines, armored, airborne, and more.
Broken Arrow brings the genre to a whole new level by combining the complexity of a joint-forces wargame with the typical real-time tactics action-packed gameplay.
ACTION-PACKED COMBAT
Deploy to the battlefield via land, sea and air. Use paratroopers and helicopters to rapidly seize key locations, reinforce them with heavy tanks and break enemy counter attacks with artillery and tactical missile strikes.
Infiltrate special forces behind enemy lines to disrupt enemy logistics and provide laser designation for your planes. Use the terrain to your advantage to ambush, out flank and outsmart your enemy.
LARGE URBAN BATTLEFIELDS
Land with your amphibious troops in large industrial harbors, airdrop troops and vehicles to seize airports and air bases, fight in the middle of a large refinery or in entire cities filled with large apartment blocks, malls and high risers.
Broken Arrow’s large battlefields are based on actual places to reinforce their realism.
CUSTOM UNITS
The game features over 300 units and each of them can be customized in multiple ways, resulting in more than 1500 combinations.
Modern vehicles and aircraft are generally compatible with different weapons and armor packages; Broken Arrow features a detailed customisation system that allows you to modify the specific components of your units.

title: Otherskin
description:
게임 정보

A mission that’s expected to be your last:
Planet Vandermire, the ancestral home of the extinct “Magna” species, is suspected to be the source of the ever expanding Corruption; a universal threat to all life in the universe. Alex is “lucky” number 13 of volunteering Space Crusaders, ready to give their life in deadly solo-expeditions on the planet's surface. Mission “Exodus” empowers individuals with a unique high technology AI suit in order to gather as much information as possible, before falling to the Corruption. It is hoped that with each attempt, scientists can increase the time of survival on the surface and find a solution to contain the Corruption.

Collect alien morphs to expand your abilities:
While Alex explores the planet, every enemy encounter can change your experience! By absorbing alien "morphs", you gather new moves and powers that can literally turn the world upside down.

Improve your unique AI-powered suit:
Upgrade your suit powers and maximise weapon impact, life support and combat agility. The high tech suit includes an AI voice that will help Alex on her journey.

Ranged weapons and melee combat:
Use your most powerful ranged weapons and combine them with fast close combat moves. It's a breeze to switch between both.

Explore Vandermire:
This foreign planet is full of varied biomes. Scout every corner of this beautiful but dangerous alien world in order to collect more information about the origins of the Corruption.

title: Crown of Greed
description:
게임 정보
Greetings, heir of Rodovia. Are you ready to claim your rightful throne? If so, know this - ruling a fantasy kingdom is no easy feat. Welcome to the Crown of Greed, a classic strategy game inspired by old-school traditions, featuring a unique indirect command system, so unusual among other strategy games.
Try your hand as a ruler
Plan, build and expand your own fantasy kingdom, filling it with a variety of upgradable buildings. Choose from a wide range of economic facilities, workshops, military buildings, and hero dwellings to secure the safety and well-being of your people. Their gratitude will come in the form of generous taxes, only yours to use.

title: Pivot of Hearts
description:
게임 정보
Pivot of Hearts is a non-monogamous romance visual novel with a simple card game built into it. It takes place in the city of São Paulo and tells the story of Wén Xiàn, a taiwanese-brazilian game developer who, after a long period of isolation, starts finding chances to open his heart again: he suddenly reconnects with Etsuko, someone important from his past, and forms an unexpected bond with a new colleague, Cauã. As he navigates through an exciting TTRPG adventure, heavy metal concerts, magical-boy dreams, and the usual young adult suffering, Wén will have to reexamine his old notions of love and play his cards right in order to achieve true happiness.

Features:
♥ 8 hours of gameplay
♥ Tarot-based card game mechanic
♥ 5 different endings
♥ Healthy non-monogamy!
♥ Original soundtrack by Livia Maki Yoshikawa
♥ Original illustrations by Raviolivs
♥ Available in Portuguese and English

title: Sparkball
description:
게임 정보
Sparkball is a fast-paced 4v4 sports brawler that blends high-octane action with deep strategy. Choose your hero from a roster of quirky, unforgettable characters and dive into a thrilling mix of brawlin’ and ballin’. Your mission: outplay your opponents, control the field, and score in the enemy team’s goal.
With its dynamic gameplay and engaging plays, Sparkball rewards skillful teamwork. Whether you’re smashing foes, passing with precision, or pulling off game-changing plays, Sparkball will keep you on your toes and craving just one more match.
Master a roster of unique heroes, each with distinct abilities and playstyles.

title: Hell Clock
description:
게임 정보
THE HELL CLOCK IS TICKING
In the 19th century, a grim chapter of Brazilian history unfolded in the badlands. The settlement of Canudos had grown into a sanctuary for thousands seeking refuge. But when they defied the newly formed Republican Army, their resistance was met with devastating force. 25,000 men, women, and children were massacred.
Play as Pajeú, a warrior who earned his freedom in battle, fighting to rescue the soul of The Counselor—his mentor and spiritual leader of Canudos. With each descent, time bends, and your powers grow as you face ever-stronger horrors commanding the dark forces that claimed The Counselor's head and trapped his soul.
RACE AGAINST TIME
Every second counts as you battle the undead forces of your oppressors. Risk delving deeper for powerful loot and face the nightmarish incarnations of those who sought to bury the truth.
FORGE UNSTOPPABLE BUILDS

title: KreatureKind
description:
게임 정보
KreatureKind는 쉽게 입문할 수 있고 건전한 카드 배틀/덱 빌딩 게임으로 괴물과 논쟁하여 마법을 구해야 합니다! 
일곱 가지 플레이어블 캐릭터를 활용해 팀을 결성하세요. (슬프고 감성적인 소년이 좋다면 루카를, 허를 찌르고 싶다면 라일리를 선택하세요)
캐릭터들은 저마다 장단점이 뚜렷하므로 토론에서 승리하려면 균형을 잘 잡아야 합니다!
 배우기는 쉽게, 고수가 되기는 어렵게 
이런 종류의 게임이 처음이라면 어느 정도 배워야 하는 과정을 거쳐야 합니다. (괜찮아요, 퀸도 게임이라면 젬병이니까요) 
핀리처럼 시중의 모든 카드 배틀 게임을 다 해 보셨나요? 어느 쪽이든 이 괴물들이라면 좋은 상대가 될 거예요!

title: Fungiman 2
description:
게임 정보
The mysterious yet strangely alluring sequel to beloved horror game Fungiman.
You are a cook and a cook needs their ingredients. What ingredients might require the help of your old friend Fungiman? What's so important that makes you go on a journey through deserts and snowy mountaintops?
You are making THE donut. The one world has never seen or tasted before, and Fungiman is there to stop you. Will you let it happen?

Features:
• A big interconnected multi-area map
• Multiple different endings
• SECRETS
• Unique retro art style

title: Isle Of Pirates
description:
게임 정보
 Ahoy, Captain! Welcome to Isle of Pirates! 
The waves are calling you, the wind fills your sails! From a deserted island to an epic pirate paradise, will you have the courage and wit to lead the way? If your answer is "Aye, Captain!", then you’re in the right waters!
Gather Resources!
A sailor’s treasure isn’t just gold! Chop down trees, break stones, and collect materials! Remember, a strong pirate base needs a solid foundation.
Build Your Tavern!
Every great captain needs a home! Use your resources to build an epic pirate tavern and spread your name across the oceans with every wave!
Decorate Your Tavern!
Pirates don’t just swing swords; they love a good atmosphere too! Hang lanterns from the ceiling, pin ancient maps to the walls, or maybe make space for a pirate band? Should it be lavish, or more like a dark pirate lair? The choice is yours, Captain!
Set Sail into the Blue Waters!
There are unexplored islands on the horizon, lands that aren’t even on the map! The helm is calling you, are you ready to explore? Remember, great treasures require great adventures!

title: Pawfect Inc.
description:
게임 정보
We aim to liberate every friend trapped in tedious desk jobs!
This is an idle casual game that sits at the bottom of your screen. Simply play by clicking and dragging—or do nothing at all, and the game will keep running on its own. In the game, you’ll recruit adorable animals to work at your startup company. Your job? Be the boss and make sure they don’t slack off! Profits generated by their work or spending can be used to renovate or expand your cozy office—or splurge on cyber-themed indulgences. After all, you’re the boss!
Character Design
The game features a wide variety of adorable animals (only a few designs are shown here). Each has unique personalities, career backgrounds, and quirks—these differences are part of the fun! What will they do once they join your company?
Office Customization
The game offers diverse range of themed scenes and furniture to match. Unleash your creativity and design a one-of-a-kind office!
You can even change the exterior buildings to place your office in any city you like—Tokyo skyscrapers, Parisian alleys, or cyberpunk metropolises!
Furniture & Props
Every piece of furniture you buy for the office unlocks new interactions for your animal employees. The more variety you add, the richer their behaviors become! Plus, you can click on these cute furniture items with your mouse to interact with them yourself!
The translation preserves the playful and motivational tone while adapting idioms like "摸鱼" (slacking off) and (cyber-themed indulgences) for natural English readability. Let me know if you need adjustments!

title: Mini Star Quest
description:
게임 정보
사냥의 시간!
미니 스타 퀘스트는 턴제 액션 게임입니다. 티켓을 모아 퀘스터들을 모집하고 여러개의 강력한 파티들을 편성하여 거대한 적들을 화끈하게 사냥해보세요!
특징
자신만의 파티들을 완성해보세요! 한 퀘스트에 최대 3개의 파티를 동시에 데려갈 수 있습니다
하나의 파티로 단기 퀘스트를 도전하거나, 또는 최대 3개의 파티로 장기전을 도전해보세요!
퀘스트를 완료하고 티켓을 모아 귀여운 퀘스터들을 모집해보세요!
귀엽고 컬러풀하며 화려하기까지한 턴제 액션에 푹 빠져보세요!

title: Dino Tower Arena
description:
게임 정보
Dino Tower Arena is a action roguelite game where you can build your dinosaur with different abilities and put it into fights against waves of enemy dinos, upgrading it with new abilities, boosting its stats and unlocking new dinosaurs while advancing on the floors of the enormous Dino Tower!

title: Space Saga
description:
게임 정보
우주의 광대한 공간은 오래전부터 인류를 매료시켰으며, 그 신비로운 깊이는 우리 모두의 호기심과 탐험에 대한 열망을 불러일으키는 비밀과 수수께끼로 가득 차 있습니다. **SPACE SAGA**에서 당신은 진정한 우주 탐험가가 될 기회를 얻게 되며, 위험과 미스터리로 가득 찬 스릴 넘치는 모험에 뛰어들게 됩니다.

title: Rusty Flesh
description:
게임 정보
Rusty Flesh is a sci-fi horror puzzle platformer for the Game Boy Color where you switch gravity instead of jumping (guess you could call it a VVVVVV-like!). Explore the different areas of a derelict spaceship putting together all the pieces of its lovecraftian mistery, and enjoy its retro-futuristic aesthetics.

In the near future, Earth has become a wasteland, unfit for any kind of life. Nations fell, and big tech corporations seized power. They had been getting ready for this. They built massive spaceships where a few chosen ones would travel for hundreds of years, looking for a new home. The Grampus was one of those ships... but something went wrong.
Features
Explore a derelict spaceship: Something's wrong in this spaceship, and it's up to you to discover what happened. Explore the ship and find clues in a non-linear narrative.
Solve gravity-based puzzles: Combine your gravity switch with other mechanics to progress through Rusty Flesh's series of puzzles.
Fight undead abominations: The former crew members have been turned into undead monsters, and they are after you.
8-bit retro gaming fun: Get back to the glorious days of 8-bit handheld gaming! Rusty Flesh actually runs on a Game Boy Color, with all its limitations.

Note: The description, screenshots and trailer you see depict a game that is still in development. All content is subject to change as development continues.

title: Little Knight 2: Old Dreams
description:
게임 정보
Little Knight 2: Dark Souls of the Past "is the official 3D RPG sequel to the classic" Little Knight ", continuing the passion and adventurous spirit of its predecessor, and creating a broader and more free medieval fantasy world. Players will take on the role of a young knight, growing from an unknown apprentice to a legendary hero renowned throughout the world. The game integrates a deep combat system, equipment reinforcement and drop, rich plot branches, and open world exploration, bringing an immersive medieval adventure experience.
① Hundreds of paranormal points are available for you to challenge, pass levels to obtain talents, and monsters can drop specified ordinary/special/set equipment from paranormal points, fight against wild monsters, and continuously become stronger from a novice
② In the game, fighting monsters, challenging alien points, and exploring maps will all earn loot. Defeating monsters will continuously drop loot and crystals to strengthen equipment, match equipment, and collect set effects, allowing you to receive a large number of rewards in the game
③ There are dagger/axe/sword/spear/shield/hammer/machete and 4 types of skills in the game for you to match to create different genres. Light/dark/fire/wind skills also interact with each other, such as wind skills summoning a magic helmet at a designated location and releasing the wind skills magic helmet together
autokwd: Little Knight 2: Old Dreams,小骑士2黯苏旧梦

title: Dark Dungeon Feminized
description:
게임 정보
Story background
[Theta Foundation] is a laboratory with the highest security level deep underground, specially set up to contain and study [weird monsters]. After experiencing a system crash, the laboratory, which was closed according to the emergency protocol, became the darkest dungeon
You will play the role of a special agent who survived the crash and try your best to escape from here
As the exit gets closer, the monster will become more and more crazy
Don't be deceived by the appearance of the monster
In order to protect your sanity from being eroded, you are implanted with a [cognitive filter] - but while it saves you from madness, it also distorts your senses, making the creepy monster look like a gorgeous beauty, but a monster is still a monster...

title: Lighthouse Of The Souls
description:
게임 정보
그는 신비주의에 정통한 추기경이었는데, 그의 수행원들과 함께 외딴 섬으로 파견되었습니다. 임무는 고대 문명의 비밀을 밝히는 것입니다. 당신의 임무는 그 비밀을 찾는 것입니다. 하지만 당신이 발견하는 것은 당신의 신앙과 인간성을 시험할 것입니다.
설명
Lighthouse Of The Souls는 RPG 요소와 사실적인 그래픽을 갖춘 3인칭 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다. 혼자 또는 친구들과 함께 어둠의 세계에서 도전에 맞서세요. 그 도전에서 생존 여부는 여러분의 기술과 전략에 달려 있습니다.

title: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme
description:
게임 정보
R.A.C.E is an action game set in a post-apocalyptic world of steel monsters and epic battles! Survival racing simulator! Welcome to a unique game where the management, pumping and control of the car at the highest level! Real steel rage in survival races! Get engaged in 3D ultimate race battles, fire rockets and use the protective shield to counter the attack from the enemy. Nitro Boost is mandatory! Collect turbo while you hit that gas pedal and leave all other race cars behind. You decide the rules on the track while you drift, drag, bump, collide, fire and overtake to finish first!

FAST ACTION RACING IN 3D
Monster trucks, roaring engines, smoking tires, damaging collisions, and above all Speed! R.A.C.E. - Rocket Arena Car Extreme - is full of epic explosions, destruction and effects. Press nitro - get even more adrenaline, and let your enemies breathe dust. The change of day and night, the neon signs and tricks will never let you get bored. If you like to play with beautiful graphics and no brakes, then this is your race car game of choice! You can change the graphics settings to improve the gameplay quality and smoothness.

THE ULTIMATE RACE BATTLE EXPERIENCE
Your Monster Truck, your arena, your rules! Participate in Arena battles and get straight in to the real action. Burn out your enemies in the derby arena and race them into fire traps, huge morgensterns, chainsaws and other destructive obstacles. This race game is like a real action movie! Rocket Arena Car Extreme (R.A.C.E.) is a burning cocktail of survival races and battles on wheels.

VARIOUS BATTLE LOCATIONS
Participate in battles of different historical epochs!

THE BEST ENEMY IS THE BEATEN ENEMY
Crazy and dangerous driving is a good thing in this racing game because risks are needed to beat your enemies. Choose a weapon to your liking: missiles, bombs, machine guns, and various electric weapons.

BEST ARENA RACE VEHICLES
Win action-packed races and earn rewards to collect your ultimate off-road race car. Make the most out of the vehicles available to you. You will find American muscle cars, European classics and Japanese drift vehicles! Each car is equipped with everything you may need to inflict the maximal damage to your opponents. Those monsters on wheels will cope with any off-road conditions.


Each vehicle may be leveled up as high as level 30. When a vehicle is leveled up to levels 10, 20 and 30, it gains unique body kits that improve race and battle performance even more.


Have you ever wondered if the tank is half full or half empty? The positive attitude rules in this action game - the tank is always full. No need to wait for several hours to restore energy for your car to start racing. You can always rush at full throttle without any limits!


Get prepared to battle for the rank. Many players fight to become the first one and to grab the main reward - the all-time champion title. Upgrade your cars, unlock new ones, upgrade your super skills and perks, upgrade your weapons and win on the road!


Enjoy the specially designed music to feel the excitement of the spectacular speed and explosive competition during the races.


You can change the graphics settings to improve the gameplay quality and smoothness. Unique car skins, colorful and vibrant styles of drawings and car stickers!


- Battle Arena – battle royale style racing
- Career – Race career campaign
- Battle Racing - Racing vehicles special mode
- Tournaments - Racing for the greatest rewards.

Play our racing game, upgrade your cars, crush your enemies, win prizes and become the king of survival races!

title: AirShooShoo
description:
게임 정보
A unique platformer, where you have to collect stars and shards flying through challenging levels. Avoiding obstacles, having the most precise movements to squeeze in some more seconds.


In single player mode the level difficulty increases slowly, giving plenty of time to enjoy and learn the challenging mechanics of flying between the platforms.


You can go one step further and aim for speed! This game is especially designed for speedrunning, an homage to the style was deeply my intention. Playing against your own time, or against the Global Leaderboards.


Challenge each other in online TimeTrials. Playing on the same level racing for the best time. Highly inspired by TrackMania Nations. A very fun mode with a high pressure sharp skill challenge.



Let's Kill each other! Online, high speed, fast paced, tactical good old shooting! Head-On: The Ultimate Gravity Shooter is considered the predecessor of this game. Try that online was the ultimate goal! Hope you enjoy that mode, it is my favourite.




Choose the skin of your ship, choose your trail, your weapons! Fine tune the engine, even the nitty-gritty details can be set to your taste. To perform on the highest level, you might need those.

title: SIMP: Super Infection Massive Pathology
description:
게임 정보


"The greatest infection in the world is love."

Gaylord took that phrase very seriously when, during his wedding, a giant syringe interrupted the ceremony and abducted all his friends and his fiancée, Zoe...

"A small infection in a needle" - the doctors said... but they had no idea what a true SIMP could do.



Travel throughout the human body, annihilating hordes of enemies and overcoming normal obstacles and traps. A leg? An eye? The rectum? Of course!

Additionally, the obstacles in some maps are dynamically generated, so each game will be different.



Face numerous enemies, from simple Slimes, macrophages, and proteins to a dangerous tapeworm! Over 20 different enemies, each with their own attack and strategy.



Enjoy over 50 weapons, 30 items, and 10 different buildings to customize your build and destroy the human body!

title: Upwards
description:
게임 정보
On the outskirts of a small village stands a massive tree whose canopy disappears far above the clouds. While grandiose on the outside, its interior houses the humble Mortem Post, which receives and delivers letters from those who have passed on. Deciding to break protocol to lend a helping wing, Rain, a flighty little courier takes a skittish girl by the name of Mila on an adventure through the inner workings of the post office. Together, they search for a letter containing the last words of someone who seemingly never existed.
One part visual novel, one part puzzle adventure! Follow Rain and Mila through the mysterious Mortem Post as they meet with various couriers working throughout the tree and make use of Rain's trusty stamp collection to overcome a myriad of obstacles that stand in their way!
Often during your adventure, you'll need to take advantage of stamps to tie words together in intuitive ways to help Rain and Mila out of various sticky situations. No two puzzles are exactly the same -- from choose-your-own-adventure style outcomes to stealth missions, you'll see just how versatile Rain's stamps can really be!
autokwd: Upwards, Rain! The Post Office of Farewells

title: Sinbad
description:
게임 정보
Sinbad is a charming 3D sandbox platfomer inspired by A Thousand and One Arabian Nights and games such as Super Mario and A Hat in Time.

It follows a young Sinbad who stumbles upon a Magic Lamp and gets sucked in and trapped inside! Finding this secret magical land in turmoil Sinbad must help a Genie usurped from his throne to overpower the evil Jinn to restore order in the Lamp in order to escape as well!

During this adventure, Sinbad discovers a magic carpet that becomes his companion. This wonderful and magical carpet allows him to hover and interact with various objects around the world. As the player, you must collect Magic Lanterns to disperse the evil curse that the Jinn has placed upon the land.



You explore many different locations and environments around the mystical island inside the Magic Lamp, each area with a different story to tell.

Collect all Magic Lanterns in order to defeat the Jinn and return to the real world!

title: Find Exit
description:
게임 정보


When you wake up, you find yourself in a surreal world full of amazing things, but have you woken up?

What is a dream?
Memories from past lives?
Projection of pictures from the subconscious?

You don't know who you are.
You don't know where you are.
You don't know what to do.

Maybe it's time to wake up?

Find Exit — is a art work with an open world full of secrets. In the game you have to solve riddles relying solely on your intellect, use: abstract, logical and associative methods of thinking, perhaps then the way out will open to you. The game is based on a silent narrative, and also proceeds from the fact that an intelligent person who values his time interacts with it. Not a single game element exists just for complication, every detail carries a thought. The whole picture is saturated with meaning. Travel, contemplate, analyze the world around you, and discover all its secrets by solving riddles.

The game contains mixed genres such as puzzle, psychological horror, slasher.

title: Porta-Tower
description:
게임 정보
Porta-Tower is a roguelike tower defense game where you can pick up and move your towers to better cover the enemies' path.
Move Your Towers
A tower's placement is important, so when a position becomes suboptimal, pick it up and move it! How much you want to move them will depend on what type of towers you have. Long-ranged towers can be left alone for longer while short-ranged towers will need to be moved more frequently to stay in range of enemies.
Upgrade Your Towers
When you've gathered enough crystals, move your tower to the upgrader and upgrade it. Be careful, though, as moving a tower to the upgrader will take it out of the defense until you put it back in position.
Unlockable Towers
As you play, you'll unlock new towers to be used in future runs. Expand your collection of towers to destroy enemies in whatever way you want.

title: Friend of a Slime
description:
게임 정보
Stranded at the shore of mystic woods you will join the troops of slimes to defeat hordes of enemies threatening the kingdom of Holy Slime. But no worries, you won't fight those battles alone. Your cute, little, yet combat ready companion will help you with your mission.
Collect fruits on your journey to transform your companion and make it even stronger!

Play together on a single keyboard or with gamepad controllers!
Player 2 will take over the control of Slime.
Features:
Survivors-like action in short 10 minute sessions
20 weapons
20 wearables
30 artifacts that last through rounds
Slime companion that can be transformed
Lightweight RPG World
Minimalistic Dialogues

title: Shade Silver 2 A Walk In The Darkness
description:
게임 정보
Shade Silver 2 A Walk In The Darkness is a game about a wizard trapped in a nightmare looking for an exit. He must stop his nightmares form becoming real and taking over reality.
Achievements
34 levels
Wider verity of game play
More horror like than the first
New death animations
New looks for Shade Silver
More Puzzles
New Bosses
Harder and more fun mazes
2 Dreams AKA Nightmares Basically 2 Games
Get ready to have nightmares and run for you life in a spellbinding Horror game made just for you. Shade Silver 2 A Walk In The Darkness is a new adventure to help you satisfy your cravings for Nightmares.
autokwd: Shade Silver 2 A Walk In The Darkness

title: The Merry Fairy
description:
게임 정보
Deep in the heart of the Fairyland forest lies a hidden sanctuary of creativity and wonder—The Merry Fairy. As a cherished guest in Fairy’s enchanted cottage, you’ll step into a world where journaling becomes pure magic. Collect whimsical decorations, adorable doodles, and uplifting quotes to create stunning journal spreads that capture your most magical thoughts.

Gather a delightful collection of stickers, doodles, and decorations to bring your journal to life. Arrange them freely to craft beautiful spreads that reflect your dreams, thoughts, and inspirations. Add your own thoughts with customisable freeform entries, or print your journal spread designs so you can add your handwriting offline.  

Let the soft glow of lanterns, the gentle rustling of leaves, and the soothing and carefully curated melodies of Fairyland transport you to a world of tranquillity. Customize your journaling space with warm candlelight, twinkling fairy lights, and the soft hum of nature’s lullaby.

Draw wisdom from ancient quotes, discover thought-provoking prompts, and receive affirmations that spark creativity and self-discovery. Or have an interesting chat with Fairy's friends, who will visit you as regularly as you wish.

title: Sqwrk
description:
게임 정보
Sqwk's tribe have been captured by the evil golem. Help him rescue them in this fast paced 3d platformer with momentum based movement

momentum based platforming with wall running
defeat enemies with a homing dash attack
levels have different side challenges to complete

title: Black Smith Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
이 몰입감 넘치는 시뮬레이션 게임에서 숙련된 대장장이가 되어 나만의 대장간을 운영해 보세요. 동적 일주일 주기 시스템을 통해 고객들은 검, 방패, 전투 망치, 도끼, 심지어 앵커 등 다양한 무기와 방어구를 주문하기 위해 가게에 방문합니다. 당신의 장인 정신과 맞춤화 옵션이 고객의 만족도를 결정합니다.
고품질의 장비를 제작하고 판매하여 돈을 벌고, 그 이익을 사용하여 대장간을 개선하세요. 더 좋은 재료를 구입하고, 작업 공간을 확장하고, 더 인상적인 아이템을 만들기 위해 기술을 향상시키세요. 명성이 높아질수록 더 고급 고객들이 독특한 주문을 가지고 찾아옵니다.
성공은 뛰어난 무기의 품질뿐만 아니라 비즈니스 기술에도 달려 있습니다. 현명하게 가격을 책정하고, 자원을 관리하며, 시장의 트렌드에 맞춰 번영하세요. 대장장이의 기술을 마스터하고 최고의 대장간을 만들어 보세요!

title: FIND ALL 8: The road to the Maya
description:
게임 정보
In this game you'll explore colorful city streets on the eve of the Day of the Dead, unique jungle landscapes and ancient temples of a lost civilization. You'll even get a chance to look inside one of the pyramids. All along the way you will have to find all the hidden objects, so that the black-and-white world will be painted in color and come to life. You decide what items you want to find! Enjoy the game with atmospheric music. Suitable for the whole family
Game features:
- Option to choose the item you want to search for
- Increasing level of difficulty
- There is a hint
- Interactivity. Items can also be searched inside buildings
- The world is populated by inhabitants, each one has a story to tell
- Coloring levels
- 2.5D effect
- Possibility to break the piñata

Artist: Anikeyra
autokwd: FIND ALL 8: The road to the Maya

title: PATAPON 1+2 REPLAY
description:
게임 정보
신기하고 귀여운 눈알처럼 생긴 생물 ｢파타퐁｣들에게, “4개의 큰북”으로 리듬을 주어 지시를 내려 모험하는 액션 게임.
「파타퐁」은 자세히 보면 조금씩 차이가 있는데, 무리의 중심에서 깃발을 흔들며 앞장서는 ｢깃발퐁｣이나, 큰 방패로 동료를 지키는 ｢방패퐁｣, 활을 이용해 공격하는 「활퐁」 등, 다양한 클래스가 있습니다. 클래스에 따라 역할과 전술도 달라지므로 각자의 개성에 맞게 부대를 편성하여 스테이지를 공략해 나갑시다!
플레이어인 당신은 파타퐁들의 ｢신｣이 되어 “세상의 끝”을 향한 「파타퐁」들의 대행진을 이끌어야 합니다!!
『PATAPON』『PATAPON2』가 세트가 되어 등장!
2007/8년에 발매된 「PATAPON」/「PATAPON2」 두 작품이 리마스터 된 합본 세트로 돌아왔다!
”딱 4개의 버튼”으로 간단한 조작성과 전략성을 갖춘 이면성!
「파타(←)・퐁(→)・동(↓)・챠카(↑)」의 “딱 4개의 큰북”을 리듬에 맞춰 치면 되는 아주 간단한 조작.
한편으론 전황에 맞춰 커맨드를 넣거나, 스테이지에 적합한 클래스로 「파타퐁」 부대를 편성하는 등, 심도 있는 전력 요소도 있는 “간단함과 전략성의 양면”을 갖추고 있다!
반복 플레이 요소가 가득!
「파타퐁」은 아이템을 조합해 탄생, 강화하는 것이 가능. 스테이지와 미니 게임에서 희귀한 소재를 모아서 더욱 강력한 「파타퐁」을 만들 수 있다. 그 밖에도 합계 “약 400종류”의 무기와 장비 같은 강화 요소도 한가득!
철저하게 준비한 “나만의 파타퐁 부대”를 작성해 다양한 기믹의 스테이지와 버라이어티 요소가 가득한 강적에게 도전해 보자!
원작 요소는 그대로 유지하면서 더욱 쉽게 즐길 수 있도록 보조 기능을 새롭게 추가!
원작의 재미는 유지하면서 이번에는 NORMAL・EASY・HARD 3단계의 ”새로운 기준”으로 난이도를 조정하고, 입력 타이밍의 조정 기능, 큰북 커맨드의 상시 표시 기능 등, 보조 기능을 새롭게 추가했다!
당시와 똑같은 재미를 유지하면서 더욱 쉽게 즐길 수 있어진 파타퐁을 플레이 하자!

title: Ruin
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a world where your people have thrived for millennia, having braved the tumultuous aftermath of a distant crash landing. This alien planet is your ancestral home, a testament to the resilience of your people. Amidst a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, the legacy of your ancestors beckons you to chart your own destiny.
A Sci-Fi Sandbox MMORPG Adventure
Embark on an unparalleled sci-fi sandbox MMORPG journey. Currently in closed beta on Windows, Ruin beckons explorers and adventurers to unearth its secrets. Join the thriving community, shaping the fate of this uncharted world. In Ruin, the universe is your canvas.
Forge Your Destiny: The Power of Guilds and Terraforming
Join forces with fellow adventurers to claim dominion over uncharted territories. Engage in strategic terraforming to fortify your holdings and harvest vital resources. Collaboration within guilds enables the transformation of barren landscapes into bastions of strength.
Dynamic Environments: Witness the Living World of Ruin
Experience the raw force of nature as the weather system dynamically shapes the terrain. From nurturing rains that sustain crops to fierce storms that can undo human progress, the environment of Ruin is in constant flux. Prepare to adapt and thrive amidst the ever-changing landscape, where the elements wield an unpredictable yet captivating influence.
Assemble a formidable team of stalwart allies to conquer formidable bosses and conquer treacherous dungeons. Embrace the classic trinity roles of tank, healer, and DPS, or lead massive 40-player raids to claim glory and untold riches. Unravel the mysteries lurking in the shadows, for only the bold shall emerge victorious.
Harness the power of strategic construction to fortify your territories against rival guilds. Erect impregnable defenses, restricting access to only trusted allies. Dominate the landscape and repel invaders as you vie for supremacy, using your cunning and might to reshape the political landscape of Ruin.
Immerse yourself in a dynamic combat system, blending the nostalgia of old-school MMORPGs with modern flexibility. Tailor your arsenal of abilities and define your own combat style, unhindered by the constraints of traditional classes. Embrace the freedom to forge your legacy, one decisive blow at a time.

title: Dr Voss’ Escape Room
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Dr. Voss' Escape Room is a fun and relaxing multiplayer puzzle game where you and up to 4 friends work together to solve a variety of challenging puzzles. Set in the mysterious lab of Dr. Alaric Voss, you'll uncover hidden clues, piece together the story, and unlock the secrets behind his quest for the immortality potion.
This is a game for those who enjoy taking their time to think things through and solving clever puzzles with friends in a chill, pressure-free environment.
Key Features
Play Together: Team up with friends to solve puzzles designed for collaboration and communication.
Challenging Puzzles: From balancing scales to deciphering hidden messages, every puzzle will test your problem-solving skills.
Relaxed Gameplay: No rush, no stress, just a fun, shared experience of unraveling the mysteries of Dr. Voss’ lab.
Progression Tracking: Watch your progress unfold as you solve puzzles and get closer to escape the room with the immortality potion.
What to Expect
Explore and Discover: Use tools like UV flashlights to reveal hidden messages and clues.
Solve Together: Work as a team to unlock doors, crack codes, and piece together the story.
Create the Ultimate Potion: Follow the clues to blend potions in the correct order, leading to the lab’s final secret.
Around 1 Hour of Gameplay: Enjoy a focused and engaging escape room experience that can be completed in about an hour, perfect for a fun session with friends.
Why You’ll Love It
Dr. Voss' Escape Room is perfect for groups of friends looking for a relaxed but rewarding experience. It’s not just about solving puzzles, it’s about working together, thinking creatively, and enjoying the journey.
So grab your friends and see if you have what it takes to escape Dr. Voss’ lab!

title: EDENS ZERO
description:
게임 정보
왕도 스페이스 판타지 만화 속 세계로 뛰어들자!
마시마 히로 작가의 작품, 스페이스 판타지 만화/애니메이션 "EDENS ZERO"를 원작으로 만들어진 액션 RPG 등장!
원작을 생생하게 체험할 뿐만 아니라, 광활한 필드를 무대로 펼쳐지는 게임 오리지널 스토리의 수많은 퀘스트까지 즐길 수 있는 풍성한 볼륨의 게임!
박력 넘치는 액션 배틀!
콤보와 필살기를 구사해 배틀에 도전하자!
오의로 끝을 내자!
오의 게이지가 쌓이면 주위의 모든 적에게 큰 피해를 주는 "오의"를 발동할 수 있다!

title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition
description:
게임 정보
수많은 팬을 보유한 스트롱홀드 크루세이더의 확장된 결정판에서 성지 탈환을 위한 전설적인 십자군 원정으로 시간 여행을 떠나보세요! 새로운 게임플레이 콘텐츠와 소스 아트워크, 음악, 다시 돌아온 성우, 작곡가, 오리지널 게임의 베테랑 개발자가 참여하여 충실하게 재구성한 업그레이드된 비주얼로 역사적인 사막 전투를 펼치세요.
사막을 정복하세요
스트롱홀드 크루세이더: 결정판은 플레이 가능한 8개의 새로운 병력, 맞서야 하는 4명의 새로운 AI 영주, 추가 캠페인으로 오리지널 게임을 확장합니다. 홀로 새로운 역사적 캠페인 2개와 '시간의 모래' 전초전 트레일 4개를 플레이하거나, 친구와 팀을 이루어 완전히 새로운 협동 트레일을 나아가세요!
또는 더 넓은 맵, 커스텀 옵션, 편의성 개선과 같은 플레이어 요청 기능을 갖춘 전초전 모드에 뛰어들어 보세요. 처음 보는 캐릭터, 병사, 캠페인 등으로 완성된 이 결정판은 오리지널 프리렌더링 아이소메트릭으로 표현된 새로운 그래픽으로 게임을 리마스터하며, 여러분의 패기를 시험합니다!
힘을 발휘하여 20명의 까다로운 AI 영주에게 맞서든, 친구와 함께 새로운 협동 트레일을 진군하든, 그저 자신이 만들어 낸 장엄한 사막 성채에 감탄하든, 스트롱홀드 크루세이더: 결정판에서는 베테랑 플레이어와 신규 플레이어 모두가 실시간 전략 클래식을 다시 방문하여 원하는 방식대로 플레이할 수 있습니다.
autokwd: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition,Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition 스트롱홀드 크루세이더: 결정판

title: Atomic Owl
description:
게임 정보
An avian story of a bird and a chatty blade unfurls its feathers! A feathery roguelite for the SNES era makes its debut!
Take up arms against the evil Crow sorcerer who brainwashed your troupe.
You must save them all.
Hidalgo Bladewing and his companions return to their favorite ramen spot following a perilous mission, only to be confronted by the vengeful void crow, Omega Wing. Two years later, Hidalgo must rescue his fallen companions from the clutches of this ruthless old foe—with the help of a chaotic, brash-talking sword.
