title: Analog - Skin off
description:
게임 정보
Analog
Analog is game series that combines a first person horror experience with analog horror.
Skin off
Skin off is the first game in Analog, where you play as a teenager during summer break. You decide to stay at your uncle's house away from the city with your friends. A strange message, however, appears on the TV that changes your plans. Follow the instruction if you want to survive.

title: Keytamine
description:
게임 정보
Keytamine – 키보드 테마의 액션 게임! 키캡 적들의 파도를 헤치며 전투를 벌이고, 클릭의 쾌감과 부드러운 애니메이션, 그리고 ASMR급 사운드 디자인으로 몰입감을 극대화합니다.
주요 특징:
10개의 독특한 키보드 테마 스테이지
200+ 종의 적과 보스 등장
40+ 패시브 업그레이드와 20+ 개의 무기
감각적인 키보드 사운드와 ASMR 효과
그리고 귀여운 고양이들이 함께해!

title: Royal Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Take to the stars in Royal Odyssey, a top-down space shooter inspired by the classic Shoot-Em-Up(Shmup) genre. Pilot Prince Zayven’s ship through a relentless asteroid storm as he races to return home and save his kingdom from a sudden threat. With quick reflexes, strategic upgrades and fast-paced action...can you overcome the dangers of space and complete Zayven's heroicjourney before it's too late?"

title: Watchword
description:
게임 정보
Watchword is a roguelike deck builder about playing words to beat increasingly difficult trials with rule-breaking synergies and combos. 
A good vocabulary will certainly help, but it will mostly take careful planning and strategy to beat each trial.
Invent crazy new words and use special symbols to play a board that scores massively! Fill your bag and customize your collection of pieces.
Purchase books to ramp up your point scoring. 
Each book has a unique power that can help (or potentially hinder) depending on what pieces you use. Some books completely change the rules of the game. Explore, and discover clever combinations!

title: Tower Networking Inc.
description:
게임 정보
Tower Networking Inc is a blend of simulation and economic-strategy with rogue-like elements. Physically connect your clients to your networks by patching cables into switches, routers and data risers. Run an internet service provider in a tower that keeps building random floors. Each new floor comes with unique residences and/or offices that naturally has a variety of different needs.
As the network operator, you are tasked to provide connectivity and various IT related services to the residents in the tower on a limited budget. Your board of directors have a strict policy where you must never go over-budget or face termination from your role. Additionally, some of your clients have service level agreements (SLA) and you must ensure their internet connection (and the services they need) stays up. If any of them files a complaint, then its game-over!.
Your goal is to ensure your internet service provider runs as long as possible.
Key Features:
RUN AN INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDER: Provide internet services to residences and offices in an ever-expanding randomly generated tower.
CABLE MANAGEMENT SIMULATION: Spaghetti ahoy! Link up switches and routers with various types (and lengths) of network cables.

title: Laundry Simulator 2025
description:
게임 정보
🫧원하는 방식으로 관리하기🫧
세탁기를 통해 자동 수동 소득을 얻거나 손을 더럽히고 고객의 옷을 청소하여 수입을 극대화하여 세탁 제국을 운영 할 수 있습니다. 더러운 빨래를 할 직원을 고용하고 관리할 수도 있습니다!
🧽세심하게 청소하기🧽
세탁기에 더러운 옷을 넣고, 원하는 세탁 프로그램으로 세탁하고, 건조하여 시간을 절약하고, 깨끗한 옷을 다림질하여 마지막 손질을 하고, 고객이 가져온 옷을 세심하게 청소할 수 있습니다. 찹찹!
🧹매장 관리하기🧹
고객이나 젖은 옷에 묻은 먼지를 청소하고 수리가 필요한 기계를 수리해야 합니다. 세탁소를 꾸미고 원하는 방식으로 상품을 구매할 수 있습니다. 상점을 업그레이드하여 가장 큰 세탁소가 될 수 있습니다. 수입을 극대화하고 유명한 사람들을 단골 고객으로 만들 수 있습니다.
🛠️ 장비 업그레이드 🛠️
더 새롭고 더 좋은 장비를 잠금 해제하고 구매하여 시간을 관리하고 수익을 극대화하세요. 더 나은 기계는 더 나은 급여를 의미합니다.
꿈의 세탁실을 구축하세요

title: ERA ONE
description:
게임 정보
Era One is a space-themed game developed by Team Complex LTD.
Combining innovation, customization, and epic space battles, Era One offers a unique gaming experience. Players can customize their own ships using assembly modules, construct stations, warships, bases, and even cities in space. The game seamlessly blends real-time strategy (RTS) and base building elements, providing players with the opportunity to engage in intense battles between space fleets.


From the ashes of a shattered universe, a young woman's quest for salvation sparks a journey of intrigue, danger, and discovery. In a future where Earth's resources were depleted, humanity embarked on The Great Colonization, expanding to other planets. The rise of mining corporations led to conflicts and the emergence of space piracy. A wealthy magnate discovered a powerful energy source, leading to the construction of the Navi Mondo, enormous fortified and self-sustaining cities in space, and the formation of the Free Federation of Worlds. Centuries passed, and the population was pushed to abandon planets, living only on the Navi Mondo. However, genetically engineered biominers mutated and posed a threat. With resources nearing exhaustion, the Free Federation planned to migrate using Hyperspace Leap technology. The colonizing ships Victrix and X Gemina encountered a gravitational anomaly, causing a breach. Chaos ensued as resources depleted, wars resumed, and the political system collapsed. Alya De Shars sought to steal a power source to launch a secret ship and start anew. This sets the stage for a story of humanity's struggle, the rise and fall of an empire, and the hope for a fresh beginning beyond the Solar System.
We asked Alberto Selvaggi to read Era One's lore and compose based solely on his inspiration and years of passion for music and piano. The result is a unique and emotionally touching soundtrack that will accompany us throughout the story, adding depth and making everything deeply engaging.


The player can construct their own base using a set of assembly modules, with no limit to shape or size.
Extensive Base Customization: Era One offers a wide range of options for base construction and customization. Players can design and build their bases from scratch, choosing the layout, structures, and aesthetics that suit their playstyle.
Resource Management: Building and maintaining a base requires effective resource management. Players must gather and manage resources such as raw materials, energy sources, and workforce to construct and upgrade their bases. Proper allocation of resources is essential for the growth and sustainability of the base, ensuring its survival in the game world.
Defensive Structures and Strategies: Bases in Era One must be fortified against external threats. Players can construct defensive structures such as turrets, and traps to protect their bases from enemy attacks. Choosing the right defensive strategy, positioning defenses strategically, and upgrading them over time are crucial aspects of base building in the game.
Research and Technological Advancement: As players progress in Era One, they can unlock and research new technologies to enhance their base-building capabilities. Advancements in areas such as construction techniques, resource extraction, and defensive systems provide players with additional options for base expansion and fortification.


Players can build their starships according to their preferences.
Vast Ship Customization Options: Era One offers a wide array of ship customization options, allowing players to design and personalize their vessels. Players can choose from different ship types, sizes, and aesthetics, customizing various aspects such as hull design, paint schemes, and exterior decorations. This level of customization allows players to create unique and visually distinct ships that reflect their individual style.
Modular Ship Components: Ships in Era One are built using modular components, offering players the flexibility to tailor their ships for specific roles and functions. Players can select and install various modules, such as propulsion systems, weapon systems, cargo holds, and utility modules, based on their playstyle and objectives. The modular nature of ship components enables players to experiment with different configurations and optimize their ships for exploration, combat, trading, or other specialized tasks.
Upgradeable Ship Systems: As players progress in the game, they can acquire new technologies and upgrade ship systems to enhance their performance. Upgradable systems can include engines for increased speed, shields for improved defense, weapons for enhanced firepower, and scanners for better exploration capabilities.

title: Indoras
description:
게임 정보
Indoras: The Whispering Shards
Enter a world of fantasy and adventure, dungeon-based game set in a realm on the brink of collapse. Once proud protectors of the land, the Templars have fallen under a sinister influence and now siphons the world’s elemental power for their own ambitions. Play one of five distinct classes—Warrior, Guardian, Heretic, Elementalist, or Sorcerer— and battle through seven different zones, each shaped by a corrupted Templar’s domain.
Key Features
Group based or Single player dungeon-based runs
Embark in dungeon runs on your own or either with your friends, up to 4 players
Progress in playing dungeons on various difficulties, and clearing them out faster for better loot
Learn the story of Indoras by progressing through dungeons, various dungeons per zone that unveils the story and the Templar's connection to it.
Customized Characters
Ability to choose different looks for your character to reflect your own identity.|

title: Brickadia
description:
게임 정보
Brickadia is a physics-based multiplayer brick building game that gives you the tools to create and play, your way or with friends! Build intricate structures, invent cool contraptions, then play in them however you'd like!
Build anything you can imagine.
Using our constantly growing collection of bricks and intuitive, powerful tools, you can build towering skyscrapers, fun vehicles, islands, spaceships, cities, anything you can dream of. The only limit is your imagination.
Battle other players.
With the flexible game rules system and our grand collection of Pew Pews, any build can instantly become a fierce battle arena! Blow your friends to smithereens or host servers with custom game modes for anyone to join.

title: GUG
description:
게임 정보
Transcend
Unique gug creation: Each gug is procedurally generated from a phrase you type. Even the devs don't know what's going to happen each time you transcend!
Fight
Unexpected threats: Battle gugs from other players and previous runs. Innovate to counter your own creations!

title: Firearms Factory
description:
게임 정보

An adventure that will last from the beginning of the 1st World War to the end of the 2nd World War is waiting for you.



You will start to produce weapons in a small workshop, and as the weapons you produce win the wars, you will gain money and experience.



With this experience and money, You can manufacture pistols, SMGs, assault rifles, bolt actions, and more...



Maybe if your government trusts you enough, you'll be well-equipped to produce tanks, what do you think?

title: The Necromancer's Tale
description:
게임 정보
The Necromancer's Tale is a narrative-driven top-down RPG where you play the role of a minor noble in the 18th Century, drawn into the Dark Necromantic Arts as you seek knowledge and revenge. Great power awaits... along with the weird, the morbid, and a gradual descent into madness.
Before you lies a great spellbook, filled with powerful rites of death and reanimation. Can you decipher the pages and master its arcane rituals without losing your mind or being strung up by the townsfolk? Your progress will require great determination, cunning and secrecy.
The Necromancer's Tale is a story-rich game, in which you converse with 180+ NPC characters, each with their own portrait art. You will investigate, negotiate, coerce and flatter in order to progress your aims. The game's Trust system means that your choices - even in conversation - really matter. If the townsfolk's trust drops too low, you will find your choices are affected - if it drops further still, you will surely be tried in court and hanged, or lynched by a frenzied mob.
Your character is created in an interactive backstory, defining your gender, early life, skills and career (military, diplomatic, or academic). Narrative options during the main game are affected by these choices.

title: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions
description:
게임 정보
Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is a fast-paced racing game for the whole family that brings the famous Europa-Park mascots Ed & Edda to life for the first time in a video game to coincide with the worldwide release of the animated feature film ‘GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE’!
You can race with the two heroes or six other colourful characters that fans of the film will recognise! The races take players to various well-known locations across Europe to compete in individual races, points races, time trials or the Grand Prix!
Each character not only has their very own racing car, but also individual strengths and weaknesses, which means that each race can be driven very differently depending on which character you take to the track!
But Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is not just a game that is great fun to play alone: in a race with two, three or even four players, every family and every group of friends can create their very own memories in the world of the Racing Champions - because with Ed & Edda, too, it's true: a shared game is often twice the fun!
 Key features of Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions:
 Race over exciting tracks in many world-famous European locations
Choose between eight well-known characters, including Ed & Edda, the legendary Europa-Park mascots
Unleash unique driving skills, master power-ups and customise your race car to make every race feel unique
Long-term modifications to the racing car and unlockable improvements keep the replay value high
A split-screen mode for local multiplayer races of 2 to 4 players invites families to have fun together and create their very own memories in the world of Ed & Edda.

title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
description:
게임 정보
Join our official Discord
Click the link on the right to join DISCORD!
Will you escape with gold and power?
Or fall to the Shadows of Chroma Tower?
Survive by means of steel, wit or magic
Defeat the Archmage's minions, plunder their riches, discover the secrets within the Tower and escape with your life! Do it the way you prefer:
Play by yourself or with friends.
5 classes, each with their own skills, talent tree and specialized subclasses.
6 professions for you to master - from fishing to weapon forging.
Several difficulties for you to challenge yourself and test your gear and skills.
Hordes, mini-bosses, bosses and raids to fight alone or with up to 9 friends.


Whether playing by yourself or with friends, you will always be contributing to the bigger picture.

title: Kungfu2
description:
게임 정보
This is a fast-paced survivor game. Players will play as kungfus with special skills, and challenge 30 levels in a 30-second violent battle. Each character has its own characteristics, and with a variety of kungfus and props, activate the power of bondage and challenge the final BOSS!
Each level is only 30 seconds, and ordinary levels quickly kill enemies to accumulate resources, and boss levels!
Multiple character kungfus characteristics
Sword Immortal, God of Wealth, Scholar... Each character has its own characteristics. Switch characters, explore completely different fighting styles, and find your destiny kungfus!
Bond kungfus system
After each level, choose randomly refreshed kungfus and props, activate dozens of bond effects, and each game is a unique growth path!
Sword system + Kongtong School = Blade of Fire!
Sword system + Fist system = High attack speed + True damage = Meat shield nemesis!
The more you fight, the stronger you become, and the more you grow
Killing monsters will drop gold coins and experience, and strengthen your attack, attack speed, critical strike and other attributes in real time! The difficulty of the levels rises step by step. Can your construction defeat the final boss?
Gameplay highlights
Short, flat and fast game: 15 minutes to complete a single game, and you can complete it in a few minutes when you turn on the double speed!
Strategic depth: The kungfus fetters require delicate calculations. Is it mindless shopping? Or operating the economy? In "Kungfu2", every decision is a gamble to live and die.
—— Today, can you rewrite the limits of kungfus within 30 seconds? ——

title: Third Shift
description:
게임 정보
Third Shift is the first ever hybrid, point-and-click, survival horror video game, to take place in a pharmacy.
You are the new pharmacist...
And the night's not done with you yet...

title: DreamBreaker
description:
게임 정보
DreamBreaker is a turn-based card-based building game with rogue.
The Demon Lord is awakening, and you must find the Demon Lord's hiding place and improve yourself as much as you can within a limited time, sealing it again before it fully regains its challenge after challenge, you collect scattered memories and find the truth of this world!
In each game, you can choose different companions and exploration routes to find different skills and items. Experience the ever-changing world of building through different combinations!
Dual-skill cards
Each card can be equipped with 2 skills, and choose 1 of them to cast when played. Think and make choices based on the battle situation
Time-Order
Planned skills will be resolved sequentially during the action phase. Acting before or after the enemy is also part of the strategy!
Hero Team
Choose 1 main attack and 2 support characters for each game. Different fighting styles, and wonderful combinations create wonderful sparks!
Choose Route
The ultimate goal is to defeat the Demon Lord. There are no prescribed game routes, so you can freely choose the map you want to explore, so that every adventure and every build is different!
Boss Fights
Dozens of well-choreographed boss fights. Test your build to be up to the task! And bosses have their own unique loots to enrich your build!
The awakened Demon Lord
The Demon Lord gradually becomes stronger with time. Spend less time facing weaker demon lords, or spend more time becoming stronger yourself!

title: Unto the Aurora
description:
게임 정보
THIS GAME CONTAINS MULTIPLE INSTANCES OF FLASHING IMAGES.
1597. North East Scotland. Accused of witchcraft and sentenced to death, with the help of a mysterious entity you escape a brutal fate by setting sail across a harazardous ocean passage towards a reported safe haven.
From Arboreta Games (solo developer of The Black Iris and It Sleeps Below the Haar), Unto the Aurora is a short historical game, with a focus on: atmosphere, exploration and emotion. Players will be responsible for navigating and steering their ship, as well as ensuring they survive the passage without freezing or starving.
Setting
Set at the tale end of the 16th century, during the height of Scotland's witchcraft panics, the world of Unto the Aurora is heavily inspired by: folklore, historical manuscripts and scholarship on the period, whilst adding in elements of fantasy and horror.
Key Features
Realistic Sailing - Experience a physics-based sailing system where wind, waves, currents and buoancy are all simulated to provide a realistic sailing experience
Survive the Crossing - Defend yourself against starvation and cold during your crossing by: warming yourself by your stove, minimising exposure to the elements and fishing.

title: Spell Slide
description:
게임 정보
Push letters to form words in Spell Slide—a unique word game with two distinct modes. In Creative mode, discover as many words as you can to boost your score and unlock new levels. In Puzzle mode, each world introduces new mechanics: from bespoke single-solution challenges, to puzzles where spelling specific words opens doors, to strategy levels with companion robots, and even cryptic clue-based conundrums. Whether you're into freeform wordplay or structured problem-solving, Spell Slide lets you play your way.

title: AAS Mos Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보


A small accident occurred in the laboratory last month, which lead to an apocalypse. Not just an apocalypse, but a 'mos apocalypse'. What's a mos? A mos is a bigger version of a mosquito which was accidentally made by humans. They are not ten cm tall, not even 30 cm, but over one meter tall! It seems that these creatures want to reproduce, therefore they are looking for blood. That is the reason why there are many reports of people going missing. At first, we thought mos would become extinct in the first week. But we were wrong. Now they are everywhere and the number of missing people keeps rising.

An emergency signal has been broadcasted. The AAS team received the signal and are here to take action. They said that they have found a way to stop this apocalypse and that there is no need to send more troops. It seems that every member of AAS has a mission. They said that once all missions have been completed, the apocalypse will end once and for all.

This game consists of two game modes: single player and co-op.
On single player mode: grab a weapon, exterminate all mos, and complete the mission!
On co-op mode: pick your weapons and perks, think of a strategy, and survive endless waves of mos.

title: Idle Adventurer
description:
게임 정보
Become an adventurer and slay your way through infinite stages of enemies in this idle action RPG. Work your way through the hoards of creatures and beasts in order to bring back the glory to your village.
There's over 50 unique monsters with different variants and appearances to match each and every environment in which you will encounter them in. Paired with 25 different bosses and super bosses, you'll have your favorite monster to slay in no time!
Collect different armor and weapon sets in order to gain stat set bonus effects and other lucrative bonuses to help you along your journey.
Can't play the game all day? Then don't worry! Your progress will continue whilst you are offline, and you will come back to a whole host of loot and items when you make your return to vanquish more foes!

title: Shattered Soul
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
Shattered Soul is a modern game that interprets Beat'em up by adding the fun with a charming narrative based on Metroidvania-styled epic action. Explore a fantastic world that intersects medieval Europe, follow stories of adventure in search of lost soul and bodies.
You become 'Ireth' and venture out looking for her lost memories. She explores the forests, cathedrals, and snowy villages of the border area, and battles enemies by using various techniques against bandits, fanatics, demonized humans and mutant animals. 'Ireth' discovers secrets all over the continent to find her soul with shattered sword 'Bias'.
As you hack-and-slash your way across town - either solo or with a friend in local co-op - you'll gain new skills, chow down on power-ups, wield an assortment of weapons, and unleash an arsenal of combos, throws, and special combat moves for both fighting enemies and platforming challenges
Key Features
Classic side-scrolling action, with all the modern trimmings.
Tightly tuned 2D controls. Dodge, dash, and slash your way through over 24 enemies and 6 epic bosses. Face ferocious beasts and vanquish ancient knights on your quest through the lost kingdom.
Five large city regions to fight through, complete with shops and side quests.
An expansive world filled with unique dungeons, quests, and secrets.
All in classic hand-painted original 2D drawings.

title: Jar Head Cauldron
description:
게임 정보
Defeat enemies with enchanted weapons crafted using your cauldron featuring “in world crafting” to upgrade items, weapons and keys to help you save all 13 members of your coven. As you progress you will unlock the secrets of the other side. Find and harvest required occulted items to complete the necromantic ritual to save your coven.
Completing The Ritual
Find and save your lost covens jared heads from a cult of black magic users
Gather required body parts from fallen enemies to build your covens new bodies 
Collect and craft the skulls required to initiate the ritual
Proform the ritual and protect your coven as they pass back through to our world
Gameplay Features and Modes
"American Magic" Crafting tree will include 17th century to early 20th century gunpowder weapons
"Occult" Crafting tree will only include primitive gunpowder weapons a focus on melee and magic. 
Features
In depth in world crafting with the use of the cauldron
Fight waves of enemies and crawl dungeons
Action is broken up with crafting, collecting and looting, puzzles and exploration at your own risk.
Occulted crafting tree that must be discovered through trial and error
Controls FPS, Drag and drop items, Craft, Loot

"인연"의 칼날로 악귀를 멸하라!
카마도 탄지로의 전투가 가정용 게임으로 다시 막을 올린다―――

탄지로와 동료들의 앞을 가로막는 상현 혈귀들에 맞서 함께 싸우자!

전작에 이어 '합체 오의'와 '장비'라는 신규 요소도 추가!
온라인 대전과 오프라인 대전을 통해 새로운 경지에 도달하자!
