title: Sometimes Toast is O.K.
description:
게임 정보
Overview:
Sometimes Toast is O.K. is a casual point-and-click adventure about making toast in a physics sandbox. Explore your kitchen, find hilarious secrets, and create chaos while burning your toast. Spread jam on the walls, hit a new high score in Toast Ninja, or feed the cabinet monster! This silly sandbox adventure will show you that Sometimes, Toast is O.K.
Key Features: 
Point-and-Click Controls
Move around the kitchen with simple point-and-click controls! Left click a location to move to it, Click and drag items around, and right click to put items in your hand.
Physics
Interact with the game’s objects by dropping them, throwing them, knocking them over, or anything else you can think of!
Sandbox
Explore the kitchen in any way you want! If something draws your eye, try it out! There’s no right or wrong way to make toast here, so look around the kitchen and put your own special spin on it.
Achievements
While exploring the kitchen, you’ll discover dozens of achievements and objectives to complete! Can you find them all?
Chaos
Feel free to cause as much destruction as you want! You don’t have to worry about cleaning up after yourself, so throw, freeze, burn, and make crumbs all over the place. But remember, among all the avocados, ninja challenges, and cabinet demons, Sometimes Toast is O.K.!

title: CAT-A-STROPHIC
description:
게임 정보
CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy 3D rogue-like city destruction game where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.
Unleash havoc by swiping at buildings, pouncing on structures, and hurling objects with telekinesis.  As the chaos unfolds, enemies will continuously spawn to capture Bluu and stop her destruction spree.  Once the level is cleared, you can rescue a kitten that supercharges Bluu’s powers, enhancing her abilities with unique effects like summoning lightning storms or turning invisible. Embrace the carnage, adapt your playstyle, and lead Bluu to victory!

title: World of Magic: Rise of Magic
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징
일부 NPC를 위한 고급 AI:
일부 NPC는 세계와 상호작용하고, 적은 긴 전투 중에 당신의 전투 스타일과 마법을 기억합니다. 만약 평범한 마을 주민이나 여행자가 죽으면, 그들과의 연결은 영원히 사라집니다.
혁신적인 마법 시스템:
몰입감을 높이는 새로운 인터랙티브 주문 방식.
매력적인 스토리라인:
독특한 캐릭터와 흥미진진한 사건이 가득한 스토리를 따라가세요.
선택의 영향:
당신의 결정이 스토리의 전개와 세계의 변화에 큰 영향을 미쳐, 매번 새로운 경험을 제공합니다.
다양한 주문:
다양한 주문을 발견하고 습득하여 나만의 마법적 정체성을 만들어보세요.
캐릭터 강화:
게임 스타일에 맞춰 캐릭터를 강화하세요.
최적화된 자원:
최상의 성능을 위한 세심하게 최적화된 자원으로 고품질 그래픽을 즐기세요.
도시에서는 통치자 외에도 가장 강력한 마법사들이 존경받습니다. 일부는 주머니를 금으로 채우려 하고 있는 반면, 시골의 가난한 사람들은 약탈하고 여성들을 번식하기 위해 납치하는 고블린과 싸우고 있습니다. 그 사이 성 주변에서는 갑자기 오크와 다른 악한 존재들이 나타나기 시작했습니다. 이 혼란 속에서 당신은 가족을 구해야 합니다. 하지만 사람들은 서로 전쟁을 시작했고, 누군가는 금지된 흑마법을 익혀서 무언가 끔찍한 것을 소환했습니다...
가장 위대한 마법사가 되어, 여러 가지 조합 가능한 마법을 익히고, 성을 방어하거나 포위하며, 가족의 행복을 최우선으로 하는 캐릭터의 매혹적인 이야기를 따라가세요.
autokwd: World of Magic: Rise of Magic

title: Vextorial
description:
게임 정보
중력을 바꿔, 퍼즐을 풀어, 유적을 돌고, 기억을 찾고.
《차원의 여정》 은 다차원 퍼즐 플랫포머로, 수많은 수상 경력을 자랑하는 작품입니다.
플레이어는 2D 생명체 Pilo가 되어 3D 공간을 탐험합니다!
이 여정에서 당신이 할 수 있는 일:
중력을 조작해 주변 환경을 변화시키기
정육면체의 각 평면을 이동하며 차원의 한계를 돌파하기

title: KILLA
description:
게임 정보
가족과도 같았던 스승님의 갑작스러운 죽음.
그녀가 남긴 마지막 한마디—"라를 죽여라."
당신은 ‘발할라’가 되어, 스승님을 죽인 를 찾아 해야 합니다.

title: The Mangust
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by the intense action of Doom Eternal, yet set within colorful and charming 2D landscapes. You'll navigate these scenes as a swift and nimble mongoose, acquiring and upgrading weapons, scavenging various items, uncovering secrets and battling hordes of enemies along the way.



Move quickly and freely with dashes, wall-jumps, and double jumps. Use a variety of ranged weapons which all can be aimed in a full range of 360 degrees. Use Melee weapons to keep enemies at bay and execute low health enemies to regain health and ammo.









All guns have six base stats that can be upgraded in any order. Select special abilities, elemental effects, bullet types, and frameworks that change how the gun fundamentally functions.
The game consists of four different environments. Each environment contains 15 hand made levels. Each level has various treasure chests and other collectables. Between each level the players is returned to a base area where various shops exists.
Outside of the guns. There are three different types of items.
Melee weapons - enhances the players combat and knock back capabilities with melee attacks.
Organs - helps with survivability.
Mantras - Improves how the player interacts with power ups and consumables,

title: Test Cricket Manager
description:
게임 정보
test Cricket Manager Game
A cricket management game where you control the on, and off, decisions of a countries national cricket team.
Starting in 1868 (Year of the first Australian touring team to England, the Australian team was entirely comprised of Aboriginals for this tour) you will take your country on a year long journey to play each other test team once at home, and another time away.
While managing the team you will be responsible for
BEFORE THE GAME
- Player wages, contracts, hiring and firing.
- Training of your players. Which skills do you want them to improve?
- Staffing levels and their wages.
- Upkeep of the ground and the pitch. Have a lot of world class spinners? Make your pitch spin friendly.
DURING THE GAME
- Set the batting line up; change your batters aggression at any time. Declare at any time.
- Choose the on field tactics.
- Choose your bowlers, will you bowl them for a long spell or quick fiery bursts?
- Set your fielding aggression (are you going for a wicket or slow the scoring down?)
AFTER THE GAME
- Sit back and check out all the statistics of the game, and season so far.
- See where you are on the ladder. Do you need to win, or will a draw do, next game?
- Do you need to retire some old stars and look at your youth players?
YOU make the decisions, and YOU take the glory. But you also take the fall for failure.

title: Cedric Darkstride: The Pallid
description:
게임 정보

Devotion, betrayal, vengeance, and redemption.

Uncover the dark secrets of "The Order" to achieve divine redemption.
A Souls-like game with an isometric view.

Help Cedric find redemption. Use your melee or ranged attacks, increase your magical powers, and solve puzzles to access certain areas. Immerse yourself in the underworld and defeat the evil one.

Explore the world of Ironholt, delve into the depths of Sombracave, or face the defenders of the various fortresses condemned by the evil one.

Choose your attack style wisely—melee, ranged, or magic—each enemy has its weaknesses.

Investigate your enemies, seek information about their pacts with the evil one and the curse they bear. Gather all the treatises to gain the power to confront the lord of evil.


Buy, sell, or try your luck at gambling to earn enough money to get potions or magic cards—any help in Ironholt is little enough.

title: THE GIRL FROM GUNMA Kai 　群馬県から来た少女 改
description:
게임 정보
It's a pseudo-retro 2D side-scrolling shooter with a variety of gameplay in 8 stages, with visuals (TMS9918A spec V9938 palette) and sound (PSG+SCC) enhanced to mimic the MSX standard popular in Japan in the 1980s. Formerly released for smartphones in 2014 and then passed through Steam Greenlight, the release was delayed for about 10 years due to the production company's busy schedule (Final Re:Quest The Movie). The overall volume of the game has been increased to compensate for this. The controls are very simple and familiar. The player controls a cute little girl with dots, and defeats various enemies with a series of automatic shots. The game is inspired by good old Japanese culture, Gunma's nature and customs, in the 80's style, and the ending may change some by discovering various hidden items in the stage. We aimed to create a simple and kitschy shooting game before the bullet-hell shooters. We hope you will enjoy this game if you are tired of complicated modern games.
autokwd: THE GIRL FROM GUNMA Kai 　群馬県から来た少女 改
company: 株式会社ヒューガ　HUGA Inc

title: City: Battle Ground
description:
게임 정보
어둡고 활기찬 비스트 시티의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 이곳의 거리에서는 바이커, 경찰, 갱스터, 그리고 미친 과학자가 이끄는 좀비 무리들이 치열하게 싸우고 있습니다. 매 턴이 마지막이 될 수도 있으며, 각 카드는 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있습니다.
다양한 진영의 카드를 조합하여 나만의 독특한 덱을 만드세요. 경찰의 힘과 교활함, 바이커의 분노, 갱스터의 기민함, 좀비의 파괴적인 혼돈을 활용하세요. 카드를 강화하고 새로운 능력을 해제하며 도시를 점차적으로 장악하세요.

title: Red Rust
description:
게임 정보
Red Rust is retro-style side-scrolling game which uniquely combines fighting mechanics with shooting mechanics. The game is heavily inspired by 8bit and 16bit hits of the 90s, but it’s being developed with the modern player in mind. Tons of great animation, hand-drawn backgrounds, variety of in-game situations and powerful soundtrack!



It's the year 1984 and you control Agent Red (or just Red), a soviet KGB officer who has been sent to the West on a secret mission. She is an attractive but brutal and cold-hearted girl! Over the course of the game she learns to understand her own emotions and the unfamiliar world around her.

title: The Shafts of Damnation
description:
게임 정보
Core Gameplay Mechanics:
Exploration: Navigate through claustrophobic tunnels and experiment rooms.
Puzzle Solving: Restore power, decode locks, and piece together evidence.
Stealth and Survival: Avoid monstrous creatures and manage limited resources.
Lore Discovery: Collect a few notes per map to unravel the story.
Cat and Mouse Gameplay: Enemies actively pursue and capture the player, using various paths.
Evolving Threat System: The enemy analyzes the player's behavior and learns from their movements.
Shadow Strategy: The player must use the environment and deception to survive.
Be Smarter and Don't Get Caught.
Genre: Souls-Horror – Hardcore difficulty only and strategic combat.
Key Features:
Atmospheric Environment: Flickering lights, eerie soundscapes, and oppressive darkness.
Dynamic Threats: Monsters with unique behaviors stalk the player.
Immersive Storytelling: Story revealed through environmental clues and collectible notes.
Endgame Encounter: A dramatic showdown with the ultimate experiment deep within the shafts.

title: Legacy of Defense
description:
게임 정보
게임 설명:

판타지 세계의 주인공이 되어 몬스터의 침공을 막아라! 레거시 오브 디펜스
레거시 오브 디펜스는 횡스크롤뷰와 덱빌딩 요소를 결합한 혁신적인 디펜스 게임입니다.

모험을 떠나 동료를 획득하고, 위험한 적으로부터 자신을 방어하세요!
주요 특징:

횡스크롤뷰 액션: 화려한 2D 그래픽과 직관적인 조작으로 눈앞에 펼쳐지는 치열한 전투를 경험하세요. 몰려오는 몬스터를 방어하는 짜릿한 손맛을 느껴보세요.

덱빌딩 전략: 다양한 카드들을 모아 나만의 덱을 구성하세요. 각 카드에는 강력한 스킬이 포함되어 있어 전략적인 플레이가 요구됩니다.

판타지 몬스터: 상상 속에서나 볼 수 있었던 다양한 판타지 몬스터들이 공격해옵니다. 각기 다른 능력을 가진 몬스터들을 상대하세요.


스킬 업그레이드: 전투를 통해 경험치를 획득하고, 주인공의 스킬을 업그레이드하세요. 강력한 스킬을 통해 더욱 효과적으로 몬스터를 소탕할 수 있습니다.

몰려오는 몬스터들을 막아내세요. 카드를 선택해 스킬을 사용하고 적들을 처치하세요. 전략적인 덱빌딩이 승리의 열쇠입니다. 각 스테이지를 클리어하며 점점 강해지는 몬스터들에 맞서 최종 보스를 물리치세요!

당신의 전략과 실력을 시험해보세요. 용감한 영웅이 되어 판타지 세계를 구할 준비가 되셨나요?

title: Hell is Us
description:
게임 정보
Hell is Us는 강렬한 근접 전투와 탐험의 스릴이 결합된 3인칭 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 세미 오픈 월드를 탐험해 의문에 대한 답을 찾고 여정 내내, 신비로운 생물들을 만나 보세요.
적대적인 세계
국가를 분열하는 내전뿐 아니라, 이 지역은 현대식 무기로는 물리칠 수 없는 초자연적 생물을 태어나게 만든 기이한 재앙으로부터 고통받고 있습니다. 다른 시대에서 온 드론과 검은 무시무시한 키메라가 들끓는 땅을 뚫고 길을 만들며 이들의 등장의 비밀을 파헤치는 과정에 함께하는 충실한 동료입니다.
독특한 탐험 시스템
지도도, 나침반도, 퀘스트 표식도 없습니다. 본능을 따르는 것 역시 모험의 일부입니다. 탐험을 진행하며 직접 결정을 내리고 본능을 따르게 만들어 주는 획기적인 글쓰기 방식과 레벨 디자인을 활용한 독특한 탐험을 즐겨 보세요. 발견은 오로지 당신의 몫입니다.
독창적인 생물들과의 전투
검, 창과 도끼: 이 초자연적 생물체들과 맞서 싸우기 위해 특별하게 만들어진 다양한 무기를 이용할 수 있습니다. 살아남으려면 이 괴물들과 어떻게 싸우고 드론을 활용해야 할지 배워나가야 할 것입니다.

''Hell is Us의 핵심 테마는 인간의 폭력은 인간의 감정과 격정이 부추기는 반복적인 사이클이라는 겁니다.'' - Jonathan Jacques-Belletête, 크리에이티브 디렉터

title: Terminator 2D: NO FATE
description:
게임 정보
훌륭한 픽셀 아트워크와 액션으로 가득 찬 아케이드 게임플레이의 조합으로 생동감 넘치는 '터미네이터 2: 심판의 날' 세계를 직접 경험해 보세요! 사라 코너와 T-800이 되어 스릴 넘치는 다양한 임무를 해결하며 T-1000과 맞서 싸우고 스카이넷의 계획을 저지하여 인류를 멸망에서 구해내세요. 미래의 존 코너가 되어 저항군을 이끌고 기계와의 전쟁에서 인류의 유일한 희망이 되어 최전선에서 전투하세요. '터미네이터 2: 심판의 날'에 등장하는 상징적인 장면과 오리지널 시나리오, 여러 개의 엔딩으로 이루어진 이 특별한 스토리에서 인류의 운명은 여러분의 결정에 달려 있습니다.
게임 특징
정통 아케이드 게임 플레이, 음악 및 시각적 효과를 처음부터 새롭게 제작하여 터미네이터 세계관에 경의를 바치는 클래식한 아케이드 게임에 흠뻑 빠져 보세요.
고전 터미네이터 2: 심판의 날에 등장하는 장면과 지금까지 공개되지 않았던 터미네이터 이야기가 어우러진 스토리 속에서 사라, 존, 그리고 T-800이 되어 상징적인 순간을 다시 체험하고 새로운 길을 열어 보세요.
사이버다인과 스카이넷의 강력한 무기를 상대로 전투를 치르며 다양한 유형의 적과 아드레날린이 솟구치는 보스전에 도전해 보세요.

title: Congruence
description:
게임 정보
Manipulate pentominoes to create congruent shapes
Some pairs have multiple solutions
There are 513 different congruences to find in total

title: Fairtravel Battle
description:
게임 정보
Fairtravel Battle is an affordable indie collectible card game with familiar gameplay and unique twists

This game is a labor of love for the collectible card game genre, and is aiming to become a fun game to play with friends or solo, without the stress of spending a ton of money buying card packs and keeping up with a meta.
Features

Unique resource system

Fairtravel Battle features a unique resource system that gives you the most flexibility when building a deck.

Make your own masterpiece by combining any kind of card and discovering new decks, creating your own voice in the game.

Multiple Game Modes

Play each mode in 2-4 player matches, either online, lan, or with CPU players.
Battle with your collection in the Duel mode
Deckbuild your way in Explorer mode
Battle a raid boss in the 4-player Raid mode. Or, be the raid boss yourself!
Draft cards to make a deck in Draft mode
Open packs to make a deck in Sealed mode

This is a sustainable game

Fairtravel Battle is being developed so that if support ends, the game can still be played, and will not otherwise disappear. It is playable offline, in your local network, in Steam lobbies, or in player-hosted dedicated servers.

Make it your own

Fairtravel Battle supports game data mods such as new cards, replacing textures, new effects, and more.



Fairtravel Battle will never have any microtransactions for card packs. Excluding some premium cosmetics and expansions, all game content is obtained from playing the game.

title: Skippy's Grand Escape
description:
게임 정보
About:
In this minimalistic space themed top down runner you play as Skippy who's racing to reach each maze's exit as fast as possible.
Watch out for enemies, traps, black holes and other dangers.
Use available skills tactically.
Compare your time against the game's times as well as Steam friends and global Steam leaderboards.
Skills:
Frost Nova: Freezes enemies in range for a short duration
Tactical Beacon: Drop a "tac beacon" which you can teleport back to, should it become a better option then proceeding or backtracking your current path
Active Sensor Pulse: Show enemy detection range, enemy paths and more
Create Spacetime Rift: Essentially a dash - but with a cooler name :-P
Extend Presence: Explore the area around you without moving Skippy
More to come
Levels:
Currently there are 6 sectors with 6 levels each
Unlock new sectors by reaching all exits of the previous sector
Levels of each sector can be done in any order you like
Gameplay modes:
The game offers 3 modes for different player types: Default, Relaxed, Hardcore.
In default mode you try to reach the game's top tiers by reaching the exit as fast as possible. Each level shows your time's tier, your best time and your friends' times.
This is the intended experience.
Should you require an additional challenge, hardcore mode will certainly give you one. You'll do the same as in default mode but there is no respawn should you ever die. Are you able to beat the game without dying once? Extra points for reaching S-tier ranks for all levels in HC mode!

title: Roman Empire Wars
description:
게임 정보
Rise!

As a new emperor of Rome, guide your country through the uncertain times, when the Empire is being constantly surrounded by the enemy nations. Don’t wait for the inevitable, but show them your might and bring the war to their doorstep! For the power of Rome is great and the Emperor’s fury brings death.

Command!

Gather your legions of the fiercest warriors in the whole Empire. Prepare for the bloodshed and create a strategy that will bring to shame the leaders across the Europe. Lead your troops to the victory as a wise and tireless commander. Give swift orders and change your plan accordingly to the situation on the battlefield. Flank, push them back and destroy. Everyone shall kneel before the armies of the Emperor.


Stand face to face with various fractions and bring them a crushing defeat. No Gauls, Huns, Greeks, Spartans or other barbarians will spit in the face of the Emperor. Make them pay for their impertinence. No matter how strong is their army, the Roman Empire will bring them devastation across the whole Europe. On the land and on the sea.


Manifest the glory of Rome, by battling in the distant lands of various countries. Rage war throughout the Greece, Carthage, Persia, Egipt and Great Britain. Let the glory of the Roman Empire be spread in Europe, by the means of sword. Make them fear your anger and marvel at your wisdom.

title: I Want to Believe
description:
게임 정보


미국 북부의 작은 마을에는 지역 주민을 흉내 내는 외계인들이 여러 명 있습니다. 당신의 임무는 누가 누구인지 파악하고 외계인을 제거하는 것입니다. 이 위험한 임무를 돕기 위해 오래된 픽업 트럭과 카메라가 제공됩니다.

I Want to Believe는 1인칭 액션 게임으로, 탐정 요소, 시뮬레이션, 잠입, 자유로운 행동 및 운전 요소를 포함하고 있습니다.

지역 주민들을 알아가고, 그들을 관찰하며, 돈을 벌고, 목표를 제거할 방법을 계획하고, 모든 것을 "깔끔하게" 처리하세요. 특히 외계인의 존재를 믿지 않는 현지 경찰 때문에 게임은 용서가 없습니다.

게임 특징
자유로운 행동
스스로 무엇을 해야 하고 어떻게 해야 할지 발견
사실적인 차량 물리
몰입감과 분위기
다양한 게임플레이 요소의 시뮬레이션
완전한 라디오 시스템

title: Pill Fight
description:
게임 정보
Fight six different enemy types in a fast-paced series of waves that increase in difficulty over time. With six unique maps to explore, forget about storylines, quests, or complex mechanics. This is gaming boiled down to its most basic principle: FUN.
Key Features:
Graphics: Pill Fight features a low-poly, minimalist art style, giving each enemy a truly unique look. The style is easy on the eyes and ensures smooth gameplay on virtually any system.
Map Variety: A total of six maps to keep the action fresh! The demo includes one map: a vibrant cityscape featuring a working bus that you can ride.
Frantic Action: Don’t let the friendly visuals fool you—things escalate quickly. Careless players can easily find themselves overwhelmed by sheer numbers.
Enemy Variety: The game features six distinct enemy types, each with unique behaviors and requiring different strategies to defeat.

title: Who Infected?
description: 게임 정보

title: Overage - Child of Chaos
description:
게임 정보
We know what you’re thinking, the age-old question: what would happen if we put your stereotypical quick witty, gun tot-in, sunglasses-wearing, chain-smoking action hero in the universe of a horror game? The answer lies in Overage - Child of Chaos. This is a game that thrives on adaptability, allowing you to find guns that can do anything from permanently setting demons on fire and electricuting them through walls, to turning you into a furry!

Explore a beautiful, futuristic 2.5D world that encompasses platforming, satire, and shooting lots of guns! Don't get too comfortable though, the world of Morning Town is a dreadful place; overrun by demons and other things that go "bump" in the night. You must exercise caution, for there can be danger lurking on each end of the screen... and there are plenty of creatures lurking in the darkness... some big and some small... but all of them are hungry and ready to sink their teeth into your flesh.

So are you ready to kick some bubblegum and chew A**?

title: Borderlands 4
description:
게임 정보
2025년 9월 23일에 찾아오는 보더랜드 4에서는 무자비한 폭군이 지배하는 새로운 행성에서 화끈한 액션과 배드애스 볼트 헌터, 셀 수 없이 다양한 기상천외하고 치명적인 무기를 만나볼 수 있습니다. 지금 위시리스트에 추가하세요!
부와 명예를 쫓는 네 명의 새로운 볼트 헌터 중 한 명이 되어 카이로스에 온몸으로 부딪혀 보세요. 강력한 액션 스킬을 휘두르고, 무궁무진한 스킬 트리로 빌드를 커스텀하고, 화려한 이동 능력으로 적들을 압도하세요.
고고하게 높은 자리에서 민중을 내려다보며 지배하는 무자비하고 억압적인 독재자 '타임키퍼'에게서 벗어나세요. 이제 세계를 뒤흔들 엄청난 재앙이 그의 완벽한 지배를 위협하고 행성 전체에 메이햄을 불러일으킵니다.

title: Effulgence RPG
description:
게임 정보
텍스트 기호로 생명을 얻은 신비로운 세계를 탐험하세요.
게임 특징:
★ 제작 자원을 모으는 유일한 방법은 생물을 물리치고 개별 입자로 분해하는 것입니다.
★ 이러한 입자를 사용하여 특별한 프린터에서 무기, 장비 및 기계를 인쇄할 수 있습니다.
★ 탐험할 수 있는 수십 개의 위치가 있습니다.
★ 프린터에서 아이템을 만들기 위한 다양한 자원.
★ 인쇄할 수 있는 아이템에 대한 100개 이상의 청사진.
★ 고급 캐릭터 업그레이드 시스템.
줄거리

그러나 신호가 백만 광년 떨어진 은하에서 온다면, 우리에게는 기호의 조각들만 도달합니다. 때때로 그것들을 해독하여 텍스트 문자로 만든 애니메이션으로 조합할 수 있습니다.
이것은 이상한 세계의 이야기입니다. 신호가 백만 년을 여행했으므로, 그 세계는 더 이상 존재하지 않을 수도 있습니다. 아니면 그 세계는 여전히 존재하며 공격을 준비하고 있을지도 모릅니다?

title: Dino & Chill
description:

Dive into the world of Dino Collector, the ultimate dinosaur-raising and collection game that works seamlessly in the background while you go about your day on your computer! Grow, collect, and discover a variety of dinosaurs, each with its own unique digging abilities to unearth precious gems.
As your dinos dig through their environments, you’ll gather gems that can be spent on exciting items to enhance your collection—collect stunning trees, collect new houses, or acquire special consumables to help your dinosaurs grow stronger and faster. description:

It's Better Alone is a puzzle platformer where you must switch control between two characters in order to solve a variety of platforming puzzles.

A weathered man, haunted by the past.

title: NIA
description:
게임 정보
Drill, smash, leap and slide through this 2d puzzle platformer mashing retro graphics & icepunk aesthetics. Explore dozens of hand crafted worlds in well over 100 different levels.

A young icer-nomad must drill, battle, and puzzle her way towards the discovery of a lifetime - the true cause of The Silver Storm and the last warm day on Earth - to save her family from the growing cold.


A young icer-nomad has just been given her first ice drill and joined her place in the community as an icercadet. Everything is going just as it should and everyone is doing their part - except that hasn’t stopped the frost from growing through the farmbeds and the lights from crackle-popping in the frigid night. Every once in a while, spectral glimpses of the cities of old can be admired through the permafrost asbut the elders only mutter ”the past is the past’. The Silver Storm is now nothing but a story told to keep cadets under their electric blankets at night.

With fantasies of canned ham and the magical foods of The Before time drifting through the new cadet’s mind, a glimpse of a factory lost deep in the ice beneath her makeshift bed is all she needs to make her decision - she’s going down. As she drills, a crack forms, a large crack that swallows her up and slides her into the depths of the ice below.

Lost in the Underice, she must now find her family the food they need while navigating the dangers lurking below her world. If that means she has to solve the mystery of The Silver Storm and end the global ice age, then so be it. People have to eat.



NIA is a lighthearted old-school 2D platformer with a few modern twists.


13 worlds hand crafted to offer the best possible experience.


A complex simplicity reminiscent of the classics, handcrafted levels for fans of platformers old and new.

title: Deflectorium
description:

Wishlist Deflectorium now. The galaxy needs you.

Actively deflect incoming projectiles back at your enemies or spin them around yourself and throw them back. This can all be done within the deflection zone around your hero. Move freely across the arena in no time. Gravity won't bother you.
Arenas are connected to each other on a hexagonal map where a boss waits patiently at the end, opening the way to other sectors. With a new threat.

Bullet perfect game

title: SeaDogs Of Nassau
description:
게임 정보


Nassau lies in ruins. Its people look to you to restore it to its former glory. Your only choice? Take to the sea and become the most notorious pirate legend of all time. Will you loot, plunder, and decimate all who stand in your way as a fearsome renegade? Or will you use your strength and charisma to rise through the ranks of the Navy? Both these paths and anywhere in between are there for you to take in Seadogs of Nassau.
Explore Unsettled Seas
As an open-world Pirate RPG, Seadogs of Nassau aims to give you the freedom to live like a true warrior of the sea. In a world inspired by Caribbean and West African civilizations of the 17th century, you’ll come face-to-face with challenges both human and mystical.

Coordinate Brutal Naval Combat
Engage in exhilarating naval battles with a pirate vessel of your own making. Fight dirty or honorably with skills befit of a seafaring corsair.

description:

title: Space Tournament
description:
게임 정보
Master the cosmic drift!

Experience the ultimate cosmic drifting thrill as you master unique controls, challenge friends, race in charming missions, and unleash your creativity with the extensive mission editor.



Whether you prefer a relaxed gaming experience while enjoying the delightful campaign or showcasing your extraordinary skills to outperform your friends, this game will satisfy you. Immerse yourself in the art of piloting a ship through space, where there's no drag and only two turbines.

Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey!
Gameplay

Steering the ship is all about mastering the two engines. You can also equip a power-component with more than two engines, but it all boils down to the same control.

You'll navigate the ship using just three buttons: . Of course you can also use a controller.

Since you're floating in the vacuum of space, there's to hold you back. The ship keeps moving and spinning after every burst of acceleration unless you counteract it. But fear not! We've got clever ship parts that create a little friction to make life easier for beginners.

This simple yet incredibly challenging mechanic lies at the heart of the game. It's an absolute delight to master control over your ship. From initially chaotic zigzagging rides, you'll gradually transform into a .

Apply your acquired skills to the multitude of missions in the campaign!


The mission editor you'll find only in the PC version. It is the same editor we use to build the campaign missions. You can without having to dive deep into the intricacies of the editor.



But hey, if you're up for it, with a little practice, you can set up more too! If you're familiar with graphic design programs or other editors, you'll quickly find your way around and revel in its wealth of features.




You can easily publish your completed missions so that others can access them too. It's time to !

The (hopefully) abundant missions created by players can be searched and sorted through tags and user ratings. This means you'll have a at your fingertips, extending the fun far beyond the campaign!

Visit our Website for more information!

title: OnOrbit - Virtual Space Lab
description:
게임 정보
Welcome Spacefarer, Join us On Orbit!

Try our sandbox, simulator and strategy PC game on STEAM or EPIC Games store from August 2024.
Its a high fidelity, real world and near future space simulator, featuring real world space engineering.
Gameplay - What's under the hood
We’re going, Together.

Join OnOrbit’s Supranational Space Cooperative (SSC) on its journey to make life multiplanetary. Your personal mission? Develop the skills you need to take humanity out into the solar system. Once your technical and psychological training is complete, use your knowledge to head out to the planets and build, build, build!
Build and repair spacecraft on orbit
Using real world, and near future space hardware, build your own craft from the ground up. Go from the smallest craft, to the craziest design you can think of in sandbox mode.
Operate your craft to complete missions
Use robotic arms, fire thrusters, mate with docking ports, spin reaction wheels, deploy aerials, move solar panels, take camera shorts ... operate any and all of your spacecraft parts to complete your mission, but watch out, they don't all work as expected.
Is it a rare part, or worthless space rust? Bring them back to the station and strip them for IS$ or reverse engineer them for reuse. Be warned though, you may have collected more than you bargained for.
Climb in the rankings and get to build your own space station. Take it to Mars, Venus or beyond. Lucky enough to own your own station? Rent a docking port to other players, sell them power, fuel, air and water and help them get their smaller craft in orbit around other planet
Join one of the space station missions, inspect the SSC Thor, SSC Tunguska, SSC Black Knight or the SSC LaGrange in the full version of the game.

Along with the sandbox, the future roadmap has us building the latest and greatest models from all your favorite space companies. Investigate and explore the ISS, Axiom space station, Artemis Lunar Gateway, Blue Origin's Orbital Reef, CASC's Tianggon sation and the ISS. Refuel and repair Hubble, Chandra, James Webb, Starlink satellites and the other on orbit craft. Fly the Sierra Dreamchaser, the Boeing Starliner, SpaceX's Dragon Then build out your own fleet to head out there.

If you're a modeler or a modder and want to know more, please visit us at our website. We're looking for captains for our existing stations around Earth, Venus and Mars.

title: Mapventure Story
description:
게임 정보
이 액션 로그라이트에서는 매번 플레이할 때마다 자신만의 맵을 만들고, 보스를 향해 바로 갈지 아니면 더 많은 적과 싸워 더 강해질지 결정할 수 있습니다. 다양한 생물군계에서 자원을 모아 마을을 업그레이드하고 사람들을 구출하여 다음 모험을 위한 더 많은 이점을 얻으세요.

여행의 시작
몇 년 전 마지막 유능한 사냥꾼이 끊임없이 변화하는 던전에서 돌아오지 못한 후, 당신은이 역할을 맡기로 결정했습니다. 마을은 거의 비어 있고 무너진 집들로만 구성되어 있지만 몬스터에 맞서 싸울 수 있다면 마을에 다시 새로운 생명을 불어 넣을 수 있습니다.
생물군계
던전은 한 생물군이 다른 생물군을 따라가는 신비한 장소입니다. 예를 들어, 울창한 숲에서 뜨거운 사막으로, 또는 으스스한 묘지에서 수정의 평면으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 각 생물군계는 마을을 확장하는 데 중요한 다양한 재료를 제공합니다. 더 발전할수록 생물 군계와 재료의 선택이 더욱 다양해집니다.
에너지
모험에서 더 강해지려면 필드에 있는 모든 몬스터를 처치한 후 생물 군계의 에너지를 사용할 수 있습니다. 공격, 방어, 특수 에너지가 있으며, 한 종류의 에너지를 충분히 모으면 레벨이 상승하고 해당 에너지와 관련된 세 가지 개선 사항 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다. 일부 강화 효과는 최대 체력이나 재료 생산량을 증가시키는 패시브 효과인 반면, 다른 강화 효과는 공격이나 동작을 변경합니다.
새로운 지인 및 오래된 지인
던전을 여행하는 동안 때때로 마을로 데려갈 수 있는 다른 사람들을 만나게 됩니다. 그들 중 일부는 이미 길을 잃은 것으로 생각되고 다른 일부는 아직 만나지 못했습니다. 누군가를 도와주면 그들도 분명히 감사를 표하고 자신만의 방식으로 여러분을 지원하고 싶어 할 것입니다.
수년 전 길을 잃은 여행자들의 피난처로 시작된 이곳은 모두가 번영을 위해 무언가를 기여한 작은 공동체의 고향이 되었습니다. 하지만 지금은 거의 아무도 남지 않았고 마을은 길을 잃은 것처럼 보입니다. 다행히도 던전에는 온갖 유용한 기술을 가진 많은 사람들이 방황하고 있으며, 여러분이 그들을 찾아서 구해주기를 기다리고 있습니다. 그들의 도움으로 마을은 다시 번성할 수 있습니다.

title: GHOST CAM

Armed with a paranormal-detecting camera and a torch, you’ll explore an abandoned bedroom that twists into a shifting labyrinth of secrets.
Hunt for ghosts and capture them on film.
Piece together a hidden story lurking beneath the surface.
Beware—some spirits don’t like to be seen.
The deeper you go, the more the world warps around you.
What kind of ghost expert will you become… and what will you uncover along the way?


👻 Test Your Ghost Photography Skills
Wield your Polaroid-style camera to capture spirits and uncover ghostly traces, earning a Ghost Hunter ranking based on your actions.
🌙 ’70s/’80s Haunted Horse Girl Aesthetic
Roam through a surreal blend of childhood horse obsession, heartache, and vintage horror. Set in liminal spaces where faded ribbons, dusty stables, and ghostly hoofbeats, the past lingers like a restless spirit.

title: 3 Last Chances
description:
게임 정보
3 Last Chances is an Action RPG game with challenging combat and progression system that allows to create your own unique playstyle. You get 3 chances to replay a year, complete quests and find just the right method of weakening and overcoming the seemingly unbeatable final boss.

Replay the same year (50 weeks) up to 3 times, searching for a method to overcome the game's ultimate Boss. Repeated missions and dialogues can be skipped, with only new content being shown.
Acquire up to 56 abilities, each with 2 different upgrades. Unlock power-ups and equip weapons to become stronger and create your own, unique playstyle.
Challenge 20 Bosses, each with their unique attacks and mechanics.
Choices available to you and the game's ending depends on your decisions.

title: Emergent Magic
description:
게임 정보
Rebuild the Grand Library
The Grand Library has burned. No longer can the magi use spells handed down for generations. They must uncover the ancient art of spell crafting. Rebuild the Grand Library and fill it with spells of your own creation. Defeat enemies as you search for powerful components to bend the elements to your will.
Create your own spells

Features a voxel based spell crafting system with emergent elemental properties and runes to further control your creations, your ingenuity is the limit. The elements are at your command
Toss enemies with your might

Feel the impact of your magic, with physics to throw and smash enemies
Dash between your enemies in this first person spell-slinger, featuring a variety of enemies that you will have to overcome in unique ways. Loot them and take their power for your own, summon them to fight for you, take their spells or craft more powerful versions of your own. Features a multitude of unique enemies with differing abilities and spells across several levels
Conquer the world together with PVE and show off your ingenuity with your spells

title: Parkdens
description:
게임 정보
Parkdens is a nature park builder game where you can place tiles next to each other to create beautiful combination of gardens, landscapes and areas. Then a variety of the objects that turns a simple landscape into a nature park like trees, boats, grounds, decks, huts, fountains etc. can be placed on the top of the tiles to create unique, interesting and beautiful parks, mini forests, sitting areas and lakes.

There is sandbox mode where the tiles and objects can be placed freely without any restrictions and you can construct the parks of your dreams! Another mode is level mode where correct objects needs to be placed next to each other in order to unlock more tiles and progress to the next level.

There are 2 themes for the parks -
- Greenery
- Desert

title: Quatros Noir
description:
게임 정보


Quatros Noir는 클래식한 공식에서 이전에 본 적이 없는 새로운 차원을 펼칩니다. 플레이어들은 네 개의 상호 연결된 그리드를 탐험해야 하며, 각각이 고유한 블록과 규칙을 가지고 있어 새롭고 중독성 있는 느낌을 얻어 높은 점수를 얻어야 합니다!

Noir를 모티브로 한 주제, 특수 효과 및 부드러운 재즈 사운드트랙으로 Quatros Noir를 경험해보세요. 격렬한 캠페인 모드, 경쟁적인 PvP 모드, 지역 협동 모드를 비롯한 20가지 이상의 다양한 게임 모드가 있습니다.



회전 그리드는 네 개의 상호 연결된 그리드를 탐험해야 하는 완전히 새로운 메커니즘입니다. 각각이 고유한 블록과 규칙을 가진 네 개의 그리드를 탐험해야 합니다. 블록 배치에 대한 신중한 고려가 필요하며, 그리드가 상호 연결되어 서로 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.



다양성 가득한 강렬한 싱글 플레이어 경험으로, '젠(Zen)', '모드(Modes)', '하드코어 레벨(Hardcore Levels)' 세 가지 섹션으로 나뉩니다. 각 섹션은 고유한 분위기와 사운드 트랙을 갖추고 있으며, 깊이 들어가면서 변화와 진화합니다

매료적인 캠페인 모드에서 Quatros Noir의 신비를 풀어보세요.

다양한 경쟁 PvP 모드와 팀워크를 시험할 로컬 코옵 모드. PvP에서는 최대 4명의 플레이어와 빠른 경기에서 대결할 수 있습니다. 코옵에서는 당신과 당신의 친구들이 하나의 그리드에서 함께 작업하여 최고의 점수를 달성해야 합니다.



독특한 시각적 효과와 현대적인 분위기가 가미된 클래식한 느낌의 느와르에서 영감을 받은 분위기 있는 세계를 경험해보세요. 몇 가지 부드러운 재즈와 결합하여 Quatros Noir의 분위기에 푹 빠져보세요.

title: Delivoo Delivery Sim
description:
게임 정보
Work your way through delivering food, groceries and more using Delivoo and save enough money to open up your restaurant!

The game idea revolves around simulating the role of a local item delivery person. You have a smartphone with an app installed that notifies you of active orders from all around Peytor Town. While you discover the city and earn money walking / running / driving / cycling / commuting / etc your backpack around, you will face a number of challenges.
Keep An Eye On Temperatures
Depending on the type of items you carry in your backpack, you need to carefully arrange them in such way that frozen pizzas don't melt and nachos cheese sauce doesn't get cold. You can upgrade it to carry more items or even have better temperature insulation.
Make Sure You've Got Change
Some customers will prefer to pay cash, so make sure to manage your wallet contents carefully and don't forget to visit the ATM every now and then. If you don't have exact change, you can either bargain and hope for the best or make the customer wait ... your rating will likely suffer.
Grind Your Way Through Delivoo Partner Program
While short and easy orders are smooth, longer distance ones will pay more. Even better: rush hour and weather conditions also influences your payment.
These perks are only available to Delivoo Partners only, so make sure to keep your rating up and customers happy in order to get bronze, silver, gold or even platinum Partner Level.
PS: There's no rating that many can't magically remove
Find your way through Peytor Town
The city is large - so large, in fact, that it has a shore with a beach, a crowded old town, a busy office area, a picturesque mountain road leading to Holywood grade villas and more. Getting around the city can prove to be complicated, depending on the vehicle you pick:
Your own two feet
Public transportation (You'll need tickets or subscriptions)
Bicycle
E-Bike (You'll need to charge it or spend twice the effort to pedal it)
Electric scooter

You can either or dozens of vehicles of this type and leave them around town so you can easily switch between them to beat the traffic and deliver that hotdog as it's still steaming hot!

title: Nqc : Non Qualia Character
description:
게임 정보
네트워크 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다!
Nqc 에서 당신은 인간 '트리스' 의 복제 데이터입니다. 다시금 현실의 존재가 되기 위해 가상 공간에서 주어진 일들을 해결해야 합니다. NPC 들이 우글대는 어느 버려진 게임 속에서 말이죠. 
차원을 넘나드는 탐험
[기억 / 현실 세계 / 게임 속의 게임] 세 가지 차원을 넘나들며 탐험 할 수 있습니다.
당신 앞에 펼쳐진 네트워크 속의 공간은 2D / 3D 를 가리지 않습니다!
[챔버] 에서 현실과 소통하거나, 잊었던 기억을 재생하고, 게임 속으로 접속하며 앞으로 나아가세요.

title: Skera VR
description:
게임 정보
Skera is a single-player, puzzle-solving action adventure game designed for VR.
- A Dying World and an Ancient Tower -
In Skera VR, you find yourself imprisoned within an ancient colossal Tower, and a planet slowly decaying around you. Following the stories of your people, you have come here to the Tower to save your people. You will need to face robotic automatons, puzzles and the machinations of an Unpredictable AI. Luckily you have something more than fighting spirit to get you out of this.
- The Guardian Sword, Procedural Cutting!-

title: Rise Again
description:
게임 정보

'Rise Again'은 마법, 로그라이크 게임 플레이 및 던전 탐험의 요소를 결합한 액션 RPG입니다. 중세 판타지 우주에서 적들을 베어내고 전진하면서 잊혀진 마법사에서 숙련된 던전 탐험가로 변신하세요.
매혹적인 모험
최후의 일격을 날리기 전, 당신은 리치의 저주에 휘말렸습니다. 저주 이전의 모든 것을 기억할 수 없습니다. 눈을 떴을 때, 당신은 죽은 자를 부활시키는 차원의 신비한 세계에 자신을 발견합니다. 새로운 세계를 탐험하고 부활의 진실을 밝혀내며, 당신과 같은 저주받은 다른 이들과 함께 이 세계의 도전을 극복하세요!

리치의 저주에서 벗어나기 위해 변화무쌍한 던전에 들어가세요. 소환된 생물들을 물리치세요. 여러 가지 주문과 강화품을 발견하고 여행 중에 사용하세요. 독특한 전투를 경험하고.

title: Lost in Cheese
description:
게임 정보
사랑스러운 정육면체 모양의 고양이가 치즈에 가로막혔어요. 엄청난 양의 치즈가요.
치즈를 밀어서 길을 열고, 커다란 빨간 버튼까지 나아가세요.
치즈로 가득한 각 스테이지를 클리어할 때마다 치즈의 미스터리에 한 걸음 더 다가가게 됩니다.
귀엽고 아늑한 치즈 가득한 세계에 빠져보세요.
여정을 따라가다 보면, 신비로운 치즈의 기원에 대한 단서를 주는 오랜 친구들을 만날 수 있어요.
특징:
100개 이상의 레벨이 있는 아름다운 섬을 탐험하세요.
퍼즐을 마스터하고 새로운 세계를 해금하세요.
최소한의 이동으로 클리어하여 보상을 받으세요.
몰입감 있는 세계에서 두뇌를 자극하는 도전을 즐기세요.

title: Slime Slayer
description:
게임 정보

Slime Slayer is an action-packed roguelite where you exterminate EVERY LAST SLIME! Craft unique character builds in every run with compounding modifier runes.
Features
Pick Your Element: Every spell can be evolved with every element, and every element is mechanically distinct! Learn the strengths and weaknesses of each element and how to best combo them to craft a slime-killing machine!

title: Times Trials
description:
게임 정보
Move fast, think faster!
Times Trials is an intense, anime arcade-style block-dropping puzzle game that will supercharge your math skills.
Your goal is simple: arrange the falling number blocks to form rows or columns that equal the target number. As the blocks keep falling, you’ll need lightning-quick thinking to make it through.
Race against the clock in timed mode or go head-to-head against friends in versus battles. Choose from four operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division.

title: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
description:
게임 정보

While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive but properly manage time, space, and energy to achieve the goal.


Early Middle Ages, 9th century, Eastern Europe. The Viking boats are drifting inland, looking for a convenient place for settlement. One of the greatest and the smartest warrior who was the leader of the expedition was Ragnald. Together with his wife as well as travel companions, they were looking for a safe land, rich in water, vegetation, and animals.


He was also accompanied by his faithful friend, Raga the wolf. It was supposed to be a peaceful voyage, but the expedition fell into an ambush set by women from the Kingdom of Women. Ruthless warriors captured women and killed all men. Almost everyone...


With the help of Raga, the wounded Ragnald survived, and with little strength left the wolfhound pulled him to the other side of the river. Just before he fainted, he noticed his beloved Tove among the captives. When he awoke, his faithful wolf was laying next to him, and apart from the voices of nature, there was no sign of the attackers or the captured women.


This is how Ragnald started his adventure into the unknown, through wild, dangerous areas, but also villages and settlements, though not always friendly. Raga's loyal companion will often prove to be a savior, rescuing him from wild animals, or helping in the hunt.


Ragnald and the wolf are facing a difficult path, the fight against the weather, wild forest, animals, fight for food, medicine, fight against hostile tribes... but the main motivation is to regain the loved one.


But once they reach the village of women, it turns out that this is not an ordinary village ... but let's not get ahead of oneself for now.

title: 150 Floors
description:
게임 정보
Ascend!
150 Floors is a roguelite, tile-based strategy RPG where you can choose to play as 8 different elemental mages. Battle your way through 150 floors filled with many eccentric enemies and meet different characters who may or may not help you on your journey, as you reach and defeat the top floor!
Gameplay
Your adventure takes place in a tower that has 150 floors filled with enemies. Use different magical skills unique to each mage to attack your enemies and defend yourself. Each floor made up of tiles have a durability limit. If you attack an enemy, you're also attacking the tile they occupy as well and it may break, sending the enemy to the previous floor. This same logic applies to your opponents as well. If the tile you occupy breaks, you fall to the previous floor as well. Defeat all monsters on a floor and an elevator appears on the floor, taking you to the next floor.
Story
2 years prior in a distant land, strange creatures spawned from the top of a large tower and began their invasion, killing millions of people and consuming their souls. Each mage, afflicted by the sudden invasion of strange creatures, wants to rid the land of these creatures for their own personal reasons. The only similarities they share are to reach the 150th floor and conquer it, granting them any wish they desire... Or so the saying goes.

title: Rogue Tactics
description:
게임 정보
The end of the universe. Humanity has disappeared, and the stars have gone out. However, humanity was able to leave something behind.
The World of Ideas.
Everything is relative in this world, and in the great void, ideas begin to materialize. As one of the self-aware ideas, you strive for the ultimate materialization of the world of ideas, but the battle for it will not be easy.
Rogue Tactics is a turn-based tactical roguelike inspired by games like Kings Bounty and Into the Breach.
Features:
Collect a unique squad of creatures with their own strengths and weaknesses.
Fight in deep tactical battles with the impact of landscape on combat.
Combine creatures to create stronger ones.
Collect a variety of spells that can turn the tide of battle.
Find "Ideas" with their unique effects.

title: Evolve Lab
description:
게임 정보
EvolveLabOnline is a roguelite autobattler, where each enemy you encounter was created by another player. You are a scientist trying to explore the depths of an unknown aquatic planet. As you descent, on each depth you will fight against enemies created by other players and if you win you can evolve the behaviour of your creature until you are the first player to reach a new record depth.

Whenever a creature loses, it stays at the current depth and becomes a possible encounter for following players. Over time the waters of this planet will be filled with all kinds of different creatures and it will get harder and harder to be the first player to reach a new depth.

To program a creature, players can add different actions to their state machine or improve and modify these actions.
The Game currently features:

4 unique creatures to pick from
27 different actions that can be used by a creature
24 different modules and modifiers to further modify actions
23 different cores that provide the creature with unique special abilities
Millions of possible combinations

title: Galactic Diner
description:
게임 정보
A jam-packed, cooking-themed RPG about winning a galaxy-wide cooking tournament…
for aliens!
You’re whisked away to compete in Galactic Diner, the universe’s most popular TV show. Serve customers, explore an alien world, meet new friends, and cook everything from pancakes to dumplings as you fight your way to the top!
...But will it REALLY be that easy?
🌶️ Cook your way to the top!
It’s just a normal reality TV cooking show… or is it? Work with unlikely new friends to defeat NovaCorp and save the galaxy!
🍳 Delicious minigame madness
Master over 50 unique cooking-themed minigames. Cook in levels themed for everything from beaches to hot pots as you fight for your life against the galaxy's best chefs!

title: Creep
description:
게임 정보
Creep is a 2D platform game that takes place inside a struggled person's inner world represented as a worm world. You control the worm form of the same person as he shows why this world exists and how it's like to live there.
I have no friends and life is full of obstacles
Yes, it is hard to say the other worms in the world are friendly, and there are lots of other dangers you will encounter. There is no one else other than you to cope with all these. Your only weapon is your wit against this crooked world until you reach the point to hell with it. This won't just go forever like that. Your relationship with other worms will change as you progress.
I once loved too
Throughout the story, you will occasionally visit some memories or analogical mini levels with different gameplay than the main part of the game. These levels will unlock new abilities the worm can use. These abilities are not mere powers. They are part of the actual character progression itself and they will start to change the main gameplay and story.

title: SwingHard VR
description:
게임 정보
A Dark Fantasy Boss Rush VR game inspired by Thrill of The Fight X Dark Souls, that will give you a real workout!
Features
Several bosses each with their own unique fighting style, special moves, and mechanics.
Multiple weapons. Swing with axes or punch and elbow with unique weapon "Claw Shields". More weapons coming soon.
Damage based on how fast you swing. You can't just wiggle the controller to do damage like other VR games.
You have to move your body to dodge! Duck, Sway, Dash, and even Jump to avoid damage.
If space is limited use unique "Squat to move mechanic" where you can use joystick to move but it requires squatting in real life, ensuring a workout!
Multiple difficulty modes. And, customize boss specific variables and player stats to create your own challenges.
Dark story coming soon! What unholy power has corrupted humans into monsters? Can it be harnessed for good?
Better graphics, sound effects, soundtracks, and more coming soon!
WORKOUT GUARANTEED!
Credits
Song in trailer: Mellow Sonic - Gravitational Singularity (Xanomeline Remix)

title: Cloak Hero
description:
게임 정보
Cloak Hero는 클래식 로그라이트 요소가 가득한 액션 어드벤처 던전 크롤러 게임입니다. 어두운 땅을 통과하는 위험한 여정에서 우리의 영웅은 용감하고 강해야 하며 다양한 무기, 유물 및 마법 주문을 사용하여 사악한 괴물 군대와 싸워야 합니다. 구석구석이 위험하기 때문에 경험을 쌓고 새로운 기술을 배우는 것이 생존에 필수적입니다. 운명이 기다리고 있습니다. 망토 영웅은 던전 깊은 곳에 도달할 수 있을까요?

이 게임은 솔로 게임 제작사에서 Godot 게임 엔진을 사용하여 개발 중입니다. 모든 사항은 개발이 진행됨에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다. 게임 위시리스트에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 여러분의 인내심과 지원에 감사드립니다.

특징:
* 무작위로 생성된 레벨
* 다양한 무기와 유물
* 강력한 마법 주문
* 자동 및 수동 전투 시스템 혼합
* 업그레이드 가능한 무기 예술과 전설적인 기술

title: Wizard Cats Tank Battle
description:
게임 정보

Choose from seven classes and fight other Wizard Cats in Wizard Cats Tank Battle, a cross-platform multiplayer game!

Wizard Cats Tank Battle puts a fantasy RPG twist on the classic arena shooter genre, with mechanics inspired by MMORPGs, MOBAs, and ARPGs. The gameplay emphasizes teamwork and support while focusing on skill and precision.

As you play, you’ll earn Cat Coins, which you can use to customize your Wizard Cat’s fur patterns, body types, hats, wands, tanks, and meows.
Classes
Choose from 7 Wizard Cat classes designed for damage, tank, and support roles. Every class has unique class abilities, including a buff, debuff, and ultimate, as well as unique stats.

Pyro-Prancer - Fire DPS
Hydro-Dancer - Water Support
Furricane - Air Glass Cannon
Purrth-Quake - Earth Tank
Pawadin - Light Support
Necropouncer - Death Tank
Voidstalker - Void Disruptor

Winning is about choosing classes that synergize well within your team, so you can effectively counter your opponents! Players are free, and encouraged, to swap classes mid-game.

Buffs are applied when projectiles hit allies. Debuffs are applied when projectiles hit enemies.

Customize your Wizard Cat with a variety of fur patterns, body types, hats, wands, tanks, and battle cries. Find your cat’s unique voice by choosing from a community-sourced collection of meows!

Your cat will meow loudly every time you defeat another player, taunting the defeated and announcing your kill to the rest of the arena.

Earn coins as you battle and unlock exciting tanks, hats, and wands!
Collect powerups around the map, including special spells such as Exploding MIssiles and Bouncing Bolt. Collect special buffs such as Zoomies (speed boost), Nipped Up (shoot faster), Storm of Claws (increased melee damage), Reflection Bubble (missiles reflect off the player) and more!
Have you ever been in a situation where you're playing a game with friends and there’s that one person who is either too experienced or too novice to really enjoy it?

The combat system in Wizard Cats Tank Battle was designed to ensure it is fun for everyone!

Novice players will benefit from the simplicity of playing a support roll: the same missiles that damage your enemies buff your allies! So, if you want a less experienced friend to have fun, tell them to stand behind you and shoot you in the back!

Experienced Wizard Cats players can use their knowledge to guide their allies into picking the best classes for the situation.

title: Archer Hero
description:
게임 정보
Play as the titular Archer Hero as he sets off to climb the mysterious tower that suddenly appeared one day. Conquer the procedurally genereated floors, defeat the monsters that lurk in the shadows and solve the puzzles of this enigmatic tower. Loot the tower as you climb to strengthen your abilities and take on tougher and tougher monsters. Can you reach the top, and uncover the secret origin of the tower?
Features
Procedurally generated floors, leading to a different experience each playthrough.
Puzzle rooms containing floor tile puzzles, numbered orb puzzles, and more.
Variety of items that can strengthen the Archer Hero in numerous ways.
Large cast of enemies designed to match the theme of each floor.
Multitude of bosses and mini-bosses.
Secret end-game content.

title: Goob
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey into the depths of a mysterious and treacherous underground world. This adventure lets you explore vast caves, battle ferocious monsters, mine for precious minerals, and upgrade your abilities in order to survive.

Underground World: Immerse yourself in an interconnected underground world filled with mysteries waiting to be unveiled. Traverse treacherous terrains brimming with unique challenges, secrets, and opportunities for discovery.

Mining for Riches: Dig deep into the earth to obtain a wide variety of valuable minerals including; gemstones, and rare crystals. The deeper you go, the more valuable the resources will be.

Abilities and Upgrades: As you progress, your character will gather precious materials to unlock new abilities and powers. Upgrade your offensive abilities to enhance your effectiveness in battle or upgrade your soft skills to increase your chances of survival… The choice is yours.

Exploration Awaits: Immerse yourself in a sprawling and visually stunning world. You'll encounter a diverse array of formidable creatures and monsters lurking within the shadows. Engage in thrilling battles by using a variety of skills to protect your loot and unravel the secrets hidden beneath the earth's surface.

GOOB’s world invites players to embark on a captivating journey of discovery, survival, and growth. Will you conquer the depths, confront the darkness, and ultimately find a way out of this dangerous world? Start your Adventure soon!

title: Quandary
description:
게임 정보

In Quandary, a moral dilemma unfolds. As a doctor facing an unimaginable choice, you must make your emotional and logical self cooperate to find a solution, even when the law offers no answers.

Quandary is an intriguing 2D puzzle platformer where your character's internal struggle is brought to life. Your logic and empathy take form as two separate characters, moving in opposite directions, forcing you to strategically utilize both to navigate challenging puzzles.

Can you find harmony within this chaos and solve puzzles that seem impossible, ultimately deciding the fate of your suffering patient?

You control two bodies that move in opposite directions!
You control two bodies that move in opposite directions and represent your empathy and logic.



Solve puzzles to reach the light.






Duh, he is you, and you are him...

title: Death's Web
description:
게임 정보
"Death's Web" is a challenging "Rogue-lite" platformer where you explore an ever-changing 2D world filled with enemies ready to slay you. Fight, die, learn repeat.
Features:
Collector of Souls: You posess the ability to steal enemies souls after they die. you can secure the souls through soul spheres and use them after death to permanently increase your stats and upgrade spells.
Curses: Numerous curses are waiting to be discovered; they may lead to your demise, but they can be exchanged for blessings to aid your journey. Survive their devastating effects to claim your rewards. Curses can blind you, summon deadly spikes, unleash freezing hail, and much more—each one a unique challenge to overcome!
 Blessings: Some will heal you, others grant powerful new abilities, and some can completely absorb incoming damage. They enhance gameplay with unique effects, making each run more dynamic and engaging!

title: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.
description:
게임 정보
Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you explore a character through thoughts and momentos you find in stages of their life. Its an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.
 Experience through the eyes of a character as they return to their childhood home, after moving out. What mementos will they find? What thoughts will they go through? Can they be happy? Maybe not. You decide which thoughts to keep or discard. Help them find a better Frame of Mind.
While this game does its best to be accessible and kind, it also portrays burdens a normative society puts on kids, that are different growing up. You probably should not play this if you are looking for escapism. This game can be harsh sometimes, but it is driven by empathy and the desire to share authentic insights. Extensive content notes can be found in game and the manual. (see link list at the bottom right)
autokwd: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.

title: Mirror Throne: Auto Battler
description:
게임 정보
Build Your Team

Build a team of JRPG inspired units with unique abilities. You will need to strategically place and synergize the characters to be successful.

Battle

Battles play turns automatically, where units use their special abilities on specific triggers. There are many unique strategies and powerful synergies to be discovered.


Challenge the Mirrored Legion in a run based rogue lite mode where each run is modified by meta shifting trinkets.


Unlock new characters, items, trinkets, and factions after each run.

title: Territorial Hissing
description:
게임 정보
Something smells funny around here...
Niko wakes up after a long night of partying to discovers that something is stinking up his neighborhood. As he investigates he stumbles upon a story of corruption that sends him down a path with more than he bargained for.
Explore the world and discover all the secrets. Fight your way through the mean critters as you learn all the truths. Snag some cool trinkets to enhance your abilities. And laugh along the way.

title: Endless Night: The Darkness Within
description:
게임 정보
"Until you make the unconscious conscious, it will direct your life and you will call it fate"
                                                                                            -Carl G. Jung
Jake’s journey begins where most fear to tread—deep within the shadows of his own mind. Guided only by fragments of memory and a will to survive, he must confront the darkness that threatens to consume him.
What awaits in the depths? Fear, doubt, and pain… or the strength to overcome it all? The choice is yours: confront the darkness—or let it define you.
UNIQUE PLATFORMING MECHANICS
Dive into a platforming experience like no other, featuring fireflies with extraordinary abilities such as horizontal and vertical boosts, teleportation, and gravity manipulation.

title: Swordplay～Karakuri～Strange Tale
description:
게임 정보
Game Title: "Swordplay～Karakuri～Strange Tale"

Overview:
"Swordplay～Karakuri～Strange Tale" is a Japanese-style 3D action game set in a world where advanced "karakuri" technology is prevalent. Players can immerse themselves in a world inspired by both "karakuri" mechanisms and the late Edo period, enjoying slapstick theatrics in a rural setting.

Features:

3D Action: Experience the world of "karakuri" by utilizing jumping and evasive maneuvers.

Special Moves: Special moves are implemented through command inputs. Mastering them will provide advantages for progressing through the game.

title: Stellar Reach
description:
게임 정보
Coming soon!
Some time in our future, humans and their machine work force have reached a distant stellar neighbourhood and multiple factions are competing for dominance. Explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate across the nearby stars in a real-scale, fully-3D environment to overcome your rivals, mastering military power, prosperous governance, booming industry, wealth, resources, and their separate technology trees. Choose your faction and your path to victory, but travel it alone; you’ll find no friends in the hostile and dangerous depths of space.
Military
There are no alliances or treaties - everyone is a threat, all of the time.
Build fleets of ships and armies to defend, attack, colonise, and occupy the many planets in the local stellar neighbourhood. Engage enemies on the surface of planet and in space warfare.
Prosperity

title: Phenomena Embattled
description:
게임 정보
From the far reaching void of space, to the very cores of planets. This is where Phenomena Embattled takes place. You are part of an alien confederation sent to earth to find the means of ending an intergalactic conflict. Humanity is caught between alien star-fleets. They must strive to keep their place in the universe. You must find the path to complete your mission.
The game is a physics based shoot 'em up. Interact with squadrons and entire fleets in a story driven world. This single player narrative focuses on action rich, rouge-like, trans-medium combat. Be it air, water, or vacuum. The medium you steer your unexplained vehicle through will determine your capabilities. And the ones of your enemies.
Features:
Physics based interactive environment
Action driven missions and story
Intelligent enemies
Formation flying
Ability leveling
Choose your unexplained phenomenon
60+ base units to fight with and against
Many unique undisclosed encounters
Underground bases

title: God Of This World
description:
게임 정보
God Of This World took a couple of classic RPG ideas and modernized them into a 3D top-down shooter. You'll have to explore a logical world while collecting health, jewels, keys, bullets, shield bombs, unlock doors, destroy enemy portals, all while shooting down non-stop seeker robot enemies with regular and tactical guns, enemies who are all set to fire back. Make your way to the boss of each level, and find secrets, as each level gets progressively harder.

title: DURT
description:
게임 정보
DURT is a block-based puzzle game where the deep underground mines have collapsed in on the unfortunate workers and there is only one mole brave enough to dare rescue them from this hazardous environment.



Journey into the 5 unique worlds filled with more than 100 expertly crafted puzzles that maximize each of the block's unique effects. Tunnel through dirt, dodge traps, and manipulate complex contraptions to solve the mine's puzzles and rescue the trapped miners! Once you have bested the story mode, go get your hands dirty creating and sharing your own puzzles using the in-game level editor or explore the community's puzzling creations via the Steam Workshop!










The game was originally made for the and won 1st place for the admin award. was made with Godot Engine.

title: Circle Defense
description:
게임 정보
I know you have rich experience in defending the Earth!
CIRCLE is a tower defense game with a light card system, where you will play as a commander defending the Earth: by building/upgrading weapons on a rotating device called "CIRCLE" and using cards to deal with the continuously invading aliens.


Origin of the CIRCLE
One day, the moon was hit and destroyed by unknown creatures, and the debris turned into a circle around the Earth. Due to concerns about the unknown creatures, humans transformed the lunar circle into the CIRCLE device and deployed cosmic-level defense weapons on it.



Under the pressure of alien attacks, the human military technology tree continues to evolve, and its functions are summarized into command cards, waiting for the commander to issue orders.
The energy for the cards comes from the CIRCLE: the faster the Ring rotates, the higher the energy generation rate, but it seems to affect the aiming rhythm for deploying weapons.



- Level-based game: each successful defense against alien attacks will greatly enhance Earth's weapon defense technology, continuously unlocking new weapon types, upgrade items, and new technology cards.
- The combination of different weapon upgrade projects and different cards will create a multitude of possibilities.
- Each type of monster has its own behavior patterns and characteristics, so make sure to respond based on your understanding of them!
- Besides monsters, you also have to face the harsh cosmic environment, and some levels will force you to abandon common strategies to try more suitable solutions.
- You can press the space bar at any time to slow down time for more time to think about strategies and operations; or maybe you just want to see the fireworks in slow motion?

title: Rocket Engineer
description:
게임 정보
Design your rockets, launch them into orbit, extract resources from other worlds, and expand your presence into the solar system of Rocket Engineer. From the design of your own rockets, to your own colonies and launch sites, you have the freedom of exploration, expansion, and industry.
Features
Colonies
Colonies allow you to extract resources, transform them, and use them for building rockets away from Earth. But be aware, workers are required and a constant food and water supply is imperative for them to keep them conscious, and even better, productive. Should they all go unconscious, any production would stop.
A fully simulated solar system
Rocket Engineer features a realistic physics system that allows you to propel your craft to new worlds, or to crash them spectacularly!

title: Stop The Slimes
description:
게임 정보
Stop The Slimes is a tower defense card-based game where you need to protect their realm from a relentless invasion of the slimes.

What’s the gameplay like?

You will draw a hand of cards.
Using energy you can places your cards to build towers.
After each level you can pick from three new cards to help build your deck.



Levels can cap your deck to a max number of cards.
The deck builder screen will let you select the cards you want!

title: Bonez
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the most bone-rattling card game in town! Outwit opponents, play Power Cards wisely, and race to reach 21 without busting. Spice things up with strategic bets and win three rounds to become the ultimate Bonez champion! Every draw counts so shuffle the deck, place your bets, and join the Bonez revolution now!

Key Features:

No playthrough is ever the same: You’ll never play the same game twice!
Free to play
Two Currencies, Twice the Fun: Bonez can be played with Chipz; or Bonez - the social currency you get from friends.
PvP Betting: Engage in thrilling Bonez and Chipz betting for high-stakes competition.
Strategic Card Play: Strategically play House and Power Cards to outscore your opponents and climb the leaderboards.
Customizable Power Deck: Craft your winning strategy by building up your Power Deck. Amp up your game by upgrading to Power Boost Cards with special abilities.
Friendship Bonuses: Team up with friends who can gift you Bonez every day.

title: Heart Of Muriet
description:
게임 정보
Heart of Muriet is a voxel fantasy 4X RTS with a unique take. Teaming up with Elves, Dwarfs, and Mages, you’ll need to build and manage settlements while researching powerful magic to overcome the enemy in tense, company-based warfare.
Build and upgrade your bases with up to 40 different buildings and even more upgrades. Choose from 4 magic realms with a great selection of spells and a plethora of research options to boost the might of your heroic wizard and their army. Pick a clever strategy for your army, control your wizard and watch them win epic battles against your enemies.
You can manage troop formations and workers with ease and without any stress. Gone are the days of dragging boxes on the battlefield, instead you control entire formations or all the workers at a specific base with a single click. Give your fighting formations special commands depending on the situation, or use your spellcasters to turn the tide of epic battles.

title: Simulacro
description:
게임 정보

"Simulacro" is a first-person puzzle game, enriched with a narrative inspired by ancient Greek philosophy.

Poísis, an art student, ventures to a mysterious island, newly emerged due to the receding waters of Greece's majestic Lake Prespa - a change brought on by global warming. Gifted with the ability to encapsulate the essence of landscapes in her paintings, she explores the island seeking artistic inspiration. Confronted with relics of a lost civilization and enigmatic portals, Poísis grapples with a pivotal philosophical query posed by the ancients: what is the true essence of reality?
Explore Ancient Greek Ruins
Engage in Artistic Creation

title: Joninės
description:
게임 정보
Four friends in early 90's go to celebrate Midsummer's day in an island in a middle of a lake.
Little do they know of what awaits them.
In this story rich horror tale you will have to survive and find your friends.
Game is in Lithuanian language with English subtitles.

title: Swing Boy
description:
게임 정보
Swing Boy는 스윙을 새로운 차원으로 끌어올린 정밀 플랫폼 게임입니다. 그랩훅을 사용해 지하에서 탈출하여 지상으로 돌아가세요. 당신이 떠난 동안 무엇이 변했나요? 무엇이 남았나요?
지상으로 탈출하는 것은 쉽지 않습니다! 유독한 하수도를 가로지르고, 버려진 지하 연구소를 탐험하며, 위험한 적들을 피해야 합니다. Swing Boy는 현대적인 물리학과 레트로 픽셀 아트 스타일을 결합하여, 솔로와 협동 플레이 모두에게 잊을 수 없는 경험을 제공합니다.
스토리 모드 몰입감 있는 이야기
로컬 & 온라인 협동 모드
파티 모드: 감염, 타임 트라이얼 등
20개 이상의 Steam 업적
12개 이상의 잠금 해제 가능한 캐릭터
멋진 보스 전투

title: Arcane Path
description:
게임 정보
아무런 기억도 없이, 당신은 황폐해져 무너져가는 도시에서 인형으로 깨어납니다. 왕궁으로 가는 길이 펼쳐져 있지만, 적대적인 자동인형들과 신비로운 골렘들이 당신의 길을 막고 있습니다. 목적지에 도달하기 위해, 당신은 여정의 중요한 각 지점을 수호하는 세 명의 강력한 적들과 맞서야 합니다.
각 전투는 당신이 마법 카드, 유물, 그리고 스킬을 최대한 활용하도록 도전합니다. 신중하게 행동을 선택하고, 적의 패턴에 맞게 적응하며, 강력한 콤보를 발휘해 모든 적을 극복하세요.

title: Kombat Hamster
description:
게임 정보
햄스터 메타 농장을 자동화된 햄스터 코인 채굴 기계로 성장시킨 다음, 기술을 개발하고 더 많은 기술 자원을 확보하여 생산량을 늘리고 더 많은 햄스터 코인을 얻으세요! 내려가는 길은 없고 올라가는 길만 있어요!

농장을 개선하고 보상을 받으세요: 더 많은 햄스터! 햄스터가 많을수록 농업 사업이 더 빨리 성장합니다! 그리고 기억하세요: 햄스터는 야행성보다 더 어두컴컴하며, 야생에서는 포식자에게 잡히지 않기 위해 낮 동안 지하에 머물지만 농장에서는 그렇지 않습니다. 그들은 연중무휴 24시간 일하고 있으며 햄스터 동전이 그들이 살아가는 유일한 목적이기 때문에 아무것도 두려워하지 않습니다.

순위를 높이고, 임무를 완수하고, 보상을 받고, 새로운 기술을 잠금 해제하고 광산, 광산, 광산! 올바른 길로 가고 있어요, 햄스터 사령관님!

이것은 단지 시뮬레이션 게임일 뿐이며 플레이하는 동안 실제 암호화폐를 채굴하는 것은 아니라는 점을 명심하세요!

행운을 빌며 달에서 만나요!

title: ZombMe
description:
게임 정보
Old school 2D platforming...with a twist.

It's another zombie game....except this time YOU are the zombie...and instead of trying to stay alive....you're trying to stay dead! Jump, flip, throw, and avoid health powerups as you try to (not) save your neck.

Features include:
Precision 2D platforming
Over a half dozen types of jumps (including many hidden ones)
Pick up and throw enemies and objects
Interact with foreground and background enemies and objects
Get a unique suit with specific powers on each world
Countless sidekicks that will help you stay dead
Many types of headgear to help boost your stats
Several "power-downs" that will keep your health low (at the expense of mobility)
The ability to ride and drive many animals and vehicles

title: Warplock
description:
게임 정보
Warplock began as a small personal project in my first year at college. Over my time as a student I continued working on it and devoting more and more time to it. With the help of my girlfriend, I have been able to create the game that it is now. Warplock is a top-down action roleplaying game. The goal? To beat each biome. Along the way you will find various upgrades and items you can pick up. You will cast spells and destroy monsters who pray on your demise. When all is said and done, you return back to your home base to restore your health and magic and place the necessary upgrades before returning back to the wilderness.

We at Quackpot Studios hope that you enjoy.

-quack quack.

title: Shattered Sun
description:
게임 정보
ANNIHILATION APPROACHES
Shattered Sun is a twin-stick action roguelike where time is the ultimate enemy. Pilot a powerful experimental mech and fight your way across the solar system's planets, crushing enemies in your path as you try to escape the unstable sun before it's too late. Do you have what it takes, Commander?

CUSTOMISE YOUR MECH

title: Pure Blood
description:
게임 정보
장황 한 '오픈 월드' 에서 펼쳐지는 대 서사시

약 평방 35 ㎢ 에 다다르는 대륙과 그 안에 숨겨진 많은 던전, 그리고 무수히 생성되는 인스턴트 던전을 통해 끝 없는 모험과 여행을 즐기세요.


전략과 '손맛' 으로 무장한 전투에 더 해진 '접근성'

4가지 직업에 따른 근거리, 원거리 전투 방식에 방어, 회피, 방어 해제, 받아치기를 더 해 팀들과 함께 무한한 콤보 공격을 손 쉽게 발휘 하세요.


수많은 장비를 파밍하고 강화하는 재미

4가지 직업과 관련 된 300여종의 장비들과 수십 종의 세트 아이템을 찾아내고 다양한 방법으로 강화하여 나만의 장비를 세팅하세요.


때로는 혼자, 때로는 같이 적들을 섬멸하라

혼자서 해결하기 힘든 전투는 최대 8명까지 함께 협동하여 장비를 교환하고 전략을 짜서 진행 중인 스토리의 퀘스트를 해결 할 수 있습니다.


열심히 성장시킨 내 캐릭터로 우열을 가린다

게임 내 메인 스토리 외에 제한 된 던전안에서 4 vs 4 의 살육전을 벌이는 PvP 외에 다량의 사용자들과 점령전을 펼칠 수 있는 대규모 RvR 전투를 준비 중입니다.

title: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
description:
게임 정보
Key Game Features:
Intelligent, terrifying creatures that stalk your team, learn, and evolve.
A changing, mutating world where the environment itself is your enemy. Each game is unique, with the landscape mutating in different ways.
Cooperative gameplay, where you work with your team to get in, collect scrap, and get out before the environment and creatures grow to monstrous levels.
Cannibalize your friends

title: Shadow Strikers Arena of Rivals
description:
게임 정보
게임 "그림자 스트라이커즈 아레나 오브 라이벌스"에서는 그림자헤이븐에서 '그림자 토너먼트'의 충격 이후 사가가 이어집니다. 이제 '라이벌 아레나'가 등장하면서 다양한 팩션의 챔피언들이 지배권을 쟁취하기 위한 새로운 도전이 시작됩니다. 동맹이 시험받고 비밀이 드러나는 음모의 세계를 탐험하세요. 도시의 권력 균형을 재정의하는 강렬한 전투에 준비하세요. 그림자헤이븐의 다음 지도자는 누가 될까요? 이 아레나에서 당신의 흔적을 남기고 발휘하세요.

• 간단한 조작, 심도 있는 전투: 게임은 주요 공격을 위한 네 개의 버튼(경혈, 경킥, 중혈, 중킥)으로 간단한 조작을 제공합니다. 이 버튼과 방향키를 조합하여 다양한 특수 공격을 실행할 수 있습니다. 간단한 조작에도 불구하고 게임은 전투 중에 다양한 콤보를 만들 수 있는 넓은 가능성을 제공합니다. 또한 게임의 튜토리얼 모드에서 하나씩 가르쳐지는 사전 정의된 콤보를 실행할 수도 있습니다.

• 온라인 및 로컬 멀티플레이 모드: 온라인에서 친구들에게 도전하거나 로컬 멀티플레이 모드(로컬 멀티플레이 모드에는 컨트롤러가 필요합니다)에서 게임할 수 있습니다. 전 세계 플레이어와의 스킬 테스트에 도전하거나 친구들과 치열한 전투를 벌이세요.

치명적인 비밀과 강력한 타격이 얽히는 아레나에 준비하세요. "그림자 스트라이커즈 아레나 오브 라이벌스"의 챔피언이 되어 그림자헤이븐의 운명을 결정할 것인가요? 전투에 참여하고 답을 찾아보세요!

title: Warp Gate Galactic
description:
게임 정보
Step into your new home, a ring transport station in a lawless system commonly called 'Isfetian Space' on the edge of Federation territory. Most people say running a warp gate station in Isfetian Space is too dangerous and won't be profitable, but you didn't listen!
The Federation doesn't care what happens on the galaxy's fringe, but a ship that wants to travel back into the safer core systems needs clean credentials. That's where you come in! Earn the trust of The Federation by sending ships that have cleared credentials, exposing counterfeit credentials, and reporting wanted individuals to the Federation Police. Send too many uncleared ships and you'll lose the trust of The Federation, and your access to the core systems, leaving you with a warp gate and nowhere to send ships!
Core mechanics:
Send ships through the warp gate to generate income

title: GravShift
description:
게임 정보
이 정밀 플랫포머/코인 러너 게임에서 위험한 코스를 통과하며 높은 점수를 획득할 수 있습니까? 중력을 반전시키고 점프하여 장애물로 가득한 도전을 극복하며 동전과 보너스를 수집하세요. 세 가지 게임 모드가 제공됩니다.

title: Twisted Jam
description:
게임 정보
About
Players, get your skates on and get ready to get physical. Twisted Jam is a game where you must score the disk into the opponent's goal. Team up with friends and push your way to victory. If pushing doesn't work, try slide tackling.
Twisted Jam is arcade sport game. Play with friends, randoms, or even bots and make highlights from epic plays. In this game, you're controlling a single character, so teamwork is a must. Feel the energy and the momentum; It feels like you're running on ice, as you're on skates, there is more energy with each step. 
Place yourself inside the stadium, where contenders team up to battle for the top spot. While competing, communicate with your squad to make plays on the opponent's goal. Additionally, take advantage of height by using "Flux Drift" to move around walls and ceilings. Don't forget to eliminate opponents; otherwise, they might do the same to you.
Mechanics
Hyper Throwing System: Contains many variations on throwing the disk. If there is an obstacle in your way, throw around it!
Flux Movement: Your character moves around on skates / hover shoes. Moving around may be feel like you walking on ice. Additionally, you can walk on certain walls (flux walls and fields).
Deflection System: It might look like a yoyo. Use this to protect your goal. Don't allow your opponent to score points on you. Use this to push any player away
Scrap Collision: Your opponent has the disk? Run into them. What if they don't have the disk? Still run into them.

title: AYON: Split In Time
description:
게임 정보

Embark on an epic time-travel adventure in AYON: Split in Time. As Dahx, you’ll traverse multiple eras to reunite with your lost brother, Aidan. Armed with ancient artifacts called Ayons, you’ll navigate a world brimming with mystery, danger, and discovery.
A Vast, Exciting World 🌍
Explore richly detailed environments spanning tropical islands 🏝️, dense forests 🌲, snowy mountains 🏔️, and arid deserts 🏜️. Each era presents unique challenges and hidden secrets. Navigate intricate dungeons and vast landscapes, facing diverse enemies and formidable bosses. Seamless transitions between time periods add depth to your exploration, making each discovery more rewarding.
Master Time Manipulation ⏳
Harness the Ayons’ power to bend time and solve complex puzzles 🧩. Each Ayon possesses unique abilities to help you overcome obstacles and progress. Master these mechanics to gain an edge in combat and uncover your family’s legacy.
Forge Your Own Path 🛡️
Customize Dahx’s abilities to match your playstyle. Enhance combat skills, develop powerful magic, and upgrade equipment to face mounting challenges. Your choices shape Dahx’s journey, ensuring a personalized adventure.
An Epic, Time-Spanning Drama 🎭
Immerse yourself in a compelling narrative across multiple timelines. Unravel the mystery of your parents’ disappearance and the ancient artifacts they discovered. Experience a tale of brotherhood, betrayal, and redemption, woven through a rich tapestry of historical and fantastical elements.
Dynamic Combat and Exploration ⚔️
Engage in fast-paced combat with varied weapons and abilities. Use the environment to your advantage and adapt to each era’s unique conditions. From fierce creature battles to intricate puzzles, the gameplay keeps you constantly engaged.
Immersive Audiovisual Experience 🎶
Lose yourself in a captivating soundscape that adapts to your environment and actions, crafted by a visionary composer. Coupled with stunning visuals and meticulously detailed environments, AYON: Split in Time creates a truly immersive world.
Take a break from the main adventure with fun and nostalgic 2D pixel art minigames. Hunt for ancient gems in hidden caves and enjoy a variety of mini-challenges that add extra layers of excitement to your journey.

Join Dahx on his quest to reunite with Aidan, uncover time travel’s secrets, and save their world from impending doom. AYON: Split in Time offers a unique blend of adventure, puzzle-solving, and action that will captivate players and leave them craving more.
