title: There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder
description:
게임 정보
Play as secret agents Franklin Benjamin and Virginia West as they attempt to stop a madman with a weather machine in this single-player interactive spy novel. Track down this madman named Zeus and destroy his infernal doomsday device. You may find yourself de-escalating a hostage situation, investigating a crime scene, or even defusing a ticking time bomb. But whatever this mission calls for - it’s time for YOU to bring the thunder, agent!
Your Mission
We have it on good intel that a madman named Zeus is attempting to build a weather device that could wipe entire nations off the face of the Earth. Obviously, we can't let that come to pass!
Track down this madman, unravel his scheme, and destroy his doomsday device. The fate of the world rests on your shoulders and your shoulders alone. This is a single-player game, after all
There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder can be played with just a mouse. Gameplay consists of selecting the action or dialog you wish to take given the situation you’re facing. Although the life of a secret agent is complicated, playing There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder is simple
Lightning Strikes Thrice - Sequel or Standalone
There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder is the third entry in the There's Always a Madman series, but it tells a standalone story. Like a classic James Bond novel or film where you can pick any one up independent of the rest, you can pick this story up without having experienced any prior stories in the There's Always a Madman franchise. However, I would recommend starting with the first game There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight if you care to experience the series in its intended order
Forecast, Then Act
As a secret agent, it's not about who has the fastest trigger finger. Put your mind to good use and make intelligent in-the-moment decisions on how best to handle your current predicament. Only by out-thinking your opponents can you survive to tell the tale
Storm's Brewing
A storm is coming, and only our top pair of secret agents can stop it. Whether you find yourself de-escalating a hostage situation, investigating a crime scene, or defusing a ticking time bomb - it'll take all your spy skills to rain on this madman's parade!

title: The Mnemograph
description:
게임 정보
A new evening newspaper is hitting the streets, and it's yours. But The Mnemograph Chronicle isn't just another one of the dozens of flimsy 'rags' that people devour every day. This is a paper written by a machine, the Mnemograph. For a genius inventor, what could be easier than creating a system capable of extracting information from the carefully harvested brains of unclaimed bodies at the municipal morgue? All that remained was to build an automated printing factory, so the power of steam could spread across the city, delivering news that chronicles its own downfall.
The rise of the press attracts entrepreneurs of varying scruples every day, so... why not you?
Your printing factory will need to be upgraded to achieve production speeds that can compete with the best-established publishers and reduce costs; regular repairs will also be necessary. The accuracy of the Mnemograph can be enhanced to improve the quality of the journal. You'll also need to manage stocks of paper, ink, copper, and coal.
But most importantly, you'll need to carve out a place for yourself in a hostile world where anything goes. You'll have to get your hands dirty with the city's underworld, exploit its criminal talents, get involved in its schemes, pay for its services, and wade through the muck of corruption under the cover of night.
Build a Unique Deck by Purchasing Services from the Underworld
At night, you'll need to protect yourself from rival newspaper moguls who will try to sabotage you as you rise to the top. But if you want to own the biggest paper in the city, you'll also have to go on the offensive, enlisting the services of the underworld.
As you progress, you'll encounter new characters. Each one offers different services tailored to a specific style of play. For instance, the crime boss provides basic services like thugs (orange cards), while the politician offers protection services (blue cards).
You get to decide who you want to meet, allowing you to build a unique deck with a personalized play style.
Manage Your Supplies, Upgrade Your Printing Factory, and Make Repairs
Carefully manage your supplies by buying and selling goods based on current prices to maximize profits. Upgrade your printing factory to reduce resource consumption and cautiously increase production speeds. Maintain your machines regularly to minimize the risk of breakdowns.

title: Hope Inc

As Victor, an engineer on a mission to save humanity, you’ll journey through a frozen city, scavenging materials for the Beacon and encountering survivors – some bloodthirsty, some benign.
FEATURES:
Level-based Structure!
15 immersive levels split between two distinct locations: outdoor levels focused on parkour and indoor areas centered on fight.
Numerous Cutscenes and Dialogues!
Immerse yourself in Victor’s dramatic journey through powerful scenes and dialogues that reveal a rich story and universe filled with vibrant characters.
Jump and Maneuver!
Platformer controls at their best! Each area is packed with obstacles and deadly foes, keeping you on your toes.
Boss Battles!

ARE YOU READY?
Can you bring hope back to a world on the brink of collapse?

title: Wild Horizon: Edge of Survival
description:
게임 정보
Survive the wild, master the elements, solve puzzles, scale cliffs, swing ropes, leap ledges, outsmart animals, and find your way home.
Wild Horizon: Edge of Survival is an adventure game set amidst the perilous wilderness. As the lone survivor of a devastating plane crash, you must navigate a rugged, rocky landscape, outwit fierce predators, and solve challenging puzzles to survive. With only the terrain around you and your instincts to rely on, each step forward brings you closer to safety—or disaster.
Key Features:
Immersive Third-Person Exploration:
Traverse a breathtaking, untamed world filled with jagged cliffs, steep slopes, and awe-inspiring vistas. The environment is as beautiful as it is deadly, capturing the raw power of nature.
Dynamic Traversal and Movement Challenges: Perform daring maneuvers like mantling steep plateaus, leaping across perilous gaps, sprinting along wall to cross deadly chasms, swinging on ropes over dizzying heights, and clinging to narrow ledges to avoid plunging into the depths below.
Stamina Management: Carefully manage your stamina to stay alive in this unforgiving wilderness.
Intricate Puzzle Mechanics:
Unlock vital tools by solving puzzles that challenge your observation and logic.
Wildlife Encounters:
Outsmart dangerous predators using your surroundings and clever tactics. Brute force isn’t an option—your wits are your best weapon
The Story
You awaken in the aftermath of a catastrophic plane crash, alone and isolated from the rest of the world. With no smartphone, no tools, and no modern comforts, you must rely on your instincts and the harsh wilderness around you. Your only hope lies in reaching the wreckage of the aircraft to repair the radio and call for help.
But the journey is treacherous. Cliffs, slick slopes, and dizzying heights make even the simplest tasks perilous.
Unlike traditional survival games, Wild Horizon isn’t about chopping down trees, gathering stones, or building cozy shelters. Your goal is to get back home.

title: Rip & Tear

게임 정보

Inspired by Doom's gruesome violence, this adrenaline-fueled carnage sets you against infinite waves of hideous demons, cultists, and biomechanical freaks in a bloody battle for survival.
With every shell you fire, limbs explode, walls are painted red, and the ground is littered with the remains of your enemies. There are no fancy weapons, no gimmicks—just you, your shotgun, and the relentless onslaught of hellspawn.

title: HELL OF FEAR: Mind Breach

What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a desperate battle for survival against an entity that turns both mind and matter against you.
SURVIVE THE DEPTHS
• Navigate through 26 unique sectors of a massive underground base, each with its own dangers and secrets
• Manage your resources and choose your battles wisely against sinister entities
• Uncover the truth through recovered logs, security footage, and the haunting remains of the base's personnel
FACE THE INFECTION
• Confront hostile entities that are controlled by a mysterious biological force
• Experience dynamic horror that adapts to your actions and decisions
• Solve environmental puzzles while avoiding detection by creatures that hunt through light and movement
KEY FEATURES
• Unique blend of psychological and biological horror
• Atmospheric survival horror set in a claustrophobic underground facility
• Strategic resource management
• Immersive sound design that heightens tension and aids survival
• Rich narrative told through environmental storytelling
🌿 Can you resist the breach?
ABOUT THE DEVELOPER
HELL OF FEAR: Mind Breach is a game designed by Tayfun Tuna and developed by Cenk Bilgin. It represents our vision of a new era in psychological survival horror.
Note: This game contains scenes of intense horror, violence, and psychological distress. Player discretion is advised.

Devil's wish is a casual game with two game modes: storyline and drama.
You will play the role of supporting role Cao Dan, a blue haired girl who occasionally becomes confused, has an angel's heart and can use ACUPRESSURE KUNG FU. In a world ruled by "talent", you will explore the inner world with the protagonist Liu Lianer.
The main storyline of this work will distinguish between two main branches, but ultimately return to a true ending.
This work mainly features a dark and humorous style, striving to better portray the characters' inner selves.
Regarding the drama mode:

In drama mode, you can determine the position and number of enemies, which will result in different dramatic effects.

title: Rustic Defense
description:
게임 정보
Rustic Defense is a hexagonal fantasy tower defense game with roguelike elements, generated enviroment with option explore your own way.
Turrets
Like in classic tower defense game, you build turrets that fight with incoming enemies.
You can research 15 types of turrets that belong to five categories (archery, natural, guns, throwing, splash). Every turret has physical damage, advanced turrets adds elemental damage bonus (fire, poison, ice) and special attack feature. Elemental damage rise overtime damage or slowing monsters. 
Enemies
Enemies incoming from four bioms. The Valley is nearest and enemies haven't any armor. Mountains, Desert and Swamp monsters has armor with resistances to specific elemental attack.
Map
Map and enviroment is randomly generated. After each wave you can choose way that you want to explore.
Progress
After every game you obtain experiences depends on reached wave. Those experiences you can convert to skills in skill tree, that give you advantage for rest of game.

title: Ox & Horse Work in Hell
description:
게임 정보
Control the tough and resilient Ox-Head and the agile Horse-Face with your friends to carry out tasks. (It also supports single-player mode and playing with AI teammates.)
Work Content
Evil spirits, due to their many grave mistakes in life and their refusal to repent, carry their sins and are unable to be reincarnated.
The job of Ox-Head and Horse-Face is to punish these evil spirits, make them confess their sins, and help them turn over a new leaf. However, be careful not to let them escape, as this would anger the King of Hell, and the consequences would be severe.
Finally, feed them the Meng Po soup to forget their memories from life, giving them a chance to start anew.
Punishments
There are various ways to punish:
Beat them fiercely with your fists
Smash them with props
Bind the fallen evil spirits to torture devices and whip them vigorously
Utilize mechanisms to create a production line
In Your Spare Time
Working in hell also involves interacting with many colleagues and leaders, encountering numerous interesting special events.
After defeating the most terrifying evil spirits in hell and before the day's work is done, don't forget to compare your daily work performance with your teammates. Who will be the outstanding employee of the day?
Main Features
Cooperative and competitive play for two players
A variety of punishment devices
Numerous mechanisms

title: Sokoku
description:
게임 정보
Use your logic to push blocks and roll dice and solve dozens of challenges!
Sokoku is a block-pushing game with a twist: you play as a die that rolls over itself. You'll need to move strategically so that the right face ends up on top and in the right place, while you interact with other cubes and different mechanics.
Dozens puzzles await you. Can you solve them all?

title: Tired to Fall
description:
게임 정보
Tired to Fall은 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임으로, 버디 잎을 모으고, 발사하며 플랫폼으로 변환하여 작은 잎이 나무로 돌아갈 수 있도록 돕습니다. 점프하고 활강하며 가시 밤, 도토리, 대포 버섯이 가득한 저지대에서 퍼즐을 해결하세요!



여정 중에 다양한 버디 잎을 모으세요.



을 발사하고, 심고, 플랫폼으로 사용하여 장애물을 극복하세요!



가시 밤, 도토리, 대포 버섯이 가득한 생동감 넘치는 저지대에서 하며 하세요.

title: DON'T STOP
description:
게임 정보
A mysterious force binds you to an unyielding rule: stopping means certain death. In Don't Stop You'll Die!, you must navigate through the seven circles of hell, facing relentless waves of enemies. Arm yourself with a powerful arsenal of weapons and abilities. Survival hinges on quick reflexes, constant movement, and split-second decisions. Can you escape this unforgiving gauntlet, or will you succumb to the chaos?
Key Features
Fast-Paced Roguelike Action: Constant movement is essential—stopping means instant death!
Dynamic Wave-Based Combat: Face relentless waves of enemies, with difficulty ramping up as you progress.
Diverse Arsenal: Wield a variety of weapons and abilities, from guns to supernatural powers, to crush your foes.
Procedurally Generated Challenges: Experience a fresh and unpredictable run every time you play.
Replayability: With its roguelike design, no two runs are ever the same—offering endless hours of gameplay.
Quirky NPCs: Interact with eccentric characters like Gort and Mort, who add charm and depth to the underworld.

title: Banshee Bash
description:
게임 정보
Banshee Bash is a fast-paced local multiplayer party royale! Team up or go solo in chaotic free-for-all battles. Collect spell books to expand your arsenal and grab potion bottles to stay in the fight.
Features
8 Playable Characters – Choose your favorite fighter!
16 Unique Levels – Battle across diverse arenas.
Unlockable Cosmetics – Customize your character with stylish rewards.
Up to 8 Players – Bring the whole party! (Windows currently limits controller connections to 4, but bots can fill the rest).
Get ready to brawl in Banshee Bash – where the magic is wild, and the competition is fierce!

title: SKYLARK
description:
게임 정보
황폐해진 하늘에 표류한 SKYLARK. 외로운 생존자가 되어 폐허가 된 세상의 진실을 밝혀내세요. 든든한 로봇 동료와 소중한 열기구에 의지한 채, 끝없는 수평선을 가로질러 자원을 모으고, 마지막 남은 동물들을 구조하세요.
매 순간 내리는 결정이 여러분의 플레이의 방향을 좌우하게 됩니다. 과연 어디에 도달할 수 있을까요?
주요 특징
생존 & 자원 관리
음식, 연료, 물자를 신중하게 분배해 열기구를 유지하세요. 몰락 직전의 세계에서 만나게 될 위험을 헤쳐나가야 합니다.
다중 경로 & 엔딩
좋은 일, 나쁜 일, 그리고 신비로운 사건들이 얽힌 분기 스토리를 경험하세요. 각 선택은 새로운 가능성과 숨겨진 진실을 열어줍니다.
라디오 신호 & 발견
수수께끼 같은 라디오 방송을 따라 미지의 지역으로 떠나세요. 전파 뒤에 숨은 존재가 누구(또는 무엇)인지 파헤치며, 다음 행보를 스스로 결정하세요.
구조 & 재건
구조가 필요한 동물 동료들을 찾아 구해주세요. 마지막 남은 동물들을 보호하고 하늘 위의 안식처를 확장해 나가세요.
석유 플랫폼에서의 시작
버려진 석유 플랫폼에서 매번 새롭게 게임을 시작하세요. 초기 자원을 활용해, 매 플레이마다 고유한 게임플레이를 경험 할 수 있습니다.
구름 위에 숨겨진 것
이 폐허 같은 하늘에 숨겨진 비밀을 밝혀낼 것인가, 아니면 영원히 잊힌 유산 속에서 길을 잃고 말 것인가? 자연의 품으로 돌아간 세계를 누비며, 감동이 깃든 여정에 나설 준비를 하십시오. SKYLARK 속 라디오 신호가 인도하는 곳은 과연 어디일까요?

title: Waste Sorting
description:
게임 정보
Waste Sorting is a single-player puzzle game.
It is inspired by the classic pipe games from the 80s and 90s.
Click the pipes to turn or switch them and create a way from start to finish.
Find a way to the correct trash can for every trash tile.
Sort 25 different types of waste into the 5 corresponding trash cans by creating a way from start to finish.
Rotate straight pipes and curved pipes, avoid blocks, use crossroads and double curves (both cannot be rotated). Include teleporters and switch pipes into your way. Plan ahead with auto-pipes that turn every tile the trash moves. And finally: Move double trash through a separator first and finish two ways at the same time.
Waste Sorting offers over 50 unique puzzle levels separated into 4 different worlds:
The trash world: the easiest levels that guide you through the gameplay. Includes the introduction to the trash cans and trash parts.
The pipe world: Step by step you learn more and more pipe mechanics.
The puzzle world: No more introductions. Just go for the pure challeges.
The paused world: A special challenge where you can click pipes, but rotations will be paused until you hit the go button. Can you keep all your clicks in mind and plan your way ahead?
Waste Sorting is also an educational game that teaches:
critical thinking
problem solving
cognitive rotation
waste sorting
creativity
...

title: Car Grind
description:
게임 정보
Car Grind is a kinetic game where you use combos of flips, grinds, and wheelies to power your car while you explore each arena. Your car is powered by combos, doing more tricks allows you to extend your reach from each recharge station.
Grind
Jump on rails and grind your car. Keep the balance right or slide off the edge and crash.
Jump & Flip
Turn your car in acrobatic flips! Don't forget to keep the car upright when you land!

title: Let's Freeze Some Penguins
description:
게임 정보
Now you're thinking with penguins!
Northern Bear is crawling with penguins! The Emperor Penguin is moving his minions north of the arctic circle, and it’s up to Walnut the Walrus and Noklas the Narwhal to freeze them in their tracks! Use Walnut’s Walrus Wind to freeze penguins into ice-blocks. Use the ice-blocks to build new paths, stairs, and bridges! This simple concept is the foundation of a whole adventure of puzzling predicaments.
Over 50 puzzle levels
3 worlds and a bonus world
Spike-balls, treadmills, elevators, and many more puzzle elements
Collect 3 Fish Medallions per level to unlock new areas
Collect message-bottles with letters from Walnut’s missing parents
Defeat the dreaded Emperor Penguin and stop his invasion!
Music by Karl Rosqvist

title: Zombie Metal Band
description:
게임 정보
Zombie Metal Band is a dynamic Action RPG where you step into the shoes of a manager of a bizarre metal band composed of zombies! Your task isn’t just to fight off hordes of the undead but also to possess four of them and turn them into loyal members of your band.
Once successfully possessed, the band immediately starts working on a new track, but its quality depends on several key parameters: IQ level, hunger level, and their thirst for another round of booze. You can influence each of these stats using magic spells and independently develop each character.
As a manager, you must care for your undead needs and well-being, as their condition directly affects the quality of their tracks, and ultimately, your chance of topping the music charts.

title: Shadow Eagle
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Eagle is a secret organization for peace. It is said that it dates back to the Seljuk Empire and perhaps even before that. Recently, they have been fighting for justice all around the globe.
In a recent robbery that took place in one of London's museums, only the portrait of Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror was stolen. Deniz sets out to Dublin to meet with the person who was examining and researching the painting before the robbery. While waiting in a pub for the meeting he learns that there will be an attack on the Limon Company data center.
Deniz and his connection Orla make a plan to stop this attack.
However this is just the beginning. What is the purpose of this attack? Why are they going to Türkiye, all of a sudden? Shadow Eagle faces an international criminal organization.

title: Baspetball
description:
게임 정보
😸 A portion of the profit from this game will be allocated to street cat rescue and support initiatives. 😻
The Ultimate Showdown:
Baspetball is a basketball-themed puzzle game with strategic elements, where the player controls a team of cats, each with their own unique abilities and movement styles. The goal is to plan their actions carefully to score baskets without letting the opposing team of dogs steal the ball.
Features:
🐾 50 handcrafted levels.
🎵 Original soundtrack.
🖼️ 5 different scenarios.
🐈 Cute cats.
🐕 Cute dogs.
🏀 Characters with basketball legend numbers.
🧩 Game experience designed for both think and relax.

title: Melon Farmer
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the juicy world of Melon Farmer!
In this captivating 3D adventure, you collect randomly scattered melons, build your own farm, and trade your harvest for valuable coins.
Use these for upgrades such as:
better fields (planned)
loyal pets (planned)
additional islands (planned)
NPCs that collect melons for you (planned)
Experience the sweet success as you expand your farm and rise to become the ultimate melon farmer!

title: Azrael
description:
게임 정보
The Path of the Ancient God
Is it easy to be a god? Dark prophet Azrael is a representative of the ancient race. It was you who created elves, orcs, humans and all living things in this galaxy. A gloomy careerist, hiding under a hood his contempt for both the ancients and mortals, skillfully pretends to be a loyal servant of the hierarchs. But behind the backs of enemies and rulers, he has been hatching his plans for centuries. Your actions shape Azrael's character. Helping friends, saving mortals, noble deeds will change the hero's phrases, open and close opportunities. As well as betrayal, indifference and pride.
Empire above all!
The First Hierarch Ozymandias has already prepared orders for you. You will have to:
Build planets to extract resources
Fight the enemies of the Empire
Trade with other ancients
Assemble a squad of great mortal heroes
Hold auctions and exorcise demons

title: Duck's Hunt
description:
게임 정보
Duck's Hunt is a fast paced hardcore FPS game where you play as a bloodthirsty duck.

No health bars. No reloads. It’s just you and the gun you snatched from the enemy. One hit and you’re out. There are no convenient save points. When you die, you are back to the start of the level. Learn from your mistakes to achieve a flawless victory!
Alright, it's go-time! Grab the keys, jump in and take off for a quick spin around the neighborhood! Just a heads-up though the roads might be a little... unpredictable, shall we say so hold on tight and get ready for a bumpy, but fun ride.

title: EggChickenFarm
description:
게임 정보
EggChickenFarm is a casual idle simulation game centered around nurturing baby chickens and collecting different chicken species in your chicken catalog.
Hatching and Growing
Start your journey with an ordinary egg! Care for each little chick, watching them grow from nothing into beautiful chickens. Provide them with delicious food and a comfortable environment to help them thrive.
Breeding and Management
Using the breeding house, you can select the best pairs of chickens to produce new eggs and chicks. Each breeding session has the potential to create unique new species, so come and complete your chicken catalog! Gradually expand your farming scale, manage resources wisely, sell fresh eggs to earn coins, upgrade facilities, and purchase more content and decorations.
Dressing Up Chickens and the Farm
Give your chickens adorable hats and change their styles to showcase their unique personalities! You can also adjust the farm scenery to alter the appearance of your space at any time. Create a warm and unique farm that stands out!

title: Machine Tower 2984
description:
게임 정보
This is a huge machine city, where countless small robots work hard to maintain the operation of the machine tower. After operating for countless years , the machine tower has become older and more dangerous day by day. Our main character, an unknown screwing robot (which can be understood as a screw worker) from the bottom of the machine tower, is about to embark on an adventure in the tower.
Challenge rich mechanical guards
Various mechanical guards have unique deformation and attack methods.
Rich prop combinations and cultivation
There are multiple weapons and different skills available

title: Ascend the Dome
description:
게임 정보
Is this the hardest and most massive climb-up game ever made?
You find yourself trapped in a massive dome containing various biomes, each filled with unique obstacles and challenges. Your mission is to escape by climbing through the layers of the dome, facing numerous challenges, minigames, and puzzles that will test your precision and skill.
Designed for speedrunners, this is definitely not a cozy game!
Climb, drive, dodge, roll, run, explore, swim, fly, grind... all to reach the top, combining climbing with unique minigames in every biome:
Kart parkour levels.
Backrooms and mazes.
Golf Rollin.
SkyBlock.

title: Pixelegend
description:
게임 정보
This is a fantasy world where you will become an adventurer, exploring vast maps, communicating with various NPCs, accepting missions, unlocking storylines, and gradually uncovering the secrets of this world. In this process, you will continuously accumulate wealth, acquire various weapons and props, and become increasingly powerful. This world may seem calm, but in reality, it is full of dangers and hidden currents. You need to challenge stronger enemies time and time again to resolve each crisis.

title: Gimlé Trials
description:
게임 정보
Gimlé Trials is a high-energy multiplayer arena game where precision spellcasting meets dynamic strategy. Engage in rapid, skill-based battles where abilities can knock opponents into danger—or save you from the brink of defeat. The rules are simple: stay in the safe zone, outplay your rivals, and become the last one standing.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced, Skill-Based Combat: Easy to learn but hard to master, Gimlé Trials rewards sharp reflexes and tactical outplays. Timing, aim, and positioning are your keys to survival.
Dynamic Knockback Mechanics: Manipulate the battlefield with unique knockback spells that send foes into deadly hazards like lava, creating exciting, high-stakes moments.
Customizable Loadouts: Between rounds, adapt your strategy by drafting new abilities. Craft your arsenal and find creative ways to dominate your opponents.
Evolving Arenas: The encroaching lava mechanic turns each match into a thrilling showdown, forcing players into intense close-quarters combat.
Strategic Round Progression: Earn currency, draft new abilities, and build your strategy between rounds for an ever-changing battle experience.
Whether you're a competitive player seeking mastery or a casual gamer looking for quick fun, Gimlé Trials delivers chaos, creativity, and excitement in every match. Step into the arena and prove your skill!

title: Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey is an arcade motorbike racing game that lets you take part in an individual fight for the championship in the top league of a speedway competition. Compete over 10 career seasons and prove that you are the true champion.
In Speedway Odyssey players will see their avatar from a top-down view in a 2D setting on a set of varied round and oval tracks. Your competition for each new game start will be a group of randomly generated AI players of varied difficulty levels.
The game allows for up to 4 players to play locally on a single computer. All game modes (single race, single tournament and career) can be played in such a way (for local multiplayer either a keyboard that has capability of supporting multiple buttons pressed at the same time or extra controllers are required).
Earn your title and don't let other pretenders take it away from you. Show that you are the true legend of speedway!

title: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
description:
게임 정보
Discover the culture of the Huni Kuin indigenous people, the true people!
A classic 2D platform game
Explore each story in a 2D platform game full of obstacles and animals typical of the Amazon Rainforest.
Different weapons and mechanics
Respect the Yuxibu (Forest Great Spirit), play with bow and arrow, club or spear and discover the strength of Nixi Pae (ayahuasca) and Dume Deshke (rapé)!
Various bosses
Face powerful enemies such as the harpy eagle, the big owl, the scorpion king, the bridge alligator and many other fantastic animals and enchanted beings.
Immerse yourself in the mysteries of the Enchanted Boa, the power of the vine (huni) and the leaf (kawa) and the secrets of the people of the forest!
Follow the stories through original drawings by the Beya Xinã Bena group and listen to the narration in the Huni Kuin language itself, the Hátxa Kuï!


This game was made in partnership with the Beya Xinã Bena collective, from the Kaxinawá Indigenous Lands of Rio Jordão, in the state of Acre, in the Brazilian Amazon region, to provide an immersion in indigenous knowledge such as songs, drawings, stories, myths and rituals of the people.

The collective Beya Xinã Bena (New Time Culture) was formed at the initiative of indigenous participants during the game's first workshop, in 2014, with the aim of gathering, promoting and disseminating audiovisual productions linked to the digital technologies of the Huni Kuĩ of Rio Jordão. It is a collective of indigenous audiovisual productions.

title: Beach Outlet Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Beach Outlet Simulator는 1인칭 시점의 시뮬레이션 게임으로, 소규모 가게를 대형 소매업체로 성장시키는 것이 목표입니다.
매장 관리
스타일리시하고 실용적인 방식으로 매장을 설계하세요. 공간을 최대한 활용하여 제품을 효과적으로 진열하고, 고객에게 즐거운 쇼핑 경험을 제공하세요.
청소
고객은 매장의 청결을 중요하게 생각합니다. 창문을 깨끗이 하고 바닥에 쓰레기가 없도록 유지하세요!

title: Kinny and the Cosmic Cauldron
description:
게임 정보
A Cosmic Culinary Adventure Begins!
The fate of the universe—and its flavors—rests in your hands!
You are the one and only witch chef of Stewpendous Spoons, a intergalactic restaurant like no other. Standing before the legendary Cosmic Cauldron, your mission is to serve the most delectable stews to a host of bizarre extraterrestrial patrons. But beware—failure is not an option. If your dishes don’t satisfy... you might just become the next ingredient!
Features
🔥 Deck-Building Roguelike Cooking SystemEach dish is a high-stakes gamble! With 20 different ingredients dropping into the cauldron every run, watch them collide and combine in unexpected ways to rack up points. Every cooking session introduces new ingredients, pushing you to build a strategic deck and create powerful synergies.
🌌 Cosmic Cooking ChallengesBrace yourself for an intergalactic kitchen frenzy! The ingredients won’t just sit still—they’ll tumble, crash, and react in chaotic ways. Hit the target score quickly to earn bonus rewards like Cauldron Expansions and powerful Cosmic Relics that enhance your cooking prowess.
🧙‍♀️ A Whimsical Witch’s TaleYour restaurant attracts customers from the farthest corners of the universe—eldritch beings with impossible demands and unrelenting appetites. If you fail to meet their expectations... well, let’s just say the consequences are cosmic-scale catastrophes.
✨ Charming 2D Cosmic Pixel ArtImmerse yourself in a hand-drawn pixel-art world that’s both cute and mysterious! From animated ingredients to enchanting space backgrounds, every detail brings your cosmic kitchen to life.
Gameplay Highlights
🍲 Ingredient Drop & InteractionIngredients fall randomly into the cauldron, bouncing, merging, and triggering unpredictable reactions. Adapt on the fly, strategize your deck, and make every dish a masterpiece.
🃏 Strategic Deck-BuildingCollect ingredients and craft your unique deck. With a vast array of ingredient types and properties, experimenting with different combinations is key to achieving high scores and mastering the art of cosmic cuisine.
🏆 Rewards & UpgradesMeet your goals to unlock cauldron upgrades and rare relics that amplify ingredient interactions. Discover faster, more efficient ways to cook and dominate the interstellar culinary scene!

title: Relicbound
description:
게임 정보
Relicbound is a thrilling third-person shooter and story-driven action-adventure game. Step into the shoes of Jackson, a skilled archaeologist kidnapped by a sinister organization bent on discovering an ancient relic capable of controlling time itself. Driven by high stakes, Jackson must navigate a dangerous journey through dense jungles, intricate cave systems, and awe-inspiring ancient temple ruins, as well as enemy-infested outposts.
With a dynamic weather system and powered by Unreal Engine 5's cutting-edge Lumen lighting, Relicbound offers stunningly lifelike environments that captivate and immerse you in its world. Every moment is crafted with meticulous detail to bring the story to life. Discover the secrets of the past and face off against relentless foes in an epic adventure where every choice could change the course of time.
Prepare to be captivated by the mystery, action, and breathtaking visuals of Relicbound.
KEY FEATURES
Thrilling Story-Driven Adventure
Embark on an epic journey as Jackson, a skilled archaeologist, racing against a sinister organization named Eclipse to uncover an ancient relic with the power to control time.
Gameplay Mechanics
Enjoy engaging gameplay mechanics, including seamless ledge climbing, exhilarating rope swings, and fluid parkour, allowing for dynamic and strategic traversal across diverse and challenging environments.
High-Octane Third-Person Shooter Gameplay
Engage in intense combat with dynamic enemy AI, utilizing a variety of weapons and tactics as you infiltrate enemy outposts and survive relentless foes.
Dynamic Weather System
Experience ever-changing environments with realistic weather effects that enhance immersion.
Time-Bending Mechanics
Harness the power of the ancient relic to manipulate time, solving intricate puzzles and gaining a tactical edge in combat in late game.

title: Circuit Defender
description:
게임 정보
Build
20 unique towers to build defenses
Large maps allow multiple routes for different styles
Play alone or with friends

title: HyperCoven
description:
게임 정보
You, malevolent King, have learnt the ways of Sorcery
Gather wilful servants by enslaving varied tribes –
Collect trinkets to enhance your fighters in unique ways –
RTS-Roguelite Blend
HyperCoven plays like an RTS, but production of units is automatic.
Capture different Coven which supply troopers for you to send into battle.
Each trooper has up to 7 different attributes that can be enhanced with trinkets found in the world and buildings erected in base.
The Campaign spans 10 hand-crafted missions.
Conquest Mode is about venturing out to conquer the whole (randomized) world, as you would venture into a dungeon.
Invasion Mode is a take on the "wave defense" idea, the world is more sparse, but extra-dimensional invaders are warping in and drop valuable items.

title: My Joyful Aquarium
description:
게임 정보

title: Sophonce
description:
게임 정보
Sophonce is a science fiction action horror first-person shooter that relies on philosophical undertones as the primary focus of the plot.
Features




Wide array of telekinetic abilities and elemental weaponry at your disposal
Reflex Mode (Slo-Mo)
An impressive arsenal of weapons with each having unique attributes to them. Many different ammo types specific to each weapon such as stasis ammo, pyro ammo, gravity ammo, shock ammo, frost ammo and rift ammo.
A riveting story that keeps track of your choices/actions that will ultimately determine the ending of the game.
And....more to be disclosed in the future!



In the beginning of the year 2222, a revolutionary technological device proved the existence of a soul which solidified proof of a higher power. The year is now 2973. The vast majority of humanity has been tank bred over past centuries by artificial means due to a highly contagious otherworldly virus which permanently altered reproductive genomes and therefore effectively sterilizing most of humanity. A dire consequence to this artificial breeding is that those who are tank-bred are soulless. You are Matthew, one of the soulless, an experimental tank bred super soldier part of the royal regime task force division. You are sent on your lonesome to investigate a distress signal from a research facility located in Poseidon, a water rich planet found in "The Black-Eye Galaxy". Luna, who is the Royal Protector of Mars, and her team were sent days prior to investigate but communication with them has been lost. This is where your adventure begins.

title: Stock the Shelves
description:
게임 정보

You're starting your journey as an entrepreneur! You're opening your own shop! Oh how terrifying the future seems. Thankfully you're not alone, your Uncle Dirk is here to support you. But something doesn't seem quite right with him, he's got dollar bills in his eyes and a bit too big of a grin on his face. Though you're probably overthinking it, he's just here to help, right?

Story
You'll be starting at the bottom with a rundown shop which you'll slowly turn into a thriving establishment. Buy new items, hire a helping hand, or 2, OR 3! Tend to customers, stock shelves. All with a juicy story of betrayal layered on top.



Store Management
Alright it's time to get into the nitty gritty of it all. In Stock the Shelves you have one goal, KEEP CUSTOMERS HAPPY! That means no shelf can be left empty. You'll be spending your days running all around the store grabbing items and putting them on shelves. Each customer has a unique shopping list which MUST be fulfilled or they won't leave happily.



When a customer can't find an item on their shopping list they can get real angry real fast. All hope is not yet lost though. You have one final chance to save this sale. If you manage to give them the remaining items on their shopping list in time before the timer runs out you'll turn an angry customer back into a happy one!



Stocking shelves is a tough task, restocking a shelf requires first completing a Restock Challenge. Each item you sell in your shop has a unique Restock Challenge. These can vary from a simple timed button press, to pressing a series of randomized inputs, or even requiring you pay attention to other elements such as the current time of day to complete the challenge correctly.

title: StarMoon Forest
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to StarMoon Forest, which has been abandoned for a long time. After you come here to take over, you can join hands with the local residents to restore the former prosperity, take advantage of the fertile land here, which is located at the intersection of various towns, start planting crops, making delicious food, opening stores for sale, rebuilding apartment communities, building road traffic, restoring convenient exchanges between nearby towns, and allowing residents from all over the world to buy goods and rent apartments here.
About the game:
Build your dream farm, make use of vast land, cultivate all kinds of crops, arrange crop machines reasonably, make all kinds of delicious food and sell it, so that residents of towns and cities can come here to buy necessary food.
Rebuild apartment buildings, build bridges and transportation, so that more urban residents can travel conveniently and rent apartments to live in.
Meet residents from all over the world, communicate with them, explore their stories, and establish friendship and even love.

Get ready to drift, boost, and BROOM BROOM your way to victory in this fast-paced, cartoonish kart racer! Pick your favorite animal racer and battle it out across four thrilling tracks – from Wild West deserts to frozen winter wonderlands, magical fairytale roads, and tropical island escapes.

Face Bosses. Every level culminates in a unique boss battle that will test your reflexes, strategy, and firepower. No two encounters are the same—learn their attack patterns, find their weaknesses, and bring them down before they crush you.

Gifted with the ability to encapsulate the essence of landscapes in her paintings, she explores the island seeking artistic inspiration. Confronted with relics of a lost civilization and enigmatic portals, Poísis grapples with a pivotal philosophical query posed by the ancients: what is the true essence of reality?
Explore Ancient Greek Ruins
Engage in Artistic Creation

Colonies

A fully simulated solar system

"Break, Enter, Repeat" thrusts you into the exciting world of burglaries, set against the frosty backdrop of the Cold War era. You are the architect of your own destiny, plotting burglaries from cosy homes to fortified government agencies, and from jewellery stores to museums, all while navigating the murky waters of espionage and intrigue.

title: God Of This World
