You'll have to explore a logical world while collecting health, jewels, keys, bullets, shield bombs, unlock doors, destroy enemy portals, all while shooting down non-stop seeker robot enemies with regular and tactical guns, enemies who are all set to fire back. Make your way to the boss of each level, and find secrets, as each level gets progressively harder.

title: Sigils of Slaughter
description:
게임 정보
Hack and slash and magic your way through an otherworldly uprising certain to raze the world to nihility. Navigate chaotic urban environments, bringing to bear supernatural weapons and dark magic. In addition to top-down shooter mechanics, our novel gesture and sketch-based user interface offers a unique gameplay experience that traditional interfaces do not by enabling the player to express their will through drawings.
Blades of Mayhem
Use butcher knives tethered to magical ropes by drawing slashes:

Magical Traps
Sketch sigils that anchor to nearby enemies and drain their life:

Conjurings and More
Conjure and command allies to help you fight, as well as unique weapons and artifacts to gain an advantage. Use a variety of magical means to survive the onslaught, but if all else fails - use your ever ready shotgun.
Experience engaging gameplay through complementary enemy design. Brawl against bare knuckle fighting brutes, fireball flinging fiends, and trigger-happy troglodytes. Confront mages that shoot lightning, wizards that cast spells, and wretches who steal your magic. Some enemies are fast, others slow. Some have shields and others don't need them. All are savage.

title: Peerless Destiny 绝世天命
description:
게임 정보
The game includes over 50 different types of growth skills that players can obtain, with over two hundred thousand words of game plot and character dialogues. In addition to over 50 sets of different types of equipment that players can obtain, scattered throughout the universe are several sets of ancient artifacts recording ancient secrets waiting for players to acquire and unlock. One hundred different effects of Fate Seals allow players to gain the blessings of destiny in intense battles...

The story takes place in a remote star domain we call Havendia, where the powers of elements such as gold, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, and thunder are the source of all energy. There are a total of eight major races here, and the peace that has been maintained for nearly a thousand years seems to have come to an end...
Exciting and Unique 3D Combat Visual Experience

We place great importance on depicting the combat process, drawing inspiration from various literary and artistic works to make "Peerless Destiny" stand out!
Featuring an innovative 3D spatial combat system, battles can extend from the ground to the sky, with unique camera effects presenting grand scenes of a fantastical world. Engage in battles as seen in novels and animations, where you can perform extraordinary feats like soaring through the air and unleashing incredible powers!
Fundamental Combat System

Blocking, dodging, parrying—inspired by the core elements of Souls-like games, we have made modifications to these mechanics. We offer various difficulty modes to cater to a broader range of players. Even against formidable bosses, players can engage in intense back-and-forth battles!
Satisfying Combo System

By interacting precisely with the keys, players can trigger combos and lengthen their duration. A well-executed combo can potentially turn the tide of a battle in an instant!
Environment Interaction Enhances Realism in Combat

Your skills not only serve as weapons to damage enemies but also have environmental impacts, capable of causing destruction in various settings—whether small villages or large cities, you have the power to wreak havoc. If you enjoy, hmm, demolition work, this could be a great choice!

Both NPCs and monsters intelligently respond to attacks by dodging, fleeing, blocking, counterattacking, and more. They offer real-time voice responses expressing disdain, fear, and other emotions towards you. In this world, each creature reacts differently based on its unique personality! Voice conversations between you and characters make the game livelier, ensuring you don't feel like a lonely warrior. Additionally, precise collision detection between creatures and the environment allows interactions such as kicking rocks on the ground or sending enemies flying through impact!

In addition to the normal "Story Mode", there are two modes to choose from: "Revisiting Old Dreams" and "Trial of Heaven"
"Revisiting Old Dreams" mode, you are randomly teleported to a previously defeated boss and immediately engage in battle. Hone your combat skills and earn additional rewards.
"Trial of Heaven" mode, also known as the "Heavenly Trial Grounds", you will face several replicated boss entities! This place is unstable. Anomalies can occur at any time! For example, encountering temporal disturbances that cause fluctuations in the flow of time, or facing imbalances in gravity, and even adverse environments that disrupt the minds of creatures.
Sustaining the "Heavenly Trial Grounds" requires a significant amount of energy, with the activity area continuously shrinking to reduce consumption. So, please eliminate your targets quickly; otherwise, you will have to face a siege by all bosses without any escape routes.
Of course, if you perform well in the trial, you can obtain not just more experience, equipment, and treasures but also Destiny Marks with random effects.

Customize your own exclusive skills and character growth path. Both skills and characters are capable of growth. The choice between specialization or a comprehensive development path is entirely up to you. The unique Thunder Tribulation system requires characters to undergo a Thunder Tribulation test with each growth, giving you a greater sense of ceremony, mission, and achievement!

We offer various ways to earn Lucky Points, which can be used to draw Destiny Marks. These marks provide different types of destiny-enhancing effects, such as invincibility aura or time dilation. This system combines elements of metaphysical concepts like the I Ching and Bagua!

Wielding the sacred artifact of heaven and earth, you guide the cycle of destiny! By unlocking celestial artifacts, you empower yourself with mysterious and endless strength, commanding unknown miracles within the cosmos!

The Celestial Stele leaderboard comprises four types of rankings. You can compete with players globally, showcase your achievements among friends, or contribute to regional competitions! The Celestial Stele was originally a heaven-defying divine object, stealing a glimpse of celestial secrets to create these leaderboards!

Embark on an incredible gaming journey with "Peerless Destiny"! Immerse yourself in a whole new gaming experience, merging captivating storytelling with interactive gameplay.

Discover a narrative fusion of novels, anime, and immersive gameplay. Experience the rebirth of a near-fallen protagonist, whose newfound strength uncovers deeper secrets of this world.

Engage in breathtaking 3D combat offering free-flight, earth-shattering battles. Destroy environments, from forests to entire villages, showcasing the true power of your character. Brace yourself for intense battles that surpass conventional limits.

Traverse a fantastical landscape filled with richly detailed environments. Witness the aftermath of destructive battles, leaving shattered vistas and scattered remnants. Indulge in the realism and engage in strategic gameplay.

Ascend to new heights through electrifying trials after accumulating sufficient experience points. Avoid fluxing time, gravitational imbalance, and cognitive disruptions. Triumph over challenges and unlock "Destiny" bonus effects.

Radiant with the light of wisdom, system sprites descend upon the dazzling starry skies of "Peerless Destiny". They are eager to establish a closer bond with you and explore the realms of fantasy together.
The game offers four difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Devil.
Easy and Normal modes provide a satisfying grass-cutting experience where skills automatically target enemies, making gameplay relatively simple.
Hard and Devil modes are somewhat similar to souls-like games, requiring manual targeting of skills and utilizing actions like blocking, dodging, and parrying to avoid damage. Otherwise, death comes easily. The gameplay is slightly more complex.
Believe me, the Devil difficulty level will be the most challenging experience you'd rather not speak about! ^^~

title: Dangerous Galaxy
Two Sides
description:
게임 정보
Two Sides is a unique sandbox where you explore the duality of choices. Play as a savior or a sinner, navigating through complex scenarios that challenge your morality. You create your own story. This isn't a game about good vs evil, your choices have consequences and there's no clear path to achieving your objective without any side effects.

Features:

- Simulated sandbox environment with NPCs that respond to your actions.
- Consequences where any character can become a witness to your action.
- Realistic physics & gunplay.
- Infinite replayability through randomized levels.

Every action you take affects how the level can play out. Are you going to shoot an innocent just because they saw you break the law so you don't get caught? Or are you going to shooting someone accidentally just to get to an objective faster?

Two Sides is a top down tactical shooter where you navigate a detailed sandbox full of interactions.

Are you prepared to make tough choices? Will you risk people's lives to conceal your mistakes, or will you take the difficult path to preserve your morality? In Two Sides you can choose how you want to approach things.

title: Never Trust a Fox
description:
게임 정보
One rainy day you come home from the store and find a wounded fox on the road. In spite of your strict parents who forbid you to have pets, you decide to take her in.

Can you take good care of her if you don't even know what foxes eat?
CONTENT WARNING
This visual novel deals with mature themes and may not be appropriate for those who are easily disturbed.

Never Trust a Fox — is a mystical thriller visual novel.
Features
A mystic thriller/horror story
You can pet a cute foxgirl!
Choices-driven branching narrative
Secret discovery journal

title: Cat Girl Survivor
description:
게임 정보
"Cat Girl Survivor : Bullet Action“은 뱀서라이크 게임의 단순한 플레이 방식과 다양한 캐릭터, 장비 아이템, 스킬, 플레이모드가 조합된 슈팅 액션 게임입니다. 자신만의 캐릭터를 선택하고 다양한 장비와 스킬을 습득해 악마로부터 위협받는 고양이 소녀 세계를 구하세요!
주요 특징
다채로운 스킬과 캐스팅 시스템 효과적으로 악마들을 공격하기 위해 다채로운 스킬과 함께 "Cat Girl Survivor : Bullet Action“에서만 볼 수 있는 캐스팅 스킬 시스템을 활 용해 보세요. 캐스팅 스킬은 사용 전 파워를 모으기 위해 몸을 움직일 수 없는 치명적 약점이 존재하지만 그만큼 광범위하고 강력한 데미 지를 적에게 줄 수 있습니다. 캐스팅 스킬과 일반 스킬을 적절히 전략적으로 사용해 악마들을 효과적으로 공격해 보세요!
스킬을 전설 등급으로 레벨업 해 화려하고 시원한 타격감을 즐길 수 있습니다.
다양한 캐릭터 기본 캐릭터 뿐 아니라 각자 다른 스킬과 능력을 지니고 있는 캐릭터들이 있습니다. 아카네, 시로, 코로 등 당신에게 매력있고 플레이 스타 일에 맞는 캐릭터를 선택해 게임을 즐겨보세요!

title: Barbarization
description:
게임 정보
Defeat enemies in each room to unlock your next reward. Survive longer for better rewards or escape through the next open door if you have to.
Collect ability cards, weapons, and trinkets to build a unique character each run. Experiment with different combinations of abilities, buffs and stat upgrades to find powerful synergies.

title: Lotus: Lost Memories
description:
게임 정보
Lotus: Lost Memories is a pixel art side-scrolling adventure with a unique take on turn-based combat! Experience a fresh blend of strategy and action, with Quick Time Events that add a dynamic edge to each battle.
Step into the richly woven tale of Atsushi, a young samurai bound by duty to his ailing father. Navigate alliances, rivalries, and dark secrets from a hidden past that threaten to alter his path. Undertake a journey of loyalty, honor, and betrayal as he faces skilled adversaries and uncovers the echoes of a legacy that will shape his destiny.
Experience a fresh take on turn-based combat. Engage in calculated battles where timing and strategy are everything. Master QTE (Quick Time Events) to give yourself an edge in combat. Dodge, block, or unleash a ranged attack to turn the tide of battle.

title: Ukrainians: Our battle
description:
게임 정보
Ukrainians: Our battle is a visual novel that will give you a wide range of opportunities to explore life in the country during the war. Feel yourself in the role of a volunteer, on whose shoulders a great responsibility fell in one moment. The game is filled with various graphic scenes and deep text stories that will not leave anyone behind. What dynamics does the country live in during the war: economy and business, education and science, sport, tourism, energy, police and other industries. Learn new facts for yourself and immerse yourself in these stories.
Dive into the exciting atmosphere of the game
In this game, you will travel to different locations, interact with people and situations that are based on real events. The war radically changed the life of every Ukrainian, and in this game you will be able to understand the features of the new reality. You are a volunteer and the army and civilians rely on you, but at the same time you also have a family and the need to look out for the well-being of everyone close to you. The game does not have a narrow direction, but on the contrary comprehensively reveals the life of the hero in the conditions of war. Every time you will be faced with a choice that will affect the further development of events both for you and for those around you.
Travel the country
company: Serhii Khramov, Illia Ustenko, Maksym Kanshin,

title: Lunar Ascendant
description:
게임 정보
Take on the mantle of leadership and venture into a future where mankind has expanded its frontier to the Moon. Lunar Ascendant is a narrative-driven political simulation and role-playing game that thrusts you into the heart of a burgeoning lunar society as the first democratically elected mayor of the lunar colony megacity, Artemis.

In this immersive text-based simulation, your decisions shape the future of humanity's first lunar city. As mayor, you'll navigate a web of political, economic, and social challenges that reflect the complexities of our own world and beyond. Draft policies to address critical issues such as pollution, wealth inequality, technological advancements, and the controversial use of human brains as CPUs. Forge alliances and manage relationships with various factions, including corporate CEOs, underground criminal syndicates, and activist groups. Be prepared to confront challenging moral dilemmas that will test your principles against the hard realities of governance.

Game Features:

Political Simulation: Experience the intricacies of running a lunar colony, balancing urban development, public order, and the needs of a diverse population.

Policy Crafting: Draft and implement policies that shape the future of Artemis, dealing with issues such as wealth inequality, environmental sustainability, and the ethics of AI development.

Interactive Narrative: Engage in rich text-based interactions with various characters, making decisions that shape the colony's future.

Dynamic World: Navigate a complex political landscape with different factions vying for influence, and make choices that lead to multiple possible outcomes.

Moral Complexity: Face difficult decisions that challenge your moral compass and define your legacy.

Dive into a world shaped by your choices, filled with rich lore and dynamic systems that react to your decisions. Can you steer Artemis towards a future of prosperity and independence, or will your leadership plunge the city into chaos? The fate of Artemis lies in your hands.

title: Circle Defense
description:
게임 정보
I know you have rich experience in defending the Earth!
CIRCLE is a tower defense game with a light card system, where you will play as a commander defending the Earth: by building/upgrading weapons on a rotating device called "CIRCLE" and using cards to deal with the continuously invading aliens.


Origin of the CIRCLE
One day, the moon was hit and destroyed by unknown creatures, and the debris turned into a circle around the Earth. Due to concerns about the unknown creatures, humans transformed the lunar circle into the CIRCLE device and deployed cosmic-level defense weapons on it.



Under the pressure of alien attacks, the human military technology tree continues to evolve, and its functions are summarized into command cards, waiting for the commander to issue orders.
The energy for the cards comes from the CIRCLE: the faster the Ring rotates, the higher the energy generation rate, but it seems to affect the aiming rhythm for deploying weapons.



- Level-based game: each successful defense against alien attacks will greatly enhance Earth's weapon defense technology, continuously unlocking new weapon types, upgrade items, and new technology cards.
- The combination of different weapon upgrade projects and different cards will create a multitude of possibilities.
- Each type of monster has its own behavior patterns and characteristics, so make sure to respond based on your understanding of them!
- Besides monsters, you also have to face the harsh cosmic environment, and some levels will force you to abandon common strategies to try more suitable solutions.
- You can press the space bar at any time to slow down time for more time to think about strategies and operations; or maybe you just want to see the fireworks in slow motion?

title: Head Chef
description:
게임 정보
Open your restaurant and lead it to success.
Create your menu by selecting what dishes to serve. Supply the kitchen accordingly if you do not want to run out of ingredients during service! You can do it yourself, or you can hire a supply manager.
Open the doors of your restaurant and start cooking! Cut, blend, grill, bake and fry ingredients: elevate them to make fantastic dishes. Plate the food and bring it to the delivery counter, where waiters will pick it up. Be fast! Guests are not willing to wait forever and may walk out of the restaurant. Line cooks are there to help you, but they also make mistakes. Supervise, coordinate and motivate them! It will take the right combination of carrot and stick to get the best out of your team.
Prepare delicious desserts in the pastry laboratory. Don't make too many - you want to serve only fresh and tasty cakes to your guests. A pastry chef may help you discover new recipes and will keep your restaurant well-stocked.

title: Sauna Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"Sauna Simulator" is a funny business simulator. Buy premises, equip them with a sauna stove and start earning from it!
You inherit a sauna stove and decide to open your own sauna business. You have a large area at your disposal, divided into rooms, which you can buy and put there any stove from the store.
While your business is small, you will do all the work yourself: please customers, clean the room, put firewood in the sauna stove. However, as your sauna expands, you'll be able to hire employees to take care of all the chores you don't want to do.
Customers leave feedback. If your customers don't like your sauna: poor service, dirty facilities, etc., they will definitely leave a bad review. If, on the other hand, you take complete care of your customers, they will leave you a positive rating. Based on these ratings, you will see the average rating of your sauna.
You should not forget about safety. If your stove is cheap, then it will have a high chance of catching fire. In such cases you will need fire extinguishers, which of course you can buy at the store.

title: Seabed Settlers
description:
게임 정보
A citybuilder inspired by classics such as Ceasar III, Anno, Pharaoh and others which takes place the bottom of the ocean. The surface has become uninhabitable and raybomb radiation has turned many into mutants. It is your job to set up your underwater empire and guide new humanity to greatness!



Goal of the game

Your job is to keep everyone in your colony healthy and alive. Tend to all your people's needs; food, power, shelter, survival, safety, culture and entertainment.

If your people are happy your city grows and they have babies. If your people are deprived of food they die. Houses evolve if needs are met, increasing your population capacity.

The threat of raybomb mutants lurks around every corner and add another layer to the game.





Find resource nodes, plan the layout of your colony, raise prosperity and culture ratings and keep your people safe!

Once your city is thriving and objectives are met, your success means your superiors will entrust you with repeating the process in a more challenging area. Along the way you unlock new buildings, resources and technologies to help with this.

At the end players will get to relive those epic childhood games while newer generation players get eased into this type of game so that they too can build fond memories.





During the campaign you will be trading with other settlements and expanding your empire.

There are rival factions that will attempt the same and might reclaim your other cities if you don’t watch out.

The goal is to move through various campaign scenarios that have various objectives.

title: Whispering Age
description:
게임 정보
Command Manager!
In whispering age you command your units by speaking with your managers, who then try... to fulfill your orders!
Assign Tasks!
Tell your managers to gather resources, construct structures, or defend the village. You'll at times need to calm your managers as civil war can break out!

title: AO: Containment Breach
description:
게임 정보
There's been a Containment Breach within the AO facility on Terra. You're being sent in to establish communications with the other teams inside and to Contain what AOs have broken containment.
AO: Containment Breach is a Procedurally Generated, Level Building, Semi-Auto-Battling, Rogue-lite, Horror hybrid. Fight and Contain AOs as you make your way through the Containment Breach of the Terra AO facility. During "Dives" scavenge for Materials to bring back to the hub to Craft unique Weapons, Upgrades, and Gear. Build Craft unique and interesting strategies to combat hostile entities. Answers to the breach lay deep within the facility...

CONTAIN: Assume all AO containments have been breached. Figure out the Containment Procedures by looking for clues and other means to Re-Contain them.

title: WHITE : ANASTASIS
description:
게임 정보
STORY
In a distant future, scientists of WHITE, are racing against time to prevent the destruction of their environment. In their quest for a new source of clean energy, they created a paradigital ecosystem capable of producing vast amounts of energy for the real world. However, mysterious entities are creating disruptions in the energy production. As a worker for WHITE energy solutions you descent into the cybernated environment to reactivate their facilities and eliminate the cause of the interferences.
GAMEPLAY
WHITE: ANASTASIS is a first-person, open-world adventure game. Explore the lush, mysterious lands of the Paraverse. Discover unseen creatures, battle malicious entities intent on your destruction, and repair critical factory installations to restore energy to the Real World!
Explore a digital world like nothing you have seen before!

title: Building Friends
description:
게임 정보
Building Friends is a charming narrative adventure where you play as Mable the Shovel! Join a lively cast of construction equipment characters with pun-tastic names as they embark on a mission to build a house from the ground up! With your shovel powers and team spirit, sharpen your skills and construct a home in this unique blend of fun and friendship.

title: StarMoon Forest
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to StarMoon Forest, which has been abandoned for a long time. After you come here to take over, you can join hands with the local residents to restore the former prosperity, take advantage of the fertile land here, which is located at the intersection of various towns, start planting crops, making delicious food, opening stores for sale, rebuilding apartment communities, building road traffic, restoring convenient exchanges between nearby towns, and allowing residents from all over the world to buy goods and rent apartments here.
About the game:
Build your dream farm, make use of vast land, cultivate all kinds of crops, arrange crop machines reasonably, make all kinds of delicious food and sell it, so that residents of towns and cities can come here to buy necessary food.
Rebuild apartment buildings, build bridges and transportation, so that more urban residents can travel conveniently and rent apartments to live in.
Meet residents from all over the world, communicate with them, explore their stories, and establish friendship and even love.

title: Toxic Toads
description:
게임 정보
What is Toxic Toads?
Toxic Toads is a 2d platformer to play alone or with friends, where you have to jump a lot and consider your every move! 
What's the fun of it?
Each toad is so toxic that it leaves a brightly colored slime behind that is deadly to the touch! 
Story mode
Play alone (if you’re forever alone) or invite your friends, some levels support up to 4 players! 
Complete 50 exciting puzzles in different locations: Lab, forest, cave!
Bring all the toads to the exit! 
Party mode
Multiplayer: up to 4 players! Network and local!
Base: Pass levels together, work together to win! 
Race: Try your best to be the fastest! All players start from the same point, but who finishes first? (Reduced Toxicity Mode)
Workshop: Access levels that are created by the community, plenty of options for you and your friends! 
...and much more! 
Level Editor: Design unique levels and race tracks, upload them to steam workshop, play by yourself and with your friends! 
Full support for all controllers
Amusing for everyone who loves TOADS!

title: Comic Book Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Manage your very own comic book store!
Step into the shoes of a comic book store owner and transform your humble store to a bookworm's haven!
Buy comic licenses, hire staff, and engage in various events such as book signings and collect rare version of comics and sell it at a premium! Use various tools to protect your store from troublemakers and keep your store clean! And explore the surrounding areas inspired by the Japanese backstreets!
Features :
Buy licenses to unlock comics, mangas, and manhwas of various genres!
Unlock and collect over 40+ comics, each with its own parodies & unique art!
Hire staff to help you with your store such as restocking, and security
Explore the surrounding areas with the backdrop of a Japanese backstreet
Decorate your store and make it more appealing to customers!
Upgrade your tools and unlock new rooms for your store!

title: Descent
description:
게임 정보
Survive
Descent is a co-op survival horror game centered around an ever-changing environment of levels and enemies, where a party of up to 4 (four) players need to complete objectives and make use of stealth to escape and further progress their story.

title: Baspetball
description:
게임 정보
😸 A portion of the profit from this game will be allocated to street cat rescue and support initiatives. 😻
The Ultimate Showdown:
Baspetball is a basketball-themed puzzle game with strategic elements, where the player controls a team of cats, each with their own unique abilities and movement styles. The goal is to plan their actions carefully to score baskets without letting the opposing team of dogs steal the ball.
Features:
🐾 50 handcrafted levels.
🎵 Original soundtrack.
🖼️ 5 different scenarios.
🐈 Cute cats.
🐕 Cute dogs.
🏀 Characters with basketball legend numbers.
🧩 Game experience designed for both think and relax.

title: Gimlé Trials
description:
게임 정보
Gimlé Trials is a high-energy multiplayer arena game where precision spellcasting meets dynamic strategy. Engage in rapid, skill-based battles where abilities can knock opponents into danger—or save you from the brink of defeat. The rules are simple: stay in the safe zone, outplay your rivals, and become the last one standing.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced, Skill-Based Combat: Easy to learn but hard to master, Gimlé Trials rewards sharp reflexes and tactical outplays. Timing, aim, and positioning are your keys to survival.
Dynamic Knockback Mechanics: Manipulate the battlefield with unique knockback spells that send foes into deadly hazards like lava, creating exciting, high-stakes moments.
Customizable Loadouts: Between rounds, adapt your strategy by drafting new abilities. Craft your arsenal and find creative ways to dominate your opponents.
Evolving Arenas: The encroaching lava mechanic turns each match into a thrilling showdown, forcing players into intense close-quarters combat.
Strategic Round Progression: Earn currency, draft new abilities, and build your strategy between rounds for an ever-changing battle experience.
Whether you're a competitive player seeking mastery or a casual gamer looking for quick fun, Gimlé Trials delivers chaos, creativity, and excitement in every match. Step into the arena and prove your skill!

title: Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Forged Into History: Speedway Odyssey is an arcade motorbike racing game that lets you take part in an individual fight for the championship in the top league of a speedway competition. Compete over 10 career seasons and prove that you are the true champion.
In Speedway Odyssey players will see their avatar from a top-down view in a 2D setting on a set of varied round and oval tracks. Your competition for each new game start will be a group of randomly generated AI players of varied difficulty levels.
The game allows for up to 4 players to play locally on a single computer. All game modes (single race, single tournament and career) can be played in such a way (for local multiplayer either a keyboard that has capability of supporting multiple buttons pressed at the same time or extra controllers are required).
Earn your title and don't let other pretenders take it away from you. Show that you are the true legend of speedway!

title: Kaisa: Resurrection
description:
게임 정보
KAISA commands you! Wishlist now!
After the sun sets and the clock strikes midnight, your task begins: you must feed your master before the first light of dawn. How hard can it possibly be to survive the night?

What happens during the day?... Well, that's another story.
Gameplay:
Feed your master during the night.
Scheme & Prepare during the day.
Find or order mighty weapons like REGULAR chopsticks or UNIMPRESSIVE kitchen knifes to improve your combat abilities.
Who knew lies could be a currency.
Stuff your master to turn back time.
Beware the noise you make, for that which listens will come..
Not everything is as it seems.
About the Demo
Hello and welcome to Kaisa: Resurrection!
We’re a small, passionate two-man team working hard to bring this game to life. This early demo is just a small taste of what’s to come, though some features are still limited.
We’re aiming for a September release, but to bring our full vision to life, we need your support! If you enjoy the demo, please wishlist the game—and keep an eye out for our upcoming Kickstarter.
Our Vision
Kaisa: Resurrection is a brutal and rewarding experience—a game that’s easy to pick up but demands real skill to master. It’s challenging, bloody, and unforgiving, but every victory is earned.

title: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
description:
게임 정보
Armed with your trusty keyboard and mouse, battle the games you never play! The more you paid for them, the more damage they will do to you (just like in real life).
Fight in an arena surrounded by your well-played spectator games, while the immortal royalty (the games you have never played) lord over you at the end of the arena.
Games you played for up to two hours will attack you in waves - but watch out for flying enemies (high Metacritic score), Platform supported enemies, DLC enemies and Controller Supported enemies; amongst many more!
** IMPORTANT ** To get the most out of this game (Play your game list instead of the Default/Friends game lists), you will need to set your "Game details" to public on your Steam profile (Your Profile->Edit Profile->Privacy Settings->Game Details). You can set it back to private after you load the game for the first time.

title: Wirelight
description:
게임 정보
A tiny turn-based tactical... soulslike! Explore a twisty, interconnected world, battle enemies using a unique spin on a 'posture' system, and employ various upgrades to your advantage.
Turn-Based Soulslike Combat
Alternate turns with enemies in turn-based combat with a unique posture system. You have the option to attack directly, but can also deal damage by knocking enemies out of position, into walls, or even blocking their movement with your own body.
Countless Combinations of Items
Unlock and discover equippable "toolsets" granting special abilities, "modules" to give various passive boosts, and weapons with unique shapes and hidden qualities.  Customize your build as you explore and fight through the challenging terrain.
A Twisty World
Explore six distinct zones through a sprawling, highly (and unpredictably) interconnected world.  Unlock shortcuts, double back to find secrets of challenge difficult enemies, and uncover the hidden depths of this tiny but intricate world.

title: Why Do Boys Play Games?
description:
게임 정보
Why Do Boys Play Games? is a turn-based tactical strategy game that allows you to interact with your opponents when you aren't battling in an attempt to simulate the camaraderie and competition of an actual fantasy football league. You begin by creating a character, completing an optional tutorial, and drafting a custom team of players.
You then take those players into battle. Each player has distinct moves and passive abilities, many of which can synergize with each other.

title: Gold  Retirement
description:
게임 정보
Gold for Retirement - is a hardcore platformer that will challenge you and push your skills to the limit!
Embark on an exciting adventure where every gold coin brings you one step closer to a carefree retirement. Explore dozens of levels filled with tough challenges and dangerous traps.Enjoy stylish pixel art that immerses you in the atmosphere of classic platformers, and lose yourself in the game’s world thanks to its incredible soundtrack.
But the main highlight - is the unique flying mechanic! Your knight is equipped with a special device built into their helmet, allowing them to soar, glide, and overcome even the most difficult obstacles.

title: Diffusion
description:
게임 정보
Use mining drills to gather ores and smelt them to gain building materials.



Defend your mining site from waves of disgusting hostile alien creatures.

title: One More Experiment
description:
게임 정보
One More Experiment is a first person puzzle-platformer based on elemental interactions.  You control The Absorber, capable of absorbing fire and water from the environment.          Use this power to navigate around obstacles, activate switches and alter the environment.
 Four chapters with mind-bending puzzles
Interact with fire, water, vines, pipes, balloons, ice and much more
Use switches to alter the environment around you
Navigate around obstacles such as force fields, spikes and moving platforms 
Explore an abandoned lab complex 
Four unique ambient soundtracks
Xbox Controller support
Single-Player mode

title: Survivesmith
description:
게임 정보
Survivesmith is a reverse bullet-hell game with a simple crafting twist. Shoot hails of bullets, missiles, nails, lasers and whatever is at your disposal at your enemies and make tactical choices to overcome all obstacles. You are here to find the 'Life Essence', and you're not leaving without it!
Item Crafting
Every biome has a unique resource (or more) for you to collect. Collect them and craft handy consumable items from your Survival Kit to make surviving a little bit easier. But be warned—you’ll need plenty of resources if you hope to face the final boss!
Biome Hazards
Every biome has some kind of hazard to throw at you. Make sure you are ready for these random weather changes, unless... you find a way to turn the tides in your favor.
Preset Loadouts
In Survivesmith, you don't have to submit to the randomness of the upgrades you get. While there are many random elements to experience in the game, your loadout isn't one of them. Make sure you know what you're doing, and equip well before a round!

title: Kiki's Nightmare
description:
게임 정보
In Kiki's Nightmare, players step into the shoes of a fearless hero tasked with rescuing princess Kiki trapped in her own twisted dreams. As the dream world comes to life around you, you'll traverse unhospitable landscapes, battle nightmarish creatures, and possibly solve intricate puzzles that test both your wits and bravery. Can you free her before the dream consumes her mind forever, or will the evil that haunts her dreams claim victory? Only the bravest can conquer the nightmare!

title: Arca
description:
게임 정보
Run, jump, shoot, dodge, slide, use power-ups, and do whatever it takes to stay ahead!
In a world on the brink of a great flood, only the fastest — and smartest — penguin will secure a spot on the mysterious Ark! This is a fast-paced platformer where you’ll race against time and other competitors on tracks full of challenges and shortcuts. The gameplay is simple to pick up, but mastering your penguin’s movement requires precision and strategy.
But beware: speed isn’t everything! If you can’t win the race, sabotage it! Throw snowballs, drop bombs, and even launch missiles to slow down your rivals and claim your rightful place on the Ark.
The game will feature various worlds and stages, packed with hidden paths and shortcuts for the most curious and agile penguins. But things aren’t always as they seem… Unexpected surprises can turn the race into complete chaos! Are you ready for this frosty showdown?

title: FiVe s'hIft masters
description:
게임 정보
slice, stab, and combo your way through four kingdoms and complete the four trials for each weapon! Then, return back to where it all began to learn the ultimate secret technique and help the prince overthrow the evil king!

title: Puzzle Tales: Arcane Voyager
description:
게임 정보
《Puzzle Tales》 - Where Elimination Meets Roguelike Adventure
Eliminate gems, unleash secret arts, and crush your foes in a grand adventure across the Ether World!
【Smooth Elimination・Strategy Upgrade】
Eliminate gems to charge your secret arts, unleash powerful spells and effects, and turn the tide of battle in an instant.
Expand your strategy from the battlefield to the chessboard, choose from a wide range of skills to pave your path to victory, and combine roguelike elements with multiple heroes for a fresh strategic experience in every battle!
【Build Diverse・Infinite Possibilities】
Take your strategy to the next level with the introduction of new "Arcane Artifacts." Skills, relics, and artifacts - this is the "trinity" of 《Puzzle Tales》!
Even in the face of powerful enemies, the chessboard and pieces are forced to join the "Great Game," making the battle environment ever-changing and the difference between victory and defeat a matter of mere moments!
- From the Solo Developer to Future Adventurers -
This is a game crafted for both "strategy enthusiasts" and "leisure explorers," organically combining the thrill of puzzle games with the strategy of roguelike games to bring you a fantasy adventure.
Join the official community (Discord/Steam Community/QQ group) now, your support and suggestions will shape the future of the game!

title: Friday at Ours
description:
게임 정보
Come Join the Party!
Loud music is blaring from your neighbour's flat. All the while you're dead-tired, a little introverted and most importantly: not invited. So what are you to do?
Once you've finally convinced yourself to stop by, you'll find that partying like a pro is not quite as easy as you would have imagined.
Unique Party-Based Gameplay:
Meet a bunch of kooky characters: If you'll manage get a read on them, you might be able to hit it off and become friends.
Solve puzzles: More and more of the party will become accessible to you, as you help out some of the partygoers.
Plan out your actions: In this turn-based time progression system, deciding when to do what is essential for getting the most out of your night.
Increase your Stats: Some partygoers may require you to refine certain social abilities. Strengthen them, to become a better conversationalist.
Collect phone numbers: Befriended characters will want to keep in touch with you. The'll also provide you with helpful tips if you don't know how to proceed.
Multiple playthroughs: You might be able to gather some hints concerning some of the guests deepest secrets. Being observant is the key to uncovering the games multiple endings.
So get out there and have yourself an unforgettable night!

title: Master of Balance
description:
게임 정보
Master of Balance is a text-driven workplace survival adventure game where you'll take on the role of a junior executive at a gaming company who, after being caught up in a strange magical incident, he must discreetly handle the business of daily life and work while investigating the truth behind what's going on.
Random Events
A large number of daily random events, Carefully balance the values of the five dimensions of boss, subordinates, family, health, and money by choosing different responses, every choice may reverse the situation in an instant.
Multiple Storylines 
Easy and witty main plot with different endings for you to explore.
Mini-game
Simple and addictive mini-game that can be played with just the mouse.
Magical Abilities
A variety of special abilities, free to mix and match, play in your own style.

title: Paw Arena
description:
게임 정보
Paw Arena is a creative and fun turn-based combat game that offers players an unprecedented experience of free-form battle. In the game, players can freely create and customize their own unique characters, endowing them with personalized appearances, abilities, and combat styles. With the latest AI technology, players can use text or voice input to command their characters in real-time, whether it’s a classic duel or a quirky, chaotic battle.
Characters in Paw Arena have unlimited potential for evolution. As the battle progresses, they will continue to grow stronger. Players can freely combine skill cards with creative combat instructions to embark on intense and dramatic adventures.
Paw Arena is not only a test of strategy and creativity but also a stage to unleash your imagination. Here, imagination is the driving force of battle. Bold ideas will help you dominate the battlefield and embark on one-of-a-kind adventures!

title: Clayground
description:
게임 정보
Step into vibrant, hand-crafted parks brimming with physics-based toys and endless possibilities. Whether you're looking to goof around with friends, master parkour, or dive into hilarious mini-games, Clayground is the all-in-one social VR playground built from the ground up for fun in VR.
(The footage below is from early alpha testing and not representative of final gameplay)
Seamless Social VR - Play Together, Effortlessly
Forget loading screens and complicated setups. Clayground is designed for instant social connection.
Next-Gen Matchmaking: Get playing faster with friends and new faces thanks to our next-gen matchmaking system, including age-based options for a comfortable social space.
Instant Groups: Create groups effortlessly and stay connected with your favorite playmates across parks.
Crossplay Freedom: Whether your friends are on PCVR (Steam), Quest, or PSVR 2 (date to be determined!), everyone can join the fun.
Effortless Park Hopping: Travel seamlessly between every park with your group of up to 8, keeping the party going without interruption.
A Physics Playground Like No Other

title: Don't Forget to Smile
description:
게임 정보
A Bullet Heaven Roguelike About Breaking Free
This isn't just a game—it's a raw, unfiltered scream against the soul-crushing grind of minimum wage work and the suffocating corporate machine.
Do you ever feel like it’s all too much? Like the game is rigged from the start? Your "manager" is lording over you for being three minutes late, your job is a cycle of mindless tasks, and life is slipping through your fingers. Welcome to your breaking point.
Don't Forget to Smile is a fast-paced survivors-like bullet heaven where you fight through relentless waves of everyday enemies. Armed with weapons inspired by - and mocking - industry, health and safety and technology, you’ll gear up, level up and reach your breaking point.

title: Gloamryn
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Gloamryn!
A mystical strategy game set in a world of eternal twilight, where survival is as much about cunning as it is about strength.
In this land of fading light, resources are scarce, enemies lurk in the shadows, and magic pulses through the earth itself.
Build camps, gather supplies, and master the art of tactical combat as you lead your people through the unknown.
Will you seek refuge under the glowing leaves of the Healing Tree, strike dangerous bargains with witches, or carve your own path in the twilight?
The choices are yours – welcome to Gloamryn.
Tactical Combat - A Unique Card Game
Tactical combat in Gloamryn takes place through a unique, specifically designed card game. Your units, their equipment, and their abilities shape every battle, while each faction brings its own way of fighting. No two encounters play out the same.
Strategic Map

title: 9 Trials of Whiskers
description:
게임 정보
9 Trials of Whiskers is a charming yet challenging 3D platformer!
Run, jump and dodge hazards as you challenge each of the 9 Trials.
Play in Tourist Mode for a relaxing experience or push your limits in Hard Mode to master every trial and compete with your own ghost runs!

title: Mumble Pines: The Arrival
description:
게임 정보
What you get:
A Nightmare Beneath the Surface – A remote island, a hidden underground research facility, and horrors that should have never been awakened. Experience an intense 3-4 hour horror journey.
Nowhere is Safe – Something is hunting you—multiple entities lurk in the shadows, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
A Dark and Twisted Mystery – You came here searching for your brother, but what you’ll uncover goes far beyond a simple disappearance.
A World of Fear and Discovery – The island hides disturbing secrets. Dare to explore, and you may find things that will haunt you forever.
A Deeply Unsettling Atmosphere – Oppressive darkness, eerie silence, and spine-chilling jumpscares make this an unforgettable horror experience.
Explore the Island – Venture beyond the main path… but be warned, some discoveries are better left undisturbed.
You will never Leave again!

THE ISLAND AWAITS YOU.....

title: God in a Closet
description:
게임 정보
Enter the mysterious house of a witch in this short adventure game to find the answers behind a hunter's quest. A strange presence looms over you, you cannot turn back.
FEATURES
A unique hand-drawn artstyle inspired by Angel's Egg and old fairytales
Simple puzzles and easy gameplay
Explore the house, read documents and speak to the witch to resolve the dangers inside
An immersive and eerie experience to be finished in one sitting (under an hour)
GAMEPLAY
Pick up useful objects in your inventory, use them alone or combined to get through the levels.

title: Gun in a Well
description:
게임 정보
Gun in a Well is an action roguelike where the only way to dodge is to shoot. Jump around using recoil, kill enemies with bullets, destroy them with electricity or burn them to crisp. Manage health and ammo, choose your upgrades, break the game and reach the bottom of the well!
Features:
💣 Dozens of unique upgrades, each with 3 levels and unique abilities, allow you to create your own play style
🔫 Choose your weapon out of a large arsenal each run
⚡ Shoot enemies with bullets or lightning, burn them or get rid of them in other ways to reach the bottom of the well
📈 Buy passive improvements between runs and beat all the ascension levels!
🏆 Approachable (but not easy!) ~10 minute runs

title: UNDER ROOMS
description:
게임 정보
In Under Rooms you take on the role of a 17-year-old teenager, you find yourself trapped in this mysterious and dangerous environment after an accident. Your mission is to survive, explore and discover your way back home. The gameplay focuses on looting, inventory management and crafting mechanics, allowing you to create and find essential resources for survival.
Throughout your journey, you will encounter various factions, each with their own ideologies and goals, creating a complex web of alliances and rivalries. Some factions refuse to cooperate due to their differences, while others offer the opportunity to make connections and find allies in the midst of chaos. However, danger is ever present: hostile entities lurk in the shadows, ready to destroy anyone who crosses their path. Explore uniquely designed locations, each with its own atmosphere and challenges, and immerse yourself in a narrative that gradually uncovers the story of your protagonist and the dark secrets of Backrooms.
Will you survive and find your way out or will you be trapped in this endless world?
Loot and manufacture: Find and create essential resources to keep you alive.

title: Sphenoid
description:
게임 정보
감옥 안에서 깨어난 당신은 마녀가 전기 의자에서 처형된 바로 그날 밤입니다. 작별 인사를 하기 전에 그는 이 뼈를 가진 사람을 제외하고는 모두 데려가겠다고 말했습니다... 뼈? 그가 약속을 지켰을까요? 당신은 그의 죽음 이후에 unleashed된 공포에서 벗어날 수 있을까요?
Sphenoid는 감옥을 배경으로 한 공포 탈출 방 게임입니다. 퍼즐을 풀고, 단서를 찾고, 다른 죄수들에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아내세요.
이 게임은 어둡고 атмосферic한 환경을 배경으로 합니다. 감옥은 그림자와 비밀로 가득 차 있으며, 당신은 절대 모퉁이를 돌면 무엇이 도사리고 있는지 알 수 없을 것입니다.
특징:
퍼즐은 탈출 방 게임 제작자들이 디자인했습니다.
감옥의 여러 지역을 탐험하고 그 공포에 맞서세요.
다른 죄수들에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아보세요.
감옥 둘러보기
개체 및 단서 찾기

title: The Black Bahr
description:
게임 정보
Prepare to set sail in a sandbox colony simulation blending vast ocean exploration with strategic crew management. Roam uncharted waters, discover islands, and shape your legacy at sea whether as an honorable captain, cunning smuggler, or ambitious faction leader.
Lead your crew as they gain experience, build reputations, and navigate alliances and rivalries. Support local empires, embrace piracy, or forge your own path. Keep your crew fed, content, and united, making critical decisions that shape your shared destiny. Your vessel is your colony, workshop, and fortress. Customize its interior, craft resources, and balance trade, adventure, and survival in a world where every choice matters.
FEATURES
• Open-Ended Exploration – Sail wherever you please in a living ocean filled with diverse island settlements, each governed by its own politics and unique outlook on the world.
• Evolving Captain and Crew – Grow stronger by earning experience through trade, naval battles, or diplomacy. Your skills and those of your crew improve as you tackle new challenges.
• Deep Faction System – Encounter various cultures and powers vying for control. Improve (or sabotage) your standing with them, join their cause, or establish your own faction to command the seas.
• Living Shipboard Community – Manage essential resources and the morale of your crew. Every decision you make, from rationing supplies to dealing with mutinous behavior, can change your crew’s loyalty and performance.
• Customize and Produce – Outfit your vessel with workshops and crafting stations suitable to its size and your leadership style. Create gear, refine materials, and stock provisions for lengthy voyages.
• Dynamic Sandbox Gameplay – No supernatural shortcuts here. This is a world grounded in realism, where your wit, preparation, and alliances chart your path.
• Rich Dialogues and Encounters – Cross paths with an array of characters, each with their own agendas. Forge friendships or spark rivalries through direct conversations and carefully chosen actions.
• Tempting Adventures and Rare Rewards – Venture into mysterious waters, daring islands, and treacherous territories that beckon explorers and risk-takers alike. Face off against fierce enemies guarding valuable treasures, rare loot, and secrets waiting to be uncovered by only the boldest captains.
Chart your course, and unleash your ambitions upon this vast ocean of endless possibilities. Your ship is your domain, your crew is your family, and your dreams are what will steer you through storms to victory or oblivion!

title: Runa Illustra
description:
게임 정보
고대 책의 페이지에 갇힌 신비한 세계에 던져진 당신은 집으로 돌아갈 방법을 찾아야 합니다. 주문서를 마스터하여 주문을 그리고 시전하세요. 그것들을 사용하여 주변을 조작하고 예상치 못한 방식으로 도전적인 퍼즐을 해결하세요.
주문을 그리세요
이 실용적인 기호 기반 마법 시스템을 탐험하세요. 주문서의 페이지에 마법 원을 그려서 언제든지 그것을 시전할 수 있습니다.

title: Conquest of Kings
description:
게임 정보
Conquest of Kings blends deep turn-based strategy with fast-paced, 30-60 minute battles! Compete in 1v1 duels or intense 4 player free-for-alls, capturing the Sacred Sites to claim victory!
Recruit units, command powerful armies, and play devastating cards to turn the tide of battle!
Fast-Paced Strategy - Deep tactical decisions in a 30-60 minute game.
Online PVP - 1v1s, 2v2, 4-Player FFA.
Command Powerful Armies - Recruit from five unit types and seize control of key tiles.
Earn the Favor of the Gods - Pay tribute to the Gods to gain powerful bonuses.
Play Powerful Cards - Play cards from your hand to influence battles

title: Luctus
description:
게임 정보
요약
루터스는 픽셀 아트 미학으로 생생하게 구현된 몰입형 스토리 기반 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 기억에 남는 캐릭터와 풍부한 세계관으로 가득한 심도 깊은 경험이 여러분을 기다립니다. 이 게임에는 주인공 노라의 드라마틱한 스토리와 액션으로 가득한 장면, 장대한 보스 전투가 어우러져 있습니다.
드라마틱한 스토리
노라와 루나는 어린 나이에 부모님을 잃은 아주 친한 친구입니다. 아버지의 죽음 이후 한 지붕 아래에서 자란 이 두 소녀는 아버지의 죽음을 초래한 생물을 쫓고 있습니다. 어느 날 아침 루나의 실종으로 시작된 노라의 이야기는 삶과 죽음에 관한 깊은 이야기로 발전합니다.

title: Duckpool
description:
게임 정보
Duckpool is a top-down shooter with roguelike elements, where you play as a rubber duck. Blast bizarre enemies with lasers and bubbles, dodge traps, fight bosses, and collect loot. Unlock unique ducks to uncover a hidden mystery. The game revives the brutal difficulty of classic arcade games.
Features
Fight your way through nine maze-like maps (+1 secret or not)
Unlock over 150 collectible ducks
Unfold the story by collecting ducks
Face off against bizarre creatures
Collect different power ups
Collect soap loot and spend it on a slot machine or buy collectables directly

title: Rename the History
description:
게임 정보
전후 역사상 가장 어려운 시기에 국가를 이끄세요. 이때 강대국이 될지 강대국이 될지 선택해야 합니다. 서쪽으로 갈지 동쪽으로 갈지? 결정은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 새로운 역사에서 국가를 잃지 않으려고 노력하고, 많은 갈등을 헤쳐 나가며 영향력을 높이세요.
당신의 목표는 21세기 초에 국가 지도자가 되는 것입니다. 국가를 개선해야 하며, 이는 여러 가지 방법으로 가능합니다. 강력한 국가 기관과 경제의 도움으로 강력한 우월성을 달성할 수 있습니다. 또는 강력한 군사 강대국이 되어 이웃을 정복하고 자신을 강대국이라고 선언할 수 있습니다. 두 가지 방법 모두 장단점이 있지만, 어떤 것을 선택할지는 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
군대
보병과 전차로 구성된 군대를 지휘하세요. 보병은 수비대를 만들고 정복한 국경을 보호하는 데 필요합니다. 전차는 전선을 돌파하는 데 필요합니다. 전선에서 승리하려면 여러 유형의 군대를 결합하세요!
경제와 건설
전장에서만 국가를 개발하는 것이 아닙니다. 돈을 빌리고, 사무실, 막사, 벙커를 건설할 수 있습니다. 귀하의 목표는 귀하의 국가에 최대의 번영을 이루는 것입니다. 다양한 경제 개발 방식을 결합하여 새로운 경제 기적을 위한 레시피를 만드십시오!
동맹과 외교
다른 국가와의 문제는 군사 행동의 형태로만 해결될 수 없습니다. 귀하는 그들과 동맹을 맺고, 군대의 통과를 요청하고, 인도적 지원을 보내는 등의 방법을 사용할 수 있습니다. 다양한 외교적 영향력 방법을 사용하여 국경에 편안한 환경을 조성하십시오.
국가 정책
국가 정책으로 국가 문제를 해결하십시오. 향후 60일 동안 국가 개발에 대한 초점을 선택하십시오. 이는 정치적 초점, 경제적 초점 또는 군사적 초점이 될 수 있습니다. 이 메커니즘은 귀하의 국가뿐만 아니라 전체 지역에도 강력한 영향을 미칩니다. 여기에서 강력한 외교 정책을 찾을 수 있습니다.
다양성의 강점
기억하세요. 선택할 수 있는 국가는 50개국 이상입니다. 그리고 각 메커니즘은 국가에 따라 더 중요하거나 덜 중요할 수 있습니다. 또한, 같은 국가에서 플레이하면 게임의 재미를 충분히 느낄 수 없습니다.

title: Coin Devotee
description:
게임 정보
Background
I met a devil who wants to play a game with me.
We will flip coins until one shows tails.
Once that happens, I can keep all the coins except for the one showing tails.
All I need is to pay some coins in return.
Sounds like a good deal, doesn't it?
The game
I flip a coin.
If heads, automatically flip another coin and repeat the process until tails.
If tails, I gain all the coins except for the one showing tails, and the round is over.
For every 5 rounds, the devil will charge me some coins.
Can't wait to become a millionaire!
Devil's offer
Every time the round is over, the devil offers three items for sale.
I can use the coins I earned from the previous round to purchase those items.
Those items will make my next round better!
The devil is too kind for me!

title: Tin Lord
description:
게임 정보
Tin Lord is a hybrid of RTS and Tower Defense in a post-apocalyptic world where you control robots that rebuild technology and fight monsters in a destroyed world.

Your task is to build and defend your base, manage resources, create defenses and destroy enemies in intense battles.
Game Features:
Real-time strategy: Build your base, place turrets and defenses, manage resources and plan your moves.
Grim post-apocalyptic world: The game's landscape changes dynamically through the interaction of tiles.
Diverse Enemies: Fight monsters using the technologies you've learned.
Defensive structures: Build a variety of turrets from simple ballistas to powerful cannons and watch them destroy your enemies.
Ecology management: your actions affect the ecological state of the world, which adds additional complexity during the game.
Prepare for an intense strategic struggle for survival and world restoration, where every move you make could be decisive!

title: Enlightening
description:
게임 정보
Enlightening은 블록을 밀어 움직이는 논리 게임으로, 전기를 활용한 독특한 메커니즘을 제공합니다.
로봇 청소기 Flux를 도와 각 레벨의 출구를 작동시키는 에너지 회로를 만들어 탈출하세요.
임무는 간단해 보일 수 있지만, 퍼즐은 공간 인식, 추상적 사고, 그리고 분석적 사고 능력을 한계까지 시험할 것입니다.
준비되셨나요? 에너지를 충전하고 도전하세요!
125개 이상의 정교하게 설계된 레벨과 25개의 튜토리얼이 준비되어 있으며, 명확하고 보람 있는 게임을 위해 체계적으로 구성되어 있습니다.
각 퍼즐은 신선한 반전을 제공하며, 문제 해결 능력을 시험하고 계속해서 몰입하도록 만들죠!

title: Death In Your Dice
description:
게임 정보
A mysterious figure draws you into the game. Price: death. Executioner: you. You have dice in your hand and the consequences of this game on your shoulders. Act, predict, observe, and above all... cheat? How long will you last before your conscience takes your minds away? How long will you last before you throw away your values? Do you think you are capable of making sacrifices in the name of honor? The time of trial has come. Even if the die has been cast, let your decisions determine you.
The die is cast
Your fate has been sealed, hasn't it? Observe your surroundings, look for solutions, develop a strategy, try to change the outcome of the roll to achieve your goals.

title: Speed Rivals
description:
게임 정보
Slot Racing: 당신과 레일 사이의 최면과 같은 춤
🏁 Speed Rivals는 빠른 속도의 슬롯 레이싱 게임으로, 정확한 컨트롤과 전략이 승패를 가릅니다.
🚗 Slot Racing의 황금기를 떠올리게 하는 역동적인 트랙에서 경주하며, 차량을 업그레이드하고 토너먼트에서 승리하여 최고의 드라이버가 되십시오! 🏆 몰입감 있는 스토리 모드 📖, 경쟁 멀티플레이 🛣️, 그리고 긴장을 풀 수 있는 젠 모드 😴를 제공합니다. 😴
각 코너는 도전이며, 승리는 정상으로 가는 한 걸음입니다. 트랙을 지배할 준비가 되었나요? 🔥🏎️

title: Rumble City
description:
게임 정보
We created an action packed party fighter experience that you and your friends are sure to enjoy! Our vision for Rumble City was to make the game feel snappy and fluid while adding the goofy over the top elements such as destructive weapons and a cartoony atmosphere!
Features
Action packed gameplay: Find tons of unique weapons and hone them to take down your friends! Each game of Rumble City is fast paced with the characters having low health so every jump, dodge, and attack counts!
Precise Platforming: What would a party fighter be without some presice platforming? Rumble City has tons of unique stages with many different weapons scattered around. Climb and jump faster then your friends to collect weapons and defeat them!
Multi-Stage Games: Each game of Rumble City offers a unique experience to players. There is no "lives", or "stock", instead, each game is a high stakes tug-of-war style challenge. Win and you progress, lose and you regress, until one team pushes the other out of the back alleys of Rumble City!
What to expect in Rumble City
Action party fighter combat.
Tons of unique weapons to choose from.
Achievements for killing your friends in creative ways.
A killer soundtrack to rock out to.
Lots of colors and teams to play as.
(Optional) Bragging rights for beating your friends.
