title: No More Grudges
description:
게임 정보
A top-down with rouge-lite elements featuring a dark story and intense gunplay combat

title: Destruction Overdrive
description:
게임 정보
FULLY. DESTRUCTIBLE. TRACK.
Use your missiles to carve new paths through any wall.
Use your bombs to blow holes in the track, making it harder for your opponents....and you
MULTI-PLAYER
You and up to 12 friends can race, destroy, and obliterate to place 1st
SINGLE PLAYER
Race against the self-destruct timer, finding and optimizing your own paths of ruin is the only way to win
STRATEGIZE
Discover or destroy the shortcuts created
Are your skills better at racing around the track naturally?
Create even tighter corners to take around the race track, or just blast your way right through the middle

title: Lumina: The Uprising Of Folk Legends
description:
게임 정보
This is a story of tradition and technology, sacrifice and rebirth, and the struggle to protect a world on the brink of unimaginable change. For generations, Shamans have protected the balance between the physical and spiritual realms, channeling Lumina—the vital essence that flows between worlds. But this harmony has been shattered by a powerful corporation seeking to exploit and manipulate this sacred energy for its own gain.
MAGIC
autokwd: Lumina: The Uprising Of Folk Legends

title: Wukong Survivors ：Begin
description:
게임 정보
Wukong Survivors ：Begin is a Rougelike type shooting game.
Game Features:
A very rare TPS+Vampire survivor!
Can use 6 big guns to crush your enemies!
Can fly using the Nimbus Cloud!
Rich build options, gun bonds combinations.
Play as different forms of Wukong, with various active and passive skills.
Bullet storms, a true bullet hell!
Collect peaches from each round of battle, purchase enhancements, and ultimately engage in a showdown with the boss.
A comically themed background storyline.

title: Seeing Red
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in SEEING RED, a single-player, first-person survival horror experience that pulls you into a chilling narrative filled with suspense and mystery. You step into the shoes of Benjamin, an ex-military private detective whose troubled past comes back to haunt him when he returns to his forgotten childhood town.
SEEING RED is a full-featured first-person survival horror game that offers an intense and immersive experience. This product includes:
Full Story Campaign – A gripping, atmospheric narrative following your search for your missing sister, uncovering dark secrets along the way.
Gameplay Features:
First-Person Combat – Use firearms and melee weapons to fight off relentless monsters, but beware—ammo and stamina are limited.
Stealth & Evasion – Hide, run, or find alternative ways to survive against creatures hunting you.
Investigation & Exploration – Search for clues, interact with NPCs, and uncover the town’s dark secrets through dialogue and environmental storytelling.
Decision-Making – Your choices affect how the story unfolds, leading to different outcomes and interactions.
Puzzles & Lore Discovery – Solve cryptic puzzles, piece together hidden lore, and unveil the truth behind the horrors that surround you.
Immersive Horror Experience – Photorealistic visuals, dynamic sound design, and psychological horror elements that heighten tension and fear.

title: Wiseguys: The Commission
description:
게임 정보
Prohibition is over, but the world of organized crime continues to thrive. New York City is controlled by five powerful mafia families, in a fierce struggle for power. In this scenario of intrigue and power, your cunning and determination will be tested as never before.

Manage your Family and build an empire
Take on the role of Don and build your own criminal empire. Manage your family’s resources and affiliates; plan every move, from petty crimes to large-scale operations and earn respect through a combination of diplomacy and violence.

Extortion, robbery or burning of business
Use ruthless methods to raise funds and expand your influence. Extort money from local merchants, rob your rivals or burn their property to show your power and intimidate those who dare to oppose.

Wage war on other families and kill their mademan
Declare war on rival families and eliminate their mademan: plan strategic attacks, assassinations and ambushes to weaken them. Defend your territory and consolidate your power. Violence is inevitable in your ascent; only the most smart and determined will succeed.

Drug trafficking
Infiltrate the lucrative drug market and increase your income. Secure safe supplies, distribute goods to maximize profits and avoid the attention of law enforcement.

Control the Commission
Become the head of the Commission and use your power to influence decisions that govern the criminal world. Negotiate with the other mafia families and make important decisions. Your leadership will be crucial to maintain order among the mafia families and establish your dominance over all criminal activities in the city.

Be Ready for Arrests and Investigations
The law is always on our tail. Protect your organization from arrest and investigation, bribe the police and use informants to stay one step ahead of law enforcement. And "manage" the “infamy” problem.

Launder dirty money
A dirty dollar is worth less than a clean one. Launder your illicit earnings by investing in legitimate assets to avoid suspicion and maintain a constant cash flow. Clean money is the most useful during difficult times.

Wiseguys: The Commission combines deep management strategy with intense action, giving you deep strategic experience in the dark world of the Italian mafia in a charming 2D style. Are you ready to be the next boss of all bosses?

title: Hollowge
description:
게임 정보
"Buried alive, one shall rise."
Descend into the depths of Hollowforge, a decaying mining complex overrun by monstrous horrors born of corporate greed. In this adrenaline-pumping first-person stealth/action game, you'll need more than just firepower to survive—you’ll need to outwit and outmaneuver the abominations lurking in every shadow.
Blending the fast-paced chaos of Doom with the stealth mastery of Thief, Hollowforge delivers a heart-pounding experience where every choice matters. Run, sneak, and shoot your way through a labyrinth of tunnels, making split-second decisions as you unravel the dark secrets of a megacorporation’s failed experiment.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced Stealth/Action: Stay sharp. Darkness is your ally, but when the monsters find you, your guns become the final word.
Immersive Underground World: Explore the massive, open-ended complex of Hollowforge—a place steeped in mystery, where every corner hides a secret or a nightmare waiting to strike.
Resource Management: Conserve your scarce ammo and health, or spend your hard-earned credits at vending machines for a fighting chance.
Weapons Arsenal: From pistols to crossbows, take control of a versatile range of weaponry as you adapt to the horrors below.
Dynamic 3D Graphics: Feel the tension build with every flicker of light in this atmospheric world. Every shadow could hide an enemy. Every step could be your last.
Get ready to survive. Will you bring the truth to light—or be swallowed by the darkness?
Are you brave enough to face the horrors of Hollowforge?

title: Break Shot Hero
description:
게임 정보
OVERVIEW
Everyone is balls! Flick your balls to victory in this billiards-like tactical RPG!
FEATURES
Angle your shots off of walls & obstacles to find your path to success! Predictive trajectories help you make tricky shots if you can imagine them.
Collect a cast of miniature characters! There are no micro-transactions, no FOMO - only the old fashioned grind. Every hero and monster can be recruited!

title: Squad Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Squad Tactics is a Turn-Based Tactical RPG with unique combat mechanics and leveling system designed from scratch.
Complex but intuitive combat system, easy to understand but hard to master. Full control of every aspect of your units allowes multiple ways to handle any given situation. It's not about the units in play, but how do you handle them.
Everything is designed for high customizability and replayability.
Squad Composition
Squads are composed of one Hero plus 1 to 6 minions. Killing the enemy Hero is enough for victory but minions shall do everything possible to prevent this from happening, resulting in ever-changing dynamics never seen in any other game.
Different playing styles and squad compositions allow for tank heroes to soak up damage, high mobility heroes for hit-and-run tactics, heal and support heroes for enhanced minion effectiveness and much more.
Additional settings allow for up to 3 heroes per squad simultaneously, for experienced players who prefer even higher complexity.

title: Re:Night
description:
게임 정보
Release in autumn 2025!!
Re:Night is a roguelike deck-building & turn-based strategy game. Players need to build their own deck in each roguelike adventure and defeat various powerful enemies in a chessboard battleground. Aggro, OTK, control… all kinds of decks can turn the tide and break through the siege. Besides, players can control multiple characters in battles to achieve amazing tactics such as flanking, blocking, ganking and so on. Come to this town, end the loop of nights and bring back the dawn!
You can simultaneously control three characters in battles. On the quadrilateral chessboard block, utilize various tactics, take advantage of each character’s unique abilities to win the battle!

title: Hacked: The Streamer
description:
게임 정보
You shape the story of the beloved streamer PinkyPie as her world turns upside down with an unsettling message during what seemed to be a regular night. You need to collect clues and connect the dots to make the right decisions that will protect her from disaster in this interactive narrative experience. Is her streaming career over, or will she return stronger than ever? The answer is in your hands.

Crafted with Passion: Our Indie Debut

Immerse yourself in the thrilling story of the game streamer PinkyPie in this game with:

More than fifty decision points
Five endings you can reach with different decisions
Quick-time events you perform in actual video games
Interactions with objects in the scene to perform various actions
Special focus moments that let you flash back to relevant memories to collect clues



You will get to meet people in PinkyPie’s personal life as well as her streaming cohort. Ahmet, Semih, Ali, and Deniz are her devoted moderators and close companions while the plot also extends to her ex-boyfriend Ömer, her BFF and housemate Bilge, and her supportive brother Alp. Can you piece together their stories? The truth is yours to uncover.



Hacked: The Streamer is the first installment of the Hacked anthology, one that puts the player in the center of an immersive experience.

title: Last Dragoon: Awaken
description:
게임 정보
한때는 드래곤과 드래곤 나이트가 세계를 보호했지만 지금은 드래곤이 모두 사라지고 세상은 사악한 생물에 의해 타락하고 해가 지면 균열에서 태어나 모든 것을 파괴하고 삼켜 버립니다. 그리고 당신, 인간 궁수, 당신의 집은 폐허가되었습니다. 당신은 방황하는 길을 떠나야합니다. 모든 것이 무의미하다고 생각했을 때 우연히 죽어가는 아기 드래곤을 발견하고 성공적으로 구하고 키우기로 결정했습니다. 그 이후로 당신은 함께 모험하고, 함께 사냥하고, 함께 놀고, 궁극적으로 서로의 가장 가까운 전투 파트너가 되었습니다. 당신이 성장함에 따라 드래곤이 성장하고 팀이 성장함에 따라 희망에 다시 불을 붙이기 시작합니다...

이것은 다른 게임 플레이 요소도 포함하는 어드벤처 타워 디펜스 게임입니다. 자세한 내용은 다음 기능을 참조하십시오.

특징:
Adventure Survival: 세계 지도를 탐험하고 생존하세요. 다른 적과 맞서 싸우거나 도망치십시오. 다른 세계에서 텔레포트합니다.

드워프 용병 고용 및 소환: 서로 다른 드워프를 고용 및 소환하여 전투를 수행합니다. 드워프는 다양한 유형으로 나뉩니다. 드워프의 유형에 따라 공격 특성과 성장 속성이 다릅니다.

건설 및 타워 방어: 기지의 다양한 방어 시설을 건설하거나 수리합니다. 밤이 되면 기지를 지키십시오.

펫 육성: 어린 드래곤의 성장에 동행하고, 어린 드래곤에게 먹이를 주고, 함께 싸우세요. 드래곤이 성장하면 드래곤의 화염을 뿌리기 위해 장착 및 제어할 수 있습니다.

내장 미니 게임: 3개의 내장 미니 게임이 있으며, 드래곤과 함께 플레이할 수 있습니다.

게임 시스템은 주야간 날씨 시스템과 결합됩니다. 날씨 시스템은 일부 게임 결정에 영향을 미칩니다.

회피 및 활 기술을 기반으로 하는 전투 시스템입니다.

사냥과 채집: 모든 종류의 동물을 사냥하세요. 다양한 컬렉션 요소로 강화하고 업그레이드하세요.

title: RelicWar
description:
게임 정보
Turn Based Gameplay
Starting each match you will have a deck of cards. These will allow you to boost movement, attack or defense. You can set traps to slow your enemies down or use the same cards in your hand during battles to give you that extra edge.
Unique Hunters
Each Hunter has a different background story, principles and weapon for combat. Outside of the dungeons you will need to upgrade them and provide healing for any lasting injuries at the nearby MediCenter. Some Relics you find can be equipped for your next adventure into the dungeons.

title: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
description:
게임 정보
Armed with your trusty keyboard and mouse, battle the games you never play! The more you paid for them, the more damage they will do to you (just like in real life).
Fight in an arena surrounded by your well-played spectator games, while the immortal royalty (the games you have never played) lord over you at the end of the arena.
Games you played for up to two hours will attack you in waves - but watch out for flying enemies (high Metacritic score), Platform supported enemies, DLC enemies and Controller Supported enemies; amongst many more!
** IMPORTANT ** To get the most out of this game (Play your game list instead of the Default/Friends game lists), you will need to set your "Game details" to public on your Steam profile (Your Profile->Edit Profile->Privacy Settings->Game Details). You can set it back to private after you load the game for the first time.

title: Mythara Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey in Mythara Chronicles, a tactical role-playing game that combines strategic combat, immersive exploration, and impactful decision-making. As a Hero dispatched by the esteemed Hero’s Guild, your mission is to restore peace to the beleaguered region of Rena. The city of Luecis is under siege by the formidable Demon-General Varynthaal, and only through uniting the divided factions can hope be rekindled.
EXPLORE A DYNAMIC OVERWORLD
Traverse a beautifully hand-painted, isometric world map. Discover vibrant towns, treacherous dungeons, and hidden campsites. Manage resources wisely and encounter dynamic events that make each journey unique.
MASTER TACTICAL COMBAT
Engage in grid-based battles where your tactical prowess is tested. Utilize class synergies, exploit terrain advantages, and position your party effectively to overcome a variety of adversaries, including demonic hordes and corrupted factions.
BUILD YOUR PARTY YOUR WAY
Assemble a party from a selection of unique classes, each with specialized abilities:
Knight: Serve as the stalwart tank and protector, shielding allies from harm.
Mage: Wield elemental magic to devastate foes and control the battlefield.
Ranger: Employ ranged attacks and set traps to outmaneuver enemies.
Warrior: Deliver high-damage melee attacks to swiftly dispatch opponents.
Cleric: Provide healing and divine support to sustain your party.
Bard: Enhance team morale and capabilities through inspiring songs.
Tamer: Summon and command beasts to aid in combat.
Rogue: Utilize stealth and deliver critical strikes to unsuspecting foes.
SHAPE YOUR REPUTATION
Your choices matter. Influence alliances, resolve political conflicts, and shape the future of Rena. Every decision impacts faction relationships, the morale of the populace, and the ultimate outcome of your quest.
DISCOVER DUNGEONS
Uncover hidden dungeons scattered across the overworld. Brave their dangers to recover powerful artifacts that grant unique abilities and unveil secrets of Mythara’s ancient past.

title: Prize Denied
description:
게임 정보
당신은 한때 플레이어 친화적인 인형뽑기로 유명한 인심 좋은 인형뽑기방 주인이었습니다. 그러나 그 친절함 때문에 결국 파산에 이르고 말았습니다... 삼촌의 차고에 남겨진 단 하나의 뽑기 기계로, 당신은 교활한 사업가로 변신하기로 결심합니다!
나만의 기계를 만들어보세요
기계 부품을 잠금 해제하고 기계를 커스터마이징하세요. 기계의 설정을 조정하여 플레이어에게 도전적인 기계를 만들거나(혹은 파산의 위험을 감수할 수 있다면 플레이어 친화적인 기계를 만들 수도 있습니다). 현재 유행하는 귀여운 상품을 선택해 플레이어를 끌어들이고, 벽과 장애물을 설치해 어떤 일이 있어도 상품이 빠져나오지 않게 막으세요!
액션 카드를 사용하세요
독특한 효과를 가진 액션 카드를 사용해 상품이 떨어지지 않도록 방해하고, 집게 성공률을 낮추며, 플레이어를 끌어모으고, 평점을 높이는 등 다양한 전략을 구사하세요. 상상력과 관찰력을 활용하면 단 한 장의 카드로 여러 개체에 영향을 미쳐 믿기 힘든 반응을 일으킬 수도 있습니다!

title: INFECT½
description:
게임 정보
·Game Description·
Having lost your memory, you wake up from an unfamiliar hospital bed, and look around to find that this place has long been deserted due to the outbreak of the virus in the early years. The sudden mysterious man tells you the current state of the world, and after being attacked by an unknown creature, your mind is blank and you choose to be cautious, so you follow the other party to the gathering place where there are still signs of human activity, intending to find out.
But if you stay in the shelter, you won't know what lies in the lost memories, and in order to find out what happened before the amnesia, you take the opportunity to go to the anomalous area with your partner to find out.
·Format of play·

title: That Time I Found A Box
description:
게임 정보
“That Time I Found A Box” is a roguelike deckbuilder where during a run you can craft and infinitely upgrade your cards. Choose carefully when to play them and when / how to upgrade them.
Discover what’s possible with deep strategic card building and deck building resulting in vanishingly rare moments of there being only one obvious play available.
Choose your allies, have some fun and create game-breaking cards!... And most importantly, be able to put the box down and get out alive.
autokwd: That Time I Found A Box

title: Secrets Of Suburbia
description:
게임 정보
The Story
In the quiet town of Covenbrook, a girl has gone missing. Some say she ran away, but rumors online suggest something far worse. The town has seen disappearances before, and people are becoming suspicious. But you are Rowan Parker, and you’re home alone on a Friday night. Who's going to let that stop you from playing video games, browsing the internet, and IMing with your friends all night?
Ok. You can also leave your bedroom and solve the mystery if you want.
Gameplay
Secrets of Suburbia is a story-rich, first-person mystery game that weaves horror and web exploration into it's core. You can investigate at your own pace.
Key Features
Explore the suburbs of 1997. Venture into a variety of locations in and around the town, from pristine homes to forgotten places. Behind locked doors, you’ll discover secrets and truths that have stayed hidden until you decide to look for them.
Explore an internet of 1997. You have unlimited access to a hand-crafted internet of 1997.  Find games, fandoms, secret websites, and people's real online personas at 56kbps*. At least, once you disable that firewall that mom just set up.
Engage in deep, logical deduction. Discovering the truth involves utilizing every resource you have. Find keys and passwords to unlock new areas both online and offline. Infiltrate other people's accounts to figure out what's really going on.

title: Impious
description:
게임 정보
Impious is a dark, turn-based roguelite RPG that immerses you in the oppressive depths of an underground indoctrination center set in a time reminiscent of modern days, yet not quite our present. As one of the "Impious," you are captured for your sins and subjected to the brutal attempts of a medieval sect to cleanse your soul through pain and obedience. Will you reclaim your freedom, or will you succumb to the brainwashing horrors within?
Features
Strategic Turn-based Combat
Engage in tactical battles where every decision counts. Utilize a variety of weapons, equipment, and consumables to gain the upper hand. Adapt your strategy by anticipating enemy moves and exploiting critical hits, dodges, and status effects.
Unique Death Mechanics
Death is not the end. When your character falls, they are returned to their cell, stripped of their gear, and subjected to further indoctrination. Manage your character's "Will" to prevent them from becoming permanently brainwashed.
Challenging Environments
Navigate through rooms filled with enemies and diverse challenges. Success relies on your equipment and stats, with varying outcomes that shape your journey. Gain experience, loot valuable items, and restore your Will through these trials.
Interact With other Characters
Meet and interact with characters you have created in previous runs. Trade items, offer motivation, and collaborate to increase your chances of escape, adding depth to the narrative and strategy.
Immersive Atmosphere
Explore the harsh, angular environments of a brutalist indoctrination center, dominated by concrete and metal. The cold, artificial lighting creates a claustrophobic and oppressive ambiance. Characters wear torturous medieval garb, emphasizing the sect's cruel methods.
Engaging Sound and Music
Experience a haunting soundscape and a unique soundtrack that blends medieval tones with 80s-inspired synth, enhancing the dark and foreboding atmosphere.
Impious offers a relentless challenge for fans of roguelites, dark RPGs, and strategy games. As you delve deeper into the center, each step brings you closer to freedom or eternal indoctrination. Are you prepared to face the horrors within and reclaim your will?

title: The Perfect Pencil
description:
게임 정보


The Perfect Pencil은 초현실적인 세계를 무대로 한 2D 액션 게임으로, 사람의 성장과 공포심을 그린다. 손으로 그린 신비로운 왕국에서 갑자기 깨어난 주인공 존을 조작하여 상상도 할 수 없는 곳에서 나타나는 공포와 맞서 보자.





다른 사람들이 볼 수 없는 것을 비출 수 있는 존의 능력을 사용하여 신비로운 땅에서 펼쳐지는 감정이 가득한 이야기를 체험해 보자.
빛과 어둠의 사이에서 당신의 선택이 운명을 바꿔놓는다. 그러나 보이는 것이 진실이라고는 할 수 없다…





이 세상에는 무엇이 있을지 모른다. 칠흑의 어둠도, 안녕의 땅도, 비밀과 놀라움과 괴짜들로 가득한 초현실적인 공간이다.





존의 능력을 사용하여 NPC의 비밀과 지도의 수수께끼를 밝혀내자. 퍼펙트 펜슬에는 메인 스토리 외에도 다양한 이야기가 숨겨져 있다. 세계를 구석구석 탐색한 결과, 당신의 인식이 변화할 만한 무언가가 숨겨져 있을지도 모른다.





존의 싸움은 우선 자신과의 싸움이지만, 동시에 사람의 마음속 어둠이 구체화된 무시무시한 보스와의 손에 땀을 쥐게 하는 전투도 있다. 어떤 것들은 상식을 뒤엎을 수도 있다... 그러나 살아남기 위해서는 때로는 위험한 다리를 건너야 할 필요도 있다.

title: Hellspresso
description:
게임 정보
As a dedicated ghost chef trying to make a living in the afterlife, you decide to open your own restaurant in hell. Day after day and night after night, from one shift to the next, race against the clock to serve more and more hungry customers. Switch to your not-so-secret magic kitchen to prepare more exotic dishes. Start off small, expand your restaurant and your skills, and slowly gain your reputation as the best ghost cooking chief in hell!
Cook dishes and serve hungry customers!
.
.
.
Run, cut meat, fry potatoes, mix delicious smoothies, make coffee, serve customers before they storm out, clean tables, stack dirty plates, wash dishes… You will have a lot on your plate.Different kinds of customers have varying tempers and willingness to give you tips. Serving them is key to the longevity of your restaurant. Every second counts, because if you take too long, your customers will be tired of waiting and they will leave angry and hungry!
.
Encountering strange orders with venomous mushrooms or magic plants that you don’t have in your fridge? Time to enter your clandestine kitchen! Discover the mystical counterparts to your regular ingredients and kitchen tools. Watch as a regular steak transforms into rotten meat, and a mushroom becomes a venomous variant with red spots. Sprinkle glowing eyes on your donuts, chop garlic, brew magic potions, and create infusions with foxglove or deadly nightshade. Your cauldron and your alembic will help you to craft enchanting recipes and satisfy every customer. Master the art of juggling between both kitchens to ensure your dishes never burn!
.
.
Discover more than 50 ingredients to cook, each with its magical counterpart hidden in your secret atelier. From familiar carrots, mushrooms, and donuts to exotic items like garlic, blood, or deadly nightshade, a world of exciting ingredients awaits your culinary creativity! You can create more than 100 different recipes from all around the world and even beyond, to offer new dishes and drinks to your demanding customers.
.
Your daily customers are always different! Design your menu however you like based on the day's forecast. Each day, you can choose which ingredients to put on your fridge and on your cupboard, as well as the counters that will be in your kitchen. With more than 10 different personalities, each customer wants something different, and it’s up to you to optimize your menu accordingly. Discover their favorite recipes to gain their trust and unlock their secrets.
.
Some ingredients and ustensiles have a magical equivalent in your secret kitchen, allowing you to put even more recipes to your menu!
.
When they are done eating, customers take a quick nap. Take advantage of their inattention to absorb a part of their soul! Souls can then be used to improve your restaurant!
.
.
Invest the souls you stole to build up your kitchen with upgrades! These decisions change the way you play and are crucial for unlocking new recipes and increasing your profit. Opt for more storage capacity with a fridge expansion to use more ingredients, or tools like a new blender or more stoves to increase your productivity. You can even invest in an automatic dishwasher! Buy more tables to host more and more hungry customers. Decorate your restaurant with fine taste to increase your customer’s patience… and tips! Take some classes and improve your serving skills to get better tips, or specialize in some recipes and increase your prices. Will you decide to master the art of donuts or to unlock the secrets of smoothies? It’s up to you!

title: GSC - Game Store Chronicle
description:
게임 정보
IT IS NOT JUST A SIMULATOR, IT IS PLAYABLE HISTORY!
Step into the exciting world of gaming history and run your own game store! This simulation lets you experience the highs and lows of managing a video game shop while immersing yourself in the evolution of gaming through the decades.
Design and Manage Your Store
From the very first console launches to the dawn of iconic gaming eras, your store will grow alongside the industry. Organize shelves, create attractive displays, and ensure your shop is the go-to destination for gaming enthusiasts. Make every decision count—your store layout and product selection are key to customer satisfaction.
Stay Ahead of the Timeline
In Game Store Chronicle, the timeline matters. As new gaming generations unfold, iconic consoles, games, and accessories will arrive on the scene. Prepare for these key events, stock the right products at the right time, and ride the wave of excitement to maximize your profits. Anticipating trends and staying ahead of the curve will set you apart from the competition.
Stock, Sell, and Strategize
Start your journey by browsing product catalogs to pick and choose items for your store. Call suppliers to place your orders and receive deliveries. As time progresses, upgrade to more advanced tools like in-game computers to streamline your inventory management. Whether it’s selling the latest console, nostalgic games, or must-have accessories, balancing supply, demand, and customer satisfaction is critical to growing your business.
Expand and Evolve
As your profits grow, so can your store! Expand your space, upgrade your interiors, and cater to the needs of an ever-growing customer base. Keep up with the ever-changing gaming landscape, adapt to new trends, and ensure your store remains the top choice for gamers.
A Dynamic Experience
Every decision you make shapes your business—from product selection to pricing strategies. Will you build a thriving store that becomes a gaming hub, or will you fall behind as trends shift and evolve? The choice is yours in this vibrant simulation.

title: Somnicore
description:
게임 정보
Somnicore에 대한 간단한 소개
솜니코어는 퍼즐과 소름 돋는 순간을 결합한 분위기 있는 게임입니다. 플레이하는 동안 계속해서 풍경을 볼 수 있도록 준비하세요. 그 과정에서 여러분은 초현실적이고 흥미로운 공간을 많이 만나게 될 것입니다.
게임의 모든 액션은 우리의 의식 밖, 꿈속에서 일어납니다. 이곳은 신비로운 장소와 불안한 생각들로 가득 차 있습니다. 아마도 헛된 말이 아닐 겁니다. 우리 꿈의 외딴 구석에 무엇이 숨겨져 있는지 알 수 없으니까요...
두려움과 완전한 평화가 공존하는 초현실적인 세계에 푹 빠질 준비가 되셨나요? :)
특징 :

title: GraviTech
description:
게임 정보
From a Different Angle
In this 3D puzzle game, you will find yourself in a space laboratory dedicated to studying gravity. You will face numerous challenges that require you to see the world from a different angle—because here, gravity can be directed in any direction.
What You'll Find in This Game:
A variety of exciting levels
Over 10 unique interactive objects
A chance to test your sense of balance
Platforming sections
Level Editor
If the levels created by the developers aren't enough for you, you can create your own! The game features a flexible level editor to bring your ideas to life.

title: Axis Football 2026
description:
게임 정보
Axis Football 2026 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.
Axis Football 2026 is currently in development. Please see the development blog posts below for more information!
Full Franchise Mode Features:
Multiple league setup options (NFL-style, Tier style)
All-time record tracking
Player Contracts
Trades
Injuries
Practice Squads
Free Agency
Retiring Players
Weekly and Yearly Awards
Dynamic, tiered league structure with playoffs, promotions, and relegations
Unlimited seasons
Player progressions based on performance, age, potential, and playtime
End of season drafts
Season-long team stats
Individual league leader stats
Franchise stats
Depth chart control
Play, coach, spectate, or simulate matches
League and team schedule viewer
Spectate other matches
Customization:
Complete team creator / editor suite

title: Echoes of Myth
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Myth is a roguelite soulslike set in a broken, ever-changing fantasy world where gods have fallen silent. Choose your class and path, tactically battling enemies and bosses. Collect unique loot, unlock talents, and permanently enhance your character. Die, learn, and rise stronger.
Soulslike Combat
Engage in challenging combat against formidable enemies and bosses. Utilize a mix of melee attacks and spells, relying on well-timed dodges and parries to survive. Choose from different classes, each offering a unique weapon, spells, and talents that fit your playstyle.
Explore a Fragmented Fantasy World
Navigate through a broken, ever-changing realm where gods have fallen silent. Chart your own course through multiple routes filled with secrets and mysteries to uncover. Each path offers new challenges and discoveries in this dynamic world.

title: Phantasms: Maledictus
description:
게임 정보
Phantasms is an episodic psychological horror game. Each chapter is hand crafted to deliver a unique and immersive horror experience.

More episodes are coming soon.
Phantasms: Maledictus
In this medieval-themed first episode, you play as a parent whose child has been abducted by a mysterious figure. You’ll face multiple possible outcomes, though only one leads to the correct ending.
Key Features
Stylized PSX graphics with a horror aesthetic.
VHS film shaders.
Interact with NPCs.
Multiple endings in this interactive story telling experience.

title: EMOTIONLESS : The Last Ticket
description:
게임 정보

Your final ride begins here - a place where you'll question your sanity while reality distorts into an endless nightmare.

title: Cafe Maid - Classic Edition
description:

Summary - Idler Gameplay
In Cafe Maid serve your guests' needs in your own idle café. Your harem of cute anime maid girls earns you money even while you are shaving or watching your favorite movies, and when you come back, you can spend all that to make your cafe the biggest success around the globe. The game scales almost infinitely.

Grow your business through managing cute maid girls, deploying them in your cafe to serve your guests. As your business grows, more girls join. Flirt with them, get to know them deeper through engaging conversations, watch them open up, and change for the better (or worse) because of you.
Key Features
Chill Idle Gameplay
An enjoyable fusion of idle & clicker gameplay, allowing you to wind down a bit. Cafe Maid will not ask much of you, allowing you to focus on the girls and their stories while their business progresses on its own.
Upgrade Your Company
Once reaching a high collective level, sell your company to an investor for profits, and start over with a new girl added to the team. Spend the profit you earned on brand strategies, raising the girl's efficiency while working in the cafe. Through your previous successes your consequent businesses earn more coins, and attract more guests to be entertained.
Tasks and Achievements
An endless rotation of random tasks around the cafe will keep you busy, earning you extra rewards, such as fresh look for the girls and the cafe, gifts to give to the girls and more. In game achievements reward your mileage, allowing you to access great rewards through earned tickets.
Managing
Hire the cutest maids, selecting from a large variety, starting with your tsundere stepsister: a punk singer, an aspiring pie cook, a classic twintailed maid, a seductive fox girl and more. Set the girls up to meet the guests' needs, whether it's preparing and serving cakes and drinks, dancing and singing for them and more.
Flirting
Flirt with any and all of the maid girls of your cafe, earning their friendship and love beyond the role of being their boss. Give them gifts, take them on dates, flatter and tease them; each girl reacts differently, and their true nature reveals itself as you talk to them, but so will they reveal your true nature.

title: Photographer's Life Simulator

title: Mina
description:
게임 정보
Mina is an action-adventure game developed and published by Anopia Games, offering immersive gameplay and a deeply woven narrative. Players step into the role of Koray, a psychiatrist investigating his patient Kagan’s claim that their worlds are simulations. During this journey of discovery, they cross paths with Mina, who once tried—but ultimately failed—to escape the simulation.
Story
Koray initially meets Kagan’s belief that their worlds are simulations with skepticism. However, through his sessions with Kagan and the journeys they undertake together, he begins to question whether Kagan’s claim might actually be true. During this process, they encounter Mina—who has previously attempted (and failed) to escape the simulation, leading to her punishment. Mina’s traumatic past and her sensitivity to social injustice add depth to the storyline. In certain chapters, players will take control of Mina herself, experiencing events from her perspective.
Far from being a mere escape tale, Mina is an experience that grapples with profound philosophical questions, addresses social issues, and is shaped by the player’s choices.
Gameplay Features
Third-Person Perspective (TPS): Explore a detailed world that offers a cinematic experience.
Dual-Perspective Narrative: Primarily guide Koray, but in select segments, step into Mina’s shoes to see events from a different angle.
Rich Story and Deep Characters: Uncover each character’s hidden secrets as you seek out the truth.
Choices and Consequences: Your decisions can bring you closer to—or drive you away from—God!
Puzzle and Exploration Mechanics: Locate hidden clues, piece together lost memories, and untangle the knots in Koray’s mind.
Psychological Thriller Elements: Walk the fine line between reality and delusion.
Atmosphere and Themes
Psychological Thriller: A thought-provoking narrative that urges you to question reality.

You will fight not only bounty hunters, but also the sheriff's dogs, the feds, hunger and disease. Get To The Trailer Home
All you know is that you need to find a trailer home to stay in for the night. Not just any trailer home, but the one your coworker's uncle owns. The trailer home that you have no pictures or details of. As long as you were on pace during your hike, you should arrive before the sun sets.
Figure Out What's Off
As you make your way, something feels wrong about this place. You can't put your finger on it, but something is not right. Uncover the truth by thinking it through, talking with locals, and exploring the area.
Take a Break
Finally.. Take a rest for the night in the comfort of the trailer -- a place for you to recharge, recoup, and destress before your next big day of hiking.
Make It Out
All you really want to do is get THROUGH the night, so that you can continue on with your hike in the morning. You just have a few hours of the trail before you get to the parking lot where your coworker should be waiting for you.

title: Insanity Within
description:
게임 정보
Step into the shattered mind of a man haunted by his past in this chilling psychological horror puzzle game. Return to the eerie, riddled manor where you once lived with your wife and daughter, a place steeped in tragedy and shadowed by accusations. Imprisoned for a murder you can’t recall committing, you’re drawn back to uncover the truth, battling the relentless grip of schizophrenia that twists your reality with every step.
Navigate a series of mind-bending puzzles that test not just your wits, but your sanity. As your mental health unravels, the world around you distorts and nightmares seep into reality. Scavenge for meds to hold the madness at bay, but time is your enemy, and every moment pushes you closer to the edge.
With each puzzle you conquer, uncover heartfelt letters from your daughter, addressed to you, piecing together the heartbreaking story of your family’s collapse. Search the manor’s forgotten corners for hidden artifacts that reveal its sinister secrets and the fractured memories you’ve buried deep.
As you descend deeper into the manor’s depths, brace yourself for a devastating revelation. This is a journey of guilt, grief, and discovery where every answer comes at a cost.
Other Key Features:
Hidden Artifacts: Search every dark corner of the eerie manor to find optional historic artifacts that were left behind after the family's tragic collapse. Collect them all!
An Immersive Experience: Step into the haunting depths of an abandoned manor, a sprawling, meticulously crafted world brimming with secrets. Explore corridors and hidden rooms, solving intricate puzzles to uncover letters and artifacts that breathe life into the manor’s mysterious past. Every discovery pulls you deeper into a narrative woven through the environment, rewarding your curiosity with a rich, unfolding story.
Interactions: There is no combat, instead Insanity Within thrives on a simple interaction system. Pull rusty levers, shift towering statues, connect celestial constellations, and inspect eerie decor to unlock the manor’s secrets. Medicine offers a lifeline, letting you pause or restore your sanity, but use it wisely. This variety of interactions keeps gameplay dynamic and reinforces the focus on exploration and mental mastery.

title: Prop Haunters
description:
게임 정보
Prop Haunters is a fun and fast-paced multiplayer party game where sneaky props and sharp hunters collide in a whimsical, action-packed showdown! Dive into a vibrant world filled with adorable environments, where you can play as a variety of quirky props trying to outwit a team of determined hunters.
As a prop, disguise yourself as everyday objects, blend into the surroundings, and evade detection with clever tactics and quick reflexes. But watch out—Runes give you the chance to fight back! But don’t get too comfortable—Runes also give hunters a boost based on their play style, such as increased speed for agile hunters or enhanced vision to spot props more easily.
With a focus on teamwork, strategy, and laughs, Prop Haunt brings hours of fun for friends and family alike. Whether you’re hiding or seeking, no two rounds are the same—every game is a new opportunity for chaos and hilarity. So, grab your friends, choose your side, and get ready for the ultimate game of hide and seek in the cutest way possible!
Key Features:
Cute, vibrant graphics that make every round a visual delight.
Multiplayer madness for up to 16 players.
A variety of props to play as, from chairs to teacups, each with its own quirky advantages.
Runes with unique powers, like flashbangs, speed boosts, and temporary invisibility, adding a new layer of strategy to each round.
Boosts for hunters tailored to their play style, helping them track down props with special abilities.
Dynamic environments full of unique hiding spots and surprises.
Fast-paced gameplay that's easy to pick up but hard to master.
Are you ready to haunt the props or hunt the haunters? The power is in your hands!

title: The Witch's Realm
description:
게임 정보
Escape and survive in this supernatural puzzle adventure game where light is your only defense!

Play as a female protagonist that is visiting her grandmother's house where you explore eerie locations, solve escape room-style puzzles, and uncover hidden objects while managing your sanity. Navigate between reality and a twisted ghost dimension while you fend off spirits with your flashlight and unravel the dark history of a cursed town. 
Explore The Witch's Realm
Investigate eerie locations, each hiding secrets and deadly threats:
A Haunted House – The last refuge of a good witch… and now a dangerous trap.
An Abandoned Town – Shrouded in mystery, filled with remnants of a lost past.
A Foggy Graveyard – Where restless spirits linger, guarding hidden truths.
A Twisted Swamp – A dark, shifting maze that distorts reality itself.
Classic Escape Room-Style Puzzles
Hidden objects
Number codes
Riddle solving
Mazes
Managing Your Sanity
The longer you stay in the darkness, the lower your sanity gets
Use Safe Zones to increase your sanity 
The lower your sanity, the more frequent and aggressive ghostly encounters become
Flashlight Mechanic 
Light is your defense against the darkness
Shining it on ghosts will temporarily make them flee or stun them
Ghost Dimension
An alternate dimension filled with supernatural power
Cleanse alters & ritual sites where ghosts use to cross over to the main world

title: Figure Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Figuré Shop Simulator는 자신만의 피규어 가게를 운영하는 재미있고 상세한 비즈니스 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 3D 프린터로 피규어를 제작하고, 선반을 채우고, 가격을 설정하며 고객에게 최고의 쇼핑 경험을 제공합니다.
사업을 성장시키기 위해 창고를 효율적으로 관리하고, 가게를 확장하고, 디자인을 커스터마이즈하세요. 컬렉터를 위한 희귀 피규어를 만들고, 트렌드를 따르며 가장 인기 있는 피규어를 제공하여 수익을 늘리세요.
하지만 조심하세요! 재고 관리, 고객 만족도 및 가격 책정은 성공의 열쇠입니다. 올바른 전략적 결정을 내려서 당신의 가게를 업계의 정상으로 이끌 수 있습니까?
주요 특징:
3D 피규어 제작 및 커스터마이즈
선반 관리, 가격 책정 및 고객 만족도
가게 확장 및 디자인 커스터마이즈
컬렉션 세트 만들기 및 희귀 피규어 발견하기
시장 트렌드를 따르고 베스트셀러 제품을 찾기
가게를 처음부터 만들어 피규어 컬렉션 세계의 최고가 되세요!

title: Secrets of Moon Island
description:
게임 정보
Secrets of Moon Island is an Action Adventure RPG with its own, unique approach to Swordplay.
Discover a mysterious island, fight against vicious monsters, and become stronger during your adventures.
The Secrets of Moon Island is a solo developer project (very indie), programmed from scratch in over 6 years of passionate work. The game tells the story of the last descendants of a once wealthy family who are trying to find out what happened to their long lost ancestor. What will they find?
Key Features
Experience Non Target Based Combat.
The game features its own combat system, the "Fencer Mode".
If your sword connects with an enemies body with sufficient speed, or even if they just run into your sword, they will take damage.
To avoid getting hit and taking damage of your own, simply either move out of the way of the enemies hit or move your weapon in the path you think the opponents weapon will take
In most cases enemies do what is known as telegraphing, they pull their weapon back in the direction they are going to try to hit you from. Use this to parry their weapon. If you have successfully parried an enemy, you will have a small time frame to get in a hit of your own.

title: Plentiful
description:
게임 정보
Shape the world to channel water.
Nurture animals and plants.
Feed your tribe.
A relaxing god game, shaping the map by stacking stones.
Water flows over the landscape and needs to be caught in ponds and lakes.
Trees placed near water will flourish and produce food.
Fruit, Vegetables and Animals are eaten by your tribe of people.
Seasons
Day/night cycle
Water simulation
Stone stacking
Volcanoes, Lightning, Floods, Locusts, Earthquakes, Plagues, Fire

title: Terrors of War
description:
게임 정보
고오캐인, 맥반석 터지는 RTS 어드벤처에 참여하세요! Terrors of War에서는 거대한 군대를 지휘하고 전장에서 전차가 울림을 퍼뜨리며 전략적인 항공 지원으로 하늘을 지배할 수 있습니다. 그러나 화력만큼이나 전략도 중요합니다. 귀하의 공급 라인은 군대의 생명선이며 모든 결정이 중대합니다.



경제는 부차적인 사항뿐만이 아니라 성공의 중추입니다. 기지를 확장하고 게임을 바꾸는 지원을 소환하며 멈출 수 없는 힘을 쌓아나가는 과정에서 각 자원의 무게를 느낄 것입니다.

당신을 숨막히게 만들 준비가 되어 있습니다! 적의 타격에 대항하고 파괴적인 공격을 계획하며 대지를 뒤흔들만한 호출을 일으킬 것입니다. 그리고 이것은 단지 시작일 뿐입니다! Terrors of War는 지속적으로 진화하며 앞으로 더 많은 화려한 특징과 놀라움이 기다리고 있습니다.



이 야심찬 프로젝트의 미래를 형성할 Early Access 여정에 참여하세요. 당신의 피드백, 버그 보고 및 Discord에서의 제안이 게임 개발에 직접적으로 영향을 미쳐 이를 참으로 협업적인 경험으로 만들어 줍니다. 액션에 참여하고 진화의 일부가 되어 함께 전장을 정복합시다!

title: Stash: A Card Looter
description:
게임 정보
Draft Unique Loot
Stash captures the thrill of opening a fresh pack of cards, chasing rare pulls, and uncovering powerful synergies. With an endless variety of unique cards, no two drafts are ever the same. Every decision is a razor-sharp balance between pushing your luck for that perfect chase card and the urgency of locking in a game-changing pick before the next battle begins.
Quick, Intuitive Card Selection
Make quick decisions with intuitive swipe-based card selection that feels just like opening a real pack of cards. Thanks to procedural generation, no two choices are ever the same. But don’t let the smoothness fool you—this is a game of deep strategy
Diverse Card Types
Choose from six distinct card types—heroes, weapons, relics, quests, consumables, and upgrades. Craft unique heroes, build strategic advantages, or grab a quick buff to turn the tide of battle.

title: Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream
description:
게임 정보
모두를 위한 몰입감 넘치는 경험
세심하게 제작된 환경과 맞춤형 사운드 디자인 및 음악을 통해 이 오싹한 이야기에 빠져보세요. 이 1인칭 심리 공포 체험은 비디오 게임을 많이 하지 않거나 공포 장르의 팬이 아니더라도 누구나 즐길 수 있도록 만들어진 독특하고 기억에 남는 모험입니다.
묘하게 익숙한 공포
워커홀릭 시뮬레이터: 리빙 더 드림은 모든 사람이 견뎌야 하는 가장 끔찍한 경험인 일을 통해 현대 세계의 어둠을 탐구합니다. 직장인이라면 이미 매일 직면하는 주제이지만, 이 게임은 이 잘 알려진 환경을 비틀어 초현실적인 경험으로 만듭니다. 결코 같은 방식으로 직장을 볼 수 없을 것입니다!
악몽인가요, 현실인가요?
이 환각의 복도와 리미널 복도에서 무엇을 발견할지 결코 예상할 수 없습니다. 이 소외된 공간을 걷는 동안 구석구석에 무엇이 숨어 있을지 누가 알 수 있을까요?
게임 중에는 음성이나 텍스트가 거의 사용되지 않기 때문에 게임의 스토리는 플레이어가 풀어나가야 합니다. 모든 내레이션은 분위기와 환경의 디테일을 통해 이루어집니다.
오직 재치와 순발력만이 이 미묘한 세계를 탈출할 수 있기 때문에 상상할 수 없는 상황에 대비해야 합니다.

title: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
Beyond the jagged seas lies the the land of Dragaea, you arrived on it's shores called by a mysterious force in a dream to discover it's secrets and become a legend in your own right. Legends of Dragaea is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler, where you form parties of heroes and plumb mysterious dungeons in search of glory, wealth, and loot.




Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is inspired by classic JRPGs distilling down the essence to it's roots as an idle dungeon crawler. Discover unique locations, visit the Adventurer's Guild and tear quests from the quest board advancing through the tiered ranking system reaping greater rewards. Encounter dangerous enemies that will test your might, and confront calamitous bosses.



With 18 skills dedicated to combat for a robust free-form skill system including melee, ranged, and magic characters allowing you to specialize your heroes any way you wish. Augment your team with over 25+ abilities each like Bonk, Fissure, and Life Steal, using any 4 abilities in any combination you choose. As you explore Dragaea you will be able to recruit new party members to aid you in your journey forming multiple teams of 3 to explore dungeons and tackle challenges becoming the finest adventuring guild in all the land.



The land of Dragaea is a place filled mystery, intrigue, and precious treasure. Collect and upgrade over 200+ pieces of weapons, armor, accessories, items, and other consumables to augment your party's prowess. No two pieces of equipment are the same with different rarities and stats affecting the possibilities. Found a favorite axe or staff? Upgrade it to it's max potential and give your adventurers the finest tools to do the job. A full featured inventory system and shop system lets you manage your collections effortlessly.

title: City of Ashes
description:
게임 정보
A brutal post-apocalyptic fighting game set in the ruins of civilization. Fight to survive. Fight to rescue. Fight for redemption.

About This GameStep into the decaying streets of a ruined metropolis in City of Ashes, a visceral third-person isometric fighting game where every punch, kick, and improvised weapon strike carries weight. Set in a post-apocalyptic world where a devastating pandemic and the collapse of governments have plunged humanity into chaos, you play as a former MMA fighter searching for his kidnapped daughter in a city overrun by cannibalistic gangs.
Face brutal hand-to-hand combat as you fight through deranged enemies, gang leaders, and their twisted arenas to rescue the only family you have left.

Game Pillars
Melee Combat with Combos
Master a dynamic melee combat system designed for fluidity and impact. Chain powerful combos, block and counter attacks, and adapt to enemy fighting styles in adrenaline-fueled encounters.
Special Melee Abilities
Unleash devastating special attacks to turn the tide of combat. From crushing takedowns to cinematic finishing moves, your skills will evolve with your journey.
RPG Progression System
Level up your fighter with a straightforward RPG system. Unlock new moves, enhance your stats, and customize your combat style to suit your playstyle.
Loot and Improvised Weapons
Scavenge the urban wasteland for gear and loot to upgrade your abilities. Use improvised weapons—pipes, bats, crowbars, and more—to gain an edge in battle.
Photorealistic Environment
Explore a hauntingly beautiful post-apocalyptic world brought to life with photorealistic visuals. Every ruined street, crumbling skyscraper, and derelict arena immerses you in a gripping atmosphere of decay and danger.

A Story of Survival and Vengeance
In the aftermath of a global pandemic and government collapse, you’ve struggled to survive with your daughter. But when a cannibalistic gang ambushes you and kidnaps her, your world is shattered. Fueled by desperation and rage, you’ll stop at nothing to bring her back—even if it means taking on the city’s most feared gang in their blood-soaked arena.

title: Heir to the Queen
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
RPG Maker VX Ace로 제작된 미스터리 어드벤처 게임입니다.
시놉시스
평범한 여고생 야무는 우연한 계기로 고대 이집트의 여이 될 자격을 얻게 된다.
하지만 왕좌에 오르기 위해서는 수수께끼로 가득 찬 관문을 통과해야만 한다.
그러나 이곳에는 그녀를 시험하는 정체 모를 존재들이 기다리고 있다.
미지의 공간에서 펼쳐지는 퍼즐, 탐험, 생존의 여정...
과연 야무는 모든 시련을 극복하고 진정한 여왕이 될 수 있을까?
게임 특징
퍼즐 & 탐험: 알 수 없는 공간을 탐색하며 단서를 찾고 퍼즐을 풀어야 한다.
미스터리한 분위기: 신비롭고 긴장감 넘치는 스토리 전개.
생존 요소: 정체 모를 미지의 존재들을 피해 살아남아야 한다.
귀여운 픽셀 아트: 아기자기한 도트 그래픽과 개성 넘치는 캐릭터 디자인.

title: Stone Age
description:
게임 정보
원시 세계에서 생존하고 발전하는 서사시적인 여행을 시작하세요! 생존, 탐험, 전략이 결합된 이 독특한 게임에서, 당신은 부족을 인도하여 위험한 포식자들을 사냥하고, 자원을 모으며, 정착지를 건설하고 확장합니다. 인류의 생존을 보장하고 기술을 발전시키세요.
주요 특징:
다이나믹한 생존 도전: 호랑이, 악어, 곰 등 위험한 포식자들과 싸우며, 각기 다른 행동과 전리품을 얻습니다.
자원 관리: 중요한 자원을 수집하고, 식물을 재배하고, 자원을 거래하여 부족을 성장시킵니다.
기술 발전: 기본적인 불 사용에서부터 발전된 대피소와 방어 시스템까지 다양한 기술을 해제하여 부족의 진화를 이끕니다.
정착지 건설: 기능과 미학을 균형 있게 결합하여 번창하는 공동체를 만들 수 있습니다.
놀라운 탐험: 숨겨진 자원, 신비로운 동굴, 고대의 비밀이 가득한 지역을 탐험하세요.
풍부한 경제: 고기, 가죽, 공예품과 같은 자원을 수집하고 거래하여 부족의 성장을 촉진합니다.
전략적 깊이: 부족의 확장을 계획하고, 위협으로부터 보호하며, 현명한 결정을 내려 생존을 확보합니다.
도구를 만들거나, 정착지를 관리하거나, 자연과 싸우는 동안 당신의 선택은 부족의 운명을 결정짓습니다. 당신의 부족을 이끌고, 세상을 창조할 준비가 되셨나요?

title: My Hidden Pets: Find My Duck
description:
게임 정보


Get ready to go on an exciting adventure in search of pretty ducks in an amazing city! Find all the hidden ducks in this colorful game, and restore peace to the city.

Game Features:

A wide variety of different ducks to find
Unique art style
Simple yet memorable storyline

Good Duck!

Sneaky Snitch by Kevin MacLeod

title: Nihongo Quest
description:
게임 정보



Learn Japanese through gaming! Nihongo Quest is a colorful JRPG that will teach you over 1000 Japanese words and characters! Explore the world of Gakushū as you battle, race, and draw your way to victory!


Learn over 1500 words and characters! This game teaches you up to the N5 level of the JLPT! (with hopefully more to come!)
Battle wild characters, students, and evil forces using the Japanese learned in the game!
Play through an engaging story as you learn Japanese!
Write out the characters that you learn to practice handwriting!
Create your own towns using your own vocabulary list!
Race against the clock in various mini-games to reinforce your learning!
Review using an automatically created, personalized review schedule to help you retain what you learn!
Customize your character with character skins!

title: Roll The Bones
description:
게임 정보
Let's roll them bones!
In this high-paced, action-packed roguelite you will need to carefully choose a loadout of spell dice to beat each dungeon floor.
Pave your way through 15 unique dungeon floors filled with bloodthirsty enemies!
What's the deal with dice?
Each die has 6 sides and possibly up to 6 different spells. Some are good, some are terrible and some will straight up annihilate the enemies (or even yourself).
Choosing dice that play well against specific dungeon floors is the key to success.

title: Golel
description:
게임 정보
Golel은 턴 기반 액션과 타일 기반 이동을 특징으로 하는 1인칭 던전 크롤러 RPG입니다.
전투는 이동과 환경을 유리하게 활용하는 것에 중점을 두고 있습니다.
Golel은 소름 끼치는 분위기의 불길한 다크 판타지 게임입니다.
비정상적인 영역으로의 발걸음
당신은 자신의 환상에 시달리는 강렬한 전사로서, 다른 인간들이 감히 들어서지 못하는 곳으로 자발적으로 모험을 떠납니다.
적대적인 몬스터와 환경에 많이 마주치겠지만, 당신의 여정에 도움을 줄 수도, 주지 않을 수도 있는 비적대적 존재도 만나게 될 것입니다.
각각의 플레이는 독특하며 다양한 도전, 장애물, 보상을 제공합니다.
다양한 기술을 사용하고 환경에 의지하여 우위를 점해야 합니다.
해골에게 책장을 떨어뜨리거나, 좀비를 가시에 밀어 넣거나, 당신을 사냥하는 몬스터가 따라올 수 없기를 바라며 좁은 통로로 도망갈 수도 있습니다.
이동이 중요하며, 환경의 전술적 활용에 의지해야 합니다. 기본 능력치만으로는 생존할 수 없습니다.
캐릭터 개발은 수백 가지의 다양한 기술, 통계 및 빌드 경로로 구성됩니다.
다양한 기술과 무기가 각기 다른 플레이 스타일을 열어줍니다.
세상은 비선형적이며, 이동할 장소를 선택할 자유가 주어집니다.
은 30시간의 메인 캠페인을 제공합니다.
수많은 기술, 무기, 속성의 조합은 매우 다양한 플레이 스타일을 허용합니다.
각 무기는 고유한 전투 재능과 전술을 가지고 있습니다.

주문 시전자가 될 수도 있고, 전사와 주문 시전자의 혼합이 될 수도 있습니다.
이로 인해 캠페인을 다양한 방식으로 완료할 수 있습니다.

일부 요소는 무작위로 생성되는 반면, 다른 요소는 독특한 레벨 디자인을 제공하기 위해 수작업으로 제작됩니다.
또한, 메인 캠페인을 완료한 후에는 완전히 절차적으로 생성되는 도전 모드를 끝없이 플레이할 수 있습니다.

title: SOS: Forgotten Planet
description:
게임 정보
SOS: Forgotten Planet is an Educational Survival Horror with Roguelike elements where you learn Morse Code. You play as Clara Redmont, the grand-daughter of the man who ordered the complete an utter destruction of the planet Ouro. Looking for answers Clara goes to the planet and finds the world still very much alive. The labs of Ouro and the cause of their destruction are procedurally generated allowing for lots of replayability.
This game will teach you Morse Code in both inputting and listening. Use Morse Code to open doors and interact with the environment. Listen to and decode it to open chests to get the items needed to survive. The game can accommodate total newcomers to Morse Code and experienced vets with difficulty options that you can increase as you get more familiar with it.
Every level is procedurally generated, meaning that no playthrough will be the same. You’ll have to navigate your way through various zones of a destroyed lab avoiding and sometimes fighting various monsters along the way. There is also a mystery to uncover of how the world came to be destroyed but the cause is different each time. You will have to uncover clues and use your skills of deduction in order to find out the truth.

title: Nomori
description:
게임 정보


Nomori is a gorgeous and heartfelt adventure puzzle game that puts the power of time and space in your hands. As Kiko, players will venture into a vividly rendered fantasy world full of colorful and eccentric spirits, where she will learn to see the world from exciting new perspectives. As Kiko comes into her own and bonds with the Spirits, she will see beyond the limits of reality and save Nomori.

Change Your Reality
Place, shift, and rotate portals to change the gravity direction of objects and even yourself.
Make clever use of portals to reach new places! Try to challenge your understanding of the world’s physical limits.
Use your spirit powers to influence the world around you. Control the flow of time and rotate the forces of gravity to solve mind-bending environmental puzzles!

title: Be Honest
description:
게임 정보
Be Honest is a horror personality quiz. It starts out innocent and slowly becomes c̸͕̃o̴̧͎̝͋r̵̻̪̚͠r̶̢͎͠ṷ̶̃̚p̸̛̳͆͘ṱ̵̞̉̇̃e̵̡̞̦̐d̶͎͌̈̈́.
Features:
Introspective questions that will teach you about yourself.
4 Good Endings
4 Bad Endings
1 Secret Ending
Images with the correct number of eyeballs.

title: Always With You 與貓同行
description:
게임 정보
"고양이와 함께하는 여정" 은 용감하고 영리한 소녀가 엄마를 찾기 위해 떠나는 액션 어드벤처 퍼즐 게임입니다.
고대 문명이 신비로운 부름을 보냈습니다. 주인공은 개성 넘치는 세 마리의 고양이와 함께 유적을 탐험하며, 소녀와 고양이를 번갈아 조작하여 돌을 밀고 틈새를 통과하며 협력해 수많은 장애물을 극복합니다.
울창한 숲을 지나고 깊은 바다로 잠수하며, 알토 문명을 방문해 숨겨진 비밀을 찾아보세요.
정교하게 설계된 40가지 이상의 퍼즐과 기믹이 당신의 지혜와 관찰력을 시험합니다.
세 마리의 특별한 고양이를 조작하여 각자의 능력을 활용해 장애물을 극복하세요!
autokwd: Always With You 與貓同行

title: Who Is Ethan?
description:
게임 정보
"Who is Ethan?"은 1~4인 온라인 협동 심리 공포 게임입니다. 공포는 모든 그림자 속에 도사리고 있습니다.
당신은 버려진 병원에서 눈을 뜹니다. 혼란스럽고 혼자라고 느끼지만… 무언가가 지켜보고 있습니다.
팀원들과 협력하여 암호 같은 단서를 해독하고, 으스스한 복도를 탐험하며, 이 벽들 속에 숨겨진 왜곡된 진실을 밝혀내세요.
하지만 기억하세요… 어떤 질문은 절대 답하지 않는 것이 좋습니다.
🔪 악몽 속에서 살아남을 수 있을까요? 🔪
주요 특징:
👥 1~4인 협동 플레이: 친구들과 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 공포에 맞서세요.
🕵️ 깊이 있는 미스터리 & 조사: 불안한 퍼즐을 풀고 진실을 조각 맞추세요.
👻 적응형 AI & 예측 불가능한 위협: 매번 다른 경험이 펼쳐집니다.
🔊 몰입형 3D 사운드 디자인: 삐걱이는 소리, 속삭임, 발소리 하나하나가 위험일 수 있습니다.
🕯️ 제한된 자원 & 영구 죽음: 당신의 모든 선택이 마지막일 수 있습니다. 신중하게 결정하세요.
당신은 이 병원을 탈출할 수 있을까요… 아니면 그 전설의 일부가 될까요?

title: The Czar is Dead 2
description:
게임 정보
The Czar is Dead 2 is a first-person rpg-shooter that tells the story of Nikolai Romanov's fight against the Communists and Anglo-Saxon invaders. The Czar managed to save himself from being shot, but the little Czesarevich was kidnapped by the villains and taken to an unknown destination. Will the former Emperor manage to save his son, atone for his sins and win the civil war? It depends only on you.

The game is in active development, the estimated release date is the second half of 2025.

title: Bound: Gulag Getaway
description:
게임 정보
Bound: Gulag Getaway
Escape the slammer in this frantic 4-player co-op adventure! Race against your friends though the gulag, dodging bumbling guards and causing mayhem along the way
Key Features:
Unique procedural animation system for hilariously unpredictable movements
4-player competitive co-op - first one out wins!
Retro-inspired pixel graphics
Dynamic environments filled with usable objects
Outwit and outmaneuver AI-driven drunk guards
Squeeze through vents, and improvise your escape
Grab whatever you can find to slow down guards and sabotage other players. Will you form alliances or betray your fellow inmates? In Bound: Gulag Getaway, freedom is just a stumble away!

title: Track Racing: The Holy Rosary
MustScream
description:
게임 정보
Mysterious deaths kept happening, and then suddenly, a suburban hospital shut down.
As a journalist, you step into the abandoned hospital to uncover the truth.
Scattered throughout the hospital are 10 medical records. Collect them and find your way out.
But there’s one problem… You’re a total coward.
The only way to run is to scream and force yourself forward.
Shout your way to the finish!
Game Features
🔊 Mic Input
Scream into your mic to run.
Running away from enemies by actually screaming makes the experience even more immersive.
(You can play without a mic, but you won’t be able to run, making the game much harder.)
(Normal movement is done with WASD.)
🌍 Online Multiplayer
Play with up to 4 players!
Scream together with your friends.
🎙 Proximity Voice Chat
Talk to your friends while playing.
If you hear a scream in the distance… run for your life!

title: A Hole In My Room
description:
게임 정보
When I woke up, I noticed a strange hole in the ceiling of my room...
My name is James. I don’t know why I’m here, nor do I know what’s behind this door! I’m trapped in a colorless space with strange lines an environment that resembles my room, except with a hole in the ceiling. A strange object covers the hole to keep the light from coming in. The only thing I know is that I’m not alone here!
Are you ready to experience a dark, intricate atmosphere? Explore strange, dark spaces, solve puzzles, and use different items to unlock doors. But remember, you’re not alone! So, hide whenever you sense danger. Find a way out as quickly as possible, before the strange, dark creature finds you!

title: Adrenaline Overdrive
description:
게임 정보
In an alternate 1980s where North Korea won their war, Brooklyn lies in ruins. The streets are controlled by the Vires syndicate, operating under the facade of Virical Corporations. As a former detective whose brother was murdered while investigating Virical Corporations, you've made a fatal choice: injecting yourself with ISS, a deadly military-grade stimulant that grants superhuman abilities at the cost of your life.
KEY FEATURES:
• MASTER SUPERNATURAL MOVEMENT
Run, jump, and slide as you tear through urban battlegrounds. Your enhanced abilities make you unstoppable - if you can stay alive long enough to use them.
• EXPLORE A FRACTURED CITY
From neon-lit corporate towers to abandoned subway tunnels, every corner of this alternate Brooklyn tells a story of war, corruption, and resistance.

title: Code Quest
description:
게임 정보
Fix the world. Learn to code. Uncover the truth.
In Code Quest, you step into the role of a mysterious character tasked with restoring order to a broken digital world. Journey through diverse locations – from enchanted forests and futuristic cities to a cosmic space station and the heart of a computer itself – solving increasingly complex programming puzzles along the way.
With a unique Scratch-like programming interface, you'll learn fundamental coding concepts such as:
Building sequences of instructions
Loops and logical conditions
Managing variables and data flow
Optimizing algorithms
Every level presents a new challenge that requires creativity and problem-solving skills. As you fix the world, you'll watch it transform before your eyes, uncovering hidden secrets and mastering the art of programming.

Key Features:
Learn through play: No coding experience required!
Scratch-like interface: Intuitive tools to build and test your code step by step.
Diverse worlds: Explore forests, cities, space stations, and the inner workings of a computer.
Engaging story: Discover the mysteries of the broken world and your role within it.
Progressive challenges: Puzzles that grow in complexity as you advance, introducing new programming concepts.

Code Quest is perfect for everyone – from beginners eager to learn the basics of coding to experienced players looking for a unique challenge. Can you repair the digital world and uncover the truth behind its fractured surface?
Add Code Quest to your wishlist today and begin your journey into the world of coding!

title: Knight of Nevermore
description:
게임 정보
Knight of Nevermore is a 2D roguelike action-platformer featuring challenging souls-inspired combat, corridors covered in spikes, and an item pool filled with combos and synergies.
Made for Replayability
Each time you enter Nevermore, it's ever-changing levels offer a unique selection of items, weapons and spells. Become a mighty fighter, cast powerful spells, or scale your stats to godlike strength - every run presents different build possibilities.
Challenging Combat
The denizens of Nevermore won't go down without a fight! Your enemies have a variety of attacks at their disposal, and you'll need to defend yourself accordingly. Triumph in battle by learning enemy move-sets and keeping your wits sharp.
Meaningful Choices
Sculpt your build with powerful synergies and manage your resources carefully. Should you reroll an item, or should you use the healing fountain before the next fight? You can't have it all, so choose wisely.
Rich in Gameplay, Light in Story

title: Merchants of Dark
description:
게임 정보
최대 3명의 친구들과 함께 신비로운 검은 함대를 위해 금지된 보물을 찾아 불길한 바다로 모험을 떠나세요. 파도 아래에서 잠복하고 있는 것들로부터 살아남을 수 있을까요?

title: RANGER COMMANDO
description:
게임 정보
Always wanted to feel like an '80s action hero? Take down a global terrorist organization?
Now you can!
Explore Random Generated Missions
Assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up - complete a variety of dynamic objectives. No handholding, but easy to pick up! Every playthrough brings a fresh challenge with diverse terrains and layouts.
Bring Total Destruction
Unload an arsenal of high-powered weapons, raining bullets and explosions on everything in sight. Make it personal!
Complete Missions Your Way
Whether you prefer stealth or full-frontal chaos, tackle objectives in your own style. 
What to Expect?
Ranger Commando is a small game for quick, replayable fun - no complex progression or roguelike mechanics to worry about. A campaign consists of 10 missions played in various locations around the world.
Tactical gameplay, with light stealth mechanics.
Perfect for a quick, stress-relieving session after a long day.
Every mission is less than 8 minutes!

Solo dev project, please be gentle 🙏
About World Peace Industries
Once a trusted private military contractor and leading weapon manufacturer, World Peace Industries has now become a global threat. Hired to protect nations, it has gone rogue, amassing power and constructing fortified bases worldwide.
Believing they are the only force capable of maintaining global stability, they will go to any lengths to impose order - no matter the cost. Their actions grow more ruthless with each passing day.

title: Ultima Chess VR
description:
게임 정보
Ultima Chess VR은(는) 전략과 짜릿한 VR 액션이 결합된 새로운 형태의 게임으로, 판타지 세계인 Ultima에서 펼쳐집니다. 전략을 완전히 새로운 차원에서 경험하세요. 모든 수가 서사적인 충돌이 됩니다. 당신의 말들은 전사와 마법 생명체로 생명을 얻고, 체스판 위의 전투는 특수 효과, 애니메이션, 실시간 해설로 가득합니다. 이것은 단순한 체스 게임이 아닙니다 – 가상 현실 속에서 펼쳐지는 진정한 두뇌와 근육의 격돌입니다.
핵심 메커니즘:
✔ 현대적인 그래픽의 클래식 체스
✔ 데스크탑 및 VR 지원
✔ 세 가지 보기 모드: 탑다운, 세계 속 시점, 미니맵을 통한 시점
✔ 시각적으로 놀라운 체스 덱 보드 12종 + 미니멀한 보드 3종
✔ 고유한 체스 말 72종
✔ 상세한 세계관이 담긴 스토리 캠페인
✔ AI 대전(Stockfish)
✔ 멀티플레이어
✔ 래피드, 블리츠, 불릿, 개인 맞춤 모드
✔ 체스 변형 모드: 960 & 피셔 랜덤, 안개 전쟁(Fog of War), 버그하우스, 킹 오브 더 힐, 3체크 체스

title: Synthetic Hopes
description:
게임 정보
Synthetic Hopes는 독창적이고 시스템적인 메커니즘과 몇몇 플랫포밍 액션 시퀀스가 결합된 퍼즐 게임입니다. 안드로이드가 노예로 전락한 사이버펑크 세계에서, 당신은 마침내 자유를 얻을 수 있는 기회를 잡은 첫 번째 세대 모델입니다.
빛을 피해 전진하세요. 요소들을 주워 새로운 혼합물을 만드세요. 장애물을 제거하고 없는 길을 만드세요. 세상의 방식을 배우고 어쩌면 순환을 끊을 기회를 잡을 수 있을지도 모릅니다!
특징
색상과 물질의 상태를 혼합하여 해결해야 하는 150개 이상의 퍼즐과 다양한 시스템적 메커니즘.
퍼즐을 배우고 해결하는 데 대부분의 시간을 보낼 수 있도록 하는 관대한 플랫포밍 및 체크포인트 시스템.
의미, 회복력, 그리고 압도적인 상황에 맞서는 이야기.
희망과 디스토피아를 동시에 담은 사이버펑크 분위기를 자아내는 오리지널 아트와 사운드트랙.

title: Sunken Engine
description:
게임 정보
러브크래프트 스타일의 트위스트가 가미된 조선소
Sunken Engine은 러브크래프트의 분위기를 지닌 선박 수리 시뮬레이터입니다. 아버지의 비극적인 죽음 후, 당신은 가족의 사업을 이어받아 운영해야 합니다. 이는 고객을 만족시키고 마을의 질서를 유지하는 일을 의미합니다. 그러나 새로운 배가 도착할 때마다 새로운 도전과 미스터리가 기다리고 있습니다.
러브크래프트식 공포
당신이 겪는 사건들은 정신 건강에 위협을 줄 수 있습니다. 이는 당신의 일을 어렵게 만들거나 어두운 존재들을 끌어들일 수 있습니다. 당신은 사업을 계속 운영하면서 정신을 유지할 방법을 찾아야 합니다.

title: Deus Proxy
description:
게임 정보
A New Kind of Auto Battler

Deus Proxy is a roguelike that brings together the most exciting aspects of new-school auto battlers and old-school tabletop gaming. Every game is a completely new adventure with 15 factions, human opponents, and hundreds of heroes, items, traits, and spells!
Asynchronous Multiplayer

In Deus Proxy you play through hand-crafted PvE and one-of-a-kind PvP encounters. Any army that wins a PvP encounter becomes an adversary in other player’s games. You see the enemy armies before picking your cards and designing your own army, which rewards drafting a diverse deck to counter the challenges you might face instead of playing the most "meta" cards.
Comprehensive In-Game Information

Tired of "wiki games" that require you to constantly alt-tab to see what a powerup does? Every spell, item, hero, unit, trait, buff, faction and game mechanic is explained in a searchable in-game compendium. When designing your army, an overlay tool is present to quickly view any stat of every unit on the field. Within seconds you can discover ways to counter your opponent.
Endless Theorycrafting

Every game of Deus Proxy is a possibility to try new strategies and find new synergies! There are no implicit faction bonuses, all bonuses come from items and spells related to that faction. Your plant-based army might focus on empowering ranged units to entangle far-away targets, giving army-wide regeneration bonuses to make your treants walking tanks, or just being immune to the acid rain your mage caused. Because you have 1-3 battles per turn, it is vital to keep your armies adaptable for each new challenge!

Heroes can equip any item that you obtain, and can cast any spell they have the slightest proficiency to cast. A huge variety of builds are possible, and the traits and stats a hero has are only a suggestion of what they're capable of when properly equipped.

title: Eclipse of Elysium
description:
게임 정보










In Eclipse of Elysium, you step into the shoes of 21-year-old Aria. At first glance, she appears to be a young, unassuming woman who wouldn't harm a fly. But appearances can be deceiving. In reality, Aria is a biological weapon, deployed on the most dangerous missions in Eldora. Will you guide Aria to become a guardian angel, protecting the innocent, or a ruthless assassin fulfilling the orders of the powerful and wealthy?



Aria's emotional landscape is turbulent at best. Impulsive, fierce, and often consumed by rage, she embodies the unpredictability of a storm. However, like the calm after a tempest, she can also exhibit kindness and a willingness to aid those around her. The emotional path Aria treads is yours to shape. Will you navigate her through the darkness with a compassionate heart, or will rage be her guide? The choice is yours.



Serving the "Python Network," one of the most critical intelligence services of the Republic, Aria operates in the shadows. She's the one called upon when danger looms, or when tasks demand a leap outside the boundaries of legality. Her hands are the ones that get dirty, fighting battles unseen and undertaking missions that others dare not whisper about.

At the helm of Aria's assignments is Liaison Officer Krall, a member of the Scalekrin—an ancient race of lizard people long oppressed. Krall has climbed the ranks through sheer determination and now stands as a pivotal figure within the Python Network. His loyalty to the organization is unwavering, and he will do whatever it takes to secure his standing, guiding Aria through the network's dark web of intrigue and espionage.



In this shadowed world, every decision, every alliance, and every battle shapes the destiny not only of Aria but also of Eldora itself. What will your choices reveal?





Charon, was once among the most influential figures in Endora. As the chief advisor to the Merchants' Guild, his knowledge, experience, and wisdom were highly valued, and his counsel was eagerly sought after.



However, those who knew him witnessed Charon's gradual descent into madness, a process that began when he started investigating the origins of the mysterious Conflux. This dangerous organism relentlessly spreads across the world, engulfing villages, cities, and even entire kingdoms in its path.

Charon's intent was to halt this threat, leading him to the ruins of ancient civilizations. Yet, as his investigations deepened, he became increasingly reticent and enveloped in secrets. Five years ago, Charon vanished from the public eye. Now, he has reemerged, leading a mysterious order that is working to accelerate the growth of the Conflux.



To be honest, I'm a newcomer in the video game industry. I've been gaming since I commandeered my sister's Super Nintendo at the age of 10. But the dream of developing my own video game only took hold three years ago when I tried out Unreal Engine for the first time and quickly realized the boundless possibilities it offers.



My dream is to create a game that merges the best of two worlds. I'd like to combine the charm and pathos of a JRPG like Xenoblade with the vast freedom of choice found in Western RPGs like Baldur's Gate. The adventure should be easily accessible. There are no complex mechanics preventing you from quickly getting into the game. I also want to avoid grinding that unnecessarily prolongs playtime.

I aim to create a cinematic work that takes players on an emotional journey, presenting them with tough emotional choices and introducing them to charming and complex characters.

title: House Of Decay
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the demons world! I don't know how you managed to get here, but it was a stupid idea on your part. It's a shame your brother was taken by demons, but do you really think you'll be able to find him? Is it really worth it? Well, it's none of my business. All you have to do is explore this wonderful world, and who knows, maybe you'll survive or even meet someone.
FEATURES:


- 3D action platformer metroidvania!
- The character visually changes with every upgrades you find!
- As many as 8 locations to explore



- Responsive controls
- Coolest retro visual style
- Variety of mobs on the locations



- Many secrets to find
- Different types of upgrades
- Ability to collect pets



- Purchasing of customization items for player and pets from the merchant (skins, hats).
- Excellent optimization
- Full support for gamepad and steamdeck controls

title: Catale
