title: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
description:
게임 정보
"Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers" is a 2.5D pixel roguelike action game. It tells the adventure story of Flandre Scarlet.
In this game, you can enjoy exhilarating combat and the thrill of countering enemies. It's a game where you only need to wield a single melee weapon to experience a variety of different skills.
You can trigger skills by defeating enemies or counter their abilities, which in turn generates new skills.
Whether it's the Spell Card skills triggered by defeating enemies or the countered enemy abilities, you can modify them using enhancement cards. This adds layers of depth to the gameplay, making the experience much richer.
autokwd: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers,东方祈妖录

title: Saw Counter
description:
게임 정보
The killer is here, and now he's coming for you!!
He will put you through trials, play with your emotions, your mind, and your body. Are you ready?
Do you remember those horror movies where you yelled at the protagonist to scream, run, and call the police? Well… Now it's your turn to be the protagonist. Test your endurance, your mind, and your feelings.
Uncover the story through its endings—why did the killer come for you? Why are you strapped to that chair? And why a saw?
A short game, a short story—but just enough to keep you entertained for a while.

A horror game that’s also a clicker.
Unique events as you fight to survive.
Polished, carefully crafted graphics.
Not too many puzzles, but just the right amount.

title: Gambonanza
description:
게임 정보
Experience a Chess Revolution
Step into the wild world of Gambonanza, where traditional chess is reimagined into a fast-paced, strategy-packed roguelike adventure. In this game, victory isn’t about capturing just the king—it’s about capturing every single piece on the board through masterful synergies!
About Gambonanza
Inspired by classic chess yet bursting with innovative twists, Gambonanza challenges you to think creatively and strategically. Every run is a fresh puzzle, where your decisions, tactics, and the perfect synergy between your chess pieces and Gambits determine your success. Assemble your ultimate strategy by:
Unlocking Gambits: Discover over 100+ powerful Gambits that, when combined with your chess pieces, create explosive combos capable of outsmarting even the toughest opponents.
Mastering Chess Mechanics: Learn to utilize a dynamic reserve system that lets you store extra chess pieces off-board and deploy them at the perfect moment to catch your adversary off guard.
Upgrading Your Board: Customize your chessboard with unique tiles—turn pieces into gold with shimmering golden squares to boost your income, recover captured pieces with blessing tiles, or safeguard your moves with protective tiles for daring, decisive maneuvers.
Every element of Gambonanza works in harmony to help you build the ultimate strategy to overcome five formidable though bosses!
Key Features
Synergistic Gambits & Pieces: Combine your chess pieces with over 100+ Gambits to unlock devastating combos and strategic surprises.
Dynamic Reserve System: Keep a stock of extra pieces off-board and deploy them at crucial moments to shift the balance of power.
Strategic Board Upgrades: Enhance your chessboard with golden squares, blessing tiles, protective surfaces, and more—each adding a unique tactical edge.
Retro Aesthetic & Quirky Ambiance: Immerse yourself in vibrant pixel art with a nostalgic CRT filter, evoking the playful excitement of a fairground.
Engaging Mini-Games: Test your luck and skill in challenges inspired by pachinko, slot machines, and Gachapon—each offering game-changing upgrades.

title: Vastophobia
description:
게임 정보
Vastophobia is a new game about exploring liminal and strange space's , focusing on atmosphere and mild threats (no jump scares here). Find out why you are here. where is your family. make your way through varied and disturbing environments. 
Use tools to evade enemies. no jump scares. you will always be able to see or hear the threats first
World Story , follow how you arrived here. what happened to you and where is your family.
Vastophbia is an early access game which focus's on atmosphere and soundscapes.
venture into the strange world of the In-Between and try to return to your family
Music By Scott Buckley - Composer

title: Drops of Death
description:
게임 정보

Drops of Death is a murder mystery visual novel where the killer is randomly chosen at the start of the game.

Featuring four dateable characters, this romantic story has a deadly twist: you may unknowingly fall in love with the killer. Not all love is innocent, and it’s up to you to decide if you can look past their actions or bring them to justice.

Drops of Death is a killer romance not for the faint of heart.


Adrien is a college student trying to destress from classes by going to the school’s pool. What should’ve been a relaxing nightly swim quickly turns into a bloody nightmare when a hooded killer emerges. Adrien barely manages to escape the killer’s clutches. Traumatized and with the case ongoing, Adrien can’t help but feel the killer is watching them, waiting to finish what they started.

Choose your pronouns, with the option to choose between two different appearances for Adrien.




Edwin is Adrien’s best friend and a fellow marketing major, who is part of an active campus fraternity. He can be very protective of Adrien’s well-being and has walked them home to ensure their safety a number of times. However, Edwin has shown extreme bouts of jealousy when Adrien displays the slightest interest in others.

Would a best friend really go to such lengths to "protect" someone they hold so dear?


Fawn is an energetic and knowledgeable detective who runs her own true crime blog called Fawning for Crime. Though she can be annoying (especially to Detective Singh), she loves talking about a killer’s motive and unsolved cases. Some may say her passion for crime is a bit…unhinged.

Could this cute and bubbly true crime lover really be capable of murder?


Natasha is a quiet college student who was on the school’s swim team until she was advised to leave for unknown reasons. The experience she had with her teammates wasn’t pleasant and led to her being distant and at arm's length with others—except her older brother, Anton.

Can grudges with old teammates be strong enough to kill?


Nick Singh is a young homicide detective in charge of leading the murder investigation. Growing up he always wanted to be a detective, and eventually he started his career in his hometown, but was relocated to this smaller suburb. Up until now, he’s been forced to do paperwork and small, uninteresting cases.

Would a man who vowed to protect others really commit such a horrendous crime?

title: Birthday Boy and Benny
description:
게임 정보
Birthday Boy and Benny is an emotional turn-based RPG set in a colorful world with strange characters that may be even stranger than you first realize. Everything seems so familiar to you - before you were born, you saw your whole life flash before your eyes, just like what happens when you die.
You expected your life to be full of hearing Dad Jokes from everyone. You expected your life to be about writing haikus, eating lots of cakes on your birthday, and maybe exploring some haunted houses every once in a while.
You didn't expect to be abused by your mentally-ill mother. She wishes you were never born. Everything you do annoys her. She hates that you love cake. She hates it when you cry. She hates that you write haikus.
Please, Mother, don't hit me
Again. The sting of hundreds
Of bees is too much.
But...
Maybe things can be okay. Maybe your friends will protect you. Maybe you can finally get away from her once and for all.
Maybe...

title: Tower Runner
description:
게임 정보
Fight your way up the Tinkerer's tower, facing dangers as he tries to stop you, discover new abilities, and loot as you ascend to the top.
Tower Runner is a medieval-themed, infinite runner. Dive deep into the tower's lore, why it is here, how it is still standing, and who is its master.

title: Death Blonde
description:
게임 정보
Death Blonde is a team-based online car arena shooter where style meets destruction. Customise your ride, join online battles, and leave your enemies in the dust. Drive fast, shoot hard, and wear fashion - because even death deserves style.
The "Death Blonde" is the legendary car driven by the infamous skeleton racer Ken K. King, better known as "Triple K." For over 20 years, Triple K and his iconic car have ruled the deadly racing scene, becoming symbols of unmatched skill, speed, and style. Now, every driver dreams of surpassing the legend in J-City, the hub of high-stakes racing.
This universe revolves entirely around the races and vehicle production. Metroil handles mechanical assembly, while Perfectia drives technological innovation, making speed and progress the pillars of its society.

title: Grid Gladiators
description:
게임 정보
2D deck building
You've played 0D deck building in Slay the Spire, you've played 1D deck building in Cobalt Core, but have you tried 2D deck building? Grid Gladiators is a 2D deck builder where you can use terrain elements and positioning to your advantage, block or simply dodge enemy attacks, and blast groups of enemies with AOE attacks.
Robust terrain system
Every run is a mix of 3 different biomes with their own terrain elements, enemies, and bosses. Collect sand dollars for extra energy in the South Beach, or catch your enemies in a choke point in the Ruins. Choose your starting location carefully or you may end up surrounded!

title: Ominous
description:
게임 정보
Ominous is a captivating 2D pixel art adventure platformer that takes you on a mystical journey through the world’s most enigmatic locations. You’ll step into the shoes of Gowan McDerrick, a decorated British soldier from the Edwardian era, as he pursues ancient artifacts and uncovers secrets that span from Mongolian monasteries to Mayan tombs.

Set against the backdrop of Great Britain’s Edwardian period, Gowan’s adventure begins with an invitation from an old friend and former commander, Brigadier-General Sir Edward Bellingham. Sir Edward, who mysteriously disappeared for ten days during the Second Boer War, returned a changed man after being found miles from where he vanished, his spine broken and his spirit darkened. Obsessed with an ancient Egyptian manuscript discovered in the tombs beneath the lost city of Kweneng, Sir Edward’s invitation leads Gowan down a path filled with intrigue, mysticism, and self-discovery.

Gowan, now faced with the choice of rejoining the army or venturing into unknown realms, takes a room in a humble dosshouse along the Thames, contemplating his future. What unfolds is a tale of exploration, history, and the supernatural, where every step forward brings Gowan closer to unveiling the mysteries that bind the past and the present.

Embark on this extraordinary journey, where the boundaries of reality blur, and discover the truth behind the artifacts that have the power to change the course of history. Ominous is more than just a game—it's an experience that challenges both mind and spirit.

title: Metrophobia
description:
게임 정보
당신은 으스스하고 버려진 듯한 지하철역에 갇히게 됩니다. 눈에 보이는 사람은 없지만, 누군가—혹은 무언가—그림자 속에서 숨어 있는 듯한 불길한 기운이 끊임없이 따라다닙니다. 목표는 간단하지만 벅찬 과제입니다. 지하철을 탈출하는 것이지만, 출구를 통과할 때마다 다시 시작점으로 돌아가 끝없는 미스터리한 루프에 갇히게 됩니다.
어두운 터널을 탐험하면서, 처음에는 미묘하게 보이는 이상 현상들이 점점 나타나기 시작합니다—처음에는 물건이 약간 어긋나 있는 것처럼 보이지만, 곧 더 무서운 형태로 발전합니다. 이 이상 현상들은 당신의 현실 인식을 왜곡하며 일상과 공포 사이의 경계를 끊임없이 흐리게 만듭니다. 환경은 생명력이 없는 것처럼 보이지만, 당신의 행동에 반응하며, 각 루프가 반복될 때마다 익숙한 역의 모습이 기이하게 뒤틀린 상태로 나타납니다.
더 깊이 들어갈수록 이상 현상은 점점 강렬해지고, 곧 어둠 속에서 나타나는 무서운 존재들과 마주하게 됩니다. 한 순간의 실수로도 치명적인 괴물과 마주할 수 있으므로 경계를 늦추지 말아야 합니다. 생존하기 위해서는 진화하는 공포에 적응하고, 지하철망에 숨어 있는 미지의 힘을 능가해야 합니다.
주요 특징

title: Bioid
description:
게임 정보


Owlkin's Cosmic Library is a curiosity chamber of artifacts and a crossroads of worlds. One has only to open the book, and unknown creatures can break out or drag you into the book-portal. The worlds are shuffled in the Library!
Open tunnels in bioplasma and travel through white labyrinths to meet beings of higher intelligence. Fight the King of Thorns, the devourer of civilizations.
Learn the story of two separated prisoners and discover the secrets of a clan of bestial avatars, watchers and collectors.

title: How Much is Happiness?
description:
게임 정보
Poverty, hunger, sleepless nights on a cold bed - there was nothing but misery in the life of a young street girl named Bun.
She can no longer put up with hopelessness and plans to leave this world and go to Paradise - a distant city where there is no place for suffering. And then one day, without saying a word to anyone, Bun disappears.
You think of nothing better than to start searching the internet. A suspicious website says it's ready to bring her back, but, uh. in exchange for a thousand signatures on the user agreements. Without thinking, you click on them and.... Bun does come back to you, but she's displeased. No wonder why - you pulled her out of Paradise back to your miserable town.
At the same time Felka appears in your life. He's a funny cat-helper, every day calculating the level of your happiness and suggesting ways to increase it.
“What's going on, who is this cat, what did you agree to?” - none of that matters as long as Bun is around. Or... doesn't it?
“How much is Happiness” is a visual novel that shows the truth of our world through the prism of absurdity. Beautiful animated girls and touching music will not leave you indifferent.
Duration of the game: 10-12 hours.

title: Deep Sea
description:
게임 정보
Deep Sea is a story-driven adventure game where players take on the role of Amara, who is overcome with grief since the death of her grandfather. Amara discovers an imprisoned water spirit that promises to bring her grandfather back, but in doing so is tricked into unleashing a deadly and impassable storm on the islands she calls home.

Players will have to use the skills learned from Amara’s grandfather to overcome her grief and find a way to weaken and eventually imprison the water spirit. Along the way, they will explore beautiful islands, solve puzzles, and uncover ancient artifacts that hold the key to stopping the storm.
Key features
Explore visually stunning islands, each with their own unique story and challenges to overcome
Discover artifacts lost to time and uncover their hidden past in an attempt to save your home
Listen to an emotionally captivating soundtrack composed by industry veterans
Relive past memories and apply their lessons throughout your journey of self-discovery

title: After Death
description:
게임 정보
Based on Real Events
In 2015, an Argentine lawyer was found dead in his home after making a few powerful enemies. Some say that he committed suicide, and others say that he was silenced. The truth behind his death has been lost... or has it? 
Continue the investigation in After Death: a first-person horror game based on this mysterious death. Some say that our developers have gotten an insider's peek into the investigations that went on behind this incident... 
Investigate a Strange World
You are Prosecutor Bisman. After a sudden death, you wake up as a ghost in a police station where the Grim Reaper himself roams the corridors. Speak to the only living man in prison who can see you, help the other ghosts trapped there, and maybe someone will help you to get your memories back...

title: Swap
description:
게임 정보
SWAP 스왑은 은하계를 여행하는 매력적이지만 용감한 고양이의 신발에 자신을 발견 할 수있는 3 인칭 어드벤처 게임이다.
모래 언덕에서 얼음 사막에 이르기까지 숨막히는 풍경으로 독특한 행성을 탐험하십시오. 퍼즐을 풀고,행성의 다채로운 주민을위한 퀘스트를 완료하고,고양이 손재주와 교활함을 사용하여 적과 싸우십시오. 모든 장애물을 극복하려면 민첩성,호기심,통찰력 및 추가 9 개의 삶이 필요합니다.
스왑은 흥미 진진한 게임 플레이,그림 같은 위치,재미있는 퍼즐,모험 정신뿐만 아니라 감동적인 주인공으로,첫 번째"야옹"에서 자신과 사랑에 빠지게 만들 것입니다 게임이다.
당신의 인생의 몰래의 모험을위한 준비!

title: Drop Command
description:
게임 정보
Mech combat at a grand scale: From small skirmishes to epic battles with hundreds of units.



Drop into combat. Either alone, leading your squad, or commanding an army. Combined arms combat pits you against a large array of opposing units, where you can pilot any units under your command. Customize the weapon and equipment loadout for your Mech, Tank, VTOL, and Battle Armour to best suit the mission at hand.



Wade through battle wreaking devastation with a large variety of powerful weapons systems. Take part in the evolving battlefield, with fully destructible debris and unit wreckage.


The procedural campaign provides replayability as you wage war across the star cluster. Face logistic and tactical decisions throughout the campaign as you vie for control of strategic resources, pivotal star systems, and political objectives. Completed or failed mission objectives will have as they impact future missions and campaign operations.



Outside the campaign, play in missions: Generate a one-time procedural mission, or a fully customizable drop scenario.

title: Peace Island
description:
게임 정보
One fine day, in a remote island community off the coast of Maine, nine cats wake up to discover that their humans have disappeared. To survive, they must band together to uncover the mysteries of their storied island home - and ultimately, it is up to them to decide:

Are the humans worth bringing back?



- Explore a truly open world - The entirety of the island will be accessible, with each building containing a hand-crafted interior. No "Invisible Walls," or buildings with no purpose.
- A realistic weather & tidal system - From foggy nights, to morning downpours, to clear, blue skies - you never know what those southeast winds might bring in - and you'll never want to miss a beautiful sunset!
- Nine Playable Cats - Each with their own stories, preferences, skills, & weaknesses - as you get to know them, you'll know which one might be the best for a certain job!



- Delve into a rich, 200-year alternate history - Learn family lineages, study old maps, and read books & letters better left hidden.
- Your decisions matter! - How you approach life after humanity will decide how the game plays out in the end.
Three different possible endings



From the very beginning, we strove to create a world that isn't just "that place between mission points." The island might be small, but there is a LOT to discover and re-discover!
From the mood of the cats, to the time of day, to the weather, the soundtrack changes. Each player's musical experience will be different!
Games are a wonderful storytelling - and all stories are not happy ones.



Sometimes, you just want to hang out with the cats and watch the sun set. A mix of casual/slow gaming.
The humans might be gone, but old power structures remain. Currying favor with the deer might make the Seagulls less willing to talk!



Peace Island began in November of 2017, when a Eric (a line cook) and Laura (a care worker) noticed a severe lack of rich, single-player, story-driven experiences in a game world where the major publishers were intent on developing the next open-world shooter.

They knew it wasn't going to be easy - developing a video game of this size typically requires dozens of people and significant funding. They just had themselves, and whatever pocket change they could set aside after bills and rent. They worked on the project in whatever few hours they could set aside outside of their sleep and regular jobs.



The world took shape, slowly but steadily. Occasionally, they could convince a friend to donate a piece of artwork, or save enough to hire a coder for an hour or two to help build the first, simple systems.

From the very start, emphasis was put on crafting a beautiful world- one that would not simply serve as "that space between one destination and another," but as a place the player wants to linger in for just perhaps one more sunset.



After two years of slow but steady progress, Peace Island "went viral" in the fall of 2019, finally allowing the project to expand beyond a single bedroom, an outdated computer, and a few notebooks.



Since then, the Peace Island project has expanded to include a a core team of 7, and an expanded talent pool of over 40 creatives from around the world.

As we enter the fist days of our fifth year of development, we are more excited than ever to share the world & story of Peace Island.

title: RookTKO's GemCore
description:
게임 정보
Into the Corporate Abyss
Plunge into the depths of corporate darkness in 'GemCore', where a neon-drenched universe belies a sinister tale of unbridled capitalism. Trapped in the role of an unwitting engineer, you're a cog in the vast machinery of a merciless mining corporation.
Bullet Heaven Chaos Meets Strategic Mastery
'GemCore' is an intense fusion of bullet heaven chaos and strategic deck-building. Each procedurally generated planet is not only a battleground filled with swarms of extraterrestrial adversaries but also a testament to your employer's insatiable greed.
The Arsenal of Oppression and Rebellion
Customize your loadout with an array of unique plugins, each offering new tactics and firepower to navigate through the bullet-ridden chaos. But beware – in this universe, every upgrade and power-up is a double-edged sword, crafted by the corporation to further its own sinister goals.
Unveiling the Harrowing Truth
As you delve deeper into the heart of alien worlds, the façade of your mission crumbles, revealing the harrowing truth of your existence. You're not just an engineer; you're a pawn in a grand scheme of galactic exploitation.
A Journey of Defiance and Discovery
In 'GemCore', the thrill of surviving overwhelming odds is intertwined with a narrative of defiance against a faceless oppressor. This premium game experience promises an ongoing saga with future DLCs, expanding your journey without additional costs.

title: Mars Era
description:
게임 정보
Mars Era – an immersive turn-based strategy game about conquering Mars and establishing the first self-sustaining colony on the Red Planet. Manage resources, build infrastructure, welcome settlers, research new technologies, and adapt to the extreme conditions of space.
Key Features:
🛠 Build a Martian Colony – Construct domes, power stations, research labs, and residential complexes. Plan your expansion carefully with limited resources.
🔄 Turn-Based Gameplay – Every decision requires a strategic approach. Prioritize between researching technologies, resource extraction, or social development.
📈 Economy & Resource Management – Balance oxygen, water, and energy production. Manage budgets, establish trade agreements, and optimize automation.
🔬 Research Advanced Technologies – Unlock survival innovations, terraform the Martian surface, develop autonomous robots, and create cutting-edge energy solutions.
🛰 Exploration & Expeditions – Send drones and settlers to uncover Mars’ secrets. Discover anomalies, ancient artifacts, and traces of possible extraterrestrial life.
👩‍🚀 Take Care of Settlers – Ensure comfortable living conditions, manage social policies, and foster the culture of a thriving Martian society.
☄️ Overcome Challenges – Face dust storms, meteor showers, resource shortages, and technical malfunctions that threaten your colony’s survival.
Can you transform Mars into humanity’s new home? Start your mission in Mars Era and lead the next era of space exploration! 🚀

title: Fantastyc Murder Mystery
description:
게임 정보
Get notified about our funding launch. Find Fantastyc Murder Mystery on:
Immerse yourself in a unique asynchronous multiplayer experience
In Fantastyc Murder Mystery, you solve player-committed murders or take up weapons to do the deed yourself.
Play as murderer in unique randomly generated levels
Every murder demands meticulous planning, as detectives worldwide piece together evidence to crack the case.
Play as a detective and solve real player-generated murders
Gather clues and interrogate NPCs to unravel each unique mystery.
Spells, Perks, and Modifiers make it truly FANTASTYC
Think with portals, turn witnesses into frogs, or transform yourself into a prop. With the powers of the Enigma Tomes, you can pull from the arcane to create the most creative crime scenes!
2 Game Modes - Play together or on your own
Play live with your friends in an online lobby where you try to solve their committed murder before they solve yours!
Interact with the many already uploaded cases on the Noticeboard and upload your best murders for people worldwide to try out!
Compete against the world and become the best murderer or detective this realm has ever seen!

title: 黑丝袜：鲁智深
description:
게임 정보
《검은 스타킹: 노지심》은 roguelike 생존 게임이며, 《서유기 생존자》의 스핀오프입니다. 노지심과 임대옥이 서유기 세계로 여행하며 우연히 몸이 바뀌고, 서유기 탐험대의 유명한 "도반"이 되는 기묘한 이야기를 다룹니다.

200개 이상의 방대한 스킬, 완벽한 로그라이크 경험



세 개의 새로운 지도, 새로운 영웅과 재능



3~5시간의 플레이 경험



재미있는 밈, 즐거운 전투

title: WiccAtriX
description:
게임 정보
Summary: Wiccatrix is a 3D Action RPG. Gameplay is designed for a XBox style controller or Keyboard.
The game is inspired by old 80's 90's Role Playing Games such as Legend (aka Four Crystals of Trazere), The original Rogue, Gauntlet (Atari Arcade) & Ultima 8 Pagan + others games like World Of Warcraft etc... Wiccatrix consists of designed scenes and randomly generated dungeons for crawling through, killing mobs and getting loot.
The game will also have other RPG aspects such as free roaming scenes with NPC’s and:~
Spellcrafting ~ A spell crafting system that uses a combination of herbs and runes to enable the player to create their own spells!!
Dialogue & a Story line ~ A rogue titan is disturbing the elemental balance which permeates the world of Terra. The players role is to guide the our hero Catsear the peasant through a world filled with enemies and other characters and ultimately a final encounter with a rogue elemental titan that seeks to destroy the world. Can he be banished? It won't be easy.
Puzzles ~ Use spells and your own wit to defeat puzzles and receive rewards and gain access to dungeons areas..
Combat ~ Go into battle with your limited melee abilities and your spells or run away screaming like a little chicken from mobs of enemies and bosses of various types. Getting into fights and not dying will challenge the player’s ability. Sometimes this will be easy and other times it will be near impossible and require a different approach. The player will have the experience of building their skills to withstand a progressively increasing horde of enemies with harder and more damaging attacks.
Loot and Reagent (Spell Ingredients) Gathering ~ Loot and Reagents can be bought from merchants, found in parts of the world or received from enemy drops and quests.

Release ~ Aiming for November 2024 or not long after ~ That's the plan..

title: Super Power Racing
description:
게임 정보


Get ready to experience a thrilling top-down arcade racing game that's inspired by the classic 90s racing games you know and love.

Super Power Racing League is the prestigious racing competition where ruthless competitors from around the world come together to tear up the track and power their way to victory

Unlock new vehicles, drive everything from a hot-hatch to an ice cream van!

title: Crowncity
description:
게임 정보
깊이 있는 게임플레이, 중세의 돈 잘 벌고 번영하는 멋진 도시를 건설하세요!

중세 후기의 신성로마제국 영주인 주인공의 이야기를 따라가는 여정에서, 주군인 디트마르셴 여공작 콘스탄츠 아래의 봉신으로서, 미개척 영지를 봉건 계약에 따라 분봉받아 영지를 발전시키게 됩니다.
그 과정에서, 이웃 영지의 방해와 모략, 거친 자연 환경과 특히 매서운 겨울 추위의 어려움, 끝없이 갈망하는 영지 주민들의 요구 등 여러 도전에 직면하게 됩니다.
도시의 재무 상태를 부유하게 만들기 위하여, 주택을 발전시키고, 적절한 조세 정책 옵션을 선택하고, 풍부하게 생산된 원재료를 가공하여 비싼 값에 수출하여 무역으로 수지 맞는 도시를 만들어보세요!

성채 영역은 건설하려는 성채 주변의 자연환경과 지리를 포함합니다!



성채는 주변 일정 범위 영역을 성채 영역으로서 포함합니다. 성채 영역에는 자연환경과 지리, 건물과 인구, 그리고 동적인 통행 인원이 포함됩니다.
해당 영역의 자연환경과 건설된 건물들의 특성에 따라서, 더 특화되어 어울리는 성채부속시설의 선택과 함께, 성채 생산량을 생산하고, 그것을 과학 연구점 또는 추가 금화 수입으로 전환시킬 수 있습니다.



성채부속시설은 각 성채에 대하여 선택될 수 있는 각 옵션들을 가리킵니다.
성채부속시설은, 성채 영역에서, 어떤 자연지리 특성이나, 또는 자연환경 타일 또는 건물 타일 등이, 또는 성채 영역의 인구 또는 통행인원 등이, 얼마만큼의 성채 생산량으로 전환될지에 대한 특성을 가지고 있습니다.
예를 들어, 바위투성이 언덕 지리 환경에서 고정된 성채 생산량 보너스를 얻는 것도 있고, 성채 영역 내에서 도서관 건물마다 보너스 성채 생산량을 얻거나, 또는 바다 또는 강과 같은 물 타일에서 보너스를 전체적으로 추가적으로 얻는 종류의 성채부속시설도 존재합니다.
자연환경과 지리적인 특성에 맞추어, 건설된 지역 건물들의 특성에 맞추어, 적절한 성채부속시설을 선택하여, 보다 더 많은 이득을 얻을 수 있습니다.


더 높은 주택 등급의 주택에서는, 더 부유한 주민들이 훨씬 더 많은 세금을 납세합니다.
성채와 세무서를 건설하여, 그들에게 주민세를 조세하세요!

조세 정책 옵션으로 다양한 설정을 직접 스스로 세부적으로 결정할 수 있습니다.
다양한 도시 세금 정책을 자유롭게 조합하여, 좋은 시너지 효과가 나오도록 조세 옵션을 조절해보세요!

주택세, 인구세, 사치품 세금, 극장 공연세, 음악당 공연세, 미술품 거래세, 그리고 자연환경 인접 세금 등의 다양한 특별세를 징수할 수 있습니다.
세금을 징수할 뿐만 아니라, 생산 시설과 산업 시설, 그리고 항구 시설에 보조금을 지급하여 생산 진행을 단축시킬 수도 있습니다.
자금이 충분하지 않을 때에는, 은행에서 대출금을 빌려 보세요!

게임의 경제 시스템은 다양한 요소에서 복합적으로 어우러집니다. 수입과 지출을 파악하는 것은 도시의 재무 업무를 수행하기 위하여 가장 먼저 해야할 일이 됩니다.
도시의 주택 발전 정도에 비하여 세무 행정이 제대로 이루어지고 있는지, 주민세 수입이 충분한지, 성채에서 너무 먼 건물들이 쓸데없이 많은 유지비를 지출시키고 있지는 않은지, 재무 요약 보고서를 통하여 도시의 재정 상황을 파악해보세요!


무역은 도시 전체의 무역 메뉴에서 수출 제안과 수입 제안을 수락하여 진행될 수 있고, 이국적인 사치품으로서, 예를 들어, 후추와 같은 향신료나 찻잎과 같은 진귀한 사치품은, 각 항구 건물마다 수입을 따로 진행할 수 있습니다.


때때로, 수익성이 좋은 특별한 수출 제안이 제시되기도 합니다. 도시가 큰돈을 벌 기회를 놓치지 마세요!



게임에는 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울의 사계절이 존재합니다. 겨울에는 추위가 매서워지고 겨울 자원을 소모하게 됩니다.
따뜻한 날에 충분히 대비하여 놓지 않으면, 한겨울의 혹독한 추위를 이기지 못하고, 도시가 무너질 수도 있습니다!


게임에는 9가지 종교가 등장합니다. 천주교, 개신교, 개혁교회, 주교회, 정교, 그리고 수목신앙, 천문신앙, 배화신앙, 주술신앙이 그것입니다. 이 중에서 원하는 종교를 영지의 국교로 선택하여 지정할 수 있습니다. 각 종교는 고유한 종교 정책과 효과 특성을 가집니다.



어떤 도시 기계공이 모처럼 고안해 낸 활자 인쇄 기술을 지켜내고, 이웃 영지들의 모략과 방해 속에서도, 값비싼 서적을 대량으로 인쇄하여 수출로 큰돈을 벌고, 중세 도시의 만성적인 재정 적자를 해결할 수 있을까요?
역사보다 이른 인쇄기의 발명은, 어떤 사건을 초래하게 될까요? 하나의 이야기는 또 다시 인과가 되어 다른 흥미로운 이야기로 이어집니다.
한편, 향기로운 포도가 가득한 포도의 명산지에서, 특출난 포도잼 기술을 연구 개발하여, 포도잼으로 유명한 도시를 만들어낼 수 있을까요?
대학을 건설하고 각종 연구시설을 개량하여, 학술과 교육 서비스를 수익화하는 데 성공할 수 있을까요?


스테이지 모드에서는, 흥미로운 이야기와 함께 여정이 이어지며 각 스테이지에서 도시를 발전시키고 임무를 수행하게 됩니다.
랜덤 맵 샌드박스 모드에서는, 랜덤 생성되는 자연환경과, 또한 연구 테크트리와 무역 제안과 같은 요소들이 랜덤 생성되는 랜덤 생성 경제환경으로, 각 게임마다 경제적으로 유의미한 톱니바퀴 요소의 전략적 차이가, 의미 있는 창발적이고도 새로운 플레이 경험을 깊이 있게 만들어냅니다.


매 게임 새롭게 달라지는 자연환경과 경제 환경에서는, 그에 맞게 적합한 선택과 집중이 중요합니다. 역동적으로 생성되는 랜덤 생성 테크트리에서, 새로운 상황에 가장 적합한 연구 과제를 선택해보세요!
랜덤 생성 테크트리는 매번 새로운 게임 경험을 선사하며, 경제적으로 최적화되는 선택의 몰입감에 깊이를 더해줍니다.


크라운시티에서 번영하는 중세 도시를 건설해보세요!

title: Echoes From The Past
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to "Echoes From The Past," an engaging adventure game that takes you on a mysterious journey through an abandoned sanatorium from 1980. Join Cerys Baker on her investigations after receiving a mysterious letter instructing her to visit Oak Sanatorium, which has been experiencing increasingly strange occurrences since its sudden closure. Immerse yourself in the eerie atmosphere of this deserted place and confront the secrets waiting to be uncovered.
Listen to the Echoes
Explore the halls of Oak Sanatorium and listen to the echoes that reveal the history of the place. Each room holds its own secrets and stories. Be attentive and look for clues that can help you solve the puzzle of this eerie place.
Solve Puzzles
Oak Sanatorium is a labyrinth of secrets and puzzles. To progress and unveil the truth, you must showcase your skills and solve tricky puzzles. Use your logical thinking and observation skills to discover hidden clues and decipher the puzzles that stand between you and solving the mystery.
Face the Power
Maintain composure and remain inconspicuous as you navigate through the sanatorium. The dark forces haunting the place are vigilant and ready to confront anyone attempting to uncover their secrets. Stealthily sneak past dangers and avoid attention to secure your survival and bring the truth to light.

Are you ready to confront the Echoes of Oak Sanatorium and unravel the secrets of this eerie place? Immerse yourself in this captivating adventure and experience a story full of suspense, puzzles, and unexpected twists.

title: Idosra: The Electric Renaissance
description:
게임 정보
Explore the distant future in Idosra, an action-adventure RPG set in a world on the verge of rediscovering electricity.



The fall of today's civilizations has come and gone. Standing in their place is the Vallas Empire. The empire has taken a keen interest in annexing neighboring city-states, a welcomed effort. Annexation with the Vallas Empire and its strong gas economy means new opportunity. Only Marika, a citizen of the city-state Lyrika, seems concerned. A chance encounter in the woods has led her to believe the empire may have ulterior motives.



A World Without Electricity. As the sea levels begin to fall, ancient coastal cities start to emerge. Rumor has it that these cities hold lost secrets to the generation of electricity. Electricity could be a great boon to the Vallan cities that rely solely on coal and gas. The lost "fire" can bring wealth and prosperity. It can also grant unimaginable power. The empire has shown an interest in researching and harnessing electricity, and the Vallan scholars are hard at work studying any clues that trickle in.



The Start of an Adventure. Marika's concerns are validated when her brother, the scholar Cata, is taken by the empire. Only the day before he had told her about a discovery he made-a lost city known as "Idosra", which may hold a vital clue to the secrets of electricity. Rumors and tales of electricity are abundant. The empire, though, holds a tight grasp on information. They are selective about what they reveal.



Did Cata know too much? Marika now fears what the fate of her brother is, and what the fate of her home will be when the empire gains command over a powerful new force.

Complete quests, explore Vallas, learn new skills, and unravel the mysteries of a world in rebirth. Only you can help her learn the fates of Cata and the lost city Idosra.

title: Shadey's Quest
description:
게임 정보
Shadey’s Quest is an autobattler roguelike featuring character building and tactial auto-combat. Shadey is a small monster who dreams of becoming the strongest Shadow and defeating the fearsome King of Shadows . He is not that strong (or smart), but he is full of energy and determination. Also, he is very good at is eating! You must guide Shadey through an enchanting and mysterious World of Shadows, feed him so that he grows into a powerful and unstoppable fighter, and help him defeat hordes of enemy Shadows!
EXPLORE AND LOOT
The World of Shadows is full of adventure. Shadey’s quest will lead him through diverse areas, from deserted Greylands, to sparwling Gloomwood and bustling City of Shades.
Each zone will offer unique foes and challenges, as well as various rewards, such as gold or mighty equipment, which will empower Shadey, unlocking new gameplay possibilities.
COOK
Usually heroes become stronger by earning priceless experience in countless fights. Shadey can achieve the same thing by simply eating something.

title: Dead
description:
게임 정보
Dead, too dead is a hardcore open-world survival game where 21st-century individuals fight for survival in an apocalyptic fantasy world. We plan to create a game with the following features :
Realistic Survival: Manage various factors such as hunger, thirst, disease, and injuries to survive in extreme environments.
Unique Characters: Combine 21st-century jobs with various traits to create unique characters and develop your own survival strategies.
Exploration and Discovery: Explore a vast open world with remnants of modern civilization and uncover hidden stories and resources.
Choices and Consequences: Every choice you make has permanent consequences. Decide carefully and create your own story.
Combat and Threats: Fight against various enemies such as ghouls, wild animals, and magical creatures, and develop survival strategies to counter constantly evolving threats.
Unique Vision System: Experience tense gameplay from a top-down perspective based on your character's field of view, and strategically use your surroundings.
Crafting and Building (Planned): Use materials from this world to craft tools, weapons, and defenses, and build your own base.
Modding Support (Planned): Utilize various modding tools to create your own content and share it with other players.
Currently, Dead, too dead is in the early stages of development, and we are conducting various tests through prototype builds. This version is to experiment with and improve the game's core mechanics and systems, and may still be lacking in many areas.
Dead, too dead aims to provide a differentiated gameplay experience from existing survival games. We aim for a sandbox game where players set their own survival goals and create their own stories. Additionally, we aim to provide a differentiated gameplay experience through modern job and trait systems, exploration of modern civilization remnants, a world where choices and consequences are reflected, and a unique top-down vision system.
If you are positive about the direction of Dead, too dead, please support us by adding it to your wishlist. Your interest will help us to have a solid development direction.

title: Crisis Reign Orbis
description:
게임 정보
Embark on the Crisis Story - 
Play the main story of Azer and travel through several stages, fight against enemies, talk with the locals, solve puzzles and rebuild the support of your team.


Slaughter The DronesRecover the various portions of the city that have gone offline by defeating the drones placed in each of the 4 borough.  

 Collect the late professor's 'Legacy Discs' scattered between the various lands. Solve puzzles, defeat enemies and create alliances in order to uncover the secrets needed to save the land of Orbis.

With each new land comes its challenges, as you travel to collect the hidden 'Legacies' Left by the professor. Defeat bosses who travel to claim it for themselves. 
 
Fight to gain true bragging rights in the 1 vs 1 Battle Mode. Fight 1 versus 1 with a friend in the local multiplayer mode and battle on 1 of the five stages.

title: KINSHFT
description:
게임 정보
KINSHFT is a sci-fantasy adventure where you play as three members of the same family, each with their own unique abilities and play styles. Spread in three wildly different eras of a future Earth, they are still connected by a mysterious force that allows them to work as a team across a vast span of time.
FEATURES:
You will encounter many mysteries across time that cannot be solved with a single character's abilities. Shift between characters and their eras and use each one's unique skills to work together to find a solution. As you journey deeper into these worlds and solve even greater mysteries you will unlock new abilities for each character.
The decisions you make as a player can have an affect on other eras in time. Some are like a ripple, destroying a bridge in one era that cuts off enemy access to an area in another. Others are like a wave, changing how a faction that once considered you an enemy now sees you as a friend.
In your travels you will encounter many new species and cultures, those that have evolved over the decades and centuries altered by the Eros impact, and those that have reached Earth from distant galaxies searching for what the asteroid may have left behind. Befriend and help the locals, meet and influence the different factions and come face to face with tremendous bosses. How those encounters end is up to you!
EXPLORE AND COLLECT - Delve into the hidden depths and dark corners of the world to collect valuable relics of the past.
CRAFT AND TRADE - Craft and trade for new and powerful items to gain new abilities allowing you to explore deeper into each new world. 
BUILD AND GROW - Trade resources and aid the inhabitants of Bastion City to help it rebuild and grow, gaining you access to new locations, shops, adventures and mysteries.
CHARACTERS: 
Each character has unique abilities that fit their individual play styles, some available from the start, others that need to be discovered, researched or unlocked. Each ability is designed to be used both in exploration and in combat, allowing players to decide how and when to use each one.
NILES - With a newfound ability to control the very forces of the universe, Niles uses fringe science to manipulate the world around him as if by magic. Waving his staff he can capture and control particles to create fantastic "Science Spells"

title: Dimension L
description:
게임 정보
Dimension L is an online turn-based strategy RPG where players enter an alternative temporal dimension. In this universe, known as Dimension L, dinosaurs never went extinct and have evolved, developing elemental powers. These creatures, called L, have created an advanced civilization, forming small villages organized with their own laws and traditions. However, peace is threatened when invaders from other dimensions attack their land.
To defend their home, the village leader, KinLoRai, organizes the Duty Cup, a tournament to gather the most powerful warriors. Each player takes on the role of an L fighter who competes in the tournament and manages their squad to lead it to victory, facing powerful rivals and aspiring to become the ultimate defender of their world.
Key Features:
Turn-based strategic battles: Engage in tactical grid combat where positioning and planning are crucial for victory.
Online multiplayer: Compete against other players in the tournament to prove who is the strongest L warrior.
Evolution and elemental powers: Enhance your L fighters to unlock unique abilities based on elemental mastery. Form a squad that maximizes the special skills of each recruit.
Alternate universe: Dimension L is a mysterious world filled with evolved creatures, reimagining the story of dinosaurs.
Grand-scale tournaments: Compete in the Duty Cup and rise through the ranks to become the defender of Dimension L.
Immerse yourself in a world of parallel dimensions, evolutionary mysteries, and epic tournaments. Do you have what it takes to save Dimension L and protect it from invaders?

title: Clockwork Ambrosia
description:
게임 정보
Knowledge is a gift, but ego is a curse - don't become the lesson.

Thrilling and empowering, Clockwork Ambrosia is a vibrant fusion of metroidvania and 2D shooter gameplay with a weapon-building twist.



Clockwork Ambrosia's combat mechanics thrill to life as players piece together unique weapons with game-changing modifications and synergies.



Rig up endless combinations of powers: screen-filling shot splitters, devastating missile strikes and armor-piercing sniper rounds.



Exploration and discovery drive the world of Clockwork Ambrosia. Brilliant pixel art takes players above the clouds to the steampunk wonders of a cloud city, through the lush and gorgeous mushroom forest, and down below to the moody underbelly of the sunken kingdoms - and much more.



Players do not work alone. They will entreat a cast of characters, from rogue - but benevolent - AI companions to bumbling mushroom folk, to overcome the dangers of the island.



Walk the forbidden biomes of Aspida as Iris, an itinerant airship engineer trying to escape the island after a near-miss airship crash. The plucky engineer soon finds herself caught up in a mystery spawning eons when the island's populace disappears, seemingly replaced by malevolent robots and cyborgs. The true architect of these plans, however, will draw Iris towards a truth she may not want to face...

title: Witchbound
description:
게임 정보
Witchbound
Haunt the mansion, chase intruders and embrace the haunting, and defend your home from exorcism.
About the Game
Witchbound turns the classic horror genre on its head, placing YOU in the spectral shoes of the ghost. Guard your lair from unwelcome intruders who dare to disrupt your eternal peace. This isn’t just a fight for survival—it’s a fight to preserve your haunted sanctuary.
In this reverse horror experience, players take on the role of a powerful, vengeful spirit bound to an ancient, abandoned mansion. Your mission? Terrify and eliminate intruders who seek to banish you from your domain. As you patrol the eerie halls of your home, AI-controlled NPC players will collaborate to complete tasks that unravel the exorcism ritual.
Key Features
The Ghost’s Perspective: You’re no helpless victim. Harness your supernatural abilities to stalk, terrify, and dispatch those who dare enter your domain.
Dynamic Cat-and-Mouse Gameplay: Outsmart the intruders as they work together to cleanse the mansion. Strike fear into their hearts, isolate them, and remove them one by one.
Evolving Challenges: As the exorcism progresses, NPC intruders grow more determined and resourceful. Adapt your strategies to keep your home under your control.
Atmospheric Haunting: Explore your cursed mansion, rich with secrets, chilling visuals, and immersive soundscapes that heighten the suspense.
Game Modes: Unlock Veilbound, a challenging mode where the line between the physical world and the supernatural thins, amplifying both your powers and the intruders’ resolve.
Gameplay Overview
For the Intruders: Complete ritualistic tasks scattered throughout the mansion while evading the ghost. Work together—or fall one by one.
For the Ghost: Use stealth, fear, and precision to hunt the intruders. Discover weaknesses in their plans and strike before they finish the exorcism.
Can you preserve the peace of your eternal afterlife, or will you be cast out into the void?
Witchbound awaits. Are you ready to haunt?

title: Astral Hunter: Homebound
description:
게임 정보
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hello, alien explorers! We are an independent development team of 2 people. We are excited to bring you Astral hunter : Homebound, a fast-paced action RougeLike game.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Build a unique fighting style
Take up arms and fight hordes of enemies

title: An Imp and an Imposter
description:
게임 정보
An Imp and an Impostor is an interactive urban fantasy novel by Athar Fikry, author of The Dragon and the Djinn.
You're an undercover imp, serving time for your magical misdeeds by working for Arkan, the division of the city government that investigates magical crimes. Your by-the-book partner doesn't know who you really are - or that your nose for crime is actually a nose for magic. Some of your magic was confiscated when you were sentenced, but you've got enough left to put you above most humans.
Now, just when you were about to recover the rest of your magic, it's gone missing from its vault! You need to track it down - and more importantly, track down the person who took it.
Go on daring heists, cracking open vaults using magic or gadgets. Talk your way past bureaucrats, professors, necromancers, mobsters, afreet, and djinn as you poke into all of the magical and mundane corners of the city, finding things that most people would like to keep hidden.
And pet the world's most adorable undead dog.

title: DSS 2: War Industry
description:
게임 정보
무한한 군대, 끝없는 도시, 비교할 수 없는 자원 시뮬레이션을 갖춘 혁신적인 실시간 대전략 게임입니다. 전쟁 게임을 재정의하고 규모와 깊이의 한계를 넓히도록 설계되었습니다.
특징
도시 건설: 전쟁 노력을 지원하기 위해 도시를 건설하고 발전시키세요.
방어: 요새화 및 경비소로 방어를 강화하세요.
자원 관리: 원활한 재료 공급을 보장하기 위해 생산 체인과 배송 시스템을 설정하세요.
자동화: 정복에 바쁜 동안 중세 산업을 계속 운영하도록 설정하세요.
군대 제어: 지도 전반에 걸쳐 군대를 지휘하면서 잘 공급하고 먹이세요.
다양한 군사 유닛: 각각의 장단점을 가진 다양한 유닛 유형을 배치하세요.
외교 시스템: 다른 이들을 설득하여 당신의 원인에 동참하게 하세요.
놀라운 규모: 수십만 명의 군인과 노동자가 실시간으로 시뮬레이션됩니다.
DSS 1에서 새로운 기능
자원, 건물 및 군인의 양이 세 배로 증가했습니다.
기술 및 레벨 업 시스템.
기술 트리.
벽과 요새의 자유로운 건설.
새로운 악당이 군단의 파도를 도입합니다.
전투 중 전술적 제어.
그래픽 업데이트.
지형을 피해 이동하고 전투 중 더 활발하게 활동하는 새로운 병사 AI.
환경 음향 디자인.
지도 편집기.
전투 실험실: 병사들을 서로 맞붙게 하세요.

title: Towers Heritage
description:
게임 정보
Tower defense game revisiting the genre for both gamers nostalgic of the old sweet TD days and newcomers.
Defend your kingdom, customize your towers and play online or offline in this tribute to the Tower Defense genre.
How would you like to play an old-school Tower Defense where you can play with your friends and create your own towers to craft new strategies?
Towers Heritage is a tribute to the classics of the genre while adding a dose of innovation with an online multiplayer mode or a unique tower creation workshop.
Immerse yourself in a fantasy world where, as protector of the kingdom, you must defend your lands against relentless waves of enemies. Strategically place your towers along the paths or build an overwhelming maze of destruction.
Not in the mood to play with other players? No problem!
🏰 Take on bots in a skirmish mode.
🏰 Enjoy the single-player adventure with a captivating campaign mode.
🏰 Or create your game with your own rules: choose the number of players, the type of game (cooperative, team against team, free for all) and much more.
Looking for a completely different challenge? Become the invader! Unleash waves of enemies on your opponents and expand your kingdom.
Developed by a passionate indie from the heart of the French countryside, Towers Heritage is a personnal tribute this genre, that tag along since his childhood.
Whether you want to enjoy a chill game or a real strategic challenge, there's something for everyone.
⚔️ Add to your wishlist now and take a seat among legends of TD.⚔️

title: The Legend of Pamperlotte
description:
게임 정보
The Legend of Pamperlotte is a tactical RPG with a unique twist: the "Tactical Combo" system! Depending on your character and class, you can have up to three actions per turn that can be anything! You can run to an enemy, hit him and run away! Or hit an enemy, run and take a potion... The more you use an action per turn, the more efficient it becomes. Another unique feature is the "Turn Again" system. If you defeat an enemy, your combo counter refills and you can act all over again and break havoc in the enemy camp! But beware, the enemy has all those same quirks as you do!
Pick your best teams among over 10 classes with 50 different unique skills and techniques. Improve your stats in the skill tree and get to know your teammates with character episodes.
In a world divided among humans, demons and animals, the war is on the verge of breaking out. Follow Hiro and his friends to prevent the catastrophe and bring peace in the Island of Pamperlotte!

title: Uagi-Saba 2
description:
게임 정보
Uagi-Saba 2 is a complex creature care/breeding sim inspired by some of my favorite artificial life sims from when I was a child.

Watch your creatures hatch from eggs and raise them to adults. Creatures can see, hear, smell and think for themselves and are all born with their own unique genes/personalities. Guide them through beautiful hand drawn environments using speech and positive/negative reinforcement. They can learn from experiences, form relationships with other creatures and breed. Breed strong family lines through selective breeding and find rare mutations after multiple generations. Laugh and interact with your creature and cry when they reach the end...



Features/Mechanics
Explore
A variety of biomes to explore. Snowy drifts. crystal caves, forgotten mines, magma vents and alien ruins.
Protect
You are the guardian, guide your creatures safely through life. Lead them to water and bring them food. Show them the way to safety and help them avoid danger.
Variety
Every creature is very different from the last. Each can be born with a variety of different body parts and genes. Body, head, ears, horns ,eyes, arms, legs, fur, scales. Color genes can also influence the individual color of body parts, including eyes. The possibilities are endless with hundreds of combinations.
Speak
Learn your creatures native language by looking through old books and scrolls. When fluent you can use commands to influence creature decisions.
Memories
Your creatures will form memories based on objects or locations it spends the most time around. It will even remember other creatures, form relationships and eventually mate.
Learn
Your creatures will learn over time through positive and negative reinforcement and can pass on things they have learned to their offspring. They will learn from experience but also from watching you and other creatures!

title: Crystal Ball Critters
description:
게임 정보
Roll, jump, ride, glide and fly in this platformer racing game. All from inside a crystal ball!
Unlike most vehicles, a ball does not have a front end; rather, its front end is where its speeding towards!
No need to steer a car back and forth. You can turn around and build up speed in any direction you wish. Racing through platforming sections; even vertically.
Drive masterfully using simple and intuitive controls to keep your speed high with up to 5 strangers or friends.
Crystal Ball Critters features beautiful environments and worlds to race across. Full of original gimmicks and secrets to keep things fresh and stay ahead of the race. All matter of colorful critters competing for recognition from the most evil (actually nicest) villain that the universe has ever had.
All you need is a jumping and rolling to access all of the game's movement. But controlling that movement to its full potential and maintaining your speed flawlessly is an art of its own.
Across the worlds of Crystal Ball Critters, you will encounter Mana Orbs.
Picking one up will give you a burst of speed; giving you an opportunity to turn instantly and change your trajectory, allowing skilled players to make sharp turns without slowing down, and rewarding skill in ways that don't require any strange input or training!
All of it comes naturally by playing.
Perfect for players looking to jump straight into a game without waiting, and also those that want to hone their skill for faster and faster times in the solo modes!
✦ What This Game Is Not

title: 死者还阳Escape from the Underworld
description:
게임 정보
In that era of epidemic, I, who lived alone, could not escape and collapsed alone in the apartment. In a trance, I suddenly found myself in a black and white world, where there were people who gathered here for different reasons, a mysterious girl, and a group of mysteries and demons beyond cognition.
"Work together or kill each other"
The girl gives us hope to return to the human world, but also brings us harsh and frightening conditions. Should we follow our instincts and continue to maintain the kindness of the human world, or do everything for the illusory hope? In this ambiguous "City God's Residence", what is right? What is evil? Everything here has turned into chaos.
"Resurrection" is a suspenseful text adventure game. Players search for the truth of human heart hidden in the puzzles in an alternative Chinese-style fantasy dream woven by Chinese mysticism, religion, and folklore.The gameplay functions of the game are mainly divided into several parts: level options, plot reasoning, level decryption, and map exploration.
autokwd: 死者还阳Escape from the Underworld

title: Spellbind Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Follow me in twitter for news:



Description;

‣  Strategy and planning are the keys when playing Spellbind Tactics, each character has certain set of movements that when used properly can lead to a powerful game plan, every character is designed to support each other in order to achieve effective synergies and movements. Your capacity when executing your game plan and your ability to react to your oponent's will be decisive in order to win.

About the game:

‣ Multiplayer tactics based.
‣ One vs One onlie matchups.
‣ Based on skills and decisions.


‣  Each character has a unique set of abilities, choose wisely how to combine them!



‣  Plan your attack and your defense, adapt to the moves of your opponent!



‣  Combine different characters and abilities to unlock powerful effects!

title: Jamir
description:
게임 정보
BASE WARS MODE

3개 팀이 기지전에 참가하여 주발전기에 가장 큰 피해를 준 1개 팀이 주 기지를 장악하고, 선두팀이 다른 2개 팀 앞에서 일정 시간 버틸 수 있으면 기지전이 종료되고 챔피언 팀이 됩니다. 보석으로 수여됩니다. FPP 및 TPP의 두 가지 보기 유형을 기반으로 15, 30, 45, 60 또는 75명의 플레이어 기본 전쟁 경기에 참여할 수 있습니다. 충분한 수의 매치 플레이어가 입장하면 기지 전쟁이 자동으로 시작됩니다.
DEATHMATCH FREE FOR ALL
목표는 라운드당 10분 동안 다른 플레이어를 최대한 많이 죽이는 것입니다. 업그레이드되고 더 강한 플레이어를 죽이면 더 많은 보석을 얻을 수 있습니다.
TEAM DEATHMATCH
목표는 라운드당 10분 동안 다른 팀 플레이어를 최대한 많이 죽이는 것입니다. 업그레이드되고 더 강한 플레이어를 죽이면 더 많은 보석을 얻을 수 있습니다.
SURVIVAL
플레이어가 가능한 한 생물의 파도에서 살아남아야 하는 협동 게임 모드입니다. 3가지 유형의 생물이 있으며 각 유형을 죽이면 파도의 강도에 따라 다른 양의 보석을 얻을 수 있습니다.

title: Godless Lands
description:
게임 정보
This is an adaptation of a board game for two players.
The game takes place on one playing field. In turn with the enemy, you make moves with your cards or use objects. To win the game, you need to destroy the main card (Place of Power) of the enemy. There are no pre-prepared decks here - all cards and items are selected in turn from the general list. Already at the stage of choosing and placing cards, you can get a significant advantage over the enemy by blocking or taking the cards he needs.
All cards in the game (Heroes and Places of Power) have basic characteristics (attack, defense, health) and 2-3 unique skills. Items play a supporting role. They can both enhance the basic parameters of your cards, and inflict direct damage to enemy cards.
For a comfortable game, it is better to start playing with a friend, gradually learning the abilities of different cards and items, their strengths and weaknesses. At the moment, the game has 48 Hero cards, 13 Places of Power cards and more than 80 items and rings.

title: Saturday Super Day
description:
게임 정보
Saturday Super Day is a point and click exploratory choose your own adventure game that was prototyped in PowerPoint.
You play as Bobbi who wakes on a mid 90s Saturday morning with a mission: To reach the computer lab at Scuttlebutt High School and back up an important project before the school servers get wiped for the summer.

Embark on a lovingly handcrafted journey through Olympia WA. That's been packed to the brim with explorable content and characters.

Features:
A vast, mid 90s accurate world to enjoy at your own pace.
Over 30 different environments to explore.
Unique hand-drawn art style based on 90s animation.
Intuitive drag and drop controls.

title: Run Away
description:
게임 정보
제발 저희 매혹적인 공포 게임에 몰두하고, 무서운 비밀을 탐색하고 가창적인 생존 전투에 참여하세요. 당신은 잊혀진 건물을 탐험하게 되며, 각각의 한 걸음이 마지막일 수 있고, 모든 구석마다 무서운 생물이 숨어 있을 수도 있습니다. 예측할 수 없는 상황에 직면하여 어려운 수수께끼를 풀고 생존을 위해 괴물과 싸우세요. 고품질의 그래픽과 현실적인 사운드 효과로 공포와 긴장감의 분위기 속에 몰입하게 될 것입니다. 하지만 주의하세요: 당신이 내리는 각각의 결정은 치명적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다. 진정한 도전에 대비하고, 오직 가장 똑똑하고 용감한 사람들만이 생존할 수 있는 준비를 하세요. 당신의 가치, 지혜, 교활함을 보여주며 이 어둠의 세계의 비밀을 밝혀내고 성공적으로 탈출하세요.

title: The Doomed Knight
description:
게임 정보
You are the Doomed Knight. Torn between madness and sanity. You walked the realm of death for thousands of years forgot your own past and identity. But something is wrong in the realm of death. A boy in the world is not allowed to die! The cities of the dead are empty! Souls are being tortured and corrupted. And the black death is preparing something unspeakable! Together with your oldest advisor, the necromicon, the book of the dead, you are out to discover what it is. And maybe even your own past will be uncovered...

This metrodvania inspired game lets you discover an fascinating world full of monsters, secrets and mysteries.

The game offers you:

- 12 giant metroidvania areas
- multiple endings depending on your decisions and gameprogress
- 12 Endbosses and over 60 monsters and creatures
- huge arsenal of items, abilities and equippment
- over 60 souls/characters you can collect
- approximately 20 hours of gameplay
- unique and detailed artstyle

title: HEX Defense
description:
게임 정보
Conquer back your homeworld, taken over by strange crystal-like lifeforms that suddenly appeared 22 years ago after a calamity. You were forced to retreat and spent years researching possible options to counteract them. And you’ve finally found it! Build complex defenses from basic blocks, find the origin of the calamity and wipe out all hostile creatures in this original tower-based RTS.

Features
Pattern-based building process: every tower is constructed from patterns of simple blocks. Build your defenses piece by piece the way you like it, upgrade, combine, optimize space and resources to survive against the overwhelming forces.
Three enemy life forms: cuboids, spheroids and polygonoids, each operating differently and requiring a unique strategy to overcome.
Freedom of strategy and flexible defense perimeter: Go for quick low-tier tower rush or bunk with well-defended artillery posts, then collect your blocks and rebuild the defenses on the spot — just mind the free space and resources left.
Indirect control over your forces. Get up to a strategic level and don't waste your time with routine tasks: plan your defenses and issue orders while your units do all the work.
Over 40 levels with varied gameplay and different objectives, taking place in seven distinct biomes.

The Hex World needs your protection!

title: Hive Quest
description:
게임 정보
Hive Quest is an immersive real time strategy game set in a mythical woodland filled with ancient magic, strange creatures & intriguing puzzles. As the Hive Mind you will guide your insect tribe on a hazardous adventure to find safety after a terrible cataclysm. Explore mysterious locations with the help of your pet Shrublet, find allies, uncover the story behind the Old Orchard and fight against other tribes. Do you have what it takes to re-establish your Hive’s fortunes and seek out the mythical ‘Sunny Uplands’?

– Guide your embattled tribe on a quest to find fortune, glory and a new home.
– Interact with a wide variety of crazy puzzles and strange goings on as you try to make sense of it all.
– Explore the mysteries of the Deep Woods and uncover new allies and enemies.
– Battle against other hives to maintain control of your territory.
– Manage resources and build your Hive into a powerful kingdom, filled with hard working drones.
– Take mind control of your drones and send them into unknown territory on dangerous missions.
– Launch attacks on enemy Hives & dangerous creatures that stand in your way.
– Obtain woodland elementals as pets and upgrade them to fight and do your bidding.

Thanks for looking!

title: Detective Butler and the King of Hearts
description:
게임 정보
Detective Butler and the King of Hearts is a linear murder mystery visual novel, with emphasis on a fast-paced, character-driven narrative. The story is divided into 15+ chapters, each with its own mystery, while at the same time asking you to piece together a deeper mystery that spans across all chapters. No prior knowledge of the Detective Butler storyline is required to enjoy the game.



Estimated 20-30 hours of content across 15+ chapters
A unique hand-drawn art-style with animated sprites and backgrounds
Fully voiced dialogue and narration (both optional, English language only)
One big murder mystery, plus at least one small mystery per chapter
Case Notes and Lecture Notes to help solve each mystery
A large cast of characters with secrets to uncover
Thought-provoking themes on truth, happiness, life, and death
Original soundtrack




Three years after the events of , Gilligan Golder is now CEO of his late father's life insurance company, where Butler also now works as a fraud investigator. At the same time, Gilligan has been attending classes at the prestigious Diamond University. The company's investors have great expectations for Gilligan upon his graduation.

One day, Gilligan and Butler learn about a Detection Club at the university. At the same time, a serial killer has been targeting the female students, each victim's heart ripped out from a gaping wound. As none of the hearts have been found -- apparently stolen -- the killer has been nicknamed "The King of Hearts."

Tensions have grown on campus as the female students fear becoming the next victim, and the male students fear being falsely accused as the killer. In the midst of all this, Gilligan falls in love with one of the girls, but lacks the confidence to pursue her.

Eventually, a new victim is discovered: one of the members of the Detection Club.

And the prime suspect?



Gilligan refuses to believe it. With Butler as the brains and Gilligan doing the legwork, they work together to pursue the truth and catch the true killer.

The other members of the Detection Club all have secrets they want to remain hidden. Will Gilligan come to regret the truth he ends up discovering?

What are the consequences of telling comforting lies over the harsh truth?

And what are the consequences of believing them?



The primary gameplay is within your own mind as you try and solve the mysteries yourself. The game will provide you with Case Notes and Lecture Notes to help you keep track of the characters, clues, and other important information.

You will encounter choices to personalize your experience and test your skills of deduction, but they won't significantly influence the outcome of the story. Instead, you'll be taken on an emotional rollercoaster, with many exciting twists and turns as the mysteries slowly unravel themselves.

In addition to the overarching mystery of the King of Hearts Serial Murders, each chapter has at least one dedicated mystery for you to solve. Please enjoy solving all of them!
autokwd: Detective Butler and the King of Hearts

title: Flipping Legend DX
description:
게임 정보
Flipping Legend DX is not for the faint of heart, but the rules are simple:
Move diagonally on a grid, like a bishop in chess
Flip backward to switch between light to dark squares
Smash enemies fast to maintain your health and rack up points
Unlock tons of characters each with a unique special ability
Upgrade characters to get the most out of every run

title: The Maker Way
description:
게임 정보
샌드박스 에디터에서 기계 설계
오픈 월드에서 완전 재미있게 운영하세요

올드 애리조나에서 작은 로버를 제어할 수 있습니다.
세계에서 가장 잘 보호되는 서버 팜에 침투하는 여러분의 목표는 불가능해 보입니다.
내부에서, 수백 테라바이트의 잃어버린 로봇 공학과 제작 지식이 담긴 "금지된 기술 보관소"를 검색하게 될 것입니다.
AI 혁명 이후 정부가 압수한 지식.
기계를 만들고 작동하여 재료와 부품을 수집하고 제작 능력을 확장하며 적과 싸우세요.
충분히 강력한 기계를 사용하면 서버 팜을 지키는 고급 기계를 물리치고 들어갈 수 있습니다.
기계 설계 및 작동
블록, 기계 부품 및 전자 요소를 사용하여 운전, 비행, 전투, 해킹 등이 가능한 기계를 만드세요.
다양한 부품, 물리적 사양 및 에너지 용량을 사용하여 다양한 디자인을 실험하고 제작품을 개선하세요.
새로운 부품 및 재료 찾기
오픈 월드를 탐험하여 새로운 부품 사양을 찾고 이를 사용하여 더 나은 기계를 만드세요.
기계 및 고급 메이커 베이스 구성 요소의 3D 프린팅에 필요한 재료를 찾으세요.

메이커 베이스 구축 및 확장
메이커 베이스의 용량과 성능을 높이세요.
더 크고 보다 정교한 기계를 인쇄할 수 있도록 더 많은 도구와 구성 요소를 추가하세요.
