title: Cradle-18
description:
게임 정보
I wake disoriented. Where am I? Looking out a window, I see the light reflected off the planet below. Clearly, I’m in orbit, but over a planet I don’t recognize. How did I get here? Why can’t I remember anything? Where is everyone?

Cradle-18 is a 3D walking simulator aboard an orbital space station. Explore from one compartment to the next to unravel the mystery of this deserted craft. What was the mission? And what has become of the crew? Am I truly alone?

Search for clues and collect information to piece together the answers. But space is a harsh environment, and the systems on this craft are showing signs of stress. Survival is not guaranteed.

Notes of horror. It feels uncomfortable on the uninhabited station in space.

Space ambient music. Enjoy space views to the beautiful space music. While you can.

title: Miyu's Cursed Store
description:
게임 정보
Intro
In a new alternate universe set in the early 20th century, follow Miyu, a young student, as she tries to live everyday life with her teddy bear and guide, 'Cotton'.


When Miyu's parents' reckless lifestyle causes financial harm and attracts dangerous attention, she and her loyal companion embark on a journey into the infernal realms to begin a new business venture.
Characteristics

Write Your Story: Make impactful choices to your journey as shopkeeper.

Profitable Dungeon Crawler: Explore fast-paced dungeon challenges to gain access to new useful resources for your shop.

Potion Crafting: Discover a new and exciting way to make potions.

Master the Art of Pricing: Strategically price your products to attract new customers and maximize profits.

title: Keys of Fury
description:
게임 정보
                                                                                                         No Controller
                                                                       No Mouse
                                                                 Pure Keyboard
Keys of Fury is a retro style Beat `em up typing game.
Destroy loads of enemies as you type your way to victory.
Earn coins for each perfect word typed and use them to purchase abilities, outfits, accessories, and music tracks!
                           Story Mode:  Help clear corruption from the inner city and engage in your own witty banter with the locals.  Fight a variety of enemies: robots, ninjas, vegetables throwing street venders, etc.
Tower Mode:  Battle through waves of increasingly difficultly worded enemies.  Choose upgrades between each wave to prepare for the next one.
Challenge Mode:  A Potpourri of a variety of levels including Bad Dad Jokes, Racing Dinosaurs, Reciting the Gettysburg Address, and more!
Modding:  Want to add your own word phrases, levels, and art?  Keys of Fury was designed to be easily moddable!

title: Hank's Voyage
description:
게임 정보


Join Hank on an adventure to rescue his friend and uncover the secrets of ancient Egypt!
Use your hat as a multi-purpose gadget, hide from your enemies, solve puzzles and prove that you're a world-class spy every step of the way!



In the year of 1948, a group of talented jazz musicians formed the Jazz Association of Secret Spies, also known as JASS.
Their main directive: maintain world peace at all costs.

As one of their agents goes missing in Egypt they send Hank, their most recent hire, to investigate what they believe to be a routine mission.

Join Hank in his journey to Giza as he unravels secret conspiracies and sheds light on ancient mysteries while making the most out of his high-tech hat gadget.
Help him to sneak past his enemies, use his hat gadget to solve different puzzles, and gain powers that will help him make his way through 5 distinct locations.




Use your hat as a multi-purpose gadget: Attack, Activate, Distract and use it as a platform to solve different puzzles.



Collect to unlock .



past and outwit your enemies: Fighting is not always an option. Sometimes you have to blend in the environment and go unnoticed.



Fight your way through featuring : Encounter unique enemies and gameplay challenges.



in several different and



an offbeat story with colorful characters and a .



the levels to discover all their : The levels are loaded with hidden treasures and great rewards, waiting to be found.

title: Rhythm Towers
description:
게임 정보
음악은 Planet Rhapsody의 고동입니다. 그루비한 곡들이 지속적으로 블루그래스 꽃밭을 통해 울리고, 유령 같은 황무지를 가로질러 메아리치며, 험준한 산맥 위로 울려 퍼집니다. 이러한 음악적인 곡들은 신비로운 AlgoRhythm을 보호하고 유지시키는데, 이것 없이는 Planet Rhapsody는 조용한 심연으로 붕괴될 것입니다.
이제 AlgoRhythm은 초자연적인 힘에 의해 분노에 휩쓸린 생명체들의 위협에 노출되어 있고, 당신의 도움이 필요합니다.
그래, 당신은 큰 성공을 이루지 못한 외계인 팝 그룹일지라도, 이런, 아이야, 당신에게는 용기가 있어. 그리고 비트를 유지할 수 있어. 음악이 당신의 세계니까 - 그래서 당신이 그것을 구해야 해.
음악으로 구축됨
다른 순서와 위치에 타워를 설치하여 독특한 교향곡을 만듭니다. 당신이 건설하는 각 Rhythm Tower는 사운드트랙에 새로운 음악 레이어를 동적으로 추가하여, 각 레벨의 음악적 풍경을 극적으로 변경합니다. 새로운 환경을 탐험하면서, 편안한 Lo-Fi 힙합부터 강렬하고 박진감 넘치는 드럼 앤 베이스까지 다양한 템포와 독특한 스타일의 새로운 음악 장르에 맞춰 춤추세요.

title: Diamond Sun
description:
게임 정보
An Evocative Hand-Crafted World
The world of Diamond Sun is brought to life in vivid, moody detail, its caverns alive with bizarre and terrifying creatures, each animatedin a unique 3D style. Every new area you’ll discover is beautifully unique and strange, teeming with new creatures and characters. Take in the sights and uncover new wonders hidden off of the beaten path. If you like classic gameplay, cute but creepy characters, epic adventure and beautiful, gothic worlds, then Diamond Sun awaits!

Brave the Depths of a Forsaken World
Beneath the surface of a flooded planet lies a ruined kingdom shrouded in mystery. Many venture into its depths, chasing after treasure, glory, or long-buried secrets. Diamond Sun is a classically inspired rogue-like adventure set in a sprawling, interconnected world. Traverse winding tunnels, explore lost cities, and navigate perilous landscapes; face off against fearsome foes, encounter eccentric allies, and unravel the enigmatic truths hidden at the heart of this forgotten realm.

title: Brobot
description:
게임 정보


Brobot is a single player platform game. Each stage will be released episodically. Its main character; Brobot, is a small robot. He must traverse a myriad of worlds and ultimately reach the mythical Dynamo Core to restore order to his home world.

Brobot allows the player to manipulate the direction of gravity to traverse various worlds and overcome obstacles, creating interesting and unique challenges that encourage fast-paced play while the player uncovers the truth of their purpose in the multiverse.

title: Interconnected Stories
description:
게임 정보

In each chapter of the story, you will have at your disposal a wide variety of cards with certain actions, with which you will have to help the characters involved to achieve their dreams at that moment. However, the way to fulfill these dreams will be at your whim, being able to generate really bizarre situations. In addition, you will also have in your hand the possibility of looking for alternative stories even more interesting than the original...




- Place the cards on the board to help our friendly characters in their mission
- Unlock dozens of action cards, all of them customized for the different characters
- Enjoy a wide variety of chapters, which can be solved in different ways
- Take advantage of free mode to create your own stories without the restrictions of the main mode




A great variety of characters will appear in the story, some with more relevance than others, but all with an distinctive essence:
- Carapán: a young 216-year-old dragon who, contrary to the traditions of his family, wants to dedicate himself to what is his true passion in life: the bakery.
- The Knight of the Iguana: a small town boy who has launched himself in search of adventure along with his secret weapon, which makes him immortal... at least as far as he has proven.
- Lúa: from a noble family, this astrologer has become a royal advisor fighting against imposed stereotypes, although she has an important private matter that keeps her busy...
- And more to discover! A princess, a ghost minstrel, an evil monster...

title: Buoy
description:
게임 정보
Fight the undead or learn all the ways to sneak and hide among them. Dig through the ruins of the Old World and complete missions from different factions and survivors to earn valuable resources. Risk life and limb to protect those in need, or brutally kill anyone who gets in your way. Destroy both the dead and the living with an arsenal of melee, ranged, and makeshift weapons. Crawl along the ruined streets in search of supplies and secrets.

title: Slumhack
description:
게임 정보
Slumhack is a puzzle-platformer game featuring indirect character control.
Play as Neriko, a girl living in a near-future slum with a virtual friend, and hack your way through the streets of Cynorm.
Make smart use of a variety of Action Buttons and guide Neriko to the goal!

title: NULLPTR
description:
게임 정보
nullptr is an action puzzle game that requires careful planning and precise execution. Once you're connected to one of the servers ports, you have 20 seconds to hack security systems, reprogram the server, evade sentinel programs and download data. Your goal is to find or create safe routes to download all databases in each server without being traced.
Hacking servers



You start each level disconnected from the server and must choose an open port to start your run. Ports are color coded and give you access to different parts of the server and also to different systems. Once connected to the server, you have the option to open more ports by installing backdoors that will give you additional entry points to attack the server.
Connection route



In order to download the server data, you must build a connection from an entry point to the database. The connection length determines the download time so it is wise to choose short routes. You will also need to evade security systems in your route, like firewalls that will block downloads. The route you take is also important to open gates in some servers. Data nodes included in a route contribute with their color to the connection profile that is used to match and open the gates.



Each server in the game is owned by one of the four megacorporations in the world of nullptr. In order to protect their data, each megacorporation has installed their own sentinel programs whose goal is to trace invaders and eliminate them. Fortunately, you are a hacker and once you understand how each program works, you can manipulate them by choosing specific routes or reprogramming the server using the stack memory.

title: Perikoto
description:
게임 정보
The lighthouse's bright rays pierce through the foggy sea and the dense woods, beckoning you. Restless crows peck on the roots of the trees, disturbing what's within. As you land on the frozen beach, you realize how far from home you are.
Features
Experience an immersive, tension-filled trek through deep snow and multiple locations.
Plan your route carefully, or accidentally lure the thing of the woods.
Explore abandoned buildings to solve the secret of the lighthouse.
Use various tools to make your way through challenging terrain.
Remember, do not scare the birds.
If you feel it approaching, hide.

This cold land is calling for you…

title: March March!
description:
게임 정보
전술적 전투
유닛을 간접적으로 조종해서 턴 기반 전투에 참여하세요. 가장 중요한 건 유닛이 전장에 진입하는 공격로를 선택하고, 유닛의 대형을 전략적으로 배치하는 겁니다. 몇 수 먼저 계획을 세워서 전투의 잠재력을 극대화하세요. 다양한 기술을 사용해서 아군을 지원하거나 적을 혼란에 빠뜨릴 수도 있습니다.

영웅을 선택하세요!
영웅마다 각기 독특한 기술 세트가 있습니다.

다양한 상황을 헤쳐 나갈 수 있게 도와주는 수십 가지 주문을 찾아낼 수 있습니다.
9가지 직업으로 구분되는 백여 가지 이상의 유닛들을 이용해서 나만의 전략을 개발하고 숨겨진 시너지 효과를 찾아내 보세요.

태양의 사원부터 도둑의 길드까지 다양한 장소로 가득 찬 다채로운 지도를 탐험하세요. 각각의 장소에서는 독특한 보너스를 얻을 수 있지만 모든 장소를 방문할 수는 없으므로 이동 경로에 대해 적절히 계획을 세워 보세요.
도둑이나 해골과 싸우는 데 지쳤다면, 더 강한 적들을 상대로 실력을 시험해 보세요.

취향과 플레이 방식에 맞춰 사용할 수 있는 다양한 유물을 찾아내 보세요. 그 외에도 다양한 콘텐츠가 마련되어 있습니다!

title: Enlightened
description:
게임 정보
You find yourself in the basement if the hotel, not knowing how you get there. The place seems empty, but only at the first glance...
Will you be able to overcome all obstacles on your way and solve the mystery of the hotel?

Solve multiple puzzles created by the fan of the escape rooms,
Find the clues about what happened and why are you here,
Explore multi floor hotel with variety of rooms,
Survive the horrors that exists there,
Experience disturbing scenes from nightmares created in pixel art,

title: Stellations
description:
게임 정보
Stellations is a manic arcade game about careening around mind maps. Pilot yourself through vibrating circuits where each input is tactile, twitchy, delightful. Chase, be chased, escape.
Features
Crispy, crunchy reactive visuals and audio
Frantic moment to moment gameplay set among serene constellations
Adversaries of various shapes and sizes that navigate around the web
A level editor plugged into steam workshop
Hand drawn homonculi to guide you through the mind palace
Minimal aesthetic, maximal atmosphere
Gameplay
Align to the path to gain momentum and shoot off points with timed button presses. Unique points allow you to create new connections, fly between webs, and boost through intersections. Unlock new lines by collecting and depositing nodes, hitting top speed, and a little exploration.

title: Unoffensible
description:
게임 정보
VR RTS
A classic RTS in VR. Featuring a completely new way of interacting with a RTS game. While keeping the basics like base building, resource gathering and crushing your enemy with overwhelming firepower. As the commander you stand in a futuristic war room. You can move around on the vast battlefield, or scale it down for a better overview.
Interaction
Your hands will be very powerful, but you can only use two of them. Making them the most valuable resource in your arsenal.
There are two movement systems. With the first you can use both hands, to scale, rotate or move the battlefield. With the second you can use one hand, to slide along the terrain.
Scale is important. On a scaled up terrain, you can stack structures accurately to improve their abilities. On a scaled down terrain, you can get an overview of the battlefield.
Physically grab objects to interact with them. Throw your units to move them to the right area. Grab missiles out of the air and throw them at the enemy. Construct a unit by dragging its icon onto the battlefield.

title: MegaBattle
description:
게임 정보




Get ready for Megabattle, a roguelike card game that combines strategic deckbuilding elements with the thrill of epic robot battles. Build a custom deck and embark on a procedurally generated journey, facing increasingly challenging trials.



In Megabattle, each victory brings valuable rewards in the form of parts and upgrade cards. Utilize these resources to enhance your deck, making your robot more powerful and resilient. During battles, strategically play cards to improve your parts, attack opponents, and defend against enemy assaults.



Explore various robot classes, each with their own unique characteristics and obtainable parts. Discover new attack cards and exclusive power-ups to strengthen your arsenal and adapt to different battle strategies.



With an immersive sci-fi/futuristic atmosphere, Megabattle transports you to a universe filled with robots, advanced technology, and thrilling action.

Prepare for battle and claim victory in Megabattle!

title: Neebota: Zeebo's Nightmare
description:
게임 정보
ENTER ZEEBO'S NIGHTMARE
Zeebo wakes up multiple times at night after the most bizarre dream where his body painfully morphs. Home alone, he mourns his parents' recent death with only his best friends and pet Hekke by his side. But no one knows just why his nightmares are this intense. As he receives a dream helmet and dream controller through his best friend Laurencia, Zeebo now has the tools to take control of his dream...and find out what's happening to him.
INTO THE FRAY
A dungeon-crawling action-RPG in a surreal nightmare with mind-bending levels and surreal events. Rich in lore, it's set in an entirely original fantasy world called Neebota. Face bizarre creatures as well yourself in different forms, as you transform yourself to gain new abilities and defeat the worst demons haunting Zeebo's mind in a quest to overcome the self.

title: Spice Sacrifice
description:
게임 정보
Spice Sacrifice is a JRPG style game with randomized action-platformer battles.



Travel through an underworld full of caves of guts and bones, or goo and piercings or other fantastical stuff. But watch out for the spice that permeates the air, it will transport your character's minds to a dimension full of dangerous beasts that they must fight. Not to mention all the other dangers that keep getting people killed in gruesomely bizarre ways.

Two of the main characters are Oregano - the anxious wreck who must rescue his boyfriend, and Yonko Donko - the punk donkey with amnesia. The story will feature themes of sexuality, mental health, queer comradery, and finding a sense of place in a hostile world.



Outside of battle, Spice Sacrifice plays like a JRPG with in-depth story segments, towns, dungeons, managing equipment and items, leveling up and collecting things, and minigames.

Travel the overworld to find and hang out with various NPC's and grow friendships with them and advance the story. The gameplay has lots of intertwining systems to keep everything deep and addicting.



When you enter a battle, the game becomes an action-platformer with completely randomized levels. A random-gen system makes each screen unique, with random wall layouts, enemy placements, powerups, etc. Avoid the enemy's spells and use a variety of high-impact attacks to survive.
The game has an ensemble cast of playable characters and NPCs, such as:






A few accessibility options we'll include:

title: LIMYN
description:
게임 정보


In the colorful soundscapes of LIMYN, you rotate with the rhythm, guiding a delicate thread through a geometric maze. Each rotation, a tick in time; each transition, a note in an ever-evolving melody. Obstacles dance, enemies lurk, but you are in command.

LIMYN evokes the simple gameplay of turn-based puzzlers like Hitman GO, but with skill-based obstacles that will challenge your musical timing.

Find the flow.

title: TOCOViX
description:
게임 정보
TOCOViX is a turn-based strategy game where 2-4 players take turn to place Crosses on the game board. The goal of the game is to combine Crosses to create "Shapes", which award points and "Stops". The purpose of Stops is to hinder opponents by preventing them from completing Shapes. A player is unable to move when all of the boxes on the board surrounding their Crosses are already occupied. The match is over when all players are unable to move or when the last standing player has more points than the others.
Levels
Choose between 10 levels with 3 different starts each. As you progress with the game levels get more complex.
Tutorials
From the Main Menu you can access tutorials with a detailed description of every game mechanic. Each explanation is made of both text and animations and can be interrupted at any moment.
TOCOViX comes with hard challenges which range from winning all levels against the CPU to conquering a certain number of boxes in a single match. Complete a challenge to obtain a Trophy and obtain all Trophies to unlock a special Cross!
Thanks to dedicated servers you can challenge other players from around the world! Every time you complete a match online you are awarded or deducted points from your online score. Challenge other players to rise through the ranks and enter the Diamond League!

title: Church of Shadows
description:
게임 정보
In a forgotten church, sealed away for centuries, a dark presence waits to be freed. You are the only one who can stop it—an unlikely hero chosen by a preacher on his last legs. Your task is deceptively simple: burn the books and break the curse. But the task is anything but easy.
Features:
Survive a Maze of Fear: Explore a dark, abandoned church where every shadow holds danger. The environment twists and shifts as the witch manipulates reality, keeping you on edge.
Face Five Unique Demons: Each demon is bound to a cursed book and has its own behavior and hunting style. From the crawling horror of Dal’Gan to the towering brute Verinnath, you’ll need strategy and courage to evade them.
Confront the Witch: Once the demons are defeated, Emelyn herself will appear. She can block doorways, twist hallways, and manipulate your surroundings, making her the ultimate challenge.
Dynamic Fire Mechanics: To burn the cursed books, you must light a cauldron. Choose wisely: using a regular flame may result in failure, but combining lanterns around the church creates a blue, everlasting fire that guarantees success.
Sanity Management: Demons and the witch can break your mind. Protect yourself using crosses to temporarily banish threats, but be careful—resources are limited, and the church itself drains your sanity.
High Replayability: Randomized book and demon spawn locations, along with shifting hallways, ensure that no two playthroughs are the same.
Terrifying Atmosphere: With dynamic lighting, sound design, and jump scares, the church becomes a living nightmare that pulls you deeper into its horrors.
Story to Unravel: Learn the tragic tale of Emelyn Hawke, a healer betrayed by her village and transformed into something monstrous after making a dark pact. Clues scattered around the church reveal the truth behind her vengeance.
Will you break the curse and escape? Or will the witch claim yet another soul?

title: Freerunners
description:
게임 정보
Freerunners is a game about giving the feeling of freerunning (Parkour). Finding a flow and an underlying rhythm of movement as you traverse through your environment in the quickest time possible.

Start off a total noob and become a skilled pro, learning new moves along the way. Vault, climb, jump, duck, swing, flip, slide, do what it takes to travel as fast as possible whilst using your environment to outwit the enemy henchmen who have kidnapped your freerunning teacher and are hunting you down.

Be Fast, Be Fluid, Be Direct!
Key Features:
50 Fast-paced Levels - Think quick and solve problems on the move in fast-paced action-packed levels.

Fail, Retry, Refine - You're going to fail a bunch as you find your flow but refine your timing and technique and watch as you improve and flow more seamlessly through your environment.

Use Your Environment - Outwit evil henchmen using the environment and your freerunning skills.

title: Kosmos Connections
description:
게임 정보
"In this story, the choices you make only matter as much as you want them to.

Your perception of these events will determine your outlook on what transpires.

'There is no such thing as a subjective truth…

only interpretations of an incomplete picture.'”

✧*:・ﾟ✧*:・ﾟ✧*:・ﾟ✧*:・ﾟ✧ *:・ﾟ✧

“Kazuhira Hatanaka is the man behind the Soul Uplink, a machine that uploads people’s souls to a digital world called the Datascape. However, when his assistant Nona runs the first test, it all goes wrong. She finds something in the Datascape that shouldn’t be there; something that gave her a sense of loss…” …At least, that’s the story of Uplink Alethia, the visual novel that Tau, your childhood friend, has created.


Welcome (back) to Kosmos, Adelfos! After being away for a long time, you return with your sister Runia for the final week of your winter vacation. With no hesitation, Tau asks you and Jennavieve, the mysterious café owner, to bug-test her game. Kosmos Connections contains two visuals novels in one – the short story of Uplink Alethia, and the fuller narrative that is Kosmos Connections. You must choose to spend your time wisely in order to build up your connections or even rekindle some. At the same time, you are helping out Tau by giving feedback on her game, experiencing a new chapter each day to analyze and discuss. Will you find out the truth of Kosmos, or forever be complacent where you stand?

title: Sketchy Fables
description:
게임 정보
You wake up in your bedroom, at home, with a mysterious card in hand—a heartfelt invitation to visit your grandmother, who resides in the tallest skyscraper of the bustling city. The world is open before you, but will you set out to see her, or will unexpected events lead you down a completely different path? The choice is yours.
🎨 Fully Hand-Drawn World
Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted game world featuring over 10,000 unique, hand-drawn and animated artworks.
🗺️ Epic Exploration
Embark on a journey through diverse environments, from charming villages to vast, rural landscapes, each brimming with life and mystery.
🔍 Uncover the Unknown
Dive into engaging questlines, discover hidden collectibles, unravel deep secrets, and challenge your mind with intricate puzzles.
✨ Personalized Adventure
Experience a game focused on personal exploration, filled with countless random encounters and surprises waiting to be found.
🎵 Play the Handpan
Discover the soothing tones of the handpan—a unique musical instrument you can play within the game to create immersive soundscapes. Your music can solve puzzles, lift spirits, and shape the world around you.
Let your curiosity guide you—this game is a celebration of creativity, wonder, and discovery.

title: Residuum
description:
게임 정보
In Residuum, players take on the role of a team of miners on Mars, tasked with defending their base from unexpected invaders. With a combination of tower defense and shooter gameplay, players will build structures and mine resources to upgrade their weapons and crew. Each game session lasts 20-30 minutes and players can earn rewards that they can use to upgrade their base in between games.

With a futuristic setting and a variety of enemy types, players will need to use strategy and quick thinking to survive. The addition of unique crew members with special abilities adds another layer of depth to the game, allowing players to choose their team and tailor their strategy to each game session.

Residuum is a thrilling and fast-paced experience, perfect for players looking for a challenging and rewarding tower defense game. So grab a friend and get ready to defend your base on the Red Planet!

title: Seekers Alliance
description:
게임 정보
Seeker's Alliance is a fast-paced Trading Card Game (TCG) where players choose Hero Units from one of three powerful Factions to build decks and embark on an epic adventure across a vast island. As they face off against other players and complete challenges posed by the island's Ruler, players must hunt down the 100 elusive Bounty Cards scattered across the land to become the island's next Ruler.
Each with their own goals and desires, fighting by your side are Heroes from three different Factions, including: 
Van der Leck Family
The Van der Leck Family is a rising star in the Sea of Data. Members are impulsive, young, and ambitious, yet possess the cold ruthlessness and wisdom to see the big picture.
House Galahad
Members of House Galahad are skilled hackers, relentless dreamers, and the fearless pioneers who first ventured into the new world.

title: Mort's Dream Jump
description:
게임 정보
Mort's Dream Jump is a fun, fast-paced platformer that challenges you to beat a series of handcrafted levels using a variety of tools. Double jumps, light dashes, jet packs, and the omnimover are all at your disposal as you navigate obstacles and make your way through each stage. Unlock new stages by collecting challenge stars and make your way through Mort's bizarre dream.

This early demo is a proof of concept and example for the kinds of single-screen stages you can expect in the full title. Rather than develop in private, I'll be posting new builds directly to Steam, where you can try new stages and help shape the development of the game.

All art assets, music, and stages are in a very work-in-progress state, and do not reflect the final version of the game.

title: A Short Tale of Solitude
description:
게임 정보
A Short Tale of Solitude is an adventure horror game, combining exploration, puzzles and survival where the gameplay is focused on fear mechanics.

The game takes place during the Great War in the Victorian orphanage, somewhere in the Northen France. Player take on the role of Sebastien, 10 - years old boy, who after the death of his parents was sent away to this forgotten by God place, full of nightmares, and violence. Upon arrival, the boy realizes that childrens have been abandoned by adult guardians and their leader has become insane and mysterious Jonathan. Who is he? Why is he so cruel? What exactly happened to Sebastian's parents? These are just a few questions, which answers can be deadly...

A Short Tale of Solitude heavily inspired by the Lord of the Flies and weird fiction work of H. P. Lovecraft, E. A. Poe and Stefan Grabiński mixed with 90's horror games and movies.


Key Features:
Classic survival horror mechanics.
Monochromatic old school art style.
A huge, explorable orphanage with surrounding areas (about 180 locations).
Your decisions on the main quest can have long-lasting impacts on the rest of the game.
Multiple endings and hidden extras.
Sanity meter.

title: Divinoids
description:
게임 정보
Pilot one of several unique Divinoids, alien mecha that change back and forth between God and Mythical Beast forms. Destroy human armies, demolish their cities and conquer their planets. Up to four players co-op.

Travel through procedurally generated galactic sectors; land on planets to explore and conquer.
Highly destroyable everything; climb and destroy buildings, cities and giant bosses piece by piece.
Each Divinoid is entirely unique; no shared moves or even climb mechanics.
Shapeshift between unique God and Mythical Beast forms to handle any situation.
Equip weapons and passive modules for deep customization and replayability.
Eject from your Divinoid when it's destroyed, and keep fighting on foot.
Grab a submarine and throw it at a helicopter!

title: The Realm of Order: Arisen
description:
게임 정보
Enter the kingdom of Mythuras: a proud and mighty human kingdom, and face the greatest threat that the land has yet to see. The dead themselves have arisen.
EXPLORE AND EXPERIENCE THE KINGDOM
Every area of Mythuras is open for exploration. Speak with citizens, inspect items and explore hidden areas to learn the story of the kingdom that you fight for.
There are no right path to saving Mythuras - you must pick the one you deem the safest, fastest or most empowering.
CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF COMBAT
Whether you are a vicious warrior wielding a sword and plate armour, a swift archer who excels in ranged combat or even a great sorcerer with great intellect, you can always get stronger. Buy new weapons and protection from the merchants scattered across the land, or search for them yourself in the darkest corners of the forests.
WORK TOWARD YOUR GOAL
With so many paths to take and so many ways to improve, play through the undead crisis over again, and find the best possible way to save Mythuras. Whether it makes you stronger, faster or perhaps most knowledgable.
MADE TO FEEL LIKE A CLASSIC GAME
The Realm of Order: Arisen is specifically designed to look, sound and feel like a game from years ago. With many old technologies researched and simulated, experience nostalgia without replaying a game from the past.

title: Immune Simulator Type Z
description:
게임 정보
Immune Simulator is a strategy-adventure game.

The story describes a world in which humans are fighting against zombies and losing. The female protagonist accidentally finds an old computer with software that records the process of human-zombie conflicts, much like historical documents.

The protagonist attempts to operate the computer and view these historical records but discovers that the historical data can be changed. After leaving the machine, the balance of power between humans and zombies in the real world also changes. Just as she thinks she can use this machine to turn the tide against the zombies, her companions begin to change one by one.

Is this machine a salvation from God or a trap from the devil? What secrets are hidden in this machine? It's up to the player to discover.

title: Rules of Alchemy
description:
게임 정보

Rules of Alchemy is a spell combo roguelike with thousands of items, deep rpg systems, fast-paced strategic combat, and a procedurally generated world full of secrets. Mix your spells with each other, the environment, and your weapon, as you master thousands of combinations to decimate your foes!
MASTER THE ELEMENTS
Unlock over 100 spells on the Runegate and discover even more hidden spells as you play the game. In Rules of Alchemy spells are cast by combining other spells in real time. This unique system will have you experimenting with tons of different loadouts. Learn to counter enemy spells and turn them into your own. You can even use the environment or items as part of your combo.
Find your perfect playstyle among the 9 classes and their weapon types. From sword and shield, to dual lances, each weapon class provides a unique combat system that evolves the further you progress in the game. Experience the unique combo system and master every weapon’s perks and techniques. Discover legendary weapons and use them to augment your spells, reach hidden areas, and defeat secret bosses.
Craft, transmute, trade, equip and level up thousands of procedural items. Combined with a deep rpg stat system, a massive spell tree, and 7 procedural biomes, Rules of Alchemy will have every run feeling fresh and exciting. Meet a wide range of NPCs and access different rare items, epic quests, boss fights and climatic endings, all based on the dialog, items, and stats you choose.
A dark force has corrupted the land and the torn have begun to invade. It is said only the Philosopher's Stone can repair this broken world and drive out the dark forces. Discover the mysteries of an ancient people and seek out answers to your immortality. Unlock the power of the runegate and find the traitorous alchemist within your ranks.









***Many features listed are not available in the demo

title: Get Bento!
description:
게임 정보
Get Bento! is a bento box-building puzzle game.

Design sushi and add them to your bento box for today's lunch. Sort and arrange your tasty treats neatly, ensuring they all fit into your lunch box.

Get Bento! follows a young girl during her holiday break as she packs delicious snacks into her bento box to take to her summer job.
FEATURES

Lunch Box
80 cutesy hand drawn sushi and other bento box tasties for you to collect and arrange in your lunch box.
Levels
The games has 100 levels designd to stimulate your puzzling needs.
Arcade Modes
If you can't get enough of organising sushi into your bento box you'll love the extra modes crafted to keep the fun going indefinitely.
Steam Deck
The game is the perfect relaxation game built for the steam deck and controller but works beautifully with a mouse too.

title: Typhoon Unit ~ Butterfly Requiem
description:
게임 정보


Typhoon Unit ~ Butterfly Requiem is a bullet hell shooting adventure where you swap between a trio of heroes on the fly!

Take control of Gale, Fia, and Casey, three flying fighters with their own unique abilities! Through strategic character swaps, and the power of Synergy Boost, you can overwhelm your foes with tactics and style!


In a land where fantasy and technology intertwine, cities across the world are under attack. The only thing connecting these incidents is the Steel Butterfly, a sword wielding butterfly woman who brings destruction in her wake.

The Typhoon Unit, a small but capable band of airborne heroes, have been called in to put a stop to the threat. Can the Typhoon Unit halt the Steel Butterfly's conquest, and discover her secrets?

title: Tentoria
description:
게임 정보
Lyss, the Deadeye



Experience the story of Lyss, the Deadeye. A badass femme fatale hitman with countless successful missions behind her, and no failures. That is, until the story begins...
Lyss, the Beast



Cursed by the God himself, she will wreak havoc in the world to quell her burning desire for revenge! She will sunk so deep and completely lose her humanity that she will be known as .



Experience the story of someone that went to hell and back to cleanse themselves. Killing demons might be easy for someone as strong as her; but when it comes to fighting with her inner demons, she will struggle a lot. Some will even talk about her as .



After series of events, her rage will subside; and she will try to live peacefully in isolation. But people, demons, even the dead will never stop bothering .



In the end, she will find her place among the society. But this is not a "they lived happily ever after" ending, on the contrary, people will try to take down .



But no fool can do harm to !

Hey there, I'm a solo developer working very hard on this game. I always loved the character action genre since my childhood. Making such a game was in my mind for more than 15 years; but I never had the courage to jump into such a monumental task. After working in the industry for years; I had earned all the necessary experience over time, and one day I felt that I should just do it! Even though I would have loved to work with a team, I want to make the first game in the franchise all by myself to test myself. If people likes this game and supports me financially, I would love to expand the franchise with a sequel and a team of professionals!

You can add the game to your wishlist if you want to support me, and by doing so, you can get notified about the early access discounted sale! I don't plan on making huge discounts to the game in it's first years, and early access sale will be the cheapest you can get it to show my appreciation for the early supporters!

For those that want to see more, I'm documenting the evolution of characters in the game on my ArtStation account. Checking them might give you some ideas about the game. Here is the link for it:

Feel free to join the community over Reddit:

In future, there will be a dedicated Discord server for the game, also I will monitor Steam forums for bug reports.

Now that you know how to reach me, feel free to ask anything!

title: Omni Axes
description:
게임 정보
Omni Axes is an authentic 3D shooting game. You play in a 3D cube space and take down the enemies coming at you from all directions to aim for a high score.

You move along the three axes using your keyboard and change the camera angle and target location with your mouse. Fly anywhere you want in the 3D space as you evade, aim and shoot. This game takes the essence of shooting games and refines each element.

The difficulty goes up as you play, so you can feel yourself progressing as you advance through the game.

Main Features:
- Completely different game modes for you to enjoy
- Flashy and exhilarating hit effects
- Original chiptune soundtrack
- Many model designs, from traditional to cute!

title: Auto GUI Battler
description:
게임 정보
A single player only PvE autobattler that is purely GUI (graphical user inteface). Manage dealt cards (units). Combine units to level them up. Upgrade items.
Survive 50 randomized rounds that are highly replayable. No synergy system, no other maps/campaigns, no meta-progression.
How much content there is
Around 90+ different units, 60+ different enemies, and around 30 items. Enemies are placed on the board in various randomized configurations. There are also a variety of skills and status effects.
There are additional difficulty modes such as instant-death and nightmare mode to provide more challenge for veteran players.
Gameplay
(The demo ends at 36 rounds rather than the full 50 rounds)
The game consists of 50 rounds, each lasting 50 seconds. Every 5 rounds, the game automatically saves to provide a checkpoint. Additionally, items are dispensed every 5 rounds.
Combine 3 units of the same name and level to level up the unit. Max level is 3.

title: One More Encounter
description:
게임 정보
One More Encounter: The Game That Never Was
On November 17, 1992, a small group of three developers released a video game like no other. Only available for the NEC PC-9801 computer, this was the most ambitious game the industry had ever conceived. Unfortunately, it was a sales failure and was lost in the abyss of time.
More than 30 years later, One More Encounter (a.k.a OME) has been partially revived. One More Encounter was a dungeon crawler where the important thing was not the motif, but the journey itself and the characters we encountered along the way. Unfortunately, only 0.35% of the total game could be saved. That is, of the more than two thousand possible encounters in the game, this version only contains seven.
Be that as it may, this is a look at a world that could have been, an industry that never really took hold, and a type of videogame that, so many years later, we are still struggling to make.
Over 6 different characters (there are 8 characters)
More than 20 minutes of gameplay (if you're a slow reader)
Two or more endings (but you can only get one)
Dynamic narrative text (because one letter appears after another)
Disclaimer
Due to problems with the game executable itself, it may have to be restarted several times to complete the game fully. We have tried our best not to do this, but something has prevented us from doing so. We have not been able to find the reason. We hope that, with your help, we can solve this mystery together.
Content Warning
The game has graphic depictions of violence, self-mutilation, and blood. Please, be very careful.
Created by Diego Freire
Art and UI by Fran Segura
SFX and Music by Javier Calderón

description:

title: RECURSOR
description:
게임 정보

RECURSOR has an extensive moveset allowing you complete freedom of movement! For the speedrunners and labbers, RECURSOR comes with a debug mode to move frame by frame, view your current state, see hitboxes and more!

Inspired by the scifi films and anime of the 80s and 90s, RECURSOR frames the game within a computer terminal / CCTV station that grants the user the ability to monitor and control the RECURSOR robot.

title: Hypnotix
description:
게임 정보
What is Hypnotix?
Hypnotix is a guided meditation mindfulness app which will take you on a different journey every time you click 'Start'.

This app is not for the faint of heart, as you will need to completely let go and prepare to be taken to unknown places within your mind . . .

Featuring:

* Algorithms that put together a different meditation journey each time, by chaining different sound files into varying combinations.
* Hundreds of meditation sound files.
* Mystery lockboxes and other awards to unlock, as a reward for time spent in meditation.
What is the aim of this app?
The focus is on you 100%. My aim is to help you unwind, relax, and take you on many exotic, unpredictable, mysterious and fun journeys.
How is this app different to most other meditation apps?
The guided meditations are put together using algorithms which build a different relaxing experience every time, using hundreds of different sound files. The guided meditations are almost hypnotic. Hypnotix is a sister app to 'Boot Camp Fitness' but focusing on mindfulness and relaxation rather than physical health and exercise.

This is not your standard, hit the spacebar and time your mediations app.
Can I control the journey in any way?
No, you will have no control whatsoever, which gives Hypnotix its appeal. There are some player settings where you can turn on or off suggestions for healthy eating, regular exercise, stress management, confidence building etc, but beyond that you will have no control. However, despite being unorthodox and unpredictable Hypnotix only takes you to positive places.
The development road map
The aim is to add more and more mystery journey meditation sound files to expand the game further and further. With many journeys shaped and influenced by players.
When using Hypnotix, please find a safe space where you can close your eyes, either by lying down or sitting comfortably. Do not use this app when driving, using heavy machinery or any other activity that requires waking attention.

High Elo Girls is an esports visual novel about ambition, competition, and pursuing your dreams to become stronger. Experience the career of a newly minted professional player; from her initial trials, all the way to finally competing in a major tournament. Along the way you’ll confront themes of new adulthood, trust, rivalry and the challenges we face when we embrace the climb.
Featuring
A newcomer-friendly tour of the MOBA esports scene
5 Team Roles to Play (Top Lane, Jungle, Mid Lane, DPS, and Support)
5 Teammates to Befriend, Romance, or Antagonize
Choice-based MOBA Simulations featuring narrative-changing decisions

But when you’re invited to join Momentum Gaming (MMG), you finally have the chance to prove to the world, what you’re really made of. title: Pedro and Sofia's Nuclear Winter

게임 정보
Earth in 2240 had survived war, ecological threats, alien invasions and more, but after all countries exhausted their nuclear stockpiles during the last war, the world was sent back into the Dark Ages. The United States was broken into kingdoms and the lands outside of their reach were populated with mutated orcs, evil mages and entire rogue armies.



Pedro and Sofia, siblings who were questing through the open lands, are called into service to a kingdom in need, where a strange new cult has been converting the local populace and building their own radiated army. Soon, they uncover a mystery across America that must be stopped before Earth is led to its final, nuclear annihilation.

Features:
Over 60 unique skills and more than 500 different types of weapons and equipment to find or build
Fully immersive 3D environments, including a massive, open-world with dungeons, towns and mysterious locations
A unique crafting system to build and upgrade a variety of weapons, armor and more
Real-time, action-RPG combat and a story-rich quest that takes place across America
Three different characters with original stories to play as and build with unique job classes
Hours and hours of quests and surprising adventures, plus fully playable on Steam Deck

title: SpaceDominator
description:

Join World of SpaceDominator!

expand your civilization, colonize planets, communicate, make enemies or friends, explore universe and experience adventures!
Explore universe!

Expand your civilization!

Explore a massive interconnected ocean world.
Face enemies and bosses that threaten the kingdom.
Acquire new weapons, items, and abilities as you progress.
Help friendly sea critters by completing tasks.
Overcome puzzling challenges along the way.
Fun mini-games and extras.
Cute pixel art and original soundtrack.

A player can experience the adventure in a fantasy world while looking around 360 degrees in VR.

Relive your imagination in your youth, 'Diving into the imaginary world' with VR !

title: Crawling Silence
description:
게임 정보
Crawling Silence is a survival horror game featuring an online co-op and singleplayer escape mode.. When playing, the players must find clues and solve puzzles to uncover the secrets hidden within the building. During your exploration, you must find one of multiple ways out of the building, utilizing items randomly hidden around the map. But beware, mistakes may alert creatures hiding behind every corner....
The setting
Crawling Silence is set in an old, long forgotten building shrouded in mystery, the secrets of which you must uncover.
But beware, various dangerous creatures may lurk in the dark...
The monsters you encounter while uncovering the secrets within the building have full access to vents, rooms and secret areas, so be cautious...

Many elements of the game are puzzle based
There are various hidden doors and passages which you can discover, and maybe find helpful clues or items!
or they will turn against you, and force you to react quickly!

title: Volleyhalla
description:
게임 정보
Enter the world of Volleyhalla, a hectic, frantic "battle-tennis" game. Defend the flock, destroy evil.

Engage in ritualized barbarian shepherd combat, which coincidentally happens to look a little bit like ping pong.
As the last Battle Shepherd, it's up to you to guard your herd from marauding beasts and harvest wool to trade for essential resources.
With each victory, you'll restore your land and uncover ancient secrets hidden beneath the soil.
Along the way, unlock unique characters who bring their own skills and stories to your journey.
Find and purchase new Weapons and Shields to complement your playstyle and vanquish your foes.
Wield unique Magics to give you an edge over your ruthless opponents and turn the tide.
Your destiny is to rebuild, protect, and save Volley Valley—will you rise to the challenge?

title: Castle Come
description:
게임 정보
Join our community on discord:


Castle Come is a walking fortress roguelike. Scout a strange land full of bandits in search of new parts, defeat enemy fortresses and scavenge the wreckage, recruit crew to man your growing arsenal of weapons and build your way from an agile little fortling into a deadly, hulking, monster machine.

Assemble your fortress
Buy and scavenge new weapons, mods and towers to grow your fortress from a little fortling to a hulking monster. Easily drag and drop machine gun turrets, mine launchers, modifiers, tractor beams, chicken pens, flamethrowers, giant boulders and much more.
It’s not just bandits roaming these dangerous lands. You will have to battle and defeat other walking fortresses. Scavenge their wreckage for parts to become more powerful, or you’ll become scrap for them to do the same!
Switch to a Tekken-inspired 2.5D fighting view when engaging in combat to make use of sidesteps, dodges and rams. Be mindful of rocks, walls and other environmental features that might hem you in as you seek to control the space in battle and avoid your enemies’ attacks.
Take advantage of a stylish time-slowing feature that kicks in whenever you line up a shot from one of your arsenal of weapons. Take control of every weapon yourself, or leave your crew to fire at will as you juggle active reloads, cooldowns and movement in the search for maximum efficiency on the battlefield.
The wreck of your old fortress in your previous failed run can be discovered as an overgrown ruin with parts to pickover as you take on the hopes of the next generation, or a house you protected might have grown into a flourishing village. The impact of your past actions are always felt in the future, even if you failed.
In Castle Come, you are born into a world enclosed by mighty walls, with a mysterious gate shrouded in legend offering the only way out. The gate will only let the biggest mech in each zone through. Progress through gates to explore and gather resources, discover Forges and ultimately uncover the mystery of who built these gates and why you’ve been trapped behind them.

title: Yours Truly
description:

A puzzle platforming adventure that explores themes of being trapped in an unfulfilling life leading to self-discovery, emotional reconciliation, and following dreams. Along the way, players will encounter challenges such as climbing obstacles, solving puzzles, collecting shiny objects, and confronting negative emotions in the form of bosses.


Yours Truly explores themes of happiness and fulfillment through various psychological and philosophical perspectives. This narrative-driven platformer aims to connect, teach, and inspire players by sharing universal experiences of hope, pain, struggle, and aspiration
Players must skillfully and cleverly take control of Liam to help him find himself through his journey. Throughout this strange place, players will find progressively challenging obstacles, puzzles, side quests, and hidden encounters that will lead Liam home.

description:

Welcome to Lone Planet: start a journey on your lonely planet to discover the birth and fate of the universe. While in search of the meaning of life, live this light adventure playing with unusual physics, in a puzzle platform manner.

The game offers (but is not limited to):
Moments of contemplation
(Bad) humor
Deep lore
Easy platform sections
Slightly harder platform sections
Science references

Everything presented to you through: colorful vector art.

title: A Ruthless World
description:
게임 정보
As an employee of Juice™, you wake up to a beautiful new day. While the urge to get to work is strong, there’s still time to tidy up at home and choose your outfit for the day. Once everything feels just right, you head off to your beloved Juice™ battery factory.
In this puzzle adventure, featuring 80s-styled graphics and modern physics, things are not always as straightforward as they seem. What starts as a simple journey to get to work turns into an adventure filled with obstacles, strange creatures, and inexplicable events.
Easy controls using keyboard, gamepad or touch input
Learn new abilities and combine them as game progresses
Bite-sized levels* with unique problems to solve
Character customization
Should run on a potato, see requirements for specifics

title: Critias Empire
description:
게임 정보
Critias Empire is a Turn-Based Strategy game where you build your empire without war, combat and rival civilizations. Instead danger comes from Disasters rained down by the Gods of Olympus.
This is a game for those who like the empire building of 4X games, as opposed to war and conflict, but still want a challenging dynamic world to play in.
In Critias Empire, the ancient Gods are vengeful and scheming. They will rain disasters down on your civilization, altering the map as volcanoes spew lava, floods wash away the land and earthquakes cause mountains to rise and crumble.
Each God has their own personality, desires and their own signature disaster. Give too much attention to Zeus and Poseidon may get angry, washing away your coastal settlements with a terrible storm!

title: Spirit of Midnight
description:
게임 정보
Spirit of Midnight is a charming adventure game. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

Use and combine items in your inventory to solve situational puzzles in humorous ways. Sit back, interact, and be entertained. Professionally scored with original music and nighttime vibes. Controller play recommended.

Play an introduction to the game before release in *** Spirit of Midnight: Prologue *** today!

title: Miuma
description:
게임 정보
Do you remember your aunt from fifteen years ago, your aunt fussing in the kitchen during the early morning to prepare the pastries for the first customers? The nostalgia of baked delectables, the scent of aged wood, and the compassionate atmosphere of family all caused your heart to twinge. Suddenly, your old house was tragically abandoned, and the glory of the former bakery was only but a distant memory that was lost in the past. After so many years, could you revive the family business and return home, accepting the challenge?

In this absorbing adventure, you can provide your fellow neighbors with luscious, lip-smacking cakes, pies, and rolls; you can engage in different handicrafts, participate in the town's fests and fairs, delight in the hymns of nature, contemplate about your town's historical streets, intriguingly interact with those around you, and explore the lore together with Kevin!

This video-game creation has both a colorful gameplay with endless possibilities and a captivating plot. A story of a timeless town is told through its vivid residents, including the protagonist Kevin and his ancestors. Free will acts as a guardian: decisions and freedom are bestowed upon you with the bittersweet responsibility of further consequences. You are allowed to decide for yourself—from a certain day's tasks to the revelation of unseen opportunities.

Sometimes, one can face barriers with which they cannot cope. Sometimes, one makes inevitable, daunting mistakes and makes the wrong decisions. Sometimes, the world does not turn out to be as open and tender as one had wondered in their childhood of purity. Instead, one can be met with the unmerciful, shattering apathy of reality. Even so, you have the spirit to keep your welcoming heart warm to let love spread and to live life to the fullest.

This game is not just a simple bakery simulator: it's a story about a young man whose fate was to resume family traditions of baking and about a man who can reject these traditions—but ... does he want to? Your life is devised by your habits, the choices that function as the fragments to your very being.

title: Dimakerus
description:
게임 정보
Dynamic Combat
In the ancient times, one had to survive by any means. Embrace the multiple ways of combat, such as sharp slashes and blunt strikes, finishings, strangling and weapon-throwing mechanics... and a moderate amount of fire!
As the enemies have as much chance to succeed as you, make use of a huge arsenal of deadly gear, varying from slicing blades such as sickles and gladius to crude maces and gigantic halberds, as you shed the blood of your enemies on the sands.
Fire System
Fire has changed the course of history. Use the devastating properties of this elementum combined with the environment to annihilate your foes, spook animals and put into practice your combat pyromaniac strategies!

title: Tales Of The Death
Twin Jet Racer
description:
게임 정보
Built For Speed

What do you get when you bolt a pair of jets onto a road cruiser hovership? A freakin’ rocket, that’s what! They’re blazing fast, they can climb the walls and even fly.

Sure, these ships are fast but they’re so much more than that. Swerve, drift, corkscrew, loop the loop - whatever environment you’re in, it’s just you versus the physics. And when you take off, you don’t come down until you decide it’s time!


Forget what you know about handling cars, bikes, even hoverships. These things are different. Start with the basics: left and right thrust is all you’ll need at first. Then later you can start easing into the pitch and strafe controls to give you that edge. And when you’ve mastered one vehicle, there’s another more powerful beast waiting to be tamed.


Compete against friends or against the clock in a series of timed checkpoint challenges in different environments, from tight tracks to open playgrounds. And with community modded race tracks, there are always new challenges to take on.

title: Tall Poppy 2
description:
게임 정보
About the game

In Tall Poppy 2, the tense exploration, action and puzzle-solving gameplay will keep players on their toes! Players join John and Emma Goldberg, a married couple who are forced to face the mischievous Tall Poppy and his new lackeys together!

With the sinister spirit unleashed, the island city of Boots Bay's population is slowly being possessed! Players will navigate through the city carefully so that they can avoid capture or possession all while trying to escape Tall Poppy's terror!

Both John and Emma have their own separate playable campaigns, allowing players to see the story from both characters’ perspectives. The fate of these two characters is in the players' hands as they work together to survive and get to the bottom of what is behind the terrifying attack on the city. Will they make it out alive?

Exciting gameplay – Engage in frantic combat with enemies, explore frightening corridors, solve puzzles to access areas and collect and use items discovered around the environment in a terrifying comedic fight for survival
Shooting - If players find the taser gun, they can shoot taser rounds and the Boots Bay citizens! With enough rounds, they can zap the possession out of them! Be careful though, rounds are hard to come by!
Climbing - Players can climb hard-to-reach areas!
Talking to characters - The world has some interesting characters to converse with!
Collecting objects - There are different objects in the world that will need to be collected and used for various reasons!
Inspecting - Players can inspect items for secret details, codes and lore!
Push/Pull - Moving objects out of the way or to help climb up a hard-to-reach place!










Welcome to the island of Boots Bay! The island is located in the middle of the pristine freshwater of Lake Huron. It was founded and built by French settlers in the year 1666 after a military conflict. It was a military outpost that later converted into a successful trading outpost. The indigenous population and French had trading relations that were very historic and highly regarded! Speaking of history, historians claim the island is named after the arc angel Bootelbub. However, some speculate it was named after the trading post's popular bever pelt boots!

Legend has it that there's a deeply hidden secret about the island's past. Some say they feel like they're being pulled...or...drawn to the island. City marketers jumped on this conspiracy theory and made the Boots Bay city motto "The island that you won't want to leave!"

The city is widely known for its European look and it's one of the city's main tourist attractions! You can visit some of the local attractions, such as, but not limited to...




















, husband to Emma and nephew to Lawrence Goldberg. John is a successful video game critic on a video-sharing website. He's known for his harsh criticisms, especially for horror games (ironically).


, wife to John. She's a live streamer who plays games and has a social media following. She's known for taking peace sign selfies mixed with the "duck face" expression in various locations.


, who's abnormally tall. His real name is Poppy Ericson. Due to his height, he often got picked on for being tall. His nickname was given to him by his old high school bully... John Goldberg. He was a grave digger for the city church until he got fired for "pranking distraught widowers as they grieved". He's known for being very curious and likes to explore places he shouldn't be exploring...

title: Spikeball
description:
게임 정보
Spikeball is a sports video game that adapts the classic game of Spikeball to the digital environment. Designed to offer a fast and competitive gaming experience, it allows you to face players from all over the world or enjoy games with friends.
In Spikeball, accuracy, strategy and speed are key. The the game is designed to deliver exciting games in every session.
Fast and Accurate Gameplay: Dynamic games that capture the essence of Spikeball.
Multiplayer Modes: Compete online with a friend or join a match online.
Player Customization: Configure your avatar with different clothing and accessory options.
Background Music: The main menu has a DJ that adds a sound environment according to the rhythm of the game.

title: Rail Fights
description:
게임 정보
Rail Fights is a multiplayer shooter for 1-8 players that adds a competitive edge to the simplicity of old-school arcade games. Players ride their tanks on a closed oval rail, bump other tanks around, capture different launchers, shoot and total opponents on the other side of the arena.
Solo or Team
Fight solo against 7 other solo players, team up with a friend as a duo to face off against 3 other teams of two or join forces with three other players to form a team of four and compete against another team.
Multiplayer
Enjoy Rail Fights locally with friends on your device, playing against each other or AI. We're keeping an eye on player interest and may add online features, like casual and ranked matches, in the future based on demand.
Single Player
Not in the party mood? You can always enjoy single-player mode against AI opponents and aim to top the leaderboards.

title: Kurama and The Cursed Isles
description:
게임 정보
Kurama and The Cursed Isles is an adventure and Platformer Game. Your ship ran aground after a terrible storm. Explore and Discover why the islands of the Archipelago are cursed and help the people. With Kurama and his most trustful little friend Aya, you have to complete 2.5D platformer levels and explore 4 islands which are little opened areas.

A 2.5D Platformer Game ! Use the Dash system to help you finish the levels. They are separated in season themed (Spring, Summer, Autumn, WInter) with challenges, trap and enemies according of the season. Giant flower, mudflood, blizzard or even lava, do not be afraid to explore the level to find items and treasures.

And 3D opened areas ! It is not just a simple Hub area to go from a level to another. Speak to the people of the islands, resolve little quests, unlock new platformer levels and secrets, purify the island, and collect treasures.

Make your way to the source of evil to destroy it.

title: Trailthread
description:
게임 정보

In the Augment Battle System, each fighter can act twice per turn. Use your first move to cast spells or attacks, and use your second move to modify those commands with game-changing Augments!

Augments apply diverse modifiers to your arsenal: Imbue attacks with lightning damage, cast your heals as team-wide spells, and guarantee your buffs trigger before anyone else moves. With millions of Primary-Augment combos available in-game, the sky’s the limit!


Trailthread's story follows a blacksmith, baker, and bandit on their journey to scale Anvite Mountain and slay the bitter Obsidian Drake. Rekindle enchanted forges, meet strange friends, and tumble across the timeline with the mysterious Timestitcher. Can you reach the summit?


Trailthread is a focused 10-hour experience. It features a streamlined world map and quick combat expansion. Enjoy plenty of strategic customization, expressive characters, vibrant music, and more… all in one tight-knit package!

title: Space gold rush TD
description:
게임 정보
Space Gold Rush is a unique hybrid of tower-defense and real-time-strategy. Set in the not distant future where space travel has become viable to everyone. In the frontiers of space where there is the unexplored, also means there is untapped resources. No time to waste mining and extracting, and no regulators to setup health and safety laws and procedures, risk it all and join the many other prospectors in a new hazardous industry blowing up asteroids anyway they can in order to strike it rich.

7 Different Towers each with their own upgrade options to specialize their stats (damage, fire rate, and range).

Mobile Turrets able to set up any where and reposition to fit different roles or when plan A does not go well.

title: Chamrosh
description:
게임 정보
Chamrosh is hack-n-slash Action game that came from Persian mythology.where players assume the role of FEREYDOUN in his quest to hunt down and dispose of demons in his way to find Chamrosh.
ENTER THE WORLD OF CHAMROSH

almost thousand years ago , A Covenant was made Chamrosh Legendary Champion have been choose to protect Persia Nation to eternity, the other Legends called gods and Kaveh the blacksmith made an spell on him to make him immortal but this curse will turn him to stone and only kaveh’s blood and anahita’s feather will turn him back to life again.
After a long time persia needs chamrosh again to fight against Greece’s army in this 600 YO war and finish this, but even gods without chamrosh couldn’t go into the world of chamrosh and only kaveh’s bloodline can go, so keyumars the last generation of kaveh have been sent to the world of chamrosh to turn him back to life again but he have been ambushed on the way and couldn’t make it.
But there was another person with kaveh’s bloodline, a kid, named fereydoun son of keyumars , the child grown up with gods, in many years they taught fereydoun how to fight and slay, now is the time to send him to the world of chamrosh…

PLAY AS A HIGHLY TRAINED DEMON SLAYER

Start your destiny with Fereydoun son of Kiamars, the latest generation of Kaveh the blacksmith, who is the last person that can turn Chamrosh alive.he is traveling to Chamrosh's world for the first time and will fight with orcs and demons .he is looking for who killed his father and his vengeance for Loss of his father makes him angry and wants to revenge.


for the first time we brings Persian elder gods and their powers in this game,you can see who they are and their abilities.they will help you in this journey and will give you their powers.listen to them,they will guide you,and you can meet Persian legendary warriors and kings of history.

this trailer is just a preview and will change in final release,we will try our best to fix all the bugs and improve animations and performance until final release and make you feel amazing.

title: Skip Lake 2
description:
게임 정보
Skip Lake 2 is a minimalist and relaxing puzzle, set in a lake of crystal clear waters and musical rocks.



The sequel of Skip Lake, this game is now going a litlle deeper in the story, and bringing new mechanichs with unique puzzles!

The game captures the international game of skipping stones into the water, transforming it into a puzzle of logic and direction, with harmony of music and sound effects, carefully composed to relax.
Hit the pots trough stunning landscapes
Key Features

Touch the rotating pillars until they are at the right angle for the stone to hit until it reaches the pot on the other side of the lake !!

Contemplate minimalist art, with details that will delight your eyes.

title: Unheeded Influences
description:
게임 정보
Plot
You awake in the dark as an elemental soul. You have no memories or strength. Chaos, an indistinct guide, teaches you about intuition and what are energies and how to shape them at will.
You learn about the 12 Natures and the 3 realms where spirits, divines, and living coexist. You start your journey accompanied by an odd and useless Egyptian fennec.
You incarnate, travel through worlds, and influence human life. Soon enough you discover the mark of the biggest realms' threat ever. And it seems you were its first victim, interrupting your old plans...
Stay immersed with our website
As an Elemental soul, you live among our mythologies that coexist
You are a soul and you are imbued with 12 different Natures, such as fire, water, time...
You evolve in the spiritual realms and travel to mystical places.
As a spirit, you'll love taking on the appearance of the living and inspiring dreamwalkers.

title: BITGUN Survivors
description:
게임 정보

Immerse yourself in the expansive world of BITGUN Survivors, now featuring an open-world experience filled with exploration, random events, and vampire-survivors inspired gameplay. Navigate through the aftermath of a zombie outbreak, as you adapt to your surroundings and make crucial decisions to ensure your survival. Witness the collapse of civilization, as friends turn against each other and people do whatever it takes to stay alive.



Features:
- Open-world exploration in a dynamic and ever-changing environment
- A vast array of random events and encounters, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same
- Vampire survivor-inspired mechanics, adding a unique twist to the zombie apocalypse genre
- Upgrades and meta progression to enhance your abilities and increase your chances of survival
- Challenging and addictive gameplay that will test your skills and adaptability
- Quick and fun game which you will need to repeat many times until you will be able survive till the end

Explore the unfolding of a zombie apocalypse and watch the civilization fall. Friends turn against each other, and people will do whatever it takes to survive. You are alone in the middle of a zombie horde and your goal is to survive.



Gameplay:
- Top down game with vampire-survivors-like gameplay
- Huge hordes of zombies
- 1 large map
- Shop for permanent upgrades

This is not an easy game. Enemies in BITGUN: Survivors are relentless and unforgiving. If you make a mistake, you will die. There are no second chances. You must be prepared for a challenge, and you must be willing to learn from your mistakes.

title: Sidekick
description:
게임 정보
Robots have drawn humanity into war, and it's your job as Blaser Man and Turtle Belly Bot to infiltrate and wipe out the heart of these tin puppets!

Experience 10 varied levels based on classic games in Sidekick! But not only that, in Sidekick different genres are linked thematically. It doesn't matter whether it's run and gun, top-down shooter, or jet ski action, here you can find everything that made you happy and frustrated on the NES!

And of course, there is also a multiplayer mode, and it's 100% couch co-op! You and your friends! In real life, together! Shoot, I tell you, shoot!

title: Radical Striker
description:
게임 정보
We are creating a 2D fighting action game by adding stage action elements to the 2D fighting game.
Production is an indie team with one person.
In the game, we are developing 2D fighting battles in one-to-many and multi-to-many so that you can play them on low-spec PCs.

Multiple heroes can be selected, and other fighting styles will be added as the characters level and stats rise.
You can continuously attack like a 2D fighting game.
Since it is basically assumed to be one-to-many, you can avoid it by warping when you are attacked as a evasion in case of being attacked by pinching.



----- World view / Story -----
Not yet published.

title: Kaiju Catastrophe
description:
게임 정보
The result of forbidden genetic manipulation and warped by super science, wreak havoc on humanity. Mutate your giant monster with devastating attacks, unlock new permanent evolutions, and an ever expanding roster of kaijus. Devastate procedurally generated cities inflicting as much damage possible before you succumb to your injuries and show humanity the true face of destruction!
A Monstrous Menagerie
Pick from a variety of giant monsters with their own weaknesses, strengths, and unique weapons to destroy humanity!
Grow Stronger Every Life
Give your kaiju new and varied evolutions that can simply boost their baseline stats or give them interesting tactical options as they rampage across the globe.
Destruction Has It's Benefits
Mad science isn't cheap, turn the untold destruction you wreak into funds for your mad science research projects. Unlocking new skins for your kaiju, new locations to destroy, and interesting accessories.

title: Ball King Jam
description:
게임 정보
볼 킹 잼은 어리석은 물리학 기반의 농구 게임입니다. 컴퓨터 상대와 대결하거나 다양한 환경과 코트에서 친구들을 이기는 재미를 즐기세요.

로컬 협동 플레이!
솔로로 플레이해보거나 친구들과 팀을 짜보세요. 최대 네 명까지 다양한 모드에서 함께 플레이할 수 있습니다. 기술과 우정을 시험하세요!
캐릭터 맞춤 설정!
캐릭터를 선호에 맞게 조정하고 맞춤 설정하세요! 도전과제를 완료하여 희귀한 의상을 언락하세요.

스탯을 강화할 수 있는 다양한 영구적이고 장비 가능한 아이템을 언락하세요.

title: Apoceus: Winter Wars
description:
게임 정보
Real-Time Strategy Returns on a Larger Scale.
Apoceus: Winter Wars is a fantasy real-time strategy game that focuses on bringing back all the classical elements from the past, such as resource gathering, recruiting & controlling armies, and base building, but on a much bigger scale.
Key features:
Large Scale
Base Building & Resource gathering
Fantasy

title: Purgatory Heroes
description:
게임 정보
죽음 이후, 당신의 영혼은 영원히 떠도는 연옥에 들어섰습니다. 자유로 가는 문을 지키는 대악마를 처치하는 것만이 유일한 탈출구입니다. 불안한 영혼들, 끔찍한 몬스터, 그리고 악마의 무리를 헤치고 싸우세요. 쓰러뜨린 적의 영혼을 모아 당신의 외형을 변화시킬 수 있습니다. 당신이 물리친 모든 캐릭터로 플레이하세요.
주요 특징
영혼 포식자
적의 영혼을 파괴하고 흡수하여 그들로 플레이할 수 있습니다. 쓰러뜨린 캐릭터로 플레이할 수 있게 해주는 독특한 시스템입니다. 다양한 클래스와 능력을 가진 수많은 캐릭터가 등장하며, 각각 고유한 강점과 약점, 그리고 독자적인 성장 경로를 가지고 있습니다.
성장 경로
캐릭터의 레벨을 올리세요. 레벨이 오를 때마다 특정 속성이 증가하거나 감소할 수 있습니다. 아티팩트와 별의 돌로 캐릭터를 강화하세요.
클래스
게임에는 다양한 클래스가 존재합니다. 각 클래스는 자신만의 고유한 이점이 있으며, 이를 발전시킬 수 있습니다.
별 지도
별의 돌을 모아 점성가의 도움으로 특정 클래스의 속성을 향상시켜보세요.

title: Maenovan
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Thirty years ago, the idyllic Maenovan Valley was ravaged by a mysterious sickness, forcing a mass evacuation. The once-thriving community was left abandoned, its secrets buried beneath an unsettling silence.
The year is 2007. You are lured to the valley by the abundance of prey and the promise of a successful hunt. As you explore the decaying remnants of the past, you'll uncover a haunting narrative that reveals the darkness that still lingers in the valley's shadows.
Gameplay:
Atmospheric Exploration: Immerse yourself in the eerie atmosphere of the abandoned valley and its surrounding areas. Explore decaying buildings, forgotten landmarks, and the unsettling remnants of a once-vibrant community.
Unraveling the Mystery: Piece together the fragmented narrative through environmental storytelling, cryptic clues, and chilling encounters. Discover the truth behind the valley's evacuation and the lingering darkness that haunts its present.
Suspenseful Encounters: Brace yourself for spine-chilling moments as you navigate the valley's eerie silence and confront the unsettling remnants of its past
Features:
Multiplayer Adventure: Play solo, or work with up to six friends to accomplish your mission while the forces of nature work against you.
Immersive Sound Design: Chilling ambient sounds will immerse you in the valley's eerie atmosphere, heightening the suspense and tension.
Compelling Narrative: A rich and atmospheric narrative will unfold as you explore, revealing the valley's dark secrets and the tragic fate of its former inhabitants.
Indie Spirit: Developed with a passion for storytelling and a commitment to creating a unique and unforgettable horror experience.

title: ZIX
description:
게임 정보
Become an Acolyte of Zix and spread chaos across the universe in this fast-paced co-op VR action roguelike. Invade unique worlds to extract their elements, then use those elements to shape future runs. Explore and discover new combinations as you delve into Zix’s many secrets.

Between cross-platform gameplay across VR platforms, and an active spectator system allowing PC players to join in on a run, you’ll never need to unravel the grand tapestry of existence alone!

GESTURE-BASED ACTION
Express yourself with the FIRST INSTINCT combat system—designed to be easy to pick up but difficult to master. Use only the primary triggers and simple gestures to perform a wide variety of abilities and movements which flow together seamlessly to create an expressive and deep combat experience. Dash, jump, use swords, grenades, arrows, blasters, and shields, all without needing to look down at your controllers or press any face buttons.
RECIPE-ROGUELIKE PROGRESSION
Mix ingredients from three major worlds to procedurally influence the content of each run. Experiment with different combinations of elements to gain an edge in combat, uncover secret areas, and influence the environment. Unlock more complex recipes over time and mold the fabric of reality as you see fit. 
PROCEDURAL ABILITY AUGMENTS
Upgrade your core abilities with procedurally stacking augments and discover unique combinations every run. Experience countless emergent builds as you harvest chaos in service of Zix.
CROSS-PLATFORM SHENANIGANS
Play alone or with up to two fellow VR Acolytes. Asymmetric PC support allows friends outside of VR to join the game on their computers as active spectators. It’s up to them and their impish inclinations if they’ll help out or simply wreak havoc.

title: Eternity Guards
description:
게임 정보
The main idea of the game is a fantasy alternative to Valhalla. Scandinavian mythology is a thematic focus - the same style, ornaments and atmosphere where heroes fight for a place in eternity, there will be only one.

This is a world of magic and tactics.

Style - handpaint.

Battle Royale PVP fighting game with strategy elements.
