On a small one map, from 2 to 6 players fight at the same time, who are divided into equal teams. Fast matches have a maximum duration of 10 minutes, so the maps are not big, but well designed for energetic battles with fun running around the map in the heat of magical effects.

Each map has all 4 times of year, all are available on the same map to increase variability.

At the end of each match, there will be a unique anti-cheat system based on feedback and ratings of players for the subsequent successful formation of the effective teams.

Before the battle, players appear in a room where they have 30 seconds to equip and buy clothes, weapons, bottles and recharge abilities.

There is an interaction with the environment in the form of teleports and places of interest (landslides, lava, waterfalls, lightning, tornado) that block the way and can inflict damage on the opponent.

The tactic is to activate the character selection circle (menu wheel) via a hotkey for the interaction: for enemies - magic, weapon strikes or debuffs; for allied characters - useful buffs, damage resistance, acceleration, healing etc.

There is a teleport on the map with an 5 sec activation delay, the next character can only be passed with the same delay. There is always some kind of artifact there, which you can use in this or in the next game only once.

There will be several characters in the game, including:
Viking - tank, human shield;



After the end of the fight, in addition to experience, which unlocks many different abilities, and in addition to game currency to unlock new weapons and elements of armor, there is also the opportunity to upgrade a room with weapons (fireplace, sparring partner, sofa, bar etc).

title: Horizon Springs
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the vibrant, open world of Horizon Springs, where your adventures know no bounds. In this captivating, simplistic paradise, you have the freedom to shape your destiny, live out your dreams, and embark on endless possibilities.

Key Features:

🌍 Explore a Living World: Horizon Springs offers a vast, ever-evolving world to explore. From lush forests to bustling cities, discover the beauty of a dynamic environment that's as alive as its inhabitants.

👤 Create Your Unique Character: Craft your identity and choose from a diverse range of customizable characters. Whether you're a budding entrepreneur, a skilled tradesperson, or an artist, your journey starts with your unique avatar.

🏡 Build, Customize, and Thrive: Acquire properties, design your dream home, and even start your own business. Become a real estate mogul, interior designer, or entrepreneur – the choice is yours.

💼 Endless Career Opportunities: Seek your fortune by pursuing various careers, from law enforcement to culinary arts. With a wide array of jobs to choose from, you can lead the life you've always wanted.

🌟 Forge Friendships: Connect with players from around the world in a thriving community. Form alliances, role-play, and engage in cooperative gameplay, making friendships that last a lifetime.

🚗 Travel in Style: Get behind the wheel of a variety of vehicles – from sleek sports cars to rugged off-road trucks. Traverse the landscape in your choice of transportation.

Experience life like never before in Horizon Springs, where the possibilities are limitless. What will you become? Where will your journey take you? Unleash your creativity, fulfill your ambitions, and become a part of an online world brimming with opportunities. Horizon Springs is your stage, your story, and your legacy.

Are you ready to write your own tale in Horizon Springs?

title: Unmurk
description:
게임 정보
숨겨진 복셀 개체를 발견하는 미니멀리스트 퍼즐 게임. 퍼즐의 가장자리만 볼 수 있으며 개체를 회전하여 퍼즐 조각을 제자리에 조정합니다. 레벨이 끝나면 숨겨진 복셀 개체를 드러냅니다.

객체 회전



퍼즐 맞추기

title: Eternal Remnant: The First Chapter
description:
게임 정보
Join Arin and Vera, two siblings being hunted for carrying an unspeakable secret, as they start a perilous journey across the continent to the shining city of Sunspire - their only hope of salvation. Guide a memorable cast of characters and help them fight for their lives in this classic-style fantasy RPG adventure that you won't soon forget.



"I just need you to trust me."



Enjoy a narrative-driven experience that is in equal parts heartwarming as it is breathtaking, all in the space of 4 -6 hours

Fast and breezy combat with characters teaming up to unleash dazzling combo attacks

A visually stunning adventure with a mix of blended environments and pixel art

A world ripe for exploring, packed with treasure and a variety of fearsome foes

Eternal Remnant: The First Chapter is a fluid experience from beginning to end, one which keeps the story moving and the gameplay evolving throughout your journey, and will leave you wanting more.

Conquer the past. Fight against darkness. Find your destiny.

title: Princess of Seas
description:
게임 정보
Princess of Seas is a sea sailing. Start the blue-colored adventure now.
Basic Features
Randomly Generated World: The world is procedurally generated. So the adventure in a completely new world every time.
Open-World: No limitation. Explore the world freely.
Trading: Selling goods all around the world and making money
Upgrading Ship: 197 ships in the world. Unlock them, buy them, and enhanced them. You can never be too powerful.
Hire Sailors: More than 300 sailors all over the world. Pick your desired sailor and build the team.
Sea Battle: Trace the pirate, defeat them (and make some money).

This game is still under development. More features are coming soon.

title: To and Fro
description:
게임 정보
To And Fro is a vibrant VR action-adventure 3D platformer where you can explore a vast, colorful world filled with treasures and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Step into the shoes of our hero, Joe, and utilize his unique abilities to navigate diverse landscapes and challenges. This cozy and casual game features easy-to-pick-up gameplay, making it perfect fun for players of all ages.

Immerse yourself in a relaxing and atmospheric quest, featuring impressionistic, low poly graphics reminiscent of the N64-style. Discover the unparalleled depth and immersion that only VR can offer, allowing you to effortlessly gauge distance and hop between platforms with pinpoint accuracy. VR perspective brings the world to life in a way that flat-screen 3D platformers simply cannot match.

Take control from a captivating third-person perspective, where you directly influence the character you observe. Seamlessly adjust your position and angle of view, offering a fluid and intuitive way to guide your player through the adventure, all while enjoying a dynamic and immersive gameplay experience.

Dive into a world of adventure with To And Fro!

title: BITGUN Survivors
description:
게임 정보

Immerse yourself in the expansive world of BITGUN Survivors, now featuring an open-world experience filled with exploration, random events, and vampire-survivors inspired gameplay. Navigate through the aftermath of a zombie outbreak, as you adapt to your surroundings and make crucial decisions to ensure your survival. Witness the collapse of civilization, as friends turn against each other and people do whatever it takes to stay alive.



Features:
- Open-world exploration in a dynamic and ever-changing environment
- A vast array of random events and encounters, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same
- Vampire survivor-inspired mechanics, adding a unique twist to the zombie apocalypse genre
- Upgrades and meta progression to enhance your abilities and increase your chances of survival
- Challenging and addictive gameplay that will test your skills and adaptability
- Quick and fun game which you will need to repeat many times until you will be able survive till the end

Explore the unfolding of a zombie apocalypse and watch the civilization fall. Friends turn against each other, and people will do whatever it takes to survive. You are alone in the middle of a zombie horde and your goal is to survive.



Gameplay:
- Top down game with vampire-survivors-like gameplay
- Huge hordes of zombies
- 1 large map
- Shop for permanent upgrades

This is not an easy game. Enemies in BITGUN: Survivors are relentless and unforgiving. If you make a mistake, you will die. There are no second chances. You must be prepared for a challenge, and you must be willing to learn from your mistakes.

title: Wonderland Quest
description:
게임 정보


Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.
Join our protagonist Adam the magician on his journey through Wonderland! Let's get back to Medieval Ages, everything is possible here!



Help Adam solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, save ladies from the goblin, majestic evil eagle, dukes and rats! Be eaten by a two-headed giant frog and escape alive! Explore the castle, dungeons of hell, and heights of the heaven, walk through magical forests filled with strange creatures, take a hot air balloon and fly up to the mountains…
… and be rewarded! Guide Adam till the end, save the gorgeous princess from the evil eagle and become a prince of Wonderland!
Logic puzzles, animated intros and cut scenes – everything is combined into one story. Everything is carefully 100% hand drawn.

What are you waiting for? Adventures await you!

title: Trials of Cascadia
description:
게임 정보


As the son of a farmer, Isaac had always dreamt of one day becoming a Paladin like the Chosen Hero, Zvarus. A man whose bravery was legendary and who stood down in the face of no foe. After a year of training with Orman's father Orlan, a retired Paladin general, Isaac sets off with his sword and holy book alongside his friend to vanquish the forces of Darkness that beset the world.

But not all is as it seems on the surface. Those who presume to speak in the name of justice may abuse their power, while those who commit heinous acts may do so out of perceived necessity. Sometimes, even certain facets of history are conveniently omitted. But the truth is out there waiting to be found, as the friends soon find out. Will they do the right thing, or play it safe? Only time will tell.





-A story-focused RPG. Explore Cascadia in an unfolding narrative to discover the world's true story, that spans multiple continents, and possibly multiple dimensions

-Custom artwork to bring the game alive with a vivid watercolor aesthetic

-Custom sound and meditative, emotional music reminiscent of 90's JRPGs

-A plethora of items and equipment to discover

-Special Artifacts that can empower your entire party

-Optional side quests strewn throughout the world map that may increase your reputation

-Playable with controller, keyboard or mouse





-A charming cast of unique characters, each with their own stories, roles, abilities and skill augments. Mix and match for your favorite group

-Build TP with normal attacks, and then spend them on flashy spells and specials. Gain Pwr with damage or healing to boost your morale

-Delay enemy actions and cancel spells altogether with instant cast skills

-Use elemental debuffs from offensive magic spells to stack weaknesses on your enemy

-Unleash devastating 5 TP ultimate attacks

-Over 50 different enemies for you to encounter, including rare enemies (and even some friendly encounters)











A new recruit to the Paladin order, Isaac is eager to prove himself to his superiors and make his parents proud. What he lacks in experience, he makes up for in talent.
Isaac is able to heal the party and cure various debuffs, but he can also dish out massive damage using his Light-based abilities such as Lumina Blade. He has a higher critical chance than others.




Isaac's best friend from a young age. Although somewhat boisterous and headstrong, Orman has the heart of a hero. He doesn't always like to follow the rules.
Orman is able to protect the party by drawing the enemy's attention and blocking physical attacks with his shield. He excels at interrupting spells and has several defensive utilities up his sleeve.




A mysterious and proud elven girl with pink hair, she is able to wield the power of the elements. Although her motives are unclear, she seems to have peaceful intentions.
Aiya can't take as much abuse as the Paladins, but she has the highest damage potential. When using her magic spells, she can also gain enchantments for her dagger, which can be stacked for exponential damage amounts.




An eccentric man who claims to be an oracle, and hundreds of years old. He claims to guide the party towards their destiny, but his past remains obscured.
Mondrus is a hybrid between a healer and a caster. He can cast nature spells which make the enemy more vulnerable or restore the party and apply shields. While his spells are cheaper to cast, they take a short time to recharge.

title: Anti-Sane
description:
게임 정보
What is this forgotten world?
You are lost in a strange and unsettling universe. Try to stay sane as you navigate eerie creatures and mysterious places.
Solve puzzles using your ability to possess objects
Uncover the secrets of the protagonist’s past as the story unfolds
Enjoy adorable pixel art with a dark twist
Don't be afraid of being alone. Be afraid of what’s lurking around you.

title: England in London
description:
게임 정보

Help the ungrateful, feel the indifference and play minigames.
Take control of Mark England, a celebrity with a few screws loose, and go on a search for his missing firewire cables. Guide him through London, Ontario as you meet the residents, collect items and take on challenges.
FEATURES
Side-Scrolling 2d with unique visuals
Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

Minimalistic User Interface
Simple and accessible controls help keep you focused and immersed in the surrealist city of London, Ontario.

Carefully handmade
No NFTs, AI-generated bullshit or asset flip guarantee! I'd buy that for a dollar!

title: Rhythm Storm
description:
게임 정보
게임 개요
Rhythm Storm은 리듬감 넘치는 요소로 가득한 로그라이크 호드 서바이벌 슈터(또는 불렛 헤븐) 게임입니다 플레이어는 움직임 제어 및 두 가지의 특별 기능을 사용하여 비행물체를 자동으로 조준하고 사격합니다 비행물체를 선택하고, 최초 구성과 기능을 설정한 후 게임을 시작하면 됩니다 게임을 진행하면 적들이 업그레이드 파워업 아이템을 떨어뜨리며, 이 아이템을 획득할 시 두 가지 방식으로 비행물체의 능력이 강화됩니다 플레이어를 제외한 게임 세계의 모든 요소는 리듬에 맞춰 움직이며, 곡이 끝날 때까지 살아남아야 합니다



텍스처 없는 벡터 그래픽
Rhythm Storm은 무텍스처 라인과 폴리곤만을 렌더링합니다 비주얼 효과 구현에는 텍스처 없이 후처리 효과만 사용되었으며, 이는 화면 캡처만 텍스처로 사용됨을 의미합니다 이를 통해 한눈에 봐도 그래픽이 선명하고 경계가 자연스러우며다른 게임과 비교할 수 없는 높은 해상도를 자랑합니다 더 나은 게임 경험을 위해 새로 고침 속도가 120hz 이상인 1440p 이상의 모니터로 플레이할 것––을 강력 권장합니다. [1080p/60hz로 게임을 플레이하는 것도 좋지만 이상적인 수준에는 미치지 못하죠

리듬감 있는 플레이
Rhythm Storm은 음악을 조합한 게임이지만 기존의 리듬 게임과는 다릅니다 비행물체의 움직임을 제외한 게임 내 다른 모든 요소가 배경 음악의 리듬과 정확히 일치합니다 보통 배경 음악의 8마디마다 파동이 바뀌고, 파워업과 게임 세계는 그러한 파동에 맞추어 움직이며 동적인 선, 원, 스테퍼 장애물을 생성합니다. UI는 박자에 맞추어 움직이며, 무엇보다도 모든 적 또한 박자에 맞추어 움직이며 장애물을 발사합니다 격파 역시 박자에 맞추어 이루어집니다 박자에 따라 파워와 기능을 활성화할 수 있기 때문에 플레이어는 성취감을 느끼게 됩니다. 하지만 이기기 위해 기능을 꼭 활성화할 필요는 없으며, 또한 반드시 음악적 재능이 있어야 하거나, 박자와 싱크를 맞추어야 하는 것은 아닙니다

불렛 헤븐/몰려드는 적으로부터 살아남기
구조적으로 본다면 Rhythm Storm은 다른 불렛 헤븐이나 쇄도하는 적/호드로부터 생존해야 하는 다른 게임과 비슷하게 느껴질 수 있습니다 게임의 장르 이름을 꼭 규정할 필요는 없지만 Rhythm Storm의 경우 불렛 헤븐이라는 장르가 가장 적절하다고 생각합니다 Rhythm Storm은 비교적 최근에 도입된 이 장르의 일부 규칙을 따르기는 하지만, 게임에 더 적절한 기능과 행동을 구현하기 위해 그 일부를 변형하기도 합니다 예를 들어, 적을 파괴할 시 XP가 자동으로 획득되지만, 대신 드론을 생성하거나 파워를 사용하는 데 에너지가 소모되어 에너지 수치가 감소합니다 업그레이드는 자동이 아니기 때문에 업그레이드 파워업을 획득해야 합니다 이에 따라 음악이 끊기더라도 당황스럽지 않고 만족스러운 느낌을 줍니다

게임플레이 트레일러 마지막에 잠깐 나온 것처럼 음악 중단의 가장 중요한 역할은 녹화 및 앙코르 업데이트를 하는 것입니다 데모를 끝냈거나 비행물체가 파괴되었거나에 상관없이 게임이 종료되고 나면, 해당 판에서 선택하여 업그레이드한 목록 전체가 저장되어 다음 판에서도 자동으로 사용할 수 있게 됩니다 앙코르 시 업그레이드 화면이 보이지는 않지만, 자동으로 업그레이드가 진행됩니다. 어떤 업그레이드가 추가되었는지는 추후 확인할 수 있습니다 이후 나타날 앙코르 업그레이드는 또한 일시 중지 메뉴에 표시되기도 합니다 해당 메뉴에서 언제든 다시 앙코르를 종료할 수도 있습니다 이후 (또는 앙코르 선택 항목을 모두 사용한 경우) 수동 업그레이드로 전환됩니다 게임을 즐기기 위해 꼭 이 기능을 사용해야 하는 것은 아니지만 앙코르 업그레이드를 사용하면 게임의 성능을 어느 정도 강화할 수 있습니다


Rhythm Storm의 알파 데모는 게이머들의 관심을 끌고 확인하기 위한 게임의 사전(그러나 업그레이드된) 빌드 버전입니다 데모 버전에도 다양한 콘텐츠가 포함되어 있으나, 정식 버전에는 훨씬 더 많은 요소가 추가됩니다 데모 버전에는 한 종류의 세계에 네 종류의 비행물체가 등장하지만, 정식 게임에서는 세 종류 이상의 세계(비행물체 유지/진행 중 업그레이드를 위해 순서대로 플레이)와 열 가지 이상의 비행물체를 선택할 수 있습니다 정식 릴리즈에서는 기능, 파워, 무기, 적 유형, 업그레이드 등의 요소가 데모와는 비교할 수 없을 정도로 다양해집니다 또한 각 세계 최종판에서는 특별 보스도 만날 수 있습니다. 정식 게임에서는 파워/난이도의 균형도 조금 달라집니다

title: Her Name
description:
게임 정보
A platform and puzzle game, "Her Name" will offer you to solve its puzzles by making your character progress at the same time as a mysterious bead on its tracks.

Days follow each other and look alike in this bleak world where routine afflicts the player in a tasteless and endless vicious circle. Until one day, a warmer aura appears in the dreary life of our character.
But before being able to approach this young woman, the player will have to overcome his fears, his anxieties and his apprehensions through his nightmares. Will a love story manage to hatch between these two souls?

Alternate between dreams and reality. Discover the anxieties and apprehensions of your character through his nightmares. Jump from platform to platform, activate levers and other buttons, push mysterious glowing cubes and trigger the hidden mechanisms of your subconscious. The riddles of your mind are just waiting to be solved...

title: Hardcube 2
description:
게임 정보
Sequel to the original 2016 game. A simple meditative platformer with nice graphics and a pleasant soundtrack. New levels and new biomes.
Go through levels filled with unique traps for each biome. Collect as many points and Collection items as possible. The game is made in the best traditions of the much-loved  original.
Unique and manually created levels, where there are several paths to the finish, and only you can decide which path to choose: dangerous, but with a good reward, or safe, but with a lesser reward. Unique traps for each biome.

title: Dimakerus
description:
게임 정보
Dynamic Combat
In the ancient times, one had to survive by any means. Embrace the multiple ways of combat, such as sharp slashes and blunt strikes, finishings, strangling and weapon-throwing mechanics... and a moderate amount of fire!
As the enemies have as much chance to succeed as you, make use of a huge arsenal of deadly gear, varying from slicing blades such as sickles and gladius to crude maces and gigantic halberds, as you shed the blood of your enemies on the sands.
Fire System
Fire has changed the course of history. Use the devastating properties of this elementum combined with the environment to annihilate your foes, spook animals and put into practice your combat pyromaniac strategies!

title: Tales Of The Death
Cyber City Clash
description:
게임 정보
Cyber City Clash - Unleash the Future of Fighting!

Welcome to the neon-lit streets of the future - Cyber City Clash, the future in 2.5D arcade fighting! Immerse yourself in a dystopian cyberpunk world where every battle echoes through the towering skyscrapers. Engage in fierce combat as you navigate through the diverse districts of the Cyber City. Will you rise to the top and become the ultimate cybernetic warrior?

Gorgeous Cyberpunk Arenas:
Explore the vividly detailed stages scattered across the Cyber City. From the bustling marketplaces to the dark alleyways, each location is a visual masterpiece that sets the stage for epic clashes. Immerse yourself in the cyberpunk atmosphere as you battle for supremacy.

Choose Your Cyber Fighter:
Select your avatar from a roster of ten cybernetically enhanced fighters, each with their own unique characteristics and combat styles. From swift assassins to hulking bruisers, find the perfect match for your playstyle and dominate the competition.

Varied Game Modes:
Whether you're a solo warrior or prefer to challenge a friend, Cyber City Clash has you covered. Dive into single-player vs AI for an immersive story-driven experience or engage in intense 2-player local battles. Take the fight online with the Player vs Player mode, featuring rollback netcode functionality for lag-free, competitive showdowns.

Accessible Controls, Deep Gameplay:
Experience the best of both worlds with a simplified control system that welcomes beginners and casual fighters while offering the depth that experts crave. Master the art of cyber combat with our tutorial mode, ensuring you're ready to face any opponent in the Cyber City.

Adaptive AI and Skill Settings:
Tailor the challenge to your liking with an adjustable AI difficulty setting. Whether you're a newcomer or a seasoned fighter, Cyber City Clash can be adjusted to your skill level, ensuring every battle is a thrilling experience.

Stunning 4K Visuals:
Witness the future in breathtaking detail with Cyber City Clash's stunning 4K visuals (on supported hardware). Every punch, kick, and explosion is a feast for the eyes, delivering a visual spectacle that matches the intensity of the battles themselves.




Features:

* Fight across multiple stages based in various locations in the cyberpunk city, each rendered in gorgeous detail.
* Engage in combat with your choice from ten cyber fighters each with their own characteristics.
* Single player vs AI game mode.
* Player vs Player local multiplayer mode.
* Online Player vs Player mode, featuring rollback netcode functionality (planned during early access period).
* Simplified control system, move sets and combos make it great for beginners or casual fighters as well as experts alike.
* Tutorial mode that introduces the fundamentals of fighting in Cyber City Clash (planned during early access period).
* AI difficulty setting to adjust the game to your skill level
* Stunning visuals, rendered in 4K on supported hardware.

title: Respark
description:
게임 정보
The Ultimate Fireworks Roguelite!
Handheld sparklers, poppers, firecrackers, bottle rockets, and even skyrockets! In Respark, engage in thrilling and intense combat, using all kinds of hanabi (fireworks) to outsmart and overcome your enemies!




Each course is automatically and randomly generated. Not only will the terrain and enemies change, but the important items you find will also differ with each playthrough. Your choices shape your adventure!
Set in the whimsical world of Animalia, where animals have formed a civilized society, Respark offers a dazzling experience. The charming visuals combined with AAAA's catchy and wonderful background music create a joyous gaming journey for both newcomers and seasoned players.
To give you a taste of Respark's magic, we've prepared a special demo! Out of the 8 worlds in the full game, you can explore World 1, 4, and 7! While the demo doesn’t include the storyline or the save/load feature, you’ll still get to experience the thrill of reaching the final phase. Can you conquer the boss of World 7?

Note: The demo version supports keyboard and mouse operation only.

title: The Celestial Seeker
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic intergalactic adventure in this space faring Metroidvania! Irata, a skilled bounty hunter and unlikely hero, is tasked with saving the solar system from a menacing federation of hostile species. With your blaster and a thirst for adventure, explore three diverse planets filled with bounties, upgrades, civilizations, hidden secrets, and dangers.
Eons ago, the Eternium core, an advanced chipset with the power to link all intelligent systems, was created in a last-ditch attempt to ward off the first coup of power organized by the Federation. Moments before defeat, the planetary alliance activated the Divine Architect, a sentient artificial intelligence that was designed to control the Eternium core.
The war was won but, in its wake, left a thirst for power. It was no longer just the federation that wanted control. Insiders within the planetary alliance from all corners of the solar system tried their hands at gaining control.
It was then, that the leaders of the 3 planets agreed to give the Eternium core its last instructions, to separate in 6 and have its pieces be spread equally across the planets.
Peace was restored. The legend of the Eternium Core faded to myth. And the Divine Architect laid dormant. Until now.

title: Hours After Midnight
description:
게임 정보
Hours After Midnight is a game where you take control of one of the heroes who swore their revenge on Rettam'diov - the Consumer of Worlds for their fallen homelands. Survive everything your enemy throws at you in this roguelike survival adventure! Collect gold, find new allies, craft and upgrade your powers, and destroy all the evil that haunts your new home!

title: Miuma
description:
게임 정보
Do you remember your aunt from fifteen years ago, your aunt fussing in the kitchen during the early morning to prepare the pastries for the first customers? The nostalgia of baked delectables, the scent of aged wood, and the compassionate atmosphere of family all caused your heart to twinge. Suddenly, your old house was tragically abandoned, and the glory of the former bakery was only but a distant memory that was lost in the past. After so many years, could you revive the family business and return home, accepting the challenge?

In this absorbing adventure, you can provide your fellow neighbors with luscious, lip-smacking cakes, pies, and rolls; you can engage in different handicrafts, participate in the town's fests and fairs, delight in the hymns of nature, contemplate about your town's historical streets, intriguingly interact with those around you, and explore the lore together with Kevin!

This video-game creation has both a colorful gameplay with endless possibilities and a captivating plot. A story of a timeless town is told through its vivid residents, including the protagonist Kevin and his ancestors. Free will acts as a guardian: decisions and freedom are bestowed upon you with the bittersweet responsibility of further consequences. You are allowed to decide for yourself—from a certain day's tasks to the revelation of unseen opportunities.

Sometimes, one can face barriers with which they cannot cope. Sometimes, one makes inevitable, daunting mistakes and makes the wrong decisions. Sometimes, the world does not turn out to be as open and tender as one had wondered in their childhood of purity. Instead, one can be met with the unmerciful, shattering apathy of reality. Even so, you have the spirit to keep your welcoming heart warm to let love spread and to live life to the fullest.

This game is not just a simple bakery simulator: it's a story about a young man whose fate was to resume family traditions of baking and about a man who can reject these traditions—but ... does he want to? Your life is devised by your habits, the choices that function as the fragments to your very being.

title: Spirit of Midnight
description:
게임 정보
Spirit of Midnight is a charming adventure game. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

Use and combine items in your inventory to solve situational puzzles in humorous ways. Sit back, interact, and be entertained. Professionally scored with original music and nighttime vibes. Controller play recommended.

Play an introduction to the game before release in *** Spirit of Midnight: Prologue *** today!

title: Survivter
description:
게임 정보

Different builds

A large number of bosses

Several modes

title: Salvation of Sisyphus
description:
게임 정보


걸어가는 거야. 점프하는 거야. 그 다음에 낙하하는 거야. 그리고 바위 던지는 거야. 그 바위도 낙하해용~~. 근데 일어나야지. .











라는 극도로 힘든, 고위험, 올라가는 (주로 낙하하는) 플랫폼 게임에 여러분의 유일한 친구가 애완돌일 뿐이에요.
이 게임에 실패가 변화를 일으켜요. 정확하게 돌을 튕겨세요. 떨어지지 않게 공중에서 잡으세요. 근데! 스스로 떨어지지 않도록 조심하세용~~.

이 게임을 진행하면서, 이 답답한 모험의 개발자에 대한 분노와 분노와 같은 부정적인 감정을 받아들임으로써 내면의 평화를 찾을 수 있을 것이다!

시시포스 파이팅!

title: CyberSurfer
description:
게임 정보
What is CyberSurfer?

Put down the controllers of yesterday and pick up your phone to experience an intuitive experience. Race on a hoverboard in time trials to get the best time and see who is the fastest in the world! Learn a new way to move through the universe, a new way to control your path!

In short, CyberSurfer is a desktop game with a mobile phone as the controller.
Your phone, a new controller

Pick up your smart phone to have an intuitive an exhilarating experience. Simply connect with the CyberSurfer app and be launched into the void.
How do I download the Mobile App?
Select the Mobile App OS to download the CyberSurfer mobile app!
Customize your hoverboard

What’s a cool way to show your cred. Show off your prized cyberboard. Race for amazing designs and hoverboards that help you in ways you never thought of.
Spanning over 300 years, a cybernetic racing culture defines many entities realites. Your purpose is to beat the tyranical robots no matter the cost. Play as a Human, Cyborg, or Robot and step up to the plate. Join the race, because there’s only one way out.


Travel the cybernetic universe while being transported by worm holes. Master the art of flying on the CyberBoard using astronomical phenomena to benefit your movements.

title: Leaf Blowing Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Experience the calming tranquility of blowing thousands of leaves around in Leaf Blowing Simulator, the only real-time physics-based simulator that allows you to effortlessly create your own virtual oasis. Shape nature at your own pace and find relaxation in the gentle flow of leaves.
BLOW THE STRESS AWAY
Whether you're a laid-back or meticulous player, this game is for everyone. Immerse yourself in a calming atmosphere, as you clean up rooftops, alleys, and open fields. Sit back, relax, and watch the wind sweep your stress away.
DON'T BE-LEAF IT UNTIL YOU TRY IT
While you put off doing your actual yard work, marvel at the intricate details of nature. Watch in awe as thousands of individually simulated leaves blow away with the click of a button.
LEAF IT UP TO YOU
Whether you want to take it slow and gather little groups at a time or create a huge pile to jump into, the world is your canvas. Experience the world your way as you clean up the world one leaf at a time.

title: Lagoda Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic adventure in this classic, pixel-art, JRPG. Take part in the land's lore, meet new friends, interact with NPCs, and fight different enemies.


On your journey, you will explore a rich variety of forests, mountains, waters, caves, and dungeons. Small villages, and prosperous cities. You will also collect various valuable resources through fishing, mining, and farming.


You will meet many different enemies as you travel through the lands. The game uses a fast-paced, turn-based battle system, where the different enemies have unique elemental weaknesses. Magic and various buffs/debuffs play a big role in battles. Tailor your party members' unique magic abilities, with the help of different elemental orbs.
The game features:

title: The Golden Light Guardian
description:
게임 정보
Sure, here's the translation to Korean:
광활한 오픈 월드 맵을 탐험하세요!!!
다양한 생물 군계를 발견하고, 독특한 자원, 숨겨진 비밀, 위험한 적들을 찾아보세요. 모든 코너에는 새로운 모험이 기다리고 있습니다!

생존하세요!
재료를 모으고, 음식을 사냥하며, 건강과 스태미나를 관리하여 적대적인 환경에서 살아남으세요.

섬을 탐험하고 생존을 위해 사냥하세요. 당신의 기술을 사용하여 몬스터를 추적하고 처치하며, 자원을 모으고 도구를 제작하고 음식을 요리하여 생존하세요.

섬을 돌아다니는 몬스터들을 조심하세요.

끊임없이 몰려오는 해골 공격자들을 견디기 위해 방어를 전략적으로 구축하고 강화하세요.

title: Body Count
description:
게임 정보
Body Count lets you step into the worn shoes of a dedicated cop whose world is shattered by a personal tragedy. As the line between right and wrong blurs, you'll grapple with the moral cost of justice in the face of unspeakable loss. Dive into a gripping experience where personal consequences are no longer calculated and a once venerable cop decends into the path of vengeance.


Body Count is a bullet hell shooter that challenges you to explore the gritty side of morality as you navigate a city teetering on the edge of chaos.

title: HUNTER REVENGE
description:
게임 정보
Hunter revenge is an action game where the objective is to survive on a completely unknown planet that has creatures whose main objective is to exterminate any and all existing life.

title: Wild Area
description:
게임 정보
"Wild Area"는 야생 지역을 탐험하면서 생존과 모험을 즐기는 게임입니다. 낮에는 채집과 사냥을 통해 생산물을 생산하거나, 모험을 떠나 밤에는 좀비를 방어하는 로그라이크 서바이벌 RPG 게임입니다.

1. 낮과 밤이 있습니다.
2. 로그라이크 방식으로 랜덤하게 생성되는 다양한 형태의 맵과 던전을 통한 모험.
3. 물과 음식을 마시고 청결을 유지하여 상태를 관리하십시오.
4. 채집과 사냥을 통해 자원을 모으세요.
5. 자원은 다양한 아이템을 제작하거나 플레이어의 상태를 유지하는 데 사용됩니다.
6. 던전을 탐험하고 보스를 물리치세요.
7. 밤에 찾아오는 좀비들로부터 살아남으세요.

title: #INNER UNIVERSE 1F0000
description:
게임 정보
360°2D Shooter.
This is an STG where you fly 360° around the stage and engage in dogfights.
It requires a good feeling of flying a fighter plane and shooting accuracy.
Always Bullet Time.
You have the superpower to stop time every frame.
Your bullets will always hit and your enemies' bullets will always be avoided.
It should be the easiest shooter.
But it is like getting into a car and resisting the urge to step on the gas pedal.
Machine Customization.
You can tune your fighter between stages.
Is it the turning performance, the boost gauge, the ammunition load, or the reload time for each weapon?
Both the operating technique and machine maintenance in racing games are important, and maintenance is not simply a factor that makes you stronger.

title: V's Rage
description:
게임 정보
“Rise from your bed…”
Those are the words V, an overworked wife and mother, hears as she wakes up in her worst nightmare: she has been cursed and trapped in a videogame by a mysterious entity. Now she must beat any foe unlucky enough to cross her path, and free herself from a crazy low-poly world inhabited by odd creatures. She got a pan, she got rage, and she will beat them all.

title: Farmistic
description:
게임 정보
Farmistic is a top-down farming simulation game in early development by an independent developer.
Manage your farm
In Farmistic you'll be in charge of managing your farm. The fields need to be plowed, cultivated, drilled and harvested. The grain and corn has to be stored or sold, and the cycle repeats. Start small and get your hands dirty driving the tractors yourself. With your first profits, you can buy more and bigger machinery, and start automating the tasks.

Maybe you want to keep your farm small and comfy for a relaxing experience?
Or will you buy up all the land, let others do the work, and become the ultimate agricultural tycoon?
Farming
Fields need plowing, cultivating, drilling, fertilization, harvesting... a never ending duty! The dealership provides a range of small, medium and large tractors and different sizes of machinery for different fields. You'll need:
Tractors
Plows
Cultivators
Seed drills
Combine harvesters
Trailers
Mowers
Rakes
Balers
Animals
Your animals are going to be hungry! Cows will need hay and straw, chickens require grain. Don't forget the water and logistics to get it to your animals! If they are well taken care of, they reward you with milk and eggs, which can be sold for a nice profit.
Immersive mode
Get your hands dirty and drive/operate the machinery yourself in immersive mode. No need for others to do the work if you want the fun all for yourself!

title: First Blood : Persian Legends
description:
게임 정보
JOIN OUR DISCORD


First Blood : Persian Legends is a story-driven real-time-tactic strategy game based on ancient Persia, Sassanid Empire, year 488 CE. Our story is heavily inspired by true events.
Drive different characters from your team to the best of their capabilities and propel the story forward with seemingly impossible stealth missions. Choose different approaches infiltrating a prison, a city or a convoy, set up convenient plans and horrors on the path of your enemies.

The group is composed of different personalities. Over the course of the whole game, the characters in our story cross paths and go through a journey of trust, friendship, loyalty and betrayal.



The story starts with Vahid, The Assassin, working under the spell of Sukhra, a powerful nobleman. Vahid has great stealth mechanics capable of killing a fleet of enemies without any noise. As the rightful heir of the throne, Kavadh, needs rescuing, Vahid goes on a journey to alter the course of history for him and the whole Sassanid empire.

Later we meet Nizar, The General, of the late king. He is a strong character capable of killing multiple foes at once but giving away subtlety of stealth.

Liana, The Concubine, comes along on the second mission where she becomes the driving force of the story. Camouflaging is her main source of power.


Play as three completely different characters with their rich and unique skill sets
Find dozens of ways to infiltrate enemy lines
Execute your objectives with pure stealth mechanics




These three characters, The Assassin, The General and The Concubine are your playable characters to find and survive impossible missions to unlock the history. Can you help saving the Sassanid Empire from within?

title: Build Fight Game
description:
게임 정보
Build Fight Game is a class-based shooter set across a collection of fully interactable voxel environments. Create, destroy, and shoot your way to victory with your team in procedurally-generated multiplayer maps!
Choose your fighter
Pick from one of three classes that best suits your gameplay style:
Recon: Low health, but fast and agile with a high powered shotgun and rapid tunnel-digging shovel. A good Recon can leverage their movement and firepower to make up for their low HP and come out on top even against the toughest opponents, all while digging strategic routes with their shovel to assist their team.
Construction: Able to build complex schematics, Construction players massively enhance their team's defences. They are equipped with a special hybrid sniper/assault rifle: the sniper mode can be devastating at long range to players that let their guard down, while the assault rifle mode is vital to staying alive in a pinch.
Destruction: High HP and low mobility, Destruction players are an explosive powerhouse with a grenade launcher and throwable dynamite. No defence is strong enough to stop their wrath, and any player caught off guard will be quickly turned to gibs.
Prepare your defences
Create key strategic pathways and hidden tunnels as Recon, build bases for your team as Construction, and ready yourself for the battle...
Battle
Engage in tense matchups against your enemies. The best players must use every tool at their disposal to come out on top in fights, even if the odds are stacked against them.
Win.
Collect gold from foes that you defeat and take it to your vault! The team with the most gold in their vault at the end of the match wins - but be careful not to let the enemies in, lest they take your gold from right under your nose!
Features
Proximity-based voice chat.

title: Amerta
description:
게임 정보
Amerta is a dark, narrative-driven side scrolling games . The game it's all about time. What happened in the past will affect the future. You will be trapped in a recurring time to solve challenging puzzles. Avoid dangerous creatures to avoid death.
Synopsis
When the world is covered by a mist, it creates chaos throughout the world. Besides making living things mutate, the mist affects space and time, making things worse. In the midst of the chaos, you are trapped in time and trying to break free from it.
Meet with Eon
Eon is a tough, brave girl trapped in an apocalyptic situation caused by a mysterious mist that blankets the world. The mist has mutated living creatures and disrupted the fabric of time, creating chaos and danger at every turn. Eon finds herself stuck in a recurring time loop, trying to solve the mysteries of this warped reality and escape from the endless cycle. Though she's caught in this unpredictable world, Eon refuses to be defeated
Features
Challenging Puzzle Related to Time
Sprint, Grab, Jump

title: The Human Story
description:
게임 정보
Explore miniature worlds depicting different cultures throughout human history:



Find characters, objects and stories about our ancestors and learn about their lives:









The Human Story is a relaxing, colorful hidden object game in which you explore historically accurate miniature worlds. The game is capturing a big picture view of how human societies and cultures evolved over time from the very first humans in the Old Stone Age until the present day.

I am a solo dev with a big curiosity for history and creating this game is my way of making sense of the world we are living in today.

title: You Can't Scare Me
description:
게임 정보
넌 날 겁줄 수 없음 (You Can’t Scare Me)은 소셜 유령 하우스 파티 게임으로, 친구들을 만나 겁을 주려고 하면 그들이 소리를 지르면 점수를 얻게 됩니다! 점프 공포증이든 웃음이든 어느 쪽이든 즐거운 시간입니다!
두 팀이 있습니다: 한터들은 공포 덫과 의상을 사용하여 헌티드를 겁주려고 합니다. 그들은 모두를 보고 들을 수 있습니다. 헌티드는 열쇠를 수집하고 비명을 지르지 않으려고 노력합니다. 헌터는 들을 수 있지만 몬스터로 보이지 않으면 볼 수 없습니다!
50개의 공포 트랩에는 다양한 몬스터, 소리, 특수 효과가 있으며, 공통적으로 많은 두려움이 있습니다!
저택, 묘지, 병원, 박람회 등 8개 층을 방문하세요. 빠른 공포를 위해 작은 맵을 플레이하거나 메가 매치를 위해 큰 맵을 플레이하세요. 각각 멀티플레이어를 위한 잠금 해제 가능한 코스튬이 있습니다!
멀티플레이어는 메타 친구를 소환하여 플레이하는 가장 흥미로운 게임입니다. 인간과 대결할 때, 다음에 어떤 일이 일어날지 알 수 없습니다! 싱글 플레이어를 사용하면 무작위 트랩 레이아웃을 플레이할 수 있습니다. 이를 사용하여 맵을 공부하면 트랩을 배치하기에 가장 좋은 장소를 알 수 있습니다. 파티 모드를 사용하면 트랩을 설치한 다음 헤드셋을 친구에게 전달하여 플레이할 수 있습니다.
autokwd: You Can't Scare Me,넌 날 겁줄 수 없음

title: Star Head
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Master the art of split limbs in this chaotic action-adventure where your head and body become instruments of mayhem. Harness magnetic powers to amplify your control while creating devastating attacks or clever diversions. Whether you're a precision head-shot specialist or a tactical mastermind, every challenge is an opportunity to express your style.
This Isn't Your Normal Platformer
Two points of control. Infinite possibilities. Star Head turns platforming into a symphony of coordinated chaos. Launch your head to clear paths while your body handles platforming challenges. Execute perfect teleports to reunite your split form at crucial moments. Chain magnetic powers between your two points to amplify your effectiveness. Create your own solutions - from aggressive dual-point attacks to cunning tactical separations.
A Journey Beyond Logic
Guide QT, a head-launching android with a rebellious streak, through a world where reality bends in unexpected ways. From abandoned military bases to mysterious cities, you'll face corrupted machines, mutated creatures, and bizarre adversaries who'll push your abilities to their limits. Each environment challenges you to master your unique powers as you search for answers about QT's creator. The Star Head rocket holds secrets - if you can overcome the chaos that stands in your way.

title: Brink of War
description:
게임 정보
Brink of War is a fast-paced and realistic first person shooter (FPS) game. Its realistic graphics, intense and fast combat experience can make everyone feel the excitement of confrontation. In this game, you can team up with friends to fight against enemies and compete for victory.

Realistic visuals: Brink of War utilizes advanced graphics engine technology to present players with a realistic battlefield environment. The terrain, weather, and lighting effects in the game can all provide players with an immersive experience.

Diversified weapons and equipment: The game offers a wide selection of weapons and equipment, including pistols, rifles, sniper rifles, submachine guns, and more. Players can choose suitable weapons and equipment according to their preferences and combat styles, modify firearms to improve various parameters, and dominate the battlefield

Game mode: The game features multiple competitive game modes, such as team death fighting, random weapons, and percentage points, and sets maps with different rhythms. Players can team up with friends to participate in competitions and showcase teamwork and tactical strategies.

Faster paced battles: The game emphasizes a fast-paced and realistic combat experience, where players need to make quick decisions on the battlefield, flexibly use various skills and tactics, and defeat enemies.

https://bfw.framer.ai/

Ranking and Achievement System: The game has a leaderboard where players can compete with other players for honors. Providing players with rich achievements and stimulating their competitive desire.

Regular updates and activities: The development team (i.e. me) will regularly update the game content, introduce new maps, weapons, and modes to keep players fresh at all times. At the same time, various activities will be held within the game to bring more benefits and challenges to players.

In short, Brink of War is an FPS game full of competitive passion and realism, suitable for players who enjoy fast-paced battles and teamwork. In this game, you will experience the fun of fighting alongside friends, challenging yourself, and achieving glory!
company: 我要自己做游戏, 核弹拌面

title: GOMAN -stuck in the avici hell
description:
게임 정보
GOMAN은 이름 없는 지옥을 배경으로 한 횡스크롤 액션 게임입니다.

어떤 이유로 지옥에 던져진 주인공 가몬이 지옥에서 탈출해 역으로 탈출을 시도합니다.

그는 지옥의 여러 층을 지배하며 탈출을 막으려는 '누시와 그 하인들'과 맞서 싸워야 합니다.

강한 개성을 가진 누시들이 만든 세계에서 탈출을 시도하는 사람은 죽임을 당하고 입구로 되돌아가 끝없는 형벌을 받습니다.

가몬이 가진 유일한 무기는 그가 죽기 전에 얻은 특성인 '무한한 저항 = 깨지지 않는 마음'입니다.

가몬은 수만 번 죽임을 당하고 돌아와도 포기하지 않고 걸음을 멈추지 않으며 누시에게 계속 도전합니다.

적의 강한 일격에 반격하여 격퇴하고, 때로는 죽었다가 돌아오기도 하지만 죽었을 때의 기억을 이용해 적의 공격을 읽고 반격합니다.

title: ReWire
description:
게임 정보
Congratulations! Fresh off the farm and out of the circuit-barn, you've been selected as a member of the Agrifront Circuit Engineers. You've finally got the chance to help out the war effort. Put out your pipe and grab your multimeter - you've got a job to do, Technician.

title: Sorry
description:
게임 정보
Sorry, Wrong Door is a thrilling online co-op experience for 1-4 players,
where you and your team are trapped inside a haunted castle. But this is no ordinary castle an all-powerful demon roams its halls, and the only way out is to defeat it.
Face Terrifying Bosses


Dive into a procedurally generated nightmare filled with terrifying monsters, cunning traps, and deadly surprises at every turn. Work together, scavenge for weapons, find keys, and fight to survive as the castle constantly shifts around you. The clock is ticking, and the demon is watching.
Experience Unique Adventures


Team up with friends in intense online co-op mode.

title: Christmas Smash
description:
게임 정보
전작 "Christmas Blaster"에서 산타클로스는 이미 크리스마스를 위협하는 사악한 존재 크람푸스와 맞서 싸워 그를 물리쳤습니다. 그의 용기와 결단력이 승리하여 평화와 기쁨을 되찾았습니다.
이제 "Christmas Smash"에서 크람푸스가 돌아와 엘프들 사이에서 큰 반란을 일으키고, 산타클로스를 그의 사명을 포기하도록 강요하기 위해 산타 부인을 납치합니다. 용기와 뛰어난 능력으로 잘 알려진 산타클로스는 다시 한 번 다가오는 위험에 맞서기 위해 소환되며, 이번에는 크람푸스와 그의 반역 엘프 군대로부터 사랑하는 사람을 구해야 합니다.
여정 동안 산타클로스는 부패한 엘프, 기계, 얼음 병사와 같은 강력한 적들과 위험한 도전에 직면합니다. 그는 동료들의 도움을 받아 눈 덮인 환경을 헤치고 나아가며, 최종적으로 적 크람푸스의 소굴에 도달하여 그와의 최후의 대결에 임합니다.
폭발적이고 액션 가득한 모험을 준비하세요!

title: Deep Sea Trip
description:
게임 정보
About The Game
Deep Sea Trip is 2D RPG deep water adventure game. The Oceans have many dangers, but there are new dangers that threaten all deep sea and ocean life. A hero fish must save the day by helping ocean friends, defeating toxic and trash monsters while figuring out their way through the ocean and life.
Featuring:

-Classic roleplaying elements mixed with modern themes

-A variety of enemies to defeat with various battle styles

-Buildings and caves to explore

-Various NPC's to interact in different ways with

-Be The Fish

I will be donating 10% sales profit after steam cut to Ocean Conservations, Ocean Explorations/Research and other Ocean causes. I will be donating to various organizations, and will be updating this further


The game is still in development, some assets in screenshots maybe updated before release

title: Amazing Space
description:
게임 정보
⠀⠀⠀⠀

Welcome to the fascinating world of space stations! Immerse yourself in a futuristic chaotic environment and create your own space base in the vastness of space. In this thrilling scenario, you become a pioneer and the last hope of humanity after Earth has been destroyed. With your spaceship, you managed to be one of the few survivors, and now it's up to you to plan and build a new home for your crew.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

Your space base will not only be a place of survival but also a place of progress and innovation. With workplaces, production facilities, service rooms, and shipyards, you have the opportunity to build a thriving community in space. Lay the foundation for a sustainable way of life and ensure your crew has everything they need to live and work.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

The workplaces in your space base will ensure that everyone has a meaningful task and contributes to the whole. From scientists working on groundbreaking discoveries to engineers developing new technologies to doctors caring for the well-being of the crew, everyone will play an important role. The diversity of professions will create a sense of community and purpose.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

The production facilities are the engine of your space base. Here, you can gather and process raw materials to produce essential materials and resources for survival and progress. Create an efficient production chain and optimize your processes to ensure the sustainability and independence of your space base.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

Service rooms will be crucial for the well-being and safety of your crew. Create recreational and community areas where people can relax and interact with each other. Also, consider the need for medical facilities and emergency measures to respond quickly in emergencies.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

Finally, a shipyard is where new spaceships are built and maintained. This will help you expand your fleet and broaden the horizon of your explorations. You can discover new worlds, mine resources, and rescue more survivors.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

However, dangers also lurk in the vastness of space. Always be on guard, as your spaceship and space base could be targeted by hostile forces seeking your resources. There is a real danger that enemies will try to hijack and plunder your spaceship.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

To protect your space base and crew, you should implement defense systems. Develop advanced defense mechanisms to repel potential attackers. From security teams to automated weapon systems to security protocols and access controls, your defense measures must be robust to defend your space base and valuable resources.

title: Angira Online
description:
게임 정보
Angira Online is a survival and building game set in a fantasy Norse world. Players take on the role of a explorer who has been sent to the realm of Angira, tasked with defeating the unknowns of the world abound and building a settlement to claim it. One of the key features of the game is the ability to build and customize boats, which players use to explore the various oceans and fjords in the game world. The game also features a crafting system, allowing players to create weapons, armor, and tools to aid them in combat and exploration.

Players must gather resources, such as wood and stone, to build their settlement and craft items. They must also hunt for food and fend off hostile creatures, such as wolves and unfriendly players. As players progress, they will encounter and defeat powerful enemies, be it players or whatever lurks in the forest, each with their own unique abilities and skills. The game is massively online, persistent, and an ever bourgeoning world filled with plenty to explore.

Angira Online also has a lot of exploration element, as players can discover different biomes such as meadows, swamps, mountains, and the deep sea. Each biome has its own unique resources and creatures, and players will need to adapt their strategies and equipment accordingly. The game also has a day and night cycle and different weather conditions, adding an extra layer of realism and challenge to the gameplay.

title: Titan Force
description:
게임 정보
The cities were overrun, by a relentless horde of zombies, the result of a catastrophic experiment gone awry. The undead were relentless, and no cure could turn back the tide of decay that swept over the planet.

The remnants of humanity turned to the only hope left: Titans. These machines were the legacy of a bygone era, their origins lost to myth and legend, now resurrected as humanity’s last line of defense.

In the heart of the wasteland that was once a thriving metropolis, the Titanforge facility stood as a bastion of hope. Here, engineers and soldiers worked side by side, forging alliances and crafting their path to survival.

Commander Maya Strickland, a veteran of countless battles, led the charge. She was a master pilot, her mind and spirit fused with her Titan, Aegis Prime. Together, they were an unstoppable force, her strategic prowess matched only by the Titan’s raw power.

As the sun set on what could be Earth’s final day, the ground shook with the approach of the undead legion. The air was filled with the electric hum of the Titans powering up, their eyes glowing like beacons in the encroaching darkness.

“Today, we fight not just for our lives, but for the future of all humanity!” Commander Strickland’s voice boomed over the comms. “We are the Titans and we will hold the line!”

The battle was a symphony of destruction. Aegis Prime’s cannons roared, cutting swathes through the undead ranks. Each Titan moved with lethal grace, their pilots’ wills bending metal and circuitry to their command.

As the night wore on, the tide began to turn. The relentless advance of the zombies was halted, then pushed back. The Titans stood tall amidst the chaos, their forms battered but unbroken.

When dawn broke, the survivors emerged from their mechs, weary but alive. They had won the battle, but the war for Earth’s future was just beginning.

In the aftermath, Commander Strickland looked out over the horizon. The world was changed, but as long as the Titans stood, there was hope.

And so, the Titans marched on, their metal feet echoing the heartbeat of a world fighting to live once more.


Key Features:

Colossal Mechs, Limitless Exploration: These towering machines become your vessels for exploration and survival. Traverse unknown landscapes, uncover hidden secrets, and adapt to the ever-changing environment.

Zee’s Enigma: Why are we here? Who is Zee? These questions propel you forward, urging you to unravel the tapestry of this enigmatic world. Zee’s survival holds the keys to our destiny.

Craft Your Path: Establish outposts, gather rare materials, and master the art of mech modification. Customize your war machine, from reinforced armor to energy-efficient thrusters.

Epic Battles Across Realms: Ground warfare, naval clashes, and dogfights in the skies—prepare for adrenaline-pumping confrontations. The fate of our kind hinges on your prowess.

Forge Alliances: Seek allies among fellow pilots. Together, you’ll uncover the truth, face PvP challenges, and shape the course of history.

Why Titanforge?
Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in a visually striking world where every detail matters.
Dynamic Gameplay: Adapt, strategize, and conquer. The environment evolves, and so must you.

Prepare to Pilot: The colossal mech awaits your command. Explore the unknown, uncover the truth, and forge your legacy.
Join the Titanforge community on Steam and be part of an epic saga!

title: Better Save Souls
description:
게임 정보


Better Save Souls - is an action roguelite game where you fight against hordes of enemies and face terrifying bosses, upgrade powerful skills to improve your character. Collect enemies souls and unlock unique heroes.

Choose your character and go on an unforgettable adventure and find your play style!

title: Neanderthallica
description:
게임 정보
Discover a prehistoric world like no other in "Neanderthallica," an engaging puzzle-metroidvania adventure with a delightful twist of sci-fi. Harness the power to manipulate the weather, shaping the environment and battles in unique ways. Craft an arsenal of gear and weapons, solve clever puzzles, and unravel hidden secrets in this visually captivating and humor-filled journey. Embrace the challenge, master the elements, and embark on an unforgettable quest through time. Are you ready to become the ultimate Neanderthal adventurer?

Key Features:

Change the weather to influence the environment, battle mechanics, and gameplay outcomes.
Craft spare parts and discover over 150 gear and weapon combinations, to allow you to tailor own approach to challenges.
Utilize weapons and weather conditions strategically to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and defeat enemies.
Explore and discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and unlock achievements as you explore the prehistoric world.
Translate symbolic dialogues to interact with NPCs and unravel the mysteries of the game.
Blend of sci-fi and prehistoric settings, offering a refreshing and captivating gameplay experience.
Humorous and lightheartedness narrative.

title: Yes Comrade
description:
게임 정보
Long Live the Great, Glorious Nation of Belegovska
Yes Comrade is a multiplayer survival sandbox where players have been based at a remote military lighthouse to complete tasks in the name of the country’s sea defence. 
Called in to take over after the previous members of the Lighthouse went crazy and trashed the place, you have been reassigned to man the sea outpost and continue the protection of the State's sea border and secrets.  
You start on a small motor boat in a foggy ocean set for the remote posting. As you arrive at the lighthouse the fog begins to clear and the brutalist architecture of the lighthouse shows. Run down and historic, this building hasn’t seen any repairs for quite some time. 
The lighthouse is a mess, trash piles are scattered everywhere, the furniture tipped over or pushed to one side. It's time to start the clean up process.
Ships need to be looked out for from the top of the lighthouse. Around the top of the ceiling is a compass for directing the communication radio. Depending on the type of ship different frequencies of radio need to be used to communicate with the ship. All messages sent to the ships are pre-recorded. Messages sent back are translated on screen. A manual of the ship's flags and styles can be found next to the communication desk. Some ships will be friendly and you can decide if you want to let them through. You have to check some elements of the ship (flag the correct way) and accept or turn them away as necessary.
The polaroid camera is used to capture anomalies seen while working the lighthouse. Images should be developed in the dark room of the basement (red room), then scanned at the computer and sent to Party Headquarters.

title: Plague Alchemist
description:
게임 정보
Plague Alchemist
You are plunged into a mundane world that is on the brink of being reshaped. As an outcast doctor, you will be forced to put down your bandages and pick up weapons. There is something happening that you can fix, but not alone.
Corruption
Something is reshaping the world and affecting its inhabitants. This has happened before, a long, long time ago. The corruption is leaving cracks in the earth and seeping through.
How was it stopped before?
Where does this come from, and can it be stopped again before it consumes everything?
Maybe...
Alchemy
Alchemy, the cornerstone of this adventure, is where you can truly shine. Discoveries need to be made, resources understood, and the process refined. Hunting for the most powerful ingredients will be pointless if they are used incorrectly.
Blow something up? Of course.
Make trees come alive? Quite possibly.
Shape time and reality by smashing a bottle? ...
A lion’s share of time and dedication has been poured into making the collection of mixtures, potions, and salves feel worth your time and effort to find, craft, and use.
The ultimate goal of this game is achieved when you experience a sense of accomplishment every time you discover a new recipe.
Dungeons
At the heart of this mystery lies something very close to you. The keys to all of this are found in dungeons. The dungeon experience is designed to be difficult for the unprepared.
Claw your way through resource-rich and danger-filled caverns, forests, and mind-bending corrupted worlds, only to face a powerful foe at the end.
Once entered, there are only four ways out: pass out from exhaustion, leaving everything behind; run home and forfeit all you have accomplished and acquired; die in battle; or succeed and claim the spoils. Or is there another way?

title: The Void Calls
description:
게임 정보

Welcome to Reprieve, a town floating above a writhing abyss, formed by murder locations and inhabited by killers. Those unfortunate enough to end up here find themselves trapped, and are inevitably consumed by The Void. Can you escape with your wit and courage, or will you be absorbed like all the rest?

Inspired by classic point-and-click adventures and indie masterpieces, The Void Calls is dark, atmospheric, and exploratory.


Point-And-Click Interface - Interact with anything, use items to solve puzzles.
Discover Secrets - Not everything in Reprieve is as it first seems.
Converse - You'll have to get to know the strange townsfolk to get out.
Explore - It's a big town, with plenty to see.


Dozens of hand-drawn pixel art environments

title: Elite Rogue
description:
게임 정보
CHOOSE YOUR CONTRACT
Every mission is a gamble—select from three randomized contracts before entering a new dimension. Each contract has a unique objective, from high-risk assassinations to dangerous extractions. Adapt, strategize, and survive against escalating threats. Succeed, and you’ll earn Darkmatter, a permanent currency that can be spent anywhere—during a mission or between runs—to unlock game-changing abilities, new classes, and cosmetics. But beware—the Contractor isn’t always on your side. Hidden risks lurk within each deal, and betrayal may come when you least expect it.

title: Bloody Horror Plant
description:
게임 정보
피 흘리는 호러 식물 – 아마도 가장 피투성이인 캐주얼 포인트 앤 클릭 어드벤처 게임! 호러 식물이 흥미로운 그리고 웃긴 포인트 앤 클릭 퍼즐을 해결하도록 도와주고, 악한 드워프를 처치하고 숲과 그 생물들을 구해라![/b]
행복한 생물들이 사는 아름다우면서 여유로운 숲은 이제 악한 드워프에게 점령당했습니다. 식인성 호러 식물을 사용하여 악한 드워프 거주지를 탐험하세요. 숲의 구조를 확인하고 지하로 들어가고 나무 꼭대기로 올라가서 모두 처치하여 자연을 지키세요. 섬세한 유머와 많은 악한 드워프의 피!



악한 드워프를 교묘히 물리치고 숲에 다시 평화를 가져올 수 있을까요?

■ 편안하면서도 자극적인 게임 플레이. 환경과 상호 작용하고 작은 포인트 앤 클릭 / 숨겨진 오브젝트 퍼즐을 해결하여 호러 식물을 도와 고유한 위치를 통해 이동하세요. 시작하기 쉽지만 내려놓기 어려움.

■ 독특하고 기이한 손그림 2D 아트 스타일 및 2D 애니메이션.

■ 몰입적이고 웃긴 캐릭터 보이스오버, 편안한 자연 소리 및 매료적인 스토리텔링으로 모험의 세계를 탐험하세요.

■ 몇몇 레벨에는 여러 엔딩이 있습니다. 놓치지 마세요!

title: Build Fight Game
description:
게임 정보
Build Fight Game is a class-based shooter set across a collection of fully interactable voxel environments. Create, destroy, and shoot your way to victory with your team in procedurally-generated multiplayer maps!
Choose your fighter
Pick from one of three classes that best suits your gameplay style:
Recon: Low health, but fast and agile with a high powered shotgun and rapid tunnel-digging shovel. A good Recon can leverage their movement and firepower to make up for their low HP and come out on top even against the toughest opponents, all while digging strategic routes with their shovel to assist their team.
Construction: Able to build complex schematics, Construction players massively enhance their team's defences. They are equipped with a special hybrid sniper/assault rifle: the sniper mode can be devastating at long range to players that let their guard down, while the assault rifle mode is vital to staying alive in a pinch.
Destruction: High HP and low mobility, Destruction players are an explosive powerhouse with a grenade launcher and throwable dynamite. No defence is strong enough to stop their wrath, and any player caught off guard will be quickly turned to gibs.
Prepare your defences
Create key strategic pathways and hidden tunnels as Recon, build bases for your team as Construction, and ready yourself for the battle...
Battle
Engage in tense matchups against your enemies. The best players must use every tool at their disposal to come out on top in fights, even if the odds are stacked against them.
Win.
Collect gold from foes that you defeat and take it to your vault! The team with the most gold in their vault at the end of the match wins - but be careful not to let the enemies in, lest they take your gold from right under your nose!
Features
Proximity-based voice chat.

title: Shadows Of Deceit
description:
게임 정보
Explore the spectral city of Havenbrook, now shrouded in darkness and mystery.
Every step you take reveals fragments of a larger story, a tale of tragedy, loss, and dark forces lurking in the shadows.
But beware, you are not alone. Something or someone knows your every move and seeks to obstruct your path to the truth. Will you survive long enough to unravel the mystery and free yourself from this endless trap?
This is an experience that will leave you breathless, a harrowing descent into the darkest recesses of the human psyche. Confront the unknown and discover if you have the strength to overcome the trials that await you.

title: Operation Crustacean
description:
게임 정보
Ride a hotdog-selling shrimp through a surreal and perilous island in this punishing 3D platformer with a twisted sense of humor.
STORY

Wake up, soldier!
You play as the lone survivor of Operation Crustacean, who got stranded in a secret world. Explore a dark and gloomy island filled with danger and unravel its mysteries to find a way back home.

GAMEPLAY

Challenge yourself with the unique shrimp-riding controls and the game's permadeath mechanics that will require all your skill.
Alternate between 2 control schemes on the fly with the press of a button: "Precision" for accurate controls and direct, vertical movement; "Gallop" to go fast and far - but at a price: The increased momentum requires planning ahead.
Avoid deadly traps, encounter ridiculous enemies and face off against epic bosses that will push you to your limits.
Experience a surreal and twisted sense of humor that will make you laugh and shiver at the same time.
Uncover rare permanent power-ups that will give you the decisive edge when it comes to life and death.

Do you have what it takes to survive and escape this bizarre island? Giddy up!

title: DI: Debt is Inevitable
description:
게임 정보
-= DEATH IS INEVITABLE =-

Each wave will feature larger quantities of enemies, where you must keep a high combo and grab as many coins as you can in order to maximize your profits each round. Memorization of the level's waves and learning each weapon are also key to delaying the inevitable. Reaching the "final" wave will just start it back from the beginning, but even more hectic than before. You cannot escape your demise.
-= DEBT IS INEVITABLE =-

The shop contains everything you need to help you survive, at prices you cannot afford. Here, you can find health, weapons, armor, consumables, powerups, and passive upgrades. Each purchase from the shop increases that item's future prices, so if you're not careful, you may soon find yourself with empty pockets, and a mountain full of debt.
Your deaths and failures in DI will not be in vain, as each run will help you unlock new levels, characters, items, and mechanics that will be available in future runs. Each unlock that you acquire can change the way you play the game dramatically. There's no shortage of things to discover in DI.

title: VICCP 2 Core
description:
게임 정보
You are again behind the mysterious control panel of omnipotence. Explore it and solve riddles. In the continuation of the game VICCP 2 Core, you have to find many endings, of which there are more.

The game is a retro sci-fi in which you can spend time atmospherically. There is no need to hurry, this is a busy board but for adults. Many different switches and buttons, levers, displays. Feedback from the first part was taken into account and no more giant puzzles, instead an increased number of atmospheric places.

PECULIARITIES:

More puzzles
More atmospheric music
More old school spirit
More endings
Even more achievements
Even more retro sci-fi and cyberpunk atmosphere.
There are no stuffy giant puzzles, as in the first part.

title: Neon Death Drop
description:
게임 정보
Explore a futuristic sky-city teeming with glitchy robots in NEON DEATH DROP, an action game about a gay go-go boy who must use his fierce dance moves to save the world.
THE GROUND IS YOUR PLAYGROUND
Manipulate floor tiles by making them move, grow, or even disappear
SLAY THE BOTS DOWN
Defeat enemies by knocking them into pits and watch them drop dead

title: ChipWits
description:
게임 정보
ChipWits is a robot coding game with no prior programming experience required. In this game, you use an icon-based language to guide your robot to solve open-ended puzzles and rescue the crew of a space station taken over by a rogue AI, Dr. Droog.


Someone, or something, has forced every last crew member to evacuate Droog Station! The fate of the station – and its crew – is left to a humble robot sitting in the corner of a supply closet: a ChipWit Model CW-03.24.


To save the station, you transmit instructions to your ChipWit by placing chips in a grid. No prior programming knowledge is required – you’ll be taught everything you need to know!




Feeling creative? Solve puzzles in unique and clever ways – there's no one right answer! Optional bonus missions have no objective other than to have fun!

Every solution can be optimized to:
• Maximize your score
• Minimize the number of chips used
• Minimize the number of cycles (steps) it takes for your program to run



When you complete your solution, you can compare your performance to players all around the world!


Droog Station isn’t going to save itself! Unravel the mystery of Dr. Droog and uncover his motive while you go face to face with some of his robotic creations.

Navigate the corridors and rooms of the station to get to your next mission. Rescue other robots and make new friends who will help you in your quest!

Finished the game? Check back often for new puzzles and challenges, and see if you can top the leaderboard!


Look familiar? ChipWits was originally released in 1984 as one of the first games for the Macintosh, Commodore 64, and Apple II.




Join our Discord community (link in the sidebar) to learn how to become a beta tester, connect with fellow players, share tips, and stay updated on the latest game news and events.

title: BLIGHTWRECK
description:
게임 정보
BLIGHTWRECK is a handcrafted 2D action-adventure Metroidvania set in a sunken ocean liner. Explore the bowels of the Starchaser, and the ocean floor surrounding it to find a way home.

Features
Five wildly different areas to explore, each filled with an assortment of upgrades to find and enemies to fight. Traverse the Starchaser’s wreck in this tight 2D platformer.
Gorgeous hand drawn 32 bit pixel art, with colorful yet atmospheric environments to traverse. No two areas look alike, and enemies are filled with personality.
An energetic soundtrack that pulls from a charcuterie board of 90s electronic music. Head bang to the boss theme while fighting a giant squid, relax and chill out to the melodic tones of the Kelp Forest in the ambience of a glowing jellyfish.
Uncover the mystery of the Starchaser’s sinking… Where are all the bodies?
Lots of crabs.

title: Marble Puzzles
description:
게임 정보
Sandbox Marble Track Creator
Create the marble track of your dreams with dozens of parts and in different environments. Build your marble track with slopes, pipes and curves or go a little more crazy and use triggers, elevators and boosters. If that's not enough then there are also teleporters, gravity fields and marble eaters.

Mind bending Puzzles
Solve nifty puzzles created by our own team or by the community. Use the parts correctly to guide each marble to their goal. An ever increasing level of difficulty makes sure you get in easily and are challenged for a long time.

Defend yourself against the marbles in tower defense mode. Make sure the marbles don't hit the detonation trigger and instead reach the goal.
Choose the right parts to build your deck and use your deck to solve increasingly difficult puzzles in rogue like mode.

title: Wendigo Hunter
description:
게임 정보
If you like the game please don't forget to add it to your wishlist.
Wendigo Hunter is an action roguelite dungeon crawler with mysterious atmosphere and minimalistic visual. As a chosen member of a cult you will try to hunt down a mythological creature hiding deep in dungeons and abandoned ruins. Unleash a captivating journey where fallen enemies' souls become the key to unlocking mesmerizing magical skills.
Fight, collect, upgrade, die, try again...
FEATURES
master your fighting skills in combat with various creatures
explore randomly generated dungeon
upgrade your magical skills by collecting souls of dead enemies
gain permanent upgrades by spending collected gems
Will you succeed or the next hunter from the cult will need to be chosen?
ABOUT DEVELOPER
Peter Jurkovský, solo developer and father of 1, began work on Wendigo Hunter as a hobby in 2022 after releasing his first PC game called Juro Janosik.

title: NANOVOID
description:
게임 정보
In NANOVOID it's not just about the shooting - it's about outsmarting your enemies. Customize and command your modular ship where each piece adds a unique function and can be the difference between victory and defeat. But beware, your enemies aren't just a health bar. Their ships also use the same modular system, meaning you'll need to strategically target their ship's components to disable them effectively.



Engage in intense battles where the laws of physics reign supreme. Every movement, every shot fired, every explosion generates forces that can be used to your advantage - or lead to your downfall if mismanaged.

Features:

Modular Ships: Build your own spaceship from various modules, each with its own function and characteristics.
Realistic Physics: All actions have consequences, and the realistic physics engine brings a new level of depth to space combat.
Tactical Combat: Outmaneuver your enemies, target their weak points, and use the environment to your advantage.
Epic Encounters: Face off against a variety of enemies, each with their own unique behaviors, attack patterns, and weaknesses.
Stunning Visuals: Experience the beauty and chaos of space with visually stunning graphics and special effects.

In this 2D tactical space shooter, you'll engage in fast-paced battles against deadly enemies and bosses, using strategy and planning to outmaneuver and outgun your opponents. Utilize your skills and reflexes to take down powerful bosses, and immerse yourself in a beautifully designed universe with stunning visuals and special effects.

Fly and fight using intuitive WSAD controls and mouse aim. The open space offers strategic possibilities, allowing you to retreat and recover your shields before re-engaging.

title: JETPACK BIRDIE
description:
게임 정보
JETPACK BIRDIE is a fast-pased third-person shooter that takes the fun and freedom of jetpack flights to a whole new level. Use its power to ignore the ground. Find and use wind zones to gain more speed, or risk using accelerated flight, which can overheat your jetpack and cause it to explode.
You are Birdie, a young man on the run from the most powerful gang in the city above the clouds. Evade enemies in a thrilling chase and carve your way to a free future. Cooperate with rebel group called Red Poppy Society and discover the dark secrets of global politics.
Your journey will fuse the short sections of NEON WHITE, classic shooter fun of the original MAX PAYNE, multi-functional weapon of CONTROL and movement that you have never seen before. Master your skills and unlock secrets in highly replayable environments to become an unstoppable force.
Features
Highly enjoyable movement with a lot of depth.
Short levels with high replayability, reminiscent of speedrun shooters.
Includes arcade mode with special challenges, leaderboard and ranking system.
Concentrated action story set in an alternate world after the collapse of the Great War.
An old school shooter with no covers or unnecessary pauses.

title: Dice Dice Dice: A Roll Playing Game
description:
게임 정보
Explore a world of turn based RPG but every move has been replaced with dice rolls.

Tactical Dice Combat: Engage in strategic battles where every roll matters. With each character wielding their own dice, the outcome of your attacks, defenses, and abilities are in the hands of chance. Adapt, strategize, and roll your way to victory!

Customizable Dice Heroes: Discover fragments scattered throughout the world and unlock new party members to join your quest. Customize each die face with shards found in chests or earned from vanquished foes. Craft the perfect combination of abilities and unleash the full potential of your party!

Chance and Choice: Embrace the unpredictability of the dice as you face enemies and make crucial decisions. With the outcome of battles, the loot you discover, and the fate of your party all determined by the roll of the dice, every moment is a thrilling gamble.

The choice is out of your hands, its in the dice you just threw.
autokwd: Dice Dice Dice: A Roll Playing Game

title: For Evelyn II - Shards of Creation
description:
게임 정보
PS1 명작에서 영감을 받은 역동적인 전투에 참여하세요.
근접 공격, 원거리 공격, 마법을 사용하거나 은신으로 적을 제압하세요. 적들은 각기 다른 방식으로 반응하므로 전투마다 전략이 필요합니다. 복잡한 퍼즐을 풀고, 숨겨진 경로를 찾아 강력한 보스를 물리쳐 새로운 능력과 유물을 획득하세요. 힘과 지략으로 이 가혹한 세계에서 당신만의 길을 개척하세요.
서사 중심의 RPG:
복잡한 캐릭터와 도덕적 딜레마, 여러 갈래의 선택이 있는 깊이 있는 스토리를 경험하세요.
선택이 중요한 대화:
대화 중 내리는 결정이 퀘스트, 관계, 게임의 결과에 영향을 미칩니다.
2D와 3D의 융합:
2D 픽셀 아트 캐릭터와 3D 환경이 조화를 이루는 독특한 비주얼 스타일을 탐험하세요.
autokwd: For Evelyn II - Shards of Creation

title: Rogue Jungle
description:
게임 정보
An Action-Roguelike set in a procedurally generated jungle!
The game world is procedurally generated and offers an unlimited experience! Fight and explore your way through this jungle and improve your skill with each run!



Upgrade your weapons and unlock new abilities!
After every fight, you can upgrade your wepon or unlock a new ability to build a unique moveset in each run!



Epic boss fights at the end of each run!
Face a big boss enemy after every run to escape the jungle!

title: Scrapchasers
description:
게임 정보
A single colony ship sails amongst the stars, its people desperate and courageous. Somewhere in the galaxy waits their new home. But the galaxy is a big and dangerous place. This isn't going to work on the first attempt...

In Scrapchasers, players travel the stars in search of a new star to call home, but they will need more than just their wits to succeed. They will need tenacity, struggling against overwhelming odds to obtain the means for their survival. Ships can be lost, but no attempt is in vain, as the massive colony ship continues its journey undeterred.

Gameplay features in Scrapchasers include:

Build your ship from scraps with deckbuilding logic
Defeat enemy ships to obtain new parts and resources
Upgrade your colony ship between runs for persistent powers
Initiate interstellar travel to generate new star systems to explore

title: Creatures on island
description:
게임 정보
소개
생물을 활용하여 작은 섬의 진화 방향을 배치한다.
작은 섬의 능력과 생물을 조합한 특기.
강력한 팀을 만들어 경기에서 이기다.
캐주얼 모드 PVE
컴퓨터와 대결
10경기에서 승리
배열 모드 PVP
플레이어와 대결
10경기에서 승리
우승 후 끝없는 모드 계속 가능

title: Not Only Nine
description:
게임 정보
Till All Complete
You have fallen. Your soul is a cat, journeying to the center of The Afterlife in order to save your human. However, the Reapers will try to stop you from reaching The Tower. An ancient being (helps?) defeat Death itself in this narrative RPG with turn-based boss battles.

Game Features:
NO quest markers - interact with residents of The Afterlife to progress.
Actually, there are no menus at all - game systems are directly integrated into the world.
Heartfelt story with deep characters that respond to actions you've taken.
I am sorry for what I do to these characters.
