The best part of RPG's is exploring RPG towns so I put a lot of that.

title: Hivefall
description:
게임 정보
Synthesis: Welcome to Hivefall, a post-apocalyptic world devastated by The Hive, a horde of carnivorous mutants that hunt in synchronicity. As one of the last survivors, your mission is simple: stay alive. Drive your caravan, fight for resources and decide whether you will rebuild what is left of humanity or perish in the attempt.
Every decision counts in this fight for survival and hope for a better future.
Main mechanics:
Dynamic Survival: Explore a hostile world by collecting resources, hunting prey and facing mutants. Constant movement is your best ally,
as stopping too long could attract the deadly attention of The Hive.
Your Caravan, Your Strength: Your vehicle is not just a means of transportation; It is your home, your refuge and your best weapon. Customize it and improve its capabilities to resist enemy attacks and travel long distances.
Wave Battles: Stay in one place too long and prepare to face endless hordes of enemies. With your caravan as a mobile combat base, use strategic tactics and resources to survive these brutal confrontations.
Reconstruction and Renaissance: Shows that humanity still has a chance.
If you survive long enough, you can help the villagers build self-sufficient settlements, marking the beginning of the recovery of the lost world.

title: Land of Ramchin: Between Dimensions
description:
게임 정보
Overview
In this expansive open-world action role-playing game, you will play as the valiant protagonist, Vico, as you embark on a series of adventures across the sprawling land of Ramchin. Engage in the seamless transitions between multiple dimensions. Through the journey, you will enhance your power and skills through battles and trials and forge your own remarkable tale in this vividly imagined world.

Story
In antiquity, a great flood swept away the dwellings of our ancestors. A giant goat bore the survivors upon its back as they drifted across the endless sea. They journeyed until the ceaseless rain subsided, revealing the once-hidden sky. However, the goat himself transformed into a vast land, with its sinews sculpting towering mountains and its arteries giving life to winding rivers. People call this place the land of Ramchin.

Millenniums later, one day, Vico got lost in a desert and stumbled upon a tram. As he prepared to board, an old man stopped him, warning him that the vehicle was a ghost tram. Subsequently, Vico found himself in a shadowy realm where two infernal messengers sought to capture him. Jolted awake by profound fear, he pondered the unsettling notion that the ghostly tram in his nightmare should appear in the real world!

This marks merely the commencement. We refrain from any more spoilers here, for the allure of this enigmatic fantasy tale is destined to captivate your imagination!

Gameplay

Beyond the abilities to run and swim, players can indulge in paragliding, self-propelled flight, and even mount a dragon to soar across the skies.

A diverse array of of items can be collected, each serving various purposes, facilitating wealth accumulation, investments, and the potential for unexpected robbing encounters. And, engaging in malicious activities in the Land of Ramchin may lead to your incarceration.

The game boasts a sophisticated system encompassing time, weather, banking, public transport, teleportation, quests, achievements, and equipment upgrades. Throughout your journey, a multitude of features ensures a continuous source of enjoyment and exploration.

Fight

In action battle mode, Vico can employ a sword for attacks, wield a shield for defence, and harness skills for additional power. Your equipment can undergo upgrades as you progress through your adventure. Make sure to pay a visit to a Landlord Shrine when you come across one!


Each location is bestowed with a name derived from its origin. For instance, Juhe, which means river in the Manchu language, or Talnotog, translating to plateau in Mongolian. Every unique place holds cultural references to real-world locations.

The protagonist is meticulously crafted to embody the appearance of a seasoned adventurer, with his golden hair colour and iconic red shirt carrying significant meaning within the narrative.


It is strongly recommended that you use a game controller (Xbox controller, PS controller, joysticks) to play.

title: Timeless Rain
description:
게임 정보
Play the demo now which features infinite lives for the 'Casual' difficulty setting to help introduce you to the world of Timeless Rain! Please note that this is an exclusive feature for the demo only.
In Timeless Rain you awake within an unknown world which seems to be unbound by the limitations of time. However, only the angelic fiends are able to fully bend the clocks to their will. There are whispers of a place, deep within the Forest of Evocation, which is said to be able to raise someone up to the same capabilities as these monsters, for better or for worse...
During the course of your travels through this world, there is some important information you may want to know. As any other creature who grasps onto their instinct to survive within this hellscape naturally would, you will learn to manipulate time in slight manners. The process will be slow and tedious, but surviving long enough to reach this 'place' is surely going to be worth it... right? Because if not... why not just feed yourself to the devils and demons that inhabit this realm?

title: Adventures of Steve the Cat
description:
게임 정보
Adventures of Steve the Cat — this is a cozy adventure platformer-study, where you will play as a small and cute cat Steve, who is trying to defeat the professor and return to normal life, from which he was unexpectedly snatched when his friends were kidnapped. And although you are lost and puzzled, you have to overcome all kinds of dangers of the forest and other locations! The game will make you feel nostalgic for the old platforerms from childhood! A beautiful picture, convenient controls and beautiful music will not leave anyone indifferent!



You are a cute cat Steve, who has to go through a lot of beautiful, exciting and dangerous locations. On your way you are going to meet a lot of enemies created by a crazy professor. He steals animals and puts experiments on them. You have to fight him and save innocent animals from him. Jump, spin, crush your enemies!



Features:
Colorful graphics
Cute main character
10 beautiful levels
Convenient and responsive gameplay

title: Starshapes
description:
게임 정보
Starshapes is a sleek puzzle drawing game where your solutions become beautiful neon-like star constellations. Many puzzles have multiple logic-based solutions, allowing for freedom to experiment with the game mechanics and finding unconventional solutions.
Solve puzzle constellations
Go stargazing and re-imagine the night sky by drawing your own constellations in 3D puzzles with multiple solutions. Experience constellations from new angles in three dimensions as you etch them into space.
Pick your own path through puzzles and unlock new and interesting rules as you progress. Unwind with ‘Connect the dots’ style secret levels featuring real-life constellations and star signs. Soak in the beautiful starlight of all the puzzles you’ve completed along your journey.
Create new constellations
Draw, Erase and Edit connections between stars to solve the puzzle and create a constellation.
Drag and rotate puzzles in 3D to view them from different angles.
Smooth and elegant animations make learning the gameplay easy and intuitive.
Stargaze your own way
Tailor your experience with accessibility features, such as color-blindness options.

title: SKY THE SCRAPER
description:
게임 정보
Dream-Chasing Window Cleaner x Action-Adventure
Experience a thrilling action-packed adventure as a window cleaner navigating the towering skyscrapers of the city.
Chase your dreams, face harsh realities, and carve out Sky’s future.
Thrilling Cleaning Action
Utilize wires and skills to swiftly and precisely clean buildings.
But be careful—one slip could lead to a deadly fall. Overcome hazards like birds, lightning strikes, strong winds, and many many more as you aim for top performance.
Manage Your Money and Well-being
Taxes, rent, medical bills—survive day by day while managing your limited income.
Overworking takes a toll on your body. Rest and entertainment are key to maintaining balance in your daily life.

title: Heat Division: Rescue Team
description:
게임 정보


Heat Division: Rescue Team is an intense 2D systemic speedrunning platformer. Take control of one of the four distinct members of the Rescue Team and make your way through several urban environments, as seen through the lens of an expressive and colorful pixel art, and safely rescue the civilians trapped within natural and man-made disasters.
Systemic speedrun platformer with warm Cyberfunk-inspired visuals seen through grungy but cartoonish pixel-art.
4 playable firefighters with unique abilities. Rescue civilians from burning buildings, natural/artificial disasters.
Find the fastest way to complete each mission, using tools provided: ladders, water buckets, axes to destroy objects blocking the way, and more.
Designed to support high refresh rates (above 60hz)

title: Awakening: Into the Stars
description:
게임 정보
Captain, can you hear me? I know that you must be a bit nervous, but don’t be, everything’s going to be fine… Just focus on my voice, please! Good! Do you know who I am? You might have some brain fog going on, so don’t worry; I can help you remember! Just open your eyes. Ready?

With the ship’s trusty AI, OMEGA – (but you can call me MEG if you’d like!) in control, there is no reason to worry, for I will take care of everything while you nap in your cosy cryo-chamber, waiting for the day your mission will truly begin.

Spaceships like ours have relied on AI for quite a long time at this point; after all: the margin for error is... minimal.

Your one task is, well, to make sure that you drop off our precious cargo, 1000 colonisers with dreams as big as yours and a hunger for a better, more fulfilling life. There’s no way that any of this could go wrong, right?

Now, theoretically speaking, of course, even if something were to happen, for example, if the ship were damaged by an asteroid, we would be able to take care of it easily. I would, of course, require your help, for I have no thumbs, but trust me… You’d be done with repairs in a few hours!
MEET THE CREW

CAPTAIN ABLE
Do you truly have to think about who you are? First-in-command and Captain of the Oberon, you are one handsome devil. You might be a little loopy after being woken up from sleep a bit earlier than expected, but trust me, soon, you will be back to normal! Ah, your memories? They will clear up in a bit, don’t worry! After all, the initial brain fog only lasts for a few hours… Here, I’ll give you a few shots of extra adrenaline, and you’ll remember everything in great detail... Perhaps even things you’ve forgotten a long ago…

AMELIA
Amelia, your sweetheart and pilot. She’s worked in the field for quite a while – and trust me, there is no one more skilled at minor repairs than her! This spunky girl is the perfect partner for someone as laid-back as you –perhaps that is why the pair of you work so well together! Of course, she will need some time to adjust to being awake once the time comes… But she will be will be back to normal rather quickly.


That’s me! Well, my full name is OMEGA, of course, the AI companion of the Oberon. I am fully dedicated to reaching our destination at any cost, and of course, always there for a quick chat if you need me! Even if you just want to know some trivia: I have the answer to any and all questions you could ask me.
And what’s best? With my empathy module set to 80 – I am able to replicate the actions of humans like you!

With a crew like this, our passengers will reach their destination safe and sound in just 400 years. Isn’t that great?

title: Deep Sea Trip
description:
게임 정보
About The Game
Deep Sea Trip is 2D RPG deep water adventure game. The Oceans have many dangers, but there are new dangers that threaten all deep sea and ocean life. A hero fish must save the day by helping ocean friends, defeating toxic and trash monsters while figuring out their way through the ocean and life.
Featuring:

-Classic roleplaying elements mixed with modern themes

-A variety of enemies to defeat with various battle styles

-Buildings and caves to explore

-Various NPC's to interact in different ways with

-Be The Fish

I will be donating 10% sales profit after steam cut to Ocean Conservations, Ocean Explorations/Research and other Ocean causes. I will be donating to various organizations, and will be updating this further


The game is still in development, some assets in screenshots maybe updated before release

title: Leaf Blowing Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Experience the calming tranquility of blowing thousands of leaves around in Leaf Blowing Simulator, the only real-time physics-based simulator that allows you to effortlessly create your own virtual oasis. Shape nature at your own pace and find relaxation in the gentle flow of leaves.
BLOW THE STRESS AWAY
Whether you're a laid-back or meticulous player, this game is for everyone. Immerse yourself in a calming atmosphere, as you clean up rooftops, alleys, and open fields. Sit back, relax, and watch the wind sweep your stress away.
DON'T BE-LEAF IT UNTIL YOU TRY IT
While you put off doing your actual yard work, marvel at the intricate details of nature. Watch in awe as thousands of individually simulated leaves blow away with the click of a button.
LEAF IT UP TO YOU
Whether you want to take it slow and gather little groups at a time or create a huge pile to jump into, the world is your canvas. Experience the world your way as you clean up the world one leaf at a time.

title: Galactic Economy
description:
게임 정보
Can you become a leader in the Galactic Economy?

Buy spaceships and spacestations on you way to get some additional income. Roll the dice and see what you can achieve in this board game.

Details:
- Local Multiplayer
- Network-Multiplayer
- Challenge other players
- Start as a regular employee on your way to become a galactic entrepreneur

title: Spirit of Midnight
description:
게임 정보
Spirit of Midnight is a charming adventure game. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

Use and combine items in your inventory to solve situational puzzles in humorous ways. Sit back, interact, and be entertained. Professionally scored with original music and nighttime vibes. Controller play recommended.

Play an introduction to the game before release in *** Spirit of Midnight: Prologue *** today!

title: Amerta
description:
게임 정보
Amerta is a dark, narrative-driven side scrolling games . The game it's all about time. What happened in the past will affect the future. You will be trapped in a recurring time to solve challenging puzzles. Avoid dangerous creatures to avoid death.
Synopsis
When the world is covered by a mist, it creates chaos throughout the world. Besides making living things mutate, the mist affects space and time, making things worse. In the midst of the chaos, you are trapped in time and trying to break free from it.
Meet with Eon
Eon is a tough, brave girl trapped in an apocalyptic situation caused by a mysterious mist that blankets the world. The mist has mutated living creatures and disrupted the fabric of time, creating chaos and danger at every turn. Eon finds herself stuck in a recurring time loop, trying to solve the mysteries of this warped reality and escape from the endless cycle. Though she's caught in this unpredictable world, Eon refuses to be defeated
Features
Challenging Puzzle Related to Time
Sprint, Grab, Jump

title: Wild Area
description:
게임 정보
"Wild Area"는 야생 지역을 탐험하면서 생존과 모험을 즐기는 게임입니다. 낮에는 채집과 사냥을 통해 생산물을 생산하거나, 모험을 떠나 밤에는 좀비를 방어하는 로그라이크 서바이벌 RPG 게임입니다.

1. 낮과 밤이 있습니다.
2. 로그라이크 방식으로 랜덤하게 생성되는 다양한 형태의 맵과 던전을 통한 모험.
3. 물과 음식을 마시고 청결을 유지하여 상태를 관리하십시오.
4. 채집과 사냥을 통해 자원을 모으세요.
5. 자원은 다양한 아이템을 제작하거나 플레이어의 상태를 유지하는 데 사용됩니다.
6. 던전을 탐험하고 보스를 물리치세요.
7. 밤에 찾아오는 좀비들로부터 살아남으세요.

title: #INNER UNIVERSE 1F0000
description:
게임 정보
360°2D Shooter.
This is an STG where you fly 360° around the stage and engage in dogfights.
It requires a good feeling of flying a fighter plane and shooting accuracy.
Always Bullet Time.
You have the superpower to stop time every frame.
Your bullets will always hit and your enemies' bullets will always be avoided.
It should be the easiest shooter.
But it is like getting into a car and resisting the urge to step on the gas pedal.
Machine Customization.
You can tune your fighter between stages.
Is it the turning performance, the boost gauge, the ammunition load, or the reload time for each weapon?
Both the operating technique and machine maintenance in racing games are important, and maintenance is not simply a factor that makes you stronger.

title: V's Rage
description:
게임 정보
“Rise from your bed…”
Those are the words V, an overworked wife and mother, hears as she wakes up in her worst nightmare: she has been cursed and trapped in a videogame by a mysterious entity. Now she must beat any foe unlucky enough to cross her path, and free herself from a crazy low-poly world inhabited by odd creatures. She got a pan, she got rage, and she will beat them all.

title: Farmistic
description:
게임 정보
Farmistic is a top-down farming simulation game in early development by an independent developer.
Manage your farm
In Farmistic you'll be in charge of managing your farm. The fields need to be plowed, cultivated, drilled and harvested. The grain and corn has to be stored or sold, and the cycle repeats. Start small and get your hands dirty driving the tractors yourself. With your first profits, you can buy more and bigger machinery, and start automating the tasks.

Maybe you want to keep your farm small and comfy for a relaxing experience?
Or will you buy up all the land, let others do the work, and become the ultimate agricultural tycoon?
Farming
Fields need plowing, cultivating, drilling, fertilization, harvesting... a never ending duty! The dealership provides a range of small, medium and large tractors and different sizes of machinery for different fields. You'll need:
Tractors
Plows
Cultivators
Seed drills
Combine harvesters
Trailers
Mowers
Rakes
Balers
Animals
Your animals are going to be hungry! Cows will need hay and straw, chickens require grain. Don't forget the water and logistics to get it to your animals! If they are well taken care of, they reward you with milk and eggs, which can be sold for a nice profit.
Immersive mode
Get your hands dirty and drive/operate the machinery yourself in immersive mode. No need for others to do the work if you want the fun all for yourself!

title: First Blood : Persian Legends
description:
게임 정보
JOIN OUR DISCORD


First Blood : Persian Legends is a story-driven real-time-tactic strategy game based on ancient Persia, Sassanid Empire, year 488 CE. Our story is heavily inspired by true events.
Drive different characters from your team to the best of their capabilities and propel the story forward with seemingly impossible stealth missions. Choose different approaches infiltrating a prison, a city or a convoy, set up convenient plans and horrors on the path of your enemies.

The group is composed of different personalities. Over the course of the whole game, the characters in our story cross paths and go through a journey of trust, friendship, loyalty and betrayal.



The story starts with Vahid, The Assassin, working under the spell of Sukhra, a powerful nobleman. Vahid has great stealth mechanics capable of killing a fleet of enemies without any noise. As the rightful heir of the throne, Kavadh, needs rescuing, Vahid goes on a journey to alter the course of history for him and the whole Sassanid empire.

Later we meet Nizar, The General, of the late king. He is a strong character capable of killing multiple foes at once but giving away subtlety of stealth.

Liana, The Concubine, comes along on the second mission where she becomes the driving force of the story. Camouflaging is her main source of power.


Play as three completely different characters with their rich and unique skill sets
Find dozens of ways to infiltrate enemy lines
Execute your objectives with pure stealth mechanics




These three characters, The Assassin, The General and The Concubine are your playable characters to find and survive impossible missions to unlock the history. Can you help saving the Sassanid Empire from within?

title: Yes Comrade
description:
게임 정보
Long Live the Great, Glorious Nation of Belegovska
Yes Comrade is a multiplayer survival sandbox where players have been based at a remote military lighthouse to complete tasks in the name of the country’s sea defence. 
Called in to take over after the previous members of the Lighthouse went crazy and trashed the place, you have been reassigned to man the sea outpost and continue the protection of the State's sea border and secrets.  
You start on a small motor boat in a foggy ocean set for the remote posting. As you arrive at the lighthouse the fog begins to clear and the brutalist architecture of the lighthouse shows. Run down and historic, this building hasn’t seen any repairs for quite some time. 
The lighthouse is a mess, trash piles are scattered everywhere, the furniture tipped over or pushed to one side. It's time to start the clean up process.
Ships need to be looked out for from the top of the lighthouse. Around the top of the ceiling is a compass for directing the communication radio. Depending on the type of ship different frequencies of radio need to be used to communicate with the ship. All messages sent to the ships are pre-recorded. Messages sent back are translated on screen. A manual of the ship's flags and styles can be found next to the communication desk. Some ships will be friendly and you can decide if you want to let them through. You have to check some elements of the ship (flag the correct way) and accept or turn them away as necessary.
The polaroid camera is used to capture anomalies seen while working the lighthouse. Images should be developed in the dark room of the basement (red room), then scanned at the computer and sent to Party Headquarters.

title: Hyper Drill
description:
게임 정보
Hyper Drill은 초고속으로 날아가는 스피드런 러닝 게임입니다. 장애물을 드릴로 뚫고, 타이밍을 잘 맞추고, 레벨 배치에 대해 알아가고, 서로 다른 은하계를 뛰어넘으세요.

title: Plague Alchemist
description:
게임 정보
Plague Alchemist
You are plunged into a mundane world that is on the brink of being reshaped. As an outcast doctor, you will be forced to put down your bandages and pick up weapons. There is something happening that you can fix, but not alone.
Corruption
Something is reshaping the world and affecting its inhabitants. This has happened before, a long, long time ago. The corruption is leaving cracks in the earth and seeping through.
How was it stopped before?
Where does this come from, and can it be stopped again before it consumes everything?
Maybe...
Alchemy
Alchemy, the cornerstone of this adventure, is where you can truly shine. Discoveries need to be made, resources understood, and the process refined. Hunting for the most powerful ingredients will be pointless if they are used incorrectly.
Blow something up? Of course.
Make trees come alive? Quite possibly.
Shape time and reality by smashing a bottle? ...
A lion’s share of time and dedication has been poured into making the collection of mixtures, potions, and salves feel worth your time and effort to find, craft, and use.
The ultimate goal of this game is achieved when you experience a sense of accomplishment every time you discover a new recipe.
Dungeons
At the heart of this mystery lies something very close to you. The keys to all of this are found in dungeons. The dungeon experience is designed to be difficult for the unprepared.
Claw your way through resource-rich and danger-filled caverns, forests, and mind-bending corrupted worlds, only to face a powerful foe at the end.
Once entered, there are only four ways out: pass out from exhaustion, leaving everything behind; run home and forfeit all you have accomplished and acquired; die in battle; or succeed and claim the spoils. Or is there another way?

title: Wandering Wolf
description:
게임 정보
S T R I B O G is a first person shooter with a strong focus on immersion and survival.
You will take part in unpredictable events and stories created by the game itself.
You will meet only that which exists within the framework of the game universe and its laws.
The main story follows the split in society during the Civil War in the Hard Fantasy setting.

- First person shooter

- Thoughtful levels, with Metroidvania elements

- The atmosphere of the civil war and hopelessness

- Immersion, alternative reality effect

- Workshop Support

title: Remorses
description:
게임 정보
STORY

Remorses is a slowly building, heart-aching journey, with tension that builds gradually, focused on an immersive atmospheric experience.

The year is 1991 in Rivervalley, Lakota Territory. It is infamous for its history and missing people recently. Not long ago, rumors of witchcraft began to spread. Rivervalley has long history of false legends before.

Play as Jake Lepistow, an investigator from Beaver Hills, Minnesota. Chasing legends and supernatural occurrences without ever having to face consequences. When a series of strange disappearances and hints of witchcraft reached him, he got his eyes on his next investigation. A made up story of an abandoned Westbrook’s Inheritance Mansion somewhere in the Rivervalley forest. The townspeople avoid it, terrified of its reputation and the rumors of a vengeful witch.
GAMEPLAY
 The most normal thing, the air that you breathe, becomes your lifeline, open windows to get fresh air, ignoring this normal aspect has serious consequences when a disturbing force messes with your mind. Manage your resources, and use every source of light to your advantage. Search for ingredients to create a potion against the possible lurking evil. With challenging visual, auditory, and logical puzzles, you must investigate the unknown and find your way to freedom, if there is one...

title: DoBad Inc
description:
게임 정보
In this open world, stealth game you play as Garett the Ferret the newest badguyer around, work your way up the corporate ladder to become one of the worst people to ever live, but acquiring this won't be easy, sneak through warehouses, murder Dogooders, steal from civilians, shoplift and more, all just for the sake of your psychotic individuality.
Features:
Traverse the city and interact with civilians
Take jobs from your bosses and commit them out in the world
Use your DoBad Promotional Credits to climb higher on this hellish corporate ladder

title: The Detective
description:
게임 정보
In the house of one of the members of the London financiers, a family celebration is approaching - Christmas, traditionally celebrated with great splendour. On this occasion, his daughter with her husband, cousins and friends appear at the estate. Unfortunately, where there are young people and huge money, there are plenty of emotions and feelings. Hazel Luanton, a longtime family friend, has died under mysterious circumstances. Why? What was the killer's motive? And finally, who did it? Will anyone else die?

Become a detective, immerse yourself in the world of secrets and solve the mystery.

Ask the residents of the house questions - every detail can be substantial! Sometimes people lie, remember that - in your notebook, you can mark whether you think the information provided is true. Further developments will depend on this.

While collecting information from the residents, you will come across traces leading to specific places - search them to find more facts and items. They can provide important clues. Sometimes it is enough to examine an object to obtain further information. Sometimes, however, you'll have to use an item on another to get to its secret. Remember that the detective follows even the strangest tips.

In addition to the secrets of the household and traces and objects hidden in various places, you will encounter some unexpected logical puzzles - the murder mystery is not the only one in this house.

Recall (or discover) how games used to be played - using the joystick (in its modern version, gamepad) or keyboard. There are dozens of lines of text to read like in old times. It is not enough to click on every suspicious element of the screen. Even more - you can put the mouse aside!

title: Legend of Hidden Flows
description:
게임 정보
《Legend of Hidden Flows》It is a sandbox Immortal cultivation game that combines strategy card construction, open world ,and role-playing.

In this game, there is a completely open world, and every restart is a brand new map. Since you were born, you have to start simulating a new life.

You will grow from an unknown person. On the way to growth, you will encounter many strange people, and you can socialize with them or fight decisively.

You can collect the world's spiritual herbs and refine miraculous elixirs and divine medicines; You can also collect legendary minerals, cast epic equipment, and become a legend.

There are many forces in this world, and various conflicts often arise between them. You can join them to serve the faction, or you can be arrogant without any sect.

You can experience a different life in this world.

Feel the rush of adrenaline as you zip through busy roads and race against the clock to make those urgent deliveries.



Take charge of your kitchen, expertly blending mouthwatering smoothies with speed and finesse; then lob them to thirsty customers at breakneck speeds from your sunroof!

Explore

title: OffiAtrix: Rise of the Team Leader
description:
게임 정보


안녕하세요,

그렇다면, 이 게임은 무엇에 관한 걸까요?

✄---

AI의 부상으로 위기가 닥쳤습니다. Offiatrix Corp.는 한때 찬란했던 기업으로, 이사회가 소집되었습니다. 안건은 인원 감축과 예산 삭감입니다.

그들은 누가 해고되고 누가 아무도 읽지 않는 매력적인 프레젠테이션을 계속 작업할지 빠르게 결정했습니다.

모든 것이 계획대로 진행되고 있었습니다… 상사들이 신성한 것을 건드리기 전까지는——커피 예산을 0으로 만들었습니다.

그리고 직원들은 깨달았습니다: 이것은 전쟁이다! 진짜 기업 육탄전!

IT 팀에서는 팀 빌딩이 마지막 설탕 한 봉지를 차지하기 위한 싸움으로 변했습니다.
마케팅 팀은 플립차트로 방패를 만들고 있습니다.
회계 팀은 촛불 위에서 커피를 끓이고 있습니다.

🔑

1. : 뛰어난 커피 제조 기술과 숨겨진 불만을 가진 사무실 전사를 모집하세요. 그들을 현명하게 관리하며, 모두가 "긴급 회의, 내 사무실로!"라고 말하기도 전에 커피를 마신다는 것을 잊지 마세요.

2. : 마케터와 회계사가 누가 더 뛰어난지 알아보세요. 싸움은 창가 자리를 놓고만 벌어지지 않습니다! 승자는 가장 강한 사람이 아니라 금요일 오후 5시 59분에 "보고서 전송"을 누른 사람입니다.

3. : 열심히 번 돈을 사용하여 본사를 업그레이드하세요——물을 낼 때 윙윙거리는 쿨러 하나에서, "생일 축하합니다"를 화음으로 부를 수 있는 두세 대의 쿨러로. 훈련된 전사는 항상 상자 속 마지막 쿠키를 먼저 집어갑니다.

4. : 사무실 생활의 세계로 뛰어들어 다른 플레이어의 팀과 만나고… 그들을 파괴하세요. 누군가가 또 다시 키보드 위에서 쥐가 샌드위치 절반을 훔쳐가는 것을 눈치채지 못한 이야기를 공유하세요. 매일 새로운 드라마가 펼쳐집니다. 기업 악몽의 경계에서 삶의 진정한 마법을 발견하세요.

🎮 : 혼돈을 받아들이고, 무적의 리더가 되어 사무실 계급 체계에서 당신이 전쟁의 신임을 모든 사람에게 보여주세요! 👑



✄---

읽어주셔서 감사합니다,
Andrew, 의 공동 소유자

title: Scrapchasers
description:

title: Arc Tracker
description:
게임 정보
Arc Tracker
Arc Tracker는 주인공 "A.T."를 원궤도를 따라 움직여 다양한 장애물들을 피하고, 코인을 획득하고, 목표지점에 도달하는 게임입니다.
최소한의 오브젝트와 UI를 적용한 미니멀한 그래픽, 편안한 사운드로 몰입감 있는 플레이 경험을 제공합니다.
다양한 구조의 레벨이 제공되며, 업데이트를 통해 지속적으로 추가할 예정입니다.
주요 목표
Arc Tracker의 주요 목표는 최소한의 조작으로 레벨을 완료하는 것입니다.
따라서 각 레벨마다 퍼펙트 클리어를 위한 기준 조작횟수가 부여되어 있으며, 해당 기준 이하의 조작횟수로 레벨을 완료하면 퍼펙트 클리어 판정을 받습니다.
퍼펙트 클리어 판정을 받지 못하더라도 레벨을 완료하기만 하면 다음 레벨로 진행 가능합니다. 이전 레벨로 언제든 되돌아와 퍼펙트 클리어를 위한 재도전을 할 수 있습니다.
A.T.의 움직임
A.T.는 윈궤도라는 단 하나의 규칙만을 따라 움직입니다. 조이스틱이나 방향키는 사용되지 않습니다.
궤도의 중심과 이동 방향을 지정해주면, A.T.는 정해진 원궤도를 따라 자동으로 이동합니다.
레벨의 난이도에 따라 궤도와 이동방향을 바꿔가며 조금 더 복잡한 플레이를 할 수도 있습니다.
조작법
궤도 중심은 마우스로 지정합니다. 클릭 또는 드래그로 궤도중심의 위치를 조절할 수 있습니다.
경우에 따라 궤도 중심의 위치를 더 정밀하게 조절해야 할 필요가 있습니다. 이를 위해 마우스 포인터 주변을 확대하여 보여주는 돋보기 옵션이 기본적으로 활성화되어 있습니다. 메뉴 화면으로 이동하여 이 옵션을 해제하거나 재설정할 수 있습니다.
이동 방향은 화면에 표시되는 UI버튼을 직접 클릭하거나 키보드의 A/D키를 사용하여 지정합니다.
플레이 모드
Arc Tracker는 BASIC, AUTO, DYNAMIC이라는 세 가지 플레이 모드를 제공합니다.
BASIC: 조작 난이도가 쉬운 모드입니다. 원궤도를 따라 움직이던 A.T.는 다음 궤도와 방향을 지정하는 동안에는 정지한 채 다음 움직임을 기다립니다. 게임을 처음 실행할 때에는 이 모드로 자동 지정되어 있습니다.
AUTO: BASIC모드와 동일한 레벨을 공유하고 조작방식이 유사하나, 유일한 차이점은 한 번 움직이기 시작한 A.T.는 장애물에 부딪히거나 목표지점에 도달하기 전까지 절대 정지하지 않는다는 것입니다. 다음 궤도를 지정하는 동안에도 A.T.는 계속 움직이며, 따라서 레벨을 풀어내는 과정에서 궤도를 옮겨 타는 타이밍을 함께 고려해야 하므로 BASIC모드에 비해 조작 난이도가 높습니다.
DYNAMIC: BASIC 및 AUTO모드와는 조작방식이 근본적으로 다릅니다. 드래그 동작으로 궤도중심을 실시간으로 변경할 수 있으며, A.T.는 계속해서 바뀌는 궤도를 따라가므로 원형이 아닌 다른 궤적을 그릴 수 있습니다. BASIC 및 AUTO 모드와는 별개의 레벨이 제공되고, 조작 난이도가 가장 높습니다.
Arc Tracker는 미니멀한 분위기 속에서 게임의 로직 그 자체에 집중하는 것을 추구합니다. 원궤도라는 단 하나의 규칙을 기반으로 하는 다양한 플레이 모드와 레벨들은 때로는 머리를 쓰는 퍼즐로, 때로는 고난도의 컨트롤 실력이 필요한 도전과제로, 때로는 심심풀이 땅콩이나 멋진 눈요기로 다가올 것입니다.

A.T.의 독특한 조작법은 적응하기는 쉽지만, 마스터하기는 어렵습니다. 올 퍼펙트 클리어에 도전해보는 건 어떨까요?

title: Wesley Smith's Repair Game

게임 정보
Welcome to Wesley Smith's Repair Game! Join self-declared blacksmith Wesley on his journey of collecting items and crafting weapons to show off his blacksmith skills. But if you already happen to have the weapons, you can use them for other things too, like getting rid of your annoying friends!

title: The Continuum

Welcome to The Continuum, a unique stealth-action platformer set in the heart of a high-stakes interstellar conflict. Engage in strategic resource management and platforming challenges as you navigate an ever-changing cosmos to rescue allies and disrupt the formidable Hivemind.
Stealth-action platformer
Make your way through challenging environments utilizing a mix of stealth, combat, and platforming elements. Balance your approach between remaining undetected and engaging with the Hivemind forces only when necessary.
In-depth Resource Management
Manage your resources wisely. Every decision you make, every ally you save, every encounter you engage in, has an impact on your journey. Space and resources are finite, making every choice critical to your mission's success.

Face the Hivemind, an enemy collective with a unified goal that adapt based on your actions. Learn to understand their behavior, manipulate their perceptions, and use the environment to your advantage.

Form alliances with the Abeds, an alien species struggling for survival against the invasion of the almighty Hivemind. Learn their backstories, complete quests, and earn their trust to gain valuable resources and aid in your mission.
High-Tech Gadgets and Alien Abilities
Utilize a variety of high-tech gadgets and harness the unique abilities of your alien allies to gain an edge over the Hivemind. Upgrade your tools and powers to face increasingly formidable challenges.
Strategic Long-Term Planning
Map out your actions based on your understanding of the Hivemind and the broader conflict. Choose when to intervene, when to retreat, and when to make the final strike against the Hivemind's structures or queen.


With its blend of challenging stealth-action platforming, strategic decision-making, and engaging storytelling, The Continuum offers an immersive journey through a universe teetering on the brink of devastation. Can you outsmart the Hivemind and tip the balance of power in your favor?

title: Followers of Krow
description:
게임 정보
The Krow
A strange phenomenon spreads throughout the kingdom. Adventurers and sellswords, suddenly and seemingly at random, as if possessed, start to call themselves "Krow". They immediately venture out to seek danger without any quest or reward. They certainly don't seem to be in control of their own actions, and soon they dissappear as if into thin air never to return.

Select your Krows
You must choose your Krow, they all have different abilities and capabilities, some are strong, some are weak, some have great affinity to magic, others none, perhaps you must make do with weaklings?
Level Up
Teach them abilities as you level them up, equipment and relics can be found by exploring the world, or why not just loot them from the orcs, goblins, trolls and various other monsters you encounter around the world.
To Battle!
Each item you equip automatically acts during combat to provide their benefits. They may be passive or cooldown based. Items may interact with each other in various ways. Your sword may deal 10 damage every 2 seconds, and your shield may block 10 damage every 3 seconds, maybe you find a relic that increases all block values by 5 every time you attack?
Not only swords and shields, it's magic!
The game features numerous weapons and tools to use to defeat your enemies. Whether you wish your Krow to be a sword master, sorcerer, magic swordman... perhaps Followers of Krow will not dissapoint...

title: Death the Guitar
description:
게임 정보
Use "sound" and "electricity" to destroy humans! "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The main character is an electric guitar whose owner was murdered. Shake the amp to jump, electrify the floor to activate gimmicks, and destroy all enemies in the room. Experience intuitive controls, hardcore action, and rich guitar sounds!
company: トロヤマイバッテリーズフライド

title: Teratale: Tide of Wishes
description:
게임 정보
This game is a top-down pixel art game. You will travel with your mysterious partner Tupa, fight powerful monsters, discover treasures and secrets scattered around the world, and uncover the truth of the world, Tupa and yourself with the help of the tide of wishes.



Travel in a rich and mysterious world and experience a non-linear exploration process based on ability locks.
Search for powerful weapons, each weapon not only has a special combat method, but also contains unique exploration abilities.
Use the power of the tide to fulfill wishes, and thus change the world in a limited way to discover more possibilities. What will happen if different wishes are fulfilled at the same time?
A twisted and interesting story, the true ending awaits those who are determined to reveal it.
Enjoy specialty cuisine all over the world. Have you heard that there are little-known legendary delicacies?

title: Discarded Memories: Mysteries of the Past
description:
게임 정보
In 1995, Andrew Connor's fiance was hit and killed by a car after she frantically ran out into the road from the nearby forest. It was clear that she had been spooked by something, but no one could figure out what. Since no evidence of foul play was found, the case was eventually marked as solved and archived by the police. Andrew was not happy with this though. His home town was full of mysteries, and now he found himself right in the middle of one of them. He knew that there had to be more to the story, so he began to search for answers on his own. However, he might just get more than he bargained for with this investigation.

Collect Evidence
Things like police case files are rarely served on a silver platter to however asks for them. It will be up to you to get the evidence you need to solve this mystery, and that includes doing things that aren't necessarily legal. Lock picking and trespassing are just some of the things you will end up doing on your quest for answers.

Investigate
Existing evidence can only get you so far. In some cases, you will need to go out and find new clues to help make sense of older ones. Once you have collected enough clues, you can use your trusty cork board to link everything together.

Don't Get Caught
Throughout your investigation, you will encounter people who won't be too happy with you poking around where you shouldn't be. You will have to exercise caution to ensure that you don't end up in jail, or worse. Stealth won't always be required, but you should be ready for when it is. There will be times where you will have to balance completing your current task, and creating as little noise as possible.

Solve the Mystery
You are on your own when it comes to solving this mystery, if there even is a mystery to solve. Is it all in your head, or is there something that everyone else missed?
autokwd: Discarded Memories: Mysteries of the Past

title: Zompell
description:
게임 정보
***We are looking for a Publisher for this game, Let us know***

Welcome to the post-apocalyptic world of "Zompell Survival Zombie," a heart-pounding first-person shooter experience now available on Steam. In this adrenaline-fueled game, players find themselves amidst a relentless onslaught of zombies, tasked with defending against waves of the undead using a vast array of weapons at their disposal. From pistols and shotguns to assault rifles and explosives, each weapon offers a unique advantage in the fight for survival.

But the excitement doesn't stop there. As players dispatch zombies, they accumulate experience points (XP) which can be used to unlock and harness powerful magic spells. These spells, ranging from protective barriers to devastating elemental attacks, provide an extra layer of strategy and defense against the ever-encroaching hordes.

With four distinct maps to choose from, each presenting its own challenges and opportunities, players can test their skills in diverse environments. Whether it's navigating through abandoned city streets, fighting for survival in a desolate wilderness, or holding out against the undead onslaught in a fortified compound, there's no shortage of thrilling scenarios to explore.

Competitive players will find added motivation in the game's leaderboard system, which records the highest scores and ranks players based on their performance. Will you rise to the top and claim the title of ultimate survivor?

Furthermore, "Zompell Survival Zombie" is committed to delivering ongoing excitement and fresh content. Regular updates will introduce new maps, weapons, and gameplay features, ensuring that players always have something new to discover and master.

And that's not all—should the game garner sufficient interest and support, plans are in place to introduce multiplayer functionality, allowing players to join forces with friends or compete against each other in intense zombie-slaying action.

With its intense gameplay, diverse features, and commitment to ongoing updates, "Zompell Survival Zombie" offers an immersive and endlessly thrilling experience for fans of the survival zombie genre. Are you prepared to face the apocalypse head-on?

title: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons
description:
게임 정보
위도 76: 온킬론의 땅 는 1900-1902년의 실제 북극 탐험 이야기에 영감을 받은 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 이 게임은 북극 해양에 숨겨진 환상의 섬 전설을 증명하려는 용감한 탐험자들의 이야기를 들려줍니다.


그랩핑 훅을 사용하고, 집라인을 타고, 절벽을 오르며, 북극 해양의 얼어붙은 광야에 숨겨진 환상의 섬을 탐험하고 그 비밀을 밝혀내세요.



이 땅은 보기보다 간단하지 않습니다. 예상치 못한 도전들이 곳곳에 숨어 있습니다.



귀여운 원숭이로 전환하여 퍼즐을 풀고, 숨겨진 경로를 탐색하며, 털복숭이 친구를 꾸밀 수 있는 스타일리시한 모자를 모으세요.



1900년의 신비로운 실제 탐험에서 영감을 받은 이야기 속으로 빠져보세요. 몰입감 있는 컷신, 예상치 못한 반전, 잊을 수 없는 캐릭터들과 함께 비밀을 풀어보세요.


북극 탐험가 바론 마그누스는 존재한다고 믿는 사람이 없는 땅을 찾기 위해 탐험대를 결성합니다. 탐험가들은 맘모스, 코뿔소, 그리고 신화 속 생물들이 사는 세계를 발견하면서 예상보다 더 많은 것을 알게 됩니다.
그 신비로운 땅은 탐험자들을 환영하지만, 그 앞에는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다. 그들의 모든 움직임을 추적하는 사냥꾼들과 그림자 속에 숨어 있는 다른 무서운 괴물들이 있습니다...

게임은 2025년에 출시 예정 – !
최신 정보, 토론, 그리고 더 많은 내용을 위해 커뮤니티에 참여하세요!
autokwd: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons,위도 76: 온킬론의 땅

title: No Stone Unturned
description:
게임 정보
It was a dark and stormy morning when the soon-to-be Greatest Detective in the World, Detective Cox, stumbled upon the body of a chicken. (The body was dead, it was a dead body, the chicken was dead and this was his body, found by the Detective who is neither dead or a chicken.) This grisly discovery leaves him with just one question…
What was he running from? Who, or what, stopped him? And did the chicken really come before the egg? Okay, maybe there's more than one question. But Cox needs answers like a walrus needs a vacation (a lot) - He needs your help (even though he’s incredibly smart, a truly world-class detective and could probably manage without your help, okay?!)
Solve A Murder Most... Fowl and 5 more Side Cases!
Learn why The Hare and the Tortoise are at each other throats, what's got the Cat's tongue, and hoo tried to silence the watchful giant owl...? (Ya know... Hoo. Like an owl)

title: Vaulted
description:
게임 정보
Vaulted is a roguelite game that combines elements of top-down shooter, RPG and immersive sim. Venture into randomly generated dungeons in search of resources and powerful equipment to ensure your settlement survives. Kill enemies stealthily, go right through, or look for workarounds with the dozens of skill cards you'll find along the way.
Choose your way of progression: use the environment, pit enemies against each other, hide in the shadows, or charge head-on.
Each run is unique: explore randomly generated dungeons where the inhabitants do not forgive mistakes. Gather resources, items, and weapons to advance deeper.
Develop your own playstyle: decide for yourself how to most effectively eliminate enemies. Experiment by combining power cards and different types of weapons to create the most powerful builds.
Upgrade your gear: spend resources at the base and trade with characters to take on new challenges!

title: Anime Slayer
description:
게임 정보
Anime Slayer is an engaging and immersive first-person shooter (FPS) game that offers an abundance of adversaries, captivating puzzles, thrilling boss battles, and a touch of humor.

As you awaken, you find yourself transported into a partially abandoned dwelling, a place that seems ethereal and detached from reality. The flickering shadows and lingering echoes create an atmosphere of eerie enchantment, casting doubt upon the authenticity of your surroundings. Every creaking floorboard and whispering gust of wind amplifies the surreal nature of this inexplicable journey. It's as if you have entered a realm where the boundaries of existence are blurred, leaving you questioning the very fabric of reality itself.
Immersed in this enigmatic realm, you are entrusted with unraveling the enigma of this place, embarking on an extraordinary quest that demands both exploration of the surrounding territories and the triumph over adversaries encountered along your path. As you navigate through the mysterious landscapes, unearthing hidden secrets, your journey becomes a captivating tapestry of adventure. Armed with resilience and cunning, you must vanquish the foes that cross your path, for within their defeat lies the key to unlocking the ultimate truth of this ethereal domain.

title: Dice Captain
description:
게임 정보

Avast ye! Set sail on a thrilling adventure with Dice Captain, a roguelike game that will give you endless excitement on the high seas. In this maritime journey, you'll chart your course through ever-changing waters, build a crew of unique sailors, and master the art of strategy with a combination of talismans, artifacts, and one-time-use cards, all to become the most powerful and respected pirate Captain.


Your ship's success relies on the diverse talents of your crew. Choose your sailors wisely, each equipped with a unique, upgradeable dice. Shape your ship's destiny with sharpshooters that never miss or experienced carpenters capable of strengthening your ship.


Find your winning strategy by experimenting with various combinations of talismans and artifacts. These mystical items possess unique features, enabling you to adapt your tactics to any situation. Mix and match talismans to create a build that suits your playstyle.


In the heat of battle, one-time-use cards become your secret weapon. These cards grant you the powers of both sailors and talismans, offering an extra layer of strategy to every encounter. Use them wisely to turn the tide of battle, unlock hidden pathways, or overcome challenging obstacles.


Each playthrough reveals new, unexplored places, challenging your skills and luck in dangerous turn-based battles, mysterious islands and stormy seas.


Sometimes decisions have consequences, and the outcome can be unpredictable. Find the most effective way to obtain all the treasures without attracting powerful enemies in your adventures!


Use your hard-earned global currency to make your journey easier. Invest in additional crew members, secure places for powerful talismans, and reinforce your ship's durability, all to shape your destiny.


Dice Captain is a dice-powered roguelike adventure that will test your adaptability, tactical skills, and decision-making ability in unpredictable situations. Are you ready to become the greatest pirate captain of all time and sail into the unknown? Start your journey today in the world of Dice Captain!

title: Remorses
description:
게임 정보
STORY

Remorses is a slowly building, heart-aching journey, with tension that builds gradually, focused on an immersive atmospheric experience.

The year is 1991 in Rivervalley, Lakota Territory. It is infamous for its history and missing people recently. Not long ago, rumors of witchcraft began to spread. Rivervalley has long history of false legends before.

Play as Jake Lepistow, an investigator from Beaver Hills, Minnesota. Chasing legends and supernatural occurrences without ever having to face consequences. When a series of strange disappearances and hints of witchcraft reached him, he got his eyes on his next investigation. A made up story of an abandoned Westbrook’s Inheritance Mansion somewhere in the Rivervalley forest. The townspeople avoid it, terrified of its reputation and the rumors of a vengeful witch.
GAMEPLAY
 The most normal thing, the air that you breathe, becomes your lifeline, open windows to get fresh air, ignoring this normal aspect has serious consequences when a disturbing force messes with your mind. Manage your resources, and use every source of light to your advantage. Search for ingredients to create a potion against the possible lurking evil. With challenging visual, auditory, and logical puzzles, you must investigate the unknown and find your way to freedom, if there is one...

title: SOLIVAGANT
description:
게임 정보
A found-footage psychological horror experience.
FEATURES
Pure horror of liminal spaces
Camcorder -aesthetic
Interactable environments

title: Pegdrop Hearts
description:
게임 정보
Meet Vivi and Dant. Join them on a heartwarming and empowering adventure in a Peggle-inspired game that offers exciting gameplay and a compelling story.



Exclusive original Lofi soundtrack: Enjoy a relaxing and immersive experience with the game's exclusive soundtrack.
Test your skills with more than 50 levels of increasing difficulty and challenge.
Beautiful hand-drawn graphics: Immerse yourself in a charming and whimsical world with the game's stunning hand-drawn graphics.
Captivating love story: Follow a heartwarming and engaging story that will make you think and feel.
Steam achievements: Unlock achievements and show off your skills to your friends on Steam.

title: Panchin is Frustrated
description:
게임 정보
This is an Idle game, meant for playing in the background while doing other things. For the optimal experience, put the game on a second monitor while you work or browse. Made for PIGSquad Idle Jam 2023, this new version adds many new dreams and activities for Panchin.

You are the all-seeing observer of a pair of roommates, Panchin and Julem. Panchin is an artist struggling with creative block, and thus spends most of their time pacing around the room, or staying distracted.

Click to collect Panchin's Tears of Frustration. The amount of Tears collected during the day affects Panchin's dreams at night.

Connect with Twitch to suggest things for Panchin to do during the day.

Featuring:
15+ Explorable Dreams
Full original synth soundtrack
A cast of quirky, clay-like characters
A hostile goblin

title: Onslaught: Rift
description:
게임 정보
Onslaught: Rift is an arcade hack and slash where you rapidly switch between three heroes to decimate waves of enemies! Learn to master each hero's set of abilities as you actively switch between them to efficiently destroy your foes.
Venture through a variety of dangerous areas, each with unique monsters and bosses to vanquish!
As your skill increases, accrue more medals by conquering harder difficulties and achieving higher scores!
Fight solo or take up arms with up to three other friends in local co-op!

title: Fruit 66
description:
게임 정보

Brace yourself for an epic challenge as you juggle the art of cooking, the thrill of reckless driving, and the pressure of timely deliveries through bite-sized levels that are sure to get your adrenaline pumping! Jump behind the wheel, fire up the blender, and let the chaos begin!



Feel the rush of adrenaline as you zip through busy roads and race against the clock to make those urgent deliveries.



Take charge of your kitchen, expertly blending mouthwatering smoothies with speed and finesse; then lob them to thirsty customers at breakneck speeds from your sunroof!



Journey along scenic highway Fruit 66, chasing down wacky customers, wackier obstacles, and the ever-elusive five-star rating!

title: SORROW: TALES FROM A WORSE WORLD
description:
게임 정보
SORROW is a third person survival game set 2 weeks after the outbreak of a brutal parasitic entity. It follows the perspective of a survivor who has survived the initial chaos, and now has to survive the harsh reality of a American continent after humanity's dominance has been tipped.
Your main objective is to survive by any means possible, including murder. The creatures that you once called a human didn't lose their intelligence, and will be able to flank you, dodge your attacks, and even vault over obstacles you do. However, it is best to remember one thing, nothing lasts forever. Your randomized character will inevitably meet their end.
Features:
multiple towns in different parts of the USA (New Mexico, Texas, Colorado, etc)
randomized interiors for each house/building. no two are the same!
A choice between stealth or action at the start of every playthrough.
Basic survival mechanics alongside a infection meter that fills up when being attacked, don't let it get too high or you'll turn.
Completely randomized characters, you could have a man who was keen on melee one playthrough while another could be better at stealth.
A radio system that chronicles the downfall of civilization
House securing system, barricade windows and block doors to delay the attacks of the creatures. (only on houses in rural areas)
Multiplayer included (peer-2-peer)!
best of all? it's completely FREE!
story mode is planned however won't come until after full release.
autokwd: SORROW: TALES FROM A WORSE WORLD

title: A Simple Expurriment
description:
게임 정보
- PUBLIC INFO -
Finding herself in space by hitching a ride with the alien who kidnapped her three kittens, a cat mom will have to use all of her feline traits in order to find them as she evades the security systems that keep looking for her.
Fortunately - or not - they're all part of an experiment that aims to understand cats' impressive influence over humans, run by the greedy Toilet Analyst of an even greedier extraterrestrial corporation in his attempt to climb the corporate ladder.
A Simple Expurriment is a combatless metroidvania where stealth is key - no big deal for a cat, specially the three kittens that were genetically upgraded to jump higher, become undetectable and so on. But that's not enough when all the security systems are after the elusive cat mom: that's why she also gets the ability to manipulate sections of the building like pieces of a sliding puzzle, allowing her to move through the depths of the Research Area, the perils of the Maintenance Area, the exclusive VIP Area and the scariest place in the galaxy - the corporate cafeteria.

- CLASSIFIED INFO (NOT FOR TERRAN EYES) -
These things are weird.
They make strange noises. They sleep a lot. They like to defy gravity.
Most importantly, they seem able to make humans do whatever they want.

title: Mech Realm
description:
게임 정보
Mech Realm - a dystopia in which humans have taken a back seat, and the world is ruled by robots and a chosen group of their creators. Progress has reached a point where humans are no longer needed, as robots have replaced almost all professions. You must decide the fate of the world and choose whether to serve the robots or resist.

Main features:

A unique gaming world with various locations and characters



Freedom of choice and exploration of the world of mechs

title: Slimewest
description:
게임 정보
The Wild West has been invaded by powerful slimes, and it's up to you to defend it. In "Slimewest", you step into the boots of one of six brave heroes, each with unique abilities to combat these sticky foes.
🌵 Defend the Wild West! Slimes are everywhere, and it's your job to stop them.
🌵 Six Heroes, Six Styles! Choose from six courageous defenders, each armed and gifted with a unique special ability.
🌵 Evolve and Strengthen! With every wave defeated, every coin collected, your character grows stronger. Enhance your abilities and attributes in the game's store.
🌵 Diverse Territories! Face off against different types of slimes across various challenging maps.
🌵 Ascend to New Heights of Power! The further you progress, the stronger you become, readying yourself to tackle even tougher adversaries.
Do you have what it takes to save the Wild West and become the legend of "Slimewest"?

title: BrickLike
description:
게임 정보
A refreshing twist on an old classic, mixing arcade gameplay with the roguelike genre.
Test your skill, break bricks, make combos, turns balls aflame and electrify bosses in this frenetic experience!

Features
- Procedurally generated maps
- Many ball modifiers with over 15 different combinations
- Unique Bosses
- A wide range of Upgrades with many synergies

title: JumpCat
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in limbo. Toyed with for eternity. Escape, or lose your last chance at life.
In JumpCat, you find yourself imprisoned in a haunting limbo ruled by Sadie—a sinister girl with a twisted love for games. She’s trapped you in her dark playground, alongside the eerie residents she’s crafted to entertain her forever. Your only hope? Climb, jump, and outsmart her to reclaim your life. Fail, and you’ll remain her plaything for eternity.
Explore Sadie’s unsettling world, where every shadow holds a secret and every leap brings you closer—or pulls you deeper into despair. Meet her peculiar creations, unravel the truth behind their tragic existence, and search for hidden collectibles that might just hold the key to your freedom.

Key Features
Escape Sadie’s Eternal Trap: Outsmart a sinister child determined to keep you in her nightmarish limbo forever.
Unravel Dark Secrets: Meet haunting residents, uncover their origins, and piece together the story of Sadie’s twisted world.
Climb for Your Life: Navigate challenging vertical levels filled with traps, puzzles, and eerie surprises.
Discover and Collect: Search for hidden artifacts that reveal more about the world—and strengthen your chances of escape.
Solo or (lan) Multiplayer Escape: Face the terror alone, or team up with friends in a frantic race to freedom.
Reclaim your life before it’s too late! Play JumpCat—and jump for your salvation.

title: Devil Apartment
description:
게임 정보


By the will of fate, Jake finds himself in an abandoned building, from which there is no way out, and becomes a participant in a deadly game. But he's not alone here. Teaming up with another player, he will have to complete tasks and move forward.

Why are they here? Who is behind all this? And will they be able to get out of here alive?



Devil Apartment is a mystery visual novel with a dark atmosphere. An emotional story about cruelty, hatred and remorse, showing what people are capable of under the pressure of circumstances. Read and make choices that affect the fate of the characters. See the world through their eyes. And remember: there are few choices, but each of them matters.


A tragic story with multiple endings
Around 3-4 hours of reading
Painful ordeals
Spiders and needles

title: Legend of Hidden Flows
description:
게임 정보
《Legend of Hidden Flows》It is a sandbox Immortal cultivation game that combines strategy card construction, open world ,and role-playing.

In this game, there is a completely open world, and every restart is a brand new map. Since you were born, you have to start simulating a new life.

You will grow from an unknown person. On the way to growth, you will encounter many strange people, and you can socialize with them or fight decisively.

You can collect the world's spiritual herbs and refine miraculous elixirs and divine medicines; You can also collect legendary minerals, cast epic equipment, and become a legend.

There are many forces in this world, and various conflicts often arise between them. You can join them to serve the faction, or you can be arrogant without any sect.

You can experience a different life in this world.
autokwd: Legend of Hidden Flows,隐流传说
