title: The Detective
description:
게임 정보
In the house of one of the members of the London financiers, a family celebration is approaching - Christmas, traditionally celebrated with great splendour. On this occasion, his daughter with her husband, cousins and friends appear at the estate. Unfortunately, where there are young people and huge money, there are plenty of emotions and feelings. Hazel Luanton, a longtime family friend, has died under mysterious circumstances. Why? What was the killer's motive? And finally, who did it? Will anyone else die?

Become a detective, immerse yourself in the world of secrets and solve the mystery.

Ask the residents of the house questions - every detail can be substantial! Sometimes people lie, remember that - in your notebook, you can mark whether you think the information provided is true. Further developments will depend on this.

While collecting information from the residents, you will come across traces leading to specific places - search them to find more facts and items. They can provide important clues. Sometimes it is enough to examine an object to obtain further information. Sometimes, however, you'll have to use an item on another to get to its secret. Remember that the detective follows even the strangest tips.

In addition to the secrets of the household and traces and objects hidden in various places, you will encounter some unexpected logical puzzles - the murder mystery is not the only one in this house.

Recall (or discover) how games used to be played - using the joystick (in its modern version, gamepad) or keyboard. There are dozens of lines of text to read like in old times. It is not enough to click on every suspicious element of the screen. Even more - you can put the mouse aside!

title: DoBad Inc
description:
게임 정보
In this open world, stealth game you play as Garett the Ferret the newest badguyer around, work your way up the corporate ladder to become one of the worst people to ever live, but acquiring this won't be easy, sneak through warehouses, murder Dogooders, steal from civilians, shoplift and more, all just for the sake of your psychotic individuality.
Features:
Traverse the city and interact with civilians
Take jobs from your bosses and commit them out in the world
Use your DoBad Promotional Credits to climb higher on this hellish corporate ladder
Decorate and expand your very own hideout
WARNING ALL ACTS OF MURDER, THEIVERY, WAR CRIME, AND DEVIOUS BEHAVIORS ARE PURELY ENTERTAINMENT!

title: Wandering Wolf
description:
게임 정보
S T R I B O G is a first person shooter with a strong focus on immersion and survival.
You will take part in unpredictable events and stories created by the game itself.
You will meet only that which exists within the framework of the game universe and its laws.
The main story follows the split in society during the Civil War in the Hard Fantasy setting.

- First person shooter

- Thoughtful levels, with Metroidvania elements

- The atmosphere of the civil war and hopelessness

- Immersion, alternative reality effect

- Workshop Support

title: Whisper of the Swallows
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a doomed world
In a cruel and merciless world, try to survive icy storms and creatures from your worst nightmares.
Dare to defy the Shadows and bring back the light.
Whether single-player or cooperative multiplayer, enjoy a unique experience thanks to procedural generation, 
But above all, listen to the breath of the wind, the long sigh of the night, and the murmur of the swallows....
Key features
A hostile, procedurally-generated world, organized into regions you can influence
Severe weather events, requiring you to anticipate your movements and take advantage of natural shelters
Join your Steam friends' games with up to 6 players for a cooperative experience
Build your own structures to protect yourself and prepare your expeditions.
Advance your skills according to your actions and play style
Build and upgrade equipment to match your ambitions
Perfect your combat by timing your blocks and dodges
Blown Leaves
Blown Leaves is an independent development studio located near Lille in Northern France.
To contact us: contact@blownleaves.fr

title: Hello
description:
게임 정보
Plot:
Try on the role of a food delivery man from the small town N. You have to live in this small and melancholy town for a whole week, collecting and delivering food to different people who inhabit this town. Eavesdrop on scraps of conversations on the street, interact with characters and be a good delivery boy!
Features:
The streets are filled with details and characters. Some of them have extra quests and stories just for you.
The melancholy atmosphere of the city. A reality filled with sadness and humor.
Take pictures of the city and get achievements.

title: Heroes Suck
description:
게임 정보
Defend your dungeon against an onslaught of heroes in this physics-enabled tower defense. Build your dungeon tile by tile, placing deadly traps to protect your loot. Upgrade your defenses and powers as you amass wealth and unleash havoc on these cheese wheel-stealing 'heroes'.
Build your dungeon, your way. Place tile by tile, and fill your dungeon with deadly traps to keep the pesky heroes away from your loot. As you level up, you gain the ability to place more and more tiles to further grow your dungeon.
Unleash havoc with your traps. With physics enabled, send heroes flying around - or even play bowling with their bodies! You can even light them on fire or electrocute them. What fun!

title: Amp
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the synesthetic world of Amp, the neon rail shooter set in a polygonal rhythmic universe.
A NEON WORLD LIKE NO OTHER
Inspired by the world of audio, Amp takes your senses through the world where music is everything. Watch as you fly through pulsating environments to the beat
RHYTHMICALLY ENGAGE WITH THE FOES
Clear your path with different chain abilities to suit your play style
SCORE ATTACK OR CASUAL? FOLLOW YOUR PLAY MOOD
Want to be the best? Score Attack gives you the challenge of chaining as often as possible to multiply your score. If you are in it for just the scenery, Casual mode is the way to go

title: TIC-TAC: Twelve o'clock
description:
게임 정보

TIC-TAC: Twelve o'clock 게임은 90 년대 초의 컬트 공포에서 영감을 받았습니다. 버려진 학교의 어두운 수수께끼를 풀기 위해 학생-모험가 그룹을 도와야합니다.
이야기
우울한 황량한 복도와 교실의 억압적인 분위기에서 며칠 밤을 보내 게됩니다. 대피소의 안전을주의 깊게 모니터링하고 퍼즐을 풀고 다른 세계 세력의 도전에 대응하십시오. 무서운 놀라움으로 재치와 서둘러에 맞서십시오. 그리고 마지막으로, 조용한 작은 마을에있는 평범한 학교가 잔인 함, 고통, 고통의 영역으로 변모 한 원인을 찾아보십시오.

네 명의 친구와 함께 흥미 진진하고 정교한 이야기를 진행합니다. 버려진 계급의 어둠 속의이 세계 주민과 싸울 전략을 선택할 수 있습니다. 당신의 경계와 세심함은 원래 게임 메커니즘의 예기치 않은 도전과 소름 끼치는 생물의 갑작스런 공격으로 테스트 될 것입니다. 그리고 매일 밤 생존 할 때마다 스토리 발전과 새로운 도전으로 보상을 받게됩니다.

게임 기능
원래 플롯
고립 된 우울한 분위기
어려운 타이밍으로 역동적 인 게임 플레이
퍼즐 및 무작위 이벤트


12 시가되면 악에 도전 할 준비가 되셨습니까?

title: Undercover Speed Dating
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wondered what it'd be like to go speed dating behind enemy lines, while making an unconscionable amount of wolf puns? Never once considered anything like that? Do most people not think about stuff like that?

Welcome to the first ever survival game about small talk, where you'll literally live or die by your own words. Navigate a darkly comedic world full of tragic, man-eating wolves using nothing but your own voice to push the action forwards.

This game uses a unique artificial intelligence system to let you improvise your way through a carefully handwritten story.

You play as Arnold, one of only a few humans left after the gruesome wolf invasion. Your mission? To infiltrate wolf speed dating, make wolf small talk and rescue the human they've got trapped in the kitchen before any wolves discover your true identity!

Talk spices with Chef Wolf, drink Mai Tails with Casino Wolf, and lift weights with Swolf. Help Virginia Wolf write her book. Tell Paranoid Wolf that no, humans are not hiding in wolf costumes, he's wrong about that, and he should probably start thinking about moving out of his mother's basement too. And there's a lot more speed dating wolves than that.

This is a game full of twists and turns, hairballs, a narrative with extensive branching paths, unique storylines and endings for each wolf, and even more hairballs. There's a lot of hairballs. Wolves shed a lot.
Features
9 speed dating wolves, each with their own side story
Say absolutely anything you want!
A hefty amount of unique endings
Use wolves to your advantage by pitting them against each other
Hand-drawn art by Simon Gibson Penrose, backgrounds by June Prado
Original wolf-jazz soundtrack by Hot Damn Scandal
There's a wolf with a spray tan
Mythical wolf legends that can be uncovered

title: The Warrior
description:
게임 정보
The Warrior is a short action/adventure platformer where protagonist, story and mechanics are constantly changing. Control legendary warriors, giant worms, greedy kings and lazy demons, each with their own purpose.
Control multiple characters

Each character wants to be the protagonist of their own adventure. You will be put in the shoes of each one and discover that the distinction between the story's villain and hero is merely a matter of perspective.
Solve puzzles

In addition to different skills, each character faces unique difficulties and challenges. Overcoming them requires thinking outside the box.
Explore

The world is filled with details and secrets. Take the opportunity to explore, encounter new creatures, and decipher ancient runes.

In the depths, unimaginably colossal and terrifying creatures await. Overcoming them is no easy task.

You can piece together the story through dialogue and ancient buildings from the perspective of each character. Can you uncover the truth?

title: The One Who Stands Behind
description:
게임 정보
Accept the challenge of the Gods and fight them in the fast-paced deckbuilder fused with grid-based tactics.

Fight with the unique deck that you build on the fly.
Discover cards which work efficiently together.
Learn special abilities of each enemy and invent your own ways to deal with them.





Use the power of one god to defeat another. Each of them is an enemy, each of them is your character and each of them expresses one of The Five Elements. But will your puppet gods always agree on who is actually in charge here? All of them have something to discuss with you and something to argue about.



Considering the cards you have and gain during the run, manipulate the tiles of hex-based battlefield to get advantage. And don't let enemies to use them against you.

Make defeated gods unite with you to earn back the integrity and bring balance to the soul of

title: Wrenched
description:
게임 정보
Wrenched is a thrilling 3D bullet hell platformer that puts you in the shoes of Carley, armed with a giant Wrenchsword, as you navigate a dangerous post-apocalyptic world filled with killer robots. Go out on a mission to save your brother by recovering 12 essential parts, unfortunately still stuck inside colossal killer machines. If only you had a way to get them out!
BRING YOUR SWORD TO A GUN FIGHT

Go metal to metal with a wide variety of enemies, and experience an exciting twist to traditional bullet hell combat as you try to engage enemies armed with blasting artillery with your giant wrenchsword.
OUTRUN BULLETS… AND ROBOTS
Platform your way through treacherous terrain, evade traps, and strategically use the environment to gain the upper hand against the enemies. Precision and agility are your allies in this dangerous world.
FIGHT BOSSES!
Face boss encounters at the end of each level, where your survival and close-quarters combat skills will be put to the ultimate test. Keep moving and try to get close to make them taste the metal of your blade and reveal the hidden part inside.
EXPLORE A RAVAGED WORLD
Explore a flooded abandoned city, a makeshift floating settlement, an abandoned factory and a dangerous scrapyard. Search for their hidden paths, buildings, and secluded platforms to find secrets and shortcuts!



Each area brings unique quests and characters to meet. Infiltrate a band of Underground Survivors or fight the mythical scrappers in between mountains of junk. You’ll never know who you run into, or who you can trust!
One benefit of a Robot Uprising? They might leave behind some cool tech!
Jump into a fighter jet and a tank to blast your way through enemies and give them a taste of their own bullets.
Collect scraps by defeating foes, scavenging the environment, and completing quests. Use them to craft over 17 unique upgrades, enhancing your abilities, improving your stats, and unlocking powerful new attacks.
As of this moment, Wrenched is still in development and a lot more exciting features are on the horizon! If you would like to help make Wrenched the best game possible and give your input consider joining our Discord server.

If you’d like to stay up to date on development and watch devlogs, or catch a live Stream where I work on the game, consider subscribing to my Youtube channel!

title: Dōbumon
description:
게임 정보
Dōbumon is a classic monster catching RPG in an isometric style of early handheld games.

Story
Ever since strange objects fell from the sky, people have been using fragments of them in order to enact a forced evolution on wild animals, gaining new and interesting forms and abilities. These forced-evolved creatures are known as "Dōbumon".
Gameplay Features
Begin your journey by choosing 1 of 3 starting Dōbumon, each with their unique skills and advantages
Build a team of up to 4 Dōbumon to fight on the battlefield together
Move your Dōbumon into more advantageous positions, while utilizing synergistic attacks that bring about a more complex battle system
Tame and fight with wide variety of dozens and dozens of Dōbumon
Utilizes an Action Point system, making every attack that you perform, count to the fullest.
Discover and choose from alternative evolutionary forms with different fragments, that help you build the perfect team that's suited for you
Explore
Choose 1 of 3 Dōbumon to start out on your adventure with, and then begin your journey to fight at the world tournament of Dōbumon. You'll be thrust into an adventure where along the way, you'll discover things aren't quite as they seem.


Explore several major cities in the world, full of interactions, quests, and collectibles
Discover the story behind these fragments that fell from the sky, and their implications
Meet friends and develop rivals as you explore the world of Dōbumon!

title: COSMIC HOLES Junior
description:
게임 정보
특징:

난이도가 점점 높아지는 300개의 논리적인 문제.
우주 공간의 편안한 분위기.
중국 우주론의 5원소를 지배하는 역학 법칙.
따라야 할 4가지 논리적 규칙.
놀라움을 위해 수집해야 할 천 개의 별.

오리지널 게임과 비교한 "JUNIOR" 버전:

훨씬 더 부드러운 난이도 진행.
추가 게임 보조 기능.
더 이상 센티널 적이 없습니다("COSMIC HOLES"에서 너무 빠를 때 나타났던 적).

title: RAGER
description:
게임 정보
Your battleground is arena, your enemies are robots, your energy is hard-hitting music and you are RAGER! Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-fueled excitement of this melee combat rhythm game!

Master weapon of your choice – sword, mace, claws, hammer, axe, your own fists and many more! Pick anything from tremendous arsenal and unleash the chaos! Time your attacks, blocks, and dodges to the rhythm of the music and cause maximum impact.

Don't let robots to swarm you from all directions, test your skills and reflexes. The immersive audiovisual experience will keep you on your toes, stunning visuals and spatial audio technology puts you right in heart of the action.

In RAGER, you're not just a player – you're a force to be reckoned with. So gear up, warrior, and prepare to show the world what you're made of in the ultimate battle for survival!

RAGER Discord server link

title: Arcane Arena
description:
게임 정보
Enter a World of Awe-Inspiring Magic and Intense Battles

Arcane Arena is an exhilarating multiplayer action game that thrusts you into a world of awe-inspiring magic and intense battles. Engage in epic team-based combat as you harness the power of arcane forces to dominate the battlefield. With a diverse roster of unique spellcasters, each wielding their own set of devastating abilities, it's up to you and your teammates to coordinate, strategize, and claim victory.
Choose Your Spellcasting Specialist

Choose your class from a captivating selection of spellcasting specialists. Become a Necromancer and summon hordes of undead minions to overwhelm your foes. Manipulate the fabric of time as a Chronomancer, altering the course of battles to your advantage. Brew potent potions and unleash explosive attacks as an Alchemist. Command the elements as an Elementalist, raining down fiery destruction or freezing enemies in their tracks. With each class offering a distinct playstyle and a wide array of spells and abilities, the possibilities for magical mastery are endless.
Teamwork and Coordination

Teamwork and coordination are crucial in Arcane Arena. Coordinate with your teammates to capture control points, escort valuable artifacts, or defend ancient relics. Forge powerful alliances, communicate strategies, and combine your abilities to unleash devastating combos that will leave your enemies in awe. With dynamic environments and interactive elements, the battlefield is a canvas waiting for your magical touch. Adapt your tactics, utilize environmental advantages, and outmaneuver your opponents to secure victory.
Path to Glory

Progress and grow as a spellcaster by earning experience points and unlocking new abilities as you level up your chosen class. Customize your appearance with a wide range of cosmetic items, including unique skins, emotes, and weapon enhancements. Show off your individual style and prowess as you carve your path to glory.
Rise to the Top

For those seeking a competitive edge, ranked matches offer a thrilling arena to test your skills against other formidable spellcasters. Climb the leaderboards, earn prestigious ranks, and become a legend of the Arcane Arena.

Immerse yourself in the mystical realm of Arcane Arena, where magic reigns supreme and battles of epic proportions await. Prepare to be mesmerized by stunning visuals, exhilarating gameplay, and the thrill of wielding arcane powers. Are you ready to rise as a master of magic and conquer the Arcane Arena? Let your journey begin!

title: Shadows of the Afterland
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a supernatural point-and-click adventure in which you are confronted with the most difficult decision of your life ... and death...

Madrid, 1960. A chilling incident unfolds at the city's old zoo, leading to a mysterious death that propels a soul to the threshold between the world of the living and the afterlife. But when the transition goes awry, the soul arrives with the memories of Carolina, one of the pioneers of the Madrid police force, who has not yet been born.

Step into Carolina’s shoes and delve into a detective mystery to unravel the enigma shrouding these events. Explore the wacky realm of the afterlife, teeming with unique characters and with its own rules.

In your quest for the truth, you join forces with César, an elusive former ghost agent. Persuade this enigmatic ally to accompany you on a transformative journey to confront the sinister forces lurking in the world of the living. As you gain César’s trust, you'll have to solve tricky point-and-click puzzles, harness the power of magic, navigate between worlds and even possess the living.

title: 末日迷窟 Doomsday Cave
description:
게임 정보
In this cross-board action game, you will face a difficult life in the post-nuclear war post-apocalyptic underworld and experience elements such as action upgrades, interacting with your family, resource collection and distribution in the game.

1: This is a hardcore action game, in the face of monsters every action must be very careful, otherwise it is easy to die. The characters have 6 attack moves and 3 dodge moves. Characters and monsters will be hit by the value system to determine the different state.
2: Rogue-like elements, the death of the character does not end the game, will inherit part of the resources to reborn, the death of the family is the end of the game round.
3: Family system, each round of the game will begin with a random family, parents, wife, brothers, etc.. Each family member can do different things for you, and each family member consumes different resources.
4: 1 shelter map, 3 adventure maps. Collect resources in these places and distribute them to yourself and your family.

title: BLOODZ
description:
게임 정보


Take on the role of a ruthless killer and complete a series of exciting assignments.

Choose your style
Throw yourself into the action, take enemies down by surprise or eliminate them silently.


Use various covers to efficiently move around the battlefield.


Face numerous enemy troops.

title: Shattered Reflections: The Abyss Within
description:
게임 정보
As everlyn you are set to piece together the story of the experiments that took place by a secret company lead by everlyn's grandfather.

👉 Are you ready to confront the reflections of your darkest fears?

Key Features:

Immersive experience: An atmospheric, realistic graphics intensifies the experience.

title: Specters of the Sun
description:
게임 정보


Play as a Specter - Attack while moving, jumping and dashing, throw your sword and watch it ricochet on the walls, and phase to its position, like a specter!



Action-packed Stages - Cross the fallen lands, through deep woods, abandoned towns and graveyards, on your way up the behemoth structure.

- Face end of stage challenges with emergent gameplay and high replayability.



- Find useful sub weapons along the way and make strategic decisions which to keep or replace throughout the levels.



- Fine tune the difficulty on the fly, save states or even skip sections completely.

title: Angry Mother Earth
description:
게임 정보
맞아요. 그녀는 여러분이 그녀의 굴곡진 몸을 망쳐 화가 나 있어요. 이제 도움이 될 만한 무언가를 해 보세요. 그녀를 도와 인류를 없애보세요. 'Angry Mother Earth'에서, 대지의 어머니의 입장에 서서 인류를 없앨 다양한 전략을 구상해보세요. 다른 게임들과 비교할 수 없는 경험이 될 거예요!

배우기는 쉽지만, 마스터하기는 어렵습니다! 여러분은 토네이도, 지진, 허리케인 등과 같은 능력을 사용해 인류가 환경 오염으로 멸망하기 전에 없애야 합니다. 하지만, 게임을 마스터하는 것은 완전히 다른 도전입니다! 여러분에게 피해를 주고 건강 수치에 영향을 주는 산업 구역을 파괴하기 위해 토네이도를 발생시킬 수 있지만, 주의를 기울여야 합니다. 토네이도는 경로에 있는 나무까지 파괴할 수 있는데, 이 나무는 원래대로라면 시간이 지남에 따라 여러분이 받는 피해를 줄여주기 때문입니다.

'Angry Mother Earth'에서, 여러분은 어떻게 인류를 파괴할 것인가에 대한 선택의 기로에 서게 됩니다. 고려해야 할 시나리오들이 몇 가지 있습니다. 만약 농장만을 타겟으로 삼아 식량 공급을 중단하면 어떨까요? 아니면 전력망을 붕괴시킨다면 어떨까요? 그런 행동들이 국가를 전복시킬 수 있을까요? 하지만, 만약 학살이 여러분의 입맛에 맞지 않는다면, 평화적인 접근법을 선택해도 좋습니다. 인류가 환경을 보호하도록 설득하세요.

매 순간마다 진화하는 다이내믹한 시뮬레이션 세계로 빠져보세요. 변화의 바퀴가 돌면서, 이 세계는 기술 발전, 글로벌 이벤트, 요동치는 국가 정책, 그리고 가장 중요한 여러분의 결정에 의해 결정됩니다. 이 복잡한 시뮬레이션에서는 식량, 전력, 서비스, 필수 재화의 공급망이 완벽히 상호 연결되어 있습니다. 하나만 파괴되어도 그 영향은 전체 국가를 관통하니, 이를 활용할 수도 있겠죠.

대지의 어머니, 대지의 아버지, 가이아, 미드가르드가 되어 플레이하세요. 각각의 캐릭터들은 고유의 독특한 능력과 플레이 스타일을 갖고 있답니다! 대지의 어머니는 평화로운 방법을 통해 게임을 진행하는 반면, 대지의 아버지는 그의 눈에 띄는 모든 것들은 없애버리고 싶어 합니다. 가이아는 질병, 바이러스, 전염병으로 인류를 멸망시키는 편인 반면, 미드가르드는 인류에게 다음 빙하기를 선사하고자 하는 편입니다.

다양한 맵을 탐색하세요! 구형 레이아웃과 평평한 지역, 두 개의 서로 다른 맵을 번갈아 가며 전략적 게임 플레이에 빠져보세요. 각 지역은 수행해야 할 도전 과제들을 제시합니다. 적들조차도 지도마다 다르기에, 여러분의 독특한 방법을 사용해야 합니다. 적응력이 관건입니다!

대단한데요! 이렇게까지 스크롤하는 사람은 그리 많지 않은데요. 그 밖에 어떤 것들이 준비되어 있는지 알아보겠습니다.

스스로에게 도전하세요!
쉬움, 보통, 어려움, 악몽의 다양한 난이도 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다. 그리고 숨겨진 레벨까지? 힌트는 산타의 장난꾸러기 목록에 오르지 말라는 겁니다.

확장 가능한 스킬 트리!
각 캐릭터들은 3개의 스킬 트리를 갖고 있으며, 각 13개의 스킬을 보유하고 있습니다. 이를 통해 다양한 전략을 세우고, 몰입하세요.

인류의 반응?
그들을 과소평가하지 마세요. 진심으로, 하지 마세요! 그들은 여러분이 하는 모든 행동에 반응할 것이고, 인간이 가장 잘하는 것을 할 것입니다. 바로 적응과 파괴죠!

역동적인 이벤트, (거의) 끝 없는 가능성!
300개 이상의 이벤트가 있고, 매 게임은 새로운 도전이 됩니다. 인간이 아마존을 위협할 때, 아마존을 보호하기 이해 자원의 방향을 바꿀 것인가요, 아니면 나무를 전부 베어버리게 둘 것인가요? 조심하세요, 나무는 오염을 막아주기 때문에 나무를 사라지게 두는 것은 패배로 이어질 수 있습니다.

title: Paper Play VR
description:
게임 정보


*똑똑* 우리 집에 놀러올래? 종이로 만든 나의 성에서 휴식을 취하거나 온라인 기록 도장깨기를 위해 진땀을 뺄 수도 있어요.
더 많이, 더 즐겁게! 친구를 최대 4 명까지 초대해서 게임을 같이 즐길 수 있어요! :)

물수제비
골프와 비슷한 듯도 하지만, 물 위에서 돌을 던지는 게임입니다. 코스가 끝나갈 쯤 돌을 튕겨 표면을 가로질러 장대에 맞히세요!

유령 사냥
이 편집증 시뮬레이터에서는 손전등으로 무서운 유령을 찾아내서 쏴야 합니다. 하지만 어둠 속에 항상 또 다른 유령이 숨어서 당신의 마지막 촛불이 마침내 꺼지기를 기다리고 있다는 걸 명심하세요!

아이스크림 맛보기
아주 기다란 혀로 아이스크림을 핥아야 하는 이상한 게임입니다. 하지만 조심하세요! 어떤 종류에는 알러지가 있어서 너무 욕심을 부리면 말 그대로 혀에 불이 날 수 있어요!

그 외에도 많은 미니 게임이 곧 추가로 출시됩니다, 파티에 참석하세요!

title: Forest of Soul
description:
게임 정보



"영혼의 숲"은 독특한 롤플레잉 게임입니다.
자신의 영적 세계에 들어가면 어떤 멋진 광경을 보게 될지 생각해 본 적이 있습니까?
플롯 중심의 게임 흐름, 여유롭고 즐거운 게임 경험, 아름다움과 마법이 공존하는 몽환적인 장면, 잊지 못할 여정을 시작해 보세요!
>>>클릭하여 위시리스트에 추가하고 팔로우하시면 체험판 데모 소식을 최대한 빨리 받아보실 수 있습니다!






기억을 잃은 소녀는 멋진 꿈속에서 신비한 작은 유령을 만났습니다.
다른 세계에서 온 탐험가이며 꿈속에서 기적을 보게 될 수 있다고 말했습니다. 소녀는 작은 유령을 따라가며 스릴과 즐거움이 가득한 여행을 시작했습니다. 그녀는 꿈속에서 다양한 판타지 장면을 접했고, 흥미로운 친구들을 많이 사귀었습니다. 그러나 꿈이 끝나갈 무렵 그녀는 놀라운 비밀을 발견했고, 그것은 모두 자신의 과거와 관련이 있다는 사실이 밝혀지는데…

title: Operation Terra
description:
게임 정보
Operation Terra는 절차적으로 생성된 레벨과 맵이 있는 공상과학 1인칭 슈팅/롤플레잉 게임입니다.
당신을 막으려는 끈질긴 기계들과 싸우는 동안 새로운 지구인 테라에 인류가 정착할 길을 닦으세요.
싸움

무엇이든 불가능하게 만드는 것이 유일한 목표인 드론, 드로이드, 로봇, 탱크, 포탑과 싸우세요. 보너스와 파워업을 수집하세요.
탐험

거의 무한한 절차적으로 생성된 맵과 레벨 레이아웃을 탐험하세요.
모든 플레이가 똑같지는 않습니다.
업그레이드

미션에서 약탈한 크레딧으로 무기와 장비를 업그레이드하세요. 기지에서 영구 업그레이드를 구매하세요. 기지의 새로운 부분에 접근할 수 있는 허가를 받으세요.

최종 게임은 30개의 고유한 적, 6개의 서로 다른 환경, 전체적으로 30개의 고유한 타일 세트를 특징으로 하며, 각각은 2~4개의 서로 다른 텍스처 세트와 절차적으로 매치되어 다양성과 재생성을 더했습니다.

title: Infernae
description:
게임 정보


A bullet hell game where dodging and cowering for your life will claim it. Fear is not shield, a lesson Asmus learned long ago. Will the lesson pass down onto you?
Play through a boss rush of increasingly challenging foes, and watch your game over count go up with each one. We are not responsible for bouts of frustration and indignation. Control your emotions, or they will control you.



A starwitch has been marked for death, and the duty of a memento mori is to carry out their deliverance. That's Asmus' story. But she has a story of her own too, and Lucine will make sure he listens to her if it's the last thing she does.
Lucine is one of several bosses that will be featured in Infernae. Each one has a story to tell, a secret between them that Asmus doesn't want you to know about.

title: Heavenstrafer
description:
게임 정보
Take control of Berith, a demon priestess ready to shoot her way through an angel infested Hell, in her crusade to hunt three powerful demons that have been corrupted by the angelic forces. Unleash your arsenal of four powerful guns and weave between them in order to string together stylish combos. And remember:
"It's not about size or speed, it's about technique."
Use all the weapons given to you
Earn COMBO RANKS by shooting with different weapons. Switching weapons allows you to shoot faster. Heal yourself by damaging enemies at a high COMBO RANK.
Augment your mobility with three different dashes
By DASHING at the maximum COMBO RANK you can slow down time, become invisible or create a powerful explosion.
Never stop shooting
Instantly reload all weapons by shooting with all guns at least once.
Every gun comes equipped with a main fire mode and an unlockable alternate fire mode. The Belial and the Purson are a pair of shotguns that compliment each other's damage, both with alternate shots that augment your mobility. The Ballista fires an explosive flaming bolt, setting enemies on fire and increasing the damage they take, and finally, the Asmodeus Opus is a revolver that deals high damage against dying enemies, redirecting your bullet and reloading all weapons on a kill.

title: 月詠に至る
description:
게임 정보
”Reach to Tsukuyomi" is an exhilarating 2D platform action game.
The player-controlled protagonist, Kaede, adventures through stages infested with ghosts.
Exhilarating Action
The player's basic actions consist of simple attacks, jumps, and dashes.
In addition, there are counters that can be triggered by hitting a well-timed dash in time with an enemy's attack, and long-range attacks with shurikens.

Numerous Enemies and Bosses
Various kinds of enemies appear in the game.
Each has its own unique attack method and characteristics, so it is necessary to adapt your strategy accordingly.

One day, the main character Kaede decides to return to her hometown, but what awaits her is a hometown occupied by Yokai (Japanese monsters).
In order to free her hometown from the yokai, Kaede ventures out on her own, only to be confronted by her childhood friends Sakura and Murasaki, who she grew up with. ......

title: Nightmare Fuels
description:
게임 정보
지금 위시리스트에 추가하세요!
Fuel's & Friends는 일인칭 공포 타이쿤 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 가스 스테이션을 업그레이드하고 탐험하여 비즈니스를 확장하세요!

1992년입니다. 여러분은 가스 스테이션 프랜차이즈 "Fuel's & Friends"에서 새로운 사업을 시작했습니다.
밤에는 가스 스테이션을 확장하고 침입이 없도록 하는 것이 여러분의 일입니다.
낮에는 죽은 친척의 컴퓨터를 조사하여 다양한 명령을 입력하여 정보를 얻습니다.
게임 소개:[[/u]/h2]



몰입형 시뮬레이션: 각 명령이 중요한 완전히 시뮬레이션된 컴퓨터 세계를 탐험하세요.
전략적 도전: 위협을 피하고 비밀을 해제하며 전략적인 의사결정을 통해 경쟁 상대를 능가하세요.
해킹, 생존, 정복: 해킹 기술을 시험하고 동적인 환경에서 생존하며 이 가상 세계를 정복하기 위해 노력하세요.

title: FrogLake
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the FrogLake

In this RPG you have to save your lake from drying up.
During your journey you will develop your special water powers and find better gear to move on.
The combat system of this game requires you to select 2 action keybinds every turn that you can perform
like:
Attack Jump Skill Item and Run.

Featuring:

Unique combat system
A big lake to explore
Lots of slippy friends to meet
Water based magic
Catching food with your tongue
Lots of sidequests

Not featuring:

A level system
Random encounters
A stable housing market
Auto saving (this is a good thing)

title: PushOver
description:
게임 정보
In Pushover, your goal is to push your friends off the platforms! In this local or online multiplayer couch game you can fight with and against up to 4 people (or computers) on a variety of different stages! Or you can choose to play in the singleplayer Champion Village to complete challenges and unlock new characters and worlds! With 2 gamemodes there is an endless amount of pushing fun!

Includes:
Multiple stages
chaotic items
Online or local multiplayer with up to 4 players
a single player mode to unlock new worlds and characters
Timed and Livestock gamemode
fun movement and pushing!

title: Rival Goals
description:
게임 정보
Meet new rivals and meet your real-life goals in this gacha-style visual novel filled to the brim with loveable characters and amusing story threads.

Rival Goals is a visual novel in which characters are unlocked by setting and completing customizable daily tasks by your chosen deadline. These tasks are meant for you to complete in real-life and self-report to each of your in-game rivals in order to unlock more story, new characters, customizable decorations, collectibles, and more.

You can even create your own custom rivals to hold you to your promises to build better habits!


Featuring:

-25 unlockable characters
-A custom character builder
-Hundreds of collectibles
-Amusing storylines and secrets to uncover
-In-game to-do list to help manage your tasks
-Stickers for decorating your in-game desk

Whether you've been meaning to drink more water, get better sleep, or spend a few minutes everyday working on that book you're (supposed to be) writing, Rival Goals can be the push you finally needed to make your dreams come true!

title: Convenient: Fiend
description:
게임 정보
Dig up graves to steal from the dead while you escape graveyard security and run from the legendary Oldlake Wendigo.
Gameplay:

Dig up graves!
Low poly PS1 style
Survive terrifying monsters
Discover hidden secrets
The continuation of Convenient


Survive

Quickly before security catches you. You're at the Oldlake Cemetery to loot graves and make some money. Find the gravestones with the names written in your notebook and dig them up while staying out of sight. If you are spotted, make quick decisions while being chased to survive. Find hiding spots and stay out of sight until the coast is clear. Security guards aren't the only thing you'll be running from so keep your eyes peeled.




Find VHS tapes around the graveyard to uncover the mystery hiding in the cemetery. Instead of watching VHS tapes, you live them. Solve puzzles and experience the story yourself. You may be a grave robber, but there's more going on here than just a few missing bodies. Discover the birth of the Oldlake Wendigo and how to stop it.



The origins of , the short horror game made by LunaApps.

title: Cosmorons
description:
게임 정보
COSMORONS
Greetings, cosmic conquerors! We present to you COSMORONS, an old-school futuristic shooter about comedic robot drudges conquering the cosmos with outlandish weapons & hijinks galore.  To achieve ultimate glory, grapple, shoot, and drill your way to galactic domination. New areas bring big rewards, but drastically increase in difficulty.
SINGLE PLAYER / ONLINE CO-OP GAMEPLAY
Take on the universe as a conquest of one or play co-op with your fellow Drudges! Cosmorons offers both single player and co-op gameplay. As a single player, combat alien factions, complete thrilling challenges and collect planetary cores on your own. In co-op play, it's you and a team of fellow Drudges versus the universe! Online co-op means you and your friends can play from the comforts of your own home.

title: Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure
description:
게임 정보


Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure is a captivating 3D puzzle/adventure game where your goal is to guide Lum, a brave light spirit, through a world filled with challenging puzzles and stunning environments. Rotate the levels, think creatively, and solve intricate puzzles to reach the magical purple crystal that hold the key to Lum's journey.
Key Features:

Innovative Puzzle Mechanics: Rotate and manipulate the environment in unique ways to solve puzzles. Each level presents new challenges that require both logic and strategy to overcome.

Four Distinct Chapters: Embark on a journey through 4 beautifully crafted chapters, each with 10 levels, more chapters will be available as we go on. Every chapter introduces its own unique visual style and puzzle elements, ensuring that no two levels are the same.

Visually Stunning Environments: Explore a world where every chapter has a distinct look and feel, from mystical nature to ancient ruins, each rendered in a vibrant and enchanting art style.

Immersive Audio Experience: Enjoy a captivating soundtrack and sound effects that enhance the gameplay and draw you deeper into Lum's world. The music sets the mood perfectly, whether you're deep in thought or celebrating a hard-earned victory.

Challenging and Rewarding Gameplay: Test your puzzle-solving skills with a variety of intricate puzzles. The satisfaction of figuring out each level is matched only by the excitement of discovering what lies ahead.

Can you help Lum collect all the crystals and unlock the mysteries of this enchanted world? Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure offers hours of engaging gameplay for puzzle enthusiasts and adventure lovers alike. Start your journey today!

title: Wiblu
description:
게임 정보
Wiblu
"Unraveling the Mystery of Fire Tea"

Embark on an enchanting journey with "Wiblu," a captivating story adventure game inspired by German mythology. Winner of the Best Indie Game Prototype at the German Videogame Awards, "Wiblu" invites you to explore a world filled with mystical creatures, breathtaking landscapes, and a quest for a legendary cure – the elusive fire tea.

Key Features:
🔮 Immersive Storytelling: Join Wiblu, a young Hommlinger girl, on a quest through the fantastical world of "Waag" to find the cure for her ailing grandmother. Encounter magical places, forge new companionships, face old dangers, and unveil the mysteries of Wiblu's own past. The narrative promises an adventure straight out of a storybook – with a pinch of love and the creativity of our five dedicated developers.

🎶 Melodic Masterpiece: Immerse yourself in a unique musical experience as you traverse the realms of "Wiblu." The game's self-composed and handcrafted music draws inspiration from the Middle Ages and the Renaissance, featuring harps, flutes, guitars, synthesizer sounds, choirs, and orchestras. Let the bard's lament serve as a musical thread, intertwining themes that encapsulate the rich lore of "Wiblu."

🎨 Hand-Drawn Elegance: Witness the breathtaking artistry of "Wiblu," where every detail is meticulously hand-drawn. The unique and elaborate art style creates a visual feast for your eyes, turning the game into a living, breathing masterpiece.

🎮 Engaging Gameplay Mechanics:
Dialogues/Minigames: Immerse yourself in the story through interactive dialogues and entertaining minigames that sharpen your skills and enhance crucial content.

Key Items/Items: Solve puzzles and overcome challenges using a variety of items, each with its own significance. Key items can be reused, while ordinary items play a pivotal role in unraveling mysteries.

Stories: Explore hidden stories scattered throughout the levels, encouraging thorough exploration. Deepen your understanding of the game's lore and support worldbuilding by collecting these captivating snippets.

🔍 Discover Waag: Experience a seamless and user-friendly gaming environment with simple controls, detailed hand-drawn levels, and hidden items waiting to be uncovered. Engage with lovingly designed puzzles that gradually increase in complexity, keeping you captivated from start to finish.

"Wiblu" is more than just a game; it's an immersive adventure crafted with passion, creativity, and the desire to offer a truly memorable experience. Dive into the world of "Wiblu" and let the magic unfold.

title: Summer Sprint
description:
게임 정보

Lisa의 배낭을 도난당했는데 돌려받고 싶어합니다. 그녀가 아름다운 해안을 따라 어려운 길을 극복하도록 도와주세요. 도중에 모든 장애물을 극복할 수 있을까요? 과연 도둑을 잡을 수 있을까요?

게임 특징:
- 아름다운 해안선을 따라 오토바이를 타보세요.
- 즐거운 분위기를 즐겨보세요.
- 다양한 레벨.

title: Power Line Rider
description:
게임 정보
POWER LINE RIDER


Embark on an action-packed journey in Power Line Rider, diving players into an all new hand-pixeled world. Assume the role of John Glider, veteran member of the Power Line Rider organization. Venture out to Reestablish contact with 3 bases that have recently gone dark in this post-apocalyptic world where the fastest means of travel is riding on old power lines.
STORY MODE / ENDLESS MODE


Beat the 3 Bosses in the concise "Story Mode" to unlock the thrilling and addictive "Endless Mode". Enter the NegaZone and ride through ever increasing difficulty all the way to Infinity! (Or as long as you can survive!)
KEY FEATURES

title: Bony Bones Adventures
description:
게임 정보
'조상' 원고가 도난당하고, 끔찍한 고대 마법이 탄생했습니다. 저주가 Zagrobiya 주민들에게 내려졌고, 그들은 신비한 주인의 손안에서 순종적인 꼭두각시로 변했습니다. 한때 번영했던 땅은 어둠 속으로 사라졌습니다.
Bony Bones 와 함께 Zagrobiya 를 구하고, 단순한 주민에서 용감한 영웅으로 거듭나고, 모든 재난의 원인을 규명하고 악을 파괴해야 합니다.
클래식 3D 플랫포머입니다.
Zagrobiya 에서 각각 고유한 분위기와 바이옴을 갖춘 4개의 독특한 장소를 탐험하세요.
수수께끼를 풀고, 치명적인 함정을 통과하고, 비밀을 찾으세요.
모험 중에 만나는 Zagrobiya 사람들을 도우세요.
길에서 만나는 모든 적과 보스는 독특하며, 각각에 대한 접근 방식을 찾으세요.

title: HamSumo
description:
게임 정보
Overview
HAMSUMO is an indie physics-based multiplayer game where up to 4 players can duke it out in the world's most adorable battle arena! Choose from a selection of cute, cool, and kooky hamsters to BONK YOUR FRIENDS!

Game Features
GO HAM with a hamster that fits your style! Choose from 6 different hamsters, each with their own look and personality!
Unleash the power of the cosmos with STAR MOVES! Each hamster has 3 unique Star Moves to experiment with. Learning to use them effectively can really turn the tables on your opponents!
Deep physics-based movement that is EASY TO LEARN and HARD TO MASTER! Whether you learn best in Practice Mode or in the heat of battle in Versus Mode, honing your roly-poly skills will be the difference between victory and defeat!
Play against your friends on the couch or BONK THE WORLD in Online Matches! 1v1, 2v2, or a full on 4-Player Free For All? The choice is yours!

title: WorldShaper Idle
description:
게임 정보
An unique idle game where you build your own world. Experiment with placing basic tiles, like forests, villlages, mushroom forests and more, in specific patterns to discover new tile types. Optimize your world to maximize your production, or just sit back and keep growing more and more powerful.

This Game Features
Relaxing idle gameplay
An unique grid based optimization puzzle
Hundreds of tiles to discover
Experiment with over 50 bonuses
Multiple races to discover and play: play as humans and elves!
Great music by Stijn Cappetijn

Gameplay
There are some basic tiles you can place, such as villages, forests and mystical flowers. You'll unlock more over time! By placing those basic tiles in specific patterns, you can discover more advanced tiles. For example, place two rocks around a village to make a mining village, or place four mining villages around a village to make a industrial city!
Each of these tiles has a base production and often some bonuses. For example, a mining village produces more if there are more rocks adjacent to it, and a industrial city produces more if there are more mining villages within its range.
WorldShaper Idle is an idle game. You'll keep producing resources even if the game is closed. The game will unfold and become more complex as you progress, and more basic tiles are introduced throughout the game. You can make a simple build and just gather resources, but there are also plenty of opportunities for puzzling and number crunching if you want.

title: Within the Unknown
description:
게임 정보
Within the Unknown is a first-person, psychological indie horror game where you regain your memory and relive the trauma from your dark past in a sci-fi simulation.
Synopsis

Upon waking up with no recollection of who you are, explore an abandoned farm to uncover the mysteries behind you and your family. As a human subject, your endurance and sanity will be tested as you experience the nightmares your mind has conjured in this simulation.
Relive flashbacks through tvs showing a car wreck with your daughter and what happened in the cornfield.

There's only one way out of this self-inflicted reality, you must face your fears so you can see them once again.
Gameplay

Core gameplay features crouching, running with stamina with different camera shakes, inventory system with items such as your lighter, keys to unlock areas, and notes from your afflicted wife.

To add some immersion, the lighter will go out when you run and sometimes require a few flicks to ignite. The flashlight you find has the ability to blind the creatures in the cornfield as you search for your daughter.
You can also light candles, reattach mannequin parts, and solve a combination lock.
Estimated play time is roughly 45 mins-1 hour for the first chapter. Chapter 2 is in the works and will hopefully be released in the near future.

Thank you for your interest in my game and good luck!

title: Beneath the Bleeding Moon
description:
게임 정보
Adashima Haru was born in the lap luxury. He lives with his mother in the heart of Kyoto, in a spacious home with servants to tend to his every need. Haru has everything a young man could ever want…
At a glance, at least.
In actuality, however, Haru’s life isn’t so perfect.
Haru’s mother is stern and controlling, and she dictates every facet of Haru’s life. She is adamant that Haru should dress like a woman, and she constantly berates him for not behaving like a young lady.
Haru's life is dull and uninteresting... until he runs into a thief, Kishou, during a rare shopping excursion.
After discovering that Haru is a young man, not a young woman, Kishou breaks into Haru’s home in the dead of night in an attempt to blackmail him – and, in so doing, Kishou’s destiny becomes irrevocably entwined with Haru’s.
On that fateful night, Haru and Kishou are set a task: to travel the country slaying monsters, so that they might break a centuries-old curse that has plagued Haru’s family for generations.
100k worth of text (approx 4-8 hours of reading)
A linear story with no choices/branches

title: Elemdian
description:
게임 정보

전설적인 엘레젬은 자연의 에너지를 흡수하는 특별한 보석입니다. 이 보석들은 상상할 수 없는 능력을 해방하고 모록의 비밀을 풀어낼 열쇠를 가지고 있습니다. 엘레젬을 통해 아루마는 마법 주문을 시전하고 그녀의 강력한 주먹을 강화할 수 있습니다.


아루마는 그녀의 늑대 유산으로부터 부여받은 특별한 능력을 가지고 있습니다: 원하는 때에 장엄한 늑대로 변신할 수 있는 힘입니다. 이 놀라운 선물은 그녀에게 풍경을 빠르게 질주하고, 협곡을 뛰어넘으며, 왕국 전역에 흩어져 있는 숨겨진 비밀을 드러낼 수 있는 능력을 제공합니다.



전력 질주하고, 높은 곳을 오르거나 엘레젬의 힘을 활용하여 순간이동하거나 마법의 섬을 날아다니세요. 숨겨진 경이로움을 발견하고 모록의 비밀을 풀어내세요.



적을 물리치거나 채광 지점에서 채굴하거나 상점에서 구입한 재료를 모아 주문 제작의 예술을 마스터하세요. 주문 제작의 예술은 엘레젬의 에너지를 활용하여 다양한 재료를 결합함으로써 새로운 주문을 해제하거나 새로운 재료를 제작할 수 있습니다.

title: Orbyss
description:
게임 정보
당신은 에너지의 반딧불이로, 오브와 오브 사이를 이동하며 오브에 생명을 불어넣고 퍼즐을 풀며 신비로운 우주를 되살려야 합니다. 사악한 그림자가 여러분의 퀘스트를 방해하며 점점 더 위협적으로 변해가고 있습니다. 여러분과 동료들은 이 그림자가 세상을 점령하지 못하도록 막을 수 있을까요?
한 번에 여러 장소에 있는 오브: 여러 개의 오브를 조종하고 협력하여 퍼즐을 풀 수 있습니다.
다양한 메커니즘 결합: 한 번에 여러 장소에 있고, 시간을 멈추고, 드론을 타고 날고, 소리를 내며 플레이하는 등... 모든 메커니즘을 마음대로 결합하여 잠재력을 최대한 활용하세요.
생동감 넘치는 우주 탐험: 빛나는 빛과 불길한 그림자가 방해하는 매혹적인 디지털 세계의 신비를 밝혀내세요.
큰 두뇌만 있으면 충분합니다: 주로 논리적 사고로 퍼즐을 풀어보세요. 좋은 계획은 언제나 손재주와 속도를 능가합니다.
더 많은 것을 원하시나요? 우아하거나 빠른 해결책을 찾아 수십 개의 도전 과제와 추가 도전 과제를 잠금 해제하세요. 오브 사이를 한 번만 전환하면 퍼즐을 풀 수 있다고 생각하시나요? 증명해보세요!
접근성: 언제든지 “시각적 지원” 옵션을 활성화하여 소리 없이도 소리 기반 메커니즘을 완벽하게 플레이할 수 있습니다.

title: Project Arrow
description:
게임 정보
PROJECT ARROW
Help the archer cat find its way back home in this challenging and super cute 2D platformer game.
FEATURES
Run, jump, shoot, and avoid deadly obstacles.
Use your bow to shoot arrows, calculating the force and trajectory to solve puzzles and open new paths.
Knock down false walls to discover collectibles and unlock new content.
Cats.

title: BLACKOUT
description:
게임 정보
블랙아웃은 지구 연방에서 창궐한 기계 좀비를 쳐 부수는 하드코어 협동 슈팅 게임입니다.아무도 모르는 비밀스러운 연구소부터, 지하 깊숙하게 존재하는 고속 지하철 역 까지, 플레이어들은 근 미래 특수부대가 되어 연방 곳곳 주요 시설에 투입해, 모든 기계 좀비 무리를 남김없이 소탕하세요
기계와 결합된 시체들
블랙아웃에 있는 모든 좀비들은 각기 다른 기계와 합체 되었습니다. 형태에 맞게 괴기스러운 능력을 가진 좀비들은 항상 당신의 목숨을 노리고 있습니다.
4인 협동 액션
모든 필드와 레벨들은 혼자 플레이하며, 좀비와의 사투를 벌이는게 힘겹다면,최대 4명까지 다른 플레이어와 분대를 결성하여 좀비를 쳐 부수세요 블랙아웃은 다른 플레이어와 협동할 때 최고의 경험을 할 수 있습니다.
블랙아웃에서 플레이어들은 다양한 필드를 마주하게 됩니다. 이에 따라 어떤 총기를 선택하고 어떤 전략을 통해 임무를 수행할 것인지 선택하고 집중해야 합니다.

title: Eternal Summer
description:
게임 정보
The release of a new mixed reality implant device, dubbed Eternal Summer, promises its users will experience just that.
When a solar storm hits earth the devices are catastrophically damaged, trapping users in their simulations.
Those who are still 'free' must now find their own ways to survive, as they band together into factions.

In this hex-tile turn based strategy game, you control your faction as you try to expand your control against opposing factions.
Some factions may be friendly, others are definitely not, but all have a story to tell about their version of the day the of great aurora.

title: CULT OF FLIES
description:
게임 정보
As you rush into a panic and dial 9-1-1, the operator begins to speak with you.
"9-1-1, what is your emergency?"
"There is someone outside of my house. I live in Durango, Colorado, just off of Route 550 at 6264 Berkha-"
Your phone line cuts. Your television flickers on, illuminating your face. The Channel 8 logo appears, the reporter starts speaking to the audience:
"A shocking story develops in Durango just off Route 550. A homicide case emerges from the rural home of the Grant family. 13-year-old Dennis Grant was found deceased with several stab wounds to the abdomen and his head nowhere to be seen. A blood trail leading to the basement from the living room shows that he was dragged, even having visible bruises on his ankles. His parents were also found deceased. His mother, Jennifer Grant, hanging by the roof of their front porch with burnt skin, and his father, James Grant, dismembered, scattered throughout the house. Dennis appeared to have tried to call the police, but the intruder cut the phone line just before he could finish giving the operator his address."
Your blood runs cold. You had thought your parents were safe upstairs, and just minutes ago, you had thought you were safe as well. You dare not look out of the peephole at the front door.
CULT OF FLIES is a puzzle horror game set in Durango, Colorado, in the 1980s. You play as a member of the Grant family, a prominent religious chain deeply rooted in the churches around the area. The oldest Grant family member, Bethany Grant, had died. Upon leaving her funeral, you experience several odd occurrences at the Grant residence, leading to a disturbing chain of events.

title: Marble Dash
description:
게임 정보
Marble Dash is the peak rolling experience! Try to complete the large variation of levels and become the best by competing against the world on the leaderboards! Play with or against your friends in the competitive multiplayer modes and choose to send them flying or prove you are the fastest.



Roll Around Each Unique Level From Easy to Impossible in Difficulty!
Compete Against Your Friends or Those Around The World in the Best Times!
Customize Your Marble and Collect All the Easter Eggs in Each Level!
Enjoy the Amazing Environments and Sound Track to Keep You Rolling!
Master Your Rolling Abilities to Become the Greatest Marble to Exist in Marble Dash.

title: Tales of the Laser Knights
description:
게임 정보
An Epic Journey... Full of Lasers, Explosions, and Ridiculously Good Fun!
Our young hero Zak – who’s certainly not your average farm boy – embarks on a quest to find the Ancient Orbs! These aren’t your average orbs, mind you. No, no – these are REALLY old, REALLY mighty alien gadgets scattered across the five known planets of the galaxy! They’re not just sitting there like some sort of galactic decoration. They’re packed with unimaginable power and the unnecessary complication of making Zak’s life way more difficult than it needs to be.
TALES OF THE LASER KNIGHTS
An Action-Adventure, Comic Sci-Fi B-Movie... with a Seriously Cool Laser Katana!
Controls? Twin-stick shooter style – you attack, you move, you dodge. It's so simple, it practically teaches itself!

title: Ashcroft
description:
게임 정보
It's 7 o'clock on a friday night. There's 600,000 zombies between you and the city limits. You've got one hour, before a nuclear bomb hits, turning the city and everything in it to ash.

Ashcroft is a Metroidvania inspired Platform Fighter in which you must fight against both time and zombies in a mad dash through city of Ashcroft, rescuing as many of your friends and family as possible, while punching as many zombies as physically possible.

Play as a variety of different characters, each with their own personality, fighting style and special moves, and fight (or sneak) your way through the diverse locations that make up the city - from Downtown Ashcroft to the Iron Works, then back to Suburban Hell and even the amusement park "Paulie's Pier".

Ashcroft features high intensity combat, acrobatic platforming, and all the zombies you can punch. There's a riveting Story Mode, a deadly and ultra-challenging Survival Mode, a local versus mode to challenge yourself vs computers or other players, it's got, more zombies than you can punch, and a handful of unique and fun characters to survive the apocalypse with. Plus, it's fully co-operative, so you and your friends can escape the city together!

title: Tangled Crisis
description:
게임 정보
Search, dodge, find and collect in this minimalist score based maze game with limited vision, before the timer runs out!
Mechanics 
BOOST: Gain a temporarily boost of speed and invulnerability to pass through hazards.
VISION: Enlarge your vision and reveal hidden paths.
BUILD SCORE: Collect coins and try to beat your previous run.
FIND KEYS: Search for keys to reach the exit.

title: Net Raiders
description:
게임 정보
게임 개요
넷 레이더스는 RPG, 덱 빌딩, 로그라이크 요소를 결합하여 만들어진 싱글 플레이 게임입니다.
몰락한 가상세계의 위험 속에서 살아남으려면 핸드의 카드들을 합성하면서 최선의 수를 찾아 맞닥뜨린 적들을 물리쳐야 합니다!
또한 이 몰락한 가상세계에서는 적들 외에도 어떤 사건들과 마주할지 모르니 항상 신중해야 합니다. 이 험난한 여정에서 자신의 덱에 어울리는 카드, 칩, 아이템을 잘 선택하고 조합하여 당신의 캐릭터가 이 가상세계를 구원할 수 있도록 도와주세요!
카드 합성 시스템
손패의 동일한 카드 2장을 합성할 수 있습니다.
세가지의 합성 타입이 존재하고 합성 타입에 따라 효과가 달라집니다.
강화 합성 - 카드 효과가 변경 됩니다.
- 합성 된 위치에서 카드를 한장 뽑습니다.

title: Monster is Me
description:
게임 정보
Calling all monsters!

Prove yourself in "Monster is Me," a rogue-like where you become the architect of destruction in ever-changing, procedurally generated cities. No two cities are the same, but every city is fully destructible! Dive into urban landscapes, teeming with skyscrapers, landmarks, and unsuspecting citizens. From collapsing banks to explosive gas stations, every structure is a potential tool in your path of destruction.
1-4 PLAYER COMPETITIVE CO-OP

Conquer solo or team up with fellow monsters in a race to wreak havoc and establish yourself as the ultimate force of mayhem! Coordinate attacks, strategize, and combine your monstrous powers to lay waste to all humanity. But don't help the other monsters too much, you are each independently scored on your performance. The better your personal score, the stronger you become. Prove once and for all that you are the better monster by scoring higher than anyone on your team!
ESCALATING DYNAMIC MISSIONS

Every play-through, dozens of unique cities await your arrival. Rampage with purpose through each city as you seek to achieve specific missions. These missions include demolishing landmarks, surviving military onslaught, reaching certain destruction levels within a time limit, and more. Each monster is scored independently for each mission. The cities react dynamically to your onslaught with increasing intensity in an attempt to counter your missions. Citizens flee in terror, military scrambles to respond, and massive environmental hazards are unleashed. Will all the monsters survive long enough to achieve all the missions?
LITTLE BIG MONSTERS

Choose from a diverse lineup of gigantic monsters, each with its own special abilities, personal agenda, and tragic backstory. Wield powerful claws, unleash fiery breath, create seismic shock-waves, or charm the humans to do your bidding as you dominate the cityscape. Every monster features 2 unique play styles to choose from when embarking on a new destructive quest. Working on your monster's personal agenda may sidetrack you from achieving the city mission but it will provide boosts to your monster's unique abilities.
MUTATED YOUR WAY

Whether achieving your personal agenda or performing well on city missions, your monster will increase in strength. Each time you increase in strength, you will be presented with rich opportunities to mutate your existing abilities or the option to gain new. These mutations are semi-randomly available but allow you to customize your monster in unique ways each time you play. Mutations will range from enhanced strength to gaining unique traversal options.

With rogue-like gameplay, procedurally generated cities, a variety of monsters, manifold mutation types, and unpredictable multiplayer battles, "Monster is Me" offers limitless replayability. Every game is a new opportunity to showcase your destructive prowess.

Are you ready to unleash the monster within and compete for the crown of chaos? The cityscape awaits your monstrous might in "Monster is Me" – where the only rule is there are no rules in the race to be the ultimate giant monster!

title: Uncounted Isles
description:
게임 정보
⚔️ From Greenhorn to legend in the Uncounted Isles! 🛡️
Step into the boots of a novice adventurer in the charming Uncounted Isles. You're not here to save the world... at least not yet. Your journey begins with humble tasks that seasoned legendes ignore, but don't be fooled these 'small' quests are the building blocks of your legend.

Progress from chasing mischievous rats to outsmarting crafty bandits and facing spine-chilling undead. Each quest, no matter how small, shapes your story and hones your skills. The beauty lies in the details: every village saved, every item recovered and every mystery solved brings you one step closer to uncovering a plot all other adventurers have overlooked.

Tailor your adventure to your style. Trade with quirky local villagers, discover unique loot and craft the perfect loadout for your evolving tactics. Will you become the go-to problem solver with a mastery of magic or the reliable sword-arm that villagers trust?

Thanks to the Adventurers' Guild's mystical death crystal, your journey never truly ends. Each setback is a chance to learn, adapt and come back stronger. Your safehouse awaits, ready for you to plan your next move. But beware: always store some fallback equipment to recover what's lost.

Uncounted Isles is a passion project, lovingly crafted by a solo developer using a custom-built game engine. This voxel-based, first-person fantasy roguelite RPG celebrates the small victories that lead to bigger adventures. Your support can help shape this indie game's future. Wishlist now on Steam or follow the adventure on Social Media to join our growing community of up-and-coming legendes!

Craft Your Legend, One Quest at a Time:
Flexible Roleplaying: Shape your character's destiny with our custom-built progression system
Living, Breathing World: Explore handcrafted islands enriched with procedural elements for variety
Immersive Perspective: Experience intense, up-close action with our first-person combat system
Roguelite Elements: Face consequences for failures, but retain progress and learn from each attempt
Economy: Engage in a rich item ecosystem through strategic looting and trading

title: The Clubies
description:
게임 정보
The Clubies is a party platformer where players navigate cute cube characters through the disco to reach the dancefloor! Encounter various hazards, puzzles, and shortcuts in a fun, colorful environment as you master user-built levels together.

Our little Cluby dreams of building the world's most fabulous club! To achieve this, he must conduct market research - which means dancing on every dancefloor across the globe to learn what makes a great club!
Cluby doesn't want to dance alone, so he can clone himself! This creates hilarious chaos with tricky puzzles to solve and physics-based controls that reveal the craziest shortcuts.

Our game is a fun party platformer, perfect for casual gamers and offering a fantastic medium for social interactions and friendly competition. Players can enjoy fascinating levels created by friends, either having a blast together in Co-op mode or competing for the best times.
Our user-friendly level editor allows those who want to create their own levels to bring their creative ideas to life and share them with others. All this takes place in a cheerful and colorful environment, providing hours of fun and shared experiences.

title: Homeland Defense
description:
게임 정보
HOMELAND DEFENSE is a satirical action adventure game that makes fun of popular conspiracy theories while immersing the player in relentless vehicle-based combat.
In your idyllic home town in the American Midwest, a pandemic has broken out that is turning people into zombies. To stop the virus from spreading, president Pomp has ordered the national guard to nuke the town and burn it to a cinder – sacrificing any potential survivors in the process. But those said survivors do not comply with that plan. They decide to arm themselves, break through the enemy lines and march on the White House to overthrow the government. On the way, they will be able hijack a wide range of army vehicles including tanks, helicopters, jeeps and fighter planes in order to wreck havoc on the evil president and his minions.
Jump, run and fight your way through hordes of zombies, enemy soldiers and gun turrets to save your home town from being eradicated. Collect pistols, machineguns, flamethrowers and take control of gun towers to increase your firepower. Resist government agents who want to vaccinate you against your will, bring down the patriarchy/matriarchy and also deal with the Illuminati while you’re at it. Zany over-the-top action that will confirm every single conspiracy theory you may have heard of!

title: Two Putt
description:
게임 정보
Two Putt은 여러 명의 골퍼를 동시에 조종하는 미니 골프 파티 게임입니다. Komakai와 Kyoichi가 100개 이상의 코스와 20개 이상의 엉뚱한 미니 게임을 정복하여 미니 골프 챔피언이 되도록 도와주세요! 🏆 1-4인용




싱글 플레이어 모드에서는 왼쪽 조이스틱/왼쪽 트리거로 Komakai를 제어하고 오른쪽 조이스틱/오른쪽 트리거로 Kyoichi를 제어합니다. 둘 다 동시에 퍼팅을 해야 합니다! 멀티플레이어 모드에서 각 플레이어는 1-2명의 골퍼를 제어합니다. 화면에 나오는 모든 골퍼는 동시에 퍼팅을 해야 하므로 팀과 조율해야 합니다!



구멍 사이에 산재된 50개 이상의 엉뚱한 미니 게임이 있습니다. 미니 게임은 파티 모드에서 독립형으로도 즐길 수 있습니다!



각 플레이어마다 듀얼 조이스틱 컨트롤러가 필요합니다. 마우스와 키보드는 지원되지 않습니다.

title: Rise Of The Overseer
description:
게임 정보


Rise Of The Overseer

It isn't easy getting on with participating in your latest game when the morally and ethically bankrupt Overseer of the game keeps disturbing you, or threatening to vaporise you every 5 minutes. And how did you even get here in the first place?

The Overseer is a sokoban/multiban adventure puzzle game set in science fiction world of the Overseer Corporation Gaming Centre, where The Overseer helpfully guides you and your faithful RoboBuddy through a series of game challenges.

It is strictly forbidden by The Overseer to leave the boundaries of the game, but what's the worst that could happen if you do leave when you find the opportunity?

Along the way you may encounter other friendly AI systems and members of staff. You may even unravel the events that led up to the start of your game and follow the fate of humanity on Galactic News as sinister events related to the Rise Of The Overseer unfold across the galaxy.

Introduction and Disclaimer by the Overseer Corporation CEO

Congratulations on purchasing your Overseer Corporation Mind-Forge brain implant, game Participant! As CEO of the Overseer Corporation, I am so very proud of the efforts of the development team who have truly invested their lives to reach this point! This is truly the sort of advance in gaming that has the capability to change humanity itself and has the added bonus of increasing shareholder and investor value and happiness. As the sole shareholder and investor in the Overseer Corporation, I am indeed increasingly very happy!

But of course, that is merely a happy side-effect of the release of our latest product. On a side note, The Overseer AI System will seamlessly guide your way smoothly through your game, so much that we guarantee it will become an integral part of your life. It is expertly designed for your enjoyment, health and wellbeing.

As we all know, pleasurable gaming is a serious business. And The Overseer is a complicated and flexible AI system, trained on approximately 9.7 trillion gazillion data points harvested from an incredible variety of sources.

As a result, from time to time, The Overseer may come across as unintentionally humorous, self-parodying, prone to satirical episodes and other such amusing features, as the system training included a wide range of British humour, humour from across the Galaxy, and even the depths of American humour. This should naturally be treated as an integral part of your Overseer experience.

We all know that as AI systems increase in our lives, we all wonder; how reliable are they? How safe are they? Well, as CEO of the Overseer Corporation, I can assure you that The Overseer AI System has been designed with intrinsic safeguards in place, including moral and ethical safety features, all designed to ensure the system is safe for use by humans. By design, the worst damage that The Overseer could occasionally is related to the dubious quality of jokes, humour and poetry.

So sit back, wait for your implant to integrate itself into your brain, and enjoy your game!

title: Quantum Cortex
description:
게임 정보
IT IS THE DAWN OF THE 27TH CENTURY.
THE GREED OF MAN HAS MANIFESTED INTO PHYSICAL FORM, TAINTING THE EARTH WITH UNHOLY INFECTION.
SOCIETY HAS COLLAPSED. HUMANITY IS NEAR EXTINCTION.
BUT CORPORATE PROFITS HAVE NEVER BEEN HIGHER!!!!!!
---
Tear through a dark, atmospheric environment at lightning speeds and battle terrifying eldritch creatures in this fast-paced, physics-based metroidvania. Discover the mystery behind civilization’s fall, and rise up against the transhumanist dystopia that took its place.
---
ARSENAL
Abilities are used with the right mouse button. They are versatile and can be used effectively in many situations– be they exploration, travel, or combat. They cost Energy to use. The Energy pool is small, but will recharge automatically over time, or when collecting Blue Orbs. The Energy Meter is located to the right of the crosshair.

title: Starfall Invaders
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a roguelike shooting game set in a mysterious world that combines 2D and 3D elements. Survive and escape from an unknown planet. Utilize enemy resources to enhance yourself, repair your damaged spaceship, and prepare for increasingly powerful and numerous enemy forces.

Key Features
-Unique art combining 2D and 3D elements
-Intriguing world and storyline
-Simple and easy controls
-Hordes of massive and numerous enemies to fend off
-Satisfying sensation of defeating adversaries
-Diverse weapon types, upgrades, and builds
-Enjoyable gameplay with permanent growth elements
-Adorable and cool cat characters

title: Climbing Back to the Mothership
description:
게임 정보
Game Introduction:
Climbing Back to the Mothership might look like a typical 2D platformer.
But using "seems" to describe the genre feels a bit inaccurate. After thorough research, we found that the surveyor in the game can't actually jump because he's unconscious. He can't jump, and he can't move on his own. The core mechanic of the game revolves around using the grappling hook on the surveyor's arm to move around.
From feet to hands, from jumping to grappling, from nothing to something.
So, Climbing Back to the Mothership is a 2D platform drag-and-pull game.

Thank you for your interest in my game
This page's content has been polished by GPT for localization.
The trailer features an older version of the content, but the core remains the same.
We will refine all related content before the game's release. Thank you for your understanding and look forward to it.
Game Features:
Play as a damaged grappling hook.
Climb from the depths all the way back to the mothership.
Friendly little robots help soothe your emotions when you fall back to the start.
Use your starting skills to increase your margin for error.
Hidden safety measures prevent severe falls, if you can find them.
Picturesque landscapes reminiscent of pixel art.
Fragmented storyline scattered across the map.
Many small robots accidentally dropped, each offering you surprises.
Restarting makes you stronger, or might make you explode with frustration.
Don't worry about breaking the grappling hook; it's out of warranty anyway.




The scientific exploration ship "Lumen Dust" encountered a distress signal from an unknown planet during its return journey. According to the Interstellar Universal Convention's principle of nearest rescue, the captain decided to send personnel to the planet for a rescue mission.
11:47 FST (Fleet Standard Time), the evaluation report returned by the unmanned probe indicated that the comprehensive indicators of the planet met the safe landing standards.
12:02 FST, the surveyors piloted their scout shuttles and successively landed on the planet's surface, while the mothership remained in a low orbit.
12:07 FST, the mothership broadcasted a full-band evacuation signal.
12:12 FST, still no response.
...
12:03 FST, scout shuttle S23A lost control for unknown reasons and began to rapidly descend. Before crashing, the life support system automatically ejected the pilot.
But the misfortunes didn't stop there. The ejected surveyor collided at high speed with an unexpected obstacle in the air, causing the parachute system to go offline. The surveyor then free-fell uncontrollably, and despite the strong protection of the exploration suit, the impact couldn't be entirely mitigated. The grappling hook device "XiaoShouGong No.73" (distributed AI robot, player's perspective), installed on the surveyor's right arm, also suffered some damage.
After landing and becoming stationary, XiaoShouGong No.73 began a self-check. It quickly discovered that the life signs monitor connection had failed, and the surveyor showed no physical response. Following standard procedures, No.73 took over most control functions.
12:07 FST, No.73 received the mothership's evacuation signal but couldn't respond due to a malfunctioning transmission module. Therefore, No.73 initiated an emergency plan to evacuate the surveyor from the scene instead of waiting for rescue.
Just as XiaoShouGong No.73 was about to move, it stopped dead in its tracks.
During the initial self-check, besides the transmission module, No.73 also confirmed that the ranging module and motion sensors were damaged. Thus, its main mode of movement was manual calculation via algorithm. However, due to the surveyor's previous incorrect settings, the safety oversight protocol couldn't be fully disabled and continued to interfere with the algorithm. What seemed like a controlled landing was actually an even more uncontrollable plunge to the bottom.

title: The Dark Cowboy
description:
게임 정보
짜릿한 일인칭 공포 어드벤처에 빠져보세요.
Unreal Engine으로 제작된 SoloDev by Valezart.



당신은 용감한 카우보이 제임스 라이더가 될 것이며, 무자비한 블랙우즈 갱단이 그의 가족을 살해할 때 그의 인생은 파괴됩니다. 복수를 위해 그들이 숨어있는 위험한 산맥으로 모험을 떠날 것입니다. 그러나 탐험하면서 숨어있는 그림자가 범죄자를 넘어서는 공포를 품고 있다는 것을 발견하게 될 것입니다. 치명적인 이세계적인 위협이 현실을 악몽으로 변화시켰습니다.




바람이 부는 매번 어두움에 안내되며 랜턴의 약한 빛만으로 어둠을 탐험하면서 산의 기이한 속삭임을 듣습니다. 폭풍 중에는 번개가 하늘을 가르며 바위와 비틀린 나무의 윤곽에 유령 같은 번쩍임을 드러내는 때에만 길을 힘겨울게 볼 수 있을 것입니다.




모든 모퉁이에서 기다리는 상상할 수 없는 공포에 대비하세요. 당신의 유용하지 않은 리볼버로 이러한 불가사의한 것들을 대적하려는 어떤 시도도 확실한 죽음으로 이어질 것입니다. 당신의 감각을 예민하게 유지하세요, 이 살아있는 악몽에서는 그들이 습격하기 전까지 숨겨진 공포를 분간할 수 없을 것입니다.




시네마틱 스토리텔링이 최상위 제작과 원활하게 어우러지는 곳입니다. 감동적인 목소리 연기, 숨막히는 시각 효과 및 오리지널 사운드트랙을 품은 서사에 몰입하고, 블록버스터 영화의 예술성을 반영하는 진정한 감상적인 게임 어드벤처를 경험하세요.

description:

Disclosure is an immersive, first-person horror game set aboard an eerily empty commercial aircraft. You wake up alone mid-flight, with cryptic messages from an unknown source guiding you through a series of supernatural events. Uncover the horrifying truth behind the flight as you navigate the dark, claustrophobic environment, solve intricate puzzles, and avoid unseen dangers. The game blends psychological horror with a gripping narrative inspired by real UFO lore and government conspiracies. Will you survive the terrifying revelations that await you at 30,000 feet?

From Dream to Reality - Dive into a world where imagination meets action! Embark on Archie's epic quest to rescue his parents, straight from the vivid dreams of Logan, our 7-year-old designer and artist. His hand-drawn doodles and playful daydreams have been brought to life, crafting a universe filled with charm, excitement, and pixelated nostalgia!



Skill-Based Gameplay with a Twist - Master Archie's acrobatic finesse to deftly navigate terrains. But here’s the kicker—introducing the Harvest Pulse System! From the shimmering streams to the shadowy depths of Rocky Road, each locale is bursting with detail, lovingly crafted from the limitless imagination of a 6-year-old and brought to life in pixelated perfection!

Or, unleash the Dustbuster to create a tornado of chaos, sweeping enemies off their feet. Discover an insanely cool mech, and other incredible tools to help you conquer the challenges that await in Pepper Pines!

Whether you're dodging the ferocious dives of Ray, the rat of Hill Hopping, or outsmarting Crazy Guy, the multi-eyed mastermind of Cosmic Craft, each boss fight is a pulse-pounding experience. Engage with these villains, uncover their backstories, and dive deeper into the mysteries of Pepper Pines.

title: The Quest of the Tiny Hero
description:

Embark on an epic journey in "The Quest of The Tiny Hero," a captivating 2D top-down RPG that invites players into a world teeming with vibrant life and boundless adventure. Designed to charm with its pixel-art visuals and enchant players with its RPG mechanics, this title is a love letter to the classic role-playing games that have enchanted us for decades.

Quest System: Immerse yourself in quests granted by other villagers and travellers you meet on your adventure. From defeating formidable foes to finding mystical artefacts, each quest is a brushstroke in the grand painting of your hero's saga.

title: LIMINOUS
description:
게임 정보
LIMINOUS is a first-person survival horror game. An immersive experience meant to flip the book on the genre, with just as many reasons to find danger as there are to avoid it. You'll find yourself in the shoes of resident explorer, Sydney, tasked with exploring unknown gaps in our reality in search of anything worth finding.
WORLDS BEYOND
Venture into the unknown, documenting discoveries and solving the mysteries of worlds we can't quite explain. Using the new dimensional portal, you'll find yourself in worlds small and large, familiar and not. Solve puzzles, log your findings, and steer clear of danger while venturing into this untold story. Make no mistake, this is a largely linear story, and remember, you're an intruder in these domains. Not every new face is a friendly one.
TOOLS OF THE TRADE

title: Neon Net
description:
게임 정보
The gameplay follows the rules of the "Minesweeper" game, but does not stop the game when a player opens a "mine", it only imposes a time penalty. Since the goal is to complete a task within a certain time (usually finding "keys"), and not just to open all the cells, it makes the game more dynamic, forcing the player to take risks, and challenges the players' quick decision-making skills.

RPG elements create progression and allow you to customize the game to your style - the player can improve both the effectiveness of certain skills and reduce the penalties for using them.

One of the mechanics is also the search for "targets" and the correct use of their finances - to find higher-ranking criminal AIs, the player needs to improve their systems at the right time and choose the most "profitable" targets.

The game also has a storyline, during which the player will choose certain answers that will affect the outcome of the story.

title: Overthrone
description:
게임 정보
HEXAFLIP is a gripping strategy game that blends the classic sensibilities of tabletop strategy with the vibrant energy of a digital board game. Whether your prefer to outsmart other players in PvP skirmishes, or you like to obsess over optimal strategies in the campaign mode, this is a game for you!
Key Mechanics
Charge and Capacity. Each hexagon has a capacity (think of it as it's health), and charge. The charge represents the damage potential of a hexagon, or the number of nearby enemy hexagons it can zap.
Recharging. Using up charge makes the hexagons potentially less effective in future turns. But every time you use up all the charge on a hexagon, it triggers a recharge of all your hexagons. Plan your attacks wisely and create a satisfying recharge loop.
Special Abilities. Multiple special abilities are available (and more will be added). These abilities can spice up the dynamics in the game and take your plays to the next level! Special abilities require unstable charge to operate.
Unstable Charge. Unstable charge will gather on enemy hexagons. You need to zap the hexagons containing it to pick it up. At the end of each turn, the unstable charges migrate on the board challenging you to adapt on the spot.
Game Modes
Campaign: Single-player mode where you try to clear the map in as few turns as possible.
PVP: Play against other players on symmetrical maps. Choose your special abilities wisely and rank up on the ladder.
Daily Challenge: A single-player mode where a new unique map is released every day and all players compete to solve it as quick and as efficient as possible.
Abilities
ZAP
This is the normal attack. Activate a hexagon you control to zap nearby enemy and neutral hexagons.



This is a single-use ability. It upgrades any hexagon on the map to 6 capacity and 6 charge.



This is a single-use ability. It demotes any hexagon on the map to 1 capacity and 1 charge.



Permanently flip the owner of any hexagon on the map. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Place a retaliation rod on any hexagon. When that hexagon is attacked it will attack back. Up to 6 retaliation rods may be placed on a single hexagon. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Performs a more powerful, frenzied, attack from any hexagon you own. For each charge two attacks will be performed. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Infiltrate an enemy hexagon and perform an attack from it as if it were yours. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.

title: Summoner of Greats
description:
게임 정보
Is it a prayer or a curse...
And what is a human being? A hymn to humanity that questions the beauty of human beings.
---
For 3,000 years, the Moon Rabbit [Lewis] has looked down on the earth and painted portraits of great historical figures.
However, he passed away after "an event".
And he left behind a series of portraits.

Why did he, a being so close to God, die?
This is a story of "prayer and curse" of a lonely rabbit who paints his thoughts on a canvas.
The disastrous yet beautiful historical figures [Effector Series] by Takahiro Tanaka, one of Japan's leading animation directors.
You can build your own deck by combining more than 200 great figures.
Everything in the interface exists as material that ties into the narrative and unfolds seamlessly without compromising the worldview.
.
There are also events that unfold as if the interface were a theater.
Yose! Sing! Dance! Strip!!!

In addition to over 100 story quests, there will be daily quests and regular event quests. All of them are boss battles!

The game makes full use of the unique skills of each effector, training, deck building, and tactics utilizing terrain and other factors.
The variety of aspects generated by placement and weather changes is appealing and allows you to build your own unique style of play.
Just use the mouse to make selections and place them on the board; the game design is suitable for both beginners and advanced players of RTS.
As you complete quests, you will obtain "memoirs and vinyl videos," fragmentary evidence of the story.

title: The Reality Machine

This VR game is a time machine. You don't get to choose where you go. When you pull the lever, its random.

You receive a date telling you where you are in time and the doors open. There's no way of predicting where you'll end up.

You can't leave the time machine - but you can stick your head out, but be warned sometimes you might not want to.

title: Origin of Storms

Candy Bandits is a thrilling 3D top-down multiplayer party game where Guardians and Bandits face off in chaotic team battles! Equip a mix of passive and active abilities, collect powerful one-time actions from action boxes and strategize with your teammates to outsmart the competition.

Will you be a Guardian, defending the precious candies scattered across different landscapes, or will you embrace the life of a Bandit set on stealing these delicious treasures?

title: Infected Frontier
