description:
게임 정보


Take on the role of a ruthless killer and complete a series of exciting assignments.

Choose your style
Throw yourself into the action, take enemies down by surprise or eliminate them silently.


Use various covers to efficiently move around the battlefield.


Face numerous enemy troops.

title: Wiblu
description:
게임 정보
Wiblu
"Unraveling the Mystery of Fire Tea"

Embark on an enchanting journey with "Wiblu," a captivating story adventure game inspired by German mythology. Winner of the Best Indie Game Prototype at the German Videogame Awards, "Wiblu" invites you to explore a world filled with mystical creatures, breathtaking landscapes, and a quest for a legendary cure – the elusive fire tea.

Key Features:
🔮 Immersive Storytelling: Join Wiblu, a young Hommlinger girl, on a quest through the fantastical world of "Waag" to find the cure for her ailing grandmother. Encounter magical places, forge new companionships, face old dangers, and unveil the mysteries of Wiblu's own past. The narrative promises an adventure straight out of a storybook – with a pinch of love and the creativity of our five dedicated developers.

🎶 Melodic Masterpiece: Immerse yourself in a unique musical experience as you traverse the realms of "Wiblu." The game's self-composed and handcrafted music draws inspiration from the Middle Ages and the Renaissance, featuring harps, flutes, guitars, synthesizer sounds, choirs, and orchestras. Let the bard's lament serve as a musical thread, intertwining themes that encapsulate the rich lore of "Wiblu."

🎨 Hand-Drawn Elegance: Witness the breathtaking artistry of "Wiblu," where every detail is meticulously hand-drawn. The unique and elaborate art style creates a visual feast for your eyes, turning the game into a living, breathing masterpiece.

🎮 Engaging Gameplay Mechanics:
Dialogues/Minigames: Immerse yourself in the story through interactive dialogues and entertaining minigames that sharpen your skills and enhance crucial content.

Key Items/Items: Solve puzzles and overcome challenges using a variety of items, each with its own significance. Key items can be reused, while ordinary items play a pivotal role in unraveling mysteries.

Stories: Explore hidden stories scattered throughout the levels, encouraging thorough exploration. Deepen your understanding of the game's lore and support worldbuilding by collecting these captivating snippets.

🔍 Discover Waag: Experience a seamless and user-friendly gaming environment with simple controls, detailed hand-drawn levels, and hidden items waiting to be uncovered. Engage with lovingly designed puzzles that gradually increase in complexity, keeping you captivated from start to finish.

"Wiblu" is more than just a game; it's an immersive adventure crafted with passion, creativity, and the desire to offer a truly memorable experience. Dive into the world of "Wiblu" and let the magic unfold.

title: Infernae
description:
게임 정보


A bullet hell game where dodging and cowering for your life will claim it. Fear is not shield, a lesson Asmus learned long ago. Will the lesson pass down onto you?
Play through a boss rush of increasingly challenging foes, and watch your game over count go up with each one. We are not responsible for bouts of frustration and indignation. Control your emotions, or they will control you.



A starwitch has been marked for death, and the duty of a memento mori is to carry out their deliverance. That's Asmus' story. But she has a story of her own too, and Lucine will make sure he listens to her if it's the last thing she does.
Lucine is one of several bosses that will be featured in Infernae. Each one has a story to tell, a secret between them that Asmus doesn't want you to know about.

title: Heavenstrafer
description:
게임 정보
Take control of Berith, a demon priestess ready to shoot her way through an angel infested Hell, in her crusade to hunt three powerful demons that have been corrupted by the angelic forces. Unleash your arsenal of four powerful guns and weave between them in order to string together stylish combos. And remember:
"It's not about size or speed, it's about technique."
Use all the weapons given to you
Earn COMBO RANKS by shooting with different weapons. Switching weapons allows you to shoot faster. Heal yourself by damaging enemies at a high COMBO RANK.
Augment your mobility with three different dashes
By DASHING at the maximum COMBO RANK you can slow down time, become invisible or create a powerful explosion.
Never stop shooting
Instantly reload all weapons by shooting with all guns at least once.
Every gun comes equipped with a main fire mode and an unlockable alternate fire mode. The Belial and the Purson are a pair of shotguns that compliment each other's damage, both with alternate shots that augment your mobility. The Ballista fires an explosive flaming bolt, setting enemies on fire and increasing the damage they take, and finally, the Asmodeus Opus is a revolver that deals high damage against dying enemies, redirecting your bullet and reloading all weapons on a kill.

title: Eternal Summer
description:
게임 정보
The release of a new mixed reality implant device, dubbed Eternal Summer, promises its users will experience just that.
When a solar storm hits earth the devices are catastrophically damaged, trapping users in their simulations.
Those who are still 'free' must now find their own ways to survive, as they band together into factions.

In this hex-tile turn based strategy game, you control your faction as you try to expand your control against opposing factions.
Some factions may be friendly, others are definitely not, but all have a story to tell about their version of the day the of great aurora.

title: CULT OF FLIES
description:
게임 정보
As you rush into a panic and dial 9-1-1, the operator begins to speak with you.
"9-1-1, what is your emergency?"
"There is someone outside of my house. I live in Durango, Colorado, just off of Route 550 at 6264 Berkha-"
Your phone line cuts. Your television flickers on, illuminating your face. The Channel 8 logo appears, the reporter starts speaking to the audience:
"A shocking story develops in Durango just off Route 550. A homicide case emerges from the rural home of the Grant family. 13-year-old Dennis Grant was found deceased with several stab wounds to the abdomen and his head nowhere to be seen. A blood trail leading to the basement from the living room shows that he was dragged, even having visible bruises on his ankles. His parents were also found deceased. His mother, Jennifer Grant, hanging by the roof of their front porch with burnt skin, and his father, James Grant, dismembered, scattered throughout the house. Dennis appeared to have tried to call the police, but the intruder cut the phone line just before he could finish giving the operator his address."
Your blood runs cold. You had thought your parents were safe upstairs, and just minutes ago, you had thought you were safe as well. You dare not look out of the peephole at the front door.
CULT OF FLIES is a puzzle horror game set in Durango, Colorado, in the 1980s. You play as a member of the Grant family, a prominent religious chain deeply rooted in the churches around the area. The oldest Grant family member, Bethany Grant, had died. Upon leaving her funeral, you experience several odd occurrences at the Grant residence, leading to a disturbing chain of events.

title: Marble Dash
description:
게임 정보
Marble Dash is the peak rolling experience! Try to complete the large variation of levels and become the best by competing against the world on the leaderboards! Play with or against your friends in the competitive multiplayer modes and choose to send them flying or prove you are the fastest.



Roll Around Each Unique Level From Easy to Impossible in Difficulty!
Compete Against Your Friends or Those Around The World in the Best Times!
Customize Your Marble and Collect All the Easter Eggs in Each Level!
Enjoy the Amazing Environments and Sound Track to Keep You Rolling!
Master Your Rolling Abilities to Become the Greatest Marble to Exist in Marble Dash.

title: Tales of the Laser Knights
description:
게임 정보
An Epic Journey... Full of Lasers, Explosions, and Ridiculously Good Fun!
Our young hero Zak – who’s certainly not your average farm boy – embarks on a quest to find the Ancient Orbs! These aren’t your average orbs, mind you. No, no – these are REALLY old, REALLY mighty alien gadgets scattered across the five known planets of the galaxy! They’re not just sitting there like some sort of galactic decoration. They’re packed with unimaginable power and the unnecessary complication of making Zak’s life way more difficult than it needs to be.
TALES OF THE LASER KNIGHTS
An Action-Adventure, Comic Sci-Fi B-Movie... with a Seriously Cool Laser Katana!
Controls? Twin-stick shooter style – you attack, you move, you dodge. It's so simple, it practically teaches itself!

title: Ashcroft
description:
게임 정보
It's 7 o'clock on a friday night. There's 600,000 zombies between you and the city limits. You've got one hour, before a nuclear bomb hits, turning the city and everything in it to ash.

Ashcroft is a Metroidvania inspired Platform Fighter in which you must fight against both time and zombies in a mad dash through city of Ashcroft, rescuing as many of your friends and family as possible, while punching as many zombies as physically possible.

Play as a variety of different characters, each with their own personality, fighting style and special moves, and fight (or sneak) your way through the diverse locations that make up the city - from Downtown Ashcroft to the Iron Works, then back to Suburban Hell and even the amusement park "Paulie's Pier".

Ashcroft features high intensity combat, acrobatic platforming, and all the zombies you can punch. There's a riveting Story Mode, a deadly and ultra-challenging Survival Mode, a local versus mode to challenge yourself vs computers or other players, it's got, more zombies than you can punch, and a handful of unique and fun characters to survive the apocalypse with. Plus, it's fully co-operative, so you and your friends can escape the city together!

title: 月詠に至る
description:
게임 정보
”Reach to Tsukuyomi" is an exhilarating 2D platform action game.
The player-controlled protagonist, Kaede, adventures through stages infested with ghosts.
Exhilarating Action
The player's basic actions consist of simple attacks, jumps, and dashes.
In addition, there are counters that can be triggered by hitting a well-timed dash in time with an enemy's attack, and long-range attacks with shurikens.

Numerous Enemies and Bosses
Various kinds of enemies appear in the game.
Each has its own unique attack method and characteristics, so it is necessary to adapt your strategy accordingly.

One day, the main character Kaede decides to return to her hometown, but what awaits her is a hometown occupied by Yokai (Japanese monsters).
In order to free her hometown from the yokai, Kaede ventures out on her own, only to be confronted by her childhood friends Sakura and Murasaki, who she grew up with. ......

title: Nightmare Fuels
description:
게임 정보
지금 위시리스트에 추가하세요!
Fuel's & Friends는 일인칭 공포 타이쿤 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 가스 스테이션을 업그레이드하고 탐험하여 비즈니스를 확장하세요!

1992년입니다. 여러분은 가스 스테이션 프랜차이즈 "Fuel's & Friends"에서 새로운 사업을 시작했습니다.
밤에는 가스 스테이션을 확장하고 침입이 없도록 하는 것이 여러분의 일입니다.
낮에는 죽은 친척의 컴퓨터를 조사하여 다양한 명령을 입력하여 정보를 얻습니다.
게임 소개:[[/u]/h2]



몰입형 시뮬레이션: 각 명령이 중요한 완전히 시뮬레이션된 컴퓨터 세계를 탐험하세요.
전략적 도전: 위협을 피하고 비밀을 해제하며 전략적인 의사결정을 통해 경쟁 상대를 능가하세요.
해킹, 생존, 정복: 해킹 기술을 시험하고 동적인 환경에서 생존하며 이 가상 세계를 정복하기 위해 노력하세요.

title: FrogLake
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the FrogLake

In this RPG you have to save your lake from drying up.
During your journey you will develop your special water powers and find better gear to move on.
The combat system of this game requires you to select 2 action keybinds every turn that you can perform
like:
Attack Jump Skill Item and Run.

Featuring:

Unique combat system
A big lake to explore
Lots of slippy friends to meet
Water based magic
Catching food with your tongue
Lots of sidequests

Not featuring:

A level system
Random encounters
A stable housing market
Auto saving (this is a good thing)

title: PushOver
description:
게임 정보
In Pushover, your goal is to push your friends off the platforms! In this local or online multiplayer couch game you can fight with and against up to 4 people (or computers) on a variety of different stages! Or you can choose to play in the singleplayer Champion Village to complete challenges and unlock new characters and worlds! With 2 gamemodes there is an endless amount of pushing fun!

Includes:
Multiple stages
chaotic items
Online or local multiplayer with up to 4 players
a single player mode to unlock new worlds and characters
Timed and Livestock gamemode
fun movement and pushing!

title: Rival Goals
description:
게임 정보
Meet new rivals and meet your real-life goals in this gacha-style visual novel filled to the brim with loveable characters and amusing story threads.

Rival Goals is a visual novel in which characters are unlocked by setting and completing customizable daily tasks by your chosen deadline. These tasks are meant for you to complete in real-life and self-report to each of your in-game rivals in order to unlock more story, new characters, customizable decorations, collectibles, and more.

You can even create your own custom rivals to hold you to your promises to build better habits!


Featuring:

-25 unlockable characters
-A custom character builder
-Hundreds of collectibles
-Amusing storylines and secrets to uncover
-In-game to-do list to help manage your tasks
-Stickers for decorating your in-game desk

Whether you've been meaning to drink more water, get better sleep, or spend a few minutes everyday working on that book you're (supposed to be) writing, Rival Goals can be the push you finally needed to make your dreams come true!

title: Convenient: Fiend
description:
게임 정보
Dig up graves to steal from the dead while you escape graveyard security and run from the legendary Oldlake Wendigo.
Gameplay:

Dig up graves!
Low poly PS1 style
Survive terrifying monsters
Discover hidden secrets
The continuation of Convenient


Survive

Quickly before security catches you. You're at the Oldlake Cemetery to loot graves and make some money. Find the gravestones with the names written in your notebook and dig them up while staying out of sight. If you are spotted, make quick decisions while being chased to survive. Find hiding spots and stay out of sight until the coast is clear. Security guards aren't the only thing you'll be running from so keep your eyes peeled.




Find VHS tapes around the graveyard to uncover the mystery hiding in the cemetery. Instead of watching VHS tapes, you live them. Solve puzzles and experience the story yourself. You may be a grave robber, but there's more going on here than just a few missing bodies. Discover the birth of the Oldlake Wendigo and how to stop it.



The origins of , the short horror game made by LunaApps.

title: Rune Golf
description:
게임 정보

Rune Golf is an immersive and contemplative golf game where you play as a solitary golf ball traversing the ruins of a forgotten civilization. Your exploration of these lost ruins will require precision, curiosity, and determination to reach the end of numerous levels! In Rune Golf, you can explore the levels as much as you like, but access to the final hole will close if you exceed the allowed number of shots for each level!

ADJUST the power and angle of your shots and navigate through the levels to reach the final hole without exceeding your allowed number of shots!

MODIFY your trajectory at any time: a slow-motion mode activates, allowing you to make extraordinary shots!

the levels without counting your shots, to identify and optimize your path, and discover hidden secrets and rewards!

with the small spirits that inhabit these ruins to uncover the secrets of this lost civilization.

from the beginning of the level with a simple touch until you find the best strategy.

title: Nyana
description:
게임 정보

Embark on Nyana’s journey to liberate her people in the 2D action-adventure Nyana. Armed with all the trappings one would expect from a metroidvania, Nyana also includes a unique base-building feature that is core to the overall experience.


Nyana’s people have been hunted and subjugated by the will of their magic-wielding Masters. But, in the deepest bowels of this world exists a safe haven hidden within an ancient structure and filled with liberated members of Nyana’s people.

As Nyana liberates more of her people in her journey, they will find their way to this safe haven and bring their own resources to help it continue to flourish. New abilities in Nyana are tied to specific buildings that can be placed in the HUB. And new buildings can only be unlocked by liberating more of Nyana’s people throughout the sprawling world.

Save your people. Build your safe haven. And learn new and crucial abilities that will aid you in your quest to uproot the rule of the Masters once and for all.


Ancient civilizations have risen and fallen in the world of Nyana. Along her journey, Nyana may discover more about these civilizations and even unlock secrets that may have been left behind and forgotten by time.


The liberation of Nyana’s people will not be enough. And so the herculean task of uprooting the Masters’ Imperium will also fall on her. The Imperium stands on the shoulders of five key individuals. Eliminating these five individuals will result in the crumbling of the Masters’ society as they know it.


You are not a hunter in this world. It is best to use enemies to traverse past them as you collect resources. However, through the use of custom-created spells, you can combat and execute those who would stand in the way of your vengeance.

As Nyana liberates her people and grows stronger in the process, she will obtain the power she needs to face off against each of the five key Masters, including the head of the snake, the Imperator.

title: Break The Line
description:
게임 정보
이는 무작위 요소를 포함한 전략적인 타워 디펜스 게임입니다.
전술 전투

title: Brickhaven
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Brickhaven
Brickhaven is the very city you and your gang fight to thrive in. Explore the busy streets, check out the shops, and muster up any juicy prospects along the way to help build your criminal empire.
The Empire
-Recruit your members right off the street
-Setup protection rackets, drug fronts, money laundering schemes, and much more to help maximize your profits
-Send members to defend your hard earned rackets and businesses in order to set a physical footprint in the city
-Be as hands off or on as you want, almost everything is able to be automated through delegation
Rule the Streets

title: Midnight Run
description:
게임 정보
Midnight Run is a casual RPG game where you play as Matt, a regular guy who was just picked to perform a late-night food run of good eats for his friends. There's only one problem. Matt doesn't have much cash, and items he has to get isn't cheap. Not to mention, he doesn't have a car so walking through the city at night is his only choice.


Navigate through the city while finding ways to either earn more cash or get free food. Keep in mind, the city is a strange place at night, so Matt has to be on his guard as he works on completing his food run. Trying to avoid oncoming traffic? No problem. Did you find yourself feeding hungry ghost? Yeah, that's about right. A Giant sewer roaches staring at you as if you're its finest meal of the night? Sure, why not! It's all good when you're doing a Midnight Run.


Game Features:
Multiple endings
Lots of side quest
Tons of Achievements
Hours of gameplay
Game replayability
Encounter the P.D.P. (Powder Doughnut Police)

title: Veiled Whispers
description:
게임 정보
Enter the Abandoned House: A Haunting Horror Puzzle Experience

Welcome to a chilling adventure set within the confines of an abandoned house, where terror lurks in every shadow. Immerse yourself in a spine-chilling journey through darkened corridors and ominous rooms, all captured from a unique bodycam perspective.

Key Features:

Solve Sinister Puzzles: Explore the eerie interiors of the abandoned house and unravel intricate puzzles that test your resolve and intellect.
Perpetual Dread: Navigate through a relentless atmosphere of fear as you encounter unsettling phenomena and unearth the house's dark secrets.
Immersive Bodycam View: Experience the horror firsthand with our distinctive bodycam perspective, intensifying the suspense and realism of every heart-pounding moment.
Fear Awaits: Brace yourself for an atmospheric horror experience where every creaking floorboard and flickering light may spell doom. Can you survive the night within the haunted confines of the abandoned house?

title: BLYX
description:
게임 정보
Blyx는 픽셀 아트로 그려진 매력적인 2D 플랫폼 게임으로, 퍼즐, 클래식한 플랫폼 액션 및 강렬한 전투로 가득 찬 마법의 세계를 탐험하도록 플레이어를 초대합니다. 이 게임에서는 Blyx의 여정에 참여하게 되며, 그는 다양하고 독특한 세계에서 자신의 목적을 찾아가려고 노력합니다.

Blyx로서 까다로운 퍼즐을 풀고 플랫폼 사이를 뛰며 대형 보스를 포함한 다양한 적과 맞서 싸우게 됩니다. 각 레벨은 도전과 놀라움으로 가득 차 있어 매번 새로운 모험을 약속합니다.

유쾌한 치즈 왕국을 방문해보세요. 여기에는 신비한 과거를 가진 슬픈 치즈 왕이 주범으로 기다리고 있습니다. 또는 강력한 용에 의해 지켜지는 부자들의 도시에서 여러분의 기술을 시험해보세요.

Blyx는 흥미진진한 이야기와 재미있는 게임플레이를 결합하여 액션-어드벤처 게임을 사랑하는 모든 이에게 꼭 한 번 시도해봐야 할 게임입니다. Blyx의 다채로운 세계로 뛰어들어, 그의 참된 목적을 찾아가는 데 도움을 주세요

title: Into the Depths of Despair
description:
게임 정보
Into the Depths of Despair (ItDod)

I woke up in a room, but I was never asleep. The air is heavy, carrying a scent I can’t recognize. I see with eyes that are not my own, feel a body that doesn’t feel like mine.

The walls seem to breathe, the shadows shift when I’m not looking. There’s no sound except my own breathing—I am alone. Or am I?

Something is keeping me here. I don’t remember how I got to this place, but I know there must be a reason. Is there a way out? Or am I sinking deeper into despair?

title: Dark Age Gladiator
description:
게임 정보
Dark Age Gladiator is a dark fantasy world where you live as a gladiator fighting in the arena for wealth and fame.
The opponents are not limited to humans, but also include a variety of demons.
In addition to fighting in the arena, players can also receive requests to exterminate demons and search for various treasures in ancient ruins to gain wealth that cannot be obtained in the arena, as well as to explore unknown worlds.

As you continue to win as a gladiator, you may find yourself fighting not only against your own city, but also against gladiators from other cities. And in the end, you will make a name for yourself as the strongest gladiator in the empire.
Main Features
.
Extensive growth system
.In addition to improving a character's basic abilities through training, player gladiators can acquire various weapon proficiencies, various types of attack skills, etc., allowing them to develop a variety of unique strengths.
Various equipment to make the character stronger
.Gladiators can wear various types of weapons and armor, which not only change their appearance but also give them strength according to their weapons.
Some armors are finely crafted and some are magic-enhanced, and by wearing powerful equipment, gladiators are able to face even the strongest enemies.
Competing against a variety of gladiators
.Each of the gladiators you will face off against has a unique fighting style and ability, and you will be required to fight according to your opponent.
Find your opponents' openings and face off against powerful foes.

title: Gaula Survival
description:
게임 정보
Gaula 생존은 다음을 수행해야 하는 생존 게임입니다.
[목록]

자원 수집
사냥
적과 싸우다
도구, 무기 등을 찾아보세요
생존에 도움이 되는 각종 아이템을 수집하세요
쉼터를 건설하세요.
마지막으로 루프를 다시 시작합니다.

Gaula Survival에서는 죽음이 결코 멀지 않습니다.

title: Arcade Forever
description:
게임 정보
Arcade Forever is a 3D vertical space shooter. This is an action game in which many enemies, obstacles and different weapons guarantee great fun. If you like fast space action, this is the game for you.
Info/Features:
Vertical space shooter.
3D graphics.
Sci-fi environment.
25 levels.
Upgrades.
No additional purchases required.

title: Alonecats
description:
게임 정보
We are excited to introduce our new puzzle game in the hidden object genre.



Your task is to find all the cats in the location. You can rotate/zoom the scene and interact with the environment to find all the hidden animals.



Key features:

- over 100 hidden cats
- 5 different locations
- simple puzzles

title: Aisla
description:
게임 정보
Play as Aisla, a woman who wakes up with no memories in a complex on Mars.
Your objective is to explore the environments and discover who the character is and what situation she is in.

Key Features:

- Narrative Driven Adventure
- Cinematic Cutscenes
- Mind Map: Keep track of your discoveries
- Collectables Objects
- Licensed Indie Soundtrack & Original Soundtrack
- Hand-painted mixed with semi realistic visuals

title: Paranatural
description:
게임 정보

온라인에서 다른 플레이어와 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 계약을 완료하며, 다양한 초자연 사냥 장비를 사용하여 유령을 식별하세요.
식별된 유령의 유형에 따라 독특한 퇴마 의식을 수행하세요.
주의: 퇴마에 실패하면 파괴적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다.
현재 16가지의 독특한 퇴마 의식이 있으며, 출시 후 더욱 많은 의식이 추가될 예정입니다.


Paranatural은 이전에 본 적 없는 독창적이고 동적인 유령 시스템을 사용합니다.
50가지 이상의 동적 반응 기반 유령 이벤트로 이루어진 전에 없던 무서운 경험이 언제나 가까이에 있습니다.
유령은 당신의 모든 움직임을 학습하고 적응하여, 자신의 능력과 환경을 활용합니다.
동적 유령 시스템은 모든 기본 게임 위치뿐만 아니라 커뮤니티가 만든 사용자 지정 위치에서도 자동으로 작동합니다!


유령 사냥의 여정 동안 유령 사냥에 특화된 애플리케이션이 장착된 특별한 전화기가 제공됩니다.
이 애플리케이션들은 영구적으로 전화기에 남아 있으며, 레벨 업할수록 게임 내 상점에서 구매할 수 있습니다.


Unreal Engine의 MetaHumans를 사용하여 완전한 기능을 갖춘 캐릭터 커스터마이저로 외모와 의상을 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.
또한 계약으로 벌어들인 돈을 사용하여 창고 내부를 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.

title: Primland The Magus -プリムランド　ザ　メイガス
description:
게임 정보
Children disappeared, adults turned into carrion...
A certain isolated island that turned into hell
Collect "relics" sleeping on the island and acquire skills.
Take on mysteries and powerful enemies using a variety of actions!
A dark fantasy 2D action game by Magus, the girl in black.

Dark and rich 2D action all drawn with pixelart!
Enjoy the action of the player charactor ”Magus” with classic and easy-to-understand controls!
Revive the attacking opponent and use it as a trigger for jumping through walls, etc.
Don't just defeat the enemy, use a variety of skills to move forward!
The dramatic truth surrounding the girls Mags, where guilt, anger, and sadness intertwine.

title: Pilot Light
description:
게임 정보
When all of the stars in the sky go dark, it becomes your mission to venture to the planet at the center of the universe and re-illuminate the pilot light. Your only guidance to your goal is the light from the engine of your rocket.

Navigate through tight spaces and dodge dangerous obstacles placed by peculiar enemies coming from the darkness. One wrong touch to your rocket will spell certain doom.
Key Features
8 Worlds
80 Levels
8 Bosses
Challenge Modes
Voice-acted cutscenes

title: Decktamer
description:
게임 정보


Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?

In Decktamer, you'll encounter creatures that have adapted to their strange environment: the abyss. Rumor has it that anyone brave enough to reach the bottom of the giant crater will find great fortune. But watch out, as you dive deeper, the creatures only get more and more bizarre and dangerous...
ROGUELIKE DECK-TAMING
In this game, cards are not simply handed out to you, you have to tame your enemies to add them to your deck!
But be careful, when one of your creature dies, the card is gone forever!

STRATEGIZE EACH TURN
Every turn, each one of your cards can use a move. Try to think about the optimal play to win your battle in this turn-based combat system! Will the turn plan out as you expected?

The Abyss is filled with mutant creatures that possess abilities they shouldn't normally have. Use that to your advantage and transfer abilities from one creature to another to create unique and devastating combos!



Only one question remains...

title: Cube Guy
description:
게임 정보
Gameplay!!
Cube Guy is a relatively simple 2.5d platformer game, that currently takes around 1 hour to fully complete.
It currently features 3 worlds, all with different themes, and unique level items to allow for fun level design that doesn't feel repetitive!

Dash!!
Unlock the dash and be able to fly through the levels, destroy walls and discover secrets along the way!

Boss fights!!
Some boss fights mix it up, featuring a turn based battle system, where you have to attack, and dodge the opponents attacks!
Main Features

title: Maize Mace Maze
description:
게임 정보
탐험
방어력을 향상시킬 수 있는 독특한 전리품이 무작위로 생성되는 층입니다.



수확
초목, 토양, 인간이 만든 쓰레기에서 자원을 추출하여 강력한 기계를 제작하세요. 채소 분대를 활용하여 방을 발견하고 지형을 파헤치세요.



기계를 제작해 복잡한 미로를 만들고 해충을 몰살시키세요. 바닥에는 방어력을 향상시킬 수 있는 독특한 전리품이 무작위로 생성됩니다.



새로운 기계 등을 잠금 해제하기 위해 탐험 중 발견한 호기심을 가지고 다시 등장하거나 더 깊이 파헤치세요!

title: OCRPG
description:
게임 정보
OCRPG is an Arcade Styled Indie RPG game where you play as two unlikely friends to help uncover the secrets of the gauntlets. Defeat each of the 8 Gauntlet Guardians and those who work under them. Take on 24+ enemies with unique mechanics, gimmicks, and personality. Unlock up to 8+ allies who synergize in unique ways, and see hundreds of lines of funny and unique dialogue.

title: Drench
description:
게임 정보


Water is running empty on Earth. Corporations have gone to the stars for answers. The UN Earth Resource Security Council has granted the Starwell Water Corporation control over a privatized galaxy. However, this has become home to a new galactic battlefront.

Explore alone, or with friends. DRENCH offers various tools, and modes to interface with the Starwell galaxy.

Within the main Drench open world, players can control a multitude of vehicle types to traverse the galaxy. With seamless ground-to-space flight, players can explore and colonize different planets. Both vehicle and ground combat is an option, with various tools weapons, and resources to scavenge or trade for. Players can build their own base, and harvest resources through the colony-building system. There are also quests, companions, and secrets to uncover.

There are other game modes in Drench that players can engage with. This includes arena-style deathmatch, Space Battles, capture-the-flag modes, KING OF THE HILL, and large-scale control point battlefront maps. There are many more modes planned to arrive in the future!

Play custom party modes such as Builder Chaos, and our own take on 'Spleef'!

Wave based PVE, and build-to-survive modes are also waiting for you in 'DRENCH'!

And of course, LAN multiplayer is an important part of Drench's design philosophy, so the game can be played in the apocalypse (or just in a cozy LAN party)!

If this sounds up your alley, feel free to Wishlist the game, and request to join the Steam Playtest today!

title: Silicon Wasteland
description:
게임 정보
Following a worldwide catastrophe, a lone android wakes up years later to the wind and rain of the quiet apocalypse. Damaged, low on power, and having limited memories, she sets out into the nearby ruined city in search of answers.

SILICON WASTELAND is a kinetic visual novel set during the twilight years of humanity, and follows the wandering android Silica, as she explores the beautiful and sometimes frightening wonders of the world in a small quest to discover her purpose.

Featuring music from the creators of the Tunic Soundtrack, Lifeformed and Janice Kwan, as well as music from WastedMeerkat and Vidboy.

title: Chicken with Robot Legs
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Chicken with Robot Legs!
You are a chicken that wakes up in an unknown place. Not knowing who you are or why are you there you know one thing, you gotta get out of there!
Explore a 2D pixel world with a lot of secrets and collectibles, the chicken doesn't stop moving forward, you'll need to use your abilities and environment to traverse and find a way out.

Features
- the first game that combines the Runner and the Metroidvania genres a "Runner-Vania" game.
- explore alternate paths to uncover secrets and collectibles.
- upgrade the chicken with abilities that help you reach for new places.
- never stop running, use the scenery and abilities in neat ways to get your way around.
- collect various kinds of items to get rewards or open secret paths.

title: Rising Sands
description:
게임 정보
Set in a post-apocalyptic world, as ex-military soldier Daku, discover the secrets of the sand and reveal how the world has gotten to this state. Uncover the many groups formed after the war, from the government corporation EcoSurge to the eco-terrorist group Rising Sands, and many more.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Rising Sands features grounded third person shooter gameplay mixed with fantasy. Heavily inspired by classic RPG titles alongside modern Shooters, the ever changing environments constantly being tampered by The Gemini's rising sand make for a unique experience for every player. The captivating story along with these elements lead to gripping boss fights that push Daku to his limits.



Rising Sands features complex characters in a world where no one truly knows who is right. See all sides of the story and discover what really happened after the war.

title: John Fox
description:
게임 정보
John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor.



But the evil big toad, decided to make an army of John Fox clones.
To lure the protagonist into the lab. The big toad's minions kill Milo, John's pet.
John Fox rushes in pursuit of the harmful toad and encounters an army of clone frogs, which flooded the entire city.

If the big toad manages to defeat John Fox, the world will be doomed to misery and chaos.



Features:

title: BOUNCE GUN
description:
게임 정보
Bounce off the walls and shoot enemies
Select upgrade and debuff
Choose your path

title: Path of the Tank
description:
게임 정보


Path of the Tank is an action-RPG where you can only play as a tank. But why? Why a tank and nothing else? Find out in this linear, story-driven and easy to pick up game that may remind you of a different time.

Gameplay features:

-Modernized old-school fighting in real-time
-Simple yet deep skill tree, with 5 powerful late-game options to freely choose
-Hunger mechanic; scavenge for food to survive!
-Wide variety of enemies from different fronts
-Upgradeable armor, potions and weapons
-Tons of secret areas that may contain more than simple loot
-Basic experience earning system. Defeat enemies and complete missions to gain xp!
-Lots of conversations with differents characters, some with a philosophical questioning.
-Locations to travel like dark crystaline caves, villages, ruins, dungeons, and, mostly, lushful forests!
-Long boss fights (you're a tank, you won't do much damage!)



Story:

Something went terribly wrong. Nature is completely altered; earth itself is coming to life, animals are scared and the spirits are restless. The balance of existance itself, which is key for the stability of life has been altered beyond recognition. It's not the first time that this has happened, and it won't be the last. The price that the rational and even the non-rational beings are paying in this world is heavy. Will you be able to stop this disaster? Of course you can. Otherwise no story would be told. But you're here to discover a lot more than that. Remove the nightmares of the innocent beings in this land, tank. Travel the path. Eat the path.



There's a lot of places to discover while traveling the path. Perhaps you could dig out some information out of your past too...? But most importantly...



Can you challenge oblivion itself?

title: AREA 8
description:
게임 정보
A science fiction and horror adventure-action game with first-person and third-person gameplay perspectives.
As an operative, you are assigned to a remote research facility known as Area 8, a place so secret that even its name is hidden from the public. What awaits you within this facility are experiments that push the boundaries of science and nature, mind-bending creatures, and fragments of an intricate mystery. But beware—once you step inside, there’s no guarantee of coming back...
If you dare to unveil the mystery, add Area 8 to your wishlist now!

title: BoxSim
description:
게임 정보


In BoxSim, puzzling and platforming combine to test your creativity and challenge your wits. As you descend deeper into the meta-box, you will discover unique boxes to help you navigate levels and solve puzzles.

During your journey into the meta-box, you'll encounter:
* Over 50 levels across multiple worlds, including optional hard mode challenges
* Movable boxes with unique abilities and interactions
* 3D platforming enhanced by box physics



Discover boxes such as:
* Bomb boxes: Explosive boxes that propel you through the air.
* Power supply boxes: Boxes that produce electricity to modify the environment around you.
* : Boxes that launch you upward based on the height from which you fell.
* : Boxes that can be pushed around but not lifted.
*

title: TransmuTowers
description:
게임 정보
How To Get Involved Pre-Release
Wishlist, follow, and join our Discord for opportunities to play in early playtests and help craft the game. We would love to get a small core group of players who love the tower defense and bullet heaven genres so we can make a great game that fits your tastes!
Explore the Campaign
Welcome to the world of Valber! In TransmuTowers, you will explore Valber through a variety of maps, each with their own resources, challenges, and monsters to defeat.
Build a New City Each Level
Establish a foothold on these maps, starting with a small camp and building up to a flourishing base where you can generate resources and build up your strength. Always restarting your cities in games? Our 20-30-min stage-based gameplay will allow you to try numerous base layouts and strategies, and reward you for it!
Defend against the Hordes
Each stage will feature new monsters to conquer, requiring the use of different strategies to beat the highest difficulties. Unlock new towers and effects rapidly as you play the game.
Core Features:
Defend multiple scenic locations throughout the campaign
Roguelike Meta-progression for unlocking new strategies
Real-time strategic decision-making, No pre-defined monster paths here
Dozens of towers with hundreds of upgrades
Randomized powerful augments each level to keep each game fresh
Ability to play solo or with friends

title: Symphony Stride
description:
게임 정보
Build powerful combos in this two-character roguelike deckbuilder. Craft a deck as you progress through adventures and follow an immersive storyline told using hand drawn comics!


This game features a unique mana system that elevates your decision-making to the next level. When one character plays a card, the other character gets one mana. However, mana comes in different colors! Play the right cards in order to unlock stronger ones in your hand!


Explore a unique experience every time you embark on a run. Choose any two characters to form a team, unlocking new potentials from each!


Join our heroes in their journey through a story told using fully colored comics.

title: Attribute2
description:
게임 정보
This is a multiplayer fun and casual third person versus game. You can not only destroy your opponents with the weapons in your hands, but you can also modify the properties of almost all objects in the scene to improve your chances of winning. This game offers a variety of maps, gameplay, and props. It also has a currency system for you to upgrade.
In the game you can:
Defeat your opponents using different weapons.
Modify the size, quality, voltage and other parameters of the items in the map to gain an edge
Get coins to upgrade your weapons and characters.
Use various skills such as moving items and creating items to make your own fortress.
Assisted aiming gives everyone an equal start
Split up your team to achieve maximum advantage

On the game modes you can:
Customise game modes
Create your own maps.

title: Skate O'Clock
description:
게임 정보
Skate O'Clock is dynamic, action, skateboarding game in retro style.
Win the race against time by collecting coins through multiple levels.

title: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
description:
게임 정보
«Permanent: Hope & Vacuum» is a disturbing first-person psychological horror indie game with adventure, puzzle, platformer, dungeon crawler and action gameplay.

This is a one-person development, so please let me introduce the game to you. Thanks!



Discover a story that will take you through a world that is as terrifying as it is intriguing, where you will encounter numerous obstacles and irrational challenges that will test your skills as a player.



Your main objective is to unravel the mystery behind your memory loss and discover all about the strange world you have woken up in after a long and surreal fall.

To do this, you'll have to defeat creatures called «Reks», solve all sorts of puzzles, overcome dungeons, use platforming mechanics, and face a variety of disturbing situations that will always leave you with more questions than answers.



Fortunately, with the help of the , you will have access to various special abilities to defend yourself, control fire, alter gravity... These skills are acquired throughout the game and will help you fight the and progress on your journey.

"But remember, is the only thing that matters. In , is more than a word. It is the very life of the character, the key to his entire story, and also the currency for obtaining documents from the that will help you better understand the LORE of the world.

Your adventure begins as you fall down a sort of energy cliff until you land in a room straight out of your worst nightmares.



From this point on, you'll be alone and confused, but unfortunately for you, .

.



It's best not to give too much away so that you can discover it for yourself, but the subtly and progressively told story will always keep you guessing, and when it's all over (if it ends) you'll understand why .














"Hi, I'm David Oliver, the only member of DOgames, a new indie studio based in Madrid (Spain) and the developer of . I'd like to introduce you to the amazing 3D fantasy world I'm creating with all my love and passion.



As an old-school gamer, I have always dreamt of creating a game capable of transporting players to another world and etching the experience in their gamer memory.

I'm working on every aspect of the game with care and attention to detail. From the puzzles, to the soundtrack, to every hidden corner, ensuring that every player will have an unforgettable experience.

I am excited to share that the project has been in full development for around a year now, but I need all the help I can get to fully realise the plans I have defined. Any kind of collaboration will be greatly appreciated; together we can make this game even more special!

title: Starstrike
description:
게임 정보
Starstrike is an action packed space shooter. Take command of powerful ships and battle through sectors of space while you find new weapons and alien technologies. Improve your ship until you can take on entire fleets! Or die, upgrade, repeat.
Gameplay Features
Single-player roguelike action
Detailed ship damage. Every meter of a ship can be destroyed. Shoot off enemy weapons or engines to cripple them. Or overpower them with withering fire and watch their ship shatter.
Choose from multiple ships with different tactical loadouts and playstyles.
Advanced ship systems including teleporters, minelayers, and shield reflectors are available to bolster your offensive and defensive capabilities.

title: Nimillion - The last expedition
description:
게임 정보

‘Nimillion’ is a fun yet challenging physics-based, rocket ship simulation adventure located in a ‘Metroidvania’ style open world. Fly your ship by controlling only its thrusters. Acquire new ship abilities: a grabbing rope, short boost, shield and more. Fine-tune your ship’s hardware to adjust thruster forces, fuel consumption and more. With the help of upgrades and tuning of your rocket ship, you must rely on your skills to explore your surroundings navigating through difficult terrain, environmental phenomenons, physics puzzles and platforming challenges while avoiding hostile entities.
ACQUIRE NEW ABILITIES

Rope tool, booster, 0 gravity and more!

Prepare for tough boss fights

Pilot your rocket ship carefully going through winds, waterfalls, sandstorms, gravity fields, vegetation and more

Use gravity, recoil, force fields and other physics-based features to your advantage

title: Puzzled Hive
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to "Puzzled Hive", a simple-styled puzzle game set in a beehive. In this game, you will take on the role of Meo, exploring mysterious places with the help of Noth to uncover answers. Will you choose to leave?
Demo Version
Currently, full controller support is not available (UI cannot be controlled with a controller).
We have completed the Demo (Version 0.2), which includes:
• A basic art style has been established, with all materials hand-drawn, giving a simple and clean overall style.
• Mechanism of switching between multiple floors.
• Explore with your companion Noth.
• A variety of puzzles created with multiple mechanisms.
Full Version Prospects
Due to time constraints, the map design of Demo 0.2 does not meet our expectations. The official version will include more puzzle mechanisms, enriched maze puzzles, scenes with diverse styles, more NPCs, and a completed storyline. If you like the adorable Meo and Noth, or if you love playing 2D puzzle games, please don't miss it!
Words from the Developers
Hello! We are Player Links Players (PLP, which means "drifting bottle" in Chinese), a studio currently working on our first indie game. Although there are still many shortcomings at this moment, it's just the beginning. In the official version, we will do our best to create an interesting game! And special thanks for Vira Lee, who created bgm for Puzzled Hive!
Contact us
We will welcome any idea or suggestion. You can find us via:
• Bilibili: 深名五介是在下（will update my developing progress here）
• QQ group: 930475923
• Email: 1163684623@qq.com/shenmingwujiegojiu@gmail.com
A picture of me with Meo and Noth drawn by my friend EZ to celebrate the demo launch!
Thank you for supporting, and we are looking forward for your experience in Puzzled Hive!

title: Menes
description:
게임 정보
Step into the enigmatic role of Menes, a celestial being without memory, thrust into a desolate realm filled with ancient secrets and relentless foes. As you traverse unforgiving landscapes, you must unravel the truth behind your mission, uncover forgotten powers, and confront the dark forces that threaten to undo the fabric of existence itself.
MENES combines intense platforming with the punishing challenge of a souls-like adventure experience. Navigate diverse prison realms, each filled with unique perils and foes—from cunning guardians to massive, elemental beings. Hone your skills, master tactical combat, and piece together the mysteries that bind the realms together.
Will you survive the trials and discover the truth about the origins, or will you fall to the shadows lurking in the desert and beyond?

title: The Shadowed Rune
description:
게임 정보
당신은 위험으로 가득한 잊혀진 탑에 도착했으며, 탈출할 방법이 없습니다. 당신의 유일한 기회는 탑 꼭대기에 올라가 룬 유물의 힘을 사용하여 저주를 푸는 것입니다. 마이아와 다른 탐험가들이 저주받은 탑의 비밀을 밝히는 것을 도와주세요!
The Shadowed Rune은 솔로 또는 2인 협동 모드*로 플레이할 수 있는 도전적인 로그라이크 게임입니다. 룬의 힘을 결합하여 새로운 주문을 발견하고 탑을 올라 저주를 푸세요. 친절해 보이지 않는 적들과 마주하게 되고, 원소의 힘을 현명하게 사용해야 하는 퍼즐도 있습니다. 각 층을 지키는 보스들에 대해 언급했나요? 그것들은 시작에 불과합니다...
*로컬 협동 멀티플레이어는 최소한 하나의 연결된 컨트롤러가 필요합니다.
주요 특징:
총알 지옥 액션 요소, 퍼즐, 도전적인 보스가 있는 독특한 로그라이크 모험.

title: Hack Deep
description:
게임 정보
The game is a cyber-space infiltration game that supports up to 4-player cooperation. In this game, players step into a futuristic cyberspace filled with technological wonders and dangers. Their mission is to infiltrate target locations, steal crucial items, and successfully evacuate, all of which require close cooperation between players.
This game not only provides players with thrilling gaming experiences but also encourages teamwork and communication among players. Each player assumes a different role with unique skills and abilities, making each game a fresh challenge. Some players might excel at hacking security systems, some might be adept combatants, while others could be stealth and theft experts. Only through clever strategies and coordinated actions can missions be successfully completed.
The cyber-space in the game is brimming with high-tech gadgets and challenging enemies. Players need to utilize various tools and skills to evade surveillance systems, bypass security personnel, and complete objectives without raising too much attention. At the same time, players must constantly watch out for the safety of their team members and support each other in times of crisis, ensuring everyone evacuates smoothly.

title: Agama versus Bugs
description:
게임 정보


In the heart of a bustling city, in a quiet corner of a certain apartment, there is a small but full of wonders world - a terrarium. This is where a certain hungry agama lives. Take part in the adventures of a lizard who has an unusual passion for bugs.

A 2.5D platform game offering many different worlds (terrariums) filled to the brim with bugs, but also with traps!
Explore the terrarium
Track down and attack unaware victims by surprise, and if they see you, chase them because they will run away!
Find the lost eggs hidden in all the terrariums.
Travel between terrariums through magical vents.

title: Luminastadt
description:
게임 정보
It is a relaxing building game. Enjoy the joy of creating something with no management, no battles and no wrong answers.
Relax to chill vibes and escape to a world that feels alive. Create a warm, inviting atmosphere with plants and animals.
Use your creativity to place objects and voxels to customise the world.

title: Gravewatch
description:
게임 정보
GraveWatch is a horror game that will take you on one of the scariest experiences of your life. You will play as Daniel, a desperate man trying his best to support his ill daughter. After losing his wife in a horrific accident and getting fired from his job, Daniel is at the end of his wits and decides to become a grave robber, which leads him to a new chapter of his life, his fiancee Sara. Together, they form an unlikely bond, ready to take on whatever comes their way...
however...
Their newest expedition doesn't go according to plan, as they are about to face hell on earth...
Features
Immersive atmosphere: You have no weapon or way to defend yourself. You must rely on your instincts to escape the most horrifying scenarios. Hide, run or die!
Play as Sara: While Daniel is the main protagonist, you will also play as Sara, his fiancée and partner in crime. This way, you will get to experience the story from 2 different perspectives, whenever they are separated or working together as a team.

title: An Unfinished Game
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Unfinished Game™ Testing facility! As our new tester, you will have to make your way through a series of unexpected experiments in this first-person adventure. Small puzzles, platforming, meta gameplay and a group of silly NPC awaits you in this unpredictable factory.

The goal? Succesfully finish all tests so that we'll finally be able to release this "Unfinished Game" of ours!

One thing for sure, expect only the unexpected in here!



What you will find:

Simple puzzles
Platforming
Physics based elements
Other testing bot eager to talk with you
Some bugs (voluntary..?)
Collectables
Easter eggs
Unintentional features
And of course, silliness

title: Planet Surf
description:
게임 정보
Far beyond the lands of the silly humans lies a brave Alaskan family of penguins. The youngest penguin, by the name Pepiño "Mac & Cheese" Flipperman, is by far the most clumsiest of them all. Pepiño is easily distractable and always daydreaming of hot tubs and soft pretzels. Pepiño sometimes becomes so lost in thought that he wanders far away from his home, and travels the far reaches of the universe with nothing but his floppy penguin mind. One day, Pepiño found himself in a slippery situation. To save himself from drowning in the arctic, Pepiño closed his eyes and once again drifted far away. Only this time, he took his flappy penguin body with him, unlocking his innate penguin ability to literally open wormholes in space-time. Pepiño arrives in a world built by his penguin ancestors long ago. This world allows Pepiño to master his abilities, so he can one day return to earth, climb out of the arctic sea, and finally lay waste to the human species. (Penguins #1)

Parkour through 20+ checkpoints, each with unique challenges.



The path of the penguin is not always clear.



Carefully move your mouse through narrow passageways. Any contact with walls or ceilings will reduce your speed!



Seomtimes you'll have to surf along slanted surfaces and launch yourself off to reach the next obstacle.



Some checkpoints include ramps and launch pads that boost your penguin far beyond average penguin speeds, pushing your reaction time to Its limit.



Watch your flippers! They might get stuck in holes. Also, watch for holes.



The later checkpoints include many rapidly rotating objects for added difficulty!



You may encounter other penguins but they are only there in spirit to provide moral support on your long journey.



Also there is secret cat room.

title: Unihorn
description:
게임 정보
Unihorn is a 3D platformer full of adorable unihorns - unicorns, where you play as one and your goal is to reach the sky in this vertical and magical tiny open world.
The climbing will be challenging yet rewarding as you will get one the best views ever and meet other fellow unihorns.

Customize your character with one of 18 variants and make friends with others. You never know if it will come handy on your way up.

Unihorn will make the youngest audience smile and the older generation will feel right back at their childhood. Casual difficulty with no penalties for falling down ensures zero frustration gameplay!












Gameplay:
- move with WASD and jump with space
- flap your wings with SHIFT, but beware - you can't fly for long!
- overcome obstacles and keep climbing up
- the goal is to reach the sky
- talk with other unihorns and uncover the heartwarming story

title: Neon Village
description:
게임 정보
Neon Village is a deck-builder game that combines "match-3 puzzle" and "roguelike" elements. Gather unique residents and create your own neon village!
Deck Builder
Collect hardworking residents, wild animals, helpful machines, and enticing pieces. Combining pieces correctly can trigger explosive synergies!
Items to Aid Village Development
Use items when you're struggling with bank payments! Unexpected combos might occur!
Gameplay and Streaming Welcome

Monetization is also acceptable.

title: Kinetic Response
description:
게임 정보
You are part of the Kinetic Response sent to Apollyon, an intrusive celestial body which has entered the Solar System and is about to render all interplanetary communication impossible. Other factions are vying for control of the icy death world, so it is up to you to destroy them using the "Modular Artillery Carrier and Recon All-Terrain Vehicle Number 2" you are entombed inside of and uncover the planet's secrets. Unfortunately Apollyon is riddled with mind-ripping anomalies, so instead of risking your vulnerable nervous system by using your biological senses, you will have to use your radar and on-board sensors to know what is happening on the outside.

title: Alien Rush
description:
게임 정보
갑자기, 라임 외계인들이 나타나서 모든 곳에서 지구인들을 사로잡기 시작했습니다. 선수들이 뛰는 지구방위군 특수작전팀은 이 결정적인 순간에 임무를 맡깁니다. 그들은 라임 외계인의 점령지 깊숙이 침투하여 부상자를 구조하고, 정보를 수집하고, 저항의 전환점을 찾습니다. 로켓 점프와 파워 해머를 사용하여 라임 외계인이 설정한 다양한 함정을 돌파하십시오. 세상을 구하기 위해 아슬아슬하게 앞으로 나아가세요! 이 게임에는 흥미진진한 스토리 애니메이션과 스릴 넘치는 보스 전투도 포함되어 있습니다. 최고의 게임 경험을 달성하기 위해 게임은 여러 브랜드와 유형의 게임 패드
시간은 생명이다. 앞으로 나아가는 것을 멈추지 마세요!
["에이리언 대시"의 게임 기능]
로켓 백팩, 파워 해머, 구조 사다리 등 다양한 실용적이고 효율적인 도구를 통합합니다. 레벨을 통과하는 모든 장을 극복하기 위해 유연하게 전환하고 사용할 수 있습니다.
팀원들은 라임 외계인이 점령한 지역의 함정을 뚫어야 할 뿐만 아니라 제한된 시간 내에 본부에서 요구하는 여러 작업을 완료해야 합니다.
도시, 바다, 기지, 우주, 라임 행성을 포함한 다섯 가지 환경이 있습니다. 레벨은 독특하고 반복되지 않는 방대한 양의 콘텐츠로 설계되었습니다.
[용감한 팀원들이 앞으로 돌격]
이 게임은 1-4명의 사용자를 위해 동시에 로컬/온라인 플레이를 지원합니다. 친구 초대를 통해 온라인 체험에 참여할 수 있습니다.
[미션을 염두에 두고 실패하지 마십시오]

title: Dissimilar
description:
게임 정보
Dissimilar blends together semi-open exploration, a narrative laced with mysteries, and an engaging turn-based battle system.
Amelia expected her evening to be perfectly ordinary. What she did not expect was for her best friend to hack her automated car and bring her against her will to the Haven, the ancient castle her family used to holiday in when she was a child.
As Amelia seeks to understand why she was kidnapped, she finds herself forced to participate in a mysterious game; a game of unknown rules and goals, which will lead her to walk the Haven's storied halls and uncover secrets long buried by her family.

title: Quantum Beast
description:
게임 정보
Quantum Beast focuses on rumble fighting that you need to fight against massive enemies ALONE. So if you are confident of your power, then go for it.
Gameplay Elements:

Cool Fighting Style
Kick the robots in the ass!
This is the core mechanic that you can counter enemy's attacks to blow them in the air. And after that, a heavy strike kick could teach then a good lesson.


Throw them toward the wall!
Hit the enemies back. When they hit the wall, the additional stamina damage could stun them more easily.




Shoot or explode, your choice.



Weapons and resources are spread in the whole area. Those little things could help you pass through the challenges.

title: WANKO WANKO ADVENTURE
description:
게임 정보
Setting:
The mutation came suddenly.
A mysterious virus attacked everything, transforming everything into a square shape.
Buildings, creatures, even dogs.

You are a dog that has been transformed into a square.
You must go deep into the resort hotel to find your lost family and solve the mystery.


How to Clear:
The door to the hotel room is sealed and you are locked in,
The door to the hotel room is sealed and you are locked in, but if you clear all the squares scattered around the room, the door will open and you will be able to move on.


Controls:
The strange floating paddle on which the dog rides can be operated in various ways!

It can push a large number of objects like a bull tozer,
or swing it like a tennis racket to send things flying far away,
Sometimes they collect things in one place and sometimes they roll them around.

The objects are moving with physical behavior, so you can control them intuitively as if they were right there, and everyone can enjoy the game with a refreshed and exhilarated feeling.


Hotel:
Scattered objects vary from room to room.
Black pollutants are burned in the incinerator, or the luggage of travelers is taken to the collection station,
mysterious precious metals in a collection device, sometimes bold, sometimes subtle.

This new beautiful world combines the retro architectural tones of the 70's with the poly-poly, shiny CG expressions of the 90's.
What lies behind the facility? Will dogs be able to meet their families?
Operation Doggie Doggie is a fun adventure action game with intuitive controls.
autokwd: WANKO WANKO ADVENTURE,ワンコワンコ大作戦

title: Tunnel Baby
description:
게임 정보
On one rainy morning, Steve found a baby in a utility tunnel.
Explore, Survive, and Find Your Way Out
Tunnel Baby is a surreal horror adventure where you must navigate a strange and eerie world. With minimal heads-up display and user interface, immerse yourself in a variety of unsettling environments as you search for a way to escape by solving puzzles, fighting enemies, and exploring environments.
Defend Yourself
Armed only with a lead pipe and a flashlight, Steve must fend off extradimensional horrors and hostile creatures. You must fight to protect yourself and get the mysterious baby back to his mother.
Trapped in a World With Seemingly No Escape
What begins as an emergency repair job turns into a nightmarish struggle for survival. After discovering a baby in the utility tunnels, down-on-his-luck civil engineer Steve Wilkins finds his mundane life upended. Each door leads to a new, unsettling location, revealing that this is no ordinary tunnel but a portal to a series of bizarre and dangerous dimensions.
A Variety of Environments and Stories
Traverse through abandoned high schools, foreclosed homes, empty offices, and more, each with its own unique story and history. These places, once filled with life, now stand empty and mysterious. Uncover the hidden tales and subplots that add depth to Steve's journey and the overarching cosmic mystery.
Unravel the Mystery
Steve learns more about this strange world through:
Disk cartridges containing games that reveal more about the world
Conversations with otherworldly beings
Scattered notes and documents revealing the fates of the people who once occupied these spaces

title: MOONY:Black_Lotus
description:
게임 정보
Reclaim Your Corrupted Memories
Dive into a captivating world where fragmented memories await discovery! In this side-scroller adventure, navigate the remains of a once thriving civilization and piece together your scattered past. Between classical jump-n-run and puzzle solving, you have to keep a close eye on your surroundings. Explore the depths as you uncover forgotten stories and concealed corruption. On your journey, you must face the truth about your past life while reclaiming the essence of yourself.
You Are Not Alone
Make your way through this hostile world and challenge yourself with uncovering it's secrets. Along the way you'll meet enigmatic strangers - use their powers to navigate the environment on different ways. Learn how to walk through solid steel bars or see in the dark. Can they aid you on your journey? Remember, every light casts a shadow.

title: The Realm
description:
게임 정보
Story
The player lost in a Labyrinthine village in another world is looking for a way out alone.
You explore the village from a first-person perspective and find the exit.
There are many creatures lurking in the village. All of them are terrifying creatures you've never seen before.
Will you be able to leave the village safely?

System
This game is a walking simulation game, and all you have to do is walk in the dark village.
The controls for this game are easy, just grab your flashlight and keep walking and look for exit.
You can have an experience like you're actually in a village of horror.

title: Alice - Island Adventure
description:
게임 정보


Embark on an enthralling adventure with Alice as she sets out on her much-awaited vacation, eagerly anticipating a well-deserved break from the monotony of daily life. Excitement courses through her veins as she boards the plane, her mind filled with visions of relaxation and exploration in exotic locales.

However, fate has other plans in store for Alice.

What begins as minor disturbances soon escalates into a series of inexplicable events that plunge Alice into a whirlwind of chaos and uncertainty. The once-promising journey quickly morphs into a harrowing ordeal as Alice grapples with the unsettling realization that something sinister is afoot.

Amidst the chaos, questions swirl in Alice's mind. Are these disruptions mere coincidences, or is there a deeper, darker force at play? With each passing moment, the mystery deepens, drawing Alice deeper into a web of intrigue and danger.

title: Uanamon: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
The war continues. The enemies have become stronger. We must become stronger too - now there is a secret weapon in the game...
We immerse ourselves in the world of the Uanamon, learn about their traditions and rules of the world. Kill your enemies and restore the world of the Uanamons!
A roguelike-survivor game.

title: Pitchks and Daggers
description:
게임 정보
How far will you go to keep your crown?
Pitchforks and Daggers is a branching court politics drama where every choice matters.
 As King Henry of Elander, you must navigate treacherous lords, scheming family members, and angry peasants- all while trying to secure your kingdom’s future.
This is a game of difficult decisions. Every action has consequences, shaping the fate of your rule and the land you govern. Consult your court, weigh your options, and decide carefully.
 Features:
A deeply branching narrative with multiple endings.
A web of political intrigue, betrayal, and war.
High-stakes choices that impact the story.
Replayability-see the different paths your rule could take.
 The Story:
King Henry has no heir- his beloved wife, Mary, cannot bear children. Meanwhile, his uncle, King Harold of Ervin, challenges his claim to the throne.
The kingdom teeters on the brink of war.
Your choices will shape the fate of Elander. Will you secure your legacy- or lose everything?

title: MEMORYLEAK
description:
게임 정보
Do You Have What It Takes Kid?
Get ready to dive into MEMORYLEAK, an extraordinary FPS adventure like no other! Explore diverse dimensions in 2D, 3D, and VR, all set in a gripping, narrative-rich world of 2000s Texas. MEMORYLEAK isn’t just a game – it's a groundbreaking journey through time and reality, designed to captivate and thrill.
Why MEMORYLEAK is a Must-Play:
Embrace the future of gaming with MEMORYLEAK, where cutting-edge technology meets compelling storytelling. Developed with Unreal Engine 5, this game is a stunning visual feast with a heart-pounding storyline.
Varied Gameplay Dimensions: Jump between intense FPS battles, explore immersive VR worlds, and enjoy captivating 2D gameplay. MEMORYLEAK offers a gameplay experience for every style.
Engrossing Storyline: Set against the backdrop of Lampasas, Texas, MEMORYLEAK's narrative is inspired by real events, woven into an engaging and thought-provoking story.
Stunning Visuals: Experience the beauty of Unreal Engine 5, with breathtaking graphics, detailed environments, and a world that feels alive.
Interactive World: Every corner of MEMORYLEAK is crafted for maximum immersion and interactivity, making you feel truly part of the game.
Explore, Engage, Enjoy: With each dimension offering its unique challenges and delights, MEMORYLEAK promises endless hours of fun and exploration.
Key Highlights:
A unique blend of 2D, 3D, and VR gameplay.
A story that's as engaging as the gameplay itself.
Gorgeous graphics that push the limits of realism.
A living, breathing game world waiting for you to explore.
Sound and music that pull you deeper into the experience.
Ready for an adventure that will redefine how you think about gaming? MEMORYLEAK is waiting for you. Join us on this unforgettable journey, and let's push the boundaries of gaming together!

title: Amadeus: A Riddle  Thee ~ Episode 1 ~ Waltz
description:
게임 정보
Story
Play as Amadeus, a young werewolf struggling to understand his condition, as he navigates a tale woven by Witches. He is equal parts desperate and determined—how can one reclaim agency over themself, when afflicted by a curse that steals it from them every time the moon Aska draws full?
Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee is a narrative game heavily inspired by Umineko When They Cry thematically, and Professor Layton aesthetically. Gameplay is a blend of pure Visual Novel scenes + Point-and-Click Adventure scenes. The story is linear, and will be told in 5 sequential episodes.
Episode 1 ~ Waltz is coming soon. The demo is completely remade as of November 27, 2024 with a host of new mechanics, art, music, and story.
Demo Features
20-40 minutes of playtime
5 scenes (2 visual novel scenes + 2 point-and-click scenes + opening cinematic)
3 detailed, hand-drawn location backgrounds to explore
Opening cinematic cutscene
8 inked character portrait expressions
10 original music tracks, including 2 tracks with multiple dynamic layers
Point-and-Click controls with unique cursor icons to indicate player interactions
Alternate Hover-and-Spacebar control scheme for players who have difficulty with mouse click
Toggle for auto-scrolling text with adjustable appearance speed and delay time between textboxes (+ instant text speed option)
Backlog of previously-read text + diegetic "glossary" for story reference
autokwd: Amadeus: A Riddle  Thee ~ Episode 1 ~ Waltz

title: Consult Me Bee Opening A Snack Shop
description:
게임 정보
You plan to do a startup about snack shop consulting.
Take out the camera to shoot short videos to get orders.
Open the computer to provide consulting services for each snack shop consultation order and receive payment.
The revenue will be used to obtain more information to provide more accurate counseling, and to pay for the rising rent.
Try to make more people rich overnight before you go bankrupt!
autokwd: Consult Me Bee Opening A Snack Shop

title: Capyverse Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Experience a fast-paced Roguelike as an enlightened capybara, where every decision shapes your journey. Discover new worlds, gain allies, and master unique abilities to save the capybara universe from looming threats. Face evolving challenges for a fresh, exhilarating playthrough as you explore, strategize, and unlock secrets in the multiverse.
You’ll step into the paws of Capy, the sharp-witted leader of a futuristic capybara civilization.
Unleash powerful allies to aid you on your journey, each with unique abilities to help you conquer the challenges of the multiverse.
Play as Moody, the baby hippo, unlocking new abilities and attacks to conquer the multiverse!

title: Doodle Deities
description:
게임 정보
Doodle Deities is a roguelike deck builder that is all about creating powerful synergies, discovering new treasures and unlocking bosses to play as. Never run out of content again with a simple editor that requires no programming and full Steam workshop integration. All the content in the game was made with the built in editors, thus anything can be changed!
Do you like moddable games? We do as well, we built two editors into the game. The normal editor for people with no programming knowledge which can add most kinds of content like cards, bosses or factions to the game. We got full steam workshop integration and anything you make can be used in multiplayer with your friends!
Then we got the advanced editor that can add anything to the game! The entire game was written in this editor, even the normal editor was written in this editor. Add new mechanics, add features to the normal editor or do a total conversion. Your imagination is the only limit here!

title: Wandering Monolith: Rogue TD
description:
게임 정보
방랑하는 모놀리스는 로그라이크, 타워 디펜스 게임으로, 덱 빌딩 요소가 포함되어 있습니다.



각 플레이는 다음 단계로 나뉩니다:
타워 소환 - 전략적으로 전장에 타워를 배치합니다.
보드 확장 - 결정할 때마다 보드가 성장하고 변화하는 것을 관찰하세요.
핵심 방어 - 침입하는 적으로부터 어떠한 비용을 들여도 핵심을 보호합니다.
업그레이드 선택 - 타워를 강화할 수 있는 업그레이드를 신중히 선택하세요.
반복! - 매번 새로운 도전과 함께 끝없는 게임플레이를 즐깁니다.
타워
적에게 우위를 줄 수 있는 타워를 선택하세요. 6가지 공격 유형과 해당 타워를 이용하여 적의 약점을 이용할 수 있는 방어를 구축합니다. 많은 업그레이드가 전략적 위치를 보상하므로 타워의 배치를 계획하세요. 공격 범위를 증가시키기 위해 높이의 이점을 활용하세요.

보드
모든 게임은 보드가 절차적으로 생성되고 사용자의 결정에 맞게 조정되기 때문에 독특합니다. 게임이 진행됨에 따라 적의 경로는 더 길어지고 여러 번 분할됩니다. 게임 플레이에 영향을 줄 수 있는 중립적인 구조물과 각 보드 세그먼트의 높이도 각 보드 조각마다 무작위로 설정됩니다. 같은 맵을 두 번 플레이하지 않을 것입니다!

그들의 세계를 방어하는 적의 파도를 막아내세요. 각 게임은 절차적으로 준비된 적 세트를 특징으로 하며, 그들의 방어 유형과 특수 능력을 보여줍니다. 적의 약점을 이용할 수 있도록 덱과 타워를 현명하게 선택하세요. 보스를 포함한 3가지 독특한 적 가족과의 전투가 기다리고 있습니다.

각 웨이브 후에는 덱에서 하나의 업그레이드를 선택하세요. 다른 모든 옵션은 일정 시간 동안 폐기되므로, 그것들을 다시 덱에 섞기 위해 비용을 지불해야 합니다. 게임이 진행됨에 따라 특정 타워로 플레이하는 방식을 변경할 수 있는 더 매력적인 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하세요. 같은 타워를 서로 가까이에 건설할 때 추가 속도를 선택하시겠습니까, 아니면 게임에서 이 유형의 타워가 하나뿐일 경우 큰 보너스를 선택하시겠습니까? 이러한 결정과 더 많은 흥미로운 결정이 덱을 구성함에 따라 기다리고 있습니다.

게임을 마칠 때마다 다음 게임을 위해 새로운 적과 보스 세트가 선택됩니다. 이러한 도전에 맞서기 위해 여러 덱을 준비하고 실시간으로 업데이트하세요! 30일 동안 승리할 수 있습니까, 아니면 방어자가 다른 세계로 도망치도록 강요할까요?



---

title: Rune Defender: Dwarven Defense
description:
게임 정보
Use the day to construct powerful towers and walls to fortify your stronghold. But as night falls, you face hordes of enemies hell-bent on breaching your defenses.
Can you withstand the onslaught?
Prepare your Defenses

Build the ultimate fortress, never to be conquered


Upgrade your defenses to emerge victorious
Survive the night
After nightfall, your fortress will be put to the test. Hordes of undead will come at your walls.


You can use various magical abilities to support your towers against the enemy

title: Enemy Metal
description:
게임 정보

2.5D ROGUELITE SHOOTER WITH UNIQUE GAMEPLAY AND A KILLER SOUNDTRACK

Easy to play yet difficult to master, Enemy Metal features unique starships and vibrant planets. Destroy enemies to unlock new starships and planets and gather crystals to power up your starships.

Battle for Survival
Begin your campaign on Planet Aureus and fight to survive with unlimited time. Compete against players around the world with a global leaderboard on each planet.
Battle against Time
Progress and discover new game modes on Ignis, the Planet of Fire and Glaceus, the Planet of Ice with limited time and increased damage. Battle the mysterious enemy in a race against time in the final challenge on Arcana, the dark moon.

Reach high levels on each planet to permanently upgrade your starships and unlock exciting new planets and starships as you defend the Sunstar System. Gather crystals to restore health and energy and increase your speed, firepower and shields.
Complete achievements on each planet to earn permanent boosts for all your starships.

title: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox
description:
게임 정보
Steel Runner is a VR vehicle crafting sandbox game using physics.
Create your own unique Runner(vehicle) by combining various types of blocks, then ride it to enjoy free exploration, adventure, and combat in an open-world environment.
Game Play
In this vast open-world, you will spawn with a small runner that you are initially given.
Use your runner to chop down trees, gather ores, and fight enemies to collect blocks, modifying and upgrading it to aim for the ultimate runner!
At times, you may want to switch to a different runner, or your runner might get destroyed by enemies.
But don’t worry, as long as you have the materials, you can always summon your runner from the saved blueprint.
Create various amazing runners and make this vast open-world your own!
Design and Construction
Runners can be created by combining 1 x 1 m blocks.
Create a vehicle body, attach tyres and... you're ready to move!
autokwd: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox

title: Cemitério São Sacramento
description:
게임 정보
About the game


In "Cemitério São Sacramento", horror mixes with humor, creating a unique and immersive experience. 

The game relies on a fear that gradually grows, keeping players attentive to every detail to unravel the dark mysteries that surround the place.


Situated in a quiet country town, you move into a humble house you found on the internet. The detail they didn't mention? The house is next to a cemetery! At least the rent is cheap.


As you adapt to your new routine, explore every corner, interact with the environment and experience strange and unexpected events that will transform your everyday life into an intriguing supernatural adventure.

Have complete freedom to explore the world your way. Do you want to unravel hidden mysteries or just live your daily life? The choice is yours. Every day, the house changes, revealing new secrets and tasks that need to be completed.

Interact with common objects, eat something, watch TV, or just pass the time. But don't be fooled by the apparent normality. Over time, your dreams will become darker, sleep paralysis will become more frequent, and what was once familiar will take on a sinister tone.

Every decision you make will shape the course of your story, leading to different endings. Fear will grow subtly, mixed with an unsettling feeling that something is always lurking.

title: Panic In Store !
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Panic in Store!

As a supermarket employee, you will be required to go from store to store, carrying out short missions for the store chain that employs you. You will have to put the right cardboards (cereal, game, fruit, etc.) in the right aisles (cereal, games, fruit, etc.) while paying attention to the obstacles that will get in your way in this game casual but nervous.
Be a good employee!

Advance from level to level, obtaining more and more stars in order to show the world your skills as a supermarket employee!
Watch out for customers and random events that are there to get in your way.
Beware of the storm!

Random events may occur during your missions: slippery puddles, inverted movements, increased number of customers in the store, level plunged into darkness. You will need to understand these events and how to defuse them, without losing sight of your main objective.
A unique apartment!

As you complete your missions during the various levels of the game, you will unlock furniture and accessories to personalize your apartment.
A fabulous look!

Become a true fashion victim by unlocking various clothes and outfits as you progress to make your games even more fun!

title: Skyt
description:
게임 정보
This game is a arcade block placing puzzle game added with some Tower Defense mechanics and strategy.
Build and defend your fort, with your minigun and defenses against massive amounts of enemies and survive until the last wave.


Build a fort! Stack physically simulated tetromino blocks on top of eachother to build forts high up in the sky. But don't let the blocks fall down or your fortress will collapse! The more blocks you have the more defenses you can maintain, so keep buying new ones.



Tear them apart! Shoot the incoming airships with a minigun to destroy them, before they explode infront of your tower and ruining your carefully placed blocks. Fight against ranged cannon airships, which shoot at your tower where it is most sensible, or ballons which attack your tower by letting bombs fall from above.



Build Cannons in the sky, to defend your tower against the airships, or boost your economy by building windmills, so you can maintain or expand the defenses you've built.

title: Loki's Revenge
description:
게임 정보
"오랜 세월 아스가르드 신들에게 죄와 속임수로 갇혀 있던 로키가 탈출하여 복수를 시작했습니다! 로키는 충성스러운 괴물 군대를 풀어 왕국을 공포에 떨게 하고, 노르드 신들로부터 통제권을 빼앗으려 합니다. 좋아하는 신으로 싸워 로키와 그의 군대를 물리치세요!
로키의 충성스러운 군대를 물리치세요

드라우그, 오거, 늑대 - 이들은 모두 로키를 위해 싸우며 반드시 막아야 합니다! 거대한 몬스터와 보스의 무리를 물리치세요.
레벨 업하고 강력한 업그레이드를 얻으세요

적을 물리치면 XP가 떨어집니다. 충분히 모아 레벨을 올리면 3개의 강력한 업그레이드 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다! 일부 업그레이드는 통계를 향상시키고, 다른 업그레이드는 새로운 공격 방법을 제공합니다. 궁극의 신을 만들기 위해 최대한 많이 수집하세요!

신들은 죽지 않습니다! 죽거나 미션을 완료한 후, 얻은 XP로 영구 업그레이드를 구매할 기회가 주어집니다. 신들의 통계를 향상시키거나 각 신에게 고유한 업그레이드를 선택하여 선호하는 신을 더욱 강하게 만드세요!

각 지도는 수작업으로 설계되었으며, 절차적 생성이 없습니다! 각각의 지도에는 강력한 업그레이드가 숨겨져 있습니다. 찾으면 향후 진행을 위해 업그레이드 풀에 영구적으로 추가됩니다.

title: Streamer Content: a simple mechanic
description:

In the midst of it, he reaches his limit and, after rage-quitting, decides to embark on a journey of self-discovery to find out who he is and what his position is in the world and the universe.
