title: Manludo 2
description:
게임 정보
You wake up on an alien space station. In this expansive sequel, every decision you make shapes your journey. Will you seize control of the station, flee to unknown territories, ignite a galactic conflict, broker peace, aid your newfound companions, or pursue riches? The choice is yours.

Engage in the unique game called 'Manludo'—a hand game of rock, paper, scissors—to challenge and outsmart the station's alien inhabitants. Success in these contests can elevate your status and influence within the station, unlocking new paths and possibilities.

Gameplay:
Experience a richly branching narrative in this game. Replay it many times. Simply press the spacebar or click to progress through the dialog. When faced with a choice, click on the corresponding button to determine your character's fate. Navigate through complex interactions and pivotal decisions to craft your unique story amidst the stars.

--- Esperanto ---
Vi vekiĝas sur ekstertera kosmostacio. En ĉi tiu vasta aventuro, ĉiu decido, kiun vi faras, formigas vian vojaĝon. Ĉu vi prenos kontrolon de la stacio, fuĝos al nekonataj teritorioj, komencos galaksian konflikton, intertraktos pacon, helpos viajn novajn kunulojn, aŭ ĉasos riĉaĵojn? La elekto estas via.

Partoprenu en la unika ludo nomata 'Manludo'— ŝtono, papero, tondilo—por defii kaj superlerti la eksterterajn loĝantojn de la stacio. Sukceso en ĉi tiuj konkuroj povas altigi vian statuson kaj influon en la stacio, malŝlosante novajn vojojn kaj eblecojn.

Spertu riĉe branĉan rakonton en ĉi tiu ludo. Vi povas reludi la ludon multfoje. Simple premu la spacan breton aŭ klaku por antaŭenigi la dialogon. Kiam vi alfrontiĝos kun elekto, klaku la korespondan butonon por determini la sorton de via rolulo. Navigu tra kompleksaj interagoj kaj decidoj, kiuj estas klavaj, por teksi vian unikan rakonton inter la steloj.

title: Never Be Alone
description:
게임 정보

Dive into the post-apocalyptic realm of 'Never Be Alone,' an expansive open-world game designed for both solo and multiplayer experiences. In this zombie survival adventure, you can seamlessly team up with friends or brave the dangers alone. Beyond the relentless undead, you'll face ruthless bandits and the relentless challenges of hunger, thirst, and treacherous radioactive zones. Survive against all odds, where the environment is as deadly as the creatures that inhabit it.
Dynamic Gameplay Features:

First & Third Person View: Experience the apocalypse through your preferred perspective. Whether you want the immersion of first-person or the awareness of third-person, switch seamlessly to suit your playstyle.
Advanced Survival Systems:
Farming System: Cultivate your own crops to sustain your group’s needs.
Generator System: Keep the lights on and your equipment powered with a robust generator system, vital for survival in the darkest times.
Rich Resource Gathering:
Scavenge and Salvage: Delve into the remnants of civilization to loot broken cars and abandoned buildings for crucial supplies.
Gather essential materials like wood, stone, and metal from the environment, necessary for crafting and building.
Relax with a fishing rod to catch food, providing a peaceful contrast to the post-apocalyptic tension.
Employ stealth and skill with the bow to dispatch threats quietly and efficiently.
Use collected materials to craft a variety of items and tools at your workbench, from defensive structures to utilities.
Maintain and repair your weapons and gear at the repair bench, ensuring you're always ready for whatever challenges lie ahead.
Scour different shops in the safe zones for supplies, weapons, and unique items.
Engage in a variety of missions and side quests that will challenge your skills and reward you handsomely.
Find sanctuary in designated Safe Zones where you can interact with other players peacefully, trade goods, plan your next move, and stay clear from both undead and human threats.



The common threat. These slow-moving zombies aren't much of a challenge individually but can quickly become overwhelming in numbers.
Quicker than the Walker, this fast-paced zombie will test your stamina. Running may save you for a moment, but they'll keep up the chase.
The pinnacle of undead agility. If a Sprinter spots you, don't even think about running; it's futile. Your best chance is to stand your ground and fight.
Approach with caution. This medium-speed menace will explode upon death, releasing a toxic cloud that can be lethal. Long-range weapons are advised, as melee attacks are a death wish.
The ultimate behemoth. Encountering a Brute means it's time to either bring out the big guns or get out of the way. Exceptionally dangerous at close range, a Brute can demolish anything in its path.


Fortify your territory by constructing impenetrable bases. Customize your fortress to reflect your survival style.
Dare to explore radioactive zones, but beware—without the proper gas mask, these areas spell instant doom.
Whether warding off bandits or outsmarting the undead, survival is better with friends. Easy connectivity makes teaming up a breeze.


Customize your survivor with a selection of character meshes and hairstyles. While the options are straightforward, they allow you to create a character that fits your style within the game's post-apocalyptic world.
Equip yourself for survival with a broad range of weaponry options. Whether you prefer the silent precision of bows and melee weapons or the robust power of firearms, you'll find tools that suit your tactical needs. And when you need a moment's respite from the ongoing chaos, enjoy a peaceful fishing break by the waterside.


Get a taste of the apocalypse with several missions designed to introduce you to the world of "Never Be Alone."
Prepare to navigate a world where danger lurks around every corner and teamwork is the key to survival. Are you ready to face the undead and never be alone?

title: Bug Alliance
description:
게임 정보
Bug Alliance is a pixel style top-down action RPG, where you play as bug warriors, each with unique abilities and weapons. Choose your Bug, select a game mode and dive into battles against worm tyranny. Fight, upgrade, farm resources, evolve and become a legend. Alliance is calling you!
-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------
THE STORY
After the Earth faces the catastrophic meteor strike, everything changes once and for all. With the extinction of humanity, it leaves its place to a new mutated life. This "New World" is mainly ruled by two forms of living, Bugs, and Worms. Worms try to devour the nature to feed their greedy King - Glutton.
Bugs, on the other hand, under the command of their Queens, pledged to protect the nature and the whole living from hoggish worms at any cost. After losing the great battle, bugs and their queens are captured, tortured, and enslaved. Many years later, bugs create a secret alliance, called “Requiem Society”, with the mission to unite all of the brave and mighty Bug warriors across the continent and fight back for the Volucris and the Queens!

title: Fatal Dopamine/ 致命多巴胺
description:
게임 정보
About This Game

"Fatal Dopamine" is a strategy-filled and challenging roguelike card game that also tests your luck. In this game, you will play as an anonymous gambler who arrives at a peculiar casino. Using a variety of unique cards, you'll employ strategy and luck in a blackjack-based game to achieve victory and become a "big shot" on the leaderboard. The gambling here isn't just about playing blackjack; it integrates multiple complex rules and strategies. Each game is a psychological battle where you need to gauge your opponent's thoughts and predict their next move. Simultaneously, you must manage your chips and cards to ensure you can surprise your opponents at critical moments. Through continuous gambling, you can gather clues to uncover the well-hidden truths of this place. Is there a conspiracy behind the games? Deception among gamblers? Evil dealings by merchants? What is the truth behind the dopamine? More stories await your discovery.

Story Background

In this world, there exists a place where only those driven by extreme desires can enter. Here, they come with their lucky cards, wagering their blood as the stakes to raise the ante for their enemies. Those who come here are all in pursuit of becoming the prominent figures on the leaderboard, which promises them the long-coveted "dopamine" they've heard so much about.

However, behind the facade of playful revelry, a darker undercurrent flows. This secretive place attracts a variety of individuals: powerful counts, scholars in search of truth, and swordsmen who will stop at nothing to gain power. Each gathers here for their own reasons, creating an atmosphere thick with tension and excitement. In the brightly lit hall, every table is adorned with exquisite gambling tools. The gamblers' eyes are like those of hungry wolves, fixated on every card and chip on the table.


-Lucky Cards: Customize your own cards that will soon meet you in the game, providing crucial assistance at critical moments.
-Deck Building: Defeat merchant bosses to unlock powerful effect cards and build your unique deck to form a distinct combat style.
-Free Choice of Challenge Order: Challenge the big names on the leaderboard in any order you prefer, which will influence the sequence of merchant card -unlocks and your deck building strategy.



-Randomly Generated Levels: Each adventure is a new experience. Randomly generated enemies, events, and rewards ensure every game is full of surprises.
-Random Events: Encounter random events that will give you extra number and effect cards. Keep an eye out for them when they appear.
-Strategic Combat: Plan every move carefully, using card combinations and tactical strategies to defeat powerful enemies and bosses.
-Permadeath: Death is final. Every failure means starting over, but you can learn and grow stronger from each experience.
-Story Unlocks: Continuously collecting cards will unlock new character stories, giving you a deeper understanding of the diverse characters in the casino.


Diverse Card Collection: Over 100 unique cards providing countless combinations and strategies.
Deep Strategy: Every decision is crucial. Choose the best cards and strategies for the current situation to progress further.
Unique Visual Style: Beautiful hand-drawn art brings you into a fantastical world that is both beautiful and dangerous.
Engaging Music: Completely original soundtrack that creates a tense and exciting adventure atmosphere.

title: CUBEN
description:
게임 정보
―Features―

Unique Puzzle Experience: Dive into an addictive and refreshing cube puzzle game!
Inventory Management: Strategically place items and build your unique setup!
Roguelite Elements: Experience new strategies and encounters with each run!



The game features a 4×4×4 grid of mini-cubes. Swipe in any of the six directions, and all mini-cubes move accordingly. When three or more same-colored cubes align in the direction of movement, they merge and burst, triggering an attack! Combine multiple bursts at once for even greater damage.



Sometimes, small companions called 'Sii' are born from the mini-cubes. These loyal allies automatically attack enemies but have short lifespans. Use items to extend their lifespans and maximize their effectiveness.


Strategically place items and 'Sii' to advance with your unique strategies.



On your journey, you may encounter the mysterious 'Pathway' Here, you will meet various characters. What is their connection to the 'CUBEN'...?

Get ready for an engaging puzzle adventure that combines strategy, excitement, and a bit of mystery!

title: NebuLeet
description:
게임 정보
Core Features:
Living Economy - Trade your way to victory in a fully dynamic market
Modular Ships - Customize and configure your vessels to match your strategy
Tactical Planetary Battles - Conquer planets, destroy enemy forces, and claim territories
Dynamic Space Combat - Engage in intense space battles with real-time action
Automation Through Coding - Program your ships to fight smarter, not harder
Transparent Diplomacy - Influence politics and watch alliances shift in real time
Evolving Galaxy – Face procedurally generated events and crises
In NebuLeet, you lead a space mercenary group, following your own agenda. Fight in space and on planets, participate in a living economy, dabble in politics - whatever brings you closer to victory.
NebuLeet features a two-layered combat system. On the surface: the simplicity of an auto-battler. Deeper down: a complex, programmable combat environment. The victory isn't just about having the best weapons - strategic algorithms can turn the tide even against superior technology.
Prefer more RPG-style gameplay? It's possible to have manual flagship controls in battles. This game is inspired by Space Rangers, after all.

title: Primest Evil
description:
게임 정보


BETRAYAL! As the Prime Evil, you were once the greatest force for bad there was in your slice of the universe...until you got a knife in your back for all your efforts. Risen again as a lich, you're back to claim what's yours in this comedic cartoon adventure -- with a mixture of roguelite character-building, intense action, and a vast array of spells and weapons, there's no shortage of ways to have fun as you blast your way back to power.
CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Choose from an array of starting classes, from the all-around Archarcanist to elemental classes like the Scorcheror and Toxigician and even the melee-focused Bruisomancer. Develop further builds from enhancements traded for souls at the Shrine of B'Gokk. Particularly enterprising players may even unlock additional specialty classes with game events or special rewards.
ALWAYS OUTNUMBERED, NEVER OUTGUNNED

Wield an extensive armory of procedurally generated magical weapons, from magic wands to enchanted sledgehammers. Learn a grimoire's worth of spells, from simple light enchantments and minor curses to arcane tornadoes and globes of invulnerability that set would-be attackers aflame. Master the power of The Most Annoying Bomb In Existence! No explosion is too loud, no hex too humiliating for your enemies as you make your way through the worlds of the Inverse Tower toward your return to the throne.

Interact with a eclectic mix of oddball characters, and navigate the personalities of Councillors whom you recruit for benefits and quests - abuse them too much, though, and you'll have a rebellion on your hands! Recruited Councillors will provide unique benefits and equipment along with quests that can bring needed resources to the Prime Evil's coffers. On the other hand…they hate each other as much as they hate you. Keep them at each other's throats instead of your own, however, and you'll reap the benefit.

Rise, fight, die, and rise again: now a member of the undead, the Prime Evil can never be put down for long. The floors of the Inverse Tower are everchanging, which can only mean new layouts and new benefits as you charge forth. And with the help of the Shrine of B'Gokk and the dread chicken-goddess's hunger for souls, you'll be able to permanently upgrade your character any time you come back successfully from a run with those unfortunate spirits in pocket. Eventually, the Prime Evil return to the great power they have lost -- it's all just a matter of time.

A comedic story and beautiful cartoon aesthetic drives Primest Evil's game experience. Enjoy a combination of hand-painted art and cel-shaded 3D models, as well as a full original soundtrack!

title: Eldorion: Guardians of the Crystals
description:
게임 정보
Eldorion: Guardians of The Crystals
A pixel art exploration game where you must face various challenges and collect crystals to save Earth from its impending doom. An RPG with multiple continents that have emerged, bringing forth a new era of mysticism.
Story
A global cataclysm reshaped Earth. New continents emerged, bringing forth a new era of mysticism.
Elena's peaceful life is disrupted when her father, a renowned archaeologist, discovers one of the Crystals of Hope. Upon touching this Crystal, Elena experiences memories of her past lives, revealing her true mission—to gather all six Crystals of Hope to prevent an unprecedented catastrophe.
The planet Eldorion, on a collision course with Earth, threatens all life. On this journey, Elena is accompanied by her father and her friends, known as the Guardians of the Crystals. Together, they will do everything in their power to help Elena fulfill her mission and, through the power of the Crystals of Hope, alter Eldorion’s trajectory, saving all life on Earth. However, the "Cult of the End of Times," a sect that has lost faith in humanity, will stop at nothing to prevent Elena from completing her journey.

title: Super Cursor
description:
게임 정보

Well hello there handsome! The name's Miss Wolfy and I'll be guiding you throughout this adventure (＾ *)✿

Super Cursor is a challenging precision platformer where you control your very own mouse cursor, who is brought to life and given his own personality! Move through the world as you dodge obstacles and enemies who are stopping you from reaching your beloved princess.

Be careful though, as anything that you touch will kill you instantly and you will have to start all over again!


Dont worry, as only the tip of your cursor will cause damage to you!
Absolutely no mistakes are allowed, can you make it to the end and free the princess and myself, or will we be together forever and ever? (ʘ‿ʘ)ﾉ✿
Features:

Dodge obstacles, enemies, and projectiles thrown your way.
Original characters, soundtracks and world.
Online Co-op because two heads are better than one right?
Bring personality to your cursor.
Funny, satirical, and rich dialogue.

title: Object 17
description:
게임 정보
You are Object 17. Someone unknown is forcing you to undergo mental ability tests. What happened to you? Where are you? Who is testing you? If your number is 17, then what happened to the previous 16 subjects? You will have to answer these and other questions during the game.

Collect puzzles from three-dimensional models of the famous Tetris. Move and rotate the figures as you like. The goal is to fit all the figures into a semi-transparent box in the center of the location. Some figures will be locked. To unlock them, you need to solve a problem.

You will have to use your abstract thinking to the fullest. Go through the tests on the flying islands in the open space of your subconscious. It won't be easy!

title: Come Home: Ghost Stories from Bangladesh
description:
게임 정보
Ghost Stories of Bangladesh is an atmospheric, first-person, horror game series based on the ghost stories of Bangladesh.
Come Home

Young Saif always loved going for walks with his dad in the forest near his home in Sylhet, Bangladesh. One day, everything changed when they became separated and Saif was left alone and frightened. What he encountered that day would impact the course of his life and reveal secrets about his home that, sooner or later, would need to be confronted.
Gameplay

First person, narrative driven with occasional, gentle, problem solving. Opportunities to take different paths which result in a different outcome to the story.
Features

Piece together your own story from the clues you discover.

Based on real ghost stories from Bangladesh.
autokwd: Come Home: Ghost Stories from Bangladesh

title: Alonecats
description:
게임 정보
We are excited to introduce our new puzzle game in the hidden object genre.



Your task is to find all the cats in the location. You can rotate/zoom the scene and interact with the environment to find all the hidden animals.



Key features:

- over 100 hidden cats
- 5 different locations
- simple puzzles

title: Nimillion - The last expedition
description:
게임 정보

‘Nimillion’ is a fun yet challenging physics-based, rocket ship simulation adventure located in a ‘Metroidvania’ style open world. Fly your ship by controlling only its thrusters. Acquire new ship abilities: a grabbing rope, short boost, shield and more. Fine-tune your ship’s hardware to adjust thruster forces, fuel consumption and more. With the help of upgrades and tuning of your rocket ship, you must rely on your skills to explore your surroundings navigating through difficult terrain, environmental phenomenons, physics puzzles and platforming challenges while avoiding hostile entities.
ACQUIRE NEW ABILITIES

Rope tool, booster, 0 gravity and more!

Prepare for tough boss fights

Pilot your rocket ship carefully going through winds, waterfalls, sandstorms, gravity fields, vegetation and more

Use gravity, recoil, force fields and other physics-based features to your advantage

title: Puzzled Hive
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to "Puzzled Hive", a simple-styled puzzle game set in a beehive. In this game, you will take on the role of Meo, exploring mysterious places with the help of Noth to uncover answers. Will you choose to leave?
Demo Version
Currently, full controller support is not available (UI cannot be controlled with a controller).
We have completed the Demo (Version 0.2), which includes:
• A basic art style has been established, with all materials hand-drawn, giving a simple and clean overall style.
• Mechanism of switching between multiple floors.
• Explore with your companion Noth.
• A variety of puzzles created with multiple mechanisms.
Full Version Prospects
Due to time constraints, the map design of Demo 0.2 does not meet our expectations. The official version will include more puzzle mechanisms, enriched maze puzzles, scenes with diverse styles, more NPCs, and a completed storyline. If you like the adorable Meo and Noth, or if you love playing 2D puzzle games, please don't miss it!
Words from the Developers
Hello! We are Player Links Players (PLP, which means "drifting bottle" in Chinese), a studio currently working on our first indie game. Although there are still many shortcomings at this moment, it's just the beginning. In the official version, we will do our best to create an interesting game! And special thanks for Vira Lee, who created bgm for Puzzled Hive!
Contact us
We will welcome any idea or suggestion. You can find us via:
• Bilibili: 深名五介是在下（will update my developing progress here）
• QQ group: 930475923
• Email: 1163684623@qq.com/shenmingwujiegojiu@gmail.com
A picture of me with Meo and Noth drawn by my friend EZ to celebrate the demo launch!
Thank you for supporting, and we are looking forward for your experience in Puzzled Hive!

title: Menes
description:
게임 정보
Step into the enigmatic role of Menes, a celestial being without memory, thrust into a desolate realm filled with ancient secrets and relentless foes. As you traverse unforgiving landscapes, you must unravel the truth behind your mission, uncover forgotten powers, and confront the dark forces that threaten to undo the fabric of existence itself.
MENES combines intense platforming with the punishing challenge of a souls-like adventure experience. Navigate diverse prison realms, each filled with unique perils and foes—from cunning guardians to massive, elemental beings. Hone your skills, master tactical combat, and piece together the mysteries that bind the realms together.
Will you survive the trials and discover the truth about the origins, or will you fall to the shadows lurking in the desert and beyond?

title: The Shadowed Rune
description:
게임 정보
당신은 위험으로 가득한 잊혀진 탑에 도착했으며, 탈출할 방법이 없습니다. 당신의 유일한 기회는 탑 꼭대기에 올라가 룬 유물의 힘을 사용하여 저주를 푸는 것입니다. 마이아와 다른 탐험가들이 저주받은 탑의 비밀을 밝히는 것을 도와주세요!
The Shadowed Rune은 솔로 또는 2인 협동 모드*로 플레이할 수 있는 도전적인 로그라이크 게임입니다. 룬의 힘을 결합하여 새로운 주문을 발견하고 탑을 올라 저주를 푸세요. 친절해 보이지 않는 적들과 마주하게 되고, 원소의 힘을 현명하게 사용해야 하는 퍼즐도 있습니다. 각 층을 지키는 보스들에 대해 언급했나요? 그것들은 시작에 불과합니다...
*로컬 협동 멀티플레이어는 최소한 하나의 연결된 컨트롤러가 필요합니다.
주요 특징:
총알 지옥 액션 요소, 퍼즐, 도전적인 보스가 있는 독특한 로그라이크 모험.

title: Randomice
description:
게임 정보
A procedural Metroid-like with no fights, focused on exploration and route-planning, in which you play a mouse trying to escape from an ever-changing house.
Find randomized upgrades
Each run is a compact Metroid-like experience, in which you will find upgrades to explore the house differently each time. From a magnetic grapple to reach a metallic faucet, to a rideable rocket that can burst through the glass blocking the way, you will find many upgrades, each with its own uses.
Adapt to what you find
You must adapt to the tools in your possession to determine where you can go, the thrill of the game coming both from the platforming mastery, but also from the mental mapping of where you can go in the house at any given time. When you obtain a new item, you need to update this mental map to determine the best possibilities, optimize your path, and decide where to go next to maximize the chances to exit quickly.

title: Gem Miner TD
description:
게임 정보
Gem Miner TD에서는 방어 미로를 구축하고, 강력한 보석을 조합하며, 끝없는 적의 공격에 맞서는 영리한 광부를 조종합니다. 이 타워 디펜스 게임은 로그라이크 요소를 통해 매 게임마다 새로운 전략적 선택을 제공합니다.
특징
전략 수립 - 바위를 캐서 복잡한 경로를 만드세요.
전략적 방어 - 보석을 배치하여 광부를 용암 구덩이로 끌고 가려는 적들의 공격을 막아내세요.
역동적인 보석 시스템 - 보석을 합성하여 더욱 강력한 방어 시설을 만드세요.
로그라이크 요소 - 특정 웨이브를 완료한 후 업그레이드를 선택하세요. 보석 강화, 광부 능력, 게임플레이 수정 사항 중에서 선택하세요.
다양한 게임성 - 여러 맵, 다양한 광부, 무한한 보석 조합, 강력한 업그레이드, 다채로운 적 유형을 경험하세요.

title: Robot Tennis
description:
게임 정보
이 턴제 전략 테니스 시뮬레이션 게임에서 나만의 테니스 로봇을 제작하고, 조종하고, 개선하세요.
코트에서 목표 지점을 선택하고 최적의 타격 각도를 정하고, 경기 내내 에너지, 정밀도, 로봇의 컨디션을 균형 있게 유지하세요!
경기 사이에 로봇을 유지 및 발전시키고 다양한 상대와 대결하여 랭킹 상위권에 올라 최고의 테니스 로봇이 되어보세요!
매일 어떤 활동을 할지 결정하여 로봇의 능력치를 발전시키세요.
수평 및 수직 범위를 확장하거나 최대 에너지, 정밀도, 컨디션을 시간에 따라 증가시키세요.
또는, 어렵게 획득한 로봇 포인트를 사용하여 즉각적인 개선을 적용할 수도 있습니다.
이전 경기에서 회복하여 다음 경기를 위해 최상의 컨디션을 유지하세요.
랭킹 리스트에서 라이벌과 경기 점수를 비교하고 대결을 신청하세요.
이전 경기의 통계를 검토하여 자신의 강점과 약점을 파악하세요.
자신만의 플레이 스타일을 시도하고 적용해 보세요. 정상으로 향하는 과정에서 어떤 능력치를 우선으로 둘지는 여러분의 선택에 달려 있습니다. 각 결정에 따라 코트 위 로봇의 성능이 달라집니다.
경기 사이에 시간을 들여 로봇을 회복하고 능력치를 강화하거나, 최대한 빠르게 연속으로 경기를 치러 가장 빠른 시간 안에 정상을 차지하세요.

title: Twilight Epoch
description:
게임 정보
As the Blight grows with each passing day, the worlds wither in turn. The drifting planes that still light the sky fade like embers, and the powers that live to see them covet dominion of the few centuries that remain. A young man from a distant plane is taken from his home, and fights to find peace, before all ends in silence.
Embark on an adventure through a mysterious science-fantasy galaxy, blending intense FPS action with the customization of a party-based RPG, across endlessly replayable levels of strange and sprawling worlds.
A GALACTIC JOURNEY
A campaign split into 3 books, with 20+ enormous levels to be explored and plundered, each handcrafted and fully unique with their own aesthetic, lore, and enemy roster.
Ancient temples, shadowy space piers, towering cities; all dense with loot, secrets, and deadly encounters.
BUILD YOUR PARTY
Swashbuckle and parry with dual cutlasses, rocket jump with a mecha arm cannon, battle as a knight in explosive armour, or just throw big rocks at people.
Use 6 characters, 100+ unique weapons across 18 types, plus a wide range combat abilities, passive-granting armours, and items that all make meaningful differences to your playstyle.
RAW COMBAT
Face off against 50 enemy types and a slew of brutal bosses in combat combining bullet hell, hack-and-slash, and FPS.
Each encounter is a combat sandbox against legions of enemies who want you dead yesterday.
DEEP MOVEMENT
B-hopping, air-strafing, explosive jumping, slope-physics, a whole list of equipment specific techniques + Unlimited sprinting!
Use your agility to out-maneuver attacks, reach remote treasures, and speed through the highly vertical environments.

title: Soulrise
description:
게임 정보
Soulrise is a game about high-risk jumps, inspired by Jump King and other precision platformer.

Trapped beneath a forgotten tower, lost souls await your help. They must ascend to the top of this Structure, overcome challenging obstacles and uncover hidden secrets - you're their only chance of salvation. Every jump must be carefully considered, as there's a lot at stake... One mistake and your progress is set back by an unpleasant fall.




Experience Soulrise alone or with up to three friends
Rotate your sword 360° around your player to determine the direction of each jump
Hold and release at the right moment to give your jumps the necessary power
Explore a tower with 10 different sections and hidden secrets
Try to avoid mistakes... Every fall has serious consequences.




Experience Soulrise alone or with up to three friends. Explore the abandoned tower together to find the best path to the top.
Or compete against each other in a specially designed mode.

title: Quantum Beast
description:
게임 정보
Quantum Beast focuses on rumble fighting that you need to fight against massive enemies ALONE. So if you are confident of your power, then go for it.
Gameplay Elements:

Cool Fighting Style
Kick the robots in the ass!
This is the core mechanic that you can counter enemy's attacks to blow them in the air. And after that, a heavy strike kick could teach then a good lesson.


Throw them toward the wall!
Hit the enemies back. When they hit the wall, the additional stamina damage could stun them more easily.




Shoot or explode, your choice.



Weapons and resources are spread in the whole area. Those little things could help you pass through the challenges.

title: Inhabitants
description:
게임 정보
Watch the development of this game live on twitch!
Inhabitants is a single-player horror game that has you delve into the mysterious disappearance of your friend.
They left without a trace. Their apartment was left unlocked and seemingly empty. Maybe there is something that can point you in the right direction?
Uncover the mysteries behind their disappearance. 
Your only clue is their computer. But what lies within may not be best if found.

title: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzle Challenge
description:
게임 정보
This game is an ultra-high difficulty jigsaw puzzle where players embark on a challenging journey. Players must fit pieces into the correct positions to complete images generated randomly using colored tiles.

However, this game deviates significantly from traditional jigsaw puzzles. Placing a piece triggers several unexpected events. For example, with each piece placed, the colors gradually fade, increasing the difficulty for players to discern the image. Additionally, the workspace gradually shrinks, forcing players to work within tighter confines.

Moreover, placing a piece in the wrong position triggers an explosion, resetting the game from the beginning. Players must carefully select pieces and place them accurately.

Furthermore, players may encounter falling debris when placing pieces, obscuring their view and adding to the challenge.

This game serves as a test of players' concentration and strategic thinking, offering an extremely challenging puzzle experience. Can players accurately fit all the pieces and complete the puzzle?

title: Archery Pro VR
description:
게임 정보
Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR!

There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

Be warned, archery is extremely addictive and challenging.

You can compete online with friends or other players and climb the tournament ranks and unlock amazing rewards.

Players can also experience a realistic and challenging single player campaign by tackling specific trick shots and situations. Friends can compare scores and progress with each other on the leaderboard.

title: Echoes of Elpis
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Elpis is a thrilling twin-stick shooter set within the mighty spaceship Elpis. Battle against relentless enemies, unlock powerful upgrades, and reveal the ship's secret past.



Fight your way through Elpis's rooms to unearth rare technology and artifacts. These epic finds offer power-ups that transform your gameplay, enabling mastery over the ship's defenses.



Echoes of Elpis melds the unpredictability of roguelite adventures with relentless sci-fi action. Adapt and refine your tactics with every run. The deeper you venture into Elpis, the more its legacy unfolds, beckoning you to etch your name among the stars as the ultimate treasure hunter.

title: Angel
description:
게임 정보
브레이크비트 리듬 레이싱 디지털 기후 변화가 eCho 네트워크의 멸종을 위협하는 PSX 영감을 받은 리듬 레이싱 모험 ANGEL에 몰입하세요. 정체된 네트워크에 새로운 활력을 불어넣기 위해 새로운 브레이크 비트를 제작하면서 디지털 풍경을 통해 추진합니다. ANGEL은 레이싱의 흐름 상태에 브레이크비트 음악의 복잡성을 부여하여 아케이드 및 콤보 기반 게임 플레이를 재정의하며, MyraTV, Superdeath 및 많은 다른 브레이크비트 애호가들의 사운드트랙으로 강화됩니다. eCho가 멸종 위기에 처했을 때 ANGEL 프로토콜 - 탐험, 창조, 성찰 - 이 계속됩니다. 연결된다는 것이 무엇을 의미하는지 묻는 여정을 시작하세요.\r\n\r\n

title: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
description:
게임 정보
«Permanent: Hope & Vacuum» is a disturbing first-person psychological horror indie game with adventure, puzzle, platformer, dungeon crawler and action gameplay.

This is a one-person development, so please let me introduce the game to you. Thanks!



Discover a story that will take you through a world that is as terrifying as it is intriguing, where you will encounter numerous obstacles and irrational challenges that will test your skills as a player.



Your main objective is to unravel the mystery behind your memory loss and discover all about the strange world you have woken up in after a long and surreal fall.

To do this, you'll have to defeat creatures called «Reks», solve all sorts of puzzles, overcome dungeons, use platforming mechanics, and face a variety of disturbing situations that will always leave you with more questions than answers.



Fortunately, with the help of the , you will have access to various special abilities to defend yourself, control fire, alter gravity... These skills are acquired throughout the game and will help you fight the and progress on your journey.

"But remember, is the only thing that matters. In , is more than a word. It is the very life of the character, the key to his entire story, and also the currency for obtaining documents from the that will help you better understand the LORE of the world.

Your adventure begins as you fall down a sort of energy cliff until you land in a room straight out of your worst nightmares.



From this point on, you'll be alone and confused, but unfortunately for you, .

.



It's best not to give too much away so that you can discover it for yourself, but the subtly and progressively told story will always keep you guessing, and when it's all over (if it ends) you'll understand why .














"Hi, I'm David Oliver, the only member of DOgames, a new indie studio based in Madrid (Spain) and the developer of . I'd like to introduce you to the amazing 3D fantasy world I'm creating with all my love and passion.



As an old-school gamer, I have always dreamt of creating a game capable of transporting players to another world and etching the experience in their gamer memory.

I'm working on every aspect of the game with care and attention to detail. From the puzzles, to the soundtrack, to every hidden corner, ensuring that every player will have an unforgettable experience.

I am excited to share that the project has been in full development for around a year now, but I need all the help I can get to fully realise the plans I have defined. Any kind of collaboration will be greatly appreciated; together we can make this game even more special!
