title: Plant Budz 98
description:
게임 정보
Plant Budz are pets raised on your new retro desktop. Budz react and evolve based on how you interact with it. Each final evolution transforms into a unique game, which can unlock new rewards and ways to play games. Transport back to the golden era of desktops to find new-age twists on nostalgic classics!

title: Cabral's Quest
description:
게임 정보
Cabral’s Quest is a pixel art puzzle game set in a hidden world underneath the wetlands, ancient homeland of the capybaras.

Make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed to help Cabral reclaim their land. Use different runes to change the elements of the world around you to solve each puzzle.
GOALS



RESCUE BABY CAPYBARAS
Baby capybaras are hidden across the world, lost after the occupation of their lands.
They're optional collectibles to prove your ability.

OBTAIN EACH FRAGMENT OF THE SACRED DEED
And help Cabral recover the land of his community.
Cross portals, doors or bridges and try to avoid the wildlife around to make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed.

CONCEPT

LOGICAL AND LATERAL THINKING
Set in a calm atmosphere, encouraging deep thinking in both logical and lateral ways.


Based on the combination and switching of game elements’ colors, allowing for an accessible but rich gameplay.


Crafted with specific wildlife and natural elements that expand the original mechanics creating new experiences and puzzles.




Use the to modify the elements of the world, changing their color and disabling them to solve the puzzles.


Each element and enemy has different behaviour, and color is always at the core of each mechanic.

Use portals, doors, bridges and other elements to move around the levels.

Avoid the corrupted wildlife that will make your way to the harder.

title: Chicken with Robot Legs
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Chicken with Robot Legs!
You are a chicken that wakes up in an unknown place. Not knowing who you are or why are you there you know one thing, you gotta get out of there!
Explore a 2D pixel world with a lot of secrets and collectibles, the chicken doesn't stop moving forward, you'll need to use your abilities and environment to traverse and find a way out.

Features
- the first game that combines the Runner and the Metroidvania genres a "Runner-Vania" game.
- explore alternate paths to uncover secrets and collectibles.
- upgrade the chicken with abilities that help you reach for new places.
- never stop running, use the scenery and abilities in neat ways to get your way around.
- collect various kinds of items to get rewards or open secret paths.

title: Rising Sands
description:
게임 정보
Set in a post-apocalyptic world, as ex-military soldier Daku, discover the secrets of the sand and reveal how the world has gotten to this state. Uncover the many groups formed after the war, from the government corporation EcoSurge to the eco-terrorist group Rising Sands, and many more.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Rising Sands features grounded third person shooter gameplay mixed with fantasy. Heavily inspired by classic RPG titles alongside modern Shooters, the ever changing environments constantly being tampered by The Gemini's rising sand make for a unique experience for every player. The captivating story along with these elements lead to gripping boss fights that push Daku to his limits.



Rising Sands features complex characters in a world where no one truly knows who is right. See all sides of the story and discover what really happened after the war.

title: Inhabitants
description:
게임 정보
Watch the development of this game live on twitch!
Inhabitants is a single-player horror game that has you delve into the mysterious disappearance of your friend.
They left without a trace. Their apartment was left unlocked and seemingly empty. Maybe there is something that can point you in the right direction?
Uncover the mysteries behind their disappearance. 
Your only clue is their computer. But what lies within may not be best if found.

title: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzle Challenge
description:
게임 정보
This game is an ultra-high difficulty jigsaw puzzle where players embark on a challenging journey. Players must fit pieces into the correct positions to complete images generated randomly using colored tiles.

However, this game deviates significantly from traditional jigsaw puzzles. Placing a piece triggers several unexpected events. For example, with each piece placed, the colors gradually fade, increasing the difficulty for players to discern the image. Additionally, the workspace gradually shrinks, forcing players to work within tighter confines.

Moreover, placing a piece in the wrong position triggers an explosion, resetting the game from the beginning. Players must carefully select pieces and place them accurately.

Furthermore, players may encounter falling debris when placing pieces, obscuring their view and adding to the challenge.

This game serves as a test of players' concentration and strategic thinking, offering an extremely challenging puzzle experience. Can players accurately fit all the pieces and complete the puzzle?

title: Archery Pro VR
description:
게임 정보
Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR!

There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

Be warned, archery is extremely addictive and challenging.

You can compete online with friends or other players and climb the tournament ranks and unlock amazing rewards.

Players can also experience a realistic and challenging single player campaign by tackling specific trick shots and situations. Friends can compare scores and progress with each other on the leaderboard.

title: Echoes of Elpis
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Elpis is a thrilling twin-stick shooter set within the mighty spaceship Elpis. Battle against relentless enemies, unlock powerful upgrades, and reveal the ship's secret past.



Fight your way through Elpis's rooms to unearth rare technology and artifacts. These epic finds offer power-ups that transform your gameplay, enabling mastery over the ship's defenses.



Echoes of Elpis melds the unpredictability of roguelite adventures with relentless sci-fi action. Adapt and refine your tactics with every run. The deeper you venture into Elpis, the more its legacy unfolds, beckoning you to etch your name among the stars as the ultimate treasure hunter.

title: Angel
description:
게임 정보
브레이크비트 리듬 레이싱 디지털 기후 변화가 eCho 네트워크의 멸종을 위협하는 PSX 영감을 받은 리듬 레이싱 모험 ANGEL에 몰입하세요. 정체된 네트워크에 새로운 활력을 불어넣기 위해 새로운 브레이크 비트를 제작하면서 디지털 풍경을 통해 추진합니다. ANGEL은 레이싱의 흐름 상태에 브레이크비트 음악의 복잡성을 부여하여 아케이드 및 콤보 기반 게임 플레이를 재정의하며, MyraTV, Superdeath 및 많은 다른 브레이크비트 애호가들의 사운드트랙으로 강화됩니다. eCho가 멸종 위기에 처했을 때 ANGEL 프로토콜 - 탐험, 창조, 성찰 - 이 계속됩니다. 연결된다는 것이 무엇을 의미하는지 묻는 여정을 시작하세요.\r\n\r\n

title: Wild Mars
description:
게임 정보
WISHLIST NOW BEFORE THE STORM HITS
A Mars survival management simulator in which you must produce fuel from bacteria and algae to leave Mars before an incoming storm destroys your base. Defend your base from the bacteria that infest it. Manage the fuel that also powers your base's elevator. Make crucial decisions to survive.
DEFEND YOUR BASE FROM THE BACTERIA

title: The Realm
description:
게임 정보
Story
The player lost in a Labyrinthine village in another world is looking for a way out alone.
You explore the village from a first-person perspective and find the exit.
There are many creatures lurking in the village. All of them are terrifying creatures you've never seen before.
Will you be able to leave the village safely?

System
This game is a walking simulation game, and all you have to do is walk in the dark village.
The controls for this game are easy, just grab your flashlight and keep walking and look for exit.
You can have an experience like you're actually in a village of horror.

title: Alice - Island Adventure
description:
게임 정보


Embark on an enthralling adventure with Alice as she sets out on her much-awaited vacation, eagerly anticipating a well-deserved break from the monotony of daily life. Excitement courses through her veins as she boards the plane, her mind filled with visions of relaxation and exploration in exotic locales.

However, fate has other plans in store for Alice.

What begins as minor disturbances soon escalates into a series of inexplicable events that plunge Alice into a whirlwind of chaos and uncertainty. The once-promising journey quickly morphs into a harrowing ordeal as Alice grapples with the unsettling realization that something sinister is afoot.

Amidst the chaos, questions swirl in Alice's mind. Are these disruptions mere coincidences, or is there a deeper, darker force at play? With each passing moment, the mystery deepens, drawing Alice deeper into a web of intrigue and danger.

title: Uanamon: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
The war continues. The enemies have become stronger. We must become stronger too - now there is a secret weapon in the game...
We immerse ourselves in the world of the Uanamon, learn about their traditions and rules of the world. Kill your enemies and restore the world of the Uanamons!
A roguelike-survivor game.

title: Hack Deep
description:
게임 정보
The game is a cyber-space infiltration game that supports up to 4-player cooperation. In this game, players step into a futuristic cyberspace filled with technological wonders and dangers. Their mission is to infiltrate target locations, steal crucial items, and successfully evacuate, all of which require close cooperation between players.
This game not only provides players with thrilling gaming experiences but also encourages teamwork and communication among players. Each player assumes a different role with unique skills and abilities, making each game a fresh challenge. Some players might excel at hacking security systems, some might be adept combatants, while others could be stealth and theft experts. Only through clever strategies and coordinated actions can missions be successfully completed.
The cyber-space in the game is brimming with high-tech gadgets and challenging enemies. Players need to utilize various tools and skills to evade surveillance systems, bypass security personnel, and complete objectives without raising too much attention. At the same time, players must constantly watch out for the safety of their team members and support each other in times of crisis, ensuring everyone evacuates smoothly.

title: NET.CRAWL
description:
게임 정보
NET.CRAWL은 육각형 격자에서 플레이하는 덱 건설 로그라이트입니다.
육각형(노드) 안으로 이동하면 활성화되고 효과가 발동합니다.
청색 노드는 데이터를 제공합니다. 황색 노드 - 크레딧.
녹색 노드는 기본적인 방어부터 창의적인 규칙 변경까지 다양한 효과를 제공하는 개인용 도구상자입니다.
적색 노드는 적대적입니다. 온갖 종류의 문제를 일으킬 수 있습니다.
그리고 자주색이 있습니다.
코어.각각 고유한 능력이나 승리 조건을 가진 미니 보스가 등장합니다. 미니 보스는 매우 강력하고 거의 게임 판도를 뒤흔들 정도입니다. 맞춤형 전략 없이는 이들을 물리칠 수 없습니다.

title: Greed Forest
description:
게임 정보
A real-time strategy tower defense game set in a dangerous yet resource-rich forest. Build your base, shape your defenses, and fend off relentless enemy swarms in a battle for survival and supremacy.
Gather and Grow:
Harvest gold, wood and stone from the forest to expand your base, unlock upgrades, and build advanced tech structures.
RTS Meets Tower Defense:
Experience the strategy of a classic RTS without unit micro-management. Focus entirely on defending against massive waves of enemies.
Campaign and Creativity:
Dive into a challenging campaign or use the built-in map editor to design and share your own custom scenarios.
Greed Forest is about mastering the balance between resource management, strategic planning, and creative defense.

title: Shop Crush
description:
게임 정보
About Shop Crush
Manage your Thrift Shop. Sell a hodgepodge of merch to picky customers. Set the prices, bargain with clients, and turn down suspicious offers. Order popular stock, fight off shoplifters, and manage your reputation — gain or lose it based on your choices!
Own a Thrift Shop
Yes, you own a Thrift Shop! Clients come every day to buy their preferred products. To keep your business profitable, you must monitor your prices and the number of products clients want.
In this choice-driven Visual Novel, you must balance the profitability of the offer with the reputational loss that every purchase can cause.

title: The Rule Of SHE
description:
게임 정보
The Rule of SHE is a role-playing game that delves into the enigmatic character of SHE. In this ever-shifting world, reality and time are constantly in flux, and each scenario introduces a different set of rules that must be followed.
Any violation of these rules will bring misfortune upon yourself. Adhere to them to uncover the truth and delve into the deepest secrets of SHE. Only when you have gained enough understanding of this eerie world will the time for successful reincarnation arrive.
1, A poetic, short narrative-driven puzzle game.
2, A bizarre and slightly eerie worldview accompanied by up to 20 original BGMs.
3, A carefully designed puzzle gameplay where switching between multiple characters can trigger different storylines.
4, The game includes boss battles and chase mechanics.
1, This is not a game with a single storyline. Please, explore all branching narratives.
2, Do not trust me; trust the rules established in each room of the game.
3, Remember to turn on the lights during your gameplay.
4, The game’s rules do not apply to your real-world life.
5, If you’re caught in a dilemma, trust your instincts.
If rules open pathways to the deeper layers of this world, what happens when they’re broken?  Between reality and illusion, will you still remember who you are?

title: Star Child
description:
게임 정보
Star Child is an explosive new futuristic action-adventure game built by a small and passionate indie team.

Explore a mysterious alien world full of unique environments, populated by dangerous alien foes.



Conquer a variety of bosses, each one designed to have a unique visual and gameplay style.

Discover secret areas, find new weapons, enhance your abilities, and destroy any obstacles in your way!

Feeling a bit overwhelmed by it all? Relax for a moment and catch some fish!

Colorful, hand-crafted pixel art
Powerful original soundtrack composed by Tantrum Tech
Multiple difficulties designed for a wide range of ages and skill levels
Full keyboard and controller support

title: Panic In Store !
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Panic in Store!

As a supermarket employee, you will be required to go from store to store, carrying out short missions for the store chain that employs you. You will have to put the right cardboards (cereal, game, fruit, etc.) in the right aisles (cereal, games, fruit, etc.) while paying attention to the obstacles that will get in your way in this game casual but nervous.
Be a good employee!

Advance from level to level, obtaining more and more stars in order to show the world your skills as a supermarket employee!
Watch out for customers and random events that are there to get in your way.
Beware of the storm!

Random events may occur during your missions: slippery puddles, inverted movements, increased number of customers in the store, level plunged into darkness. You will need to understand these events and how to defuse them, without losing sight of your main objective.
A unique apartment!

As you complete your missions during the various levels of the game, you will unlock furniture and accessories to personalize your apartment.
A fabulous look!

Become a true fashion victim by unlocking various clothes and outfits as you progress to make your games even more fun!

title: DisplaceMen
description:
게임 정보
DisplaceMen is a magic realist ADV that depicts a seven-day mystery story with multiple scenarios and endings.

In the coastal town of Huanmen, everyone knows how to 'displace'—to turn any item or even living being they own into another, as long as the two have equivalent psychological value. Displaced things will vanish and be forgotten.

You are a broke painter who wanders around the town, collecting the strangest things to make art. While chatting with your commissioners, with a painter’s eye to observe and imagine, you will unveil the true faces of these people - the motivational speaker, the trace scholar with a day job as a tattoo artist, the hardcore cosplayer teenager, the wanted pseudoscientist, etc. Working to redeem the vanished “mermaid,” you will accumulate properties until you realize you can displace people. Deciding what to let go of is a painter’s practice. Stay sensitive. Stay gold.



This game will provide a unique visual novel experience featuring multiple gameplay mechanics -
Magic-Realist Narrative
Experience the mainstage “mermaid” mystery by making seamless decisions for multiple endings. Enjoy the satellite stories while exploring various locations in a town operating with the rules of displacement.
Imagine the most impossible found objects as art material. Observe your subjects and chat with your clients to uncover their secrets. Make artistic decisions to enable story branching. Balance special personal values for characters to activate unique painting results.
Collect items and tokens of human ownership within the main story and sidequest. *Bonus: Displace your item or token at the right moment for the best value by watching your psychological values change triggered by events.
Solve small drag-and-drop puzzles while immersed in visceral dream sequences of the vanished “mermaid.” Witness the forgotten story emerging from beautifully intangible streams of consciousness.


_

*Love is an investment. This is a story for those who have the deepest love for things that are not present. We miss the things that are not here, and this drives us insane. We have different mechanisms to process this, and this game proposes two of them: 1, Keep talking to people, and 2, Keep making paintings.

*By the way, the game can make you laugh a lot, especially at inappropriate moments.
tag: 자신이 선택하는 모험,비주얼 노벨,포인트 앤드 클릭

title: A LETTER FROM MOM
description:
게임 정보
On the morning of your 14th birthday, you receive a party invitation from your missing mom. But when you arrive, you find yourself in a cult village. This game is a point-and-click puzzle adventure starring Nero, a black cat. As Nero, you will search for your missing mom and explore the cult village. The villagers seem welcoming, but beneath the surface, secrets are hidden among the fluttering butterflies and lush greenery. Can you escape from this beautiful yet mysterious village?

How to Play
Click on points of interest: If something seems suspicious, click to investigate.
Collect items: Click on items to add them to your item box.
Use items: Click on items in your item box, then click where you want to use them.
Move around: Click arrows to move to different locations.

Playtime: 1 hour

title: Rules of War
description:
게임 정보
            
Test your strategic genius in this fast paced turn-based 4X game. In Rules of War you can:
- Develop your territory
- Command your army
- Expand your borders
- Acquire new technologies
- Spy on your enemies
- Engage in missile warfare

Do you have what it takes to lead your nation to VICTORY?

Disclaimer: The game is currently under development. Visuals and features may change depending on player feedback and comments. If you have a comment please reach out to us through our website or discord.
COMBAT
            
Deploy your infantry, mortar units, tanks, reconnaissance vehicles, and artillery to attack your enemies. Currently planned 10 land units.
            
Explore through the uncertainties of the fog of war and expand your borders to increase your economic output. The more land you control, the more resources.

Learn or perish. Research new technologies to get access to the most powerful weapons. Currently 30 technologies planned, from unit upgrades to espionage advantages and nuclear weapons.
            
The ultimate weapon. The ultimate deterrence.

title: Urok
description:
게임 정보
자연의 힘을 조종하라
자연을 활용해 놀라운 일을 해보세요. 숲 속의 불길을 커다란 화염구로 바꾸고, 호수를 사라지게 하여 공기를 안개로 채울 수 있습니다. 신중히 움직임을 계획하고 자연의 도움을 받아보세요. 다양한 요소를 조합해 강력한 마법을 만들어보세요!
마법 카드 획득하기
카드를 신중히 선택하세요. 각 마법 카드를 다양한 방식으로 활용할 수 있습니다.
적들에 맞서 반응하라
주변 세계를 잘 관찰하세요. 위험할 수도 있지만 큰 도움이 될 수도 있습니다. 이 게임은 턴제 방식으로 진행되며, 적의 주문을 막거나 특별한 마법을 만들기 위해 신중히 계획을 세울 수 있습니다!

title: Quantum Beast
description:
게임 정보
Quantum Beast focuses on rumble fighting that you need to fight against massive enemies ALONE. So if you are confident of your power, then go for it.
Gameplay Elements:

Cool Fighting Style
Kick the robots in the ass!
This is the core mechanic that you can counter enemy's attacks to blow them in the air. And after that, a heavy strike kick could teach then a good lesson.


Throw them toward the wall!
Hit the enemies back. When they hit the wall, the additional stamina damage could stun them more easily.




Shoot or explode, your choice.



Weapons and resources are spread in the whole area. Those little things could help you pass through the challenges.

title: Project Vic 2
description:
게임 정보
Years have passed since the cruel experiments of Dr. Ethan Hastings. Deserted alleys, vandalism and curious observations. The government warns against entering this region.

But none of that matters to you. You love lost places and would do anything to discover new exciting places - no matter how dangerous the location may be.

You set off to explore the old Hastings Mansion. But what awaits you there is beyond anything you could ever have imagined.
Features:
Explore the Hastings Mansion after the events of the past
Find more exciting information about the research of Dr. Ethan Hastings
Investigate unknown locations and form your own impression of the effects on the environment
Use the advanced functions of your camera to discover hidden places and the secrets of this world

For questions, feedback or support requests join my Discord or write in the discussion section.

title: Soul #531
description:
게임 정보
In this game you play as a ghost, waking up in the underworld, where souls are wandering aimlessly. You remember one specific detail however, your dog, waiting for you in your home back in the real world. Undertake an adventure through the layers of the underworld, solving handcrafted puzzles, defeating enemies with a fun and easy to learn combat system, and test your skills with platforming sections.

Upgrade your player as you progress throughout the game by collecting coins of the dead, the coins that other souls are buried with to ensure safe passage through the underworld. Experience the linear world, designed and handcrafted to progress with the story, and uncover its secrets.

This game is developed by one person, and the stylized art is all hand drawn.

title: pondlife: discone
description:
게임 정보
there are no goals in this videogame.

discone is an exploration of videogames beyond gameness: beyond designed rules and designer-defined objectives. we, as designers, create a physics, a space, some characters. as players, you create the play.
move your expressive character-bodies around an online world
to explore and pull at the videogame's seams, left there intentionally or unintentionally. we believe that a novel, intuitively explorable, and experientially understood movement system, situated in a space, & connected online has infinite potential, and we are excited to explore this possibility space with you.
open exploration and discovery
the ability to pick a point on the horizon but without any combat or external conflict. the casual socialization and community of online web games in the context of a challenge-oriented, self-directed 3d platformer. the exciting stress of embodying and manipulating an alien avatar along not just a path, but an infinity of player-selected paths. are those mountains even climbable? (they definitely are)
embracing simplicity and childlike wonder
to seek the territory outside the boundaries of traditional art & its received aesthetic norms. we are inspired by paint and are exploring pixel-based art (all screen art is pixel art) as an impressionism, as something beyond chunky, low-resolution pixels. our approach to 3d-rendering accepts & embraces the glitchiness, the inherent flatness of polygons & deformed meshes, the seams & rough edges.
discone
is a game with no bosses and no ladders.

title: ZJ the Ball
description:
게임 정보
ZJ the Ball (Level 1) is a short, story driven, 2D side scrolling adventure game. You play as ZJ the Ball, who can move left and right, along with jumping and bouncing. Coins are scattered throught the level, and if you collect them all, it will improve your score! At the end of the level, ZJ the Ball meets a robot named Axel, who challenges ZJ the Ball to play a classic styled arcade game. If you make a mistake in the arcade game, you lose coins and your score decreases! Try to get a perfect score to fully complete the level!

[ZJ the Ball (Level 1) Story]
ZJ the Ball realizes how much good work his mom does at their neighborhood church, so he decides to get a thank you gift for her. As he travels through the city looking for one, he meet's a robot named Axel! What does he want?!

title: Tunnel Baby
description:
게임 정보
On one rainy morning, Steve found a baby in a utility tunnel.
Explore, Survive, and Find Your Way Out
Tunnel Baby is a surreal horror adventure where you must navigate a strange and eerie world. With minimal heads-up display and user interface, immerse yourself in a variety of unsettling environments as you search for a way to escape by solving puzzles, fighting enemies, and exploring environments.
Defend Yourself
Armed only with a lead pipe and a flashlight, Steve must fend off extradimensional horrors and hostile creatures. You must fight to protect yourself and get the mysterious baby back to his mother.
Trapped in a World With Seemingly No Escape
What begins as an emergency repair job turns into a nightmarish struggle for survival. After discovering a baby in the utility tunnels, down-on-his-luck civil engineer Steve Wilkins finds his mundane life upended. Each door leads to a new, unsettling location, revealing that this is no ordinary tunnel but a portal to a series of bizarre and dangerous dimensions.
A Variety of Environments and Stories
Traverse through abandoned high schools, foreclosed homes, empty offices, and more, each with its own unique story and history. These places, once filled with life, now stand empty and mysterious. Uncover the hidden tales and subplots that add depth to Steve's journey and the overarching cosmic mystery.
Unravel the Mystery
Steve learns more about this strange world through:
Disk cartridges containing games that reveal more about the world
Conversations with otherworldly beings
Scattered notes and documents revealing the fates of the people who once occupied these spaces

title: MOONY:Black_Lotus
description:
게임 정보
Reclaim Your Corrupted Memories
Dive into a captivating world where fragmented memories await discovery! In this side-scroller adventure, navigate the remains of a once thriving civilization and piece together your scattered past. Between classical jump-n-run and puzzle solving, you have to keep a close eye on your surroundings. Explore the depths as you uncover forgotten stories and concealed corruption. On your journey, you must face the truth about your past life while reclaiming the essence of yourself.
You Are Not Alone
Make your way through this hostile world and challenge yourself with uncovering it's secrets. Along the way you'll meet enigmatic strangers - use their powers to navigate the environment on different ways. Learn how to walk through solid steel bars or see in the dark. Can they aid you on your journey? Remember, every light casts a shadow.

title: Rogue Wave
description:
게임 정보
Your team is gone, wiped out the moment you entered this mysterious silicon-based realm. Now, it’s up to you to find your way home, alone.
Harness the power of your Nanobot technology to stay alive, no matter the odds. Their energy is finite, so gather resources so that they can enhance your equipment, weapons, and even your abilities. Define your own unique survival strategy against relentless waves of enemies.
Play Your Way
Precision Weapons: Take control with manually wielded weapons.
Automated Nanobot Weapons: Let your nanobots do the fighting.
Defensive Static Weapons: Fortify your position and defend.
This game is designed to adapt to your playstyle. The real challenge lies in discovering the perfect combination of upgrades to match your strategy and succeed.
Reach the Portal Home
Your mission is straightforward: find the Portal home. Each run features a single portal—can you locate it? Can you reach it? The locals view you as a virus. They want to eradicate you and will stop at nothing to prevent your escape.

If you do manage to reach the portal, where will it lead you? To another part of this bizarre alien world, or back home to your family and friends?
Unleash Your Inner Warrior with Nanobot Upgrades

title: STREAM STRATOS
description:
게임 정보

"STREAM STRATOS" is a 3D action game.
Players progress through stages to liberate areas occupied by enemies.


As you progress through the stages, the variety and number of enemies increase, gradually raising the difficulty level. In the latest stages, strong adversaries await the player.

title: Dungeon Seekers
description:
게임 정보
Dungeon Seekers is a multiplayer VR dungeon adventure featuring drop-in cooperative play, realistic character physics, and immersive combat and climbing mechanics. Team up with friends, battle monsters, and discover treasure as you customize your heroes and upgrade their equipment.
Fully cooperative gameplay.
Block, dodge, parry, and counterattack mechanics.
Realistic interactions with objects and environments.

title: Brave Glin in Fairyaria
description:
게임 정보
Play as Brave Glin, a little magical creature that getting lost in a forest, nedding face dangers on the way to return home!
- Freatures -
∎ Jump! Use enemies as platforms by jumping over their heads! Each enemy has a different reaction when they are trampled!
∎ Defend Yourself! Use a slingshot, a shield and even a stick to defend yourself from enemies!
∎ Super Star! Collect tiny stars, defeat enemies, increasing the experience bar to can collect the great Shooting Stars!
∎ 4 Thematic Worlds! Meet many charismatic characters, crossing the world of Fairyaria!
∎ Friends! The scarecrow Hans and the crow Crowie will help you on the journey!

title: Tower of Whispers
description:
게임 정보
The Tower of Whispers is a rogue-lite hack-and-slash dungeon crawler where you fight your way through the tower, with each floor more treacherous than the last, to harness its powers and unveil its secrets.


Experience thrilling isometric combat, engaging rogue-lite gameplay, and extensive build customization. Delve into the bowels of the tower, where each floor poses new challenges and hidden treasures. Discover a myriad of items that will not only aid you in battle but also allow you to tailor your character's abilities and playstyle.
Unveil the tower's Secrets
Explore the floors of the Tower of Whispers and learn to wield its not-so-chaotic nature to your advantage.
Experience the tower through the eyes of different heroes. Dash and slash your enemies with the thorned knight, Electrocute them from afar with the storm wielder, drag them down to the deepest depths with the sea hunter, and many more to be discovered.
Make use of the dearest objects left behind by other heroes lost to the treacherous tower and infuse mementos into these relics to make them even more powerful.
Discover the stories of the souls trapped within the tower and its mysterious servants that inhabit it. Each relic is filled with extensive lore about the tower, its origins, and purpose.

title: Music Sim Empire
description:
게임 정보
What would the world be without music?

In the year 2150, music is a relic of the past. People have forgotten it. Now it's your task to rediscover it - all the fascinating epochs from the 20th-century jazz to hip-hop. You decide which genre is particularly important to you - which of the individualized musicians you want to hire. Each musician and each genre brings its own exciting characteristics and is worth exploring and experiencing. Take care of your musicians and their needs, let them produce albums, mixtapes, singles, or even a summer hit. Grow into a thriving music empire that dominates the market and the charts. Focus on a single genre or let all genres flourish by creating a precisely planned facility where all processes are strictly timed. Upgrade your musicians, studios, cafeterias, distributions, etc., to suit your needs and watch as simple rooms turn into high-tech laboratories and futuristic studio technology noticeably increases efficiency. Unlock legendary musicians who actually existed. It's worth stopping by regularly even for a short visit. There is always something to upgrade, and special events can occur at any time. These could be XP boosts for a day, discounts, or situations you have to deal with. Do you sell one of your beloved musician because an agent offers you a considerable sum? Do you want to send your most popular musician on a tour? And how do you deal with it when your rappers argue again? Become part of a fascinating world where music gets a second chance and rewrite its history!

title: Galactic Frontiers - Defense Protocol
description:
게임 정보
Galactic Frontiers - Defense Protocol is an immersive tower defense game set in outer space, where players strategically fortify against waves of cosmic invaders using advanced technology and powerful towers.
Created by three-person indie team mañana studios.
Prepare for an odyssey into the far reaches of space with Galactic Frontiers - Defense Protocol. As the commander of humanity's last bastion, you stand resolute against the ceaseless tide of cosmic invaders. Your strategic ingenuity is our beacon of hope, as each wave threatens to engulf our frontier worlds. Erect powerful towers and harness advanced technology to fortify our defenses, forging an impenetrable barrier against encroaching darkness.
Your journey to safeguard humanity unfurls through a series of diverse missions, from daring rescue operations to pivotal defensive standoffs. Each mission presents unique challenges and opportunities to secure the future of our species. With each triumph, humanity edges closer to survival, yet failure is not an option. The stakes loom large, with the fate of our species teetering on the brink with every decision you make.
In the cosmic crucible of Galactic Frontiers - Defense Protocol, the destiny of humanity hangs precariously in the balance. Will you rise to the challenge and steer us toward victory, or will the galaxy succumb to eternal night? The stars await your command, commander. Are you prepared to seize your destiny?
Gameplay
Asteroid Mining: Utilize specialized towers to extract valuable resources from asteroids scattered throughout the level, enhancing your economy and fortifications.
Node-Based Energy Network: Strategically link towers through an intricate energy grid system, optimizing resource distribution and powering defensive capabilities across your installations.
Energy Generation: Erect energy-generating towers to sustain your network, ensuring a steady power supply for your defenses and mining operations.
Defense Towers: Choose from a diverse array of defense towers, including projectile, laser, and missile variants, each with unique attributes and tactical advantages.
Repel Onslaughts of Enemy Forces: Prepare for relentless assaults from enemy forces and repel waves of invaders using your strategic defenses and resource management skills.

title: John Fox
description:
게임 정보
John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor.



But the evil big toad, decided to make an army of John Fox clones.
To lure the protagonist into the lab. The big toad's minions kill Milo, John's pet.
John Fox rushes in pursuit of the harmful toad and encounters an army of clone frogs, which flooded the entire city.

If the big toad manages to defeat John Fox, the world will be doomed to misery and chaos.



Features:

title: BOUNCE GUN
description:
게임 정보
Bounce off the walls and shoot enemies
Select upgrade and debuff
Choose your path

title: Geno 2 the Generals' Orders
description:
게임 정보
Geno the heaven blight and his brother in arms Khad are tasked with taking out demonic generals that have taken over the planet! Destroy giga robots, save the cities, give the citizens theirs homes back, and stop the reign of terror from the 6 masterminds. Collect power orbs to unlock new areas and explore the open world of each location.

title: Rigid
description:
게임 정보


With just a dash and a wall climb ability you can speed through worlds! Parkour your way to the end of the level using launch pads, doors & more!

Explore through four worlds and 40+ levels
A both casual yet action-packed experience
Map Editor: Make and play community-made maps using the map editor
Multiplayer: Race against your friends on official or community-made maps
Leaderboards: Climb up the leaderboards by gaining high scores
Unique scoring system that provides infinite replayability
Move at Mach 10 (it's seriously very fun)

title: Scary Stories
description:
게임 정보
This is a text-based, choose-your-own-adventure style game that presents you with multiple spine-chilling stories where you must navigate your way through with nothing but your wits and any items you find along the way.
Each story has multiple choices which can branch into new paths and even new endings... Along the way, you may be fortunate or smart enough to find yourself something that could be of use.
FEATURES
- Out-the-box Custom Story support!
- Text-based Stories
- Multiple choices/branching paths
- Custom audio sound effects
- Items that can be used to unlock paths/choices
- Configurable settings

title: Enemy Metal
description:
게임 정보

2.5D ROGUELITE SHOOTER WITH UNIQUE GAMEPLAY AND A KILLER SOUNDTRACK

Easy to play yet difficult to master, Enemy Metal features unique starships and vibrant planets. Destroy enemies to unlock new starships and planets and gather crystals to power up your starships.

Battle for Survival
Begin your campaign on Planet Aureus and fight to survive with unlimited time. Compete against players around the world with a global leaderboard on each planet.
Battle against Time
Progress and discover new game modes on Ignis, the Planet of Fire and Glaceus, the Planet of Ice with limited time and increased damage. Battle the mysterious enemy in a race against time in the final challenge on Arcana, the dark moon.

Reach high levels on each planet to permanently upgrade your starships and unlock exciting new planets and starships as you defend the Sunstar System. Gather crystals to restore health and energy and increase your speed, firepower and shields.
Complete achievements on each planet to earn permanent boosts for all your starships.

title: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox
description:
게임 정보
Steel Runner is a VR vehicle crafting sandbox game using physics.
Create your own unique Runner(vehicle) by combining various types of blocks, then ride it to enjoy free exploration, adventure, and combat in an open-world environment.
Game Play
In this vast open-world, you will spawn with a small runner that you are initially given.
Use your runner to chop down trees, gather ores, and fight enemies to collect blocks, modifying and upgrading it to aim for the ultimate runner!
At times, you may want to switch to a different runner, or your runner might get destroyed by enemies.
But don’t worry, as long as you have the materials, you can always summon your runner from the saved blueprint.
Create various amazing runners and make this vast open-world your own!
Design and Construction
Runners can be created by combining 1 x 1 m blocks.
Create a vehicle body, attach tyres and... you're ready to move!
autokwd: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox

title: Cemitério São Sacramento
description:
게임 정보
About the game


In "Cemitério São Sacramento", horror mixes with humor, creating a unique and immersive experience. 

The game relies on a fear that gradually grows, keeping players attentive to every detail to unravel the dark mysteries that surround the place.


Situated in a quiet country town, you move into a humble house you found on the internet. The detail they didn't mention? The house is next to a cemetery! At least the rent is cheap.


As you adapt to your new routine, explore every corner, interact with the environment and experience strange and unexpected events that will transform your everyday life into an intriguing supernatural adventure.

Have complete freedom to explore the world your way. Do you want to unravel hidden mysteries or just live your daily life? The choice is yours. Every day, the house changes, revealing new secrets and tasks that need to be completed.

Interact with common objects, eat something, watch TV, or just pass the time. But don't be fooled by the apparent normality. Over time, your dreams will become darker, sleep paralysis will become more frequent, and what was once familiar will take on a sinister tone.

Every decision you make will shape the course of your story, leading to different endings. Fear will grow subtly, mixed with an unsettling feeling that something is always lurking.

title: Alonecats
description:
게임 정보
We are excited to introduce our new puzzle game in the hidden object genre.



Your task is to find all the cats in the location. You can rotate/zoom the scene and interact with the environment to find all the hidden animals.



Key features:

- over 100 hidden cats
- 5 different locations
- simple puzzles

title: Eldoran
description:
게임 정보
Story
It was an era in which the world was shaken by an unprecedented collision. As our Earth and a parallel universe Earth reached exactly the same position in the universe, shocking anomalies emerged on both worlds. The anomalies selectively fused the Earths together, not only annihilating entire regions but also significantly decimating life on both sides. The few survivors found themselves in a world permeated by mysterious energies and vibrant crystal beings. Eldoran, as the locals of the parallel world named it, became a magical place that evoked both fascination and terror.
Features
Survival
Discover numerous survivors in the open world. Save and recruit them for your camps. Find food, build shelters, and combat diseases to prevent your survivors from succumbing to death.

Base Building
In the open world, you can establish camps anywhere and expand them from a small refuge to a large compound. Build shelters, crafting stations, and defensive measures. Defend your camps against attacks of all kinds.

Farming
With the right tools, you can reforest trees and cultivate various types of plants and food. Care for your growing plants and harvest them when they are ripe.

Crafting
With a variety of workstations, you can craft new armor, weapons, food, and other useful items.

Fishing
Fishing is not just a means of food procurement in Eldoran but also a hobby. Catch fish and bring them to your own waters to breed.

Taming
Many primitive crystal beings from the Earth of Eldoran can be captured and trained to assist you in the struggle for survival.

title: The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity
description:
게임 정보
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© is a survival horror action-adventure game built in RPG Maker MZ and is a prequel to The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows© (Will contain spoilers for The Clown's Forest, This game is best played after beating the first game)
STORY
Blitzo lost control while hunting down Michael. Jonathan had slipped back into control momentarily. Blitzo taunts Jonathan, vowing to destroy him once and for all. Jonathan, stuck in his own body and his own mind, with no way out, has to figure out how to keep himself safe in what was once his own subconscious. Jonathan's mind is slowly dwindling but he has to become stronger than Blitzo himself.

Forcing himself to relive his worst memories and fabrications created by Blitzo, Jonathan has to survive his nightmares to ensure he continues to exist to aid Michael in any way he can. But Blitzo refuses to make it easy for him.
GAMEPLAY
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© Is a top-down Survival Horror game set between the events of The Clown's Forest© and The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows©, Jonathan has to survive his own nightmares to come out on top of Blitzo. Explore familiar and not so familiar locations fabricated by Jonathan's shared subconscious with Blitzo as Blitzo tries destroying Jonathan's soul from the inside.

Puzzles return with more terrifying consequences and new characters and lore will be expanded on as Jonathan not only fights against his past, but also the longhurst family's past as a whole. 

Jonathan has to protect himself from Blitzo. No matter the cost.
autokwd: The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity

title: Love and Demons
description:
게임 정보
특이한 패러디 이세카이 비주얼 노벨. 러브 앤 데몬즈에 오신 것을 환영합니다! .


책임으로부터 도망치고 싶다는 생각이 든 적이 있나요? 강제된 유산을 피해 도망치는 맥스 왕자가 바로 그런 생각을 하고 있습니다.
그러나 그의 탈출은 위험으로 가득 찬 매우 적대적인 환경인 악마의 영역으로 그를 몰아넣습니다.
위험을 감수하지 않고는 집으로 돌아가는 것이 쉽지 않을 것 같습니다.

러브 앤 데몬즈는 폭발적으로 환상적인 픽셀 아트 패러디 이세카이 비주얼 노벨로,] 맥스의 운과 미덕이 시험대에 오르게 됩니다.
그를 구원으로 이끌고, 주사위를 굴려 운명에 도전하고, 능력치를 높여 맥스를 훈련시키고, 이 세상의 수많은 비밀을 밝혀내세요.
다양한 선택지와 얽히고설킨 스토리를 활용하여 수많은 나쁜 결말을 피하고 탐나는 좋은 결말로 가는 길을 개척하세요.

맥스는 자신의 운명을 스스로 개척하고 무엇보다도 살아남기 위해 노력해야 하지만,
혼자서 하는 것이 아니라 모험에 동행할 새로운 기묘한 지인들과 함께 하게 됩니다.

첫 번째 캐릭터는 주인공이자 전형적인 게으른 왕자, 특히 왕실의 책임에 있어서는 더욱 그렇습니다!
당연하게 그는 친구들과 함께 술을 마실 기회를 절대 놓치지 않아요.
그의 게으름과 무관심은 그를 문제의 자석으로 만들었죠. 럭키 부인은 그의 편이 아닌 것 같지만
그는 그녀의 마음을 바꾸기 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다 ... 아마도...
악마의 영역은 이름에서 알 수 있듯이 다채로운 행동을 하는 악마들로 가득합니다.
그래서 수줍음이 많은 카렌은 그들과 관계를 맺는 데 어려움을 겪고, 다른 생명체들처럼 '활기찬' 성격이 아닌 식물과 함께 있는 것을 선호합니다.
하지만 의외로 고집이 세고 자신의 신념이 확고하니 과소평가하지 마세요!
모든 종류의 악마 중에서도 대악마는 가장 강력한 존재로 꼽히는데, 릴리스도 그중 하나입니다.
왕좌의 후계자인 릴리스는 거만하고 거리감이 있어 보일 수 있으며, 사회성 또한 별로 도움이 되지 않을 것 같습니다.
하지만 실제로는 도움이 필요한 사람들을 돕는 것을 좋아하고 곤경에 처한 사람을 보면 참지 못합니다.
다만 한 가지 작은 결점이 있다면 감정을 잘 조절하지 못한다는 것인데, 언제든 '폭발'할 수 있으니 주변에서 말을 조심하는 것이 좋습니다!
물론 기묘한 생명체는 많지만, 오렐리아는 그중에서도 단연 최고일지도 몰라요.
오렐리아는 릴리스의 모조품이 아니니까요. 그리고 감히 그녀 앞에서 그런 말을 하지 마세요. 그녀는 원하는 만큼 지저분해질 수 있으니까요.
하지만 걱정하지 마세요. 시련에서 살아남는다면 그녀의 비꼬는 말과 착한 소녀의 얼굴을 파헤쳐서 그 거친 층 아래에 무엇이 있는지 알아낼 시간이 충분할 테니까요.












맥스는 주점에서 친구들과 맥주를 마시던 중 갑자기 경비병들이 자신을 찾고 있다는 사실을 깨닫습니다.
맥스는 도망치기로 결심하지만 운이 따르지 않아 우연히 무시무시한 악마의 영역에 던져집니다.
이 미지의 땅을 헤매던 그는 흥미로운 세 소녀를 만나게 됩니다.
그는 무엇을 할까요? 이 소녀들은 누구일까요? 집으로 돌아갈 수 있을까요?

title: Zerra's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Zerra's Adventure is a classic turn-based RPG with no random encounters. Explore diverse areas, collect items and treasures to improve your team and defeat the strangest enemies. Level up, learn new attacks, and meet quirky characters on your adventure!




Explore diverse landscapes, from frog-filled forests to infernal deserts and dark caves infested with spiders. Face dangers like spikes, fireballs, and shots as you search for treasures, weapons, and other items that will aid you in your adventure, even in a gym filled with insane bodybuilders.




, from small turtles and pigs to armed rabbits and final bosses such as giant frogs and penguins. Utilize your skill and strategy to overcome their signature attacks and progress through the game.




during your adventure and find secret bonuses that will challenge you with short minigames that reward your skill with special and unique items.




by gaining experience and leveling up. Discover new attacks and passive abilities that offer different benefits to the team. Customize each character with weapons and accessories found during your adventure, choosing between increasing attack, defense, or special abilities according to your gameplay style. The choice is yours!

title: Bloody Shrine
description:
게임 정보
사원의 운명은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 의식을 완수하면서 강력한 악마를 해제하고 강력한 무기를 발견하며 전략적으로 주문과 아이템을 선택하며 강렬한 전투에 참여하세요. 지옥을 파괴하는 시너지를 형성하여 구울리, 엘리트 및 위협적인 보스들에게 혼란을 일으키세요. 도전을 이겨내고 암흑의 무자비한 힘에 대항하여 신성한 신사를 지키 수 있을 것인가요?
특징
다양한 플레이 가능한 캐릭터. 각각은 다른 플레이 스타일을 가지고 있습니다.
도전을 완수하여 다양한 무기, 주문 및 아이템을 해제
엘리트 및 보스를 포함한 다양한 유형의 적과 전투
짧은 파동
게임을 클리어한 후 난이도 상승

title: Fear Faith
description:
게임 정보

Ascend the tower that seems to defy all logic, the first to reach the top floor will be rewarded with everything they could wish for, you won't be the only one trying.
Blood in every direction
Unleash your rage against everyone in any direction, find their vulnerable angle to wreak havoc, and unlock abilities with every victory.
There is no better defense than a good offense
Blocking is two-dimensional, not only will you have to find the perfect moment to block but also the angle from where the attack is coming from to block it in the right direction, if your reflexes are fine enough you will be completely unstoppable.
Boss after boss.
The tower houses different horrors, few but unique in their ways of tormenting you. Your mission will be to find and kill each of them at different heights of the tower.
Feeling alone without being the only person in the room is a terrible feeling.
The end of your ascent will depend on how you have treated those you have encountered on your journey through the tower, decide who you can trust and who can trust you.

title: Combo Haven
description:
게임 정보
Combo Haven is a game that aims to distill the most exciting aspect of platform fighting games: doing cool combos! Without having to worry about putting in countless hours of effort or outplaying opponents with years of practice, in Combo Haven anyone can experience the satisfying thrill of landing a nasty combo.
If you are someone who likes to be challenged, rest assured. Underneath the relatively forgiving and easy to learn controls and physics of Combo Haven, lies a significant level of mechanical depth, for those who aim to beat the developer high scores and reach the top of the leaderboards.
Combo Haven is currently in development. I hope to release a polished free demo to Steam by mid 2025, and the full version by the end of 2025. The demo will include 4-5 levels, with one playable character.
The full version will include 20+ unique levels, and 3 different playable characters, as well as global leaderboards, replay saving features, and an original soundtrack.

title: CountDown
description:
게임 정보


Prepare for a thrilling subterranean adventure in CountDown, a casual pixel-art rogue-like that puts you in control of an omnipotent GLOVE GOD! Set in a charming underground village, devoid of light, you are the last bastion between your townsfolk and the encroaching hoards of mutated fauna. As night falls, your duty is to defend your people, by any means necessary. Will you rely on your "trained" soldiers, or will you unleash your god-like strength to turn the buildings, objects, and even citizens into projectiles to hurl at the oncoming threats?

Delve further into the depths of this chasm to gather resources from the flora which can further fortify your defenses. You'll encounter five unique enemy types in the demo, culminating in an epic boss battle! So don't wait, immerse yourself in the brief yet exhilarating experience of CountDown now!



For any issues or further inquiries about the game, please check out the community discord! There's also information posted here frequently about upcoming updates, as well as sneak peaks at future additions.

title: Ichorous Moon
description:
게임 정보
The Ichorous Moon rises. The guardian bells of Türme are silent. It's institutions fractured by change and in-fighting.
Race through the night to save the city, or condemn it.
Unique 2.5D perspective

Carve a path through the streets of Türme, but watch your back!
An infinite runner when outdoors, get indoors before the moons influence overwhelms you!
Use your lantern and gear to fight through waves of afflicted city-folk and creatures
Rhythm based combat

Charge through overwhelming numbers unscathed, if you have the skills
Dodge hits in waves of QTE challenges
Slow time to effortlessly defeat uncountable swarms
Customise your combat ability with a variety of spells and gear
Die, respawn, advance… but time is always ticking down

The bells you ring can't toll forever; waste no time.
Respawn at the last belltower you reached, and mark your progress through town.
Rougelike progression; your run is over if you die after time runs out!
Procedurally generated city, each run is unique!
Collect ichor and use it wisely to enhance your body and mind

Balance your build or choose a specialization and face the consequences!

title: Death Report
description:
게임 정보
-Pure manual map, without using automatically generated maps
-Pure manual system, easy to adjust
The game includes a puzzle mission and an FPS shooting mission.
puzzle mission: In a space with supernatural phenomena, as an observer, when a supernatural event occurs, you need to click on the correct options and actions to report the supernatural event. If the selection is incorrect, you may fail the misson.
FPS Shooting Mission: You will infiltrate these supernatural spaces, wield weapons, shoot monsters, and monsters will attack you. If operated improperly, you will die.

title: Rune Golf
description:
게임 정보

Rune Golf is an immersive and contemplative golf game where you play as a solitary golf ball traversing the ruins of a forgotten civilization. Your exploration of these lost ruins will require precision, curiosity, and determination to reach the end of numerous levels! In Rune Golf, you can explore the levels as much as you like, but access to the final hole will close if you exceed the allowed number of shots for each level!

ADJUST the power and angle of your shots and navigate through the levels to reach the final hole without exceeding your allowed number of shots!

MODIFY your trajectory at any time: a slow-motion mode activates, allowing you to make extraordinary shots!

the levels without counting your shots, to identify and optimize your path, and discover hidden secrets and rewards!

with the small spirits that inhabit these ruins to uncover the secrets of this lost civilization.

from the beginning of the level with a simple touch until you find the best strategy.

title: Nyana
description:
게임 정보

Embark on Nyana’s journey to liberate her people in the 2D action-adventure Nyana. Armed with all the trappings one would expect from a metroidvania, Nyana also includes a unique base-building feature that is core to the overall experience.


Nyana’s people have been hunted and subjugated by the will of their magic-wielding Masters. But, in the deepest bowels of this world exists a safe haven hidden within an ancient structure and filled with liberated members of Nyana’s people.

As Nyana liberates more of her people in her journey, they will find their way to this safe haven and bring their own resources to help it continue to flourish. New abilities in Nyana are tied to specific buildings that can be placed in the HUB. And new buildings can only be unlocked by liberating more of Nyana’s people throughout the sprawling world.

Save your people. Build your safe haven. And learn new and crucial abilities that will aid you in your quest to uproot the rule of the Masters once and for all.


Ancient civilizations have risen and fallen in the world of Nyana. Along her journey, Nyana may discover more about these civilizations and even unlock secrets that may have been left behind and forgotten by time.


The liberation of Nyana’s people will not be enough. And so the herculean task of uprooting the Masters’ Imperium will also fall on her. The Imperium stands on the shoulders of five key individuals. Eliminating these five individuals will result in the crumbling of the Masters’ society as they know it.


You are not a hunter in this world. It is best to use enemies to traverse past them as you collect resources. However, through the use of custom-created spells, you can combat and execute those who would stand in the way of your vengeance.

As Nyana liberates her people and grows stronger in the process, she will obtain the power she needs to face off against each of the five key Masters, including the head of the snake, the Imperator.

title: Break The Line
description:
게임 정보
이는 무작위 요소를 포함한 전략적인 타워 디펜스 게임입니다.
전술 전투

title: Brickhaven
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Brickhaven
Brickhaven is the very city you and your gang fight to thrive in. Explore the busy streets, check out the shops, and muster up any juicy prospects along the way to help build your criminal empire.
The Empire
-Recruit your members right off the street
-Setup protection rackets, drug fronts, money laundering schemes, and much more to help maximize your profits
-Send members to defend your hard earned rackets and businesses in order to set a physical footprint in the city
-Be as hands off or on as you want, almost everything is able to be automated through delegation
Rule the Streets

title: Christine
description:
게임 정보
Christine is a young orphan who works at the Paris Opera, with an untapped talent for singing. She loves to sing and dreams of being a soprano at the Opera, but she never thought it would be possible.

When she sees that there will be a selection for the lead singer of a majestic opera based on the book Phantom of the Opera by Gaston Leroux, a light goes on.

Our Christine's life has several coincidences with the Christine in that story: an orphan living and working hard at the Paris Opera. She loves music, a passion inherited from her late father, but she didn't have the opportunity to explore that talent and passion.

How will she reconcile her daily tasks with her evolution? Who can she count on: her friends, an Angel of Music, or herself?
Is it worth facing her fears to pursue her goal?

In this interactive story with a unique musical score, follow the defining year in Christine's quest to pursue her dreams.
FOLLOW CHRISTINE'S DEVELOPMENT!


Add “Christine” to your wishlist and follow the game to keep up with the development.


The game will feature art from Katia Numakura (@katia.numakura) and music from Tatyana Jacques (@taty_jacques).
