title: XWarShooterVR
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the immersive world of "XWarShooterVR" a VR shooter where the combination of devastating guns, epic technomagic skills, and base-building strategy delivers an immersive gaming experience.


GAME FEATURES:

TRAINING:
Improve your warriors in martial arts, choose from over 75 characters, each with a unique set of skills. Develop their abilities, upgrade a variety of weapons with different ranges and power. Emphasize the singularity of each hero, shaping their unique style of fighting on the battlefield.


WIN HOWEVER YOU WANT:
Are you a team player or do you prefer solo attacks? Protect allies from enemies or rain meteorites down on your opponents' heads - choose your path to victory. With countless combinations of military arsenal, technomagic skills and a variety of heroes, you choose your play style.


EQUIPMENT:
Each hero is armed with three weapons and boosters. Assemble your deadly combination, boost your power and dominate the battlefield. Become a strategist and weapon master to surpass your opponents.


BUILD:
Build your base, collect resources and boosters to stay one step ahead of the enemy not only in battles but also in building a strong and impregnable base. Take your tactical skills to the next level.


COMPETE:
Take on the challenge and prove your skills in a unique blend of shooter and strategy. Team up with your battle buddies, socialize and compete in exciting battles.


Hone your combat and base-building skills, because in "XWarShooterVR" you will not only have to fight your opponents on the battlefield, but also attack other people's bases, create and defend your own fortifications.
Join "XWarShooterVR" and become a legend in this exciting VR world!

title: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk
description:
게임 정보

Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk is mainly a 2D platformer with lots of different mechanics and a little bit of humor. The game offers various styles of gameplay as you progress.

Ok, so here's a checklist for you:
Do you like platformers?
Do you like short games?
Do you like cheap games?
Do you like stickmans?
Do you like wacky humor?
Do you like various styles of gameplay?
Well, if you answered yes to some of these questions you should consider buying this game.
autokwd: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk

title: Decurion
description:
게임 정보
디큐리온(Decurion)은 빠른 템포의 클래식 탑다운 슈팅 게임으로, 스킬, 정확한 조준, 그리고 전술적 사고가 요구됩니다.
임무: 모든 적을 처치하고, 살아남으며, 기지를 방어하라.
연속 처치를 이어가고, 근접 공격을 활용하며, 빠르게 레벨을 클리어하면 추가 포인트를 획득할 수 있습니다.
라운드 사이에서 포인트를 사용해 다양한 업그레이드를 진행하고 생존 확률을 높이세요. 레벨이 진행될수록 난이도가 상승합니다.
메카와 파일럿 선택
각 메카와 파일럿은 고유한 능력을 가지고 있으며, 이를 조합해 자신만의 플레이 스타일을 완성할 수 있습니다.

title: Kira Legends
description:
게임 정보
In a world where Demons and Dragons are enemies, you must fight enemies, dangerous bosses and explore mysterious dungeons. There is so much to do in the world of Kira Legends, wether it's enagaging combat, intense boss fights, unleashing your inner dragon while flying around the vast world or just playing with friends, there is never a moment where you aren't having a blast.

Here are just some of features you'll get to enjoy in Kira Legends

- Immersive Melee Combat
.

- Unlock new Weapons and Items
.

- Interact with new characters
.

title: OMAPELI
description:
게임 정보
OMAPELI is an action RPG setting in a medieval fantasy world.
Features

Explore the vast world
The over-world is made of multiple different biomes that each host their respective wild-life, structures and mobs. Houses and dungeons also have a lot to be found.

Fight for your dear life
Don't be a fool! Gather your weapons - swords, bows and spell books - and pat-pat the wood resin out of those nasty chairs.

Do Quests
You can find NPCs everywhere - in villages, roaming in the vastness and in big trouble. Do the needful and you will be handsomely rewarded.

Be the person
The character editor can shape the very fabric of your skeletal structure. Be the person you want to be.

Share your journey
A server-client based multiplayer system is in the developments that should allow local LAN and hopefully over-internet multiplayer for 2-10 simultaneous player.

title: TAKE BOMB: The suit take off
description:
게임 정보
The game begins when the player regains consciousness after his spaceship crashes on an unknown planet.
The player is immediately spoken to by a fallen suit, and when he puts it on, he gains the power to create bombs.

However, the weight of the suit prevents you from jumping on your own, and you must use the bomb's blast to jump and overcome obstacles.

The suit can withstand any kind of blast and can even dash with the blast on its back.

Of course, you will also be able to attack with bombs, and your days will be full of bombs.

Change your suit and use your new powers to open up new paths.
autokwd: TAKE BOMB: The suit take off

title: Hell's Scream
description:
게임 정보
Hell is waiting for you!

Go back in time with an old school shooter game.
Imagine yourself in a violent world where mass slaughter cannot be prevented.
All you can do is survive, and that's not going to be easy.

What to expect:
Several large worlds with all types of terrain and weather conditions.
Multiple types of weapons and AI enemies.

In the future:
Multiplayer + tournament
New maps and weapons

title: Observe
description:
게임 정보

Forgotten in ominous rooms, you wander, you look and you solve. Collaborate with yourself to change the past, future and present by replaying your mistakes and creating new ones in this single-player puzzle game. Help your future self to push through, crack puzzles and explore the ethereal. Without yourself, you are left behind.

The game world consists of multiple worlds, each of which is made up of several interlinked rooms of which each contains a puzzle. As you solve, actions from previously completed rooms are replayed. Playthroughs of multiple rooms come together to overcome complex challenges. Thinking ahead to create valuable replays is crucial towards progress.

Solve puzzles using only your eyes. With your vision as the only tool at your disposal, watch as the world around you reacts to being observed.
Multiple worlds with distinctive puzzle mechanics such as lasers, mirrors, conveyor belts and duplicators.
Collaborate with many parallel versions of yourself from the past.
A captivating story about learning from regret.
By traversing through time, you are forced to witness your past mistakes. You confront your own regrets, along with learning about the mistakes of others throughout your journey. The rich environment you travel through is riddled with memories of regret, left behind for someone to listen to. Engage your mind not only through solving puzzles, but by listening to authentic real life stories.
company: Robin van der Horst, Eryk Kiepuszewski,

title: Medieval Life
description:
게임 정보
Medieval Life is a fascinating text-based simulation RPG that transports you into the harsh and challenging world of the Middle Ages. This game revolves around careful planning and smart time management to survive in an era marked by hardships and social hierarchies. From securing your basic needs like food and shelter to managing your daily tasks, you must make every decision thoughtfully to not only survive but also rise to the ranks of the wealthy and powerful.

A central element of Medieval Life is starting a family and navigating the strict social classes of the Middle Ages. Your journey may begin as a simple farmer or craftsman, but with hard work, strategic alliances, and savvy management, you can gradually work your way up. Perhaps one day, you will become a ruler yourself, enjoying the respect and power that comes with the title.

Although Medieval Life may not seem like a complex game at first glance, it is full of depth and strategic challenges. Every decision you make has consequences and influences the course of your game. The combination of role-playing elements and planning makes it an engaging experience that requires both skill and foresight. This is a game that can keep you entertained for hours, providing a realistic insight into medieval life as you work to achieve your own medieval dreams.

title: Dungeons and Diners
description:
게임 정보
In the Diner
Take Orders: Manage food orders as they arrive on your plate.
Cook & Serve: Tackle a hectic kitchen, preparing and plating a variety of dishes that bring life to your diner.
In the Dungeon
Adventuring Guild: Form parties with friends, whether playing online or offline, and set off on collaborative quests.
Inventory Management: Keep a close eye on your loot and ingredients, ensuring you’re always ready for the next challenge.
Character Choices: Select from four distinct heroes, each with unique abilities that can turn the tide in battle.
Development Roadmap & Updates
Our current focus is on perfecting the Demo build. We’re busy gathering player feedback, squashing bugs, and refining core systems—especially the dynamic interplay between diner operations and dungeon adventures. Soon, you’ll experience:
Enhanced combat effects (like a slow effect on the Archer’s Rain of Arrows ability)
Polished town mechanics, ensuring every shop and service—from the General Store to the Diner—operates seamlessly
A richer audio experience that brings every location to life
We’re committed to rolling out regular updates as we work towards a polished Early Access release. Check out our visual roadmap below for a closer look at our progress and upcoming milestones.

title: Cut the Cards
description:
게임 정보
In this roguelike deckbuilder, you cut the cards... literally! With scissors! You can recombine the cut-outs to form new cards, and you can play your custom cards in combat or in text-based dialogue events. The game has a custom language processing engine that will determine the special effects of each new card you make.
(Note: This game does not use generative AI.)

Features:
Hundreds of cards. You can mix-and-match effects from different cards using a unique card-cutting mechanic. There are endless possibilities of what you can make!

title: Invade
description:
게임 정보
INVADE는 최대 4명의 플레이어가 즐길 수 있는 혼돈의 멀티플레이어 파티 게임입니다. 선택한 캐릭터로 다양하고 예측할 수 없는 레벨들을 돌파하고, 상대의 보물 상자를 빼앗아 자신의 기지로 안전하게 가져오세요. 그러는 내내 상대방이 당신에게 사용하는 마구잡이식의(그리고 폭발하는 일이 비일비재한) 파워업을 피해야만 합니다.

로컬 멀티 플레이어 모드 & 온라인 멀티플레이어
INVADE는 친구와 플레이할 수 있는 게임입니다. 최대 4인의 플레이어가 온라인 또는 같은 기기에서 2개 팀으로 나뉘어 플레이할 수 있습니다.

캐릭터
저마다 특색 있는 무기를 갖춘 다양하고 흥미로운 캐릭터들 중에서 신중하게 선택하세요!

레벨
해변, 기차역, 건설 현장 등 다채로운 레벨 중에서 매치 장소를 고르세요!

파워업
상대의 머리 위로 폭탄을 떨어뜨릴 수도 있고, 상대를 용암으로 둘러싸거나 우주로 날려버릴 수도 있습니다! 어떤 게임이든 여러 가지 파워업이 등장하면 더욱 정신없어지기 마련이죠!

title: LlamaRPG: Farm to Fable
description:
게임 정보
Your journey takes you from your birthplace of Sorrelfield to the mysterious Za of the desert and through the fast-paced lives of The Uprooted, to name a few.

Discover all 10 factions and choose your place among them. Llamas always look for greener pastures - it's time to find yours!

Battle through the singleplayer campaign or craft items and trade them with your friends after PvPing.

Master the turn-based combat system and find new ways of playing your character, all while doing it in a game that combines the best parts of your favorite old-school RPGs mixed together into its own unique style.

Key Features
2D 16 Bit Style Graphics
Turn-Based Combat
Complex Crafting System & Professions
Endless Itemization Options
Talent Trees & Specializations
Unique Puzzles & Fight Mechanics
Buy Once - Enjoy Forever: No Monetization or DLCs
Planned Mobile & Console Support

The entire world is meant to have a purpose and often be revisited for various quests, grinds, or simply for fun. No gimmicks, no LlamaPass, no PayToWin mechanics; just pure reward for putting in the work and becoming better at the game.

title: Hop'n & Bop'n
description:
게임 정보
With Hop'n n Bop'n, you'll embark on a rhythmic adventure that blends precision platforming with infectious beats in more than 30 energizing levels.



Master the art of hopping, bopping, sliding, and slamming your way around a selection of hazards that activate in sync to the music. Race against time to set a new high-score or try to hunt down tapes for your collection to unlock cool playlists and costumes.



Explore the game's strategically distributed secret areas, each offering unique unlockables and a variety of different gameplay routes.



If you’re ready, then get started Hop’n & Bop’n!

title: Folk Emerging
description:
게임 정보




Lead nomadic families through the dawn of time in this turn-based 4X strategy game with deeply simulated characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the vast wilderness, gather and trade scarce resources, and stand your ground in risky tactical combat. Discover fire, medicine, language—and survive to tell the tale.

Experience what prehistoric life was like by diving into this exploration of ecology, paleolithic societies, and the origins of culture.





Before agriculture and settlements, we spent hundreds of thousands of years as nomadic hunter-gatherers. Guide your people as you migrate through harsh climates, each posing unique challenges.





Manage the relationships between individuals, families, and tribes. Watch your collective adapt over countless generations. Beware the unintended consequences current choices can have on your great-great-great-grandchildren.





Take calculated risks on the battlefield, because a warrior is not just a warrior. When one falls in combat, the tribe loses not only a fighter but also a skilled hunter, family member, and carrier of hard-won wisdom passed down through the ages.





Hunt, gather, and extract resources from the ecosystems around you, but tread carefully: nature is ruthless and you are at its mercy. Maintain the natural equilibrium or face sudden and unexpected challenges.

title: Horizon Heat
description:
게임 정보
Horizon Heat is an ideal choice for those who love racing and the atmosphere of the 80s and 90s. The player will have to drive straight and avoid other cars on his way. The game design impresses with its bright neon colors and some futuristic elements. The game has several levels, each with its own unique design. The game also has a leaderboard that allows players to compare their results with other players and friends.

The game's soundtrack created specifically for the game, is simply fascinating with its shades of retrowave and vintage sound. You will have to unlock some tracks, but it will not be difficult.

The game has detailed car reflections, you can see the sun and other cars on the road in the reflection. Sometimes you can find strange cars in the game, you will definitely recognize them. Earn money while traveling and buy new cars. You can collect them all.

However, the main thing in the game is the gameplay. It is relaxing and suitable for any player, regardless of experience level. This game will be a great option for those who love the retro vibe and atmosphere of the 80s and 90s, as well as for those who just want to spend time playing a relaxing and beautiful game.

title: Scarleth
description:
게임 정보
모험의 시작
악몽에서 깨어나 오른팔을 잃은 후 회복한 Leth는 이 이야기의 주인공으로, Scarleth의 4개의 크리스탈을 회복하기 위해 여러 지역을 여행해야 합니다. 그렇게 하면 멸망한 붉은 왕국의 남은 것을 구할 수 있습니다.
게임 특징
탐험할 거대한 세계! 비밀과 미스터리, 마을, 그리고 여행 중 마주할 적들이 가득한 곳에 들어가 보세요.
독특한 액세서리와 아이템! 신화적이고 신성한 요소들이 당신이 선호하는 전략으로 게임을 플레이할 수 있게 도와줍니다.
강력한 연금술을 발견하세요! 다양한 자원을 결합하여 마법의 힘을 만들어 보세요.
모든 비밀을 탐험하세요! 어디에나 비밀이 산더미처럼 존재합니다!
레벨 시스템과 강화! 레벨을 올릴 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 대장간에서 금 조각을 사용해 무기와 갑옷을 강화할 수 있습니다.
키보드와 Xbox 컨트롤러 완벽 호환! 가장 편한 방법으로 게임을 조작할 수 있습니다.

title: OOLO
description:
게임 정보
Set off into the lush fantasy world of OOLO, a modern take on the classic isometric adventure game! Embark on a non-linear journey across mysterious forests, haunted catacombs, magical factories, and more as you collect keys, solve puzzles, and discover upgrades that allow you to explore the map in new and exciting ways. Collect memories of previous adventurers to piece together the secrets of the Isle of Souls on your quest to rekindle the World Flame.
Explore a vast world with over 400 interconnected rooms!
Venture through dark forests, subterranean crypts, deadly swamps, and more.
Find new artifacts that change the way you move and interact with the world.

title: Voxel Vanguard
description:
게임 정보
Voxel Vanguard is a dynamic strategy game set in a vibrant voxel world where players must strategically expand their territory by placing interconnected towers. Navigate through voxel worlds, strategically deploy towers, and connect them with tethers to fend off threats and conquer new territories.
Features:
Dynamic Voxel Terrain: Navigate through a dynamic voxel world filled with endless possibilities and strategic opportunities.
Immersive Voxel Art Style: Experience the charm and beauty of a vibrant voxel art style, bringing the game world to life with its unique aesthetic.
Strategic Tower Placement: Strategically place towers across the voxel landscape to expand your territory and defend against incoming threats.
Real-time Destruction Mechanics: Witness structures being built and destroyed voxel by voxel, adding a layer of realism and immersion to gameplay.
Resource Management: Manage resources efficiently to build and maintain your tower network, balancing expansion with defense.
Challenging Enemies: Face off against a variety of challenging enemies, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and behaviors.
Engaging Single-Player Campaign: Embark on an epic single-player campaign filled with story-driven missions and challenging objectives.
Community Creation Tools: Utilize in-game creation tools to design and share custom maps, towers, and gameplay experiences with the community.

title: Escape Alliance
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
Escape Alliance is a fast paced maze runner where you will advance through maps of dangerous enemies, obstacles and projectiles while making sure to not touch the edges of the map. Only one hit will take you out!
Singleplayer/Multiplayer
It's perfectly fine to play the game alone, but if you play with other players, the first player will unlock the next checkpoint for everyone else, making it a collaborative experience.
Some maps will only be available in multiplayer as it will have puzzles requiring multiple players to solve.
The game supports up to 12 players.
Maps
The game will introduce different landscapes and different maps, but as of now only one map and a snow biome has been developed.
Release date

title: Backpacker Guild
description:
게임 정보


Backpacker Guild에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 사악한 몬스터들을 토벌하기 위해 용병을 고용하고 강력한 장비를 제작해서 용병들의 가방을 꾸려주세요. 강한 용병은 여러분들의 손으로 만들어집니다.
주요특징


용병들을 고용하고 그들의 짐을 자유롭게 싸주자
용병들의 가방에 아이템을 배치해주세요. 여러분이 어떻게 아이템을 배치하는지에따라 용병들이 강해지거나, 약해지거나, 이상해질수도 있습니다.



마력지도에는 다양한 보너스와 아이템 제작 레시피가 숨겨져 있습니다.
마나석을 사용하여 레시피와 보너스들을 획득해보세요.



몬스터는 버릴게 없는 훌륭한 자원입니다.
몬스터에게 각종 재료를 얻어 장비를 제작하세요.



길드를 찾아온 손님들은 아이템 제작부터 몬스터 토벌까지 다양한 의뢰를 맡깁니다.
성실하게 의뢰를 수행하여 풍성한 보상을 획득하고 명성을 쌓아보세요.


가방을 싸주었다면 이제 용병들을 믿고 전투를 지켜보세요.
용병들이 전투에서 승리하고 다양한 전리품을 가지고 길드로 복귀할 것입니다.

title: Galactic Frontiers - Defense Protocol
description:
게임 정보
Galactic Frontiers - Defense Protocol is an immersive tower defense game set in outer space, where players strategically fortify against waves of cosmic invaders using advanced technology and powerful towers.
Created by three-person indie team mañana studios.
Prepare for an odyssey into the far reaches of space with Galactic Frontiers - Defense Protocol. As the commander of humanity's last bastion, you stand resolute against the ceaseless tide of cosmic invaders. Your strategic ingenuity is our beacon of hope, as each wave threatens to engulf our frontier worlds. Erect powerful towers and harness advanced technology to fortify our defenses, forging an impenetrable barrier against encroaching darkness.
Your journey to safeguard humanity unfurls through a series of diverse missions, from daring rescue operations to pivotal defensive standoffs. Each mission presents unique challenges and opportunities to secure the future of our species. With each triumph, humanity edges closer to survival, yet failure is not an option. The stakes loom large, with the fate of our species teetering on the brink with every decision you make.
In the cosmic crucible of Galactic Frontiers - Defense Protocol, the destiny of humanity hangs precariously in the balance. Will you rise to the challenge and steer us toward victory, or will the galaxy succumb to eternal night? The stars await your command, commander. Are you prepared to seize your destiny?
Gameplay
Asteroid Mining: Utilize specialized towers to extract valuable resources from asteroids scattered throughout the level, enhancing your economy and fortifications.
Node-Based Energy Network: Strategically link towers through an intricate energy grid system, optimizing resource distribution and powering defensive capabilities across your installations.
Energy Generation: Erect energy-generating towers to sustain your network, ensuring a steady power supply for your defenses and mining operations.
Defense Towers: Choose from a diverse array of defense towers, including projectile, laser, and missile variants, each with unique attributes and tactical advantages.
Repel Onslaughts of Enemy Forces: Prepare for relentless assaults from enemy forces and repel waves of invaders using your strategic defenses and resource management skills.

title: Geno 2 the Generals' Orders
description:
게임 정보
Geno the heaven blight and his brother in arms Khad are tasked with taking out demonic generals that have taken over the planet! Destroy giga robots, save the cities, give the citizens theirs homes back, and stop the reign of terror from the 6 masterminds. Collect power orbs to unlock new areas and explore the open world of each location.

title: NET.CRAWL
description:
게임 정보
NET.CRAWL은 육각형 격자에서 플레이하는 덱 건설 로그라이트입니다.
육각형(노드) 안으로 이동하면 활성화되고 효과가 발동합니다.
청색 노드는 데이터를 제공합니다. 황색 노드 - 크레딧.
녹색 노드는 기본적인 방어부터 창의적인 규칙 변경까지 다양한 효과를 제공하는 개인용 도구상자입니다.
적색 노드는 적대적입니다. 온갖 종류의 문제를 일으킬 수 있습니다.
그리고 자주색이 있습니다.
코어.각각 고유한 능력이나 승리 조건을 가진 미니 보스가 등장합니다. 미니 보스는 매우 강력하고 거의 게임 판도를 뒤흔들 정도입니다. 맞춤형 전략 없이는 이들을 물리칠 수 없습니다.

title: Greed Forest
description:
게임 정보
A real-time strategy tower defense game set in a dangerous yet resource-rich forest. Build your base, shape your defenses, and fend off relentless enemy swarms in a battle for survival and supremacy.
Gather and Grow:
Harvest gold, wood and stone from the forest to expand your base, unlock upgrades, and build advanced tech structures.
RTS Meets Tower Defense:
Experience the strategy of a classic RTS without unit micro-management. Focus entirely on defending against massive waves of enemies.
Campaign and Creativity:
Dive into a challenging campaign or use the built-in map editor to design and share your own custom scenarios.
Greed Forest is about mastering the balance between resource management, strategic planning, and creative defense.

title: Shop Crush
description:
게임 정보
About Shop Crush
Manage your Thrift Shop. Sell a hodgepodge of merch to picky customers. Set the prices, bargain with clients, and turn down suspicious offers. Order popular stock, fight off shoplifters, and manage your reputation — gain or lose it based on your choices!
Own a Thrift Shop
Yes, you own a Thrift Shop! Clients come every day to buy their preferred products. To keep your business profitable, you must monitor your prices and the number of products clients want.
In this choice-driven Visual Novel, you must balance the profitability of the offer with the reputational loss that every purchase can cause.

title: Meowstery of a Growing Aurora
description:
게임 정보
About the game
'Meowstery of a Growing Aurora' is a 2D side-scrolling adventure set within an exciting, but familiar setting. Travel through the world of the VR-MMORPG Shenanghia and help Rhyn find a way to shrink her pet cat, Aurora!
Key Features
Meticulously created levels spanning from dense jungles to monster infested castles
An engaging story with multiple endings (should you be quick and bold enough to earn them)
Non-Metroidvania progression; “Meowstery of a Growing Aurora” is a linear game, with different stages, and upgrades being awarded once a level has been reached
The ability to pet Aurora (in both her small and large state)
Story
The year is 20XX, and Eleanor (in-game name Rhyn), a player of the mega-popular Virtual Reality MMORPG Shenanghia has agreed to an interview with Mr. Slater, a freelance gaming journalist; to tell her side of the story from that fateful afternoon in December 203X, when Aurora, her in-game pet cat grew to massive proportions.
Released in the not-so-distant future of 20XX, Shenanghia is a Virtual Reality MMORPG that took the world by storm.
Built on the promise that its servers will never go offline, and anything that happens in the game’s world is persistent, its players have started calling it their new home, almost like a second (virtual) life.
Bonds are made, relationships built (and ruined), and jobs are created.
However, every game has its dips in popularity.
And every time the number of players active on Shenanghia’s servers starts to dip, a near cataclysmic event happens!
From Lizardfolk rising up from the swamplands and briefly taking over the central kingdoms, to Werewolves massively increasing their numbers every time they kill something in the game; something always occurs.
And from those occurrences the Bounty Bands were born!
Consisting of high-level players with a thirst for glory, these groups take on the deadliest challenges, clear the trickiest dungeons, and hunt any creature (or player) that would pose a big enough threat to be noticed by the community.

title: Jumpers' mountain
description:
게임 정보
Join our little friends on this adventure, jumping between platforms to uncover the paths of 'Jumper's Mountain'. However, beware, as there are many secrets to reach the top, and a miscalculated jump can be quite costly.


Jumpers' Mountain is a platform and puzzle game where you'll need to master the jumping technique to discover which creature lives at the top of the mountain. This journey won't be easy, but remember that with every wrong jump comes a new chance to do better.
Hold to charge and release to jump.
The scenery is a good reference to know how high or far you can jump.

title: Yarn Guardians
description:
게임 정보
Yarn Guardians is a 2D action-adventure that combines elements of shoot'em up games and the open level structure of Metroidvania games with twin-stick shooter controls.

Help Rudy and his friends to restore the balance in a fragmented world:
Rudy's peaceful life changes abruptly when his home is wrecked by carrot wielding bunnies. He embarks on a journey unaware that he is following in the footsteps of the legendary Yarn Guardians. On his path, the adventurous cat encounters power-hungry villains, shady characters and new friends.

title: Into The Mine
description:
게임 정보
EVER WISHED FOR... an Indiana Jones style adventure blended with an old-school shooter? Light a torch. Grab your shotgun. Prepare for a cursed adventure -  
Not all that glistens in the darkness is GOLD!

title: CrateMage
description:
게임 정보
CrateMage isn't just a puzzle game, its a game obsessed with having you use your crate infused powers to overcome some truly devious puzzles. If you're like me & have a crippling addiction to moving boxes around then this experience will ignite that visceral lust in your brain's burnt out pleasure centers and satiate your crate cravings!
