Features
Crates
Metal Crates
Crates which look slightly different to the aforementioned Crates

title: Jump the Track
description:
게임 정보
Meet Sam, a slacker too ambitious for his own good, whose life suddenly takes an absurd turn into a hectic and dangerous adventure that defies all odds! 
It’s a matter of life or death, can Sam find a way out?
Jump the Track is an explosive comedy that blends visual novel with pachinko.
Sam struggles with inner turmoil and conflicting emotions. You have the power to guide fate—roll the ball and see where the story takes you!

title: Rise of the Bugs
description:
게임 정보
A colony of Bugs living in the basement of a house is running out of food. The elder sends a search group to retrieve the mystical sauce from the kitchen. There are legends that this sauce allows cockroaches to mutate and become stronger. Can you survive in the kitchen and come back a winner?
Interact with your Bugs-friends and random passerby as you mission! They will give you information that help you, and you can get even closer to kitchen goal!
RISE OF THE BUGS features a branch of improve and mutations of the Bugs. Unlock new playable characters as you progress through the game. Each of them has unique animations and new capabilities.

title: Red Squad Reborn
description:
게임 정보
Red Squad Reborn is a third-person and first-person shooter combat game, plunging players into the heart of World War III's relentless conflict between NATO and Russian forces. Set in a near-future battleground torn apart by global tensions, the game immerses players in a gripping narrative-driven experience filled with adrenaline-pumping action and strategic gameplay.
Game Modes:
Team Deathmatch
Free For All
Search and Destroy (TBA)
Last Man Standing (TBA)
Domination (TBA)

title: Rogue Wave
description:
게임 정보
Your team is gone, wiped out the moment you entered this mysterious silicon-based realm. Now, it’s up to you to find your way home, alone.
Harness the power of your Nanobot technology to stay alive, no matter the odds. Their energy is finite, so gather resources so that they can enhance your equipment, weapons, and even your abilities. Define your own unique survival strategy against relentless waves of enemies.
Play Your Way
Precision Weapons: Take control with manually wielded weapons.
Automated Nanobot Weapons: Let your nanobots do the fighting.
Defensive Static Weapons: Fortify your position and defend.
This game is designed to adapt to your playstyle. The real challenge lies in discovering the perfect combination of upgrades to match your strategy and succeed.
Reach the Portal Home
Your mission is straightforward: find the Portal home. Each run features a single portal—can you locate it? Can you reach it? The locals view you as a virus. They want to eradicate you and will stop at nothing to prevent your escape.

If you do manage to reach the portal, where will it lead you? To another part of this bizarre alien world, or back home to your family and friends?
Unleash Your Inner Warrior with Nanobot Upgrades

title: Pirate Escape
description:
게임 정보
In Pirate Escape, you play as one of several captains and control a pirate ship, trying to survive 15 waves. You can turn your ship left and right, but never stop. Shooting is automatic. When you destroy enemy ships, they drop crates of coins. Between waves, you can buy items in the store or hire crew members.

title: Ultimate Panzer
description:
게임 정보
Ultimate Panzer is an action roguelike in which you control one of several powerful tanks. Equipped with a huge arsenal of unique weapons, the player explores procedurally generated dungeons made up of hundreds of hand-crafted arenas battling challenging foes.

DEADLY ARSENAL

The player will discover many new weapons throughout his voyage, such as cannons, machineguns, lasers, rocket launchers, grenade launchers and much more. Each weapon type enables unique gameplay ideas.

ROBOT ALIENS

The main adversary in the game are the evil robot aliens that conquered Earth. The fearless tank commander must defeat them to save the planet.

title: Road Warriors
description:
게임 정보
Become a warrior of the road!

Road warriors is a casual rogue-lite game where you can create a build to fight against tons of enemies, becoming stronger and stronger throughout the run!

Features

Builds
Unique items to compose your build

Weapons
Multiple weapons to be unlocked

Original soundtrack
Originally composed music to keep you on the road.

title: Nimillion - The last expedition
description:
게임 정보

‘Nimillion’ is a fun yet challenging physics-based, rocket ship simulation adventure located in a ‘Metroidvania’ style open world. Fly your ship by controlling only its thrusters. Acquire new ship abilities: a grabbing rope, short boost, shield and more. Fine-tune your ship’s hardware to adjust thruster forces, fuel consumption and more. With the help of upgrades and tuning of your rocket ship, you must rely on your skills to explore your surroundings navigating through difficult terrain, environmental phenomenons, physics puzzles and platforming challenges while avoiding hostile entities.
ACQUIRE NEW ABILITIES

Rope tool, booster, 0 gravity and more!

Prepare for tough boss fights

Pilot your rocket ship carefully going through winds, waterfalls, sandstorms, gravity fields, vegetation and more

Use gravity, recoil, force fields and other physics-based features to your advantage

title: Puzzled Hive
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to "Puzzled Hive", a simple-styled puzzle game set in a beehive. In this game, you will take on the role of Meo, exploring mysterious places with the help of Noth to uncover answers. Will you choose to leave?
Demo Version
Currently, full controller support is not available (UI cannot be controlled with a controller).
We have completed the Demo (Version 0.2), which includes:
• A basic art style has been established, with all materials hand-drawn, giving a simple and clean overall style.
• Mechanism of switching between multiple floors.
• Explore with your companion Noth.
• A variety of puzzles created with multiple mechanisms.
Full Version Prospects
Due to time constraints, the map design of Demo 0.2 does not meet our expectations. The official version will include more puzzle mechanisms, enriched maze puzzles, scenes with diverse styles, more NPCs, and a completed storyline. If you like the adorable Meo and Noth, or if you love playing 2D puzzle games, please don't miss it!
Words from the Developers
Hello! We are Player Links Players (PLP, which means "drifting bottle" in Chinese), a studio currently working on our first indie game. Although there are still many shortcomings at this moment, it's just the beginning. In the official version, we will do our best to create an interesting game! And special thanks for Vira Lee, who created bgm for Puzzled Hive!
Contact us
We will welcome any idea or suggestion. You can find us via:
• Bilibili: 深名五介是在下（will update my developing progress here）
• QQ group: 930475923
• Email: 1163684623@qq.com/shenmingwujiegojiu@gmail.com
A picture of me with Meo and Noth drawn by my friend EZ to celebrate the demo launch!
Thank you for supporting, and we are looking forward for your experience in Puzzled Hive!

title: Menes
description:
게임 정보
Step into the enigmatic role of Menes, a celestial being without memory, thrust into a desolate realm filled with ancient secrets and relentless foes. As you traverse unforgiving landscapes, you must unravel the truth behind your mission, uncover forgotten powers, and confront the dark forces that threaten to undo the fabric of existence itself.
MENES combines intense platforming with the punishing challenge of a souls-like adventure experience. Navigate diverse prison realms, each filled with unique perils and foes—from cunning guardians to massive, elemental beings. Hone your skills, master tactical combat, and piece together the mysteries that bind the realms together.
Will you survive the trials and discover the truth about the origins, or will you fall to the shadows lurking in the desert and beyond?

title: The Shadowed Rune
description:
게임 정보
당신은 위험으로 가득한 잊혀진 탑에 도착했으며, 탈출할 방법이 없습니다. 당신의 유일한 기회는 탑 꼭대기에 올라가 룬 유물의 힘을 사용하여 저주를 푸는 것입니다. 마이아와 다른 탐험가들이 저주받은 탑의 비밀을 밝히는 것을 도와주세요!
The Shadowed Rune은 솔로 또는 2인 협동 모드*로 플레이할 수 있는 도전적인 로그라이크 게임입니다. 룬의 힘을 결합하여 새로운 주문을 발견하고 탑을 올라 저주를 푸세요. 친절해 보이지 않는 적들과 마주하게 되고, 원소의 힘을 현명하게 사용해야 하는 퍼즐도 있습니다. 각 층을 지키는 보스들에 대해 언급했나요? 그것들은 시작에 불과합니다...
*로컬 협동 멀티플레이어는 최소한 하나의 연결된 컨트롤러가 필요합니다.
주요 특징:
총알 지옥 액션 요소, 퍼즐, 도전적인 보스가 있는 독특한 로그라이크 모험.

title: Aisla
description:
게임 정보
Play as Aisla, a woman who wakes up with no memories in a complex on Mars.
Your objective is to explore the environments and discover who the character is and what situation she is in.

Key Features:

- Narrative Driven Adventure
- Cinematic Cutscenes
- Mind Map: Keep track of your discoveries
- Collectables Objects
- Licensed Indie Soundtrack & Original Soundtrack
- Hand-painted mixed with semi realistic visuals

title: Paranatural
description:
게임 정보

온라인에서 다른 플레이어와 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 계약을 완료하며, 다양한 초자연 사냥 장비를 사용하여 유령을 식별하세요.
식별된 유령의 유형에 따라 독특한 퇴마 의식을 수행하세요.
주의: 퇴마에 실패하면 파괴적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다.
현재 16가지의 독특한 퇴마 의식이 있으며, 출시 후 더욱 많은 의식이 추가될 예정입니다.


Paranatural은 이전에 본 적 없는 독창적이고 동적인 유령 시스템을 사용합니다.
50가지 이상의 동적 반응 기반 유령 이벤트로 이루어진 전에 없던 무서운 경험이 언제나 가까이에 있습니다.
유령은 당신의 모든 움직임을 학습하고 적응하여, 자신의 능력과 환경을 활용합니다.
동적 유령 시스템은 모든 기본 게임 위치뿐만 아니라 커뮤니티가 만든 사용자 지정 위치에서도 자동으로 작동합니다!


유령 사냥의 여정 동안 유령 사냥에 특화된 애플리케이션이 장착된 특별한 전화기가 제공됩니다.
이 애플리케이션들은 영구적으로 전화기에 남아 있으며, 레벨 업할수록 게임 내 상점에서 구매할 수 있습니다.


Unreal Engine의 MetaHumans를 사용하여 완전한 기능을 갖춘 캐릭터 커스터마이저로 외모와 의상을 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.
또한 계약으로 벌어들인 돈을 사용하여 창고 내부를 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.

title: Primland The Magus -プリムランド　ザ　メイガス
description:
게임 정보
Children disappeared, adults turned into carrion...
A certain isolated island that turned into hell
Collect "relics" sleeping on the island and acquire skills.
Take on mysteries and powerful enemies using a variety of actions!
A dark fantasy 2D action game by Magus, the girl in black.

Dark and rich 2D action all drawn with pixelart!
Enjoy the action of the player charactor ”Magus” with classic and easy-to-understand controls!
Revive the attacking opponent and use it as a trigger for jumping through walls, etc.
Don't just defeat the enemy, use a variety of skills to move forward!
The dramatic truth surrounding the girls Mags, where guilt, anger, and sadness intertwine.
autokwd: Primland The Magus -プリムランド　ザ　メイガス

title: Pilot Light
description:
게임 정보
When all of the stars in the sky go dark, it becomes your mission to venture to the planet at the center of the universe and re-illuminate the pilot light. Your only guidance to your goal is the light from the engine of your rocket.

Navigate through tight spaces and dodge dangerous obstacles placed by peculiar enemies coming from the darkness. One wrong touch to your rocket will spell certain doom.
Key Features
8 Worlds
80 Levels
8 Bosses
Challenge Modes
Voice-acted cutscenes

title: Decktamer
description:
게임 정보


Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?

In Decktamer, you'll encounter creatures that have adapted to their strange environment: the abyss. Rumor has it that anyone brave enough to reach the bottom of the giant crater will find great fortune. But watch out, as you dive deeper, the creatures only get more and more bizarre and dangerous...
ROGUELIKE DECK-TAMING
In this game, cards are not simply handed out to you, you have to tame your enemies to add them to your deck!
But be careful, when one of your creature dies, the card is gone forever!

STRATEGIZE EACH TURN
Every turn, each one of your cards can use a move. Try to think about the optimal play to win your battle in this turn-based combat system! Will the turn plan out as you expected?

The Abyss is filled with mutant creatures that possess abilities they shouldn't normally have. Use that to your advantage and transfer abilities from one creature to another to create unique and devastating combos!



Only one question remains...

title: Twilight Epoch
description:
게임 정보
As the Blight grows with each passing day, the worlds wither in turn. The drifting planes that still light the sky fade like embers, and the powers that live to see them covet dominion of the few centuries that remain. A young man from a distant plane is taken from his home, and fights to find peace, before all ends in silence.
Embark on an adventure through a mysterious science-fantasy galaxy, blending intense FPS action with the customization of a party-based RPG, across endlessly replayable levels of strange and sprawling worlds.
A GALACTIC JOURNEY
A campaign split into 3 books, with 20+ enormous levels to be explored and plundered, each handcrafted and fully unique with their own aesthetic, lore, and enemy roster.
Ancient temples, shadowy space piers, towering cities; all dense with loot, secrets, and deadly encounters.
BUILD YOUR PARTY
Swashbuckle and parry with dual cutlasses, rocket jump with a mecha arm cannon, battle as a knight in explosive armour, or just throw big rocks at people.
Use 6 characters, 100+ unique weapons across 18 types, plus a wide range combat abilities, passive-granting armours, and items that all make meaningful differences to your playstyle.
RAW COMBAT
Face off against 50 enemy types and a slew of brutal bosses in combat combining bullet hell, hack-and-slash, and FPS.
Each encounter is a combat sandbox against legions of enemies who want you dead yesterday.
DEEP MOVEMENT
B-hopping, air-strafing, explosive jumping, slope-physics, a whole list of equipment specific techniques + Unlimited sprinting!
Use your agility to out-maneuver attacks, reach remote treasures, and speed through the highly vertical environments.

title: Soulrise
description:
게임 정보
Soulrise is a game about high-risk jumps, inspired by Jump King and other precision platformer.

Trapped beneath a forgotten tower, lost souls await your help. They must ascend to the top of this Structure, overcome challenging obstacles and uncover hidden secrets - you're their only chance of salvation. Every jump must be carefully considered, as there's a lot at stake... One mistake and your progress is set back by an unpleasant fall.




Experience Soulrise alone or with up to three friends
Rotate your sword 360° around your player to determine the direction of each jump
Hold and release at the right moment to give your jumps the necessary power
Explore a tower with 10 different sections and hidden secrets
Try to avoid mistakes... Every fall has serious consequences.




Experience Soulrise alone or with up to three friends. Explore the abandoned tower together to find the best path to the top.
Or compete against each other in a specially designed mode.

title: Quantum Beast
description:
게임 정보
Quantum Beast focuses on rumble fighting that you need to fight against massive enemies ALONE. So if you are confident of your power, then go for it.
Gameplay Elements:

Cool Fighting Style
Kick the robots in the ass!
This is the core mechanic that you can counter enemy's attacks to blow them in the air. And after that, a heavy strike kick could teach then a good lesson.


Throw them toward the wall!
Hit the enemies back. When they hit the wall, the additional stamina damage could stun them more easily.




Shoot or explode, your choice.



Weapons and resources are spread in the whole area. Those little things could help you pass through the challenges.

title: Plant Budz 98
description:
게임 정보
Plant Budz are pets raised on your new retro desktop. Budz react and evolve based on how you interact with it. Each final evolution transforms into a unique game, which can unlock new rewards and ways to play games. Transport back to the golden era of desktops to find new-age twists on nostalgic classics!

title: Cabral's Quest
description:
게임 정보
Cabral’s Quest is a pixel art puzzle game set in a hidden world underneath the wetlands, ancient homeland of the capybaras.

Make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed to help Cabral reclaim their land. Use different runes to change the elements of the world around you to solve each puzzle.
GOALS



RESCUE BABY CAPYBARAS
Baby capybaras are hidden across the world, lost after the occupation of their lands.
They're optional collectibles to prove your ability.

OBTAIN EACH FRAGMENT OF THE SACRED DEED
And help Cabral recover the land of his community.
Cross portals, doors or bridges and try to avoid the wildlife around to make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed.

CONCEPT

LOGICAL AND LATERAL THINKING
Set in a calm atmosphere, encouraging deep thinking in both logical and lateral ways.


Based on the combination and switching of game elements’ colors, allowing for an accessible but rich gameplay.


Crafted with specific wildlife and natural elements that expand the original mechanics creating new experiences and puzzles.




Use the to modify the elements of the world, changing their color and disabling them to solve the puzzles.


Each element and enemy has different behaviour, and color is always at the core of each mechanic.

Use portals, doors, bridges and other elements to move around the levels.

Avoid the corrupted wildlife that will make your way to the harder.

title: WANKO WANKO ADVENTURE
description:
게임 정보
Setting:
The mutation came suddenly.
A mysterious virus attacked everything, transforming everything into a square shape.
Buildings, creatures, even dogs.

You are a dog that has been transformed into a square.
You must go deep into the resort hotel to find your lost family and solve the mystery.


How to Clear:
The door to the hotel room is sealed and you are locked in,
The door to the hotel room is sealed and you are locked in, but if you clear all the squares scattered around the room, the door will open and you will be able to move on.


Controls:
The strange floating paddle on which the dog rides can be operated in various ways!

It can push a large number of objects like a bull tozer,
or swing it like a tennis racket to send things flying far away,
Sometimes they collect things in one place and sometimes they roll them around.

The objects are moving with physical behavior, so you can control them intuitively as if they were right there, and everyone can enjoy the game with a refreshed and exhilarated feeling.


Hotel:
Scattered objects vary from room to room.
Black pollutants are burned in the incinerator, or the luggage of travelers is taken to the collection station,
mysterious precious metals in a collection device, sometimes bold, sometimes subtle.

This new beautiful world combines the retro architectural tones of the 70's with the poly-poly, shiny CG expressions of the 90's.
What lies behind the facility? Will dogs be able to meet their families?
Operation Doggie Doggie is a fun adventure action game with intuitive controls.
autokwd: WANKO WANKO ADVENTURE,ワンコワンコ大作戦

title: Inhabitants
description:
게임 정보
Watch the development of this game live on twitch!
Inhabitants is a single-player horror game that has you delve into the mysterious disappearance of your friend.
They left without a trace. Their apartment was left unlocked and seemingly empty. Maybe there is something that can point you in the right direction?
Uncover the mysteries behind their disappearance. 
Your only clue is their computer. But what lies within may not be best if found.

title: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzle Challenge
description:
게임 정보
This game is an ultra-high difficulty jigsaw puzzle where players embark on a challenging journey. Players must fit pieces into the correct positions to complete images generated randomly using colored tiles.

However, this game deviates significantly from traditional jigsaw puzzles. Placing a piece triggers several unexpected events. For example, with each piece placed, the colors gradually fade, increasing the difficulty for players to discern the image. Additionally, the workspace gradually shrinks, forcing players to work within tighter confines.

Moreover, placing a piece in the wrong position triggers an explosion, resetting the game from the beginning. Players must carefully select pieces and place them accurately.

Furthermore, players may encounter falling debris when placing pieces, obscuring their view and adding to the challenge.

This game serves as a test of players' concentration and strategic thinking, offering an extremely challenging puzzle experience. Can players accurately fit all the pieces and complete the puzzle?

title: Archery Pro VR
description:
게임 정보
Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR!

There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

Be warned, archery is extremely addictive and challenging.

You can compete online with friends or other players and climb the tournament ranks and unlock amazing rewards.

Players can also experience a realistic and challenging single player campaign by tackling specific trick shots and situations. Friends can compare scores and progress with each other on the leaderboard.

title: Echoes of Elpis
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Elpis is a thrilling twin-stick shooter set within the mighty spaceship Elpis. Battle against relentless enemies, unlock powerful upgrades, and reveal the ship's secret past.



Fight your way through Elpis's rooms to unearth rare technology and artifacts. These epic finds offer power-ups that transform your gameplay, enabling mastery over the ship's defenses.



Echoes of Elpis melds the unpredictability of roguelite adventures with relentless sci-fi action. Adapt and refine your tactics with every run. The deeper you venture into Elpis, the more its legacy unfolds, beckoning you to etch your name among the stars as the ultimate treasure hunter.

title: Angel
description:
게임 정보
브레이크비트 리듬 레이싱 디지털 기후 변화가 eCho 네트워크의 멸종을 위협하는 PSX 영감을 받은 리듬 레이싱 모험 ANGEL에 몰입하세요. 정체된 네트워크에 새로운 활력을 불어넣기 위해 새로운 브레이크 비트를 제작하면서 디지털 풍경을 통해 추진합니다. ANGEL은 레이싱의 흐름 상태에 브레이크비트 음악의 복잡성을 부여하여 아케이드 및 콤보 기반 게임 플레이를 재정의하며, MyraTV, Superdeath 및 많은 다른 브레이크비트 애호가들의 사운드트랙으로 강화됩니다. eCho가 멸종 위기에 처했을 때 ANGEL 프로토콜 - 탐험, 창조, 성찰 - 이 계속됩니다. 연결된다는 것이 무엇을 의미하는지 묻는 여정을 시작하세요.\r\n\r\n

title: The First Mine
description:
게임 정보
The First Mine is a relaxed turn based building and puzzle game. You need to run a productive gold mine by placing, grouping and upgrading various resource tiles without being distracted by different game events.
Play as a single player or in multiplayer mode with friends
Place, group and upgrade various tiles to collect resources
Run a productive mine with your population to mine gold
Don't let different game events distract you
Play a calm and relaxed game alone in single player mode or play together with up to 4 friends in multi player mode. Each round you have to place, group and upgrade various tiles to mine gold and collect resources like wood, stone, wheat and fish.
To mine gold, you need people in your villages. To keep them, you must provide enough wheat and fish. More people and a higher level increases the amount of gold produced per round. You need wood and stone to upgrade the level.

title: The Truth
description:
게임 정보
"The Truth" is a psychological horror game where you play as a police officer who is investigating a suspected criminal. You need to solve different puzzles to solve the case. Find out what happened to the family and the suspected criminal. As you delve deeper into the investigation, you begin to realize that things are not as they seem. The truth is elusive, and the more you uncover, the more terrifying the situation becomes. As you uncover the dark secrets of the family and the suspected criminal, you will be forced to confront your own fears and anxieties.
Singleplayer
The Truth features a singleplayer horror experience powered by Unreal Engine 5
Story
Discover secrets and find the truth about the case you are investigating.
Find out what happened and don't die.
Puzzles
The Truth features several puzzles and challenges to solve.
Highly detailed environments
The games features more than one simple house. It features several houses, a huge forest and more.
Checkpoint and save system
You don't need to start over when you close the game. There are many checkpoints that automatically save the game. There are also many save-devices that you can find during your journey.

title: Potata: Foxy Tale
description:
게임 정보


포타타 : Foxy Tale에서는 당신은 매혹적인 우주에 빠져들고 마법의 숲을 탐험할 것입니다. 조국을 구하는 유일한 방법은 숲속의 정령 조각을 모으는 것입니다.

숲과 주민들의 운명은 작지만 용맹한 여우에게 달렸습니다. 당신의 손 안에 지니고 있는 자연 마법의 힘은 세상을 구하기 위한 어떤 도전도 극복하는 데 도움이 될 것입니다

title: Shadow Codex
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Codex invites you into a mystical world where magic meets mystery. In this cooperative puzzle-horror game, you and your friends take on the roles of a daring explorer and wise researchers, each with your own crucial part to play. Set in an enchanted forest filled with secrets, you’ll need to communicate effectively and strategize together to uncover ancient truths and combat malevolent witches.
As the explorer, navigate through atmospheric, richly detailed environments—from a enervating graveyard to a frozen lake—each haunted by a distinct elemental witch with unique powers and vulnerabilities. Meanwhile, the scholar assists by deciphering a mystical book filled with lore, puzzles, and spells essential for progress and survival.
Asymmetric Co-Op: Engage in a unique cooperative format where one player explores in-game locations while the other consults interactive documents to provide guidance and solve puzzles.
Mystical Environments: Explore three beautifully rendered, eerie locations each themed around natural elements of fire, ice, and blood, with challenges and aesthetics to match.
Interactive Puzzles: Solve a variety of dynamic puzzles that require real-time communication and collaboration, ranging from brewing ancient potions to decoding celestial alignments.
Rich Narrative: Unravel a gripping story woven through interactions and discoveries in the game, revealing the histories and secrets of the witches you face.
Replayability: With multiple solutions to problems and various strategies to defeat the witches, each playthrough offers new challenges and outcomes.
Atmospheric Visuals and Sound: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world complemented by a haunting soundtrack that enhances the mysterious and foreboding atmosphere of the forest.
Accessibility Modes and Customization: Don't want the enemies listening to you? Turn it off. Just want a chill puzzle experience with your friends? Shadow Codex has that. Want jump scares and butt-clenching terror? That's there for you too.
In Shadow Codex, your teamwork will be tested as you delve deeper into the forest’s shadows. Can you and your partner banish the darkness together, or will you be consumed by the secrets that lurk within? Step into the forest, and discover what lies beyond the veil.

title: Treasure Islands
description:
게임 정보
Treasure Islands is a budget price first-person adventure by Mark J. Lovegrove, for Screen 7.
A Tale From Triassic Zoo...
Nick and Pippa have inherited Uncle's assets and among them, an old abandoned museum! To see it re-opened they will need a new selection of exhibits, artefacts & curiosities!
The search will stretch to far away islands, each with their own character, quirks and treasures to be found! But beware - they are not the only opportunists out there...
Mysterious caves, curious locals and strange events - with YOUR help the treasure hunting team will keep their wits about them as they search for that all important centre-piece!
But what are the shady scientists up to? Is Uncle still out there? Will Triassic Zoo keep turning in your absence? And what other mysteries await? Find out in Treasure Islands - Soon !!
Pieces Of Fate...
» Explore 7+ islands in a light-hearted single-player adventure story
» Quirky characters & creatures to meet with full English voice acting + subtitles
» 120+ minutes of engaging licensed music + an additional 60 minute underscore
» Filled with atmospheric sound, in-game achievements & many other secrets!
Treasure Islands contains infrequent cartoon violence and is suitable for most ages.
You may also be interested in Mr. Maze, already available on Steam!

title: Nine Lives Ninja: Survive!
description:
게임 정보
고양이(닌자이기도 한)로서 악한 숲 속 생물들의 무리와 싸우세요. 압도당하기 전까지, 또는 놀라운 역경을 극복하고 하루 더 생존할 때까지 궁극의 닌자(고양이이기도 한)를 만들며 최대한 오래 살아남으세요.

Nine Lives Ninja: Survive는 여러 가지 능력, 업그레이드, 고양이 커스터마이징이 가능한 캐주얼 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다. 손으로 그린 캐릭터, 적, 환경을 정성껏 만들었습니다.
특징
무기는 가까운 적에게 자동으로 발사되어 생존에 집중할 수 있습니다
세 가지 활성 능력: 회피, 함정 만들기, 당신을 위해 싸우는 그림자 분신 만들기
고양이 커스터마이징! 서로 다른 시작 장비를 가진 여러 고양이를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다
런 사이에 업그레이드에 투자하여 더 오래 생존하고 더욱 치명적이 되세요

title: Valourglade
description:
게임 정보
After a devastating raid by monsters, a once-thriving village lies in ruins. It's up to you to rebuild the village from the ground up. Explore the world to gather resources, face formidable bosses, and gather blueprints to craft new tools and construct buildings. As you help villagers with quests and restore their home, you'll earn their trust—and uncover the mysteries of the land.
Rebuild the Village: Gather materials from caves and forests to craft tools and rebuild homes, shops, and key structures.
Fight Epic Bosses: Battle fierce monsters guarding powerful loot like blueprints and upgrades that will transform your village.
Help the Villagers: Take on side quests to earn rewards and strengthen your bond with the townsfolk, unlocking new features and abilities.
Craft and Upgrade: Build everything from basic tools to advanced structures, expanding your village’s potential with each new blueprint you discover.
Can you bring peace and prosperity back to the village and defend it from the dangers that lurk beyond?

title: Daimyo Reign
description:
게임 정보
Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!
Build
-Building improvements allow you to increase your wealth, recruit new units, defend your territory, and reduce unrest.

title: Loot Goblin Inc.
description:
게임 정보
A 1-4 Player Corporate Loot Goblin Simulation Game

Being a loot goblin is a simple life. Break into people’s homes and steal their valuables ~~ it's an honest days work! That's pretty much all we do here at Loot Goblin Inc. Join us, whether you want to go at it alone in solo mode or group up in co-op and split the earnings.




Look, we understand. You're a Loot Goblin, you can't help but steal things. But here at Loot Goblin Inc., we get you. You do the stealing, and we give you the cash! You can't survive out there in the human world, but if you work for us, we'll make sure you stay safe and fed. Did I mention every Friday is Pizza-Party Friday? You loot goblins love your free greasy foods, plus you can snack on any food scraps you find in the humans' homes you break into. Can't turn a deal like that down, I'd say so at-least!

title: Fantasy Football Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Fantasy Football Tactics는 아메리칸 풋볼과 축구에서 아이디어를 얻은 턴 방식 풋볼 RPG 게임입니다. 판타지 세계를 배경으로 왕국을 횡단하고 라이벌을 물리치며 챔피언 팀을 구성해야 합니다.
게임 플레이
4대4 턴 방식 택티컬 풋볼 경기에서 팀을 위해 결정을 내리고 경쟁에서 앞서가세요.
각 플레이어는 자기 차례에 한 번 이동하고 한 가지 행동을 할 수 있습니다.
볼을 차지해 골 존으로 던지거나 직접 들고 가세요. 방법은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
두 골을 먼저 넣는 팀이 승리합니다.
상대에게 대미지를 주면 실책을 하거나 경기장에서 완전히 쓰러질 확률이 높아집니다.
멀리서 마법 주문을 쓰거나 가까이에서 강력한 태클을 날리세요.
특수 능력으로 볼을 던지고, 선수를 치유하고, 경기장을 누비고, 팀을 강화하거나 상대 팀을 약하게 만드세요.
자연 속성을 활용해 팀의 잠재력을 최대한 끌어내세요.
왕국의 독특한 경기장에서 16곳에서 퀘스트를 수행하며, 팀원들에게 강력하고 새로운 능력을 가르치세요.
8가지 포지션에 걸쳐 팀에 선수를 발탁하세요.
각 행동에서 경험치를 획득해 레벨을 올리고 능력치를 높이세요.
결과가 좋지 않은 결정을 내렸나요? 걱정 마세요! 되감기 기능으로 쉽게 다시 도전할 수 있습니다.
퀵 매치 모드에서는 경기 규칙을 설정해 CPU 또는 친구와 대결할 수 있습니다.
각 경기장은 1990년대 로우 폴리 스타일로 정성스럽게 만들어졌습니다.
스토리
옛날 옛적, 모든 정치 및 영토 분쟁은 수많은 전투와 암살, 잔인한 전쟁으로 해결되었습니다. 수 세기에 걸쳐 많은 목숨을 잃은 후, 왕국은 문화가 발달하고 평화를 찾았습니다. 무기는 버려지고, 전사와 마법사들은 전투 기술을 풋볼 경기에 새롭게 적용했습니다. 국가들은 더 이상 군사력이 아니라, 스포츠 경기의 승리를 통해 힘을 얻습니다. 본국을 선택하고 이 땅의 챔피언이 되어 보세요!
팀 선발
8가지 포지션에 걸쳐 원하는 선수 조합을 구성하세요. 원한다면 전원 "밸런서"로 맞출 수 있습니다. 밸런서가 뭐냐고요? 좋은 질문입니다!

밸런서: 위대한 치유사의 후예인 밸런서는 팀의 중심을 잡고 공을 점유하는 데 중추적인 역할을 합니다. 전장에서 부상을 치료하는 능력은 팀원의 집중력과 인내력을 향상하는 용도로 바뀌었습니다.
스로워: 한때는 금지되었던 기술이 이제는 스로워의 특기가 되었으니, 그것은 바로 전방 패스입니다. 이제 공격의 중추로 여겨지는 스로워는 팀의 태생적 리더이자 공을 던지는 데 능숙한 전문가입니다.






이 게임은 영어 버전의 출시만 예정되어 있지만, 찜 목록 수를 적극적으로 모니터링하여 가장 관심이 많은 언어로 우선 번역할 예정입니다. 찜 목록에 추가해 관심을 표해주세요. 감사합니다!

title: Dice
description:
게임 정보

Welcome to a card-based roguelike where you, yes you, must save your village. What an honor, right? Roll the dice, play your cards, and laugh in the face of danger. Or at least try not to cry.


As soon as Koshchei opened his eyes, darkness began to spread throughout the forest. Trees whispered evil tales, rivers began to churn ominously, and cute little animals turned into evil monsters. Choose one of the five losers... I mean, heroes, living in your village, and venture into the forest where every bush hides danger, and every tree has an old story to tell. Get ready to battle the chicken-legged hut, get roasted by the firebird, and encounter other charming characters from Slavic folklore.


In this game, the dice decide your fate. A bad roll? Well, someone got up on the wrong side of the bed! But not all is lost, for your cards can change the course of battle. Play them wisely, and don’t forget a pinch of luck—you'll definitely need it. Dice, Destiny and Death is an adventure where every action can lead to either an epic victory or a colossal failure. The village is counting on you, hero. So go forth, save the world, and try not to become the next meal for some mythical beast! Good luck! We're all watching and laughing... I mean, believing in you.

title: SCP: Site Director
description:
게임 정보
Overview

Based on the popular SCP mythos, build your own SCP Foundation and protect the world against dangerous anomalies while navigating the administration of your sites and protecting your personnel. Orchestrate multiple sites and manage containment breaches with on-site security staff and specialized MTF (Mobile Task Force) Units.
The Latest And Greatest Technology



From your very own Facility Management System, on your cutting edge CRT monitor control your foundation and issue construction orders, change site procedures, and manage the research (and containment) of your SCPs.


Expand the staffing of your sites and ensure they live long enough to be promoted and improve their skill (increasing the funding you receive from research). Arm your Security Forces with various weapons and improve their armaments through technological progression. Defend against SCP Breaches, Test Subject Riots, and Raids. Create your own Mobile Task Force Units and designations that serve as specialized security that excel in a few activities.

title: Hero of the Hive
description:
게임 정보
Take flight in this casual adventure game as a bee on a mission to save your crumbling hive. With the Queen mysteriously missing, it's up to you to gather resources like pollen and nectar to rebuild your home, explore the vast Aurora Basin, and embark on quests across the land to help the animals of nature as you become the hero your hive needs!



With the Queen missing, the hive is struggling to survive. There are few bees left to forage for the hive. Fly out into the vibrant world to collect all the staples a bee needs: pollen, nectar, and propolis. You may even find a few rare flowers along the way!



Help get the bees back on their wings! The hive is in desperate need of repair and you know just what they need. Reopen shops to customize your bee with vibrant colors or fun hats, rebuild rooms to attract more bees back to the basin, and even fix up a dance floor to show off your moves!



Bees hold ecosystems together! Animals across the entire basin rely on your assistance. From helping a lost fawn find its way home to resolving disputes between wildlife, you can help restore the balance of nature and make new friends along the way!



Explore the vast and diverse Aurora Basin! From the snowy mountain peaks to the scorching heat of the desert, there are unique areas to visit with secrets to be found.

title: Outsider
description:
게임 정보
Who is the Outsider?
Outsider is a science fiction narrative game with meaningful choices. You'll join my childhood friend Nando in his online encounters with a woman claiming to be an extraterrestrial. This game is a faithful recreation of their conversations based on the detailed records he left me before disappearing over a decade ago.
Outsider is a choice-rich game where you will play as Nando's "inner voice", helping him navigate the experience of meeting someone claiming to be from an advanced civilization.
The game's main play area is a fully-featured simulated chat interface. Your first job will be to help Nando figure out whether "Mara" is who she claims to be. How could an extraterrestrial prove their origin through a chat interface?
Outsider doesn't interrupt conversations with long and indistinguishable options. All choices are labeled with emojis that indicate the answer's tone and likely impact. Consequences flow naturally and won't unexpectedly lock you out of important content.
Some choices enable you to skip parts of the story and make progress while not missing anything important. You will use them to pace the game and focus on topics that interest you without affecting the game's endings. A plethora of reading options, such as multiple fonts (including a special Dyslexia-friendly font), adjustable text speed and fast-forward will help you explore all branches without getting bogged down by what you've already read.

title: Legend of the Corndog
description:
게임 정보
Finding yourself out of food, you decide to venture into the outdoors for the first time in an embarrasingly long time in order to satiate your growing hunger.


Legend of the Corndog(s) is a First-Person, Open World Experience that thrives on not taking itself seriously. Believe us, we're just as shocked as you are.



Features Include:
- Pet the Dog!
- Talk to the Locals!
- Visit Strange Places!
- Make Shop Vendors lives Miserable!
- And More!

title: Influencer Boxing
description:
게임 정보
Step into the ring with "Influencer Boxing," a thrilling game featuring 12 of your favorite social media stars. Each influencer brings their unique style and charisma to intense boxing matches, set in dynamic, visually stunning arenas. Pick your fighter, engage in exciting story modes, and challenge other fighters. Who will emerge as the ultimate influencer champion? Join the fight and find out!

title: Age of Enchantment
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Age of Enchantment, a thrilling blend of tower defense strategy and deckbuilding innovation!
In the realm of Alhambria, a once-peaceful land now faces an ancient evil reborn. As ominous shadows spread across the horizon, you must harness the power of arcane enchantments and strategic prowess to defend against hordes of undead and demonic adversaries. The various races of Alhambria must now come together to stand their ground and push back the Darkness.
Class-Inspired Towers: Draw upon archetypes from classic fantasy to build towers that reflect distinct combat roles. Choose from towers specializing in magic and physical damage as well as melee and ranged attacks. Each tower is modeled after iconic fantasy roles like powerful Wizards, swift Rangers, and stalwart Fighters. Create diverse combinations to exploit enemy weaknesses, ensuring no two defenses are ever the same.
Innovative Deckbuilding: Customize your strategy by building a deck of powerful cards, each offering unique abilities and synergies. Expand your arsenal at the Shop using currency earned during intense waves of combat
Dynamic Tower Defense: Experience classic tower defense mechanics with a twist. Place and upgrade towers strategically to fend off waves of enemies, each wave more formidable than the last.
Enchanting Powers: Enhance your towers with mystical enchants that amplify their strengths or unlock new tactical possibilities. Adapt your defenses on-the-fly to counter diverse enemy tactics.

title: Tailgate
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Play as an aging labrador retriever named Hyde. One morning you wake up and realize that your Human, Derek, is gone. 
Get out of the house and explore the desolate yet beautiful fall surroundings of the San Pedro village. Use your dog’s senses, solve problems, and puzzles the doggo way. Search for hidden passages around obstacles and enemies, find long-lost balls that will remind you of precious moments, discover ancient dog lore, and finally pass through the mysterious Tailgate to find and save your Human.
Story
Thousands of years ago ancient Dogs chose to accompany Humans on their journey, establishing a strong spiritual bond, the Kana. Connected through Kana they’ve been through thick and thin together. Through war, misery, desperation, illness, and other mishaps big and small, Dogs have never questioned Humans. Dog after dog, generation after generation, they were loyal to the human race. But as a wise dog said, loyalty is a two-way street. Kana was absorbing an immense amount of hate, doubt, pain, and suffering. The connection became so corrupted and fragile that it finally broke down, tearing the fabric of both Human and Canine worlds apart. 
What exactly caused Kana's final corruption is unknown, but it must have been something truly terrible. Dogs have became feral, returning to their prehistoric forms or even worse. The Rift, however, for reasons no one yet understands, did not affect some of the dogs. One older, grumpy labrador in particular…
Features
Up to 9 different locations including village streets, an abandoned warehouse, stray dogs' Refuge, rural wilderness, and a mystical canine parallel world;
Think and see like a dog — sniff for smell traces that will lead you to your objectives, important places, and items.
Talk to other animals that will help you on your journey with their unique abilities. A cat that can read (at least that's what she says), a diplomatic pug, a stray dog that will teach you survival skills, and many others.
Collect memory balls to discover the story of Hyde’s life, doggo wisdom, and ancient canine lore.
Replenish your stamina and gain temporary power-ups.
Fool around like a dog would — play with balls, sticks, and stones, try to catch a cat, eat weird food, and go places that you normally would not dare to go.

title: Toilet Zone 2
description:
게임 정보
You play as Hiru, a duck from the Exploration Guild. Their purpose is to chart and explore other worlds. Your expeditions are powered by the Power Crystal, an other worldly gem capable of producing portals.
But soon, you'll find that its use has unintended consequences....

Use the power of water-powered flight to navigate past enemies and obstacles. Explore a set of challenging levels and master the controls.

Master the Art Of Water-powered Flight
Navigate through increasingly difficult challenges
Create and share your own levels with the in-game level editor
Gather achievements and compete with your friends on the leaderboards

title: Echoes of Exile
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Exile is a short horror game about exploring space caves. You fly to points of interest and delve into the caves with your drone and flashlight.
Send your drone out for recon
One of the few tools you have is a drone which can fit into places inaccessible to humans. It is a useful tool but not without it's limitations.
Unravel the truth about what happened in these caves
As you journey into the depths of the caves on your mission, you may be able to piece together the events that led to the radio silence.

title: Mage Food Truck
description:
게임 정보
Play your cards to explore a hangry realm, crafting and delivering exotic meals in the face of fantastical beasts and curses from dissatisfied customers.

Gameplay
Mage Food Truck is a single player roguelike deckbuilder. Each run consists of a Morning, Day, and Night shift, with turn events that become increasingly perilous. You'll play hands from your growing collection to traverse the realm, collect ingredients, craft recipes, and deliver them to earn as much gold as possible. When the day is done or your truck is wrecked, your customers will pass judgment upon you with a review of 0-3 stars!

Each work day begins with a small starter deck, and you’ll purchase new cards from the Turvy Mart at the end of each turn. Playing a Job card lets you use any crew member's ability, which you can combine with other cards to boost productivity!



The Explorer travels around the map, seeking ingredients and delivering food.
The Chef crafts delicious dishes from ingredients you've collected.
The Mage protects your truck with a magic shield and fights off pesky curses.
The Bard motivates your crew with EXP, unlocking powerful Special cards unique to each crew member.

title: L8R SK8R
description:
게임 정보
L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

Just like those classics, new areas in the hub world are unlocked with a collection mechanic, but instead of collecting stars, crystals, or dragons, you have to collect time.

When exploring the hub world, you’ll encounter time locks that hinder your progress.

These locks will require you to collect a certain amount of time in order to be opened.

Every time you beat a level, you’ll collect any time you shave off your previous best record. (Each level has a default record that it starts with. Basically a par time.)

So, for example, if you need another minute to open a lock, you could go back and beat the best times in three levels by 20 seconds. Or alternatively you could shave 10 seconds off of six levels. You might even find a shortcut that lets you take a whole minute off of just one level. The choice is yours!

Master the core movement mechanics; wall jumping, wall riding, air dashing, sliding, boosting, and of course, double jumping.

Play through 25 unique levels set across various time periods across all of history, including five boss fights.

title: JumpMap
description:
게임 정보
JumpMap 은 흥미진진한 1인칭 3D 플랫폼 게임으로 특별한 메커니즘을 제공합니다: 떨어질 때마다 이전 위치로 되돌아갑니다. 정밀함과 타이밍을 요구하는 20개 이상의 신중하게 설계된 레벨을 탐험하세요. 이제 Speedrun 모드가 추가되었습니다: 모든 레벨을 통과하고 최고의 시간을 기록해 보세요!
당신의 유일한 목표는 각 레벨의 정상에 도달하는 것입니다. 클라이밍에 집중하고 도전을 헤쳐 나가며 각 오르막을 정복하는 능력을 키우세요.
게임 플레이
Speedrun 모드: 시계를 보며 모든 레벨을 한 번에 클리어하세요. 시간을 추적하고 최고 기록을 목표로 도전하세요. 자신과 친구들과 경쟁하여 가장 빠르게 완료하세요!
최고 시간 추적: 각 레벨을 완료하는 속도를 측정하고, 개인 최고 기록을 통해 도전과 성취감을 느껴보세요.
더블 점프: 공중에서 다시 한 번 점프할 수 있는 능력을 통해, 가장 까다로운 플랫폼도 마스터하고 새로운 높이에 도달하세요.
컨트롤러 및 Steam Deck 지원: 컨트롤러 또는 Steam Deck을 사용할 때 원활한 게임 플레이를 즐기세요. 이동 중에도 편안하게 또는 소파에서 편안하게 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: Manipulus - A Deck Building Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times.
As a Manipuli general, form strategic defensive lines and manoeuvre your followers to activate wild abilities to defeat the oncoming monsters and lead your band to safety. Re-play your cards, re-live your actions, and fight to keep your refugees alive in this dark and captivating adventure.
It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
tag: 카드 배틀,자신이 선택하는 모험,트레이딩 카드 게임

title: 风铃Windbell
description:
게임 정보
Windbell is a platform action game that emphasizes combos and combat experience. There are hundreds of weapons and skills that can be freely matched in the game, and you can match your favorite fighting style as you like.


In this game, you play the role of Sol, in order to rescue the junior sister who was sealed in the ice, constantly wandering through the major secret realms, just to collect materials and forge the sharpest weapon in the world.


Every time you enter the secret realm, it's a new experience. The buffs and skills obtained during the rogue process will be integrated into the Sol's weapons when Sol leaves the secret realm.


You can use the powerful weapons fused in the secret realm to complete the tasks on the Heavenly Book, and the task rewards on the Heavenly Book can permanently improve a certain attribute of Sol.


-------------------------------------

title: Tristan Cole's Pro Driver
description:
게임 정보
In Tristan Cole's Pro Driver you're a stunt driver for hire and willing to take on any paying job that gets you closer to buying your next upgrade. Whether it's taxiing passengers around town, completing objectives, or winning races, you need to drive with both speed & style to to impress your customers.



Weave through traffic, hit & destroy props, and jump across rooftops as you navigate your way through the stylized maps of TCPD. Customize your choice of heavily modified caged street cars featuring custom suspension built for high speed stunts. Score big combos by performing dozens of tricks including wheelies, drifts, spins, flips/rolls, grinds, and plenty of insane aerial stunts.



Challenge other drivers in a variety of multiplayer modes to show off your style & prove that you're the best stunt driver on the street.

title: RunMan Turbo
description:
게임 정보



The world's fastest returns in RunMan Turbo, a high speed 2D platformer continuing the energetic flair of beloved predecessor RunMan: Race Around the World. Combining the essence of old school classics with tight, modern mechanics, RunMan’s return brings wild enthusiasm and unhinged energy matched with a vibrant aesthetic and groovy soundtrack.




A new challenger wielding a mysterious power has scrambled RunMan's world! Each time you run through a level, it will look and play different, requiring you to master your instincts and reaction in order to get the fastest time.

Bounce, slide and run fast as heck through high speed levels across five unique zones. Beat record times to earn medals and unlock secret characters, levels, and more.




Cool stuff can you do in this game:





Other stuff you will be jazzed about:







RunMan Turbo is soundtracked by a bunch of awesome artists and bands from Philadelphia. With an eclectic mix of rock, folk, funk, and more, I promise you have never heard a game that sounds like this!

Confirmed artists:
Catbite
SNACKTIME

More music to come soon...


Created by Tom Sennett in 2003 and debuting in the Game Maker Community, the RunMan series has spanned more than half a dozen titles, including 2009's beloved RunMan: Race Around the World - a collaboration with Maddy Thorson (, ). RunMan is also featured as a playable character in indie classic . After a few false starts on mobile, RunMan returns to PC for the triumphant sequel RunMan Turbo.


Yo! I'm Tom Sennett, I'm from Philadelphia, and for two decades I've created video games which have brought joy to millions of people around the world. I'm an IndieCade award winner, and have been featured in Kotaku, VICE, Rock Paper Shotgun and more. When it comes to making games, I do everything including design, art, and programming - I even sometimes create my own sound effects and music. My work focuses on taking classic gameplay constructs and tearing them down to be rebuilt in a lean and modern way. I'm pumped to share it with you!

title: Valourglade
description:
게임 정보
After a devastating raid by monsters, a once-thriving village lies in ruins. It's up to you to rebuild the village from the ground up. Explore the world to gather resources, face formidable bosses, and gather blueprints to craft new tools and construct buildings. As you help villagers with quests and restore their home, you'll earn their trust—and uncover the mysteries of the land.
Rebuild the Village: Gather materials from caves and forests to craft tools and rebuild homes, shops, and key structures.
Fight Epic Bosses: Battle fierce monsters guarding powerful loot like blueprints and upgrades that will transform your village.
Help the Villagers: Take on side quests to earn rewards and strengthen your bond with the townsfolk, unlocking new features and abilities.
Craft and Upgrade: Build everything from basic tools to advanced structures, expanding your village’s potential with each new blueprint you discover.
Can you bring peace and prosperity back to the village and defend it from the dangers that lurk beyond?

title: Daimyo Reign
description:
게임 정보
Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!
Build
-Building improvements allow you to increase your wealth, recruit new units, defend your territory, and reduce unrest.

title: Loot Goblin Inc.
description:
게임 정보
A 1-4 Player Corporate Loot Goblin Simulation Game

Being a loot goblin is a simple life. Break into people’s homes and steal their valuables ~~ it's an honest days work! That's pretty much all we do here at Loot Goblin Inc. Join us, whether you want to go at it alone in solo mode or group up in co-op and split the earnings.




Look, we understand. You're a Loot Goblin, you can't help but steal things. But here at Loot Goblin Inc., we get you. You do the stealing, and we give you the cash! You can't survive out there in the human world, but if you work for us, we'll make sure you stay safe and fed. Did I mention every Friday is Pizza-Party Friday? You loot goblins love your free greasy foods, plus you can snack on any food scraps you find in the humans' homes you break into. Can't turn a deal like that down, I'd say so at-least!

title: Fantasy Football Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Fantasy Football Tactics는 아메리칸 풋볼과 축구에서 아이디어를 얻은 턴 방식 풋볼 RPG 게임입니다. 판타지 세계를 배경으로 왕국을 횡단하고 라이벌을 물리치며 챔피언 팀을 구성해야 합니다.
게임 플레이
4대4 턴 방식 택티컬 풋볼 경기에서 팀을 위해 결정을 내리고 경쟁에서 앞서가세요.
각 플레이어는 자기 차례에 한 번 이동하고 한 가지 행동을 할 수 있습니다.
볼을 차지해 골 존으로 던지거나 직접 들고 가세요. 방법은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
두 골을 먼저 넣는 팀이 승리합니다.
상대에게 대미지를 주면 실책을 하거나 경기장에서 완전히 쓰러질 확률이 높아집니다.
멀리서 마법 주문을 쓰거나 가까이에서 강력한 태클을 날리세요.
특수 능력으로 볼을 던지고, 선수를 치유하고, 경기장을 누비고, 팀을 강화하거나 상대 팀을 약하게 만드세요.
자연 속성을 활용해 팀의 잠재력을 최대한 끌어내세요.
왕국의 독특한 경기장에서 16곳에서 퀘스트를 수행하며, 팀원들에게 강력하고 새로운 능력을 가르치세요.
8가지 포지션에 걸쳐 팀에 선수를 발탁하세요.
각 행동에서 경험치를 획득해 레벨을 올리고 능력치를 높이세요.
결과가 좋지 않은 결정을 내렸나요? 걱정 마세요! 되감기 기능으로 쉽게 다시 도전할 수 있습니다.
퀵 매치 모드에서는 경기 규칙을 설정해 CPU 또는 친구와 대결할 수 있습니다.
각 경기장은 1990년대 로우 폴리 스타일로 정성스럽게 만들어졌습니다.
스토리
옛날 옛적, 모든 정치 및 영토 분쟁은 수많은 전투와 암살, 잔인한 전쟁으로 해결되었습니다. 수 세기에 걸쳐 많은 목숨을 잃은 후, 왕국은 문화가 발달하고 평화를 찾았습니다. 무기는 버려지고, 전사와 마법사들은 전투 기술을 풋볼 경기에 새롭게 적용했습니다. 국가들은 더 이상 군사력이 아니라, 스포츠 경기의 승리를 통해 힘을 얻습니다. 본국을 선택하고 이 땅의 챔피언이 되어 보세요!
팀 선발
8가지 포지션에 걸쳐 원하는 선수 조합을 구성하세요. 원한다면 전원 "밸런서"로 맞출 수 있습니다. 밸런서가 뭐냐고요? 좋은 질문입니다!

밸런서: 위대한 치유사의 후예인 밸런서는 팀의 중심을 잡고 공을 점유하는 데 중추적인 역할을 합니다. 전장에서 부상을 치료하는 능력은 팀원의 집중력과 인내력을 향상하는 용도로 바뀌었습니다.
스로워: 한때는 금지되었던 기술이 이제는 스로워의 특기가 되었으니, 그것은 바로 전방 패스입니다. 이제 공격의 중추로 여겨지는 스로워는 팀의 태생적 리더이자 공을 던지는 데 능숙한 전문가입니다.






이 게임은 영어 버전의 출시만 예정되어 있지만, 찜 목록 수를 적극적으로 모니터링하여 가장 관심이 많은 언어로 우선 번역할 예정입니다. 찜 목록에 추가해 관심을 표해주세요. 감사합니다!

title: Dice
description:
게임 정보

Welcome to a card-based roguelike where you, yes you, must save your village. What an honor, right? Roll the dice, play your cards, and laugh in the face of danger. Or at least try not to cry.


As soon as Koshchei opened his eyes, darkness began to spread throughout the forest. Trees whispered evil tales, rivers began to churn ominously, and cute little animals turned into evil monsters. Choose one of the five losers... I mean, heroes, living in your village, and venture into the forest where every bush hides danger, and every tree has an old story to tell. Get ready to battle the chicken-legged hut, get roasted by the firebird, and encounter other charming characters from Slavic folklore.


In this game, the dice decide your fate. A bad roll? Well, someone got up on the wrong side of the bed! But not all is lost, for your cards can change the course of battle. Play them wisely, and don’t forget a pinch of luck—you'll definitely need it. Dice, Destiny and Death is an adventure where every action can lead to either an epic victory or a colossal failure. The village is counting on you, hero. So go forth, save the world, and try not to become the next meal for some mythical beast! Good luck! We're all watching and laughing... I mean, believing in you.

title: SCP: Site Director
description:
게임 정보
Overview

Based on the popular SCP mythos, build your own SCP Foundation and protect the world against dangerous anomalies while navigating the administration of your sites and protecting your personnel. Orchestrate multiple sites and manage containment breaches with on-site security staff and specialized MTF (Mobile Task Force) Units.
The Latest And Greatest Technology



From your very own Facility Management System, on your cutting edge CRT monitor control your foundation and issue construction orders, change site procedures, and manage the research (and containment) of your SCPs.


Expand the staffing of your sites and ensure they live long enough to be promoted and improve their skill (increasing the funding you receive from research). Arm your Security Forces with various weapons and improve their armaments through technological progression. Defend against SCP Breaches, Test Subject Riots, and Raids. Create your own Mobile Task Force Units and designations that serve as specialized security that excel in a few activities.

title: Hero of the Hive
description:
게임 정보
Take flight in this casual adventure game as a bee on a mission to save your crumbling hive. With the Queen mysteriously missing, it's up to you to gather resources like pollen and nectar to rebuild your home, explore the vast Aurora Basin, and embark on quests across the land to help the animals of nature as you become the hero your hive needs!



With the Queen missing, the hive is struggling to survive. There are few bees left to forage for the hive. Fly out into the vibrant world to collect all the staples a bee needs: pollen, nectar, and propolis. You may even find a few rare flowers along the way!



Help get the bees back on their wings! The hive is in desperate need of repair and you know just what they need. Reopen shops to customize your bee with vibrant colors or fun hats, rebuild rooms to attract more bees back to the basin, and even fix up a dance floor to show off your moves!



Bees hold ecosystems together! Animals across the entire basin rely on your assistance. From helping a lost fawn find its way home to resolving disputes between wildlife, you can help restore the balance of nature and make new friends along the way!



Explore the vast and diverse Aurora Basin! From the snowy mountain peaks to the scorching heat of the desert, there are unique areas to visit with secrets to be found.

title: Outsider
description:
게임 정보
Who is the Outsider?
Outsider is a science fiction narrative game with meaningful choices. You'll join my childhood friend Nando in his online encounters with a woman claiming to be an extraterrestrial. This game is a faithful recreation of their conversations based on the detailed records he left me before disappearing over a decade ago.
Outsider is a choice-rich game where you will play as Nando's "inner voice", helping him navigate the experience of meeting someone claiming to be from an advanced civilization.
The game's main play area is a fully-featured simulated chat interface. Your first job will be to help Nando figure out whether "Mara" is who she claims to be. How could an extraterrestrial prove their origin through a chat interface?
Outsider doesn't interrupt conversations with long and indistinguishable options. All choices are labeled with emojis that indicate the answer's tone and likely impact. Consequences flow naturally and won't unexpectedly lock you out of important content.
Some choices enable you to skip parts of the story and make progress while not missing anything important. You will use them to pace the game and focus on topics that interest you without affecting the game's endings. A plethora of reading options, such as multiple fonts (including a special Dyslexia-friendly font), adjustable text speed and fast-forward will help you explore all branches without getting bogged down by what you've already read.

title: Legend of the Corndog
description:
게임 정보
Finding yourself out of food, you decide to venture into the outdoors for the first time in an embarrasingly long time in order to satiate your growing hunger.


Legend of the Corndog(s) is a First-Person, Open World Experience that thrives on not taking itself seriously. Believe us, we're just as shocked as you are.



Features Include:
- Pet the Dog!
- Talk to the Locals!
- Visit Strange Places!
- Make Shop Vendors lives Miserable!
- And More!

title: Influencer Boxing
description:
게임 정보
Step into the ring with "Influencer Boxing," a thrilling game featuring 12 of your favorite social media stars. Each influencer brings their unique style and charisma to intense boxing matches, set in dynamic, visually stunning arenas. Pick your fighter, engage in exciting story modes, and challenge other fighters. Who will emerge as the ultimate influencer champion? Join the fight and find out!

title: Labyrinth Sword Princess
description:
게임 정보
【 Synopsis 】
The floating island is going to fall. This lonely island suspended ten thousand meters in the air
The lack of power has been unable to levitate, and the people living on it are also in a huge crisis.
The only way to save the island is to search the labyrinth for the treasure that powers the island's core,
But not everyone is willing to go to dangerous places to find treasure, except monsters
Others want to fight for the treasure.
Do you choose to risk the danger of finding the treasure, or use the scarce means of transportation to get away?
And Leah's partner will also influence her ending according to her choices.
Use the machine, the skill, the operation and the partner Leah to find the cause of the incident.
【 Game content 】
3D action RPG game, see through the enemy's flaws, use the operation to break through the difficulties!
In addition to the normal attack power, the game also provides countermeasure skills to deal with different types of enemies in the game,
Of course, traps or mechanics can also be used to outmaneuver, such as pushing the enemy
It's okay to fall into a trap, push next to a bomb, or just fall to your death.
The maze part is not confined to the traditional customs clearance, and some difficulties can be completely generated
Organ to pass quickly.

title: Fire Isle
description:
게임 정보
Fire Isle is a high-energy, competitive multiplayer game where up to four players wield unique flames to battle for control of a dynamic, ever-changing map. The objective? Dominate the battlefield by collecting Wisps, ethereal flames that appear randomly across the map. Be the first to burn their tiles - or risk losing them when they move after a set number of turns. As resources grow scarce and strategies collide, only the most cunning fires will survive!

title: Dread of Night
description:
게임 정보
Lost and stranded on a mysterious island the player searches for a way out. Not everything is at it seems however as the island is inhabited by a violent cult who stop at nothing to hunt down and kill all outsiders.

Based off classic survivor horror, players will explore the island, solve puzzles, collect keys and fight numerous disturbing enemies with various weapons ranging from melee weapons to firearms. Along the way they will discover audio diaries, video tapes, and notes detailing the events leading up to the downfall of the island.

title: Wish Creatures
description:
게임 정보
Wish Creatures
Wish Creatures is a Turn-Based Monster Taming game where monsters leave your party when they "Level Up".
Explore the world of Monstoria and battle monsters with a party of your own! Monsters are known as "Wishlings". As you battle, Wishlings will automatically leave your team to re-enter the Cosmos as a Star. You can wish on a Star to use their signature battle action, known as a "Star Power"! Balance your ever-changing team with Star Power to take down the most powerful foes!
Features
Turn monsters into Stars and wish on them in turn-based battles.
Explore a vast province of rustic towns, cityscapes, haunted ruins, magical caves, and more to find Wishlings.
Recruit Wishlings by hearing what they have to say. Inspire them, and they'll join you!
An emotional story. Journey with unlikely allies, battle goofy villains, and find the truth about your neighbor's mysterious monster.
Side-activities like the action-based dojo minigame, or the methodical Pulsar Radar that increases the odds of encountering rare Pulsar Wishlings.
Two difficulty modes: Chill mode for folks who want to freely experiment with Wishes, and Locked-In mode to start battles with no advantages!

title: Valheron
description:
게임 정보
Presentation
First game developed by Maël Boucault, 19, a student in video game design.
After nearly a thousand hours of work, I'm proud to present the first version of this project, with updates planned to enrich the experience and add new features.
For a long time, I've found the world around me boring, and playing video games was an escape, but today my aim is to create worlds that entertain and amuse me. With this in mind, I founded AtomicPunch Studio to make this dream a reality and launch my very first game.
Quick Description
Guided and created by the gods, you are the hero the people need.
Your mission: eradicate the demons that threaten this world and help the villagers rebuild their communities. You'll need to explore the lands of Valheron, recruit allies and form a fighting team to confront the forces of darkness.
In the kingdom of Valheron, a fearsome swordsman named Kwang arrives in a village on the brink of destruction. A demonic rift has opened, releasing an ancient demon named Sevarog, who threatens to engulf the entire world in a wave of darkness. On his journey, Kwang befriends two unlikely allies: Gideon, a powerful sorcerer, and Crunch, a robot with mysterious origins. Together, they must join forces to save Valheron.

title: Tech Hustle
description:
게임 정보
Tech Hustle is a wild, fast-paced management sim where you turn a small tech shop into a booming empire! Juggle deliveries, haggle with customers, hire quirky employees, and upgrade to robots that handle it all—while you take a coffee break. But watch out! The black market offers juicy deals on rare tech… if you’re willing to bend a few rules. Will you play it safe or hustle your way to the top?
Run Online and Physical Store
Customize Store: Make your store look fabulous or hilariously awful—it’s your choice! Just be ready for customer reviews like, “Great prices, but what’s up with the neon toilets?”

title: Serial Victims
description:
게임 정보


Serial Victims is a 3D psychological horror game that immerses you in the nightmares of individuals who fell prey to serial killers. In Serial Victims, you embody each victim, racing against time to uncover clues, call for help, and perform various actions before the inevitable happens. Your ultimate objective is to have the victims assist in catching the killer with as few victims as possible.

Survival is not the goal. Instead, your aim is to do what you can within the time you have left.





Serial Victims gives a fresh and replayable horror experience. Each playthrough is randomized, ensuring that no two experiences are the same:
