title: Trickster Trove
description:
게임 정보
In a world where greed surpasses fear, only the cleverest will endure. Design your own dungeon—a lethal snare for anyone who dares to be tempted by your riches. Clever traps, merciless creatures, and complex mazes — all crafted to thwart intruders. Alternatively, take a chance by exploring other players' dungeons, evading deadly traps and claiming their treasures. But remember — death in this world is not final, it's merely another lost opportunity.

Use modules to create intricate labyrinths filled with traps and monsters. Each module has a unique shape, structure, and atmosphere, featuring parkour zones and hidden rooms. Build a dungeon where every step is a risk, every turn is a trap, and anyone who dares to enter becomes a part of your game. But remember – the best dungeon doesn’t just stop intruders. It instills fear in them before they even take their first step.

title: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play and swift reflexes where it not only matters which card you play but also where you play it. Explore as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell". Uncover its secrets and try to find the legendary "Blank card" which will activate whatever is written on it.
Key Features
Real-Time Deckbuilding Action:
Experience the best of both worlds as you combine the strategic depth of deckbuilding with the adrenaline-pumping excitement of real-time combat. Make split-second decisions to unleash powerful card combinations and obliterate your enemies.

Roguelite Adventure
No two runs are the same! Navigate through procedurally generated levels filled with unique challenges, hidden treasures, and formidable foes. Adapt your strategy on the fly as you uncover new cards, relics, and abilities with each playthrough.

Diverse Card Collection
Build and customize your deck from a vast array of cards, each offering distinct abilities and synergies. Discover rare and powerful cards that can turn the tide of battle in your favor. Will you focus on offensive prowess, defensive fortitude, or cunning tactics?

Dynamic Combat
Engage in intense, fast-paced battles where every move counts. Dodge, block, and strike with precision, using your deck to unleash devastating combos and special attacks. Face off against a variety of enemies, each with their own unique behaviors and strategies.

Inspiring Influences
Fans of Slay the Spire, The Binding of Isaac, and Enter the Gungeon will feel right at home in Decksplorers: Into the Shell. We’ve taken inspiration from these classics to create a game that blends their best elements into an entirely new and exhilarating experience.

Endless Replayability
With an ever-expanding array of cards, enemies, and levels, no two runs will ever feel the same. Challenge yourself in this roguelite adventure and uncover new powerful combinations of cards and powerups to reach the end.


Prepare yourself for a deckbuilding journey like no other. Decksplorers: Into the Shell is ready to test your strategic mind and reflexes in a relentless pursuit of victory. Are you ready to delve into the shell and uncover its secrets?

Wishlist now and be the first to explore the unknown!

title: Skibi's Castle TD 2
description:
게임 정보
Skibi's Castle TD 2 is a colorful, sticker-themed tower defense game developed by missing_tooltip, skotey, and catfan, the same team behind the original. Command Skibi's defenses and protect her castle from Rydik's invaders by summoning troops and purchasing new towers and upgrades.

Key Demo Features:
Challenging Puzzles: Engage in open-ended puzzles that reward strategic thinking and experimentation.
Strategic Depth: Replay stages to perfect your scores in time, cost, and distance to earn the game's most valuable currency, gold.
Indie Craftsmanship: Handcrafted by a passionate indie family company, ensuring a personal touch and a pinch of sarcasm.
Original Music: Get into the zen mode with original tunes by haishoe, featuring nostalgic themes to match the seasonal settings.
Leaderboards: Compete with friends on the leaderboards for biggest brain bragging rights.

Journey Before Destination - Our vision for Skibi's Castle TD 2 is to reimagine tower defense from the ground up, merging upfront auto-battler planning with puzzle-like levels. SK2 is the first step in the journey for us, just like the original (fun fact: the Blizzard version of the game was actually Skibi Castle TD 1 version 6). To that end, we plan to have the full release before the year is out so you have a cool new game to play, and we can enjoy our holidays ːlunar2019grinningpigː.

After the game is released, our next step in 2025 is to listen to your feedback and expand upon the core gameplay. This could mean borrowing from roguelike and idle game systems, improving on the traditional survival mode, or introducing something new like a bullet hell tower defense RTS mission hybrid.

Creating games has been my lifelong passion, and I believe that how we reach our goals and what we learn along the way is more important than the destination itself. I hope that playing SK2 is as enjoyable and fulfilling for you as it was for us to create it. Let us know what you think, chat!

title: EARTH:3000
description:
게임 정보
Earth: the year 3000…
EARTH:3000 is a survival RPG made with the Unreal 5 engine, set in a post-technological dark age.

Centuries have passed since the apocalypse. History is mostly forgotten, but relics of past eras remain. Swords and muskets exist alongside mutants and cyborgs.

Create a custom character and explore the mysteries and dangers of the wasteland! Will you search the ancient ruins for knowledge, or loot them for treasure? Fight other players and steal their items, or work together to build a new civilization? Rule over a city, or journey to distant lands - and maybe even find a way off of this doomed world?

Planned features (subject to change prior to release)
Survive in a future dark age wasteland
Fast-paced, full-loot PVP
Control towns and hire NPC guards
Loot ancient ruins for rare artifacts
Mix of mostly low-tech melee and ranged weapons
Play as a mutant, cyborg or techno-mage (very rare)
Defend against bandits... or become one
Fly across the deserts in a sandship or airship
Form caravans to trade resources
(or rob merchants and steal their goods!)
Fight for territory against rival factions
Journey to the toxic oceans and acid rainforests
Discover clues to the earth's lost secrets
Travel to SPACE
...and more!

title: Into The Sands
description:
게임 정보
Into the Sands is a mystery game set in a desert. As a scrapper, explore the dunes and find interesting treasures. As you explore you may uncover exciting information about the desert. Are the nomads aware of the vast history in the desert?
The game involves venturing out into the desert and collecting scrap metal to improve your capabilities. As you explore new dialogue options and avenues to investigate will open up to you.
Talk to the desert shopkeeper to get your first tool. Use it to explore and unearth desert objects:
Talk and inquire with the nomads as you play to get more information and help you progress:

title: Tamzin Twins: The Tyranny of Tyrek
description:
게임 정보
Tamzin Twins is an action-RPG adventure with countless enemies of all sorts, magic spells, sword agility combat, breathtaking locations, tons of loot and miniature baseplates for all characters.
Start Evil, Become Queens
Enya and Kyra start their journey as evil servants of the dark lord Tyrek Tefari. He orders the twins to be executed because they are growing too powerful. The twins escape the assassination attempt and swear to kill Tyrek for betraying them. In the twins’ attempt at revenge, Tyrek nearly kills them by stabbing them and throwing them off a cliff.

The twins wake up battered and bruised across the world without their magic. They vow to enact revenge on Tyrek Tefari, no matter what army stands in their way. Enya and Kyra will discover what it means to be leaders, what it means to do good for others and what morality means in this epic tale to be experienced. The twins will meet barons and kings of different leadership qualities and learn from them all to become queens themselves. Initially their goals are all about revenge and whatever it takes, but eventually they see the effect they have on the people they help.
Unique Sword-Throwing Combat
It’s not every day you see a player juggle swords and throw them around. The player has 4 weapon slots where they can throw them and leave them on the ground. Magical weapons will have certain effects when they are stuck on the ground. Magically recall your weapons in an instant and damage your foes again on the way back.

From the terrible tyrant Tyrek Tefari to even humble shopkeepers, players are bound to find some characters they’ll relate to and enjoy having conversations with. This game has a fully featured dialogue system that allows the other player to keep exploring while you enjoy talking with the locals.
Play together on the same screen. Player two isn’t just player one without any dialogue, player two is Kyra who has her own dreams, ambitions and opinions on things that differ from her twin sister’s. Will they learn morality at the same speed? Of course not! Will they get along all the time? Nope! Will they actually talk to each other sometimes? Yep
Enya and Kyra’s path to revenge is filled with misty cliffs, dangerous swamps, endless seas, haunted forests, relaxing shores, creepy dungeons and deadly volcanoes. These areas are swarming with monsters, allies, enemies and all matter of creatures from Golems to Demons to Ghosts.
autokwd: Tamzin Twins: The Tyranny of Tyrek

title: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Please visit the community hub for additional info regarding the game's release.

Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure is a game set in an ancient structure where light is both your guide and your challenge.

In Lux Leonarii you the player explore an ancient structure by harnessing the power of light in the form of highly focused light beams as you solve intricate puzzles by using rotating mirrors, devices and your wits.

Each level invites you to manipulate the beams of light using the environment, directing them through a series of obstacles and challenges while learning new ways to think about space, reflections and interactions.

It combines the challenge of puzzle solving with a visually appealing experience using dynamic lighting that reacts in real-time to the beam's locations to create captivating Levels.

Perfect for mechanical puzzle lovers who still enjoy some degree of visual appeal, Lux Leonarii challenges you to think with reflections in mind, explore creative solutions and discover the forgotten power of light. Will you unlock the secrets hidden here ?.

–Key features–

- Escalating difficulty, from simple A to B connections with a single colour, up to 7 different colours, ten-fold reflections and utilizing all available tiles, so while the first few levels are easy as they introduce the game mechanics, and as the mechanics interact with each other, levels get challenging.

- It is a mechanical puzzle, meaning your actions are immediately visible in real time so if there is a beam being interrupted by an obstacle you will be able to see it immediately and might even be able to nudge the mirrors slightly to bypass it, or the opening of a door might move said door to interrupt another beam, possibly the very same one that is opening it.

- 4 Directly interactable tiles (Like Mirrors you can rotate)

- 7 Indirectly interactable tiles  (Like Doors)

- If you are here only for the Puzzle aspect of the game, the adventure aspect of the game (collecting, crafting, health) can be fully ignored and is merely there because it makes me feel like I am doing well in the game when the inventory is full of stuff. (This might change in the future, with either the removal/change/expansion of the system, but this is the current state of it.)

-Extensive Options, along with the basics (graphics, audio) there are additional settings for example the light sources in the game like the light beams themselves, the fire bowls along with the background light can be customized so you can customize the experience.
autokwd: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure

title: Golden Ticket Simulator
description:
게임 정보


Immerse yourself in the ultimate cinematic experience with Golden Ticket Simulator – the revolutionary theater simulator that lets you and your friends enjoy unforgettable movie moments in virtual cinemas. Whether you're a movie buff, a social butterfly, or simply someone looking for a new way to spend time with friends, Golden Ticket Simulator provides the perfect platform. 🍿
Features

Virtual Theaters: Experience movies in stunningly realistic theaters that you can share with your friends. Choose from a variety of theaters, ranging from classic Art Deco cinemas to modern IMAX experiences.

Iconic Movie Scenes: Visit famous film locations and enjoy movies right on the set. Watch a classic at the T-Rex enclosure from "Jurassic Park" or experience a screening aboard a spaceship.

Personalized Avatars: Create your own avatar and give it a unique look. Show off your style as you move around the virtual cinema.

Exclusive Content: Get access to special screenings, premieres, and Q&A sessions with filmmakers. Discover exclusive bonus content and behind-the-scenes material.

Easy Invites: Quickly and easily invite your friends to join your screenings. Share your experiences and make every movie night a social event.

Interactive NPC Guests: Encounter our live, Artificial Intelligence-driven cinema NPCs who converse with you in real-time. Enjoy stimulating dialogues, receive bespoke movie recommendations, and enhance the cinematic atmosphere with an exciting buzz.





(The content of this page is currently evolving in tandem with our development efforts and will be subject to ongoing refinement.)

title: Best Laid Plans
description:
게임 정보
You are the Commander - Start off with a small group of troopers and build your army. Win encounters to gain rewards. Spend rewards to collect troopers, or discover Printers to make your own! Collect perks and other assets along the way. Experience each unique room as it is revealed by your reconnaissance. Gain small footholds and develop them into larger, defensible bases. Build and maintain roads and resource income to ensure attrition does not halt your advance. After all, tactics win battles, but logistics win wars, Soldier!
Your big brother is grinning at you as you look up from your handful of troopers and the adjoining "rulebook", which still has a cheeky red bow Scotch-taped to its front. He has set all this up for you as one big birthday gift -- A Campaign for which he will be the Dungeon Master -- but you get the sense that there is something more to it as well. He wants to see how you perform. After all, you wanted some of his collection, right? Well now you have the chance to earn it.
Build Your Collection
The enemy forces are countless. To have any hope of victory you must increase your numbers. Troopers are the bread & butter of your force, but there are plenty of... Jams? Tanks, planes and trains are just some of the things you may obtain. Augment the abilities of your entire forces, or specific units, with the collection of Perks! Steer your production into the units that work best for you and your strategy.
Wage War on Multiple Levels
Deploy your units and designate tactics to win encounters. As you bulldoze your way through the enemy, don't expect them to sit idly by. Enemy forces will coalesce for Room Combat at set intervals, in which you must defend your bases, moving whole companies between footholds and claiming new ground when able. Small gains from encounters can add up to big advantages when the bell tolls!
Explore rooms and claim objectives. Determine the priority of different points of interest for your personal Strategy. You don't have all the time in the world, after all. The enemy forces grow stronger with each turn of the board. Make sure you have a plan for what you pursue!
Thwart the Chipper Regime
Expunge the evil Chipper armies room by room. Discover their origins and intentions along the way. All these enemy forces must be coming from somewhere, after all. Reinforce your points of control to prevent retaliatory strikes from erasing your progress. Gain bonuses for maintaining full room control and defeating Chipper Lieutenants.

title: This Be Mutiny
description:
게임 정보
This Be Mutiny is a turn-based strategy game about treasure, romance, and betrayal.

You and your crew of swashbuckling pirates are on an epic treasure hunt - until it devolves into mutiny. But if you can survive the backstabbings and betrayals, the treasure will be yours!!!

Treasure - Work through a series of heists to lead you to the long lost treasure.
Romance - Get to know your crew mates along your adventures.
Betrayal - But be ready: at the end of each heist, your pirates will inevitably betray you.

title: Broken Shores
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Broken Shores, a serene beach cleanup simulation where you become the island's environmental hero. After a devastating cyclone ravaged this once-pristine paradise, the island is now a patchwork of debris and desolation. Your mission is to restore the island's natural beauty, one piece of trash at a time.

Features:

Explore and Clean: Wander along sunlit shores and lush trails as you discover hidden pockets of debris. From sparkling seashells to tangled piles of plastic, your task is to meticulously clean up the remnants of the cyclone’s wrath.

Transform Trash into Treasure: Collect various types of trash and use them to repair and refurbish the island’s decaying structures. Rebuild shelters, revitalize gardens, and rejuvenate coastal habitats to breathe life back into the island.

Relaxing Gameplay: Enjoy a tranquil experience with no time limits or pressure. Take your time to appreciate the calming sounds of the waves and the gentle breeze as you work to restore the island.

Beautiful Environments: Immerse yourself in stunning, hand-crafted environments. From the sun-drenched beaches to the verdant rainforests, every corner of the island is designed to provide a visually pleasing and relaxing escape.

Eco-Friendly Impact: Learn about the impact of pollution on natural habitats and discover eco-friendly tips as you play. Broken Shores promotes environmental awareness in a fun and engaging way.

Join the quest to heal Broken Shores and turn it back into the island paradise it once was. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a peaceful escape, this game offers a soothing and rewarding journey to restore nature’s beauty, one clean-up at a time.

title: Forbidden Offering
description:
게임 정보
Step into a world on the brink of collapse in Forbidden Offering, an isometric rogue-lite bullet heaven where dark knowledge is your greatest weapon and the end of the world is a looming threat. Carve your path through relentless hordes of monsters with your daring duo, March and Lenore, as they defy fate and challenge the very fabric of their deteriorating reality.
In this crumbling world, the ritual demands the immolation of the girl named Lenore to prevent it from falling apart completely. Yet, young witch March stands defiant, her heart set against this cruel fate. Thus begins their perilous journey to the Last Horizon Threshold, unaware of the true extent of Lenore's mysterious power.
Features
Traverse through diverse world pieces, each with unique biomes as the world collapses around you.
March gains access to new powers as the story unfolds, evolving her abilities to devastating effect.
Unearth ancient relics that bestow new, deadly abilities to aid your quest.
Confront formidable bosses guarding each pathway to the Last Horizon Threshold.
Wield formidable magic, with a variety of unique spells to master.

title: Trapped: Forced To Kill
description:
게임 정보
Life turns around when you find out that you have woken up in a room that isn't yours.

Suddenly, to make things worse; Ciara Mori finds out that she has been trapped with a crazy, psycho, man who wants nothing but to gain enjoyment out of seeing others in pain. And if that's not enough, shortly after you find out that you are imprisoned with twelve other helpless people who want nothing but to get out and see their family again.

But that won't be happening! Not until he gets his enjoyment.

Or will you possibly find a way to escape this hell-room? It's up to you to learn about this mysterious place and pick up new clues on how you got there. New clues that could possibly lead to your escape... Mingle with other characters, gain relationships, friendships, and enjoy intimate moments with your chosen characters. But be careful, don't get too close to them... they might turn on you.

What To Expect:
- You play as Ciara Mori: a nine-teen year-old girl. Explore the areas you're trapped in, search for clues, mingle with characters and enjoy
the dark, twisted storyline that is bound to get you swept off your feet! Participate in various killing games, torture games and more, brought to you by the
cunning antagonist- Akira! Work on putting together clues from the story in order to find out the true reason on why you were brought here and enjoy the
beautiful, hand drawn art, with special intimate moments!

Gaining Relationships with Characters:
-Throughout the story, get closer to the one and only, Ash Ito. Enjoy intimate moments with him, choose different choices in order to strengthen your
relationship, help him through tough times and solve puzzles together! It may be a tough situation, but there's always time for a bit of romance ;).
With other characters, you get moments where you can speak to your favourite characters, help them, and get them to trust you.

Steam Features:
-Choose certain choices or actions to gain steam achievements!

title: Flaming Trails - Lost Ember
description:
게임 정보
At the end of time, an ancient, familiar evil awakens, threatening the remaining life in the universe.
Join Ember on a journey in this fantasy adventure, where exploration, combat, and puzzles await you. Traverse beautifully crafted landscapes, from enchanted forests to ancient ruins, as you battle the forces of darkness and restore balance to a world on the brink of destruction.
Features
Exciting Combat: Fight alongside Ember and take on intricate bosses and monsters.
Puzzles: Solve a variety of puzzles that challenge your logical thinking and creativity. Each puzzle is carefully designed to seamlessly blend with the environment and story, unlocking new areas and secrets as you progress through the story. Discover the history of a civilization on the edge of collapse.
Engaging Story: Uncover the secrets of a forgotten past and confront the darkness that threatens the world. Experience a rich narrative that unfolds through dialogues and environmental storytelling.
Handcrafted Art: Enjoy a hand-pixeled experience with original environments, character designs, and animations that bring the world of Ember to life.
About Us
We are a passionate two-person indie studio, dedicated to creating captivating and meaningful gaming experiences. Every aspect of this game, from the art to the gameplay, has been lovingly crafted to provide you with an unforgettable adventure. We’re thrilled that you’ve discovered our game and hope it brings you as much joy as we had in developing it.

title: Sintropia
description:
게임 정보
Defend your home with fruits and towers made of scrap in Sintropia!
Prepare yourself for a strategic battle in Sintropia, a adorable tower defence where you control fruits with special skills to defend your trunk.
Colect resources and build your defences:
During the day, explore the map colecting resources like scrap metal and destroying iron blocks to obtain "scrap" the money of the game. Use the scrap to build and enhance powerfull towers that will defend your trunk from enemy waves.
Control frutis with unique skills:
Lead a army of fruits, each one with their own set of unique skills. Some being faster, other being able to carry more resources, and other ones with special skills like being able to increase the speed of other fruits.
Manage your time wisely:
Time is a precious resource on Sintropia. Use the day time to colect resources, build your defences and prepare for the night. Because when the sun sets, waves of enemies will try to reach your trunk. Utilize your resources strategically to defend your base from the attacks to come.
Download the demo:
The free demo of Sintropia will be avaiable soon! Give us your feedback, revies, and suggestion of interesting game mechanics that you would like to see!
What will come in the final release:
Local Co-Op for up to 2 players.
Minigames for up to 4 players localy.
More than 5 variants for each fruit
More than 20 worlds, with each one containing at least 5 stages, each world will introduce a new gimmick, like rain, mud, wind, storms and more.
More fruits like the grapes, avocados and cocoa. And also a few vegetables and tubers, like potato, carrot and beets.
Better accesibility and difficulty options
And more...

Join an Airsoft free for all with no rules of engagement make friends betray your friends collect loot for an edge and more

title: Rat Race Ritual
description:
게임 정보
Choose your side: Developer or Boss, and outsmart the opposition in a tense, role-based struggle for survival
Your role is to manage developers and keep productivity on track, but it’s not always about catching them right away. Assign tasks through the "Gira" system and decide when to report suspicious behavior or let developers continue their work. Sometimes, allowing them to complete tasks like brewing "Schrödinger's coffee" might lead to big rewards—or dire consequences. You can also temporarily slow down developers or send them to HR for a performance check. If developers don't report to HR in time, their location will be revealed on the minimap, giving you the upper hand in tracking them down.

title: Driving Rogue
description:
게임 정보
Driving Rogue plunges you into a high-speed rogue-like challenge where every race is a fight for survival and mastery. Navigate treacherous city streets, execute precise maneuvers, and unlock the mysteries of your past with each victorious run.
Core Gameplay
Drive, drift, and deploy unique abilities to dominate the roads. Master the art of precision driving to finish each level in an optimal state and unlock potent upgrades and new challenges.

title: Albert's Ark Idle
description:
게임 정보
Experience Albert’s Ark Idle, an idle/clicker adventure filled with magical minigames and exciting activities! Gather money by clicking your castle, playing minigames, buying and upgrading buildings, and restore magic to the kingdom while you go on fun adventures!


Fishing, Fusions and Food

Use the power of Creature Essence to unlock minigames. Grow vegetables at the farm to gain a variety of buffs, or use the harbor to explore the Seven Seas with Albert and come back with huge treasures.




After acquiring Creature Essence from adventures, from all over the world, who will help you with your tasks. Harness the strength of the Bigfoot, the grace of the Unicorn, and the whimsical magical powers of the Fairy to and boost your clicks.




Through hard work and the help of your mystical friends, return magic to the world, which will bring changes to the island with new visuals and also give a boost to your income.




Upgrade and develop your buildings and watch as they visually change to bigger and more impressive structures!




Jealous and greedy pirates will “visit” you to take your riches. or click away the bombs they throw at you to stop them, keeping your island safe from their pillaging schemes... for a time.




Use this power to for your next playthrough! Choose your path, craft your destiny, and ascend to greatness in the world of Albert’s Ark Idle.

title: Cardinal Descent
description:
게임 정보
카디널 디센트
이 중독성 있는 전략적 덱 빌더 게임에서 원소를 마스터하세요! 카디널 디센트는 무한히 다시 플레이할 수 있는 로그라이크 게임으로, 원소 기반의 손패를 사용하고, 게임을 바꾸는 스페이스 카드를 발견하며, 정교하게 구성된 덱이 점점 더 어렵고 복잡해지는 적의 카드에 파괴적인 콤보를 퍼붓는 모습을 즐길 수 있습니다.
원소를 마스터하세요
원소 기반의 슈트 카드를 사용해 적을 공격하고, 전략적으로 결합하여 강력한 효과를 발휘하세요. 전통적인 카드 슈트는 흙, 물, 불, 번개로 대체되었습니다. 각 손패는 이 원소들의 조합을 극대화하기 위해 신중하게 고려되어야 합니다. 예를 들어, 번개 카드는 젖은 카드에 공격할 때 두 배의 효과를 발휘하며, 불과 물을 결합하면 증기 피해를 줄 수 있습니다.
공간을 창출하세요
상점에서 강력한 스페이스 카드를 구매하여 손패에 카드 피해 배수, 증기 및 연소 효과 조작 등의 수정 효과를 추가하세요. 특정 전략을 중심으로 덱을 구성하여 자신의 능력을 극대화하고, 놀라운 콤보를 완성하세요.

title: Merana and the Cubewalker
description:
게임 정보
메라나와 큐브워커는 스토리 기반의 3인칭 퍼즐 플랫포머 게임입니다.
메라나는 어느 날 정육면체를 발견한 정착촌의 소녀입니다. 이 유물로 인해 세상이 그녀를 중심으로 움직이게 됩니다. 루빅스 큐브처럼 현재 있는 영역을 회전할 수 있습니다.
게임 플레이
주요 핵심 요소는 큐브입니다. 큐브는 모든 방향으로 회전할 수 있는 3x3x3 루빅스 큐브입니다. 큐브를 회전하면 표면이 다양한 방식으로 새로운 위치로 이동합니다.
게임의 목표는 어느 시점에서 모든 영역을 발견하는 것입니다. 먼저 미개척 지역이 지도에 표시된 다음 퍼즐과 마주하게 됩니다. 시간이 지남에 따라 점점 더 많은 지역을 이용할 수 있게 되면서 퍼즐은 더욱 어려워집니다.
퍼즐 네트워크
퍼즐을 푸는 방법에는 여러 가지가 있습니다. 플레이어는 레벨을 하나씩 완료하는 대신 어떤 퍼즐을 풀지 선택할 수 있습니다. 모든 사람이 같은 목표를 가지고 있지만 접근 방식이 다른 일종의 네트워크 시스템입니다.
지식
루빅스 큐브를 이해할 필요는 없지만, 새로운 시도를 통해 새로운 경로를 만들 수 있습니다. 리셋 버튼을 사용하면 큐브를 원래 위치로 되돌릴 수 있으므로 엉망이 될까 걱정할 필요가 없습니다.
그래픽

title: Spritz the Happy Onion
description:
게임 정보
Steven Spielberg once said, "I think the real indicator [that games have become a storytelling art form] will be when somebody confesses that they cried at level 17." Well your move, Steve!

Spritz the Happy Onion is a zesty, delicious throwback to momentum-based platformers of old, complete with run button. Except in this game, you can die as many times as you like. Though dying does lose you an expensive egg, which are important because...

A MONSTER HAS APPEARED IN THE SKY TO DEVOUR THE MOON. And only our little layered lancealot possesses a recipe for a cake that might ruin it's appetite.

Spritz can also hop off of background elements, (a feature so satisfying and natural and fun I'm not sure why I haven't seen it anywhere before,) and don magic hats to give him extra abilities like flight and invincibility.

I'm Googling it right now, and it seems like the moon is important for a lot of things like tides and satellites and night visibility. It's not just pretty! So it would be very prudent for you to help Spritz on his quest!

title: LocoPets
description:
게임 정보
미친 동물은 "팀 빌더" 로그라이크입니다. 덱 빌더와 자동 전투기의 최고 요소를 결합하여 완전히 새로운 것을 만듭니다. 팀을 구성하고, 말도 안 되는 시너지를 발견하며, 숫자를 증가시키세요. 각 플레이는 무한한 가능성을 제공합니다.

혼돈을 받아들여라
미친 동물의 힘을 풀어보세요! 동물과 매력을 결합하여 멋지고 놀라운 상호작용을 발견하세요. 음식을 활용하고, 포션과 스크롤을 사용하여 미친 동물을 특수 특성과 강화로 업그레이드하세요. 각 플레이는 실험하고 전략을 세우며, 미친 콤보와 터무니없는 시너지를 발견할 수 있는 새로운 기회입니다.

60가지 고유한 매력, 각각 게임을 바꾸는 효과를 가지고 있습니다
18가지 고유한 미친 동물, 각각 고유한 특수 능력을 가지고 있습니다
25가지 음식, 포션, 스크롤로 동물을 강화, 업그레이드, 변경합니다
20개의 토큰으로 플레이를 영구적으로 업그레이드합니다
8가지 원소 유형으로 팀을 구성할 수 있는 특별한 매력 상호작용이 있습니다
특수 특성과 브랜드를 통해 동물에게 더욱 고유한 힘을 제공합니다
미친 동물의 레벨을 올려 그들의 힘과 능력의 위력을 증가시킵니다
유형 및/또는 크기가 같은 미친 동물의 친화도를 올려 강화하세요
신비로운 마법사를 방문하여 특별한 비용으로 특별한 아이템을 구매하세요

title: UNDER DEATH
description:
게임 정보
Discover an explosive mix of platformer, roguelite, and survivor! Transform your world, enhance your character, use your items, and battle hordes of enemies and formidable bosses—find your way to victory!
Enjoy a game feel based on intuitive, physics-driven mechanics! Explore Under Death to understand its workings and secrets, battle powerful demons with various abilities, and survive attacks from all tormented souls.
Your death will be far from restful: you're trapped in Under Death, a world where lost souls traverse time. It's a world with its own rules, where the law of the strongest prevails. But an external force has granted you a mysterious power: you can free souls that will help you escape.

title: Shadows of Delusion
description:
게임 정보
Shadows of Delusion is a classic inspired, first-person survival horror game where you must survive the horrors of a desolate town filled with disturbing delusions.
Fight against horrific creatures:
Using any weapons you come across and conserving your ammo is necessary to survive this nightmare.
Journey through the surreal hellscape of the human mind:
Explore horrifying locations to find items and documents to search for answers.
Solve challenging puzzles:
Discover the secrets of the delusion by solving twisted puzzles.

title: Adult Game
description: Adult Game

title: The Last Camp 1990
description:
게임 정보
The Last Camp 1990 is a horror game about a group of friends who go camping in the middle of woods.

You will witness the chilling scenes that start when 4 friends set out to camp in the forest and their car runs out of gas.

This game is primarily a horror simulator game with a first-person narrative involving exploration, driving and conversation mechanics.

First person controller.
Receive texts from NPCs.
Atmospheric environment graphics.
Retro film aesthetic.

Creepy music and sound effects.

title: Galactic Love Utopia
description:
게임 정보
You are a fanfiction writer who gets kidnapped by aliens. But instead of being probed or experimented upon you are taken to a space station run by a mysterious rich backer who selects a single member of each known intelligent alien species to write more for them to read. You are the only human on a writer's retreat space station filled with different alien species.
In Galactic Love Utopia you will meet and get to know a bunch of intergalactic babes as you try to get used to living in this luxurious yet strange environment.
Gameplay
Galactic Love Utopia is a story focused visual novel with some dating simulator elements. Make choices and decide which part of the space station you want to explore by selecting a room to visit on the interactive map. Focus on improving your relationship with one or some of the main heroines, or visit a place where none of them tend to hang out for a scene with one of the side heroines.
Main heroines
, a shy woman from an alien species whose skin color changes depending on their emotions.

title: Uncursed
description:
게임 정보
Uncursed is a co-op pirate adventure where you rescue lost souls, loot shiny treasures, items and uncover secrets so dark even your torch might quit. Survive deadly dungeons, face unpredictable weather, and the occasional chaos caused by your crewmates—all while gathering loot to buy a ship, buy cool gear, and maybe splurge on a new hat.
Your crew's goal is to buy and repair a ship to reach more distant waters and shed light on the threatening secret.
Explore the surrounding islands alone or in a team, collect valuable objects and the souls attached to them. Every day you can take part in a new adventure in the procedurally generated dungeon, which rewards you with valuable treasures if you survive its terrifying creatures and cunning traps.
Many mysteries and social experiences await you at sea and on the islands; from uncovering dark secrets to sharing intimate shit taking at sunset.

title: Mage Food Truck
description:
게임 정보
Play your cards to explore a hangry realm, crafting and delivering exotic meals in the face of fantastical beasts and curses from dissatisfied customers.

Gameplay
Mage Food Truck is a single player roguelike deckbuilder. Each run consists of a Morning, Day, and Night shift, with turn events that become increasingly perilous. You'll play hands from your growing collection to traverse the realm, collect ingredients, craft recipes, and deliver them to earn as much gold as possible. When the day is done or your truck is wrecked, your customers will pass judgment upon you with a review of 0-3 stars!

Each work day begins with a small starter deck, and you’ll purchase new cards from the Turvy Mart at the end of each turn. Playing a Job card lets you use any crew member's ability, which you can combine with other cards to boost productivity!



The Explorer travels around the map, seeking ingredients and delivering food.
The Chef crafts delicious dishes from ingredients you've collected.
The Mage protects your truck with a magic shield and fights off pesky curses.
The Bard motivates your crew with EXP, unlocking powerful Special cards unique to each crew member.

title: L8R SK8R
description:
게임 정보
L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

Just like those classics, new areas in the hub world are unlocked with a collection mechanic, but instead of collecting stars, crystals, or dragons, you have to collect time.

When exploring the hub world, you’ll encounter time locks that hinder your progress.

These locks will require you to collect a certain amount of time in order to be opened.

Every time you beat a level, you’ll collect any time you shave off your previous best record. (Each level has a default record that it starts with. Basically a par time.)

So, for example, if you need another minute to open a lock, you could go back and beat the best times in three levels by 20 seconds. Or alternatively you could shave 10 seconds off of six levels. You might even find a shortcut that lets you take a whole minute off of just one level. The choice is yours!

Master the core movement mechanics; wall jumping, wall riding, air dashing, sliding, boosting, and of course, double jumping.

Play through 25 unique levels set across various time periods across all of history, including five boss fights.

title: JumpMap
description:
게임 정보
JumpMap 은 흥미진진한 1인칭 3D 플랫폼 게임으로 특별한 메커니즘을 제공합니다: 떨어질 때마다 이전 위치로 되돌아갑니다. 정밀함과 타이밍을 요구하는 20개 이상의 신중하게 설계된 레벨을 탐험하세요. 이제 Speedrun 모드가 추가되었습니다: 모든 레벨을 통과하고 최고의 시간을 기록해 보세요!
당신의 유일한 목표는 각 레벨의 정상에 도달하는 것입니다. 클라이밍에 집중하고 도전을 헤쳐 나가며 각 오르막을 정복하는 능력을 키우세요.
게임 플레이
Speedrun 모드: 시계를 보며 모든 레벨을 한 번에 클리어하세요. 시간을 추적하고 최고 기록을 목표로 도전하세요. 자신과 친구들과 경쟁하여 가장 빠르게 완료하세요!
최고 시간 추적: 각 레벨을 완료하는 속도를 측정하고, 개인 최고 기록을 통해 도전과 성취감을 느껴보세요.
더블 점프: 공중에서 다시 한 번 점프할 수 있는 능력을 통해, 가장 까다로운 플랫폼도 마스터하고 새로운 높이에 도달하세요.
컨트롤러 및 Steam Deck 지원: 컨트롤러 또는 Steam Deck을 사용할 때 원활한 게임 플레이를 즐기세요. 이동 중에도 편안하게 또는 소파에서 편안하게 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: Manipulus - A Deck Building Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times.
As a Manipuli general, form strategic defensive lines and manoeuvre your followers to activate wild abilities to defeat the oncoming monsters and lead your band to safety. Re-play your cards, re-live your actions, and fight to keep your refugees alive in this dark and captivating adventure.
It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: Witchpop
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Souper Star Cafe where the secret ingredient is Magic. Pick your chef and sous chef, pick your soup, and cook with your spells to make the best soup possible.
Features
Physics Based Puzzle Matching, where you'll have to match ingredients in real time! Avoid your ingredients touching the bottom of the pot where they'll end up burning. Too many burned ingredients and your soup will be ruined!
Accumulate Curses over time and survive as long as you can while trying to attain the highest score possible.
Use Spells to either help save your soup or to score even higher
Risk and Reward Gameplay. Make and store up larger clusters of ingredients to score even more, and take extra curse cards for even higher multipliers
Play with Friends, either head to head in different soup pots, or cooperatively sharing the same pot with multiple cursors.
Multiple Characters to change the aesthetics of your chef and sous chef. With all characters sharing the same abilities, all characters are equally viable to be picked.
Mouse/Keyboard and Controller Support. Either use your mouse to fling ingredients, or, use a gamepad to control the cursor or to teleport between ingredients for incredibly fast movement.

title: Bass Invaders
description:
게임 정보
Nasty aliens from outer space want to eat your moonbase. This is out of the question! Board your tank, load your cannons, and show the aliens who's boss. Aliens you destroy drop items, which you can collect to upgrade your tank. But beware of falling debris and rivalling players who try to snatch the items from under your nose. Aliens move to the rhythm of the music and this helps you anticipate their movement. Get into the groove in order to blast aliens quicker, and score bonus points! Who can eliminate the most aliens and get the highscore? Hilarious outer space musical mayhem for 1-4 players.

title: Echos
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in an expansive and captivating world where exploration, survival, and strategy intertwine to create a unique gaming experience.
In this open-world survival adventure, you will embark on a journey through vast and diverse landscapes, each teeming with secrets waiting to be uncovered. From dense forests to barren deserts, icy tundras to mysterious caves, the environments are not only visually stunning but also brimming with hidden challenges.
Key Features:
Exploration and Discovery: Traverse various biomes, each with its own set of challenges and resources. Uncover hidden areas, ancient ruins, and mysterious artifacts that may change the course of your journey.
Crafting and Resource Management: Gather resources from the environment to craft essential tools, weapons, and survival gear. Whether you're building a shelter, crafting advanced weaponry, or preparing potions, careful resource management is crucial to your survival.
Dynamic Combat: Face off against a range of creatures, each with its own attack patterns and weaknesses. Engage in real-time, fast-paced combat where both skill and strategy are needed to survive.
Survival Mechanics: Keep an eye on your character's health, hunger, and stamina levels. Adapt to the environment by learning to craft necessary survival items such as clothing, fire starters, and food, while managing limited resources.
Story and Quests: Experience an engaging narrative filled with side quests and objectives. The world is rich with lore, and every discovery brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind your environment and your place within it.

title: Sigma Squad
description:
게임 정보
Sigma Squad is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer FPS that takes the classic genre experience to a new level of precision.
“What you see is what you get,” some say. In Sigma Squad, we have that too, but with one difference—it actually works here. With 256-tickrate servers, we guarantee smooth gameplay and precise shots that let you trust every move you make.
Explore five unique maps, each inspired by different cultures and iconic spots:
Freedom Land
Maiameee
Hong
Japanese Sunset
"The day"
Created by a small, family-run indie studio with over 10 years of experience in technology development, Sigma Squad represents our passion for the genre and our desire to deliver an enhanced and precise experience for both casual and competitive players alike.
We greatly appreciate your support in adding Sigma Squad to your wishlist.

title: Incrate
description:
게임 정보
Incrate is a mind-warping 2D/3D puzzle game contained within a crate! You've been mysteriously trapped in a bizarre box-shaped prison. Rotating the prison will twist your notions of perspective. Bend reality to your whim and manipulate your world and the things in it to solve the puzzles and escape!
You find yourself suddenly uplifted from your life and discover you're an inmate in a crate with no recollection of how or why you got there. The crate is an otherworldly prison contained within a boxed world. The local inhabitants that greet and guide you seem to be a despondent guard and mysterious ghost...

title: Yaku Slap
description:
게임 정보
🎴 Yaku Slap – Walk the Flower Path and Slap Down Monsters! 🌸
Ready to duel monsters, master ancient card combos, and get just a little addicted to slapping down the perfect hand? Yaku Slap blends the strategic flair of Hanafuda Koi Koi with rogue-like chaos where every match could be your last—or your ultimate victory.
Collect powerful spells, master rare Yaku combinations, and score big as you fight your way down the Flower Path to become a true Yaku Master. Win, lose, and unlock classes, and passive abilities with every run!

🎴 Features:
🌿 Strategic Card Combat: Master the classic Koi Koi mechanics with a supernatural twist.
🌸 Rogue-like Progression: Every run earns you perks and passives to power up.
🃏 Monster Showdowns: Duel dangerous creatures that are as challenging as they are zany—slap hard or get slapped!

title: Absolution of the Dead
description:
게임 정보
NARRATIVE.
The Germans knew they would lose the war. In a desperate attempt at victory, they unleashed a hell upon the battlefront that would consume Europe...
You wake up in a zombie infested hotel, the only way out is to descend into pure chaos. As you go from floor to floor slaughtering the undead, you'll go deeper into the trenches of your mind to uncover the truth of the outbreak.

title: Unfoldink
description:
게임 정보
Unfoldink is a 2D logical puzzle adventure game where you craft unique combinations of cards, to come up with animated stories that explain the tribe's depararature.
UNFOLDINK OFFERS
-> Unique mind boggling puzzles
 -> Total of 10 diffrent cards and...
...over 350 animated combinations
-> Surprising and funny character interactions

title: Nothing At Stake
description:
게임 정보
Nothing At Stake is an open world action-adventure styled in the vein of classic n64 games, specifically taking inspiration from the first 3d Legend of Zelda games.
Within is an oblique dark fantasy world packed full of dungeons, ruins of a recently dead civilization, and colorful characters doing their best to survive in a seemingly hopeless world.
Help them make something of the scattered chaos that remains or set down your own path accumulating power as you scope out a land you'd been long isolated from.
Story
OVER A DECADE AGO, THE DOMINANT CIVILIZATION FELL.
STRUCK BY AN OTHERWORLDLY FORCE, MANIFESTED IN THE FORM OF A 100 QUADRILLION TON CONGLOMERATION OF ROCK, METAL, AND OTHER INDETERMINATE SUBSTANCES.

title: The Otherworld Laboratory
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 실종된 지인을 찾아 연구실을 방문합니다.
그곳에서 그는 다른 세계의 연구실에 갇힌 자신을 발견합니다.
연구실은 네 가지 지시를 내립니다.
- 이상이 있으면 왼쪽 복도로 가세요.
- 이상이 없으면 오른쪽 복도로 가세요.
- F호실에 있는 출구로 나가세요.
- 온 길을 되돌아가지 마세요.
-----------------------------------------------------------------
※ 이 작품에는 소름 돋는 표현과 충격적인 장면이 포함되어 있습니다. 이러한 콘텐츠에 익숙하지 않은 분은 주의해 주시기 바랍니다.
[다른 차원의 공포]
설정은 장난꾸러기 사악한 신이 만든 특별한 "연구실"입니다. 현실과 분리된 뒤틀린 세계입니다. 플레이어는 신비한 규칙을 따르고 출구를 찾아 다른 차원의 금지된 연구실을 돌아다닙니다.
※ 시나리오는 Exit 8과 크툴루 신화에서 영감을 받았습니다.
[실시간 영상/스트리밍에 관하여]
동영상 공유 사이트에 영상을 스트리밍하고 게시하는 것은 허용됩니다.

title: Simulario
description:
게임 정보
The game features experimental 2D simulated physics based gameplay. The main feature of the game is that every pixel, every object, every particle in the game is a simulated physical entity.

This means, that the game is fair, it doesn't create invisible walls, doesn't impose unpredictable or illogical rules, doesn't script the way objects interact. What you see gives you complete idea what to expect. If you see a wall and want to go through, just shoot it and go.

Everything in the game is destructible. Everything acts accordingly to laws of physics, so if you want to do something, and your real world intuition makes you expect things to act in a certain way, chances are the game objects you interact with will work as you expect.

Therefore, the way you plan to win the level is up to you. You can explore possibilities, be creative, and you ideas will work if physics allow it. You can add matter, build shapes, create mechanical tools to reach the destination, you can destroy things. You can use forces, momentum or inertia. You can use ropes, wheels, jet engines, and so on.

Purely physically based gameplay is not very popular due to high performance requirements of physics simulation. But two years of prototyping and plenty of computer science allowed me to solve all problems and remove all technical obstacles, and now we have a robust physics engine, that works very fast, and allows to build massive sophisticated and fun to play with physical worlds.

The game will consists of many very different levels. You will drive a dirt bike, drive tanks and heavy multi purpose machines, fly in air, serf in water, dive underwater, fly in space, float in zero gravity or fight massive gravity, dig underground, build mechanical machines, attach jet engines and launch rockets, use ropes and forces, use heavy explosives and laser weapons. Simulated physics allow planty of ways to have fun.

But one of the most prominent features will be to control a soft body based character, that has evolved to walk and fight. That's a never before experienced level of realism and immersion.

The game is currently on early stage of implementing gameplay mechincs. The game will not be released in any kind of early access until it is finished and polished. But there will be multiple demos published, that would allow you to enjoy some of the physics based gameplay.

The game will include competitive levels with Steam based leaderboards, as well as casual levels. All levels will be highly replayable due to the fact, that it's hard to win one way, the physical world is chaotic in a certain way, and your actions will turn the world in different configurtations every time, opening new possibilities to beat levels.

The game will also have a tool for the players to create and publish user generated content.

title: On Roads Between
description:
게임 정보

Also, I am going to look into making the stickers tradable, with a foil and aging system. Keep an eye out for rare stickers, because you might be the only one in the world to have it.
