게임 정보
Establish Your Stronghold
 Start with an empty plot of land, and gradually expand your base by deploying into raids and gathering essential resources. As you venture out, you'll scavenge items from abandoned towns, ruins, and other hazardous locations, carefully extracting valuable materials like guns, ammo, and food. Every raid brings its own set of dangers, from radioactive zones to swarming mutant creatures. Some regions are heavily contaminated, requiring special gear and caution to loot safely. These zones might hide rare resources, but also host terrifying, radiation-mutated monsters that could easily overwhelm an unprepared survivor.
Build and Fortify Your Base 
Back at your base, use the resources you gather to construct new structures, fortify walls, and develop areas that support your growing community. The more you build, the more survivors you'll attract. These survivors come with unique skills and specialties—some may be engineers, able to repair or improve your armory; others might be skilled medics, offering healing services. As you expand, you’ll also attract traders who bring exotic goods from far-off places, but their supplies come at a steep price. Negotiating with them and exchanging loot for crucial supplies could turn the tide in your survival.
Survive in a Dangerous World 
Along with the growing base, you’ll face ever-present threats. The world around you is constantly shifting, and you must adapt. Dangerous mutants—twisted by the apocalypse’s radioactive fallout—roam the wilderness, and become more common as time continues and some may even infiltrate your base. Your best defense might be well-equipped guards, fortified outposts, and traps designed to ward off these horrific invaders. The wasteland is unpredictable, and with the constant looming threat of radiation storms and mutant hordes, staying one step ahead is vital.
Make Strategic Decisions 
Your decisions will be key to surviving. As you deploy into new areas for exploration, gathering crucial resources and completing quests, you may stumble upon new factions, rogue survivors, or hostile creatures. Completing missions for these groups might offer unique rewards, such as new weapons, armor, or blueprints for advanced technology. But be careful—alliances are fragile, and sometimes helping one group means making enemies with another.

title: Pizza Super Slice
description:
게임 정보
Pizza Super Slice is a cartoon-exploration-platformer in which you play as an animated pizza slice. Explore a strange, cartoonish town full of little secrets, dark corners and secret passages.

title: Fling your Friends TD - Tower Defense
description:
게임 정보
Dedicated to my daughter. Wherever you are, I hope you know that you are loved.
Fling your Friends TD is the ultimate party game that will have you and your friends laughing, strategizing, and outsmarting each other in the most entertaining showdown ever! In this game, players take on the roles of either the Defender or the Attackers in a wild and whimsical battle of wits and creativity.
Defender:
Build Your Fortress: Carefully place traps and obstacles to create a formidable defense that will challenge the Attackers.
Special Abilities: Use unique abilities to disrupt and thwart the Attackers' progress, adding an extra layer of strategy to your defenses.
Attacker:
Plan and Conquer: Strategically plan your route and collaborate with your friends (or go solo) to navigate through the Defender's traps.
Character Progression: Level up your character's skills and counter the Defender's strategies.
Overcome Challenges: Utilize special abilities to outmaneuver obstacles and reach your goal.
Key Features
Cooperative PvP Multiplayer: Engage in thrilling multiplayer modes, teaming up with and against friends in a battle of cunning.
Creative Trap: Place an array of imaginative traps that will keep the Attackers on their toes.
Hilarious Gameplay: Experience the fun and chaos of a light-hearted game designed to bring joy and laughter to your gaming sessions.
Strategic Depth: Balance creativity and strategy to outwit your opponents and achieve victory.
Vibrant Visuals: Enjoy colorful and cartoony graphics that enhance the game's charm and appeal.
Replayability: Every game offers a unique experience with countless trap combinations and strategies to explore.
autokwd: Fling your Friends TD - Tower Defense

title: PreStrafe
description:
게임 정보
What is this?
PreStrafe is a direct homage that recreates all of the movement mechanics of The Specialists, a Half-life mod with unique movement abilities that allows full creative freedom in your approach to your environment, these include:
Dive
Walldive
Walljump
Wallflip
Roll
Flip
Plus all of the many aspects of GoldSrc movement mechanics, bunny-hopping, prestrafing, air strafing, wallstrafing, surfing, ramp trimping, and more.
Gamemodes.
Time Trial is the main mode where you compete against others and your personal best times. Freeroam is a sandbox mode where you can freely practice your skills without the stress.
Custom levels.
Use the built-in level editor, upload to workshop, subscribe and play with friends, and edit existing workshop maps to your liking.
Release and other features?
Planned features include cosmetics and other character customization, profile ranks, and rewards for top records. Release is set for Summer 2025 or earlier.
Will there be combat?
PreStrafe is primarily a movement oriented game, no further than that. Melee, guns, gun-fu, bullet time, all of the things we love from The Specialists will come under a different title.

title: Lobsterpunk
description:
게임 정보
Lobsterpunk is a puzzle, walking simulator where you make your way through an abandon city powered solely by the combustion of lobsters. Bring the dead machinery one last breath of life before their steel forms lay cold forever. As you do, see the memories of the last man on earth, the ones he loved, the ones he lost, & the mistakes he made to get to where he is.
Complete lockpicking puzzles to traverse this dead city, explore any house you desire, find the story of those who once lived here through what they left behind & how familiar that might feel, however foreign the setting.
Lockpicking Systems:
Lockpicking uses W,A,S,D to turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find the sweet spot in a lock!
Volt Wave uses W,A,S,D toto turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find a moving sweet spot on a panel!
Gearbox uses W,A,S,D to turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find the sweet spot in a set of 3 layered gears!

title: Filtration
description:
게임 정보
From the developer that brought you Quaternion comes a new ball-rolling platform challenge that's bigger, better, and full of surprises! Jump, bounce, blast, and fly through 12 pocket dimensions in order to harvest the precious power sources within. Find Modules that let your ball do things you've never seen before at the touch of a button. With robotic foes and tricky puzzles in your way, it's gonna take a lot more than Ion Cells to get through this!
Filtration is a single-player puzzle platform game. By rolling a robotic ball, you'll explore and unlock the secrets of the lost Amali civilization, along with hints as to where they might have gone. Along the way, you'll find Modules, expansion units to plug into your ball and increase its capabilities, adding abilities like a protective shield, a rocket engine, and a pair of wings. The game provides a balance of tricky platforming, brain-tickling puzzles, and action combat in order to explore every corner of the ball-rolling genre.
Features include:
12 main levels, along with several small bonus levels
An expansive Split Complex hub
12 Planck Cores for you to collect
12 Modules to power up your ball
30,000 Ion Cells
Unlockable upgrades to your abilities
An awesome soundtrack
And more!

title: Project Louisiana - The BOUNDS VR
description:
게임 정보
Explore and unveil the secrets of an old New Orleans mansion. Investigate your daughter disappearance and unravel the mysteries of a voodoo cult whose interest seems to be revolving around her.
Exploration, puzzles and combat... Will you be strong enough to survive The BOUNDS VR and  face the truth?

title: Lab 77
description:
게임 정보
The game you will love to make your friends play.

In Lab 77 you play as Specimen S539-77, making your way through the challenges of Lab 77's test chambers under the supervision of the Director. Place versions of yourself to bridge gaps between platforms, collect lab notes to learn about the lore of Lab 77, avoid dangers in the test chambers and complete your training.

Strategically maneuver your way through 77 test chambers to complete your training. Pick up collectible lab notes in each chamber to learn about the lore of Lab 77, the enigmatic Dr. Leitner and the daily issues faced by staff at Lab 77.

title: Ninas Escape
description:
게임 정보
A special kind of Jump-and-Run game in honor to the classics from the 80s home computer era. Our hero, little Nina, has been trapped into a large cave with multiple levels - you can help her to escape from there. In every level, there is a teleporter that moves Nina to the next level. Those teleporters work from batteries - so you have to collect all batteries in a level to avtivate the end level teleporter to escape from that level.
There are numerous hazards in every level: poisonous spiders dangling from the ceilings, pools filled with deadly liquids (water, slime, lava), flying balls that send out electrical shock bolts, evil people chasing Nina. Movement is done by walking, running and jumping, also climbing walls and ladders. There are lift platforms (moving horizontal and vertical), in-level teleporters that need coins to operate, and electrical forcefields that block passageways.
You can play either alone, or party up with friends or family and play locally with up to 4 players in a game (coop mode). There is no "points counting", so no rivalry is needed. But all players have to complete a level to count it "done". So it is "play together", and not "who wins the game".

title: Shenaniguns
description:
게임 정보
Shenaniguns는 탑다운 방식의 실시간 멀티플레이어 슈팅 게임입니다. 매번 생성될 때마다 게임 모드에 따라 2~3개의 무기를 얻어 친구들과 전투를 벌이세요!
권총, 샷건, 저격총, 수류탄, 터렛, 포털 건, 농축 우라늄, 그래플링 후크, 4인치 텅스텐 큐브, 산업용 대형 물총, 휘발유, 최루액, 도박, 아연도금 각철판, 드론, RPG 등 100가지 이상의 무기가…
특수 능력과 마법 부여 등 훨씬 더 많은 요소들이 기다리고 있습니다!
게임 모드
자유 경쟁 - 최대한 많은 사람을 처치하세요!
팀 데스매치 - 빨강과 파랑, 두 개의 균등한 팀!
3가지 무기 - 이름 그대로입니다
깃발 뺏기 - 상대 팀의 깃발을 획득하여 추가 점수 획득!
점령전 - 지도 곳곳에 있는 점령 지점에 서서 팀 점수를 획득하세요!
보스 전투 - Vectah 등! 곧 더 많은 보스가 추가될 예정입니다
건 게임 - 획득하는 무기는 점수에 따라 결정됩니다
혼돈 - 죽으면 폭발하고, 더 빨리 움직이며, 3가지 무기, 더 가까운 생성 지점, 더 큰 불, 더 큰 전투, 그리고 엄청난 양의 핵폐기물이 있습니다

title: Devil's Terminal
description:
게임 정보
Devil’s Terminal is a cozy mystery visual novel about troubled teens, summer camp, and an occult AI. At Camp Guidance, you will take on the role of a socially anxious outcast and stumble upon an ancient computer that foretells a greater purpose for you. The story explores themes of being lost, late-night talks around a campfire, and the strange comfort of discovering who you really are.

title: SHOJING ショウジング
description:
게임 정보
Shoji, Shocking, SHOJING.
Break through, instinctively.
"SHOJING" is a casual game in which you control a cat and break shoji screens.
Why not try breaking down those shoji screens to your heart's content, something that you're not allowed to break in the real world?
Good children and good cats, please do not copy this game.
Operation
Easy operation with only mouse movement and left click.
Even those who do not usually play games and children can easily play.

title: The Wide Open Sky is Running out of Catfish
description:
게임 정보
A vast empty sky, an old digital camera, and a home in the clouds…
Your mom has been gone for a while, and the once teeming environment has grown quiet without her careful maintenance. Equipped with a magic flute and the support of your computer friends, it’s up to you to bring abundance back to an empty sky… all on the back of a giant, flying catfish!
The Wide Open Sky is Running out of Catfish is a story-driven photography game which explores themes of friendship and the impermanence of time and place.
Giant Catfish!
Is your catfish lonely? No problem! Soar through the sky and transform clouds into fish!
Take Photos!
Document your findings! Catalog dozens of unique creatures and share your discoveries with the world below!
autokwd: The Wide Open Sky is Running out of Catfish

title: YOU ARE SUPER MEGA LEGEND PHOENIX
description:
게임 정보
불사조는 진짜 유명한 피닉스임.




당신은 2천년 전 엄청 유명한 대학살의 주인공인 전설의 피닉스이다. 당신은 전투의 상처를 치료하기 위해 2천년간 잠적했고, 지상의 마물들은 당신을 처치하기 위해 찾아왔다.



명예로운 환상수인 당신은 그들의 도전을 받아들여야 하지만, 아직 상처 치료가 덜 되어 전성기 시절의 힘을 딱 11초만 낼 수 있다.

차례로 몰려오는 적들을 모두 무찌르고 2천년 전 '불사조는 진짜 유명한 피닉스임.'의 전설을 재현해 주도록 하자.












게임이 시작되면 오른쪽 UI에 당신이 입력 가능한 키보드 키가 표시됩니다. 그 키를 눌러 마물을 공격하세요.

COMBO에 주의하십시오. 올바른 키 입력에 성공하면 1 COMBO가 쌓이고, 공격력이 상승합니다. (COMBO당 +1)
COMBO는 잘못된 키를 입력하면 0으로 초기화됩니다.



당신은 단 11초만 싸울 수 있습니다. 11초 안에 모든 적(LEVEL 10)을 처치하지 못하면 패배합니다.
autokwd: YOU ARE SUPER MEGA LEGEND PHOENIX

title: Lana: Queen of Ancient Egypt
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey in the mystical world of Lana, where ancient secrets and formidable challenges await.
Key Features:
Explore a Vast and Mysterious World
Traverse diverse landscapes, from sun-drenched deserts to enigmatic temples, each filled with hidden secrets and rich lore.
Engage in Challenging Puzzles
Solve intricate puzzles that blend logic and creativity, unlocking pathways and uncovering the mysteries of ancient civilizations.
Battle Diverse Adversaries
Face a variety of foes, each with unique abilities and strategies, requiring quick reflexes and tactical thinking.

title: Cambrox
description:
게임 정보
In a world filled with creatures known as Cambros. Get ready for a top-down 2D Pixel Art JRPG. Collect various Cambros and make a team to explore your heart's content.
Cambrox is about collecting Cambro's, battling trainers, testing your limits, and making it to the fabled Glizzy Stadium.
Collect over 200 unique Cambro's with 12 unique types in this action-packed adventure. Battle in single battle and trio rotation battles to really test your limits as a master.
After beginning this game go onto a crazy journey filled with action and adventure and see what the world of Cambrox has in store for you.
With multiple save slots feel free to try different modes while keeping your main save safe.
Easy Mode (For a chill and stress-free adventure)
Normal Mode (Intended Experience)
Hard Mode (Scaled Up Battles all Cambros in Encounters Increased, better Enemy AI)
Nuzlocke Mode (Your Cambro's cannot be revived and level caps are set for each part of the game)
Speedrun Mode (For one session playthrough, has some optimizations for speedrunners like segment practice mode)
Super excited for you to start your journey. We are a two-person team and we really hope you enjoy our hard work. We believe love is something that makes you wanna die after it's gone, but we wanna make something you'll love that will make you wanna live forever.

title: ShapeSCALE
description:
게임 정보
A game about scaling shapes

Scale shapes to match the target size
50+ levels

Created for the GMTK Game Jam 2024

title: COCOA
description:
게임 정보
COCOA는 대조적인 세계를 독특하고 감동적으로 탐험합니다.
이 게임에서는 아프리카 코트디부아르 남부에서 Issa와 Asante로서 아동 노동의 가혹한 현실을 경험하게 됩니다. 수확, 분쇄, 청소, 건조 등 카카오콩 처리의 힘든 일정을 포인트 앤 클릭 미니게임을 통해 진행하고, 경비원의 눈을 피해 은밀하게 탈출 기회를 찾는 과제를 수행합니다.

반대로, 탐욕스러운 사업가 Mr. Theodore와 그의 매니저 Tom의 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 럭셔리 초콜릿 공장을 관리하고, 운영을 확장하며, 기계를 업그레이드하는 경영 타이쿤 경험을 제공합니다.

이 어두운 RPG는 이러한 대조적인 경험들을 엮어 강렬하고 불안감을 주는 결말로 이끌며, 탐욕과 인간 가치라는 주제를 강조합니다.
특징
90년대 애니메이션 스타일로 손으로 그린 많은 컷씬들
플레이하는 매 순간 긴장감을 유지하는 강렬하고 생생한 스토리

아동 노동자:
많은 비밀 지역이 있는 어두운 미로 같은 정글을 탐험
경비원들이 지도를 스캔하여 당신을 추적하는 것을 피하기 위해 달아나거나 덤불에 숨기
포인트 앤 클릭 미니게임에서 매일 카카오 처리 작업을 완료. 늦지 않도록 하고 오늘의 목표를 달성하세요!
일터 캠프에서 탈출할 수 있도록 도와줄 다양한 NPC와 대화

초콜릿 공장:
가장 효율적인 시스템을 만들기 위해 컨베이어 벨트와 기계를 배치
공장을 업그레이드: 작업자를 기계로 대체하고, 효율성을 개선하며, 공장 공간을 확장

이 게임은 심각한 주제를 다루고 있지만, 궁극적인 목표는 상업 산업에서 아동 노동 착취에 대한 인식과 공감을 증진하는 것입니다. 우리는 이 게임에서 제시된 주제를 촉진하거나 경시할 의도가 없습니다.

title: Bleeding Hearts: Althazar Chapter
description:
게임 정보
- Available in Bleeding Hearts: Althazar

Complete Bleeding Hearts: Althazar Game

Complete the Mission and Fight against the Threat to Home Land and the world

After Wasim Khan's defeat in the 2024 General Elections, Pakistan descended into civil war, which raged for two years. Despite requests for international peacekeeping troops, the country fractured into several independent states by 2026. One of these regions declared its independence, forming a new country called Qalbistan. This nation emerged from the merger of the Port Area and Tribal regions, with its capital named Althazar.

Althazar quickly gained notoriety as the city with the highest crime rate. It's said that 25% of the population is involved in criminal activities, 25% pays to escape crime, and the remaining 50% are victims. The lawlessness in Qalbistan is so severe that no other country is willing to accept refugees from the region, not even the peacekeeping forces, who are now trapped within its borders.

As the player, you must lead your team through this chaotic and dangerous landscape. Survival is the ultimate goal, but you also face the challenge of rescuing abducted members and finding a safe haven away from the turmoil of Qalbistan. The decisions you make will determine your team's fate as you fight to navigate the lawless streets of Althazar.

Time to Start

Welcome to the world of Althazar, the first part of Bleeding Hearts Series with great collections of maps and heavy single player action. All the maps are open world 3D with new modes and gameplay features and will be available at launch to get everyone started

High Intensity Action Levels

Find, fight, kill and rescue abducted citizens while surviving and fighting tranches of enemy soldiers, rebels and facing civilian revolt in the largest maps. Massive chases to catch enemies and race against time for completing the critical missions.

Plan for escape from the world top 1 crime city Althazar. You will be provided with different set of weapons at each level and tons of interactions to get the work done and quid pro co with available civilians to get help and conquer.

title: The Lizard Problem
description:
게임 정보
Have you had enough of building impenetrable defenses and then having to wait at 2x speed until the waves provides a challenge big enough? Then look no further.



The Lizard Problem is a dynamic tower defense with a focus on making every wave a new challenge that has to be reacted to. Mother nature herself will rip your defenses apart with earthquakes that shatter your formations and the level in the beginning of each wave, providing new paths for the lizards to then take and try and steal your eggs. You will have to adapt to the ever changing landscape by moving your towers and replacing those who got destroyed in battle.

You may be just a magpie bird, but you are not defenseless. Apart from bribing the animals of the world to help you (building towers), you can yourself engage in the battle. Smack them with your wings, just like your mom said. Speaking of your mom, she will guide you through the life of a soon to be parent, giving you tips on how to deal with The Lizard Problem.

The natural breaks between waves give you a good time to think about what to do next, but if you already got a plan, the game makes sure you can execute it as fast as possible. There are intuitive hot keys for every interaction, letting you place and move turrets in a fraction of a second, even mid round. The flight mechanic makes sure you can reach all ends of the map quickly, which is especially useful for quickly killing of a stray lizard that escaped with the close range melee combat.

Many more features are to be announced as development continues!

title: Wish Of Hers
description:
게임 정보
개요
Wish of Hers는 주인공의 꿈속 세계에서 벌어지며, 현실이 한 걸음 한 걸음마다 휘어지고 변화합니다. 이러한 초현실적인 풍경을 탐험하면서 누군가가 당신의 꿈을 조작하고, 더 깊은 목적을 향해 인도하고 있음을 알게 됩니다. 전투를 통해 진실에 한 발짝 더 다가가고, 꿈속에 숨어 있는 궁극의 적에 맞서기 위해 힘과 능력을 모읍니다.
능력
파워 카드를 구매하여 독특하고 강력한 능력을 획득하세요. 이 능력들은 전투 전략을 강화하도록 설계되었으며, 파괴적인 공격부터 방어적인 동작까지 다양합니다. 능력들은 창의적인 방식으로 결합하여 꿈속에서 변화하는 도전에 적응할 수 있습니다.

업그레이드
현실 조형기를 사용하여 능력을 업그레이드하고 더욱 강력하게 진화시키세요. 업그레이드할 때마다 능력은 새로운 효과와 강화된 힘을 얻게 되며, 꿈의 신비를 깊이 탐구하기 위한 우위를 제공합니다.

title: Quantum Loop
description:
게임 정보
Zoom and dodge your way about space, exploring the quadrant and solving intertwining objectives however you can. Hit an asteroid and the mission resets - but whatever you learn you can exploit in the next loop! Use your crafty wits and precise piloting in chorus to prevent the asteroid crisis!
Quantum Loop is a short non-linear space exploration game where you play as a galactic agent sent on a mission across time to solve an existential threat to the universe: the Asteroid Crisis.
Every life matters! - Your mission takes place within a time loop!
If you hit an asteroid, it's game over. But your knowledge stays with you! Exploit what you can learn about the world to reach success!

title: Arctis
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an exciting Arctic expedition where survival is just the beginning. Lead your group across a rotating map as you scavenge for food, clothing and tools. As mysterious strangers invade the frozen wasteland, your struggle intensifies. Confront external threats and internal conflicts, uncover the fate of lost characters, and survive the relentless Arctic winter as new dangers emerge!




The map changes dynamically with each turn. Your group will face not only a shortage of resources, but also constantly moving ice floes.

Events on the map continuously appear and disappear.
Changing seasons mean mild summers and harsh winters.




As mysterious strangers appear on the map, uncover their intentions and adapt your strategy. But be prepared — finding the right approach won't always be simple.





Hunting is crucial for gathering resources. Utilize tools and characters to collect essential supplies in a hunting mini-game.





Throughout your journey, you'll meet all kinds of people — some who will stand by you, others who may pose a danger. Build a resilient community to prepare for the arrival of outsiders. Your group is your family and internal conflicts are likely to happen. Immerse yourself in the evolving story of your characters and fight to survive the freezing cold!

title: Broken Hero: Slime Tower
description:
게임 정보
Step into the role of a small slime on an epic journey through the Tower of Slimes. Immerse yourself in a world filled with diverse slimes and unique environments. With no prior knowledge, let the tower's caretaker guide you as you discover who you are and why you were created.
Explore a universe rich in interactions and stories.

title: Drakefall
description:
게임 정보
Explore the World of Drakefall in this roguelike deckbuilder. Build your deck, discover powerful items, and journey through swamps and mountain peaks with a familiar playstyle.
Tell us what do you think about Drakefall
Features
Evolving Deck Construction: Make strategic card choices! Explore and acquire hundreds of cards to build your deck with every attempt to conquer the ruptured world of Drakefall. Pick cards that synergize well to effectively defeat foes and challenge theruling dragons.

title: You're a dad
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a text adventure about becoming a father! Get up, take care of your child, buy groceries, prepare dinner. Do nothing else. Repeat every day, because...
... You're a dad!
This is your child. It is your job to make sure he thrives, or at least survives. You can go skating, imaginary monster hunting, or just sleep the day away. The game reacts to your actions, so it really is possible. But should you?
(No, you shouldn't. Make good choices, okay?)
Navigate through all the endings!
Your family is coming for dinner. So not only do you have to be a dad - you also need to make food. You can make food. It's not that hard. Don't get lost in day dreams, going camping or starting a cat café. If your child starts reading philosophy, nip that in the bud before they get a PHD.

title: Duck Norris Tales
description:
게임 정보


Duck Norris Tales is pixel run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the arcade games from the '90s.
STORY
Step into the feathers of a brave duck on a mission of revenge after aliens destroy his favorite ice cream shop! Join him on an epic journey through the depths of the Earth as he uncovers secrets, battles monsters, and rallies the Gods to aid in his quest. Can he save humanity along the way?
THE BATTLE
The Gods are divided and at war, and it's up to you to restore peace and earn their respect. Each time you challenge a God, you have the chance to gain their blessing and grow stronger! Learn new abilities and make new allies to unlock powerful super moves as you strive to bring balance.

Uncover secrets about the world and unlock devastating super attacks as you cleanse the land.

title: Guns of Gaia
description:
게임 정보
당신의 행성을 되찾으세요!
《Guns of Gaia》는 서바이버 요소와 기지 건설 요소가 결합된 싱글 플레이어 자동 슈팅 게임입니다. 생명공학을 활용하여 지형을 변화시키고 방어 시설을 구축하며 함정을 설치하고 유인물을 배치하세요. 생명체를 키우고 장비 및 무기를 해제하세요. 지속적으로 변화하는 도전에 적응하며 적을 물리치고 당신의 행성을 탈환하세요!
지형 변형
사람들은 과거의 행성 지형을 25가지 다른 유형으로 분류했습니다. 일반적인 지형은 금, 나무, 물, 불, 흙 요소의 영향을 받아 다양한 지형으로 변할 수 있습니다. 정밀한 지형 조작을 통해 평범한 땅을 방어탑, 함정, 유인물 등 전술 자원으로 변환하여 전투에서 우위를 점할 수 있습니다. 각 지형은 독특한 시각적 및 전략적 특성을 가지며, 그로 인해 생성되는 무기와 장비도 유일무이합니다. 플레이어는 무기, 캐릭터, 건물 선택을 현명하게 진행하여 최적의 방어 및 공격 조건을 만들어야 합니다.
생명체 육성
게임에서는 다양한 지형에서 여러 생명체를 육성할 수 있습니다. 각 생명체는 전투에서 다양한 기능을 제공하며, 그들의 신체 구조는 희귀한 총기 및 도구 제작과 해제에 사용될 수 있습니다. 생명체 육성 및 연구를 통해 플레이어는 자신의 무기고 및 장비 창고를 지속적으로 확장하고 최적화하여 전투 능력을 크게 향상시킬 수 있습니다.
초기 예약 체험판에 포함된 내용:
3개의 캐릭터
13가지 지형
21가지 무기
100가지 도구
7가지 적

완성된 버전에는 더 많은 내용과 기능이 포함될 예정이며, 이는 예약 체험 기간 동안 받은 피드백에 기반하여 결정됩니다. 기대해 주세요!

title: Scavengers of Mars
description:
게임 정보
Control your Mars Rover to explore the harsh environment of the Earth's red neighbour - Mars. Scavenge remainders of previous missions and a recent Space catastrophic disaster to collect sparse resources and re-use old, refurbished devices. Help the survivors by providing them with resources required for their survival. Upgrade your Rover capabilities in order to provide them with higher survival chances. Repair and upgrade capabilities of the surface outposts scattered around the map in order to get access to the new types of surface and space operations.
Scan the Martian surface for an opportunity to discover, mine and collect precious materials and collectibles. Sell collected resources or reclaim their content to turn them into crafting materials. Complete quests for the competing Earth organisations and unlock access to new, better tech and Rover improvements.
The Rover:
Your Mars Rover is your best friend on the hostile Red Planet. It is both your mobile exploration platform and a mobile inventory. Use your rover capacity to retrieve found resources and gear, then get it safely back to the nearest Outpost to use it for your future improvements or as an occasion to earn some spare funds.
Invest collected materials in better Rover types, with increased inventory space, more equipment slots, support for more complex devices and improved resistance against the environmental hazards.
As you'll progress, you'll get access to new gear types, with improved modifiers for the Rover's performance and the opportunity to perform new interaction types, from simple surface mining, performing repairs and performing scans of the nearest environment to getting access to map-wide probe mechanics, ability to pinpoint areas of particular resource richness or the ability to drill into the planet's ground.
Game Features:
Martian Mysteries: Explore the Martian Surface just after a catastrophic disaster happened on the planet's orbit. Help the castaways with their survival as the Earth corporations compete against each other on who will be the one to get the deal and organise the succesful rescue mission. Try to discover the details on what was the reason behind the disaster in order to ensure the safety of the future missions.
Control the Rover: Take control of a small, exploration oriented mobile platform. Collect, repair and craft new module types in order to improve and modify your capabilities. Maintain the energy and resource intake and outtake levels on the Rover's deck. Invest in better Rovers to get access to bigger inventory and module slots.

title: Match In Peace
Skyrift: The Shattered Sky
description:
게임 정보
In a world once whole, cataclysmic events shattered the land into countless floating islands, each with its unique ecosystem and challenges. Embark on an epic quest in Skyrift: The Shattered Sky, where you, alongside a team of intrepid adventurers, strive to restore harmony to a fractured realm.

Join the legendary hero Aeron in this strategic 3D roguelike adventure, set against a backdrop of verdant forests, arid deserts, and ethereal space realms. Your journey begins from a central village on a large floating island, the hub for all restoration efforts. Gather resources, upgrade structures, and plan your expeditions to reunite the fragmented islands and lost continents.

Key Features:

Dynamic World Exploration: Traverse diverse floating islands, each with its distinct environment, from lush forests teeming with life to harsh deserts and cosmic anomalies.

Ancient Temples: Discover and modify dormant celestial observatories that hold the key to restoring balance. Use collected modules to transform these temples into powerful spawners, influencing enemy dynamics and resource generation.

Strategic Gameplay: Balance resource gathering, combat, and temple modifications. Navigate a dynamic day-night cycle that affects enemy behavior, resource availability, and the overall urgency of your missions.

Rich Narrative: Uncover the secrets of the shattered world, the true purpose of the Core of Unity, and the history behind the cataclysm. Face off against the enigmatic figure wielding remnants of the Core's power in a final epic showdown.

Epic Showdown: Confront the last boss, whose quest for dominion led to the world's fragmentation. Learn from his mistakes, restore the temples, and reforge the Core of Unity to bring the world back together.

Experience a captivating tale of restoration and unity in Skyrift: The Shattered Sky. Forge your path, reunite the realms, and restore harmony to a world forever changed.

title: Thor's Wrath
description:
게임 정보
Thor's Wrath is a solo defense and combat game. You embody a formidable and somewhat brute warrior. Armed with Thor's mighty hammer, you must face hordes of enemies alone while protecting the city's treasures. The goal is to climb to the top of the best warrior rankings and prove yourself worthy of Thor's hammer! The real challenge lies in your ability to wield your hammer or cast spells with precision while safeguarding your treasures.

Thor's Wrath offers immediate entertainment, is a highly accessible game with different levels of complexity and features innovative game mechanics.
Warning :this Game Is Virtual Reality Only
Main Gameplay Elements

Environment & Level : closed environment represented by different places of a huge castle in a dark fantasy world and several levels of difficulties.

Game physics : ragdoll animation providing a lot of fun when you throw the enemies around the environment and destructible scenery.

Weapons: powerful hammer to hit, throw, activate attack spells

Enemies : thieves, Attackers and Defenders with each a different fighting behavior

Score : based on multiple skills (enemies killed, duration of the fight, scenery destroyed, accuracy of throws, …)
Other features

Unique gameplay featuring hammer manipulation like a boomerang.

Competition between players from around the world.

Possibility to improve your skills to create replayability.

Hyper casual game accessible to both casual and hardcore gamers.

Learning through experience : the player increases their score through their skills.

title: Umblight
description:
게임 정보
In Umblight, you play as someone travelling through the dark forests, where the only way to defend yourself from the creatures from the dark is to fight with your cards.
As you adventure deeper, the fights get harder, but you'll become stronger as well...
You can combine the stats of any card you collect along your journey to build your own powerful special deck.

title: Forest Time
description:
게임 정보
Play the role of a spirit who guides the forest dwellers and guests through their day, helping them meet their goals in this peaceful, family-friendly turn-based puzzle.
Be one with the invisible yet ever-present soul of the forest that helps everyone to find their path. Feel free to practice your planning skills and think several steps ahead to create a perfect route for every character. Or just try different ways and see which one works. The game doesn’t punish you and encourages the retry by allowing you to undo each action while solving the puzzle.
Carefully crafted world
Enjoy the peaceful setting with simple, non-stressful tasks. Participate in festivities and occasionally find some secrets hidden in the woods. Almost every level introduces a new character or concept—no one knows what awaits you after the next turn.
Variety of Characters
There are many characters in the game, and each one is unique in something, just as we are. Different classes of characters offer different mechanics. Different characters within one class vary in a subtle way. Explore their traits and quirks in different settings and find a perfect path for each and every one of them.
Many levels to solve
There are many tasks to solve, from collecting fruits and berries and chatting with friends to trick-or-treating or playing with spirits during seasonal festive events. Complete them all in the order you choose. All puzzles are grouped into four seasons of the year, and it’s up to you which season to explore first.
Development plans
The game is currently in development, and the plans are to release it for desktop platforms by the end of 2025. Please wishlist and follow us. Your support is much appreciated!

title: Dragons Invade Scotland
description:
게임 정보
Match-3 meets Tower Defense! Your matches become towers. Defend each real castle in Scotland! Learn about real Scottish castles/stories/legends while playing. The game takes place on full map of Scotland made of 5 million tiles, where each tile is 19.5 square meters of the real world.

From the creator of Tower Swap. This game isn't released yet, so here's some reviews of Tower Swap:

"It's a perfect blend between the match-3, merge, and tower defense genre, so if you like any of those genres and you want to venture forth with a twist this is a perfect game with a great gameplay loop and great mechanics. It's super addicting... I enjoyed my time with Tower Swap so much that I lost track of time and got a super long gameplay recording." - MintCity Review

"This is a hidden gem and belongs in the best-of list of indie match 3 mobile games alongside Triple Town, 10000000, and Puzzle Craft." - Loren Hernandez

"Never have I ever played a game for such a long time continuously as this game. It's so simple and sooo good. 10/10 would recommend everyone ever. My grandma would love this game and my grandchildren would someday still love this game. ok I'm done. But seriously, play it."

"One of the most well-designed games I've ever played! Game is easy for beginners to play but it takes quite a bit of skill to attain higher levels, as success requires using both match-3 and tower defense strategies."

100s of castles are planned with real folklore from each:

Did you know that there was a castle ruled by a Viking princess, and it was on an island, and she put up a chain reaching to the mainland to stop ships?

Did you know that there was a castle that was said to have been built by a wizard using an army of goblins?

Did you know that there's a fairy flag that still exists today in Dunvegan castle, and it is said that it can only be used 3 times, and it has already been used twice in medieval times to summon fairies to their defense?

All of these and hundreds more are planned to be added to the game.



Note that the game is priced low because it contains IAPs. If you don't want to pay you can play for free on the web but with banner ads, coming soon. You are essentially paying to remove the banner ads, and to be able to load up the game without internet, and to make sure your progress doesn't get cleared from your browser's storage. The Steam version doesn't have any banner ads. There will also be mobile versions with the same structure.

title: Tears Apart
description:
게임 정보
Tears Apart는 순수한 고속 액션입니다. 대천사 Raggon이 되어 어둠을 뚫고 은하계에 빛을 가져오는 임무를 수행하세요. 당신은 우주를 가득 메운 그림자 속을 돌진하며 적을 베고 정복할 것입니다.
승리를 향한 돌진
모든 공격은 적과 장애물을 가르는 번개처럼 빠른 돌진입니다. 이 게임은 속도와 정확성에 달려 있습니다. 한 번의 실수로 어둠이 당신을 삼킬 수 있습니다.
별자리 창조
숨겨진 별을 발견하고, 당신이 정화하는 은하계마다 더 강해지는 별자리를 해제하세요. 각 별자리는 새로운 힘과 무한한 플레이 방법을 제공합니다.
에픽 보스 전투
당신의 기술을 그 어느 때보다도 시험할 거대한 심연의 보스들과 대결하세요. 이 전투들은 강렬하고 빠르며, 무자비하게 진행됩니다—바로 당신이 원하는 방식대로.
은하계에 질서를 가져오세요
혼돈의 심장부로 뛰어들어, 모든 돌진으로 어둠을 부수고 별을 다시 밝혀 우주의 질서를 회복하세요. 각 승리는 단순한 승리가 아닌 새로운 별의 탄생, 광대한 우주에서 희망의 등대이며, 영원한 영혼의 안식처입니다.
출시 시 특징:
돌진 기반 전투: 모든 공격이 적을 가르는 고속 액션을 경험하세요.
역동적인 우주: 숨겨진 별과 도전, 적들로 가득한 독특한 은하계를 탐험하고 정복하세요.
별자리 시너지: 무한한 전략적 가능성을 제공하는 강력한 별자리를 해제하고 결합하세요.
에픽 보스 전투: 거대한 보스들과 강렬하고 빠른 속도의 전투에서 맞서 싸우세요.
스타더스트 업그레이드: 스타더스트를 모아 다음 은하계를 위한 영구적인 업그레이드에 투자하세요.
몰입감 있는 분위기: 시작부터 끝까지 우주의 모든 구석에 도달하려는 캐릭터로 플레이하세요. 그녀의 우주 규모의 여정에 뛰어들어 다른 원초적 존재들과 만나보세요.

어둠을 찢고 은하계를 균형 잡을 준비를 하세요. 지금 위시리스트에 추가하고, 우주를 차지할 준비를 하세요!

title: Queendom
description:
게임 정보
It is a turn-based strategy game similar to a board game.
The goal of the game is to capture 12 regions. For each captured region, the player gets one point. The one who reaches the goal first wins.
The game consists of turns. Each turn consists of three phases. The first phase is the orders phase. Only three orders can be given per turn. When all players press “next move”, the second phase begins. In this phase, each player takes turns executing the orders he chose in the previous phase.
Among the orders are march, defense, muster troops, hold a tournament and capture territory.
When all orders have been completed, the game enters the game world phase. A random world event card is played. Then a new round begins.
Features:
Give orders on your lands by thinking through your strategy and tactics
Manage your deck - your victory depends on the correct use of cards.
Lead your troops - can you reach your goal with minimal casualties?
Single and multiplayer games - play against artificial intelligence or friends

title: Palix Transit
description:
게임 정보
Palix Transit
A turn-based role-playing game in a unique, hand-crafted universe.
Immerse yourself in the mystical world of Hara, a planet inhabited by seven sacred races descended from seven gods. The journey of this world began over a decade ago, and now you can explore it in Palix Transit with a vibe reminiscent of 16-bit RPGs.
The story
In the small village of Loriko, the young Amoran Soken is preparing for the Palix Festival, an event that celebrates the Palix Transit - an astrological term associated with the third and final war of the gods. But just before the festival, Ajila, Soken's girlfriend, has a disturbing dream. When a strange object appears in the sky and two powerful beings threaten Loriko, her worst fears are realized. In the end, Soken will take up the fight against the overpowering opponents, but how will he face this impossible task?
You decide, in the open world you can freely explore parts of South Arluna. Discover secrets, level up and equip yourself, find allies, solve puzzles, face powerful creatures and more.
Gameplay features
- Turn-based battles: classic JRPG gameplay
- Telekinesis mechanics: Use Soken's ability to solve puzzles and riddles.
- Comrades-in-arms Collect allies to help you on your journey.
- Diverse equipment: Equip your characters with weapons, headdresses, powerful masks and shields.
- Platformer elements: Jump and explore the world to discover hidden secrets.
- Secrets and Lore: Find secrets or delve into the world.
Find the villagers Loriko to gather them.
Venture towards Inedua, the castle that rose from nothing over twenty years ago, to take on its roaming creatures. But be careful, Inedua did not only attract large animals.
Important notice:
This game was developed by a single developer. Please do not expect AAA quality.
It is a unique, original universe with deep, diverse lore with handcrafted, lovingly created characters penned by the solo developer whose initial models and ideas date back over a decade.

title: project_Structure_01
description:
게임 정보
In the beginning of the game you wake up in space and an unknown entity sends you to explore mysterious locations.

project_Structure_01 is a first-person exploration game that takes a minimalist approach to storytelling and gameplay, instead focusing on immersing the player within a captivating and introspective environmental experience. Eschewing traditional narrative conventions, the game invites players to navigate a series of surreal liminal spaces imbued with a unique atmosphere and brutalist architectural style.

At the heart of the project_Structure_01 experience is a profound sense of exploration and discovery. Players must traverse the game's meticulously crafted environments, which blend elements of haunting ambience and soothing tranquility. The soundscape, composed of haunting and relaxing ambient tracks, seamlessly enhances the player's sense of presence, complementing the visual and spatial design.

Through its minimalist approach and focus on environmental immersion, project_Structure_01 offers a contemplative and deeply engaging exploration experience. Players are invited to become lost in the game's captivating liminal spaces, allowing the atmosphere and architectural design to guide their journey of discovery.

Features:
ㆍHaunting and relaxing ambient tracks
ㆍLiminal spaces experience from first-person perspective
ㆍOccasional 3D platforming sections
ㆍFun optional collectibles

title: Sepulchron
description:
게임 정보
Sepulchron is a difficult puzzle game set in the seemingly deserted Astor Manor. The puzzles within its walls will challenge your logical deduction, observation skills, perseverance, and real-world knowledge of everyday facts. With a day-and-night cycle, you must balance exploration during both periods: Days of tranquil monotony, and nights of dread and danger, requiring you to use anything you can find to defend yourself from ghastly threats. Discover the secrets that the Manor hides if you wish to survive longer than the 72 hours you have left before you die.


PUZZLES



Using physics as a base, Sepulchron's puzzles go beyond simply finding an item to act as a 'key' to solve them, as many puzzle games do. Found a sword, and there are ropes blocking your path? Don’t just 'interact' with it — swing that sword to cut the rope! Need to press something, but it won’t stay down? Maybe you need to place something heavy to weight it down. Use your logic and common sense to uncover secrets and solve the difficult puzzles scattered throughout Astor Manor.


GAMEPLAY



Ghosts and ethereal beings rise with the moon, and you must defend yourself against the evil that lurks in the dark. Either find and use weapons suited for combat with the best ammunition for each situation, or improvise and use whatever you can get your hands on — a chair, a sword from the wall, or even a teddy bear — to defeat your enemies and survive another night. And a word of warning: These sneaky ghosts change tactics every time you play, so stay on your toes!






Instead of relying on jump scares like most scary games, Sepulchron builds its horror through a suspenseful atmosphere. This is achieved by the day-and-night cycle, where days are tranquil, giving a fleeting sense of safety, while nights are dark and dangerous, making preparations vital. The contrast between light and darkness also plays a crucial role, with nights being truly dark, making the management of your light sources and its fuel essential for survival.






If you enjoy the following:

- Difficult Puzzles

- A Horror-filled, Moody Atmosphere

- Passive Storytelling through Enviroment and Lore Books

- Physics-Based Gameplay

- Unpredictable enemies that change tactics and placement every time you start over.

- A Short, yet Dense and Content-rich Game

- Time Management

- A Game Full of Personality


... Then you will have a great time playing Sepulchron!

title: Just an Ordinary Maintenance Check
description:
게임 정보
You receive a call from a regular client for sewer maintenance, not a hard ask and he's paying well. You remember it like yesterday, replacing pipes and gears, flipping switches, turning valves, and activating breaker boxes. Something's off in the sewer though, out of place sounds and moving shadows. Something stalks nearby, and it can hear you. Navigate the sewer quickly and quietly, whatever it is could be around any corner. You will need to pick up some items along to way to get through the sewer faster, various tools to see and know where you're going. Utilizing items to get into locked rooms and to open those large metal doors. Work fast, stay quiet, and get out.
In this puzzle-survival horror game you have to enter a vast sewer network and fix a few generators and pipe machines. Luckily, you brought everything you could possibly need. Except for a map... Large mechanical doors and locked flood doors will block your path along the way, find keys and tools to get past them. Get in, fix the machines, and get out. It's quite unsettling in the damp tunnels and there's strange sounds echoing throughout them. The presence of something stalking close by is pretty clear. Be mindful of the noise you're making, sound travels pretty far down there.

title: Fantasy Waifu Collector
description:
게임 정보
Fantasy Waifu Collector is an exciting game about collecting "Waifu" in order to build an army to defeat the Goddess of Dragons! Players will meet, build, and collect many different characters as they explore a fascinating world filled with monsters.

A unique take on the "gacha" genre, this game is aimed to be very free-to-play friendly. Afterall, why should fun gameplay be hidden behind paywalls!?

title: Project Chameleon
description:
게임 정보
Project Chameleon은 적에게 들키지 않기 위해 물체로 변신해야 하는 잠입 게임입니다. 전 세계를 무대로 임무를 수행하는 엘리트 스파이 Siren이 되어 플레이하세요. 환경을 조작하고 함정을 설치하며 각 미션에서 강력한 장치를 사용하세요.







강력한 슈트를 사용하여 다양한 물체로 변신하십시오. 슈트는 사용 후 충전이 필요하므로 변신할 물체를 신중하게 선택하세요!





일부 물체는 환경을 조작하는 데 사용할 수 있는 고유한 기능을 가지고 있습니다. 복잡한 해킹 시스템을 사용하고, 소리를 내는 물체로 경비를 유인하는 등 추가적인 능력을 사용하여 더 복잡한 도전에 도전하십시오!





각 시나리오에서 고급 장치와 다양한 아이템을 찾아 Siren의 임무를 돕는 데 사용하십시오!

title: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery
description:
게임 정보
This top down 2.5D ghost story mystery will take the player through a Louisiana inspired neighborhood haunting. The short story format allows for both easy accessibility and let's you discover up to 5 endings without the burden of a 30+ hour RPG.
Using Spirit Vision, Clair leaves their body in an astral form to explore the history of the place and dig deeper into the truth of the festering catalyst of its haunting.
autokwd: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery

title: Mirrormind
description:
게임 정보
Mirrormind is a 3D Puzzle Platformer in a unique lo-fi dithered style where you can shift perspective into any person you can see. Journey through a series of worlds where each world explores a shift in perspective. These shifts include an exploration of gravity, the 2nd person perspective, and more.
Explore 4 visually striking worlds about switching perspectives: using different directions of gravity, controlling yourself in the 2nd person perspective and switching between past and present.
Over 30 different puzzles, each focused on showing some unique and interesting consequence of its mechanics.
Unique undo system where you can reverse time to quickly explore other solutions.
A parallel and optional narrative exploring themes of perspective, senses, sights and experience.

title: Trouble in Cookie Town
description:
게임 정보
COOKIE TOWN UNDER SIEGE! 🍪⚠️
Disaster has struck Cookie Town! The once-sweet and peaceful city is being devoured by dancing, cookie-eating monsters! With the town’s legendary Broccoli Repellent shattered and scattered, nothing is stopping the crazed horde. As the towns last hope, you must grapple, shoot, and puzzle-solve your way through the chaos—recovering lost pieces, fighting monsters, and mastering physics-based challenges to save Cookie Town before it crumbles!
🪝 Grapple, Swing & Solve! – Use your physics-based grappling hook to zip through Cookie Town, dodge monsters, and complete tricky challenges to recover the lost Broccoli Repellent!
💥 High-Score Mayhem! – Blast cookie monsters, chain insane combos, and master physics-driven puzzles as you fight to save the city from becoming a snack.
🎯 Complete Wacky Challenges! – Take on bizarre physics-based puzzles and absurd objectives to recover all the missing repellent pieces. (It’s okay to get angry—we believe in you!)
🍪 Cookie-Chomping Chaos! – Face an army of unpredictable, dancing, and dangerously hungry monsters who won’t stop until every crumb of Cookie Town is devoured!
🤣 Goofy, Over-the-Top Action! – Physics-driven movement, slapstick combat, ridiculous puzzles, and a surprising amount of dance battles—because why take anything seriously?

title: Mage Food Truck
description:
게임 정보
Play your cards to explore a hangry realm, crafting and delivering exotic meals in the face of fantastical beasts and curses from dissatisfied customers.

Gameplay
Mage Food Truck is a single player roguelike deckbuilder. Each run consists of a Morning, Day, and Night shift, with turn events that become increasingly perilous. You'll play hands from your growing collection to traverse the realm, collect ingredients, craft recipes, and deliver them to earn as much gold as possible. When the day is done or your truck is wrecked, your customers will pass judgment upon you with a review of 0-3 stars!

Each work day begins with a small starter deck, and you’ll purchase new cards from the Turvy Mart at the end of each turn. Playing a Job card lets you use any crew member's ability, which you can combine with other cards to boost productivity!



The Explorer travels around the map, seeking ingredients and delivering food.
The Chef crafts delicious dishes from ingredients you've collected.
The Mage protects your truck with a magic shield and fights off pesky curses.
The Bard motivates your crew with EXP, unlocking powerful Special cards unique to each crew member.

title: L8R SK8R
description:
게임 정보
L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

Just like those classics, new areas in the hub world are unlocked with a collection mechanic, but instead of collecting stars, crystals, or dragons, you have to collect time.

When exploring the hub world, you’ll encounter time locks that hinder your progress.

These locks will require you to collect a certain amount of time in order to be opened.

Every time you beat a level, you’ll collect any time you shave off your previous best record. (Each level has a default record that it starts with. Basically a par time.)

So, for example, if you need another minute to open a lock, you could go back and beat the best times in three levels by 20 seconds. Or alternatively you could shave 10 seconds off of six levels. You might even find a shortcut that lets you take a whole minute off of just one level. The choice is yours!

Master the core movement mechanics; wall jumping, wall riding, air dashing, sliding, boosting, and of course, double jumping.

Play through 25 unique levels set across various time periods across all of history, including five boss fights.

title: JumpMap
description:
게임 정보
JumpMap 은 흥미진진한 1인칭 3D 플랫폼 게임으로 특별한 메커니즘을 제공합니다: 떨어질 때마다 이전 위치로 되돌아갑니다. 정밀함과 타이밍을 요구하는 20개 이상의 신중하게 설계된 레벨을 탐험하세요. 이제 Speedrun 모드가 추가되었습니다: 모든 레벨을 통과하고 최고의 시간을 기록해 보세요!
당신의 유일한 목표는 각 레벨의 정상에 도달하는 것입니다. 클라이밍에 집중하고 도전을 헤쳐 나가며 각 오르막을 정복하는 능력을 키우세요.
게임 플레이
Speedrun 모드: 시계를 보며 모든 레벨을 한 번에 클리어하세요. 시간을 추적하고 최고 기록을 목표로 도전하세요. 자신과 친구들과 경쟁하여 가장 빠르게 완료하세요!
최고 시간 추적: 각 레벨을 완료하는 속도를 측정하고, 개인 최고 기록을 통해 도전과 성취감을 느껴보세요.
더블 점프: 공중에서 다시 한 번 점프할 수 있는 능력을 통해, 가장 까다로운 플랫폼도 마스터하고 새로운 높이에 도달하세요.
컨트롤러 및 Steam Deck 지원: 컨트롤러 또는 Steam Deck을 사용할 때 원활한 게임 플레이를 즐기세요. 이동 중에도 편안하게 또는 소파에서 편안하게 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: Manipulus - A Deck Building Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times.
As a Manipuli general, form strategic defensive lines and manoeuvre your followers to activate wild abilities to defeat the oncoming monsters and lead your band to safety. Re-play your cards, re-live your actions, and fight to keep your refugees alive in this dark and captivating adventure.
It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

title: 风铃Windbell
description:
게임 정보
Windbell is a platform action game that emphasizes combos and combat experience. There are hundreds of weapons and skills that can be freely matched in the game, and you can match your favorite fighting style as you like.


In this game, you play the role of Sol, in order to rescue the junior sister who was sealed in the ice, constantly wandering through the major secret realms, just to collect materials and forge the sharpest weapon in the world.


Every time you enter the secret realm, it's a new experience. The buffs and skills obtained during the rogue process will be integrated into the Sol's weapons when Sol leaves the secret realm.


You can use the powerful weapons fused in the secret realm to complete the tasks on the Heavenly Book, and the task rewards on the Heavenly Book can permanently improve a certain attribute of Sol.

title: Falos Chemistry
description:
게임 정보
🔥 Falos Chemistry - Learn Chemistry the FUN Way! 🔥

Get ready to jump, run, and fly your way to becoming a chemistry pro! 🎮 Falos Chemistry is a super fun game that teaches you the basics of chemistry while you play. No boring lessons here—just awesome games that help you learn!

🚀 4 Amazing Mini-Games:

Jumping Gorilla 🦍: Hop through levels and learn atomic weights!
Running Gorilla 🦍: Run fast and memorize electron configurations!
Dragon Snake 🐍: Slither and master elemental symbols!
Bird 🐦: Flap your way to chemistry victory!

🎓 What You'll Learn: Discover the building blocks of chemistry, like atomic weight, electron configurations, and elemental symbols, all while having a blast!

Whether you’re just starting or need a refresher, Falos Chemistry makes learning easy and exciting. Perfect for anyone who loves games and wants to get better at chemistry. 🧪💥
