title: Necropolis Nights
description:
게임 정보
"Necropolis Nights" is a thrilling survival card game set on a dynamic board where every decision counts. By day, gather resources, craft tools, hunt animals, fish, and farm crops to stockpile supplies. But beware: when night falls, the undead rise. Defend yourself from zombies and survive the darkness. Strategize your actions, adapt to changing circumstances, and manage your resources wisely to endure the endless nights and build a haven in a world overrun by the undead.
Each new day introduces a fresh set of cards, replacing those from the previous day. To survive, you'll need to carefully choose your strategy and prioritize what you collect. As resources change daily, you must decide what to gather whether it’s food, tools, or other resources to adapt to the evolving challenges. Every decision counts, as you’ll need to balance immediate survival needs with long term goals. Collect the right cards and manage your resources wisely to outlast the dangers of the night.
Key Features:
Dynamic Day-Night Cycle: The gameplay shifts dramatically between gathering and preparing during the day and collect valuable items without falling prey to zombies at night.
Evolving Challenges: Each day resets the available resources, presenting a new puzzle to solve. Will you focus on farming for food, scavenging for weapons, or crafting defenses to hold off the undead?
Unique Card Mechanics: Cards represent your resources, tools, and actions. With limited slots and changing availability, you’ll need to carefully plan your deck to maximize efficiency and survivability.
Crafting and Resource Management: Combine collected materials to create powerful tools, weapons, and fortifications. Each crafted item can be the difference between survival and being overwhelmed.
Survival Meets Strategy: Balance your short-term survival needs with long-term goals. Plan for the future while managing the present—every choice counts.
Replayability: A dynamic board and procedurally generated cards ensure a fresh experience every time you play, with unpredictable challenges and events to overcome.
Zombie Variety: Face different types of undead, each with unique behaviors and abilities, forcing you to adapt your tactics as the game progresses.
The Ultimate Survival Experience

title: Inventris TD
description:
게임 정보
Inventris TD is a roguelike lite tower defense shooter where the combat happens inside your inventories.
Features:
Acquire cats by hatching eggs.
map tiles are Inventory tiles where you can deploy cats as towers and enemy route blocks
Inventory Tetris centric design
Allocate cats in the other inventory to make them mod your player gun bullets
Unlock more inventory tiles also unlocks more map, which leads to stronger enemies as well as better resources and traps
Turn-based tower defense where each enemy turn starts with your shot

title: Lost Ground
description:
게임 정보
어느 마법사의 실수로 악마들이 지상에 강림한 이후, 인류는 패배를 거듭하여 마지막 요새까지 후퇴했습니다. 하지만 아직 모든 것이 끝난 게 아닙니다. 영웅들은 성검의 인도 아래 최후의 반격을 준비하고 있습니다. 원정대를 지휘하여 악마들에게 잃어버린 땅을 되찾으십시오. 이제 인류의 희망은 당신의 어깨에 달려있습니다.

3x3 그리드에서 펼쳐지는 턴제 전투

■ 다수의 영웅을 3x3 그리드에 배치하여 적을 물리치세요. 영웅과 적은 다양한 공격 범위를 갖고 있습니다. 효과적인 배치로 아군의 피해를 최소화하고 수많은 적을 일망타진하세요.

■ 영웅들은 불, 물, 바람 등의 속성을 가지고, 개성적인 특징을 가진 카드를 통해 전투를 수행합니다. 속성으로 보스의 약점을 타격하고, 극적인 시너지를 일으켜보세요.

■ 모험에서 획득하는 유물은 게임의 판도를 가를 수 있는 강력한 특수 효과를 제공합니다. 카드와 유물의 조합으로 자신만의 콤보를 완성하세요. 어떤 것을 획득할지는 회차마다 달라집니다!


■ 로스트 그라운드의 세계는 외길이 아닙니다. 탐험은 전진, 후진, 우회 모두 가능합니다. 육각형 타일로 이루어진 세계를 자유롭게 탐험하며 저주받은 땅의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

■ 유적, 광산, 캠프, 상점, 몬스터, 보물상자... 안개로 가려진 땅 너머에는 다양한 기회와 위험이 있습니다. 안전한 방법으로 착실하게 강해질지, 위험을 무릅쓰고 큰 보상을 노릴지, 선택은 당신의 몫입니다.

■ 퀘스트를 수행하고 보상으로 받은 특성 포인트로 영구히 성장하세요. 단순한 파밍 퀘스트부터 도전 과제에 가까운 기묘한 퀘스트까지 다양하게 준비되어 있습니다.

■ 묘하게 움푹 파인 지형이 있나요? 파헤치세요. 몬스터가 길을 막고 있나요? 때려눕히고 파헤치세요. 수상한 지역을 파헤치다보면 생각치도 못한 만남이 있을지도 모릅니다.


■ 몬스터를 찾아 처치하고 경험치를 획득하여 영웅을 레벨업 시키세요. 상위 카드를 획득하려면 충분한 레벨업이 필요합니다.

■ 모험에서 장비를 획득하고 영웅에게 장착시키세요. 머리, 몸통, 손, 발 등... 각각의 부위마다 다른 스탯이 부여되고 장비마다 다른 고유 효과가 발휘됩니다.

■ 장비, 특성 등의 일부 보상은 회차를 거듭해도 소멸하지 않고 이월됩니다. 영구히 성장하면서 강력한 적에게 도전해 보세요.

title: The Genetic Dilemma
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 두 인물의 시선을 통해 이 세계를 경험하게 됩니다. 대중교통이 무료로 제공되는 시대, 그러나 그 속에서 살아가는 사람들의 일상은 결코 단순하지 않습니다.
남자의 이야기
반복되는 일상에 지친 그는 가벼운 용돈벌이를 위해 설문 조사에 참여하기로 합니다. 지루한 하루를 보내던 중, 우연히 오래된 친구와 재회하게 됩니다. 친구의 집에 초대받아 방문한 그곳에서, 그는 친구의 여자친구와 마주하게 되는데… 단순한 만남이 예상치 못한 방향으로 흘러가며, 그의 삶은 돌이킬 수 없는 변화를 맞이합니다.
여자의 이야기
자율주행 자동차의 자동 브레이크 시스템을 연구하는 그녀는 최첨단 기술의 중심에서 일하고 있습니다. 그러나 어느 날, 뜻하지 않은 사고로 인해 생사의 기로에 서게 됩니다. 그리고 그녀에게 제안된 것은 기존의 장기 이식과는 차원이 다른 ‘혁신적인 수술’— 오직 뇌만을 새로운 몸으로 옮기는 이식 수술이었습니다.
눈을 떴을 때, 그녀는 완전히 새로운 세상 속에 있었습니다. 하지만 그녀를 기다리는 운명은 과연 축복일까요, 아니면 새로운 딜레마의 시작일까요?
대중교통이 무료로 제공되는 세계. 하지만 이 편리함의 대가는 결코 가볍지 않습니다— 단순히 이동하는 것조차 끝없는 광고를 견뎌야 하는 시대입니다.

title: Hope & Elpis
description:
게임 정보

Hope&Elpis는 새내기 마법사 호프와 고대의 마법사 엘피스의 여정을 그린 변신 로그라이크 덱빌더 게임입니다. 불가사의한 고대 유물인 ‘오브’의 공간에서 적을 무찌르고 봉인하세요. 악한 영혼을 봉인하면 오브는 그 대가로 강력한 마법을 제공합니다.


고대의 마법사로 변신하세요!
호프의 마법과 엘피스의 오브 마법을 적재적소에 사용하세요. 엘피스의 강력한 오브 마법에는 대가가 따릅니다

타일 위에서 벌어지는 전투
적의 공격을 회피하고, 광역 마법으로 적을 처치하세요. 때로는 과감한 공격이 최선의 방어이기도 합니다.


다양한 오브의 힘
해방할 오브의 힘을 전략적으로 선택하세요. Hope&Elpis는 3가지의 힘을 선택, 조합해 강력한 마법을 사용할 수 있습니다.

title: The Family
description:
게임 정보
The Family
– A Gritty Journey into the Dark World of 1950s Mafia Life

Step into the underworld of 1950s Bayford, Italy, where violence, betrayal, and power define the streets. In The Family, you assume the role of Tyler Jones, a down-and-out boxer struggling to make ends meet. Desperation leads him into the clutches of the notorious Cappello crime family, where the allure of easy money pulls him deeper into a world he never imagined.

As Tyler, you’ll navigate a dangerous path between two warring Mafia families—the Capellos and their bitter rivals, the Costellos. Will you rise through the ranks, gaining wealth and power beyond your wildest dreams, or will you fall victim to the greed and bloodshed that define this ruthless world?

Featuring 13 intense chapters filled with dramatic twists, brutal combat, and morally complex decisions, “The Family” challenges you to prove your loyalty, outmaneuver your enemies, and survive in a world where trust is scarce, and the stakes are deadly.

Do you have what it takes to thrive in this violent underworld, or will you be consumed by the very life you sought to escape?
The choice is yours—but remember, in the Mafia, every decision has consequences.

Key Features:
- Immersive 1950s Mafia setting in the heart of Bayford, Italy.
- Play as Tyler Jones, a struggling boxer turned Mafia enforcer.
- Experience a gripping narrative with 13 action-packed chapters.
- Explore a large open world filled with hidden secrets, dangerous opportunities, and vibrant characters.
- Navigate the complex web of alliances and rivalries between two powerful crime families.

title: Eclipsi
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an adrenaline-fueled space adventure within tightly curated battlegrounds. Dive into the heart of action with our 3D space shooter, offering thrilling single and multiplayer showdowns from 1v1 to 5v5. Strategize, dominate, and experience the ultimate intensity with our innovative ranking and scoring system – all within the confines of a dynamic, focused game space!
Experience the ultimate 3D space shooter adventure with our second level featuring two lush, expansive planets. Explore vibrant landscapes to collect ores, achieving victory through resource mastery, base destruction, or strategic base capture. Engage in thrilling flight simulation and combat both in space and through the planet's atmosphere, with intense battles from 1v1 to 5v5 in single and multiplayer modes. Dominate the cosmos with our dynamic ranking and scoring system!

title: AraCore Astromining Ventures
description:
게임 정보
In 2086, a young pilot is driven by the desperate need to help their struggling community on Mars from the brink of destitution. As that pilot, you sign up to work for an astro-mining corporation and embark on high-stakes mining missions, earning commission to fund the survival of your family and friends in a merciless profit-driven world. As your career continues, you'll delve deeper into the corporate underbelly and uncover the harsh realities and ruthless capitalist secrets of the company you work for and their competitors.

*Fly free to explore over 20 mission locations
*Find, mine, break down, and haul precious resources from asteroids into your cargo
*Spend your commission wisely: will you use your pay to help your community, yourself, or something more?
*Converse with your bosses, colleagues, and rival factions to discover more about the world
*Actions have consequences: what you do, or fail to do, in a mission will dictate future missions and the direction of the story
*Keep up with your rivals: upgrade your surveyor ship and drone ship to give yourself an edge over your fellow pilots and rival corporations

You'll fly out to missions given by corporate HQ in your surveyor ship. Missions take place in local asteroid fields where you will pilot mining drones to navigate through the rocks, scan materials, and gather resources using tools such as kinetic impactors to break down larger asteroids and grappling magnets to haul them into cargo containers. While most missions are about pure profit, some missions will see you spying on rival corporations, clearing debris, rescuing stranded pilots, or testing out new controversial technologies.

As you explore each field, you'll earn commission for the resources you've collected and uncover what's really going on out in the outer reaches of the asteroid belt. If you damage equipment or fail your missions, you might be fined and have less money to send back to your community on Mars. After returning to base, you'll receive upgraded technology to make your mining life easier.

Your actions and the decisions you make along the way will change the course of the story, the missions you take, and the relationships with the people around you.

title: Little Droid 2: Escape
description:
게임 정보
"Little Droid 2: Escape" is the second part of the game. New enemies, bosses, traps, secret places are waiting for you. In the game you can improve weapons. As in the first part, the droid will have to be constantly charged to complete the entire game.

title: Blood of Inquisition
description:
게임 정보
어두운 날들이 페르난데스 백작령에 찾아왔습니다. 백작은 중병에 걸렸고 그의 상태는 귀족과 평민들의 눈을 피하고 있습니다. 백작부인은 카운티의 일을 관리할 충분한 권한이 없어 매우 어려운 상황에 처해 있습니다. 상황은 백작부인에 대한 암살 시도와 그녀의 딸 납치로 더욱 복잡해졌습니다. 이는 백작부인이 보안을 강화하고 가장 숙련된 전문가들의 서비스를 요청하게 만들었습니다.

오랜 전투 끝에, 마누엘 베르몬다는 검을 버리고 은둔 생활을 시작하며 그림 그리기와 책 읽기에 전념하기로 결심합니다.

운명의 뜻에 따라, 마누엘은 페르난데스 백작부인의 서비스에 들어오라는 초대 편지를 받습니다. 오랜 고민 끝에, 마누엘은 이 임무를 맡으면 모든 죄를 용서받을 것이라는 신비한 목소리를 듣게 됩니다.

게임 특징:

각각의 스토리와 여러 가지 가능한 결말을 가진 여섯 명의 히로인
다른 캐릭터의 관점에서 본 미니 스토리
이야기에 영향을 미치는 많은 분기와 변수
40개 이상의 플롯 일러스트와 40개의 배경
10개 이상의 결말

title: We Have To Let You Go
description:
게임 정보
We Have To Let You Go is a puzzle RPG game about getting fired (literally) by your totalitarian dictator boss and going on a journey to stop his new business prospects to take over the world.
Features

6 sprawling chapters with plenty of secrets to uncover.
Classic Dragon Quest inspired battles with puzzle elements.
Over 20 unique abilities that offer constant creativity in battle.
Challenging boss fights that require skill and strategy to overcome.
A vital dodge mechanic that adds a risk and reward factor to combat.
A large cast of delightful characters to meet on your journey.
A cute and colorful pixel art style.
Several collectables and optional side quests.
An ever-changing soundtrack that develops throughout the adventure.

We Have To Let You Go will release in 2025
autokwd: We Have To Let You Go

title: Gnomer
description:
게임 정보
Gnomer is a rogue-like game where you take control of a hero knight fighting his way through waves of gnomes, trying to reach lower levels filled with even more dangerous gnomes. During your journey down, you choose which levels you drop to, with each having a specific reward ranging from stat upgrades to card booster packs containing special cards.
UNPACK THOSE CARDS !
Effect Cards bring a new, unique twist to the game. You get to collect them like trading card game cards, and each one has a specific effect. For example, one can light your projectiles on fire, make enemies explode when dying to electricity, modify the way your crossbow shoots, and so much more. It’s only up to you to try all the different combinations.

title: Battlewrights
description:
게임 정보
Battlewrights is a hilarious local multiplayer combat game for two to four players. The core mechanics are deceptively simple: Press button to throw your weapon, press it again to magically recall it. Repeat until you are the last person standing. Everyone can play. Every character plays the same. But if you want to take things further, try throw- and recall-jumps, charged throws, perfectly timed catch-shots and game-changing powerups.
Are you ready to fight your friends for the title of supreme Battlewright?
Everyone knows double-jumps, but have you heard of throw-jumps?
Charge your throw for maximum power!

title: Doggy Waiter 2
description:
게임 정보
활력을 불어넣는 캐주얼 재미로 접시를 쌓아보세요! 접시, 컵, 머그잔 등을 최대한 높이 올리되 떨어뜨리지 마세요! 그런 다음 강아지 웨이터가 안전하게 부엌으로 데려다 줄 수 있도록 도와주세요.

시각적으로 만족스러운 스테이지 21개 클리어
18가지 이상의 다양한 요리로 최대한 많은 포인트를 쌓을 수 있습니다.
우뚝 솟은 접시 더미에서 성취의 빛을 느껴보세요
온라인 순위표에서 경쟁하세요. 최고 점수를 획득하세요!

title: Paperlands
description:
게임 정보
Paperlands is a 2D puzzle adventure set in a papercraft world where everything can be interacted with only if brought to life with color. A child started to color the world but got quickly distracted and the world was not finished. Help the people of Paperlands to finish what was started and bring Paperlands to life!
Key Features
Color the objects and people to be able to interact with them
Solve puzzles, unlock new colors and reach new locations
Get creative and color the world to your liking

title: Super Monkey: Time Traversal Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
FIND YOUR WAY HOME, MASTER TIME
A monkey, accidentally hurled into the future, now fights to return to the present and undo the chaos caused by the mad scientist, Dr. E. Will. Armed with time-manipulation powers, you'll battle through dystopian slums and sprawling cities, bending reality to outsmart mercenaries and overcome the obstacles in your way.
DEFEAT DR. E. WILL’S CREATIONS
Face off against relentless mercenaries and bizarre lab experiments engineered to stop you in your tracks. Use your time-manipulation powers to outmaneuver and outsmart your enemies. Get ready for speed, precision, and fast-paced combat, all while racing against the clock.
SPEEDRUN YOUR WAY TO VICTORY
For speedrunners and action fans alike, a timer tracks your every move. Set new personal bests, shatter developer-set records, and perfect your runs using the time-manipulation mechanic. The faster and more precise you are, the greater your rewards.

title: HOSTYLE
description:
게임 정보
HOSTYLE follows agent Cryptic's job interview to become an assassin for one of the most corrupt companies on earth, wherein he needs to traverse various simulated obstacle courses as quickly and as stylishly as possible. This fast-paced 3D platformer combines stylish movement options alongside a futuristic but nostalgic 6th-generation aesthetic inspired by the Y2K era.  Get harassed by your cutesy but demonic supervisor as you challenge yourself to ascend the ranks of the HOSTYLE corporation through pure style.

title: Dunes Of Raeth
description:
게임 정보
Dunes Of Raeth is a single-player, sci-fi narrative set in the war-torn desert planet of Raeth.
You play as the King of Raeth. You are on your way to save one of your sons as your transport crashes in the Desert. In the ruthless dunes of your home-planet, you are surprised to discover a whole city...a whole civilization living in the middle of the desert.
As you learn more about the city, you realize that there are mystical forces at play here. The spirit of the planet itself has demanded an audience with you. After centuries of war and drought, you have the power to make a change.
Discover the mysteries behind the mystical energy that sustains your world, and make your way back to your throne. Your family needs you, your planet needs you!
Includes
A beautiful, stylized, immersive world

A story that adapts to your choices and evolves with you

Mysteries to solve

Over 36 different endings to experience
-Developed by Kalempirion Studios 13 -
-Solo-Dev : The DAC-
-Music by : Coraldi-

title: Zalis: A romantic adventure
description:
게임 정보
Danylo works diligently in an alchemical workshop he's been entrusted with. It is the first time he's in charge, and he does not want to let the locals down. But the vital component of potions is mana, and the only mine where locals could get mana crystals has been closed. Attacks on cargo and reports of missing people have become more frequent as well. How is the sweet and kind stranger who recently arrived in the village involved in this?

Features:

Nameble hero and love interest.

Play as a male or female.

Manage a shop, create potions, and raise your stats.

Engage in a fantasy story in the Ukrainian setting.

Potentially more characters in DLC.

title: Dumbest Tourists of Timelines
description:
게임 정보
"Dumbest Tourists of Timelines" 에서 미래의 투어 가이드가 되어 역사상 가장 어리석은 관광객들을 과거와 미래의 상징적인 시대를 여행하게 하세요!
혼자서 또는 친구들과 협력 모드에서 함께 플레이하면서 각 여행에서 독특하고 놀라운 도전에 맞서야 하며, 무모한 관광객들이 스스로 만든 재앙에서 구해내야 합니다!
이 미친 여행에서 중세 시대부터 고대 문명, 미래의 시대까지 다양한 시간대를 방문하게 됩니다. 각 레벨은 웃긴 사고와 피해야 할 역사적 함정으로 가득 차 있습니다. 화산 폭발에서 무모한 관광객을 구하거나 분노한 파라오에게 발각되지 않으려 하거나, 매 순간이 도전입니다!
주요 특징:
시간 여행: 다양한 시대를 탐험하고 독특한 역사적 환경과 상호작용하세요.
협력 플레이: 혼자서 또는 친구들과 함께 로컬 협력 모드로 플레이하세요.
관광객들이 역사를 어지럽히지 않도록 막을 수 있을까요? 배낭을 챙기고 "Dumbest Tourists of Timelines" 의 도전에 맞서세요. 각 시대는 웃음과 멸종의 기회가 될 수 있습니다!

title: Carcerem
description:
게임 정보
Carcerem은 현실적인 1인칭 공포 게임입니다. 고대 미로의 음산한 복도로 발을 들여보세요. 미로의 깊은 곳에서 끊임없이 들려오는 죄수들의 비명과 소가 우는 듯한 소리가 전해진다고 합니다. 미로를 탐험하며 그 구조를 파악해 보세요. 점점 더 깊이 들어갈수록 위험은 커집니다.
주인공은 죄를 짓고 처벌로 미로에 갇힌 죄수입니다. 그곳에서 탈출한 사람은 사면을 받을 수 있다는 것을 알고 있으며, 미로 속의 어떤 위험에도 싸워서 자신의 자유를 쟁취하려고 합니다.
미로는 수백 년 전 죄수를 가두기 위해 지어진 돌로 된 감옥입니다. 지금까지 아무도 이곳에서 탈출한 적이 없습니다.
수천, 아니 수만 명의 죄수들이 수세기 동안 이 미로를 지나갔지만, 아무도 그 벽을 넘어 탈출하지 못했습니다.
게임플레이
퍼즐 해결. 미로 내에서 수백 년 전에 만들어진 독특한 퍼즐은 죄수가 그 구조를 세밀하게 분석해야 합니다. 그 어떤 누구도 퍼즐을 풀어 미로 밖으로 해결책을 전달한 적이 없습니다.
아이템과 힌트 탐색. 죄수에게 있어 미로를 탈출할 수 있는 아이템이나 힌트는 그 무엇보다 소중합니다. 미로를 풀 수 있는 아이템을 찾아보세요.
매 걸음이 위험. 미로 내에서 마음 놓을 수 없습니다. 각 구석마다 위험한 돌연변이나 함정이 숨어 있을 수 있습니다.

title: Last Spirit
description:
게임 정보
 Last Spirit is a fast paced roguelike for up to 4 players. Combine items to fight groups of monsters! Unlock new characters and master unique abilities to save your home planet. Goin our communities to learn more!
 - Coop up to 4 players
 - Bunch of unlockable characters with unique abilities
 - More than 100 items that change you playstyle
 - A handful of unique bosses and locations

title: Artillis
description:
게임 정보
Artillis is a 3D Tower Defense, grid-based, Roguelike. Every island is a new puzzle to solve, procedurally generated to offer unrivaled visual and strategic depth.
Tower Customization: All towers have upgrade-slots where you can assign modules to drastically change their behavior.
Roguelike Progression: You bring everything with you from island to island, carried on the back of a giant turtle. Throughout each journey you'll pick up new towers and modules, enlist heroes and acquire ancient relics.
Iterative Procedural Generation: With ordered chaos in three dimensions, no two islands are the same. You have to adapt to the individual challenges and opportunities of each.
Setting Up Camp: Each day you'll fortify your position, placing your tents and towers and exploring the surroundings, in preparation for the nightly attacks.
Enemy Types: Every island will offer different selections and ratios of enemies, and it's up to you to adjust your defenses accordingly.
Draw Enemy Path: The enemies follow in your footsteps, which you can use to your advantage, leading them into range of your towers and creating chokeholds.

title: Black Zen White
description:
게임 정보
Black Zen White is a puzzle platformer where the world alternates every 10 seconds between two slightly different versions: black then white. Use your head, act at the right time and interact wisely with other inhabitants to find your way in this cute hand-drawn 2D game.
Act right at the right time...
...get help from friends...
...go through walls...

title: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens
description:
게임 정보
Merge adorable dessert-shaped cats to create larger felines, all the way up to the ultimate cat-ermelon! Collect points to unlock exciting power-ups and customize your gameplay. Play casually for fun or take on challenges as you navigate obstacles and changing weather conditions.
autokwd: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens

title: Arinoa: Conquest
description:
게임 정보
작은 정착지에서 시작하여 자원을 모으고, 건물을 건설하며, 점진적으로 영향력을 확장해 나갈 것입니다. 세력이 성장함에 따라 내부와 외부 모두에서 도전에 직면하게 될 것입니다.
특징
경제 관리: 자원을 모으고 건물을 건설하여 세력을 성장시키세요.
강력한 군대 지휘: 군대를 구축하고 고유한 영웅과 용병을 모집하여 이끌어 나가세요.
던전 탐험: 절차적으로 생성된 던전을 습격하여 방어구와 강력한 무기를 획득하세요.
외교 참여: 다른 세력과 동맹을 맺거나, 교역을 하거나, 전쟁을 벌이세요.
세력 발전: 새로운 기술을 연구하고 새로운 능력을 해제하여 다른 세력보다 앞서 나가세요.

title: Gun Of Fate : The Silver Gun Of Ylia
description:
게임 정보
A shooting adventure RPG game, where you play as a gunslinger in Westland. You can explore the area, encounter fights with Outlaws and wild beasts , accept quest and side mission, unlock items and equipment. In the main story, your character will play an important role in stopping an evil outlaw syndicate that terrorized the Westland. And to achieve that you will unveil the legends of this mystery land!
autokwd: Gun Of Fate : The Silver Gun Of Ylia

title: Ace of Space
description:
게임 정보
Select a flagship and embark on a journey across a universe on the brink of annihilation. Construct your deck of ships and science, obtain powerful artifacts to enhance your strategy, and make tough choices for the good of the galaxy. Warp across sectors, battle hostile factions, and face impossible odds as the universe itself collapses around you.
In Ace of Space you take the roll of Flagship Commander on a desperate mission to save the galaxy from an all-consuming cosmic entity. With each sector you enter, you’ll encounter distinct factions, from the ruthless Sovereign Imperium to the elusive Venom Syndicate and the nature-bound Verdant Dominion. The stakes are high, and every choice you make could be your last.
But there’s more than just war—time and space are unraveling, and an ancient, unstoppable force is at the heart of it all. Will you attain the strength and synergies needed to stop the Oblivion Nexus, or will you and your crew be lost to the void?
Wishlist today. Updates are coming at a rapid pace.
Features:
Dynamic Tactical Combat: Engage in strategic, real-time battles with enemies from across the galaxy. Adapt to each faction’s unique strengths and weaknesses.
Factions with Rich Lore: Each sector is controlled by a distinct faction with their own agendas, strengths, and hostilities. Fight, trade, or forge alliances with the Ironclad Cartel, Stormfront Collective, and more.
Cosmic Mystery Unfolding: Explore a universe in chaos, as an entity from beyond space and time slowly consumes everything. Each sector brings new challenges, from navigating frozen wastelands of the Frostspire League to surviving the brutal zealots of the Eternal Pantheon.
High-Stakes Story: Your decisions matter. Protect your crew, manage resources, and make critical choices that will decide the fate of your ship—and the galaxy.
73 Units
116 Cards
8 different Factions to encounter and play as
39 Events
79 Artifacts

title: Neon Highways
description:
게임 정보
Supercars, Neon-lit Cities, Cyber-Grids and Endless Highways: Welcome to Neon Highways, Where the '80s Come Back to Life!
Neon Highways is a Synthwave / Retrowave inspired casual arcade racer that lets you cruise through the vibrant, neon-lit streets of the 80s.
The music and visual style of Synthwave, inspired by a retro-futuristic vision of the 1980s, evokes a nostalgic sense of a past that never truly existed, yet feels instantly familiar.
This game takes you on an unforgettable road trip through this wonderful retro-futuristic world, where Retrowave, Synthwave, and Neon-Noir aesthetics blend with nostalgic synth melodies to create a journey like no other.
What’s waiting for you in Neon Highways?
🏁 Unlock New Highways, Chase the Horizon!
Cruise through neon-lit cityscapes, endless desert highways, and scenic ocean roads. Unlock up to 12 highways across 6 unique regions.
🚗 Unlock Sleek Supercars!
From classic-inspired speed machines to futuristic cruisers, unlock a growing collection of stylish supercars as you progress.
🎵 Synthwave Soundtrack, Pure Retro Vibes!
Cruise through neon highways with a synthwave soundtrack that perfectly matches the vibe. Every track brings that classic 80s arcade feel to life.
🎥 Authentic Retro Visual FX!
We’ve taken care to make sure Neon Highways doesn’t just look retro, it feels retro. Experience CRT scanlines, subtle film grain, and VHS-style artifacts that bring the nostalgia of old-school arcades and TVs to life on your modern screen.
🎮 Casual Racing, Pure Arcade Fun!
Neon Highways brings a relaxing casual arcade racing experience built for pure cruising enjoyment. If you’re up for a challenge, switch to the Rush Hour Mode—where heavier traffic and tighter time limits create a true test of your reflexes that brings all the stress you could ask for!
Grab the wheel, hit the open road, and let the neon sun guide you through a world where the '80s never left.

title: Later
description:
게임 정보
LATER is a narrative-driven hidden object game about doing things later. Explore a lovingly hand-drawn 2D comic world where a mysterious, cat-like creature invites you to a game of hide and seek. What starts as a playful challenge quickly turns into an intense journey through inner conflicts and the darker sides of procrastination.
Unique Hidden Object Experience
Search for a lovable creature hiding in an increasingly cluttered apartment – and maybe uncover a few secrets along the way.
Atmospheric 2D Comic Style
Lovingly hand-drawn black-and-white visuals with a melancholic undertone.
Surreal Journey
A short, narrative-driven game that will surprise you.
Easy to Play
Fully playable using just the left mouse button – perfect for a relaxed and accessible experience.
Short and Impactful
Designed to be completed in around 30–60 minutes, offering a unique experience in one sitting.
tag: 캐주얼,숨은 그림 및 물체,포인트 앤드 클릭,인디

title: Nightmare Battler Zozo
description:
게임 정보
Nightmare Battler Zozo is a fun and vibrant 2D platformer that blends playful adventure with dreamlike battles. Join Zozo, a young boy trapped in a surreal dream world, as he navigates through bizarre dreamscapes filled with peculiar enemies, mind-bending puzzles, and exciting surprises at every turn. In a land where dreams and nightmares collide, only Zozo’s wits and courage will help him escape!
Battle Your Nightmares: Fight against charmingly creepy enemies that are manifestations of Zozo’s childhood fears. Use a variety of weapons and abilities to blast through your foes and conquer the nightmares.
Explore Dynamic Dreamscapes: Every level takes you deeper into Zozo’s dreams, with vibrant and interactable environments packed with secrets. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden areas, and traverse fantastical landscapes that reflect Zozo's vivid imagination.
Cartoonish Fun: Inspired by the lightheartedness of Sunday morning cartoons, Nightmare Battler Zozo delivers a humorous and heartwarming narrative. The game’s colorful, animated style is sure to delight younger audiences, while its nostalgic platforming mechanics will appeal to older generations who grew up with classic games.
Versatile Gameplay: Master Zozo’s diverse abilities as you jump, climb, fight, and outsmart your way through enemy-filled dreamscapes. Each level offers new challenges and opportunities to test your skills in combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving.
Face Your Fears: Themed around childhood fears, each stage presents unique challenges based on common childhood anxieties, from creepy crawlies to spooky shadows, providing a mix of humor and lighthearted tension.
Whether you're battling nightmare creatures or uncovering hidden surprises, Nightmare Battler Zozo invites you to experience a thrilling, colorful world of imagination and adventure.

title: That sausage museum game
description:
게임 정보
박물관에서 소시지가 된 기분이 어떤지 궁금해 본 적이 있나요? 이제 기회가 생겼습니다! 우리의 길쭉한 영웅을 조종하여 초현실적인 예술 전시회를 여행하세요. 기괴한 도전, 중력을 무시하는 조각들, 그리고 정신을 혼미하게 하는 설치미술에 맞서 싸우는 지적으로 도전적인 모험이 기다리고 있습니다.
박물관에 맞서다
인내와 정밀함이 필요한 물리 기반의 도전에 직면하세요. 각 동작은 진행과 전시의 시작으로 되돌아가는 것 사이의 섬세한 균형입니다. 그러나 모든 승리는 맛있는 보상을 가져다줍니다: 진정한 예술 감정가가 되는 것.
소시지가 되다
몰입감을 주도록 설계된 조작으로 진짜 소시지가 된 듯한 기분을 느낄 수 있습니다. 모든 굴림과 공중제비는 자연스러워 보입니다 - 비록 소시지는 그렇지 않지만. 아, 그리고 위험을 감수할 준비가 되어 있다면 던질 수도 있습니다.

현대 예술 세계의 허세를 비웃는 게임을 원하셨다면, 당신은 지금 올바른 곳에 있습니다.

예술은 도전이 될 수 있습니다.

title: Trash Teammates
description:
게임 정보
Team up with friends to stack trash, climb up, and avoid danger in this fun and hectic multiplayer party game!
Play as one of five different toys and climb as high as you can through the garbage chute! Stack a variety of trash and create your own road to freedom. But be careful! For many hazards await you in your quest for survival.
Don't touch the buzzsaw! It rips everything apart - trash, players and maybe even friendships...
Be wary of the crusher: it may not look as dangerous as the buzzsaw, but it packs a solid punch when it comes to flattening trash... and you.
In this test of teamwork, creativity and stamina... Will you become the MVP, or the trash teammate?

title: Nebula Strike
description:
게임 정보
Nebula Strike is a 3D space shooting game. You need to use the left joystick to control the character's movement, the right joystick to control the character's direction to the enemy, and use the configured weapons to defeat the enemy.
This game focuses on excitement.
Game Features
Fast-paced game experience
Various weapons to choose from
Various enemies and attack methods
Each enemy attack requires facing dozens of enemies, and find a way to defeat them all!

title: Flowering Void
description:
게임 정보
Flowering Void puts you in the perspective of a creature with no memory, but very human emotions. You have a goal, but don't know why. You exist in a dark realm, but don't know where. Over time, you'll learn more about the nature of your world and the impact you're having on it.
The Survival Sequence
In the primary gameplay area, you're challenged to protect a core from an army of hostile entities, allowing the core to gain as much energy as possible. This sequence has no set end point, so you're encouraged to improve your skills and toolset to perform as best as possible and earn better rewards and endings.
The Sanctuary
The second area is where you spend most of your down time. Here you can purchase new items, view your inventory, practice your movement, and even uncover secrets.

title: Trapped In The Omniverse
description:
게임 정보
Trapped In The Omniverse: The Infinite Confluence is a challenging first-person survival game that combines interdimensional exploration with adventure and survival. You find yourself lost in the mysterious Antechambers of Quantum Dynamics, where reality blends and distorts. Your mission is to restore the Cosmoportal, the only means to return home, while facing creatures and overcoming obstacles in a chaotic environment. With exploration mechanics, strategic combat, and resource management, every step brings you closer to uncovering the secrets of the multiverses and finding your way back home. Can you restore balance and find the exit before it’s too late?



Quantum Dynamics was a pioneering company in quantum mechanics and its applications during its peak in the 70s and 80s. Their main focus was the unification of quantum physics with gravitational theory, and it is rumored they made significant advances in detecting multiverses and the possibility of traveling between them.

The most notable discovery attributed to Quantum Dynamics was the existence of a connection between the Multiverses through the so-called Antechambers, also known by various names according to documentation found in their old facilities. These antechambers, such as the Omniverse Chamber, the Cosmoportal Nexus, the Infinite Confluence, the Dimensional Nexus Hub, the Quantum Echo Chamber, or the Transdimensional Sanctum, allowed interaction between different universes.

Within these antechambers, it was found that the atmospheres of both Multiverses mixed, creating an environment conducive to the construction of habitable structures. The cross-contamination between parallel realities made these structures livable and allowed for simultaneous existence in both multiverses.



However, Quantum Dynamics began to face significant problems as the antechambers became increasingly contaminated. The company could not maintain control over the presence of specimens and elements from both Multiverses, leading to the gradual abandonment of the facilities.

Despite its disappearance and the loss of records about Quantum Dynamics' activities, the abandoned remains of the company and the documentation found within them remain silent witnesses to a fascinating period in multiverse exploration and attempts to overcome dimensional barriers.

After the fall of Quantum Dynamics, an independent team of daring researchers embarked on a mission to unravel the hidden mysteries behind the company and its legacy. Through meticulous research and exploration of abandoned facilities, they discovered a wealth of written and video material shedding light on Quantum Dynamics’ work.

Among the most surprising findings were numerous documents and records detailing the antechambers used by the company. These antechambers, commonly known by Roman numerals, were not limited to a few. Instead, it was discovered that Quantum Dynamics had managed to build and catalog dozens of interconnected antechambers, each with its own unique features and properties.



Each antechamber presented a specific configuration, with varying dimensions and distinctive characteristics. Some were expansive, covering vast stretches extending across thousands of square kilometers in both multiverses. Others were more compact, limited to a few hundred acres but with an incredible concentration of quantum energy.

The researchers discovered that these numbered antechambers were not only connection points between multiverses but also key nodes for understanding the structure and very nature of reality. Each antechamber seemed to contain fragments of information and knowledge that transcended the limits of any individual universe, revealing fascinating aspects of quantum physics and existence itself.

As they delved deeper into the recovered files, the research team also found mentions of an even more ambitious expansion project known as "Project Omega." This project, which remained unfinished after Quantum Dynamics' disappearance, aimed to create a definitive antechamber capable of connecting multiple multiverses simultaneously. Speculations and hypotheses about the implications and potential applications of such a project flooded the researchers' minds.



The writings and videos uncovered showed indications of the difficulties Quantum Dynamics faced in maintaining control over existing antechambers. The cross-contamination of multiverse atmospheres appeared to be a constant challenge, affecting the balance and habitability of the structures built within them.

The researchers realized that these findings could have significant implications for the future of interdimensional exploration. The possibility of accessing dozens of antechambers and the incomplete vision of Project Omega sparked new questions and possibilities about the nature of the multiverses and the potential for traveling through them.

As the research team delved into this wealth of information, they understood that their discovery had the potential to change humanity’s understanding of the universe and its place within it. The enigmas and secrets locked within the numbered antechambers offered a glimpse into the limits of reality, challenging conventional physics and opening doors to new horizons of exploration and discovery.

title: Dark Light
description:
게임 정보
Dark Light is a pixel art platformer adventure inspired by NES games of the 80s and 90s. You play as John, who is awakened from a peaceful sleep when a lightning strike shatters the silence of the night. As he looks out the window, he witnesses terrifying monsters emerging from the darkness. Armed with improvised tools and driven by curiosity, John embarks on a perilous journey to uncover the source of this strange anomaly and face the growing threats.
EXPLORE
Explore the island, battle enemies and bosses, and unlock new abilities as you guide John through a world filled with danger and mystery. Solve puzzles, defeat monstrous creatures, and uncover hidden secrets in a story-driven adventure that will challenge both your reflexes and your mind.
UNCOVER
What started as a simple investigation soon spirals into a fight for survival as John delves deeper into the island's mysteries. Along the way, he'll face monstrous foes, discover forgotten lore, and slowly piece together the puzzle of what caused this dark anomaly.

title: VOIDFACE
description:
게임 정보
Every enemy is a boss.
From ground-shaking robots to monsters and demons, each of them are uniquely brutal.
And so are you.
In VOIDFACE, you face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.
FEATURES
36 unique bosses, across 12 stages
Easy and hard mode
One hit, and you're dead (2 hp on Easy)
Various defensive and offensive spells
Stylized, smooth-rendered pixel graphics
Distinctive soundtrack for each stage

title: Moon Space
description:
게임 정보
In this thrilling 2D arcade game, you control a rocket that constantly moves forward. Your mission is to steer the rocket left and right to destroy meteors and dodge obstacles. Every meteor destroyed adds to your score, and combo multipliers give you a chance to rack up even more points! Be careful though—one collision and it's game over. Compete against yourself and others on the global leaderboard while facing unique challenges that push your skills to the limit. How high can you score?

title: Fishing Mega-Game
description:
게임 정보
At it's very core, Fishing Mega-Game is all about collecting fish. Each fish has a different arrangement of starting upgrades and attacks. The more fish you encounter the more you can experience. Who knows, you might get lucky and find an oddly colored "shiny" fish!
While fishing, send your bait into a fishing hole full of hungry fish looking to weaken you until you are fully consumed. Combat this with an arsenal resembling an aquatic "bullet heaven" type of game. Level up, or find rare upgrades to power through the hordes of small fry before you arrive at the main catch. Deal enough damage to it and add it to your collection!
This game takes inspiration from Vampire Survivors and Ridiculous Fishing!
Key Features
Creature Collecting
Roguelike style leveling
Meta-progression
and more!

title: Bird
description:
게임 정보
Bird is a social impact game about mass incarceration where players explore the memories and artwork of Darrell Fair. Darrell is an artist, activist, and mentor, represented by the Exoneration Project. He was wrongfully convicted in 1998 due to a coerced confession and has been serving time in Illinois ever since. Bird is a documentary, a virtual art gallery, and a video game all at once. 
The central framework of Bird is built on a metaphor from Michelle Alexander's "The New Jim Crow," which compares mass incarceration and racism in the U.S. to a birdcage. 
“One theorist, Iris Marion Young, relying on a famous “birdcage” metaphor, explains it this way: If one thinks about racism by examining only one wire of the cage, or one form of disadvantage, it is difficult to understand how and why the bird is trapped. Only a large number of wires arranged in a specific way, and connected to one another, serve to enclose the bird and to ensure that it cannot escape.11”
― Michelle Alexander, The New Jim Crow: Mass Incarceration in the Age of Colorblindness
This metaphor permeates Bird’s gameplay, and inspires players to ask themselves, what can I do to free this bird?
The story of Bird is told through animations, hand-drawn in Stateville Correctional, recorded audio interviews with Darrell and his family, and a dynamic choral soundtrack with lyrics taken from interviews conducted in Stateville and sung by the multi-Grammy-winning choir, The Crossing.

title: Aksun
description:
게임 정보

'악선'의 세계에서 '드레드'가 되어, 당신을 방해하는 악귀들을 전부 제거하고
과업을 이루기 위해 저승으로 나아가십시오.
무속이 담긴 한국의 신비로운 세계
'악선'은 한국 문화 기반의 액션 게임입니다.
역사와 무속을 배경으로 등장하는 등장인물과 괴물들
그리고 다양한 유산을 직접 경험해 보십시오.

'드레드의 제례'에 등장하는 다양한 무구들은 당신의 과업을 이루는 데 도움이 될 것입니다.
당신의 마음이 이끄는 데로 무기를 고르고 성장하며 나아가세요.

'악선'은 로그라이트 게임입니다.
전투 중 드레드가 사망해도, 혼은 저승의 어딘가로 돌아갈 뿐입니다.
육신을 수복하는 동안, 사망 전 습득한 도구들은
당신의 과업에 도움이 될 것입니다.
'악선'에서의 죽음은, 하나의 수단일 뿐입니다.
육체가 찢기고 부서져도 앞으로 나아가십시오.

title: Vending Machine Hero
description:
게임 정보
자판기 안에 사람이 있어요!
[게임의 배경 및 스토리]


이세계 존재들이 숨어사는 도시를 배경으로하는 어반 판타지 게임입니다.
이세계 존재들을 감시 & 관리하는 임무를 맡은 주인공 나비와 함께 기이한 도시를 조사해보세요.


도시 어디에나 존재하고, 아무도 신경쓰지 않는 자판기.
나비는 이 도시의 자판기 안에서 살고 있으며, 일반 사람들에게 이세계 존재들의 존재를 걸리지 않게 관리하는 몬스테라의 조사원입니다. 오늘은 또 어떤 사건을 조사하고 해결해야 할까요?
오늘은 무엇을 마실까?
[다양한 음료수를 마시며 재미있는 능력을 사용해보세요]


나비는 음료수를 마시고 능력을 사용할 수 있습니다. 어떤 음료수를 좋아하시나요? 취향이 가득한 음료수들을 마시면서 재미있는 능력들을 사용해 조사를 진행해볼까요?


자판기에서 새로운 음료수들을 연구하고, 출시해보세요. 조사원 활동에 많은 도움이 될거에요.


조사원의 서포터 오라클과 함께 음료수를 판매하여 활동비를 벌어보세요.
다양한 연구와 업그레이드에는 항상 돈이 필요하답니다.

title: MONOWAVE
description:
게임 정보
혼란한 세상에 퍼지는 감정의 울림!
감정의 실타래로 얽힌 세상, 네 가지 감정인 행복, 슬픔, 분노, 불안 정령을 조율하는 수호자가 있었습니다. 감정은 조화를 이루고 세상은 평온했지만, 어느 날 예기치 못한 재앙으로 수호자가 사라지고 말았습니다. 남겨진 감정 정령들은 뿔뿔이 흩어졌고, 고립된 채 각자의 감정에 빠져들어 폭주합니다. 감정의 불협화음이 가득한 세계는 배려와 이해 대신, 갈등과 불신만이 남게 되었습니다.
한편, 세상의 변두리에서 새로운 수호자 '모노'가 탄생합니다. 특별한 '공감' 능력을 지닌 모노는 저 너머의 감정 정령들에게 이끌려 길을 떠납니다. 감정의 힘에 반응하고 움직이는 생태계, 마주하는 친구들과의 교류. 이 모든 울림이 폭주한 감정 정령들에게도 전해질 수 있지 않을까요? 모노의 여정이 지금 시작됩니다!
🌈 네 가지 독특한 감정 능력
주인공 '모노'는 감정을 수호하는 정령으로, 느끼는 감정에 따라 특별한 힘을 발휘합니다.

title: MATCH APP!
description:
게임 정보
게임 개요
매치앱!은 일본 데이팅앱을 소재로 한 비주얼노벨 게임입니다.주인공되어 데이팅앱을 통해 새로운 만남을 찾아가는 스토리를 체험할 수 있습니다.
스토리
주인공 마사양은, 졸업을 앞둔 대학교 4학년생입니다. 친구 히로시의 권유로 마사양은 데이팅앱의 세계로 뛰어들게 되었습니다.소극적인 마사양에게는 모든 것이  첫경험이라 혼란스러울 따름입니다.과연 마사양은 이성과 "매칭"할 수 있을까요?
캐릭터소개
마사양(CV:오노 류타로)
본작의 주인공.대학교 4학년생.대학생활내내 제대로 된 연애를 해본적이없습니다.히로시의 권유로 데이팅앱을 시작하게됩니다.
히로시(CV:쿠구이 우리에라)
마사양의 룸메이트이자 친구.어느날 마사양에게 데이팅앱을 권유합니다.마사양의 연애를 서포트해줍니다.
쿠모코(CV:타케카와 카에데)
마사양과 데이팅앱에서 매칭된여성.연애경험이 많지는 않지만,적극적으로 리드합니다.
게임정보
플레이타임:1시간-2시간
풀보이스(일본어음성)
CG 10장
멀티엔딩

title: A Snoot's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Join Snoot in an Epic, Adorable Journey Like No Other!
Prepare for the fluffiest, fastest-paced, and most Snoot-tastic adventure ever! In “A Snoot’s Adventure,” you’ll step into the floppy shoes of Snoot, the lovable creature from Snootville, as you embark on a magical quest to save the Seven Realms. With vibrant 3D platforming, high-speed paintball combat, and heartwarming acts of kindness, this game blends snoot-strategy with non-stop action!
                       A mysterious rift has opened between Snoot’s peaceful realm and our universe. Now, Snoot must race through intergalactic realms, collecting Spirit Leaves from the legendary Tree of Life to restore harmony. Along the way, earn Gratitude Hearts for helping the quirky citizens of these realms, from shy snails to the snootily mischievous JoJo Magnifico.
                        Key Features

title: Far From The Darkness
description:
게임 정보
Far From The Darkness is a multiplayer strategy and betrayal game for 4 to 12 players.
You are part of a squad of soldiers among whom werewolves are hiding. During the night, the soldiers must complete missions while surviving the werewolves, who can transform once and kill a victim during the night.
If the missions are not completed within the time limit, the squad will have to survive a blood night. During this phase, the werewolves can transform again and continue the massacre.
If the missions are completed within the time limit, the day breaks, and the squad votes to eliminate the most suspicious person.
Of course, the werewolves are not invincible, and the squad is not defenseless. All players (soldiers and wolves) have roles that grant them unique abilities. New roles will be added regularly.
Additional Information:
Gameplay: Unlike the board game, you must move around in a 3D environment. Some roles grant the ability to shoot various projectiles; poor aim can seriously hinder your team.
Communication: The game features a proximity chat system to communicate with other players.
Atmosphere: During the night phases, players move through dark areas, lit only by their flashlights. In this terrifying darkness, danger can come out of nowhere! A word of advice, try to find batteries to stay far from the darkness.
Progression: Every action during a match earns you experience. Each level unlocks in-game cosmetics. Your stats are also saved.

title: Bubble Balance Bonanza
description:
게임 정보
Roll, bump, jump, and crash your way through many unique levels in this fast-paced, marble style, physics-driven platformer. With unpredictable environments, cute characters to meet and interact with and crazy obstacles to overcome, you'll need both skill and strategy to keep your balance and complete the journey.
Are you ready for the bonanza?
Protected by a bubble, you'll embark on a wild adventure through an unknown and treacherous world.
With over 30 levels to explore and complete, you'll meet many other creatures, animals and friends! Bubble Balance Bonanza features a dynamic world map where you’ll roll around to select new levels.

title: Flexible Frosty
description:
게임 정보
Put on your mittens and your beanie to discover an icy world in this retro arcade-style game from the heyday of the GameBoy.
Cool features included:
1 little & cute flexible penguin
GameBoy-like graphics and audio
Wholesome & family friendly
Approximately ~2 hours long
40 short levels filled with unique puzzles
40 ice creams to collect as an additional challenge
15 achievements for completionist lovers
An optional binocular view to help you solve larger levels
Mouse, keyboard, and full gamepad support

title: Crop Crusaders
description:
게임 정보
Play as a sentient Vegetable who can transform into 6 different veggies with unique abilities. Escape the tormenting lab where you were created and are now being held captive.
CARROT: Dash through the air and see in the dark using the carrot’s abilities.
TOMATO: Fire your stem as a weaponized projectile to take out enemies in a blast.  
BROCCOLI: Swing through the air with the Broccoli’s grappling hook ability.
PEPPER: Traverse dangerous levels covered in acid much more safely with the near acid-proof pepper veggie.
CUCUMBER: When you're as slim as a cucumber, you can fit through tight gaps and get to otherwise inaccessible spots.
EGGPLANT: Break rocks and manipulate the environment through smashing stones and boulders to bits with the physically strongest veggie of them all!
Diverse terrain and environment

title: The Stare
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a haunting journey that challenges your sanity, where every level is a riddle waiting to be solved and every moment is filled with unsettling uncertainty.
You find yourself trapped in a dark, twisted dreamscape, an endless maze of dimly lit hallways and desolate rooms that seem to stretch on forever. Each step forward is hesitant, as the very environment feels alive, intent on confusing and disorienting you. The oppressive atmosphere weighs heavily, with shadows that flicker and dance, and every creak and whisper echoing from unseen corners fills you with unease. It's a world where even the air seems to pulse with dread, and the question is not only where you are but whether you can truly escape.
Inspired by the eerie mystery of the classic backrooms, this game turns every door into a gamble and every room into a potential nightmare. There is a constant, unshakable feeling that something is watching, always lurking just out of sight. The silence is broken only by the occasional distant sound—a reminder that you're not alone. The only way to survive is to stay calm, think clearly, and press forward, but each decision feels like a step deeper into the unknown. Beware, because you won’t always know where you're heading, and sometimes, turning back might not be an option.
Can you uncover the hidden secrets of these shifting levels before it’s too late? The dynamics here are elusive, and only those with sharp minds and steady nerves can hope to make it through unscathed.
Prepare yourself to lose your sense of direction, solve cryptic puzzles, and confront your deepest fears as you venture deeper into the unknown. This is more than a game; it is a test of your wits and courage, challenging you to unravel the mystery before you become a part of it forever.

title: Unfoldink
description:
게임 정보
Unfoldink is a 2D logical puzzle adventure game where you craft unique combinations of cards, to come up with animated stories that explain the tribe's depararature.
UNFOLDINK OFFERS
-> Unique mind boggling puzzles
 -> Total of 10 diffrent cards and...
...over 350 animated combinations
-> Surprising and funny character interactions

title: Nothing At Stake
description:
게임 정보
Nothing At Stake is an open world action-adventure styled in the vein of classic n64 games, specifically taking inspiration from the first 3d Legend of Zelda games.
Within is an oblique dark fantasy world packed full of dungeons, ruins of a recently dead civilization, and colorful characters doing their best to survive in a seemingly hopeless world.
Help them make something of the scattered chaos that remains or set down your own path accumulating power as you scope out a land you'd been long isolated from.
Story
OVER A DECADE AGO, THE DOMINANT CIVILIZATION FELL.
STRUCK BY AN OTHERWORLDLY FORCE, MANIFESTED IN THE FORM OF A 100 QUADRILLION TON CONGLOMERATION OF ROCK, METAL, AND OTHER INDETERMINATE SUBSTANCES.

title: Hats and Guns
description:
게임 정보
Hats and Guns is a roguelite deckbuilder set in the Wild West. Play as different characters with unique gameplays. Upgrade your cards and collect powerful weapons and relics as you attempt to survive in the heart of a dangerous procedurally-generated desert.
Key features
Deckbuilding
Over 100 card upgrades to assign to 5 basic card types (accuracy, speed, dexterity, reflex and strength) to create powerful combos and optimize your deck.
4 playable characters
4 unique gameplay characters are available, each with a passive skill, a starting weapon and a unique starting deck.
Tactical combat
Combat is grid-based, and accuracy is the central system of combat. You'll need to pay close attention to your position, resources and accuracy management to maximize damage and stay alive in these challenging encounters.
Procedural desert and moral choices
Travel through the wilderness, meticulously choosing your path. Collect equipment to become more powerful and reach your goal, a fearsome gang leader!
Will you become as cruel as he is to get your revenge, or will you stay on the right path?

title: Inspiring ballads
description:
게임 정보
Inspiring ballads is an RPG set in an open fantasy world. Get reliable equipment, create powerful magic, pick up a sword and decide your fate and the fate of the inhabitants of the entire island! Become the new ballad hero!
A classless system. Choose who you want to be: a brutal warrior, a destructive magician, a mobile fighter, a master of poisoning - or find an even more effective way.
Several schools of magic, including hidden ones.
Create equipment from trophies from enemies.
Dozens of types of opponents.
The inhabitants of the island, who were just waiting for you to solve their problems.
The opportunity to win over representatives of the opposite sex.
There are several endings - from the most obvious to the hidden and very hidden.

title: ZaciSa: Idle Defense!
description:
게임 정보
Tower Defense meets Idle Clicker
This is a Tower Defense x Idle Clicker game set inside the Crayon Empire. Let the game build out your bases, upgrade your colorful forces and attack all oncoming enemy forces. Or take charge and control your destiny and fortify your defenses. As the game levels up and enemies get stronger, you will be rewarded new weapon choices and abilities.

title: Birdigo
description:
게임 정보
Make Words
Longer words score higher, but specific combos can turn short words into powerhouses. Not happy with your hand? Discard any number of letters, up to four times each round.

Build your Deck
Add enhanced letter cards to supercharge your score. Delete difficult letters to improve your odds of drawing the ones you want.
Deploy Feathers to Change the Game
Feathers aren’t just bonuses. They transform how words are scored, making some patterns incredibly potent.
Try Wild Strategies
With more than six million possible combinations of feathers, along with enhanced letters and transformative songs, there’s no limit to the strategies you can try. How about two-letter words with enhanced letters left in your hand? It could work!
Lead your Flock to Safety
Birdigo consists of migrations with dozens of stopovers — each one a chance to replenish and re-strategize. To reach the next one, you’ll need to fly further each round.

Achievements unlock new feathers, songs, decks, and migration routes. Huge bonuses and multipliers mean big numbers, which you’ll need to win these treacherous routes.
Should you play that easy word, or discard some letters in the hopes of drawing something better? Which feather should you pick? Which song? Your choices are the difference between a successful migration and failure.

title: Rusty the Rooster
description:
게임 정보
"Rusty the Rooster" is an engaging 2D pixel art platformer that invites players into a vibrant and adventurous world where courage and determination know no bounds. The protagonist, Rusty, is a courageous and spirited rooster on a noble quest to rescue his beloved girlfriend and their unborn chicks from imminent danger. Throughout this thrilling journey, players will navigate Rusty through beautifully crafted pixel art landscapes, each teeming with challenges and surprises.
The game is divided into three distinct worlds, each comprising eight meticulously designed levels. These worlds offer a variety of environments and themes, ensuring that players remain captivated as they progress through Rusty's epic saga. The levels are filled with intricate platforming sections and cunningly placed obstacles that will test players' timing and reflexes.
As Rusty traverses each level, he faces an array of formidable foes, including stealthy wolves, cunning foxes, and bomb-spitting pelicans that add a layer of strategic combat to the gameplay. Each enemy type requires a different approach, encouraging players to adapt and refine their tactics as they advance.
At the end of each world, Rusty must confront a powerful boss, a true test of skill and perseverance. These boss battles are designed to challenge players' mastery of the game's mechanics, requiring them to utilize all the skills and abilities they've honed throughout their journey.
"Rusty the Rooster" is more than just a platformer; it's a tale of bravery, love, and the unyielding spirit of a rooster determined to protect his family. With its charming pixel art graphics, engaging gameplay, and a heartwarming storyline, this game promises to deliver an unforgettable experience that will resonate with players of all ages. Whether you're a seasoned platformer enthusiast or a newcomer to the genre, "Rusty the Rooster" offers a delightful adventure filled with excitement and heart.

title: Hermes Library
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Hermes Library. It is the main library of the Hephaestus University, the most famous university in the United Nation of Europa. As a junior named Rainn Echo, you will become the new librarian working at the front desk. While performing your daily duties, you will also witness several mysterious incidents there.
【How to Become a Capable Librarian】
You will help students, faculty members, and alumni to check out and return books. Using the workbook provided, you will check if every reader has complied with the library's rule: if they have checked out more than they should, if they have returned everything on time, if they have used their own ID card... Pay attention to details, and you will become an outstanding librarian!
Work time is divided into two parts: the morning and the afternoon. You will need to help about 12 readers every day with their return and check-out. During their conversations, you will get a glimpse into the lives of these students, professors, and alumni and piece together a rich campus environment.
Check-out: the reader needs to provide their ID and the book they want to borrow. If they have a reservation, they will tell you the title of the book so that you can take it out of the reservation area on the left. The first step of check-out is to use the scanner on the ID card. The information of the reader will appear on the screen on the right. You need to check the information and make sure that they are using their own ID and they have the authorization to borrow. Then you can press the "receipt" button on the bottom of the screen, type in the title of the checked-out book and the return date, and press "print." Then you can give the printed receipt along with the ID card and the now-checked-out book to the reader.

title: Pastopia
description:
게임 정보
Pastopia is a third-person, open-world adventure where coding becomes your key in unlocking the mysteries of a forgotten world. 
Explore a beautifully crafted world filled with puzzles and challenges that inspire creative thinking. With your Golem A.I. companion by your side, you'll discover and develop coding skills as you play, using them to revive the lost memories of the past.

title: Squink
description:
게임 정보
You are a Squid trying to escape the seemingly endless office, but the only way you can move is blasting yourself around with explosions. Build up momentum to clear jumps and avoid falling back down.
Don't worry it wont take you long to get back up... unless you fall again.
Online Co-op/Multiplayer:
Don't fall all by yourself you can play with anyone on your Steam friend list!
Gameplay:
This is a rocket jumping game where you progress through increasingly more difficult jumps.
All you have to do is: Aim and Shoot at the floor
Build up momentum with your ink blasts
Fly across large gaps
Bonk your head against a wall
Fall all the way back down
Shoot two bubbles together and launch yourself into it for a massive boost in the air
Every success and failure is auto saved
As you ascend through the office you will endure many hardships:
Waterfalls
Disappearing blocks
Hanging boxes
Angry managers
And much more!
Atmosphere:
You'll get enraged at some point, but that cute squid smile and fast speed with bring you right back to loving it!
4 layers each with unique environments
A soundtrack containing songs for each layer

title: Kiln People Revelations
description:
게임 정보
Exploration & Revelation
Fragments of the conspiracy are scattered throughout the abandoned amusement park, and every clue you uncover can alter the course of the game, leading to multiple endings. Collect and piece together clues to unravel the hidden truth behind Kiln People Revelations!
Fight to the End
Control the Kiln Person to battle your enemies. Make the most of the environment and apply strategic tactics to survive and thrive in this brutal game.
Metagaming
Your actions will directly shape the course of the game, carving out your own unique path. As the boundaries between in-game and real-life experiences become increasingly fluid, the program team is attentive to your choices that transcend the fourth wall.
Interactive Narrative
As you interact with Kiln Person 42, your relationship will evolve with the unfolding plot, leading to unexpected twists.

title: Saci: The Cursed Hunt
description:
게임 정보
In the heart of the Amazon jungle, myths become deadly reality. You wake up alone, and the only way to survive the night is to capture the elusive Saci by finding five objects scattered across the dense, ever-changing forest. Saci is always hunting you, using tricks to alter the environment and lead you astray. Known for his mischievous nature in Brazilian folklore, Saci warps reality, setting traps and illusions to confuse you. With danger at every turn, can you outwit the jungle's trickster spirit before it’s too late?
Survive the night or become another victim of the jungle’s deadly legend.
Key Features:
Dynamic Environment: Explore the Amazon Jungle with realistic weather and wildlife.
Saci’s Tricks: Face visual pranks and shifting landscapes designed to confuse you.
Stealth and Survival: Avoid wildlife predators while gathering the objects.
Exploration: Discover hidden caves, ancient ruins, and unravel the jungle’s secrets.
Who is Saci?
The game draws from Brazilian folklore, where Saci-Pererê is not only a mischievous trickster but also one of the guardians of the Amazon forest. Known for his one-legged figure, magical red cap, and pipe, Saci controls whirlwinds and alters the jungle to confuse travellers. In this version, Saci’s dark past as a former enslaved child who lost his leg adds a tragic edge to his pranks. He warps the environment with illusions and traps to stop you from capturing him.

title: Apes Warfare
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a captivating grid-based combat system where you lead the Guardians in a battle to reclaim stolen artifacts from enemy forces.
Strategically manage a diverse roster of units, each with unique strengths and abilities, from agile scouts to powerful heavy hitters, ensuring every battle feels fresh and dynamic.
Different terrains modify buffs and debuffs, enhancing strategic gameplay and requiring you to adapt your tactics for maximum advantage.

title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare
description:
게임 정보
TritonXR turns ANY space into a dynamic combat arena with your friends - duck behind your living room couch to reload, throw a grenade down your hallway or jump over your bed to avoid an attack.
Cutting-Edge XR
Battle as many friends as you can fit in your space, customise your environment, choose your loadout, and experience VR like never before. Play in either our Immersive Mode (full VR), Mixed Reality (hybrid) or the Real Life mode that lets you feel like you’re truly battling IRL.
Your Space, Your Battlefield
TritonXR is as simple to set up as it is fun to play. Our intuitive mixed-reality map editor lets you quickly create combat arenas in your physical space. Add walls, props, weapons and more!
Team Up, Take Down
No friends? No problem. Our brand new Survival Mode lets you battle flying foes that can navigate around your space, and creepy crawlies that can climb any piece of furniture in your room. See how long you can survive in singleplayer or multiplayer mode!
The world's most advanced XR game is here - turn any playspace into the ultimate multiplayer combat arena in TritonXR!

title: Teddy the Tractor
description:
게임 정보
You arrived to help your uncle with crops in the fields. But of a sudden, you've been attacked by a tractor monster. To rescue the village, you must collect crops and defeat Teddy the tractor!
One of the most important parts of Teddy the Tractor is the tractor. You will ride your tractor, upgrade it, unlock new weapons, and fight Teddy.
During the gameplay, you move through the story by committing quests and collecting crops day by day. Time moves forward constantly, and some quests can be missed or failed.

title: FlowerCorner: Plant Watering To Vibe To
description:
게임 정보
Flower Corner is a relaxing idle game where you nurture and grow a variety of plants while doing other activities on your computer. The game sits at the bottom of your screen, quietly blooming in the background, allowing you to enjoy a peaceful gardening experience without interrupting your daily routine.
Casual and Customizable: Arrange your garden with different plants, pots, and decorations to create your own mini green space. As you unlock new species and items, you can customize your garden to reflect your personal style.
autokwd: FlowerCorner: Plant Watering To Vibe To

title: More Life
description:
게임 정보
explore your crumbling city
meet NPCs with main character syndrome
find glitches in the fabric of reality
enter surreal alternate universes
collect stuff you find in the street
scheme against the authorities

title: Fantasy Hearts
description:
게임 정보
Experience an old-school atmosphere in a brand new battler with strategy and RPG elements!
If you've been playing tactical RPGs and turn-based strategy games of the fantasy genre (Final Fantasy Tactics, Heroes of the Sword of Magic, Eador or Disciples), then FANTASY HEARTS is the multiplayer game that will make you feel unreal nostalgic.
ALL THE CLASSICS
✔ PvP battles
✔ PvE battles
✔ Hex field
✔ Fantasy characters

title: Pick Me Up
description:
게임 정보
석기 시대 식민지 시뮬레이션
석기 시대의 당신만의 정착지를 세우고 식민지를 건설하세요! 정착민들을 이끌고 새로운 땅을 개척하며 자원을 모으고 건물을 세워 자급자족이 가능한 안전한 마을을 만들어 나가세요. 당신의 전략적 선택이 정착지의 생존과 번영을 결정짓고, 부족을 확장해 가며 점차 강력한 식민지로 키워 갈 것입니다.

title: Witchpop
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Souper Star Cafe where the secret ingredient is Magic. Pick your chef and sous chef, pick your soup, and cook with your spells to make the best soup possible.
Features
Physics Based Puzzle Matching, where you'll have to match ingredients in real time! Avoid your ingredients touching the bottom of the pot where they'll end up burning. Too many burned ingredients and your soup will be ruined!
Accumulate Curses over time and survive as long as you can while trying to attain the highest score possible.
Use Spells to either help save your soup or to score even higher
Risk and Reward Gameplay. Make and store up larger clusters of ingredients to score even more, and take extra curse cards for even higher multipliers
Play with Friends, either head to head in different soup pots, or cooperatively sharing the same pot with multiple cursors.
Multiple Characters to change the aesthetics of your chef and sous chef. With all characters sharing the same abilities, all characters are equally viable to be picked.
Mouse/Keyboard and Controller Support. Either use your mouse to fling ingredients, or, use a gamepad to control the cursor or to teleport between ingredients for incredibly fast movement.

title: Bass Invaders
description:
게임 정보
Nasty aliens from outer space want to eat your moonbase. This is out of the question! Board your tank, load your cannons, and show the aliens who's boss. Aliens you destroy drop items, which you can collect to upgrade your tank. But beware of falling debris and rivalling players who try to snatch the items from under your nose. Aliens move to the rhythm of the music and this helps you anticipate their movement. Get into the groove in order to blast aliens quicker, and score bonus points! Who can eliminate the most aliens and get the highscore? Hilarious outer space musical mayhem for 1-4 players.

title: Echos
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in an expansive and captivating world where exploration, survival, and strategy intertwine to create a unique gaming experience.
In this open-world survival adventure, you will embark on a journey through vast and diverse landscapes, each teeming with secrets waiting to be uncovered. From dense forests to barren deserts, icy tundras to mysterious caves, the environments are not only visually stunning but also brimming with hidden challenges.
Key Features:
Exploration and Discovery: Traverse various biomes, each with its own set of challenges and resources. Uncover hidden areas, ancient ruins, and mysterious artifacts that may change the course of your journey.
Crafting and Resource Management: Gather resources from the environment to craft essential tools, weapons, and survival gear. Whether you're building a shelter, crafting advanced weaponry, or preparing potions, careful resource management is crucial to your survival.
Dynamic Combat: Face off against a range of creatures, each with its own attack patterns and weaknesses. Engage in real-time, fast-paced combat where both skill and strategy are needed to survive.
Survival Mechanics: Keep an eye on your character's health, hunger, and stamina levels. Adapt to the environment by learning to craft necessary survival items such as clothing, fire starters, and food, while managing limited resources.
Story and Quests: Experience an engaging narrative filled with side quests and objectives. The world is rich with lore, and every discovery brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind your environment and your place within it.

title: Sigma Squad
description:
게임 정보
Sigma Squad is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer FPS that takes the classic genre experience to a new level of precision.
“What you see is what you get,” some say. In Sigma Squad, we have that too, but with one difference—it actually works here. With 256-tickrate servers, we guarantee smooth gameplay and precise shots that let you trust every move you make.
Explore five unique maps, each inspired by different cultures and iconic spots:
Freedom Land
Maiameee
Hong
Japanese Sunset
"The day"
Created by a small, family-run indie studio with over 10 years of experience in technology development, Sigma Squad represents our passion for the genre and our desire to deliver an enhanced and precise experience for both casual and competitive players alike.
We greatly appreciate your support in adding Sigma Squad to your wishlist.

title: Incrate
description:
게임 정보
Incrate is a mind-warping 2D/3D puzzle game contained within a crate! You've been mysteriously trapped in a bizarre box-shaped prison. Rotating the prison will twist your notions of perspective. Bend reality to your whim and manipulate your world and the things in it to solve the puzzles and escape!
You find yourself suddenly uplifted from your life and discover you're an inmate in a crate with no recollection of how or why you got there. The crate is an otherworldly prison contained within a boxed world. The local inhabitants that greet and guide you seem to be a despondent guard and mysterious ghost...

title: Yaku Slap
description:
게임 정보
🎴 Yaku Slap – Walk the Flower Path and Slap Down Monsters! 🌸
Ready to duel monsters, master ancient card combos, and get just a little addicted to slapping down the perfect hand? Yaku Slap blends the strategic flair of Hanafuda Koi Koi with rogue-like chaos where every match could be your last—or your ultimate victory.
Collect powerful spells, master rare Yaku combinations, and score big as you fight your way down the Flower Path to become a true Yaku Master. Win, lose, and unlock classes, and passive abilities with every run!

🎴 Features:
🌿 Strategic Card Combat: Master the classic Koi Koi mechanics with a supernatural twist.
🌸 Rogue-like Progression: Every run earns you perks and passives to power up.
🃏 Monster Showdowns: Duel dangerous creatures that are as challenging as they are zany—slap hard or get slapped!

title: Absolution of the Dead
description:
게임 정보
NARRATIVE.
The Germans knew they would lose the war. In a desperate attempt at victory, they unleashed a hell upon the battlefront that would consume Europe...
You wake up in a zombie infested hotel, the only way out is to descend into pure chaos. As you go from floor to floor slaughtering the undead, you'll go deeper into the trenches of your mind to uncover the truth of the outbreak.

title: Unfoldink
description:
게임 정보
Unfoldink is a 2D logical puzzle adventure game where you craft unique combinations of cards, to come up with animated stories that explain the tribe's depararature.
UNFOLDINK OFFERS
-> Unique mind boggling puzzles
 -> Total of 10 diffrent cards and...
...over 350 animated combinations
-> Surprising and funny character interactions
