description:
게임 정보
Nothing At Stake is an open world action-adventure styled in the vein of classic n64 games, specifically taking inspiration from the first 3d Legend of Zelda games.
Within is an oblique dark fantasy world packed full of dungeons, ruins of a recently dead civilization, and colorful characters doing their best to survive in a seemingly hopeless world.
Help them make something of the scattered chaos that remains or set down your own path accumulating power as you scope out a land you'd been long isolated from.
Story
OVER A DECADE AGO, THE DOMINANT CIVILIZATION FELL.
STRUCK BY AN OTHERWORLDLY FORCE, MANIFESTED IN THE FORM OF A 100 QUADRILLION TON CONGLOMERATION OF ROCK, METAL, AND OTHER INDETERMINATE SUBSTANCES.

title: Star Shift Legacy
description:
게임 정보
** Star Shift Legacy is a work in progress. The demo is outdated and contains bugs.

—Over 100 playable characters and hours of gameplay
—Branching story arcs
—Base and empire building
—Strategic turn-based combat (standard)
—Tactical battle system (fleet and army)

title: Señorita El Chupacabra
description:
게임 정보
Wild West
Welcome to the Wild West where steampunk meets magic, also, human races are living next to fantasy creatures. The protagonist is a young vampire Maria El Chupacabra decides to become a bounty hunter!
But Maria isn't a super hero and few precise shots can take her down easily.

Steampunk Arsenal
Use various types of guns and traps to take your opponents down, some weapons can be used as a tool.

Magic
Support your action with magic, increasing your strength or casting curses on the enemy.
There are some magic items and spells that can bring chaos to your opponents.

Use Opponents
The protagonist has the power to take control of one opponent for some time.
Each opponent has his strength and weaknesses strong ogres can push heavy objects whereas elves run fast and jump high, using that against them or solving a puzzle to get extra stuff.

Planning
During the game, you can find traps like bear traps or exploding barrels, put them in the right place, alert opponents and see how the traps are doing the rest of the job.
But sometimes you have to avoid fighting for example blocking enemy wasy or sneak behind their back.

title: QUADREMOR
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by the biggest first person shooters of the 90's and early 2000's, Quadremor brings you back to the classic retro shooting experience you know and love. It's fluid gameplay and unique, dark atmosphere will instantly make you feel at home.
Backstory
In the 23rd century, humanity got so technologically advanced it could colonize other planets of the solar system with ease.
This colonization lead to discoveries of numerous alternative energy sources - which helped with developing first teleporting devices.
People started to explore worlds in other dimensions. They contacted many friendly interdimensional species and gathered a lot of valuable data.
Unfortunately, one of the dimensions proved to be very hostile towards human race.
Monsters killed every member of one of the expeditions, grouped together into a huge army and got into our world through an open portal.
After 2 weeks of fighting, humanity got almost entirely annihilated.
Monsters returned to their homeworld not knowing that you - one of the last human mercenaries and a war veteran - followed them.
Mission
The game takes place in a hostile dimension called Quadremor.
It's a true multiverse full of twisted creatures who want every other race to be either dead or enslaved by them.
You have to find and kill every one of these monsters and make sure that nothing from this dimension will ever get to our world again.
Gameplay
Quadremor is a unique yet familiar first person shooter with an emphasis on dark atmosphere and fluid gameplay.
The game includes multiple weapons, many types of monsters, hand crafted levels, extreme power ups, jump pads, secrets, teleports, and all sorts of good stuff to make your experience as enjoyable as possible.

title: Alien Boom Boom
description:
게임 정보



The aliens are invading your small town, they seem to be everywhere, but a mysterious transmission is guiding you to fight back!




It's time to take the fight to them! Put a stop to their plans by travelling through their network of interconnected ships, bringing you to new destinations such as moon bases, space stations, the white house, exotic runes, your small town and more!




Your ability to utilize your weapons effectively, control recoil, and place those much needed headshots is great and all, but you're still going to have to master the movement! Dash, jump and time your attacks effectively to ensure you tip the scales in Earth's favor.




The mysterious voice in your head needs your help! There is more here than meets the eye, and some how you are central to stopping this invasion.
The truth is UP there!

Alien Boom Boom is a shooter that embraces exaggerated action over realism.

Master your movement and powerful weapons such as explosive shotguns, powerful plasma rifles, railguns that rip through enemies and more. Visit many locations, while battling the alien threat including: moon bases, space stations, the white house and exotic locales.





Follow the journey of a small-town hero as they are thrust into a world-saving mission
Discover the truth behind the alien invasion and uncover a sinister plot.

title: Midline '85
description:
게임 정보


Midline ‘85 is an interactive thriller about working as an emergency service operator in a small town. Face the fears, desires and cruelty of people caught in trouble, as well as calls from your coworkers, friends, or even enemies. You will observe six months of Elena’s work, from her first day on the job to the story’s finale. Only your choices determine how it ends.


Study Midline for the smallest details of its life: local radio broadcasts, the morning paper, or work mail. Find information that will unlock new dialogue options. But remember: there is no knowing where an unexplored path might take you…




Your telephone is your only weapon. Use information you’ve gathered outside of calls, monitor the person on the other end’s mental state. Lie, intimidate, investigate or play by the book — there’s no tactic you shouldn’t try when someone’s life is at stake. Time is working against you, but it’s no reason to despair.




The past casts long shadows. Your actions affect the state of the protagonist, who cannot forget people’s deaths or her own mistakes. See the consequences in her character, available dialogue options and ultimately the ending.

title: Monolith's Dreamers
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a mysterious world on a quest for a lost civilization. Solve puzzles and try to prevent disaster from unfolding.
Nyria, a young archaeologist and adventurer, is searching for a way to save her world from a dire fate.
To do so, she places her hopes in exploring the ruins of an ancient and mysterious civilization that vanished long ago.
In the Depths of the Ruins, she encounters mysterious entities and follows in the footsteps of explorers who came before her.
She gradually uncovers numerous Secrets of the Forgotten Past and comes to understand that these ruins are, in fact, connected to the very fabric of Space and Time.
As the only one capable of unraveling and solving the threads of destiny, Nyria unexpectedly finds herself carrying a burden far heavier than she ever imagined…
Navigate the traps protecting the ruins and help the inhabitants.

title: The Left Behind
description:
게임 정보
The Left Behind is a solo and co-op post-apocalyptic survival game. Explore a typical Dutch open-world landscape at daytime and beware of hordes of enemies coming in at night. Loot and hunt to survive. Each night, the game becomes increasingly challenging. Keep track of your highscore and try to survive as many nights as possible.
The world
Explore typical Dutch landscapes in a post apocalyptic setting. Every building you encounter can be entered and looted. Discover the personality of each building, the world and the people that used to live in it.
Objectives
Survive with up to four (4) people as long as you can in this harsh world. Survive together or take on each other to see who survives the longest? It’s up to you to decide! Loot abandoned buildings at daylight and try to survive enemies coming in at night. Keep an eye out for your food, thirst and health bar at all times. Stack up some food while you can, you never know when you need it…

title: BLOCKLORDS
description:
게임 정보
What is BLOCKLORDS?
BLOCKLORDS is a player-driven MMO medieval grand strategy game where your decisions and skills shape the world and narrative.
Choose from several playstyles, including farming, fighting, resource management, and ruling, and forge your own destiny as your Hero.
Experience the pinnacle of strategy gaming with BLOCKLORDS and let your legacy be written in the annals of its world. Join us, as this medieval saga beckons you to make your mark.

Heroes at Your Command:
From Farmers, Hunters, Warriors, Rulers and everything in between, every Hero possesses unique stats & traits essential for battles, management, and resource gathering. All new players start as a Farmer character!

The Art of Agriculture:
Farm resources and settle farms across an expansive world map, customizing them to your vision. In this ever-changing world, start a family and watch as your stats and traits evolve with each strategic decision, shaping the future of your lineage. As you navigate the challenges of pioneering life, embark on grand adventures, meeting personalities, confronting fearsome creatures, and unraveling enigmatic adventures. Deploy specialized squads for tasks such as resource gathering and enemy confrontations, furthering your legacy as a strategic leader.

The Thrill of Combat:

title: Liquor Love Lady
description:

할아버지의 유언으로 고향에 있는 작은 칵테일 바 ‘히아신스 바’를 물려받게 된 에블린. 하지만 칵테일 바에 대해 아무것도 모르는 그녀에게 가게 운영은 쉽지가 않다.
그때 그녀의 앞에 나타난 다섯 남자들!
그들의 도움으로 에블린은 점점 술에 큰 흥미를 느끼게 되며, 칵테일을 공부하고, 바 운영에도 능숙해진다. 그런데 이 남자들, 칵테일 메뉴 개발을 도와주는 것치고는 너무 선을 많이 넘어오는 것 같은데...?
매출을 올리기 위한 신메뉴 개발부터 생각지도 않았던 연애까지, 에블린 앞에 펼쳐지는 다사다난한 이야기!
---------

칵테일 대회에 나갈 때까지 가게를 운영하며 신메뉴를 개발하고, 호감도를 가장 많이 쌓은 남성과 칵테일 대회에 나가는 것을 목표로 하는 게임입니다.
바를 열어 칵테일을 제조하고 판매하는 미니게임을 통해 타이쿤 게임의 재미를 느낄 수 있습니다.
바를 운영하여 벌어 들인 돈으로 캐릭터 이벤트 시나리오를 구입하여 호감도를 올리거나, 칵테일 신메뉴를 개발할 수 있습니다. 또는 상점을 업그레이드를 하여 더 많은 재화를 벌어 들일 수도 있습니다.
최종적으로 제일 호감도가 높은 캐릭터와 칵테일 대회에 나갈 수 있습니다.

title: Lea
description:
게임 정보

In this game, you'll take on the role of Lea, an ace pilot who has gone rogue. You'll not only have to deal with the threats of war but also confront inner struggles. Embark on a journey through a series of islands filled with battles and discoveries. In a time of chaos, stand firm with those who have their own beliefs and stories, uncover the conspiracies behind the war, unravel the secrets of the Philosopher's Stone, and bring peace to as many people as possible.

Exciting Aerial Combat

The game boasts breathtaking visual effects, with every environment brimming with details and surprises.

title: Five Day Detective
description:

He hates crime. All Inspector Dermot Dervish likes less are early mornings, his boss, and any technology from the last thirty years. But he won’t need any of these. Armed with his trusty notebook, razor wit, and an assistant who’s trying to pretend she’s not a traffic warden, only Dermot can solve a series of shocking and intriguing murders, and bring the city’s criminal scum to justice.

Casual control scheme: Control Inspector Dermot Dervish with keyboard or controller.

Three substantial murder mysteries where the game’s humour belies dark psychology and motives.
Full game expected 2025.
Solve a range of puzzles including item based problems, computer based forensics, and the climactic denouement where you must unmask the killer.

title: Grim Potions

title: Age Of Blocks
description:
게임 정보
In Age of Blocks, gathering resources and mining blocks are at the heart of your kingdom’s survival and expansion. Send your workers to chop down towering trees for wood, harvest bushes and catch fish to keep your army fed, and mine precious gold to fund your growing empire. Every resource plays a vital role, fueling construction, recruitment, and technological advances. As you collect blocks from the voxel-based world, you'll unlock the power to shape the land itself—place blocks to build walls, raise towers, and design your perfect stronghold. Whether you're fortifying defenses or expanding your city, mastering resource collection and block placement is key to defending Azuria!
Building your civilization is a journey of strategy and creativity. With 13 unique types of buildings at your disposal—from humble houses and bustling farms to powerful barracks and advanced research centers—you'll shape a thriving kingdom tailored to your playstyle. As your city grows, unlock a wide range of technologies that boost your economy, strengthen your armies, and unlock new tactical possibilities. Advance through different ages of civilization to gain access to more powerful structures, elite units, and game-changing upgrades. Every decision you make brings you one step closer to turning your fledgling settlement into the most formidable empire in all of Azuria!
Leading your army into battle is where your strategy truly comes to life. Train and command a diverse roster of units such as fearless Footmen, swift Lancers, and devastating Warhounds on the front lines. Rain arrows from afar with Longbowmen and Crossbowmen, or unleash heavy siege power with Catapults, Rams, and the deadly Scorpio. Dominate the seas with powerful Galleons and Scorpio Ships, transport your troops across the map with Transport Ships. Monks can provide crucial support on the battlefield, turning the tide with healing. As you research new technologies, your units become stronger, faster, and deadlier, giving you the edge you need to crush your enemy.

title: Agent Simulator
description:
게임 정보



Agent Simulation is an action, simulation, and strategy game in which each player shows their targeting skills and agility against enemies in a virtual environment. At the end of each mission, you will collect medals and earn various certificates with these medals. At the end of the game, these certificates will prove your strength as an agent and help you to receive your agent license.
In each level of the ‘Agent Simulation’, you will be evaluated according to your targeting skills. Before the limited time provided ends, you must kill all your enemies. Every successful head shot will get you more points! Of course, if you say ‘I am not that good’ and use up your time, you need to start over. Sorry for that! Sometimes you will be asked to complete the missions in such a limited time, you have to be fast and agile! It is a great environment to test yourself, is it not? You can skip the levels that you could not complete and still advance in the game. But it does not sound that great, right? We are talking about being an agent in here.
There will be three options offered in each level and those options will constantly change! For example, double bullets, double damage, slowing time down, blocking bullets or extra life, etc. You can strategize using any of these options! If you would like, you can repeat any level to test and improve your skills.
When you complete all levels of a lesson, you will receive an overall score including all points and medals you earned in that lesson. If your overall score is not high enough to move on to the next lesson, we regret to inform you that you have to work harder and spend more time by repeating all low scored levels. Do not forget that it is not easy to train an agent!
Earning enough certificates will allow you to receive your agent license at the end. According to your license score, you can see where you are in the world ranking or within your friends.
Fight to be the best!

title: Bomberrage
description:
게임 정보

title: Delilah
description:
게임 정보
Delilah is an old-school FPS set in a world divided between Humanity and Hell. Its main goal is to capture the magical formula of the great classics.



Two characters with unique loadouts
Varied encounters, from tight horror experiences to slaughter maps
Seven episodes (planned), each with a distinct theme and story
Authentic 2.5D graphics in 256 colors, multi-directional monster sprites
MIDI tunes emulating sounds straight from the 90's
Custom game engine that supports 3d and dynamic level geometry



A century ago a great hero has saved our species by closing the gates of Hell, but the billions of demons already on Earth didn't just magically disappear. Instead, while Humanity was slowly reconquering the planet, several Arch Devils have adapted to the rules of our dimension. They formed their own twisted governments (known as Circles), to use their populations as human shields.

Our two protagonists were born into this century-long cold war: one is an enforcer of the Transylvanian Daemocratic Circle, the other is an Anointed defender of Humanity.
Borington is a one-person game development team from Transylvania. My previous games include 'BlackChain' and 'Rum & Gun', both available on Steam.

title: Morphing

title: That sausage museum game
description:
게임 정보

박물관에 맞서다

소시지가 되다
몰입감을 주도록 설계된 조작으로 진짜 소시지가 된 듯한 기분을 느낄 수 있습니다. 모든 굴림과 공중제비는 자연스러워 보입니다 - 비록 소시지는 그렇지 않지만. 아, 그리고 위험을 감수할 준비가 되어 있다면 던질 수도 있습니다.

예술은 도전이 될 수 있습니다.

title: Trapped In The Omniverse
description:
게임 정보
Trapped In The Omniverse: The Infinite Confluence is a challenging first-person survival game that combines interdimensional exploration with adventure and survival. You find yourself lost in the mysterious Antechambers of Quantum Dynamics, where reality blends and distorts. Your mission is to restore the Cosmoportal, the only means to return home, while facing creatures and overcoming obstacles in a chaotic environment. With exploration mechanics, strategic combat, and resource management, every step brings you closer to uncovering the secrets of the multiverses and finding your way back home. Can you restore balance and find the exit before it’s too late?



Quantum Dynamics was a pioneering company in quantum mechanics and its applications during its peak in the 70s and 80s. Their main focus was the unification of quantum physics with gravitational theory, and it is rumored they made significant advances in detecting multiverses and the possibility of traveling between them.

The most notable discovery attributed to Quantum Dynamics was the existence of a connection between the Multiverses through the so-called Antechambers, also known by various names according to documentation found in their old facilities. These antechambers, such as the Omniverse Chamber, the Cosmoportal Nexus, the Infinite Confluence, the Dimensional Nexus Hub, the Quantum Echo Chamber, or the Transdimensional Sanctum, allowed interaction between different universes.

Within these antechambers, it was found that the atmospheres of both Multiverses mixed, creating an environment conducive to the construction of habitable structures. The cross-contamination between parallel realities made these structures livable and allowed for simultaneous existence in both multiverses.



However, Quantum Dynamics began to face significant problems as the antechambers became increasingly contaminated. The company could not maintain control over the presence of specimens and elements from both Multiverses, leading to the gradual abandonment of the facilities.

Despite its disappearance and the loss of records about Quantum Dynamics' activities, the abandoned remains of the company and the documentation found within them remain silent witnesses to a fascinating period in multiverse exploration and attempts to overcome dimensional barriers.

After the fall of Quantum Dynamics, an independent team of daring researchers embarked on a mission to unravel the hidden mysteries behind the company and its legacy. Through meticulous research and exploration of abandoned facilities, they discovered a wealth of written and video material shedding light on Quantum Dynamics’ work.

Among the most surprising findings were numerous documents and records detailing the antechambers used by the company. These antechambers, commonly known by Roman numerals, were not limited to a few. Instead, it was discovered that Quantum Dynamics had managed to build and catalog dozens of interconnected antechambers, each with its own unique features and properties.



Each antechamber presented a specific configuration, with varying dimensions and distinctive characteristics. Some were expansive, covering vast stretches extending across thousands of square kilometers in both multiverses. Others were more compact, limited to a few hundred acres but with an incredible concentration of quantum energy.

The researchers discovered that these numbered antechambers were not only connection points between multiverses but also key nodes for understanding the structure and very nature of reality. Each antechamber seemed to contain fragments of information and knowledge that transcended the limits of any individual universe, revealing fascinating aspects of quantum physics and existence itself.

As they delved deeper into the recovered files, the research team also found mentions of an even more ambitious expansion project known as "Project Omega." This project, which remained unfinished after Quantum Dynamics' disappearance, aimed to create a definitive antechamber capable of connecting multiple multiverses simultaneously. Speculations and hypotheses about the implications and potential applications of such a project flooded the researchers' minds.



The writings and videos uncovered showed indications of the difficulties Quantum Dynamics faced in maintaining control over existing antechambers. The cross-contamination of multiverse atmospheres appeared to be a constant challenge, affecting the balance and habitability of the structures built within them.

The researchers realized that these findings could have significant implications for the future of interdimensional exploration. The possibility of accessing dozens of antechambers and the incomplete vision of Project Omega sparked new questions and possibilities about the nature of the multiverses and the potential for traveling through them.

As the research team delved into this wealth of information, they understood that their discovery had the potential to change humanity’s understanding of the universe and its place within it. The enigmas and secrets locked within the numbered antechambers offered a glimpse into the limits of reality, challenging conventional physics and opening doors to new horizons of exploration and discovery.

title: Dark Light
description:
게임 정보
Dark Light is a pixel art platformer adventure inspired by NES games of the 80s and 90s. You play as John, who is awakened from a peaceful sleep when a lightning strike shatters the silence of the night. As he looks out the window, he witnesses terrifying monsters emerging from the darkness. Armed with improvised tools and driven by curiosity, John embarks on a perilous journey to uncover the source of this strange anomaly and face the growing threats.
EXPLORE
Explore the island, battle enemies and bosses, and unlock new abilities as you guide John through a world filled with danger and mystery. Solve puzzles, defeat monstrous creatures, and uncover hidden secrets in a story-driven adventure that will challenge both your reflexes and your mind.
UNCOVER
What started as a simple investigation soon spirals into a fight for survival as John delves deeper into the island's mysteries. Along the way, he'll face monstrous foes, discover forgotten lore, and slowly piece together the puzzle of what caused this dark anomaly.

title: VOIDFACE
description:
게임 정보
Every enemy is a boss.
From ground-shaking robots to monsters and demons, each of them are uniquely brutal.
And so are you.
In VOIDFACE, you face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.
FEATURES
36 unique bosses, across 12 stages
Easy and hard mode
One hit, and you're dead (2 hp on Easy)
Various defensive and offensive spells
Stylized, smooth-rendered pixel graphics
Distinctive soundtrack for each stage

title: Moon Space
description:
게임 정보
In this thrilling 2D arcade game, you control a rocket that constantly moves forward. Your mission is to steer the rocket left and right to destroy meteors and dodge obstacles. Every meteor destroyed adds to your score, and combo multipliers give you a chance to rack up even more points! Be careful though—one collision and it's game over. Compete against yourself and others on the global leaderboard while facing unique challenges that push your skills to the limit. How high can you score?

title: Fishing Mega-Game
description:
게임 정보
At it's very core, Fishing Mega-Game is all about collecting fish. Each fish has a different arrangement of starting upgrades and attacks. The more fish you encounter the more you can experience. Who knows, you might get lucky and find an oddly colored "shiny" fish!
While fishing, send your bait into a fishing hole full of hungry fish looking to weaken you until you are fully consumed. Combat this with an arsenal resembling an aquatic "bullet heaven" type of game. Level up, or find rare upgrades to power through the hordes of small fry before you arrive at the main catch. Deal enough damage to it and add it to your collection!
This game takes inspiration from Vampire Survivors and Ridiculous Fishing!
Key Features
Creature Collecting
Roguelike style leveling
Meta-progression
and more!

title: Trash Teammates
description:
게임 정보
Team up with friends to stack trash, climb up, and avoid danger in this fun and hectic multiplayer party game!
Play as one of five different toys and climb as high as you can through the garbage chute! Stack a variety of trash and create your own road to freedom. But be careful! For many hazards await you in your quest for survival.
Don't touch the buzzsaw! It rips everything apart - trash, players and maybe even friendships...
Be wary of the crusher: it may not look as dangerous as the buzzsaw, but it packs a solid punch when it comes to flattening trash... and you.
In this test of teamwork, creativity and stamina... Will you become the MVP, or the trash teammate?

title: Nebula Strike
description:
게임 정보
Nebula Strike is a 3D space shooting game. You need to use the left joystick to control the character's movement, the right joystick to control the character's direction to the enemy, and use the configured weapons to defeat the enemy.
This game focuses on excitement.
Game Features
Fast-paced game experience
Various weapons to choose from
Various enemies and attack methods
Each enemy attack requires facing dozens of enemies, and find a way to defeat them all!

title: Flowering Void
description:
게임 정보
Flowering Void puts you in the perspective of a creature with no memory, but very human emotions. You have a goal, but don't know why. You exist in a dark realm, but don't know where. Over time, you'll learn more about the nature of your world and the impact you're having on it.
The Survival Sequence
In the primary gameplay area, you're challenged to protect a core from an army of hostile entities, allowing the core to gain as much energy as possible. This sequence has no set end point, so you're encouraged to improve your skills and toolset to perform as best as possible and earn better rewards and endings.
The Sanctuary
The second area is where you spend most of your down time. Here you can purchase new items, view your inventory, practice your movement, and even uncover secrets.

title: Irreversible
description:
게임 정보
The World
The year is 1989. Three decades have passed since the onset of "Global Isolation," triggered by an anomalous incident in the Mediterranean Sea. In this time, the world has transformed beyond recognition. All connections between continents have been severed, and shifting boundaries known as "running lines" gradually consume the land year after year. Nations grapple with profound social, ecological, migration, and food crises. To mitigate logistical challenges, a network of orbital stations has been constructed for intercontinental transport and storage of biome-specific resources.
Your Role
You are a junior technical specialist recently arrived at an orbital station. You possess no extraordinary skills—just an individual trying to escape debt, willing to take on any assigned task. However, due to an orbital accident, you find yourself stranded in an unknown desert.
The Power of Communication
Though you're isolated, you're not entirely alone. Your only lifeline is Anna, another survivor of the crash. Together, you must coordinate and solve the problems you face, relying solely on dialogue and shared decision-making. Your conversations with Anna form the backbone of your journey, and through these exchanges, you’ll gradually piece together what happened—and how to survive.
Face a World of Unpredictable Hazards
The desert is more than just an expanse of sand. This alien environment teems with strange anomalies—phenomena that defy the laws of physics and nature. These anomalies come in a variety of shapes, sizes, and behaviors, from gravitational distortions to space-bending effects. Each new discovery forces you to think on your feet, using your limited tools and resources to push forward and overcome the challenges in your path. Exploration is key, but it’s not without risk.
While the anomalies are dangerous, they aren’t the only threat. The desert is home to unique insectoid creatures that have adapted to the harsh climate. These creatures fiercely protect their territory, hunting for food and eliminating anything that threatens their survival—including you. Your actions must be careful and your behavior vigilant, especially at night and in shadowy areas, if you hope to stay alive.

title: Scourge of the Reptiles
description:
게임 정보
Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a low fantasy prehistoric world. When a devastating meteor strikes the Earth, humans, elves and dinosaurs alike are gifted with magical abilities.
As the hero is able to control and ride the giant beasts, they venture forth with a party to discover that the world is much bigger than they initially thought. There are those sitting on neighbouring thrones who wish to enact war, plotting to bring forth chaos and destruction.

title: Heroes of Magic and Steel
description:
게임 정보
                                                     독특한 팀을 구성하고 전략적인 덱을 구축하며, 이 도전적인 중세 판타지 로그라이크 게임에서 전술적 전투를 승리로 이끌어 보세요. 모든 결정이 중요합니다. 영웅을 선택하고, 지능적으로 배치하며, 전쟁의 기술을 마스터하여 점점 더 큰 도전을 극복하세요.                                          
                                                                               매번 새로운 경험! 독특한 능력을 가진 영웅들을 선택하고 조합하여 균형 잡힌 팀을 만듭니다. 완벽한 팀은 없으며, 계획적인 전략이 핵심입니다. 도전을 예측하고, 시너지를 만들며, 게임을 유리하게 이끌어 나가는 방법을 찾아보세요.

title: Titan Star
description:
게임 정보
Recently a large mysterious crystal comet entered the planet's atmosphere, then shattered into thousands of smaller shards that are scattered around the world. Turns out, these crystal shards hold significant power.  Now, large and powerful creatures, roam the world leaving destruction in their paths fighting to expand their territory. If left unchecked, these creatures will destroy everything.
An unlikely duo, magic and science, always had an intense rivalry for as long as anyone can remember. But those days are now behind us. You, along with both departments of magic and science will need to combine your strengths if you hope to have any chance of stop these creatures...
Fight alongside powerful turrets with the help of magic and other technology to bring down these giants!
Battle in an immersive atmospheric environment
Experience the destructive force of power-infused giants
Boss battle gameplay mixed with tower defense
Manage resources to request aid in battle

title: Tower Deckfense
description:
게임 정보
Tower Deckfense is a game that combines the genres of tower defense and deck building with roguelike elements. Choose your starting deck and begin your journey!
Overview
In each playthrough, you'll start with your initial cards and build on them as you progress. You can add cards, duplicate them, remove them, make them cheaper, or level them up...
When you reach a combat stage, you'll have to make the most of the cards you draw from your deck. You'll need to strategically use the terrain and modifiers you encounter to prevent any enemies from reaching your base.
Towers

title: Relentless Dark
description:
게임 정보
As the solo developer behind Relentless Dark, this project has been a labor of love, and I’m so excited to finally share my passion with the world. Your support and feedback mean EVERYTHING to me as I yearn to create the most intense and terrifying zombie horde experience imaginable. Whether you want to follow the development, contribute ideas, or simply be part of the community, I’d love for you to join me as I move forward, one small step at a time.
Relentless Dark is designed to be a pulse-pounding, 4-player cooperative zombie horde game, where teamwork and instinct are pushed to their absolute limits. With a haunting atmosphere, brutal combat, and an unforgiving AI, every moment will feel like a fight for survival. Can you and your friends endure the relentless onslaught, or will the darkness swallow you whole?
Oh also this is my first game, wish me luck!

title: Hydra Coil
description:
게임 정보
Hydra Coil is a Relaxed Turn-based Space Fantasy RPG where you explore a miniature cosmos, assemble a crew of Voyagers, and uncover the mysteries of the Hydra—an ancient force struggling to emerge from a dying universe.
Imagine Heroes of Might and Magic... set in space!

FEATURES
Turn-Based Space Exploration: Traverse miniature Solar Systems with your Spaceship; fly to new worlds, visit space stations, ghost ships, fantastic creatures, and countless other wonders floating in space. 
Orbital Mechanics: Fly around planets, visiting colonies, landmarks, and more points of interest to gather treasures and trigger story events.  
Tactical Spaceship Battles: Simple yet engaging 4v4 battles in space or in a planet's atmosphere.
Simple Colony Building: Construct and maintain colonies on key worlds, with many different colony types to accommodate unique alien races. Place new structures and upgrade existing ones to strengthen the colony and receive rewards.
Grow your Crew: Meet new Voyagers along the way and add them to your crew, each with unique abilities and skills to upgrade.
This game does not have:
Multiplayer
Playable Characters (Spaceships only)
Grand Strategy, this is not an RTS or 4x style game
Microtransactions

title: A Strange Mage's Rampage
description:
게임 정보
호드 서바이벌 아레나 + 덱 빌더, 이게 가능할까요? 저는 그렇게 생각하며, 이 게임이 이를 증명한다고 생각합니다.덱을 구성할 카드 풀을 커스터마이징하고 나보다 더 낯선 외계인 무리를 상대로 살아남으세요.
하나의 가능한 콤보는 다음과 같이 표시될 수 있습니다:
진행 상황
새로운 카드를 잠금 해제하여 나만의 런덱 꾸미기
새로운 캐릭터를 잠금 해제하여 다음 실행 시 최고의 빌드 방법을 대폭 변경하세요.
더 많은 에일리언, 더 많은 라운드, 더 많은 재미와 무작위성으로 더 높은 난이도를 잠금 해제하세요(더 큰 카드 풀).
실행 중
다음을 수행합니다.
15-120초의 짧고 액션이 가득한 파도를 즐기세요.
레벨을 올리고 무작위로 선택된 3가지 업그레이드 중에서 기본 캐릭터 능력치를 어디로 가져갈지 선택하세요.
라운드 사이에 상점에서 카드 구매
생존을 위한 투쟁의 시작
멈출 수 없는 존재가 되거나 죽음을 맞이하세요

다음을 수행합니다.

title: Tower Petroleum
description:
게임 정보
For those who want classical tower defense experience Tower Petroleum gives towers, tower upgrades, monsters, economical upgrades and strategic experience like you had before!
Tower Petroleum has a narrative element to it. Every choice you make, shaped by your own moral compass, forges a unique path, not only influencing the story but also defining your entire gameplay experience.
Features:
Unique levels with different strategic possibilities.
Deck-building team assembling mechanic
Different branches of towers upgrades: feed your enemies lead or disintegrate them with deadly plasma, use drones or fire: whatever fits your playstyle.

title: Paragone Bomb
description:
게임 정보
Paragone Bomb is a top-down shooter featuring a variety of enemies, weapons, and abilities for our main character.

A tactical game with a bird's-eye view.
Steam Workshop support for custom maps and community challenges.
Single-player mode: play with enhanced bots on all our maps.
Upgrade all weapons during gameplay.
Upgrade abilities and modules.
A store where you can purchase ammo, weapons, modules, medkits, and much more using resources collected during missions.

title: Calvar - The Darkest Gate
description:
게임 정보
Calvar - The Darkest Gate is a harrowing first-person horror survival game that drags players into a nightmarish and twisted realm. As Leonard Valentin, you are thrust into a malevolent world haunted by otherworldly entities and obscured by the shadows of a cursed piano and a maleficent cult.
Key Features:
Immersive Interaction System: Every choice you make weaves your path through the darkness. Traverse the haunted landscapes, manipulate cursed objects, and unearth the horrific secrets lurking in the gloom. This innovative interaction system ensures your actions cast long shadows over your journey, adding layers of depth and terror.
Dynamic Inventory System: Scavenge for items that are more than mere survival tools; they are keys to unraveling the arcane mysteries. Each artifact harbors tales of sorrow and horror, with hidden functions that could spell the difference between damnation and your fleeting survival.
Combat and Survival: Arm yourself with an arsenal to battle grotesque abominations from the abyss. Survival hinges on ruthless decision-making and judicious use of scarce resources. Fleeing may often be the only option as not all horrors can be slain.
Dialogue and Quest System: Engage in dialogue that weaves through the fabric of the narrative, impacting the story's trajectory toward multiple ghastly endings. Delve into sinister quests tied deeply with the overarching nightmare, shaping the fate of the haunted world around you. Each choice reshapes your harrowing tale, ensuring no two descents into madness are alike.
Atmospheric World: Venture through environments that breathe unease and fear. Dark corridors, whispering voids, and visuals that chill to the bone craft an atmosphere thick with dread. The game’s world is meticulously crafted to immerse you in a relentless state of terror, navigating through oppressive darkness and surreal horrors.
Complete Narrative Experience: Embark on a full narrative journey that stretches from a chilling prologue to a horrifying conclusion. Each chapter of the game is meticulously woven to deliver a cohesive and terrifying story-driven experience that ensnares you from the ominous start to the grim finale.

title: Deep Sea Arena
description:
게임 정보
Deep Sea Arena
Dive into Deep Sea Arena, an intense underwater arena shooter where deadly creatures emerge from the abyss. Battle relentless waves of deep-sea horrors, dodge ambushes, and fight to stay alive. How long can you survive the depths?

Fast-Paced Arena Shooter:
Ever-Descending Platform: Your battleground continuously sinks into the ocean depths, ramping up tension as you go.
Depth-Based Highscores: The deeper you manage to survive, the higher your score.
Escalating Difficulty: Face increasingly dangerous waves of enemies as pressure, darkness, and limited space intensify.
Constant Action: Quick reflexes and strategic movement are key—there’s no safe corner in this relentless descent.
Diverse Enemies: Encounter a variety of deep-sea creatures, each with unique attack patterns.
company: Marcel van Duijn, Jarno van Duijn

title: Finares
description:
게임 정보
Who are you?
You are Ares, a shepherd dog without a permanent home. Just as you were about to settle down, you return from a short trip to find yourself alone. All the humans have disappeared. When no one fills your food bowl anymore, you realize the situation is serious. Then, a strange female dog appears in your territory, and your adventure to find the humans begins. Find your way through the chaos of the world and lead your pack forward.
What can you expect on this journey?
Travel through multiple open worlds
Listen to local frequencies for signals from humans
Find diary entries, notes, laptops, smartphones, and anything that gives you clues about the last thoughts of humans
Meet other dogs along the way and exchange information with them
Use your nose to track scents and reach new places
Help pick locks and restore the power
Play tag and hide-and-seek
Take care of your pack
Always have your trailer with you
Search for supplies and shelters for the night
Solve puzzles to get information
Friendship
Painted graphics

Find Us Cats is a new hidden object game starring our favorite feline friends! Find dozens of cats in each level and aim for a high score in Level 1 of our free demo, the Planetarium.

title: Necropolis Nights
description:
게임 정보
"Necropolis Nights" is a thrilling survival card game set on a dynamic board where every decision counts. By day, gather resources, craft tools, hunt animals, fish, and farm crops to stockpile supplies. But beware: when night falls, the undead rise. Defend yourself from zombies and survive the darkness. Strategize your actions, adapt to changing circumstances, and manage your resources wisely to endure the endless nights and build a haven in a world overrun by the undead.
Each new day introduces a fresh set of cards, replacing those from the previous day. To survive, you'll need to carefully choose your strategy and prioritize what you collect. As resources change daily, you must decide what to gather whether it’s food, tools, or other resources to adapt to the evolving challenges. Every decision counts, as you’ll need to balance immediate survival needs with long term goals. Collect the right cards and manage your resources wisely to outlast the dangers of the night.
Key Features:
Dynamic Day-Night Cycle: The gameplay shifts dramatically between gathering and preparing during the day and collect valuable items without falling prey to zombies at night.
Evolving Challenges: Each day resets the available resources, presenting a new puzzle to solve. Will you focus on farming for food, scavenging for weapons, or crafting defenses to hold off the undead?
Unique Card Mechanics: Cards represent your resources, tools, and actions. With limited slots and changing availability, you’ll need to carefully plan your deck to maximize efficiency and survivability.
Crafting and Resource Management: Combine collected materials to create powerful tools, weapons, and fortifications. Each crafted item can be the difference between survival and being overwhelmed.
Survival Meets Strategy: Balance your short-term survival needs with long-term goals. Plan for the future while managing the present—every choice counts.
Replayability: A dynamic board and procedurally generated cards ensure a fresh experience every time you play, with unpredictable challenges and events to overcome.
Zombie Variety: Face different types of undead, each with unique behaviors and abilities, forcing you to adapt your tactics as the game progresses.
The Ultimate Survival Experience

title: Inventris TD
description:
게임 정보
Inventris TD is a roguelike lite tower defense shooter where the combat happens inside your inventories.
Features:
Acquire cats by hatching eggs.
map tiles are Inventory tiles where you can deploy cats as towers and enemy route blocks
Inventory Tetris centric design
