Turn-based tower defense where each enemy turn starts with your shot

title: Lost Ground
description:
게임 정보
어느 마법사의 실수로 악마들이 지상에 강림한 이후, 인류는 패배를 거듭하여 마지막 요새까지 후퇴했습니다. 하지만 아직 모든 것이 끝난 게 아닙니다. 영웅들은 성검의 인도 아래 최후의 반격을 준비하고 있습니다. 원정대를 지휘하여 악마들에게 잃어버린 땅을 되찾으십시오. 이제 인류의 희망은 당신의 어깨에 달려있습니다.

3x3 그리드에서 펼쳐지는 턴제 전투

■ 다수의 영웅을 3x3 그리드에 배치하여 적을 물리치세요. 영웅과 적은 다양한 공격 범위를 갖고 있습니다. 효과적인 배치로 아군의 피해를 최소화하고 수많은 적을 일망타진하세요.

■ 영웅들은 불, 물, 바람 등의 속성을 가지고, 개성적인 특징을 가진 카드를 통해 전투를 수행합니다. 속성으로 보스의 약점을 타격하고, 극적인 시너지를 일으켜보세요.

■ 모험에서 획득하는 유물은 게임의 판도를 가를 수 있는 강력한 특수 효과를 제공합니다. 카드와 유물의 조합으로 자신만의 콤보를 완성하세요. 어떤 것을 획득할지는 회차마다 달라집니다!


■ 로스트 그라운드의 세계는 외길이 아닙니다. 탐험은 전진, 후진, 우회 모두 가능합니다. 육각형 타일로 이루어진 세계를 자유롭게 탐험하며 저주받은 땅의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

■ 유적, 광산, 캠프, 상점, 몬스터, 보물상자... 안개로 가려진 땅 너머에는 다양한 기회와 위험이 있습니다. 안전한 방법으로 착실하게 강해질지, 위험을 무릅쓰고 큰 보상을 노릴지, 선택은 당신의 몫입니다.

■ 퀘스트를 수행하고 보상으로 받은 특성 포인트로 영구히 성장하세요. 단순한 파밍 퀘스트부터 도전 과제에 가까운 기묘한 퀘스트까지 다양하게 준비되어 있습니다.

■ 묘하게 움푹 파인 지형이 있나요? 파헤치세요. 몬스터가 길을 막고 있나요? 때려눕히고 파헤치세요. 수상한 지역을 파헤치다보면 생각치도 못한 만남이 있을지도 모릅니다.


■ 몬스터를 찾아 처치하고 경험치를 획득하여 영웅을 레벨업 시키세요. 상위 카드를 획득하려면 충분한 레벨업이 필요합니다.

■ 모험에서 장비를 획득하고 영웅에게 장착시키세요. 머리, 몸통, 손, 발 등... 각각의 부위마다 다른 스탯이 부여되고 장비마다 다른 고유 효과가 발휘됩니다.

■ 장비, 특성 등의 일부 보상은 회차를 거듭해도 소멸하지 않고 이월됩니다. 영구히 성장하면서 강력한 적에게 도전해 보세요.

title: The Genetic Dilemma
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 두 인물의 시선을 통해 이 세계를 경험하게 됩니다. 대중교통이 무료로 제공되는 시대, 그러나 그 속에서 살아가는 사람들의 일상은 결코 단순하지 않습니다.
남자의 이야기
반복되는 일상에 지친 그는 가벼운 용돈벌이를 위해 설문 조사에 참여하기로 합니다. 지루한 하루를 보내던 중, 우연히 오래된 친구와 재회하게 됩니다. 친구의 집에 초대받아 방문한 그곳에서, 그는 친구의 여자친구와 마주하게 되는데… 단순한 만남이 예상치 못한 방향으로 흘러가며, 그의 삶은 돌이킬 수 없는 변화를 맞이합니다.
여자의 이야기
자율주행 자동차의 자동 브레이크 시스템을 연구하는 그녀는 최첨단 기술의 중심에서 일하고 있습니다. 그러나 어느 날, 뜻하지 않은 사고로 인해 생사의 기로에 서게 됩니다. 그리고 그녀에게 제안된 것은 기존의 장기 이식과는 차원이 다른 ‘혁신적인 수술’— 오직 뇌만을 새로운 몸으로 옮기는 이식 수술이었습니다.
눈을 떴을 때, 그녀는 완전히 새로운 세상 속에 있었습니다. 하지만 그녀를 기다리는 운명은 과연 축복일까요, 아니면 새로운 딜레마의 시작일까요?
대중교통이 무료로 제공되는 세계. 하지만 이 편리함의 대가는 결코 가볍지 않습니다— 단순히 이동하는 것조차 끝없는 광고를 견뎌야 하는 시대입니다.

title: Mazer Laser
description:
게임 정보
빠르고 도전적인 아케이드 게임
피하고, 텔레포트하며 앞으로 나아가세요. 이 아케이드 게임에서 다양한 미로를 광속으로 움직이며 자신에게 도전하세요. 정밀함과 속도가 당신의 가장 좋은 동맹이 될 것입니다.
악마 같은 난이도

title: Xalos: Collectible Card Game
description:
게임 정보
Players take command of aliens, robots and humans using their unique playstyles to destroy the opponent's energy core. Discover synergy between the cards to craft your combos. Players will face off against the enemy AI in singleplayer or other players in multiplayer mode.
Mechanics
There are 3 main races.
Aliens: Balanced offense and defense, excelling in neither. Effects allow for a board control based approach.
Robots: Typically boast higher defense. Effects have a focus on destruction and sustainability.
Humans: Higher attack power but low defense. Their effects boost each other, call for reinforcements and can equip weapons to become even stronger.

title: Marble Havoc
description:
게임 정보
Marble Havoc is a 3D-action game. Take your marble in different levels to the goal.

You start with your marble on a way in a waterland. Navigate your marble over the way without falling into the water.



Jump over obstacles and ditches. Find the flag. Your mission is to navigate your marble to the flag and hit the flag pole. Then you mastered the level.

You are not alone! In the waterland there are other marbles on their way:

title: Social Warfare
description:
게임 정보
Be a troll-for-hire on social media! 
You have been mandated to serve in the Social Warfare Battalion. Endorsing multiple identities, you will shape public opinion through comments on social media. You will promote loyalty in the Great Kingdom of Eternia while disrupting society in its arch-enemy, the Federation of the Free.
Each mission is a news item where, using a terminal that enables you to take multiple online identities, you select comments/replies that fit your objectives. A mood meter gives you real-time feedback on the public’s reaction: you win when it goes totally to the right side, and lose when it goes totally to the wrong side.
The game will then switch sides and put you in the Federation of the Free's Social Intelligence Task Force, where you will fight against what you were promoting. Through a list of news items that covers a range of political and social matters, you will alternately promote two opposing viewpoints.

Social Media is your weapon, public opinion your battelfield!

title: Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics is a turn-based strategic tennis game. Zero in on your opponent’s pattern of play to predict their shots and gain the upper hand. Line up the perfect shot and simulate the outcome before committing to your next play. Sometimes the court is wide open, and sometimes you have to aim for the lines.
Create Your Own Playstyle:
Fine tune your strategy with custom playstyles that make it easy to construct points just the way you want.

title: Digital Legacy of Zero
description:
게임 정보
Explore a Digital World where you can collect and train creatures to build your ultimate team. Defend your upgradeable basement from waves of enemy attacks and strategically manage your resources to achieve evolutions. Travel through time to uncover the secret to prevent the impending Armageddon.
Improve Your Team
Manage resources to unlock new evolutions for your creatures, perform special summoning rituals and create your strongest team.
Collect Creatures
Defeat wild enemies to get their eggs that hatch into allies! Each creature brings unique abilities to your team, adding new evolution lines and endless possibilities. Build your dream squad and defeat evil bosses in the Digital World!

title: Tank vs Orcs
description:
게임 정보
Tank vs Orcs is an action packed twin stick shooter in development where you get to live out the ultimate power fantasy; being a fricken' tank and battling endless hordes or orcs.
You'll have quite the arsenal of weapons at your disposal including chain gun, plasma rifle, chainsaw, rockets, cannons, and much more. Tank vs Orcs will also feature boss battles and some lite rogue like mechanics as well. A playable demo for PC and Mac is coming soon!

title: Ghost Golfing
description:
게임 정보
Explore the graveyards of GHOST GOLFING!
⛳At the start of each level, the hole is there, lonely, on the other side of the field, and you have a series of pieces that form the path to it. There are windmills, pumpkins, gravestones, mirrors, and even portals! Your challenge? Build the perfect path to guide the ball! And believe me, it won't be easy. One misplaced piece, and the ball could end up rolling off the field or flying straight into the lake!

title: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
description:
게임 정보
First-person interactive psychological horror narrative game. Immerse yourself in this one-of-a-kind horror where your real phone connects to the game! Travel into Cara’s memories searching for her missing sister. Uncover dark family secrets, exorcize demons, and solve puzzles in a world of witchcraft. Cara’s phone and yours will unlock unspeakable horrors!
Real-Phone Mechanics In this groundbreaking horror experience, you guide Cara using your real-life phone. As her phone connects to yours, you’ll uncover hidden clues, exorcise demons, and receive chilling warnings. Augmented reality reveals secrets unseen in the game alone. Help Cara solve puzzles, fend off dark threats, and discover terrifying family truths. The best part? While this unique connection enhances your experience, it’s not required, the game can still be fully enjoyed and completed without using your phone. Will you dive deeper into the nightmare?

title: Stellar Raven
description:
게임 정보
The near future. The Great Arion Empire, led by the wise and just Empress Rovena, protects peace and order on Earth and hundreds of other planets. But one of the commanders of the elite Space Marine squad, known for his unpredictability and propensity for violence, disobeyed orders, defied the Empire and went over to the rebels. That commander is you. Now, as a rebel, you find yourself in a deadly game against the full might of the Empire, and your chances of survival are close to zero.
Stellar Raven is a single-player first-person shooter in the tank simulator genre. The game is a futuristic action experience where you control a high-tech flying tank and engage in intense battles against enemy forces on different planets.
Gameplay:
You control the flying tank from a first-person perspective, battling enemies on various planets.
The main objective is to destroy all enemy forces on each level and ultimately defeat the final boss, Empress Rovena.
You will need to travel through and conquer several distinct planets, each with its own unique challenges, enemies, and environmental hazards, making every level a different tactical experience.

title: Future Weapon 2D
description:
게임 정보

우주의 구원자 또는 재앙이 되십시오. 해적 쓰레기를 무찌르고 Javelin Pirates가 모은 소수의 침략군을 막아내십시오.

살아남으려면 연방의 침입 방지 체크리스트를 따르십시오.

친구를 사귀세요
총 좀 잡아
우주선을 잡아
총 업그레이드
우주선 업그레이드
업그레이드 업그레이드
식민지 개척자 모집
어떠한 자비도 보여주지 마라

title: Grandpa's Bee Haven
description:
게임 정보
Grandpa’s Bee Haven is an engaging idle-beekeeping simulator designed to sit at the bottom of your screen while you multitask. Your mission? Help Grandpa grow his beekeeping business into a real beekeeping haven. Work together with Grandpa’s helpers to produce unique bee resources and craft amazing bee products!
Set Up Your Apiary
Strategically place beehives in ideal locations and populate them with different bee species. Ensure your bees thrive by adding nearby watering stations, honey extractors for harvesting, and solar wax melters for collecting beeswax. Once you’ve planned the layout, Grandpa and his helpers will get to work building and assembling everything.
Produce and Upgrade
Unlock hive upgrades to generate valuable resources like honey, pollen, beeswax, propolis, and royal jelly. Use these resources to invest in further upgrades or craft unique products.
Craft Unique Products
Transform the fruits of your bees’ labor into delightful and useful items. Make beeswax candles, propolis medicine for example to enhance your income and diversify your offerings.
Hire Helpers
Expand the bee haven team with charming helpers! Recruit Grandma, a Scientist, a Shaman, or even a loyal Dog or Cat. Helpers have different capabilities: Grandma boosts production alongside with Grandpa, while the Scientist unlocks advanced upgrades.
Design Your Bee Paradise
Create a stunning bee-garden that reflects your style. Be a perfectionist or get really creative with flowers, lush bushes, and beautiful trees.

title: The Lizard Problem
description:
게임 정보
Have you had enough of building impenetrable defenses and then having to wait at 2x speed until the waves provides a challenge big enough? Then look no further.



The Lizard Problem is a dynamic tower defense with a focus on making every wave a new challenge that has to be reacted to. Mother nature herself will rip your defenses apart with earthquakes that shatter your formations and the level in the beginning of each wave, providing new paths for the lizards to then take and try and steal your eggs. You will have to adapt to the ever changing landscape by moving your towers and replacing those who got destroyed in battle.

You may be just a magpie bird, but you are not defenseless. Apart from bribing the animals of the world to help you (building towers), you can yourself engage in the battle. Smack them with your wings, just like your mom said. Speaking of your mom, she will guide you through the life of a soon to be parent, giving you tips on how to deal with The Lizard Problem.

The natural breaks between waves give you a good time to think about what to do next, but if you already got a plan, the game makes sure you can execute it as fast as possible. There are intuitive hot keys for every interaction, letting you place and move turrets in a fraction of a second, even mid round. The flight mechanic makes sure you can reach all ends of the map quickly, which is especially useful for quickly killing of a stray lizard that escaped with the close range melee combat.

Many more features are to be announced as development continues!

title: Wish Of Hers
description:
게임 정보
개요
Wish of Hers는 주인공의 꿈속 세계에서 벌어지며, 현실이 한 걸음 한 걸음마다 휘어지고 변화합니다. 이러한 초현실적인 풍경을 탐험하면서 누군가가 당신의 꿈을 조작하고, 더 깊은 목적을 향해 인도하고 있음을 알게 됩니다. 전투를 통해 진실에 한 발짝 더 다가가고, 꿈속에 숨어 있는 궁극의 적에 맞서기 위해 힘과 능력을 모읍니다.
능력
파워 카드를 구매하여 독특하고 강력한 능력을 획득하세요. 이 능력들은 전투 전략을 강화하도록 설계되었으며, 파괴적인 공격부터 방어적인 동작까지 다양합니다. 능력들은 창의적인 방식으로 결합하여 꿈속에서 변화하는 도전에 적응할 수 있습니다.

업그레이드
현실 조형기를 사용하여 능력을 업그레이드하고 더욱 강력하게 진화시키세요. 업그레이드할 때마다 능력은 새로운 효과와 강화된 힘을 얻게 되며, 꿈의 신비를 깊이 탐구하기 위한 우위를 제공합니다.

title: Quantum Loop
description:
게임 정보
Zoom and dodge your way about space, exploring the quadrant and solving intertwining objectives however you can. Hit an asteroid and the mission resets - but whatever you learn you can exploit in the next loop! Use your crafty wits and precise piloting in chorus to prevent the asteroid crisis!
Quantum Loop is a short non-linear space exploration game where you play as a galactic agent sent on a mission across time to solve an existential threat to the universe: the Asteroid Crisis.
Every life matters! - Your mission takes place within a time loop!
If you hit an asteroid, it's game over. But your knowledge stays with you! Exploit what you can learn about the world to reach success!

title: Mirror Soul!
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a mesmerizing journey in Mirror Soul, a unique puzzle platformer where you control two characters bound by an unbreakable mirrored connection. Explore intricately designed levels that challenge your wits and reflexes, utilizing the power of symmetry to overcome obstacles and solve mind-bending puzzles.
In Mirror Soul, you take control of two characters simultaneously, each moving in perfect mirrored harmony. Every step, jump, and action you perform is mirrored across an axis, demanding precise coordination and strategy to navigate the dual worlds. Guide your characters through beautifully crafted environments filled with traps, platforms, and puzzles that require synchronized movements and creative thinking.
Key Features:
Symmetrical Control: Master the art of controlling two characters at once, with every move mirrored along an axis. Perfect your timing and coordination to progress through challenging levels.
Intricate Puzzles: Solve a variety of puzzles that test your logic and spatial awareness. Use the unique mechanics of mirrored movement to unlock new areas and secrets.
Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in a visually captivating world, with each level featuring detailed, hand-crafted environments that enhance the dual-world concept.
Engaging Storyline: Unravel the mystery behind the connection between the two characters. Discover their story through captivating narrative elements woven into the gameplay.
Dynamic Soundtrack: Enjoy an atmospheric and dynamic soundtrack that adapts to the gameplay, enhancing the immersive experience of Mirror Soul.

title: Abyss Lord
description:
게임 정보
천천히 하지만 확실히 죽어가는 세상. 신들의 탐욕이 그 존재 자체를 위협하는 세상. 필멸자들이 다른 사람들의 야망에 희생된 세상.
라오타르 아즈 디르나트가 사는 세상. 네 명의 매력적인 자매를 둔 백작 가문의 일원인 그는 귀족의 삶을 즐기고, 여성들 사이에서 성공하며 많은 친구를 가지고 있습니다. 그리고 그 자신도 모르는 비밀이 있습니다.
이 청년의 미래에 무엇이 기다리고 있을까요? 사랑하는 사람들 옆에서 길고 행복한 삶? 불명예로운 죽음으로 이어지는 상실과 고통? 인류의 적의 왕좌? 수호자의 칭호? 예쁜 고블린에서 우아한 뱀파이어에 이르기까지 온갖 종족의 하렘? 죽을 때까지 유일한 사랑?
이 모든 것은 그의 비밀에 달려 있습니다. 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
Abyss Lord는 많은 사람들이 게임에서 부족한 것을 주기 위해 고안된 소설입니다. 다양성. 아니요, 여러 옵션 중에서 표준적인 선택에 대해 말하는 것이 아닙니다. 우리는 미래에 대한 지식과 그것을 바꿀 수 있는 능력에 대해 이야기하고 있습니다.
이제부터 저장 및 로딩은 단순한 게임 규칙이 아닙니다. 이는 역사에 직접적인 영향을 미치는 개인의 능력입니다. 바람직하지 않은 결과를 받은 경우, 처음에는 불가능했더라도 과거로 돌아가 피할 수 있습니다.
예상치 못한 부상으로부터 동료를 구하십시오. 아무도 대비하지 못한 위험에 대해 미리 경고하십시오. 다른 사람이 저지른 실수를 바로잡으십시오. 결국 재부팅 후에도 다음에 무슨 일이 일어날지 기억할 것입니다. 라오타르, 그의 사랑하는 사람, 그리고 전 세계의 운명은 여러분의 손에 달려 있습니다.
하지만 잊지 마십시오. 여러분이 할 수 있는 일은 다른 사람도 할 수 있습니다. 그러한 힘이 여러분에게 있다고 해서 안심하지 마십시오.

title: Hedgehog's Dilemma
description:
게임 정보
...and as a result, there are two states at the same time - symmetric and antisymmetric. The particles become entangled.

Now their fate is linked. Even if both particles are in different parts of the galaxy, by measuring the state of one of them, we will instantly affect the other.

Sometimes a person meets a person - and by the will of the Universe, quantum states, or the irresistible current of existence, their lives become connected. The meeting of Marharyta and Mykhailo was definitely a game of fate; they were two scientists with a clear view of the world, and combined as much as they differed from each other. But is it enough?

- Build relationships between Marharyta and Mykhailo, two university professors with their own baggage
- Navigate choices that define potential ending
- Read story from both perspectives and collect information on what's actually happened in their past and in their future
- Define for yourself the cost of connection and fate

The game consists of two hours of content, two different storylines, lot's of dating scenes, and lots of philosophical dialogue.

title: You're a dad
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a text adventure about becoming a father! Get up, take care of your child, buy groceries, prepare dinner. Do nothing else. Repeat every day, because...
... You're a dad!
This is your child. It is your job to make sure he thrives, or at least survives. You can go skating, imaginary monster hunting, or just sleep the day away. The game reacts to your actions, so it really is possible. But should you?
(No, you shouldn't. Make good choices, okay?)
Navigate through all the endings!
Your family is coming for dinner. So not only do you have to be a dad - you also need to make food. You can make food. It's not that hard. Don't get lost in day dreams, going camping or starting a cat café. If your child starts reading philosophy, nip that in the bud before they get a PHD.

title: Duck Norris Tales
description:
게임 정보


Duck Norris Tales is pixel run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the arcade games from the '90s.
STORY
Step into the feathers of a brave duck on a mission of revenge after aliens destroy his favorite ice cream shop! Join him on an epic journey through the depths of the Earth as he uncovers secrets, battles monsters, and rallies the Gods to aid in his quest. Can he save humanity along the way?
THE BATTLE
The Gods are divided and at war, and it's up to you to restore peace and earn their respect. Each time you challenge a God, you have the chance to gain their blessing and grow stronger! Learn new abilities and make new allies to unlock powerful super moves as you strive to bring balance.

Uncover secrets about the world and unlock devastating super attacks as you cleanse the land.

title: Guns of Gaia
description:
게임 정보
당신의 행성을 되찾으세요!
《Guns of Gaia》는 서바이버 요소와 기지 건설 요소가 결합된 싱글 플레이어 자동 슈팅 게임입니다. 생명공학을 활용하여 지형을 변화시키고 방어 시설을 구축하며 함정을 설치하고 유인물을 배치하세요. 생명체를 키우고 장비 및 무기를 해제하세요. 지속적으로 변화하는 도전에 적응하며 적을 물리치고 당신의 행성을 탈환하세요!
지형 변형
사람들은 과거의 행성 지형을 25가지 다른 유형으로 분류했습니다. 일반적인 지형은 금, 나무, 물, 불, 흙 요소의 영향을 받아 다양한 지형으로 변할 수 있습니다. 정밀한 지형 조작을 통해 평범한 땅을 방어탑, 함정, 유인물 등 전술 자원으로 변환하여 전투에서 우위를 점할 수 있습니다. 각 지형은 독특한 시각적 및 전략적 특성을 가지며, 그로 인해 생성되는 무기와 장비도 유일무이합니다. 플레이어는 무기, 캐릭터, 건물 선택을 현명하게 진행하여 최적의 방어 및 공격 조건을 만들어야 합니다.
생명체 육성
게임에서는 다양한 지형에서 여러 생명체를 육성할 수 있습니다. 각 생명체는 전투에서 다양한 기능을 제공하며, 그들의 신체 구조는 희귀한 총기 및 도구 제작과 해제에 사용될 수 있습니다. 생명체 육성 및 연구를 통해 플레이어는 자신의 무기고 및 장비 창고를 지속적으로 확장하고 최적화하여 전투 능력을 크게 향상시킬 수 있습니다.
초기 예약 체험판에 포함된 내용:
3개의 캐릭터
13가지 지형
21가지 무기
100가지 도구
7가지 적

완성된 버전에는 더 많은 내용과 기능이 포함될 예정이며, 이는 예약 체험 기간 동안 받은 피드백에 기반하여 결정됩니다. 기대해 주세요!

title: Forest Time
description:
게임 정보
Play the role of a spirit who guides the forest dwellers and guests through their day, helping them meet their goals in this peaceful, family-friendly turn-based puzzle.
Be one with the invisible yet ever-present soul of the forest that helps everyone to find their path. Feel free to practice your planning skills and think several steps ahead to create a perfect route for every character. Or just try different ways and see which one works. The game doesn’t punish you and encourages the retry by allowing you to undo each action while solving the puzzle.
Carefully crafted world
Enjoy the peaceful setting with simple, non-stressful tasks. Participate in festivities and occasionally find some secrets hidden in the woods. Almost every level introduces a new character or concept—no one knows what awaits you after the next turn.
Variety of Characters
There are many characters in the game, and each one is unique in something, just as we are. Different classes of characters offer different mechanics. Different characters within one class vary in a subtle way. Explore their traits and quirks in different settings and find a perfect path for each and every one of them.
Many levels to solve
There are many tasks to solve, from collecting fruits and berries and chatting with friends to trick-or-treating or playing with spirits during seasonal festive events. Complete them all in the order you choose. All puzzles are grouped into four seasons of the year, and it’s up to you which season to explore first.
Development plans
The game is currently in development, and the plans are to release it for desktop platforms by the end of 2025. Please wishlist and follow us. Your support is much appreciated!

title: Dragons Invade Scotland
description:
게임 정보
Match-3 meets Tower Defense! Your matches become towers. Defend each real castle in Scotland! Learn about real Scottish castles/stories/legends while playing. The game takes place on full map of Scotland made of 5 million tiles, where each tile is 19.5 square meters of the real world.

From the creator of Tower Swap. This game isn't released yet, so here's some reviews of Tower Swap:

"It's a perfect blend between the match-3, merge, and tower defense genre, so if you like any of those genres and you want to venture forth with a twist this is a perfect game with a great gameplay loop and great mechanics. It's super addicting... I enjoyed my time with Tower Swap so much that I lost track of time and got a super long gameplay recording." - MintCity Review

"This is a hidden gem and belongs in the best-of list of indie match 3 mobile games alongside Triple Town, 10000000, and Puzzle Craft." - Loren Hernandez

"Never have I ever played a game for such a long time continuously as this game. It's so simple and sooo good. 10/10 would recommend everyone ever. My grandma would love this game and my grandchildren would someday still love this game. ok I'm done. But seriously, play it."

"One of the most well-designed games I've ever played! Game is easy for beginners to play but it takes quite a bit of skill to attain higher levels, as success requires using both match-3 and tower defense strategies."

100s of castles are planned with real folklore from each:

Did you know that there was a castle ruled by a Viking princess, and it was on an island, and she put up a chain reaching to the mainland to stop ships?

Did you know that there was a castle that was said to have been built by a wizard using an army of goblins?

Did you know that there's a fairy flag that still exists today in Dunvegan castle, and it is said that it can only be used 3 times, and it has already been used twice in medieval times to summon fairies to their defense?

All of these and hundreds more are planned to be added to the game.



Note that the game is priced low because it contains IAPs. If you don't want to pay you can play for free on the web but with banner ads, coming soon. You are essentially paying to remove the banner ads, and to be able to load up the game without internet, and to make sure your progress doesn't get cleared from your browser's storage. The Steam version doesn't have any banner ads. There will also be mobile versions with the same structure.

title: Tears Apart
description:
게임 정보
Tears Apart는 순수한 고속 액션입니다. 대천사 Raggon이 되어 어둠을 뚫고 은하계에 빛을 가져오는 임무를 수행하세요. 당신은 우주를 가득 메운 그림자 속을 돌진하며 적을 베고 정복할 것입니다.
승리를 향한 돌진
모든 공격은 적과 장애물을 가르는 번개처럼 빠른 돌진입니다. 이 게임은 속도와 정확성에 달려 있습니다. 한 번의 실수로 어둠이 당신을 삼킬 수 있습니다.
별자리 창조
숨겨진 별을 발견하고, 당신이 정화하는 은하계마다 더 강해지는 별자리를 해제하세요. 각 별자리는 새로운 힘과 무한한 플레이 방법을 제공합니다.
에픽 보스 전투
당신의 기술을 그 어느 때보다도 시험할 거대한 심연의 보스들과 대결하세요. 이 전투들은 강렬하고 빠르며, 무자비하게 진행됩니다—바로 당신이 원하는 방식대로.
은하계에 질서를 가져오세요
혼돈의 심장부로 뛰어들어, 모든 돌진으로 어둠을 부수고 별을 다시 밝혀 우주의 질서를 회복하세요. 각 승리는 단순한 승리가 아닌 새로운 별의 탄생, 광대한 우주에서 희망의 등대이며, 영원한 영혼의 안식처입니다.
출시 시 특징:
돌진 기반 전투: 모든 공격이 적을 가르는 고속 액션을 경험하세요.
역동적인 우주: 숨겨진 별과 도전, 적들로 가득한 독특한 은하계를 탐험하고 정복하세요.
별자리 시너지: 무한한 전략적 가능성을 제공하는 강력한 별자리를 해제하고 결합하세요.
에픽 보스 전투: 거대한 보스들과 강렬하고 빠른 속도의 전투에서 맞서 싸우세요.
스타더스트 업그레이드: 스타더스트를 모아 다음 은하계를 위한 영구적인 업그레이드에 투자하세요.
몰입감 있는 분위기: 시작부터 끝까지 우주의 모든 구석에 도달하려는 캐릭터로 플레이하세요. 그녀의 우주 규모의 여정에 뛰어들어 다른 원초적 존재들과 만나보세요.

어둠을 찢고 은하계를 균형 잡을 준비를 하세요. 지금 위시리스트에 추가하고, 우주를 차지할 준비를 하세요!

title: Project Chameleon
description:
게임 정보
Project Chameleon은 적에게 들키지 않기 위해 물체로 변신해야 하는 잠입 게임입니다. 전 세계를 무대로 임무를 수행하는 엘리트 스파이 Siren이 되어 플레이하세요. 환경을 조작하고 함정을 설치하며 각 미션에서 강력한 장치를 사용하세요.







강력한 슈트를 사용하여 다양한 물체로 변신하십시오. 슈트는 사용 후 충전이 필요하므로 변신할 물체를 신중하게 선택하세요!





일부 물체는 환경을 조작하는 데 사용할 수 있는 고유한 기능을 가지고 있습니다. 복잡한 해킹 시스템을 사용하고, 소리를 내는 물체로 경비를 유인하는 등 추가적인 능력을 사용하여 더 복잡한 도전에 도전하십시오!





각 시나리오에서 고급 장치와 다양한 아이템을 찾아 Siren의 임무를 돕는 데 사용하십시오!

title: Zalis: A romantic adventure
description:
게임 정보
Danylo works diligently in an alchemical workshop he's been entrusted with. It is the first time he's in charge, and he does not want to let the locals down. But the vital component of potions is mana, and the only mine where locals could get mana crystals has been closed. Attacks on cargo and reports of missing people have become more frequent as well. How is the sweet and kind stranger who recently arrived in the village involved in this?

Features:

Nameble hero and love interest.

Play as a male or female.

Manage a shop, create potions, and raise your stats.

Engage in a fantasy story in the Ukrainian setting.

Potentially more characters in DLC.

title: The Victor Initiative
description:
게임 정보
Overview
The Victor Initiative is a first-person survival horror game in which you explore the halls of an abandoned government facility in order to discover its secrets while evading the strange entities lurking within. The game is divided into separate floors, which all present unique challenges. These floors make up larger 'chapters', which present widely different threats for you to outsmart. The demo includes the first chapter of the game.
Gameplay
In The Victor Initiative, you have no health bar, nothing telling you what to do and one main goal: surviving. From a first person perspective, make your way through the winding halls of The Initiative in a bid to survive to the next room. Each room will present a new threat, or a new puzzle that you need to solve in order to keep pushing through. With no tools, no knowledge, and just your environment & the occasional patchy audio log for clues, will you be able to survive?
The Mission
It's your job to explore an abandoned government facility that lost contact with the rest of the world 60 years ago. What horrors will you discover within?

title: Snakes with Fists!
description:
게임 정보
The RPG with a Beat 'em Up Battle System
Snakes with Fists! combines the open-world exploration elements of an RPG—interesting NPCs, side quests, secrets, and a strong narrative—with the fun of fighting in the beat 'em up style! Open areas are explored in a top down 2d RPG world, Beat 'em UP stages are entered and cleared to unlock new areas and to complete quests. 
Also, you can fight anyone!
Yes, you can... but should you?
Instead of 'random encounters' you will enter into a Beat 'em Up style fight scene with anyone you punch in the RPG world.

title: Acroama: Company of Strays
description:
게임 정보
Ever want to be a superstar? Got big dreams, but no talent? Instead of chasing those dreams, live vicariously through wannabe punk-rocker Ash Blaze as he ditches his monotonous desk job and pursues a life of excitement and adventure, and probably more than a few mornings waking up on the roof of the local pub in nothing but his underwear and his left boot.
Enter an epic head-to-head tournament with worldwide reach, where music is your weapon and fame is your destiny! Face off against all sorts, from established K-pop idol groups and rock-gods to the local cult choir and that one guy who keeps insisting that the keytar will make a comeback.
 Turn-Based Strategic Combat for Dummies
Use your skill and wits to outperform your enemies - chain together attacks, buffs, and bend the soundscape to your will by planning multiple rounds in advance and having it all play out exactly as you wish in a flood of eardrum shattering beats and pyrotechnics mayhem that would definitely violate workplace health and safety standards.
Forget those boring old heath bars – they’re so 2010s – control the momentum and dominate the stage through the “state-of-the-art” and totally original Tug-of-War combat system; Drown out the tunes from those lame-wads across the stage from you and get them booed off stage to advance to the next stage of the tournament.  
 A World of Musical Misfits
Every Paul needs his Ringo, every Bob their Marley – Ash can’t win it all by himself, he’ll need a band! Build your flock as you navigate through a city full of musicians who all think they’re way cooler than they actually are. Each new member brings their own deck of tricks to the table, expanding your options on the battle stage.
Talk to people around the stadium to learn about the world, themselves, and even hints to finding collectibles! Choose dialogue options that present you as the next coming of the King of Rock or embrace your inner chaos goblin – whichever speaks to your heart more! There are no wrong answers, so feel free to flip flop around Ash’s personality so much that his band mates start to consider calling a doctor.
 Orchestrate Your Strategy

title: The Hundredth Hike
description:
게임 정보
The Hundredth Hike
The Hundredth Hike is an Indie Psychological Horror game, living the story of you, as a mountain hiker, reliving your tragic past and finding the calm of the nature under your boots. Unaware of what lies before you, you unleash a powerful and mysterious truth.
Rich Story
The Hundredth Hike is a story rich in lore, that is set in the middle of a devastating apocalypse. Napazarim has taken over the minds of 90% of the population causing hallucinations in the infected people in which became an international pandemic. You are one of the lucky few who survived and after losing your family, over the years you went on hikes all over the world to escape real life. This is YOUR Hundredth Hike how will it be different?
Losing your Mind
Along your Hundredth Hike you question your reality on this enormous hike along a mountain that has been restricted for over a decade. Sneaking into a quarantined country, you delve deep into your own mind and lose touch of reality. Will you bring yourself back from the fold?
Mechanics
Run, Hide and solve deep puzzles to escape your faith. With inventory management for your light sources and many interactive objects you will always feel on edge. With barely any HUD and following the protagonists story you will always be immersed in The Hundredth Hike. There are many mechanics of the game I don't want to give away as more and more mechanics are introduced over the course of the game.
Graphics
With the power of UE5, I have been able as a solo developer to get realistic and eye watering graphics with each chapter giving a different feel. From the amazing weather effects to the fully manually placed assets across all of the chapters, you will get an experience which is hard to forget.

title: Woke Quest
description:
게임 정보
Woke Quest is a satirical turn-based role-playing game that humorously critiques real-life events, personalities, and RPG conventions.
Four unsuspecting individuals from diverse backgrounds are drawn together by a mysterious force that transcends the boundaries of their reality. Suddenly, a surge of energy engulfs them, transporting them from their computer screens into a realm unlike anything they’ve ever imagined.
Emerging from a cosmic rift, they find themselves in a vibrant world brimming with magic, mythical creatures, and breathtaking landscapes straight out of an RPG. It quickly becomes clear that they are far from home.
Unbeknownst to them, their arrival marks the beginning of an epic saga that will shape the destiny of this enchanted realm and challenge their very understanding of reality.

title: Bluebie VS The Army of Cyborgs
description:
게임 정보
Bluebie VS the Army of Cyborgs is a Cartoony 3D platformer that will take you to the fictive world of planet Rebaga. The planet look pretty much like earth and the culture there is pretty similar to ours. One day, Cybex, a self made Cyborg, decided to invade the planet and turn its inhabitants into his servants.
Of course, Bluebie, a farmer, is not willing to see his planet enslaved by the army of Cybex and decided to fight back and free the prisoners Cybex took.
In his quest, Bluebie will travel through mines,  mountains, desert and different other places where the cyborgs settled and launched their operation. He will fight the generals of Dr Cybex to free as much prisoners as he can while developing and purchasing new skills thanks to his colorful closet plenty of different outfits.
Fight Enemies
A stick, a spear, a boomerang, a slingshot, a crossbow and a pigeon launcher. Which weapon to use to fight your enemies. Every weapon will have its own range and damage level. One is sometimes enough, two or more could be a necessity.
autokwd: Bluebie VS The Army of Cyborgs

title: Tinymon RPG
description:
게임 정보
Wake up in an unfamiliar world full of monsters to catch and battle. 
Tinymon RPG is a new take on the classic monster-taming genre, featuring simple but charming graphics, familiar but fresh battles, and a new world to explore to collect both the Tinymon inhabitants and language learning cards that have been lost.
Where have you awoken? Travel through the land of Tinymon, battling your way to the top on a journey full of questions you hope to answer. Learn a new language through the flashcard system, the professor's cards have been lost and scattered around the island. Even though you are a new (and confused) resident, it's up to you to find them. Find out where and how you arrived to this new world through a story with unexpected twists.
*Language learning aspects are toggleable and therefore completely optional
Tinymon RPG features in-world, turn based battles. Run into a challenger, and battle right in the environment you found them in. Simple, but refreshing. Customize what parts of the HUD are in English and Japanese, whether you want to play in full English and ignore all language learning features, or mix it up and have a little of both. It's up to you to choose the experience that fits you best.
Language learning? Tinymon RPG features both English and Japanese simultaneously. All dialogue and text within the game can be customized to your liking. Tinymon RPG is a dual language game if you want it to be, showing every bit of text in the game in 2 languages at once. With the collectible flashcard system, you will learn new words and phrases on your journey through this Isekai inspired world.

title: Anime Scary Teacher 3D
description:
게임 정보
A day at school has never been this thrilling! Izumi Sensei, your ruthless teacher with a dark side, has been terrorizing the students for far too long. It’s time to teach her a lesson she’ll never forget—by pranking her at every turn!
Will you outsmart Izumi Sensei, or will her sharp instincts catch you in the act? Your mission: cause as much chaos as possible, and maybe even make her regret all those cruel punishments. After all, revenge is sweet!
Features:
Dive into a hilarious 3D anime world full of tricky pranks and surprises!
Outsmart and prank the terrifying Izumi Sensei, but beware—she's always watching!
Explore different parts of the school and unlock hidden areas for the perfect prank.
Customize your character with fun anime-style accessories.
Laugh, plot, and prank your way through this wild adventure as you teach Izumi Sensei that payback can be fun!

title: World Below
description:
게임 정보
Enter the mix between Roguelike and Autobattler games you never knew you wanted! Create unique teams and explore countless synergies and posibilities; finding rule-changing Relics, powerful items and unlock new Units to aid you, as you delve deeper into the World Below.
OBTAIN POWERFUL RELICS
Reveal how far you can take your mastery of the game by creating never-before-seen strategies. Break the rules by collecting an unlimited number of Relics, claiming them from enemies, chests, or the remains of the titanic Bosses.

title: Keep Chopping!
description:
게임 정보
Compete for forest supremacy in Keep Chopping! In this fast-paced local multiplayer game, players plant trees to gain control of the screen while sabotaging their rivals. Gather Acorns by chopping trees, then decide whether to plant new ones or spend them on bonuses to defend your forest or attack your opponents.
Golden Acorns add another layer of depth, offering upgrades that can completely change how you play. Stack upgrades for wild combos and experience the chaos as the match escalates.
Designed for short, high-energy matches, Keep Chopping! is perfect for quick gaming sessions during coffee breaks or downtime.
Competitive Gameplay: Plant trees to gain points and sabotage your rivals to keep your lead.
Resource Management: Choose between expanding your forest or using bonuses for offense and defense.
Golden Acorns: Unlock upgrades that shape your strategy and stack for chaotic effects.
Quick and Accessible: Short matches make it easy to jump in and play anytime.

title: The Adventures of Tango Rio
description:
게임 정보
A hand-drawn point-and-click adventure awaits! 
Meet Tango Rio, a cynical and disillusioned postman who embarks on a quest to find his father who vanished two years ago. 
The only clue? The name of a mysterious Polynesian archipelago, coupled with a strong feeling that his disappearance is not like the others. 
Join Tango on an adventure brimming with ancestral rituals, legends, wild dances, and mysterious Vatican prophecies.

title: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion
description:
게임 정보
Story:
Enter The Void
On the search for his missing wife and daughter, paranormal investigator, Jonathan Hunter, finds himself trapped in a strange new world. Faced with the ruins of a dying kingdom and searching for answers, Hunter must enlist the help of an amnesiac spirit named Angel and the kingdom’s last remaining denizen: A lonely shopkeeper named Craven. Armed with his wits, a weapon, and newfound mystical powers, Hunter must dive into a plot of revenge, redemption, and insanity on his search for the truth. Together, he and his allies’ will face demons inner and outer to find Hunter’s family and save the kingdom from destruction. No matter the cost…
autokwd: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion

title: Nocturnal Visitors: Book One
description:
게임 정보
One ordinary November night, a sixteen-year-old boy called Jamie witnesses a paranormal event in his own house. Shortly afterwards, he is transported to Aliorbis, a mysterious alternate version of Earth where magic and science coexist in almost perfect harmony. It’s the place where all the legends that he knows of were born.
There, Jamie learns that he is what is known as a “Visitor”, someone who can cross the barrier that separates his world and Aliorbis. He quickly becomes part of SEEK, an organization that investigates crimes that pose a threat to both worlds. Through his adventures with SEEK, Jamie slowly becomes acquainted with its dark and twisted past filled with corruption and chaos, and gradually begins to wonder if he is truly on the right side of this story.
Experience a plot that mixes elements of fantasy and thriller, play as different characters with unique storylines and points of views and investigate multiple scenarios filled with clues and details in this adventure game  inspired by videogames of the 2000s.

title: Planeturem
description:
게임 정보
Explore a procedurally generated planet filled with resources to harvest - with a variety of biomes and creatures to discover. Encounter structures containing potentially rare items, from materials to craft new items, to a brand new piece of armour, or maybe even something to lure evil towards you?
Build your base to protect yourself and fight off calamitous beasts - if successful, you may have the ingredients to construct a new weapon!

title: Hardcore Circus
description:
게임 정보
Hardcore Circus는 『슈퍼 미트 보이』, 『점프 킹』, 『겟 오버 잇』에서 영감을 받은 고난도 정밀 플랫폼 게임입니다. 플레이어는 숙련된 곡예사 Dik가 되어 악마의 손에서 형제를 구출하는 모험을 떠납니다。
게임 특징：

경고하겠네, 이방인들, 논리와 자네와 동료 간의 협력은 공기만큼이나 필수적이라네. 이 도전은 둘이 함께해야 하는 것, 마치 포도주와 잔, 빵과 수프처럼 말일세. 각 문턱을 잘 살펴보고, 발을 어디에 두는지 조심하게. 잘못된 발걸음은 값싼 술만큼이나 위험하니까.

title: Simulario
description:
게임 정보
The game features experimental 2D simulated physics based gameplay. The main feature of the game is that every pixel, every object, every particle in the game is a simulated physical entity.

This means, that the game is fair, it doesn't create invisible walls, doesn't impose unpredictable or illogical rules, doesn't script the way objects interact. What you see gives you complete idea what to expect. If you see a wall and want to go through, just shoot it and go.

Everything in the game is destructible. Everything acts accordingly to laws of physics, so if you want to do something, and your real world intuition makes you expect things to act in a certain way, chances are the game objects you interact with will work as you expect.

Therefore, the way you plan to win the level is up to you. You can explore possibilities, be creative, and you ideas will work if physics allow it. You can add matter, build shapes, create mechanical tools to reach the destination, you can destroy things. You can use forces, momentum or inertia. You can use ropes, wheels, jet engines, and so on.

Purely physically based gameplay is not very popular due to high performance requirements of physics simulation. But two years of prototyping and plenty of computer science allowed me to solve all problems and remove all technical obstacles, and now we have a robust physics engine, that works very fast, and allows to build massive sophisticated and fun to play with physical worlds.

The game will consists of many very different levels. You will drive a dirt bike, drive tanks and heavy multi purpose machines, fly in air, serf in water, dive underwater, fly in space, float in zero gravity or fight massive gravity, dig underground, build mechanical machines, attach jet engines and launch rockets, use ropes and forces, use heavy explosives and laser weapons. Simulated physics allow planty of ways to have fun.

But one of the most prominent features will be to control a soft body based character, that has evolved to walk and fight. That's a never before experienced level of realism and immersion.

The game is currently on early stage of implementing gameplay mechincs. The game will not be released in any kind of early access until it is finished and polished. But there will be multiple demos published, that would allow you to enjoy some of the physics based gameplay.

The game will include competitive levels with Steam based leaderboards, as well as casual levels. All levels will be highly replayable due to the fact, that it's hard to win one way, the physical world is chaotic in a certain way, and your actions will turn the world in different configurtations every time, opening new possibilities to beat levels.

The game will also have a tool for the players to create and publish user generated content.
