게임 정보
"Beneath The Surface"는 심리적 긴장감, 몰입감 있는 탐험, 강렬한 전투, 그리고 등골이 오싹해지는 만남을 결합한 무서운 1인칭 생존 호러 경험입니다. 불길한 숲의 깊은 곳으로 들어가 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내고, 지하의 지옥 같은 세계에서 생존을 위해 싸우세요.
빛이 희망을 드러내고 어둠이 말로 표현할 수 없는 공포를 숨기는 세계로 들어가세요. 탐험, 퍼즐, 그리고 슈팅 메커니즘을 갖춘 "Beneath The Surface"는 당신의 용기와 이성을 한계까지 시험할 것입니다. 당신은 탈출할 수 있을까요, 아니면 악몽에 사로잡힐까요?탐색을 시작하세요! 어둡고 선형적인 공포 경험을 기대하세요. 게임 플레이는 30~40분 동안 긴장감을 선사합니다.

title: Orkendale: The Scarred Land
description:
게임 정보
Orkendale: The Scarred Land is an open-world role-playing game in which the fate of an entire continent is in your hands. Whether the orcs will be able to take over the continent or humanity will defeat them will depend only on your decisions. And if the humans retain power, which faction will rule? Only you are free to decide who to support in this war...

In Orkendale: The Scarred Land you will find a large open world filled with exciting quests, various enemies and dangers. Explore the surroundings and travel through the locations to see how different factions of people live.

There are 3 different factions of people waiting for you in the game:
Free City - its residents prefer not to take an active part in the general unrest, but this time even they won't be able to stay on the sidelines;
Imperial City - people in it believe that only by uniting the mainland into one kingdom you can get power and global weight in the world. And for the sake of this they are ready to seize all the territories to engage in their subsequent development;
Miner's Town - was formerly part of the Imperial City, but it has defended its independence for 100 years, and it looks like it will soon have to do it again.

There are many mysteries hidden on the island of Orkendale. You can solve them or leave them untouched.
In addition, Orkendale is inhabited by various creatures, but it is dominated by two main species: humans and orcs. The Orcs were defeated many years ago, so since then they are no longer considered an equal race and a threat to humans. They have a small territory where the ruins of an ancient tower still remain. A tower that could become their weapon in the struggle for power over the mainland.
Explore World with Full Freedom

You can explore everything you see, in whatever order you want.




At the center of the story is an experienced traveler Jack, who is equally well-trained in both close combat and long-range warfare. He has been tasked with ferrying the magic stones needed to recover a magical artifact. During the voyage, however, the ship was attacked by a sorcerer, resulting in the ship being sunk and the stones stolen. Jack was miraculously saved - he was thrown ashore alive. Now he has to return the stones, and at the same time take part in deciding the fate of the continent on which he found himself...


:

title: Gobocore: Goblin Rescue Squad Autobattler
description:
게임 정보
Turn-Based Auto-Battler about rescuing your kidnapped tribe members by growing your small tribe of goblins.
TURN BASED BATTLE 
Your Goblins will take turns automatically and figure out their own opponents.
The turns can be set to proceed automatically or with a pause on world turn.
Gather equipment, choose the best upgrades, and lead your goblins on a chase to track down the kidnappers of their tribe members through a procedurally generated run. Your goal is to help them survive and carve out a cozy little place for themselves in this fantasy world.
EQUIPMENT
You start the game with a weak little goblin, whom you will equip with dingy gear.
Over time, by evolving your dungeon core and overcoming battles, you will gather life essence from other creatures. You can spend it on upgrades and gear.
Buy gear in home camp. And equip it to units.
The gear you equip and the mutations your goblins gain sometimes contain skill cards that they can manifest. You will be able to use these skill cards to help them achieve victory by playing them on friendly or enemy units.

title: Exodos
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a world of revenge to assume your role as the true king in an adventure full of dark creatures into the heart of hell.

In this epic journey of light against darkness you live in the shoes of the warrior Vergil who seeks revenge against the last skull king.

Be strong and courageous during your journey facing Zombies, wizards, ghosts and many other creatures with your powerful sword!

Avoid traps, destroy enemies with your powerful sword, quickly jump over platforms avoiding falling over the cliff like in classic action and adventure games from the 90s. Experience that nostalgia with Exodos!

Features:
33 levels divided into 7 acts.
Exciting action gameplay - use physical combos
Different obstacles and enemies.
Free imprisoned souls to paradise.
Beautiful animated graphics
2D action platformer

title: The Lab Thing
description:
게임 정보
WARNING: This video game may trigger seizures for some audience with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.



The Lab Thing is a first-person survival horror game.

Explore a mysterious secret lab as the only body survived. Gather all the scientist's notes about the monster, upgrade backpack items, record information and try to escape before you join the body collection of the lab thing!

the game is set in a secret underground lab that is haunted by a monster that likes to collect human bodies. You will explore an atmospheric underground abandoned lab, wander through tight corridors, check out every dead room, and get lost in the endless presence of afterlife.

This lab is cursed with its past. The secret project that turned against its creators. The symbol of human failure walks right behind you and not only protects his murderous victory but listens to potentials for future. As a player, you will relive parts of this dark past, find the memory of its nature and explore the need to survive.

in this game you are a normal defenseless human being; no weapons could save you from the monster finding you from the next corner, behind the door, hidden in the closet or inside a body bag. You’ll be able to pick up key elements, interact with the environment, and search for door keys that may help you escape this nightmare reservoir of human failure.

title: Bite Size Terrors: eye candy
description:
게임 정보
Bite Size Terrors:
Are Short Experimental Horror Experiences each with their own Unique Genres and Styles.
From the Creator of Notebook Entries, this is...
eye candy:
SHORT. Less than an Hour.
A Suspenseful Horror that displays Color Theory in a Stylized Motion.
Discover who you play as time progresses, finding out there's more to what meets the eye.
Black & White Manga Style.
Sound Design is meticulously built and well known in this series.
Story:
Playing as Frank, you install security cams as your day job. One day you get a call that freezes you to your core.
Time Stops.
You Know This Address.
You Know What Happened.
You Know What Needs To Be Done.
Gameplay:
A Horror Experience.
You Work Your Job. You Walk. You Drive. You Install Cameras.
Simple Mechanics with an emphasis on Story Building, Sound Design, Music, Mood Changes & Delivering Experimental Horror Like Movies..

title: Barber Party
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the World of Barber Party
Step into the bustling chaos of Barber Party, a cooperative game for up to 4 players where the thrill of running a hair salon meets the excitement of a party game. With quirky characters, zany challenges, and endless fun, this is no ordinary day at the salon! Whether you're playing offline with friends on the couch or teaming up online, the fun never stops.

Crazy, Cozy, and Full of Chaos
Get ready for a unique blend of cozy vibes and high-octane action as you take on the role of a barber in a world full of surprises. Your salon is full of demanding clients, and it’s up to you and your friends to keep them looking sharp while navigating the hectic pace of the game.

Success in Barber Party relies on your ability to work together. Collaborate with up to 3 other players to style, cut, wash, and dry hair with maximum efficiency. The faster you work, the happier your clients will be. But watch out – things can get wild, and you'll need to strategize to keep up with the rush! Complete challenges to unlock a host of new characters and color variations. Style your team with unique looks and show off your flair as you climb the ranks to become the ultimate barber crew.

Race against the clock in this fast-paced, arcade-style game. Each round challenges you to manage your tools and customers under intense time limits. Can you handle the pressure and keep the salon running smoothly? Master a variety of fun and easy-to-learn Quick-Time Events (QTE) as you style your clients' hair to perfection. Whether it’s a snip here or a blow-dry there, every action counts in delivering top-notch service.
In the world of Barber Party, there’s no time for safety rules – just throw those scissors! It’s faster and way more fun. Are you ready to join the madness and prove your skills in the most stylish party game ever?

title: Pumpkin Woods
description:
게임 정보
Pumpkin Woods is a single player witch-themed open world survival craft.
Collect magical ingredients and build your cozy witch home while exploring the wonderful sights and secrets of these mysterious lands. Beware though, danger might be lurking deep in these woods...
Custom outfits for your witch
Craft tools to gather magical resources
Manage your health, happiness, hunger and thirst
Adopt a companion cat
Furnish your secluded witch cabin

title: Beaming Stingray
description:
게임 정보

비밍 스팅레이는 시간과 노화에 대한 친근하고 유동적인 슈팅 게임입니다. 소라야의 삶은 무모한 복수 행위로 인해 위태로워졌습니다. 그녀는 남은 시간 동안 평화를 찾을 수 있을까요?
당신 자신과 함께 싸우세요.
녹색 시간 총알을 흡수해서 소라야의 타임스톤을 채우고 자신의 과거 버전과 함께 싸우세요. 실드로 무장한 적을 함께 공략해서 약점을 노출시키거나 타임 고스트와 함께 어우러져서 선형 시간에서는 불가능한 콤보를 달성하세요. 앞을 내다보는 전략으로 다수의 고스트를 쌓아 진정으로 아찔한 액션을 펼칠 수 있습니다. 타임스톤의 가능성을 이용하는 것이 성공과 생존의 열쇠입니다.

두뇌를 자극하는 액션
복잡한 퍼즐 같은 보스를 상대하고 같은 색깔/심볼의 적 세 대를 연결해서 점수를 증폭시키는 콤보를 달성하세요. 레벨 내내 콤보를 유지하려면 다수의 플레이 세션, 신중한 전략, 다수의 고스트 협동이 필요합니다.

쏟아지는 총알 사이를 질주하고 백 블래스트를 쓰면서, 물밀듯이 몰려오는 탱크와 전쟁 무기를 물리치세요. 당신이 비행하는 작은 데이티는 창의력을 발휘할 수 있게 도와주는 독특한 이동 방식과 적에게 대미지를 입히는 속사포로 무장하고 있습니다. 직사 거리에서 사격하면 두 배의 대미지를 입히고 백 블래스트로 콤보를 끝내면 콤보+를 달성하여 추가 포인트와 타임스톤 부스트를 얻게 됩니다.

라에샤 혁명군(RRA)이 지상에 서식하는 신화 동물을 마구잡이로 포획했습니다. 신화 동물을 풀어줄 방법을 찾으면 그들도 은혜를 갚을지도 모릅니다. 모든 동물을 구하면 소라야의 머릿속에 잠들어 있는 비밀 레벨과 미니게임이 잠금 해제됩니다...

title: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
description:
게임 정보


Zeta Wolf Chronicles is a dating sim with a hyperrealistic focus, that hones in and examines the struggles of adolescent dating. Experience the journey of Rayen as he navigates his senior year in high school. Learn about the nuances of love and its many intricacies along the way.



Dispirited by his lack of progress, Rayen initially seeks out extravagant means to reach his end. One day, he is approached by a mysterious visitor, who quickly alters his fate. Suddenly, he must choose to befriend one of four girls in his rehabilitation process! Meanwhile, he continues his agenda to pursue Siona, his fateful crush. In this tale inspired by real-life events, Rayen is forced to change his life, and commit time and energy toward what his heart desires the most. Will desperation win out, or will knowledge, patience, and logic pave the way to success?
4 Romancable Girls with a Fifth Wheel

title: Grimwalker
description:
게임 정보
슈팅 게임 "Grimwalker"에서 지옥의 군대와 대치하십시오. 다양한 무기로 짜릿한 전투를 벌이고 악마의 형상을 사용하여 더욱 강력해지십시오. 생존을 위해 자원을 관리하면서 비밀로 가득한 세계를 탐험하십시오.



클래식한 소총과 권총부터 근접 무기까지 다양한 무기의 아르설을 사용하세요. 적들과의 전투에서 승리하기 위해서는 적마의 생물들과의 싸움에서 적절한 장비 선택이 핵심입니다.



이것은 단순한 슈팅 게임뿐만 아니라, 탐험할 수 있는 수수께끼와 미스터리로 가득한 세계입니다. 장비를 관리하고 생존 기회를 제공하는 자원을 찾으세요.



자신의 악마의 형태로 변신하여 적들에게 혼란을 일으키세요. 모두는 한계를 가지고 있습니다... 악마로서, 당신은 그 한계를 무시할 수 있습니다.



잊혀진 마을을 점령한 악마들의 군대에 맞서 싸우고, 악마들의 미스터리를 풀어내기 위해 일어나세요.

title: Endless Anime Golf
description:
게임 정보
프로시저럴 제너레이션
프로시저럴 제너레이션은 비디오 게임 내에서 역동적이고 독특한 경험을 만드는 데 사용됩니다. 이를 사용하면 코스가 항상 달라져 플레이어가 플레이할 때마다 새로운 경험을 할 수 있습니다. 이를 통해 정적인 콘텐츠로는 달성하기 어려운 수준의 흥미와 재플레이 가능성을 게임에 추가할 수 있습니다.
최대 파 8
파는 플레이어가 한 홀을 완료하는 데 필요한 스트로크 수에 대한 표준을 설정합니다. 최대 8개의 파를 선택할 수 있기 때문에 플레이어는 성공하기 위해 자신의 기술을 연마하고 기술을 완성해야 합니다.
즐겨 찾기 저장하기
즐겨 찾는 홀을 저장하면 나중에 쉽게 액세스할 수 있습니다. 특정 코스나 홀을 다시 플레이하여 스코어를 올리거나 경치를 즐기고 싶을 때 특히 유용합니다. 즐겨 찾는 홀을 기억 속에서 사라지게 하지 말고 저장 시스템을 사용해 나중에 다시 즐길 수 있도록 가까이에 두세요.

title: Subway Nomads
description:
게임 정보
Descend into the dark depths of a desolate subway system in Subway Nomads, a first-person survival game where you control your own destiny. Find yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where every journey through the underground tunnels is fraught with danger and secrets. Will you escape this shadowy maze, or make it your new home?
 Survive the Metro: Navigate the ruined subway system, where each station could present new threats or opportunities. Zombies roam abandoned stations, ready to attack anyone who enters their domain.
Build and Fortify Your Metro: Your subway train isn’t just a vehicle; it’s your mobile base. Reinforce your metro, decorate it, and equip it with storage and crafting stations to enhance your chances of survival. Additionally, plant your own food to keep yourself alive.
Explore Freely: Whether you’re scavenging through metro lines for supplies or attempting to escape to the surface, the choice is yours. Follow the story to find a way out or stay underground for the ultimate survival challenge.
First-Person Survival: Experience the intense thrill of survival from a first-person perspective. Gather resources, find weapons and tools, and strategize to overcome the dangers lurking in the metro.
Open World Gameplay: There’s no set path to success. Choose your own route, make your own decisions, and determine how you want to survive in this underground world.

title: Bite Size Terrors: Reverse Blue
description:
게임 정보
Bite Size Terrors:
Are Short Experimental Horror Experiences each with their own Unique Genres and Styles.
From the Creator of Notebook Entries, this is...
Reverse Blue:
An Atmospheric Mystery.
Use your Pod to fly around & Investigate the events surrounding your fellow Air Mates.
Fear Open Space, the only thing between you & the ground, is a Bright Blue Sky.
Story:
As an engineer, your objective is to make sure your fellow air companions are doing okay mentally & that their Ethers are operational.
Ethers are used to survey Weather Disturbances & Conduct Research.
Today, as you float across the sky, an Ether is unusually floating below the clouds.
HQ encourages you to investigate the matter, as you do, you slowly realize,
This Bright Blue Sky... Is Hiding Something.
Gameplay:
Control a Pod in an open blue sky. Clouds cover your view at a distance, while you try to find each Ether to uncover the truth.
Look through logs, investigate each Ether & the outside air around you.

title: Bite Size Terrors: Speechless
description:
게임 정보
Bite Size Terrors:
Are Short Experimental Horror Experiences each with their own Unique Genres and Styles.
From the Creator of Notebook Entries, this is...
Speechless:
A Story Focusing on Show not Tell.
No dialogue. No Voices. Discover the story as you play and explore.
Enrich yourself in a colorful, yet destroyed world.
Soundtrack gets added depth/Sounds with each achievement in-game.
Use limited bullets & your instincts to survive.
Story:
There is another world that connects with ours, the biggest difference is.... It doesn't hide it's monsters,
Not knowing how long you've waited, Today is the day.
Prepared, you venture into the other world, confronting the creatures that await you.
As you get deeper & deeper, you start to understand that sometimes...we don't hide our monsters either.
We embrace them.
Gameplay:
A Survival Horror focusing on limited bullets, guns & ways to defend yourself.
Find your way around this world, finding New Objectives, Key Items & Weapons.
Minimalistic gameplay with an emphasis on atmosphere when arriving in a new environment.

title: Uciana
description:
게임 정보
Build a Spacefaring Empire in this 4X turn-based strategy game.

Explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate in Uciana, a turn-based strategy game set in a procedurally generated galaxy. Each playthrough brings fresh challenges with new star systems, events, alien races, and the unknown waiting to be discovered.

Strategically manage your empire's resources to thrive. Balance research, farming, and production to grow your systems while adapting to the ever-changing galaxy. Will you fortify your systems with defenses, or expand aggressively by building fleets to conquer and protect your growing empire?

Engage in tactical, turn-based ship-to-ship combat. Customize each ship with weapons, defenses, and components tailored to your strategy. Victory depends on careful planning and adapting to your role as leader.

Features:
Procedurally generated galaxy maps and systems for unique experience each time.
Ship customization.
Tactical turn-based combat.
Steam Cloud Saves for seamless play across devices.

title: EggRoyale
description:
게임 정보
Birds gather for a heartwarming battle over a giant egg!
Various types of birds engage in real-time combat, waging an intense struggle to claim the egg.
As the player, you’ll command your bird army, defending your base’s egg from incoming enemies.
Strategically position your units based on their strengths and the terrain to maximize your defense.
Protect the egg until the time runs out to secure victory.
Enjoy the adorable yet determined efforts of the birds as you lead your allies to triumph!
The birds’ ambitions take flight over the mysterious “BigEgg”…
One day, a massive egg called “BigEgg” suddenly appeared in the park.
“The bird that hatches this egg will rule over all birds.”
This rumor spread among the birds, sparking an intense scramble to claim the egg—a true bird battle!
Experience authentic real-time strategy with simple controls!
Position your forces, set attack targets, and establish defensive lines—all with easy controls!
All you need is one button!
Master unit synergies and unleash special skills for a dramatic comeback!
With dynamic changes in battle depending on the birds' compatibility and positioning, enjoy deep and strategic gameplay.
Turn the tide of battle with devastating skills and aim for a miraculous comeback!
Endless Defense Mode
Test your endurance in Endless Mode, where you compete to see how long you can defend.
Push your limits and aim for a spot on the global leaderboard!
Battle Mode

title: Vehicle No. 4
description:
게임 정보
Vehicle No. 4 is an action-packed horde survival strategy game where you must fend off waves of enemies. Build your own combat vehicle by freely placing weapons and upgrading them with unique modules. Every decision matters: adapt your strategy, enhance your vehicle, and conquer increasingly tough challenges. Face the horde – with your ultimate, self-designed vehicle!
Place your weapons
Upgrade every weapon separately

title: Beneath The Surface
description:
게임 정보
"Beneath The Surface"는 심리적 긴장감, 몰입감 있는 탐험, 강렬한 전투, 그리고 등골이 오싹해지는 만남을 결합한 무서운 1인칭 생존 호러 경험입니다. 불길한 숲의 깊은 곳으로 들어가 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내고, 지하의 지옥 같은 세계에서 생존을 위해 싸우세요.
빛이 희망을 드러내고 어둠이 말로 표현할 수 없는 공포를 숨기는 세계로 들어가세요. 탐험, 퍼즐, 그리고 슈팅 메커니즘을 갖춘 "Beneath The Surface"는 당신의 용기와 이성을 한계까지 시험할 것입니다. 당신은 탈출할 수 있을까요, 아니면 악몽에 사로잡힐까요?탐색을 시작하세요! 어둡고 선형적인 공포 경험을 기대하세요. 게임 플레이는 30~40분 동안 긴장감을 선사합니다.

title: Through The Murky Water
description:
게임 정보
The vhs mockumentary underwater horror game.
Observe the environment of the station through the camera monitors.
Go into the depths of the ocean and explore the darkness of the depths.
Features
This game is an interactive horror mockumentary experience.
You will have to explore interactive materials, for example to conduct interviews.
Walk underwater, watch the cameras of the underwater station.
Come face to face with mysterious and frightening events that happened on the bottom of the ocean.

title: Chinese Strange Stories
description:
게임 정보
Enter a world where the lines between the living and the spirit world blur. Immerse yourself in a game that weaves together the mystical, the supernatural, and the struggles of everyday life during the turbulent final years of the Ming dynasty.

Features:

A Deep, Story-Rich World
Explore a vast and intricate narrative based on nearly 500 "marvel tales" from Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio, a collection of classical Chinese stories by the Qing dynasty writer Pu Songling. Encounter spirits and mythical creatures, and live the life of people during the closing days of the Ming dynasty. Witness their struggles, hear their tales, and decide how you will shape their destiny in a world filled with intrigue, war, and mysticism.

Traditional Turn-Based RPG Meets Card Battling
Enjoy a unique blend of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling. The combination of randomness and strategy provides endless possibilities for combat and decision-making.

Distinctive Art Style
Step into a living Chinese painting and dive into a harmonious blend of history and artistry. Let the beauty of classic Chinese art captivate your senses like never before as you explore and discover.

Party & Deck Building
Assemble a party of characters, each with their own unique decks. Arrange your team strategically to build the perfect deck. Find unique cards through exploration, quests, and crafting. The more you play, the more options you’ll have to customize and strengthen your cards.

title: Five Heads
description:
게임 정보
THE GAME
Five prisoners sit around a table, each with a card on their forehead—visible to everyone but themselves. In the first two rounds, they must figure out where they rank from lowest to highest, using logic, deduction, and psychology. In the final round, each player takes a leap of faith, guessing their exact card. Every guess is a clue, every mistake a setback—can you crack the code?
THE RUN
The Run is a high-stakes gauntlet of logic and teamwork. You and your team of five must survive a series of escalating challenges, ending each level in the correct order to advance. Before moving forward, you’ll vote on a power to aid your deduction and a poison that makes the next level even tougher. With each round growing more intense, will your team adapt, or will the increasing chaos break your streak?

title: Rochd Reanimated
description:
게임 정보
Rochford Reanimated is a strategic, card-based survival game set in a zombie-infested world. As the radio operator of a small survivor community, you must guide your people through perilous missions, resource management, and relentless undead threats. Use a hand-drawn map to explore the surrounding area, coordinate critical missions for food, tools, and fuel, as you strive to expand your community and liberate Rochford County. Every choice brings you closer to either rebuilding or facing the collapse of your community. Will you outsmart the apocalypse?

title: Screaming Head
description:
게임 정보
In this 2d platformer you play as a polyamorous head that pushes his enemies away using the power of scream.
Your wives have been kidnapped and your life had been destroyed by none other than your own body.
It's time to prove once and for all that mind rules over body and not the other way around!
This colorful gem of a gaming experience with unbelievably punchy soundtrack and infuriatingly pushy enemies is everything you need! (if everything you need is a game about a head that is screaming)
Now go ahead and SCREAM YOUR HEAD OFF!!!

title: GOLDO: Lost Goblin
description:
게임 정보
Guide Goldo, a lost goblin, in this short, surreal stealth adventure: sneak past hostile adventurers, uncover bizarre treasures, and unravel the dungeon's dark mystery!
SNEAK AROUND - Use cover and tunnels to avoid gold-thirsty adventurers. Carefully time each move to stay hidden.
DISCOVER BIZARRE TREASURES - Explore for treasures left behind by the dungeon’s enigmatic boss. Every discovery brings you closer to understanding its true nature. All that glitters is Gold.
EXPLORE A SURREAL WORLD - Journey through the Golden Nexus, a bizarre and oneiric dungeon where reality bends. Is this place a dream or a nightmare?

title: Sibling Souls
description:
게임 정보
Step into the dark world of 2147, a dystopian place of vampires, androids, and dangerous secrets
You are Lina, a young woman desperate to find your twin brother, who vanished the night he became a vampire. Leaving behind the safety of your home, you step into a city where danger hides in every shadow. In your search for answers, you’ll uncover secrets that threaten not just your brother—but the fragile balance of the world itself.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The new humans may look like ordinary people, but beneath their polished exterior lies cold machinery. They call themselves the city's protectors, maintaining order through constant surveillance and binding residents with digital communication rings. They know far too much about you—and this knowledge might lead you to your brother… unless they choose to use it against you.

title: Beneath The Bell
description:
게임 정보
Average playtime: around 120 minutes.
Beneath the Bell is a horror game that combines exploration, bizarre puzzles, and frightening paranormal phenomena, all enriched by brief action sessions.
You will find yourself in an old abandoned school, immersed in a gloomy and disturbing atmosphere, which changes and deforms due to paranormal events that you will unintentionally trigger.
By exploring it thoroughly, it will reveal itself to you, allowing you to uncover its secrets and move forward.
You will have to solve dark puzzles and escape the presences that haunt the school.

title: Rico's Theater
description:
게임 정보
Welcome, Investigator! 

You work for an organization called, "The Order," a paranormal investigation company that strictly deals with entities & objects called "Anomalies." These anomalies are manifestations of pure chaos, and it's our job to contain & eliminate them. ... we're losing control of the situation. Fast. 
   
In the Order HQ, you'll be able to upgrade your equipment, study on known & unknown entities, shop for allies & other important materials, edit your character's classes & skill trees, & much more. You can also just hang out & socialize with other fellow investigators if you feel like it! 




 is a large facility that will actively change with every investigation that you initiate. No investigation will be the same. You will have multiple tasks & objectives to complete in each investigation of which vary in difficulty & skill. Your primary objective will be to lure any anomalies using the appropriate equipment & to eliminate them once they show themselves.




, the more dangerous & difficult the anomaly(s) will become. Eliminate any threats you encounter. Remember, you will not always be dealing with one single anomaly. There will most likely be multiple depending on your investigation. 


We're excited to work with you.

title: Raed
description:
게임 정보
Lost in the aftermath of a black hole incident, you’re left floating in space with fading oxygen and fragmented clues. Explore haunting environments, uncover hidden truths, and piece together the fate of your crew in this emotional sci-fi adventure. Will you survive long enough to face the dark secret that awaits?

title: Tangermarine
description:
게임 정보
Tangermarine is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter with a dash of bullet heaven and roguelite thrown in. Explode vegetables with a horrifically cute citrus super soldier - it's a-gore-able! Oppressive horror atmosphere and veg-based blood and gore meets Kawai cuteness.
Fast-paced twin-stick arena shooter action
Survive waves of undead veg in rounds 30 - 90 seconds long
Gather souls to upgrade your character and gain a new powerup with each wave
Lots of fruit and vegetable-based gore
Lots of vegetables were harmed in the making of this game

title: On Roads Between
description:
게임 정보
On Roads Between is currently in ALPHA and will not be released until complete. Free demos will be available forever but will have limited cross-play with the final game.
Monsters are attacking New Zealand, and the newspaper is paying good money for photos. Grab a camera, a couple mates and your high-school car, to be the first to capitalize on it.
On Roads Between is a co-op horror game set in 1980s New Zealand with a unique papercraft art-style. Drive anywhere from the top of the North Island to the bottom of the South to capture anomalies and Lovecraftian horrors on fresh film.
On Roads Between features a massive map (won't be in demo, still squashing bugs,) where you can drive from town to town. Restock and replenish your items in the small towns before venturing out into the native bush to get paid. Keep your car topped up and repaired, just in case you need a quick getaway.
You can drive almost anywhere, and where you can't, you can hike. Keep in mind that you drop your items when you die, so don't go too far from you camp.
Camps are how you respawn friends, save progress and pass the time. This is the 1980s, so you have to pass time by playing instruments, sports and maybe a few pranks on your friends. Remember, time flies when you're having fun.
Soon enough, night will fall. And with it, monsters and anomalies will be more common. Get your cameras ready, and hope you have enough spare film to catch them all. And don't worry if a Scuttler or a Merchant takes you out. You can still help your friends from beyond the grave.
With your new found dough, put together the slickest outfit you can. Stick stickers all over your character to build a unique look. Yes, I know what you guys will do with this feature, and you can disable seeing other's custom costumes. Please don't make me regret adding this.
Also, I am going to look into making the stickers tradable, with a foil and aging system. Keep an eye out for rare stickers, because you might be the only one in the world to have it.

title: Cryptage
description:
게임 정보
A real-time action roguelite, you are a wizard venturing into a crypt full of monsters, while improving yourself as a wizard, in this roguelike you can buy staffs and skins for your wizard, with an infinite game mode where you defeat bosses and enemies, the gameplay is based on waves, and in each wave you can choose some cards that will give you powerful abilities, and when you choose repeated cards the ability improves in some way.

title: Squash and Spell : Kids Typing
description:
게임 정보
Squash and Spell is a fun & friendly game designed for children as soon as they show an interest to interact with a computer. 
A fun on screen representation of all the letters in the alphabet.
                     A spelling rainbow with lots of words.
A word processor mode which lets children type and see the result.
                     Fully voice acted, including a toggle for phonics.
A writing mode where, depending on hardware, children can use a stylus, touch or mouse to draw letters.
                    Time of day system with cosy ambient sounds.

title: Don't Forget the Phone
description:
게임 정보
Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Use the computer and other gadgets around the tower to complete your nightly checklist.
But watch out! The research subjects from the lab below tend to wander a bit at night. Use all methods at your disposal to dissuade them.
Complete all of your tasks before sunrise or YOU'RE FIRED!
Congratulations on your new position as a watchtower attendant!
On behalf of the Eclipse Research Foundation, welcome to our family!
Your role is vital in securing, and protecting, our state-of-the-art research facility. Nightly duties will consist of stimulating, and engaging, tasks such as:
Answering phone calls!
Checking your email!

title: MiniMo: Crazy Chase
description:
게임 정보
The chase is as ON as it is CRAZY!
MiniMo: Crazy Chase is an online, fast-paced, asymmetrical twist on the classic hide 'n seek formula for 1-5 players where players fulfill one of two different roles.
Either they are MONSTERS, hiding to avoid getting caught and seeking to collect all the keys before it's too late... or they play as THE ROBOT, hiding from NO ONE but seeking to chase and collect all of those puny, soon-to-be incarcerated monsters! 
It's a party game through and through, inviting you to jumpscare your friends or steel your stealthy nerves in quick matches that last no longer than 2 minutes!
Over in a flash in more ways than one!
The good news is you can see things in front of you. The bad news is, that's the ONLY thing you can see! All stages are shrouded in darkness, your flashlights the only weapon against this dim unknown. The monsters' flashlights are... functional at best. The robot, however, has a much cooler, more expensive robo-flashlight to make monster-chasin' easier!
If a monster flashes their lights on a key for some time, they collect it. But if a monster stays within the horrifyingly red light of the robot, it gets CAUGHT and put in monster-jail! If all keys are collected, the monsters win. If all monsters have been caught, the robot wins!
But wait, isn't 4 vs 1 unfair?
Well, unfair for whom?
When you play as the ROBOT...you, and you alone, get to be the sci-fi-horror-villain I always knew you could be, making the monsters sweat as they desperately try to avoid you. But you do have a few tricks up your, um, sleeve. Wait, do robots have sleeves?
For one, the monsters are on the clock... you are NOT! If time runs out, you ALSO win! 
Secondly, as the game progresses, and those monsters (hopefully and/or regrettably) collect more and more keys, your robot software unlocks hidden benefits.
The monsters, though... are slippery and, well, plural! Oh, and they have these awesome powers they'll try to use at the right time to (hopefully and/or regrettably) gain the upper hand. Wait, do monsters have upper hands?
Also, it's not over when caught. Fellow monsters may try to orchestrate a prison break just for you – working together and good communication are your keys to victory! Aside from the actual keys, that is!

title: Sigrid & Friends: Playtime
description:
게임 정보
In this mix between turn-based RPG and visual novel, you get to know four girls that make up the continent's best adventure club, as you all go to the Sketchpark to play town games, dungeon games, and more. Play together, get to know each other and have the most fun you can have, before going home to enjoy a relaxing evening and a fairy-tale marathon.
Features:
* A surreal tone and setting with quirky, over-the-top characters and the opportunity to build bonds with them.
* A meta-layer where you get to decide the conditions for each game.
* A turn-based combat system focusing on special attacks.

title: Once Glorious Artahk
description:
게임 정보
In Once Glorious Artahk, you’ll explore the ruins of the ancient city of Artahk in search of a way to save the world from an endless night. Solve a variety of different puzzles to unlock new paths, abilities, and forgotten lore, then read the lost stories you uncover to gain insight into a tangled web of mysteries. Using only your wits and your trusty torch to guide you, you must find a way to return light to a starless sky. 
EXPLORE
Explore crumbling ruins, darkened halls, and tangled forests as you scour what remains of the once-glorious city of Artahk. The game world is divided into five distinct zones that can be explored non-linearly and feature many puzzles that overlap and build upon each other.
SOLVE PUZZLES
From piecing together the proper sequence to arrange ancient runes, to deciphering cryptic murals, or using mirrors to redirect the light from your torch in order to activate magical mechanisms, the ruins of Artahk are littered with all manner of puzzles waiting to be solved.

title: 雪原余烬 Snow Ash
description:
게임 정보
Game Features
A card-centric delivery journey
Reach your destination through a deck of trucks and characters
You will encounter different event cards and enemy cards on the way, and you need to respond flexibly!
The environment will also bring risks, you can solve them through cards, and at the same time, you may also gain benefits!
Temperature, environment, and materials constitute the elements of survival
On the snow, you will continue to suffer from increasingly severe cold, you need enough fuel!
Your team will endure hunger and pressure, and you can go further only if you can solve them
Ammunition, tools... cards will also consume some supplies. Goods are not just trading items, manage your resources well
Trade, skills and equipment between different shelters
Each shelter has different goods to buy and sell
You can learn different skills in different shelters
You can also buy different equipment and vehicle accessories in different shelters!
Multiple recruitable characters, as well as development and construction combined with cards
You can recruit several different characters to freely match your team!
You can plan different ability directions for them, and each character can freely learn any skills to form your deck!
They have different spark abilities, and each character is unique!
Truck modification and construction
You can upgrade and modify your truck to help you cross the snow better.
The truck has its own unique cards, and you can also get some more special and unique cards through accessories!

title: Null Path
description:
게임 정보
                 What's Inside?
- 7 Different biomes
- Over 60 Levels to explore
- 5 powerups to unlock
- 9 eggs to find
- 6 discoverable teleport combinations
- Dozens of traps
- Hundreds of challenging jumps
- 2-3+ hours of content
Features
Precision Platforming: Master tight controls and execute pixel-perfect jumps to navigate through perilous gauntlets of spikes, saw blades, collapsing platforms and more.
Diverse Biomes: Explore hand crafted levels, each with its own unique challenges, hazards, and atmospheric designs.

title: Scent of Clouds
description:
게임 정보
You've always known that your keen sense of smell is your greatest talent. However, you're a doe which makes the art of perfumery not exactly the most traditional profession for your kind. Luckily, you've found a mentor who couldn't care less about societal pressures and has taken you under her wing. After two years of working as her assistant, you're now ready to create fragrances on your own. Yet, you don't expect just how deep the waters will be...
The most important sense in the animal kingdom is the sense of smell, particularly here on the Palent planet, where it plays a key role in communication, camouflage, healing, and many other essential functions. Palent is predominantly inhabited by highly intelligent animals, whose level of technological development resembles that of the 18th- to 19th-century Earth. Peace has long prevailed here, but recent rumors speak of unknown species of lizards disrupting the established order. Where have they come from?

title: Five More Minutes
description:
게임 정보
Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos!
Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.
Each genre has its own set of unique cards, keepsakes, and strategies. Level up your character to gain more actions, health, and collect powerful mementos from your gaming adventures.

title: Mystic Resistance
description:
게임 정보
Change your strategy on the fly as you're presented with new upgrades for each of your 15 potential towers! Add powerful potions to your arsenal to defeat the endless hordes of monsters.
Mystic Resistance begins like any other tower defense game, except this time, you can't use the exact same strategy in every situation. Every few levels you will be met with a choice to gain a new tower, item, ability, or upgrade to help you on your journey, with enough options to make every run feel unique.

title: Nyric
description:
게임 정보
Explore. Survive. Shape the Unknown.
Nyric is an open-ended survival game where your imagination shapes the universe. Use prompt-based world generation to bring surreal realms to life, then venture into the unknown to gather resources, uncover secrets, build settlements and leave your mark.
Chart Your Path
Type a phrase—"A city of glowing fungi," "A world trapped in eternal twilight," "A storm-haunted wasteland"—and Nyric generates an uncharted realm for you to explore. Whether you're wandering through a dream or surviving a nightmare with friends, no two journeys are ever the same.
Collectable AI Companions
You're not alone. Strange, ever-curious Faebots accompany you, offering guidance, mischief, and unexpected insight. Some are eager to assist, others follow their own whims—but all will leave their mark on your journey.

title: Panzer Planet
description:
게임 정보
Face relentless waves of giant insects, aliens, and zombies in a fight for survival. Customize your build with an arsenal of unique weapons and power-ups, and harness the game's unique planetary perspective to outmaneuver your enemies and turn the tide of battle. How long can you last against the cosmic onslaught?
You are a skilled bounty hunter with a powerful tank, hired by planets desperate to reclaim their land from invaders. Your mission: exterminate the monstrous threats and make the planets habitable for settlers.
For every monster you eliminate, you earn a bounty, which can be used to upgrade your weapons, tank, and abilities—allowing you to tackle even greater challenges and amass even greater rewards.

title: 修真幸存者（Immortal Survivor）
description:
게임 정보
《immortal survivor》is a survivor like game based on Chinese Xiu Zhen culture. During the gameplay, players will take on the role of "cultivators" and survive under the siege of monsters. By killing monsters, players can increase their level and strengthen themselves, ultimately surviving to challenge the ultimate boss and achieve victory in the game.

title: upg
description:
게임 정보
what's upg!
upg (pronounced up-gee) is a fast-paced bullet heaven auto-shooting action platformer where you focus on movement while your weapons do the shooting. dash through procedurally generated levels, collecting upgrades and taking down waves of enemies.
features:
- automatic weapon systems - focus on dodging and positioning
- fluid movement system with wall-sliding, dashing, and precise jumps
- multiple weapons:
  - rapid-fire projectiles
  - homing missiles
  - orbital defenders
  - chain lightning
  - returning boomerangs
- roguelite progression:
  - (upg)rade existing weapons
  - unlock new weapons
  - improve speed, health, and jump height
- procedurally generated levels
- pixel art with dynamic lighting
- retro-inspired sound effects
controls:
- wasd/arrows to move
- space to dash
- that's it - weapons fire automatically
stack upgrades, combine weapons, survive as long as you can.

title: Purple Tears. Part I: Everybody dies in the end
description:
게임 정보
In the aftermath of the Cataclysm, a small Eastern European town finds itself trapped within the confines of an enigmatic purple cylinder. Its boundaries are impenetrable, leaving the fate of the world beyond a haunting mystery. Also, the laws of physics have been upended — distant planets now linger in the skies.
Yet, life endures. The townspeople, resigned to their isolation, have adapted to a fragile existence, striving to live ordinary lives beneath the ever-present shadow of uncertainty.
But for five schoolmates, the humdrum of everyday life is no longer enough. Driven by a desire to uncover the fragmented rumors from the internet and the "urban legends," they decide to embark on a hike to abandoned research institute RADIOSVET. There, it is said, a signal was received — a transmission from the other side.
autokwd: Purple Tears. Part I: Everybody dies in the end

title: Rotten Forgotten
description:
게임 정보
Rotten Forgotten: A Whimsical Farm Revival Adventure.
Gather your friends and embark on a delightful agricultural escapade in Rotten Forgotten, a charming cooperative farming game for 1-4 players. Your once-thriving family barn teeters on the brink of bankruptcy, and it's up to you and your companions to breathe new life into the dilapidated homestead.
Cultivate a variety of quirky crops, tend to your eclectic menagerie of farm animals, and race against time to fulfill orders and save your beloved barn from financial ruin. With a perfect blend of strategy, teamwork, and lighthearted fun, Rotten Forgotten is perfect for playing with friends.
Co-op!
Engaging co-op gameplay for solo farmers or groups of up to four players. Play with keyboard and/or controllers.
Challenging time management as you juggle crop cycles and animal care.
Plant!

title: Pixel Blitz
description:
게임 정보
This is an HD2D pixel style soul like, rogue-like, semi clear version parkour slash and racing platform jumping game, where players can choose different ability constructions to challenge different levels.
During the process of passing levels, players need to observe the monster's position in the scene in real time, arrange the path of flashing, jumping, sprinting, and slashing, and finely control the character to kill the fastest blood path.
In theory, on top of this geometric minimalist basic graphics style, players can flexibly customize over 500 combinations of graphics styles and choose the most suitable one to play the game, in order to create a unique challenge experience!

title: Snowman Mo
description:
게임 정보
Join this brave little guy!
He's about to embark on a grand journey to find his friends in this heartwarming adventure game.
A narrative, single-player experience made with all the charm you deserve.
Scamper around the snowcapped peaks of Grumble Mountain and discover a world full of possibility.
Battle bullies, wolves, and firebees in frantically fun snowball fights.
Turn into a snowball and tumble down icy slopes.
Meet dozens of unforgettable characters. Like this snowman named Sherbert!

title: ApocaShift
description:
게임 정보
Establish Your Stronghold
 Start with an empty plot of land, and gradually expand your base by deploying into raids and gathering essential resources. As you venture out, you'll scavenge items from abandoned towns, ruins, and other hazardous locations, carefully extracting valuable materials like guns, ammo, and food. Every raid brings its own set of dangers, from radioactive zones to swarming mutant creatures. Some regions are heavily contaminated, requiring special gear and caution to loot safely. These zones might hide rare resources, but also host terrifying, radiation-mutated monsters that could easily overwhelm an unprepared survivor.
Build and Fortify Your Base 
Back at your base, use the resources you gather to construct new structures, fortify walls, and develop areas that support your growing community. The more you build, the more survivors you'll attract. These survivors come with unique skills and specialties—some may be engineers, able to repair or improve your armory; others might be skilled medics, offering healing services. As you expand, you’ll also attract traders who bring exotic goods from far-off places, but their supplies come at a steep price. Negotiating with them and exchanging loot for crucial supplies could turn the tide in your survival.
Survive in a Dangerous World 
Along with the growing base, you’ll face ever-present threats. The world around you is constantly shifting, and you must adapt. Dangerous mutants—twisted by the apocalypse’s radioactive fallout—roam the wilderness, and become more common as time continues and some may even infiltrate your base. Your best defense might be well-equipped guards, fortified outposts, and traps designed to ward off these horrific invaders. The wasteland is unpredictable, and with the constant looming threat of radiation storms and mutant hordes, staying one step ahead is vital.
Make Strategic Decisions 
Your decisions will be key to surviving. As you deploy into new areas for exploration, gathering crucial resources and completing quests, you may stumble upon new factions, rogue survivors, or hostile creatures. Completing missions for these groups might offer unique rewards, such as new weapons, armor, or blueprints for advanced technology. But be careful—alliances are fragile, and sometimes helping one group means making enemies with another.

title: Pizza Super Slice
description:
게임 정보
Pizza Super Slice is a cartoon-exploration-platformer in which you play as an animated pizza slice. Explore a strange, cartoonish town full of little secrets, dark corners and secret passages.

title: Fling your Friends TD - Tower Defense
description:
게임 정보
Dedicated to my daughter. Wherever you are, I hope you know that you are loved.
Fling your Friends TD is the ultimate party game that will have you and your friends laughing, strategizing, and outsmarting each other in the most entertaining showdown ever! In this game, players take on the roles of either the Defender or the Attackers in a wild and whimsical battle of wits and creativity.
Defender:
Build Your Fortress: Carefully place traps and obstacles to create a formidable defense that will challenge the Attackers.
Special Abilities: Use unique abilities to disrupt and thwart the Attackers' progress, adding an extra layer of strategy to your defenses.
Attacker:
Plan and Conquer: Strategically plan your route and collaborate with your friends (or go solo) to navigate through the Defender's traps.
Character Progression: Level up your character's skills and counter the Defender's strategies.
Overcome Challenges: Utilize special abilities to outmaneuver obstacles and reach your goal.
Key Features
Cooperative PvP Multiplayer: Engage in thrilling multiplayer modes, teaming up with and against friends in a battle of cunning.
Creative Trap: Place an array of imaginative traps that will keep the Attackers on their toes.
Hilarious Gameplay: Experience the fun and chaos of a light-hearted game designed to bring joy and laughter to your gaming sessions.
Strategic Depth: Balance creativity and strategy to outwit your opponents and achieve victory.
Vibrant Visuals: Enjoy colorful and cartoony graphics that enhance the game's charm and appeal.
Replayability: Every game offers a unique experience with countless trap combinations and strategies to explore.
autokwd: Fling your Friends TD - Tower Defense

title: PreStrafe
description:
게임 정보
What is this?
PreStrafe is a direct homage that recreates all of the movement mechanics of The Specialists, a Half-life mod with unique movement abilities that allows full creative freedom in your approach to your environment, these include:
Dive
Walldive
Walljump
Wallflip
Roll
Flip
Plus all of the many aspects of GoldSrc movement mechanics, bunny-hopping, prestrafing, air strafing, wallstrafing, surfing, ramp trimping, and more.
Gamemodes.
Time Trial is the main mode where you compete against others and your personal best times. Freeroam is a sandbox mode where you can freely practice your skills without the stress.
Custom levels.
Use the built-in level editor, upload to workshop, subscribe and play with friends, and edit existing workshop maps to your liking.
Release and other features?
Planned features include cosmetics and other character customization, profile ranks, and rewards for top records. Release is set for Summer 2025 or earlier.
Will there be combat?
PreStrafe is primarily a movement oriented game, no further than that. Melee, guns, gun-fu, bullet time, all of the things we love from The Specialists will come under a different title.

title: Lobsterpunk
description:
게임 정보
Lobsterpunk is a puzzle, walking simulator where you make your way through an abandon city powered solely by the combustion of lobsters. Bring the dead machinery one last breath of life before their steel forms lay cold forever. As you do, see the memories of the last man on earth, the ones he loved, the ones he lost, & the mistakes he made to get to where he is.
Complete lockpicking puzzles to traverse this dead city, explore any house you desire, find the story of those who once lived here through what they left behind & how familiar that might feel, however foreign the setting.
Lockpicking Systems:
Lockpicking uses W,A,S,D to turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find the sweet spot in a lock!
Volt Wave uses W,A,S,D toto turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find a moving sweet spot on a panel!
Gearbox uses W,A,S,D to turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find the sweet spot in a set of 3 layered gears!

title: Filtration
description:
게임 정보
From the developer that brought you Quaternion comes a new ball-rolling platform challenge that's bigger, better, and full of surprises! Jump, bounce, blast, and fly through 12 pocket dimensions in order to harvest the precious power sources within. Find Modules that let your ball do things you've never seen before at the touch of a button. With robotic foes and tricky puzzles in your way, it's gonna take a lot more than Ion Cells to get through this!
Filtration is a single-player puzzle platform game. By rolling a robotic ball, you'll explore and unlock the secrets of the lost Amali civilization, along with hints as to where they might have gone. Along the way, you'll find Modules, expansion units to plug into your ball and increase its capabilities, adding abilities like a protective shield, a rocket engine, and a pair of wings. The game provides a balance of tricky platforming, brain-tickling puzzles, and action combat in order to explore every corner of the ball-rolling genre.
Features include:
12 main levels, along with several small bonus levels
An expansive Split Complex hub
12 Planck Cores for you to collect
12 Modules to power up your ball
30,000 Ion Cells
Unlockable upgrades to your abilities
An awesome soundtrack
And more!

title: Project Louisiana - The BOUNDS VR
description:
게임 정보
Explore and unveil the secrets of an old New Orleans mansion. Investigate your daughter disappearance and unravel the mysteries of a voodoo cult whose interest seems to be revolving around her.
Exploration, puzzles and combat... Will you be strong enough to survive The BOUNDS VR and  face the truth?

title: The Walking Trade
description:
게임 정보
워킹 트레이드(Walking Trade)는 혼돈과 상거래가 충돌하는 기발하고 액션으로 가득한 좀비 아포칼립스 상점 경영 게임입니다!
공간, 미학, 기능의 균형을 맞춰 상점을 디자인하세요. 진열대를 정리하고, 가격을 책정하고, 고객이 행복하게 또는 최소한 살아서 돌아갈 수 있도록 하세요.

title: MAiZE
description:
게임 정보
MAiZE is a first person horror survival game set in a haunted corn maze. Navigate the maze to collect the five harvest items (an apple, an orange, a batch of grapes, a pear, and a cob of corn). Once all harvest items have been found, you can collect the Cornucopia to unlock the next section of the maze. Pumpkins scattered throughout the maze offer various buffs or debuffs. Evade the Scarecrows and other ghostly/demonic enemies that haunt the maze. Uncover the secrets of the maze and its haunted history.

title: Crone
description:
게임 정보
Crone is rogue-like dungeon crawler with fast paced combat and high-octane spell casting. Collect scrolls to help you survive the decent. Resources in the depths are limited, so use them wisely. Rescue the residents of Bogtown to unlock new upgrades and grow stronger. The Crone's eyes have been stolen. Recover them to reveal the mysteries that lurk below.

title: The Corruption
description:
게임 정보
Explore
Explore a corrupted world overcome with digital zealots who have become indistinguishable from zombies.
Destroy
It’s backrooms meets Bioshock. Destroy the digital zombies with traps, emergent interactions, and a grenade launcher.
Ascend
When will this utopia end?

title: Dino Space Station
description:
게임 정보
Dino Space Station은 2D 픽셀 아트 플랫폼 게임입니다. 전원을 복원합니다. 공룡을 피하세요. 잔해에서 탈출하세요. 유성우가 부활한 공룡들로 가득 찬 정거장을 파괴했습니다. 어둡고 위험한 복도를 탐색하고 랩터를 피하며 살아남으세요. 경고: 게임플레이가 불안을 유발할 수 있습니다.
어둠 속에서 탐색
적대적인 회피 공룡
전원 복원

title: A Father's Tale
description:
게임 정보
A Father's Tale is a story about grief and acceptance. After the loss of your son, you magically get sucked into his drawing book that contains a fantasy world inside. Explore this land with colorful creatures and beautiful landscapes in a Top-Down view of the Father. Jumping, crouching and running your way through obstacles
The book soon becomes a way to reconnect with your loved one. All your memories are written and drawn inside but suddenly it's revealed this kingdom is being taken under control of a powerful and mysterious entity. All it's colors are vanishing and you will need to find a way to save the joy and colors from the book.
In this adventure, you will solve puzzles to open new paths and learn about this world. Evil creatures will, however, try to stop you. Their objective is to fill the land with darkness and sadness by using their dark magic so you will need to sneak around them. Using covers and distractions, they will be no match for you.
During your journey, a magic crystal will become your most powerful ally. It will contain many powers, including coloring what was once lost to the corruption from darkness. Some objects you encounter during your exploration are corrupted by darkness and grief. You will have the power to restore their color and thus, progressing in your quest.

title: Mac & Jack: Candy Bashers
description:
게임 정보
As the old saying goes, nothing stands between a Pumpkin and their Cat.
In Mac & Jack: Candy Bashers you'll brave the Halloween night and work to survive against waves of monsters while collecting as much candy as you can! Discover new items by Trick-or-Treating between waves, purchase them from the shopkeeper for permanent use, and build a loadout that customizes the difficulty of every run!
And if the monsters have you feeling a little tense? Take a second to breathe and just spend time with your friend. 
Features:
Wave based runs that are customized by what items you choose to bring. Looking for an easy breezy run? Pack a little less! Thrive on difficulty? Bring all you can carry!
Over a dozen unique items and accessories to unlock!

title: DinoSwarm
description:
게임 정보
The Swarm Queen is ready to invade the dimensions and gather as much power as she can. She will grant you incredible powers and enhancements.
Create your own Hybrid and upgrade it to face increasingly difficult challenges. Infinite possibilities! You can hybridize your Dinosaur using DNA from various body parts collected during battle. In addition to changing the physical appearance and movements, its stats also change, so have fun experimenting with different builds!

title: Dungeon Fletcher
description:
게임 정보
Time jumps and avoid obstacle as you collect treasures and find secret passages in the search of the best score!
Dungeon Fletcher is an ode to old school computer platformers of the 90s/80s!
Game modes
Challenge yourself in 4 different difficult modes, explore the dungeon and try to find all secret areas!

title: The Advent: Children of Arla
description:
게임 정보
The Advent: Children of Arla invites you to explore the enigmatic planet of Argus, a world created by the Hydrackians—an ancient and advanced civilization—to serve as humanity’s legacy. This RPG hybrid combines massive multiplayer worlds with engaging single-player dungeon adventures to deliver an unparalleled gaming experience.
Key Features:
Hybrid Gameplay: Seamlessly transition between vast multiplayer worlds and challenging single-player RPG dungeons.
Immersive Lore: Discover the story of Klateqal, the bipedal shapeshifting dragon whose role as humanity’s guardian led to betrayal, banishment, and the fusion of his soul with his enemy, Zo-ar. Unravel mysteries tied to ancient Earth legends and the Hydrackians’ grand plan.
Mesoamerican Mythology: Journey through a sub-world inspired by Aztec and Mayan timelines, including ‘Temple Q,’ a breathtaking dungeon set in ancient Teotihuacan.
Dynamic Quests and Challenges: Solve intricate puzzles, navigate perilous traps, and complete quests that impact the fate of Argus and its inhabitants.
Customization and Progression: Build your character’s skills, unlock unique abilities, and discover rare artifacts to aid in your journey.
Stunning Visuals: Explore richly detailed environments, from lush jungles to the surreal landscapes of Argus and beyond.
The Story Begins:
On the home world of Arla, Klateqal—the legendary dragon believed to be the inspiration for Earth’s Quetzalcoatl—was once beloved by his people and destined for greatness. Framed for murder by the cunning Zo-ar, Klateqal was sentenced to banishment. A tragic accident involving Luminoy, a mysterious mineral, fused Klateqal with his enemy, creating a powerful and vengeful being consumed by hatred.
Centuries later, humanity discovers Argus, a planet imbued with remnants of Hydrackian technology and a dark secret tied to Klateqal’s fate. As one of the Children of Arla, you must navigate this mysterious world, face its challenges, and decide its destiny.
Wishlist Now!
Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure. Add The Advent: Children of Arla to your wishlist on Steam today and be the first to uncover the secrets of Argus.

title: JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Forever Lost In A Maze...
following your boss around different cities across the UK, from silly goofy Train Stations to the iconic F1 track, collect different items like a totally-not-phallic sausage for JoshGeoff, your ring leader boss. What will happen if you don't get these items... you don't want to know since it'll be your worst, and last nightmare.
JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator Maps
At the moment, we have 5 maps that will be on release, with more to come in the future! The 5 maps include, Weiner Town, Kiev Central, Silverstone, Bus Station and Bike Depot.
JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator Official Roadmap

title: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?
description:
게임 정보
Satan was feeling lonely. The people simply don't care about eternal damnation like they used to. Maybe all hell needed was a promotional event to get people excited again. One day, he heard people arguing about how many toddlers they could beat in a fight and then he got an idea. If anyone could defeat 20 waves of toddlers they would acquire powers beyond their wildest imagination.
A Deal with the Devil 
At the end of each wave, choose between a variety of powerful upgrades, but each one comes at a cost! For example an upgrade might give a boost to damage after a reload, making it powerful if you reload your weapon often. However, the upgrade also reduces the knockback given to enemies. Many Faustian upgrades are able to be taken multiple times, stacking the benefits and drawbacks. So repeating that same upgrade may give you massive damage after you reload, but the knockback it inflicts is so reduced that it pulls enemies closer to you! Depending on the upgrades you choose, this could be a critical weakness in your strategy or an attribute you are able to overcome with the other power you have acquired.
Explore Unique weapons
Explore a variety of powerful weapons that each have two firing modes.
Including a Brella gun that has an automatic rifle component and an alt fire that shoots umbrellas that pushes back enemies and deletes projectiles,
A double barrel shotgun with an alt fire that shoots two barrels at once, increasing knock back and penetration while stunning enemies,
An AK-47 with Molotov launcher alt fire,
And many more!
autokwd: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?

title: Koko's Cafe
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
이 성장 비주얼 노벨에서 커피를 서빙하고 손님들과 친구가 되어 그들의 이야기를 알아가 보세요.

title: Little Onryo
description:
게임 정보
As a small Onryō, you just can't wait to curse as many chumps as possible - but first you have to power up your Nensha by collecting all the objects in an 8-bit style old school platformer!
Make your nefarious way through ten different worlds, dodging guardians and nasties, negotiating crumbling platforms, cunning level designs and use your telekenesis and Nesha bolt to solve problematic puzzles.
A fond love letter and parody of the classic 48K games of Matthew Smith and all small and gruesome spirits that dwell in wells.
FEATURES:
Hundreds of rooms to explore and solve, including a country house, shopping mall, moon base, furry forest and the most dreaded foe of all - your mother!
Dozens of curious enemies with a massive four frames of animation!
Tricky jumps and physics puzzles!
16 blistering colors! (Except when it isn't)
A chiptune soundtrack!
Explore every nook and cranny and save your sisters!
Old school gameplay - it's a challenge, just like the good old days. You get seven lives to conquer a world and that's it!
tag: 탐험,2D 플랫폼,퍼즐 플랫폼,숨은 그림 및 물체,2D

title: Space Grunts 3
description:
게임 정보
Space Grunts is a combination of turn-based tactics and fast paced arcade action.
Navigate your way through procedurally generated space stations, taking out enemies or using the shockwave of your rockets, grenades and other explosions to simply move those enemies out of the way on your path to the end goal.
(Planned) Key features
Fast turn-based gameplay (as seen and enjoyed in the original Space Grunts)
Tactical weapon usage with weapons having a "spread pattern"
Explosive weapons generate shock-waves pushing/forcing entities around the map
Procedurally generated
Risk reward mission system: Dangerous missions give bigger rewards than easier missions

title: The Gas Station
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to The Gas Station, a nerve-wracking survival horror experience set in the desolate heart of nowhere. As the night shift worker at a lonely gas station, your routine starts with mundane tasks—restocking shelves, taking out the trash, keeping the power on. But the deeper into the night you go, the more unsettling the events become. Eerie phone calls. Shadows moving where they shouldn’t. What starts as an ordinary shift spirals into a nightmare you can't escape.
In The Gas Station, every decision matters, with multiple endings that keep you on edge until the very last moment. Will you survive the hostile activity, make it to dawn, and live? Or will your curiosity—or fear— be the cause of your death?
Features:
Dynamic Tasks: Keep the station running while terror builds around you. The more you do, the worse it gets.
Multiple Endings: Drive away, uncover the killer’s hideout, or fight for survival in a basement torture chamber. Your fate is in your hands.
Immersive Atmosphere: Experience the haunting isolation of a lonely gas station, complete with PS1-style visuals and atmospheric sound effects.
You clock in for a quiet night. But will you clock out alive? Welcome to the most terrifying shift of your life.

title: Pixel Domain
description:
게임 정보
Pixel Domain is a minimalist, medieval 4x game. Play cards to capture territories, play more cards to build in those territories to get access to better cards, play better cards to get a larger army, build castles to get access to powerful hero's, build improvements to pay for your upkeep. Pixel Domain can be played against an AI, online or hotseat multiplayer. Unlock new cards by playing challenges. Conquer the island or build a wonder to win.

title: We Love Fish Tanks
description:
게임 정보
Dive into We Love Fish Tanks – a cozy and relaxing sandbox where you can build the aquarium of your dreams. Create, grow, and collect at your own pace with no stress, no consequences, no manipulative game mechanics.
Key Features:
Customize Your Tanks: Choose from a variety of backgrounds, wall styles, water colors, and lighting options to design up to 9 fish tanks that are uniquely yours.
Fish of All Sizes: Stock your aquarium with fish of different sizes to create a lively and dynamic underwater world.
No Limits on Fish: Add as many fish as you want to your tanks—your only limit is how much your computer can handle!
Discover and Collect: Breed fish to unlock unique colors and personalities, building a vibrant and curated collection of aquatic life.
Stress-Free Fun: With no losing conditions, and no manipulative game mechanics, the game is all about nurturing your fish, chilling out, and watching your creations flourish.
Whether you’re a collector, decorator, or simply someone who loves fish, We Love Fish Tanks is the perfect way to relax and create your own aquatic paradise. Start your journey today and see where your imagination takes you!
For my Pookie Bear <3

title: Musical Meteors
description:
게임 정보
Musical Meteors is an arcade game mixing retro aesthetics and gameplay with music education. Players learn the layout of the piano by using it to destroy meteors floating across the screen. Each meteor is labelled with a musical note corresponding to a key on the piano. When that key on the piano is pressed, the corresponding meteor explodes, awarding points. Earn enough points to level up and unlock more keys, increasing the difficulty as you play.
IMPORTANT NOTE: This game requires a MIDI keyboard device to be played. User interface elements are interacted with using mouse and keyboard, while the game itself is controlled with a MIDI keyboard. Make sure you have access to a MIDI keyboard and can connect it to your computer before playing. Also ensure that no other programs are running simultaneously that use a MIDI keyboard, as that can interfere with the game's functionality.

title: Just Cube
description:
게임 정보
                                                    "Just Cube" 는 도전적인 장애물, 장대한 보스 전투, 쉴 틈 없는 긴장감으로 가득한 12개의 독특한 장소로 여러분을 안내하는 2D 플랫포머 게임입니다. 각 장소는 여러분의 기술과 반사 신경을 시험하는 새로운 도전이며, 정밀한 움직임과 뛰어난 전략을 요구합니다.
이 게임은 단순히 A 지점에서 B 지점으로 이동하는 것뿐만 아니라, 여러분을 가로막는 수많은 함정과 맞서야 합니다. 그리고 각 장소의 끝에는 여정을 계속하지 못하도록 방해하는 장대한 보스 전투가 기다리고 있습니다.

title: Endless Descent
description:
게임 정보
Endless Descent is a high-stakes roguelike adventure where every decision matters. Players descend into an ever-changing labyrinth of procedurally generated dungeons, armed with medieval weapons and the resolve to survive. But beware — in Endless Descent, you only have one life. If you fall, everything is lost: your character, your progress, and your hard-earned treasures.
Across multiple dungeon worlds, players search for rare and powerful Soul Stones, mystical artifacts capable of enhancing their abilities or empowering their weapons with unique effects. Each descent presents tougher enemies, unpredictable encounters, and the constant pressure to survive. Victory means growth, but defeat means starting over with nothing but hard-earned knowledge.
With intense, permadeath-driven gameplay, deep customization, and endless replay ability, Endless Descent offers a relentless challenge where only the strongest, smartest, and most adaptable adventurers will endure. How far will you descend before the dungeon takes its toll?

title: Nanima
description:
게임 정보
Fight through a constantly evolving microscopic world to deliver a vital payload. The inhabitants of the microcosm may be small but they can tear you apart, so you'll have to scavenge what's left of previous expeditions from their remains to bolster your arsenal.
Combine dozens of unique weapons and augments to create devastating combos while strategically placing thrusters, weights, and fins to fine-tune your movement and outmaneuver enemies.

title: POUMOSA
description:
게임 정보
= Gameplay =
POUMOSA is a Point And Click adventure game.
It is intended for players who like dialogues, puzzles and wiggling mustaches.
= Story =
In 1503, Europe is captivated by the promise of the New World. Expeditions are being prepared in all the kingdoms, each hoping to obtain their share of the riches and unexplored lands.
You play the role of Balthazar De Rochemort, a nobleman who invests in one of these expeditions and boards a ship. However, caught in a violent storm, your expedition drifts and discovers a small mysterious island, inhabited by an unknown people.
Study their language !

title: Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments
description:
게임 정보
"Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments"는 3D 숨은 그림 찾기 게임으로, 당신의 임무는 아늑하고 어질러진 아파트에 숨어 있는 1000마리 이상의 고양이를 찾는 것입니다.
서랍, 금고, 캐비닛을 열고 물건을 이동시켜 가장 예상치 못한 숨은 장소를 찾아보세요. 아파트의 모든 구석구석에는 놀라움과 도전이 가득하며, 디테일이 풍부한 등각 투영 환경을 탐험할 수 있습니다.
비밀 고양이와 흥미로운 퍼즐을 통해 새로운 방과 지역을 잠금 해제하세요. "Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments"는 고양이 애호가와 탐험 도전의 팬들에게 완벽한 선택입니다.
최고의 고양이 찾기 달인이 될 준비가 되셨나요?

title: C:aged
description:
게임 정보
C:aged is a short visual novel with multiple endings, hundreds of branching paths and where your choices do matter.
Story
SPOILER: The following text will reveal story information that may spoil the mystery of the game.
Where are you?
What is this place?
Where is the game that you are wanting to play?
All these questions are likely on your mind as you stare at a slow stream of falling symbols, but then...
Who is this girl?
What is her role here?
Why is she so evasive?
Why won't she let you play the game?
The mystery deepens as you get sidetracked in odd conversation after odd conversation, each time getting no closer to the game you are expected to play.

title: Tolampis
description:
게임 정보
《Tolampis》is an adventure game in a watercolor hand-painted style independently developed by Yahnart, an illustrator artist. You will play as a firefly to explore a mysterious forest named Tolampis. In a bizarre visual experience, you will unravel the dark mysteries shrouding the forest and re-energize it.
Game Features:
Explore the dark forest of Tolampis. The invasion of dark forces has caused mutations in the plants, making them full of aggression.
Players will conduct exploration while flying and search for rune fragments in every corner.
Different kinds of night elves will endow players with different abilities to solve the problems they face.
Musical elements will become an important part of the gameplay process, helping you find rune fragments.
There will be puzzle-solving parts during the exploration process. You need to use the collected information to figure out solutions to the problems.
Your exploration progress in the game will change the story direction of the game, and the development of the game will be determined by the players.
Enjoy the visual effects that integrate hand-painted animation techniques and bring life to the wonderful game visuals.
In the psychedelic music atmosphere created by the artist, take a deep breath and face various challenges.
You will look for faint lights in the dark forest and explore in the psychedelic music and whimsical ideas.

title: Have You Herd?
description:
게임 정보
Join our Discord community and experience the excitement of witnessing development updates in real-time as they happen. This game is a labor of love, and we invite you to be a part of our server where you can engage directly with our talented developers who have been developing this game since 2022!

We have so much to come in terms of levels and world building, and we can't wait to share it all with you!
HERD UP~!

title: Hotel Clover
description:
게임 정보


어릴 적, 당신은 남들과 조금 달랐습니다. 가여운 이들을 보면, 직접 나서서 도와주기 일쑤였죠. 어쩌면, 유령을 볼 수 있는 것은 이런 심성 때문일지도 모르겠습니다.

그러던 어느 날, 무자비한 퇴사마가 작은 호텔에 있는 유령들을 퇴치한다는 소문이 돌기 시작합니다. 화재로 타 죽은 가여운 이들을 말이죠.

결국, 당신은 남들보다 한발 빠르게 호텔로 출발합니다. 해야 할 일은 자명해 보입니다.


그녀들의 이야기를 들으세요.
■ 호텔에 남겨진 히로인들은 언제나 당신을 기다리고 있습니다. 그들과 함께 시간을 보내 운명의 끝을 발견하세요.





■ 모든 일에는 돈이 필요합니다. 심지어 유령을 대할 때도 마찬가지죠!






■ 대화할 때마다 매번 달라지는 히로인의 대사를 수집하세요. 그들이 특별히 좋아하는 음식을 기록해두는 것도 좋겠군요.



■ 원하는 목표에 도달하기 위해서는 다양한 상호작용 요소를 활용해야 합니다. 때때로 호텔을 떠나 다양한 활동을 찾아보세요.

title: RevenBlade
description:
게임 정보
RevenBlade features primarily melee-focused combat with abilities that are focused on getting up close to enemies.



Mobility is at the forefront of RevenBlade gameplay. Dashing, climbing, sliding, hovering, and more all give characters tons of outplay potential and depth to character mastery. Each map is also carefully designed with verticality in mind which allows you to flank and dive your opponents not just from the sides, but also from above and below.



Work together with four teammates to control Towers, allowing you to destroy and take over enemy Crystals as your own. Coordinate your efforts into a single place, or split up to contest Shard points and look for the flanking opportunities that could turn a lost objective into a massive win.

Instead of having an overly complicated shop, RevenBlade's Upgrade and Augment system allows you to level-up your abilities and choose up to four of a collection of Augments hand-tailored for each character. These Augments give bonus effects, buffs, or alterations to each ability, making them fit the specific needs of your team composition or counter enemy strategies.

title: Purge Phalanx
description:
게임 정보
Battle your way through campaigns as a warrior of humanity against the demonic corruption in fast-paced movement FPS combat. As you progress deeper the horde gets stronger but your arsenal of weapons is more than enough to prevail. If the challenge is arduous still, gather warriors online and/or split screen to triumph as a team of up to 4.
No skill tree, no stats, no grind, instant fun. Only shooting and surviving matter, so come join your brothers in arms and unleash destruction.

title: Kingsguard
description:
게임 정보
Kingsguard는 액션과 전략이 결합된 게임으로, 낮 동안에는 왕국을 건설하고 밤에는 다가오는 위험에 대비합니다. 당신은 왕국을 승리로 이끌 것인가, 아니면 어둠 속으로 몰락하게 할 것인가요?

낮 동안에는 방어를 구축합니다. 포탑과 병영을 건설하여 군대를 육성합니다.

하지만 밤에는 왕국을 방어해야 합니다. 포탑이 대신 싸우게 하거나, 군대를 지휘하거나, 직접 전장에 나가 싸울 수도 있습니다.

title: CABALL: sunset hour
description:
게임 정보
Veronica tries to return to her old life and forget about the encounter with mystical creatures. But everything changes when her only amulet ceases to protect her.
In passers-by, dark corners and her own reflection, she sees creepy creatures and hears tantalizing whispers of an approaching holiday.
Veronica finds herself in the epicenter of the Caballs games and is forced to become a full participant.
  Features:
A storyline continuation of the "Shackles of the Soul" route of the visual novel CABALL
Two romantic interests
Two endings, with no silly deaths
A visual novel with a mystical atmosphere, a kind of romance and intrigue

title: Cats With Standards
description:
게임 정보
Follow the Standards and Do as You’re Taught
Bow your head. Curl your tail. Smile when it hurts. You’ll follow rules so twisted they gnaw at your mind. Every choice is a gamble, every success a nail in the coffin of your soul.
Cats With Standards
A story-driven hidden object descent into madness. Non-stress gameplay which still claw through the sinister truth of a world that demands you to obey. The darker the rules, the darker the secrets—and the more you’ll wonder if you ever belonged at all.
Hidden Object
Bones. Yes, bones. Find them to continue. They don’t belong to the cats, but they obey anyway. A society so warped, even their appetites aren’t their own. Each hidden fragment adds to the grotesque mosaic of your crumbling reality.
Psychological Horror
A dystopian nightmare dripping in fur and fangs. Find yourself laughing when you're supposed to cry. The original soundtrack gnaws at your mind, dragging you deeper into a world where the laughter feels wrong, and silence is worse.

title: 次元沙漏的棋盘 Dimensional Racing Board
description:
게임 정보
The legendary artifact dimension hourglass has undergone a mutation! Regions and heroes from all dimensions have come here because of the pull of the artifact...... Play as your respective hero and compete with your friends on the board to see who will reach the finish line first.
Dice the dice and use your hero skills to sprint as hard as you want and trap your friends!
The game supports 2-6 players, so don't worry if you're just one person, you can find strangers in the lobby to play with......
