title: Trials of Yarbil
description:
게임 정보
Prove your worth as a samurai wizard in the Trials of Yarbil.
Start with nothing and become a mastermind of combat and magic. Fight through floors of enemies and defeat the mini-boss to get to the end of each level.
Gameplay Features:
Pick an elemental movement ability at the start of each run
Find items and weapons on the ground like bombs, swords, rocks, and sticks and use them to outsmart your enemies
Create your own strategies on the fly using the environment around you
3 unique levels with 5-7 floors and 1 mini-boss floor

title: The dead has risen
description:
게임 정보
Hope Brown, apprentice sheriff of Hudrence County, after the outbreak of the epidemic he travels to Micido, his hometown, to look for his brother, the only member of his family alive. 
During your journey, however, you will encounter various difficulties including: zombies, monsters, assassins and criminals. 
Will you be able to find out who is the mind that designed this virus to eliminate the population? 
During your exploration you will meet characters who will change your life, you will discover crimes and hidden truths.
BEWARE OF THE DARK
The torch will be essential, many places will be in darkness.

title: Curation
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of museum management! Build, customise, and expand your dream museum into a place of science and history, wonder and mystery in this award-winning casual building/management sim!
As the architect, designer, and curator, it’s your job to transform an empty plot of land into a cultural landmark. Create an unforgettable experience for your NPC visitors by selecting, buying, and placing artefacts throughout your new museum. If they have a great time, they might even donate a little cash before heading out!
Build, expand, customise
Design your museum from the ground up! Drag out walls and create uniquely shaped rooms to give your museum a one-of-a-kind layout. A range of customisation options means you can expand and modify your building, tailoring each room for the ultimate visitor experience.
Collect & Display Unique Artefacts

title: Bearstone Campsite
description:
게임 정보
Bearstone Campsite is a first-person horror game that follows the journey of our character who goes missing during a camping trip.
Maria, Paul, and Nathan should have never gone without you. It’s absurd they thought they could manage without the only sensible person in the group. But could they, really? Your friends are out there, desperate, waiting for you to come back.
Now, witness their story. You left them to this fate.
You’ve always been cautious... or maybe just a coward. But this time, what are you going to do?

title: Jelly Farm
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Jelly Farm, where farm fun gets a sweet twist! Embark on a colorful and addictive adventure as you run a unique farm where everything is made of food. Plant vibrant crops and harvest resources to create unique treats that will make your farm shine.
(explore and cultivate)
Jelly Farm is the perfect place to relax, have fun and discover your inner jelly farmer! Get ready to build your own dream farm and reap the rewards of a lifetime of fun.

title: Emberhold
description:
게임 정보
Explore and defend a fantasy kingdom in the skies!
Emberhold is a bastion of hope for the people of Astria, one that has long been in slumber. With your help, the fires of the guilds and trade will awaken anew to battle the tides of evil lurking at it's borders! Work together with allies to reclaim lost territory and quell the warring factions. Rebuild your bastion to defend against the nightmares that lie beyond the fog and below the mists.
Experiment with varying playstyles
Outfit your party the way you want! Your characters can fight with a sword and shield, wield magic, or use a gun; your party composition is yours to decide how best to take on the challenges that await.
Collect, repair, craft, and expand
Gather resources and find unique items on your adventures to restore the Emberhold to it's former glory! Craft equipment at the forge to outfit your party before you set out so that you're ready to face even the strongest foes.
Face off against challenging enemies
Use strategy and skill to take down enemies in a variety of encounters. Even the simplest of foes can pose a threat in large numbers. Take your party and challenge powerful bosses in uniquely phased fights.

title: Train World Driver
description:
게임 정보
Train World Driver에서 운전석에 앉아보세요!
편안하고 신나는 기차 운전 경험을 즐겨보세요! Train World Driver에서 여러분은 기관사가 되어 증기의 황금기부터 최첨단 기관차까지 다양한 기관차를 조종합니다. 번잡한 도시를 가로질러 승객을 태우든, 경치 좋은 풍경을 가로질러 화물을 실어나르든, 모든 여정은 새로운 모험입니다.
특징
🚂 기관차 함대
19세기의 상징적인 증기 기관차부터 오늘날의 고속철도의 경이로움까지 수십 개의 기차를 운전하세요.
📦 다양한 미션
빡빡한 배달 일정부터 경치 좋은 여가 노선까지 다양하고 재미있고 도전적인 미션을 완료하세요.
🌍 동적 미션 생성기
Train World 플레이어와 소통하세요! Train World 플레이어는 저장 파일을 사용하여 철도 네트워크를 기반으로 미션을 생성하고 공유하여 무한한 게임 플레이 가능성을 만들 수 있습니다.
🎮 배우기 쉬운 컨트롤
모든 사람을 위해 설계된 Train World Driver는 간단하게 유지합니다. 속도, 타이밍 및 정밀도를 관리하여 성공하세요.
🗺️ 숨 막힐 듯한 환경
다양하고 몰입감 넘치는 풍경을 여행하며 기차 운전의 기술을 마스터하세요.
Train World Driver는 기차 애호가와 느긋하고 매력적인 경험을 찾는 캐주얼 게이머 모두에게 적합합니다. 오늘 기차 운전사가 되는 즐거움을 발견하세요!

title: Sky Fields
description:
게임 정보
Sky Fields에 오신 것을 환영합니다
드론이 되어 Sky Fields를 탐험하고, 떠 있는 다양한 섬을 여행하며 슬라임 컬렉션을 확장하세요. 다양한 슬라임 속이 가득한 독특한 환경을 탐험하면서 싸우고, 자원과 원시 슬라임을 수집하여 새로운 슬라임을 부화시키고 키우세요. 각 슬라임은 고유한 외모, 강점, 희귀성을 지니고 있습니다!
각 섬의 고도는 만날 수 있는 슬라임을 결정하고, 환경 자체를 변화시켜 나무, 식물, 동물군을 형성합니다. 이는 모든 전투에 전략적 깊이를 더하며, 각 발견을 흥미롭고 예측할 수 없는 경험으로 만듭니다.
특징:
탐험
Sky Fields의 세계로 날아가 다양한 섬과 생태계를 넘나들며 탐험하세요. 그러나 조심하세요 — 폭군 군대가 황량한 땅에 숨어 있습니다! 그들에게 맞설 수 있나요? 강화된 성소를 탐험하고, 위험한 섬을 정복하며, 여행 중에 귀중한 자원을 모으세요.
전투 및 레벨업
턴제 전투에서 전략적으로 공격 순서를 정하세요. 다양한 팀 조합을 시도하고 슬라임 간의 시너지를 활용하세요. 근접 전투 유닛 뒤에 지원 유닛과 마법사를 배치하여 이상적인 배치를 만드세요. 강력한 적을 만나고, 레벨업하여 팀을 강화하세요.
나만의 슬라임 만들기!

title: Death Trap Mountain
description:
게임 정보
Venture into 8 enormous stages brimming with challenges, rewards, enhancements, and formidable enemies as you assist Mitch in his quest to locate his missing canine companion. Death Trap Mountain presents a timeless adventure in platforming, incorporating numerous novel concepts. The terrain presents increasingly challenging scenarios for Mitch to navigate. Mitch is likely to encounter numerous adversaries and forge a few allies in his journey! A sinister threat looms over the realm as the black dragon Illugir awaits in his domain.
Bellow are some zoomed out images of the first 3 levels. (Work in Progress)

title: Killer Depths
description:
게임 정보
Killer Depths is a submarine horror game. Study the monsters that lurk below and adjust the settings on your vessel according to what you think is currently stalking you. 
FEATURES 
Over a dozen different creatures haunt the waters. Many can not be seen or heard, requiring more intuitive investigation.
The brightness, noise and the speed of the vessel will attract or scare off monsters.
Monster attacks can cause flooding, power outages and explosions. Use tools to keep the vessel from imploding.
Vigilant divers may uncover encrypted messages revealing details about the world and their employer.
What you see and hear may not be real.

title: Power Chips
description:
게임 정보
Get your mech suit ready and blast through the bots on your way to uncover why a new wave of destruction is sweeping the city! Power Chips is a love letter to classic 2D 16-bit platforming and shooter games that’s fun for the whole family. 

One of the many features in Power Chips is the crisp movement, specifically dashing, which gives players a burst of forward momentum. This not only speeds up movement but also opens up new platforming possibilities and combat strategies, allowing for quicker evasion and better control when lining up attacks. Additionally, wall jumping lets the player cling to and scale vertical surfaces, adding depth to platforming and enabling players to scale walls to avoid attacks.

You can attack the main bosses in any order. After each boss is vanquished a new a weapon will be gained, some bosses are weaker to another bosses weapon so plan your route wisely!

title: Cardalaxy
description:
게임 정보
Cardalaxy is a card upgrading game with 4X inspiration and
5+ different victories.
Upgrade Planets
Upgrade your planets with buildings to increase their value. Advance through multiple tiers of buildings, each with better effects and bonuses.
Research, Explore, Develop
Collect points and use them in each of the different systems to advance your empire.

title: How West Clement Was Kinda Won
description:
게임 정보
A drifter finds themselves in a town that is knee deep in a dire situation. The town is going to be taken over by a big ol' company! And you just so happened to arrive right on time to help out these citizens in need!
Play through 4 chapters of that shows the best of Clement County!
Turn-based combat with up to 3 other NPC companions that you love so very much!
Also those companions I was talking about? There's more than 20 of them you could unlock!
Multiple areas in one of the dumbest parts of the world!
Build your character by leveling up, eating pizza, drinking soda and frickin' fighting!
Fight enemies like feral zombies, construction workers, crocodile dudes and other bad things!
Amazing special attacks like Vomit, Super Kick, Skull Crack and MP3 Player!
Everything, art and code, hand-made with love!!!
autokwd: How West Clement Was Kinda Won

title: Superstellar
description:
게임 정보
Superstellar offers a fresh take on the survivor genre with its advanced stat synergies, extensive build diversity and crucial player choice. Roam endless space and engage in frantic combat with responsive, racing-like movement. Complete missions and milestones to unlock new spaceships, each equipped with new weapons and exclusive upgrade choices. Choose your upgrades wisely and fight to stay alive as long as possible against hordes of pesky enemies! Runs typically last about 20 minutes, but skilled players might endure a bit longer.

How long can you survive?
⚔️ Gameplay & Combat
Endless battles – Survive as long as possible in a randomly generated space environment.
Massive enemy waves – Face over 500 enemies at once!
Enemy territories – Each with unique enemies, events and challenges.
Dynamic events - Adapt to hazards like solar flares, asteroid belts, darkness, and radiation!
All out war – A randomized brutal mode that combines all enemy territories into one.
🚀 Ships & Classes
🌀 Orion – Energy and electricity-based, specializing in electrocution.
🔥 Phoenix – Fire-based, focused on igniting and burning enemies.
❄️ Titan – Ice and summoner-based, capable of chilling, freezing, and shattering foes.
Each ship boasts a game-changing ultimate ability aswell, and comes in light, medium, and heavy armored variants with different stats and ability enhancements.

title: Gatestodian
description:
게임 정보
Defend the Gates from a demonic invasion and become a hero!
Your mission is to protect the Gates that hold back endless hordes of demons, eager to break through and destroy the peaceful inhabitants of the kingdom. In this epic battle, you will be guided by a wise mentor — an old warrior whose advice will lead you to victory against overwhelming forces.
Choose one of four unique heroes, each with their own style of combat and abilities. Upgrade and enhance your chosen hero's skills to adapt to the ever-growing threats and discover new strategies to combat the terrifying forces of evil.
Key Features:
Four Unique Heroes: Each hero has their own playstyle and skill set. Choose the one that best suits your strategy and master their abilities.
Advice from a Wise Mentor: A seasoned veteran will offer you valuable guidance that may turn the tide of battle… but should you always follow his advice?
Upgrade System: Develop your hero, improve their abilities, and create your own unique build to face the most dangerous enemies.
Epic Battles Against Demons: Prepare for intense battles where every decision, skill, and upgrade can change the course of the fight.
Are you ready to stop the demons and save the kingdom? The fate of the world is in your hands!

title: BACKROOMS INSIDE THE ESCAPE
description:
게임 정보
Venture through a labyrinth of seemingly endless, creepily familiar corridors based on popular Creepypasta lore. Experience the terror with high-quality graphics that bring the eerie environment to life, and envelop yourself in a soundscape of detailed 3D audio that enhances every haunting whisper and distant footstep. The atmosphere is thick with dread, filled with puzzles that challenge the mind and screamers that test your resolve, ensuring a pulse-pounding journey into the unknown.
High-Quality Graphics – Immerse yourself in an environment where every detail is crafted to enhance the horror.
Detailed 3D Audio – Every sound is designed to amplify the suspense and immerse you deeper into the game.
Creepy Atmosphere – The constant, oppressive dread is carefully maintained to keep you on edge.
Challenging Puzzles – Test your wits with intricate puzzles that integrate seamlessly into the narrative.
Effective Screamers – Prepare for heart-stopping moments that are sure to keep the adrenaline pumping.

title: Cat and Isle of Stars
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Isle of Stars, a tranquil paradise where cats roam freely and island life feels untouched by time. In "Cat and Isle of Stars," you’ll manage a unique cat café, build bonds with local residents, and discover the joy of daily life, from farming and fishing to crafting cozy spaces for your cats.
As you settle into this charming world, you may sense the presence of something more—a legend that whispers through the island. By night, the cats may lead you into parts of the island’s history long forgotten, and cryptic hints from residents suggest the island hides a greater purpose. Is your arrival a twist of fate, or does this land hold something special for you?
Game Features:
Cat Café Haven: Decorate and nurture your café to create a warm haven for island cats and visitors alike.
Island Legends: Follow the cats’ quiet guidance as you explore the island’s hidden lore under moonlit skies.
Resident Connections: Each resident has a unique story tied to the island’s past; helping them reveals more about the world and its secrets.
Serene Island Life: Tend crops, craft, and fish along the shores to build your own vibrant corner on the island.
Protect the Isle: As whispers of outsiders’ plans circulate, the cats’ behaviors grow strange, hinting that they may be leading you to an ancient strength, perhaps the island’s last hope for peace.

title: Purge Phalanx
description:
게임 정보
Battle your way through campaigns as a warrior of humanity against the demonic corruption in fast-paced movement FPS combat. As you progress deeper the horde gets stronger but your arsenal of weapons is more than enough to prevail. If the challenge is arduous still, gather warriors online and/or split screen to triumph as a team of up to 4.
No skill tree, no stats, no grind, instant fun. Only shooting and surviving matter, so come join your brothers in arms and unleash destruction.

title: Kingsguard
description:
게임 정보
Kingsguard는 액션과 전략이 결합된 게임으로, 낮 동안에는 왕국을 건설하고 밤에는 다가오는 위험에 대비합니다. 당신은 왕국을 승리로 이끌 것인가, 아니면 어둠 속으로 몰락하게 할 것인가요?

낮 동안에는 방어를 구축합니다. 포탑과 병영을 건설하여 군대를 육성합니다.

하지만 밤에는 왕국을 방어해야 합니다. 포탑이 대신 싸우게 하거나, 군대를 지휘하거나, 직접 전장에 나가 싸울 수도 있습니다.

title: CABALL: sunset hour
description:
게임 정보
Veronica tries to return to her old life and forget about the encounter with mystical creatures. But everything changes when her only amulet ceases to protect her.
In passers-by, dark corners and her own reflection, she sees creepy creatures and hears tantalizing whispers of an approaching holiday.
Veronica finds herself in the epicenter of the Caballs games and is forced to become a full participant.
  Features:
A storyline continuation of the "Shackles of the Soul" route of the visual novel CABALL
Two romantic interests
Two endings, with no silly deaths
A visual novel with a mystical atmosphere, a kind of romance and intrigue

빡빡한 배달 일정부터 경치 좋은 여가 노선까지 다양하고 재미있고 도전적인 미션을 완료하세요.
🌍 동적 미션 생성기
Train World 플레이어와 소통하세요! Train World 플레이어는 저장 파일을 사용하여 철도 네트워크를 기반으로 미션을 생성하고 공유하여 무한한 게임 플레이 가능성을 만들 수 있습니다.
🎮 배우기 쉬운 컨트롤
모든 사람을 위해 설계된 Train World Driver는 간단하게 유지합니다. 속도, 타이밍 및 정밀도를 관리하여 성공하세요.
🗺️ 숨 막힐 듯한 환경
다양하고 몰입감 넘치는 풍경을 여행하며 기차 운전의 기술을 마스터하세요.
Train World Driver는 기차 애호가와 느긋하고 매력적인 경험을 찾는 캐주얼 게이머 모두에게 적합합니다. 오늘 기차 운전사가 되는 즐거움을 발견하세요!

title: Sky Fields
description:
게임 정보
Sky Fields에 오신 것을 환영합니다
드론이 되어 Sky Fields를 탐험하고, 떠 있는 다양한 섬을 여행하며 슬라임 컬렉션을 확장하세요. 다양한 슬라임 속이 가득한 독특한 환경을 탐험하면서 싸우고, 자원과 원시 슬라임을 수집하여 새로운 슬라임을 부화시키고 키우세요. 각 슬라임은 고유한 외모, 강점, 희귀성을 지니고 있습니다!
각 섬의 고도는 만날 수 있는 슬라임을 결정하고, 환경 자체를 변화시켜 나무, 식물, 동물군을 형성합니다. 이는 모든 전투에 전략적 깊이를 더하며, 각 발견을 흥미롭고 예측할 수 없는 경험으로 만듭니다.
특징:
탐험
Sky Fields의 세계로 날아가 다양한 섬과 생태계를 넘나들며 탐험하세요. 그러나 조심하세요 — 폭군 군대가 황량한 땅에 숨어 있습니다! 그들에게 맞설 수 있나요? 강화된 성소를 탐험하고, 위험한 섬을 정복하며, 여행 중에 귀중한 자원을 모으세요.
전투 및 레벨업
턴제 전투에서 전략적으로 공격 순서를 정하세요. 다양한 팀 조합을 시도하고 슬라임 간의 시너지를 활용하세요. 근접 전투 유닛 뒤에 지원 유닛과 마법사를 배치하여 이상적인 배치를 만드세요. 강력한 적을 만나고, 레벨업하여 팀을 강화하세요.
나만의 슬라임 만들기!

title: Consortium's Fall: Echoes of Xo'lara
description:
게임 정보
Consortium’s Fall is a sci-fi roguelite twin-stick shooter about a lone hero’s fight against his people’s oppressor. Infiltrate the three bases of the Stellar Consortium, fight the grunts and bosses that guard them, growing stronger with upgrades and weapons you pick up along the way - all while uncovering knowledge and secrets of long gone past. With every new run, you will master the very elements the enemy seeks to exploit. Bring about the Consortium’s fall, no matter what it takes.

You are Zyx, a Cilian scholar compelled to infiltrate the tyrannical Stellar Consortium in the name of his people and home planet, Zolareus. Zolareus is home to an abundance of Eternum, a powerful component the Consortium uses in their relentless pursuit of galactic dominance. If nothing is done, the Stellar Consortium will suck Zolareus dry and secure your people as one of their pawns.

Will you persevere and fight back, before it’s too late? On your journey throughout the enemy’s territory, you will encounter mysterious pillars with messages from ancient times. Decode their scripture to gain better understanding, and uncover knowledge that will help you in your rebellion!

title: Exot
description:
게임 정보
After long years of labor, Maurice was finally able to treat himself to the cruise of his dreams. A brand new concept, which promises great thrills as you approach a mysterious region of the universe: the Exot galaxy!
Following the incompetence of the crew on board, our hero finds himself stranded with his escape pod on an unknown planet, with no hope of leaving...
C.L.I.C., YOUR BEST FRIEND
The manufacturers of your Compact Loyal Integrated Console (C.L.I.C.) have locked certain features: unlock them to access new resources and improve its performance to be able survive in the Exot galaxy.
YOUR SHIP, A CUSTOMIZED BASE
You begin your adventure in an escape pod: you will be safe there, even it is not fully functional. Transform it into a truly tailor-made base by adding new rooms, grow rooms, etc. Convert it into a ship by adding engines and anti-G systems, and take off.
EXPLORE THE GALAXY
Each planet in the Exot galaxy contains specific resources that you will need to progress. To achieve this, several paths are available to you: some are easy, others will challenge you.
EVOLVING WORKSHOPS
Workshops will allow you to craft many items and resources: feed them with fuel, automate them, improve their performance and try to unlock all the available recipes.
MAKE ENCOUNTERS
Domesticate the local fauna, do business with merchants, confront various hostile entities to try to find a place for yourself in this little-known galaxy.
THE MASTER OF THE PLACE
During your first trip into Hyperspace, you risk having an astonishing encounter. A legendary entity awaits you there: the Catgo. It will test you through a series of quests to complete. The rewards you earn will open new doors for you…
FEATURES

title: Hallway Shot
description:
게임 정보
Halls that loop forever. You are given tools to break out of the loop but can you truly escape? Hallway shot is what happens when you condense a survival horror game into an extremely long hallway.
Five Halls are randomized with a new hall only replacing an old one when a solution is found. Search through furniture for useful items. Halls will be full of random puzzles, enemies, friends, and a variety of other things. In Hallway Shot you find items, solve puzzles, and escape monsters to solve every hall and eventually leave the hallway. Even if you can't figure out a hall's puzzle, there are numerous alternative solutions that let you remove it from the loop and try to solve it again later.

title: Whiskers and Wizardry
description:
게임 정보
자신감 넘치는 마법 고양이가 되어 액션 가득한 로그라이트 게임을 경험하세요! 독특한 마법을 만들고, 미니언들과 강력한 보스들을 물리치며, 숲을 악으로부터 정화하고, 인간 마법사 주인을 구하세요. Margoq's Lair의 제작자들이 만든 게임입니다.
상상도 못한 자만하는 마법 고양이를 플레이하세요!
누구를 속이죠? 누구나 멋진 고양이 마법사가 되고 싶지 않았나요?!

title: Shadowbridge - The Genesis
description:
게임 정보
In Shadowbridge: The Genesis, you step into a rich fantasy world in this immersive point-and-click adventure. As Ezra's ally, you'll travel through a series of diverse and intricately designed dimensions, each with its own unique landscapes, challenges, and threats. Your mission; to solve the enigmatic puzzles scattered across these realms and uncover the secrets behind the sudden collapse of the Balance Dimension.
Explore strange, fantastical worlds teeming with hidden clues, ancient mysteries, and treacherous obstacles. With each dimension you traverse, you’ll encounter peculiar inhabitants, cryptic messages, and intricate riddles that will test your wits. Can you decipher the secrets that hold these worlds together and help Ezra bring peace to Shadowbridge once again? Every choice you make and puzzle you solve brings you one step closer to restoring the balance or plunging the dimensions into eternal chaos.
Prepare for an unforgettable journey through mind-bending landscapes, where your puzzle-solving skills and keen observation will be key to saving the dimensions from destruction. Will you rise to the challenge and become a true guardian of balance?"

title: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side
description:
게임 정보
Tsurine is a PsySpec wrapped up in the intensity of her job, and the stress that comes with dissociative amnesia. One night, a mysterious woman offers to help recover her lost memories. All Tsurine must do in exchange is hunt down the missing fragments to an unusual key.
Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side is an intricate choice-heavy psychological medicore thriller about an amnesiac facing both real and mental horrors within a world akin to an endless, liminal hospital. 
The game utilizes a fusion of Visual Novel, RPG, and Point-&-Click mechanics to paint a story about how people choose to cope with trauma, and the way it shapes one's identity. While the main story of Ad Nauseam is firm, it features hundreds of branching paths, choices, and open exploration areas to engage in along the way. Every action you take, and every choice you make, is remembered and seen through to its very end.
Uncover the secrets of this strange world, and the ones lurking within Tsurine's forgotten past. Will you accept your limitations when faced with peril, or will you dive deep into delusion and madness for a chance at hope?
Can you face the world? Can you face yourself?
Are you sure?
The world of Ad Nauseam is heavily inspired by the works and the aesthetics of Yami Kawaii, Liminality, Traumacore, and both Modern & Pastel Goth. It features a long, diverse, and dark soundtrack done by lolratz combining elements of Breakcore, Hyperpop, and Witch House music genres.
Character Artist: @Catfan1000
Background & Soundtrack Artist: @lolratz

title: Star Watch
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Star Watch is a casual game combining elements of "light-action shooting" and "creature care and management." Players take on the role of the Star Watch commander, leading a squad of unique monsters to fight against the evil alien invaders—the Cows, and reclaim the occupied planets and their precious relics!
Game Features
20 Unique Monsters: Each monster has distinct abilities and appearances, allowing players to freely form their own custom squads.
6 Major Planet Levels: Explore planets with unique environmental challenges, each featuring a powerful BOSS with special abilities.
Easy-to-Learn Controls: All actions are performed by simple clicks, making the game accessible to players of all ages.
Diverse Strategy Choices: Combine turret controls with carefully selected monster abilities to fend off enemies, adapting strategies to different planetary environments.
Planet Relic Collection: Defeat the final BOSS on each planet to reclaim valuable relics, enhancing your monster squad for future battles.
Gameplay
Players will need to raise monsters and manage resources to expand their influence across the galaxy. When enemies attack, players must skillfully operate turrets and unleash special monster abilities to fend off the invading Cows while protecting their squad. After each level, players can earn rewards to upgrade their monsters and technologies, further strengthening their forces for tougher challenges ahead.
company: 鈴夢有限公司, 赤腳蛙工作室

title: Dragon Gate: Tournament
description:
게임 정보
Dragon Gate: Tournament is a futuristic arcade combat racer for up to four players in which only the fastest and most skillful survive. In fast-paced, short races, you fight for every metre while an orbital laser pulverises anyone who falls too far behind. Knocked out? No problem! With homing missiles, you can still intervene in the action and decide who comes out on top. Are you ready to become the champion?
In Dragon Gate: Tournament, up to four players race against each other in multiple high-speed sprints, competing to earn points. A sprint ends when only one player remains, as any player who falls too far behind the leader is eliminated by a powerful enormous orbital beam.

title: Ryder
description:
게임 정보
In Ryder, you’ll embark on a journey through a vibrant, low-poly world filled with puzzles and creatures waiting to be restored. As a Ryder, you can bond with over 60 creatures, each with unique traits that help you solve more than 100 puzzles. Explore four colorful regions, use creature abilities to overcome puzzles, complete your bestiary, and climb the Sanguine Mountain to fulfill your destiny.
Step into the role of a Ryder—an ethereal being with the ability to inhabit living creatures through a process known as bonding. You are tasked with restoring the souls of creatures hidden away long ago and must journey to the summit of the mystical Sanguine Mountain.
Each creature’s soul is stored behind a Sacred Site puzzle. Puzzles are solved by retrieving and intermediately using orbs from within the puzzle area. Strategically switch between your party of creatures in the right sequence to get the orbs to the Sacred Site. Completing a Sacred Site brings the creature back into the wild.

title: Eldritch Escape
description:
게임 정보
In this roguelike bullet-heaven, Earth has been consumed by an ancient eldritch god. Form a customizable squad of survivors and explore decaying, metroidvania-inspired worlds trapped within the god’s belly. Battle endless waves of nightmarish creatures, extract resources, rescue survivors, uncover forbidden knowledge, and search for a way out.
Portals powered by ancient eldritch forces link worlds and realities, forming a tangled web. With a limited oxygen supply, your squad has just 20 minutes to navigate the portal network, jumping from world to world in search of the one escape route. Can you escape the void in time?

title: Sizebound
description:
게임 정보
Sizebound
Sizebound is a first person puzzle game where you will use physics and perspective slightly differently.
In this game you will have to solve puzzles with objects that will vary in size and weight, by going through portals, by changings your perspective of the object, to solve different kinds of puzzle rooms.
You will be guided through your adventure by Clappy an AI agent part of a laboratory called "The Nexus" where all the tests will take place.
Key Features
In-game Level editor
Single player campaign
(Level count: not known at the moment)
 Coop campaign
In game modding tools
(Custom props/play models, and possibly more)
More about the game
This game is inspired by Portal and Superliminal and was at started for the GMTK 2024 with the theme "Built to scale".

title: Chalice of Highland
description:
게임 정보
⚔︎ Guide a young bird on his quest to find the Chalice of Highland ⚔︎
In Chalice of Highland, embark on an epic adventure inspired by Gameboy aesthetics. Explore the world and dive into six challenging dungeons to recover the Chalice of Highland. As a brave bird, you’ll wield a sword to battle enemies and use your unique ability to fly, uncovering secrets along the way.
Key Features :
6 Unique Dungeons: Each dungeon presents its own mechanics and challenges, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.
7 Epic Bosses: Face off against formidable bosses guarding each piece of the Chalice of Highland.
7 Dream Sequences: Uncover the hero's backstory through dream sequences that reveal the mysterious past of the Highlands.
Customizable Screen Colors: Choose from different screen color palettes to enhance your retro gaming experience.
Classic or Widescreen: Play in the original Gameboy format or switch to a 16:9 widescreen view for a modern twist.

title: Zoominoes
description:
게임 정보
Crazy Combos 
Upgrade animals using snacks and souvenirs to create crazy combos. Score thousands or even millions of points!
Collect Animals
Zoominoes is filled with tons of animals from cute to mythical. Try and collect them all!
Special Events
Special events at the end of each week make the game even more challenging. Plus, there's lava!

title: Welcome Home
description:
게임 정보
Enter the shadows of one of the darkest, most enigmatic buildings you’ll ever explore. Inside these cursed walls, nothing is as it seems. Each step uncovers fragments of a story drenched in deceit, desperation, and survival. You will meet liars, killers, and victims of this harrowing environment—along with a few who may hold the keys to your salvation.
As a nameless protagonist, your journey is driven by the chilling need to uncover the secrets buried deep within "the house." Search for hidden paths, solve cryptic mysteries, and confront the horrors that await. But beware: Not all doors should be opened, and not all who dwell here wish you well.
Exploration Meets Terror: Delve into a grim, atmospheric world designed to unsettle you with haunting visuals and an eerie soundtrack.
Meaningful Choices: Your decisions matter. Engage with NPCs through branching dialogue, altering your path and the unfolding narrative.
Survival Over Shooting: Ammo is scarce, and danger is everywhere. Choose your battles wisely—sometimes, running is the only option.
Unlock the Unknown: Seek out vital items and NPCs to progress, piecing together the disturbing truth of your environment.
A Distinctive Retro Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in the original Game Boy resolution (160x144), brought to life with stunning, handcrafted pixel art that adds a nostalgic yet deeply unsettling charm to every scene.

title: Jane Austen Simulator: Pride and Prejudice
description:
게임 정보
Improve your word-guessing skills with this unique twist on Hangman! Guess sentences from Jane Austen’s Pride and Prejudice. Unlock audio clips and images. With no way to lose, you will be immersed in the greatest love story ever written. Who is “a single man of large fortune”? D_r_y
Think like Jane Austen
In this game you'll step into the shoes of Jane Austen and write the book Pride and Prejudice just like she did it more than 200 years ago. This is a perfect opportunity to show off how much you actually remember from the book.
Gameplay similar to Hangman
Ok, maybe not exactly the same way as Jane Austen. You'll not have to come up with the story yourself *phew*. You will go through the book in a way that is very similar to the word game Hangman. One sentence at a time, guessing letters. If the letter you've guessed, is in the sentence, it will be revealed and you can continue guessing. If you guess wrong, some of the revealed letters will be removed. 
A new way to Enjoy a Book
The proses of guessing the words to progress through the book really makes you pay attention to what you are reading. You get to see some clever use of words that may have gone past you when just reading. You will feel much closer to the text because you are taking such an active role.
autokwd: Jane Austen Simulator: Pride and Prejudice

title: Kioku: Last Summer
description:
게임 정보
Kioku: Last Summer is a heartfelt adventure set on the remote island of Kioku, where you play as Asti, a young girl just settling into her new home. As summer unfolds, so does a journey filled with wonder, nostalgia, and the allure of childhood memories. Kioku invites players of all ages to step into a world where every day is a new adventure, every friend holds a story, and magic is hiding in plain sight
Explore a Unique Island World
The island of Kioku is inspired by Scandinavian landscapes mixed with Japanese aesthetics, blending vibrant colors, rustic charm, and a touch of mysticism. As you explore, immerse yourself in the nostalgic beauty of summer, meeting friends and watching as the island’s story unfolds.
Meet a Cast of Colorful Characters
Kioku’s inhabitants are diverse, friendly, and sometimes mysterious. Each new connection enriches your experience, and your choices shape these relationships, creating memories that echo long after summer ends.

title: Oakley the Leafbug
description:
게임 정보
Summary : 
Oakley the Leafbug is a fast-paced 2.5D platformer built in Godot.
Features :
2 Playable Characters (Oakley the Leafbug & Snowblitz the Arctic Fox)
Drift on Oakley's leaf to surf waves and kickflip your way into gaining more speed!
Snowblitz can swap between two control sets, roll mode and trick mode to chain combos.
2 Zone Types (Race & Score Attack)
Race : Get to the finish line as fast as possible to complete the zone.
Score Attack : Score enough points to pass all score gates to complete the zone.

title: Death Trap Mountain
description:
게임 정보
Venture into 8 enormous stages brimming with challenges, rewards, enhancements, and formidable enemies as you assist Mitch in his quest to locate his missing canine companion. Death Trap Mountain presents a timeless adventure in platforming, incorporating numerous novel concepts. The terrain presents increasingly challenging scenarios for Mitch to navigate. Mitch is likely to encounter numerous adversaries and forge a few allies in his journey! A sinister threat looms over the realm as the black dragon Illugir awaits in his domain.
Bellow are some zoomed out images of the first 3 levels. (Work in Progress)

title: Killer Depths
description:
게임 정보
Killer Depths is a submarine horror game. Study the monsters that lurk below and adjust the settings on your vessel according to what you think is currently stalking you. 
FEATURES 
Over a dozen different creatures haunt the waters. Many can not be seen or heard, requiring more intuitive investigation.
The brightness, noise and the speed of the vessel will attract or scare off monsters.
Monster attacks can cause flooding, power outages and explosions. Use tools to keep the vessel from imploding.
Vigilant divers may uncover encrypted messages revealing details about the world and their employer.
What you see and hear may not be real.

title: Sticky Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
Sticky Mayhem is a rogue-like action game where you can build human towers & can battle with each other.
Craft your human tower by understanding the physics & balance of human tower building. Pick the right soldiers, armor, weapon, engines, etc. for combat.
In battle, use speed, shape of the tower and your weapons to attack and destroy your opponent.
After every round use the earnings to upgrade your soldiers, armor, weapon, engines, etc. for the next forthcoming rounds.
Use Sandbox mode to experiment on pyramid structure, combination of soldiers & weapons.

title: StarSim: BattleZone
description:
게임 정보
StarSim: BattleZone는 StarSim 우주를 배경으로 한 실시간 전략(RTS) 게임입니다.
게임 플레이는 기지 건설, 자원 수집, 새로운 기술 연구, 방어 건설, 유닛 훈련 등과 같은 클래식 RTS 메커니즘을 포함합니다.
여러분은 Home Ascolate의 부대를 지휘하여 자원이 풍부한 무인 행성의 통제권을 장악하게 됩니다.
캠페인에는 Home Ascolate와 다른 세력 간의 갈등을 보여주는 스토리 중심의 임무가 포함되어 있습니다.

title: Type Rider
description:
게임 정보
"Type Rider" is a typing-based tower defense game where you summon units by typing.
The protagonist, once known as the "Type Rider" for her high-speed typing skills while riding a motorcycle, has been tasked with resolving issues in a world overrun by ink lifeforms. She decides to ride her beloved bike once again.
Build Your Unique Deck: Construct your own deck with over 50 unique ink monsters, each possessing various elements such as attributes, classes, and special skills.
Typing Summons: A system where you summon ink monsters by successfully typing. Counter the approaching ink lifeforms by summoning your own creatures.
Strategic Battles: Use the order of summoning and spell cards strategically to gain an advantage in battle.

title: Star Ash Fleet
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
"Star Ash Fleet" is a real-time strategy game with unique gameplay mechanics. The game simulates interstellar battlefield environments on a 2D plane, creating a holographic battlefield projection for the player. Players will take on the role of a newly appointed fleet commander, using various gameplay strategies to tackle meticulously designed mission levels and experience thrilling battles.
The interstellar war between the Earth Human Federation and the Pleiades Star Cluster Empire has already spread across the entire galaxy, and the war, which has lasted for centuries, is about to reach a critical turning point. The Federation fleet, commanded by the player, accidentally uncovers the Empire’s conspiracy during a battle. After countless efforts and sacrifices, a significant historical event will pull both the entire war and the player into an uncontrollable situation.
Core Gameplay
Unique Control Experience
We have designed a proprietary fleet control system that combines elements from traditional RTS games while further simplifying and innovating the gameplay. This allows players to easily control a fleet with multiple warships. At the same time, players can execute precise micro-management of individual ships within the fleet through simple controls.

title: Night Plane
description:
게임 정보
Night Plane is a thrilling airborne hospitality simulator that costs way less than a plane ticket! Board passengers, assist with their trivial struggles, and resolve emergency situations all by yourself in this hyper-realistic representation of a commercial flight in 1999 New Zealand. Enjoy the world-class airport, babies crying at 30,000 feet, and very reliable aircraft systems. Also, please don't let the psychopomp fly the aircraft.
Board passengers, keep them comfortable, and strive to provide a survivable flight for all paying customers.
Decide who boards the plane! Customer satisfaction is what it's all about, but some passengers just aren't worth the hassle. If someone looks like a troublemaker, feel free to reject them at boarding and luxuriate in their absence during the flight.
Countless (99+) interactable objects, both in the airport and on the plane!
Hyper-realist representation of 1999 New Zealand.
Unravel the occult mysteries of the airplane bathroom...
And pet the cat!

title: The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls
description:
게임 정보
- Welcome to the Planet NESS-444 -
The Planet NESS-444 is a vast world full of Adventure,
enemies to face or to have as allies in battle,
valuable resources to gather, mysteries and secrets to unveil.
Climb the world's highest peaks to discover breathtaking views or
wander into the depths of the planet to reveal ruins of ancient lost civilizations.
Unique biomes scattered across the land waiting for you to explore them,
until you are able to discover the truth...

- Nessky -

title: The Immortal Scripture
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
An ancient emperor accidentally obtained 《The Immortal Scripture》 and embarked on a journey of battles to unlock its secrets, heading towards the path of immortality...
Unique Gameplay
In 《The Immortal Scripture》 players can freely choose which side to battle. What if you choose the left side and lose to the AI-controlled right side? Then just switch to the right side and fight against the AI-controlled left side.
Ridiculously Strong AI
The AI in 《The Immortal Scripture》 uses the latest reinforcement learning algorithms. After long periods of training and fine-tuning, it ensures that every level is a challenge that even the author can easily lose to. The goal is to provide players with a refreshing and engaging gaming experience.
Beyond Balance
Each level in《The Immortal Scripture》 has undergone repeated calculations to ensure the overall strength is evenly matched on both sides. Additionally, it ensures that each character's card abilities are neither overly strong nor overly weak.
The Author is a Good Person
To help players clear the game, at the very beginning, the author offers a sacrifice feature. By sacrificing your subjects, you can directly alter the stats of the characters on the board, making it easier to clear the level. Hopefully, this will help you progress!

title: Curry Princess GOLD
description:
게임 정보
A casual game where you collect falling spices, earn gold, and cook delicious curry.
Enjoy three different game modes:
Classic Mode: An endless score-attack challenge, a remastered version of Curry Princess originally released for iOS/Android in 2018, now reimagined for console with enhanced gameplay.
Story Mode: Unfold an engaging story as you progress through episodes.
2P Mode: Play local two-player content. Compete against each other for victory, or work together to overcome the Curry Master's trials—it's up to you!
These three modes offer a variety of ways to play!

title: Build The Sun
description:
게임 정보
Explore, Build, Expand, And Build The Sun.
This world is big and mysterious. But thankfully out of the darkness come these little black sprites! House them, feed them, and spend them on harvesting resources, building things and making new settlements!
Playing entirely with the mouse, you will be exploring a generated map to find a nice spot for your first settlement. Collect some basic resources and upgrade this settlement until you need to find new resources, for which you'll have to expand your base to new areas!
But these tiny sprites have big ambitions! They want to light up this dark world, by building the Sun.
Will you help them?

title: Underground Security Inc
description:
게임 정보
Underground Security Inc is a unique blend of rogue-lite, tower defense and worker-placement elements. As a head manager of the local dungeon, you are responsible for its security and profitability. 
       Beware! you must face against waves of "heroes" bent on liberating your gold. Build traps, hire minions and cast spells to repel the would-be-adventurers.

title: AquaDark
description:
게임 정보
In the ‘80s, there were no aquaparks in your country. Or, at least, that was the case until you opened one yourself. As the owner, you want to memorize this moment and record everything on your VHS tapes. Everything is perfect, people are happy and have fun all day. However, at night, you start to notice something unsettling, creepy, dark…

Game features:
Dark Atmosphere - immerse yourself in the thrilling atmosphere of an aquapark, where not everything is as it seems.
Aquapark Management - manage your aquapark, serve the customers, restock the shelves, and record everything.
Day and Night - talk to happy customers during the day and embrace darkness while being alone at night.
Blissful Dream - let the customers in, check their tickets, sell toys and swimsuits, sometimes clean the aquapark. It’s a dream job…during the day.
Recurring Nightmare - check cameras, patrol the aquapark, and search for anything unusual. Even if everything is unusual…
Strange Events - for a second you thought that you saw a head between balls. Was it real? Or was it just your imagination? You can never be sure.

You built your aquapark yourself. Or you paid for it, to be specific. You thought of everything - water slides, playgrounds, sports swimming pool etc. However, as you keep an eye on your facility, you start to notice new sections. Hidden rooms, sections that definitely weren’t included in the project. There is only one way to find out what they are.

As more and more unsettling events occur, you are desperate to find out what’s happening. Some NPCs may know more than you could imagine. Talk to them, make your choices and discover the true cause of strange events in your property. Will you be able to unearth the truth?

title: CloverPit
description:
게임 정보
You wake up in a rusty, narrow cell, standing over a dangerously unstable grate.
Someone has kidnapped you, demanding payment, and your only way out is to play the Slot Machine and pay off your debt.
Don’t let yourself fall —literally— into ruin!

title: Drill To Hell : Clicked Too Deep
description:
게임 정보
A clicker where you delve into the depths of the earth!
Begin by digging the dirt with your hands
Break the blocks by clicking on them and collect the gems. Deeper down are rocks that take longer to break but contain rarer gems.
Automate your mining
Buy as many items as possible:
miners to dig for you
minecarts to collect gems automatically
refineries to increase the amount of gems recovered
...
And many other improvements to discover!
autokwd: Drill To Hell : Clicked Too Deep

title: The President Bodyguard: Sam story
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the world of covert operations, where your mission is to protect the President of the United States from deadly threats and cunning conspiracies. As Sam Marshall, a former special forces officer, you take on a challenging journey from training to protecting the president on the world stage and within the walls of the White House. Six intense missions await, filled with dramatic twists, stealth operations, and quick tactical decisions.
Game Features:
Highly realistic missions: Navigate through meticulously crafted scenarios — from a diplomatic visit to Beirut to an emergency evacuation during an attack on the White House.
Variety of gameplay styles: Operate drones, conduct reconnaissance, use binoculars for long-range surveillance, eliminate enemies stealthily, or engage in combat to protect the president.
Intense decision-making moments: Every action has consequences. Keep the president and yourself safe by managing limited resources, coordinating evacuations, and selecting strategically crucial routes.
Real-time unfolding events: Public spaces with crowds, tense negotiations, night operations in conflict zones, and sudden attacks — each mission demands flexibility, speed, and strategic thinking.
Smart and dynamic NPCs: Interact with allies and local security teams, work in crowded environments, and avoid panic when threats are uncovered.
Atmospheric graphics and detailed settings: Move through beautifully crafted, realistic locations, from luxury hotels to the intense environment of the White House.
Are you ready to risk it all to protect the president? Follow Sam’s journey — from routine patrols to the most dangerous mission of his career — to become the last line of defense.

title: Queen's Revenge
description:
게임 정보
Betrayal and darkness have torn the queen from her home. Trapped in a sinister parallel world, she must fight for survival, defeat her enemies, and push back the darkness—hoping to one day reclaim her rightful throne.

title: Ashes of Morgravia
description:
게임 정보
Ashes of Morgravia is a tactical deckbuilding game set in a grim, decaying world where gods have fallen, and humanity battles to survive in the shadow of their demise.
With a unique dual-deck system, strategic card-based combat, and a richly atmospheric dark fantasy setting, Ashes of Morgravia challenges players to navigate the night-shrouded ruins and face relentless, necrotic horrors.
Dual Deck System
Master two unique decks—one for movement and one for combat. Stride through treacherous landscapes and clash with your enemies in a dynamic card-based system.
Animated Cards
Immerse yourself in the world with fully animated cards, bringing every action to life.

title: Blades of Crossed Hearts
description:
게임 정보
What is Blades of Crossed Hearts?
Blades of Crossed Hearts is an angsty anime character action fighting game taking inspiration from Marvel vs Capcom and the Devil May Cry series.

title: The Otherworld Laboratory
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 실종된 지인을 찾아 연구실을 방문합니다.
그곳에서 그는 다른 세계의 연구실에 갇힌 자신을 발견합니다.
연구실은 네 가지 지시를 내립니다.
- 이상이 있으면 왼쪽 복도로 가세요.
- 이상이 없으면 오른쪽 복도로 가세요.
- F호실에 있는 출구로 나가세요.
- 온 길을 되돌아가지 마세요.
-----------------------------------------------------------------
※ 이 작품에는 소름 돋는 표현과 충격적인 장면이 포함되어 있습니다. 이러한 콘텐츠에 익숙하지 않은 분은 주의해 주시기 바랍니다.
[다른 차원의 공포]
설정은 장난꾸러기 사악한 신이 만든 특별한 "연구실"입니다. 현실과 분리된 뒤틀린 세계입니다. 플레이어는 신비한 규칙을 따르고 출구를 찾아 다른 차원의 금지된 연구실을 돌아다닙니다.
※ 시나리오는 Exit 8과 크툴루 신화에서 영감을 받았습니다.
[실시간 영상/스트리밍에 관하여]
동영상 공유 사이트에 영상을 스트리밍하고 게시하는 것은 허용됩니다.
게시자 또는 제3자가 입은 모든 손해에 대해 당사는 책임을 지지 않습니다.
다른 사람을 비방하거나 종교적 또는 정치적 목적을 가지고 있거나 반사회적이거나 공공 질서와 도덕을 위반하는 비디오의 스트리밍 또는 게시는 금지됩니다.

title: Gordak
description:
게임 정보
Gordak is an exploration, survival and building game where you are shipwrecked on an unknown procedurally generated island and have to settle your own village and grow your tribe through gathering resources as well as finding and recruiting other survivors. You must protect your village at all costs while also heading out into the wild to slay the undead lords of Gordak, an orc god who has plagued the island with an undead curse.
EXPLORE THE ISLAND
Explore the island and its distinct biomes for enemies to slay and to gather resources to build and upgrade your village. Be cautious, as some biomes might be hard to navigate unprepared.
FIGHT AND SURVIVE
Slay everything in your way to becoming the strongest war chief the island has ever known. There are various melee options available as well as using a bows or magical staffs with unique abilities.

title: Robot Unlock
description:
게임 정보
After years of trying you finally manage to dial into other-space. You find that the dweller of other-space has challenging questions about computability and is asking for your help.
75+ levels
Solve puzzles in constrained spaces using a handful of instructions
Solve open-ended problems and design your own solutions
Optimize your solutions for speed, instructions or space
Use multithreading - carefully time and synchronize your execution threads to halve the execution time
Set breakpoints - step backward, or even step forward!
Compare with other players - see how your solutions rank with fun histograms
Create your own levels, share them and solve community made levels
Trailer music: "Home Dimension" by Joey Freeze / CC BY 3.0

title: Honu
description:
게임 정보
You awaken in a stunning world, seeking to unravel mysteries through puzzles that reveal hidden details of your surroundings. Along the way, meet unique, animal-like characters, each with their own story.
Features
Solve puzzles using magitech
Explore breathtaking environments
Interact with intriguing NPCs
Discover the secret of Honu

title: Snapshot Spirit Live!
description:
게임 정보
In Snapshot Spirit Live! you play as a jetpack-flying photographer named Katie as she hunts ghosts in this educational photography game with minimalist 1-bit-inspired graphics and a Game Boy-inspired soundtrack.
Play as Katie as she flies around a haunted forest to find and photograph a wide variety of cute ghosts and build her photo portfolio. Katie streams her photography and jetpack-flying adventures to viewers, and she comments on what happens each day!

title: Tessera
description:
게임 정보
Tessera is a serene jigsaw puzzle game where the puzzles are made by you.
Take a stroll through various levels and choose a view that suits your puzzling predilection, then transform what you see into a jigsaw puzzle.
Watch hot air balloons, birds and clouds move across the sky and use them as reference to connect pieces together. Sea waves, rustling leaves and shadows cast are more than decoration and can be used to help you piece together the puzzle.

Features:
Unique blend of walking simulator and jigsaw gameplay
Dynamic soundtrack that changes as you get closer to solving a puzzle
Reveal hidden paths by piecing them together, unlocking new areas to explore
Explore 5 fantastical worlds with unique visuals

title: HOMELAND: Last Defense
description:
게임 정보
HOMELAND: Last Defense is a Metroidvania 2.5D shooter involving circuitry and moving the rooms around you.
Play as Fid, the last hope of the country Orotof; an everyday electrician given cybernetic upgrades that can be upgraded and rewired on the go. Your country will be invaded imminently by your neighbors in Camto, and Orotof's army knows they cannot possibly defend against Camto's powerful military.
At the very last minute, your country's army tasked all their remaining scientists and engineers to create YOU, a weapon like the world has never seen, the deciding factor in who will win the war.
Travel throughout your country, and choose how you proceed. Fight off Camto's soldiers, protect civilians, repair infrastructure, upgrade your circuits, go on missions with different factions, and do what you think is best to Defend your HOMELAND

title: Rusty Heights
description:
게임 정보
Rusty Heights is an experimental side-view platform game: It is to be played with the mouse only and is made of a single very high level to be climbed without ever falling down.
You play as the last functional robot of your kind. Equipped only with your grappling hook, you will have to overcome the obstacles of the mountain: electrical platforms, deadly turrets and many other rusty machines will prevent you from reaching the top of this dystopian world.
Be careful, the higher you go, the greater the fall! So Learn to master your trusty grappling hook, and never give up!
Be brave little robot! Every fall will make you stronger!

title: FIREBALL

Assume the role of Autonomous Strategic Mobile Projectile No. 100 (hereinafter referred to as "No. 100") and strive to conquer the Facility.

Touch the black objects to charge energy.

title: Sculptor

게임 정보
In Sculptor you create statues of girls: broke stone segments, use special skills and paint color. Improve your skills with the teacher and become more effective in creating sculptures.

Follow the story of a lonely sculptor who created a statue of a girl and fell in love with her. To bring her to life, he makes a deal with the goddess Aphrodite.
Features of the game:
1. Unusual mechanics of three-stage sculpture creation.
2. A strong story inspired by ancient Greek myth of Pygmalion.
3. The setting of Ancient Greece and myths.

title: The Last Prisoner
description:
게임 정보
"Escape is impossible... or is it possible?"
A space prison, endless corridors, deadly traps and an all-seeing artificial intelligence ready to tear you apart. You are the last prisoner awakened from a corrective cryo-sleep, your task is to escape from this hell and find out where is everyone else? The only way to escape is to manipulate gravity and adapt to the chaos around you.
The Last Prisoner is a hardcore platformer with gravity changing mechanics, an engaging story, and memorable characters.
What's in store for you:
Gravity Changing Mechanics: Bypass traps by changing the direction of gravity, dodge deadly AI tricks and blast through levels.
High difficulty for real hardcore gamers: Each level is a new challenge that requires lightning-fast reactions and precision.
Engaging story and charismatic characters: Uncover the truth about humanity’s fate while facing a devious AI and meeting a mysterious ally.
An AI determined to destroy you: The merciless AI will do everything to stop your escape, activating traps at the most unexpected moments. But don’t think she’s just a regular opponent. She won’t just try to kill you—she’ll mock your failures with sarcasm and playful taunts. Get ready for her sharp and cheeky remarks.

title: ITRP _ Vacuum Bless
description:
게임 정보
ITRP _ Vacuum Bless – research puzzle game about research and puzzles under the nul-gravity conditions.
Welcome to the space program!
In the frameworks of this program, you could’ve navigate through endless space, but instead, have to focus on the way to get out of the spaceship which got stuck in space.
Alone within million kilometers
You have to rely only on yourself. Fortunately, it is enough to manage all the systems of the spaceship. Just study it. Find hidden tunnels and other ways of opening new compartments. Obtain the tackle – it will help you to reveal your performance limitations.
Please, remind me what mission was it…
Wait, why there are no two-factor security systems on this spaceship? No captain’s cabin? Who has placed so many mysteries here and why? Why does this spaceship completely consist of puzzles? Is this a kind of trick?
Does the rescue shuttle indeed exist?
There is only one way to find it out. Tighten the straps of your overall to navigate in the gravity-free vacuum – and go ahead to reveal mysteries!
Estimated game duration: 4-7 hours.

title: Bloodmoon
description:
게임 정보
Survive by mastering intense combat: slash with your sword, dash and teleport to evade, and blast enemies with flames and electricity. Light is your only source of healing. Recharge within its glow, or brave the shadows for greater rewards.
Each wave grows deadlier. Strategize carefully, level up to boost your power, and fight to outlast the darkness.
Key Features:
Survive Horde Combat: Battle waves of creatures and face unique bosses.
Light vs. Dark: Stay in the light to recover or risk the shadows for rewards.
Spell-Powered Action: Dash, teleport, and wield arcane abilities.

title: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side
description:
게임 정보
Tsurine is a PsySpec wrapped up in the intensity of her job, and the stress that comes with dissociative amnesia. One night, a mysterious woman offers to help recover her lost memories. All Tsurine must do in exchange is hunt down the missing fragments to an unusual key.
Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side is an intricate choice-heavy psychological medicore thriller about an amnesiac facing both real and mental horrors within a world akin to an endless, liminal hospital. 
The game utilizes a fusion of Visual Novel, RPG, and Point-&-Click mechanics to paint a story about how people choose to cope with trauma, and the way it shapes one's identity. While the main story of Ad Nauseam is firm, it features hundreds of branching paths, choices, and open exploration areas to engage in along the way. Every action you take, and every choice you make, is remembered and seen through to its very end.
Uncover the secrets of this strange world, and the ones lurking within Tsurine's forgotten past. Will you accept your limitations when faced with peril, or will you dive deep into delusion and madness for a chance at hope?
Can you face the world? Can you face yourself?
Are you sure?
The world of Ad Nauseam is heavily inspired by the works and the aesthetics of Yami Kawaii, Liminality, Traumacore, and both Modern & Pastel Goth. It features a long, diverse, and dark soundtrack done by lolratz combining elements of Breakcore, Hyperpop, and Witch House music genres.
Character Artist: @Catfan1000
Background & Soundtrack Artist: @lolratz

title: Star Watch
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Star Watch is a casual game combining elements of "light-action shooting" and "creature care and management." Players take on the role of the Star Watch commander, leading a squad of unique monsters to fight against the evil alien invaders—the Cows, and reclaim the occupied planets and their precious relics!
Game Features
20 Unique Monsters: Each monster has distinct abilities and appearances, allowing players to freely form their own custom squads.
6 Major Planet Levels: Explore planets with unique environmental challenges, each featuring a powerful BOSS with special abilities.
Easy-to-Learn Controls: All actions are performed by simple clicks, making the game accessible to players of all ages.
Diverse Strategy Choices: Combine turret controls with carefully selected monster abilities to fend off enemies, adapting strategies to different planetary environments.
Planet Relic Collection: Defeat the final BOSS on each planet to reclaim valuable relics, enhancing your monster squad for future battles.
Gameplay
Players will need to raise monsters and manage resources to expand their influence across the galaxy. When enemies attack, players must skillfully operate turrets and unleash special monster abilities to fend off the invading Cows while protecting their squad. After each level, players can earn rewards to upgrade their monsters and technologies, further strengthening their forces for tougher challenges ahead.
company: 鈴夢有限公司, 赤腳蛙工作室

title: The Victor Initiative
description:
게임 정보
Overview
The Victor Initiative is a first-person survival horror game in which you explore the halls of an abandoned government facility in order to discover its secrets while evading the strange entities lurking within. The game is divided into separate floors, which all present unique challenges. These floors make up larger 'chapters', which present widely different threats for you to outsmart. The demo includes the first chapter of the game.
Gameplay
In The Victor Initiative, you have no health bar, nothing telling you what to do and one main goal: surviving. From a first person perspective, make your way through the winding halls of The Initiative in a bid to survive to the next room. Each room will present a new threat, or a new puzzle that you need to solve in order to keep pushing through. With no tools, no knowledge, and just your environment & the occasional patchy audio log for clues, will you be able to survive?
The Mission
It's your job to explore an abandoned government facility that lost contact with the rest of the world 60 years ago. What horrors will you discover within?

title: Snakes with Fists!
description:
게임 정보
The RPG with a Beat 'em Up Battle System
Snakes with Fists! combines the open-world exploration elements of an RPG—interesting NPCs, side quests, secrets, and a strong narrative—with the fun of fighting in the beat 'em up style! Open areas are explored in a top down 2d RPG world, Beat 'em UP stages are entered and cleared to unlock new areas and to complete quests. 
Also, you can fight anyone!
Yes, you can... but should you?
Instead of 'random encounters' you will enter into a Beat 'em Up style fight scene with anyone you punch in the RPG world.

title: Acroama: Company of Strays
description:
게임 정보
Ever want to be a superstar? Got big dreams, but no talent? Instead of chasing those dreams, live vicariously through wannabe punk-rocker Ash Blaze as he ditches his monotonous desk job and pursues a life of excitement and adventure, and probably more than a few mornings waking up on the roof of the local pub in nothing but his underwear and his left boot.
Enter an epic head-to-head tournament with worldwide reach, where music is your weapon and fame is your destiny! Face off against all sorts, from established K-pop idol groups and rock-gods to the local cult choir and that one guy who keeps insisting that the keytar will make a comeback.
 Turn-Based Strategic Combat for Dummies
Use your skill and wits to outperform your enemies - chain together attacks, buffs, and bend the soundscape to your will by planning multiple rounds in advance and having it all play out exactly as you wish in a flood of eardrum shattering beats and pyrotechnics mayhem that would definitely violate workplace health and safety standards.
Forget those boring old heath bars – they’re so 2010s – control the momentum and dominate the stage through the “state-of-the-art” and totally original Tug-of-War combat system; Drown out the tunes from those lame-wads across the stage from you and get them booed off stage to advance to the next stage of the tournament.  
 A World of Musical Misfits
Every Paul needs his Ringo, every Bob their Marley – Ash can’t win it all by himself, he’ll need a band! Build your flock as you navigate through a city full of musicians who all think they’re way cooler than they actually are. Each new member brings their own deck of tricks to the table, expanding your options on the battle stage.
Talk to people around the stadium to learn about the world, themselves, and even hints to finding collectibles! Choose dialogue options that present you as the next coming of the King of Rock or embrace your inner chaos goblin – whichever speaks to your heart more! There are no wrong answers, so feel free to flip flop around Ash’s personality so much that his band mates start to consider calling a doctor.
 Orchestrate Your Strategy

title: The Hundredth Hike
description:
게임 정보
The Hundredth Hike
The Hundredth Hike is an Indie Psychological Horror game, living the story of you, as a mountain hiker, reliving your tragic past and finding the calm of the nature under your boots. Unaware of what lies before you, you unleash a powerful and mysterious truth.
Rich Story
The Hundredth Hike is a story rich in lore, that is set in the middle of a devastating apocalypse. Napazarim has taken over the minds of 90% of the population causing hallucinations in the infected people in which became an international pandemic. You are one of the lucky few who survived and after losing your family, over the years you went on hikes all over the world to escape real life. This is YOUR Hundredth Hike how will it be different?
Losing your Mind
Along your Hundredth Hike you question your reality on this enormous hike along a mountain that has been restricted for over a decade. Sneaking into a quarantined country, you delve deep into your own mind and lose touch of reality. Will you bring yourself back from the fold?
Mechanics
Run, Hide and solve deep puzzles to escape your faith. With inventory management for your light sources and many interactive objects you will always feel on edge. With barely any HUD and following the protagonists story you will always be immersed in The Hundredth Hike. There are many mechanics of the game I don't want to give away as more and more mechanics are introduced over the course of the game.
Graphics
With the power of UE5, I have been able as a solo developer to get realistic and eye watering graphics with each chapter giving a different feel. From the amazing weather effects to the fully manually placed assets across all of the chapters, you will get an experience which is hard to forget.

title: Woke Quest
description:
게임 정보
Woke Quest is a satirical turn-based role-playing game that humorously critiques real-life events, personalities, and RPG conventions.
Four unsuspecting individuals from diverse backgrounds are drawn together by a mysterious force that transcends the boundaries of their reality. Suddenly, a surge of energy engulfs them, transporting them from their computer screens into a realm unlike anything they’ve ever imagined.
Emerging from a cosmic rift, they find themselves in a vibrant world brimming with magic, mythical creatures, and breathtaking landscapes straight out of an RPG. It quickly becomes clear that they are far from home.
Unbeknownst to them, their arrival marks the beginning of an epic saga that will shape the destiny of this enchanted realm and challenge their very understanding of reality.

title: Bluebie VS The Army of Cyborgs
description:
게임 정보
Bluebie VS the Army of Cyborgs is a Cartoony 3D platformer that will take you to the fictive world of planet Rebaga. The planet look pretty much like earth and the culture there is pretty similar to ours. One day, Cybex, a self made Cyborg, decided to invade the planet and turn its inhabitants into his servants.
Of course, Bluebie, a farmer, is not willing to see his planet enslaved by the army of Cybex and decided to fight back and free the prisoners Cybex took.
In his quest, Bluebie will travel through mines,  mountains, desert and different other places where the cyborgs settled and launched their operation. He will fight the generals of Dr Cybex to free as much prisoners as he can while developing and purchasing new skills thanks to his colorful closet plenty of different outfits.
Fight Enemies
A stick, a spear, a boomerang, a slingshot, a crossbow and a pigeon launcher. Which weapon to use to fight your enemies. Every weapon will have its own range and damage level. One is sometimes enough, two or more could be a necessity.
