title: Bird
description:
게임 정보
Bird is a social impact game about mass incarceration where players explore the memories and artwork of Darrell Fair. Darrell is an artist, activist, and mentor, represented by the Exoneration Project. He was wrongfully convicted in 1998 due to a coerced confession and has been serving time in Illinois ever since. Bird is a documentary, a virtual art gallery, and a video game all at once. 
The central framework of Bird is built on a metaphor from Michelle Alexander's "The New Jim Crow," which compares mass incarceration and racism in the U.S. to a birdcage. 
“One theorist, Iris Marion Young, relying on a famous “birdcage” metaphor, explains it this way: If one thinks about racism by examining only one wire of the cage, or one form of disadvantage, it is difficult to understand how and why the bird is trapped. Only a large number of wires arranged in a specific way, and connected to one another, serve to enclose the bird and to ensure that it cannot escape.11”
― Michelle Alexander, The New Jim Crow: Mass Incarceration in the Age of Colorblindness
This metaphor permeates Bird’s gameplay, and inspires players to ask themselves, what can I do to free this bird?
The story of Bird is told through animations, hand-drawn in Stateville Correctional, recorded audio interviews with Darrell and his family, and a dynamic choral soundtrack with lyrics taken from interviews conducted in Stateville and sung by the multi-Grammy-winning choir, The Crossing.

title: Tiny Racing
description:
게임 정보
Gear up for a thrilling ride in Tiny Racing! Dive into a vibrant world of pixel art where you control a variety of vehicles across contrasting and challenging tracks. With intuitive arcade controls, master each turn, drift, and boost to outpace your rivals.
From time trials to full tournaments, every race is a test of skill and strategy. Win cash to purchase new vehicles and become the undisputed champion! Get ready for high-speed excitement and a nostalgic gaming experience in Tiny Racing!
Summary
Get behind the wheel of trucks, drift cars and formula cars!
Quick race, time trials and 12-race tournaments await you
18 unique tracks over 3 settings both day and night
Earn money winning races to purchase cool new vehicles
Easy to pick-up controls means you dive right in!
Out-drive computer opponents over 4 difficulty modes

title: Wolley's Dungeon Adventure
description:
게임 정보
In Ballonia, life once thrived thanks to its cheerful, bouncy inhabitants. But when the dark sorcerer Malvolio appeared, he invaded the land, and corrupted the cheerful critters, turning them into dark and dangerous entities. 
It's up to you to use your special abilities to take back Ballonia, and restore peace to the land, and its inhabitants
After Malvolio invaded, there was one Ballonian who refused to give up hope. Wolley possesses a special power that allows him to inhale and expel objects. 
Help take back Ballonia alone, or with a friend with co-op mode

title: Block Sprawl
description:
게임 정보
Block Sprawl: A City Planner Deck Builder
Build your dream city from the ground up! Sprawl combines the classic, strategic fun of Tetris with the deep city-building mechanics inspired by Foundations of Rome and Urban Sprawl. Every decision matters, and every choice shapes your bustling metropolis in this single-player, deck-building strategy game.
Key Features:
Card-Driven Strategy: Draw Permit, Plot, and Action Cards to drive your city planning. Use Permits to construct CIVIC, RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, and INDUSTRIAL buildings, each with unique combinations and synergies.
Tetris-Like Building Challenges: Place buildings of varying shapes on a grid-based city map. Master the puzzle-like placement rules to maximize your city’s layout.
Dynamic Scoring System: Every turn matters! Points are calculated based on the adjacency bonuses, and prestige is awarded for completing rows and columns with aligned building types. Find the perfect balance to maximize your city's prestige.
Action Cards for Dynamic Play: Unlock powerful abilities that can trigger throughout your turn—from gaining extra coins to free placements and lingering effects that last multiple rounds.
Deep Choices and Urgent Challenges: You’re racing against an ever-growing list of demands. Every time you end your turn, adversarial effects impact your city, keeping you on your toes and making each choice count.
Plot, build, strategize, and expand in Sprawl, a unique blend of deck-building strategy, puzzle-solving, and city-building. Your city’s success lies in your hands. Will you create the next metropolis or end up sprawled out?
Wishlist now and prepare to reshape the skyline!

title: SUSPICIOUS HOLES
description:
게임 정보
Suspicious Holes is a stylized roguelike card game dungeon crawler with horror undertones.
In Suspicious Holes you will:
play the Suspicious Holes card game against darkly eccentric masked characters
win to unlock new locations and opponents
experience an ever changing setting where the cards are never the same. Every play through is unique in this roguelike experience

title: The Blue Cut Hook
description:
게임 정보
Step into the warm glow of your very own tavern, where good food, great company, and grand adventures await! In The Blue Cut Hook, you're not just a business owner—you’re a friend, a mentor, and a cornerstone of the community. Build lasting relationships, craft mouthwatering meals, forge mighty weapons, and embark on thrilling quests to create the ultimate haven for adventurers and townsfolk alike!
🍻 From Stranger to Family
Your tavern is more than just a place to eat—it’s a home. Lend a listening ear, solve problems, and earn the trust of your patrons. With each bond you forge, your reputation grows, and soon enough, you’ll find yourself at the heart of a thriving community.
🍲 Cook Up Something Legendary
A great tavern needs great food! Scour the world for exotic ingredients, unlock secret recipes, and craft a menu that keeps adventurers coming back for more. Will you serve hearty comfort food or daring new flavors from distant lands? The choice is yours!
🔨 Forge, Craft, and Equip
Adventurers need the right gear to survive their quests, and that’s where you come in! Hire a blacksmith, gather rare materials, and create powerful weapons and armor to aid your patrons. A well-equipped adventurer is a happy (and generous!) customer.

title: ZOPHARION
description:
게임 정보
"엘리트 병사인 THORYN의 역할을 맡아, ZOPHARION 바이러스에 대한 연구를 맡고 있는 뛰어난 과학자 DR. ZYPHAR가 숨기고 있는 비밀을 밝혀내기 위한 임무를 시작하십시오."
바이러스는 연구소 승무원들을 괴물로 변하게 만듭니다. 누구도 안전하지 않으며, 바이러스의 확산 속도는 가공할 수준입니다. 괴물들과 자신의 두려움에 맞서 싸워야 하며, 당신의 결정은 연구소와 인류의 운명을 좌우하게 될 것입니다.

title: Time Management
description:
게임 정보
Do you have what it takes to beat all 100+ levels in Time Management? Tight corridors and fast paced, yet sometimes slow, gameplay add together for an enriching experience around obstacles.
Main Features:
Walls/Death Walls
Turrets
Various Tokens (Dash, Pause, Play, and Time Addition/Subtraction
Mud
Controller Compatibility
Limited Character Customization
Custom fonts, art, sound effects, and music built and made from the ground up
Zen Mode for Practicing Levels

title: ThaumSmith
description:
게임 정보
Play as the beloved ThaumSmith, the master crafter behind every hero's success. Paladins, warlocks, rogues, and more depend on your expertise to forge powerful gear and brew life-saving potions. Equip them for epic quests, helping them grow stronger each day. As your crafting skills improve, you'll uncover the secrets of a world plagued by corrupted magic and hidden mysteries. You may not be the story's main character, but the fate of the town—and its heroes—rests in your hands!

title: Emojis Battle
description:
게임 정보
Emojis Battle에서는 유명한 블루이모지들과 싸워 왕국을 구하세요. 노란 이모지의 역할을 맡고, 한때 하나였던 땅에서 블루이모지들에게 국경일을 주지 않겠다고 한 왕의 결단으로 시작된 1년 간의 갈등에서 승리하세요.
자유로운 선택:
경계가 없습니다! 당신의 전략에 맞는 노란 이모지 군을 구성하세요. 그들의 무기를 선택하고 블루이모지들과의 전투를 이끌어가세요!
블루이모지:

title: Fungi Crossing
description:
게임 정보
This is a Fungi.
You will be playing as a group of them.
Fungi can cling to almost anything. as well as to each other.
as the Fungi you will to traverse terrain, solve puzzles, and find new and interesting ways to cling to each other to best the many challenges of the wastelands.

title: Gaunts Gambit | Multiplayer FPS
description:
게임 정보
DESCRIPTION:
Gaunts Gambit is a multiplayer first person shooter game. Set in an abandoned school left empty because of a rampant virus, former students sneak back in fighting over control of the grounds and buildings. They fashion makeshift weapons from whatever they can find.
GAMEMODES:
(Subject to Change)
6v6 Deathmatch
Battle Royale
Zombies
FFA
6V6 DEATHMATCH:
Players are divided into two teams of six, where they battle and capture land to earn points for their team. The team with the most points wins the match!
BATTLE ROYALE:
Players fight on a shrinking map, scavenging gear and eliminating others. The last player standing wins!
ZOMBIES:
Players face waves of zombies, barricading entrances to slow them down. Survive as long as possible against the increasing difficulty!

title: Fecal Freighter
description:
게임 정보
After a sudden invasion of space aliens hunting for human biological waste, the job of a sewage truck operator has become a perilous craft. Join the elite of the elite and become a transporter of the brown gold — the very substance without which the world wouldn’t be quite so... picturesque. But beware: dark alleys hide sinister surprises, and no matter how hard you try, you’ll never be fully prepared for what lurks there. It’s not just aliens after you — sludge demons spawned from the filth and the fanatical followers of the Brown Cult, whose ominous leader is rumored to have ties to a shadowy global government, are on your tail too.

title: Finger Party
description:
게임 정보
Finger Party is a short incremental game about collecting and plopping creatures with your fingers and revealing the mystery about the Finger Party.
Life of a finger:
1. Be a finger
2. Join a party
3. Gain immense power through various finger-related technologies
4. Collect and plop the colorful blobs
5. Gain inside information about the party
6. ?̸̛͇̙̅̔̀͐ͅ?̶̰̩̤͎̘̐̓̋̔̕?̷̧̞̔͘͠ͅ3̴̦̤̿̈́n̷̢̺̥̩̈́̎̚d̷̳̺̟͋̒̕͝ͅ0̸̰͈̰̪̔̇f̵̦͕̅̓̓̐͝t̸̛̓̌̆́͜h̸̯́͑̆3̸̮̏͗̑̚͝p̸̫̀̋̈́͊4̸̣̻͆̂r̶͚̩̭͗̿͐͋t̷͙̤͉̬̹̉y̸͓̳͖͇͗́̀͋͜?̸̰͇͓̹̇ͅ?̵̹̰̚?̷̝̝̹̙͆́̅
Plop the Blobs in this simple and relaxing gameplay loop

title: Samurai Conqueror
description:
게임 정보
“Samurai Conqueror” is an epic historical strategy game where you aim to unify Japan across time — from the ancient Kofun period to the transformative Meiji era.
Set against the sweeping backdrop of Japan’s full historical timeline, you’ll choose one legendary figure to lead your faction and strive to bring all of Japan under your rule.
Develop your domain through commerce, agriculture, technology, and military might.
Wage war against rival factions, expand your realm, and reshape the course of Japanese history.
Will you be the one to unify the ages?
Choose one historical figure from Japanese history and start the game.
Strengthen your faction’s commerce, agriculture, technology, and military power with development commands.
Invade other factions and expand your territory. Aim to unify Japanese history!

title: Roadside Egg Stand
description:
게임 정보
로드사이드 에그 스탠드는 아늑하고 편안한 방치형 게임입니다. 귀여운 길가의 에그 스탠드를 직접 만들고 관리하며 신선한 달걀을 제공하고 작은 마을의 아름다운 도로에 기쁨을 전하세요.
조용한 시골길을 달리다 알록달록한 달걀과 수제 간식, 그리고 "신선한 달걀!"이라는 손글씨 표지가 있는 작은 나무 스탠드를 발견한다고 상상해보세요. 이 따뜻하고 포근한 느낌이 바로 이 게임의 핵심입니다.
행복한 닭 키우기:
닭 떼를 보살피고, 희귀 품종을 발견하며 점박이 달걀부터 황금 달걀까지 수집하세요!
스탠드 꾸미기:
꽃바구니, 랜턴, 꽃 장식과 손으로 그린 표지판을 추가해 스탠드를 더욱 매력적으로 꾸며보세요.
새로운 장소 탐험:
시골길, 숲길, 활기찬 마을 시장 등 아름다운 장소로 사업을 확장하세요.
신선한 달걀, 신선한 수익:
고객을 응대하고, 적절한 가격을 책정하며, 특별한 요청을 처리해 수익을 올리고 닭들이 잘 먹고 행복하도록 돌보세요!
이번 주의 직원:
최고의 닭들에게 재미있는 타이틀과 보상을 제공하며 가족처럼 축하하세요!
여유로운 분위기, 끝없는 재미:

title: Gridle
description:
게임 정보
Gridle is an incremental idle RPG where you’ll manage a powerful party to take down waves of enemies! Strategically upgrade, heal, reassign, and level up your party members to ensure maximum progress. After 50 initial levels to conquer, the game transitions into infinite levels where the challenge never stops.
Your party will automatically fight enemies for you. Allowing you to do other tasks while the gameplay flows. Optimize your party for survival to ensure they progress as much as possible by assigning classes to your party slots, upgrading your classes, unlocking skills, rebirthing for knowledge upgrades and much more.
Rebirth
Gridle features a huge rebirth tree with well over 200 knowledge upgrades. These upgrades impact everything from money earnings to individual class perks and will ensure your party can go way beyond any limits and eventually reach the end of the realm.

title: Stickility
description:
게임 정보
Dive into depths of laboratories and stickmen!
Biotec is a shady company, suspected of commiting a serious crime behind the curtains. It went through several investigations, and yet nothing has been found. Explore the facility's interiors, seeking the truth yourself, and try to stop Biotec's tyranny once and for all.
Gather and Craft
The game combines traditional metroidvania exploration with crafting mechanics, allowing you to gather resources and create items to aid on your journey.
Explore the world full of items required to craft new equipment, weapons and additional tools, all of which increase your chances of succeeding.
Discover various biomes and enviroments
Biotec's facility is full of laboratories, atmospheric server halls, large warehouses, lively greenhouses, smelly sewer systems, vast caves, and more. Explore each and every location in the game, discovering its secrets and lore.

title: Trackastrophe!
description:
게임 정보
Trackastrophe! is a wacky puzzle game about an eccentric old train travelling a colorful world.
Analyse the maps, make a path by placing a variety of different track tiles, then pray your train gets to the end in one piece!
The game features over 100+ levels which will make you travel through different locations, each including their own unique themes and mechanics.
For those who seek a bigger challenge, the game features several bonus levels that will be sure to make you think!

title: Steam & Stones
description:
게임 정보
Team up with your friends and build a thriving dwarven city. 
Use automation to unlock new technologies and harness the power of water, lava, and steam. Create an intricate network of minecarts and clever contraptions to power your industries. Craft the finest dwarven goods, including the best ales to keep your hardworking dwarves fueled and happy. Watch your dwarven city flourish as you amass a fortune, and build a city of stone and steam!
Steam & Stones is still in active development!
Join our Discord to help playtest and give your feedback, and support us by adding the game to your Wishlist!
Features
A full minecart system to haul quantity of ores and crystals from big distances
A torque-based power system to power machines and contraptions.
Water (and lava) physics
Automation working hand in hands with your residents
A bustling city-builder, where Dwarves have demands. Housing, beer, you name it!
Tech tree to unlock new machines, upgrades, and new processes.
Brewing your own beer, for export or local consumption.
Dwarves
Gold
More dwarves

title: Chaos Ascension
description:
게임 정보
Chaos Ascension은 빠르고 액션 가득한 로그라이트 게임입니다. 각기 독특한 능력, 무기, 플레이 스타일을 가진 다양한 영웅 중 하나를 선택하세요. 적의 무리를 처치하며 강력한 장비를 수집하고 새로운 능력을 해제하며, 여정을 위협하는 보스들과 맞서 싸워야 합니다. 매번 다른 진행이 가능하며, 생존을 위한 나만의 전략을 세울 수 있습니다.
특징:
몬스터 무리를 처치하세요
빠르게 끝나는 20분 러닝
지도를 탐험하며 생존에 도움이 될 다른 주요 지점을 발견하세요
여러 플레이 가능한 클래스 중에서 캐릭터를 선택하세요
경험치 보석을 모으고 레벨을 올리며 다양한 업그레이드 스킬을 선택하세요
장비를 획득하여 캐릭터를 강화하세요
강력한 보스와 대결하세요

title: Touhou Volleyball Danmaku
description:
게임 정보
The latest sensation to hit Gensokyo, Volleyball! But this isn't an ordinary game of volleyball.
Taking place in the skies, you will pick a team of 2 of your favorite Touhou characters as they not only attempt to keep the ball from falling on your side, but also avoid the bullets coming your way! Score a point by dropping the ball on the other side or hitting an opponent with your bullets. Reach the point match or have the most points at time out to win.
The upcoming demo will contain the following features:
Play as a team of 2 and choose from Reimu, Marisa, Sakuya, and Remilia.
Each character will have their own special abilities and bullet patterns.
Powerful bombs and spell card attacks.
Local versus against a human opponent or the CPU.
Gamepad is recommended.

title: Deep Sea Heroes
description:
게임 정보
Deep Sea Heroes is the ultimate top-down roguelike set in a captivating underwater world! Choose from 4 unique heroes, each equipped with exclusive weapons. Brave the ocean depths as you face off against pirates and deadly sea creatures, from fierce sharks to adorable yet dangerous axolotls.
Explore stunning underwater biomes, collect weapons and upgrades, and fight to survive intense battles while uncovering the secrets of the deep. If you crave action, strategy, and a one-of-a-kind experience beneath the waves, Deep Sea Heroes will hook you!
In your journey through Deep Sea Heroes, you'll unlock new underwater heroes, ranging from a swift and nimble lobster to a towering and deadly killer whale. Every death marks the start of a new opportunity: choose to revive with your current character or dive into a fresh adventure with a new hero. The choice is yours, but the challenge in the depths never ends!

title: The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity
description:
게임 정보
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© is a survival horror action-adventure game built in RPG Maker MZ and is a prequel to The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows© (Will contain spoilers for The Clown's Forest, This game is best played after beating the first game)
STORY
Blitzo lost control while hunting down Michael. Jonathan had slipped back into control momentarily. Blitzo taunts Jonathan, vowing to destroy him once and for all. Jonathan, stuck in his own body and his own mind, with no way out, has to figure out how to keep himself safe in what was once his own subconscious. Jonathan's mind is slowly dwindling but he has to become stronger than Blitzo himself.

Forcing himself to relive his worst memories and fabrications created by Blitzo, Jonathan has to survive his nightmares to ensure he continues to exist to aid Michael in any way he can. But Blitzo refuses to make it easy for him.
GAMEPLAY
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© Is a top-down Survival Horror game set between the events of The Clown's Forest© and The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows©, Jonathan has to survive his own nightmares to come out on top of Blitzo. Explore familiar and not so familiar locations fabricated by Jonathan's shared subconscious with Blitzo as Blitzo tries destroying Jonathan's soul from the inside.

Puzzles return with more terrifying consequences and new characters and lore will be expanded on as Jonathan not only fights against his past, but also the longhurst family's past as a whole. 

Jonathan has to protect himself from Blitzo. No matter the cost.
autokwd: The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity

title: Love and Demons
description:
게임 정보
특이한 패러디 이세카이 비주얼 노벨. 러브 앤 데몬즈에 오신 것을 환영합니다! .


책임으로부터 도망치고 싶다는 생각이 든 적이 있나요? 강제된 유산을 피해 도망치는 맥스 왕자가 바로 그런 생각을 하고 있습니다.
그러나 그의 탈출은 위험으로 가득 찬 매우 적대적인 환경인 악마의 영역으로 그를 몰아넣습니다.
위험을 감수하지 않고는 집으로 돌아가는 것이 쉽지 않을 것 같습니다.

러브 앤 데몬즈는 폭발적으로 환상적인 픽셀 아트 패러디 이세카이 비주얼 노벨로,] 맥스의 운과 미덕이 시험대에 오르게 됩니다.
그를 구원으로 이끌고, 주사위를 굴려 운명에 도전하고, 능력치를 높여 맥스를 훈련시키고, 이 세상의 수많은 비밀을 밝혀내세요.
다양한 선택지와 얽히고설킨 스토리를 활용하여 수많은 나쁜 결말을 피하고 탐나는 좋은 결말로 가는 길을 개척하세요.

맥스는 자신의 운명을 스스로 개척하고 무엇보다도 살아남기 위해 노력해야 하지만,
혼자서 하는 것이 아니라 모험에 동행할 새로운 기묘한 지인들과 함께 하게 됩니다.

첫 번째 캐릭터는 주인공이자 전형적인 게으른 왕자, 특히 왕실의 책임에 있어서는 더욱 그렇습니다!
당연하게 그는 친구들과 함께 술을 마실 기회를 절대 놓치지 않아요.
그의 게으름과 무관심은 그를 문제의 자석으로 만들었죠. 럭키 부인은 그의 편이 아닌 것 같지만
그는 그녀의 마음을 바꾸기 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다 ... 아마도...
악마의 영역은 이름에서 알 수 있듯이 다채로운 행동을 하는 악마들로 가득합니다.
그래서 수줍음이 많은 카렌은 그들과 관계를 맺는 데 어려움을 겪고, 다른 생명체들처럼 '활기찬' 성격이 아닌 식물과 함께 있는 것을 선호합니다.
하지만 의외로 고집이 세고 자신의 신념이 확고하니 과소평가하지 마세요!
모든 종류의 악마 중에서도 대악마는 가장 강력한 존재로 꼽히는데, 릴리스도 그중 하나입니다.
왕좌의 후계자인 릴리스는 거만하고 거리감이 있어 보일 수 있으며, 사회성 또한 별로 도움이 되지 않을 것 같습니다.
하지만 실제로는 도움이 필요한 사람들을 돕는 것을 좋아하고 곤경에 처한 사람을 보면 참지 못합니다.
다만 한 가지 작은 결점이 있다면 감정을 잘 조절하지 못한다는 것인데, 언제든 '폭발'할 수 있으니 주변에서 말을 조심하는 것이 좋습니다!
물론 기묘한 생명체는 많지만, 오렐리아는 그중에서도 단연 최고일지도 몰라요.
오렐리아는 릴리스의 모조품이 아니니까요. 그리고 감히 그녀 앞에서 그런 말을 하지 마세요. 그녀는 원하는 만큼 지저분해질 수 있으니까요.
하지만 걱정하지 마세요. 시련에서 살아남는다면 그녀의 비꼬는 말과 착한 소녀의 얼굴을 파헤쳐서 그 거친 층 아래에 무엇이 있는지 알아낼 시간이 충분할 테니까요.












맥스는 주점에서 친구들과 맥주를 마시던 중 갑자기 경비병들이 자신을 찾고 있다는 사실을 깨닫습니다.
맥스는 도망치기로 결심하지만 운이 따르지 않아 우연히 무시무시한 악마의 영역에 던져집니다.
이 미지의 땅을 헤매던 그는 흥미로운 세 소녀를 만나게 됩니다.
그는 무엇을 할까요? 이 소녀들은 누구일까요? 집으로 돌아갈 수 있을까요?

Zerra's Adventure is a classic turn-based RPG with no random encounters. Explore diverse areas, collect items and treasures to improve your team and defeat the strangest enemies. Level up, learn new attacks, and meet quirky characters on your adventure!




Explore diverse landscapes, from frog-filled forests to infernal deserts and dark caves infested with spiders. Face dangers like spikes, fireballs, and shots as you search for treasures, weapons, and other items that will aid you in your adventure, even in a gym filled with insane bodybuilders.




, from small turtles and pigs to armed rabbits and final bosses such as giant frogs and penguins. Utilize your skill and strategy to overcome their signature attacks and progress through the game.




during your adventure and find secret bonuses that will challenge you with short minigames that reward your skill with special and unique items.




by gaining experience and leveling up. Discover new attacks and passive abilities that offer different benefits to the team. Customize each character with weapons and accessories found during your adventure, choosing between increasing attack, defense, or special abilities according to your gameplay style. The choice is yours!

title: Death Report
description:
게임 정보
-Pure manual map, without using automatically generated maps
-Pure manual system, easy to adjust
The game includes a puzzle mission and an FPS shooting mission.
puzzle mission: In a space with supernatural phenomena, as an observer, when a supernatural event occurs, you need to click on the correct options and actions to report the supernatural event. If the selection is incorrect, you may fail the misson.
FPS Shooting Mission: You will infiltrate these supernatural spaces, wield weapons, shoot monsters, and monsters will attack you. If operated improperly, you will die.

title: Hop'n & Bop'n
description:
게임 정보
With Hop'n n Bop'n, you'll embark on a rhythmic adventure that blends precision platforming with infectious beats in more than 30 energizing levels.



Master the art of hopping, bopping, sliding, and slamming your way around a selection of hazards that activate in sync to the music. Race against time to set a new high-score or try to hunt down tapes for your collection to unlock cool playlists and costumes.



Explore the game's strategically distributed secret areas, each offering unique unlockables and a variety of different gameplay routes.



If you’re ready, then get started Hop’n & Bop’n!

title: Greed Forest
description:
게임 정보
A real-time strategy tower defense game set in a dangerous yet resource-rich forest. Build your base, shape your defenses, and fend off relentless enemy swarms in a battle for survival and supremacy.
Gather and Grow:
Harvest gold, wood and stone from the forest to expand your base, unlock upgrades, and build advanced tech structures.
RTS Meets Tower Defense:
Experience the strategy of a classic RTS without unit micro-management. Focus entirely on defending against massive waves of enemies.
Campaign and Creativity:
Dive into a challenging campaign or use the built-in map editor to design and share your own custom scenarios.
Greed Forest is about mastering the balance between resource management, strategic planning, and creative defense.

title: Shop Crush
description:
게임 정보
About Shop Crush
Manage your Thrift Shop. Sell a hodgepodge of merch to picky customers. Set the prices, bargain with clients, and turn down suspicious offers. Order popular stock, fight off shoplifters, and manage your reputation — gain or lose it based on your choices!
Own a Thrift Shop
Yes, you own a Thrift Shop! Clients come every day to buy their preferred products. To keep your business profitable, you must monitor your prices and the number of products clients want.
In this choice-driven Visual Novel, you must balance the profitability of the offer with the reputational loss that every purchase can cause.

title: The Rule Of SHE
description:
게임 정보
The Rule of SHE is a role-playing game that delves into the enigmatic character of SHE. In this ever-shifting world, reality and time are constantly in flux, and each scenario introduces a different set of rules that must be followed.
Any violation of these rules will bring misfortune upon yourself. Adhere to them to uncover the truth and delve into the deepest secrets of SHE. Only when you have gained enough understanding of this eerie world will the time for successful reincarnation arrive.
1, A poetic, short narrative-driven puzzle game.
2, A bizarre and slightly eerie worldview accompanied by up to 20 original BGMs.
3, A carefully designed puzzle gameplay where switching between multiple characters can trigger different storylines.
4, The game includes boss battles and chase mechanics.
1, This is not a game with a single storyline. Please, explore all branching narratives.
2, Do not trust me; trust the rules established in each room of the game.
3, Remember to turn on the lights during your gameplay.
4, The game’s rules do not apply to your real-world life.
5, If you’re caught in a dilemma, trust your instincts.
If rules open pathways to the deeper layers of this world, what happens when they’re broken?  Between reality and illusion, will you still remember who you are?

title: Star Child
description:
게임 정보
Star Child is an explosive new futuristic action-adventure game built by a small and passionate indie team.

Explore a mysterious alien world full of unique environments, populated by dangerous alien foes.



Conquer a variety of bosses, each one designed to have a unique visual and gameplay style.

Discover secret areas, find new weapons, enhance your abilities, and destroy any obstacles in your way!

Feeling a bit overwhelmed by it all? Relax for a moment and catch some fish!

Colorful, hand-crafted pixel art
Powerful original soundtrack composed by Tantrum Tech
Multiple difficulties designed for a wide range of ages and skill levels
Full keyboard and controller support

title: Umigame
description:
게임 정보
유령의 늪에 더 깊이 들어갈수록, 마녀 메이브의 영향력을 더 많이 느낄 수 있습니다. 그녀는 이곳의 생물들을 자신의 뜻대로 굴복시켜 저주받은 혐오스러운 것으로 만들었습니다.

title: Side42 the tavern of infinity
description:
게임 정보
About This Game

Side42 is a retro platformer that challenges your precision and reflexes. Dive into an adventure spanning 5 chapters, with a total of 20 thrilling levels, each designed to test your skills.

Game Features:

Challenging Gameplay :
Master your skills with a controller to overcome complex obstacles. Please note that a controller is required to play this game.

Time Trial Mode :
Replay levels to beat your best time or collect all the gold.

Simple and Humorous Story :
Enjoy a light-hearted and funny narrative that accompanies you throughout your journey.

Get ready for a captivating gaming experience with Side42, where each level tests your dexterity in a charming retro universe.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Play as a hero who wants to return to the tavern after saving the universe, but the return doesn't go as planned. An odd journey beyond the hero's known boundaries begins, much to his chagrin, because, well, he's finished saving the universe, and there's not even a taxi to take him back, no, he has to walk the way back.

Key features of the game:

-Epic storyline, Post-it style.

-No complex quests, just challenging moments to get back home.

-Your goal: achieve the best time to impress your friends.

-Unique blend of hand-drawn art and contemporary 3D graphics, creating a strange yet captivating aesthetic.

-Test your skills and composure in training rooms to master the art of mastery, like a true master.

-Playable only with a controller for an immersive experience.

-The gameplay remains consistent, it's you who evolves to overcome the challenges.

Get ready for an original gaming experience, where humor, action, and challenges await you at every turn, except when they don't.

title: Office: Boss's Mystery
description:
게임 정보
Office: Boss's Mystery is a humorous point-and-click adventure that combines comedy with an absurd mystery. You play as Tim, a new employee at Global Clips — a small corporation that specializes in selling paperclips. From your very first day, you realize that not everything in this office is as it seems, and what begins as a typical workday quickly turns into a laugh-filled investigation that leads you to uncover the secrets surrounding the boss.
Explore the different corners of the office, solve puzzles, engage in quirky conversations with equally quirky coworkers, and uncover the secrets hidden within the company. With diverse dialogues, surprising interactions, and an unpredictable story, every click reveals new, humorous details.
Key Features:
Absurd and witty storyline — a satirical take on the world of small corporations, full of humor and unexpected situations.
Varied dialogues and interactions — talk to characters, explore the environment, and discover new paths leading to multiple endings.
Charming visual style — low-poly graphics that add a touch of lightness and character to the game.
Atmospheric music — gentle, mood-setting melodies that perfectly complement the office's ambiance and its mysteries.
Office: Boss's Mystery is a game for everyone who appreciates humor and classic point-and-click adventures. Are you ready to solve the boss's mystery and find out what’s really behind those paperclips?

title: Only The Wurst
description:
게임 정보
Only The Wurst is a chaotic first-person party game where you and up to 11 other players compete in an onslaught of non-stop 60 second minigames with no breaks in-between. Each minigame has a completely unique setting, gameplay loop, and artistic direction; with the only thing in common between them being an extreme dedication to over-the-top gib splattering violence!
POINTS MODE
When playing in 'Points' mode, every player's performance in each minigame will be evaluated and earn them points for the round. After a fixed number of minigames have been completed, the player with the most points wins and is rewarded handsomely!
ELIMINATION MODE
When playing in 'Elimination' mode, a poor performance in a minigame will cost you. The bottom-ranking player at the end of each game will be eliminated, and the games will continue taking one victim at a time until only one player remains.
SURVIVAL MODE
When playing in 'Survival' mode, your performance is no longer considered. You and your enemies will cycle through endless minigames until only one person is still alive to be crowned the winner. No respawns, no points, no mercy.
GAME RULE MODIFICATIONS

title: Fantasy Knight
description:
게임 정보
Step into the epic realm of Fantasy Knight, a breathtaking action-adventure game where courage and magic collide! Take on the mantle of a legendary knight, armed with a gleaming sword and formidable magical prowess, as you traverse a stunningly crafted fantasy world teeming with peril and wonder.

Fantasy Knight offers a dynamic combat system that seamlessly blends swift swordplay with powerful magic spells. Engage in heart-pounding battles, mastering devastating combos and unlocking mystical abilities to decimate your foes. Harness the elemental forces of fire, ice, and lightning to aid you in your quest.

Explore and Conquer: Venture through scorched wastelands, treacherous volcanic mountains, and ancient lava-filled ruins. Each environment is intricately designed, brimming with hidden secrets, treacherous traps, and formidable adversaries.

Prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey of heroism and magic in Fantasy Knight. The fate of Ignis rests in your hands—will you rise to the challenge and become the hero the kingdom desperately needs?

title: Hyperslice
description:
게임 정보

Upgrade your ship and buy abilities throughout your run to turn your ship into a killing machine.
Slice through enemies & push them
Use various abilities
Unleash your powerful ship's ultimate

title: DisplaceMen
description:
게임 정보
DisplaceMen is a magic realist ADV that depicts a seven-day mystery story with multiple scenarios and endings.

In the coastal town of Huanmen, everyone knows how to 'displace'—to turn any item or even living being they own into another, as long as the two have equivalent psychological value. Displaced things will vanish and be forgotten.

You are a broke painter who wanders around the town, collecting the strangest things to make art. While chatting with your commissioners, with a painter’s eye to observe and imagine, you will unveil the true faces of these people - the motivational speaker, the trace scholar with a day job as a tattoo artist, the hardcore cosplayer teenager, the wanted pseudoscientist, etc. Working to redeem the vanished “mermaid,” you will accumulate properties until you realize you can displace people. Deciding what to let go of is a painter’s practice. Stay sensitive. Stay gold.



This game will provide a unique visual novel experience featuring multiple gameplay mechanics -
Magic-Realist Narrative
Experience the mainstage “mermaid” mystery by making seamless decisions for multiple endings. Enjoy the satellite stories while exploring various locations in a town operating with the rules of displacement.
Imagine the most impossible found objects as art material. Observe your subjects and chat with your clients to uncover their secrets. Make artistic decisions to enable story branching. Balance special personal values for characters to activate unique painting results.
Collect items and tokens of human ownership within the main story and sidequest. *Bonus: Displace your item or token at the right moment for the best value by watching your psychological values change triggered by events.
Solve small drag-and-drop puzzles while immersed in visceral dream sequences of the vanished “mermaid.” Witness the forgotten story emerging from beautifully intangible streams of consciousness.


_

*Love is an investment. This is a story for those who have the deepest love for things that are not present. We miss the things that are not here, and this drives us insane. We have different mechanisms to process this, and this game proposes two of them: 1, Keep talking to people, and 2, Keep making paintings.

*By the way, the game can make you laugh a lot, especially at inappropriate moments.

On the morning of your 14th birthday, you receive a party invitation from your missing mom. But when you arrive, you find yourself in a cult village. This game is a point-and-click puzzle adventure starring Nero, a black cat. As Nero, you will search for your missing mom and explore the cult village. The villagers seem welcoming, but beneath the surface, secrets are hidden among the fluttering butterflies and lush greenery. Can you escape from this beautiful yet mysterious village?

How to Play
Click on points of interest: If something seems suspicious, click to investigate.
Collect items: Click on items to add them to your item box.
Use items: Click on items in your item box, then click where you want to use them.
Move around: Click arrows to move to different locations.

Playtime: 1 hour

- Develop your territory
- Command your army
- Expand your borders
- Acquire new technologies
- Spy on your enemies

Do you have what it takes to lead your nation to VICTORY?

Deploy your infantry, mortar units, tanks, reconnaissance vehicles, and artillery to attack your enemies. Currently planned 10 land units.
            
Explore through the uncertainties of the fog of war and expand your borders to increase your economic output. The more land you control, the more resources.

Learn or perish. Research new technologies to get access to the most powerful weapons. Currently 30 technologies planned, from unit upgrades to espionage advantages and nuclear weapons.
            
The ultimate weapon. The ultimate deterrence.

title: Urok
description:
게임 정보
자연의 힘을 조종하라
자연을 활용해 놀라운 일을 해보세요. 숲 속의 불길을 커다란 화염구로 바꾸고, 호수를 사라지게 하여 공기를 안개로 채울 수 있습니다. 신중히 움직임을 계획하고 자연의 도움을 받아보세요. 다양한 요소를 조합해 강력한 마법을 만들어보세요!
마법 카드 획득하기
카드를 신중히 선택하세요. 각 마법 카드를 다양한 방식으로 활용할 수 있습니다.
적들에 맞서 반응하라
주변 세계를 잘 관찰하세요. 위험할 수도 있지만 큰 도움이 될 수도 있습니다. 이 게임은 턴제 방식으로 진행되며, 적의 주문을 막거나 특별한 마법을 만들기 위해 신중히 계획을 세울 수 있습니다!

title: Contained
description:
게임 정보
Contained is a monster pet simulator where you are sealed inside a sci-fi facility alongside some moody monsters.
Your role is to take care of these monsters and use their powers to keep the base running.
As your pet monsters evolves, they will uncover new skills, moods and resources.
But beware, monsters have a mind of their own and can be dangerous!

Monster Pet Simulator
Take care of your monsters and watch them grow.
Keep a monster happy, feed it, play with it, and make sure it doesn't get lost for too long.

Base Management
Use your monsters to run and upgrade the facility.
Generate resources, power machines, and keep the lights on.
Can you keep the base running and uncover the secrets of the facility?

Uncover the story
As you progress through the game, you will uncover the story of the facility and the monsters within.
How did you end up here? What is the purpose of the facility?

Complex simulation
The facility stands in a delicate balance. Your input is required to manage and optimize all these interlocking systems.

title: Forsaken Shadows
description:
게임 정보
Forsaken Shadows – A Mind-Bending Singleplayer Horror Experience
Enter the terrifying world of Forsaken Shadows, a single-player psychological horror game where the unseen lurks in the darkness, manipulating your every move. Trapped in an abandoned underground facility, you must unravel dark secrets and survive the psychological torment inflicted by an invisible, malevolent presence.
With every step, the presence draws closer—manifesting through distorted sounds, hallucinations, and shifts in reality. As your stress level rises, your perception becomes increasingly twisted, blurring the line between reality and nightmare. Will you uncover the truth before losing your sanity?
Key Features
🔹 Psychological Horror: Experience an invisible force that manipulates your reality and stalks your every move.
🔹 Immersive Storytelling: Unravel the mysteries of a forgotten facility and piece together the events that led to its demise.
🔹 Dynamic Environments: The underground world shifts and changes, altering your path and perception.
🔹 Stress Mechanic: The more fear consumes you, the more distorted your vision and control become, intensifying the horror.
🔹 Deep Atmosphere: Haunting hallucinations, eerie sounds, and environmental manipulation keep you on edge at all times.
Do you have the strength to escape the Forsaken Shadows? Or will the unseen presence break your mind before you uncover the truth?

title: SerialWorld
description:
게임 정보
A comical RPG where a boy named "Milo" and a mysterious creature "Anima" venture into a fantastical world to solve the town's mysteries!
Strategic Battles with Easy Controls
Engage in battles by summoning three Anima at once!
Each Anima has its own personality, and with numerous skills, there's plenty of strategic depth.
Quirky Characters
Prepare to face off against quirky and comical characters!

title: Orbit
description:
게임 정보
"Orbit" is a resource management text adventure where you explore a planet and uncover its secrets.
Battery
Sunlight charges his battery.


In areas with less sunlight, his battery charge decreases.
Interact
Nico can interact with some objects.



Nico may find items from them.
Some items can be exchanged for other items.
While making sure your battery doesn't run out, investigate the objects on the planet and uncover its hidden secrets!

title: Lost Resolve
description:
게임 정보
You awaken in the Somber Sepulchre, utterly alone and bereft of purpose. To find your Lost Resolve, you must venture deep within the Forlorn Dream. You will search the very depths of loneliness and sorrow, that you might once again find hope.

Game Features
A variety of movement abilities that flow together seamlessly
Beautiful worlds to run through and lose yourself in
Challenging time trials
An emotive and nostalgic original soundtrack

title: Shadoblitz
description:
게임 정보
This is a high-freedom hack-and-slash roguelite. As an apprentice reaper, you must undergo the Reaper's trials, fighting strategically in limited spaces, absorbing evil spirits, and using the environment to your advantage!

title: Nuclear Tides
description:
게임 정보
Nuclear Tides is a minimalist tower defense game. After the nuclear apocalypse, the isolated island is filled with radiation. Clear the radiation and build structures and turrets during the day, and defend your base against the onslaught of nuclear tides at night. Game features include：
Procedurally generated initial land plots.
Dozens of different land plots include buildings, turrets, and wonders. Most of the time, two identical plots can be combined to form a higher-level plot.
The synergistic effects of turrets
Be mindful not to let emissions get too high, or it will lead to disaster. Find a balance between economy, defense, and the environment.

title: Sacred Earth - Reverie
description:
게임 정보
Sacred Earth - Reverie is a fantasy RPG with visual novel elements, inspired by both classic and modern JRPGs. Follow the story of a former knight of the kingdom as they go on a personal journey through the countryside in order to uncover hidden truths and long lost mysteries of the past.
Explore dungeons, interact with your allies and the townsfolk, build your characters with equipment, abilities, and perks, and test your might against foes in fast-paced turn-based combat.

title: Jötunn's Greed
description:
게임 정보
Down with the Jötunn! Take down that giant!

A war-hungry giant has laid siege to your village. Play as a viking village chief and raid nearby villages to build your home back up from the ruins. Risk losing your gathered loot by venturing further into the continent and raiding more difficult villages. If you're strong enough, you'll reach the Jötunn's village and take revenge!
Gather Supplies
Each village is stocked with chests and other containers full of building supplies, currency and equipment to help your village grow. The farther in you go, the more loot you can acquire.
Choose your build
Choose between different sets of weapons and armor, each giving you different stat upgrades and attack abilities.
Fight for your life
Your health is limited. Losing all of your health on a raid will cause you to drop all of your acquired loot and return to your home village.
Upgrade your village
Had some successful raids? Use the supplies you gathered to upgrade buildings in your home village, giving you access to better equipment and new abilities.
Wield God-like powers
Utilize 1 of 5 possible powers of the Norse gods while on your raids, giving you special abilities.
Avoid the Storm
Some Norse deities do not like loot hogs. After spending too much time in a single village, a storm will appear, forcing you to move on or perish.
Navigate Through the Fog
Until the storm arrives, each village you raid is filled with dense fog, making it difficult to find your way around.
No Two Villages are the Same
Each village is procedurally generated. Just because you found your way before does not guarantee you will again.

title: Ghost Kickers!
description:
게임 정보
Ghost Kickers! is a top-down action-adventure inspired by classics from the 16-bit era. Choose an exorcist from a range of powerful heroes, each with their own weapons and mystical skills. Battle an army of yokai to save the world from chaos.

Game Features:

Single-Player Story
Embark on a grand adventure to face the yokai thread and discover a magical world filled with secrets and wonder.

100-Storied Pagoda
Test your skills as you climb a towering pagoda to become the strongest exorcist in the world.

Multiplayer Arena
Challenge your friends in the arena, both offline and online and reach for the top in ranked matches.

Map Designer
Create, customize, and share your own maps with a global community for endless new adventures.

Unique Exorcists
Choose from a unique cast of customizable heroes, each with distinct abilities and playstyles.

Prepare to vanquish the darkness and rise as a legendary exorcist in Ghost Kickers!

title: Humanolve: A Human Evolution Card Saga
description:
게임 정보
Humanolve: A Human Evolution Card Saga is the epitome of human survival and evolution. Immerse yourself in a world thousands of years ago, as early humans took the first steps to dominate nature. Can you survive the hostilities of nature and wild life in this roguelite adventure? Or will you succumb to a mere footnote of history?
Core Features
Every choice matters: A simple and intuitive system involving interacting with and combining cards, yet choices have a deep and profound impact on your evolution journey.
Action based research system: Your actions reward you in more ways than one. You can unlock powerful tools and abilities based on your actions.
Deep simulation: Fulfill evolving physical and psychological needs with diverse activities—harvesting, crafting, hunting, nourishing, healing, tracking, communication, and more—yielding surprising outcomes.
Expansive Exploration: Traverse 10+ unique locations brimming with challenges and rewards, each offering distinct hurdles and thrilling discoveries.
Master the nature: Explore your surroundings, make them secure for your people to call home, harvest resources, hunt wild game, heal and nourish your tribe.
Memorable Endings: Encounter diverse end game scenarios, each offering a satisfying conclusion to your epic survival tale. Each scenario presents a meticulously crafted challenge, beckoning replay for maximum enjoyment!

Note: This is pre-alpha footage for reference!

title: Streamer Content: a simple mechanic
description:
게임 정보
The "Streamer Guy" is doing his routine live stream while his frustration serves as content and entertainment. In the midst of it, he reaches his limit and, after rage-quitting, decides to embark on a journey of self-discovery to find out who he is and what his position is in the world and the universe. Help Streamer Guy in this difficult journey using only a mouse!
Enjoy:

A simple mechanic! Move the mouse cursor using the center of the screen as the base, and Streamer Guy will move in the same intensity. Anyone can get the hang of it!

title: Never Be Alone
description:
게임 정보

Dive into the post-apocalyptic realm of 'Never Be Alone,' an expansive open-world game designed for both solo and multiplayer experiences. In this zombie survival adventure, you can seamlessly team up with friends or brave the dangers alone. Beyond the relentless undead, you'll face ruthless bandits and the relentless challenges of hunger, thirst, and treacherous radioactive zones. Survive against all odds, where the environment is as deadly as the creatures that inhabit it.
Dynamic Gameplay Features:

First & Third Person View: Experience the apocalypse through your preferred perspective. Whether you want the immersion of first-person or the awareness of third-person, switch seamlessly to suit your playstyle.
Advanced Survival Systems:
Farming System: Cultivate your own crops to sustain your group’s needs.
Generator System: Keep the lights on and your equipment powered with a robust generator system, vital for survival in the darkest times.
Rich Resource Gathering:
Scavenge and Salvage: Delve into the remnants of civilization to loot broken cars and abandoned buildings for crucial supplies.
Gather essential materials like wood, stone, and metal from the environment, necessary for crafting and building.
Relax with a fishing rod to catch food, providing a peaceful contrast to the post-apocalyptic tension.
Employ stealth and skill with the bow to dispatch threats quietly and efficiently.
Use collected materials to craft a variety of items and tools at your workbench, from defensive structures to utilities.
Maintain and repair your weapons and gear at the repair bench, ensuring you're always ready for whatever challenges lie ahead.
Scour different shops in the safe zones for supplies, weapons, and unique items.
Engage in a variety of missions and side quests that will challenge your skills and reward you handsomely.
Find sanctuary in designated Safe Zones where you can interact with other players peacefully, trade goods, plan your next move, and stay clear from both undead and human threats.



The common threat. These slow-moving zombies aren't much of a challenge individually but can quickly become overwhelming in numbers.
Quicker than the Walker, this fast-paced zombie will test your stamina. Running may save you for a moment, but they'll keep up the chase.
The pinnacle of undead agility. If a Sprinter spots you, don't even think about running; it's futile. Your best chance is to stand your ground and fight.
Approach with caution. This medium-speed menace will explode upon death, releasing a toxic cloud that can be lethal. Long-range weapons are advised, as melee attacks are a death wish.
The ultimate behemoth. Encountering a Brute means it's time to either bring out the big guns or get out of the way. Exceptionally dangerous at close range, a Brute can demolish anything in its path.


Fortify your territory by constructing impenetrable bases. Customize your fortress to reflect your survival style.
Dare to explore radioactive zones, but beware—without the proper gas mask, these areas spell instant doom.
Whether warding off bandits or outsmarting the undead, survival is better with friends. Easy connectivity makes teaming up a breeze.


Customize your survivor with a selection of character meshes and hairstyles. While the options are straightforward, they allow you to create a character that fits your style within the game's post-apocalyptic world.
Equip yourself for survival with a broad range of weaponry options. Whether you prefer the silent precision of bows and melee weapons or the robust power of firearms, you'll find tools that suit your tactical needs. And when you need a moment's respite from the ongoing chaos, enjoy a peaceful fishing break by the waterside.


Get a taste of the apocalypse with several missions designed to introduce you to the world of "Never Be Alone."
Prepare to navigate a world where danger lurks around every corner and teamwork is the key to survival. Are you ready to face the undead and never be alone?

Embark on thrilling adventures alongside your favorite streamers and experience the thrill of victory and the agony of defeat! Why Choose the Steam Version of Embervale?
The Steam version of Embervale offers the most reliable and optimized gaming experience. With all graphical assets included directly in the game, you can enjoy significantly reduced loading times. This ensures that even players with slower internet connections can dive into the adventure seamlessly.

Streamers will particularly benefit from using the Steam version when playing Adventure mode with their viewers, as it provides the best and smoothest experience possible.

Rest assured, the Steam version contains the same rich content and exciting features as the Twitch extension and web versions. Plus, you can showcase your Embervale achievements on your Steam profile, adding an extra layer of bragging rights to your gaming accomplishments.
Can I Play Without a Twitch Account?
When you start Embervale, you'll have the option to create an account through Steam or link your existing Twitch account to your Steam profile. This flexibility ensures you can jump into the game whether you’re using Twitch or not.

However, for Twitch streamers, there's an exclusive Adventure Mode. To access this feature, you'll need to either log in with your Twitch account or link your Steam account to Twitch. This mode is designed to enhance the interactive experience for streamers and their communities!
Once you link your account to Steam, all your achievements will be synchronized across platforms. No matter where you play, any unlocked achievements will automatically appear on your Steam profile. This seamless integration ensures your accomplishments are always up-to-date and ready to show off!

title: Zombiehood
description:
게임 정보

절차적으로 생성된 세계를 달리고 총을 쏘세요. Zombiehood는 당신이 무작위 무기, 탄약 및 아티팩트를 관리하면서 점점 더 강력해지는 좀비 무리를 상대하는 도전을 합니다. 죽음과 함께 새로운 시작이 오며, 지도가 재설정됩니다. 그러나 진행 상황은 경험치와 돈의 형태로 계속되어, 이를 사용해 런 간에 캐릭터를 강화할 수 있습니다.
강렬한 전투
Zombiehood의 전투는 속이 깊습니다. 적은 특정 약점, 갑옷 및 저항력을 가지고 있어, 게임에서 긴장감을 유지해야 합니다. 부위별 데미지는 사지와 머리를 쏘면 새로운 적 유형을 유발할 수 있습니다. 움직임은 타이트하고 무게감이 있으며 비커밋형 회피는 빠르게 움직일 수 있게 합니다. 다양한 무기 종류가 게임을 흥미롭게 유지합니다.
에머전트 로그라이트 시스템
Zombiehood의 시스템은 서로 겹쳐집니다. 수십 가지 무기를 수집하고 스탯을 업그레이드하면 아티팩트를 발견하게 됩니다. 아티팩트는 무작위 게임플레이 수정자를 제공하여 플레이 방식을 형성하며, 이들은 쌓입니다. 이러한 수정자와 올바른 무기 간의 시너지를 찾아 강력한 빌드를 만들어 적을 물리치세요.

무한한 맵 다양성
맵은 바이옴으로 구성되며, 이는 다양한 레벨 풀로 구성됩니다. 이러한 레벨은 각 런마다 무작위로 선택되고 생성되어 두 번의 런이 동일하지 않게 됩니다. 전쟁의 안개가 맵을 덮고 있으며, 이를 탐험하여 최종 보스에게 도달해야 합니다. 도중에 보충 및 치유할 수 있는 상점과 도와주거나 해를 끼칠 수 있는 무작위 이벤트를 찾게 될 것입니다.
끝없는 전투
성공적인 런을 완료하면 새로운 '해골 난이도'가 잠금 해제됩니다. 이 난이도는 최대 5번까지 중첩될 수 있으며, 50레벨의 적을 상대할 수 있습니다. 더 큰 적은 더 큰 보상을 의미하며, 이를 통해 최적의 미니멕싱을 추구하면서 캐릭터를 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.
오픈 소스
치트 브랜치에서 개발자 콘솔에 액세스할 수 있습니다. 탐험하고, 실험하고, 게임플레이 시스템을 조작하여 독특한 시나리오와 도전을 만드세요. 또한, 코드는 완전히 오픈 소스이며, 리믹스하고, 적응하고, 새로운 콘텐츠를 제작하여 게임의 커뮤니티 주도 진화를 가능하게 합니다.

title: Fatal Dopamine/ 致命多巴胺
description:
게임 정보
About This Game

"Fatal Dopamine" is a strategy-filled and challenging roguelike card game that also tests your luck. In this game, you will play as an anonymous gambler who arrives at a peculiar casino. Using a variety of unique cards, you'll employ strategy and luck in a blackjack-based game to achieve victory and become a "big shot" on the leaderboard. The gambling here isn't just about playing blackjack; it integrates multiple complex rules and strategies. Each game is a psychological battle where you need to gauge your opponent's thoughts and predict their next move. Simultaneously, you must manage your chips and cards to ensure you can surprise your opponents at critical moments. Through continuous gambling, you can gather clues to uncover the well-hidden truths of this place. Is there a conspiracy behind the games? Deception among gamblers? Evil dealings by merchants? What is the truth behind the dopamine? More stories await your discovery.

Story Background

In this world, there exists a place where only those driven by extreme desires can enter. Here, they come with their lucky cards, wagering their blood as the stakes to raise the ante for their enemies. Those who come here are all in pursuit of becoming the prominent figures on the leaderboard, which promises them the long-coveted "dopamine" they've heard so much about.

However, behind the facade of playful revelry, a darker undercurrent flows. This secretive place attracts a variety of individuals: powerful counts, scholars in search of truth, and swordsmen who will stop at nothing to gain power. Each gathers here for their own reasons, creating an atmosphere thick with tension and excitement. In the brightly lit hall, every table is adorned with exquisite gambling tools. The gamblers' eyes are like those of hungry wolves, fixated on every card and chip on the table.


-Lucky Cards: Customize your own cards that will soon meet you in the game, providing crucial assistance at critical moments.
-Deck Building: Defeat merchant bosses to unlock powerful effect cards and build your unique deck to form a distinct combat style.
-Free Choice of Challenge Order: Challenge the big names on the leaderboard in any order you prefer, which will influence the sequence of merchant card -unlocks and your deck building strategy.



-Randomly Generated Levels: Each adventure is a new experience. Randomly generated enemies, events, and rewards ensure every game is full of surprises.
-Random Events: Encounter random events that will give you extra number and effect cards. Keep an eye out for them when they appear.
-Strategic Combat: Plan every move carefully, using card combinations and tactical strategies to defeat powerful enemies and bosses.
-Permadeath: Death is final. Every failure means starting over, but you can learn and grow stronger from each experience.
-Story Unlocks: Continuously collecting cards will unlock new character stories, giving you a deeper understanding of the diverse characters in the casino.


Diverse Card Collection: Over 100 unique cards providing countless combinations and strategies.
Deep Strategy: Every decision is crucial. Choose the best cards and strategies for the current situation to progress further.
Unique Visual Style: Beautiful hand-drawn art brings you into a fantastical world that is both beautiful and dangerous.
Engaging Music: Completely original soundtrack that creates a tense and exciting adventure atmosphere.

title: POUMOSA
description:
게임 정보
= Gameplay =
POUMOSA is a Point And Click adventure game.
It is intended for players who like dialogues, puzzles and wiggling mustaches.
= Story =
In 1503, Europe is captivated by the promise of the New World. Expeditions are being prepared in all the kingdoms, each hoping to obtain their share of the riches and unexplored lands.
You play the role of Balthazar De Rochemort, a nobleman who invests in one of these expeditions and boards a ship. However, caught in a violent storm, your expedition drifts and discovers a small mysterious island, inhabited by an unknown people.
Study their language !

title: Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments
description:
게임 정보
"Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments"는 3D 숨은 그림 찾기 게임으로, 당신의 임무는 아늑하고 어질러진 아파트에 숨어 있는 1000마리 이상의 고양이를 찾는 것입니다.
서랍, 금고, 캐비닛을 열고 물건을 이동시켜 가장 예상치 못한 숨은 장소를 찾아보세요. 아파트의 모든 구석구석에는 놀라움과 도전이 가득하며, 디테일이 풍부한 등각 투영 환경을 탐험할 수 있습니다.
비밀 고양이와 흥미로운 퍼즐을 통해 새로운 방과 지역을 잠금 해제하세요. "Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments"는 고양이 애호가와 탐험 도전의 팬들에게 완벽한 선택입니다.
최고의 고양이 찾기 달인이 될 준비가 되셨나요?

title: C:aged
description:
게임 정보
C:aged is a short visual novel with multiple endings, hundreds of branching paths and where your choices do matter.
Story
SPOILER: The following text will reveal story information that may spoil the mystery of the game.
Where are you?
What is this place?
Where is the game that you are wanting to play?
All these questions are likely on your mind as you stare at a slow stream of falling symbols, but then...
Who is this girl?
What is her role here?
Why is she so evasive?
Why won't she let you play the game?
The mystery deepens as you get sidetracked in odd conversation after odd conversation, each time getting no closer to the game you are expected to play.

title: Madora
description:
게임 정보
A third-person 3D Roguelite like you've never seen before! Madora raises the challenge level by bringing a different map perspective and character view. Explore dark forests and lands as you challenge enemies and protect the world of Madora.

title: Ella Stars
description:
게임 정보
[게임 소개]
🎸 엘라 스타즈 – 리듬의 힘으로 스테이지를 정복하라!
박자 감각? 없어도 괜찮아!
엘라 스타즈에서는 ‘엘라’와 ‘버드’가 함께 뮤직 세계를 위협하는 악당들을 물리칩니다!
강렬한 비트와 함께 보스들의 스킬을 피하고, 리듬 액션으로 반격하세요!
애니메이션을 찢고 나온 듯한 생동감 넘치는 뮤직 액션 게임 – 지금 도전하세요!
[게임 특징]
■다채로운 음악 스타일
- 글램 록(Glam Rock)부터 로파이 힙합(Lo-fi HipHop)까지!
- 비트에 몸을 맡기면 귀가 즐거워지는 사운드 트랙!

title: Astro Combat
description:
게임 정보
[Introduction]：
A space explorer with a dream of living freely has been pursuing infinite energy. Just as he is about to complete the construction of a Dyson Sphere, he is suddenly attacked by a more advanced civilization, losing everything and forced to flee. He makes an emergency landing on an unknown planet.
Alone and with limited resources, he must start from scratch, searching for supplies, rebuilding his life, and rekindling his dream of freedom!
During his journey, he encounters one of twelve trapped Star Sprites, who seeks help and hopes that her sisters can also be rescued.
Accept this mission and delve deep into the secrets of this mysterious planet.
You will traverse various regions, experience exotic cultures, make friends, face challenges, and ultimately save all the Star Sprites, absorbing their energy to repair your ship.
Afterward, you can continue to take on more challenges in the vast universe. Completing the story doesn't necessarily mean the game is over~

title: Just Grow
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the dark world of childhood nightmares, where every room is a challenge, and every fight is a test of courage.
Step into the shoes of Cooper, a young hero trapped in an abandoned orphanage filled with reawakened childhood memories. Plush bears, toys, clowns, and robots—seemingly innocent things have transformed into dark monsters that stand in your way. To survive, you must fight, explore, and develop your skills as you navigate procedurally generated rooms packed with challenges.
Gather essence from defeated enemies and use it to play the mysterious "GrowMachine.” The rewards you earn will unlock new possibilities—granting abilities that allow you to delve deeper into the orphanage and uncover its secrets.
Key Features:
Dynamic melee combat: Intuitive controls and reflex-based gameplay deliver thrilling action.
Procedurally generated levels: Every playthrough is a fresh challenge—you never know what lies behind the next door.
Unique art style: Hand-drawn, frame-by-frame animations give the game a distinctive look.
Dark, magical atmosphere: The abandoned orphanage holds many secrets, balancing fear and wonder.
Embark on an emotional adventure that pushes the limits of courage and perseverance. Will Cooper conquer the nightmares of childhood and find light within the darkness?

title: Soul Roach City
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a harrowing journey of violent paranoia and schizophrenic delusion in Soul Roach City, the worst city in the world—a decaying urban nightmare where gangs rule, and the streets are flooded with drugs, smut, and despair. Thrust into a brutal, action-packed FPS horror experience, confront horrific realities and twisted delusions of guilt and suffering as you struggle to discern what’s real from the nightmares that haunt your mind. Are you ready to face the truth?
Key Features:
Roguelike Perma-Death FPS: Every run is unique, with high stakes and no second chances.
Cigarette-Based Health System: Stay alive by strategically managing your health in a grim, unconventional way.
Projectile-Based Bullet System: Experience satisfying, skill-driven combat where every bullet counts.
Diverse Enemies: Battle brutal gangs and surreal, drug-induced visions in a city gone mad.
Multiple Stages of Descent: Progress deeper into the decaying nightmare of Soul Roach City.
Unique Perks Every Run: Customize your playstyle with perks that make each run a new experience.
Discover Each Characters Harrowing Past: Unravel the tragic journey into madness of each playable character that led to this point.
Explore the Rich Lore: Dive deep into the twisted and haunting history of Soul Roach City.
Classic FPS-Inspired Movement System: Master air-strafing, bunnyhopping, and more for high-speed, skill-based traversal.

title: Shape Warzone
description:
게임 정보
Redefine tower defense in Shape Warzone, a 2D top-down strategy game where every wave is a fresh challenge. Unpredictable and randomized enemy spawns keep you on your toes as you defend your base from relentless, shape-themed attackers.
Start by mining Shape Shards, your currency, to build and upgrade an arsenal of turrets and defenses. Expand your base across a dynamic grid system that evolves into more challenging layouts offering higher XP rewards at greater risks. Customize your defenses with buildings like long-range snipers or lasers, defensive goos or shockers, and fast paced turrets to create a fortress as unique as your playstyle.

title: WitchCraft: Spellbound Decks
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에 대하여

Witchcraft: Spellbound Decks는 고대 마법의 예술에 몰입하여 카드를 구성하는 로그라이크 덱빌딩 게임입니다. 마법이 실재하는 신비로운 세계를 배경으로, 플레이어는 젊은 마녀가 되어 강력한 주문과 의식의 힘을 활용하여 점점 더 어려워지는 적들을 물리칩니다.

Witchcraft에서 실험은 필수적입니다. 다양한 카드 조합을 통해 강력한 전략을 창조하세요. 당신은 순수한 힘을 추구하나요, 아니면 교묘한 속임수를 신뢰하나요? 일시적인 이익을 위해 카드를 희생할 것인가, 아니면 장기적으로 무적의 덱을 구성할 것인가요? 선택은 당신의 몫이며, 각 시도는 다를 것이고, 당신의 전술을 적응하고 발전시키도록 도전할 것입니다.
특징

턴제 전투: 각 움직임이 중요한 전략적 전투에 참여하세요. 신중하게 행동을 계획하고, 강력한 주문과 교묘한 전술을 사용하여 적을 압도하세요.

탐험 지도: 가지가 많은 경로와 숨겨진 비밀이 가득한 동적인 지도를 탐험하세요. 다양한 도전과 보상을 만나면서 신중하게 경로를 선택하세요.

카드 제작: 고대 의식을 통해 새로운 카드를 제작하여 덱을 맞춤화하세요. 요소를 결합하여 자신만의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 강력한 주문과 능력을 만드세요.

상점: 신비로운 상점을 방문하여 특정 카드를 구매하세요. 자원을 현명하게 사용하여 덱을 강화하고 생존 확률을 높이세요.

랜덤 이벤트: 여정의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있는 다양한 랜덤 이벤트를 경험하세요. 유용한 동료이거나 위험한 적일 수 있는 이 만남들은 당신을 긴장하게 할 것입니다.

보스 전투: 독특한 능력과 전략을 가진 강력한 보스와 맞서 싸우세요. 가장 숙련된 마녀들만이 그들을 물리치고 여정을 계속할 수 있을 것입니다.

title: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
description:
게임 정보
A thoroughly original point and click adventure set between a vibrant fantasy world and the South Yorkshire/Derbyshire apocalypse.
Venture through working men's club parties, 24-hour all-night shrubberies, A post apocalyptic Peak District and fire-regulation-busting, volcano-adjacent coffee shops in this final comedy point and click extravaganza!
Crammed to breaking point with clever puzzles, hilarious events and a thoroughly 1990s adventure style.

title: Sorted
description:
게임 정보
Sorted is an online co-op game for one to four players. You are a robotic chibi employee traveling across space in a high-tech cargo spaceship. Your mission is simple, to craft and send products within the various sorting stations across the known galaxy. Avoid destruction as you race against the clock, to appease customers both far and near. Work together with your friends to become the most effective sorting company or fall prey to the rival company Skull Express led by Doctor Diabolical. Keep your ship running smoothly and achieve greatness!
Machines
Utilize machines to help get the job done. Interact with the stamper, combination, and sorting machines to get those products out of the station and into the hands of your customers.
Customization
Customize your robot to sort with style! Make yourself unique by changing accessories ranging from heads, hats, eyewear, and backpacks.
Strategy
Find your playstyle as you take on the challenges of each station with its unique layout and environmental hazards that will test your very metal. Will you succeed or succumb to your rival sorting company?

title: GOLDO: Lost Goblin
description:
게임 정보
Guide Goldo, a lost goblin, in this short, surreal stealth adventure: sneak past hostile adventurers, uncover bizarre treasures, and unravel the dungeon's dark mystery!
SNEAK AROUND - Use cover and tunnels to avoid gold-thirsty adventurers. Carefully time each move to stay hidden.
DISCOVER BIZARRE TREASURES - Explore for treasures left behind by the dungeon’s enigmatic boss. Every discovery brings you closer to understanding its true nature. All that glitters is Gold.
EXPLORE A SURREAL WORLD - Journey through the Golden Nexus, a bizarre and oneiric dungeon where reality bends. Is this place a dream or a nightmare?

title: Rusty Heights
description:
게임 정보
Rusty Heights is an experimental side-view platform game: It is to be played with the mouse only and is made of a single very high level to be climbed without ever falling down.
You play as the last functional robot of your kind. Equipped only with your grappling hook, you will have to overcome the obstacles of the mountain: electrical platforms, deadly turrets and many other rusty machines will prevent you from reaching the top of this dystopian world.
Be careful, the higher you go, the greater the fall! So Learn to master your trusty grappling hook, and never give up!
Be brave little robot! Every fall will make you stronger!

title: Sibling Souls
description:
게임 정보
Step into the dark world of 2147, a dystopian place of vampires, androids, and dangerous secrets
You are Lina, a young woman desperate to find your twin brother, who vanished the night he became a vampire. Leaving behind the safety of your home, you step into a city where danger hides in every shadow. In your search for answers, you’ll uncover secrets that threaten not just your brother—but the fragile balance of the world itself.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The new humans may look like ordinary people, but beneath their polished exterior lies cold machinery. They call themselves the city's protectors, maintaining order through constant surveillance and binding residents with digital communication rings. They know far too much about you—and this knowledge might lead you to your brother… unless they choose to use it against you.

title: Beneath The Bell
description:
게임 정보
Average playtime: around 120 minutes.
Beneath the Bell is a horror game that combines exploration, bizarre puzzles, and frightening paranormal phenomena, all enriched by brief action sessions.
You will find yourself in an old abandoned school, immersed in a gloomy and disturbing atmosphere, which changes and deforms due to paranormal events that you will unintentionally trigger.
By exploring it thoroughly, it will reveal itself to you, allowing you to uncover its secrets and move forward.
You will have to solve dark puzzles and escape the presences that haunt the school.

title: Rico's Theater
description:
게임 정보
Welcome, Investigator! 

You work for an organization called, "The Order," a paranormal investigation company that strictly deals with entities & objects called "Anomalies." These anomalies are manifestations of pure chaos, and it's our job to contain & eliminate them. ... we're losing control of the situation. Fast. 
   
In the Order HQ, you'll be able to upgrade your equipment, study on known & unknown entities, shop for allies & other important materials, edit your character's classes & skill trees, & much more. You can also just hang out & socialize with other fellow investigators if you feel like it! 




 is a large facility that will actively change with every investigation that you initiate. No investigation will be the same. You will have multiple tasks & objectives to complete in each investigation of which vary in difficulty & skill. Your primary objective will be to lure any anomalies using the appropriate equipment & to eliminate them once they show themselves.




, the more dangerous & difficult the anomaly(s) will become. Eliminate any threats you encounter. Remember, you will not always be dealing with one single anomaly. There will most likely be multiple depending on your investigation. 


We're excited to work with you.

title: Raed
description:
게임 정보
Lost in the aftermath of a black hole incident, you’re left floating in space with fading oxygen and fragmented clues. Explore haunting environments, uncover hidden truths, and piece together the fate of your crew in this emotional sci-fi adventure. Will you survive long enough to face the dark secret that awaits?

title: Tangermarine
description:
게임 정보
Tangermarine is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter with a dash of bullet heaven and roguelite thrown in. Explode vegetables with a horrifically cute citrus super soldier - it's a-gore-able! Oppressive horror atmosphere and veg-based blood and gore meets Kawai cuteness.
Fast-paced twin-stick arena shooter action
Survive waves of undead veg in rounds 30 - 90 seconds long
Gather souls to upgrade your character and gain a new powerup with each wave
Lots of fruit and vegetable-based gore
Lots of vegetables were harmed in the making of this game

title: On Roads Between
description:
게임 정보
On Roads Between is currently in ALPHA and will not be released until complete. Free demos will be available forever but will have limited cross-play with the final game.
Monsters are attacking New Zealand, and the newspaper is paying good money for photos. Grab a camera, a couple mates and your high-school car, to be the first to capitalize on it.
On Roads Between is a co-op horror game set in 1980s New Zealand with a unique papercraft art-style. Drive anywhere from the top of the North Island to the bottom of the South to capture anomalies and Lovecraftian horrors on fresh film.
On Roads Between features a massive map (won't be in demo, still squashing bugs,) where you can drive from town to town. Restock and replenish your items in the small towns before venturing out into the native bush to get paid. Keep your car topped up and repaired, just in case you need a quick getaway.
You can drive almost anywhere, and where you can't, you can hike. Keep in mind that you drop your items when you die, so don't go too far from you camp.
Camps are how you respawn friends, save progress and pass the time. This is the 1980s, so you have to pass time by playing instruments, sports and maybe a few pranks on your friends. Remember, time flies when you're having fun.
Soon enough, night will fall. And with it, monsters and anomalies will be more common. Get your cameras ready, and hope you have enough spare film to catch them all. And don't worry if a Scuttler or a Merchant takes you out. You can still help your friends from beyond the grave.
With your new found dough, put together the slickest outfit you can. Stick stickers all over your character to build a unique look. Yes, I know what you guys will do with this feature, and you can disable seeing other's custom costumes. Please don't make me regret adding this.
Also, I am going to look into making the stickers tradable, with a foil and aging system. Keep an eye out for rare stickers, because you might be the only one in the world to have it.

title: Cryptage
description:
게임 정보
A real-time action roguelite, you are a wizard venturing into a crypt full of monsters, while improving yourself as a wizard, in this roguelike you can buy staffs and skins for your wizard, with an infinite game mode where you defeat bosses and enemies, the gameplay is based on waves, and in each wave you can choose some cards that will give you powerful abilities, and when you choose repeated cards the ability improves in some way.

title: Tiny Racing
description:
게임 정보
Gear up for a thrilling ride in Tiny Racing! Dive into a vibrant world of pixel art where you control a variety of vehicles across contrasting and challenging tracks. With intuitive arcade controls, master each turn, drift, and boost to outpace your rivals.
From time trials to full tournaments, every race is a test of skill and strategy. Win cash to purchase new vehicles and become the undisputed champion! Get ready for high-speed excitement and a nostalgic gaming experience in Tiny Racing!
Summary
Get behind the wheel of trucks, drift cars and formula cars!
Quick race, time trials and 12-race tournaments await you
18 unique tracks over 3 settings both day and night
Earn money winning races to purchase cool new vehicles
Easy to pick-up controls means you dive right in!
Out-drive computer opponents over 4 difficulty modes

title: Wolley's Dungeon Adventure
description:
게임 정보
In Ballonia, life once thrived thanks to its cheerful, bouncy inhabitants. But when the dark sorcerer Malvolio appeared, he invaded the land, and corrupted the cheerful critters, turning them into dark and dangerous entities. 
It's up to you to use your special abilities to take back Ballonia, and restore peace to the land, and its inhabitants
After Malvolio invaded, there was one Ballonian who refused to give up hope. Wolley possesses a special power that allows him to inhale and expel objects. 
Help take back Ballonia alone, or with a friend with co-op mode

title: Squash and Spell : Kids Typing
description:
게임 정보
Squash and Spell is a fun & friendly game designed for children as soon as they show an interest to interact with a computer. 
A fun on screen representation of all the letters in the alphabet.
                     A spelling rainbow with lots of words.
A word processor mode which lets children type and see the result.
                     Fully voice acted, including a toggle for phonics.
A writing mode where, depending on hardware, children can use a stylus, touch or mouse to draw letters.
                    Time of day system with cosy ambient sounds.

title: Don't Forget the Phone
description:
게임 정보
Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Use the computer and other gadgets around the tower to complete your nightly checklist.
But watch out! The research subjects from the lab below tend to wander a bit at night. Use all methods at your disposal to dissuade them.
Complete all of your tasks before sunrise or YOU'RE FIRED!
Congratulations on your new position as a watchtower attendant!
On behalf of the Eclipse Research Foundation, welcome to our family!
Your role is vital in securing, and protecting, our state-of-the-art research facility. Nightly duties will consist of stimulating, and engaging, tasks such as:
Answering phone calls!
Checking your email!

title: MiniMo: Crazy Chase
description:
게임 정보
The chase is as ON as it is CRAZY!
MiniMo: Crazy Chase is an online, fast-paced, asymmetrical twist on the classic hide 'n seek formula for 1-5 players where players fulfill one of two different roles.
Either they are MONSTERS, hiding to avoid getting caught and seeking to collect all the keys before it's too late... or they play as THE ROBOT, hiding from NO ONE but seeking to chase and collect all of those puny, soon-to-be incarcerated monsters! 
It's a party game through and through, inviting you to jumpscare your friends or steel your stealthy nerves in quick matches that last no longer than 2 minutes!
Over in a flash in more ways than one!
The good news is you can see things in front of you. The bad news is, that's the ONLY thing you can see! All stages are shrouded in darkness, your flashlights the only weapon against this dim unknown. The monsters' flashlights are... functional at best. The robot, however, has a much cooler, more expensive robo-flashlight to make monster-chasin' easier!
If a monster flashes their lights on a key for some time, they collect it. But if a monster stays within the horrifyingly red light of the robot, it gets CAUGHT and put in monster-jail! If all keys are collected, the monsters win. If all monsters have been caught, the robot wins!
But wait, isn't 4 vs 1 unfair?
Well, unfair for whom?
When you play as the ROBOT...you, and you alone, get to be the sci-fi-horror-villain I always knew you could be, making the monsters sweat as they desperately try to avoid you. But you do have a few tricks up your, um, sleeve. Wait, do robots have sleeves?
For one, the monsters are on the clock... you are NOT! If time runs out, you ALSO win! 
Secondly, as the game progresses, and those monsters (hopefully and/or regrettably) collect more and more keys, your robot software unlocks hidden benefits.
The monsters, though... are slippery and, well, plural! Oh, and they have these awesome powers they'll try to use at the right time to (hopefully and/or regrettably) gain the upper hand. Wait, do monsters have upper hands?
