Also, it's not over when caught. Fellow monsters may try to orchestrate a prison break just for you – working together and good communication are your keys to victory! Aside from the actual keys, that is!

title: Sigrid & Friends: Playtime
description:
게임 정보
In this mix between turn-based RPG and visual novel, you get to know four girls that make up the continent's best adventure club, as you all go to the Sketchpark to play town games, dungeon games, and more. Play together, get to know each other and have the most fun you can have, before going home to enjoy a relaxing evening and a fairy-tale marathon.
Features:
* A surreal tone and setting with quirky, over-the-top characters and the opportunity to build bonds with them.
* A meta-layer where you get to decide the conditions for each game.
* A turn-based combat system focusing on special attacks.

title: Once Glorious Artahk
description:
게임 정보
In Once Glorious Artahk, you’ll explore the ruins of the ancient city of Artahk in search of a way to save the world from an endless night. Solve a variety of different puzzles to unlock new paths, abilities, and forgotten lore, then read the lost stories you uncover to gain insight into a tangled web of mysteries. Using only your wits and your trusty torch to guide you, you must find a way to return light to a starless sky. 
EXPLORE
Explore crumbling ruins, darkened halls, and tangled forests as you scour what remains of the once-glorious city of Artahk. The game world is divided into five distinct zones that can be explored non-linearly and feature many puzzles that overlap and build upon each other.
SOLVE PUZZLES
From piecing together the proper sequence to arrange ancient runes, to deciphering cryptic murals, or using mirrors to redirect the light from your torch in order to activate magical mechanisms, the ruins of Artahk are littered with all manner of puzzles waiting to be solved.

title: 雪原余烬 Snow Ash
description:
게임 정보
Game Features
A card-centric delivery journey
Reach your destination through a deck of trucks and characters
You will encounter different event cards and enemy cards on the way, and you need to respond flexibly!
The environment will also bring risks, you can solve them through cards, and at the same time, you may also gain benefits!
Temperature, environment, and materials constitute the elements of survival
On the snow, you will continue to suffer from increasingly severe cold, you need enough fuel!
Your team will endure hunger and pressure, and you can go further only if you can solve them
Ammunition, tools... cards will also consume some supplies. Goods are not just trading items, manage your resources well
Trade, skills and equipment between different shelters
Each shelter has different goods to buy and sell
You can learn different skills in different shelters
You can also buy different equipment and vehicle accessories in different shelters!
Multiple recruitable characters, as well as development and construction combined with cards
You can recruit several different characters to freely match your team!
You can plan different ability directions for them, and each character can freely learn any skills to form your deck!
They have different spark abilities, and each character is unique!
Truck modification and construction
You can upgrade and modify your truck to help you cross the snow better.
The truck has its own unique cards, and you can also get some more special and unique cards through accessories!

title: Null Path
description:
게임 정보
                 What's Inside?
- 7 Different biomes
- Over 60 Levels to explore
- 5 powerups to unlock
- 9 eggs to find
- 6 discoverable teleport combinations
- Dozens of traps
- Hundreds of challenging jumps
- 2-3+ hours of content
Features
Precision Platforming: Master tight controls and execute pixel-perfect jumps to navigate through perilous gauntlets of spikes, saw blades, collapsing platforms and more.
Diverse Biomes: Explore hand crafted levels, each with its own unique challenges, hazards, and atmospheric designs.

title: Scent of Clouds
description:
게임 정보
You've always known that your keen sense of smell is your greatest talent. However, you're a doe which makes the art of perfumery not exactly the most traditional profession for your kind. Luckily, you've found a mentor who couldn't care less about societal pressures and has taken you under her wing. After two years of working as her assistant, you're now ready to create fragrances on your own. Yet, you don't expect just how deep the waters will be...
The most important sense in the animal kingdom is the sense of smell, particularly here on the Palent planet, where it plays a key role in communication, camouflage, healing, and many other essential functions. Palent is predominantly inhabited by highly intelligent animals, whose level of technological development resembles that of the 18th- to 19th-century Earth. Peace has long prevailed here, but recent rumors speak of unknown species of lizards disrupting the established order. Where have they come from?

title: Five More Minutes
description:
게임 정보
Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos!
Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.
Each genre has its own set of unique cards, keepsakes, and strategies. Level up your character to gain more actions, health, and collect powerful mementos from your gaming adventures.

title: Mystic Resistance
description:
게임 정보
Change your strategy on the fly as you're presented with new upgrades for each of your 15 potential towers! Add powerful potions to your arsenal to defeat the endless hordes of monsters.
Mystic Resistance begins like any other tower defense game, except this time, you can't use the exact same strategy in every situation. Every few levels you will be met with a choice to gain a new tower, item, ability, or upgrade to help you on your journey, with enough options to make every run feel unique.

title: Nyric
description:
게임 정보
Explore. Survive. Shape the Unknown.
Nyric is an open-ended survival game where your imagination shapes the universe. Use prompt-based world generation to bring surreal realms to life, then venture into the unknown to gather resources, uncover secrets, build settlements and leave your mark.
Chart Your Path
Type a phrase—"A city of glowing fungi," "A world trapped in eternal twilight," "A storm-haunted wasteland"—and Nyric generates an uncharted realm for you to explore. Whether you're wandering through a dream or surviving a nightmare with friends, no two journeys are ever the same.
Collectable AI Companions
You're not alone. Strange, ever-curious Faebots accompany you, offering guidance, mischief, and unexpected insight. Some are eager to assist, others follow their own whims—but all will leave their mark on your journey.

title: Galaxidia
description:
게임 정보
Gameplay
Play cards from your hand onto the galaxy board and optimize their positions to earn Stardust. Cards costs Aether and have their own temperature and surface. Some of them have living creature in it. Most cards have adjacency-based effects. Balance your resources, plan your turns and strategically build galaxies before the game ends.
Managing Collection
Browse and organize your unlocked cards in your collection. Use filters to sort by rarity, temperature, surface or creature. Alsco do search for specific cards. Create custom decks by adding cards from your collection and preparing strategies for your next galaxy-building game.
Opening Packs

title: Shoestrings Story
description:
게임 정보
A point-and-click visual novel
Approximately 300,000 characters of narrative
A wide variety of mini-games
Retro pixel graphics
A smoking girl dragging around a TV
Sudden quantum mechanics
No "just parry" mechanic
The protagonist is a freelance writer named Love Catch. Due to childhood trauma, they are unable to speak and have no combat experience. However, after saving a wounded, mysterious creature known as a Mamono, they are unexpectedly chosen to become a "Hero." Love Catch’s mission is to "persuade" an entity called the "Demon King," who is said to command the Mamono, and bring an end to the 900-year-long war against these creatures.

title: Wildlife Sports : Untamed
description:
게임 정보
Join your friends in a wild ride of wacky sports challenges! With simple yet entertaining gameplay, this couch multiplayer game promises endless fun and laughter. Choose your quirky animal and compete in silly competitions. Whether you’re looking to play in short bursts or keep the party going all night long, dive into the excitement and see who will reign supreme!

FEATURES : 
You can choose an animal from the roster, they have differents stats to fit your style.
 3 different games to choose  from with their own sets of rules: 
Football
Basketball
Volleyball
Easy to learn, easy to master !

title: Rabanaz
description:
게임 정보
A chip-based deckbuilder with plenty of tweaks to cheat your way to victory. Link up upgrades, install modification tubes, and alter the scoring to discover your perfect strategy. Can you outwit the Rabanaz machine?
- Synergize your gambling strategy: Select and create new chips for your collection. Install vaccuum tubes that alter how the machine works. Discover the best combinations to maximize your chances.
- Every run is unique: The machine doesn't want you to win and will alter its circuits, change the tubes available, and throw different obstacles in your path. Can you uncover what's at the heart of this?
- Shiny and permanent: Randomness need not be so random. Each run earns you a precious few gems that be spent to tilt your future odds more in your favour.

title: Papercraft Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling roguelite adventure where your wits and your backpack are your greatest weapons. In Papercraft Tactics, every item you collect and every choice you make shapes your journey. Traverse through branching paths filled with perilous encounters, clever puzzles, and fearsome foes, all leading to an epic boss battle.
Combine and optimize the treasures you discover to create the ultimate loadout, ensuring your survival against escalating challenges. With a dark, hand-drawn art style inspired by real life art and animation, immerse yourself in a world where strategy, luck, and resourcefulness are the keys to victory. Will your backpack carry you to triumph—or weigh you down into defeat?

title: Hungry
description:
게임 정보
The Ultimate Battle of Bites!
Step into the colorful chaos of Hungry, the action-packed multiplayer game where you're not just playing to win, you're playing to feast! Take control of a Boomble, a lively ball of energy with one mission: eat your way to victory. Gobble up orbs scattered across the map to grow in size and power. But be careful, if any of the other Boombles is bigger than you, they’ll swallow you whole!

In this high-stakes game of survival, strategy and speed are key. Outsmart opponents by navigating the map, collecting power-ups, and timing your attacks. Use clever maneuvers to dodge the giants and ambush smaller players to claim their points. The clock is ticking, and only the biggest, boldest Boomble will reign supreme when the timer hits zero.
As you dominate matches, you'll unlock exciting customization options, like flashy colors, quirky hats, and stylish accessories to give your Boomble personality. Whether you prefer a wizard look or a hilarious cowboy vibe, your Boomble will stand out as you conquer the leaderboard.

isn’t just a game, it’s a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled competition where every bite counts. Will you rise to the top or get devoured trying? There’s only one way to find out: grab your Boomble, and let the feast begin!

title: Radiant Rush
description:
게임 정보
You can't control your speed—only your steering. With this simple yet challenging mechanic, you'll need to master each level you encounter. Navigate through abstract mindscapes inspired by synthwave and the retro-futuristic aesthetics of the 1980s.
Take on 50 hand-crafted levels designed to test your drifting skills and uncover the art of precision and momentum. Once you've conquered the main game, push your limits in Hard Mode, where the true challenge awaits. Feeling unstoppable? Prove your skills in Speedrun Mode and rise to the top of the leaderboards!

title: Polterparty
description:
게임 정보
폴터파티는 젊은 수사관이 되어 유령이 출몰하는 '엘더글룸 저택'을 탐험하는 흥미진진한 멀티플레이어 호러/파티 혼합 게임입니다.
방문할 때마다 변화하는 환경과 방문객의 공포와 감정에 적응하며 길을 찾아보세요.
다섯 가지 독특한 직업과 개별 특전 중에서 원하는 플레이 스타일을 선택하고 으스스한 도전에 나서세요. 8개의 다른 개체에 맞서 저택에서 그들을 몰아내세요.

title: Dark of the Depths
description:
게임 정보
A first-person realistic underwater explorer. Plunge into the real world horror of the ocean's dark depths. As you head down into the trench, the dark of the abyss surrounds you.
Dark of the Depths uses realistic visuals to put you in the pitch-black atmosphere of the deepest oceans. Use your torch to guide you through the darkness, avoiding violent fish and experience our fears of what lies beneath.
Encounter creatures such as Basking sharks and Killer whales. However, larger, more ferocious beasts lurk within the dark.
Traverse a network of rusted oil structures in search of missing items. Recover interactive collectibles from wreckages and find all the items needed to complete the game and leave the ocean floor.

title: Transpawt Train
description:
게임 정보
다양한 동물이 함께 살아가는 “발바닥 도시”에 오신 여러분을 환영합니다!
여러분은 “철도 공단”의 직원으로서, 발바닥 도시의 기차 노선들을 설계하고
동물 마을들을 연결하는 임무를 담당합니다.
창의적인 전략과 설계로 동물들의 세상을 이어주세요!
동물 마을을 연결해서 철도를 설계해보세요!
여러분이 설계한 철도를 따라 기차가 운행을 시작해요.
동물 주민들이 편하게 기차를 탑승할 수 있도록 만드세요!

title: Christmas Story
description:
게임 정보
Christmas Story is a horror game that blends the warmth of Christmas evenings with chilling mysteries.
One winter evening, a grandson travels to a quiet, snow-covered village to visit his grandfather. The village house is filled with a cozy Christmas atmosphere: the fire crackles in the stove, garlands twinkle on the tree, and snowflakes swirl outside the window. Everything seems perfect until the grandfather decides to share an old Christmas story...
At first, the tale seems like a simple fairy tale, but as the story unfolds, the line between reality and fiction begins to blur. You find yourself drawn into a terrifying chain of events where Christmas symbols take on sinister forms, and the cozy atmosphere turns into a nightmare.
Will you be able to escape this haunting story, or will you become a part of it?
Key Features:
Atmospheric Contrast: Experience a journey from cozy Christmas lights to dark horror.
Interactive Story: A narrative that evolves based on your actions and decisions.
Puzzles and Secrets: Solve the mysteries of the village and uncover what lies behind the grandfather's story.
Detailed World: Explore an atmospheric village with intricate environments, from snowy forests to abandoned houses.
Terrifying Moments: Unexpected scenes and eerie creatures inspired by Christmas mythology.
Christmas Story immerses you in an adventure where a Christmas evening could become the beginning of your worst nightmare.

title: Block King Demands Red Squares
description:
게임 정보
Block King Demands Red Squares!
You play as the advisor of the Block King in the Shapes Kingdom. The king is a bit of a handful and impulsive so you need to do your best to try to fulfil his requests while keeping the citizens happy. If your reputation gets too low, you will get fired.
Construct a robust trading network
You're in change of constructing the necessary industries and infrastructure needed to fulfil the quests given to you. Construct harvesters which harvest shapes, send them to factories which processes them into new shapes. After that you need to make sure that the logistic network can deliver the shapes to the correct town without causing stoppages.
Space is premium
Having to work with limited sites to fit all the necessary buildings means you need to plan accordingly to get them to fit. You cannot simply make one town which creates everything, you need to send them across the country to build larger so making sure that the logistical network works is important.
Multiple scenarios
The game is divided into multiple different scenarios. Each one tasking you with a different set of quests and towns to work with, giving you new challenges. There is also a free play mode which is more open and allows you to decide more freely how you decide to advance your industry.

title: Barfbot
description: 게임 정보

title: null HEART break
description:
게임 정보
A simple game made using RPG Paper Maker
Welcome to the Void. An obscure wasteland of thoughts and concepts trying to exist without reason. You play as null an incomplete being trying to fill it's empty heart.
Don't get erased.
Let your heart break endlessly.
Empty the Void.
Become whole.
End it all.
null HEART break is a lovely RPG 4 empty souls.
Features:
Turn based battle featuring animated enemies.
Original hand drawn art filled with character.
Charming Soundtrack that captures the feelings of the void.
A heartfelt story that questions what it means to be alone.
Defeat enemies through the games Logic Point System.
Explore an empty world filled with different concepts and ideas.
Interact with characters so charming you'd think they had a soul.
View treasured memories of the past.
Let go of those you hold dear.
Break your Heart.

title: Not Us
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wondered what lies beyond the forest? Could it be that the foe you fear the most is the one that grants you the greatest strength?
Play as Twig, our brave heroine on a mission to save her land from a looming danger. Follow her path, forage, craft and unveil the mysteries hidden deep within the forest.

title: IDLE BOSS RUSH
description:
게임 정보
IDLE BOSS RUSH is an incremental, idle game with epic boss fights, where you progress even if you're not playing. Advance from a wretched camp to a lively city by raising an army able to slay giants.

Slay Giant Bosses
There are no mere monsters here. Every enemy takes time or a good strategy to beat. Every kill matters. Giants can be seen from any point in the town—melting right before your eyes.
Build a Kingdom
Customize your land as you progress from a simple town to a grand kingdom by raising an army able to slay giants. Manage your town's residents and resources. Strategically select structures and synergetic upgrades to your liking.

title: Oni Hunters
description:
게임 정보


환영합니다, 전설과 그림자의 땅, 기로니아에 오신 것을.

매 반세기마다, 이 지역에는 다른 어떤 축제와는 다른 축제가 내려옵니다. 하지만 이것은 단순한 축제가 아닙니다 - 이것은 미스터리와 어둠으로 둘러싸인 '몬스터 주빌리' 이벤트입니다.

•거대한 오픈 월드와 그 던전을 탐험하세요•



기로니아의 넓고 열린 지형에 몸을 던져보세요. 번화한 도시부터 가장 어두운 구석, 복잡한 던전까지, 당신이 밟는 모든 걸음마다 새로운 비밀을 밝혀내거나 위험으로 이끌 수 있습니다. 각 던전 내에 숨겨진 보물과 도전을 발굴하면서 그 수많은 미스터리를 통해 길을 찾아 나가세요. 이렇게 넓은 세계에서, 이야기는 정말로 당신이 형성할 것입니다.

•전략적이고 다이나믹한 전투 시스템•



턴 기반 전투이지만 예측하기는 어렵습니다. 새롭게 변화된 전투 시스템은 전략과 선견지명을 요구합니다. 여러 가지 전투 모드로, 모든 만남은 당신의 지혜와 용기를 시험하는 것입니다.

수백 가지의 독특한 몬스터를 발견하고 친구가 되어보세요. 각각은 다른 능력과 희귀성을 자랑합니다. 그들을 훈련시켜 기로니아에서 가장 위대한 몬스터 테이머가 되어보세요. 하지만 몬스터 주빌리의 그림자에서 테이머와 테이밍되는 자 사이의 경계는 종종 흐릿해질 수 있음을 잊지 마세요.

••

몬스터 퓨전의 강력한 비밀을 밝혀내세요!
두 생물을 결합하여 부모의 기술과 능력을 상속받는 새롭고 강력한 엔터티를 창조하세요. 실험하고, 발견하고, 무적의 팀을 구축하세요.



••

최대 20시간의 핵심 스토리 모드로, 음모, 유머, 그리고 어둠의 이야기에 몰입하세요. 모든 선택, 모든 전투, 그리고 잡히거나 합쳐진 모든 몬스터는 당신을 '몬스터 주빌리'의 미스터리 해결에 한 걸음 더 가깝게 만듭니다.

당신의 행동과 결정에는 무게가 있습니다. 결정에 따라 새로운 결말로 이끌 수 있으므로 길을 지혜롭게 선택하세요. 여러 갈래의 경로가 있으므로 플레이할 때마다 독특한 경험을 기대하실 수 있습니다.

몬스터 주빌리에서 모든 것이 보이는 그대로인 것은 아닙니다. 이 오랜 축제의 진실과 속임수를 발견함에 따라, 당신은 몬스터 테이밍의 어둠의 한면과 직면하게 될 것입니다.



••






기로니아로 들어오세요. 그것의 미스터리를 밝혀내세요. 전설이 되세요.

🌟 지금 를 위시리스트에 추가하고 비교할 수 없는 모험을 준비하세요! 🌟

title: Santa's Hitlist CEO Edition
description:
게임 정보
Children all over the world (and even some adults) have been sending you letters, asking for just one thing: they wish their parents could be happier and come home earlier, instead of working endless hours for low wages.
As Santa, it’s your mission to fulfill their wishes by destroying the root of all evil—the greedy CEOs who exploit their employees and steal the joy from families.
This holiday season, it’s PAYBACK TIME!!!
Play as Santa Claus and take on corrupt CEOs who have drained the joy from their employees in this over-the-top action-packed adventure.
🎅 TAKE REVENGE as Santa!!!

title: Misty Garden
description:
게임 정보
Create a peaceful garden. Build a soothing retreat and help the wandering creatures unwind from chaotic lives. Misty Garden is a calm and relaxing base building providing laid-back experience interacting with the Purrlings, a creature living in the Misty forest.
Take care of Purrlings!
They are interested in your garden! Welcome and place them in the facilities for them to relax. There are open-air rock baths, hot-sand spa, and places to take a nap!
Build & Decorate facilities for the Purrlings to relax
Build and upgrade the facilities the Purrling could use during their stay. They might even request a specific service from you! Decorate the place well, so it looks nice and cozy!

title: !mrak
description:
게임 정보
!mrak is a first-person shooter with immersive sim elements set in an alternate 2003 Hokkaido, which became part of Russia in the mid-20th century. A techno-hub hidden behind neon signs and dark facades. Here, power is divided between corporations, intelligence agencies, and those who remain in the shadows.
You are a tool in someone’s game. Your goal is to find the target, eliminate them, and disappear. How? That’s your choice. Sneak across rooftops, hide in the shadows, disable cameras… or leave a bloody trail behind.
Freedom of approach and an interactive world: Hide in the dark, hack systems, or charge in headfirst. Guards, cameras, hidden pathways—use the environment to your advantage.
Tools:From makeshift implants to Soviet weaponry. Branching levels: Industrial complexes, skyscraper rooftops, underground clubs—find your own path.
A world caught between eras and cultures: Vintage electronics, the hum of CRTs, worn-out cassette tapes, and the cold lights of the metropolis. Soviet legacy, Japanese traditions, and Western influences create a unique atmosphere.

title: Beach Bar Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Beach Bar Simulator에 오신 것을 환영합니다!
아름다운 마이애미 해변에서 펼쳐지는 편안하면서도 도전적인 경영 시뮬레이션 게임! 당신만의 해변 바를 운영하며 손님을 맞이하고, 자원을 관리하며 작은 가게를 인기 명소로 성장시켜 보세요!
특징:
🛠️ 싱글 & 협력 모드 – 혼자서 즐기거나 친구와 함께 온라인 협력 플레이!
🍹 리얼한 바 운영 – 칵테일을 만들고, 손님을 맞이하며 만족도를 유지하세요.
🏝️ 커스터마이징 & 확장 – 바를 디자인하고, 장비를 업그레이드하여 완벽한 해변 분위기를 조성하세요.
💰 경제 & 전략 – 예산을 관리하고, 가격을 설정하며, 현명한 비즈니스 결정을 내리세요.
🎯 고객 반응 – 적절한 음료를 제공하고 최상의 서비스로 고객을 만족시키세요.
작은 해변 바를 세계적인 명소로 성장시킬 수 있을까요? 지금 바로 칵테일을 만들고, 서빙하며 성공을 향해 나아가세요! 🍹🏝️

title: Door to Somewhere
description:
게임 정보
Door to Somewhere is a 2.5D horror game about an alchemist, a door, and a forest of monsters. You are Winnie, a novice witch skilled at making potions.
Story--
After a mysterious death, and being involved in a violent incident in the past, she is the first culprit in the eyes of the city. She is innocent however, just a humble alchemist selling her wares in a small market. This matters not, and she must flee the city and into the nearby forest. There, she has set up a hut for herself, safe but alone. Unbeknown to her, horrors are leaking into her world through a strange detached door. Their motives unknown, they begin to show their faces to the witch. The woods are not safe, but she cannot return home, not yet. She must prove her innocence and solve the mystery behind where these creatures came from. 
Key Features--
-Experiment with alchemy to create powerful potions. Brew healing tonics, antidotes, and antibiotics to fight the corruption—but beware, resources are limited
-Explore a sprawling forest teeming with hopes and horrors, and discover what lies on the other side of the door
-Use your potions and wits to solve intricate puzzles and unlock new paths
-There are various monsters waiting for you, some are friendly, some are not
-Make important decisions that will decide the fate of the forest's inhabitants, these choices leading to one of a variety of multiple endings
The door is open. The choice is yours.

title: Swimmer Away
description:
게임 정보
In this dark and realistic ocean setting, you are the last hope. As a Coast Guard rescue swimmer, you'll face the ocean's fury and make the agonizing choices that define who lives and who dies. Search sinking vessels, battle monstrous waves, and endure the chilling grip of hypothermia. Your decisions have consequences, and every rescue is a gamble against the relentless sea.
Race against the chilling grip of hypothermia as you battle to find and rescue survivors from the raging depths. Every second counts in this desperate struggle against the elements!
Defying the elements, one wave at a time.

title: Charlie Spotlight
description:
게임 정보
About
Meet Charlie, the next King of Comedy!
Or at least its' Little Prince.
It's a steady grind to get to the top, until on a night like any other, after one of his sets, Charlie is approached by a couple of rather unusual fans.
Help Charlie along the way in this classics-inspired Point-and-Click Adventure game!
Features
Point-and-Click mechanics
Characters with silly dialogues
Fun Puzzles with moderate moon logic
Dorky Tutorial
Questionable Humor

title: Herb Seek Slash
description:
게임 정보
Game Story
An ordinary swordsman, Ethan, sets out to find an ordinary herb to save his sister, Elaine, on an extraordinary and perilous journey.
About the Game
This is a 2D top-down scrolling shoot'em up RPG. Take control of Ethan, slashing enemies with powerful sword waves across the main stages. Stay alert—getting pushed off-screen means death! Each stage features interactive challenges to test your skills.
“Advice” from the Witch
Death isn’t the end—the Witch will revive Ethan and give some “advice". Is the advice helpful? Well…It depends.

title: Study Arcade
description:
게임 정보
The Pomodoro Technique (25 minutes of intense focus followed by 5 minutes of rest) is extremely helpful for more productive studying and working, but let's be honest, we all get distracted pretty easily. My attempts to use the technique looked something like this: set a timer, timer goes off, start scrolling social media or playing a game designed to keep me on for as long as possible, get distracted, and never get back to work. The problem is that most entertainment is designed to monetize your time, the most important resource you have! This free tool helps you solve that problem. It's what I wish I had when I was in school (especially during college), and so I'm putting it out there for free.
When you open Study Arcade, you're presented with an extremely simple interface to set a timer and get going. Hit Start, leave it open in the background, and get to work. It'll alert you  automatically when it's time to take a break.
Come back after studying, hit Play, and it'll give you a random arcade minigame for you to play, giving you a break when you need one! I've made 5 minigames so far, from block-breaking to retro shooter. Crucially, though, it only lets you play after you've already been productive, and all of the games are designed to give you a quick brain break and then help you get back to work. Study more to get a chance to play all of them and try to beat the highscore. Escape the doomscrolling, get stuff done, and most importantly, have fun while doing it. Simple as that!

title: GLOOPALAXY
description:
게임 정보
[The game is still in early development, and most of the visuals are subject to change.]
Run your own space aquarium in this tiny, light management and creature collection game.
Collect strange aquatic creatures from outer space called gloops, and create ecosystems for them to thrive in. Take care of your visitors, coming in from every corner of the universe to admire your aquarium!
🚀 Explore the galaxy and uncover its secrets
Discover and explore new worlds, each revealing unique creatures. Bring back rare objects and materials to customize your aquarium, and capture new gloops with your remote fishing device. You may even get lucky and bring back shiny ones ✨
🐠 Study and take care of your gloops
Each creature has unique preferences. Place them in various tanks, experiment with their environment, and fill your encyclopedia with all there is to know about them!
🪸 Customize your aquarium
While looking for creatures, you may find new decorations and materials to customize your aquarium. Build new rooms, change the colors and place items to make it look just right!
👽 Welcome intergalactic visitors
Visitors from the whole galaxy will come to admire your creatures, so make sure that they get what they're paying for! Adjust the ticket price, and open your aquarium for the day!
✨ Meet your objectives
Each mission brings new creatures, new planets and more! Fill your encyclopedia, make money and drive visitor satisfaction up to unlock them all.

title: Soul Blossom
description:
게임 정보
Long ago, little souls lived in harmony in the Forest of Eternal Blossom. One day, everything has changed. The evil bug king attacked the forest and kidnapped all the little souls! Cik, the only survivor of the attack, embarks on a difficult mission to rescue his loved ones.
Solve logic puzzles by controlling a little soul. Bloom flowers, gather followers and save your loved one from the Evil Bug King.
Bloom flowers to solve logic puzzles. Fly into the flower to bloom it. It will return to its initial state if you fly away. There are many types of flowers that act differently when blossomed.
Most puzzles require other souls to solve them. Rescue them during your journey, they will follow you around and help you with the puzzles. You can order them to fly in the chosen direction or call them back with a single click.
Some actions require multiple followers to perform. Carefully distribute the followers to solve puzzles.

title: Klasztorna: Lost Within
description:
게임 정보
Psychological horror in which you're trapped inside your own school, hunted by a relentless entity. As you navigate through the ever-changing hallways, you must find a way to escape, all while avoiding the creature lurking in the shadows. In Klasztorna, the environment shifts, distorting reality and testing your perception. The line between what's real and what's imagined blurs, and only your wits can help you survive. Can you escape, or will the darkness consume you?

title: Xiwang Ave N 3rd Section
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Xiwang Ave N 3rd Section is a story-driven, first-person, single-player exploration game. At his mother’s request, the protagonist takes a break from work to deliver packages for a distant relative in his home city. After many years of drifting, memories now overlap with reality, and those who were once lost or out of contact suddenly reappear, bringing long-buried pasts……The newly built pedestrian bridge, the temple running a car wash business, the never-ending construction site, and the lost packages…the ordinary everyday life might show signs of an approaching storm….
And that so-called ‘helping out a distant relative’ seems to have some embarrassing truths that are hard to speak about.......
Features
Play a first-person, story-driven city exploration game

title: Cropdeck
description:
게임 정보
이 roguelite 덱빌더에서 농업을 마스터하세요!
장애물을 제거하고, 최적의 배열로 작물을 심고, 위험으로부터 보호하세요. 고유한 특성을 가진 허수아비를 사용하여 전략을 강화하고, 막을 수 없는 콤보 덱을 만들고, 모든 역경을 극복하세요.
🌱 심고, 자라고, 수확하세요!
장애물을 제거하고 땅을 갈아 심을 준비를 하세요.
최대 효율과 수확을 위해 작물 배치를 전략적으로 계획하세요.
식물을 돌보세요 - 물을 주고, 비료를 주고, 피해로부터 보호하세요.
수확을 거두고 이익을 얻으세요. 하지만 조심하세요 – Sir Landlord가 세금을 받으러 올 수 있어요!
🎃 최고의 콤보를 찾아보세요!
강력한 특성과 패시브 능력을 가진 다양한 허수아비를 찾아 농업을 강화하세요.

title: Store Keeper
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Store Keeper — a game where you take on the role of a large wholesale warehouse manager!
Your task is to establish a seamless logistics operation: from receiving goods from suppliers to delivering them to retail stores. Smart inventory management, precise calculations, and efficient space organization will help you build a warehouse that runs like clockwork.
Key Features:
🔹 Receiving and Inspecting Shipments

Monitor incoming goods, check invoices, and identify supplier errors. Decide how to handle defective or surplus products. Every decision impacts your reputation and profits.
🔹 Optimizing Warehouse Space

Arrange products strategically to speed up shipments and minimize losses. Upgrade warehouse facilities and organize storage areas for maximum efficiency.
🔹 Maintaining Proper Storage Conditions

title: Rice & Rest
description:
게임 정보
A cozy cooking experience
Serve hot and tasty meals to your customers. As you cook unlock nine Japanese-inspired recipes some with multiple variations. Cooking opens the hearts of those around you as you cook you will meet friendly faces.
Small moments that matter
At The Rice & Rest, you do more than just cook you create a space for connection. A warm meal and a friendly ear can brighten someone’s day, ease their worries, or even spark new friendships. Some moments are lighthearted and fun, others thoughtful and introspective.
The friends you make along the way
7 characters for you to cook for, chat with, and befriend. As you expand your menu and earn loyal customers you will learn more of their lives and stories. You might also learn more of why you are here and about the world you are in.
There’s a wide variety of characters to meet a robot trying to understand themselves, your new demon boss (literally she's a demon, she's not that bad), a wizard detective and his assistant investigating a magical crime, and more.
Features
7 Characters to meet
Hand drawn art
Chill vibes - With jazz music from Ovani sound
A story you are part of, the main character is directly involved in the story of Rice & Rest
9 Meals to cook with over 25 raw ingredients that can be prepared in different ways

title: Bodacious Blasteroids
description:
게임 정보
Blast, Upgrade, and Adapt in this fast-paced roguelike shooter!
Bodacious Blasteroids is a high octane arcade shooter where firepower is everything. Build an arsenal of devastating weapons and obliterate waves of evolving enemies. But there’s a catch. Your guns overheat, forcing you to rotate between weapons on the fly. Master the art of swapping weapons to unleash devastating combos!
Rotating Firepower – Stay on your toes! Your weapons overheat, so be prepared to switch up tactics constantly. Find the ultimate synergy between your tools of destruction as you swap your way to victory.
Evolving Arsenal – Upgrade your weapons in wild ways! Stack mods to transform your weapons into a screen-clearing powerhouses.

title: Zima
description:
게임 정보
                                                                                Zima is a cozy RPG that plunges you into a relentless unnatural winter. As you delve into ancient temples to combat a growing corruption, you’ll unravel the mysterious legacy of who you are and what your purpose is. Prepare to uncover secrets buried deep within the Sacred Temples and uncover your true identity.

In Zima you play as a fierce and stubborn young woman determined to protect her home, and the secrets that lie beneath... Within the Sacred Temples you will fight your way through corrupted enemies and forgotten temple guardians using action combat and skill based dodging all while avoiding traps meant to keep intruders out! 
Your arsenal will include unique melee and ranged weapons that can be upgraded using currency gathered within the temples.
Each temple contains hidden rooms with materials essential for upgrading items in your home, so be sure to explore thoroughly!
Upgrade choices provide unique buffs, allowing customization of your survival strategy.
Most importantly, The Sacred Flame is your lifeline — you'll need to gather Living Coal found within the temples to maintain it and should you fail... winter will consume your home, wreaking havoc.

title: Red Van Simulator 極速紅Van傳說
description:
게임 정보
遊戲中玩家扮演亡命紅色小巴 （後稱紅Van）司機，為賺錢養家，不惜超速駕駛。玩家需要上下移動，避開障礙物，以最快速度到達終點！
In the game, players take on the role of a reckless red minibus (hereafter referred to as "Red Van") driver , who drives at high speeds to earn money to support their family. Players need to move up and down to avoid obstacles and reach the finish line as quickly as possible!
遊戲靈感來自網上多張超速照片，加上製作者以往的經歷，紅Van司機永不減速轉彎。網上更有改圖笑稱紅Van司機比起漫畫頭文字D的賽車手更為厲害。
The game is inspired by numerous online photos of speeding violations, combined with the creator's past experiences. The Red Van driver never brakes while turning. There are even online memes joking that Red Van drivers are more skilled than the racers in the comic "Initial D."
不過，隨著香港的夜生活減少，加上鐵路愈起愈多，紅Van已漸趨式微，玩家就可能是最後一代亡命紅Van傳奇。
However, with the decline of nightlife in Hong Kong and the increasing number of railways, the Red Van has gradually faded away. Players may be the last generation of legendary reckless Red Van drivers.
autokwd: Red Van Simulator 極速紅Van傳說

title: Appa
description:
게임 정보
Appa is a linear narrative focused strategic card game.
Gameplay: Appa is a unique rock paper scissor style strategy where you and your opponent both choose a card at the same time trying to predict the moves of the other.
Choose from a set of 35+ Cards with 10+ Synergizers combo. Ranging from normal attacks to card that change the meta of the game itself.
Customize your cards with fun Synergizers and blow your opponent away with a cascading domino effects in a satisfying game of push and pull.
A dreamlike drama about grief and death: Join Varun and Arundhati as they process and deal with the death of their father. Having received a letter from their death before his passing. They start getting constant nightmares where they face their emotions and play a card game with him.
A blend of Comics and Cinema: The story is told through a unique blend of 2d hand crafted cinematics and graphic novel Style as the two siblings navigate their grief, reconcile with their past and mend their relationship

title: Letters of longing
description:
게임 정보
You are a soldier in Spain in 1938. You must infiltrate the enemy's territory to retrieve sensitive information. It's an infiltration mission that awakens memories in you of an old relationship that you think has disappeared.
In this "Walking Simulator" game you will find puzzles in which the solution lies in knowing how to find your way through a town hall destroyed by war. Through keys and maps scatered arround the building you will advance and discover the story that is told to the player through the messages written on a typewriter.
These messages are the letters sent to each other by Juan and Antón, the protagonists of the story. In these you can see how the war has affected them, what their true relationship truly is. The letters show the things they did not share and only the two of them experienced.

title: Minuto - Galactic Deliveries
description:
게임 정보
A puzzle game about connecting planets, making deliveries, and dealing with the weirdest customers in the galaxy.
📦 Deliveries in Space? Easier Said Than Done.
Minuto is just a rabbit trying to do his job—flying across the galaxy, delivering packages, and making sure everything arrives on time and in one piece. But space is tricky. Planets move, gravity pulls, and sometimes your customers are way too picky.
🌀 Figure out the best routes to link up planets and sync deliveries.
🪐 Watch out for cosmic chaos—asteroids, wormholes, and time loops can mess up even the best-laid plans.
🎭 Meet strange (and demanding) customers who always have something interesting to say.
📖 Uncover the hidden history of the galaxy, one delivery at a time.
🚀 WHAT TO EXPECT:
✅ A Puzzle About Connections – Every level is a new challenge in timing and precision.
✅ Space Is a Mess – Expect surprises, from unexpected obstacles to completely ridiculous delivery requests.
✅ Relaxing but Tricky – A chill, atmospheric vibe with puzzles that will definitely make you think.
✅ – Strange things are happening in this galaxy… if you pay attention.

title: Booty Battler
description:
게임 정보
Booty Battler: An auto-battler pirate adventure in the pursuit of loot!
As the Captain, your role involves recruiting and managing your crew through multiple maps filled with enemies and treasures.
Captain and Helmsman - You steer the ship! Progression is heavily dependent on being able to collect the loot from battle before it sinks beneath the waves! Your crew, relics and ship equipment can improve your ship's mobility, but ultimately it is up to you to prioritize and navigate to the loot necessary for your crew's survival.
Latest updates:
Relics are in! These unique and powerful items will help you throughout the entire run.
10 more friendly units added (90 more to go until full-release worthy)
Unit Traits are in! Each unit has a trait, when your raiding party has at least 2 matching traits, the trait bonus is activated for powerful effects.
Mystery events are in! These can be an opportunity for extra loot, tough battles, unique pirates, and more.
UI and Graphics overhaul - New UI system with tooltips to provide clarity on your ship's status, and upgraded water and battle graphics.
Ship Equipment is in! -  Slotted into slots separate from your raiding party, these cards provide your ship with various mobility options.

title: Billionaire in the Oil Boom
description:
게임 정보
The year is 1960, and the world is on the brink of an energy revolution. The discovery of vast oil reserves in the Middle East is changing the global economic landscape, creating unprecedented wealth and opportunity. Nations rise, corporations battle for dominance, and fortunes are made overnight. Will you seize the moment and build a financial empire, or will you be left behind as others strike it rich?
Money is never enough
In this era of rapid transformation, money is more than just a currency: it’s power. Take control of financial markets and wield a variety of investment tools to build your fortune. Trade in:
Stocks – Invest in emerging oil giants before they take over the world.
Bonds & State Bonds – Secure lucrative government contracts and finance infrastructure projects
Commodities – Buy and sell crude oil, gold, wheat and other valuable resources driving the global economy.
Real Estate – Capitalize on booming Middle Eastern cities as wealth floods the region.
Take Over Corporations – Control Industries
Investing isn’t just about buying and selling assets—you can take control of entire companies! Acquire businesses, set corporate strategies, and dictate their future. Will you build a financial empire through innovation, or will you crush your competition through hostile takeovers? Your leadership and decision-making skills will determine your success.
High-Stakes Special Operations – Shape the Market
To dominate the industry, you must play the game at the highest level. Execute powerful financial moves, including:
Mergers & Acquisitions – Absorb competitors and control global supply chains.
Private and Public Stock Offerings – Raise capital without losing control of your empire.
One well-timed move can shift the balance of power—but one mistake can cost you everything.
Exploit Global Tax Systems & Political Instability
The Middle East oil boom isn’t just about business—it’s about navigating the complex political and economic landscape. With multiple nations vying for control, you must .

title: MMKK
description:
게임 정보
Use the earpick to remove earwax!
*You can use a keyboard and mouse, but the game is optimized for a controller with two analog sticks.

title: All We Fallen
description:
게임 정보
Overview
After the Fall, take control of any of The Fallen and descend to the bottom of the world in search of a way back to the Surface.
All We Fallen is a difficult Roguelike which takes the player through a web of infinite cave systems into the depths of the world. Join a mysterious guide, Bernahrd, with motives unknown in guiding the Fallen toward the abyss.
On the journey, discover new weapons, enemies, bosses, characters and much more. Every run is unique, due to the permadeath and procedural generation.
Visuals
All We Fallen is locked to a fixed screen size to maintain a strong visual theme and to keep the screen size consistent. It is also rendered with a fixed color palette, further backing the visual theme.
Audio
All of the music in this game is made by the solo developer, Lenni Huopaniemi. More music by me can be found under the name Lennihuopa on most platforms.

title: Prism Shift
description:
게임 정보
Challenge your logic in this casual, minimalist puzzle game. Slide and merge colored blocks using the additive color system — combine red with blue to create magenta, green with blue for cyan, and red with green for yellow. Clear clusters of connected colors, but think strategically: merging the wrong way might leave you stuck.
Solve increasingly complex puzzles filled with special blocks:
Prisms to convert white blocks into essential red, green and blue blocks
Duplicators to copy blocks
Gates that restrict movement
Void holes that delete blocks
and more...
Your goal? Fill all outputs with required blocks and clear connected blocks to conquer each level.

title: Cats CCG
description:
게임 정보
Cats CCG is a strategic digital card game where each card represents an anthropomorphic cats. Build your deck, master powerful abilities, and challenge opponents in tactical duels!
The cardsPlay rare magic to dominate the board.

title: Creature Containment
description:
게임 정보
In the 500 years since the world experienced a catastrophic apocalypse, magic has begun to seep into the world. Although devastated by such an event, humanity has begun to harness this power, and is currently experiencing a golden age of expansion and growth.
As a newly graduated United City States Militia Commander, you have been tasked with heading to the western frontier. A particularly nasty goblin infestation has taken over an old-world underground mega-facility, and it's your job to clear it out.
ARKCORP, working in conjunction with the UCS Militia, has provided the operation with a cutting edge M-TEK computer, capable of administering an entire base from one machine. With this tech, you can:
Read Emails
Construct Shops
Purchase and Sell Equipment

title: Thunder Tiger
description:
게임 정보
Thunder Tiger is a fast-paced, side-scrolling shoot ’em up that blends the timeless charm of 1980s and 1990s arcades with a fresh, futuristic twist. Command your sleek, heavily armed fighter through a series of intense 2D stages teeming with alien threats, mechanized war machines, and heart-pounding boss battles. With its vibrant pixel graphics and nostalgic retro flair, Thunder Tiger offers a thrilling old-school shooter experience tailored for modern players.
Blast your way through linear, action-packed levels, perfect for unleashing your reflexes and competing for new high scores. Each stage is designed for relentless arcade mayhem, complete with rapid-fire power-ups and mesmerizing visual effects. Whether you’re a longtime fan of classic shooters or new to the genre, Thunder Tiger’s tight controls and smooth controller support make it easy to pick up, but challenging to master.
In Thunder Tiger, every second counts—dodge and weave through waves of enemies, collect power-ups to upgrade your firepower, and chain kills to rack up massive combos. Are you ready to relive the golden era of arcade action with modern speed and style? Climb into the cockpit and prepare to save the galaxy—Thunder Tiger is calling your name!

title: Cursed Bloodline
description:
게임 정보
Cursed Bloodline
조사가 곧 지옥으로 변한다. 실종자들이 흔적을 남기고 사라진 집에 들어서면, 다음 차례는 바로 당신일지도 모른다.
장르: 심리 공포 / 내러티브 드라마
모드: 싱글 플레이, 스토리 중심
시점: 1인칭 시점
주요 특징: 강렬한 분위기, 모션 캡처 애니메이션, 실제 현장 녹음, 챕터 기반의 선형 진행
스토리
당신은 작은 마을의 형사로, 여러 난제를 해결해온 베테랑이다. 그러나 이번 사건은 다르다. 주인이 누구인지조차 모르는 기묘한 집에서 사람들이 계속 실종되고 있다. 그 집으로 발을 들여놓는 순간, 현실과 환각의 경계가 무너지고, 당신은 깨닫게 된다 — 조사하는 건 당신이 아니라, 집이 당신을 지켜보고 있다는 사실을.
게임 플레이
집 안 곳곳을 탐색하며, 모든 사물과 소리, 빛의 깜빡임이 새로운 단서를 드러낸다.
챕터별로 진행되는 선형 스토리, 시간이 지날수록 공포는 점점 강해진다.
실제 모션 캡처로 구현한 생생한 움직임과 표정.
스크립트와 랜덤 이벤트가 뒤섞여, 예측 불가한 공포 연출.
실제 장소에서 녹음한 사운드로 극강의 몰입감 제공.
차별화 포인트
실제 범죄 수사와 심리 공포를 결합한 독창적인 스토리.
인디 게임에서 보기 힘든 AAA급 모션 캡처 기술.
완전한 UI 없는 경험 — HUD도, 힌트도 없다. 오직 순수한 몰입감만.
각 챕터마다 서로 다른 공포 스타일을 적용해, 익숙해질 틈을 주지 않는다.
분위기
시작부터 끝까지 숨 막히는 긴장감.
너무 현실적이라 실제로 일어날 것 같은 공포.
미니멀한 비주얼로, 모든 디테일이 공포로 연결된다.
‘Visage’, ‘Outlast’, ‘Layers of Fear’를 즐겼다면, 이 게임은 당신의 다음 악몽이 될 것입니다.

title: Compression
description:
게임 정보
너는 2075년의 평범한 엔지니어다. 밤에 지하 창고로 호출되며, 그곳에서 끔찍한 악몽을 경험하게 된다. 창고를 관리하는 인공지능이 창고에 대한 통제를 잃어버리게 된다. 창고는 거대한 적대적인 유기체로 변해버린다. 벽, 바닥, 천장, 모든 것이 살아 움직이며 너를 쫓기 시작한다. 살아있는 벽 외에도, 너를 기다리고 있는 것은 살인 로봇들, 지뢰, 화학 폭탄, 시간 가속기와 지연기, 독성 안개와 그 밖의 치명적인 함정들이다.
너에게 있는 것은 작업용 엑소슈트, 소총, 그리고 약간의 운뿐이다. 하지만 너의 목표는 단순히 창고에서 벗어나는 것이 아니다. 너는 무엇이 평범한 창고를 적대적인 포식자로 변하게 했는지 알아내야 한다. 그리고 창고는 이를 막으려 할 것이다.
모든 레벨은 수작업으로 제작되었으며, 철저히 계획되었다. 너에게는 완전한 도전이 보장된다. 하지만 항상 생존할 기회는 있다. 우주복에 치명적인 손상이 가해지면, 너는 즉시 마지막 체크포인트로 이동한다.

title: Melodic Mage
description:
게임 정보
Unleash the power of music in Melodic Mage, a 2D pixel art action shooter where every attack and dodge must follow the rhythm! Play as a wizard battling through dynamic levels, casting spells, dashing, and dodging—all in sync with the beat.
Key Features
🎵 Rhythm-Based Combat – Cast spells and dodge enemy attacks in sync with the music.
🧙‍♂️ Magical Arsenal – Unlock and choose between different mages.
⚔️ Challenging Enemies & Bosses – Conquer diverse levels, each with their own final boss.
🎶 Hard mode – For those looking for a challenge, the hard mode will punish you every time you miss a beat.
Master the rhythm. Control the magic. Become the Melodic Mage!

title: BABELOMANIA
description:
게임 정보
[And the Lord said, "Look, they are one people, and they have all one language, and this is only the beginning of what they will do; nothing that they propose to do will now be impossible for them."]
GENESIS, 11:6
20XX, 14th of May. Central France.
You are cordially invited to attend the wedding of Francesco Colombo and Delphine Badeaux. The ceremony will take place on the grounds of the historical Château de Bois-le-Dumont, a bizarre estate with a dark hidden past.
Please be warned that when the lights go out, you shall find no succour. When the darkness overwhelms your neighbour, you shall find no salvation. When the cruel ambition reveals itself, you shall find no solace. Arm yourself with your wits, determination, and an open mind...
Or lose your humanity, before you lose your life.
BABELOMANIA is a technogothic horror adventure, with a visual novel style narrative, point&click puzzles and light survival elements.

title: Shoot  the Moon
description:
게임 정보
SHOOT FOR THE MOON은 우스꽝스러운 로그라이트 업그레이드와 사랑스러운 성우진의 부적응 친구들이 등장하는 아케이드 액션 플랫폼 게임입니다!
드루이드가 통제하는 위험한 숲을 통과하면서 비행 생물에게 마법의 창을 던지세요!
이상한 가족의 도움으로 창, 주문, 괴물 친구를 업그레이드하여 점점 더 높이 성장할 수 있으며, 숲에서 하늘 도시, 용의 뱃속을 거쳐 그 너머까지 탐험할 수 있습니다!
창 길이와 속도를 업그레이드하여 멈출 수 없는 작살과 투척 기계가 되세요!
숲의 어두운 면에 숨겨진 끔찍한 비밀을 밝혀내세요!
순간이동 및 마인드 컨트롤과 같은 예상치 못한 기술을 잠금 해제하기 위해 새로운 친구를 데려오세요!
새, 박쥐, 짐승을 삼켜서 달리는 동안 콤보에 불을 붙이고 힘을 키워보세요!
숲을 노예로 삼는 사악한 드루이드에게 복수하세요.
유쾌한 목소리 연기와 중독성 넘치는 게임, 이제 창을 들고 달을 향해 쏠 시간입니다!
놓치면 무기를 업그레이드하고 다시 가세요!

title: Quadrofriend
Hyper Mice Rescue
description:
게임 정보
🐭💥 너무 늦기 전에 가족을 구하세요! 💥🐭
🚀 미사일이 다가오고 있습니다! 당신의 아이들이 갇혀 있습니다! 아이들을 구할 시간은 몇 초밖에 없습니다!
당신은 아이들을 구하기 위해 시간과 싸우는 절망적인 쥐 아빠입니다. 40층 건물에서 아이들을 구하려고 불길이 번지기 전에!
⚡ 달리고, 점프하고, 벽을 타고 각 층을 번개처럼 빠르게 넘겨보세요!
💣 미사일을 피하고 퍼즐을 풀어 아이들에게 도달하세요! 너무 늦기 전에!
🏆 치즈를 모으고 가능한 한 빨리 레벨을 완료하여 3개의 별을 받으세요!
🔥 10층마다 특별한 가족 구성원을 구해야 합니다! 새로운 강력한 도전에 맞서세요!
🎭 2개의 다른 결말 – 시간 초과 전에 몇 명을 구할 수 있나요?
⏳ 시간이 다가옵니다! 모두 구할 수 있나요? ⏳

title: Elemental Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
Elemental Labyrinth는 픽셀 아트 타워 디펜스 게임으로, 전장을 직접 구성하고 전투의 흐름을 조종할 수 있습니다. 적들의 경로를 결정하는 미로를 만들고, 무작위 원소 정령을 소환한 뒤 강력한 형태로 융합하여 끊임없이 몰려오는 적의 파도를 막아내세요.
각 정령은 고유한 능력을 지니고 있으며, 전략적으로 조합하여 강력한 시너지를 만들어야 합니다. 다양한 배치와 정령 조합을 실험하며 최적의 방어 전략을 찾아보세요!
레트로 감성의 픽셀 아트, 깊이 있는 전술적 게임 플레이, 그리고 무한한 전략적 가능성을 갖춘 Elemental Labyrinth는 타워 디펜스 장르에 신선한 변화를 가져옵니다. 당신의 미궁이 시간의 시험을 견뎌낼 수 있을까요?
🏗️ 나만의 미로를 건설하세요

title: NOCTIS
description:
게임 정보
Noctis
Noctis is a single-player supernatural survival horror game where each level takes you deeper into the nightmarish realms of the dream world.
After falling asleep, your struggle for survival begins – can you wake up to reality, or will you be trapped forever in an endless nightmare? Progress through the game by solving puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the entity that haunts your dreams. Every completed level brings you one step closer to reality… or so you hope.
🕰️ Multiple Nightmare Worlds
Worlds inspired by different fobias and horror themes, where reality twists into a living nightmare. Each level drags you deeper into the unknown.
🧩 Varied Challenges
Your task is simple – wake up. Do different tasks to break free from the nightmare’s grip and escape… if you can.
👁️ Lurking Horrors
You are not alone. Terrifying entity lurk in the shadows, watching, waiting. Run, hide, or face the horror head-on.
Sleep… if you dare.

title: Emojis Battle
description:
게임 정보
Emojis Battle에서는 유명한 블루이모지들과 싸워 왕국을 구하세요. 노란 이모지의 역할을 맡고, 한때 하나였던 땅에서 블루이모지들에게 국경일을 주지 않겠다고 한 왕의 결단으로 시작된 1년 간의 갈등에서 승리하세요.
자유로운 선택:
경계가 없습니다! 당신의 전략에 맞는 노란 이모지 군을 구성하세요. 그들의 무기를 선택하고 블루이모지들과의 전투를 이끌어가세요!
블루이모지:

title: Fungi Crossing
description:
게임 정보
This is a Fungi.
You will be playing as a group of them.
Fungi can cling to almost anything. as well as to each other.
as the Fungi you will to traverse terrain, solve puzzles, and find new and interesting ways to cling to each other to best the many challenges of the wastelands.

title: Gaunts Gambit | Multiplayer FPS
description:
게임 정보
DESCRIPTION:
Gaunts Gambit is a multiplayer first person shooter game. Set in an abandoned school left empty because of a rampant virus, former students sneak back in fighting over control of the grounds and buildings. They fashion makeshift weapons from whatever they can find.
GAMEMODES:
(Subject to Change)
6v6 Deathmatch
Battle Royale
Zombies
FFA
6V6 DEATHMATCH:
Players are divided into two teams of six, where they battle and capture land to earn points for their team. The team with the most points wins the match!
BATTLE ROYALE:
Players fight on a shrinking map, scavenging gear and eliminating others. The last player standing wins!
ZOMBIES:
Players face waves of zombies, barricading entrances to slow them down. Survive as long as possible against the increasing difficulty!

title: Fecal Freighter
description:
게임 정보
After a sudden invasion of space aliens hunting for human biological waste, the job of a sewage truck operator has become a perilous craft. Join the elite of the elite and become a transporter of the brown gold — the very substance without which the world wouldn’t be quite so... picturesque. But beware: dark alleys hide sinister surprises, and no matter how hard you try, you’ll never be fully prepared for what lurks there. It’s not just aliens after you — sludge demons spawned from the filth and the fanatical followers of the Brown Cult, whose ominous leader is rumored to have ties to a shadowy global government, are on your tail too.

title: Finger Party
description:
게임 정보
Finger Party is a short incremental game about collecting and plopping creatures with your fingers and revealing the mystery about the Finger Party.
Life of a finger:
1. Be a finger
2. Join a party
3. Gain immense power through various finger-related technologies
4. Collect and plop the colorful blobs
5. Gain inside information about the party
6. ?̸̛͇̙̅̔̀͐ͅ?̶̰̩̤͎̘̐̓̋̔̕?̷̧̞̔͘͠ͅ3̴̦̤̿̈́n̷̢̺̥̩̈́̎̚d̷̳̺̟͋̒̕͝ͅ0̸̰͈̰̪̔̇f̵̦͕̅̓̓̐͝t̸̛̓̌̆́͜h̸̯́͑̆3̸̮̏͗̑̚͝p̸̫̀̋̈́͊4̸̣̻͆̂r̶͚̩̭͗̿͐͋t̷͙̤͉̬̹̉y̸͓̳͖͇͗́̀͋͜?̸̰͇͓̹̇ͅ?̵̹̰̚?̷̝̝̹̙͆́̅
Plop the Blobs in this simple and relaxing gameplay loop

title: Samurai Conqueror
description:
게임 정보
“Samurai Conqueror” is an epic historical strategy game where you aim to unify Japan across time — from the ancient Kofun period to the transformative Meiji era.
Set against the sweeping backdrop of Japan’s full historical timeline, you’ll choose one legendary figure to lead your faction and strive to bring all of Japan under your rule.
Develop your domain through commerce, agriculture, technology, and military might.
Wage war against rival factions, expand your realm, and reshape the course of Japanese history.
Will you be the one to unify the ages?
Choose one historical figure from Japanese history and start the game.
Strengthen your faction’s commerce, agriculture, technology, and military power with development commands.
Invade other factions and expand your territory. Aim to unify Japanese history!

title: Roadside Egg Stand
description:
게임 정보
로드사이드 에그 스탠드는 아늑하고 편안한 방치형 게임입니다. 귀여운 길가의 에그 스탠드를 직접 만들고 관리하며 신선한 달걀을 제공하고 작은 마을의 아름다운 도로에 기쁨을 전하세요.
조용한 시골길을 달리다 알록달록한 달걀과 수제 간식, 그리고 "신선한 달걀!"이라는 손글씨 표지가 있는 작은 나무 스탠드를 발견한다고 상상해보세요. 이 따뜻하고 포근한 느낌이 바로 이 게임의 핵심입니다.
행복한 닭 키우기:
닭 떼를 보살피고, 희귀 품종을 발견하며 점박이 달걀부터 황금 달걀까지 수집하세요!
스탠드 꾸미기:
꽃바구니, 랜턴, 꽃 장식과 손으로 그린 표지판을 추가해 스탠드를 더욱 매력적으로 꾸며보세요.
새로운 장소 탐험:
시골길, 숲길, 활기찬 마을 시장 등 아름다운 장소로 사업을 확장하세요.
신선한 달걀, 신선한 수익:
고객을 응대하고, 적절한 가격을 책정하며, 특별한 요청을 처리해 수익을 올리고 닭들이 잘 먹고 행복하도록 돌보세요!
이번 주의 직원:
최고의 닭들에게 재미있는 타이틀과 보상을 제공하며 가족처럼 축하하세요!
여유로운 분위기, 끝없는 재미:

title: Gridle
description:
게임 정보
Gridle is an incremental idle RPG where you’ll manage a powerful party to take down waves of enemies! Strategically upgrade, heal, reassign, and level up your party members to ensure maximum progress. After 50 initial levels to conquer, the game transitions into infinite levels where the challenge never stops.
Your party will automatically fight enemies for you. Allowing you to do other tasks while the gameplay flows. Optimize your party for survival to ensure they progress as much as possible by assigning classes to your party slots, upgrading your classes, unlocking skills, rebirthing for knowledge upgrades and much more.
Rebirth
Gridle features a huge rebirth tree with well over 200 knowledge upgrades. These upgrades impact everything from money earnings to individual class perks and will ensure your party can go way beyond any limits and eventually reach the end of the realm.

title: Bomberball
description:
게임 정보
Bomberball is a sci-fi multiplayer sports game with class-based loadouts. Run, pass, and throw a planet-killer bomb into the opposing team’s rift. Coordinate formations in tightly-crafted arenas. Experience the fast-paced, strategic combat of the future.
Features
Work with your team to get the bomb into the enemy team's rift, by any means necessary. Fight for every inch in unforgiving stadiums, coordinate a playbook with your teammates, and position yourself for the perfect score!
Learn and perfect the art of controlling a physics-based ball objective with precision. Utilize fast reflexes and quick thinking in a variety of playstyles to win!
Elevate the first person athlete experience with superhuman abilities - shield, grapple, or launch your hero into action - avoid imminent danger in intense situations or assist your team!

title: A Difficult Game About Letters
description:
게임 정보
When your best friend falls into trouble, it’s up to you to embark on a daring journey through the Land of Letters.

In A Difficult Game About Letters, you take control of a character who can transform into any letter of the alphabet. Each letter's shape provides unique abilities, which you’ll need to solve puzzles, navigate obstacles, and complete challenging platforming levels.
Here’s what you can do in the game:
Transform Into Letters: Instantly switch between 26 different letters to adapt to obstacles. Each letter's shape can help you in unique ways.
Jump Across Platforms: Use letters like J or V to jump higher or leap across wide gaps.
Hook and Grab: Turn into L or T to hook onto ledges, edges, or moving platforms.
                          Roll and Squeeze: Transform into round letters like O or C to roll through tight spaces or under obstacles.

title: Black Pieces Move First
description:
게임 정보
어느 날, 겸손한 검은 폰이 체스의 첫 번째 규칙에 도전하기로 결심했습니다. 백색 말들은 이에 대해 전혀 만족하지 않았습니다. 결과는? 전쟁이었습니다.
당신은 다양한 체스판에서 검은 폰을 조종하게 됩니다. 클래식 체스의 이동, 방어, 공격 규칙을 따르면서도, 한 가지 변형이 있습니다: 검은 폰은 왕처럼 이동할 수 있는 능력을 가지고 있으며, 검은 말을 밀어내고 명령에 따라 공격하게 할 수 있습니다.
이 퍼즐은 논리적 사고, 민첩성, 창의력을 요구하며, 각 레벨의 목표를 달성하기 위한 해결책을 찾아야 합니다(총 60단계, 점차 난이도가 상승합니다).

title: Panzer Planet
description:
게임 정보
Face relentless waves of giant insects, aliens, and zombies in a fight for survival. Customize your build with an arsenal of unique weapons and power-ups, and harness the game's unique planetary perspective to outmaneuver your enemies and turn the tide of battle. How long can you last against the cosmic onslaught?
You are a skilled bounty hunter with a powerful tank, hired by planets desperate to reclaim their land from invaders. Your mission: exterminate the monstrous threats and make the planets habitable for settlers.
For every monster you eliminate, you earn a bounty, which can be used to upgrade your weapons, tank, and abilities—allowing you to tackle even greater challenges and amass even greater rewards.

title: 修真幸存者（Immortal Survivor）
description:
게임 정보
《immortal survivor》is a survivor like game based on Chinese Xiu Zhen culture. During the gameplay, players will take on the role of "cultivators" and survive under the siege of monsters. By killing monsters, players can increase their level and strengthen themselves, ultimately surviving to challenge the ultimate boss and achieve victory in the game.

title: upg
description:
게임 정보
what's upg!
upg (pronounced up-gee) is a fast-paced bullet heaven auto-shooting action platformer where you focus on movement while your weapons do the shooting. dash through procedurally generated levels, collecting upgrades and taking down waves of enemies.
features:
- automatic weapon systems - focus on dodging and positioning
- fluid movement system with wall-sliding, dashing, and precise jumps
- multiple weapons:
  - rapid-fire projectiles
  - homing missiles
  - orbital defenders
  - chain lightning
  - returning boomerangs
- roguelite progression:
  - (upg)rade existing weapons
  - unlock new weapons
  - improve speed, health, and jump height
- procedurally generated levels
- pixel art with dynamic lighting
- retro-inspired sound effects
controls:
- wasd/arrows to move
- space to dash
- that's it - weapons fire automatically
stack upgrades, combine weapons, survive as long as you can.

title: Purple Tears. Part I: Everybody dies in the end
description:
게임 정보
In the aftermath of the Cataclysm, a small Eastern European town finds itself trapped within the confines of an enigmatic purple cylinder. Its boundaries are impenetrable, leaving the fate of the world beyond a haunting mystery. Also, the laws of physics have been upended — distant planets now linger in the skies.
Yet, life endures. The townspeople, resigned to their isolation, have adapted to a fragile existence, striving to live ordinary lives beneath the ever-present shadow of uncertainty.
But for five schoolmates, the humdrum of everyday life is no longer enough. Driven by a desire to uncover the fragmented rumors from the internet and the "urban legends," they decide to embark on a hike to abandoned research institute RADIOSVET. There, it is said, a signal was received — a transmission from the other side.
autokwd: Purple Tears. Part I: Everybody dies in the end

title: Rotten Forgotten
description:
게임 정보
Rotten Forgotten: A Whimsical Farm Revival Adventure.
Gather your friends and embark on a delightful agricultural escapade in Rotten Forgotten, a charming cooperative farming game for 1-4 players. Your once-thriving family barn teeters on the brink of bankruptcy, and it's up to you and your companions to breathe new life into the dilapidated homestead.
Cultivate a variety of quirky crops, tend to your eclectic menagerie of farm animals, and race against time to fulfill orders and save your beloved barn from financial ruin. With a perfect blend of strategy, teamwork, and lighthearted fun, Rotten Forgotten is perfect for playing with friends.
Co-op!
Engaging co-op gameplay for solo farmers or groups of up to four players. Play with keyboard and/or controllers.
Challenging time management as you juggle crop cycles and animal care.
Plant!

title: Diabolika
description:
게임 정보
- STORY:
You have woken up amongst the corpses in the old deprecated and depraved temple - the air stench of rot and the once prosperous village turned into ruin while you have been unconscious.
You don't quite remember what brought you to these lands - nonetheless it is least important thing to worry about right now.
Facing with this strange and horrifying reality you must gather your last strength and escape the overwhelming darkness.
- CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER
Choose one of three classes each with its own unique gameplay style and mechanics.
Lordsworn:
- As the retainer of the crown, slash and bash your foes with pure brutal force or smite them with holy light.
Take upon an knight oath and complete deeds to raise in power.
Shine as beacon of hope for the righteous and innocent in this gods-forsaken land.
Sorceress:
- As a highly qualified scholar and mage - transform your knowledge into a deadly weapon.
Harness the power of the stars and elements and cast powerful spells capable of eradicating your foes.
As the owner of the Grimoire learn its secrets becoming even more powerful or perish under the power of forces beyond your comprehension.

title: Cross Court Tennis 3
description:
게임 정보
최신 크로스 코트 테니스 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 실제 물리 역학이 적용된 재빠른 공과 훌륭해진 조작감, 승리 전략을 경험해 보세요. 세계 1위를 목표로 서브하고 훈련하세요. 3D 테니스 시뮬레이션을 만끽하며 프로처럼 플레이하세요.
전체 게임 컨텐츠:
커리어 모드
사전 제작된 선수 5명 선택 가능
50명 이상의 고유한 상대
24개에 달하는 국제 토너먼트
하드코트, 잔디코트, 클레이코트
트레이닝 세션 30개
튜토리얼
볼 머신으로 연습
서브 연습

title: Hunter: Into the Abyss
description:
게임 정보
심연이 요동친다, 타락이 세상을 집어삼킨다
심연 깊은 곳에서 장로들이 깨어나려 합니다. 그들의 타락이 대지와 생명체를 뒤틀고 있습니다. 고대의 마지막 수호자로서, 오직 당신만이 그들을 막을 수 있습니다. 변화하는 던전을 탐험하고, 치명적인 전투를 마스터하며, 다시금 부활하려는 공포의 존재를 사냥하십시오.
전략적이고 깊이 있는 전투
한순간의 판단이 승패를 가르는 고난도 전투를 경험하세요. 매번 다른 스킬이 주어지는 로그라이크 방식으로, 변화하는 전장에서 빠르게 적응해야 합니다. 강력한 능력을 선택하고, 공격 타이밍을 조절하며, 강력한 적들을 뛰어넘으세요. 전투를 거듭할수록 당신은 성장하고, 새로운 전술을 발견하며, 장로들을 무너뜨릴 방법을 찾게 될 것입니다.
끝없는 반복 플레이의 재미
같은 전투는 단 한 번도 없습니다. 매번 새로운 던전이 생성되며, 색다른 적들과 강력한 보스를 마주하게 됩니다. 다양한 능력을 해금하고, 독특한 도전에 맞서며, 플레이할수록 서서히 드러나는 숨겨진 이야기를 경험하세요. 죽음조차 당신을 더욱 강하게 만들 것입니다.
강해져라, 그리고 다가오는 공포를 견뎌라
죽을 때마다 강해지십시오. 더 강력한 업그레이드를 해금하고, 새로운 도전에 대비하며, 다시 한 번 싸울 준비를 하세요. 던전은 계속해서 변하고, 적들은 점점 더 강력해지며, 위협은 더욱 거대해집니다. 당신은 장로들의 부활을 막을 것인가, 아니면 심연에 삼켜질 것인가?

title: Dice Builder
description:
게임 정보
Dice Builder
Roll the Dice, Build Your Destiny!
Embark on a captivating journey in Dice Builder, a unique city-building game where every decision starts with the roll of a dice. In this innovative blend of strategy and chance, you will manage and expand your city by carefully assigning dice rolls to gather essential resources, upgrade buildings, and unlock new areas of your empire.
---
Key Features:
Dynamic Dice Gameplay:
Each day begins with a dice roll, providing you with opportunities to allocate your resources strategically. Will you invest in upgrading your infrastructure or prioritize resource collection? The power is in your hands, but the dice determine your fate.
Resource Management:
Master the art of resource management by balancing water, food, gold, stone, wood, and population. Each resource plays a crucial role in the growth and sustainability of your city:
Water: Essential for building houses and powering various utilities.
Food: Harvested from farms, fisheries, and hunting lodges, sustaining your growing population.
Gold: Earned through taxation and selling armory, used for purchasing additional dice and upgrading structures.
Wood and Stone: Gathered from lumbermills and mining camps, used for constructing and upgrading buildings.
Specialized Buildings:
Construct and upgrade a variety of buildings to optimize resource collection:
Farms: Thrive on fertile green ground, maximizing food production.
Lumbermills and mining camps: Strategically placed in forests and stony grounds for optimal resource output.
Water Pumps and Fisheries: Located on static or moving water for enhanced water and food production.
Ground Quality Mechanics:
Choose your building locations wisely based on ground types:

title: Transpawt Train
description:
게임 정보
다양한 동물이 함께 살아가는 “발바닥 도시”에 오신 여러분을 환영합니다!
여러분은 “철도 공단”의 직원으로서, 발바닥 도시의 기차 노선들을 설계하고
동물 마을들을 연결하는 임무를 담당합니다.
창의적인 전략과 설계로 동물들의 세상을 이어주세요!
동물 마을을 연결해서 철도를 설계해보세요!
여러분이 설계한 철도를 따라 기차가 운행을 시작해요.
동물 주민들이 편하게 기차를 탑승할 수 있도록 만드세요!

title: Leave
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in LEAVE, a narrative-driven platformer and atmospheric adventure that tells a deeply moving story of survival, resilience, and the fight for freedom. Follow the journey of a young child navigating the haunting beauty of a world torn apart by tyranny, experiencing themes of hope, defiance, and the devastating impact of oppression all brought to life through cinematic visuals, emotional storytelling, and seamless gameplay.
Solve intricate puzzles using interactive systems like pushing objects, breaking obstacles with an axe, and crawling under carpets to evade enemies.
Engage with procedural animations and active rag-doll physics for immersive movement and realistic interactions.
Experiment with fun activities like throwing rocks into a lake or playfully interacting with the world around you.

title: Melt Abyss
description:
게임 정보
・Dual protagonists that can be switched at will
You can switch between the two protagonists Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua at will to explore the city freely.
・A variety of VTUBER’s signature skills
There are more than a dozen of VTUBER’s signature skills appearing in the game, such as the famous “Ui Beam”.
・Different bonds with different VTUBERs
In the city, Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua will fight or talk with different VTUBERs, and different VTUBERs will have different attitudes towards the two protagonists.

title: SurfsUp
description:
게임 정보
Master the art of speed, precision, and acrobatic platforming in this high-octane, movement-focused game.
Overview:
Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled adventure where gravity-defying speed and precision platforming take center stage. Inspired by the legendary surf maps of Counter-Strike, this game offers players a fun and thrilling experience.
Glide through the air and tackle gravity-defying ramps in beautifully crafted environments. Every moment in SurfsUp is about mastering momentum and navigating challenging levels with perfect timing and control.
Gameplay Features:
Surfing Mechanics: Master the art of high-speed air-surfing! Use ramps to slide through levels with precision and style. Timing, control, and momentum are crucial as you navigate ramps, tight turns, and massive jumps. The faster you go, the more agile you become, but misjudge your landing, and you'll pay the price.
Fluid Movement: Experience the thrill of fluid, acrobatic movement across unique maps. Perfect your surfing technique to gain speed, jump further, and reach impossible heights, all while maintaining control.

title: RAKKA: WAKE 01 - SOOT
description:
게임 정보
London, 1993. Rakka works as a disillusioned office employee, navigating the monotony of corporate life. When she stumbles upon a mysterious code hidden in a care package from her job, her world begins to quickly unravel. Alongside her roommates—Sascha, Björn, and Kev—Rakka's life takes a sharp turn from mundane to mayhem, facing unsettling phone calls, mysterious black cars, and a break-in. Are they being watched? Entwined in a dangerous conspiracy, the roommates weigh their options, and when Björn reveals he’s figured out the code, a decision is made. As you guide Rakka and her friends through this narrative, you'll uncover not just the answers to the mystery, but also explore the depths of their friendships. How far will they go for each other? And just who’s on the other end of the line? Follow these friends down their dead-end lives as they piece it all together, and they might just make it out the other side, with any luck.
A visual novel paired with point-and-click elements, Rakka distinguishes itself with its breadth of hand-drawn assets, detailed backgrounds, charming character art, and unique paper-cut style. Complimented by the art is the incredible original soundtrack; spearheaded by the minds behind The PMT, it oozes indie charm. Both serve in tandem, dragging the player into the character and dialogue driven world of Rakka. Think you can make it to its thrilling conclusion?

title: Okinawa Journal
description:
게임 정보
Okinawa Journal is a captivating point-and-click narrative game set during the summer of 2000 in the serene yet mysterious landscapes of Okinawa. You step into the ethereal role of Kami, a guardian angel tasked with guiding Haruki, a struggling journalist, as he delves into the baffling disappearance of a beloved actress.
Along the way, you’ll meet a diverse cast of characters—both human and spirit—each harboring their own secrets, ambitions, and obligations. As the investigation unfolds, you’ll uncover a web of hidden truths tied to Okinawa’s dark past, with consequences that linger in the present.
With challenging decisions, intriguing locations to explore, and multiple endings to discover, Okinawa Journal invites you to shape a story where every choice carries weight.
With Haruki's Insight, you'll always know what still interests him. Also, Okinawa Journal is a succinctly written text-based game. There are no walls of text or meandering dialogue. The characters in the game summarize all their interactions in thought, which you, as a guardian angel, are able to understand.

title: Glory On Pluto
description:
게임 정보
Earth needs you. Well, it needs someone to fly their newest rocket to space and inspire the masses, and you’re next on the hiring list.
Journey from Earth to Pluto and beyond, building wild item synergies and combos to push your rocket to unimaginable speeds. Restock and hire crew to help out, and bring back glory to earth one boost at a time!
The engine of the future
Place fuel items into 18 slots on a novel and chaotic engine board. With 6 segments and 3 rings that will rotate randomly after each boost, stay on your toes to plan your synergies as best you can.
No such thing as a misfuel
With a planned 100+ items across 12+ fuel types, each with its own effects and bonuses, no two journeys will be the same.
Friends along the way
A planned 40+ crew members can be hired and upgraded after each phase of your journey, giving bonuses and increasing your chances of travelling to the edge of the solar system!
Strategy and fate
With an engine prone to reorganising itself and a limited stock from the acquisition counter after each boost, you’ll have to stay on your toes to build the strongest strategy you can against the odds.
Challenges and Rewards
Take it easier in cadet mode, manage an overheating engine in commander mode, or face an array of setbacks in specialist mode. Gain glory equal to your struggles, use it to buy crew and restock your engines, and push ever deeper into the vastness of space.

title: Frostpoint Toll
description:
게임 정보
Wake up, Pilot. We’ve arrived at Frostpoint
Say hello to your new home—if you can call it that.
Here, we appreciate a good joke. But your situation? Far from amusing. What remains of you is fragile, but one thing persists—your will.
Your Frame is online and ready to harvest
It's dangerous to go alone, and highly inefficient...
Your machine is a marvel—capable of leveling cities. You, my friend, will have a more trivial task: move through rough terrain, dig, smash, and collect for your cause.
Gratitude is expected. After all, you are still here.

title: Art-Therapy: Jigsaw Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
🧩 A Cozy Jigsaw Puzzle Game for Everyone
If you like puzzles, this one’s for you. It has over 100 beautiful pictures in different styles—some colorful and fun, others peaceful and calming. There’s no rush, no timers, just a simple and relaxing way to spend your time.
💡 Easy to play – Just pick a picture and start putting the pieces together. No complicated menus, no pressure.
🎨 Lots of variety – From detailed artwork to soft, cozy scenes, there’s something for every mood.
🎵 Relaxing music & sounds – Different music styles and ambient sounds to help you focus and unwind.
🌿 A stress-free experience – Play at your own pace, take a break whenever you want, and enjoy the moment.
Whether you want a quick puzzle session or something to help you relax after a long day, this game is here for you. Just sit back, put the pieces together, and have a good time. 😊

title: BURST
description:
게임 정보
BURST is a small one to four player local sports game that takes a very different spin on bubble football. Try your luck against an overwhelming number of opponents and lay waste to the field in the process. 
Inspired by hallmarks of the genre like NES World Cup this game is also easy to pick up ideally enjoyed with friends.
1 - 4 player local co-op with gamepads
Remote Play Together supported
adaptive difficulty
2D retro pixel graphics
tackle your your opponents to gain control over the field
charge up and use a power shot to score a goal
short 5 minute rounds, ideal for in-between times

title: Jackie Hart: Headhunter
description:
게임 정보
Step into the shoes of Jackie Hart, a paranormal investigator,  as she navigates a chilling mystery set in the shadowy streets and rooftops of modern Taiwan. A gruesome discovery on a hotel roof leads to a tangled web of ritualistic sacrifices, ancient folklore, and unearthly entities each with their own motivations and plans for Jackie.
In this 2D point & click adventure, you'll:
Investigate Disturbing Crime Scenes: Examine eerie environments, piece together clues, and reconstruct events to unravel the truth.
Engage in Deep, Choice-Driven Dialogue: Interact with a cast of richly developed characters, from skeptical police officers to enigmatic shamans, where your decisions shape the narrative and relationships.
Explore Taiwan's Mystical Lore: Delve into indigenous rituals, encounter spirits, and face the terrifying yaoguai, as you uncover secrets rooted in cultural mythology.
Strengthen Your Abilities: Meet powerful allies in the world of mysticism and magic who can unlock your latent powers.

title: Rainbow Unicorn Dash
description:
게임 정보
Rainbow Unicorn Dash is a fast and fun 2D game with art designed by my 5-year-old 🎨 Play as a unicorn, collect shoes to dash through enemies, and chain together massive combos. After dashing, your shoes fly off and bounce around the stage—dash through them again to extend your combo and climb the leaderboards. Unlock powerful abilities, aim for the highest scores, and enjoy quick, exciting gameplay sessions!
🌈 - Play as a unicorn
🎨 - Cute Art
✨ - Chain together massive combos
📈 - Climb the leaderboards
🔥 - Unlock fun abilities
⏰ - Quick gameplay sessions

title: Vox Populi: Australia 2025
description:
게임 정보
Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for the Australian federal elections of 2025 or many other alternative elections! In "Vox Populi: Australia 2025", you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

Choose from a host of different scenarios that place the country in various realistic or fictional situations on different dates.
Recruit your campaign team from a variety of characters, based on their ideologies or traits.
Act directly on your nation's regions or demographic groups to impact their political opinions and voting intentions.
Adapt your strategy to the actions of your opponents and place obstacles in their path.
Face the many unforeseen events that will shake up the country's political life.
