Influence and organise national referendums to change voting rules, territorial integrity or laws that directly benefit you.
Collect enough seats in the future House of Representatives to ensure your influence on the nation's destiny.
Collect dozens of cards that will help you in the great national debates.
Play as an alien or a defender of humanity in a variety of fictional science fiction scenarios.
Organise speeches to the populations of post-apocalyptic scenario worlds to gain supreme power.

This game includes:

10 different scenarios, past or future, many with randomisation for replayability, adapted to the country's history and politics
Science fiction or post-apocalyptic scenarios with their own characters, regions, traits, ideologies, corpuses and events
A detailed, fully customisable character creator
Dozens of pre-existing or randomly generated characters
Dozens of unique ideologies and corpuses
A realistic subdivision of Australia into regions and demographic categories, each with its own characteristics

title: Clap Clash
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
This is a unique blend of rhythm, deck-building, and roguelike mechanics. Embark on an adventure, unlock and collect various skills, and build your own skill pool to adapt to the ever-changing challenges.
The gameplay is inspired by a classroom clapping game that was popular in parts of East Asia about twenty years ago. Unlike traditional card-based roguelikes, you won’t have the luxury of time to carefully plan your next move. Instead, you must adapt to a fast-paced and ever-shifting combat rhythm, making split-second decisions before each beat.

title: SEMP 64
description:
게임 정보
This is a super easy multiplayer platformer.
So it's a 3D platformer, with online multiplayer and it's super easy.
(Disclaimer: it's actually super difficult and not super easy)
Climb to the very top of the super huge level.
Fall down and... well try again I guess. Maybe you where lucky and able to save yourself onto a near platform. Or you lost hours of progress, who knows what'll happen.
Play alone, join the global lobby or host your own 4 player lobby for your friends.
But let's be real, it's much more fun to see tons of players fall down... I mean climb up the world.
Already mastered the game? Well respect. But what now?
Hop into the level editor and build your own levels! Let's see if you can make players rage quit even faster than I could.

title: Shadows of Tuonela
description:
게임 정보
Journey to the Finnish purgatory – Tuonela – and fight the countless other versions of yourself to prove worthy of ascending back onto the Earth.

Explore the open world, gather resources, craft better equipment to prepare for battle.

But choose your fights wisely as the three hit combat can take even a seasoned Shadow by surprise.

Tuonela remembers only the triumphant.

title: DigSite
description:
게임 정보
Step into the golden age of archaeological discovery in the 1920s as an ambitious archaeologist racing to uncover the secrets of ancient Egypt. DigSite invites players to dig, explore, clean, document, and donate long-forgotten relics hidden beneath the vast desert sands.
Buy a dig site license, choose the right spot and dig for valuable artifacts. The intense desert heat and endless sands will take their toll, and your survival depends on balancing your physical needs. Drink water regularly to avoid dehydration, as the oppressive sun and physical labor will quickly drain your energy. Find shaded spots where you can rest in the heat of the day.
When you contribute a rare artifact to the museum, the rewards are significant. You’ll earn substantial recognition and monetary compensation. This funding can be used to expand your excavation operations.
After cleaning and restoring the finds, it’s time to document your discoveries. Use a vintage camera to take photos, capturing every angle of the artifact before it is sent off to a museum. Your images, detailed notes, and thorough cataloging will not only preserve the artifact for future generations but will also help you build a reputation as one of the greatest archaeologists of your time.

title: Dealicious
description:
게임 정보
Dealicious is a cooking-themed kitchen management deck-builder card game. Discover and stack cards together to cook meals, manage your kitchen space and expand eventually hiring staff as you grow your empire. Discover unique cards which offer special abilities/bonuses! Can you collect them all?
300+ cards to collect
90+ recipes
30+ missions
Many packs to discover and unpack
Kitchen customization & expansion
Management of staff (hire & fire)
Gold system (pay bills on time!)
Stack and move cards freely!

title: Memories Of Zattera
description:
게임 정보
"Fragments of the past weave together, each memory unveiling a hidden truth, each detail blurring the line between reality and mere perception."
For a decade, the arcane kingdom of Ahlfar, blessed by ancient magic and guide by the stars, clashed with Kyrguios, a nation powered by science and invention. Their final war was unlike any before it: Kyrguios unleashed cutting-edge warships and bold strategies, delivering a crushing blow that shattered Ahlfar’s faith in its centuries-old arcane traditions.
In the aftermath of defeat, as tensions simmer and rebuilding begins, Ahlfar’s king dared to learn from the very force that overcame them. Now, the royal family stands at a crossroads: adhere to ancient customs or embrace Kyrguios’s pragmatic innovation.
Who could have imagined a mechanical cannon surpassing the fiery might of a seasoned mage’s spell?
Explore Moral & Political Dilemmas in a Fantasy Universe
Explore the collision of magic and technology, tradition and innovation. Will you champion the starlit legacy of Ahlfar or spark a new era with Kyrguios’s progress?
Connect with an Engaging Cast and Forge Meaningful Relationships
Meet memorable heroes and adversaries whose bonds grow as you progress. Every interaction can spark friendship, rivalry, or something in between.
Experience a Story Crafted for Multiple Playthroughs
Each perspective uncovers hidden truths and deeper layers of the story. Return with fresh insights to experience entirely new outcomes.

title: Collisions: Cosmic Geometry
description:
게임 정보
Test your limits in the most frantic Neon Arcade Survival game in the galaxy! In Collisions, your reflexes will be pushed to the limit as you fight for survival in a fast-paced and intense arena against geometric enemies that move randomly and unpredictably.
Collisions: Cosmic Galaxy is an indie project developed by me, Gabriel Henrique, with dedication to the indie gaming universe and the creation of visually striking and challenging experiences. The game is in its final stages of development—stay tuned for updates!
✅ Wishlist Collisions now and get ready for the ultimate neon challenge!
🎮 Simple Gameplay, Intense Challenge
Move using WASD or arrow keys.
Easy to learn, hard to master!

title: Fly With Friends
description:
게임 정보
Please note this game is in development—its gameplay and features are constantly evolving. If something seems off or incomplete, it's likely a sign that changes are coming!
Fly With Friends is a social multiplayer flying game. Relax, explore, and fly...with friends!
TAKE TO THE SKIES!
Explore the island and make new friends! Engage in epic aerial dogfights, blast balloons (or other players) with your egg cannon, and conquer nail-biting race courses!
STYLE YOUR PILOT & RIDE!
Express yourself by decking out your egg pilot with a variety of cool skins and fun accessories. Earn a plane-load of money, unlock upgrades, and get tons of rewards!

title: SnaPaul 2 : Anomalies
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in SnaPaul, a first-person psychological horror game that traps you in a dark, mysterious house filled with unexpected horrors. After a prank gone horribly wrong, you're ensnared in a nightmarish loop crafted by your own mother. As you delve into her twisted past, the boundaries between reality and madness blur. Unravel sinister secrets and confront malevolent forces in this unforgettable experience.
Key Features:
Intense Psychological Horror
Engaging Storyline
Short but Impactful Gameplay
Unique Achievements
Are you ready to discover what lurks in the darkness? Your mind and courage will be tested in SnaPaul. Brace your nerves, because once you enter... you'll never be the same.
Note: This game contains explicit violent scenes that may disturb some players, including depictions of mutilat

title: Sheep  the Stars
description:
게임 정보

High stakes rocket-powered precision sheep platformer. As a sheep strapped to a rocket, boost up and climb through perilous terrain and traps to reach the goal before everyone else. Every sheep has dreamed of touching the stars, will you be the first?

Tackle the single player story and challenges, or take your precision skills (and pure rage) into the multiplayer area. Be the sheep that flies the furthest the faster.

(Enjoy the demo alongside development. Actively looking for feedback on gameplay and multiplayer while we continue polishing visuals, and levels)
Features
Rage / Precision platformer with escalating challenges
Multiple difficulty modes to suit beginners and pros alike
Multiplayer lobbies with friends or take your chances with open lobbies
Highly customizable multiplayer gameplay for everyone
Customizable cosmetics and unlockables
Simple to learn, difficult to master

(This game is under active development, join the Discord Server or the Email List to help shape the future of the title.

title: Minerva Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
Minerva Labyrinth is a turn-based, party-based, first-person dungeon crawler set in the near future of Earth.  Take command of five warriors with incredible powers and defend humanity from an ancient enemy known as the Hate.
Hate is Forever
In the 1990s, humanity finally comes together on an unprecedented scale to confront the  global climate and energy crises that threaten its future.  Over fifty years later, civilization thrives worldwide in a new era of cooperation and humanism, and the recent rediscovery of ancient magic promises miraculous new advancements.  Yet as human strife recedes, something dark and forgotten returns from deep in the earth...
Minerva Squad
Create your own party from ten classes, ten passive skills, and customizable stats, or jump in right away with the balanced quick-start party.
You're not alone in your fight.  Return to your allies to recover from your wounds and upgrade your equipment, from bows and swords to skirts and tiaras.
Enter the Labyrinth
Conquer 16 fully hand-crafted dungeon levels, spanning multiple locations and biomes.
The labyrinth itself is your enemy, but beyond traps, riddles, mazes, and grisly monsters lie valuable hidden treasures.
Battle the Hate in fast-paced interleaved turn-based combat. Each enemy type has its own powers and tactics to counter your own, and each labyrinth has a powerful overlord waiting to crush you.
Fully-annotated automap tracks your progress as you explore the labyrinth.
Optional tutorial mode for players new to dungeon crawling.

title: Rune Craft
description:
게임 정보
Once a glorious civilization, the Rune World was plunged into chaos by the "Core of Chaos" going berserk. As the last inheritor of the runes, you must survive the relentless tides of monsters that emerge with each passing day and night. Every battle is a new trial of runes—whether it’s extracting ancient runes from the bodies of colossal bosses or assembling the ultimate weapon capable of sealing the Chaos.
Game Features
Diverse Items: Choose from hundreds of unique runes and weapons, each with their own distinct traits.
Freeform Builds: The selection and arrangement of your runes will shape the form and attributes of your weapon’s output.
Treasure Chests & Shops: Elite monsters and bosses drop powerful chests, while shops serve as a vital source for runes.
Dynamic Events & Objectives: Encounter a variety of special events and objectives throughout the game, each offering rich rewards upon completion.
◆ Dynamic Trajectory System ◆
Morph projectiles in real-time with runes, craft signature ballistics by combining trajectory modifiers with effect-enhancing glyphs

title: RockIt Ronnie
description:
게임 정보
Shoot your way thru traffic to rack up points and beat the clock...
Grab powerups along the way to add time, boost score, collect special weapons, and much more...
Battle and defeat diabolical bosses to advance to new worlds

title: Core Rush ! Dash Arena
description:
게임 정보
Core Rush: Dash Arena is a fast-paced, action-packed party game where players race to the core in wild arenas filled with obstacles, platforms, and chaos! Whether you're driving high-speed customizable cars or controlling quirky characters, your goal is simple but challenging: be the first to reach the core and claim victory!
Compete across a variety of vibrant arenas, each featuring unique themes and dynamic obstacles. Dash, jump, drift, and smash your way through intense races, balancing speed and strategy to outplay your opponents. Every round is a test of skill, reflexes, and adaptability as you navigate ever-changing environments designed to keep you on the edge of your seat.
Key Features:
Single-Player and Multiplayer Modes: Race solo or challenge up to 8 players in chaotic online matches!
Unique Arenas and Platforms: Experience a range of arenas with different layouts, hazards, and surprises.
Switch between characters and vehicles, each with distinct abilities and handling.

title: Wadar: a dimension altering reality
description:
게임 정보
Wadar is a 2d platformer designed to make you think and utilizes gameplay elements that are not seen often in platformers.
some examples of this includes the player being able to:
Flip gravity
Pause your existence?
Stop time
Teleport (in a bunch of different ways)
Use portals
Stop gravity 
and a bunch of other abilities with levels made to allow the player to get the most out of them. 
abilities are not the only focus of this game however. there are 9 worlds which includes 
Ability focused worlds
A troll world, 
A world where you have to find out how much you need to do something and 
A world based on colour platforms defining what you can see or collide with (these platforms have symbols to try and help with colour blindness compatability)
there are also a lot of secrets within some levels to be found including both unlockable cosmetics to stylize your character and even secret endings which may let you skip some levels.
there are over 70 levels in this game and plenty of which you will most likely need to play multiple times to find everything.

title: Fugue Shot
description:
게임 정보
Each run in Fugue Shot presents a series of unique dreamscapes, filled with increasingly difficult puzzles and randomized encounters to test your abilities to their limit. Plan your shots carefully to clear the playfield and overcome the ever-shifting landscape of this liminal and surreal world.
Build Your Own Solutions
Set up your playfield, test different ideas, and interact with a satisfying physics engine to master constantly changing puzzles and challenges.
Power Up Your Run
Choose from dozens of unique items to impact your gameplay and warp your playstyle. Discover powerful synergies to create truly unique builds, allowing for emergent gameplay and a constantly shifting experience.

title: Hellaven
description:
게임 정보
Hellaven - This is a comedy visual novel about an angel imprisoned for life in a heavenly prison many years ago for selling drugs, but at one point his life changes and he is forced to go on an adventure to understand his past
Story
70 years ago, under certain circumstances, a white-haired angel appears in a heavenly prison, but in one day everything changes, and a girl comes to him with an offer of cooperation that is impossible to win, because it helps him free himself from life imprisonment and start a new life... The main thing is not to make past mistakes again, or to make sure that no one knows about it... And you will also have to see old acquaintances and meet many new friends in the human world.
Peculiarities
Duration: 3-4 hours
Full voice acting of the novel (so far only in Russian)
Full video scenes between transitions from locations
Several secret characters
Lots of cute, funny and spicy moments
Colorful, scenic art
Black humor
Dynamic action scenes with different outcome
Elements of Fanservice

title: A Simple Platmer
description:
게임 정보
Your objective is to reach the end of the game while avoiding obstacles along the way some of the obstacles are spikes, thwomps (objects that kill you and move up and down), platforms that disappear on a timer, lasers, bullet spawners, and much much more.


Good Luck :)

title: Leaia
description:
게임 정보
Farm, fight, brew magical alcotions, and uncover the mysteries of the Tree of Life!
 Farming & Harvesting – Sow, water, fertilize, and reap a variety of crops. Sell your produce for profit and expand your farm!
 Adorable & Useful Animals – Raise chickens, goats, pigs, and cows. Ride your very own horse! Train and bond with your loyal dog, who can fetch resources, fight alongside you, and learn special skills.
 Dynamic Combat System – Engage in real-time battles with dodges, parries, staggers, and powerful skills like the whirlwind sword attack or wielding primitive black powder firearms!

title: Split Signal
description:
게임 정보
A new puzzle game from LYNE creator Thomas Bowker with visual design by Peter Bentley.

Traverse a vast landscape filled with hundreds of tetromino inspired puzzles and fix something that has broken.

title: Candela: Colorless Dreams
description:
게임 정보
Bring light to a colorless world in Candela, a mysterious and atmospheric puzzle platformer set in a desolate, post-apocalyptic land. Manipulate blue and red flames to solve puzzles, master challenging platforming, and uncover secrets.
Harness the powers of blue and red flames, combining them to unlock new possibilities.
Explore a non-linear world map, collecting keys and finding secrets to access new areas and progress.
Face challenging puzzles and a variety of mechanics that test your skills and creativity.
Discover a land full of mysteries waiting to be unraveled.

title: Meowmentum
description:
게임 정보
Meowmentum is a first-person speedrunning platformer in which you must finish speed trials as fast as possible to become a full-fledged catmage! 🐈🧙‍♂️ What are you waiting for? Go get your name on the leaderboards MEOW~!



Use your newly-found powers of Meowmentum and harness the potential of paw-kour! Run on walls, slide down ramps, and dash through magic orbs to keep going faster!





Prove yourself worthy by completing the Elder Catmages' speed trials! Discover secret shortcuts and movement techniques as you paw through each trial!





Collect meow-zmerizing medals and race against Catmages all around the world! Will you dominate the leaderboards and become a master of Meowmentum?





Hello! We are a team of 5 indie developers (+ 4 audio collaborators) aiming to create the best magical cat speedrunner in existence! We sincerely hope you enjoy our game, in whatever capacity it may be. Wanna chat with us? JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER!! Thank you <3

title: Service Dog
description:
게임 정보
DEMO COMING REAL SOON!
Every Dog Loves a Good Walk... 
But when that leash snaps, and your master eats pavement, that sweet taste of freedom is undeniable.
He's Right Behind you!
Your master is hot on your tail, but you've got way more important things to do.
Everyone has a Favor to Ask.
Who will you help? Who will you knock over? And who will get peed on?

title: Triumvora
description:
게임 정보
Triumvora is a Survival/Action RPG with Roguelite and Hack 'n Slash elements, set in a surreal world of plants and concrete.
Inside this infinite city, a new ecosystem has formed. Mysterious creatures have claimed the top of the food chain. Live through one's eyes and grow from a weakling to the city's ruler.
KEEP HUNGER AWAY
Food is limited and in high demand. Will you eat it, stash it for hard times, or share it? Will you protect your stockpiles or raid others’?
Don't lose track of the food available in the area, unless you want to be swarmed by other hungry creatures.
RAISE YOUR AURA
These strange beings are able to see and absorb Aura, concentrated sources of the universe’s energy.
How will you assert your power? Through the wealth of your stockpiles, the number of loyal allies you've gathered, or pure aggression?
Use Aura to level up your stats, unlock new attacks and create one of the coveted Crowns - your key to the top.
REACH UNCHALLENGED RULERSHIP
Someone needs to take the lead, and that someone is you. ...Or so every other creature thinks.
Deal with all threats to your crown. You can keep your territory only once everyone is on your side. Sway them with gifts or fear. Or both!
Don't let death deter you from your dreams. There's higher powers at play here, which can make good use of your hard-earned Aura.
LABOUR OF LOVE
If you're a fan of unique Indie games, do wishlist this! Triumvora is made by a solo developer (hi!) and I've put in a lot of love and care in every aspect of it, from the gameplay to the art.

title: FPI Bank: Cryptocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Tired of normal games? Then you can have a wonderful time not spending it on this game!
No gameplay and no plot! Only microtransactions and fees for jumps and slides.
Shooter, madness, puzzles, lul, easter eggs YES! ... and when not yes?
Wishlist this non game and receive nothing but the extra fees from FPI bank!
This is an FPS adventure with elements of spatial destruction, platforming, and puzzles. The game features levels with dynamic gameplay shifts and engaging realistic locations but also crazy places.

title: Blood Aliens 3
description:
게임 정보
Features
Fast-Paced Combat: Take down swarms of aliens with quick reflexes and calculated precision. Chain kills into streaks to earn extra points.
Story: Engaging 3D cutscenes and professional voice acting that bring your journey to life.
Multiple endings: Are you able to get a great score? You'll be rewarded with an alternative ending to the story and cinematic!
Diverse Enemies: Face a variety of alien species, each with unique movement patterns, projectile attacks, and behaviors to keep every encounter fresh.
Boss Battles: Test your mettle against powerful alien bosses that demand every ounce of strategy and dodging ability.
Difficulty adjustments: Three difficulty modes that adapt to each player.
Fun achievements: Unlock them by exploiting enemy mechanics.

title: Deus Mantle
description:
게임 정보
Deus Mantle is a progression-based survival sandbox, where you find yourself exploring infinite procedurely-generated worlds full of danger and mystery.
Get prepared to face dangerous creatures to fulfill the will of the gods, and through these hardships you may just find your way home.
Every biome has unique materials you can gather and unique challenges to overcome!
Find tasty chilli peppers in Sandy Desert, dig up snowballs in Snowy Forest and get lost in Deep Forest looking for those precious berries.
Advance through technology tree, unlocking different items, buildings and game mechanics.

title: The Tale of Azu
description:
게임 정보
특징
🌿 신화 세계로의 모험 - 현실과 신화를 넘나드는 신비로운 모험 속에서 색다른 세계를 탐험하세요
🐾 고양이의 액션 - 민첩한 움직임과 다채로운 스킬로 펼쳐지는 귀엽고 역동적인 액션
🐺 성장과 강화 - 아즈를 훈련하고 강화하여, 모험 속의 강력한 적들과 맞서세요
🎭 감동적인 스토리 - 잃어버린 누나 고양이를 향한 아즈의 가슴 따뜻한 여정을 함께하세요
줄거리
대한민국 어딘가, 아직 어린티를 완전히 벗지 못한 소년 고양이, 아즈가 살고 있다.
아즈는 세상에서 가장 행복한 고양이였다.
누나 고양이 모카가 곁을 떠나기 전까지는...
모카는 아즈의 둘도 없는 동료이자, 아즈에게 고양이로서 살아가는 법을 가르쳐준 스승이었다.
그런 모카가 떠난 이후, 아즈는 마음 어딘가가 빈 것만 같아 견딜 수가 없었다.
집사는 모카가 무지개 다리를 건너서 먼 곳으로 떠나버렸다고,
그래서 이제는 아즈가 자기를 지켜줘야 한다고 했다.
집사를 지키는 것 쯤이야 별 문제 없었지만, 아즈는 궁금해서 참을 수가 없었다.
항상 함께였던 모카가, 자신을 두고 가버린 무지개 다리란 곳은 어떤 곳일까.
그렇게 말도 없이 갑작스레 떠나버릴만큼, 신나는 곳일까.
자신도 그 곳에 가면 모카를 다시 만날 수 있을까…
궁금증은 모카와 함께했던 기억들이 옅어져갈수록, 그 자리를 대신하려는 듯이 강렬해졌다.
그래서 어느 날, 아즈는 모카를 찾아, 무지개 다리를 찾아 떠나기로 결심한다.
아즈가 알고 있는 가장 똑똑한 존재인 까마귀 아저씨조차도,
무지개 다리가 어디에 위치한지는 알지 못했다.
그래도 아즈는 무지개 다리를 찾아야만 했다. 내일 해가 뜨면 무작정 밖으로 나가보기로 했다.
어디로 갈까, 그런데 어떻게 밖에 나갈까. 모르겠다. 일단 든든하게 밥을 많이 먹어두자...
이런저런 생각을 하다 보니 어느새 아즈는 잠이 들고 만다.
그리고 눈을 떠보니, 낯선 대지 위였다.
당신은 집사로서 아즈가 이 모험을 완수하고, 모카와 재회할 수 있도록 도와야합니다.

title: Secret of the Abbey
description:
게임 정보
This is an atmospheric first-person game set in the 18th century. The game is filled with various puzzles that players must solve to progress through the storyline and unlock new locations. The puzzles vary in complexity and diversity.
In addition to puzzles, many notes can be found in the locations, revealing past events and helping to immerse players in the game's atmosphere. By collecting all the notes, the player will uncover the full story of what is happening.
The game emphasizes atmosphere and immersion, achieved through photorealistic environments, sound effects, and animations.

title: Chronicles of Fear: The Babysitter's Tale
description:
게임 정보


크로니클 오브 피어는 점프스캐어나 다른 싸구려 트릭이 없는 공포 게임을 만드는 데 중점을 둔 시리즈입니다.

우리의 주요 목표는 공포 매뉴얼이 아닌 실제 이야기를 사용하여 플롯을 구축함으로써 믿을 수 있는 공포 설정을 만드는 것입니다. 플레이어가 찾을 수 있는 숨겨진 디테일로 가득한 인터랙티브한 환경을 제공합니다.

완료하는 데 약 1.5~2시간이 걸리는 짧은 게임입니다.
'워킹 시뮬레이터' 장르이지만 주변 환경과 상호작용하고 캐릭터와 대화할 수 있습니다.
게임플레이에는 점프스케이어가 없으며, 현실에 가깝기 때문에 다음과 같은 트리거가 포함되어 있습니다;
거미 공포증, 가족 트라우마, 밀실 공포증, 고소공포증, 폐쇄공포증, 폐쇄공포증





이웃이 외출하는 동안 아들을 돌봐줄 수 있는지 물어보는데, 몇 달러를 벌 수 있는 좋은 방법입니다. 이런 날 밤에 일어날 수 있는 최악의 일이 뭐겠어요? 한적한 빈집에서 TV 앞에서 간식을 먹으며 쉽게 돈을 버는 것이야말로 가장 재미있는 활동이기 때문입니다. 하지만 만일을 대비해 문을 꼭 잠그는 것은 잊지 마세요.
autokwd: Chronicles of Fear: The Babysitter's Tale

title: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe
description:
게임 정보
A third-person action video game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies in an anime style.
The world has been ravaged by a zombie apocalypse. Emilia, along with her friend and other students, will try to stay alive within the educational center while zombies lurk around every corner.
Waiting for help won't be the best option. The scarcity of medicine, food, and water will force them to venture outside as they seek help, but nothing will be so simple. They will encounter a city looted by other survivors, who, faced with the lack of resources, will opt for more ruthless actions.
Emilia and her companions' mental health will be threatened, facing psychological and emotional problems as they try to find moments of happiness in a desolate world, although happiness is fleeting in this dark and hostile world.
Will they be able to overcome adversity and preserve the remaining humanity, or will they succumb to the bleak fate that seems inevitable in this new post-apocalyptic world?
autokwd: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe

title: The Raptured
description:
게임 정보
SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT AND JOIN THE DISCORD COMMUNITY



The Raptured is a TPS horror survival video game that follows Fletcher in Still Pines, overrun by apparitions that stalk the player. Find out what happened to the town, and try not to be consumed by the treacherous hordes of the apparitions.

The Raptured is a narrative-driven videogame experience that is fictitiously set in the 1990s after the Cold War and immerses the audience in misconstrued reality. Two novice journalists meet together to investigate a dodgy tip from someone anonymous, but little do they know, they are stumbling into the illegal testing grounds of a dangerous PMC.

title: The Spiral
description:
게임 정보
The Spiral is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Explore the dungeon, find tools for your survival, and try to escape with your life.
Descend into Darkness
Explore an infinite dungeon with randomized layouts, items, and enemies. No two playthroughs are the same.
Find Powerful Equipment
Make use of the dungeon's bounty to survive. Simple farming tools, legendary weapons, curious potions, and enchanted charms are all at your disposal.
Fight for Your Life
You are not alone. Monsters, nightmares, and other desperate wanderers like you all call the dungeon home. Kill them before they kill you.

title: Dobbel Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
신비로운 저주가 땅을 지배한다…
마법의 충격파가 섬 전체를 휩쓸자, 모든 종류의 야생 동물이 괴물로 변해 지역 주민을 향해 저항하기 시작합니다… 파티를 모으고, 주사위를 굴리고, 섬을 가로질러 전투를 하며 강력한 저주를 완전히 끝내세요!

title: Scorched Warfare
description:
게임 정보
높은 하늘 위에서 균열이 서서히 펼쳐집니다.
성벽 아래에서는 수많은 군대가 성문을 뚫고 들어옵니다.
당신은 제국의 장군이 되어 분쟁의 시작점으로 돌아가, 모든 것을 근본적으로 바꾸려 합니다...
부대를 지휘하며 전투
다양한 부대와 함께 싸우며, 중세 판타지 전장을 몰입감 있게 체험하세요.
전술 모드
직접 적을 물리칠 뿐만 아니라, 전술 모드에서 모든 부대에 대해 세부적인 계획을 세울 수 있습니다.
Roguelite 부대 구성
게임을 진행하면서 독창적인 부대 빌드를 구성하며, 다양한 전투 스타일을 경험해 보세요!
영웅 성장
게임 진행에 따라 영웅은 강력한 기술들을 연속적으로 해금합니다.

title: NeuroSquad - Slay the Horde
description:
게임 정보

NeuroSquad is a Bullet Heaven / Action Roguelite game, where you can design your own guns by building them up modularly. Summon a group of holographic soldiers who fight alongside you as you control the whole squad!
In this game no upgrade is tied to a specific weapon, you can freely choose which gun gets which modifications.


Choose from a wide variety of pickups and upgrades! Customize your own attacks and discover powerful synergies! Set up your auto-attacking soldiers using neuro-implants. Summon them, make them stronger, turn them into killing machines!









Humanity is in the process of stepping out of the biological era. Brain enhancement, neural chips, and other body augmentations are part of this new reality. But a change this drastic was never going to happen without conflict and catastrophes.

Now it's your turn to face their hordes. The latest weapon types, such as the laser shotgun and biosense mines, as well as augmentations like the cyber aura will help you become stronger and wipe out the AI bots.

With each death you become more powerful. Each night is a new opportunity to save the future.

title: Dark Age Dinos
description:
게임 정보
Travel alone or with friends through the land of Cretacia - a land of war, banditry and dinosaurs. Each mission is a short, self-contained journey with its own enemies, ability combinations, loot and objectives. Your friend can't make it tonight? They can join you on the next mission tomorrow without getting left behind. Or you can strike out on your own. We get it, not everybody wants to share the power and glory.
Every mission is different and not every journey ends in victory. You'll recruit new characters with each outing, so even defeat has its upside. What are you waiting for? Cretacia isn't going to save itself!

title: The House In The Hollow
description:
게임 정보
"The House In The Hollow"는 공포와 신비, 마법이 어우러져 진정한 몰입감과 스릴을 선사하는 1인칭 어드벤처 게임입니다.

플레이어는 Aloysius Abadier가 되어 100년 전 사라진 악명 자자한 오컬티스트 Francis Barrett의 미스터리를 풀어야 합니다.

외딴곳에 떨어진 잊혀진 숲으로 모험을 떠나면 신비로운 의식과 고대의 유물, 강력한 마법이 가득한 어둡고 뒤틀린 세계를 발견할 수 있습니다. 버려진 저택을 탐험하면서 숨겨진 비밀과 고대 유물, 강력한 주문을 찾아보세요. 하지만 조심하세요. 어떤 일이 있어도 비밀이 드러나고 여러분이 탈출하는 걸 막으려 하는 어둠의 힘이 기다립니다.

오컬트 지식과 결단력을 발휘하여 미스터리를 풀고 골짜기를 탈출해야 하는 이 게임은 1인칭 탐험과 퍼즐, 발견 요소가 독특하게 어우러진 것이 특징입니다.

이야기 -

프랜시스 바렛은 영국의 마술사이자 오컬티스트로, 구석진한 생활을 살며 외딴 저택에서 대부분의 시간을 보냈습니다.

산중턱에 자리한 숲으로 둘러싸인 이 집은 세상에 알려지지 않은 숨겨진 곳이었습니다.

프랜시스 바렛에 대해 알려진 것은 오컬트와 마법 정보의 천체 지능체와 총합인 The Magus를 저술한 것 이외에는 거의 없습니다.

프랜시스 바렛이 사라진 이후 많은 해가 지나도록, 사람들은 바렛씨의 신비한 집을 찾으려 하지만 성공하지 못했습니다.

프랜시스 바렛이 집에서 수행한 실험, 또는 무엇을 호출했는지에 대해서는 아무도 확신할 수 없습니다.

집을 찾으러 간 사람들 중에는 돌아오지 않은 사람들도 있습니다.


잊을 수 없는 모험을 시작하세요. 현실적인 환경의 세계에 1인칭 시점으로 몰입하여 전에 경험해보지 않은 방식으로 골짜기를 탐험하세요.

하지만 명심하세요. 진행이 쉽지는 않을 겁니다. 골짜기를 둘러싼 깊은 미스터리를 밝히려면 문제를 해결하고 탐험에 참여해야 하거든요.



실감 나는 게임 세계를 창조하려고 의상과 인테리어 피팅 및 비품에 물리학을 적용했기 때문에 플레이어가 정말 환경의 일부가 된 것처럼 느낄 수 있을 것입니다.

플레이어가 게임 속 세계를 돌아다니는 동안 환경 및 애셋 입자 효과는 사실성을 높여 모든 나뭇잎과 가지를 자연스럽고 진짜처럼 보이게 하는 전체 바람 애니메이션 등의 디테일 하나하나를 정확하고 실감 나게 표현합니다.



몰입도를 더 높이기 위해 물리학을 바탕으로 렌더링된 물질로 멀티 텍스처링을 사용하여 현실적으로 보이고 느껴지는 세상을 만들었습니다.

또한 라이트 섀프트, 템포럴 안티앨리어싱, 톤 매핑 등 게임의 고급 시각 요소는 매끄러운 시네마틱 경험을 제공합니다.



The House In The Hollow는 독특한 장소와 아르데코 디자인, 고급 색상 보정, 앰비언트 오클루전, 실시간 레이 트레이싱 기능을 한데 묶어 풍부하고 몰입감 있는 경험을 선사합니다.

title: Two Weeks Game
description:
게임 정보
Two Weeks Game is a story based simple action-adventure game taking place in social narrative horror environment.
The plot:
Underground hacker crew fights day and night to uncover conspiracies. Nikolay and his comrades heard that city is invaded by neko youkai mind-flayer. Muhosransk Valley is an experimental government zone where epic fail took place. To make people flee from overpopulated town the visual novel contest was used. Nikolay must find proofs of earth, fire, water and wind to stop visual novel contest from going to another stage.
Game includes:
49 NPC characters
Muhosransk Valley that have multiple towns and dungeons
Evil neko youkai mind-flayer that uses Samozbor dimension to roam free through Valley
Fully voiced dialogues
Your faithful comrades you always can call and they rally up to help you find proofs

title: NUMANUIN Clicker
description:
게임 정보

NUMANUIN Clicker - just a Clicker, no more! Click, Click, Click and Click! ...and one more Click!

Features:
100% Free!
Windowed mode
Ability to off\on sound
Ability to mouse click
Short duration
Mouse control
Dark interface
Just Click!

title: Memento Dawn
description:
게임 정보
Memento Dawn is a colorful puzzle game in which we can control the light and shadow to help the girl find a way to get back her memories.
A PUZZLE GAME FOR WHOLESOME EXPERIENCE.
Follow the girl's journey through a beautiful land where her memories are kept and help her answer the hidden mysteries.
UNIQUE BUT SIMPLE MECHANIC FOR EVERYONE.
Manipulate light and shadow to create a path for the girl to go through the darkness. Collect memories to unfold a lovely story.

title: Whimsical Heroes
description:
게임 정보


In a land once flowing with milk and honey, resources suddenly began to run out. Sensing the impending end of the world as they knew it, the three heroes embark on a journey through unknown lands to uncover the mystery behind this life-sustaining energy crisis.

Conquer all in tactical, turn-based battles set on a hexagonal grid. Lead a team of cartoon heroes - the brave bean explorer, the fluffy cat defender, and the onion musician from distant realms - through a series of adventures in Whimsical Heroes!

title: Rebirth of Arcadia
description:
게임 정보
전략적인 턴제 전투
최대 5명의 캐릭터를 조작하며, 전략적인 포지셔닝과 이동, 그리고 통제 지역(ZOC)을 활용해 적을 혼란에 빠뜨리세요. 액션 포인트(AP)를 현명하게 사용하고, 상황에 따라 강력한 콤보를 만들어 여러 적을 공격하거나 방어를 강화하세요.
스킬 변환 시스템
전장에서 원소 에너지를 활용하여 스킬의 잠재력을 끌어내고, 전투 중 일시적으로 더 강력한 능력으로 변환할 수 있습니다.
캐릭터 커스터마이징
쓰러뜨린 적에게서 유전자를 모아 패시브 스킬을 획득하고, 룬스톤 시스템을 통해 캐릭터의 스킬을 강화하며 전략에 맞춰 추가 효과를 부여하세요.
심연 탐험
스토리 전투를 통해 심연의 미스터리를 풀고, 무작위로 생성된 스테이지에서 싸워 캐릭터를 강화하세요.



심연이라 불리는 깊은 구덩이에 떨어져 목숨을 잃은 소년 솔로몬. 그러던 중, 용의 팔을 가진 미스터리한 인물 루비누스와 그의 파트너 에스메랄다가 솔로몬의 비참한 시신을 발견합니다. 그들은 고향 아르카디아의 룬스톤 기술을 이용해 심연에 대해 더 많이 알기 위해 솔로몬을 되살리기로 합니다.

자신들이 있는 장소에 대한 지식이 부족하다는 것을 깨달은 두 사람은 위험한 생물과 거대한 육식 동물이 배회하는 미지의 영역으로 발을 들여놓습니다. 두 사람은 이 위험한 환경에서 목숨을 걸고 싸워 지상으로 돌아가는 방법을 찾아야 합니다.

title: Halberd Black
description:
게임 정보
Halberd Black is an action-adventure JRPG set thousands of years into the future of our galaxy, where you play as a Stark, a genetically engineered human being caught in a struggle to survive and protect those he holds most dear from those who'd wish him harm. Explore the rich story of the Halberd Black universe and explore the beautiful landscapes, and dense city streets and enjoy combat reminiscent of the JRPGs of old ( With a Modern Twist ). Fight a wide variety of enemies using a dynamic turn-based combat system. Explore new environments as you seek strength to fight back against the powerful megacorporation that is after you and your friends. Only through grit and determination will you be able to fight against the threats that are coming your way. The only question is, do you have what it takes?

title: Betroyal
description:
게임 정보
Betroyal is a fast-paced roguelite turn-based tactical game, that took best from roguelike tactics genre. Pass through regions full of encounters, hire and upgrade units, get epic perks, abilities and items fro your commander and kill all bosses. And again, but with crazy build that you always wanted to try.

Build up your camp to draft more powerful and rare units, and unlock new perks for the protagonist.

The sheer variety of tactical and strategic options makes Betroyal a true treat for any ardent fans of the roguelite genre.
Core Features:

Hundreds of builds for your commander from classic to the most insane
A new look at a turn-based combat system
Three regions with procedural generations of encounters
50+ units, including Meat Wagon and Swine Lord, to hire and upgrade with more than 200 individual abilities
Camp building to unlock devastating possibilities
Narrative image of father-daughter relationships without tons of texts
Classic tactics and roguelite features, including numerous commander builds, procedural map generation, and high replay value

title: Master of Luna
description:
게임 정보
Master of Luna is a turn-based strategy game where you take the role of a half-forgotten deity seeking to regain their former power and ascend once again.
Multi-Layered Strategy

There's a lot of things happening all around. Cities grow and spread out across the map. Heroes gain levels and change classes. You learn new spells and expand your domain. AI opponents lurk in the dark. In the midst of it all, you must find a path to victory.

Besides the world map, the game has tactical combat, where you have to masterfully outmaneuver the enemy. Or just summon a bunch of creatures, that works as well.
Melancholic Vibe

Luna is a world of eternal twilight, illuminated by the blue light of two moons and shrouded in thick mist. Dreams and memories mean a lot in this place.

The world has gone through many cycles of sleep and awakening. It’s ancient, so there are lot of mysteries, shattered ruins, heroes of old and eldritch artifacts.
Respectful Attitude

Master of Luna respects its players. You make few decisions, but they matter a lot. There is no micromanagement or tedious tasks. Feedback is instantaneous. At no point you supposed to just hit “End Turn” over and over waiting for some bar to fill up. Creatures have few abilities, yet they are tangible. UI is straightforward and uses the same scheme for world and combat. Important information is explained in tooltips.

title: Ironsand
description:
게임 정보
여러분은 은하 연합의 최고의 특수 부대입니다. 여러분의 임무는 Long-eared의 사막 행성에 착륙하여 Iron God 컬트 추종자로부터 그들을 보호하는 것입니다. 여러분의 길에 있는 모든 적을 파괴하세요. 주요 임무는 거대한 타이탄 전투 로봇을 찾아 파괴하는 것입니다. 그리고 모래를 주시하는 것을 잊지 마세요. 모래 아래에는 사이보그보다 더 무서운 생물이 숨어 있을 수 있습니다
최대 4명까지 협동 가능
친구들과 함께 XBS-87 행성의 위험한 생물들과 싸워보세요! 전략을 개발하고, 다양한 기술과 무기를 사용하고, 플레이 스타일을 혼합하고, Iron God 숭배의 잔인한 추종자들로부터 은하계를 구출하세요
독특한 게임플레이
여러분의 팀은 적 도시를 점령하고 타이탄을 파괴하기 위해 5 번의 시도를 해야 하며, 각 시도 후에 파워업을 선택합니다. 5 번 실패하면 처음부터 다시 시작

title: Chyss
description:
게임 정보
Chyss is a turnbased, tactical 1vs1 game based on chess.
You can move, attack, and consume your mana to spells and use items when it's your turn.
Your goal is to destroy your opponent's Leader!

The year is 12022.
Number of civilisations evolved from primitive life to being able to travel the universe.
In this universe, a game has evolved to become essential: The Chyss.

The Chyss has its roots in chess, but many have added to the rules in order to create its successor. A timeless, universal, and balanced game, allowing interplanetary competition, where fair play, game intelligence and risk-taking are the traits of legendary players.
Young children want to become great Chyss players, the vast majority of adults play, whether to have fun, relax, explore the possibilities, or to pursue their childhood dreams.

In this universe, a phenomenon affects about a third of the people...
About a third of people become incarnates overnight. Falling asleep as themselves, they wake up controlled by different, higher forces.
These forces do not want their loss, but simply direct their steps, their actions.

You are this higher force which is going to take control of an inhabitant of this universe.
You, and all the other players of this video game...
You will embody an incarnate.

This incarnate is now you.
Your goal will be determined by you. You can become the best Chyss player in the universe, but there are many pitfalls along the way.
There are many extremely strong, clever players in this universe.
The best Chyss player in the universe is anonymous. She is only known as "The Galaxy Queen".
Good luck! And battle with pride.

title: Lamia's Bambina
description:
게임 정보
Train the best, most powerful Lamias!
WORLD
In an impoverished demon world ravaged by the war between man and beast, the Lamia tribe are on the verge of extinction.

Ivy, reincarnated into the demon world as the Lamia tribe's savior, along with princess Hedera aim for the revival of their tribe. Play as Ivy as you multiply and raise Lamias and battle the Harpy tribe to reclaim the Lamia Palace.
DUNGEONS
Battles take place in demon world dungeons with familiar 2D maps. Explore the dungeons again and again and defeat the bosses waiting in their depths.
Classic command-style turn-based battles. The key to good battle strategy is to form your party to take advantage of each Lamia's characteristics, choosing from Lamias skilled at physical attacks to those specializing in magic attacks. Lead your Lamias to victory.
Not only will you find Lamias, but you'll also see Harpies, Fairies, and other familiar monsters complete with up-tempo*** conversations and stories in an enjoyable pixel art demon world.

The Lamia training system is scheduled to be released in Summer 2024, when Japan is scorching hot.

Don't miss the latest Lamia's Bambina ("LamiBam") information!

title: The Bugs Manor 🦋
description:
게임 정보

The Bugs Manor is a free top-down 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay focused on direct interactions with the environment.



The haunted house is full of dangerous creatures, you will need to use the stealth and your wits to escape, but be careful, because if you fail, a bloody death waits for you.



Can you overcome the enigmatic challenges of the manor? Solve multiple puzzles through inventory-free gameplay. This allows you to interact directly with the environment and items without the interruption of annoying menus.



Uncover the dark secrets of the evil Bugs home and its numerous rooms. Follow the story of Danny, a kid who has just moved into the house and is spending his first night there alone. But maybe he's not as alone as he believes...

title: Dicey Birdball
description:
게임 정보
Dicey Birdball is a roguelike strategy sports game where you manage a team of birds playing football. Roll dice and assign them to your birds to maneuver, score goals, and win the championship. Enact leaguewide rule changes to evolve the sport of Birdball, from increasing the size of the field to summoning iceberg obstacles to touchdown teleportation.

Each run you'll take control of a different team with their own unique story and objective. Win enough matches to make it to the championship and fulfill the team's objective. Between matches you'll make decisions to improve the team such as gaining new abilities, drafting new dice, and enacting new rules.

Feature List:
Compete in turn-based, grid-based football matches using a team of up to 3 birds from 5 different classes.
Manage a team of different bird classes, each with their own unique set of abilities.
Spend seeds on new dice to increase the number of moves you can make each turn.
Guide the evolution of the sport by choosing which rules change over time, such as expanding the field and allowing alternate scoring mechanism.
Unlock new teams with different bird combinations to play with.
Unlock the ability to create your own team with custom colors and team composition.

title: Sacred Constellars: Ruin Raiders
description:
게임 정보
Ruin Raiders, a daring few who risk everything to explore ancient second-era tombs. With the promise of great rewards, they unearth relics of immense power, remnants of a bygone era. The Church of Eion strives to secure these artifacts, sealing them away in heavily guarded vaults. Yet, some relics slip through, disrupting the status quo. This is one such story....
Charming 2D Pixel Art Style.
Master tactics to overcome many battles.
Unique boss fights that are more than just HP sponges or enemies that simply hit harder.
Interact with a fleshed out and unique world that melds fantasy and elements of science fiction.
Create bonds with your fellow party members. Up to twelve interesting characters.
20+ hour story rich role playing campaign.

title: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara
description:
게임 정보
It all starts with Captain Disaster answering a distress call from a mysterious ship... but it ends up with a planet desperate to rekindle its geothermal energy source, and the long-lasting legacy of an intergalactic empire long consigned to the history books. The planet houses a secret that none of its inhabitants are aware of...

Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara features a contextual one-click interface, a host of colourful characters, devious puzzles, detailed cartoon style graphics, full voicing and an original soundtrack. You play as the adventurous but not altogether bright eponymous Captain, aided (sometimes) by your ship's computer, Zero-Bit, as you help a race of aliens whose complex history is largely unknown, even to themselves.



This game is a collaboration between award-winning developers Dave Seaman (multiple AGS Awards for Captain Disaster in: Death Has A Million Stomping Boots & other games) and Lorenzo Boni (winner of the $106 Adventure Game Challenge for Where Did the Humans Go? and an AGS Award). These two amiable lunatics have been point & click adventure game fans for many years and they have collaborated previously on small games and even a children's book, but nothing approaching the scale and scope of this new Captain Disaster game!

(Playing the two previous Captain Disaster games is not necessary for this one, although there will be some references to events in the earlier games, and even a returning character from Stomping Boots...)

The soundtrack is being composed by , a recent finalist in the , whose previous work includes the OST for .

Making this game together has been a real joy and we hope that comes across in the game, and we sincerely hope you have as much fun playing it as we are having making it. , without revealing much in terms of the game's overall theme. If you find the demo a little bit too easy, don't worry - we deliberately made it reasonably simple, bigger challenges await in the full game.



It's absolutely designed to be enjoyed by all ages! The storyline contains complex themes and some of the puzzles will definitely challenge all but the most hardened point-and-clickers (I'm talking about people who completed games like Monkey Island 2, The Dig and Lucy's Dreaming without ever resorting to hints!!), but at the same time it will always contain humour and animation to delight younger players. Naturally some references in the game will require a certain knowledge of adventure games, sci-fi shows and movies, etc, but these are not essential to playing the game or solving the puzzles, just an added extra.



Have you managed to scroll all the way down to the bottom of this description? Congratulation! You must be tired...
