title: Play Rough
description:
게임 정보
THE WORLD
A hundred years in the future, the dregs of the human race struggle to survive in a contradictory world of VIOLENCE, MAGIC, and LIVING CARTOONS.
Guide the sheltered psychic Beau Chartreuse in a turn-based RPG journey through the ruins of California, meeting strange assets and stranger enemies. A world where brutality reigns supreme and kindness is never easy… A world that frays at the edges, allowing something wonderful in!
THE PARTY
All of this is a lot for just you and Beau, so it’s good that you’ve got some strong allies on your side!
Oh, I’m sorry. It’s just a fox and an old man. They’re both bitter and full of regrets, but who isn’t? I’m sure that Valentine and Dr. Woland will have their uses.
Or they may stab you in the back. You can never be sure of people, these days. Best not to get too attached.
THE OPPOSITION
Men and women, clowns and dreams and cartoons and nightmares! This world is full of things that will want to take your money, your life, or something worse.
With every enemy a unique encounter, it’s up to you to decide exactly how much you’re willing to bite off!
Will you blaze through the world, hunting for every enemy while putting your party’s health at risk? Or will you cautiously hoard your money and food for those foes you can’t avoid?

title: Look Locked
description:
게임 정보
"Look Locked": A co-op puzzle game where doors only open, if you can see them being opened. Work together, time your actions, and communicate to unravel challenges. Coordination and observation lead to victory!
 
 Two Player Co-Op
Unique Puzzles
Challenging Gameplay
 
The effect of each of your actions will only take place for the other player if they have seen that action.
 
More content will be added with updates, and with the later coming "Level-Editor" the fun won't stop!

title: Storefront Simulator
description:
게임 정보
The morning sun spills through the storefront windows, painting the aisles with golden light.
The doors swing open, a flood of eager shoppers surges through, looking for their favorite foods and household goods.
The constant ring of the cash register means more money, which means you can invest in a bigger building, more inventory, new equipment, new employees.
Have you got the grit, the vision, and the determination to keep growing your brand?
Storefront Simulator features a full building editor – so you can lay the foundation, design the floor plan, install the shelves and checkout machines, and create a retail shopping experience of your very own.
Design a store that's as cozy as a corner café or as expansive as an open air market. Your imagination is the only limit.
From there, you’re in charge:
Become a master of inventory. Negotiate deals, stock shelves with hot commodities, and find out your best proven money-makers.
Grab your friends and get ready to grow your retail empire together! Join forces with up to 3 other players to build the ultimate shopping experience. Collaborate with your squad to design the perfect layout, manage inventory like pros, and keep your customers as happy as clams. Whether you're dividing and conquering tasks or working side-by-side for maximum efficiency, teamwork makes the dream work (and the profits soar!)

title: Mozi
description:
게임 정보
먼 은하계에, 모자성이라는 신비한 행성이 숨어 있습니다. 이 행성은 광활한 바다를 가지고 있어 인류에게 끝없는 상상력을 불러일으킵니다. 은하 탐험대의 공학사로서, 나는 모자성에서 기지를 확장하는 중대한 책임을 지고 있으며, 인류의 별계열 식민지화를 위한 확고한 한 걸음을 내디뎌지고 있습니다.

title: Table Flip Simulator
description:
게임 정보

Table Flip Simulator is your route to a zen-like calm, as you smash things in the most satisfying ways the gaming medium can offer. Even better, you get points to unlock dozens of costumes for the most imaginative and clever chaos you can muster – what can be better than that? (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻

Ruin Many Slices of Life
Make coffee as a barista, throw popcorn at a movie theatre, and toss a desk as a high school teacher. Table Flip Simulator brings players to mundane everyday situations where you can wreck the world with big flip energy!

Game Physics the Way They’re Supposed to Be
At the heart of Table Flip Simulator is choice, you can mess up a location however you see fit. Not only do varied items behave in different ways, but an assortment of quirky characters including a VR addict who wears their headset outside, a party loving vampire, and a couple looking for a quiet place for a romantic date are there for your destructive pleasure. Experiment with items and targets to trigger awesome reactions and rack up points.




Each stage will give you different tasks and optional objectives if you want to get the best scores. Fulfil orders the right way in a coffee shop, figure out how to get the party really started in a nightclub, show your leadership and gravitas when wrecking a not-Oval political office, and more. A wide range of stages will get you thinking outside of, and then destroying, the box.


Show your mastery of throwing in battles of world-shaking importance. Tussle with a college professor and knockout a kaiju in which you throw and break things in an even more epic fashion.


Experiment and master the mechanics, stages and boss fights to set high scores in a title that will continue to evolve.

title: Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop
description:
게임 정보


"Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop" is an adventure pixel art indie game with platformer and puzzle elements. You will play as Ponchee the bunny, who finds herself on an uninhabited planet called FlopHop. She has no memories except for current events, and her teacher and friend becomes her spacesuit Usagi-01, which tells her about the past, the future, and her destiny.


Gameplay
In the world of FlopHop, you will experience an exciting story told through quests and lore, during which you will be engaged in platforming gameplay: Ponchee must protect capsules with plants to eventually green the planet. You will also encounter many puzzles of various kinds that will stand in Ponchee's way as she learns about the history of the world, the universe, and her home planet.


Why is Ponchee alone on this planet? Who created Usagi-01? What happened to her home planet, and how did she end up on FlopHop? Ponchee will uncover all this together with our players! But this journey of discovery might not be so sweet – along the way, there will be many disappointments, moments of loneliness, contemplation, and reflection.

title: Hiragana Hero
description:
게임 정보
Learn to read, recognize, and use hiragana as you are guided by Keen Reflex through a 35-floor ever-changing labyrinth in an addictive and educational dungeon crawler RPG!
Learning to read hiragana is the first step in your Japanese learning journey, and it's the first hurdle that learners struggle to get over.
This addictive RPG dungeon crawler will have you reading Japanese in record time without all that boring study.
After deciding to learn Japanese, you're introduced to Keen Reflex, an online streamer who teaches viewers Japanese with his experience as a professional Japanese translator and with his JLPT N1 Japanese fluency. When you go to watch his stream, though, you are mysteriously teleported INSIDE the Japanese learning game Keen is playing. You find yourself in a magical land filled with creatures called hiragana that can only be defeated by shouting their name. The only way out seems to be to make your way through puzzles and hoards of hiragana, leveling up your stats and your reading comprehension along the way!

title: Laundry Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Take control of an abandoned laundry and try to win the recognition of the town's residents!
Clear the room of debris and arrange it as you wish. Buy washing machines, dryers, ironing machines and everything that will help you become No. 1 in this business.
Repair equipment, monitor the levels of liquids and powders in devices. Unlock new business functions such as dry cleaning, washing and others.

title: Refugees: Shelter
description:
게임 정보
Game Play
Collect all the materials that can be used for survival, and build a workbench that can produce sustainable materials. You can choose to help other refugees to tide over the difficulties, or keep the materials for yourself to ensure your own safety.
You can use different equipment, such as bulletproof vests and helmets to enhance your character's defense capabilities.
Get through times of material scarcity by producing and manufacturing daily necessities.
On rainy days, the hearing of hostile NPCs will decrease, but the player's physical strength will decrease faster when outdoors, which usually happens in summer.
When there is snow on the ground, the footsteps of the player outdoors will increase (which means that hostile NPCs can hear your footsteps more easily), and the player's physical strength will decrease faster, which is a more difficult weather situation.
In general, the player has only one goal, which is to survive until the day when peace (truce) comes. The player can choose to help other refugees or not.
The player can even fight other refugees to get supplies.
In the first version, there will only be one character for players to choose from. But I did consider adding different characters, for example, a character with a doctor background will recover from injuries faster, a security guard will have longer lasting stamina, etc.
If new characters are added in subsequent versions, my plan is to update them for free.
Story Background
A premeditated war broke out overnight, accompanied by deafening explosions and raging fires. The once bustling city was instantly plunged into panic and chaos, its former tranquility shattered and replaced by cries of terror and the wreckage of buildings.
Before this war, no one believed that this political struggle would ultimately lead to armed conflict. People's confidence in peace caught them off guard, and many had no time to escape, hurriedly taking refuge in bomb shelters, praying to survive this disaster. These bomb shelters, built 80 years ago, have witnessed the changes of history and now once again serve as sanctuaries for people.
About me
Hello, everyone. This game is a Solo-Indie Game. It has not yet entered the promotion stage because I have too much work to complete.

title: Sheep Seeker
description:
게임 정보
You’re not a shepherd—you’re an athlete! Team up with a friend or ride solo and speed through dynamic, fast-paced levels, herding sheep in a futuristic medieval competition. Explode, Teleport, Warp to enhance your parkour skills and outmaneuver the flock. Compete for the top spot on the global leaderboard—because in this world, catching sheep is the ultimate test of speed and skill!
Features:
COOP RACE
You and your friends have been handpicked to compete in the prestigious Sheep Seeker World Tournament, where only the best can seek out the hidden sheep across dynamic levels.
SOLO GAMEMODE
You can also play solo and compete against players from around the world!

게임 정보
∆ is an atmospheric first-person exploration game that takes you on a journey to the Beyond - a time/space singularity that can only be accessed through a hidden door inside a dream.

[Features]

Modern graphics and immersive sound design, powered by Unreal Engine 5.
Combines exploration, mind-bending puzzle and platforming elements.
A dreamy, ominous atmosphere.
Horror elements without relying on jump scares.
Approximately 2-3 hours of playtime.

[Story]

Declassified documents from a secret research project reveal that the dream realm is physical in nature and consists of multiple layers.
While regular and lucid dreams occur near the surface, deeper layers constitute a shared reality and can only be accessed by specially trained agents and mystics or by the means of deep space travel.
It is hypothesized that at the bottom of the labyrinth lies a passage to the Beyond - a time/space singularity transcendental to human understanding.

title: 伥影重生 Ghost:Reborn
description:
게임 정보
Game Introduction
"Ghost:Reborn" is a 2D pixel horizontal action game with a Chinese cyber theme. While wandering in the world, players use the dual identities of demon-slayer and assassin killer to jump through different scenes, discover the truth of the broken world, and repair the broken order.
Game Background
Since when, people who have lost their history have gradually been alienated into henchmen. Henchmen no longer have self-awareness, but numbly seek the memory or consciousness of others to feed on. They have vague memories of the vivid memories of the past, and vaguely believe that they can return to the beautiful past as long as they eat the consciousness of others. But this is just a temporary solution. Over time, more and more people have become henchmen. Henchmen no longer have hope for the present and the future, leading to the irreversible decline of civilization...

title: The Final Fragment
description:
게임 정보
“Believe in yourself!”, “Follow your heart!”, “Trust your gut!”. The modern world always preaches about self-discovery, self-realization and self- anything, really. But nobody explains how to find that fickle and unreachable 'self' everyone seems to treat like the ultimate answer to the greatest puzzle called life. Is it a journey you need, as they say, to take on yourself?

These musings torment Nina, a melancholic student at the Olha Kobylianska Arts Academy.

Answers run away from her, hiding behind all sorts of mundane troubles: how to hide a crush on that one perfect girl she shares a dorm room with, deal with an eccentric ex-friend and choose a major for her next year at college? And, most importantly, what does her submission for the upcoming academy’s art exhibition desperately lack?

But a mysterious incident at the exhibiton tears apart Nina’s safe and uneventful life, forcing her to confront everything she's been running away from…

Length: ~20k words, approximately 2 hours of reading



Experience a cozy coming-of-age tale filled with emotion and mystery
Dive into the painterly atmosphere of the arts academy drawn by Valentyna Olefirenko
Listen to your inner voice and choose what feels right
Find the last missing piece of Nina’s scattered sense of self

title: Imperium
description:
게임 정보
In Imperium, you play as a Paladin either solo or as a team of 4, pitted against the hordes of a necromantic cult; you are tasked with defending various fortresses in a grand fantasy war. Arm yourself with spells, build wards to repel evil, and fight to the bitter end.
Experience Unrelenting action, with combat inspired by 90's shooters and Dungeon Crawling Classics.
Wield an arsenal of both magic and melee weapons simultaneously. Combine both to discover new combos and strategies.
Access new Potions, Cantrips, Spells and Melee Weapons during play.
Enchant your weapons to deliver even more radiant justice.
Drink potions to unlock bonuses for use during a run.

title: Transfer
description:
게임 정보
From the same Team that made Solitude Underwater!
We present a FNAF-FPS Train Horror Adventure game!
Info
The apocalypse came and went and mutated all the animals into vicious monstrosities. The surviving people hide from these bloodthirsty beasts behind the tall, thick walls of their towns.
You are Blake O’Grady, a convict who’s agreed to become a train conductor for a chance at freedom. Your train’s not that fast, not that strong, and its route winds through all the deadliest parts of the no-man’s-land between towns.
Transfer vital supplies to each of the towns. Keep your train chugging along through every danger. Do what it takes to survive the mutant-infested wilds. And beware of The One, which is strongest of all…
Key Features
Transfer Supplies to every Town
Defend your Train from various mutated creatures
Upgrade your Gear and Weapon
Help the Townsfolk with Stealth missions outside the comforts of the Train and the Town's protection for a reward
Drive A Train Locomotive (with a train whistle)
WARNING: PHOTOSENSITIVITY/EPILEPSY SEIZURES - READ THIS NOTICE BEFORE PLAYING
A very small percentage of people may experience epileptic seizures or blackouts when exposed to certain kinds of flashing lights or light patterns. These persons, or even people who have no history of seizures or epilepsy, may experience epileptic symptoms or seizures while playing video games. If you or any of your relatives has an epileptic condition or has had seizures of any kind, consult your physician before playing any video game.
IMMEDIATELY DISCONTINUE use and consult a physician if you or your child experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions. Parents should watch for or ask their children about the above symptoms.

title: The Time Forgotten
description:
게임 정보
The Time Forgotten drops players into the heart of a stunningly realized, immersive world. Every dinosaur for itself. In this world there can only be one left standing; search for Evolution Points through exploration, combat, and major choices on your dinosaur. Shape your dinosaur's journey of evolution. Develop special abilities and traits that give you an edge over the foe in the match and earn your rightful place as KING.
Creation
First things first. You get to design your dream selected dinosaur (You customize each dinosaur in the game to your liking) You'll be able to choose the starting traits and what your dinosaur will look and be, but that's the very beginning. New skins, color schemes, and other fun cosmetics will be unlocked the further you level up your dinosaur. You develop your dinosaur's strengths and weaknesses through the use of a large array of different evolution paths in the evolution menu. From armored plates to swifter movement to heightened senses.
Evolution

title: Assassin Story
description:
게임 정보
You will play one of the six characters with different positions, missions and fighting methods, , and sneak into the armless and unpredictable Xianyang, the capital of the Qin Dynasty, to explore, collect, fight and grow in this historical wuxia punk world.
You need to reasonably plan the buildings and order of exploration within the time limit of 72 hours. The environment and content of each building may change according to the time and the triggering of some world events.
Face-to-face duel? Stealth assassination? Borrowing a knife to kill? Winning without fighting? Facing the enemy creature cards that have just entered the room and are covering the field, you can freely choose how to deal with them according to your deck construction and the room environment.

title: Space Diner Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Space Diner Simulator is a cozy diner management game where you will slowly grow your diner from a humble little place to a place with many workers.
Cook, clean, serve and unlock new recipes as you improve your diner with all kinds of different equipment.
Quality service is of the utmost importance in the hospitality service. Customers will complain if the food isn't on time or if it's not hot enough. So speed is greatly appreciated.
Cooking is a skill and as any skill over time it gets better. The more dishes you prepare, the better quality and price they will have. But don't be afraid to try all the different dishes.

title: Bunker Constructor Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Contracts
Fulfill contracts from the citizens of the city. Each contract is unique and requires careful consideration of all customer requirements. More complex orders bring more money. Make the client satisfied by fulfilling even the smallest wishes to receive all money earned and even a bonus.
 Construction
Build real underground bunkers that will allow to survive in the most terrible apocalypse. Each bunker must be placed at a particular depth to provide its residents with full protection. Show all your imagination and creativity – build multi-level complex bunkers.
 Building Materials
Buy the necessary building materials in various stores – construction, furniture, electronics store, and transport them to the construction site by your own car or pay for the delivery. All remaining materials can be sold or used in the next contract.
 Underground Bunkers
Build real protected underground bunkers. First, dig the shaft to the required depth. Arrange a convenient descent – build a ladder. Dig out a sufficient volume for constructing bunker. Build capital reinforced concrete floors, walls and ceilings to ensure the strength of the bunker. Build interior walls to organize different rooms and start arranging furniture.
 Interior
To be comfortable in the bunker, it must be furnished with comfortable and practical furniture. Each customer has their own preferences and requirements in interior design. Organize bedrooms, kitchens, workrooms, home theaters, gyms and other spaces.
 Licenses

title: The House of Toys
description:
게임 정보
The House of Toys is a game developed by Old School Bros, a duo of video game and horror genre enthusiasts.
The game's mission is to free the soul of the cursed toy, day after day, game after game. But be careful—each game can be different. You will earn rewards that make your work more satisfying, allow you to improve your room, and help you discover secrets.
The House of Toys is divided into several phases in each game.
Phase 1:
Investigate – Explore the mansion, searching for clues to help you identify the toy.
Phase 2:
Puzzles and Action – While avoiding the cursed toy, you’ll need to solve puzzles that grant you the power to free its soul.
Phase 3:
Stealth – You’ll need to be cautious and stealthy to use your new power and release the toy’s soul.
Do you dare to discover the true origin of the curse?

title: Arena Worker
description:
게임 정보


You are an arena worker. The battle arena needs several things to operate properly:

Medical and ammunition kits on the right spots
Clean horizontal surfaces for contestants to move around (not slippery)
Solid covers without holes for proper protection
Flags of opposite teams ready for capturing
And most importantly your readiness for adapting to ever-changing scenarios of this battle arena



Mr. Mood is hosting the greatest tournament in the universe. 16 teams will be contesting for enormous cash prizes and the title of champions of the battle arena. And you must be proud to help Mr. Mood to fulfill this extraordinary goal because your prize is freedom. However:

If you fail to maintain the arena properly - the tournament restarts
If you favor one team more and create an imbalance - the tournament restarts
If you die from a stray bullet - the tournament restarts



You are not alone in this never-ending tournament. With every successfully finished task, you gain some spare money and if you won't be able to spend it during the tournament it will be deposited in the Arena Worker Fund. This Fund is not just a bag for your extra cash it is a cool system that will help you to work more efficiently:








New tournament - new rules. The host is enjoying to watch every game, and to make it interesting Mr. Mood likes to refresh it:

title: E-Shop Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
"E-Shop Tycoon" is a game about managing an online shopping site in all aspects;
Create your own online shop
Hire new employees, expand your office, deal with cargo companies, advertise, buy new buildings, get ahead of other companies, increase your popularity and earn more.
Start in the garage and buy products from your computer. Sign a contract with a cargo company, build your own warehouse and sell products through your warehouse. Advertise your company to increase your prestige and increase your sales popularity. Sell in bigger places by reaching your targets.
Customize your office
Buy and place items in the office to keep your employees happy. Make your office more usable by buying new items. Customize your office by arranging it the way you want!
Grow and manage your company
Create new departments, upgrade your servers and warehouses or hire more employees to speed things up. Accept deals from other companies for more income!
New departments, new opportunities
Establish your own cargo company, cut the middle man and keep all the profits to yourself!
Found the Software Department to protect your site from hackers by providing a high level of cybersecurity. Return the favor, form shady deals with hackers to attack rival sites and destroy their prestige!
Deal with characters
Throughout the game, meet new characters and try to get along with them.
Your users are key to your success
Manage customer requests and gain prestige by keeping them happy. See how your company is doing on social media and react to the posts of customers and companies. Give interviews to media companies and increase your popularity.
Increase your sales by organizing campaigns and advertising activities. See the results of your advertisements and campaigns as sales results.

title: My Space Bar
description:
게임 정보
Build Your Space Station Bar
My Space Bar is a restaurant and attractions simulator where you build and manage a space station bar!



Expand your station. Build a dining area with tables, lights, and décor. Build a kitchen and hire staff. Make your space bar even more special by adding dance clubs, arcades, and more. The happier your customers are, the more space bucks they will spend!
Build Your Station

Customize your space station using different kinds of floors and walls. Will you go with a space age look, or perhaps something more cozy? It’s up to you! How you build your station matters. Tables near windows and good lighting are more appealing than those near a noisy generator. The better ambiance you provide the more money you will make!

Build solar panels and generators to provide power for all of the cool things in your station. Dance clubs and arcades require quite a bit of power. You’ll need to decide the best places to put the generators to avoid disturbing your patrons.

Customers will want a comfortable and well-lit place to eat. Make sure your tables are near light sources, fans to circulate fresh air, décor to beautify the area, and more.

Hire and level up staff to run the kitchen, serve the food, play music, and maintain your equipment. Each staff member has different strengths and weaknesses. A good waiter can increase the chance that a party will order dessert and a good mechanic will ensure that all of your arcade machines are in working order. And of course, doing that well means more money!

Start with a simple menu and then expand into more choices including dessert and specialty drinks. The more options you have, the more satisfied your customers will be.

Unlock and build a dance club and an arcade! The more atmosphere you add to the dance club and the more arcade machines you provide the more your customers will spend time there and of course, spend money too. Additional specialty areas will be added during development as well!

title: Dealicious
description:
게임 정보
Dealicious is a cooking-themed kitchen management deck-builder card game. Discover and stack cards together to cook meals, manage your kitchen space and expand eventually hiring staff as you grow your empire. Discover unique cards which offer special abilities/bonuses! Can you collect them all?
300+ cards to collect
90+ recipes
30+ missions
Many packs to discover and unpack
Kitchen customization & expansion
Management of staff (hire & fire)
Gold system (pay bills on time!)
Stack and move cards freely!

title: Memories Of Zattera
description:
게임 정보
"Fragments of the past weave together, each memory unveiling a hidden truth, each detail blurring the line between reality and mere perception."
For a decade, the arcane kingdom of Ahlfar, blessed by ancient magic and guide by the stars, clashed with Kyrguios, a nation powered by science and invention. Their final war was unlike any before it: Kyrguios unleashed cutting-edge warships and bold strategies, delivering a crushing blow that shattered Ahlfar’s faith in its centuries-old arcane traditions.
In the aftermath of defeat, as tensions simmer and rebuilding begins, Ahlfar’s king dared to learn from the very force that overcame them. Now, the royal family stands at a crossroads: adhere to ancient customs or embrace Kyrguios’s pragmatic innovation.
Who could have imagined a mechanical cannon surpassing the fiery might of a seasoned mage’s spell?
Explore Moral & Political Dilemmas in a Fantasy Universe
Explore the collision of magic and technology, tradition and innovation. Will you champion the starlit legacy of Ahlfar or spark a new era with Kyrguios’s progress?
Connect with an Engaging Cast and Forge Meaningful Relationships
Meet memorable heroes and adversaries whose bonds grow as you progress. Every interaction can spark friendship, rivalry, or something in between.
Experience a Story Crafted for Multiple Playthroughs
Each perspective uncovers hidden truths and deeper layers of the story. Return with fresh insights to experience entirely new outcomes.

title: Collisions: Cosmic Geometry
description:
게임 정보
Test your limits in the most frantic Neon Arcade Survival game in the galaxy! In Collisions, your reflexes will be pushed to the limit as you fight for survival in a fast-paced and intense arena against geometric enemies that move randomly and unpredictably.
Collisions: Cosmic Galaxy is an indie project developed by me, Gabriel Henrique, with dedication to the indie gaming universe and the creation of visually striking and challenging experiences. The game is in its final stages of development—stay tuned for updates!
✅ Wishlist Collisions now and get ready for the ultimate neon challenge!
🎮 Simple Gameplay, Intense Challenge
Move using WASD or arrow keys.
Easy to learn, hard to master!

title: Prepare The Past
description:
게임 정보
Unravel the Past. Change the Future.
A doomed civilization. A future in ruins. A chance to change everything.
Sent back in time with a single mission—investigate the past and present your findings—your goal is to document history before it’s too late. Using advanced tools, you’ll capture key moments, uncover hidden anomalies, and attempt to warn those who still have time to act. But will they listen?
Blending open-world exploration with photography-driven gameplay, this game invites you to traverse a vast and immersive landscape, analyze events as they unfold, and piece together the mystery of an impending catastrophe. Every discovery matters, and every choice shapes the outcome.
Features
Investigate and Document – Use high-tech photography tools to analyze key moments in history.
Expansive Open World – Explore diverse biomes, uncover lost civilizations, and interact with a world unaware of its fate.
Capture Critical Events – Record anomalies, track pivotal changes, and create a visual archive of history in motion.
Dynamic Storytelling – Your findings influence how the past reacts. Can you convince them to change course?
Collection and Progression – Gather artifacts, upgrade your equipment, and unlock deeper secrets hidden in the timeline.
The future is broken, but the past holds the key. Will you find the answers before time runs out?

title: Cascade
description:
게임 정보
Cascade is a game which has interactive simulated fluids and landscapes you can modify while on a mission or in the level editor. Use aircraft, boats, wheeled vehicles, horses, snowmobiles, Choose a creative mode or an mission driven path with challenges that include drones, turrets, monsters, bases to attack. 
There are single player missions that involve first person characters, horse back, aircraft, driving, boats and more. these involve  challenges of exploration, quests, attack, divert rivers etc, fun ! 
The level editor allows you to :
Modify landscapes and the fluids will update in real-time.
Add simulated fluid sources that will follow the landscape.
Add large volumed of liquids.
Change the landscape auto material.
Paint trees and grass.
Place objects that interact with the fluids - rocks, buildings, bridges, floatable objects.
Place enemies like drones, turrets, monsters etc.
Explore your creation on foot, on horseback, in an aircraft, wheeled vehicles, boats, submarines, snowmobile.
Create rivers, seas, and also  mix different fluids ( water, mud, mercury, lava, honey. goop, and more)
Paint with fluids.
Add drains to control the levels.
Create dams then burst them or divert the fluid anywhere.

title: CorAstral
description:
게임 정보
Face countless perils in this fast paced runner where timing and reflexes are everything. Dodge obstacles or slash them with your sword. Perform aerial acrobatics to overcome more challenging sections.
Control Polaris, a powerful and agile warrior that must reach the Core of his world as soon as possible, where he will face a terrible menace.

title: Dreamscape Legends
description:
게임 정보
Every Decision You Make Shapes Your Own Unique Story…
In Dreamscape Legends, as you navigate the intricate realms of the Dreamscape, you are not merely engaging in battles; you are at the heart of a dynamic, ever-evolving narrative. Each card you play, every battle you engage in, and every decision you make are pivotal chapters in your unique story, shaped by your decisions and the outcomes of your confrontations. Your journey is intertwined with a grander tale of ideological clashes, the mysteries of the Nightmares, and the collective struggle for survival in this enigmatic realm.
What sets Dreamscape Legends apart is its groundbreaking use of advanced AI to generate unique dialogue, storylines, and quests for every player, ensuring that no two playthroughs are ever the same (in campaign mode).
Every interaction, every choice you make is reflected in a narrative uniquely tailored to your journey, making each game a new chapter in the vast, unfolding saga of the Dreamscape. The cards in your hand are more than just game pieces; they are the tools with which you carve your path through the Dreamscape, influencing not just the outcome of battles but the unfolding lore of this world. Your actions, strategies, and victories contribute to a larger, player-driven saga where every choice can lead to new quests, challenges, and chapters in the game's rich narrative tapestry.
Dreamscape Legends offers not just a game, but a world that grows with you, a canvas for your imagination, where every move is a stroke in the grand painting of the Dreamscape.
Key Features:
Dynamic Content: Quests, campaign events, and dialogue are generated dynamically by generative AI, based on your interactions, gameplay, and more.
Realistic NPC Chat: Open chat with in-game AI opponents and campaign NPCs.
Unique gameplay mechanics not found in any other TCG: Dreamscape cards change the in-game mechanics. Nightmare cards show up randomly in both players' decks at the beginning of the game, introducing an element of Suprise and "chaos" caused by the.

title: Fly With Friends
description:
게임 정보
Please note this game is in development—its gameplay and features are constantly evolving. If something seems off or incomplete, it's likely a sign that changes are coming!
Fly With Friends is a social multiplayer flying game. Relax, explore, and fly...with friends!
TAKE TO THE SKIES!
Explore the island and make new friends! Engage in epic aerial dogfights, blast balloons (or other players) with your egg cannon, and conquer nail-biting race courses!
STYLE YOUR PILOT & RIDE!
Express yourself by decking out your egg pilot with a variety of cool skins and fun accessories. Earn a plane-load of money, unlock upgrades, and get tons of rewards!

title: SnaPaul 2 : Anomalies
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in SnaPaul, a first-person psychological horror game that traps you in a dark, mysterious house filled with unexpected horrors. After a prank gone horribly wrong, you're ensnared in a nightmarish loop crafted by your own mother. As you delve into her twisted past, the boundaries between reality and madness blur. Unravel sinister secrets and confront malevolent forces in this unforgettable experience.
Key Features:
Intense Psychological Horror
Engaging Storyline
Short but Impactful Gameplay
Unique Achievements
Are you ready to discover what lurks in the darkness? Your mind and courage will be tested in SnaPaul. Brace your nerves, because once you enter... you'll never be the same.
Note: This game contains explicit violent scenes that may disturb some players, including depictions of mutilat

title: Sheep  the Stars
description:
게임 정보

High stakes rocket-powered precision sheep platformer. As a sheep strapped to a rocket, boost up and climb through perilous terrain and traps to reach the goal before everyone else. Every sheep has dreamed of touching the stars, will you be the first?

Tackle the single player story and challenges, or take your precision skills (and pure rage) into the multiplayer area. Be the sheep that flies the furthest the faster.

(Enjoy the demo alongside development. Actively looking for feedback on gameplay and multiplayer while we continue polishing visuals, and levels)
Features
Rage / Precision platformer with escalating challenges
Multiple difficulty modes to suit beginners and pros alike
Multiplayer lobbies with friends or take your chances with open lobbies
Highly customizable multiplayer gameplay for everyone
Customizable cosmetics and unlockables
Simple to learn, difficult to master

(This game is under active development, join the Discord Server or the Email List to help shape the future of the title.

title: Minerva Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
Minerva Labyrinth is a turn-based, party-based, first-person dungeon crawler set in the near future of Earth.  Take command of five warriors with incredible powers and defend humanity from an ancient enemy known as the Hate.
Hate is Forever
In the 1990s, humanity finally comes together on an unprecedented scale to confront the  global climate and energy crises that threaten its future.  Over fifty years later, civilization thrives worldwide in a new era of cooperation and humanism, and the recent rediscovery of ancient magic promises miraculous new advancements.  Yet as human strife recedes, something dark and forgotten returns from deep in the earth...
Minerva Squad
Create your own party from ten classes, ten passive skills, and customizable stats, or jump in right away with the balanced quick-start party.
You're not alone in your fight.  Return to your allies to recover from your wounds and upgrade your equipment, from bows and swords to skirts and tiaras.
Enter the Labyrinth
Conquer 16 fully hand-crafted dungeon levels, spanning multiple locations and biomes.
The labyrinth itself is your enemy, but beyond traps, riddles, mazes, and grisly monsters lie valuable hidden treasures.
Battle the Hate in fast-paced interleaved turn-based combat. Each enemy type has its own powers and tactics to counter your own, and each labyrinth has a powerful overlord waiting to crush you.
Fully-annotated automap tracks your progress as you explore the labyrinth.
Optional tutorial mode for players new to dungeon crawling.

title: Rune Craft
description:
게임 정보
Once a glorious civilization, the Rune World was plunged into chaos by the "Core of Chaos" going berserk. As the last inheritor of the runes, you must survive the relentless tides of monsters that emerge with each passing day and night. Every battle is a new trial of runes—whether it’s extracting ancient runes from the bodies of colossal bosses or assembling the ultimate weapon capable of sealing the Chaos.
Game Features
Diverse Items: Choose from hundreds of unique runes and weapons, each with their own distinct traits.
Freeform Builds: The selection and arrangement of your runes will shape the form and attributes of your weapon’s output.
Treasure Chests & Shops: Elite monsters and bosses drop powerful chests, while shops serve as a vital source for runes.
Dynamic Events & Objectives: Encounter a variety of special events and objectives throughout the game, each offering rich rewards upon completion.
◆ Dynamic Trajectory System ◆
Morph projectiles in real-time with runes, craft signature ballistics by combining trajectory modifiers with effect-enhancing glyphs

title: RockIt Ronnie
description:
게임 정보
Shoot your way thru traffic to rack up points and beat the clock...
Grab powerups along the way to add time, boost score, collect special weapons, and much more...
Battle and defeat diabolical bosses to advance to new worlds

title: Core Rush ! Dash Arena
description:
게임 정보
Core Rush: Dash Arena is a fast-paced, action-packed party game where players race to the core in wild arenas filled with obstacles, platforms, and chaos! Whether you're driving high-speed customizable cars or controlling quirky characters, your goal is simple but challenging: be the first to reach the core and claim victory!
Compete across a variety of vibrant arenas, each featuring unique themes and dynamic obstacles. Dash, jump, drift, and smash your way through intense races, balancing speed and strategy to outplay your opponents. Every round is a test of skill, reflexes, and adaptability as you navigate ever-changing environments designed to keep you on the edge of your seat.
Key Features:
Single-Player and Multiplayer Modes: Race solo or challenge up to 8 players in chaotic online matches!
Unique Arenas and Platforms: Experience a range of arenas with different layouts, hazards, and surprises.
Switch between characters and vehicles, each with distinct abilities and handling.

title: Wadar: a dimension altering reality
description:
게임 정보
Wadar is a 2d platformer designed to make you think and utilizes gameplay elements that are not seen often in platformers.
some examples of this includes the player being able to:
Flip gravity
Pause your existence?
Stop time
Teleport (in a bunch of different ways)
Use portals
Stop gravity 
and a bunch of other abilities with levels made to allow the player to get the most out of them. 
abilities are not the only focus of this game however. there are 9 worlds which includes 
Ability focused worlds
A troll world, 
A world where you have to find out how much you need to do something and 
A world based on colour platforms defining what you can see or collide with (these platforms have symbols to try and help with colour blindness compatability)
there are also a lot of secrets within some levels to be found including both unlockable cosmetics to stylize your character and even secret endings which may let you skip some levels.
there are over 70 levels in this game and plenty of which you will most likely need to play multiple times to find everything.

title: Fugue Shot
description:
게임 정보
Each run in Fugue Shot presents a series of unique dreamscapes, filled with increasingly difficult puzzles and randomized encounters to test your abilities to their limit. Plan your shots carefully to clear the playfield and overcome the ever-shifting landscape of this liminal and surreal world.
Build Your Own Solutions
Set up your playfield, test different ideas, and interact with a satisfying physics engine to master constantly changing puzzles and challenges.
Power Up Your Run
Choose from dozens of unique items to impact your gameplay and warp your playstyle. Discover powerful synergies to create truly unique builds, allowing for emergent gameplay and a constantly shifting experience.

title: Chronicles of Fear: The Babysitter's Tale
description:
게임 정보


크로니클 오브 피어는 점프스캐어나 다른 싸구려 트릭이 없는 공포 게임을 만드는 데 중점을 둔 시리즈입니다.

우리의 주요 목표는 공포 매뉴얼이 아닌 실제 이야기를 사용하여 플롯을 구축함으로써 믿을 수 있는 공포 설정을 만드는 것입니다. 플레이어가 찾을 수 있는 숨겨진 디테일로 가득한 인터랙티브한 환경을 제공합니다.

완료하는 데 약 1.5~2시간이 걸리는 짧은 게임입니다.
'워킹 시뮬레이터' 장르이지만 주변 환경과 상호작용하고 캐릭터와 대화할 수 있습니다.
게임플레이에는 점프스케이어가 없으며, 현실에 가깝기 때문에 다음과 같은 트리거가 포함되어 있습니다;
거미 공포증, 가족 트라우마, 밀실 공포증, 고소공포증, 폐쇄공포증, 폐쇄공포증





이웃이 외출하는 동안 아들을 돌봐줄 수 있는지 물어보는데, 몇 달러를 벌 수 있는 좋은 방법입니다. 이런 날 밤에 일어날 수 있는 최악의 일이 뭐겠어요? 한적한 빈집에서 TV 앞에서 간식을 먹으며 쉽게 돈을 버는 것이야말로 가장 재미있는 활동이기 때문입니다. 하지만 만일을 대비해 문을 꼭 잠그는 것은 잊지 마세요.
autokwd: Chronicles of Fear: The Babysitter's Tale

title: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe
description:
게임 정보
A third-person action video game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies in an anime style.
The world has been ravaged by a zombie apocalypse. Emilia, along with her friend and other students, will try to stay alive within the educational center while zombies lurk around every corner.
Waiting for help won't be the best option. The scarcity of medicine, food, and water will force them to venture outside as they seek help, but nothing will be so simple. They will encounter a city looted by other survivors, who, faced with the lack of resources, will opt for more ruthless actions.
Emilia and her companions' mental health will be threatened, facing psychological and emotional problems as they try to find moments of happiness in a desolate world, although happiness is fleeting in this dark and hostile world.
Will they be able to overcome adversity and preserve the remaining humanity, or will they succumb to the bleak fate that seems inevitable in this new post-apocalyptic world?
autokwd: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe

title: The Raptured
description:
게임 정보
SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT AND JOIN THE DISCORD COMMUNITY



The Raptured is a TPS horror survival video game that follows Fletcher in Still Pines, overrun by apparitions that stalk the player. Find out what happened to the town, and try not to be consumed by the treacherous hordes of the apparitions.

The Raptured is a narrative-driven videogame experience that is fictitiously set in the 1990s after the Cold War and immerses the audience in misconstrued reality. Two novice journalists meet together to investigate a dodgy tip from someone anonymous, but little do they know, they are stumbling into the illegal testing grounds of a dangerous PMC.

title: The Spiral
description:
게임 정보
The Spiral is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Explore the dungeon, find tools for your survival, and try to escape with your life.
Descend into Darkness
Explore an infinite dungeon with randomized layouts, items, and enemies. No two playthroughs are the same.
Find Powerful Equipment
Make use of the dungeon's bounty to survive. Simple farming tools, legendary weapons, curious potions, and enchanted charms are all at your disposal.
Fight for Your Life
You are not alone. Monsters, nightmares, and other desperate wanderers like you all call the dungeon home. Kill them before they kill you.

title: Dobbel Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
신비로운 저주가 땅을 지배한다…
마법의 충격파가 섬 전체를 휩쓸자, 모든 종류의 야생 동물이 괴물로 변해 지역 주민을 향해 저항하기 시작합니다… 파티를 모으고, 주사위를 굴리고, 섬을 가로질러 전투를 하며 강력한 저주를 완전히 끝내세요!

title: Scorched Warfare
description:
게임 정보
높은 하늘 위에서 균열이 서서히 펼쳐집니다.
성벽 아래에서는 수많은 군대가 성문을 뚫고 들어옵니다.
당신은 제국의 장군이 되어 분쟁의 시작점으로 돌아가, 모든 것을 근본적으로 바꾸려 합니다...
부대를 지휘하며 전투
다양한 부대와 함께 싸우며, 중세 판타지 전장을 몰입감 있게 체험하세요.
전술 모드
직접 적을 물리칠 뿐만 아니라, 전술 모드에서 모든 부대에 대해 세부적인 계획을 세울 수 있습니다.
Roguelite 부대 구성
게임을 진행하면서 독창적인 부대 빌드를 구성하며, 다양한 전투 스타일을 경험해 보세요!
영웅 성장
게임 진행에 따라 영웅은 강력한 기술들을 연속적으로 해금합니다.

title: Re-Activated
description:
게임 정보


Re-Activated is a 2D puzzle platformer game where you need to manipulate the movement system of a robot to pass the levels. You control the little flying robot named “Minic” to help the robot. Explore the facility and solve the puzzles in a relaxing 1-bit style atmosphere.

You play as a little robot called "Minic" to help the bigger robot to pass the levels. The big robot's only function is to walk and stop. As Minic and the big robot pass the levels, new functions in the big robot's movement system unlocks. As a Minic, your purpose is to combine these functions cleverly to solve puzzles.

To use these functions, there is a plugboard of the big robot's brain. There are inputs and outputs. Inputs have a jack that connects to the cable and outputs have a jack socket. You can connect those jacks to sockets to manipulate the movement system of the big robot. There are multiple inputs and multiple outputs. That creates multiple combinations of movement systems. It's your call to choose which one of the combinations is a better choice for every level.

Explore the 40+ levels in a facility of robots in a relaxing 1-bit pixel art style with great lighting effects in pixel perfect game.

title: no brake no gain
description:
게임 정보
BUILD. CUSTOMIZE. DRIVE.
no brake no gain is an arcade precision-driving game where skill outshines speed. Navigate intense, obstacle-packed tracks where every dodge, drift, and turn demands ultimate control.
Take on a series of high-stakes driving challenges designed to push your reflexes and creativity to the limit. Complete tricky objectives, from speed-based sprints to navigating trap-laden courses. Whether you're dodging hazards or chasing perfection, every level demands mastery!
KEY FEATURES
ARCADE PRECISION DRIVING
Feel the thrill of tight, responsive controls that reward skill and creativity. Master each challenge with pinpoint accuracy as you weave through traps, perform daring maneuvers, and reach the mysterious idol in style.
GARAGE CUSTOMIZATION
Upgrade your cars to handle tougher challenges with confidence. Fine-tune speed and handling, and paint your vehicle to match your personal style as you prepare to conquer every challenge.
VERSUS MINIGAMES
Gather your friends for local multiplayer chaos! Compete in exciting game modes like Capture the Flag, Pass the Bomb, and Survival. May the best driver win!
DYNAMIC LEVELS
Conquer wild, unpredictable tracks filled with lasers, moving platforms, explosive barrels, and other inventive obstacles. Adapt, react, and push your skills to the limit!

title: A Bard's Last Song
description:
게임 정보
In "The Bard's Last Song", players take on the roles of three unlikely heroes - Maggie the Mage, Kelly the Knight, and Anwir the Rogue - as they embark on a journey to unite their shattered land. The game begins with Maggie and her father figure, the Bard, on a fateful hike up a mountain. The Bard's sudden death leads to the scattering of his pages across the land, and the trio must recover them in order to restore balance to their world. Each character faces their own unique challenges and enemies as they make their way through twisting forests, dark dungeons, and ruined castles.

Along the way, players will engage in epic battles, solve puzzles, and explore a richly-detailed, hand-drawn world filled with bizarre creatures and hidden secrets. With fast-paced combat, challenging platforming, and a deep, emotionally resonant story, "The Bard's Last Song" is an unforgettable adventure that will keep players hooked until the very end.

title: It Consumes
description:
게임 정보
SURVIVE IN THE DARKNESS
It Consumes is an arena-FPS survivors game that plays like a combination of Devil Daggers and Vampire Survivors, but with an additional twist — to see the environment and the horrors within it, you must use your pulse to temporarily reveal your surroundings.
EVERY RUN IS UNIQUE
Gain new abilities, upgrade your firepower and mobility, and become an unstoppable demon slaying machine. Different upgrades reward different styles of play, so there's always new strategies to try out when you start a new run.
PUSH YOUR LUCK
Increase the power of your abilities by taking on Blights, which add unique debuffs that you'll have to compensate for. How many can you stack before it becomes too much?

title: Do You even Forklift?
description:
게임 정보
When all you have is a Forklift, everything looks like palete.
Take a flight to Ghibli stylized JAPAN!
Let your forklift loose on a peacefull prefecture.
Travel through whole island and solve more than 30 puzzles to learn your story.
Some truck takes your parking place? No problem, you can forklift them!
Place Kei Cars on the right parking spots,
They can have alarms,
And might be Wired,
Be smart about parking gates,
Use illegal moves when no one sees, 

But sometimes you can Help others.
Maybe they will show you how to cook Ramen?  Of course using a forklift!
Featuring:
An elegant forklift straight from Japan (that's you)
A lot of kei cars to stick on the fork,
A dedicated beep button (!!!)

title: DoubleWe
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 출시 시점부터 한글로 번역되어 있지는 않을 것입니다. 대신, 찜하기 수치를 확인하면서 가장 많은 관심을 보이는 언어부터 순서대로 번역을 진행할 예정입니다. 관심이 있으시다면 저희가 알 수 있게 찜 목록에 추가해 주세요!
진정한 편집증을 경험하세요
당신이 가장 취약할 때를 노려 당신을 죽이려는 클론들이 군중 속에 숨어 있습니다. 탄약이 한정적인 무기와 함께 수백 명의 얼굴을 신중하게 살펴가며 당신의 클론을 찾아내세요. 언제나 뒤를 조심하세요. 사방에 위험이 도사리고 있습니다!
생물학적 공포에 맞서세요
로그라이트 게임을 진행해 나가면서 주변의 세상이 변하는 것을 경험하게 됩니다. 이야기가 진행됨에 따라 새로운 클론, 새로운 적, 새로운 위험이 생겨나며, 이 위협을 극복할 새로운 전술을 개발하지 못한다면 생명을 위협받게 될 것입니다.

title: The Dream Office
description:
게임 정보
꿈이 실현되고 공간이 수익성 있는 기회로 바뀌는 기업 경영의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다. "드림 오피스"에서 당신은 상업 공간, 특히 사무실 건물을 번성하는 생산성 허브로 바꾸는 재능을 지닌 노련한 관리자의 세련된 신발을 밟게 됩니다. 하지만 그것은 단지 책상과 의자에 관한 것이 아닙니다. 혼란스러운 상황을 정리하는 것부터 완벽한 거래를 성사시키는 것까지 전략적 결정을 내리는 것입니다.
주요 기능:
🎨1. 크리에이티브 모드 - 샌드박스:
샌드박스 모드에서 창의력을 발휘해보세요. 자신만의 방을 디자인하고 만들어 넓은 개방형 공간을 독특하고 개인화된 환경으로 바꿔보세요.
🛠️2. 몰입형 역학:
쓰레기 청소, 벽 수평 맞추기, 페인팅, 타일 깔기, 세탁, 공간 정리 등 다양한 활동에 참여합니다. 불필요한 품목을 판매하면 관리에 전략이 추가됩니다.

title: Whimsical Heroes
description:
게임 정보


In a land once flowing with milk and honey, resources suddenly began to run out. Sensing the impending end of the world as they knew it, the three heroes embark on a journey through unknown lands to uncover the mystery behind this life-sustaining energy crisis.

Conquer all in tactical, turn-based battles set on a hexagonal grid. Lead a team of cartoon heroes - the brave bean explorer, the fluffy cat defender, and the onion musician from distant realms - through a series of adventures in Whimsical Heroes!

title: Rebirth of Arcadia
description:
게임 정보
전략적인 턴제 전투
최대 5명의 캐릭터를 조작하며, 전략적인 포지셔닝과 이동, 그리고 통제 지역(ZOC)을 활용해 적을 혼란에 빠뜨리세요. 액션 포인트(AP)를 현명하게 사용하고, 상황에 따라 강력한 콤보를 만들어 여러 적을 공격하거나 방어를 강화하세요.
스킬 변환 시스템
전장에서 원소 에너지를 활용하여 스킬의 잠재력을 끌어내고, 전투 중 일시적으로 더 강력한 능력으로 변환할 수 있습니다.
캐릭터 커스터마이징
쓰러뜨린 적에게서 유전자를 모아 패시브 스킬을 획득하고, 룬스톤 시스템을 통해 캐릭터의 스킬을 강화하며 전략에 맞춰 추가 효과를 부여하세요.
심연 탐험
스토리 전투를 통해 심연의 미스터리를 풀고, 무작위로 생성된 스테이지에서 싸워 캐릭터를 강화하세요.



심연이라 불리는 깊은 구덩이에 떨어져 목숨을 잃은 소년 솔로몬. 그러던 중, 용의 팔을 가진 미스터리한 인물 루비누스와 그의 파트너 에스메랄다가 솔로몬의 비참한 시신을 발견합니다. 그들은 고향 아르카디아의 룬스톤 기술을 이용해 심연에 대해 더 많이 알기 위해 솔로몬을 되살리기로 합니다.

자신들이 있는 장소에 대한 지식이 부족하다는 것을 깨달은 두 사람은 위험한 생물과 거대한 육식 동물이 배회하는 미지의 영역으로 발을 들여놓습니다. 두 사람은 이 위험한 환경에서 목숨을 걸고 싸워 지상으로 돌아가는 방법을 찾아야 합니다.

title: Halberd Black
description:
게임 정보
Halberd Black is an action-adventure JRPG set thousands of years into the future of our galaxy, where you play as a Stark, a genetically engineered human being caught in a struggle to survive and protect those he holds most dear from those who'd wish him harm. Explore the rich story of the Halberd Black universe and explore the beautiful landscapes, and dense city streets and enjoy combat reminiscent of the JRPGs of old ( With a Modern Twist ). Fight a wide variety of enemies using a dynamic turn-based combat system. Explore new environments as you seek strength to fight back against the powerful megacorporation that is after you and your friends. Only through grit and determination will you be able to fight against the threats that are coming your way. The only question is, do you have what it takes?

title: NeuroSquad - Slay the Horde
description:
게임 정보

NeuroSquad is a Bullet Heaven / Action Roguelite game, where you can design your own guns by building them up modularly. Summon a group of holographic soldiers who fight alongside you as you control the whole squad!
In this game no upgrade is tied to a specific weapon, you can freely choose which gun gets which modifications.


Choose from a wide variety of pickups and upgrades! Customize your own attacks and discover powerful synergies! Set up your auto-attacking soldiers using neuro-implants. Summon them, make them stronger, turn them into killing machines!









Humanity is in the process of stepping out of the biological era. Brain enhancement, neural chips, and other body augmentations are part of this new reality. But a change this drastic was never going to happen without conflict and catastrophes.

Now it's your turn to face their hordes. The latest weapon types, such as the laser shotgun and biosense mines, as well as augmentations like the cyber aura will help you become stronger and wipe out the AI bots.

With each death you become more powerful. Each night is a new opportunity to save the future.

title: Dark Age Dinos
description:
게임 정보
Travel alone or with friends through the land of Cretacia - a land of war, banditry and dinosaurs. Each mission is a short, self-contained journey with its own enemies, ability combinations, loot and objectives. Your friend can't make it tonight? They can join you on the next mission tomorrow without getting left behind. Or you can strike out on your own. We get it, not everybody wants to share the power and glory.
Every mission is different and not every journey ends in victory. You'll recruit new characters with each outing, so even defeat has its upside. What are you waiting for? Cretacia isn't going to save itself!

title: Chyss
description:
게임 정보
Chyss is a turnbased, tactical 1vs1 game based on chess.
You can move, attack, and consume your mana to spells and use items when it's your turn.
Your goal is to destroy your opponent's Leader!

The year is 12022.
Number of civilisations evolved from primitive life to being able to travel the universe.
In this universe, a game has evolved to become essential: The Chyss.

The Chyss has its roots in chess, but many have added to the rules in order to create its successor. A timeless, universal, and balanced game, allowing interplanetary competition, where fair play, game intelligence and risk-taking are the traits of legendary players.
Young children want to become great Chyss players, the vast majority of adults play, whether to have fun, relax, explore the possibilities, or to pursue their childhood dreams.

In this universe, a phenomenon affects about a third of the people...
About a third of people become incarnates overnight. Falling asleep as themselves, they wake up controlled by different, higher forces.
These forces do not want their loss, but simply direct their steps, their actions.

You are this higher force which is going to take control of an inhabitant of this universe.
You, and all the other players of this video game...
You will embody an incarnate.

This incarnate is now you.
Your goal will be determined by you. You can become the best Chyss player in the universe, but there are many pitfalls along the way.
There are many extremely strong, clever players in this universe.
The best Chyss player in the universe is anonymous. She is only known as "The Galaxy Queen".
Good luck! And battle with pride.

title: Lamia's Bambina
description:
게임 정보
Train the best, most powerful Lamias!
WORLD
In an impoverished demon world ravaged by the war between man and beast, the Lamia tribe are on the verge of extinction.

Ivy, reincarnated into the demon world as the Lamia tribe's savior, along with princess Hedera aim for the revival of their tribe. Play as Ivy as you multiply and raise Lamias and battle the Harpy tribe to reclaim the Lamia Palace.
DUNGEONS
Battles take place in demon world dungeons with familiar 2D maps. Explore the dungeons again and again and defeat the bosses waiting in their depths.
Classic command-style turn-based battles. The key to good battle strategy is to form your party to take advantage of each Lamia's characteristics, choosing from Lamias skilled at physical attacks to those specializing in magic attacks. Lead your Lamias to victory.
Not only will you find Lamias, but you'll also see Harpies, Fairies, and other familiar monsters complete with up-tempo*** conversations and stories in an enjoyable pixel art demon world.

The Lamia training system is scheduled to be released in Summer 2024, when Japan is scorching hot.

Don't miss the latest Lamia's Bambina ("LamiBam") information!

title: The Bugs Manor 🦋
description:
게임 정보

The Bugs Manor is a free top-down 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay focused on direct interactions with the environment.



The haunted house is full of dangerous creatures, you will need to use the stealth and your wits to escape, but be careful, because if you fail, a bloody death waits for you.



Can you overcome the enigmatic challenges of the manor? Solve multiple puzzles through inventory-free gameplay. This allows you to interact directly with the environment and items without the interruption of annoying menus.



Uncover the dark secrets of the evil Bugs home and its numerous rooms. Follow the story of Danny, a kid who has just moved into the house and is spending his first night there alone. But maybe he's not as alone as he believes...

title: Dicey Birdball
description:
게임 정보
Dicey Birdball is a roguelike strategy sports game where you manage a team of birds playing football. Roll dice and assign them to your birds to maneuver, score goals, and win the championship. Enact leaguewide rule changes to evolve the sport of Birdball, from increasing the size of the field to summoning iceberg obstacles to touchdown teleportation.

Each run you'll take control of a different team with their own unique story and objective. Win enough matches to make it to the championship and fulfill the team's objective. Between matches you'll make decisions to improve the team such as gaining new abilities, drafting new dice, and enacting new rules.

Feature List:
Compete in turn-based, grid-based football matches using a team of up to 3 birds from 5 different classes.
Manage a team of different bird classes, each with their own unique set of abilities.
Spend seeds on new dice to increase the number of moves you can make each turn.
Guide the evolution of the sport by choosing which rules change over time, such as expanding the field and allowing alternate scoring mechanism.
Unlock new teams with different bird combinations to play with.
Unlock the ability to create your own team with custom colors and team composition.

title: Sacred Constellars: Ruin Raiders
description:
게임 정보
Ruin Raiders, a daring few who risk everything to explore ancient second-era tombs. With the promise of great rewards, they unearth relics of immense power, remnants of a bygone era. The Church of Eion strives to secure these artifacts, sealing them away in heavily guarded vaults. Yet, some relics slip through, disrupting the status quo. This is one such story....
Charming 2D Pixel Art Style.
Master tactics to overcome many battles.
Unique boss fights that are more than just HP sponges or enemies that simply hit harder.
Interact with a fleshed out and unique world that melds fantasy and elements of science fiction.
Create bonds with your fellow party members. Up to twelve interesting characters.
20+ hour story rich role playing campaign.

title: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara
description:
게임 정보
It all starts with Captain Disaster answering a distress call from a mysterious ship... but it ends up with a planet desperate to rekindle its geothermal energy source, and the long-lasting legacy of an intergalactic empire long consigned to the history books. The planet houses a secret that none of its inhabitants are aware of...

Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara features a contextual one-click interface, a host of colourful characters, devious puzzles, detailed cartoon style graphics, full voicing and an original soundtrack. You play as the adventurous but not altogether bright eponymous Captain, aided (sometimes) by your ship's computer, Zero-Bit, as you help a race of aliens whose complex history is largely unknown, even to themselves.



This game is a collaboration between award-winning developers Dave Seaman (multiple AGS Awards for Captain Disaster in: Death Has A Million Stomping Boots & other games) and Lorenzo Boni (winner of the $106 Adventure Game Challenge for Where Did the Humans Go? and an AGS Award). These two amiable lunatics have been point & click adventure game fans for many years and they have collaborated previously on small games and even a children's book, but nothing approaching the scale and scope of this new Captain Disaster game!

(Playing the two previous Captain Disaster games is not necessary for this one, although there will be some references to events in the earlier games, and even a returning character from Stomping Boots...)

The soundtrack is being composed by , a recent finalist in the , whose previous work includes the OST for .

Making this game together has been a real joy and we hope that comes across in the game, and we sincerely hope you have as much fun playing it as we are having making it. , without revealing much in terms of the game's overall theme. If you find the demo a little bit too easy, don't worry - we deliberately made it reasonably simple, bigger challenges await in the full game.



It's absolutely designed to be enjoyed by all ages! The storyline contains complex themes and some of the puzzles will definitely challenge all but the most hardened point-and-clickers (I'm talking about people who completed games like Monkey Island 2, The Dig and Lucy's Dreaming without ever resorting to hints!!), but at the same time it will always contain humour and animation to delight younger players. Naturally some references in the game will require a certain knowledge of adventure games, sci-fi shows and movies, etc, but these are not essential to playing the game or solving the puzzles, just an added extra.

title: Play Rough
description:
게임 정보
THE WORLD
A hundred years in the future, the dregs of the human race struggle to survive in a contradictory world of VIOLENCE, MAGIC, and LIVING CARTOONS.
Guide the sheltered psychic Beau Chartreuse in a turn-based RPG journey through the ruins of California, meeting strange assets and stranger enemies. A world where brutality reigns supreme and kindness is never easy… A world that frays at the edges, allowing something wonderful in!
THE PARTY
All of this is a lot for just you and Beau, so it’s good that you’ve got some strong allies on your side!
Oh, I’m sorry. It’s just a fox and an old man. They’re both bitter and full of regrets, but who isn’t? I’m sure that Valentine and Dr. Woland will have their uses.
Or they may stab you in the back. You can never be sure of people, these days. Best not to get too attached.
THE OPPOSITION
Men and women, clowns and dreams and cartoons and nightmares! This world is full of things that will want to take your money, your life, or something worse.
With every enemy a unique encounter, it’s up to you to decide exactly how much you’re willing to bite off!
Will you blaze through the world, hunting for every enemy while putting your party’s health at risk? Or will you cautiously hoard your money and food for those foes you can’t avoid?

title: Look Locked
description:
게임 정보
"Look Locked": A co-op puzzle game where doors only open, if you can see them being opened. Work together, time your actions, and communicate to unravel challenges. Coordination and observation lead to victory!
 
 Two Player Co-Op
Unique Puzzles
Challenging Gameplay
 
The effect of each of your actions will only take place for the other player if they have seen that action.
 
More content will be added with updates, and with the later coming "Level-Editor" the fun won't stop!

title: Rogue Souls
description:
게임 정보

When the Lich is released, it unleashes its dark magic upon the world, reviving old spirits, ancient creatures, and new monsters. But in its arrogance, it also brings back ancient Souls; Souls with their will intact, serving no one but their purpose.
Gameplay:
Rogue Souls combines the exploration and looting of a 'Roguelike' with the difficulty of a 'Souls' game, where your skill is everything. Whether defeating all enemies without taking a single hit or facing the weakest enemy repeatedly. Bring various Souls to life with unique abilities and weapons, making each playthrough feel completely different. Wield powerful items to strengthen your character and fulfill your main objective: not to die.
Features:
- 4 different types of Souls.

- 16 usable weapons.

- Randomly generated rooms.

- +20 unique items

title: ANTHEM#9
description:
게임 정보
타인의 눈에 띄지 않는 곳에서 활약하며 세계 질서의 균형을 유지하려는 주인공의 싸움을 그린, 턴제 덱 빌딩 로그라이트. 턴마다 무작위로 주어지는 레드, 그린, 블루 3색 보석을, 순서를 바꿔 나열하면 스킬이 발동되는 독특한 퍼즐 배틀형 전투 시스템을 채용했습니다.

title: Electric Alps
description:
게임 정보
Electric Alps is a 2D puzzle game based on real-world electrical engineering. Explore how electricity works. Plan your circuitry, install devices and solve logic-based wiring problems.

You take on the role of an electrician, returning to the remote village of St. Ampere, nestled in the breathtaking Austrian Alps. Tasked with wiring up homes and structures, you’ll master the principles of electrical engineering. Install cables, switches, and other electrical devices, strategically wiring them up to create functional circuits. Each building is a puzzle, requiring your skills to power it up. Your journey will ultimately transform the village, awakening it from its unpowered slumber. One circuit at a time.
⚡ Based on Real-World Electricity
Explore the fundamentals of electrical engineering, delving into real-world electricity. Understand the principles of current flow and master the art of wiring in this hands-on and educational experience.
🧠 Solve Puzzle-Based Circuitries
Engage wiring challenges that combine logic, strategic planning and your new-found electrical knowledge to solve a variety of puzzles in the world of electrical installations.
🛠️ Utilize a Vast Toolbox
Explore a vast array of devices and appliances as you advance through St. Ampere. From installing sockets to crafting intricate power consumption systems, you master various electrical activities, adding switches, relays, motion detectors, fuses, RCDs and other tools to your toolbox.
🏡 Electrify Your Village
As you advance, St. Ampere around you evolves. Overcoming challenges not only opens up new areas, introduces fresh devices but also revitalizes the village. Homes become inhabited, structures turn usable, and green, sustainable energy production takes center stage, transforming St. Ampere into a vibrant, electrified haven.
⛰️ Enjoy the Alpine Charm
Enjoy Austrian culture and the breathtaking Alps. The picturesque alpine landscapes aren't merely a background, but an integral part of your exploration, adding our Austrian charm to your journey through St. Ampere.

title: Infinity Knights: Xross
description:
게임 정보
Whether you’re looking for a solo experience or to team up with friends and family, an unforgettable adventure awaits in Infinity Knights: Xross! Lovingly developed by three brothers, this multiplayer RPG immerses players in a lush fantasy world filled with rich lore and challenges. Form strong bonds and band together with allies to take on epic quests, craft powerful items, and challenge colossal bosses, where teamwork is your greatest weapon!
company: Timesea Studio, Saxon, Michael, and Tyrone Goodrick

title: Termina
description:
게임 정보
Termina is an intense, adrenaline-fueled, survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Dive into the heart-pounding action of endless waves of the undead, scavenging for power-ups, unlocking powerful weapons, and battling through hordes of relentless zombies until your last breath.

Gameplay
Termina is a wave-based shooter reminiscent of classic zombie survival games. Players must fend off successive waves of zombies, utilizing a variety of weapons, power-ups, and perks to survive!


Key Features:
Multiple weapons
Multiple maps to play
A bunch of achievements
perks n power-ups

title: EbiTapes
description:
게임 정보

Set off on a cozy-grunge jam journey in EbiTapes, a quirky adventure game where you take on the mission of saving the Annual City Festival. Traverse through intriguing little places, each brimming with mellow vibes and fresh discoveries. Alongside your snarky cat companion, Zongy, dive into the depths of the city, getting to know its people and unraveling its secrets.

Record the sounds you encounter along the tranquil trail to solve puzzles and weave joyful mixtapes. Dance with cows, search for lost slippers, and mend friendships one beat at a time. EbiTapes offers a laid-back experience in a beautifully crafted world for all ages.


Get lost in a completely handcrafted world brought to life by an award winning illustrator!



Meet a friendly cast of characters on your journey! Some might need your help, while others just want to tag along for a while. It's nice to have new friends for your jam sessions!



Your tool to help you on your journey is a sound recorder.
Use it to record interesting sounds in the world and play them back at the right place - you can also make music with it!
The world is filled with amazing sounds! Keep your ears peeled and a sound recorder at hand, you might discover some cool noises that can help in your troubles!



Play little concerts for the locals and make sure that everyone is having a good time when listening to your tapes.
There are no mistakes, just happy little loops. No musical knowledge is required!

title: Abaddon
description:
게임 정보
The terror and horrors that lie within Abaddon will give every horror fan a unique and absolutely terrifying new experience. When you find yourself in the worst possible place, surrounded by unimaginable pain and horror with no one to rely on but yourself, hope is all you have left. Immerse yourself in everyone's worst fears and bring your lost brother back home. Stay alert, as you are not alone.

synopsis


In this first-person psychological horror game, you are lost in a maze-like, nightmarish world of terror. You play as 22-year-old Jimmy, who is searching for his younger brother, Georgie, after he disappeared under mysterious circumstances into a twisted world of nightmares and terror. Now, Jimmy must confront his past, his fears, and his regrets in order to find Georgie and escape the living nightmare. Though you are on your own, remember that you are not alone.


Fear: Unimaginable Fear - A New Level of First-Person Psychological Horror Game

Plot: The immersive plot of the game is designed to test the player's sanity and bravery in a unique and terrifying story-driven gameplay experience, right from the first few minutes of gameplay.

Enemies: The video game villains in this horror genre are like none other, guaranteed to give you nightmares.

The Maze: The game takes place in a chaotic and maze-like world filled with everyone's worst nightmares. In order to face what lies within the maze, the player must possess both skill and bravery.


We are an indie games studio called "Nice to Meet Studios LTD" that has been playing horror games for over a decade. Our love for the genre has led us to create "Abaddon", a game that aims to provide the best and scariest horror experience possible. Inspired by classic horror games such as Amnesia: The Dark Descent, P.T., Outlast, Visage, MADiSON, Detention, Resident Evil, and many more, "Abaddon" is designed to terrify players like never before.

Our goal is to make the players suffer and terrify them in a never-before-seen horror experience. If you think you're brave enough, we'd love for you to try to beat it - if you dare. Lose yourself in the world of "Abaddon"

title: Nivoz Running Canned
description:
게임 정보
The game is mission-completion third-person action.

>Combat is similar to TPS, but different.
Because you can't AIM!
Instead, you can simultaneously fire a shotgun that shoots in front of your character and an automatic tracking missile.
The behavior of the missiles can be controlled by the character's direction.

Use the features to your advantage and win the battle!

Juju" is an alien robot.
The day she met "Nivoz," a robot that looks like a canned food, a series of mishaps ensued.
The town where she lives is pierced by a huge building.
The unfamiliar robots began to run amok.
The two robots begin their journey in search of a safe place.

title: Jigsaw Industry
description:
게임 정보
Jigsaw Industry is a game that allows you to unleash your creativity and fully enjoy the fun of thinking. Design your own factory to combine and process different shapes and colors. A fully automated and intelligent factory can be achieved through digital circuits, logic signals, and other means.
You can perform basic cutting, combining, coloring, and color matching operations on graphics by arranging various facilities in an orderly manner,
You can perform various intelligent operations by connecting digital logic signals to achieve fully automatic intelligent puzzle solving
You can write your own signal processing components using Lua programming language to achieve custom signal processing

title: SkullStars: Supernova
description:
게임 정보
Sometime into the future, in a galaxy much different than ours...
Light It Up!
A motely crew of individuals attempt to reverse universal cataclysmic events caused by an organization's network of industries while unearthing a conspiracy against the universe's collective societies. Dive into the world of the SkullStars universe and explore the stories of our cast members.

title: Tarvos Desolation
description:
게임 정보
참혹한 우주 탐사 사고 후, 당신은 타르보스(Tarvos)라는 미지의 탐사되지 않은 달에서 유일한 생존자가 되었습니다.
처음에는 환대하는 환경처럼 보이지만 곧 끔찍한 본질을 드러냅니다.
당신의 목표는 타르보스의 적대적인 표면에서 살아남고 탈출에 도움이 될 비밀을 밝히는 것입니다. 몬스터 무리와 맞서 싸우고, 신비한 장소를 탐험하며, 답을 찾을 수 있는 버려진 실험실로 향하는 길을 찾아야 합니다. 이것이 집으로 돌아갈 유일한 기회일지도 모릅니다.
주요 특징:
잊을 수 없는 공포 분위기:어두운 장소, 신비로운 소리, 예측 불가능한 위협이 미지의 달에서의 밀실 공포 악몽으로 당신을 끌어들입니다.
몬스터 무리와의 역동적인 전투:작은 돌연변이부터 두려운 괴수에 이르기까지 다양한 적과 맞서 싸우며 생존 기술을 시험받으세요.
탐험과 생존 퍼즐:자원을 모으고, 장비를 업그레이드하며, 증가하는 도전에 맞서기 위해 기술을 발전시키세요.
미스터리 발견:승무원의 기록, 이전 임무의 흔적을 찾고 추락의 진짜 원인을 밝혀보세요. 다른 생존자가 있을까요?
스토리와 동기:
왜 당신의 탐사가 추락했나요? 사고였나요, 아니면 누군가가 의도적으로 당신을 죽음에 처하게 했나요? 타르보스에서의 모든 걸음이 진실에 가까워지게 하지만, 당신은 충분히 살아남아 이를 밝힐 시간이 있을까요?

title: ARMED DECOBOT
description:
게임 정보


ARMED DECOBOT is a unique blend of Beat 'Em Up and Bullet Hell Shoot 'Em Up mechanics inspired by Treasure and Metal Slug. It seamlessly combines the crowd control & throw heavy melee combat of Beat 'Em Ups with the intense dodge & shoot gameplay of Shmups. It's fast paced, it's difficult, it's chaotic, it's a pure unbound arcade action game! A quick burst of adrenaline to start the day!

Gameplay

You will seamlessly switch between ranged & melee combat as the situation demands.
You'll strategically pepper enemies with shots to keep them stunned as you move in for a combo!
You'll knock them down, pick them up with your grappling hook and throw them at other enemies!
You will create devastating throw chains!
You will use everything in your arsenal to frantically fight over screen space!


It's a game with maxed out risk and reward!
