title: Hold Your Breath
description:
게임 정보
Survive in a post-apocalyptic world
Breathe if you can...






⚔️ Fight against bandits, cultists, military, psychos, and animals.
🗺️ Explore the open world and uncover its mysteries.
🔍 Find a home that will become your shelter and arrange it.
🏕️ Survive by gathering resources and provisions.
🛠️ Craft weapons, resources, medicines, and supplies.
🎯 Hunt diverse wildlife.

A vast world awaits you, ripe for exploration not just for air, but also for other vital resources: food, water, weapons, and armor. Players can follow different narrative paths, from mere survival to interacting with bandits and uncovering the secrets of this devastated world.



Survival is the cornerstone of the gameplay. Players need to adapt to harsh conditions, securing food, water, and shelter while crafting weapons and armor to protect against wild animals, bandits, and other unknown threats.

Danger lurks at every corner in this world. Lack of air, radioactive zones, aggressive creatures, and hostile groups can all lead to your demise. Beyond physical threats, players encounter moral dilemmas that can alter the course of the story and the outcome of their survival.



In "HOLD YOUR BREATH," players are continually faced with the choice between risk and potential reward. Is it worth venturing into danger for valuable resources? Should you trust strangers? Each decision you make could have long-term implications.



Dive into the world of "HOLD YOUR BREATH" if you're ready to confront a reality where every breath could be your last. The choice is yours: fight for every liter of air or succumb and become yet another victim of this ruthless world.

title: Digital City
description:
게임 정보
Digital City is a novel simulator intended to support local authorities representatives and urban planners in their day-to-day work. Functioning as a true-to-life digital twin, Digital City replicates real-world traffic scenarios, allowing users to build, test and refine their ideas before implementing them in cities around the world.
Leveraging the power of the Unreal engine, Digital City’s simulations are highly life-like and photorealistic. The simulator creates visualizations of traffic flows, pedestrian movement, and transit operations in unprecedented detail, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions based on real-world dynamics. Furthermore, the simulator creates an immersive user experience where users will experience the urban landscape from the perspectives of various traffic participants, such as pedestrians, car drivers, public transport operators, cyclists, and other stakeholders. This unique feature provides valuable insights into each group’s potential challenges and needs within the urban environment.
Transform how urban planning is conducted with Digital City and unlock the potential of future-ready cities. Harness the power of immersive simulations to design urban environments which prioritize sustainability, safety, and quality of life for all citizens. Experience the future of urban planning today!

title: ARCHETYPE BLUE
description:
게임 정보
「아키타입 블루」는 카드를 수집하고, 활용하고, 강화하는 덱빌딩 로그라이트 게임으로,
플레이어는 전설의 영웅이 되어 동료와 함께 판타지 세계의 다양한 지역으로 원정을 떠나게 됩니다.



※ 개발 중인 화면입니다.

나만의 취향이나 전략으로 구성한 덱을 이용해 원정대를 목적지까지 성공적으로 이끌어보세요.
각종 스킬과 마법 카드를 조합하여 적을 분쇄하는 재미와, 원정대 및 전투에 영향을 주는
수많은 랜덤 요소가 원정을 떠날 때마다 새로운 재미와 몰입감을 선사합니다.
《 플레이할수록 강해지는 나만의 덱 》
플레이어가 사용하는 카드는 공격, 스킬, 축복, 저주, 꿈의 다섯 타입으로 나뉘어집니다.

각 카드가 가진 특성과 효과를 이해하고, 새 카드를 수집하여 강력한 나만의 덱을 만들어보세요.
또한, 원정 중에 카드를 강화하여 위력을 더욱 강하게 만들 수도 있습니다.



※ 개발 중인 화면입니다.
지략만큼 중요한 것은 바로 운!

다양한 상황에서 맞닥뜨리는 랜덤 요소가 원정의 판도를 뒤집을 수도 있습니다.
예상치 못한 상황에 신중하게 대응하여 동료들과 함께 무사히 모험의 끝에 도달합시다.

title: Rogue Souls
description:
게임 정보

When the Lich is released, it unleashes its dark magic upon the world, reviving old spirits, ancient creatures, and new monsters. But in its arrogance, it also brings back ancient Souls; Souls with their will intact, serving no one but their purpose.
Gameplay:
Rogue Souls combines the exploration and looting of a 'Roguelike' with the difficulty of a 'Souls' game, where your skill is everything. Whether defeating all enemies without taking a single hit or facing the weakest enemy repeatedly. Bring various Souls to life with unique abilities and weapons, making each playthrough feel completely different. Wield powerful items to strengthen your character and fulfill your main objective: not to die.
Features:
- 4 different types of Souls.

- 16 usable weapons.

- Randomly generated rooms.

- +20 unique items

title: ANTHEM#9
description:
게임 정보
타인의 눈에 띄지 않는 곳에서 활약하며 세계 질서의 균형을 유지하려는 주인공의 싸움을 그린, 턴제 덱 빌딩 로그라이트. 턴마다 무작위로 주어지는 레드, 그린, 블루 3색 보석을, 순서를 바꿔 나열하면 스킬이 발동되는 독특한 퍼즐 배틀형 전투 시스템을 채용했습니다.

title: Electric Alps
description:
게임 정보
Electric Alps is a 2D puzzle game based on real-world electrical engineering. Explore how electricity works. Plan your circuitry, install devices and solve logic-based wiring problems.

You take on the role of an electrician, returning to the remote village of St. Ampere, nestled in the breathtaking Austrian Alps. Tasked with wiring up homes and structures, you’ll master the principles of electrical engineering. Install cables, switches, and other electrical devices, strategically wiring them up to create functional circuits. Each building is a puzzle, requiring your skills to power it up. Your journey will ultimately transform the village, awakening it from its unpowered slumber. One circuit at a time.
⚡ Based on Real-World Electricity
Explore the fundamentals of electrical engineering, delving into real-world electricity. Understand the principles of current flow and master the art of wiring in this hands-on and educational experience.
🧠 Solve Puzzle-Based Circuitries
Engage wiring challenges that combine logic, strategic planning and your new-found electrical knowledge to solve a variety of puzzles in the world of electrical installations.
🛠️ Utilize a Vast Toolbox
Explore a vast array of devices and appliances as you advance through St. Ampere. From installing sockets to crafting intricate power consumption systems, you master various electrical activities, adding switches, relays, motion detectors, fuses, RCDs and other tools to your toolbox.
🏡 Electrify Your Village
As you advance, St. Ampere around you evolves. Overcoming challenges not only opens up new areas, introduces fresh devices but also revitalizes the village. Homes become inhabited, structures turn usable, and green, sustainable energy production takes center stage, transforming St. Ampere into a vibrant, electrified haven.
⛰️ Enjoy the Alpine Charm
Enjoy Austrian culture and the breathtaking Alps. The picturesque alpine landscapes aren't merely a background, but an integral part of your exploration, adding our Austrian charm to your journey through St. Ampere.

title: EbiTapes
description:
게임 정보

Set off on a cozy-grunge jam journey in EbiTapes, a quirky adventure game where you take on the mission of saving the Annual City Festival. Traverse through intriguing little places, each brimming with mellow vibes and fresh discoveries. Alongside your snarky cat companion, Zongy, dive into the depths of the city, getting to know its people and unraveling its secrets.

Record the sounds you encounter along the tranquil trail to solve puzzles and weave joyful mixtapes. Dance with cows, search for lost slippers, and mend friendships one beat at a time. EbiTapes offers a laid-back experience in a beautifully crafted world for all ages.


Get lost in a completely handcrafted world brought to life by an award winning illustrator!



Meet a friendly cast of characters on your journey! Some might need your help, while others just want to tag along for a while. It's nice to have new friends for your jam sessions!



Your tool to help you on your journey is a sound recorder.
Use it to record interesting sounds in the world and play them back at the right place - you can also make music with it!
The world is filled with amazing sounds! Keep your ears peeled and a sound recorder at hand, you might discover some cool noises that can help in your troubles!



Play little concerts for the locals and make sure that everyone is having a good time when listening to your tapes.
There are no mistakes, just happy little loops. No musical knowledge is required!

title: Dark Heart: 50000
description:
게임 정보
한순간에 모든 것을 잃고 미지의 세계로 던져진 소년 「N」과 함께, 『Dark Heart: 50000』에서 공포와 신비로 가득 찬 세계를 경험해보세요. 「N」은 사랑하는 「S」를 구출하기 위해, 초현실적인 차원을 넘나들며 위험천만한 여정을 시작합니다.
「S」가 곳곳에 남겨둔 흔적만이 그의 유일한 희망입니다. 정교한 퍼즐과 숨막히는 위협들이 가득한 이 세계에서, 「N」은 「S」와 재회할 수 있을까요?
『Dark Heart: 50000』에서 그 해답을 직접 확인해 보십시오.

title: Deer Head
description:
게임 정보
이 공포/퍼즐 어드벤처에서 살아남아라. 살아남고 숲에 사는 복수심에 불타는 사슴 괴물과 싸워라. 카메라로 괴물을 플래시하고 도망쳐라. 숲을 탐험하고 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아내라.
숲을 탐험하라
편안한 숲에서 휴가를 보내기로 했지만... 그것이 저주받은 곳이라는 사실은 예상하지 못했다. 숲을 탐험하고 진실을 밝혀내야 한다.
사슴 머리
무서운 사슴 머리의 악마가 숲에 살고 있으며, 조심하지 않으면 당신을 죽일 것이다. 그게 누구일까...?
카메라
무기는 없다, 오직 너와 너의 카메라만 있다. 카메라를 사용하여 괴물로부터 자신을 보호하고 어둠 속에서 볼 수 있다. 배터리를 조심하라!

title: Heartreasure: Stellar Journey
description:
게임 정보
🪐 Embark on a Cosmic Journey to Find Hidden Hearts ♥! ✨
Step into a storybook-like world filled with beautifully hand-drawn 2D illustrations and embark on a simple yet charming hidden object adventure!
Your journey takes place in the vastness of space! 🛰️🌌
Explore a universe full of unique and whimsical planets, each with its own enchanting scenery.
🌟 Features 🌟
🔍 Find the Hidden Hearts ♥ — Discover cleverly hidden hearts within beautifully illustrated landscapes!
🪐 A Universe of Unique Planets — Travel through different planets, each with its own theme and atmosphere!
🎨 Hand-Drawn Art — Every illustration is lovingly crafted with ballpoint pen, giving it a warm and nostalgic feel!
🖱️ Simple Controls — Just click with your mouse to play, making it easy and relaxing for everyone!
Enjoy a peaceful cosmic adventure and immerse yourself in a world of hidden wonders! 🚀💕

title: Arcade Management Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of arcade nostalgia with Arcade Management Simulator, a detailed simulation where you manage, expand, and transform your arcade into the ultimate entertainment hub.
Manage Your Arcade
Start with a modest arcade and steadily grow your business. Purchase and set up arcade cabinets, gacha machines, and claw machines to create a space your customers will love.
Dynamic Pricing & Gameplay
Set prices for each play session and find the perfect balance between affordability and profit. Test your luck with over 500 collectible gachas and even try your hand at the claw machines.
Sell & Trade
Sell or trade your collected gachas with customers to keep them coming back. List them online for a massive profit.
Host Events
Transform your arcade into the ultimate party destination! Host birthday parties, office gatherings, and other celebrations to bring in waves of excited guests. Enter Fever Mode, where your arcade experiences a surge in activity and doubles your earnings for the duration
Build Your Reputation
Your goal is to make your arcade the most highly-rated spot in town. Clean, repair, and upgrade your facilities to attract more customers and keep them happy.
Expand & Upgrade
Reinvest your profits to expand your arcade, add new attractions, and customize your layout. Unlock advanced machines and create a one-of-a-kind arcade experience.
In Arcade Management Simulator, every choice you make shapes your journey. Can you rise to the challenge and turn your humble arcade into the most legendary entertainment destination?

This is just the beginning we'll have more features added as development progresses.

title: Tree Kingdoms
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the battle of the Tree Kingdoms.
Explore the map, claim territory, upgrade your cities, and expand your empire to survive the winter and lead your kingdom to victory! Tree Kingdoms is a bite-sized 4x strategy game where you control the forest to claim land and secure your domain. How will your touch shape the board this year?

Strategic Turn-based action!


You are a Great Spirit of the forest, the plants and trees your subjects - but you are one of many Great Spirits. In the coming year you must strive to assert your domain before the winter comes and your power is diminished, as even spirits cannot control the seasons.



Expand and develop your territory to unlock new units and strategic advantages!
Eliminating your competition will ensure your survival, giving you space to grow as you please. So too with laying down deep roots to tide you and yours over the winter, as even the frost cannot reach so deep. But for many, sometimes it is just enough to survive the year and face a new spring. How will your touch shape the forest this year?

title: The Panda Who Fell
description:
게임 정보
Story
Everyone has been naive at some point in life. As children, we explored the world with curiosity, not knowing what was safe or dangerous. It was a time of learning, where mistakes were part of the journey. Being naive is a natural step in discovering life’s wonders.
And so was this little panda, who fell into a big, ancient cave, while exploring the wilderness. Guide him through an uncharted underground world, as you race against time to rescue him from the depths of an ancient, forgotten cave.
Gameplay
The Panda Who Fell is a challenging precision platformer with some extra spice:
Get to the top and safe the panda
Master all challenges of the cave
Manage to reach the next Angels monument before time runs out
Discover the cave's mystery

title: ODDLI: A satisfying game
description:
게임 정보
ODDLI(오들리)는 루프(loop)형 플레이에 기반한 캐주얼 퍼즐 게임입니다. 루프형 플레이란, 과거의 자신이 플레이한 패턴을 다시 보아가며 게임을 풀어가는 방식을 뜻합니다. 퍼즐의 장애물은 바로 과거의 나! 플레이어가 선택했던 이전 움직임을 그대로 반복하는 장애물들을 넘어서야만 비로소 목표 지점에 도달할 수 있습니다. 레벨을 클리어해갈 때 마다 과거와 현재가 얽히며 만들어내는 매력적인 루프 플레이를 즐겨보세요.
과거의 자신을 피하며 움직여라!
ODDLI의 규칙은 간단합니다. 캐릭터를 움직여 목표에 도달하기! 하지만 또 하나 더 중요한 규칙이 있으니, 지금 당신의 선택이 곧 다음 퍼즐 장애물로 추가된다는 사실! 과거의 자신과 부딪히지 않으면서 목표지점에 도달할 수 있도록 전략을 짜보세요.

title: Sea of Dreams Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Welcome aboard the Sea of Dreams, can you survive to this nightmare ?
Fend against vast enemy forces, with hundreds of nightmarish foes swarming the screen at any given time.
In this action-packed rogue-lite, you play as one of the survivors trapped aboard the Sea of Dreams.
Slay, adapt, and grow stronger with every wave of enemies—then slay even more!
Upgrade your abilities, and unlock unique perks to adapt to the escalating chaos.
Set in the terrifying universe of Sea of Dreams, this standalone spin-off delivers relentless action in a world steeped in dread and mystery. Will you endure the horrors of The Other World and find your way back, or will you become another lost soul aboard the Sea of Dreams?
The nightmare begins. Will you survive?

title: Prism Warriors DX
description:
게임 정보
Prism Warriors DX is the sequel to the acclaimed retro bullet hell shooter Prism Indigo DX. When Tokyo comes under attack from a mysterious group of evil magical girls calling themselves "the Twilight Four", the Prism Warriors must band together to stop them in their tracks and uncover their true scheme before time runs out...
Play as the whole spectrum
This time, all seven Prism Warriors are playable, each with their own unique Passive skill and rechargeable Special move. From Prism Amber's resilience, to Prism Saffron's rapid-fire assaults, to Prism Aqua's freezing abilities, you're sure to find a Prism Warrior that suits your playstyle.
The new Rainbow difficulty lets you play as all seven Prism Warriors at once, cycling from one to the next each time you lose a life. Be warned, though: should all seven of them fall, you'll have to start over from the beginning...
Overcome all-new challenges

title: xiao wang phone store simulator
description:
게임 정보
Xiao Wang phone store simulator  a mobile phone sales and management simulation game, players through reasonable management, earn money, expand the scale of the store, open the secret room. You will become the owner of Xiao Wang's Repair Shop and expand its scale. By purchasing second-hand mobile phones, refurbishing and repairing them, you can earn gold coins. Then, you can open the mysterious chamber and explore the secrets hidden within.
autokwd: xiao wang phone store simulator,휴대폰 매장 시뮬레이터

title: Card'em All!
description:
게임 정보
Card'em All! is a rogue-like deck-builder with a twist, incorporating the following rules and features:
When you face a wave of enemies, you can do the following:
Use your natural attack, as permitted
Play cards that represent Units, Abilities, or Effects
Units, once deployed, act on their own and use their own attacks and abilities
If you have no units in front, enemy attacks affect you and your health pool.
Several Waves comprise an Encounter.
Your units persist across waves, until the end of an Encounter.
Enemies drop loot in the form of Booty, the fate of which is decided at the end of an Encounter.
At the end of each Encounter you are offered one or more choices for a reward.
These rewards often include cards for your deck.
Certain cards have upkeep and require special attention.
The Booty is added to your Gold pool.
A series of Encounters comprises a Run. Different Runs, across timelines, bring you closer to waking up from the dream sequence and winning the game.
When you die, your dream sequence starts from the beginning with the following changes:
You retain all your deck
You retain half of your gold

title: Dreamland
description:
게임 정보
We see the world through the eyes of Alexey, an ordinary worker at the logistics company "Watcher's Cargo." He has long stopped communicating with his old acquaintances. However, after several unusual incidents, Alexey begins to see symbols. Gathering together, the group decides to uncover the root cause of the events that have occurred to them.
The young people travel through several dimensions, solving puzzles and interpersonal conflicts along the way. But will they be able to overcome themselves and untangle this story? Everything depends entirely on the player and their choices.
This story is just a brief excursion into a vast and mysterious world of dreams. Will it turn into a nightmare?

title: UltraBravoRPG
description:
게임 정보
Ultra Bravo RPG is a pixelated comedy RPG in which you explore a three-dimensional map
while battling enemies by pressing buttons.
Game Features
(1)Press the button to attack the enemy!
Press the button in front of the enemy! Pressing a button mashing! etc.
Press the buttons appropriately to attack enemies!
If successful, it can deal a lot of damage!
Press the button in front of the enemy!

title: Tomb of the Bloodletter
description:
게임 정보
Tomb of the Bloodletter is a strategic word game roguelike that transforms your keyboard into an array of powerful and deadly abilities! Form words using tactical combinations of your letters' powers to defeat the denizens of this dingy tomb, and claim the Bloodletter for yourself...
Choose your graverobber!
The final game will feature 4 unique playable characters, each shaking up the rules of the game and adding new layers of depth to the Tomb. 
Your journey begins with a single word...

title: Chains Of Reality
description:
게임 정보
Come forth and adventure through a journey unlike no other, surviving the depths alone, or with your friends. In Chains Of Reality, the choice is yours, traversing through numerous, strangely liminal environments trying to utilize the limited resources available in each reality, until it is inevitably unsustainable. 
UNIQUE GAMEPLAY UNLIKE ANY OTHER
Chains Of Reality has it all; core survival game mechanics, huge crafting, currency and inventory system, immersive adventures, a beautiful storyline, and base building inside of liminal spaces while trying to survive just another day. Maybe its the environment that's slowly killing you, maybe its the lack of resources, or maybe its what lurks out there..
IMMERSIVE GRAPHICS
Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Chains Of Reality is a stunning visual experience that'll be sure to cause you to feel immersed within the unique environments found throughout the game.
UNIQUE STORYLINE
Trapped here against your will, unbeknownst of what's to come, you play as the main protagonist who is just trying to make it through another day, and put the pieces together to solve the final puzzle; why we are here. Uncover the mysteries that lie throughout, solving problems on your own while experiencing emotion, character development, and more as you drive yourself closer to the end. Will you end up like the rest, the ones who lose themselves? Or will you manage to be the first victor, conqueror of the unknown..
STRANGE, UNIQUE ENVIRONMENTS
Chains Of Reality hosts a plethora of oddly familiar environments popular within The Backrooms fanbase. Explore strange architecture that scratches that liminal feeling deep within your mind, be at ease with calming forest and ocean environments, or feel unsettled within deep, abandoned, and creepy structures and environments. It's ultimately your choice where you choose to reside in this universe, just make sure its sustainable!

title: AstroScaper
description:
게임 정보

AstroScaper is a minimalist puzzle city-builder where every placement counts. Build colonies on asteroids using strategic proximity-based mechanics and minimal resource management. Relax in freebuild mode or chase high scores in challenge mode – all against a serene cosmic backdrop.

AstroScaper is being crafted by a two-person team in early development. Heavily inspired by Islanders, the game will share a similar scope and vibe while introducing fresh ideas in a sci-fi setting.

We’re pouring our hearts into this little universe and welcome you along for the journey. Feel free to share feedback and ideas!
CHALLENGE MODE - CORE GAMEPLAY
In Challenge Mode, you'll progress through a series of asteroids, each demanding thoughtful placement of your structures. Buildings earn points based on proximity bonuses, encouraging clever arrangements and strategic thinking. There’s no rush – take your time to plan and refine your layout to maximize your score. Future seasonal leaderboards and events will offer fresh challenges and friendly competition.
FREEBUILD MODE - CASUAL CREATIVITY
Prefer to relax and just build? Freebuild Mode lets you pick any asteroid seed and create without limits or pressure. Construct a peaceful space town for the fun of it – no scores, no game-overs. Simply enjoy the meditative experience of building among the stars and grab some screenshots.
ROBUST CAMERA CONTROLS

title: Black Equation
description:
게임 정보
A fantasy tale of magic, secrets, and love — hidden behind a delicate balance of numbers.
This is not just a game. It’s an interactive book where you juggle resources, and every number reflects a world collapsing under the weight of its own myths.
You’ll uncover 29 chapters — a complete novel with illustrations, atmosphere, and deep characters.
The text is written entirely by hand, without the help of AI — every word born from real experience and imagination.
Manage magic, destruction, and souls while keeping balance.
Immerse yourself in a dark kingdom filled with intrigue and secrets.
Features gothic ink-style illustrations.
Themes of inner struggle, love, and identity.
Perfect for fans of Sarah J. Maas, Leigh Bardugo, Patrick Rothfuss, and Andrzej Sapkowski.
For those who seek not action, but atmosphere. Not a battle — but depth.

title: Lavender Field
description:
게임 정보
STORY:
Cold walls. An empty room. A missing sister… Chloe has no choice but to unravel this mystery—no matter how difficult it may be to move forward.
Chloe, a young girl with a disability, and her older sister Kamila have faced many hardships. Despite everything, Kamila has always done her best to help Chloe reclaim a sense of normalcy. But now, Kamila is gone, and Chloe is trapped in a crumbling house filled with eerie silence and unanswered questions.
Immerse yourself in a haunting visual novel where the bond between two sisters is tested by an unknown force. As Chloe searches for a way out, she must navigate eerie rooms, uncover hidden objects, and piece together the secrets buried deep within these walls.
With every discovery, memories resurface, unveiling the complex relationship between the sisters and the hidden truths of their family's past.
Can you escape? And more importantly—can you uncover what truly happened to Kamila?
FEATURES:
🔹 Multiple locations – Each scene pulls you deeper into the game's immersive atmosphere.
🔹 Item search – Explore your surroundings, find hidden objects, and use them to progress.
🔹 Gradual story unveiling – No clear answers at the start—the mystery unfolds step by step.
🔹 Atmospheric soundtrack – Tense, haunting melodies heighten the suspense and intrigue.

title: Gunjutsu
description:
게임 정보
GUNJUTSU
💥 TRICKSHOTTING IS BACK. This is for the ones who never stopped spinning.
GUNJUTSU is a tribute to the golden age of Trickshotting—built for those who lived through the OG console era and designed to feel just like the good old days.
🎯 Master the Art of Trickshotting
Work your way down the 'Trickshot Iceberg', a fully-fledged tutorial system that will teach you every skill.
⚡ A Perfect Balance of Skill & Creativity
For the OG Trickshotters: A game with depth, challenge, and variety.
For newcomers: A step-by-step system that helps you grow into a Trickshot master.
HOW IT PLAYS:
🔥 Stay Airborne – Earn points only while in the air—land, and your score resets!
💀 Trick & Shoot – You only bank points if you hit the target.
🧩 A Puzzle-Shooter Like No Other – Every level is an open-ended Trickshot puzzle.
🎮 Compete Worldwide with quantitative skills – Climb the global Leaderboards and prove you're the best Trickshotter alive.
🚀 Wishlist GUNJUTSU now.

title: End Turn
description:
게임 정보
** End Turn is in early development—features and balance are subject to change as the game evolves.
---------------------------------------
End Turn is a minimalist auto deckbuilding roguelike where your hand plays itself, enemies count down to take you out in one hit, and your goal is to build a deck strong enough to win before time runs out.
Each turn, cards are drawn and autoplayed, setting off a chain reaction of abilities, combos, and resource generation. Draft powerful cards, stack strong synergies, and collect treasures that can turn the odds in your favor. But be careful—if an enemy’s countdown reaches zero, it’s game over.
Between turns, use your winnings to buy new cards and treasures that shape your strategy. Manage your resources, experiment with builds, and push your deck to its limits to take down every enemy before calamity strikes.
Runs are fast, choices matter, and every deck is an opportunity to try something new. Adapt, optimize, and do your best to survive—because in the end, it’s either them or you.

title: G.M.M
description:
게임 정보
G.M.M (Guerrier Mages and Metamorphes) is a turn-based 2D RPG.
Story
Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman and his mage friend Vard.
During one of their mission, they will encounter a metamorph of the wolf clan with serious wound.
But by helping him, they will put themself into a major conflict between several country.
Travel the world to gain new allies.
Level up your allies to learn new techniques.
Fight enemies in turn-based battles

title: Riftseekers
description:
게임 정보
Use abilities and powerups to defeat enemies, avoid traps, collect gems, and score enough points to summon bosses. Defeat these bosses to complete stages and open rifts to randomized biomes. Collect upgrades between stages to make sure you can survive. In this endless arcade-style roguelike, how many points can you get?

title: Monster Pod Quest
description:
게임 정보
Monster Pod Quest is a first-of-its-kind creature collector RPG where you build your own monsters, each of which is completely unique to your playthrough.
Create new creatures and play through infinite dynamic worlds, powered by a custom-made image generator. Every monster is unique!
All the artists whose pixel art was used for training are credited in the game, and all the art was either purchased or freely available under a creative commons license (more details below).
Gameplay
Monster Pod Quest is a party-based creature collecting RPG, but with unlimited possibilities for the monsters you may encounter and create.
Create, train and customise your party of unique monsters.
Gather the meat and bones of your enemies to grow new allies in pods.
Breed new powerful species.
Journey across procedurally generated worlds to challenge the bosses of the land.
Defeat enemies in strategic turn-based party battles, using each monster's special moves.
Every playthrough is unique: monsters, tiles, moves, quests, and the map are all procedurally generated.
Show off and trade your creatures online.
About the AI
All the pixel art training data was either free to use commercially (Creative Commons license), or assets which I bought. A huge thank you to all the artists involved - see in-game credits for names.
MPQ is not about replacing human art with AI-made images - it is a new type of game entirely, with creatures and worlds generated during gameplay based on player choices. This isn't possible without AI, and has not been done before.

title: single spark
description:
게임 정보
Dual Management, Strategy Reigns Supreme
Guild Economy System
Become not just a battle commander, but a shrewd financial steward! Balance hero salaries, equipment purchases, and dynamic decisions like tax policies and adventurer benefits to ensure your team’s survival and growth amid monster invasions. Every coin you invest yields returns—adventurers will use spare funds to train, upgrade gear, and sharpen their skills!
Class Synergies & Relic Combos
Unlock powerful united strength effects by strategically pairing heroes of different classes. Combine these with mystical relics to forge an adventurer army unlike any other.
Dynamic Policies, Adapt to Survive
Policy Crafting
Respond to your guild’s evolving challenges with tailored policies. Shift strategies between crisis management and rapid growth—cut taxes to retain talent during a recession, or slash benefits to fund emergency defenses against a demonic siege. Survive bankruptcy today to thrive tomorrow!
Roguelike Adventures
Quests & Random Events
Dispatch teams on randomly generated quests, face unpredictable events, and encounter diverse heroes to recruit. Every choice reshapes your path to victory.
A Unique DBG Twist
Sacrifice isn’t always defeat. Will you nurture your veterans into legends, or embrace attrition as a strategy? Sometimes, fallen heroes leave rare relics… and bold heroes emerge when rewards are high.

title: Busy Cowboy
description:
게임 정보
Busy Cowboy , a game about building a small town to fend off monsters Pull out your revolver and shoot fast!
The town will be attacked by monsters every night, allocate coins wisely, build town defenses, and defend the town.

title: At the Bottom
description:
게임 정보
Only when you hit rock bottom can you truly see the light.
Will you dare to take the plunge?
Feel the collapse of your country.
The world’s cracking at the seams. Some still cling to yesterday, others already crawling in the dirt of a new reality. Life’s grinding wheel crushes the weak and spits them out—but if you’re ruthless enough, you might slip through.
You’re a nobody. Just a beggar in an underground tunnel.
But poverty’s got rules of its own.
Day by day, you learn to survive—reading people, finding their weak spots, twisting them to your advantage. Step by step, you build your crew from the same outcasts. A new kind of family. A street family.
The world didn’t ask who you want to be. It decided for you.
But can you claw your way to the top?
 Your tools of survival:
Beg
Sniff out what breaks people—guilt, fear, or shame—and squeeze them for every coin they’ve got.
Recruit misfits
That legless war vet? Useless to most. The shady street musician? Weird vibes. The blind fortune teller? Creepy but convincing. All of them could be gold.
Run shady deals
What brings in more cash — offering desperate souls a date with the porcelain throne or peddling some shady pies?
Steal what’s yours
The rich won’t miss it. You deserve it. Fair's fair, right?
 Grow your gang
More beggars, more turf, more power. Become the legend whispered through alleyways.

title: Inkventure
description:
게임 정보
A slimy dad on a gooey rescue mission!
 A lazy afternoon turns chaotic when a mysterious bucket sucks Gloop’s four mischievous kids into a vibrant, color-filled dimension. Now it's up to him—a lovable slime and single dad—to jump inside, master the art of color shifting, and rescue his quirky children!
 Match Gloop’s color to the floors as you carefully navigate each stage. Watch your step, because touching the wrong color spells disaster! Shift between green, red, blue, and yellow by touching buckets filled with colorful ink to safely reach Gloop’s adorable kids and bring them back home.
 Along the way, you’ll encounter tricky obstacles. Push boxes matching Gloop’s current color to climb higher platforms, and open locked doors by finding and activating levers of the correct color to advance your journey.
 Ready to jump, splash, and slime your way through the ink dimension? Gloop’s family depends on you!
 The game also includes the Megadrive ROM file you can burn and play on your original hardware if you have it!
Features:
Delightful 2D puzzle-platforming action
Charming, colorful pixel-art visuals
Color-changing mechanics
40 challenging levels
Family-friendly story featuring lovable slime characters across numerous cutscenes
Optional Time Rewind feature - fix your mistakes!
Supports both 16:9 and 4:3 aspect ratio modes
Optional CRT shader for retro visuals

title: LootMage
description:

LootMage(루트메이지)는 중세 판타지 세계를 배경으로 한 마법 탄막 슈팅 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다.

끊임없이 쏟아지는 적들의 공격을 회피하며 마법을 활용해 스릴있는 전투를 경험하세요.

title: Pingbert's Snow Ride
description:
게임 정보
Slide down in Pingbert’s Snow Ride, an endless high-speed platformer where you take control of Pingbert, the cheerful penguin mail carrier. Glide above snowy hills, dodge obstacles, avoid falling off the edge, and deliver mail faster than ever while pulling off slick moves like drifting, spinning, and diving! Earn coins as you play to improve Pingbert's cozy cabin, which doubles as a humble mail postal service, and unlock a variety of useful upgrades and stylish customizations!
Slide, drift, spin, and glide your way through Bubble Mountain. Nail these moves to fullfill your duty as a mail carrier penguin and rack up high scores!

title: Bomb Vehicle Idle Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Bomb Vehicle is an idle-loot-rpg game that blends elements of post-apocalyptic survival, biohazard crisis, vehicle customization, and explosive action. In this game, players drive their meticulously crafted battle vehicles across the wasteland, exploring unknown territories and eliminating hordes of zombies.
The game is set in a world thrown into chaos due to an outbreak of a mysterious virus, where most humans have turned into ferocious zombies, societal structures have collapsed, and resources are extremely scarce. To survive in this new world, players must gather resources, build and upgrade their vehicles and weapons, and use them to explore the world and eliminate zombie swarms.
In Bomb Vehicle, players can:
Collect Vehicles: The game features a wide array of battle vehicles that can be collected through various means. Each vehicle boasts unique designs, performance characteristics, and special abilities that play crucial roles in different combat scenarios.
Customize Vehicles: Craft your own exclusive battle vehicle by equipping it with different engines, chips, armor, and special abilities. You can even outfit your vehicle with various turrets, from conventional machine guns to high-tech energy cannons.
Reinforce Vehicles: Gather materials to enhance your vehicle. In this challenging post-apocalyptic world, a meticulously enhanced vehicle will not only help you better deal with threats from zombies and other hostile forces but also allow you to progress further in the game.
Loot and Grow: Obtain rare equipment and materials by defeating enemies and completing quests, boosting the power of your vehicle. Every success will give you more confidence when facing greater threats.
Strengthen Weapons: Equipment can be enhanced and synthesized to create even more powerful gear. A carefully enhanced and advanced synthesis weapon set is key to maintaining an advantage in combat.
Explore the World: Traverse desolate city ruins, radiation-contaminated zones, forests, and other perilous areas in search of valuable supplies and potential allies. Each region is filled with challenges and opportunities waiting for brave explorers to uncover.
Combat and Survival: Confront hordes of zombies and other adversaries, using your wisdom and tactical advantages to win battles. Properly configure your vehicle setup to ensure combat readiness under any circumstances.
Continuously Unlocked New Combat Enhancement Modules: Such as Brain Slurry Amplifier, Brainwave Disruptor, Z Virus, Support Bomber... These will provide significant boosts to your battles.

BUILD SCRAP is a deck-building roguelike with mass elements and customizability through markings, offering a more diverse and strategic combat experience.


Whether attacking, avoiding, or defending, sometimes you can use your enemies to take advantage of the stage.



You can customize the performance of your cards by synthesizing marks on them, allowing you to fight with your own unique cards and your own unique strategy.

Get through various situations created by unique enemies.

title: Prison of Lies
description:
게임 정보


Four prisoners on death row are cleared of all charges. But the prison has a quota to meet. The four are put in a room and asked to decide among themselves over the course of an hour... who will be the one to die?

Prison of Lies is a psychological linear visual novel about lies, trust, and empathy. There are four chapters, each of which get progressively shorter.

While playing the game, you uncover more about each prisoner.

It takes approximately half an hour to play.
Features

Original soundtrack
Bios and other extras
Non-linear storytelling

title: DodgeKill
description:
게임 정보
DodgeKill is not your typical game. Here, there's no character to control—your cursor is the one taking all the action!
Minimalist yet dynamic
A game visually simple, some geometric shapes, a few colors, and that's all.
But if we combine all this, we get a game with varied enemies and complex challenges!
Easy to learn, hard to master
Is it playable with only the mouse ? Absolutely! 
You just need to move the cursor. But make no mistake, even if the controls are simple, the game remains no less complicated! 
(Controllers and touchscreens are also compatible 🙂)
Gameplay
A unique gameplay playable entirely with the mouse
Various level filled with surprises, for increasingly difficult challenges
A tough difficulty that tests your nerves and will give you great satisfaction with each victory
Simple and intuitive controls, accessible to all players
Challenges available to increase the difficulty even more
 Ready to take on the challenge ?

게임 정보
Deus Mantle is a progression-based survival sandbox, where you find yourself exploring infinite procedurely-generated worlds full of danger and mystery.
Get prepared to face dangerous creatures to fulfill the will of the gods, and through these hardships you may just find your way home.

Find tasty chilli peppers in Sandy Desert, dig up snowballs in Snowy Forest and get lost in Deep Forest looking for those precious berries.
Advance through technology tree, unlocking different items, buildings and game mechanics.

title: The Tale of Azu
description:
게임 정보
특징
🌿 신화 세계로의 모험 - 현실과 신화를 넘나드는 신비로운 모험 속에서 색다른 세계를 탐험하세요
🐾 고양이의 액션 - 민첩한 움직임과 다채로운 스킬로 펼쳐지는 귀엽고 역동적인 액션
🐺 성장과 강화 - 아즈를 훈련하고 강화하여, 모험 속의 강력한 적들과 맞서세요
🎭 감동적인 스토리 - 잃어버린 누나 고양이를 향한 아즈의 가슴 따뜻한 여정을 함께하세요
줄거리
대한민국 어딘가, 아직 어린티를 완전히 벗지 못한 소년 고양이, 아즈가 살고 있다.
아즈는 세상에서 가장 행복한 고양이였다.
누나 고양이 모카가 곁을 떠나기 전까지는...
모카는 아즈의 둘도 없는 동료이자, 아즈에게 고양이로서 살아가는 법을 가르쳐준 스승이었다.
그런 모카가 떠난 이후, 아즈는 마음 어딘가가 빈 것만 같아 견딜 수가 없었다.
집사는 모카가 무지개 다리를 건너서 먼 곳으로 떠나버렸다고,
그래서 이제는 아즈가 자기를 지켜줘야 한다고 했다.
집사를 지키는 것 쯤이야 별 문제 없었지만, 아즈는 궁금해서 참을 수가 없었다.
항상 함께였던 모카가, 자신을 두고 가버린 무지개 다리란 곳은 어떤 곳일까.
그렇게 말도 없이 갑작스레 떠나버릴만큼, 신나는 곳일까.
자신도 그 곳에 가면 모카를 다시 만날 수 있을까…
궁금증은 모카와 함께했던 기억들이 옅어져갈수록, 그 자리를 대신하려는 듯이 강렬해졌다.
그래서 어느 날, 아즈는 모카를 찾아, 무지개 다리를 찾아 떠나기로 결심한다.
아즈가 알고 있는 가장 똑똑한 존재인 까마귀 아저씨조차도,
무지개 다리가 어디에 위치한지는 알지 못했다.
그래도 아즈는 무지개 다리를 찾아야만 했다. 내일 해가 뜨면 무작정 밖으로 나가보기로 했다.
어디로 갈까, 그런데 어떻게 밖에 나갈까. 모르겠다. 일단 든든하게 밥을 많이 먹어두자...
이런저런 생각을 하다 보니 어느새 아즈는 잠이 들고 만다.
그리고 눈을 떠보니, 낯선 대지 위였다.
당신은 집사로서 아즈가 이 모험을 완수하고, 모카와 재회할 수 있도록 도와야합니다.

title: Secret of the Abbey
description:
게임 정보
This is an atmospheric first-person game set in the 18th century. The game is filled with various puzzles that players must solve to progress through the storyline and unlock new locations. The puzzles vary in complexity and diversity.
In addition to puzzles, many notes can be found in the locations, revealing past events and helping to immerse players in the game's atmosphere. By collecting all the notes, the player will uncover the full story of what is happening.
The game emphasizes atmosphere and immersion, achieved through photorealistic environments, sound effects, and animations.

title: The Spiral
description:
게임 정보
The Spiral is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Explore the dungeon, find tools for your survival, and try to escape with your life.
Descend into Darkness
Explore an infinite dungeon with randomized layouts, items, and enemies. No two playthroughs are the same.
Find Powerful Equipment
Make use of the dungeon's bounty to survive. Simple farming tools, legendary weapons, curious potions, and enchanted charms are all at your disposal.
Fight for Your Life
You are not alone. Monsters, nightmares, and other desperate wanderers like you all call the dungeon home. Kill them before they kill you.

title: Dobbel Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
신비로운 저주가 땅을 지배한다…
마법의 충격파가 섬 전체를 휩쓸자, 모든 종류의 야생 동물이 괴물로 변해 지역 주민을 향해 저항하기 시작합니다… 파티를 모으고, 주사위를 굴리고, 섬을 가로질러 전투를 하며 강력한 저주를 완전히 끝내세요!

title: Scorched Warfare
description:
게임 정보
높은 하늘 위에서 균열이 서서히 펼쳐집니다.
성벽 아래에서는 수많은 군대가 성문을 뚫고 들어옵니다.
당신은 제국의 장군이 되어 분쟁의 시작점으로 돌아가, 모든 것을 근본적으로 바꾸려 합니다...
부대를 지휘하며 전투
다양한 부대와 함께 싸우며, 중세 판타지 전장을 몰입감 있게 체험하세요.
전술 모드
직접 적을 물리칠 뿐만 아니라, 전술 모드에서 모든 부대에 대해 세부적인 계획을 세울 수 있습니다.
Roguelite 부대 구성
게임을 진행하면서 독창적인 부대 빌드를 구성하며, 다양한 전투 스타일을 경험해 보세요!
영웅 성장
게임 진행에 따라 영웅은 강력한 기술들을 연속적으로 해금합니다.

title: Betroyal
description:
게임 정보
Betroyal is a fast-paced roguelite turn-based tactical game, that took best from roguelike tactics genre. Pass through regions full of encounters, hire and upgrade units, get epic perks, abilities and items fro your commander and kill all bosses. And again, but with crazy build that you always wanted to try.

Build up your camp to draft more powerful and rare units, and unlock new perks for the protagonist.

The sheer variety of tactical and strategic options makes Betroyal a true treat for any ardent fans of the roguelite genre.
Core Features:

Hundreds of builds for your commander from classic to the most insane
A new look at a turn-based combat system
Three regions with procedural generations of encounters
50+ units, including Meat Wagon and Swine Lord, to hire and upgrade with more than 200 individual abilities
Camp building to unlock devastating possibilities
Narrative image of father-daughter relationships without tons of texts
Classic tactics and roguelite features, including numerous commander builds, procedural map generation, and high replay value

title: Master of Luna
description:
게임 정보
Master of Luna is a turn-based strategy game where you take the role of a half-forgotten deity seeking to regain their former power and ascend once again.
Multi-Layered Strategy

There's a lot of things happening all around. Cities grow and spread out across the map. Heroes gain levels and change classes. You learn new spells and expand your domain. AI opponents lurk in the dark. In the midst of it all, you must find a path to victory.

Besides the world map, the game has tactical combat, where you have to masterfully outmaneuver the enemy. Or just summon a bunch of creatures, that works as well.
Melancholic Vibe

Luna is a world of eternal twilight, illuminated by the blue light of two moons and shrouded in thick mist. Dreams and memories mean a lot in this place.

The world has gone through many cycles of sleep and awakening. It’s ancient, so there are lot of mysteries, shattered ruins, heroes of old and eldritch artifacts.
Respectful Attitude

Master of Luna respects its players. You make few decisions, but they matter a lot. There is no micromanagement or tedious tasks. Feedback is instantaneous. At no point you supposed to just hit “End Turn” over and over waiting for some bar to fill up. Creatures have few abilities, yet they are tangible. UI is straightforward and uses the same scheme for world and combat. Important information is explained in tooltips.

title: Whimsical Heroes
description:
게임 정보


In a land once flowing with milk and honey, resources suddenly began to run out. Sensing the impending end of the world as they knew it, the three heroes embark on a journey through unknown lands to uncover the mystery behind this life-sustaining energy crisis.

Conquer all in tactical, turn-based battles set on a hexagonal grid. Lead a team of cartoon heroes - the brave bean explorer, the fluffy cat defender, and the onion musician from distant realms - through a series of adventures in Whimsical Heroes!

title: Rebirth of Arcadia
description:
게임 정보
전략적인 턴제 전투
최대 5명의 캐릭터를 조작하며, 전략적인 포지셔닝과 이동, 그리고 통제 지역(ZOC)을 활용해 적을 혼란에 빠뜨리세요. 액션 포인트(AP)를 현명하게 사용하고, 상황에 따라 강력한 콤보를 만들어 여러 적을 공격하거나 방어를 강화하세요.
스킬 변환 시스템
전장에서 원소 에너지를 활용하여 스킬의 잠재력을 끌어내고, 전투 중 일시적으로 더 강력한 능력으로 변환할 수 있습니다.
캐릭터 커스터마이징
쓰러뜨린 적에게서 유전자를 모아 패시브 스킬을 획득하고, 룬스톤 시스템을 통해 캐릭터의 스킬을 강화하며 전략에 맞춰 추가 효과를 부여하세요.
심연 탐험
스토리 전투를 통해 심연의 미스터리를 풀고, 무작위로 생성된 스테이지에서 싸워 캐릭터를 강화하세요.



심연이라 불리는 깊은 구덩이에 떨어져 목숨을 잃은 소년 솔로몬. 그러던 중, 용의 팔을 가진 미스터리한 인물 루비누스와 그의 파트너 에스메랄다가 솔로몬의 비참한 시신을 발견합니다. 그들은 고향 아르카디아의 룬스톤 기술을 이용해 심연에 대해 더 많이 알기 위해 솔로몬을 되살리기로 합니다.

자신들이 있는 장소에 대한 지식이 부족하다는 것을 깨달은 두 사람은 위험한 생물과 거대한 육식 동물이 배회하는 미지의 영역으로 발을 들여놓습니다. 두 사람은 이 위험한 환경에서 목숨을 걸고 싸워 지상으로 돌아가는 방법을 찾아야 합니다.

title: Halberd Black
description:
게임 정보
Halberd Black is an action-adventure JRPG set thousands of years into the future of our galaxy, where you play as a Stark, a genetically engineered human being caught in a struggle to survive and protect those he holds most dear from those who'd wish him harm. Explore the rich story of the Halberd Black universe and explore the beautiful landscapes, and dense city streets and enjoy combat reminiscent of the JRPGs of old ( With a Modern Twist ). Fight a wide variety of enemies using a dynamic turn-based combat system. Explore new environments as you seek strength to fight back against the powerful megacorporation that is after you and your friends. Only through grit and determination will you be able to fight against the threats that are coming your way. The only question is, do you have what it takes?

title: Chyss
description:
게임 정보
Chyss is a turnbased, tactical 1vs1 game based on chess.
You can move, attack, and consume your mana to spells and use items when it's your turn.
Your goal is to destroy your opponent's Leader!

The year is 12022.
Number of civilisations evolved from primitive life to being able to travel the universe.
In this universe, a game has evolved to become essential: The Chyss.

The Chyss has its roots in chess, but many have added to the rules in order to create its successor. A timeless, universal, and balanced game, allowing interplanetary competition, where fair play, game intelligence and risk-taking are the traits of legendary players.
Young children want to become great Chyss players, the vast majority of adults play, whether to have fun, relax, explore the possibilities, or to pursue their childhood dreams.

In this universe, a phenomenon affects about a third of the people...
About a third of people become incarnates overnight. Falling asleep as themselves, they wake up controlled by different, higher forces.
These forces do not want their loss, but simply direct their steps, their actions.

You are this higher force which is going to take control of an inhabitant of this universe.
You, and all the other players of this video game...
You will embody an incarnate.

This incarnate is now you.
Your goal will be determined by you. You can become the best Chyss player in the universe, but there are many pitfalls along the way.
There are many extremely strong, clever players in this universe.
The best Chyss player in the universe is anonymous. She is only known as "The Galaxy Queen".
Good luck! And battle with pride.

title: Lamia's Bambina
description:
게임 정보
Train the best, most powerful Lamias!
WORLD
In an impoverished demon world ravaged by the war between man and beast, the Lamia tribe are on the verge of extinction.

Ivy, reincarnated into the demon world as the Lamia tribe's savior, along with princess Hedera aim for the revival of their tribe. Play as Ivy as you multiply and raise Lamias and battle the Harpy tribe to reclaim the Lamia Palace.
DUNGEONS
Battles take place in demon world dungeons with familiar 2D maps. Explore the dungeons again and again and defeat the bosses waiting in their depths.
Classic command-style turn-based battles. The key to good battle strategy is to form your party to take advantage of each Lamia's characteristics, choosing from Lamias skilled at physical attacks to those specializing in magic attacks. Lead your Lamias to victory.
Not only will you find Lamias, but you'll also see Harpies, Fairies, and other familiar monsters complete with up-tempo*** conversations and stories in an enjoyable pixel art demon world.

The Lamia training system is scheduled to be released in Summer 2024, when Japan is scorching hot.

Don't miss the latest Lamia's Bambina ("LamiBam") information!

title: The Bugs Manor 🦋
description:
게임 정보

The Bugs Manor is a free top-down 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay focused on direct interactions with the environment.



The haunted house is full of dangerous creatures, you will need to use the stealth and your wits to escape, but be careful, because if you fail, a bloody death waits for you.



Can you overcome the enigmatic challenges of the manor? Solve multiple puzzles through inventory-free gameplay. This allows you to interact directly with the environment and items without the interruption of annoying menus.



Uncover the dark secrets of the evil Bugs home and its numerous rooms. Follow the story of Danny, a kid who has just moved into the house and is spending his first night there alone. But maybe he's not as alone as he believes...

title: Dicey Birdball
description:
게임 정보
Dicey Birdball is a roguelike strategy sports game where you manage a team of birds playing football. Roll dice and assign them to your birds to maneuver, score goals, and win the championship. Enact leaguewide rule changes to evolve the sport of Birdball, from increasing the size of the field to summoning iceberg obstacles to touchdown teleportation.

Each run you'll take control of a different team with their own unique story and objective. Win enough matches to make it to the championship and fulfill the team's objective. Between matches you'll make decisions to improve the team such as gaining new abilities, drafting new dice, and enacting new rules.

Feature List:
Compete in turn-based, grid-based football matches using a team of up to 3 birds from 5 different classes.
Manage a team of different bird classes, each with their own unique set of abilities.
Spend seeds on new dice to increase the number of moves you can make each turn.
Guide the evolution of the sport by choosing which rules change over time, such as expanding the field and allowing alternate scoring mechanism.
Unlock new teams with different bird combinations to play with.
Unlock the ability to create your own team with custom colors and team composition.

title: Sacred Constellars: Ruin Raiders
description:
게임 정보
Ruin Raiders, a daring few who risk everything to explore ancient second-era tombs. With the promise of great rewards, they unearth relics of immense power, remnants of a bygone era. The Church of Eion strives to secure these artifacts, sealing them away in heavily guarded vaults. Yet, some relics slip through, disrupting the status quo. This is one such story....
Charming 2D Pixel Art Style.
Master tactics to overcome many battles.
Unique boss fights that are more than just HP sponges or enemies that simply hit harder.
Interact with a fleshed out and unique world that melds fantasy and elements of science fiction.
Create bonds with your fellow party members. Up to twelve interesting characters.
20+ hour story rich role playing campaign.

title: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara
description:
게임 정보
It all starts with Captain Disaster answering a distress call from a mysterious ship... but it ends up with a planet desperate to rekindle its geothermal energy source, and the long-lasting legacy of an intergalactic empire long consigned to the history books. The planet houses a secret that none of its inhabitants are aware of...

Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara features a contextual one-click interface, a host of colourful characters, devious puzzles, detailed cartoon style graphics, full voicing and an original soundtrack. You play as the adventurous but not altogether bright eponymous Captain, aided (sometimes) by your ship's computer, Zero-Bit, as you help a race of aliens whose complex history is largely unknown, even to themselves.



This game is a collaboration between award-winning developers Dave Seaman (multiple AGS Awards for Captain Disaster in: Death Has A Million Stomping Boots & other games) and Lorenzo Boni (winner of the $106 Adventure Game Challenge for Where Did the Humans Go? and an AGS Award). These two amiable lunatics have been point & click adventure game fans for many years and they have collaborated previously on small games and even a children's book, but nothing approaching the scale and scope of this new Captain Disaster game!

(Playing the two previous Captain Disaster games is not necessary for this one, although there will be some references to events in the earlier games, and even a returning character from Stomping Boots...)

The soundtrack is being composed by , a recent finalist in the , whose previous work includes the OST for .

Making this game together has been a real joy and we hope that comes across in the game, and we sincerely hope you have as much fun playing it as we are having making it. , without revealing much in terms of the game's overall theme. If you find the demo a little bit too easy, don't worry - we deliberately made it reasonably simple, bigger challenges await in the full game.



It's absolutely designed to be enjoyed by all ages! The storyline contains complex themes and some of the puzzles will definitely challenge all but the most hardened point-and-clickers (I'm talking about people who completed games like Monkey Island 2, The Dig and Lucy's Dreaming without ever resorting to hints!!), but at the same time it will always contain humour and animation to delight younger players. Naturally some references in the game will require a certain knowledge of adventure games, sci-fi shows and movies, etc, but these are not essential to playing the game or solving the puzzles, just an added extra.

title: Play Rough
description:
게임 정보
THE WORLD
A hundred years in the future, the dregs of the human race struggle to survive in a contradictory world of VIOLENCE, MAGIC, and LIVING CARTOONS.
Guide the sheltered psychic Beau Chartreuse in a turn-based RPG journey through the ruins of California, meeting strange assets and stranger enemies. A world where brutality reigns supreme and kindness is never easy… A world that frays at the edges, allowing something wonderful in!
THE PARTY
All of this is a lot for just you and Beau, so it’s good that you’ve got some strong allies on your side!
Oh, I’m sorry. It’s just a fox and an old man. They’re both bitter and full of regrets, but who isn’t? I’m sure that Valentine and Dr. Woland will have their uses.
Or they may stab you in the back. You can never be sure of people, these days. Best not to get too attached.
THE OPPOSITION
Men and women, clowns and dreams and cartoons and nightmares! This world is full of things that will want to take your money, your life, or something worse.
With every enemy a unique encounter, it’s up to you to decide exactly how much you’re willing to bite off!
Will you blaze through the world, hunting for every enemy while putting your party’s health at risk? Or will you cautiously hoard your money and food for those foes you can’t avoid?

title: Look Locked
description:
게임 정보
"Look Locked": A co-op puzzle game where doors only open, if you can see them being opened. Work together, time your actions, and communicate to unravel challenges. Coordination and observation lead to victory!
 
 Two Player Co-Op
Unique Puzzles
Challenging Gameplay
 
The effect of each of your actions will only take place for the other player if they have seen that action.
 
More content will be added with updates, and with the later coming "Level-Editor" the fun won't stop!

title: NeuroSquad - Slay the Horde
description:
게임 정보

NeuroSquad is a Bullet Heaven / Action Roguelite game, where you can design your own guns by building them up modularly. Summon a group of holographic soldiers who fight alongside you as you control the whole squad!
In this game no upgrade is tied to a specific weapon, you can freely choose which gun gets which modifications.


Choose from a wide variety of pickups and upgrades! Customize your own attacks and discover powerful synergies! Set up your auto-attacking soldiers using neuro-implants. Summon them, make them stronger, turn them into killing machines!









Humanity is in the process of stepping out of the biological era. Brain enhancement, neural chips, and other body augmentations are part of this new reality. But a change this drastic was never going to happen without conflict and catastrophes.

Now it's your turn to face their hordes. The latest weapon types, such as the laser shotgun and biosense mines, as well as augmentations like the cyber aura will help you become stronger and wipe out the AI bots.

With each death you become more powerful. Each night is a new opportunity to save the future.

title: Dark Age Dinos
description:
게임 정보
Travel alone or with friends through the land of Cretacia - a land of war, banditry and dinosaurs. Each mission is a short, self-contained journey with its own enemies, ability combinations, loot and objectives. Your friend can't make it tonight? They can join you on the next mission tomorrow without getting left behind. Or you can strike out on your own. We get it, not everybody wants to share the power and glory.
Every mission is different and not every journey ends in victory. You'll recruit new characters with each outing, so even defeat has its upside. What are you waiting for? Cretacia isn't going to save itself!

title: The House In The Hollow
description:
게임 정보
"The House In The Hollow"는 공포와 신비, 마법이 어우러져 진정한 몰입감과 스릴을 선사하는 1인칭 어드벤처 게임입니다.

플레이어는 Aloysius Abadier가 되어 100년 전 사라진 악명 자자한 오컬티스트 Francis Barrett의 미스터리를 풀어야 합니다.

외딴곳에 떨어진 잊혀진 숲으로 모험을 떠나면 신비로운 의식과 고대의 유물, 강력한 마법이 가득한 어둡고 뒤틀린 세계를 발견할 수 있습니다. 버려진 저택을 탐험하면서 숨겨진 비밀과 고대 유물, 강력한 주문을 찾아보세요. 하지만 조심하세요. 어떤 일이 있어도 비밀이 드러나고 여러분이 탈출하는 걸 막으려 하는 어둠의 힘이 기다립니다.

오컬트 지식과 결단력을 발휘하여 미스터리를 풀고 골짜기를 탈출해야 하는 이 게임은 1인칭 탐험과 퍼즐, 발견 요소가 독특하게 어우러진 것이 특징입니다.

이야기 -

프랜시스 바렛은 영국의 마술사이자 오컬티스트로, 구석진한 생활을 살며 외딴 저택에서 대부분의 시간을 보냈습니다.

산중턱에 자리한 숲으로 둘러싸인 이 집은 세상에 알려지지 않은 숨겨진 곳이었습니다.

프랜시스 바렛에 대해 알려진 것은 오컬트와 마법 정보의 천체 지능체와 총합인 The Magus를 저술한 것 이외에는 거의 없습니다.

프랜시스 바렛이 사라진 이후 많은 해가 지나도록, 사람들은 바렛씨의 신비한 집을 찾으려 하지만 성공하지 못했습니다.

프랜시스 바렛이 집에서 수행한 실험, 또는 무엇을 호출했는지에 대해서는 아무도 확신할 수 없습니다.

집을 찾으러 간 사람들 중에는 돌아오지 않은 사람들도 있습니다.


잊을 수 없는 모험을 시작하세요. 현실적인 환경의 세계에 1인칭 시점으로 몰입하여 전에 경험해보지 않은 방식으로 골짜기를 탐험하세요.

하지만 명심하세요. 진행이 쉽지는 않을 겁니다. 골짜기를 둘러싼 깊은 미스터리를 밝히려면 문제를 해결하고 탐험에 참여해야 하거든요.



실감 나는 게임 세계를 창조하려고 의상과 인테리어 피팅 및 비품에 물리학을 적용했기 때문에 플레이어가 정말 환경의 일부가 된 것처럼 느낄 수 있을 것입니다.

플레이어가 게임 속 세계를 돌아다니는 동안 환경 및 애셋 입자 효과는 사실성을 높여 모든 나뭇잎과 가지를 자연스럽고 진짜처럼 보이게 하는 전체 바람 애니메이션 등의 디테일 하나하나를 정확하고 실감 나게 표현합니다.



몰입도를 더 높이기 위해 물리학을 바탕으로 렌더링된 물질로 멀티 텍스처링을 사용하여 현실적으로 보이고 느껴지는 세상을 만들었습니다.

또한 라이트 섀프트, 템포럴 안티앨리어싱, 톤 매핑 등 게임의 고급 시각 요소는 매끄러운 시네마틱 경험을 제공합니다.



The House In The Hollow는 독특한 장소와 아르데코 디자인, 고급 색상 보정, 앰비언트 오클루전, 실시간 레이 트레이싱 기능을 한데 묶어 풍부하고 몰입감 있는 경험을 선사합니다.

title: Two Weeks Game
description:
게임 정보
Two Weeks Game is a story based simple action-adventure game taking place in social narrative horror environment.
The plot:
Underground hacker crew fights day and night to uncover conspiracies. Nikolay and his comrades heard that city is invaded by neko youkai mind-flayer. Muhosransk Valley is an experimental government zone where epic fail took place. To make people flee from overpopulated town the visual novel contest was used. Nikolay must find proofs of earth, fire, water and wind to stop visual novel contest from going to another stage.
Game includes:
49 NPC characters
Muhosransk Valley that have multiple towns and dungeons
Evil neko youkai mind-flayer that uses Samozbor dimension to roam free through Valley
Fully voiced dialogues
Your faithful comrades you always can call and they rally up to help you find proofs

title: Snake in the Dark
description:
게임 정보
스네이크 게임을 해보셨죠. 하지만 눈을 가리고 할 수 있을까요? Snake in the Dark는 스네이크와 소코반 같은 시대를 초월한 아케이드와 퍼즐 게임을 완전히 새롭게 재해석했습니다. 여러분이 알고 있는 재미있는 게임플레이에 예상보다 더 많은 퍼즐 요소가 추가되었습니다!
𓆙 먹고 빛나라!!
던전은 어둡고, 뱀은 몇 발자국 앞만 볼 수 있습니다. 마법의 빛 큐브를 먹으면 잠시 동안 레벨 전체를 볼 수 있습니다. 벽은 어디에 있을까요? 먹이는 어디에? 꼬리는 어디에? 빛을 비춰 찾아보세요!
𓆙 커져서 승리하라!!
각 레벨의 궁극적인 목표는 모든 압력판 스위치를 동시에 눌러 출구 문을 열고, 문이 열려있는 동안 도달하는 것입니다. 뱀이 너무 짧나요? 걱정 마세요! 더 많은 빛 큐브를 먹어서 커지면 모든 스위치에 한 번에 닿을 수 있습니다.
𓆙 돌을 밀고 퍼즐을 풀어라!!
보세요! 돌 구슬이 있네요! 이걸 밀어서 스위치의 추로 사용해 문을 열어보는 건 어떨까요? 그리고 이건 뭘까요? 바닥의 구멍이 길을 막고 있나요? 다른 돌 구슬로 구멍을 메워 그 위를 지나갈 수 있는 다리를 만드세요. 소코반 스타일로 문제를 해결하세요!
