title: MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme
description:
게임 정보
The world's loudest tabletop RPG brings ruin to video gaming.
Take control of the vilest scum ever to crawl upon the earth, and wander the dying lands of the original game through a graphic style inspired by the book.
Evade deadly flails aimed to crack your skull open in a combat system both dynamic and unforgiving that’ll require a strategic, ruthless approach.
Face horrific quests testing your skills to the brink of the Apocalypse.

Literally.

A Desperate Quest at the End of All Things
You wake up in Galgenbeck, a revolting cluster of shanties and ruins-to-be scattered around the greatest cathedral of the dying lands, dedicated to the doomsday following of the two-headed Basilisks. From the Cathedral’s blackened spires slithers a voice and a truth: the world is ending. The two-headed Basilisks demand an offering. This will delay the inevitable end of all things.

There is another voice. From the shit-reeking alleys where the rabble and gutterscums fester, a rumor: whoever appeases this demand will receive Arch-Priestess Josilfa Migol’s blessing. She will cleanse heretic souls and grant them passage to the Shimmering Fields when the true time comes.

The ones desperate enough to embark on this quest are dubbed cursed walkers, and you are one of them. You know that your foul soul is rotting, and every night, you are tormented by visions of eternal damnation. You need a way out. One way or another.

This miserable world is dying, and everyone is looking for salvation, wealth, or vengeance; you can try to cross your destiny with other walkers and form a party, but they will all join you for a reason. Keep everyone’s agenda in mind during the exploration, and you might just get along. Wrong a companion, and they’ll turn their back on you. Or put a dagger in yours. “Friendly” is such an alien world in the brutal, dying world of MÖRK BORG. Remember that when someone offers their help!
s is divided into regions, each one worse than the other. Locations and adventures are dynamically generated based on your progress and the quests you’ll stumble into. Quests, adventures, bosses, and special items reset on every playthrough. Explore the dying world but don't get lost in it. You won't get out alive.

Instead, you level up by performing certain actions during your adventures. When you level up, some of your characters’ abilities will get better, but some will get WORSE. The more you level up, the higher the chances you may lose something in the process. Can’t teach an old goblin new tricks! They’ll kill you.

as it was written in the Calendar of Nechrubel. Miseries are cataclysmic events that will affect the entire world and the poor creatures dwelling in it. The more you play and the deeper you crawl into the filth, the more Miseries you get. They can trigger when you end an adventure and the closer you get to the Apocalypse the more likely this is.Rumors say that these Miseries can be delayed. The foolish claim that they can be prevented but nobody these are all unconfirmed heresies. And whatever the price is for such an unholy miracle, it's unpayable.
Omens that can be spent to deal max damage, reroll an ability check in a crucial situation, absorb the damage from a fatal blow, or guarantee a safe outcome from wielding the Power of a scroll. So remember, you can rely on the fickle fates of alternate worlds tangled with the eyes of eldritch watchers if you want… just don’t tell the Inquisition.

. In the dying world of MÖRK BORG, conjuring such witchcraft is never guaranteed. Every scroll has a chance to trigger an arcane catastrophe, and nobody can foresee what kind of disaster it could bring. You may get dizzy and start puking… or explode. However, some arcane catastrophes might even be better than the intended effect. Use at your own risk.
that determine your likelihood of survival. They affect mechanics and interactions with the world, enemies, and other characters. Some encounters, events, and choices require you to roll a d20 modified by the relevant ability. You should always put your life in the hands of a die roll. That’s why it’s called die roll.

get your ugly sack of bones and blood to the Valley of the Unfortunate Undead and face the terrifying presence of Verhu, the truth speaker and the most worshiped of the Basilisk heads, and Gorgh, and his envious brother. Will you be able to appease them in time and cleanse your rotting soul by delaying the apocalypse? Will this torment ever end? Or will your repeated sufferings open your soul to the Heresy Supreme?

is a groundbreaking grimdark fantasy tabletop RPG by and of . Unleashed upon the world in 2020, it won three gold ENNIES for Product of the Year, Best Writing, and Best Layout as well as silver for Best Game. MÖRK BORG’s dark, dying world is mid-apocalypse, and its wretched denizens cower in the shadow of the godlike two-headed Basilisks. Life is short, cheap, and full of terrors, but despite this, MÖRK BORG is currently enjoyed by thousands of players scattered around the globe, and the creative community surrounding it thrives.

title: Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG. Echidna, mother of monsters, has unleashed myriad foes across the Aegean. Olympus calls for aid - recruit armies, cultivate skills, and invoke divine aid to save the realm and become a legendary hero!
Choose Your Path
In Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey, each playthrough brings you new randomly generated enemies, events, and allies. Your decisions will shape the encounters you face and the development of your hero. Your hero will acquire heroic epithets granting permanent unique effects and learn godly prophecies to turn fights in your favor.
Battles will be won and lost by the strategies you employ. Fight from a distance with a force of archers, or send flying units in to disrupt enemy formations. Hinder your enemies by casting powerful prophecies, or turn your hero into a one-person army and wreak havoc. After each crisis, new boons are earned, allowing you to continually adjust your approach to find success.
Choose Your Patron
Each Patron offers distinct prophecies, units, and epithets to your hero. Behold the pantheon:
Athena uses strong, defensive units. Her powers aid allied troops and enable clever strategies.

title: Party Management
description:
게임 정보
Party Management exists in a fantasy world of the contemporary age. Mighty warriors and mystical wizards now adorn streetwear and star in movies. Adventuring is a common pass time, but to do it you must be licensed under a party manager. This is where you come in. Select and manage up to 7 unique party members for each puzzle and use their abilities to guide them on a treacherous adventure into the golden city of Opulence in hopes of striking it rich, quitting their 9-5’s, and following their dreams.
Features:
Unique RPG Themed Puzzling Mechanics
Solve 20 trials across 4 areas
Expand your party and take on harder challenges
Chart the world around you through Ava’s Log
Master 7 unique abilities across your party
Discover the secrets of Opulence and Confluence
Replay your favorite trials with an expanded party to find new solutions

title: Case Files: Internal Affairs
description:
게임 정보
Two police officers have taken their own lives within hours of each other. Is foul play involved? Can you crack the case in this 3rd installment of the Case Files series?
FEATURES
Observe suspects.
Sort through evidence to discern truth from lies.
Find contradictions in suspect interviews.
Solve mini puzzles.
Guide your partner in the interview room.
Make key decisions that will alter the outcome of the case.
Replay to unlock multiple endings and alternate interview clips.

title: The Prophecy of Horn
description:
게임 정보
A stylish turn-based RPG in the grimdark world of Darkness and White Noise, where you will have to fight the God-Deamon Horn himself! The game is unique in its original mechanics: fast hybrid turn-based battles against hundreds of opponents, a rampage system, a combo system and a unique character progression system!
The game takes place in the original world of Darkness and White Noise. The God-Deamon Horn, the Destroyer of Worlds, arrives at the planet where he was once born as a man, to remember his past, mortal life. He hears the desperate prayers of the local fanatical Priestess, and seduces her soul, making her his assistant. Neither armies nor kingdoms could repel the space invader. But three of the strongest heroes want to make a last desperate attempt to strike at his army. They follow in the footsteps of the Priestess.
You will play as a group of three heroes and fight hordes of monsters in a dynamic hybrid turn-based combat system, where heroes move in turn-based mode, and monsters move simultaneously, which allows you to overcome hordes of monsters in fast-paced, dynamic and spectacular battles!
Hybrid turn-based combat system. On enemy turn, they do their turns simultaneously.
On player turn, earch of 3 character do there turns one after another.

title: Home Wars: Battlefield
description:
게임 정보
"Home Wars: Battlefield"는 오랫동안 기다려온 "Home Wars" 비디오 게임의 스핀오프입니다.
이 타이틀에서 플레이어는 Home Wars 세계를 1인칭/3인칭 관점에서만 경험하게 되며, 전작의 전략적 측면은 일시적으로 포기합니다.
"Home Wars: Battlefield"는 무엇인가요?
1인칭/3인칭에서 매우 협력적인 PvE 멀티플레이어 슈팅 게임입니다.
여기서 전략은 전술과 개별 군인의 용기로 대체되었습니다!
"Home Wars: Battlefield"의 진영은 무엇인가요?
군대, 곤충, 공룡의 3개 진영이 있습니다.
처음 두 진영은 첫 번째 타이틀에도 있었지만, 공룡은 새로운 진영입니다.
왜 공룡인가요? 우리 모두 어린 시절에 적어도 한 마리의 작은 플라스틱 공룡을 가지고 있었습니다... 그리고 무엇보다도 공룡은 항상 매우 멋집니다!
"Home Wars: Battlefield"의 특징은 무엇인가요?
마지막으로, 요청하신 대로 Home Wars에서 플레이어는 군인과 곤충으로 플레이할 수 있으며, 이 경우 공룡으로도 플레이할 수 있습니다.
또 다른 큰 요청 사항은 친구와 함께 플레이할 수 있는 가능성입니다.
경쟁적인 멀티플레이어 비디오 게임은 훌륭하지만, 제 생각에는 협동 게임이 재미와 사회적 기능 면에서 한 단계 더 뛰어납니다.
친구와 함께 관심 지점을 강화하고 아군 봇으로 방어하는 재미를 만끽하세요.
잠금 해제 트리를 통해 전투에서 얻은 리소스를 사용하여 점진적으로 더 나은 장비를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다.
마이크로트랜잭션 없음! 바로가기 없음! 여기서 진행하려면 플레이해야 합니다!
3개 진영의 차이점은 무엇입니까? 어떤 유형의 게임 플레이를 할까요?
3가지 매우 다른 게임 플레이를 하게 됩니다.
군대는 가장 파괴적이고 다재다능한 무기를 가지고 있지만 가장 비쌉니다. 따라서 신체적, 수적으로 열등할 가능성이 큽니다. 전장에서 정적 방어, 경차량, 탱크, 포병, 비행기, 헬리콥터, 함선, 잠수함, 메카닉 등 다양한 차량을 소환할 수 있습니다!
곤충은 가장 민첩하고 빠른 진영이며 독을 사용할 수 있는 유일한 진영입니다. 이 진영의 일부 유닛은 적을 빠르게 공격하기에 완벽하며, 아마도 사각지대에서 공격하는 데 적합하지만, 더 크고 더 장갑이 짙어 더 직접적이고 무서운 교전이 가능한 다른 유닛도 있습니다.
공룡은 게임에서 가장 무거운 진영입니다. 많은 진영이 대자연이 직접 설계한 거인으로, 걷는 죽음의 기계를 만들었습니다. 여기에서는 쓰러뜨리기 어려운 살덩어리의 거인과 측면에서 적을 공격하기에 완벽한 빠른 생물을 볼 수 있습니다.

title: Pico Drift
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of Pico Drift, a racing game that puts your driving skills and reflexes to the test. Customize your car, master the art of drifting, and leave the competition in the dust.
After the race, dive into the in-game map editor to create your own drift playgrounds and unique challenges. Build a racetrack with carefully planned obstacles, or craft your own city district where you can race through traffic to outrun the cops. We plan to continuously expand the game with more building blocks and new themes.
Inspired by the iconic racing games of the 2000s and the creativity of modern sandbox titles, Pico Drift aims to deliver a competitive experience for speed enthusiasts!

title: Roguebound Pirates
description:
게임 정보
강렬한 해상 전투
바다에는 보물도 가득하지만... 위험 요소도 가득합니다! 교묘한 계획을 세워 적보다 앞서가지 못하면 심해에 빠지게 됩니다.
 함선 커스텀
함선에 다양한 무기, 장비, 신화 속 유물을 탑재하세요. 플레이어는 선장으로서 자유롭게 함선 구조를 디자인할 수 있습니다. 여러 가지 장비 옵션을 발견할 수 있고, 대부분 다른 장비로 추가 개조가 가능하기 때문에 진정으로 강력하고 독창적인 시너지를 만들어낼 수 있습니다.

title: Princess of Frozen Flowers
description:
게임 정보
Play as Snow, a legendary warrior princess armed with her mother’s weapon, 'Icebreaker', and a time-reverting device, 'the Antikythera', in this strategic dungeon RPG. The fate of the world of Ouranos hangs in the balance—its destruction is imminent in just 3 days. But there’s hope: you can save Ouranos by collecting Angelic Power Sources from 3 unique dungeons.
Each day, you must select one dungeon to tackle. Each passing day the dungeons gain new mechanics and within the dungeons, everything costs time.
You’ll need to master your fighting class, leverage the Antikythera’s powerful rewind mechanic, and carefully manage your resources to uncover the most efficient strategies and conquer each dungeon in time.

title: Requiem of Reuinis
description:
게임 정보
"Requiem of Reuinis" is a magictower-style RPG where players take on the role of Tassia and her companions, gradually uncovering the truth of a lost history.
Game Features:
Zonal Exploration: Players can collect resources in different areas and retreat at any time, without worrying about getting stuck due to operational mistakes!
Alchemy and Research: Players can obtain advanced resources through alchemy using exploration materials, or conduct various research to gradually enhance their strength.
Deep Customization: Nearly 300 equipment pieces and 100 skills, with numerous playable builds, allowing players to create their unique completion strategy.
Multi-layered Narrative: The stories of the protagonist group, knight orders, and the church intertwine to reveal the truth of the【Calamity】
Game Controls:
Game supports mouse play
WASD/Arrow Keys: Movement
Spacebar: Trigger event/Confirm
Esc: Cancel
Backspace: Undo
Z/X/C/V: Skills
Alt: Outlook
Ctrl: Skip dialogue
Shift: Run
autokwd: Requiem of Reuinis,列乌尼斯的挽歌 Requiem of Reuinis

title: Buster Jam
description:
게임 정보
Buster Jam is a comedic, fast-paced minigame mania featuring an early 2000s art style and soundtrack. Its rich characters and story, paired with hilarious visuals and fluid animation truly immerse you into its world, as if you were playing a cartoon.
STORY
Robot businessman SYLUS is hosting the first ever SY-Corp Game Jam! Contestants create and compete with their very own video games; winner taking home a grand prize of $50,000. It's an opportunity Buster and friends can't turn down, but is there more to this Jam than meets the eye?
GAMEPLAY
Help Buster and friends create games through a fast-paced series of nonstop mini-game mayhem, and uncover the secrets that lie beneath SY-Corp. Characters have their own set of mini-games and aesthetic, bound to keep the experience fresh every level. Don't let their bossfights catch you off guard, as they're sure to keep you on toes right before the finish line.
WHAT NOW?
Buster Jam is still in development, and planned to release 2025. Wishlist the game to keep up to date with the project. (Wishlisting helps us, too!)

title: HackOS
description:
게임 정보
HackOS – Dive into the Ultimate Hacking Sandbox
HackOS is the definitive hacking sandbox you've been waiting for. Immerse yourself in a world of virtual espionage, ethical dilemmas, and high-stakes strategy, all from the comfort of your terminal. Inspired by classic hacking games and refined for modern players, HackOS combines the depth of simulation with the excitement of arcade gameplay.
Key Features:
Authentic Hacking Experience: Utilize realistic commands, crack ports, infiltrate networks, and uncover secrets hidden in the shadows of the digital world.
Dynamic Sandbox: Explore an ever-evolving ecosystem influenced by your decisions. From the dark web marketplace to the global stock exchange, your actions shape the virtual landscape.
Story-Driven Campaign: Join factions, complete missions, and unravel the mysteries of Node Zero, a shadowy organization with its own agenda.
Advanced Modding Tools: Create your own missions, events, and scenarios with the intuitive HackOS Editor, inspired by node-based systems like Unreal's Blueprints.
Diverse Gameplay Systems: Manage your reputation, cooperate with factions, invest in the stock market, or trade cryptocurrencies. Every choice has consequences.
No Microtransactions, Ever: Enjoy the full game for a single, fair price.
Whether you’re a seasoned hacker or new to the genre, Hack OS offers an unparalleled hacking experience that will test your skills, your strategies, and your morality.
Are you ready to log in?

title: Shadows of the Werewolf
description:
게임 정보
Shadows of the Werewolf는 잔혹한 늑대인간과 다른 치명적인 생물들로부터 탈출해야 하는 생존 공포 모험 게임입니다. 기괴한 장소를 탐험하고, 전략적인 결정을 내리며, 공포 뒤에 숨겨진 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내고, 무슨 일이 있어도 생존하세요.
시네마틱 스토리텔링
몰입감 있는 컷신과 드라마틱한 순간들을 통해 생생하게 펼쳐지는 공포, 스릴러, 액션의 강렬한 혼합.

생존 게임플레이와 물리 기반 전투:
숨거나, 싸우거나, 환경을 사용하세요. 캐릭터와 물체가 물리적으로 반응하는 역동적인 전투에 참여하십시오. 제한된 내구성의 아이템을 사용하여 막거나, 공격하거나, 적에게 던져 각 만남마다 선택이 중요합니다.

분위기 있는 환경
교외의 집, 으스스한 숲 속 휴양지, 정원 미로 등 위험한 장소들을 탐험하세요.

제한된 인벤토리를 신중하게 관리하여 치명적인 만남을 견디고 긴장감 넘치는 퍼즐을 풀어 나가세요. 위험한 상황을 탐색하면서 모든 아이템이 중요하며, 긴장감을 유지합니다.

쉬움, 보통, 어려움 모드 중에서 선택하여, 여러분의 플레이 스타일에 맞게 경험을 맞춤 설정하세요. 이야기를 즐기기 위해 여기 계신가요, 아니면 궁극적인 생존 도전을 위해 계신가요? 모든 유형의 플레이어를 위한 모드가 있습니다.

title: Orendale
description:
게임 정보
에픽 턴제 RPG 어드벤처에 몰입하세요!

오렌데일에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 전략과 스토리텔링이 만나는 풍부하고 몰입감 있는 세계에서, 당신의 선택이 운명과 세계의 운명을 결정짓는 잊을 수 없는 여정을 떠나보세요.



전술적인 턴제 전투에서 신중하게 움직임을 계획하세요. 환경을 이용해 적의 약점을 공략하고 다양한 스킬과 능력을 숙달하여 승리를 거머쥐세요.



자신만의 독특한 영웅을 만드세요. 각기 다른 강점과 약점을 가진 다양한 클래스 중에서 선택하세요. 스킬을 발전시키고 강력한 장비로 캐릭터를 무장시키세요.



자원을 모아 무기, 방어구, 아이템을 직접 제작하세요. 자신의 플레이 스타일에 맞춰 장비를 조정하고, 전투에서 우위를 점할 수 있는 희귀 장비를 발견하세요.



강력한 적들과의 에픽한 전투에서 맞서 싸우세요. 그들의 패턴을 연구하고 전략을 조정하며, 동료의 고유 능력을 활용하여 적을 물리치세요.

오늘 모험에 참여하여 오렌데일에서 자신만의 전설을 만들어가세요. 이 세계가 필요로 하는 영웅이 될 것인가, 아니면 그것을 파괴할 악당이 될 것인가?

title: journey of reincarnation
description:
게임 정보
The game will also be available in English,
but will be translated after the Japanese version is released and released at a later date.
Journey of Reincarnation is
Roguelike + auto battle + NES style retro
It's a combination RPG.
story
The story begins with the protagonist who,
after an unfortunate death,
receives mercy in the heavenly
realm and chooses a new life.
The challenge is a dungeon
Combat is a fully automatic battle with no commands.
Characters think for themselves, choose the best move, and act.
Captivating music written specifically for this world

title: Order of Renewal
description:

Chronicles of The Lands
Fog descends, plunging large areas into darkness for years, the sun is shining no brighter than the moon at night. Cold and poor harvest set in, causing starvation, disease, and mass pestilence. Man-eating animals and mythical creatures appear. Robbery and lawlessness reign. The migration of peoples begins, accompanied by many wars for survival.

title: Japanese Salaryman
description:

Experience a diverging plot over two weeks in 1992 Japan, where your choices in dialogue and your actions in the top-down 2D world dramatically impact the course of the story.
Whatever your actions, Issei's fate is in your hands.

description:

Dual Cat: Max is a story about a heroic cat named Max. Max's best friend Erwin has been kidnapped and needs your help to save him. Dive into a whimsical world where robots believe cats can help bring humans back.

An exciting puzzle-platformer
Handcrafted levels to conquer
Charming toon 3D graphics
The bond of true friendship

title: PROJECT SURVIVOR
description:
게임 정보
Project Survivor는 총알 지옥, 호드 생존자, 액션 로그라이트 게임으로, 이 디스토피아에서 생존하고 업그레이드하는 것 외에도 각 임무의 목표를 달성하여 전진해야 합니다.

description:

Place sushi tiles strategically to create mouthwatering combos. Maximize your score by matching different proteins and sushi types while discovering new flavors to cook up your recipe for victory. Each new game is unique!

With each new game, discover and unlock new tiles and bonuses to perfect your bento!
Use a variety of elements: unique perks in every game, special tiles, and upgrades. Craft an epic bento box packed with flavors to score big and unlock even more upgrades!
[Animated banner]
🌟 An endless playground! Break the game with insane combos all over the grid!

🎴 Special tiles, upgrades, and bonuses to spice up your matches!

title: Of Lies and Rain
description:
게임 정보
Of Lies and Rain은 스토리 중심의 1인칭 슈팅 게임으로 VR 전용으로 제작되었습니다. 어두운 사이파이, 포스트 아포칼립스 세계를 배경으로 하며, 현실과 디지털 영역의 경계에서 과거를 되찾고 인류를 멸종의 위기에서 구하기 위해 싸웁니다.
2048년 9월 7일
당신이 알던 세계는 사라졌고, 당신의 기억도 사라졌습니다. 낯선 목소리가 A.D.E.를 처치하라고 촉구합니다. A.D.E.는 20년 동안 지속된 전쟁의 뒤에 있는 인공지능으로, 이 전쟁은 인류를 지구 깊숙한 곳으로 숨게 만들었습니다. 지표면은 이제 적대적인 기계들과 생존을 위한 싸움을 벌이는 새로운 생명체들에 의해 지배되고 있습니다. 모두가 같은 처지입니다.
A.D.E.를 물리치기 위해서는 당신의 능력을 사용해야 합니다. 기술 속에 숨겨진 새로운 차원의 현실, 기술에 의해 파괴된 세상 속에서 여러 세계에 접근할 수 있는 능력입니다.
어떤 것도 보이는 대로가 아닌 디스토피아적 이야기를 따라가며, 친구와 적의 경계가 그 어느 때보다 희미해진 세계에서 싸워 인류의 미래를 구하세요.
특징
세계의 파괴와 인류의 몰락을 초래한 자들에 대한 진실을 밝혀내세요.
세상 곳곳에 숨겨진 기억을 통해 생존자의 삶을 탐험하세요.
현실과 디지털 세계가 얽혀 있는 세계를 여행하며 생물학적, 디지털 의식 사이의 경계를 흐립니다.
독특한 능력을 가진 적대적인 기계들과 싸우며 파괴된 세계에서 싸우세요.
각기 다른 전투 경험을 제공하는 독창적이고 혁신적인 디자인의 무기를 사용하세요.
당신의 길을 막고 있는 수수께끼를 풀고, 당신의 운명을 향해 나아가세요.

title: Alfons World
description:
게임 정보
《Alfons World》는 수집, 육성, 전투 및 시뮬레이션 관리 요소를 통합한 오픈 월드 생존 제작 어드벤처 게임입니다. 광활한 게임 세계에는 약 280종의 파파가 서식하고 있습니다. 각각의 파파는 고유한 외형, 속성, 스킬 및 특성을 가지고 있으며, 전투, 건설, 농업, 산업 생산 등 다양한 기능에 사용될 수 있습니다.
플레이어는 파파를 포획하고 번식시켜 얻을 수 있으며, 육성을 통해 능력을 향상시킬 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 파파의 작업을 합리적으로 배치하여 피로를 예방하고, 음식을 제공하고 편안한 환경을 조성하여 상태 값을 회복시켜 오랫동안 효율적으로 작업할 수 있도록 합니다.
또한, 게임 내에는 파파의 특정 특성이 유전될 수 있는 특별한 디자인이 있습니다. 플레이어는 필요에 따라 특정 파파를 선택하여 번식시켜 우수한 특성을 가진 자손을 얻을 수 있습니다. 며칠마다 게임 내에서 파파 반격 광란이 발생하여, 대규모의 파파 생물이 플레이어의 집을 공격합니다. 이때, 집의 방어를 교묘하게 배치하고 자신의 파파 팀을 전략적으로 활용하여 침입을 성공적으로 저지해야 합니다.
플레이어의 목표는 강력한 파파 제국을 건설하는 것뿐만 아니라, 신중하게 육성한 파파 팀을 이끌고 수많은 도전을 극복하여 탑의 깊숙한 곳에 있는 강력한 보스를 물리치고 최고의 영예를 얻는 것입니다. 《Alfons World》의 세계에서, 각 플레이어는 자신만의 기묘한 모험 이야기를 써 내려가며, 독특한 파파 전설을 만들어 나갈 수 있습니다!

title: Novel Rogue
description:
게임 정보
In the mystical Ancient Library, a young apprentice named Wright trains under Yuisil, the Witch of Portals. As part of his magical studies, he delves into the stories of four enchanted books, each offering a unique realm to explore. From reclaiming a fallen kingdom to unraveling the mysteries of the underworld, your choices shape the destinies of captivating characters and their intertwining tales.

In this card deck-building roguelite full of pixel artwork, dive into thrilling, turn-based card battles where every decision counts. Build and customize decks across four unique systems, each tailored to the worlds within the books. Collect powerful cards, use Ink to enhance your deck, and adapt your strategy to overcome enemies and unlock special endings. With randomized dungeons and escalating challenges, each run is a fresh test of your skills.

title: Fear Still Alive
description:
게임 정보
Fear Still Alive 는 생존과 전술 요소가 결합된 포스트 아포칼립스 액션 게임입니다. 거대한 돌연변이 무리와 맞서 싸우고, 무장한 생존자들과 충돌하며, 생존을 위한 필수 자원을 끊임없이 찾아야 합니다. 오염된 땅을 가로지르고, 버려진 지역을 탐험하며, 도덕적 딜레마에 직면하십시오. 이 세상에서 살아남는 것이 가능할까요? 당신의 모든 발걸음이 마지막이 될 수도 있습니다.
게임 특징
☢ 강렬한 게임 플레이
전투: 적과 싸울지, 피할지, 함정을 사용할지 선택해야 합니다. 하지만 자원은 한정되어 있으며, 한 발 한 발 신중하게 사용해야 합니다.
다양한 적: 느리지만 끈질긴 감염자부터, 예측할 수 없는 능력을 가진 위험한 돌연변이까지 다양한 적들이 기다리고 있습니다.
생존자들과의 충돌: 인간이 지배하는 거점은 더욱 큰 도전이 될 것입니다. 그들은 돌연변이보다 더 똑똑하고, 더 강한 무장을 갖추고 있으며, 방해가 되는 사람은 가차 없이 제거합니다.
☢ 서바이벌 분위기
자원 부족: 총알, 음식, 응급 키트—항상 부족합니다. 무너진 건물을 샅샅이 뒤지고, 생존자들의 은신처에서 보급품을 찾으며, 때로는 도덕적 선택을 해야 합니다. 훔칠 것인가, 아니면 굶주릴 것인가?
몰입감 있는 환경: 폐허가 된 소련 도시, 얼어붙은 방사능 황무지, 지하 벙커, 버려진 군사 기지 등 각 지역은 각각의 비밀과 위험을 품고 있습니다.
☢ 어둠 속의 목소리:
무전기 속에서 들려오는 목소리, 당신의 유일한 동맹입니다. 그는 조언을 주고, 길을 안내하며, 위험을 경고합니다. 하지만 그는 누구일까요? 믿어도 될까요? 혹시 그의 말 속에 숨겨진 위협이 있는 것은 아닐까요?
게임의 깊이
탐험: 비선형적 레벨 디자인으로 숨겨진 아이템을 찾을 수 있는 다양한 장소가 존재합니다. 하지만 그 자원은 쉽지 않게 얻을 것입니다. 돌연변이와 생존자들이 그들을 지키고 있습니다.
선택: 당신의 결정이 게임의 흐름을 바꿉니다. 무전기의 목소리를 따를 것인가? 다른 생존자들을 도울 것인가, 아니면 자신의 생존을 위해 희생시킬 것인가?
전략: 강력한 적들은 신중한 접근이 필요합니다. 주변 환경을 활용하고, 함정을 설치하며, 무기를 조합하여 살아남아야 합니다.
Fear Still Alive 는 투쟁과 공포, 그리고 희망의 이야기입니다. 세상을 구할 것인가, 아니면 폐허로 남길 것인가—그 선택은 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
공포는 아직 살아 있습니다.
하지만 당신은 더 강합니다.

title: AOKAKI
description:
게임 정보
Go as quickly as you can and as stylishly as you dare!

AOKAKI is a fast-paced 2D platformer where you play as an isopod ronin of the same name. Explore a challenging bug-inhabited world, illustrated with charming pixelart while listening to our original soundtrack!

Features

Inspired by retro classics and built through a modern lens, with responsive controls and dynamic gameplay.






Play as Aokaki, a warrior with a great sense of justice that rebelled against his Shogun's tyranny. When returning to his homeland after years of pilgrimage, the ronin finds himself amidst the destruction caused by his former lord, now armed with a mysterious demonic fungal power capable of corrupting and destroying life. The brave Aokaki must fight against the forces of the Shogun and of his Four Generals, in order to put an end to the treat that ravages the people of the Sanagi province.

title: Arkham Mysteries: Chapter One
description:
게임 정보
ARKHAM MYSTERIES: CHAPTER ONE
결코 밝혀져서는 안 될 진실을 밝혀라
미스터리와 탐험이 가득한 내러티브 어드벤처에 빠져들어라.
모든 발견이 진실로 향하는 길이 될 수도, 파멸로 이끌 수도 있다…
탐정 John Graves가 되어, 실종된 교수 Wellington의 흔적을 따라간다.
수수께끼 같은 Samantha Damasco가 너를 인도할 것이다.

title: Creature Park
description:
게임 정보
크리쳐 파크에 오신걸 환영합니다!
지루한 일상 생활에 지친 여러분, 현실과 동 떨어진 크리쳐들이 넘쳐나는 크리쳐 파크에 어서오십시오! 크리쳐 파크와 함께 일하게 된 여러분들은 동물원의 밝은 곳이 아닌, 어두운 곳에서 일하게 되실 겁니다. 하지만 걱정마세요! 여러분들을 위한 적절한 메뉴얼과 돈만 있으면 큰 도움을 주는 첨단 기술들이 있으니까요! 그래도 문제가 생긴다면... 다음 사람이 올 테니 저희는 괜찮습니다!
크리쳐를 잡아오세요!

여러분은 위험 지역에 파견을 나가, 크리쳐를 직접 잡아와야 합니다. 크리쳐들은 각기 다른 특징을 가지고 있습니다. 이들을 잘 관찰하여 빈틈을 노리세요!
동물원을 관리하세요!

여러분이 잡아온 크리쳐들은 동물원에서 살게 됩니다. 크리쳐들이 동물원에서 날뛰는 모습을 보기 싫다면, 그들이 원하는 것을 들어주세요. 여러분들의 작은 선택이 동물원 운영에서 어떤 결과를 가져올지는... 직접 확인하세요!
다양한 위협

위험 지역에는 다양한 종류의 크리쳐들이 존재합니다. 여러분은 포식자가 아닌 피식자라는 것을 잊지 마십시오.
협력 플레이

당사는 여러분이 팀을 꾸려 함께 행동하기를 장려합니다! 혼자서는 힘들 수도 있지만, 여럿이라면 가능한 일도 많으니까요!

title: Maximus Mouse's Manic Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
Maximus Mouse is back!
Experience manic arcade action set across loads of game modes. Classic arcade gameplay with many twists and surprises awaits you!
Story
Those pesky cats have stolen Max's retirement fund! Pursue them around the world to get it back, but watch out for surprises along the way!
Party!
Grab three of your friends for some couch mayhem! Stay alive, grab those coins and capture those cheeses! Use power ups to your advantage, but beware - anything can happen: laser attacks, high winds, and lemon hitmen are just a few of the events you'll face.

Oh, and do keep an eye out for that walrus!
Trials
Pit your wits against the cats across 50+ trials. Quick, bite-sized challenges to test any mouse!
Arcade
Try your hand at the arcade modes and beat those scores!

title: The Banker Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
The Banker Tycoon은 꿈의 은행을 구축하고 관리하는 매력적인 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 먼저 서비스의 전략적 가격을 설정하고, 최고의 직원을 채용하여 최상의 운영을 보장하십시오. 은행을 맞춤 설정하고 확장하여 비전에 맞게 기능과 역량을 향상시키세요. 은행이 성장함에 따라 명성이 높아지고, 더 부유한 고객을 끌어들여 금융 세계의 리더로 자리매김할 것입니다. 도전에 대응하고, 혁신하며, 은행 산업의 정상에 올라 궁극의 은행 거물이 되십시오!
은행의 세부 사항을 만들고 맞춤화하며, 서비스를 확장하고 장식하십시오.
더 많은 카운터/책상 추가
좌석 구역 확장
장식과 분위기 향상
직원의 요구사항 충족
더 나은 고객 서비스를 위해 시설 업그레이드

title: Worldseekers - Deckbuilding RPG
description:
게임 정보
Worldseekers는 GPS 탐색 RPG입니다. 이 세계의 광활한 땅과 기만적인 던전을 탐험하면서 희귀한 카드, 이벤트, 독특한 캐릭터를 발견하세요.

정신적, 육체적 건강을 증진하기 위해 Worldseekers는 GPS 메커니즘과 전화 앱 링크를 사용하여 밖으로 나가서 걸을 수 있도록 도와줍니다. 물론 Steam 버전을 사용하면 몇 시간 동안 PC에서 플레이할 수 있으며, 추가 산책에 대한 보상도 받을 수 있습니다. 모든 스트리머의 경우 기본적으로 위치를 조정하거나 숨깁니다.

이메일 뉴스레터에도 가입하세요: (다른 소셜 미디어 자료는 아직 모두 있지만 이메일이 훨씬 더 좋습니다. IMO에서는)
세상을 신비와 신비가 가득한 환상적인 땅으로 바꿔보세요:
[목록]
독특하고 어려운 몬스터를 물리치세요
재미있고 수수께끼 같은 서사를 즐겨보세요
끊임없이 변화하는 땅이 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞춰집니다.
던전 및 기타 콘텐츠를 집에 가져가서 건강한 습관에 대한 보상을 받으세요.[/목록]
미스테리와 마법이 가득한 광대한 세계를 탐험해보세요.
전설적인 생물과 전투를 벌이고 던전 깊이를 탐험하세요.


질문이나 피드백이 있거나 우리를 지원하고 싶다면(확실히 사용할 수 있음) Twitch나 YouTube(최종 보스 편집)에서 저에게 연락해 주세요!

title: Project: Autumn
description:
게임 정보
Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands. 
Explore and Discover
Run, climb, and crawl across the islands as you collect and find new items and tools! 
Be a part of the Community!
Why are we always so pressured by efficiency? Work together with many fun and quirky people as you each learn to relax and enjoy the beauty around you.
Unwind in a Recovering Paradise
Although on a top secret mission, the distractions here are plentiful! Surely our bosses won’t mind if we fish for a little while longer.

title: Cosmic Coop
description:
게임 정보
GAME UPDATE:
Art (100% COMPLETE!)
Code (99% COMPLETE!)
Gameplay Trailer (Coming soon)
Cosmic Coop DEMO (60% Complete)
Adding in all the items (1000% COMPLETE!)
Dialogue / Quests (70% Complete)
Localization (0% Complete)
Final Polish (50% Complete)
Crash-land on Critteria and embark on a cozy, out-of-this-world adventure! In Cosmic Coop, you’ll transform a patch of alien soil into a bustling farm brimming with adorable Critterlings—each with its own quirks and cosmic charms.
Decorate & Attract
Channel your inner designer and fill your farm with shimmering altars, glowing lights, and lush crops. Every new decoration tempts curious Critterlings to stop by—and maybe even stick around for good!
Build & Nurture
From constructing snug coops to planting local flora, turn your farm into a vibrant haven. Each discovery, whether it’s a rare seed or a newly hatched Critterling, brings you closer to beauty of Critteria.
Explore & Befriend
It’s not just Critterlings who call this planet home. Encounter strange anthropomorphic neighbors who offer advice, trade essential items, and share stories about the world you’ve stumbled upon. Friendship, after all, is the greatest resource in the galaxy.

title: Shield Cat: The Lost Conductor
description:
게임 정보
A Troubling Dream...
Shield Cat: The Lost Conductor is a game starring Lance the otter, a mail courier for the Cat Kingdom. One day, he has a dream where his partner Parker calls out to him.
"Lance, please help me!"
Lance wakes up with a start. Is his partner really in trouble? Or was it really just a dream...
Explore And Collect!
There are tons of collectibles and secrets in the Cat Kingdom! Throughout your quest, you'll find abilities to make you stronger, as well as grant you access to new areas and secrets. A detailed map screen will help you keep track of your progress, where you've been, and where you need to go. Can you find all the hidden collectibles across the land?
Features
Beautiful pixel art reminiscent of the 16 and 32bit games of old, with plenty of modern enhancements.
Find abilities to increase your power, as well as gain access to new areas you couldn’t before.
Passive abilities that grant you bonuses and new moves just for having them.
Mysterious puzzles all across the world. You’ll need to keep your wits about you for them!
Tons of different collectibles to find all over the Cat Kingdom.
Several areas to explore, from the depths of the Lignum Woods, the dark Abandoned Mines, and the mysterious Autumn Grove.
A detailed map system that keeps track of your progress in each area, how many collectibles you still need to find, and more.
Secret areas all over the Cat Kingdom to be found by only the most cunning players.
A cast of humorous and interesting characters to meet and interact with.
And Much More...
A number of retro filters to take you back to the past.
Plenty of accessibility options to make it easier for everyone to play.
Full Keyboard, Mouse, and Gamepad support, as well as full action rebinding - Play however you like!

title: Treasures of the Haunted Forest
description:
게임 정보
Finding a job in the big city is hardly possible for a young witch, and the rumors say the haunted forest hides countless unique alchemical ingredients. Maybe that would be your chance?

Explore the haunted forest in search of alchemical ingredients. Discover new potions and sell them to customers. Enhance your equipment to enter even deeper into the woods. Improve and decorate your house.

title: Roam
description:
게임 정보
지역 땅은 많은 비밀, 자연의 경이, 보물 및 유물을 숨겨있습니다. 그러나 주요한 미스터리는 수세기 동안 호수 바닥에 존재해 온 방대한 터널과 동굴 네트워크입니다. 여러분은 탐험가의 역할을 맡아 이러한 고대 지하 통로의 깊이를 탐험하고 호수와 그 주변의 비밀을 풀어내는 임무를 맡고 있습니다.

오픈 월드와 절차적 생성
«Roam» 의 세계에서는 절차적 생성 덕분에 무작위 이벤트와 적대적인 환경 시스템이 각 플레이에서 독특한 상황을 만들어냅니다. 위험이 매 순간 도사리고 있습니다: 공격적인 생물들의 공격, 함정, 그리고 마법적인 이상 현상은 여러분이 직면할 작은 부분일 뿐입니다.

선택의 자유와 퀘스트
여러분은 자신의 길을 선택할 완전한 자유를 갖고 있습니다. 다양한 무기와 마법을 사용하고 유용한 물약을 준비하며, 장비를 찾고, 만들고, 업그레이드하여 적대적인 환경을 헤쳐 나가세요. 탐험 경로의 선택은 여러분에게 달려 있습니다. 플레이어는 적과 싸우거나 전투를 피하고, 무자비한 힘 대신 교묘함, 민첩성 및 마법을 사용할지 선택할 수 있습니다. 위험을 혼자든지 친구와 함께 극복하고 매료시키는 장소를 탐험하며 새로운 비밀을 발견하세요. 퀘스트는 여러분에게 최대한의 행동 자유를 제공하기 위해 디자인되었습니다. 손잡이로 안내하는 대신 힌트를 제공하여 여러분이 과업을 해결하고 목표를 달성하는 방법을 선택할 수 있게 합니다. 여러분의 결정은 사건의 흐름에 영향을 주며 새로운 기회를 열거나 예상치 못한 결과로 이어질 수 있습니다.

탐험하고, 싸우고, 생존하세요.

title: Y2K Directive
description:
게임 정보
The year is 1999.

As chaos looms on the horizon, reports flood in of gigantic monsters, zombie plagues, interdimensional portals, and various supernatural disasters unfolding worldwide. You, a military leader from a small island nation, are tasked with a simple yet daunting mission: Save as many civilians as possible before the clock strikes 2000.

Welcome to your Y2K Directive.

SURVIVE: Navigate through this apocalyptic year, rescuing civilians from endangered cities and deploying your troops to stem the tide of horrors.

ADAPT: Leverage the terrain, day and night cycles, and weather to your advantage. Train your troops, rebuild destroyed bases and power plants, and establish refugee camps for civilians. Keep panic and civil unrest at bay.

OVERCOME Every problem has a solution. Utilize your troops not just for combat but also to reduce panic, quell civil unrest, or suppress insurgencies. Manage your economy and infrastructure with precision to save your country from impending doom.

This strategic civil defense simulation, inspired by classic games like XCOM/UFO with roguelike elements, guarantees endless possibilities to test your skills. In each playthrough, a new scenario is generated. Zombies? Alien fauna? Kaijus? Maybe all of them (and more) at once? Choose your preferred settings, or let the random generator surprise you. Will you withstand the test, or let your country fall into chaos and anarchy?

title: Hyperspace Deck Command
description:
게임 정보
Command advanced battle fleets!
Protect your fabricator megaship from waves of advancing enemies in tactical, card-based combat.
Deploy and move your space forces across multiple orbital lanes.
Use high-tech ability cards to support your vessels in battle.
Carefully consider your actions: Units operate on individual turn timers and every card you play brings them closer to carrying out their next attack run.
Enhance your tactics with dual-use status effects!
Ability cards in Hyperspace Deck Command give you an extra bit of tactical flexibility. Every effect works differently depending on if you play them against allies or enemies. Do you want to shield your ship, or contain and prevent damage from a specific attacker? Do you deploy defensive mines around your front line unit or trap the approach vector of a specific enemy? Should your carriers deploy fighters to strafe targets, or send them to guard your own vessels?
Build highly customizable decks!
Combine dozens of possible fabricators, deck commanders, randomly generated flagships and auxiliary vessels into thousands of possible starting decks.

title: Te-Amic
description:
게임 정보
Multiplayer: Team up with friends to survive and upgrade your abilities in a world filled with various equipment.
Farming: Grow a wide variety of plants and raise animals to build and expand your farm.
Survival: Gather resources, craft tools, and fight to survive against harsh environments and challenging enemies.
Te-Amic: A special system where you can make new friends to assist you on your journey.

title: House spirit cat
description:
게임 정보
Imagine, how could spirits and mythical creatures feel these days? What if they were closer, than it could seem? Perhaps, your classmate nearby or a guy selling you street food may appear as one of them.
This is a story about Kot - a house spirit in the shape of a cat. It’s lost its owner and his powers leave him insensibly. It has to find a new owner to survive before they disappear. But what if he meets a lost kitten? Or a restless soul? Or a thirsting demon hunting the weakend hero’s energy remains?
Here you can control the character’s fate and the events of the story. Make your choice, fights with demons, save kittens and punish villains All in your paws.
Game features:
Multiple endings, non linear playthrough
Visual novel with interactive elements.
Original soundtracks
Fairy tale characters in the modern world
Cats!

title: Back To The Collis
description:
게임 정보
Back To The Collis is a story-rich, fully hand-drawn Point & Click adventure puzzle game, that will take you on a journey into the atmospheric world and amaze you with lots of logical and engaging puzzles.





In Back to the Collis you will play as Benjamin, who has formerly left the town of Collis, built on a hill, and now lives in the forest in his comfort, nearby the town.
But after a while, Benjamin must return to the Collis to tackle a seemingly simple problem of water shortage, which has already affected him as well.
With Benjamin, you will have a chance to explore the town, introduce its varied and memorable populace, their social problems, solve lots of exciting puzzles and who knows, maybe at the end of your shared journey you will even understand why he left this town long ago.




Back to the Collis is classic point & click adventure game, where you will solve lots of engaging environmental quests and logical puzzles.
This game is designed to be more than just a game, it is an adventure that will make you think about the way of life of its society, their coexistence issues, which has lots of in common with our real ones.

title: Calamity
description:
게임 정보
You are our very best in these chaotic times. Your job is to help out the locals during these devastating disasters. Can you survive the calamities?
Chaotic Events: Experience meteors smashing into buildings, physics driven tornadoes ripping through towns and tossing you and the locals around, and exploding everything near by, survive the blistering cold inflicted by blizzards, and find cover while dust storms are hitting and huge tumbleweeds hit the town.

Destruction: Experience buildings getting ripped apart by tornadoes or meteors smashing into buildings flying debris.


Player Choices: Play with your friends or find others to help out the locals while trying to survive natural disasters. Adapt and alter your surroundings to gain advantages and create new paths to safety.

title: Cozy Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
코지 던전은 던전을 탐험하며 적을 물리치고 개조하여 수익을 얻는 어드벤처/인테리어 디자인 게임입니다! 사업에 새로운 변화를 더하기로 한 몬스터 퇴치 길드의 리더가 되어 보세요. 던전을 민박집으로 바꿀 수 있는데 던전 정복에만 집중할 필요는 없잖아요?
위험천만한 던전 탐험
교묘한 퍼즐과 사악한 적, 치명적인 함정으로 가득한 던전을 통과하세요. 탐험과 전투에 도움이 되는 다양한 도구를 사용하고 기지를 발휘하면 생존에 필요한 우위를 점할 수 있습니다.

내면의 장인정신을 발휘하세요
여러분이 방문하는 모든 던전은 고객의 소유이며, 고객들은 새로운 모습을 보고 싶어 합니다! 새 가구를 만들고 쓰레기를 치우며, 벽과 바닥을 바꾸고 고장 난 가구를 판매하는 등 다양한 작업을 할 수 있습니다! 모든 준비가 끝나면 이제 돈이 굴러들어 오길 기다리면 됩니다!

길드 커스터마이징
열심히 번 골드를 사용하여 길드를 꾸미고 확장하며 캐릭터를 향상시키고, 새로운 설계도를 사고, 새로운 친구를 만나는 등 원하는 방식대로 길드를 꾸미고 확장할 수 있습니다!

title: Backrooms: Levels of Fear
description:
게임 정보
당신이 조심하지 않고 엉뚱한 곳에서 현실을 벗어나면 당신은 뒷방에 있게 될 것입니다. 그곳은 눅눅한 오래된 카펫의 냄새, 모노노랑의 광기, 형광등의 끝없는 배경 소음뿐입니다. 최대 윙윙거리는 소리와 함께 무작위로 분할된 약 6억 평방 마일의 빈 방에 갇히게 됩니다.
지옥에서 당신의 말을 확실히 들었기 때문에 근처에서 방황하는 소리가 들리면 신이 당신을 구하십시오.

1인칭 심리 및 생존 공포 경험. 당신은 백룸에서 길을 잃었고 이 위험한 우주에서 살아남을 방법을 찾아야 합니다.
다양한 레벨을 탐색하고 단서, 물건 또는 메시지를 찾아 백룸의 비밀을 알아내십시오.
이곳에 살고 있는 독립체와 탈출하거나 싸우거나 대화를 시도하세요.
다른 탐험가의 발자취를 따라 그들을 만나고, 그들의 은신처에서 피난처를 찾고, 인벤토리를 채워서 생존 가능성을 높이십시오.
당신은 현실 세계로의 복귀에 성공할 것인가, 아니면 뒷방의 깊숙한 곳에서 길을 잃을 것인가?

주요 기능:
백룸 탐색
위험에서 살아남기
그들의 비밀을 밝혀라
개체와 다른 탐험가를 만나다

⚠️ 이것은 게임이 아닙니다! 백룸이 존재하며 위험은 현실입니다. 이 프로그램을 실행하는 것은 생존 가능성을 높일 수 있는 유일한 기회입니다. 놓치지 마세요, 지금 위시리스트!

title: Dino Party
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Dino Party, a wild multiplayer brawler where friendships are tested, and buildings don’t last long. Battle through a series of unpredictable minigames, punch your friends into oblivion, and tear down the arena in fully physics-driven destruction. Play online or locally—just be ready for absolute mayhem.
Seamless Minigame Mayhem
Experience non-stop action as the stadium morphs seamlessly between explosive minigames. Whether you’re teaming up for 2v2 soccer brawls, dodging crumbling lava floors, or surviving a frantic game of hot potato, every match throws unpredictable hazards. No two rounds are ever alike!
Punch First, Ask Questions Later
Two buttons. Endless chaos. String together punch combos to yeet rivals off cliffs, shield at the perfect moment to avoid disaster, or unleash the dreaded Assbomb™ (a butt-stomp so powerful, it’s legally required to yell “BOOM” when you land). Whether you’re a strategic shield-master or a button-mashing maniac, everyone gets to wreak havoc!

title: DearMyFriend
description:
게임 정보
DearMyFriend is a beautifully pixel-art and story-driven sandplay exploration game developed by GuluGames.



On an ordinary day, a train from another world slowly stopped outside the classroom, as if sensing the call of lonely girl.
Stepping onto the train, the light and wind of the golden continent rushed towards you, indicating the beginning of your adventure.
At this moment, you would not know your footsteps would cover every corner of the continent, and the songs in the wind would sing your name.


The golden continent filled with maple leaves, the bitterly cold valley blanketed in endless snow, the deep abyss of dark flames, or the land of civilization high above the clouds... You will wander diverse areas of the Stargather Land, weave together the ancient tales behind the continent of stars.

Of course, interspersed between these exciting adventures is your dull real life. Sometimes you have to return to your small room, but this may let you figure out what you really want.



Battle is not just about using brute force as you know. Here are some combat suggestions from Stargather Envoy:
Observe carefully and find the chance to defeating the enemy quickly;
Allocate stamina reasonably, use different elemental powers at the right time, crush your enemies with one hit.

It seems you already know this. Stargather Land never let you down.
You have chances to take on an advanced challenge after you finished the normal one.



Numerous treasures and accessories are scattered throughout the Stargather Land, where never disappoint the brave. So find them as much as possible and try to use them, which will add endless richness to your adventures!

This is a fascinating fantasy world and a gripping growth story.
On the journey, there is always a moment that makes you stop and admire.

title: Dual Eclipse
description:
게임 정보

Dual Eclipse is a shortform dungeon crawler meant to be played over a weekend that resolves turn-based combat with trick-taking. Players will parry cards, turn the tide of battle with powerful Eclipse cards, and loot monsters to upgrade their decks.
Play as one of three classes to explore mysterious dungeons, evade dangerous traps, uncover powerful treasure, and discover secrets.
UNIQUE TRICK-TAKING COMBAT

title: The Greenening
description:
게임 정보
For fans of short incremental games like Nodebuster & Digseum.
Wash away the ashes to gain knowledge about a forlorn world.
Rediscover and nourish the life buried beneath.
Expand your abilities and grow ever more powerful.

title: Fillet Fury
description:
게임 정보
필렛 퓨리에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
카드 한 장이 강철의 번쩍임으로 끝날 수 있는 무자비한 서부 시대. 플레이어는 고위험 게임에서 자신의 신경과 칼 실력을 시험받습니다. 하지만 주의하세요. 필렛 퓨리에서는 돈이 아니라 손가락을 겁니다.
전략과 실시간 액션이 결합된 혁신적인 경험을 즐겨보세요.
결정 하나로 모든 것이 바뀔 수 있습니다.
게임플레이:
강렬한 메커니즘: 점점 더 어려운 적들과 베팅하며, 라운드마다 생사를 건 나이프 게임으로 발전.
전략적 사고: 상황에 맞춰 전략을 바꾸세요. 용기도 필요합니다.
서부 분위기: 시각과 사운드로 냉혹한 무법자 시대를 완벽 재현.
⚠️ 이 게임은 성인용이며, 잔혹한 폭력과 피, 고어, 자해를 묘사합니다. 플레이 시 주의 바랍니다

title: No Way Home
description:
게임 정보
[Note: the games has nothing to do with a certain superhero movie. We had the name first!]
No Way Home is a twin-stick shooter adventure, set in a hostile far flung part of the universe filled with danger at every turn. Outgun ships many times your size in tense skirmishes, complete missions for the many aliens that may offer help, loot bigger and better weapons, and explore countless areas in search of answers and a way home.
Fast-paced topdown-style twin stick combat
Engage in tense skirmishes that require the use of cover, timing and thoughtful positioning moreso than reading predictable bullet patterns
A regenerating shield allows a tactical and front-foot approach to combat, with a buffer to trade hits and move around the environment strategically
Loot new weapons and ship components as random drops from encounters, creating your own build and play-style over time
Procedural world generation with hand-crafted encounters throughout

title: Mirror Land
description:
게임 정보
**WHAT IS THIS**
*Mirror Land* is an original game that focuses on optical illusion puzzles. It is inspired by some Magic Mirror Concepts such as **FengYueBaoJian** in *Dream of the Red Chamber* and **The Mirror of Erised** in *Harry Potter*. It uses MAGIC MIRROR to GRAB and RELEASE characters and cooperate with moving the MAGIC MIRROR to complete incredible space puzzles.
According to THE MIRROR CONCEPT, a series of gameplay and stories are created. Meanwhile, this game uses poetry-writing methods as a source of reference, which makes the game more interesting and creates a poetic atmosphere in it.

**For closer eye movement and deeper puzzle layout, the puzzles of this game are specially developed for vertical screens. If the player’s display can be rotated to vertical, as long as the windows desktop is set to vertical. Then open the game, the game will be full screen. Or, if the display cannot be rotated or you don't want to bother, players can just use the normal horizontal screen mode. The game experience will not be different, and the areas on the left and right sides of the screen will be filled with black. **

**HOW TO PLAY**
You can learn how to play from the demo video or read the tips below.
0.The MIRROR and The Feet of the character have an interactive relationship.
1.When you can see The Feet of the character in the MIRROR, press the MIRROR Button, thus the character is tied to the MIRROR surface and turns into 2D form.
2.When the MIRROR is moved, the terrain reflected in the MIRROR is changed.
3.When the 2D form character’s feet meet an empty foothold reflected by MIRROR, press the MIRROR Button again, thus the character is released to the corresponding terrain.

**MECHANISM**


**Pedal Trigger** can make the terrain or other things change.


**THRUST DEVICE** When the character moves to the front of the THRUST DEVICE, this device will do a powerful thrust and push the character out for a certain distance. During this process, the
character is not affected by gravity.





**CLUSTER LIGHT**
When the source of The CLUSTER LIGHT is turned on, there will be a beam of The CLUSTER LIGHT. It can be reflected by a MIRROR. You can make the LIGHT travel to different positions by adjusting the angle of light emission as well as the angle and position of the mirror.
1.The CLUSTER LIGHT can pass through transparent terrain.
2.When the CLUSTER LIGHT reaches a FLAT place whether it is transparent or not, a TELEPORT POINT of LIGHT can be etched at the irradiation point.
3.LUMEN STONE CAT can travel in CLUSTER LIGHT-TELEPORT POINT System


**NPCs**



**LUMEN STONE CAT** is a passenger of the CLUSTER LIGHT. It is a mysterious animal imprisoned in the LUMEN STONE. When it is not exposed to the CLUSTER LIGHT, it looks like a dull square stone that is almost as tall as the character. In this case, It can be dragged and moved on a flat place, helping characters reach different terrain. But when THE CAT is moved to a teleport point of the CLUSTER LIGHT, which connects with another teleport point by CLUSTER LIGHT, THE CAT will transform into a cat that can swim in the LIGHT. After it reaches the teleport point as far as it can, THE CAT will transform into stone-form again.



**The SILENCE** is such a STABLE being that no character can push it away. When it blocks a character's way, the character can only walk away and wait for it to go to the next position, or catch it and put it in the MIRROR.



**The STRENGTH** In most cases, the STRENGTH will push away every movable object that gets into its reach. How far it pushes an object depends on the size of STRENGTH. During the pushing process, the STRENGTH and the object are not affected by gravity.
What The STRENGTH can push away: the character, the cubes, and smaller STRENGTHs
What The STRENGTH can not push away: THE SILENCE, THE LIGHT FLOWING STONE CAT, and solid terrains.
When the STRENGTH pushes the objects beyond its ability, it will be pushed away by the reaction force.
The STRENGTH can also be caught and put in the MIRROR.

**CHESSBOARD OF THE MIRROR MECHANISM**

1.When the character is caught and put on the CHESSBOARD OF THE MIRROR, he will become a chess piece that can move to the adjacent chessboard grid.
2.Each chessboard grid has a corresponding relationship with a certain foothold out of the MIRROR. When the MIRROR releases the character, the character will be placed in the corresponding position.


**THE STORY OF MIRROR LAND**

There is a continent in the darkness where the sun, the moon, and stars do not exist. The LIGHT is stored in a big mountain like gel. The mountain is called LUMEN.
Living creatures near the LUMEN gradually evolve into humans. They learn the methods of mining and using the LIGHT. They pipe the LIGHT to high places, illuminating most places. Technology and civilization are developing. Kingdom has formed.
Not far from the west of the LUMEN is the MIRROR PLAIN where the supply of MIRRORS is inexhaustible. Once the last piece of MIRROR PLAIN was exploited, an earth movement will come. A new MIRROR PLAIN will raise.
These MIRRORS can catch living creatures and put them into the surface of MIRRORS. This is discovered by accident.
One of the believable legends is about a hunter. Once upon a time, he was chasing the LUMEN BEAST. This BEAST escaped to a mirror. The hunter prayed subconsciously that someone could help him catch it. Unexpectedly, THE MIRROR responded to his prayer and caught the BEAST.
Later, people found a way to make MAGIC MIRRORS between witchcraft and technology.

THE STORY OF XIU(the character)

XIU’s ancestors are INKMEN,XIU is a inkman as well. INKMEN is one of the results of human genetic modification.
After humans learned to make MAGIC MIRRORS, some clever bad guys commit crimes with MAGIC MIRRORS they make, and leave no trace of themselves. The ruler of the kingdom decides to keep all the clever guys under supervision. Every movement of them has to leave a trace behind. So the clever ones become INKMEN. Ink always seep out through their skin, and their shoes cannot be waterproof. So the footprints they leave are all ink-like.
XIU’s mother was a TRAFFIC MIRROR ENGINEER. In a TRAFFIC MIRROR test 7 years ago, when the MIRROR released her, she disappeared. This strange thing made people panic, but no reason was found.
Now XIU is fifteen years old, inherited mother's relics.XIU found 7 SPECIAL STONES among them. One day, a mysterious voice came into XIU's ears, saying,” Take THESE STONES to the FURNACES I designate. Then forge them into a HAMMER according to the drawings I give you. Use the HAMMER to smash the one-thousand-year-old MIRROR hanging in the capital. And you can find your mother…”
"As long as there is a chance of finding my mother, I will try it…."
