Welcome to the mysterious land of Hollow Veil, where darkness thrives and hopeless souls wander endlessly. In The Watcher's Curse, you step into the shoes of Artem, a duty-burdened watcher tasked with protecting the world from nefarious forces.
As a watcher, Artem's responsibilities are twofold: learn the secrets of the world along with any lost knowledge and remove any threats posed by the aforementioned nefarious forces. Most common amongst said forces are the puritanical technotheists, a fanatical order that believes technology brings them closer to god. Whether stationed in an overlapped hell forest or chasing ancient horrors through an ageless monolith, Artem faces a relentless barrage of esoteric threats.
Our tale begins with Artem in a precarious predicament, unexpectedly transported across the world after a chance encounter with a seemingly innocuous tome. Stranded in the gloomy confines of Grimm's Briar, nestled amidst the foreboding Noctemura mountains, Artem crosses paths with Mayor Barkeep. Eager to return home, Artem finds himself entangled in the mayor's plea for aid in unraveling the enigma shrouding the disappearance of local villagers.

title: Effective Immediately
description:
게임 정보
Congratulations,
You have been appointed the position of repair technician on-board the deep space relay station. Pack your belongings, your family can not join you at this time.
Effective Immediately.

Effective Immediately is a gritty, sci-fi future on the verge of political change. As the sole position of travel in the galaxy you must decide who to accept or decline passage to. Encounter alien denizens and walk the line of survival or upholding morality. Make a choice and deal with the consequences.

Compare documents for inconsistencies, repair ship systems and ultimately allow or disallow travel. All the while the OCA is piling on more and more bureaucratic red tape in this puzzle, management life-sim.
Make choices that impact the story
Meet many different characters with unique motivations and inner conflicts. Are they lying or telling the truth?
Pass judgment and determine not only their fates but also the trajectory of your own journey.

Verify ID discrepancies
Ensure they have the correct details; name, race, expiry date all match?
What is their destination? Does their story match up? Are they allowed to travel to that sector since the new OCA regulations came in?

Use schematic rules to repair many alien ship systems; navigation, shields, medical and more.
Learn the rules and become an efficient engineer.

title: Fracctal Monsters
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Fracctal Monsters, the ultimate monster taming experience that takes pet care and real-time combat to a whole new level!



Embark on an exciting journey filled with online exploration, immersive training, adrenaline-pumping 2D action-based platformer combat, and intense PvP battles where you'll face off against other players for epic loot and bragging rights.



In Fracctal Monsters, every virtual pet is more than just a creature – they're your loyal companions with unique personalities, distinct hobbies, specific diets, and individual preferences. Each monster offers a one-of-a-kind bond and interaction that will keep you coming back for more.



Explore a vibrant, living world where you can discover hidden secrets and participate in thrilling challenges. Obtain new monsters by opening packs or winning them in various in-game challenges. The expansive world of Fracctal Monsters is teeming with adventures that challenge your skills and strategic thinking.



Raise and evolve your monsters by engaging them in training modes, keeping them happy, and feeding them their preferred diets. Watch as they grow stronger, learn new abilities, and transform into even more powerful forms. The evolution system allows for deep customization and personal connection with your monsters.



Prepare for epic boss battles that test the limits of your monster's strength and strategy. Team up with other players or go solo to take down formidable foes and earn exclusive rewards. Each boss encounter is a challenge that requires tactical planning and skillful execution.



With a vast world to explore, countless challenges to overcome, and a thriving community of fellow tamers, Fracctal Monsters promises endless hours of fun, excitement, and adventure. So, are you ready to dive into the captivating world of monster taming and unleash the power of your Fracctal Monsters? Join us now and embark on an unforgettable journey like no other!

title: Operatives: Revolve
description:
게임 정보
Operative Revolve is a cinematic roguelike deckbuilder with a unique gameplay mechanic. Play as Operatives, secret agents who oversee a world governed by machine ideology. Use your Machine cards to physically attack or block damage while battling enemies who oppose your directive and uncover the hidden truths within the machinated world.

title: Aether Singularity
description:
게임 정보
A demonic anomaly has been detected in an important research facility. DATA agents... deploy!

In 1969, mankind established its first link to the Aethernet. Humanity soon entered a golden age of technological wonder and prosperity.
But, kept secret from the eyes of the public, a second discovery was made shortly after... demons weren't just the subject of myths and religion.
To combat them, the Demonic Anomalies Termination Agency was born. An FBI offshoot where agents are partnered with daemons through a pact, their mission: send the demons back where they belong.
GAMEPLAY
In this fixed camera action game you and your squad will have to explore a top secret facility. Balance the powers of both magic and lead to defeat the demons who are rampaging throughout it!
Battles take place in real-time, requiring you to dodge enemy attacks and find the perfect time to retaliate against them. As you shoot enemies you'll gain mana which you can use to cast spells to gain an advantage. On the verge of death will you choose to use what little mana you have to heal yourself, or will you try to blast away one of your foes so the battle becomes easier? Make strategic use of your resources and complete your mission!
A RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK
As you explore the facility you'll be able to find information, and maybe even spells, to help you with your mission. However, you'll be faced with a constant timer that ticks down even when in battles. Failing to get to the bottom of things before time runs out won't spell the end for you, but...
BONUS CHALLENGES
In addition to the main mission there are over 15 bonus challenges that can be tackled! Defeat the enemies, protect the target, and more as you aim for the best score possible! Can you get a gold rank in all of them?
THE CAST




SILVIA
An experienced agent, she has been working at DATA for a decade. Felt like nobody ever had her back until she got assigned to Alfonso's squad, thus adopted a bit of a rebellious attitude. Competent at her job, she enjoys being sent on assignments despite her snarky remarks.
Silvia's daemon, bound by pact. Quite reliable, has learned to adapt to Silvia's attitude and does his best to cheer her up.
While she might not show it, Silvia is glad to have been partnered with him. Their mutual trust has resulted in Ranru evolving and being able to cast a variety of magicks.
The leader of the squad, his expertise has gained him notoriety within DATA veterans. After a mission gone wrong and a falling off with his previous team, he was reassigned to direct a smaller, fast-response squad, which he's now fond of.

The latest addition to the squad, recruited due to her excellent track record as a police officer. Has great social skills and is used to dealing with civilians, but is still trying to fit in in DATA. Greatly respects Alfonso and Silvia.

title: Bloom Paradise
description:
게임 정보
Story
Every nook and cranny in Bloom Paradise was once filled with flowers of every color, until one day when pesky pests came and ravaged the land, rendering it unrecognizable. Thus, flower fairies Tamabo and Hanabo have joined forces, setting off on an adventure to restore Bloom Paradise to its former glory and get rid of those irksome pests.
How to Play
Play as either Tamabo (Player 1) or Hanabo (Player 2) and make flowers bloom. Fill all the grounds in each stage to clear it. How you bloom flowers differs between single-player mode and two-player mode. In single-player mode, flowers bloom on the ground as Tamabo walks across. In two-player mode, however, when either Tamabo or Hanabo walks across the ground, only flower buds appear. The other character must then touch these buds to make them bloom. Work together to take back Bloom Paradise from the pests. Both Tamabo and Hanabo can shoot water in the direction they're facing with the use of the attack button. Flowers can't bloom when the ground is covered in mud, so use water to clean up and eradicate any pests standing in your way.
Features
・100 total stages
・19 types of bothersome yet likable pests
・Single-player and two-player coop modes with differing ways to play
・Game design reminiscent of late 80s arcade games

title: AOKAKI
description:
게임 정보
Go as quickly as you can and as stylishly as you dare!

AOKAKI is a fast-paced 2D platformer where you play as an isopod ronin of the same name. Explore a challenging bug-inhabited world, illustrated with charming pixelart while listening to our original soundtrack!

Features

Inspired by retro classics and built through a modern lens, with responsive controls and dynamic gameplay.






Play as Aokaki, a warrior with a great sense of justice that rebelled against his Shogun's tyranny. When returning to his homeland after years of pilgrimage, the ronin finds himself amidst the destruction caused by his former lord, now armed with a mysterious demonic fungal power capable of corrupting and destroying life. The brave Aokaki must fight against the forces of the Shogun and of his Four Generals, in order to put an end to the treat that ravages the people of the Sanagi province.

title: Arkham Mysteries: Chapter One
description:
게임 정보
ARKHAM MYSTERIES: CHAPTER ONE
결코 밝혀져서는 안 될 진실을 밝혀라
미스터리와 탐험이 가득한 내러티브 어드벤처에 빠져들어라.
모든 발견이 진실로 향하는 길이 될 수도, 파멸로 이끌 수도 있다…
탐정 John Graves가 되어, 실종된 교수 Wellington의 흔적을 따라간다.
수수께끼 같은 Samantha Damasco가 너를 인도할 것이다.

title: Creature Park
description:
게임 정보
크리쳐 파크에 오신걸 환영합니다!
지루한 일상 생활에 지친 여러분, 현실과 동 떨어진 크리쳐들이 넘쳐나는 크리쳐 파크에 어서오십시오! 크리쳐 파크와 함께 일하게 된 여러분들은 동물원의 밝은 곳이 아닌, 어두운 곳에서 일하게 되실 겁니다. 하지만 걱정마세요! 여러분들을 위한 적절한 메뉴얼과 돈만 있으면 큰 도움을 주는 첨단 기술들이 있으니까요! 그래도 문제가 생긴다면... 다음 사람이 올 테니 저희는 괜찮습니다!
크리쳐를 잡아오세요!

여러분은 위험 지역에 파견을 나가, 크리쳐를 직접 잡아와야 합니다. 크리쳐들은 각기 다른 특징을 가지고 있습니다. 이들을 잘 관찰하여 빈틈을 노리세요!
동물원을 관리하세요!

여러분이 잡아온 크리쳐들은 동물원에서 살게 됩니다. 크리쳐들이 동물원에서 날뛰는 모습을 보기 싫다면, 그들이 원하는 것을 들어주세요. 여러분들의 작은 선택이 동물원 운영에서 어떤 결과를 가져올지는... 직접 확인하세요!
다양한 위협

위험 지역에는 다양한 종류의 크리쳐들이 존재합니다. 여러분은 포식자가 아닌 피식자라는 것을 잊지 마십시오.
협력 플레이

당사는 여러분이 팀을 꾸려 함께 행동하기를 장려합니다! 혼자서는 힘들 수도 있지만, 여럿이라면 가능한 일도 많으니까요!
tag: 온라인 협동,4인 로컬 플레이,생명체 수집,퍼마 데스

title: Maximus Mouse's Manic Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
Maximus Mouse is back!
Experience manic arcade action set across loads of game modes. Classic arcade gameplay with many twists and surprises awaits you!
Story
Those pesky cats have stolen Max's retirement fund! Pursue them around the world to get it back, but watch out for surprises along the way!
Party!
Grab three of your friends for some couch mayhem! Stay alive, grab those coins and capture those cheeses! Use power ups to your advantage, but beware - anything can happen: laser attacks, high winds, and lemon hitmen are just a few of the events you'll face.

Oh, and do keep an eye out for that walrus!
Trials
Pit your wits against the cats across 50+ trials. Quick, bite-sized challenges to test any mouse!
Arcade
Try your hand at the arcade modes and beat those scores!

title: The Banker Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
The Banker Tycoon은 꿈의 은행을 구축하고 관리하는 매력적인 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 먼저 서비스의 전략적 가격을 설정하고, 최고의 직원을 채용하여 최상의 운영을 보장하십시오. 은행을 맞춤 설정하고 확장하여 비전에 맞게 기능과 역량을 향상시키세요. 은행이 성장함에 따라 명성이 높아지고, 더 부유한 고객을 끌어들여 금융 세계의 리더로 자리매김할 것입니다. 도전에 대응하고, 혁신하며, 은행 산업의 정상에 올라 궁극의 은행 거물이 되십시오!
은행의 세부 사항을 만들고 맞춤화하며, 서비스를 확장하고 장식하십시오.
더 많은 카운터/책상 추가
좌석 구역 확장
장식과 분위기 향상
직원의 요구사항 충족
더 나은 고객 서비스를 위해 시설 업그레이드

title: Worldseekers - Deckbuilding RPG
description:
게임 정보
Worldseekers는 GPS 탐색 RPG입니다. 이 세계의 광활한 땅과 기만적인 던전을 탐험하면서 희귀한 카드, 이벤트, 독특한 캐릭터를 발견하세요.

정신적, 육체적 건강을 증진하기 위해 Worldseekers는 GPS 메커니즘과 전화 앱 링크를 사용하여 밖으로 나가서 걸을 수 있도록 도와줍니다. 물론 Steam 버전을 사용하면 몇 시간 동안 PC에서 플레이할 수 있으며, 추가 산책에 대한 보상도 받을 수 있습니다. 모든 스트리머의 경우 기본적으로 위치를 조정하거나 숨깁니다.

이메일 뉴스레터에도 가입하세요: (다른 소셜 미디어 자료는 아직 모두 있지만 이메일이 훨씬 더 좋습니다. IMO에서는)
세상을 신비와 신비가 가득한 환상적인 땅으로 바꿔보세요:
[목록]
독특하고 어려운 몬스터를 물리치세요
재미있고 수수께끼 같은 서사를 즐겨보세요
끊임없이 변화하는 땅이 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞춰집니다.
던전 및 기타 콘텐츠를 집에 가져가서 건강한 습관에 대한 보상을 받으세요.[/목록]
미스테리와 마법이 가득한 광대한 세계를 탐험해보세요.
전설적인 생물과 전투를 벌이고 던전 깊이를 탐험하세요.


질문이나 피드백이 있거나 우리를 지원하고 싶다면(확실히 사용할 수 있음) Twitch나 YouTube(최종 보스 편집)에서 저에게 연락해 주세요!

title: Project: Autumn
description:
게임 정보
Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands. 
Explore and Discover
Run, climb, and crawl across the islands as you collect and find new items and tools! 
Be a part of the Community!
Why are we always so pressured by efficiency? Work together with many fun and quirky people as you each learn to relax and enjoy the beauty around you.
Unwind in a Recovering Paradise
Although on a top secret mission, the distractions here are plentiful! Surely our bosses won’t mind if we fish for a little while longer.

title: Cosmic Coop
description:
게임 정보
GAME UPDATE:
Art (100% COMPLETE!)
Code (99% COMPLETE!)
Gameplay Trailer (Coming soon)
Cosmic Coop DEMO (60% Complete)
Adding in all the items (1000% COMPLETE!)
Dialogue / Quests (70% Complete)
Localization (0% Complete)
Final Polish (50% Complete)
Crash-land on Critteria and embark on a cozy, out-of-this-world adventure! In Cosmic Coop, you’ll transform a patch of alien soil into a bustling farm brimming with adorable Critterlings—each with its own quirks and cosmic charms.
Decorate & Attract
Channel your inner designer and fill your farm with shimmering altars, glowing lights, and lush crops. Every new decoration tempts curious Critterlings to stop by—and maybe even stick around for good!
Build & Nurture
From constructing snug coops to planting local flora, turn your farm into a vibrant haven. Each discovery, whether it’s a rare seed or a newly hatched Critterling, brings you closer to beauty of Critteria.
Explore & Befriend
It’s not just Critterlings who call this planet home. Encounter strange anthropomorphic neighbors who offer advice, trade essential items, and share stories about the world you’ve stumbled upon. Friendship, after all, is the greatest resource in the galaxy.

title: Treasures of the Haunted Forest
description:
게임 정보
Finding a job in the big city is hardly possible for a young witch, and the rumors say the haunted forest hides countless unique alchemical ingredients. Maybe that would be your chance?

Explore the haunted forest in search of alchemical ingredients. Discover new potions and sell them to customers. Enhance your equipment to enter even deeper into the woods. Improve and decorate your house.

title: Roam
description:
게임 정보
지역 땅은 많은 비밀, 자연의 경이, 보물 및 유물을 숨겨있습니다. 그러나 주요한 미스터리는 수세기 동안 호수 바닥에 존재해 온 방대한 터널과 동굴 네트워크입니다. 여러분은 탐험가의 역할을 맡아 이러한 고대 지하 통로의 깊이를 탐험하고 호수와 그 주변의 비밀을 풀어내는 임무를 맡고 있습니다.

오픈 월드와 절차적 생성
«Roam» 의 세계에서는 절차적 생성 덕분에 무작위 이벤트와 적대적인 환경 시스템이 각 플레이에서 독특한 상황을 만들어냅니다. 위험이 매 순간 도사리고 있습니다: 공격적인 생물들의 공격, 함정, 그리고 마법적인 이상 현상은 여러분이 직면할 작은 부분일 뿐입니다.

선택의 자유와 퀘스트
여러분은 자신의 길을 선택할 완전한 자유를 갖고 있습니다. 다양한 무기와 마법을 사용하고 유용한 물약을 준비하며, 장비를 찾고, 만들고, 업그레이드하여 적대적인 환경을 헤쳐 나가세요. 탐험 경로의 선택은 여러분에게 달려 있습니다. 플레이어는 적과 싸우거나 전투를 피하고, 무자비한 힘 대신 교묘함, 민첩성 및 마법을 사용할지 선택할 수 있습니다. 위험을 혼자든지 친구와 함께 극복하고 매료시키는 장소를 탐험하며 새로운 비밀을 발견하세요. 퀘스트는 여러분에게 최대한의 행동 자유를 제공하기 위해 디자인되었습니다. 손잡이로 안내하는 대신 힌트를 제공하여 여러분이 과업을 해결하고 목표를 달성하는 방법을 선택할 수 있게 합니다. 여러분의 결정은 사건의 흐름에 영향을 주며 새로운 기회를 열거나 예상치 못한 결과로 이어질 수 있습니다.

탐험하고, 싸우고, 생존하세요.

title: Y2K Directive
description:
게임 정보
The year is 1999.

As chaos looms on the horizon, reports flood in of gigantic monsters, zombie plagues, interdimensional portals, and various supernatural disasters unfolding worldwide. You, a military leader from a small island nation, are tasked with a simple yet daunting mission: Save as many civilians as possible before the clock strikes 2000.

Welcome to your Y2K Directive.

SURVIVE: Navigate through this apocalyptic year, rescuing civilians from endangered cities and deploying your troops to stem the tide of horrors.

ADAPT: Leverage the terrain, day and night cycles, and weather to your advantage. Train your troops, rebuild destroyed bases and power plants, and establish refugee camps for civilians. Keep panic and civil unrest at bay.

OVERCOME Every problem has a solution. Utilize your troops not just for combat but also to reduce panic, quell civil unrest, or suppress insurgencies. Manage your economy and infrastructure with precision to save your country from impending doom.

This strategic civil defense simulation, inspired by classic games like XCOM/UFO with roguelike elements, guarantees endless possibilities to test your skills. In each playthrough, a new scenario is generated. Zombies? Alien fauna? Kaijus? Maybe all of them (and more) at once? Choose your preferred settings, or let the random generator surprise you. Will you withstand the test, or let your country fall into chaos and anarchy?

title: Hyperspace Deck Command
description:
게임 정보
Command advanced battle fleets!
Protect your fabricator megaship from waves of advancing enemies in tactical, card-based combat.
Deploy and move your space forces across multiple orbital lanes.
Use high-tech ability cards to support your vessels in battle.
Carefully consider your actions: Units operate on individual turn timers and every card you play brings them closer to carrying out their next attack run.
Enhance your tactics with dual-use status effects!
Ability cards in Hyperspace Deck Command give you an extra bit of tactical flexibility. Every effect works differently depending on if you play them against allies or enemies. Do you want to shield your ship, or contain and prevent damage from a specific attacker? Do you deploy defensive mines around your front line unit or trap the approach vector of a specific enemy? Should your carriers deploy fighters to strafe targets, or send them to guard your own vessels?
Build highly customizable decks!
Combine dozens of possible fabricators, deck commanders, randomly generated flagships and auxiliary vessels into thousands of possible starting decks.

title: Te-Amic
description:
게임 정보
Multiplayer: Team up with friends to survive and upgrade your abilities in a world filled with various equipment.
Farming: Grow a wide variety of plants and raise animals to build and expand your farm.
Survival: Gather resources, craft tools, and fight to survive against harsh environments and challenging enemies.
Te-Amic: A special system where you can make new friends to assist you on your journey.

title: Shield Cat: The Lost Conductor
description:
게임 정보
A Troubling Dream...
Shield Cat: The Lost Conductor is a game starring Lance the otter, a mail courier for the Cat Kingdom. One day, he has a dream where his partner Parker calls out to him.
"Lance, please help me!"
Lance wakes up with a start. Is his partner really in trouble? Or was it really just a dream...
Explore And Collect!
There are tons of collectibles and secrets in the Cat Kingdom! Throughout your quest, you'll find abilities to make you stronger, as well as grant you access to new areas and secrets. A detailed map screen will help you keep track of your progress, where you've been, and where you need to go. Can you find all the hidden collectibles across the land?
Features
Beautiful pixel art reminiscent of the 16 and 32bit games of old, with plenty of modern enhancements.
Find abilities to increase your power, as well as gain access to new areas you couldn’t before.
Passive abilities that grant you bonuses and new moves just for having them.
Mysterious puzzles all across the world. You’ll need to keep your wits about you for them!
Tons of different collectibles to find all over the Cat Kingdom.
Several areas to explore, from the depths of the Lignum Woods, the dark Abandoned Mines, and the mysterious Autumn Grove.
A detailed map system that keeps track of your progress in each area, how many collectibles you still need to find, and more.
Secret areas all over the Cat Kingdom to be found by only the most cunning players.
A cast of humorous and interesting characters to meet and interact with.
And Much More...
A number of retro filters to take you back to the past.
Plenty of accessibility options to make it easier for everyone to play.
Full Keyboard, Mouse, and Gamepad support, as well as full action rebinding - Play however you like!

title: Backrooms: Levels of Fear
description:
게임 정보
당신이 조심하지 않고 엉뚱한 곳에서 현실을 벗어나면 당신은 뒷방에 있게 될 것입니다. 그곳은 눅눅한 오래된 카펫의 냄새, 모노노랑의 광기, 형광등의 끝없는 배경 소음뿐입니다. 최대 윙윙거리는 소리와 함께 무작위로 분할된 약 6억 평방 마일의 빈 방에 갇히게 됩니다.
지옥에서 당신의 말을 확실히 들었기 때문에 근처에서 방황하는 소리가 들리면 신이 당신을 구하십시오.

1인칭 심리 및 생존 공포 경험. 당신은 백룸에서 길을 잃었고 이 위험한 우주에서 살아남을 방법을 찾아야 합니다.
다양한 레벨을 탐색하고 단서, 물건 또는 메시지를 찾아 백룸의 비밀을 알아내십시오.
이곳에 살고 있는 독립체와 탈출하거나 싸우거나 대화를 시도하세요.
다른 탐험가의 발자취를 따라 그들을 만나고, 그들의 은신처에서 피난처를 찾고, 인벤토리를 채워서 생존 가능성을 높이십시오.
당신은 현실 세계로의 복귀에 성공할 것인가, 아니면 뒷방의 깊숙한 곳에서 길을 잃을 것인가?

주요 기능:
백룸 탐색
위험에서 살아남기
그들의 비밀을 밝혀라
개체와 다른 탐험가를 만나다

⚠️ 이것은 게임이 아닙니다! 백룸이 존재하며 위험은 현실입니다. 이 프로그램을 실행하는 것은 생존 가능성을 높일 수 있는 유일한 기회입니다. 놓치지 마세요, 지금 위시리스트!

title: Dino Party
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Dino Party, a wild multiplayer brawler where friendships are tested, and buildings don’t last long. Battle through a series of unpredictable minigames, punch your friends into oblivion, and tear down the arena in fully physics-driven destruction. Play online or locally—just be ready for absolute mayhem.
Seamless Minigame Mayhem
Experience non-stop action as the stadium morphs seamlessly between explosive minigames. Whether you’re teaming up for 2v2 soccer brawls, dodging crumbling lava floors, or surviving a frantic game of hot potato, every match throws unpredictable hazards. No two rounds are ever alike!
Punch First, Ask Questions Later
Two buttons. Endless chaos. String together punch combos to yeet rivals off cliffs, shield at the perfect moment to avoid disaster, or unleash the dreaded Assbomb™ (a butt-stomp so powerful, it’s legally required to yell “BOOM” when you land). Whether you’re a strategic shield-master or a button-mashing maniac, everyone gets to wreak havoc!

title: DearMyFriend
description:
게임 정보
DearMyFriend is a beautifully pixel-art and story-driven sandplay exploration game developed by GuluGames.



On an ordinary day, a train from another world slowly stopped outside the classroom, as if sensing the call of lonely girl.
Stepping onto the train, the light and wind of the golden continent rushed towards you, indicating the beginning of your adventure.
At this moment, you would not know your footsteps would cover every corner of the continent, and the songs in the wind would sing your name.


The golden continent filled with maple leaves, the bitterly cold valley blanketed in endless snow, the deep abyss of dark flames, or the land of civilization high above the clouds... You will wander diverse areas of the Stargather Land, weave together the ancient tales behind the continent of stars.

Of course, interspersed between these exciting adventures is your dull real life. Sometimes you have to return to your small room, but this may let you figure out what you really want.



Battle is not just about using brute force as you know. Here are some combat suggestions from Stargather Envoy:
Observe carefully and find the chance to defeating the enemy quickly;
Allocate stamina reasonably, use different elemental powers at the right time, crush your enemies with one hit.

It seems you already know this. Stargather Land never let you down.
You have chances to take on an advanced challenge after you finished the normal one.



Numerous treasures and accessories are scattered throughout the Stargather Land, where never disappoint the brave. So find them as much as possible and try to use them, which will add endless richness to your adventures!

This is a fascinating fantasy world and a gripping growth story.
On the journey, there is always a moment that makes you stop and admire.

title: House spirit cat
description:
게임 정보
Imagine, how could spirits and mythical creatures feel these days? What if they were closer, than it could seem? Perhaps, your classmate nearby or a guy selling you street food may appear as one of them.
This is a story about Kot - a house spirit in the shape of a cat. It’s lost its owner and his powers leave him insensibly. It has to find a new owner to survive before they disappear. But what if he meets a lost kitten? Or a restless soul? Or a thirsting demon hunting the weakend hero’s energy remains?
Here you can control the character’s fate and the events of the story. Make your choice, fights with demons, save kittens and punish villains All in your paws.
Game features:
Multiple endings, non linear playthrough
Visual novel with interactive elements.
Original soundtracks
Fairy tale characters in the modern world
Cats!

title: Back To The Collis
description:
게임 정보
Back To The Collis is a story-rich, fully hand-drawn Point & Click adventure puzzle game, that will take you on a journey into the atmospheric world and amaze you with lots of logical and engaging puzzles.





In Back to the Collis you will play as Benjamin, who has formerly left the town of Collis, built on a hill, and now lives in the forest in his comfort, nearby the town.
But after a while, Benjamin must return to the Collis to tackle a seemingly simple problem of water shortage, which has already affected him as well.
With Benjamin, you will have a chance to explore the town, introduce its varied and memorable populace, their social problems, solve lots of exciting puzzles and who knows, maybe at the end of your shared journey you will even understand why he left this town long ago.




Back to the Collis is classic point & click adventure game, where you will solve lots of engaging environmental quests and logical puzzles.
This game is designed to be more than just a game, it is an adventure that will make you think about the way of life of its society, their coexistence issues, which has lots of in common with our real ones.

title: Calamity
description:
게임 정보
You are our very best in these chaotic times. Your job is to help out the locals during these devastating disasters. Can you survive the calamities?
Chaotic Events: Experience meteors smashing into buildings, physics driven tornadoes ripping through towns and tossing you and the locals around, and exploding everything near by, survive the blistering cold inflicted by blizzards, and find cover while dust storms are hitting and huge tumbleweeds hit the town.

Destruction: Experience buildings getting ripped apart by tornadoes or meteors smashing into buildings flying debris.


Player Choices: Play with your friends or find others to help out the locals while trying to survive natural disasters. Adapt and alter your surroundings to gain advantages and create new paths to safety.

title: Cozy Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
코지 던전은 던전을 탐험하며 적을 물리치고 개조하여 수익을 얻는 어드벤처/인테리어 디자인 게임입니다! 사업에 새로운 변화를 더하기로 한 몬스터 퇴치 길드의 리더가 되어 보세요. 던전을 민박집으로 바꿀 수 있는데 던전 정복에만 집중할 필요는 없잖아요?
위험천만한 던전 탐험
교묘한 퍼즐과 사악한 적, 치명적인 함정으로 가득한 던전을 통과하세요. 탐험과 전투에 도움이 되는 다양한 도구를 사용하고 기지를 발휘하면 생존에 필요한 우위를 점할 수 있습니다.

내면의 장인정신을 발휘하세요
여러분이 방문하는 모든 던전은 고객의 소유이며, 고객들은 새로운 모습을 보고 싶어 합니다! 새 가구를 만들고 쓰레기를 치우며, 벽과 바닥을 바꾸고 고장 난 가구를 판매하는 등 다양한 작업을 할 수 있습니다! 모든 준비가 끝나면 이제 돈이 굴러들어 오길 기다리면 됩니다!

길드 커스터마이징
열심히 번 골드를 사용하여 길드를 꾸미고 확장하며 캐릭터를 향상시키고, 새로운 설계도를 사고, 새로운 친구를 만나는 등 원하는 방식대로 길드를 꾸미고 확장할 수 있습니다!

title: Dual Eclipse
description:
게임 정보

Dual Eclipse is a shortform dungeon crawler meant to be played over a weekend that resolves turn-based combat with trick-taking. Players will parry cards, turn the tide of battle with powerful Eclipse cards, and loot monsters to upgrade their decks.
Play as one of three classes to explore mysterious dungeons, evade dangerous traps, uncover powerful treasure, and discover secrets.
UNIQUE TRICK-TAKING COMBAT

title: The Greenening
description:
게임 정보
For fans of short incremental games like Nodebuster & Digseum.
Wash away the ashes to gain knowledge about a forlorn world.
Rediscover and nourish the life buried beneath.
Expand your abilities and grow ever more powerful.

title: Seed Adventure
description:
게임 정보
세계수는 죽어가고 있으며, 이는 시드의 세계를 위협합니다. 시드는 마을의 족장이 후계자로 선택한 귀여운 작은 씨앗입니다! 이 3D 플랫폼 게임에서 다양한 위험한 환경을 가로질러 마을을 구하세요!
당신의 마을이 위험에 처해 있으며, 당신은 마을을 구해야 합니다! 서로 다른 7개의 환경을 지나 궁극적인 목표인 세계수에 도달하고 마을을 구하세요.
고된 모험이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다! 환경에 맞게 조정된 다양한 장애물을 극복하여 당신의 능력을 시험해보세요.
쉬움, 보통, 그리고 가장 용감한 이들을 위한 어려움 중에서 난이도를 선택하세요!

작은 구성 및 제한된 저장 공간에 적합합니다.

title: 瞳:创之槲 Tong Create Thorns
description: 게임 정보
