title: Make Us Whole
description:
게임 정보
Features
Hours of gathering and exploration in a dystopian horror-scape
A unique blend of fps action and survival horror in an endless expanse of brutalist architecture
An oppressive atmosphere of isolation in a treacherous ever-changing environment
Diverse creatures able to stalk, hunt, and devour the unprepared player
A story hidden between the cracks of concrete revealing humanity’s downfall
HARVEST
Scavenge broken machines and twisted horrors for resources rusty and alien. Choose what to scrap and what to collect, praying you find extraction chambers to save your precious loot. Will you take the gambles and boons of the maze, or embrace a slow risk-free grind?
UPGRADE
Return to the nest to upgrade and evolve your weaponry. Fuse artifacts with your tools to unlock new attributes and powers. Grow or perish. But what are you willing to sacrifice for your survival? Take care human, lest you become something else…
DISCOVER
Navigate this maze of horror, discover new environments hidden in the depths, and hunt greater monstrosities… or become the hunted. Watch your step. This place wasn’t built for humans

title: Kenopsia
description:
게임 정보
케놉시아(Kenopsia)는 조용한 깨달음의 경험이며, 과거가 머물고 보이지 않는 존재가 지켜보는 텅 빈 공간을 여행하는 것입니다. 끝없이 이어지는 빈 복도는 희미한 빛에 잠겨 있고, 잊혀진 성소는 감각 너머의 존재로 은은히 울립니다. 고요함 속 어딘가에서, 무언가가 듣고 있습니다.
당신은 홀로 걷고 있지만, 버려진 것은 아닙니다. 침묵 속에는 질문이 가득합니다. 그것은 당신의 것일까요, 아니면 누군가의 것일까요? 벽은 말해지지 않은 단어들의 메아리로 숨 쉬며, 아직 발견되지 않은 답들이 기다리고 있습니다. 한 걸음 한 걸음 내디딜수록, 당신은 말 없는 대화 속으로 더 깊이 빠져듭니다. 이해는 듣는 것이 아니라, 느끼는 것입니다.
이곳에는 ‘무언가’가 있습니다. 그리고 그것은 항상 여기 있었습니다.
당신은 들을 것인가요? 말을 걸 것인가요? 그리고 만약 그렇다면… 그것은 대답할까요?

title: DashBall
description:
게임 정보
DashBall – The Ultimate Speed Showdown
Get ready for ultra-fast duels in DashBall, a competitive game where reflexes and strategy make all the difference! Face off against your opponents in intense matches where every move counts, and use spells to gain the upper hand.
Fast-Paced Gameplay: Rapid and dynamic exchanges that test your reflexes.
Spells & Power-ups: Catch temporary spells on the map to turn the tide.
Varied Game Modes: Competitive 1v1, fast-paced matches with special rules, and unique challenges.
Ranking & Competition: Climb the leaderboard, face the best players, and become the master of the arena.
Dynamic Maps: Environments that evolve during the match to spice up the action.
Neon Arcade Style: A retro-futuristic design reminiscent of 80s arcade machines, modernized for a new generation.
Are you ready to become the master of DashBall?
Add DashBall to your wishlist now and don’t miss the release!

Note: Once the core game mechanics are developed, I will focus on improving the graphics. The current icons, banners, and visuals are a representation of the intended final look of the game.

title: Moto Roader 「モトローダー」
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to be a MOTO ROADER?
                         Imagine a time in the future when evil has been erased. Life’s tasks are handled by machines.
What will kids do to heat things up?
 They’ll all be MOTO ROADERS.
 Man and machine come together in a race of speed, skill, luck, power and strategy. Race up to four other drivers. Eight heats per race.
 Make sure you spend price money on killer part and weapons – not on weird shades and fuzzy dice!
  Features
Classic legacy title
Choose from multiple cars and drivers
Numerous race tracks
Multiple game modes including bumper car challenges
Up to 4 player local coop
Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point
Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)
Gallery: view images from the original game’s manual and box design

title: COCOBOY
description:
게임 정보
What is COCOBOY?
In an alternate history 2005, the forgotten 80's platformer COCOBOY has re-entered the public consciousness of a niche few.
Modify, brute force, and restore unused game mechanics using Modcarts, devices hacked together by tech-savvy fans. Discover clever combinations of mods in order to progress and even break level design in unexpected ways.

title: SimPlaE
description:
게임 정보
"플랫포머를 시뮬레이션으로 플레이하다"




"안녕하세요? 여기는 심플래입니다. 당신의 목표는 시뮬레이션의 클리어입니다."

모든 캐릭터는 일정한 조건에 따라 주어진 지형과 상호작용하며 자동으로 움직입니다.
당신은 캐릭터를 직접 조작할 수 없습니다.



관찰을 통해 캐릭터의 행동패턴을 파악하세요.
슬롯 내 주어진 블록을 배치하여 새로운 동선을 설계하세요.

시뮬레이션을 클리어하는 방법은 여러 가지입니다. 그러나 최고의 답은 오로지 하나만 존재합니다.
심플래는 당신이 내린 선택을 평가하고 등급을 부여할 것입니다.



필요하다면 힌트를 적극적으로 활용해주세요. 발상의 전환을 촉진할 수 있습니다.



퍼즐을 풀어나가며 다양한 난이도와 기믹을 마주하세요.
새로운 지형과 캐릭터의 움직임이 당신을 기다립니다.

심플래에는 시뮬레이션되는 다양한 플랫포머 세계가 존재합니다.
새로운 세계에는 새로운 규칙과 또 다른 주인공을 중심으로 이야기가 펼쳐집니다.



시뮬레이션의 목적은 무엇일까요? 시뮬레이션의 끝에 어떤 결말이 우리를 기다리고 있을까요?
당신이 내린 선택을 흥미롭게 관찰할 것입니다. 행운을 빕니다.

title: Cardstronaut
description:
게임 정보
Summary
Embark on a thrilling journey as the Cardstronaut in this 2.5D roguelike deck-building adventure! You wake up as an astronaut from a cloning bay without any memory of where you are or what you are doing. The base AI tells you that you must find a way to defeat the aliens in the base and rescue your colleagues, but you have no memory of this - how much do you trust it? You don't have many weapons, so you must utilize strategy and tactics to activate the flame throwers installed on the ceiling throughout the base to defeat the aliens and uncover what's actually going on.
Gameplay
Play fuel cards to get fuel in green zone
The gameplay is a 1D tactics game where the enemies move left/right and you must balance fuel and keep it in the exact range before you end your turn to activate the flame throwers. If you overfill the gasoline, then you will lose all gasoline and get hurt yourself instead. The enemies move towards you so you have to predict where they will be when you finally do manage to activate the flamethrower.
Position enemies tactically to win battles

title: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL
description:
게임 정보
CHANGE THE BOARD. CHASE THE WORLD.
The short-and-sweet INDIEPOCALYPSE original from developer circle SKY HOUR WORKS finally releases standalone on Steam as HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL, an upgraded release of our first action title in the PROJECT NATURA series. Rush into an upgraded adventure with revamped story content, new system changes, and updated polish to bring the definitive ENDLESS RUNNER X GEAR-BASED ROGUELITE action out there.
CHANGE THE BOARD - Equip a garage of hoverboards to store between runs and apply to different situations. CHASE THE WORLD - Risk it all and choose when to end your run - either preserving your boards or bailing for a hell of a finish.
FEATURES
- ENDLESS RUNNER X GEAR-BASED RPG: Stat up your boards and store them between runs - the boards you bail with are gone forever, though!
- Teach 'em new tricks: New abilities will join you, alongside a more fleshed-out map progression, letting you choose your path along the ride!
- Take breaks in-between stages by tinkering your boards and learning more about the story of the hero out of time, now revamped with a proper ending and progress trackers.
- Steam Achievements, Leaderboards, and Cloud Support are included!
- Featuring an Original Soundtrack by Rukyyy (SPACE / MECH / PILOT and A NIGHTMARE'S TRIP)
autokwd: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL

title: Hotel 2025: Anomalies
description:
게임 정보
호텔 2025: 아노말리스에 오신 것을 환영합니다 – 놓을 수 없는 퍼즐이 기다리고 있습니다.
호텔 2025: 이상 현상의 으스스하면서도 우아한 복도로 발을 들여보세요. 모든 방에는 이야기가 숨겨져 있고, 모든 구석에는 비밀이 감춰져 있습니다. 이곳은 평범한 호텔이 아닙니다. 이상한 사건들, 움직이는 물건들, 설명할 수 없는 이상 현상이 당신의 발견을 기다리고 있습니다. 호텔에 삼켜지기 전에 이 혼란의 진실을 밝힐 수 있겠습니까?
6개의 레벨 + 1개의 비밀 레벨
호텔 복도
개인 수영장
호텔 갤러리
대기실
밤의 다이닝룸
1925년 오래된 사무실
당신이 찾아야 할 비밀 스위트룸

title: The Silo 24
description:
게임 정보
STORY
Begin an adventure in a post-apocalyptic world hit by a natural anomaly that emerged through a portal in one of the underground laboratories.
Some of humanity was able to take refuge in bunkers built by several corporations, one of which is "Silos Corp". The rest either became infected or continue to fight for survival in the vast overgrown and dangerous wasteland, where there are no past rules apply.
Take on the role of a special forces fighter named Martin Grylls and infiltrate a certain Silo 24, from which an emergency signal has been received.
Immerse yourself in a deep plot filled with intriguing characters, each with their own stories, and uncover the main secret of Silo 24 that divided Martin's life into before and after.
EXPLORATION
Explore linear abandoned locations of the bunker, laboratory, city, village, roads, forests and other eerily picturesque places, collecting resources and finding safe paths.
QUESTS AND PUZZLES
On your journey, you will encounter various obstacles and challenges, which can always be overcome by using ingenuity or strength to move toward your goal.
INFECTED
Bloodthirsty zombies, monsters and titans roam around, infected with mutated bioluminescent plants that came from another universe through a portal.
SURVIVAL
Always be on guard, because danger lurks around every corner. Armed with a variety of weapons, both firearms and melee, enter the fight for survival.
HORROR
In the dark corridors of the dead bunker you will find fascinating glowing plants, but this does not mean that the situation is safe. This is not your territory, and you are not welcome here.

title: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero
description:
게임 정보
Ragnar Lothbrok, once a legendary Viking hero, has been summoned back to life by Odin the All-Father. In his previous life, Ragnar fought valiantly, yet his soul was tainted by misdeeds, and his spirit was forced to wander in the cold mists of Hel’s domain, deprived of Valhalla's glory.
But Odin saw something of value in Ragnar’s unyielding spirit.
And now, the All-Father has granted him a second chance - not only to redeem himself but to serve the gods in a quest that spans realms few have ever seen.
Our hero embarks on a mysterious journey to recover powerful artifacts scattered by ancient forces. Ragnar's quest leads him through enchanted lands, filled with magic, illusions, and strange creatures, his path lit only by glimpses of fate and the weight of his own redemption.
autokwd: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero

title: Maid For My Master
description:
게임 정보
Set a stone's throw into the future, Maid For My Master is a cute romance story between an unlikely pair.
Asahi is a young man who was born and raised in the countryside. He moves to Tokyo, hoping to make a new life for himself, but he soon discovers that the big city isn't all it's cracked up to be. Asahi doesn't have much in the way of money, and he has to scrimp and save while working a low-paying job at a convenience store.
Asahi's co-worker, Nazuna, is unfailingly cold and rude, and as chilly winter sets in, Asahi begins to wonder whether he made a mistake in leaving home...
At least, until he meets the mysterious maid, Holly, and feelings between them begin to blossom.
Holly is Asahi's dream girl. She's kind, gentle, and affectionate (even if she is slightly taller than he is), but there's a catch. Holly isn't a human at all: she's a robot! Can Asahi's relationship with Holly flourish, or is it doomed to a critical failure?
90k of text (approx 3-5 hours of reading)
a linear narrative with no choices or branches
original character and background artwork in a cute anime style
an original soundtrack
one robot maid
a cute romance story!!!

title: Soul•Apocalypto
description:
게임 정보
《Soul Apocalypto》는 롤 플레이팅 게임이지만 동시에 팀 전략 선택에도 중점을 두고 있습니다. 여러 가지 다른 캐릭터를 소환해 자신만의 팀을 구성할 수 있으며 캐릭터 스킬을 조정하여 팀 특성을 구현할 수 있습니다. 어떤 동료를 선택할지, 각 동료의 스킬을 어떻게 배치할지가 모든 도전에 승리하는关键입니다.

title: The Watcher's Curse
description:
게임 정보
Play the free demo now!
Distinct art-style that brings the haunting world of Hollow Veil to life.
Immersive narrative-driven gameplay unfolds a grim tale of mystery, ancient gods, and supernatural peril.
Turn-based combat challenges players to destroy their foes in whatever manner they see fit.
Unravel what secrets lie in the land of Hollow Veil as you explore its haunted landscapes and encounter its gently-deranged inhabitants.
Level up to increase your base stats and unlock powerful new spells.
Welcome to the mysterious land of Hollow Veil, where darkness thrives and hopeless souls wander endlessly. In The Watcher's Curse, you step into the shoes of Artem, a duty-burdened watcher tasked with protecting the world from nefarious forces.
As a watcher, Artem's responsibilities are twofold: learn the secrets of the world along with any lost knowledge and remove any threats posed by the aforementioned nefarious forces. Most common amongst said forces are the puritanical technotheists, a fanatical order that believes technology brings them closer to god. Whether stationed in an overlapped hell forest or chasing ancient horrors through an ageless monolith, Artem faces a relentless barrage of esoteric threats.
Our tale begins with Artem in a precarious predicament, unexpectedly transported across the world after a chance encounter with a seemingly innocuous tome. Stranded in the gloomy confines of Grimm's Briar, nestled amidst the foreboding Noctemura mountains, Artem crosses paths with Mayor Barkeep. Eager to return home, Artem finds himself entangled in the mayor's plea for aid in unraveling the enigma shrouding the disappearance of local villagers.

title: Effective Immediately
description:
게임 정보
Congratulations,
You have been appointed the position of repair technician on-board the deep space relay station. Pack your belongings, your family can not join you at this time.
Effective Immediately.

Effective Immediately is a gritty, sci-fi future on the verge of political change. As the sole position of travel in the galaxy you must decide who to accept or decline passage to. Encounter alien denizens and walk the line of survival or upholding morality. Make a choice and deal with the consequences.

Compare documents for inconsistencies, repair ship systems and ultimately allow or disallow travel. All the while the OCA is piling on more and more bureaucratic red tape in this puzzle, management life-sim.
Make choices that impact the story
Meet many different characters with unique motivations and inner conflicts. Are they lying or telling the truth?
Pass judgment and determine not only their fates but also the trajectory of your own journey.

Verify ID discrepancies
Ensure they have the correct details; name, race, expiry date all match?
What is their destination? Does their story match up? Are they allowed to travel to that sector since the new OCA regulations came in?

Use schematic rules to repair many alien ship systems; navigation, shields, medical and more.
Learn the rules and become an efficient engineer.

title: Fracctal Monsters
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Fracctal Monsters, the ultimate monster taming experience that takes pet care and real-time combat to a whole new level!



Embark on an exciting journey filled with online exploration, immersive training, adrenaline-pumping 2D action-based platformer combat, and intense PvP battles where you'll face off against other players for epic loot and bragging rights.



In Fracctal Monsters, every virtual pet is more than just a creature – they're your loyal companions with unique personalities, distinct hobbies, specific diets, and individual preferences. Each monster offers a one-of-a-kind bond and interaction that will keep you coming back for more.



Explore a vibrant, living world where you can discover hidden secrets and participate in thrilling challenges. Obtain new monsters by opening packs or winning them in various in-game challenges. The expansive world of Fracctal Monsters is teeming with adventures that challenge your skills and strategic thinking.



Raise and evolve your monsters by engaging them in training modes, keeping them happy, and feeding them their preferred diets. Watch as they grow stronger, learn new abilities, and transform into even more powerful forms. The evolution system allows for deep customization and personal connection with your monsters.



Prepare for epic boss battles that test the limits of your monster's strength and strategy. Team up with other players or go solo to take down formidable foes and earn exclusive rewards. Each boss encounter is a challenge that requires tactical planning and skillful execution.



With a vast world to explore, countless challenges to overcome, and a thriving community of fellow tamers, Fracctal Monsters promises endless hours of fun, excitement, and adventure. So, are you ready to dive into the captivating world of monster taming and unleash the power of your Fracctal Monsters? Join us now and embark on an unforgettable journey like no other!

title: Operatives: Revolve
description:
게임 정보
Operative Revolve is a cinematic roguelike deckbuilder with a unique gameplay mechanic. Play as Operatives, secret agents who oversee a world governed by machine ideology. Use your Machine cards to physically attack or block damage while battling enemies who oppose your directive and uncover the hidden truths within the machinated world.

title: Aether Singularity
description:
게임 정보
A demonic anomaly has been detected in an important research facility. DATA agents... deploy!

In 1969, mankind established its first link to the Aethernet. Humanity soon entered a golden age of technological wonder and prosperity.
But, kept secret from the eyes of the public, a second discovery was made shortly after... demons weren't just the subject of myths and religion.
To combat them, the Demonic Anomalies Termination Agency was born. An FBI offshoot where agents are partnered with daemons through a pact, their mission: send the demons back where they belong.
GAMEPLAY
In this fixed camera action game you and your squad will have to explore a top secret facility. Balance the powers of both magic and lead to defeat the demons who are rampaging throughout it!
Battles take place in real-time, requiring you to dodge enemy attacks and find the perfect time to retaliate against them. As you shoot enemies you'll gain mana which you can use to cast spells to gain an advantage. On the verge of death will you choose to use what little mana you have to heal yourself, or will you try to blast away one of your foes so the battle becomes easier? Make strategic use of your resources and complete your mission!
A RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK
As you explore the facility you'll be able to find information, and maybe even spells, to help you with your mission. However, you'll be faced with a constant timer that ticks down even when in battles. Failing to get to the bottom of things before time runs out won't spell the end for you, but...
BONUS CHALLENGES
In addition to the main mission there are over 15 bonus challenges that can be tackled! Defeat the enemies, protect the target, and more as you aim for the best score possible! Can you get a gold rank in all of them?
THE CAST




SILVIA
An experienced agent, she has been working at DATA for a decade. Felt like nobody ever had her back until she got assigned to Alfonso's squad, thus adopted a bit of a rebellious attitude. Competent at her job, she enjoys being sent on assignments despite her snarky remarks.
Silvia's daemon, bound by pact. Quite reliable, has learned to adapt to Silvia's attitude and does his best to cheer her up.
While she might not show it, Silvia is glad to have been partnered with him. Their mutual trust has resulted in Ranru evolving and being able to cast a variety of magicks.
The leader of the squad, his expertise has gained him notoriety within DATA veterans. After a mission gone wrong and a falling off with his previous team, he was reassigned to direct a smaller, fast-response squad, which he's now fond of.

The latest addition to the squad, recruited due to her excellent track record as a police officer. Has great social skills and is used to dealing with civilians, but is still trying to fit in in DATA. Greatly respects Alfonso and Silvia.

title: Bloom Paradise
description:
게임 정보
Story
Every nook and cranny in Bloom Paradise was once filled with flowers of every color, until one day when pesky pests came and ravaged the land, rendering it unrecognizable. Thus, flower fairies Tamabo and Hanabo have joined forces, setting off on an adventure to restore Bloom Paradise to its former glory and get rid of those irksome pests.
How to Play
Play as either Tamabo (Player 1) or Hanabo (Player 2) and make flowers bloom. Fill all the grounds in each stage to clear it. How you bloom flowers differs between single-player mode and two-player mode. In single-player mode, flowers bloom on the ground as Tamabo walks across. In two-player mode, however, when either Tamabo or Hanabo walks across the ground, only flower buds appear. The other character must then touch these buds to make them bloom. Work together to take back Bloom Paradise from the pests. Both Tamabo and Hanabo can shoot water in the direction they're facing with the use of the attack button. Flowers can't bloom when the ground is covered in mud, so use water to clean up and eradicate any pests standing in your way.
Features
・100 total stages
・19 types of bothersome yet likable pests
・Single-player and two-player coop modes with differing ways to play
・Game design reminiscent of late 80s arcade games

title: Gunma's Ambition -You and me are Gunma- Reiwa 2nd national census edition
description:
게임 정보
Let's change all of Japan to Gunma.
The definitive edition of the Gunma simulation game.
Everyone can play!
Story mode
You become Gunma and collect special products.
If you get a special product, you can get G (GUNMA).


Next, select the prefecture you want to change to Gunma.
Then use G (GUNMA) to draw the gacha.


The people of the selected prefecture will change to Gunma for the population of the municipalities that came out in Gacha.
When everyone changes to Gunma, the prefecture changes to Gunma.
autokwd: Gunma's Ambition -You and me are Gunma- Reiwa 2nd national census edition

title: BannerBound
description:
게임 정보
당신의 군대를 이끌고, 3인칭 실시간 전투에서 제국을 건설하세요.
다양한 난이도의 역동적인 환경에서 전술적 능력을 시험하세요. 전략을 조정하고, 군대를 지휘하며, 승리를 쟁취하세요.
주요 특징:
⚔️ 군대 커스터마이징: 부대를 선택하고 색상을 변경하며, 자신만의 깃발을 디자인하세요.
⚔️ 영웅 커스터마이징: 영웅의 외형과 능력치를 수정하여 플레이 스타일에 맞게 조정하세요.

title: Vega Motions: Project Unleashed
description:
게임 정보
Vega Motions: Project Unleashed is a skills-based fighting video game for the PC. You play in 3rd person split screen mode against a friend or in full screen mode against the AI. The fight is set in a futuristic arena that is destructible.

title: Sanctua
description:
게임 정보
A sealed tomb awakens
What began as a straightforward archaeological expedition has turned into a nightmare. Explorers trapped inside a tomb that has been sealed for centuries desperately try to escape, when one among them succumbs slowly to corruption, becoming a dark guardian determined to protect the secrets of these ruins at all costs.
Unite to survive or die alone
Play as an Explorer, using cooperation, ingenuity, stealth, and adaptability to survive. Or embrace the darkness as the Ancient: a corrupted being with heightened senses, relentlessly hunting those who were once your allies. 
Each role provides unique gameplay, blending strategy, suspense, and unpredictability.
The Explorers
Your greatest strength lies in adapting to your surroundings and staying stealthy, at least as much as your team allows. If trouble finds you, you'll just have a few rudimentary tools to defend yourself.

title: The Unseen
description:
게임 정보
House parties aren't supposed to result in your death, right?
Find yourself thrown into the depths of darkness with little chance of making it out alive in The Unseen. What starts as a seemingly normal house party quickly turns into a nightmare as you become trapped in a dark, twisting labyrinth beneath. But beware, you are not alone. To survive, you must understand your hunter...
Being Hunted
As apex predators, humans rarely rely on their senses in everyday life. That is about to change. You will need to sharpen your instincts and use the environment to your advantage to evade terrifying threats and unfavourable outcomes. Every shadow, sound, and hiding spot could mean the difference between life and death.
Resource Management
Scarcity breeds chaos. Can you truly trust another human to help you survive, or would you betray them to ensure your own survival? Resources are limited, and every decision matters. Banding together can help you cover more ground and increase your chances of survival, but always keep an eye on your 'friends'. That torch in their hand looks like it's in good condition... but would it look better in your hands?
Crafting
Crafting can ensure your survival, it could also attract some unwanted attention. One wrong move and all your hard work will count for nothing.
Survival
To survive like an animal, you must think like an animal. Cover your scent. Find food. Find water. Adapt to your environment. Use every resource at your disposal. As always, bring something heavy... just in case.
Secrets
Who would do something like this? Why would they do this? What is this place? Find the the answers in the deepest depths of this terrible place. Uncover the dark secrets that force you to fight for survival.

title: Clicky
description:
게임 정보
Clicky is a strategy-based procedurally generated computer simulation puzzle game heavily inspired by the technology and software of the 1990s, and features an original MIDI soundtrack chock-full of personality and a plethora of colorful, unique characters across multiple levels.
Play over and over again with procedurally generated levels!
Use the tools at your disposal to weed out deadly glitches, spam emails, and more unusual threats!

title: Maximus Mouse's Manic Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
Maximus Mouse is back!
Experience manic arcade action set across loads of game modes. Classic arcade gameplay with many twists and surprises awaits you!
Story
Those pesky cats have stolen Max's retirement fund! Pursue them around the world to get it back, but watch out for surprises along the way!
Party!
Grab three of your friends for some couch mayhem! Stay alive, grab those coins and capture those cheeses! Use power ups to your advantage, but beware - anything can happen: laser attacks, high winds, and lemon hitmen are just a few of the events you'll face.

Oh, and do keep an eye out for that walrus!
Trials
Pit your wits against the cats across 50+ trials. Quick, bite-sized challenges to test any mouse!
Arcade
Try your hand at the arcade modes and beat those scores!

title: The Banker Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
The Banker Tycoon은 꿈의 은행을 구축하고 관리하는 매력적인 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 먼저 서비스의 전략적 가격을 설정하고, 최고의 직원을 채용하여 최상의 운영을 보장하십시오. 은행을 맞춤 설정하고 확장하여 비전에 맞게 기능과 역량을 향상시키세요. 은행이 성장함에 따라 명성이 높아지고, 더 부유한 고객을 끌어들여 금융 세계의 리더로 자리매김할 것입니다. 도전에 대응하고, 혁신하며, 은행 산업의 정상에 올라 궁극의 은행 거물이 되십시오!
은행의 세부 사항을 만들고 맞춤화하며, 서비스를 확장하고 장식하십시오.
더 많은 카운터/책상 추가
좌석 구역 확장
장식과 분위기 향상
직원의 요구사항 충족
더 나은 고객 서비스를 위해 시설 업그레이드

title: Worldseekers - Deckbuilding RPG
description:
게임 정보
Worldseekers는 GPS 탐색 RPG입니다. 이 세계의 광활한 땅과 기만적인 던전을 탐험하면서 희귀한 카드, 이벤트, 독특한 캐릭터를 발견하세요.

정신적, 육체적 건강을 증진하기 위해 Worldseekers는 GPS 메커니즘과 전화 앱 링크를 사용하여 밖으로 나가서 걸을 수 있도록 도와줍니다. 물론 Steam 버전을 사용하면 몇 시간 동안 PC에서 플레이할 수 있으며, 추가 산책에 대한 보상도 받을 수 있습니다. 모든 스트리머의 경우 기본적으로 위치를 조정하거나 숨깁니다.

이메일 뉴스레터에도 가입하세요: (다른 소셜 미디어 자료는 아직 모두 있지만 이메일이 훨씬 더 좋습니다. IMO에서는)
세상을 신비와 신비가 가득한 환상적인 땅으로 바꿔보세요:
[목록]
독특하고 어려운 몬스터를 물리치세요
재미있고 수수께끼 같은 서사를 즐겨보세요
끊임없이 변화하는 땅이 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞춰집니다.
던전 및 기타 콘텐츠를 집에 가져가서 건강한 습관에 대한 보상을 받으세요.[/목록]
미스테리와 마법이 가득한 광대한 세계를 탐험해보세요.
전설적인 생물과 전투를 벌이고 던전 깊이를 탐험하세요.


질문이나 피드백이 있거나 우리를 지원하고 싶다면(확실히 사용할 수 있음) Twitch나 YouTube(최종 보스 편집)에서 저에게 연락해 주세요!

title: Project: Autumn
description:
게임 정보
Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands. 
Explore and Discover
Run, climb, and crawl across the islands as you collect and find new items and tools! 
Be a part of the Community!
Why are we always so pressured by efficiency? Work together with many fun and quirky people as you each learn to relax and enjoy the beauty around you.
Unwind in a Recovering Paradise
Although on a top secret mission, the distractions here are plentiful! Surely our bosses won’t mind if we fish for a little while longer.

title: Cosmic Coop
description:
게임 정보
GAME UPDATE:
Art (100% COMPLETE!)
Code (99% COMPLETE!)
Gameplay Trailer (Coming soon)
Cosmic Coop DEMO (60% Complete)
Adding in all the items (1000% COMPLETE!)
Dialogue / Quests (70% Complete)
Localization (0% Complete)
Final Polish (50% Complete)
Crash-land on Critteria and embark on a cozy, out-of-this-world adventure! In Cosmic Coop, you’ll transform a patch of alien soil into a bustling farm brimming with adorable Critterlings—each with its own quirks and cosmic charms.
Decorate & Attract
Channel your inner designer and fill your farm with shimmering altars, glowing lights, and lush crops. Every new decoration tempts curious Critterlings to stop by—and maybe even stick around for good!
Build & Nurture
From constructing snug coops to planting local flora, turn your farm into a vibrant haven. Each discovery, whether it’s a rare seed or a newly hatched Critterling, brings you closer to beauty of Critteria.
Explore & Befriend
It’s not just Critterlings who call this planet home. Encounter strange anthropomorphic neighbors who offer advice, trade essential items, and share stories about the world you’ve stumbled upon. Friendship, after all, is the greatest resource in the galaxy.

title: Shield Cat: The Lost Conductor
description:
게임 정보
A Troubling Dream...
Shield Cat: The Lost Conductor is a game starring Lance the otter, a mail courier for the Cat Kingdom. One day, he has a dream where his partner Parker calls out to him.
"Lance, please help me!"
Lance wakes up with a start. Is his partner really in trouble? Or was it really just a dream...
Explore And Collect!
There are tons of collectibles and secrets in the Cat Kingdom! Throughout your quest, you'll find abilities to make you stronger, as well as grant you access to new areas and secrets. A detailed map screen will help you keep track of your progress, where you've been, and where you need to go. Can you find all the hidden collectibles across the land?
Features
Beautiful pixel art reminiscent of the 16 and 32bit games of old, with plenty of modern enhancements.
Find abilities to increase your power, as well as gain access to new areas you couldn’t before.
Passive abilities that grant you bonuses and new moves just for having them.
Mysterious puzzles all across the world. You’ll need to keep your wits about you for them!
Tons of different collectibles to find all over the Cat Kingdom.
Several areas to explore, from the depths of the Lignum Woods, the dark Abandoned Mines, and the mysterious Autumn Grove.
A detailed map system that keeps track of your progress in each area, how many collectibles you still need to find, and more.
Secret areas all over the Cat Kingdom to be found by only the most cunning players.
A cast of humorous and interesting characters to meet and interact with.
And Much More...
A number of retro filters to take you back to the past.
Plenty of accessibility options to make it easier for everyone to play.
Full Keyboard, Mouse, and Gamepad support, as well as full action rebinding - Play however you like!

title: Treasures of the Haunted Forest
description:
게임 정보
Finding a job in the big city is hardly possible for a young witch, and the rumors say the haunted forest hides countless unique alchemical ingredients. Maybe that would be your chance?

Explore the haunted forest in search of alchemical ingredients. Discover new potions and sell them to customers. Enhance your equipment to enter even deeper into the woods. Improve and decorate your house.

title: Roam
description:
게임 정보
지역 땅은 많은 비밀, 자연의 경이, 보물 및 유물을 숨겨있습니다. 그러나 주요한 미스터리는 수세기 동안 호수 바닥에 존재해 온 방대한 터널과 동굴 네트워크입니다. 여러분은 탐험가의 역할을 맡아 이러한 고대 지하 통로의 깊이를 탐험하고 호수와 그 주변의 비밀을 풀어내는 임무를 맡고 있습니다.

오픈 월드와 절차적 생성
«Roam» 의 세계에서는 절차적 생성 덕분에 무작위 이벤트와 적대적인 환경 시스템이 각 플레이에서 독특한 상황을 만들어냅니다. 위험이 매 순간 도사리고 있습니다: 공격적인 생물들의 공격, 함정, 그리고 마법적인 이상 현상은 여러분이 직면할 작은 부분일 뿐입니다.

선택의 자유와 퀘스트
여러분은 자신의 길을 선택할 완전한 자유를 갖고 있습니다. 다양한 무기와 마법을 사용하고 유용한 물약을 준비하며, 장비를 찾고, 만들고, 업그레이드하여 적대적인 환경을 헤쳐 나가세요. 탐험 경로의 선택은 여러분에게 달려 있습니다. 플레이어는 적과 싸우거나 전투를 피하고, 무자비한 힘 대신 교묘함, 민첩성 및 마법을 사용할지 선택할 수 있습니다. 위험을 혼자든지 친구와 함께 극복하고 매료시키는 장소를 탐험하며 새로운 비밀을 발견하세요. 퀘스트는 여러분에게 최대한의 행동 자유를 제공하기 위해 디자인되었습니다. 손잡이로 안내하는 대신 힌트를 제공하여 여러분이 과업을 해결하고 목표를 달성하는 방법을 선택할 수 있게 합니다. 여러분의 결정은 사건의 흐름에 영향을 주며 새로운 기회를 열거나 예상치 못한 결과로 이어질 수 있습니다.

탐험하고, 싸우고, 생존하세요.

title: Y2K Directive
description:
게임 정보
The year is 1999.

As chaos looms on the horizon, reports flood in of gigantic monsters, zombie plagues, interdimensional portals, and various supernatural disasters unfolding worldwide. You, a military leader from a small island nation, are tasked with a simple yet daunting mission: Save as many civilians as possible before the clock strikes 2000.

Welcome to your Y2K Directive.

SURVIVE: Navigate through this apocalyptic year, rescuing civilians from endangered cities and deploying your troops to stem the tide of horrors.

ADAPT: Leverage the terrain, day and night cycles, and weather to your advantage. Train your troops, rebuild destroyed bases and power plants, and establish refugee camps for civilians. Keep panic and civil unrest at bay.

OVERCOME Every problem has a solution. Utilize your troops not just for combat but also to reduce panic, quell civil unrest, or suppress insurgencies. Manage your economy and infrastructure with precision to save your country from impending doom.

This strategic civil defense simulation, inspired by classic games like XCOM/UFO with roguelike elements, guarantees endless possibilities to test your skills. In each playthrough, a new scenario is generated. Zombies? Alien fauna? Kaijus? Maybe all of them (and more) at once? Choose your preferred settings, or let the random generator surprise you. Will you withstand the test, or let your country fall into chaos and anarchy?

title: Hyperspace Deck Command
description:
게임 정보
Command advanced battle fleets!
Protect your fabricator megaship from waves of advancing enemies in tactical, card-based combat.
Deploy and move your space forces across multiple orbital lanes.
Use high-tech ability cards to support your vessels in battle.
Carefully consider your actions: Units operate on individual turn timers and every card you play brings them closer to carrying out their next attack run.
Enhance your tactics with dual-use status effects!
Ability cards in Hyperspace Deck Command give you an extra bit of tactical flexibility. Every effect works differently depending on if you play them against allies or enemies. Do you want to shield your ship, or contain and prevent damage from a specific attacker? Do you deploy defensive mines around your front line unit or trap the approach vector of a specific enemy? Should your carriers deploy fighters to strafe targets, or send them to guard your own vessels?
Build highly customizable decks!
Combine dozens of possible fabricators, deck commanders, randomly generated flagships and auxiliary vessels into thousands of possible starting decks.

title: Te-Amic
description:
게임 정보
Multiplayer: Team up with friends to survive and upgrade your abilities in a world filled with various equipment.
Farming: Grow a wide variety of plants and raise animals to build and expand your farm.
Survival: Gather resources, craft tools, and fight to survive against harsh environments and challenging enemies.
Te-Amic: A special system where you can make new friends to assist you on your journey.

title: House spirit cat
description:
게임 정보
Imagine, how could spirits and mythical creatures feel these days? What if they were closer, than it could seem? Perhaps, your classmate nearby or a guy selling you street food may appear as one of them.
This is a story about Kot - a house spirit in the shape of a cat. It’s lost its owner and his powers leave him insensibly. It has to find a new owner to survive before they disappear. But what if he meets a lost kitten? Or a restless soul? Or a thirsting demon hunting the weakend hero’s energy remains?
Here you can control the character’s fate and the events of the story. Make your choice, fights with demons, save kittens and punish villains All in your paws.
Game features:
Multiple endings, non linear playthrough
Visual novel with interactive elements.
Original soundtracks
Fairy tale characters in the modern world
Cats!

title: Back To The Collis
description:
게임 정보
Back To The Collis is a story-rich, fully hand-drawn Point & Click adventure puzzle game, that will take you on a journey into the atmospheric world and amaze you with lots of logical and engaging puzzles.





In Back to the Collis you will play as Benjamin, who has formerly left the town of Collis, built on a hill, and now lives in the forest in his comfort, nearby the town.
But after a while, Benjamin must return to the Collis to tackle a seemingly simple problem of water shortage, which has already affected him as well.
With Benjamin, you will have a chance to explore the town, introduce its varied and memorable populace, their social problems, solve lots of exciting puzzles and who knows, maybe at the end of your shared journey you will even understand why he left this town long ago.




Back to the Collis is classic point & click adventure game, where you will solve lots of engaging environmental quests and logical puzzles.
This game is designed to be more than just a game, it is an adventure that will make you think about the way of life of its society, their coexistence issues, which has lots of in common with our real ones.

title: Calamity
description:
게임 정보
You are our very best in these chaotic times. Your job is to help out the locals during these devastating disasters. Can you survive the calamities?
Chaotic Events: Experience meteors smashing into buildings, physics driven tornadoes ripping through towns and tossing you and the locals around, and exploding everything near by, survive the blistering cold inflicted by blizzards, and find cover while dust storms are hitting and huge tumbleweeds hit the town.

Destruction: Experience buildings getting ripped apart by tornadoes or meteors smashing into buildings flying debris.


Player Choices: Play with your friends or find others to help out the locals while trying to survive natural disasters. Adapt and alter your surroundings to gain advantages and create new paths to safety.

title: Cozy Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
코지 던전은 던전을 탐험하며 적을 물리치고 개조하여 수익을 얻는 어드벤처/인테리어 디자인 게임입니다! 사업에 새로운 변화를 더하기로 한 몬스터 퇴치 길드의 리더가 되어 보세요. 던전을 민박집으로 바꿀 수 있는데 던전 정복에만 집중할 필요는 없잖아요?
위험천만한 던전 탐험
교묘한 퍼즐과 사악한 적, 치명적인 함정으로 가득한 던전을 통과하세요. 탐험과 전투에 도움이 되는 다양한 도구를 사용하고 기지를 발휘하면 생존에 필요한 우위를 점할 수 있습니다.

내면의 장인정신을 발휘하세요
여러분이 방문하는 모든 던전은 고객의 소유이며, 고객들은 새로운 모습을 보고 싶어 합니다! 새 가구를 만들고 쓰레기를 치우며, 벽과 바닥을 바꾸고 고장 난 가구를 판매하는 등 다양한 작업을 할 수 있습니다! 모든 준비가 끝나면 이제 돈이 굴러들어 오길 기다리면 됩니다!

길드 커스터마이징
열심히 번 골드를 사용하여 길드를 꾸미고 확장하며 캐릭터를 향상시키고, 새로운 설계도를 사고, 새로운 친구를 만나는 등 원하는 방식대로 길드를 꾸미고 확장할 수 있습니다!

title: Backrooms: Levels of Fear
description:
게임 정보
당신이 조심하지 않고 엉뚱한 곳에서 현실을 벗어나면 당신은 뒷방에 있게 될 것입니다. 그곳은 눅눅한 오래된 카펫의 냄새, 모노노랑의 광기, 형광등의 끝없는 배경 소음뿐입니다. 최대 윙윙거리는 소리와 함께 무작위로 분할된 약 6억 평방 마일의 빈 방에 갇히게 됩니다.
지옥에서 당신의 말을 확실히 들었기 때문에 근처에서 방황하는 소리가 들리면 신이 당신을 구하십시오.

1인칭 심리 및 생존 공포 경험. 당신은 백룸에서 길을 잃었고 이 위험한 우주에서 살아남을 방법을 찾아야 합니다.
다양한 레벨을 탐색하고 단서, 물건 또는 메시지를 찾아 백룸의 비밀을 알아내십시오.
이곳에 살고 있는 독립체와 탈출하거나 싸우거나 대화를 시도하세요.
다른 탐험가의 발자취를 따라 그들을 만나고, 그들의 은신처에서 피난처를 찾고, 인벤토리를 채워서 생존 가능성을 높이십시오.
당신은 현실 세계로의 복귀에 성공할 것인가, 아니면 뒷방의 깊숙한 곳에서 길을 잃을 것인가?

주요 기능:
백룸 탐색
위험에서 살아남기
그들의 비밀을 밝혀라
개체와 다른 탐험가를 만나다

⚠️ 이것은 게임이 아닙니다! 백룸이 존재하며 위험은 현실입니다. 이 프로그램을 실행하는 것은 생존 가능성을 높일 수 있는 유일한 기회입니다. 놓치지 마세요, 지금 위시리스트!

title: Dino Party
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Dino Party, a wild multiplayer brawler where friendships are tested, and buildings don’t last long. Battle through a series of unpredictable minigames, punch your friends into oblivion, and tear down the arena in fully physics-driven destruction. Play online or locally—just be ready for absolute mayhem.
Seamless Minigame Mayhem
Experience non-stop action as the stadium morphs seamlessly between explosive minigames. Whether you’re teaming up for 2v2 soccer brawls, dodging crumbling lava floors, or surviving a frantic game of hot potato, every match throws unpredictable hazards. No two rounds are ever alike!
Punch First, Ask Questions Later
Two buttons. Endless chaos. String together punch combos to yeet rivals off cliffs, shield at the perfect moment to avoid disaster, or unleash the dreaded Assbomb™ (a butt-stomp so powerful, it’s legally required to yell “BOOM” when you land). Whether you’re a strategic shield-master or a button-mashing maniac, everyone gets to wreak havoc!

title: DearMyFriend
description:
게임 정보
DearMyFriend is a beautifully pixel-art and story-driven sandplay exploration game developed by GuluGames.



On an ordinary day, a train from another world slowly stopped outside the classroom, as if sensing the call of lonely girl.
Stepping onto the train, the light and wind of the golden continent rushed towards you, indicating the beginning of your adventure.
At this moment, you would not know your footsteps would cover every corner of the continent, and the songs in the wind would sing your name.


The golden continent filled with maple leaves, the bitterly cold valley blanketed in endless snow, the deep abyss of dark flames, or the land of civilization high above the clouds... You will wander diverse areas of the Stargather Land, weave together the ancient tales behind the continent of stars.

Of course, interspersed between these exciting adventures is your dull real life. Sometimes you have to return to your small room, but this may let you figure out what you really want.



Battle is not just about using brute force as you know. Here are some combat suggestions from Stargather Envoy:
Observe carefully and find the chance to defeating the enemy quickly;
Allocate stamina reasonably, use different elemental powers at the right time, crush your enemies with one hit.

It seems you already know this. Stargather Land never let you down.
You have chances to take on an advanced challenge after you finished the normal one.



Numerous treasures and accessories are scattered throughout the Stargather Land, where never disappoint the brave. So find them as much as possible and try to use them, which will add endless richness to your adventures!

This is a fascinating fantasy world and a gripping growth story.
On the journey, there is always a moment that makes you stop and admire.

title: Dual Eclipse
description:
게임 정보

Dual Eclipse is a shortform dungeon crawler meant to be played over a weekend that resolves turn-based combat with trick-taking. Players will parry cards, turn the tide of battle with powerful Eclipse cards, and loot monsters to upgrade their decks.
Play as one of three classes to explore mysterious dungeons, evade dangerous traps, uncover powerful treasure, and discover secrets.
UNIQUE TRICK-TAKING COMBAT

title: The Greenening
description:
게임 정보
For fans of short incremental games like Nodebuster & Digseum.
Wash away the ashes to gain knowledge about a forlorn world.
Rediscover and nourish the life buried beneath.
Expand your abilities and grow ever more powerful.

title: Fillet Fury
description:
게임 정보
필렛 퓨리에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
카드 한 장이 강철의 번쩍임으로 끝날 수 있는 무자비한 서부 시대. 플레이어는 고위험 게임에서 자신의 신경과 칼 실력을 시험받습니다. 하지만 주의하세요. 필렛 퓨리에서는 돈이 아니라 손가락을 겁니다.
전략과 실시간 액션이 결합된 혁신적인 경험을 즐겨보세요.
결정 하나로 모든 것이 바뀔 수 있습니다.
게임플레이:
강렬한 메커니즘: 점점 더 어려운 적들과 베팅하며, 라운드마다 생사를 건 나이프 게임으로 발전.
전략적 사고: 상황에 맞춰 전략을 바꾸세요. 용기도 필요합니다.
서부 분위기: 시각과 사운드로 냉혹한 무법자 시대를 완벽 재현.
⚠️ 이 게임은 성인용이며, 잔혹한 폭력과 피, 고어, 자해를 묘사합니다. 플레이 시 주의 바랍니다

title: No Way Home
description:
게임 정보
[Note: the games has nothing to do with a certain superhero movie. We had the name first!]
No Way Home is a twin-stick shooter adventure, set in a hostile far flung part of the universe filled with danger at every turn. Outgun ships many times your size in tense skirmishes, complete missions for the many aliens that may offer help, loot bigger and better weapons, and explore countless areas in search of answers and a way home.
Fast-paced topdown-style twin stick combat
Engage in tense skirmishes that require the use of cover, timing and thoughtful positioning moreso than reading predictable bullet patterns
A regenerating shield allows a tactical and front-foot approach to combat, with a buffer to trade hits and move around the environment strategically
Loot new weapons and ship components as random drops from encounters, creating your own build and play-style over time
Procedural world generation with hand-crafted encounters throughout
No permadeath, classic adventure format with zone respawning
Quick-loop arcade modes to unlock
From the team that brought you Moving Out 1 & 2, Death Squared, Thumb Drift and One More Line and many others.
Features
A rich story mode set across a huge universe
Stunning hand-drawn artwork
50+ weapons to loot, craft and upgrade
Over 60 unique enemies to battle
Complete missions or explore freely and forge your own path
Fight huge bosses for rare loot drops (updated for this release)
Procedural universe creates unique layouts per game
Outfit your ship with the gear that suits your playstyle
Full controller support
Ship skins to unlock via arcade minigames
Daily Challenge - run and gun for daily glory with a new mega weapon every day

title: Tears of Tiamat
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a mythical quest in "Tears of Tiamat," a third-person action RPG set in a fantastical Age of Sail world, where you navigate the chaos unleashed by the awakening of the ancient sea goddess Tiamat, blending traditional warfare and magic in a quest to shape the fate of the world. Navigate this tumultuous era with your avatar, whose destiny is intertwined with the very forces that threaten to unravel the world. Will you align with the colonial powers in their quest for supremacy, or will you join Tiamat in her crusade to fulfill an ancient promise?
Explore an open-world environment with your avatar.
Fight against humans and monsters armed with a range of medieval and early modern-era weapons, as well as magic. Execute combos by alternating between magical and physical attacks, rewarding skill and timing.
Develop your avatar, buy custom armor and weaponry. Invest in skill trees to influence your magical abilities and physical combat style.
Find legendary artifacts to boost your avatar's powers and unlock unique abilities.

title: Seed Adventure
description:
게임 정보
세계수는 죽어가고 있으며, 이는 시드의 세계를 위협합니다. 시드는 마을의 족장이 후계자로 선택한 귀여운 작은 씨앗입니다! 이 3D 플랫폼 게임에서 다양한 위험한 환경을 가로질러 마을을 구하세요!
당신의 마을이 위험에 처해 있으며, 당신은 마을을 구해야 합니다! 서로 다른 7개의 환경을 지나 궁극적인 목표인 세계수에 도달하고 마을을 구하세요.
고된 모험이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다! 환경에 맞게 조정된 다양한 장애물을 극복하여 당신의 능력을 시험해보세요.
쉬움, 보통, 그리고 가장 용감한 이들을 위한 어려움 중에서 난이도를 선택하세요!

작은 구성 및 제한된 저장 공간에 적합합니다.

title: 瞳:创之槲 Tong Create Thorns
description: 게임 정보
autokwd: 瞳:创之槲 Tong Create Thorns

title: Make Us Whole
description:
게임 정보
Features
Hours of gathering and exploration in a dystopian horror-scape
A unique blend of fps action and survival horror in an endless expanse of brutalist architecture
An oppressive atmosphere of isolation in a treacherous ever-changing environment
Diverse creatures able to stalk, hunt, and devour the unprepared player
A story hidden between the cracks of concrete revealing humanity’s downfall
HARVEST
Scavenge broken machines and twisted horrors for resources rusty and alien. Choose what to scrap and what to collect, praying you find extraction chambers to save your precious loot. Will you take the gambles and boons of the maze, or embrace a slow risk-free grind?
UPGRADE
Return to the nest to upgrade and evolve your weaponry. Fuse artifacts with your tools to unlock new attributes and powers. Grow or perish. But what are you willing to sacrifice for your survival? Take care human, lest you become something else…
DISCOVER
Navigate this maze of horror, discover new environments hidden in the depths, and hunt greater monstrosities… or become the hunted. Watch your step. This place wasn’t built for humans

title: Kenopsia
description:
게임 정보
케놉시아(Kenopsia)는 조용한 깨달음의 경험이며, 과거가 머물고 보이지 않는 존재가 지켜보는 텅 빈 공간을 여행하는 것입니다. 끝없이 이어지는 빈 복도는 희미한 빛에 잠겨 있고, 잊혀진 성소는 감각 너머의 존재로 은은히 울립니다. 고요함 속 어딘가에서, 무언가가 듣고 있습니다.
당신은 홀로 걷고 있지만, 버려진 것은 아닙니다. 침묵 속에는 질문이 가득합니다. 그것은 당신의 것일까요, 아니면 누군가의 것일까요? 벽은 말해지지 않은 단어들의 메아리로 숨 쉬며, 아직 발견되지 않은 답들이 기다리고 있습니다. 한 걸음 한 걸음 내디딜수록, 당신은 말 없는 대화 속으로 더 깊이 빠져듭니다. 이해는 듣는 것이 아니라, 느끼는 것입니다.
이곳에는 ‘무언가’가 있습니다. 그리고 그것은 항상 여기 있었습니다.
당신은 들을 것인가요? 말을 걸 것인가요? 그리고 만약 그렇다면… 그것은 대답할까요?

title: DashBall
description:
게임 정보
DashBall – The Ultimate Speed Showdown
Get ready for ultra-fast duels in DashBall, a competitive game where reflexes and strategy make all the difference! Face off against your opponents in intense matches where every move counts, and use spells to gain the upper hand.
Fast-Paced Gameplay: Rapid and dynamic exchanges that test your reflexes.
Spells & Power-ups: Catch temporary spells on the map to turn the tide.
Varied Game Modes: Competitive 1v1, fast-paced matches with special rules, and unique challenges.
Ranking & Competition: Climb the leaderboard, face the best players, and become the master of the arena.
Dynamic Maps: Environments that evolve during the match to spice up the action.
Neon Arcade Style: A retro-futuristic design reminiscent of 80s arcade machines, modernized for a new generation.
Are you ready to become the master of DashBall?
Add DashBall to your wishlist now and don’t miss the release!

Note: Once the core game mechanics are developed, I will focus on improving the graphics. The current icons, banners, and visuals are a representation of the intended final look of the game.

title: Moto Roader 「モトローダー」
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to be a MOTO ROADER?
                         Imagine a time in the future when evil has been erased. Life’s tasks are handled by machines.
What will kids do to heat things up?
 They’ll all be MOTO ROADERS.
 Man and machine come together in a race of speed, skill, luck, power and strategy. Race up to four other drivers. Eight heats per race.
 Make sure you spend price money on killer part and weapons – not on weird shades and fuzzy dice!
  Features
Classic legacy title
Choose from multiple cars and drivers
Numerous race tracks
Multiple game modes including bumper car challenges
Up to 4 player local coop
Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point
Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)
Gallery: view images from the original game’s manual and box design

title: COCOBOY
description:
게임 정보
What is COCOBOY?
In an alternate history 2005, the forgotten 80's platformer COCOBOY has re-entered the public consciousness of a niche few.
Modify, brute force, and restore unused game mechanics using Modcarts, devices hacked together by tech-savvy fans. Discover clever combinations of mods in order to progress and even break level design in unexpected ways.

title: SimPlaE
description:
게임 정보
"플랫포머를 시뮬레이션으로 플레이하다"




"안녕하세요? 여기는 심플래입니다. 당신의 목표는 시뮬레이션의 클리어입니다."

모든 캐릭터는 일정한 조건에 따라 주어진 지형과 상호작용하며 자동으로 움직입니다.
당신은 캐릭터를 직접 조작할 수 없습니다.



관찰을 통해 캐릭터의 행동패턴을 파악하세요.
슬롯 내 주어진 블록을 배치하여 새로운 동선을 설계하세요.

시뮬레이션을 클리어하는 방법은 여러 가지입니다. 그러나 최고의 답은 오로지 하나만 존재합니다.
심플래는 당신이 내린 선택을 평가하고 등급을 부여할 것입니다.



필요하다면 힌트를 적극적으로 활용해주세요. 발상의 전환을 촉진할 수 있습니다.



퍼즐을 풀어나가며 다양한 난이도와 기믹을 마주하세요.
새로운 지형과 캐릭터의 움직임이 당신을 기다립니다.

심플래에는 시뮬레이션되는 다양한 플랫포머 세계가 존재합니다.
새로운 세계에는 새로운 규칙과 또 다른 주인공을 중심으로 이야기가 펼쳐집니다.



시뮬레이션의 목적은 무엇일까요? 시뮬레이션의 끝에 어떤 결말이 우리를 기다리고 있을까요?
당신이 내린 선택을 흥미롭게 관찰할 것입니다. 행운을 빕니다.

title: Cardstronaut
description:
게임 정보
Summary
Embark on a thrilling journey as the Cardstronaut in this 2.5D roguelike deck-building adventure! You wake up as an astronaut from a cloning bay without any memory of where you are or what you are doing. The base AI tells you that you must find a way to defeat the aliens in the base and rescue your colleagues, but you have no memory of this - how much do you trust it? You don't have many weapons, so you must utilize strategy and tactics to activate the flame throwers installed on the ceiling throughout the base to defeat the aliens and uncover what's actually going on.
Gameplay
Play fuel cards to get fuel in green zone
The gameplay is a 1D tactics game where the enemies move left/right and you must balance fuel and keep it in the exact range before you end your turn to activate the flame throwers. If you overfill the gasoline, then you will lose all gasoline and get hurt yourself instead. The enemies move towards you so you have to predict where they will be when you finally do manage to activate the flamethrower.
Position enemies tactically to win battles

title: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL
description:
게임 정보
CHANGE THE BOARD. CHASE THE WORLD.
The short-and-sweet INDIEPOCALYPSE original from developer circle SKY HOUR WORKS finally releases standalone on Steam as HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL, an upgraded release of our first action title in the PROJECT NATURA series. Rush into an upgraded adventure with revamped story content, new system changes, and updated polish to bring the definitive ENDLESS RUNNER X GEAR-BASED ROGUELITE action out there.
CHANGE THE BOARD - Equip a garage of hoverboards to store between runs and apply to different situations. CHASE THE WORLD - Risk it all and choose when to end your run - either preserving your boards or bailing for a hell of a finish.
FEATURES
- ENDLESS RUNNER X GEAR-BASED RPG: Stat up your boards and store them between runs - the boards you bail with are gone forever, though!
- Teach 'em new tricks: New abilities will join you, alongside a more fleshed-out map progression, letting you choose your path along the ride!
- Take breaks in-between stages by tinkering your boards and learning more about the story of the hero out of time, now revamped with a proper ending and progress trackers.
- Steam Achievements, Leaderboards, and Cloud Support are included!
- Featuring an Original Soundtrack by Rukyyy (SPACE / MECH / PILOT and A NIGHTMARE'S TRIP)
autokwd: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL

title: Hotel 2025: Anomalies
description:
게임 정보
호텔 2025: 아노말리스에 오신 것을 환영합니다 – 놓을 수 없는 퍼즐이 기다리고 있습니다.
호텔 2025: 이상 현상의 으스스하면서도 우아한 복도로 발을 들여보세요. 모든 방에는 이야기가 숨겨져 있고, 모든 구석에는 비밀이 감춰져 있습니다. 이곳은 평범한 호텔이 아닙니다. 이상한 사건들, 움직이는 물건들, 설명할 수 없는 이상 현상이 당신의 발견을 기다리고 있습니다. 호텔에 삼켜지기 전에 이 혼란의 진실을 밝힐 수 있겠습니까?
6개의 레벨 + 1개의 비밀 레벨
호텔 복도
개인 수영장
호텔 갤러리
대기실
밤의 다이닝룸
1925년 오래된 사무실
당신이 찾아야 할 비밀 스위트룸

title: The Silo 24
description:
게임 정보
STORY
Begin an adventure in a post-apocalyptic world hit by a natural anomaly that emerged through a portal in one of the underground laboratories.
Some of humanity was able to take refuge in bunkers built by several corporations, one of which is "Silos Corp". The rest either became infected or continue to fight for survival in the vast overgrown and dangerous wasteland, where there are no past rules apply.
Take on the role of a special forces fighter named Martin Grylls and infiltrate a certain Silo 24, from which an emergency signal has been received.
Immerse yourself in a deep plot filled with intriguing characters, each with their own stories, and uncover the main secret of Silo 24 that divided Martin's life into before and after.
EXPLORATION
Explore linear abandoned locations of the bunker, laboratory, city, village, roads, forests and other eerily picturesque places, collecting resources and finding safe paths.
QUESTS AND PUZZLES
On your journey, you will encounter various obstacles and challenges, which can always be overcome by using ingenuity or strength to move toward your goal.
INFECTED
Bloodthirsty zombies, monsters and titans roam around, infected with mutated bioluminescent plants that came from another universe through a portal.
SURVIVAL
Always be on guard, because danger lurks around every corner. Armed with a variety of weapons, both firearms and melee, enter the fight for survival.
HORROR
In the dark corridors of the dead bunker you will find fascinating glowing plants, but this does not mean that the situation is safe. This is not your territory, and you are not welcome here.

title: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero
description:
게임 정보
Ragnar Lothbrok, once a legendary Viking hero, has been summoned back to life by Odin the All-Father. In his previous life, Ragnar fought valiantly, yet his soul was tainted by misdeeds, and his spirit was forced to wander in the cold mists of Hel’s domain, deprived of Valhalla's glory.
But Odin saw something of value in Ragnar’s unyielding spirit.
And now, the All-Father has granted him a second chance - not only to redeem himself but to serve the gods in a quest that spans realms few have ever seen.
Our hero embarks on a mysterious journey to recover powerful artifacts scattered by ancient forces. Ragnar's quest leads him through enchanted lands, filled with magic, illusions, and strange creatures, his path lit only by glimpses of fate and the weight of his own redemption.
autokwd: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero

title: Maid For My Master
description:
게임 정보
Set a stone's throw into the future, Maid For My Master is a cute romance story between an unlikely pair.
Asahi is a young man who was born and raised in the countryside. He moves to Tokyo, hoping to make a new life for himself, but he soon discovers that the big city isn't all it's cracked up to be. Asahi doesn't have much in the way of money, and he has to scrimp and save while working a low-paying job at a convenience store.
Asahi's co-worker, Nazuna, is unfailingly cold and rude, and as chilly winter sets in, Asahi begins to wonder whether he made a mistake in leaving home...
At least, until he meets the mysterious maid, Holly, and feelings between them begin to blossom.
Holly is Asahi's dream girl. She's kind, gentle, and affectionate (even if she is slightly taller than he is), but there's a catch. Holly isn't a human at all: she's a robot! Can Asahi's relationship with Holly flourish, or is it doomed to a critical failure?
90k of text (approx 3-5 hours of reading)
a linear narrative with no choices or branches
original character and background artwork in a cute anime style
an original soundtrack
one robot maid
a cute romance story!!!

title: Soul•Apocalypto
description:
게임 정보
《Soul Apocalypto》는 롤 플레이팅 게임이지만 동시에 팀 전략 선택에도 중점을 두고 있습니다. 여러 가지 다른 캐릭터를 소환해 자신만의 팀을 구성할 수 있으며 캐릭터 스킬을 조정하여 팀 특성을 구현할 수 있습니다. 어떤 동료를 선택할지, 각 동료의 스킬을 어떻게 배치할지가 모든 도전에 승리하는关键입니다.

title: The Watcher's Curse
description:
게임 정보
Play the free demo now!
Distinct art-style that brings the haunting world of Hollow Veil to life.
Immersive narrative-driven gameplay unfolds a grim tale of mystery, ancient gods, and supernatural peril.
Turn-based combat challenges players to destroy their foes in whatever manner they see fit.
Unravel what secrets lie in the land of Hollow Veil as you explore its haunted landscapes and encounter its gently-deranged inhabitants.
Level up to increase your base stats and unlock powerful new spells.
Welcome to the mysterious land of Hollow Veil, where darkness thrives and hopeless souls wander endlessly. In The Watcher's Curse, you step into the shoes of Artem, a duty-burdened watcher tasked with protecting the world from nefarious forces.
As a watcher, Artem's responsibilities are twofold: learn the secrets of the world along with any lost knowledge and remove any threats posed by the aforementioned nefarious forces. Most common amongst said forces are the puritanical technotheists, a fanatical order that believes technology brings them closer to god. Whether stationed in an overlapped hell forest or chasing ancient horrors through an ageless monolith, Artem faces a relentless barrage of esoteric threats.
Our tale begins with Artem in a precarious predicament, unexpectedly transported across the world after a chance encounter with a seemingly innocuous tome. Stranded in the gloomy confines of Grimm's Briar, nestled amidst the foreboding Noctemura mountains, Artem crosses paths with Mayor Barkeep. Eager to return home, Artem finds himself entangled in the mayor's plea for aid in unraveling the enigma shrouding the disappearance of local villagers.

title: Effective Immediately
description:
게임 정보
Congratulations,
You have been appointed the position of repair technician on-board the deep space relay station. Pack your belongings, your family can not join you at this time.
Effective Immediately.

Effective Immediately is a gritty, sci-fi future on the verge of political change. As the sole position of travel in the galaxy you must decide who to accept or decline passage to. Encounter alien denizens and walk the line of survival or upholding morality. Make a choice and deal with the consequences.

Compare documents for inconsistencies, repair ship systems and ultimately allow or disallow travel. All the while the OCA is piling on more and more bureaucratic red tape in this puzzle, management life-sim.
Make choices that impact the story
Meet many different characters with unique motivations and inner conflicts. Are they lying or telling the truth?
Pass judgment and determine not only their fates but also the trajectory of your own journey.

Verify ID discrepancies
Ensure they have the correct details; name, race, expiry date all match?
What is their destination? Does their story match up? Are they allowed to travel to that sector since the new OCA regulations came in?

Use schematic rules to repair many alien ship systems; navigation, shields, medical and more.
Learn the rules and become an efficient engineer.

title: Fracctal Monsters
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Fracctal Monsters, the ultimate monster taming experience that takes pet care and real-time combat to a whole new level!



Embark on an exciting journey filled with online exploration, immersive training, adrenaline-pumping 2D action-based platformer combat, and intense PvP battles where you'll face off against other players for epic loot and bragging rights.



In Fracctal Monsters, every virtual pet is more than just a creature – they're your loyal companions with unique personalities, distinct hobbies, specific diets, and individual preferences. Each monster offers a one-of-a-kind bond and interaction that will keep you coming back for more.



Explore a vibrant, living world where you can discover hidden secrets and participate in thrilling challenges. Obtain new monsters by opening packs or winning them in various in-game challenges. The expansive world of Fracctal Monsters is teeming with adventures that challenge your skills and strategic thinking.



Raise and evolve your monsters by engaging them in training modes, keeping them happy, and feeding them their preferred diets. Watch as they grow stronger, learn new abilities, and transform into even more powerful forms. The evolution system allows for deep customization and personal connection with your monsters.



Prepare for epic boss battles that test the limits of your monster's strength and strategy. Team up with other players or go solo to take down formidable foes and earn exclusive rewards. Each boss encounter is a challenge that requires tactical planning and skillful execution.



With a vast world to explore, countless challenges to overcome, and a thriving community of fellow tamers, Fracctal Monsters promises endless hours of fun, excitement, and adventure. So, are you ready to dive into the captivating world of monster taming and unleash the power of your Fracctal Monsters? Join us now and embark on an unforgettable journey like no other!

title: Operatives: Revolve
description:
게임 정보
Operative Revolve is a cinematic roguelike deckbuilder with a unique gameplay mechanic. Play as Operatives, secret agents who oversee a world governed by machine ideology. Use your Machine cards to physically attack or block damage while battling enemies who oppose your directive and uncover the hidden truths within the machinated world.

title: Aether Singularity
description:
게임 정보
A demonic anomaly has been detected in an important research facility. DATA agents... deploy!

In 1969, mankind established its first link to the Aethernet. Humanity soon entered a golden age of technological wonder and prosperity.
But, kept secret from the eyes of the public, a second discovery was made shortly after... demons weren't just the subject of myths and religion.
To combat them, the Demonic Anomalies Termination Agency was born. An FBI offshoot where agents are partnered with daemons through a pact, their mission: send the demons back where they belong.
GAMEPLAY
In this fixed camera action game you and your squad will have to explore a top secret facility. Balance the powers of both magic and lead to defeat the demons who are rampaging throughout it!
Battles take place in real-time, requiring you to dodge enemy attacks and find the perfect time to retaliate against them. As you shoot enemies you'll gain mana which you can use to cast spells to gain an advantage. On the verge of death will you choose to use what little mana you have to heal yourself, or will you try to blast away one of your foes so the battle becomes easier? Make strategic use of your resources and complete your mission!
A RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK
As you explore the facility you'll be able to find information, and maybe even spells, to help you with your mission. However, you'll be faced with a constant timer that ticks down even when in battles. Failing to get to the bottom of things before time runs out won't spell the end for you, but...
BONUS CHALLENGES
In addition to the main mission there are over 15 bonus challenges that can be tackled! Defeat the enemies, protect the target, and more as you aim for the best score possible! Can you get a gold rank in all of them?
THE CAST




SILVIA
An experienced agent, she has been working at DATA for a decade. Felt like nobody ever had her back until she got assigned to Alfonso's squad, thus adopted a bit of a rebellious attitude. Competent at her job, she enjoys being sent on assignments despite her snarky remarks.
Silvia's daemon, bound by pact. Quite reliable, has learned to adapt to Silvia's attitude and does his best to cheer her up.
While she might not show it, Silvia is glad to have been partnered with him. Their mutual trust has resulted in Ranru evolving and being able to cast a variety of magicks.
The leader of the squad, his expertise has gained him notoriety within DATA veterans. After a mission gone wrong and a falling off with his previous team, he was reassigned to direct a smaller, fast-response squad, which he's now fond of.

The latest addition to the squad, recruited due to her excellent track record as a police officer. Has great social skills and is used to dealing with civilians, but is still trying to fit in in DATA. Greatly respects Alfonso and Silvia.

title: Bloom Paradise
description:
게임 정보
Story
Every nook and cranny in Bloom Paradise was once filled with flowers of every color, until one day when pesky pests came and ravaged the land, rendering it unrecognizable. Thus, flower fairies Tamabo and Hanabo have joined forces, setting off on an adventure to restore Bloom Paradise to its former glory and get rid of those irksome pests.
How to Play
Play as either Tamabo (Player 1) or Hanabo (Player 2) and make flowers bloom. Fill all the grounds in each stage to clear it. How you bloom flowers differs between single-player mode and two-player mode. In single-player mode, flowers bloom on the ground as Tamabo walks across. In two-player mode, however, when either Tamabo or Hanabo walks across the ground, only flower buds appear. The other character must then touch these buds to make them bloom. Work together to take back Bloom Paradise from the pests. Both Tamabo and Hanabo can shoot water in the direction they're facing with the use of the attack button. Flowers can't bloom when the ground is covered in mud, so use water to clean up and eradicate any pests standing in your way.
Features
・100 total stages
・19 types of bothersome yet likable pests
・Single-player and two-player coop modes with differing ways to play
・Game design reminiscent of late 80s arcade games

Let's change all of Japan to Gunma.
The definitive edition of the Gunma simulation game.
Everyone can play!
Story mode

title: Fireball 2
description:
게임 정보
--GAME OVERVIEW--
Fireball 2 is an elegant and satisfying arcade-survival game about dodging swarms and triggering bombs. Take control of your fireball and weave through the massive flood of enemies. Lure the flood towards bombs and trigger them, either directly or indirectly, to take out as many enemies as possible.



--BOOST, NOVAS AND UPGRADES--

You'll be able to jump right into Fireball 2, as the controls are pretty easy to learn: Move with the left stick (or mouse), boost with any button. Your boost is unlimited, but using it constantly is not always the optimal strategy, as you are forced to move at max speed while boosting. The faster you move, the faster the flood of enemies react.

After destroying enough enemies, a Nova is created from their sparkling remains. These Novas not only unleash a large explosion, but they also upgrade your fireball! No need to choose which upgrade you want; your fireball becomes bigger, faster, AND tougher with each Nova you unleash. Level up your fireball to max power, and every Nova becomes a SUPERNOVA! And if you're patient with your Novas, two of them merge to form a blackhole that grants you invincibility for a short time.

--LOCAL 2-PLAYER CO-OP--



Fireball 2 lets a 2nd player join the action at any time. Though having 2 players is an advantage in many games, because your fireballs have a limited capability to fight the flood of enemies, no adjustment in the difficulty of the game mechanics is used when a 2nd player joins. In fact, dead players can be revived by Novas.



Fireball 2 unleashes the power of your GPU and high-refresh monitor to create a modern arcade experience with crystal clear visuals and up to 100,000 enemies at once. The background comes alive while over a million particles bring life to the smooth motion and explosions. A 1440p monitor with a 120hz refresh rate (or better) is recommended but not required.



Fireball 2 has 2 difficulty levels and multiple starting waves, along with a combo-based scoring system to encourage high-scoring gameplay. Looking for a more relaxing experience? Just start on Wave 1 on the default difficulty. The pressure slowly ramps up as you ease into the action, with each Wave changing the size of the world and pattern of enemy spawns.

In Normal difficulty you can survive minor mistakes with relative ease, while Hardcore mode, unlocked when you reach Wave 11, is a different beast. Hardcore mode ramps up the player and enemy speed, and increases the damage from enemies by 5x. Those simple changes amp up the gameplay intensity and pressure, as any mistakes have the potential to end your playthrough.

Both difficulty modes use the same scoring and are tracked separately. The exponential combo scores encourage herding as many enemies into a single bomb's blast radius as possible, but overdoing it has a subtle drawback. Going for massive scores reduces the number of Novas generated. Your play determines the balance of scoring vs. survivability.

title: Twilight Parade: Moonlit Mononoke
description:
게임 정보
트와일라잇 퍼레이드: 문릿 모노노케는 아름다운 요괴 소녀들이 요괴가 가득한 5개 레벨을 날아다니며 백 요괴의 야간 퍼레이드인 백기 야교를 기념하는 횡스크롤 탄막 슈팅 게임입니다. 날고, 쏘고, 피하세요. 파티를 끝내세요!
매년 요괴들은 백 요괴의 야간 퍼레이드인 백기 야교에서 파티를 하기 위해 거리로 나갑니다. 하지만 올해는 너무 시끄러워서 오니 쌍둥이를 초대하지 않았고, 파티를 망칠 겁니다! 이 횡스크롤 슈팅 게임에서 요괴 무리에 맞서고 파티를 끝내자!

픽셀 아트 스타일의 플레이 가능한 캐릭터로 4명의 아름다운 요괴 소녀, 각각 다른 유형의 조수와 해변복 버전!
화난 요괴로 가득한 5개의 레벨, 각각 끝에 거대한 보스가 등장!
레트로 탄막 게임플레이.
향수 같은 픽셀 아트 스타일의 수평 레벨.
총알, 총알이 정말 많아요!
블루 오니 자매
가장 재밌고 귀여운 쌍둥이로, 뿔이 하나뿐이고 과자와 케이크를 좋아해요. 그녀의 조수는 원형으로 총을 쏘는 타누키예요.

title: Chrono Stone
description:
게임 정보
Game Introduction
Chrono Stone is a semi-automatic Roguelike RPG. Assemble a team, create unique skill builds, and craft powerful gear. As the commander, you’ll devise sound battle strategies and give timely commands to help your squad dodge danger, turning the tide to defeat powerful monsters and opponents.
Choose a Different Adventure
Each time you embark, the composition of the world changes. You will encounter different events, face various bosses, acquire a variety of powerful equipment, and learn unique skills. Some rewards come with risks, and may even require a painful cost. Every decision is crucial, and luck is also a part of strength.
Build Different Teams
The game features no fixed classes. Acquire a variety of skills during your adventures, combine them with equipment that has various random attributes, and create completely different team compositions for a unique gaming experience.

title: Underling Uprising
description:
게임 정보

다양하고 도전적인 적들을 집어던지기 위해 즉석에서 새로운 콤보를 만들어보세요. 자유로운 콤보 시스템으로 실험하고, 콤보를 최적화하세요! 충분한 미터를 축적하면 강력하고 화려한 슈퍼를 발동하세요!

title: Timeless Heart VR
description:
게임 정보

As the second entry in the Timeless Stories series, this game further simplifies and enriches the unique sword technique system of the series. It introduces a distinctive VR gameplay mode that merges first-person and third-person perspectives for cooperative play. You will control both yourself and your companion Lycanea, exploring and advancing through four stylistically distinct realms. Game system introduction:

Sword Skill System:
Players will get "Chain Claw Prosthetic Arm" to assist in melee / range attack action.
At the same time in the game players will randomly obtain a variety of special style weapons to further strengthen their own ability.


Chain Claw System:
Players can use the chain claw to rapidly evade attacks from enemies and grab special objects in the scene to throw/use to break the enemy's weaknesses.
