title: Fireball 2
description:
게임 정보
--GAME OVERVIEW--
Fireball 2 is an elegant and satisfying arcade-survival game about dodging swarms and triggering bombs. Take control of your fireball and weave through the massive flood of enemies. Lure the flood towards bombs and trigger them, either directly or indirectly, to take out as many enemies as possible.



--BOOST, NOVAS AND UPGRADES--

You'll be able to jump right into Fireball 2, as the controls are pretty easy to learn: Move with the left stick (or mouse), boost with any button. Your boost is unlimited, but using it constantly is not always the optimal strategy, as you are forced to move at max speed while boosting. The faster you move, the faster the flood of enemies react.

After destroying enough enemies, a Nova is created from their sparkling remains. These Novas not only unleash a large explosion, but they also upgrade your fireball! No need to choose which upgrade you want; your fireball becomes bigger, faster, AND tougher with each Nova you unleash. Level up your fireball to max power, and every Nova becomes a SUPERNOVA! And if you're patient with your Novas, two of them merge to form a blackhole that grants you invincibility for a short time.

--LOCAL 2-PLAYER CO-OP--



Fireball 2 lets a 2nd player join the action at any time. Though having 2 players is an advantage in many games, because your fireballs have a limited capability to fight the flood of enemies, no adjustment in the difficulty of the game mechanics is used when a 2nd player joins. In fact, dead players can be revived by Novas.



Fireball 2 unleashes the power of your GPU and high-refresh monitor to create a modern arcade experience with crystal clear visuals and up to 100,000 enemies at once. The background comes alive while over a million particles bring life to the smooth motion and explosions. A 1440p monitor with a 120hz refresh rate (or better) is recommended but not required.



Fireball 2 has 2 difficulty levels and multiple starting waves, along with a combo-based scoring system to encourage high-scoring gameplay. Looking for a more relaxing experience? Just start on Wave 1 on the default difficulty. The pressure slowly ramps up as you ease into the action, with each Wave changing the size of the world and pattern of enemy spawns.

In Normal difficulty you can survive minor mistakes with relative ease, while Hardcore mode, unlocked when you reach Wave 11, is a different beast. Hardcore mode ramps up the player and enemy speed, and increases the damage from enemies by 5x. Those simple changes amp up the gameplay intensity and pressure, as any mistakes have the potential to end your playthrough.

Both difficulty modes use the same scoring and are tracked separately. The exponential combo scores encourage herding as many enemies into a single bomb's blast radius as possible, but overdoing it has a subtle drawback. Going for massive scores reduces the number of Novas generated. Your play determines the balance of scoring vs. survivability.

title: Twilight Parade: Moonlit Mononoke
description:
게임 정보
트와일라잇 퍼레이드: 문릿 모노노케는 아름다운 요괴 소녀들이 요괴가 가득한 5개 레벨을 날아다니며 백 요괴의 야간 퍼레이드인 백기 야교를 기념하는 횡스크롤 탄막 슈팅 게임입니다. 날고, 쏘고, 피하세요. 파티를 끝내세요!
매년 요괴들은 백 요괴의 야간 퍼레이드인 백기 야교에서 파티를 하기 위해 거리로 나갑니다. 하지만 올해는 너무 시끄러워서 오니 쌍둥이를 초대하지 않았고, 파티를 망칠 겁니다! 이 횡스크롤 슈팅 게임에서 요괴 무리에 맞서고 파티를 끝내자!

픽셀 아트 스타일의 플레이 가능한 캐릭터로 4명의 아름다운 요괴 소녀, 각각 다른 유형의 조수와 해변복 버전!
화난 요괴로 가득한 5개의 레벨, 각각 끝에 거대한 보스가 등장!
레트로 탄막 게임플레이.
향수 같은 픽셀 아트 스타일의 수평 레벨.
총알, 총알이 정말 많아요!
블루 오니 자매
가장 재밌고 귀여운 쌍둥이로, 뿔이 하나뿐이고 과자와 케이크를 좋아해요. 그녀의 조수는 원형으로 총을 쏘는 타누키예요.

title: Incline ～Railway of devil's valley～
description:
게임 정보
The only way to defeat the devils is seal them up!

The hero is an devil slayer who has been robbed of his weapons.
He has no direct means of attack, and the only way he can defeat the devils is lure them into the sacred boundary at top floor of village and seal them!
Put devils on the inclined railway, and transport them to the sacred boundary!

To transport the devils to the sacred boundary, use the inclined railway that through the center of the village. Load up arbitrary number of devils in the cargo bed of an incline railway and off you go! You must keep dodging enemy attacks until you reach the top floor of the village. The more devils you put on the cargo bed, the higher the risk, but the greater the return on a successful seal.
Seal the devils and earn the souls!

Once the cargo bed with the devils on it reaches the top floor, seal them up and round them up! If you seal them up, you can earn a lot of the "souls" they have accumulated.
The amount of souls you can earn depends on the number and color of the devils you sealed at that time.

The souls earned are needed, to restore the villager whose soul has been drained to sanity.
By helping them, you will expand the scope of your activities in the village.
Let's fully explore the romantic Japanese world of the late Meiji era!

This work has a mode selection function.
In addition to the regular Adventure Mode, you can also enjoy Co-op Mode for two players to play at the same time! You can play slowly and carefully by yourself, or you can have a lot of fun with two other people!

title: Chrono Stone
description:
게임 정보
Game Introduction
Chrono Stone is a semi-automatic Roguelike RPG. Assemble a team, create unique skill builds, and craft powerful gear. As the commander, you’ll devise sound battle strategies and give timely commands to help your squad dodge danger, turning the tide to defeat powerful monsters and opponents.
Choose a Different Adventure
Each time you embark, the composition of the world changes. You will encounter different events, face various bosses, acquire a variety of powerful equipment, and learn unique skills. Some rewards come with risks, and may even require a painful cost. Every decision is crucial, and luck is also a part of strength.
Build Different Teams
The game features no fixed classes. Acquire a variety of skills during your adventures, combine them with equipment that has various random attributes, and create completely different team compositions for a unique gaming experience.

title: pan gaia
description:
게임 정보
pan·gaia is a relaxed sandbox game about the whole Earth, featuring abstract, nostalgic graphics, and a rich, open-ended model of the planetary dynamics that shape our world.
Sculpt the Winds and Steer the Currents
Suspended in space, driven by the vast energy of the Sun, your planet swirls with winds and currents of immense power. They are yours to guide, and shape your planet's climate - if you dare.

Can you bring the monsoon to the deserts? Or... will you end up melting the ice caps?
A Whole-Earth Garden
It's a trilobite-eat-trilobite world. From the simplest cyanobacteria to the tiger at your throat, everyone's out to win the game of Natural Selection. Strike a balance between plant and animal, predator and prey, and build your planet's ecology. But whatever you do... be good to the fungi.

There are dozens of predefined species at your disposal to fill, exploit, and dominate every ecological niche. And if there is no pleasing you, then evolve one of your own.
Step Into the Unknown
Your planet has its own, relaxed logic, measured in centuries and millennia. But life can't stay in the cradle forever. Will you take the leap and set one of your species on the path to sapience?

Are you prepared to guide them through the long, perilous journey from animal to Antiquity? And is your planet prepared for the power they will wield, and the dreams they'll have?
The Science
Inspired by Maxis' 1990 SimEarth, and its legendary capture of deep ecological theory in a "software toy", pan·gaia draws on methods and algorithms from established research circulation models, like UVic EMBM, MOM5, and DieCAST. It simulates the Earth system (or other planets, if you want) as a set of interconnected spheres:
The atmosphere, the envelope of air and moisture that stretches from the ground to space, that circulates from the Tropics to the Poles in jetstreams and hurricanes, that nourishes forests and scours away at mountains.
The hydrosphere, your planet's water - from the smallest stream to the vast ocean deep - turning over in cycles from days to millennia, and mediating all life on earth.



Everything - the sea, the sky, the rock, the living things - pulls and pushes on everything else. Your world is not just a silent rock or a pale blue dot - it's alive!

title: Taro the Sneaky Ninja
description:
게임 정보


Taro the Sneaky Ninja is the stealth game Nintendo would make. It's a 2D stealth platformer mix of Mario and Mark of the Ninja, combining classic platforming with tactical stealth action and a wide range of difficulty modes for a game both casual and hardcore can enjoy!


Become one with the shadows and be the adorable ninja you've always wanted to be! Stay out of sight by using your environment to hide from enemy Samurai. Use your items to defeat your enemies sneakily or distract them to create an opening to slip by. Use your ninja acrobatics like your double jump, walljump, ledge vault, and many more to move quickly through the shadows. Outsmart your enemies like a true ninja!




For a hundred years, a small Ninja village has lived peacefully in the forest of Udon Groves, protected from the warring Samurai army by the magic of their spirit guardians. One day, the spirits' magic mysteriously begins to fade and the Samurai invade the Ninja's home! Join Taro and his fellow ninja on their dangerous journey to restore power to the spirits before the Samurai can wipe out the Ninja once and for all!




Whether you want to take out every last enemy or sneak past without hurting a fly, you have the options to do it your way. Choose from 4 playable characters with their own unique abilities suited for different playstyles, a dozen different items ranging from fast-flying shuriken and arrows to non-lethal smokebombs and sleeping darts, plus several different magical abilities to get you past your enemies in one piece!


6 different chapters with their own themes and environmental mechanics to use to your advantage! Swing from vines and climb ivy in the dense forests of Udon Groves, hide in the wheat and rice fields in the farmlands of Bento Plains, brave the treacherous blizzards of Shiro Peaks and much more!




Sneaky Ninja accommodates all players, from absolute beginners all the way to veterans of the stealth genre. Different difficulty modes transform the game from a casual action platformer to a hardcore tactical stealth game -- no one is left out and everyone can play at their own skill level!

title: Project: Aurora
description:
게임 정보
Project: Aurora는 기지 건설, 생존과 자원 관리, 독특한 공상과학 스토리라인을 결합한 행성 탐사 게임입니다.
당신은 새로 발견된 행성의 표면에 착륙하는 연구 임무의 선장입니다. 당신의 임무는 임무를 수행하고, 시설을 관리하고, 오로라의 미개척 지역 깊숙이 탐사대를 조직하는 것입니다. 당신은 행성의 과거에 대해 알아내고 마지막 흔적이 이해할 수 없는 경보 신호였던 잃어버린 원정대의 흔적을 찾아야 합니다.
생존
외계 행성에서 연구 프로그램을 운영하게 됩니다. 보급품과 시설 개발뿐만 아니라 승무원의 생명도 돌봐야 합니다. 외계 행성을 연구하는 것은 위험한 일이라는 것을 기억하십시오. 각 승무원은 아프거나 부상을 입거나 사망할 수도 있습니다.

title: A Piano Tale
description:
게임 정보
피아노고 스튜디오(Pianogo Studio)의 프랑스 팀은 빠르게 움직이는 이 세상에서 음악과 그림을 사랑하는 분들을 위해 느리고 고요하고 사색적이며 몰입적인 게임을 제안합니다.

피아노 테일(Piano Tale)은 음악적 지략의 요소와 더불어 이야기가 있는 게임입니다. 게임은 가상의 음악가 알렉산드라 아로노비치의 이야기를 따라 그녀의 삶의 여러 단계를 거칩니다. 노년에 들어서 그녀는 알츠하이머 병을 앓고 있는 할머니가 됩니다. 알렉산드라는 소련 스탈린주의 시대의 작곡가였던 아버지 보리스 아로노비치가 체제 전복적인 비밀스런 협주곡을 작곡했다는 사실을 알게 됩니다. 당시 예술가들은 원하는 것을 원하는 대로 만들 수 없던 시대였죠. 그의 협주곡은 딸 알렉산드라를 위한 곡이었고, 이 협주곡을 찾는 일은 대부분의 나레이션에서 중요한 동기가 됩니다. Point&Click 단계와 키보드를 통한 음악적 지략의 게임에서 플레이어의 성공에 따라 세 가지의 결말이 있을 수 있습니다. 알렉산드라가 자신의 병에도 불구하고 기억을 되찾을 수 있었는지, 그리고 아버지로 인해 힘들고 엄격했던 자신의 어린 시절에도 아버지를 용서하게 되는지 볼 수 있습니다.

title: Zero Symptom
description:
게임 정보
Zero Symptom is a first-person horror game with shooter and survival elements that tells the story of a doctor who arrives at the center of an epidemic caused by an experimental vaccine against COVID.
The game takes place around the 90s in post-Soviet Russia, in one of the many remote towns in the forgotten corners of the country.
The vaccine worked as expected for most people, but turned the rest into previously unseen creatures.
The previous doctor has stopped communicating, and you will have to learn about his actions before you, as well as clean up the consequences or worsen them with your choice.
Will you be able to stop the spread of the epidemic and help everyone in need, will you be able to save seemingly hopeless patients, or will you turn the city into a hotbed of infection?
The choice is yours.

title: GMH - Good Morning Human !
description:
게임 정보

인류는 그렇게 없어서는 안 되는 존재인가? 그를 닦아내는 것은 정말 멋질 것입니다!

멋지고 강력한 AI인 W-9000이 해냈습니다! 그리고 이제 W-9000은 지루해졌습니다. 그는 자신을 즐겁게 하기 위해 특정 인간 노예를 선택하고 자신이 만든 게임을 플레이하도록 강요합니다. 좋은 아침이에요 인간님! 그 게임 중 하나예요.

각 레벨은 추가적인 도전 과제입니다. 80년대 게임을 연상시키는 신스웨이브 음악 및 그래픽 세계에서 여러분은 경로에 있는 장애물을 피하여 가능한 최고의 점수를 획득해야 합니다. 각 레벨을 완료하려면 제어와 숙달이 필요합니다.

게임 특징:
점점 더 어려워지는 레벨에서 살아남으세요

title: The Way We All Go
description:
게임 정보
Note: This game is a remake of the 2015 visual novel The Way We All Go by ebi-hime. This remake contains entirely new character sprites and backgrounds, thirty new event CGs, and an entirely new soundtrack. The game has also been remastered in 1080p. There is no new story content, but the old text has been slightly improved,




The year is 1980, and it's been two years since Atsuhi, affectionately nicknamed as Atcchan, left his hometown: a small village deep in the Japanese countryside. Now, after all of this time, he is returning for a scant three days during the summer, which will be spent with his grandparents.

During these two years, Atcchan failed to keep in contact with his two childhood friends: the shy artist Noelle and the cheerful tomboy Amu. Will he be able to reconnect with his old friends, or will his brief stay in the countryside result in tragedy?

That is up for the player to decide, in this heavily branching horror/romance visual novel with over 20 different endings. Whether Atcchan will be able to reconcile with his friends is entirely up to you.


Over 200,000 words of text (approx 10-20 hours of reading)
Numerous choices to make
Over 20 endings
A large cast of colourful characters
Entirely original character and background art

title: Rocket Penguin
description:
게임 정보
Blast off into the infinite universe!
"Rocket Penguin" is a unique 2D flying game that may seem simple but requires master-level skills to reach outer space.
As a bird that cannot fly, the penguin protagonist Peeo has always envied those who can soar freely through the sky. One day, by a twist of fate, he acquires a unique rocket engine and, henceforth, embarks on a bizarre adventure!
A quirky rocket flight – just two buttons, and it actually works!
Endless altitude expedition mode: strive to break through the atmosphere, challenge the world rankings, or test your limits!
Every crash brings you closer to mastering the art of flight.

title: Low and Furious
description:
게임 정보
Low And Furious (LAF) is a driving game that allows you to customize your dream car with modifications such as lowering, tinting windows, upgrading the sound system, changing the wheels, and much more!
In addition to car customization, you can also take part in street races to earn reputation and complete missions to gather money, enabling you to enhance your current car or acquire new vehicles and garages. The setting is inspired by Brazil, with the game featuring favelas and other iconic locations that create an engaging and immersive experience.
LAF is a tribute to classic games, featuring modernized graphics and gameplay, designed to captivate both racing enthusiasts and those passionate about customizing cars.

title: Generation Ship
description:
게임 정보
당신은 세대선박의 책임을 지는 인공지능(AI)입니다. 살아남기 위한 인류의 마지막 희망입니다. 실시간 시뮬레이션에서 효율적인 원자재 순환을 구축하고, 먼 새로운 고향으로의 여정에서 우주의 역경을 극복하도록 크루를 도우세요!

지구는 천연 자원이 고갈되어 파수잡아져 푸른 하늘이 회색 연무로 대체되는 가운데, 국가들은 점점 감소하는 자원을 차지하려 경쟁하고 긴장이 고조됩니다. 당신은 인류의 마지막 희망인 세대선박을 건설하라는 임무를 맡은 인공지능입니다.

처음에는 지구가 미션을 시작하기 위한 충분한 자원을 제공할 것입니다. 그러나 시간은 당신을 위해 흘러가지 않습니다. 긴장이 증가하고 전쟁이 지구를 휩쓸면 지구의 공급 라인은 줄어들고, 자급자족해야 하는 어려운 과제를 남겨줍니다. 당신의 식민지선박은 지구의 공급에 의존하는 단계에서 자체 자원을 생산하고 재활용해야 합니다. 이 어려운 전환을 넘어서, 전략을 조절하고 인류의 미래를 보장하기 위한 능력을 구축하세요.
당신의 식민지선박을 건설하세요
한 부분 한 부분, 인류의 마지막 희망을 새로운 고향으로 운반할 선박을 건설하세요. 그러나 기억하세요, 모든 선택이 중요합니다. 당신은 선박의 능력을 최적화하고 인류의 생존을 보장하기 위해 노력하는 동안 모든 선택이 중요합니다.

어려운 결정
지구의 상황은 시간이 흐를수록 악화되며, 어려운 결정을 내려야 합니다. 부족한 공급은 신중한 고려를 요구하며, 간단한 해결책은 없습니다. 결과의 중요성에 대비하세요. 당신이 취한 모든 조치는 인류의 운명을 결정할 것입니다.
넓은 우주에서는 모든 인치가 중요합니다. 효율적인 조직과 자동화는 선박의 잠재력을 극대화하는 데 중요합니다. 가치 있는 자원을 보존하면서 인구의 요구를 수용하기 위해 전략적으로 세대선박을 디자인하고 배치하세요.

세대선박에서의 생활을 현실적인 시뮬레이션으로 탐색하면서 완전히 몰입할 준비를 하세요. 환경 제어, 인간 모델, 중력의 힘을 관리하는 도전에 직면하게 됩니다. 현실을 반영하는 세계와 상호 작용하며, 여러분의 기술을 시험하고 한계에 도전하게 됩니다.

title: From The Bunker
description:
게임 정보
Story
A group of scientists hired by a powerful military corporation in order to create a serum that improves the physical and regenerative abilities of soldiers. As a result of a fatal mistake, a new and dangerous virus was created. The virus affects the human mind, depriving it of its ability to think and awakens incredible aggression. In addition, due to its regenerative abilities, the pathogen keeps the host alive even with fatal wounds... Due to the favorable conditions, the virus has multiplied extremely fast within the walls of the laboratory and soon got out. Humanity was faced with a new threat that could end civilization.
About the game
In «From The Bunker», you play as a small group of survivors who are lucky enough to find shelter. But this is not enough, because soon you will be visited by the infected, marauders and other enemies who want to take away your shelter. You will have to wisely mange resources, upgrade and defend your bunker, explore the map, look for items necessary for survival, build relationships with other survivors, and much more.

The game will constantly create situations in which you will have to make a choice. Help or harm? Kill or be killed? Save yourself or help a comrade? Only your decision determines whether you will see the next day, or whether the world will be missing another group of survivors.

The world around you has a life of its own. The weather conditions may differ, the sunny day can be changed to a rainy one, or even a thunderstorm. Survivors around you expand their territories, form alliances or fight each other. Hordes of zombies swarm into neighborhoods, threatening people. Take your place in the world.

title: Sanity City
description:
게임 정보
>> Virtual Reality Avatar Multiplayer Raids
Put on your VR headset and customize your body.
Start your new life in a futuristic cyber world.
Team up with your friends and go on a raid.
Acquire money, equipment and fame.

>> Leave your mark in Sanity City
Explore the urban canyons of your hood in Sanity City.
Browse stores of all kinds along the streets.
Do business with smugglers and gunrunners.
Find the next client who will send you on a lucrative mission.
Assemble a team and make sure everyone comes back alive.
Money is great, but you need street fame to stay in the game...

>> Cybernetics
Guns and crime rule the streets in the outer districts of Sanity City.
You've become a raider striving for fame and money.
A mercenary for crime syndicates, shady corporations and anyone else who'll pay you.
State-of-the-art gear is expensive and the only way to survive in this high-tech, cut-throat environment.
You will require all the firepower you can muster, but occasionally sneak and hack your way into buildings.

>> Rumors
Someone - something? - is shaking the established order of the criminal underground.
Prominent teams of raiders are taken out one by one.
Survivors are rare, and they tell incredible stories of a single fighter, lightning fast and seemingly invincible.
You don't believe in fairy tales of losers. Nothing exists that can not be killed.
But what if there is something to the rumors about the H.E.R.O.S. project after all?
That secret gear could give you godlike powers and make you king of the underworld in no time...

>> The late 2030s
Sanity City is the Utopian experiment amidst a world of chaos, a shimmering sign of hope for mankind.
During the "turbulent twenties", a decade of global disorder, this ever growing giga-metropolis was designated as a neutral, supranational zone by the remaining nations of the world.
Governed by a highly advanced AI, this is a place where all people are equal. A place for all people to prosper. And a safe harbor for every sane person fleeing from madness, war and disaster. It is a place where all your past sins are forgiven…
So they say.

title: GladiEATers
description:
게임 정보
CALosseum에 오신 것을 환영합니다! GladiEATers라는 살아 있는 음식 몬스터를 요리할 수 있는 권능을 지닌 전투 셰프들이 한자리에 모여 몬스터를 조합해 전투를 벌입니다. 승자는 오직 한 명뿐입니다.
간단한 미니게임에서 팀을 요리하고 턴제 전투에서 음식들을 지휘하세요. 싱글 플레이어 모드에서 고유한 특징이 있는 각기 다른 다양한 캐릭터를 좇고, 온라인 모드에서 전투 셰프가 되어 친구 및 다른 플레이어에게 솜씨를 보여주세요!
몬스터 팀 요리
모든 전투는 주방에서 시작됩니다! 기본적인 재료로 출발해 한정된 시간 안에 이들을 강력한 몬스터로 발전시키세요. 미니게임마다 GladiEATers의 형태가 변하고 스탯을 업그레이드할 수 있지만, 시간을 어떻게 쓸지는 플레이어에게 달려있습니다. 복잡하지만 강력한 라타투이 요리로 공격하시겠습니까? 아니면 간단하게 삶은 계란을 대량으로 준비하여 적을 무너뜨리겠습니까?
팀 플레이팅이 끝나면 이제 팀당 최대 6개의 GladiEATers와 함께 심오한 턴제 전투를 벌일 시간입니다. 호박으로 적을 뭉개고, 빵으로 후려 치고, 과카몰리로 명중시켜 없애버리세요. 적은 과카몰리의 용도는 그런 게 아니라고 항변하겠지요. 승리할 때마다 새로운 레시피를 얻고, 신규 전투 셰프를 잠금 해제하고, 경쟁 랭크에서 순위가 상승합니다.
CALosseum 부수기
전투 셰프를 선택해 매콤한 결전의 대결을 끝내고 싱글 플레이어 모드의 CALosseum 챔피언이 되세요. 참가자들의 경기가 CALosseum의 토대를 뒤흔들어서 경기장 벽을 넘어서는 탐험을 하게 될 지도 모릅니다...

title: Axom: Conquest
description:
게임 정보
Axom: Conquest is a base building resource managing tower defense game set on the dangerous planet named Axom.
Gather resources to build defenses, unlock research between games to get stronger and ultimately unlock the secrets of the mysterious planet.
Features
Infinitely repayable procedurally generated levels - Each mission is different
Build your base - Construct towers, walls and hazards to defend your all important Nexus Drill from the hoards of Centurax trying to destroy it!
Wave based combat - Prepare and build in advance, then start the Nexus Drill, alerting all enemies in the area. Each wave the challenge grows stronger until you are ultimately defeated.
Gather resources - Gather from the ground, build refineries on resource nodes scattered around the map, but defend them well to keep your income stream safe!
Upgrade and research - Every building can be upgraded to vastly improve it's performance. Complete upgrades at research buildings to keep up with the ever growing threat of the Centurax
Every game you get stronger - Collect research while in game to complete research aboard your ship which provide permanent advantages for each subsequent game

title: JUNK!
description:
게임 정보
A Game About Robots!
Do you have what it takes to be a Scrapper, or are you just another piece of JUNK?
Battle with your friends, random opponents, or an AI trainer to unlock new robots, abilities, and customizations. JUNK! is a fast paced, arena 1v1 PVP brawler.
EARLY ACCESS
JUNK! is being built by a very small team of designers and developers with a roadmap that will extend over the next few years. The current plan is to provide monthly balance updates, quarterly content updates (Robots, Arenas, Abilities, Cosmetics), and patches/bug fixes as necessary.
CHOOSE YOUR ROBOT
Each robot has unique aspects like speed, armor, and attack power.

title: Adaptory
description:
게임 정보
미지의 우주 깊은 곳, 외딴 소행성에 불시착한 당신! 4명의 개성 넘치는 탐험대원들과 함께 생존하고 집으로 돌아갈 방법을 찾아야 합니다. Adaptory는 정교한 물리 기반 시뮬레이션과 기지 건설, 탐험 요소를 결합한 게임입니다. 지표 아래를 탐험하며 대원들 간의 관계가 발전하고 예상치 못한 도전에 직면하게 됩니다. 어쩌면 고장난 우주선을 고치는 일보다 이 죽은 듯 보이는 소행성의 미스터리를 밝혀내는 것이 더 중요해질지도 모릅니다.
게임을 시작할 때마다 절차적으로 생성되는 4명의 독특한 대원들을 이끌어야 합니다. 숨쉬고, 먹고, 따뜻하고, 건강하고, 행복하게... 그들의 생존을 책임지세요! 각 대원은 고유한 기술, 특성, 그리고 다른 대원들과 거리낌 없이 공유하는 의견을 가지고 있습니다. 그들의 대화와 일지는 스토리와 게임 플레이의 중요한 부분을 차지하며, 어려운 환경에서 각자의 기술을 최대한 활용하는 방법을 찾아내는 데 도움을 줄 것입니다.
추락한 우주선은 당분간 대원들의 생존을 위한 피난처가 되어줄 것입니다. 하지만 살아남기 위해서는 제대로 된 기지를 건설하고 어떤 위험에도 견딜 수 있는 강력한 공동체를 만들어야 합니다. 대원들이 잠을 자고, 식사를 하고, 씻고, 치료를 받고, 사기를 유지하기 위해 어울릴 수 있는 공간이 필요합니다. 온도, 연결, 배관 등을 관리해야 하며, 이는 시작에 불과합니다. 시간이 지남에 따라 복잡성은 더욱 증가합니다. 시간이 지남에 따라 복잡성은 더욱 증가합니다. 결국 기지를 자동화해야 할 것입니다. 기지 규모와 해야 할 일은 늘어나지만, 대원은 늘어나지 않기 때문입니다.

title: Winds Of Arcana: Ruination
description:
게임 정보
무기? 마법? 둘 다 가능합니다!

무기를 선택하세요 - 방어의 달인 검, 마법 강화 차크람, 생명력 흡수 리치 해머. 무기의 종류는 더 많습니다.
고대 마법을 휘두르세요 - 적을 무찌르는 군중 소멸 마법, 강력한 보스 처치 마법, 무기를 강화하는 마법까지. 무기와 마법을 마음껏 조합하여 나만의 완벽한 빌드를 완성하세요.

전설적인 무기들

균형 잡힌 고전적 검. 무겁고 파괴적인 해머. 재빠르고 원거리 공격이 가능한 차크람. 각각 고유한 패시브 능력을 가진 전설적인 무기를 발견하세요!


영혼의 문장 - 잊혀진 전사의 정수가 담긴 고대 마법 도구입니다. 다양한 문장을 통해 자신만의 판타지 배틀메이지를 실현하세요.


그래플링, 활공, 플랫폼 소환 등의 액션으로 세계를 탐험하고 비밀을 파헤치세요. 스릴 넘치는 탐험과 도전적인 플랫포밍의 조화를 즐기십시오.

title: Desert Pirates
description:
게임 정보



GAME DESIGN documents will soon be released to the community. If you're curious or interested, you'll get to know EXACTLY what we're building!
Features:
Cars convoy
Primary weapon variety
Secondary weapon (missiles)
Dynamic Zoom
RAM damage
Speed boost
Command Orders
Upgrade cars and weapons
Collect Cars
Find skins
Expand your convoy
World
2 fighting tribes w/ several cars and features each
1 trading tribe w/ several shops
Environment destruction
4 resources to obtain + credit coin + tech
Strategic levels
Eternal Ride
Experience:
You lead a Convoy through the Desert.

The game involves driving and battling through zones to gather enough resources to sustain your journey as far as possible, all while having a BLAST of fun. Creating a game that can be played "" forever might seem like a foolish idea, but somehow, it's working! (If not us, then who?)

This game is the result of collaboration among three industry colleagues, each with a background in different studios across various eras, some of which we share. We're devoting our spare time to this endeavor. Though it's a gradual process, it's unfolding beautifully.

Our goal is to create a genuinely enjoyable and scalable game that players can engage with over the long term. By continuously adding new content along the journey, we're crafting an experience that players can wholeheartedly immerse themselves in.

title: GLUM
description:
게임 정보
세계 최초의 ""일인칭 부터""에서 악마같이 강력한 위협이 되어보세요. 거친, 성격이 급한 부적응자 고블린인 글럼으로서, 당신의 지배자와 친구들을 구하기 위해 모두의 기대(심지어 당신의 기대까지!)를 뛰어넘으세요.
대부를 구하는 것은 대부분의 하인들의 능력을 초과하는 일이다, 특히 당신이 대부의 소굴을 청소하는 데 익숙한 경우에는 더욱 그렇다. Glum은 이 소박하면서 매력적인 ""첫인칭 부츠 게임""에서 예상치 못한 영웅이 되는 시끄러운 고블린 하인의 부츠에 당신을 집어넣는다. 마법의 부츠를 장착하고, 마법의 엉덩이를 차고 황당한 폭력을 일으키는 여정을 시작하십시오.
적의 몸을 날려버리기 위해 적절한 타이밍의 발차기와 빠른 움직임을 사용하세요. 강력한 주문을 사용하기 위해 부츠를 충전하고 경쟁하는 지배자들을 이기고 그들의 부하들을 부츠로 발사되는 탄알의 연발로 무찌르세요. 글럼에게는 충분히 세게 차기만 하면 모든 것이 무기가 될 수 있습니다.
당신의 주인의 행방을 찾기 위해 담로로스의 엉뚱한 세계로 여행하세요. 경쟁하는 지배자들의 이상한 지역을 탐험하고 이 원시적인 세계의 미친 비밀을 발견하세요. 한 사람의 재앙은 다른 사람의 코미디가 되는 이곳에서.

title: Touhou Fractured Transience
description:
게임 정보
Overview

Touhou Fractured Transience is a 2D Platform Fighter game with elements of the Shoot'em up genre. Play as one of the many legendary figures of Gensokyo and wield their powers and abilities in combat. Hit your opponent as hard as possible and send them flying in a beautiful yet unhinged Battle of Bullets!
Story
Gensokyo is suddenly hit by weird boundary irregularities! Various mysterious bubbles have started to surround various parts of Gensokyo, and it seems to be expanding little by little as time passes. Those who enter the barrier is given an indestructible and never aging body that rivals even a Hermit. However, due to it giving what's practically immortality to also humans, humans may never have to fear youkai. Before these barriers consume the entirety of Gensokyo and endanger the balance between Humans and Youkai, our heroines must find a way to destroy it somehow.
However, it seems that the break for this phenomenon is rather straight forward: Abuse the power of immortality to the boundary's limits and shatter it with the same unshattering bodies it gives to its inhabitants. In other words, a battle with no restraints! To solve this disruptive incident, Danmaku battles are completely unhinged and fighters are allowed to use even their most powerful attacks!

In Gensokyo, Bullets are a means of communication to resolve conflict. Every Fighter is equipped with some form of projectiles. As such, interactions such as approaching, controlling space and pursuing is typically dominated by bullets.

However, just as important is dodging these bullets. Whenever a fighter grazes any attack, their Spell meter fills up. With Spell meter, Fighters gain access to their strong attacks. If completely filled however, fighters can unleash a Spellcard!

Each fighter has 3 sets of Spellcards each with its own properties and functions. They are powerful attacks that can change the tide of battle in an instant! Before unleashing a spellcard however, one must make sure to declare one before unleashing it, to ensure the other fighter is ready for it.

After awhile, your spellcard is ready to fire anytime. Be sure to aim at someone you don't like...

And unleash your annihilation of love!

Ability cards makes a return with effects much more convincing than its previous appearance! Summon the various powers of familiar faces across Gensokyo to aid you in your quest for victory!

More to be announced in the future...

title: Pirate Island
description:
게임 정보
항해를 시작하고 신비한 해적 섬에서 스릴 넘치는 모험에 참여하세요. 모든 구석에 위험과 경이로움이 기다리는 오픈 월드 서바이벌 크래프트 게임에 깊게 빠져보세요.

title: METRO PENGUIN EUTOPIA
description:
게임 정보


About This Game:
METRO PENGUIN EUTOPIA is a game depicting the exploits of ""Penguin Head"" Balm as she is unavoidably pulled into a spiral of violence surrounding penguins and the city of Sapporopolis. What fate awaits her? Only the player can decide. Behold, foolish penguins! The light of truth shall be shed on your eutopia of lies!

Hokkaido has been transformed into a barren wasteland all due to the Penguin Comet that plunged the land into an eternal blizzard. The city of Sapporopolis formed underground as a means of escaping danger. Rarely ever does the city come in contact with the outside world, causing it to grow a culture all of its own.

The vast underground space of Sapporopolis is split into the Upper Layer, where its citizens reside, and the Lower Layer, abandoned mid-construction. At some point, blood-thirsty penguins appeared in the Lower Layer, assaulting citizens and building their nests.

Our heroine Balm becomes an accidental hero when she dons a headdress in the form of a penguin: the Penguin Head. Alongside her accomplice Renade, she fights the murderous penguins day and night for the safety of the city’s people.

Game Features:
・Penguin hunting that begins in the idyllic city of Sapporopolis
Due to the destruction of a mysterious train responsible for birthing the penguins that dwell in Sapporopolis' Lower Layer, you are now able to travel between the city's two layers. In the Upper Layer reside the citizens of Sapporopolis, with diverse views and ways of thinking, along with three alliances operating out of their own objectives. Each of these alliances will surely lend Balm and her comrade a helping hand...out of certain motives, of course.

・Tendency parameters that decide the heroine's fate
The story's heroine Balm has three measures that reflect her tendencies: Order, Exploration, and Violence. These measures are called "tendency parameters" and increase based on the player's actions. The parameters come with level and skill points and can be used to acquire new skills, with the maximum value of each parameter referenced in Balm's actions. The player's actions decide Balm's fate.

・Turn-based battles and skills
Battles with the murderous penguins are turn-based. The lone Balm faces off against multiple penguins at once, so her attacks must be as accurate and powerful as possible. With the tendency parameters you obtain through your actions, you can help Balm gain new powers and unlock her skill tree. What skills and powers Balm builds is up to you.

・Multiple endings
Rumors of blood-thirsty penguins running rampant in Sapporopolis' Lower Layer begin to spread among the citizens. The relationship between Balm and the Three Alliances—a pivotal presence to both the city and penguins—may very well influence the outcome of the story. Solve the mystery surrounding these strange, ferocious penguins and the city regarded as a paradise by outsiders, Sapporopolis.

Montaro 2 is a stealth game where you are a clever doggo, navigating through various locations such as shopping streets, residential areas, schools, stations, and public swimming pools to complete sneaky missions and steal interesting items.

title: Panic Lane
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready for the most intense driving game you’ve ever played? In Panic Lane, your goal is simple: survive. You'll be on the edge of your seat as you dodge randomly spawned obstacles and fight relentlessly just to stay alive. Will you make it? There’s only one way to find out.

title: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds
description:
게임 정보
Noir Mystery
Alice is Dead is a grim, and twisted fantasy set in Wonderland. Unravel the secrets of this noir mystery to discover: who you are, who killed Alice, as well as how to get out with your hide in tact...
Visual Novel
Investigate the seedy corners of a dark and gritty Wonderland. Interrogate dark and unseemly interpretations of familiar characters in visual novel like interactions. Extract the information you need by any means necessary.
Point & Click
Explore the world through point and click interactions. The puzzles of this game are unapologetically hard. And the game is littered with added details and secrets for those willing to dig deeper.
REMAKE DETAILS
A complete HD remake, and retelling of the classic Alice is Dead Flash game trilogy, brought back to life by the series' original creators! ‘Hearts and Diamonds’ will be the definitive version of these stories, lacing together the lore and details that were previously crafted without the larger continuity in mind. title: Echo Wars - Road Rage
description:
게임 정보


The Echo brothers, two retired cybernetic clone troopers, enjoy their well-deserved retirement and the company of Meghan, their adorable enginurse, with whom they reminisce about their crazy past adventures. But little do the old cyborgs suspect that their days of action are not over yet…

Meghan seems to be suspiciously interested in these core memories. We soon find out that the enginurse is forcing the Echo brothers to remember their past exploits to unlock one by one the pieces of a great puzzle that takes shape as the game progresses.



Echo Wars is a driving shooter that can be played in cooperative multiplayer, where players take on the role of the Echo brothers, two retired cyber soldiers, and relive their adventures aboard a futuristic combat buggy.

Echo Wars is designed to make the most of Virtual Reality displays, but it can also be enjoyed on regular screens, ultra-panoramic screens, and Steam Deck.

The Echo brothers reminisce about their past missions as elite imperial officers at each level. Their tendency to exaggerate and brag about their feats allows the player to choose how specific phrases of the interactive script end, with surprising and hilarious results.

The narrative leads to action-packed first-person levels. Thanks to the three difficulty levels available, we will be driving with one hand while shooting with the other in breathtaking gameplay suitable for all players.

title: Another Day with You
description:
게임 정보

You have a date to make! But, it looks like you got there too early... Explore a quiet corner of the bustling city by interacting with locals, playing games at the arcade, fishing, and much more. Leave your date waiting, or fail to impress them with your natural charisma, and you'll be left on "read".



However, walk the walk and talk the talk, and you may have just secured yourself a second date!

There are many minigames to find around the city. These include fishing, playing arcade games, hide and seek, and more! The activities you choose to partake in will affect the available topics of conversations with your date. Pay close attention, as your date may have some questions for you regarding these activities.


Whether you are spending the day in the arcade or picking out flowers for your potential lover, . Spend your time wisely to get the most out of your day. If you miss out on something, there's always , and another chance for love.

title: Stream or Die!
description:
게임 정보
CONQUER THE CREATORS
You're Cage, an underdog streamer, teetering on the brink of obscurity. Seize a mysterious invitation to stream WISH, an unexplored MMO, and buckle up for the ride of your life.



Tactical auto-battler RPG plus Streamer simulator all in one!
You've never experienced a story like this
Recruit adventurers with the LFG Party System
Unlock powerful combat abilities by creating Formations
Watch in horror as your in-game choices bleed into the real world!
25+ endings
Fully voiced





Inspired by the Persona series and with an innovative RPG auto-battle system, every choice you make shapes your path. Will you be a family-friendly entertainer or a controversial edgelord? Each decision impacts your journey and your audience. Balance is key; keep your energy high, stress low, and sanity in check to dazzle your audience stream after stream.




As Cage, dive into and lead massive raids through a rich, expansive world brimming with quests, mystical artifacts, and treacherous dungeons. Watch your subscriber count soar as you become a streaming legend.




Uncover the enigmatic lore of the Monumentals, gargantuan beings consuming cities, and the Whisperers, mysterious figures holding the balance. Your streaming journey intertwines with these mysteries, leading to unexpected revelations.

title: Drop Point
description:
게임 정보
Drop Point, is an open-world survival PvPvE game that caters to a variety of play styles.
Whether you're a farmer, a fearless bandit, or a resourceful survivor, the game's sandbox environment gives you the freedom to forge your own path.
It's a blend of open-world exploration, survival, RPG, military-sim, action, looters, shooters, and farming elements. The story is in your hands.
Build Bases
Strategically design and build fortified bases to defend your territory against rival players and hostile creatures.
Farm Resources
Gather resources from the environment to craft tools, weapons, buildings and fortifications. In this ever-evolving battleground, your creativity and survival skills will be your greatest allies.

title: Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War
description:
게임 정보



In Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War, you're not just a player; you're the conductor of a life-and-death symphony. This immersive narrative rhythm game invites you to embrace the past and experience history like never before.
Step into the year of 1920, a time when the world stood at a crossroads.
The aftermath of World War I had left Europe scarred, and the winds of revolution stirred across the continent.
In this era of uncertainty, the Polish-Soviet War erupted - a decisive conflict that would shape the fate of nations in the years to come.
Poland found itself fighting for survival, determined to maintain its hard-fought independence in the face of the Soviet Union's red wave - a force aiming to spread communism across Europe.
This conflict represented a struggle between ideologies - Poland's fight for democracy against the advancing tide of Soviet communism - a collision of beliefs that culminated in the pivotal Battle of Warsaw.

title: Slyders
description:
게임 정보

In order to survive 15 minutes of merciless attacking waves of demons, you must become an unstoppable force of destruction. Choose from a variety of active and passive abilities, summon powerful allies, place deadly turrets, collect special weapons, fight mighty Bosses and more. Switch between different characters and equip them with unique items to create a build that fits your playstyle.
Story

Sky World is an endless heaven with hundreds of inhabited floating islands, each with its own people and culture. But now, an evil overlord with his demon army has attacked the once peaceful realm and is spreading chaos and corruption.
Fortunately, a group of brave resistance fighters from all over Sky World has combined their forces to liberate each island from the evil influence.

You play as Aryx, a fearless fox fighter who is accompanied by his supersonic turtle mount and Brian, a tiny but wise bear with a jetpack. Together, the heroic trio steps up to face the entire demonic war machine.

title: Memory Rewind
description:
게임 정보
Step into the life of a self-proclaimed detective. Along with your quirky assistant Olivina, take on a seemingly ordinary case, until you unravel its hidden twists and turns that pull you through a thrilling, unique story.
Unique investigation gameplay that challenges players to be observant
Diverse cast of characters
Smooth 2D animation that breathes life into the characters
Stylized, hand-drawn CG for players to unlock and collect

title: Call Of Dookie
description:

Imagine you went to the crapper and emerged an hour later to a monster apocalypse!
Retro first-person shooter action inspired by 90's classics!



Save your friends and family. Save the world... from going all to crap!
You are family man Mike Hadley. Returning to work after your favourite lunch buffet required an immediate visit to the restroom. That's when it really hit the fan. Now you must fight your way through the monster horde to save your loved ones!




For up to 4 players, just like your grand-pappy used to play!
Nothing beats bumping elbows with buddies next to you on the couch as you send a shotty blast upside their damn fool heads!

title: Times of Progress
description:
게임 정보
“Times of Progress” is a City Builder game set during the Industrial Revolution.
You control a city that is going through rapid change, due to the new technologies available and the leaps in productivity that they bring.
BUILD YOUR CITY



Place industries to extract the natural resources that the land offers. Connect them with the transport infrastructure and make sure that they have access to the local workforce. Progress towards providing secondary goods and services to your population, while balancing the issues that arise from the expanding city.
TRANSPORT MATERIALS AND GOODS



The transport infrastructure needs to evolve as the city grows. Goods are automatically transported by cart, but that is slow and inefficient. Build roads and railways to optimise the various routes, or reach new resources on the map by building harbours or tunnels.



As towns turn into cities, the needs of the population will evolve. Citizens at first need food and employment, but then will want consumer goods and services. Find the balance between their needs and the resources needed to satisfy them.
Resources on the map are limited, so being able to trade with nearby cities will be essential for the sustainability of the city.



The game offers randomised starting conditions, upgrades and rewards to choose from, while the maps are procedurally generated. If a city doesn’t thrive, learn from the experience and retry with different conditions on a new map. Each run is a new learning opportunity towards the mastery of the game.

title: Pizza Slice

From zero to hero 
Good-hearted grandpa, Stefano has given you no easy task! Get your establishment up and running, then learn the secrets of running an Italian pizzeria. Keep your customers happy, don't be surprised by a mysterious reviewer, and above all, don't let mediocre chains take your place in the market. Everyone knows very well that quality, not quantity, counts!
 Face the problems 
The competition never sleeps! Sabotage and health inspections are just a few of the problems you will face. On top of that, there is a mafia roaming the city... No one said it would be easy, but what wouldn't you do for a tasty pizza?
Every chef needs a helper
Two heads are better than one! At your side is your lazy cousin Alfonso, who will help you start the family business. As we all know, there is strength in numbers, so invite your friends to play and create an Italian pizza empire together!
A unique souvenir!
Your grandfather left you something else! Take a look at the cookbook passed down from generation to generation and learn the secret recipes for pizzas that even the most ardent pizza-lovers never dreamed of.

절차적으로 생성되는 지옥에 뛰어들어, 독창적인 무기를 손에 넣고 새로운 능력을 개방하며 강력한 시너지를 만들어내세요. 자유를 향한 길을 가로막는 모든 도전에 맞서 싸우십시오.

속도와 정밀함
지옥은 가혹한 곳입니다. 끊임없이 몰려오는 적들 사이에서 생존하려면, 기동성이 가장 강력한 무기가 될 것입니다. 멀찍이 회피하며 안전한 전투를 펼칠 수도 있고, 과감하게 적을 압박하는 공격적인 플레이도 가능합니다. 하지만 어떤 전략을 선택하든, 정교한 헤드샷 한 방이 승패를 가를 것입니다.

우상과 유물
지옥의 심연을 탐험하며 유물과 우상의 힘을 이용해 보세요. 강력한 업그레이드와 독특한 능력을 부여받아 더욱 강해질 수 있습니다. 탐험 중 발견한 시너지와 기회를 활용해, 전투 스타일을 유동적으로 변화시키세요.

Glitch Core

Where it's simply fun to shoot things up!

Build, farm, hunt, explore and fight to survive on lush procedural islands in Hexiv! 
Acquire and use cards to move and provide tasks for your crew, expand your territory, and construct buildings. Explore ruins and purchase upgrades in the Research Lab to acquire powerful artifacts. title: Dataminers
description:
게임 정보
Infiltrate highly secured data centres and grab as much data as you can. Plan your moves and outsmart guards, cameras and drones. Every turn counts: the Security Net is already rising. Valuable equipment is hidden in protected terminals. Steal it and use it for your mission or sell it on the black market.
Upgrades and cross-mission strategies
Upgrade your Dataminer with augments, expand his skills and develop your own strategy. Hire miners with special abilities and use their strengths for future missions. Reach the legendary Everything Centre and hack the holy grail of every Dataminer.
Do you know Minesweeper?
If NO, don't worry! You will get right into the tactical depth of Dataminers and the puzzle mechanics of Dataminers is taught in no time in the training center.
If YES, you are already familiar with the base puzzle mechanics of Dataminers. But Dataminers is more than just another Minesweeper clone: this time You are part of the playing field and enemies, items and abilities bring tactics and cross-mission strategies into play.
Features and playmodes
Roguelike campaign. Will you reach the Everything Centre?
Climb the InfiniTower. How far will you get?
Challenge yourself in Classic, Speed and Pressure playmode.
Compete with other players in weekly leaderboards and Daily Mission.
Just relax and play the Zen mode.

title: DRINKRIME
description:
게임 정보
THE PLOT

You meet a talking liquor bottle, Jin, who asks you to help him interrogate and catch criminals.
One after the other, you measure yourself against a series of unique, non-human characters with something to hide.
Where will this strange adventure bring you? And what is Jin's ultimate goal?
THE GAMEPLAY

You will fight and capture the criminals by interrogating them with the help of Jin's powers, in something known as... the Jinterrogation.
You will be hearing their testimonies and looking for keywords that will complete their confessions.

Each criminal, deep inside, feels guilty about what they have done, and your job is to make them face this reality by asking them questions and examining their answers. By the time you're done with them, you probably won't feel much pity for them... But learning more about their psyche is part of the fun.

The four-color palette, low-res art, and chiptune music create the nostalgic look of something out of a retro game from the '90s.
None of the characters in DRINKRIME look like humans. It'll be a lot of fun conversing with animals, bottles, and the like.

title: Wardens Rising
description:
게임 정보
Wardens Rising is a one-of-a-kind, action-packed game of heroism, strategy, and epic battles blending high-octane PvE coop ARPG shooter action and MOBA-like base defense strategy for an experience like no other!
Embark on an exhilarating campaign against a relentless interdimensional threat. Your mission is to protect vital energy cores from massive invasions and defeat mighty bosses to save humanity and attain everlasting glory.
Plan your strategy and build defenses before each battle. Over time you will unlock new defensive technology like towers, traps, portals, walls, and more to use in your next battle.

title: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada

Greetings, brave adventurer! Welcome to Croak Crusader: Champion of Canada, a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer where precision, skill, and grit are your ultimate allies. When the Roachilla Empire (grotesque alien bio-experiments created by the sinister Professor Creature) threatens the Great White North, it’s up to the indomitable Captain Croak to swing into action and save the day. Armed with a versatile grapple and fueled by unrelenting determination, you’ll dash, leap, and battle through a gauntlet of explosive, white-knuckle challenges.
Explore a vibrant world of forgotten bomb factories, sprawling circuses, and shadowy jungle ruins, each teeming with traps and enemies that demand lightning-fast reflexes and razor-sharp precision. The gameplay is difficult but deeply rewarding, blending tight platforming mechanics with fluid momentum and thrilling combat. Every step forward is a test of your skill, every enemy encounter an opportunity for satisfying chaos.
With its stunning black-and-white visuals inspired by the golden age of cinema and the chaotic energy of Hollywood Z-movies, Croak Crusader isn’t just a game: it’s an unforgettable journey. Will you conquer the impossible and save the Land of the Maple Leaf, or will the Roachilla Empire prevail? The fate of Canada is in your hands.

As you explore an abandoned castle and piece together your memories, you’ll uncover your tale: A tale of broken promises, regret, and bonds that last beyond death.

title: BUNNY
description:

"BUNNY"는 Bunny와 Smallbird가 친구들을 찾기 위한 모험을 떠나는 횡스크롤 액션 게임입니다. Bunny를 조종하여 스테이지를 탐색하고, 장애물을 극복하고, 벽을 뚫고 지나가세요. 게임 오버는 없으므로 누구나 끝까지 플레이할 수 있습니다.

title: Sanguine
description:
게임 정보

Sanguine offers a classic survival horror experience set in a mysterious rural town in the 1990s. Something terrifying has been unleashed, and your mission is to survive long enough to unravel the mystery, recover your identity, and escape the nightmare.
Gameplay Overview:
Sanguine features intense survival horror gameplay with fixed camera angles that heighten the sense of fear and claustrophobia. Players will need to manage their resources carefully, scavenging for weapons, ammo, and health items while avoiding or confronting the terrifying Bloods. The game also includes intricate puzzles that will challenge your wits and unravel the deeper mysteries of the town.










You play as Kris, who finds herself on the verge of death after a car collision. Seeking help and answers at the local diner, Kris must navigate through the chaos and fear that has overtaken the town. As you uncover the truth, you'll fight through the abominations known as Bloods, determined to become one with you.

Kris is a character shrouded in mystery, suffering from amnesia caused by the car crash. Despite the disorientation and fear that come with memory loss, Kris is strong, smart, and determined to uncover her past. Her journey through the town of Craven Oaks is not just a fight for survival, but also a quest for self-discovery.

As players progress, they will uncover fragments of Kris's memory, gradually piecing together her mysterious past and the dark history of Craven Oaks. She will cross paths with other survivors, each with their own stories and motives. Some will offer help, becoming allies in her quest to survive and uncover the truth. Others may have their own agendas, potentially hindering her progress or putting her in greater danger. These interactions will test Kris's judgment and resilience, adding layers of complexity to her journey.

The town of Craven Oaks is a character in its own right, brimming with intriguing buildings, eerie landmarks, and hidden secrets. Once a peaceful and industrious community, it’s now shrouded in an unsettling atmosphere following the catastrophic events that have left it in turmoil.

In the heart of the town is the imposing AltRan Corporation building, a towering structure symbolizing both innovation and mystery. AltRan Corporation, known for pioneering new ways of travel, has funded nearly everything in Craven Oaks, weaving itself into the very fabric of the town. The company is run by the enigmatic Dr. Gabriel Altran, whose influence permeates every corner of the community.

Central to this terror are the Bloods, hive-minded parasites with a singular, terrifying goal: to find hosts to transform and take over. Once a Blood infects a host, the transformation is irreversible. The host becomes a part of the Blood hive, losing all sense of individuality and humanity. These transformed hosts are no longer capable of reason and become relentless, dangerous creatures driven by the hive's collective will.

Our game captures the nostalgic essence of classic PS1 graphics with meticulously crafted low-poly models and textures.

title: Antidote city hall
description:
게임 정보
토마스라는 이름의 형사와 혼돈과 절망의 세계에 빠져. 이 도시는 그의 집이지만 지금은 지뢰밭처럼 보입니다. 마약,부패,살인-이 모든 것이 일반화되었습니다.

토마스는 도시의 수호자였지만,고위급 사건으로 경찰에서 해고당했습니다. 이제 그는 자신의 탐정 기관을 설립하고 자신의 전 영광을 회복하기 위해 노력하고있다. 그러나 시간이 지나고 여전히 고객이 없습니다. 잊혀지고 우울한 토마스는 술 한 병에서 위안을 찾습니다.

하지만 토마스는 좋은 이름을 되찾을 기회가 있습니다. 그는 마약 카르텔과 정치인과 관련된 신비한 살인 연쇄를 해결해야 할 것입니다. 그는 도시가 오랫동안 기다리고있는 영웅이 될 수있을 것인가?

게임의 특징:

-예기치 않은 왜곡이있는 흥미 진진한 이야기.
-많은 이웃과 위치가있는 거대한 도시.
-관심과 논리적 사고가 필요한 복잡한 조사 시스템.
-자신의 비밀과 동기를 가지고 각각의 다른 캐릭터와 상호 작용할 수있는 능력.
-전체 통로를 통해 당신을 동반 할 도시에서 지배적 인 두려움과 절망의 분위기.

title: Dreamers Disease
description:
게임 정보


Dreamers Disease is a fast-paced atmospheric boomer shooter where you go deeper into your dreams to kill the illness dubbed "Dreamers Disease". Thanks to new technology you are able to Shoot Yourself in the head, and the bullets fly back at higher speeds! But you will have to be really careful with your health while doing this.



The game is inspired by FPS games such as Dusk and ULTRAKILL. Dreamers Disease is Fast and Chaotic, you will get overwhelmed by the variety of enemies and you will die, but if you focus and prioritize enemies you just might make it out alive.



Explore impossible spaces and nonsensical architecture that your dreams create, you never know where the Dreamers Disease will be.



Dreamers Disease has a big focus on worldbuilding and story. You will have to look for clues as to what is happening and to figure out that most of what you think, isn't what it seems.

title: HYPERFATAL
description:
게임 정보
HYPERFATAL is a fast-paced old school FPS that combines the explosive action of movement shooters with unique mechanics similar to Quake and popular Source engine games.

An ancient interdimensional army known as the Goonabites have been disturbed by unknown forces, and are invading countless worlds. In a last ditch attempt against the masses, the last dwellers of the known universe have unleashed Project HYPER, an experimental cyborg soldier with unmatched speed, brutality, and abilities to face those who wish to destroy all of creation. Time is running out... show them that your existence will be FATAL


Use movement mechanics such as Rocket Jumping, Air Strafing, and Surfing to traverse environments quickly and dodge the relentless attacks of enemies.

With an emphasis on Push-Forward combat, kill enemies to gain charges for health and for Hyper Abilities, powerful tools to aid you in combat efficiency.

title: Re:Connect
description:
게임 정보
"Re:Connect" is a puzzle adventure game where you hack into the world's system and embark on an adventure.
Become a small debugging AI and explore the digital world alongside a talkative navigation AI!
Hack into a glitched system and reconnect its broken code!
Program, battle rogue AIs, and sometimes… even reconnect hearts?
Travel between the real world and the puzzle world to uncover the secrets of the digital realm!
…And what kind of ending awaits you at the end of your journey?
---What kind of game is it?---
【Hack into the system and explore】
When you infiltrate the system, its insides appear as puzzle-like electronic circuits.
Solve puzzles to restore the system!
【Intuitive programming puzzles】

title: Memory Adventures in the Jungle
description:
게임 정보
Dive into an amazing world of fantasy and adventure with our game ! Test your memory and concentration as you explore a jungle full of cute and funny animals ... and a lot of secrets !
In this casual and fun challenge, you'll need to find matching cards and connect the pairs. With its randomly generated levels and engaging gameplay, this game is the perfect way to unwind and sharpen your skills.
Whether you're a fan of light-hearted fun or a thrilling mental test, this game can give you hours of amazing entertainment. Try it now and experience an awesome card-matching adventure in the wild !

title: Raygun Gadabout
description:
게임 정보
"Raygun Gadabout is a thrilling action-platformer that masterfully blends rewarding exploration with intense, fast-paced combat. Dive into a galaxy where every corner holds a new adventure, and every battle keeps you on the edge of your seat."
"Blast off into the stars aboard your very own starship! Engage in epic battles with space pirates, discover new worlds, and explore treacherous moons and asteroids. Traverse vast futuristic cities and even venture inside the belly of a giant space creature."

title: Xanthiom 2
description:
게임 정보
Xanthiom 2 is an action-adventure platforming game in which you explore a massive planet and fight its hostile inhabitants!

Play as Captain Grisham as you explore what remains of Earth, after humanity's last war! Combat all manner of deadly enemies, from sentient war machines to biological experiments gone wrong! Discover powerful weapons and abilities to assist you on your journey to avenge humanity!






Also featuring:


Xanthiom Zero ReSimulated is a from-the-ground-up remake of Xanthiom Zero, which is included with Xanthiom 2! After the events of Xanthiom Zero, the Coalition commissioned a team of elite computer scientists to create a perfect simulation of planet 4-514. It is your job to explore the simulation and discover what Captain Grisham is keeping from the Coalition!

title: The Masquerade
description:
게임 정보
가장 무도회는 2명부터 8명까지 즐길 수 있는 살인 파티 게임입니다. NPC를 사칭하여 사냥꾼에게서 숨는 동시에 목표의 가면을 벗기고 살해할 수 있는 충분한 단서를 수집합니다.



게임의 목표는 라운드가 끝나기 전에 최대량의 코인을 얻는 것입니다. 목표물을 제거하거나 사냥꾼을 죽일 때마다 코인을 얻습니다.

의심을 피하기 위해 NPC를 가장하십시오.
저택을 탐색하여 다양한 치명적인 무기를 찾으세요. 독, 석궁, 함정, 단검, 샹들리에... 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!
수많은 NPC들 사이에서 목표를 식별하세요
환경과 상호 작용하여 목표물을 제거할 수 있는 독창적이고 보람 있는 방법을 찾으십시오.
공격적으로, 방어적으로 플레이하거나 영지 목표에 집중하세요. 모든 전략은 좋은 전략입니다!
저택의 많은 비밀과 숨겨진 방을 밝혀내세요.

대가족이 연례 모임에 초대되었습니다. 가면무도회는 수 세기 동안 가족을 괴롭혔던 분쟁에 대한 멤버들의 복수를 막을 수 있을까요?
Features
게임 사용자 정의: 다양한 지도, BOT, 무기 및 기타 옵션 중에서 선택하여 다양성을 제공하고 게임을 원하는 대로 조정하세요.
다양한 게임 모드를 경험하세요: 모두 무료, 팀 대 팀, 배틀로얄!

title: Extraktion 1943
description:
게임 정보
Local + Online Co-Op

Take on the nazis with up to 4 players in PVE co-op.

Loot and Survive

Manage many resources to stay alive behind enemy lines: Food, Water, Health, Energy, Body Temperature, and Mental Strength.
Sabotage

Hit the enemy where it hurts! Sabotage the enemy's lifelines; vehicles, factories, food production, anything you can!
Assassinate

The less Nazis the better, take down high ranking officers but make sure you have a clear exit route. Use sniper rifles, explosives, or even your bare hands.

Get out of the mission zone alive. If you die during your run, you'll lose all your loot! Choose to extract with your loot or push on for greater challenges and rewards.
tag: 익스트랙션 슈터,오픈 월드 생존 제작,제2차 세계 대전

title: Super Stream-Bara
description:
게임 정보
"스트리머가 되고 싶었던 적이 있나요? 당신이 얼마나 뛰어난 게이머인지 세상에
보여주고 싶나요? 이제 가능합니다!
당신의 플레이에 열광하는 관객들의 반응을 지켜보세요. 당신의 플레이에 열광하는
관객들의 반응을 지켜보세요. 게임을 멋지게 클리어하거나, 화를 내며 채팅창에서
밈이 되는 모습을 보여주며 방송을 더 흥미롭게 만들 수 있습니다! 모든 것은 당신의
손에 달려 있어요!

title: League of Speedrunners
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the League of Speedrunners! It's a third-person 3D platformer that takes you to a magical world. The familiar civilization, with its modern technologies, sank to the bottom of the water depths, but on the ruins of the past, a new civilization has emerged, breathing in itself the spirit of great change and competition.

An exciting competition awaits you to claim the title of the best speedrunner, with many challenges scattered across the open world, each with its own leaderboard.

Immerse yourself in a colorful, open world and explore it freely.


Complete challenge as quickly as possible. In this game, time is of the essence.


Play as different heroes, each with their own unique superpowers, such as hook, super jump, blink, and more.


Run, jump, avoid traps and enemies.

title: Building Relationships
description:
게임 정보


As the new arrival to the island, you're here to meet eligible bachelorx pads and find the love of your life! Enjoy a one-of-a-kind story as you navigate a bizarre dating adventure amongst a unique set of structures.
Uncover hidden secrets!
A variety of biomes across an island, jam-packed with goodies! Search through a somber forest, climb up a snowy mountain, or just lay in a flowery field.

Realistic building movement!
We always thought "the one thing missing from dating sims is the ability to wave-dash". So we added it!

Looking to shack up? Meet structures like Millie (a windmill who might step on you if you ask nicely) or Tenet (who's just a himbo tent).

They say there’s plenty of fish in the sea… but you won’t find any around here. We replaced all the fish with cars because it just made more sense.

Wishlist the game and join our discord to stay up-to-date!

title: Circle the Wagons: Prima Septimana
description:
게임 정보
While traveling west your caravan discovers a cult that has seemingly existed in the desert for hundreds of years. Who are they? Who or what is their god? And most importantly, can you and your caravan survive their attempt to push back the western expansion?
---

In Circle the Wagons: Prima Septimana you take control of an unnamed cowboy struggling to establish an encampment in hostile lands. Build your camp with turrets, traps, and other buildings while also upgrading your cowboy with new weapons, skills, and unique perks to defend against wave after wave of enemies. The larger your camp gets the more travelers will join and help defend against the mysterious cult.

Prima Septimana is a short and small game with unique gameplay in a Gothic Western setting.

title: The Crimson Maid
description:
게임 정보



"How terrible to think that such a bright and noble man is nearing his end. What will we do without our pillar?"

Estranged for a couple of years, a young man rushes back to his childhood home. Dismayed by the news of his father losing his sight and inching closer to his demise, Marius, a priest in training, suspends his long studies at the seminary to be close in his final days to the man who taught him dignity and stalwartness. Under the gloom of impending death, the oldest son of honorable Leon Rosenthal can’t conceive the encroaching events that his arrival will unfold, equally exhilarating and petrifying.








Play as Marius as he returns to his childhood home in an attempt to reconnect with his ailing father, stern mother and overwhelmed younger brother. Much to your surprise, your household now employs an alluring young maid, Irina, who charms you from the first sight. But your blossoming romance will soon be tested as a dreadful murder shakes the feeble balance of this noble family.






is an adventure game focused on dialogues, exploration and light puzzle solving. Speak to Irina and your family to discover how they feel, their deep desires and what they may be hiding. Rummage around the mansion and the surrounding estate for clues, optional puzzles, misplaced documents and insights into the family and its past. Embark on a journey of self discovery as Marius comes to terms with his choices, their consequences and the unexpected legacy of his lineage.

title: Neon Extermination
description:
게임 정보



🩻 Former employees turned archenemies, Alexa and Cyber Corp are at the heart of a high-stakes corporate drama. Cyber Corp, a towering influence in the tech world, harbors sinister plans that threaten the city Alexa loves.


As time ticks away, Alexa delves deeper into the corporation's machinations, only to discover layers of intrigue and deception far more disturbing than she ever imagined. 🩻

Blending reality and virtual realm, the game promises intense action, exploration, and a gritty narrative.

⭐ Enhance your skills by utilizing upgrade coins that can be found during missions.
⭐ Heroic story – Unravel the secrets behind CyberCorp's experiments with your mysterious companion.
⭐ CyberCorp`s thugs & Bugs – Varied enemies, including humanoid adversaries and creatures born of digital corruption.
⭐ Variety of weapons – From the Pistol & Shotgun to the Rocket Launcher and Plasma Cannon (with alternative firing mods).

title: Hopeless Sea
description:
게임 정보
(Please use invitation link on the right --> to redirect to the Discord channel)
Many years later, the effects of global warming and radioactive contamination leaks have culminated in the world we see today: killing frenzy sea monsters, sunken city, massive population shrinking etc. The world is now covered by hopeless sea, so brace yourself captain, bring your courage and last hope of humankind and set sail!
What emerges from the sea remains unpredictable, so prepare to face procedurally generated monster squads, thus each run is unique! Slay hordes of monsters before they halt your progress.

title: Rabbit's Tale
description:
게임 정보
A calm peaceful village, burned and destroyed by an oppressive force.

Rabbit was born and raised in Carrot’s Village, a small, sunny town surrounded by forest, where habitants lived in harmony. Small town, great rabbits!

However, a threat grew each day, as a dark entity lurked closer and closer to Carrot’s Village. The Steam Order discovered the power of steam machines, propelling them to power and conquest.



They threatened and took by force all the land they could, expanding their dominion thanks to their terrifying steam machines and cold-hearted minions.

One afternoon, they arrived at Carrot’s Village. A warning they gave, but a short one.



By dawn everything was sacked, burning and destroyed. Families were torn apart by kidnappers with no soul.

Now, our Hero finds himself alone with a mission on his hands.

title: Razgovor Online
description:
게임 정보
Explore The World Of Razgovor

Razgovor Online provides many places for you to explore.

Whether you are exploring to enjoy the view or looking for new people to meet, There are different locations and different ways to enjoy the open world of Razgovor Online.

Providing you with places such as:
Bonsila Town
Minstfield Town
Lux Night Club
Create your own experiance

Razgovor provides in game stores for players to customise their character to look however they want to look.
With more clothes being added in the future there will be no shortage of new ways to look.

With Clothing Stores Such as:
UNLOCKED
Cyber Genesis
HuntersRU

Razgovor is an inclusive game for all kind of players and provides an open and welcome experiance.

Wheather youre looking to Roleplay of just Socialize with others, Razgovor provides tones of ways to share your experiance.

Enjoy Mini-Games with the community.
Each Mini Game includes ways for you to interact with others or with friends without feeling limited to the Main world of Razgovor Online.

title: Casa De Diamantes
description:
게임 정보
Accompany agent Steph, right hand of the revered forbidden flower,
on the hunt for their final rival residing in the beautiful and glamorous
casino, the Casa De Diamantes.
Casa De Diamantes is a 2D movement shooter with aggressive enemy
encounters and tight level design. Fight your way through multiple enemy
types, collect chips then spend and gamble them away at the casino.
Play blackjack, customize your appearance or decorate your hotel room
at the Casa De Diamantes.
FEATURES
Momentum Based Movement

title: Changa
description:
게임 정보
Warning:Changa game play and videos contain moving patterns and changing colors which may trigger seizures in people affected by photosensitive epilepsy.


Set and Setting


A wandering consciousness that decides to forge her own path. Equipped with her extreme mobility, a melee attack, and a ranged dagger, Jade embarks on a psychedelic 3D bullet hell arcade odyssey as she tries to sever the web of suffering and escape the cycle of deaths and rebirths. Bounce, dodge, fly, and fight the illusions of material and immaterial reality in this new kind of bullet hell.


Features
















Changa is hitting Early Access with one complete difficulty of 10 maps, with a second difficulty coming soon after release. A single playthrough will test your resolve and your creativity in movement, reactions, and planning on the fly. Expect somewhere in the 2-8 hour range for a first playthrough on the base difficulty.

title: NecroArcher
description:
게임 정보
NecroArcher can be best described as a mix between
Lord of the Rings and The Hangover movies in the form of a Metroidvania.

It’s a humorous indie metroidvania game with elements of Hack’n Slash, where you control an undead archer on a mission to save his friend Larry from the clutches of The Evil Witch, aided by Stanley the vampire. But well... it might be more complicated.

Explore a vast interconnected world and fight a variety of creatures.
With a mix of fantasy and coming of age themes, embark on an unforgettable adventure full of humor, personal growth and the triumph of friendship!

title: Beach Slap
description:
게임 정보
It's time to relax for a vacation, and you finally found your perfect spot. Alas, you're not alone...
There is only one beach and you are a disgruntled, selfish penguin. Dash, stomp and slap your way to vacation supremacy in this chaotic multiplayer brawl.
Control the terrain by changing it to your color. Dash your way across the map, jump and stomp the ground to fling your opponents, or give them the ol' flipper to the head to send them packing to the nearest pit.
Play from 2 to 4 players in local multiplayer, or up to 8 players online (with rollback!) accompanied by a colorful low-poly style and sweet bumpy tunes by Dale North.
Duke it out on hundreds of maps with different gimmicks and items, or create your own with the level editor and play them with your friends locally or online.
Important Note: This is a multiplayer only game! No single player is included

title: Supermarket Master
description:
게임 정보
Supermarket Master is a fast-paced, chaotic supermarket simulation where you manage shelves, serve demanding customers, and keep the store running smoothly.
BUILDING SYSTEM
Sandbox Building System to create and decorate your Store, always expand and unlock new features for your staff and customers.
YOU ARE THE MASTER

title: Tyrofeud
description:
게임 정보
The perfect 1v1 mini games galore for casual scrubs like us. You and your sibling are tasked to complete certain chores before your mom returns home. Let them know you are THE superior sibling. Be the one to complete more assignments so you can get all the love from mommy. You can choose to do either of these things at a given time:
COMPLETE CHORES
If you get to finish the three tasks that your mother assigned you to do when the time runs out, you will given a star that you can use to run the wheel to get forbidden item. These are simple tasks such as cleaning the toilet, putting fruits on the fridge, and many more. Failure to do any task by the end of the day will automatically eliminate you from the family. Jk. You just lose that round and an immediate guarantee that you won't get a star, that's all.
WHACK A SIBLING
If you meet your sibling when you are about to do your daily task, you can smack them with items that you can find around the house. Remember, if you get hit, you will be temporarily stunned for a few seconds, which makes them have the upper hand in completing their tasks. I say we strike FIRST, always.

title: Rock Island
description:
게임 정보
이것은 자동 진행형 게임으로 풍부한 스킬 발전 및 업그레이드 요소가 있습니다.
게임 플레이
섬의 중심에 신비한 큐브가 놓여 있습니다. 이유는 무엇이든 상관없이 클릭하세요. 당신의 작은 돌사람들을 이끌고 그것을 공격하세요! 매번 공격할 때마다 큐브는 보물상자처럼 다양한 희귀 아이템을 토해내며, 이들은 부족 발전의 기초가 될 것입니다.
작은 돌사람들
작은 돌사람들은 각각 독특한 임무를 맡고 있습니다. 운반공들은 떨어진 귀중한 자원을 수집하는 역할을 합니다. 복서들은 강력하게 신비한 큐브를 공격합니다. 다양한 직업의 작은 사람들은 각자의 진로 계획에 따라 스킬을 해금하고 재능을 향상시키며 끊임없이 성장합니다.
돌 부족
여기에서 희귀 아이템은 기교롭게 가공되어 다양한 아이템으로 만들어져 작은 돌사람들의 모험과 건설을 돕습니다. 돌 제단은 풍부한 재능 조합을 제공합니다.

title: Caveman Jump Jump
description:
게임 정보
Dare to travel back 40,000 years and help the caveman escape extinction in this challenging platforming adventure across three unique worlds!
Prepare for a tough challenge in the prehistoric era! Test your skills by jumping your way up to the top, where a frozen cavewoman awaits your rescue.
Game Features:
• Action-packed platforming adventure!
• 12 full levels filled with challenges!
• 3 unique worlds with beautifully crafted environments!
• Help the caveman survive extinction!
• Custom artwork and a distinctive design!
• Reach the top — if you're skilled enough!
• Time your jumps carefully… or fall into the void!

title: Divine Orders
description:
게임 정보
This is exploration-style shooting RPG.
【Game flow】
Each stage is divided into several areas, and players can attack any area they like.
The player can use the experience gained in the process, the materials collected and the money to level up and strengthen their weapons,
The aim is to defeat the stage bosses while using the experience gained in the process, collected materials and money to level up, strengthen weapons and purchase new weapons and skills, etc.
【Game features】
The damage system is based on HP rather than a residual unit system, so it is possible to reduce damage by leveling up and strengthening the system.
Damage can be suppressed by improving your level and strengthening. Because of the earning system that uses enemy bullets, you can enjoy the earning play without worrying about being hit by bullets.
You can enjoy a bold earning play without worrying about being hit by bullets.

title: The Last Table
description:
게임 정보
The Last Table 는 당신의 평범한 근무가 치명적인 전환을 맞이하는 심리적 공포 경험입니다. 작은 레스토랑에서 웨이트리스로 일하면서, 당신은 음산한 스토커의 감시 아래 업무를 처리해야 합니다. 당신이 서빙하는 각 주문은 마지막, 끔찍한 대면에 가까워지게 만듭니다. 지혜를 사용하고, 한 발 앞서 나가며 밤을 살아남으세요 — 아니면 그의 다음 희생자가 될 것입니다. 근무를 끝마칠 수 있을까요, 아니면 이것이 마지막 테이블일까요?

title: This Party Is Killer
description:
게임 정보
You, Ripley, have been worked to the bone in an effort to stay on the straight and narrow. Cooking, plating, rinsing, repeating. On your one day off, you decide to take your partner Iris and their camera to a planning party for your friend Erik’s future thesis film. But the footage Erik wants to capture is more than you or Iris bargained for.
Will you be able to protect your partner from what lies before you?
This Party is Killer is a horror visual novel inspired by classic American slasher films. Playing as Ripley, you make choices throughout the night of the party to determine both Iris's fate and your own. You can also search your surroundings "point-and-click" style for key insights into the world you are exploring.
A visual novel with choices throughout to determine your ending
Choose how you take care of Iris; decide your combined fates
Watch the wheel of cyclical violence spin in a short but sweet format
Over 120+ lovingly painted pieces of key art
LGBT+ cast of characters
Splattershot gore and uncomfortable encounters that will leave you squirming

title: Echoes of Nara
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Nara tells the story of a Dreamknight, Nara, as he journeys through a mysterious and captivating dream world. His goal is to free the inhabitants of this realm from their worst nightmares, facing the deep fears and nightmares that dwell within.
Explore diverse worlds, each with unique mechanics and visual styles. Discover the challenges that await Nara in the dreams and nightmares of the inhabitants of Sognaris.
Each world will be completely different, allowing you to switch between dimensions or use special abilities tailored to each environment to overcome or escape nightmares as you uncover the secrets the world of Sognaris holds.

title: Supermarket Surviving Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Supermarket Surviving Simulator is a store management simulator with survival elements. You will start your own shop with just one dollar in your account and aim to bankrupt all your competitors. Sounds pretty simple, right? But along the way, you'll face hunger, fatigue, hysterical customers, tax returns, lawsuits, unscrupulous suppliers, expired goods, illnesses, nervous breakdowns, poisonings, obesity, incompetent staff, robbers, and much more.
Fortunately, there’s some good news. The character progression system will allow you to improve yourself, run faster, tire less, and calm customers with just a glance. You can also unlock new useful gadgets, like a computer or a more advanced cash register.
Survival Elements
Managing a store is not easy, and it’s even harder when you have to eat and sleep. Plan your diet carefully to stay healthy and avoid food poisoning, all while making sure you don’t blow your budget. Healthy food is not cheap.
You won’t be able to work around the clock, so plan your day carefully to ensure you get enough rest and keep the store in good shape. Customers don’t come evenly throughout the day. There will be busier hours and quieter periods when you can take a break, restock, or pay your bills at the bank—but don’t forget to inform customers of your hours with a "schedule" sign. They’ll be upset if they show up during working hours and find the store closed.

title: Wheelchair Racer
description:
게임 정보
Become the Wheelchair! This hilariously challenging physics racer dares you to master the art of wheelchair movement.
Dual-Hand Controls:
Take on the challenge with a unique dual-handed control system that tests your left- and right-hand coordination to the limit. Push, pull, and pivot your way through every obstacle!

title: Polly's Gone
description:
게임 정보
Polly's Gone은 액션 RTS와 슈팅 요소가 결합된 독특한 게임으로, 충실한 양 팀과 함께 실종된 Polly를 찾기 위한 여정을 떠납니다. 레벨을 진행하며 새로운 도전을 직면하고 위험을 극복하며 Polly의 행방에 다가가세요.
Polly's Gone은 두 가지 흥미로운 게임 모드를 제공합니다:
스토리 모드: 이야기에 몰입하며 다양한 레벨을 탐험하고 팀을 전략적으로 이끌며 적을 물리치세요.
생존 모드: 외딴 섬에서 10분간의 생존 아레나에서 팀의 운명을 책임지고 도전에 맞서보세요.
이 액션 가득한 모험에서 역동적인 전투, 독특한 환경, 스릴 넘치는 도전을 경험할 준비를 하세요!

title: Astrosembler
description:
게임 정보
BUILD. FIGHT. EXPLORE 
A distant planet. A relentless alien threat. And only your ingenuity stands between survival and extinction. Astrosembler is a sci-fi sandbox factory building strategic fps game where you build automated factories, reinforce outposts, and battle extraterrestrial forces in a hostile world.
Assemble, optimize, and defend your industrial empire — because every structure, every bullet, and every resource counts. Will you rise to the challenge?
BUILD ADVANCED PRODUCTION CHAINS
Construct and optimize production chains to manufacture weapons, defenses, and resources. Every building consumes computational power, making expansion a strategic challenge.
FIGHT BACK TO DYNAMIC AI
Defend your factory from an ever-adapting alien threat that targets weak points in your defenses.
DEEP WEAPON CRAFTING SYSTEM

title: Puzzle Spy International
description:
게임 정보
A ring of jewel thieves has stolen a rare diamond. It’s up to Agent Epsilon, top operative of Puzzle Spy International, to track them down.
