Follow a trail of cryptic puzzles spanning several countries. Make narrative choices as you chat with (and chat up!) suspicious characters. Decode cryptograms, decipher clues, and deduce answers as you solve wordplay and logic puzzles across the globe!

FEATURES:
2-5 hours of playtime with 8 unique challenging puzzles to solve
Click and drag words and input text to uncover a solution
Generous hint system ensures that you’ll always be able to complete a puzzle
Make conversational choices as you talk to contacts in different countries
Fun to play solo or with a group (on the same computer)
Mid-century modern retro art style to immerse you in the vibe of the mid-1960s
Thrilling spy music original soundtrack
Every puzzle along your path is a unique challenge for you to uncover and figure out how to solve. Bring your wordplay, logical deduction and deciphering skills. Figuring out the intent of each puzzle is half the fun, so put on your thinking cap and go-go boots and get to work!

title: Ward Off Evil
description:
게임 정보
As the Cycle draws to a close, the last bastion of humanity overflows with survivors loyal to their ancient empires. Each tribe envisions a new future for mankind, oblivious to the conspiracy that led them all here in the first place.
Though many cling to their crumbling cities and dwindling civilizations, this dying world's fate is not set in stone. As a Guide, you can lead your army across the wastes, take on any contract, and champion any cause. Will you stand against impossible odds for the sake of all humanity, or will you abandon all hope and bring about the end times?
Features:
Create your character
You are one of many nameless wanderers, but your destiny is far from fixed. Customize your character by choosing a tribe and a background. Develop them throughout the game by learning new active skills, passive perks, and discovering otherworldly powers.
Build your army
Many survivors will fight for coin, honor, or glory. Recruit units from a cast of four major factions - ambitious Lemurians, noble Thuleans, fierce Hyperboreans, and fanatical Agarthans. Complement your army with minor tribes, like the enigmatic Shu or the ethereal Atlanteans, or tame beasts and monsters native to the wastes. If all else fails, conjure Elementals and Thoughtforms through long-forgotten rituals... if you are willing to pay the price.

title: Dice x Dice
description:
게임 정보
굴려라. 바꿔라. 정복하라. 이 덱 빌딩 로그라이크에서 주사위로 현실을 재구성하세요. 당신의 최강 주사위 무기고를 구축하십시오.
✨ 게임의 독창성
운명은 당신의 무기
단순한 D6로 시작해 규칙을 부수세요:
🎲 전투 중 적 스탯 재굴림으로 보스 약화,
🎯 숫자 도둑질로 적의 힘을 빼앗아 주사위 강화,
💥 수식어 중첩 — «3→5 변환» + «5 폭발» = 혼돈!
...
RNG가 아닌 전략입니다. 주사위 뒤에 숨은 진짜 게임.
🔄 불멸의 빌드 제작
⚔️ 60+ 수식어. 아이템, 스킬, 광란의 이벤트를 조합해 확률을 조종하세요:
“피의 주사위” – 6은 자해하지만 다음 굴림 +3.
“혼돈의 계략” – 5턴마다 모든 숫자 재배치.
“상인의 저주” – 10 HP로 행운의 주사위 구매… 또는 저주받은 유물을 적에게 판매.
...
🎭 규칙을 뒤집는 캐릭터

title: The Last Ride Home
description:
게임 정보
🌲 고요한 숲. 깜빡이는 불빛. 마지막 절박한 집으로의 여정.
The Last Ride Home은 네 인생에서 가장 긴장감 넘치는 여정이자 생존을 위한 필사적인 싸움이다. 숲이 너를 둘러싸고 깜빡이는 불빛이 완전히 꺼질 위기에 처하면서 매초가 소중하다. 위험한 길을 따라 달리고, 치명적인 장애물을 피하고, 바로 뒤를 쫓는 괴물로부터 도망쳐라. 과연 너는 집에 무사히 도착할 수 있을까?
🌟 주요 특징:
🔦 고장 나고 예측 불가능한 자전거 라이트:
네 자전거 라이트는 제멋대로 깜빡이며 약한 빛에서 완전한 어둠으로 바뀐다. 어둠이 너를 집어삼키기 전에 주변 환경을 재빨리 기억해라. 다시 라이트를 켜기 위해 적절한 순간에 터치해야 하지만, 주의해라: 그 과정에서 조종이 더 어려워질 수 있고, 작은 실수가 치명적일 수 있다!
🛑 운전 실수는 치명적이다:
길을 벗어나지 말고 장애물을 피하라: 길에서 벗어나거나 장애물에 부딪히면 게임이 끝난다.
멈추지 말아라: 너무 오래 멈추면 괴물이 너를 잡을 것이다.
돌아갈 수 없다: 숲은 실수를 용서하지 않는다 – 선택한 길은 최종 결정이다.
🦌 황금 뿔을 가진 사슴 괴물:
숲의 전설에서 태어난 그림자 같은 존재가 빛나는 눈과 소름끼치는 미소로 너를 쫓아온다. 이 괴물은 생각보다 훨씬 빠르며, 실수할 때마다 더욱 가까워진다.
🛣️ 갈라지는 길과 소름 끼치는 체크포인트:
모든 경로는 다르며 각 분기점에는 비밀이 숨어 있다: 버려진 오두막, 잊힌 묘지, 경고 표지판, 그리고 이전 희생자들의 흔적 등이 있다. 이러한 시각적 단서는 숲의 비극적인 과거를 은밀히 드러내지만, 머뭇거릴 시간이 없다 – 앞을 보며 나아가라!
⌛ 시간 압박과 증가하는 위험:
네게 주어진 시간은 제한적이다. 잘못된 경로를 선택하거나 라이트 없이 지체하는 순간이 많아지면 너의 운명은 끝난다. 속도, 집중력, 빠른 반응 사이의 완벽한 균형을 찾아라.
📈 진행률 및 위협 표시기:
너의 여정에서 현재 진행 상황을 확인하고 목표 지점까지 얼마나 남았는지, 그리고 괴물이 얼마나 가까이 왔는지 항상 주시해라. 실수할 여지는 없다.
🎮 게임 메커니즘:
🚴 속도 조절과 정확한 조향: 속도를 지속적으로 조정하며, 괴물로부터 도망치기 위해 가속하거나 날카로운 커브와 치명적인 장애물을 피하기 위해 감속해라.
🔦 자전거 라이트 관리: 고장 난 라이트는 빠른 반응을 요구한다. 어둠 속에 완전히 갇히기 전에 적절한 타이밍에 라이트를 켜되 자전거의 조종을 놓치지 않도록 주의해라.

title: Chemical Combat
description:
게임 정보
Deep within an abandoned research facility, a catastrophic experiment has transformed the scientists into zombified monsters, unleashing chaos within the once safe lab. Armed with a supply of highly volatile chemicals, you'll need to fight your way through a sprawling maze of interconnected rooms, splashing enemies with explosive elixirs and collecting various valuables.
Chemical Combat is an action-packed, chemistry-themed roguelike where strategy is key. Craft complex concoctions that trigger crazy chain reactions, battle your way through crowds of deadly monsters, and gather resources to upgrade your equipment. Survive, escape... or delve deeper for even greater rewards.
COMBINE CATALYTIC CHEMICALS 🧪
Combat here isn't just aimless shooting - it's about chaining the right reactions at the right times. Combine elements to ignite, corrode, freeze, and stun your foes, stacking reactions for even greater devastation. Refine and adapt your playstyle in order to conquer any challenge.
ENTER THE COMPLEX 🗺️
Each expedition takes you into a procedurally generated laboratory full of enemies, puzzles and traps - randomized layouts with risks and rewards around every corner. Navigate safely, as there's only one way out... unless you count death as a second.
MINE RARE MINERALS ⛏️
Construct and upgrade automated drills to passively mine materials between floors. Choose which elements to excavate, expand your arsenal, and experiment with an array of up to 16 unique elements. Be warned though: fuel isn't cheap, so you'll have to manage your resources carefully in order to maximize profits.
BATTLE BRUTAL BOSSES ☠️
Encounter deadly guardians at the exits to each floor. Defeat them to claim large bounties, permanent upgrades, and access to deeper levels, but beware - fighting these titans demands strategy, skill, and split-second reflexes, so there's no room for error.
PURCHASE POWERFUL PERKS ✨
Return to safety after each floor, where you'll have the opportunity to spend your hard-earned cash on various upgrades which significantly boost your damage, survivability, or can even enable entire new playstyles. The choice is yours, but invest wisely - difficulty never decreases...

title: Echoes of the Outworlder
description:
게임 정보
Explore and gain new abilities in the fantasy world you find yourself transported to in this short Isekai Metroidvainia inspired by modern classics in the Isekai and LitRPG genres. Fight monsters. Search for secrets. Uncover what caused the majority of the world's inhabitants to lose access to magic.
Features:
COMBAT
Defeat enemies that hinder your progress and take what they leave behind to grow stronger.
EXPLORATION
Use abilities you gain to explore new places and find secrets.

title: Dumbino
description:
게임 정보
Prepare for a chaotic physics sandbox where dominoes go wild and overkill!
Explosions, chain reactions, and utter madness is what you can expect. Dumbino takes the simple concept of dominoes and cranks it up to an unhinged level of goofiness!
Rack your brains with crazy constructions and creative or chaotic solutions for mass domino destruction! Express your creativity or madness in the level editor. Assemble, destroy, tip and share your creations with the community!
Special Goofy Dominoes

title: BUDD
description:
게임 정보
B.U.D.D. is a sci-fi action platform game with light Metroidvania elements, inspired by games and anime from the late 80's and early 90's.
Bounty Hunter for Hire: Eris Altair
Step into the boots of Eris, an ARCANA bounty hunter-in-training who crash lands on the mysterious alien planet of Verdeo. To make her way back to the space colony, she'll find one of many B.U.D.D. units, versatile helper drones that aid in combat and traversal. After escaping Verdeo, Eris will uncover the secrets of not only her crash, but the organization that hired her, and the entire Lumina System.
A Helping Hand in Battle
Eris can use her B.U.D.D. units to solve puzzles, attack the enemy, extend a combo, or open up opportunities for extra damage. With each level earned, Eris and her BUDD units will learn new skills to overcome the Lumina System's many challenges.
Space Faring Adventure
After repairing your ship, you'll take on missions for colony MARI-XIII and embark on a journey across four planets, each with its own unique challenges, secrets, and boss battles. In addition to the main planets, you can test your skills in multiple timed satellite missions, where precision and speed are rewarded generously.
Features
4 full regions to explore across the Lumina System.
5 Satellite missions to test your skills.
Plenty of abilities to learn thanks to your BUDD Units.
An introspective story. Just who is Eris? Why did she join ARCANA? And why is the desk clerk so interested in her?
Extra challenge modes unlocked after the main campaign.
Galleries that fill out as you progress through the game.
Plenty of other secrets to find!

title: Dragon Spot: Cozy Puzzle Builder
description:
게임 정보
타이머나 스트레스 없이 드래곤 섬을 만들고 발전시키는 명상 전략 게임에 빠져보세요. 숨막히는 풍경을 만들고 주민들이 이빨을 가진 애완동물을 돌보는 모습을 지켜보세요. 휴식과 창의력 모두를 위한 완벽한 게임입니다.
간단한 섬 디자인 및 커스터마이징

몇 가지 간단한 도구로 아름다운 섬을 쉽게 만들어 보세요. 나만의 취향에 맞게 환경을 커스터마이징하세요. 나만의 완벽한 드래곤 파라다이스를 만들어 보세요. 번거로움은 필요 없습니다!
드래곤을 위한 성장하는 커뮤니티를 만드세요

성장하는 정착지를 건설하고 마법의 세계에 빠져보세요. 주민들이 이빨 달린 애완동물을 사랑스럽게 키우며 섬을 활기차고 번성하는 커뮤니티로 변화시키는 모습을 지켜보세요. 새로운 집을 짓고 드래곤을 돌보는 모든 행동으로 섬은 따뜻함과 매력으로 살아납니다.
이웃 주택을 건설하고 개인화하기

드래곤을 키우는 데 도움을 줄 사람들과 함께 살게 됩니다. 그들을 위한 아늑한 보금자리를 건설하세요.

title: Creature Kitchen
description:
게임 정보
Creaking footsteps in vacant rooms... Voices whispering beyond the trees...

Befriend your local wildlife and feed them their favorite snacks in this cozy atmospheric cooking simulator! There's a strange house to search, a forest to explore, and stomachs to fill. Set the radio to play some tunes and get comfy, the witching hour has only begun...

Features

Find and feed creatures of all shapes and sizes.
Cook up over thirty recipes to suit each critter's tastes.
Explore a mysterious house and expand your cooking arsenal.
Snap pictures to fill out the photo album.
Vibe to an original soundtrack complete with an in-game radio.
Get immersed in early 2000s graphics with a modern flair!
A bite-sized experience - Creature Kitchen is about an hour long.

title: My Infamous Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
It's time to be evil. Build and master your dungeon, hire despicable monsters, and rise to conquer the overworld. Gaze from below as your dark tendrils creep across the land, snatching treasures from the forces of good and funding an ever growing empire. But beware! Saint Million the Hero King and his table of royal knights are always watching. Leave your dungeon weak, and a single cleave from the hero's sword will end your reign.
My Infamous Dungeon is a roguelite dungeon builder. Take time to carefully plan your dungeon, then protect it against waves of greedy heroes.
Features
An ever-changing dungeon
Build a unique dungeon every time. Combine over 6 monsters clans and 20 professions to uncover devious synergies and menacing strategies. Roguelite elements bring improvisation and variety to each playthrough.
Control the pace
Heroes enter the dungeon when you allow it. Take your time to plan your dungeon and lay devilish traps, then test your work against waves of delightfully foolish heroes.

title: Sea Walker Saga
description:
게임 정보
1878. An alternate steampunk reality.
The Flood has swallowed everything. The world turned into an endless ocean. The survivors have learned to create mobile islands - 'Isla Muvimi' for trade and communication.
You will have to travel across the vast seas in search of the mythical continent. Battles at sea and in the air, mysteries of the underwater depths and the search for allies await the player in order to survive in this difficult world.
Build and develop your mobile island - 'Isla Movimi' - and take it on an endless journey.
Build and manage your floating base island.
Control your battle turrets, plane and bathyscaphe.
Explore the vastness of the ocean, battle enemies and search for amazing secrets in the world of Sea Walker Saga.

title: Razgovor Online
description:
게임 정보
Explore The World Of Razgovor

Razgovor Online provides many places for you to explore.

Whether you are exploring to enjoy the view or looking for new people to meet, There are different locations and different ways to enjoy the open world of Razgovor Online.

Providing you with places such as:
Bonsila Town
Minstfield Town
Lux Night Club
Create your own experiance

Razgovor provides in game stores for players to customise their character to look however they want to look.
With more clothes being added in the future there will be no shortage of new ways to look.

With Clothing Stores Such as:
UNLOCKED
Cyber Genesis
HuntersRU

Razgovor is an inclusive game for all kind of players and provides an open and welcome experiance.

Wheather youre looking to Roleplay of just Socialize with others, Razgovor provides tones of ways to share your experiance.

Enjoy Mini-Games with the community.
Each Mini Game includes ways for you to interact with others or with friends without feeling limited to the Main world of Razgovor Online.

title: Casa De Diamantes
description:
게임 정보
Accompany agent Steph, right hand of the revered forbidden flower,
on the hunt for their final rival residing in the beautiful and glamorous
casino, the Casa De Diamantes.
Casa De Diamantes is a 2D movement shooter with aggressive enemy
encounters and tight level design. Fight your way through multiple enemy
types, collect chips then spend and gamble them away at the casino.
Play blackjack, customize your appearance or decorate your hotel room
at the Casa De Diamantes.
FEATURES
Momentum Based Movement

title: Changa
description:
게임 정보
Warning:Changa game play and videos contain moving patterns and changing colors which may trigger seizures in people affected by photosensitive epilepsy.


Set and Setting


A wandering consciousness that decides to forge her own path. Equipped with her extreme mobility, a melee attack, and a ranged dagger, Jade embarks on a psychedelic 3D bullet hell arcade odyssey as she tries to sever the web of suffering and escape the cycle of deaths and rebirths. Bounce, dodge, fly, and fight the illusions of material and immaterial reality in this new kind of bullet hell.


Features
















Changa is hitting Early Access with one complete difficulty of 10 maps, with a second difficulty coming soon after release. A single playthrough will test your resolve and your creativity in movement, reactions, and planning on the fly. Expect somewhere in the 2-8 hour range for a first playthrough on the base difficulty.

title: NecroArcher
description:
게임 정보
NecroArcher can be best described as a mix between
Lord of the Rings and The Hangover movies in the form of a Metroidvania.

It’s a humorous indie metroidvania game with elements of Hack’n Slash, where you control an undead archer on a mission to save his friend Larry from the clutches of The Evil Witch, aided by Stanley the vampire. But well... it might be more complicated.

Explore a vast interconnected world and fight a variety of creatures.
With a mix of fantasy and coming of age themes, embark on an unforgettable adventure full of humor, personal growth and the triumph of friendship!

title: Super Spy Academy
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling adventure filled with espionage and intrigue in Super Spy Academy, a captivating narrative-driven game set in a prestigious private university overtaken by sinister forces. As Leo, a determined freshman, players must navigate through a series of challenging puzzles and obstacles to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of his brother and the infiltration of the academy by the villainous "Super Villain Academy."

With the help of QBear, an AI companion, players will explore a rich 3D world teeming with secrets and surprises, interacting with unique characters along the way. From navigating through six diverse areas with their own distinct themes to solving over 15 puzzles scattered throughout the academy, every step taken brings players closer to unraveling the gripping mystery at the heart of Super Spy Academy.

Featuring fully voice-acted dialogue, captivating visual novel-style storytelling elements, and engaging mini-games to test your spy skills, Super Spy Academy offers an immersive gameplay experience unlike any other. Whether playing with a mouse and keyboard or a gamepad, players will find themselves immersed in a world where every clue leads closer to the truth. Dive into a world of suspense and embark on an unforgettable journey to save the academy from its perilous fate.

Key Features:

Lots of characters to interact with
Explore 6 diverse areas, each with its own theme and challenges
Solve over 15 puzzles to progress through the story
Fully voice-acted cast brings the characters to life
Experience visual novel-style storytelling elements
Navigate a rich 3D world filled with secrets
Engage in mini-games to test your spy skills
Compatible with mouse and keyboard, as well as gamepad controls

title: High School Dirty Secrets
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in a haunted high school, Kasuga must uncover buried secrets to escape the terror-filled halls.
                                       Kasuga, a popular student, wakes up to find herself inexplicably trapped inside her school after dark. The eerie silence and shadowy corridors are far removed from the bustling, lively atmosphere she knows. Worse yet, her memory of how she ended up there is a blank slate.
Desperate to escape, Kasuga begins exploring the seemingly abandoned building, only to encounter chilling phenomena. Cryptic text messages flood her smartphone. Strange entities begin to manifest.
Piece by piece, Kasuga must uncover the truth about her school, her peers, and even herself. But beware: nothing is as it seems, and some secrets are better left buried.
                          A Spine-Chilling Horror Adventure: Explore a haunted high school filled with eerie sights, cryptic clues, and unsettling twists that will keep you on edge.
Interactive Smartphone Gameplay: Use Kasuga's smartphone to log clues, capture photos, and receive unsettling messages as you unravel the mysteries surrounding her imprisonment.
Dynamic Perspective Switching: Experience the tension from every angle—switch seamlessly between 3rd and 1st person views to fully immerse yourself in the environment.
Anime-Style 3D Graphics: Dive into a world that combines stunning visuals with a deeply atmospheric setting, creating a perfect blend of beauty and dread.
Will you help Kasuga escape the nightmare... or will you succumb to it?

title: Pandash
description:
게임 정보



Collect All Perks
The game lets you unlock and collect unique active and passive perks to use against your foes. Each perk brings new powers for even more combinations. Uncover new abilities and enhance your run with awesome possibilities.




Create different builds depending on your playstyle! Want to place traps over traps with more traps? Want to throw all of your projectiles at once - with huge explosions? Or just ram everything down in a melee build? That might be for you!




Explore the pixelart world and see where the run will bring you! Use the level and for your advatage and search the detours to get new rewards.




Pandash is a strategic roguelite that takes the player Ryu on a journey to a world where he receives support from a mysterious ghostly realm. In this Roguelite platformer, the player must traverse various areas to gradually free his world from the unknown threat.
During the game, the player can discover and use various perks to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles.

Each use of the perks disrupts the balance of the worlds. The current world and the ghostly realm must remain in harmony. If this harmony is disturbed, Ryu's strength falters and he will feel the direct effects. But perhaps there are also ways to take advantage of this imbalance...
The threatened world that Ryu travels through is full of secrets and dangers. The environment changes every time the player begins his journey. Each journey also means new challenges that he must face.

title: LoveSoTea
description:
게임 정보
Love your tea, love your life.

Gameplay:
Become more and more proficient in the art of tea by making a daily brew each day.
Advancing the story unlocks a variety of tea leaves to choose from, with a particular focus on black tea.
Schedule events in your calendar that can boost luck and wellbeing and live a happy, peaceful life.

In the kitchen:
Practise making tea in the kitchen and play with different heat levels, tea leaves, and brewing times.
Then run taste tests until you discover the perfect brew.

Story:
Meet Yoru, who has been told he only has a few months left to live, and Chihiro, a high school student who keeps insisting on treating him to some delicious tea, for reasons unknown.
The two slowly pass his remaining time together, not at a café but at home, sharing some peace and quiet - and a few laughs - at a tea time just for two.

Features:
Many café games have a lot of tasks, such as running the business and serving countless tables. In this game, you only serve one person.
Plus, you should be able to recreate all the teas in the game at home with your own setup.

- Featuring Japanese and Chinese teas
- No need to be a master of tea party etiquette
- Easy controls: just click, drag, and drop!
- No prior knowledge of tea-making required
- Appropriate for all ages (in theory)

NOTE: If you do care about tea-making etiquette, please forgive the blasphemous idea of throwing tea leaves straight in the kettle.

title: Louloudi Asteri ~Save the Solar System~
description:
게임 정보
'A 3D side-view twin-stick shooter that plays like 2D! Save the solar system through multidimensional manipulation!"


In the distant future...
Having overcome numerous challenges, humanity thrived throughout the entire solar system.
Suddenly, a massive virus arrived from the far reaches of space.
The virus rapidly multiplied and spread, threatening human activity.
If left unchecked, the solar system would be completely consumed by the virus...

The last hope for humanity lies in an anti-virus spaceship.
Can the two aces, Luludi and Asteri, save the solar system?

"Louloudi Asteri Save the Solar System" is a side-view 3D shooting game. With twin-stick controls, not only can you move in all directions, but you can also perform sidesteps and rolls in depth, allowing for skillful evasion of enemy attacks that would be unavoidable in 2D gameplay.

During your ship's roll, the camera rotates, allowing you to find gaps in enemy attacks and hidden spots in the terrain. Combine rolling with vertical movement to evade enemy attacks or chase down and destroy enemies spread throughout space.


Sidestepping is a rapid acceleration in depth. Even when normal movement won't allow for evasion in time, you can sidestep to barely dodge enemy attacks. As you become familiar with the controls, you can weave through gaps in enemy fire in 3D space.


With a beginner-friendly shield and life system, you automatically recover by using energy when you take damage. The game continues as long as your ship isn't destroyed by consecutive hits. When your ship is hit by enemy attacks, the shield decreases. If you avoid subsequent damage, the shield automatically recovers. When the shield gauge runs out due to continuous damage, the condition gauge decreases. Condition also recovers automatically but requires more energy. If the condition gauge runs out, your ship will be destroyed.


You can switch between the two ships, Luludi and Asteri, with different equipment at any time. Power-ups are performed individually, allowing for strategic play such as switching to balance power-ups or swapping early during a pinch to wait for recovery opportunities.


Enjoy the smooth movements powered by physics calculations and the deformed journey through the solar system as you fight off the giant virus.


There are both normal and difficult routes prepared for each stage, catering to a wide range of players. If the normal route becomes unsatisfying, try searching for the hidden challenging route!
company: 星花🌸ゲーム開発, 星花

title: Artifice
description:
게임 정보


Elia Sanberg lives in the cozy hamlet of Benello, a small town on the Mishil continent of the magically-infused world of Allea. Elia’s recent interest has been in the development of an invention she calls a “magical brain.” Her idea is to create the world’s first machine capable of calculating the sums of numbers.

On the eve of her breakthrough, however, she is summoned by Benello’s mayor to deal with a local bandit problem. She and her militia compatriot Donovan are successful in routing the bandits, but instead of returning home, Elia and Donovan find themselves transported to a strange, future version of their world where computers have not only been invented, but have become massively powerful.

Humanity on this Allea is caught in the middle of a conflict between two sentient artificial intelligences, and one of them wants Elia’s help.



Turn-based combat.
Two worlds with over thirty dungeons to explore.
Hunt down spell tomes and learn eighty magic spells.
Upgrade your magical abilities with a unique system called “inscriptions.”
Over 200 unique enemies.
Enemy mastery unlocks, which include bestiary entry reveals, battle effects, and even special equipment.
Collect items from the environment and sell them to a disenchanted god to gain access to more special items and equipment.

title: Comet
description:
게임 정보
Take control of a spaceship in this top-down action shooter and defend yourself and earth from the unknown mysteries and horrors off space!


Space rocks have been approaching earth at an alarming rate, pilot a spaceship with powerful lasers and find the source of the problem.
Farm the materials off asteroids and alien ships, and save earth from destruction!
Game Features
Shooting the space rocks

title: DEVIL'S LIMINAL
description:
게임 정보
A horror and queer romance visual novel where your choices determine the course of the story and your relationships.

After graduating from private school, Margo returns to her hometown in Arizona to work before starting college. As she settles into her summer internship working at the social services department of a veterans home, supernatural events start to happen around her. A series of strange dreams lead her to an occult puzzle involving her own soul.

Features
Main character with a defined personality and background.
Two love interests with relationship and friendship routes.
Branching dialogue choices that influence the story.
Unlockable gallery images.
Supernatural, generational horrors.
The inescapable bleak landscape of rural Arizona.

title: Wicked Lands
description:
게임 정보
Kaboom! The Nexus? Shattered. Time? Cracked like a bad egg yolk. Your purpose? A cosmic mystery. Embark on a thrilling journey into a wicked fantasy realm that's as unpredictable as a caffeinated cat on a trampoline!
MASTER HYBRID WARFARE
Lead your motley crew of minions into fast-paced, tactical combat that will make your enemies question their life choices. Outmaneuver them, exploit their weaknesses and use your arcane powers to turn your minions’ strikes into critical hits - or at least keep them alive till tomorrow!


Get creative with a wide arsenal of magical mayhem. Make two units swap positions, raise a skeletal sidekick, persuade an enemy to switch sides or turn them into a walking bonfire with a sizzling fireball!

Thought you were done? Not so fast! A killing blow grants your minions an extra jab. Skillfully string together their attacks and your own spell-slinging to unleash gloriously orchestrated kill-streaks!
LOOT & PLUNDER
Equip your minions with dazzling items, expand your arcane arsenal with fresh spells, and get your hands on artifacts that rewrite the rules of the game! Every faction hoards their own unique loot, but be warned - you’ll have to pry it from their cold, dead hands!
EMBRACE FATE
Embrace the double-edged sword of fate! As dawn cracks and dusk falls, it's time to draw a Fate Card. Each one introduces new, deadly foes or other challenges to your run. But don’t despair! Finish the quests they come with and get rewarded with new minions, bonus mana or other powerful upgrades. Only with these will you stand a chance to survive the escalating chaos and make it to the final Fate Card draw - giving you a shot at defeating one of the legendary bosses!
Barter for arcane knickknacks with the Bog Witch, hit the jackpot at the Pixie Casino or lay an offering before the monument of Sparkles - the infamous Catmancer, whose loyalties change faster than you can say "hairball.” Discover unique landmarks and denizens ranging from grudgingly civil to suspiciously friendly, offering boons such as spell-cloning, eldritch insurance or some mushrooms to give your minions a psychedelic edge in battle!
Discover why the Nexus went kaboom, find out who you really are, and maybe - just maybe - break the time loop that grips the Wicked Lands!
New combinations of minions, items, artefacts, spells and factions and a randomly generated map offer a fresh experience as well as new challenges every time you play. Daily runs and leaderboards make sure that you’ll have plenty of reasons to come back for more!

title: Nanika Game Online
description:
게임 정보
Q: What kind of game is this?
A: It's an online falling-block puzzle game where you drop and merge objects called “Nanika,” each with its own unique skill. The game features real-time matches and cooperative play.
Q: What are the rules?
A: You win by reducing your opponent’s HP to zero, causing their Nanika to exceed its stack limit, or by having more HP than your opponent when the match ends.
Q: What is “Nanika”?
A: “Nanika” refers to the objects you drop and merge within the game. There are 66 types in total, and when you combine identical Nanika, they evolve to the next level and become more powerful. Each type has its own skill, so creating different combinations can greatly expand your strategic options.
Q: What ways are there to play?
A: There are three main modes:
Unranked Mode – Play casually without affecting your rank.
Ranked Mode – Your rank changes with wins and losses.
Mirror Mode – Use the same deck as your opponent for a pure test of skill.
Custom Mode – Compete with friends in your own custom matches.
You can also participate in 1v1 or 2v2 online matches.
Q: How is the class determined?
A: As you earn points in the game, you level up. Upon reaching Level 1, you’re assigned a role, and every time you level up, you gain a new skill.
Q: Who is it recommended for?
A: Beginners can steadily practice and get used to the game in Unranked Mode, while advanced players can enjoy challenging themselves in Ranked Mode. If you like team battles, 2v2 matches allow you to cooperate with friends, making the game fun for a wide range of players.
Q: What’s the biggest appeal?
A: It combines the simple mechanics of a falling-block puzzle with the rich strategic depth of 66 different types of Nanika. Because it’s played in real time, split-second decisions and proper use of skills can determine the outcome of a match. Additionally, building your own deck and choosing your role lets you showcase your unique playstyle, which is a major part of the game’s charm.

title: Parable Academy
description:
게임 정보
Parable Academy is a 2.5D tag team fighter with only one attack button. A Fabled curse has swept the world... ordinary teens have begun transforming into characters from their favorite stories. In order to keep these young people safe from their own curses, a university was set up - Parable Academy for Fabled Youths! Can these students survive the constant attacks from literature's greatest villains?
With simple movement controls and a single button to use for all attacks, Parable Academy is incredibly easy for newcomers to pick up.
Press the attack button with a direction to use your fighters' normal moves, or hold the button down to unleash powerful Supercharge attacks!

title: Supermarket Master
description:
게임 정보
Supermarket Master is a fast-paced, chaotic supermarket simulation where you manage shelves, serve demanding customers, and keep the store running smoothly.
BUILDING SYSTEM
Sandbox Building System to create and decorate your Store, always expand and unlock new features for your staff and customers.
YOU ARE THE MASTER

title: OMEXYAN
description:
게임 정보
Test your skills and become the champion of the Universal Games!
The galaxy is watching you in this once-in-a-millennium competition. 
Step into the world of OMEXYAN, where movement, rhythm, and skill rule the arena! Feel the adrenaline in this dynamic VR game that challenges your reflexes and precision.
-Dive into the world of OMEXYAN, where reflexes, precision, and skill dominate in an exciting VR adventure!
Use the color-catching devices in your hands to collect incoming red and green orbs. Then, control two colorful remote devices to aim at and hit the matching-colored cubes accurately. In the third challenge, wield a sporty laser weapon to shoot the correct-colored targets with precision.
Earn points, unlock new levels and arenas, and face increasingly challenging and diverse tasks. With a fast-paced soundtrack accompanying your gameplay, OMEXYAN ensures you’re fully immersed in a dynamic and thrilling experience.
This game focuses on skill-based challenges and dynamic VR gameplay, offering exciting and captivating entertainment.

title: Beach Slap
description:
게임 정보
It's time to relax for a vacation, and you finally found your perfect spot. Alas, you're not alone...
There is only one beach and you are a disgruntled, selfish penguin. Dash, stomp and slap your way to vacation supremacy in this chaotic multiplayer brawl.
Control the terrain by changing it to your color. Dash your way across the map, jump and stomp the ground to fling your opponents, or give them the ol' flipper to the head to send them packing to the nearest pit.
Play from 2 to 4 players in local multiplayer, or up to 8 players online (with rollback!) accompanied by a colorful low-poly style and sweet bumpy tunes by Dale North.
Duke it out on hundreds of maps with different gimmicks and items, or create your own with the level editor and play them with your friends locally or online.
Important Note: This is a multiplayer only game! No single player is included

title: Bee Hero: Bug Blaster
description:
게임 정보
Annihilate hordes of wacky bugs in this action-packed Looter Shooter RPG. Build insane weapon combos. Collect game-changing loot. Master a deep skill tree.
                                     Explore tons of powerful abilities that activate automatically on cooldown. From homing missiles and poison arrows to laser mines and ricochet blades, unleash devastating weapons like gas grenades, vampire fields, propeller bombs, and more. Create chaos with every cooldown.

title: Filiy Eclipse
description:
게임 정보
When he wakes up, he finds himself in an escape pod.
He has no memory, doesn't know where he is, and can't even remember his own name.
He arrives at a shopping street but there is no one there. Only a robot.
The robot speaks to him.
"You have temporarily lost your memory. If you want to regain your memory quickly,
you should go to the museum and look around at various things."
With nowhere to go, he decides to head to the museum.
● Obtain a secretary hidden somewhere and learn and strengthen command skills.
   It can also be learned at a dojo.

title: Tyrofeud
description:
게임 정보
The perfect 1v1 mini games galore for casual scrubs like us. You and your sibling are tasked to complete certain chores before your mom returns home. Let them know you are THE superior sibling. Be the one to complete more assignments so you can get all the love from mommy. You can choose to do either of these things at a given time:
COMPLETE CHORES
If you get to finish the three tasks that your mother assigned you to do when the time runs out, you will given a star that you can use to run the wheel to get forbidden item. These are simple tasks such as cleaning the toilet, putting fruits on the fridge, and many more. Failure to do any task by the end of the day will automatically eliminate you from the family. Jk. You just lose that round and an immediate guarantee that you won't get a star, that's all.
WHACK A SIBLING
If you meet your sibling when you are about to do your daily task, you can smack them with items that you can find around the house. Remember, if you get hit, you will be temporarily stunned for a few seconds, which makes them have the upper hand in completing their tasks. I say we strike FIRST, always.

title: Rock Island
description:
게임 정보
이것은 자동 진행형 게임으로 풍부한 스킬 발전 및 업그레이드 요소가 있습니다.
게임 플레이
섬의 중심에 신비한 큐브가 놓여 있습니다. 이유는 무엇이든 상관없이 클릭하세요. 당신의 작은 돌사람들을 이끌고 그것을 공격하세요! 매번 공격할 때마다 큐브는 보물상자처럼 다양한 희귀 아이템을 토해내며, 이들은 부족 발전의 기초가 될 것입니다.
작은 돌사람들
작은 돌사람들은 각각 독특한 임무를 맡고 있습니다. 운반공들은 떨어진 귀중한 자원을 수집하는 역할을 합니다. 복서들은 강력하게 신비한 큐브를 공격합니다. 다양한 직업의 작은 사람들은 각자의 진로 계획에 따라 스킬을 해금하고 재능을 향상시키며 끊임없이 성장합니다.
돌 부족
여기에서 희귀 아이템은 기교롭게 가공되어 다양한 아이템으로 만들어져 작은 돌사람들의 모험과 건설을 돕습니다. 돌 제단은 풍부한 재능 조합을 제공합니다.

title: Caveman Jump Jump
description:
게임 정보
Dare to travel back 40,000 years and help the caveman escape extinction in this challenging platforming adventure across three unique worlds!
Prepare for a tough challenge in the prehistoric era! Test your skills by jumping your way up to the top, where a frozen cavewoman awaits your rescue.
Game Features:
• Action-packed platforming adventure!
• 12 full levels filled with challenges!
• 3 unique worlds with beautifully crafted environments!
• Help the caveman survive extinction!
• Custom artwork and a distinctive design!
• Reach the top — if you're skilled enough!
• Time your jumps carefully… or fall into the void!

title: Breathless Hope
description:
게임 정보
Breathless Hope is a first-person horror and action game set in a peripheral area forgotten by the government and completely isolated after a deadly outbreak.
Survive and help your neighbors
Within the blockade, you’ll have to survive on your own. Most of your neighbors are either infected or locked inside their homes.
Every decision matters
Make tough choices that will shape the storyline. Would you help a neighbor who wronged you in the past? Your choices matter and could mean the difference between life and death.
Don't lose your breath
Run for your life, avoid getting caught, and show no mercy – because the monsters you face certainly won't. When tired, stop and rest – or take an energy drink – otherwise, you’ll become easy prey.
Explore
Explore dark alleys in search of supplies to help others and yourself. But be cautious when turning a corner, as something may be lurking.
Remember: In this game, haste is the enemy of survival.

title: Divine Orders
description:
게임 정보
This is exploration-style shooting RPG.
【Game flow】
Each stage is divided into several areas, and players can attack any area they like.
The player can use the experience gained in the process, the materials collected and the money to level up and strengthen their weapons,
The aim is to defeat the stage bosses while using the experience gained in the process, collected materials and money to level up, strengthen weapons and purchase new weapons and skills, etc.
【Game features】
The damage system is based on HP rather than a residual unit system, so it is possible to reduce damage by leveling up and strengthening the system.
Damage can be suppressed by improving your level and strengthening. Because of the earning system that uses enemy bullets, you can enjoy the earning play without worrying about being hit by bullets.
You can enjoy a bold earning play without worrying about being hit by bullets.

title: The Last Table
description:
게임 정보
The Last Table 는 당신의 평범한 근무가 치명적인 전환을 맞이하는 심리적 공포 경험입니다. 작은 레스토랑에서 웨이트리스로 일하면서, 당신은 음산한 스토커의 감시 아래 업무를 처리해야 합니다. 당신이 서빙하는 각 주문은 마지막, 끔찍한 대면에 가까워지게 만듭니다. 지혜를 사용하고, 한 발 앞서 나가며 밤을 살아남으세요 — 아니면 그의 다음 희생자가 될 것입니다. 근무를 끝마칠 수 있을까요, 아니면 이것이 마지막 테이블일까요?

title: This Party Is Killer
description:
게임 정보
You, Ripley, have been worked to the bone in an effort to stay on the straight and narrow. Cooking, plating, rinsing, repeating. On your one day off, you decide to take your partner Iris and their camera to a planning party for your friend Erik’s future thesis film. But the footage Erik wants to capture is more than you or Iris bargained for.
Will you be able to protect your partner from what lies before you?
This Party is Killer is a horror visual novel inspired by classic American slasher films. Playing as Ripley, you make choices throughout the night of the party to determine both Iris's fate and your own. You can also search your surroundings "point-and-click" style for key insights into the world you are exploring.
A visual novel with choices throughout to determine your ending
Choose how you take care of Iris; decide your combined fates
Watch the wheel of cyclical violence spin in a short but sweet format
Over 120+ lovingly painted pieces of key art
LGBT+ cast of characters
Splattershot gore and uncomfortable encounters that will leave you squirming

title: Echoes of Nara
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Nara tells the story of a Dreamknight, Nara, as he journeys through a mysterious and captivating dream world. His goal is to free the inhabitants of this realm from their worst nightmares, facing the deep fears and nightmares that dwell within.
Explore diverse worlds, each with unique mechanics and visual styles. Discover the challenges that await Nara in the dreams and nightmares of the inhabitants of Sognaris.
Each world will be completely different, allowing you to switch between dimensions or use special abilities tailored to each environment to overcome or escape nightmares as you uncover the secrets the world of Sognaris holds.

title: Supermarket Surviving Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Supermarket Surviving Simulator is a store management simulator with survival elements. You will start your own shop with just one dollar in your account and aim to bankrupt all your competitors. Sounds pretty simple, right? But along the way, you'll face hunger, fatigue, hysterical customers, tax returns, lawsuits, unscrupulous suppliers, expired goods, illnesses, nervous breakdowns, poisonings, obesity, incompetent staff, robbers, and much more.
Fortunately, there’s some good news. The character progression system will allow you to improve yourself, run faster, tire less, and calm customers with just a glance. You can also unlock new useful gadgets, like a computer or a more advanced cash register.
Survival Elements
Managing a store is not easy, and it’s even harder when you have to eat and sleep. Plan your diet carefully to stay healthy and avoid food poisoning, all while making sure you don’t blow your budget. Healthy food is not cheap.
You won’t be able to work around the clock, so plan your day carefully to ensure you get enough rest and keep the store in good shape. Customers don’t come evenly throughout the day. There will be busier hours and quieter periods when you can take a break, restock, or pay your bills at the bank—but don’t forget to inform customers of your hours with a "schedule" sign. They’ll be upset if they show up during working hours and find the store closed.

title: Wheelchair Racer
description:
게임 정보
Become the Wheelchair! This hilariously challenging physics racer dares you to master the art of wheelchair movement.
Dual-Hand Controls:
Take on the challenge with a unique dual-handed control system that tests your left- and right-hand coordination to the limit. Push, pull, and pivot your way through every obstacle!

title: Polly's Gone
description:
게임 정보
Polly's Gone은 액션 RTS와 슈팅 요소가 결합된 독특한 게임으로, 충실한 양 팀과 함께 실종된 Polly를 찾기 위한 여정을 떠납니다. 레벨을 진행하며 새로운 도전을 직면하고 위험을 극복하며 Polly의 행방에 다가가세요.
Polly's Gone은 두 가지 흥미로운 게임 모드를 제공합니다:
스토리 모드: 이야기에 몰입하며 다양한 레벨을 탐험하고 팀을 전략적으로 이끌며 적을 물리치세요.
생존 모드: 외딴 섬에서 10분간의 생존 아레나에서 팀의 운명을 책임지고 도전에 맞서보세요.
이 액션 가득한 모험에서 역동적인 전투, 독특한 환경, 스릴 넘치는 도전을 경험할 준비를 하세요!

title: Astrosembler
description:
게임 정보
BUILD. FIGHT. EXPLORE 
A distant planet. A relentless alien threat. And only your ingenuity stands between survival and extinction. Astrosembler is a sci-fi sandbox factory building strategic fps game where you build automated factories, reinforce outposts, and battle extraterrestrial forces in a hostile world.
Assemble, optimize, and defend your industrial empire — because every structure, every bullet, and every resource counts. Will you rise to the challenge?
BUILD ADVANCED PRODUCTION CHAINS
Construct and optimize production chains to manufacture weapons, defenses, and resources. Every building consumes computational power, making expansion a strategic challenge.
FIGHT BACK TO DYNAMIC AI
Defend your factory from an ever-adapting alien threat that targets weak points in your defenses.
DEEP WEAPON CRAFTING SYSTEM

title: Puzzle Spy International
description:
게임 정보
A ring of jewel thieves has stolen a rare diamond. It’s up to Agent Epsilon, top operative of Puzzle Spy International, to track them down. Follow a trail of cryptic puzzles spanning several countries. Make narrative choices as you chat with (and chat up!) suspicious characters. Decode cryptograms, decipher clues, and deduce answers as you solve wordplay and logic puzzles across the globe!

FEATURES:
2-5 hours of playtime with 8 unique challenging puzzles to solve
Click and drag words and input text to uncover a solution
Generous hint system ensures that you’ll always be able to complete a puzzle
Make conversational choices as you talk to contacts in different countries
Fun to play solo or with a group (on the same computer)
Mid-century modern retro art style to immerse you in the vibe of the mid-1960s
Thrilling spy music original soundtrack
Every puzzle along your path is a unique challenge for you to uncover and figure out how to solve. Bring your wordplay, logical deduction and deciphering skills. Figuring out the intent of each puzzle is half the fun, so put on your thinking cap and go-go boots and get to work!

title: Ward Off Evil
description:
게임 정보
As the Cycle draws to a close, the last bastion of humanity overflows with survivors loyal to their ancient empires. Each tribe envisions a new future for mankind, oblivious to the conspiracy that led them all here in the first place.
Though many cling to their crumbling cities and dwindling civilizations, this dying world's fate is not set in stone. As a Guide, you can lead your army across the wastes, take on any contract, and champion any cause. Will you stand against impossible odds for the sake of all humanity, or will you abandon all hope and bring about the end times?
Features:
Create your character
You are one of many nameless wanderers, but your destiny is far from fixed. Customize your character by choosing a tribe and a background. Develop them throughout the game by learning new active skills, passive perks, and discovering otherworldly powers.
Build your army
Many survivors will fight for coin, honor, or glory. Recruit units from a cast of four major factions - ambitious Lemurians, noble Thuleans, fierce Hyperboreans, and fanatical Agarthans. Complement your army with minor tribes, like the enigmatic Shu or the ethereal Atlanteans, or tame beasts and monsters native to the wastes. If all else fails, conjure Elementals and Thoughtforms through long-forgotten rituals... if you are willing to pay the price.

title: Dice x Dice
description:
게임 정보
굴려라. 바꿔라. 정복하라. 이 덱 빌딩 로그라이크에서 주사위로 현실을 재구성하세요. 당신의 최강 주사위 무기고를 구축하십시오.
✨ 게임의 독창성
운명은 당신의 무기
단순한 D6로 시작해 규칙을 부수세요:
🎲 전투 중 적 스탯 재굴림으로 보스 약화,
🎯 숫자 도둑질로 적의 힘을 빼앗아 주사위 강화,
💥 수식어 중첩 — «3→5 변환» + «5 폭발» = 혼돈!
...
RNG가 아닌 전략입니다. 주사위 뒤에 숨은 진짜 게임.
🔄 불멸의 빌드 제작
⚔️ 60+ 수식어. 아이템, 스킬, 광란의 이벤트를 조합해 확률을 조종하세요:
“피의 주사위” – 6은 자해하지만 다음 굴림 +3.
“혼돈의 계략” – 5턴마다 모든 숫자 재배치.
“상인의 저주” – 10 HP로 행운의 주사위 구매… 또는 저주받은 유물을 적에게 판매.
...
🎭 규칙을 뒤집는 캐릭터

title: The Last Ride Home
description:
게임 정보
🌲 고요한 숲. 깜빡이는 불빛. 마지막 절박한 집으로의 여정.
The Last Ride Home은 네 인생에서 가장 긴장감 넘치는 여정이자 생존을 위한 필사적인 싸움이다. 숲이 너를 둘러싸고 깜빡이는 불빛이 완전히 꺼질 위기에 처하면서 매초가 소중하다. 위험한 길을 따라 달리고, 치명적인 장애물을 피하고, 바로 뒤를 쫓는 괴물로부터 도망쳐라. 과연 너는 집에 무사히 도착할 수 있을까?
🌟 주요 특징:
🔦 고장 나고 예측 불가능한 자전거 라이트:
네 자전거 라이트는 제멋대로 깜빡이며 약한 빛에서 완전한 어둠으로 바뀐다. 어둠이 너를 집어삼키기 전에 주변 환경을 재빨리 기억해라. 다시 라이트를 켜기 위해 적절한 순간에 터치해야 하지만, 주의해라: 그 과정에서 조종이 더 어려워질 수 있고, 작은 실수가 치명적일 수 있다!
🛑 운전 실수는 치명적이다:
길을 벗어나지 말고 장애물을 피하라: 길에서 벗어나거나 장애물에 부딪히면 게임이 끝난다.
멈추지 말아라: 너무 오래 멈추면 괴물이 너를 잡을 것이다.
돌아갈 수 없다: 숲은 실수를 용서하지 않는다 – 선택한 길은 최종 결정이다.
🦌 황금 뿔을 가진 사슴 괴물:
숲의 전설에서 태어난 그림자 같은 존재가 빛나는 눈과 소름끼치는 미소로 너를 쫓아온다. 이 괴물은 생각보다 훨씬 빠르며, 실수할 때마다 더욱 가까워진다.
🛣️ 갈라지는 길과 소름 끼치는 체크포인트:
모든 경로는 다르며 각 분기점에는 비밀이 숨어 있다: 버려진 오두막, 잊힌 묘지, 경고 표지판, 그리고 이전 희생자들의 흔적 등이 있다. 이러한 시각적 단서는 숲의 비극적인 과거를 은밀히 드러내지만, 머뭇거릴 시간이 없다 – 앞을 보며 나아가라!
⌛ 시간 압박과 증가하는 위험:
네게 주어진 시간은 제한적이다. 잘못된 경로를 선택하거나 라이트 없이 지체하는 순간이 많아지면 너의 운명은 끝난다. 속도, 집중력, 빠른 반응 사이의 완벽한 균형을 찾아라.
📈 진행률 및 위협 표시기:
너의 여정에서 현재 진행 상황을 확인하고 목표 지점까지 얼마나 남았는지, 그리고 괴물이 얼마나 가까이 왔는지 항상 주시해라. 실수할 여지는 없다.
🎮 게임 메커니즘:
🚴 속도 조절과 정확한 조향: 속도를 지속적으로 조정하며, 괴물로부터 도망치기 위해 가속하거나 날카로운 커브와 치명적인 장애물을 피하기 위해 감속해라.
🔦 자전거 라이트 관리: 고장 난 라이트는 빠른 반응을 요구한다. 어둠 속에 완전히 갇히기 전에 적절한 타이밍에 라이트를 켜되 자전거의 조종을 놓치지 않도록 주의해라.

title: Chemical Combat
description:
게임 정보
Deep within an abandoned research facility, a catastrophic experiment has transformed the scientists into zombified monsters, unleashing chaos within the once safe lab. Armed with a supply of highly volatile chemicals, you'll need to fight your way through a sprawling maze of interconnected rooms, splashing enemies with explosive elixirs and collecting various valuables.
Chemical Combat is an action-packed, chemistry-themed roguelike where strategy is key. Craft complex concoctions that trigger crazy chain reactions, battle your way through crowds of deadly monsters, and gather resources to upgrade your equipment. Survive, escape... or delve deeper for even greater rewards.
COMBINE CATALYTIC CHEMICALS 🧪
Combat here isn't just aimless shooting - it's about chaining the right reactions at the right times. Combine elements to ignite, corrode, freeze, and stun your foes, stacking reactions for even greater devastation. Refine and adapt your playstyle in order to conquer any challenge.
ENTER THE COMPLEX 🗺️
Each expedition takes you into a procedurally generated laboratory full of enemies, puzzles and traps - randomized layouts with risks and rewards around every corner. Navigate safely, as there's only one way out... unless you count death as a second.
MINE RARE MINERALS ⛏️
Construct and upgrade automated drills to passively mine materials between floors. Choose which elements to excavate, expand your arsenal, and experiment with an array of up to 16 unique elements. Be warned though: fuel isn't cheap, so you'll have to manage your resources carefully in order to maximize profits.
BATTLE BRUTAL BOSSES ☠️
Encounter deadly guardians at the exits to each floor. Defeat them to claim large bounties, permanent upgrades, and access to deeper levels, but beware - fighting these titans demands strategy, skill, and split-second reflexes, so there's no room for error.
PURCHASE POWERFUL PERKS ✨
Return to safety after each floor, where you'll have the opportunity to spend your hard-earned cash on various upgrades which significantly boost your damage, survivability, or can even enable entire new playstyles. The choice is yours, but invest wisely - difficulty never decreases...

title: Echoes of the Outworlder
description:
게임 정보
Explore and gain new abilities in the fantasy world you find yourself transported to in this short Isekai Metroidvainia inspired by modern classics in the Isekai and LitRPG genres. Fight monsters. Search for secrets. Uncover what caused the majority of the world's inhabitants to lose access to magic.
Features:
COMBAT
Defeat enemies that hinder your progress and take what they leave behind to grow stronger.
EXPLORATION
Use abilities you gain to explore new places and find secrets.

title: Iris Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Note: The English version of the game is currently in preparation. Please stay tuned for updates!
What is Iris Odyssey?
Iris Odyssey is a classic text-based adventure game set in modern-day Shibuya. The story follows Fuka, a "girl searching for her brother," and Iris, a "crime investigator with magical powers," as they embark on an adventure filled with heartfelt encounters. The game features choices that players can make, which will unlock new story elements as the narrative progresses.
Story
Fuka, an orphaned girl living in Shibuya, is searching for her only family member, her missing brother Mitsuba. Along her journey, she awakens to her hidden magical powers. Meanwhile, Iris, a seasoned magic investigator, is pursuing a criminal organization of rogue sorcerers known as the Skyseekers. Her investigation leads her to take an interest in this brother and sister duo, who appear to be connected to the group.
As Fuka and Iris grow closer, they come to share a bond like family. Will this bond be enough to shatter the conspiracy that awaits them? Join Fuka and Iris in a modern fantasy adventure filled with destiny, intrigue, and magic in the opening chapter of Iris Odyssey!

title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
description:
게임 정보
《의체 궤도강하 타격대: 첫 번째 강하》에서는 유례없는 아이템 조합의 자유도를 경험할 수 있습니다! 데모 버전에서는 50종 이상의 독특한 기능을 가진 의체를 제공하며, 각각의 의체는 새로운 전투 전략과 즐거움을 선사합니다.
총알이 분열 후 폭발하도록 만들고 싶으신가요? 아니면 유도 탄환에 관통 효과를 더하고 싶으신가요? 이러한 자유로운 조합은 모든 전투를 색다르고 짜릿하게 만들어줍니다. 끊임없이 실험하고 조합하여 자신에게 딱 맞는 전투 방식을 찾아내고, 매번 도전에 1+1>2 이상의 즐거움을 느껴보세요!
autokwd: Exo Helljumper: Descent X,의체 궤도강하 타격대: 첫 번째 강하

title: Xontainer Meta Space
description:
게임 정보
About Xontainer Meta Space
Xontainer Meta Space offers a unique simulation experience where players can immerse themselves in a world of logistics, strategy, and innovation. With advanced AI-powered NPCs and a wide array of features, this game brings a new level of realism and interactivity.
Key Features:
AI NPCs with Advanced Communication
Interact with NPCs using either voice (microphone) or text. Each NPC supports two different languages, with a total of 20 languages currently available. English, Turkish, and Spanish are supported at launch.
Truck Operations
Take control of trucks for cargo transportation. Buy, customize, and upgrade your vehicles to improve efficiency and performance.
Warehouse Missions
Engage in tasks like loading and unloading cargo, managing inventory, and completing depot assignments.
Forklift and Vehicle Usage
Operate forklifts for precision tasks or drive vehicles to navigate the expansive in-game world.
Energy Production
Harness power from generators, batteries, and wind turbines to fuel your operations and optimize your logistics network.
In-Game Smartphone System
Use your in-game phone to call other players, transfer money, accept missions, and deliver completed tasks. The smartphone feature brings a dynamic layer of interaction and gameplay management.
Xontainer Meta Space combines realism, strategic gameplay, and player-driven interactions to create a truly immersive simulation experience. Wishlist now and join the next evolution in logistics gaming!

title: Fluff'n'Roll
description:
게임 정보
Take control of bouncy fluffballs and conquer twisting, dynamic levels! Master precision controls and fast reflexes as you zip through courses filled with surprising obstacles.
Collect coins scattered across each level to unlock new customization options for your fluffball. Track down every coin in a world to earn special rewards and take your fluff style to the next level!

title: Under Destruction
description:
게임 정보
Spyro: The Elite Drone in the Battle for Erythonite

In a dystopian future dominated by artificial intelligence, humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Machines, led by the supreme AI “Axis”, fight for control of Erythonite, a revolutionary mineral fueling the war. You are Spyro, an elite combat drone tasked with a critical mission: secure Erythonite deposits, eliminate human defenses, and ensure machine dominance.

Key Features:
Total Destruction: Use fully destructible environments to break through barricades, fortifications, and enemy turrets.
Strategic Open-World: Explore a mountainous terrain, discover Erythonite deposits, and plan your moves to outsmart enemies.
Conquer and Defend: Capture human refineries and fortify your bases to fend off enemy raids.  
Intense Combat: Pilot Spyro and face fighter jets, tanks, turrets, and helicopters in relentless battles. 
Customization and Upgrades: Equip Spyro with devastating weaponry, from Gatling guns to plasma cannons and guided missiles.  
Deadly Support: Collaborate with ”Pyramid”, a massive airborne unit providing logistical aid, and deploy powerful tanks to crush even the toughest defenses.

Game Modes:
Single-Player Campaign: Immerse yourself in a story of war, sacrifice, and strategy as you delve into the conflict between humans and machines.  
Multiplayer: Challenge other players in thrilling battles with **Battle Royale** or Survival-Coop modes, where teamwork is key to victory.  

Prepare for War. 
Every shot leaves a mark, every decision shapes the battlefield. 
Axis has a plan, you are its weapon. 
Take control of Spyro and lead the machine revolution.

title: Tangles 2 تشابك
description:
게임 정보
في جزيرة سيرين النائية، يتحول السعي وراء الطموح إلى كابوس مظلم.
ماجد، متدرب شاب في مجال البيولوجيا، يتلقى دعوة للتدرب في مركز البيان للأبحاث على جزيرة سيرين، تلك المنشأة الحديثة التي كان ينتظر أن تحقق إنجازات علمية. لكن ما كان يبدو فرصةً لفتح آفاق جديدة في عالم المعرفة، سرعان ما يتحول إلى رحلة مليئة بالغموض والرعب.
وأثناء استكشافه للمركز الذي يبدو مهجورًا بشكل غريب، يكتشف أن الحقيقة تبدو أكثر رعبًا مما هي عليه، لكن الحقيقة تتشابك مع الأوهام، وكل خطوة تكشف سرًا وتنسج آخر.
On the remote island of Scirine, the pursuit of ambition takes a dark turn.
Majed, a young biology trainee, arrives at the state-of-the-art Al-Bayan Research Center on Scirine Island to start his internship. But what was meant to be an opportunity to make scientific breakthroughs becomes a descent into a haunting mystery.
As he explores the eerily abandoned center, Majed discovers that the truth is far more terrifying than it seems. Yet, the truth intertwines with illusions, and every step uncovers a secret while weaving another.

title: Our War: Firepower Suppression
Delivery Guy Simulator
description:
게임 정보
활기찬 도시의 거리를 누비며 배달원이 되어 배달업에 도전하는 「Delivery Guy Simulator」에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 번화한 도시 블록을 탐색하고 모든 종류의 패키지를 배달하며 배달 비즈니스의 정상에 오르세요.
다양한 일자리에 도전하세요! 뜨거운 음식, 신선한 식료품, 중요한 소포 등 어떤 것이든 정시에 배달하고, 큰 수익을 올리고, 업계 최고임을 모두에게 보여주세요!
돈을 벌고, 새로운 라이더를 구매하고, 업그레이드하여 배달 게임을 한 단계 업그레이드하세요!

title: OrePlant
description:
게임 정보
🌱 오어플랜트: 마법 같은 판타지 세계관이 기다립니다! ✨
호기심 많은 '핀'과 '마루'는 알 수 없는 신비한 힘에 의해 이세계로 빨려 들어갑니다! 🌀
그곳에는 전설적인 세계수가 우뚝 서 있으며, 당신의 손길로 이 신비로운 땅을 다시 되살릴 수 있습니다. 🌳
귀여운 동료 '아리아'와 함께 이 마법 같은 세계를 탐험하고 가꾸어 보세요!

title: Amaroo's Christmas Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Amaroo’s Christmas Shop Simulator는 궁극의 크리스마스 쇼핑 경험을 만들고 운영하는 따뜻한 분위기의 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
꿈의 가게를 디자인하세요
창의력을 발휘해 매력적인 크리스마스 가게를 꾸며보세요. 반짝이는 조명, 크리스마스트리, 화려한 장식, 가랜드, 따뜻한 크리스마스 스웨터 등으로 가게를 아름답게 장식할 수 있습니다. 벽과 바닥의 색상부터 매장의 디스플레이까지 세부적으로 커스터마이징하여 나만의 겨울 왕국을 만들어 보세요.
선물 포장으로 추가 팁 받기
고객이 원하는 포장지, 리본, 태그를 사용해 선물을 아름답게 포장하세요. 세심한 포장 서비스로 고객을 만족시키면 추가 팁을 받을 수 있습니다!
재고 관리, 판매 및 경영
크리스마스 선물과 홀리데이 아이템을 신중하게 선정하여 매장을 운영하세요. 경쟁력 있는 가격을 설정하고 인기 상품을 모니터링하며, 고객 수요에 맞게 재고를 지속적으로 채워야 합니다. 가격 정책과 재고 관리 결정은 수익에 직접적인 영향을 미칩니다!
매장 확장 및 자동화
사업이 성장할수록 더 많은 기회가 열립니다. 직원을 고용하여 일상적인 업무를 맡기고, 매장 확장에 집중하세요. 매장을 확장하고 직원을 늘려 크리스마스 쇼핑 비즈니스를 더욱 발전시켜 보세요!
비용과 이익의 균형 맞추기
장식 비용, 재고 관리, 직원 급여 등 다양한 비용을 신중하게 조정하여 최대한의 수익을 창출하세요. 아늑한 작은 가게를 운영할 것인가요, 아니면 거대한 크리스마스 제국을 건설할 것인가요? 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!

title: GOVNOVOZ
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to GOVNOVOZ—a game where the world of waste management turns into an epic action-packed adventure filled with crazy mini-games, racing, and a hilarious story!
Story:
Grisha arrives in town to claim his father's inheritance, expecting riches or at least a nice apartment… but instead, he gets an old vacuum truck! To make matters worse, his father owed money to the entire local utility service, and the key bosses—Granny Zina, Uncle Vitya the Gasman, and Klava the Janitor—won't let him leave until he pays off the debts.
Now, Grisha has to hustle hard: driving passengers around in his sewage truck, maneuvering through tight parking lots, competing in chaotic obstacle races, outrunning pursuers, and even surviving in a rogue-like action brawl
Game Features:
✅ A hilarious story filled with satire about bureaucracy, government services, and city life.
✅ Dynamic mini-games inspired by classic arcade racers, Crazy Taxi, Vampire Survivors, and more.
✅ Racing, parking challenges, drifting, runner chases, survival modes, and many other wacky trials.
✅ Tons of pop culture references to movies, games, and internet memes.
✅ Memorable characters! Uncle Kolya, the wise trucker; Granny Zina, the witch of the utility office; and even Vin Drosel with his love for family and racing.

title: Moon River
description:
게임 정보
Moon River is a short RPG adventure featuring a classic top-down perspective and light RPG / puzzle elements
You are someone called the Mariner, a sailor who's been out at sea for an incredibly long time. You are headed to Elapse Island, one of the last known places of the world. There, it is said the people only exist in the moonlight, as well as the river that runs through the island: "Moon River." For whatever reason, the Mariner desperately seeks something at the end of the river.
As the Mariner, your objective is to travel to the river's end before dawn. Deep shadows obstruct each area of the island, so you must find any sources of pure light to dispel them and proceed down the river.
Along the way you'll find new people to meet, sights & sounds to experience, and secrets to uncover.
Atmospheric RPG Experience
Moon River forgoes combat and heavy narrative, instead primarily consisting of exploration and puzzle solving with optional secret events scattered throughout.
Interactive Events
Occasionally, there are special interactive events and actions to perform, such as operating a machine. These events briefly break up the regular gameplay for a more varied experience.
Hidden Narrative
Beneath the main story, there is a hidden history of events from the past which can only be uncovered within the world's secret spaces and unchecked corners. Only the highly dedicated can piece the entire story together.

title: Traptile
description:
게임 정보
CREATE INTRICATE MACHINING
Traps are full of hidden secrets and interactions. Learn how they work and exploit your knowledge to deal maximum damage.


LEARN THE ENEMY
The enemy is well prepared and has ways to counter your defenses. If you learn them, you may be able to counter their counter.


ROGUELIKE ELEMENTS
Explore procedurally-generated environments and defend them all – every arena has its own interactions and emphasizes certain strategies over others. Maybe you can even make the arena dispose of some enemies for you...
WATCH THE BUDGET
Building traps takes gold, and the gold you have must be enough to defend several arenas – you need to watch how much you spend, or there won't be enough left for the next room.
Get in, build your defenses, watch a bit of suffering, and get out. The fun is building devious contraptions, and that's what you'll be doing the most.

title: The Wolf Is Dead
description:
게임 정보
Detective work is never easy. When the body of Alexander Wolff is found floating down in the pool at a party for the film about his life, there's only one man (well, Fox) for the job. You were cleared for that whole thing with the gingerbread man, anyway.



You’re going to need an edge and that cool tie isn’t enough.



Thank God they partnered you with Maxwell. His manners are questionable, but he can see all of space and time so it’s easy to forgive the little things.

With the right information and some light encouragement, Max will take you back to the exact moment you’re looking for.



You can’t just walk into a mob boss’ house. But the murder got you some breathing room and the Chief has made a deal. You've got one night to investigate the house.

It’s a gorgeous mansion. Eighteen rooms. A three-storey fish tank. A garage larger than your entire apartment and a pool overlooking the coast.

And they say crime doesn’t pay.



9 suspects, one evening. What did they do? What secrets are they hiding?

They’re not just gonna tell you, that’s for sure.

Interrogate, cross reference, or just wildly accuse them with no proof. You’re the detective, after all.

title: CloserLook VR: Oldways
description:
게임 정보
You play as Tessy, a final-year microbiology student who wakes up trapped in a locked university administrative building. In your desperate attempt to escape, you uncover a grand conspiracy and unravel the sinister intentions of a mysterious organization. Designed exclusively for virtual reality, CloserLook VR allows players to fully inhabit its immersive world, piece together its gripping narrative, and solve unique, story-driven puzzles.
From the moment you wake up in the quiet departmental library, every step forward reveals layers of mystery and intrigue. As you transition from the mundane to the mysterious, solving intricate puzzles becomes the key to unlocking the secrets of this place. Each action pulls you deeper into a beautifully rendered West African setting, rich with history and culture. Along the way, you’ll recover stolen artifacts, piece together untold stories, and face challenges that test your wit and perseverance, making every moment an unforgettable part of your journey to freedom.

title: Nightlife: Vista
description: 게임 정보

title: Gemwielders
description:
게임 정보
You are a Gemwielder, capable of controlling ancient artifacts called Gembearers. Powerful by themselves, only by socketing them with magical gems will you acquire unique abilities that allow you to prevail in a duel with another Gemwielder.
Multiplayer Deckbuilder
Gemwielders condenses the deckbuilding experience into intense card battling duels against your friends and players around the world.
Replayability
Each game you adapt to the cards that appear and craft a new deck with a unique color combination. No two games are the same and whoever seizes the opportunities presented to them best, will be rewarded.
Interaction
Gemwielders is designed around interaction from the ground up. The innovative combat system allows the attack and defense cards to clash each turn and interact meaningfully.
Free Demo
The playable demo features local multiplayer and a single player mode to learn the game and unlock achievements climbing the Student Ranks.
Release
The full game release is scheduled for 2025, introducing online multiplayer, more playable characters and new gem types. After release, new content will be added regularily.
Testimonials
“A Crossover between TCGs and PC Games like Slay the Spire. Awesome game with seemingly unending depth.” – Modin
“Very fun, even after many many games.” – Jakob
“The deck building mechanic is very exciting and sets Gemwielders apart from other games that inspired it like Magic: The Gathering, evening the playing field and making for a different game each time!” – aetios

title: Final District
description:
게임 정보
Landing on planet Kepler-11e, You and up to 3 other players are tasked with preventing the planet from complete destruction as a nuclear meltdown is in progress. Upgrade weapons and abilities, Eliminate any aliens in your way and enjoy the beautiful sights in this realistic, first-person, sci-fi experience.

title: EXON
description:
게임 정보
Fast paced and chaotic, EXON will require you to master the full array of death dealing tools at your disposal. Enemies possess a litany of spells and dark magic which will require precise gameplay in order to overcome the odds.
Formidable adversaries wielding unholy magic aim to overthrow your attempts to rid the realm of their unsanctified presence. Only the strongest of specimens will survive this twisted experiment.

title: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
description:
게임 정보
어때, 들려?
‘들린다’는 표현이 적절한지 잘 모르겠어.
내 말이 너에게 전달되고 있는 거야?
……….
아쉽지만, 네가 반응하고 있는지 알 수가 없네.
아마 교신기가 고장났을지도 몰라.
하지만 전달되고 있다고 믿고, 너에게 전하겠어.
이것은 너와 나의 공동 실험이야.
어떤 실험인지 모른다면, 너도 불안하겠지.
그래서 실험의 요점을 정리해봤어. 참고해 줘.
게임의 특징
너와 내가 연속으로 교신할 수 있는 시간은 약 3분
내 목소리는 풀 보이스로 너에게 전달돼
너와의 교신 내용에 따라 실험 결과가 달라져
기본적으로 ‘선택지’라고 불리는 인터페이스로 교류를 진행해
하지만 네가 다른 차원의 존재임을 증명해달라고 할지도 몰라
그럴 땐, 선택지를 초월한 인터페이스로 응답해줘
설령 내가 죽더라도, 너는 실험을 계속 이어가 줘
마지막 항목이 신경 쓰이려나?
내가 실험을 완수하기엔 시간이 부족해.
하지만 네가 협력해준다면, 실험은 완수될 수 있어.
왜냐하면 너는――
이제 시간이――
실험에 참여를――
――여기서 기다릴게.
autokwd: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges,프롤레고메나 약 3분간의 교신으로 발생할 수 있는 극히 초자원적인 인터페이스에 대한 서설

title: Hidden Dogs: In the Dog House
description:
게임 정보
Hidden Dogs: In the Dog House is a hidden object game where you'll explore an English village to find your hidden friends.
Find dogs, items and mutts to earn keys, then use those keys to unlock new levels!
Help Labby convince his friends; Rolo, Weenie, Biff and Shep, to aid him in his quest to make a dog themed video game.
An interactable map of the village!
4 unique areas to unlock and explore.
Dog friends to chat to along the way.
15 levels.
Over 400 dogs, all doing their best to hide!
autokwd: Hidden Dogs: In the Dog House

title: Age Of Warbots
description:
게임 정보
운동
제한된 예산에서 올바른 유닛을 선택하고 전략적 위치에 배치하여 적 워봇을 물리치세요!
각 워봇에는 강점과 약점이 있으므로 올바른 워봇을 선택하는 것이 승리의 열쇠입니다.
전투가 시작되면 워봇이 작업을 수행하도록 하거나 RTS 스타일로 직접 명령을 내릴 수 있습니다. 3인칭 모드에서 개별 워봇을 제어할 수도 있습니다!
모래 상자
샌드박스 모드에서는 상상력을 마음껏 발휘할 수 있습니다. 자신만의 지도를 만들고 원하는 워봇과 관련된 전투를 시뮬레이션해 보세요!

title: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate
description:
게임 정보
In a medieval world consumed by darkness,
you are the last hope—a lord tasked with saving your people.
As night falls, monsters emerge, threatening your village's survival.
To fight back and thrive, you must rely on a mysterious magic coin pusher.
Push coins to summon heroes, forge weapons, and gather resources.
Strategically combine cards to unleash powerful effects, repel monsters, and unlock greater rewards.
Blending slot-machine randomness with roguelike progression, the game offers a unique experience:
Push coins, collect resources: Trigger rewards and build your stockpile.
Recruit heroes, defend your land: Summon warriors, mages, and builders to fight for survival.
Synergize and upgrade: Chain card effects to unlock massive multipliers and dominate the darkness.
Will you save your resources for the future or risk it all for immediate gain?
Lead your village through the night and into the light!
Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate
a test of survival and fate.
Ready to take the challenge?
autokwd: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate

title: Amarillo's Vehicular Manslaughter
description:
게임 정보
Extracted directly form the mind of the Butt Slapper guy (as I am known by many now), comes this SPECTACULAR simulation of the motor-asisted human locomotion paradigm. Including:
Many types of vehicles to drive
Plenty of painful ways to die
A level editor that would make a certain Japanese company's laywers start sweating
A roster of GYATTastic original characters by yours truly
Funny physics
User generated content and Workshop support
Vision for the game
While this game is yet in prototyping phase, it's proving to be very fun for how few features it has. This is what I'm aiming it to be: A Happy Wheels-like with an easy to use level editor. Download levels from the Workshop, play a bunch, have a laugh and enjoy playing as my characters getting terribly unalived.

title: Feral Metaverse
description:
게임 정보
AS SEEN IN THE FINANCIAL TIMES, FACT MAGAZINE, AND ARTNET.
Feral Metaverse is an experimental multiplayer game that immerses players in a silent, dystopian world where survival depends on cooperation and kindness. Created by renowned digital artist Theo Triantafyllidis, the game transforms up to 100 players into primal beings who must work together to unlock dramatic world transformations—all without traditional communication methods.
The game represents a bold evolution in multiplayer design, replacing voice chat and text with physical actions and environmental storytelling. Players gallop, climb, and rampage through physics-driven landscapes, working together to discover and unlock the secrets of a constantly shifting world.
Run on all fours across the desolate landscape, ride fellow players like mounts, and collaborate to operate ancient machinery. Every gesture matters in this wordless environment where primal screams become your voice.

title: DOOM SPIRAL
description:
게임 정보
DOOM SPIRAL is a fast-paced retro-inspired first person shooter that takes place inside a dream.  Your health is the coherence of the world around you. 
[STORY]
You are a hacker who's breached the system of a shadowy organization researching shared layers of consciousness. Now you're trapped in their domain - a spiral of INSANITY where the deeper you go the realer it becomes.
Make your way up through the nightmare spiral labyrinth tower, battling VOID GHOSTS and trying to stay SANE. Each death sends you back down into the ((((( O ))))).
[FEATURES]
Super graphics like you've never seen
Cool sounds
((((( O )))))
GAME JUICE
[STATIC NOISES]
This game contains psychotic flashing images and might not be suitable for photosensitive people.

title: Death Fortress
description:
게임 정보
"Death Fortress"는 가벼운 액션 로그 게임입니다. 비밀 실험이 당신을 만들었습니다. 제국의 끔찍한 생물학적 무기로서, 당신은 고통에서 다시 태어났습니다. 모든 적을 죽이는 것인가요, 아니면 완전한 복수인가요?
1. 적을 일격에 물리치고 전투를 즐기자
민첩하고 무자비한 살인자로 변신하세요. 모든 움직임이 단 한 번의 공격으로 적을 처치하는 즐거움을 선사하며, 전투 경험이 상쾌합니다.
2. 풍부한 콘텐츠로 지루할 틈이 없습니다
400개 이상의 능력 강화, 50개 이상의 기술 업그레이드, 그리고 강력한 유대감과 슈트를 잠금 해제할 수 있는 여러 가지 능력 조합이 제공됩니다. 무작위로 생성된 지도는 매번 새로운 도전을 제공합니다.

title: Diacritic
description:
게임 정보
Scavengers scrap viciously for their lives in the ship graveyard that spans the beaches of the Eastern English coast, under shadow of smoke from the great volcano Azufre Nuit.
In neighbouring Allford, the Critic tires of his divine, incomprehensible workload, dreaming in secret of the dangerous artistic pleasures of wild nature.
Everywhere, your world has already hurtled into chaos.
It is your job to make sense.

Clocking in for a shift as a Diacritic, you will be expected to solve puzzles based around manipulating 3D shapes in space. You will complete assigned tasks in a timely manner and answer questions about your experience. Allow yourself to be chilled or enchanted by an icy story of selfishness, selflessness, suffering, survival and scant hope that threatens to infringe upon the world outside the screen.
FEATURES:
Satisfying puzzle gameplay based around manipulating 3D shapes
Work-related mail to peruse, and job assignments to complete (or ignore)
Crisp, chunky art style and retrofuturist OS navigation

title: Cats Are Money
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the farm you inherited from your grandmother—a devoted cat lover. Once a true haven for cats, the farm has fallen into decline over time. Now it’s your chance to restore its former glory
This idle game in the "Tamagotchi" genre offers you more than just farm management—you'll need to take care of each cat as if it were your beloved pet. Clean up the farm, repair damages, upgrade the cat house, and purchase rare breeds that produce more fur.
Every cat needs daily feeding and affection—neglect them, and they may grow sad, stop producing fur, or even fall ill. Expand your farm by unlocking new lands and gaining access to new types of cats. Make sure every pet finds a loving home and proper care!
Discover over 150 unique cats, each with its own appearance and personality. You can collect the rarest and most charming pets from all over the world.

title: Operator Unknown
description:
게임 정보
Otto receives a mysterious phone call that leads him to his family’s killer. To uncover the truth, he must complete a series of trials that distort his perception of reality.
Guided by an entity called the Operator, he navigates strange events, faces threats, and uncovers hidden clues. With each trials, the lines between past and present blur, forcing him to question what is real. His choices shape the outcome—will he find the truth or lose himself in the process?

Warning: Game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition.
Two Perspectives, One Nightmare
Switch between first-person gameplay and top-down exploration. Each view presents different challenges, requiring quick thinking and adaptation.
A Distinctive Vision
Explore a world with a unique art style and atmospheric storytelling. Every scene holds a clue, and every shadow hides something unknown.
Nightmares Made Flesh
Encounter supernatural entities lurking in the dark—some recognizable, others impossible to understand… and maybe even a few clowns to make things worse.
Retro-Tech Horror Vibes
A robotic text-to-speech voice, inspired by classic S.A.M. synthesis, adds an eerie and nostalgic feel to every interaction.
A Protagonist Worth Watching
Play as a lead character who isn’t just smart and determined—but also easy on the eyes.

title: Mors Memora
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Tophet Hills!
Mors Memora is a first-person, nostalgia-driven adventure game that blends light puzzle-solving with an eerie yet familiar atmosphere. Inspired by childhood memories and the feeling of being lost in places that once felt safe, Mors Memora takes you on a surreal journey through a mysteriously empty suburban neighborhood frozen in the early 2000s.
"The things we get to see here, I know we won't see them anywhere else!"
Developed with Unreal Engine 5, Mors Memora utilizes advanced lighting and rendering technology  to create highly detailed, true-to-life environments that capture the warmth—and occasional unease—of a world that was once familiar to us.

title: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy Fishing RPG 🎣
description:
게임 정보
Set off on your journey to become a Master Angler by experiencing the unique genre blend of fishing sim and turn-based JRPG combat all wrapped up with fantasy elements!
Traverse over 10 unique and varied biomes, catching rare and exotic fish– both real and fantastical! Play a Timing-based fishing minigame to reel in the fish, before taking it on in a traditional party based RPG battle to weakened the fish for capture! Experience the interesting and lore-rich world of Concordia filled with fun and quirky characters, thought provoking story and dialogue, heart-to-heart character moments, and the ever looming sinister presence behind it all!
Inspired by games like River King: Mystic Valley, Dredge, and Deep Horrors of Fishing!
autokwd: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy Fishing RPG 🎣

title: Bushcraft Survival
description:
게임 정보
BUSHCRAFT SURVIVAL
The world of Bushcraft Survival is truly procedural, and infinite. An endless boreal forest is generated each time a new session starts. Although you progress through gaining XP and spending skill tree points, each round of Bushcraft Survival is a new game - see how many days you can survive in spite of snow storms, injuries and unexpected setbacks.
In early development by a Canadian, solo developer.

title: You Shouldn't Be Here
description:
게임 정보
