You Shouldn't Be Here is a short psychedelic visual novel that takes place in a strange world filled with harrowing creatures. You’ll meet Dimitriv who is willing to keep you safe as long as you help him with something. 
The story touches on topics such as mental health, exclusion, and various other existential questions.
The gritty pixel-art, together with the somewhat erratic and despairing soundtrack, intends to create a dreamlike, bordering on nightmarish, atmosphere.
In the shape of the infinite, I am one.
Swallowed by an ocean of bliss.
No choices to be made,
no stories to unfold,
no riddles to solve.

title: Twinspell
description:
게임 정보
Twinspell is a cooperative roguelike dungeon crawler where players control two characters on an epic journey through alternate dimensions. Together, they must explore procedurally generated dungeons and face powerful enemies.
With fast-paced, strategic action gameplay, players must balance exploration, combat, and collecting passive relics to strengthen their abilities. Each victory grants experience and new progression options, while each defeat is a chance to learn from mistakes and try again in a completely new dungeon. Prepare for unique challenges each time you play, where cooperation between characters is the key to survival.

title: oGANTTo
description:
게임 정보
oGANNTo is a deck-building game based on planning. The focus of this game is to develop balance and generate the highest revenue.

Analyse the plan
Analyze the supplychain and decide which resources and techniques will produce the best results.

Set the course
Information, material and cost flows are factors that must be managed.

Utilise Employees
Specialist or Workforce are resources. They must be used efficiently.
They increase the overall goal or cause the task to fail.
Learn Techniks
Common economic methods such as overtime, extra shifts, milestones, and customer visits are used. They all contribute to the result.

Leadership Styles and Progressive Challenge
Different campaigns are run with increasing difficulty.
There are multiple methods for achieving victory.
make an attempt with
Management by Results.
Management by Objective.
Management by Motivation.
and more.
The project is currently in development.
Hi, thanks for your interest in my new game. I'm currently putting it together.
I'm always happy when someone adds my product to their wish list.
I'll keep you updated on the latest developments.
Until then,
Velemir

title: Punch to Glory
description:
게임 정보


Game Features:

2D Cartoonish Graphics: Colorful visuals for a nostalgic boxing experience.

Card Mechanics: Build your strategy with various cards that define your fighter's style.

Turn-Based Combat: Outsmart your opponents using tactics and strategy.

Upgradeable Stats and Cards: Enhance your character and cards for more effective battles.

Engaging Story: Immerse yourself in a captivating storyline.

Start your journey as a boxer from the ground up, fighting your way to glory. Develop your character, collect fight cards, and face the challenges life throws your way. Train hard, manage stress, and give everything you've got to turn your championship dreams into reality. Every victory brings you one step closer to the top. Are you ready ?

title: Typing Fury: Around the World
description:
게임 정보
Three different game modes
Normal, Scrambled, and Trivia
Scrambled and Trivia modes offer hints to help you if you get stuck
Each mode can be played as a 15- or 30-second challenge
Fully customizable games
Choose country names or capitals
Select one or more of 6 different continents
There are over 200 countries and territories with their own flags
Choose if you want to view maps, flags or why not both
Want more challenge? Enable case-sensitive
Detailed statistics
Track every keystroke with precision
High score lists
Steam achievements
And more..

title: Tattoo Removal Simulator
description:
게임 정보
In Tattoo Removal Simulator, you take on the role of a skilled tattoo removal specialist. title: As Long As You're Here
description:
게임 정보
An emotional family drama seen through the eyes of a woman with Alzheimer's disease. Annie and her family cope with reversed caretaking roles when she moves from her long-time home. As she unpacks her life, memories of her deceased brother and homes from her past bleed into the present.
You are Annie, an elderly woman whose memory is starting to betray her. As your children clash over how to care for you, old memories of your long-dead brother start to emerge.
As Long As You're Here is a subtle reflection of what life with dementia might look like, and a story about regret, being in transit, and the complex relationships between siblings.
As Long As You're Here is a short and personal experience made with care by a small team of developers.
The aim is to create a mature and nuanced experience that shows the difficult repercussions of losing not only your memory, but also your agency and sense of time and place.
What disappears when we forget?
... and what resurfaces?

Something really wrong is going on here, and YOU are the only one strong enough to infiltrate the city and investigate.

title: Niraya of ■■
description:
게임 정보
"Niraya of ■■"
"Niraya of ■■" is a Japanese horror game inspired by the Buddhist beliefs of the Kamakura period. The game focuses on a unique system where players "avoid" the attacks of various monsters, rather than defeating or hiding from them. This, combined with the fear of exploring eerie environments and solving puzzles, is a major draw of the game.
A Unique Gameplay Experience of Dodging
"Niraya of ■■" emphasizes "dodging" instead of the typical actions of "repelling," "hiding," or "fighting" found in major horror games. Players control a young child, managing limited stamina and using their surroundings to evade monster attacks. While being pursued by supernatural creatures, players will experience the thrill of finding ways to survive through trial and error.
The Fear of Exploring an Unknown World
In this game, the protagonist is cast into a mysterious realm unknown to the modern world and must attempt to escape. Players will guide the protagonist through unknown areas, solving hidden puzzles to progress. 싱글 플레이 캠페인에서 강렬한 액션을 경험하세요.
다양한 허구의 공상 과학 영감을 받은 무기를 사용하세요.
아이언 피스트의 힘을 활용하여 적들을 물리치며 강렬한 1인칭 전투를 펼치세요.

Build your team of creepy crawlies
From the humble cricket to the rare and enigmatic orchid mantis, a whole array of creepy crawlies awaits you to be collected and employed in fierce combat. Build your team to challenge other trainers and complete your research journal for the old entomology professor. Use special lures and traps to find special bugs that don't ordinarily show themselves. Can you catalog all rare bugs that lurk in the forest?

Can you build up your team of highly specialized attackers to beat the best trainers spider town has to offer?

Spider town offers plenty of areas to explore and stories to experience. Complete quests for the villagers, collect special items to unlock new areas and complete puzzles and find those bugs by any means necessary! It is said that Spider Town hides a dark secret. Join local kids in the bug club and embark on a wild adventure.

You've been told to explore the house of the missing CEO of PUPPETEERS Playplace, James Anderson. But when you step in to what used to be his house, you realize it is not what you signed up for.

title: Faraway
description:
게임 정보
"I am a shooting star! A spark meant to shine and vanish in a blink. But I will travel! I will mark my trail in every firmament. I will live to see the universe." Faraway is an immersive, both challenging and chill, procedurally generated audiovisual experience about creating constellations.
Faraway is a single player game, where you control a shooting star who is constantly in the process of vanishing, but keeping itself alive by harvesting energy from the stars, by creating constellations. Players have to tame the smooth, flowing controls of swinging and slingshotting around stars, while weaving an energy string and connecting it to stars.
Faraway has a randomly generated core mode, and 16 puzzle stages.
In the core mode, every game stars from scratch with a new world that procedurally generates itself in realtime based on the player’s performance, allowing experienced players to catapult themselves quickly to higher scores and higher levels of difficulty. Players have complete freedom on how to shape their constellations, but certain moves - like making loops - yield extra energy and points.
The 16 puzzle stages present new ways to think about the game mechanics and get better at the core mode.
Created single handedly by Steph Thirion, game designer, creative coder and musician, with all visuals being fully generated from scratch in realtime, Faraway is an elegantly minimal-yet-deep game, wrapped in an audiovisual experience that will have players return to it for a long time.

어느 날 갑자기 ADRIFT의 세상으로 들어와, 운전대를 잡게 된 당신의 목표는 오직 하나. 에너지 코어를 운반하는 것입니다. 이유도 목적지도 방법도 알 수 없는 상황에서, 당신의 머릿속에서는 온갖 의문이 요동칠 뿐이죠.
사막을 질주하는 트럭
오프로드 트럭의 시동을 걸고, 굽이진 계곡을 따라 움직이세요. 모래 언덕에서는 속도를 올리고, 험난한 평원에서 기다리는 난관을 핸드브레이크로 돌파하며, 세월의 풍파에 휩쓸린 세상 속을 질주하세요.

분과 초를 다투는 상황에서도 침착하게 주변을 탐색하고 경로를 계획한 뒤, 다음 오아시스로 돌진하세요. 하지만 신비한 에너지 코어가 사막의 열기 속에 방치된 채로 매초가 흐를 때마다, 당신의 운명도 끝을 향해 조금씩 달려간다는 것을 잊어서는 안 됩니다.
끝없는 여정 속으로
오랫동안 잊힌 사막의 고요함 속에서 과거의 사건을 밝혀내세요. 지름길을 개척하고, 나만의 경로를 설계하여, 베이퍼웨이브 스타일로 창조된 탑뷰 세계 속을 자유롭게 누비세요!

A high-speed physics-based speedrunning FPS inspired by 90's movement shooters and platformers. Move like you've never moved before.
Master gravity-defying physics-based movement with wall riding, loops, and more
Explore the last city of Terragrad in a sprawling hub with events and challenges at every turn
Race through varied stages with flexible level design, letting you find the fastest route on your own terms
Hunt for challenging medals requiring skill and planning to earn, then take to the leaderboards and challenge the fastest players in the world (or just your friends!)
Hit Mach 1 on the ground

title: The Vast White
description:
게임 정보
Explore The Vast White at your own pace
Embark on a solitary snowboarding journey down a vast, untamed mountain where every run is unique. The Vast White blends exploration, storytelling, and the thrill of the descent into a seamless open-world adventure. With only your board and your instincts, carve through pristine alpine wilderness, uncover hidden trails, and unravel the secrets buried beneath the snow.
🏔️ An Open Mountain to Conquer
Ride at your own pace through sprawling peaks, frozen forests, and secluded valleys—every path you choose reveals new wonders and challenges.
❄️ Uncover the Mountain’s Mysteries
Explore every corner of the mountain to find hidden routes, and stunning landscapes that reveal the mountain's past.

title: As Long As You're Here
description:
게임 정보
An emotional family drama seen through the eyes of a woman with Alzheimer's disease. Annie and her family cope with reversed caretaking roles when she moves from her long-time home. As she unpacks her life, memories of her deceased brother and homes from her past bleed into the present.
You are Annie, an elderly woman whose memory is starting to betray her. As your children clash over how to care for you, old memories of your long-dead brother start to emerge.
As Long As You're Here is a subtle reflection of what life with dementia might look like, and a story about regret, being in transit, and the complex relationships between siblings.
As Long As You're Here is a short and personal experience made with care by a small team of developers.
The aim is to create a mature and nuanced experience that shows the difficult repercussions of losing not only your memory, but also your agency and sense of time and place.
What disappears when we forget?
... and what resurfaces?

title: Sugar OVERDRIVE
description:
게임 정보
Sugar OVERDRIVE is a fast-paced melee game that takes elements from Shooters like Doom, and mixes them with the weapons and crazy combos of Character Action Games like Devil May Cry or Bayonetta.
Candy City is now the only place allowed to produce candies and sugar products, and the inhabitants of the city are slowly transforming into sugar creatures.
Something really wrong is going on here, and YOU are the only one strong enough to infiltrate the city and investigate.
...But you don't really care. All you want is to raid the city, get to the candy factory and have all the sugar for yourself. Because why bother with anything else?
COMBO OR DIE: The only way to heal is to combo your enemies into candy. The longer the combo, the more you can heal!
MASTER YOUR ARSENAL: From lightning hammers to scythes, there are many weapons to master and use in combos.
BECOME A MOVEMENT PRO: From sliding, to dashing, to kick-jumping. The movement in Sugar OVERDRIVE is expressive and deep, and you will need it to survive.
CONTROL THE FLOW OF BATTLE: Parry your enemies, throw them into deadly chocolate or explode them all with one grenade. Sugar is food to be toyed with.
CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD: Show everyone that you are the best with the infinite arena mode, where your skills are the only thing that can stop you.
SUGAR OVERDRIVE: Enemies drop sugar when they die, and the more stylish you play, the more sugar they will drop. Use sugar to unleash unique weapon abilities, or your ultimate SUGAR OVERDRIVE ability.

title: DEATH PLUNDER-亡命掠夺者
description:
게임 정보
Customize your character:
Choose your character's background, choose your talent, assign attribute points, build your character's advantage, is a hundred steps through the sharpshooter, or the mighty strongman, or the swift raider, everything is up to you.
Arm your character:
Rich equipment system, each piece of equipment has visual changes, and has different parts of the protective effect, please do a good job of protection, to meet the deadly attack of zombies.

title: Ecliptic
description:
게임 정보
✦ A Story in the Stars ✦
Play as ???, a mysterious character who wakes to an unfamiliar world with too many questions, and not enough answers. Meet the residents of the Orrery, uncover their stories, and figure out what ???'s got to do with any of it.
✦ Features ✦

title: Niraya of ■■
description:
게임 정보
"Niraya of ■■"
"Niraya of ■■" is a Japanese horror game inspired by the Buddhist beliefs of the Kamakura period. The game focuses on a unique system where players "avoid" the attacks of various monsters, rather than defeating or hiding from them. This, combined with the fear of exploring eerie environments and solving puzzles, is a major draw of the game.
A Unique Gameplay Experience of Dodging
"Niraya of ■■" emphasizes "dodging" instead of the typical actions of "repelling," "hiding," or "fighting" found in major horror games. Players control a young child, managing limited stamina and using their surroundings to evade monster attacks. While being pursued by supernatural creatures, players will experience the thrill of finding ways to survive through trial and error.
The Fear of Exploring an Unknown World
In this game, the protagonist is cast into a mysterious realm unknown to the modern world and must attempt to escape. Players will guide the protagonist through unknown areas, solving hidden puzzles to progress. However, as mentioned, the exploration is filled with terrifying experiences, including strange phenomena and sudden monster attacks.

title: Savage Gears
description:
게임 정보
Savage Gears는 2000년대 초반의 목표 지향적인 액션 게임에서 영감을 받은 폭력적인 싱글 플레이 FPS입니다.아이언 피스트와 파괴적인 무기 무기고 을 갖춘 당신은 두려움 없는 군인 Ero Lei'Bourne로 플레이하며, 대륙을 멸망의 위기에서 구하기 위한 위험한 임무를 수행합니다.
스토리
대체 역사인 동아프리카를 배경으로, 당신은 Ero Lei'Bourne의 여정을 따라가며 군비 경쟁 음모를 저지하기 위한 특수부대 작전에 참여하게 됩니다... 아니면 죽음을 맞이할 수도 있습니다.
특징
싱글 플레이 캠페인에서 강렬한 액션을 경험하세요.
다양한 허구의 공상 과학 영감을 받은 무기를 사용하세요.
아이언 피스트의 힘을 활용하여 적들을 물리치며 강렬한 1인칭 전투를 펼치세요.
끊임없이 몰려오는 용병, 드론, 실험적 돌연변이 병사들과의 역동적인 전투를 벌이세요.
포트 스페크에서 기차 레벨, 숲 환경 등 다양한 환경을 탐험하세요.

title: LAUNDRY / ランドリー
description:
게임 정보
Note: This game is still in development, and content may change.
LAUNDRY is a Heisei retro-style 3D horror adventure.
Story
In the 1990s, there was a laundromat in a certain town in Japan. This laundromat had been temporarily closed due to the disappearance of its previous owner, but it is now reopening. The protagonist, Hitomi, visits this laundromat and gradually gets involved in eerie events.

Game System
Fixed Camera + Tank Controls
Players control Hitomi from a third-person perspective using a fixed camera with various angles.





Players guide Hitomi as she enters the laundromat and does her laundry. Through this routine, the background of the laundromat and Hitomi gradually becomes clear, transitioning the game from ordinary to extraordinary.





By playing the cassette tapes obtained, players can transition into flashback scenes to learn about past events.
Each cassette contains unique music and audio, each with its own distinctive emotion.

title: Blood Punk
description:
게임 정보


Blood Punk is a hyper violent fast-paced retro FPS where you must exchange your health for bullets.

Eviscerate giant abominations with the blood of an angel using deadly weapons in a dark fantasy comic book world.



The world was in balance, but the greed of a monarch led him down a treacherous path.
He ensnared an angel and exchanged it's divine ichor with his own mortal blood.

The balance was broken and the world fell into desolation.

Now it is up to Numa, scion of the deluded monarch, with celestial blood coursing through her veins, to restore the balance.

title: Bugboy
description:
게임 정보
Summer has finally come and it is time to start your internship with the entomology professor. In the mysterious settlement called 'Spider Town' we don't just research insects, we catch, train and battle them so we can become to best creature-collector around!
Build your team of creepy crawlies
From the humble cricket to the rare and enigmatic orchid mantis, a whole array of creepy crawlies awaits you to be collected and employed in fierce combat. Build your team to challenge other trainers and complete your research journal for the old entomology professor. Use special lures and traps to find special bugs that don't ordinarily show themselves. Can you catalog all rare bugs that lurk in the forest?
Train Your Bugs In Battle
Bugboy features a unique semi-active battle system, engage your battle bugs and let them loose on a variety of insects for glory and a chance to capture them. Level them up to increase your stats to gain the upper hand in battle. Equip your critters with special items to imbue them with special abilities and new attacks. Can you build up your team of highly specialized attackers to beat the best trainers spider town has to offer?
Uncover the secrets of spider town
Spider town offers plenty of areas to explore and stories to experience. Complete quests for the villagers, collect special items to unlock new areas and complete puzzles and find those bugs by any means necessary! It is said that Spider Town hides a dark secret. Join local kids in the bug club and embark on a wild adventure.

title: Baking Bad
description:
게임 정보
In Baking Bad you and your friends are criminals diagnosed with an extreme medical condition. In order to ward its effects, constant doctors visits need to be made but the medical bills aren't cheap.
Cook
Cook baked goods in the back of your RV with a large amount of recipes. Discover new recipes and master the product quality to maximize profits.
Sell
Distribute or sell your baked good either locally or through a dealer, just be careful of a deal going wrong.
Evade
Stay one step ahead of the relentless police force. They are determined to shut you down and will stop at nothing to catch you. Engage in intense combat or use your wits to outsmart and outrun them.

title: ENTWINE
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a rich narrative, with meticulously detailed environments, horrific monsters, intricate, challenging puzzles and slow-burn psychological horror inspired by the classics. 
GAMEPLAY
Play as Lucas Hale, a retired police officer, as you find yourself picking up a paranormal investigation job. You've been told to explore the house of the missing CEO of PUPPETEERS Playplace, James Anderson. But when you step in to what used to be his house, you realize it is not what you signed up for.
A fresh take on psychological horror. Forget a fetch quest filled P.T. clone. ENTWINE will keep you on the edge of your seat throughout your entire playthrough.
Solve various puzzles, explore through a forest, house, underground complex, police station and more. Slowly uncover the heartwrenching story behind Lucas Hale and dive deeper into the abandoned estate before being hunted down by the puppet himself.

title: Hell Hell - ヘルヘル
description: 게임 정보

title: VISK
description:
게임 정보




1~2인용 온라인 협동 호러 게임인 VISK의 암울한 세계로 들어가 보세요.
여러분과 친구는 황량한 마을로 보내집니다.
이곳의 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내고 주변을 조심스럽게 탐험하세요.
결국, 당신은 혼자가 아닐지도 모릅니다...
친구와 함께 또는 싱글 플레이어로 플레이
2인 온라인 협동 모드
친구와 함께 플레이하고 협력하여 진행하세요.
워키토키와 근접 음성 채팅을 사용하여 함께 작업하세요.
싱글 플레이어 모드
이 음산한 경험에 혼자 들어가 보세요.
아무도 당신을 도와주지 않을 것입니다.


누가 당신을 여기로 보냈나요? 이 마을은 어떻게 된 거죠? 정말 혼자입니까?
독특한 환경을 탐험하며 답을 찾아보세요.


퍼즐을 풀고, 주요 아이템을 검색하고, 환경과 상호작용하여 새로운 장소로 이동하세요.
전생의 유물을 검색하고 이곳에서 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아보세요.

title: Noga
description:
게임 정보
Noga is my third game as a solo indie developer. It's a single-player story-based game in first-person, with shooting and driving mechanics.
You are the sole survivor of an alien attack on a military outpost where your friend was kidnapped.
Embark on a long and dangerous journey to try to save him and yourself in a world that has suddenly turned upside down and become a death trap.
As the story unfold you will discover the truth behind the alien invasion and the forces involved in it.
The story progresses in a world infested with aliens of various types, spaceships, mercenaries and people hiding and trying to survive.
You must fight for your life and the lives of the companions you have collected along the way, upgrade your weapons and vehicles, learn new skills, and investigate the events that led to the invasion.
The game takes place in Israel and goes through different places from the snowy north to desert south.
Main features:

title: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
description:
게임 정보

On a cold, barren isle somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago, a man wakes up without any memories of where he is, what happened to him, or who he is.
A cellphone gives off a flashing green light, revealing itself in the snow close to him. It will become vital when gathering his past memories, figuring out what is going on, and making decisions on what he must do.
Gameplay
The M/S Cornelia II incident is a mystery point-and-click adventure game in a contemporary setting.
The gameplay consists of regular elements of adventure gaming, such as exploring surroundings and using/combining items.
An original aspect of the game is collecting memory fragments and clues in your surroundings to help puzzle together your past in a room set in your mind.

title: Psychotic Bathtub
description:
게임 정보
FEATURES
Argue with Rubber Duck
Drown Jesus
Drink Wine
Drink Poison
Drink Blood
Flood Bathroom
Chat with Death
Find Your Very Own Ending
WHAT’S PSYCHOTIC BATHTUB?
Sit in your bathtub and experience your very own psychotic episode. Interact with the environment and find a way out of the really scary parts of your mind. 
50% OF PSYCHOTIC’S FINAL PROFIT WILL BE DONATED
Psychotic Bathtub shows a fictional disorder that follows psychotic symptoms. Psychotic is intended to destigmatize mental health disorders and to make them accessible. 50% of it’s final profit will be donated to mental health related projects.

title: Little Cheese Works
description:
게임 정보
Get the cheese back to the goal within the time limit!
Work together with 2 to 4 people to clear the game.
This game includes voice chat function!
Cat will wake up if it hears footsteps or voice chat!
If a cat found me, it would be terrible...

title: Spite スプライト
description:
게임 정보
■What is "SP(L/R)ITE"?
"SP(L/R) ITE" is an adventure game in which you aim to escape from a room floating in a different space.
Solve the riddles in each room in cooperation with your neighbor who can only speak through the walls and a vivacious goddess.
The view after opening the last door depends on your choice.

■The story reveals the background along with the mystery
When Pal awoke, he had a strange sensation.
A familiar ceiling, a familiar room scene, but no smell.
He was puzzled, then a talking-stone statue appeared in front of him.
"Akrida, the goddess of destiny" she saids.

Pal is forced to kill each other by this self-proclaimed goddess of fate.
His opponent is a faceless neighbor who lives across the wall, Jean.
The first person to escape from the locked room will survive.
This was supposed to be a death game.

Jean, the neighbor, does not trust Akrida and asks Pal to escape from the room with him.
Even though hear that, Akrida agrees to help without hesitation.
She said she can do anything if they want out of the room.

Interacting with Jean, and sometimes guided by Akrida, Pal eventually recovers the truth he has lost.

■Truth and Choice
The setting of "SP(L/R)ITE" is a secret room in ruins.
The "threads of fate" spun by Acreda unexpectedly intertwine to create an isolated and different space.
In order to advance to the next room, players must collect items and complete a painting that will be the key to escape.
Pal the player receive hints from Jean and Akrida, and collect items scattered around the room to complete the picture.

Completing the painting advances Jean and Pal's story and brings it to its conclusion.
The ending scenery is left to your choice.

"SP(L/R)ITE" is a short ADV project developed by Tricore, an indie game development company based in Fukuoka, Japan.

title: Beyond R: Rule Ripper
description:
게임 정보


Trapped in an Evolving Death Game, he chooses to rebel

You awaken in a mysterious luxury bar, the Golden Jack, alongside nine strangers, and are forced to play a game by The Owner. Each player represents one of the game's rules. You can disobey your own rule, and that rule will disappear if you die. Only three players can survive...unless you find another way.

Beyond R: Rule Ripper is a visual novel with some light gameplay elements, inspired by series such as Zero Escape, Danganronpa, and Ace Attorney, as well as anime like Death Parade and Kaiji. Mixing suspense, drama, and mystery, with a seasoning of comedy.



Defy the death game by gaining the trust of its players and confronting them in the game's Councils, a face-off between all players where anyone can kill through a vote. Can you tame this wild variety of players before it's too late or will the pressure of death drown you?



Make your voice heard and prevent the discussion from falling into chaos through an imagined game of pool. When do you strike and who?

title: MOTIONREC
description:
게임 정보
MotionRec은 움직임의 궤적을 기록하고 재생하는 힘으로 황폐해진 세계를 모험하는 기록 퍼즐 액션입니다.
모션렉을 활용해 기계가 지배하는 세계의 수수께끼를 풀어나가세요!


기록하기
걷거나 점프한 궤적을 기록할 수 있습니다.
또한, 스테이지의 기믹을 이용해 복잡한 움직임도 기록할 수 있습니다.




재생하기
기록된 동작을 그 자리에서 재생할 수 있습니다.
공중에서 재생할 수 있는 횟수에는 제한이 있으며, 지면에 착지하면 회복됩니다.



PressKit

title: Dusky Depths
description:
게임 정보
AN UNFORGIVING SCI-FI ROGUE-LITE


Dusky Depths is a rogue-lite twin stick shooter set on a mysterious and treacherous planet. Take control of your ship and defend yourself against an onslaught of ancient drones and bizarre organisms. How long can you hold out?

Your only hope of escaping your eventual demise is to restore and activate the warp gates left behind by an ancient civilization. Where will they lead you? There is only one way to find out...
KEY FEATURES
More than 100 different items
A vast amount of weapons, ship augmentations and other types of items will allow you to play in countless play styles.
Upgrade your ship and your items!
You can upgrade your ship as well as all items in the game. Choose wisely which upgrade to take and come out on top!
Fully destructible terrain
Modify the terrain to open up completely new paths!
Procedural map generation
The Expedition mode features maps that combine procedurally generated and hand-crafted parts for the best of both worlds. Additionally, many distinct enviroments await you.









You are a mercenary stranded on a mysterious planet inhabited by odd creatures and rundown machinery.
The expedition team that you were a part of has been annihilated after an attack by a highly sophisticated drone armed with alien weaponry.

Abandoned warp gates, autonomous defense systems and other technological marvels indicate that at least one highly advanced civilization has inhabited this planet before.

But to you, only one thing matters:

title: Return to Basic Killing
description:
게임 정보
Return to Basic Killing – An Old-School FPS with Brutal Action
Prepare for relentless, no-nonsense carnage in Return to Basic Killing, a hardcore old-school FPS.. Fast movement, deadly firefights, and secret-filled levels bring back the best of the '90s—modernized for today's shooter fans.
Trapped inside a heavily guarded Nazi fortress, you are Rebekah Razor, a battle-hardened soldier seeking revenge. Break out, blast your way through 30 intense levels, and uncover the horrors of a war-twisted world. Classic gunplay, advanced AI, and a gritty alternate history—are you ready to return to the basics?
🔥 Key Features 🔥
🩸 Classic FPS Action – Fast movement, brutal gunplay, and no hand-holding.
🗺 30 Action-Packed Levels – Huge maps filled with secrets, enemies, and intense fights.
🔫 Old-School Arsenal – Find weapons, loot ammo, and unleash mayhem.
🧠 Smart Enemy AI – Enemies react to sound, alerts, and your tactics.
🕵️ Secrets & Exploration – Hidden rooms, collectibles, and surprises in every level.
🎙 Dynamic Voiceovers – Your enemies will talk—and scream—as they fall.
💀 Multiple Game Modes – Play in Classic Mode or test your skills in Perma-Death Mode.
🌍 A Dark Alternate History
After World War II, history took a terrifying turn. Spain and Portugal joined the Axis. The Third Reich crushed Europe, defeated Britain, and signed a steel-fortified non-aggression pact with Stalin. The world is now divided:
☠ Nazi Europe – An oppressive empire of fear and control.
☭ Communist Asia – A powerhouse standing in opposition.
🗽 The Free World – A fragile alliance of neutral territories, including the USA.
Amid this chaos, one woman fights back.
🩸 Your Story – Escape or Die
You are Rebekah Razor, a war-hardened fighter from the International Brigades who fought fascism in Spain and WWII. Captured behind enemy lines, you've spent years imprisoned in a Nazi fortress hidden deep in the mountains, subjected to horrific experiments.
Now, an opportunity for escape arises. But between you and freedom stand guards, war machines, and monstrous experiments—the twisted results of Nazi science.

title: Travel Knight Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Travel Knight Adventures is a fast paced first-person shooter adventure game that takes you on a journey through the pre sci-fi age.

You fall from the sky. Now it’s time to explore various settlements, castles, and cities. Delve into mysterious dungeons and tombs filled with hidden treasures, traps, and riddles waiting to be solved.

- More than 30 different weapons and magic items with unique mechanics
- Fast passed combat: mix between melee, throwing, kick, guns and magic
- More than 50 hand crafted location - no procedurally generation
- Move between islands by top-down controlled ship or travel through land by top-down horse

title: Beyond the Curtains
description:
게임 정보


"Beyond the Curtains" is a tranquil and relaxing game of casually gazing out the window, longing to witness interesting events and surprises.
Through the large window, you will have the opportunity to experience the world outside from the perspective of the room's owner.
Before long, even the fleeting shadows left by passers-by will become a glimpse into their evolving, ever-changing lives.
Additionally, the interior of the room will change over time, which may reveal some personal information about the one viewing through the window...?

Features

As you continually cycle between day and night, time actually keeps moving forward. And the things outside the window will change accordingly...






● Pick-me-up for hard times: Maybe your classroom or office doesn't have a window, but it does now, and it's always sunny!
● Progress at your own pace: Use the nap button to change the time of day so you don't have to worry about missing anything.
● Selectable topics: longing and fantasy, sex and curiosity, different windows, different people's rooms.
● Adjust the music to your taste: Use the in-room playback device to choose from original, classical, or even... heavy metal?
● Become one with the window: Minimal buttons and UI for maximum immersion.

title: Red Snow
description:
게임 정보


RED SNOW is the most violent snowboarding game on planet earth.

Hit the slopes with an arsenal of weapons.

Combo your way through an arctic battlefield as you flip, spin, and grind for your life.

Upgrade your weapon loadout and build your dream snowboarder-warrior.

Paint the slopes red with their blood. Welcome to RED SNOW.

title: XenoTechArena
description:
게임 정보
Xenotech Arena is a Roguelite arena shooter set in Neo-Japan inspired arena.
A variety of characters such as Geisha Girl, Ninja Head, and Sumo Rider are playable.
Choose and collect over 70 different power-up items to enhance your player!
If you can get class change items, you can evolve and further enhance your players.
Take on screen-filling monsters with your enhanced character and enjoy the exhilarating experience of tackling and blasting them!
Collect items in dungeon mode and see how long you can survive in arena mode!

title: Faraway
description:
게임 정보
"I am a shooting star! A spark meant to shine and vanish in a blink. But I will travel! I will mark my trail in every firmament. I will live to see the universe." Faraway is an immersive, both challenging and chill, procedurally generated audiovisual experience about creating constellations.
Faraway is a single player game, where you control a shooting star who is constantly in the process of vanishing, but keeping itself alive by harvesting energy from the stars, by creating constellations. Players have to tame the smooth, flowing controls of swinging and slingshotting around stars, while weaving an energy string and connecting it to stars.
Faraway has a randomly generated core mode, and 16 puzzle stages.
In the core mode, every game stars from scratch with a new world that procedurally generates itself in realtime based on the player’s performance, allowing experienced players to catapult themselves quickly to higher scores and higher levels of difficulty. Players have complete freedom on how to shape their constellations, but certain moves - like making loops - yield extra energy and points.
The 16 puzzle stages present new ways to think about the game mechanics and get better at the core mode.
Created single handedly by Steph Thirion, game designer, creative coder and musician, with all visuals being fully generated from scratch in realtime, Faraway is an elegantly minimal-yet-deep game, wrapped in an audiovisual experience that will have players return to it for a long time.

title: Wintertwined
description:
게임 정보
When an endless snowstorm traps a parent and child in a remote cabin, they discover its horrific history.
Wintertwined will be a narrative focussed, puzzle horror game.
You take control of Winter, a shy but snarky young adult, who’s trying to get back “home” safely.
With the aid of Giles, Winter's parental guardian, the two of them must work together to survive the snowy apocalypse.
Wintertwined is currently in development and planned for a commercial release in 2025
Features
• A slow burn mystery with multiple endings
• Original soundtrack by Harumi Makoto
• Puzzles with 3 difficulty levels
• Original spritework

title: Contract Rush DX
description:
게임 정보
Contract Rush DX (Also known as simply Contract Rush), is a hand-animated run and gun, with multiple playable characters and a focus on exploration and story! Complete Contracts and collect power-ups that strengthen you immensely, all culminating in massive boss fights! With inspiration from flash cartoons/games of the 2000s, the visuals are hand-animated with a sharp and bold style.






Taking on Contracts will have you exploring large levels, all with their own set of enemies, NPCs, and secrets!
Power-ups will prepare you for the Contract's boss battle at the end of the level. Power-ups can increase movement speed, spread-shot bullets, fire rate, and much more!


Sub-Contracts will have you taking on smaller challenge levels with a variety of objectives. Earn all 3 stars in each and get rewards!






, all with unique play styles. Some are focused on pure shoot'em up gameplay, others centered around melee attacks. If you're having trouble on a level, sometimes trying out a new character is the key!

title: SysAdmin Odyssey - Back to the office
description:
게임 정보
The system administrator simulator is a sandbox in which you can try on the role of a system administrator in offices of different types and sizes and even remotely!
Every new game day you will face different tasks and problems in the office where you work. Scared users will come running to you and tell you that their keyboard is not working and the printer has stopped printing. Will you be able to solve all the problems effectively, or will you accumulate a lot of debts on tasks and violate the SLA? Or maybe you will be able to teach users how to solve their own minor problems, while you drink coffee at home? It all depends on you!


In this game you are waiting for:
- Simulation of computer networks and devices.
- Dynamic system of events and various breakdowns.
- Variability and the ability to influence the gameplay with your own decisions.
- Generating user problems from a variety of different options that you need to diagnose and solve.
- Setting up network equipment.
- Troubleshooting computer networks and systems.
- Time management.
autokwd: SysAdmin Odyssey - Back to the office

title: Slumberer's Universe
description:
게임 정보
"Maybe, just maybe, there are some things to live for."
"But at the same time, does any of this really matter? When I die, I'll forget this all anyway."
Slumberer's Universe is the story of a grieving middle schooler struggling to cope with loss.
Months have passed since Alph's best friend Walter died in a car accident. Alph's been trying to overcome his death, but there's always something that reminds him of the horror and sadness of it. One day, one specific remaining of Walter set a series of life-changing moments in motion. Everything started to change—mostly for the worse. As Alph struggles to understand the universe's new form, he faces unsettling questions: What is Walter’s connection to the universe? And why is Alph the only one who seems to notice the growing darkness?

Solve the mysteries and find out the truth about the universe, while trying to overcome your friend's death in this heart-wrenching psychological horror RPG! Slumberer's Universe is not just a story about grief—it's a chilling exploration of existence itself, where the line between "what's it to live" and "what's it to die" begins to blur.

And maybe, just maybe, find a reason to keep on living. The fate is still unclear.
Key features:
A gripping and heartfelt story about suicide and death, and their consequences.
A unique turn-based-meets-action battle system that's been praised by players!
Original visual / art style
And the story, of course. That's the main thing.

title: Grimdark Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Survive the onslaught of an endless horde of monsters!
Kill monsters, gather their eyes, improve yourself!
In this roguelite survival game, all you can do is survive as long as you can.
Gather eyes for level up current run.
Gather credits in each run to buy upgrades and help the next survivor.

title: Mineral Madness
description:
게임 정보
Dig your way through procedurally generated caves filled with valuable minerals. Collect ores, gems, and rare treasures as you build up your resources. Use them to upgrade your mole’s abilities, craft powerful tools, and gain an edge over your rivals. The deeper you dig, the better the loot!
The underground world is filled with rival moles who will stop at nothing to take you down. Fight for dominance by using clever tactics, combat skills, and explosive surprises. Whether in a heated battle or a strategic showdown, the fight for supremacy is on—are you ready to emerge victorious?
Dig deep and rise to the top in Mineral Madness! As a mighty mole, you're on a quest to claim your title as the top mole in a world full of dangerous rivals. Hone your digging skills, gather precious resources, and fight off competitors to become the ultimate underground champion. Can you dig your way to victory?
Prepare for intense, fast-paced multiplayer action! Team up with friends or face off against foes in chaotic, mineral-filled arenas. The cave is a dangerous place, and only the smartest and toughest moles survive. Will you conquer your enemies, or will they leave you in the dust?
No two adventures are ever the same! The caves in are procedurally generated, offering fresh and unique challenges each time you dig down. Explore endless tunnels, navigate unpredictable terrain, and discover hidden treasures in caves that are as diverse as they are dangerous.

title: Battle Titan RAINBOW
description:
게임 정보


"주인공은 위험한 무역로"별천지"를 여행 하는 상인들을 태운 화물선을 보호 하면서
배틀타이탄 '레인보우'와 함께 싸우게 됩니다."

Pixel art 를 기반으로 한 레트로 메카닉 슈팅 게임으로 RPG 적인 성장 요인이 있는 게임 이며,다양한 장비와 아군의 지원으로 강력한 적들을 파괴하는 Shooting rpg로 개발하고 있습니다.


Top View 2D 슈팅 게임(SH m`Up 장르) SHMUP
90년대 명작 슈팅 게임 テクノソフト 의 "썬더 포스" 와 コンパイル 슈팅 "무자 알레스터" MUSHA-Alester. 에서 영감을 받았습니다.

레트로한 Game Play를 기반으로 직관적인 재미를 추구 하였습니다.
적을 추적하는 단검, 순간 사용가능한 뎃슈 기능, 다양한 서브 무장, 에너지 방패,
주인공을 보좌하는 용병단과 동일 문파의 제자들의 기체, 항공모함 크기의 무장 수송선
상상이상의 크기를 가진 괴수 곤충들, 그리고 절대적인 힘을 가진 아수라 클랜의 Battle Titan들!!



다양한 환경의 전투 스타일을 적용한 전투 스테이지로 구성 되었습니다.
총알 의 숫자로 승부하는 탄막 스타일 보다는 초기 슈팅 게임들이 추구했던
조준 사격등의 슈팅 게임적 요소 를 차용 했습니다.


무협지 적인 요소, 비행하는 검과 필살 기술 !!
여러 문파의 특별한 기술, 병기, 인물들이 등장 합니다. 원작을 기반으로
무술 체계를 정비 게임내에 사용 합니다. 단순한 많은수의 탄막 Play 보다는
창과 도끼, 암기 같은 다양한 병기가 등장 합니다.




한국의 취미 잡지("취미가" HOBBIST)에 1991년 5월호 부터 12회 연재된 메카닉 무협 소설 "대인전기 무혼"의 세계관을 바탕으로 한 탑뷰 슈팅 장르(SHM`UP) 게임.

원작인 Battle Titan Moohun 의 메카닉 무협의 스타일을 접목하여
동양적인 스토리 라인 과 게임내 세계관의 을 구축 하였습니다.
주인공의 여정의 시작은 원로회의 명령을 받아 시작 됩니다.




게임의 원작이 제작되었던 90년대 를 대표하는 거대 로봇 애니메이션 스타일로
게임내 미술적 분위기와 메카닉 디자인을 구성 하여 차별화 하였습니다.




RPG 적인 요소로 5종의 장비를 획득 / 교환/ 하여 레이저, 포스 캐논, 내력검, 내력도 , 추가 연소실, 내력방패 등등 다양한 전투 환경에 적합하게 대응할 수 있습니다.

.


인터미션과 전투 마다 만화풍의 인터미션이 추가 되어 전체 시나리오를 진행 합니다.

title: Project Box
description:
게임 정보
Horror x Thriller x Fantasy


A surreal 2D side-scrolling puzzle-adventure.
Looking for clues: To reveal the truth of old cases.
Enter a bizarre and curious world and start a fantastical adventure.




Story

Children in the apartment complex are searching for their missing friend, unwittingly becoming entangled in a decade-long murder case.
The residents, while avoiding the topic, whisper terrifying rumors behind closed doors.

Among them are a strange landlord couple, a murderer living in the penthouse, siblings traumatized by witnessing their mother's suicide, a creepy doctor practicing medicine illegally, and a grocery store owner obsessed with collecting shrouds.
The question looms : who is the perpetrator of these horrifying crimes?

Hidden in the dark corners of the apartment lies a secret unknown to all—a tragic box reeking of death and the disturbing sound of crying echoing in the hallways.After tonight, the truth may be buried forever.

title: Wink & the Broken Robot
description:
게임 정보
Explore a lush post-apocalyptic world and help a broken robot recover all its pieces. Enjoy 9 worlds filled with secrets and a huge open world to explore.
Shoot enemies with your laser while collecting coins and mysterious ancient treasures like floppy disks and cassette tapes
Wink takes inspiration from Gameboy classics like Super Mario Land 2 and Link’s Awakening, but it's taking that inspiration and running with it. It has been described as a “cross between Megaman and Kirby”. Regardless of the comparisons, Wink has its own personality and a crazy little world to explore all its own
Your purchase includes an executable version of Wink & the Broken Robot which features:
26 levels in 9 worlds from underground caves to factories to waterfalls in the mountains
Hop n Bop/Shoot-Em-Up hybrid gameplay. Jump on most enemies or shoot to defeat them
100% accurate Gameboy Color restrictions in sound and gameplay
Original chiptune soundtrack by Max Oakland
9 bosses to fight
Open world to explore. You can play worlds in whatever order you want and there are many secrets and easter eggs on the overworld map

title: Shotgun Recovery
description:
게임 정보
Life on a knife's edge
The blood on your hands was not worth it, but you can't change that now. Explore Gravdal, a small town with a bad reputation, nested in the shadow of great mountains and rolling hills. Plot with wicked syndicates and grab whatever money you can to fund your escape. It's only a matter of time before the law, or your mind, catches up.
Your own worst enemy
When you're not hiding from police or flashing guns at cashiers; take a moment for self-care. Eat something, take a shower or pop some pills. For when nightmares come alive, preparedness may be the difference between waking up in a cold sweat — or not waking up at all.
Key Features:
Reactive sanity system
Gib-rich combat
A mix of linear and open levels with secrets to discover
Unlockable game mode and weapons

title: Mainland
description:
게임 정보
Experience the epic thrill of medieval warfare and the camaraderie of shared conquest in Mainland, a groundbreaking multiplayer action role-playing game that takes inspiration from the Mount & Blade series and adds an exciting cooperative twist up to 4 players.
1. Forge Unbreakable Alliances Or Fight Other Players:
Rally your friends or team up with other players in a seamless cooperative multiplayer experience.
Build your own band of warriors, each with unique skills and abilities.
Plan and execute strategies together in massive battles that test your teamwork and leadership.
2. Conquer the Medieval World:
Immerse yourself in a sprawling, realistic medieval world filled with kingdoms, castles, and villages.
Choose your path: serve a lord, establish your own kingdom, or become a feared warlord.
Engage in epic sieges, skirmishes, and large-scale battles that will leave your mark on the realm.
3. Realistic Combat Mechanics:
Experience the visceral thrill of real-time combat with a dynamic and physics-based system.
Master an array of medieval weapons, from swords and shields to bows and siege engines.
Utilize advanced tactics to outsmart your foes, or take to the field and lead your troops into the heart of the battle.
4. A World of Opportunity:
Trade goods, participate in tournaments, and complete quests to enhance your character and your warband.
Become a renowned merchant, a tournament champion, or even a renowned outlaw.
Shape your character's destiny in a world full of choices, where every decision has consequences.
5. Deep Political Intrigue:

title: Demon Corporation: Onboarding
description:
게임 정보
How many steps does it take to go from being depressed and seeking death to being a workplace judge? The story of Togawa Tsubasa, a young female programmer who has just graduated from college, can reveal the answer to you! This game is a strategy RPG game with the theme of anti-work from 9 am to 9 pm, six days a week. The gameplay inherits from the classic "Magic Tower" series, combining elements such as pigeons and BD combinations. Please play with caution under the age of 35 to avoid dissing and hurting the boss!

Infiltrate the president's office, data center, yacht party, thank-you reception... workplace ugliness will be repaid doubly!
This work takes place in the magical city of Tokyo. The owner, Togawa Tsubasa, unexpectedly gains the ability to travel to the Night Snack World. The "Night Snack World" overlaps with the real world, where human desires are purified and manifested in the form of monsters. Through this, Togawa Tsubasa can escape the shackles of reality, see the ugliness of the workplace wrapped in layers of darkness, obtain decisive evidence, and expose the truth to the world!

The gameplay of this game originates from theseries. It is easy to get started and has no operational barriers. Whether or not you can defeat the enemy depends entirely on the players' wisdom. However, there is no need to worry. The game will never freeze due to minor calculation errors. Through the pigeon gameplay, players can be fully revived every time, combined with various "slack off skills" to form imaginative BD and experience a completely different tower pushing fun!

A shiver! Boring! Pure venting and self-indulgence cannot solve the practical difficulties of working people. The development concept of this game is to help players better understand the workplace, grasp the workplace, and empathize with working people. The developers have collected a large number of workplace cases, PMP, MBA courses, and selected and adapted hundreds of workplace knowledge, allowing everyone to discover what is truly helpful to themselves while smiling knowingly!




List of project assistants for NO.996 Magic Tower (in no particular order) -
Art Assistance: Pixel Painter, Little Fish | Pixel Painter, Ximi Sheep | Inner Involution Calligraphy Inscription Gu Wu
Script Assistance: Game Screenwriter Zhang Yi | Screenwriter Assistant Mantou
Promotion Assistance: The Way of Game Design of Qianhou Horse | Game People Community

title: One More Run
description:
게임 정보
One More Run is an easy to learn, difficult to master roguelite experience while blending several game genres into one cohesive world. You'll choose from 5 fantasy themed mechs (classes) that each play vastly differently from one another.
Each class brings its own skills and upgrades, equipment modules, and unlocks that can dramatically change how you play over the course of a run and the larger campaign. The Cleric focuses on defense and regeneration to gradually wear down the opponent, while in contrast the Ranger is fragile, but can overclock its weapons for devastating bursts of damage, albeit at risk of overheating.

title: RUBATO
description:
게임 정보


RUBATO is an experimental, 2D physics-based take on the collect-a-thon genre.



Use your tongue to lick enemies and objects to make your way through metroidvania-like areas, whilst collecting "Planet Bits" to help fix the solar system!

title: Wretch
description:
게임 정보
Wretch is a story driven thriller set in an abandoned school from the POV of a security officer working a night shift. What seems like a routine call turns out to be something else entirely.
Why was the school vacated with such a haste? What is Project Luminaire? Who killed Bethany Carlington and who is it that's lurking in these dark corridors?
Exploration and puzzles:
Navigate your way through the abandoned school building searching for clues and answers, dealing with the deteriorating environment. Your job is to investigate the area and search for any intruders, but as the story unfolds the hot question becomes philosophical: "Who's the intruder here?".
Dynamic- and non-linear story progression:
The game has a heavy focus on environmental story telling and does quite little to hold your hand through it all. There are multiple ways to progress and multiple endings to the story, with optional secrets / trivia that'll answer you questions you didn't originally even come around asking.
Hide and seek:
It's quite evident you're not alone, can you find them before they find you? Darkness breeds danger, keep your flashlight on!
-Average completion time ~60 minutes
-For the sake of immersion, no saves
-Requires audio for full interactivity

title: 坤坤大冒险
description:
게임 정보
먼 평행세계에는 구구시가 있다. 이곳은 예로부터"닭신"의 전설이 전해지고있다. 전설에 따르면 굶주림과 재난이 닥칠 때마다"닭신"이 인간세상에 재현된다고 한다. 정교한 하식조작으로 구구시를 배불리 먹인 시민들도 번마다 재난을 평정했다.그러나 시간이 흐르면서'닭신'의 힘도 약해지기 시작했고, 이차원에 숨어 있던 폭식 괴물은 다시 꿈틀거리기 시작했다.다가오는 위기에 대처하기 위해'닭신'은 최후의 힘을 다해'쿤즈족'만이 받아들일 수 있는 신비한 메시지를 모든 평행세계에 보낸다.이것이"닭의 신"에서 온 시험이 될 것인지, 아니면 쿤쿤의 자기 구원이 될 것인지는 아무도 모른다. 한마디로 쿤쿤에 속하는 큰 모험이 시작될 것이다!
"쿤쿤 대모험"은 Q판 만화풍의 ARPG 역할극게임으로서 게임에서 게이머들은 우리의 주인공 쿤쿤을 조작하여 반개방된 쿠쿠시내에서 자유롭게 탐색할수 있다. 탐색하는 과정에 도시가 숨어있는 비밀위기를 료해하고 우리의 롱구를 들고 이 도시를 구할 때가 되였다.

title: Jury Trial
description:
게임 정보

Interested in creating your own cases? With the ingame case editor you will be able to write your own cases and share them with the community. Whether fictional or recreated cases, the ingame editor got you covered.



In this law simulation RPG, you will tackle a multitude of different cases and champion the fight for justice. From representing the poorest of the poor and the wrongfully convicted to the wealthiest and most privileged members of society, you'll navigate through case materials, uncover inconsistencies to find new evidence, analyze and select jurors and experts, question witnesses, and strive to convince the jury at trial. Your clients depend on you because they have nowhere else to turn to.
















The game is set in a fictional country deeply divided by racial profiling, prejudice, and social injustice. A deep bias runs through the country and its people. Apart from your courtroom skills as a gifted negotiator, it’s crucial for you to find a jury that gives your client a Otherwise, every argument and scientific fact might be in vain because no one will listen.

Your potential jurors consist of:









Jury Trial is a project by two indie developers who are doing their best to create a game in their spare time, one they've always wanted to play but couldn't find anywhere. Operating in a nearly nonexistent genre without a budget, we are driven by a passion for the world of law. If you have questions, suggestions, or are interested in offering your help as a potential tester or translator, please contact us through the Steam Community section or via social media.

title: CrossPlanet
description:
게임 정보
CrossPlanet – The Ultimate Multiplayer Shooter Experience
CrossPlanet is a thrilling third-person shooter that delivers fast-paced, skill-based combat across dynamic battlefields. Whether you're facing off against other players in intense PVP firefights or teaming up to battle monstrous alien creatures in PVE missions, CrossPlanet offers action-packed gameplay with a focus on strategy, movement, and precision gunplay.
A Shooter Focused on Gameplay First
No unnecessary fluff—CrossPlanet is built for fluid movement, satisfying gunplay, and competitive action. Players can sprint, take cover, aim down sights, and unleash devastating firepower across a variety of maps and modes. With a robust selection of 11 weapons, each with distinct handling and playstyles, every encounter feels fresh and tactical.
Battle Across Diverse Worlds
From futuristic military bases to hostile alien landscapes, CrossPlanet’s maps are designed for strategic combat and environmental storytelling. Engage in team-based skirmishes, solo challenges, and cooperative missions as you adapt to ever-changing battle scenarios.
Key Features:
✅ Multiplayer Warfare – Face off in competitive PVP battles or squad up for cooperative PVE missions.
✅ Diverse Arsenal – Wield 15 unique weapons, each designed for specific playstyles.
✅ Tactical Movement – Sprint, evade, double jump, jetpack and use map layouts to outmaneuver your enemies.
✅ PVE Battles – Fight against swarms of alien creatures and massive bosses in thrilling co-op missions, or risk going in solo.
✅ Skill-Based Combat – No pay-to-win mechanics—victory comes from strategy and reflexes.
CrossPlanet features 10 PVP Multiplayer maps, 15 Modes, 10 Unique Armors to wear and show off, earned through playing the game! Plus, a range of PVE missions against waves of enemies and huge bosses, either alone or with friends! 
CrossPlanet is designed for players who love pure shooter gameplay without distractions. Whether you're a competitive player looking for your next challenge or a PVE fan ready to take on alien horrors, prepare to drop into the action.
Are you ready to dominate the battlefield?

title: Reclaim The Sea
description:
게임 정보
Reclaim the Sea is a roguelike strategy and adventure game, set in a naval pirate fantasy world. Your goal is to lead your pirate crew through dangerous seas, keep your ship in one piece and save the World. Face tough decisions, manage resources, spend gold in equipment, upgrades and new crew. You will encounter different ships from many factions each time and face tough decisions. Will you be a good pirate or reckless buccaneer? Will you defend this civilian ship attacked by thugs? Or will you take advantage of its weakened position? If you engage in a fight, you will have many options: taking down the enemy crew, burning or sinking their ship, staying at long range and playing defensively or engaging at close range… Each run is unique thanks to randomly generated ships and maps.
Command your crew
Order your crew to move in the ship to accomplish all the required tasks : charge weapon, pilot the ship, board the enemy ship, repair the ship and many more!
Set weapon targets
Choose your ship weapons and set their targets. Will you reduce enemy fire power or manoeuvrability? Will you try to kill the enemy crew, destroy their ship or overwhelm it under fire?

title: HYPER PRIMATE
description:
게임 정보
정글이 부른다... 대답할 건가?

특징은 다음을 포함하되 이에 국한되지 않음:



유동적인 운동량 기반 이동 시스템. 최대 속도로 날뛰는 꿈을 실현하세요.
20종 이상의 Monke 무기를 포함한 거대한 분변 연료 무기고로 당신의 유인원 두뇌에 직접 도파민을 전달하세요.

title: Ravenous Horde
description:
게임 정보
총 64명의 플레이어와 팀을 이루어 이 아포칼립스의 FPS 세상에서 좀비 무리에 맞서 싸우거나 또는 반대로 좀비 무리에 들어가 살아 있는 생존자들을 공격하세요! 팀원들을 기습 공격하여 팀원들을 분열시킬 수도 있습니다. 레벨을 올리고 새로운 무기, 특전 시스템, 의상 옵션 등을 언락하여 사용해 보세요! 마음에 드는 무장을 장착하고 전투에 참여하세요!
특전
원하는 방식으로 플레이해 보세요! 특전을 사용하면 원하는 대로 게임을 플레이할 수 있습니다. 50개 이상의 특전을 사용하여 공격 또는 방어로 플레이하거나 동료 헌터들을 도울 수 있습니다. 좀비 캐릭터에 대한 특전도 선택하여, 더 많은 신체 부위를 던질 수도 있으며 피해를 줄일 수도 있고 헌터들의 속도를 늦춰 좀비 친구들도 물릴 수 있도록 할 수 있습니다!

title: Battle Vision Network
description:
게임 정보
COMPETE IN FAST-PACED ONLINE 1v1 BATTLES
Take turns launching attacks by creating color-matching formations. Vertical matches create attackers, horizontal ones defenders. Rapid-fire matches are 5 minutes and gameplay is simple to jump into. Endless depth of strategy emerges with advanced play.

RECRUIT NEW UNITS WITH UNIQUE ABILITIES
Climb the intergalactic ranks and discover a giant roster of units with unique abilities. Choose between multiple teams bursting with style. Recruit charismatic captains who run the playfield with big personalities and tide-turning special abilities.

Fierce competition requires fierce customization. Ascend the win ladder and discover show-stopping new looks for your captains, expressive emojis and custom win screens to taunt your rivals, and surprises along the way.

BVN is a live game with new seasonal twists, characters, rankings and challenges. Teams spend a season vying for the Champion title–and the player community decides who takes the crown! Win a match with the Rag Tags team? That win shapes the stats, outcome, and narrative events of the season for everyone.

title: Ages of Cataria
description:
게임 정보
Ages of Cataria is a village story generator! Learn your villager's stories as they grow old in your town, customize your village to your aesthetic, and discover a fantastical new land.



Legend has it that the continent of Cataria was home to an ancient civilization. One day, the continent mysteriously vanished and became lost to the world. After hundreds of years, the land of Cataria has been rediscovered and all that remains of the civilization are ruins. Now, thousands have set off to explore Cataria to settle a new home and uncover the mysteries of this land. Craft the origin story of your village, choose your starting location and uncover the legend for yourself.




Choose between two ancestries: . Elves are plant-like beings, while Humans are... well, we all know what Humans are. Each ancestry has unique building aesthetics, requires different resources, and experiences different lifestyle events.



Boost your villager's productivity by playing around town. From cooking to hunting, each job will have a unique minigame. In addition to boosting your productivity, minigames will also increase your villager's skill level.



Villagers will have different , , and . You will need to manage your villager's wellness to ensure their comfort and productivity are positive so they can continue having a grand ol' time.



with your villagers. These interactive novels will define your villager's personality and story. Stories range from small events to life-changing moments.



in town to make your town look unique, or share your style online with others.

title: The Creator
description:
게임 정보

디자인 세계에 빠져보세요

더 크리에이터는 디자인 마스터가 되어 세계에서 가장 아름다운 구석구석에 세련되고 아늑한 공간을 만드는 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 제한도, 스트레스도 없이 창의력과 영감만 있으면 됩니다.

디자인 마스터

다양한 장식 요소, 가구, 식물, 조경을 활용해 독특한 인테리어와 외부 디자인을 만들어 보세요.
원하는 스타일, 색상, 소재를 선택해 편안하고 조화로운 분위기로 공간을 채우세요.


아늑한 도시형 아파트와 모든 종류의 주거용 주택을 맞춤 제작해 보세요.
차고와 다양한 방은 나만의 독특한 아이디어를 위한 공간을 제공합니다.
편안한 휴식 공간과 기능적인 요소로 환경을 개선하세요.
수천 개의 아이템이 디자인 프로젝트의 일부가 되기를 기다리고 있습니다.


리소스 찾기와 제약은 잊고 오로지 아름다움의 창조에만 집중하세요.
자유롭게 실험하고 그 과정을 즐기며 완벽한 솔루션을 찾아보세요.
사실적인 낮과 밤의 주기와 화창한 날부터 번개를 동반한 뇌우까지 다양한 날씨 조건이 작품에 깊이와 표현력을 더합니다.
다양한 필터가 포함된 맞춤형 사진 모드로 프로젝트의 멋진 사진을 캡처하세요.
최고의 사진을 친구 및 게임 커뮤니티와 공유하여 다른 사람의 작품에서 영감을 얻어보세요.

title: 万词破 - 单词女友 WCP Word Girlfriend
description:
게임 정보
An "accident" has caused you, who are about to graduate from university, to lose some important memories, including important events, important people, and a significant portion of your vocabulary. In urgent need of improving your vocabulary to meet the requirements of your future job, you joined an experimental project called the "Ten Thousand Words Club." There, you encountered three women whose destinies are intertwined with yours.
Gameplay Overview:
You need to choose a vocabulary book and set your own study plan, including learning methods, the number of new words and reviews per day, and more. After completing these learning tasks, you can earn virtual currency rewards, increase the teaching assistants' affection levels, and unlock new storylines.
* After completing the daily study plan, you can choose to continue working or battling in the virtual world to earn virtual currency and experience points, or you can improve your attributes by working with a fitness trainer. Whether it's "working," "battling," or "working out," all are vocabulary mini-games with a review function. While playing the game, you also enhance your mastery of previously learned words.
* The development of the storyline will change based on the affection levels of the teaching assistants and your choices. To pursue the teaching assistant you like, you need to select her as your current teaching assistant, complete learning tasks according to your set plan, and earn virtual currency to buy her gifts.
* The main antagonist in the game also has his eyes on these three beautiful teaching assistants, considering you as his rival. He will occasionally challenge you with word challenges. Defeat him, and you'll receive substantial rewards!
Game Features:
* Multiple motivational factors: The presence of virtual teaching assistants, cultivating word girlfriends, exploring multiple endings, facing challenges from the antagonist, rewards from vocabulary mini-games, a rich achievement system, and more. Each aspect of the game is designed to provide you with continuous motivation to learn vocabulary.
* More scientific, user-friendly, and personalized learning methods: We understand the drawbacks of traditional vocabulary learning methods. We have made vocabulary learning more dynamic and moderately intense to reduce user frustration and drowsiness. We prioritize the user learning experience and do not mindlessly recommend vocabulary words that exceed the user's learning capacity. We offer multiple learning methods, allowing users to customize their learning based on their actual situations and make adjustments at any time.
