title: Laws of Nadragia
description:
게임 정보
중세 나라 나드라지아에서 혁명이 일어났습니다! 이제 나라는 왕이 아닌 그의 꼭두각시들이 다스립니다. 새로운 국가 권력 기관인 최고 대학회가 통치합니다. 옛 법들은 불타버렸고, 매일 새로운 법들이 만들어지고 있습니다. 새로운 폭정의 시대가 시작되었습니다.
검사로서 법과 사실을 이용하세요.
법과 재판 기록의 허점을 찾아 피고인에게 어떤 수단을 써서라도 유죄 판결을 얻으세요. 법은 매일 바뀌고, 재판도 그렇습니다. 사람들의 생명이 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
전체주의 국가에서 생존하세요.
나드라지아 당국은 유죄 판결 할당량 준수를 요구하며 당신의 모든 움직임을 감시하고 있습니다. 각 재판은 피고인뿐만 아니라 당신에게도 마지막이 될 수 있습니다.

title: Neon Sword
description:
게임 정보


Neon Sword is an open world 3rd person top down action roleplay game with elements of business simulation. The none linear story has multiple choices that effect the world around you leading you down many paths; the person you become is shaped by your decisions made within the game.

Time and Setting

Neon Sword takes place in the fictional Quaid City in the year 2083. The setting takes inspiration from late 70s to early 90s Sci-Fi, Cyberpunk and Synthwave - Neon Lights, Big hair and dodgy moustache...




Another crime goes unsolved in the city that is the cesspit of humanity! Well, not if you have any say in the matter as you start a personal crusade of revenge. Are you the hunter or the hunted? You will turn Quaid City upside down hosing the streets clean of the human vermin that infest the dark shadows out of the neon glare as you shape the destiny of Quaid City...

The time has come to wield the .

title: Farmer's Diary
description:
게임 정보
The Farmer's Diary is your journey to restore an old and neglected farm to its glorious days. With your limited budget, you progress through the game with the goal of reaching an advanced farm using your farming skills.

Upgrade System
You will upgrade your farm and make it more developed and beautiful by upgrading each building separately.

Farming
Your crop field is your greatest treasure. Plant the seed and give them water until harvest time and collect and sell your grown products.

Husbandry
These beautiful animals are your friends. Don't forget to look after them and feed them. also you can sell the products you get from them.

Orcharding
Do you want to grow fruit trees? then buy some saplings! The seedlings will take some time to grow, but if you be patience they will eventually give you big returns.

Production (Available With First Update)
You can purchase various production machines for your workshop, where you can produce many new products using the raw materials you gather by farming.

title: Blaze of Storm
description:
게임 정보
Blaze of Storm is a standard vertical scrolling shmup. The main character, a pilot, fights against enemies in cyberspace as a cyber diver.
Two types of weapons are available: a main weapon and a subweapon. The main weapon is a Vulcan shot that is fired in front of the player's ship. The subweapon type can be changed by getting an item.
Subweapons have different performance depending on their type. Some circle around the ship to defend against enemy bullets, others automatically track and attack the enemy, and so on.
In addition, subweapons can generate an explosion by hitting the enemy with the weapon itself, and this explosion can cause great damage to the enemy.
Enemies appear in cyberspace in a wide variety of shapes, including mecha, creatures, and plants.
This is a shmup in which you can take advantage of the properties of subweapons and their explosions to your advantage. Stay tuned!
Story:
In the year 794 of the Cyber Century, the nation was managed by a giant computer called "Elixia." Elixia controlled all aspects of politics, economy, and the military, making war and poverty a thing of the past. However, that peace suddenly crumbles.
Unidentified enemies appeared in cyberspace and began to erode the system of Elixia. The city's infrastructure was in chaos, communication networks were cut off, and people faced fear.
In response to this situation, cyberdiver "Ayame Crow" began investigating cyberspace. Cyberdivers are people with special abilities who can directly connect their consciousness to cyberspace.
Behind this crisis, it was discovered that there was a human being called "Phantom" who uploaded his mind into cyberspace. He was plotting to control Elixia in order to lead humanity to chaos that he called freedom.
Now, the cyberspace battle to save humanity from crisis begins!

title: Blood Accord
description:
게임 정보
야나는 두 명의 가장 친한 친구와 함께 공중 화장실에 갇힌 채 깨어납니다. 한 명은 불 같은 성격에 날카로운 말솜씨를 가진 용감한 영혼, 비카입니다. 다른 한 명은 부드럽고 따뜻한 마음을 가진 조화로운 영혼, 랼랴입니다.
처음에는 야나는 안도감을 느낍니다. 혼자가 아니니까요. 그녀가 세상 누구보다 사랑하는 소녀들과 함께 있다는 사실에 마치 하늘이 내려준 축복처럼 느껴집니다.
하지만 시간이 지날수록 좁은 공간은 더 이상 안식처처럼 느껴지지 않고 감옥처럼 느껴집니다.
말 못할 긴장감이 감돌고, 오래전 묻어두었던 비밀들이 수면 위로 떠오르기 시작합니다.
녹슨 수도꼭지에서 떨어지는 핏방울 하나하나가 과거는 잊혀져서는 안 된다는 것을 상기시켜 줍니다.

title: The Gambit Lost to Time
description:
게임 정보
플뢰레타, 윈터브랜드, 베르단디아, 골든송으로 구성된 네 왕국의 통치자들이 모두 같은 날 의문의 사건으로 죽음을 맞이하며 우노니아 대륙이 혼돈에 빠졌습니다. 갑작스러운 왕위 계승으로 새로운 역할을 떠맡게 된 후계자들은 서로를 향해 비난을 쏟아냈고, 수 세기 동안 이어졌던 평화에 종지부를 찍으며 혼란의 시기가 찾아왔습니다.
대륙의 평화만을 바라며 시간을 여행하는 조언가, 미아가 이때 등장합니다. 
Gambit Lost to Time은 로그라이트 요소가 가미된 전술 RPG 게임으로, 미래의 지식을 활용해 과거를 바꾸며 대륙의 평화를 되찾아야 합니다.
여러분의 전략과 지략으로 전쟁 중인 네 왕국 중 하나를 도와주세요. 오늘의 친구가 다른 시간선에서 적이 될 수도 있다는 점을 염두에 두고 왕과 여왕, 그리고 왕국의 신하들을 친구로 삼으세요. 함께하는 동료나 적대하는 인물들의 갈등 및 유혈 사태가 반복적으로 재현되는 와중에도 감정을 억눌러야 합니다... 
그 운명의 날에 실제로 무슨 일이 벌어진 것인지 알아내고, 그토록 아끼는 친구들과 이 대륙을 지키기 위해서라면 무엇이든 희생할 수 있지 않을까요? 그 결정은 여러분의 손에 달려 있습니다.
전략
어느 왕국을 지원하든 전략가로서 왕국군의 생존을 보장하며 승리로 이끄는 책무를 맡아야 합니다.
50가지 이상의 스킬 중 3개를 슬롯에 채우고 영웅을 전장으로 이끌어 보세요.
그리고 그 영웅을 중심으로 전장을 함께 누빌 병사들을 징집하세요.
전투 전에 영웅을 지휘관으로 임명해야 합니다. 각 영웅에는 부대에 적용될 지휘관 고유 보너스가 있습니다. 올바른 지휘관 보너스를 사용해 자신만의 플레이 스타일에 힘을 실어주거나 다양한 상황에 맞게 활용해 보세요!
시간의 책략
시간 여행자의 힘을 활용해 현재를 원하는 대로 재구성해 보세요. 시간선을 거듭할 때마다 이 세계 자체와 다른 사람들... 그리고 자신에 대해 더 자세히 알아갑니다. 이상적인 시간선을 손에 넣을 때까지 더 강력하게 성장하며 힘을 강화하세요.
지난 행동이 만족스럽지 않으면 시간을 되돌려 이전 턴으로 돌아갈 수도 있습니다.
미래의 지식을 "책략"으로 활용하면 또 다른 시간선에서 다시 마주한 전투의 흐름을 완전히 뒤바꿀 수도 있습니다.
미래에서 겪어보고 학습한 덕분에 새로운 가능성을 열고 전투도 완전히 새롭게 전개할 수 있습니다.
전투를 빠르게 완료하는 경우 획득하는 시간의 정수를 이용해서 다음 시간선으로 넘어가기 전에 최대한 많은 지식을 습득하세요. 
독특한 네 왕국
꽃이 무성한 플뢰레타의 평원부터 차가운 윈터브랜드의 산맥과 파릇파릇한 베르단디아의 숲, 그리고 혹독한 골든송의 황무지까지. 서로 평화롭게 지내던 좋은 시절도 있었습니다.

title: Reactoryx
description:
게임 정보
You are a renowned ██████  ██████████ tasked with solving a case involving ███████████ events surrounding one of the ██████  ████████ corporations. At first glance, the case seems routine: missing █████████, strange ████, and unsettling ███████ among employees. However, the deeper you dive into this enigma, the clearer it becomes that much more is at stake than ██████████ secrets.
Game Features
Unique Reporting System
Every action, discovery, and solved puzzle must be documented in reports you submit to your client. The thoroughness of your reports affects the game's progression, unlocking or concealing critical storylines.

title: Warranted Humanity
description:
게임 정보
An unknown virus is turning infected mammals into cannibals and zombies.
In Warranted Humanity choices matter. Name your hero, choose the colour of his car and rush through the tutorial, because the clock is ticking and humanity’s survival is resting on your shoulders.
GAME FEATURES
How you spend your time at night, affects your efficiency during the day and how well you fight and scavenge during day-time excursions, determines your options and progress during the night. Will your read a book to improve your skill in hacking, craft a bigger backpack, upgrade your toolbelt or distill more biodiesel for the generator?
Fighting is action-based, but the body part hit, weapon condition, the presence of armour, as well as the hero’s stats all have an influence on the outcome of hits, parries, damage received and damage dealt.
Morale is just as important as health in Warranted Humanity. Killing healthy and curable humans (instead of incapacitating them) has a large negative impact on morale, especially in the beginning of the game. Develop courage by taking damage and improve humanity’s odds of survival, to improve your maximum morale, or you will flee to your shelter in panic after receiving only a few bites and scratches.
Manage short-term challenges like cuts, hunger and fatigue, or they will turn into long-term problems like infection, starvation and sleep deprivation, affecting maximum health, stamina and morale.
Oversee survivors who joined your shelter. Add survivors to your shelter by helping those you encounter during day-time excursions, or by incapacitating and abducting infected humans you then treat with antibodies you harvested from your own body. More survivors at the shelter translates into more hands to help with the crafting, maintenance and upgrades, but it also means more mouths to feed.
Deal with locks in a number of ways They come in different types and sizes and stand between you and important resources. If you have the right tool in your backpack, you can lockpick, hack or pry open a lock. These actions are implemented as mini-games and the difficulty of the task is affected by the hero’s stats. You can also use a key or enter the right combination, if you found one of these along the way.

title: Portal Foxes TD
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Defend portals from hordes of slimes with elemental foxes from a tabletop VR perspective. Recruit a colorful set of characters to help in your quest to reconnect a fragmented world over a 25 level single-player story adventure.
No fixed paths.
Slimes can climb anything, but they (usually) don't like to. You must know your enemy to build your defenses effectively.
No Upgrades. No Numbers.

title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
description:
게임 정보
《의체 궤도강하 타격대: 첫 번째 강하》에서는 유례없는 아이템 조합의 자유도를 경험할 수 있습니다! 데모 버전에서는 50종 이상의 독특한 기능을 가진 의체를 제공하며, 각각의 의체는 새로운 전투 전략과 즐거움을 선사합니다.
총알이 분열 후 폭발하도록 만들고 싶으신가요? 아니면 유도 탄환에 관통 효과를 더하고 싶으신가요? 이러한 자유로운 조합은 모든 전투를 색다르고 짜릿하게 만들어줍니다. 끊임없이 실험하고 조합하여 자신에게 딱 맞는 전투 방식을 찾아내고, 매번 도전에 1+1>2 이상의 즐거움을 느껴보세요!
autokwd: Exo Helljumper: Descent X,의체 궤도강하 타격대: 첫 번째 강하

title: Xontainer Meta Space
description:
게임 정보
About Xontainer Meta Space
Xontainer Meta Space offers a unique simulation experience where players can immerse themselves in a world of logistics, strategy, and innovation. With advanced AI-powered NPCs and a wide array of features, this game brings a new level of realism and interactivity.
Key Features:
AI NPCs with Advanced Communication
Interact with NPCs using either voice (microphone) or text. Each NPC supports two different languages, with a total of 20 languages currently available. English, Turkish, and Spanish are supported at launch.
Truck Operations
Take control of trucks for cargo transportation. Buy, customize, and upgrade your vehicles to improve efficiency and performance.
Warehouse Missions
Engage in tasks like loading and unloading cargo, managing inventory, and completing depot assignments.
Forklift and Vehicle Usage
Operate forklifts for precision tasks or drive vehicles to navigate the expansive in-game world.
Energy Production
Harness power from generators, batteries, and wind turbines to fuel your operations and optimize your logistics network.
In-Game Smartphone System
Use your in-game phone to call other players, transfer money, accept missions, and deliver completed tasks. The smartphone feature brings a dynamic layer of interaction and gameplay management.
Xontainer Meta Space combines realism, strategic gameplay, and player-driven interactions to create a truly immersive simulation experience. Wishlist now and join the next evolution in logistics gaming!

title: Fluff'n'Roll
description:
게임 정보
Take control of bouncy fluffballs and conquer twisting, dynamic levels! Master precision controls and fast reflexes as you zip through courses filled with surprising obstacles.
Collect coins scattered across each level to unlock new customization options for your fluffball. Track down every coin in a world to earn special rewards and take your fluff style to the next level!

title: Under Destruction
description:
게임 정보
Spyro: The Elite Drone in the Battle for Erythonite

In a dystopian future dominated by artificial intelligence, humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Machines, led by the supreme AI “Axis”, fight for control of Erythonite, a revolutionary mineral fueling the war. You are Spyro, an elite combat drone tasked with a critical mission: secure Erythonite deposits, eliminate human defenses, and ensure machine dominance.

Key Features:
Total Destruction: Use fully destructible environments to break through barricades, fortifications, and enemy turrets.
Strategic Open-World: Explore a mountainous terrain, discover Erythonite deposits, and plan your moves to outsmart enemies.
Conquer and Defend: Capture human refineries and fortify your bases to fend off enemy raids.  
Intense Combat: Pilot Spyro and face fighter jets, tanks, turrets, and helicopters in relentless battles. 
Customization and Upgrades: Equip Spyro with devastating weaponry, from Gatling guns to plasma cannons and guided missiles.  
Deadly Support: Collaborate with ”Pyramid”, a massive airborne unit providing logistical aid, and deploy powerful tanks to crush even the toughest defenses.

Game Modes:
Single-Player Campaign: Immerse yourself in a story of war, sacrifice, and strategy as you delve into the conflict between humans and machines.  
Multiplayer: Challenge other players in thrilling battles with **Battle Royale** or Survival-Coop modes, where teamwork is key to victory.  

Prepare for War. 
Every shot leaves a mark, every decision shapes the battlefield. 
Axis has a plan, you are its weapon. 
Take control of Spyro and lead the machine revolution.

title: Tangles 2 تشابك
description:
게임 정보
في جزيرة سيرين النائية، يتحول السعي وراء الطموح إلى كابوس مظلم.
ماجد، متدرب شاب في مجال البيولوجيا، يتلقى دعوة للتدرب في مركز البيان للأبحاث على جزيرة سيرين، تلك المنشأة الحديثة التي كان ينتظر أن تحقق إنجازات علمية. لكن ما كان يبدو فرصةً لفتح آفاق جديدة في عالم المعرفة، سرعان ما يتحول إلى رحلة مليئة بالغموض والرعب.
وأثناء استكشافه للمركز الذي يبدو مهجورًا بشكل غريب، يكتشف أن الحقيقة تبدو أكثر رعبًا مما هي عليه، لكن الحقيقة تتشابك مع الأوهام، وكل خطوة تكشف سرًا وتنسج آخر.
On the remote island of Scirine, the pursuit of ambition takes a dark turn.
Majed, a young biology trainee, arrives at the state-of-the-art Al-Bayan Research Center on Scirine Island to start his internship. But what was meant to be an opportunity to make scientific breakthroughs becomes a descent into a haunting mystery.
As he explores the eerily abandoned center, Majed discovers that the truth is far more terrifying than it seems. Yet, the truth intertwines with illusions, and every step uncovers a secret while weaving another.

title: Our War: Firepower Suppression
Delivery Guy Simulator
description:
게임 정보
활기찬 도시의 거리를 누비며 배달원이 되어 배달업에 도전하는 「Delivery Guy Simulator」에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 번화한 도시 블록을 탐색하고 모든 종류의 패키지를 배달하며 배달 비즈니스의 정상에 오르세요.
다양한 일자리에 도전하세요! 뜨거운 음식, 신선한 식료품, 중요한 소포 등 어떤 것이든 정시에 배달하고, 큰 수익을 올리고, 업계 최고임을 모두에게 보여주세요!
돈을 벌고, 새로운 라이더를 구매하고, 업그레이드하여 배달 게임을 한 단계 업그레이드하세요!

title: OrePlant
description:
게임 정보
🌱 오어플랜트: 마법 같은 판타지 세계관이 기다립니다! ✨
호기심 많은 '핀'과 '마루'는 알 수 없는 신비한 힘에 의해 이세계로 빨려 들어갑니다! 🌀
그곳에는 전설적인 세계수가 우뚝 서 있으며, 당신의 손길로 이 신비로운 땅을 다시 되살릴 수 있습니다. 🌳
귀여운 동료 '아리아'와 함께 이 마법 같은 세계를 탐험하고 가꾸어 보세요!

title: Amaroo's Christmas Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Amaroo’s Christmas Shop Simulator는 궁극의 크리스마스 쇼핑 경험을 만들고 운영하는 따뜻한 분위기의 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
꿈의 가게를 디자인하세요
창의력을 발휘해 매력적인 크리스마스 가게를 꾸며보세요. 반짝이는 조명, 크리스마스트리, 화려한 장식, 가랜드, 따뜻한 크리스마스 스웨터 등으로 가게를 아름답게 장식할 수 있습니다. 벽과 바닥의 색상부터 매장의 디스플레이까지 세부적으로 커스터마이징하여 나만의 겨울 왕국을 만들어 보세요.
선물 포장으로 추가 팁 받기
고객이 원하는 포장지, 리본, 태그를 사용해 선물을 아름답게 포장하세요. 세심한 포장 서비스로 고객을 만족시키면 추가 팁을 받을 수 있습니다!
재고 관리, 판매 및 경영
크리스마스 선물과 홀리데이 아이템을 신중하게 선정하여 매장을 운영하세요. 경쟁력 있는 가격을 설정하고 인기 상품을 모니터링하며, 고객 수요에 맞게 재고를 지속적으로 채워야 합니다. 가격 정책과 재고 관리 결정은 수익에 직접적인 영향을 미칩니다!
매장 확장 및 자동화
사업이 성장할수록 더 많은 기회가 열립니다. 직원을 고용하여 일상적인 업무를 맡기고, 매장 확장에 집중하세요. 매장을 확장하고 직원을 늘려 크리스마스 쇼핑 비즈니스를 더욱 발전시켜 보세요!
비용과 이익의 균형 맞추기
장식 비용, 재고 관리, 직원 급여 등 다양한 비용을 신중하게 조정하여 최대한의 수익을 창출하세요. 아늑한 작은 가게를 운영할 것인가요, 아니면 거대한 크리스마스 제국을 건설할 것인가요? 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!

title: GOVNOVOZ
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to GOVNOVOZ—a game where the world of waste management turns into an epic action-packed adventure filled with crazy mini-games, racing, and a hilarious story!
Story:
Grisha arrives in town to claim his father's inheritance, expecting riches or at least a nice apartment… but instead, he gets an old vacuum truck! To make matters worse, his father owed money to the entire local utility service, and the key bosses—Granny Zina, Uncle Vitya the Gasman, and Klava the Janitor—won't let him leave until he pays off the debts.
Now, Grisha has to hustle hard: driving passengers around in his sewage truck, maneuvering through tight parking lots, competing in chaotic obstacle races, outrunning pursuers, and even surviving in a rogue-like action brawl
Game Features:
✅ A hilarious story filled with satire about bureaucracy, government services, and city life.
✅ Dynamic mini-games inspired by classic arcade racers, Crazy Taxi, Vampire Survivors, and more.
✅ Racing, parking challenges, drifting, runner chases, survival modes, and many other wacky trials.
✅ Tons of pop culture references to movies, games, and internet memes.
✅ Memorable characters! Uncle Kolya, the wise trucker; Granny Zina, the witch of the utility office; and even Vin Drosel with his love for family and racing.

title: Moon River
description:
게임 정보
Moon River is a short RPG adventure featuring a classic top-down perspective and light RPG / puzzle elements
You are someone called the Mariner, a sailor who's been out at sea for an incredibly long time. You are headed to Elapse Island, one of the last known places of the world. There, it is said the people only exist in the moonlight, as well as the river that runs through the island: "Moon River." For whatever reason, the Mariner desperately seeks something at the end of the river.
As the Mariner, your objective is to travel to the river's end before dawn. Deep shadows obstruct each area of the island, so you must find any sources of pure light to dispel them and proceed down the river.
Along the way you'll find new people to meet, sights & sounds to experience, and secrets to uncover.
Atmospheric RPG Experience
Moon River forgoes combat and heavy narrative, instead primarily consisting of exploration and puzzle solving with optional secret events scattered throughout.
Interactive Events
Occasionally, there are special interactive events and actions to perform, such as operating a machine. These events briefly break up the regular gameplay for a more varied experience.
Hidden Narrative
Beneath the main story, there is a hidden history of events from the past which can only be uncovered within the world's secret spaces and unchecked corners. Only the highly dedicated can piece the entire story together.

title: Miljama horror tale
description:
게임 정보
Miljana는 전쟁 지역에 있는 병사의 관점을 다루는 심리 공포 게임입니다.
Miljana
Miljana에서 당신은 몇 주 동안 적의 요새에 갇혀 있다가 마침내 아군과 연락을 취하게 됩니다. 구조 팀이 파견되지만, 적에 대한 고급 정보를 활용하여 그들을 당신의 위치로 안내하는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 그러나 당신의 임무는 단순한 지시를 내리는 데 그치지 않습니다. 임무의 성공은 당신의 전략적 결정과 도전을 극복할 능력에 달려 있습니다.
게임플레이
Miljana는 구조 팀을 안내하고 관리하는 다양한 메커니즘을 갖춘 1인칭 포토리얼리즘 시뮬레이터입니다.
주요 특징
분위기 있는 환경과 포토리얼리틱 그래픽
좌표 기반 메커니즘

title: Inner Truth
description:
게임 정보
내면의 진실과 마주하라
큐트하고 크레이지한 세 명의 히로인과 함께, 어둡고 뒤틀린 현대 사회를 살아남아라.
절망 속에서 기어오르고, 숨겨진 수수께끼를 풀어내며, 공포를 극복하라.
스토리

title: The Mirrion
description:
게임 정보

귀중한 자원을 수집하고, 미개척 영역을 탐험하며, 생존을 위한 더 많은 기회를 잠금 해제하세요. 숲, 산, 그리고 숨겨진 동굴은 위협뿐만 아니라 도구 제작, 피난처 건설, 야생에서의 안전을 보장하는 필수 재료도 함께 갖추고 있습니다.
치명적인 위험과 무한한 가능성이 가득한 광대한 오픈 월드를 탐험하세요. 피난처를 구축하고, 자원을 수집하며, 기술과 창의성을 사용하여 생존 방법을 찾으세요. 각 발견은 이 가혹한 세계를 집으로 만드는 데 한 걸음씩 나아가게 됩니다.

야생에서 진정한 사냥꾼이 되세요: 먹이를 추적하여 음식과 귀중한 자원을 확보하세요. 작은 먹이에서 큰 포식자에 이르기까지, 모든 사냥은 전략과 정밀성을 요구합니다. 수집한 재료를 사용하여 무기와 도구를 제작하고 장비를 업그레이드하여 생존 확률을 높이세요.

title: リズフリたん！Rhythmic Flip Turn
description:
게임 정보
🎵 Remember where the adorable animals are hiding, then press the keys to the rhythm in this fun and fluffy music game! 🎶
🐾 How to Play
The rules are simple! Just memorize the example pattern and press any key you like 👆✨
🔹 The animals remember which key you pressed!
🔹 "Press the same key for the same animal"—don’t forget! 🔍
autokwd: リズフリたん！Rhythmic Flip Turn

title: Grim Pastures
description:
게임 정보
Grim Pastures는 1970년대의 향수를 불러일으키는 농장 환경을 배경으로 한 멀티플레이어 생존 사회 추리 게임입니다. 이 게임에서 각 플레이어는 계절 근로자를 연기하지만, 농장에는 위협이 존재합니다. 연쇄 살인범이 마을 사람들 사이에 숨어 있으며, 생산 과정을 방해하려고 합니다.
각 플레이어는 고유한 능력을 가지고 있습니다. 어떤 플레이어는 민첩하고 빠르며, 어떤 플레이어는 리더십을 발휘하고, 또 다른 플레이어는 농업과 축산에 특화되어 있습니다. 게임이 시작되면 살인범은 비밀리에 선택되고, 플레이어들은 서로를 신뢰해야 합니다. 살인범은 마을 사람들의 일을 방해하려고 하며, 마을 사람들은 생존하고 농장의 임무를 완료하기 위해 서로를 신뢰해야 합니다.
농장에서의 임무에는 채소, 과일, 고기, 유제품, 목재, 건초 등 중요한 자원의 생산이 포함됩니다. 시간이 제한되어 있고, 각 임무는 정해진 시간 내에 완료되어야 합니다. 그러나 이 과정은 살인범의 방해로 위협받고 있습니다. 살인범은 생산 지역을 파괴하거나 작업자를 방해하거나 주의를 분산시켜 마을 사람들이 임무를 완료하는 것을 어렵게 만들 수 있습니다. 마을 사람들의 유일한 목표는 생산을 제때 완료하고 농장의 질서를 유지하면서 살인범으로부터 자신을 보호하는 것입니다.
Grim Pastures에서 생존하는 것은 단지 임무를 완료하는 것만이 아닙니다. 그것은 전략, 팀워크, 그리고 누구도 신뢰하지 않는 것을 의미합니다. 어떤 마을 사람이 동료이고 어떤 마을 사람이 적일까요? 아무도 확신할 수 없습니다. 이것은 매 순간이 긴장감과 흥분으로 가득 차게 만듭니다. 각 플레이어는 자신의 추측과 관찰에 의존해야 합니다.
이 게임에서 당신은 농장에서의 생산을 완료하는 것뿐만 아니라 서로를 보호하며 생존해야 합니다. Grim Pastures는 인내, 집중, 완벽한 타이밍이 필요한 도전입니다. 결국, 누가 살아남을까요? 당신과 당신의 팀을 기다리고 있는 것은 놀라움과 흥분으로 가득 찬 경험입니다!

title: Intermundia: Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
책을 읽고 비디오 게임을 플레이하면서 각 상호작용을 관리하세요.
한 페이지 한 페이지 넘기면서 두 세계의 경계를 넘나드는 우정의 이야기를 발견하세요. 간단한 탭 한 번으로 함정이 가득한 던전을 탐험하고, 맹렬한 적과 싸우고, 인벤토리를 관리하세요. 
고전 게임북에서 영감을 받은 다양한 선택지로 가득한 스토리와 다양한 엔딩을 만나보세요!
이 장대한 모험에 빠져들고, 움직임을 계획하고, 운명을 선택하고, 결과에 맞설 준비를 하세요!
팀을 커스터마이즈하고 전투를 준비하세요.
캐릭터를 관리하고, 최고의 장비를 선택하고, 기술을 최적화하여 완벽한 전략을 세우세요.

title: Surface
description:
게임 정보
Surface is a first person linear exploration game.
In this game you simply walk your way to the end. The point is to immerse yourself in this world presented to you.
There are no mechanics besides movement and looking around.
Being mysterious by design the story isn't told explicitly, everything is up to interpretation, all you know is that you want to reach the surface.
While the game does not contain monsters, the ambience and environments will invoke feelings of unease and even dread.

title: The Four Money Bears: Berryville
description:
게임 정보
WELCOME TO BERRYVILLE!
OH NO! The town of Berryville is in dire need of help! This town of bears needs a crafty entrepreneur to help get them out of financial hardship and recover from a bad storm! Can you help? You will only have a short amount of time to get to financial success before you lose everything and the town goes to ruin.

Wait! Don’t worry! You have the help of the Four Money Bears! These cute financial partners will help guide you to learn to manage money. With the support of Spender, Saver, Investor and Giver bear you'll be able to make your financial dreams come true and maybe even learn something along the way!
BECOME THE BEST MERCHANT.
Can you become the biggest merchant in the world? You'll have to beat the competition and manage your money wisely.
Use all the town's resources at your disposal and unlock and craft tons of recipes.

title: Gunlocked 2
description:
게임 정보
Movement is your weapon. A sci-fi action roguelike and shmup combined, in Gunlocked 2 you'll pilot and upgrade a state-of-the-art warship against endless waves of deadly aliens. Deep customization, branching paths, and tons of unlockables offer endless replayability set against the infinity of outer space.
What's New in the Sequel?
Expanded Customization: More unique pilots, unlockable warships with their own strengths and weaknesses, and a hugely expanded upgrade system offer new creative freedom.
Weapon Mastery: Each pilot has masterful command over their starting weapon, giving them a unique weapon variant no other pilot has access to.
Pilot Skills: Pilots start with a unique ability, not tied to any equipment slots or weapons, giving them a flair all their own.
Augments: Unlock and equip up to 6 ability modifiers before you start your run. Will you cover your weaknesses or lean into your strengths? Collect data discs to upgrade their power even further for higher difficulty runs.
Warships: No longer just cosmetic, unlockable ships allow you to further focus your play-style, bringing their own stats and strengths to the battle
Utilities: Discover common, uncommon, and rare upgrades that you can stack infinitely to create the perfect build. Make trades with special characters to refine your builds like never before.

title: Ink Reverie
description:
게임 정보
Ink Reverie is a casual city-building game set in a fictional historical era with art inspired by the Tang and Song dynasties.

As you gradually unfold these scrolls, you traverse through the shifting sands of time and the rise and fall of history, returning to a secluded town from a thousand years ago. As a diligent manager, you'll guide hardworking villagers to transform a remote village into a prosperous home through exploration, construction, production, and trade.
Game Features

Five distinct regions and human environments, each with unique gameplay mechanics: Jiangnan Mountain Village, Dunhuang and the Western Regions, Citong Sea Area, the Four Seasons of Jincheng, and the ancient capital of Chang'an.
Traditional Chinese style hand-drawn art: Utilizing detailed literature research and field investigations, combined with fictional elements, to recreate the styles of the Tang and Song dynasties in a unique way.
Unique match-3 synthesis gameplay: By clicking and dragging, you can freely adjust the building layouts. Adjacent low-level buildings will merge into high-level buildings, unlocking more gameplay and content.
Goal of increasing prosperity: Through exploration, construction, production, and trade, gradually build your ideal home.
Chapters in the Game

🌸Chapter I: Jiangnan Mountain Village🌸
"In the south of the Yangtze River, I meet you again in the beautiful scenery as flowers fall."

A small village nestled in the picturesque Jiangnan area, perched on a mountain, maintains simple trade relations with the town at the foot of the mountain. The tea and peach blossom brew produced here are considered real treasures. Starting from a small piece of wasteland, you will establish basic production facilities and expand the village through trade with the town, aiming to create an ideal and prosperous home. Tea and peach blossom brew are the village's specialties, and you need to use these resources wisely to acquire more types of buildings and increase the village's prosperity.


🐫Chapter II: Dunhuang and the Western Regions🐫
"Beneath the moon of Dunhuang lies a sea of sand; the ancient road witnesses poplars through the years."

Dunhuang, a vital trade hub on the Silk Road linking East and West, serves as the starting point for you embarking on your trade journey. You can construct relay stations and organize caravans, choosing to trade eastward or westward to acquire diverse resources. Besides regular resource production, you must build relay stations and organize camel caravans to establish trade routes with cities in both directions. Through these extensive journeys, you can obtain precious materials and resources, facilitating the development and expansion of your town.

⛵Chapter III: Citong Sea Area⛵
"The waves are calm, and great whales rest; the sails shine as treasure ships arrive."

Citong ancient port (now Quanzhou) is the starting point of the ancient Maritime Silk Road. You will begin a new chapter of maritime trade here. The sea area is filled with unknowns and challenges, and you need to plan resources wisely to increase the success rate of merchant voyages. Besides regular resource production, you need to build merchant ships and form fleets for maritime trade with other regions.

🌾Chapter IV: The Four Seasons of Jincheng🌾
"In spring, returning to thickly shaded tall trees; in autumn, arriving at late blooming fragrant yellow flowers."

Jincheng, located at the foot of North Heng Mount in Shanxi, experiences four distinct seasons and notable climatic characteristics. You need to strategize resource management according to seasonal changes, ensuring successful crop harvesting and material storage. Each season brings unique production priorities and resource demands, necessitating careful planning of crop planting and storage techniques. Focus on large-scale production activities in autumn, and ensure adequate material reserves to endure the winter cold.

🐲Chapter V: The Prosperity of Chang'an🐲
"Looking back at Chang'an city, the embroidered piles of mountains open in succession."

Chang'an, the capital of thirteen dynasties, was the center of ancient China's politics, culture, and economy. In this chapter, you will develop various markets, experiencing the grandeur of the Tang dynasty. Buildings are classified into 4 types: scholars, farmers, artisans, and merchants. As these buildings upgrade, their attributes will improve. By strategically combining different buildings within various market areas, you can unlock unique benefits.

title: Assenizator
description:
게임 정보
A sewage disposal is a great and revered profession! Petrovich and Mikhalych are working as sewage collectors, but one day, while dumping waste into a river, they are noticed by a policeman and now they need to earn money so that they are not fined. In addition, there is an annoying competitor who takes away customers. You will have to help Petrovich and Mikhalych to cope with these problems!
Drive the legendary ZIL-130 and listen to the radio
You will have to fulfill orders for the ZIL-130 sewage disposal unit, which Petrovich bought in his youth. And so that you don't get bored on the road, turn on the radio station with the best songs about the sewage disposal!
Fulfill customer orders

title: Kabonk!
description:
게임 정보
Kabonk! is a nostalgic brick-breaker with multilevel puzzles, physic based controls and a sweet set of power ups set in neon-lit arcades. Enter the arcade and experience a classic with sparks, bounces and bonks.
In Kabonk! you control a physics based paddle and navigate through multiple arcade levels by breaking bricks with different types of spheres, each with unique physics-based properties. Try smashing difficult bricks with more force or add spin-effects to reach difficult objects.
Some bricks are unbreakable but some just needs some force or extra love. Manipulate your way through each level and try to beat each puzzle.
5+ different worlds
25+ unique levels
Physics based manipulation
10+ power-ups
(Coming soon) Steam leaderboards
Neon-lit
Switches, buttons and pressure plates
*All images are captured early in development and are subject to change.

title: VISK
description:
게임 정보




1~2인용 온라인 협동 호러 게임인 VISK의 암울한 세계로 들어가 보세요.
여러분과 친구는 황량한 마을로 보내집니다.
이곳의 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내고 주변을 조심스럽게 탐험하세요.
결국, 당신은 혼자가 아닐지도 모릅니다...
친구와 함께 또는 싱글 플레이어로 플레이
2인 온라인 협동 모드
친구와 함께 플레이하고 협력하여 진행하세요.
워키토키와 근접 음성 채팅을 사용하여 함께 작업하세요.
싱글 플레이어 모드
이 음산한 경험에 혼자 들어가 보세요.
아무도 당신을 도와주지 않을 것입니다.


누가 당신을 여기로 보냈나요? 이 마을은 어떻게 된 거죠? 정말 혼자입니까?
독특한 환경을 탐험하며 답을 찾아보세요.


퍼즐을 풀고, 주요 아이템을 검색하고, 환경과 상호작용하여 새로운 장소로 이동하세요.
전생의 유물을 검색하고 이곳에서 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아보세요.

title: Noga
description:
게임 정보
Noga is my third game as a solo indie developer. It's a single-player story-based game in first-person, with shooting and driving mechanics.
You are the sole survivor of an alien attack on a military outpost where your friend was kidnapped.
Embark on a long and dangerous journey to try to save him and yourself in a world that has suddenly turned upside down and become a death trap.
As the story unfold you will discover the truth behind the alien invasion and the forces involved in it.
The story progresses in a world infested with aliens of various types, spaceships, mercenaries and people hiding and trying to survive.
You must fight for your life and the lives of the companions you have collected along the way, upgrade your weapons and vehicles, learn new skills, and investigate the events that led to the invasion.
The game takes place in Israel and goes through different places from the snowy north to desert south.
Main features:

title: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
description:
게임 정보

On a cold, barren isle somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago, a man wakes up without any memories of where he is, what happened to him, or who he is.
A cellphone gives off a flashing green light, revealing itself in the snow close to him. It will become vital when gathering his past memories, figuring out what is going on, and making decisions on what he must do.
Gameplay
The M/S Cornelia II incident is a mystery point-and-click adventure game in a contemporary setting.
The gameplay consists of regular elements of adventure gaming, such as exploring surroundings and using/combining items.
An original aspect of the game is collecting memory fragments and clues in your surroundings to help puzzle together your past in a room set in your mind.

title: Psychotic Bathtub
description:
게임 정보
FEATURES
Argue with Rubber Duck
Drown Jesus
Drink Wine
Drink Poison
Drink Blood
Flood Bathroom
Chat with Death
Find Your Very Own Ending
WHAT’S PSYCHOTIC BATHTUB?
Sit in your bathtub and experience your very own psychotic episode. Interact with the environment and find a way out of the really scary parts of your mind. 
50% OF PSYCHOTIC’S FINAL PROFIT WILL BE DONATED
Psychotic Bathtub shows a fictional disorder that follows psychotic symptoms. Psychotic is intended to destigmatize mental health disorders and to make them accessible. 50% of it’s final profit will be donated to mental health related projects.

title: Little Cheese Works
description:
게임 정보
Get the cheese back to the goal within the time limit!
Work together with 2 to 4 people to clear the game.
This game includes voice chat function!
Cat will wake up if it hears footsteps or voice chat!
If a cat found me, it would be terrible...

title: Spite スプライト
description:
게임 정보
■What is "SP(L/R)ITE"?
"SP(L/R) ITE" is an adventure game in which you aim to escape from a room floating in a different space.
Solve the riddles in each room in cooperation with your neighbor who can only speak through the walls and a vivacious goddess.
The view after opening the last door depends on your choice.

■The story reveals the background along with the mystery
When Pal awoke, he had a strange sensation.
A familiar ceiling, a familiar room scene, but no smell.
He was puzzled, then a talking-stone statue appeared in front of him.
"Akrida, the goddess of destiny" she saids.

Pal is forced to kill each other by this self-proclaimed goddess of fate.
His opponent is a faceless neighbor who lives across the wall, Jean.
The first person to escape from the locked room will survive.
This was supposed to be a death game.

Jean, the neighbor, does not trust Akrida and asks Pal to escape from the room with him.
Even though hear that, Akrida agrees to help without hesitation.
She said she can do anything if they want out of the room.

Interacting with Jean, and sometimes guided by Akrida, Pal eventually recovers the truth he has lost.

■Truth and Choice
The setting of "SP(L/R)ITE" is a secret room in ruins.
The "threads of fate" spun by Acreda unexpectedly intertwine to create an isolated and different space.
In order to advance to the next room, players must collect items and complete a painting that will be the key to escape.
Pal the player receive hints from Jean and Akrida, and collect items scattered around the room to complete the picture.

Completing the painting advances Jean and Pal's story and brings it to its conclusion.
The ending scenery is left to your choice.

"SP(L/R)ITE" is a short ADV project developed by Tricore, an indie game development company based in Fukuoka, Japan.

title: Beyond R: Rule Ripper
description:
게임 정보


Trapped in an Evolving Death Game, he chooses to rebel

You awaken in a mysterious luxury bar, the Golden Jack, alongside nine strangers, and are forced to play a game by The Owner. Each player represents one of the game's rules. You can disobey your own rule, and that rule will disappear if you die. Only three players can survive...unless you find another way.

Beyond R: Rule Ripper is a visual novel with some light gameplay elements, inspired by series such as Zero Escape, Danganronpa, and Ace Attorney, as well as anime like Death Parade and Kaiji. Mixing suspense, drama, and mystery, with a seasoning of comedy.



Defy the death game by gaining the trust of its players and confronting them in the game's Councils, a face-off between all players where anyone can kill through a vote. Can you tame this wild variety of players before it's too late or will the pressure of death drown you?



Make your voice heard and prevent the discussion from falling into chaos through an imagined game of pool. When do you strike and who?

title: MOTIONREC
description:
게임 정보
MotionRec은 움직임의 궤적을 기록하고 재생하는 힘으로 황폐해진 세계를 모험하는 기록 퍼즐 액션입니다.
모션렉을 활용해 기계가 지배하는 세계의 수수께끼를 풀어나가세요!


기록하기
걷거나 점프한 궤적을 기록할 수 있습니다.
또한, 스테이지의 기믹을 이용해 복잡한 움직임도 기록할 수 있습니다.




재생하기
기록된 동작을 그 자리에서 재생할 수 있습니다.
공중에서 재생할 수 있는 횟수에는 제한이 있으며, 지면에 착지하면 회복됩니다.



PressKit

title: Dusky Depths
description:
게임 정보
AN UNFORGIVING SCI-FI ROGUE-LITE


Dusky Depths is a rogue-lite twin stick shooter set on a mysterious and treacherous planet. Take control of your ship and defend yourself against an onslaught of ancient drones and bizarre organisms. How long can you hold out?

Your only hope of escaping your eventual demise is to restore and activate the warp gates left behind by an ancient civilization. Where will they lead you? There is only one way to find out...
KEY FEATURES
More than 100 different items
A vast amount of weapons, ship augmentations and other types of items will allow you to play in countless play styles.
Upgrade your ship and your items!
You can upgrade your ship as well as all items in the game. Choose wisely which upgrade to take and come out on top!
Fully destructible terrain
Modify the terrain to open up completely new paths!
Procedural map generation
The Expedition mode features maps that combine procedurally generated and hand-crafted parts for the best of both worlds. Additionally, many distinct enviroments await you.









You are a mercenary stranded on a mysterious planet inhabited by odd creatures and rundown machinery.
The expedition team that you were a part of has been annihilated after an attack by a highly sophisticated drone armed with alien weaponry.

Abandoned warp gates, autonomous defense systems and other technological marvels indicate that at least one highly advanced civilization has inhabited this planet before.

But to you, only one thing matters:

title: Return to Basic Killing
description:
게임 정보
Return to Basic Killing – An Old-School FPS with Brutal Action
Prepare for relentless, no-nonsense carnage in Return to Basic Killing, a hardcore old-school FPS.. Fast movement, deadly firefights, and secret-filled levels bring back the best of the '90s—modernized for today's shooter fans.
Trapped inside a heavily guarded Nazi fortress, you are Rebekah Razor, a battle-hardened soldier seeking revenge. Break out, blast your way through 30 intense levels, and uncover the horrors of a war-twisted world. Classic gunplay, advanced AI, and a gritty alternate history—are you ready to return to the basics?
🔥 Key Features 🔥
🩸 Classic FPS Action – Fast movement, brutal gunplay, and no hand-holding.
🗺 30 Action-Packed Levels – Huge maps filled with secrets, enemies, and intense fights.
🔫 Old-School Arsenal – Find weapons, loot ammo, and unleash mayhem.
🧠 Smart Enemy AI – Enemies react to sound, alerts, and your tactics.
🕵️ Secrets & Exploration – Hidden rooms, collectibles, and surprises in every level.
🎙 Dynamic Voiceovers – Your enemies will talk—and scream—as they fall.
💀 Multiple Game Modes – Play in Classic Mode or test your skills in Perma-Death Mode.
🌍 A Dark Alternate History
After World War II, history took a terrifying turn. Spain and Portugal joined the Axis. The Third Reich crushed Europe, defeated Britain, and signed a steel-fortified non-aggression pact with Stalin. The world is now divided:
☠ Nazi Europe – An oppressive empire of fear and control.
☭ Communist Asia – A powerhouse standing in opposition.
🗽 The Free World – A fragile alliance of neutral territories, including the USA.
Amid this chaos, one woman fights back.
🩸 Your Story – Escape or Die
You are Rebekah Razor, a war-hardened fighter from the International Brigades who fought fascism in Spain and WWII. Captured behind enemy lines, you've spent years imprisoned in a Nazi fortress hidden deep in the mountains, subjected to horrific experiments.
Now, an opportunity for escape arises. But between you and freedom stand guards, war machines, and monstrous experiments—the twisted results of Nazi science.

title: Travel Knight Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Travel Knight Adventures is a fast paced first-person shooter adventure game that takes you on a journey through the pre sci-fi age.

You fall from the sky. Now it’s time to explore various settlements, castles, and cities. Delve into mysterious dungeons and tombs filled with hidden treasures, traps, and riddles waiting to be solved.

- More than 30 different weapons and magic items with unique mechanics
- Fast passed combat: mix between melee, throwing, kick, guns and magic
- More than 50 hand crafted location - no procedurally generation
- Move between islands by top-down controlled ship or travel through land by top-down horse

title: Beyond the Curtains
description:
게임 정보


"Beyond the Curtains" is a tranquil and relaxing game of casually gazing out the window, longing to witness interesting events and surprises.
Through the large window, you will have the opportunity to experience the world outside from the perspective of the room's owner.
Before long, even the fleeting shadows left by passers-by will become a glimpse into their evolving, ever-changing lives.
Additionally, the interior of the room will change over time, which may reveal some personal information about the one viewing through the window...?

Features

As you continually cycle between day and night, time actually keeps moving forward. And the things outside the window will change accordingly...






● Pick-me-up for hard times: Maybe your classroom or office doesn't have a window, but it does now, and it's always sunny!
● Progress at your own pace: Use the nap button to change the time of day so you don't have to worry about missing anything.
● Selectable topics: longing and fantasy, sex and curiosity, different windows, different people's rooms.
● Adjust the music to your taste: Use the in-room playback device to choose from original, classical, or even... heavy metal?
● Become one with the window: Minimal buttons and UI for maximum immersion.

title: Forgotten Fragments
description:
게임 정보
The Spheres Are the Key
Use the spheres power to light the torches and complete the level. But it won't always be easy: you'll need to aim your throws well and launch them before the time limit runs out...
Two Campaigns, Two stories
Uncover Enid's story as you recover the forgotten fragments, or team up with a friend to unravel all the secrets of the two-player campaign. Each campaign has its own levels!
Over 120 Levels to Conquer
Each campaign features 4 worlds to explore, with over 60 levels each. But the challenge doesn't end there, as you can replay each level to improve your time and become the best!
At the end of each world, you'll face a powerful boss, each with their own unique mechanics. Get ready to apply everything you've learned during your adventure to emerge victorious in these battles.
Find the hidden collectibles in some levels to unlock skins and customize your characters. Make sure to explore every corner: to play the secret levels, you'll need to light special torches...

title: Eastern Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Eastern Tactics is a strategy RPG game set in the fictional backdrop of the Tang Dynasty. In the game, players control descendants of famous Tang Dynasty generals embarking on an adventurous journey. Utilizing diverse incarnate abilities and employing varied combat strategies, players aim to emerge victorious in battle challenges.

Game Features

Embark on an adventure: Experience a mysterious and grand adventure in a magical world where the fate of the world's peace lies in your hands.
Only incarnates can defeat other incarnates: Summon various incarnates with unique abilities to assist you in battles.
Win battles and grow stronger: Every battle poses a strong strategic challenge, and winning battles allows your characters to grow. Equip them with different attribute gear, learn more powerful skills, and prepare for the next challenge.
Challenge peculiar and powerful bosses: Your team will face a variety of formidable and bizarre enemies, and each boss battle requires a targeted strategy to overcome.


In every era, there are always those struggling for survival, while others seek a path to transcendence.

In the sixth year of Zhenguan (632 AD), Emperor Taizong of Tang, upon the advice of the celestial being Yuan Tiangang and others, held a grand ceremony on Mount Tai known as the Fengshan ceremony.

Two years later, certain extraordinary beings with incarnates outside their bodies started to become active. It is said that these beings were demonic entities attached to human desires and transformed into incarnates, granting the possessors of these incarnates various extraordinary abilities. "Only an incarnate messenger can defeat another incarnate messenger."

In the eleventh year of Zhenguan (637 AD), in the distant west, the Sassanid Empire was reaching its final moments. Zoroastrian incarnates in the far west were no match for the four great Muslim caliphs, and the king and nobles decided to flee. Unwilling to accept the fate of the Zoroastrian religion being annihilated by the emerging Abbasid Caliphate, the Zoroastrian high priest, the Mobed, dispatched two messengers to travel across the ancient Silk Road to the emerging Eastern Empire in the far east, in search of awakening the slumbering gods...

As they journeyed thousands of miles through the desert to the east, Emperor Taizong suddenly launched a war to conquer the Western Regions.

And this is just the beginning of the story.

title: Poker Warlords
description:
게임 정보
In Poker Warlords, each card dealt spawns a medieval fantasy army! You might get dealt a mighty 10 out of 10 Dragons or you might get a measly 8 out of 24 Footmen. Play traditional poker betting rounds with face-down and face-up cards, then choose which two armies will fight for you in battle. You have to know when to hold 'em and when to fold 'em!
Bet smart, battle hard, then win big! After the final bet the fight begins. Armies clash in fast-paced autobattler combat. No micromanagement—just smart bets, unit counters, and tactical positioning. The last army standing takes the pot.

title: Countryballs: The Heist
description:
게임 정보
Countryballs: The Heist는 인기 유튜브 시리즈에 기반한 PWA의 유머러스한 컨트리볼 잠입 어드벤처입니다. 독특한 변장으로 컨트리볼을 커스터마이징하고 전 세계로 잠입하여 한층 더 미친 고객들을 위해 미친 물건들을 훔쳐보세요. 계획하고, 방해하고, 몰래 잠입하여 도둑의 명성을 얻거나 내장된 Heist Editor를 사용하여 커뮤니티를 위한 천재적인 습격을 직접 제작해 보세요.


나만의 컨트리볼 전문가 도둑 만들기

250개 이상의 잠금 해제 가능한 깃발과 스킨으로 구성된 방대한 컬렉션에서 나만의 변장을 만들어 보세요. 얼음으로 뒤덮인 북극, 모래사막, 호화로운 수영장 파티, 비밀 우주 정거장 등 다양한 배경을 만들어 보세요: 위장하거나... 들키면 줄행랑을 치세요!

PWA 컨트리볼 유니버스의 주인공이 되어 보세요

수백만 명이 보고 사랑한 도둑 컨트리볼에 관한 PWA의 이야기를 당신이 주인공이 되어 경험하세요.
(어쩌다 보니) 수상한 스파이 기관에 가입한 컨트리볼 신인이 되어 전 세계를 돌아다니며 미친 여정을 통해 친숙한 컨트리볼 캐릭터들을 만나보세요... 그들의 별난 모습들까지도요.



친구( 혹은 적)의 습격을 다운로드하여 새로운 모험을 시작하거나, 직접 습격 제작자가 되어 통합된 Heist Editor를 사용하여 전 세계 플레이어를 위한 까다로운 습격을 디자인하세요. 이 만능 에디터를 사용하면 모국어로 자신만의 스토리를 담은 완벽한 습격을 만들어 커뮤니티와 공유할 수 있습니다.

title: Sahara Storms WWIII
description:
게임 정보
Set in a world torn apart by global conflict caused by major powers, players take on the role of soldiers from two different teams. Engage in intense multiplayer battles as you strive to defeat enemy forces and emerge victorious.

Key Features

Immerse yourself in thrilling battles on a dynamic battlefield.
Customize your weapons with a variety of attachments to suit your play style.
Experience the excitement of conquest gameplay, where strategic objectives must be achieved to secure victory.

Prepare yourself for the challenges that await in Sahara Storms WWIII.
Character Classes
Choose a character class that matches your preferred play style and bring your unique abilities to the battlefield.

Medic Class: Equipped with medical supplies, the Medic class plays a crucial role in providing healing support to teammates.

Support Class: As a Support class soldier, your role is to provide essential ammunition support to your team.

Assault Class: The Assault class is a versatile frontline unit, known for their intelligence and adaptability with their speed and ammuniation support.
Weapon Customization
Upgrade and customize your weapons using attachments to enhance your performance in combat.

title: April '86
description:
게임 정보
구성:
Sergei는 어린 시절을 Pripyat시에서 보냈습니다. 그는 한때 아버지와 여동생 Varya와 함께 그곳에서 살았습니다. 1986년, 체르노빌 원자력 발전소 사고 직전, 도시에서 아이들이 사라지기 시작했습니다. 어느 날 Varya도 사라졌습니다. 자원봉사자들로 구성된 경찰과 수색팀도 흔적을 찾지 못했다.
1986년 4월 26일 - 체르노빌 원자력 발전소에서 사고가 발생했으며 실종 아동 문제에 아무도 관여하지 않았습니다. 세르게이의 아버지는 원자력 발전소 직원이었으며 방사선병으로 사망했습니다. 세르게이는 도시에서 대피하여 벨로루시에 있는 조부모와 함께 살았습니다. 10년 후, 세르게이는 죽은 도시를 배경으로 한 여동생의 사진이 담긴 이상한 봉투를 받습니다. 어떻게 이럴 수있어? 그녀는 정말 살아 있나요? 이러한 질문에 답하기 위해 우리의 영웅은 버려진 도시 프리피야트로 돌아가 1986년에 실종된 아이들에게 일어났던 끔찍한 사건을 하나씩 재구성해야 합니다.

title: Shadow Project
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Project is a narrative-focused, tactical FPS that takes place during the heightened tensions of the Cold War between the Soviet Union and the United States. Your goal is simple, but achieving it will not be. You must infiltrate Soviet territory and put a stop to their recently discovered experiments, which have subjected all forms of life to a series of tortuous and inhuman trials.
Blood Must Spill 
Set in the late 1980s, you are part of a team that is tasked with taking down a series of Soviet military installations that are suspected of being involved with these trials, referred to as Shadow Project by US intelligence. Rumors have circulated describing large-scale unethical human experimentation for several years, but were recently given confirmation from a Soviet defector, who has exposed the horrible truth of Shadow Project.

title: Shinjuku Anomaly
description:
게임 정보
You have a part-time job taking photos of anomalies in the night in Shinjuku.
There are four rules for your part-time job.
If you see a anomaly, take a picture of it.
When taking a picture, get close to a anomaly to an appropriate distance.
However, don't get too close.
If you run out of film, come back.
Game Overview
This is a short horror visual novel game. It has multiple endings.
Scheduled release
Within 2025
Warning
This game is fictional and has no connection to any real people, incidents, or organizations.
