description: 게임 정보
company: Gods and Heros Studio, Gods and Heros Studio

title: DEVIL'S WAY 2
description:
게임 정보
조용한 마을에서 평범한 사람으로서 당신은 생활을 시작합니다. 그러나 심해지는 정신분열증 발작으로 인해 당신의 삶은 지옥으로 변해버립니다. 마을은 더 이상 익숙한 곳이 아니라, 끔찍한 악몽으로 변모했습니다. 이제 살아남고 이 악몽에서 벗어나기 위해서는 당신의 지혜와 용기를 사용해야 합니다.
주요 특징
두려움으로 가득 찬 분위기
외진 어둡고 쓸쓸한 마을 길, 섬세하게 디자인된 환경과 소름 돋는 음향 효과가 당신을 소름끼치게 만들 것입니다.
제한된 자원 관리
마을에서는 제한된 수의 총알과 한 개의 무기만이 당신을 도울 수 있습니다. 자원을 신중하게 사용하여 살아남으세요.
심리적 긴장과 공포
정신분열증 발작으로 인해 마을 길가의 표지판에서 여러 질문들을 보게 됩니다. 그러나 이 질문들이 당신을 올바른 길로 인도할지, 아니면 더 큰 위험으로 이끌지 모릅니다.
괴물에 맞서 생존하기
정신분열증 발작의 결과인지 현실인지 구분하기 어려운 무서운 괴물들과 싸워야 합니다.
깊은 이야기와 현실적인 캐릭터
정신 질환과 싸우는 한 인물의 시각에서, 현실과 환상이 뒤섞인 이야기를 체험하세요.
DEVIL'S WAY 2는 끊임없이 경계심을 일깨우는 분위기, 강렬한 이야기, 그리고 도전적인 생존 메커니즘을 통해 플레이어들에게 잊을 수 없는 공포 체험을 선사할 것을 약속합니다.

title: Winter Heat
description:
게임 정보
Winter Heat is a no-choices kinetic novel game about love in the internet age.
Javiera Vera is a freelancer living in the sweltering summer of Santiago, in Chile.
Fukkoshi Shio is an office worker living in the snowy rural town of Miyazu, Kyoto, in Japan.
The two are long-time internet friends, living across the world, across time zones, but with a bond as strong as the fiber optic cables connecting them. How will that bond transform, though, during one special December?
Follow Javi and Shio through their online chats and video calls as they grow even closer together.
Features:
A fluffy, fun romance story across continents.
Totally linear storyline with some unlockable chapters.
2-3 hours of gameplay.
Bonus game included: Oomfie RPG!

title: Don't Freeze: A Winter Card Survival
description:
게임 정보
여객기 추락 사고 이후, 당신은 혹독한 겨울 황무지에 홀로 남겨진 유일한 생존자가 되었습니다. 당신의 임무는 문명으로 돌아갈 때까지 살아남는 것—그리고 이 치명적인 환경을 헤쳐 나가며 독특한 카드 기반 생존 경험을 펼치는 것입니다.
추락 현장의 잔해에서부터 얼어붙은 강, 버려진 마을, 그리고 광활하고 가차 없는 겨울 지형까지, 10가지 이상의 다양한 환경을 탐험하며 당신의 생존 본능을 시험하세요.
사냥, 낚시, 덫 설치, 그리고 수색을 통해 생존에 필요한 음식과 보급품을 확보하세요—살아남기 위해 사용할 수 있는 모든 것을 찾아야 합니다.
autokwd: Don't Freeze: A Winter Card Survival

title: Idle Bones Magic
description:
게임 정보
Idle Bones Magic is an idler incremental game you play as a necromancer raising the dead and snowballing them into enormous hosts.
Go from a lowly initiate in the dark arts to a powerful necromancer taking over the world with hordes of countless zombies. You'll manage your resources to raise all sorts of creatures, which you'll put to work gathering more resources and attacking your enemies.
Start from animating bones into skeletal servants. Use them to pick up more bones to make more of themselves, then start exploring, expanding, and exploiting your surroundings. Shortly you'll be amassing thousands of zombies and taking over entire countries, learning how to create even more powerful creatures and indoctrinating more necromancers into your cult.
Unleash a zombie apocalypse on this unsuspecting world and watch your hordes multiply and take over everything.

title: Gears of Glory
description:
게임 정보
In this Tower Defense game, inspired by classics like Bloons and Kingdom Rush, we introduce a new twist – the ability to move your towers around the map using a van called the "Gear Machine."
The idea is simple: defend your base against an invasion of over 12 different types of robots. This will require some heavy firepower, as these robots are built with advanced materials. To fight back, humanity has developed a series of towers designed to take on this challenge.

And that’s where your mission begins! Choose from over 10 different types of towers to find the best way to destroy all the robots. But it won’t be easy – you'll have limited resources to buy towers, move them, and unlock new areas to place them. Each map also brings its own unique challenges!

title: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism
description:
게임 정보
Beat Overconfident Tokyo!
Unite the power of local pride and "hometown (jimoto: your local roots)" across the nation in this innovative action game!
Game Overview
Take control of the team led by Saitama Prefecture, joined by allies from across Japan.
Stages are set in carefully selected "hometowns (jimoto)" from Japan's 47 prefectures!
Navigate fields filled with familiar landmarks and local specialties!
The game rules are simple: jump and bounce to avoid falling off the stage and reach the goal.
It's a classic side-scrolling platformer.
However, your character is completely limp, making even walking a challenge.
The key to the game is mastering its unique controls.
Once you get the hang of it, you can even dash and perform big jumps. Give it a try!
Ally System
Clear stages to recruit new prefectures as allies!
They might help you by creating platforms or throw in unexpected challenges...
Harness the power of "hometowns" to pave the way to Tokyo's defeat!
Local Pride is Your Ultimate Weapon
Your attacks are powered by regional specialties! For example, Saitama wields Fukaya leeks, while Osaka throws takoyaki...
Use hometown pride to overcome stage obstacles and gimmicks.
Boss Battles with Local Trivia for Major Damage
During boss battles, answer quizzes about your local area to deal massive damage to Tokyo!
Packed with features that let you rediscover the charm of Japan while you play.
Step into the battle with local pride in your heart and beat Tokyo!
autokwd: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism,打倒東京にはJimotoism
company: sewohayami, 株式会社カナメクト

title: Portilus - Civitas Sanguinis
description:
게임 정보
Step into the role of a gladiator thrust into a ruthless world where only the strongest endure. You begin as an unknown fighter, forced to prove your worth in the arena where every battle is a chance to rise or fall into oblivion. Your journey takes you from obscurity to legend, with your helm and blade becoming symbols of your legacy.

title: Engine Eternal
description:
게임 정보
You are a survivor living in the remnants of humanity. In an attempt to escape to a better life, you board the Engine Eternal, a train that has the potential to take you to Paradise. During your journey across the Old World, you and up to 3 fellow survivors will stop at several locations and disembark to search old abandoned locations to look for fuel and upgrades to keep the Engine running.

title: Make a Hit!
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Make a Hit! is a puzzle roguelike themed around mixing cassettes in the 80s to climb to the top of the Billboard.
Scoring
Match cassettes on different attributes and combine powerful cassette modifiers to boost your sales and mix those coveted Diamond hits! 
Challenge
Increase your notoriety and sign with increasingly challenging Record Labels to make loads of cash and, just maybe, reap the rewards of the rare Perfect Contract Bonus.

title: WonderLang Japanese
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to WonderLang, where mastering Japanese transforms into an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.
WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and compelling narrative. Get immersed in Wonderlang, as you: Explore, Fight, Converse and Investigate using your target language.
More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!
WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of the language. While the game doesn't aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually.
Key Features
Immersive Japanese Learning
Learn practical Japanese through every conversation, quest, and puzzle.
Progress through beginner level A1 with 40 to 50 hours of combined learning and gameplay.
                                                               Engaging Storyline
Follow the journey of a young hero who must learn Japanese to lift a magical curse from their brother.
Explore vibrant villages, uncover secrets, and build friendships interracting with over 60 unique NPCs.
Learning as a Gameplay Mechanic
Solve puzzles, and complete quests by forming sentences and understanding dialogues.
Practice building sentences and pronunciation thanks to speech recognition challenges.
Utilize in-game tools like a dictionary and contextual help to aid your learning.

title: Clawsome
description:
게임 정보
Step into the whimsical world of Clawsome! Help Clawby find new friends in this wholesome claw machine game in which you collect unique and quirky prizes that move, disappear and even fight back! Navigate through ever changing challenges and build the most charming diorama collection with the figurines you grab!

A Claw Machine Like No Other
Clawby isn’t your typical grabber. The world is alive with moving platforms, disappearing prizes, and unexpected twists that will keep you on your toes.
Collect Unique Figurines
Each prize you grab becomes part of your growing collection. View your treasures in beautifully crafted dioramas and examine them from different angles to appreciate every tiny little detail.

title: Deal On Four Wheels
description:
게임 정보
🔥 Deals on Four Wheels
Have you ever dreamed of running your own dealership? In Deal On Four Wheels, you don’t just buy and sell vehicles—you customize them to meet the demands of the most demanding clients! From luxury models to high-performance sports cars, every deal could turn into a goldmine… if you play your cards right!
🚗 Diverse Clients, Unique Stories
Not all customers are the same! An influencer wants a flashy ride to impress their followers, a VIP seeks exclusivity, while an everyday client has more practical needs. Meet their demands, earn stellar reviews, and build your reputation in the industry!

title: Mind Over Monarchy
description:
게임 정보
Rise. Conquer. Rule.
Command your army in a tactical, turn-based strategy game where every move matters. Battle across an 8x8 grid, blending classic chess-like mechanics with roguelike progression.
Game Modes
🔥 Story Mode – Start as an ambitious challenger, fight through escalating battles, and dethrone the reigning king.
⚔️ Endless Mode – Face relentless waves of enemies, upgrading and recruiting new units as you fight for survival.
Strategic Combat

title: Positive! Hapili Link
description:
게임 정보
I’m Kanna Omori. A 16-year-old high school student.
One day, I met Moron, a fairy from the Posiri Kingdom of another world — and somehow, I ended up becoming a super heroine.
He said he wants me to help protect his homeland from the evil clutches of the Negari Republic.
What even is this? It’s way too scary.
“Positive! Hapili Link” is a side-scrolling adventure action game set in a small town somewhere in Japan.
The player takes on the role of Kanna Omori, a 16-year-old high school girl, who teams up with Moron, the fairy from another world, to fight against agents of the Negari Republic, also from another world.
The game is divided into two parts: the Adventure Part, where you search for the "Nega Vacuum" devices that the enemy agents have hidden around town, and the Battle Part, where you transform into the super heroine "Hapili Link" to destroy the discovered Nega Vacuums.
In the Adventure Part, you explore the town alongside Moron, gathering clues and uncovering the Nega Vacuums disguised as everyday objects.
In the Battle Part, you borrow the fairy’s power to transform into the super heroine "Hapili Link" and use her minigun to fight and destroy the Nega Vacuums.
The game focuses on immersion in the story, so both the Adventure and Battle parts feature a relatively gentle difficulty level.
Enjoy a story full of laughter, tears, and heartwarming moments.
The superpowered transformation phrase is: “Positive! Hapili Link!”

title: The Last Shores
description:
게임 정보
🌿 Immerse yourself in a relaxing, contemplative adventure with The Last Shores, a top-down 3D solar-punk exploration game where nature and mystery meet.
🧪 Play as Tal, a young biologist on a mission
Freshly graduated from GREEN-CORP University and sent to an abandoned island for a one-year internship, your objective is simple: clean up the entire island, restore the ecosystems and unravel the secrets buried beneath these forgotten lands. But you'll soon discover that there's much more to this island than meets the eye...
🌍 A living, poetic world
Collect and recycle waste to bring the island back to life.
Repair wind turbines to generate energy.
Care for small animals and rediscover lush nature.
Soar from cliff tops to explore freely.
Unearth buried treasures all around the island ( it'll make memories ).

title: Battle
description:
게임 정보
B.A.T.T.L.E. is a high-action single-player FPS game with realistic shooting mechanics, stunning graphics, and intense combat. Step into the battlefield, master powerful weapons, and fight through challenging missions in a war-torn world.
Key Features:
🔫 64 Powerful Weapons – Use a wide range of guns, from rifles to snipers, each with unique handling.
🎨 240 Weapon Skins – Customize your guns with different skins to match your style.
🌍 Realistic Environments – Battle in detailed war zones with lifelike graphics and effects.
🧠 Smart AI Enemies – Fight against enemies that react and adapt to your tactics.
🎮 Smooth Gameplay – Optimized performance for high FPS and lag-free action.
🔥 Epic Story Mode – Experience a thrilling war story with action-packed missions.
Why Play B.A.T.T.L.E.?
Realistic Gunplay – True-to-life shooting mechanics with smooth controls.
High-Quality Graphics – Immersive visuals that bring the battlefield to life.
Full Weapon Customization – Unlock and equip skins to personalize your loadout.
Challenging Combat – Test your skills against advanced AI in intense battles.
If you love FPS games, action-packed shooting, and immersive war stories, B.A.T.T.L.E. is for you. Get ready to fight and become the ultimate warrior!

title: Toy Smash Kaboom!
description:
게임 정보
《장난감 탕! 탕!》는 책상 정리와 타워 디펜스 대전을 결합한 게임입니다! 다양한 장비 조합과 재미있는 전략 설계를 통해 매번 흥미진진한 전투 경험을 선사합니다. 마음에 드는 장난감을 선택하고 지금 바로 출발하세요!
배경 이야기
밤이 깊어지면 아이가 달콤한 잠에 들고, 장난감들은 깊은 잠에서 깨어나 책상 위에서 「꿈 수호전」이라는 신비한 모험을 시작합니다! 이 세계에서 모든 전투는 아이의 상상력과 사랑이 이어지는 순간입니다. “두근두근” 그건 바로 심장이 뛰는 소리!
전투 전략 수립
《장난감 탕! 탕!》에서는 책상 위 장난감의 창의적인 조합으로 치열한 대결을 펼칩니다! 승패는 단순히 장난감 선택뿐 아니라, 책상 공간 속 배치의 예술에 달려있죠! 장난감의 특성과 기능 시너지를 영리하게 결합해 독보적인 전투력을 발휘하세요. 배치가 정교할수록 폭발하는 전투력이 놀랍습니다!

title: Rusty Foodies
description:
게임 정보
도시 시궁쥐의 삶은 불행과 고난의 연속입니다. 도시 생태계의 최하위인 시궁쥐에겐 도시의 모든 존재가 위험하기 짝이 없죠. 굶주린 길고양이, 갑작스레 범람하는 하수도, 사각을 노리는 까마귀들까지... 하지만 역시 가장 두려운 존재는 바로 "인간"입니다.
여기, 시궁쥐 "아티" 일가의 삶 또한 불행과 고난의 연속이었습니다. 이번 달은 특히나 더 불행했죠. 먹이 비슷한 것도 입에 대기 힘들었으니 말입니다. 하지만 이 또한 지나가리라. 영원히 불행하란 법은 없는 것일까요? 호화로운 만찬이 그들의 눈 앞에 펼쳐졌습니다.
...사실 영원히 불행한 경우도 있죠. 뒤늦게 돌아온 아티를 기다리고 있던 것은 독이 든 음식을 먹고 싸늘하게 눈을 감은 가족들이었습니다. 절망한 주인공 앞에 나타나서 태연하게 독이 든 음식을 집어 먹는 바퀴벌레. 그 광경을 본 아티의 머릿속은 한 가지 끔찍한 계획만으로 가득 차게 되는데...
아티의 계획은 결코 쉽지 않을 것입니다. 가족들 입에 겨우 풀칠이나 해주던 것이 한계였던 그가 온갖 훼방꾼들을 피해 이 새로운 파트너이자 이름난 미식가인 바퀴벌레 친구들을 만족시킬 만한 질 좋고 많은 양의 음식을 구하는 것은 불가능에 가깝겠죠.

title: From The Top
description:
게임 정보
Fusing Battling tops and Roguelike Deckbuilding together to create an endless  decent source of battling tops fun! Collect new tops, combine them together, pair 'em up with synergistic relic and go on a short adventure, From the Top!
Features
Realistic simulation-:  Ready, Launch, and Battle! Use your spinning top to knock your opponents out or simply out last them in a battle of attrition.
But these aren't your regular old battling tops, these ones have Smash at them with full force, build a wall between to defend yourself, Fly high to the sky and strike and many more abilities to choose from!

title: Tomodakill
description:
게임 정보
Tomodakill is a free multiplayer shooter based on one of the largest Twitch Italy communities. You can play as your favorite streamer and jump into action!

Two teams of 6 players will face off in a fast-paced Deathmatch. The battles will take place on 3 different maps, small and chaotic, full of nooks and secrets. Weapons and healing items will be found on the ground, and the action will be even more intense thanks to the many Jumpads! The first team to reach 30 kills wins. What are you waiting for? Dive in!

title: Farm Life Simulator
description:
게임 정보
🚜 Farm Life Simulator – Build, Grow, Thrive!
Welcome to Farm Life Simulator, where you can shape your own farm, cultivate crops, raise animals, and create a thriving homestead in a dynamic open world. With full freedom to build, expand, and explore, every farm is unique—grow it your way!
🏡 Build & Expand Your Dream Farm
Place buildings, barns, other various structures wherever you like with free placement.
Upgrade and expand your land—start small and grow into a massive farm.
Customize your farm with decorations, signs, and crafted structures.
🌾 Plant, Grow, and Harvest Crops
Plow fields, plant a variety of crops, and manage soil conditions.
Water, fertilize, and care for your plants to ensure a bountiful harvest.
Experience realistic crop growth—plants progress over time and can wither if neglected.
Weather matters! Rain can water crops naturally, while dry seasons require extra care.
🐄 Raise & Care for Animals
Own and manage chickens, cows, and other farm animals.
Feed, water, and care for them to keep them happy and productive.
Chickens lay eggs, cows produce milk, and animals react to their environment.
Build pens, coops, and pastures to create the perfect home for your animals.
🚜 Use Tractors & Tools to Work the Land
Drive and use tractors, plows, mowers, and planting tools to cultivate fields.
Mow overgrown grass, till soil, and harvest crops with realistic equipment.
Upgrade your farming gear to increase efficiency and unlock new mechanics.
🛠️ Craft, Build, and Upgrade
Gather resources to craft essential tools, decorations, and farm structures.

title: AnimaCircus
description:
게임 정보
Dearest public, welcome to the feline circus!
In AnimaCircus, the player gets into a circus troupe made out exclusively by cats, performing to a human audience excited to see your tricks.
Using the keyboard keys or controller buttons, press the direction shown on-screen at the right time to guarantee the best show possible. But don’t worry if you get it wrong, the spectators are very comprehensive.
Main Features
Play 20 songs composed especially for this show and pick the difficulty that better suits you;
See the set come to life as you get many notes consecutively;
Customize your avatar, picking their skin and eyes color, as well your best clothes.

title: Astral Planes
description:
게임 정보
Collect sounds, improvise grooves, and evolve the soundtrack in a procedural music-driven world where every move is part of the song. Astral Planes is a music-based physics-driven game where gameplay isn't just synced to music-- it is the music. As you navigate obstacles and collect notes, you'll generate a live, interactive soundtrack with every action.
This is a rhythm game without a script - you aren't matching anything - you're creating. Select a plane and feel the vibe, with or without friends. Every note you collect is added to an evolving loop. The music changes as you play, leading to unexpected grooves. Every session is unique.

title: Blossom Breeze
description:
게임 정보
Slow down and organize some petals.
Blossom Breeze is easy and simple to play.
Control Beanie to clear petals that have fallen by matching three in a row. Blossom Breeze is a single screen, top down, 2D game that matches your pace of life. Set the intensity to low to leisurely clear the board and clear your mind. Or set the intensity to high to engage in a chaotic, fast paced puzzle clearing mayhem. Setup combos to slow down the next set of petals to keep ahead of the Blossom Breeze.
Select from different petal sets including Standard, Enhanced, Pixelly and Dog View.
Keyboard works great but a controller works even better.
The game starts with petals falling from a tree above. The higher levels have bigger boards and more petals falling. The branch above fills with petals which fall after the branch is full. Change how fast the branch fills with petals by changing the intensity between three levels.

title: A Mirror
description:
게임 정보
"The mirror is a thing not meant for mortal eyes, its frame slick with an unnatural sheen as though carved from the petrified bones of something long dead yet never truly silent. The surface not mere glass, but a pane wrought from the void itself, the reflection warped in ways too subtle to notice at first. Wrong beyond articulation" 
In A Mirror, Darkly things may not be as they seem. In this first-person puzzle game, you find objects in the mirror's reflection in order to escape the nightmare world you have been brought to. 
Features
Explore the world in first-person perspective, interacting with your surroundings
Find objects using a novel mechanic - using a mirror to look behind you to see if the object appears differently and identify it to progress.
Psychological horror, building tension through audio and visual elements.
A short experience, akin to an H.P. Lovecraft novel or internet creepypasta.

title: Pub Toilet Simulator 25
description:
게임 정보
In Pub Toilet Simulator 25, players race through the randomly generated layout of "Spetherwoons", a traditional English pub, in a fast-paced, first-person scramble to reach the toilet before their piss-meter fills up. The pub features winding corridors, multiple floors, and dead ends, with each level growing larger and more complicated.
Players must also keep their beer-meter full by picking up beers scattered throughout the pub. Delicious pub food can be collected for extra points, but wasting time on food increases the risk of failure.
As the levels progress, the layout of Spetherwoons becomes more complex, demanding quick decision-making, efficient beer management, and fast navigation. The goal is to reach the toilet as quickly as possible while maximizing your score and surviving the increasingly confusing environment.

Choose your character, grab a beer, and get ready for the piss-fueled adventure of a lifetime!

title: Surface Tension
description:
게임 정보
Construct a resilient base, strategically defend against relentless hostiles, harness vital resources. Don't forget to unlock technologies to combat a spreading corruption and restore nature in this roguelike base defense.
Venture into a world transformed by a creeping corruption. In Surface Tension, you'll face the challenge of rebuilding and defending a fragile ecosystem against relentless hostile forces.
Resource Management:
Gather and manage a diverse range of resources. Whether through manual collection or automated buildings, you'll need to strategically acquire materials to fuel your technological progress.

title: Exo Digger
description:
게임 정보
Earth, 2147. The planet is overpopulated and polluted. Billions of people live in poverty and unemployment. Only a select few the lucky winners of a lottery manage to secure jobs. CONGRATULATIONS!
You have won the Galactic Labor Reserve lottery!
XenoMining Inc. is sending you to Planet PX-173, where you will work in the mines.
• Contract duration: 6 months
• Job description: Mineral extraction
• Payment: Based on your mining performance

title: Monitor State
description:
게임 정보
              Step into the role of an operator in a retro-futuristic dystopia, where a screen displays the world under constant surveillance. With moral dilemmas similar to Papers, Please and subtle hints of Pony Island’s unsettling atmosphere, Monitor State puts you in control of a surveillance system, watching citizens, enforcing laws, and uncovering a web of secrets that could change everything.
              A Living, Breathing World
Gripping Storyline: Dive into a detailed dystopian world where each case reveals hidden stories, drawing you into a thrilling plot.

title: The Mirror Dimension
description:
게임 정보
The Mirror Dimension is a Co-Op psychological thriller and horror game that can be played with 1 to 4 players. In the game, players will investigate paranormal activities in a visited house, attempting to solve events occurring in different dimensions. By confronting and eliminating the spiritual entities you encounter, you'll strive to identify the problem in your own dimension. Are you ready to explore different dimensions and uncover their mysteries?
Everything around you is filled with surprises that can distract you. As you interact with your environment, you might unknowingly transition to a different dimension. Everything can change at any moment; observe your surroundings carefully and find a way to survive by uncovering the secrets of the dimensions!
Each dimension has its own unique plotlines. Explore the dimensions, uncover their secrets, and use this knowledge to survive! Do you think you can make it through?

title: Million Depth
description:
게임 정보
Million Depth is a "deep-diving action strategy game" where Moma, a human girl from outer space, visits Earth to find her only friend, and dives into the million-floor deep underground world known as Million Depth.
As Moma, players will have to design and craft their own original weapons and engage in strategic time-freezing battles to survive the hostile environment of Naraka Akasha in order to reach the bottom and uncover the true identity of Moma's elusive friend.
To Moma, left drifting all alone in space, messaging her Earth friend was the only thing that kept her going.
After all of her dearest crewmates died from a virus, the only thing to do was the daily aptitude test.
But as long as Moma could imagine the scenery of Earth as described by her friend, she managed to live through the boredom and solitude of life on the ship.

title: Disco Samurai
description:
게임 정보
개요
디스코 사무라이는 펜실베이니아의 사이버펑크 도시 디스코를 배경으로 한 독특한 리듬 전투 게임입니다. 공격, 방어, 대시 및 기타 능력을 음악의 비트에 맞춰 부드럽게 결합하여 당신의 기술을 시험해보세요. 법과 규칙이 없는 세상에서, 검을 마스터한 자만이 영광과 번영을 누릴 자격이 있습니다. 상상 이상의 음모에 휘말린 반항적인 학생 폭스가 되어, 볼륨을 높이고 신스웨이브와 록의 전율적인 사운드스케이프의 리듬을 잡고, 미니멀리스트 디오라마 아레나를 통해 싸워 나가세요!
상세 정보
전투
디스코 사무라이에서는 당신과 적의 행동이 음악의 비트에 맞춰 동기화됩니다. 사무라이로서 적을 존중해야 합니다 – 적의 공격 지표에 주의를 기울이고, 패리, 블록, 회피를 번갈아 사용하여 적을 지치게 해야 합니다. 주저하지 말고 주도권을 잡아 공격하거나, 적을 환경적 위험 요소로 차서 추가 피해를 입히는 등의 특수 능력을 사용하세요. 비트를 놓치면 당신은 죽은 목숨입니다 – 하지만 레벨은 짧으니 다시 시도하는 데 몇 초밖에 걸리지 않습니다.

보스 전투
복잡한 공격 패턴을 가진 매우 위험한 보스들과 맞서 싸우세요. 각 보스는 자신만의 독특한 노래에 맞춰 공격 패턴이 동기화되어 있어, 각 싸움에 개인적인 터치를 더합니다.

맞춤 음악
레벨을 완료한 후, 게임에 로드한 맞춤 음악으로 다시 플레이할 수 있습니다.
스토리
세상은 디스코 사무라이에 미쳐 있습니다 – 사이버펑크 메타버스인 디스코를 배경으로 한 게임입니다. 모든 사람이 이 게임을 하고 있습니다 – 당신의 이웃, 당신의 상사, 아마도 당신이 가장 싫어하는 정치인까지도요. 사람들은 가상 부동산, 자동차, 디자이너 옷을 구매할 뿐만 아니라 심지어 보험까지 가입하고 있습니다! 미친 소리 같나요? 저에게 말해보세요 – 게임이 출시된 이후로 세계 범죄율이 77% 이상 감소했습니다! 사소한 범죄로 감옥에 썩느니, 디스코에서 악명 높은 현상금 사냥꾼이 되어 아무런 결과 없이 활동하는 게 낫지 않겠어요?

이 이야기는 건축과 미술 분야에서 이름을 날리고 싶은 반항적인 학생 폭스를 따라갑니다. 가상 반달리즘과 픽셀 피를 흘리는 것이 강의를 듣는 것보다 그녀의 스타일에 더 맞기 때문에, 디스코 세계는 ""브루탈리즘""의 새로운 정의를 배우게 될 것입니다.

title: Sticker Kittens
description:
게임 정보


스티커 새끼 고양이(Sticker Kittens)는 새끼 고양이를 맞춰야 하는 스도쿠 같은 퍼즐입니다. 새끼 고양이를 키우고 함께 노는 방법도 배울 수 있어요!

title: Ascendant Dawn
description:
게임 정보
Ascendant Dawn는 잔혹한 청동기 시대 세계에서 유목 부족을 이끄는 대전략 게임입니다. 평화로운 목동부터 피에 굶주린 약탈자까지 다양한 방식으로 플레이할 수 있습니다. 당신의 부족의 운명은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다; 그들을 영광으로 이끌 것인가 아니면 적의 희생양이 될 것인가. Ascendant Dawn는 국가를 성장시키는 대신 유목 부족을 성장시키는 대전략 장르의 신선한 접근 방식입니다. 시간이 지남에 따라 기술과 전통으로 부족을 개선하십시오.
문화
각각 고유한 수정자와 전통을 가진 수십 가지 문화 중에서 선택하십시오. 또한 다양한 난이도의 다섯 가지 시작 중에서 선택하십시오. 전통을 제정하고 제거하여 문화를 영향을 미치고 다양한 메커니즘과 플레이 스타일을 가능하게 합니다.
세계
Ascendant Dawn의 세계는 청동기 시대를 기반으로 하며 다양한 환경을 특징으로 합니다. 툰드라, 초원, 숲, 산, 사막은 모두 고유한 영향을 미칩니다.
전쟁
문화마다 추가 고유 유닛이 있는 다양한 유닛 유형. 군대를 구축하려면 적절한 자원, 인구 및 심지어 가축이 필요합니다. 지형이 성공에 큰 영향을 미치는 2D 전장에서 군대를 지휘하십시오. 외교와 무역을 사용하여 전쟁이 시작되기 전에 적의 중요한 자원(예: 주석)을 차단하여 승리를 확보하십시오.
정착지
부족으로서 정착지를 설립하거나 정복하여 제국으로의 여정을 시작하십시오. 정착지 관리는 Ascendant Dawn에 완전히 새로운 차원을 추가합니다. 질병과 기근과 같은 함정을 피하면서 건설에 집중하십시오. 정착지의 인구가 증가하고 감소함에 따라 이는 지도에 반영됩니다.
왕조
왕조를 관리하고 성장시키며 위대함으로 이끌어 가십시오. 캐릭터가 죽으면 상속인의 통제를 받습니다. 그러나 가족을 조심하십시오. 그들은 당신을 음모할 수 있습니다.
인구
인구는 가장 귀중한 자원입니다. 인구 시스템은 장기적인 문제를 생각하게 만듭니다. 인구 붕괴와 같은 문제는 항상 존재하는 위협이며 농부를 군인으로 강요하면 식량이 생산되지 않습니다. 인간 인구 외에도 가축 떼를 통제할 수 있습니다.
계절

title: Crucible of the Forgotten
description:
게임 정보
Overcome a series of challenging stages in this roguelite horde survival game by developing your power with autocasting spells across many different dimensions, including items, upgrades, talents, and more that interact with each other to produce many unique and powerful builds.
SURVIVE, EXPLORE, and ASCEND TO POWER
Crucible of the Forgotten combines the simple moment-to-moment tactical gameplay of horde survival roguelites with the depth of build crafting found in classic ARPGs and strategic evolution of the player character over a much shorter period of time.
You will rapidly gain power through your choices, defining your build as you progress through the stages in the game, with sessions taking anywhere from 10 minutes to several hours.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR BUILD

title: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home
description:
게임 정보
Ever dreamed of being a home owner? Welcome to the Squeakross: Home Squeak Home program!
You just got into a fresh new home for your tiny rodent friend, but… it’s empty! Solve puzzles from the Home Squeak Home Catalog and transform them into splendid furniture and accessories to dress it up!
Relaxing Puzzle Solving: Learn how to play in 5 minutes, and solve logic-numbers puzzles at your rhythm, no time pressure.
Scared of puzzles? Worry not! Your rodent friend is here to help. Customize your game experience: Toggle hints, Solve a random cell, or use the brand new Logic-Assist system that lets you preview possible solutions!
No assistance needed? You can disable all those options if you prefer to be challenged.
Our Home Squeak Home catalog features many different styles of interior decor, from basic housing supplies to extravagant ones to match a broad range of tastes. You will also find many accessories to dress your rodent friend.
Aaah… The joy of seeing a Squeakross puzzle transform into a beautiful object is so satisfying!
Shape your rodent to your liking in the world's first (we think??). From snout to tail, decide what kind of friend you want to have by your side!

title: cultivation of the strong
description:
게임 정보
'강자의 자기 수양'은 세계 빅맵 개발과 3인칭 생존 사격, 로그라이크의 결합이다.
마음속에 여자가 없으면 칼을 빼는 것은 자연히 신이 난다.진정한 강자가 되려면 여자들의 시험을 통과해야 한다!
제국의 가장 위대한 영웅, 도전을 받아들일 준비가 되셨습니까?
* 게임의 특징
독특한 오픈 월드 맵
3인칭 사격에 Roguelike, 전통 놀이를 뛰어넘어 더욱 재미있는 경험을 선사합니다
autokwd: cultivation of the strong,강자의 자기 수양

title: Backrooms: Step Into The Void
description:
게임 정보
"If you're not careful and you noclip out of reality in the wrong areas, you'll end up in the Backrooms, where it's nothing but the stink of old moist carpet, the madness of mono-yellow, the endless background noise of fluorescent lights at maximum hum-buzz, and approximately six hundred million square miles of randomly segmented empty rooms to be trapped in

"Backrooms: Step Into The Void" is a first-person psychological horror game that thrusts players into the unsettling and disorienting labyrinth of the Backrooms. Combining elements of intense psychological terror with heart-pounding action sequences, the game challenges players to navigate through an eerie, seemingly infinite maze of monotonous yellow rooms and fluorescent-lit hallways. With a focus on atmosphere and immersion, "Backrooms: Step Into The Void" presents a relentless sense of dread, as players must solve puzzles, evade sinister entities, and uncover the mysteries lurking within the void. The game's haunting environment and unpredictable threats ensure a spine-chilling experience that keeps players on edge from start to finish.
Atmosphere

Immerse yourself in the unsettling world of the Backrooms, where each step deepens your descent into a maze of musty, dimly-lit corridors and vast, empty rooms. The oppressive hum of flickering fluorescent lights and the scent of aged carpet create an eerie, claustrophobic environment. Shadows dance at the edge of your vision, and distant noises hint at lurking dangers. Every level blurs reality further, heightening the tension as you strive to escape the horrors stalking you. Can you find your way out, or will you be lost forever in the madness?
Exploration

Navigate through a variety of unique levels inspired by the original Backrooms concept. Explore The Lobby, visit Pipe Dreams, check out Terror Hotel, enjoy Level Fun, immerse yourself in Sublimity and many other delightful locations.
Be careful!

Beware of the lurking horrors that inhabit the Backrooms. As you navigate the endless maze, you must stay vigilant and cautious. Stray from the path, and you risk encountering malevolent entities that stalk the shadows, each more terrifying and relentless than the last. These creatures are drawn to your presence, and a single wrong turn could lead you straight into their grasp. In the Backrooms, danger is ever-present, and survival depends on your wits and awareness.

title: Madam of Malice
description:
게임 정보
정말 소름 돋네. 게임하자고?
내가 선택할 수 있는 건가? 카드 게임이라니, 흥미롭네. 근데 이 카드에 있는 여자는 누구야? 저택에 있는 도둑처럼 보이는데, 맞지? 좋아, 그래서 내가 뭘 해야 해? 어, 어, 어! 그걸 왜 당겨? 이게 뭐야? 게임판이라고? 좋아, 규칙이나 알려줘, 이 *친 할망구야!

title: Whiskers Wonderland
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Whisker's Wonderland!
Embark on a chilling adventure through the dilapidated halls of Whisker's Restaurant, a long-forgotten establishment where horrors lurk and secrets await discovery.
Exploring the Restaurant:
Enter the eerie ambiance of Whisker's Restaurant, where every creaking floorboard and flickering light hints at the sinister history that haunts its halls. Traverse through the abandoned dining areas, navigate the decaying kitchens, and brave the unsettling atmosphere that pervades every corner of this forgotten locale. But tread carefully, for beyond the public spaces lies the forbidden domain of the animatronic workers' lair, a place shrouded in mystery and dread.
Escaping Whiskers:
Beware the enigmatic presence of Whiskers, the sarcastic and cunning proprietor of Whisker's Restaurant. Concealing his true intentions behind a facade of hospitality, Whiskers manipulates you, leading you deeper into the darkness. Solve sinister puzzles, confront your deepest fears, and uncover the truth behind his dark past. Can you escape Whiskers' grasp and survive the horrors that await you?

title: Sliding Hero
description:
게임 정보
슬라이딩 히어로는 장애물을 만날 때까지 한 방향으로 미끄러져 이동하는 탐험 퍼즐 게임입니다.

저택의 수많은 시련을 이겨내고 저택에 갇힌 상황에 숨겨진 진실의 가면을 벗겨낼 수 있을까요?
이동과 미스터리가 핵심인 메트로배니아 퍼즐 게임
불길한 베네치아 저택에 갇힌 상태에서, 순발력과 지력으로 세레니시마의 군인 루카 시코모로가 탈출하도록 도와주세요. Sliding Hero에서는 이동할 때마다 전략을 시험하게 됩니다. 장애물에 부딪힐 때까지 한 방향으로만 슬라이딩할 수 있어, 이동 그 자체가 퍼즐이 되니까요. 1700년대 베네치아와 카니발 가면 속 신비에 영감을 받은, 복잡하며 어둠에 휩싸인 세계를 탐험하세요. 모든 그림자 속에 위험과 속임수가 숨어 있습니다

title: Death Remains
description:
게임 정보
WHAT IS DEATH REMAINS?
Death Remains is a relentless open-world survival game where the dead never rest—and neither do you. Face off against overwhelming zombie hordes and ever-shifting factions in a world where permadeath forces you to choose wisely at every turn.
HOW YOU PLAY!
Whether you dive into online multiplayer on player-run servers hosting up to 100 players or team up in local co-op for up to four, the challenge is real. Roam vast landscapes where day gives way to night, winter encroaches, and nature slowly reclaims deserted cities. Experience dynamic events such as reactivating power plants and transforming trains into mobile bases for transport and supplies.
Your survival hinges on every choice—from scavenging for scarce resources and crafting weapons to constructing fortified shelters by felling trees and sawing wood. Navigate treacherous terrain in physics-driven vehicles while honing your skills in carpentry, cooking, farming, fishing, and more—all while battling hunger, thirst, illness, and other hardships.

title: Gummy Nightmares
description:
게임 정보
Step into the enigmatic world of "Gummy Nightmares" as Player One, a young boy who awakens in a mysterious amusement park with no memory of his past or identity. Guided by a mysterious girl named Jenny, you must use your slingshot, whistle, and backpack to battle evil robots, solve puzzles, and find clues to recover your lost memories.
Welcome to Gummy Park!
Gummy Park was once a lively amusement park filled with joy and laughter, but one day, an accident turned everything sinister. Now, you must explore this eerie park haunted by sinister robots, uncover its secrets, and remember who you are before the nightmares consume you!

The Robots
Beware of the sinister plushie robots that haunt the park, trying to keep you from discovering the truth. Survive by hiding, setting traps, or confronting them. As you progress through the story, these robots will become increasingly aggressive. Fortunately, along your journey, you will also encounter friendly robots who will help you achieve your objectives and fight the evil ones!

Your slingshot is your best friend! Use it to shoot active elements like electric boxes, gumball dispensers, or fire extinguishers to attack your enemies and slow them down. The slingshot isn't just for fighting; it can also be used to interact with your surroundings, solve puzzles, and unlock secrets. Most importantly, remember to regularly fill your backpack with gumballs from the dispensers located throughout the park.

In certain areas of the park, you'll encounter patrolling robots such as Gummy and Scrawny. Fighting them isn't always an option; at times, survival hinges on finding a hiding spot. Seek sanctuary inside lockers, beneath beds, or within the rides situated in the lobby. Additionally, the karts in the lobby provide a means of evading your adversaries.
One of the distinctive features of Gummy Nightmares is the option to set traps for the patrolling robots. To do so, you must first collect specific baits scattered throughout the park, then place them inside traps like the meat fridge in the kitchen or the giant bear slide in the lobby. Next, you'll need to draw the attention of the robots by creating loud noises with your whistle and luring them into the traps.

title: Last Moon
description:
게임 정보
Last Moon is an action RPG that pays homage to the classics of the 90s. Step into the shoes of a Lunar Knight and traverse a vast, ruined world, confront tainted creatures and upgrade your abilities in your quest to restore peace.

While the giant If harbours life, human greed triggers the destruction of the Moon. Corrupted creatures appear, and the world falls into chaos. Only a true Lunar Knight can stop it, and it’s you. Armed with courage, your fate seems sealed, but will you manage to save the situation and bring peace to If?

Smooth and tuned controls, alone or with a friend
Dodge, block and slay the corrupted creatures! All controls and movements are tightly tuned to give the best game experience mixing old school and new generation action-RPG. Local co-op will allow players to embark on this journey with a friend.

Become more powerful
Upgrade your Lunar Knight powers, forge your weapons, choose your skills and fight with corrupted creatures to increase your weapons mastery levels.

Find and equip more than 30 Runes of the Ancients scattered and hidden around If's world. Choose wisely the runes to equip to make the best fighting strategy and adapt it to the situation as you will have to fight more than 50 unique monsters.
Experience the day and night cycles and discover the differences, the inaccessible places and the secrets hidden at different times but be careful with the night, dangerous creatures are sometimes hidden in the shadows…

- Choose among 8 weapons, more than 30 runes, 10 summoning spells and learn up to 70 skills to match your playstyle. Play alone or with a friend in local co-op to live this great adventure together.
- Face more than 50 unique monsters created by the Lunar Corruption! The giant If is invaded by all sorts of corrupted creatures and huge bosses that you will have to fight to restore the peace.
- Feel the wind through the foliages, explore winding, interconnected paths, and discover unique environments with a lovely, cute and charismatic character.
- Save the Selene villagers from corruption, and help them to rebuild the village and bring peace back.

title: Alpine Lake
description:
게임 정보
If you're a fan of Stardew Valley, The Sims, or Animal Crossing, Alpine Lake is the perfect cozy getaway for you.



Shape your inn from the ground up by designing and constructing buildings entirely from scratch. Your imagination sets the limits – create any layout you can envision!



Every guest arrives with their own personality and narrative. Extend a warm welcome, provide them a cozy haven, and unravel the stories they carry within.



Embark on a journey through an expansive alpine region, uncovering hidden treasures and valuable resources. Bring along your faithful canine companion for a hike and see what buried goodies you might unearth along the way!



Engage with a lively community of townspeople, each with their own unique stories. Support your neighbors by sending your guests to local businesses, adding to the collective growth of the town.



Cultivate your own farm to harvest top-notch ingredients, ensuring delightful meals for your guests. Enhance your culinary expertise by upgrading your kitchen and mastering an expanding assortment of recipes acquired on your journey! You may even build, decorate, and open your restaurant on your property for the best eating experience you can provide for your guests!



Lose yourself in one of the many relaxing activities, such as fishing, photography, and crafting.

title: 17.waves TD
description:
게임 정보
온라인 코옵 타워 디펜스
외행성 W4-V35의 17개 콜로니가 공격받고 있습니다! 17.waves에서 전부 살아남을 수 있을까요?
최대 4명의 친구들과 온라인에서 모여 몰려오는 외계인 무리들로부터 기지를 지키십시오.
협력을 통해 코인과 자원을 모으고 타워를 만들어 유지해야 합니다.
콜로니 수호
[b]외계인의 습격[/b] -- 외계인 벌레들이 기지를 습격합니다! 놈들의 습격 경로를 학습하고 방어 계획을 세우십시오.
[b]타워 제작[/b] -- 다양한 유형의 타워 중에 원하는 타워를 선택해 가장 효율적인 방식으로 배치하십시오.
협력이 중요합니다
내 역할 찾기 -- 7가지 특징적인 업그레이드 중 하나를 이용해 각 팀원을 특화시키십시오. 플릿 풋, 로드 로드, 오버클록과 같이 서로 다른 특징이 있습니다!
[b]자원 채굴[/b] -- 타워는 에너지를 소모하므로 계속 충전해줘야 합니다. 자원을 모아 타워에 주입해 계속 가동하도록 해야 합니다.

title: Let's bounce! Popsicle boy!
description:
게임 정보


Let's bounce! Popsicle boy! is a casual rogue-like game with mechanics inspired by Breakout. When you defeat cute enemies or break bricks, you can obtain powerful weapons. Seize the opportunity to gain greater combat benefits!
Gameplay:
Unique collision combat system based on the rules of "Breakout"!
Randomly configured level layout brings you a different experience in every game!
Unlock characters with different attributes and special skills!
Thirty attribute/skill upgrade cards provide powerful support for every challenge!
Defeat randomly appearing enemies and BOSS, and unlock rich game achievements!

title: Wreckage
description:
게임 정보
용감한 영혼과 생존자여, 이 소식을 들으십시오!

대담한 운전자여, 능숙한 총잡이여, 창의적인 기어 헤드여, 그리고 숙련된 트럭 운전사여, 행동할 시간이 왔습니다!

파괴의 여파에서 놀랄 만한 저항력을 보이셨습니다. 굴러간 유리 사막을 가로지르고 연기에 휩싸인 산을 넘고 무자비한 좀비 무리와 I-95 고속도로에서 용감하게 맞서 싸우셨습니다. 이제 여러분은 낙원의 문턱에 서 있습니다. 문명의 마지막 남은 보루 - 해가 비치는 플로리다 남부의 햇볕이 내리쬐는 습지대에 용감한 개인들의 무질서한 공동체입니다.

그러나 운명은 여러분에게 어려운 도전을 내미고, 여러분은 악명 높은 리버 시티 레이더스에 의해 잡혀, 위험한 검투사 투기장에 강제로 끌려갔습니다. 그러나 두려워하지 마십시오. 이 매장에는 영광을 얻을 수 있는 기회가 놓여 있으며, 우리의 안식처의 거룩한 해변을 차지할 수 있는 기회가 있습니다.

파괴의 챔피언, 자신의 장비를 선택하고 최고의 무기로 무장하고 거대한 경기장에서 경쟁을 떠날 여정을 시작하십시오. 혼돈과 학살에서 무적의 챔피언으로 승리하여 길들어진 상대들의 잔해로 포장된 승리의 길을 걸어 보십시오. 이제 용기를 모으십시오, 도전을 받아들이십시오, 그리고 이 용감하고 비길 데 없는 모험의 땅에서 여러분만의 전설을 쓰십시오!

title: Communite
description:
게임 정보


Communite is a Wholesome, Cozy, MULTIPLAYER City Builder based on kindness and teamwork!

Relax and use your creativity spread new life in an endless world - working together with other players to create your perfect paradise!

Whether its planting plants, growing carrots, designing a desert, or creating vast oceans (with your own volcano island hidden deep within) - the world is what you make of it!

The game is currently in Alpha but already has tons of content ready as we prepare for our next HUGE update!

ALSO COME JOIN OUR DISCORD!!! We're super active and would LOVE to build with you:

title: Dragonscale Monastery
description:
게임 정보
Dragonscale Monastery에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 산의 힘을 이용해 세계와 단절된 수도원의 원장직을 맡으세요. 임무는 성역을 발전시키고 기이한 드래곤의 사육에 대한 미스터리를 파헤치는 것입니다.
주요 특징:
산악 지형: 건설 메커니즘, 꼼꼼한 계획, 자원의 전략적 사용이 결합되어 굉장히 어려운 도전에 대비하세요. 접근하기 어려운 암반에 다리와 사다리를 건설하세요. 극도로 제한된 지형의 잠재력을 전부 발휘할 수 있도록 현명하게 건물을 선택하세요.
드래곤 사육: 드래곤 사육의 복잡한 기술을 마스터하세요. 최고의 종을 짝지어 주고, 새로운 종을 발견하고, 이들의 숨겨진 힘을 끌어내세요. 운명의 결정권을 쥔 통치자의 호의를 얻으세요.

title: Touhou: the Unreachable Oneiroborder
description:
게임 정보
Exquisite Touhou Danmaku, Seven Years in the Making
“The Unreachable Oneiroborder” is a Touhou Project danmaku shoot-em-up fangame. The game is easy to learn, regardless of your prior experience with bullet hells.
Perhaps you’ve imagined your dreams coming true? One day, humans' dreams materialized into reality, satisfying their cravings and fulfilling their desires… a fantastic development, certainly. Yet, after the first nightmare materialized itself, sleep became an unspeakably horrific taboo in Gensokyo. The Dream Manifestation Incident has begun…
Take control of Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sanae Kochiya and Sumireko Usami; uncover the truth behind the suspicious phenomenon, and solve the incident that has shaken Gensokyo's very foundations.

title: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
description:
게임 정보
KISS 는 K-pop의 신나는 세계에 보내는 러브레터입니다.

이 인생 시뮬레이션에서 당신은 인재를 찾고, 일정을 관리하고, 예산을 편성하고, 소셜 미디어를 계획하고, 음악과 패션을 선택하는 강력한 관리자입니다!

차기 K팝 아이돌 그룹 데뷔!


연습생을 선택하세요.


각 연습생은 고유한 특성과 배경 이야기를 가지고 있습니다.
팬들을 열광하게 만들지만 그룹을 망칠 수도 있는 건방진 나쁜 여자를 선택하시겠습니까?
아니면 그녀가 무대에 설 준비가 되기 전에 조금 더 격려가 필요한 수줍은 노래 새와 함께 갈까요?
이 게임에서 당신은 그들의 노래를 듣고, 그들의 성격을 이해하고, 그들의 강점을 찾아 힘을 실어줍니다!
다양한 아이돌 그룹을 모으는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
autokwd: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut

title: Furcifer's Fungeon
description:
게임 정보
Choose from hundreds of unique talents and many spells and items.
Shape your talent tree with your choices.
Be a necromancer, a knight, an electro wizard, or just a pyromaniac!
Highly customizable loadout (over 1 million starting configurations)
Characters with unique abilities and talents can freely switch between different spell sets!

title: Sword Hero
description:
게임 정보
주요 기능:

심리스 오픈 월드: 제한이 없는 광대한 오픈 월드를 탐험하여 자유롭게 시작하세요.
다이나믹 시스템: 날씨, NPC 루틴, 범죄 및 소속 전쟁과 상호 작용합니다.
신체 부위 손상: 혈액이 나는 전투에서 적을 절단하세요.
건축: 집을 짓고 살아남고 번성하기 위해 아이템을 제작하세요.
거대한 보스: 엄청난 적들과의 에픽한 전투를 진행하세요.
물리학과 래그돌: 전투에서 전략적 이점을 얻기 위해 동적 래그돌 메카닉을 활용하세요.
개인화된 진행: 능력과 외모를 사용자 정의하여 강력한 능력과 장비를 잠금 해제하세요.
레벨 스케일링이 없는 적: 성장을 도전하는 진화하는 적과 마주하십시오.
생동감 있는 세계: NPC가 지형을 형성하는 동적 세계에 몰입하세요.
끝없는 가능성: 다양한 활동을 통해 운명을 조종하여 당신의 길을 선택하세요.

위험한 날씨 유형, 매일 반복되는 NPC, 범죄 및 평판 시스템, 다이나믹한 소속 전쟁 등 수십 가지 다이나믹 시스템으로 가득 찬 sandbox 오픈 월드 RPG. 알려진 영웅, 두려워하는 전설, 용병단의 지도자가 되거나 자신만의 수제 보금자리에서 간단한 삶을 유지하세요.



당신은 무명인으로 Sword Hero의 생생한 세계에 던져질 것입니다. 이 섬에는 세계의 새로운 자칭 신에게 부자 상인에 의해 주어진 수수께끼의 목걸이를 제공하는 것이 유일한 목표입니다. - 그의 요청을 따를지 아니면 Wes의 섬에서 다른 유리한 기회를 쫓을지는 완전히 당신에게 달려 있습니다.



보이지 않는 벽 없음 - 시작부터 원하는 곳으로 이동하세요! 그러나 Wes의 황야는 준비되지 않은 자에게는 가혹합니다. 고블린, 트롤, 거대한 나방과 같은 야수들이 땅을 배회하고 있지만 엄격하게 레벨링되지 않습니다. 게임의 시작에 당신을 파괴하는 적들이 충분한 힘을 얻으면 당신을 보고는 달아날 것입니다.



주변의 시뮬레이션된 세계에 대한 모든 세부 사항이 기여합니다. 게임은 당신의 행동뿐만 아니라 다른 캐릭터의 행동에도 반응합니다. 한 번은 마을 대장간 주인인 NPC가 다른 플레이 스루에서는 아내를 잃은 외로운 모험가가 될 수 있습니다.

그들처럼, 당신도 눈앞에 수십 가지 가능성이 있습니다. 의로운지 무자비한지, 주목받는 중심이 되든 고립된 늑대가 되든 주어진 도구를 사용하여 최종 목표에 도달하세요.

그리고 가장 중요한 것은 - 변화입니다. 힘과 시각적으로. 길드에서 순위를 올리거나 더 나은 장비를 받거나 만들거나 찾거나 훔치거나, 고대의 힘을 배우거나 또는 Deep World에서 로 몸 부위를 교환하여 자연스럽게 얻을 수 있는 힘보다 더 강력해질 수 있습니다.

title: Kiosk Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Kiosk Simulator is an action-packed comedic take on the hustles of running a big city kiosk and the nostalgia of reaching that lone open kiosk on a rainy late night.
Roleplay
Take on the role of a kiosk’s owner in Cologne, Germany.
Restock, serve customers, maintain and protect your kiosk against robbery and vandalism!
Vibrant Cast and Dynamic Gameplay
Each customer could be a loyal customer, a potential shoplifter or even a troublemaker!
Difficulty Curve
Tougher antagonists/bosses might take away your hard-earned cash - so be prepared for a challenge!

title: Algolemeth
description:
게임 정보
Create AI and Conquer the Dungeon.
Algolemeth is a dungeon RPG where you send golems equipped with program into a dungeon for fully automated exploration.
Challenge the Dungeon through Trial and Error!
As an alchemist, players create autonomously operating golems, forming parties to undertake automatic dungeon conquests. Once the golems are dispatched into the dungeon, all you can do is watch. Analyze enemy actions, iterate through trial and error, and aim to conquer the dungeon!
Bring Back Parts and Strengthen Your Golems!
Various enhancement parts can be found in the dungeon. Among them are those that directly increase the golem's physical abilities and modules that allow for new action logic. Create your own unique golems with the parts you acquire!

title: Horse Racing Manager
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of horse racing and construct a remarkable rags-to-riches narrative. Start as a humble stablehand and ascend the industry by establishing your very own horse racing stable. This dynamic game offers freedom and deep simulation.
Diverse Career Paths
Start your journey by honing your skills in established stables, mastering the intricacies of the sport. As you accumulate the necessary resources, seize the opportunity to establish your very own stable.
Breed the Next Champion with the Pseudo-DNA Feature
Delve into the complexities of horse genetics and breeding, aiming to produce the ultimate racing superstar with our life mimicking Pseudo-DNA feature.
Tailor Your Horse's Training and Nutrition
Fine-tune your horse's journey to greatness with personalized training and dietary choices. Decide whether to amplify its natural speed or develop its stamina for endurance races. Every decision impacts its performance, sculpting a unique path to the winner's circle.
Step into the saddle and either watch your horse's performance from the sidelines or take direct control during the race, making split-second decisions that could lead to victory. Embark on a journey, progressing from racing on obscure back alley tracks to competing on the global stage for substantial prize money.
Hire team of professionals, including jockeys, head trainers, trainers, veterinarians, farriers, stablehands, and even landscapers.
Invest in your stable's facilities to provide top-notch training and care for your horses.
Keep a vigilant eye on your financial resources, managing your budget to ensure the sustainability and growth of your stable.
Remain up-to-date with a comprehensive news system that delivers the latest updates on races, competitors, and industry developments.

Forge your destiny in the heart-pounding realm of horse racing, where your choices and strategies will determine your path to glory. Can you lead your stable to victory and become a true legend in the world of equestrian sports? The journey begins now.

title: Moonshot
description:
게임 정보

Embark on an unprecedented journey in Moonshot, a game that masterfully blends survival and tycoon elements within the thrilling setting of space colonization. Set in the year 2027, where private global entities have ignited a new space race for resource acquisition, you are at the forefront of this interstellar venture.

Your Mission: Begin by constructing your very own rocket, assembling a skilled team, and making history as the first astronaut to set foot on the Moon since 1969. What will you encounter in this alien landscape? How will you adapt to the hostile environment that awaits?

Moonshot's Realism: Experience space exploration in the near future, where the technology is grounded in today's reality or in advanced prototype stages. Forget star gates or teleportation - this is a journey akin to what real astronauts will soon undertake (hopefully)!




















Add to Wishlist: Support us in creating this unique experience by adding Moonshot to your wishlist now!

title: The Tragedy at Deer Creek
description:
게임 정보
In the winter of 1997, photographer Charlotte Gray ventures into the remote woods of Alaska, to the derelict logging camp at Deer Creek, in order to complete her project 'Abandoned Alaska.'
Having photographed ghost towns throughout the Midwest, Charlotte expects to find the worn remains of a piece of American labor history, but what she finds is a place that seems to be eerily frozen in time, harboring numerous secrets sleeping deep beneath the Alaskan snow.
Bit by bit, she finds fragments from the lives of the people who once lived here. Piecing together the fragments, Charlotte slowly starts to unravel the tragedy that befell Deer Creek and its people.
'The Tragedy at Deer Creek' is a narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game that tells a mournful tale of family, loss, and loyalty, exploring the lengths we are willing to go to protect the ones we love.

title: Punk Juice
description:
게임 정보


Join a band with two crass, potty-mouthed punks, Ricki and Max. What else do you have going on Tuesday nights? Curate your style, endure the trials and tribulations of public transit, and play dead-end gigs! Go on mediocre dates, thrift with your besties, buy overpriced coffee, and complain about the cost of rent in this Seattle-inspired grungy city. Punk Juice invites you to recreate your life… Only worse!
WHAT KIND OF PUNK ARE YOU?

Fully customize your character from their hair to their socks! Your punk reflects whatever inner rebel lies within you. Stay up to date with the latest fashions, shop for "new" clothes at the thrift store, and befriend new styles from your friends.
PLAY DEAD-END GIGS

Unravel an overarching narrative where every decision you make decides your fate. Play rhythm mini games to make a name for yourself in the music scene, be it rivals, friends, or new connections. Go on adventures with your bandmates to build your friendships and unlock extra pieces of the story.

Check out every nook and cranny that makes up the unique neighborhoods in Punk Juice. You'll find new places, quests, and friends in every hot spot.

Who knows what relationships blossom on your adventure? Will you make new friends, keep it casual, or flirt with the enemy...

title: 100 Cats Greece
description:
게임 정보
100 CATS 그리스 - 최고의 숨겨진 고양이 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

이곳에는 그리스에 숨어있는 100마리의 고양이가 있습니다! 찾아가세요!

title: FSA DRIVING
description:
게임 정보
In FSA Driving, you will become a super courier in the fictional city of Nijnait, navigating the streets and alleys in various high-performance vehicles. Make strategic use of the city's terrain and items, showcasing stunt driving skills to complete thrilling delivery challenges and savor a unique driving experience.

Explore a rich and entertaining open world
Embark on a journey through Nijnait, inspired by the city of Tianjin in China. Speed through bustling urban areas and vast wild outskirts, collecting items, engaging in various mini-games, and experiencing interactive elements integrated into the map.

Unique stunt abilities
Beyond regular driving, master challenging maneuvers such as blade overtaking, water gliding, and airborne gliding—actions that are hard to achieve in real life.

Simulated management elements
Conduct goods trading in specialty shops located across different areas of the city. Buy low, sell high, and race against fluctuating price curves.

Character development aspects
Manage resources such as energy, hunger, and restroom needs, as these values will impact your missions. Restore these values by interacting with various buildings on the map. Enhance your abilities gradually by increasing your driving and stunt proficiency throughout the game.

title: Subversive Memories
description:
게임 정보
Synopsis
Renata has been haunted her entire life by a void within. She needs to find answers that fill the gaps of her past.
She follows a promising track to an abandoned military research base. However, she soon finds out that this place holds secrets beyond her comprehension and that her obsession might cost her a price she can't pay.
About the game
Subversive Memories is set in a fictitious Brazil during the military dictatorship that took place from 1964 to 1985. It talks about the horrors of being oppressed by those who should protect us and the memories of the victims of a ruthless authoritarian regime that kidnapped, censored and killed thousands of people.

title: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an Emotional Adventure
Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature is a peaceful and reflective experience, filled with meaningful collectibles, unique emotion-driven interactions, and environmental puzzles. The orchestral soundtrack emphasizes an intimate storyline of unlikely friendship, loss, and love.

Explore a Colorful World
Travel across vast, beautifully diverse landscapes, each seamlessly blending into the next, filled with unique flora and fauna waiting to be discovered. The progress you make is reflected in the vibrant flowers blooming on the Golem’s back. There are many secrets and collectibles to discover, making for a rewarding exploration experience.

Along the way, you’ll encounter a variety of charming creatures, such as squirrels, peacocks, armadillos, elephants, horses, sand cats and more. During your journey you also meet a curious Fox who turns out to be a helpful ally on your quest. As the adventure unfolds, the Golem and the Fox develop a deep and meaningful bond, highlighting the connection between Nature, and emotions in this ever-changing world.

Solve puzzles that shape the environment around you. Use the Golem’s abilities to interact with the world in creative ways, unlocking new paths and uncovering secrets. Hidden within the remnants of a lost civilization lies the means to reclaim and rejuvenate Nature.

Born again through magic, the Golem is deeply connected to the world around you. Its emotions are influenced by the environment in real time, shaping the weather, plants, and animals nearby. Embark on a journey of self-discovery, seeking purpose and a place to belong in a world reborn.

title: Solnox - Grimoire of Seasons
description:
게임 정보
사계절과 지형 변화 효과를 활용하여 끊임없이 변화하는 전장을 마스터하세요. 나만의 덱을 구성하여 완벽한 시너지 효과를 내고 세 명의 수호자를 이끌고 부정한 생명체를 상대로 승리하는 방법을 배워보세요.




전장은 이제 당신의 것입니다. 다양한 계절 카드를 사용하여 계절의 힘을 불러일으켜 자신과 적의 밑에 놓인 타일을 바꾸세요. 플레이하는 모든 카드가 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 것입니다. 적들이 비슷한 힘을 발휘하여 당신의 죽음을 굳히기 때문에 예측할 수 없는 대학살에 대응하세요.



봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울. 사계절에 내재된 고유한 특성을 발휘하여 강력한 시너지 콤보를 만들어 무자비한 적을 물리치세요. 부패의 확산을 막으려는 헛된 시도로 죽어가는 세상을 되찾으세요.



수호자들은 힘을 합쳐야만 다가오는 타락으로부터 스스로를 지킬 수 있습니다. 매번 신중하게 덱을 구성하거나 실험적인 조합을 시도하여 세 명의 강력한 캐릭터 간의 시너지를 더욱 향상시키세요. 실패할 때마다 더 강해지고, 새로운 카드 슬롯을 잠금 해제하고, 더 강력하고 복잡한 카드를 수집하세요.

title: Orc Warchief: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
Here you have full game, please wishlists if you like our game:


In the free Orc Warchief prologue, you'll be able to manage your Orc Village. Collect resources, expand your city and pursue politics. You have to keep order because orcs like to be naughty. Gameplay will be limited to a few quests compared to the full game.

Many years have passed since the Great War and defeat that the Orcs suffered from vile humans. From that time they hunted us like animals and pressed deeper into our lands. But you decided not to back down one step further. You’re a young Warchief lusting for blood and your warriors want revenge. Reclaim your lands, rebuild your villages and bring doom on our enemies. Raise our warbanner and gather The Horde. We will follow you to death or victory! Lead our Warchief!

Rebuild your destroyed villages and gather resources you need. Hunt for game and prepare supplies for your army. Train your warriors and prepare your weapons. Build your war machines and defences. And bring the revenge your people deserve.

In this strategic city builder your goal is to rebuild the might of The Horde. You need to gather necessary resources to build your buildings and expand your village. Gather food to feed your growing population. Mine metal and forge weapons necessary for your army. Train your warriors and equip them with various armour and gear. Build defences to buy time for preparations and strike when you're ready for war.

You need to manage your resources well and balance between expansion and needs of your clan. Your clan members have different skill sets and will help you in unique ways.

Raiding human settlements or ambushing their caravans increases your Fear and builds your name as a true Warchief. This attracts new Orcs and allows you to expand your population.

Unlock new buildings and special units to grow your military might. Worship your Gods to gain their favour and forbidden powers. Such powers can have a devastating effect on your enemies as well as your subjects and vary depending on the chosen God.

Incite fear among enemies to gather support necessary for warchief but remember that your growing settlement will also attract human attacks so prepare your defences and train your warriors well. Defeat is not an option. A true Orc is born and dies in battle.

title: Tokyo Underground Killer
description:
게임 정보

Neon-infused katana action in a fever dream Tokyo!
Dive into Tokyo's criminal underground as the feared "Shinjuku Vampire" Kobayashi and take out crazy lunatics for just the right price.


・Unrelenting katana combat: Slash, stab and parry your way through hordes of monsters inspired by Japanese demons
・Blood is the key to survival: Use 10 different blood skills to overcome challenging enemies, then suck in their blood to replenish your health and skills
・Fever dream Tokyo: Explore neon-drenched renditions of real places like Shinjuku, Akihabara or Shibuya
・Enjoy Tokyo's nighlife: Between missions you can relax in your own apartment in Shinjuku, buy decorations and play minigames in the city hub
・Hand drawn comic: A bizarre story with crazy characters brought to live in dynamic comic scenes drawn by Hans “Heavy Metal Hanzo” Steinbach
・Thanks, Andrew: Over 1 hour of original electronic music composed by the legendary Andrew Hulshult

title: Summer Road 10-Minute Roguelike
description:
게임 정보


10분 로그라이크 RPG - 바쁜 어른들을 위한
자동전투" x "아이템 수집"x"로그라이크"

화면의 절반을 차지하는 거대한 인벤토리를 활용해 장비를 합성하고 적을 물리쳐라!
전투는 자동이지만, 장비 조합에 따라 캐릭터의 행동이 달라진다.
전략적인 아이템 선택이 승리의 열쇠! 한 번 플레이하는 데 약 10분 정도 소요되어 부담 없이 즐길 수 있다.
선택하는 길과 이벤트에 따라 모험이 달라져, 반복 플레이의 재미가 가득!

추천 대상
아이템 수집가와 빌드 마스터
빠른 플레이 애호가
로그라이크 RPG 매니아



하나의 목표, 무한한 모험

동쪽의 신비로운 빛을 향해 여정을 떠나세요! 매 플레이마다 다른 스토리를 선사하는 10분짜리 RPG입니다. 랜덤 이벤트, 우연한 만남, 그리고 당신의 선택이 길을 결정합니다. 계속해서 플레이하며 새로운 가능성을 발견해 진정한 엔딩을 찾아보세요!



호기심 많은 세 아이가 신비로운 빛의 수수께끼를 풀기 위한 여름 모험을 시작합니다.
그들을 기다리는 시련과 보물은 무엇일까요?


모그모, 여행을 함께하는 신비로운 생명체는 세 개의 아이템을 먹어 새로운 아이템을 만들어냅니다.
상상도 못한 특별한 아이템을 만들기 위해 아이템 조합을 생각해 봅시다!

모그모의 힘을 활용해 모험을 정복하세요!

title: Breath of Space
description:
게임 정보
STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/GameplayGif_03.gif[/img]

Breath of Space는 3인칭 슈팅 게임, 로그라이트, 로그라이크 장르의 요소를 결합한 액션으로 가득 찬 비디오 게임입니다. 이 게임은 광활한 Aegea Space Mining Facility를 배경으로 하며, 여기에서 다양한 위협에 맞서 싸우고 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하여 더 진행해야 합니다. 그러나 로봇 동료가 저장 파일을 운반하고 죽으면 모든 진행 상황이 손실됩니다. 따라서 경계를 늦추지 말고 동료를 살려두어 진행 상황을 그대로 유지해야 합니다.
로그라이크 또는 로그라이트
게임 내 플레이 스타일은 로봇 동료인 네페스가 죽었을 때 행동하는 방식에 영향을 미칩니다. 네페스를 위한 세 가지 자세 중에서 선택할 수 있으며, 더 위험한 자세를 선택할수록 네페스가 더 강해집니다. 그러나 플레이 스타일이 공격적일수록 모든 진행 상황을 잃을 확률이 높아집니다. 네페스가 죽으면 죽을 때 진행 상황이 초기화되니 조심하세요!

에게 우주 채굴 시설
모든 방이 독특한 시련과 기회를 선사하는 광활한 우주 채굴 시설로 여행을 떠나세요. 다양한 업그레이드, 리소스 및 수정 사항을 사용하여 게임을 탐색하고 당신을 기다리고 있는 진화하는 도전에 적응하십시오. 시설에 더 깊이 파고들수록 판돈이 증가하여 더 큰 보상과 함께 더 큰 위험을 제공합니다.

브레스 오브 스페이스에서 우주 요원이 되어 위험한 임무를 수행하세요. 연방의 번영을 위한 희망의 등대인 에게해 우주 채굴 시설이 미지의 존재에 의해 침략당합니다. 그러나 시설이 공격받고 핵심 인물인 Uzay의 아버지가 사라지자 시설을 되찾기 위한 위험한 임무에 투입됩니다. 다른 요원들과 마찬가지로 어려운 도전에 직면하고 임무 성공에 실패하게 됩니다.

미지의 지역을 탐험하고, 강력한 적과 싸우고, 연방의 운명을 결정하세요. 시설을 구하고 아버지가 남긴 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있을까요? 이 스릴 넘치는 모험에서 이야기는 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.
패배는 시작에 불과한 혁신적인 재탄생 시스템을 경험하세요. 동료 드로이드 네페스의 힘을 활용하여 다시 일어서고 한계를 뛰어넘어 새로운 능력과 전략을 잠금 해제하세요.
패시브, 지원, 공격의 세 가지 모드에서 네페스를 지휘하세요. 네페스의 다재다능한 기술을 활용하여 자신만의 스타일로 도전에 대처하며 즉석에서 적응하세요.
"Qouise" 자원 시스템으로 위험과 보상 사이의 미세한 경계를 탐색하세요. 현재 달리기를 위해 임시 업그레이드에 투자할지 아니면 영구적인 발전을 위해 자원을 축적할지 결정하여 장기 전략을 수립하세요.
다양한 슈트 업그레이드, 무기 강화, 네페스 개조로 우자이의 여정을 커스터마이징하세요. 이러한 요소들을 전략적으로 조합하여 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들고 앞에 놓인 도전을 극복하세요.
에게 연합 연합에서 영감을 받아 세심하게 제작된 세계에 빠져보세요. 문화, 요리, 건축물이 조화롭게 어우러진 세계를 탐험하며 분열되어 있지만 서로 연결된 우주의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

title: Imperial Ambitions
description:
게임 정보
Explore Colonize Industrialize Sabotage And Battle!
Imperial Ambitions is a 4X strategy game where the players will take over one of the European superpowers that existed during the age of discovery and renaissance and lead them to imperialism.
Discover and colonize the world,
Allocate your labor force,
Monopolize markets,
Fight tactical battles,
Survive the age of imperialism.
Tactical Wars With Completely New Mechanics
Imperial Ambitions has a completely new strategy game design providing a unique 4X gameplay experience. Anyone who enjoys the Napoleonic wars will find the tactical thinking required for Imperial Ambitions to be much more rewarding. As you forge an empire, the battlefields will become more challenging. We've redesigned the way that armies move on a campaign map, so they act more like real-world military units. Large armies can move in column formation, making it harder to move and requires more tactical thinking to prepare for the battle. The regiments can be split from the main army for small tactical excursions, or sneak into enemy lines for crossfire. For the same reason, attention is required to avoid leaving gaps on your frontline.

The society in the game is divided into classes, slaves, peasants, apprentices, artisans and masters. Besides slaves, the citizens will be allowed to progress through four tiers of classes, with each step providing increased capabilities, but also requiring different resources from you. The education is the key for most of your citizens to climb this social ladder. Higher classes will provide exponentially more labor, but will also require unique luxury resources. The citizens may stop working for several reasons, such as training, hunger, epidemic, strike, accidents, criminal activities, exhaustion, rebellion or retirement. While higher classes are often preferable, they are also harder to maintain due to requirement of luxury. The units and agents are also required to be trained from respective classes. For that reason, the players need to find the optimal balance between these classes.

Your Empire will grow beyond the mountains and the seas. As it grows you will have access to more and endemic resources. The more you invest into your roads and docks, the more resources that produced around the corners of your empire will be transported into your capital. With abundance in your capital, you can allocate your laborers to produce to higher quality goods. Imperial Ambitions has more than 40 different resources that can be extracted, produced or imported. Your population will demand products depending on their level of education. You must manage your resources and customize your production chains, while ensuring the wellbeing of your population. Some key resources may just not be accessible to you. You can resolve either by leasing the land from the natives, military invasion, trading with superpowers, or exploiting black market.

For the savvy entrepreneur and economist, the black market is a huge opportunity to boost your own empire. No longer do you have to go through the tedious and sometimes costly process of building a colony and maintain an industry. the game will include a black market besides the regular market. In regular trade, a player can initiate a bid for something they need and, if another player sells it to them, everyone is happy! Though, this trade is also taxed by any country that has lands en route. Black market, however works completely different. The resources in the black market is pulled from towns with high corruption. And players can bid for these resources, even if they belong to their enemies. The cost, however, is often higher than normal, yet no one can tax. This can be a boon for some players in need of certain products that are capitalised by their enemies and for everyone that prefers not to pay taxes. Instead, however, corruption and criminal activity will become more prevalent among the towns along the route. e careful not to get caught in a cycle of corruption and crime! To promote corruption player can send man of shadows to start a crime syndicate. It however requires opium to initiate (also only available at black market) However, the player is not defenseless. Players can use the man of shadow to start intelligence mission, to eradicate crime syndicates.

In our opinion, it is unrealistic for the players to be able to view the tech tree. In Imperial Ambitions, the player will only be shown the available techs they can fund without disclosing the whole tree. It makes the game more challenging and exciting. This is also part of the discovery experience in Imperial Ambitions - you learn by doing! Funding a tech is not enough for research. The player must have one of their gentlemen agent perform an action related to that technology to be able to discover it. This action is also not revealed to the player. Thus player has to make a guess to what actions would help discover that tech. For example, a gentlemen has to sail the ocean to be able to discover the "Sextant", a navigation tool for sailors. Or, to discover "Abolishment of slavery" the player need to actually working slaves.

We envision a simple diplomacy for Imperial Ambitions. The difference in IA from most 4X, is that an agent has to be sent to the opponent's capital or party in an effort to ceasefire, establish trade relations, embassies, defensive pacts and alliances. Once an embassy or trade consulate is established the agent is dismissed. On the other hand, cancelling an existing agreement can simply be performed from the diplomacy window. It takes days to build bridges but seconds to destroy them.

We chose a pixelated art style for the game since it’s a fun and approachable way to communicate controversial events of our recent history such as post-colonial subversion. We also wanted a retro aesthetic design to assist players in imagining this alternate universe, mixing pop culture with classic cartoon representations of imperialism.

title: Shark Rain
description:
게임 정보
Premise and Lore
SHARK RAIN is a story-driven, third person shooter that is set in a vast ocean covered with many different islands that used to be a modern day civilisation before it was catastrophically flooded many years ago.
Become a cute Shark Girl and use your Water Bazooka to flood the world. Transform into a shark to swim and jump through many different levels! Collect gems and special artifacts to upgrade your power!
The Hub World
Discover a newly found town full of cute and lively NPCs. Make friends, eat food, upgrade and customize your gear as you fight for a new hope against the specter of a past evil that is trying to claw its way back into power.
Real Time Water Simulation
SHARK RAIN utilizes the Fluid Flux real time 2D water simulation system which allows you to literally flood the entire game area with water! It will flow down slopes and cause objects to float and be pushed by the water's current!
Combat
Slap everyone with your tail and unlock different types of water spouting weapons to destroy your enemies!
Puzzles
Use the force of water to move objects and unlock secret areas!

title: Little Eternal Chronicle
description:
게임 정보
The Heart of the World, "Cronium," has been shattered, scattering fragments across the land.
Only children under the age of 10 can survive the six months leading to the world’s destruction.
This is the story of 7 children and 1 cat, watched over by a single small bird.
■ Strategic battles using "clocks" to manipulate time.
Children (and the cat) cannot wield weapons.
Instead, they equip skills at the 0, 3, 6, and 9 o’clock marks of their clocks, allowing for highly strategic combat.
Combine the strengths of both children and adults to create powerful synergies.
■ Fly as a small bird across the map.
In Bird Mode, you can freely fly around the map, searching for items and solving puzzles in a point-and-click style.
While you can control all the main characters, the bird represents you in this world, adding a unique flavor to the experience.
■ Rewind time and discover the paths of fate.
Scenes from April to October are saved as a storyline.
Once you meet certain conditions, you can revisit and replay any scene.
A seemingly small event—like something a tiny bird might trigger—could completely alter the course of fate.
Can you find a way to change this world?
■ Mischief, mischief!!
Children love pranks—even if the world is ending!
Doodle on backs, startle adults with firecrackers...
A serious and emotional story can quickly be derailed by your antics.
Sometimes, new side stories will emerge from your playful mischief.
company: Midori Games / みどりげーむず

title: ZWAARD
description:
게임 정보


Customize your blade with a wide range of components scavenged from the remnants of civilization. Engage in fluid combat, combining precision strikes and strategic maneuvers as you confront formidable foes. Explore vast, open landscapes, uncover hidden secrets, and adapt your playstyle to the challenges that await you.


can be done at different locations in the world and will effect various . The components you will be able to change depend on the kind of parts you have found and are inside of your inventory.

This will allow you to fully change and the weapon to . Different parts will allow you to create that can result in against multiple kinds of .



A century after a transformed the world, cling to survival in a shattered landscape. As a lone adventurer, you navigate the ruins, encountering mysterious relics of the past and uncovering the mysteries of an that destroyed this world.

Assemble the fragments of a forgotten history, battling mutated creatures and overcoming the remnants of a . Your journey is not just one of survival but a quest to reclaim lost knowledge and restore hope to a .

title: The Touhou Empires
description:
게임 정보
"환상전략록"은 실시간 전략 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
마음에 드는 세력을 골라 각지에 흩어진 자원으로 물자를 비축하여,
최종적으로 자신 이외의 모든 세력을 물리치는 것에 그 목적이 있습니다.

우리군의 승리를 위해 다양한 지식과 테크닉을 사용해 전투에 임하라!
동방프로젝트의 인기 캐릭터가 40명 이상 등장!



주인공 레이무/마리사를 비롯해 역대 시리즈에 등장한 인기 캐릭터들이 총출동!
모든 캐릭터들은 고유 필살기 '스펠 카드'를 가지고 있습니다!
공격·방어 등, 각각 다른 능력을 가진 히로인을 이용해, 환상향 세계 지배를 목표로!
나만의 취향의 세력을 찾아 내자!



하쿠레이신사博麗神社는 내정과 방위능력이 강하며 홍마관은 초반부터 강력한 군사를 배출할 수 있는 등
히로인이 속한 각 세력마다 특기·약점이 존재!
자신의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 세력을 찾아내는 것도 이 게임을 즐기는 묘미 중 하나!



기동력은 있지만 창에 약한 기병, 사거리는 넓지만 접근전에 약한 궁병,
강력한 광범위 공격이 가능한 마도서 등 각각 강점이 있는 여러 다양한 유닛들이 존재.
전황과 상대 세력에 맞게 적절한 유닛을 선택!



싱글 플레이로도 차분하게 즐길 수 있는, 20막 이상의 스토리 탑재!
환상향의 수수께끼를 둘러싼, 30명 이상의 동방 캐릭터가 등장!
이변을 일으킨 진범은 과연 누구일까? 수수께끼를 직접 밝혀내자!



최대 6명이 동시에 플레이할 수 있는 온라인 대전 기능까지 지원!
"3 대 3"의 팀전부터 마지막 한 명을 가리는 배틀로얄까지
다양한 조합이 가능한 자유도로 친구들과도 태그를 하며 전세계 플레이어에 도전!



호화 작곡진의 도입부 및 개발 차원에서 빚어낸 잘 만들어진 효과음,
지금까지 없었던 참신한 키비주얼과 초원이나 물의 세세한 환경표현 등
여러모로 인디게임 수준을 뛰어넘는 '퀄리티에 대한 집착'을 보여드리겠습니다!
