title: Moonwakers : Episode 01
description:
게임 정보
Discover the rogue survival-lite 
Dive into a survival roguelite by taking control of a S.E.E.D, an advanced reconnaissance android! To accomplish your mission, explore exoplanets to determine if they are suitable for humanity.
Thus, you'll need to search for vital elements necessary for life: Carbon, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, Oxygen, Phosphorus, and Sulfur. But beware, danger lurks on this unknown land, and your survival will depend on your ingenuity and skills.
Traps abound, and you'll need to strategize to make it through. Regularly, you'll have to shelter your character to escape ionic storms.
Exploration will allow you to acquire new skills and enjoy more autonomy, speed, and gliding. Your biggest challenge? Managing your energy to avoid extinction.
Movement is survival, movement is fun
What could be cooler than exploring an unknown planet on a snowboard?
This mode of movement, fast and fluid, offers you gliding sensations for greater freedom and intensity. Speed, adrenaline, and exploration intertwine in this unique roguelite, where moments of absolute calm collide with the unpredictable challenges of a vibrant, ever-changing world.
Energy consumption as core mechanic

title: Thawed Waters
description:
게임 정보
Thawed Waters is a mature emotional story experienced through hardcore boat-poling gameplay when every wrong move leads to losses and each stamina point counts!

Thawed Waters is not another farming sim, nor rogue-like, but pure classic isometric action with a problematic topic that needs to be raised in video games.

It's time to look into the ugliest corner of human life - animal testing.

"Pandemic of the second decade was nothing compared to what global warming melted in the Arctic later, freeing bacteria buried by nature millions of years ago. One of the thawed viruses ruthlessly attacked not only people but also animals of all kinds. Multiple attempts to develop a vaccine before the world plunged into chaos were unsuccessful, and a few remnants scattered across the globe lost all hope of surviving."
Stepan, head of Pukhovka village, 2047



NAVIGATE THE BOAT

Survive the planetary flood in the rusty boat with the pole in your hands! Choose directions wisely and apply force carefully to minimise rocking and tilting and avoid capsizing. Go around obstacles with the surgeon’s precision to keep the boat in one piece. Mistakes cost precious live cargo and materials, and the old man's stamina is a finite resource. Every decision is critical.

RESCUE AND SIT RABBITS

Finding the perfect time to pick rabbits is one side of the problem. How about sitting jumpy animals around the boat to achieve balance? The boat's behaviour depends on it, and therefore your life! Don’t miss a safe zone to release your fellow travellers or drown together and be forgotten.

FIGHT FATIGUE

Mental and physical fatigue are your eternal silent companions, that you have to deal with to survive. Collect and identify Siberian herbs and berries, mix them and brew a cosy cup of tea in safe zones to ease physical fatigue. Or not too cosy and get some unexpected side effects. Live through events of your past as mini-games to reduce or increase mental fatigue when dreaming next to the bonfire.

UPGRADE AND MODIFY

Your only ally, a mysterious prosthetic arm, holds the key to survival. Upgrade it with unique mods, and unleash its potential to travel further, push stronger, and save more lives. The boat barely stays afloat, but natural wit and a bit of luck will get you some cool artefacts increasing the boat’s stability or strength when it is needed the most.

LIVE THROUGH APOCALYPTICAL EVENTS

Fight the forces of nature to save it and give humanity another chance. Find a new meaning in life and watch how the broken old man transforms physically and mentally. Discover all the endings of this unusual story of personal salvation through rescuing the tiniest creatures. Explore the dark and submerged corners of the dying Siberian hinterland with a touch of cyberpunk.

title: Abandoned Archive
description:
게임 정보

Abandoned Archive is a uniquely crafted, fast-paced, spellcasting roguelike. Set in an archive that has been long forgotten and sealed away, the player must venture deep below ground to uncover the dark secrets tucked away.
Spells & Relics


Discover the many schools of magic, and utilise their spells to fight your way down the tower you are sealed in. Battle with anything from lightning and air to gravity and time. Becoming powerful requires you to synergise your spells by carefully choosing upgrades and collecting rare relics that offer passive effects to be combined with your finest abilities.


When one day you find yourself sealed in a tower, a strange, sentient Orb proposes a deal. With Oblome the Orbite, who claims to be one with science, you forge onwards in an attempt to escape your imprisonment and find the city of Orbites. Tied to your pact, you must protect Oblome at any cost if any danger arises, and in turn, he will protect you. There is definitely something stowed away, some kind of synthetic horror at the base of this archive. Will you delve deep and decipher the mysteries? Or will you simply succumb to your surroundings?


Set in the country of Gratissia in the tower named “Turrim”, Abandoned Archive has the player exploring fragments of a species’ past, floor by floor. With an exiled ex-scientist as your guide and protector, there seems to just be many burning questions, with answers hiding in the cracks of the archive.

title: The Walker
description:
게임 정보
Walker는 싱글 플레이어 생존 공포 게임입니다. 평화로운 날이 지났고 더 이상 먹기 위해 일하지 않고 생존을 위해 노력하십시오. 이 모든 것의 이면에 무엇이 있는지 알아보십시오. 살아서 탈출하시길 바랍니다.

당신은 무슨 일이 일어났는지 모른 채 도시에서 눈을 떴고, 그날 갑자기 당신의 삶이 전례 없이 바뀌게 됩니다. 도시는 무너졌고 세상은 당신이 이전에 알던 것과 같지 않습니다. 당신이 찾은 모든 용품을 얻고 필요한 것을 만들고 현명하게 사용하십시오.

[목록]
어깨 너머로 카메라 시점 – 플레이어는 캐릭터의 위치를 자세히 살펴보고 강렬한 분위기를 느낄 것입니다.
사용할 수 있는 많은 무기 – 스토리가 환경에 맞게 진행됨에 따라 더 많은 무기가 포함되지만 탄약과 건강 키트가 제한되어 모든 총알이 중요합니다.
가능한 최고의 그래픽 제공 – 루멘 및 DLSS와 같은 최신 기술을 사용하여 최고의 그래픽에 생명을 불어넣으십시오.[/목록]

title: Drift Halls
description:
게임 정보
A short walking simulator where you can change environment lighting with the press of a button using the real-time lighting of Unreal Engine 5, where secrets may be revealed by the light or the dark.
Optional paths may hold secret rooms and bits of lore. If a path looks scary, it can usually be avoided if you just want to relax. There is no combat or HUD. No puzzle-solving is required to complete the game.
The radio is your tool to change the world lighting, and indicates the current lighting state. A tuner can catch stray signals in some areas, and you might hear music, or possibly other sounds hidden in the static...

title: Find This Pixel Anomaly
description:
게임 정보
In Find This Pixel Anomaly your task involves monitoring real-time surveillance camera feeds. Identify any irregularities within the monitored areas. These anomalies can vary from missing furniture to cute visitors.
Found an anomaly? File a report and hope it will get fixed in time. Otherwise you will get in trouble, because too many anomalies will end the game.
Activate Night Vision to reveal only the most elusive anomalies lurking in the shadows. But don’t get too comfortable — this mode limits what you can see, making every mistake potentially fatal. Focus on the hidden details and spot the threats before they end your game.
EXTRA OBJECT
Wait, was this chair here before? Who put it there? Well, it doesn't matter because you should hurry up and file a report. These added items can blend in surprisingly well, so stay sharp.

title: Snow Resort Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of Snow Resort Simulator. Tackle daily responsibilities: upgrade facilities, maintain a cozy resort, satisfy guests with freshly cooked meals and drinks, and keep your inventory fully stocked. Be prepared for the challenges that come with winter.
Ensure you prepare tickets according to customer requests. Sell tickets to customers who want to ski. Use the income to improve your resort and restock supplies.

title: Null Transit
description:
게임 정보
Adrift in the endless void, the captain and crew cling to survival aboard a failing spaceship. Their only hope? Recover a crucial Astronavigator Core before the ship succumbs to the darkness.
FIVE CREW MEMBERS (and a clone). ONE MISSION.
Meet the crew: Captain, Commander, Recon, Engineer, Disciple. Each crew member brings unique strengths, but all are fragile in the face of death.
To avoid unnecessary losses, the captain can send humanoid clones instead—expendable, but at a cost. Every clone drains Ionite, the rare energy source keeping the ship operational. Run out, and the crew will have no choice but to risk their own lives.
How far will you go to keep your crew alive?
A HIGH-STAKES ACTION PLATFORMER
Choices Matter. Losing a crew member is permanent. Every decision counts.
Master Fluid Movement. Simple controls—jump, dash, and channel energy—that evolve into intricate, parkour-like maneuvers as you improve.
Unique Dash-Attack Combat. There is no attack button. Dash through energy to recharge movement and power up your weapons. Every fight is a test of momentum and precision.
Distinct Combat Styles. Each crew member wields two unique weapons, shaping how they fight.
The Captain strikes from afar with tactical orbital bombardments.
The Commander dominates close-quarters combat with brute force.

title: Monday Syndrome
description:
게임 정보
Monday Syndrome is a singleplayer action roguelike where you play as an intern that's trapped in a hellish office. Descend into a satirical corporate hell, battling demonic coworkers with absurd office supply weapons in an endless, procedurally generated tower. Can you survive the eternal 9-to-5?
Unleash fast-paced, chaotic combat amidst destructible office environments.

title: Cosmic Fear
description:
게임 정보
Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension  have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one, big picture. The solution is near; the next expedition will be the crucial one. You turn your gaze to the stars: what lies hidden in the unfathomable depths of the cosmos?
Night falls as the horn's haunting call echoes through the woods. The Great Ceremony is about to begin.

title: 神明高中生 - Cosmic High Schooler
description:
게임 정보
The principles of the universe are its bones, time flows silently through its veins, and the cosmic web forms its nerves…
"All things will fade—that may be the rule for many worlds, but not for mine."
"Even you must sometimes hope for a twist in the world, don't you?"
 You are an ordinary girl from a rural area, with a humble background.
For the sixteen years since your birth, the seasons have cycled, the sun has risen and set, and the universe has moved faithfully to the rhythm you know so well.
Immersed in the bittersweet routine of daily life, you believe that this is all there is to existence.
However, upon entering high school, the arrival of two mysterious boys disrupts your once ordinary life.
It seems a supernatural force is shaking the familiar world you thought you understood.
As reality and dreams start to intertwine, you begin to question your preconceptions about the world.
Is this story one of miracles, mysteries, or distortions?
All the answers rest in your choices…
autokwd: 神明高中生 - Cosmic High Schooler

title: Escape the Laser Trap
description:
게임 정보
You are entering a labyrinth of futuristic corridors that resemble a space station. Strangely, this place feels familiar...
The corridors are filled with deadly laser traps and hostile robots patrolling the area.

title: Deepspace Emporium
description:
게임 정보
Deepspace Emporium is an immersive shopkeeping simulator set in the gritty, atmospheric depths of a massive space station, where survival and success are anything but guaranteed. You play as a former scavenger who, with a little luck and a sizable loan, has managed to open a shop on the Lower Levels of this colossal outpost. Life here is tough, with a sharp divide between the wealthy elite in the Upper Levels and the struggling masses below. To keep your shop running, you'll need to buy, sell, and barter a wide variety of goods—from counterfeit cigarettes and handmade firearms to life-saving drugs—all while keeping an eye on the ever-increasing rent demanded by your ruthless landlord.
In this world of gray morality, every transaction is a choice, every choice has consequences, and no one’s hands are truly clean. Command, corporate interests, and local factions all pull at the strings of station life, each with their own agenda. Do you try to stay out of trouble, or do you play both sides to get ahead? How far will you go to survive, and what will you sacrifice to make a name for yourself on the station?
This is the demo version of the game and does not include Save and Loading.
Features:
Run Your Own Shop: Manage inventory, haggle with customers, and make tough decisions on what to stock. Each sale impacts your reputation and the type of customers you attract.
Navigate Gray Morality: Deal with customers from all walks of life, including desperate scavengers, wealthy upper-level clients, and dangerous underworld figures. Not every sale is strictly legal, and not every buyer can be trusted.
Face Rising Rent and Expenses: Your relentless landlord demands an ever-increasing rent, pushing you to make more money, even if it means taking riskier deals or questionable jobs.
Handle Contraband: Trade in goods of varying legality. Avoid detection by authorities while keeping valuable connections in the black market.

title: Pay 2 Win: The World is Mine
description:
게임 정보
Pay 2 Win is an idle game about world domination. Join your two new assistants, Annie and May as they assist you in employing the most devious tactics the games industry has to offer. Go from humble beginnings with pay for convenience sales tricks, to artificially scarce battle passes and more!
As your repute grows, so do your choices; will you take the difficult path of soulful game design, or the path of least resistance and succumb to the dark powers  bequeathed to you by your finance board? Each decision made alters your run and affects the story. One thing is certain - to make it in this industry, you'll need wits, a bit of luck, and resources. Lots and lots of resources.
autokwd: Pay 2 Win: The World is Mine

title: ROT
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a dark dense forest in which terrible inexplicable things happen. In recent years, many people have disappeared here, including the brother of the main character. You will have to find the missing people's belongings by following the coordinates left in the notes of the missing brother. Someone or something lives in the forest and changes everyone who goes there.
There is no map. Navigate through the trees using only a compass and coordinates.
Someone buried all the evidence. A metal detector will help you find the right things, and with a shovel you can dig up not only them, but also useful items for survival.

title: Look Mum No Computer
description:
게임 정보
Brace yourself for a wild ride where music meets mayhem! Look Mum No Computer takes you to the quirky, pixel-art universe of Soldersworth in this twin-stick shooter action-RPG. Join Sam and his synthesizer sidekick, Kosmo, as you battle rogue machines and fix them from the inside — one electrifying beat at a time!
 🎵 Interactive Music: Craft and upgrade unique synthesizer modules that not only serve as powerful weapons but also form the instruments of the game’s evolving soundtrack. Customize your playstyle and experiment with the original electronic music of Look Mum No Computer.

title: The Hidden Library
description:
게임 정보
"The Hidden Library" is a 2D adventure with point-and-click elements, where you will immerse yourself in worlds forbidden by authority, awakening the imagination and guiding you through a forgotten literary past.
Set in Southern Russia in the early 2000s, you play as Elena, a 13-year-old girl who discovers her late grandfather’s hidden library. It is a place of shadows, secrets, and forbidden Soviet-era literature. As Elena uncovers stories that were once censored, she becomes absorbed in their worlds, meeting characters from novels that the Soviet authorities deemed dangerous and subversive. Each new adventure plunges the player into the very heart of one of these stories, offering a rare glimpse into ideas that were hidden from the public eye, questions of freedom, and the power of literature.
Explore a Library Full of Secrets
The hidden library is not just a place of forgotten books. It is a labyrinth of secrets. Every shelf, every corner hides an artefact or a clue, urging you to delve deeper into Elena’s family history. Diaries, letters, and photographs reveal the mystery of Elena’s grandfather and the dangerous truths he sought to protect.
Journey Through Forbidden Books
Each level of the game is inspired by a banned book or genre, recreating the worlds of Soviet political satires, dystopian futures, and subversive classics. Walk in the footsteps of characters from iconic works, experience their conflicts, interact with complex individuals, and understand why these stories were deemed too dangerous to be read by the Soviet government.
Interact with Literary Figures
Meet characters from the banned books you explore. These figures are not just passive elements in the world; they are alive, complex individuals with their own motivations and inner conflicts. Form alliances, face enemies, and learn about their roles in the struggle against oppressive regimes.
Immersive Story-Driven Gameplay
Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and open new areas as you dive deeper into Elena’s journey and the stories hidden within forbidden literature. Each encounter with characters and themes from these novels sheds light on the enduring struggle for truth, memory, and freedom.

title: Her Love
description:
게임 정보


Ethel Briggs is a shy, self-conscious girl in her final year of university. Though she should be working on her thesis about Romantic poetry, her well of inspiration has run dry. After a nasty break-up with her former girlfriend, Clementine, Ethel is feeling very blue - and it certainly doesn't help that she's spending the winter holidays in the depressingly drab village of Oxbury, while her family are off holidaying in sunny Australia.

Left to her own devices, Ethel struggles to finish her thesis while the cold, wintry wind blows outside and the days continue to get shorter and darker.

Staying inside proves to be unbearable, however, and Ethel escapes the confines of her family's home for a breath of fresh air. Going for a walk in the woods should be enough to invigorate her, and fill her with newfound passion for Romanticism.

That was Ethel's plan, at least - but she wasn't counting on meeting a mysterious, dark-haired beauty in the woods, who is much more than she seems.


50,000 words of text (approx 2-4 hours of reading)
A linear story with only one ending
Original character and background art
An original soundtrack
A dark lesbian romance
Mild body horror elements
A creepy, unsettling atmosphere

title: Steam Shot
description:
게임 정보
You are a cog in a never ending war. A war that has torn the land asunder and tormented man's soul into a husk of empty nothingness. You're not special. You're just another soldier assigned to another mech to defend yet another outpost from yet another enemy. Win or lose, live or die, it has no meaning. There is only The War.

Manually aim, load, and fire your cannons at your opponent: friend, enemy, or AI!

Control a steam mech and outmaneuver your opponent - escape from danger or charge straight into it!

Stay in the fight by repairing your mech with your trusty hammer!



VR? Check. Multiplayer? Check. Cannons? Check. Steampunk? Check. Mechs? Check. What more could you want?

title: The Eastern Sacrifice
description:
게임 정보
오랫동안 제사를 받지 못한 신들은 잊혀졌고, 사원에는 단지 미미한 흔적만이 남아 있습니다. 무정한 우주의 아래, 생명들은 한낱 미물처럼 여겨집니다. 생명체들은 수련을 통해 육신을 넘어 등계를 이루려 합니다. 세상은 이미 혼란에 빠져, 광기의 소용돌이에 잠식되고 있습니다.
수미좌 아래에서 경전의 소리가 울려 퍼지는 가운데, 당신은 석상의 눈을 뜹니다. 그리고 함께 깨어난 것은 바로 이단과 악령에 맞서려는 강한 의지입니다. 인류의 존엄을 되찾고, 등계하여 대사명이 되어 귀의하는 종파를 세우십시오. 전당 속 공포에 떨고 있는 신도들을 내려다보며 첫 번째 시선을 내리쬐어보세요.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
신의 시각으로 세상을 굽어보다
당신은 "잔념"의 신격으로 게임을 시작합니다. 도인들에게 개척을 명령하고, 제자들을 파견하여 악마를 물리치며 종파를 통솔하게 하십시오.
하지만 "대사명"으로 등계하는 길은 쉽지 않을 것입니다. 각 계층을 오를 때마다 신적 능력이 해제되며, 이를 통해 클릭할 때마다 더욱 강력한 힘을 발휘할 수 있습니다.
autokwd: The Eastern Sacrifice,登阶 The Eastern Sacrifice

title: Runehaven
description:
게임 정보
Runehaven is an atmospheric first-person dungeon crawler with roguelike elements taking place in a destructible voxel world. Combine runes to craft your own unique spells or to enchant weapons, alter the environment, explore procedurally generated dungeons, battle vile creatures, solve puzzles, discover hidden secrets, and dodge deadly traps!
Craft your own spells by combining different runes using a magic system inspired by Ultima and Arx Fatalis! Each rune affects the spell in an unique and emergent way!

title: THRASHER
description:
게임 정보
From the artist & composer behind the cult hit THUMPER comes THRASHER, a mind-melting arcade odyssey and audiovisual experience. Guide a magnificent space eel, elegantly swooping and thrashing it through mesmerizing alien worlds. Race to evolve the space eel from a tiny worm into a mega beast, taking on wild bosses through 9 psychedelic realms. Dive into the game's deep combo system to perfect your runs and compete on the leaderboards, or simply vibe out inside the breathtaking but unsettling landscapes.  Experience the award-winning game on PCVR and 2D screens (including Steam Deck) soon!
TRANSCEND SPACETIME
Immerse yourself in a dazzling odyssey where music, visuals, and gameplay mesh into one transcendent experience. Journey from the depths of primordial gloom to the heights of celestial bliss, culminating in a heart pounding reckoning with a cosmic baby god.
YOU V THE UNIVERSE
Swoop, dash and thrash at breakneck speed, busting through obstacles and stacking up combos, leading to nine jaw dropping encounters with mysterious leviathans that will challenge your skills, and your sanity.
SOUND AND FURY
Lose yourself in the enthralling soundtrack created by designer Brian Gibson, bassist for the band Lightning Bolt. THRASHER is a spatial audio and haptics showcase, creating a stunning sensory experience.
CHILL OR CHALLENGE
Vibe out and enjoy the wild journey, or push yourself to the limit by chaining together massive combos to worm your way up the rankings.

title: Imperialism: Concert of Europe
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to an era defined by steam power, revolution, and imperial expansion in the 19th century. Can you steer your nation towards prosperity, renown, and dominance?

Overview:
Immerse yourself in turn-based grand strategy gameplay set amidst the dynamic landscape of the 19th century.

Gameplay Features:
Develop your nation's industry by constructing factories and expanding railroads.
Transform raw resources into refined goods to drive economic growth.
Utilize goods to bolster your population across various societal strata, including workers, soldiers, and engineers.
Forge alliances with minor powers to extend your Sphere of Influence.
Engage in global trade within a market shaped by the forces of supply and demand.
Negotiate colonial territories with rival great powers to expand your dominion.
Seize diplomatic advantage by purchasing other nations' debts and accruing interest.

Historical Depth:
Experience pivotal historical events that shaped the course of the 19th century.

Visual and Auditory Experience:
Enjoy a board game-inspired aesthetic that captures the essence of the era.
Navigate through a Victorian-style user interface for an immersive gameplay experience.
Immerse yourself in the era with a classical music soundtrack that sets the mood for strategic conquest.

title: Blood Rush
description:
게임 정보
BLOOD RUSH는 ULTRAKILL과 Hades 같은 장르의 거장들에게서 영감을 받은 강렬한 로그라이트 FPS입니다.
절차적으로 생성되는 지옥에 뛰어들어, 독창적인 무기를 손에 넣고 새로운 능력을 개방하며 강력한 시너지를 만들어내세요. 자유를 향한 길을 가로막는 모든 도전에 맞서 싸우십시오.

속도와 정밀함
지옥은 가혹한 곳입니다. 끊임없이 몰려오는 적들 사이에서 생존하려면, 기동성이 가장 강력한 무기가 될 것입니다. 멀찍이 회피하며 안전한 전투를 펼칠 수도 있고, 과감하게 적을 압박하는 공격적인 플레이도 가능합니다. 하지만 어떤 전략을 선택하든, 정교한 헤드샷 한 방이 승패를 가를 것입니다.

우상과 유물
지옥의 심연을 탐험하며 유물과 우상의 힘을 이용해 보세요. 강력한 업그레이드와 독특한 능력을 부여받아 더욱 강해질 수 있습니다. 탐험 중 발견한 시너지와 기회를 활용해, 전투 스타일을 유동적으로 변화시키세요.

title: Glitch Core
description:
게임 정보
Glitch Core
A realistic, tactical, fast paced FPS Rogue Lite, set in a future where AI is deemed too dangerous for earth.
Where you play as an AI agent on a moon base, training in a ruthless combat simulation to improve your skills, that is, until you find the truth behind your existence....

TLDR:
A casual, action packed rogue like FPS game!
Where it's simply fun to shoot things up!
Dark immersive world design with a hint of procedural generation

title: Hexiv
description:
게임 정보
Build, farm, hunt, explore and fight to survive on lush procedural islands in Hexiv! 
Acquire and use cards to move and provide tasks for your crew, expand your territory, and construct buildings. Explore ruins and purchase upgrades in the Research Lab to acquire powerful artifacts. Refuel your lander to hop to new islands to get access to fresh resources and advance toward the final showdown at the planet's equator!
Features:
Beautiful and dynamic pixel perfect pixel art!
10 Chapters with customizable difficulty modifiers!
Procedural islands with different biome, wildlife, and varied topography.
100+ upgradeable artifacts which grant unique game modifiers!
100+ cards you can buy from the Trader or acquire from building actions or combat spoils!
Over a dozen unique crew you can unlock, each with their own passives and quest.
6 landers with unique mechanics!
Buy upgrades in the research laboratory!
Dozens of enemy tiles and units intent on stopping you and terraforming the planet into a frozen wasteland!
Radishes!

title: Dataminers
description:
게임 정보
Infiltrate highly secured data centres and grab as much data as you can. Plan your moves and outsmart guards, cameras and drones. Every turn counts: the Security Net is already rising. Valuable equipment is hidden in protected terminals. Steal it and use it for your mission or sell it on the black market.
Upgrades and cross-mission strategies
Upgrade your Dataminer with augments, expand his skills and develop your own strategy. Hire miners with special abilities and use their strengths for future missions. Reach the legendary Everything Centre and hack the holy grail of every Dataminer.
Do you know Minesweeper?
If NO, don't worry! You will get right into the tactical depth of Dataminers and the puzzle mechanics of Dataminers is taught in no time in the training center.
If YES, you are already familiar with the base puzzle mechanics of Dataminers. But Dataminers is more than just another Minesweeper clone: this time You are part of the playing field and enemies, items and abilities bring tactics and cross-mission strategies into play.
Features and playmodes
Roguelike campaign. Will you reach the Everything Centre?
Climb the InfiniTower. How far will you get?
Challenge yourself in Classic, Speed and Pressure playmode.
Compete with other players in weekly leaderboards and Daily Mission.
Just relax and play the Zen mode.

title: DRINKRIME
description:
게임 정보
THE PLOT

You meet a talking liquor bottle, Jin, who asks you to help him interrogate and catch criminals.
One after the other, you measure yourself against a series of unique, non-human characters with something to hide.
Where will this strange adventure bring you? And what is Jin's ultimate goal?
THE GAMEPLAY

You will fight and capture the criminals by interrogating them with the help of Jin's powers, in something known as... the Jinterrogation.
You will be hearing their testimonies and looking for keywords that will complete their confessions.

Each criminal, deep inside, feels guilty about what they have done, and your job is to make them face this reality by asking them questions and examining their answers. By the time you're done with them, you probably won't feel much pity for them... But learning more about their psyche is part of the fun.

The four-color palette, low-res art, and chiptune music create the nostalgic look of something out of a retro game from the '90s.
None of the characters in DRINKRIME look like humans. It'll be a lot of fun conversing with animals, bottles, and the like.

title: Wardens Rising
description:
게임 정보
Wardens Rising is a one-of-a-kind, action-packed game of heroism, strategy, and epic battles blending high-octane PvE coop ARPG shooter action and MOBA-like base defense strategy for an experience like no other!
Embark on an exhilarating campaign against a relentless interdimensional threat. Your mission is to protect vital energy cores from massive invasions and defeat mighty bosses to save humanity and attain everlasting glory.
Plan your strategy and build defenses before each battle. Over time you will unlock new defensive technology like towers, traps, portals, walls, and more to use in your next battle.

title: Esothe
description:
게임 정보
Esothe is a third person single player indie game. The game tells about the journey of a lonely wanderer through a forgotten land located on a plateau, separated from the rest of the world by a high wall. The plateau initially seems to be an abandoned, although an idyllic land, however, with time it reveals its dark past, which the explorer slowly discovers...
Features:
Exploration - An open world with dozens of locations to explore, full of secrets and connected underground ruins,
Platforming - traversing dungeons and ruins requires dexterity - a lot of jumping and crawling,
Story - The plateau has a dark past. Statues of winged beings, that can be found at every step, skeletons of giants in dungeons, traces of siege. All this will fold into a complex story over time,
Puzzles - The plateau is full of magical mechanisms that are the remains of the technology of the ancient civilization that once lived here, some of the mechanisms are inactive and you need to find a way to activate them to know their destiny.

Esothe takes place in the same universe as Venineth game.

title: Jury Trial
description:
게임 정보

Interested in creating your own cases? With the ingame case editor you will be able to write your own cases and share them with the community. Whether fictional or recreated cases, the ingame editor got you covered.



In this law simulation RPG, you will tackle a multitude of different cases and champion the fight for justice. From representing the poorest of the poor and the wrongfully convicted to the wealthiest and most privileged members of society, you'll navigate through case materials, uncover inconsistencies to find new evidence, analyze and select jurors and experts, question witnesses, and strive to convince the jury at trial. Your clients depend on you because they have nowhere else to turn to.
















The game is set in a fictional country deeply divided by racial profiling, prejudice, and social injustice. A deep bias runs through the country and its people. Apart from your courtroom skills as a gifted negotiator, it’s crucial for you to find a jury that gives your client a Otherwise, every argument and scientific fact might be in vain because no one will listen.

Your potential jurors consist of:









Jury Trial is a project by two indie developers who are doing their best to create a game in their spare time, one they've always wanted to play but couldn't find anywhere. Operating in a nearly nonexistent genre without a budget, we are driven by a passion for the world of law. If you have questions, suggestions, or are interested in offering your help as a potential tester or translator, please contact us through the Steam Community section or via social media.

title: CrossPlanet
description:
게임 정보
CrossPlanet – The Ultimate Multiplayer Shooter Experience
CrossPlanet is a thrilling third-person shooter that delivers fast-paced, skill-based combat across dynamic battlefields. Whether you're facing off against other players in intense PVP firefights or teaming up to battle monstrous alien creatures in PVE missions, CrossPlanet offers action-packed gameplay with a focus on strategy, movement, and precision gunplay.
A Shooter Focused on Gameplay First
No unnecessary fluff—CrossPlanet is built for fluid movement, satisfying gunplay, and competitive action. Players can sprint, take cover, aim down sights, and unleash devastating firepower across a variety of maps and modes. With a robust selection of 11 weapons, each with distinct handling and playstyles, every encounter feels fresh and tactical.
Battle Across Diverse Worlds
From futuristic military bases to hostile alien landscapes, CrossPlanet’s maps are designed for strategic combat and environmental storytelling. Engage in team-based skirmishes, solo challenges, and cooperative missions as you adapt to ever-changing battle scenarios.
Key Features:
✅ Multiplayer Warfare – Face off in competitive PVP battles or squad up for cooperative PVE missions.
✅ Diverse Arsenal – Wield 15 unique weapons, each designed for specific playstyles.
✅ Tactical Movement – Sprint, evade, double jump, jetpack and use map layouts to outmaneuver your enemies.
✅ PVE Battles – Fight against swarms of alien creatures and massive bosses in thrilling co-op missions, or risk going in solo.
✅ Skill-Based Combat – No pay-to-win mechanics—victory comes from strategy and reflexes.
CrossPlanet features 10 PVP Multiplayer maps, 15 Modes, 10 Unique Armors to wear and show off, earned through playing the game! Plus, a range of PVE missions against waves of enemies and huge bosses, either alone or with friends! 
CrossPlanet is designed for players who love pure shooter gameplay without distractions. Whether you're a competitive player looking for your next challenge or a PVE fan ready to take on alien horrors, prepare to drop into the action.
Are you ready to dominate the battlefield?

title: Ages of Cataria
description:
게임 정보
Ages of Cataria is a village story generator! Learn your villager's stories as they grow old in your town, customize your village to your aesthetic, and discover a fantastical new land.



Legend has it that the continent of Cataria was home to an ancient civilization. One day, the continent mysteriously vanished and became lost to the world. After hundreds of years, the land of Cataria has been rediscovered and all that remains of the civilization are ruins. Now, thousands have set off to explore Cataria to settle a new home and uncover the mysteries of this land. Craft the origin story of your village, choose your starting location and uncover the legend for yourself.




Choose between two ancestries: . Elves are plant-like beings, while Humans are... well, we all know what Humans are. Each ancestry has unique building aesthetics, requires different resources, and experiences different lifestyle events.



Boost your villager's productivity by playing around town. From cooking to hunting, each job will have a unique minigame. In addition to boosting your productivity, minigames will also increase your villager's skill level.



Villagers will have different , , and . You will need to manage your villager's wellness to ensure their comfort and productivity are positive so they can continue having a grand ol' time.



with your villagers. These interactive novels will define your villager's personality and story. Stories range from small events to life-changing moments.



in town to make your town look unique, or share your style online with others.

title: Neon Sword
description:
게임 정보


Neon Sword is an open world 3rd person top down action roleplay game with elements of business simulation. The none linear story has multiple choices that effect the world around you leading you down many paths; the person you become is shaped by your decisions made within the game.

Time and Setting

Neon Sword takes place in the fictional Quaid City in the year 2083. The setting takes inspiration from late 70s to early 90s Sci-Fi, Cyberpunk and Synthwave - Neon Lights, Big hair and dodgy moustache...




Another crime goes unsolved in the city that is the cesspit of humanity! Well, not if you have any say in the matter as you start a personal crusade of revenge. Are you the hunter or the hunted? You will turn Quaid City upside down hosing the streets clean of the human vermin that infest the dark shadows out of the neon glare as you shape the destiny of Quaid City...

The time has come to wield the .

title: Reactoryx
description:
게임 정보
You are a renowned ██████  ██████████ tasked with solving a case involving ███████████ events surrounding one of the ██████  ████████ corporations. At first glance, the case seems routine: missing █████████, strange ████, and unsettling ███████ among employees. However, the deeper you dive into this enigma, the clearer it becomes that much more is at stake than ██████████ secrets.
Game Features
Unique Reporting System
Every action, discovery, and solved puzzle must be documented in reports you submit to your client. The thoroughness of your reports affects the game's progression, unlocking or concealing critical storylines.

title: Warranted Humanity
description:
게임 정보
An unknown virus is turning infected mammals into cannibals and zombies.
In Warranted Humanity choices matter. Name your hero, choose the colour of his car and rush through the tutorial, because the clock is ticking and humanity’s survival is resting on your shoulders.
GAME FEATURES
How you spend your time at night, affects your efficiency during the day and how well you fight and scavenge during day-time excursions, determines your options and progress during the night. Will your read a book to improve your skill in hacking, craft a bigger backpack, upgrade your toolbelt or distill more biodiesel for the generator?
Fighting is action-based, but the body part hit, weapon condition, the presence of armour, as well as the hero’s stats all have an influence on the outcome of hits, parries, damage received and damage dealt.
Morale is just as important as health in Warranted Humanity. Killing healthy and curable humans (instead of incapacitating them) has a large negative impact on morale, especially in the beginning of the game. Develop courage by taking damage and improve humanity’s odds of survival, to improve your maximum morale, or you will flee to your shelter in panic after receiving only a few bites and scratches.
Manage short-term challenges like cuts, hunger and fatigue, or they will turn into long-term problems like infection, starvation and sleep deprivation, affecting maximum health, stamina and morale.
Oversee survivors who joined your shelter. Add survivors to your shelter by helping those you encounter during day-time excursions, or by incapacitating and abducting infected humans you then treat with antibodies you harvested from your own body. More survivors at the shelter translates into more hands to help with the crafting, maintenance and upgrades, but it also means more mouths to feed.
Deal with locks in a number of ways They come in different types and sizes and stand between you and important resources. If you have the right tool in your backpack, you can lockpick, hack or pry open a lock. These actions are implemented as mini-games and the difficulty of the task is affected by the hero’s stats. You can also use a key or enter the right combination, if you found one of these along the way.

title: Portal Foxes TD
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Defend portals from hordes of slimes with elemental foxes from a tabletop VR perspective. Recruit a colorful set of characters to help in your quest to reconnect a fragmented world over a 25 level single-player story adventure.
No fixed paths.
Slimes can climb anything, but they (usually) don't like to. You must know your enemy to build your defenses effectively.
No Upgrades. No Numbers.

title: Dead Static Drive
description:
게임 정보
Grand Theft Cthulhu

Dead Static Drive is Grand Theft Cthulhu. An indie survival-horror game following a nightmarish road trip across a 1980s Americana. Playing as prodigal-child Hearst, you need to scavenge, fight, sneak, and explore in order to figure out what’s happened to your parents, and the rest of the world. Evade police. Equip yourself and those close to you, and follow your own moral code.  Learn how—and who—to trust. And learn it fast, the monsters are gaining on you.

Dead Static Drive blends weird fiction and uncanny Eldritch themes with a spooky unease underlying this small-town life.
Heavily influenced by the work of weird fiction authors T. E. D. Klein, Gene Wolfe, & Ramsey Campbell, filmmaker David Lynch, and photographer William Eggleston, Dead Static Drive hopes to invoke images of an America now lost, where with the right car and enough gas, anything felt possible.

title: The Drifter
description:
게임 정보


A Pulp Adventure Thriller from the minds that brought you Crawl and Peridium.
An engrossing roller-coaster of a story - Drawing on King, Crichton and Carpenter, with a dash of 70s Ozploitation.
Point 'N Click or Controller - Featuring unique twin-stick interaction makes The Drifter as comfy to play on the couch as at the PC.
Brooding dark-synth cinematic score.
Fully voice acted.



Mick Carter's been drifting a while now - never staying one place long, moving from job to job. Forced to return to his old home town, he witnesses a violent murder, is pursued by mysterious armed men, and killed.

And that's just the start of Mick's problems.

His consciousness ripped away, thrust back into his own body seconds before his death...
Framed for the murder he witnessed, tormented by his own past, and haunted by a feeling that something followed him back from the other side...

Follow Mick as he's sucked headfirst into a lunatic web of shadowy corporations, murder, and the thousand year obsession of a madman.



The Drifter is our fast-paced take on a classic 2d point and click adventure. Taking cues from the recent revival of the genre, the focus is on story with puzzle solving being the glue that ties it together. Mick's a pretty practical guy, and so puzzles are down-to-earth, designed to be unobtrusive, and give an investigative feel. We're keeping the pacing quick and lean, you'll never be wandering around lost or confused - Mick is propelled through the story at a good clip, from one situation to another, with barely a moment to catch his breath.

title: Dissonators
description:
게임 정보
Description
Year 2055. Corporations and syndicates rule the world undividedly. Their power is absolute. The Alliance and Syndicate wage bloody proxy wars across the planet for power and profit. The global economic crisis foreshadows a global infrastructural collapse. Lives exchange for materials and resources ..
In addition to chaos and regression, the world market is being captured by a new generation of drugs - RED. A byproduct of experiments with meta-materials. It spreads across the continents like fire. Everyone needs a small victorious War! A war for control over the markets.
Features:

title: Love is a Demon
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an unpredictable journey with Ash through love, friendship, and supernatural chaos.
Love is a Demon is a narrative adventure game that takes you on a heartfelt and hilarious ride through the complexities of romance and personal growth. Step into the shoes of Ash, an introverted dreamer finally ready to confess their feelings to their best friend, Ivy. But just as everything seems to fall into place, an unforeseen supernatural event throws their world into chaos.
Live the Story – Explore Ash’s world through immersive, interactive moments that pull you deeper into their journey.
Shape the Narrative – Every choice you make influences Ash’s relationships and leads to different outcomes.
Laugh & Cringe – Enjoy witty dialogue, quirky interactions, and absurd situations that make love feel messier than ever.
Emotional Journey: Explore love, friendship, and self-discovery through relatable moments that resonate with your heart.
Solve & Explore: Solve fun puzzles that reflect the ups and downs of Ash’s journey.
Multiple Endings: Your decisions shape Ash’s path and determine the outcomes of their love story.
Character Exploration: Build relationships, uncover backstories, and explore how each character’s dynamics influence the journey.
Will Ash find the courage to confess, or will otherworldly chaos derail their plans?
Your choices. Your love life. Your demonic mess.

title: The Magus Circle
description:
게임 정보
마술은 예술이다! 더 매거스 서클은 뱀서라이크 요소를 결합한 생존 로그 라이트 게임입니다. 플레이어는 직접 마법 문양을 그려 주문을 시전하고, 다양한 업그레이드를 조합하여 강력한 마법사로 성장해야 합니다. 짧게는 1분, 길게는 20분 이상까지 이어지는 플레이 타임 속에서, 끊임없이 몰려오는 적의 파도를 돌파하고 생존해야 합니다.

title: DECRYPTO Project
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the DECRYPTO project! I am Inky, the official INKorp virtual assistant. Your job is to train an advanced AI model to better understand encryption systems and human language. During the next week, you will be subject to the following responsibilities:
Analyze encrypted texts to reverse the encryption and determine the key by using specialized software apps.
Keep alert for special tasks where you’ll need to deduce the encryption system yourself. Send us the encryption parameters quickly—don’t waste time reading the content!
Earn INKredits by completing your daily tasks. Use them to unlock new applications, customize your InkOS system, or access news articles.
Under any circumstance, do not perform any of the following activities: deliberately failing tasks, engaging with individuals of malicious intent, or exploiting potential flaws of the InkOS system.
Perform your duties diligently for a week and you will discover why the DECRYPTO project is necessary to save humanity!

title: Upfall
description:
게임 정보
Upfall is a game about bouncing, dodging, and dying. Escape the depths by bouncing on bubbles and avoid the hazards which slowly present themselves. Glowing red = danger... at least to start with! Each new depth you reach causes the colours to change and the hazards to increase, with enough random generation so each upfall is never the same. It's not easy, but with fast restarts and quick rounds you'll find yourself coming back over and over.
Can you find your way back to the surface?
Totally, utterly free – The world isn't great right now for a lot of people so we wanted to give back. Upfall is completely free - no ads, no monetisation, no catch
Quick rounds – Each fall takes between 2 and 10 minutes so you can play between other games or on your lunch break
Unlocks and customisation – Unlock new colour palettes, audio styles, ambiences, and characters to customise how the game looks and sounds
Keyboard or controller – Play keyboard only, feel the controller vibrate, or watch the DualShock 4/DualSense controller light change colour to reflect the game state
Chill but eerie – Simple rules with a creepy, no-jump scares, atmosphere to keep you engaged and coming back
A game by Amicable Animal with art from eggysworld and piano samples from Luci Holland.
(Just so you know: this game is provided as is, and we can't offer support as it's free. It is built in Unity so if you can play Unity games it should run fine!)

title: VOW
description:
게임 정보
Story
The main character is a girl named Marya, who wakes up in the forest with no memory of how she ended up here. The village is empty, but in the huts locked from the inside there are traces of life - letters, birchbark inscriptions and anxious prayers. In time, she realizes that the inhabitants were keeping an ancient Vow, a ritual that protected the village from invisible evil. Someone has broken the vow, and now the world is frozen on the border between sunset and night.
The deeper she delves into the mystery, the closer she comes to the realization that she herself may have been the cause of everything that is happening.
Main features of the game
Original setting inspired by Slavic mythology.
Atmospheric plot about madness and oblivion.
Mysterious letters on birch bark, changing depending on the time of day.
Realistic graphics with dirty, faded textures.
Multiple endings based on player decisions.
No interface and no map for maximum immersion.

title: Dreadline: Net Quota
description:
게임 정보
Dreadline is a co-op horror fishing game where you embark on dangerous waters to try and catch enough fish to pay off your debts to a shady merchant. 
Different fish require different tools. You’ll use rods, nets, and harpoons to catch increasingly strange creatures lurking beneath the fog-covered waters. The further you venture, the more specialized equipment you'll need to tackle the different fish. 
In order to make it back to shore in time before nightfall, you'll need to upgrade your boat if you want to make it out to the farthest reaches. Speed, hull reinforcement and fuel capacity are essential. You may also want to tack on some more... offensive upgrades, for the more dangerous waters. 
Who knows what swims in the depths below? These waters are dangerous, and there have been unusual creatures sighted around here. Make sure to keep an eye out, and try to keep a low profile. Some monsters are attracted to the light, some sneak up on you—stay alert!

title: Life Dash
description:
게임 정보
Life Dash is your ticket to a hilarious and exciting cartoon world where you race to build your dream life—faster than your friends! In this playful yet strategic life-sim, every decision matters, from choosing what to eat, where to work, when to study, and how to invest your money. Can you master life's balancing act and reach your dreams faster than anyone else?
Live, Learn, Earn, Repeat!
Each week is a turn, packed with choices: get a job, upgrade your skills, buy food, or maybe risk it all on gold, stocks, or commodities. Every action you take moves the clock forward, bringing new opportunities—and surprises—your way.
Explore a Colorful Cartoon World
Dive into a vibrant world filled with charming characters, fun mini-quests, and delightful surprises that make every turn fresh and exciting.
Choose Your Own Strategy
Play it safe or take risks! Invest wisely, upgrade your career, or focus on happiness—how you play is entirely up to you. Each path offers unique rewards and challenges.
Key Features:
Weekly Decision-Making: Make choices on work, study, spending, investing, and more, shaping your character's future week by week.
Mini-Quests: Complete goal-based and time-based quests that boost your happiness and help you learn the ropes.
Cartoon-style World: A colorful, inviting world to explore.
Friendly Competition: Reach your life goals in the least number of weeks—compare your record time with your friends.
Learn While You Play: Develop real-world skills, from financial literacy to effective decision-making.
Dive into Life Dash and start turning everyday choices into a thrilling journey to success. Your future awaits—how fast can you get there?

title: Touhou Crawl
description:
게임 정보
던전화된 환상향을 돌파하자!

이 게임은 던전 크롤 -스톤수프-의 큰 영향을 받은 동방 2차 창작 팬게임 로그라이크입니다.
이 게임은 제가 아주 오래전에 만들어졌던 프로젝트로 로컬라이징 지원, 편의성 추가, 추가 컨텐츠, 밸런싱등의 개선을 통해 스팀 무료 게임으로 제공될 예정입니다.

(상점 페이지에 보이는 스크린샷, 영상은 과거 버전의 영상으로 차후 수정될 예정입니다.)
게임 특징
12개의 종족, 20개의 직업, 혹은 9명의 유니크한 동방 캐릭터 스타팅
17개의 작고 큰 던전과 10개의 룬
200종이 넘는 몬스터 (그 중 약 80명의 동방 캐릭터 네임드)

title: Fire in the Hole
description:
게임 정보
With the upcoming merger approaching, play as one of four animal company leaders looking to dominate the competition through an intense game of golf. But for stakes so high, they've agreed to mix things up a little. And thus, the hunt is on!
Fire in the Hole is a top-down twin-stick shooter featuring four animals all duking it out on the golf course. It is a local PVP and controllers are recommended (although one player can use Mouse and Keyboard) and the game is intended for 2-4 players.

title: Dreadful Death
description:
게임 정보
You Are the Next Victim
Waking up in a strange locked room, you realize one thing: this house is a trap, and its owner is a maniac keeping you here for reasons only he knows. You have just a few days to escape, but every mistake brings you closer to your demise…
Game Features:
DEADLY HIDE AND SEEK
The killer hears every sound—drop an item or step on a creaky floorboard, and he’ll come hunting.
Stay alert—you can encounter him anywhere, and his traps are scattered throughout the house.
Don’t try to fight—without proper preparation, you won’t survive.
THREE WAYS TO ESCAPE

title: GNOM
description:
게임 정보
The genre of the game is survival dungeon-crawler. Your goal is to explore the Unruly Caves, discovering their secrets, fighting enemies and overcoming various difficulties.
Project GNOM has a moderate gameplay pace. The hero will have to work hard with a pickaxe to get to ore deposits and find secrets hidden from the eyes. Most enemies can be dealt with with an axe and shield, but often you'll need to use a variety of traps to be more effective. If things get too difficult, you can retreat or try to push enemies against each other.
The stones themselves are also dangerous. In the caves are not uncommon collapses, and after each blow with a pickaxe can appear, for example, poisonous gas, flow lava that burns the stones, and may happen and even worse. But the dwarf has to dig. He needs resources to survive. He searches for knowledge left in the caves long before him by other pioneers.

title: The Line
description:
게임 정보
It’s a night out like any other. Your friend is already inside, and you just need to get through the line.
Use your phone to spot and capture anomalies—things that feel off, but only when you look closer.
Interact with strangers. Some are just waiting. Others have been here for a while.

title: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster
description:
게임 정보
Class is back in session! After a 15 year wait Class of Heroes 3, the revered school-themed dungeon RPG series, is finally here!
Enrol in one of three distinct schools and join your fellow students on an epic dungeon crawling adventure. Enjoy school life on campus and meet brand new friends for a huge range of characters and classes.
Choose your party to suit your play style and then take to the sprawling 3D dungeons to take down enemies and acquire loot to see your party get ever stronger. With hundreds of combinations of Race, Classes, armours, weapons and Items, you can create a wild array of party compositions to take on the challenges ahead!
Remastered for an all new generation, Class of Heroes 3 is the pinnacle of this much loved series!
Key features:
Enter the dungeon!: Class of Heroes 3 takes 3D dungeon-crawling RPGs to a new level - with more characters and bigger dungeons than ever before!
Back to School: Choose from one of three distinct schools - each will change your uniform, difficulty and story!
Make new friends! The new relationship system will allow you to forge (or break!) bonds with the fellow students in your party. The stronger the bond, the greater the benefit!
Let’s party!: Team up with fellow students from a huge range of races and classes to build the best possible party of heroes to explore dungeons with.
Plunder the dungeons!: Take your party into colossal, labyrinthine dungeons - fight off enemies and plunder the loot to make yourself stronger on each run!
Build it your way: With hundreds of weapons, armour and items - along with  even more combinations of races and classes. Customise your team to suit your playing style!
New and improved: As the third iteration in the series, every aspect of the original games has been enhanced and improved to make this the most enjoyable in the series yet!

title: The Ump Show
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the game as a baseball umpire. Make accurate calls but make sure your team wins!

Pitchers will change up the pitch selection to confuse the batters but you have to be better. Track fastballs and breaking pitches to make accurate strike/ball calls. If you make a terrible call, the players will challenge your call! If you make too many wrong calls, it's game over!

Calls you will make as the home plate umpire:
Ball/Strike
Checked swings
Fair/Foul
Tag Plays and Forceouts

Since you want your preferred team to win, remember to cheat! Giving up too many walks or too many balls can give away the game. Pick your moments and redirect the game at the right time.

To help you, you can spend your integrity to purchase powerups!

Block: Stop a player from challenging your call
Balk: Call a balk on the pitcher and immediately reward a walk to the batter
Eject: Replace the batter or pitcher with your preferred player.
Story Mode

You start as an umpire with no credibility in the amateur leagues. Your goal is to build credibility and earn favors to climb your way to umpiring at the highest levels!

title: Masada
description:
게임 정보
Civilization is trapped in Masada, a vast and exotic nebula far from any star system. Thousands of years have passed since humanity became prisoners of this strange world, and in that time, it has blossomed into drastically different cultures—ranging from humble nomads to black hole-worshiping theocracies and powerful empires competing for total domination. The struggle for survival is always present in this brutal space.
Gameplay
Masada is a single-player RTS/RPG set in a 5,000 x 5,000 x 50 km open world sandbox.
Explore many unique regions ranging from vast asteroid fields filled with pirates to dense nebula where any dangers could be lurking in the fog, to even epic ice capped terrain. The nebula is a strange and wild place.
Immerse yourself in a simulated world. You are not the center of the universe in Masada. Ships and their pilots will carry on with their business whether you are there or not. Encounter miners hauling ore back from an excavation, ambush traders as they bring goods across the nebula, scavenge wreckage from a battle you stumble upon, and much more.
Build and customize your fleets, from nimble interceptors to powerful battlecruisers and even motherships. You will need to use a wide range of tactics to truly thrive in the nebula. Arm your ship's weapons with autocannons, artillery, railguns, missiles, beams, pulse cannons, torpedoes... and more. Setup support ships with repairing shield beams to protect your frontline. Develop robust carriers that can quickly dock and repair your smaller craft in battle. The combination of outfitting all your ships with a wide range of weapons and modules leads to infinite variations of tactics for you to explore.
Craft and discover greater and more powerful modules and weapons through industry, trade, combat and exploration.
Learn to build and fly all the ships in the nebula through blueprints. Some will be harder to acquire than others...
Train and recruit a powerful faction of pilots to pursue roles from scouts to frigate captains and set your best to command your most powerful warships. Your pilots can achieve mastery in any area to dominate the nebula.
Freedom to pursue any path. Whether you want to lead a powerful faction, command a small elite squad of pirates, build an industrial powerhouse or even become a nomadic trader, Masada is a game centered around unrestricted player freedom.

title: Brotherhood
description:
게임 정보
They are billions. You are alone.
An ominous brotherhood of religious fanatics perform experiments on humans in their top-secret scientific complex. An ancient prison hidden deep in the Swiss mountains houses hundreds of test subjects whose bodies are mutilated in an effort to produce a new biological species of superhuman.

You are one of them, but unlike other test subjects, your body is immune to mutagens. For you, it's not poison anymore, rather a source of power that makes your body nearly indestructible.
Steal the weapon and obliterate them.
Break into the depths of the secret complex, unravel the secret of the millennial brotherhood's ancient technology and harness the power of mutagen to annihilate all those who stand in your way.
A timeless classic, with a fresh presentation.
The Brotherhood is a retro-shooter with classic Wolfenstein 3D style. You will feel right at home when exploring complex one-story levels in search of first aid kits, ammo and key cards, while fighting hordes of enemies in action-packed firefights. An old school shooter's classic weapons, upgrades, and well-hidden secrets will complete the experience.
Enemies are powerful. But not immortal.
There are more than 20 types of enemies in the game, and each knows how to kill you in a variety of ways. Among them are ordinary soldiers, cyborgs with power armor, flamethrowers, and huge walking mechs.

Fear not! There are brutal means to fight them all! A total of 9 types of weapons representing the most advanced engineering fashion of the brotherhood. You'll have plenty of obliteration methods at your disposal - not only a shotgun that can make a juicy "bang", but also a laser rifle that can fire infinitely, a flamethrower, and a rocket launcher. There is also...a " Butterfly ", a weapon so secret that not even the Brotherhood knows why it's called like that.
Crowds of fanatics aren't the only obstacles you need to overcome on your journey; traps and environmental elements also pose a grave threat. Watch out, since just 1 wrong step is all it takes for the laser barrier to slice you into 8 pieces.
You will face 24 huge and complex levels across 6 acts. Escape the prison by sneaking through a secret laboratory, sand dunes, and an ancient castle that holds thousands of years of Brotherhood history.
No one is with you. All you have is yourself. Your shotgun. Hordes of enemies. Animal rage and the desire to kill.
Destroy Them All!

title: AMNYAM
description:
게임 정보
“마우스 조준 기술로 정상에 도전하세요!”
“AMNYAM”은 당신이 “마우스 조준 기술”을 사용하여 올라가고 정상에 도전하는 플랫폼 게임입니다.
주변에 떠 있는 “목표”를 정확히 조준하고 클릭하여 고양이 소녀가 높이 점프하게 하세요.
하지만 아무것도 하지 않으면 캐릭터는 원래 높이로 떨어집니다.
따라서 공중에서 다음 목표를 클릭해야 합니다.

title: Suspended Animation 💽
description:
게임 정보
Suspended Animation is a sci-fi first person exploration game about a ship in danger, and the evil AI tasked with saving it: you.

Piece together the events of the past to find out what's going on, exploring every nook and cranny for clues. Download yourself to nearby droids to get in where you shouldn't be. Increase your security access by being trustworthy, or by hacking your way there.

Solve puzzles to traverse the treacherous environment of your failing ship, and talk to NPCs to gain their trust - if you even want it.

title: Peggy's Farm
description:
게임 정보
Whether you're a Peggle player, a cozy gamer, or a supporter of all things indie, you won't be able to put it down. 
Enjoy the non-stop, ball-bouncing fun of Pachinko mixed with the cozy and satisfying gameplay of farming sims like Stardew Valley and Harvest Moon.

title: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree
description:
게임 정보
Game introduction
This is an RPG strategy adventure game that incorporates tabletop game elements and uses card construction as the main gameplay.
Main plot
A game called Greed Island is holding a trial session. 100 players from all over the world participated in this event and played on the latest virtual reality equipment. Not long after the trial started, the players They found that they could not leave the game, and there was a huge ancient tree where they were. Through talking to the NPC, they learned that most of the people who came here came here to reach the top of the soul tree, because it can realize your dreams. Any wish. Faced with the situation of being unable to return to reality, the players started their adventure with complicated emotions.
Gameplay
You will play Lin Yue, a player who is late for the trial meeting, and adventure in the fantasy world of swords and magic. You will get to know many players from the same world as you, as well as NPCs in the game, who may become you. A powerful partner on the way forward, or an enemy that can hinder or even destroy you.
During the adventure, you will be able to collect a variety of cards, equipment and props, and make full use of them to challenge various powerful enemies and learn the truth about this world.
Character introduction
Lin Yue. An editor from an ordinary magazine company attended a game trial session due to work reasons, but was late.
Zhou Mo. He used to be the best among players, but for some reason he gave up his adventure in the Soul Tree and lived in the Novice Village.
