⚙️ 설정

title: FSA DRIVING
description:
게임 정보
In FSA Driving, you will become a super courier in the fictional city of Nijnait, navigating the streets and alleys in various high-performance vehicles. Make strategic use of the city's terrain and items, showcasing stunt driving skills to complete thrilling delivery challenges and savor a unique driving experience.

Explore a rich and entertaining open world
Embark on a journey through Nijnait, inspired by the city of Tianjin in China. Speed through bustling urban areas and vast wild outskirts, collecting items, engaging in various mini-games, and experiencing interactive elements integrated into the map.

Unique stunt abilities
Beyond regular driving, master challenging maneuvers such as blade overtaking, water gliding, and airborne gliding—actions that are hard to achieve in real life.

Simulated management elements
Conduct goods trading in specialty shops located across different areas of the city. Buy low, sell high, and race against fluctuating price curves.

Character development aspects
Manage resources such as energy, hunger, and restroom needs, as these values will impact your missions. Restore these values by interacting with various buildings on the map. Enhance your abilities gradually by increasing your driving and stunt proficiency throughout the game.

title: Subversive Memories
description:
게임 정보
Synopsis
Renata has been haunted her entire life by a void within. She needs to find answers that fill the gaps of her past.
She follows a promising track to an abandoned military research base. However, she soon finds out that this place holds secrets beyond her comprehension and that her obsession might cost her a price she can't pay.
About the game
Subversive Memories is set in a fictitious Brazil during the military dictatorship that took place from 1964 to 1985. It talks about the horrors of being oppressed by those who should protect us and the memories of the victims of a ruthless authoritarian regime that kidnapped, censored and killed thousands of people.

title: The Touhou Empires
description:
게임 정보
"환상전략록"은 실시간 전략 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
마음에 드는 세력을 골라 각지에 흩어진 자원으로 물자를 비축하여,
최종적으로 자신 이외의 모든 세력을 물리치는 것에 그 목적이 있습니다.

우리군의 승리를 위해 다양한 지식과 테크닉을 사용해 전투에 임하라!
동방프로젝트의 인기 캐릭터가 40명 이상 등장!



주인공 레이무/마리사를 비롯해 역대 시리즈에 등장한 인기 캐릭터들이 총출동!
모든 캐릭터들은 고유 필살기 '스펠 카드'를 가지고 있습니다!
공격·방어 등, 각각 다른 능력을 가진 히로인을 이용해, 환상향 세계 지배를 목표로!
나만의 취향의 세력을 찾아 내자!



하쿠레이신사博麗神社는 내정과 방위능력이 강하며 홍마관은 초반부터 강력한 군사를 배출할 수 있는 등
히로인이 속한 각 세력마다 특기·약점이 존재!
자신의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 세력을 찾아내는 것도 이 게임을 즐기는 묘미 중 하나!



기동력은 있지만 창에 약한 기병, 사거리는 넓지만 접근전에 약한 궁병,
강력한 광범위 공격이 가능한 마도서 등 각각 강점이 있는 여러 다양한 유닛들이 존재.
전황과 상대 세력에 맞게 적절한 유닛을 선택!



싱글 플레이로도 차분하게 즐길 수 있는, 20막 이상의 스토리 탑재!
환상향의 수수께끼를 둘러싼, 30명 이상의 동방 캐릭터가 등장!
이변을 일으킨 진범은 과연 누구일까? 수수께끼를 직접 밝혀내자!



최대 6명이 동시에 플레이할 수 있는 온라인 대전 기능까지 지원!
"3 대 3"의 팀전부터 마지막 한 명을 가리는 배틀로얄까지
다양한 조합이 가능한 자유도로 친구들과도 태그를 하며 전세계 플레이어에 도전!



호화 작곡진의 도입부 및 개발 차원에서 빚어낸 잘 만들어진 효과음,
지금까지 없었던 참신한 키비주얼과 초원이나 물의 세세한 환경표현 등
여러모로 인디게임 수준을 뛰어넘는 '퀄리티에 대한 집착'을 보여드리겠습니다!
autokwd: The Touhou Empires,환상전략록 - The Touhou Empires

title: Moonwakers : Episode 01
description:
게임 정보
Discover the rogue survival-lite 
Dive into a survival roguelite by taking control of a S.E.E.D, an advanced reconnaissance android! To accomplish your mission, explore exoplanets to determine if they are suitable for humanity.
Thus, you'll need to search for vital elements necessary for life: Carbon, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, Oxygen, Phosphorus, and Sulfur. But beware, danger lurks on this unknown land, and your survival will depend on your ingenuity and skills.
Traps abound, and you'll need to strategize to make it through. Regularly, you'll have to shelter your character to escape ionic storms.
Exploration will allow you to acquire new skills and enjoy more autonomy, speed, and gliding. Your biggest challenge? Managing your energy to avoid extinction.
Movement is survival, movement is fun
What could be cooler than exploring an unknown planet on a snowboard?
This mode of movement, fast and fluid, offers you gliding sensations for greater freedom and intensity. Speed, adrenaline, and exploration intertwine in this unique roguelite, where moments of absolute calm collide with the unpredictable challenges of a vibrant, ever-changing world.
Energy consumption as core mechanic

title: Thawed Waters
description:
게임 정보
Thawed Waters is a mature emotional story experienced through hardcore boat-poling gameplay when every wrong move leads to losses and each stamina point counts!

Thawed Waters is not another farming sim, nor rogue-like, but pure classic isometric action with a problematic topic that needs to be raised in video games.

It's time to look into the ugliest corner of human life - animal testing.

"Pandemic of the second decade was nothing compared to what global warming melted in the Arctic later, freeing bacteria buried by nature millions of years ago. One of the thawed viruses ruthlessly attacked not only people but also animals of all kinds. Multiple attempts to develop a vaccine before the world plunged into chaos were unsuccessful, and a few remnants scattered across the globe lost all hope of surviving."
Stepan, head of Pukhovka village, 2047



NAVIGATE THE BOAT

Survive the planetary flood in the rusty boat with the pole in your hands! Choose directions wisely and apply force carefully to minimise rocking and tilting and avoid capsizing. Go around obstacles with the surgeon’s precision to keep the boat in one piece. Mistakes cost precious live cargo and materials, and the old man's stamina is a finite resource. Every decision is critical.

RESCUE AND SIT RABBITS

Finding the perfect time to pick rabbits is one side of the problem. How about sitting jumpy animals around the boat to achieve balance? The boat's behaviour depends on it, and therefore your life! Don’t miss a safe zone to release your fellow travellers or drown together and be forgotten.

FIGHT FATIGUE

Mental and physical fatigue are your eternal silent companions, that you have to deal with to survive. Collect and identify Siberian herbs and berries, mix them and brew a cosy cup of tea in safe zones to ease physical fatigue. Or not too cosy and get some unexpected side effects. Live through events of your past as mini-games to reduce or increase mental fatigue when dreaming next to the bonfire.

UPGRADE AND MODIFY

Your only ally, a mysterious prosthetic arm, holds the key to survival. Upgrade it with unique mods, and unleash its potential to travel further, push stronger, and save more lives. The boat barely stays afloat, but natural wit and a bit of luck will get you some cool artefacts increasing the boat’s stability or strength when it is needed the most.

LIVE THROUGH APOCALYPTICAL EVENTS

Fight the forces of nature to save it and give humanity another chance. Find a new meaning in life and watch how the broken old man transforms physically and mentally. Discover all the endings of this unusual story of personal salvation through rescuing the tiniest creatures. Explore the dark and submerged corners of the dying Siberian hinterland with a touch of cyberpunk.

title: Abandoned Archive
description:
게임 정보

Abandoned Archive is a uniquely crafted, fast-paced, spellcasting roguelike. Set in an archive that has been long forgotten and sealed away, the player must venture deep below ground to uncover the dark secrets tucked away.
Spells & Relics


Discover the many schools of magic, and utilise their spells to fight your way down the tower you are sealed in. Battle with anything from lightning and air to gravity and time. Becoming powerful requires you to synergise your spells by carefully choosing upgrades and collecting rare relics that offer passive effects to be combined with your finest abilities.


When one day you find yourself sealed in a tower, a strange, sentient Orb proposes a deal. With Oblome the Orbite, who claims to be one with science, you forge onwards in an attempt to escape your imprisonment and find the city of Orbites. Tied to your pact, you must protect Oblome at any cost if any danger arises, and in turn, he will protect you. There is definitely something stowed away, some kind of synthetic horror at the base of this archive. Will you delve deep and decipher the mysteries? Or will you simply succumb to your surroundings?


Set in the country of Gratissia in the tower named “Turrim”, Abandoned Archive has the player exploring fragments of a species’ past, floor by floor. With an exiled ex-scientist as your guide and protector, there seems to just be many burning questions, with answers hiding in the cracks of the archive.

title: The Walker
description:
게임 정보
Walker는 싱글 플레이어 생존 공포 게임입니다. 평화로운 날이 지났고 더 이상 먹기 위해 일하지 않고 생존을 위해 노력하십시오. 이 모든 것의 이면에 무엇이 있는지 알아보십시오. 살아서 탈출하시길 바랍니다.

당신은 무슨 일이 일어났는지 모른 채 도시에서 눈을 떴고, 그날 갑자기 당신의 삶이 전례 없이 바뀌게 됩니다. 도시는 무너졌고 세상은 당신이 이전에 알던 것과 같지 않습니다. 당신이 찾은 모든 용품을 얻고 필요한 것을 만들고 현명하게 사용하십시오.

[목록]
어깨 너머로 카메라 시점 – 플레이어는 캐릭터의 위치를 자세히 살펴보고 강렬한 분위기를 느낄 것입니다.
사용할 수 있는 많은 무기 – 스토리가 환경에 맞게 진행됨에 따라 더 많은 무기가 포함되지만 탄약과 건강 키트가 제한되어 모든 총알이 중요합니다.
가능한 최고의 그래픽 제공 – 루멘 및 DLSS와 같은 최신 기술을 사용하여 최고의 그래픽에 생명을 불어넣으십시오.[/목록]

title: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an Emotional Adventure
Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature is a peaceful and reflective experience, filled with meaningful collectibles, unique emotion-driven interactions, and environmental puzzles. The orchestral soundtrack emphasizes an intimate storyline of unlikely friendship, loss, and love.

Explore a Colorful World
Travel across vast, beautifully diverse landscapes, each seamlessly blending into the next, filled with unique flora and fauna waiting to be discovered. The progress you make is reflected in the vibrant flowers blooming on the Golem’s back. There are many secrets and collectibles to discover, making for a rewarding exploration experience.

Along the way, you’ll encounter a variety of charming creatures, such as squirrels, peacocks, armadillos, elephants, horses, sand cats and more. During your journey you also meet a curious Fox who turns out to be a helpful ally on your quest. As the adventure unfolds, the Golem and the Fox develop a deep and meaningful bond, highlighting the connection between Nature, and emotions in this ever-changing world.

Solve puzzles that shape the environment around you. Use the Golem’s abilities to interact with the world in creative ways, unlocking new paths and uncovering secrets. Hidden within the remnants of a lost civilization lies the means to reclaim and rejuvenate Nature.

Born again through magic, the Golem is deeply connected to the world around you. Its emotions are influenced by the environment in real time, shaping the weather, plants, and animals nearby. Embark on a journey of self-discovery, seeking purpose and a place to belong in a world reborn.

title: Solnox - Grimoire of Seasons
description:
게임 정보
사계절과 지형 변화 효과를 활용하여 끊임없이 변화하는 전장을 마스터하세요. 나만의 덱을 구성하여 완벽한 시너지 효과를 내고 세 명의 수호자를 이끌고 부정한 생명체를 상대로 승리하는 방법을 배워보세요.




전장은 이제 당신의 것입니다. 다양한 계절 카드를 사용하여 계절의 힘을 불러일으켜 자신과 적의 밑에 놓인 타일을 바꾸세요. 플레이하는 모든 카드가 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 것입니다. 적들이 비슷한 힘을 발휘하여 당신의 죽음을 굳히기 때문에 예측할 수 없는 대학살에 대응하세요.



봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울. 사계절에 내재된 고유한 특성을 발휘하여 강력한 시너지 콤보를 만들어 무자비한 적을 물리치세요. 부패의 확산을 막으려는 헛된 시도로 죽어가는 세상을 되찾으세요.



수호자들은 힘을 합쳐야만 다가오는 타락으로부터 스스로를 지킬 수 있습니다. 매번 신중하게 덱을 구성하거나 실험적인 조합을 시도하여 세 명의 강력한 캐릭터 간의 시너지를 더욱 향상시키세요. 실패할 때마다 더 강해지고, 새로운 카드 슬롯을 잠금 해제하고, 더 강력하고 복잡한 카드를 수집하세요.

title: Orc Warchief: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
Here you have full game, please wishlists if you like our game:


In the free Orc Warchief prologue, you'll be able to manage your Orc Village. Collect resources, expand your city and pursue politics. You have to keep order because orcs like to be naughty. Gameplay will be limited to a few quests compared to the full game.

Many years have passed since the Great War and defeat that the Orcs suffered from vile humans. From that time they hunted us like animals and pressed deeper into our lands. But you decided not to back down one step further. You’re a young Warchief lusting for blood and your warriors want revenge. Reclaim your lands, rebuild your villages and bring doom on our enemies. Raise our warbanner and gather The Horde. We will follow you to death or victory! Lead our Warchief!

Rebuild your destroyed villages and gather resources you need. Hunt for game and prepare supplies for your army. Train your warriors and prepare your weapons. Build your war machines and defences. And bring the revenge your people deserve.

In this strategic city builder your goal is to rebuild the might of The Horde. You need to gather necessary resources to build your buildings and expand your village. Gather food to feed your growing population. Mine metal and forge weapons necessary for your army. Train your warriors and equip them with various armour and gear. Build defences to buy time for preparations and strike when you're ready for war.

You need to manage your resources well and balance between expansion and needs of your clan. Your clan members have different skill sets and will help you in unique ways.

Raiding human settlements or ambushing their caravans increases your Fear and builds your name as a true Warchief. This attracts new Orcs and allows you to expand your population.

Unlock new buildings and special units to grow your military might. Worship your Gods to gain their favour and forbidden powers. Such powers can have a devastating effect on your enemies as well as your subjects and vary depending on the chosen God.

Incite fear among enemies to gather support necessary for warchief but remember that your growing settlement will also attract human attacks so prepare your defences and train your warriors well. Defeat is not an option. A true Orc is born and dies in battle.

title: Tokyo Underground Killer
description:
게임 정보

Neon-infused katana action in a fever dream Tokyo!
Dive into Tokyo's criminal underground as the feared "Shinjuku Vampire" Kobayashi and take out crazy lunatics for just the right price.


・Unrelenting katana combat: Slash, stab and parry your way through hordes of monsters inspired by Japanese demons
・Blood is the key to survival: Use 10 different blood skills to overcome challenging enemies, then suck in their blood to replenish your health and skills
・Fever dream Tokyo: Explore neon-drenched renditions of real places like Shinjuku, Akihabara or Shibuya
・Enjoy Tokyo's nighlife: Between missions you can relax in your own apartment in Shinjuku, buy decorations and play minigames in the city hub
・Hand drawn comic: A bizarre story with crazy characters brought to live in dynamic comic scenes drawn by Hans “Heavy Metal Hanzo” Steinbach
・Thanks, Andrew: Over 1 hour of original electronic music composed by the legendary Andrew Hulshult

title: Summer Road 10-Minute Roguelike
description:
게임 정보


10분 로그라이크 RPG - 바쁜 어른들을 위한
자동전투" x "아이템 수집"x"로그라이크"

화면의 절반을 차지하는 거대한 인벤토리를 활용해 장비를 합성하고 적을 물리쳐라!
전투는 자동이지만, 장비 조합에 따라 캐릭터의 행동이 달라진다.
전략적인 아이템 선택이 승리의 열쇠! 한 번 플레이하는 데 약 10분 정도 소요되어 부담 없이 즐길 수 있다.
선택하는 길과 이벤트에 따라 모험이 달라져, 반복 플레이의 재미가 가득!

추천 대상
아이템 수집가와 빌드 마스터
빠른 플레이 애호가
로그라이크 RPG 매니아



하나의 목표, 무한한 모험

동쪽의 신비로운 빛을 향해 여정을 떠나세요! 매 플레이마다 다른 스토리를 선사하는 10분짜리 RPG입니다. 랜덤 이벤트, 우연한 만남, 그리고 당신의 선택이 길을 결정합니다. 계속해서 플레이하며 새로운 가능성을 발견해 진정한 엔딩을 찾아보세요!



호기심 많은 세 아이가 신비로운 빛의 수수께끼를 풀기 위한 여름 모험을 시작합니다.
그들을 기다리는 시련과 보물은 무엇일까요?


모그모, 여행을 함께하는 신비로운 생명체는 세 개의 아이템을 먹어 새로운 아이템을 만들어냅니다.
상상도 못한 특별한 아이템을 만들기 위해 아이템 조합을 생각해 봅시다!

모그모의 힘을 활용해 모험을 정복하세요!

title: Touhou: the Unreachable Oneiroborder
description:
게임 정보
Exquisite Touhou Danmaku, Seven Years in the Making
“The Unreachable Oneiroborder” is a Touhou Project danmaku shoot-em-up fangame. The game is easy to learn, regardless of your prior experience with bullet hells.
Perhaps you’ve imagined your dreams coming true? One day, humans' dreams materialized into reality, satisfying their cravings and fulfilling their desires… a fantastic development, certainly. Yet, after the first nightmare materialized itself, sleep became an unspeakably horrific taboo in Gensokyo. The Dream Manifestation Incident has begun…
Take control of Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sanae Kochiya and Sumireko Usami; uncover the truth behind the suspicious phenomenon, and solve the incident that has shaken Gensokyo's very foundations.

title: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
description:
게임 정보
KISS 는 K-pop의 신나는 세계에 보내는 러브레터입니다.

이 인생 시뮬레이션에서 당신은 인재를 찾고, 일정을 관리하고, 예산을 편성하고, 소셜 미디어를 계획하고, 음악과 패션을 선택하는 강력한 관리자입니다!

차기 K팝 아이돌 그룹 데뷔!


연습생을 선택하세요.


각 연습생은 고유한 특성과 배경 이야기를 가지고 있습니다.
팬들을 열광하게 만들지만 그룹을 망칠 수도 있는 건방진 나쁜 여자를 선택하시겠습니까?
아니면 그녀가 무대에 설 준비가 되기 전에 조금 더 격려가 필요한 수줍은 노래 새와 함께 갈까요?
이 게임에서 당신은 그들의 노래를 듣고, 그들의 성격을 이해하고, 그들의 강점을 찾아 힘을 실어줍니다!
다양한 아이돌 그룹을 모으는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
autokwd: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut

title: Furcifer's Fungeon
description:
게임 정보
Choose from hundreds of unique talents and many spells and items.
Shape your talent tree with your choices.
Be a necromancer, a knight, an electro wizard, or just a pyromaniac!
Highly customizable loadout (over 1 million starting configurations)
Characters with unique abilities and talents can freely switch between different spell sets!

title: Sword Hero
description:
게임 정보
주요 기능:

심리스 오픈 월드: 제한이 없는 광대한 오픈 월드를 탐험하여 자유롭게 시작하세요.
다이나믹 시스템: 날씨, NPC 루틴, 범죄 및 소속 전쟁과 상호 작용합니다.
신체 부위 손상: 혈액이 나는 전투에서 적을 절단하세요.
건축: 집을 짓고 살아남고 번성하기 위해 아이템을 제작하세요.
거대한 보스: 엄청난 적들과의 에픽한 전투를 진행하세요.
물리학과 래그돌: 전투에서 전략적 이점을 얻기 위해 동적 래그돌 메카닉을 활용하세요.
개인화된 진행: 능력과 외모를 사용자 정의하여 강력한 능력과 장비를 잠금 해제하세요.
레벨 스케일링이 없는 적: 성장을 도전하는 진화하는 적과 마주하십시오.
생동감 있는 세계: NPC가 지형을 형성하는 동적 세계에 몰입하세요.
끝없는 가능성: 다양한 활동을 통해 운명을 조종하여 당신의 길을 선택하세요.

위험한 날씨 유형, 매일 반복되는 NPC, 범죄 및 평판 시스템, 다이나믹한 소속 전쟁 등 수십 가지 다이나믹 시스템으로 가득 찬 sandbox 오픈 월드 RPG. 알려진 영웅, 두려워하는 전설, 용병단의 지도자가 되거나 자신만의 수제 보금자리에서 간단한 삶을 유지하세요.



당신은 무명인으로 Sword Hero의 생생한 세계에 던져질 것입니다. 이 섬에는 세계의 새로운 자칭 신에게 부자 상인에 의해 주어진 수수께끼의 목걸이를 제공하는 것이 유일한 목표입니다. - 그의 요청을 따를지 아니면 Wes의 섬에서 다른 유리한 기회를 쫓을지는 완전히 당신에게 달려 있습니다.



보이지 않는 벽 없음 - 시작부터 원하는 곳으로 이동하세요! 그러나 Wes의 황야는 준비되지 않은 자에게는 가혹합니다. 고블린, 트롤, 거대한 나방과 같은 야수들이 땅을 배회하고 있지만 엄격하게 레벨링되지 않습니다. 게임의 시작에 당신을 파괴하는 적들이 충분한 힘을 얻으면 당신을 보고는 달아날 것입니다.



주변의 시뮬레이션된 세계에 대한 모든 세부 사항이 기여합니다. 게임은 당신의 행동뿐만 아니라 다른 캐릭터의 행동에도 반응합니다. 한 번은 마을 대장간 주인인 NPC가 다른 플레이 스루에서는 아내를 잃은 외로운 모험가가 될 수 있습니다.

그들처럼, 당신도 눈앞에 수십 가지 가능성이 있습니다. 의로운지 무자비한지, 주목받는 중심이 되든 고립된 늑대가 되든 주어진 도구를 사용하여 최종 목표에 도달하세요.

그리고 가장 중요한 것은 - 변화입니다. 힘과 시각적으로. 길드에서 순위를 올리거나 더 나은 장비를 받거나 만들거나 찾거나 훔치거나, 고대의 힘을 배우거나 또는 Deep World에서 로 몸 부위를 교환하여 자연스럽게 얻을 수 있는 힘보다 더 강력해질 수 있습니다.

title: Breath of Space
description:
게임 정보
STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/GameplayGif_03.gif[/img]

Breath of Space는 3인칭 슈팅 게임, 로그라이트, 로그라이크 장르의 요소를 결합한 액션으로 가득 찬 비디오 게임입니다. 이 게임은 광활한 Aegea Space Mining Facility를 배경으로 하며, 여기에서 다양한 위협에 맞서 싸우고 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하여 더 진행해야 합니다. 그러나 로봇 동료가 저장 파일을 운반하고 죽으면 모든 진행 상황이 손실됩니다. 따라서 경계를 늦추지 말고 동료를 살려두어 진행 상황을 그대로 유지해야 합니다.
로그라이크 또는 로그라이트
게임 내 플레이 스타일은 로봇 동료인 네페스가 죽었을 때 행동하는 방식에 영향을 미칩니다. 네페스를 위한 세 가지 자세 중에서 선택할 수 있으며, 더 위험한 자세를 선택할수록 네페스가 더 강해집니다. 그러나 플레이 스타일이 공격적일수록 모든 진행 상황을 잃을 확률이 높아집니다. 네페스가 죽으면 죽을 때 진행 상황이 초기화되니 조심하세요!

에게 우주 채굴 시설
모든 방이 독특한 시련과 기회를 선사하는 광활한 우주 채굴 시설로 여행을 떠나세요. 다양한 업그레이드, 리소스 및 수정 사항을 사용하여 게임을 탐색하고 당신을 기다리고 있는 진화하는 도전에 적응하십시오. 시설에 더 깊이 파고들수록 판돈이 증가하여 더 큰 보상과 함께 더 큰 위험을 제공합니다.

브레스 오브 스페이스에서 우주 요원이 되어 위험한 임무를 수행하세요. 연방의 번영을 위한 희망의 등대인 에게해 우주 채굴 시설이 미지의 존재에 의해 침략당합니다. 그러나 시설이 공격받고 핵심 인물인 Uzay의 아버지가 사라지자 시설을 되찾기 위한 위험한 임무에 투입됩니다. 다른 요원들과 마찬가지로 어려운 도전에 직면하고 임무 성공에 실패하게 됩니다.

미지의 지역을 탐험하고, 강력한 적과 싸우고, 연방의 운명을 결정하세요. 시설을 구하고 아버지가 남긴 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있을까요? 이 스릴 넘치는 모험에서 이야기는 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.
패배는 시작에 불과한 혁신적인 재탄생 시스템을 경험하세요. 동료 드로이드 네페스의 힘을 활용하여 다시 일어서고 한계를 뛰어넘어 새로운 능력과 전략을 잠금 해제하세요.
패시브, 지원, 공격의 세 가지 모드에서 네페스를 지휘하세요. 네페스의 다재다능한 기술을 활용하여 자신만의 스타일로 도전에 대처하며 즉석에서 적응하세요.
"Qouise" 자원 시스템으로 위험과 보상 사이의 미세한 경계를 탐색하세요. 현재 달리기를 위해 임시 업그레이드에 투자할지 아니면 영구적인 발전을 위해 자원을 축적할지 결정하여 장기 전략을 수립하세요.
다양한 슈트 업그레이드, 무기 강화, 네페스 개조로 우자이의 여정을 커스터마이징하세요. 이러한 요소들을 전략적으로 조합하여 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들고 앞에 놓인 도전을 극복하세요.
에게 연합 연합에서 영감을 받아 세심하게 제작된 세계에 빠져보세요. 문화, 요리, 건축물이 조화롭게 어우러진 세계를 탐험하며 분열되어 있지만 서로 연결된 우주의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

title: Imperial Ambitions
description:
게임 정보
Explore Colonize Industrialize Sabotage And Battle!
Imperial Ambitions is a 4X strategy game where the players will take over one of the European superpowers that existed during the age of discovery and renaissance and lead them to imperialism.
Discover and colonize the world,
Allocate your labor force,
Monopolize markets,
Fight tactical battles,
Survive the age of imperialism.
Tactical Wars With Completely New Mechanics
Imperial Ambitions has a completely new strategy game design providing a unique 4X gameplay experience. Anyone who enjoys the Napoleonic wars will find the tactical thinking required for Imperial Ambitions to be much more rewarding. As you forge an empire, the battlefields will become more challenging. We've redesigned the way that armies move on a campaign map, so they act more like real-world military units. Large armies can move in column formation, making it harder to move and requires more tactical thinking to prepare for the battle. The regiments can be split from the main army for small tactical excursions, or sneak into enemy lines for crossfire. For the same reason, attention is required to avoid leaving gaps on your frontline.

The society in the game is divided into classes, slaves, peasants, apprentices, artisans and masters. Besides slaves, the citizens will be allowed to progress through four tiers of classes, with each step providing increased capabilities, but also requiring different resources from you. The education is the key for most of your citizens to climb this social ladder. Higher classes will provide exponentially more labor, but will also require unique luxury resources. The citizens may stop working for several reasons, such as training, hunger, epidemic, strike, accidents, criminal activities, exhaustion, rebellion or retirement. While higher classes are often preferable, they are also harder to maintain due to requirement of luxury. The units and agents are also required to be trained from respective classes. For that reason, the players need to find the optimal balance between these classes.

Your Empire will grow beyond the mountains and the seas. As it grows you will have access to more and endemic resources. The more you invest into your roads and docks, the more resources that produced around the corners of your empire will be transported into your capital. With abundance in your capital, you can allocate your laborers to produce to higher quality goods. Imperial Ambitions has more than 40 different resources that can be extracted, produced or imported. Your population will demand products depending on their level of education. You must manage your resources and customize your production chains, while ensuring the wellbeing of your population. Some key resources may just not be accessible to you. You can resolve either by leasing the land from the natives, military invasion, trading with superpowers, or exploiting black market.

For the savvy entrepreneur and economist, the black market is a huge opportunity to boost your own empire. No longer do you have to go through the tedious and sometimes costly process of building a colony and maintain an industry. the game will include a black market besides the regular market. In regular trade, a player can initiate a bid for something they need and, if another player sells it to them, everyone is happy! Though, this trade is also taxed by any country that has lands en route. Black market, however works completely different. The resources in the black market is pulled from towns with high corruption. And players can bid for these resources, even if they belong to their enemies. The cost, however, is often higher than normal, yet no one can tax. This can be a boon for some players in need of certain products that are capitalised by their enemies and for everyone that prefers not to pay taxes. Instead, however, corruption and criminal activity will become more prevalent among the towns along the route. e careful not to get caught in a cycle of corruption and crime! To promote corruption player can send man of shadows to start a crime syndicate. It however requires opium to initiate (also only available at black market) However, the player is not defenseless. Players can use the man of shadow to start intelligence mission, to eradicate crime syndicates.

In our opinion, it is unrealistic for the players to be able to view the tech tree. In Imperial Ambitions, the player will only be shown the available techs they can fund without disclosing the whole tree. It makes the game more challenging and exciting. This is also part of the discovery experience in Imperial Ambitions - you learn by doing! Funding a tech is not enough for research. The player must have one of their gentlemen agent perform an action related to that technology to be able to discover it. This action is also not revealed to the player. Thus player has to make a guess to what actions would help discover that tech. For example, a gentlemen has to sail the ocean to be able to discover the "Sextant", a navigation tool for sailors. Or, to discover "Abolishment of slavery" the player need to actually working slaves.

We envision a simple diplomacy for Imperial Ambitions. The difference in IA from most 4X, is that an agent has to be sent to the opponent's capital or party in an effort to ceasefire, establish trade relations, embassies, defensive pacts and alliances. Once an embassy or trade consulate is established the agent is dismissed. On the other hand, cancelling an existing agreement can simply be performed from the diplomacy window. It takes days to build bridges but seconds to destroy them.

We chose a pixelated art style for the game since it’s a fun and approachable way to communicate controversial events of our recent history such as post-colonial subversion. We also wanted a retro aesthetic design to assist players in imagining this alternate universe, mixing pop culture with classic cartoon representations of imperialism.

title: Shark Rain
description:
게임 정보
Premise and Lore
SHARK RAIN is a story-driven, third person shooter that is set in a vast ocean covered with many different islands that used to be a modern day civilisation before it was catastrophically flooded many years ago.
Become a cute Shark Girl and use your Water Bazooka to flood the world. Transform into a shark to swim and jump through many different levels! Collect gems and special artifacts to upgrade your power!
The Hub World
Discover a newly found town full of cute and lively NPCs. Make friends, eat food, upgrade and customize your gear as you fight for a new hope against the specter of a past evil that is trying to claw its way back into power.
Real Time Water Simulation
SHARK RAIN utilizes the Fluid Flux real time 2D water simulation system which allows you to literally flood the entire game area with water! It will flow down slopes and cause objects to float and be pushed by the water's current!
Combat
Slap everyone with your tail and unlock different types of water spouting weapons to destroy your enemies!
Puzzles
Use the force of water to move objects and unlock secret areas!

title: Little Eternal Chronicle
description:
게임 정보
The Heart of the World, "Cronium," has been shattered, scattering fragments across the land.
Only children under the age of 10 can survive the six months leading to the world’s destruction.
This is the story of 7 children and 1 cat, watched over by a single small bird.
■ Strategic battles using "clocks" to manipulate time.
Children (and the cat) cannot wield weapons.
Instead, they equip skills at the 0, 3, 6, and 9 o’clock marks of their clocks, allowing for highly strategic combat.
Combine the strengths of both children and adults to create powerful synergies.
■ Fly as a small bird across the map.
In Bird Mode, you can freely fly around the map, searching for items and solving puzzles in a point-and-click style.
While you can control all the main characters, the bird represents you in this world, adding a unique flavor to the experience.
■ Rewind time and discover the paths of fate.
Scenes from April to October are saved as a storyline.
Once you meet certain conditions, you can revisit and replay any scene.
A seemingly small event—like something a tiny bird might trigger—could completely alter the course of fate.
Can you find a way to change this world?
■ Mischief, mischief!!
Children love pranks—even if the world is ending!
Doodle on backs, startle adults with firecrackers...
A serious and emotional story can quickly be derailed by your antics.
Sometimes, new side stories will emerge from your playful mischief.
