title: The Siege and the Sandfox
description:
게임 정보


주변 왕국에 포위당한 한 고대 사막 도시. 그곳의 궁궐과 지하로 뻗은 동굴 같은 미로를 탐험하라. 역동적인 파쿠르 기술을 익히고 계략과 은신술을 사용해 그곳에 도사린 진정한 위험을 밝혀내라. 경비병을 피하고 적을 쓰러뜨리고 가능성 있는 이들을 아군으로 만들어라. 기술을 강화하고 너무 늦기 전에 사악한 음모를 저지하라.



파쿠르 플랫포머 요소를 채용한 2D 은신 메트로바니아
풍부한 16비트 도트 그래픽과 현대적 효과의 앙상블
손에 땀을 쥐게 해주는 오디오. 중독성과 역동성을 두루 갖춘 음향 효과
찾아서 도와줘야 할 다양한 인물들. 스토리를 풍성하게 해주는 독특한 개성
적의 눈을 피해 붙잡히지 말고 다양한 방법으로 위협에 맞서라
이동 방식을 몸에 익히고 여러 도구를 찾아 이전에 갈 수 없었던 새 지역에 접근하라
[/b]




"일지매 같은 은신술로 적을 무력화하거나, 홍길동처럼 신출귀몰하게 이곳저곳을 통과하세요. 달리거나 점프하거나 미끄러지고 도망치거나 마치 공중 곡예를 하듯 움직이며 복잡하게 설계된 게임 속 세상을 탐사하세요. 그리고 새 아이템와 장비, 스킬을 찾아 접근할 수 없었던 지역에 발을 들이세요.

은신 메트로바니아 게임 'The Siege and the Sandfox'의 무대는 자연스럽게 이어지는 하나의 거대한 세상으로 구성됩니다. 위로는 웅장하고 새로운 궁궐이, 아래로는 고대 감옥이, 마치 거미줄처럼 연결되고 뒤엉킨 복잡한 동굴로 연결되어 있습니다.
각 지역에서는 개성적인 적들이 약삭빠른 Sandfox를 기다리는데, 그중에는 추적 능력이 상대적으로 탁월한 부류도 있습니다. 횃불을 끄거나 문을 연 채로 놔두면 적들의 의심을 사서 발목 잡힐 수도 있으니 부디 신중히 움직이기 바랍니다."






"광활한 사막 한가운데에 찬란히 빛나는 어떤 왕국이 있었습니다. 달이 왕궁 위로 차오르던 밤, Kasha’i라는 이름의 어쌔신은 반역을 꾀한 왕비의 손에 왕이 숨을 거두는 모습을 보게 됩니다.
이 사실을 숨기고자, 왕비는 대대손손 왕을 지키고 충실히 보필하여 명성을 쌓아온 Sandfox 가문의 후예 Kasha’i를 지하 감옥 깊숙한 곳으로 이어지는 깊은 구덩이 '배신자의 몰락'에 던져 넣어 사실상의 사형을 선고합니다.

이제 플레이어는 Kasha’i를 도와서 지하 감옥을 탈출하고 궁궐로 돌아가는 여정을 시작해야 합니다. 왕국이 멸망의 위기에 놓였음을 다른 이들에게 경고하고, 왕비의 사악한 음모로부터 왕국을 구해내세요. 또한, Sandfox의 상징과도 같은 유리 단검을 휘둘러 왕비에게 복수하세요.
복수를 위한 여정은 그리 녹록하지 않습니다. 어두컴컴한 동굴과 흙먼지 가득한 영묘, 위험천만한 감옥과 무너져가는 고대 건축물을 지나며, 지하 세계의 흉포한 자들을 피하고 적대적이지 않은 이들을 도와 새로운 면모를 보여줘야 합니다. 그리고 이렇게 앞으로 나아가는 동안, 왕국에 대한 진정한 위협인 '모래 속의 사악한 존재'가 나타날 것입니다.

황혼이 지나 밤이 되고, 밤이 지나 다시 동이 트기 전까지 새로운 조력자들이 도움을 받아 궁궐로 복귀하세요. 그리고 왕국을 배신한 왕비의 악행에 종지부를 찍어야 합니다."

title: Last Moon
description:
게임 정보
Last Moon is an action RPG that pays homage to the classics of the 90s. Step into the shoes of a Lunar Knight and traverse a vast, ruined world, confront tainted creatures and upgrade your abilities in your quest to restore peace.

While the giant If harbours life, human greed triggers the destruction of the Moon. Corrupted creatures appear, and the world falls into chaos. Only a true Lunar Knight can stop it, and it’s you. Armed with courage, your fate seems sealed, but will you manage to save the situation and bring peace to If?

Smooth and tuned controls, alone or with a friend
Dodge, block and slay the corrupted creatures! All controls and movements are tightly tuned to give the best game experience mixing old school and new generation action-RPG. Local co-op will allow players to embark on this journey with a friend.

Become more powerful
Upgrade your Lunar Knight powers, forge your weapons, choose your skills and fight with corrupted creatures to increase your weapons mastery levels.

Find and equip more than 30 Runes of the Ancients scattered and hidden around If's world. Choose wisely the runes to equip to make the best fighting strategy and adapt it to the situation as you will have to fight more than 50 unique monsters.
Experience the day and night cycles and discover the differences, the inaccessible places and the secrets hidden at different times but be careful with the night, dangerous creatures are sometimes hidden in the shadows…

- Choose among 8 weapons, more than 30 runes, 10 summoning spells and learn up to 70 skills to match your playstyle. Play alone or with a friend in local co-op to live this great adventure together.
- Face more than 50 unique monsters created by the Lunar Corruption! The giant If is invaded by all sorts of corrupted creatures and huge bosses that you will have to fight to restore the peace.
- Feel the wind through the foliages, explore winding, interconnected paths, and discover unique environments with a lovely, cute and charismatic character.
- Save the Selene villagers from corruption, and help them to rebuild the village and bring peace back.

title: Jupiter Moons: Mecha🦾
description:
게임 정보
기체를 선택하고 장비를 변경하여 완벽한 덱을 완성하세요. 이 로그라이크 어드벤처 게임에서 카드를 사용해 강력한 조합을 찾으면서 전술적 전투와 덱 구성을 즐겨보세요!
당신의 기체를 개조하세요

기체의 구조를 선택하세요. 모든 조종사는 근접전 위주의 습격 구조, 은신 저격형 구조 혹은 순수 레이저 화력 등 색다른 전투법을 사용합니다. 기체의 구조는 새로운 장비를 설치하거나 최신 변형판으로 개선하는 등의 방법으로 게임 중에 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.
완벽한 덱을 구성하세요
전투에서 상대를 파괴하여 무기와 방패 및 장비를 획득하세요. 승리하면 기체에게 새로운 '장난감'을 장착시킬 수 있으며, 이 '장난감'을 교체하면 여러분의 전투 덱도 변경됩니다.
당신의 기체를 전장에서 시험하세요

셀 수 없이 많은 무기와 아이템을 찾아 사용해 보세요. 레이저부터 기관총, 플라즈마 소총, 저격형 대포, 검, 망치, 드론, 지뢰, 역장, 제트 엔진은 물론 로켓 펀치, 채찍, 대낫, 망토, 참호 혹은 소형 핵 등 특별 무기도 있습니다!
전술적 전투를 즐겨보세요

상대의 행동을 예측하고 전장의 상황에 맞게 전술을 변경하세요. 측면 공격, 습격, 포위, 은폐 혹은 급소 공격 등의 방법을 취해보세요.
전장에서 우위에 서게 해 줄 특별한 카드 조합을 찾아보세요. 아니면 보스전을 한 턴에 혹은 아무 피해 없이 승리하게 할 만큼 게임을 파괴하는 조합을 찾아보세요. 찾은 조합을 가장 어려운 난이도에서 확인해 보세요.

기체의 부품들은 저마다 방어력과 체력이 있습니다. 장비의 균형을 맞춰서 덱의 효율성을 유지하고 충분한 내구도를 제공하세요. 부품이 파괴될 경우, 거기에 장착된 카드들은 사용할 수 없습니다!
캠페인에서 진로를 현명하게 결정하고, 현재 장비로 싸울 수 없다면 회피하세요. 더 많은 보상을 위해 더 큰 위험을 감수하거나, 그저 목표만 완수하세요. 기계를 훼손시키는 외계 AI의 근원을 파헤치세요.

title: Farmer's Diary
description:
게임 정보
The Farmer's Diary is your journey to restore an old and neglected farm to its glorious days. With your limited budget, you progress through the game with the goal of reaching an advanced farm using your farming skills.

Upgrade System
You will upgrade your farm and make it more developed and beautiful by upgrading each building separately.

Farming
Your crop field is your greatest treasure. Plant the seed and give them water until harvest time and collect and sell your grown products.

Husbandry
These beautiful animals are your friends. Don't forget to look after them and feed them. also you can sell the products you get from them.

Orcharding
Do you want to grow fruit trees? then buy some saplings! The seedlings will take some time to grow, but if you be patience they will eventually give you big returns.

Production (Available With First Update)
You can purchase various production machines for your workshop, where you can produce many new products using the raw materials you gather by farming.

title: Dissonators
description:
게임 정보
Description
Year 2055. Corporations and syndicates rule the world undividedly. Their power is absolute. The Alliance and Syndicate wage bloody proxy wars across the planet for power and profit. The global economic crisis foreshadows a global infrastructural collapse. Lives exchange for materials and resources ..
In addition to chaos and regression, the world market is being captured by a new generation of drugs - RED. A byproduct of experiments with meta-materials. It spreads across the continents like fire. Everyone needs a small victorious War! A war for control over the markets.
Features:

title: Blood Accord
description:
게임 정보
야나는 두 명의 가장 친한 친구와 함께 공중 화장실에 갇힌 채 깨어납니다. 한 명은 불 같은 성격에 날카로운 말솜씨를 가진 용감한 영혼, 비카입니다. 다른 한 명은 부드럽고 따뜻한 마음을 가진 조화로운 영혼, 랼랴입니다.
처음에는 야나는 안도감을 느낍니다. 혼자가 아니니까요. 그녀가 세상 누구보다 사랑하는 소녀들과 함께 있다는 사실에 마치 하늘이 내려준 축복처럼 느껴집니다.
하지만 시간이 지날수록 좁은 공간은 더 이상 안식처처럼 느껴지지 않고 감옥처럼 느껴집니다.
말 못할 긴장감이 감돌고, 오래전 묻어두었던 비밀들이 수면 위로 떠오르기 시작합니다.
녹슨 수도꼭지에서 떨어지는 핏방울 하나하나가 과거는 잊혀져서는 안 된다는 것을 상기시켜 줍니다.

title: The Gambit Lost to Time
description:
게임 정보
플뢰레타, 윈터브랜드, 베르단디아, 골든송으로 구성된 네 왕국의 통치자들이 모두 같은 날 의문의 사건으로 죽음을 맞이하며 우노니아 대륙이 혼돈에 빠졌습니다. 갑작스러운 왕위 계승으로 새로운 역할을 떠맡게 된 후계자들은 서로를 향해 비난을 쏟아냈고, 수 세기 동안 이어졌던 평화에 종지부를 찍으며 혼란의 시기가 찾아왔습니다.
대륙의 평화만을 바라며 시간을 여행하는 조언가, 미아가 이때 등장합니다. 
Gambit Lost to Time은 로그라이트 요소가 가미된 전술 RPG 게임으로, 미래의 지식을 활용해 과거를 바꾸며 대륙의 평화를 되찾아야 합니다.
여러분의 전략과 지략으로 전쟁 중인 네 왕국 중 하나를 도와주세요. 오늘의 친구가 다른 시간선에서 적이 될 수도 있다는 점을 염두에 두고 왕과 여왕, 그리고 왕국의 신하들을 친구로 삼으세요. 함께하는 동료나 적대하는 인물들의 갈등 및 유혈 사태가 반복적으로 재현되는 와중에도 감정을 억눌러야 합니다... 
그 운명의 날에 실제로 무슨 일이 벌어진 것인지 알아내고, 그토록 아끼는 친구들과 이 대륙을 지키기 위해서라면 무엇이든 희생할 수 있지 않을까요? 그 결정은 여러분의 손에 달려 있습니다.
전략
어느 왕국을 지원하든 전략가로서 왕국군의 생존을 보장하며 승리로 이끄는 책무를 맡아야 합니다.
50가지 이상의 스킬 중 3개를 슬롯에 채우고 영웅을 전장으로 이끌어 보세요.
그리고 그 영웅을 중심으로 전장을 함께 누빌 병사들을 징집하세요.
전투 전에 영웅을 지휘관으로 임명해야 합니다. 각 영웅에는 부대에 적용될 지휘관 고유 보너스가 있습니다. 올바른 지휘관 보너스를 사용해 자신만의 플레이 스타일에 힘을 실어주거나 다양한 상황에 맞게 활용해 보세요!
시간의 책략
시간 여행자의 힘을 활용해 현재를 원하는 대로 재구성해 보세요. 시간선을 거듭할 때마다 이 세계 자체와 다른 사람들... 그리고 자신에 대해 더 자세히 알아갑니다. 이상적인 시간선을 손에 넣을 때까지 더 강력하게 성장하며 힘을 강화하세요.
지난 행동이 만족스럽지 않으면 시간을 되돌려 이전 턴으로 돌아갈 수도 있습니다.
미래의 지식을 "책략"으로 활용하면 또 다른 시간선에서 다시 마주한 전투의 흐름을 완전히 뒤바꿀 수도 있습니다.
미래에서 겪어보고 학습한 덕분에 새로운 가능성을 열고 전투도 완전히 새롭게 전개할 수 있습니다.
전투를 빠르게 완료하는 경우 획득하는 시간의 정수를 이용해서 다음 시간선으로 넘어가기 전에 최대한 많은 지식을 습득하세요. 
독특한 네 왕국
꽃이 무성한 플뢰레타의 평원부터 차가운 윈터브랜드의 산맥과 파릇파릇한 베르단디아의 숲, 그리고 혹독한 골든송의 황무지까지. 서로 평화롭게 지내던 좋은 시절도 있었습니다.

title: Blaze of Storm
description:
게임 정보
Blaze of Storm is a standard vertical scrolling shmup. The main character, a pilot, fights against enemies in cyberspace as a cyber diver.
Two types of weapons are available: a main weapon and a subweapon. The main weapon is a Vulcan shot that is fired in front of the player's ship. The subweapon type can be changed by getting an item.
Subweapons have different performance depending on their type. Some circle around the ship to defend against enemy bullets, others automatically track and attack the enemy, and so on.
In addition, subweapons can generate an explosion by hitting the enemy with the weapon itself, and this explosion can cause great damage to the enemy.
Enemies appear in cyberspace in a wide variety of shapes, including mecha, creatures, and plants.
This is a shmup in which you can take advantage of the properties of subweapons and their explosions to your advantage. Stay tuned!
Story:
In the year 794 of the Cyber Century, the nation was managed by a giant computer called "Elixia." Elixia controlled all aspects of politics, economy, and the military, making war and poverty a thing of the past. However, that peace suddenly crumbles.
Unidentified enemies appeared in cyberspace and began to erode the system of Elixia. The city's infrastructure was in chaos, communication networks were cut off, and people faced fear.
In response to this situation, cyberdiver "Ayame Crow" began investigating cyberspace. Cyberdivers are people with special abilities who can directly connect their consciousness to cyberspace.
Behind this crisis, it was discovered that there was a human being called "Phantom" who uploaded his mind into cyberspace. He was plotting to control Elixia in order to lead humanity to chaos that he called freedom.
Now, the cyberspace battle to save humanity from crisis begins!

title: Atura
description:
게임 정보
Atura is a relaxing yet challenging strategy and puzzle game where you take on the role of a skilled herding dog. Set in a peaceful, nature-inspired world with a charming low-poly, paper-craft art style. Navigate intricate courses, adapt to the unpredictable behavior of the sheep, and master the art of shepherding through thoughtful movement and strategy.
Whether looking for a calm, immersive experience or a test of precision and planning, Atura provides a unique take on herding, rewarding players who can guide their flock efficiently and with care.
In Atura, you control a herding dog from a third-person perspective using simple and intuitive controls. There is no steep learning curve—move, position yourself strategically, and gently guide the flock through each course.
Every level introduces new challenges, from varied terrain and natural obstacles to dynamic sheep behavior that requires quick thinking and adaptability. Success comes from precise movement and efficient pathfinding, which turns each completed trial into a satisfying achievement. Whether optimizing your approach for the best results or simply enjoying the rhythm of herding, Atura offers a rewarding experience at your pace.

title: Dead Static Drive
description:
게임 정보
Grand Theft Cthulhu

Dead Static Drive is Grand Theft Cthulhu. An indie survival-horror game following a nightmarish road trip across a 1980s Americana. Playing as prodigal-child Hearst, you need to scavenge, fight, sneak, and explore in order to figure out what’s happened to your parents, and the rest of the world. Evade police. Equip yourself and those close to you, and follow your own moral code.  Learn how—and who—to trust. And learn it fast, the monsters are gaining on you.

Dead Static Drive blends weird fiction and uncanny Eldritch themes with a spooky unease underlying this small-town life.
Heavily influenced by the work of weird fiction authors T. E. D. Klein, Gene Wolfe, & Ramsey Campbell, filmmaker David Lynch, and photographer William Eggleston, Dead Static Drive hopes to invoke images of an America now lost, where with the right car and enough gas, anything felt possible.

title: The Drifter
description:
게임 정보


A Pulp Adventure Thriller from the minds that brought you Crawl and Peridium.
An engrossing roller-coaster of a story - Drawing on King, Crichton and Carpenter, with a dash of 70s Ozploitation.
Point 'N Click or Controller - Featuring unique twin-stick interaction makes The Drifter as comfy to play on the couch as at the PC.
Brooding dark-synth cinematic score.
Fully voice acted.



Mick Carter's been drifting a while now - never staying one place long, moving from job to job. Forced to return to his old home town, he witnesses a violent murder, is pursued by mysterious armed men, and killed.

And that's just the start of Mick's problems.

His consciousness ripped away, thrust back into his own body seconds before his death...
Framed for the murder he witnessed, tormented by his own past, and haunted by a feeling that something followed him back from the other side...

Follow Mick as he's sucked headfirst into a lunatic web of shadowy corporations, murder, and the thousand year obsession of a madman.



The Drifter is our fast-paced take on a classic 2d point and click adventure. Taking cues from the recent revival of the genre, the focus is on story with puzzle solving being the glue that ties it together. Mick's a pretty practical guy, and so puzzles are down-to-earth, designed to be unobtrusive, and give an investigative feel. We're keeping the pacing quick and lean, you'll never be wandering around lost or confused - Mick is propelled through the story at a good clip, from one situation to another, with barely a moment to catch his breath.

title: Benny Bash
description:
게임 정보
About
Survive this horror/puzzle adventure. Uncover the secrets of a cursed video game from the '80s while a malevolent entity hunts you. Solve escape room-style puzzles, navigate eerie labyrinths, and see how your actions in the game shape the real world. Stay sharp... and stay alive.
In Benny Bash you will...
Face puzzles in the escape room style.
Uncover a horror story as you progress.
Play cursed 80s games.
Explore eerie environments.
Discover how your actions in the game shape the real world and vice versa.

title: Love is a Demon
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an unpredictable journey with Ash through love, friendship, and supernatural chaos.
Love is a Demon is a narrative adventure game that takes you on a heartfelt and hilarious ride through the complexities of romance and personal growth. Step into the shoes of Ash, an introverted dreamer finally ready to confess their feelings to their best friend, Ivy. But just as everything seems to fall into place, an unforeseen supernatural event throws their world into chaos.
Live the Story – Explore Ash’s world through immersive, interactive moments that pull you deeper into their journey.
Shape the Narrative – Every choice you make influences Ash’s relationships and leads to different outcomes.
Laugh & Cringe – Enjoy witty dialogue, quirky interactions, and absurd situations that make love feel messier than ever.
Emotional Journey: Explore love, friendship, and self-discovery through relatable moments that resonate with your heart.
Solve & Explore: Solve fun puzzles that reflect the ups and downs of Ash’s journey.
Multiple Endings: Your decisions shape Ash’s path and determine the outcomes of their love story.
Character Exploration: Build relationships, uncover backstories, and explore how each character’s dynamics influence the journey.
Will Ash find the courage to confess, or will otherworldly chaos derail their plans?
Your choices. Your love life. Your demonic mess.

title: Mushroom Island
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Mushroom Island, a place to relax and unwind.

title: Float Your Goat
description:
게임 정보
Guide your trusty goat across treacherous waters by building the perfect raft using your nautical engineering wit and a healthy dose of trial and error. Will your creation stay afloat, or will your goat take an unexpected dose of water?

50+ Levels
Conquer 50+ levels of varying difficulty and gain access to a variety of different materials along the way. 
Save your Goat
Each level can be completed in countless ways, have endless fun exploring multiple solutions and constructions for every level!

title: Apomo District
description:
게임 정보
Bosses
Track down and hunt over 50 bosses called ‘Apomo,’ in order to free them from their madness. Fallen knights, spore-covered beasts, hammer-swinging moss balls, sweaty bath demons and more. Each encounter can be bizarre, terrifying, but strangely appealing.

Daily Life
The world changes every day in real time! Each day slaps you with new Apomo to fight, quests to explore, characters to meet, and events to partake in.

Combat
Use weapons such as bells, lanterns and umbrellas to fit your combat style.

Collecting
When you’re tired of smushing Apomo, fish for your next delicious meal. Catch bugs and turn them into magical attacks. Maybe mine some rocks to get to their gooey sentient core.

Movement
Don’t just walk around like a dingus. Utilize all the movement in the world like slime boards, slime gliders, jump pads, wave dashes and more.

title: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
description:
게임 정보
A missing body. A murdered professor. Five mysterious patients and a former femme fatale.
Play therapist and detective in a twisted Lovecraftian journey through the minds of six questionable suspects.
Will you save your patients or catch the killer? Or can you do both?
Whatever you decide, your assistant Marianna will always be there for you - unless she’s the killer of course…
SIMPLE UI - ask questions and respond to patients, watch replays and gather evidence 
EXPLORE - link answers together to progress 
MISSION TRACKER - your notepad keeps you updated 
MULTIPLE ENDINGS - multiple patient outcomes, player fates and killer endings 
NO SPOILERS - murderers are chosen at random when the game begins 
--
The 5th game from the creators of The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker, The Shapeshifting Detective, Dark Nights with Poe and Munro, and Murderous Muses.
--
autokwd: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2

title: MeowFall
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for an epic journey in search of the ultimate prize: the best hat ever! Think you're up to the challenge?

Embark on a journey inspired by classic gaming challenges, where every victory feels like a triumph.

Take on the role of an adorable kitten on an epic quest to find the hat of dreams. Navigate through vibrant yet perilous worlds, brimming with cunning traps, cleverly hidden secrets, and bonus levels.


Key Features:

🎯 Tough Challenges: This game isn't for the faint-hearted! Every jump and dodge needs to be spot-on to conquer the trials ahead.

🔍 Discover Secrets: Uncover hidden treasures, unlock secret passages, and explore meticulously crafted bonus levels that offer unique challenges and rewards.

🎩 Fabulous Hat Collection: Seek out and collect a variety of fabulous hats scattered throughout the game.

🪤 Crafty Traps: Watch out for the tricky traps lurking around every corner! From sneaky spikes to mind-bending platforms, each level tests your reflexes and smarts.

🎵 Awesome Music: Immerse yourself in the game's world with a charming, energetic soundtrack that sets the perfect mood for your adventure.

title: The End of History
description:
게임 정보
Medieval Sandbox RPG: Weave Your Destiny
Game Overview
In a vast, medieval-inspired world, you begin your journey as a nameless individual, ready to weave your own story.
Freedom of Choice: Trade, plunder, serve… any path is yours to choose. Become a noble lord, usurp the throne, it's all up to you.
Complex Relationships: NPCs have their own desires and ambitions, acting according to their motivations. Your choices will change the world and history itself.
Dilemma-Driven Decisions: War or peace, wealth or morality. The difficult choices you make will forge your unique narrative.
Key Features
Expansive Open World: A beautiful world rendered in UE5. Explore castles, cities, villages, and diverse landscapes.
Free Roleplaying: From an unknown individual to a hero, ruler, or villain - become who you want to be.
Massive Real-Time Battles: Experience intense combat with hundreds of soldiers clashing. Employ strategy to claim victory.
Procedural Storytelling: Your actions change your relationships with NPCs, creating a unique and emergent story.
A World of Dilemmas: Conquest is not the only goal. Struggle with the choices between war and peace, and influence the course of history.
What Story Will You Weave?

title: NIPA
description:
게임 정보


NIPA is a DUNGEON CRAWLER puzzle game with an oriental setting in which YOU CAN'T SHOOT.

Move, run, dodge, slow down time or transform into a ghost.NIPA will test the reflexes of the most skilled players. The only way to beat each level is repetition and perfection. The White Tower is a place full of obstacles and dangers that will delight those looking for a challenge.



With a aesthetic inspired by Hindu culture and a dynamic soundtrack in which each piece accompanies the level, NIPA will transcend players to another astral plane, one in which self-improvement plays a key role.





● Explore the White Tower and use your skills to dodge .
● Prepare to over and over again until you beat the level.
● Take on puzzles against the clock and.
● 7 unique levels inspired by , symbolising physical, mental, emotional and spiritual aspects.
● A Hindu setting with .

title: Bang Bang Barrage
description:
게임 정보


Recoil-Driven Navigation: Propel yourself through the waters with each shot! Turn gunplay into a dance of strategy and precision. Master the art of movement to outmaneuver and outlast the sea’s dangers.

Multiplayer Mayhem: Sail solo or with up to three friends, mastering the waves through seamless teamwork or solo cunning. More players, more chaos!

Endless Replayability: Each voyage across the sea is unique, with fresh challenges, traits, and upgrade paths to explore. No two games are the same, ensuring endless fun and discovery.

Ever-Changing Voyages: Tailor each run with a variety of upgrades and adapt to spontaneous buffs and debuffs that the sea throws at you. Adapt your strategy on the fly and make the most out of unexpected twists and turns.

title: Everglyph Trials
description:
게임 정보

계속 진화하는 선택과 도전이 있는 로그라이트 덱빌더인 Everglyph Trials에서 여러분이 가진 재치와 전략을 테스트해 보세요.
각각 고유한 효과 조합이 있는 다양한 카드로 덱을 구성하세요. 파괴적인 콤보를 만들고 전술을 조정하여 강력한 플로어 보스를 물리치세요.

title: Pinball Hero
description:
게임 정보
An ensemble of heroes stumble into a creaky room, seemingly unguarded. They notice a silhouette in the dark room; linen cloth draped over a large object. They remove the cloth revealing a strange device of metal gizmos and gadgets. Upon the press of the button & the flick of a switch, the heroes are drawn into the device, emerging as shorter...stubbier versions of themselves.
Welcome to Pinball Hero.
This game is a reimagining of the Pinball genre, mixed with rogue-lite elements. Bump, hack & slash enemy bumpers with your Pinball Hero. Acquire new items and explore mysterious dungeons. Though a hero may fall in battle many times; determination, skill and powerful artifacts will ensure that future attempts to reclaim your hero spirit are successful.
Bump, bop and bash a multitude of enemies and bosses, inspired by retro and contemporary fantasy.
Fill your backpack to the brim with over 100 unique items that automatically trigger to augment your pinball battle experience.

title: Little Herbal Baker
description:
게임 정보
Little Herbal Baker is a cozy and laid-back game where you play as Lilia, a novice baker who has freshly arrived in a town called ‘MILKYWOOD’ in the fantastical world. Taking over a bakery formerly managed by a master baker, you are now embarking on your journey to become a master baker.
Gather dozens of ingredients in the wilderness to create baked goods that everyone loves. Sometimes new ingredients will inspire new recipes!

title: Midnight Swamp
description:
게임 정보


Mysterious laughter echoed from the river on that restless summer night. Why the hell did you get out of the tent? You find yourself drawn into the gloomy world of Midnight Swamp, filled with strange inhabitants and thrilling puzzles.

Soon, the Witch from the gingerbread house is teaching you the basics of potion craft, and a talking Cat is convincing you to infiltrate the inhospitable castle towering over the swamp. But can you trust the locals? Do you have the courage to uncover the secrets of this place?
Well, it seems you have no choice...



A variety of puzzles, potion crafting, and location exploration
A dark swamp hiding a sinister secret
Many strange inhabitants to meet
Hand-drawn graphics

title: HYPERFIGHT 2
description:
게임 정보
HYPERFIGHT 2 is the sequel to the original HYPERFIGHT, a fast-paced fighting game with no blocking and a unique meter system. This installment takes everything up to 11 - expanded movesets, more offensive and defensive options, and fresh new characters alongside returning favorites - while keeping the beloved accessibility of the original.



Featuring:
A fully voiced roster of characters, each with their own unique movesets and playstyles
Funky and energetic soundtrack composed by STEEL_PLUS
Online multiplayer with rollback netcode and lobbies with up to 8 players
Local versus, against player and CPU opponents
Single player Arcade Mode, Training Mode, and Tutorial
Full controller support, with rebindable controls
More to be revealed!

title: Backrooms Liminality
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to an immersive horror experience where the familiar becomes unsettling, and the mundane turns into a waking nightmare. Explore an abandoned liminal space trapped in the eerie twilight of darkness, where reality blurs and the past refuses to let go.

Game Overview:

In Backrooms you take on the role of a lone explorer drawn to a forgotten neighborhood by cryptic messages and haunting visions. As you delve deeper into the desolate streets, you’ll uncover the dark secrets that led to its abandonment. Every corner and hallway holds pieces of the puzzle, but be warned: you are not alone. Shadows move in the periphery of your vision, and echoes of the past resonate through the empty halls.

Key Features:

Eerie Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted environment where the ordinary becomes sinister. The game's ambient soundscape and chilling visuals create a palpable sense of dread.
Exploration-Based Horror: Navigate through an open-world liminal space. Each corner hides its own story, revealed through environmental storytelling and hidden clues.
Unravel the Mystery: Piece together the history of the suburb through journals, photographs, and artifacts. Uncover the truth behind the mass disappearance of its residents and the malevolent force that lingers.
Dynamic Encounters: Encounter unpredictable, supernatural entities that stalk the shadows. Use your wits to evade them, as direct confrontation is rarely an option.
Psychological Horror Elements: Experience a narrative that plays with your mind, challenging your perception of reality and making you question what is real and what is imagined.

Survive the Shadows!

Your journey will test your courage and resolve. Will you uncover the truth behind the abandoned suburb, or will you become another lost soul wandering its streets? Backrooms invites you to face your fears and explore the thin line between reality and the supernatural.

Dare to enter the shadows?

title: Video Battle Arena
description:
게임 정보
각 라운드에서는 두 개의 무작위 YouTube 동영상이 서로 맞붙습니다. 여러분의 과제는 어느 동영상이 더 많은 조회수나 댓글을 가졌는지 추측하는 것입니다.

미리 정의된 주제 목록을 사용하여 동영상의 주제를 선택하거나 자신의 관심사에 따라 직접 주제를 만들 수 있습니다.

Steam의 Remote Play Together 기능 덕분에 혼자서 게임을 즐기거나 최대 3명의 친구와 함께 온라인으로 플레이할 수 있습니다(총 4명의 플레이어). 모든 플레이어가 비밀리에 추측을 제출하고 모두가 답변을 마치면 정답과 승자가 공개됩니다.

특히 흥미로운 동영상이 있다면 클릭하여 브라우저에서 열 수 있습니다.

현재 게임에는 15개의 업적이 잠금 해제를 기다리고 있습니다.

title: Crop and Claw 2
description:
게임 정보
STORY
Many years after the events of Crop and Claw have passed. Rumors about the Cult of Atmoss have begun spreading throughout Garden, with their remaining members in motion. A withdrawn dragon named Wend and his friends, along with some mercenary help, must follow the trail of chaos in an foreign realm of the world of Garden and attempt to stop the ominous plot unfolding around them.
KEY FEATURES
Build a custom party of dragons and join story characters throughout an adventure.
Dragons, everywhere.
A non-linear adventure allowing for exploration, routing, and replay-ability.
You are a dragon.
Turn-based combat against flora and dragons alike.
Multiple interactions and solutions to puzzles with characters and environments, encouraging exploration and experimentation.
Dragons. It really is a dragon adventure.

title: Heir to the Throne
description:
게임 정보
왕좌의 계승자는 무작위 세계에서 매혹적인 협동 액션을 제공합니다! 몬스터 무리에 맞서 싸우고 독특한 기술을 가진 무기를 발견하세요. 기술과 영리한 팀 플레이를 능숙하게 결합해야만 승리할 수 있습니다. 운명에 맞서세요!

로그라이트 싱글 및 멀티플레이어
싱글 플레이어로 게임을 플레이할 수도 있지만, HttT는 협동 멀티플레이어 모드도 제공합니다. 악에 맞서 싸우는 공동 전투에서는 시너지 효과를 내기 위해 기술 사용을 영리하게 조율해야 합니다. 발견한 아이템을 교환하여 그룹의 전투력을 강화하세요. 죽음은 피할 수 없지만 팀 동료와 함께라면 부활할 수 있는 기회가 있습니다.

독특한 캐릭터 개발
미리 정해진 영웅 클래스가 없는 “당신이 입는 옷이 곧 당신이 된다”는 접근 방식 덕분에 캐릭터를 장비하고 플레이하는 방식이 완전히 자유롭습니다. 또한 무기 기반의 무작위 스킬 시스템을 통해 매번 다르게 진화하는 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: Reality Drift
description:
게임 정보


Drive through a series of strange worlds, racing to be the first to deliver packages to obnoxious godlike creatures who have nothing but disdain for you. At the end of each track, choose between three options for a new track - you'll decide based on your stats and the linked upgrades being offered.






You'll start each race with a fixed set of stats for ACCEL, MAX SPEED and GRIP. Each time you're offered a choice for the next track, each option will be linked to a stat upgrade. Certain combinations will synergise with each other, or with your current stats! Sometimes, additional bonus upgrades such as Regen Braking, Shield, Antigrav and Foresight will be offered.






Winning in Reality Drift is as much about making the right choices as how well you drive. Will you lean into ACCEL and MAX SPEED, or will you try to go for a GRIP build where you never have to slow down? Choices are made in real-time so you only have a few seconds to decide! In addition to the core stats, extra powerups are often available including REGEN BRAKING, SHIELD, ANTIGRAV, NAVIGATOR and FORESIGHT. The computer-controlled cars follow the same rules as you and choose which upgrades to obtain, but only you can choose what the next track will be.



As you win races you'll unlock a total of 25 missions, each with its own twist on the formula. Winning all races will unlock New Game+ where the difficulty will be raised and your mastery of the game will truly be tested!

title: 千里山河录
description:
게임 정보
这是一款六边形拼图游戏，站在了同类型优秀作品巨人肩膀上的同时，也努力打造了一个拥有自己特色、能够为玩家游玩体验带来更多惊喜的作品。
透过时光的缝隙，用着900年前古朴的画卷风格，玩家通过自由创造，徐徐展开一幅幅水墨丹青风格的壮丽山水人间长卷。
玩家将与小千一同启程拜访中华美景与诗词古典，重新获得灵感再绘一幅当代的千里江山图。
以全自由拼图玩法为核心，融入剧情冒险与Roguelike挑战，让玩家在休闲放松的同时再次遇见百年前的山水人间之美

title: Retro Game Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
1980 年代のモーレツなゲーム ストアを管理する
ビデオゲーム、ゲーム機、ポスター、雑誌を購入、在庫し、販売して利益を得ます。
ストアの評判を高めて、必須の製品ライセンスを確保します。
時間の経過とともにリリースされる新しいガジェットやシステムに投資することで、店舗の生産性を最適化します。
 管状製品の注文、在庫、販売

title: Elflock
description:
게임 정보
Elflock is a single-player third-person adventure. You are a princess returning to your home on the brink of war and it's up to you to navigate the machinations of the nobles surrounding the king. Engage in intricate dialogues and uncover mysteries in this branching fantasy tale!
THE FATE OF AN ENTIRE KINGDOM IN YOUR HANDS
When a hostile empire delivers an ultimatum, help your father, the king, make the decision that could save your homeland - or cause its destruction if the circumstances are misjudged.
UNRAVEL A TANGLED WEB OF ULTERIOR MOTIVES
You must explore every nook and cranny of the castle and delve into the personal relationships of its residents to gather crucial information about complex characters needed to win the nobles' support for your goals.

title: Operation Night Strikers
description:
게임 정보
Four milestones of the 80s arcade movement in one action-packed compilation! Relieve all the high-speed arcade thrills and explosive spills!

Title lineup
Operation Wolf
Operation Thunderbolt
Night Striker
Space Gun

Operation Wolf
Using only a machine gun and rocket-propelled grenades, you alone must infiltrate enemy territory, secure the hostages, then get them safely to the extraction point!
Your mission code name is Operation Wolf. Do not fail!

Operation Thunderbolt
A hostage rescue mission in Africa and only one man can help! Roy Adams, hero of Operation Wolf is back, and this time his former green beret team-mate, Hardy Jones joins the fight.
Your mission code is Operation Thunderbolt. Impossible odds are nothing to these men!

Night Striker
Become a member of the United Nations Special Action Force, a.k.a. Night Striker, and destroy the enemy terrorist organization with in your high-speed combat hovercraft: Intergray!

Space Gun
2039 AD: an age of space exploration. On their way to investigate an unexplained incident on a space station, a team of space marines receive a distress call from a cargo ship, but what could prepare them for the horrors onboard?!
Use your multi-purpose rifle to slay the monsters and rescue the hostages!

Four faithful ports, complete with various gadgets, replay functions, and other useful features to enhance the originals!

Features
Apply filters to simulate actual arcade monitors
Gadgets display various useful information to either side of the play area

title: Astrobuilder
description:
게임 정보
Become Anyone. Rewrite Everything.
Astrobuilder is the world’s first dynamic world RPG where every character is playable and no story ever repeats.
Set in the collapsing Neon River galaxy, you don’t just shape the world—you live as part of it. Switch identities, trade across stars, forge alliances, and trigger quests born from an evolving simulation of 600+ thinking NPCs.
In this galaxy, you’re not the only one making choices. The world reacts. The world remembers. And it moves—with or without you.
Rebuild the Galaxy, One Planet at a Time
One empire and four rising factions—Mogel, Patti, Nami, and the Reefs—threaten the last bastion of civilization: the Star of Reason.
Lead your guild of wanderers to restore shattered planets, reopen lost trade routes, and breathe life back into a fractured galaxy.

title: Shades
description:
게임 정보
Hello and welcome !
I'm Mamat, a true passionate gamer and a new French game developer on Unreal Engine 5, and I present to you my very first game : Shades !
These last few years many FPS were not really satisfying me, so I decided to make one by myself with all my ideas and my perspective of a truly immersive first-person game, which means immersive menus, no or minimum HUD or camera effects or pop up notifications or outlined/highlighted items and interactions, like in real life, and be really free to do whatever you want in dense and beautiful environments, no invisible walls, many destructions possible for example, using different ways to complete the objectives and find solutions to problems by yourself, no backseating, minimap or floating arrows/pings/compass, and with that all the latest hardware and software technologies available on PC to have the most realistic graphics and physics for the best immersion possible.
I'm making this game first to gain experience (so please be indulgent), and to start a portfolio in game development, then hopefully in the future to change from my actual job to my dream job : being a game developer, or even better, create my own game studio, which really listen his community and who you can trust and rely on, to make all our dream games for all of us, I have so many ideas !
So based on your support, i hope this early access will give me the time and resources to make all this happen.
About Shades, it's a really immersive solo FPS with infiltration and tactical extraction shooter aspects. Go stealth, or loud, in a variety of missions as a mercenary for an agency that really use your skills to make this world better.
For now the game may not very optimized, so you will surely need a good and recent PC for the best experience (you can check the system requirements below), it may also lacks some content and functionalities, so be aware of that before buying my early access game and then leaving a bad review please.
Currently implemented in the game, there are 4 different maps : your home/vehicle (upgradable), the secret training bunker of the agency, the agency test mission then your first official mission, with for now a basic stealth system with simple lootable AI enemies, a money/level system, a tablet/PC with online casino games, shops, applications, dark web markets and more, 10 customizable weapons : sniper rifle, revolver, 2 assault rifles, 2 SMGs, 2 shotguns, 2 handguns + 4 grenades : fragmentation, contact frag, flash and smoke, several utilities/explosives, an axe, fist fighting and a push/kick/ragdoll system.

title: Butterfly Dream
description:
게임 정보
Add to wish-list to support us!
Contact Email:
hddy2000@qq.com
The realm of Fargodia, a time long from now.
The ancient ritual of Butterfly Summoning has awakened the once-dormant providence.
King Verlenbair, now fully transformed into a spectral figure, stands poised at the crossroads of fate.
Behind him a silent battle brews, with an archenemy arriving from the depths of dreams.
The laments and hopes of past worlds signal both redemption and judgment, with each butterfly flutter heralding either a new dawn or the shadow of apocalypses.
Will this be the start of a new saga, or the revelation of something deeper?
As destinies intertwine, the story shall be unfolded.
Based on traditional box-garden level exploration and combat experience, Butterfly Dream integrates Chinese philosophy and aesthetic thinking. It is a small-scale souls-like game of retro style.
[Retro-style box level]
"All phases are illusory"
Go into strange dreams, explore dark medieval castles, and immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of Gothic.
Step into a dangerous world and crack the intricate map of the courtyards.
Find a variety of weapons and props to overcome the powerful monsters that hinder you.
[classic fragmented narrative]
"There was once a man who dreamed that he had become a butterfly"
Take the dialogue of characters and the collection of props as clues to piece together the truth of dreams in confusion.
Experience the amplification and distortion of desire, and feel the struggle of people to become monsters.
[High-degree-of-freedom combat]
"Wash us with your precious blood and forgive us all our sins"

title: Missing Banban
description:
게임 정보
친구가 실종되었고, 어둠의 세력이 이미 미쳐버린 이 세상에 다가오고 있습니다. 이 강렬한 액션 횡스크롤 어드벤처에서 친구를 구할 수 있는 유일한 두꺼비인 보안관 토드스터가 되어 보세요! 땅을 탐험하고 이 우주의 흥미로운 캐릭터들을 만나면서 점프하고, 총을 쏘고, 미스터리한 실종 사건을 조사하세요!
함정과 위험을 피하고 정확한 움직임으로 주변 환경을 이동하여 길을 따라 모든 장애물을 통과하세요!
뛰어다니고, 벽을 오르고, 뛰어다니며 이 세상의 모든 도전을 이겨내세요!
해변, 숲, 비밀 공장 등을 돌아다니며 친구를 찾아보세요.

title: Spirebound
description:
게임 정보
Your adventure starts now!
Experience a grand and heartfelt adventure through relaxing gameplay and controls.
Jump, Dash, and Swing your way up the great spire of wishes where you will get your innermost wish fulfilled.
Everyone dreams - everyone needs a helping hand
You are not alone on your way to the top. Other climbers also want to see their wishes realized. Meet this cast of quirky characters, help them and let them help you as you make friends and memories.
A tiny world with lots to do
Collectibles and treasures are hidden all over the tiny island. Some require you to solve puzzles and riddles whereas others test your platforming abilities. As a reward, you can trade your riches for hats and outfits.
For new and seasoned gamers alike
Spirebound is designed with young and inexperienced players in mind. The fixed camera views of the game allow young and inexperienced players to simply pick the game up and have fun. The whole adventure can be played and finished this way.
For more experienced players, we created 'Dream Dares', entirely optional bonus levels, wherein you can put your platforming skills to the test.

title: Another Door
description:
게임 정보
Another Door is a party game combining turn-based roguelike and gambling for an adventure between betrayal and forced friendship. Hide your intentions, bluff your opponents and bet on your luck with the sole purpose of saving your soul…
On your journey, you'll have to face enemies beyond your imagination, but also the decisions of your "allies". Cooperation is one strategy, betrayal is another - it's up to you to make the right choices.
Think carefully before you walk through another door...
Hidden choices, well-guarded intentions: play with up to 4 players online or on the same screen while keeping your choices secret, and only reveal your darkest plans at the very last moment.
Open another door: face the number of cards indicated, collect the reward and end your adventure here, safe in the knowledge that you'll get out alive, or continue, taking all the risks in the hope of obtaining more gems.
A gambling game based on risk management and luck: no need to be the fastest, have the best reflexes, or know how to aim. Only your audacity, your eloquence, and a good dose of luck will serve you here.

title: Hibernaculum
description:
게임 정보
WHAT IS HIBERNACULUM?

Hibernaculum is a retro inspired dungeon crawler that sets out to recreate the engrossing labyrinthine experiences of the classics of days gone by, whilst also building a modern, deeply unique & explorable world of survival, mystery and macabre intrigue.
Hibernaculum is a first person sci-fi/horror role playing game with survival horror roots.
Create a unique character to explore the depths of Hibernaculum & have the experience you want to have. Choices only matter, if they matter to you.
Non-linear gameplay allows for exploration at your own pace, and in your own fashion. Forge ahead and risk calamity or riches. Conversely, pace yourself and avoid harm.
Navigate a decayed industrial realm through environmental storytelling and a unique, brooding atmosphere.
Hibernaculum will be developed in C++ for PC (Windows) & Mac with hopes for porting to iOS & Nintendo Switch.
Hibernaculum will initially be available in English, French, German & Spanish.
Hibernaculum will be released DRM-free & available on Steam & GoG.

Hibernaculum has a sharp focus on exploration and atmosphere with a penchant for allowing the player to discover, uncover, salvage and piece together the mysteries of the Ship whilst emphasising mechanics that allow for emergent gameplay amidst the matrices of survival, combat and character progression.

With a raft of modern conveniences such as an on-screen minimap + waypoints, more aesthetic and navigable maps + hub areas, a more concise and efficient stat/combat system as well as many other UI and quality of life features we hope to make Hibernaculum the most playable, expansive, intriguing and absorbing game of it's type since the heyday of these games; the long forgotten primeval epoch of 1995.

title: School 666
description:
게임 정보
이 끔찍한 끝없는 학교에서 살아남아야 합니다. 끝없는 학교의 이상 현상을 생존하기 위한 올바른 길을 찾아보세요. 극도로 강력한 이상 현상 보스들로부터 탈출하기 위해 머리를 사용하세요. 이 극도로 강력한 차원 뒤에 숨겨진 이야기를 탐험하고... 죽지 마세요.
학교에 다시 오신 것을 환영합니다!
이상 현상을 발견하면 돌아서세요. 당신은 끝없는 학교에서 깨어났습니다. 앞으로 나아갈 길 또는 뒤로 물러날 길을 선택해야 합니다. 잘못된 결정을 내리면 원점으로 돌아갑니다.
유니크한 이상 현상들
무엇이든 이상 현상이 될 수 있습니다. 당신 주위의 모든 의자, 모든 문구류, 심지어 칠판이나 교실 자체도 당신이 예상하지 못한 이상 현상이 될 수 있습니다. 이러한 이상 현상에 의해 두려움에 질리거나 웃음을 터뜨릴 수도 있습니다.

title: Warfare Ultimatum
description:
게임 정보
Warfare Ultimatum은 바다의 깊은 곳에서 우주까지 대규모 전투에 초점을 맞춘 현대적인 FPS/RTS 하이브리드입니다!

저는 이것을 유일한 이성적인 총력전이라고 부르는 것을 좋아합니다. 이것은 SF가 아니며, 로우 폴리도 아니고, 역사적인 세계 대전 시대도 아닙니다.
이것은 현대적인 총력전으로, 현장에 발을 딛고 있으며, 외교도 포함됩니다.
하드코어 시뮬레이션이나 아케이드 게임도 아닙니다. Battlefield와 The Generals 시리즈를 생각해 보세요.
오늘날 우리가 알고 있는 고급 기술 또는 프로토타입 무기가 등장할 것이지만, 그게 우리가 선을 긋는 지점입니다.

FPS/RTS 하이브리드인 만큼, 하이브리드 장르의 일반적인 함정은 개발자가 "왜 우리가 세부 사항에 주의를 기울여야 합니까? 우리는 이미 두 가지 장르를 결합하고 있으니 충분합니다."라고 생각하는 것입니다. 하지만 여기서는 그렇지 않습니다. Warfare Ultimatum은 몰입감과 세부 사항에 관한 것입니다.

참고: 이것은 핵심 게임 플레이 쇼케이스이며, 기술 미리보기입니다. 우리가 염두에 두고 있는 몰입형 영화 경험은 현재 조기 접근 단계에서 전혀 제시되지 않습니다. 게임 플레이가 먼저이고, 시네마틱은 나중입니다.
어디서나 전술 전쟁을 수행하세요!
전쟁은 경계를 모릅니다. 육지, 바다의 표면, 그 깊이, 하늘 또는 우주까지 나타날 수 있습니다!
기술을 충분히 발전시키면 우주에서 적에게 폭탄을 떨어뜨릴 수 있습니다!

전형적인 전장이 아닙니다! 우리 게임을 차별화하는 주요 특징은 "외교 전쟁" 모드입니다.
외교 전쟁
긴 전쟁 게임, 두 개의 군대, 두 명의 지휘관, 평화 시기와 전쟁 시기, 무역 또는 정복, 낮과 밤의 주기, 공격 및 스텔스 미
션을 조정... 그리고 더 많은 것들... 수백 명의 플레이어가 모두 지속적인 서버에서 함께합니다!
역할 놀이와 지휘 체계 옵션이 있습니다.
시대 발전
외교 전쟁의 각 조직 또는 군대는 더 발전된 기술에 접근하기 위해 관심 있는 주제를 연구할 수 있습니다.
AI, 우주, 핵 에너지 등 다양한 주제가 있습니다.
충분한 지식을 얻으면, 귀하의 조직은 기술 시대를 발전시키고 새로운 상위 기술 트리에 대한 접근을 잠금 해제할 수 있는 옵션을 갖게 됩니다.
클래스 기반
6개의 주요 클래스(인원, 엔지니어, 의무병, 폭파 전문가, 저격수, 작업자) 중에서 전쟁에서 자신의 클래스나 직무를 선택하세요. 각 클래스는 고유한 장비, 통계 및 무기를 가지고 있습니다.
깊은 몰입감을 위해 각 유닛/플레이어 캐릭터는 클래스에 의해 영향을 받는 특성과 개인 통계를 가지고 있습니다.
유닛마다 배경도 있으며, 이는 개인 통계에 고려됩니다. 즉, 유닛은 현재 전쟁 이전에 전 외과의사나 전 군인이었을 수 있습니다.
때때로 미래의 이야기로, 거대 기업들이 귀중한 자산을 보호하기 위해 자신의 사병을 배치하기 시작했습니다. 지구의 자원이 점점 더 부족해지고 있기 때문입니다.
일부 기업은 이제 어떤 정부보다도 강력하며, 일부는 자신의 법을 정의하고 자신의 자유로운 주를 지배합니다. 이에 대응하여, 전 세계의 정부들도 이 대규모 사병의 반란을 저지하기 위해 공동의 노력을 기울이고 있습니다.

title: Drunken Rogue
description:
게임 정보

In order to get her hands on a cherished wine collection, rumored to be hidden away by Vampire of Demise Endo, drunken Rogue Lita makes her way to the vampire king's castle. See what story unfolds in this roguelike deck-building game.

To make it to the vampire's castle, you must conquer several dungeons, each with its own traps, terrain, and ferocious demons lying in wait. A frontal assault is simply too reckless. Lita takes advatage of her Wind Cloak while Endo posesses the ability to turn into fog, allowing both to evade the perils of their adventure. However, what you evade only comes back stronger on the next floor. Whether you are prepared to face the inevitable trouble is up to you.

The best part is that the characters in this game get stronger the drunker they become! The only way to step foot into the all-too-risky dungeons is to do so with intoxicated abandon! To top things off, the drunker you become, the less you can tell what's real and what's not, and you may even hallucinate. Your pet dog Odysseus that appears before you may very well be a fiendish demon. Please drink responsibly.

title: YTASH - A Nocturnal Poem
description:
게임 정보
YTASH는 《Nocturnal》 유니버스를 배경으로 한 미니 메트로배니아 게임입니다.
플레이어는 영원한 불꽃을 다루는 대가인 알데시르가 되어 이타쉬 도시와 그 잠들어 있는 기계들을 탐험하며 깨워보세요.
그러나 깊이 잠든 기계들은 쉽게 깨어나지 않으며, 도시를 뒤덮은 어둠은 모든 생명의 불꽃을 삼키려는 존재들을 풀어놓을 것입니다.
게임 특징
빠른 템포의 전진형 전투 시스템을 마스터하여 공격적인 자세를 유지하세요.
불꽃을 지니고, 그것을 삼키려는 모든 존재를 피하세요.
칼날을 사용하여 고대의 기계와 횃불을 다시 점화하고, Ytash를 서서히 깨워보세요.
불꽃 게이지를 채워 강력한 버너아웃 상태를 발동하세요.
잃어버린 시의 조각들을 모아, 스스로를 파괴한 도시의 이야기를 밝혀보세요.
상징적인 기술을 해제하여 플랫폼과 전투 능력을 향상시키세요.
하나의 핵심 개념을 중심으로 한 간결한 모험을 제공하는, 많은 비밀이 숨겨진 작은 섬을 탐험하세요.

title: Onychomp : Lush journey
description:
게임 정보
산을 오르면서 던전을 탐험하세요.
마법의 산을 오르는 동안 프로시저럴 던전을 통해 위험한 여정을 떠나세요. 밤이 끝나기 전에 정상까지 가는 길을 찾으세요.
생물을 물어 먹고 노랑퍼지세요
만나는 모든 생물을 삼키기 위해 탐욕스러운 식욕을 터뜨리세요.
더 높이 올라갈 수 있는 물건을 만드세요

title: PSYCHExFUSE
description:
게임 정보
스토리
방황하는 영혼이 상상할 수 없는 공포의 파스텔 색상 세계에서 길을 잃게 됩니다.
 꿈과 현실 사이의 경계를 흐리게 하는 마음을 혼란스럽게 하는 사건들을 통해 그들을 안내하고, 방랑자의 과거 자아라고 주장하는 익숙한 얼굴들과의 논리를 무시하는 만남을 헤쳐나가세요.
 모든 희망이 사라진 것처럼 보일 때, 우리 영웅의 탈출의 열쇠라고 주장하는 여신이 그녀의 그릇이 되는 대가로 도움을 제공합니다...
특징
위협, 퍼즐 및 공포로 가득 찬 독특한 세계를 탐험하세요.
자신의 과거 버전들을 도와주고, 구하고, 충돌하세요.
두 신과 반의 전쟁 뒤에 숨겨진 미스터리를 풀어보세요.
대체 엔딩으로 당신의 행동의 결과를 직면하세요.
아름답게 손으로 그린 컷신과 다양하고 분위기 있는 사운드트랙을 경험하세요.
질문에 답하세요... 당신은 정말 자신을 믿을 수 있나요?

title: Resina Salvation
description:
게임 정보
A strategic incremental clicker set in Roman times. Clicks. Improvements. Resources. But above all, a volcano on the verge of eruption, sending waves of monsters for you to kill.
Wood, Rock, Water, every natural ressource is collectable. Just click on it to create blocks of it. The click on the block to send it on your storage !

title: Dead Static Drive
description:
게임 정보
Grand Theft Cthulhu

Dead Static Drive is Grand Theft Cthulhu. An indie survival-horror game following a nightmarish road trip across a 1980s Americana. Playing as prodigal-child Hearst, you need to scavenge, fight, sneak, and explore in order to figure out what’s happened to your parents, and the rest of the world. Evade police. Equip yourself and those close to you, and follow your own moral code.  Learn how—and who—to trust. And learn it fast, the monsters are gaining on you.

Dead Static Drive blends weird fiction and uncanny Eldritch themes with a spooky unease underlying this small-town life.
Heavily influenced by the work of weird fiction authors T. E. D. Klein, Gene Wolfe, & Ramsey Campbell, filmmaker David Lynch, and photographer William Eggleston, Dead Static Drive hopes to invoke images of an America now lost, where with the right car and enough gas, anything felt possible.

title: The Drifter
description:
게임 정보


A Pulp Adventure Thriller from the minds that brought you Crawl and Peridium.
An engrossing roller-coaster of a story - Drawing on King, Crichton and Carpenter, with a dash of 70s Ozploitation.
Point 'N Click or Controller - Featuring unique twin-stick interaction makes The Drifter as comfy to play on the couch as at the PC.
Brooding dark-synth cinematic score.
Fully voice acted.



Mick Carter's been drifting a while now - never staying one place long, moving from job to job. Forced to return to his old home town, he witnesses a violent murder, is pursued by mysterious armed men, and killed.

And that's just the start of Mick's problems.

His consciousness ripped away, thrust back into his own body seconds before his death...
Framed for the murder he witnessed, tormented by his own past, and haunted by a feeling that something followed him back from the other side...

Follow Mick as he's sucked headfirst into a lunatic web of shadowy corporations, murder, and the thousand year obsession of a madman.



The Drifter is our fast-paced take on a classic 2d point and click adventure. Taking cues from the recent revival of the genre, the focus is on story with puzzle solving being the glue that ties it together. Mick's a pretty practical guy, and so puzzles are down-to-earth, designed to be unobtrusive, and give an investigative feel. We're keeping the pacing quick and lean, you'll never be wandering around lost or confused - Mick is propelled through the story at a good clip, from one situation to another, with barely a moment to catch his breath.

title: Sweets'Devil
description:
게임 정보
For sweets, What Are Humans?
To sweets, humans are like legendary, towering villains—invincible monsters! They're terrifying devils that eat sweets!
In "Sweets' Devil", our heroine Renée faces off against hostile desserts in epic, explosive battles. But she's not the powerless kid who can't resist! Renée can transform into powerful combat forms, able to suppress the whole battlefield . Make the journey through the fantasy world into a joyous sweets-beating adventure.
After meet and make friends with those magic hats which Renée called them hattie as nickname, more powerful unique outfit transformations 'ATTIRE' will become available, each offering fresh ways to dominate the battlefield.
Beyond battles, Renée can roam the conquered regions, taking on fun challenges and side adventures, diving deeper into the stories with an array of interesting characters.
【Martial Magical Girl————Enemies Who Can't Beat Me Are Made To Be My Friends!】
Transformation! Magic! Battle!
Let the girl who's overflowing the cuteness charges forward with ultimate power and speed!
Combine a vast array of dazzling attacks to obliterate any resistance that stands in your way!
Unleash powerful burst skills to handle the most dangerous situations , turn the tide of battle!

title: Wander Stars
description:
게임 정보
Unleash custom attacks by combining words in a Super! Anime! Turn-Based! RPG!
Join Ringo, a young martial artist looking for her brother, and Wolfe, a mysterious scoundrel running from his past, as they join forces in an unlikely partnership to collect the pieces of the fabled Wanderstar Map. Across 10 “episodes” of anime-inspired adventure, Ringo and Wolfe will have to work together to find answers, make up for past mistakes, and travel across the universe in search of their goal. And who knows, maybe they’ll learn how to get along at some point!
Trained in the ways of Kiai, a magical form of martial art and also the universe’s most exciting form of televised entertainment, Ringo can combine words to create customized attacks in intense turn-based battles. During her race across the universe you’ll expand Ringo’s vocabulary, equip Pep Up bonuses earned through honorable victories and level up her spirit power. Defeat or befriend a cast of fearsome space pirates, mysterious scoundrels, cute witches, high school delinquents, talking crows, and skilled martial artists on your way to becoming a Kiai master.

title: Nano Neighbors
description:
게임 정보
Nano Neighbors - An Online Desktop Idle Game!
In the future, NanoCorp revolutionized society with NANOs—advanced androids designed to work, protect, and evolve. But their greatest discovery wasn’t in circuits or code—it was in connection.
As a Handler, your bond with your NANO determines its growth, efficiency, and potential. The stronger your connection, the more your NANO thrives—and so does the world around you.
Customize your NANO
Personalize your NANO’s appearance to match your style. Upgrade and enhance them as they grow alongside you.
Give Your NANO a Purpose
Assign your NANO different tasks and jobs—whether it’s crafting, gathering, assisting with research, or even taking on unique missions. They can earn rewards and income for you to spend on more customisation!
Build & Decorate a Capsule Home
Design a cozy, futuristic capsule where your NANO lives. Decorate with furniture, gadgets, and upgrades to create the perfect space.
Invite Friends & Visit Their NANOs
Interact with your friends’ NANOs, visit their capsules, or invite them over to yours. Watch how their NANOs grow and evolve in different ways.

title: TreasureTails
description:
게임 정보
A curious journey where you play as a cute cat named Mikado. Follow your instincts and solve clues to find and unearth hidden bounties, riches and ancient artifacts. Sell, gift or collect them as you please. Learn more about the world around you and its many mysteries!
An adventure fit for a cat
Explore a land full of wonders and hidden treasures with the help of your trusted shovel and metal detector. Every beep is potentially a great find!
Drive around in a pickup truck or take your time and walk to wherever your curiosity takes you, there's no rush.
Chat with other villagers and treasure hunters, they might just give you clues or hints on where to find treasures. 
Follow the main trails or go off-road in search of forgotten long-lost treasures, the world is your oyster!
Sell your findings to other villagers or add them to your collection.

title: TORSO TENNIS
description:
게임 정보
Enter the world of TORSO TENNIS: a sports-like roguelike. DRAFT and GRAFT to perfect your TORSO and win the season.
WISHLIST TO BECOME A TENNIS GOD
FEATURES
High-intensity grid-based multi-ball tennis gameplay.
Upgrade & Win. Level up your LIMBS, get perma-boosts from TATTOOS, and YOINK limbs from your defeated opponents.
Tons of builds. Find new limb + tattoo combinations that absolutely wreck your foes and break the game.

title: Block Factory
description:
게임 정보
Creativity meets production in Block Factory, an automation game with a clear purpose: building sets of captivating 3D figurines. Design and optimize your factory to efficiently produce and assemble toy blocks into finished figurines. Analyze blueprints and meticulously plan your assembly lines, orchestrating the production of blocks.
Build specialized machines that streamline the gathering and transformation process, shaping blocks into charming figurines. Create intricate assembly lines to stack, glue, and assemble hundreds of blocks, bringing your models to life! Optimize and enhance every step of the journey to ensure your enchanting figurines.

title: Fatal Claw
description:
게임 정보
현대인들의 기술로 다시 눈뜬 멸망한 고대 왕국
웅장한 지하세계, 난폭한 감염체, 봉인되어버린 출구, 생명을 기록하는 돌, 고대인과 현대인들이 뒤섞여 사는 FatalClaw의 세상은 미스터리 그 자체입니다.
모든 것을 포기한듯한 이 지하 세상 한편에서 선조들의 도움으로 부활한 의문의 고양이 "키샤"와 함께 생존자들을 구출하고 서로 유기적으로 연결된 방대한 고대 유적, 위험천만한 지형을 탐험하며 오염체들로 부터 흡수한 능력을 활용해 지하 세상의 미스터리를 풀고 사건의 진실을 밝히세요.
"키샤"와 당신의 여정 끝에 지상의 빛이 함께 하기를 염원합니다.

진정한 모험
서로 유기적으로 연결된 독특하고 개성 넘치는 각각의 지역은 여러분을 진정한 탐험의 세계로 인도합니다.
비선형으로 디자인된 맵을 통해 정해진 길이 아닌 다양한 방식으로 탐색하며 자신만의 서사를 써내려가 보세요.
수많은 장애물과 함정 때로는 강력한 오염체들을 만나게 될지도 모르지만 당신이 어디로 향하든 그 길 끝에서 의미를 발견하게 될 것입니다.
이 모험의 결말은 플레이어의 선택에 달렸습니다. 자신이 추구하는 가치를 따르고 이루어내세요.

title: House Builder 2
description:
게임 정보
하우스 빌더 2: 꿈의 집을 만드세요

House Builder 2에서는 생동감 넘치는 로우 폴리 오픈 월드에서 친구와 함께 또는 혼자서 꿈의 건축물을 건설할 수 있습니다! 궁극의 협동 건설 모험에서 작업에 필요한 자재를 구입하고 짐을 싣고 다음 작업을 향해 달려가세요!
주요 기능
🛠️ 작업 준비 중

장비를 갖추고 준비하세요. 모든 작업은 올바른 도구와 계획으로 시작됩니다! 먼저, 다음 건설에 필요한 것이 무엇인지 살펴봐야 합니다. 동네 창고에 가서 사서 트럭에 싣습니다.

🚚 출근

늦지 마세요. 그렇지 않으면 탑승을 놓칠 수 있습니다. 짐을 싣고 출발하여 모든 것이 제대로 전달되었는지 확인하세요. 현장에서는 작업에 앞서 공사에 필요한 모든 자재를 내려야 합니다.

👷‍♂️👷‍♀️

친구들과 함께 꿈의 집을 짓는 것이 더 재미있어요! 새로운 협동 모드에서 동료 빌더와 팀을 이루어 프로젝트에 대해 협업하고, 리소스를 공유하고, 함께 디자인할 수 있습니다. 아늑한 별장을 짓든, 장엄한 저택을 짓든, 팀워크로 꿈을 실현해 보세요!

🏡

평화롭고 조용한 것을 선호하시나요? 시간을 갖고 긴장을 풀고 모든 챌린지를 혼자서 완료하세요.

🌍

가능성이 가득한 광활한 오픈 월드에서 창의력을 마음껏 발휘해 보세요. 그것을 탐색하고, 일하고 싶은 장소를 찾고, 일을 시작하세요. 광활한 풍경이 당신의 캔버스입니다. 원하는 대로 모양을 만들어보세요!

🔨

더욱 정밀하고 제어할 수 있는 고급 메커니즘을 통해 한 차원 높은 건축 시뮬레이션을 경험해 보세요. 다양한 도구와 재료를 활용하여 미적으로 아름답고 구조적으로 건전한 주택을 건설하세요. 도전적인 임무를 수행하고, 건축 계약을 완료하고, 진행하면서 새로운 도구와 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하세요. House Builder 2는 건설과 탐색에 대한 참여와 동기를 유지하는 역동적인 게임플레이 경험을 제공합니다.

🌈
풍부하고 생동감 넘치는 색상이 모든 세부 사항을 생생하게 표현하는 시각적으로 매혹적인 세계에 빠져보세요. House Builder 2는 무성한 풍경부터 복잡한 인테리어까지 눈을 즐겁게 하여 모든 건축 프로젝트가 독특하고 아름답게 느껴지도록 합니다.

House Builder 2와 함께 일생일대의 건축 모험을 시작할 준비를 하세요. 노련한 건축가이든 초보 건축업자이든 여기에는 모두를 위한 무언가가 있습니다. 오늘부터 도구를 들고 꿈의 집을 만들어보세요!

title: The Demons Told Me to Make This Game
description:
게임 정보
The Demons Told Me to Make This Game is a time-looping, Lovecraftian narrative adventure about horrifying monsters and the humans who are even worse.
You play as Dark Wisp, a disembodied spirit summoned to guide a crew of amateur exorcists through a demonic invasion of a Midwestern town. Unable to interact with the physical world, you’ll rely on your powers instead:
Possession — take over one exorcist at a time, whispering thoughts into their minds.
Time Manipulation — Rewind time to change the outcome of events.
Just one problem — your hosts aren’t exactly thrilled to hear a voice in their heads. As you make them relive the same events again and again, they’ll resist and rebel. You’ll have to experiment — and make them do unspeakable things — to find out what’s happening in Red Hives and have everyone survive to tell the tale.
TDTMTMTG revolves around solving a series of time loops. Your goal is to ensure all hosts survive every segment of the loop.
Loops are broken down into time segments — small chunks to help you experiment with their interconnected events. In each segment, you’ll choose which host to possess and follow. Others are left to their own devices and will often make impressively bad decisions. Hosts don’t remember the events of past loops (but they slowly start growing suspicions).

title: Shades
description:
게임 정보
Hello and welcome !
I'm Mamat, a true passionate gamer and a new French game developer on Unreal Engine 5, and I present to you my very first game : Shades !
These last few years many FPS were not really satisfying me, so I decided to make one by myself with all my ideas and my perspective of a truly immersive first-person game, which means immersive menus, no or minimum HUD or camera effects or pop up notifications or outlined/highlighted items and interactions, like in real life, and be really free to do whatever you want in dense and beautiful environments, no invisible walls, many destructions possible for example, using different ways to complete the objectives and find solutions to problems by yourself, no backseating, minimap or floating arrows/pings/compass, and with that all the latest hardware and software technologies available on PC to have the most realistic graphics and physics for the best immersion possible.
I'm making this game first to gain experience (so please be indulgent), and to start a portfolio in game development, then hopefully in the future to change from my actual job to my dream job : being a game developer, or even better, create my own game studio, which really listen his community and who you can trust and rely on, to make all our dream games for all of us, I have so many ideas !
So based on your support, i hope this early access will give me the time and resources to make all this happen.
About Shades, it's a really immersive solo FPS with infiltration and tactical extraction shooter aspects. Go stealth, or loud, in a variety of missions as a mercenary for an agency that really use your skills to make this world better.
For now the game may not very optimized, so you will surely need a good and recent PC for the best experience (you can check the system requirements below), it may also lacks some content and functionalities, so be aware of that before buying my early access game and then leaving a bad review please.
Currently implemented in the game, there are 4 different maps : your home/vehicle (upgradable), the secret training bunker of the agency, the agency test mission then your first official mission, with for now a basic stealth system with simple lootable AI enemies, a money/level system, a tablet/PC with online casino games, shops, applications, dark web markets and more, 10 customizable weapons : sniper rifle, revolver, 2 assault rifles, 2 SMGs, 2 shotguns, 2 handguns + 4 grenades : fragmentation, contact frag, flash and smoke, several utilities/explosives, an axe, fist fighting and a push/kick/ragdoll system.

Daily life part
