The old-fashioned world of the Internet
In the past, bulletin boards were a great place to support Kurumi as a magical girl. Kurumi's heyday has passed, and now those bulletin boards are in disrepair. Protect the bulletin board and become popular again in a screen that reminds you of the Internet and CRTs of the Heisei era.
autokwd: BBS  Magica,【掲示板】ワイ魔法少女なんやが？【管理できん】

title: Steel Knight's ARMIS
description:
게임 정보
In "Steel Knight's ARMIS" you step into the pilot's seat of ARMIS (Advanced Robotic Mechanized Interceptor System) and navigate a battlefield full of dramatic turns.
As a member of the rebellion, you’ll fight your way through a dramatic story of five chapters.
Not only will you face waves of numerous enemies, but enemy pilots controlling their own ARMIS units. While the gameplay is straightforward, upgrading your ARMIS is essential to counter these powerful opponents. Gather experience points to level up, choose your upgrades wisely, and develop your unique ARMIS.




◆ The Thrill of Obliterating Enemy Hordes
With ARMIS machines fully powered to their limits, even the largest enemy swarms don't stand a chance. Build your ARMIS to your liking and experience the exhilarating rush of defeating countless foes.


◆ Experience a Classic Robot Anime-Style Story
This game offers a story that feels just like watching a classic, high-energy mecha anime. 
The narrative unfolds over 5 chapters, with each chapter featuring a different protagonist. 
Immerse yourself in their passionate journeys and fight for what they believe in.
autokwd: Steel Knight's ARMIS,鋼の戦騎ARMIS -Steel Knight's ARMIS

title: Waystones
description:
게임 정보
All the strategic depth of deckbuilding classics taken to the extreme! Manage combat on a tactical map, pursuing divine boons and avoiding the deadly spread of corruption in Waystones, a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder!
Hex-Based Tactical Combat
Avoid detrimental status hexes, collect powerful boons, and use obstacles to your advantage while moving around the tactical map. Crafting your deck meets new depth with various movement based cards and multi-target patterns!
Craft Unique Decks
Enhance your deck with hundreds of card options. Carefully select and upgrade your cards to create a deck with potent combinations. Use your deck to defeat enemies on your journey between Waystones and cleanse the corruption!

title: Theta and Paralldox on Worldlines
description:
게임 정보
Theta is a little girl who turns left every time she hits a wall. She is curious about the world and discovers a mysterious place, where she picked up a fork that can split her into multiple copies of herself, and from that moment, the world changes forever.
Use the power of splitting to solve puzzles and explore the truth of a world under the observation of "God"

title: Apocalypse Express
description:
게임 정보
Apocalypse Express is an action management Roguelike in which the player conducts, upgrades and repairs different parts of the train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. Departing the darkness of their lifelong shelter, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the outside world with their own eyes, charting out a map around the few remaining memories of the past world.
Manage the Chaos
Be prepared for some nail-biting tension as you try to keep your train running while balancing putting out fires, collecting resources and dispatching enemies. You won't always be able to take care of every part of the Train so be ready to think fast and smart as things will not go as planned.

title: DreamEcho
description:
게임 정보
You are an office worker drifting in a big city, and due to your busy job, you no longer have many friends to stay in touch with. After working tirelessly for an unknown number of days, you have a nightmare ----- a very dark, empty, and cold nightmare. In the dream, there is nothing; it feels as if the entire world consists only of you.
Then, a mysterious girl appears. She tells you the story of Dream Echo, a story where everyone's dreams are connected together...
You wake up, half in disbelief, with a vague memory of this event. From then on, every time you fall asleep, you find yourself in that dream home, and she is there waiting for you, ready for you both to embark on adventures in the world of Dream Echo...
Welcome to the Paradise of Concepts! This game is created by passionate POE fans. There are no specific skill upgrades or fixed combinations in the game; all are based on fundamental logic, and all are modular that can be combined freely. How you play is entirely up to the player! The game will continue to update in the future until the is fully constructed!

title: Pumpkin Restaurant
description:
게임 정보
호박 레스토랑은 화면 하단에 나타나며, 다른 일을 하면서 레스토랑을 운영할 수 있습니다.
직원 고용:
레스토랑 직원으로 호박 사람이나 고양이를 고용하세요. 레스토랑에는 웨이터, 요리사, 출납원이 필요합니다.
직원에게는 임의의 속성 값이 있습니다. 더 나은 속성을 가진 직원을 선택하고 적절한 직책을 할당하십시오.
게임이 진행됨에 따라 특별한 직원이 등장합니다.
레시피 모음:
주방에는 다양한 레시피가 갖춰져야 합니다. 레시피가 풍부할수록 주방 효과는 더욱 강해집니다.
레시피는 업그레이드를 통해 속성을 향상시킬 수 있습니다.
게임이 진행되면서 특별한 레시피가 등장합니다.

title: Skingdom
description:
게임 정보
Create your own ski realm in Skingdom, a ski resort construction and management game! Arrange your resort, draw your slopes and build your lifts, hotels and shops. Take care of your budget, hire staff and invest in upgrades for your ski resort to reach the top of the mountain!
Build different lift types : ski lifts, chair lifts, gondola lifts and cable car lifts
Each lift type has its own characteristics. Speed, seats or maximum altitude, invest in the best lifts to outcome the mountain challenges.
Draw slopes for your guests, from easy green slopes in the forest for beginners to the hard slopes with bumps on the edge of the mountains for the most experienced skiers.
Build your resort by investing in housing to welcome your vacationers and shops to satisfy all their needs. But the mountain is not only skiing, movies, pools and other activities will allow your guests to relax after a long day of sports.

title: Strange Block 36
description:
게임 정보
"이상한 블록 36"은 배틀 로얄 장르의 멀티플레이어 온라인 게임입니다. 플레이어는 떨어지는 블록을 제거하고 적에게 공격을 시작해야 합니다. 36명이 같은 화면에서 경쟁하며 우승을 놓고 경쟁한다!
게임 특징:
• 대규모 동일 화면 전투: 동일 화면에서 36명이 함께 대규모 온라인 전투를 경험하며, 각 플레이어의 전략과 행동이 명확하게 표시됩니다.
• 공정한 결투: 우리는 힘만이 승리와 패배를 결정하는 유일한 기준이 되도록 공정한 경쟁 플랫폼을 제공합니다.
• 모험 모드: 수백 개의 레벨이 하나씩 잠금을 해제하고 정복하기를 기다리고 있습니다.
• 맞춤형 키보드: 플레이어는 자신의 조작 습관에 따라 키의 위치와 크기를 자유롭게 조정할 수 있습니다.
• 비디오 재생 기능: 언제든지 검토 및 분석을 위해 최근 100개의 게임 비디오를 자동으로 저장하여 게임 기술을 향상시킵니다.

title: Our Ephemeral Nights
description:
게임 정보
Faced with the circumstances of his family and disappointments of the world, Kev enters his final semester of college, studying Computer Science with the goal to get a financially stable job. He yearns for a lost simplicity, a time where things were a bit simpler and might’ve felt right. In a chance encounter with Vivi, a girl from the drama department, he’s given a flier to a theatrical performance – her last performance before she also graduates that semester.
Though their time left as students is fleeting, the two continue to walk their different but interwoven paths, as they discover and embrace the beauty in their shimmering but fading moments as students.
Features
Our Ephemeral Nights is a free to play, romance and drama visual novel made with the Ren'Py Visual Novel Engine.
Free-to-Play
Available for Windows, Linux, and Mac
Original Soundtrack
20+ CG's

title: Alchemist Historical Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Alchemist Historical Simulator transports you to the heart of medieval science and mysticism, where you take on the role of an aspiring alchemist. In a world filled with both wonder and danger, you’ll balance the practical and the mystical as you uncover the hidden truths of alchemy.
Key Features:
Play as an alchemist in 18th century Paris.
Receive visitors in your home with an alchemy lab.
Study their symptoms and select medicines by studying the books of ancient healers.
Buy ingredients at the market, create your own, grow the necessary plants in your own garden
Craft medicines and potions from various ingredients, based on recipes.
Heal visitors and earn money from it.
Spend money on developing your own laboratory
Сollect bits of knowledge from ancient books and manuscripts of alchemists of previous generations, solve symbols, allegories and ancient riddles
Find the recipe for the Philosopher's Stone and be the first to create it
Additional features:
Day and Night Duality: By day, serve your town by healing people with carefully crafted potions and remedies. By night, conduct secret experiments in the pursuit of the elusive Philosopher's Stone and the mysteries of immortality.
Historical Accuracy: Delve into authentic medieval alchemical practices, study ancient texts, and encounter historical figures who shaped the field.
Branching Storyline: The path you choose will shape your destiny. Will you pursue alchemy for wealth, power, or the betterment of mankind?
Risk and Reward: Experiment with different ingredient combinations—reap the benefits of success or face dangerous, sometimes explosive, failures.
Puzzle-Based Discovery: Decipher cryptic manuscripts and solve alchemical riddles to unlock ancient knowledge.
Open-Ended Gameplay: Explore a detailed medieval world, filled with challenges, opportunities, and consequences, where your choices determine the outcome of your journey.

title: Shrine of Haunts
description:
게임 정보
Game Genre
Japanese Mystery Visual Novel × Folk Horror × Psychological Thriller
Synopsis
Summer 1995. You return to the secluded village of Iwao, surrounded by mountains, due to your grandfather's critical illness. An ancient shrine in the village is said to seal away the legendary yokai "Tsuchigumo". As the annual "Mushi Okuri Festival" approaches, the ritual flames threaten to awaken a millennium-old curse...
An Ancient Rite Shrouded in Curse
"When eerie echoes resound from the cave, every villager lowers their gaze"
In the shrine's flickering torchlight, the maiden chants unspeakable prayers. Scattered archives, midnight bonfires of forbidden objects...
As the ritual draws near, you begin to realize—
The fractures in your memory hold the key to tearing open the village's veil of darkness.

title: BATTLERCORE: TEAM BLAZER
description:
게임 정보
You are the chosen one, the heir to the Emperor's legacy. On the desolate planet of Sphera, a war for power has ravaged the continent of Centradia for decades. As the wielder of imperial power, you've joined the BLAZE HOUND, a peacekeeping force intervening in battles across the globe through Liberators, mercenary soldiers with unwavering determination.

title: ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom
description:
게임 정보
                                                             《ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom》 is a black and white hand-drawn Suspense inference interactive narrative game.
Detective novelist MEL Gideon waits anxiously in the cafe for the mysterious letter writer to show up, but what happens next is unexpected - a cold dead body in a dilapidated, narrow room. Unlike the complicated and bizarre death scenes she writes about, real death is so simple .....
Game characteristics：                                                                                                      
Simple to play: The game is easy to use, but you still need to gather clues, solve puzzles, analyze and think to uncover the truth.
Fine Arts:Unique visual design featuring black and white hand painted illustrations that create a retro and weird atmosphere.
Music: Each score is independently composed for the character and plot development, presenting a rich and profound auditory experience through delicate melodies and harmonies.
autokwd: ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom,ELISSA：卧室的缢吊尸

title: Easy Delivery Co.
description:
게임 정보
Easy Delivery Co. is a relaxing driving game with definitely no secrets. You’ve been hired as a delivery driver in a once-lively scenic mountain town now plagued with inhospitable weather. Make deliveries and uncover the story of the town’s not-at-all mysterious residents, all while earning well below minimum wage.
Features
Earn money, buy drastically overpriced gas and get to know the locals
Take in the atmospheric scenery or blitz through (road safety not required)
Split-screen race mode with up to four players
Simple controls and retro graphics
Nothing strange going on, no lore, nothing at all, we promise

title: GRIND MOMO
description:
게임 정보
Grind Momo is an incremental clicker game where you earn money, invest strategically, and build a business empire through clicking and smart decisions.
💼 Work & Earn – Choose a job based on your level and click to generate income.
💰 Invest Wisely – Grow your wealth by trading stocks, crypto, and funds.
🏠 Real Estate & Rentals – Buy properties and vehicles to rent out for steady income.
🏭 Craft or Buy – Use factories to craft items at a lower cost, or purchase items from the market to rent or sell for profit.
📦 Manage Inventory – View your owned items in your inventory for tracking and management.
🎯 Milestones – Achieve milestones across various values, unlocking bonuses related to that type of milestone (e.g., money, XP, etc.).
🔄 Prestige System – Reset your progress to earn prestige points that can be spent on upgrades such as combo gain, delays, or boosting XP and money per click.
⚙️ Config Options – Customize your experience with the ability to:
Hard Reset the game.
Reset the tutorial progress.
Change the color theme of the entire game.
Access cheat options to adjust certain game aspects (hidden).
Grind, invest, and level up with strategic upgrades, milestones, and customization!
🚀 Built with Flutter on Android Studio.

title: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
description:
게임 정보
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.
Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and grit of early 1900s Scandinavia. In this world, every shadow offers a hiding place, and every corner hides a new challenge. Allies and quick reflexes are your greatest tools as you unravel the city's secrets and outsmart your pursuers.
Join Hanna's adventure through Eriksholm on her quest to find her brother and uncover the mystery behind his disappearance. Venture into stunning landscapes in a gripping story where every second counts as Hanna strives to reunite her family.

title: Frenemies
description:
게임 정보
Frenemies는 최대 10명의 플레이어가 무인도에 갇히게 되어 궁극적인 생존과 배신의 시험을 치르는 귀여운 멀티플레이어 게임입니다. 인기 TV 쇼 서바이버(Survivor)에서 영감을 받은 사회적 속임수 게임에서 기지를 건설하고, 동맹을 맺고, 전투를 벌여 최후의 플레이어가 되어보세요.
섬을 탐험하고 농사, 공예, 요리, 낚시 등을 배우는 방법을 알아보세요. 기지를 건설하고 퀘스트를 완료하여 새로운 섬에 보금자리를 마련하는 데 도움을 주세요.
닭 포획, 해적 총격전, 눈덩이 대혼란, 빨간불 초록불, 소품 사냥 등을 포함한 다양한 섬과 게임 모드에서 면역을 위한 전투를 벌이세요.

title: Sigilfarer
description:
게임 정보
Sigilfarer는 모든 결정이 주사위 굴림에 달려 있는 로그라이트 어드벤처입니다. 주사위 빌딩 시스템을 마스터하며 광활하고 절차적으로 생성된 세계를 탐험하세요. 경로를 전략적으로 계획하고, 자원을 관리하며, 운을 최대한으로 시험해보세요!
커스터마이즈 가능한 주사위 시스템
Sigilfarer는 덱 빌딩 장르를 재구상하여 커스터마이즈 가능한 주사위 시스템으로 당신의 운명을 형성할 수 있게 합니다. 당신의 파티는 주사위 세트입니다; 각 검, 방패, 그리고 갑옷은 주사위 면이 되어, 당신이 사용할 수 있는 공격, 버프, 그리고 전략적 옵션을 결정합니다.
주사위는 굴러가지만, 결과는 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다
팀에서 최대 네 명의 캐릭터를 관리하며, 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞춘 독특한 빌드와 시너지를 창출하세요. 주사위는 전체 플레이 동안 중요한 역할을 하며 파티의 능력을 나타냅니다.

title: G-Rebels
description:
게임 정보
G-Rebels: An action-packed combat flight sim in a dystopian open world full of intrigue, free exploration, dangerous missions and breathtaking flight maneuvers.

In the year 2684, Earth was almost completely flooded by catastrophic events. The survivors created floating megacities, which compete for the remaining natural resources.

As part of an elite unit of the most powerful city-state, it is your job to ensure law and order in the metropolis and the colonies.

With your ultra-modern glider, you secure transport routes and fight organized crime. But the course of a secret mission suddenly calls everything into question: are you fighting for the right side or are you part of a dark conspiracy?

Discover vibrant metropolises, outposts, research facilities, factories, etc. in a freely explorable world of more than 12,000 square kilometers.

Follow the main storyline or discover the world on your own and earn your money in mining, as a bounty hunter, racing pilot, bodyguard, mercenary, pirate or as a hunter for lost artifacts.

Invest the credits you earn in upgrading your Skyblade: Engine, weapon or shield upgrades? AI-controlled drones, multi-warhead missiles or stealth devices? Plan your Skyblade's equipment before you go into battle.

Fight against other gliders or hack into their control unit to take control of enemy skyblades.

Take part in the battle for power: conquer outposts, skyports, power plants, etc. to help your faction gain influence and control.

Technical and visual highlights: Changing weather conditions with volumetric clouds, dynamic sun and moon position with realistic day-night changes, complete world streaming (no loading screens), real-time simulation of thousands of flying objects in the world, etc.

title: Pixel Piracy Online
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist and follow Pixel Piracy Online (PPO) Now!



Pixel Piracy Online is an entirely new game set in the same universe as Pixel Piracy; it's a complete remake of the base game. In this game, you assume the role of a pirate, and your purpose is to make a name for yourself.

Pirate MMO

The goal is to create a Pirate MMO that players/pirates can call home; the game is currently in pre/pre-production, and screenshots don't represent the final product yet. You will play alone or with friends, be part of the big pirate community and build the world and gather resources, farm and feed others, socialize, pillage settlements, level up your character and crew, min-max to become the best, loot different epic loot, craft to survive the hostile world and most importantly battle others.

Pixel Piracy Online runs on persistent centralized non-sharded servers that require an internet connection. Ownership of the game gives you access to these online centralized servers.

Key Features














Pixel Piracy Online's story takes place a super long time after the first Pixel Piracy game. All pirates got wiped out by Holy Mother Shrimp, and now life is starting again with a twist that everyone remembers their past. Here, dead men will tell tales.



The game is currently in ; some content and descriptions on the store might change as to what 1.0 will include, but the community will be heavily involved in the production process and will be informed of potential changes.

There will also be closed curated testing rounds where the community can try and test the game; the first tests will happen in 2023/Q3-Q4.

The game will not be available on Steam Early-Access but will be released as a full 1.0 release and expanded further with content in 2025 or later.

Pixel Piracy Tavern Discord Server .

title: Monster Mop Up
description:
게임 정보
일상의 스트레스를 잊고, 친구들과 함께 청소 도구를 들고 가벼운 청소 여행을 떠나보세요! 여유로운 페이스로 구석구석을 정리하거나, 고집스러운 얼룩을 빠르게 제거하는 도전을 즐길 수 있는 《청결 특공대》는 색다른 힐링 경험을 제공합니다. 여러분은 닦고, 문지르고, 청소하며, 작은 몬스터들이 남긴 모든 흔적을 말끔히 없애 세상을 새롭게 바꿀 수 있습니다!
사랑스러운 작은 몬스터들이 인간 세상에서 온갖 혼란을 일으키고 있습니다! 이들은 여기저기 뛰어다니며 모든 것을 엉망으로 만들어 놓습니다. 창의력과 기술을 활용해 이 작은 녀석들을 찾아내고, 그들이 남긴 끈적한 얼룩을 깨끗이 정리하세요! 하지만 외모에 속지 마세요. 이 작은 악동들은 꽤나 교활합니다. 이들은 숨기도 하고, 주변을 더 어지럽히기도 합니다. 이제 당신의 실력으로 이들을 정리할 차례입니다!

title: Lone Fungus: Melody of Spores
description:
게임 정보
Play as Greencap's ancestor in this prequel to the first Lone Fungus, set thousands of years before the first game. 

Just like the first game, Lone Fungus: Melody of Spores is a sprawling Metroidvania set in a mushroom world! This time perhaps our protagonist will be a bit less lonely...


Features 8-directional Castlevania-like combat with sub-weapons, but with a modern fast and fluid movement system!


Play as Greencaps ancestor, set in a world thousands of years before the first game, in a time where the various mushroom tribes are being destroyed and divided by a mythical creature known as the 'Spirit Beast'.

Fulfill the prophecy of becoming the 'Hiertan', a cultural leader which unites the various mushroom tribes in together defeating the 'Spirit Beast'.

title: A Story in Bronze Ware
description:
게임 정보
The peaceful Bamboo Spring was once a small country during the Spring and Autumn Period. At the time, the people were living in great misery due to continued invasions. To protect this country from foreign enemies and prosper, you must devote yourself to rebuilding this land from almost nothing. This game allows you to train your troops and use your diplomatic tricks on other lords. Try your best to uncover the true history of the ancient China!
A Rags-to-Riches Story
In Bamboo Spring, you will start from scratch and build a farming courtyard by your own hand through laborious activities such as logging, mining, farming, animal husbandry, fishing and hunting. In the authentic style of the Spring and Autumn Period, you will accumulate resources by working with your hands and lay a solid foundation for the great cause of revival.
An Experience Based on True History
Each inhabitant in Bamboo Spring carries emotions and secrets, being a part of little-known anecdote from the Spring and Autumn period. Delve into their inner worlds, uncover the historical stories hidden in the country, and bring those dusty pasts to life again.

title: Bloodgrounds
description:
게임 정보
Lead your team of Gladiators in turn-based arena battles, recruiting, training, and sometimes sacrificing them for glory. But remember, your Gladiators are mortal - If they fall in battle, they are lost forever... though their legacy will live on.
As a noble heir, you'll manage your city by unlocking, constructing, and upgrading buildings that provide new services and mechanics to aid you on your bloody quest for vengeance.
You fought tooth and nail for survival, driven by a burning hatred and a thirst for justice. Now, as a wealthy patron and a gladiator trainer, you plot your revenge against the tyrannical Emperor who stole your freedom and murdered your father. But the path to redemption is fraught with peril, and you must navigate a treacherous world filled with deception and danger.
Recruit new allies and expand your gladiator team to climb the ranks of the brutal tournaments. Each victory brings you closer to the grand Capitol, where your ultimate target - the Emperor, lost in his madness - awaits on his throne.

title: Mystic Land: The Search  Maphaldo
description:
게임 정보
Mystic Land is a project that started all the way back in 1994 when couple of friends had the idea of creating a fantasy role playing game that would be a mix of best elements from computer FRP games like Wizardry, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder.
The game saw a couple of attempts to be born back then, but it wasn’t to be. Partly because we were just too young and “green” back then, partly because, you know, “life happens”… we drifted apart, started our professional jobs and other ventures. You know, we grew up.

But, after more than 25 years, we found all them early unfinished DOS versions, maps, concept art and documentation lying on old disks collecting dust. We also found a lot of sketches and ideas on paper (that miraculously survived the 25+ years).
And so the decision was made - it’s time to develop this thing.

We are still determined that Mystic Land will be the best old-school computer fantasy role playing game with all the goodies from the 90s like turn based grid movement and combat, lots of (meaningful) skills and attributes and (hard) puzzled to solve.
Saying that, we will also add some quality-of-life improvements like full controller/mouse/keyboard support and easier inventory and battle strategy management.

title: Towerbolt
description:
게임 정보
Towerbolt is a precision platformer with an emphasis on speed and fluid ascending movement. Set in the far future where robots are waging war against humanity, play as a Bolter, an augmented half human, half robot super soldier, and break out of a futuristic Megatower prison!

title: LEVEL UP YOUR BODY
description:
게임 정보
(이 페이지는 자동으로 번역되었습니다)



[/u] - 피트니스 VR 리듬 복싱 게임! VR 헤드셋을 착용하고 리드미컬하게 흐르는 비트에 맞춰 펀치를 날리고 물체를 타격하는 미래형 스테이지에 입장하세요. 몸을 웅크리거나 능숙하게 피하면서 장애물을 피하세요.



액티브 게임 플레이[/u] - 이 게임을 플레이하면 체력을 강화하고 지구력을 높이며 조정력을 향상시키는 동시에 반사 신경을 날카롭게 할 수 있습니다. 각 게임 동작은 더 건강하고 민첩한 자신을 향한 한 걸음이됩니다. 가상 세계에 몰입할 뿐만 아니라 신체 능력을 완전히 새로운 차원으로 끌어올릴 준비를 하세요.



커스텀 레벨 지원 - 다른 사용자나 자신이 만든 커스텀 레벨을 플레이하세요.



VR 레벨 에디터 - 혁신적인 VR 레벨 에디터를 사용하면 좋아하는 노래와 멜로디를 VR에 직접 매핑하여 독특한 게임 레벨을 만들 수 있습니다. 창작물에 몰입하여 전에 없던 리듬을 경험해 보세요.

title: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness
description:
게임 정보

Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness – 메트로배니아 탐험의 메커니즘과 현대 슬래셔의 역동성을 결합한 액션 RPG 장르의 등각 투영 스토리 중심 게임입니다.

게임의 줄거리는 외계 침략의 중심에 자신을 발견한 중세 남자의 이야기를 담고 있습니다. 주인공과 그의 가족, 지역 주민들은 외계인에게 납치된다. 엄청난 행운, 전투 기술, 신비한 목소리의 개입 덕분에 우리의 주인공은 외계 기술을 가지고 우주선에서 지구로 탈출하는 데 성공합니다. 나중에 그의 가족이 다른 배에 타고 있고 지구에서 본격적인 침략이 벌어지고 있다는 사실을 알게 된 영웅은 행동하기 시작합니다.

- 전투 시스템: 게임플레이의 핵심 요소는 단순히 아이템, 무기, 방어구의 능력치가 아닌 플레이어의 액티브 스킬과 획득한 고유 능력을 효과적으로 사용하는 것입니다. 각 유형의 적을 섬멸하는 독특한 접근 방법을 찾거나, 위치와 주변 물체의 특징을 활용하여 적을 물리치세요!

- 게임 세계는 세미 오픈 원칙으로 구성되어 있습니다. 플레이어에게는 탐험과 상호작용을 위한 광범위한 영역이 제공됩니다. 모든 위치는 서로 연결되어 있으며 스토리가 진행되거나 새로운 기술을 습득하면 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.

- 게임 세계는 역사적 사실에 기초한 것이 아닌 완전히 허구적인 세계입니다. 지역 주민들은 그들만의 문화, 예술, 삶의 방식을 가지고 있습니다. 중세 시대는 Eclipse 세계에서 인간 발달의 현재 단계를 조건부로 지정하는 것입니다. 때때로 플레이어는 중세 시대의 전형적인 기술과 아이템을 접할 수 있지만 나중에 줄거리는 그 모습에 대한 설명을 제공합니다.

지구에 대한 외계인 침공에 맞서 중세 저항군을 이끄세요!

title: The Ump Show
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the game as a baseball umpire. Make accurate calls but make sure your team wins!

Pitchers will change up the pitch selection to confuse the batters but you have to be better. Track fastballs and breaking pitches to make accurate strike/ball calls. If you make a terrible call, the players will challenge your call! If you make too many wrong calls, it's game over!

Calls you will make as the home plate umpire:
Ball/Strike
Checked swings
Fair/Foul
Tag Plays and Forceouts

Since you want your preferred team to win, remember to cheat! Giving up too many walks or too many balls can give away the game. Pick your moments and redirect the game at the right time.

To help you, you can spend your integrity to purchase powerups!

Block: Stop a player from challenging your call
Balk: Call a balk on the pitcher and immediately reward a walk to the batter
Eject: Replace the batter or pitcher with your preferred player.
Story Mode

You start as an umpire with no credibility in the amateur leagues. Your goal is to build credibility and earn favors to climb your way to umpiring at the highest levels!

title: Masada
description:
게임 정보
Civilization is trapped in Masada, a vast and exotic nebula far from any star system. Thousands of years have passed since humanity became prisoners of this strange world, and in that time, it has blossomed into drastically different cultures—ranging from humble nomads to black hole-worshiping theocracies and powerful empires competing for total domination. The struggle for survival is always present in this brutal space.
Gameplay
Masada is a single-player RTS/RPG set in a 5,000 x 5,000 x 50 km open world sandbox.
Explore many unique regions ranging from vast asteroid fields filled with pirates to dense nebula where any dangers could be lurking in the fog, to even epic ice capped terrain. The nebula is a strange and wild place.
Immerse yourself in a simulated world. You are not the center of the universe in Masada. Ships and their pilots will carry on with their business whether you are there or not. Encounter miners hauling ore back from an excavation, ambush traders as they bring goods across the nebula, scavenge wreckage from a battle you stumble upon, and much more.
Build and customize your fleets, from nimble interceptors to powerful battlecruisers and even motherships. You will need to use a wide range of tactics to truly thrive in the nebula. Arm your ship's weapons with autocannons, artillery, railguns, missiles, beams, pulse cannons, torpedoes... and more. Setup support ships with repairing shield beams to protect your frontline. Develop robust carriers that can quickly dock and repair your smaller craft in battle. The combination of outfitting all your ships with a wide range of weapons and modules leads to infinite variations of tactics for you to explore.
Craft and discover greater and more powerful modules and weapons through industry, trade, combat and exploration.
Learn to build and fly all the ships in the nebula through blueprints. Some will be harder to acquire than others...
Train and recruit a powerful faction of pilots to pursue roles from scouts to frigate captains and set your best to command your most powerful warships. Your pilots can achieve mastery in any area to dominate the nebula.
Freedom to pursue any path. Whether you want to lead a powerful faction, command a small elite squad of pirates, build an industrial powerhouse or even become a nomadic trader, Masada is a game centered around unrestricted player freedom.

title: Brotherhood
description:
게임 정보
They are billions. You are alone.
An ominous brotherhood of religious fanatics perform experiments on humans in their top-secret scientific complex. An ancient prison hidden deep in the Swiss mountains houses hundreds of test subjects whose bodies are mutilated in an effort to produce a new biological species of superhuman.

You are one of them, but unlike other test subjects, your body is immune to mutagens. For you, it's not poison anymore, rather a source of power that makes your body nearly indestructible.
Steal the weapon and obliterate them.
Break into the depths of the secret complex, unravel the secret of the millennial brotherhood's ancient technology and harness the power of mutagen to annihilate all those who stand in your way.
A timeless classic, with a fresh presentation.
The Brotherhood is a retro-shooter with classic Wolfenstein 3D style. You will feel right at home when exploring complex one-story levels in search of first aid kits, ammo and key cards, while fighting hordes of enemies in action-packed firefights. An old school shooter's classic weapons, upgrades, and well-hidden secrets will complete the experience.
Enemies are powerful. But not immortal.
There are more than 20 types of enemies in the game, and each knows how to kill you in a variety of ways. Among them are ordinary soldiers, cyborgs with power armor, flamethrowers, and huge walking mechs.

Fear not! There are brutal means to fight them all! A total of 9 types of weapons representing the most advanced engineering fashion of the brotherhood. You'll have plenty of obliteration methods at your disposal - not only a shotgun that can make a juicy "bang", but also a laser rifle that can fire infinitely, a flamethrower, and a rocket launcher. There is also...a " Butterfly ", a weapon so secret that not even the Brotherhood knows why it's called like that.
Crowds of fanatics aren't the only obstacles you need to overcome on your journey; traps and environmental elements also pose a grave threat. Watch out, since just 1 wrong step is all it takes for the laser barrier to slice you into 8 pieces.
You will face 24 huge and complex levels across 6 acts. Escape the prison by sneaking through a secret laboratory, sand dunes, and an ancient castle that holds thousands of years of Brotherhood history.
No one is with you. All you have is yourself. Your shotgun. Hordes of enemies. Animal rage and the desire to kill.
Destroy Them All!

title: AMNYAM
description:
게임 정보
“마우스 조준 기술로 정상에 도전하세요!”
“AMNYAM”은 당신이 “마우스 조준 기술”을 사용하여 올라가고 정상에 도전하는 플랫폼 게임입니다.
주변에 떠 있는 “목표”를 정확히 조준하고 클릭하여 고양이 소녀가 높이 점프하게 하세요.
하지만 아무것도 하지 않으면 캐릭터는 원래 높이로 떨어집니다.

title: Suspended Animation 💽
description:
게임 정보
Suspended Animation is a sci-fi first person exploration game about a ship in danger, and the evil AI tasked with saving it: you.

Piece together the events of the past to find out what's going on, exploring every nook and cranny for clues. Download yourself to nearby droids to get in where you shouldn't be. Increase your security access by being trustworthy, or by hacking your way there.

Solve puzzles to traverse the treacherous environment of your failing ship, and talk to NPCs to gain their trust - if you even want it.

title: Peggy's Farm
description:
게임 정보
Whether you're a Peggle player, a cozy gamer, or a supporter of all things indie, you won't be able to put it down. 
Enjoy the non-stop, ball-bouncing fun of Pachinko mixed with the cozy and satisfying gameplay of farming sims like Stardew Valley and Harvest Moon.

title: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree
description:
게임 정보
Game introduction
This is an RPG strategy adventure game that incorporates tabletop game elements and uses card construction as the main gameplay.
Main plot
A game called Greed Island is holding a trial session. 100 players from all over the world participated in this event and played on the latest virtual reality equipment. Not long after the trial started, the players They found that they could not leave the game, and there was a huge ancient tree where they were. Through talking to the NPC, they learned that most of the people who came here came here to reach the top of the soul tree, because it can realize your dreams. Any wish. Faced with the situation of being unable to return to reality, the players started their adventure with complicated emotions.
Gameplay
You will play Lin Yue, a player who is late for the trial meeting, and adventure in the fantasy world of swords and magic. You will get to know many players from the same world as you, as well as NPCs in the game, who may become you. A powerful partner on the way forward, or an enemy that can hinder or even destroy you.
During the adventure, you will be able to collect a variety of cards, equipment and props, and make full use of them to challenge various powerful enemies and learn the truth about this world.
Character introduction
Lin Yue. An editor from an ordinary magazine company attended a game trial session due to work reasons, but was late.
Zhou Mo. He used to be the best among players, but for some reason he gave up his adventure in the Soul Tree and lived in the Novice Village.
