title: Detained: Too Good  School
description:
게임 정보
소개

당신은 나쁜 소녀였습니다. 그리고 지금은 더욱 나쁜 소녀가 될 시간이죠.

소년원에서 갓 풀려난 당신은 형제의 살인을 복수하기 위한 위험한 임무를 시작합니다. 여정이 진행되면서 소중한 동맹과 강력한 적들을 만나게 될 것입니다. 당신을 죽이려는 갱단들이 지배하는 부패한 도시 정글을 탐험하고, 궁극적인 복수의 화신이 되기 위해 기술과 장비를 커스터마이징하세요. 이 모든 과정에서 도시의 미래를 바꿀 수 있는 거대한 음모를 밝혀낼 수 있을 것입니다.
Features

폭발적인 전투

폭력적인 적 무리와 맞설 수 있는 강인한 여학생을 플레이해 보세요. The Vagrant의 유명한 전투 엔진을 기반으로 한 Detained: Too Good for School의 전투는 빠른 속도, 강력한 타격감, 그리고 짜릿한 만족감을 선사합니다. 90개 이상의 업그레이드 가능한 스킬과 수집할 수 있는 무기는 당신을 막는 자들의 시체로 거리를 메우는 데 필요한 우위를 제공합니다.

역동적인 스토리라인

여러 갈래로 나뉘는 경로를 통해 자신만의 운명을 선택할 수 있는 몰입감 있는 이야기를 경험하세요. 원하는 대로 도전을 극복하세요. 당신의 행동은 주변 세계에 지속적인 영향을 미치게 된다는 것도 잊지 말아야 합니다. 무너져 가는 Swinster City의 질서를 회복하고 약자를 위해 싸우시겠습니까? 아니면 악당들과 함께 범죄 제국의 정상에 오를 건가요? 수십 개의 다양한 결말이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다!

놀라운 게임플레이의 다양성

풍부한 디테일이 묘사된 오픈 월드를 자유로운 속도로 탐험해 보세요. 다양한 괴짜 캐릭터들을 만나 독특한 보상을 제공하는 사이드 퀘스트를 시작하세요. 아르바이트를 해서 쇼핑이나 호스트 클럽에서 쓸 여윳돈을 벌어보세요. 버스를 타고 체육관에 가서 운동을 하거나, 학교에서 수업을 듣고 새로운 특전을 잠금 해제하거나, 지하 경기장에서 순위를 올리기 위해 싸우는 것도 할 수 있습니다. 게임 내 하루하루는 항상 새롭고 다채롭게 변할 것입니다.

완전한 상호작용이 가능한 세계

분주한 아침부터 흥미진진한 밤의 풍경까지 도시의 모습을 바꾸는 주야간 주기를 제어하세요. 상호작용 가능한 다양한 물건들로 집을 꾸며보세요.

재료를 사용해 무기와 액세서리를 제작하고, 수집 가능한 스티커와 모드 부품으로 속성을 커스터마이징하세요. NPC를 모집하여 도전적인 Raid Stage를 공략하거나, 적을 무시하고 보행자를 공격해 보세요! (단, 지나친 혼란을 일으키면 경찰이 개입할 수도 있습니다.)



혼란 속에서도 사랑을 찾아보세요. 남녀 모두 포함된 8명의 로맨스 가능한 캐릭터가 당신의 관심을 기다리고 있습니다. 함께 시간을 보내고, 뜨거운 데이트를 하며 관계 레벨을 올려 전용 스토리 장면을 감상하세요. 일부 파트너는 전투에도 함께할 것입니다. 결국, 함께 싸우는 커플이 오래가는 법이니까요.

title: Duil
description:
게임 정보
스토리:
Targat 왕국은 Vezruvil이 이끄는 언데드 침략군에 의해 파괴되었습니다. 여러분의 가족은 처형되어 개에게 던져졌습니다. Duil은 구금되어 고통을 받을 운명이었습니다. 하지만 아무것도 영원히 지속되지 않습니다. 영웅은 족쇄에서 풀려납니다. 여러분은 Vezruvil 성으로 가서 어둠의 왕을 파괴해야 합니다.
게임플레이:
Duil은 불멸입니다. 패배하면 미로로 들어가 탈출구를 찾아 이전 위치로 돌아가야 합니다. 모든 게임 진행 상황은 저장되지만 인벤토리에서 아이템 하나를 잃게 됩니다.
 게임이 진행됨에 따라 스토리가 전개됩니다.
지도를 탐색하고 NPC와 대화하고 비밀과 숨겨진 방을 찾으세요.
정보를 찾고 게임의 신비한 세계의 역사를 알아보세요.

title: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics
description:
게임 정보
턴 방식 전술과 스릴 넘치는 PvP 전투의 조합, 헥사돔에 잘 오셨습니다. 챔피언을 선택하고, 가슴 뛰는 1 대 1 전투에 참여하고, 영원한 명성을 얻기 위해 도전하세요.
네, 제대로 읽으셨습니다! 헥사돔이 새로운 참가자를 모집하고 있습니다. 바로 당신을요. 독특한 능력과 플레이 스타일의 다양한 클래스 기반 영웅으로 팀을 구성하세요. 무자비하지만 영리하게 팀을 장악하고, 상대를 제압하고, 정상에 오르세요.


챔피언 선택

수인 혼합종부터 고대 사무라이의 합성 복제품까지, 헥사돔에서는 뛰어난 전사들로 팀을 구성해야 합니다. 각 챔피언은 원거리, 제어, 근접, 지원 캐릭터 중 무엇을 고르냐에 따라 고유한 강점을 지닙니다. 팀의 선택과 쇼맨십을 통해 궁극기를 펼칠 수 있습니다.
반드시 성공하고 싶으신가요? 역동적인 엄폐 시스템, 다양한 거점, 끊임없이 움직이는 골 포스트를 통해 경기장을 최대한 활용하세요.




헥사돔에서 모든 액션 포인트는 소중합니다. 즉시 공격에 투자하시겠습니까? 아니면 나중의 더 강력한 기술을 위해 자원을 절약하시겠습니까? 게임의 자원 관리 시스템은 전략을 더 깊이 있게 만들어, 여러 단계를 앞서 생각하게 합니다. 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있는 전술적 결정을 내리고, 팀의 자원을 잘 관리하여 승리하세요. 물론 조준하고 쏘기만 하면 되지만, 경기장을 붉게 물들이기만 하는 것이 아니라 목표를 달성해야 승리할 수 있습니다.

title: Celestial Empire: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
이 독특한 이야기를 전체 게임 소개로 즐겨 보세요 - 모두 무료입니다. 'Celestial Empire: Prologue'의 기후 도시 건설 경험에 빠져보세요, 여기서는 땅의 놀라운 자연이 중국 전통 건축물과 혼합됩니다. 전략에 따라 도시와 농촌 구조 계획을 맡게 됩니다. 아무것도 없는 곳에서 화려한 번화한 도시로 성장하는 것을 지켜보세요. 이 도시는 전지전능한 황제를 맞이하기에 충분할 것입니다.
주요 특징
꿈의 도시를 만들고 꾸미기
생산 체인 디자인
지배하고 결정하기
다른 정착지와 교역하기
계절 변화 관찰하기
신의 축복을 구하기
다가오는 재난을 극복하기

title: Keepsake County
description:
게임 정보


We’ve added a huge update to Keepsake County’s demo, showcasing a brand new, never-before-seen heist (plus two classics), as well as 3 new enemies! Just for Steam Stealth Fest!

Burgle the Architect, the man responsible for Keepsake County’s strange, maze-like homes who lives on the edge of a huge swampy lake across from a guest house. Why’s he so paranoid? And why does he keep looking up at the sky?
Dodge the Pizza Guy, tiptoe past Hounds, and evade the Detective on your tail!
Play a shiny new tutorial that carefully guides new players to greatness.
Mantling, for scampering through the rooms and up the pipes of hoarders!
Twitch Integration, where viewers can prank streamers, or help them pull off amazing heists.
More story than ever, plus loads of new goofy and midwestern voice acting!
Loads of bugfixes and improvements.



Burglarize hideous farmhouses in the middle of nowhere and get outta dodge.

You have moments before the cops arrive to rob a procedurally-generated house that you've never seen before. If you're caught, residents will call the police even sooner... or take the law into their own hands.

title: Space Chef
description:
게임 정보
모험이 가득한 풀코스 식사: 레스토랑 매니저, 가벼운 생존 RPG, 그리고 인생 시뮬레이션, 이 모든 것이 말굽 성운의 기이한 세계에서 펼쳐집니다. 직접 은하계 최고의 요리사가 되어 외계 행성에서 최고의 식재료를 찾아 맛있는 요리를 만들고.
외계 세계 탐험
재료의 세계는 끝이 없습니다... 재료가 먼저 당신을 잡아먹지 않는다면 말이죠. 먼 행성, 버려진 우주 정거장, 본인 소유의 지하실을 탐험하며 식물과 동물, 그 밖의 맛있는 먹거리를 찾아보세요.
탐험하는 길에 우주 해적도 만나고, 고대 유적이나 최근에 버려진 것으로 의심되는 레스토랑도 발견하게 될 겁니다. 장비, 주방용품, 우주선을 업그레이드하는 데 사용할 수 있는 희귀 자원(및 다양한 잡동사니)이 있는지 잘 살펴보세요.
각양각색의 우주 요리 만들기
냉장고에 (아마도 거의) 꿈틀거리지 않는 재료가 가득 찼다면 이제 접시를 꺼내 서빙할 차례입니다!
간단한 가정식 비플 꼬치구이부터 전설적인 까다로운 옥토에그 서프라이즈까지 140가지가 넘는 다양한 요리를 만들어 보세요. 맛있는 음식과 빠른 서비스로 손님에게 놀라움을 선사하세요. 은하계 최고의 요리사가 되기 위한 여정을 기념하는 아스트로노미컬 컬리너리 엑설런스 스타즈를 획득할 수 있습니다.
명성이 높아질수록 손님이 몰려들기 시작합니다! 배달 서비스를 계속하거나, 손님이 끊이지 않는 식당을 오픈하는 등 유연하게 사업을 운영하세요. 모험을 떠나고 싶을 때면 언제든지 주방을 닫을 수 있습니다.

title: Resina Salvation
description:
게임 정보
A strategic incremental clicker set in Roman times. Clicks. Improvements. Resources. But above all, a volcano on the verge of eruption, sending waves of monsters for you to kill.
Wood, Rock, Water, every natural ressource is collectable. Just click on it to create blocks of it. The click on the block to send it on your storage !

title: TreasureTails
description:
게임 정보
A curious journey where you play as a cute cat named Mikado. Follow your instincts and solve clues to find and unearth hidden bounties, riches and ancient artifacts. Sell, gift or collect them as you please. Learn more about the world around you and its many mysteries!
An adventure fit for a cat
Explore a land full of wonders and hidden treasures with the help of your trusted shovel and metal detector. Every beep is potentially a great find!
Drive around in a pickup truck or take your time and walk to wherever your curiosity takes you, there's no rush.
Chat with other villagers and treasure hunters, they might just give you clues or hints on where to find treasures. 
Follow the main trails or go off-road in search of forgotten long-lost treasures, the world is your oyster!
Sell your findings to other villagers or add them to your collection.

title: Wander Stars
description:
게임 정보
Unleash custom attacks by combining words in a Super! Anime! Turn-Based! RPG!
Join Ringo, a young martial artist looking for her brother, and Wolfe, a mysterious scoundrel running from his past, as they join forces in an unlikely partnership to collect the pieces of the fabled Wanderstar Map. Across 10 “episodes” of anime-inspired adventure, Ringo and Wolfe will have to work together to find answers, make up for past mistakes, and travel across the universe in search of their goal. And who knows, maybe they’ll learn how to get along at some point!
Trained in the ways of Kiai, a magical form of martial art and also the universe’s most exciting form of televised entertainment, Ringo can combine words to create customized attacks in intense turn-based battles. During her race across the universe you’ll expand Ringo’s vocabulary, equip Pep Up bonuses earned through honorable victories and level up her spirit power. Defeat or befriend a cast of fearsome space pirates, mysterious scoundrels, cute witches, high school delinquents, talking crows, and skilled martial artists on your way to becoming a Kiai master.

title: IRON GUARD: Salvation
description:
게임 정보
Join the fight for humanity’s survival in IRON GUARD: Salvation, an exhilarating Tower Defense game with real-time strategy elements. Build powerful defensive structures, upgrade your turrets, and directly engage with relentless waves of robots using your handheld drone. Only your tactical brilliance and battle-hardened strategies can save humanity across battles waged on different planets—including the hostile world of Akris.
Story:
Years after the Avalon crew was saved from the sentient planet Akris, a new threat emerges as multiple planets across our solar system come under attack. Once harmless, the terraforming machines have turned hostile under Akris's control, threatening human existence. Lead the defense, repel the onslaught across diverse worlds, and uncover the secrets of Akris. Prepare for intense battles both on distant planets and the enigmatic world of Akris itself, and rise as humanity’s last salvation.
Key Features:
Fast-paced and dynamic gameplay – each battle feels unique as enemies adapt their tactics.
Multiple modes and various mechanics – offering limitless replayability.
Formidable foes – each enemy tests your skills with distinct tactics, demanding strategic precision.
Resource management and upgrades – level up your turrets and drones to handle escalating threats. Optimize your operations with harvesters, minerals and factories to ensure a steady flow of resources and build your ultimate defense.
Command heroes with unique abilities and devastating superweapons to shift the balance of power.
30 levels set across various planets and the mysterious world of Akris – face new obstacles and strategic opportunities in every corner of the galaxy.
Tactical control – command the battlefield from above like a master strategist, or shrink into the action and experience the thrill of a giant's world.
Arsenal of Tactical Possibilities - choose from 25+ various turrets. Take control of movable platforms to adapt your defenses dynamically, deploy devastating superweapons and much more.

title: Backrooms of Reality
description:
게임 정보
Backrooms Of Reality is an atmospheric game with horror elements based on creepypasta /meme Backrooms.
You play the role of a new office worker of some mysterious large company. The strange events of the first day of work take us to the backrooms, the endless corridors on the verge of our reality.


Key Features:

Gameplay: Singleplayer. Mainly a "walking / running simulator". with puzzle and horror elements and a bit of story in the background.

Playing time: approx. 1-2 hours depending on the player.

Enemies: You can meet 2-3 enemies in the game. Some events are scriptable, others are random, so you never know what's lurking around the corner.

Immersive: Atmospheric, photorealistic graphics enhance your horror experience.

Controls: Mouse and keyboard

Saving: The game does not have a save system, but you unlock new chapters (levels) during the gameplay. Once unlocked, you'll be able to access these chapters from the main menu.

Multiple Endings: There are 3 endings (and endless endings if you get lost in backrooms)




Licensing:
Some content relating to the Backrooms is licensed under Creative Commons ShareAlike 3.0 – the base concepts originates from the Backrooms Wiki and Backrooms fandom and its authors. Backrooms Of Reality being partly derived from this content, is released under Creative Commons ShareAlike 3.0 The source files of Unreal Engine 4 and all other third party software are the properties of their respective owners and not released under CC-BY SA. In addition, certain third-party and first-party assets are the properties of their creators and not released under CC-BY SA.

title: World of Stickman Classic RTS
description:
게임 정보

Welcome to World of Stickman, an exciting real-time strategy world where you'll take part in epic battles of antiquity with Stickman heroes. Choose your civilization - Romans, Egyptians or Vikings - and go to war to rule the ancient world.

Game Features:
Epic Battles: Experience the scale of great battles in real time with hundreds of fighting stickmen. Control various types of troops such as swordsmen, pikemen, archers, ballistae and catapults to defeat the enemy.






Take up the challenge and become a great leader in the classic World of Stickman military strategy game. Your strategy will decide the fate of the ancient world!

title: XEARZ
description:
게임 정보
Overview
XEARZ is a side-scrolling action game.
It contains platforming and light Metroidvania-like elements.
The player progresses through stages using melee attacks, subweapons, a variety of guns, and skill.
The main feature of XEARZ is that although it is a side-scrolling game, the map has depth, and you can enjoy attacking, defending, and exploring with the depth of the map by jumping across multiple planes with a single button press.
Story
Humanity has made tremendous progress in the fields of AI and robotics, the results of which have led to the production of highly intelligent androids.
In this new era, ideological conflicts about the relationship between humans and androids have intensified.
Some saw androids as a type of human, recognizing their consciousness and ability to make emotional and ethical decisions,
They were pursuing the possibility of coexistence. The partisans who advocated this view actively embraced technological advances and advocated a cooperative symbiosis between androids and humans.

In contrast, however, there was a faction that viewed androids as mechanical beings and treated them differently from humans.
They pointed out the potential danger that androids equipped with advanced AI posed to humans and argued for the need to limit them in human society.
This faction took a cautious position on the development and use of androids, emphasizing clear boundaries between humans and androids.

The ideological conflict gradually increased tensions and caused political friction.
Threats from enemy nations also added to this complicated situation, and there were reports of various androids infiltrating the country as spies.
The evolution of androids and the accompanying changes in human society were presenting a new dimension in national security.

The government was busy trying to resolve ideological conflicts within the country while promoting stricter control and monitoring of androids.
At the same time, scientists and ethicists were working to establish new frameworks and norms for the coexistence of humans and androids.
The future was moving toward uncharted territory, and many unanswered questions hung in the air about how the fusion of humans and androids would change society.

title: System Purge: Hollow Point
description:
게임 정보
Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a challenging, atmospheric, and action-packed 2D platformer.

HOLLOW POINT
Cloned flesh is no substitute; you’ve saved no one real. Hollow Point continues the story of the first System Purge, adding six new surreal sectors to explore. Survive a litany of new obstacles and monstrous threats as you delve into the System’s very foundations…and beyond.

BEARTRAP MODE
After you've finished Hollow Point, tackle the game’s hardest challenge in Beartrap Mode. Play through an alternate story which remixes and redesigns every level from the original game, adding new obstacles, new secrets, and 4 brutally difficult boss encounters.

SPEEDRUN MODE
Put your skills to the test in 2 new speedrun categories. Jumps, deaths, and uncovered secrets are now tracked during each run.

title: Carbox
description:
게임 정보
Drive. Build. Share. 

Carbox is a Sandbox Driving game
With its easy-to-use and powerful editor, you can let your imagination run wild and create customized maps and races to play and share with other players.
Build your dream city, share it with the community, earn coins and rewards to get more vehicles and content. Drive and compete in an ever-expanding world of custom maps and races.
 
Features

Cars with hand-made designed physics and many different driving styles
World editor to create cities and circuits
Sharing platform to share your maps, and explore other player's cities
Asynchronous multiplayer and leaderboards
Tons of assets to unlock. Make your city unique!
Day-Night cycle
Custom Traffic System
Unlock cars and cities by racing and building

title: Spirebound
description:
게임 정보
Your adventure starts now!
Experience a grand and heartfelt adventure through relaxing gameplay and controls.
Jump, Dash, and Swing your way up the great spire of wishes where you will get your innermost wish fulfilled.
Everyone dreams - everyone needs a helping hand
You are not alone on your way to the top. Other climbers also want to see their wishes realized. Meet this cast of quirky characters, help them and let them help you as you make friends and memories.
A tiny world with lots to do
Collectibles and treasures are hidden all over the tiny island. Some require you to solve puzzles and riddles whereas others test your platforming abilities. As a reward, you can trade your riches for hats and outfits.
For new and seasoned gamers alike
Spirebound is designed with young and inexperienced players in mind. The fixed camera views of the game allow young and inexperienced players to simply pick the game up and have fun. The whole adventure can be played and finished this way.
For more experienced players, we created 'Dream Dares', entirely optional bonus levels, wherein you can put your platforming skills to the test.

title: Another Door
description:
게임 정보
Another Door is a party game combining turn-based roguelike and gambling for an adventure between betrayal and forced friendship. Hide your intentions, bluff your opponents and bet on your luck with the sole purpose of saving your soul…
On your journey, you'll have to face enemies beyond your imagination, but also the decisions of your "allies". Cooperation is one strategy, betrayal is another - it's up to you to make the right choices.
Think carefully before you walk through another door...
Hidden choices, well-guarded intentions: play with up to 4 players online or on the same screen while keeping your choices secret, and only reveal your darkest plans at the very last moment.
Open another door: face the number of cards indicated, collect the reward and end your adventure here, safe in the knowledge that you'll get out alive, or continue, taking all the risks in the hope of obtaining more gems.
A gambling game based on risk management and luck: no need to be the fastest, have the best reflexes, or know how to aim. Only your audacity, your eloquence, and a good dose of luck will serve you here.

title: Hibernaculum
description:
게임 정보
WHAT IS HIBERNACULUM?

Hibernaculum is a retro inspired dungeon crawler that sets out to recreate the engrossing labyrinthine experiences of the classics of days gone by, whilst also building a modern, deeply unique & explorable world of survival, mystery and macabre intrigue.
Hibernaculum is a first person sci-fi/horror role playing game with survival horror roots.
Create a unique character to explore the depths of Hibernaculum & have the experience you want to have. Choices only matter, if they matter to you.
Non-linear gameplay allows for exploration at your own pace, and in your own fashion. Forge ahead and risk calamity or riches. Conversely, pace yourself and avoid harm.
Navigate a decayed industrial realm through environmental storytelling and a unique, brooding atmosphere.
Hibernaculum will be developed in C++ for PC (Windows) & Mac with hopes for porting to iOS & Nintendo Switch.
Hibernaculum will initially be available in English, French, German & Spanish.
Hibernaculum will be released DRM-free & available on Steam & GoG.

Hibernaculum has a sharp focus on exploration and atmosphere with a penchant for allowing the player to discover, uncover, salvage and piece together the mysteries of the Ship whilst emphasising mechanics that allow for emergent gameplay amidst the matrices of survival, combat and character progression.

With a raft of modern conveniences such as an on-screen minimap + waypoints, more aesthetic and navigable maps + hub areas, a more concise and efficient stat/combat system as well as many other UI and quality of life features we hope to make Hibernaculum the most playable, expansive, intriguing and absorbing game of it's type since the heyday of these games; the long forgotten primeval epoch of 1995.

title: School 666
description:
게임 정보
이 끔찍한 끝없는 학교에서 살아남아야 합니다. 끝없는 학교의 이상 현상을 생존하기 위한 올바른 길을 찾아보세요. 극도로 강력한 이상 현상 보스들로부터 탈출하기 위해 머리를 사용하세요. 이 극도로 강력한 차원 뒤에 숨겨진 이야기를 탐험하고... 죽지 마세요.
학교에 다시 오신 것을 환영합니다!
이상 현상을 발견하면 돌아서세요. 당신은 끝없는 학교에서 깨어났습니다. 앞으로 나아갈 길 또는 뒤로 물러날 길을 선택해야 합니다. 잘못된 결정을 내리면 원점으로 돌아갑니다.
유니크한 이상 현상들
무엇이든 이상 현상이 될 수 있습니다. 당신 주위의 모든 의자, 모든 문구류, 심지어 칠판이나 교실 자체도 당신이 예상하지 못한 이상 현상이 될 수 있습니다. 이러한 이상 현상에 의해 두려움에 질리거나 웃음을 터뜨릴 수도 있습니다.

title: Warfare Ultimatum
description:
게임 정보
Warfare Ultimatum은 바다의 깊은 곳에서 우주까지 대규모 전투에 초점을 맞춘 현대적인 FPS/RTS 하이브리드입니다!

저는 이것을 유일한 이성적인 총력전이라고 부르는 것을 좋아합니다. 이것은 SF가 아니며, 로우 폴리도 아니고, 역사적인 세계 대전 시대도 아닙니다.
이것은 현대적인 총력전으로, 현장에 발을 딛고 있으며, 외교도 포함됩니다.
하드코어 시뮬레이션이나 아케이드 게임도 아닙니다. Battlefield와 The Generals 시리즈를 생각해 보세요.
오늘날 우리가 알고 있는 고급 기술 또는 프로토타입 무기가 등장할 것이지만, 그게 우리가 선을 긋는 지점입니다.

FPS/RTS 하이브리드인 만큼, 하이브리드 장르의 일반적인 함정은 개발자가 "왜 우리가 세부 사항에 주의를 기울여야 합니까? 우리는 이미 두 가지 장르를 결합하고 있으니 충분합니다."라고 생각하는 것입니다. 하지만 여기서는 그렇지 않습니다. Warfare Ultimatum은 몰입감과 세부 사항에 관한 것입니다.

참고: 이것은 핵심 게임 플레이 쇼케이스이며, 기술 미리보기입니다. 우리가 염두에 두고 있는 몰입형 영화 경험은 현재 조기 접근 단계에서 전혀 제시되지 않습니다. 게임 플레이가 먼저이고, 시네마틱은 나중입니다.
어디서나 전술 전쟁을 수행하세요!
전쟁은 경계를 모릅니다. 육지, 바다의 표면, 그 깊이, 하늘 또는 우주까지 나타날 수 있습니다!
기술을 충분히 발전시키면 우주에서 적에게 폭탄을 떨어뜨릴 수 있습니다!

전형적인 전장이 아닙니다! 우리 게임을 차별화하는 주요 특징은 "외교 전쟁" 모드입니다.
외교 전쟁
긴 전쟁 게임, 두 개의 군대, 두 명의 지휘관, 평화 시기와 전쟁 시기, 무역 또는 정복, 낮과 밤의 주기, 공격 및 스텔스 미
션을 조정... 그리고 더 많은 것들... 수백 명의 플레이어가 모두 지속적인 서버에서 함께합니다!
역할 놀이와 지휘 체계 옵션이 있습니다.
시대 발전
외교 전쟁의 각 조직 또는 군대는 더 발전된 기술에 접근하기 위해 관심 있는 주제를 연구할 수 있습니다.
AI, 우주, 핵 에너지 등 다양한 주제가 있습니다.
충분한 지식을 얻으면, 귀하의 조직은 기술 시대를 발전시키고 새로운 상위 기술 트리에 대한 접근을 잠금 해제할 수 있는 옵션을 갖게 됩니다.
클래스 기반
6개의 주요 클래스(인원, 엔지니어, 의무병, 폭파 전문가, 저격수, 작업자) 중에서 전쟁에서 자신의 클래스나 직무를 선택하세요. 각 클래스는 고유한 장비, 통계 및 무기를 가지고 있습니다.
깊은 몰입감을 위해 각 유닛/플레이어 캐릭터는 클래스에 의해 영향을 받는 특성과 개인 통계를 가지고 있습니다.
유닛마다 배경도 있으며, 이는 개인 통계에 고려됩니다. 즉, 유닛은 현재 전쟁 이전에 전 외과의사나 전 군인이었을 수 있습니다.
때때로 미래의 이야기로, 거대 기업들이 귀중한 자산을 보호하기 위해 자신의 사병을 배치하기 시작했습니다. 지구의 자원이 점점 더 부족해지고 있기 때문입니다.
일부 기업은 이제 어떤 정부보다도 강력하며, 일부는 자신의 법을 정의하고 자신의 자유로운 주를 지배합니다. 이에 대응하여, 전 세계의 정부들도 이 대규모 사병의 반란을 저지하기 위해 공동의 노력을 기울이고 있습니다.

title: Drunken Rogue
description:
게임 정보

In order to get her hands on a cherished wine collection, rumored to be hidden away by Vampire of Demise Endo, drunken Rogue Lita makes her way to the vampire king's castle. See what story unfolds in this roguelike deck-building game.

To make it to the vampire's castle, you must conquer several dungeons, each with its own traps, terrain, and ferocious demons lying in wait. A frontal assault is simply too reckless. Lita takes advatage of her Wind Cloak while Endo posesses the ability to turn into fog, allowing both to evade the perils of their adventure. However, what you evade only comes back stronger on the next floor. Whether you are prepared to face the inevitable trouble is up to you.

The best part is that the characters in this game get stronger the drunker they become! The only way to step foot into the all-too-risky dungeons is to do so with intoxicated abandon! To top things off, the drunker you become, the less you can tell what's real and what's not, and you may even hallucinate. Your pet dog Odysseus that appears before you may very well be a fiendish demon. Please drink responsibly.

title: YTASH - A Nocturnal Poem
description:
게임 정보
YTASH는 《Nocturnal》 유니버스를 배경으로 한 미니 메트로배니아 게임입니다.
플레이어는 영원한 불꽃을 다루는 대가인 알데시르가 되어 이타쉬 도시와 그 잠들어 있는 기계들을 탐험하며 깨워보세요.
그러나 깊이 잠든 기계들은 쉽게 깨어나지 않으며, 도시를 뒤덮은 어둠은 모든 생명의 불꽃을 삼키려는 존재들을 풀어놓을 것입니다.
게임 특징
빠른 템포의 전진형 전투 시스템을 마스터하여 공격적인 자세를 유지하세요.
불꽃을 지니고, 그것을 삼키려는 모든 존재를 피하세요.
칼날을 사용하여 고대의 기계와 횃불을 다시 점화하고, Ytash를 서서히 깨워보세요.
불꽃 게이지를 채워 강력한 버너아웃 상태를 발동하세요.
잃어버린 시의 조각들을 모아, 스스로를 파괴한 도시의 이야기를 밝혀보세요.
상징적인 기술을 해제하여 플랫폼과 전투 능력을 향상시키세요.
하나의 핵심 개념을 중심으로 한 간결한 모험을 제공하는, 많은 비밀이 숨겨진 작은 섬을 탐험하세요.

title: Onychomp : Lush journey
description:
게임 정보
산을 오르면서 던전을 탐험하세요.
마법의 산을 오르는 동안 프로시저럴 던전을 통해 위험한 여정을 떠나세요. 밤이 끝나기 전에 정상까지 가는 길을 찾으세요.
생물을 물어 먹고 노랑퍼지세요
만나는 모든 생물을 삼키기 위해 탐욕스러운 식욕을 터뜨리세요.
더 높이 올라갈 수 있는 물건을 만드세요

title: DEATHGRIP
description:
게임 정보
DEATHGRIP invites the player to the jump in the pilot's seat of some of the fastest and most lethal hovercrafts ever seen and dominate the tracks they compete on. Navigate natural environments through split paths, twists, turns, jumps, shortcuts, and narrow corridors in an intense race to the finish.

DEATHGRIP introduces a depth to its racing controls that challenges the player to explore the skill ceiling. From afterburner allowed at any time to pitching, rolling, drifting, repairing, managing heat, and firing weapons, one should take pride in their ability to master a racer.

It is an experience meant to be visceral, brutal, exciting, and intense, centered on offering players instant enjoyment without gimmicks and an extended sense of achievement for those competitive and dedicated enough to get the most out of the game.


The base release will include (at a minimum) the following features:

8 Unique Racers
All racers share the same functionality, but each has it's own strengths and weaknesses to suit different playstyles.

10 Distinct Tracks
Race across 10 environments on 10 tracks over terrain filled with obstacles, jumps, drops, shortcuts, multiple paths, and other challenges.

Combat Racing
Race against AI with offensive and defensive armaments. Outfit your racer with cannons, shotguns, missiles, countermeasures, and more. Witness the carnage as the track turns into a battlefield.

Time Trials and leaderboards
Best times across the game are saved as ghosts. Compete against your own times, challenge the ghosts of your friends or compete those of the top ranking players on the leaderboards.


Earn credits from winning and spend them on visual and performance upgrades to suit your playstyle. Choose from multiple parts to spec out your racer for speed,


Prove yourself by winning trophies and claiming tops ranks.

title: Temple of Revi
description:
게임 정보
Revitalize the Nature
Put the Magic Generators in the right place according to their color to restore part of the nature and bring life again to the world.
Travel through different Lands
Meet different places as you progress in your journey, each with a unique aesthetics and characteriscs.
Eradicate the Corruption
Clean the world from the evil and corrupted magic that spread.

title: Superstar Strategy
description:
게임 정보
Lead Your Troops into Battle

Engage in a battle of wits and strategy in this turn-based tactical RPG. Employ the distinctive abilities of each unit and leverage the battlefield's terrain to outsmart your adversaries and assert your dominance!

Exploit the Battlefield Terrain

Manipulate the environment to your advantage – push, pull, teleport, and displace your foes onto traps, inflicting additional damage and status effects between turns. Escape traps before the next round begins to defy fate and evade harm.

Solo Adventures, Cooperative Play, or Versus Challenges

Embark on a solitary journey through the Campaign and Solo Skirmishes, join forces with a friend in Cooperative play to combat menacing monsters, or engage in competitive scenarios and arenas in Versus mode!


Select from 14 distinct unit roles to forge your own army with unique combinations. Each unit class boasts individual skills, playstyles, and synergies. Experiment with diverse combinations to uncover potent combos and force multipliers, enhancing your chances of triumph.


Unleash the power of each player-controlled unit's unique abilities, shaping their playstyle. Launch formidable attacks, rescue allies, intimidate enemies, and set the battlefield ablaze with awe-inspiring powers. Free actions can be seamlessly combined with other abilities for added potency and trickery.

Navigate diverse maps with distinct primary objectives and multiple win conditions. Adapt your strategy on the fly – if defeat seems imminent, shift tactics and aim for an alternative victory to turn the tide of battle!

Order your units' movements strategically, sequencing actions until all have been exhausted for the round. Time your attacks between your opponent's turns to strike precisely when the moment is just right!

title: Echoes of the Stars
description:
게임 정보
■ Stylized action combat ■
Dodge and teleport out of harm's way with high mobility skills. Strategize with on the fly character switching. Move between ranged attacks and AoE magic as an archer or close-range melee combat and flashy quick fire abilities as a battlemage. Customize each character even further with a tech tree and the ability to make your own custom combos!
■ A diverse hand-painted world ■
Lush forests, dank sewers, and the blizzard torn peaks are just a small fraction of the diverse biomes, cultures and locals to discover on your journey. Step inside cozy inns, tea shops, and a variety of stores and houses illuminated by our custom 2d lighting system. You can enter almost all interiors scattered across the world.
■ Mini games and hidden items ■
Become a sandwich artist, race raptors to the finish, or seek out the world’s greatest treasures! With mini games and hidden items sprinkled throughout the world, there is always something new to discover.

title: Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game
description:
게임 정보
Supporting small indie artists, Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game brings players to a cute & whimsical fantasy world where rivalling factions of animal characters fight to uncover fantastical riches!

Gameplay
AT:TCG is played as a 2-player game with both players racing to uncover all of their 8 'Treasure' cards before the opponent does. They can bring in animal characters to help their cause & do battle! Play happens with a pre-built deck of 50 cards and 8 player-chosen Treasure cards. Players are matched up with another player on Steam online, or if no players are available they will play against a CPU. An internet connection is required.

Collections
Show off cards you pull from booster packs or earn through challenges to your friends! AT:TCG uses the Steam Inventory service to manage the cards you own, meaning your collection is in safe hands!

Events
Participate in regular events & prove your might and mettle to earn prizes! Ranked Challenge is the first regular event to reach Arcane Treasures: TCG - seeing players fight to earn the most Ranked Points over an event period - but more will be on the way!

Player Feedback
The development process is heavily rooted in player feedback, with great respect held in the views of the player. By participating in the Discord, you can have your say! But don't just take our word for it, feel free to ask members of the community who have given in feedback!

Supporting Indie Artists
Arcane Treasures and those involved with its development have always been rooted in the indie world, and always will be. Except for placeholder artworks during early development stages (which are steadily being replaced) all artwork is sourced from small, independent artists, and as the game grows it is committed to finding further ways to support independent artists.

If you're an artist and you'd like to get involved, please get in touch through the email attached to the Steam store page.

title: Guns Undarkness
description:
게임 정보
A strategy JRPG helmed by lead developer Shoji Meguro (composer for the Persona and Shin Megami Tensei series’).
Customize your arsenal of unique firearms to dominate the battlefield and forge relationships with your team to bolster your combined abilities during intense turn-based combat.

・A turn-based tactical JRPG inspired by games like Metal Gear Solid and Persona
・A relationship system that boosts the protagonist as you grow closer with your teammates
・A story set in a futuristic world on the verge of global and societal ruin
・A meeting of the minds Shoji Meguro (Persona, Shin Megami Tensei), Ilya Kuvshinov (Ghost in Shell: SAC 2045, The Wonderland), and Lotus Juice (Persona Series)



The year was 2045 and humanity was in a state of abeyance that allowed technology to flourish, but deepened the social divide between the rich and the poor, the Haves and the Have Nots.

Within the ranks of the latter grew a faction who planned the Great Reset–an event steeped in primitivism that would change the course of humanity.

The Thousand Plateaus launched two weapons of mass destruction, triggering a worldwide nuclear war.

And so, the Great Reset was accomplished.

Enter our Protagonist, a rookie member of a private military company tasked with handling the worsening situation.
It is up to you to discover the truth behind love in a world wracked by devastation and whether humanity is capable of being revolutionized.




Guns Undarkness is a futuristic JRPG that combines tactical positioning with turn-based strategy.



On the field, the player will control the Protagonist and up to 3 allies.

Use hand signals to instruct your allies to hide at select spots and then order them to cover you. Once you have the highlighted enemy in your sights, it’s time to open fire!



If your team engages the enemy while totally hidden then you’ll activate an attack bonus. The more you fire during this bonus, the more damage you’ll deal before the battle begins.

Hidden or not, once you fire on the enemy your team will leap into a turn-based battle.



Attacks are basic actions that don’t consume SP, while Skills use SP but pack more punch. Attacking from behind cover? Then unleashing your skills with no cost to your SP!

The affinity of your weapon and that of your target’s TAGS (defense suit) will determine how much damage you deal. Manage to strike your enemy in a weak point and you can deal massive damage, while an enemy’s defense value can also reduce the amount of damage they take.

Hit an enemy’s weak point with a normal attack and you’ll be able to duck into cover. All skills are powerful, but there are also guns with special buff/debuff abilities.





Winning a battle earns your team two types of experience points: Character EXP and Gun EXP. Leveling up boosts a character’s stats and unlocks new skills for guns.






Off the field, you and Alpha Team will spend your downtime outside of missions in the Maroon, an amphibious submarine that the team uses as their hideout. You’ll use the hideout to accept quests or visit shops and other locations on the world map.






You’ll be able to enhance the guns you own by adding parts. You’ll even acquire blueprints and materials that’ll let you build new guns as you progress through the story.




Led by Commander McGovern, the Alpha Team is one of the offensive units that work for BTI, a large American private military group.

The team was originally composed of McGovern, Will and Zach–two men who had been her subordinates back when she was a marine– and Naomi, an advanced combat android. Our story begins with the Alpha Team welcoming in their fifth member – the Protagonist.



The main protagonist, and the player's avatar. After working his way through the ranks of numerous private military groups, he becomes the newest member of the BTI Alpha Team.

Thanks to his exemplary combat ability, he's the only member of Alpha Team kitted out with the latest TAGS equipment -- definitely not something typically gifted to a rookie.




A bright and cheerful 17 year old; she's the only child of the great scientist Dr. Cowen.

Despite her uneasy relationship with her father, she chooses to take over his research in the midst of nuclear war with the hope of creating a brighter future for mankind.




Despite his earnest nature making him seem like a softy, he provides serious support to the Alpha Team when equipped with a shotgun.

He's like a brother to the Protagonist, a former U.S. Marine alongside Zach, and once served under the same superior as Alpha Team Commander McGovern.




A high-performance combat android, she has no problems conveying emotion or communicating with humans.

While Naomi has a gentle, motherly disposition, she’s also a reliable member of the Alpha Team’s offensive, charging across battlefields with her handgun.




A silent mercenary of mystery. In his younger years, he worked as an assassin until General Zhang, leader of the Thousand Plateaus, hired him to do his dirty work. He has superhuman reflexes that he can use to dodge bullets, which are far more powerful than even state-of-the-art TAGS technology.



A far eastern military regime that instigated the nuclear war. Led by General Zhang. In the name of primitivism, the idea of abandoning human technology and returning to the primitive ages, they have set the entire world on a path to ruin. Primitivism gained more and more supporters following the start of the war, until looting and pillaging became rampant across the entire globe. As of now, chaos reigns thanks to them.






DEVASTATED CITY

A city with a some technology left where the wealthy settled after the war, subsequently making it a prime target for the primitivists.




WEST COAST VILLAGE

The poor gathered here after the war and formed a group to fight back against primitivist looters.




RESEARCH FACILITY

A large research city once occupied this area before the war. It was abandoned shortly after, but important research materials still remain in the rubble.




・Shoji Meguro (Persona Series, Shin Megami Tensei Series)
・Ilya Kuvshinov (Ghost in Shell: SAC 2045, The Wonderland)
・Lotus Juice (Persona Series)

title: Casebook 1899 - The Leipzig Murders
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in an industrial metropolis on the threshold of the 20th century and solve four exciting murder cases as Detective Joseph Kreiser.
Casebook 1899 is a classic point-and-click adventure with a few special features. You control detective Joseph Kreiser, who examines objects, questions witnesses and interrogates suspects. You have an inventory of items that you can combine with each other and with the game world, talk to other characters and solve environmental puzzles.

Look for clues
Scrutinise the beautifully hand-pixellated scenes for clues. The scenes are faithful recreations of a German boomtown in the late 19th century and brought to life by handcrafted animations.
Interrogate suspects and witnesses
You will meet many people in your investigations. Are they witnesses? Or are they suspects? You will have to find out by interrogating them. But first you have to get them to talk to you!
Use your notebook
You are recording all your observations and witness statements in your notebook to review at a later time. Each scene has its own page in your notebook to make it easy to find what you're looking for.
Draw your own conclusions
By combining clues in your notebook you unlock new conclusions on your deduction board. Decide for the correct explanation of the facts to find the right culprit between multiple suspects.
Choices matter
Depending on who you decide is the culprit in each of the four cases the games ending changes, making this story truly a test of your deductive skills! A sharp eye and an alert mind are your strongest weapons in the fight against crime.

title: Bittersweet Birthday
description:
게임 정보


You wake up...dazed, and with no memories. As you ask yourself where you are and how you got there, a strange voice breaks through the speaker system offering you a way out. Unstable individuals are hunting you down and it looks like your only chance of escape...is to listen...



Bittersweet Birthday is an action game where every combat encounter is a challenging and unique experience. Learn your enemy's patterns, plan your movements and tear down your opponent in fierce battles that combine Soulslike dodge roll mechanics with bullet hell mayhem.





Outside of battle, uncover the mysteries surrounding your past through exploration and a colorful cast of characters. Complete side quests and discover secret items to unlock Memories that affect your style of combat. Good or bad, use these mementos to lighten the load or add extra challenge to your encounters.

Among the traumas and the broken memories, gather up the pieces of your past and get ready... You've got a birthday party to attend!

title: Arcticide
description:
게임 정보


Procedural levels with diverse biomes, weather, and a day/night cycle.
Survive ruthless mercs, inhuman horrors, and deadly hazards.
Random events including snipers, assassins, bombardments, and supply drops.
Wield a variety of weapons, attachments, devices, and consumables.
A tight resource economy - loot, repair, craft, and pick your battles.
Manage hunger, stamina, and other immersive survival systems.
Horizontally-focused meta-progression.

WATCH YOUR STEP
Navigate and survive dangerous procedural regions in this gritty FPS. Set in a near-future Arctic ravaged by a devastating calamity. Arcticide is a challenging permadeath experience full of unpredictable environments and situations. Resources are scarce, so pick your battles, scavenge carefully, and watch your step. Weapons and equipment have limited durability, so be sure to repair them, replace them, or face the consequences.

Random threats and opportunities abound in every run. Elite soldiers, snipers, aerial barrages, and toxic areas could mean certain death if mishandled. On the other hand, supply caches, printing stations, and helpful locals could tip the scales in your favor.


Finding databanks and surviving deep into runs will provide valuable intel to help you progress. The horizontal meta-progression system allows for unlocking new starting loadouts, potential loot, and crafting recipes. These provide fresh tactical options and tools to play with rather than make the game explicitly easier - to improve your chances of survival, there is no substitute for learning and refining your tactics.

Completed runs also give deeper insight into the events that led to the calamity, and provide clues as to where to search next. Each destination offers unique events, biomes, and enemies.

title: Wish Upon A Llama
description:
게임 정보
Wish Upon A Llama is a cozy, animal-focused RPG for pet lovers! As Llama Town's dedicated rancher, it is your responsibility to provide whole-hearted love and care for your beloved friends.



Take your animals on walks anywhere you go to explore and enjoy the countryside together!
Animals come in various colours, patterns, and personalities. Baby animals will inherit genetic traits from both parents, so you'll need to consider these factors as you breed your animals. Can you discover all 50+ special breeds?
Give gifts to your animals, pet, interact with them and play fetch together!
Find and befriend wild animals in various unique areas such as a procedurally-generated maze-like forest!










Llama Town boasts a diverse population for you to meet! From the aspiring designer to the chill gamer, resilient immigrant, and determined engineer, encounter individuals with unique personalities and intriguing stories. Forge new friendships and perhaps discover romance. Challenge your friends to activities like jump rope, town cleaning, trivia games, spelling bees, and more -- there's never a dull moment in Llama Town!

title: X-MODE
description:
게임 정보
X-Mode is a free-to-play medium paced multiplayer FPS with a variety of different gamemodes to play. Perfect for quick casual games with friends or if you're more hardcore you can grind for the top of the global leaderboard.
KEY FEATURES
Play a variety of different gamemodes:
- Free For All
- Team Deathmatch
- Capture The Flag
- Infection
- Elimination
- Race
- Point Hold
Choose from a selection of ranged and melee items
Level up your player and rise to the top of the global leaderboard
Customize your items and player character to stand out
Unlock all the Steam achievements
ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

title: In The Dragon's Wake
description:
게임 정보

Stranded and alone, you must scavenge resources, craft weapons, build shelters and fight your way through a treacherous open-world environment teeming with monsters, wildlife, forgotten temples, and derelict research facilities.
Beware, you are not the only one exploring this lost land, for a mysterious dragon freely roams the skies and stalks the grounds, and it is never too far away.

ISLAND SURVIVAL

Embark on a relentless quest for survival as you scavenge materials, hunt for food, mine resources, and build your base. Keep your wits about you as a variety of ancient predators also call the island home. Adapt, innovate, and improvise as you strive to overcome the unknown challenges that lie ahead.




CRAFT TOOLS AND WEAPONS

Craft an assortment of tools, equipment and weapons to overcome the island's many obstacles.






Whether it's in the rainforest, swamp, beach or overlooking a vista, your base serves as a vital hub for replenishment, crafting, farming, storage, and defense. Utilize a versatile modular building system to craft your perfect sanctuary, personalizing it to suit you.






Roaming the open skies and stalking the lands, a mysterious Dragon also hunts the island in real-time and will unleash devastation upon the unprepared. Stay alert and always be aware.






Discover the island's mysterious temples and ancient structures, each concealing intricate puzzles and treacherous traps. Navigate through these enigmatic challenges to unlock valuable artifacts and advance your journey through the game. From navigating winding mazes to evading deadly mechanisms, every step forward brings you closer to unraveling the island's secrets and revealing its hidden truths.






Venture through the diverse biomes of the island, each offering its own unique ecosystem and challenges to overcome. From lush forests teeming with life to arid deserts where survival is a constant struggle, the island's biomes provide a rich tapestry of environments to explore. Traverse snowy mountain peaks, murky swamps, and deep caves, each presenting its own set of hazards and rewards.

title: Poke ALL Toads
description:
게임 정보
A light-hearted game about mischief where you guide a band of fairies with a simple goal.


However toads don't like being poked and will not sit idle after the offense. Use the unique abilities of each fairy to get the upper hand or even turn the toads attack into your advantage. Protecting the blue fairy is all you need to worry about.

This is a puzzle game that puts its cartoony art as one of the main protagonists. Watch your fairies run around the world, sleep in inappropriate places, react to the environment or get flung into the air.

The game features over 100 levels in vibrant worlds, each one introducing new mysterious contraptions and tricky toad varieties. Learn how they work through observation and experimentation.

Learning, as well as getting punished by your actions, is part of the fun.

title: Arrows and Antiquity
description:
게임 정보
The ruins of antiquity are overrun with looting bandits and only you can stop them! Set out on a quest, bow in hand, to quickly and accurately remove these raiders once and for all!
Features:
Use your agility and special arrows to earn medals and new weaponry!
Fine-tune your routes and compete for top times on leaderboards!

title: Neuroshima Hex
description:
게임 정보


-Experience a post-apocalyptic world of Neuroshima - a tabletop hit on your own PC !



-Face each other head on, commanding armies of different factions with different strategies and battling for the control of cities and factories.



-Many different units, technologies and special abilities that can be used for an effective strategy.



-Lead army through a hexagonal landscape and attempt to outmaneuver opponents!



-Lot to do in just one turn! - Move units, activate technologies, attack enemy units and deploy new forces!



-Enjoyable mix of strategy and chance as players struggle to outwit each other on their way to victory!

title: AirBoost Airship Knight
description:
게임 정보


◆Game Story
In this declining future world, the surviving people live by excavating resources from ruins.
Over time, a new profession emerged – Airship Knight.
These knights navigate the desolate world in airships, exploring dangerous ruins and engaging in battles.

The story of the game follows the protagonist,
the blonde Airship Knight Dorota, who one day, during a battle in the ruins,
accidentally discovers an amnesiac girl named Agate.
Agate comes from a long-lost civilization, and her appearance is somehow connected to the sudden activation of robots inside the ruins.
This also catches the attention of sky pirates, leading to fierce battles.
Fellow knights from the Airship Knights Association—Rita, Red, and Bell—come to help.

The game features rich levels and exciting battles,
with many stages where companions will join you in the fight!




The game is a side-scrolling action game with different gameplay for each level.
Besides the protagonist Dorota, multiple companions join in the battle, working together to overcome various challenges!







=Planning, Production, Development=:
KO (kkll7952) of FilterGame

=Character Design, Illustrations, CG Art=:
十三十三

title: The Case of Andrew D.
description:
게임 정보
Ever wanted to be a Digital Forensics investigator? Get hired by a small private eye company and become their IT guy, helping solve cases requiring Digital Forensic skills. Your job will be to squeeze as much information as possible from data available in real files - be it in meta data, or just the content. Unzip password protected zip files, locate landmarks, find hints hidden in documents. The Case of Andrew D. follows on the ideas we introduced in The USB Stick Found in The Grass, you will also find it in a way similar to A Normal Lost Phone or Her Story.

Gameplay & content:
- browse the messages posted on the firm bulletin board by other members of the team, see how their investigations develop
- download files they uploaded to the server and analyze them on your computer, using any tools you want
- use the client to upload back or post information you gathered from the files, and see how they help others proceed with the investigations
- learn the narrative - every missing person, every stolen document, every request has its own story and there are often hidden layers

Features:
- an immersive way of introducing the narrative through a client program connecting to the server of a private eye company
- mixture of a real world and alternate reality - stories are placed in real places and require dealing with real files and real world locations
- hidden stories that explore difficult topics

title: CASSETTE BOY
description:
게임 정보
Is the moon still there when I'm not looking at it?
If it isn't...will the people I love disappear if I stop looking at them?



"Do you really believe the moon isn't there when you're not looking at it?" This famous quote attributed to Einstein poses a profound question about quantum mechanics. This game is a puzzle adventure inspired by quantum mechanics, set in a world where things cease to exist when you're not looking at them. Manipulate existence and solve the mysteries of this intriguing world!

About Cassette Boy:
Cassette Boy looks like a 2D game, but its world is actually 3D.
In order to solve its puzzles, you will have to turn and twist the map around, changing the perspective.
Things that you can't see from your perspective, for example because they're hidden behind a wall, stop existing—this is called the "Schrödinger system."
Hide obstacles out of sight and out of mind or reveal secret passages to advance through the game.
Of course, solving puzzles won't be enough. You'll have to pick up weapons and face monsters and bosses as well.
Enemies, puzzles, and more await you in this mysterious world!



The state of matter is only defined once you observe it.
In Cassette Boy's world, what you can't observe doesn't exist. In other words, the only thing that matters is what you can see on the screen.
Yes, even the people you just talked to. They don't exist unless you're observing them.
Flip the world around and bring things in and out of existence.

title: MidEvil

Rewarding combat system with melee, ranged and mounted combat.
PvP and PvE.
NPCs, zombies, bandits and guards.
Companion AI and pets.
Random quest system.
Dismemberment system.
AI guarded, civilized hubs for trading.
Controller support.
Steam Deck compatibility.
Steam achievements.

Future plans include many more additions such as ship building and siege weapons.

The main goal is to test multiplayer performance and stability. We had a lot of fun testing so we thought we'd share it. We welcome any feedback or suggestions.



















Have fun!

title: Dark Auction: Hitler’s Estate
description:
게임 정보
"Dark Auction: Hitler’s Estate"은 본격 미스터리 어드벤처 게임으로, "Another Code" 와 "호텔 더스크의 비밀" 의 스즈키 리카가 원작 및 시나리오를 맡았습니다! 캐릭터 디자인은 "GANGSTA." 의 코스케가, 음악은 "몬스터 헌터 시리즈" 의 코미야마 유우코가 맡았습니다.

◆특징

고성 내를 자유롭게 탐험할 수 있는 3D 맵
키워드로 추리 및 고찰할 수 있는 워드 클라우드 시스템
기억의 진실이 해명되는 경매 파트

◆줄거리
1981년, 독일.
어릴 적, 어머니에게 버려진 기억을 지닌 18세의 노아는,
팔리지 않는 작가로 히틀러 연구에 몰두하는 변인의 아버지 레오나르도와 둘만의 생활을 하고 있습니다.
이상한 연구 등 그만두었으면 하는 노아였지만, 레오나르도는 어떻게 해도 돈이 궁핍하게 되어도, 결코 연구를 그만두지 않습니다.

어느 날 "히틀러와 관련된 물건"이 경매에 출품되는 초대장이 도착하고,
레오나르도는 노아의 반대를 무릅쓰고, 돌아오면 모두를 이야기하겠다는 약속의 말을 남기고, 회장의 고성으로 향합니다.

예정된 날에도 돌아오지 않고 연락이 닿지 않는 아버지를 고성까지 맞이하러 가는 노아.
거기서 노아는 어떤 충격적인 광경을 목격합니다.

그야말로 참가자와 함께 고성에 갇힌 것을 알게 된 노아는,
옥션 기관의 초대를 받아, 이 이상한 경매에 참여하게 됩니다.

title: Mad King Redemption
description:
게임 정보
왕국은 미친 왕에게 함락되었고, 왕은 금지된 마법을 사용해 여왕을 소생시키려 했어요. 하지만 삶과 죽음의 힘이 너무 커서 감당할 수 없었고, 그 결과 왕은 이성을 잃었습니다. 신중하게 버튼을 눌러 적 무리를 처치하세요! 싸움꾼의 역할에 충실하면서 도적의 전략적인 요소가 더해져 왕국의 운명이 여러분의 어깨 위에 놓여 있습니다. 전투 기술, 유물 및 영웅을 잠금 해제하려면 매번 실행 후 영웅의 형제단을 업그레이드하세요.
BEAT'EM'UP 게임플레이
사랑받는 고전 게임에서 영감을 얻어, 저희는 구식 컨트롤과 레트로 감성을 혁신적인 3D 메커니즘과 결합한 비뎀업 경험을 만들었습니다. 4명의 플레이 가능한 캐릭터는 각각 고유한 전투 스타일, 게임플레이에 영향을 주는 커스터마이징 가능한 능력치, 자세한 배경 스토리를 가지고 있습니다. 모든 영웅은 죄를 지었습니다. 그들도 구원이 필요합니다.
로그 엘리트 진행
매번 실행할 때마다 새로운 영웅, 공격 기술, 유물을 잠금 해제하고, 금지된 회랑 깊은 곳으로 모험을 떠나 광기의 왕을 찾아 그의 광기에서 벗어날 수 있도록 하세요. 모든 달리기는 무작위 요소로 구성되어 있습니다. 모든 영웅이 죽거나 미친 왕이 쓰러질 때까지 미친 왕에게 가해진 모든 피해는 같은 런에서 지속되며, 단결된 영웅 형제단만이 미친 왕을 물리칠 수 있습니다. 새로 실행할 때마다 모든 영웅이 다시 태어나지만 미친 왕도 완전한 생명력을 회복합니다.

title: Ascendant Dawn
description:
게임 정보
Ascendant Dawn는 잔혹한 청동기 시대 세계에서 유목 부족을 이끄는 대전략 게임입니다. 평화로운 목동부터 피에 굶주린 약탈자까지 다양한 방식으로 플레이할 수 있습니다. 당신의 부족의 운명은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다; 그들을 영광으로 이끌 것인가 아니면 적의 희생양이 될 것인가. Ascendant Dawn는 국가를 성장시키는 대신 유목 부족을 성장시키는 대전략 장르의 신선한 접근 방식입니다. 시간이 지남에 따라 기술과 전통으로 부족을 개선하십시오.
문화
각각 고유한 수정자와 전통을 가진 수십 가지 문화 중에서 선택하십시오. 또한 다양한 난이도의 다섯 가지 시작 중에서 선택하십시오. 전통을 제정하고 제거하여 문화를 영향을 미치고 다양한 메커니즘과 플레이 스타일을 가능하게 합니다.
세계
Ascendant Dawn의 세계는 청동기 시대를 기반으로 하며 다양한 환경을 특징으로 합니다. 툰드라, 초원, 숲, 산, 사막은 모두 고유한 영향을 미칩니다.
전쟁
문화마다 추가 고유 유닛이 있는 다양한 유닛 유형. 군대를 구축하려면 적절한 자원, 인구 및 심지어 가축이 필요합니다. 지형이 성공에 큰 영향을 미치는 2D 전장에서 군대를 지휘하십시오. 외교와 무역을 사용하여 전쟁이 시작되기 전에 적의 중요한 자원(예: 주석)을 차단하여 승리를 확보하십시오.
정착지
부족으로서 정착지를 설립하거나 정복하여 제국으로의 여정을 시작하십시오. 정착지 관리는 Ascendant Dawn에 완전히 새로운 차원을 추가합니다. 질병과 기근과 같은 함정을 피하면서 건설에 집중하십시오. 정착지의 인구가 증가하고 감소함에 따라 이는 지도에 반영됩니다.
왕조
왕조를 관리하고 성장시키며 위대함으로 이끌어 가십시오. 캐릭터가 죽으면 상속인의 통제를 받습니다. 그러나 가족을 조심하십시오. 그들은 당신을 음모할 수 있습니다.
인구
인구는 가장 귀중한 자원입니다. 인구 시스템은 장기적인 문제를 생각하게 만듭니다. 인구 붕괴와 같은 문제는 항상 존재하는 위협이며 농부를 군인으로 강요하면 식량이 생산되지 않습니다. 인간 인구 외에도 가축 떼를 통제할 수 있습니다.

title: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home
description:
게임 정보
Ever dreamed of being a home owner? Welcome to the Squeakross: Home Squeak Home program!
You just got into a fresh new home for your tiny rodent friend, but… it’s empty! Solve puzzles from the Home Squeak Home Catalog and transform them into splendid furniture and accessories to dress it up!
Relaxing Puzzle Solving: Learn how to play in 5 minutes, and solve logic-numbers puzzles at your rhythm, no time pressure.

title: Backrooms: Step Into The Void
description:
게임 정보
"If you're not careful and you noclip out of reality in the wrong areas, you'll end up in the Backrooms, where it's nothing but the stink of old moist carpet, the madness of mono-yellow, the endless background noise of fluorescent lights at maximum hum-buzz, and approximately six hundred million square miles of randomly segmented empty rooms to be trapped in

"Backrooms: Step Into The Void" is a first-person psychological horror game that thrusts players into the unsettling and disorienting labyrinth of the Backrooms. Combining elements of intense psychological terror with heart-pounding action sequences, the game challenges players to navigate through an eerie, seemingly infinite maze of monotonous yellow rooms and fluorescent-lit hallways. With a focus on atmosphere and immersion, "Backrooms: Step Into The Void" presents a relentless sense of dread, as players must solve puzzles, evade sinister entities, and uncover the mysteries lurking within the void. The game's haunting environment and unpredictable threats ensure a spine-chilling experience that keeps players on edge from start to finish.
Atmosphere

Immerse yourself in the unsettling world of the Backrooms, where each step deepens your descent into a maze of musty, dimly-lit corridors and vast, empty rooms. The oppressive hum of flickering fluorescent lights and the scent of aged carpet create an eerie, claustrophobic environment. Shadows dance at the edge of your vision, and distant noises hint at lurking dangers. Every level blurs reality further, heightening the tension as you strive to escape the horrors stalking you. Can you find your way out, or will you be lost forever in the madness?
Exploration

Navigate through a variety of unique levels inspired by the original Backrooms concept. Explore The Lobby, visit Pipe Dreams, check out Terror Hotel, enjoy Level Fun, immerse yourself in Sublimity and many other delightful locations.
Be careful!

Beware of the lurking horrors that inhabit the Backrooms. As you navigate the endless maze, you must stay vigilant and cautious. Stray from the path, and you risk encountering malevolent entities that stalk the shadows, each more terrifying and relentless than the last. These creatures are drawn to your presence, and a single wrong turn could lead you straight into their grasp. In the Backrooms, danger is ever-present, and survival depends on your wits and awareness.

title: Madam of Malice
description:
게임 정보
