내가 선택할 수 있는 건가? 카드 게임이라니, 흥미롭네. 근데 이 카드에 있는 여자는 누구야? 저택에 있는 도둑처럼 보이는데, 맞지? 좋아, 그래서 내가 뭘 해야 해? 어, 어, 어! 그걸 왜 당겨? 이게 뭐야? 게임판이라고? 좋아, 규칙이나 알려줘, 이 *친 할망구야!

title: Last Words
description:
게임 정보
Last Words is a game of social deception based on the Prisoner’s Dilemma philosophical theory. Are two individuals more likely to work together, or betray the other to make things better for themselves? Stuck in the past (or is it the future?) after your time machine inevitably breaks, you must work together with your fellow imprisoned time traveler to get out. You’ll both profit if you make it out together. But…
What if you betrayed them and seized the loot all for yourself along with a new ride home stranding them? After all, your goal is to amass a collection, not help rival explorers make a greater name for themselves. On the other hand, what if they are preparing to do the exact same thing to you? Can you afford to risk your own survival and a potential partnership?
Work together with the other stuck in time prisoner to escape this predicament.
Unlock perks, consumables, and tricks to synergize on both of your escape plans.
Trust in your sudden ally, prepare for his sudden, but inevitable betrayal, or plot their downfall first before they can even consider it.
[/list]
Customize your time traveler with the aforementioned perks, consumables, and other tricks unlocked in your travel.
Put the spoils of time travel collecting to use by changing your explorer’s appearance and personal hideout.
Flaunt your achievements and shiny accolades, but don’t get too cocky or they might be tempted to try and steal it for themselves.

title: My Cozy Home
description:
게임 정보
꿈에 그리던 집을 짓는 꿈을 꾸어본 적이 있나요? 이 게임은 금전적 투자나 현실의 번거로움 없이 꿈의 집을 짓는 데 필요한 모든 도구를 제공하므로 더 이상 고민하지 마세요.

편안한 사운드트랙을 들으며 수백 가지의 오브제를 사용해 집 안을 원하는 대로 배치해 보세요. 디자인이 마음에 들면 커뮤니티와 자유롭게 공유하세요.
이 게임의 일부 기능은 다음과 같습니다 :-
자유로운 디자인 - 나만의 레이아웃을 디자인하세요. 객실 레이아웃을 자유롭게 선택할 수 있습니다.
가구 배치 - 라이브러리에 있는 가구와 다양한 물건을 배치하여 방을 꾸밀 수 있습니다.
페인팅 - 원하는 대로 벽에 페인트를 칠하거나 가구에 색을 칠하세요.
공유 - 레이아웃이 마음에 들면 커뮤니티, 친구, 가족과 방을 공유할 수 있습니다.
커스터마이징 - 게임에서 날씨, 주변 색상 등을 커스터마이징할 수 있습니다.

title: Skulker
description:
게임 정보
Game Description:
Skulker is an intergalactic-themed casual fishing game that combines elements of fishing exploration and prop collection.
As a player, you will play a Star Hunter "skulker" who doesn't want to work but wants to fish. You will enjoy fishing time on different civilized planets, meet all kinds of alien civilization characters, and understand their world and stories.
In the game, players can match 160 different kinds of fishing equipment, combining different genres of equipment matching effects in different planets, in order to facilitate the decision-making of the current need to explore the attributes, and ultimately smooth collection of the rich catches of various planets, and complete the commission requests sent to you by different characters
Game Features:
Multiple planets with very different styles to experience different interstellar civilizations.
A large number of plot texts and dialogue choices enrich the unique world outlook settings of each planet, allowing players to experience different local customs.
33 different fishing games to show your fishing skills.

title: Greek Tragedy
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Southern Michigan University, your midwestern home for... horror. Explore our hallowed halls, meet new...friends... and discover your inner spirit via our diverse and inclusive assortment of... fraternities. Strange puzzles, spooky chases, and a cultist conspiracy await in this 90s-era survival horror experience. We think you'll agree, there's just something in the air at Southern Michigan University!

STORY
While immersing herself deeply in her creative writing, Amy Chipley suddenly gets an urgent message from Kurt, her boyfriend. The cryptic e-mail implores her to meet up with him at the Student Union Building, and suggests immediate danger.



Locked in the common room with strange, foul-smelling gas seeping in, Amy must do her best to find a way out quickly, else she perishes at the hands of a bloodthirsty cult. Why are there cameras in the dorm rooms? What do these robed fraternity brothers want? And how do ancient gemstones fit into all of this?



Investigate the conspiracy and uncover secrets behind a recent wave of disappearances, rescue Kurt and expose the truth behind it all, or get the hell out as quickly as possible. You’ve still got student loans to pay, after all.

title: Ribby: The Game
description:
게임 정보
DEMO v1 AVAILABLE NOW!

Demo v2 coming... soon?

It's Ribby: The Game! An RPG/Visual Novel hybrid about acceptance, friends, and frogs! Ribbit.

Follow the story of Ribecca "Ribby" Brown, an altruistic frog girl on a journey to get back home - hoping to make some friends along the way and discover things she doesn't yet know about herself.

Looking inward is always a daunting task, especially when you're afraid of what you'll find.

what r they talkin bout...
Warning: This game may make you feel like:

Smiling
Having fun
Telling ALL of your friends about it
Kissing someone right on the mouth

Cover Art & BG by: &

thank you for checking out this goofy little page, and have a great day

-octolivvy

title: Lost Twins II
description:
게임 정보
Lost Twins 2 is an incredibly cute puzzle adventure that will challenge, entertain and maybe even inspire you. Guide Abi and Ben on their journey to find a way back home across a whimsical polygonal playground crafted with an enormous amount of care. Is the mystical Fenghuang leading them home or steering them down a rabbit hole?
Inspired by Miyazaki, the art style merges soft, painterly backgrounds with simplified, memorable characters and fluid animations. Each frame is crafted meticulously with pride - specific lighting techniques, thoughtful composition, and immense attention to detail mean that every single moment you'll spend playing Lost Twins 2 will be a feast for the eyes. The original musical score is atmospheric, soothing, and thematic to complement the art style.



The puzzles in Lost Twins 2 are painstakingly designed, with elegant solutions that make you feel, momentarily, like a genius. They are hard enough to present a challenge but logical enough that you'll be able to solve them within a few attempts. There is a joy to be discovered in every level in Lost Twins 2.

title: Dungeons of the Amber Griffin
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for an exciting journey through the world of the Mystical Kashubia. Learn the beliefs of ancient Pomeranians and deal with the monsters that have begun to roam the area. While defeating the monsters, gather information for a bestiary, based on Kashubian stories.
Bestiary
In cooperation with the Museum of Kashubian and Pomeranian Literature and Music in Wejherowo, we have created a Kashubian fantasy world, unique and unprecedented in cRPG games.
Unique character classes
Create a team of four daredevils with various skills useful in combat. Choose character classes such as, e.g. WÒJÔRZ (Warrior), DULAS (Rogue), ŻÉRCA (Priest), KÙTIN (Mage) and decide on their development.

title: Aboard the Adventure
description:
게임 정보


Aboard the adventure is a humorous adventure game (with capital ADVENTURE!) in which you will be part of the team of the daring Captain Quinn, with the goal of defeating the sinister Professor Weaver in a race to get various ancient and mysterious artifacts that can change the fate of the world.



Intrigue, grave robbers, fisticuffs, NINJAS! Get ready for a roller coaster of thrills and action.
Use poison darts, machetes and whatever else you have on hand to fight your way through your mission to save the world.



You didn't think we were going to leave all the weight on Captain Quinn's shoulders, did you?
Throughout the game you can also control Miguel, the captain's best friend and second in command - out of a crew of two - aboard the SS Adventure. And also Doc: a brilliant academic whose high IQ is only surpassed by her adventurous spirit!

.

With full voice acting and fun dialogue, you'll have a hard time forgetting the many diverse characters that populate the Aboard of Adventure universe. Besides, it won't be all about throwing punches: you'll also have to overcome your personal conflicts, help others and even solve some heart problems!

Travel the world solving puzzles at your own pace and enjoy the pixelated experience that we have lovingly prepared for you.

Come on, go on an adventure! And most of all,

title: Alliance of the Sacred Suns
description:
게임 정보
먼 미래, 인류의 마지막 위대한 제국이 무너지기 직전입니다. 유력 귀족 가문은 부귀영화를 위해 서로 싸우는 반면 제국 시민들은 입에 풀칠하기 위해 분투합니다. 정치적인 긴장 사이에서 선대 황제가 승하하고 플레이어가 황위를 이어받게 됩니다.
황제가 승하하셨다, 황제 폐하 만세
Alliance of the Sacred Suns에서 플레이어는 사회, 정치, 경제적으로 문제가 산적한 성간 제국의 젊은 황제 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 대전략 게임과 RPG 게임을 조합한 이 게임에서 플레이어는 제국의 미래에 영향을 주는 결정을 내리는 동시에 궁정과 제국 귀족 가문을 관리하고 자신의 안위를 담보해야 합니다.


평생을 황제로
황위를 물려받은 젊은 황제는 평생에 걸쳐 제국의 영광을 되찾아야 합니다. 제국의 기반을 무너트리려는 분리주의자들과 황제의 권위를 인정하지 않는 무리를 조심하세요. 제국에는 자신의 목적을 달성하기 위해 수단과 방법을 가리지 않고 황제의 통치를 끝장내려는 이들이 많습니다.

플레이어는 성격, 성장 과정, 장점 등 황제의 배경을 원하는 대로 설정할 수 있습니다. 황제의 출신 가문, 문화, 능력에 따라 제국을 통치하는 동안 겪는 문제를 헤쳐 나가는 방법이 달라집니다.
Alliance of the Sacred Suns에서 플레이어 캐릭터는 나이를 먹으며 시간이 지남에 따라 발생하는 이벤트와 통치 참여도에 따라 건강이 나빠지거나 좋아질 수 있습니다. 턴마다 제한된 행동력이 주어지는데 보통은 행동력을 모두 사용해 다양한 활동을 하기 원하겠지만 턴이 끝날 때 행동력을 일부 남기면 캐릭터가 스트레스를 덜 받으므로 건강 상태가 호전됩니다.


플레이어가 황위에 오르기 몇 세대 전부터 제국은 쇠퇴하고 있었습니다. 강력한 귀족 가문이 등장하고 그들의 힘이 커지면서 중앙 집중적인 황권이 약해졌습니다. 귀족들은 자신이 제국의 위계 질서에서 어느 위치에 있는지 잘 알고 있습니다. 이들은 어느 정도 황제에게 복종하지만 자신이 가진 수단을 동원해 영향력을 발휘하려 할 것입니다.





유력 가문의 수장과 상호작용하든, 자기 가문 사람들과 상호작용하든, 제국 시민들과 상호작용하든 어떤 군주가 될지를 결정할 기회가 많이 주어집니다.




제국이 안에서부터 부패하더라도 정체된 것은 아닙니다. 플레이어는 공중을 맴도는 독수리들에게 보여주기 위해 다양한 방법으로 권위를 투사해야 합니다.



Alliance of the Sacred Suns는 모드를 지원하도록 설계되었습니다. 플레이어는 텍스트와 XML 편집을 통해 게임의 많은 메카닉과 콘텐츠에 액세스할 수 있습니다. 저희는 전 세계 모더들이 저희가 제공하는 우주-정치 프레임워크를 사용해 제작할 콘텐츠를 기대하고 있습니다.

title: Rockbeasts
description:
게임 정보
Witcher 3, Cyberpunk 2077, 그리고 The Blood of Dawnwalker의 각본가가 제작한 어두운 코미디물입니다. Rockbeasts는 MTV와 락 주제곡, 그리고 이상한 머리 모양이 지배했던 시대에 밴드 매니저가 되는 롤플레이 경영 게임입니다.

로큰롤 밴드 매니저

당신은 음악의 세계를 바꿔나가고 있습니다. 당신 밴드의 곡들은 장르를 다시 규정하는 예술 작품입니다. 그러니 창작의 자유를 추구하는 음반사와 계약하셨겠죠? 설마 돈을 추구하기로 한 건 아니겠죠?

성공으로 가는 길은 쉽지 않고, 매니저가 되는 건 복잡한 일입니다. 밴드를 록의 반항아로 만드시겠습니까? 아니면 돈만 쫓게 만드시겠습니까? 선택이 항상 쉬운 건 아닙니다. ROCKBEASTS는 그런지 록과 맹렬한 자본주의, 텔레비전 음악 채널의 시대였던 90년대 미국을 배경으로 합니다.

아침은 커피와 담배로

예전에 어떤 꼬마 하나가 “아저씨도 숙취에 걸리나요?”라고 묻길래, 이렇게 대답했지. “숙취는 술 마시는 걸 멈춰야 찾아오는 거야.
-레미 킬미스터

누군가는 이 부적응자 무리를 추슬러서 공연 준비를 시켜야 합니다. 그게 바로 당신의 역할이죠. 밴드를 확실히 준비시키세요. 밴드에게는 제대로 된 잠재력이 있지만, 당신이 끼니를 챙겨주고, 앰프 작동 여부를 확인하면서 매주 공연에 성공할 수 있도록 도와주는 사람이 되어야만 합니다.

Don’t stop me now

나는 그냥 록 스타가 되지 않겠다. 전설이 될 것이다.
-프레디 머큐리

공연장을 고르고, 세트를 준비하고, 모든 것이 계획대로 흘러가게 만드세요. 성공하면 밴드는 드디어 명성과 영광을 향한 첫 걸음을 내딛을 수 있을지도 모릅니다. 물론 첫 무대는 깜깜한 지하실에서 하게 됐지만, 록의 전설들조차도 시작은 미미하지 않았던가요?

앙코르

당신을 위해 100종의 캐릭터와 90종의 장소를 뽑아두었습니다! Rockbeasts는 미니 앨범이 아니라 2장을 꽉꽉 채워 넣은 LP와 같습니다.
캐릭터 하나하나가 진짜이며, 당신이 내리는 결정은 각각의 캐릭터에게 영향을 미칩니다. 당신의 밴드 구성원은 시간이 지나면서 변하며, 그들과의 관계 역시 변해갑니다.

ROCKBEASTS에서는 매니저로서 어려운 선택을 내려야 합니다. 자신만의 록스타 전설을 써나가세요. 그 이야기는 당신의 결정에 따라 달라질 것입니다.

Baldur’s Gate 3, Cyberpunk 2077, Horizon Zero Dawn, Metaphor ReFantazio, Alan Wake II 등의 게임에 참여했던 성우들이 목소리 출연합니다.

title: Omen Exitio: Hunger
description:
게임 정보
Inside History

The events told in Omen Exitio: Hunger start from real events set then within an extremely accurate historical framework, all draped in a typically Lovecraftian atmosphere.

On February 11, 1927, a little boy named Billy Gaffney mysteriously disappears from his apartment in Brooklyn. The town is turned upside down by the authorities and the many volunteers who try to help, but there is no clue about the little boy. Only your intervention could shed some light on this drama.

Through a cinematic and engaging narrative you will have to exploit your skills as a reporter and your keen powers of observation to search for clues and interrogate suspects. But your talents alone will not be enough.
To get closer and closer to the truth you may have to visit other worlds, interpret your dreams, and sometimes listen to your cat. We still don't know what lies beneath that macabre veil that has dropped over the city, Perhaps nothing but horror awaits us.

Be very careful about the choices you decide to make: your actions are limited, and you will have to make crucial decisions. What will you be willing to sacrifice for the discovery of the truth?
Omen Exitio: Hunger is a story of ordinary people discovering how adventure and horror are inherent in the everyday.



Meticulously scour the locations of the investigation: clues will be crucial to closing the case. The New York of Omen Exitio: Hunger is not the famous one of the Roaring Twenties. Cramped, smelly alleys, labyrinthine junkyards, and decaying houses are just a few of the frightening places where you'll have to apply your reporting skills to gather clues vital to the success of your occult investigation.


Juggling the truths, lies and lucubrations of suspects and witnesses is certainly not for everyone, but it is your only hope.
New interview-based investigative mechanics will allow you to extract all the information you need to continue your investigation of the unknown.
Sometimes you will find yourself disdaining your interlocutors, others empathizing with them, but what you need to pay most attention to is the shadow behind every word.


New York's most famous neighborhoods are the space for adventure. A dark and cold, unforgiving city.
The urban but almost wild environment of these neighborhoods is home to a human fauna of the strangest kind: men and women struggling with their daily lives suddenly interrupted by the inexplicable tragedy you are investigating. You'll have to move through these neighborhoods with your eyes and ears wide open. There are no places that don't deserve your attention, but you won't be able to visit them all either.

title: Catastrophe - Earthquake
description:
게임 정보
In Catastrophe - Earthquake, you control Phe, who, during a visit to her brother, becomes trapped in a condemned building. What was supposed to be a family gathering turns into a desperate fight for survival.
The building is in ruins, earthquakes are shaking everything around, and time is running out. Phe must escape before the collapses and other dangers bring her to a tragic end. Your mission is to find essential survival items such as water, food, and medication, which are scattered throughout the apartment.

title: AutoBlobber
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to AutoBlobber, where your strategic Blob skills will be put to the ultimate test!
In AutoBlobber, strategy is everything. You'll manage your Blob, fighting through countless waves of enemies, and surviving by carefully placing upgrades between each wave. Evolve  your blob with new enchantments and upgrades, and see how many waves you can survive.
Show your skills by climbing the global leaderboard!
Equip Upgrades Between Waves
Unique upgrades with different abilities and target modes
Battle
Battle countless enemies with increasing difficulty per wave.
Combine Upgrades Into Stronger Versions

title: A Paranormal Story
description:
게임 정보
After days of being held captive, you finally manage to escape from your kidnapper. However, the feeling of freedom you should feel evaporates when you realize you have the cell phone of the man who kidnapped you. The right thing to do would be to just wait for the police, but a strange feeling takes over you. There are dark secrets hidden in this cell phone, and YOU NEED TO UNCOVER THESE SECRETS!
A paranormal story is an investigation and suspense game where you must try to understand the past and secrets of the cell phone owner, through old messages, notes and mysterious apps through a fake smartphone interface.
Think twice before anything
During the game, you will have to solve countless puzzles. With each solved puzzle, a new door opens, and you get closer and closer to the truth. But be careful: in A Paranormal Story, you must choose the path that your character will follow, and each decision can influence the final outcome of your story.

title: Your Story: Games with Death
description:
게임 정보
    Your Story: Games with Death는 '선택형 어드벤처' 장르의 인터랙티브 텍스트 퀘스트로, 당신이 이야기의 창작자가 되어 자신의 길을 선택하며, 모든 결정이 위대함으로 이어질 수도 있고 비극으로 끝날 수도 있습니다.
     이 텍스트 퀘스트는 중세 시대를 배경으로 고향 도시를 벗어나 미지의 땅으로 모험을 떠나고자 하는 젊은 모험가의 이야기를 들려줍니다. 그 미지의 땅은 신비와 수수께끼로 가득하며, 치명적인 위험이 도사리고 있습니다.
    운명은 이미 정해져 있고 죽음이 당신을 기다리고 있지만, 이야기를 다시 쓰고 결말을 바꾸어 운명을 바꿀 만한 힘이 당신에게 있을까요? 이곳에서는 모든 것을 바꿀 수 있으며, 어떤 결말이 당신을 기다리고 있는지는 오직 당신만이 알게 될 것입니다. 당신에게는 죽음의 함정을 피하고 자신만의 길을 선택하며, 당신만의 규칙으로 죽음과 한 판 승부를 벌일 기회가 있습니다.
    Your Story: Games with Death는 단순한 어드벤처 게임이 아닙니다. 이는 당신이 그 끝을 결정하는 여정입니다. 이것은 당신이 만들어가는 당신만의 이야기입니다. 당신의 이야기가 영웅적인 서사시가 될지, 아니면 때 이른 죽음으로 끝날지는 전적으로 당신에게 달려있습니다.
    끝없는 발견의 갈증으로 더 나은 삶을 찾아 끝없는 바다를 건너는 모험가의 삶을 살아보세요. 모든 수풀이 치명적인 위험을 숨기고 있을지 모르는 울창한 정글을 탐험하세요. 과거의 그림자들이 살아나고 벽이 잊혀진 비밀을 속삭이는 고대 유적을 헤쳐나가세요. 큰 재산을 모으거나 방랑자의 길을 선택하세요. 이 세계에서 당신의 모든 발걸음은 삶과 죽음의 경계에서 벌이는 게임입니다. 실수를 하면 심연이 당신을 삼켜버릴 것입니다

title: Plush Party
description:
게임 정보
Easy to enter, fun to master controls!
Add style to every game! Customize everything from appearance to accessories, and create your favorite plushie.

title: Lost Host
description:
게임 정보
어느 운명적인 밤, 한 소년이 방에서 신비롭게 사라졌고, 그가 남긴 것은 그가 가장 좋아하던 장난감, 충성스러운 작은 자동차뿐이었습니다. 용감한 장난감 자동차는 주인에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아내기 위해 잊지 못할 모험을 떠납니다.
플레이어로서, 당신은 이 장난감 자동차를 조종해 기발한 퍼즐을 풀고, 까다로운 도전을 극복하며, 소년의 집을 탈출하는 방법을 찾아내야 합니다. 하지만 모험은 여기서 끝나지 않습니다. 자동차는 집 밖으로 나아가, 거리, 공원 등 여러 흥미진진한 장소들을 탐험하며 소년의 실종에 대한 단서를 추적합니다.
외부의 큰 세상은 작은 장난감 자동차에게는 매우 위험합니다. 높은 곳에서 떨어지거나, 불, 물과 같은 위험들이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다. 그리고 적들도 있습니다. 개, 로봇 청소기, 그리고 다른 장난감들이 당신의 길을 막을 것입니다. 하지만 걱정하지 마세요! 게임의 역동적인 물리 엔진 덕분에, 거의 모든 물체를 밀고, 움직이고, 상호작용하며 창의적인 방법으로 장애물을 극복할 수 있습니다.
이 감동적이고 따뜻한 순간들이 가득한 스릴 넘치는 모험은 온 가족이 함께 즐길 수 있는 게임입니다. 소년의 실종에 얽힌 미스터리를 밝혀내세요 — 어쩌면 소년은 당신이 생각하는 것보다 더 많은 도움이 필요할지 모릅니다!

title: Chessplus
description:
게임 정보
Combine. Split. Promote.
Use regular chess moves to merge two pieces onto the same square, creating a powerful hybrid. Move the combined piece using either piece’s abilities, or split them apart later to individual pieces for strategic positioning when the time is right.
But beware, if the combined piece is captured, you'll lose both!
Features
Explore exponentially more strategies by combine pieces into powerful hybrids or split them later for strategic positioning. Need more queens? Create your own with a "Biook" (Bishop + Rook) or rocket a pawn across the board with the "Rawn" (Rook + Pawn) for a quick promotion. 
Balanced Chess at its core, only regular legal moves apply. But be careful if your combined piece is captured - you'll lose them both!
Show off your ELO ranking in PC / Mobile in cross-platform multiplayer and make every move matter in a Roguelike adventure.
How to Play
Use traditional Chess moves to combine your pieces.

title: Mayhem Maidens
description:
게임 정보
"전략 × 귀여운 픽셀 아트! 새로운 로그라이트 타워 디펜스 경험"
The World Bows Down Before My Flames가 타워 디펜스와 로그라이트를 결합한 독특한 게임으로 찾아옵니다! 불꽃 같은 호무라와 다섯 명의 개성 넘치는 캐릭터를 지휘하여 적의 물결을 막아내고, 창의적인 전략으로 당신만의 모험을 만들어 보세요. 매력적인 픽셀 아트와 무궁무진한 커스터마이징 옵션으로 매번 새로운 재미와 도전을 느낄 수 있습니다.
"게임 특징"
최대 5명 캐릭터 동시 조작:
하나의 영웅만 조작하는 것에 만족하지 마세요! 한 번에 5명의 캐릭터를 지휘하며 실시간으로 전술을 바꿔가며 싸우세요. 빠르고, 긴장감 넘치며, 정말 재미있습니다!
꿈의 팀을 구성하세요:
독특한 스킬 조합, 패시브 능력, 그리고 창의적인 빌드를 시도하세요. 강력한 탱커, 번개처럼 빠른 공격수, 또는 균형 잡힌 완벽한 팀을 만드는 것은 전적으로 당신의 선택에 달려 있습니다!
끝없는 리플레이 가능성:
매번 새로운 선택과 도전으로 가득 찬 게임! 랜덤으로 스킬을 해제하며 적을 압도하는 완벽한 팀을 만들어 보세요. 순수한 승리의 쾌감을 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: NO EXIT
description:
게임 정보
No Exit is small chapter based indie horror game. You'll have to face challenging enemies, and perhaps make some allies, to escape this crooked dimension that you're trapped in. 
Jump from place to place. Escape or fight. Even though some of them thought your fate is sealed, you can prove them wrong... 

Find the Exit.
Designed for casual horror fans, it offers a spooky atmosphere with plenty of casual scares. Players can expect intense boss encounters with dynamic visuals and cool music, along with a story that unfolds gradually. With each chapter, the game will challenge you with grander events and much more difficult challenges. Can you survive long enough, to learn the truth?
You and your friend have always been the best urban explorers in town, seeking out abandoned places and uncovering their secrets. Your latest target was an old, forsaken warehouse rumored to be haunted. However, while you were away on vacation, your friend’s curiosity got the better of him. Unable to wait, he ventured in alone, and now he’s missing. Determined to find him, you enter the decaying warehouse, only to realize that it’s not just an empty building. Now, you find yourself in a twisted pocket dimension, with strange creatures constantly trying to find and kill you. Can you escape?

title: Chertovica
description:
게임 정보
체르토비카는 근접 전투에 중점을 둔 다크 판타지 부머슈팅 게임입니다.
릴리스가 당신을 영원한 잠에서 깨웠습니다. 악마가 세상을 뒤덮고 있으며, 여러분은 악마를 막아야 할 사람입니다. 빛을 선택하여 성기사가 되시겠습니까, 아니면 어둠을 선택하여 뱀파이어 군주의 힘을 얻으시겠습니까?
검을 뽑고 권총을 장전하여 이 세상을 지옥으로 바꾸려는 빙의된 전직 인간, 디보젠키, 광포한 늑대 및 기타 해충을 처치하세요.
반쯤 무너진 벽 뒤에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견하세요. 절망의 어두운 지하 묘지나 마지막 안식처로 여겨졌던 오래된 수도원 부지를 탐험해 보세요. 악마의 침공으로 인한 짙은 분위기를 경험하세요. 하지만 공포는 지옥에서 오는 것일까요, 아니면 공포인 여러분이 지옥으로 오는 것일까요?

title: Animas
description:
게임 정보
베네수엘라 산악 지대의 기묘한 저택을 탐험하라. 모든 방마다 수십 년의 비극이 메아리친다. 당신은 블랑코 가문의 어두운 역사 뒤에 숨진 진실을 찾아 왔지만… 이 저택은 다른 계획을 품고 있다. 여기서 과거와 현재가 충돌하며, 사이비 의식과 세대를 저주한 선택이 드러난다.
과거를 파헤쳐라
시간의 메아리: 시간으로 갈라진 저택을 탐험하라. 1970년대의 평화로움에서 쇠퇴한 현재까지, 각 단계가 과거의 공포를 드러낸다.
독특한 공포, 현지의 영혼: 『Animas: 원령』 은 베네수엘라 민속과 심리적 공포를 엮는다. 고대 신앙부터 현대 도시전설까지, 비디오게임에서 보기 드문 공포의 면모를 경험하라.
압도적인 분위기: 생생한 3D 오디오와 불안한 분위기로 현실과 악몽의 경계가 무너진다. 이건 당신의 생각인가… 아니면 저택인가?
진정한 목소리, 글로벌 접근
전문 라틴 아메리카 스페인어 더빙으로 『Animas: 원령』 의 독특한 문화적 배경에 완전히 몰입하세요. 이 악몽의 세부 사항을 놓치지 않도록, 모든 대화와 텍스트는 한국어 자막이 제공되며, 영어, 포르투갈어, 중국어, 일본어, 러시아어로도 지원됩니다.

title: 史莱狗
description:
게임 정보
Slimg chased by space pirates, is forced to land on a mysterious planet. In order to leave this planet, Slimg began his adventure on this planet
Explore
The SR400 planet has a total of four regions with completely different styles.
Sdog village: The creatures in sdog village love pumpkins, and there is a mysterious ability in the village that allows other creatures to freely grow and shrink.

title: Tabletop Tavern
description:
게임 정보
테이블탑 태번: 지휘하고, 정복하고, 반복하라

테이블탑 태번에 빠져보세요. 실시간 전략과 로그라이크가 결합된 게임으로, 모든 전투는 주사위 던지기이며 모든 승리는 직접 쟁취해야 합니다. 혼돈의 탁상 전장에서 용병들을 이끌고, 다양한 전사들을 모집해 무자비한 고블린 무리에 맞서 전설을 만들어 보세요. 무한한 조합, 가혹한 선택, 끝없는 재플레이 가능성을 갖춘 이 게임은 로그라이크 팬을 위한 완벽한 RTS 혼돈입니다.
주요 특징:
실시간 전투: 탁상에서 펼쳐지는 역동적인 전투에서 부대를 지휘하며, 모든 움직임이 중요합니다.
팀 모집: 독특한 기술, 개성, 이야기를 가진 다양한 용병들을 모아 팀을 구성하세요.
로그라이크 요소: 매 플레이가 독특합니다. 강력한 장비를 찾아 독창적인 빌드를 만들고, 예측 불가능한 환경에서 살아남기 위해 적응하세요.
무리와 대결: 당신을 파괴하려는 결심을 한 사나운 고블린 군대를 속이고 싸우세요.

title: From Basement with Love
description:
게임 정보
From Basement with Love is a 2D adventure game that combines elements of point & click puzzles and a visual novel.

As a spy in a foreign country during the Cold War era, you are given a dangerous mission to unravel secret military operations aimed against the national security of your homeland.


A small basement room serves both as your living space and as the center of your undercover operations.

Your desk is equipped with the equipment that allows you to intercept and decipher enemy's communication.

title: City Garden Harvest
description:
게임 정보
The world changed after a challenging energy transition. You work remotely as a programmer on an important project. The stressful job doesn't help your anxiety, and your salary barely covers the rent. Everything changes the day a small packet of seeds is mistakenly delivered to you. 
Grow flowers, berries, and vegetables right in your home. Sell your harvest profitably to the Cooperative, buy cooking devices, and create dishes from your homegrown produce!
Renovate
Decorate your home with interior items however you like, and turn your apartment into a green utopia. You can relax and grow plants for comfort or dedicate your entire apartment to industrial-scale tomato farming.For designing your apartment, you will have dozens of various designer interior items at your disposal.
Farm
Take care of your plants—water, fertilize, transplant, and, of course, harvest them! The game features soil chemistry simulation, and all plants and fruits go through several distinct growth and ripening phases.
Cook
Learn recipes and prepare healthy, organic meals right at home! Sell them at the market for a hefty profit—such food is worth its weight in gold in the world of the future. At your disposal are a stove, oven, mortar, and food processor, allowing you to create over 50 dishes!
Plan
Use your time wisely—in City Garden Harvest, time flows faster when you're working with plants, and there’s never enough time for everything.
Chill
Learn to balance work and life—earn money by coding and unwind by caring for plants. Spend your earnings to expand your home farm!
Vibe
Enjoy the music—we’ve composed 11 beautiful tracks perfectly suited to various farming activities.

title: Little Chef 2
description:
게임 정보
Little Chef 2 invites you back into the kitchen for a delightful cooking adventure filled with cozy vibes and whimsical fun! Whether you're a seasoned chef or just here for the laughs, this adorable sequel brings joy to every dish you create!
PHYSICS BASED
Enjoy physics-based interactions as you unleash your creativity across a variety of kitchens and charming settings. Grab ingredients and objects from the scene and toss them around at your will.
OVER 150 UNIQUE DISHES
No matter what you end up cooking, a huge variety of possible dishes make every ingredient count and allow you to throw anything into the pot!
CUTE & HIDDEN INTERACTIONS
company: Julien Truebiger, Hello Erika, Danny van Duist

title: Sweep City
description:
게임 정보
Jump into your street sweeper and master the satisfying art of cleaning, from fallen leaves to forgotten treasures.
Get behind the wheel of your trusty sweeper and keep the neighborhoods tidy. Every shift brings something new - you never know what you might find hidden beneath the debris.
Relax and unwind in the atmospheric world of Sweep City.
Features:
Satisfying driving and street cleaning mechanics
Endless streets to explore with procedural generation
Discover hidden treasures as you sweep
Turn collected materials and rare finds into sweeper upgrades
Cruise to your own tunes with the built-in media player
Coming Soon:
Interactive Twitch integration
New environments to explore
Dynamic weather system

title: Reflections of the void
description:
게임 정보
너는 결코 나갈 수 없는 집의 수호자이다. 매일 네 태블릿에 나타나는 지시를 따르며 살아간다. 그 지시를 어길 수도 있고, 아마 뭔가 변할지도 모른다. 결정은 네 손에 달려 있다. 하지만 그렇게 하기 전에 잘 생각해 보길 권한다. 네 선택은 너의 삶뿐만 아니라 다른 것들에도 영향을 미친다.
너의 임무는 살아남는 것이다. 그러나 아무도 너를 쫓아오지 않고, 자연적인 원인으로 죽지도 않는다. 믿어라, 너는 이 세상의 수수께끼를 풀기 전까지 수없이 죽을 수 있다.
특징:
이것은 단 두 사람에 의해 만들어진 게임입니다.
완전한 자유로운 행동: 어떤 문을 열지, 어떤 캐릭터와 더 자주 상호작용할지 스스로 선택할 수 있습니다. (당신은 좋아하는 캐릭터를 선택할 수도 있습니다, 그게 무엇을 의미하든지).
선택의 영향: 당신의 모든 선택은 현재의 대화뿐만 아니라 이후의 사건에도 영향을 미칩니다. 또한, 당신의 선택은 당신 자신이나 게임 내 다른 캐릭터의 죽음을 초래할 수 있습니다. 이곳에는 불사의 존재는 없습니다.
세밀하게 구축된 세계: 종말 이후의 우주는 처음 봤을 때보다 훨씬 더 넓고 깊습니다. 가장 세심한 플레이어들은 'Reflections of the Void'라는 어두운, 놀랍고 잔혹한 세계를 발견하게 될 것입니다. 생존하는 것만이 진정으로 사는 것은 아닙니다.
사랑 이야기: 게임 내에 사랑 이야기가 있지만, 모든 사람이 그 복잡하고 다소 이상한 (혹은 미친?) 여자를 사로잡을 수는 없습니다. 우선 그녀의 생각을 이해해야 합니다. 왜 그녀는 특정 방식으로 행동할까요? 아마도 모든 것이 그렇게 명확하지 않을 수도 있습니다.
의미적 깊이: 어떤 이들은 그저 어두운 이야기로 볼 수도 있고, 다른 이들은 그 사건들의 철학적 의미를 발견하고, 삶과 죽음, 사랑의 모든 형태, 생존의 대가에 대해 질문을 던질 수 있습니다. 어떤 이들에게는 이야기의 심리적 측면이 가장 중요할 수도 있습니다. 그리고 모든 사람은 옳습니다. 이 게임은 그 이야기의 배경이 되는 세계처럼 다면적이고 복잡한 경험을 제공합니다.

title: Infinite Rails
description:
게임 정보
Explore an Infinite World
Dive into a procedurally generated world with endless possibilities. Every region you explore offers unique landscapes, resources, and challenges. From rolling plains to rugged mountains, adapt your rail-building strategy to conquer any terrain. Discover new stations and routes as you expand your network. No two worlds are ever the same, ensuring a fresh experience every time you play.
Lay Tracks
Design and build your dream railway with intuitive track-laying tools. Connect stations across vast distances and create efficient routes to optimize transportation. Strategize your track placement to avoid obstacles and minimize travel times. Experiment with complex track layouts, including junctions, loops, and switches. Watch your rail system come to life as trains follow your carefully constructed network.
Terraform
Take control of the land to suit your railway-building needs. Carve trough terrain, and bridge rivers to create the ultimate routes. Use advanced tools to shape the environment and overcome natural barriers. Turn rugged terrain into a smooth path for your trains to travel. In , the world bends to your vision.

title: Dyping Escape
description:
게임 정보
"I want you to play this typing game.
Just type the keys as instructed.
There's no need to think at all."
The horror typing game "Dyping", played over 250,000 times, has received a massive upgrade and is now officially released.
Now back with infinitely more despair.
A Dying-Typing Game
The ominous "Eyes" present you with disturbing typing prompts.
The words you type become reality and come back to haunt you.
"Please kill me." If you type this sentence, you die. Game over.
Break the Game From the Outside
The game is filled with unavoidable, unfair deaths.
Once the sinister text appears, it seems like your only choice is to type it and march toward your demise.
...But perhaps, you can still open the "Settings Screen."
Roguelike Typing
As the game progresses, the deaths imposed by the Eyes grow increasingly unreasonable.
However, if you obtain "fragments"—cards that allow you to alter words and letters—you can fight back against its malice.
Use the ever-changing fragments in each playthrough to defeat the Eyes!

title: Kiosk Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Kiosk Simulator is an action-packed comedic take on the hustles of running a big city kiosk and the nostalgia of reaching that lone open kiosk on a rainy late night.
Roleplay
Take on the role of a kiosk’s owner in Cologne, Germany.
Restock, serve customers, maintain and protect your kiosk against robbery and vandalism!
Vibrant Cast and Dynamic Gameplay
Each customer could be a loyal customer, a potential shoplifter or even a troublemaker!
Difficulty Curve
Tougher antagonists/bosses might take away your hard-earned cash - so be prepared for a challenge!

title: Algolemeth
description:
게임 정보
Create AI and Conquer the Dungeon.
Algolemeth is a dungeon RPG where you send golems equipped with program into a dungeon for fully automated exploration.
Challenge the Dungeon through Trial and Error!
As an alchemist, players create autonomously operating golems, forming parties to undertake automatic dungeon conquests. Once the golems are dispatched into the dungeon, all you can do is watch. Analyze enemy actions, iterate through trial and error, and aim to conquer the dungeon!
Bring Back Parts and Strengthen Your Golems!
Various enhancement parts can be found in the dungeon. Among them are those that directly increase the golem's physical abilities and modules that allow for new action logic. Create your own unique golems with the parts you acquire!

title: Horse Racing Manager
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of horse racing and construct a remarkable rags-to-riches narrative. Start as a humble stablehand and ascend the industry by establishing your very own horse racing stable. This dynamic game offers freedom and deep simulation.
Diverse Career Paths
Start your journey by honing your skills in established stables, mastering the intricacies of the sport. As you accumulate the necessary resources, seize the opportunity to establish your very own stable.
Breed the Next Champion with the Pseudo-DNA Feature
Delve into the complexities of horse genetics and breeding, aiming to produce the ultimate racing superstar with our life mimicking Pseudo-DNA feature.
Tailor Your Horse's Training and Nutrition
Fine-tune your horse's journey to greatness with personalized training and dietary choices. Decide whether to amplify its natural speed or develop its stamina for endurance races. Every decision impacts its performance, sculpting a unique path to the winner's circle.
Step into the saddle and either watch your horse's performance from the sidelines or take direct control during the race, making split-second decisions that could lead to victory. Embark on a journey, progressing from racing on obscure back alley tracks to competing on the global stage for substantial prize money.
Hire team of professionals, including jockeys, head trainers, trainers, veterinarians, farriers, stablehands, and even landscapers.
Invest in your stable's facilities to provide top-notch training and care for your horses.
Keep a vigilant eye on your financial resources, managing your budget to ensure the sustainability and growth of your stable.
Remain up-to-date with a comprehensive news system that delivers the latest updates on races, competitors, and industry developments.

Forge your destiny in the heart-pounding realm of horse racing, where your choices and strategies will determine your path to glory. Can you lead your stable to victory and become a true legend in the world of equestrian sports? The journey begins now.

title: Moonshot
description:
게임 정보

Embark on an unprecedented journey in Moonshot, a game that masterfully blends survival and tycoon elements within the thrilling setting of space colonization. Set in the year 2027, where private global entities have ignited a new space race for resource acquisition, you are at the forefront of this interstellar venture.

Your Mission: Begin by constructing your very own rocket, assembling a skilled team, and making history as the first astronaut to set foot on the Moon since 1969. What will you encounter in this alien landscape? How will you adapt to the hostile environment that awaits?

Moonshot's Realism: Experience space exploration in the near future, where the technology is grounded in today's reality or in advanced prototype stages. Forget star gates or teleportation - this is a journey akin to what real astronauts will soon undertake (hopefully)!




















Add to Wishlist: Support us in creating this unique experience by adding Moonshot to your wishlist now!

title: The Tragedy at Deer Creek
description:
게임 정보
In the winter of 1997, photographer Charlotte Gray ventures into the remote woods of Alaska, to the derelict logging camp at Deer Creek, in order to complete her project 'Abandoned Alaska.'
Having photographed ghost towns throughout the Midwest, Charlotte expects to find the worn remains of a piece of American labor history, but what she finds is a place that seems to be eerily frozen in time, harboring numerous secrets sleeping deep beneath the Alaskan snow.
Bit by bit, she finds fragments from the lives of the people who once lived here. Piecing together the fragments, Charlotte slowly starts to unravel the tragedy that befell Deer Creek and its people.
'The Tragedy at Deer Creek' is a narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game that tells a mournful tale of family, loss, and loyalty, exploring the lengths we are willing to go to protect the ones we love.

title: Punk Juice
description:
게임 정보


Join a band with two crass, potty-mouthed punks, Ricki and Max. What else do you have going on Tuesday nights? Curate your style, endure the trials and tribulations of public transit, and play dead-end gigs! Go on mediocre dates, thrift with your besties, buy overpriced coffee, and complain about the cost of rent in this Seattle-inspired grungy city. Punk Juice invites you to recreate your life… Only worse!
WHAT KIND OF PUNK ARE YOU?

Fully customize your character from their hair to their socks! Your punk reflects whatever inner rebel lies within you. Stay up to date with the latest fashions, shop for "new" clothes at the thrift store, and befriend new styles from your friends.
PLAY DEAD-END GIGS

Unravel an overarching narrative where every decision you make decides your fate. Play rhythm mini games to make a name for yourself in the music scene, be it rivals, friends, or new connections. Go on adventures with your bandmates to build your friendships and unlock extra pieces of the story.

Check out every nook and cranny that makes up the unique neighborhoods in Punk Juice. You'll find new places, quests, and friends in every hot spot.

Who knows what relationships blossom on your adventure? Will you make new friends, keep it casual, or flirt with the enemy...

title: 100 Cats Greece
description:
게임 정보
100 CATS 그리스 - 최고의 숨겨진 고양이 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

이곳에는 그리스에 숨어있는 100마리의 고양이가 있습니다! 찾아가세요!
특징

😻 100 마리의 숨은 고양이
😸 진짜 고양이 소리
⌛️ 타이머 모드

title: FSA DRIVING
description:
게임 정보
In FSA Driving, you will become a super courier in the fictional city of Nijnait, navigating the streets and alleys in various high-performance vehicles. Make strategic use of the city's terrain and items, showcasing stunt driving skills to complete thrilling delivery challenges and savor a unique driving experience.

Explore a rich and entertaining open world
Embark on a journey through Nijnait, inspired by the city of Tianjin in China. Speed through bustling urban areas and vast wild outskirts, collecting items, engaging in various mini-games, and experiencing interactive elements integrated into the map.

Unique stunt abilities
Beyond regular driving, master challenging maneuvers such as blade overtaking, water gliding, and airborne gliding—actions that are hard to achieve in real life.

Simulated management elements
Conduct goods trading in specialty shops located across different areas of the city. Buy low, sell high, and race against fluctuating price curves.

Character development aspects
Manage resources such as energy, hunger, and restroom needs, as these values will impact your missions. Restore these values by interacting with various buildings on the map. Enhance your abilities gradually by increasing your driving and stunt proficiency throughout the game.

title: Subversive Memories
description:
게임 정보
Synopsis
Renata has been haunted her entire life by a void within. She needs to find answers that fill the gaps of her past.
She follows a promising track to an abandoned military research base. However, she soon finds out that this place holds secrets beyond her comprehension and that her obsession might cost her a price she can't pay.
About the game
Subversive Memories is set in a fictitious Brazil during the military dictatorship that took place from 1964 to 1985. It talks about the horrors of being oppressed by those who should protect us and the memories of the victims of a ruthless authoritarian regime that kidnapped, censored and killed thousands of people.

title: Ascendant Dawn
description:
게임 정보
Ascendant Dawn는 잔혹한 청동기 시대 세계에서 유목 부족을 이끄는 대전략 게임입니다. 평화로운 목동부터 피에 굶주린 약탈자까지 다양한 방식으로 플레이할 수 있습니다. 당신의 부족의 운명은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다; 그들을 영광으로 이끌 것인가 아니면 적의 희생양이 될 것인가. Ascendant Dawn는 국가를 성장시키는 대신 유목 부족을 성장시키는 대전략 장르의 신선한 접근 방식입니다. 시간이 지남에 따라 기술과 전통으로 부족을 개선하십시오.
문화
각각 고유한 수정자와 전통을 가진 수십 가지 문화 중에서 선택하십시오. 또한 다양한 난이도의 다섯 가지 시작 중에서 선택하십시오. 전통을 제정하고 제거하여 문화를 영향을 미치고 다양한 메커니즘과 플레이 스타일을 가능하게 합니다.
세계
Ascendant Dawn의 세계는 청동기 시대를 기반으로 하며 다양한 환경을 특징으로 합니다. 툰드라, 초원, 숲, 산, 사막은 모두 고유한 영향을 미칩니다.
전쟁
문화마다 추가 고유 유닛이 있는 다양한 유닛 유형. 군대를 구축하려면 적절한 자원, 인구 및 심지어 가축이 필요합니다. 지형이 성공에 큰 영향을 미치는 2D 전장에서 군대를 지휘하십시오. 외교와 무역을 사용하여 전쟁이 시작되기 전에 적의 중요한 자원(예: 주석)을 차단하여 승리를 확보하십시오.
정착지
부족으로서 정착지를 설립하거나 정복하여 제국으로의 여정을 시작하십시오. 정착지 관리는 Ascendant Dawn에 완전히 새로운 차원을 추가합니다. 질병과 기근과 같은 함정을 피하면서 건설에 집중하십시오. 정착지의 인구가 증가하고 감소함에 따라 이는 지도에 반영됩니다.
왕조
왕조를 관리하고 성장시키며 위대함으로 이끌어 가십시오. 캐릭터가 죽으면 상속인의 통제를 받습니다. 그러나 가족을 조심하십시오. 그들은 당신을 음모할 수 있습니다.
인구
인구는 가장 귀중한 자원입니다. 인구 시스템은 장기적인 문제를 생각하게 만듭니다. 인구 붕괴와 같은 문제는 항상 존재하는 위협이며 농부를 군인으로 강요하면 식량이 생산되지 않습니다. 인간 인구 외에도 가축 떼를 통제할 수 있습니다.
계절

title: Crucible of the Forgotten
description:
게임 정보
Overcome a series of challenging stages in this roguelite horde survival game by developing your power with autocasting spells across many different dimensions, including items, upgrades, talents, and more that interact with each other to produce many unique and powerful builds.
SURVIVE, EXPLORE, and ASCEND TO POWER
Crucible of the Forgotten combines the simple moment-to-moment tactical gameplay of horde survival roguelites with the depth of build crafting found in classic ARPGs and strategic evolution of the player character over a much shorter period of time.
You will rapidly gain power through your choices, defining your build as you progress through the stages in the game, with sessions taking anywhere from 10 minutes to several hours.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR BUILD

title: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home
description:
게임 정보
Ever dreamed of being a home owner? Welcome to the Squeakross: Home Squeak Home program!
You just got into a fresh new home for your tiny rodent friend, but… it’s empty! Solve puzzles from the Home Squeak Home Catalog and transform them into splendid furniture and accessories to dress it up!
Relaxing Puzzle Solving: Learn how to play in 5 minutes, and solve logic-numbers puzzles at your rhythm, no time pressure.
Scared of puzzles? Worry not! Your rodent friend is here to help. Customize your game experience: Toggle hints, Solve a random cell, or use the brand new Logic-Assist system that lets you preview possible solutions!
No assistance needed? You can disable all those options if you prefer to be challenged.
Our Home Squeak Home catalog features many different styles of interior decor, from basic housing supplies to extravagant ones to match a broad range of tastes. You will also find many accessories to dress your rodent friend.
Aaah… The joy of seeing a Squeakross puzzle transform into a beautiful object is so satisfying!
Shape your rodent to your liking in the world's first (we think??). From snout to tail, decide what kind of friend you want to have by your side!

title: Million Depth
description:
게임 정보
Million Depth is a "deep-diving action strategy game" where Moma, a human girl from outer space, visits Earth to find her only friend, and dives into the million-floor deep underground world known as Million Depth.
As Moma, players will have to design and craft their own original weapons and engage in strategic time-freezing battles to survive the hostile environment of Naraka Akasha in order to reach the bottom and uncover the true identity of Moma's elusive friend.
To Moma, left drifting all alone in space, messaging her Earth friend was the only thing that kept her going.
After all of her dearest crewmates died from a virus, the only thing to do was the daily aptitude test.
But as long as Moma could imagine the scenery of Earth as described by her friend, she managed to live through the boredom and solitude of life on the ship.

title: Disco Samurai
description:
게임 정보
개요
디스코 사무라이는 펜실베이니아의 사이버펑크 도시 디스코를 배경으로 한 독특한 리듬 전투 게임입니다. 공격, 방어, 대시 및 기타 능력을 음악의 비트에 맞춰 부드럽게 결합하여 당신의 기술을 시험해보세요. 법과 규칙이 없는 세상에서, 검을 마스터한 자만이 영광과 번영을 누릴 자격이 있습니다. 상상 이상의 음모에 휘말린 반항적인 학생 폭스가 되어, 볼륨을 높이고 신스웨이브와 록의 전율적인 사운드스케이프의 리듬을 잡고, 미니멀리스트 디오라마 아레나를 통해 싸워 나가세요!
상세 정보
전투
디스코 사무라이에서는 당신과 적의 행동이 음악의 비트에 맞춰 동기화됩니다. 사무라이로서 적을 존중해야 합니다 – 적의 공격 지표에 주의를 기울이고, 패리, 블록, 회피를 번갈아 사용하여 적을 지치게 해야 합니다. 주저하지 말고 주도권을 잡아 공격하거나, 적을 환경적 위험 요소로 차서 추가 피해를 입히는 등의 특수 능력을 사용하세요. 비트를 놓치면 당신은 죽은 목숨입니다 – 하지만 레벨은 짧으니 다시 시도하는 데 몇 초밖에 걸리지 않습니다.

보스 전투
복잡한 공격 패턴을 가진 매우 위험한 보스들과 맞서 싸우세요. 각 보스는 자신만의 독특한 노래에 맞춰 공격 패턴이 동기화되어 있어, 각 싸움에 개인적인 터치를 더합니다.

맞춤 음악
레벨을 완료한 후, 게임에 로드한 맞춤 음악으로 다시 플레이할 수 있습니다.
스토리
세상은 디스코 사무라이에 미쳐 있습니다 – 사이버펑크 메타버스인 디스코를 배경으로 한 게임입니다. 모든 사람이 이 게임을 하고 있습니다 – 당신의 이웃, 당신의 상사, 아마도 당신이 가장 싫어하는 정치인까지도요. 사람들은 가상 부동산, 자동차, 디자이너 옷을 구매할 뿐만 아니라 심지어 보험까지 가입하고 있습니다! 미친 소리 같나요? 저에게 말해보세요 – 게임이 출시된 이후로 세계 범죄율이 77% 이상 감소했습니다! 사소한 범죄로 감옥에 썩느니, 디스코에서 악명 높은 현상금 사냥꾼이 되어 아무런 결과 없이 활동하는 게 낫지 않겠어요?

이 이야기는 건축과 미술 분야에서 이름을 날리고 싶은 반항적인 학생 폭스를 따라갑니다. 가상 반달리즘과 픽셀 피를 흘리는 것이 강의를 듣는 것보다 그녀의 스타일에 더 맞기 때문에, 디스코 세계는 ""브루탈리즘""의 새로운 정의를 배우게 될 것입니다.

title: Sticker Kittens
description:
게임 정보


스티커 새끼 고양이(Sticker Kittens)는 새끼 고양이를 맞춰야 하는 스도쿠 같은 퍼즐입니다. 새끼 고양이를 키우고 함께 노는 방법도 배울 수 있어요!

title: Alpine Lake
description:
게임 정보
If you're a fan of Stardew Valley, The Sims, or Animal Crossing, Alpine Lake is the perfect cozy getaway for you.



Shape your inn from the ground up by designing and constructing buildings entirely from scratch. Your imagination sets the limits – create any layout you can envision!



Every guest arrives with their own personality and narrative. Extend a warm welcome, provide them a cozy haven, and unravel the stories they carry within.



Embark on a journey through an expansive alpine region, uncovering hidden treasures and valuable resources. Bring along your faithful canine companion for a hike and see what buried goodies you might unearth along the way!



Engage with a lively community of townspeople, each with their own unique stories. Support your neighbors by sending your guests to local businesses, adding to the collective growth of the town.



Cultivate your own farm to harvest top-notch ingredients, ensuring delightful meals for your guests. Enhance your culinary expertise by upgrading your kitchen and mastering an expanding assortment of recipes acquired on your journey! You may even build, decorate, and open your restaurant on your property for the best eating experience you can provide for your guests!



Lose yourself in one of the many relaxing activities, such as fishing, photography, and crafting.

title: 17.waves TD
description:
게임 정보
온라인 코옵 타워 디펜스
외행성 W4-V35의 17개 콜로니가 공격받고 있습니다! 17.waves에서 전부 살아남을 수 있을까요?
최대 4명의 친구들과 온라인에서 모여 몰려오는 외계인 무리들로부터 기지를 지키십시오.
협력을 통해 코인과 자원을 모으고 타워를 만들어 유지해야 합니다.
콜로니 수호
[b]외계인의 습격[/b] -- 외계인 벌레들이 기지를 습격합니다! 놈들의 습격 경로를 학습하고 방어 계획을 세우십시오.
[b]타워 제작[/b] -- 다양한 유형의 타워 중에 원하는 타워를 선택해 가장 효율적인 방식으로 배치하십시오.
협력이 중요합니다
내 역할 찾기 -- 7가지 특징적인 업그레이드 중 하나를 이용해 각 팀원을 특화시키십시오. 플릿 풋, 로드 로드, 오버클록과 같이 서로 다른 특징이 있습니다!
[b]자원 채굴[/b] -- 타워는 에너지를 소모하므로 계속 충전해줘야 합니다. 자원을 모아 타워에 주입해 계속 가동하도록 해야 합니다.

title: Let's bounce! Popsicle boy!
description:
게임 정보


Let's bounce! Popsicle boy! is a casual rogue-like game with mechanics inspired by Breakout. When you defeat cute enemies or break bricks, you can obtain powerful weapons. Seize the opportunity to gain greater combat benefits!
Gameplay:
Unique collision combat system based on the rules of "Breakout"!
Randomly configured level layout brings you a different experience in every game!
Unlock characters with different attributes and special skills!
Thirty attribute/skill upgrade cards provide powerful support for every challenge!
Defeat randomly appearing enemies and BOSS, and unlock rich game achievements!

title: Wildlife Rescue Simulator
description:
게임 정보
야생동물 구조 시뮬레이터에서 여러분은 모험가이자 수의사입니다. 당신의 임무는 인간이 만든 재난으로부터 야생 동물을 구하는 것입니다. 외딴 곳에 갇힌 동물에 대한 조난 메시지를 받으면 헬기에 탑승하여 동물을 구출하기 위해 비행합니다.



바다표범은 종종 어선의 희생양이 됩니다. 그들은 어망에 걸리고 있습니다. 그들을 돕기 위해 남극으로 날아가야합니다. 물개를 잡는 것은 어렵고 동물을 발로 차는 끈을 자르는 것은 더 어렵습니다. 그러나 당신이 그것을 관리 할 때 물개는 당신의 도움에 영원히 감사 할 것입니다.



동물과 풍경 사진을 찍어 구조 임무를 문서화해야 합니다.



기지에 도착하면 사진을 최대한 활용하기 위해 사진을 편집하고 충성도 높은 팔로워 커뮤니티에 게시합니다.



사람들은 여러분의 작품을 좋아하고 여러분의 사진에 엄청난 댓글을 달며 많은 사람들이 그 대의를 위해 돈을 기부합니다. 기부금을 사용하여 장비를 업그레이드하여 더 멀리 비행하고 더 많은 동물을 도울 수 있습니다.

위시리스트에 추가하여 이 게임의 개발을 지원해 주세요.

title: Sleeping Forest
description:
게임 정보
Hey there, fearless adventurers! Welcome to the wild bunch that is "Sleeping Forest"!

👉 Assemble Your Dream Team:
Imagine this: you're the hotshot leader of the "Sleeping Forest" mercenary group, and your team is as dynamic as a wizard at a disco. But guess what? It's not just these four legends; no sir, you're gonna be recruiting mercenaries along the way! Build your dream squad, and watch it grow like a happy garden of destruction.

🤔 No Room for the Faint of Heart:
Get ready to make decisions that'll make your granny blush! In the heat of battle, one wrong move, and BAM! Perma-death's knocking on your door. Every choice matters, but hey, that's what makes victory taste so sweet. Will you rise to the challenge or crumble like a cookie under pressure?

🌎 Fantasy World Extravaganza:
We're not in Kansas anymore—say hello to a medieval-fantasy mashup that's weirder than ... well its weird, trust me! Explore magical lands, encounter quirky creatures, and unlock the secrets of this world inspired by the coolest parts of our own history.

💘 Love in the Air (and Maybe Some Arrows):
Who said mercenaries can't catch feelings? Amidst the chaos, expect a dash of romance to spice up the battlefield. Forge bonds, make choices, and maybe, just maybe, find love in the weirdest places. Love and war, they say – let’s see if you can conquer both!

🕵️‍♀️ Puzzles and Investigations, Oh My!:
It's not all hack and slash – put that brain to work! Solve puzzles, unravel mysteries, and outsmart your enemies. It's like being a detective in armor, and trust us, nothing says "victory" like outwitting your foes.

👬 Party Time with Pals:
Grab your buds because "Sleeping Forest" supports local couch co-op multiplayer! Team up, laugh together, and probably argue over battle strategies. It's a party, and everyone's invited to this medieval-fantasy fiesta!

🏆 Buddy, Are You Up for the Challenge?:
So, ready to dive into "Sleeping Forest" and create your own legend? It's not just a game; it's a rollicking adventure filled with laughs, tears, and a sprinkle of magic. Gather your wits, recruit your squad, and let's turn this fantasy world upside down!

Adventure awaits, my friend. Let's make history together!

title: Cookie
description:
게임 정보
Cookie is an engaging idle game where players step into the role of a skilled baker, producing both ingredients and delicious cookies. These items can either be sold on a dynamic online marketplace to other players or used directly to bake even more tempting cookies. With each transaction, market prices fluctuate, creating a constant rise and fall in value.

When you sell your last batch of flour right before the prices crash...
Players have the power to influence the economy by strategically buying or selling to maximize their profits. Through clever trading and efficient management, they can dominate the market and expand their cookie empire. The cycle of production, sales, and market influence creates an immersive, interactive world where every decision can shift the balance of the marketplace.

title: TORSO TENNIS
description:
게임 정보
Enter the world of TORSO TENNIS: a sports-like roguelike. DRAFT and GRAFT to perfect your TORSO and win the season.
WISHLIST TO BECOME A TENNIS GOD
FEATURES
High-intensity grid-based multi-ball tennis gameplay.
Upgrade & Win. Level up your LIMBS, get perma-boosts from TATTOOS, and YOINK limbs from your defeated opponents.
Tons of builds. Find new limb + tattoo combinations that absolutely wreck your foes and break the game.

title: Block Factory
description:
게임 정보
Creativity meets production in Block Factory, an automation game with a clear purpose: building sets of captivating 3D figurines. Design and optimize your factory to efficiently produce and assemble toy blocks into finished figurines. Analyze blueprints and meticulously plan your assembly lines, orchestrating the production of blocks.
Build specialized machines that streamline the gathering and transformation process, shaping blocks into charming figurines. Create intricate assembly lines to stack, glue, and assemble hundreds of blocks, bringing your models to life! Optimize and enhance every step of the journey to ensure your enchanting figurines.

title: Fatal Claw
description:
게임 정보
현대인들의 기술로 다시 눈뜬 멸망한 고대 왕국
웅장한 지하세계, 난폭한 감염체, 봉인되어버린 출구, 생명을 기록하는 돌, 고대인과 현대인들이 뒤섞여 사는 FatalClaw의 세상은 미스터리 그 자체입니다.
모든 것을 포기한듯한 이 지하 세상 한편에서 선조들의 도움으로 부활한 의문의 고양이 "키샤"와 함께 생존자들을 구출하고 서로 유기적으로 연결된 방대한 고대 유적, 위험천만한 지형을 탐험하며 오염체들로 부터 흡수한 능력을 활용해 지하 세상의 미스터리를 풀고 사건의 진실을 밝히세요.
"키샤"와 당신의 여정 끝에 지상의 빛이 함께 하기를 염원합니다.

진정한 모험
서로 유기적으로 연결된 독특하고 개성 넘치는 각각의 지역은 여러분을 진정한 탐험의 세계로 인도합니다.
비선형으로 디자인된 맵을 통해 정해진 길이 아닌 다양한 방식으로 탐색하며 자신만의 서사를 써내려가 보세요.
수많은 장애물과 함정 때로는 강력한 오염체들을 만나게 될지도 모르지만 당신이 어디로 향하든 그 길 끝에서 의미를 발견하게 될 것입니다.
이 모험의 결말은 플레이어의 선택에 달렸습니다. 자신이 추구하는 가치를 따르고 이루어내세요.
스타일리시한 액션과 중독적인 전투
돌진하고 뛰어넘고 할퀴고 내려찍고 "키샤"의 변이 능력을 개방시키고 활용해 강력한 오염체들을 처치하세요.

title: House Builder 2
description:
게임 정보
하우스 빌더 2: 꿈의 집을 만드세요

House Builder 2에서는 생동감 넘치는 로우 폴리 오픈 월드에서 친구와 함께 또는 혼자서 꿈의 건축물을 건설할 수 있습니다! 궁극의 협동 건설 모험에서 작업에 필요한 자재를 구입하고 짐을 싣고 다음 작업을 향해 달려가세요!
주요 기능
🛠️ 작업 준비 중

장비를 갖추고 준비하세요. 모든 작업은 올바른 도구와 계획으로 시작됩니다! 먼저, 다음 건설에 필요한 것이 무엇인지 살펴봐야 합니다. 동네 창고에 가서 사서 트럭에 싣습니다.

🚚 출근

늦지 마세요. 그렇지 않으면 탑승을 놓칠 수 있습니다. 짐을 싣고 출발하여 모든 것이 제대로 전달되었는지 확인하세요. 현장에서는 작업에 앞서 공사에 필요한 모든 자재를 내려야 합니다.

👷‍♂️👷‍♀️

친구들과 함께 꿈의 집을 짓는 것이 더 재미있어요! 새로운 협동 모드에서 동료 빌더와 팀을 이루어 프로젝트에 대해 협업하고, 리소스를 공유하고, 함께 디자인할 수 있습니다. 아늑한 별장을 짓든, 장엄한 저택을 짓든, 팀워크로 꿈을 실현해 보세요!

🏡

평화롭고 조용한 것을 선호하시나요? 시간을 갖고 긴장을 풀고 모든 챌린지를 혼자서 완료하세요.

🌍

가능성이 가득한 광활한 오픈 월드에서 창의력을 마음껏 발휘해 보세요. 그것을 탐색하고, 일하고 싶은 장소를 찾고, 일을 시작하세요. 광활한 풍경이 당신의 캔버스입니다. 원하는 대로 모양을 만들어보세요!

🔨

더욱 정밀하고 제어할 수 있는 고급 메커니즘을 통해 한 차원 높은 건축 시뮬레이션을 경험해 보세요. 다양한 도구와 재료를 활용하여 미적으로 아름답고 구조적으로 건전한 주택을 건설하세요. 도전적인 임무를 수행하고, 건축 계약을 완료하고, 진행하면서 새로운 도구와 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하세요. House Builder 2는 건설과 탐색에 대한 참여와 동기를 유지하는 역동적인 게임플레이 경험을 제공합니다.

🌈
풍부하고 생동감 넘치는 색상이 모든 세부 사항을 생생하게 표현하는 시각적으로 매혹적인 세계에 빠져보세요. House Builder 2는 무성한 풍경부터 복잡한 인테리어까지 눈을 즐겁게 하여 모든 건축 프로젝트가 독특하고 아름답게 느껴지도록 합니다.

House Builder 2와 함께 일생일대의 건축 모험을 시작할 준비를 하세요. 노련한 건축가이든 초보 건축업자이든 여기에는 모두를 위한 무언가가 있습니다. 오늘부터 도구를 들고 꿈의 집을 만들어보세요!

title: The Demons Told Me to Make This Game
description:
게임 정보
The Demons Told Me to Make This Game is a time-looping, Lovecraftian narrative adventure about horrifying monsters and the humans who are even worse.
You play as Dark Wisp, a disembodied spirit summoned to guide a crew of amateur exorcists through a demonic invasion of a Midwestern town. Unable to interact with the physical world, you’ll rely on your powers instead:
Possession — take over one exorcist at a time, whispering thoughts into their minds.
Time Manipulation — Rewind time to change the outcome of events.
Just one problem — your hosts aren’t exactly thrilled to hear a voice in their heads. As you make them relive the same events again and again, they’ll resist and rebel. You’ll have to experiment — and make them do unspeakable things — to find out what’s happening in Red Hives and have everyone survive to tell the tale.
TDTMTMTG revolves around solving a series of time loops. Your goal is to ensure all hosts survive every segment of the loop.
Loops are broken down into time segments — small chunks to help you experiment with their interconnected events. In each segment, you’ll choose which host to possess and follow. Others are left to their own devices and will often make impressively bad decisions. Hosts don’t remember the events of past loops (but they slowly start growing suspicions).
autokwd: The Demons Told Me to Make This Game

title: SimplePlanes 2
description:
게임 정보
The ultimate successor to the beloved SimplePlanes! If you loved the creative freedom of the original, then get ready to take things to the next level in SimplePlanes 2.
EASY FOR NEWCOMERS, FAMILIAR FOR VETERANS
Whether you're a seasoned SimplePlanes builder or jumping in fresh, SimplePlanes 2 caters to you!

Intuitive Building: Snap parts together to create planes, cars, boats – let your imagination soar!
Download Community Crafts: If you don't fancy building, then download community made crafts and jump straight into the action.
Helpful Tutorials: Master the game quickly, no matter your experience level.
Familiar, Yet Improved Designer: We've enhanced the building experience while keeping it true to what you loved in the original.
EVERYTHING YOU LOVED – AMPLIFIED!
Everything players love about the first game is cranked up to the max in SimplePlanes 2. More parts, more environments, more features. More of what you want!

Enhanced Parts: Get ready for the new, highly customizable curved wing system, procedural jet engines, targeting pod, laser-guided bombs and rockets, underwater parts, aircraft textures, new and improved fuselages, and so much more.
New Environments to Explore: We've added the largest island yet where you can discover new cities, airports, and it's jam packed with exciting new challenges.
Multiplayer Mayhem: The most-requested feature is finally here! Fly and fight with friends, tackle challenges together, or just relax and explore the world.
Introducing Major Chad: He's your new in-game pilot, bringing fresh gameplay mechanics and a whole new personality to the world of SimplePlanes.
Improved Environmental Effects: Experience a richer atmosphere with volumetric clouds and fog, enhanced terrain textures, and a stunning new water system featuring waves and underwater effects.
Backwards compatibility: Fly your SimplePlanes 1 crafts in SimplePlanes 2 with no fuss, no extra work, no shenanigans. Breathe new life into them by upgrading them with new parts and textures.*

*

title: BrokenLore: FOLLOW
description:
게임 정보
사회 현상의 어두운 면을 파헤치는 연작극 BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW의 프리퀄, FOLLOW의 매혹적인 세계로 들어서십시오.
FOLLOW는 괴로운 과거와 끊임없이 쫓아오는 내면의 악마에 시달리는 젊은 여성 앤에 대한 강렬한 심리 1인칭 공포 게임입니다.

title: Sealed Bite: Extended
description:
게임 정보


Emilia's family members start mysteriously vanishing, whisked away one-by-one as if by magic. Setting off to search the world for any traces of them, she is unceremoniously forced to do bidding of an ancient wolf spirit. Is the power Emilia gains from it free to be made her own? Are the spirits her allies, or is she being led astray? And is she even looking in the right place?

Embark on a fairytale metroidvania-style platforming adventure in pursuit of power, memories and truth!



Explore the beautifully handcrafted pixel-art world, from autumn forests to frigid mountain tops, caves, castles and more!
Hone your abilities as the memories of your lost family members come back, one by one - or prove you don't need "medicine" to persevere!



Features:




This, and more awaits you in the world both ethereal and unforgiving!

title: Become the Moon
description:
게임 정보
달이 되다 은 Feldspar Games에서 개발한 독특한 덱빌딩 오토배틀러 게임입니다. 망가진 마법과 이상한 존재들로 가득한 혼돈의 세계를 탐험하며 새로운 우주적 경지에 오르세요.
하수인, 주문, 유물을 조합해 고유의 덱을 만드세요. 라운드마다 새로운 카드를 선택해 무기를 강화하고, 강력한 시너지를 구축하고, 하수인에게 이로운 효과를 부여할 수 있습니다. 강력한 유물을 수집해 덱을 증강하고 별을 향해 도약하세요!

title: The Run: Got Next
description:
게임 정보
The Run: Got Next is a fast-paced, full court, 3v3 basketball game that celebrates all of street hoops culture worldwide. Play solo online or squad up to stack wins and become the G.O.A.T.

Get in the Game
This is not a simulation. The Run is easy to pick up and play, fast, fluid and above all else, fun. Signature dunks, monster blocks, sweet handles, tricks, logo 3s, alley oops and more – we’re bringing our own flavor to gameplay focused on style and substance, while remaining grounded in street hoops.

Bring Your Best Three & Hold Court
Build out your squad from an ever-evolving roster of diverse, larger-than-life, legendary street ballers, each with towering strengths and weaknesses that require you to really think about how you set your lineups.

Multiplayer Meets Roguelike
Staying on the court takes more than just a great jumper -- there's levels to this. With court conditions, strategic modifiers and drops impacting every game and new players coming in to stop your streak, every Run is unique.

A Handcrafted Hoops Experience
Play on some of the most legendary courts across the world with a uniquely stylized look and feel. From our characters to the courts, hand-keyed animations and everything in between, experience a truly handcrafted sports game for the first time ever.

Who’s Next?

title: Into The Craft
description:
게임 정보
Into the Craft is an Open World survival game, where you will create your own place.

Whenever you do an activity, you level up a profession. Develop your character, to unlock more crafting recipes and become better at everyday work!

You can engage in a variety of activities such as:

- Gathering

- Farming

- Tame and raise animals

- Cooking

- Build a small village

- Exploration

- Craft at workstations

- Trade with villagers

- Fight and loot the enemy Camps

and much more!

Gain experience points in categories like Mining, Lumber, Weaponsmith, Armorsmith, Alchemy, Building, Fighting and Jewelcraft. Level them up by doing tasks in the game world, to unlock new recipes, be able to gather better resources, or fight more dangeorus foes!

title: Grocery Store Tycoon
description:
게임 정보

Grocery Store Tycoon에서는 사용자가 1인칭 시점에서 주인이 되어 플레이할 수 있으며, 자유로운 카메라 이동으로 상점을 관리할 수도 있습니다.


가장 빠른 계산원의 속도에 도전하거나 단순히 급여를 지불하고 싶지 않다면 직접 계산대를 운영해보세요. 긴 대기 시간과 불만 고객을 피하려면 최대한 빠르게 스와이프하세요.


한 번에 한 케이스씩 창고에서 선반으로 운반하거나 카트를 사용하여 대량으로 운반하세요.


계산대, 선반, 냉장고, 냉동고, 농산물 선반, 쇼핑 카트 보관소, 쇼핑 바구니 스탠드, 물류 장비 및 장식품과 같은 배치 가능한 물품을 구매하세요.


고객 통계, 상품의 공급과 수요, 가격 조정, 배치 가능한 물품의 상태 확인, 직원 관리를 통해 상점을 관리할 수 있는 인터랙티브 UI.


경험치를 통해 아이템 유형, 배치 가능한 물품, 관리 도구, 직원 고용 능력, 상점 확장 및 다른 상점 구매 기회를 잠금 해제하세요. 이는 수동적으로, 일하며 또는 보너스 목표를 완료하면서 얻을 수 있습니다.


배치 가능한 물품을 유지 관리하고, 카트와 바구니를 반환하며, 상점을 깨끗하게 유지하여 상점을 최대한으로 운영하세요.


직원을 관리하여 그들이 행복할 수 있도록 하세요, 그렇지 않으면 그들이 그만둘 수 있습니다! 직원이 원하는 업무에 배치하고, 원하는 급여를 제공하며, 과로시키지 않는 것이 직원의 행복에 기여합니다. 믿을 수 없는 직원은 연락을 취하고 당신의 행복에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.


고객을 만족시켜 좋은 리뷰를 받고 상점이 좋은 평판을 유지하도록 하세요. 그들이 찾는 상품을 갖추고, 가능한 한 짧은 시간 안에 상점에서 머물게 하며, 카리스마 있는 직원이 계산대 뒤에 있는 것이 고객의 만족에 기여합니다.
[/img>

title: Mohrta
description:
게임 정보
Explore a unique FPS game unlike any other
Mohrta is a tempered and atmospheric FPS adventure, where you delve into unique and bizarre dimensions, fight gnarly creatures, and defeat deific bosses. Tackle these areas and bosses in any order that you choose, build and upgrade your arsenal to suit your playstyle, and uncover a hidden truth behind the events of the game’s story.
Game Features
Play through the game's five enormous and differently-themed dimensions in any order you choose.
Soak in the otherworldly atmosphere and lovingly-crafted level design.
Fight though a myriad of highly-detailed environments that push the limits of GZDoom.
Explore unusual settings, characters, and enemies fleshed out in beautiful signature Scumhead detail, featuring designs by Osiol.
Acquire a huge roster of weapons, each with multiple functions and utility.
Upgrade your equipment to defeat greater challenges.
Over 50 diverse enemies and 20 challenging boss fights to dodge, shoot, and strike through.
Befriend a huge cast of strange and loveable NPCs, each with their own quests and storylines.

The Great Strange- a zone in which supernatural phenomena occur at an abnormal rate, where echoes of other worlds and ethereal beings converge and contort reality.

A special military group known as "The Hayward" was formed to investigate and destroy the anomalies within The Strange. For years, the Hayward had done an admirable job of monitoring, handling, and reverse-engineering elements of the Great Strange into their work. Among these Hayward operatives is where your remains found new life.

You are Hayward Generation VII 81363-7, a corpse swathed in iron and arcane. Though a newer model, you are no guest to the Strange and a formidable veteran of its wilds.

Recently, the Great Strange has begun to rapidly expand- its phenomena intensifying to an unseen degree. Current leads suggest the involvement of Hayward Generation I "Avlan", whose disappearance synchronizes with the Strange’s sudden proliferation.

Mission Objective: Enter the mining village of Kozanoda where Avlan was last spotted and apprehend the missing Gen I.

Use of lethal force is authorized. Use of paranormal apparatus is authorized. Exercise extreme caution when confronting Avlan. Minimize injuries to civilians and infrastructure. Attempt capture where possible. Mission subject may be terminated if need be.

title: Panic Delivery
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Panic Delivery!
Oh, how exciting! Welcome to Panic Delivery, the most wonderful (and mandatory) job opportunity for hardworking humans like you! ✨
Here at Panic Delivery, we care about efficiency—and what better way to prove your worth than by braving the treacherous streets of our beautiful monster-ruled world? That’s right! As a freshly recruited delivery agent, you’ll get the once-in-a-lifetime chance to bring important (and totally safe!) packages to our esteemed, very hungry clientele.
But don’t worry! You won’t be alone—grab up to three other delivery units and work together in this thrilling 4-player online cooperative horror/comedy experience! And remember: a happy customer is a returning customer… or at least, what's left of them! 💀📦
So put on that uniform, grab those packages, and start running—we promise you won’t get lost… but your limbs might!.
Key Features

title: Kill All Lice
description:
게임 정보
Feeling the urge to scratch your head? Discover KAL, Guild Studio's miracle product to help you get rid of lice!
With its joystick-powered formula, control Captain Soepp or Lieutenant Xam'Pu and face off against the hordes of Lous the First, king of lice, in an epic solo or co-op adventure.
Dive into a captivating universe where frantic action meets zany humor. "Kill All Lice" takes you to the scalps of Eloise and her family in an epic battle to eradicate an epidemic of fearsome critters. Take the helm as Captain Soepp and Lieutenant Xam'Pu, two heroes determined to fight the invasion. Whether you choose to play solo or team up with a friend, prepare for an experience that will be... completely wacky!

title: Bogdan's Cross
description:
게임 정보
Bogdan's Cross is an action-adventure game set in the tumultuous era of the Crusades. Follow the journey of Bogdan, a humble shepherd boy, as he rises to become a legendary Templar knight. Traverse stunning landscapes, uncover hidden tales and mysteries, and confront shadows of doubt and despair. While grounded in historical accuracy, the game takes creative liberties to weave a captivating fictional narrative.

Key Features:

Immersive Storytelling:
Dive into a richly woven narrative that captures the essence of the medieval period. Follow Bogdan's transformation from a humble shepherd to a revered Templar knight. Experience his internal struggles and moments of faith, redemption, and transformation as you navigate through an epic story filled with unexpected twists and profound themes.



Historical Figures and Settings:
Bogdan's Cross brings history to life by incorporating real historical figures and meticulously recreated settings from the medieval era. Encounter legendary Templar knights, interact with notable figures from the Crusades, and explore medieval towns, castles, and battlefields. While the game takes creative liberties to enhance the story, the attention to historical detail ensures an authentic experience that immerses players in the past.




Embark on a journey across diverse and beautifully rendered landscapes. From the rolling hills of the countryside to the bustling streets of medieval cities, each environment is meticulously crafted to provide a sense of wonder and discovery. Uncover hidden secrets, solve environmental puzzles, and find valuable treasures that enhance your abilities and deepen the story. The open-world design encourages exploration, allowing players to venture off the beaten path and uncover the rich history of the Templar Order.




Engage in intense and visceral close-quarters combat that captures the brutality and skill of knightly battles. Face a wide range of enemies, including sinister dark entities and strange, otherworldly creatures that lurk in the shadows. Each encounter is a test of your combat prowess, requiring quick reflexes and precise timing. Use a variety of medieval weapons and armor to defend yourself and defeat your foes




Immerse yourself further into the world of Bogdan's Cross by discovering a range of collectible items. These include pages from the Latin Vulgate Bible, ancient relics, and other period-related artifacts. Each collectible not only adds depth to the historical context but also provides insights into the lore and hidden stories of the Templar Order. Collecting these items can unlock special abilities, offer narrative clues, and enhance your understanding of the game’s rich tapestry.





Creating Bogdan's Cross has been a deeply personal and transformative journey for me. Coming from the animation industry, where I honed my skills in storytelling and visual artistry, I decided to embark on the ambitious path of solo game development. This game represents my first foray into the world of video games, driven by a passion to blend historical authenticity with compelling fiction.

A key part of my development process involved using Quill, a VR art tool, to bring Bogdan's universe to life. This innovative workflow allowed me to craft detailed environments and characters in a highly immersive and intuitive way, ensuring a unique and visually stunning experience for players. Every element of Bogdan's Cross, from the detailed environments to the intricate character arcs, reflects my dedication to creating an immersive and engaging experience. I hope that players will find the same sense of wonder and excitement in playing the game as I did in making it.

title: Thalassophobia
description:
게임 정보
Team up in Thalassophobia, a 4-player co-op horror game where you descend into the ocean's depths to uncover sunken secrets and survive the terrors lurking below.

title: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
Plunge into the heart of adventure with our 2D dungeon crawler featuring roguelite elements and get catapulted into a series of mind-bending labyrinths with a top-down perspective. All this is rendered in glorious pixel-art and adorned with a turn-based combat system infused with electrifying arcade nuances, where each weapon serves as a unique extension of your character.
Another hallmark of this adventure is its randomly generated level design. Every zone of the Hyper-Dungeon is a unique universe, different from any other gameplay session. The layout of the rooms, the shape of the corridors, and the placement of monsters, traps, and treasures are reinvented every time, providing players with an ever-changing challenge.
Navigating these subterranean levels will be anything but a walk in the park: you'll need tactics, quick reflexes, and keen observation to overcome lethal traps and a wide variety of enemies. The full version of the game offers a total of 50 meticulously designed levels, paying special attention to gameplay mechanics, plot, and dialogue. The gameplay offers a broad spectrum of experiences that continually alternate: from last-stand battles to tactical reasoning, and from puzzles that require intuition and wit.
Each level is a microcosm unto itself, with different biomes, varying levels of brightness, and changing dimensions. Think you can dodge some challenges? Think again... what invaluable treasures will you miss by taking the easier path? But it doesn't end here: classic mechanics of the genre—such as character development, leveling up, and collecting rare items—are enriched by an intuitive yet effective crafting system.
Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to customize your fighting technique with three different styles, each with unique unlockable abilities. Monsters in the game are numerous and exhibit different behaviors, making encounters compelling without being excessively difficult or frustrating: we firmly believe that a video game should above all be fun.

title: Looking For Fael
description:
게임 정보
Try to find your way out of your own apartment.
A surreal and giant labyrinth
Upon receiving a cryptic voicemail from your missing roommate, the ordinary confines of your apartment transform into a surreal labyrinth. Guided by his voice and a custom retro console in hand, embark on a journey to decipher the mysteries that have twisted your home into an enigmatic maze.
But beware. The further you venture into other realities, the harder it will be to find your way back.

title: PARKSIDE: DECAYED SOUL MANIPULATION
description:
게임 정보
In PARKSIDE, the future of biomechanical subterfuge and suffering is revealed through the story of Alexander Petrovich, an unemployed hacker who is kidnapped by a mysterious group known as the Illuminated Brethren of Conclave Automata.
Will he bend to the will of the Brethren and aid in realizing their vision for humanity, or will he take the hand of a guardian angel? Though, no matter his choice, a sinister voice in his head may have other plans.

PARKSIDE is a First Person Shooter / Immersive Simulation, with a focus on freedom, choice, and consequences.
Set in the fictitious city of Abbotsford, California in the year 2038, the world the player experiences is the result of four years of shrouded meddling by the Illuminated Brethren - the environment is cold and unforgiving, the people are drab and demoralized, narcotics and gangs are rife, and military police walk the streets. How has it come to this?

Following his capture by the Brethren, Alexander is interfaced with an experimental combat platform known as POLYPHEMUS. Through a piece of technology called the Remote Combatant Viewer, he is sent to complete illicit, dangerous missions for the Brethren, whose directives come from the mysterious Divine Rod.

Many tools are at the player's disposal to tackle problems including a roster of futuristic weapons, armaments such as EMP grenades and frag mines, and abilities that can be used to navigate all manner of obstacles. You can hack or bypass keypads, security cameras, turrets, and robots... or shoot them to bits - pick your poison and run with it as you navigate smoky streets, dark alleys, airy vents, and secret bases. Keep in mind that you're not the only one with a gun...

Choices matter - in the secret fight for control of the precious lives of all citizens, there are many powerful stakeholders. There is one important question with many answers and outcomes: are you a servant of the Divine Rod, Alexander?

title: RIM:Soul Jar
description:
게임 정보
과거로 떨어진 불멸의 용사
어느 날, 기억을 잃은 채 과거의 세계로 떨어진 용사.
그는 강력한 힘을 지니고 있지만, 자신이 누구였는지 조차 알지 못합니다.
그러나 손에 쥔 무기는 너무나도 익숙합니다.
이제, 앞으로 나아가며 자신이 왜 이곳에 오게 되었는지를 밝혀야 합니다.
죽을수록 강해지는 용사
이 세계에서 용사의 여정은 결코 쉽지 않습니다.
강력한 적들이 길을 막지만, 용사는 죽음을 거듭할수록 더 강해집니다.
반복되는 도전 속에서 능숙해지는 컨트롤과 얻게 되는 새로운 힘들은 당신을 세상의 구원자로 거듭나게 합니다.

title: Animaloid Girl
description:
게임 정보
What kind of anima I will be depends on you.

The story of a girl who is changing from a human to a "KEMONO" and watching her coming of age.

Would you like to live with a girl who grows beast ears, a tail, and gradually transforms into a "KEMONO"...?
This is a multi-ending "adventure game about training an Animalized girl" set in a KEMOMIMI x Hong Kong x cyberpunk world.

After the release of the Japanese version, multilingual support is planned sequentially!


The fragile and pure illustrations are animated vividly in Live2D.
A variety of facial expressions, gestures, and direction color your communication with the girl and weave a story like an animation.

Adventure game about training an Animalized girl "Animaloid Girl"
What kind of animalization she will do will be determined by the choices you, the player, make...
Once upon a time, a mysterious race of people emerged, changing from humans to animal. Those with ears and tails were called "Half-ANIMA", and those who took on the full animal form were called "ANIMA"...

You have taken in a girl who is not related to you by blood.
The girl was showing signs of "Animalization", a transformation into the form of a animal.

Anima is a minority in this world in which the ears of a beast appear, a tail grows, and the whole body is covered with fur.


You are studying Anima, and as the girl's guardian, you will watch her grow up for a year.

Which will you choose, the KEMONO girl, the KEMOMIMI girl, or the human girl?
You are free to choose to further Animalization through drug administration, to halt its progression, or even to surgically rewind it.

Will you raise the girl to be what you want her to be? Will you make her become what she wants to be? Or...?
I'm the only one who looks different from everyone else...
Some of my friends said I was pretty... but...
I didn't become this way because I wanted to...
Why am I an "Anima"...?


A girl who was once an ordinary human being is suddenly transformed into the form of a KEMONO by the sudden onset of Animalization.
Animalization is a very rare condition in this world.
The girl who has become one of the few "Anima" in the world is looked at strangely by people and becomes a special minority, and this disturbs her.
What kind of help can you offer to the girl who is confused and distressed by the change, who feels as if she has lost her place in everyday life?
And how will the girl respond to your actions?
The future is in your hands.

Players will spend a year with the girl, wavering between "exemplary guardian", "mad scientist who can't control his curiosity" and "adult who leads the girl to unknown possibilities".
Will the end result be "an ideal KEMONO" or "a happy future for the girl"?
This is a game of nurturing and adventure that will test your "desire" and "reason".
This is not a novel game where you enjoy a single story, but an adventure game where you are responsible for the choices you make, the results you get, and the whole picture you see through repeated playthroughs.
autokwd: Animaloid Girl,アニマロイドガール

title: Farmer's Dynasty 2
description:
게임 정보

그림같은 풍경 한가운데에 목가적인 농장이 기다리는 끝없이 광활한 경작지의 분위기에 빠져드세요. 동물과 작물을 돌보며 현실감 넘치는 북새통을 체험하세요. Farmer's Dynasty 2가 여러분을 초대합니다. 광활한 오픈 월드를 배경으로 건설하고, 농사를 짓고, 전원 생활의 본질을 만끽하세요. 직접 트랙터에 올라 밭을 일구며 머리결을 스치고 지나가는 상쾌한 바람을 느끼세요. 시골 생활의 아름다움과 시련이 그 어느 때보다도 매력적으로 펼쳐집니다. 동반자를 찾고, 가족을 이루고, 농장을 다음 세대에 물려주고, 자부심 넘치는 후손으로서 유산을 이어가세요.
건설하고, 생활하고, 사업을 하세요
농장은 당신의 열정과 오랜 노력의 증거이며, 동물들은 여러분의 가장 큰 책임이고, 가족은 미래에 대한 보장입니다. 밭을 일구고, 가축을 돌보고, 건물을 보수하거나 확장하고, 농장을 넓히세요. 열심히 일하고, 영리하게 사업을 하고, 부지런히 움직이다 보면 농부로서 훌륭한 평판을 얻고 지역 사회에서의 입지를 높일 수 있습니다. 가족을 이루고, 후손을 돌보고, 그들에게 농장을 물려줘 유산을 이어가세요. Farmer's Dynasty 2에서는 당신과 당신의 가문이 어떻게 기억될지 직접 선택할 수 있습니다
과거와 현재의 농업

성능이 떨어지는 낡은 트랙터부터 400마력의 강력한 트랙터까지! 어떻게 성공할 것인지 직접 선택하세요. 전통적인 농법과 장비로 유산을 이어받고, 낡았지만 검증된 차량을 사용하고 싶으신가요? 아니면 강력한 기계와 차량으로 현대적인 농법의 이점을 누리고 싶으신가요? 무엇이든 가능합니다! Farmer's Dynasty 2의 다양한 세계를 어떻게 알아보고 경험할지는 여러분의 선택입니다.
지역 사회의 믿음직한 일원이 되어 곤경에 빠진 NPC에게 도움을 주고 그들과 친구가 되세요. 수많은 부가 퀘스트를 통해 다른 사람들과 교류해 가며 다양한 방법으로 평판을 쌓을 수 있습니다. 그리고 돈벌이도 짭짤하죠!

계절의 변화와 낮과 밤의 주기는 현실감을 더할 뿐만 아니라 또다른 시련이기도 합니다. 봄 또는 여름에 밭을 일구고, 가을에 수확을 거둔 후 목가적인 겨울을 만끽하세요! 폭설이 내리면 제설차에 시동을 걸어 농장과 Farmer's Dynasty 2 세계의 도로를 안전하게 만드세요
농장이 완벽한 상태고, 동물들을 잘 돌보고 있는데도 힘이 넘쳐나나요? 걱정할 필요 없습니다. 할 일은 언제나 더 있으니까요! 울창한 숲을 돌봐야 하고, 정원에서는 다 익은 과일이 수확되기를 기다리고, 잔디도 깎아야 합니다. 강력한 트랙터뿐만 아니라 전기톱, 갈퀴, 예초기 등 필수 도구들을 사용할 수 있습니다. 색다른 경험을 원하신다면, 낚시 등 다양한 취미를 즐겨보거나 양봉가가 되어 보세요.

필요한 수리 작업을 통해 농장을 눈에 보기에도 좋은 완벽한 상태로 유지하세요. 새로운 집을 짓고 땅을 넓히세요. 낡은 트랙터를 복원하고 농장에 없어서는 안 될 중요한 기계들을 수리하세요. 모든 것을 양호한 상태로 유지하고 어느 일에든 사용할 수 있도록 관리해야 합니다.
동반자와 함께 시골 생활의 매력과 농사의 즐거움을 만끽하세요. 평생의 사랑을 찾아 가족을 이루고, 다음 세대에게 당신의 유산을 이어갈 준비를 시키세요.

시골에서의 모험을 떠날 준비 되셨나요? 지금 바로 기계에 시동을 거세요. 겨울이 곧 다가오고 있지만, 그 전까지는 늘 할 일이 있으니까요!

title: 500 CALIBER CONTRACTZ
description:
게임 정보
KILLING IS EASY
500 Caliber Contractz is a momentum-based 3D-Platformer in which you play as a contract killer hired via crowdfunding to murder CEOs, Disgraced Sinister Ex-Doctors, Private-Prison-Owning DJs, etc. With your handy high caliber sniper rifle and a chest full of anxiety, you can and will propel yourself to where you need to be. Collect tokens that float around for a reason I haven't bothered coming up with and then murder your target. Do it. Please.
MORE DETAILZ
In this game you are given a large variety of moves and plopped into an open level to explore as you please.
