title: A Killer Chat! Christmas
description:
게임 정보
Note: this is a standalone game. You do not need to download Killer Chat! to play, but we do recommend playing through Killer Chat! first (it's free!)
WELCOME BACK TO HELL, LOSERS!
Over a year has passed since asking too many murder-related questions online (for your book) got you invited to a serial killer chatroom. Of course, you did what any insane person would do and called the police pretended to be a serial killer. For, uh… hot singles in your server research purposes. 
Somehow, you got your bad happy ending. You’re now a bestselling writer, desperately in love, and have come to think of the server as family - it's like a dream come true. Sure, most of them still think you are a serial killer, your boss needs you to write another hit ASAP and your one true love is definitely technically a murderer, but look on the bright side - it’s Christmas!

title: Ship
description:
게임 정보
Ever wanted to step into the shoes of a packaging expert? In Ship, Inc., you take on the role of a packaging employee at a fast-paced cargo shipment company. Your job? Sort, package, and ship parcels to their correct destinations while keeping up with the growing demands of the business.

How It Works

At Ship, Inc., every package counts! Follow shipment orders carefully, choose the right box sizes, and ensure each package reaches its destination safely. Misplacing or damaging shipments could cost you, so be precise and efficient!


✔ – Select the correct box size, arrange items properly, and seal them securely before shipping.
✔ – Keep an eye on incoming orders and ship parcels correctly to maximize efficiency.
✔ – Earn money to improve your workspace, increase storage, and unlock better shipping tools.
✔ – Stay on top of customer demands as you balance speed and accuracy in your shipments.
✔ – Packages must be handled properly! Fragile items require extra attention to avoid damage during transit.
✔ – As you progress, new challenges and complex orders will test your multitasking skills.


Every second counts in the shipping industry! Improve your workflow, make the right decisions, and prove yourself as the best packaging expert in . Are you up for the challenge?

title: Appulse
description:
게임 정보
Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.
Inspired by the classic pinball Space Cadet we loved during our childhood, Appulse is a reinterpretation of the genre. Bringing newcomers and old timers by mixing the juicy mechanics of the pinball, and the thrilling and fast gameplay of a roguelite shooter, we want to spark a new interest among the gamer community!
We stayed faithful to the pinball legacy and designed a completely unique table for Appulse. In this game you are entirely immersed into a space war. Your goal is to protect the capital
ship while he is cruising through space to escape the grasp of the robot syndicate.

title: Frontier: Path of Shadows
description:
게임 정보
It’s the 25th century. Humanity is discovering new planets and settling across the galaxy. People who are tired of mundane everyday life flock to the Frontier – the borderline separating the civilized space from the unknown. Comfort and law are in short supply here, but fortunes await those who can deliver a new route, a rare plant, or someone else’s secrets.
When Jay agreed to deliver a suspicious cargo to a client, he thought it would be an easy way to make a quick buck. But what seemed like a simple job quickly turned into serious trouble. The mysterious crystal inside the box wasn’t just an object; it somehow communicated with him! Now, powerful figures lurking in the shadows are anything but happy about this unexpected turn of events. With their lives on the line, Jay and his team find themselves holding the fate of an entire sector in their hands.
TACTICAL COMBAT: The game's tactical battles use a point-and-link system, where both heroes and enemies move along a grid. With a procedurally generated map that adapts to the player's experience, every encounter presents a new challenge!
VIVID CHARACTERS: Each character has a unique past, distinct abilities, and a personalized skill tree. Build your ideal team and experience the world through their eyes.
EXPLORING NEW PLANETS: The Frontier is full of uncharted territories, and the Nebula of the Great Rift holds many secrets. Venture into the unknown, discover new planets, uncover their histories, and harvest valuable resources.
THE SYMBIOTE’S MYSTERY: What secrets lie within the small blue crystal? It reacts to Jay’s actions, displays signs of intelligence, and changes color in response. Study its behavior, uncover its logic, and unlock new possibilities.
EVERY CHOICE MATTERS: Every event in the game impacts the characters and the crystal. Whether you're strategizing in battle, forging relationships with factions, or negotiating with allies, remember: the fate of the sector rests in your hands.
A UNIQUE AUTHOR-CREATED SETTING: The game is set in the Frontier: Endless Space universe, a richly developed sci-fi world filled with diverse human cultures, advanced technologies, and uncharted planets beyond the settled territories. Perfect for sci-fi fans seeking deep lore and exploration.
autokwd: Frontier: Path of Shadows,Фронтир: Путем Теней

title: MUDBIRD
description:
게임 정보
MUDBIRD is an adventure survival game about exploring a mysterious archipelago. Use the few sticks and leaves you have at your disposal to make it through the cold days and escape! A cozy and atmospheric spring experience. 
a few features:
survive on a desolate island in early spring!
interact with a whole cast of NPCs and ghosts!
repair grandpa's old canoe to explore a set of islands
save up your hard-earned cash to escape the archipelago and head home!
go spearfishing, take care of your tulip garden, tend to the fire
use your binoculars to discover the birds of the islands
explore a mysterious underground cave
send a message in a bottle to other players on their own islands!
2d top-down hand-drawn pixelart graphics
relax and watch the snow fall

title: JAIL DICE: Roll to Break
description:
게임 정보
제일 다이스: 롤 투 브레이크 ( JAIL DICE: Roll to Break ) 는 실시간 전투와 턴제 진행 방식이 뒤섞인 익스트랙션 퍼즐 액션 게임입니다.
주사위 형태의 전투기 [ 다이스 모빌 ] 을 조작하여, 지하 연구실 내 전투 지역에서 적들을 파괴하고 자원을 수집하세요. 갈수록 더 많은 적들이 생성되기 때문에, 전투 지역에 오래 머무를 수는 없을 겁니다.

title: Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors
description:
게임 정보
Fire up the forge and craft your finest weapons in Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors, a reforged adventure!  As a determined donkey blacksmith, your journey takes you across the land — but treacherous monsters block the way.  Rally the local warrior clans and equip them with custom-crafted swords, bows, shields and more in a completely hands-on blacksmith shop.  Once your soldiers are armed, send them into battle to clear the path forward!  While the warriors fight, you'll gather loot and help out with your trusty cannon.  Collect better ores and parts to forge even stronger weapons, and keep honing your craft as you push onward toward the ultimate showdown with the evil wizard Dudley!
Local warriors specialize in certain weapon types, but it’s up to you to craft the perfect weapon for the battle ahead! The forging process is entirely hands-on—choose your ore, select a weapon mold, then melt and pour the metal. Construct and hone the weapon before attaching various parts, ensuring it's battle-ready for the awaiting soldier.
As you journey down the trail, you’ll unlock new weapon molds and encounter warriors skilled in using them. Your trusty assistant, Scout, will provide insights on upcoming monsters and their weaknesses, helping you choose the most effective weapons and parts for the fight. From swords and axes to shields and beyond, use your gathered materials to forge powerful gear and maximize your impact in battle!
Once the local warriors are armed and ready, it’s time to join them on the battlefield! As they wield your handcrafted weapons against the monsters blocking the trail, you'll follow along in your blacksmith battle wagon, collecting loot from fallen enemies. The quality of your weapons directly impacts how far the soldiers can push forward, making your craftsmanship essential to their success.
But you're not just a spectator—your trusty cannon lets you provide support during battle, with new cannonball types unlocking as you progress. If your troops fight their way to the end of the trail, you'll be rewarded with powerful Epic Weapon Designs, giving you new blueprints to craft even stronger weapons for future battles!

title: TOWER KING
description:
게임 정보
Building Management Simulation x Rogue-lite!
You are a rookie hired CEO.
"The fate of this building’s management is in your hands! You can turn things around, right!?"
Endure unreasonable demands from your boss and achieve your goals!
However, the orders keep escalating…!?
Overcome countless hardships and aim to become a tycoon!!
A Dynamic Business Environment!
The business environment changes every time, influenced by the foot traffic of existing buildings and stores.
You can only buy the random products selected by your boss—meaning free management is out of the question!?
Think strategically within your limited choices to find the best management strategy!
Sharpen Your Business Skills!
Upgrade products to improve their performance!
It’s up to you as the CEO to manage a cast of unique employees!
Use them efficiently to maximize your profits!

title: Inazuma Eleven Team Builder
description:
게임 정보
🔥 About Inazuma Eleven Team Builder
Inazuma Eleven Team Builder is a tool-game designed for all Inazuma Eleven enthusiasts! Create your dream team, organize your players, and strategize your formations just like a true coach. ⚽
🏆 Build Your Ultimate Team
Select, customize, and organize your squad with your favorite players from the Inazuma Eleven universe. Whether you're recreating legendary teams or inventing new strategies, this tool is designed for people who love tactical planning.
🔍 Features
✔ Team Management – Choose players, set formations, and assign roles.
✔ Custom Lineups – Design formations and strategies for every match scenario.
✔ Save & Share – Keep track of your teams and share them with others.
🔗 Join us on Discord and Steam to be part of the discussion and share your creations!
🚀 Create, strategize, and lead your team to victory! 🔥

title: Desk Paws
description:
게임 정보
이것은 컴퓨터 데스크톱 기반의 방치형 게임입니다.
여기서 당신은 아름다운 작은 집, 귀여운 아파트 관리인,
그리고 엄청나게 많은 귀여운 전자 애완동물을 얻을 수 있습니다!
그들은 당신이 일하고 공부하는 동안 조용히 함께할 것입니다.
====================[수집]======================
우리는 당신을 위해 총 100 마리 이상의 완전히 다른 애완동물을 준비했습니다!
특별히 제작된 인형뽑기 기계를 통해 그들을 얻으세요!
또는 다양한 스타일의 방을 수집하고, 자유롭게 당신의 오두막을 조합하세요! 작은 애완동물들이 들어와 살게 하세요!
또한, 아파트 관리인 푸미 을 위한 의상과 머리장식을 수집하세요!
오, 그래, 아마도 당신은 그들을 번식시켜 수집 수를 300 로 확장하고 싶을 수도 있습니다?
====================[배치]======================
애완동물들이 오두막에 살게 하여 임대료를 모으고, 그런 다음 인형뽑기 기계에서 한 번에 다 써보세요~
당신이 좋아하는 작은 애완동물을 파견하여 모험을 떠나게 하고, 건축 자재, 간식 또는 다른 좋은 것들을 수확하세요!
====================[특징]======================
사용자 정의 가능한 수준의 [방해 금지] 버튼 단축키, 진지하게 일할 때 한 번의 클릭으로 모든 것을 숨기고 싶나요? 완전히 괜찮아요!
집, 애완동물, UI의 사용자 정의 가능한 위치와 크기, 데스크톱의 특정 위치에 고정되기를 원하지 않나요? 완전히 괜찮아요!
뭔가를 클릭하고 싶나요? 데스크톱에서 자유롭게 끌고 던질 수 있는 작은 소품을 시도해보세요~심지어 그것들을 쌓을 수도 있어요!
또는 방문객을 맞이하고, 그런 다음 푸미 의 비밀 일기를 넘겨볼까요?

title: Electrician Life
description:
게임 정보
전기 기술자 생활은 전기 기술자가 되는 것에 대한 편안한 시뮬레이션 게임입니다⚡
집에 전선을 연결하고, 회로를 설치하고, 결함 있는 시스템의 문제를 해결하면서 전기적인 도전에 임하게 됩니다. 다양한 프로젝트에서 레이아웃을 계획하고, 전력을 관리하고, 안전을 보장하세요. 정밀성이 핵심입니다. 연결이 하나 잘못되면 모두 고장납니다! 전등을 계속 켜 둘 수 있나요? 🔌
주요 기능:
🔌 전기 - 세상에 힘을 주는 보이지 않는 힘!
우리 주변에 있지만, 실제로 그 작동 방식을 이해하는 사람은 거의 없습니다... 하지만 이제 당신은 압니다! 숙련된 전기 기술자의 역할을 맡아 현실적이면서도 매력적인 방식으로 전기적인 도전에 임하세요.
🛠 전선을 연결하세요!


처음부터 끝까지 전기 설비를 담당하세요. 케이블을 깔고, 콘센트를 설치하고, 회로 차단기를 연결하고, 모든 것이 원활하고 안전하게 실행되도록 하세요. 정밀성과 계획이 핵심입니다. 연결이 하나라도 잘못되면 시스템이 의도한 대로 작동하지 않습니다!

title: Cosmic Drift
description:
게임 정보
Launch rockets into orbit around planets, find a good trajectory, and take risks to increase your score!
Click to launch your rocket from the portal. Once in the air, it will rotate thanks to the planets' gravity.
Find the best trajectory to stay in orbit for as long as possible, getting close to the three planets without crashing to score the most points within the allotted time.
You can play solo, multiplayer, and even on Twitch directly with your viewers!
And more to come!

title: Chunky JUMP!
description:
게임 정보
A new short horror adventure from the world of The Bunny Graveyard, for new and returning players alike!
STORY
By day, you run a small gas station in Carrot Town, serving its quirky citizens, stocking supplies, and keeping business afloat. By night, you must outwit and survive a terrifying monster that lurks in the shadows... all while playing a little game called Chunky JUMP! on your trusty BIRD BOY.
FEATURES
SURVIVE the night, keep your focus, time your jumps, and don’t let the fear break your concentration. Survive until morning… if you can.
PLAY as Jeff, the gas station worker and talk with the residents of Carrot Town!
LISTEN to the mysteries going on in Carrot Town, learn new information and make your own conclusions...
Play the STORY MODE and find out more about Carrot Town's mysteries and citizens.
Play the ENDLESS MODE to play multiple new levels and collect skins of familiar faces!
Earn Bun-Bun coins by completing ACHIEVEMENTS!

title: Infiniclick
description:
게임 정보
Combine, automate and upgrade programs to amass a fortune! Infiniclick is a relaxing incremental game (or not—it's up to you) where your goal is to pay off an unfair debt to the Fun Corp.
Each program comes with upgrades that will allow you to earn more money with them.
Some programs will require resources from others to run.

title: Life is a Journey
description:
게임 정보
인생은 여행이다에서 당신은 밴을 타고 잊지 못할 모험을 떠나게 됩니다. 매 마일이 새로운 경험입니다! 🚐✨ 캠핑카를 제작하고 업그레이드하여 자신의 라이프스타일에 맞게 맞춤화하세요. 이것은 단순한 차량이 아닙니다. 바퀴 달린 집입니다. 이를 잘 관리하고, 개선하고, 변형시켜 앞으로의 모든 길을 정복하세요.
미지의 세계로 모험을 떠나는 외로운 여행자의 입장에서 생각해 보세요. 모든 발걸음이 이야기를 말해줍니다. 편안한 시뮬레이터와 가벼운 생존 기법이 혼합된 몰입형 게임입니다. 일하고, 여행하고, 탐험하세요. 밴 라이프를 즐기고 진정한 유목민처럼 살아보세요. 세상은 여러분의 놀이터이며, 캠핑카는 끝없는 모험의 열쇠입니다.
풍경을 즐기고, 별빛 아래에 캠프를 세우고, 여러분의 속도에 맞춰 세상과 교류하세요. 먼 랜드마크를 따라가든 호기심에 따라가든, 여행 자체가 가장 중요합니다.

title: Desktop Fishes
description:
게임 정보
Desktop Fishes transforms your computer desktop into a playful, interactive aquarium filled with adorable, retro pixel-art fishes! 🐠✨
Discover and collect a huge variety of fishes, breed them and create unique new species, there are over 10,000 possible genetic combinations! Each baby fish inherits cool traits from it's parents, giving you endless new surprises to explore!
Your aquarium is alive and swimming directly over your desktop apps, letting you casually interact while working, browsing, or gaming. Feed your fishes, gently play with them, or simply move your mouse and watch them react playfully—they love attention and will respond to your every click and hover!
Features:
🐟 Breed & Discover: Combine different fishes to uncover brand-new species and unexpected genetic traits. Every new fish is a fun surprise waiting to be discovered!
🖥️ Interactive Overlay: Your fishes seamlessly swim over your desktop applications or stay in the background, making your workspace a bit more cheerful without getting in your way.
🖱️ Playful Interaction: Feed your fish and interact with them directly using your mouse—they'll eagerly swim towards your cursor, respond to your actions, and become your playful desktop companions.
🌊 Idle-Friendly Fun: Perfectly designed for casual play, Desktop Fishes lets you enjoy a relaxing aquarium experience at your own pace. Your fishes will thrive even when you're busy doing other things, making your desktop livelier and more delightful every day.
Dive into the fun, explore endless fishy combinations, and bring your desktop to life with your own vibrant, swimming friends!

title: EVERDARK: Undead Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Embark on Everdark, an action-packed shooter that blends classics like Unreal or Doom with influences from survival horror games such as Resident Evil. Filled with references to 1980s horror movies, you'll be transported to a city swarming with vampires, where you'll face these creatures in diverse and bloody ways.
Survive in a devastated city
Upon returning from a visit to your cousin in Milwaukee, you're forced to take a detour that leads you to Everdark. Then, you suffer a terrible car accident that leaves you stranded with no way to call for help or continue your journey.
The only way out is on foot. However, the streets have descended into chaos… The city is infested with vampires that have wiped out most of its inhabitants! Can you help the survivors, uncover the cause of this catastrophe, and escape alive?

title: AI-deal-Rays
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
'AI-deal-Rays' is a high-speed 3D stage-clear action game where you control the full-intelligence android "Ideal" in battle. Engage in combat against enemy androids and large-scale weapons while unfolding a story set in the year 2200.
Simple Controls
We've eliminated the complex operations typical of 3D action games, optimizing for smooth playability for everyone. At the same time, you can enjoy a variety of combat actions:
Mirage Line: A special evasive maneuver that allows instantaneous movement behind enemies.
Cluster Drain: An offensive and defensive technique that absorbs HP from enemies.
Stray Dash: A high-speed attack that charges at enemies from mid-range.
Sonic Burst: A powerful special move.
Playable with keyboard/mouse or gamepad.
Anime-Style Presentation and Camera Work

title: Ramen Crisis
description:
게임 정보
Ramen Crisis – 미친 라면 배달 액션 게임!
당신은 용감한 라면 배달원! 스쿠터를 타고 높게 쌓은 라면을 떨어뜨리지 않고 안전하게 고객에게 전달하세요!
국물이 식기 전에 서둘러 배달하세요! 그리고 계란, 차슈 등 토핑도 잊지 마세요!
길에 있는 장애물과 함정을 피해 모든 배달을 성공적으로 완료하세요!
게임 특징
짜릿한 물리 액션 – 라면 탑이 흔들릴 거예요! 균형을 잘 맞추고 조심스럽게 배달하세요!
예상치 못한 해프닝 – 배달 중에는 다양한 웃긴 장애물과 상황들이 기다리고 있어요!

title: TAMASHIKA

the DREAM is a construction of the MIND that perpetuates the ILLUSION

the cartesian prison is a hall of mirrors, a recursive LABYRINTH
