title: NIGHT STRIKER GEAR
description:
게임 정보
NIGHT STRIKER GEAR is an action-packed retro 3D shoot-'em-up.
Control the special armored vehicle INTER-GRAY in third-person view, ripping through a cyber futuristic highway while shooting down enemies.
◆Story
Lotus Raai is a resort complex and theme park of an unprecedented scale. Dignitaries from all around the world gather to celebrate its opening, when conspiracy begins to rear its head...
The United Nations intervenes to rescue the endangered guests and reveal the true nature of the events. As a member of the United Nations Special Tactical Action Force, often referred to as the Night Striker, you set out on a nocturnal infiltration into Lotus Raai, aboard your trusted hovercar INTER-GRAY.
Shoot down the enemies who try to stop you and get to the bottom of the mystery!
◆Details
Long-awaited sequel to the classic arcade 3D shoot-'em-up NIGHT STRIKER (1989)
Designed and created by M2, the Operation Night Strikers collection developer (published by Taito)
All-new levels and a glamorous array of enemies presented in breathtaking graphics, utilizing the modern aspect ratio of 16:9 while staying true to the sprite scaling pseudo-3D style of the original NIGHT STRIKER.
New GEAR System that adds fresh and distinct tactical depth.
Brand new, stylish soundtrack that further accentuate the hallmark sense of rushing forward
Supports Micomsoft's Cyber Stick (reissued) USB controller
autokwd: NIGHT STRIKER GEAR,ナイトストライカーGEAR

title: Styx: Blades of Greed
description:
게임 정보


당신은 교활하고 독설적인 고블린이자 은신 기술의 달인 Styx가 되어 플레이하게 됩니다. 당신의 목표는 엘프, 인간, 오크 간의 전쟁이 터지기 직전인 세계에서 가장 귀중하면서도 위험한 자원인 쿼츠를 손에 넣는 것입니다.
Styx: Blades of Greed는 전작 두 편의 검증된 공식을 더욱 정교하게 다듬어, 자유도와 창의성을 경험의 중심으로 삼습니다. 거대한 수직 환경을 탐험하고 새로운 도구와 능력을 익히세요. 처음 Styx를 접하든 오래된 팬이든, 탐욕을 부리는 게 이토록 즐거웠던 적은 없었습니다!

_KO
더 이상 남을 위해 일할 필요는 없습니다! 이번에는 우리의 유명한 녹색 피부 친구가 자신의 목표를 추구하며 직접 조직을 이끕니다. Styx와 그의 크루는 비행선을 타고 수수께끼의 새 에너지원 쿼츠를 추적합니다. 위험천만한 여정을 거치며 익숙한 얼굴과 개성 넘치는 새 캐릭터를 만나고, 종교 재판소의 함정을 피하세요. 이번 모험은 대전쟁의 서막이자, 의 핵심 사건과 얽혀 있는 용병 집단 '블랙 핸드'의 탄생을 알리는 계기가 됩니다.



_KO
모든 위대한 강탈에는 철저한 준비가 필요합니다! 다음 작전을 실행하기 전에 무기와 물약을 제작하세요. 당신에게는 다양한 능력이 있습니다. 앰버 스킬 덕분에 복제와 투명화 능력이 다시 돌아왔죠. 쿼츠를 활용한 정신 지배와 시간 왜곡 능력도 습득하세요. 모든 상황은 잠입 퍼즐이며, 다양한 방식으로 해결할 수 있습니다. Styx는 작은 체구에도 불구하고 민첩함, 기지, 그리고 날카로운 유머 감각을 활용해 가장 까다로운 상황에서도 빠져나갑니다.
항상 단검을 먼저 꺼내는 타입인가요? 우리가 뭐라 할 수 있겠어요... 아무도 보지 않으면 문제도 없습니다!



_KO
세 가지 광활한 오픈 월드를 자유롭게 탐험하세요. 인간 세계의 경계를 이루는 The Wall, 푸르른 오크 마을 Turquoise Dawn, 엘프 수도의 폐허 Akenash까지. 글라이더를 타고 하늘을 날아오르며, 그래플링 훅으로 한순간에 접근 불가능할 만큼 높은 곳에 도달하고, 날카로운 발톱으로 거대한 벽을 오르세요. 수직적인 환경을 활용해 목표에 다가가세요. 새로운 도구를 얻으면 이전에는 도달할 수 없었던 지역이 열리며 메트로이드배니아 스타일의 진행이 가능해집니다.

title: Scaling Up
description:
게임 정보
뱀 농장의 주인이 되어보세요
작은 드래곤으로서, 농장을 처음부터 끝까지 키워보세요. 자원을 모으고 관리하며, 뱀들을 수용할 수 있는 다양한 시설을 건설하고, 그들이 행복하게 지낼 수 있도록 돌보며 아름다운 비늘을 모으세요.
매력적인 뱀들을 발견하세요
각 건물은 다양한 종류의 뱀을 수용할 수 있으며, 각 뱀은 다른 비늘을 탈피합니다. 이 비늘은 새로운 건물을 짓거나, 더 나은 도구와 장비를 제작하거나, 금으로 판매하는 데 사용될 수 있습니다. 뿔이 달린 뱀부터, 바퀴가 달린 뱀, 심지어 날개가 달린 뱀까지, 다양한 뱀 친구들을 만나게 될 것입니다.
작업을 자동화하세요

title: Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator는 미니 레이서 자동차 상점의 모든 측면을 관리할 수 있게 해줍니다! 상세한 미니 자동차와 다양한 예비 부품을 판매하고, 희귀 아이템을 위한 추첨을 제공하며, 고객이 구매할 수 있도록 맞춤 제작된 미니 자동차를 전시하세요. 사업을 확장하면서, 레이스 트랙에서 당신의 창작물을 시험 운전하여 맞춤 제작된 미니 자동차를 평가하고, 상점을 자동차 애호가들의 최고 목적지로 바꾸세요!
희귀 예비 부품 찾기
추가적인 흥미를 더하기 위해, 각 자동차 팩에는 가챠 시스템이 있어 희귀 예비 부품을 얻기 위해 운을 시험할 수 있습니다. 각 추첨에서는 궁극의 미니 자동차를 완성하는 데 필요한 중요한 부품일 수 있는 무작위 부품을 제공합니다.
미니 자동차 판매
당신은 자동차 애호가를 매료시키기 위해 인상적인 디테일로 제작된 다양한 미니어처 레이싱 자동차 모델에 접근할 수 있습니다. 고객이 만족하고 사업이 번창하도록 항상 최고의 상품을 제공할 수 있도록 재고를 신중하게 관리해야 합니다. 상점 주인으로서 자동차 팩을 열어 자신의 미니 자동차 컬렉션을 가질 수도 있습니다.

title: STRAND
description:
게임 정보
SUMMARY
Strand takes place in a future where humanity expands beyond its system, driven by a shared vision of growth. VESTA, a paradise covered with vast oceans and thriving plankton, has been discovered by exploration probes. To assess its colonization potential, the A.R.E.S. Station has been sent into its orbit.
When a powerful magnetic field hits A.R.E.S., the station is warped by mysterious phenomena, distorting time, space, and physics. Solving these puzzles is your only way to escape.
A PREVIEW OF THE FUTURE
Step into life in the 25th century, where humanity unites in pursuit of a brighter future. This is a speculative vision of ideal technological advancement, filled with both inspiration and unease. As you explore this world, you’ll confront the double-edged nature of progress, offering incredible potential, but at what cost?
RICH ARRAY OF PUZZLES AND RIDDLES

title: The Sisterhood Pasture: Cozy Folklore Farming
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Moonlit Valley!
Your grandmother has left you a delightful surprise—a vacation lodge in the heart of a mysterious valley, Jacaranda Mansion!
Nestled in a secluded southwest valley, home mostly to ladies, it’s a hidden paradise with a rich cultural heritage. But beyond the familiar scents of home, there are secrets here—secrets tied to the lost myths you once heard from your grandmother as a child...
The immediate goal is clear: use the valley’s magical farming techniques and mysterious technologies to revive Jacaranda Mansion’s former glory! But with so much to explore, you’re free to set your own goals and chart your journey as you and the sisterhood discover the countless wonders of Moonlit Valley together.
As for your grandmother’s whereabouts? Don’t worry; she’s simply taken off on an impromptu road trip, riding her motorcycle into the horizon!
Cultivate southwest specialty crops with creative grafting! Enjoy an alchemical experience that’s impossible to put down!
Raise adorable animal friends… and, of course, don’t miss the fishing!
 Cook to your heart’s content! Choose from a variety of ingredients and techniques. Let your culinary mastery make the restaurant a local legend… (But if it fails, well, it’s all part of the fun!)
autokwd: The Sisterhood Pasture: Cozy Folklore Farming

title: Plushes
description:
게임 정보
Plushes is a cozy action game about exploration and creature collecting. Become a brave hunter who has to clear the city streets of uninvited guests - cute, but wayward and sometimes aggressive Plushes. Banish them or tame them - the choice is yours!
You'll find yourself on the elegant streets of the snowy city, where secrets hide around every corner. Travel through a variety of locations, fight numerous enemies, solve puzzles, build a personal zoo, trade and engage in other activities to stop the plush invasion.
Turn enemies into friends

Each fluffy guest has its own features: someone immediately gets into a fight, someone sits and sweetly hums a song, and someone doesn't mind getting acquainted with you themselves. All of them require various approaches to capture - and your task is to figure out the most effective tactics by trial and error, turning enemies into friends.

title: Neon Spellstorm
description:
게임 정보
Race the Neon Path, Wield Limitless Magic, and Shape a Shattering World
Neon Spellstorm throws you into the shoes of a powerful wizard in a low-tech cyberpunk world, sprinting along a crumbling neon path. Every step brings you closer to new foes and treasures, but don’t look back—the path collapses behind you! Use everything at your disposal to survive as you carve a path through destructible terrain, unleash an arsenal of devastating spells, and create wild synergies that make each run unique.
A World That Falls Beneath Your Feet
Discover the thrill of pushing forward on an ever-dissolving path. The environment itself becomes an obstacle, with terrain crumbling behind you and breaking apart as spells and enemies collide. Every run challenges you to stay one step ahead, with each decision propelling you deeper into the unknown.

title: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror
description:
게임 정보
Den-Den: Tokyo Horror는 오픈 월드 생존 호러 체험으로, 노인을 돌보는 간병인이 되어 플레이합니다. 일주일 동안 매일 밤 도쿄의 어두운 거리를 탐험하고 어디로 갈지, 누구를 돌볼지 선택해야 합니다. 모든 사람을 구할 수는 없습니다.

의존하는 사람들뿐만 아니라 자신도 생존을 위해 필요한 제한된 자원을 관리하세요. 시간은 당신의 편이 아니며, 사람들은 무언가 사악한 것에 의해 저주받았습니다. 이번 주 당신의 감시하에 몇 명의 사망자가 나올까요?
기능들:
위험과 악이 모든 거리 모퉁이에서 도사리고 있는 도쿄의 디스토피아 버전을 밤에 탐험하고 항해하세요.
시간이 제한되어 있으며, 매일 밤 어디로 갈지, 누구를 돌볼지에 대한 어려운 결정을 내려야 합니다.
자신뿐만 아니라 돌보는 사람들의 생존을 위해 어디에서나 필요한 자원을 찾아내세요.
돌보는 사람들의 집에 들어가 그들의 필요를 파악하고 필요한 모든 방법으로 그들의 요구를 충족하세요.
사람의 필요가 유지되지 않으면 그들의 몸과 영혼은 서서히 잠복해 있는 악에 취약해지며, 악마의 소유나 죽음과 같은 끔찍한 결과를 초래합니다.
상점과 상인들은 당신의 모든 법적 요구를 충족시킬 수 있지만, 야쿠자는 당신의 더... 비정상적인 요청을 충족시켜줄 수 있습니다.
테이저, 페퍼 스프레이, 신토 유물 및 총기와 같은 다양한 무기로 자신을 방어하세요.

title: Sleep Well Cemetery
description:
게임 정보
You play the role of a gravedigger who takes care of peace and order at the cemetery every day. Your daytime duties seem simple, but they require attention and commitment

However, when darkness falls, the cemetery comes to life in a completely different way. The night brings unexpected challenges – things you don't expect. Every night can surprise you, and you have to be ready to face whatever has decided to go out for an evening walk.


Driving a Melex around the cemetery is not just ordinary transport - time is running out and there are plenty of responsibilities. Sometimes you have to be in a hurry, which means that slightly damaging a tombstone is just... part of the workday.



Assembling coffins is the basis of every day - each one must be carefully prepared, because we never know what we will use it for in the end.



Sometimes the situation at the cemetery requires more than just a shovel and a melex. When things start to get out of control, you need to reinforce yourself.



When the dead decide to leave their graves, your task is clear: gently but firmly guide them back to their resting place. Peace must be restored!



Remember that as a gravedigger you have to be ready for anything.

title: Dataclysm
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Dataclysm - A Digital-Fantasy Trading Card Game!
Embark on a journey into the heart of a digital kingdom unlike any other. Dataclysm invites you to explore a world where ancient data comes alive, and every line of code tells a story waiting to be unraveled. 
The Story Unfolds: Origins and Evolution
"Never search too deeply into the game's files: some information is perhaps better left hidden." - The URL
The story of Dataclysm begins in a basement, within an abandoned computer, where an unfinished game is left behind until an inexplicable event has awakened forgotten lines of code and given them consciousness. This convergence gave rise to diverse archetypes that quickly adapted to "life" on the Motherboard: mysterious SANDBAGS, ARMORER guardians, enigmatic MAGICIAN scholars, tribal RANGER adventurers, majestic DRAGONS, carefree UNDEAD, and many more.

title: Panzer Strike
description:
게임 정보
A new take on a classic military strategy gameplay
Command your troops
Choose your side: USSR or Germany
More than 40 types of realistic military equipment
Wide range of tactics and strategies

title: Lonely House
description:
게임 정보
은은한 로파이(Lo-Fi) 음악이 흐르는 아한 분위기에 몸을 맡기고 집 꾸미기에서 창의성을 표현하고 싶으신가요? 시작해보세요!
­
저희 작은 게임에서는 다음과 같은 것을 할 수 있습니다:
­
다양한 식물과 다른 물건들을 이용하여 집을 꾸밀 수 있습니다
벽에 다른 그래피티 꾸미기
스타일리시한 표지판 추가하고 그 조명을 제어하기
벽의 스타일을 바꾸고 건물의 높이 조절하기
심지어 태양과 날씨까지 제어할 수 있습니다!
­
그리고 벚꽃을 감상하는 것을 잊지 마세요 ⌛️

title: Ad Astra Infinita: The New Evolution
description:
게임 정보
Ad Astra Infinita: The New Evolution is a punkish, sanboxy JRPG focused on mechanical exploration and light environmental storytelling.
Included:
10-20 hours of gameplay across seven or eight regions in the game world
20+ boss battles, some of which are challenging and/or have been tested, but all of which drop cool stuff
150+ Mutagenes to equip to your party, split across eight different categories such as Human Weapons, Mutant Weapons, Mentalities and Structures
150+ skills to use in battle, including physical attacks, Psionics, and Transcends
A fair amount of silly dialogue and environmental interactions, such as increasing or decreasing the number of corpses in a facility, going bowling, and quiz questions
50+ pieces of original music, including some that could be called headbangable slabs of riffage
Not included:
Original art
Cutscenes
Meticulously balanced gameplay
Base building
Much serious dialogue
Dating/Waifus
autokwd: Ad Astra Infinita: The New Evolution

title: Psychic Kung Fu Master
description:
게임 정보
 Official QQ Group：2153025067
C-RPG gameplay, turn-based combat, collect martial arts to become the leader of the martial world, recruit disciples, cultivate martial skills, and compete for supremacy in the world.
"At the start, you receive the script of Xuzhu and gain a century's worth of inner power."
"Meet Elder Tong and take over the Lingjiu Palace."
autokwd: Psychic Kung Fu Master,今古群侠传

title: Experimental gnawer No.44: Observation Record
description:
게임 정보
It was a lab mouse, created from birth to be used in experiments, a product of combining human genes with its own. Due to a moment of negligence by the researchers, it escaped from the fate designed for it and fled to safety.
With a mouse’s instinct to hide and survive in human dwellings, it found refuge in the attic of a certain house after escaping.
Due to work requirements, you’ve been assigned by your superiors to live in a remote house, where you continue your monotonous life. However, each night at midnight, you start to hear strange noises coming from the attic… What kind of beginning awaits you?
❗This is a feeding simulation game designed for female players with slight horror, bloody violence, and a touch of the bizarre. Suitable for ages 17+ in the visual novel genre.❗
The game revolves around raising a half-human, half-mouse creature. You can feed it different foods, teach it various skills, and make different choices that lead the little lab mouse to evolve in various forms—and to different endings between you two.
❗ Warning ❗
The game contains graphic depictions, including dissection, internal organs, abuse, and killing, as well as flashing imagery that may be unsettling and/or trigger seizures in players with photosensitive epilepsy.
This game may not be suitable for all audiences.

title: Mitch
description:
게임 정보
In this story-driven art game, you’ll follow Mitch, who’s just moved to a strange new planet. Join her as she settles in — starting a new job, exploring the city, and meeting all kinds of interesting folk.
Key Features
Explore the city! Jump on the subway and discover each unique neighborhood.
Meet new friends! Develop relationships with a variety of unusual characters. 
Work for a spider chef! Grind away at your new job - serving sandwiches to flies.
Settle in for a heartwarming and introspective story. Watch Mitch as she grows and adapts to her new life. Face challenges, solve problems, and learn lessons as events unfold.
Enjoy open-world freedom grounded by a linear journey. Join Mitch for a week in her life. Each day is full of potential!
100% indie. This is a two-dev project with hand-drawn artwork and an original soundtrack.

title: Neon Hearts City
description:
게임 정보
A private investigator, tracking a missing person, uncovers a conspiracy between humans and androids and a secret that could change everything. Neon Hearts City is a retro point-and-click adventure that thrusts you into a grungy cyberpunk city of the future.
While searching for Audrey, a missing young girl, Elijah Crow's investigation takes a violent turn when one of his leads is silenced.
Somewhere along the shore, androids longing to become human are offered as sacrifices.
Far out at sea, a mysterious tower harbors secrets that could unravel the fabric of civilization.
Suspended in the sky, Roark Prison looms—a colossal airship where thought criminals face imprisonment.
Somehow, these threads are inextricably intertwined.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon
description:
게임 정보
The prophesied end of the Zemurian continent draws near, and so does the launch of humanity's first foray into space. A sudden invitation from Marduk to cooperate in a high-tech training exercise sets Van Arkride, Ashen Chevalier Rean Schwarzer, and Father Kevin Graham on a collision course with the secrets that lay at the very core of Zemuria.
Their paths may diverge, but the ultimate question remains the same: Just what lies beyond the edge of the horizon?
Gameplay Mechanics
Explore detailed locations across the Calvard Republic, strengthen your connections with your allies, and uncover what lies beyond the horizon of Zemuria across three intertwining story paths. Plus, Trails beyond the Horizon introduces new gameplay mechanics to the beloved battle system introduced in Trails through Daybreak, giving you an unprecedented amount of options in both Field and Command Battles. Battle it out in the action-packed Field Battle mode, then swap to the turn-based Command Battle mode to strategically plan out your attacks!
autokwd: The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon

title: Crimson Desert
description:
게임 정보
오픈월드 액션 어드벤처
전례 없는 힘을 둘러싼 전쟁에 휘말린 파이웰 대륙
거친 눈보라가 몰아치는 백색의 산간 지역 크웨이덴부터 끝없는 녹음이 펼쳐진 대지 아카펜, 그리고 사방이 바위산으로 둘러싸인 붉은 사막까지 거대한 자연이 살아 숨 쉬는 파이웰 대륙에 전례 없는 힘을 둘러싼 어두운 전쟁의 그림자가 드리워지고 있습니다.
경이와 신비로 가득 찬 이 방대한 오픈 월드 속에서 베일에 싸인 미지의 세계를 탐험하며, 당신을 막아서는 적들과 치열한 전투를 펼쳐보세요. 
클리프와 회색갈기단
"이것이 우리의 사명이다."
파이웰 대륙을 구하기 위해 분투하는 회색갈기단은 사명을 이루겠다는 집념 하나로 험난한 여정을 이어 나갑니다.
사명으로 향하는 길. 그 위험한 여정에서 목숨을 내주어도 아깝지 않을 동료를 만나기도 하고, 사사건건 방해하는 수많은 적과 마주치기도 합니다.
역경으로 가득 찬 절망 속에 숨겨진 대재앙의 실체를 밝혀내고, 파이웰의 평화를 되찾으세요.

title: Adult Game
description: Adult Game

title: Catfall
description:
게임 정보
A lonely astronaut cat survives a spaceship crash and now embarks on a journey.
Customize your cat's appearance and set off on this short third-person adventure to find the crew: your feline friends and your dearest human.
In this alien world, you'll explore a mysterious extraterrestrial city and attempt to unravel its secrets.
The cat will face puzzles, meet new friends, and encounter dangerous foes. Each step will bring him closer to the truth and unveil new horizons of this cosmic journey.

title: Worldwide Rush
description:
게임 정보
월드와이드 러시를 통해 전 세계 규모의 여객 운송과 관리를 체험해 보세요. 거대한 운송 네트워크를 운영하며 겪는 도전과 승리를 경험하고 글로벌 재벌이 되어 보세요.
본사를 건설하고 강력한 차량들을 모아 승객 수요에 따라 수익성 높은 노선을 전략적으로 연결하세요. 급증하는 시장과 새롭게 떠오르는 목적지를 활용하여 최대 수익을 위해 네트워크를 최적화하고 조정하세요. 호텔과 마케팅에 투자해 승객 증가를 노리되, 방심은 금물입니다! 경쟁 업체들도 주도권을 잡으려 합니다. 협력을 택하시겠어요, 아니면 적대적 인수를 시도하시겠어요?
월드와이드 러시를 새로 시작할 때마다 서로 다른 도전 과제가 주어집니다. 절차적이면서도 유기적인 목적지 생성, 다양한 지역 지형, 이벤트, 현지 차량, 그리고 다른 경쟁자들이 무한한 재플레이 가치를 보장합니다. 세계 최대 규모의 항공기로 하늘을 제패하고, 초고속 열차로 전 세계의 주요 도시를 연결하거나, 분주한 여객선과 호화 크루즈로 바다를 지배해 보세요. 당신의 야망만큼이나 끝없는 가능성이 펼쳐지는 역동적이고 정교한 글로벌 샌드박스에서 실험하고 성장해 보세요.

title: Ithya: Magic Studies
description:
게임 정보
Immerse Yourself in a Fantasy World
Unlock beautifully crafted scenes, from serene forests to mystical ancient cities, each providing a calming background for study and creative pursuits. Discover a world created by artist ‘Blue Turtle’ featuring unique, hand-drawn illustrations.
Set the Perfect Ambience
Set the tone for each session by adjusting the environment to match your mood. Choose between day, night, or rainy settings, and enjoy ambient sounds alongside relaxing fantasy and lofi playlists. 
Personalize Your Room
Make the space your own with customization options. Decorate your room and collect Elementals to add personality to your virtual study space.

title: 99 Managers Futsal Edition
description:
게임 정보
99 Managers Futsal Edition is an open-source sports management game, where you control every aspect of a Futsal team, from tactics to finances and much more.
Work in progress
The gameplay, user interface, and features will change before the final release.
Main responsibilities
Choose tactics and lineup for every game
Guide and change your players during the matches
Win the league and cups on a national and international level
Stay up to date by reading news and emails
Special features
Open Source under AGPL-3.0-or-later license
Fantasy teams and players that can be shared with the generation seed
Light/dark themes
More about 99 Managers
99 Managers will be a series of sports management games for different team sports. It is open source and also respects your privacy, because it has no trackers or similar privacy-invading software integrated. Being open source means, that you can see the source code of the game and see how it is made. Besides that, you are also able to suggest bug fixes, new features or create your own customized version of the game.
Made with Godot Engine 4 and much love.

title: Dino Topia
description:
게임 정보
"Dino Topia" is a sandbox roguelike game set in a prehistoric world.
Tame and collect a variety of dinosaur companions to help you build, farm, and work together in creating your ultimate home. Take on thrilling battles and face monsters of increasing difficulty with your loyal dinosaur allies by your side.
Sandbox Construction
Gather resources, unlock new technologies, and freely design and expand your home base into a thriving settlement.
Farming and Production
Work hand-in-hand with your dinosaur companions to plant, water, fertilize, and harvest crops. Together, build a fully functional and flourishing farm.

title: OFF
description:
게임 정보
Allow me to confess that I find you quite tangible for a phantasmagorical being.
I must say, this is really quite strange. You are the first living being I have ever met in this place. Nevertheless, I will introduce myself. I am the Judge.
The Batter has a sacred mission to fulfill.
He seeks to purify the world. You, then, the controller, the soul that he harbors, must aid him in this laudable task. Alongside my sportive companion you will find it necessary to solve puzzles, rain blows upon certain hostile individuals of our wild zones, and oversee the headways and logistics of a network of swan boats and interurban locomotives.
I, too, travel widely among the zones of this world.
Open your wings and fly toward the zones ahead without hesitation! All of them are filled with strange and enchanting beings as well as every modern convenience. All of them appear, it must be said, to require the beneficient application of our friend the Batter’s muscular wrist. Do not worry, my dear phantasm—I, the Judge, will be with you (in spirit and body) at all the most crucial moments of your quest.

title: Vicious Cycle
description:
게임 정보
Vicious Cycle is a first person Horror game where you venture into a dark forest by bike and on foot. Brave hazardous trails on your bike until the path is blocked. Then, explore abandoned sites on foot while solving puzzles and encountering supernatural creatures. Can you survive the cursed forest?
Survive haunted trails
With only your Bicycle light as a guide, ride through forest trails filled with roadblocks and Creatures out to get you. Be wary of your surroundings as they can come from anywhere!
Investigate the eerie Forest
Venture into long abandoned areas of the forest where mysteries and danger await. Uncover the stories of the people that were once there.

title: Cozy
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Cozy Town, a delightful slice-of-life farming adventure where you can create your dream homestead, form meaningful connections, and enjoy the peaceful rhythms of small-town living. Whether you're an experienced farmer or a newcomer to the countryside, there's always something exciting waiting for you in this enchanting world.
Step into a quaint, picturesque village surrounded by lush forests, sparkling rivers, and fields of opportunity. Cozy Town is alive with vibrant characters, seasonal festivals, and endless possibilities for relaxation and discovery. Whether you're growing crops, fishing by the lake, or helping your neighbors, every moment is a chance to find joy in the little things.

title: ARKA KRAYA
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to discover what is hidden beyond the ordinary?
There aren't a lot of exciting adventures in the life of a modern teenager.
But you can change that if you want to. Go camping with your friends with a night in the woods around a campfire. And when strange things start happening, the choice is yours: stay back or go on an adventure.
You will see that the world is still full of mysteries and riddles that even modern science cannot solve.
You are going to meet some extraordinary characters. Will you be able to find the right approach to them in order to continue your journey?
Is it always necessary to tell the truth? Is it always wrong to be angry? Your emotions, words and actions have an impact on the world around you. And who says there is only one right approach?
ARKA KRAYA is an adventure game in a world where magical realism meets your imagination.
We were inspired by the works of Hayao Miyazaki and tried to create a story, the main character of which will be you.
One story - two worlds and several endings
Control over the words and emotions of the characters
Graphic style inspired by classic American animation and Japanese anime
Frame-by-frame animation of characters that are brought to life by the artists hands
Unique soundtrack combining the sound of classical instruments and synthesized sounds

title: NOT TACTICAL VR
description:
게임 정보
NOT TACTICAL VR is the single-player VR extraction game.
Use the special weapons collected across different maps to lighten the load of your missions.
Realistic combat experience
Complete missions on immersive battlefields using a variety of items based on real-world weapons and gear. Hold your gun with both hands, reload magazines, and pull the trigger. Use complex gun physics and injury and healing systems to escape the area.
Adapt and upgrade
Tailor and upgrade your arsenal to suit your playstyle from your home base with our modding system.

title: Fischer's Fishing Journey
description:
게임 정보
고양이 피셔와 함께하는 업무와 공부 시간
《냐옹이 낚시 일기》에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 귀여운 고양이 피셔를 데스크톱에 배치하고, 그를 최고의 공부 및 업무 파트너로 삼아보세요. 게임을 데스크톱 배경화면으로 설정하면, 피셔가 화면 한쪽에서 조용히 낚시를 즐깁니다. 또는 화면 위에 고정해 하루 종일 함께할 수도 있습니다. 낮과 밤이 바뀌고, 비와 맑음이 교차하는 다채로운 동적 풍경이 몰입감 있는 힐링 분위기를 선사합니다. 바람이 살랑이는 소리, 시냇물이 졸졸 흐르는 부드러운 효과음과 함께라면, 공부와 업무 시간이 더욱 평온하고 여유롭게 느껴질 거예요.
바쁜 일상 속에서 잠시 쉬어가며, 피셔와 함께 여행을 떠나보세요. 행성 곳곳의 다양한 풍경을 탐험하고, 특별한 자연의 아름다움을 감상하며, 여유로운 낚시의 즐거움을 만끽할 수 있습니다.
가볍고 힐링되는 방치형 낚시
복잡한 조작 없이, 피셔가 모든 낚시를 대신해 줍니다! 당신은 여유 시간이 날 때마다 낚싯대와 미끼를 확인하고, 물고기가 얼마나 잡혔는지 살펴보기만 하면 됩니다. 낚은 물고기는 판매하여 수익을 얻을 수도 있고, 어항에 넣어 추가적인 보상을 획득할 수도 있습니다. 이렇게 얻은 물고기 코인으로 미끼를 구매하고, 낚싯대를 업그레이드하며, 어항을 확장해 더욱 다양한 물고기와 새로운 낚시터를 개방해 보세요!

title: Scenes from the Heart - Part 1
description:
게임 정보
Scenes from the Heart is a Visual Novel about a mature but lonely boy (you) who struggles to connect with others due to his superiority complex. His life changes when he befriends Chisaki Namichi, who faces bullying for her unique eye color at elementary school. Together, they later discover Konaka Motomi, a new transferred classmate with her own quirks.
As they bond, Konaka introduces improvisation theater to Chisaki and you. Inspired, Chisaki initiates her long dream of a visual novel development project, involving the player and Konaka. Despite initial conflicts during the process, they succeed and win an award for their demo, as a menacing shadow is watching over them, hinting at challenges ahead...
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The story will be split into two parts:
Part 1 is more like a prologue to introduce the starting point and the main cast.
Part 2 will be diving deeper into everyday life and branching the story at a certain point.
[ Scenes from the Heart is also my first game and Visual Novel ever, so naturally there will be some flaws included most likely, but those I aim to fix on Part 2, which I planned to be developed later if (and when) its Kickstarter-campaign succeeds. ]
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

title: Nexus FPV
description:
게임 정보
In Nexus, you are a force of nature. Weave through gunfire, master aerial combat, and rain destruction from above in this high-stakes FPV drone roguelike shooter. Pilot advanced combat drones through intense missions where split-second decisions matter. Death sends you back to base - but your tech, skills, and power grow with every run.
Master the Skies
High-speed combat that rewards skill and daring. Start as a rookie, become an ace. Dive through obstacles, chain perfect attack runs, and strike from impossible angles. Go loud with guns blazing or strike with surgical precision. The skies are yours to dominate.

title: Fish Stick Protocol
description:
게임 정보
스웬덴 갤러리에 어서 오세요! 당신은 공식적으로 오너의 갤러리에 놓을 유물을 확보하는 직책을 맡았습니다. 이력서가 없다고요? 그저 절차를 따라 모험 속으로 (말 그대로) 곤두박질치면 됩니다.
근무 시간이 시작되면 우선 해동부터 해야 합니다. 최대 8인의 플레이어가 한 번에 해동될 수 있습니다. 장기들이 깨어나는 동안에는 간지러울 수 있습니다.

title: Dream Garden
description:
게임 정보
잠시 휴식을 취하며 아늑한 정원을 만드는 데 몰두하고 싶으신가요? 드림 가든에서는 고전적인 일본식 젠 가든이든 연못, 물고기, 백합이 있는 정원이든 원하는 모든 종류의 정원을 만들 수 있습니다.

드림 가든은 작고 귀여운 정원 디오라마를 만드는 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 다양한 도구, 식물, 장식, 커스터마이징이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다. 모든 것을 시도해보고 꿈의 정원을 만들어 보세요.



정원에 사용할 나무, 덤불, 돌, 잔디, 꽃 등이 가득합니다. 원하는 대로 장식을 배치하고, 언제든지 회전하고, 크기를 조정하고, 속성을 변경할 수 있는 완벽한 자유도. 아이템을 한 번에 하나씩 배치하거나 브러시를 사용하여 정원 전체에 간단히 페인트를 칠할 수 있습니다. 원하는 것은 무엇이든 자유롭게 만들 수 있습니다.



풍경을 바꾸고, 강이나 호수를 추가하고, 언덕을 만들고, 정원을 모래, 잔디 또는 자갈로 채우세요. 사전 설정이 없어 나만의 독특한 정원을 만들 수 있습니다. 모든 도구를 조합하여 최고의 디오라마를 만들어 보세요.



정원을 진정한 일본 선 정원처럼 꾸며보세요. 모래 패턴을 만들고, 조합하여 나만의 패턴을 만들거나 마우스를 움직여 패턴이 저절로 만들어지도록 하세요. 직접 해보면 갈퀴를 들고 모래를 긁어모으는 듯한 기분이 들 것입니다.



다양한 조명, 시간, 심지어 계절에 따라 정원을 살펴보세요. 매우 상세한 날씨 사용자 지정 기능을 제공합니다. 비를 켜거나 끌 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 강수량을 사용자 지정할 수 있고, 사계절 중 하나를 선택할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 늦가을이나 초봄과 같은 중간 계절을 선택할 수 있어 잔디가 이미 피기 시작했지만 아직 눈이 조금 남아 있을 때 결과를 얻을 수 있습니다. 기분에 맞게 정원을 꾸미세요.



정원을 만드는 명상적인 과정에 긴장을 풀고 몰입하세요. 컴퓨터 앞에 앉아서 정원을 만드는 것이 아니라 직접 이 정원 앞에 앉아 손으로 장식을 배치하며 분위기를 느끼고 상상할 수 있도록 모든 것을 준비했으며, 이 모든 것이 수작업으로 만들어진 차가운 음악과 함께 분위기를 더해주는 멋진 음악과 함께합니다.

title: Backrooms
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Backrooms—where reality ends, and terror begins.
In this survival-horror experience, you’re trapped in the unsettling liminal spaces of the Backrooms, armed with only your bodycam and your wits. Explore a procedurally shifting maze of endless halls, decaying rooms, and dark corridors, each more unsettling than the last. But beware—something is always watching.
Survival Is Key:
Manage your resources carefully. Batteries, food, and sanity are finite, and the creatures lurking in the shadows are anything but forgiving. Every step brings you closer to escape—or an untimely end.
Solve, Gather, Craft:
The Backrooms aren’t just about survival. Solve intricate puzzles to unlock new areas, gather mysterious artifacts, and craft tools to fend off danger or open hidden pathways. Your ability to adapt is your only chance.
Dynamic Horror:
Experience a world that shifts and twists around you, where nothing stays the same for long. Walls move, rooms disappear, and every sound could mean the arrival of an unspeakable entity.

title: Games of the Monarch's Eye
description:
게임 정보
Steel, strategy, sabotage - or forbidden magic? How far will you go to defeat your greatest rival and win glory in the grandest tournament in the entire realm? Will you win back your honor or spark a revolution?
Games of the Monarch’s Eye is a Silk Road inspired interactive fantasy novel by Saffron Kuo. It’s entirely text-based, includes hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
After a decade in disgrace, you have returned to your home city of Varze to compete for the title of Monarch’s Eye. In this grand tournament, the bravest Varzians compete in games of Intellect, Heart, and Might. The winner becomes the Monarch’s most trusted guard and advisor, gaining wealth, fame, and honor – everything that you have lost. The only catch? The current Eye - and therefore your main competition - is Casiola, once your childhood friend and now your bitterest rival.
But while you were gone, the city has grown volatile. Powerful factions vie for dominance and the guilds’ professional differences now spill over into political rivalries. On one side, the idealist Artisans, rumored to still dabble in the ancient magic of Celestia as they seek perfection in their crafts. On the other, the ambitious and pragmatic Merchants, constantly chasing fame and profit. Caught between them is the Monarch, striving for a peaceful revitalization for Varze - if only it can happen before the city tears itself apart with an all-out revolution. And the Games might make the perfect opportunity for the factions to make their first moves.
As you prepare for the Games, you must also navigate this factional strife. How will you forge your path to victory? Will you hone your blades, charm the public with your silver tongue, try to get ahead of your opponents with your careful observation of their strengths and weaknesses, or just cheat your way to the top? Will you dive into politics, currying favor with one faction or the other; or will you try to float aloof above them? Do you dare to seek wisdom in the stars, or from forgotten ancient tomes? Whatever path you take, your old rival is right on your heels - and if you’re not careful, you’ll fall behind and lose your honor once more.
Play as male, female, or nonbinary; gay, straight, bi, pan, or aromantic.
Push Varze’s culture towards commerce or craft, peace or war, tradition or modernity.
Compete in high-stakes tournaments to test your wits, strength, and eloquence!
Regain your lost honor through a performance of stellar integrity - or deceive, and sabotage every single one of your opponents! And what will you do if you find yourself fighting in the ring against your true love?
Uncover lost tomes of once-forbidden magic, and reveal the secrets of the stars!

title: Floorball Practice
description:
게임 정보
Floorball Practice
Step into the immersive world of Floorball Practice, the ultimate training ground for Floorball enthusiasts! Built on the cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5, this game pushes the boundaries of realism with ray tracing, lumen lighting, and detailed characters. Designed to fine-tune your Floorball skills, this Early Access title offers an open-world experience like no other—laying the foundation for the next phase in Floorball gaming.
Key Features
Explore an Open World
Travel through a sprawling open world featuring multiple Floorball halls connected by a train system. Venture into lush forests to jog or run, boosting your stamina while taking in stunning visuals across a dynamic weather system with a fully functioning day and night cycle.
Master Your Skills
Practice like a pro with objectives and skill-based activities designed to refine your Floorball techniques.
Practice shooting with customizable sticks, balls, rinks, goals, and Floorball fields—designed with gear you can unlock and arrange to your liking.
Unlock advanced animations and shooting finishes to perfect your style.
Customize Your Experience
Choose between male or female characters, with options for left- or right-handed playstyles.
Build your identity with a wide range of clothing, sticks, and training gear available through an in-game currency system.
Use the in-game phone system to order gear, set GPS destinations, manage playlists, and more.
Practice Alone or with a Friend
Switch seamlessly between first-person and third-person perspectives to fully immerse yourself in the action. Play solo, or share the Floorball journey with a friend or sibling in mode.

title: Silent North
description:
게임 정보
Players must survive the north using anything at their disposal. You can fight as a lone wolf in the wild or with friends in a home. Every encounter can change the outcome of your journey in the North. From fierce battles for resources to alliances, adaptability and resilience are important in this ever-changing landscape, where fate hangs on your ability to survive and the unpredictable forces of Nature and the Infected.
In the Swiss Alps, survival means scavenging gear from villages, like damaged clothes. Gather resources to keep yourself alive, or battling foes for superior equipment. For the boldest, venturing into quarantined zones yields invaluable loot. Gear up and adapt to survive.

title: Shape of Dreams
description:
게임 정보
Shape of Dreams는 MOBA식 조작과 시스템에 액션 로그라이크를 융합한 게임입니다.
꿈의 세계를 탐험하며 자신의 기억을 편집하고 자신만의 영웅을 만들어보세요!
꿈과 현실의 중간계, 여울
어느 날, 꿈의 세계와 현실 세계의 경계가 무너져 차원의 균열을 통해 중간 세계인 "여울"로 왕래할 수 있게 되었습니다. 꿈의 세계의 끝에 다다르면 원하는 무엇이든 이룰 수 있다는 출처 불명의 소문과 함께, 영웅들은 각자만의 이유를 가지고 미지의 세계로 발을 내딛습니다.

title: Crown Gambit
description:
게임 정보


Crown Gambit은 혼란과 정치적 불안에 시달리는 수도에서 세 명의 성기사를 험준한 길로 인도하는 스토리 중심의 전략 게임입니다.

반란군 중 한 명에게 충성을 맹세하고 그들이 권력을 잡을 수 있도록 도와주세요. 자신의 원칙을 따라야 하지만 선택에는 종종 대가가 따르므로 조심하세요!

음모자들 중에서 한 편을 선택하고 권력에 목마른 기사부터 교활한 귀족, 반항하는 평민까지 조상의 유물을 사용하여 적을 물리치세요.

왕국을 구하기 위해 무엇을 희생하시겠습니까? 어떤 왕위 계승자를 옹호하시겠습니까? 왕국의 운명은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.


신비로운 세력이 어둠 속에서 배후 공작을 펼치면서 메오드레드 왕국의 힘의 균형이 끔찍한 정치적 위기로 인해 핵심까지 흔들리고 있으며, 왕위를 노리는 각 세력은 군대를 규합하여 왕관을 탈취하고, 평민들은 반란을 일으키고 위험은 여전히 상승하고 있습니다... 이 혼란의 중심에서 당신은 왕관의 유물을 다루는 초급 성기사 세 명을 플레이하여 왕국이 혼돈에 빠지지 않도록 어려운 결정을 내려야 합니다.

스토리를 따라 지독한 선택을 통해 성기사의 개성을 만들고 자신의 원칙에 충실하세요. 현명하게 동맹을 선택하고 경쟁을 헤쳐나가 음모를 저지하세요. 하지만 누구도 믿지 마세요. 혼돈의 시대에서는 이중성이 최고의 덕목입니다.


근접 전술 전투에서 세 명의 성기사, 피에 복종하는 호전적인 전사 Aliza, 메이스를 휘두르는 성직자 Hael, 닻을 흔드는 탱커 Rollo를 플레이하세요. 신성한 유물 무기로 적을 박살 내면서 강렬한 공격 애니메이션을 통해 타격의 위력을 경험하세요. 다른 강력한 성기사들 또한 자신의 충성심을 따르고 싸움 없이는 쓰러지지 않으므로 경계심을 늦추지 마세요.

여정 중에 준비를 마치고 각 성기사의 덱을 신중하게 구성하여 방해가 되는 모든 장애물을 극복하세요. 잘 정비된 단결된 팀이 되어 스타일리시하게 적과 싸우고 모든 타격을 성공시키세요.


신성한 유물을 통해 어둠과 고대의 힘을 조종하고 선조의 은총을 소환하여 전투의 흐름을 바꾸세요. 당신은 확실히 적을 더 빨리 베어낼 수 있겠지만 이 신성한 힘의 대가는 당신의 영혼일 수도 있으니 조심하세요...

title: Yooka-Replaylee
description:
게임 정보
Yooka-Replaylee는 Banjo-Kazooie 및 Donkey Kong Country 게임 개발의 주력 개발진이 만든 3D 인디 플랫폼 수집 게임, Yooka-Laylee (2017)의 리마스터링 완전판입니다. 유카(녹색 친구)와 레일리(보라색 친구)로 구성된 사랑스러운 콤비와 함께 다시 한번 거대하고 아름다운 오픈월드를 탐험하면서 새롭게 리믹스된 챌린지와 과거의 인기 챌린지를 즐겨 보세요. 아름다운 오케스트라 연주 사운드트랙과 함께 제공됩니다. 이제 맵이 생겼다는 것도 저희가 얘기했던가요? 반짝이는 새로운 화폐! 그리고 다양한 사용자 편집 옵션도 생겼어요! 사랑스러운 이 콤비가 더욱 선명해지고, 소리도 더욱 경쾌해지고, 움직임도 훨씬 더 날렵해졌어요! 



악독한 기업의 회장인 캐피털 B가 온 세상의 책을 전부 훔쳐서 돈으로 만들어 버리는 계략을 꾸미고 있어요. 하지만 세상에서 가장 강력한 책은 모험심 강한 우리의 콤비, 유카와 레일리가 살고 있는 난파선의 만에 숨겨져 있답니다!  소중한 책을 빼앗긴 우리의 주인공들은 다채로운 캐릭터와 반짝이는 수집품으로 넘쳐나는 환상적이고 놀라운 세상에서 기상천외한 모험을 시작합니다.

과연 당신은 책 속에 담긴 마법의 페이지를 전부 찾고 이 세상을 구할 수 있을까요?




일러스트레이션과 애니메이션을 개선하고 게임 구동 성능 및 해상도를 강화하여, 우리의 사랑스러운 콤비가 훨씬 더 멋지고 날렵하게 다시 태어났습니다.
새롭게 개선된 기존의 챌린지와 완전히 새롭게 만들어진 챌린지를 찾고 수행해 보세요!
캐피털 B의 어설픈 부하들이 힘들게 번 코인을 세상 곳곳에 흘리고 다니고 있어요. 하이보리 타워의 공식 화폐를 모아 비디오 게임 업계에서 가장 많은 사랑을 받는 생각하는 자판기, 벤디에 사용하세요!
게임 속 세상에 푹 빠져보세요! 새로운 월드맵과 챌린지 트래커를 통해 자기가 어디 있고 무엇을 해야 하는지 쉽게 파악할 수 있습니다. 야호!
토닉이 새로운 맛과 함께 돌아왔어요! 게임 진행 방식을 완전히 바꿀 수 있는 강화를 여러 개 장착할 수 있기 때문에, 자기 플레이 스타일에 맞게 자유롭게 조정할 수 있답니다. 그것뿐만 아니라, 현대적이고 유행에 민감한 모험가를 위해 벤디에 새로운 상품이 추가되었습니다.
새롭게 개선된 이동 세트를 통해 좀 더 자유롭게 이동하고, 새로워진 카메라 컨트롤을 통해 멋진 액션을 손쉽게 포착할 수 있게 됐습니다.
유명한 비디오 게임 작곡가인 Grant Kirkhope(Banjo-Kazooie)와 David Wise(Donkey Kong Country)의 오리지널 음악이 오케스트라 연주로 아름답게 편곡되어 돌아왔습니다. 그러니까 이제부터 아름다운 선율을 경험해 보세요.

title: Pixel P.I.
description:
게임 정보
You are Pixel P.I., a hacker detective who has to solve old cases to find clues about her own past.
After an unknown incident Pixel lost her memories, and the only link to her past is a list of old cases that she found. What's wrong with these cases? Why were they never solved? And what kind of clues do they contain about Pixel's past? These are all mysteries that you will need to solve in order to help Pixel.
These cases will force you to reason, to make deductions, and ultimately to give them resolution. You will have to explain your reasoning to your companion, to make sure you are not making any mistake and driving the investigation to the wrong place. They will keep you grounded, and let you know if your logic is faulty, because in this game you will write the deductions.
The Game Features 6 Cases
The axe murderer
The broken case
The remorseful doctor
????
????
The final case
Each case features a new set of characters that you can interact with.
Game Mechanics
Interrogation: You can get clues and information about the case by asking your own questions to suspects and witnesses.
Contradict: Show a clue and explain why it shows that the person is lying to force them to correct their statement.
Accuse suspect: Solve the case by presenting all your clues against someone.

title: Fat Goblins
description:
게임 정보
Fat Goblins에 오신 것을 환영합니다, 여기서 혼돈, 통통함, 그리고 클래스 기반 전투가 16대16 거대 성전투의 형태로 함께합니다!

고블린이 가득하고, 모자를 훔치며, 공주를 살찌우는 팀 기반 전투에 대비하세요!


다양한 모자를 착용하여 파이어볼을 발사하고, 팀원을 치유하며, 화살을 쏘거나 적 팀을 헤치고 나아가세요!


성벽을 돌파하고 적 성의 포로가 된 통통한 공주를 구출하세요!

title: Mecha BREAK
description:
게임 정보
대재난 이후, 탄화규소 기반의 광물 '코라이트'가 황폐해진 지구의 에너지 산업에 희망의 불씨를 가져왔습니다. 하지만 이러한 축복은 잠시, 동시에 끔찍한 저주를 가져왔습니다. 병원성과 통제 불가능한 확산성으로 코라이트는 인류가 거주할 수 있는 마지막 공간마저 서서히 잠식했습니다. 그리고 30년도 되지 않아 코라이트로 오염된 '페이딩 구역'이 전 지구를 뒤덮고 인류를 멸종 위기로 몰아넣고 있습니다.
혼란의 시대 속에서 주인공은 전설적인 파일럿이 되어 3세대 메카 브레이크를 조종하고, S.H.A.D.O.W. 부대의 일원으로 세상의 진실을 찾아 인류의 미래를 위해 맞서 싸워야 합니다.
돌격형, 근접형, 저격형, 정찰형, 지원형… 다양한 특성을 가진 강력한 메카 중 자신에게 맞는 메카를 선택하고, 3vs3, 6vs6, PvPvE 세 가지 모드에서 전장을 누비며 숨 막히는 속도감과 액션의 쾌감을 느껴보세요!
3vs3 / 6vs6
승리를 위해 어떤 대가도 감수해야 하는 3vs3 모드, 그리고 개인의 기술뿐만 아니라 팀 전술이 승리의 핵심이 되는 6vs6 모드까지, 아드레날린이 솟구치는 전투가 당신을 기다리고 있습니다.
요새 형태로 탄막을 퍼붓고, 빔 캐논으로 적군의 진영을 태우고, 미사일로 전장을 초토화시켜 보세요. 배틀 엑스, 할버드, 광선검 등 다양한 근접 무기를 활용해 적의 전선을 파괴하고, 번개처럼 빠른 기동력과 강력한 화력을 체험해 보실 수 있을 겁니다!
PvPvE 철수

title: Sister Ray
description:
게임 정보
Sister Ray is an RPG-survival about the brutal daily life of a drug addicted artist named Ray, who takes care of her little sister. Look after your condition, so no one finds out about the addiction. Improve your drawing and social skills. Do everything to get cash for another fix. Survive and look for a way out.



Live each game day as you see fit. The only conditions are to survive and not get caught.
Explore the city streets and visit important locations - the school, bar, underground casino, police station, etc.
Look for places to sketch or draw at home, raising your skill and opening new abilities. Maybe you’ll get to the exhibition after all?
Any action inevitably advances the time of day - plan ahead and do not miss important events.



Selling paintings, part-time work, speculation, pickpocketing - there are a great many ways to get some cash. But what will you spend it on?
Relationships with others are an extremely fragile thing. Try not to lose your friends.
The younger sister is the only person close to you. All your bad habits will become an example for her to follow. She shouldn't find out about the addiction.

title: Aldian of Ancients
description:
게임 정보
Take control of dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures and explore a beautifully crafted world filled with threats and secrets. Build a pack/herd with your friends and take on the challenges of the land. Fight other players for survival and sustenance, conquer territories and nurture your offspring to adulthood. Always be on the lookout since danger not only comes from other players and the environment but sources beyond your comprehension...

The Lands of AldianImmerse yourself in an ancient world, lost in the shuffle of evolution, populated with creatures that promulgate intrigue. Explore different biomes, find hidden secrets and maybe you might stumble upon things that might bewilder you. 

The Denizens of Aldian

title: The Greys: Human Abductions
description:
게임 정보
The Greys: Human Abductions에서 당신은 실종되어 죽은 것으로 추정된 동생의 신비한 집을 물려받은 남자의 입장에 서게 됩니다. 동생의 집을 탐험하면서, 극비 문서, 녹음, 외계인과의 만남에 대한 불안한 증거로 가득 찬 숨겨진 다락방을 발견합니다. 미스터리에 더 깊이 파고들수록 동생과 같은 공포, 이상한 소리, 설명할 수 없는 사건, 심지어 외계인 납치의 무서운 가능성까지 경험하게 됩니다. 동생의 실종 뒤에 숨은 진실을 발견할 것인가, 아니면 알려지지 않은 세력의 다음 희생자가 될 것인가?

특징 및 게임플레이:

- 서랍을 열고, 문서를 집어 들고 검사하고, 녹음을 재생하고, 조명, 문, 숨겨진 수납공간과 상호작용하세요.

- 열쇠를 찾고, 코드를 해독하고, 미스터리한 상자를 여는 복잡한 퍼즐을 풀어보세요.

- 이상한 소음, 발소리, 속삭임, 으스스한 외계인 현상 등 무시무시한 소리를 경험해 보세요. 오디오 디자인은 게임의 핵심 요소로, 환경을 탐험하고 상호작용할 때 공포와 두려움을 증폭시킵니다.

- 설명할 수 없는 이벤트가 발생하고, 불빛이 깜빡이고, 눈가에 그림자가 움직입니다. 이상한 이벤트가 확대되기 시작하면 숨을 곳을 찾아야 합니다.

- 이야기를 더 깊이 파고들수록 공포는 더욱 커집니다. 더 많은 것을 알아낼수록 위험은 더욱 현실적으로 다가옵니다.

- 게임에는 여러 엔딩이 있으며, 게임 내내 여러분의 선택이 엔딩에 영향을 미칩니다.

title: Trainatic
description:
게임 정보
Watch your train grow from a tiny engine to a screen-clearing machine.
Unlock new cars and discover game-changing synergies.

title: The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows
description:
게임 정보
As the family dog, it's your job to protect your loved ones from danger - especially from the kind they can't see. In The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows, play as a dog defending its family from an onslaught of paranormal entities.


The Good Dog offers a variety of game modes. In Protect, you must survive the night as waves of entities enter your home and attempt to harm your sleeping family. Distract the entities by squeaking your toys or barking, or attack them if they get too close - whatever it takes to keep them away from your family. In Fetch, you must explore a range of dilapidated locations to retrieve something for your owner while avoiding the entities roaming the level.

In the Story Mode, explore the game's detailed environments to discover why the paranormal creatures have targeted you. Each environment can be explored freely, with some areas of the map opening up as time passes and as you make discoveries about the world. Solving each puzzle will bring you one step closer to saving your family. Be cautious, however; the paranormal will be tracking you throughout your journey. Using your unique abilities, you’ll need to avoid these threats at all costs - or take a chance at slowing them down with tooth and claw.


Use your keen sense of smell to search the area for tools. Roll around in the dirt to cover your scent and hide from threats. Dig up hidden items to solve puzzles and fight back against the paranormal. Bark at certain immaterial entities to disperse them, or at physical entities to draw their attention away from your family.


With over a dozen unique breeds to choose from, each with a different set of stats and abilities, you'll be able to play the game the way you want. Will you choose a small breed to fit into tighter spaces and evade danger, or a larger breed with more health and attacking power? Will you prioritize your stamina, tracking capabilities, stealth, or something else entirely? No matter how you want to play, there will be a breed for you.

title: MARINES VS GOD
description:
게임 정보


2400년, 지구의 과학자들은 상상할 수 없는 보물이 가득한 ‘신들의 행성’을 발견했습니다. 하지만 각 행성은 강력한 수호신의 보호를 받고 있습니다. 가장 용감한 자들만이 해병대에 합류하여 이 위험한 행성으로의 짧고도 위험한 임무에 도전할 수 있습니다.





가능한 많은 신성한 보물을 모으고, 괴물 무리와 함정, 파괴적인 재앙을 일으키는 신의 공격에서 살아남아 행성에서 탈출하세요.


최고의 주문을 전략적으로 선택하고 마나를 현명하게 관리하며, 함정을 설치하고 생명체를 소환하며 원소의 힘을 조종해 해병대를 처치하세요.



— 주변의 해병대를 공격합니다.

— 번개로 일정 지역에 피해를 줍니다.

— 적을 속이는 허상을 만듭니다.

— 짧은 지연 후 큰 피해를 입힙니다.

— 선택한 위치에 벽을 생성합니다.







• 화성 황무지
• 미래의 도시
• 정글 미로
• 얼음 요새
• 버려진 문명


제우스, 악마의 군주, 아나르 드림스(Anar Dreams)


수호자, 저격수, 의무병 또는 기술자


고전적인 비대칭 모드 (4대1) — 신과 해병대의 대결
PvP, PvE, 협동 및 혼합 모드로 친구 또는 AI와 플레이 가능 (최대 8명)

title: Lands of Achra
description:
게임 정보
The Lands of Achra roll forth...

Continuing the universe of Path of Achra and inspired by Conquest of Elysium, it is the second passion project of this grateful solo developer, who thanks you for visiting



Choose from a huge list of factions and customize it with various sub-cultures and cults. Unlock more as you play. Gigantic variety is the goal: fight as a single swordmaster with legendary strength, a rampaging dragon, a swarming horde of Rat-Men, a phalanx of the Garnet City...

Discover strange artifacts to empower your army. Construct buildings to spread your territory and secure resources. Create devastating combos by picking from numerous "acts," such as burning weapons, revolution, summoning a buried god...

Survive the unfolding turn-based world as its denizens grasp for power, seeking glory, ever-elusive...

title: LEGION
description:
게임 정보
LEGION is an epic real-time strategy game that brings the thrill of large-scale battles to both mobile devices and desktop platforms. Engage in intense, short skirmishes on diverse maps as you command massive armies, each consisting of hundreds of units.
Key Features
Cross-Platform Play: Experience seamless gameplay across mobile and desktop, allowing you to take the battle wherever you go.
Real-Time Strategy: Strategize in real time as you control every aspect of your squads on the battlefield.
Complete Squad Control: Take charge of your units with full precision—raise shields, adjust formations, and control formation density to outmaneuver your opponent.
Realistic Physics: Watch as cavalry charges tear through formations of archers, creating dynamic and believable battle scenes.
Variety of Maps: Fight across 3 unique battlefields, each offering different tactical challenges and opportunities.
Campaign Mode: Immerse yourself in a gripping campaign, honing your skills and learning the ropes before taking the fight online.
Online Multiplayer Battles: Test your strategic prowess against players worldwide in exciting real-time skirmishes.
Ranked Matches: Climb the ranks in competitive battles, proving your skills as a commander.
Unit Upgrades: Customize and improve your squads to create a fighting force tailored to your style of play.
Command, strategize, and dominate in LEGION—the ultimate RTS experience where every decision counts. Will your tactics bring victory, or will your army fall before a superior foe?

title: Tearscape
description:
게임 정보
Discover a Gothic world in this 2D top-down action-adventure, blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and pixel art inspired by Game Boy Color classics. Fight monstrous foes, unlock new abilities, and explore a non-linear map filled with hidden secrets and dangerous challenges.
Features
Master precise combat, where every strike and dodge matters. Strategically manage your stamina by carefully considering each move as you face off against grotesque enemies. You have a limited number of healing flasks—use them wisely and plan your moments to recover carefully. Upgrade your character's stats to remain effective and competitive in combat.

title: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search  a Dead Body
description:
게임 정보
"Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?"
This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient Japanese tomb!
Game Features
Play as Kofun and go on an adventure to search for a dead body to bury in his body!
Complete tasks on your To-Do List to progress the story!
Interact with all sorts of things in your surroundings and collect Action Points!
Use Action Points to get new skills and hints for your adventure!
Kofun
A young boy who lives in Friendly Park. Believes he's an ancient Japanese tomb.
Thinks keyhole-shaped tombs are the coolest of them all.
Haniwa
A young funerary clay sculpture boy who's always full of energy.
He's the one who first shows Kofun the outside world.
autokwd: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search  a Dead Body

title: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall
description:
게임 정보
Year 1645. Scholar Fang Zhiyou descended into madness following the suicide of his childhood friend. Overwhelmed with grief, unable to continue writing, and chased by past traumas; he began drowning his sorrows in alcohol and developed a mental condition that made him see people as beasts.
On the 24th day of the fourth lunar month, after drinking heavily, Fang collapsed in the street on his way home. When he woke up, he found himself transported to the Kingdom of Shituo, a city he had once introduced in his book.
A book that described how, 500 years before the Great Sage Sun Wukong’s journey, the Yaoguai wreaked havoc on Shituo, slaughtering and terrorizing its people under the command of the Golden Winged Great Peng.
Just as in his book, he starts experiencing the chaos and the horrifying reality of the war. Amid the murders, rapes, and the burning city, Fang lost all hope of survival. Yet, that changed when he encountered a young girl.
A girl looked extremely similar to Su Lingyan, an old friend who had tragically ended her life three years earlier. The courtesan Su Lingyan, his childhood sweetheart and his only confidante. She even shared the same childhood nickname, “Little Swan.”
Determined to protect her, Fang vowed to survive and ensure her safety until the massacre was over, no matter the cost.
Story Background
There are two storylines set in the late Ming Dynasty, “Memo” and “Recall”.
Memo chapters:
This part covers the 10 days following the 24th day of the fourth lunar month, 1645.
After Emperor Chongzhen’s suicide on Mei Mountain, Wu Sangui led Qing soldiers into the northern plains of the former Ming Empire. The Ming royal family fled south, establishing the Southern Ming Dynasty to resist the Qing invasion.
The Qing army divided into two forces. One attacked the peasant army led by the Dashing King, Li Zicheng. The other, commanded by Prince Yu (Dodo), directly invaded south of the Yangtze River. Dodo dispatched a hundred thousand soldiers to lay siege to Yangzhou city. Shi Kefa, leading both citizens and soldiers, defended the city to the end. Eventually, the city fell, and Dodo ordered a massacre.
autokwd: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall

title: Wild West Pioneers
description:
게임 정보
Are you tired of the crowded east coast cities? Grab your family and move to the West where there is free land for everybody and claim your future. With fertile soil and abundant resources, you’ll find more than adventure and freedom. This is your chance to be a driving force of the American dream.



Wild West Pioneers is a classic city builder with a modern touch, putting you in control in developing the American frontier. Lay the groundwork for prosperous settlements, decide who will lead the city and establish production chains for food, wood etc., so the needs of each settler are fulfilled. Then send another trek on its way to expand your sphere of influence. Set up trade routes and prepare the land for the coming railroad network.

With a variety of quests, an intuitive interface and eye-catching visuals, the world of Wild West Pioneers evokes the spirit of the heyday of city builders and catapults it into the presence. No need to stress out, when you can just relax and watch the charming hustle and bustle of a busy settlement as well as dozens of buildings and production chains.






You decide what the West will look like. Choose from a wide variety of buildings both residential as well as commercial like the sawmill or butcher up to warehouses and transport hubs to distribute your produce. Upgrade them over time to accommodate the ever-changing needs of the settlers. Pick mayors and sheriffs, but be careful who you appoint - their perks will affect the cities’ growth.




One settlement is only the beginning. While you discover new resource streams and production chains the urge to expand will become unstoppable. Send your settlers into uncharted territory and build new villages. Then set up trade routes, so resources can be exchanged. Don’t leave anybody behind or it will cost you dearly.




Your villages are filled with characters. Everybody has needs and demands that you have to fulfill, if you want your reputation to precede you. Only with a sufficient happiness level influenced by job availability, health standards etc. will you be able to attract new settlers and become one of the driving forces in the expansion of the United States.




Day and night cycle have an impact on the game world. Watch the city life change from dusk till dawn and show true leadership skills when you take on the challenges of efficient production chains and trade routes.




The strategic map will help you to plan your progress. Send expeditions, establish trading outposts and dispatch wagons with daring explorers eager to found new settlements. With the sandbox character of Wild West Pioneers, no game will ever be the same.




Sit back, chill and watch your plans come to fruition. Observe the hustle and bustle of city life, where every job is executed by a person and not a backend value. Watching your settlement grow in its detailed glory is half the fun.

title: Roombattle
description:
게임 정보
Roombattle is a party fighting game where players will control robotic vacuum cleaners and will fight equipped with sharp objects and balloons. The main objective is to be the last to be equipped balloons in the game. In addition to the battles, the game contains a large crowd of minigames.
Meet up with your friends, customize your vacuum, and get ready to battle in different rooms to claim victory!
Play with your friends in thrilling vacuum battles across colorful and dynamic rooms. Each theme features exclusive mechanics, making every round unique and exciting. Destroy the room and then clean it up!
Compete in multi-round matches, eliminating rival vacuums by popping their balloons to secure victory. Collect power-ups to become the most powerful vacuum cleaner in the room and defeat your friends!
Roombattle is designed for all types of players and can be played with just 2 buttons and a stick. Don’t have a controller? No problem—you can also play using a keyboard!
And if you have more than 4 players, don’t worry—Roombattle supports up to 6 players!

title: Snow Town Geek Store
description:
게임 정보
Here's the deal. It's the noughties, you work in a store of geek goods: games, mp3s, DVDs with movies and anime, gum, Cheetos, cigarettes, beer... Develop your store, communicate with customers (be friends, quarrel, cheat or flatter), get involved in shady dealings and earn your mom a trip to Hawaii.
So:
🛒 Order your favorite childhood goodies and put them on sale
💬 Choices really matter - chat with customers, bargain, count the change and cheat!

title: AQUAPAZZA: Aquaplus Dream Match
description:
게임 정보
26 characters from across AQUAPLUS's classic franchises clash in this action-packed fighting game! Master your favorite heroes from games and anime including Utawarerumono, To Heart 2, White Album, and more!



Pick from a roster of over a dozen fan favorites. Dominate the battlefield with your character's unique moveset and movement!








You don't just pick one character to control: select one of a dozen more partner characters, then call on them for powerful assists that can change the course of the fight!

title: Kitty Loves Birds
description:
게임 정보
호기심 많은 고양이의 발걸음을 따라 자연에서 영감을 받은 이 매력적인 모험을 시작하세요!
각기 다른 세 가지 다채로운 세계를 탐험하세요.
당신의 고양이 영웅은 점프하고, 새를 잡고, 환경을 민첩하게 탐색하는 것을 좋아하며, 장애물과 동물들을 피하고 간단한 퍼즐을 풀어가면서 모험을 이어갑니다.
이 게임은 매력과 놀라움이 가득한 편안하고 재미있는 게임입니다!

특징:
간단하고 직관적인 게임 플레이
귀여운 새들과 동물들
다채롭고 매력적인 그래픽
각 10단계의 3개의 다른 세계
캐릭터를 커스터마이징할 수 있는 고양이 스킨
스팀 업적
아름다운 음악

title: Bendy: Lone Wolf
description:
게임 정보
Bendy: Lone Wolf™ will tests your ability to survive against ever increasing odds. Monsters and obstacles emerge from every direction as you journey into the rubberhose halls of the world's most evil animation studio. Every day is a challenge.
Become Boris as he ventures deep into the endlessly generated corridors of Joey Drew Studios and beyond in search of supplies, weapons, and the dark truths that await him. The secrets of the machine are hiding around every corner.

title: The Soul
description:
게임 정보
A 3rd person action adventure game set in a parallel universe.
Side by side with us, invisibly live dark creatures. Vampires, zombies, demons and other creatures are very dangerous and always hungry. They have learnt to hide from the Guardians, who have been finding and exterminating bloodthirsty creatures for hundreds of years.
Max Soul is a cold-blooded Guardian, capable of destroying any monster in his path. His whole life is an endless hunt, and his next assignment is to identify the monster and eliminate it.
But is everything so unambiguous? Is there really only good and evil?
The player will have to get into the role of Max, dive headfirst into the hunt and understand the soul of the protagonist.
Conducting an investigation and determining the type of monsters to choose how to destroy them.
Dramatic plot with a complicated, grey morality.
Voice control mechanics using a microphone.

title: Mech Havoc
description:
게임 정보
An Evil AI called HIVE has gained sentience and conquered Planet-X! Now it's up to you to FIGHT BACK using a large range of vehicles. From a small and quick Weaponized Delivery Truck all the way to building sized Heavy Mechs.
Unlock new Vehicles and Weapons by completing missions and fighting against the ever-increasing threat of hostile machines. Equip Your Vehicle with newer and Stronger Weapons. And make use of Artillery Strikes, for when your weapons alone just aren't enough to stop a Horde of Killer Robots.
