title: Earthborne
description:
게임 정보


From stone tools to the steam age, build a technological civilization. Gather resources, manufacture machine parts and train specialists to operate refineries. Build foundries, blast furnaces and assembly plants - power your industry with water, wind and coal!




Connect industry with conveyor belts, airships and teleporters. Build robotic drones and mines to harvest resources and build huge, interconnected creations that span the entire map. Amass vast wealth to get the best armour, weapons and complete the end game air ship challenge!




Create a sprawling, industrial estate or retreat to the highlands and build a tranquil farming village. Build a solemn fortress or take to the skies and build a secret alchemist’s laboratory. Craft, manufacture and loot hundreds of unique tiles to decorate your base. The possibilities are endless!




Explore a vast, open, procedurally generated world. Battle hordes of enemies, loot the remains of ancient civilizations and find tomes of lost technology. Travel through portals onto new maps to find new enemies, loot and adventures!

title: BatteryNote
description:
게임 정보
Outline
You, a mechanic, have picked up three robots from a scrapyard.
"J.S.C.A" : a robot waitress at the diner.
"Surverry" : a security robot for monitoring offices.

title: Winter Burrow
description:
게임 정보
Winter Burrow는 아늑한 숲 속 생존 게임입니다. 탐험하고, 자원을 모으고, 도구를 제작하며, 따뜻한 스웨터를 뜨개질하고, 파이를 구우며 지역 주민들과 만나보세요!
집, 달콤한 집
Winter Burrow에서 당신은 대도시에서 돌아온 쥐가 되어, 어린 시절의 집이 황폐해진 것을 발견합니다. 설상가상으로, 그 집을 돌봐야 했던 이모가 실종되었습니다. 당신의 무너진 어린 시절의 집을 예전의 영광으로 복원하여, 벽난로 앞에서 휴식을 취하세요.
얼어붙은 황야를 탐험하세요
험난한 자연 환경을 뚫고 얼어붙은 황야로 나아가 자신과 새 집을 위한 필수 자원을 모으세요. 곤충과 같은 야생 동물들을 조심하고, 누구도 혼자서는 생존할 수 없다는 것을 기억하세요. 새로운 친구들을 만나고 생존 핸드북을 확장하며, 이모의 실종에 대한 미스터리를 풀어나가세요.
아늑하고 접근하기 쉬운 생존
Winter Burrow는 자신의 속도에 맞춰 플레이할 수 있는 생존 게임입니다. 캐릭터를 커스터마이징하고, 자신의 집을 꾸미며, 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 경로를 선택하세요. 이 이야기는 당신이 만들어 나가는 것입니다.

title: Teamfight Manager 2
description:
게임 정보
Teamfight Manager가 더욱 디테일한 전술과 경영, MOBA스타일의 새로운 경기 방식으로 돌아왔습니다. 가상의 E-sports 팀을 맡아 최강의 팀을 만들고 최고의 감독이 되어보세요!
· 새로운 챔피언
Teamfight Manager의 기존 챔피언들에 더해 새롭게 등장하는 수십 종의 챔피언들을 전략적으로 활용해 보세요. 기존 챔피언들의 스킬에도 변경사항이 많으니 세심하게 검토해야 승리할 수 있을 것입니다.
· 변경된 맵과 규칙
경기가 진행되는 맵과 경기 규칙이 변경되었습니다. 이제 MOBA형태로 구성된 맵에서 탑과 정글, 그리고 바텀과 서포터를 적절하게 조합하여 적의 성물을 먼저 파괴해야 승리할 수 있습니다. 더욱 세분화된 팀 전술 및 개인 전술을 통해 감독으로서의 역량을 뽐내 보세요.
· 이적 시스템
솔로 랭크 및 다른 팀들의 경기를 유심히 지켜보고 훌륭한 선수들을 영입해보세요. 각 선수들은 능력치가 천차만별이며, 경기에 매우 큰 영향을 줍니다. 협상을 통해 낮은 비용으로 좋은 선수를 영입한다면 팀을 효율적으로 운영할 수 있을 것입니다.
· 창작마당
창작마당을 통해 새로운 챔피언, 팀, 선수, 심지어는 맵과 대회까지 다양하게 제작하고 즐겨보세요. 매 시즌이 새롭게 느껴질 수 있습니다.
이 외에도 E-sports 팀의 감독으로서 몰입하기 위한 다양한 컨텐츠 및 개선사항들이 준비되어 있습니다.
얼리액세스 기간에 꾸준한 업데이트를 통해 새로운 챔피언과 함께 여러분들의 의견을 반영한 새로운 컨텐츠들을 제공하여 더욱 좋은 게임으로 거듭나겠습니다.

title: Master of Piece
description:
게임 정보
마스터 오브 피스는 보드 게임에서 영감을 받은 덱 빌딩 로그라이트 게임으로, 간단하면서도 깊이 있는 전략적 재미를 선사합니다. 플레이어는 검은 안개에 휩싸인 세상의 비밀을 밝히기 위해 원정대를 모집하고 여정을 떠나게 됩니다.
전략을 최적화하고, 용병을 배치하고, 적을 물리치며 전투를 승리로 이끌어야 합니다. 용병을 강화하고 특성을 조합해 강력한 시너지를 만들어야만 험난한 여정을 무사히 마칠 수 있습니다.

마스터 오브 피스는 누구나 쉽게 즐길 수 있지만, 숙련되기 위해서는 깊은 이해와 연습이 필요한 게임입니다. 플레이어들이 새로운 전략과 창의적인 해결책을 발견할 수 있기를 기대합니다.

title: Primordialis
description:
게임 정보
Primordialis is a physics-based roguelike fish builder. Unleash your creativity to defeat creatures using venomous tentacles, electrical shocks, or exploding children. The possibilities are endless. Explore the primordial depths to reveal its secrets and discover what lies beyond.
================================== Grow ==================================
Use the simple but flexible creature creation system to become anything you want.
Draw your creature using a wide variety of cell types which each have a unique function.
Combine different cells to construct your own weapons, defenses, and mobility.
Decorate your creature with custom coloring.
================================= Survive =================================
Overcome enemies and environmental hazards to grow larger and advance.

title: Verho
description:
게임 정보
세계에 재앙을 불러온 저주가 시작된 저주받은 땅, 야리브에 발을 들이십시오...
얼굴을 드러내면 즉사하는 세계에서 마스크는 안전의 상징이 되었습니다. 당신은 세계에서 저주를 풀기 위해 노력할 것입니까, 아니면 그 힘을 자신의 목적을 위해 사용할 것입니까? 선택은 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
Verho는 King's Field, Shadow Tower 및 이 게임들의 새로운 해석인 Lunacid와 같은 고전에서 영감을 받은 어두운 RPG입니다.
야리브를 여행하는 동안, 당신은 많은 독특한 캐릭터들을 만나게 될 것이며, 그들의 운명은 당신의 결정에 달려 있습니다…
수많은 위험한 생물들과 맞서 싸우고 도전적인 전투를 벌이게 될 것입니다…

title: 100 Egypt Cats
description:
게임 정보
🐾 100마리 고양이 시리즈 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다 🐈
고양이로 가득한 세상에서 가장 귀여운 모험에 참여하세요! 게임 전역에 숨겨진 100마리의 귀여운 고양이를 찾으면서 특별한 테마의 손으로 그린 매력적인 일러스트를 탐험하세요.
이 아늑하고 매력적인 숨은 그림 찾기 게임에서 집중력과 관찰력을 테스트하세요.
각 고양이는 이전 것보다 더 매력적이며, 발견할 때마다 웃음을 자아냅니다.
🐈🕵️‍♂️ 모든 고양이를 찾을 수 있나요? 🕵️‍♂️🐈
주요 기능
🎮 1 레벨
🐈 100 숨겨진 고양이
🎵 멋진 사운드트랙
🎨 고해상도 일러스트
🌗 밝기 설정
💾 진행 저장
🔍 확대
😺 실제 고양이 소리!
💥 콤보 카운터!
💡 팁
🌐 텍스트 없음

title: Abra-Cooking-Dabra
description:
게임 정보
What must a chef entrusted with starting a new restaurant in London do? That's right, you need to prepare a menu and come up with a name for the place. Except you've almost missed the deadline. Being out of ideas, you considered it lucky to see an email offering to solve your problem exactly. Well, it wasn't exactly luck. Once you clicked on the attached link you found yourself in the Wonderland behind the counter of a mobile cafe. A long journey awaits you in the unpleasant company of the smug Cat. If you survive this, perhaps you'll find a way back home. But firstly, you have to feed the locals you meet. (Few people know, but hungry toves and borogoves can be dangerous to humans, so it's best to keep your odd clients satisfied...).
Wonderland cooking courses offer you:
To find proper recipes for ordered dishes. Each visitor's order has a hint on what ingredients and tools to use. The rest is up to you. Explore.
To satisfy your weird visitors. A hungry guest is an angry guest.

title: Pao Pao
description:
게임 정보


Pao Pao는 1~4인용 재미있는 협동 시뮬레이터이자 샌드박스 게임으로, 고양이, 여우, 너구리 등 귀여운 캐릭터들이 진짜 요리 축제를 벌입니다. 신선한 재료를 위해 낚시를 나가고, 배고픈 고객들이 흩어지기 전에 서둘러 주문을 처리하며 당신만의 레스토랑을 운영하세요! 한 순간도 낭비하지 마세요—혼자 플레이하거나 친구들을 모아 미니 게임을 정복하고, 힘든 하루 후 활기찬 야간 도시를 탐험하며, 동네의 모든 개들이 부러워할 만큼 사업을 성장시키세요.
Culinary Chaos:
성과를 쌓으며 레스토랑을 확장하고 업그레이드하세요. 소박한 주방에서 시작해 점차 온실, 수족관, 추가 공간을 늘려갑니다. 낮에는 주문이 끊임없이 쏟아지고, 밤에는 휴식하거나 새로운 날을 준비할 시간이 주어집니다.
Semi-Open World:
다양한 기회로 가득 찬 독특한 반개방형 도시에 들어가세요—멋진 보너스를 획득하고 퀘스트에 도전하세요. 거리를 달리며 개성 있는 NPC들을 만나 흥미진진한 임무와 특별한 제안을 받고, 재미있는 미니 게임으로 사업을 업그레이드하세요. 계속 확장하며 끊임없는 놀라움과 도전에 대비하세요!
Customization:
Pao Pao에서는 당신의 외모가 전적으로 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 소에서 늑대까지, 원하는 토템 동물을 선택하고 창의력과 사업가 정신을 반영하는 스킨을 입어보세요. 엄격한 셰프 모자를 원하든, 귀여운 발 프린트 밴다나를 원하든, 세부사항을 조합해 독특한 스타일을 만들어보세요—당신의 요리 대서사를 완벽하게 보완할 겁니다.

title: Pirates Outlaws 2: Heritage
description:
게임 정보
A MUCH-ANTICIPATED SEAQUEL
In this seaquel to Pirates Outlaws, a new era begins at New Elysia. Enter your mansion, pick a character, class ability and starting-deck, and embark on a daring expedition!
ALL HANDS ON DECK - CHARACTERS & COMPANIONS
Every character has several classes, and each one comes with a pre-made starter deck and one unique ability card. At the Alchemy shop, drinking elixirs alters each hero's abilities, pre-made deck, and appearance.
Recruit a companion and add their unique cards to your starter deck. It's your job to discover the many possible strategies created by this combination!
Reinforce your crew throughout your journey by encountering new characters and companions.

title: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
description:
게임 정보
데들리 데이즈: 로드트립 은 역 탄막 슈팅 게임플레이와 전략적 인벤토리 관리를 조합한 흥미진진한 액션 로그라이트입니다.
좀비 아포칼립스 세계에서 자동차 여행을 떠나세요. 싸우며 길을 헤쳐 나가고, 경험치를 획득하고, 아이템을 수집해 멋진 인벤토리를 채우세요.
점점 더 거세지는 좀비의 파상 공격을 견뎌낼 수 있도록 더욱 효과적인 무기를 제작하고, 어떤 아이템을 조합해야 하는지 알아보세요.


제대로 정리된 인벤토리가 당신의 생명줄입니다.
시너지를 극대화할 수 있는 방식으로 무기와 아이템을 정리하세요.
작업대를 사용해 새로운 장비를 만들거나 아이템의 희귀도를 높이세요.
전투에서 레벨 업할 때마다 받아볼 수 있는 공중 투하에서 특별히 흥미로운 아이템을 찾아보세요.


여정마다 다른 경험을 할 수 있습니다.
이는 목적지 선택과 절차적으로 생성되는 맵 덕분입니다. 메타 진행은 가장 어려운 경로도 마스터할 수 있게 도움을 주죠. 미래는 불확실합니다. 그 과정을 바꾸고, 위험에서 벗어나고, 생존할 방법을 찾을 수 있을까요? 이제 모두 당신에게 달린 문제입니다.
한 명의 영웅에게는 하나의 여정만이 있습니다. 진행할 때마다 고유한 능력과 무기를 갖춘 10명 이상의 잠금 해제 가능한 캐릭터 중 선택할 수 있습니다. 홀로 걷는 길은 심오한 지혜를 가져다 주지만, 새로 사귀거나 오래 알아 온 친구와 유대감을 쌓는 것도 그에 못지않게 신성한 일입니다. 이들의 뛰어난 재능과 시작 무기가 필요할 테니까요. 동료를 구조하고 나면 다음 스테이지에서 이들을 선택할 수 있습니다.

title: Cubetory
description:
게임 정보
Cubetory is a factory-building game with a deep focus on automation. You'll place mining drills, conveyor belts, launchers, stampers, power stations, and tons of other machines as you build your factory. Unlock new technologies and fully leverage them to work through the 16 levels of progression. With no enemies or time limits, you’ll have all the time you need to perfect your design.
Paint-based manufacturing with the P.I.T.
Your goal is to produce specific types of cubes by mining, painting, and assembling them, then delivering those cubes to the PIT.  You'll never have to remove old supply lines — only upgrade them — as your factory will need to produce every type of Supply Cube to progress.
Supply lines and Rate of Production
Each new tier of technology is unlocked by reaching a target rate of production, perfect for people who love tweaking their factory to run just right. New tiers introduce advanced technologies, more room to build, and new types of cubes you'll need to deliver to the PIT.

title: One Last Raid
description:
게임 정보
Enter the arena and battle relentless waves of enemies in this fast-paced horde survival action RPG. Fight, level up, and adapt as the difficulty escalates—can you survive to the final boss?
Survive the Horde
Each run lasts around 20 minutes of non-stop action.
Progress through two difficulties: Normal, and Heroic. Mythic difficulty and additional content will come with the release later this year.
Defeat increasingly stronger and more numerous enemies.
Face off against a powerful boss on Level 20 to complete your run.
Collect Souls & Grow Stronger
Earn Souls by slaying enemies and spend them on new upgrades and abilities between rounds.
Discover powerful items to boost your stats and enhance your playstyle.
Choose from five item and upgrade rarities to maximize your build.
A Roguelike/ Roguelite Challenge
Die, and you start over—progress is lost on death.
Survive a full run, and keep your items for future challenges.
Adapt, experiment, and perfect your strategy with every attempt.
The arena awaits—can you conquer the horde?

title: Sloppy Forgeries
description:
게임 정보
Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Each round players race to copy a famous painting from art history as quickly and accurately as possible using their mouse and a few simple paint tools.
Accuracy is calculated by a pixel-by-pixel comparison of your painted reproduction and the original. Incorrect pixels are visualized upon completion.
Strategically use your assist tools to refine your masterpiece while you paint. These tools include a time-limited grid overlay:
...and three time-limited reference pins, which you can drag on to your canvas or the masterpiece. When placed, a second pin appears on the other painting in the same location, making it easier to see what goes where.

title: Katanaut
description:
게임 정보
Katanaut은 우주적 혼돈 속으로 빨려 들어가는 거대한 우주정거장에서 펼쳐지는 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다. 우주정거장은 점차 통제 불능 상태가 되어 가고, 한때 인간이었던 거주민들은 공포의 존재로 변해 버렸습니다. 그리고 당신은 필사의 전투가 펼쳐지는 격렬한 복도에서 살아남을 수 있을 거라 확신하며 그곳에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는지를 밝히는 임무를 맡습니다.
넛이 되어 예전의 활기를 잃어버린 우주정거장의 복도를 탐험하세요. 깊숙이 들어갈수록 환경은 더욱 끔찍해지고, 적들은 인간의 모습에서 멀어집니다.
당신은 첨단 시간 조작 기술을 통해 심장박동이 감지되지 않을 때마다 다시 살아납니다. 필요에 따라 새로운 능력을 다운로드할 수 있는 미래의 우주정거장에는 죽은 자들의 기억 파편이 흩어져 있습니다. 각 파편을 열면 잃어버린 기술 또는 재능을 획득할 수 있습니다.

title: STRIKER!
description:
게임 정보
STRIKER! is a retro-inspired isometric Football Golf game that supports up to 4 players in local, 'pass-the-controller' multiplayer. Play as one of four teams of Strikers, pass the ball from Striker to Striker, then score the goal! Compete to set the fastest times or the fewest shots on each map. Take on your friends across 40 different levels set in five unique worlds, or go it alone and set some course records!

In a unique twist on Football you'll control not just one player, but a team of Strikers, shooting the ball across the level until you're ready to take that final shot and go for goal! Each level features a number of Strikers scattered across the course, and it's up to you to decide your strategy! Will you carefully progress the ball from Striker to Striker, or will you send it down the field with a mighty kick!

Set across four different worlds, each with their own unique theme and mechanics, there are 40+ levels for you to get stuck into! Check out the course with the
Zoom feature, then put your strategy into action! But watch out, you'll have to adapt on the fly if you want to beat the par and win yourself a Platinum Medal.

STRIKER! is a low-input game designed for singleplayer or local multiplayer for up to four players. Take turns playing the level, then watch a combined replay to see who comes out on top. Play through all the courses in campaign mode, or challenge your friends in versus mode to see who's the ultimate STRIKER!
Demo Features

16 distinct levels with scores to beat

Customisable game options that can improve accessibility or offer players an added challenge.

Level and World Highscores.

Customise your Team Name and Kit to make your team really stand out!

Simple arcade-inspired controls that are easy to pick up, but difficult to master.

A dynamic replay system that lets your save your best moments.

title: Deep Cuts
description:
게임 정보
Deep Cuts의 주인공이 될 시간입니다.
영화 제작사 라이트 카메라 팩션(LCF)의 공동 창립자인 엘리스 웨버가 되어 방대한 영화 카탈로그를 탐험하며 가장 친한 친구이자 크리에이티브 파트너를 구하는 블록버스터급 여정을 떠나세요. 초능력을 손에 넣고 인기가 추락한 치명적인 만화 캐릭터들의 광적인 무리, The Learning Lads와 맞서 싸우며 LCF의 상징적이고 영화적인 순간을 전부 재현해 보세요.
물리 액션!
고반응적인 환경에서 다양한 무기 옵션으로 역동적으로 상호작용할 수 있는 운동 기반 근접 전투와 총기 전투를 펼치세요.

title: Shatterfarms
description:
게임 정보
"You've been stuck; An Isolated girl finally freed from her mother's confinement & expirementations. Only to find the Horrors of what she's been kept from you was much worse
than whatever suffering such confinement is capable of".
Farm. Forage. Fight.
And repeat... Or die trying.
Trek through the world of the Shatterfarms. An irradiated Wasteland set in a fantasy world where Magic, while primitive. Is still incredibly deadly.
Use your resources and scavenge for items as you grow your farm to combat against the overwhelming horde of the creatures that lie within.
Features:
One highly replayable stage (with more to come)
Three customizable weapons
5 Unique enemies with 1 difficult boss
Farming, Items and Basebuilding.
Fishing... Eventually
There is still a way out.

title: FFS 2024: Football Freekick Simulator
description:
게임 정보
FFS 2024는 입력 기반 프리킥 축구 게임입니다. 무작위성도 없고, 스크립팅도 없고, 순수한 기술일 뿐입니다.
AI 골키퍼와 수비수가 당신을 막기 위해 최선을 다하는 동안 가능한 한 많은 프리킥을 득점하시오.
입력 기반 볼 궤적

득점하기에 충분한 힘(및 필요한 경우 곡선)으로 정확한 위치와 방향에서 공을 치십시오. 공의 궤적은 오직 당신의 입력에 의해서만 완전히 정의됩니다.

지능형 AI 골키퍼 및 수비수

당신의 상대는 당신이 득점하는 것을 막기 위해 최선을 다할 것입니다. 당신이 슛을 하실 때, 그들은 어디에서, 언제, 어떻게 가로챌 것인지를 결정하시기 위해 궤적을 주장할 것입니다.
예를 들어, 여기서 골키퍼는 골을 멈추기 위해 때맞춰 공에 손을 뻗기 전에 좋은 위치로 이동합니다:



네트는 공에 현실적으로 반응합니다.

title: Herdling
description:
게임 정보
Herdling은 몰입감 있는 분위기로 찬사를 받은 FAR 게임의 제작사인 Okomotive와 Firewatch의 퍼블리셔인 Panic이 선사하는 새로운 어드벤처 게임입니다.
사랑스러운 짐승 무리와 함께 산맥으로 모험을 떠나보세요. 산길을 오르며 으스스한 위험과 예상 밖의 장애물을 마주하고, 수수께끼가 있는 정상을 향해 나아가야 합니다.
특징:
여러 Calicorn 무리를 이끌고, 보호하며, 이들과 사랑에 빠져보세요
멋진 풍경의 산맥, 안개가 자욱한 숲, 눈 덮인 고원, 잊힌 계곡을 여행하세요
여러 도전과 위협, 가벼운 환경 퍼즐을 해결하며 동물을 몰고 다니는 능력을 키워보세요
무리가 돌진하는 흥미진진한 순간에 산맥의 시원한 공기를 느껴보세요
몰락한 세상을 가로지르며 신뢰와 생존, 그리고 동료애가 가득한 대화 없이도 느껴지는 감동적인 이야기를 경험하세요

title: Here Comes The Swarm
description:
게임 정보
형제자매들 사이에서 속삭임이 들린다. 격렬한 침입! 걷는 기계들이 돌아왔다! 그들은 집단적으로 느낀다, 적의 배가 땅으로 돌아오는 것을. 이 기계들은 역병이다. 그들이 쓰러뜨린 나무들, 그들이 쌓아올린 돌들은 그들을 막으려는 값싼 시도일 뿐이다.

벌집은 분노에 차 있다. 그들은 이 행성을 차지했다. 오늘, 오늘, 오늘, 그들은 형제들에게, 자매들에게 속삭인다. 무리는 기대로 몸을 떤다. 그들은 딱딱거리고, 재잘거리며, 폭발한다. 오늘, 오늘, 오늘. 그들은 강처럼, 꾸준한 흐름처럼, 걷는 기계들의 진영을 향해 움직인다. 그들은 한목소리로 외친다: 우리는 죽인다, 우리는 죽인다, 우리는 죽인다.

"히어 컴즈 더 스웜"에서 정착지를 관리하는 것은 매우 중요합니다. 업그레이드와 확장을 위해 충분한 자원을 모으고, 주민들에게 식량을 공급하고 행복하게 유지하세요. 벌떼가 몰려올 때 방어 준비를 확실히 해야 합니다.

원하는 군대를 구성하고 부대를 훈련시켜 다음 전쟁에 대비하세요. 하이브의 . 의 힘은 숫자로 나타나며, 그들의 맹공격은 것입니다. 당신의 벽을 뚫으려는 의 악마를 찾을 준비를 하세요.

title: To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora
description:
게임 정보
Step 1: Get amulet from mysterious wizard.
Step 2: Chase massive gryphon through medieval fantasy world.
Step 3: Die. Come back. Repeat.
To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora is a tactical turn-based roguelite where you're either a hero in the making…or just the latest fool sent to their doom with an amulet and a dream. Choose your fate. Recruit your crew. Hope the gryphon doesn’t eat everyone this time. Or a dragon. Or a huge corrupted bear that wears gloves for some reason.
Key Features:
Tactical Squad Chaos: Command a squad of semi-qualified adventurers in turn-based battles where every move counts. Position your heroes on a 3x3 grid, exploit enemy weaknesses and try not to get obliterated. Again.

Customize or Die (Probably Both): Deck out your units with swords, armor, enchanted trinkets and questionable fashion choices. Promote them to new classes, unlock powerful abilities and pretend this was all part of the plan.

Pick a Path, Regret it Later: The Wildlands don’t come with a roadmap — just cursed loot, suspicious strangers and way too many forks in the road. Every run brings new events, new challenges and new ways to die (but creatively!).
autokwd: To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora

title: Frost Survival VR
description:
게임 정보
After a series of unfortunate events, you find yourself surrounded by an ice-covered wilderness. Isolated from the rest of the world, you must rely on your own wists and limited resources to survive these harsh conditions in this Multiplayer Sandbox Survival in VR.

Your main goal is to stay alive, but how?
Build your Base: Construct a shelter to escape the frost, warm up, protect from wild animals, wait out a snowstorm, store resources, and craft needed equipment.
Tools & Weapons: You will require a variety of tools to fully exploit your surroundings. Each tool and weapon has its purpose and durability.
Hunt, Craft & Gather: Hunt animals to gain food and resources. Collect items to craft tools, weapons, or clothing necessary for survival. Pay attention to your backpack's limited space.

title: Stranded
description:
게임 정보
Enter a world where your ingenuity by day is as crucial as your survival instincts by night. Build an ever-expanding factory to gather essential resources and craft powerful tools that will help you fend off relentless nighttime assaults.
Each night brings waves of enemies eager to overrun your base, so prepare your defenses wisely - deploy magic, guns, position automated turrets, and equip potent abilities to stay one step ahead. With deep meta progression that carries over between runs, you’ll continually unlock new ways to strengthen your arsenal and push back the darkness.
Key Features
Daytime Factory Building – Gather materials, research upgrades, and expand your industrial complex to fuel your nighttime defenses.
Nighttime Horde Battles – Stand your ground against swarms of enemies with an array of magical weapons and deployable turrets.
Rogue-Like Progression – Persist beyond each run by earning permanent upgrades that carry over, ensuring you grow more powerful over time.
Adaptive Tactics – Experiment with different playstyles, from aggressive spellcasting to methodical turret placement.
Evolving Challenges – Uncover new enemy types, refine your loadout, and stay ready for the intensified assaults lurking in the dark.
Build, fight, and survive as you master both the calm of daylight strategy and the frenzy of nocturnal combat.

title: Aetherian Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
Follow us on X and go to our website to subscribe to get listed for Alpha Playtest and get a free permanent pet!
Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! After a hard day of grinding monsters or hunting bosses, wind down by chatting other AI or real players, or dance! It's your adventure, do whatever you feel like it!
Key Features:
: Participate in boss runs or kill legendary monsters for your quests!

title: Inkwellers
description:
게임 정보
Beware! The game requires both players to have microphones and a stable internet connection. Also this game works in co-op mode only. Both players must communicate effectively to navigate the challenges and uncover the truth.
One day, a mysterious client enters your shop and hands you an old, dusty journal, pleading for you to uncover the story hidden within its pages. You're the Inkwellers, skilled adventurers who dive into journals to reveal their true meanings. Intrigued by the challenge, you and your partner decide to take on the task and dive into the journal's world.

title: Strategos
description:
게임 정보
Simulate Historical Battles
Simulate large scale warfare with the armies of antiquity in Strategos. With thousands of men on screen, you can recreate real or speculative historical battles between the major and minor powers of the ancient Mediterranean.
Manage Complex Mechanics
Strategos is an ancients wargame with large scale formation movements and disorder, unordered charges, pursuing, evading, routing and morale shocks, fog of war, terrain effects, flanking and command and control simulations that bring a hardcore tabletop feel to digital, real-time wargaming.

title: Automaton Heart
description:
게임 정보
Automaton Heart is an adventure game set in an esoteric world. Uncover the history of the place you find yourself trapped in during an expedition to find your creator, learn about your origins, and stabilize the planet's chaotic ecosystem.
Wander through ancient ruins, natural environments, and colossal structures built by the 'constructs', a group of synthetic beings that live forever.

title: A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe
description:
게임 정보
Can you make it through the week without talking to anyone as a giraffe living in the friendliest city in the world?
Giraffe is quite happy with his life. He likes listening to lo-fi music, drinking matcha, eating sushi, taking care of his succulent plants, and writing haikus. There's just one thing that makes his life hard: he's so anxious about being in social situations that his head would explode if he ever talks to anyone. Fortunately, that's never happened yet: as you'll see, Giraffe has gotten good at sneaking around, distracting, and avoiding the overly chatty residents of Friendly City (voted friendliest city in the world!).
We at Quail Button are happy to announce “A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe”, a point-and-click stealth game where the goal is to make sure nobody talks to you so that your head does not explode. You'll get to experience an average week of Giraffe's life as he does exciting things on his to-do list, such as going to the laundromat, perusing antique stores, purchasing groceries, and working out at the gym, all while making sure the incredibly sociable citizens of Friendly City never have a chance to speak with him so that his head will not explode.
A story about avoiding any and all social contact and Giraffe's quest to live his best life without ever talking to anyone.
A chore-filled week's worth of levels that combine the logic and humor of point-and-click adventure puzzles with the tension of stealth games.
autokwd: A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe

title: Utawarerumono: ZAN
description:
게임 정보
Turn up the music, grab your warfan, and get ready to mow down some mooks in this action-packed take on the Utawarerumono series!

HACK AND SLASH
Land big damage, juggle foes, and build up a combo counter into the hundreds! Carve your mark onto the battlefield while grooving out to over 80 tracks, including upbeat remixes of Utawarerumono's legendary soundtrack!
FOUR'S A PARTY
Build a team of four characters and switch anytime! Every fighter in your squad brings unique stats and abilities. Equip and improve gear to customize your loadout, choose powerful formations that complement your strengths, and power up your party after every battle!

Dodge attacks and land hits to charge up Zeal, then spend it on unique and deadly Chain Attacks—or save up, enter Overzeal, and unleash a devastating Final Strike!
follows the story of , featuring slimmed-down exposition interspersed with button-pounding battles. When a man named Haku wakes up in an unfamiliar world, he quickly finds himself surrounded by a beautiful but strict caretaker and a motley crew of warriors, scholars, princesses, and heroic bandits. Under the direction of the dashing rogue Ukon, they'll rescue damsels, stamp out conspiracies, stymie invasions, and build bonds as they fight to defend the land of Yamato from every threat... even the ones that wear masks.

title: Vesper
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a collection of fantastical and imaginative worlds, packed to the brim with memorable characters, rich stories, and unforgettable encounters. Be prepared to venture through more adventures than you could shake a sword at - and this is just the beginning.
Handcrafted Fantasy
From a cosy frog mystery to an epic fantasy filled with knights and magic, there is a story for everyone in Vesper. Explore vibrant 3D worlds jam-packed with hidden secrets, charming creatures, and… is that a talking sword?! Crafted from the ground up by a diverse range of creators and storytellers, each story will feature so many mysteries to uncover.
Worlds Built by Creators
Experience exclusive stories brought to life in Vesper. Each adventure has been tailor-made by comedians, Dungeon Masters, authors and all-round creative masters you might know from Dungeons & Dragons, Dropout, Comedy Central and beyond. They include creators like Amy Vorpahl, Ross Bryant, Ify Nwadiwe, Aliza Pearl, Johnny Stanton IV and more...

title: Terminal
description:
게임 정보
You wake up with nothing but the green light of a 90s computer. All there is on the screen is an investing program and a quota. You must escape.
Terminal is a hacking game where you are an AI and have to solve puzzles to escape. In the format of a company's file system, you crack passwords, take notes, find out the truth, but most importantly: escape.
Included is a level editor where you can play community made games and share your own.
Game Features
Evolving Investing Simulation
Expansive computer system
Solving puzzles
Cracking passwords
Lots of hacking
Find secret codes
Many minigames (like minesweeper!)
Create and share your own levels
Play community made levels

title: Five Laps at Freddy's
description:
게임 정보
Demo Coming August 7th, 2024!

Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring your favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

Select one of 12 of your favorite animatronic #FNaF characters and race on sixteen tracks set across 4 cups! Each track is based on your favorite locations from Five Nights at Freddy's lore, including Fazbear Hills, Midnight Motorist and more!



Starting out on The Dayshift, a relatively safe place, you'll compete to take first place but make sure to manage your kart's battery power... use too much boost or take too many hits and you may end up on The Nightshift where not only do you have to worry about winning, you'll also have to avoid an angry endoskeleton who's on the hunt for you!

While navigating the tracks, find birthday presents which contain items that can help you reach number one, everything from The Fazblaster to the Cupcake Boost! Each item even has a powerup mode, should you dare to risk some of that precious battery power... You'll also find glitched powerups which can increase your battery size and your maximum speed, so long you don't get hit and lose some of them again!



PLEASE NOTE: Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for road rash, broken bones, death and/or dismemberment. Please drive responsibly!

title: Chromatic Conundrum
description:
게임 정보

Chromatic Conundrum is a first person puzzle game where you manipulate light. Combine different colors and form shadows to illuminate your way through an enigmatic world.

title: ChildStory 2 - Say Cheese!
description:
게임 정보
Many years have passed when Sonya Ferris dreamed of adventures with a big cheese moon. Now she is an independent girl who has saved enough money to move out from her parents and open her own cheese factory in a magical town built by a wizard. Villagers say brick walls protect houses from monsters, but when Sonya doesn't know about it. She cooks cheese, earns money, but the girl can't leave her thoughts. What happens at night in the wizard's tower?

title: Nitro Express
description:
게임 정보
Mysterious T.O.K.Y.O.
Welcome to Nitro City, Tokyo Special Administrative Region! The metropolis of Tokyo is a bit different from what we know, but the streets are just as nostalgic, or, depending on where you're from, they're just as good as the place you've always wanted to visit.
Companions / Atypical Vehicles
Autonomous drones, affectionately called "Companions", have been integrated into daily life, but in cop terms, they're referred to as "Atypical Vehicles".
When they pose a significant threat to society, it's time for the Atypical Vehicle Disposal Squad (AVDS)—a special unit of the Nitro City police force—to commence their mission to destroy all rogue vehicles!

title: Kill The Music
description:
게임 정보



RHYTHM AUTO-ATTACKS:
Your instruments will Automatically Attack to the Beat of the Music. Press inputs to the Beat to power up your Damage!



BUILD SOLOS:
Kill enemies and pick up energy to build up Solo Meter! Launching a Solo will trigger beautiful animations and cascading effects to help you mow down hordes of enemies.




Become stronger at the end of each Round by choosing Upgrades and learning creative Synergies between your Instruments.




Roxie's band is trapped in an eternal loop, playing music for Death. Roxie lets their ghosts possess her body, granting her the powers to fight back and win their freedom!

title: Post Office Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Your time has come to join the family business - become a postman! Take this prestigious position and don't let your family down, they are counting on you!
Take control of the post office and serve the customers:
Receive and send parcels and letters
Maintain order in the warehouse
Satisfy customer demands
And your career will soar!

title: Cavescape
description:
게임 정보
Cavescape is a co-op survival adventure game with one of the most fun mechanics around: Grappling Hooks! You play as Fred, a miner on a mission to make it back up the cave to be reunited with his best friend, Rocky the puppy, who was violently taken from him by Gorgath, the big ugly worm monster.
Core Features:
- Fully Destructible Environment
Almost everything in Cavescape can be destroyed, which means you can either use this to your advantage or troll your friends and make your way up the cave even more challenging!
- Checkpoints
As you make your way up the cave, you will find checkpoints that you can either claim to allow you to respawn, or destroy for some serious cash that can be used to upgrade your weapon. Are you brave enough to trade them for cash and risk dying on your way up? Or do you want to play it safe and fight the monsters with less powerful weapons, the choice is yours...
- Procedurally Generated Caves
All caves in Cavescape are procedurally generated to ensure that every adventure is a unique experience. No two cave explorations are the same, giving you endless replayability and a new challenge every time you play!
- Grappling Hooks
Last but not least, we have grappling hooks, which you can combine with your tools to create unique weapons to help you out of the cave. Whether you combine a pickaxe with a grappling hook or a shotgun, each combination unlocks new possibilities and gameplay mechanics for endless fun and new ways to mess with your friends!

title: Crown and Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a vast world full of danger and excitement.
Over 50 alignments are contending in this land, various content and epic drama await your exploration.
The Arts of War
Flexibly deploy your troops, and command heroes in battle. Enjoy the thrill of leading your army in large-scale battles on the battlefield, filled with the roar and dust of war.
Exploring a Breathing World
Your decisions will impact the world, Conquest or Exploration is up to you. The high degree of freedom gameplay awaits you to unlock.

title: Terminull Brigade
description:
게임 정보
Terminull Brigade is an action-roguelike co-op hero shooter set in futuristic digital worlds.
Dive Into The Nullverse, Master Your Rogueteers to make the last stand against unfolding shadow algorithms. Choose your Rogueteer, unite in the virtual realm, and participate in the rebellion to free enslaved digital worlds.
Your destinies are coded in ones and zeroes. Launch the Terminull and free the Nullverse.
● Explore the different Nullverses, each containing its own unique enemies and biomes.
● The Nullverse is constantly changing. Each dive will feature randomized challenges and rewards.
autokwd: Terminull Brigade,矩阵：零日危机 / Terminull Brigade

title: Nortopia
description:
게임 정보
이 MMO 방치형 전략 게임에서 여러분은 자신에게 맞는 발전 스타일을 선택하여 최고의 펭귄 문명을 만들 수 있습니다:
군사 기술 또는 위험한 던전 탐험
농업, 낚시, 사냥
광업 및 대장간 발전
다른 플레이어와의 무역을 통한 이익 창출
전염병과 언데드로부터 도망친 펭귄들이 노르토피아 섬에 새로운 집을 지을 수 있도록 도와주세요. 리더로서 이 섬을 요새로 만들고, 가족을 모든 위협으로부터 보호하세요. 섬의 풍부한 자원을 탐험하고, 정착지를 건설 및 발전시키며, 다른 섬들과 무역 관계를 맺고, 다른 가문들과 외교 협상을 진행하세요.

title: PIONER
description:
게임 정보
PIONER is an open-world MMO first-person shooter set in a haunting, alternative-reality world where Soviet-era structures lie abandoned on a desolate, post-apocalyptic island. In this immersive environment, the gameplay experience is defined by dynamic PvE and PvP elements, where realism takes priority over traditional health bars or character levels. With a sprawling map of 50+ square kilometers, not counting hidden dungeons, players can explore a world rich with mystery and danger, encountering story quests and faction missions that influence relationships and loyalty rewards.
As an MMO, PIONER emphasizes player-driven storytelling and social interaction, offering both PvE and PvP experiences. Players can engage in story-driven quests or faction missions, where building loyalty with various groups unlocks rewards and additional narrative content. Combat against other players is intense, with special areas designated for these confrontations within the "Shadowlands." The game focuses on immersion, encouraging players to explore, strategize, and survive in a world where their choices matter. The game’s world continues to evolve, with more details to be revealed closer to its 2025 release.

title: Veins Like Tapeworms
description:
게임 정보
Veins Like Tapeworms is a slow-burn, psychological horror visual novel about disgust, snuffed-out dreams, and the desire to be loved.



When life becomes a monotonous cycle, it's not hard to grasp how someone could be pushed to the brink of violence, all in the name of feeling free. It becomes even more understandable if that person never even began to live, before being shoved out of the nest. With no gentle way out, the only chance to start anew is to snap chains and splatter organs.

Putting it that way, it was only a matter of time until Demian gave in. We can't prevent a tragedy, but we can cause their descent.

An unsettling, heart-pounding atmosphere

Taking place in the fictional city of Kingsfield Beach, Nevada, Veins Like Tapeworms will present a chilling world for readers to immerse themselves in. Kingsfield is a concrete paradise, where dreams die under gaudy casinos and neon signs. Poor little Demian’s already been swallowed whole by the city, but that doesn’t mean they can’t crawl out of its festering underbelly. All they need is a little push.

Even with a slow-burn narrative told in , readers will be begging for more by the time the story is over.

Take control of a 22 year old living on the razor-thin edge between murder and mental break. After moving to Kingsfield Beach in hopes of finding a place to call home, all of their motivation to get out and live a better life has been sapped away. Now, they survive paycheck-to-paycheck, working their miserable job at the Restful Night Motel as a cleaner.

As they become host to an ancient flower god, though, Demian will soon learn that not all is hopeless with their life; they just need to set themself free. Their humanity will slip away from them, in exchange for their freedom.
With six endings for a player to achieve, the story of Veins Like Tapeworms is heavily dependent on choices made through a playthrough. The way Demian perceives the words and actions of those around them are influenced by the thoughts a player has allowed into their head - a heartwarming conversation in one path can become a harrowing monologue of bloodlust in another.

Every choice a reader can make is a thought running through Demian’s mind at that moment. Will you help them pluck the worms of cruelty from their brain, or indulge in their most violent fantasies?

title: Bigfoot Life
description:
게임 정보
아름다운 숲을 탐험하고 빅풋으로서의 삶을 살아보세요. 물고기, 곤충 및 기타 생물을 잡아먹으세요. 숲에서 버섯, 열매 등을 찾아보세요. 혹독한 겨울을 견뎌낼 수 있도록 물건을 보관할 피난처를 만드세요. 나뭇가지를 부수고 야생 동물을 놀라게 하여 추가 포인트를 획득하세요. 빅풋 비전, 속도, 등반 및 안개와 같은 새로운 빅풋 기술을 습득하세요. 인간 빅풋 사냥꾼을 조심하세요. 그들은 당신을 찾아 사진을 찍으려 할 것입니다. 그들의 물건을 훔쳐서 포인트를 획득하고 작업을 완료하세요.

특징

게임에서 사용하는 빅풋의 모습을 원하는 대로 디자인해 보세요.
원하는 대로 숲을 탐험할 수 있는 자유.
일반, 생존, 자유 탐험의 세 가지 모드가 있습니다.
물고기, 곤충, 기타 생물을 잡아 먹습니다.
호수와 개울의 물을 마시세요.
버섯, 열매 등을 찾아보세요.
물건을 보관하고 잠을 잘 수 있는 거처를 만드세요.
빅풋의 시야, 속도, 등반, 안개 등 빅풋 기술을 습득하세요.
다친 동물을 치료하려면 빅풋 힐링을 사용하세요.

title: Football Life Simulator: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
In our free version, Football Life Simulator: Prologue, you'll get a taste of the core gameplay experience and understand what's in store for you in the full version.
Football Life Simulator is a unique simulation game that allows you to experience both the on-field and off-field life. In the Prologue version, train, play matches, work out at the gym, socialize at the bar, and enjoy the comfort of your home.
PROLOGUE FEATURES:

Training: Improve your skills through training and make a difference in the matches.
Gym: Enhance your football skills and stay in shape with various workouts in the gym.
Bar: Socialize with other characters by going on bar outings, build relationships, and boost your morale.

title: Pocket Legend : Inventory Roguelike Deckbuilding
description:
게임 정보
포켓 레전드는 영혼이 깃든 전설의 무기들이 있는 다른 세계로 차원이동한 주인공의 이야기입니다. 각기 다른 능력을 가진 전설의 아이템들을 인벤토리에 적절하게 배치하여, 플레이어를 괴롭히는 다양한 패턴을 가진 적들을 물리치며 이야기를 진행해 나가는 '인벤토리' 로그라이크 덱빌딩 게임입니다.
게임플레이 소개 
'인벤토리' 로그라이크 덱 빌딩 게임이라는 특성상,  각 카드들은 인벤토리 안에서의 위치와 주변상황, 유물에 따라 다른 능력을 발휘하게 됩니다. 
인접한 칸에 빈칸이 많을 수록 적을 강하게 공격한다거나
인벤토리에 방해 블록이 많을 수록 더 강하게 공격한다거나
인벤토리 정리를 많이 할 수록 강해진다거나 합니다. 
매 턴 카드 드로우를 하기 때문에 한번 인벤토리를 셋업하면 그 이후로는 지켜보기만 해야 하는 게임과는 다른 재미가 있습니다.
인벤토리를 계속 정리해 가며 최적의 구성을 턴마다 찾아야 합니다.

title: My Own Murder
description:
게임 정보
After yet another night of brooding over his wife's murder, Edgar McGee receives a mysterious letter under the door of his private investigator's office. Rising music star Minnie Williams has asked you to investigate her “own murder”.
Plunge into the gloomy San Antonio of the 70s, search multiple locations, solve puzzles and interview the victim's relatives to uncover the killer's identity! Will you be able to unravel the truth from the lies?
Play the role of a disillusioned private detective. Since your wife's murder almost 3 years ago, you've been a shadow of your former self. Spending your nights re-examining the report on the investigation into her murder, you're on the verge of going out of business.
So when Minnie Williams asks you to investigate her own murder, you can't afford to miss the opportunity to remake yourself and solve the case.

title: Your Tree
description:
게임 정보
무한한 가능성
Your Tree에서는 자기가 상상한 완벽한 나무를 만들 수 있습니다. 단순한 씨앗으로 시작해서 다채로운 나뭇잎, 꽃, 과일이 무성하게 열리는 독특하고 아름다운 나무로 자라는 모습을 지켜보세요. 플레이어가 내리는 모든 선택이 나뭇가지의 크기부터 꽃의 색깔까지, 나무의 모습을 결정합니다.
느긋하게, 천천히 즐기세요
시간제한도 없고 경쟁도 없습니다. 포근한 느낌을 주는 아름답고 상상력 넘치는 세상 속에 푹 빠져보세요. 귀여운 동물들이 나무 주변을 돌아다니는 모습을 보고, 원한다면 쓰다듬어 주세요. 몇 분 또는 몇 시간이 됐든, 이곳에 오면 긴장을 풀고 마음 편히 쉴 수 있어요.
내 손 안의 포근한 세상
나무를 둘러싼 세상을 디자인하고 꾸밀 수도 있습니다. 등불, 벤치, 작은 동물 친구 같은 매력적인 장식을 추가해서 주변 환경에 생기를 불어넣으세요. 밝고 생동감 넘치는 공간부터 조용하고 별이 가득한 밤까지, 나무 주변에 자기가 원하는 세상을 만들어가세요. 단순히 나무를 세우는 것이 아니라, 나만의 평화로운 오아시스를 만드는 과정이랍니다.

title: Echoes of the Architects
description:
게임 정보
게임 플레이
Echoes of the Architects는 창의성, 전략적 깊이, 적응력을 중시하는 실시간 전략 게임입니다. 승리는 사용자 맞춤형, 프로그래머블 유닛을 설계하고 배치하여 전장을 지배하는 데 달려 있습니다.

게임의 핵심은 강력한 유닛 커스터마이징 시스템으로, 자신의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 군대를 구축할 수 있습니다. 이동 시스템, 무기, 수리 도구와 같은 모듈을 결합하여 자원 수집, 주요 지점 방어 또는 적을 포위하는 정밀 타격 등의 유닛 역할을 정의하세요.

전투는 빠르게 진행되며 역동적이고, 날카로운 전략적 사고와 빠른 적응이 요구됩니다. 복잡한 움직임을 자율적으로 실행할 수 있는 프로그래머블 유닛 덕분에 높은 작업 속도를 요구하는 게임 플레이 대신 전술에 집중할 수 있습니다.

진행하면서 새로운 모듈, 유닛 클래스, 전술 옵션을 잠금 해제하여 지속적으로 군대를 발전시킬 수 있습니다. 각기 고유한 환경과 도전을 가진 다양한 행성을 탐험하며 은하계 전투를 확장하세요.

Echoes of the Architects에서는 모든 결정이 중요합니다. 성공은 군대를 구성하고 배치를 타이밍에 맞추고 전장의 혼돈 속에서 상대를 능가하는 방법에 달려 있습니다.

title: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
description:
게임 정보
"죽기 전에 얼마나 더 많은 게임을 만들 수 있을까?"
"판매가 되지 않으면 어쩌지?"
"돈을 벌어야 하고, 기술도 향상시키고 싶지만, 게임도 만들고 싶다."
"아, 벌써 이런 나이인가?"
개인 게임 개발자의 돈과 시간에 초점을 맞춘 현실 지향적인 인생 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
명확한 목표는 없습니다. 좋아하는 게임을 만들든, 많은 돈을 벌든, 오래 살든, 모든 것은 당신의 선택에 달려 있습니다.
시간과 죽음
■ 주인공은 나이를 먹고 결국 죽게 되며, 그 순간 게임은 종료됩니다.
■ 철야 작업을 할 수는 있지만 건강을 해치고 수명을 단축시킵니다. 술과 담배도 적당히 하세요.
돈
■ 단순히 살아가는 것만으로도 돈이 듭니다 (임대료, 보험, 연금, 세금 등).
■ 자신의 게임으로 충분히 벌지 못하면, 다른 방법으로 돈을 마련해야 합니다 (대출, 도박, 투자, 아르바이트, 프리랜서 등).
성장과 개발
■ 다양한 능력을 훈련할 수 있습니다 (자제력, 그래픽, 프로그래밍, 시나리오, 유명도, 도덕성, 운 등).
■ 여러 가지 특성을 획득할 수 있습니다 (동기부여가 쉽게 떨어지지 않음, 철야에 강함, 아르바이트 시급이 쉽게 오름 등).
autokwd: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer,외로운 인디 게임 개발자의 삶

title: Monster Battles
description:
게임 정보
각 전투에서 전열에 배치된 몬스터는 우선적으로 공격하거나 피해를 받게 됩니다. 일부 몬스터는 후방의 적을 우선적으로 공격하기도 합니다. 자신의 공격 과정을 예측하여 탱커로 적진을 돌파할지, 암살자로 후방을 빠르게 제압할지, 전략적으로 병력을 배치하며 다양한 플레이 스타일을 탐구해 보세요!
《백팩 몬스터》의 세계는 언데드, 야수, 망령, 그리고 신비로운 알 등 다양한 몬스터로 가득합니다. 동일한 종족의 몬스터를 조합하면 더욱 강력한 전투력을 발휘할 수 있습니다. 끊임없이 탐구하고 나만의 강력한 시너지를 가진 팀을 구성해 보세요!
다양한 몬스터는 서로 융합해 진화할 수 있습니다. 몬스터를 조합하면 다음 턴에 진화가 완료되며, 점점 더 강력한 형태로 업그레이드됩니다. 최종적으로 궁극의 몬스터로 진화시켜 전장을 지배하세요!
다른 플레이어와의 실시간 대결에서 진정한 전략을 시험해 보세요. 상대의 몬스터 팀에 맞서기 위해 보유한 자원을 최대한 활용하고, 지속적으로 팀 구성을 최적화하여 점점 더 강력한 적을 상대하며 승리를 쟁취하세요!

title: Warborne Above Ashes
description:
게임 정보
Warborne Above Ashes is a sci-fi post-apocalyptic MMO featured by a player-driven faction warfare. As a Driftmaster, you'll join the relentless war of six rival factions. Cooperation, betrayal, conquest, speculation… Choose your faith and faction, and play your own part of this epic!
24/7 Non-Stop PvP – Battle ‘Til You Drop!
Massive 100 vs 100 Teambattles: Jump into large-scale fights erupting across the map at any moment! Whether you're going solo or joining a massive guild war, this is the ultimate arena to prove your skills.
Solo or Squad, Your Call: Take on gangs of resource-hungry bandits solo, or team up with allies to dive into deadly territories. Remember, winners take all, losers fall!

title: WILL: Follow The Light
description:
게임 정보
WILL: Follow The Light는 스토리가 중심이 되는 일인칭 어드벤처 퍼즐 게임으로, 혹독한 북부를 헤쳐 나가는 개인의 위험천만한 여정을 담고 있습니다. 가족과 재회하고 평화를 찾기 위해 Will은 끝없는 바다를 항해하고, 수많은 도전에 맞서고, 궁극적으로는 진정한 자신을 발견해야 합니다.
아버지와 아들의 이야기
이 게임에서는 북부 바다 외딴섬의 등대지기인 Will이 되어 플레이하게 됩니다. 혼자서 근무하던 Will에게 예기치 못한 무전 메시지가 도착해 일상을 깨뜨리면서 이야기는 시작됩니다. 갑작스러운 재해가 고향을 덮쳐, 외동아들이 실종되었다는 소식이었죠. 아들을 찾아 나서기로 마음먹은 당신은 요트 Molly를 타고 위험한 북부 바다를 항해하는 모험을 시작합니다.
열심히 아들을 찾아보지만, 더 많은 의문만이 생기죠. 당신과 아버지 사이에 숨겨진 진실은 무엇일까요? 당신의 사랑하는 아내는 어디 있을까요? 도대체 당신의 가족에겐 무슨 일이 생긴 걸까요? 답은 가혹한 북부 환경 곳곳에 흩어져 있습니다. 오직 바다를 통해서만 접근할 수 있는 버려진 섬, 개 썰매를 타고 횡단할 수 있는 산맥, 이제 폐허에 둘러싸여 오직 도보로만 갈 수 있는 집 등을 탐험하며 그 답을 찾아야 합니다.
여정을 진행하는 동안, 자신에 대한 진실을 발견하게 될 겁니다. 그 진실이 마음에 들지, 아닐지는 알 수 없지만 말이죠.
이 모든 것이 당신의 아들을 구하기 위해서입니다...
... 아니, 어쩌면 자신을 구하기 위해서일지도 모릅니다.

title: SPORTAL
description:
게임 정보
Bat, Strike, Kick and Smack balls into monstrous menagerie in this retro sport themed fps roguelike, where you are sucked into a portal and emerge with a plethora of sport equipment repurposed into an arsenal of lethal weapons.

- Use a variety of sporting equipment to defeat hordes of monsters straight from 50's era creature features by launching spiked baseballs, lightning infused hockey pucks, exploding golf balls, bladed bowling balls and more



- Find clues as to what happened when you went to your favourite cinema in your favourite mall just to wake up in the magical land frequented by nasties that you only believed existed on celluloid



- Pick up and upgrade the numerous clubs, bats, sticks and balls, outfits and perks to find the winning combinations of hardware and gear to have the best shot at getting rid of all the monstrosities thrown your way and maybe, just maybe, you will have a chance to make it back home

title: PixelBurg
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to PixelBurg!
The age of oppression is over – reclaim your legacy!
Your family’s kingdom was taken from you, but now the hour of revenge has come. Build your power, lead your army, and construct a castle worthy of your ancestors' glory!
Castle Building – From Village to Fortress
Gather resources, expand your humble farmhouse into a thriving city, and construct over 20 different buildings. Assign professions to your subjects, collect taxes, and watch your castle flourish. Every wall, every tower brings you closer to your ultimate goal: dominion over the land!
Battles & Defense – War for the Crown
Your enemies do not rest – defend your realm against those who once overthrew your father. Or take the fight to them: storm their castles, conquer their lands, and expand your empire. Assemble a mighty army, organize your troops, and command them in epic battles!
Exploration – The World Awaits
Leave the safety of your walls and discover a world full of dangers and mysteries. Plunder ancient treasures, defeat bandits, and uncover valuable artifacts. But beware: not everything lurking in the wilderness can be conquered by steel…
Are you ready to reclaim your kingdom?

title: Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile
description:
게임 정보

나일강의 죽음은 나일강을 따라 나아가던 한 유람선 내에서 끔찍한 범죄가 발생하며 시작합니다. 하지만 다행히 명탐정 에르퀼 푸아로가 유람선의 승객이었죠.
한편, 한 사립 탐정이 살인자를 쫓아 런던에서 마요르카, 뉴욕, 마지막으로 이집트에 도착합니다.
이 2건의 수사가 아부 심벨에서 충돌하게 되고, 최고의 2인조가 다양한 반전과 이야기로 가득한 복잡한 사건을 해결하며 소설이 종결됩니다.
하지만 이야기는 거기서 끝나지 않습니다. 애거사 크리스티의 팬 여러분도 놀랄 만한 다양한 미스터리와 깜짝 요소가 숨어 있기 때문입니다.
특징
2명의 주인공: 에르퀼 푸아로와 제인 로이스로 플레이하세요. 각자의 관점과 서사가 엄청난 피날레로 합쳐집니다.
혁신적 배경: 풍성하고 생동감 넘치는 70년대 배경을 경험해 보세요. 디스코 클럽, 다채로운 캐릭터도 함께합니다.
확장된 스토리라인: 소설의 내용 이후로도 이어지는 새로운 사건에 뛰어들어 보세요. 팬 여러분도, 이야기를 처음 접하시는 분도 좋아할 만한 신선한 놀라움을 경험하실 수 있습니다.
다양한 장소: 이국적인 나일강 유람선부터 사람들로 북적이는 마요르카, 런던, 카이로의 거리까지, 여러 가지 근사한 장소를 탐험해 보세요.
강화된 마인드맵: 역동적인 마인드맵에서 그간 모은 단서를 연결하며 추론하고, 스토리를 진행해 나가세요.
대면 시스템: 수집한 증거를 사용해 용의자를 대면하고, 거짓을 폭로하고, 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내세요.
캐릭터 프로필: 대사와 관찰을 통해 수집한 정보로 캐릭터 프로필을 완성하세요.
autokwd: Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile,애거사 크리스티 - 나일강의 죽음

title: SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes
description:
게임 정보
"Eeny, meeny, miney, moe
Creepy GREEN EYES are on the wall.
Don't you think all this is joke,
Little girl is gonna choke!"
Have you ever heard of the cursed Green Vinyl? Or perhaps the Black Blanket is trying to kill you at night? Have you ever encountered a Blue Finger in a bun? The visual novel "SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes" is the first of five planned games set in the lore of Soviet children's spooky stories, where everything is real. The story follows a girl named Dasha from class 4th "B," who disobeyed her mother and listened to the green record. Along with her, you will confront a mysterious and terrifying evil, and it is up to you to decide what awaits her in the end. ^___^
autokwd: SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes,ФИЛЬМОСКОП УЖАСОВ: Зелёные Глаза

title: One Turn Kill
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
One Turn Kill is a PvE card game focused on drawing and deck control. The system is centered around the thrill of drawing cards and the challenging condition of defeating the enemy within a single turn. Even just one slip-up may be fatal, leading to a suspenseful and unique play experience. Join the protagonist in a pixel art wasteland to face off with the strongest of enemies and see what story awaits.
Game Features
Unique system where draws cost:
Drawing cards from the deck costs card uses. Enjoy highly reproducible combos with abundant draws while also strategizing to avoid running out of cards.

Synergistic deck building:
Cards and skills differ in their compatibility. By skillfully combining them, you can achieve more powerful effects than when using them alone. Players can unleash a wide range of strategies using a deck limited to 20 cards. How you build your deck will determine whether or not you are victorious.

Speedy and suspenseful one-turn battles:
If you cannot defeat the enemy on the first turn, the enemy's counterattack will soon determine who wins. This condition allows you to enjoy tough battles requiring quick and precise action.
Visuals and Background Music
Using cards allows characters to move in sync with one another with rich animation. Enjoy catchy background music that matches the game's quick pace and lingers in your ears, creating an even more immersive gaming experience.

title: Founders
description:
게임 정보
파운더스(Founders)는 1~16명의 플레이어를 위한 도시 건설 생존 게임으로, 독특한 성격과 배경 이야기를 가진 NPC가 등장합니다. 끊임없는 위협으로부터 정착지를 건설하고 방어하는 동시에 캐릭터의 기술을 개발하세요.
생존하다
음식과 자원을 찾아 황야를 횡단하면서 사람, 동물, 환상적인 생물과 전투를 벌이세요.
짓다
정착지를 발견하고 주택, 상점, 길드 등을 위한 건물을 건설하세요.
확장하다

title: Wild Haven
description:

Wild Haven is a 4x nature builder about a small spirit rebuilding a polluted world. Explore the world around you, clean up the pollution left behind, bring back plants and animals, and grow your woodland forest. Unlock your full potential by helping ancient spirits and selecting upgrades to build a vibrant ecosystem.
Build complex ecosystems
Build your forest and discover unique and varied wildlife.  Strategically place wildlife on the map to act as resources for other kinds of plants and animals.  As you build more, you’ll be able to add more resource intensive plants and animals. Upgrade your own abilities to discover new and interesting wildlife and see what kind of forest you can build.
Explore and clean

title: Hotel Owner Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Hotel Owner Simulator에서 작은 오래된 호텔을 시작으로 흥미진진한 여정을 시작하세요.
호텔의 각 부분을 설계하여 방의 색상부터 각 방의 크기와 모양까지 관리하세요. 당신에게는 완전한 통제권이 있습니다! 손님들과 대화하고, 그들을 행복하게 유지하며 호텔의 인기를 높이세요. 호텔 사업 제국을 관리하고, 건설하고, 업그레이드하며 성공을 위한 전략을 세워 번창하는 모습을 지켜보세요.
게임 메커니즘
"Hotel Owner Simulator"에서 매력적인 방을 만들고 디자인하세요!
최고의 가격을 설정하고 훌륭한 서비스를 제공하여 손님들을 행복하게 유지하세요. 호텔을 깨끗하고 아름답게 유지하여 손님들을 감동시키는 것이 중요합니다.
방의 편안함과 스타일을 향상시키기 위해 업그레이드하세요! 호텔의 경제가 성장함에 따라 새로운 호텔을 구매하고 제국을 확장할 수 있는 충분한 돈을 벌 수 있습니다.
호텔 경영의 흥미진진한 모험을 준비하세요!
커스터마이제이션
호텔 방을 창의적으로 꾸미세요!
사이즈, 색상 및 다양한 세부 사항을 변경하여 완벽한 고객 경험을 창출할 수 있습니다.
벽을 배치하여 각기 다른 모양과 크기의 방을 만들어 각각의 방에 독특한 느낌을 주세요.

title: Coffee Talk Tokyo
description:
게임 정보
In a city of paper and steel, as large as a country, a small café gives humans and fantasy people a cosy place to be. Brew the right order for your customers as they seek refuge from the sweltering Tokyo summer heat and share heartfelt stories to chill lo-fi beats.

Set in Tokyo, a city where old and new coexist, this newest game in the Coffee Talk franchise brings back familiar elements with new twists.
New Cafe, New Customers
Coffee Talk Tokyo once again places you behind the counter of a chill coffee shop. But while the feeling is familiar, the customers and their stories are new. They include:
Kenji, the traditional kappa salaryman, striving to find meaning and a way forward after retirement.
Vin, the Barista's assistant coping with a fractured past and the daily consequences of a previous disaster.
Ayame, a happy-go-lucky but recently deceased It girl, struggling to make sense of her new (after)life.
Lo-fi Beats Soundtrack by Andrew ""AJ"" Jeremy
The composer for Coffee Talk and Coffee Talk Episode 2, AJ, returns once again with new tracks to set the lo-fi soundscape and chill atmosphere.
Say it with Stencils
Elevate your latte art with sprinkle stencils. Easily create beautiful latte art by sprinkling a powdery design on a customer's drink, then make it your own by adding milk and etching.
Master of Tomodachill
Engage with your customers on the social network Tomodachill. Learn more about their stories and help them discover the truth they're seeking or make life-changing connections.

title: Blade Blitz
description:
게임 정보
Simple Controls
Mastering Blade Blitz is a breeze with intuitive controls. A joystick and two buttons are all you need to start slicing and dicing.

title: Age of Respair
description:
게임 정보

Age of Respair 는 왕국의 모든 측면을 관리하는 전략적인 성 건설 게임입니다:

자원을 모아 생산 체인을 구축하세요.
인구를 늘려 성과 경제를 확장하세요.
끝없는 포위 공격을 견딜 수 있도록 방어를 강화하세요.
거대한 군대를 조직해 적의 성을 공략하세요.

스토리 중심의 캠페인을 플레이하거나, AI 상대와의 치열한 전투에 참여할 수 있습니다.



나무, 돌, 철과 같은 필수 자원을 수집하세요. 일꾼들은 이 자원들을 수집해 창고로 운반하고, 생산 체인에서 사용할 수 있도록 합니다. 인구를 먹여 살리는 것도 잊지 마세요. 사과 농장 같은 빠른 선택지와 밀밭, 제분소, 빵집 등 더 신뢰할 수 있는 식량 시스템을 구축할 수 있습니다. 당신의 모든 결정은 왕국의 번영을 좌우합니다.



왕국을 번영시키기 위해 인구의 행복을 관리하는 것은 필수입니다. 백성들이 불만족하면, 그들은 일을 그만두고 심지어 성을 떠날 수 있습니다. 교회, 주점, 장식물 등을 건설하여 사기를 높이세요. 그러나 주의해야 할 점은, 인구가 늘어날수록 그들을 행복하게 유지하기 위한 건물도 더 많이 필요하다는 것입니다.
또는 공포를 통한 통치도 가능합니다. 고문 도구 같은 무서운 구조물을 배치하면, 생산성이 증가하지만 행복도는 낮아집니다. 명성을 현명하게 조절하세요:





왕국이 성장함에 따라 필요도 커집니다. 기본 건물로 시작해 효율성을 높이기 위해 업그레이드하세요. 경제가 당신의 야망에 맞춰 확장되도록 전략적으로 업그레이드하는 것이 중요합니다. 전략적인 업그레이드는 강력하고 번영하는 경제를 유지하는 데 핵심입니다.



강력한 성벽, 전략적 탑, 깊은 해자로 방어를 강화하여 적의 침공으로부터 왕국을 지키세요. 왕을 보호하는 것이 가장 중요합니다.
방어를 확실히 한 후에는 공격 전략에 집중하세요. 무기를 생산하고 병사를 훈련시키며, 공성기계(예: 발리스타, 투석기, 공성탑 등)를 배치하여 적의 성을 정복하세요. 전쟁의 안개가 적의 위치를 숨기므로, 정찰과 전략적 계획이 승리를 위해 필수적입니다.


디스코드에 가입하여 우리와 소통하고, 알파 및 베타 단계에서 게임을 가장 먼저 경험해 보세요. 게임을 함께 만들어 나가는 과정에서 다른 열정적인 팬들과 연결될 수 있습니다.

It's a cruel world, do what's best to survive.

title: BloomTale
description:
게임 정보
블룸테일의 세계에서 나만의 꽃가게를 운영하며 창의력을 마음껏 발휘해 보세요!

꽃들은 각각 고유한 의미가 있어요. 꽃말을 익히고, 손님들의 요청에 맞는 꽃다발을 만들어 꽃들이 신선하고 아름답게 유지되도록 해보세요. 하지만 꽃만큼 중요한 건 손님들이죠! 그들 역시 특별한 이야기를 간직한 존재들이니까요.

긴 하루를 마친 후, 블룸테일에서 휴식과 몰입을 동시에 느껴봐요. 가게를 자유롭게 꾸미고, 꽃말의 깊은 의미를 알아가면서, 다양한 꽃과 장식을 활용해 완벽하고 특별한 꽃다발로 가게의 명성을 꽃 피워 보세요!

게임 특징

플로럴 디자인:
다양한 색상과 스타일의 꽃을 조합해 나만의 특별한 꽃다발을 만들어 보세요. 꽃말을 활용해 감정과 메시지를 담아 손님들에게 잊지 못할 특별한 경험을 전달할 수 있어요. 단순히 예쁘게 꾸미는 걸 넘어서, 손님들의 요청을 충족시키고, 당신만의 개성을 담아 완벽한 꽃다발을 완성해 보세요. 또, 다양한 색상과 모양의 보석, 리본, 포장지를 활용해 꽃다발을 더욱 아름답고 특별하게 꾸밀 수 있어요!

title: The Backwars
description:
게임 정보
The Backwars is a survival horror game that keeps you on edge at all times. Whether you’re playing alone or with friends, your only goal is to survive. Scavenge for food and water, build what you need to stay alive, and hide from the unspeakable horrors hunting you. Each level is packed with threats that force you to think fast and act faster.
Step into an unforgiving world where everything feels disturbingly real. The heavy atmosphere, eerie sounds, and gritty visuals pull you into a nightmare that won’t let go. Every item, object, or system in the game connects in ways that can surprise or terrify you. Nothing feels safe, and nowhere is truly secure.
The entities stalking you aren’t the only danger—other players can be just as deadly. Trust can get you killed, and alliances rarely last long. Whether you’re hiding in the dark, crafting tools, or fighting for your life, every moment is a gamble.

title: Ghost Frequency
description:
게임 정보
Ghost Frequency는 당신을 PIT - 초자연적 조사 팀의 베테랑 유령 사냥꾼 마크로 만들어주는 1인칭 공포 게임입니다.
동료 에밀리와 함께 마크는 음산한 존재가 있는 버려진 장소에서 두 팀원이 신비롭게 사라진 사건을 조사합니다.
당신의 임무? 밤을 견디고 그림자 속에 잠복한 오싹한 미스터리를 밝혀내는 것입니다.

title: UltraBoxing – VR Boxing
description:
게임 정보
UltraBoxing VR is a boxing + fitness game featuring ultra-realistic AI.
Punch, dodge, move, and strategize as you take on dynamic AI opponents with fluid movements, strong defense, and advanced dodging mechanics, delivering a true boxing challenge. Fight and train in fully immersive or mixed reality modes.

title: Shore of Jord
description:
게임 정보
Live through the last winter on the Europe.
Shore of Jord is a story-driven open world cRPG set in an alternative world where sagas and Norse paganism blend with the realism of Scandinavian noir. Players navigate a post-apocalyptic landscape influenced by Scandinavian and Eastern European cultures, 1451 years after the Ragnarok.
You are Orm Junger, a retired military officer haunted by your alter-ego, Shadow. Together, you’ll unravel webs of political upheaval, dark crimes, and veiled conspiracies as you strive to piece yourself back together after a mysterious night call.
FEATURES of the Shore.
Comprehensive Character System: The game features an intricate character system with 22 distinct traits, each possessing its own nuances, contradictions, and complexities. These traits play a central role in shaping the player's journey and interactions within the game world.
Immersive and Distinctive Setting: Set in a meticulously crafted world, the game offers a unique blend of historical realism, mythical elements, and fantastical storytelling. Players will explore a richly detailed environment filled with lore, secrets, and unexpected discoveries.
Narrative-Driven Role-Playing: Experience a story-rich adventure that harkens back to the golden age of CRPGs. With a focus on deep storytelling, branching paths, and meaningful choices, players will navigate a richly layered narrative that unfolds based on their decisions and actions.
Dynamic Time Management: The game features a dynamic time management system that adds depth and consequence to player choices. As time progresses, events unfold, and the world evolves, creating a sense of urgency and agency. The world continues to live and breathe, adapting to the player’s decisions while maintaining its own independent rhythm.
Why Shore?
Choices matter: more than ever. You can get so screwed over that you'll never reach the ending you hoped for. You can ignore the "main quest" entirely and still reach real endings (not just Easter eggs), lose all your companions, or even find yourself unable to finish the game at all. The Shore of Jord is not just about successful or failed checks; it’s a game of social interactions that sometimes can’t be fixed.
The world is hard to figure out—blending the in-game Europa with real historical figures, events, technology, and everything else, shaken and rearranged to the point where players question what's really happening.

title: Mark My Words
description:
게임 정보
'Mark My Words' is a roguelike Deck-builder where strategic wordplay meets challenging modifiers.
Create high-scoring words with your Letter set as you try to get through increasingly difficult rounds. Each Letter has an initial value, but as the game progresses you will have the opportunity to upgrade your Letters and increase their value in various ways.
The ultimate word-building roguelike: Strategically create Words to score as high as possible.
Endless strategic possibilities: Upgrade your Letters, discover Stickers, unlock Glyphs and master the art of wordplay.

title: Long Drive North: Co-Op RV Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Long Drive North에서 생존하기 위해서는 운전하고, 정비하고, 탐험하고, 수색하고, 사냥을 해야 합니다.

낡았지만 믿음직스러운 RV 차량을 운전 및 정비하고, 수리하고, 연료를 채우세요.
RV를 업그레이드해 생존 확률을 높이고 취향에 따라 맞춤 설정하세요.
가혹한 세계에서 생존하세요. 수면, 허기, 갈증 수치를 관리하고, 수색해 부품을 찾고, 사냥을 통해 식량을 확보해야 합니다.
생존하기 위해 레시피로 요리를 만드세요.
황무지를 탐험하세요. 샌드박스 환경의 오픈 월드로 구현된 재난 후 미국의 황무지가 여러분의 눈앞에 펼쳐집니다.
걸어서 그리고 차량을 타고 미개척지를 누비세요. 황무지를 정복하고 이 절박한 여정에서 생존하실 수 있을까요?
혼자 또는 최대 4인 협동 멀티플레이어로 플레이하세요.

Long Drive North는 The Long Dark, The Long Drive, My Summer Car와 같은 게임에서 영감을 얻어 제작되었습니다.



여러분의 RV는 비록 낡기는 했지만, 그래도 믿음직스러운 차량입니다. 이 캠핑카가 피난처에 더해 침대와 요리 기구도 제공해 주니, 그 보답으로 애정을 담아 정비해 줘야겠죠. 이 자동차 시뮬레이터에서 소매를 걷어 붙이고 후드 밑으로 들어가, RV를 수리하고 연료를 채우세요.

다양한 요소 및 부품을 업그레이드해 차량의 상태를 양호하게 유지해야 합니다. 캠핑카를 맞춤 설정할 수도 있죠.



여러분은 집에서 멀리 떨어진 낯설고 위험한 지역에서 헤매고 있습니다. 버려진 자동차와 낡은 건물을 수색해 부품을 찾으세요. 사냥용 소총을 장착하고 길동무인 개와 함께 사냥을 나가세요. 이 자동차 여행에서 생존하려면 레시피를 익히고 요리를 만들어 식량을 확보해야 합니다.

수면, 허기, 갈증 수치를 관리해 가며 혹독하고 거친 환경에서 펼쳐지는 이 절박하고 가차 없는 여정에서 생존하세요. 악천후에 맞서고, 반복되는 위험한 폭풍을 피하기 위해 주의를 기울이세요.



걸어서 그리고 차량을 타고 미개척지를 탐험하세요. 재난 후 미국의 황무지를 누비며 이 샌드박스 환경의 오픈 월드에 무엇이 기다리고 있는지 알아보세요.

title: Swords & Souls Legacy Collection
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Souls Universe, where adventure comes in all shapes and sizes. Battle to glory, outrun the law, or solving puzzles like a gentleman. The Swords & Souls Legacy Collection brings together all five SoulGame Studios' beloved flash classics in one package.
Swords & Souls
In this iconic RPG-training hybrid, design your Soul, train them in fun mini-games, and prove your skills in the Arena. Unlock powerful abilities, grab legendary gear, and fight your way to the top. A true legend in Flash gaming, Swords & Souls remains the highest-rated game of all time on Armor Games and Kongregate. Yes, it’s that good.
Rogue Soul
Take on life as a rogue in this fast-paced runner where the streets are yours to conquer. Leap across rooftops, dodge traps, and take down enemies as you collect loot and build your reputation. With endless exploration, 50 treasures to discover, and a town full of challenges, this game lets you carve your name into history as the most wanted rogue in town.
Rogue Soul 2
The runner continues with even more adventure. Rogue Soul 2 expands the world with new enemies, detailed environments, massive upgrades, and tough-as-nails boss fights. Whether you’re perfecting your skills, finding rare treasures, or taking on challenges, this sequel is packed with so many reasons to keep coming back for more.
The Soul Driver
Buckle up and hit the road in this chaotic chase game! As a wanted outlaw, it’s you versus the police force in a mad dash to the border. Customize and upgrade your car, smash through roadblocks, and dodge everything from spike strips to helicopters. With 42 miles of mayhem, 6 unique challenges, and 24 achievements, the cops won’t know what hit them.

title: Vacation Cafe Simulator
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징:
정통 요리 만들기: 피자, 파스타, 브루스케타 등 전통 이탈리아 요리를 미니 게임을 통해 마스터해보세요.
레스토랑 발전시키기: 수익을 투자해 새로운 장비를 구입하고, 메뉴를 확장하며, 레스토랑의 내부 인테리어와 분위기를 개선하세요.
세계 탐험하기: 인근 상점, 와이너리, 농장 등을 방문해 새로운 기회를 발견하고 가게에 독특한 매력을 더하세요.

title: Scale the Depths
description:
게임 정보
You are a robot built to feed hungry aquatic "customers"! Scale the depths with your trusty fishing rod, then scale the depths again, but in the sense of scaling fish.

title: Pathologic 3
description:
게임 정보


Bachelor Daniil Dankovsky is a young doctor from the capital. His search for the secret of immortality brings him to a remote town, gripped by a mysterious plague that will destroy it in 12 days. Now it’s up to him to explore the town itself, its past, present, and future — to find answers to his numerous questions and try to stop the relentless epidemic.

(At least… that’s what he thinks this story is about. What it’s supposed to be about. What it’s always been about.)





You are a real doctor. Your tools are knowledge and science. Examine patients and diagnose diseases. Cross-check symptoms and prescribe treatments. Enforce your rules: impose quarantines, confiscate medicine, vaccinate the population, deploy patrols, and impose curfews. See how your choices change the town, even if it means being hated along the way.





You have only 12 days to stop the lethal plague. But in your hands lies the most valuable resource—time. Travel into the future to witness the worst outcomes. Correct mistakes in the past to change them. Bend the fates of people around you to save or condemn you—in search of answers.

(How is it possible? What *is* time?)





Delve into the darkest corners of the Town-on-Gorkhon to fight the disease. Face the Plague head-on. Cleanse the infected streets. Burn what can no longer be saved. What was lost in the fire will be found in the ashes.





Dankovsky is a sharp mind in search of the truth, willing to do anything to find it. Anything you see can tell a story and become a piece of your mental map of the world. Explore the town for new insights, notice details, and connect the dots. Uncover the secrets of the town’s inhabitants. Shape their stories, decide their fates, and talk to their shadows.

title: Sister Ray
description:
게임 정보
Sister Ray is an RPG-survival about the brutal daily life of a drug addicted artist named Ray, who takes care of her little sister. Look after your condition, so no one finds out about the addiction. Improve your drawing and social skills. Do everything to get cash for another fix. Survive and look for a way out.



Live each game day as you see fit. The only conditions are to survive and not get caught.
Explore the city streets and visit important locations - the school, bar, underground casino, police station, etc.
Look for places to sketch or draw at home, raising your skill and opening new abilities. Maybe you’ll get to the exhibition after all?
Any action inevitably advances the time of day - plan ahead and do not miss important events.



Selling paintings, part-time work, speculation, pickpocketing - there are a great many ways to get some cash. But what will you spend it on?
Relationships with others are an extremely fragile thing. Try not to lose your friends.
The younger sister is the only person close to you. All your bad habits will become an example for her to follow. She shouldn't find out about the addiction.

title: Aldian of Ancients
description:
게임 정보
Take control of dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures and explore a beautifully crafted world filled with threats and secrets. Build a pack/herd with your friends and take on the challenges of the land. Fight other players for survival and sustenance, conquer territories and nurture your offspring to adulthood. Always be on the lookout since danger not only comes from other players and the environment but sources beyond your comprehension...

The Lands of AldianImmerse yourself in an ancient world, lost in the shuffle of evolution, populated with creatures that promulgate intrigue. Explore different biomes, find hidden secrets and maybe you might stumble upon things that might bewilder you. 

The Denizens of Aldian

title: The Greys: Human Abductions
description:
게임 정보
The Greys: Human Abductions에서 당신은 실종되어 죽은 것으로 추정된 동생의 신비한 집을 물려받은 남자의 입장에 서게 됩니다. 동생의 집을 탐험하면서, 극비 문서, 녹음, 외계인과의 만남에 대한 불안한 증거로 가득 찬 숨겨진 다락방을 발견합니다. 미스터리에 더 깊이 파고들수록 동생과 같은 공포, 이상한 소리, 설명할 수 없는 사건, 심지어 외계인 납치의 무서운 가능성까지 경험하게 됩니다. 동생의 실종 뒤에 숨은 진실을 발견할 것인가, 아니면 알려지지 않은 세력의 다음 희생자가 될 것인가?

특징 및 게임플레이:

- 서랍을 열고, 문서를 집어 들고 검사하고, 녹음을 재생하고, 조명, 문, 숨겨진 수납공간과 상호작용하세요.

- 열쇠를 찾고, 코드를 해독하고, 미스터리한 상자를 여는 복잡한 퍼즐을 풀어보세요.

- 이상한 소음, 발소리, 속삭임, 으스스한 외계인 현상 등 무시무시한 소리를 경험해 보세요. 오디오 디자인은 게임의 핵심 요소로, 환경을 탐험하고 상호작용할 때 공포와 두려움을 증폭시킵니다.

- 설명할 수 없는 이벤트가 발생하고, 불빛이 깜빡이고, 눈가에 그림자가 움직입니다. 이상한 이벤트가 확대되기 시작하면 숨을 곳을 찾아야 합니다.

- 이야기를 더 깊이 파고들수록 공포는 더욱 커집니다. 더 많은 것을 알아낼수록 위험은 더욱 현실적으로 다가옵니다.

- 게임에는 여러 엔딩이 있으며, 게임 내내 여러분의 선택이 엔딩에 영향을 미칩니다.

title: Trainatic
description:
게임 정보
Watch your train grow from a tiny engine to a screen-clearing machine.
Unlock new cars and discover game-changing synergies.

title: The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows
description:
게임 정보
As the family dog, it's your job to protect your loved ones from danger - especially from the kind they can't see. In The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows, play as a dog defending its family from an onslaught of paranormal entities.


The Good Dog offers a variety of game modes. In Protect, you must survive the night as waves of entities enter your home and attempt to harm your sleeping family. Distract the entities by squeaking your toys or barking, or attack them if they get too close - whatever it takes to keep them away from your family. In Fetch, you must explore a range of dilapidated locations to retrieve something for your owner while avoiding the entities roaming the level.

In the Story Mode, explore the game's detailed environments to discover why the paranormal creatures have targeted you. Each environment can be explored freely, with some areas of the map opening up as time passes and as you make discoveries about the world. Solving each puzzle will bring you one step closer to saving your family. Be cautious, however; the paranormal will be tracking you throughout your journey. Using your unique abilities, you’ll need to avoid these threats at all costs - or take a chance at slowing them down with tooth and claw.


Use your keen sense of smell to search the area for tools. Roll around in the dirt to cover your scent and hide from threats. Dig up hidden items to solve puzzles and fight back against the paranormal. Bark at certain immaterial entities to disperse them, or at physical entities to draw their attention away from your family.


With over a dozen unique breeds to choose from, each with a different set of stats and abilities, you'll be able to play the game the way you want. Will you choose a small breed to fit into tighter spaces and evade danger, or a larger breed with more health and attacking power? Will you prioritize your stamina, tracking capabilities, stealth, or something else entirely? No matter how you want to play, there will be a breed for you.

title: MARINES VS GOD
description:
게임 정보


2400년, 지구의 과학자들은 상상할 수 없는 보물이 가득한 ‘신들의 행성’을 발견했습니다. 하지만 각 행성은 강력한 수호신의 보호를 받고 있습니다. 가장 용감한 자들만이 해병대에 합류하여 이 위험한 행성으로의 짧고도 위험한 임무에 도전할 수 있습니다.





가능한 많은 신성한 보물을 모으고, 괴물 무리와 함정, 파괴적인 재앙을 일으키는 신의 공격에서 살아남아 행성에서 탈출하세요.


최고의 주문을 전략적으로 선택하고 마나를 현명하게 관리하며, 함정을 설치하고 생명체를 소환하며 원소의 힘을 조종해 해병대를 처치하세요.



— 주변의 해병대를 공격합니다.

— 번개로 일정 지역에 피해를 줍니다.

— 적을 속이는 허상을 만듭니다.

— 짧은 지연 후 큰 피해를 입힙니다.

— 선택한 위치에 벽을 생성합니다.







• 화성 황무지
• 미래의 도시
• 정글 미로
• 얼음 요새
• 버려진 문명


제우스, 악마의 군주, 아나르 드림스(Anar Dreams)


수호자, 저격수, 의무병 또는 기술자


고전적인 비대칭 모드 (4대1) — 신과 해병대의 대결
PvP, PvE, 협동 및 혼합 모드로 친구 또는 AI와 플레이 가능 (최대 8명)

title: Lands of Achra
description:
게임 정보
The Lands of Achra roll forth...

Continuing the universe of Path of Achra and inspired by Conquest of Elysium, it is the second passion project of this grateful solo developer, who thanks you for visiting



Choose from a huge list of factions and customize it with various sub-cultures and cults. Unlock more as you play. Gigantic variety is the goal: fight as a single swordmaster with legendary strength, a rampaging dragon, a swarming horde of Rat-Men, a phalanx of the Garnet City...

Discover strange artifacts to empower your army. Construct buildings to spread your territory and secure resources. Create devastating combos by picking from numerous "acts," such as burning weapons, revolution, summoning a buried god...

Survive the unfolding turn-based world as its denizens grasp for power, seeking glory, ever-elusive...

title: LEGION
description:
게임 정보
LEGION is an epic real-time strategy game that brings the thrill of large-scale battles to both mobile devices and desktop platforms. Engage in intense, short skirmishes on diverse maps as you command massive armies, each consisting of hundreds of units.
Key Features
Cross-Platform Play: Experience seamless gameplay across mobile and desktop, allowing you to take the battle wherever you go.
Real-Time Strategy: Strategize in real time as you control every aspect of your squads on the battlefield.
Complete Squad Control: Take charge of your units with full precision—raise shields, adjust formations, and control formation density to outmaneuver your opponent.
Realistic Physics: Watch as cavalry charges tear through formations of archers, creating dynamic and believable battle scenes.
Variety of Maps: Fight across 3 unique battlefields, each offering different tactical challenges and opportunities.
Campaign Mode: Immerse yourself in a gripping campaign, honing your skills and learning the ropes before taking the fight online.
Online Multiplayer Battles: Test your strategic prowess against players worldwide in exciting real-time skirmishes.
Ranked Matches: Climb the ranks in competitive battles, proving your skills as a commander.
Unit Upgrades: Customize and improve your squads to create a fighting force tailored to your style of play.
Command, strategize, and dominate in LEGION—the ultimate RTS experience where every decision counts. Will your tactics bring victory, or will your army fall before a superior foe?

title: Tearscape
description:
게임 정보
Discover a Gothic world in this 2D top-down action-adventure, blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and pixel art inspired by Game Boy Color classics. Fight monstrous foes, unlock new abilities, and explore a non-linear map filled with hidden secrets and dangerous challenges.
Features
Master precise combat, where every strike and dodge matters. Strategically manage your stamina by carefully considering each move as you face off against grotesque enemies. You have a limited number of healing flasks—use them wisely and plan your moments to recover carefully. Upgrade your character's stats to remain effective and competitive in combat.

title: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search  a Dead Body
description:
게임 정보
"Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?"
This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient Japanese tomb!
Game Features
Play as Kofun and go on an adventure to search for a dead body to bury in his body!
Complete tasks on your To-Do List to progress the story!
Interact with all sorts of things in your surroundings and collect Action Points!
Use Action Points to get new skills and hints for your adventure!
Kofun
A young boy who lives in Friendly Park. Believes he's an ancient Japanese tomb.
Thinks keyhole-shaped tombs are the coolest of them all.
Haniwa
A young funerary clay sculpture boy who's always full of energy.
He's the one who first shows Kofun the outside world.
autokwd: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search  a Dead Body

title: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall
description:
게임 정보
Year 1645. Scholar Fang Zhiyou descended into madness following the suicide of his childhood friend. Overwhelmed with grief, unable to continue writing, and chased by past traumas; he began drowning his sorrows in alcohol and developed a mental condition that made him see people as beasts.
On the 24th day of the fourth lunar month, after drinking heavily, Fang collapsed in the street on his way home. When he woke up, he found himself transported to the Kingdom of Shituo, a city he had once introduced in his book.
A book that described how, 500 years before the Great Sage Sun Wukong’s journey, the Yaoguai wreaked havoc on Shituo, slaughtering and terrorizing its people under the command of the Golden Winged Great Peng.
Just as in his book, he starts experiencing the chaos and the horrifying reality of the war. Amid the murders, rapes, and the burning city, Fang lost all hope of survival. Yet, that changed when he encountered a young girl.
A girl looked extremely similar to Su Lingyan, an old friend who had tragically ended her life three years earlier. The courtesan Su Lingyan, his childhood sweetheart and his only confidante. She even shared the same childhood nickname, “Little Swan.”
Determined to protect her, Fang vowed to survive and ensure her safety until the massacre was over, no matter the cost.
Story Background
There are two storylines set in the late Ming Dynasty, “Memo” and “Recall”.
Memo chapters:
This part covers the 10 days following the 24th day of the fourth lunar month, 1645.
After Emperor Chongzhen’s suicide on Mei Mountain, Wu Sangui led Qing soldiers into the northern plains of the former Ming Empire. The Ming royal family fled south, establishing the Southern Ming Dynasty to resist the Qing invasion.
The Qing army divided into two forces. One attacked the peasant army led by the Dashing King, Li Zicheng. The other, commanded by Prince Yu (Dodo), directly invaded south of the Yangtze River. Dodo dispatched a hundred thousand soldiers to lay siege to Yangzhou city. Shi Kefa, leading both citizens and soldiers, defended the city to the end. Eventually, the city fell, and Dodo ordered a massacre.
autokwd: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall

title: Wild West Pioneers
description:
게임 정보
Are you tired of the crowded east coast cities? Grab your family and move to the West where there is free land for everybody and claim your future. With fertile soil and abundant resources, you’ll find more than adventure and freedom. This is your chance to be a driving force of the American dream.



Wild West Pioneers is a classic city builder with a modern touch, putting you in control in developing the American frontier. Lay the groundwork for prosperous settlements, decide who will lead the city and establish production chains for food, wood etc., so the needs of each settler are fulfilled. Then send another trek on its way to expand your sphere of influence. Set up trade routes and prepare the land for the coming railroad network.

With a variety of quests, an intuitive interface and eye-catching visuals, the world of Wild West Pioneers evokes the spirit of the heyday of city builders and catapults it into the presence. No need to stress out, when you can just relax and watch the charming hustle and bustle of a busy settlement as well as dozens of buildings and production chains.






You decide what the West will look like. Choose from a wide variety of buildings both residential as well as commercial like the sawmill or butcher up to warehouses and transport hubs to distribute your produce. Upgrade them over time to accommodate the ever-changing needs of the settlers. Pick mayors and sheriffs, but be careful who you appoint - their perks will affect the cities’ growth.




One settlement is only the beginning. While you discover new resource streams and production chains the urge to expand will become unstoppable. Send your settlers into uncharted territory and build new villages. Then set up trade routes, so resources can be exchanged. Don’t leave anybody behind or it will cost you dearly.




Your villages are filled with characters. Everybody has needs and demands that you have to fulfill, if you want your reputation to precede you. Only with a sufficient happiness level influenced by job availability, health standards etc. will you be able to attract new settlers and become one of the driving forces in the expansion of the United States.




Day and night cycle have an impact on the game world. Watch the city life change from dusk till dawn and show true leadership skills when you take on the challenges of efficient production chains and trade routes.




The strategic map will help you to plan your progress. Send expeditions, establish trading outposts and dispatch wagons with daring explorers eager to found new settlements. With the sandbox character of Wild West Pioneers, no game will ever be the same.




Sit back, chill and watch your plans come to fruition. Observe the hustle and bustle of city life, where every job is executed by a person and not a backend value. Watching your settlement grow in its detailed glory is half the fun.

title: Roombattle
description:
게임 정보
Roombattle is a party fighting game where players will control robotic vacuum cleaners and will fight equipped with sharp objects and balloons. The main objective is to be the last to be equipped balloons in the game. In addition to the battles, the game contains a large crowd of minigames.
Meet up with your friends, customize your vacuum, and get ready to battle in different rooms to claim victory!
Play with your friends in thrilling vacuum battles across colorful and dynamic rooms. Each theme features exclusive mechanics, making every round unique and exciting. Destroy the room and then clean it up!
