title: Mythos: Build & Survive
description:
게임 정보
Before the missionaries came to the Slavic lands to start writing down the known history, there was the Age of Mythos:

Forests, valleys and fields are full of creatures from Slavic beliefs. Even though they may look like monsters, you don't have to fight them all. Make proper offerings to them and you will gain powerful allies.


Give your workers a roof over their heads and a good supper and they will build a thriving settlement for you. Do not disappoint your subjects, because dissatisfied people may leave you.

title: Jump Ship
description:
게임 정보

Jump Ship은 우주선의 크루가 되어 우주를 탐험하는 미션 기반 4인 협동 FPS입니다. 함선 내부의 활동부터 직접 걸어서 행성을 탐험 및 우주 유영까지 자연스럽게 이어지며 전환이 가능합니다. 지상과 우주 모두에서 격렬한 전투에 참여하고 함선을 지키며 업그레이드 하십시오. 팀워크는 생존과 승리에 직결됩니다.

개발진은 협동 게임과 우주를 사랑합니다. Jump Ship은 이 두 가지를 하나에 담기 위한 저희의 결실입니다.
소개
우주를 건너는 여행 - 하나하나 무작위 요소로 짜임새 있게 만든 다양한 미션에 참가해 보세요. 단 한 번의 게임도 동일한 경험을 선사하지 않습니다.
자연스러운 함선과 필드 전환 - 함선으로 점프를 한 뒤 끊김없이 자연스럽게 함선 조종과 우주 유영 및 필드 탐험이 가능합니다, 가능하게 했으니까요.
업그레이드, 관리, 수리 - 부품을 획득해 함선을 업그레이드 또는 수리하고 필요에 맞게 바꿔 나가세요.
대원들과 함께 또는 홀로 - Jump Ship은 친구들과 함께 즐길 때 가장 재미있지만 혼자서도 즐겁게 탐험할 수 있습니다.

우주를 탐험하며 마주치는 다양한 도전에 맞추어 내 함선을 업그레이드하고 커스터마이즈 하세요. 다양한 장소에서 자원을 획득해 생존해야 합니다. 방어를 강화하고 에너지 출력을 조정해 함선의 속도를 높이거나 공격력을 강화하세요. 선택은 여러분의 몫입니다.
필드와 함선 간의 부드러운 전환으로 소행성 무리를 피해 함선을 조종하다가도 제트팩으로 적 함선으로 날아가 코어를 폭파할 수도 있습니다. 탐험, 전투, 이동 간의 자연스러운 변환을 경험해 보십시오.
친구들과 미션에 도전하며 각자 역할을 분담해 보세요. 파일럿, 엔지니어, 탐험 선발대까지 다양한 역할을 서로 분담하세요. 협력해서 적의 공격을 막아내며 통제실에 난 불을 끄거나 비행 중에 함선의 에너지 출력을 조정해야 합니다. Jump Ship에는 정해진 클래스가 없습니다. 어떤 일을 해낼 지 직접 생각하고 적응해서 행동하세요.

title: Trauma - Visual Novel
Train Mechanic Simulator 2025
description:
게임 정보
Take on the role of a Train Mechanic, repair old-school steam locomotives for your customers. Spend earned money on expanding your workshop capabilities and improving your skills.
It all starts with…



Cleaning the locomotive of dirt and rust. This will enable quicker accurate diagnosis and significantly speed up the repair process.
Work, work



Repairs are the essence of the game. It's your job. It's your way to get more cash and new skills needed to stay relevant in the business.
Fully Stocked Workshop



Your fully stocked workshop will allow you to carry out the most complicated diagnostics and repairs. As your business grows, you will be able to upgrade your current tools and purchase new ones to increase efficiency and bring in faster profits.



You will find a wide range of various types of steam locomotives in your workshop, from the oldest through to the most recent designs. Be prepared, it won't be a walk in the park.



Your locomotive doesn’t have to be boring, use the available personalization options and make it your own.



Your biggest challenge will be the disassembly of the locomotives themselves. Full of realism and details, these will make it no easy task, and you'll have to work hard to fully understand them. After that, you will have the opportunity to take her on a spin and find out if everything is ok.

title: Farm Renovator
description:
게임 정보
Farm Renovator에서 당신은 완전히 갖추어진 미국 농장을 개조하고, 확장하고, 운영하게 됩니다! 선택의 자유, 다양한 작업, 비즈니스 운영 방식에서 창의성, 어려운 상황에 대처 이것이 이 게임의 핵심 요소입니다.
개조
버려진 농장을 이전의 모습으로 되돌리세요. 잡초와 쓰레기는 버리고 벽은 보수하고 페인트를 칠하고 기호에 맞게 장식하세요. 기계를 찾아 새로운 삶을 주세요. 이 기계들은 틀림없이 농장에서 유용하게 쓰입니다! 장비를 수리하고, 수리할 수 없는 것은 구입하세요. 첫 번째 작물을 수확하고, 고객을 초대하여 확장, 추가 보수, 개선을 위한 자금을 지원받으세요.

title: Life After End
description:
게임 정보
"Life After End — a fierce struggle for survival in post-apocalyptic Siberia, where every moment can be your last. Familiar places are now a nostalgic reminder of times past, which will seem like a fairy tale.
Be prepared for unbearable conditions: build shelters, search for food, create weapons and medicine. But remember, you won't survive alone. Look for allies, but don't forget that in this world, even friends can become enemies in a moment of danger.
Game features:
Realism to the limit. Remember that your actions will have consequences. Weather and your physical condition can become crucial factors. Illness, frostbite, hunger, thirst, and fatigue will be obstacles to survival.
Multiple maps and modes. Go through an engaging storyline campaign or immerse yourself in survival on a map with other players. The storyline campaign will be available some time after release.
Animal taming. Get yourself a dog, cat, wolf, or bear. Each companion has pros and cons. Choose wisely, as it can cost you your life. And yes, you'll be able to ride a bear, yes, yes.
Huge arsenal of weapons. From spears and bows to advanced rifles that can be customized to suit your needs - search for or create what will help you survive.
Crafting and building system. Not only collect, but also create tools and buildings that will help you survive.
Interactive environment. Block passages by moving furniture and tables. Close windows with objects. Use the environment for defense and attack.
Every decision you make is a chance. A chance to survive, sit by the campfire with friends, warm up, play the balalaika, and drink something hot from a glass. Otherwise, I have no idea what the game is about.

title: Ys vs. Trails in the Sky: Alternative Saga
description:
게임 정보
Maximum Thrill! High-Speed Battle Action!
The fast-paced action that earned acclaim in Ys SEVEN is back and better than ever! With the ability to jump adding a whole new layer of speed and strategy, you'll soar across vast battlefields while unleashing thrilling combos that take the excitement to the next level.
Familiar characters from the Trails in the Sky series showcase their mastery of diverse crafts, delivering familiar yet dynamic attacks you can only experience in this title!
Bringing the Story to Life with Full Voice Acting!
Featuring a stellar cast of voice actors from the Ys and Trails series, every scene comes to life with full voice acting. Their powerful performances heighten the drama of battles and cutscenes.
Falcom All-Stars! A Cast of Beloved Characters!
In addition to the playable characters, many fan-favorite characters from various titles join as support characters! These allies provide powerful backup in heated battles, which will assist you in achieving victory. Let their guidance lead you to triumph!
Key Features:
Beautifully remastered graphics for display in HD and 4K screens, as well as 60FPS support
Featuring couch and online multiplayer (with rollback netcode) for the first time
Includes English voice acting from a familiar cast from the Ys and Trails series
A vast Material Collection of wallpapers and soundtracks from various Falcom titles to unlock
PC-centric features including mouse and keyboard support, arbitrary aspect ratio (up to 5:4 and 21:9), and more!
autokwd: Ys vs. Trails in the Sky: Alternative Saga

title: Rise of Rebellion
description:
게임 정보
・Overview
"Rise of Rebellion" is a single-player 3D action RPG that pursues strategicity through operations during battle.
The hero fights with the invaders he encounters on the island in order to regain his invaded hometown.
The basis of combat is melee with swords, but the “May,” energy derived from the earth, allows the use of techniques that are advantageous in battle.
However, if you use Mei too much, you will be incapacitated for a certain period of time due to the wrath of the god of the earth.
That dilemma further increases the strategic nature of the battle.
Please experience the "link feeling" that makes you sweat in your hands while confronting strong enemies.

・Story
"If God exists, he must be a jealous God."

The dragons that once aimed at the sky were extinct due to the earth punishment.
People worshiped God and the land where God dwelled.
The earth was full of "May", and the warriors who mastered it were called "Manus".

You fight to regain your hometown as a Manus.
autokwd: Rise of Rebellion,Rise of Rebellion～地罰上らば竜の降る～

title: ASCENDANT
description:
게임 정보
여러분과 뜻밖의 영웅으로 구성된 여러분의 팀, 그리고 세 개의 바이오코어만이 생존과 전멸의 갈림길에 서 있는 모든 것인 ASCENDANT에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
ASCENDANT는 깃발 뺏기 게임으로... 과격합니다. 천 년 동안의 냉동 수면 후, 눈을 뜨고 보니 세상은 엉망진창이 되어 있습니다. 돌연변이 야생동물, 통제를 벗어난 기술, 그리고 셰이드를 살아 있게 유지하는 호박으로 가득 찬 바이오코어를 두고 싸우는 라이벌 팀까지. 문제는? 매 경기가 다르다는 것입니다. 가상 게임 디렉터 덕분에 바이오코어 위치, 이용 가능한 공간, 야생 이벤트가 매번 바뀌기 때문에 여러분은 적응하거나... 죽어야만 합니다. 4개의 팀, 3개의 바이오코어... 계산은 직접 해 보세요.

title: DEPRISION
description:
게임 정보
You wake up paralyzed in an abandoned place. You can’t move. You can’t scream. You can only watch as twisted shadows slither through the corners of the room. Something is watching. Something is waiting.
Then darkness.
When you regain consciousness, you convince yourself it was just sleep paralysis. A nightmare. But the roar of the storm outside tells a different story. A lightning bolt tears through the sky, followed by a deafening thunderclap that shakes the ground beneath you. You’re not in your bed. You’re in the middle of a forest engulfed in a violent thunderstorm. Rain stabs your skin like needles, and the wind howls through the trees, bending them like paper. You don’t remember how you got here. You don’t remember who you are.
Every flash of lightning reveals twisted figures between the trees. Shadows or something else? The thunder drowns out all sound, but the chill crawling up your spine tells you something is watching.
Your amnesia is your greatest enemy, but soon, it won’t be the only one.
You must find shelter. You must keep moving. But then it happens again. A force grips your body, paralysis takes hold. Only this time, something stirs in the darkness. Something that awakens with every episode, feeding on every crack in your sanity.
Is it real? Or is your mind falling apart?
The truth hides in the storm, buried in the shadows between the trees. You just have to survive long enough to find it.

title: Solarpunk
description:
게임 정보
Solarpunk는 기술적으로 발달된 공중에 떠있는 섬의 세상에서 진행하는 생존게임입니다. 혼자서 혹은 친구들과 플레이하며, 여러분은 건물을 건설하고, 식량을 키우며, 도구들을 만들고 여러분의 자체 비행선으로 멀리 떨어져 있는 섬들을 탐험할 수 있습니다.
여러분은 자원을 모으고 식물에 물을 주는 등 자원을 모으고 여러분의 공정을 자동화 하기 위해 햇살과 바람 그리고 물을 이용할 수 있습니다.
특징
멀티플레이어: 혼자서 혹은 여러분의 친구들과 협동모드로 플레이해보세요.
건물: 자원을 모아서 공중에 하늘에 여러분의 집을 건축해보세요.
농장운영: 여러분의 식량 공급을 원활하게 할 수 있도록 식물을 키우세요.
제작: 기술적인 도구들을 만들어 여러분의 공정을 자동화하세요.
에너지: 햇살과 바람, 그리고 물을 이용해 여러분의 도구들을 위한 에너지 시스템을 만들어보세요.
비행선: 여러분의 자체 비행선을 구축하여 하늘에 멀리 떨어져 있는 섬들을 탐험해보세요.

title: Homura Hime
description:
게임 정보
Story
Welcome to a world where humans and demons coexist. Souls harboring strong emotions and deep regrets at their time of death are transformed into archdemons. Archdemons have the power to corrupt the foundation of the world and contaminate their surroundings. Creatures tainted by this demonic power turn into lowly monsters that operate solely on raw instinct.
Faced with the threat to the world posed by five extremely powerful demon girls, the High Priestess is forced to dispatch Homura Hime—the "Flame Princess" and the strongest exorcist of them all—and her aide, Ann, who are now entrusted with the divine mission of purifying the world and defeating all demons.

title: Voxelgram 2
description:
게임 정보
Voxelgram 2 은 3차원으로 조각하는 것처럼 퍼즐을 푸는 3D 노노그램 게임입니다. 각 챌린지를 완료하여 복셀 모델을 밝혀내세요.
특징:
2색 퍼즐 : 200+개의 독특한 퍼즐에 도전하세요. 20+개의 아름답게 제작된 디오라마로 구성되어 있습니다.
절차적 제작: 절차적으로 제작한 퍼즐로 끝없이 반복되는 플레이를 즐겨보세요.
유저 제작 콘텐츠
