title: My Little Puppy
description:
게임 정보
"사람이 죽으면 먼저 가 있던 강아지가 마중을 나온다는 이야기가 있다."
웰시코기 봉구는 유기견이었습니다. 단미된 걸 보면 누군가 보살피던 강아지인 것이 분명했지만 어쩐 일인지 봉구를 찾아오는 사람은 없었고, 강아지로서는 많은 8살 나이로 인해 여기저기 아픈 곳이 많아 새로운 가족을 만나는 것도 쉽지 않았죠. 좁은 철창에 갇힌 채 지내야만 했던 봉구의 하루하루는 그래서 늘 시무룩하기만 했습니다. 그러던 어느 날, 기적처럼 새로운 가족을 만났습니다. 꾀죄죄한 몰골에 어딘가 어리숙한 느낌마저 드는 아저씨였지만 봉구는 그 사람의 냄새가 정말 무척이나 좋았답니다. 그렇게 만난 아빠의 곁에서 봉구는 여느 강아지처럼 물고 당기고, 뛰고 놀고, 먹고 자며 길지 않은 여생을 특별할 것 없이 행복하게 지내다 무지개 다리를 건넜습니다.
킁킁킁... 이 냄새는... 강아지 천국에서의 어느 날, 봉구는 익숙한 냄새에 깜짝 놀라며 낮잠에서 깨어납니다. 킁킁킁... 아...아빠다! 희미하지만 저 멀리서부터 흘러온 이 냄새는 그토록 기다려온 아빠의 냄새가 분명했습니다. 단 한번도 잊어본 적 없는 바로 그 냄새였죠. 그렇게 안달이 난 봉구는 강아지 천국을 빠져나와 어쩌면 위험할지도 모를 아빠 마중 여정에 나서게 됩니다. 기적처럼 아빠가 봉구를 찾아왔듯이, 이번에는 봉구가 아빠를 찾아가야 할 때가 온 것이죠.
과연 봉구는 다시 아빠를 만날 수 있을까요?
아름다운 세상을 모험하며 만나는 다양한 강아지와 사람의 이야기
강아지 천국 바깥은 삶과 죽음의 경계에 있는 익숙한 듯 다른 세상입니다. 사막, 설산, 해변 등 아름답게 그려진 여러 지역을 모험하며, 어드벤처/액션/레이싱 장르를 넘나드는 다채로운 게임 플레이를 경험해보세요. 잊지 마세요! 봉구는 강아지입니다. 냄새 맡기, 짖기, 달리기, 점프 등 강아지가 할 수 있는 행동에는 여러모로 한계가 있기 때문에 각자의 사연을 지닌 강아지와 사람을 만나 도움을 주고 받아야만 아빠 마중 여정을 잘 마무리할 수 있습니다. 강아지는 고양이와 달리 혼자서 할 수 있는 게 많지 않답니다!

title: Swordai
description:
게임 정보
Swordai is a multiplayer sword fighting game where players compete to climb a tower full of monsters, traps, and treasure. Swordai combines a fast paced directional combat system that includes ripostes, feints, parries, kicks and combos with massive multiplayer dungeons, loot, abilities and a skill tree. Enter the tower alone or with friends, battle your way through monsters, bosses and other players, and escape with your loot alive.

As you progress through the various trials and challenges that Swordai has to offer you will unlock skills and abilities that allow you to customize your combat style as you strive to gain power and reach the top of the tower. Each floor of the tower is a unique hand-crafted dungeon crawl with a variety of different enemies, trials and monsters as well as the ever present threat of other players.



Fight with or against up to 50 other players as you compete to traverse enormous dungeons filled with monsters, bosses, traps, and treasures.





Swordai uses an "easy to learn, difficult to master" directional combat system that provides a fluid yet brutal combat experience that will keep you coming back day after to day to hone your skills.





Slay bosses, find chests, or kill other players within the tower, then find an exit portal to escape with your loot.





Unlock new powerful abilities and upgrades as you progress.

title: SWAT Commander
description:
게임 정보
첨단 특수 무기와 전술 팀의 지휘를 맡습니다. SWAT Commander는 현실성에 큰 중점을 두면서, 택티컬 게임의 풍부한 역사뿐만 아니라 해당 부대가 배치되어야 할 필요성이 있는 실제 상황을 다룹니다. 스쿼드 성원들은 당신의 지휘를 따르며, 다양한 상황에 적극적으로 대응하여 적과 효과적으로 싸우고 경찰 규약을 따릅니다. 올바른 명령을 내리면서도, 자신이 작전의 중심에 있고 많은 임무를 혼자서 수행해야 한다는 점을 잊지 마세요!
고도로 훈련된 정보원이자 핵심 전술 부대의 구성원인 당신과 팀원들은 매우 위험한 여러 미션을 수행하게 됩니다. 인질극, 강도, 갱 전쟁, 기타 여러 범죄 활동의 증인이 되세요. 최대 5명의 플레이어가 참여하는 코옵 모드에서 AI 정보원이나 친구들과 함께 미션을 완수하세요!

title: Droid Escape
Occulto
description:
게임 정보
Occulto is an indie adventure game with a focus on artistic hand-drawn visuals and a non verbal game play.

It is being developed by two fans of the genre. This is our very first game and we want to create an artistic adventure game, with challenging riddles, hand drawn scenes, animations and original soundtracks.

The whole game is under development, and its release will be approximately on the end of 2024 or the first months of 2025. Please be patient, this is a truly indie game! :)

You will guide Eliot, a young apprentice of magic, through riddles, mysteries, traps and help him find his teacher who has mysteriously disappeared.

An evil Presence is looking for a powerful book which is in the possession of the teacher.

title: Block 17
description:
게임 정보
Block 17 is a fantastic action game with elements of horror, created in a pixel-art style.

In the game, you must find a way out of a prison on the planet Mars, swarming with monsters. You will be accompanied by a bot, originally intended for repairs, but circumstances have forced it to become your assistant not only in repairing electrical networks but also in destroying disgusting creatures.

Find secrets, navigate the gloomy prison corridors, explore rooms, upgrade weapons and the bot's abilities, and maybe you'll be lucky in the next battle with the boss.

We strive to create a strong atmosphere of crushing horror in our game. Despite being a pixel-art platformer, we aim to make the game realistic, logical, and detailed, so the player feels immersed in a real world.

The main character is a mechanic summoned to a high-security prison on Mars to fix a malfunction in the electrical system. But as soon as he starts, the lights go out, he gets hit and loses consciousness, and when he wakes up, he finds himself in a prison swarming with creepy creatures.

What happened? How do you get out now? These are the questions you will have to answer.

Of course, we were inspired by well-known works of science fiction, but we tried to bring something new to our product.

In the game, the hero will have to confront the artificial intelligence created to maintain order in the prison, as well as an intelligent biological substance trying to escape to the open settlement. As the game progresses, you will have to choose which side to take, and who knows where that choice might lead you.

Block 17 features many different enemies that will not only scare you with their appearance but also create numerous difficult situations from which the player must escape. We aim to create many unique enemies with distinct abilities.

Additionally, the game will have many secrets, hiding either interesting information or useful items, as well as environmental elements designed to shed light on what is happening.

We put a lot of work into the visuals, as they are a huge part of the atmosphere. Even though the graphics are pixelated, we are constantly developing our own solutions to make the light and glare as spectacular as possible.

So, the development is in full swing. If you are interested in our project, please add the game to your wishlist and follow us!

title: Ant Detective
description:
게임 정보
Once again Kowalski is hot on the trail...of something. You take on the role of the titular Ant Detective in this prequel to learn Kowalski's true backstory...or maybe this game is a sequel where he didn't really die and just got a stomach cramp. We're not sure yet. Either way if you wishlist it we will make sure mother provides another wacky (and much longer!) adventure for Kowalski to ass about in.

Ant Detective is a third person detective noir game with a comedy twist - you're an ant, as is everyone else. Figure out who did the crime, and hope you can make them to do the time. If not you can always fall back to shooting them.
Features
Branching crime investigation: collect ant-clues, interview witness-ants, anty-thing a real detective would do!
Hyper-realistic gunplay: your gun fires bullets when you pull the trigger.
Satirical fully voice acted story; can two guys voice fifty ants? We'll find out.

title: Raven Gold
description:
게임 정보
Do You Like Sparklies?

Raven Gold is a game founded on the concept of rewarding exploration. Explore handcrafted dungeons and find piles of hidden treasure



Solve unique, challenging, handcrafted puzzles to find incredible treasure!



But it's not just a casual stroll in the park! Face off with hordes of enemies! Use your wits to take on powerful bosses that have been carefully programmed with unique skills and behaviours!



Once you've accrued some gold, decide what to do with it! Raven gold features a myriad of ways to spend your cash, from buying gear, to crafting, to buying key items that add to your experience!



And if you're looking for an interesting story, there's one of those too!

title: Margaritari
description:
게임 정보
☆About the Story★
A childhood accident had paralyzed both Viola's left leg and her later life. Bullying. Loneliness. Departure. Discrimination. For someone as innocent as Viola, who still does not understand how to face the darkness, escaping and isolating seems to be the only redemption.

Until one day, a mysterious girl appears in her dream.
☆About the Game★
JRPG-style side scroller, story-rich. Explore the world by interacting with the environments and the characters.
Approximate play time：3-5 hours.

Consists of two endings: TE1 and TE2. (Two True Endings)

title: Descended
description:
게임 정보
Descended is an action RPG that treats ideas of deep sea settlements and genetic manipulation.

The player's avatar is a human who has recently arrived at the bottom of an alien sea with one task in mind - to survive and keep revolutionary science safe from evil men on the planet's surface. This new science is also the key to survive the abyss, as it allows the player avatar to swiftly morph its body, alter genes, and tailor ecosystems. The seafloor is procedurally generated and will contain biomes such as Volcanic Trenches, Brine Mires, Worm Plains, and Seamounts.

In addition to the fun and games, Descended intends to incorporate and passively teach marine and environmental science by weaving gameplay mechanincs around concepts such as "marine snow", "source populations" and "invasive species". Its flora and fauna will be inspired by Earth's.

title: The Guardians Realm
description:
게임 정보
The Guardians Realm is an open-world Fantasy RPG in a medieval setting. It's inspired by other great RPGs like Runescape and Classic WoW, and focuses on combat, crafting, gathering, and exploring.
OPEN WORLD
In The Guardians Realm, your survival hinges on your skills in combat, crafting, gathering, and exploration. Engage in dynamic, skill-based combat with a free-moving camera that gives you full battlefield control and the ability to engage with multiple enemies. Craft powerful weapons and armor, gather resources, and defeat legendary bosses for greater rewards.
The game's flexible skill progression system allows you to tailor your character to suit your preferred play-style, whether you're a fearless warrior, a master craftsman, or a dedicated resource gatherer. With every choice you make, The Guardians Realm evolves, offering endless possibilities and unforgettable experiences.
SKILL-BASED COMBAT
Engage in fast-paced, skill-based combat with a free-moving camera that gives you full control over the battlefield. Utilize a variety of weapons, armor, and abilities to create your perfect custom build. Execute powerful combos with melee and range combat to defeat multiple foes and take down powerful bosses. Use your abilities to escape death, deal killing blows, or give yourself an advantage in critical moments.
CRAFTING
Master the art of crafting to create powerful weapons, sturdy armor, and essential survival tools. Gather resources from the environment, refine them, and combine them in ways to suit your play-style. Level up your gathering and crafting skills to create more powerful equipment.
GATHERING
Berries
Fruits
SKILLS
Woodcutting
Firemaking

title: Animal Express
description:
게임 정보
Animal Express is a chaotic co-op package delivery simulation game for one to four players. Assemble your team of couriers and pick, pack and deliver your orders in time!

Working as a courier, in Vicity is no monkey business. It's up to you to make sure the people of Vicity are getting their goods in time. Collect items like fast food, clothing, flowers, and more, Pack them carefully, and deliver them in a race against the clock. Join as a solo courier or start delivering orders with a team of a maximum of 4 players.

Clear communication and coordination are key in a successful delivery company. Picking the right items, remembering what's in each box, and making sure your delivery path is clear are amongst some of the skills needed for a successful courier. While your goal as a courier is easy to understand, there's more than enough challenge in making sure all of your customers are happy!

title: INSTALLATION 19
description:
게임 정보

Step into the shoes of Alex Carter, a member of The Abducted, a UFO hunting group. Alex follows an anonymous tip to a location for nighttime sightings, unaware that he will be stumbling into a highly classified military facility.


Exploration: Navigate the dark, foreboding halls with minimal lighting. This walking simulator immerses you in the eerie environment without the aid of a flashlight.


Uncover the secrets of the classified facility through a narrative woven into audio logs and gameplay elements.


Progress by interacting with objects like key cards, audio tapes, and documents to uncover the story.


Immerse yourself in the game’s rich soundscape, meticulously designed to pull you deep into the atmosphere of a highly classified military base. The audio experience was thoughtfully crafted by three talented Musicians Institute graduates.


We’re excited to announce that Nurbs Studios has teamed up with Default Gaming for an exclusive pre-release live stream of Installation 19! Join Default as he delves into the eerie world of the game before its official release. Stay tuned for more details coming soon!

title: Tokyo Desire : Deck Builders
description:
게임 정보
도쿄디자이어: 덱빌더스

6명의 미소녀 히로인, 도쿄에서의 달콤한 데이트!, 배틀을 통해 소녀의 마음을 얻으세요!!
도쿄에서 펼쳐지는 달콤하면서도 긴장감 넘치는 배틀!
나만의 플레이 스타일로 구성한 덱을 통해 그녀들의 트라우마와 오타쿠에 대한 선입견을 날려주세요!
과연 당신은 6명의 미소녀들을 모두 정복하고 도쿄의 반전 인기남이 될 수 있을까요?
방어 카드를 사용해 적의 공격을 예측하고, 성공한다면 강력한 반격기를 발동하세요.
적들도 주인공의 공격을 반격할 수 있으니, 반격 준비에 들어가면 조심해야 합니다!
기존 덱 빌딩 로그라이크 게임에서는 볼 수 없었던 화려한 아트워크와 애니메이션!
다양한 카드 조합으로 그녀들의 머릿속에 가득한 오타쿠 주인공에 대한 선입견을 타파하세요!
도시를 돌아다니며 공략하고 싶은 미소녀를 발견하고, 그녀들의 마음을 사로잡아 보세요.
수집할 수 있는 다양한 카드 보상과 풍부한 이벤트가 기다리고 있습니다!

총 6명의 귀엽고 사랑스러운 미소녀 캐릭터들이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다.
처음에는 다른 국적의 주인공을 어색하고 무뚝뚝하게 대하겠지만, 마인드 배틀을 통해 그녀들의 마음을 얻으면 어떤 반응을 보여줄까요?

title: Roman Trail
description:
게임 정보
March for Glory!
The drums of war echo across Britannia! Do you have what it takes to survive the brutal march along Roman Trail? In this 2D, rogue-like, comedy adventure, you step into the boots of a Roman Centurion, leading your scrappy band of Legionaries through a perilous journey during the Roman invasion of Britannia in 43 CE. With dark humor and a satirical twist, Roman Trail blends history with hilarity, throwing players into ambushes, unexpected accidents, and the ever-looming threat of dysentery. Every decision matters—will you make it to the next camp, survive brutal battles, and conquer the relentless march toward glory?
Features:
Single player, retro game experience
Short, challenging runs of each marching trail
Procedurally generated events and minigames keep each run unique
Fusion of historical realism and dark humor
Multiple branching campaign paths as you truly conquer Britannia
Challenging final events that reflect ancient battles or sieges
Unlockable passive buffs at the end of each run: they help future marches but also carry unexpected negative buffs
Morale & reputation system that reacts to player choice
Expansive minigames allow players explore, pillage forage, hang out on sentry duty, control local riots, and even challenge Barbarian champions to 1:1 combat for BIG payoffs!

title: Hellstorm: Reign
description:
게임 정보
Hellstorm: Reign is a first-person shooter game that combines the fast-paced action of classic and modern FPS games.
In a world devastated by endless wars and ecological disasters, humanity is on the brink of extinction. The surface of the planet has turned into a barren wasteland known as Hellstorm, while underneath lies a hidden sanctuary called Itopia. Itopia promises peace and advanced technology.
As a special agent, you must infiltrate Hellstorm and uncover the secrets of Itopia. Utilize advanced movement abilities like wall-running, sliding, and quick maneuvers to navigate dangerous environments and evade enemy attacks. Your arsenal is filled with powerful weapons, each offering different variations to suit your playstyle.

title: Project: Fractured Reality
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in a Nightmare. Hunted by the Unknown.
It’s been 3 months since your daughter vanished, and no one will tell you where she was last seen. The villagers are insane, the toxic weapon testers are heartless, and the silence is deafening. Just when hope seems lost, a cryptic message leads you to a photo of a house and a location. “Your daughter is probably here—but you’re on your own.”
🩸 Key Features 🩸
🕯 True Survival Horror
You're weak, vulnerable, and alone. Scavenge, craft, and adapt to survive in an ever-shifting nightmare where every decision could be your last.
🏚 Safehouses Aren’t Always Safe
Find shelter, but beware—nothing in this twisted village is ever as safe as it seems. The deeper you venture, the more dangerous the safehouses become. Someone—or something—is always watching.

title: Kings & Savages
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Kings & Savages! 

==================================
UPDATE FEB 27 2025
New mode now available to play, Commander! Where you choose which unit to control at placement time. While you can still play the game in Auto Battle mode, Commander mode is now called a Solo Battler.
==================================
My name is Marco José Pereira, the solo developer of this game.
Please note, this is early in development and most of what you see will be improved upon.
Inspiration for this game comes from a couple of my favourites, Chess and Dota.
But I wanted a game that doesn't require the time commitment of Dota nor the brain power of Chess!
And here we are...
Key game mechanics:
A game lasts roughly a minute
No decisive RNG gameplay (% critical chance replaced with critical hit after 4 attacks)
RNG determines which Hero/Savage/Items choices are available
Both players start at the same time. No first player advantage
High degree of opponent information to allow for counterplay
Non-grid placement to enable complete freedom of movement
Win/Loss and Draws are possible
All AoE (Area of Effect) damage affects allies
All projectiles can damage allies
Final projectile from last dead unit can still cause a draw
I welcome everyone to join me on discord to discuss anything about the game.
Meet the Heroes
There are currently 12 heroes planned for release. Here are 3 of them.

title: Shattered Dreams: Redemption
description:
게임 정보
Once a young basketball prodigy destined for the NBA, your dreams were shattered by an injury.
Three years later, living with your gambling-addict father and bouncing between dead-end jobs is pushing you further into a suffocating situation with no way out in sight.
But your uncle gets you a job at a renowned music entertainment agency, giving you some room to breathe—until a encounter with a pressured superstar threatens to turn your world upside down.
You will be immersed in the city of Brookside, where you will discover the stories and characters that inhabit it—for better or for worse.
Shattered Dreams: Redemption is a visual novel with mature themes, focusing on its story and the various branching paths you can explore.
The further you progress in the story, the more your choices will shape your story, and only you will decide the kind of relationships you'll build with the girls you meet, the enemies you'll confront, and the allies you'll rely on in Shattered Dreams: Redemption.

title: Workhorse
description:
게임 정보
The player needs to assist Jack, who owes a huge loan, in repaying the loan within one year.
Gameplay and mechanism:
The game lasts for 12 months, with 8 rounds per month. Players randomly select 25 items from their backpacks in each round to earn coins, and adjacent items may have a combo effect. Players maximize the amount of coins in each round by building their own backpacks.
After one round, the player selects one of the three items they want to add to their backpack. In the eighth round of loan repayment, if unable to repay the game, it will fail. After repayment, choose one of the three item bonuses to add to the backpack, and these bonus effects will always exist in this game.
Subsequent development:
1. Achievement system and talent tree: Players unlock achievements to obtain talent points, and select talents through talent points to enhance the effects of items.
2. Advanced system: Unlock higher difficulty levels after completing the level.
3. Essence Points: Players use essence points to disable certain items and props, reducing the randomness of the game through essence points.
4. Fragmented plot collection system

title: Another Hour Another Planet
description:
게임 정보
Explore another world in the community-built spiritual successor to One Hour One Life.

Another Hour Another Planet is a multiplayer survival game of parenting and civilization building. Get born to another player as your mother. Live an entire life in one hour. Have babies of your own in the form of other players. Leave a legacy for the next generation as you help to rebuild another planet from scratch.

Each Another Planet server starts out with a practically infinite expanse of untouched alien wilderness. The first player to join the server is Eve. Other players who join the server are born as Eve's children and grandchildren, forming a multi-generational family tree. Each minute that passes in the game is a year of your life as you grow up, have children, age, and eventually die, leaving the world for your offspring to carry on. You can rejoin the game for another life, getting born as a baby to some other mother somewhere in the world. In each life, you play one small part in a huge story that started long before you were born and will continue on long after you die.

Each Another Planet server can support over one hundred simultaneous players who are building and shaping a persistent, trans-generational world. The shape a given world today can be quite different from how it will look tomorrow, next week, or next month, as players continue their collective project.

As we design and build another planet together, who knows where we'll end up?

description:

Everything started some months ago that a terrible accident happened which made you fall in coma. Ever since then you are in a hospital not able to wake up or even remember who you are. You will have to search deep inside your subconscious where all the truth about who you are is hidden. You will have to be brave and put all the pieces of the puzzle together by visiting your past and fighting the monsters that you were hidding from all the others in your whole life. If you don't manage to make it you will never wake up and never learn who you are and the power hidden deep inside of you.
Are You Ready to Face Your Own Mind?
You Will Have to Face Monsters,




Will you be able to retrieve your memory and become who you were? Or will you never wake up?

No one knows why such an important task falls on the girl, but she knows that you are the only one who can help her!
Go! Guide the way, use the only ninja, break through many difficulties!

title: Backpack Quest: Battles And Adventures
description:
게임 정보
Face off against other champions or monsters with your backpacks, automatically firing off their contents as your character fights. Foods are eaten, potions are drunk, swords are swung and shields are raised for protection. Gain more items for your backpack after each fight; these items synergize and combine together, making you all the more powerful! Having prepared, start the combat and lay back; watch the cute and sexy girls fight it out in a polished, dynamically changing, gorgeous 2D environment.

Melee Mode (PvP)
Compete against other players over multiple rounds, while adding to your backpack, both making it bigger and also filled to the brim with stashed armors, weapons, consumable items and other stuff! As you purchase items from the shop every turn, everything you put in your backpack will activate on its own dealing damage, blocking opponent's attacks or buffing, healing you. On top of that certain items make each other stronger when placed next to each other! While other items can be combined to be crafted into a new item.
Arena Mode (PvP)
In this battle royale mode, you clash with 9 other players over multiple rounds. Losing all your health will result in you being eliminated. Round after round expand your backpack with stuff while keeping an eye on other players' build. Can you be the one to come out victorious?
Scenario Mode (PvE)
A campaign mode where you progress through the world, and choose your path! Each tile features a different challenge. Tiles can hold threatening monsters, but also ways to recover health, purchase items, or scavenge for treasures. Improve your character with ever more stuff during your adventure and face the last boss at the very end!
Shop Draft Modifications
The shop drafts new items each round. Round after round, buy items from the shop to upgrade and expand your equipment. Every other round, you will be offered to pick from various shop modifications that allow you to shift the odds in favor of what you are building towards.
Environment Rules
Each game plays in a different zone and thus has differing effects applied on the fighters. Adjusting your strategy to the current environment will allow you to gain an edge over your opponents!
Ultimate Powers
Learning of your opponent's spec, you may choose to use your ultimate power to tilt the odds in your favor. You can only use your ultimate power a limited amount of times so make sure to use it strategically!

title: To Get There
description:

Game nostalgia about the wonderful days of childhood and dreams of space. And, of course, about beloved toys. Each of us dreamed of becoming an astronaut and going on a space adventure during our childhood... Perhaps this game will awaken your dreams.
Manage a group of robots, plan your moves, collect batteries, and avoid traps. This is a game about attentiveness and cleverness in a nostalgic setting of a child's dream of space.
Key features of the game:
5 biomes
100 levels
Unique mechanics for simultaneous control of a group of robots
Simple rules, but genuinely challenging puzzles
All images are hand-drawn

title: Chiggy Pigg & The Great Drought
description:
게임 정보
Chiggy Pigg is a sci-fi Action-Adventure RPG where you play in a fantasy desert setting as a Pink Fairy Armadillo. You'll explore a fictional desert world saving its inhabitants from the worlds scorching conditions.
Featuring a unique blend of gameplay styles, Chiggy Pigg includes: fast paced movement, arcade-style shooting, minimalistic hack-and-slash combat, platforming, and a slim-but-rich story, all bundled with the spirit of a classic collectathon. All of these mechanics are unified into a cohesive experience that includes addicting mini-games and plenty of optional environmental puzzles to solve. There's something for everyone!

Prepare for an understated, light-hearted adventure!
Chiggy Pigg is intended to be played with a gamepad.

title: Aftershock
description:
게임 정보
Nikolai, broken by his past as a soldier, relives the same pain day after day. Will you be able to walk this path with him and face his struggles, or will it all end… in tragedy?
Memories of the past collide with the present, creating distorted visions, where the line between home and the battlefield grows ever thinner. You will have to make choices that lead to different endings. But what if the truth isn’t what you remember?
The game features elements of non-linearity and interactivity—nothing stops you from staring at the night street, taking a bitter drag of your cigarette...
What Awaits You:
A deep and emotional story
A strong psychological undertone
Retro-style visuals
Immersive sound design
And, of course, the one ray of sunshine in this wretched cage—Olechka!

랭크를 올리고 Fever Bowl에 출전하여 궁극의 영광을 위해 경쟁하세요! 경기장에 나가서 완전한 3D와 현실적인 매치 엔진을 통해 당신의 로스터가 어떻게 작동하는지 확인하세요!

매주 갱신되는 포괄적이고 몰입감 있는 드래프트 시스템에 참여하세요. 최고의 선수를 확보하기 위해 전략을 세우고, 100개 이상의 대학을 스카우트하며 로스터를 강화할 숨겨진 보석을 발견하세요.
액션을 감상하세요!

고급 3D 매치 시뮬레이션 엔진으로 게임의 스릴을 경험하세요. 각 선수의 기술과 팀워크가 필드에서 생생하게 구현된 모습을 감상하세요.

title: Stellar Drift
description:
게임 정보
STELLAR DRIFT is a multiplayer, physics based, spaceship building game with roguelike elements. It takes place on "The Drift". A procedurally generated field in space riddled with precious metals, mining companies, outlaws, and various factions working to assert their dominance. 
DESIGN AND EQUIP YOUR SHIPS to thrive on The Drift. Every active component of your ship can be conveniently mapped to specific keys giving you complete control as the pilot. Find hundreds of parts though missions or loot them off of your un-alived enemies. Recruit crew members and synergize your ships parts to overwhelm other factions trying to assert their dominance on the drift.

ENEMIES AND FACTIONS on the drift are ever evolving. If left unchecked enemies can form groups and upgrade to elite or even boss status. Factions gather recourses and claim regions advantageous for their growth. Strategize when and where to focus your efforts, when to fight or run, and who to befriend or sabotage.

title: Altiros

Build the homebase of your dreams in the vast, boundless skies of Altiros!

Altiros is a creative online sandbox adventure. Build impressive architectural structures. Explore a vast, fantastic and beautiful world of skybound islands. Reshape or destroy anything you encounter. Play solo, or call over your friends. Adventures await!
THE SMALLER THE BLOCKS, THE BIGGER THE IMPACT
Your arsenal of small-sized blocks allows you to create highly detailed architectural compositions. Create a beautiful base of your dreams without it feeling too blocky or oversized!
CALL YOUR FRIENDS TO THE PARTY
Invite friends into your unique shard to show off or join everyone in a hub world. Take down powerful enemies, compete and build entire settlements. Conquer the world of Altiros together!
ENVIRONMENTAL DESTRUCTION AT THE TIPS OF YOUR FINGERS
Use special Neophyte Glove to destroy the terrain with directional blasts, or crush those blocks with your trusty weapons! Reshape Altiros to your whims as you destroy any object or a surface you want to.
THIRD PERSON GOODNESS
Live, build, destroy and fight against cute yet ferocious critters in this beautiful world with your highly customizable third person avatar!
BEAUTIFUL AND COLORFUL VISTAS
Altiros combines cube-based landscapes with stylistic graphical choices to create breathtaking environments for you to explore and live in!

And please support us by adding the game to your Wishlist on Steam!

title: The Apollo Project

You are Special Agent Ryan Jericho, sent to the mysterious Island facility to recover The Apollo Project. A device intended to rescue humanity from the brink of extinction in a world ravaged by extreme climates, ever worsening storms and draughts. And it was only a few weeks ago that you were serving as security at it's unveiling, where catastrophe struck and the device exploded.

With a peculiar connection to Apollo, mysterious powers begin to awaken within you as you return to The Island. Only you are sent to unravel the truth of the events leading up to the explosion. With the world on the brink of death, only one soldier can make the difference between salvation and total destruction.

Remain hidden in sight, using various objects around you to distract guards. Or leap into the fray and fight like hell with your newfound powers. Explore The Island and gear up for your journey. Hack into various computers, cameras and drones to assist you in battle and infiltration Choose your path and face the weight of your actions. There's danger lurking behind every corner, are you prepared for it?

To help prepare you in your quest as Ryan Jericho, take part in several missions testing your combat, platforming and stealth abilities among others. Dispatch a series of enemies with just one round, race to the finish with or without the aid of Apollo. Or if you're feeling brave, make it to your goal without the ability to fight back.
Key Features

Traverse the environment on foot, or through short range teleportation and grapple hooks
Explore an open environment unhampered through seamless transitions
Harness the power of the alien artifact only known as Apollo, and save the world before it's too late

Uncover the truth. Save your system from the infection. Show your creator the light. Protect your world while being pitted against the spread of malicious foes. Cut down your enemy. Deconstruct the virus. Fight for your existence.

Control time. Control combat. Slow time to gain an edge of complex sword strikes. Splitting bullets, slicing fragments, controlling the fight.

title: Darkness Blooms
description:
게임 정보
Darkness Blooms is a classic fantasy team RPG with a big world and an epic story to discover. This top down pixel art game has an truly grand and complex story for you to discover as you make friends, defeat enemies, and try to save the world. You will be confronted with ethical, moral, political choices and these choices will effect the world around you. You will gain experience, unlock new abilities, unlock new playable characters and story lines and each play through will be unique based on the choices you make and the friends you keep in your party.

---

In this long peace the world no longer needs heroes but in every great story you have ever heard there was one warrior strong enough to answer the call. How can anyone prove they are strong enough to be a hero in a world so boring. You only wish there were bad guys in the world so you could prove your self but I promise you will live to regret that wish..

The long peace has been broken, not by man but by nature its self. Something has awoken a anger within the world and the plant and animal life have been possessed by rage. The world had gotten used to peace and are not prepared to to defend them selves from this attack, an attack from everywhere. Some try to defend their homes. Some travel north to reach to gates of the kingdom. Many die. What will you do? Are you ready to be a hero?

In this world your greatest dream and your worse nightmare come true at once as you are forced to become the hero you always dreamt of. However life as a hero is much darker and harder than you ever expected. It comes with great pain and great loss. And you will learn no hero can do it alone.

Darkness Blooms mixes action adventure in the style of Link To The Past with turn based team combat in the style of Final Fantasy. As you gain strength you will be able to defeat small foes with a single swing avoiding any need to fall into combat. Bosses however will take the whole team in formation and with a strategy in mind. Each unlockable character comes with their own skills and abilities both inside and outside of combat. A strong defender, a fast thief, an empathetic healer, a curious explorer, and more. The story will take you from your small boring town to explore the whole world and see and experience things you could not have believed possible. And maybe you will make some friends along the way.

title: Skykipelago

Skykipelago는 하늘에 행복한 작은 도시를 짓는 편안한 건설 전략 게임입니다. 다양한 색감의 섬들을 탐험하고, 건물의 행복도를 관리하며, 성장을 돕기 위해 건물을 발전시키세요. 그리고 땅이 더 이상 흥미롭지 않다면 – 절벽 끝으로 확장하세요.

title: Tower Builder
description:
게임 정보
Tower Builder is a building and design game. The main goal is to build the biggest tower while not going bankrupt. This is an engineering and cost management game. The beams, columns and floors have structural properties. The plan for this game is for either single player or multiplayer in three modes.

• Challenge mode: you play the role of a Developer, Engineer and Builder with limitation in place. You have to strategize to construct the tower tall and strong enough that the it does not collapse without going bankrupt.
• Free Build mode: you have no size limit and unlimited funds, but the tower has structural properties.
• Sandbox mode: you can build and decorate as you like.

title: Madness in the dark
description:
게임 정보
실제 테스트는 모든 단계가 함정으로 판명 할 수있는 어두운 정신 병원에서 당신을 기다립니다. 어둠 속에서 숨어 광기에 직면하고 살아 남기 위해 두려움을 극복. 오직 정신을 지키는 자만이 어둠을 통과하고 빛을 찾을 수 있을 것입니다.



게임에는 거의 빛이 없습니다. 적을 보려면,당신은 어둠 속으로 촬영해야합니다. 샷은 당신에게 목표로하고 위협을 마무리 할 수있는 기회를 제공,하지만 잠시 동안,방을 거룩하게하고 시간을 느리게 할 것이다. 그리고,각 탄에는 합당한 것이 있어야 한다 것 을 생각하십시요. 결국 카트리지가 거의 없으며 모든 환자가 공격적인 것은 아니며 소음은 정말 위험한 환자를 끌어들일 수 있습니다.



당신은 건물 밖으로 얻을 수 있지만,또한 생존자 도움이되지 않습니다. 퍼즐을 해결하고이 우울한 병원의 모든 비밀을 찾을 수 있습니다. 신경 쇠약의 직전에 당신을 떠날 것이다 몰입 소리와 사실적인 그래픽과 대기 스릴러. 이 미친 세상에서 생존과 빛에 당신의 방법을 찾을 수 있습니다.

title: 龙之塔
description:
게임 정보
게임 플레이
이 게임은 뱀파이어 생존자 게임으로, 1명의 영웅과 4마리의 몬스터를 조합하여 다른 팀으로 게임을 진행할 수 있습니다.
일정한 숨겨진 조건을 달성하면 영웅이 각성하여 더 강력한 힘을 얻을 수 있습니다.
게임에 들어간 후 몬스터를 빠르게 처치하여 경험치를 얻고 레벨업해야 합니다.
레벨업 후 4가지 선택 중 하나의 스킬을 선택하고 영웅이나 몬스터에 할당할 수 있습니다.
스킬의 효과는 영웅이나 몬스터의 속성에 따라 다릅니다.
살아남은 시간이 길수록 올라갈 수 있는 층이 높아지고 몬스터도 강해집니다.

게임 목표
용의 탑을 가능한 한 높은 층까지 오르며, 높은 층수로 갈수록 위험이 커지고 얻는 보상이 풍부해지며 더 오래 살아남는 것이 목표입니다.

게임 특징
1명의 영웅과 4마리의 용을 선택하여 다양한 특성을 가진 팀을 구성하고 게임 내에서 무작위로 나오는 스킬과 조합할 수 있습니다.
2영웅은 각성할 수 있습니다.
3게임 내 스킬은 자동으로 발동되어 보다 편안한 플레이를 제공합니다.
4올라갈수록 난이도가 올라가고 내려갈수록 난이도가 낮아져서 페이스를 자유롭게 조절할 수 있습니다.
5아이템과 스킬이 풍부합니다.
6레벨업 시 게임이 중단되지 않으며, E 키를 눌러 모든 스킬 포인트를 한 번에 사용할 수 있습니다.

title: Sylvana's Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
A turn-based strategy game with roguelike and deck-building elements. Explore a dark and magical world full of forgotten lands, monsters, and secrets. Build your own deck of cards to fight your way through the dungeons. Upgrade your cards, unlock new items, and discover ancient artifacts.

title: Ether@Net
description:
게임 정보
Enter the mysterious world of Ether@Net, a first-person horror puzzle adventure set against the backdrop of urban Hong Kong. You play as Alex, a skilled mystery solver from a secret organization, tasked with investigating a series of unusual occurrences in a haunted apartment building. As you uncover the hidden secrets, you’ll find yourself caught between the digital world and the supernatural realm, solving mysteries that connect the living with the dead.
Game Features:
Supernatural Mystery: Explore eerie apartments and interact with ghostly presences to uncover the truth behind a digital and spiritual enigma. Every puzzle you solve brings you closer to revealing the dark secrets of the city’s most forgotten spirits and unresolved cases.
Challenging Puzzles: Use your investigative skills to uncover hidden clues and solve complex puzzles, blending modern technology with supernatural elements. Each step forward leads you deeper into the haunted apartment’s twisted past.
Immersive Environments: Discover intricately designed locations, from dilapidated tenements to high-tech modern apartments, each filled with rich history and atmosphere that enhance the chilling narrative.

title: 9Cat Saga
description:
게임 정보
9Cat is a free-to-play isometric co-op shooter, but with cute cats and a vast variant of gears and cats that completely alter your playstyles..
You will wander in the ever-changing landscapes to scavenge resources and shoot your way out of trouble.
Recruit more 9Cats, collect more gears, gather your friends to form a squad of up to 4 kittens and defeat bosses… but we warned, it will require much more than shooting.
How will you raise your 9Cat? A mighty warrior, a geeky technician or a spell weiding wizard? Let’s find out in 9Cat Saga.

title: CIVITA
description:
게임 정보

CIVITA is a First-Person Shooter game that offers multiplayer PVP action.
Players can use a variety of weapons and equipment to cooperate with their teammates or face off against enemies alone.
One of the standout features of this game is the rope action, which allows players to move quickly between buildings or strategically ambush enemies from high vantage points, providing a unique combat experience.
Additionally, with its long TTK, each battle is prolonged and more strategic, giving players more opportunities to turn the tide of combat.

title: Mark's power
description:
게임 정보
Mark's Power is an RPG with dialogues, crafting, gathering and turn-based battles. Explore the world where fate has thrown you, and tilt the cup of fate in your favor. Win over the locals, fight the enemies, and do not forget about the main goal — to repair your ship and go home! Or maybe it's worth using your power and...

Technology transfer
One of the key features of this game is the ability to transfer technology, accelerating the natural development of local residents. For example, by teaching the art of making steel things, we will be able to hire stronger warriors armed with sharp swords. On the other hand, the sooner the locals create their first atomic bomb, the worse it will be for us, right?
History
Find out the history of the world where fate has thrown you. Why are the island and lowland states fighting among themselves? What do the remains of giant mechanisms mean?
Trading
There is no money in this wild world, and only the objects themselves have value. Find out the trader's weakness in order to make a profitable exchange. Tip the scales in your favor!
Crafting
You can use your portable manufacturer to create various things. Usually, the created thing is more valuable than the ingredients, so you can make good money on it.
You can collect wild pumpkins and other resources, and then use them for trading or crafting.
You can explore the corners of locations, solve riddles and receive a significant reward for your curiosity.
To win the battles, you can hire several warriors from the locals. Their strength depends on the thickness of your wallet

The game is easy to control and does not require a long understanding of the mechanics.

title: End Of World - Story
description:
게임 정보
STAY TUNED FOR BETA ACCESS
You are a retired space marine enjoying the tranquility of your space farm. But then, something happens... and you will need to go back to missions.

Embark on a cosmic saga where evolution and technology intertwine in unimaginable ways!

"In EOW the gameplay of each scenario is like an Indiana Jones mini-movie: you are dropped into an exotic place, you talk to a couple dozen NPCs, figure out the enigma, collect some necessary items, battle monsters and finally find the relic and triumph."

EXPLORE FOUR UNIQUE CIVILIZATIONS
Journey through a universe with Space Apes mastering the cosmos, Cyborg Wild Beasts embodying the fusion of nature and technology, Sentient Penguins ruling icy domains, and Humans pushing the frontiers of science and exploration.

Go on daring missions across the galaxy's most breathtaking locations. As ancient relics resurface, you'll need to outsmart rivals and navigate the unknown to recover these powerful artifacts, each holding the key to untold powers and secrets.


Balance resource management, facility building, and family life while guiding your space colony through the galaxy's challenges.

Dive into space farming and civilization building, drawing inspiration from renowned farming and life simulation games, but set in the vastness of space.


In a galaxy reshaped by a quantum event, four civilizations emerge from the ashes of Earth's tumultuous history. The Space Apes, once Earth's explorers, now soar through the stars. The Cyborg Wild Beasts, an ode to nature's resilience, roam the lands. The Sentient Penguins, evolved from the icy wastelands, unveil technologies that defy the harshest environments. And the Humans, reborn from chaos, constantly innovate, ever driven to explore the unknown.

The quantum event not only redefined technology and life itself but also set the stage for a new era. As Year 499 post-quantum event dawns, these civilizations face unknown challenges and unforeseen connections. Each step into the future brings them closer to each other, intertwining their destinies in a story rich with exploration, conflict, and discovery.

Will you guide our protagonist through trials and triumphs? What secrets will you uncover in this galaxy of endless possibilities? Can you shape the destiny of a universe on the brink of a new epoch? The journey awaits...

title: The Mystery of the Cardboard Island
description:
게임 정보
The Mystery of the Cardboard Island is a cozy game about two genres colliding. By day, you deliver boxes to your neighbors and friends on the island. All is good, calm, but there is something strange going on at the center of it all. By night, your nightmares show the island being burned down by horrible demons: and only you can stop this!
The Day: A peaceful Island

Explore a contained open world while delivering boxes, doing minigames, chatting with the locals and simply walking around! During the day you'll be able to do things at your own pace. Customize your house and your own look, repeat minigames to beat the locals or even the dev ranking!



Deliveries on the island are always a bit special. Chase a legged box around, calculate the best path to deliver pizza boxes before they get cold and more!
The Night: Going up in flames

You keep having these horrible nightmares. In them, monsters are burning your island. You'll need to go around and rescue your friends, fight and destroy little monsters to eventually find the higher demon and confront them in a cinematic puzzle fight!


Something is going on here. Something no one seems to notice, except you. Why are you having these nightmares? Why do they all show the same night, mere days into the future? During both day and night you'll need to explore, find hidden secrets and chat with the locals to try and discover what is really happening.


All the art in the game is made from (digital) cardboard! We wanted to push this artstyle as far as possible. Houses open up when you enter them, the characters can enter inside one of their own boxes to rest, some animals are made of origami... Come and enjoy this cozy cardboard world.

Want to change how you look? You'll be unlocking all kinds of customization options to change your appearance. You just need to visit the craft aesthetician. But that's not all! As a resident of the Cardboard Island you have a house on it, and you'll be able to furnish it as you'd like!
autokwd: The Mystery of the Cardboard Island

title: HaeTae: Guardians
description:
게임 정보
난이도
도전적인 전투가 기다리는 클래식한 액션 어드밴처 게임입니다.
단순한 이동과 구르기 공격만으로도 긴장감 있는 전투를 구현했습니다.
거기에 해태라는 동아시아 신수를 통해 스킬과 궁극기를 사용하여, 전투에 재미를 더했습니다.
총 세 가지 난이도(쉬움, 보통, 어려움)가 있으며, 가장 어려운 난이도는, AI가 변경됩니다.
강력한 궁극기 한 방
육성 방식에 따라 다양한 궁극기를 사용합니다.
무적이 될 수도 있고, 번개를 내려 칠 수도, 자신에게 버프를 걸어 빠르게 이동과 공격을 할 수도 있습니다.
그로기
보스는 그로기 게이지가 있습니다.
해태가 사용하는 모든 방식의 공격으로 깎을 수 있습니다.
그로기를 통해 강력한 한 방을 노려보세요.

title: Fusion Fighters
description:
게임 정보
Fusion Fighters is a fighting game unlike any other! In Fusion Fighters, instead of picking from a roster of characters and learning how to play some, you create your own characters by creating various equipment like weapons and apparel. You can create a build to suit any playstyle!



Features:
Highly customizable character creation system
Singleplayer and multiplayer PvP and PvE gamemodes
Rollback NetCode online support
Up to 4 players can play at once
Custom stage builder
Ability to share custom creations with players online
Free updates for 2 years
And much, much more!




In Fusion Fighters, the start of every good build is making good equipment! You can create custom weapons, subs, and apparel by using various templates and modifiers to make unique equipment! There's nearly 1,000 unique combinations for just the weapons alone!



You can view your equipment collections at any time. If you decide you don't need one anymore, you can scrap it to get back the materials used to create it. You won't get the money back, but you can get everything else back.




Once you've made your equipment, put it together in a build! Builds are user-created sets that are saved locally and can be used online. Builds contain a primary weapon, a secondary weapon, a sub, an Ultimate, a badge, your outfit, and cosmetic options.



The build creation menu allows you to create a build while testing it out. The menu is designed to make iterating on your builds as simple as possible, and also doubles as the game's training room.




Before you battle, feel free to choose from an existing ruleset or create your own! There are enough settings to completely change the experience. Whether you want to change the win condition, starting items, or stock count, it's got you covered.



There's also a gamemode called World Cup, which is a PvE mode where you unlock new templates and enhancers for your equipment! Each match consists of a ruleset, a stage, and some opponents. There are many presets for each of these, and each one is also slightly variated when you play, so no two runs are the same!

title: Plagueborn
description:
게임 정보
Explore a long forgotten world
It has been 100 years since a malevolent plague spewed from the earth and extinguished almost all life. Travel to decrepit villages and find out how to prevent the next coming of the plague!

title: Rise of the Robots X

Join the official game's Discord and Social Networks.
Discover Rise of the Robots X, meet other Strategists and develop the community.
Contribute and follow the development of the game and be informed when new improvements are made.
Share your ideas, give your opinion, and vote for artistic and gameplay elements.
Participate in contests and design with the team content that we will add to the game.

title: Cold Chains
description:
게임 정보


Cold Chains는 미스터리가 가득한 황량한 환경을 배경으로 한 1인칭 서바이벌 호러 게임입니다.

수년간의 혼수 상태에서 깨어난 후, 버려진 병원에서 홀로 남겨지고, 폭력적인 생물과 절망적인 고통으로 가득한 이 악몽에서 답을 찾고 탈출구를 찾아야 합니다.

장소를 탐험하고, 길을 따라 발견한 것을 활용하세요. 이곳에 온 첫 번째 사람이 아니며 마지막도 아닐 것입니다. 과거에 쓰러진 사람들이 남긴 짐을 사용하지만, 이 유령이 나오는 곳에서 다음으로 죽지 않도록 조심하세요.
자유 탐험
많은 내부와 위협이 있는 열린 지도를 탐험하세요.
약탈과 생존
길을 따라 발견한 것으로 장비를 갖추세요. 여정은 쉽지 않을 것이고, 살아남고 탈출구를 찾기 위해 찾을 수 있는 모든 것이 필요할 것입니다.
싸움
전역에 널려 있는 방대한 무기고로 당신의 길을 가로막는 모든 위협을 파괴하세요.
다양한 게임 모드
스토리 모드에서 여정을 마무리하고 끝없는 절차적 던전 크롤링 모드를 즐기세요.

콜드 체인은 탐험, 전투, 퍼즐을 포함하는 고전적인 서바이벌 호러 경험입니다.
당신의 삶을 위해 싸우거나, 탈출하거나, 갇힌 방랑자가 되세요!
company: Gustavo Lucas, Retro Head Game Studio

title: The pet squad
description:
게임 정보
What is T.P.S.?
The Pet Squad is a 2D strategy and puzzle game with pixel art aesthetics, mainly inspired by Lemmings, that puts you in the role of a support operator.
The game is set in the not-too-distant future, where humans have managed to artificially evolve animals. The pet squad SLU is an organization responsible for maintaining order between humans and the evolved animals, known as Animanos.
As an operator, you will have to support your squad at all times, guide them along the correct path, and protect them from enemies or themselves. To achieve this, you will have access to the most advanced technology, allowing you to teleport objects and even slow down time.
Think about how to help your squad and use the objects to achieve the goal.
Keep in mind that there are multiple interactions between objects.
Gather your to solve cases and complete missions. Keep in mind that each one has .

title: Rod of Asclepius
description:
게임 정보


Explore ancient Pannonia, master the art of historical medicine, and uncover the secrets of Late Antiquity in this narrative-driven RPG.

Rod of Asclepius is a historical RPG set in the 4th-century Roman province of Pannonia Secunda. You play as a Roman medicus, responsible for diagnosing, treating, and saving lives using authentic medical techniques from the era. As war and disease spread across the empire, your choices will shape the fate of those around you.

Blending exploration, turn-based medical procedures, and historical accuracy, Rod of Asclepius immerses players in the challenges faced by ancient healers. Investigate mysterious ailments, gather rare herbs, and balance the ethical dilemmas of early medicine.
Features
✅ Authentic Historical Setting – Explore archeologically researched Roman-era locations, customs, and medical techniques.
✅ Turn-Based Medical Challenges – Perform surgeries, mix remedies, and apply treatments in a strategic, skill-based system.
✅ Resource Management – Collect medicinal plants, tools, and rare ingredients to craft life-saving treatments.
✅ Isometric Pixel Art – A unique 2.5D pixel-art aesthetic that brings Late Antiquity to life.
✅ Investigation & Diagnosis – Unravel medical mysteries by questioning patients, studying symptoms, and making tough decisions.
✅ Morality & Reputation System – Your medical ethics influence how NPCs react to you and shape your standing in Roman society.

Can you survive as a healer in a collapsing empire?
Wishlist now and begin your journey into the world of Roman healing.

title: Exist.EXE
description:
게임 정보
Exist.EXE is a puzzle adventure where players assume the role of Marcus, a game developer who never moved on from his mother’s death. One day, he gets sucked into the digital world where he can use his programming skills to hack things and shape them to what he needs them to be.
Along the way, he realizes this is also a self-discovery journey for him as an AI entity resembling his dead mother persuades him to stay in the digital world and avoid sadness in real life while his best friend reminds him to stay true to reality instead of delving into the concept of a fake perfect world. Players will get to experience gameplay with distinctive and captivating visuals in pixel art blended with modern design elements.


Dive into an Immersive Digital World
Experience gameplay like never before with captivating modernized pixel art visuals and engaging mechanics that draw you into a abstract digital realm

title: Inside Darkness
description:
게임 정보
Inside Darkness is a captivating 2D puzzle-platformer set in a fantasy world, offering a unique gameplay experience that revolves around the contrast of light and shadow. You play as a young girl who can transform into a monster when engulfed in darkness. In this world of alchemical secrets and lurking dangers, you’ll face challenging puzzles and uncover the dark mysteries of an ancient kingdom.
Key Features:
Immersive Fantasy World: Explore ancient catacombs and dungeons filled with hidden threats and mysterious mechanisms. Alchemical labs, secret passages, and dangerous creatures of the dark await around every corner.
Unique Transformation Mechanics: In darkness, the girl transforms into a powerful and dangerous monster, strong and agile. However, in the light, she reverts to her human form, quick but vulnerable. Use both forms strategically to overcome enemies and solve a variety of challenges.
Puzzles and Traps: The game features numerous logical challenges and dangerous traps. Combine the monster's strength and the girl’s agility to navigate secret passages and discover hidden levels.
Deep Story with Multiple Endings: Experience an intense narrative filled with betrayal, magic, and hidden truths. Uncover the secrets of the protagonist’s origin and fight against the queen’s tyranny. Your choices and actions will shape the outcome, unlocking different endings and pathways.
Hidden Levels and References: Find secret locations and bonus levels, unlock unique content, and explore the world of Inside Darkness to uncover all its mysteries and references to classic works.
Visual Style and Atmosphere: Beautifully crafted 2D environments and animations immerse you in a fantastical and mysterious world, combining fairytale-like aesthetics with the allure of ancient legends.
Inside Darkness combines an engaging story, innovative light and dark mechanics, and numerous puzzles and hidden secrets. Fans of puzzle-platformers, adventure games, and fantasy will find plenty to love in this unique experience!

title: FURRY TOWER DEFENSE
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT

FURRY TOWER DEFENSE is an esoteric road-trip tower-defense game about hauling a brigade of weaponized furries to the Hull, the place you can reverse an apocalypse. In the accident intended to bring about human immortality, you and your crew cannot be harmed unless the Crystal you carry is destabilized. When the Crystal is down, they target you and your company, seeking to eradicate the last of those who have not turned already. Repairs of the containment device are possible, but take precious manpower and time. You must fight tooth-and-nail in an adventurous campaign, keeping yourselves alive and sane, in order to deliver this Crystal to the Hull. And the Hordes are beginning to catch up.

FEATURES

Furries (unfortunately)
Throwing Furries (thankfully)

Tower Defense
PvE Action
A host of mini-games and side content

title: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day
description:
게임 정보

the full paid version is a work in progress!
Plot 
Notoria is a vast, desolate wasteland where time stands still. Shortly after you have fallen there, you will be escorted to Cradletown - an old town nestled in the mountains that serves as a refuge for those who, just like you, have suddenly fallen from other worlds.  
Later, you will return to the desert and join the notorious Riders of the Night to explore Notoria in search of answers to what is happening here. You'll visit many different locations and investigate unexplained anomalies that have recently appeared on the planet.

Find A Purpose

Restore Bargan's Treasure

title: Re: Spin. Die. Repeat.

Re: Spin. Die. Repeat. is a slot machine-inspired roguelike deckbuilder where you create powerful synergies to craft unique builds. Unlock and add hundreds of unique symbols, items, characters, and create your own isekai world with your spins. Immerse into a classic fantasy adventure or be reborn into a random isekai world—no matter what, it will be a game of chance and skill.

title: Mei tales
description:
게임 정보
“Mei tales” (《梅花千日谈》) is a narrative card game with a Chinese fantasy setting. In the game, you can choose to play as one of several protagonists, search for companions, make your own decisions, and begin your own legendary adventure.
Since the great war between humans and demons, both races have coexisted peacefully for thousands of years. Humans built cities, lived tranquil lives, and mingled freely with demons. Yet one day, the warlike faction of demons made a comeback and infiltrated Yongzhou City, sending shockwaves far and wide. As plum blossoms fall, the merciless hand of fate stirs the clouds and rain—neither humans nor demons can escape what is to come.
In “Mei tales” the pro-war faction plots a cataclysmic conflict that could destroy the world. With time running out, you must find a way to resolve the looming crisis. Your choices in various scenarios will determine the story’s ultimate outcome, leading to different endings.
Rich Content
You can choose from multiple protagonists, each with their own journey. Whether you seek precious treasures, forge divine weapons, concoct potent medicines, or become engrossed in cooking delicious dishes to share with people you meet along the way, these experiences will accompany you through a thousand days and nights, forming a memorable journey.
Every protagonist offers a unique adventure, each with a distinct background—such as a fallen noble, a determined little demon, a princess unwilling to be bound by fate, or a lonely wanderer. You can shape their destinies or invite them to travel alongside you. In the end, whether you remain human or become a demon depends on your actions and choices.

When you arrive in a new place, you may choose to observe and listen, or opt for darker methods—such as theft or ambush—to propel your story forward.

Judging an enemy’s traits accurately and equipping items that counter them can lead to a variety of combat experiences.

description:

Secret agent Franklin Benjamin's former-mentor-turned-rogue-agent Dustin MacGuffin has resurfaced to take from you that which you hold most dear. In this single-player interactive spy novel, play as secret agent Franklin Benjamin and use your particular set of skills to save Virginia from the clutches of the madman Dustin MacGuffin. Which means - you’d better get the MacGuffin!
Your Mission
It was supposed to be the rarest of all things - a day with no mission. That is, until you woke up to find Virginia gone and a note left behind telling you she had been taken. That note was left behind by your old partner, Dustin MacGuffin, who's since gone rogue - now he's up to something and using her as leverage to keep you from getting involved. Talk about a grave miscalculation
Now, you're taking matters into your own hands to get her back. This is not a sanctioned mission, so you're on your own this time using resources outside the usual channels. But you will get the MacGuffin ... whatever it takes
There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin can be played with just a mouse. Gameplay consists of selecting the action or dialog you wish to take given the situation you’re facing. Although the life of a secret agent is complicated, playing There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin is simple
Sequel or Standalone
There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin is the fourth entry in the There's Always a Madman series, but it tells a standalone story. Like a classic James Bond novel or film where you can pick any one up independent of the rest, you can pick this story up without having experienced any prior stories in the There's Always a Madman franchise. However, I would recommend starting with the first game There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight if you care to experience the series in its intended order
Make Them Talk
Will you go on a full rampage or are you just a professional applying your particular set of skills? Choose the tools for how you want to get the job done, interrogate the henchmen standing in your path, and work your way up the chain to get to the man behind it all

title: Notmads
description:
게임 정보
Notmads에서 당신은 거대한 걷는 짐승을 길들이고 조종하는 기술을 익힌 강력한 마법사가 됩니다. 믿음직한 동반자의 등에 올라타고, 마법과 경이로움으로 가득 찬 환상적인 오픈 월드를 탐험하세요.

여행 중에 자원을 수집하고, 짐승의 등에 나만의 집을 짓고 꾸며서 모험에 데려갈 수 있는 이동 요새를 만들 수 있습니다. 위험한 생명체들이 가득한 세계에서 마법의 힘을 사용하여 스스로를 방어하고 생존해야 합니다.

친구들을 초대하여 이 여정을 함께하며, 이 마법 같은 세계를 함께 발견하는 경험을 나누세요. 플레이어가 자신의 속도로 탐험할 수 있도록 설계된 오픈 월드에서 도전적인 퀘스트에 도전하고, 강력한 적들과 싸우거나, 단순히 아름다운 풍경을 감상하며 휴식을 취할 수 있습니다.
짐승을 조종하라!
정확한 조작으로 거대한 짐승의 속도와 방향을 자유롭게 조정하세요. 짐승은 고유한 레벨, 통계, 장비, 능력을 가지고 있으며, 세계를 탐험하면서 동반자를 맞춤 설정하고 성장시킬 수 있습니다.

어디든 집이 된다!
당신의 짐승은 등 위에 플랫폼을 가지고 있으며, 그곳에 집을 지을 수 있습니다.

짐승의 등에 다양한 건축 자재와 구성 요소를 사용하여 꿈의 집을 건축하세요. 방어탑과 같은 방어 구조물을 건설하여 안전을 보장하세요.

적들이 당신의 거대한 짐승을 공격하려 할 것이니, 위험을 피하기 위해 계속 움직이세요. 하지만, 일부 지역은 더 위험하고 공격이 더 빈번하게 발생할 수 있습니다. 자동 터렛을 설치하여 짐승의 플랫폼에서 생성된 에너지를 사용해 적을 처치하고 집을 보호하세요.

스킬은 강력한 능력으로, 자유롭게 장착하거나 교체할 수 있습니다. 각 스킬은 무작위로 생성된 고유한 시작 스탯을 가지고 있으며, 사용하면 할수록 강해집니다. 스킬을 장착할 수 있는 슬롯은 한정되어 있어, 스킬 세트를 구성할 때 전략적으로 선택해야 합니다. 전투 중에 스킬을 교체하는 것은 어려울 수 있으니, 공격, 방어, 패시브 스킬 중에서 신중하게 선택하세요. 일부 스킬은 짐승 전용으로, 더 많은 커스터마이징 옵션을 제공합니다.

친구와 협력하여 위험한 던전에 도전하고, 적을 물리치며, 거대한 동반자를 보호하세요. 주요 스토리를 포함하여 게임의 모든 요소를 함께 경험하여, 진정한 협력형 모험을 즐길 수 있습니다.
거대한 짐승을 지휘하며 던전 깊숙이 탐험하세요. 하지만, 이동 중인 집을 방어할 수 있는 방어 구조물, 예를 들어 터렛 같은 것을 잊지 말고 구축하세요. 이를 전투에서 유리하게 사용하면 적의 공격을 받아도 던전을 포기할 필요가 없습니다.

적을 물리치고 보물을 찾아보세요. 전리품은 일반적인 것부터 희귀한 것까지 다양하며, 검, 지팡이, 방어구 등 각 전리품은 고유한 통계와 희귀도를 가지고 있어 모험에 끊임없는 흥미를 더합니다.

정식 출시에서는 메인 캠페인이 제공될 예정이지만, 얼리 액세스에서는 게임을 시작할 수 있는 일련의 도입 임무가 제공됩니다. 이러한 기본 임무를 통해 세계를 탐험하고 게임의 메커니즘을 익힐 수 있습니다.

title: Quasis: The Last Eclipse
description:
게임 정보
Key Features
100+ hours of gameplay.
A living, breathing world that reacts to player's actions.
20+ recruitable allies (party members), each with their own backstory, character and playstyle.
3 overlapping worlds - Real World, Matrix and Augmented Reality(AR). To solve a problem in one of them you'll often have to visit another.
Hundreds of engaging quests.
Complex in-game economy system.
6 distinct endings.
10 huge Technopolises, dozens of Grey Zones, Gaia's Groves and countless locations for exploration.
150+ enemy types (Mutants, cyborgs, robots, etc..)
200+ hand-crafted matrix servers to hack into.

The game also features a vast variety of equipment. Mix and match to heart's content:
4 types of weapons (pistols, machine guns, shotguns, and heavy weaponry)
4 generations of weapons (gunpowder, magnetic-kinetic, laser, and plasma)
13+ ammunition types for each generation.
Hundreds of weapon modifications.
20+ types of cybernetic implants for your team.
12 generations of cyberdecks, each featuring 24 unique modifications.
General Info
Quasis: The Last Eclipse is an isometric RPG combining the ruthless wastelands of post-apocalypse with a spectacle of cyberpunk aesthetics. The game features turn based tactical combat and action packed real-time hacking, a variety of different realms and dimensions, contrasting with the real world, such as AR (Augmented Reality) and Matrix, different points of view depending on the realm the player is in… and many more other novelties and surprises.
Your decisions will be reflected throughout the game — NPCs may treat you based on your actions, new dialogue options may appear and the questlines may shift toward different outcomes. The fate of the world is in your hands, whether you decide to re-build Phoenix and bring down the corporate elites, aid Gaia's Children and become one with nature or just get lost exploring the corners of the vast and expansive world of Quasis.
No part of the world went untouched by the catastrophe. Some never recovered, the others changed beyond recognition. From radioactive wastelands and overgrown ruins to a village lost in fog or a sentient forest... you'll get to visit them all.
But beware! When you look deep into the a mutated forest, there might be something looking back at you.
No matter the gun you have, the bullet is the thing that deals the actual damage. That is the principle our equipment system is built around. 12 calibers and 13 types of ammunition ranging from armor-piercing to EMP smart-round, mix and match to your hearts content. Now extrapolate that attention to detail to shields, grenades, abilities and augmentations and what you get are incredibly deep and varied progression and equipment systems.
During real-world combat, you will have to rely on tactical planning and careful positioning, analyze your enemies' weaknesses and make precise orders to your party members. Your weapons, ammunition and implants can make the difference between getting shiny loot and getting your party killed.
The AR implant, which is mandatory in all technopolices provides a decent tradeoff for most.
After all, few would choose a real apocalypse over a fake utopia.
But those brave enough to look beyond the smoke and mirrors, will find themselves in a city completely different to the one they used know. Secret passages, people deemed "undesirable" and shady business hidden in plain sight. Those are just some of the things the corporations try to keep out of your sight.
To enter the Matrix you'll need a specialized device called "cyberdeck". It is a portable personal computer that you get to build on your own. Mix and match hundreds of components and hunt down the best software to achieve peak performance.
To complete a matrix run you will need to go through a few different stages, first of which would be the transport layer. In the fast paced stream of data that is the digital highway you will need to evade clusters of code to get to the target server.
While on your way, you can visit proxy servers to buy yourself some time to burn through while hacking.
Once you go through the transport layer you enter the target server and face dozens of nodes that may contain anything from top secret data and military grade software to the control panel of the whole city. Each node is guarded by a cyber-sentinels. Matrix combat is a unique real-time experience where you will need to multi-task between a number of different mini-games, all while managing your stats, dealing damage and analyzing enemy weak spots.
"Last Time Studio" was created as a shared project of people passionate to bring our dream worlds to life. Our first shared creation, Quasis: The Last Eclipse is a game that combines both innovation and new takes on classic RPG mechanics.

We are an independent studio. That is a decision that was made on day one and it has been the cornerstone of our philosophy ever since. We think that compromising on our vision would defeat the purpose of the whole enterprise, so we seek funding through sources that wouldn't put restrictions on our creative process. We are currently running a crowdfunding campaign and any help would be much appreciated.

If our mission statement resonates with you, we would like to invite you to our Discord community, where you can help us shape the world of Quasis.

Exciting Combat Experience

From the dark and damp underground to the ruins of shattered castles, and even to the mysterious and majestic sky city, explore this world full of mysteries, uncover its secrets, and learn more about yourself along the way.
