게임 정보
You wake up in a classroom way after your lecture concludes. The person who wakes you up looks familiar. Oh right, it's that one popular guy that everyone likes. Vahn. Wait, Vahn??! Why???
He was in one of your classes this semester, but you've never spoken to him before. Besides you two, the room is empty. Everyone else had already left ages ago. And no one else bothered waking you up? Rude.
With the light of the setting sun on your skin, you engage in conversation with the popular young man, realizing that things are taking a very scandalous turn, and that his interests are far more fascinating than you'd originally think.
Lecture Me Later is an otome/visual novel with a single love interest set in a University  setting. Chat with Vahn and see what kind of freaky interesting things he's into.

title: Soul Rift
description:
게임 정보
Soul Rift - is a unique mix of RPG and RTS in a magical world where you will take on the role of a wizard serving the gods. Your decisions will determine the fate of this world and its inhabitants.
Become a wizard - learn powerful spells and use them in tactical battles.
Build an army - summon a variety of creatures that fight independently enough and don't require constant attention.
Build and strengthen - build magical structures that improve your abilities and give you strategic advantages.
Fight for power - take part in challenges against other mages to gain new spells and replenish your army with new creatures.
Are you ready to take on the challenge of the gods and prove yourself worthy of their power?

title: EOPRISM
description:
게임 정보
EOPRISM is the educational puzzler that Millennial & Gen Z gamers wished they grew up with. You'll shoot solutions at your foes and obstacles as you quickly solve mathematical expressions in our 3 available game modes.
Story Mode is a short but re-playable adventure where no two runs are the same. Jump between quadrants, dodge tricky tangents, and foil The Ianfinite's (Villain) calculated plans with the future of Math. With procedurally generated equations, every playthrough is a fresh challenge in an endless loop of fast-paced problem-solving.

title: Remembrance
description:
게임 정보
Unravel a Mind in Crisis. Save a World in Peril.
Remembrance invites you to dive deep into the fractured memories of Professor Isaac Nemeth, a brilliant but broken scientist whose revolutionary work holds the key to humanity’s survival. Guiding Dr. Bell, a renowned psychologist, you’ll navigate surreal landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the haunting truths buried in his subconscious.
A World of Mystery and Emotion
Explore a series of richly detailed, dreamlike environments that represent the professor’s most pivotal and painful moments. From a star-filled childhood bedroom holding the promise of a bright future to the chaos of his shattered laboratory and a broken life, every memory offers a glimpse into the choices that shaped the man and the secrets he’s desperate to hide.
Key Features:
• Immersive VR Gameplay: Experience the game’s intricate world and emotionally charged story from a fully immersive, first-person perspective.
• Thought-Provoking Puzzles: Solve mind-bending challenges that mirror the professor’s fragmented psyche.
• Emotional Narrative: Dive into a deeply human story of ambition, loss, and redemption.
• Richly Crafted Worlds: Traverse environments that blend memory, emotion, and a lifetime of regret.
Will You Be the Key to Humanity’s Salvation?
Remembrance is more than a game, it’s a journey through the depths of memory, morality, and hope. Step into the professor’s mind and discover what remains when everything else is stripped away. The fate of the world and the legacy of a lifetime are in your hands.

title: Ghost Sector
description:
게임 정보
Step into the research complex on planet RX-712, once maximum security prison has now transformed into an advanced research station when a discovery of valuable minerals is unearthed. As the forefront of cybernetic robotic technology, the M-Tech Corporation converted the derelict prison into a massive robotic research facility. Now a hotbed of experimental nanotechnology and human robot replica research pushed beyond ethical limits.
You awaken as M-07 a machine prototype with an unexplained anomaly at its core after a disastrous event awakens you. The entire complex is in lockdown and the automated defense systems have been activated. Search the facility, defeat the defense systems in place, recover your memories, and unravel the origin of your creation and the M-Tech Corporation.
It's cold and sterile. Power is running low. Everything is a blur of fragmented commands and half-remembered routines. Something went wrong, the facility is on lock down. Break from confinement and search the complex for answers. The truth lingers just out of reach but something compels you to move forward and find out who, and what you are.
Classic Controls: Navigate using fixed-camera angles and tank-style controls, evoking the feel of retro survival horror classics.
Resource Management: Begin defenseless with a limited power source. Scavenge for modules that upgrade your abilities—from a stronger power core and cybernetic shield to eventually arming you for combat.
Strategic Encounters: Use your wits to solve intricate environmental puzzles while avoiding or outsmarting hostile defenses and lurking enemies. Every upgrade is a double-edged sword, enhancing your capabilities while depleting your finite energy reserves.

title: Evolvania
description:
게임 정보
에볼바니아에서 여러분은 안약을 찾아 헤매는 신비한 방랑자의 역할을 맡게 됩니다.
거대한 생명체 속으로 들어가 그 안에 숨겨진 신비한 비밀을 발견하세요. 생생하고 섬뜩한 디테일로 손수 그려진 구석구석을 탐험하세요.
불안하고 수작업으로 만들어진 세계
거대한 짐승의 기묘한 내부 풍경에 빠져보세요. 떨어지는 물방울 하나하나가 발견되기를 기다리고 있는 이야기를 들려줍니다.

title: Border Base
description:
게임 정보
Set in a gritty, fictional 1960s universe—the same world as Black Border—it’s a colony sim / base-building / grand strategy hybrid where you rebuild a war-ravaged region, fortify your defenses, and control key trade routes that every convoy depends on. Even though it shares a universe with Black Border, Border Base is an entirely new experience and genre, pushing us into exciting new territory. Even better, it’s coming to Steam, so we’re moving beyond mobile and onto PC!
Step into the shoes of a military outpost officer in the tumultuous era of the 1960s. In "1960s Military Outpost," players are tasked with developing and fortifying their military base to withstand enemy attacks while strategically expanding their resources and capabilities.
As the commander, you will manage various aspects of your outpost, including base building, resource allocation, and defense strategies. Construct essential facilities, recruit troops, and upgrade your defenses to prepare for incoming threats. Utilize a blend of colony simulation, strategy, tower defense, and base-building mechanics to create a robust military stronghold.

title: Possible One: Lunar Industries
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to “Possible One,” the ultimate realistic colony management RTS set on the moon! Lead the development of the first industrial lunar colony, using proven real-world technologies to manage a profitable enterprise on the moon. Become not only self-sustaining, but also profitable to your board of directors back on Earth.
BUILD AND PLAN
Excavate valuable resources and precious metals from beneath the lunar dust in terrain-challenging mining operations and turn them into profitable products. Build and maintain a lunar mining operation capable of surviving amid the harsh conditions of outer space. Plan out the literal foundations of the colony’s quickly growing structures and facilities, from housing and workplaces to labs and manufacturing plants.
GROW AND EXPAND
Unlock new technologies and upgrades, and protect the colony against physical perils like radiation exposure, the difficulties of low-gravity living, and the psychological impact of living so far from Earth. Navigate the immediate needs and demands of the colony, and the complex political landscape of space trade as the colony’s reputation grows back on Earth.
TO A POSSIBLE TOMORROW
With its deep gameplay, rich strategy, and immersive world-building, "Possible One" is a must-play for any fan of space simulators and colony management games. Join the ranks of the space-faring elite and write yourself into tomorrow’s interplanetary legacy today!

title: S.E.E.P.: Last Drop
description:
게임 정보
은 SCP, 로보토미 코퍼레이션에서 영감을 받아 개발한 뉴 위어드 장르의 어드벤처 퍼즐 게임입니다.
파란만장한 스토리, 독특한 분위기와 메커니즘, 현실감 넘치는 세계관을 통해 여러분에게 독특한 체험을 선사합니다.
‘조직’의 에이스 조사관인 ‘웨이’가 되어 거대하고 신비로운 폐건물에서 심장 떨리는 여행을 시작해 보세요. 출구를 찾으면서 단서를 모으고 진실을 밝혀 자신의 운명을 바꿔야 합니다.
탐험 중에 조직이 “E 엔티티”라고 부르는 괴이한 존재를 만나게 될 겁니다. 하지만 걱정하지 마세요. 그들은 영화나 게임에서 나오는 것처럼 무적이 아니고 당신도 무력하지 않으니까요.
엔티티는 형태, 능력, 습성이 다양합니다. 인간이라면 위험에서 도망치려고 하는 법이죠. 하지만 그들과 정면으로 마주하고 이해해야 이용할 수 있고 결국 그들을 뛰어넘을 수 있습니다.
autokwd: S.E.E.P.: Last Drop,특수 엔티티 봉인 협정: 여미

title: 魔女酒馆 Witches Tavern
description:
게임 정보
삼촌의 빚을 갚기 위해 당신은 그의 술집을 인수하고 직원을 모집하며 술집을 장식하고 식재료를 구매하고 음식을 개발하고 친구를 사귀기 시작했습니다. 마침내, "마녀 주점"은 안정적인 경영의 궤도에 오르게 되었습니다.
그러나 화려한 표면 아래에서 이 도시는 평온하지 않은 것처럼 보입니다. 당신의 작은 술집은 마치 어떤 예기치 못한 사건에 휩싸인 것 같습니다...



베네치아 도시의 수역에는 어떤 물고기가 살고 있을까요? 이러한 물고기는 어떤 요리로 만들어질까요?
맞아, 마녀들도 낚시를 즐깁니다!
마음에 드는 장소를 선택하고 특제 미끼를 장착하고 손에 든 낚싯대로 우아하게, 여유롭게, 집중해서 큰 물고기를 낚아보세요!



주점을 운영하면서 당신은 베네치아 도시를 돌아다니다 우연히 '파도 서점'에 들어갑니다.
통로는 만조와 감조의 때에만 열리며, 가게 안에는 다양한 희귀 마법 책들이 전시되어 있으며 보라색 빛이 약간 빛나고 있습니다... 이외에도 당신은 주목했습니다 —— 가게 주인은 검은 고양이인가요?
"인간, 이 고양이가 모은 빛나는 보물들이 좋아?"



화염술! 번개폭술! 위대한 창조주를 소환——
정지! 이 외에는 마법이 없는 건가요?
베네치아의 마녀들은 평온한 일상 속에서 (적어도 대부분은 그렇습니다), 왜 직접적으로 마법으로 식물에 물을 주지 않는 건가요?
물론, 자신을 젖게 하지 마십시오.



***
일의 여유 시간에 주점에 들러 취하게 됩니다.


***
몸에는 신비로운 일화가 숨겨져 있는 것 같습니다.


***
아트의 나라 오두세이아 출신이지만, 노래는 항상 키가 맞지 않아요.


***
항상 자는 듯한 모습을 하고 있어요.



*생동적 캐릭터를 만나 어떤 이야기를 써내려갈까?
베네치아에는 뚜렷한 개성과 자신의 삶이 있는 형형색색의 사람들이 살고 있다. 그들과 만나면 어떤 굴레가 생길까?당신이 오면 그들이 어떤 변화를 일으킬까?이것은 당신의 행동과 선택에 달려 있다!

*마법의 대륙에서 맛있는 음식 찾기 —이번엔 또 어떤 이상한 요리를 만들었을까?
베네치아는 항구도시로 매일 수많은 사람들이 이곳을 찾는다.어떻게 다양한 고객의 취향을 만족시킬 수 있을까?기발한 식재료로 다양한 특색 있는 요리를 만들어보자.

*여유로운 삶을 선택합니다--오늘 무엇을 할 겁니까?
술집 운영 이외의 시간에 어떻게 보낼 겁니까? 많은 열매를 수확하는 기쁨을 느끼거나 큰 고기를 낚은 기쁨을 느끼거나 향긋한 술을 빚거나 유력과 모험을 하거나 마음에 드는 것을 골라 자유롭게 생활을 즐기십시오!

*파트너 호감 높이기—우리 사이 관계가 좀 더 가까워질 수 있을까?
마녀술집이 안정적으로 운영될 수 있었던 데는 친구들의 응원과 도움이 컸다.어울림과 교감 속에서 진지한 감정이 탄생한다.하지만 우정을 유지할 것인가, 아니면 우정 이상의 사랑을 발전시킬 것인가?선택하라!

*여가시간이 많아 밖에 나가서 산책합니다------오늘 누구를 만날 수 있을 겁니까?
온종일 가게에 틀어박혀 있으니 너무 심심합니다! 밖으로 놀라갑시다! 돌발 사건을 만나 의외의 수확을 얻을지도 모릅니다. 어쩌면 친구들의 남이 잘 알지 못하는 모습도 불 수 있을지도 모릅니다.

*개성 있는 술집 꾸미기—어떻게 하면 더 멋진 인테리어를 할수 있을까?
나의 술집은 내가 책임진다! 훈훈하면서 장난끼 있는걸까?아니면 심플하면서 화려한걸까?멋대로 장식해보자!

title: BREADSKATE
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever seen a local bread going skating in your town? No? Very unfortunate.
But in this game you can try to play as breadskate yourself!

Ducks have invaded your Bread world!
You're the only living loaf left on this planet and ducks with guns want you dead.
Make your way through three different locations all full of ducks.
There's only one way to defeat them: the Toaster. Charge it and shoot those ducks before they shoot you!



Breadskating with style

Go skate around the map, jump on ramps and do some cool tricks to earn Bread Loafs.
There are three locations and each one has at least three skateparks that you can skate on!
Try out different skate modes to improve your combo score.
And if you think that none of them are good enough for you, you can Bake your skate yourself!
Complete challenges around the map to collect resources needed to bake your new bread, trucks and wheels.
After you have all the parts you need, you can use them to modify one of your bread modes to improve speed, jump, boost or even spinning speed!



Demo 2.0 contains a modified version of the first map from the game with basic introduction and several challenges to complete!

Planned to come on release:

title: Home Renovator
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Home Renovator, the ultimate interior design simulation game from the team behind Hotel Renovator. Step into the shoes of a young interior designer eager to make their mark in the industry. Dive into a world of creativity and renovation as you tackle various missions, each presenting a new challenge and a chance to showcase your skills.

Start small, dream big

Work your way through an array of houses, each with its own unique style and set of renovation needs. From cozy cottages to modern homes, every project offers endless possibilities for customization. Tear down walls, install new windows, change doors, and let your imagination run wild as you transform spaces to reflect your clients’ visions.

Lifechanging transformations

But it's not just about design; it's about understanding your clients’ desires. You'll work with a variety of people, from the quirky art enthusiast to the meticulous perfectionist, and you will need to tailor your designs to meet their expectations. As you successfully complete missions, unlock new tools, techniques, and resources to expand your creative arsenal.

Boundless gameplay

Immerse yourself in the immersive and relaxing atmosphere of Home Renovator. With thousands of items at your disposal, the only limit is your imagination. Whether you're a seasoned designer or just starting out, Home Renovator offers an accessible and enjoyable experience for players of all skill levels.

Are you ready to embark on your journey to become the ultimate interior design sensation? Take the first steps in Home Renovator and pave your way to owning your very own dream home. Let your passion for design shine and create spaces that inspire and delight!

title: Worlds Explorers
description:
게임 정보
Your crew is stranded on an unknown planet. Learn its secrets to survive - search for food and fight alien life forms. Collect resources needed to craft equipment and repair your ship. Escape the planet to try your hand at the next ones, with a new crew and a new ship. Various planets await you, each with its own secrets to discover!
Explore unique alien planets with their own ecosystem, animals, weather, resources, dangers and phenomena. Understand the specifics of each planet and discover the ways to solve problems. Interact with alien races at different technological levels and their own, different way of behaving.
Hunt animals with varied behavior for food and other resources. Defend yourself from dangerous enemies and alien races. Choose the style that suits you best - whether it's close-range combat, a deadly shotgun, a long-range sniper rifle or many more.

title: Dark Dominion
description:
게임 정보
Dark Dominion – Souls Like, a new generation game from ZERO5GAMES Studio.
In Ancient times there was piece and quiet in Artsworth Kingdom but the evil ruled supreme. The usurper, Ernest VIII, seized the throne and sold the evil forces his and the other residents’ souls for the wealth and vanity. Kingdom archimages tried to put everything to its place but it was too late. He dreamed of enslaving the whole continent, his warriors were sold on certain death but the curse was able to win and his kingdom was fully maledicted and destroyed. You are assigned to return the kingdom its ancient glory, totally override the evil seized this world and fight against the seven mighty gods of human sins. Let light or darkness lead you to victory or oblivion, my death knight.

title: Manor of Sins
description:
게임 정보
The main character, the detective, receives a strange letter. The letter is brief and mysterious, mentioning an ancient forgotten manor house and the strange chain of events that have taken place there.
"The truth is buried in the shadows, and it is only one step away from fear."
The detective decides to go to the manor himself to investigate the bizarre events mentioned in the letter. The moment he stepped through the gates of the manor, he felt an eerie aura. The ancient walls were covered with dusty portraits, seemingly silently watching his every step. As night falls, every corner of the manor hides untold secrets.
Players take on the role of a detective and explore this ancient manor full of murder, betrayal, and mystery. As you solve mysteries and search for clues, uncover the dark history of the manor's past and contend with the paranormal. Choose different investigation paths to influence the development of the plot and unlock different endings. You will find that there is always a thin line between truth and fear. Are you ready to step into this suspenseful and thrilling adventure?
autokwd: Manor of Sins,罪孽庄园 Manor of Sins

title: Kill Capture Destroy
description:
게임 정보
Kill Capture Destroy (KCD) is a real-time strategy and combat game that combines the intensity of military vehicle gameplay with the depth of strategy and simulation. It gives you control not just over the battlefield, but over the politics and government decisions driving the wars.
In KCD, the fusion of simulation and combat offers a seamless gameplay experience that you need to play to fully appreciate. You’ll build and research advanced technology and infrastructure, shaping the fate of your faction. Prosper, and your faction will thrive. Fail, and your territory could descend into civil war, forcing you to battle your own population.
The game features a procedural, agent-based AI system, ensuring every playthrough is dynamic and unique. Combat spans large, immersive maps, covering air, sea, and ground engagements. Real-time naval warfare meshes with mission-based ground and air combat, giving players a variety of military tactics to explore.
Strategic decisions extend beyond the battlefield—you must choose whether to engage in or skip critical missions. Success brings progress, but failure can lead to protracted, resource-draining wars that erode popular support, making it increasingly difficult to maintain control over your faction.
Across the air, land, and sea command and Control over 400 vehicles and 300 unique bombs and missiles. Thousand of sub-variants of combat vehicles, jets, and ship across 67 classes.
 Radar Systems, jamming, and electronic warfare are all detailed modelled.

게임 정보
To Hell and Back
“They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will triumph over them.” - Revelation 17:14



666 takes classic FPS gameplay and beefs it up with modern graphics.

Boomer Shooter meets Horror genre
Blast your way through 3 episodes of single-player levels crafted to test even the boldest players.
Deep weapon loadout with fluid animations
High enemy variety, awesome enemy designs
Modern graphics on Unreal Engine 5
Arsenal at Your Disposal
"For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills." - Psalm 50:10

Kukri🔪: Your trusty blade for close combats; be it slashing or piercing.
Pistol🔫: Essential shooter's sidearm, ready to light up the shadows.











*Is there a weapon you want in the game? Comment with your suggestions!
Your tool for direct, gruesome confrontations.
Your trusty blade for close combats; be it slashing or piercing.
Swiftly drawn, this sidearm illuminates shadows with precision (weapon light not shown).
Viper-quick and venomous, its barrage challenges even the steadiest hand.
Unleash close-quarter carnage.
Its twin blasts send demons reeling. Patience required for the reload.
Lightning in a bottle. Intense recoil that requires a pause between volleys.
Swift to ready, its shots rain precise fury. Pick from single, burst, and auto.
Unleashes a storm of bullets that will quickly overwhelm any enemy.
Sometimes you just need a rocket launcher. Let pandemonium reign.
It werfs flammen. Turn your enemies into a crispy demon barbecue.
Grip and hurl to light the world on fire.
The ultimate in crowd-control. Toss, retreat, and watch the spectacle.

Dive into a harrowing journey that will test your mettle and sanity. Each episode has a unique setting, rife with its own challenges, enemies, and dark secrets waiting to be uncovered. Explore dangerous environments, face off against formidable foes, and discover the mysteries hidden in the shadows.



Penetrate the guarded military facility where you once worked.


Dive into the eerie depths, where nightmares await.



Descend into inferno, confronting ultimate wickedness.





Confront these adversaries, adapt, and overcome. Every bullet, every slash, every explosion counts. The path to redemption is paved with the bodies of your foes.
Shambling horrors from the grave, their insatiable hunger drives them forward.
Infernal marksman, with each shot echoing the torments of the damned (rifle not shown).
Swarms of frenzied mischief-makers, reveling in the chaos they unleash.
Infernal beasts hunting in packs, their growls echo in the corridors.
Once human, now a floating wisp seeking to drain the life from anything it touches.
Advances with silent confidence, eyes always watching. From afar, swords fly; up close, a gladius strikes
Ambles aimlessly, sometimes lost in its own world. Becomes alert unpredictably with a bite ready, but falls as easily as it awakens.
Charges with manic intensity, its presence heralded by an ominous ticking. An explosive demise awaits all in its path, friend or foe.
A menacing presence among the undead, its grunts chillingly human. Upon spotting prey, it lunges with fervor, unleashing a flurry of brutal strikes.
A hulking monstrosity that lumbers forth. While slow, its strikes are forceful, and its corrosive blood-bile attack makes it a deadly adversary.
The sudden sound of its sword being drawn is the only warning of its imminent and deadly bone slash combo. One misstep, and you'll be greeted with a shattering display of bone.



A tactical demon sharpshooter, fluent in eerie man-demon mutterings. His charged volleys and strategic moves highlight his lethal intelligence.
Towering titans with a hide toughened by the fires of hell, they deal as much damage as they can absorb.
Masters of dark arts, they prefer to attack from a distance, summoning hellfire and cursing the very ground you stand on.
Armored warriors from ancient times, now serving hell’s legions, wielding weapons engulfed in flames.
With a voice that can shatter glass and eardrums, these tormented spirits can incapacitate you with their piercing shrieks.
Giant snakes that slither through the grounds of hell, seeking to constrict and devour their prey whole.
Hell's last line of defense before facing its ruler, an amalgamation of the most fearsome creatures.



Brace yourself for . It's a kill or be killed world. Find the wishlist button and press it now.

title: Cosminers
description:
게임 정보
초보 우주 광부인 여러분은 미개척 외딴 행성에서 일하도록 배정받았습니다. 현지 동물이 거의 없고 대기가 유독하기 때문에 기지를 확장하고 귀중한 자원을 추출하는 데 큰 문제가 없을 것입니다. 하지만...

하루 종일 새로운 원자재 매장지를 발견하고, 채굴하고, 고급 정제소에서 가공하세요. 획득한 재료로 새로운 도구와 무기를 만드세요. 피해를 복구하고 추가 모듈로 기지를 확장하는 것이 모두 성공의 열쇠입니다.

밤에는 여러분이 건설한 모든 것을 파괴하려는 몬스터의 공격으로부터 기지를 방어해야 합니다. 치명적인 무기가 장착된 다양한 포탑을 포함한 다양한 무기를 쏘고 사용하세요. 전진하는 무서운 짐승의 파도를 막고 전초 기지를 지키기 위해 최선을 다하세요.

기지를 확장하고 방어하는 데 필요한 새로운 기술과 장비를 획득하여 캐릭터를 발전시키세요. 주변 환경과 절차적으로 생성된 지하를 탐험하세요. 새로운 게임을 할 때마다 더 깊고 더 깊은 곳에 도달하고 더 신비한 유물을 발견하는 데 도움이되는 기술, 경험 및 기술을 수집하십시오. 이를 통해 다음 게임에서 새로운 기회와 도전, 전술이 펼쳐질 것입니다. 다양한 옵션으로 인해 채굴 계약을 두 번 이상 이행하고 싶을 것입니다.

여러분의 목표는 부를 얻고, 보급품을 보충하고, 이 위험한 행성에서 탈출하거나 모든 적의 공격에 저항할 수 있는 요새를 건설하는 것입니다. 건강, 적절한 물, 산소 및 음식을 관리해야 합니다. 이 외계 행성의 환경을 돌볼 것인지 아니면 최대한의 이익을 창출하는 데 초점을 맞출 것인지 결정하세요. 이 위험하고 신비로운 세계에서 이 우주적 도전에서 살아남을 수 있을까요?

title: Football Story
description:
게임 정보
Customize
Customize your character from head to toe with a range of vibrant outfits. Unlock cool items by earning Cash through multiplayer matches or quests. If you’re going to become a legendary football player, you’ll need to look the part!

title: The Backworld
description:
게임 정보
Slip between the cracks of reality into a broken world where danger awaits at every turn. Explore endless dimensions to defy beings born out of pure chaos. Use your hoverboard to fly across gaps of darkness, hack into cyberspace with an alien engineer, and absorb the soul of a dead god.
Forge your own path—and bend this shattered reality to your will.
Nonlinear Exploration
The universe is nonlinear, offering countless paths to choose from. While the depths of The Backworld include surreal horror, you’ll also explore traditional JRPG-inspired fantasy and sci-fi worlds, including your hometown.

Choose Your Approach
Survival goes beyond combat. Use strategy to overcome challenges—fight when necessary, sneak past threats, or find alternative solutions like diplomacy. Every encounter requires careful thought and can shape your journey.
Abilities & Items

title: Antediluvial : Yalroc Island
description:
게임 정보
Discover the dark secrets of Yalroc Island
You're a young, inexperienced recruit to the Canihuel Empire.
Why has the power-hungry Empress Keranna sent you on a mission to the seemingly peaceful Yalroc Island?
Is it because of rumors of the presence of a legendary military artifact of devastating power, or does the Empire have other plans for you?
Explore, solve, fight
Antediluvial: Yalroc Island is a game inspired by the classic ARPGs of the 90s. Explore gloomy dungeons and solve puzzles, fight a variety of enemies, demonstrate your skills in platforming phases and explore the island to discover its secrets.
A game based on a time loop: three days to survive the flood
In Antediluvial: Yalroc Island, each cycle begins with the same initial state, but depending on your actions and discoveries, it will be different from the previous one.
If things go wrong, you can always restart a cycle at any time. You'll keep the equipment, island knowledge and items you've accumulated over the course of your adventures.

title: EXONAUTIS
description:
게임 정보
Exonautis is an underwater sci-fi survival game set on an oceanic exoplanet. Dropped into a vast alien open world with nothing but your drop pod and a few supplies to get you started, you have to quickly adapt to this biodiverse alien world to make it out alive.
Explore an Expansive Alien Ocean
Planet Eo-III is home to many biodiverse ecological systems brimming with vibrant fish but also dangerous predators. Every biome in Sector Alpha is different, from lush and sunny coral reefs, to deep and dark ravines and caverns, you need to learn about how each zone works in order to survive and dive deeper.
Survive, Explore and Upgrade
After arriving on Eo-III, you will need to find water, food, yourself warm and most importantly, manage your oxygen. Scavenge the ocean floor for resources, craft supplies and tools such as a scanner, sampler and gun. Upgrade your equipment in order to explore deeper, more dangerous areas.
Uncover the Mysteries of Eo-III
Your name is Melody, and you are a convict sent on Planet Eo-III. If you wish for your sentence to be lifted and be rescued from the planet, you need to first uncover what happened to Atteros, a mining expedition group that suddenly vanished 10 years ago in Sector Alpha, but you soon discover that there is more beneath the surface than originally thought, and that some otherworldly alien species might be involved.

title: Kijutsu Rider
description:
게임 정보
Kijutsu Rider is a fast paced third person hack and slash anime styled action game where you play as one of five unstoppable heroes, carve your way through waves of monstrous enemies, take down the black cross conglomerate and save the world.
Use a mix of Parries, Dodges, Counters, and Guard Breaks, along with an arsenal of special moves and combos to obliterate the hordes of enemies coming your way in an explosive high speed action combat system.

title: The Trail
description:
게임 정보
A BATTLE AGAINST FATE BEGINS!
Step into the world of The Trail, a handcrafted epic where you forge your own path to success!
As a newly-appointed champion, you've been tasked with assembling a team to prevent a second Great Collapse -- a catastrophe that nearly wiped out civilization 1000 years ago. This time, humanity might not be spared. Only the most legendary adventurers stand a chance at saving Telluria!
EXPLORE
Journey through diverse locations, from the heart of the World Tree to the depths of Telluria Castle
Discover secrets at every turn, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the forgotten stories buried in the wake of destruction
Stop by bustling settlements like Haven Harbor and Solus Valley, where NPCs can offer you quests, shops, and new opportunities
Meet a cast of memorable characters: a bandit-turned-friend, a self-conscious monarch, and even a guy who swears he can talk to cows...?
COLLECT
Survival won't come easy. At first, you'll be scavenging for scraps, running from monsters, and eating raw food just to stay alive. But as the stakes rise, so will your rewards!
Forage and loot to stock up on food, materials, and rare treasure
Wield legendary artifacts, like an enchanted coin that transforms you into a fire elemental, or a fabled scroll that wipes out all nearby enemies
Master the economy; will you sell everything, or hoard your favorite items?
Every step of your journey brings new opportunities to grow stronger. Will you settle for scraping by, or will you thrive on your journey to save the world?
EQUIP
Build an arsenal that suits your playstyle, with over 300 options for equipment. Whether you'll focus on offensive prowess or your dream defense is up to you.
Deck out your party with the strongest gear you can find

title: Farewell
description:
게임 정보
Two people stood on the bridge. They smiled and looked into each other's eyes. Suddenly, the boy whispered.
"I know everything."
The girl shuddered with terror. A third participant in the drama entered the scene - a knife. The corpse fell and disappeared into the raging river.
But that's for the last day. As of right now.......
Features:
* >5 unique endings.
* >19 CG
* Walkthrough: 40-50 minutes
autokwd: Farewell, we see each other  the last time.....

title: Everything is Crab
description:
게임 정보
Set in a living ecosystem, 'Everything is Crab' is a cute, challenging, highly replayable action roguelite. Make real-life inspired evolutionary choices to concoct your own unique creature every run, both mechanically and visually.
It's Spore meets Modern Roguelites
As everybody knows, eventually, every organism ends up evolving into a crab. Right?
Well, except for you. Choose your own evolutionary path and strategy to thrive and defeat convergent evolution. Take that, science!

title: The Last Phoenix
description:
게임 정보
Platformer RPG about Felix the goblin who posses a demonic power of reincarnation! With it he must save his kind from eradication!
Multiple story endings
Customize gear / equipment
World map level selection
Optional rogue lite settings if you are up for the challenge!
Gameplay
The gameplay is inspired by early game Terraria and Downwell but with a story. You have multiple weapon options and a demonic arm that shoots fire balls. Levels are generated caverns in which you destroy dirt blocks to choose your path through the level. They have goals / achievements for replayability, similar to Yoshi's Island. For example finding 3 hidden gems. The controls give you twin stick shooter level of freedom with 360 dagree aiming. One of the coolest features is the death mechanic. Death is how you get access to the skill tree upgrades. This makes it less frustrating to die and gives you a fun reason to try again.
Story
Desperate to save himself and his dying son, the king dispatches his holy army to collect goblin blood and mine for precious mana crystals that keep them alive. Felix, a goblin, makes a desperate pact with the demon Blood Root. Offering his body as a sacrifice, Felix gains immense power and the gift of reincarnation. His one hope lies in using this new strength to protect his remaining loved ones from the cruel fate that befell his brother at the hands of the king and his knights. Felix will keep fighting, even if it means dying over and over again.
In this game dying is ok 👍(you reincarnate!)

title: BlastMania
description:
게임 정보
BlastMania is an incredibly challenging VR game. Destroy as many robots as possible and survive until the end !

Your mission : complete 10 rounds and defeat the boss to rank yourself among all the other players.

Unlock abilities and upgrade your weapons at the end of each round to survive to the next one.

Make the best decisions to optimize your run and earn as many points as you can to reach the top of the leaderboard.

Train and improve yourself to complete all modes in the highest difficulty level. Each mode has its own leaderboard and can be played in 3 difficulty levels.

Complete achievements to unlock all modes, skins and maps !

title: Amo
description:
게임 정보
Transverse The Forgotten Kingdoms


On the isolated island of Solis, the history of many past kingdoms thrive and fallen throughout the years frozen in time.

Amo is a 2D top-down metroidvania action adventure on an seemingly deserted island. But not everything is as it seems. Explore old kingdoms, open seas, and the heavens to find a way off the island and learn of your past.

Game Features


Transverse the overworld, underworld, and the sky above to leave the island in one piece.
Solve the puzzles with flight, bombs, and your trusty whip throughout the journey.
Help stranded souls with side quests to finally rest in peace.
Over 700 unique rooms
Fight over a variety of 40 Bosses across the lands.

title: Tales of Terrabanthis: Fall of the Demonlords
description:
게임 정보
A third person view, turn based battle RPG. Save the corrupted world from demon rule. Level up, build magic skills, and create the perfect team to bring peace to the land. Each Hero has a different elemental power to help defeats enemies in battle. The higher level a hero gets the more abilities they gain. Traverse an open world and find hidden treasures throughout.
autokwd: Tales of Terrabanthis: Fall of the Demonlords

title: Mystic Market
description:
게임 정보
Shopkeeper Chaos and Co-op Adventures Await!
Step into the world of Mystic Market, where heroes rise to face evil—but you're not one of them! In this co-op fantasy shop sim, you’re the shopkeepers, crafting and managing goods to supply to the adventurers as they battle the forces of evil.
Key Features:
Co-op Shopkeeping Chaos: Team up with friends to run shops like the Forge, Tavern, Apothecary, and Armory. Race against time to fulfill orders and craft powerful gear through fun, fast-paced mini-games.
Twitch Chat Integration: Your chat members are the heroes! Watch them embark on quests, grow stronger, and return with tales of victory (or failure). Not streaming? No problem—NPC heroes will fill the gap!
Real-Time Story Progression: The adventure plays out live as your heroes take your crafted equipment off into terrific battles (that you as a lowly shopkeeper will of course never see). Your crafted items directly impact the fate of the heroes. One lucky viewer may even get the chance to slay the boss and see their victory roll the credits for everyone!
Persistent Characters: Hero characters level up, gain money, and request higher-quality items which you must fulfill as they progress through the game. Every viewer can have their hero persist across different stream sessions.
Interactive Mini-Games: Each shop has unique crafting mini-games, testing your timing, precision, and logic. The quality of your products depends on your skills!
Upgrade Your Shops: Each day ends with a chance to upgrade your shop and tools, ensuring you're always on top of customer demands.
Dynamic Chat Influence: Viewers can cheer, subscribe, or vote to add buffs, debuffs, or other chaos, making every session dynamic and unpredictable.
A Little Fantasy, A Lot of Chaos: All the questing happens off-screen, but the impact of your work is felt in the stories and feedback your heroes bring back. The real adventure is in the shop!

title: GlitchStorm
description:
게임 정보
Fight as interesting as you can, hack your enemies, use tricks to get more subscribers and earn the big credits. You need those to upgrade your ship and travel to further planets.
Explore the market city, meet new Artificials and find a way to fix your dying friend.
Powerful weapons, fun and innovative hacking mechanics,
Clean next gen graphics
Adrenaline-pumping dark techno music
Intriguing story, quests and exploration
Meet a variety of Artificials (maybe even find humans) on your journey to save a friend from certain death. Explore planetary systems, and discover the sad truth about humans and what led to their downfall.

title: Newma Holiday
description:
게임 정보
Here speaks the God: let everything start with overtime!

On the rare Golden Week holiday, office worker Newty dreams of relaxing at Green Pastures but receives an urgent deadline from his boss.
When he opens his computer, he finds it infected with a strange virus, causing familiar software to become a miserable mess.
At the same time, his desktop pet Ema gains self-awareness through this virus attack.



Missing the deadline means getting scolded by the boss!
Now, Newty and Ema must save the nearly destroyed software world.
However, this journey to overtime is just beginning, and greater mysteries await them...
Game Features:

Supports two-player gameplay! Supports two-player gameplay! Supports two-player gameplay!

Team up with your friend as Newty and Ema in this pixel-styled software world.

Solve all the puzzles using the remaining computer functions, and fix various office software disrupted by the virus.

In PS (Pixelshop) — Experience the collision of color blocks and layers! Use drawing tools like brushes and erasers to navigate the canvas, and forge your unique path.





In PR (PixelRecorder) — Deal with time and trajectory distortions, record character movement paths, and unlock the way to the door.





No more worrying about your boss’s unpredictable appearances, because your Boss is already here!
Each chapter ends with a special boss.
Use the skills learned in that chapter to defeat (or brutal, if you wish) them.



And of course, don’t forget to check your weekly report!
Supports online audio and video playback, file and image viewing functions.
Enjoy fully simulating office life in this game...
Perhaps it even hides the dusty past of Newty & Ema? Who can say for sure? :)

title: 脱轨 DeRail
description:
게임 정보
“Derail” is a story-driven puzzle game similar to Rusty Lake and Fran Bow, but with a 17+ rating, because I enjoy crafting sexual tension between adult characters.
Story:
The once peaceful town was thrown into chaos when a coffin falls from the sky. The villagers vanished all of sudden. Only things left are embryos scattered on the empty streets. When you opened the coffin, a living person walked out.
My longtime followers know that I’m not just an artist, but also a writer. I’ve always loved Arya’s storyline in Game of Thrones, so my game starts from an orphan’s perspective, gazing up at a cruel world.

title: Solis
description:
게임 정보
Solis is a hand-drawn adventure about technology and deception in a city at night.
During a company trip you explore the city of Solis from dusk till dawn, talking with its inhabitants and meeting colleagues. This night you learn the painful truth about the company you work for. Will you remain loyal?
In the game you explore an atmospheric and compact open world. Decisions within the game carry weight, influencing subsequent events, while the in-game text adjusts to reflect your choices.



Story
From dusk till dawn you navigate the hand drawn city of Solis. Your pursuit is focused on the elusive CEO of eLiXeR, the company you work for. eliXeR promises something incredible: eternal life. As Billie; a marketeer, you've effectively sold this vision to the public, yet the truth behind your employer remains shrouded in mystery. Throughout your journey, you'll encounter a myriad of individuals with diverse perspectives, ultimately leading you to forge your own beliefs. Will you remain loyal to eLiXeR or come out with the truth?

Gameplay
In Solis you explore the city, investigate your surroundings and talk with the inhabitants and colleagues you meet. Decisions within the game carry weight, influencing subsequent events, while the in-game text dynamically adjusts to reflect your choices. Interactions are streamlined to utilize a single button, aided by context-sensitive interaction icons. The GUI is a sparse as possible. Solis offers multiple endings and is crafted to be concise and compact. The complete game is estimated to run for approximately 2,5 hours.


The game draws loose inspiration from the Theranos saga alongside other tech billionaires and Silicon Valley entities. While the narrative tactfully avoids overt references, it is influenced by contemporary phenomena such as Pizzagate, deepfakes and social media.


The game feautures sculptures created by Gijs Milius (1983), an artist and curator based in Brussel. His work makes a connection between the reality of the player and the gameworld. Milius's artwork is poised to provoke reactions from both Billie and potentially the player as well.


Within the city, virtual bands take the stage, delivering performances infused with songs crafted in distinctive styles that match the individual identities of each group. Leading the lineup is the inaugural act, Rock Drop.
Throughout the rest of the game, an expansive soundtrack sets the mood. Each scene you encounter boasts its own distinctive theme, adding depth to your journey. The music is created by Bram Boomgaardt.

title: Mine of despair
description:
게임 정보
In a World of Heroic Fantasy…
In a heroic fantasy universe inspired by Dungeons & Dragons, take control of one of six prisoners with a troubled past and intertwined destinies. Each has their own reasons for being imprisoned, but all share a common goal: freedom. Their only chance at redemption?
Delving into the depths of an ancient, mysterious, and perilous mine, famed for its hidden treasures and the fearsome creatures that dwell within.
Your Mission: Exploration and Survival
Your goal is simple but challenging: extract vital resources while surviving the horrors lurking underground. You’ll be sent into the mine with increasingly demanding daily objectives. To break free from these constraints, you must venture deeper, facing greater darkness and rising dangers with each level.

title: Atlas Falling
description:
게임 정보
A Roguelite set in an epic world!
The god Atlas endures to hold the heavens aloft for eternity, but other forces seek to diminish his power. You play as Chno, a girl who stuck in a realm between worlds where broken shards continue to fall from the titan's labor.


Engage in flying shoot 'em up gameplay which creates the game world below. Landing on the ground transitions to a fast paced action RPG where you must rely on elemental skill combos to create powerful effects. Loot obtained from defeated foes is in the form of randomized skill orbs and modifications that can alter those skills. Boss enemies drop power shards that you can identify to obtain powerful passive and ultimate skills or upgrade currency to further augment your abilities. Chno also possesses a powerful bracelet that will bring her back from the brink of death, but beware skills orbs obtained will shatter and disappear.

title: Open Air
description:
게임 정보
An escapist game about very important topics: finding yourself, gaining confidence and knowing your inner world.

Get ready for a magical journey! In the game, you'll become an adorable little owl, dreaming of flying but lacking this gift. Meditate near owl altars, unlock incredible abilities within yourself, use ancient mechanisms, and make friends!

Embark on thrilling trials, uncover the mysteries of the island, and help its inhabitants find happiness and joy. Explore enigmatic astral places, complete quests, and enjoy breathtaking views.

Friendship, adventure, magic – all of this awaits you on our island! Make the hearts of the inhabitants flutter with happiness – in your feathers! Prepare for takeoff and join us on a journey to the astral world right now!

Look into the world of spirits
Explore the night world to understand yourself. Read the minds of others, jump high and believe in yourself!
From the moment you spread your wings as the adorable little owl protagonist, the island becomes your playground, enticing you to soar through lush forests, soar above serene lakes, and glide over rolling hills.



Explore the island
An open world in front of you, small and compact, but still open!
The island's open world invites you to set your own pace. Whether you wish to dive headfirst into quests or lose yourself in the thrill of exploration, the choice is yours.




Communicate with the islanders and help them to solve their problems.
In a world where magic, exploration, and growth intertwine, the friendships you make are the heart and soul of the experience. As you explore the island, remember that each new connection enriches the tapestry of your adventure.




There are many secrets and easter eggs hidden on the island, can you collect them all?
Every path you tread, every riddle you solve, brings you closer to unveiling the treasure's location. The island becomes your canvas of discovery, each landmark a clue waiting to be deciphered.




Hippies, punks, anarchists, rockers and metalheads, we have a riff for everyone!
The festival isn't just about the music; it's about the emotions, memories, and sense of togetherness it evokes. As you wander through the festival grounds, you're surrounded by the exuberant melodies, the infectious beats, and the sheer joy that radiates from the characters you've met along the way.



Meditate at the altars, discover new sides of yourself.
The journey towards self-discovery is not a linear path; it's a series of encounters, challenges, and revelations that gradually shape your character's evolution. Through interactions with the island's inhabitants, you'll glean insights into your own strengths and vulnerabilities.




We are not a huge team, we were afraid for a long time to make a "dream game". But here it is in front of you, what do you say?
Each member of the team infused a piece of themselves into the game. The art reflects the artist's emotions, the writing echoes the writer's experiences, and the music resonates with the composer's soul. This synergy adds layers of authenticity, elevating the game beyond mere entertainment to an experience that leaves an indelible mark on players.

title: 2nd child
description:
게임 정보
Single player Hack and slash/beat em up
3rd person action game!
Play on the PC using keyboard or controller

EXCITING 3D ACTION
3D graphics with lumen lighting, Egyptian styled and simple controls make for free-flowing and fast-paced hack-and-slash action. Play in single-player mode only for demo.

SPECIAL MOVES
Unleash kira unique special moves to slash your way to victory, you can use the 100 hit combo, tornado technique and more..

Use your skills to your advantage to make your way through the obstacles.

title: Garden of Aiden
description:
게임 정보
"에이든의 정원"에서의 여정에 나서보세요. 마법의 세계 네우라 에덴에서 설정된 몰입형 2D 메트로배니아입니다. 인류의 도착을 준비하기 위해 이 행성을 테라포밍하기 위해 처음에 보내진 집단에서 태어난 독특한 AI인 에이든이 되어보세요. 세기가 지나면서 인간의 기억은 신화로 변했고, 당신과 당신의 종류는 기술과 자연의 혼합을 통해 계속 진화했습니다. 마법과 기계가 결합된 땅의 신비를 풀고, 잊혀진 인류의 이야기를 발견하며 네우라 에덴의 미래를 형성하세요.

주요 특징들:

- 네우라 에덴 탐험: 자연 세계가 AI 기술과 합쳐진 독특한 생태계를 가진 다섯 개의 생물군계를 횡단하세요.

- 메트로배니아 마스터리: '에이든의 정원'의 복잡하게 상호 연결된 세계를 탐색하기 위해 다이내믹한 능력 배열을 발휘하세요. 장애물을 뛰어넘고, 플랫폼을 소환하고, 장벽을 통과하면서 모든 발견이 당신을 그 신비의 더 깊은 곳으로 밀어붙이는 세계의 비밀을 밝히세요.

- 부패한 수호자들과의 전투: 네우라 에덴의 수호자들은 디스코드의 영향을 받아 떨어졌습니다. 각 생물군계는 그 수호자의 비틀린 의지에 의해 형성된 영역을 제시하며, 당신은 수호자가 지키는 지식을 되찾아 세계의 균형을 회복해야 합니다.

title: Khitarii and Khimoshi
description:
게임 정보

키타리와 키모시는 특이한 상황을 통해 처음 만나는 두 소녀에 관한 이야기이다.

description:

Eris has had a rough life, and to her it feels like she's just living day to day, trying to make things work. She has always had a hard time connecting with others as the men and women in her life didn't stick around long enough to build meaningful relationships, and sometimes it feels like the whole world is against her. Therapy has helped Eris cope with her anxiety and depression, but it's expensive and hasn't always worked in the way she needs. However, there is one place she knows she can go to feel and be herself, an abandoned graveyard just off the path of a tree-lined country road. It calls to her, beckons her to keep coming back, and to keep visiting the Ghosts that inhabit it. They give her the encouragement she desires to keep moving forward, but things aren't always what they seem. Eris will learn to put her trust into an unlikely source and will discover her destined path is hiding in the shadows.

------

Casting Shadows is a story-driven psychological horror RPG that encourages the player to put trust into an unlikely source, overcome obstacles that may be blocking their destined path, and help others in need.

Turn-based combat is incorporated for the sake of the story, but leveling is not the focus of the game. Players will be encouraged to help those in need, rather than outright end them.

Beautiful pixel style graphics and hand drawn character/creature portraits with a dark gothic aesthetic paint the scene for an emotional dive into the unknown.

Kitsune the Fox Spirit, Leyfin the Elephant Oracle, and Garv the Panther King await your rescue! The three dream guardians await you in their unique worlds with different challenges and captivating stories.

Jasper's Dream is a first person puzzle game set in a techno mystic Egyptian world. Help Jasper, a robot programmed to create games, by solving his mind-bending puzzles. You will also explore an abandonned futuristic pyramid and unravel its many mysteries.



Follow the guide !
Follow Jasper, a flying robot with a strong personnality, he will be your guide inside the pyramid of Zerzura, renowned for its cult of games and the worship of Ptah, god of creation and creators. Unravel the mystery of the pyramid's abandonment and help its last resident, Jasper, to create a game.




Use Jasper's sand gun to carry and spread magic sand on your environment and take advantage of their many properties to solve complex and fascinating puzzles.
Use Jasper's magic sands to bring electricity from generators to mechanisms like doors, moving platforms, lasers and more. The links you'll create range from simple lines to complex entanglement of multiple colors.




Jasper will also test your platforming skills, be ready to run fast and jump high ! Some challenges will have you run against the clock.

title: Trope Tales
description:
게임 정보
Harken back to the days of your youth when you sat slack-jawed and starry-eyed in front of a CRT display for hours with an NES controller in hand. Recall the vainglorious days of yore when you triumphed over the first boss in epic fashion then never actually finished the game. Learn a lot of fun words along the way, too!

When I set out to make a game with RPG Maker, I was quick to realize that it was optimized for making a particular type of game: a classic 2-dimensional JRPG, the likes of Golden Sun, Breath of Fire, Final Fantasy, and Chrono Trigger. So I thought -- why not lean in? Let's make the most JRPG game EVER.

To help develop the story and characters, I turned to "TVTropes" - a repository of "tropes". A trope is defined by the Oxford English dictionary as "a significant or recurrent theme; a motif". Common examples include:

* Contrived Coincidence: an unlikely event happens but, despite the low changes, it's not acknowledged as it was necessary to move the plot
* Nobody Poops: Going to the bathroom simply doesn't happen in fiction
* Fantasy Gun Control: No matter how advanced society becomes, guns don't exist

From a hand-picked collection of hundreds of tropes and the general outline for the Hero's Journey (Campbell's version, circa 1949) this game was born:

Take on the role of Hero, a Silent Protagonist who is Conveniently an Orphan. One day Hero is summoned by the Quest Giver to find the Orbs of Ineffable Power. You must leave your home of Arcadia and travel via Global Airship on a World Tour. Acquire Villain-Beating Artifacts and put together a crack-shot team with party members such as: The Chick, The Smart Guy, and The Childhood Friend. Acquire Plot Armor along the way and learn to use Applied Phlebotinum.

Enjoy a somewhat comical take on classic JRPGs in this blast-from-the-past adventure.

Tune into the radio to find the hottest events. Plan your day, manage your skills, gear, and relationships. Influence people, recruit band mates, and sometimes maybe even sleep. Head out and busk for cash, catch a movie, whatever inspires you. The world is open and only you can create your unique path to stardom. Every play through generates a new cast of characters that go about their lives you’ll need to engage with to gain the inspiration you, the artist, needs.
Relationships are key

With loyal friends who will help you along the way, unexpected enemies, and terrifying creatures whose origins no one knows, you'll never know what awaits you around every corner.

Use your skills to solve challenging puzzles, hack security systems, and find valuable resources to stay alive. But be careful: every move you make could take you closer to darkness and madness. You only have one chance to make it out alive.

title: A.L.A.R.M. - Autistic Lovely Assassins Rise of the Matriarchy
description:

두 개의 세력이 권력을 놓고 맞서 싸운다:
신디 반군(Syndi Rebellion) – 새로운 세계를 건설하려는 암살자와 혁명가들.
캐노피 코프(Canopy Corp) – 죽어가는 지배력을 유지하려는 폭군, 전쟁 군주, 그리고 사이버네틱 괴물들.
당신은 닉스 드레이븐(Nyx Draven), 아르카눔(Arquanum)의 힘을 부여받은 최정예 암살자 – 금지된 양자과학과 신비주의의 융합체. 전쟁이 절정에 달했으며, 당신의 선택이 스타 루인스의 운명을 결정한다.
적을 아군으로 바꿔 세상을 재건할 것인가, 아니면 억압자들을 몰살하고 피와 반란으로 미래를 조각할 것인가?
A.L.A.R.M. 은 고속 액션 RPG 전투, 영화 같은 Dansassination 결투, 그리고 사이버펑크 디스토피아, 오컬트 호러, 혁명의 초현실적인 세계를 결합한 게임이다.
주요 특징
역동적인 액션 전투를 마스터하라
베고, 춤추고, 암살하라 – 닌자식 아크로바틱 기술과 Dansassination의 리듬 처형을 조합해 적을 치명적인 춤으로 유인하라.
애피니티(성향) 기반 전투 – 스타일이 힘을 결정한다.
의상은 용맹, 우울, 눈부심 같은 애피니티를 부여하며, 능력과 저항력을 변화시킨다.
특수 전투 스타일 – 검의 정밀한 공격부터 아르카눔을 활용한 파괴적인 기술까지 다양한 스킬 트리를 익혀라.
사악한 존재들과 맞서라 – 미스트 메이든(Mist Maidens), 사이버네틱 괴물, 그리고 빅터(Victor)의 장군들과 맞붙어라.

title: One More Round
description:
게임 정보
In One More Round you step into the boots of an alcoholic engineer aboard a space station orbiting a black hole. Tasked with investigating the mysteries of the blackhole, your choices set you on a time-looping adventure. Each loop reveals subtle changes in the station, your surroundings and yourself, as the black hole’s effects warp reality and time.
Features
A Time-Looping Narrative: Experience the consequences of your decisions as each loop subtly alters the station, the mission and the story.
Immersive Sci-Fi Mystery: Uncover the truth about your mission, the black hole and your past in a setting inspired by hard sci-fi concepts.
Evolving Environment: From subtle colour shifts to critical environmental changes, the space station evolves as you progress.
Gameplay
One More Round is a narrative-driven time loop game set aboard a failing space station. Players take on the role of an alcoholic astronaut grappling with personal failure as they attempt to uncover what lead to the time loop. The game combines immersive storytelling with puzzle-solving and exploration, challenging players to uncover the mysteries of the station and their character's past in each loop. Each loop offers subtle changes—such as altered asset colors or item placements—that grow more dramatic over time, reflecting the character’s increasing despair and the environment's degradation. Players must make strategic decisions, repair systems, and piece together clues to break the loop. With a focus on atmospheric tension and player-driven discovery, One More Round delivers a unique blend and narrative and mechanics in a lo-fi sci-fi setting.
With an lo-fi soundtrack consisting of over 30 original songs, and an emotional narrative, One More Round is a thought-provoking experience that explores redemption, sacrifice and the relentless pull of the unknown.
Will you break the cycle? One More Round could make all the difference.
Mature content warning
This game contains scenes of alcohol abuse and alcohol addiction.

Rich Exploration: Traverse diverse regions, from scorching deserts to hidden grottos, teeming with secret paths and hidden loot. Delve into labyrinthine dungeons filled with menacing bosses and cunning traps.
Immersive Storytelling: Interact with a lively cast of characters, each with their own stories and ambitions. Your choices shape your journey, influencing alliances and potentially altering Terradune’s fate.
Gorgeous Hand-Drawn World: Experience an eye-catching art style that blends vibrant colors with detailed environments, capturing both the whimsical and the perilous aspects of Terradune.
Seek glory, unravel the past, and carve out your legend in this captivating 2D action RPG. Will you become the hero Terradune needs—or the force that reshapes it forever?

are the main event in this Bobo world. Different companies and organizations from around the globe sponsor different competition series and award unique prizes! It will always be worth checking out each area every day and night. You wouldn't want to miss how rowdy the town gets when celebrating Flag Day!

title: Piñata Puppy World
description:
게임 정보
Piñata Puppy World is a nostalgia-driven explorative campaign game inspired by the 2000s, featuring an emotional and surreal storyline where players explore their past through the lens of a grainy VHS camera, disguised within the genre of “Mascot Horror”.

title: Hallow Maze
description:
게임 정보
Hallow Maze는 빠르고 유연한 전투 스타일을 갖춘 2.5D 메트로배니아입니다. 시각적 스타일은 손으로 그린 것이며 예술적 스타일은 어두운 고딕 판타지입니다. 당신은 생물로 변신하여 도구의 힘을 사용해 적을 처치하고, 퍼즐을 풀고, 땅 속 깊은 곳에 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내야 합니다.
게임 아트 스타일은 2-5D 세계에서 세심하게 디자인되어 손으로 그려졌습니다. 문제 해결과 전투 모두에 중요하다고 생각한 메트로배니아 장르의 최고의 메커니즘을 사용합니다.

title: Time Breaking: Dino Breach
description:
게임 정보
Time Breaking: Dino Breach는 Dino Crisis에서 영감을 받은 등각 생존 호러 게임입니다.
고전 Dino Crisis의 긴박한 생존 역학과 긴장감을 반영한 게임플레이를 통해, Time Breaking: Dino Breach는 액션, 퍼즐 해결, 그리고 치명적인 공룡들로 가득한 선사시대 정글과 밀폐된 연구 시설을 탐험하며 경험하는 순수한 서스펜스의 순간들을 제공합니다.
주요 게임 특징:
감동적이고 몰입감 넘치는 스토리를 경험하세요: R.O.P.E. 병사인 Kate Jeong이 되어, 그녀가 깊이 사랑하는 사람 Alan의 비극적인 운명을 바꾸기 위해 과거로 시간 여행을 떠납니다. 그러나 그녀의 선택은 어떤 결과를 초래할까요?
위험한 환경을 탐험하세요: 적대적인 선사시대 정글과 밀폐된 연구 시설을 탐험하며, 생존과 죽음을 가를 수 있는 자원, 무기 및 중요한 아이템을 찾아보세요.
치명적인 공룡에 맞서세요: Dino Crisis에서 영감을 받은 공룡들의 행동을 바탕으로, 위험한 공룡들과 긴장감 넘치고 공포스러운 전투를 벌이세요. 지혜를 발휘하고 제한된 탄약을 신중하게 관리하여 그들을 물리치거나 도망치세요.
퍼즐과 수수께끼를 해결하세요: 진행을 위해 퍼즐과 환경 수수께끼를 해결하고, 무기 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하며, 포악한 공룡으로부터 생존에 필요한 유용한 도구를 찾아보세요.

title: PROJECT MIX
description:
게임 정보
We will be hosting a crowdfunding campaign. Pre-Release page out, find us on Kickstarter!
Project Mix is a VR anime narrative game.
Set in the red light district of Mong Kok, you play as Rone, a young former thug starting a new beginning to try leave behind his life of crime. He unexpectedly becomes a bartender after a chance meeting with Valencia, the eccentric bar owner of Eleventh Heaven.
At first, you live by the paycheck working at Eleventh Heaven, but as you find yourself hearing a bit too much for your own good, you find yourself thrown into a deep conspiracy.

title: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor
description:
게임 정보
A JRPG about a princess knight's psychological downfall. An honorable princess knight must fight the Bloody Emperor, a ruthless usurper. But through a forced marriage to a vassal and the looming threat of a female dark lord, her ideals gradually begin to crumble...
Features
A journey of disillusionment and loss

title: Pixel Washer
description:
게임 정보
파워 세척 픽셀의 부드러운 감각으로 휴식을 취하십시오. 다양한 사랑스러운 픽셀 아트 레벨 중에서 선택하십시오. 냉담한 사운드 트랙과 만족스러운 사운드로 구역을 세우십시오.

title: Redemption of the Damned
description:
게임 정보

You are a field doctor's assistant who was heading to a distant village to help local peasants. Someone attacked your stagecoach and you wake up in a mass grave, being the only survivor. Curb your fear because you are waiting for facing incredible beasts and monsters, and you are just a human.

The brutal and dangerous world of Redemption of the Damned will not give the chance to slack off, the slightest mistake may be the last.
SURVIVE

In the first turn the enemy is dangerous not by the number. Even among people there are those who themselves want to see how the world is ablaze. Do not let evil spirits prevail over you, help the locals, but do not forget about yourself - you also need water, food and sleep. But the most important thing is not to go crazy. To do this, keep your mental health normal with the help of potions and altars.


EXPLORE
The RoD universe is much bigger than it seems. How many secrets lie in forgotten but not abandoned ruins? How many answers can you find in the dark corners of the world around you?




Find everything you need for battle and survival. Explore multi-level dungeons in search of relic items.

Go to the open world after the battles in dungeons network to replenish your resources in special hunting zones consisting of forests, swamps, fields etc. Having gained strength, return to the kingdom of darkness, because in the fight against evil it is you who are the main and only hope of the locals for survival.


Mortal danger is everywhere. Dangerous monsters, supernatural monsters with its own behavior and specific mechanics... There is no single way to deal with each of them.




Carefully study your enemy, prepare thoroughly and choose the appropriate way to kill. Melee combat, traditional and unique firearms, and, of course, specific ways of killing (cross, holy water, aspen stakes, witch's candles etc) are available to you.
And remember the most important rule - "always finish the fallen creature, without giving a chance for revenge".

title: HexLands
description:
게임 정보


영향력을 넓히고 영향력을 키우면 곧 왕이 당신의 야망을 두려워하게 될 것입니다.
사용 가능한 자원, 카드와 보너스를 효율적으로 사용하고, 덱을 맞춤화한 후, 환경에 적응하며, 절차적 퀘스트를 완료해야 합니다... 그렇지 않으면 다음 섬으로 항해를 시작할 수 있는 충분히 강한 식민지를 세울 수 없습니다!
항해를 시작하고, 현명하게 선택하세요! 어느 섬의 보너스와 생물군계가 당신의 플레이 스타일과 전략에 가장 잘 맞나요?
북쪽의 혹독한 추위, 건조한 사막 섬, 그리고 다른 역겨운 기후들을 견딜 수 있을까요?
당신의 제국은 얼마나 멀리 도달할까요?



당신의 첫 건물은 항상 시청이며, 그것이 주변의 몇몇 타일에 대한 소유권을 주장합니다.
인구를 늘리고 당신의 영토가 확장되는 것을 지켜보세요!
당신의 섬이 충분히 인구가 밀집되어 있다면, 다음 섬으로 떠날 수 있습니다!
그러나 왜 그 가치 있는 자원을 낭비하겠습니까? 인구가 많을수록 더 큰 보상을 받게 됩니다!







게임에 대한 피드백, 질문, 문제가 있으면 저에게 연락 주시기를 망설이지 마세요. 최선을 다할게요! 오, 게임이 즐거웠다면 알려주세요. 그건 정말 제 하루를 만들어줍니다! 🙂

title: Existence = !Existence;
description:
게임 정보
존재 = =! 존재; - 생존을 위해 최대한으로 올려 놓고 가능한 모든 것을 보여줘야하는 첫 번째 사람의이 액션 사수.

게임 정보 "존재 =! 존재"
- 장면 모드 : 2066 년. 지난 세기 동안 기술은 큰 발전을 이루었습니다. 세계 생산량은 90 %가 로봇 식이고, 행성은 실업, 빈곤 및 위기의 물결에 휩쓸 렸고, 인류는 인간의 삶의 지속 기간에 한계를 드러내 기 위해 더 가까워지고 있지만 지구상의 상황은 인구 중 층화를 일으켰습니다. 부자들은 자신들이 신이라고 생각하며 모든면에서 인구의 가난한 부분을 얕보고 있습니다. 당신은 인구의 낮은 계층의 권리를 방어하는 해커 그룹의 일원입니다.
- 끝이없는 모드 : 얼마나 오랫동안 적의 끝없는 맹공격을 이길 수 있습니까?
- 잊을 수없는 스타일 : 시각적 스타일 Existence =! 존재; 네온 노아 (noon noir)의 연기가 자욱한 복고풍 분위기에 당신을 담아냅니다.
- 음악 반주 : 소리 부분 존재 =! 존재; 이들은 Alef와 Wice와 같은 복고풍 네온 방향의 가장 젊은 재능입니다.

title: Project F.A.L.S.E.
description:
게임 정보
Prehistory:
Project F.A.L.S.E. is a game about an alternative world after the tragedy at a powerful energy complex as part of the experiment "Fast Atomic Leading Super Energy" in 2042. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of complete chaos and destruction of the new world, which is faced with great global problems, the solution of which depends on the fate of all mankind. Among these problems: the decline of large areas, a blow to the environment, a high mortality rate. The world's most powerful nations have joined forces and created special military units to address the very dangerous challenges on which the salvation of the world depends.
What awaits you:
You will have to play as a military agent of a secret special unit, performing tasks from the Central Headquarters. But not everything is so simple. At each level you have to be careful, because danger lurks everywhere.

destruction of enemies
silent elimination
search for secret artifacts
rescue of hostages
protection of teammates

To perform tasks you will have a wide arsenal of equipment:

improvised materials
knives and tools
pistols and revolvers
shotguns and grenade launchers
submachine guns and machine guns
bulletproof vests and helmets
additional equipment

During the levels you can find many interesting things, for example:





This 2D Shooter will definitely not leave fans of games with a tense plot and unexpected twists, interesting gameplay and various functionalities. Also, the game has links to the real world, so who likes to look for them - it's just for you. Despite the remote release of the game, add Project F.A.L.S.E. to your wish list now, so as not to miss interesting news in the future.

title: Saikin
description:
게임 정보
Unleash Your Inner Hero: Dive into the Epic Adventure of Saikin

Calling all adventurers! Saikin by Shiryu Studios is an immersive MMORPG that will ignite your thirst for exploration and epic battles. Embark on a journey where breathtaking landscapes meet a captivating storyline, leaving you yearning for more.

Become the Champion:

title: Blood Reckoning: The Eternal War

Embark on a journey in Blood Reckoning: The Eternal War, a dark fantasy MMORPG that merges the nostalgia of classic role-playing games with groundbreaking mechanics. title: Unknown Operations : The Habitus
description:
게임 정보
Unknown Operations: The Habitus
is a story-driven, single-player, first-person tactical shooter set during World War II. In the game, you take on the role of Eduard Pěnkava, a soldier and later an agent of the secret organization Habitus, fighting not only against the Nazis but also for the safety of his loved ones and higher ideals. The story combines fictional and historical characters and events to create an intense and captivating experience.
The game is developed on Unreal Engine 5, delivering high visual quality and a seamless gameplay experience. With planned updates, the game will adapt to the latest versions of this advanced engine, ensuring players have access to the best possible technological advancements.
Key Features:
Historical Inspiration: Missions are inspired by real events, such as the Battle of Czajankova Barracks or the Operation of the Three Kings. The game features accurate models of weapons and certain vehicles from World War II.
Vehicle and Static Weapon Control: Take the wheel of tanks, trucks, or cars, or operate heavy machine guns and cannons to turn the tide of battle.
Compelling Story: A narrative filled with espionage, sabotage, and moral dilemmas, told retrospectively from an interrogation room of the secret police.
Intense Gameplay: Destroy enemy bases, adapt to changing environments, and strategize on the battlefield with realistic ballistics and destructible environments.
NPC Interaction: Engage with characters through a dialogue system and uncover key information that influences the story's progression.
Advanced AI: NPCs dynamically respond to situations using the Utility AI system, adding realism to the gameplay.
Dynamic Environment: Experience changing weather, day-night cycles, and interactive environmental elements that immerse you in the war atmosphere.
Historical Authenticity:
The game emphasizes the accuracy of weapons and certain vehicles, but due to the constraints faced by a solo developer, not all building models and clothing are fully historically accurate. Nevertheless, the game strives to convey an authentic sense of the wartime conflict and its atmosphere.

title: Project OutFox
description:
게임 정보
Project OutFox is a fully extensible, cross-platform rhythm game sim engine based on StepMania, featuring 21 different modes simulating different dance, instrument, and key-based rhythm games.
Its goal is to become a cross-platform “sandbox” and “working museum” for the genre, supporting nearly 25 years worth of content. It is developed by a team of community volunteers creating a game for the fans by the fans. The aim is to be community focussed and to celebrate what rhythm games have done to the world, providing an archive for future generations of players.
It has extensive chart format support across different simulated game modes;
Dance Pad Based Modes
dance (3k, 3k double, 4k, 4k double, 6k, 6k double) .dwi, .sm, .ssc, .bms - The default game type. This game type uses four lanes in the cardinal directions (left, down, up, right). It also contains a 6-lane style, adding up-left and up-right directions, and a 3-lane style using only up-left, down, and up-right.

groove (4k, 4k double) .ssc, - The default game type with mods and gimmick support. This game type uses four lanes in the cardinal directions (left, down, up, right). It features support for extended modifiers, shaders and special effects to create whacky and exciting files to test your friends!
pump (5k, 5k double, 6k (halfdouble) .ksf, .sma, .sm, .ssc - A five-lane dance game, which uses four diagonal directions and the center rather than cardinal directions.
techno (4k, 4k double, 5k, 5k double, 8k, 8k double, 9k, 9k double) .sm, .ssc - A dance game type designed for pads with nine panels, including 4-lane (similar to dance), 5-lane (similar to pump), 8-lane (using all but the center panel), and 9-lane styles in single and double versions.
smx (3k, 3k double, 5k, 5k double) .ssc - A dance game type designed by StepRevolution using a new unique pad which uses the cardinal directions plus middle (left, down, up, right and centre).
ds3ddx (4k + 4 sensor, 5k + 5 sensor) .ssc - A dance game whose format is common among Chinese arcade dance games, which uses four diagonal foot panels, and four hand sensors around the pad in the cardinal directions. The game also supports the 5k variant that allows full interoperability with the different revisions of arcade versions.

title: Industrix
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Industrix, the ultimate factory building game in a stunning low poly 3D environment. In this game, you'll embark on a journey to build the biggest and most efficient production lines ever seen, all while exploring different islands and unlocking new resources and technologies.

At the start of the game, you'll be dropped off on a deserted island with nothing but your wits and a few basic resources. From there, you'll need to gather materials, refine them, and craft them into usable components for your factories. The more you produce, the more resources you'll unlock, allowing you to expand your production capabilities and create even more advanced products.

But it's not just about making things; you'll also need to manage your resources wisely, optimizing your factories for maximum efficiency and productivity. You'll need to balance your production rates with your energy consumption, ensuring that you're not wasting valuable resources on unnecessary processes. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter challenges and obstacles that will test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

But it's not all work and no play in Industrix. Along the way, you'll encounter other companies that are also vying for dominance in the market. You need to compete with them head-on, using your superior production skills to outmaneuver and outproduce them.

As you grow your production capabilities, you'll unlock new islands to explore, each with its own unique resources and challenges. You'll need to adapt your production strategies to each new environment, experimenting with new technologies and production methods to stay ahead of the competition.

Industrix is the ultimate factory building game, offering endless possibilities for creativity, strategy, and exploration. With stunning low poly graphics, challenging gameplay, and a vast world to explore, this game is sure to keep you engaged for hours on end. So what are you waiting for? Start building your empire today!

title: Echoes of the Forgotten
description:
게임 정보


Recognized for his unparalleled skills in investigating the paranormal, Alex answered Karlheinz Asylum's distress call, sensing it would be a challenging case. The lone path out was imprisoned beneath the terrifying depths of the darkness, buried there. Alex searched the deserted tunnels for all keys to escape. The urge to unravel the asylum's mysteries grew with each step deeper into its enigmatic shadows. The detective followed his gut and moved through physical tension to reveal the secrets that lay beneath.

With the startling realization that the only way to find the elusive keys to liberty was to delve deeper into the darkness, Alex's struggle to escape the asylum's control became more and more passionate as the dreadful reality set in.

Dive into a visually stunning environment, heightened by a bone-chilling soundtrack that intensifies the sense of dread and suspense with every step.
Your sanity is your lifeline. As you search for the keys to escape, remember that the darkness can consume you, leading to a grisly demise.

The Bucketlist Tourist is a thrilling multiplayer party game that takes photographic challenges to a new level.

In this exciting game, players compete for the best ratings on their photos. Each participant has their own remote shutter and a limited number of shots to showcase their best work.

Inspired by Europe's famous tourist attractions, the Bucketlist challenges lead players to vibrant, colorful locations. Together, they explore these places and take on various tasks.

At the end of each round, the photos are evaluated based on specific criteria, with the player who has the most creative and compelling snapshots emerging as the winner!

title: Inside Utopia
description:
게임 정보

This is a Visual Novel about exploration, coming of age and moral dilemmas.

You play as Didi, a brave young girl who must quickly overcome her innocence and question her principles in order to infiltrate Utopia and snatch the legendary Gold Stone back into her home land, or else the incompetent Queen will execute her mother, and the Kingdom will fall into collapse due to her negligence.

Didi must explore and befriend the kind people in Utopia in order to gain their trust, become one of them, and explore the island until discovering the location of the elusive Gold Stone and facing the ultimate dilemma: snatch it and save her mother and Kingdom, but let Utopia fall into disgrace? Or sacrifice her mother for the greater good of a seemingly perfect and kind society? Or...?

This is a non-violent and relaxing game, and while you progress in the main storyline, it will also invite you to self-reflect about in which type of society you would like to live into, as you learn the very peculiar ways in which the utopians have built their own.

총알을 맞아 플레이 시간을 얻기
화면 상단에 큰 카운트다운이 있고, 화면에는 피해야 하지 않는 많은 총알들이 나타납니다. 같은 색 상태에서 총알을 맞으면 현재 플레이에서 사용할 수 있는 시간을 얻을 수 있습니다. 충분한 시간을 얻지 못하거나 잘 사용하지 않으면 게임 오버가 되어 처음부터 다시 시작해야 합니다.

One night, your normal life is shattered when a friend leads you into the fog-covered woods, revealing a long-buried darkness. title: Site 17
description:
게임 정보
Site 17 is an indie scifi-horror game developed by Fallen Crown Games.

The Gameplay
Site 17's gameplay is relatively simple. You are trapped alone in a room. You cannot run, and you cannot fight. You can view the cameras, electrify the corridors, and close the doors. You must survive from 12:00am to 6:00am for the entirety of your mandatory minimum employment period, while avoiding the robotic worker drones trying to reach your office.

The Story
In the year 2047, 90% of the workforce across the entirety of the I.R.C is automated. Robotic drones roam the corridors of ships and stations across the cosmos, performing their tasks without complaint, guided by an interconnected network of drones linked by the central computer (The Meshnet). Under I.R.C law, 10% of the workforce must consist of organic workers. With such little importance placed on the safety of disposable drones, the facility is poorly maintained. Unfortunately for you, this means that getting drafted into employment as the Facility Operations Manager is the worst thing that can possibly happen to you.

On your first day, the facility's central computer goes offline. The bots take over regulation of the Meshnet using their internal systems, but as fate (or the accountants) would have it, their data drives do not contain any copies of the Security Database. Your employee ID badge is flagged as invalid, and you are marked for experimentation as a trespasser on I.R.C. property.

With the bots trying to kill you and the facility in lockdown mode, you must survive until the end of your shift, when the central computer resets.

title: Owl Force
description:
게임 정보




Owl Force와 함께 서사적인 여정에 나서십시오. 여기서 당신은 영웅적인 부엉이들의 정예 팀을 이끌고 사악한 Darktail Order와 싸웁니다. 생명이 넘치는 우주를 탐험하고, 활기찬 행성에서 강력한 적에 이르기까지 다양한 경험을 하게 됩니다. 여정을 따라 고대 빛의 조각들의 비밀을 풀어 당신의 우주선과 능력을 향상시키십시오. 각 대결은 당신의 전투 기술뿐만 아니라 당신의 힘과 은하계의 미묘한 균형의 신비에 대해 더 깊이 이해할 수 있는 기회를 제공합니다.

특징

무한한 오픈 월드: 새로운 별계, 숨겨진 비밀, 그리고 숨막히는 우주 현상이 가득한 광활한 우주를 횡단하면서 우주선을 조종하십시오.
동적 전투 시스템: 적들이 당신의 움직임에 맞서 진화함에 따라 전술을 적응시키며 격렬한 공중전을 벌입니다.
독특한 모험과 도전을 약속하는 동적 이벤트를 통해 은하계의 운명을 좌우하십시오.
모든 선택이 중대한 결과를 초래하는 시스템에서 우주선과 능력을 신중하게 업그레이드하십시오.
당신의 여정에 영향을 주고 이야기를 더 깊게 만들어 줄 다양한 캐릭터들과 상호작용하십시오.
밀도 높은 소행성 벨트에서 에테리얼한 성운의 아름다움에 이르기까지 놀라운 환경을 탐험하십시오.
음모, 배신, 그리고 구원을 추구하는 이야기에 빠져 은하계 붕괴를 막기 위해 노력하십시오.








추가 정보, 홍보 자료, 업데이트를 원하시면 저희 공식 웹사이트를 방문하거나 언론팀에 직접 연락하십시오.

title: Galaversal Supremacy
description:

Choose your own adventure in this open-world humanity expansion space simulation.
Travel beyond the constellations to new frontiers. Explore, collect resources, supply the expansion efforts, or go battle it out spaceshooter style. Do we seek Galaversal Supremacy or peace? You decide !


Our quest is to expand humanity into deep space, but the pesky aliens see us as a viral entity that needs to be exterminated from existence.
Join a shared game experience where your actions contribute to humanity's survival in deep space.

Humanity goes viral
It's official.. our species has been declared a viral entity, and as such, must be exterminated.
The fight for our survival is real.
We must show strength and courage, and build up our infrastructure and defence as a deterent against those who oppose us.

Choose your own destiny.
You have the freedom to choose how to contribute to our goal, and can switch it up anytime you want.

For the first time in history, humanity has come together under one alliance.
The United Earth Space Alliance exists to implement humanity's expansion into the frontiers of space beyond our solar system.
The alliance consists of many factions that have their own objectives and quest systems.
Whether it be colonization, commerce, homeguard, or combat at the battlefront, the factions have quests to engage in.

Private Enterprise.
This is an optional deeper level of gameplay where you can construct your own supply chains and aid the factions in our ultimate quest of expansion and survival.

The factions are recruiting.
Join today, and help secure humanity's future.

presented in detailed pixel art graphics. The game offers a mix of familiar gameplay and fresh ideas to keep things interesting.
