title: Timberquest
description:
게임 정보
In this game, we define Survival as the state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in difficult circumstances. Survival can be threatened by various factors such as environmental factors, starvation, dehydration, monsters/animals, psychological distress, diseases, or lack of sleep. Adventure, on the other hand, involves taking risks, covering distances, encountering animals/monsters, and experiencing a story that includes loss, gain, and new visual things.

As you embark on this journey, you will meet Luna, Ray, Davo, Solara, Ember, and Orion, who all met in a tavern and decided to embark on an adventure together. They boarded a ship and set sail towards a new continent, but their journey was cut short when their ship exploded due to a fire caused by the wares they were carrying. They ended up shipwrecked on the shores of the new, wild continent. Despite the setback, they were excited to explore the new land and discover what it had to offer.

Our game is an RPG with a heavy focus on cooperative play, but it can also be enjoyed as a single-player experience. Unlike other "survival" games, our game is more equipment-driven, giving players greater control over their survival strategies. The combat system is inspired by MOBAs, making for a more engaging and challenging experience. However, instead of PvP elements, our game's combat system is designed entirely for PvE. Our game features stat-driven abilities, adding a layer of complexity to the gameplay and allowing players to customize their characters to suit their preferred playstyle.

Are you ready to embark on this adventure and survive the untamed wilderness? Get ready to join Luna, Ray, Davo, Solara, Ember, and Orion and explore the new continent in our exciting RPG game!

title: BLEAK Remastered
description:
게임 정보
In the wake of his sister Asha's kidnapping, Bleak is thrust into the perilous world of Pinnacle. With his loyal surveyor bot, Glitch, by his side, he faces hostile factions, mysterious landscapes, and hidden dangers. Together, they uncover ancient secrets and confront their own fears, all in a quest to rescue Asha. As they journey deeper, Bleak discovers inner strength and forges an unbreakable bond with Glitch. In a final showdown against evil forces, they must overcome adversity to reunite with Asha and confront the darkness lurking within Pinnacle. Do you dare?

Featuring
- 40+ Platforming levels (Multiple ways of beating levels that change the path you take)
- Competitive Time Trial Online Leaderboards
- 3 playable characters with unique mechanics
- Massive lore that spans thousands of years across seven original races
- Strong focus on single-player narrative story telling
- 35+ original songs

BLEAK Remastered is a visually stunning and technically enhanced version of the original game "BLEAK: Welcome to Glimmer", boasting brand new artwork and a revamped game engine. Set in the dystopian world of Glimmer, players will find themselves immersed in a dark and atmospheric adventure unlike any other.

The remastered version features meticulously crafted artwork, with updated graphics that breathe new life into the game's environments, characters, and animations. From the haunting landscapes of Glimmer's desolate urban sprawls to the intricate details of its futuristic technology, every aspect of the game's visuals has been reimagined to deliver a truly immersive experience.

In addition to the visual overhaul, the remastered edition also introduces improvements to the game's engine, enhancing performance, stability, and overall gameplay mechanics. Players can expect smoother controls, optimized performance on a variety of platforms, and a more seamless gaming experience from start to finish.

title: Lyara
description:
게임 정보

A curious little girl finds herself lost in an unknown world, looking for answers and trying to understand what is going on, and deal with her on emotions as well. Lyara begins her journey in this new world, making new friendships along the way, and facing numerous challenges forcing her to grow up and the player to give a pause to thought.
Join this adventure to surpass challenges and learn with the kid.




Lyara is a challenging 2D platform game in pixel art including multiple mechanics according to the world, demanding player's agility and precision, as well as puzzle resolution.
You will find a great challenge in this crazy adventure! Like the classics platform games, Lyara will make the player experience a rich narrative with fun and enjoyable moments.




New enviroments and mechanics each world demands new player's skills.
You wont rest until every inch of this universe is explored!




Discover multiple worlds with unique characteristics that will develop the character.




During this journey, find out more about Lyara`s past, search for answers and meet new characters that will help you understand more about this world.



Every new friendship along the way make part of protagonist's life in a different way, helping her to grow up.



Explore this great universe with an original soundtrack that will be with you along the way.


Look for collectables during the adventure that will tell more about the story and level up the challenge!

title: Lichgate: Tower Wars

Alpha access
Join our Discord server to follow updates and for access to closed alpha tests.
Summon enemies to attack
Instead of fixed waves like in other tower defenses, you choose the enemies that will siege your opponent's base! Outwit the other players by choosing when to summon units that bolster your economy for a late game win and when to pressure their defenses with units with special abilities and attacks.
Customize your summons
Build your own loadouts of units to summon in battle to fit your play style and overthrow your opponent.

title: Hero Chest
description:
게임 정보
An Unexpected Hero!
In Hero Chest, you are the unexpected hero: a tired chest, constantly looted by adventurers and heroes!
Get ready for an action-packed and strategic adventure in a world where you, a humble chest, decide to turn the tables against the invaders.
Explore challenging dungeons, use special cards to chart your path, and recruit powerful monsters to form an unbeatable party.
Adventure with humor!

title: Jurassic Lab: Dinosarium DNA
description:
게임 정보
In the game, you will become a researcher, who has a unique opportunity to recreate the Jurassic period creatures by assembling dinosaur's skeletons from bones found during the excavation in an advanced technological laboratory. With the help of future technologies and artificial intelligence, having a skeleton and DNA, we start recreating the long-extinct creatures that inhabited the Earth.

At the start, you will find yourselves in a sci-fi laboratory with a bone collection of 7 dinosaurs.
Having collected a complete dinosaur skeleton, we start the processes of DNA synchronization with the collected material, adapting the original DNA to the new realities on the planet.

Our complex has specially created landscapes for the necessary habitat for each species of dinosaur.

After the successful completion of the dinosaur resurrection, you will go to the recreated habitat where a living dinosaur is already waiting for you.
Travel to each location is carried out with the help of a roller coaster. When you get to the locations, you will see with your own eyes each dinosaur in a natural environment adapted to the conditions of the planet at this time.

KEY FEATURES:
PUZZLE: Collect the skeleton of a dinosaur with our own hands.
ROLLER COASTER: Travel on a dynamic roller coaster through cave tunnels to dinosaur locations.
INTERACTIVE WITH DINOSAURS: Meet and interact with living dinosaurs.

title: NAME OF THE WILL

Welcome to HOPE, where The Benevolent Father leads your joyful cult.
Get ready for a story-rich daylight horror adventure in NAME OF THE WILL!
In NAME OF THE WILL:
A 4-hour descent into a hand-drawn Asian euphoric cult
Befriend your neighbors by day. At night, sneak through their secrets before they catch you
Hack the cult system by solving puzzles and mini games
Fear of peer pressure, interrogations and eerie rules you must obey
Refusing can be defiance: the only true way out is to forge your own path
Jump between past and present to reshape both timelines
3 Unique endings + 1 hidden ending
Electronic music created by award-winning composer

Fight against the most dangerous aces of the World War 1
Unlock and upgrade authentic warplanes to gain an edge in the air



Engage a variety of air and ground enemies

Fight bosses in epic battles
Equip your machine with the optimal weapons for the given situation
Perform maneuvers to outsmart enemies

title: Death Ring
description:
게임 정보
Death Ring is a casual action roguelike in which you will have to force your way through hordes of undead in search of the human world’s main artefact.
Numerous scenarios of each character’s development based on random dropping items will make your runs unique.
Casual mechanics
You control only the movement of the character and the choice of weapons.
The fire is carried out automatically.
Collect coins and crystals dropped from opponents.
Roguelike mechanics
With each character level up, you need to choose one of three randomly dropped items.
There are over a hundred unique items in the game.
Luck and your choice will allow you to create unique builds.
History of the game development
The Death Ring was meant to be the third game in a series of experimental shoot 'em up games, after Bloody Walls and DED. The game prototype was developed back in 2017. In the course of testing various elements of the game mechanics I failed to create a game that would be interesting and captivating, which led to the project suspension.
After the popular Vampire Survivors game was released, I finally realized in what way Death Ring should be modified, so roguelike elements were introduced and the fire control option was eliminated.
Five years have passed since then, and the game is finally going to enter its early access phase.

title: Vie: Try Again
description:
게임 정보
When her evil brother takes over her temples in a ploy to rise to greater power, the Moon Goddess-- Vie-- enlists the help of a lowly town guardsman named Cut in order to take back her territory, stop her brother, and save the world.
Join Cut As He:
- Dies repeatedly to monsters twice (or even half) his size.
- Builds a unique book of spells with the Goddess's divine power.
- Deals with narcissistic, condescending deities guarding the stolen temples.
- Upgrades his stats and spells while fighting towards the next boss!
- Gets tired of dying repeatedly.
- Tries again.
Features Include:
- Deck-building your personal spell book.
- Randomly generated maps and routes on each run, and the push to do it all over again when you fail.
- Breathtaking pixel art.
- An original, adaptive soundtrack consisting of tracks that change to fit the gameplay
- A story about saving the world, and yourself.
NOW WITH 50% FEWER SELF-INSERT CHARACTERS!!

title: Killbot General
description:
게임 정보
A concentrate of tactical decisions. No need to spend 30 minutes setting up in the beginning, or an hour at the end cleaning up the map. Get your strategy fix with satisfying 5-minute battles that focus on tactical decisions, not micromanagement or actions per minute.
Your personality and choices matter! Discover the unique, irreverent universe of the Killbots as you choose your own path in the dynamic branching storylines, where your choices as well as your successes affect the outcome.
Even bring one or two friends and forge the unique story of your alliance together!
Like pieces on a chess board, gameplay is accessible (and controller-friendly!) yet deep, involving light resource management, multiple unit types, strategic strikes and terrain evaluation. Speaking of which...
In Killbot General, the high ground (and other terrain features) matters. This means every procedural map presents a unique challenge for you to ponder and adapt to.
Fight for (and against!) any faction you wish to create! Create everything starting from the name, leader, what it's fighting for and its motto; even import your own PNG image and put what you want on the flag.

title: Nether Spirits: Beyond the Gate
description:
게임 정보
Death is not the end. But the Nether may be yours.
You have died. Your soul, battered, bruised and shattered into pieces, awakes in the Nether, a vast land consumed and transformed by sin and inhabited by spirits and monsters alike. Your only solace: the beam of blue light right in the center of the Nether, said to make whoever reaches it whole again. To make it, you’ll have to build a powerful deck, fight, explore, outwit and barter - and piece yourself together bit by bit.
New strategic depths
Plan ahead with the timeline, a unique concept in the deckbuilding genre. Queue your cards to create new combinations, unleash a rapid onslaught of attacks all at once, or modify cards you’ve already placed in the timeline.
Change your active sin as you please, feed the different aspects of your soul and experiment with distinct play styles. Do you keep yourself in balance or will you let one sin dwarf all others? Reign with Pride, outwit with Envy, conquer with Wrath, devour with Gluttony - the possibilities are endless.
Team up with a friend or stranger to support each other and increase your chance of victory, or challenge other players to a duel, testing the full potential of your deck. Play in PvE, co-op, 1v1 or 2v2 PvP mode - anytime, anywhere.
Travel the vast expanse of the Nether and discover its dark history. Explore age-old ruins in search of lore and treasure, meet compelling characters and help them on their way, or venture into hostile forests thick with fog and mystery - there is no wrong path, only your own.

title: The Electric Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Sharp gameplay with a chilling mystery on the side. This action-packed adventure will have you on the edge of your seat as you embark on an epic journey across the barren wasteland of a large city in an undisclosed location.

Explore and find your way to the source of the desolation.
Battle a variety of powerful enemies.
Make use of your many special abilities in our tight, action-packed combat system.
Rewarding gameplay.
Rich story.

Permadeath
Die once and it's over...

Combat
Partake in fast-paced, cinematic, and exciting combat. From three hit combos to clashes you will feel like a force to be reckoned with.

Highly animation-based combat that allows you to choose how you would like to dispatch your foes, either normally destroying them, or by triggering a killing blow and taking them down instantly.



Every time you hit an enemy it causes damage to your sword. This damage can be repaired by temporarily retreating, however, if you chose to persist then you may risk breaking your sword, rendering you defenseless.

Fight like your life depends on it, and remember, everything is your enemy.

title: Evard The Hermit: Through Fears

Rich story
Evard has the ability to absorb the fears of other people, but this does not happen without his own psyche being affected — his own mind gets filled with fears and phobias, sowing endless anxiety and crowding out memories.
After escaping from prison, Evard will have to:
locate various sources of fear, face them head on, and overcome a range of phobias.
be led by flashbacks that allow him to discover the secret of his origins.
explore the post-war medieval world and encounter different situations and people.
Game mechanics
sword fighting
stealth
balance
World
Open up the map and immerse yourself! Explore a world set in the Middle Ages of Northern Europe.

title: Catacombs Of The Yokai

After finishing a late shift at work you find a mysterious amulet that was dropped on the ground.





As you go to return it to the woman that dropped it, you encounter a strange doorway that you haven't seen before. Entering the door leads you into an unnerving nightmare realm.



On your way through the depths you will encounter various enemies (many inspired from Japanese/Taiwanese urban legends and myths) that must be tricked, conversed with or eluded in sometimes unconventional ways.



Can you survive and return the amulet banishing this portal forever?

title: Super Cucumber
description:
게임 정보
Cucumber is the greatest Aardvark Superhero who has ever lived, and when a series of old enemies and new adversaries attempt to take over the world using the powers of magic, science and capitalism, it's up to him to climb to the top of six elaborate towers and defeat the forces of evil.
Complete dozens of increasingly difficult platforming levels and overcome a series of unique boss battles. After your initial playthrough, perfect your path through each world on hardcore mode and keep an eye out for secrets that may become accessible as Cucumber gains exciting new abilities!
Features:
Combo system and abilities Inspired by fighting games and 16-bit classics.
Over 100 levels purposefully designed to build your skills, then push them to the limit.
New secrets and challenges await after your first playthrough!
Hand-drawn 2D art and cute lighthearted characters.
Full controller and native Steam Deck support.

title: Kosmocean - The Endless Sea
description:
게임 정보


Kosmocean, a planet covered by water, were human survive on tiny islands, and factions lay spread across the sea. Veredis, that bordered on a pastoral lands, Utopia with its ancient steel Submarines, Noun Cult and its Firetop Mountain.

You are Ikki, a young boy living on a small island with his intrepid grandfather who taught him everything he knows. Together they built Bathys, a pocket submarine, using recyled material, flotsom and jetsom.




After a catastrophe with an unknown cause, our heros, Ikki and his grandfather are separated. All that is left is the incomplete logbook.

Through the game puzzles, bullet-hell sequences, and skill-based challenges, will reveal the lost scattered pages of the journal. Ikki will be plunged miles and miles into the depths where the sun never shines. His journey will take him to the blue Abyss of uncharted waters of the Pole all the way back to their own origins and onward to the revelation of his grandfather's closely guarded secret.
Where the ocean seems to have no bottom, a new world beneath the sea may hold the key to the survival of humanity...

You will discover a detailed water world brought to life with hand-drawn animated graphics and immersive sound design.

title: Enfilade

If there are not enough players there is bot support.
Level up and unlock new weapons.

There are 4 game modes -- Free For All, Team Death Match, Domination, Gun Game

title: Sligga Trigger
description:
게임 정보
Sligga Trigger is an arcade twin-stick shooter with a one-of-a-kind style and unique over-the-shoulder perspective. Every millisecond counts in this white-knuckle, red-hot, balls-to-the-walls action game.
Demo Features
18 screens across 2 stages
5 bosses
16+ enemy types
Hi Score Support
Long-Term Features
Every stage has a branching path
Co-op gameplay
Story Mode
Boss Rush Mode
RNG / Roguelike Mode

title: Closer Than You Know
description:
게임 정보

Closer Than You Know (CTYK) is a cozy, fresh take on the familiar point-and-click adventure games. Packed with story and puzzles, CTYK is a great introduction to point-and-clicks while also being fun for fans of nostalgic point-and-click adventure games.

Young Sam has a spark of creativity burning inside her, but Granican law has deemed any such talents “dangerous” and “a threat to the Granican way of life.” While imprisoned for the crime of “invention” Sam breaks free and discovers the seed of an ancient magic that starts her on a quest to Earth where--with the help of a friendly Praying Mantis--she collects fragments of Hope to restore life to her home planet.




A young girl with the spark of hope! Headstrong, clever, and a little too curious for her own good, Sam is the hero of our story!

Behind every great hero is a great sidekick. Thoughtful, constructive, and kind, Mantis is a whole lot of wisdom in a bug-size package!

The mysterious former King of Granica, who after vanishing without a trace, has seemingly left his magic all over the world...


See the wants and needs of those around you. Fulfill their wishes and gather Hope to take back home!



From the lush tropical rainforest to the frigid arctic to an actual ant farm, your adventures will take you places you never dreamed!



Strangers are just friends you haven't met, and in CTYK you will make friends of everything from a bravely insecure capybara to an eccentric old scientist with an unusual power.

title: Autumn with the Shiba Inu
description:
게임 정보

Freelance hacker Quei-Li is given a new job: uncover information from a secret government network about a high-profile corruption case. While she typically avoids high-risk jobs like this, her curiosity about the secret network and her wish to bring on positive change to Shiba Island convinces her to accept.

The job leads to Quei-Li bluffing her way into the ARI government as an undercover programmer. She builds up a rapport with her coworkers while seeking the information her client needs. The more she digs around, the more secrets Quei-Li discovers, leading her to question her own existence.



Choose wisely - help Quei-Li navigate her undercover job. Will she succeed in retrieving the classified data?
Multiple endings - what seems like a good outcome might cause someone else to suffer. Your choices impact the endings!
Original character artwork - Alicia's dog illustrations make the inhabitants of Shiba Inu Island come to life.
Hacking mini-game - step into Quei-Li's role with a brain-twisting hacking mini-game! (Mini-games are skippable)
Accessibility options - tune your experience and comfort while enjoying the game. 4k resolution and full HD resolution toggles.

Autumn with the Shiba Inu is set in the same universe as the first game in the Shiba Inu series, A Summer with the Shiba Inu. "Autumn" is a standalone story, so reading "Summer" is not required to enjoy Autumn with the Shiba Inu!

title: Squadron
description:
게임 정보
Squadron immerses you in a dark and mysterious universe where a multitude of questions can hide. It's up to you to find the answers to the puzzles that will arise, but be careful you will have to travel beyond the limits of the software, which knows a Redit post, or even a steam account can hide answers. Arm yourself with a web browser and a good coffee, it's a safe bet that you will experience a more than eventful journey through this private military network.

You will be the hero of a story that unfolds around you in YOUR world who may know that this game is in fact very real.

title: MR.E
description:
게임 정보
You are in a room full of boxes. After calibrating your optics, you see a door in front of you. There are some markers on the walls that seem familiar.

These are your first thoughts when you have enough wits. In MR.E, you’ll try to make sense of your surroundings, your identity, and what happened to the spaceship you are on by beating many obstacles. Kopernik, mainly a research ship, is on a supply run to bring medical resources and rations to the colonists on Titan.



Somewhere on the journey, the ship’s AI had gone rogue. It seems this AI knows a great deal about you, and what makes matters worse is that it knows there is someone dear to you among the surviving crew members. You’re clearly at a disadvantage but have nowhere else to go but keep pressing.
Are you up to the following challenges?

Monitor your power supply and make efficient moves to beat obstacles.
Watch out for the environment, and even better; use it to your advantage.
Help the surviving crew members because the ship is working against them.
Discover your true identity and how you’ve got to this point.

title: Goblin's Journey
description:
게임 정보
Goblin's Journey is a humorous point & click adventure game with a stupid plot and even more idiotic characters.
You play as a greedy bastard goblin named Alastar. You are about to save you king's life - in exchange for gold of course!
An adventure full of gold, mischief and innapropriate content.

Explore the vast country of Goblin Lands in this semi-open world adventure, visit also Human Lands (ew!) and if you are lucky enough you get to see the beauties of hell as well!

Make money by doing all kinds of (il)legal stuff, and then use the money to buy some cool items for you including collectible cards and other keepsakes! If you are lucky enough you can even buy your own apartment.

Make sure all your kids are asleep before you start playing!

title: Unwound
description:
게임 정보
An island made of candy sounds like paradise – but for the residents of Sarkara, fabled to be the home of the legendary Serenity Sweet, devastating earthquakes are threatening the resident’s idyllic way of life! 
As a representative of the Office of Harmonious and Normal Operations (“O.H.N.O.”), you’ve been sent to help, but when a boat crash leaves you as a limbless ball of yarn, you’ll have to pull yourself together – or build yourself up even stronger – to uncover the mysteries of Sarkara its eccentric residents.
Uncover what’s threatening the island – and all of reality as we know it – in this rollicking yarn, a 3D narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency. 
~ ~ Dress up in found objects. Reinvent yourself! ~ ~ 
Any item, from a doll’s lost arm to a floaty feather, can change how you move and talk and play.

title: MOKI - The Escape
description:
게임 정보
Moki wakes up in a strange environment. The only memory: their own name. A peaceful world... or is it?! Join Moki in a challenging 2.5D jump & run platformer with many puzzles. Meet lovable and sometimes oddball characters and experience a unique and emotional story.
"Streak"
Moki has a very special ability: "streaking" (short-range teleportation). Even through organic matter like wood or plants, Moki can "streak" and thus solve puzzles and enter places that other beings are hardly able to reach.
Explore
Explore a diverse game world and find out what this seemingly peaceful environment is really all about. Is there perhaps more behind the visible facade? Why are you here in the first place? Why do you only remember your own name "Moki" and who the hell are all these other strange creatures you meet on your journey? Explore and find out!
Collect
Find treasures, items and boosters in the game world. Some of them will help you progress, others will give you special abilities, and still others will just make you happy when you find them.
Push through
Moki doesn't have strong muscles and doesn't like to hurt anyone. But sometimes you'll get into difficult situations. Help Moki overcome it. There are often puzzles to solve but also one or another adversary that might stand in Moki's way.
Info about the development
MOKI - The Escape is the first game development of studio VAMPIRE - Digital Media (Software House Markus Hermann). Only two people are involved in the project. An indispensable part of the atmosphere of MOKI - The Escape is the fantastic music produced by Jakob Wiersch, the artist who exclusively composes and creates the soundtrack for the game.

title: Deaded
description:
게임 정보
DEADED Is a Third Person Survival game where you scavenge, build, survive and thrive through the zombie infested post apocalyptic world. With heavy emphasis on physics and ragdoll - block, push and move objects to manipulate zombies to gain an advantage against them.

Physics and Ragdoll
DEADED aims to create an environment in which realistic zombies interact with. Block door ways with couches, barricade doors with wood and have the ability to push zombies over. These zombies will attack you head on, ignoring objects in their way so use it to your advantage.



Save Survivors
Save survivros you find throughout the city and assign them jobs at your base to produce valuable resources. Make them cut wood, scavenge scrap piles or set them as a security gaurd to help defend against the undead.




Scavenge the city for valuable loots and rummage through housese to find materials to help you and your community survive.




Shoot, slice and stomp your way through the infected with a variety of weapons such as the machete and pistol, damage any zombies limb enough and it will pop off!




With the ever changing fog city, discover a way to navigate through it without getting lost. As with each entry something always changes, and its up to you to find out why and how to solve a route of safety through the city.

title: 5 Star Fishy
description:
게임 정보
One angry fishy. One cruel world. One nuclear missile.

Welcome to the Zakaria Trench!
Beneath a small bay between two islands lies a deep trench with sunken cities, military bases, submerged nuclear silos, deep wilds, and many other fun tourist spots for the family. There are 9 areas total, so I hope you have a map, because you are going to need it.


Make Them All Pay
Armed with only your teeth, a hunger for vengeance, and whatever you find along the way, you must swim to the bottom of the trench to reach the sunken nuclear missile. You are not alone, however, so you might as well stir up as much mayhem as possible along the way.



No matter how big or fierce you foes are, they will bleed out for the crimes commited against you. You will be heard. And they will be dead.



Find arcade minigames, pets, abilities, secrets, characters, and more!

title: Forum Mortuorum
description:
게임 정보
Sports management with a twist: your athletes can die! Recruit a team. Train and equip them. Pick challenging but winnable matches to maximize your profit and team development. And choose when to sideline your best for a big upcoming match!
‘Hands-off’ arena matches: watch from the stands as your team battles it out through a diverse variety of Mediterranean arenas
Classless character development: mix and match training, perks, and equipment drive your gladiators’ style and specialties
Much more on the way: Until this is the best gladiator management game out there, I will be adding features, content, and polish. Forum Mortuorum accepts no equal! Wishlist today to follow the journey

title: Sol Uknight
description:
게임 정보
The game is a 3D-RPG, Puzzle, Adventure. The story is centered around two main protagonist, from opposite sides of their universe connected through time. The game takes us on an adventure through action based questing and storytelling to save themselves and each other in the ultimate struggle to acquire the Crown of Knight to bring balance back to the realm.
I will want to edit this description in the future, with some imagery and map icons of the over story narrative as to to allude to story narrative side of the game, which has a greater game Lore concept, and world building narratives like LOTR or other fantasy novels.

title: Telluria: Forebodings
description:
게임 정보
Long, long ago on a distant plane of existence, Adhar the Supreme God, sat alone in the primordial void.
Being able to shape matter and energy as he pleased, tired of floating alone in the depths of time, he decided to create the Eternal Flame which, thrown into the vortex of chaos, created a new world, Telluria, and a Divine Being, Teine, for its sustenance.
In subsequent eras Teine, considered Supreme God and venerated as such, led a rebellion against Adhar for dominion over Telluria.
Adhar's anger was terrible. He hurled his power over the world, sending fire from the sky, cataclysms, earthquakes.
All life was extinguished, cities and settlements razed. Earth and grass covered everything.
After a long time, life began to spring anew, but time and space were now torn apart.
Teine herself was punished. Adhar divided her into two halves, Vehra demigoddess of order and Celtia demigoddess of chaos, imprisoning them as soon as they were created on a celestial island adrift in the astral plane.

title: Project Athenia
description:
게임 정보
Project Athenia is a multiplayer first-person shooter in which you can play against your friends in several game modes on many different maps.
Features
Multiplayer Servers
3 Game Modes
3 Maps
A beautiful & user-friendly UI
AI
Credits
Programming: paasmoo

title: Evie: The Echo Condition
description:
게임 정보
Battle for your companion's survival as you explore a mysterious, vibrant, and crumbling world full of dangers and secrets to discover. Evie is an action-adventure game with an HD-2D visual style that plays out like a modernized version of SNES and Genesis classics.

UNBREAKABLE BOND

With Evie's help, her friend battles their way back from serious illness as the two bond throughout an epic adventure.

FIND YOUR OWN PATH

Exploration is rewarded and certain magical abilities will make specific encounters easier, while other abilities may be the key to unlocking a secret area.

FACE YOUR FEAR

A fluid combat system allows players to use magic, dash behind enemies, drop traps, block, parry, and deflect projectiles. Play your way and focus on skills and abilities that match your play style.

HD-2D visuals merge hand drawn sprites into a 3D world in a real time action-adventure game.
Lots of secret areas to discover, making way for helpful items on your journey.
Uncover a diverse set of new magical abilities.
Overcome a formidable boss at each distinctive biome to earn new abilities.

title: Mearcair/System Pulse - Prologue
description:
게임 정보
짜릿한 액션으로 가득한 총알 천국, 포지셔닝과 기술 구축에 도전하는 시스템 펄스에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 무자비한 로봇 드론 군단을 거느린 호스트 펄스가 운영하는 게임 쇼에 참가해 실력을 겨뤄보세요. 음악의 비트에 따라 플레이어를 전멸시키려는 로봇 무리의 움직임과 공격이 결정되는 박동하는 경기장을 누비며 혼돈의 교향곡에 빠져보세요.
프롤로그 버전은 정식 게임의 콘텐츠가 제한된 무료 버전입니다.
Steam 클라우드 동기화는 프롤로그의 저장 데이터를 정식 게임으로 옮깁니다. 정식 출시를 기대해 주세요.
💥 리듬에 맞춘 대혼란

시스템 펄스에서 음악은 단순한 반주가 아니라 게임의 생명선입니다. 비트에 맞춰 로봇이 움직이고 공격하는 아드레날린이 솟구치는 경험을 준비하세요. 리듬에 맞춰 동작을 조정하지 않으면 어떤 파멸에 직면하게 됩니다. 긴장을 늦추지 말고 음악에 귀를 기울이며 모든 움직임을 음악에 맡기세요.
💥 강렬한 총알 천국

다양하고 역동적인 경기장에서 로봇 적 무리에 맞서 심장을 두근거리게 하는 전투를 벌이세요. 강력한 무기로 무장하고 반사 신경과 정확성을 최대한 발휘해 보세요. 적을 피하고, 파괴적인 화력을 발휘하고, 전략적으로 적을 제압하여 박진감 넘치는 전투에서 살아남으세요.
💥 위험한 파워업

여정 중에 다양한 강력한 능력과 무기를 발견하고 잠금 해제하세요. 생존력을 높이고, 약화 상태 효과를 발동하고, 무기를 업그레이드하여 점점 더 강력해지는 적을 물리치세요. 올바른 조합으로 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있으므로 업그레이드를 현명하게 선택하세요.
박동감 넘치는 음악의 비트가 끊임없는 액션과 동기화되는 매혹적인 오디오 환경에 빠져보세요. 음악의 비트를 활용하여 완벽한 샷을 정렬하고 위험을 피하세요.

title: Colonisator
description:
게임 정보
Lead your more or less virtuous shipping company on the path to wealth and glory, in this turn-based adventure set in the golden age of piracy !
The game
The royal city of Sundercity charges you with colonizing and administering islands in its name... but you are not alone! Up to 3 AI competitors and factions more or less happy to see you will be there to make your life difficult.
Complete your mission by building a reputation over time, and demonstrate your skill to thwart the many dangerous situations that await you!
Turn based
You decide the movement of your ship and manage the different situations that arise. Explore, colonize, fight, trade, stopover to resupply.
Strategy
As the game progresses, you will have to make difficult decisions, which will have irremediable consequences! So you have to deal with your officers, the crew, but you also have to make sure that your islands thrive.
Stay away from pirates and be ready to make any compromises to achieve your goals!
Management
Resources are all produced somewhere and do not magically teleport!
Make sure your ship and your islands lack nothing, where trouble will quickly fall upon you. If your company is in difficulty, Sundercity will not do you any favors!
Simulation
All characters in the game are simulated. They all have their own characteristics and aspirations. Your actions and those of important characters will influence their decisions.
You'll get the crew you deserve!
Action
Switch to first person view, take command of your ship and lead your crew to victory in intense clashes!

title: Fabled Frontier
description:
게임 정보
Fabled Frontier is an open world crafting and action rpg set in a procedurally generated world inspired by fairy tales. Build your hero as well as a home!

Build your hero
Build your hero to be a raging warrior, trap setting ranger, beast summoner, or something else!

Explore the lands and beyond
Explore the procedurally generated world and discover what creatures and lands lie in it. Then find what lies beyond the massive rings on the water.

Construct a home
Create a place to rest up and get ready for new adventures

Key Features
Craft a custom character build from practically countless combinations of items, enchantments, abilities, and passive skills
Gather materials by engaging a wide variety of enemies
Visit different planes where each has various biomes to explore, creatures to fight, and resources to craft
Build a base

title: The Merlies
description:
게임 정보
The Merlies is a poetic adventure game that takes place in a gorgeous, microscopic universe.
Lead your little birds community in a collective adventure to organize their society and find good balance among the remains of a forgotten civilization. Build your village ingeniously, gather your fellow Merlies to explore the world and uncover its secrets. Ready to take flight on this journey?




The Merlies are looking for peace and harmony in a cute post-human world. Will solidarity and courage be enough to explore the multiple biomes and unravel their mysteries ?


The Merlies is an adventure game based on exploration and building your own village : as you wander around, explore the surroundings, find scraps left by a lost civilization and assemble them ingeniously in order to bring comfort and harmony to your tribe.


Cooperation, solidarity and team spirit are at the heart of the gameplay. Explore the world with your squad of courageous Merlies and unlock unique skills to glide your way into this immense universe.




Wacky constructions and clever upcycling are the key to bring comfort and happiness to your tribe. The Merlies way of life is to do a lot with a little.






Based on an idea by Cosmografik, creator of and

title: Divemensions
description:
게임 정보
What happens when you are a 2D creature that has been given the ability to move between the layers that make up your universe? Well... you start solving puzzles of course!

Get ready to think in 3D to solve interesting puzzles where the main focus is interacting with the different layers of the level, or prove your puzzle-design capabilities by creating your own levels with the Level Editor!
Gameplay Features

Move Between Layers!

By moving forwards or backwards you can travel between different layers of the level to interact with the elements that are found there. In this game the background isn't just for show, it is a physical part of the level!



Sometimes life can get pretty lonely... but luckily you have some boxes to keep you company! These boxes can be pushed around, and not only in 2D! You can move them between different layers or push even them out of the map!



What kind of puzzle would it be if we didn't have some buttons and platforms? Use your body or a friendly box to press buttons that activate platforms that move into a specific position, and it's completely wireless!


More features and elements will be added until the release of the game, so stay tuned for when they're ready to show!
The game features a full-fledged Level Editor that can be used by anyone to expand the limits of what's possible in this universe, are you up to the challenge?

title: Handsome and Brave
description:
게임 정보
Handsome and Brave is a story about a World in turmoil and a Knight that can't save it. But he's not alone, he has you. As a Watcher you can pickup, move, and most importantly throw the ragdoll Knight. Together you'll embark on an epic adventure to vanquish the evil Wizard and restore Law to the World.
Solving Puzzles
The Knight's uniquely resistant body and can-do attitude make him the perfect tool for any occasion. Some of his uses are:
Breaking Rocks
Opening Locks
Baking Bread
Turning Cranks
Switching Switches
Farming Produce
Vanquishing villains
Producing lasting pieces of art
And much more!
It's up to you to utilize his ragdoll body to explore this beautiful broken World at your own pace and solve the clever puzzles left by the dastardly people that broke it.
Helping People

title: Evolution From the little light
description:
게임 정보
Experience a 2D side-scrolling narrative adventure infused with puzzles and a dash of action, unfurling the compelling story of evolution in the merciless oceans.

Witness the fierce competition among species as they adapt to the harsh environment, mirroring the relentless struggle for survival. As a player, you will navigate this intricate web of existence, making crucial decisions, confronting perils, and unraveling the concealed secrets of evolution.



Visual Style



A captivating play of light and darkness takes center stage, evoking a constant duality.
Vivid splashes of color punctuate a predominantly grayscale world.
The ocean's depths, shrouded in mystery, blend realism with a touch of fantasy.
A seamless, interface-free integration ensures an organic gameplay experience.


Mechanics

title: Code5erpent
description:
게임 정보
Step foot on Earth: 3026

Zephir and his two friends, Martha and Orox, are newly recruited soldiers of the Human World State. Born in a world of flames and chaos, the three friends try to make a life for themselves as their destiny is inevitably shaped by the greater conflict that is the war against the serpents, gigantic space-faring entities born in the depths of the cosmos, and hell-bent on devouring the Earth.

Game features

Choose your type of experience: Multiple difficulty modes are available at the start of the game, allowing for gameplay experiences tailored to the player. Play on the Greatest Difficulty mode in order to unlock additional content, such as a new area, new characters and new bosses!
Battle like never before: As the serpents attacked the Earth, Humanity had to adapt: Their scales were impenetrable, nothing could pierce their skin! Nothing... but oxygen. Highly concentrated oxygen. Fortunately for you, Earth is teeming with it, and the Human World State found a way to garner its energy in order to take down its space-faring enemies. Introducing: the Oxygun. Start using it, and see the molecules as numbers! Mix and match them in varied and interesting ways in order to come up with terrifying combos to annihilate your foes!
Customise your playstyle: Code5erpent's unique focus on numbers and their mathematical properties during combat allows for every player to tackle each challenge however they see fit. The game is packed with a host of varied equipment pieces, such as weapons, armors and magic scrolls, spread around the world for you to equip and create the party that suits your playstyle.
Explore a war-torn overworld: Earth has changed a lot since when the serpents started their attack. Investigate a burning world, and meet what's left of Humanity, barely surviving, trying to find a way to fight back against these space invaders under the command of the Human World State.
Enter mysterious dungeons: Just like any RPG worthy of its title, Code5erpent features multiple fully-fledged dungeons for you to enter. Crawl through great, maze-like structures, teeming with loot, enemies, lore, and mathematical puzzles for adventurers to sink their teeth into.
Experience a complex character-driven story: Travel the ruined world of Earth in the year 3026 alongside a colorful cast of six primary characters: Zephyr the pessimistic loner, Martha the fervent soldier, Orox the noble knight and their three instructors: Tomeo the special forces elite, CageHead, the mysterious robot, and Alaska, the passionate orphan girl that is (just a bit) psychopathic. Uncover the secrets of the serpents that attacked the Earth long ago and are still ravaging it, all while completing missions for the enigmatic Human World State. Friendship, love and hatred, brotherhood, betrayal and reconciliation; you will experience it all!

title: GRØWTH
description:
게임 정보
GRØWTH is a first-person psychological horror title that digs its roots deep into the player's psyche. Explore the town of Omlest, as you seek out the answers to the nightmare unfolding in front of you. But beware, you might not like what you uncover...



Exploration is Key

To learn about life in the town of Omlest, you must seek out the answers for yourselves. With a mixture of open-world exploration and a horror atmosphere, you'll navigate this ghastly town using your own intuitions. There are no waypoints.

Risk vs Reward

Never knowing what's around the corner, means exploring Omlest is always a gamble. There's also an emphasis on combat, and you'll have to weigh out whether you stick to your fight or flight response. Sometimes while exploring, you may find a ton of health and ammo, other times you might get ambushed. Whatever you do, keep your wits about you and keep going. Don't let the dread consume you.

Storytelling Through Interactivity

With a focus on telling the narrative through meaningful interactions, players are encouraged to engage with Omlest in creative ways. The town is full of puzzles, enemy variants, special items, unique art and lore. And every single building in the town is explorable!

title: Closing Time
description:
게임 정보
A massive box store stands at the edge of town. Sat in a car in the pouring rain, you're about to make the biggest decision, and the biggest mistake of your life. This burglary isn't something you had planned for, but so many things in and outside of your control pushed you to this. Inside, the goods and cash prove to be plentiful, but something else is here. Something else, outside of the realms logic and reason is stalking your every move and now you must evade it to avoid becoming prey. Solve puzzles to move throughout the store, gain access to its different sections, and uncover its secrets, and perhaps uncover answers to the mystery of the monster that roams this store and what ties it to this place.
Explore the store after hours where things are not what they seem
Something stalks these halls, and will hunt you, but not before playing with you

title: Foul
description:
게임 정보
Foul is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic environment.
It takes you into a world where every action matters and essential supplies are hard to come by. Explore the vast world filled with infected species that need to be dealt with.
Fight off the infected with a range of different weapons.
Engage in fierce combat with enemies found everywhere in the world. Use all kinds of melee and ranged weapons in your defence. Do you stand a chance against the infected?
Drive like there is no tomorrow.
Cars are rare but valuable, allowing for quick map traversal and offering the potential to inflict significant damage.

title: Crusader's Legacy
description:
게임 정보
This Game is in Early Development

Genre: Bullet Hell, Fantasy, Action-RPG
Story:
Knightguard has been taken over by Skeletron. An undead king that was bested many centres ago, by a small group of heroes. Unfortunately, the Revenants resurrected Skeletron so he could bring back chaos and destruction. Three new heroes who aren’t aware of what’s to come, must band together to fight against Skeletron and his horde of evil minions. To bring peace and tranquillity back to the kingdom of Knightguard. Or that’s what they thought…
Progression:
Unlock gear from exploration, side guests and combat. Each level has unique gear to be obtained. Gold is used for purchasing gear, skills and upgrading equipment. Enjoy a particle weapon or build, upgrade your gear so you can continue to use it until you unlock a better version.
Difficulty:
Beat normal mode to unlock heroic mode and then nightmare mode. Each difficulty has new areas throughout each level, more secrets, new loot, new NPC's, improved/different enemies, new mini games, extra boss phases, new side quests and visual differences.
Endgame:
On nightmare mode you will encounter exotic gear quests, secret raid bosses, unique rarity gear, secret alterative ending. There's optional content with collecting cards or progression, etc with certain mini games, that transfers between each difficulty and level.
Classes:
There's three playable characters. Each class has 2 mobility options, 1 main ability and 3 sub abilities. Only one sub class ability, can be equipped while using your main ability.

Magnus | Void Caster: Magnus use to be a healer at a chapel in Knightguard, where he would heal wounded soldiers, but he wanted more out of life and devoted his time on mastering the art of dark magic instead. Now Magnus lives on the outskirts of town, working on perfecting his magic.
Race: Human, White Skin, Male



Evelyn is one of the towns best hunters. Her parents died when she was just a child, so she became independent at a very young age. She used to pick pockets to make ends meat, but a man named Melvin took her under his wing and trained her to hunt animals.




Lucas is the king’s personal guard. He use to fight on the front lines, but the king personally choose Lucas to work for him. Lucas accepted the job, because his wages where more than quadrupled. He now has a wife and child. He has settled for this quite life, but he keeps thinking back to the good old days.

title: Now You Would Destroy The Earth
description:
게임 정보
The year is 1981. Seven years since some strange disease ripped through the city of Sennenmoor, a quarantine cutting it off from the world. Seven years that have seen it forgotten, left to rot amongst the moorland. Five years since you last saw him. Five happy years together and then, suddenly, five years apart. No warning. One day he was just gone.
Three weeks since the letter. Written in shaking hand, though undeniably his. Still the smell of him hanging a little on the paper, still the letters slanting more as they went on, rushed and desperate.
Two weeks since you took a job as a research scientist in a dead and broken city, for you knew where the letter came from, though you didn't know how, nor how he'd gotten back. The city of his birth, the city he often said he wanted to go back to, one day, to stay, to live out your lives there.
Two hour since you took a military train southbound from Glasgow towards Sennenmoor. A letter in your breast pocket. On it, written in scrawled hand, the words;
We're going home, Elias.

Now You Would Destroy The Earth is a top-down psychological horror narrative adventure about a man seeking answers from a lover he thought long gone, across the backdrop of a city torn apart by a strange disease. With multiple endings, paths and secrets to find, converse and navigate your way through the broken streets of Sennenmoor to find the truth about the man you once loved, and the nature of the disease itself.
autokwd: Now You Would Destroy The Earth

title: Cursed Dungeon Raider
description:
게임 정보
Cursed Dungeon Raider는 으스스하고 공포스러운 요소로 가득한 몰입형 탐험 모험을 제공합니다. 위험한 발굴 현장에서 실제 역사적 유물을 찾아보세요. 치명적인 함정으로 가득 찬 던전과 무덤을 탐색하고 각 지역 고유의 신화 괴물을 만나세요.



게임에서 발견하는 유물은 실제 역사적 유물의 3D 스캔을 기반으로 합니다. 이는 게임이 오락용일 뿐만 아니라 교육 목적으로도 사용되며 이러한 전시물과 그 기원에 대한 추가 정보를 제공한다는 것을 의미합니다.



이러한 유물을 박물관에 기부하여 고고학적 명성을 얻고 새로운 발굴 현장에 접근하거나 암시장에 판매하여 더 많은 돈을 벌고 흥미로운 새 장비를 구입하세요. 공식 기관으로부터 새로운 임무를 받거나 사악한 캐릭터에 대한 계약을 완료하세요.



다음 여행을 떠나기 전에 장비를 준비하세요. 경로와 앞에 있는 함정을 비출 수 있는 충분한 광원이 있는지 확인하세요. 돌아가는 길을 분필이나 말뚝으로 표시하고 항상 충분한 응급처치 용품과 구충제를 휴대하세요.



세계를 여행하고 다양하고 매혹적인 고고학 유적지를 탐험하여 고대 문명의 비밀을 밝혀보세요. 눈 덮인 북쪽부터 머나먼 땅의 고대 유적 유적까지, 각 지역에는 고유한 비밀이 있습니다. 오랫동안 잊혀진 무덤과 사원이 모래 밑에 있는 건조한 사막을 여행하거나 역사적인 유물과 묻혀 있는 보물이 발견을 기다리고 있는 외딴 지역으로 모험을 떠나보세요.



발굴된 유물을 홈 갤러리에 전시하고 다른 플레이어에게 선물해보세요. 각 지역의 신화 속 괴물에 대한 정보를 수집하고, 이들의 강점과 약점, 퇴치, 추방, 무력화 방법을 알아보세요.

모험이 당신을 기다립니다!

title: The Neath
description:
게임 정보
Explore this extensive underground world in this fantasy action adventure game.

Having fled to a isolated island sitting atop a complex network of cavern, tunnels and underground waterways you seek to explore your surroundings and collect whatever useful things you can find.

Search through areas natural and manmade for weapons and tools to help you fight, crawl, climb, swim and think your way past monsters and natural obstacles.

title: Fruit Of Choice
description:
게임 정보
Enemies keep coming. You have to use your mouse to move and dash to survive as long as you can.

Make good use of dash boosts, shields, bombs, etc. to help you survive longer.

Use your items carefully, lure and kill enemies to still have room to survive.



If you play well, you'll enter the powerful Hyper Mode!




When touched by an enemy or enemy attack, hyper mode is canceled and life is reduced.




If you find an opening and move while dashing at the appropriate angle and timing, your chances of survival will increase.

Survive as long as you can and score high!




( Currently, the free demo only has an arcade mode.
But the game will feature .
Please look forward to seeing develop in the future :D )

title: Club House on Haunted Hill
description:
게임 정보



Club House on Haunted Hill is a story-driven, adventure golf game that blends golf and narrative in the style of a 1960s horror movie. As you play the story you navigate through the haunted lands of the Island of Gallows Neck, each course telling a piece of the overall story.

In addition to the campaign you will be able to play against friends locally or online on various haunted golf courses. Each hole offers an adventure filled with supernatural elements and horrifying hazards enhancing the challenge.





Distribute points in Muscle, Cunning, Control, Mercy, and Sanity to create the perfect golfer tailored to your play style. You can max out muscle to have the longest drive, or put points in sanity to withstand the psychological terror of golf.







Cunning enhances your ability to judge distances and predict ball landings. With a sharp cunning of the game you'll be able to anticipate the ball's trajectory and make strategic decisions to outmaneuver your opponents.


Mercy increases good hit chances, even with off-target hits. Giving you a better chance of landing successful shots, even when your timing isn't perfect.


Sanity improves ball spin and loft control. By mastering this attribute, you can execute complex shots with precision, allowing you to navigate obstacles and fine-tune the ball’s spin.


Muscle determines how hard you will hit the ball and how far it will travel. This attribute gives you an edge on long fairways and challenging your competitors with powerful shots.

title: The Hydra Experiment
description:
게임 정보
The hive-minded mad scientist, Dr. Esereth, has granted you consciousness! At least, temporarily...
To retain the gift of life, you must prove your worth to the collective by conquering four themed testing areas in any order: the nanite factory, the observatory, the chemistry branch, and the greenhouse.
Find prototypes scattered throughout the facilities to help you solve puzzles and navigate combat. Assign them to one of nine buttons (by default mapped to the numpad).

title: Space Chaos
description:
게임 정보
Objective: Deliver unpredictable cargo at all costs, no matter the challenges!
Cosmic Chaos: Navigate absurd cosmic environments filled with unexpected threats.
Teamwork: Collaborate with your crew to keep the ship running and handle emergencies.
Reputation: Unlock new sectors and upgrade your ship.
DELIVER THE CARGO, AT ALL COSTS
Your mission is simple: deliver your unpredictable cargo to its destination, no matter what. Unexpected challenges await, but the cargo must arrive safe and sound.

IN THE HEART OF CHAOS
Embark on a journey into cosmic unknowns, where absurdity reigns and chaos lurks at every turn. Navigate through wacky and varied environments: asteroid fields, alien attacks, cosmic whales, and other bizarre phenomena that can quickly upend your mission.

title: Full BET - Fighting Casino

카지노에서 펼쳐지는 1대1 턴제 격투 배틀
각양각색의 캐릭터들이 돈과 명예를 걸고 링에 올라, 하이 스테이크 전투 쇼에 참가한다.

플레이어는 번갈아 가며 카드를 선택하고, 선택한 순서대로 캐릭터가 행동한다.

상대와 심리전을 펼치며, 이 하이 스테이크 배틀에서 승리를 쟁취하라!

title: Iridescent
description:
게임 정보
Premise



In "Iridescent" you step into the shoes of Kruk, a long time member of the Astel family, renowned healers entrusted with perilous missions. Tasked with curing a devastating plague that transforms people into beasts or madmen, Kruk soon discovers that this affliction is merely a symptom of a world teetering on the brink of destruction. Beeing seemingly the only one who is willing to try, he embarks on a odyssey through the whole world to acquire the cure.
Gameplay



Venture forth into a sprawling world brimming with diverse characters and hidden secrets waiting to be unearthed. Traverse through intricate dungeons, each presenting its own set of unique challenges and items that unlock new areas and mysteries to explore. But beware, for formidable adversaries lurk around every corner, testing your mettle and resolve. Death comes easy to those who dare danger without caution.



Combat in "Iridescent" is a test of skill and precision. Embrace the art of parrying to deflect enemy attacks while sneaking your own attacks in between, gradually chipping away at their stagger bar until its filled and you can unleash a powerful grapple attack that inflicts massive damage. Boss battles are dynamic and intense, with adversaries evolving and adapting their tactics as the fight unfolds, keeping you on your toes until the very end.



Get a taste of the world of 'Iridescent' with my demo! Dive into the first two levels of the game to experience the intense combat, intricate dungeon exploration, and epic boss battles. Then, after completing the demo, test your skills further by facing off against two optional foes, offering a little glimpse of the challanges in the full game. Don't miss this chance to preview the excitement of 'Iridescent' and prepare for the full adventure!

title: Inherited Shadows
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by the classics of the genre, Inherited Shadows weaves a gripping tale about Amanda, a young adult struggling to lead a normal life while haunted by the trauma of her mother’s absence, but on an ordinary morning in 1999, everything will change for her forever.
A TRUE HORROR ADVENTURE
Explore a world where tension never goes away. Every step is a life or death decision. Hide, solve puzzles and discover the dark secrets of a cult you were never meant to find. With an oppressive atmosphere, relentless enemies and a disturbing story, this is a true horror adventure.
THERE ARE QUESTIONS WHICH ARE BETTER LEFT UNANSTERED

title: Unyverse
description:
게임 정보
Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) with fighting game combat created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse will deliver an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.
RPG meets Fighting Game Mechanics.
Unyverse expands on the action-RPG genre by adding fighting game style melee combat. Players will be faced with morally complex decisions that the story in ways that will surprise even the most adept RPG player. Explore an Afrofuturistic world filled with creatures and vast landscapes to discover. In addition to the main story arc of the game, players will be able to uncover unexplored parts of the planet as side quests. At any time during the campaign, a player has the freedom to freely roam a large playable area to uncover resources, trade, hunt, and expand their reputation and influence.
A Fresh New World for RPG Gamers to Explore
Unyverse is an afrofuturistic RPG inspired by the diaspora of African cultures and projected into the future in a galaxy far far away. Never before have we seen an afrocentric world in games but players will be able to create any type of character they want to explore this vast world. We aspire to create the Mass Effect of Afrofuturism with the feel and kinetic action of a fighting game. Your choices will matter and affect your reputation with different factions in the game world. The overarching plot will drive the player forward as a new Mwindaji (Bounty Hunter) as they complete the main quest line where their choices could save their home planet. 
Fighting Game 1v1 Multiplayer That Affects Reputation.
PVP mode will be a combat arena (think ThunderDome) battle allowing players to bring their Characters from single player mode and compete against others online.  Because Unyverse features a unique blend of RPG and fighting game mechanics we can offer players a fun mode that only affects their reputation in the village/city arenas that they have opened up and won PVP matches in - thus giving PVP a single player benefit without upsetting the balance for single player gameplay.

title: Critical Upload
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!
Be careful how you order your items
Each time you are hit, and item will drop from your ship. When you have no items left, you are only one hit away from critical hull breach!

Beam into derelict ships to use unique abilities to combat unique enemies!
Take the ship back to base to research the new technology for later runs
Check out the mothership bar between missions, in first person view!
Fully interactable level between missions to talk to characters about research, combat and story events
Death in co-op does not leave you out of the fun!
When you die in multiplayer coop, you will be attached to a player who is still alive, but you will be missing your items.
When the player you are in picks them up, you can shoot from the alive player's ship!

title: Project DOSA
description:
게임 정보
From Outerloop Games comes Project Dosa, a game about life, love and loss. Join sisters Samara and Amani as they eat the world and taste everything life has to offer. Reunite with the people you love, defeat the forces of capitalism (metaphorically) and eat one last meal before saying goodbye.


BATTLE AND BOND
Journey across a vibrant world to reconnect with estranged friends and family. Battle them in fantastical turn-based narrative combat to reconcile past hurts and open up the possibilities of friendship and love. Grow your bonds with them over time.

Food is more than fuel - it's community, culture, history, shared memories. Discover new recipes through exploration and conversation, and cook for friends, family and local communities to heal rifts and reconcile relationships.
Discover and shape your spirit-mech's mechanical and fantastical abilities as you traverse the world, cook and battle together.

title: Sliced
description:
게임 정보
Fast-Paced PvP Combat:

Dive into intense player-versus-player battles. Quick reflexes and strategic thinking are your keys to victory in the high-speed arena.

Dynamic Arenas:

Battle across a variety of arenas, each with its own unique layout and hazards. Adapt your strategy to the changing environment to gain the upper hand.


Equip yourself with an arsenal of weapons, from axes to spears, each offering distinct gameplay mechanics. Mastering each weapon’s strengths and weaknesses is essential.



Experience the thrill of combat with a visceral dismemberment system. Strategically target your opponents' limbs to weaken them or go for a dramatic finish.


- Free-For-All (FFA)
- Team Deathmatch
- Teams King of the Hill
- FFA King of the Hill
- Capture the Flag
- Infection




Personalize your fighter with a selection of cosmetic items. Stand out in the arena with unique combinations of armor, weapons skins, and victory poses.


Have the freedom to set up your own game lobbies, making it easy to play with friends or open the doors to challengers worldwide. Perfect for organizing friendly matches or competitive clashes, with full control over your play experience. Additionally, you can create private lobbies filled with bots for practice sessions or enjoy a mix of friends and bots for varied gameplay dynamics.


Enjoy new content and game modes introduced in regular updates.


Become part of a game that listens to its community. Share your feedback, and help shape the future of "Sliced" with new features and content inspired by players.

title: Absym
description:
게임 정보
두 개의 차원이 격돌하는 생존 전쟁
ABSYM에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 이 어둡고 강렬한 로그-소울라이크 게임은 현실의 끝자락으로 당신을 초대합니다. 붕괴해가는 세계, 니힐로르(Nihilor)와 타락한 평행 차원, 압시말리트(Absymalith) 사이의 위태로운 균형을 오가며 치명적인 도전에 맞서십시오. 아름답고도 위험한 환경을 탐험하며, 붕괴 직전의 우주에 숨겨진 비밀을 밝혀내십시오. 한 걸음 내디딜 때마다 구원에 가까워질 수도, 혹은 완전한 타락에 빠질 수도 있습니다.
로그라이크 전투의 스릴과 소울라이크 탐험의 전략성을 융합한 독창적인 시스템
살아남고, 성장하십시오. 하지만 명심하세요: 모든 승리에는 대가가 따릅니다.

title: Synthroute 82
description:
게임 정보


Take control of VINDICATOR, top of the line simulation vehicle. In this solo arcade infinite destruction racing game your goal is to obliterate evil M.I.N.D. LTD cars and enjoy the never ending ride. Have a moment and need to de-stress? There's nothing better than road mayhem!

Rules are easy - score as many points as you can before you die. Don't worry tho, you can take few hits before that happens.
Features
Infinite racing and destruction
Tailored for busy people - 5 to 10 minutes play session
Ever increasing difficulty - start slow, die hard
Original synthwave soundtrack @2fd5 bandcamp and soon on all streaming platforms
Easy to pick up gameplay
Local leaderboards
Infinite procedurally assembled environments
Vaporwave aesthetics
Keyboard only controls
How to play
AD / Left Right arrow for steering

title: M.E.M.O
description:
게임 정보
M.E.M.O demo (α)
Welcome to M.E.M.O demo (α) where you can get a sneak peek into the world of "M.E.M.O"!
While some features are yet to be implemented in this version, you can already experience the captivating world setting and core cryptography gameplay that makes "M.E.M.O" special.
※Please have paper and pen ready when playing.
※The demo(β) is scheduled for release in July 2025.
※This demo may differ from the final product.

※The screenshots shown are all from the development stage.
"In the dark, swaying train, you awaken to the sound of a red telephone, having lost your memory..."
In 2176, Shin Japan is plagued by various social issues.
Amidst this, a terrorist organization called "OUKAMI" threatens the government with the release of a deadly virus nationwide.
As a chosen agent, you must dive into the memories of the deceased to prevent this terror.
Retro landscapes of the mind, cryptic codes guarding old secrets, the truth of a world collapse 100 years ago...
Wandering through the maze of memories, can you find the key to save the future?

title: Felampire
description:
게임 정보

Felampire beckons you into the shadows of its 2D Metroidvania realm. Embrace the essence of a mysterious cat, brought to life within the sacred confines of an ancient crypt. Awaken without memories, alone, yet filled with unfathomable powers just waiting to be unleashed. Your odyssey unfolds in the labyrinthine passages beneath and stretches into the world above, where your kind is feared and scorned.

Embark on a metroidvania platformer adventure unlike any other, where you play as a cat exploring the depth of crypts, acquiring mystical abilities, and navigating through long-forgotten ruins. Unravel puzzles, unlock ancient secrets, and discover the true essence of the felampire, all while piecing together your own mysterious origins.

Face formidable bosses and conquer them to assimilate their extraordinary powers, transforming the way you combat foes and traverse the enigmatic world of the crypts. Felampire invites you into a captivating tale of discovery, power, and identity, where your actions dictate the unfolding of a story far greater than yourself.

Make tough decisions as you discover your heritage and what that means. You decide who you will side with. Navigate the shadows of uncertainty as you face moral dilemmas that shape the destiny of Aethermere. Choose forgiveness or vengeance, alliance or isolation, as you grapple with the consequences of your actions. The path you walk will define not only your journey, but the fate of the kingdom itself.
