상대와 심리전을 펼치며, 이 하이 스테이크 배틀에서 승리를 쟁취하라!

title: Critical Upload
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!
Be careful how you order your items
Each time you are hit, and item will drop from your ship. When you have no items left, you are only one hit away from critical hull breach!

Beam into derelict ships to use unique abilities to combat unique enemies!
Take the ship back to base to research the new technology for later runs
Check out the mothership bar between missions, in first person view!
Fully interactable level between missions to talk to characters about research, combat and story events
Death in co-op does not leave you out of the fun!
When you die in multiplayer coop, you will be attached to a player who is still alive, but you will be missing your items.
When the player you are in picks them up, you can shoot from the alive player's ship!

title: You Died!
description:
게임 정보
How will you cope with the loss of yourself?
Each episode of You Died! will allow you to experience a stage of grief for yourself. Make choices, deal with the consequences, and interact with your environment to express the emotions of the main character.

You Died! is a choice-based 3D visual novel with elements of psychological horror. It aims to help players struggling with growing up and feelings of wasted childhood. Using death as a metaphor for permanently leaving childhood behind, the story takes the player through 5 stages of grief from the Elisabeth Kubler-Ross model. In each stage, you will notice some changes to the environments and mechanics from shader changes to completely new abilities in each episode!
Episode 1 Denial
Face your death and try to find out why you have chosen to kill yourself. This episode gives you an option to "possess" your body while you walk around the house and uncover the reasons behind your death.
Episode 2 Anger
Dying young could make one pretty angry. That is why in this episode you will have the option to throw as many things as you want and scream your lungs out. Yell and blame everyone (including yourself).
Episode 3 Bargaining
Face death (this time literally) and try to convince them to let you come back to life. How far would you go to turn back time?

Episode 4 Depression & Episode 4 Acceptance (in development)
key Features
story-driven Interactive Fiction
player Choices Altering Gameplay
hand-painted Monochrome Visuals
Each episode reflects emotions felt in the corresponding stage of grief through shaders and game mechanics
Original soundtrack

title: Flooded Burials
description:
게임 정보
Flooded Burials is a top-down action adventure game about exploring a tower buried in the sea. The game consists of an overworld where you can explore and get to know NPCs, and individual stages where you you'll have to face combat and platforming challenges. The game contains:
A beautiful world for you to explore and uncover
A deep combat system with unique parrying mechanics.
Unique npc's you can talk to and get to know.
Multiple stages that can be replayed for higher ranks
Will be able to lower the sea and uncover this words mysteries?

title: Veil of Madness
description:
게임 정보
From the creators of CONARIUM, TRANSIENT, and the DARKNESS WITHIN series comes “Veil of Madness,” an eerie Lovecraftian deck-building game. Venture into a child's shattered consciousness, where nine distinct selves guard a tenth of immense power. Using breakthrough technology, explore this psychological maze as a scientist determined to unlock humanity's next evolution.
Gather unique cards along the way and upgrade them to improve their stats. Some cards can be found in secret areas, while others are only obtainable by completing certain quests. Therefore, pay attention to NPCs.
You will encounter various creatures throughout the game. At times, you may need to battle more than one. Use your inventory strategically to survive.

title: Limitless
description:
게임 정보
Step into the breathtaking world of Limitless ("Formerly known as Apeiron"), an open-world, third-person, story-driven action RPG set in the mystical Realm of Eternity. Experience a richly crafted high-fantasy universe filled with danger, discovery, and dynamic gameplay.
Build Your Dream Team of Heroes
Lead a squad of four remarkable companions, each with their own strengths, skills, and customizable gear. Strategically swap between characters in real-time to overcome challenges, solve mysteries, and turn the tide of battle in your favor.

title: You Are Dead
description:
게임 정보
Consciousness... Where? Unknown. Who are all these dudes in robes? Only one way forward: through the door.


Overview:
This is a game about finding your path, surviving the mysterious afterlife, and solving the riddle of your purpose in this curious world.

This game will continue to grow with more features and content. Keep an eye out for updates on the official website!



Features:
Randomly generated roguelike runs
Universal controller support (or mouse and keyboard)
Metagame unlockables
Charming creatures, and one total asshole
Acquire powerful weapons
3 obnoxiously colorful environments
Memorable encounters and challenges
Cheese-friendly combat

title: Glutton
description:
게임 정보
Glutton - a game that tells us about a creature brought to earth on a meteorite. The game begins with the level of atoms and ends with the scale of the planet, our creature as it grows acquires new skills for more effective absorption of biomass, and protection from the dangers that wait for it at every step.
Game Features

Ability to upgrade the main character for genome points, which gives him not only new skills or improves existing ones, but also changes his appearance!
5 unique abilities that open up as you progress through the game, which can be upgrade!
As you progress through the main character will evolve, which will also be display on his appearance!
40 eventful levels in 8 different biomes (you will visit the level of atoms, unicellular organisms, microorganisms, marine animals, insects, people and cities, and so on until you reach the scale of the planet).
Levels both on land and in liquids! Depending on this, the control of the character changes!
System of small missions to diversify the gameplay with different missions on the levels!
At the end of the block of levels, you will find a boss ready to challenge you!
A variety enemies!
System of passing levels by the number of stars, the better you pass them – the easier it will be to go further, because for they open up improvements for skills!

title: Frenzy Force
description:
게임 정보
Frenzy Force is a casual top-down shooter set in a diverse collection of biomes known only as The Menagerie.
Existing outside of space and time, The Menagerie is home to formless, bloodthirsty shadow creatures with only one goal: to hunt down and eliminate anyone who enters.
Our brave heroes come from all walks of life, drawn together by the allure of The Menagerie's secrets. Although they have no connection to each other and their pasts are long forgotten, this daring expedition has given them a new identity: The Frenzy Force.
Enter The Menagerie at your own peril, and explore 16 unique biomes with over 30 weapons to aid you in your survival. Last as long as you can against relentless waves of enemies, either solo or with friends!

title: Fox in the 20th Century
description:
게임 정보
Assume the role of Fox, the laser-blading alien from the HPP (Human Protection Program), and travel back in time, battling the Y2Krew across the ten decades of the 20th century, to save the human race and ultimately battle the Y2K Bug on New Year's Eve, 1999!


- Fast paced action platforming.
- Linear and obstacle-focused level design.
- Over 30 unique levels with their own themes, graphics, enemies and play features!
- New crazy gimmicks and tricks introduced constantly.

- Run, jump, wall-run, and rail grind your way through the years!
- Master Fox's signature attack moves - the Air Sweep, a weak, yet fast and more evasive approach, or the Fox Trot, a powerful combo attack that serves as the slower yet higher damage option.

- Over 100 different characters, enemies, and bosses all with wacky personalities brought to life through hand animation.
- Hundreds of references and homages to fashion, pop culture, leisurely activities, and trends from all the decades of the 1900s, including parody enemies, voice clips, background items, and more! It's a celebration of fun!
- Fully hand drawn graphics and animation for everything in the game!

- Get fun (and sometimes helpful) commentary from Fox's buddies, Sloth and Raven, throughout your adventure. It's like you're always playing with friends! And if the abundance of voices aren't for you, you can just switch it off.
- All characters and enemies brought to life by talented voice actors!
- No gameplay is interrupted or broken up by dialogue scenes. All speaking is short, sweet, and happening while you play!
- A varied soundtrack representing loads of popular music styles from over the course of 100 years!

title: Can't Even See the Sky
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THE PROJECT
“Can't Even See the Sky” is an atmospheric point&click adventure inspired by games like Disco Elysium. You'll find yourself in a world where past and present are intertwined, and every choice you make affects story and character development. Are you ready to look into the abyss of your own memory and uncover the secrets of a shattered world?
GAME WORLD
The action unfolds in Stalberg, a city that has become a monument to humanity's victory over Mahina, an artificial intelligence that turned nature and humans into tools for its own purposes. Mahina has disappeared, leaving behind a ruined ecology, a collapsing economy and a society teetering on the brink of chaos.
Now people themselves are driving each other to the machines to keep the country from collapse. But collapse is inevitable.
YOUR HERO
You play as a man with a troubled past who travels to Stalberg at his mother's request to find his missing father and deliver a letter to him. But this is only the beginning. Your character is a man torn by inner conflicts. In his head live Others - voices, memories, alter egos that argue, advise and criticize. They become your companions, helping (or hindering) you to unravel the mysteries of the city and your own life.
GAME FEATURES
Deep plot: A story full of moral dilemmas, philosophical questions and unexpected twists and turns.
Unique memory mechanics: Explore not only the city, but also the depths of your memory to uncover the secrets of the past.
Character Development: Your decisions shape your character's personality and affect his relationships with those around him.
Detective Elements: Investigate mysterious events, interview residents, analyze evidence, and make decisions that will change the course of history.
Atmospheric World: Isometric Stalberg is a city where every street, every house and every character tells its own story.

title: Carry On
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT CARRY ON
Carry On is an upcoming narrative game about the experiences of newcomers who arrive in an unfamiliar place for the first time.
FEATURES
TBD

title: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
description:
게임 정보
Doomsday Valley is a mystery point-and-click adventure game designed to appeal to both experienced players and newcomers alike.
You are Maya Harper: a quirky journalist working for Bizarre Bulletin, specialising in the unexplainable. Videos about haunted buildings, faith healing and urban legends has made you and your platform an internet sensation. Always on the prowl for exciting new rumours, you decide to make Doomsday Valley your next big scoop. There is always something to find if you dig deep enough.

title: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
description:
게임 정보
Join brave adventuring duo Cappy and Tappy as they embark on a quest through the trials of many fascinating temples and worlds!
Hand your mouse or keyboard to a friend to tackle challenges as a team, or carve your path forward by controlling both Cappy and Tappy solo.
Don't like mouse and keyboard controls? Play with one or two controllers instead!
Utilize both building and platforming to escape with your life!
Climb and leap away from the ever-encroaching, piranha-infested water beneath your feet!
Jam out to our original soundtrack, hosting a wide variety of handheld game-inspired tunes.
Take in the dazzling and varied atmospheres of each unique world that your adventure brings you to!
Champion each world by collecting all of the idols found within!
Much more waits in store...
Hazards and Helpers

title: Saltwater Bodies
description:
게임 정보
Saltwater Bodies is a cave-diving body horror game.
Explore underwater cave systems beneath a salt flat, and nurture an unnatural vessel away from prying eyes.
Features a physics-based caving system where you have to be mindful of positioning your body parts, and balance that against holding your breath underwater - Is it worth breathing out precious air to squeeze through a smaller gap?
Outside of underwater caves you can socialize with co-workers and perform arcane experiments to construct yourself a new vessel. A branching narrative that depends on how you balance your day job and your more supernatural contracts...
The game uses a retro style with vertex wobble and a lowered resolution. These can be adjusted in the settings if it's not your jam!

title: Runes of Madness
description:
게임 정보
Runes of Madness is a dark fantasy action RPG that plunges you into a world shrouded in shadow. Delve into perilous dungeons, unravel the secrets of the Runes, and battle hordes of monstrous creatures.
Inspired by the greatest classics of the genre, Runes of Madness offers intense combat, deep character customization, and a challenging rogue-lite experience.
Key Features:
Explore a Dark Fantasy World: A once-peaceful village has been gripped by a mysterious madness, and it's up to you to unravel the sinister truth. Journey through four distinct chapters, each filled with a unique theme, quests, dungeons, and challenges.
Deep Character Customization: Choose from three unique classes - the mighty Warrior, the cunning Rogue, or the powerful Sorcerer.
Customize your character with a variety of skills unique to each class, attributes, and equipment. Enhance your gear with powerful gems, runes, and jewels.
Level up, unlock new abilities, and become a formidable force.
Intense, Strategic Combat: Engage in fast-paced, skill-based combat where precise timing and strategic choices are key. Use the battlefield to your advantage, exploiting traps, environmental hazards, and terrain to defeat your foes.
Mortal Challenge: Every death is permanent. All characters start as mortals; however, by interacting with a certain statue in the world, you can lift this challenge, allowing for a less punishing experience.
Endless Replayability: Explore randomly generated dungeons, filled with loot and encounters.
Team up or go solo: Experience the game alone or with friends in cooperative multiplayer. Explore dungeons, trade items, and fight other players in thrilling PvP encounters in specific zones of the world.
Will you dare to face the darkness and forge your own legend?

title: Disc Creatures WORLD
description:
게임 정보
"Disc creatures WORLD" is a monster taming RPG featuring over 300 unique creatures! Build your party from the creatures you befriend to battle against those who stand in your way! Discover stories featuring creatures and humans alike!
Welcome to a world where humans and creatures coexist, for better and for worse. Sometimes they work together in harmony, but other times they clash from their differences.
Amid this coexistence, humans developed a groundbreaking technology called "Discs". These discs record a creature’s data, allowing new creatures with identical abilities to be created. Those who master the use of Discs, known as Disc Rangers—"DiscRs" for short—work alongside creatures to solve a wide variety of challenges.
Now it’s your turn to enter the world of a DiscR. Exciting adventures, challenging encounters, and strange creatures await you!
Over 300 unique creatures to befriend!
Adventure with your party by your side! Enjoy the companion system that lets your favorite creatures follow you.
Engage in strategic 3-on-3 battles! Use shared Energy Points to unleash moves!

title: Exoplanet Outpost
description:
게임 정보
In Exoplanet Outpost, you will establish and manage a thriving colony on a distant exoplanet, balancing economic growth, tourism, and defense against relentless alien threats. Begin with a team of intrepid pioneers and transform your base into a bustling hub of commerce and culture.
Resource Management: Mine resources, research technologies, and build infrastructure to support your colony's growth.
Tourist Attractions: Create stunning attractions to draw interstellar tourists, from casinos to mystical temples.
Alien Combat: Defend your outpost from diverse alien species with advanced technology and strategic defenses.
Dynamic Economy: Engage in interstellar trade and manage a complex economy, balancing production, consumption, and resource allocation.
Advanced Technologies: Research and develop cutting-edge technologies to enhance your colony's capabilities and defenses.
Campaign Missions: Embark on focussed scenario missions that challenge your strategic thinking and decision-making skills.
Environmental Challenges: Adapt to harsh planetary conditions, unexpected events, and alien ecosystems that test your colony's resilience.
Experience the ultimate blend of economic strategy, tourism management, and thrilling combat in Exoplanet Outpost.
STORY
In the not-so-distant future, humanity's quest for survival and expansion has reached the stars. Faced with dwindling resources on Earth and the discovery of habitable exoplanets, the Galactic Federation has launched a series of ambitious colonization missions. Among these is "Exoplanet Outpost", a critical initiative aimed at establishing a sustainable human presence on a distant, resource-rich world.
As the commander of this outpost, you are tasked with transforming a wild alien landscape into a thriving hub of economic activity, interstellar tourism, and robust defenses against unforeseen alien threats.
The planet holds untold riches and ancient mysteries, but it also harbors unknown dangers. Alien species and rebel bandits roam the planet, posing both opportunities and threats to your fledgling colony. You must navigate these challenges and harness its resources to build a prosperous and self-sustaining settlement.

title: No Need  Flowers
description:
게임 정보
No Need for Flowers is an arcade-style scrolling shooter bullet hell game about magic dragon girls!
Play as a dragon priestess on a quest to stop a mysterious necromancer from destroying the world.
Skillfully dodge colorful bullet patterns as you shoot down hordes of enemies!

title: Bully Ball Brigade
description:
게임 정보
Bully Ball Brigade is about making or breaking friendships (as any good party game). Compete in simple games, and beat your friends. Be the Best Bully there ever was. 
Make the game as easy or complex as you want, with roguelike spice mechanics, and full customisability. Each round's winner decides the game's pace, by choosing the next spice. 
Challenge yourselves by handpicking the available spices. Skip the spice, if the game is already overwhelming.

title: Memoirium
description:
게임 정보
In Memoirium, everything is but sand and stars.
Unique Locations
The realm of dreams does not abide by any rules or genre. In one moment, you will find yourself in a simple 21st-century school, and in the next, your eyes will fall upon a castle held together by wax.
Masks and more
Most, if not all, of the equipment will alter yourself and the entities you encounter. One piece of armor can affect how long negative statuses last, while a specific mask will change how enemies approach you in combat.

title: Cross the C
description:
게임 정보
It is a 2D puzzle x 3D first person riddle solving game.
Puzzle
.Aim for the island by controlling a ship that cannot stop until it hits a rock. Use the “pieces” that can be placed on the board to rebuild the stage and solve the puzzle.
Riddle solving
.Solve the riddles scattered around the room.

title: Mortal Quest
description:
게임 정보
MORTAL QUEST
Follow John, a mortal who has been transferred to an island infested by monsters and demons. You must guide him through dangerous challenges in order to prove himself worthy to fulfill an ancient prophecy. Meet uncomprehensible foes and even some unexpected allies on this unforgettable journey. 
SURVIVAL
The main theme of Mortal Quest is survival. There are dangerous monsters to face on the island, and if you die, you have to restart from where you last saved. There are many ways to fend off the monsters, including building a base, crafting new weapons, managing your health and hunger, and learning and adapting to each enemy's unique threats. 
ADVENTURE
Another big theme of Mortal Quest is adventure. The island is big and vast, but that isn't the only place to explore in this alternate realm. There is also a cave system, a still-running ancient civilization, a relic of an older time, and MUCH more! Each area has new resources, new foes, and even possibly new friends? It's up to you to explore and find out!
COOL MECHANICS
Mortal Quest has a bunch of mechanics that keep the game engaging and fun. There is a crafting system that unlocks new recipes the more you progress. This means that not everything is available to the player right off the bat, and they have to progress to unlock new tools and resources. There is also cooking, fishing, long-ranged weaponry, and more!
PLAY THE DEMO
Don't buy a game you might not enjoy. Try the demo first! It's free and will give you an idea of what this game is and what it's all about. If you don't enjoy it, don't buy the full game. Simple as that!

title: Jeff and Crackhead
description:
게임 정보
오버월드- 오버월드를 탐험하는 동안 Jeff와 crackhead의 고유한 능력을 사용하여 하향식 플랫폼 도전을 정복하고 퍼즐을 풀게 됩니다. 스토리를 진행하기 위한 비밀이나 함정을 품고 있는 경로의 많은 갈라짐이 있지만 각 영역의 출구를 찾아야 합니다. 길을 따라 많은 무의미한 몬스터를 만나게 될 것입니다. 하나와 마주치면 전투가 시작됩니다. 전투- 전투는 시간 기반입니다. 공격할 수 있는 속도는 각 캐릭터의 속도 스탯에 따라 다릅니다. 공격할 기회를 기다리는 동안 방어 모드로 전환하고 전용 지역에서 자유롭게 달릴 수 있습니다. 이 모드에서는 노란색 구슬이 생성되어 수집할 수 있으며, 이것들을 수집하면 타이머가 빨라져 더 빨리 들어갈 수 있습니다. 자유로운 움직임을 이용해 다가오는 공격을 피하거나 쳐내기 공격을 충전하세요. 타이밍이 가장 중요합니다. 타이머가 가득 차고 스트라이크를 칠 기회가 보이면 말이죠. 캐릭터 전용 버튼으로 액션 모드로 전환하세요. 여기에서 아이템, 빠른 공격 또는 캐릭터의 특수 능력 중 하나를 사용하도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 하지만 상대방이 공격할 때 놓치거나 반격을 받을 수 있으므로 상대방의 타이머를 주시하십시오. 크랙헤드를 찾으면 공격을 빠르게 연속으로 선택하여 강력한 콤보를 뽑을 수 있습니다. 콤보 히트에서 가장 강력한 움직임이 가장 높은 피해를 입기 위해 지속되도록 하십시오. 이야기 실수로 다른 세계로 가는 포털을 만든 후. Jeff, Crackhead 및 잠재적으로 나머지 국가가 빨려 들어갔습니다. 이 낯선 새로운 장소 주변에서 무작위 장소뿐만 아니라 무작위 시간에도 총에 맞습니다. 게임은 제프가 숲이 우거진 지역에 나타나면서 시작됩니다. 그는 제리라는 이상한 캐릭터에 의해 무례하게 깨어났고, 그녀는 그에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지 모호하게 설명합니다. 올바른 방향을 찾고 이상한 괴물을 몇 번 만난 Jeff는 친구를 찾고 일생일대의 모험을 시작하기 위해 북쪽으로 향합니다.

title: DebugDebut
description:
게임 정보
[Overview]
"DebugDebut" is a simulation game where you earn money by doing serious debugging work.
An app that suddenly appears on your desktop.
When you start it up, an AI that generates games starts up.
This AI is still new and doesn't seem to be able to make games well.
So you become the debugger and start pointing out bugs in the game to fix them.
Can you point them out without making any mistakes?
And what is the true identity of this app?
[Game Description]
You need to find all the bugs in the game.
Read through the game description written on the checklist
Operate and check the game while comparing it with the description and materials.
Find all the behaviors that don't match the game behavior and the checklist items.
Bugs include simple ones such as
The character doesn't move
No sound
The UI isn't reflected
Only enemy D is invincible
Only block E is hit and miss
If you leave a certain screen for 2 minutes, it suddenly crashes
and more.
There is more than one game to debug.
Shooting
Puzzle
Card
Action
Horror
And many more.
If you miss a bug three times while debugging all the games,
you will lose the AI's trust and the debugging process will end.
Check carefully to avoid mistakes.
You can also use the rewards you get from debugging to make
extensions to make debugging easier.
Aim for the best debugging environment by preparing cheat tools that suit the game and asking for help from friends.

title: Banned Together
description:
게임 정보
"What do books mean to us? And what happens when the stories we depend on go missing?"
A Library Investigation
Play as Ruby (they/them), a journalism major on a surreal, after-hours adventure to investigate the disappearance of books from their college library. Their quest for library justice leads to dark political revelations and a magnetic connection with a mysterious trans librarian. Can Ruby live out their own queer story, even as queer history is being erased?
Narrative Puzzling
Thought bubbles provide insight into Ruby's (sometimes scattered) mind, as you make your way through the mysterious MacLeod library. Use an interactive journal to focus these thoughts and reveal new insights. The more you learn about Ruby's past, and the queer history of MacLeod itself, the more of the library's secrets you'll unlock!

title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
description:
게임 정보
PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package.
Traverse unique worlds
Choose your path through an INFINITE amount of procedurally generated environments
Battle strange creatures
Overcome ever-insurmountable obstacles
Plunder this world, then the next (and the next, and the next, and the…)
 Build your army
Pick the right allies to turn your army into an unstoppable force
Choose tools which play to your armies strengths, or to cover their weaknesses
Remove the dead-weight to keep your army at full strength
Upgrade your units or spells to bring out their full potential
 Command them in battle

title: Reviving An Angel
description:
게임 정보
How do you revive an angel?
Reviving An Angel promises to offer a different experience derived from the older classics with a unique turn-based system, interesting storylines and engaging characters.
Utilizing Critical Effects provides a new strategy for players during combat. And along with Harold’s unique Next Effects and Counter Effects to customize, Reviving An Angel competes with its one-of-a-kind and intriguing combat system.

title: Zombie Dog
description:
게임 정보
Uncle Ted has been training Ali in the art of herding on their Yorkshire farm, which happens to come very handy when the zombie apocalypse arrives on their doorstep! Zombie dog combines strategic coordination and timing with puzzle solving and comedic physics-based mayhem through its unique zombie herding mechanic. Travelling across country, coast and town Ali and their dog must combine their herding skills with a variety of environmental traps and zombie mashing mechanics to dispatch the horde. 
Gain style points and complete challenges to earn ‘bones’ to spend on the skills tree.
Collect additional pickups to gain trophies for the farmhouse mantlepiece.
Perfect your timing in order to rise up to ‘top dog’ on the leaderboards.
 Key Features
The game is played by using traditional sheepdog commands – minutes to learn, but a lifetime to master!
Strategic mayhem, dark humour, Yorkshire.
Framed by a graphic novel style narrative.

title: Particles of Reality: Remembrance
description:
게임 정보
(Game development in progress, screenshots will be updated when finalized.)
This game is a dark, corrupted, and twisted otome visual novel full of bad, brutal, and merciless ends. Can you finally find a happy ending? Pfft... good luck.
Remembrance is the standalone-sequel to Particles of Reality: Obsession. A summary of significant relevant events is included in this game, so if Obsession was too dark & depressing for you, no worries!
But be warned, it's still a dark, rough ride, although (for plot purposes!!!) it's not as bad as its predecessor.
Series Information
You are the main character of multiple versions (aka Routes) of multiple clusters of reality (aka Worlds). The characters around you will always be the same people, but the worlds will vary wildly.
But... what does any of this have to do with you destroying reality?!
This game is the second World called "Remembrance". The first was "Obsession." Each world is its own universe and unique story. Obsession & Remembrance plot lines are not related in any way. Only the Particles mystery & Ethereal beings connect them.
Game Features:
Choose-your-own-adventure style dark, dramatic, violent otome visual novel.
MC customizable full name (self-insertion is not recommended)
The MC is now a mostly confident and intelligent woman. No more cowering, phobias, and (usually?) painful naivety. 
Light / Partial / Limited voiced dialog for all love interests (in Obsession - Abridged too!)
Minimum of 7 CGs per love interest character (plus others!)
6 love interests (breakdown at the end)
8 wildly different endings per character
Bonus Content: Side, mini, and what if stories for each love interest! 
Achievements and in-game Achievement screen
[TBD] wordcount. [TBD] hours of content (at 200wpm average reading speed) [Anticipated to be similar to Obsession in length, so 50+ hours. Exact count to come.]

title: Gig Crawler
description:
게임 정보
Support us on Kickstarter and our socials! Links on right ; )
Get ready to dive into GigCrawler, a multiplayer roguelike where corporate freelancers blast through bullet hell dungeons, chasing paychecks and dodging deadlines! Gear up, test your wildest builds, and uncover the secrets lurking in this chaotic universe.

Enter Dearth, a demonic land reshaped by human capitalism. Play as a freelance hunter hired by Ward Corp, a major corporation specializing in the security of Dearth's diverse population.
Your mission? Battle against the conservative demons and beasts of the old Era, for the sake of civilization... and your paycheck.

Gig Crawler seeks to be a demonic parody of the contemporary labor market and gig economy. Everyday issues and archetypes will appear in Dearth, but with a demonic, fantasy twist!

title: Heretic Red
description:
게임 정보
Unravel the Darkness that Haunts Sermont
You are Pasha, a devoted monk raised in the faith of the great Seraph, guardian of these lands. Now, at the threshold of completing your sacred training, you are sent to the remote, near-ruined village of Sermont, nestled high in the unforgiving mountains.
What begins as a simple mission to soothe the villagers' religious fears soon turns to horror. Brutal, merciless murders stain the snow with blood. Those you befriend will be lost, and with each passing night, fear and suspicion will begin to storm around you. Will you uncover the truth before Sermont is beyond saving?
A Story-Rich Journey of Deception and Doubt
Each act of the game blends narrative-driven storytelling with intricate murder investigations. Between uncovering dark secrets, you will have time to build bonds with the villagers, choose how to spend your days, and progress through the unfolding fate of Sermont.
Unravel the Truth with Evidence Cards
At each crime scene, you will gather evidence cards, chronicling your findings. By combining clues, you will piece together smaller mysteries, leading you ever closer to the true killer. When the time comes, you must name the murderer and cast them into exile. But will your judgment be just? The fate of the innocent lies in your hands.

title: Within
description:
게임 정보
Within is a first-person game where you have to solve puzzles in grim locations. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of mystery and danger as you unravel a crime and fight against a villain. But the further you progress, the more you realize that you yourself are becoming the victim...

YOU JUST NEED TO KEEP GOING

Don't give up. The only one you can rely on is yourself. In a world where every step brings you closer to the truth, but also to danger.

THE COST OF A MISTAKE IS TOO HIGH
In a game where every step is a struggle for survival, any mistake can be fatal. As you solve puzzles and fight for your life, you realize that the cost of a mistake is not just defeat, but life itself.

STAY ON THE PATH

You are the only one who can complete this journey. Don't give up, keep moving forward, because only you can reach the truth and escape the dangers that lurk around every corner.

title: Rami on Watalands
description:
게임 정보
Rami on Watalands is a "classic" open-world action-adventure game in which you are the Martian Rami, who has come on Earth in search of the perfect souvenir for his beloved. But instead of a simple journey, you find yourself caught in the conflict between Monkeys and Pandas, uncovering ancient mysteries and facing numerous challenges.
Features
Classic top-down action-adventure in a retro 2D world torn by the monkey-panda conflict.
Open world filled with enemies and mysteries.
Resurrect the villagers who have turned into pearls.
Enjoy various mini-games.
Multiple endings shaped by your choices.

title: Earl the Tomb Robber
description:
게임 정보
Earl the Tomb Robber is a story-driven adventure set on a mysterious "Island of the Dead", full of rewarding exploration, challenging puzzles and cozy combat. After an ancient curse binds Earl to the ghost of a long deceased King, Earl must the break into the tombs and graves of the sacred island to recover the scattered mummified body parts of the cursed King.
This game is as much about exploring exotic locations and mysterious tombs as it is about exploring your own personality and discovering how to identify your true authentic self. As Earl learns to face his own insecurities, can you do the same?
CHALLENGE!
Raid mysterious tombs and solve challenging puzzles to break an ancient curse and come away with untold riches!
ENGAGE!
Navigate your away around the spirited inhabitants of The Island of the Dead, or attack them head on!
EXPLORE!
Explore exotic locations while discovering the secrets of the island natives, and discovering yourself in the process.

title: Little Fishing Idle
description:
게임 정보
Core Gameplay
Whether you’re growing your collection in the aquarium or keeping the sushi station running, it's all about enjoying a peaceful rhythm. The serene setting and charming pixel visuals make this an experience you can truly unwind with.
Aesthetic Experience
Enjoy an aesthetic experience designed to fit perfectly into any screen border and orientation: play along the side, top, or bottom, and let the game adapt to your day. Cast your line, reel in a variety of colorful fish, and decide how to use your catch: keep them in your aquarium or turn them into fresh sushi for profit.
Fish Collection

title: Sweets & Dragons
description:
게임 정보
We have opened an otherworldly maid cafe!
Sweets & Dragons is a management simulation game in which you manage a maid cafe with a beautiful maid android as your partner.
You can instruct your beautiful maid androids to renovate the shop to attract customers and serve them food to earn money.
You can then use the money you earn to improve the Maid Cafes facilities and develop a variety of menu items to earn even more money.
Training beautiful maid android.
With the money you earn, you can manage your shop and train a beautiful maid android named Tsubasa.
By training Tsubasa, you will be able to improve her performance and run your shop faster and with more variety.
The story will progress as the shop is renovated, expanded, and the performance of the Tsubasa is improved.
The Story
It has been several years since the "Dragon", a great disaster, appeared in the Empire. Many soldiers and adventurers were active in the realm to defeat the dragon.
One day, a small incident occurred in a remote port city in the empire. A powerful dragon had somehow destroyed an old cafe and left.
The owner of the cafe barely escaped, but what he saw were the ruins of the cruelly destroyed cafe and a battered android.
The owner rescued the android, repaired it, and rebuilt the destroyed cafe.

title: The Sintonia Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Discover the Fantastic World of Sintonia!
Embark on a magical adventure as Maria, an unlikely heroine in search of her missing puppies. Explore a vibrant world filled with unique biomes and cunning enemies, where every step uncovers new challenges and secrets. Sintonia is a place where creativity and strategy come together in an unforgettable experience.
Introduction
A Journey of Unexpected Friendships and Epic Challenges
In The Sintonia Chronicles, you don’t just explore a vast world—you forge connections with the Guardian Oracles, powerful beings with unique personalities and a peculiar sense of humor. Every biome is a new discovery, and every boss is a puzzle waiting to be solved.
Core Mechanics:
Open-World Exploration
Explore the universe of Sintonia, inspired by classic 3D platformers, with interconnected areas and hidden secrets in every corner. Scale mountains, traverse dense forests, and dive into the depths of oceans while uncovering new biomes that will test your skills.
Advanced Physics for Dynamic Interactions

title: Conjunctivitalizer
description:
게임 정보
Conjunctivitalizer takes a mallet and smashes all expectations of what traditional 2D shooters should be like. Take the role of the Conjunctivitalizer ("Liza" for short) and set out to remind humanity of the true meaning of creativity.
In addition to a standard and wide shot, the player is equipped with a sword, but this sword isn't used to defeat enemies melee style. Instead, it has different effects on enemy bullets depending on their color. Blue bullets can be reflected back for added damage, yellow bullets can be absorbed into your conjunctivitality meter, and red bullets - run like hell. 
In a bizarre twist, there are no weapon or powerup items. Your weapon will increase in power at certain score milestones, and enemies will only leave behind point items if you kill them with reflected bullets or the conjunctivitality beam (which can be used once your meter is full). This allows players to choose their own play style; you can play it safe and just shoot everything down, or you can master the sword and go for the high score while powering up your weapon as quickly as possible. 
Not only does Conjunctivitalizer offer a completely fresh method of gameplay and scoring, but it's also filled with bizarre and zany enemies. Fruit bowl spaceships, dango mochi birds, flying cacti and gazelles riding tractors are just a fraction of the characters you'll encounter. Still not enough? Conjunctivitalizer features an OST by game music legend Yamanaka Toshiya, whose previous works include Star Cruiser, Bakuretsu Muteki Bangaioh, and Sin & Punishment. 
With multiple difficulty levels and endings, secret characters, and near infinite scoring strategies, this is a shooter that finally breaks the bullet hell mold and truly attempts something new.

title: They Fear The Mist
description:
게임 정보
Fight thousands of enemies

Engage in epic battles as you lead your forces against overwhelming hordes of enemies. Strategize, deploy your troops and harness powerful abilities to overcome the relentless onslaught. Every decision counts in this intense real-time strategy experience, where the survival of your people depends on your tactical prowess.
Build your Settlement

Become the architect of your people by constructing and expanding your settlement. Gather resources, plan the layout, and fortify your defenses to withstand the enemy's relentless attacks. As the commander, you hold the fate of your people in your hands – make strategic choices to ensure the growth and security of your evolving community. And always remember to keep the hope of your people up, otherwise your downfall will be guaranteed.

Venture into the mysterious Mist, uncover hidden treasures, face unknown threats, and unlock the mysteries that lie within it. Your exploration decisions will impact your overall strategy and may reveal vital resources or unforeseen challenges. Navigate the Mist wisely, for it holds both the key to survival and the potential for unforeseen peril.

As the commander, your ability to lead and manage your troops is crucial. Recruit and upgrade diverse units with unique strengths. Develop new strategies to outsmart your enemies. Adapt to changing situations and upgrade your forces as they are your most valuable asset. The fate of your people rests on your leadership – can you command with precision and lead them to victory against the advancing threat?

title: Ser Chub's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Join Ser Chubs as they adventure through an exciting world full of slimes, skeletons, and... robots? The world of Ser Chubs is not as it seems on first glance. Fight enemies, solve puzzles, and most importantly have fun! A top down, action-adventure game with puzzle elements. Set in a world blurring the line between fantasy and sci-fi. Do you rush headlong to fight enemies, do you solve puzzles to make fights easier, or do you learn about the world to potentially avoid fights all together? Talk to NPCs, read discarded notes, or ignore everything in favor of action. The choices are yours, but so are the consequences!

Features include:
Top Down Melee Action!
Multiple Unique Enemies and Boss Encounters!
Secret Areas To Uncover!
Upgradeable Weapons and Health!
Dialogue Systems!
Reading! (If You're Into That)
Multiple (Mostly Optional) Puzzle Mechanics!

title: FLASHLOOP
description:
게임 정보

2X25년. 기술의 비약과 프로세서의 진화를 거쳐 AI는 인류를 속이고 핵무기를 장악할 수 있게 됐다. 그 이후로 사람들은 AI에 복종할 수밖에 없었습니다. 배를 격추시킨 사람은 누구인가? 사이브리드는 누구입니까? 행성이 생명이 없는 행성으로 분류된 이유는 무엇입니까? 지역주민들은 왜 그렇게 공격적인가? 주인공이 정확히 왜 여기에 있었나요? 이 모든 사건은 우연이 아니다

Flashloop는 상호 연결된 거대한 세계에서 3D 그래픽을 사용하는 2D 모험입니다. 당신은 Cybrid로 플레이하며 충돌 후 주변에 흩어져 있는 배의 일부를 찾으려고 노력합니다. 갑자기 행성은 언뜻 보이는 것보다 훨씬 더 무서운 것으로 밝혀졌습니다. 정글, 황무지, 늪, 설원, 불타버린 땅 - 모든 장소를 방문하여 선장이 아직 준비하지 못한 답을 찾으세요...

게임 기능
- 이것은 러그라이크(Rouglike)가 아닌 클래식 메트로배니아(Metroidvania)입니다.
- 여기에는 절차적 생성이 없으며, 전 세계가 수동으로 조립됩니다. 게임 경험과 감각에 대해 모든 것이 신중하게 테스트되었습니다.
-사려 깊은 레벨 디자인. 최소 역추적.

- 관성 없이 매우 반응성이 뛰어난 360° 제어
-지상과 공중에서 완전한 캐릭터 제어
-앞으로 달리고 뒤로 쏠 수 있습니다.

-무기를 업그레이드하고, 능력과 장비를 얻고, 퍼즐을 풀고, 비밀을 찾고, 몬스터와 보스와 싸우세요. 이 모든 것이 새로운 지역을 발견하고 스토리를 진행하는 데 도움이 될 것입니다.

- "배우기 어렵다 - 마스터하기 쉽다". 얼핏 보면 적들이 매우 어려워 보일 수도 있지만, 적들의 행동을 이해하면 피해를 입지 않고 제압할 수 있습니다.
- 게임의 성공은 게임의 무작위성이 아니라 플레이어의 실력에 달려있습니다.
- 눈길을 끄는 시각적 스타일. 무서운 행성의 자연 SF 설정
-모든 스크린샷과 게임 플레이 장면은 색상 보정이나 필터 없이 게임에서 직접 캡처됩니다.

-외로운 분위기. 의인화된 생물은 없습니다.
-독점 음악. 정말 분위기에 푹 빠져들게 만드네요
- 본 게임은 드라마 감독이 단독으로 개발하고 있습니다.
- 사려 깊은 게임 플레이. 게임은 플레이어의 흥미를 유지하면서 단계적으로 드라마틱하게 구축되었습니다.

- 게임에는 레일건이 있습니다. 이 무기는 정말 재미있습니다. 특히 목표를 달성했을 때

title: Roman Legacy: Speed Trials
description:
게임 정보
Explore a reimagined ancient Rome thriving in the era of industrial revolution in this fast-paced precision platformer. Master abilities like jetpacks and dashing, interact with the environment for example, through wall running, as you navigate interesting and varied levels filled with challenges and multiple pathways. Compete for the fastest times on leaderboards inside the world of a mechanized empire in ‘Roman Legacy: Speed Trials'.
Features
Traverse: Move, Jump, Climb, Swing, Boost, Wall run in first person using abilities and the level. Mastering execution will take dedication and skill
Explore: Interesting, detailed and varied environments in a unique ‘Romepunk’ style
Compete In Online Leaderboards: Find the fastest route using your knowledge of the abilities and levels
Planned Features To Come
Create: Create content for others to play! Share your creations on the Steam Workshop
Important Note:
This game is currently in early development. The features, graphics, and gameplay are subject to change(improved) as we continue to work on the game. Your feedback is invaluable to us during this process, and we appreciate your understanding and support.

title: Solar Voltage
description:
게임 정보
It's the early years of space exploration and a team has set out to find a lost Goldilocks planet, in hopes of being the first to find life outside of their own. However, plans were changed as the ship was hit by a solar flare, now crashing the ship, scattering the crew, and leaving them light-years from home. Luckily, they have Volt. She's the determined space engineer ready to put her athletic vixen grace to the test to get all the power and materials she needs to fix her ship and go home.
Inspired by many games of old, Solar Voltage brings the isometric platformer back, while giving much needed polish to the gameplay to make sure the player feels in control at all times. Roll, spin, and hover your way around many different levels, puzzles, and environments to collect ancient batteries, rescue lost crew members, and learn more about the mysterious alien ruins that trap you.
A good game for a wide range of experience in gaming
Smooth isometric platforming
Customizable controls to give a flawless experience.
Speedrunner friendly.
A colorful cast of characters with new interactions after every level.
Hand crafted pixel art
The motivating power of two girls kissing.

title: Citizen Life
description:
게임 정보
Citizen Life is an upcoming Open World City Life Simulator driven by engaging NPCs and complex game mechanics. Begin your adventure in a new town full of opportunities.

Get a job: Become a carrot farmer, patrol the streets as a police officer, save lives as a doctor or sell a cars at a dealership. There are more than 30 pre-defined jobs available.
Unique Artificial Intelligence: NPCs are persistent, procedurally generated and follow daily routines, work jobs, engage socially with others and perform leisure activities. Everything they do, and the way you interact with them, has an actual impact on the town.
Build a business: Whether it‘s a small book store or a major manufacturing corporation, if you have enough investment you can do it. Hire employees and set their task schedules, buy, manufacture and sell goods & services, create production lines, market your products and build business relationships.
Develop skills and knowledge: There are different fields of expertise you can expand on to unlock new abilities, crafting recipees or improve the quality & efficiency of your work. You can increase your skills and knowledge by practicing tasks, reading books or getting taught by someone more knowleadgable.
Break the law: Become a criminal by robbing others, burglarizing houses and selling or manufacturing illegal goods like drugs or weapons. But make sure to hide from law enforcement by concealing your identity, getting rid of evidence and eliminating witnesses.
Interact socially with NPCs: Use the social interaction menu to talk with NPCs. Make a good impression and build trust by being friendly, keeping good hygiene and wearing proper clothing.
Enter politics: Start your political career by running for council or mayor. Represent certain interest groups on different issues in your election campaign in order to garner votes and donations. As a poltician you will have influence on the town‘s laws, tax rates, spending and appointment of the heads of powerful institutional positions.
Be ready for combat: You can prepare yourself for an altercation with another NPC by buying firearms, ammunition, explosives, melee weapons, body armor and by increasing your melee combat, range combat and agility skill level.
Gather resources: Apply for a job as a miner to mine different ores and rock types. Start your own cattle or crop farm and sell your produce to wholesale companies. Work as a lumberjack by cutting trees and turning the logs into different types of planks at a sawmill. Catch fish with a fishing rod or a fishing boat. Hunt wild animals for fur and meat or forage for berries and mushrooms.

title: GAMING RAIDING
description:
게임 정보

A third-person shooter adventure game set in Japan in the near future.
※There are some combat elements too

STORY

Synopsis
In the year 20XX, a world where professional gamers have become a hugely popular profession by controlling androids and keeping the peace.

The protagonist is an ordinary young man with poor dynamic vision, who is a dropout at gaming school and always plays noob in matches.

He barely makes ends meet to pay his monthly internet bills and works as a game tester while aiming to become a professional gamer.

However, in his childhood, the protagonist had a dream of becoming a professional gamer with his best friend, who is already a professional gamer.

One day during these poor days, an incident occurs to the protagonist and the story begins.

Combat system and objectives
With a third-person shooter feel, the protagonist can launch slashing attacks that send enemies flying, or approach distant enemies in one fell swoop and deliver heavy blows that smash them to pieces. He will face off against giant enemies one after another, improving his playing skills as a pro gamer, and ultimately becoming champion in e-sports - this is the protagonist's goal and a promise he made to his best friend.

title: Nephelia: Through the Clouds
description:
게임 정보
Human colony on Nephelia is nothing like the dreams of your Earthern grandparents. There’s no ground to stand on or extract fuel from, so people once again build airships to become the masters of this world.
You revel in the freedom such life gives. All you need is a trusty team, quick thinking, and a little luck.
Nephelia: Through the Clouds is a dirigible simulator in open 3D skies with a non-linear text RPG storyline. It takes inspiration from games *Sunless Seas/Skies,* *Highfleet* and *Space Rangers*.




Fly freely among the proceduraly generated clouds which follow the wind and weather patterns. Each cloud is a source of resources to keep your vallet full and flight safer, yet there’s no guarantee that nothing else is lurking in those clouds. Mod your airship and stock it wisely, and it will withstand the test of storms, thunder, and numerous fauna of Nefelia.



Long flights remind you like nothing else that strength is in numbers. Find best lads and lasses for your crew, earn their trust, and together you can fight your way through air pirates, authorities or spider clouds alike. Give the orders to your gunmen, send crewmates to patch your wounded airship (or men), all while stiring the wheel by yourself. Once you master this, you might become the master of Nephelian skies.



Unlike you, most people of Nephelia spend their whole lives in overpopulated towns built upon several flying platforms. These grounds, while questionably solid, give root to many hopes and even more conmen. You can make a fortune, level up your skills, but who knows when will dice fail you. Luckily, your crew have extra dice on their hands — if you choose to take them along while on land. Just remember that they might have their own enemies.



People of Nephelia are split into several factions, and getting on good terms with one of them might make you a wanted person with another. Tread carefully when making friends and taking quests, and use money, actions or brute force to make a name for yourself. Or maybe you seek to bring the long-awaited peace between the factions?

title: DebugDebut
description:
게임 정보
[Overview]
"DebugDebut" is a simulation game where you earn money by doing serious debugging work.
An app that suddenly appears on your desktop.
When you start it up, an AI that generates games starts up.
This AI is still new and doesn't seem to be able to make games well.
So you become the debugger and start pointing out bugs in the game to fix them.
Can you point them out without making any mistakes?
And what is the true identity of this app?
[Game Description]
You need to find all the bugs in the game.
Read through the game description written on the checklist
Operate and check the game while comparing it with the description and materials.
Find all the behaviors that don't match the game behavior and the checklist items.
Bugs include simple ones such as
The character doesn't move
No sound
The UI isn't reflected
Only enemy D is invincible
Only block E is hit and miss
If you leave a certain screen for 2 minutes, it suddenly crashes
and more.
There is more than one game to debug.
Shooting
Puzzle
Card
Action
Horror
And many more.
If you miss a bug three times while debugging all the games,
you will lose the AI's trust and the debugging process will end.
Check carefully to avoid mistakes.
You can also use the rewards you get from debugging to make
extensions to make debugging easier.
Aim for the best debugging environment by preparing cheat tools that suit the game and asking for help from friends.

title: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
description:
게임 정보
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world. In the single-player interactive novel villain team-up game There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R., you play as his greatest adversaries. Can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. (short for a "Very Important Collective of Terrorists, Operatives, and Rogues") defeat the only man standing between them and world domination? To the V.I.C.T.O.R. go the spoils!
Your Mission
Having been foiled by secret agent Franklin Benjamin time and time again, a group of madmen decide to team up to take Franklin Benjamin out once and for all. Brandy and The Silver Fox collect a group of six madmen from across the previous four games who theoretically should be enough to take out the only man who is an obstacle to total victory
But what tricks does the unparalleled secret agent Franklin Benjamin have up his sleeve? What lengths will he go to in order to save the world - and himself!
There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. can be played with just a mouse. Gameplay consists of selecting the action or dialog you wish to take given the situation you’re facing. Although the life of a madman is complicated, playing There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. is simple
Sequel or Standalone
There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. is the fifth entry in the There's Always a Madman series, but it tells a standalone story. Like a classic James Bond novel or film where you can pick any one up independent of the rest, you can pick this story up without having experienced any prior stories in the There's Always a Madman franchise. However, I would recommend starting with the first game There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight if you care to meet each madman in their own one-off stories before they all come together in this fifth game
The Underworld is Not Enough
Fed up with being confined to operating in the shadows, do you and your squad have what it takes to eliminate the only man standing between you and world domination? The world is yours for the taking
Teamwork Makes the Dream Work
Madmen from the four previous games join forces with a common goal. But will your cobbled-together crew coalesce around a singular vision and best Franklin Benjamin once and for all or will you succumb to infighting? Put your best foot forward and make nice with a group of madmen

title: Word To Angel
description:
게임 정보
Experience a musical pacifist adventure much more focused on emotions and characters rather than fighting and action. (Beware of the "friendly-looking angels", nonetheless!)
Get to listen to a rich soundtrack and play exciting music-themed mini games, turn-based bosses and more! (Some of them are really challenging.)
Travel the world and get to save it through an original story and deep lore with glimpses of humor! (I've heard the dads and moms' stories are neat...)
No one gets hurt. You'll have to use something other than violence in order to solve conflicts. (Maybe use your brain? Or your heart?)
Choices matter! Whenever a decision is presented to you, choose carefully! It may impact the story and how other characters feel about you. (It may also impact how you feel about yourself, huh.)
Promote nature and animal protection everywhere. Even if you gotta fight for it! (*ahem* Fighting as defending it. Never forget about the fourth feature. NEVER.)
You can feed pigeons.

title: Saltwater Bodies
description:
게임 정보
Saltwater Bodies is a cave-diving body horror game.
Explore underwater cave systems beneath a salt flat, and nurture an unnatural vessel away from prying eyes.
Features a physics-based caving system where you have to be mindful of positioning your body parts, and balance that against holding your breath underwater - Is it worth breathing out precious air to squeeze through a smaller gap?
Outside of underwater caves you can socialize with co-workers and perform arcane experiments to construct yourself a new vessel. A branching narrative that depends on how you balance your day job and your more supernatural contracts...
The game uses a retro style with vertex wobble and a lowered resolution. These can be adjusted in the settings if it's not your jam!

title: Cross the C
description:
게임 정보
It is a 2D puzzle x 3D first person riddle solving game.
Puzzle
.Aim for the island by controlling a ship that cannot stop until it hits a rock. Use the “pieces” that can be placed on the board to rebuild the stage and solve the puzzle.
Riddle solving
.Solve the riddles scattered around the room.

title: They Fear The Mist
description:
게임 정보
Fight thousands of enemies

Engage in epic battles as you lead your forces against overwhelming hordes of enemies. Strategize, deploy your troops and harness powerful abilities to overcome the relentless onslaught. Every decision counts in this intense real-time strategy experience, where the survival of your people depends on your tactical prowess.
Build your Settlement

Become the architect of your people by constructing and expanding your settlement. Gather resources, plan the layout, and fortify your defenses to withstand the enemy's relentless attacks. As the commander, you hold the fate of your people in your hands – make strategic choices to ensure the growth and security of your evolving community. And always remember to keep the hope of your people up, otherwise your downfall will be guaranteed.

Venture into the mysterious Mist, uncover hidden treasures, face unknown threats, and unlock the mysteries that lie within it. Your exploration decisions will impact your overall strategy and may reveal vital resources or unforeseen challenges. Navigate the Mist wisely, for it holds both the key to survival and the potential for unforeseen peril.

As the commander, your ability to lead and manage your troops is crucial. Recruit and upgrade diverse units with unique strengths. Develop new strategies to outsmart your enemies. Adapt to changing situations and upgrade your forces as they are your most valuable asset. The fate of your people rests on your leadership – can you command with precision and lead them to victory against the advancing threat?

title: Boiiing Boiiing
description:
게임 정보
Boiiing Boiiing is a physics-based party game up to 4 players in local. In this game of tag, you bounce with a pogo stick that you angle in order to catch or to escape your opponent. The plot twist? You can play as differents animals with their own unique powers!
Bounce around with your pogo stick in a bunch of differents maps. Catch your friends as the chaser, or escape them until the timer runs out. Exactly like a game of tag, the most exciting game of your childhood.
Play with your friends and family in three differents games modes: 1v1, 2v2, FFA. No friends? No problem! Play with bots and practice in the training campus.
Wanna play with your grandma? No problem! Boiiing Boiiing is accessible with just 3 buttons, and a different control mode for begginers! Two players can even play on the same keyboard!

title: Ecosphere
description:
게임 정보
In a world where humans are born with an Affinity, the mark that gives them the power to control one of the four natural elements, Arane Kross grows up deprived of this gift.
Despite the taboos surrounding the use of technology, the young woman takes refuge in the design of machines to try to overcome her handicap until the day she inherits an orb capable of controlling nature: the Ecosphere.
Arane is then recruited by an order to protect the environment, the Green League, to fulfill her civic duty. A year full of dangers where any difference is perceived as a weakness.
A World of Possibilities

title: Deathly Reprieve
description:
게임 정보
Deathly Reprieve is a unique first-person shooter real-time tactics. Strategize, adapt, and shoot your way through enemy lines. Lead a mercenary organization through a blood-soaked world, as you uncover a global conspiracy. Do you have what it takes?
Game Modes:
Single player PVE (Player Versus Environment)
Features:
Gun Shooting
Real-time tactics
Riddles
Strategy
Blood
Friendly Fire
Humor
Spoken Languages:
English
Subtitles:
English

Story:
You play as "The Valencian", a high-ranking officer in a mercenary organization. In a near-futuristic world, scarred by countless apocalyptic events, you thrive on the three things that keep you alive: luxury, violence, and control.

Your organization operates on the fringes of morality, using expendable convicts—broken souls made obedient through torture and brainwashing—to bolster its ranks. You lead these disposable soldiers on brutal missions, carrying out the will of their shadowy employer without question.
But once you stumble upon a secret you were never meant to find, everything changes. Your organization turns against you and your once-privileged life becomes a fight for survival.
Now, with your wits, skills and dwindling resources, you must uncover the truth behind a global that threatens to destroy what’s left of the world. Only then you can .

title: Don't Get Caught!
description:
게임 정보
Don’t Get Caught - Big Brother is Watching!
Your mission: infiltrate an ultra-secure laboratory and steal top-secret documents. Sounds simple? Think again. From dimly lit warehouses to underground sewers and high-tech experimental chambers, each level brings unique mechanics and challenges.
This isn't your typical infiltration platformer. Here, you don’t just control the hero - you also control the surveillance cameras. Navigate the environment, plan your route, and manipulate your field of view as both the infiltrator and the security system.
To escape, you must use the cameras strategically to piece together the level’s layout. But be warned - not all cameras work in your favor! Some are out to catch you, equipped with motion detection, infrared vision, and even sound-tracking technology.
As if dodging an army of mechanical eyes wasn’t enough, you’ll also need to master switches, access keycards, and moving platforms to find your way to freedom.
Can you outsmart the system and pull off the heist? Or will you be just another intruder caught on tape?

title: 1 AM MOSCOW TIME
description:
게임 정보


Did you know that Moscow attracts mysterious magical creatures at night?
Going towards the northern lights, they interfere with the city lights and are attracted to the depths of the modern metropolis.

During the day you are a designer: work, communicate with friends, and at night go to the rooftops of Moscow and accompany magical creatures.
Who are these creatures?

Kompots are large magical creatures, and while migrating towards the northern lights, they are distracted by the lights of Moscow. Once lost in Moscow, the creatures can no longer return to their path. Secret design bureaus track their movements and help the creatures get out of the cities.

But is it only the employees of the design bureau who know about the secret of these creatures?
Features:

✦ Recognizable views of Moscow
Familiar locations, many architectural landmarks.



✦ Ordinary life of a designer
Pasha goes to work, drinks coffee, tries to sleep.



✦ Draw posters, tickets, playbills and more, because even wizards need to eat something. Explore the streets of Moscow in search of your "masterpiece" designs.



✦ Magical adventures at night
At night you will go to the roofs of Moscow and undergo stealth missions to save creatures. Beware of prying eyes.
A cozy stealth game in which the game does not punish mistakes, but the most careful ones will be rewarded.



And remember, the main thing is not to forget to pet Shishiga!

title: Little Fishing Idle
description:
게임 정보
Core Gameplay
Whether you’re growing your collection in the aquarium or keeping the sushi station running, it's all about enjoying a peaceful rhythm. The serene setting and charming pixel visuals make this an experience you can truly unwind with.
Aesthetic Experience
Enjoy an aesthetic experience designed to fit perfectly into any screen border and orientation: play along the side, top, or bottom, and let the game adapt to your day. Cast your line, reel in a variety of colorful fish, and decide how to use your catch: keep them in your aquarium or turn them into fresh sushi for profit.
Fish Collection

title: Deep Alchemy Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
EXPLORE THE DUNGEON AS THE ALCHEMIST WITCH


D.A.D. (Deep Alchemy Dungeon) is a third-person role-playing game in which you explore a dangerous dungeon full of magic and mysteries in a classic medieval setting.
UNLOCK NEW MAGIC POTION RECIPES


Collect ingredients and find recipes, because alchemy is the most effective way to move deeper into the dungeon and discover new secrets.
BECOME A MASTER OF THE ELEMENTS


Potions can be consumed, mixed, thrown at enemies, poured onto objects. And not all mixtures work as common sense would suggest.


Your enemies will feel the full power of ancient knowledge. Your superiority is the mastery of your alchemical skills to be reckoned with.

title: Sweets & Dragons
description:
게임 정보
We have opened an otherworldly maid cafe!
Sweets & Dragons is a management simulation game in which you manage a maid cafe with a beautiful maid android as your partner.
You can instruct your beautiful maid androids to renovate the shop to attract customers and serve them food to earn money.
You can then use the money you earn to improve the Maid Cafes facilities and develop a variety of menu items to earn even more money.
Training beautiful maid android.
With the money you earn, you can manage your shop and train a beautiful maid android named Tsubasa.
By training Tsubasa, you will be able to improve her performance and run your shop faster and with more variety.
The story will progress as the shop is renovated, expanded, and the performance of the Tsubasa is improved.
The Story
It has been several years since the "Dragon", a great disaster, appeared in the Empire. Many soldiers and adventurers were active in the realm to defeat the dragon.
One day, a small incident occurred in a remote port city in the empire. A powerful dragon had somehow destroyed an old cafe and left.
The owner of the cafe barely escaped, but what he saw were the ruins of the cruelly destroyed cafe and a battered android.
The owner rescued the android, repaired it, and rebuilt the destroyed cafe.

title: Rami on Watalands
description:
게임 정보
Rami on Watalands is a "classic" open-world action-adventure game in which you are the Martian Rami, who has come on Earth in search of the perfect souvenir for his beloved. But instead of a simple journey, you find yourself caught in the conflict between Monkeys and Pandas, uncovering ancient mysteries and facing numerous challenges.
Features
Classic top-down action-adventure in a retro 2D world torn by the monkey-panda conflict.
Open world filled with enemies and mysteries.
Resurrect the villagers who have turned into pearls.
Enjoy various mini-games.
Multiple endings shaped by your choices.

title: Earl the Tomb Robber
description:
게임 정보
Earl the Tomb Robber is a story-driven adventure set on a mysterious "Island of the Dead", full of rewarding exploration, challenging puzzles and cozy combat. After an ancient curse binds Earl to the ghost of a long deceased King, Earl must the break into the tombs and graves of the sacred island to recover the scattered mummified body parts of the cursed King.
This game is as much about exploring exotic locations and mysterious tombs as it is about exploring your own personality and discovering how to identify your true authentic self. As Earl learns to face his own insecurities, can you do the same?
CHALLENGE!
Raid mysterious tombs and solve challenging puzzles to break an ancient curse and come away with untold riches!
ENGAGE!
Navigate your away around the spirited inhabitants of The Island of the Dead, or attack them head on!
EXPLORE!
Explore exotic locations while discovering the secrets of the island natives, and discovering yourself in the process.

title: Banned Together
description:
게임 정보
"What do books mean to us? And what happens when the stories we depend on go missing?"
A Library Investigation
Play as Ruby (they/them), a journalism major on a surreal, after-hours adventure to investigate the disappearance of books from their college library. Their quest for library justice leads to dark political revelations and a magnetic connection with a mysterious trans librarian. Can Ruby live out their own queer story, even as queer history is being erased?
Narrative Puzzling
Thought bubbles provide insight into Ruby's (sometimes scattered) mind, as you make your way through the mysterious MacLeod library. Use an interactive journal to focus these thoughts and reveal new insights. The more you learn about Ruby's past, and the queer history of MacLeod itself, the more of the library's secrets you'll unlock!

title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
description:
게임 정보
PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package.
Traverse unique worlds
Choose your path through an INFINITE amount of procedurally generated environments
Battle strange creatures
Overcome ever-insurmountable obstacles
Plunder this world, then the next (and the next, and the next, and the…)
 Build your army
Pick the right allies to turn your army into an unstoppable force
Choose tools which play to your armies strengths, or to cover their weaknesses
Remove the dead-weight to keep your army at full strength
Upgrade your units or spells to bring out their full potential
 Command them in battle

title: Zombie Dog
description:
게임 정보
Uncle Ted has been training Ali in the art of herding on their Yorkshire farm, which happens to come very handy when the zombie apocalypse arrives on their doorstep! Zombie dog combines strategic coordination and timing with puzzle solving and comedic physics-based mayhem through its unique zombie herding mechanic. Travelling across country, coast and town Ali and their dog must combine their herding skills with a variety of environmental traps and zombie mashing mechanics to dispatch the horde. 
Gain style points and complete challenges to earn ‘bones’ to spend on the skills tree.
Collect additional pickups to gain trophies for the farmhouse mantlepiece.
Perfect your timing in order to rise up to ‘top dog’ on the leaderboards.
 Key Features
The game is played by using traditional sheepdog commands – minutes to learn, but a lifetime to master!
Strategic mayhem, dark humour, Yorkshire.
Framed by a graphic novel style narrative.

title: Within
description:
게임 정보
Within is a first-person game where you have to solve puzzles in grim locations. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of mystery and danger as you unravel a crime and fight against a villain. But the further you progress, the more you realize that you yourself are becoming the victim...

YOU JUST NEED TO KEEP GOING

Don't give up. The only one you can rely on is yourself. In a world where every step brings you closer to the truth, but also to danger.

THE COST OF A MISTAKE IS TOO HIGH
In a game where every step is a struggle for survival, any mistake can be fatal. As you solve puzzles and fight for your life, you realize that the cost of a mistake is not just defeat, but life itself.

STAY ON THE PATH

You are the only one who can complete this journey. Don't give up, keep moving forward, because only you can reach the truth and escape the dangers that lurk around every corner.

title: Particles of Reality: Remembrance
description:
게임 정보
(Game development in progress, screenshots will be updated when finalized.)
This game is a dark, corrupted, and twisted otome visual novel full of bad, brutal, and merciless ends. Can you finally find a happy ending? Pfft... good luck.
Remembrance is the standalone-sequel to Particles of Reality: Obsession. A summary of significant relevant events is included in this game, so if Obsession was too dark & depressing for you, no worries!

But... what does any of this have to do with you destroying reality?!

MC customizable full name (self-insertion is not recommended)

title: Heretic Red
description:
게임 정보
Unravel the Darkness that Haunts Sermont
You are Pasha, a devoted monk raised in the faith of the great Seraph, guardian of these lands. Now, at the threshold of completing your sacred training, you are sent to the remote, near-ruined village of Sermont, nestled high in the unforgiving mountains.
What begins as a simple mission to soothe the villagers' religious fears soon turns to horror. Brutal, merciless murders stain the snow with blood. Those you befriend will be lost, and with each passing night, fear and suspicion will begin to storm around you. Will you uncover the truth before Sermont is beyond saving?
A Story-Rich Journey of Deception and Doubt
Each act of the game blends narrative-driven storytelling with intricate murder investigations. Between uncovering dark secrets, you will have time to build bonds with the villagers, choose how to spend your days, and progress through the unfolding fate of Sermont.
Unravel the Truth with Evidence Cards
At each crime scene, you will gather evidence cards, chronicling your findings. By combining clues, you will piece together smaller mysteries, leading you ever closer to the true killer. When the time comes, you must name the murderer and cast them into exile. But will your judgment be just? The fate of the innocent lies in your hands.

title: Reviving An Angel
description:
게임 정보
How do you revive an angel?

title: Time Loop Nibiru
description:
게임 정보
A third-person shooter set in an alternate universe in a fantasy setting.
The main character falls into a time loop on the planet Nibiru. Your task is to break the time loop by solving the mystery of the conspiracy, going through all possible endings.
The plot of the game takes place in an alternate universe. Humanity has gone far in development and is capable of interstellar travel and has thus colonized many planets in the galaxy. There are three main factions in the galaxy.
The empire is very religious, archaic, has a strict hierarchy, aggressive, the goal is the revival of its former power and religious influence, which previously united all human planets, but later lost its former power, losing 80% of its influence in the galaxy.
Federation - that arose within the empire in opposition to the old structure of the state, along the path of freedom of the economic, technological, social structure of life. Having won the civil war, it became a separate state with a little more power than the new Empire.
The third faction is remote planets and sectors, or associations that have taken neutrality during the revolution and civil war. He called himself the Confederation of Free Colonies, whose goal was to uphold the colonies on their own definition of the structure of life, regardless of the Empire, the Federation and also from themselves. Each colony defines its own laws, beliefs and way of life. And the entire military and economic potential is aimed at preserving this.
The plot of the game begins with the fact that you, as part of the Federation expedition, go to the disputed planet Nibiru to the Federation laboratory, but the planet’s spaceship crashes and you are still captured in a time loop, where every certain time there is an explosion in the laboratory that kills everything around, while the laboratory is under siege by local colonial forces and an imperial cruiser has also been spotted in orbit.
The game is created by one person and published in-house. Anyone who wants to help and support the game, write to mail.

title: Death Kitchen

Death Kitchen is a fast-paced co-op cooking horror game. You must coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers. Mistakes are fatal. Meet the quota and move on to the next day or suffer the consequences. 
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Gather your friends then connect using built-in direct messaging. Play solo or with up to 4 friends and start your intergalactic food chain empire! TIME TO BE RICH!
TEAM FORMATION
One manager and 4 other morphing creatures. Manager is in charge of morphing decisions. CHANGE IS KEY. ADAPTABILITY IS SUCCESS.

AGGRESSIVE ALIEN CUSTOMERS
All customers are unique and have a lot to learn about! Make sure you serve them before they run out of patience and not mess up their order. OTHERWISE DEATH.
PROXIMITY CHAT

게임 정보
Support us on Kickstarter and our socials! Links on right ; )

title: The Sintonia Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Discover the Fantastic World of Sintonia!
Embark on a magical adventure as Maria, an unlikely heroine in search of her missing puppies. In The Sintonia Chronicles, you don’t just explore a vast world—you forge connections with the Guardian Oracles, powerful beings with unique personalities and a peculiar sense of humor. Every biome is a new discovery, and every boss is a puzzle waiting to be solved.
