Open-World Exploration
Explore the universe of Sintonia, inspired by classic 3D platformers, with interconnected areas and hidden secrets in every corner. Scale mountains, traverse dense forests, and dive into the depths of oceans while uncovering new biomes that will test your skills.
Advanced Physics for Dynamic Interactions

title: Conjunctivitalizer
description:
게임 정보
Conjunctivitalizer takes a mallet and smashes all expectations of what traditional 2D shooters should be like. Take the role of the Conjunctivitalizer ("Liza" for short) and set out to remind humanity of the true meaning of creativity.
In addition to a standard and wide shot, the player is equipped with a sword, but this sword isn't used to defeat enemies melee style. Instead, it has different effects on enemy bullets depending on their color. Blue bullets can be reflected back for added damage, yellow bullets can be absorbed into your conjunctivitality meter, and red bullets - run like hell. 
In a bizarre twist, there are no weapon or powerup items. Your weapon will increase in power at certain score milestones, and enemies will only leave behind point items if you kill them with reflected bullets or the conjunctivitality beam (which can be used once your meter is full). This allows players to choose their own play style; you can play it safe and just shoot everything down, or you can master the sword and go for the high score while powering up your weapon as quickly as possible. 
Not only does Conjunctivitalizer offer a completely fresh method of gameplay and scoring, but it's also filled with bizarre and zany enemies. Fruit bowl spaceships, dango mochi birds, flying cacti and gazelles riding tractors are just a fraction of the characters you'll encounter. Still not enough? Conjunctivitalizer features an OST by game music legend Yamanaka Toshiya, whose previous works include Star Cruiser, Bakuretsu Muteki Bangaioh, and Sin & Punishment. 
With multiple difficulty levels and endings, secret characters, and near infinite scoring strategies, this is a shooter that finally breaks the bullet hell mold and truly attempts something new.

title: Elemental Shifter
description:
게임 정보
Choose Your Warrior Path
After clearing rooms and defeating bosses, gain the option to choose from 25+ different Path's with over 10 unique game changing abilities and find that Path that gives you the perfect stats to show the true potential of your build.
Explore And Loot To Find New Weapons
Defeat enemies and explore your randomly generated rooms to find chests with loot including 20+ different weapons ranging from Greatswords to Spears, all having 2 random activatable abilities with over 15 more to discover.

title: The Forgotten Rooms
description:
게임 정보
현실이 사라지면 무엇이 남을까?
눈을 뜨자, 당신은 이상하고 버려진 구조물 안에 있다는 것을 깨닫습니다. 고요함은 으스스하고, 빛은 깜빡거리고, 벽은 허무한 느낌을 풍긴다. 당신은 여기서 나가야 합니다... 하지만 누군가 당신을 지켜보고 있습니다.
Forgotten Rooms는 심리적 공포와 생존 요소를 결합한 게임으로, 플레이어를 미지의 세계로 끌어들입니다. 현실과 환각의 경계가 점점 얇아지면서 당신은 어둠과 외로움, 그리고 당신을 쫓는 존재들에 맞서 싸워야 하며, 출구를 찾으려고 노력하면서 정신 건강을 유지해야 합니다.
주요 기능:
* 어둠과의 싸움: 손전등은 당신의 유일한 친구이지만, 배터리가 죽기 전에 현명하게 사용해야 합니다.
* 퍼즐과 탈출: 지혜를 사용하여 문을 열고 비밀 통로를 발견하여 출구에 도달하세요.
* 심리적 공포 요소: 실제인가 상상인가? 당신은 보는 것을 얼마나 신뢰할 수 있나요?
* 현실을 왜곡하는 호텔: 게임이 진행되면서, 익숙해 보이지만 똑같이 불안한 호텔에서 길을 잃습니다.
여기서 나갈 방법이 있나요? 아니면 떠나고 싶지 않은 무언가를 발견하게 될까요?

title: Gambetto

Gambetto combines roguelike deckbuilding and the rules of chess to create a challenging, turn-based strategy card game.
Big-Brain Combat!
Confront adversaries on a 5x5 chess board, and leverage your wit with careful placements, timed movements, and varied card synergies. Claim your foe’s king to win the round and dramatically improve your deck with hundreds of randomized rewards!
Improve Your Deck!

Gambetto is still under development, and upcoming features include:

title: Pogan
description:
게임 정보
Waking up in the Sacred Grove, you realize there is little time to waste. With gods and demons roaming freely and peace to the world disturbed, you have to do anything in your might to restore order to your homeland. Set out on an adventure that is about to decide on the fate of Wyraj.

THE WORLD IS WAITING

Swing right into the action in an procedural generated world of Pogan, where every nook and cranny has a story to tell. Day and night, progress in your adventure while on a constant lookout for undiscovered territories. Prove your strength in combat, deal with hordes of enemies, and conquer new lands.

MARK YOUR TERRITORY

To experience rare, peaceful moments in the wicked world where danger lurks in every corner, you will be able to use your equipment to set up countless bases. Given you successfully conquered enemies’ territories, you might even settle down for a while, building villages filled with various structures beneficial to your growth and journey.

IT’S YOU VS THEM

The world you explore is filled with mythological creatures that won’t always act in your favor. If powerful gods and demons stand in your way, will you be able to conquer them all and victoriously move forward?



- Play single or multiplayer up to 50 players via user hosted servers
- Travel the procedurally generated worlds full of mysterious places to reveal and conquer
- Explore the secrets of crafting by acquiring unique items with special properties allowing you to upgrade weapons, clothes and other props
- Develop your fighting skills by deciding which combat style you want to broaden with the advanced abilities leveling system
- Tame animals and grow plants, use them to cook better dishes for you and your friends to be more agile and strong
- Create villages and cities by developing construction skills and perfecting building materials using an extensive and versatile building system
- Bring peace on earth by opposing the Slavic gods and demons, each of whom has mysterious weak points to discover and use against them
- Advanced combat system with multiple attacks, blocks and counters



- Health and stamina
- Crafting
- Building
- Farming
- Cooking
- Collecting resources
- Breeding
- Brewing
- Fishing
- Weather and day cycles
- Abilities and leveling up
- Horse riding
- PvP
- PvE

title: Lethal Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
"Lethal Dungeon" is a Lethal Puzzle Card Game.
In every battle, you must make a one-turn kill with only the first hand you are dealt.
You will get more rewards if you defeat enemies with the fewest number of cards as possible,
If you cannot defeat the enemy, you can use money to duplicate cards.
Use the money you earn to strengthen your deck!
Fight stronger enemies and earn money!
Repeat this process to conquer the dungeon.

title: CORING
description:
게임 정보
확장되고, 얽히고, 악화되는... 가지치기
무한히 성장하는 시간선이 얽혀 「세계수」를 형성합니다. 그 중 일부 시간 가지가 이상 변이를 일으켰을 때, '가지치기자'인 당신은... 어떻게 할 것입니까?
「당신은 변이된 악의 가지를 잘라내야만 합니다」— 정원사
낯선 세계로 나아가, 재앙의 근원을 찾아내고, 그것을 제거하십시오......
「...그녀는... 왜 이렇게 낯익게 느껴지는 걸까?」
핵심 메커니즘 — "선 긋기 계획" 게임 플레이!

title: The shield of the Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
"The Shield of the Kingdom" is a strategy + light action game, which sets itself apart from traditional tower defense games. In addition to supporting the classic rich pairing of heroes, skills, and troops, "Shield of the Kingdom" also offers extra features such as hero's signature gear and movement in the battlefield . Beyond exploring and devising combat strategies to counter different types of enemy forces and bosses, players can also enjoy a unique gaming experience distinct from tradition through hero role transformations brought by signature gear, battlefield positioning, and the deployment of reinforcements.
In the game, enemies will attack the player with unpredictable formations and strength. Try different hero combinations and their skill synergies to fend off the enemies! Additionally, selecting the necessary allied troops to deploy can compensate for weaknesses in the battle situation, achieving twice the result with half the effort.
autokwd: The shield of the Kingdom,王国之盾

title: Steampunk Shinobi
description:
게임 정보
스팀펑크 시노비는 역동적이고 진화하는 세계를 통해 끊임없는 복수의 여정을 떠나는 로그라이트 액션 게임입니다.
스팀펑크의 독창성과 명예를 중시하는 중세 일본의 전통이 만나는 세계로 들어가 보세요. 시노비의 혈통으로서, 죽음을 맞이할 때마다 다음 세대의 클랜에 횃불을 넘겨주는 임무를 수행해야 합니다.
계보 중심 게임플레이
각 시노비는 절차적 세대를 통해 형성되며, 모든 후계자와 함께 탐험할 수 있는 고유한 능력과 속성을 제공합니다.
당신의 유산을 위조하세요
일반 장비부터 전설 가보에 이르기까지 시간이 지남에 따라 더 강해지는 소중한 아이템을 본부로 보내세요. 고유한 능력과 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하는 새로운 시설로 기지를 확장하여 각 세대가 이전 세대보다 더 강력한 힘을 발휘할 수 있도록 하세요.

title: Changer Seven
description:
게임 정보
A LOVE LETTER TO OUR CHILDHOOD HEROES, AND THE CHANGE THEY LEFT IN OUR HEARTS!
Dive into Changer Seven, an exhilarating 3D third-person action-adventure where fast-paced combat meets stunning visuals and a gripping narrative.
Lead a squad of super-powered teenagers in a tag-team/assist-based combat system to battle hordes of enemies and uncover the dark mysteries surrounding their legacy. As you fight to save humanity, you’ll also face the personal struggles that come with being a hero and the changes your choices can bring to the future.
BE THE CHANGE!
Play as your favorite Changer Seven, unleash radical combos, and call in allies to assist you in battle. Face a terrifying old menace transforming citizens into monstrous beings and defend the city of Sunny Point from total annihilation!
FEATURES
✅ REUNITE THE PARTY – Gather and control your favorite Changer Seven!
✅ TAG TEAM COMBAT – Call in allies for assist-based attacks!
✅ A VAST WORLD TO EXPLORE – Traverse cityscapes, underground hideouts, and mysterious dungeons beyond Sunny Point.
✅ EPIC CINEMATICS – Immerse yourself in a breathtaking story of courage and transformation!
✅ DYNAMIC COMBO SYSTEM – Chain attacks, switch characters, and master devastating skills!
✅ SPECIAL ABILITIES – Unlock powerful new abilities to crush your foes!
✅ BOSS BATTLES – Take down colossal enemies and reclaim lost territories!
ARE YOU READY TO EMBRACE THE CHANGE?

title: Avalon: Sacred Crusade
description:
게임 정보


"Beware the schemes of mortal men. For all the shortness of their lives, they lust to leave their mark. Before this hubris, even the Gods can be tumbled." - Merlin the Outcast

To some, Avalon is an idea, a myth, an ideal, perfection; it is a place outside of time or space, an eternal edifice. To others, it is home. The Avalonians share much with Humanity, but one cannot remain in Avalon for long without becoming something... else. Long ago, in the forgotten age of The Migration, the Covenant was formed: the bridges between realms would be closed.

Their greatest criminals, however, continued to be cast out forever to languish in the mundane realm. Some lived as Oracles, Saints, or Wizards. Others we remember in legends of darkness: Sorcerers, Shapeshifters, Blood-drinkers, scattered across time.

Now though, the realms grow close once again, the veil between them weakening by unknown machinations. The Grail has been stolen, and without it, evils long buried are rising in ever greater numbers. The call to battle has gone out for the first time in this age, and many have answered it. These new defenders of the ancient Covenant must not fail, for the fate of both realms now hangs in the balance.



A Blast From the Past

Return to an era before all stats were homogenized into just health and mana. Avalon: Sacred Crusade takes heavy inspiration from popular RPG titles of the 1990s and features rich character customization that allows you to select your character's background, attributes, spells, and equipment.

No easy recoveries or quick wins here. Deal with a classic death penalty system where you drop your items on the ground and need to retrieve them. Experience what it was truly like to play early MMORPGs and graphical MUDs.

Experience a living world with a depth not often found in the modern gaming era. Trade and exchange different currencies, meet strange and interesting races, and improve your character's individual relationship with various NPC groups.

You may choose to adventure alone, however, the game features a robust party system which allows up to six players to work together in the same group. For the best experience, bring your friends - or make new ones in the persistent shared world of Avalon: Sacred Crusade!





Listen to classic 16-bit midi style music while you slash away at pre-rendered 2D sprites. You can experience all of this without the usual hassle of running a retro game on a modern system. Avalon: Sacred Crusade will run on any DirectX 10 capable PC!





We are passionate about maintaining a good relationship with our community. We welcome any feedback that you might have involving the game or its development, be it positive or critical. We plan to run regular community events that you can participate in and earn special achievements. If this interests you, consider joining our discord!

title: Elder Magic Squad
description:
게임 정보
Elder Magic Squad is an adventure game with FPS, Roguelite, and magical content. Players control an old wizard who learns a variety of magic and can experience different growth and gameplay, as well as adventures using randomly dropped magic.
The game can be played single-player or in co-op with up to four other players.
Each fresh start creates a completely new experience. Choose from a variety of heroes' abilities, magic, and skills to enjoy battles.
Translated with (free version)

title: EvilTrap
description:
게임 정보
EvilTrap

Prepare for an unnerving adventure in EvilTrap, an open-world psychological survival horror game where every playthrough offers a fresh nightmare. Stranded on a desolate island, you'll face relentless supernatural threats as you scavenge for essential supplies and navigate a world teeming with danger.



Key Features:

Dynamic Horror Experience: Each game session is uniquely terrifying with 90% of jump scares being entirely random, ensuring that no two encounters are ever the same.

Adaptive AI: The island’s malevolent intelligence relentlessly tracks your progress, but it’s not the only thing lurking in the shadows. Stay vigilant as both the environment and the AI adapt to your strategies.

Survival Mechanics: To endure, you'll need to manage your hunger, find rest, and craft essential tools like traps and safe havens. Balance resource gathering with the constant threat of the unknown.


EvilTrap challenges you to confront your fears in a world where every corner holds a new threat and survival depends on your ability to adapt and overcome.

title: Watchman
description:
게임 정보
STORY:
The game takes place in the subconscious mind of its female protagonist.
You find yourself in an old, abandoned wrestling gym. It is empty, silent… but the silence is deceiving. Soon, you realize that you are not just a night watchman—you are trapped in the distorted space of your own mind.
This abandoned gym is merely a shell. Inside, it holds fragments of the past, broken memories, and entities that conceal a terrifying truth. You must explore this unsettling world, facing what was meant to be forgotten, time and time again.
But are you ready to see where it all leads?
FEATURES:
Unique experience from gameplay and atmosphere.

title: Garden Ink
description:
게임 정보
Game Description
Garden Ink is a game, in which you bring an empty world to life. You plant biomes that you can choose freely, and each area offers new content and secrets to discover.
Gameplay
By solving minigames and puzzles, you unlock new biomes and decorative elements. With these, you can gradually beautify your world. Your goal is to create a flourishing and beautiful environment. The gameplay gives you a top-down view of your world. You can directly interact with it and unlock various tools. With these tools, you can paint plants, replant them, or combine decorative elements. This opens up countless possibilities to design your world in a unique way.
Atmosphere
Everything is accompanied by a relaxing soundtrack, cute sounds from the creatures, and harmonious visuals. Garden Ink invites you to play at your own pace and create a cozy little world that is entirely your own.

title: Looters Inc.
description:
게임 정보
Looters Inc is a 4 player physics-based co-op heist game, where you and your friends break into houses, clinics, banks and more to steal valuable items. Nothing is safe, even the people.
Key Features:
Procedurally Generated Maps: Each burglary attempt is a new experience, as rooms and furniture are randomized. Maybe the next house you target will only have bathrooms!
Agressive NPCs: The home owners will not take your thuggery lying down. They are violent and they work together. You might lose some of your fellow robbers in action, but sometimes, sacrifices must be done.
Multiple Escape Vehicle Upgrades: You will start with a rusty old truck, with a small flat bed. But do not worry, using the money you steal, you can upgrade to better machinery. Better vehicle = More space for stolen goods.
Don't Forget Your Tools: Choose between a variety of tools to help your robbery go smoothly. From a "Silent Window Breaker" to make sure you don't wake up the residents, to a "Baseball Bat" to put them back to sleep if they do wake up, you will find tools for every play style.
Bonus Items: Experience the satisfying rush of opening a safe and finding a $1000 box of jewelery! Or the grief of finding a 1$ trash bag. Maybe the odds will be in your favour next time around.
Local and Online Co-op: Team up with up to 3 more looters in local or online multiplayer. And remember, robbery is more fun when done with friends!

title: Rune Dice
description:
게임 정보
Rune Dice는 덱 빌딩 게임의 전략적 깊이와 주사위 던지기의 짜릿한 메카닉을 결합했습니다. 고대 룬의 마법을 사용하여 적의 무리와 싸우세요!
나만의 룬 덱 구축하기
각각 고유한 힘을 가진 고대 룬을 찾아 사용하세요. 적의 공격을 막는 방어적인 쉴드 룬부터 상대를 움직이지 못하게 하는 프로스트 룬까지 - 당신만의 컬렉션을 만들고 강력한 시너지를 발견하세요.
더 멀리 갈수록 더 흥미로워집니다. 룬의 능력을 극적으로 변화시키는 룬 진화 의식을 수행하세요. 독 룬을 변형시켜 적이 죽을 때 독소를 퍼뜨리게 하거나, 쉴드 룬을 강화하여 공격자에게 데미지를 반사하게 만드세요.
주사위 아레나
조준하고 주사위를 던지세요. 매번의 던지기는 강력한 조합을 만들고 룬을 활성화할 기회입니다.

title: Hexmental
description:
게임 정보
Experience a new take on the MOBA genre!
Dive into fast-paced 10-minute matches of non-stop skirmish filled with impactful decision-making. Playing is easy—just move, cast spells and capture treasures to secure victory! However, mastering the game will take more than luck.
Tip the battle in your favour with elemental mayhem!
Hex grid-based maps and spell arsenal consisting of 6 different elements allow you to control the battlefield with towering flames, slippery ice, soaking water, and sturdy rocks. Each element has unique spells and effects that you can combine to discover even more ways to express yourself during every single match!
Choose your loadout and play it your way!
Go solo or team up with friends in quick matches, ranked games, or custom lobbies. With a variety of elements, items and spell combinations at your disposal it's easy to come up with new ways to play!

title: Mearcair/System Pulse
description:
게임 정보
짜릿한 액션으로 가득한 총알 천국, 포지셔닝과 기술 구축에 도전하는 시스템 펄스에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 무자비한 로봇 드론 군단을 거느린 호스트 펄스가 운영하는 게임 쇼에 참가해 실력을 겨뤄보세요. 음악의 비트에 따라 플레이어를 전멸시키려는 로봇 무리의 움직임과 공격이 결정되는 박동하는 경기장을 누비며 혼돈의 교향곡에 빠져보세요.
💥 리듬에 맞춘 대혼란

시스템 펄스에서 음악은 단순한 반주가 아니라 게임의 생명선입니다. 비트에 맞춰 로봇이 움직이고 공격하는 아드레날린이 솟구치는 경험을 준비하세요. 리듬에 맞춰 동작을 조정하지 않으면 어떤 파멸에 직면하게 됩니다. 긴장을 늦추지 말고 음악에 귀를 기울이며 모든 움직임을 음악에 맡기세요.
💥 강렬한 총알 천국

다양하고 역동적인 경기장에서 로봇 적 무리에 맞서 심장을 두근거리게 하는 전투를 벌이세요. 강력한 무기로 무장하고 반사 신경과 정확성을 최대한 발휘해 보세요. 적을 피하고, 파괴적인 화력을 발휘하고, 전략적으로 적을 제압하여 박진감 넘치는 전투에서 살아남으세요.
💥 위험한 파워업

여정 중에 다양한 강력한 능력과 무기를 발견하고 잠금 해제하세요. 생존력을 높이고, 약화 상태 효과를 발동하고, 무기를 업그레이드하여 점점 더 강력해지는 적을 물리치세요. 올바른 조합으로 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있으므로 업그레이드를 현명하게 선택하세요.
박동감 넘치는 음악의 비트가 끊임없는 액션과 동기화되는 매혹적인 오디오 환경에 빠져보세요. 음악의 비트를 활용하여 완벽한 샷을 정렬하고 위험을 피하세요.

title: GameChanger - Episode 1
description:
게임 정보
영원한 실패의 순환을 깨세요!
중간세계는 오랫동안 경직된 상태에 있었습니다. 위대한 포털들의 집단 지능과 그들 하인들의 지속적인 존재는 주민들이 자신들의 세계를 절대 떠나지 못하게 합니다. 하지만 레이드 프로그램은 그 창조자의 계획을 끈질기게 따릅니다. 반복되는 바이러스의 도움으로, 그는 모든 포털을 닫고 끝없는 드래곤을 물리쳐 자신의 임무를 완수하고 중간세계에서 빠져나갈 방법을 가능하게 하려고 합니다.
중간세계를 탐험하세요!
GameChanger는 트윈 스틱 슈터 전투와 퍼즐 요소가 있는 2D 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 중간세계의 해방자로서, 당신은 레이드가 이끄는 바이러스 역할을 맡습니다. 바이러스는 떠다니며 이동하고 발사체를 사용하여 적을 물리치고, 스위치를 활성화하는 등 다양한 일을 할 수 있습니다. 선형적인 시작 지역 이후에는 작지만 훌륭한 오픈 월드가 기다리고 있으며, 그곳에서 세 개의 던전을 발견하고 어떤 순서로든 완료하여 드래곤에 맞설 수 있습니다. 던전 외에도, 퍼즐 해결, 미니게임, 전투 아레나 및 기타 활동을 통해 얻을 수 있는 많은 선택적 업그레이드가 세계 곳곳에 숨겨져 있습니다. 모든 업그레이드를 획득함으로써, 당신은 주요 여정을 더 쉽게 만들 뿐만 아니라 중간세계와 레이드의 이야기에 대해 더 많이 배울 수 있습니다!

title: Take off mask
description:
게임 정보

'가면을 벗다'는 여러 캐릭터들로 구성된 대규모 파티를 운용하며 신비의 세계 '다리안'의 곳곳을 탐험하는 게임입니다. 새로운 동료와 만나고, 불의의 적들과 싸우고, 숨겨진 보물을 찾으며 '북쪽의 악마'를 향해 진군해 나가야 합니다.

플레이어가 조작할 기본 캐릭터는 가면을 쓰고 있으며 이 세계의 불청객입니다. 말이 통하지 않는 이 세계의 주민들과의 소통을 도와줄 '가면'만이 유일하게 의지할만한 점입니다. '가면'은 그 힘으로 주변인들의 감정을 정확히 캐치해 정보를 주게 됩니다. 여러분은 이를 보고 상황을 나름대로 파악하여 여러분만의 선택을 통해 이야기를 이끌어 나가게 됩니다.

수많은 캐릭터들이 각자의 소속, 종족, 가치관에 따라 싸우고, 연계하고, 맺어집니다. 여러분의 선택을 기다리는 동료들은 많이 있지만 한 번에 모든 이들을 동료로 맞이하는 것은 불가능에 가깝죠. 때로는 특징없는 자코 캐릭터들로 남은 빈 자리를 채워야 할지도 모릅니다. 하지만 그 조차도 고유한 선택의 한 갈래로서 재미를 느끼게 해줄 것입니다.

'가면을 벗다'는 몰입감 높은 플레이 경험을 위해 로딩이나 컷신 등에 의해 조작이 중단되는 상황을 최대한 없애는 다소 실험적인 시스템을 추구합니다. 16x16 타일 사이즈의 맵은 백그라운드로 로딩되고, 각 지역의 이야기는 멈춤 없이 벌어지는 이벤트를 통해 접하게 됩니다.

언뜻 복잡해 보이는 화면이지만, 한 번에 하나의 캐릭터만을 조작하며 카메라가 조작중인 캐릭터를 쫒아다니기 때문에, 막상 실제 조작을 해보면 생각보다 쉬운 플레이 감각을 느낄 수 있습니다. 또한 RTS나 시뮬레이션 게임이 아니기 때문에 키보드와 게임 패드를 이용해서도 원활한 플레이가 가능하기 때문에 어렵지 않게 플레이해 나갈 수 있습니다.

title: Fishing Echoes
description:
게임 정보
In Fishing Echoes, elemental forces await. Track down clues with each catch and get prepared for epic boss battles in this thrilling fishing adventure.
Elemental fish present a distinct challenge with their powerful statuses. These fish can manipulate elements to hinder your progress. Adapt your strategies, outwit their elemental tricks, and capture them to turn the tide in your favour.

title: Mearcair/System Pulse
description:
게임 정보
짜릿한 액션으로 가득한 총알 천국, 포지셔닝과 기술 구축에 도전하는 시스템 펄스에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 무자비한 로봇 드론 군단을 거느린 호스트 펄스가 운영하는 게임 쇼에 참가해 실력을 겨뤄보세요. 음악의 비트에 따라 플레이어를 전멸시키려는 로봇 무리의 움직임과 공격이 결정되는 박동하는 경기장을 누비며 혼돈의 교향곡에 빠져보세요.
💥 리듬에 맞춘 대혼란

시스템 펄스에서 음악은 단순한 반주가 아니라 게임의 생명선입니다. 비트에 맞춰 로봇이 움직이고 공격하는 아드레날린이 솟구치는 경험을 준비하세요. 리듬에 맞춰 동작을 조정하지 않으면 어떤 파멸에 직면하게 됩니다. 긴장을 늦추지 말고 음악에 귀를 기울이며 모든 움직임을 음악에 맡기세요.
💥 강렬한 총알 천국

다양하고 역동적인 경기장에서 로봇 적 무리에 맞서 심장을 두근거리게 하는 전투를 벌이세요. 강력한 무기로 무장하고 반사 신경과 정확성을 최대한 발휘해 보세요. 적을 피하고, 파괴적인 화력을 발휘하고, 전략적으로 적을 제압하여 박진감 넘치는 전투에서 살아남으세요.
💥 위험한 파워업

여정 중에 다양한 강력한 능력과 무기를 발견하고 잠금 해제하세요. 생존력을 높이고, 약화 상태 효과를 발동하고, 무기를 업그레이드하여 점점 더 강력해지는 적을 물리치세요. 올바른 조합으로 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있으므로 업그레이드를 현명하게 선택하세요.
박동감 넘치는 음악의 비트가 끊임없는 액션과 동기화되는 매혹적인 오디오 환경에 빠져보세요. 음악의 비트를 활용하여 완벽한 샷을 정렬하고 위험을 피하세요.

title: Garden Ink
description:
게임 정보
Game Description
Garden Ink is a game, in which you bring an empty world to life. You plant biomes that you can choose freely, and each area offers new content and secrets to discover.
Gameplay
By solving minigames and puzzles, you unlock new biomes and decorative elements. With these, you can gradually beautify your world. Your goal is to create a flourishing and beautiful environment. The gameplay gives you a top-down view of your world. You can directly interact with it and unlock various tools. With these tools, you can paint plants, replant them, or combine decorative elements. This opens up countless possibilities to design your world in a unique way.
Atmosphere
Everything is accompanied by a relaxing soundtrack, cute sounds from the creatures, and harmonious visuals. Garden Ink invites you to play at your own pace and create a cozy little world that is entirely your own.

title: Looters Inc.
description:
게임 정보
Looters Inc is a 4 player physics-based co-op heist game, where you and your friends break into houses, clinics, banks and more to steal valuable items. Nothing is safe, even the people.
Key Features:
Procedurally Generated Maps: Each burglary attempt is a new experience, as rooms and furniture are randomized. Maybe the next house you target will only have bathrooms!
Agressive NPCs: The home owners will not take your thuggery lying down. They are violent and they work together. You might lose some of your fellow robbers in action, but sometimes, sacrifices must be done.
Multiple Escape Vehicle Upgrades: You will start with a rusty old truck, with a small flat bed. But do not worry, using the money you steal, you can upgrade to better machinery. Better vehicle = More space for stolen goods.
Don't Forget Your Tools: Choose between a variety of tools to help your robbery go smoothly. From a "Silent Window Breaker" to make sure you don't wake up the residents, to a "Baseball Bat" to put them back to sleep if they do wake up, you will find tools for every play style.
Bonus Items: Experience the satisfying rush of opening a safe and finding a $1000 box of jewelery! Or the grief of finding a 1$ trash bag. Maybe the odds will be in your favour next time around.
Local and Online Co-op: Team up with up to 3 more looters in local or online multiplayer. And remember, robbery is more fun when done with friends!

title: Rune Dice
description:
게임 정보
Rune Dice는 덱 빌딩 게임의 전략적 깊이와 주사위 던지기의 짜릿한 메카닉을 결합했습니다. 고대 룬의 마법을 사용하여 적의 무리와 싸우세요!
나만의 룬 덱 구축하기
각각 고유한 힘을 가진 고대 룬을 찾아 사용하세요. 적의 공격을 막는 방어적인 쉴드 룬부터 상대를 움직이지 못하게 하는 프로스트 룬까지 - 당신만의 컬렉션을 만들고 강력한 시너지를 발견하세요.
더 멀리 갈수록 더 흥미로워집니다. 룬의 능력을 극적으로 변화시키는 룬 진화 의식을 수행하세요. 독 룬을 변형시켜 적이 죽을 때 독소를 퍼뜨리게 하거나, 쉴드 룬을 강화하여 공격자에게 데미지를 반사하게 만드세요.
주사위 아레나
조준하고 주사위를 던지세요. 매번의 던지기는 강력한 조합을 만들고 룬을 활성화할 기회입니다.

title: Hexmental
description:
게임 정보
Experience a new take on the MOBA genre!
Dive into fast-paced 10-minute matches of non-stop skirmish filled with impactful decision-making. Playing is easy—just move, cast spells and capture treasures to secure victory! However, mastering the game will take more than luck.
Tip the battle in your favour with elemental mayhem!
Hex grid-based maps and spell arsenal consisting of 6 different elements allow you to control the battlefield with towering flames, slippery ice, soaking water, and sturdy rocks. Each element has unique spells and effects that you can combine to discover even more ways to express yourself during every single match!
Choose your loadout and play it your way!
Go solo or team up with friends in quick matches, ranked games, or custom lobbies. With a variety of elements, items and spell combinations at your disposal it's easy to come up with new ways to play!

title: Watchman
description:
게임 정보
STORY:
The game takes place in the subconscious mind of its female protagonist.
You find yourself in an old, abandoned wrestling gym. It is empty, silent… but the silence is deceiving. Soon, you realize that you are not just a night watchman—you are trapped in the distorted space of your own mind.
This abandoned gym is merely a shell. Inside, it holds fragments of the past, broken memories, and entities that conceal a terrifying truth. You must explore this unsettling world, facing what was meant to be forgotten, time and time again.
But are you ready to see where it all leads?
FEATURES:
Unique experience from gameplay and atmosphere.

title: Final Absolution
description:
게임 정보
Story
This was supposed to be a simple union-busting job: Get in. Rough up some slackers. Take out a few commies. Get out. Get paid. Easy money. But something’s gone terribly wrong.
PATHOS has gone rogue. It won’t let me leave this godforsaken rock. All systems are down. The colonists are missing. Something horrific has happened here...
The Game
Final Absolution is a survival-horror first-person shooter from the creators of Beyond Sunset. It offers a more tightly focused, slower-paced experience with a strong emphasis on atmosphere and tension.
Features
Retro Nintendo 64-inspired graphics, powered by GZDoom
Methodically paced survival-horror gameplay
Arsenal of 10 unique weapons with alternate fire modes
18 distinct maps
Original ambient soundtrack by Karl Vincent

title: Rebirth x Reverse Mana
description:
게임 정보
Hugh, a calm and collected boy, and Amity, a bright and cheerful girl, graduate from secondary school and enter a magick school.
Having lived in a non-magick world, the two are bewildered but intend to learn magick and study to become full-fledged sorcerers...
The older sorcerers with strong habits have their own agendas, and their agendas overlap and become a swell that engulfs the sorcerer world.
===
Players control Hugh or Amity, who are enrolled in a magic school, and aim for great heights as a sorcerer while befriending teachers, seniors, and classmates.
The main game stage is a competition against other characters, and the stage is cleared when someone defeats the boss at the top of the map.
The player gains Mana from the land on the map to strengthen the attributes of fire, water, earth, and wind, while defeating monsters to join their ranks.
Items obtained during movement and exploration can be used to battle monsters and strengthen spirits.
By using items effectively, it is important to strengthen players efficiently and take on bosses before other characters.
Play through the game stages and grow little by little to become the strongest magician.

title: World Turned Stone: Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
This is the prologue for the full game and it includes the first stage of terraforming the world from the beginning of the apocalypse.
Prologue owners will get a special discount on the full game.
Civilization has turned STONE.
Revive the people, terraform the world, defend against the apocalypse, and rebuild civilization from the stone age to advanced technology!
Dust and statues are all that’s left - it’s up to you now, survivor.
A Survival Crafting Base Building Game
Gather dust and craft your way up to rebuilding civilization, from the stone age to advanced technology.
Revive people from the stone and build homes for them to work at your base.
Build new workstations and machines.
Make water and food to maintain your character in the harsh apocalypse.
Defend your base against mutants from the apocalypse using melee/ranged weapons and defense structures like wooden spikes and castle walls.
Terraform the world by building machines to alter the atmosphere and watch the world transform to its original state.

title: Full Metal Sergeant 2
description:
게임 정보
If you die on the battlefield it’s not my fault. 
You think boot camp’s hard? Try surviving my camp.
In Full Metal Sergeant 2 you’re an hellish instructor. Your mission is to transform raw recruits into specialized war machines. Mold their minds and bodies, instill discipline, and hone their combat skills. 
TRAIN HARDER, OR DIE TRYING: Assign recruits to 9 elite special forces roles. Push them past their limits: mental breakdowns, injuries, personal traits ,and desertion are your problem.
BUILD A CAMP THAT BREAKS BONES: Construct training areas designed to crush every weakness. Shooting ranges, obstacle courses, anything to forge the perfect warriors.
12 WEEKS TO PERFECTION: Every training decision ripples into battle. If they're not ready they won't last much on the battlefield
TURN-BASED COMBAT, PERMADEATH CONSEQUENCES: Lose focus for one turn? Say goodbye to your best soldier.
Turn-based combat system
The main highlight for this sequel is a completely new turn based battle system. The key is to strategically utilize the unique abilities of each soldier's specialization to gain a tactical advantage.
12 Week gameplay loop
The game is divided into 12 weeks. Each week you’ll be given some training points. Use them to train your recruits with a variety of different trainings taken from real military camp. Get rid of those negative traits!

title: Mercy Station - Zombie Hospital Simulation
description:
게임 정보
Serve as a medical professional running an emergency clinic during a violent viral outbreak of mutant humans in 1-8 player co-op first-person medical sim and FPS gameplay. Provide care, quarantine the infected, and defend your patients from zombies, werewolves, mind control worms, and other infection types while you race to study the infection and help find a cure.
Evaluate and treat victims caught up in the chaos of the mutant outbreak using an in-depth medical system. Apply proper care for gunshot wounds, stabbings, car crashes, and other physical trauma. Perform triage and dismiss the recovered to free space for more patients.
Quarantine and medicate the infected before they turn into mutants and attack your patients and staff. Arm yourself, gear up, and fight off raids from wandering mutant hordes or armed bandits exploiting the unrest to steal your critical life-saving supplies. Infection types include zombies, werewolves, mind control worms, and others added post-release.
Order supply deliveries, keep a tight budget, and expand infrastructure. Monitor your “Hope” score by making sure you have enough medicine, beds, blood, and body bags for everyone who comes in. Grab a broom, mop, or power washer to clean up the dirt, bugs, blood, and shell casings that litter the facility.

title: Fellowship of the Oak
description:
게임 정보
The lands of Ascrabeth are under threat and an alliance of the willing is gathering. You are responsible for providing your followers with everything they need to succeed! From crafting weapons to farming crops, you will do whatever is necessary to equip them with the finest gear, the tastiest provisions, and the most comfortable accommodations.
Craft, Farm and Build
Improve your skills in gathering resources and crafting a wide range of hero-equipment. Cultivate a variety of crops to create delicious provisions and build up comfortable houses to furnish them cozily.
Lead your Heroes to Success

title: Panic in Puzzle World
description:
게임 정보
      Panic in Puzzle World is an action-platformer. The dragon, Tide, jumps, slashes, bounces and blasts to save the 4 Puzzle Masters from their captors, so that Puzzle World can be saved from the robot invasion!
Ten densely-packed levels of bumping, jumping and fire-blasting, each with novel mechanics to enjoy!
Rad boss fights! Fearsome robots stand in your way, with tons of attacks to tango with!
Made a mistake? Rewind at any time, if you'd like! (this difficulty feature can be toggled on/off)
Fun hats, color-palettes, challenge levels and more to unlock! Gotta use those gems for something, right?
A fun story delivered through in-game cutscenes (which are effortlessly skippable)!
Replay any level and aim for S-Ranks and fastest times!

title: Cereal Reaper
description:
게임 정보
What this?
Cereal Reaper is a game where a cereal addicted freak runs out of cereal and does whatever it takes to get more. Find goofy characters on your journey and beat people up on your way to find the greatest breakfast ever.
Collect items and fight! (if you feel like it)
On the way, find tons of items that make you more powerful to slay more powerful bosses! If you don't want to do that, just do it less. Sometimes violence is the right solution though. There are no random enemy encounters so feel free to explore all corners of the map without any trouble!
Talk to people to find out more things about the world!
There are hundreds of characters around the world to talk to! Some more useful than others, but reading is very good! You should do it more.
GO FAST!!!
The game has many features designed for speedrunning. This makes replaying the game for the purpose of beating it quickly more fun! The game has an ingame timer built in so don't bother with any external tools!

title: The Town That Died In The Night
description:
게임 정보
Everyone's infected, and the only option is the nuclear one. Can you escape the town, before it comes to that? Or will you succumb to the virus? Explore the town of Little River, while trying to find a way out. You might not figure out the mystery of the outbreak, but you might just escape with your life. Every bite feeds the infection, every second the virus spreads. A message is broadcast on every channel to take shelter immediately. But that only means one thing. You must escape.
A classic-style survival horror game, with online functionality. Try to escape with up to three friends. Fixed cameras, zombies, and plenty to explore.
autokwd: The Town That Died In The Night

title: Conquest of Eldinar
description:
게임 정보
Conquest of Eldinar is an upcoming 3D Real Time Strategy and Action game being developed for Steam PC, where you choose from one of 16 different epic fantasy Factions to play as while you build your base, train an army, and engage in thrilling large scale battles. The game supports both dynamic single-player campaigns and competitive online multi-player matches.
The world of Eldinar is a chaotic one, where many different races are constantly in conflict, battling for supremacy. Humans, Elves, Dwarves, Orcs, Dragonkin—the list goes on, each with their own unique cultures, aesthetics, lore, and, of course, arsenals of deadly weapons and spells. Some of these factions are heavily inspired by real-world cultures, while others serve as homages to beloved tropes within the fantasy genre. In Conquest of Eldinar, there is no shortage of exhilarating faction choices, each with its own distinct strengths and weaknesses.

title: Ghost Vanguard
description:
게임 정보
Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements.
key Features
Unleash stylish combos in a 2D Belt-Scroll Beat'em Up combat.
Explore various combo styles with weapon, spell, and relic combinations, adding depth to your strategic builds.
Encounter enemies with diverse attack patterns, leading to exhilarating and challenging battles.
Presenting a dark fantasy world through finely crafted 2D pixel art.

title: Recital of the Heart
description:
게임 정보
Gregory Bellatoni arrives at a mansion party, intent on meeting his love, Eliza.
Before he can reach her, Gregory finds himself thwarted and trapped inside a mirror world called the 'Weave' within the mansion. Inside, he encounters characters from works of art across all of time. He even meets some of the artists who made them. Gregory quickly finds out, however, that some are friendlier than others...
Gregory, with the help of Kand, a strange denizen of the mirror world, must overcome obstacles, tame beasts, and make peace with his inner desires to escape this world and reach Eliza.
Gameplay
Recital of the Heart is an action adventure game with a focus on exploration, narrative, and challenges. The combat system encourages experimentation with modifications on uniqu melee, ranged, and mobility actions to reward the player with emergent gameplay.
Explore a World of Living Art - The mirror world is a vast and varied world abound with secrets around every corner. Meet a cast of characters, some recognizable and some new,  from works of art, literature, and music.
 Overcome Puzzles and Challenges - Utilize the unique skills you collect while playing to traverse traps, solve puzzles, and outsmart foes.
Create your own Symphony - Mix and match dozens of unique Brushes, Instruments, and Tempos to bestow Gregory with powerful melee, ranged, and mobility abilities. Additional flourishes modify your abilities for even more combinations.
The story is simple and familiar. Save the princess atop the tower distant. But the 'dragons' you will face along the way may surprise you. Some may terrify, some may humble, some may pull on thy heartstrings. But each will bestow upon you a lesson. The story may be simple, and it may seem familiar, but what a tale truly means...

...is all in the way it is told...
"And you realized, didn't you? That when it mattered, there wasn't a moment of hesitation. You marched right through Hell before you realized you were there."

title: Postmortal
description:
게임 정보
Postmortal is a modern take on the classic hack-and-slash action RPG genre, where an intricate, engaging and satisfying combat system meets the relationship-building mechanics of a dating simulator.
Explore a shattered world, uncover the past and become a dominant force in shaping its future by slaying enemies, making friends, collecting loot and equipment, braving dungeons and hostile environments, and grow so powerful that you rival the might of the gods themselves!
Key Features
Battle a wide range of enemies with an even wider range of equipment, including swords, spears, axes, shields, staffs, crossbows and more! Every weapon you find has its own play-style that will make every encounter unique.
Collect loads of weapons, armour and accessories to equip. Customise your build to maximise the synergies between your equipped items – becoming overpowered is the goal!
Explore a vast world of hostile environments from a forest cloaked in darkness to a swamp filled with the corpses of dead gods. Delve into dangerous dungeons to find glory and loot.
Befriend and Romance a cast of quirky characters, each with a unique backstory and personality. How you interact with them matters as each character has their own relationships with other characters - you can't befriend everyone equally!

title: AstroMart Adventures
description:
게임 정보
Build a convenience store on an asteroid.

This game is currently not in dev.
Please follow my current game here: ]Playable Alpha[/url]

I am a solo dev who got caught into the magic world of VR.
This won't be the next AAA title, but maybe it will be a fun game you can enjoy for a while.

title: Time To Wake Up
description:
게임 정보


Time To Wake Up is an atmospheric psychological thriller where one night you find yourself stuck in a dream. No worries, though. You are not alone. You hear a voice, in need of your eyes and willing to help you out.
Blinking is thinking



Your sight is your light at the end of the tunnel. Blink and rearrange your surroundings, reset all motion, flood whole rooms, or turn them around.



Even with your sight, even if you're not alone, do watch your step. Your dream can be foggy. You never know what exactly is around the corner during your trip down memory lane.



Didn't we already warn you to watch your step? Do watch it before it falls off the stairs or other dark places your mind might take you to!



Time To Wake Up takes you through various school environments. Imagine lively libraries, perplexing playgrounds, tense toilets, and more...All connected by absurd hallways and strange classrooms.

title: Shadow Of The Union
description:
게임 정보
Create various items and weapons from a wide range of unique materials that can be gathered or found in different corners of the locations. Don’t forget to upgrade your workbench — it will allow you to craft cooler items with unique characteristics! However, not all items can be crafted right away; some require research or the creation of blueprints.
Your base is your only safe place, offering great opportunities for survival. Build and upgrade it to withstand the next attack from dangerous monsters without losing any ground. Strive to automate base defense and other processes as efficiently as possible, using electricity, as well as various devices and mechanisms. But remember, all of this requires constant monitoring and maintenance!

title: Lucha Chess
description:
게임 정보
이 로그라이크 자동 전투 게임에서 최고의 멕시코 레슬링 팀을 구성하세요!
링에 올라 전략, 전투, 로그라이크 요소가 독특하게 혼합된 루차 체스(Lucha Chess)를 마스터하세요. 각자 강력한 능력을 지닌 상징적인 멕시코 레슬링 선수들을 이끌고 수백 가지 아이템 및 유물과 결합하여 완벽한 팀을 만드세요.
팀 빌딩의 기술을 마스터하세요
최고의 팀 구성과 시너지 효과를 발견하면서 무한한 가능성을 탐험해보세요. 당신의 강점을 활용하여 적의 약점에 맞서고, 모든 전투에서 전략을 조정하여 한 발 앞서 나가십시오.
고전 만화에서 영감을 받은 예술 스타일
고전 만화의 매력과 에너지에서 영감을 받아 손으로 그린 독특한 아트 스타일로 가득한 생동감 넘치는 세계에 빠져보세요. 모든 프레임은 개성으로 가득 차 있으며 이전에 본 적이 없는 방식으로 Lucha 세계에 생기를 불어넣습니다.
이 액션으로 가득 찬 자동 전투 게임에서 팀을 구성하고, 가장 어려운 도전에 맞서고, 정상에 오를 준비가 되셨나요? 반지가 기다리고 있어요!

title: Hidden Tactics
description:
게임 정보

Gods love playing, and Hidden Tactics is their favorite board game. Play as a god of Humans, Elves, Orcs or Dwarves and defeat your opponent on a classic 7-round Hidden Tactics game. Master your strategy, and relax while watching a spectacle of fight & glory.
Strategic Placement
Place units and buildings on your side of the battlefield during the Preparation phase. You win a game of Hidden Tactics by destroying the opponent's villages, located at the end of each lane. Carefully manage your gold income and anticipate your enemy's next move by strategically placing your troops or using game-changing spells.

Watch your units fight during the Battle phase! Don't worry about the fallen - they will rise again, fully healed, at the end of each round.

Each faction has its specific units and buildings. Choose between 60+ cards to create the deck that best fits your playstyle !

As you can only bring a limited selection of units with you in battle, every deck will have its strengths and weaknesses. Some situations might require recruiting more powerful units : Mercenaries ! Each game features a random selection of mercenaries, with 20 mercenaries at launch. Be careful, as your opponent has access to the exact same pool of mercenaries !

title: Bestiario
description:
게임 정보
Bestiario is a JRPG set in a Spain inhabited by mythological creatures. The title has elements of Social Sim as one of its main inspirations is the Persona saga.

With Bestiario we aim to bring back those turn-based combat RPGs with great and exciting stories where you connect with the characters while living great and exciting adventures.

Creating a magical world focused on Spain has allowed us to discover a new and exciting mythology that will surprise many of you with the richness of its culture.

The fearsome Ojancano is a huge cyclops with ten fingers on each hand that is almost impossible to defeat. The Cocollona is a nun who, when she sins, turns into a crocodile with butterfly wings. The tarasca is a giant snake with a strange carapace, capable of invoking meteorological phenomena. We could be taken to ad infinitum.
The Goddess Mari awaits you peacefully in her cave and many more mythological creatures are awaiting for you in Bestiario!

Not everything will be about fighting. Like in Persona, there will be a calendar system that will allow you to take a series of actions before moving on to the next chapter in the main story.

You will be able to develop your character and explore the story further thanks to its social simulator.

You will have time to defeat evil creatures at disruptions while also spending some time doing side quests, playing minigames like Chinchon and interacting with other characters.

What will you find in Bestiario?

Deep and intuitive character customisation system.
Combat system inspired by the Grandia saga.
More than 30 hours to complete the main story and much more if you want to complete it.
Unique artwork and graphical style.
Unique and original soundtrack in the genre.

title: ProtoZED
description:
게임 정보


프로젝트 좀보이드(Project Zomboid), 림월드(RimWorld), 제로 시버트(Zero Sievert) 및 타르코프에서 영감을 받은 이 탑다운 추출 슈팅 게임에서는 프로시저 생성된 동네를 탐험하고 은밀하게 움직여서 약탈을 할 수 있습니다.
실시간으로 수백 마리의 좀비!
그리드 기반 인벤토리 시스템


DEV STREAMS를 보러 저의 트위치를 팔로우하거나 업데이트를 위해 YT를 구독해주세요!

프로젝트 좀보이드, 타르코프에서의 탈출, 제로 시버트와 같은 게임에서 수천 시간을 투자하며, 이들 게임에서 가장 흥미로운 요소를 가져온 타이틀을 몇 년 동안 개발하고 영감을 받아왔습니다. 이 프로젝트는 2021년 초부터 진행 중입니다.

title: Tsarevna
description:
게임 정보
Tsarevna is an action game where grace and fury merge into one. As a young princess, you will take up a sword and embark on an unpredictable journey, challenging the mythical creatures that have taken over the world. But the key to victory lies not in brute force, but in the elegance and precision of your movements.
Deadly Grace
Combat is a ballet, where steps, jumps, and sword swings merge into a single flow. Dodge, attack, parry, and chain smooth combos, turning every fight into a devastating performance. Each movement is a deadly art.

title: Warrior Chef
description:
게임 정보
WARRIOR CHEF
Play as Mako, a Warrior Chef in a fantasy world of sentient food, chopping up foes for ingredients to cook new abilities in a 3D Metroidvania about eating your way through four Food Kingdoms in a race to stop the spreading Rot.
COMBAT
Deep sword combat has you master Mako's two-handed chef knife, a family heirloom sharp enough to split food in two. Modify it's moveset with special Whetstones providing utility, manoeuvrability or raw power.

COOKING
With a self-heating pot attached at the hip, Mako can cook on the go. The more he eats the stronger his abilities grow, with a variety of ingredient synergies and augmenting Spices to be found. Be warned- with such power comes one hell of a food coma.

title: Kanun 1919
description:
게임 정보
메신저는 외딴 마을 투로우에서 출발해 중요한 문서 꾸러미를 배달해요. 그런데 목적지에 도착하면 자신의 외모가 사람들에게 환영받지 못한다는 사실을 알게 돼요.
이 우울한 장소의 비밀을 밝히고 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아내 주세요.
20세기 초의 작은 마을에 흠뻑 빠져보세요. 마을 사람들과 대화하고, 적과 싸우고, 마을과 주변을 탐험하세요.
특징:
디젤펑크 대체 역사
스타일라이즈드 그래픽
외딴 마을의 우울한 분위기

title: Dread Pilots
description:
게임 정보
From Klei Entertainment, creators of Don't Starve, Invisible Inc, and Griftlands comes Dread Pilots, a new space survival exploration sandbox game.
You are a Dread Pilot, an unfortunate soul trapped in a dangerous and uncaring purgatory with only your wits to aid you in your quest to escape.
WELCOME TO THE DREAD
The Dread is a pocket dimension somewhere between deep space and a nightmare. You face mutated, carnivorous plant life, mind-bending anomalies, living computers, fanatical cults, space vampires and more as you traverse its many regions in a desperate search for resources and allies. Explore dark infected caverns, soar past glistening technological landscapes, and navigate chaotic mineral fields, all animated in Klei Entertainment's signature hand-drawn 2D style.
SURVIVAL AT ALL COSTS
The life of a Dread pilot is short and cheap. Combat can pay off if you have the advantage, but it’s perilous if you don't. Explore carefully, judge the risks well, and always keep an eye on your tenuous connection to reality or you may just find yourself blown to pieces - or worse. Sometimes information gathering, trade, and diplomacy is the more prudent option.

title: Zombie Epoch:Deck Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Zombie Epoch: Deck Apocalypse는 던전 탐험과 카드 전략이 결합된 포스트 아포칼립스 서바이벌 게임입니다. 생존자로서 위험한 폐허 속을 탐험하고, 희귀 자원을 모으며, 강력한 덱을 구축하고, 자신을 강화하여 끝없이 밀려오는 좀비 무리와 싸워야 합니다.
매번 탐험은 생사의 싸움입니다—경로를 신중히 선택하고, 자원을 적절히 관리하며, 무작위로 얻은 아이템과 카드로 자신만의 플레이 스타일을 구축하고 점점 강력해지는 적들과 싸워야 합니다!
강해질수록 더 어려운 지역, 희귀 아이템 및 강력한 카드를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다.
최종 목표는 단순한 생존이 아니라 인류의 복원을 위한 노력—문명의 불꽃을 되살리는 것입니다!
각 맵은 무작위로 생성되며, 매번 아이템, 카드, 좀비가 달라집니다. 이동 경로를 신중하게 계획하고, 던전을 탐험하며 중요한 자원을 모아야 합니다.
autokwd: Zombie Epoch:Deck Apocalypse,좀비 시대: 덱 아포칼립스

title: K!CHIN
description:
게임 정보
Din Dino, the mob's top ex-hitman, runs away from their past to pursue their true passion: selling custom t-shirts. It's a new start, a new life. But escaping won't be so easy. Their boss, Al Sapone, shows up and demands that they pay a huge debt if they want to buy their freedom.
Will Din Dino go back to their shady ways in order to keep their new life? And why is running a crappy t-shirt store so important to them?
Play cozy minigames and make full use of your sticker arsenal to create textile masterpieces.
Find out your clients' tastes, and you might learn something new about them.

title: Toward The Ice
description:
게임 정보
It was just another day for the princess, hunting for food alone in the wilderness. What she didn't know is that her younger brother the prince had secretly followed her. She only realized this when she heard his screams as he was being carried off by a band of trolls.

They were too strong for her, and she had to watch helplessly from a distance as he was taken to their cave in the mountains via a winding route through the Dwarven lands. She was able to track them, but she needs your help to defeat the beasts and bring him back safely. It's only a matter of time before they eat him, so time is of the essence. Can you be the heroes that she needs?

Toward The Ice is a classic first-person party-based dungeon crawler RPG with grid-based movement and turn-based combat. It can be described as a gridder, blobber, and a DRPG where you navigate mazes fighting monsters, avoiding or disarming traps, and solving puzzles to reach the next area. Build your party of six from any combination of ten character classes and explore more than a dozen maps, gathering items and equipment along the way.

Toward The Ice is a standalone sequel to Into The Inferno, Navigating The Labyrinth, and Crossing The Sands and you do not need to play the previous games to enjoy this one completely.

title: Contract Cafe
description:
게임 정보
Contract Cafe

The story takes place in a city on a continent where you, as Riko, the current manager of the café, receive a letter from an old friend. You promise to take care of a mysterious girl, Niya, bringing her into your world, sharing special moments with her, and helping her grow. In the beginning, whether it's your bond with Niya, joyful days with your team, or the peculiar stories from the shop, they all fill your life with happiness and warmth...

The café plays an irreplaceable role for everyone involved. You have to work hard to keep it running for Niya and for all the people around you. At the same time, a super powerful company that economically controls the city is watching and waiting to show its claws...

The truth about Niya's past, the challenges faced by your friends, the troubles in society, and the conflicts between humans and other beings all unfold in your café, making it the center of an unfolding drama...

Live freely in this city

Explore this evolving city, befriend a variety of customers, keep up with the latest coffee trends through casual chats and news, and improve and upgrade your struggling coffee shop by acquiring new supplies and equipment. Turn your little shop into a special spot in the city and immerse yourself in the story!"




Protagonist: Riko. Niya.

Store Sisters: Taya. Tana.

Courier: Remlin.

Based on the original characters created by the renowned artist AIKOlik, there are as many as 18 key characters!



Igame Studio is a young collective formed by passionate young people about gaming. "Contract Café" is our debut work, poured with all our efforts to win your love and affection!

title: Immortal Boy
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a cute retro-fantasy world and battle alongside your companions in this emotionally charged Turn-Based + Bullet Hell RPG!
Wide range of exploration with a plethora of side missions
Character-rich story with fleshed-out character arcs
Minigames for extra rewards!
Nostalgic Chiptune Soundtrack
Windows 98 Webcore Nostalgia
Do what she says

title: SHELL SHOCK
description:
게임 정보
TBA

title: Mind Flowers
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THIS GAME
Mind Flowers is a narrative-driven psychological simulation with pixel art aesthetics, immersing you in a hauntingly beautiful dystopian world.
As a psychologist, you run a clinic in a decaying city, diagnosing patients with mysterious conditions named after flowers. Each case takes you deep into their memories, where you experience their past, uncover their struggles, and make life-changing decisions.
But be careful! A wrong diagnosis may lead them to irreversible consequences.
A deep and emotional storyline
Handcrafted pixel art visuals
A dark, immersive atmosphere
Decision-driven gameplay that shapes the world around you
Mind Flowers is not just a game; it's an exploration of the human mind and the fragility of emotions. Are you ready to uncover the truth? 🌸

title: Paresis II
description:
게임 정보
SCREENSHOTS ARE A WORK IN PROGRESS
Paresis® II takes place in the first games location while innovating on new concepts. In the first game you had to stand still and lean in order to survive. In Paresis® II, you will be able to fully navigate the house and explore various rooms. Also, the first game made players solve puzzles in real time by trying to figure out how the morphs would interact with you the player. In this game, players will have to solve numerous puzzles in each room, with every room having a unique theme and structure. Morphs will also interact with the players as they roam throughout the house. They will pose as objects in the rooms and will cause many diversions to throw the player off. Some of these could include, turning off lights or making fake sounds. As you progress, the player will face more challenges, including bossfights. This is still an ongoing project but we are excited for everyone to try the next installment of Paresis®. There will be much more to share in the upcoming months.

title: Brush Burial 2
description:
게임 정보
Caught in the mulching churn of a frontier world, Fennel, a devil flung far from home, cuts out a living from the cities and towns at the edge of the earth.
Master a suite of unique combat and movement techniques through use of your forked tail. Lose your way in the slithering guts of the colonial undercarriage. Make wealth out of misery.

Brush Burial 2 is an immersive sim with sanguine and spirited systemic gameplay. Your goal, be it a corpse to make or a coffer to clear, is yours to accomplish as you see fit.
Features:
Sprawling, interconnected levels with countless paths to the objective, full of hostile or friendly NPCs who react to crimes like stealing, trespassing, and murder.
Fast paced, instantaneous combat that is simple but robust, encouraging the use of improvised weapons, environmental objects, and a unique hand-to-hand takedown system.
Dozens of unique cosmetics to be unlocked through gameplay challenges, as well as progression through the game's main story.
A suite of rogues and rough riders to befriend and betray along your way.

title: Mech Log Zero
description:
게임 정보
Mech Log Zero is a shooter akin to games from the old-school PS1 and N64 eras.
Swap between a first-person Pilot view and a third-person view when controlling the Mech.
Use the synergy between the Pilot and the Mech to explore and prevail in Mordaro´s many interconnected Megastructures.
GAMEPLAY-
Use the Mech to destroy colossal machines part by part, or use your skills as the pilot to find an entrance through the colossus, enter their central core, destroy it, and escape with the Mech before the giant machine explodes.
Exit the Mech as the pilot and explore the zones the Mech can´t access, or find a breakable secret wall so the mech shots can enter the zone from outside.
Find ways to move around Mordaro´s layers using the new upgrades and weapons scattered across the megastructures.
New weapons not only serve as a way to attack, but some of them will offer you new ways to move around.
STORY-
Dehka and Alyssa´s new gig has given them the power to hack into a Machine, deep inside one of Mordaro´s lower layers.
You take on the role of Dehka, who at the same time controls the Machine Alyssa has called "The Pilot".
It is your job to retrieve LifeSeeds for your people's needs using this machine...
They will quickly find, however, that the lower layers aren´t as lifeless as they thought they would be.
You´re far away from any danger, right?

title: Skyhell
description:
게임 정보
Featurelist:

Stunning narative adventure.
Survive, invade and rule! In this world you don't only have fanatical war for resources, but also you will conquere states, you're going to be in bloody naval battles and you will explode some skyscrapers. The fate of your own state and of its residents totally depends totally on you.

Weapon modifications.
Customize your gun! Dozens of weapon modification for pistols/rifles/shotguns are available for you. As if this wasn't enough, you can make for your weapons dozens of various modifiers to make your weapon more powerful or paint it in different styles.

Everything is destructible.
Physics of destruction will allow you to break everything into little pieces - doors, walls, ships or anything else. And yes, you can destroy skyscrapers, if you want to;

Made with Unreal Engine 5.
Power Unreal Engine 5 allows to accurately convey the story about the world that keeps getting destroyed by numerous wars for resources.

title: World Turned Stone
description:
게임 정보
Civilization has turned STONE. Prologue (Apocalypse) link below!
Revive the people, terraform the world, defend against the apocalypse, and rebuild civilization from the stone age to advanced technology!
Dust and statues are all that’s left - it’s up to you now, survivor.
A Survival Crafting Base Building Game
Gather dust and craft your way up to rebuilding civilization, from the stone age to advanced technology.
Revive people from the stone and build homes for them to work at your base.
Build new workstations and machines.
Make water and food to maintain your character in the harsh apocalypse.
Defend your base against mutants from the apocalypse using melee/ranged weapons and defense structures like wooden spikes and castle walls.
Terraform the world by building machines to alter the atmosphere and watch the world transform to its original state.
Follow a tech tree to advance your technology and always know what to do next.
Prologue (Apocalypse) link below!

title: Ripley [Remembered]
description:
게임 정보
Sage wakes up every morning to the same routine—serving coffee in a train café. But at 6PM, the train she works on crashes, and the day resets. Time is limited, and every action pushes the clock forward. To escape the loop, Sage must uncover the hidden connections between passengers, solve puzzles in the right order, and survive surreal bullet-hell boss fights. But the deeper she digs, the more she realizes that not everyone on the train is who they seem to be.
As Sage gathers clues, she gets closer to the horrifying truth about her surreal reality.
Features:
Time-Based Puzzle Gameplay – Every interaction moves the clock forward, forcing players to plan their actions wisely.
Bullet Hell Boss Fights – Intense, rhythmic battles reward players with new inventory items.
Psychological Narrative – A haunting mystery about memory, loss, and identity unfolds with each loop.
Persistent Items & Progression – Certain items carry over between loops, unlocking new paths and possibilities.
Immersive Train Setting – A modern, dreamlike train environment filled with unique NPCs hiding secrets.
Genres:
Narrative-Driven Puzzle Adventure
Psychological Mystery
Bullet Hell
Time Loop

title: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars
description:
게임 정보
HARUKA: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya.
Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.


Humankind faces its twilight in the far future.
Having explored every corner of the universe, people have stopped progressing—their lifestyle now dependent on Energy Capsules, a legacy of their past.

Yuuki is a boy living in Spica Village, a base for receiving Energy Capsules from the lunar ruins.
One night, he meets Miiya, a mysterious girl who crash-landed due to a spaceship malfunction.

Their meeting sparks the beginning of an intergalactic journey in search of Yuuki's father, who left for space to unravel the mystery behind humankind's decline.！




Explore the planets' vast fields. Fun and excitement await!
Scour every corner and solve mysteries!



Fight your way through exciting battles while switching between the protagonist, Yuuki, and the heroine, Miiya.
Face off against unique bosses at the end of each episode!
Battle your foes while countering their different gimmicks!



Part of the story is presented in a manga-style format.
Enjoy the story in manga + anime style!



Enjoy ten episodes presented in a TV anime series format!
Each episode ends with a preview of the next one.



Collect all cat pictures scattered throughout the world and win wonderful prizes!




A boy waiting at home for his father who left for the far reaches of the universe. He dreams of venturing into space someday. He likes tinkering with machines and maintains communications facilities daily. The device on his back is for recovering energy capsules.



She meets Yuuki when her spaceship crash-lands on his planet on an out-of-season snowy day. Her bright and carefree personality cheers her friends on. She is a mysterious girl full of secrets.



Yuuki's mysterious alien companion. She has a precocious personality and is proud of her beautiful figure. Her pet phrase is, "I'mma protect Yuuki!" She has psychic powers and is always ready to help in a pinch.



A butler robot who faithfully carries out his duties of taking care of Miiya. He always puts his mistress, Miiya, first. He can't say no to Miiya, no matter how unreasonable her requests are. He looks prim and proper but actually has a chivalric and masculine personality, as his speech patterns show.

title: Sever's Zone
description:
게임 정보
"Sever's Zone" is a First Person Shooter in an alternative universe based on dozens of books and games on the theme of "Stalker". At the same time, "Sever's Zone" only resembles the game "Stalker" - it has no stalkers, no Chernobyl station, no other elements exclusive to "Stalker", but has much in common for the entire universe - the Anomalous Zone, artifacts and anomalies, researchers and inhabitants of the Zone.
The main feature of "Sever's Zone" is the original story written by the author of the game based on his science fiction book, published earlier.
The game will take the player through a story in which several characters will help him learn to survive in the Zone. From the very beginning the player will have a strong dose of ether radiation - a strange radiation that permeates the entire Zone as a result of episodic Breakdowns. The protagonist, having miraculously survived the deadly Breakdown, must reach the scientists' base, where, according to rumors, there are specialists who can help him reduce the ether overdose. However, due to the recent Breakdown, all the anomalies in the Zone are shuffled, all the passages between locations are closed, and the protagonist must find a way through all these obstacles and reach the scientists' base.

title: Machine of the Wasteland
description:
게임 정보
Machine of the Wasteland
Step into the chaos, seize your destiny, and become the King of the Wasteland!
Machine of the Wasteland is a high-octane vehicular combat action game set in a brutal, post-apocalyptic world where survival hinges on your ability to outmaneuver and outgun your enemies. MOW offers a taste of the fast-paced, twin-stick shooter action, as you battle through open arenas with customizable combat vehicles.

title: Cosmic Holidays
description:
게임 정보
On a planet shrouded in mystery, you'll need to observe, adapt, and make use of a stunningly rich fauna and flora to help Cibo reach his vacation resort.
Cibo has a unique ability he can inflate his head:
This lets him glide through the air, bounce, wedge himself into cavities, absorb shocks, roll, and move objects. He can also mimic shapes and produce sounds using this power.
Cibo will interact with geysers to propel himself, sticky termites, glowing plants that ignite at night, and much more. He will explore vast and mysterious landscapes, miniature ecosystems floating in the sky, and encounter incredible creatures, some as large as hills. He will even bounce off strange moving shapes drifting through the sky.
Cibo’s journey is filled with discovery and wonder, but it’s also about understanding this world. Careful observation of this harmonious ecosystem will provide the keys to his adventure.
The player will gradually uncover the origins of gameplay elements—where do these insects live? How do these plants grow? What produces this pollen? This aspect of the game reinforces the coherence of the interconnected ecosystems, making the world feel truly alive.
The origin of this adventure
Somewhere in the galaxy, there is a world where everyone works endlessly. For its inhabitants, the Cibos, the great annual lottery is their only chance to escape this routine and win a week of vacation on a distant planet.
This year, Cibo is the lucky winner. But his dream is short-lived: his shuttle crashes at the opposite end of his destination. Now stranded on an unknown planet, he must journey through a mysterious world if he ever hopes to reach his long-awaited vacation resort.

title: Lady Death Demonicron
description:
게임 정보
Lady Death: Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword-slicing, magic-wielding, 15 level, multiplayer beat-em-up that takes the best aspects of the 90's arcade classics. A little bit of Streets of Rage, a pinch of Golden Axe and a dash of Mortal Kombat - all mixed together with a killer 90's industrial-metal soundtrack.

All Lady Death wants is to mourn a fallen friend in peace. Then in infernal portal rips open and a throng of demon scum storms the cemetary gates. Little does Lady Death know, the most brutal battle of her undead life has just begun.

Malevolent forces tear Lady Death from one realm to another... From the stinking pits of Hell, to an undead heavy metal festival, to a demonic dinosaur catastrophe, to a cannibalistic, industrial nightmare. Through it all, one true ally stands at her side: Ravenheart, a haunted warrior armed with a savage sword and the touch of death, but will even his strength be enough?

title: S: Lost Chapters
description:
게임 정보
Prepare for a brand new type of horror as you are drawn back into the haunting tales that once gripped the souls of millions. Weave through threads of the past and present as you encounter both familiar characters and new enigmas that will leave you questioning reality itself.

S: The Lost Chapters represents our most ambitious and intense horror experience to date.
A New Type Of Horror Experience
Prepare for a truly brand-new experience as the boundaries between horror and reality begin to blur. Brace for unsettling encounters that challenge your perception and make you question the very nature of the game world.
Sound & Light Mechanics
Experience cutting-edge gameplay that leverages sound and light to create a truly immersive atmosphere. Utilize these mechanics to your advantage, but be careful as your adversaries can do the same, making each encounter a nerve-wracking test of skill, timing and intuition.
Stories Both New & Old - Intertwined
Experience a captivating narrative where the events of the past merge with the mysteries of the present, creating a web of interconnected stories that will keep you engrossed from beginning to end. Uncover secrets within familiar locations while discovering new and haunting truths in brand-new locales.
New Survival Mechanics
Prepare for a heightened level of immersion as you navigate a treacherous world. Use new survival mechanics that go beyond mere hiding and evasion, challenging your strategic thinking and decision-making skills. Resources, inventories and new tools help you adapt to evolving threats and make difficult choices that determine your fate.
He’s Not Alone And Neither Are You
In this relentless nightmare, expect to encounter not only the iconic adversaries you once faced, but face off against a new cast of terrifying beings. Who, or what else is out there?

title: Midnight Souls
description:
게임 정보
You are a hero setting out to date a girl, whom you met online, traveling to the distant, unknown small town of Camomile Peaks. But not everything is as it seems, and soon enough, you'll find yourself in the middle of dark secrets and uncovered mysteries.
FEATURES
During your stay in Camomile Peaks you're most likely to experience:
Unraveling murder mysteries
Solving puzzles
QTEs and various minigames
Fighting enemies and facing your fears
Buying useful (and questionable) items
Lots of dialogues
True love (probably)
A full three-act story: Setup, Confrontation, and Resolution
Making friends along the way
A cat!

title: Toward The Ice
description:
게임 정보
It was just another day for the princess, hunting for food alone in the wilderness. What she didn't know is that her younger brother the prince had secretly followed her. She only realized this when she heard his screams as he was being carried off by a band of trolls.

They were too strong for her, and she had to watch helplessly from a distance as he was taken to their cave in the mountains via a winding route through the Dwarven lands. She was able to track them, but she needs your help to defeat the beasts and bring him back safely. It's only a matter of time before they eat him, so time is of the essence. Can you be the heroes that she needs?

Toward The Ice is a classic first-person party-based dungeon crawler RPG with grid-based movement and turn-based combat. It can be described as a gridder, blobber, and a DRPG where you navigate mazes fighting monsters, avoiding or disarming traps, and solving puzzles to reach the next area. Build your party of six from any combination of ten character classes and explore more than a dozen maps, gathering items and equipment along the way.

Toward The Ice is a standalone sequel to Into The Inferno, Navigating The Labyrinth, and Crossing The Sands and you do not need to play the previous games to enjoy this one completely.

title: Contract Cafe
description:
게임 정보
Contract Cafe

The story takes place in a city on a continent where you, as Riko, the current manager of the café, receive a letter from an old friend. You promise to take care of a mysterious girl, Niya, bringing her into your world, sharing special moments with her, and helping her grow. In the beginning, whether it's your bond with Niya, joyful days with your team, or the peculiar stories from the shop, they all fill your life with happiness and warmth...

The café plays an irreplaceable role for everyone involved. You have to work hard to keep it running for Niya and for all the people around you. At the same time, a super powerful company that economically controls the city is watching and waiting to show its claws...

The truth about Niya's past, the challenges faced by your friends, the troubles in society, and the conflicts between humans and other beings all unfold in your café, making it the center of an unfolding drama...

Live freely in this city

Explore this evolving city, befriend a variety of customers, keep up with the latest coffee trends through casual chats and news, and improve and upgrade your struggling coffee shop by acquiring new supplies and equipment. Turn your little shop into a special spot in the city and immerse yourself in the story!"




Protagonist: Riko. Niya.

Store Sisters: Taya. Tana.

Courier: Remlin.

Based on the original characters created by the renowned artist AIKOlik, there are as many as 18 key characters!



Igame Studio is a young collective formed by passionate young people about gaming. "Contract Café" is our debut work, poured with all our efforts to win your love and affection!

title: Danger is near
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a captivating atmosphere with 'Danger is Near,' a session-based hardcore multiplayer first-person shooter that combines various genres including survival, weapon and combat simulation, RPG, and MMO. This game will take you to a realistic post-apocalyptic world where you must balance between survival and hardcore gameplay.

Your main goal is to survive and adapt to harsh conditions by building a shelter, extracting resources, finding allies and exploring the area. At the same time, do not forget that the danger is still nearby, and the atmosphere around is not friendly! Various factors will not let you get bored!

Please note that this description is not final and may not fully represent the game's complete functionality. If you're uncertain about anything, we advise against purchasing the product.

title: Blood Peace
description:
게임 정보
🏃‍♂️ Love Action? 🏃‍♀️
You're in for a treat! Blood Peace offers intense battles where your special abilities and reflexes will be your best weapons ⚡. Each level is a true battlefield where your survival depends on your agility and ability to improvise.
🔁 Rogue-lite with Infinite Replayability
In Blood Peace, every defeat is a new opportunity to come back stronger. Thanks to procedural generation, no run is ever the same! Explore dungeons full of secrets, face unique bosses, and collect increasingly powerful loot 🎁.
👹 Diverse and Dynamic Bestiary
Face off against formidable creatures! Each enemy has its own attacks and behaviors, forcing you to constantly adapt your strategies. From gigantic monsters to cunning foes, every fight is a new challenge for your brain and reflexes 🧠.
🔫 Weapons and Loot Galore
The world of Blood Peace is packed with incredible loot! Access a multitude of weapons, each with random attributes that can radically change your playstyle. Combine them to become an unstoppable force 🚀.
🕹️ Key Features:
Ultra-fast FPS Action 🎮: Shoot, dodge, and survive in epic battles.
Unique Gameplay ⭐: Enjoy a blend of numerous movements and hack'n slash elements.
Rogue-lite Exploration: Every defeat is a lesson. Come back stronger after every run.
7 Unique Biomes 🌍: Explore varied environments, each with its own atmosphere and dangers.
Procedural Loot and Weapons 💣: Thousands of equipment combinations to build your class and adapt to any playstyle.
References and Easter Eggs 🐣: Discover jokes and pop culture nods hidden throughout the game.
🔥 Ready for Maximum Action?
Wishlist Blood Peace now and get ready for explosive action! 🔥

title: The Pope: Power & Sin
description:
게임 정보


교황 : 힘과 죄는 1492 년에서 1503 년까지 알렉산더 VI 교황이었던 로드리고 데 보르자의 삶에서 영감을 얻은 게임입니다. 교황의 역할을 맡고, 교회 국가의 권위를 강화하고, 이교도들과의 영적, 정치적 독립과 행정 교회 구조의 갱신을 위해 싸우십시오. 알렉산더 VI의 통치는 최고 교회 당국의 수많은 스캔들, 과잉 및 도덕적 부패의 시절입니다.



어려운 시기에는 빠르고 폭력적인 결정이 필요합니다. 당신의 성도를 훼손하는 이단자들을 제거하십시오.



이탈리아를 연합하고 영토 확장, 세금 징수 및 부자가 되세요.



정치가 항상 깨끗해야 할 필요는 없으며 모든 사람과 어울리지 않아도 됩니다. 당신은 당신 편에 신이 있으니 어떤 결정이라도 옳을 수 있음을 기억하십시오.



정보를 수집하십시오. 바티칸 복도나 심지어는 고해 실에 모든 곳은 좋습니다. 많은 사람들이 힘을 원하고 당신의 자리에 있기를 원합니다.



부하 직원을 관리하고 무엇보다도 가족을 돌보십시오. 가족의 높은 지위를 부여하고 그들의 미래를 확보하십시오.

title: Keepers of the Keep
description:
게임 정보
STORY
You play as Monet or Vincent, thieves who have found themselves in a sour predicament.
You work at the Hutch & Go shop within The Keep, a new town you have found yourself living in, working off your debts while earning some coin on the side. While this is not the life you envisioned for yourself, your own actions have landed you here.
The Keep is bustling with unique citizens, including six Keepers (short of "shopkeepers"): Elgin, a quiet giantkin and local butcher. Hylda, a flirtatious pixie and owner of Little Grove Construction. Valentine, a rocker harpy and lead vocalist for The Harpy Ladies. Daiba, a friendly oni and café owner. Mango, an upbeat pyka who runs the Keep's recycling center. And Vanitas, a grouchy elf and brilliant ritualist.
Meet and mingle with these six keepers, among many, many others as you work your day job, shop around this new town, and go questing with the help of these new strangers. Make a new life for yourself in the Keep, all while slowly uncovering the tensions brewing deep within the town's surface.

title: Taishō Romance Theater
description:
게임 정보
► This is a mystical tale of magic, love, and blood ties happened in the late winter of the Taishō era.
In this diverse romance visual novel, you will follow the journey of the amnesiac actor, Kotori Sakuma. To escape an impending imprisonment, as well as investigate the truth behind a friend's death, he will explore the unknown forces of the other side of the world—whether willingly or reluctantly—and uncover the secrets behind the death. Ultimately, the choice will come: return to the embrace of the bloodline, or pursue complete freedom.
As you approach the truth, you will dive deeper into the characters’ inner emotions, savor the intricate entanglements with them, and experience the fate of parting ways through multiple endings. Behind the veils, where death intertwines with bonds, every choice you make will impact character relationships, story progression, and the ultimate conclusion.
► The sacred object that determines the path ahead—some call it destiny, while others attribute it to “me.”
