The amnesiac actor, Kotori Sakuma, who lost his past memories in an accident, travels to Tokyo with his troupe to prepare for the premiere of a new script.
However, his previously peaceful life is shattered by an unexpected event—something he says suddenly possesses unknown power. Conseuqently, the other side of the world, which ordinary people cannot touch, reveals its secrets to him.
Before investigating his forgotten past, which may hold the key to answering his confusion, the suspicious death of his friend drags him into a murder accusation.
Please join Kotori Sakuma in Tokyo on the eve of Valentine’s Day in 1921, as he explores the unknown conspiracy and the forgotten chapters of his life.

title: Jet Birds
description:
게임 정보
안전벨트를 매고, 날개를 펼치고, 제트팩을 점화하라!—Jet Birds는 초고속, 고난이도의 레이싱 게임으로, 정밀한 비행이 승리의 열쇠다. 제트 엔진을 장착한 새를 조종하여 숨 막히는 자연 경관을 가로지르며 속도와 컨트롤 사이에서 균형을 잡아라.
하늘을 지배하라
피치, 요, 롤을 자유롭게 조종하고, 비행 중에 날개 길이를 조정할 수 있는 완벽한 컨트롤 시스템. 모든 회전과 급강하는 당신의 손에 달려 있다. 회피 및 대시 기술을 사용하여 장애물을 피하고 좁은 틈을 통과하며, 비행을 정밀하게 조율하여 소중한 몇 밀리초를 단축하라.
시간과의 레이스
타임 어택 레이스에 도전하여 속도와 정확성의 한계를 극복하고 글로벌 리더보드를 정복하라. 루트를 최적화하고, 공기 역학을 개선하며, 제트 추진 비행 기술을 연마하는 것이 승패를 가를 것이다.
새를 선택하고, 세계를 선택하라
거대한 산봉우리부터 울창한 정글 계곡까지, 20개 이상의 독창적인 환경을 누비며 비행하라. 각 환경은 고유한 도전 과제를 제공한다. 개성 넘치는 제트팩 장착 새들 중에서 선택하고, 각기 다른 비행 특성을 활용하여 최고의 레이서가 되어라.
특징:
✅ 정밀한 비행 메커니즘 – 3D 공간에서 자유로운 고급 조종 시스템을 통한 진정한 실력 테스트.
✅ 사실적인 물리 엔진 – 현실적인 공기 역학으로 미세한 조작까지 비행에 영향을 미친다.
✅ – 자신의 기록을 경신하고 전 세계 플레이어들과 경쟁.
✅ – 20개 이상의 아름답게 제작된 자연 경관을 고속 비행.
✅ – 각기 다른 디자인과 비행 특성을 가진 다양한 새들 중에서 선택.

title: Galago
description:
게임 정보
Galago is a 2D exploration-platformer, blending puzzle-solving, survival, and mystery.
Find the 6 golden fireflies per level. Some are hidden, others are in plain-sight, yet seemingly out of reach...
While you explore, your endeavour will be hindered by hunger, hazards and predators. To survive, you must forage for tree sap and insects.
This is not the galago's natural habitat — you are in the city's wealthiest suburb. As you skitter along walls, peering through warmly lit windows, what stories might you witness?

title: Melted Time
description:
게임 정보
당신은 실시간으로 녹아내리는 촛불입니다. 당신의 임무는 신비롭고 분위기 있는 장소를 탐험하며 흥미로운 퍼즐을 해결하는 것입니다. 하지만 서두르세요: 시간은 당신 편이 아닙니다! 생존하기 위해 시간과 공간을 조작하고, 창의적으로 생각하며, 주변 환경의 모든 요소를 활용해야 합니다.
진행하면서 예상치 못한 반전, 배신, 그리고... 야채 살인 사건이 가득한 매력적인 이야기를 풀어나가게 됩니다. 맞습니다! 이 이상한 세계에서 어두운 비밀을 발견하고, 베리의 분해를 목격하며, 기타 기이하지만 매혹적인 사건들을 경험하게 될 것입니다.
실시간 녹는 메커니즘.
신비와 비밀로 가득한 분위기 있는 장소.
퍼즐을 해결하기 위한 시간과 공간 조작.
블랙 유머와 부조리 요소가 담긴 독특한 스토리.

title: Magic Wands Workshop
description:
게임 정보
"Magic Wands Workshop"는 몰입감 있는 마법 지팡이 제작 시뮬레이터입니다.
단계별로 독특한 걸작을 만드는 동안 편안하게 즐기세요. 적절한 가지를 선택하는 것에서 시작하여, 가공하고, 코어를 추가하며, 장식을 넣고, 마법 패턴 의식으로 마무리합니다.
깃털, 털, 송곳니, 비늘 및 판타지 생물의 기타 요소와 같은 독특한 구성 요소를 구입하세요.
매번 창작물을 테스트하여 최고의 품질과 아름다운 외관을 보장하세요.
고객의 성격, 필요 및 경험에 따라 지팡이를 맞춤 제작하세요. 마법 세계에서 가장 유명한 지팡이 제작 장인이 되세요.

title: Moonstone Resort
description:
게임 정보
Build your dream farm from the ground up in Moonstone Resort, a charming single-player farming simulation. Start with a small plot of land and transform it into a thriving agricultural empire.
Key Features:
Farming: Plant and harvest a variety of crops and expand your fields to maximize your yield. From humble vegetables to bountiful orchards, discover the joys of rural life.
Mining: Explore the depths of the local mines in search of valuable ores, gems, and other resources. Help the lost creatures and let them enjoy their freedom.
Crafting: Turn raw materials into useful items, tools, and decorations. Craft everything from simple farming implements to complex machinery to improve your efficiency and personalize your farm.
Expansion: expand and decorate the hotel, build attractions that attract crowds of tourists

title: Elementalist
description:
게임 정보
Elementalist is a challenging movement puzzle platformer, where you collect elemental orbs that give you powers, such as double jump, horizontal dash, ground slam, and teleporting shot. After you collect a power, it will be the next one you use, so be careful about the order of your actions. Some puzzles will require you to think outside the box.

Collect movement abilities, and use them with just one button


Salvage the Sun Fragments


Interact with the enviroment

title: Project Creatures
description:
게임 정보
Project Creatures is a Multiplayer Creature Collection Game. Capture new creatures and battle your friends! 
Discover a brand new world filled with amazing creatures, and set out to find the strongest. Test your skills in battle against other players with our battling system, designed to be easy to learn, yet hard to master. Train your creatures by levelling them up and select the moves you think work best for your playstyle. 



Main Features in Project Creatures:
Take Control of your Creatures
Battle other players or other creatures in our combat gameplay! Put your skills to the test and aim to be the greatest!
Capture and Level a variety of unique Creatures
Build your collection and customize their movesets to give you the exact creature you want to use. Tailor each one to your playstyle and level them up on your way to the very top!
Exploring a vast Open World
Traverse the ingame world either alone or with your friends! Meet up in various towns or take each other on inside the Stadium! Find new and exciting creatures in the different biomes and discover hidden secrets.

title: 魔法拾荒者
description:
게임 정보
 > is a light rogue-like spell-building looter extraction game. Players must scavenge valuable items on the map while constructing their own spells to fend off waves of enemies, ultimately escaping with their hard-earned loot.
 In each session, players need to carefully manage their inventory, aiming to collect as many valuable items as possible and compete to see who can extract with the highest total value.
 Players can customize their spell effects based on different spells—what exciting interactions might arise between them?

title: Catena
description:
게임 정보
Catena is a deck-building roguelite with a unique combat system.
Customize your allies freely by equipping "Modules"—actions like "move forward one tile"—and outmaneuver your enemies with strategies tailored to your playstyle.
Experience the thrill of finding the optimal solution as you navigate ever-changing maps and adapt to unpredictable rewards.
Game Features
Programming-Inspired Customization
Grid-Based Turn-Based Battles
Permanent Death on Defeat (With Persistent Upgrades in the Full Version)
Customization before battle is the key to victory.
Various events unfolding along the journey

title: Frontier Control : Invasion
description:
게임 정보
Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy defense game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.
Each unit can be a hero
Every unit gains experience and levels up while in combat, unlocking access to passive and active abilities according to their current weapon and armor suit.
Flexible playstyle
There are only 2 units you can train in the game, Agents and Specialists.
However each unit can be equiped with a unique weapon and armor suit, each of those influencing the unit stats and abilities. There are 8 different weapons and 8 different armor suits, making for a total of 64 possible different combinations.
Tower Defense x RTS
While the game is played as a classic Real-Time Strategy game, there are 8 different turrets you can build in your base, each of one that can be leveled up twice. Weather you prefer focusing on efficient simcity and static defenses or training your entire colony into an army and not using any turrets, both can work.
Fully destructible map
Every single object on the map can be destroyed or used as a cover for your units like cars or appartments. As the game progresses, the city will get more and more damaged by enemy drops and new routes will be taken by enemy herds to attack your base.

title: Zeizen
description:
게임 정보
 · You have entered Shanghai Central Bank... A labyrinth of pain wherein lies a treasure beyond earthly logic, and approximately 10 billion dollars for you and your heist crew to share. You have one night to run the maze. Make it count.
 · On the outside a precise work of marble and concrete... On the inside a labyrinthine expanse where walls throb to a cardiac rhythm. There is no map, no guide, only your wits and whatever luck Genobrain sees fit to grant.

title: WILDERLOCKE
description:
게임 정보
WILDERLOCKE takes the high stakes tactical battles of monster-taming JRPG challenges like the Nuzlocke and adds the unpredictability and replayability of the roguelike formula.
100+ monsters to discover and evolve.
250+ varied moves, 80+ versatile passives (and more to come).
A customisable set of 4 moves and 2 passives for each monster.
Half of your monster’s stats depend on its species, the others are set by you - build the same monster as a supporting tank or fast damage dealer, depending on what your party needs.

title: Zitifono
description:
게임 정보
After a storm, your boat breaks down, but relax ! The friendly and quirky inhabitants of Zitifono will help you to return home.
Embark on an uplifting adventure, swim and discover all the secrets of the mysterious and colorful islands.
Enjoy your stay in this heartwarming tiny world!
Key features:
Go on humorous quests!
Dialogue choices: help the inhabitants and choose what you say to them.
Swim in the sea and explore islands!
Carry weird statues and activate strange mechanisms!
Take a cute little train (it's cool).
Enjoy a feel-good ambience!
Explore a small open world and find secrets.

title: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
description:
게임 정보
In Jordi & Oslo and the Lost Tail, Oslo the Dragon has gone missing. You impersonate two characters, Jordi and Sígrid, as they try to piece together who is behind their friend’s mysterious disappearance. In this humorous point-and-click adventure, you solve smart puzzles, crack punch lines, and explore beautiful watercolour-painted locations inspired by the Spanish countryside.

Get priority-mailed out of your home, beat an indefense wooden log, and discover off-limit underground facilities. Then, find your way out to a charming rural village full of quirky characters, lovely animals, and obsolete technology. Cozy banter, hot chocolate, and fussball challenges await you!
Jordi and Oslo and the lost tail is a 5x game:

Exchange items between Jordi and Sígrid’s inventories, explore lovely homely locations, explode untidy rooms, examine clues until the characters say something funny,  and expose a shady plan to gain magical powers.
A comic blend:

The video game is based on the ‘Jordi and Oslo’ comic strips that feature in the Spanish local newspaper, Segre, and it is entirely hand-drawn and hand-animated by their author, JoveGuille. The videogame mixes the whimsical 1990s point-and-click adventures style with the playful art and the dialogue style of the comic strips.

title: ALYSSA
description:
게임 정보
Here's a new game from the creator of Don't Be Afraid and Mandela Invasion!



ALYSSA is a adventure game with horror elements, in which you play a 9-year-old girl from a broken family who hears disturbing voices in her head. They promise her that they know where she will find her longed-for happy life, but to find it, she will have to murder everyone who stands in her way.

Alyssa will murder discreetly, and the environment is perfect for it. From poisoning tea to initiating explosions, you'll find plenty of opportunities in the levels. Will you be able to find them all? However, remember not to get caught, because if someone catches you in suspicious activity - it means your end.

Due to the fact that Alyssa is not an ordinary child, she will be able to use the help of ghosts and demons. With them, you will easily scare someone to force them to go to another place or cause interesting phenomena. Of course, these beings will want something in return, so before they are available, you will need to convince them with something.

Sometimes you will also meet people and creatures that will try to harm you. In this case, you will avoid detection and look for opportunities to get out of a place. Not everyone is defenseless!

The player's task is to murder targets while remaining undetected, using only elements of the environment. Which way will you choose? Which creatures will you use in your journey? Will you discover all the secrets? And above all - will you help Alyssa find happiness?

title: Hero's Hand
description:
게임 정보
We mashed together Poker, RPGs and Roguelites to make the wildest single player adventure possible. Become the Knight of Spades and build up your reputation across the land of Carduia! Face off against maniacal monsters by moving around the board to pick up cards to form the best poker hands possible with the cards you are dealt.
         Your strategies, fortunes, items, weapons and armor come together to form a unique run experience each time, as you thwart larger and more over-the-top creatures in your efforts to face death and save the world!

title: Skyclimbers
description:
게임 정보
도시 건물
하향식 컨트롤과 3인칭 역학을 독특하게 조합하여 청사진을 배치하거나 무료 빌드를 사용하여 왕국을 건설하십시오. 자원을 수확하고, 주민 역할을 할당하고, 확장하세요!

RPG 클래스
선택한 원소 왕조에 따라 고유한 장비와 스킬 트리가 있는 5가지 클래스 중 하나를 선택합니다. 캐릭터 생성을 통해 각 클래스 및 다이너스티와 스타일을 믹스 앤 매치할 수 있습니다. [/비]

몬스터 길들이기
Sentius Gauntlet을 사용하여 오픈 월드에서 몬스터를 길들이십시오. 각 Sentius는 레벨을 올리고 각각 고유한 원소 기술을 가진 새로운 형태로 진화할 수 있습니다.

생존
당신의 영토를 확장하고 포위할 적대적인 토착 부족으로부터 자신을 방어하십시오.
tag: 앞서 해보기,도시 건설,오픈 월드 생존 제작,액션 RPG

title: Dark Queen
description:
게임 정보
슬라브 신화와 크로아티아 민간전승에서 영감을 받은 2.5D 액션 어드벤처 게임으로, 송 오브 아이언, 프린스 오브 페르시아, 인사이드, 림보와 같은 게임들의 영향을 받았다.
 이 게임을 통해 어린 시절 들었던 영웅의 꿈을 꾸게 했던 이야기들을 상기시키고자 한다. 십자군 전쟁의 고된 전투에서 돌아오는 중세 기사의 입장이 되어 판타지 책 속으로 들어가게 된다.
 하지만 쉴 틈이 없다. 사악한 여왕이 당신의 고향을 어둠으로 물들였기 때문이다. 마법에 걸린 숲에서 황폐한 황무지에 이르기까지 다양한 풍경을 배경으로 괴물들과 대단한 보스들과 싸우게 된다.
 다음 덤불 뒤에는 어떤 생물이 숨어있고, 어떤 괴물을 만나게 될 것인가? 십자군 전쟁의 유혈도 이것을 대비하지는 못했다. 생존하려면 능력을 향상시켜야 할 것이다.

title: Eternal Skies TCG
description:
게임 정보
Remember when handhelds used to have single player card games, where you play through an RPG-like story collecting cards and having battles along the way? This long-dormant genre has always been one of my favorites, so I created Eternal Skies because I wanted a new one. Eternal Skies is a TCG RPG, where you advance through the story by having card battles. The card game and mechanics themselves were created completely from scratch, and are inspired by Slavic mythology and the old Dreamcast game Skies of Arcadia. Don't like the way the card game plays? Change it! There is a built-in card editor, and almost everything else relevant to the game is stored in easily editable plaintext.
Here are some bullet points about the game before I go into more detail:
A completely new TCG with a lot of depth!
Lots of cards and ability to add your own!
Customize basically anything!
Hardcore mode and grind reducing options!
Runs on a potato!
A story!
Arcade modes!
Beep-y music!
Difficult to pronounce words for English speakers!
Really horrible card art until I can afford better art!
Made almost completely by one guy!
Chock full of references and memes!
Sweet sweet 90s vibes!
Plot and Modes
In the story mode, conflicts in this world are settled by card battle. The only issue? The richest nobles control all the most powerful cards. You play helping a young girl named Zyna, and you don't even particularly like card games. However, you end up getting roped into a conflict that pulls you all around the country and then some. Travel around, fix problems, and collect cards and build better decks along the way. You'll need them.

title: Dragons Brew
description:
게임 정보
Dragons Brew is a captivating boardgame cafe simulation game where you can create and manage your very own cozy cafe. Drawing inspiration from beloved games like Stardew Valley and Traveller’s Rest, Dragons Brew combines charming pixel art with engaging simulation mechanics.

In Dragons Brew, you’ll experience the thrill of running a cafe with a unique twist: offering takeaway services, door deliveries, and an innovative boardgame system that impacts both the cafe operations and the overall gameplay!
Variety of Recipes: Serve Delicious Meals and Drinks

In Dragons Brew, you’ll have access to a wide range of recipes to create delightful meals and beverages for your customers. From classic coffee and tea to exotic pastries and gourmet dishes, each recipe will have unique ingredients and preparation methods. Master the art of cooking and brewing to keep your customers happy and coming back for more.
Expand Your Boardgame Collection: Unlock New Boardgames with Unique Effects

As you progress in Dragons Brew, you’ll unlock an extensive collection of boardgames, each offering unique gameplay mechanics and effects on your cafe. Whether it’s increasing customer satisfaction, boosting your cafe’s popularity, or providing special bonuses, every boardgame will add a new layer of strategy and fun to your cafe management experience.
Quest System: Engage with the Community Through Diverse Quests

Engage with the lively community in Dragons Brew by completing a variety of quests. From helping locals with their requests to organizing special events in your cafe, these quests will offer rewards and unlock new content. Build relationships with the townsfolk, gain their trust, and enhance your cafe’s reputation through meaningful interactions and quests.
Day-Night Cycle and Seasons: Dynamic Changes Affecting Gameplay and Strategy

Experience the passage of time with a realistic day-night cycle and changing seasons in Dragons Brew. Each time of day and season will bring different challenges and opportunities, affecting customer preferences, ingredient availability, and event possibilities. Adapt your strategies to thrive in every situation and make the most of each moment.

Immerse yourself in the stunning pixel art world of Dragons Brew. Every detail, from the quaint seaside village to the cozy interiors of your cafe, is meticulously crafted to create a visually enchanting experience. Explore the charming town, interact with its quirky inhabitants, and uncover hidden secrets as you expand your cafe empire.

Express your unique style in Dragons Brew by customizing your avatar. Choose from a variety of hairstyles, outfits, and accessories to create a character that reflects your personality. As you progress, unlock more customization options to keep your avatar fresh and fashionable.

Transform your cafe into the ultimate boardgame hub with extensive customization and expansion options in Dragons Brew. Decorate your cafe with a wide range of furniture, decor, and thematic elements. Expand your space through the local estate agent to accommodate more customers, add new features, and enhance the overall ambiance to attract a diverse clientele.

In Dragons Brew, you can grow your own ingredients to use in your recipes. Cultivate a variety of crops, from herbs and vegetables to rare and magical plants. Harvest your produce and ensure a steady supply of fresh ingredients.

Expand your horizons in Dragons Brew by discovering new areas beyond your cafe. Explore neighbouring towns, enchanting forests, retail parks, coffee roasteries and boardgame conventions. Each new location will offer unique challenges, ingredients, and opportunities for your cafe. Uncover the secrets of these areas and integrate their unique elements into your cafe’s offerings.

The world of Dragons Brew is ever-growing, with new boardgames and recipes continuously being added. Stay updated with regular content updates that introduce new boardgames with exciting mechanics and fresh recipes to keep your menu dynamic. Your cafe will always have something new to offer, ensuring endless fun and engagement for you and your customers.

title: StellarFighter: Galactica
description:
게임 정보
Story
The year is 2092, after the failure of the 2030 Agenda and worsening environmental catastrophes, major corporations began colonizing space.
Space colonies, in orbit and on planets like Mars, were occupied by the wealthy, while the poor on Earth suffer the consequences.
As a Bounty Hunter, you travel through the solar system in search of contracts to ensure the survival of your family and those left behind.
Old School
Hand painted 16-bit pixel art and animations mixed with an amazing synthesized soundtrack.
Features
Story mode with 4 characters to unlock;
15 Levels to master;
5 "Most Wanted" Boss Fights;
Weapons that level up as you defeat enemies.

title: ICE on the EDGE
description:
게임 정보
최고봉의 무대를 향해 나아가라! 피겨 스케이터 육성 시뮬레이션
당신은 피겨 스케이터의 코치가 되어 선수를 육성하고,
세계 최고 수준의 대회인 「온 더 엣지」에서 우승을 쟁취하게 됩니다.
개성 넘치는 캐릭터와 아름다운 3D 그래픽으로 전개되는 육성 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
선수의 프로그램을 구성하자
대회에서 선보일 음악, 의상, 기술은 코치인 당신이 직접 선택합니다.
선수의 능력을 충분히 살려 안정적인 구성으로 승부할 것인가?
아니면 위험을 감수하고 고난도 기술에 도전해 단숨에 역전을 노릴 것인가?
선택은 오로지 당신의 판단에 달려 있습니다.
선수의 실력과 잠재력을 파악해, 최고의 프로그램을 완성해 보세요.
대회에 출전하자
육성한 선수를 이끌고 대회에 도전하세요!
당신이 지시한 프로그램대로 선수가 연기를 펼치며, 순위를 두고 경쟁합니다.
선수를 믿고, 승리를 기원해 보세요!
멀티 스토리 & 멀티 엔딩
라이벌들과의 경쟁, 경기의 승패, 그리고 선수의 성장……
이 모든 요소가 이야기를 다양한 방향으로 이끌어 가며, 다채로운 결말을 만들어 냅니다.
당신의 지도와 선택에 따라 어떤 드라마가 전개될까요?
최고의 엔딩을 목표로, 당신만의 피겨 스케이팅 이야기를 완성해 보세요.
전략적 육성과 캐릭터 드라마가 융합된 본 작품.
정상을 향해 나아가는 뜨거운 여정을, 직접 체험해 보시기 바랍니다.

title: Fraudulent Idols
description:
게임 정보
Fraudulent idols is a fixed camera detective action horror where the player guides their way through STRATA Pharmaceutical Plant to investigate missing Alien Technology. The entire game operates on a turn based fixed-camera system. Inspired by the likes of Silent Hill and Final fantasy. Fraudulent Idols is a game where choice is your difficulty setting. Explore STRATA to unveil the mystery behind the Cloud Burst out break and the missing technology.

The character faces challenges in the form of hostile parasites, breathtaking bosses, desperate humans, and decadent designed puzzles in the quests to descend deeper into the mysterious research facility. Multiple scientific based weapons and skills can be acquired and used to help aid this devilish task.

The player will have multiple choices to make throughout the game that will hold groundbreaking weight on other situations in the game including current and future missions, DLC, and even the sequel!

title: Untrusted: hackers at large
description:
게임 정보
Step again into the dangerous world of "Untrusted" with "hackers at large", in this gripping single-player command line adventure that thrusts you into the roles of mysterious hackers. Immerse yourself in a digital underworld where every decision you make, has profound consequences.

Infiltrate high-stakes targets, seize control, and exploit their vulnerabilities for personal gain. But it's not just about you – manage your crew of skilled hackers, each with their own specialized talents that will open up multiple strategies: the choices are yours to make, and they reverberate throughout the world of Untrusted.

Use vulnerabilities and your deduction skills to hack into computers
Manage your crew around the world. Hide. Escape. Don't die.
Management/RPG elements woven in the hacking gameplay in a unique blend
Set in an alternate timeline in the late 70s/early 80s
Realistic hacking mechanic, albeit with optional friendly interrface commands for those who don't want to meddle with a command line interface (some typing still required :) )

"Untrusted: hackers at large" is a single player prequel to "Untrusted" also available on Steam: join our Discord to learn more!

title: Nightborn
description:
게임 정보
Nightborn은 어두운 고딕 버전의 우리 세계를 배경으로 하는 내러티브 중심의 게임 플레이를 제공하는 액션 RPG입니다.
플레이어는 나이트본에 대한 초자연적 위협을 추적하는 훈련을 받은 뱀파이어 탐정 블러드하운드의 역할을 맡아 같은 종류의 사람들에게는 금지된 신비한 의식을 사용합니다.
뉴올리언스의 뱀파이어 엘리트인 Nightborn의 정치적으로 영향력 있는 멤버인 Maker를 포함한 동료 뱀파이어의 일련의 실종 사건을 조사하십시오.
10개의 상징적인 뱀파이어 혈통 중에서 선택하고 시그니처 혈통 파워 스킬 트리 세트를 사용하여 나만의 블러드하운드 캐릭터를 만드세요.
혈통의 힘에는 신체적 기량 향상, 변신, 필멸자의 정신 조종, 섬뜩한 마법 행위가 포함됩니다.
은신, 유혹 또는 무력을 통해 필멸자를 잡아먹음으로써 뱀파이어의 힘에 연료를 공급하십시오.
필멸의 법 집행관과 몬스터 헌터를 피해 어두운 본성을 감추세요.
퀘스트를 수행하고, 단서를 발견하고, 초자연적인 지하 세계를 탐험하여 고딕 양식의 뉴올리언스의 미스터리를 해결하세요.
자신의 힘, 무기, 전술을 사용하여 자연적 적과 초자연적 적과 싸우거나, 피하거나, 속이십시오.
Nightborn 파벌, 지배 기득권층, 무모한 Libertines 또는 광신적인 Orthodoxy의 편에 서십시오. 또는 모든 것을 피하고 자신만의 길을 개척하십시오.
고딕 나이트 클럽
필멸의 활동에 참여함으로써 잃어버린 인간성과 연결되십시오. 공공 장소는 미묘하고 매혹적인 사람들에게 많은 먹이 기회를 제공합니다.

title: Predatory Islands
description:
게임 정보
4X real-time strategy. The game takes place on a planet that turned out to be a forced landing site for space settlers. The spaceship crush prevented them from reaching their designated star system. Their home-to-be was almost completely covered with an ocean, so the colonists had no other choice but to settle down on the small islands. The catastrophe destroyed practically everything that the colonists were carrying with them. They found and divided the warp-engine that crashed onto the planet among groups of colonists. They used the parts of the space engine to assemble devices that allow the island to go into hyperspace. Since then each group of colonists owned their own island and the ability to instantly travel. You have to become the leader of such group and guide them to prosperity and victory.

Key Features:

Tournament sessions
Support for gaming sessions on a dedicated server which allows you to participate in various gaming tournaments, with a duration of several hours to several months and a total number of participants from 2 to hundreds or even thousands.

Social sphere and characters skills
Define a profession for the character. It can be a worker or a soldier. Gradually they will gain experience and raise their level. Organize the troops training according to your combat tactics. Build houses for the characters and plan their life. Determine how long they have to work and rest.

Changeable landscape
Fully terraformable landscape. Use terrain modification to defend the island. Apply landscape destruction from explosions when attacking the enemy.

Change of day and night
The game world exists in the same time zone. Day will change into night, and night into day. Determine which of your characters will stay awake during the day and which at night. Plan your attacks during daylight or darkness.

Manage the diet
Develop agriculture, cattle raising or fishing. Determine dietary diversity of the characters so that they are happy with your leadership. Surplus can be sold in some game scenarios.

Industry development
Create production plants and produce what is necessary to survive. Start with a workshop. The study of the lost knowledge will allow you to create more modern productions.

title: 1992: Rasputie
description:
게임 정보
1992: Rasputie is a turn-based role-playing strategy game where you can build a political career in post-Soviet republics such as Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, or Georgia. Immerse yourself in the complexities of this historical period: economic and political reforms, public protests, lobbying, corruption, and military conflicts. Will you lead your country to freedom and democracy, or will you shackle it under an authoritarian regime?
You have four types of resources at your disposal: capital, public support, power, and authority. Which of these will help you rise to the top? Keep in mind that every choice has consequences, both for you personally and for the entire country.
Your character’s political views, shaped by their actions and public statements, will influence how the public and other players perceive them. Will you seek allies among liberals or turn to socialists? Or perhaps compromise is the best path?
FEATURES
Hundreds of real-life-inspired characters and historical events
Complete freedom of action: shape both your character’s and your country’s fate
Flexible game settings, including historical, realistic, and random event modes
The ability to implement reforms and launch social programs to create your ideal state
Organize protests and strikes, using public support to push for political change
Build your own business empire to fund your most ambitious plans
Develop connections in the government to lobby for your interests
Resort to force when all other options are exhausted
The Soviet Union has fallen, and your new country stands at the rasputie. Where will you lead it?

title: Out of the Ocean
description:
게임 정보

Sakuragi Asuka is an ordinary girl of no particular note. She's so plain and ordinary her parents think nothing of palming her off on her aunt for a year so they can work overseas, leaving Asuka marooned on the small island of Omorishima.

Asuka is an awkward girl by nature, and she finds it hard to fit in. How in the world is she going to cope living in Omorishima, which is so dissimilar to Tokyo?!

Asuka is dreading going to school, and she's terrified she won't be able to make any friends...

But a chance encounter with a mysterious maiden late at night soon flips Asuka's life upside-down. This maiden has long, fair hair, bright blue eyes...

And she also has a tail!

What is Asuka going to do now?!


- About 120,000 words of text (approx 6-10 hours of reading)
- Choices which determine your ending
- Two adorable heroines, Misuzu and Nerine
- Cute anime-style artwork
- A custom OST
- One cute mermaid girl!

title: Never Stop Gaming - An EPIC Video Game Store Simulation
description:
게임 정보
You and your friends open and manage a video game store in a mall during the mid 90s. Sell games, expand your store, host midnight sales and VIP visits and grow your store to become the geeky superstore of your dreams!
Never Stop Gaming is a love letter to the video game stores we grew up in, and the wild characters that made these stores so special. At its core, Never Stop Gaming is a cozy 4 player co-op business simulation: Order games and consoles, place them on shelves and sell them to customers. As your store becomes more successful, expand it to include additional sections for merchandise, tabletop games, card games and a LAN Party section.
While operating the store, you will perform hilarious missions, host VIP visits and get involved in the life of customers who love video games more than you. Just kidding, we know that’s not possible.
This game is in early development. More information coming soon :)
autokwd: Never Stop Gaming - An EPIC Video Game Store Simulation

title: Dicewood
description:
게임 정보
Dicewood is a fantasy horror turn-based roguelike deck-builder where adorable forest animals band together to escape the relentless hunter.
Fleeing into a dark, twisted forest filled with ancient horrors, creepy monsters, and cannibal tribes, player must strategically combine different animals, overcome nightmarish foes, and make their way to the river to start a new life.
Every roll counts in this high-stakes journey of survival, teamwork, and hope.
Unique dice-creatures, each with its own abilities
Scary fairytale vibes
Build your deck of creatures
Will the animals be safe?

title: Chemical-Burn
description:
게임 정보
WELCOME, WELCOME TO HAZARD CITY
Chemical-Burn is a first person shooter action-adventure set in Hazard City—one of the last few cities on Earth, where the remaining human populations have been placed.  Engage in thrilling first person combat using a variety of weapons and your dog Buddy. 
KEY FEATURES
Satisfying First Person Combat - get ready to engage in fast paced and responsive first person combat with a variety of weapons and against many unique enemies
Powerful Arsenal of Weapons - Cindy will have her hands full with a variety of weapons from a Halligan Bar when at close range to a silenced MP7, she is ready to blow away anyone in her way

title: Potion in Motion
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of potion-making, where every brew is a mix of magic, mystery, and just a little bit of chaos. Learn from your father’s cryptic notes, experiment with mystical ingredients, and cast spells to refine your craft, all while keeping up with the endless demands of your quirky customers.

title: Shroomwood
description:
게임 정보
Play as Shroomie, a curious little mushroom navigating the ever-changing wilderness of Shroomwood. This top-down 2D roguelike adventure blends fast-paced combat with dynamic dungeon exploration. Each run through the Shroomwood forest offers new challenges, randomized rooms, and a host of peculiar creatures from classical slimes to zombie-infested mushrooms. Discover powerful weapons, stack unique modifiers, and uncover the secrets hidden within vibrant and unique biomes.
Enter the Shroomwood
In Shroomwood, no two journeys are the same. The forest rearranges itself with every playthrough, offering fresh combinations of handcrafted rooms connected by a procedurally-generated dungeon layout. Equip diverse weapons, enhance them with random modifications, and face off against magical foes in your quest to survive the wild,  remaining alert of the dangers lurking around every corner.
High-Paced Action
We blended the shooting mechanics of traditional roguelikes such as Enter the Gungeon and Binding of Isaac with a brand new melee system to create a roguelike that put a creative spin on the classic tried-and-true formula! There are more bullets, more enemies, more death, and more fun.
Upgrade your Arsenal

title: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess
description:
게임 정보
Defy Fate and Save Your Sister
Hard times have befallen the once-glorious noble House of Báthory. Vultures circle the family's untold riches, eager to claim what's left. You are Sophia, one of the last surviving members of the Báthory bloodline. Your elder sister has been falsely accused of vampirism and entombed alive in her own castle. Under the cover of night, you set out on a desperate mission: rescue her and restore your family’s lost honor.
Fight or die
Travel through a desolate land filled with peril: from crumbling villages to shadowy caves and towering stone walls guarded by ruthless soldiers. Face wild beasts, merciless bandits, restless dead, and true creatures of the night in brutal, fast-paced combat. Slash them with saber and axe, shoot them with pistol and bow, throw bombs and use every weapon at your disposal to survive.
A World of Danger and Mystery

title: Shadowborn
description:
게임 정보
An ultimate challenge for the daring souls. The fight for your humanity will be relentless. Darkness lies dormant within each of us... One wrong decision, and your light will flicker into the shadows.
Join Kaelara on her quest for revenge against a tyrannical king.
In her desperation, she summons the ancient spirit of darkness, the Nemorsis, to overthrow the evil ruler and his minions.
Step into the shadows in this rogue-like stealth game.
Wield shadow-based powers to navigate your way to the king. Engage in intense combat with a diverse array of enemies and formidable bosses while remaining unseen. Traverse a labyrinth of rooms, each offering unique encounters and puzzles, as you inch closer to your ultimate goal.
Key Features:
Roster of 20 Unique Shadow-Based Skills: Obtain these skills randomly, forcing you to adapt your play style with each run. Each skill can be upgraded up to level 5, with every second level introducing additional shadow-based mechanics.
A Vast Array of Puzzles and Traps: Navigate through intricate puzzles and avoid deadly traps.
In-Depth Stealth System: Utilize the field of view, ambient shadow levels, and character distances. Your actions directly influence your stealthiness.
Expansive Single-Player Campaign: Journey through diverse environments including a dungeon, village, castle, temple, and a hellish landscape.
Challenging AI System: Face enemies with unique behaviors and a keen field of view, making each encounter unpredictable.
Dynamic Fog of War: Experience an animated fog of war that changes based on your character’s field of view.
Randomized Reward System: Each run offers unique rewards, requiring strategic choices between different options.
Permanent Progression System: as you die and you progress you earn permanent skills and point to improve you character.
Embrace the darkness. Fulfill your vengeance and overthrow the king.

title: Haunted Lands
description:
게임 정보
숨겨진 비밀과 하드코어한 도전으로 가득한 레트로풍 액션 플랫폼 게임인 Haunted Lands로 발걸음을 딛어보세요. 각기 다른 플레이 스타일에 맞는 다섯 가지 개성 넘치는 캐릭터 중에서 선택하세요. 악령과 악몽에나 나올 것 같은 괴물들이 기어 다니는 위험한 묘지를 탐험하세요. 강력한 유물을 획득하여 무시무시한 것들에 맞서고 새로운 전투 방식을 찾아보세요.
주요 특징
독특한 영웅들. 5명의 플레이 가능 캐릭터 중 하나를 고르세요. 일부는 안전 거리에서 몬스터를 무력화하는 것을 선호하고, 다른 일부는 근접 전투에 뛰어납니다. 각자 고유의 능력 및 플레이 스타일을 보유하고 있습니다.
위험한 장소들. 악령과 이계의 괴물들로 가득한 오래된 묘실과 무덤의 폐허를 탐험하세요. 적의 무리와 정예 적, 까다로운 보스를 물리치며 나아가세요.
강력한 유물. 유물을 획득하여 능력을 강화하고, 묘지의 공포에 맞설 새로운 방법을 찾아보세요. 가장 강력한 아이템은 캐릭터의 기술을 완전히 바꿀 수 있습니다.

title: Playable Alpha
description:
게임 정보
As researcher with great ambitions, and lack of talent, you are sent to a newly discovered planet far away from civilization.
In this VR first person survival, you will need to build an outpost and survive the hostile environment. While exploring the planet, unveiling its secrets.

title: Just A Shadow Game
description:
게임 정보
네가 감히 내 영역에 들어오겠다고? 그렇다면, 게임 마스터인 나, 섀도우의 감시 아래 궁극의 의식 마스터로서 올라설 준비를 하라! 약한 자들이 너의 비전한 힘 앞에서 굴복하는 모습을 지켜보라. 너는 상상할 수 없는 공포의 주문을 짜고, 무(無)에서 죽은 자들을 소환하며, 자연의 법칙을 무시하는 방어를 구축하게 될 것이다!

너의 통치의 핵심 요소:
• 의식 덱 빌딩: 부패한 건물과 금지된 주문을 마치 용이 금을 모으듯이 쌓아라. 너의 타락의 깊이를 반영하는 덱을 만들어, 너에게 감히 반대하는 어리석은 자들에게 혼돈을 퍼부어라.
• 악몽의 의식 결투: 네 희생물을 둘러싼 탑을 세워라. 가장 용감한 영웅조차도 눈물을 흘리게 만들고, 신성하지 않은 성역 사이의 결투에서 너를 돕기 위해 모독적인 의식을 통해 흉물들을 소환하라. 악마와 같은 정밀도로 그들을 배치하여, 고통에 허덕이는 이단자들의 파도를 부수며, 그들의 희생물을 네 신성하지 않은 공격으로 폭격하라.
• 죽음은 단지 스승일 뿐: 넘어져도 다시 일어나라, 더욱 강해져라! 각 패배는 네 뒤틀린 진화를 촉진한다. 신성 모독적인 지식을 모으고, 점점 더 강력한 카드를 해제하며, 사악한 건물을 건설하고, 너의 어두운 선물을 강화하라.
• 어둠에 잠긴 세계: 빛이 발을 들이기를 두려워하는 영역에 몰입하라. 이 저주받은 땅의 비밀을 파헤쳐라. 지식이야말로 궁극의 지배로 가는 열쇠이다. 너의 힘의 상승은 나, 섀도우의 비꼬는 서사를 통해 전개되며, 기괴하고도 매혹적인 일러스트레이션과 함께 네 나약한 마음에 새겨질 것이다.

자, 떨고 있는 인간이여, 이 힘을 잡을 용기가 있는가? 네가 이전의 많은 자들처럼 무너질 것인가, 아니면 유일하고 진정한 섀도의 지배자로서 일어설 것인가? 네 공포의 통치는 네가 이 악마적인 도전을 받아들이는 순간부터 시작된다. 선택은 네 것이다... 그 선택을 할 용기가 있다면!

title: Meowbrick Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
한때, 던전에 살고 있는 사악한 생물들은 고양이 부족의 고향을 끊임없이 침략하여 보물과 자원을 빼앗았습니다. 자신의 영토를 방어하고 잃어버린 부를 되찾기 위해 용감한 고양이 전사들은 던전에 들어가 이 적들을 물리치고 영광을 되찾기로 결심했습니다.

테트리스 고양이와 던전은 슬레이 더 스파이어와 고전적인 테트리스 메커니즘을 결합한 게임입니다. 여기서 당신은 테트리스 블록을 제거하여 적에게 피해를 입히고 다양한 효과를 발동시킬 수 있습니다. 방의 모든 적을 물리친 후에는 세 가지 새로운 블록 중 하나를 선택하여 컬렉션에 추가하여 전투력을 점진적으로 증가시킬 수 있습니다.
특징
강력한 블록을 수집하고 업그레이드：몬스터와 보스를 물리쳐 블록을 획득하고 강력한 조합을 만들어보세요。독특한 전투 메커니즘：테트리스 블록을 제거하여 적에게 피해를 입히고 특수 효과를 발동시킵니다。무작위로 생성된 던전：매번 새로운 맵, 적, 놀라운 일들이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다。풍부한 이벤트와 상점：모험 중 다양한 이벤트와 상점을 만나 새로운 블록과 자원을 획득하세요。
전략적 빌딩：블록을 현명하게 조합하고 배치하여 강력한 전략을 만들어 적을 물리치고 게임을 클리어하세요。

이 모험에 참여하여 강력한 블록 조합을 구성하고 던전의 모든 적을 물리쳐 고양이 부족의 영광과 부를 되찾으세요！

title: Page Turner
description:
게임 정보
EXTRA EXTRA
This Newsie is done spreading the news—he wants to make it.
Page Turner is a classic run-and-gun platformer complete with secrets to discover, weapon pickups to collect, and boss fights to take down.
Explore 1920's BigCity as a Newsie chasing leads in pursuit of becoming an investigative journalist. Each level is inspired by a major historical event from the 1920s including the Black Sox Scandal, Prohibition, and the obscene working conditions that inspired Upton Sinclair's The Jungle.
Support Your Leads with Photographic Evidence
Find and photograph Secret Photos to support your story and rack up bonus points.
Upgrade Your Attacks
Collect unique pickups, from the homing Paper Airplane Flyers to the shaken Soda Thrower.

title: Dominova
description:
게임 정보
전략적인 도미노 배치
도미노 네트워크를 확장하여 가능한 최고의 점수를 달성하세요. 우주적 평면을 펼치고 경로를 최적화하여 최대한 많은 자원을 모으세요.
우주적 평면 관리
도미노 네트워크가 커질수록 더 취약해집니다. 각 턴마다 평면이 바뀌므로, 승리를 위해 즉흥적으로 대처해야 합니다.
자원 관리
현금을 모으고 덱을 업그레이드하며, Nova 카드를 구매해 독특한 시너지와 전략적 다양성을 창출하세요.

title: Severed Love
description:
게임 정보



Live2D 풀 애니메이션 × 360도 파노라마 탐색으로, "얀데레가 거기에 있다"체험을 맛볼 수 있는 어드벤처 게임.

애니메이션하지 않는 순간은 1초라도 존재하지 않는다.
이는 인디게임에서만 존재를 허용하는 배덕성벽의 단면도다.

한국어 번역에 기계 번역을 사용하고 있는데, 추후에 원어민 번역을 구현하고자 합니다. 당신의 성원이 필요해요!


기억을 잃고 낯선 방에서 눈을 뜬 당신은 손발이 절단되어 있었다.
한쪽 팔을 결손한 남자·"사지 절단의 악마"는, 당신을 모르는 사람의 이름으로 불러, 연인과 같이 취급해 온다.



자신의 손발을 빼앗은 상대로부터의 헌신적인 간호. 하지만 한 걸음 잘못하면 당신은 죽임을 당한다…….
공포와 스톡홀름 증후군 사이에서 요동치는 극한 상태의 감금 생활이 시작됐다.
「欠損失愛 (Severed Love)」에서는, 게임 실황 전달과 팬 아트를 환영하고 있습니다!
당신이 개인에서도 법인이라도 허락 없이 실황 배달을 할 수 있습니다.
스토리 끝까지 전달 가능하지만 일부 수집 요소의 컴플리트를 제한할 예정입니다.
동영상 투고 시에는, 작품명의 명기, 공식 사이트 또는 Steam 스토어 페이지로의 링크를 부탁드립니다.
팬아트 투고 시에는, 작품명의 명기나 해시태그 「#欠損失愛」를 사용해 주시면 감사하겠습니다.


뒤돌아보니 갑자기 얀데레 남자가 나타났다! 라는 사각지대에서의 공포.
게다가 그대로 얀데레 남자가 다가와 당신을 바라본다...!?
고가동역의 Live2D를 담은 본 작품에서 밖에 얻을 수 없는, 당신과의 거리를 한 걸음 좁히는 공포×연애 체험.

당신은 팔다리를 잃고 목줄로 구속되어 있기 때문에 돌아다니면서 탐색하는 것조차 불가능하다.
파노라마를 둘러보며 궁금한 부분을 클릭하여 관찰하고 사지 절단의 악마의 비위를 맞출 단서를 찾아봅시다.
다만, 당신이 책장의 책을 하나 읽는데도, 사지 절단의 악마를 잘 설득해서 도움을 받는 것이 필수입니다.



"사지 절단의 악마×결손 히로인"이라는 배덕적인 컨셉으로 혼자서는 살 수 없는 당신과 얀데레 남자와의 공의존, 절망적인 상황을 진하게 그립니다.

모든 것을 악인에게 의존해야 하는 절망적인 상황.
얀데레 남자와의 맞물리지 않는 대화에서는, 당신이 순종적으로 행동하면 잘 된다고는 할 수 없습니다.
당신은 증오심을 담아 정론으로 그를 몰아세우거나 오로지 폭언을 해도 좋다.
당신이 죄책감을 가질 필요는 없어요. 왜냐하면 그는 범죄자니까요.
사지 절단의 악마는 어떤 당신에게도 "한계까지" 다해줍니다.

감금만으로는 부족해！
그런 당신의 사디즘과 마조히즘을 모두 충족시키는, 성벽에 특화된 처녀 게임입니다.



다양한 죽음을 즐길 수 있는 수십 가지의 데드 엔드를 시작으로 멀티 엔딩 스토리.
데드엔드를 맞이할 때마다 입수할 수 있는 "키워드"로, 죽으면 죽을 정도로 사지 절단의 악마의 새로운 에피소드를 볼 수 있습니다.

예상치 못한 리액션에 겁을 먹고, 유대감을 느끼고, 때로는 사람을 놀리며, 감정의 롤러코스터 같은 체험을 즐길 수 있는 어드벤처 게임입니다.



일본어에서는 주인공의 1인칭을 선택 또는 자유 입력할 수 있습니다.
일본어 이외의 현지화 버전에서도 당신이 어떤 젠더로 취급되었는지를 선택할 수 있습니다.
작품 속에서 주인공의 성별은 분명하게 밝혀지지 않기 때문에 자유롭게 상상하고 즐겨 주세요.



신체결손을 비롯한 충격적인 묘사는 설정에서 순하게 할 수 있습니다.



그는 당신의 손발을 절단하고 감금하고 헌신적으로 간호하는 엽기 범죄자다.
그는 당신을 모르는 사람의 이름으로 부르며 연인처럼 행동한다.
그는 자신도 한쪽 팔을 결손했고, 새빨간 매니큐어의 섬뜩한 의수를 입어 결손에 위험한 집착을 품는다.
그는 쿨하고 퇴폐적인 분위기지만 연인에 대해 이야기할 때는 수줍게 미소를 짓는다.
그는 감금 개호 생활을 그만둘지 망설이고 있으며, 계기가 있으면 당신을 죽여 버릴지도 모른다. 그는 일촉즉발의 말기 상태의 우울증이다.




사지를 결손해 기억상실이 되어버린 주인공.
당신은 팔다리가 없어 일상생활조차 할 수 없기 때문에 사지 절단의 악마의 간호가 없으면 살아갈 수 없다.
사지 절단의 악마가 먼저 죽어버려도 당신은 아무것도 못하고 굶어죽을 뿐이다.

A. 네, 하지만 성별에 관계없이 즐기실 수 있습니다.
본 작품의 연애 대상은 1명의 남성뿐이지만, 달콤한 연애보다 Live2D 애니메이션을 완전 활용한 마음 흔드는 게임 체험과 스토리를 중시하고 있습니다.

얀데레의 남자와의 맞물리지 않는 대화는 때로는 의미심장하거나 초현실적으로 보일 수도 있을 것입니다.
불합리한 죽음의 여러가지에 절망하는 결손의 주인공을 사랑하거나 스토리를 고찰하거나, 쉬르함을 웃는 즐기는 방법도 가능한, 게임 실황 전용의 작품입니다.


A. 체험판(1화)은 풀보이스 예정입니다. 본편에도 더 많은 캐릭터 보이스 구현을 목표로 하고 있으니 응원해주시면 감사하겠습니다!
주인공은 보이스는 없고 공략대상 '사지 절단의 악마'의 보이스는 일본어 뿐입니다.


A. 뒤돌아보면 얀데레를 만나거나 갑자기 무음이 되는 등의 점프스 케어 연출을 포함합니다.
사실적인 괴물의 그래픽, 큰 소리의 비명과 같은 과격한 공포 연출은 없습니다.


A. 본작에는 시간의 루프는 없습니다만, 세이브 데이터라는 이름의 기억을 계승하는 약간의 이유가 있을지도 모릅니다.
스토리의 메인이 아니기 때문에 메타픽션을 기대하고 본 작품을 구입하는 것은 추천할 수 없습니다.


A. 신체결손이나 자살 등 충격적인 묘사를 포함합니다.
유혈을 동반한 신체 절단 등 직접적인 잔혹한 묘사는 없습니다.
신체결손을 비롯한 충격적인 묘사는 설정에서 순하게 할 수 있습니다.


A. "사지 절단의 악마"는 굉장히 신사적이고 음담패설을 굉장히 싫어합니다.
만약 당신이 그와 왜곡된 의존 관계를 키울 수 있었다면, 그런 그를 성희롱할 수 있을지도 모릅니다.


A. "欠損失愛"는 쓰레기인 죄수를 관찰하는 어드벤처 "Romp of Dump"의 if 세계선을 그린 이야기입니다.
처음이신 분은 사전 정보 없이 "欠損失愛"를 즐기시면 최대한의 놀라움으로 즐길 수 있습니다!
클리어후에 "Romp of Dump"를 놀면 사지 절단의 악마의 배덕적인 에피소드가 더욱 알차집니다!

title: Rootbound
description:
게임 정보
A physics-based action adventure about a plantling’s quest to save its home from a mysterious blight. Equipped with your sentient backpack, you venture into a broken world. Meet lost souls, solve ancient puzzles, fight dangerous monsters, and uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten civilization.
EXPLORE THE WORLD
Every corner of the handcrafted island of Akara is filled with secrets and activities. Learn what happened to the ancient civilization that once ruled the land, and make use of their lost technology. Solve puzzles to obtain powerful weapons and valuable upgrades - they will prove useful for the challenges that lie ahead.
A LIVING BACKPACK
Your backpack is much more than a simple storage for items and materials. As a sentient, but silent companion, it has a mind of its own and aids you on your journey by collecting items and tossing them to you when needed – that is, if it’s in the mood. But be careful: enemies might notice its living nature and turn their attacks on it.

title: BLOODLETTER
description:
게임 정보
블러드레터는 타로 카드, 중세 필사본, 당시의 치유 방법과 이를 둘러싼 미신에서 영감을 받은 전략 경영 덱 빌더입니다. 마을을 집어삼키는 부패와 마을의 생존 사이에 놓인 것은 목욕탕이라는 성역뿐입니다.
이발사가 되어 카드 덱을 사용해 어젯밤의 공격을 받은 마을 사람들의 마음을 치유하고 다가올 다음 날 밤을 준비하세요.
저녁에는 고통을 덜어주는 대가로 새로운 치유 방법과 독특한 덱 구성 능력을 제공합니다. 그들을 대하는 태도에 유의하세요. 그들이 당신을 신뢰하지 않는다면 그들은 당신을 돕지 않을 것입니다.

title: The Symbiant II
description:
게임 정보
잡범에 불과한 로디아스는 어느 날, 설명할 수 없는 충동에 이끌려 범죄 생활을 뒤로 하고 무작정 외진 산속으로 향합니다.
외계 내륙지를 헤매던 로디아스는 잘생긴 여행객을 만나게 되고, 그 여행자는 로디아스가 갖고 있는 많은 질문에 대한 해답을 쥐고 있다는 소생의 사원으로 그를 초대합니다.
신성한 사원에서 머무르는 동안, 로디아스는 원초적인 굶주림을 비롯해 자기 자신도 알지 못하던 자신의 비밀을 알게 됩니다. 더욱 이상하게도, 그의 마음속에선 만나는 남자들과 은밀한 관계를 맺고 싶다는, 인정하고 싶지 않은 새로운 욕망이 들끓기 시작합니다.
수수께끼와 촉수, 아름다운 남자들로 가득한 이 새로운 성인용 이야기에 흠뻑 빠져보세요!
구성 요소
20시간이 넘는 플레이 시간
50종의 CG (바리에이션 제외)
영어 전체 녹음
3명의 연애 상대 (다자연애 루트 포함)
오리지널 배경 음악
조사 미니 게임

title: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】
description:
게임 정보
Craft. Sabotage. Survive.
In a world where the Dark Overlord rules with an iron fist, one alchemist's quest for redemption becomes a divine mission of resistance.
「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】is a story-driven stealth action game that puts players in the role of Auronika Cortez, a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter in a dark medieval-industrial world.
As Auronika, you’ll help bring down the tyrants using your forbidden alchemy skills, crafting potions for the resistance and manufacturing magical bombs to directly attack your oppressors.
Outsmart the regime and turn the tides of secret war—one concoction or explosion at a time.
Key Features
Revolutionary Crafting System: Master the art of medieval chemistry through an innovative alchemy system. Combine reagents to create powerful concoctions and tools for the resistance.
Strategic Sabotage: Design and craft custom explosives. Every component affects the final result - from the blast radius to elemental effects.
Dynamic Stealth Gameplay: Navigate a vertically-stratified city where every shadow could mean survival. Dodge patrols, exploit vantage points, and escape through the underground networks of a society divided by power and privilege.
Morally Complex Narrative: Experience a story of resistance, redemption, and the price of freedom as Auronika must navigate between her heavenly mandate and the brutal realities of uprising.

title: Overrun Protocol
description:
게임 정보
OVERRUN PROTOCOL takes place in 2056, in a world where artificial intelligence has spiraled out of control. After your spaceship crashes on a mysterious island, you quickly discover that this place hides a dark secret.
Facing killer drones, armored units, and autonomous defense systems, you must explore the island, gather resources, and upgrade your equipment to survive. Use hacking to disable or hijack certain machines, access secure areas, and uncover the events that led to this catastrophe.
Key Features
🔹 Intense survival gameplay – resource management, crafting, and open-world exploration.
🔹 Strategic combat against deadly machines – use improvised weapons, traps, and hacking tools to counter the hostile AI.
🔹 An immersive environment – explore a ruined tropical island.
🔹 A deep narrative – uncover the hidden story behind the machine uprising and the true purpose of OVERRUN PROTOCOL.

title: Fading Light
description:
게임 정보
잊혀진 세계의 암흑 속을 여정한다
생존이 여러분의 지혜와 예기치 못한 동반자 스파크에 달려 있는 신비롭고 위험한 세계를 배경으로 한 메트로바니아 어드벤처 ' Fading Light (페이딩 라이트) '를 느껴보세요. 이 세계에서 생존은 당신의 지혜와 불꽃 동반자 스파크(Spark)에 달려 있습니다. 모든 그림자 속에 위협이 숨겨져 있고, 나아가는 한 걸음마다 새로운 비밀이 밝혀지는 황혼의 세계를 탐험하세요.
어둡고 험난한 이 세계에서 당신은 숨겨진 부족 출신의 생존자 노테오(Noteo)가 되어 호기심 많은 불덩이 동반자 스파크와 함께 모험을 시작하게 됩니다. 고대 유적을 탐험하고, 공포를 일으키는 생명체들과 맞서 싸우며, 암흑 속에 감춰진 고대의 신비를 밝혀내야 합니다.
게임 특징
메트로이드바니아 스타일 탐험: 서로 얽혀 있는 거대한 세계를 탐험하며, 각기 다른 독특한 환경과 생물, 도전 과제를 지닌 위험한 생물군계로 여정을 떠나세요. 이 세계는 발견을 위해 설계되어 있어, 당신은 자신만의 속도로 탐험하고, 싸우며, 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있습니다.

title: Astra Bestiary
description:
게임 정보
Uncover the mysteries of a lost civilization in this creature-collecting adventure. Inscribe your findings into a bestiary—a tome with the forgotten lore of Yselion and its creatures. With every entry, you draw closer to the truth behind the fallen empire and the Beasts that roam its ruins. Hatch, train, and forge deep bonds with unique Beasts as you face the legendary Star Trials—only the fittest will endure.


Raise 100+ Fully Animated Beasts as you guide their evolution into powerful paragons. Each Beast follows a unique path, shaped by your choices and raising. Will your companion become a ruthless Tyrant, a noble Monarch, or a cunning Archon? Every Adult Beast can be ridden!

title: Bless You Again
description:
게임 정보
“Bless You Again“
Rogue-like 3D action shooting game
Lily, a homunculus girl who is a magician, dives into a dungeon called “Tomb of Blessings” for a certain purpose.
There, she will “risk her life” to challenge the ordeal that awaits her.
Contents
3D models and animations faithfully reproduced from cell animation
Simple 3D actions such as melee attacks, mid-range magic, and aiming magic
Special move magic can be used when conditions are met!
Aim for deeper levels by conquering dungeons!
There are enemies, traps, and treasure chests in the dungeon. Explore and strengthen yourself!
Defeat enemies, gain experience, and obtain blessings to strengthen your status!
Powerful blessings may be hidden in bosses and rare treasure chests!
When your health reaches 0, you have to start over from the first level, but you can bring back only one blessing!

title: Stealer
description:
게임 정보
Stealer is a platformer with Metroidvania elements. You start the game as a thief who, just like you, understands nothing. As you explore the locations, you are immersed in darkness, but you have a precious lantern. Look for clues and interact with the environment to achieve your goals.
Game Difficulty
This is a challenging platformer. Don’t think you’ll be able to simply run past all the obstacles! Sometimes you can make things easier by tackling challenges wisely or even avoiding them altogether. However, this depends on your attentiveness and ability to analyze the situation. Stay alert and use your skills to successfully complete the game!

title: Car Cleaner Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Have you already met Little Sam, from whom you can take over the used car dealership in Car Dealer Simulator? His wife, Clever Emma, runs a small car wash right next door. Wouldn't it be nice to expand it and become the biggest and best car wash in Wingston Springs?
Start with a simple manual car wash for passenger cars and a vacuum for interior upholstery…



… and then expand your services with more car washing and cleaning options.
Your task will be to provide the best possible service for incoming vehicles, focusing on both speed and quality of service.

The game combines elements of management, work organization, and simulation. You won’t just be washing cars - you’ll also take care of the entire infrastructure, from keeping the car wash clean and regularly servicing the machines to investing in new technologies that will attract more customers.

Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your services from passenger cars to delivery vehicles or even larger machines that require a specialized approach.

Car Cleaner Simulator is fun not only for fans of business-themed simulators but also for those seeking a relaxing and satisfying experience. The game allows you to create your ideal car wash, where the quality of services, efficiency, and the wealth of your business depend entirely on your skills and strategy.

title: Liquid Lungs
description:
게임 정보
Liquid Lungs is an adrenaline-fueled first-person shooter that merges fluid parkour with high-intensity combat. Inspired by the free-running thrills of Mirror’s Edge and the fast-paced firefights of Titanfall, this dystopian adventure delivers a seamless blend of movement and marksmanship that keeps you always on the edge.
Parkour-Fueled Combat
Race across rooftops, leap between walls, and slide under obstacles while engaging in relentless gunfights. Every level is designed for swift traversal, challenging you to combine acrobatics with precise shooting.
Bullet Time and Dodge Mechanics
Channel your inner Max Payne by triggering slow-motion events and executing dodge moves. Slip past incoming attacks with pinpoint timing before retaliating with deadly precision.
Dystopian Cityscapes
Explore a near-future world dominated by towering structures and neon-lit corridors. Each location encourages creative use of your parkour skills, rewarding those who master every inch of verticality.
Arsenal and Secrets
Experiment with a broad range of weapons to match your personal style. Unlock new gear as you progress, and keep an eye out for hidden secrets that add depth and replayability to every run.

title: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of Nytland, your new home, my Liege!

Design intricate cityscapes across diverse biomes, tackle logistical challenges, and make choices that will define the fate of your people.
There are plenty of elements to build with, from towering castles to quaint hamlets. Go beyond the walls of your first settlement, across multiple regions, building many villages and growing them all into bustling cities, to create a vast trade network that spans the continent. Conquer the surrounding land to expand your area of influence. Your vision will shape an empire that stands the test of time.
RAEV pushes the boundaries of city-building—it’s a Kingdom builder, allowing you to build not just one city but many as you construct your kingdom. Every decision matters, from resource management to diplomacy, trade, and citizen welfare. Will you create a utopian paradise, a bustling economic powerhouse, or a militaristic stronghold? The fate of your kingdom is in your hands.
autokwd: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores

title: The Dark Rites of Arkham
description:
게임 정보
Detective Jack Foster rejoins the police department after a traumatic incident to take over the investigation of what appears to be mere political blackmail. Soon, however, he's faced with the discovery of a gruesome ritual murder that took place in a sealed room, from which no one could have gotten in or out without being seen. Along with his new partner, Harvey Whitman, an expert on cults, Foster dives deep into the shadows of the city of Arkham.
The case will get even darker when they find out it is related to three witches that escaped the Salem trials in 1693, and a conspiracy that could put an end to the world as we know it.

title: SUPER ADVENTURE
description:
게임 정보
SUPER ADVENTURE is a Shmup turned 2D-Platformer with great emphasis on bullet dodging, expressive boss fights and a wacky story.
ADVENTURE START
Your sleep was interrupted by aliens that destroyed your house, so you head out to find them. On your way you are given an irreplaceable item that holds great importance on your journey!
THE SHIELD:
Always active on your backside
Turn around to block
Protects you from all attacks coming your way
Additionally SUPER ADVENTURE can be mainly played in two different styles.
THE SWORD:
The sword focuses on close quarter combat and features a juggle and combo system.

title: ROCKABILLYHOSTEL
description:
게임 정보
ROCKABILLY HOSTEL is a simple walking simulator based on pixel art.
There is no concept of story and/or clear the stages.
It is just a game for you to walking around and look around the beautiful abandoned buildings and the scenery.
There is nothing more about this game but it is OK as long as the
girls and the graphics are pretty.
Two main characters can walk around seaside towns which left abandoned.
You can explore the houses, the ruins, forests, beaches and various places.
There are pretty girls live in some abandoned buildings.
There is no heart warming communication or any episode like that.
Enjoy the natural communication.

title: Robot Hospice
description:
게임 정보
For everyone who wishes to be kind, and for those who can only live with kindness.
"Robot Hospice" is a heartfelt adventure game about bidding farewell to beloved robots.
⬜︎ Welcome to Robot Hospice!
A place where cherished robots spend their final days—the Robot Hospice.
As Midori, a new staff member, you will interact with these robots, share their memories, and face both partings and self-discovery along the way.

title: PHi: The Broken Strings
description:
게임 정보
PHi is a 3D puzzle platformer that takes you on an emotional journey through 4 levels, each representing a key life experience. Solve puzzles, explore, and immerse yourself in stunning visuals and a powerful story.
The game offers over 25 creatively designed puzzles, each tested to evoke a unique emotion tied to the story.
Explore the depths of a richly crafted world in this side-scrolling puzzle platformer. With four distinct levels, each evoking a unique emotion, each level offers new challenges and hidden content. 
You are Lost! Find way on your own!

title: Et le grain mourut
description:
게임 정보
192X. As summer draws near, Parisian students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them. For years, he has been walking to school every morning with his dearest childhood friend, and has unwound with his artistic peers after class. In a week, this routine will come to a close. And recent revelations already threaten Olivier’s comfortable life.
This game is currently in development. Current graphics do not reflect the final result. The game will release simultaneously in both English and French.
Features
3 routes and a half, with various choices that may or may not have consequences
70k word count (around 25k/30k words per route)
25 items and 21 character portraits to collect, and achievements to unlock!
Historical urban fantasy of the angel variety...?

title: Insectile
description:
게임 정보
Find bugs, catch bugs, and piece bugs together! Explore a huge, whimsical world as a little mushroom in this clever, turn-based RPG about puzzlingly-shaped insects!
Find Bugs
These creatures we call “Insectiles” hide under every rock and within every crevice! Finding them is not so easy when you are small. Explore giant gardens, uncover secret pathways, and hop across lily pads in search of each and every Insectile!
Catch Bugs
Every Insectile is a potential teammate! Collecting them all will require careful observation of their behavior: Bring tasty snacks, chase energetic crickets, morph new species, and even dodge wasp stingers to grapple these unique creatures!

title: Chemist Wanted
description:
게임 정보
“Chemist Wanted” 에서 제작은 단순히 몇 가지 재료를 모으고 “제작”을 클릭하는 것이 아닙니다. 화합물을 만들려면 다양한 재료와 공정을 결합하여 원하는 결과를 얻어야 합니다. 여기에는 반응, 용해, 침전, 추출, 증발, 여과 또는 심지어 이 모든 과정이 포함될 수 있습니다. 최상의 조합을 찾으려면 많은 실험을 수행하고 지식을 쌓아야 합니다. 당신이 충분히 기술을 갖고 있다면, 당신만의 한적한 열대 섬에서 조기 퇴직을 위한 충분한 돈을 벌 수 있을 것입니다!

특징:
고부가가치 물질 합성을 위한 현실적인 화학 기반 시스템입니다
다양한 출발 물질 및 합성 단계로 인해 올바른 경로를 밝히기 위해서는 세심한 연구가 필요합니다
화학과 다양한 프로세스 사용 방법을 가르쳐 주는 비디오 라이브러리에 연결된 새로운 기술을 점진적으로 잠금 해제하세요
누구 밑에서 일하기로 선택했는지에 따라 흥미로운 스토리라인이 펼쳐집니다
빠른 속도로 발전하는 기술 스타트업, 거대 기업, 수상한 마약상, 아니면 그냥 자신을 위한 회사입니다! 모든 장비, 화학 물질 재고, 제품 재고, 카탈로그된 반응, 측정된 특성 등을 관리할 수 있는 사용하기 쉽고 직관적인 UI입니다
화학 기술을 마스터하려는 사람들에게는 점점 더 어려워지는 과제입니다

화학물질을 자유롭게 실험해 보세요
반응기를 설정하고 두 개의 출발 물질을 추가한 후 무슨 일이 일어나는지 확인하세요! 액체와 고체를 결합하여 용액을 만들고, 용매와 이온 교환을 사용하여 특정 성분을 분리하고, 혼합물을 증발시켜 침전을 유도하는 등 가능성은 사실상 무한합니다.

자신만의 방식으로 플레이하세요
당신의 선택에 따라 게임 경험이 달라집니다. 기업에 근무하면 배송 목표를 엄격하게 정하고 배송 지연에 따른 처벌을 가하지만 급여는 괜찮은 편이다. 범죄 조직과 협력하면 절도나 그보다 더 나쁜 표적이 될 수 있지만 급여는 엄청날 수 있습니다. 또는 실험하고 자신만의 길을 찾으세요.

실제 화학적 변형을 배우세요
연구를 통해 다양한 프로세스를 사용할 수 있는 능력을 확보하세요. 원자 수준의 고유한 시각적 요소로 각 개념을 명확하게 설명하는 상세한 라이브러리를 살펴보세요. 이러한 기술을 이해하면 원하는 결과를 효과적으로 달성하기 위해 언제 적용해야 하는지 알 수 있습니다.

복잡성 증가
최고 가치의 제품을 생산하려면 다양한 기술을 사용하여 여러 가지 출발 물질을 결합해야 합니다. 가능한 조합의 수를 수천 개로 늘리면 게임이 점점 더 어려워집니다! 속성과 상호 작용은 재생 가능성을 최대화하기 위해 절차적으로 생성됩니다.

현재로서는 게임을 한국어로 번역할 계획이 없습니다.

title: Spellsided
description:
게임 정보
Spellsided is a turn-based single-player RPG that comes with a new, puzzling twist on deck-builders - it’s a dice-builder!
Join our Discord community and follow us on YouTube via the links in the sidebar to stay up to date with development!
DISCOVER SPELLS
Play as a fully-customisable magical die named Hex, who has been discarded by the Gods of the Tabletop. Cast your spells with every step as you navigate a fantasy world of toppling dominoes, warring chess pieces, and conniving cards.

title: Mechs and Muskets
description:
게임 정보
Step into an alternate history of the Napoleonic Wars, where towering mechs change the course of battle.
Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG that blends the grandeur of Napoleonic warfare with the power of mechanized combat. As a French soldier caught in the midst of a fierce continental war, you'll command a team of customizable mechs, each equipped with unique parts and powerful abilities. With a turn-based combat system, strategic depth, and a story driven by choices, you’ll need to outmaneuver, outsmart, and outfight your enemies on the battlefield.
In this alternate timeline, both men and machines clash in an epic struggle for domination. Will you lead your squad to victory in the Emperor's name, or will you be crushed under the weight of steel and gunpowder?
- Tactical, Turn-Based Combat: Plan each move carefully as you lead your team of customizable mechs in intense, strategic battles. Positioning, timing, and teamwork are key to success.
- Deep Customization: Build and upgrade your squad with unique mech parts. Equip them with different weapons, armor, and abilities to adapt to your playstyle or counter your enemies’ strategies.

title: Danchi Days
description:
게임 정보
In this Summer Neighborvania Adventure, in an old danchi (Japanese housing complex), there used to be a yearly summer festival. Alas, the residents have aged, and the once-loved tradition is now on hold. But one girl, Hoshino, decides to revive it. Hand out flyers to let everyone know the festival’s back!
There’s 100 people to invite, from all walks of life! Some might agree to go immediately - but others have problems to solve. It's not necessary to invite everyone, but the more, the merrier!

title: Umbra's Cauldron
description:
게임 정보
The gameplay shown is from an early stage of development.
Umbra's Cauldron is a 2D card-stacking game in which you take on the role of an alchemist.
Had I mixed a bloodroot or a drop of honey into my tincture? Oh well, it'll all go wrong... Or at least that's what you thought. Now you find yourself as a book in a magical world, trying to regain your original form with the help of powerful potions and lots of unexplored recipes. But don't worry, you're not alone. Crawly critters will be by your side on your journey.
Will you be able to discover all the card, fill your empty pages and transform back?
Stack Cards
Draw, stack and combine cards to collect resources, discover recipes and brew unique potions.
Living Book
You have turned into a book. All the cards you discover and recipes you find are written down on your pages. If you fill your empty pages completely, you might find a way to turn back.
Features
Everything is a card

title: Aegis Force: The Scorian War
description:
게임 정보
Tactical victory or agonizing defeat… The choice is yours —
Battle your way through the continent of Ianua with your force of heroes in tactical combat encounters that take place on a grid, reminiscent of games such as Fire Emblem, Final Fantasy Tactics and Shining Force. 
As Callon, use the powers of a Tactimagus to make every move count. Utilize a myriad of spells, attacks, and abilities across your ever-expanding team to forge your victory across dozens of increasingly complex strategic battles.

title: Night Mafia
description:
게임 정보
Night Mafia: Immerse Yourself in the World of a Thrilling TV Show
Game Description:
"Night Mafia" is a unique multiplayer game that will make you lie to your friends and doubt their words. Even your closest ally may turn out to be the mafia, and only your deduction skills can reveal the traitor hiding among you.
Lore:
On the brink of poverty, you couldn’t pay off your debts, leaving you with no choice but to participate in the terrifying "Night Mafia" show, which might be your only way out. But everything comes at a price.




Gameplay:
Every day you survive is simply luck that you haven’t been betrayed by friends or killed by the mafia. Your victory depends solely on you, but without others' trust, it will be hard to succeed alone.
In Night Mafia, each day, each action, and each choice impacts the game’s final outcome. The game consists of three sessions, each serving as a key to your survival or demise.
Day Session
The game begins during the day. Your goal is to locate vending machines on the map, obtain items from them, and participate in mini-games scattered around the area. The mini-games are diverse: some require teamwork, while others can be completed alone. The more challenging the mini-game and the better you perform, the more valuable the reward. Time management is crucial for success during the day. If you don’t obtain the necessary items before the session ends, it could lead to fatal consequences, as surviving the night without protection will be tough. Your responsibilities also vary depending on the role assigned to you, but the main goal for each resident remains the same: prepare for the night.

title: Step into the Dark
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to HopeTown — a grim underground world where remnants of human civilization fight for survival among the ruins of an ancient prison.

You will:
Explore the Ruins of the Old Prison: Delve into dark corridors and abandoned cells where every corner hides its own secrets and dangers. Discover places where dramatic events once unfolded.
Fight Dangerous Enemies: Overcome confrontations with various threats that remain in the prison after the rebellion. Use your skills and available weapons to survive in this perilous place.
Solve Mysteries and Find Hidden Elements: Collect useful items, explore deserted corners, and uncover secrets that will aid you in your journey.
Key Features:
Immersive Combat System: Experience thrilling battles using a variety of weapons and unique mechanisms created by the Order of Mechanics.

title: Incoherence
description:
게임 정보
Alex’s quiet life in a small, unassuming town begins to unravel as strange and impossible events take hold. Neighbors disappear, buildings shift overnight, and creatures that shouldn’t exist begin to roam the streets. Something sinister is at work, and Alex must uncover the truth before the town—and himself—are consumed by the madness.
Inspired by classics like Silent Hill and System Shock, Incoherence is a survival exploration game set in a sprawling, open-world town. Scavenge for resources, craft tools, and uncover clues to navigate a reality that seems to bend and break with each passing moment. As Alex pieces together the fragments of this eerie mystery, he must confront the terrifying connection between himself and the forces at play.
In a world where reality itself is the enemy, the answers may come at a cost Alex isn’t prepared to pay.
Key Features
Immerse yourself in a first-person adventure, rich in detail and atmosphere.
Equip a variety of classic weapons, each with unique strengths and abilities.
Interact with complex NPCs, adding depth to the unfolding story.
Encounter diverse monsters, testing your combat skills and strategies.
Evolve your character through RPG elements, with leveling and skill trees.
Tailor your arsenal with weapon upgrades to suit your playstyle.
Unearth blueprints and use found materials to craft vital resources.
Explore computer systems and find notes that piece together the game's narrative and open new pathways.
Overcome challenges by repairing and hacking robots and security systems.
Collect in-game currency scattered throughout the world for use at various vendors.

title: Screamer
description:
게임 정보
열망, 야망, 복수.
신념을 위해 맞서 싸우고, 그것이 싸울 가치가 있다는 사실을 증명하세요. 세상에서 가장 가혹한 레이싱 대회와 수수께끼의 대회 마스터 뒤에 감춰진 어두운 진실을 밝혀내는 것이 모든 Screamer의 사명입니다.
극한의 레이싱과 결투 메커니즘이 결합된 전투를 시작하고, 인상적인 캐릭터가 등장하는 매력적인 이야기를 진행하세요. 도로에서 멋진 차를 몰고 애니메이션에서 영감을 받은 세상에 숨겨진 비밀을 알아내세요.

title: Cryptica
description:
게임 정보
Cryptica is a narrative-based psychological horror game where the apocalypse is only the beginning. Explore the enigmatic lands of Antarctica and its surrounding areas while the world ends.
Play as Ari Harper, as he desperately attempts to find his missing sister, who has disappeared with a film crew while making a documentary in Antarctica. Uncover unfathomable horrors, discover ancestral secrets, and find your sister at all costs.
Player Freedom
Players can explore in 1st or 3rd-person modes in massive rustic and surreal environments. Go forth and explore freely.

title: No Vacation  an Executioner
description:
게임 정보
About
It's a story about a frustrated executioner in late 17th century. He felt sick at his job and ran away from the gallows. It aroused a riot of monsters, he had to clean up this cruel mess, and find out the truth about the "Gloomy Oil" of this crazy world.
It's a Retro PS2 style Survival Horror Action-RPG, you will use various skill to survive, beat your enemy and explore forward.
Inspired by the Book : The Hangman of Paris by Claude Cueni, and the Paintings of Zdzisław Beksiński. (But it's a story nothing about any Sanson family)
About the Control
Recommended to use gamepad such as Xbox controler or PS DualShock. Keyboard players can also use Arrow Keys to control the camera. If using mouse, please trigger the "Use mouse" option at "Config" menu.
(It's a retro PS2 style, slow action battle system for the survival mechanic and for crafting a better atmosphere, not a "quick-action game". Please notice before purchasing.)

title: Skylark 64
description:
게임 정보


The leaves of The World's Tree have begun to fall! And you need to get them back!

Play as Skylark, A flying squirrel who must save The World's Tree from King Murasaki! You must collect all of the Soul Leaves before It's too late! Can you collect them all?




You don't have to go alone though! Have a friend play as Aerial, Skylark's sister in split-screen co-op for twice the fun!

title: ISO-CORE
description:
게임 정보
The Game is in development, So the name and/or important aspects of the game may change before release.
Explore a procedurally generated 2D isometric pixel art world. Build And Craft your own base, find new places and biomes, fight mobs and expand your world.

title: Page Turner
description:
게임 정보
EXTRA EXTRA
This Newsie is done spreading the news—he wants to make it.
Page Turner is a classic run-and-gun platformer complete with secrets to discover, weapon pickups to collect, and boss fights to take down.
Explore 1920's BigCity as a Newsie chasing leads in pursuit of becoming an investigative journalist. Each level is inspired by a major historical event from the 1920s including the Black Sox Scandal, Prohibition, and the obscene working conditions that inspired Upton Sinclair's The Jungle.
Support Your Leads with Photographic Evidence
Find and photograph Secret Photos to support your story and rack up bonus points.
Upgrade Your Attacks
Collect unique pickups, from the homing Paper Airplane Flyers to the shaken Soda Thrower.

title: Port Valley
description:
게임 정보
Port Valley is a (not so) classic Point & Click adventure game where perspective changes everything! Witness Port Valley's Election Day from three different points of view: An extremely lazy Asian food delivery guy, a mysterious female plumber… and someone else.

One by one, these unusual "heroes" will be forced to interrupt their boring everyday lives and get ready for action before it's just too late. Work, revenge, political conspiracies, a banana balloon… it seems everything was meant to clash on this specific day.

It's finally time to overcome the crossed paths of Port Valley’s singular citizens and unfold the obscure plot that is tying together these apparently unrelated stories.
Some Key Features

3 plots, 3 main characters, 3 mayoral candidates… 3 chances to unfold a bigger and complex story.
A renewed (yet classic!) Point & Click interface.
A light-hearted, comical tone with annoying self-aware humor. (Which doesn't necessarily mean this is just a comedy *wink* *wink*.)
Even more annoying puzzles with different ways to solve them. For real.
Active NPCs. They also have objectives, they're not 'just there' to give you stuff.
It's surprisingly not about detectives. (I swear it's legal in this genre.)
There's a dog...?
The 2022 DEMO
It's an hour-long experience with all-new content focused on gameplay, animations and the new UI.
The puzzles and the plot have been simplified so it can be played as an independent thing. Please, don't judge the game's difficulty just yet!

title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis
description:
게임 정보
UNDEFEATED: Genesis is a superhero action game where you can soar freely through the skies of an alien world and unleash awesome powers. You will take down giant enemies in huge, destructible environments using your incredible abilities. This is the ultimate superhero experience!

Story
You are an ordinary college student leading an unremarkable existence when you are struck by a meteor. You awaken on a mysterious planet where you discover you have been bestowed with incredible powers.



This planet once had a civilization far more advanced than Earth’s, but a massive explosive incident ravaged it centuries before, leaving it plagued by destructive mutants. Now you must stand up for the remaining survivors of this world and use your awesome powers to rid the planet of its violent and catastrophic blight.

We are Indie-us Games, an independent development studio of Unreal Engine professionals based in Osaka, Japan. We are big fans of superhero stories and we want to create an experience that makes you feel just as powerful as your favourite comic or manga heroes.


Our first project was , a 2019 superhero game developed by three students, which we released for free on Steam. After we gained experience in the video game industry we reunited at Indie-us Games to begin work on the sequel to ...
is that sequel! It will be the first title in a trilogy of Unreal Engine 5 games paying homage to superheroes while telling an expansive story.

Wishlist now!

title: The Occultist
description:
게임 정보

특징
신비로운 펜듈럼: 앨런에게 가장 중요한 물건입니다. 다섯 가지의 고유한 방식을 통해, 앨런은 펜듈럼으로 주변과 상호작용하고 변화를 일으킵니다.
일인칭 액션: 앨런 레벨스의 눈으로 불길한 The Occultist의 세계를 경험하고, 펜듈럼을 사용해 갓스톤에서 있었던 일의 진상을 밝히세요.
서바이벌 호러: The Occultist는 긴장감 넘치는 탐험과 분위기, 친밀하고 개인적인 내러티브 등 장르의 모든 요소를 갖추고 있습니다.
차세대 그래픽: The Occultist의 뛰어난 레벨과 그래픽 품질은 몰입감 넘치는 공포스런 경험을 선사합니다.
은신과 잠입: 앨런은 적들과 직접 싸워서는 안됩니다. 은신 시스템을 이용해 적들의 기습을 피하며 스토리를 전개해 나가야 합니다.
인상적인 캐릭터: 갓스톤에는 조사를 악몽으로 만들어 줄 다양한 캐릭터들이 등장합니다.
퍼즐: 직관적인 퍼즐부터 오컬트에 대한 지식과 통찰을 요구하는 복잡한 퍼즐까지 다양하게 준비되어 있습니다.
사운드트랙: 유명 작곡가 Pepe Herrero가 The Occultist의 사운드트랙을 담당했습니다.


The Occultist에서, 이상 현상 조사관인 앨런 레벨스는 자신의 아버지가 갑자기 사라진 이유를 찾기 위해 신비한 갓스톤 섬으로 찾아갑니다. 아버지는 수십 년 동안 섬 이야기를 했지만, 앨런이 아는 것은 아버지가 그곳에서 태어나 유년기를 보냈다는 것뿐이었습니다.

하지만 앨런은 혼자가 아닙니다. 그는 이전 조사 때마다 가지고 다녔던, 기원을 알 수 없는 신비한 펜듈럼을 가지고 다닙니다. 정체불명의 갓스톤 섬에 유일하게 남겨진 듯한 안개 낀 거리와 광기 어린 건물들을 돌아다니며 점점 분명해지는 것은... 이번 일은 그 어떤 사건과도 다를 거라는 사실입니다.

갓스톤에서는 1950년까지 사악한 종교 단체가 거주하며 불쾌한 실험과 잔인한 의식을 거행했습니다.그 이후로 오늘날까지 누구도 이 섬에 발을 들이지 않았습니다. 앨런은 이상 현상에 관한 재능을 활용해 갓스톤의 거리와 건물에 얽매여 있는 듯한 영혼들과 소통하거나, 모든 방법을 동원해 분노한 그들로부터 피해야 합니다.

이상 현상 조사관인 앨런 레벨스에게 이런 일들은 낯설지 않습니다. 하지만 신비한 갓스톤 섬과 아버지의 실종에 관한 답을 찾으려는 그의 여정은 앨런의 능력을 시험대에 올립니다. 갓스톤은 오컬트 세상에서 가능한 일에 대한 앨런의 신념을 그 어떤 조사보다도 크게 흔들어 놓습니다. 어쩌면 갓스톤에는 풀어야 할 저주가 숨어 있을 수 있습니다... 하지만 그래야 하는 걸까요?

title: Beautiful Light
description:
게임 정보
인디 개발사인 Deep Worlds가 개발한 격렬한 PvPvP 익스트랙션 슈팅 게임 Beautiful Light의 거친 세계로 들어서세요. 기동타격대의 대원으로 성장하거나, 다른 플레이어의 레이드를 무시무시한 이상현상으로 방해해 보세요. 눈길을 사로잡는 그래픽이 돋보이는 Beautiful Light는 몰입감, 호러, 전술 게임플레이에 집중한 게임입니다. 이 게임은 가파른 학습곡선을 적용해 플레이어를 극한으로 밀어붙여 스릴 넘치는 환경에서 자신의 능력을 시험해 볼 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

진입하고, 확보하고, 탈출하세요.
// 진입

진입 지역에 맞설 준비를 단단히 하고, 신비로운 아티팩트를 찾거나 퀘스트를 완료하세요. 다양한 무기, 방어구, 보조화기로 무장하고 두 명의 대원과 팀을 이루세요. 전승, 방해물, 위험으로 가득 찬 적대적인 환경에 진입해 탐험하세요. 적 대원과 기괴한 이상현상이 여러분을 쓰러뜨리기 위해서라면 뭐든지 할 것입니다. 각 레이드는 고유한 속성을 지니니, 미지의 세계에 맞설 준비를 하세요.
// 확보

아티팩트는 이용할 수 있는 다양한 속성을 지닙니다. 이토록 황폐한 세계에서 자원 이용은 곧 도시의 생존과 직결되죠. 아티팩트는 매우 귀중하니 누구보다 먼저 확보해야 합니다. 여러분의 앞길을 가로막는 모든 적을 제거해야만 하죠. 누군가 이 아티팩트를 손에 넣었나요? 아티팩트를 확보하는 이가 여러분이 되도록 하세요.

죽게 되면 임무는 실패하고, 손에 넣은 모든 것을 잃게 됩니다. 일단 조명탄을 쏘고 구출 헬기를 부르고, 무언가가 여러분을 처치하기 전에 탈출하세요. 아티팩트가 있든 없든 말이죠. 어찌되었든 때론 당신의 목숨은 이상한 돌이나 친구보다 더 소중합니다. 구출 헬기가 도착할 때까지 살아남고 숨어 있는 다른 위협에 주의하세요.

게임을 진행하려면 퀘스트를 완료하고, 아티팩트를 확보하고 살아서 탈출하세요. 상인들이 임무를 완료하기를 기다리고 있습니다. 그들을 실망시키지 마세요. 두둑한 보상을 챙겨줄 테니까요. RPG 게임 같은 테크트리에서 보상을 현명하게 사용하여 캐릭터 레벨을 올리고 기술을 향상시키거나, 상인에게서 다음 레이드를 위한 무기와 희귀한 장비를 구매하세요.

이형체로서의 목표는 플레이어를 사냥하고, 죽이고, 먹어 치워 그들이 유물을 가지고 탈출하는 것을 막는 것입니다. 이형체를 해방하고 가능한 많은 플레이어를 먹어 경험치를 획득하세요. 기술을 향상시키고 더 많은 능력을 얻으며 새로운 괴물 같은 이형체들을 잠금 해제하세요.

title: Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel
description:
게임 정보
There is something very wrong. Or did you just misremember things?
-Take a journey through a strange land with some point-and-click elements, meeting a variety of odd, object-headed citizens as you investigate.
-Let a bizarre mystery unfold as you help Marion find a way to keep her entire world from slipping between her hands.
autokwd: Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel

title: CBS: The Beginning
description:
게임 정보
Today, we're attempting to make a come back with another new, unique title, trying to grasp your attention and earn your praise with a fresh cbs game.
Plot
This time it is a turn based rpg, where you will be in charge of your own character in pursuit of freedom and survival through out the game world, helping Gemme, Waett and the Babysitter in their quest to redeem the city and perhaps figure out what has happened to the world and even find out a way to fix it.
Features
Create, customize your characters, choose from 3 primary enhancement classes
Level up, with generated equipments gather inventory and equip them to fight in melee
Fight your way through the story of disasters and heroism
Engage in dialogue with characters in visit mode stages, gain rewards and expand your group
Fight in endless melee maps waves ranging from 7 to 70

title: CANDY HOUSE in the DARK FOREST
description:
게임 정보
"당신 이야기의 주인공이 되기 위해 모든 것을 바치겠습니다. 설령 대본에서 악역으로 등장하게 되더라도 말이죠."
버려진 헨젤과 그레텔은 달콤한 향기를 따라 과자 집에 도착했습니다. 이상하게도... 과자 집은 좋은 것들로 가득 차 보이지만, 기이한 분위기가 감돌고 있습니다. 두 사람은 변덕스러운 인형, 장난기 많은 테디베어들, 파악하기 어려운 진저브레드 쌍둥이, 그리고 수수께끼에 싸인 마녀를 만납니다...
이곳의 디저트는 배를 채우는 것뿐만 아니라 여러 수수께끼를 풀어내는 열쇠이기도 합니다.
레시피를 개발하고, 재료를 모아 다양한 마법의 디저트를 만들어 디저트 도감에 기록하세요!
무기로 사용할 수 있는 디저트, 지능을 높이는 디저트, 심지어 모습을 바꿀 수 있는 디저트도 있으며, 신비한 생물을 불러올 수도 있습니다.
그들의 모든 발걸음에는 위험이 도사리고 있으며, 매번의 선택이 이야기의 방향을 바꿀 것입니다.
과연 헨젤과 그레텔은 달콤한 설탕 코팅 아래 숨겨진 어두운 음모를 밝혀낼 수 있을까요?
autokwd: CANDY HOUSE in the DARK FOREST,Candy House in the Dark Forest

title: Adanath
description:
게임 정보
Adanath is a narrative driven, combat oriented game with RPG elements where you are Adanath, a simple man with a fate sealed by Sumerian gods, venturing into the abyss of unknown to save his lost love & his soul.

In the game players will follow steps of Nina, Adanath’s lost wife. As Adanath ventures into the unknown, he will fight enemies, sometimes friends, and develop his skills & weapons.

With each battle won, Adanath’s story will reveal, and Adanath will follow the story where he will learn his fate was sealed before time, and before human kind
walked the realm.

Narrative Driven
With every battle won & puzzle solved, Adanath will learn more about himself, possess new skills & weaponry, developing into a skilled warrior from a simple city man.


Unique Combat
In every fight, player must find a unique way to defy death. As player progresses through levels, fight after fight, he will need to upgrade his defensive & offensive abilities, as well as equipment, finally into an arsenal that is designed by gods, for gods.



To create an immersive & re-playable game and a memorable transformation experience from ancient Sumerian technology to deity-created technology, we blended creative design with ultra realistic graphic elements in 2.5D, to give the player a strong bonding feeling with the protoganist.
