Every stage in Nosher is a wondrous labyrinth of secrets waiting for you to discover. The only issue is poor Nosher can't reach the secrets.

Nosh on a bat, gain the ability to fly. Nosh on a skeleton, gain the ability to smash the big rock. Nosh on a spider, explore the verticle landscape of each stage. Nosher is a puzzle platformer that rewards you for exploring; whether that's with a hidden collectible to achieve a platinum score or a giant bat to make friends with.

Nosh on These Berries
Nother is built off the love for the golden age of puzzle platformers. Berries in Nosher are so much more than berries, they are life. Collecting them will not only provide a 'second chance' for Nosher, but they're also a key part of achieving a high score on each stage.

Collectibles are nice, but they're not everything. Every stage in Nosher offers four tiers for rewards; bronze, silver, gold, and platinum. To prove you're the best in noshing you'll need to combine stage knowledge, speedrunning, and some cheeky tactics to claim the top prize.

title: Dragon Spirits 0
description:
게임 정보
Overview
This is a 3 VS 3 creature collector turn-based RPG with dozens of Dragon Spirits to collect.
In battle, every point of damage and healing value will attract "Aggro", causing one of your Dragon Spirit to be focused by the enemy.
You need to arrange the Build reasonably, protect the healer and attacker to win.
Plot
Ralph, the main character, is fed up with the dull routine of school and decides to hop on his dad's automatic ship to the paradise - DS Islands.
DS Islands is the site of a prehistoric civilization that was discovered in 20XX and shocked the world.
There, people have no life limit, and use magical "Spells" to command a creature called "Dragon Spirits" and live a peaceful life.
Actually, DS Islands is an area opened up on the Earth by Andes, the creator of our three-dimensional world and the executor of the Big Bang.
Andes created the illusion of dinosaur extinction and teleported them to the DS Islands.
Under the influence of Andes' energy, dinosaurs gradually turned into Dragon Spirits with magical powers.
In order to prevent being discovered by outsiders, Andes created a barrier to protect the DS Islands.
Only people who know that area can enter, otherwise time and space will be warped.
In 20XX, human civilization finally came into contact with the civilization on the DS Islands...

This game is the origin of the Dragon Spirits series. It was completed in 2010 (approximately). The quality isn't worth charging for. I posted it on Steam as a self-reminder.
1. Don't be too obsessed with marketing.
Marketing plays a big role, just as good wine also needs a bush. But numbers are only numbers. I read on a forum that if you focus too much on numbers, they lose their effectiveness as a tool. So, focus on what's important and give it your all.
2. Don't be too obsessed with game quality.
Game quality matters a lot too, good quality shows my responsibility for players. But creators also need to be responsible for themselves. I should create games that can sustain a healthy attitude over time. It's okay to make trash, at worst, release it as a free-to-play.

In 2010, when Shanghai was hosting the World Expo, Pokémon did not have an official Chinese version, and Yu-Gi-Oh cards were printed by ZZ Youth Pavilion.
Everyone's copyright awareness was relatively weak. We gathered in forums and made various games with RPG Maker in our spare time.
Back then, there were not even many platforms to upload games, and we used Drive to ship games. A game had only a little downloads, dozens of downloads for the better ones, and close to a thousand downloads for the most.
I developed this game in such an environment. Almost all the players were classmates. At that time, the series was not even named "Dragon Spirits".
Now it seems that this game is so stupid. I don't know why I thought I did a good job back then. It's not that I haven't played popular games when I was a child, but I just wouldn't compare them with my own works.

In 2024, Dragon Spirits' engine was upgraded to Unity, one of the most used commercial game engines, and the game was indeed played by many people, even made money.

title: B-17 Squadron
description:
게임 정보
현실감 넘치는 폭격기 시뮬레이터에서 B-17을 조종하세요. 폭탄을 투하해 주요 목표를 파괴하세요.
승무원에게 명령을 내리고 스트레스와 긴장감을 느껴보세요. 점령된 유럽을 누비며 역사적인 작전에 참여하세요.

주요 특징:
B-17 승무원을 통솔하세요.
모든 분대원을 직접 컨트롤하세요.
목표물을 파괴하세요.
적과 맞서 싸우세요.
폭격기 부대 전체에 명령을 내리세요.



강력한 전투기, 강인한 부대
전투기는 완벽하게 무장되어있고, 많은 화물을 싣고 있습니다.
그러나, 최고의 무장과 장비를 갖춘 전투기가 있어도 효율적인 승무원이 없으면 성공적인 팀이 될 수 없죠.
기장 또는 조종사로서 조종석에서 강력한 전투기를 컨트롤하는 동시에 비행 파라미터, 엔진 회전 속도, 날개 플랩을 조절하십시오.
무선통신실에서 보고를 보내거나 받고, 지도를 연구하면서 비행 중대를 목적지까지 이끌어가세요.





폭탄을 투하해서 타겟이 제거되었습니다.
하지만 작전이 끝난 것은 아닙니다. 사령관으로서 다른 임무에 참여하려면 폭격기와 부대원들을 귀환시켜야 합니다. 어려운 일이죠, 특히 전투기에 손상이 있을 때는 말입니다.
전투기가 손상되는 모습을 보면 긴장감이 느껴질 겁니다.
전투기가 수명을 다하면 부대원들 역시 끝장이라는 사실을 알고 있으니까요. 하지만, 폭격기에 기술병이 타고 있다는 사실을 기억하십시오. 가지고 있는 자원을 창의적으로 활용해 문제를 해결해야 합니다.





편대를 노리는 대공포와 메서슈미트 중대 말고도 신경 써야 할 문제는 많습니다.
연료, 탄약, 폭탄 수량에도 주의를 기울여야 합니다.
고도가 높아지면 산소 공급에도 신경을 써야 하죠. 부대원들이 마스크를 썼는지 다시 확인하세요.
이따금 공항까지 도달하는 데 필요한 연료를 확보하기 위해 화물 일부를 희생해야 할 수도 있습니다.
엔진 화재, 바퀴 고장, 막힌 폭탄 해치 등등 다양한 결함도 해결해야 합니다.





폭격기는 호화롭게 즐기는 일등석 휴가와는 다릅니다. 승무원의 생활 환경은 불편할 겁니다. 스트레스와 아드레날린 수시로 상승하며, 생존하기 위해 끊임없이 고군분투해야 합니다.
무기가 대공포와 적기의 공격에도 살아남는 데 도움이 될 겁니다.

적절한 전투대형을 유지하면 방어력이 올라갑니다. 12대의 폭격기는 적군이 가장 노리기 어려운 목표입니다. 임무를 완수하기 위해 편대 전체를 컨트롤할 수 있습니다.

행운을 빕니다, 기장님!

title: Aeronesia
description:
게임 정보
Description



Following a bizarre incident, you find yourself trapped in a barely habitable world of floating continents. You're not the first to end up here - over the centuries, hundreds of other people have been transported into Aeronesia as well with nothing more than the items they had on them at the time. And in a world without food, equipment, and law... those other people may be more of a threat than any other danger you might face.

You're not trying to save this world, you're trying to leave it.
Main Features

Aeronesia is a non-linear platform RPG with heavy emphasis on:

Exploration, player freedom, and worldbuilding
Quest-based progression, with the player deciding whether and how to approach the tasks they're given
Combat featuring melee weapons and firearms, as well as traps and thrown items
Character customization through equipment and perks
Dialogue with varying outcomes and a choice of factions to work for or against
Factions, locations and phenomena whose history and nature you discover over time
Detailed pixel art graphics and animations
Dark humour

title: Schoolmare
description:
게임 정보


Schoolmare 는 선생님과 사랑에 빠지는 서바이벌 호러 게임입니다. 하지만 그것은 함정이었습니다... 당신은 끔찍한 괴물에게 죽임을 당하지 않고 학교에서 나가야 합니다.

이 으스스한 분위기는 당신을 깨어 있게 할 것입니다: 학교에서 나가려면 열쇠와 기타 아이템을 찾아야 합니다. 그러나 쉽지 않을 것입니다. 무섭고 뚱뚱하고 콧수염이 난 괴물에게 쫓기게 될 것입니다.

당신의 탈출 전략을 생각해보세요

탐색
위치를 탐색하고 숨을 수 있는 장소를 찾으십시오.

수집
건강, 체력 등을 보충하기 위해 여분의 아이템을 수집하십시오.

생존
살아남고 괴물에게 잡히지 말고 최대한 빨리 달리십시오.


이 선생님은 그녀가 가장한 사람이 아니었습니다. 그녀는 당신이 어디에 있는지 알고 있으며 당신이 아무리 잘 숨어도 당신을 찾을 것입니다. 그러나 그녀는 예기치 않게 당신을 공격하기 위해 아주 잘 숨을 수 있습니다.

Whether for good or ill, the future of the world of Yggdrasil will depend on the will of the players. Become an emperor, an adventurer, a mercenary or a simple merchant.
Steal money and other items from your comrades, slaughter your prey, or bring justice to the edge of your sword.
In Yggdrasil, death has an impact and consequences, and every action must be carefully considered, especially when visiting the many deadly trap dungeons...

Free World in 3D
A death with consequences
Possibility of destroying the world
Possibility to create weapons, armors, items
Various basic and hidden classes
Freedom to do evil (kill, steal... from players)
Very difficult and hardcore game

title: Virnap
description:
게임 정보

Virnap is a 3D horror game planned to release in 2023 made primarily for VR that will get you into a nightmare chosen from its library of 40 nightmares for 20 different fears



Will the game be ported to PC?
Yes. We plan to make a PC release around a month after the game's VR release.

Will it have an options menu for lower-end computers?
It will have a highly customizable options menu for graphics that you can customize however you like for it to fit your computer.

When will it release?
We will release a free demo on Steam around mid to late 2023. And a full release in late 2023 or 2024.

Which fears will it contain?
Here are some examples of the phobias contained in the game:

Arachnophobia (Fear of Spiders)
Scopophobia (Fear of Being Watched or Stared At)
Nyctophobia (Fear of Darkness)
Acrophobia (Fear of Heights)
Cynophobia (Fear of Dogs)
Entomophobia (Fear of Insects)
Claustrophobia (Fear of Enclosed Spaces)
Pteromerhanophobia (Fear of Flying)
Somniphobia (Fear of Sleeping)

Of course, these are not all. Right now the game is on its early development right now.
